Thimnak in ti thukpi cu a khuh ih, Pathian ih Thlarau cu tipi parah a leng."},"3":{"text":"Cun Pathian in, “Tleunak um seh,” ti ah a ti ih tleunak cu a um."},"4":{"text":"Pathian in a zoh tikah a ṭha a ti. Cun Pathian in tleunak cu thimnak ihsin a ṭhen."},"5":{"text":"Tleunak cu “Sun,” ti ah a ko ih thimnak cu “Zan,” ti ah a ko. Zanlam a liam ih zinglam a suak, ni khatnak a si."},"6":{"text":"Cun Pathian in, “Tidai ṭhentu ah vankuumpi um seh, hmun dangdang ah tidai cu um hai seh,” ti ah a ti. A ti bangtuk in a um."},"7":{"text":"Vankuumpi cu Pathian in a tuah ih a hnuai tidai le a tlun tidai cu a ṭhen."},"8":{"text":"Pathian in vankuumpi cu, “Van,” ti ah a ko. Zanlam a liam ih zinglam a suak, ni hnihnak a si."},"9":{"text":"Cun Pathian in, “Leicar a langnak dingah van hnuai ih tidai tla cu hmunkhat ah khawm-aw hai seh,” ti ah a ti. A ti bangtuk in a cang."},"10":{"text":"Pathian in leicaar cu, “Leilung,” ti ah a ko ih hmunkhatih a kom-awmi tidai cu, “Tifinriat,” ti ah a ko. Pathian in a tuah ciami a zoh tikah a ṭha a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Pathian in, “Leilung in thingkung hramkung a phunphun, ci a neimi le rah a neimi, suah seh,” ti ah a ti. A ti bangtuk in an cang."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah ci a neimi le rah a neimi thingkung hramkung phunkim leilung in a suahter. Cun Pathian in a tuah ciami a zoh tikah a ṭha a ti."},"13":{"text":"Zanlam a liam ih zinglam a suak, ni thumnak a si."},"14":{"text":"Cun Pathian in, “Sun le zan ṭhentu dingah, ni le thla le kum ṭhentu dingah, le nithla relnak ah van ah khin tleunak tla um hai seh;"},"15":{"text":"Van ah an vaang ding ih leilung ah tleunak an pe ding,” ti ah a ti. A ti vekin an um."},"16":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian in tleunak tumpi pahnih a tuah: sun caan reltu-ah ni a tuah ih zan caan reltu-ah thlapi a tuah. Arsi pawl khal a tuah."},"17":{"text":"Leilung tleutertu dingah hi tleunak pawl tla cu Pathian in van ah a ret."},"18":{"text":"Sun le zan uktu dingah le tleunak le thimnak ṭhentu dingah an si. Pathian in a tuah ciami a zoh tikah a ṭha, ti ah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Zanlam a liam ih zinglam a suak, ni linak a si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Pathian in, “Ti sungih a nungmi sahring a phunphun tidai in suah seh, leitlun thli lak khalah vate tla zam hai seh,” ti ah a ti. A ti vekin an cang."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah ti sungih ṭihnungza sahring tumpipi Pathian in a seemter, ti sungih a um a nungmi sahring a phunphun tla a seemter; cun vate a phunphun khal a seemter. Pathian in a tuah ciami a zoh tikah a ṭha, ti ah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun Pathian in, “Ti sungih a nungmi sahring pawl cu pungzai uhla tipithuanthum khat ṭheh uh, vate pawl khal pungzai uhla leitlunah khat ṭheh uh,” ti ah thluasuah a pek."},"23":{"text":"Zanlam a liam ih zinglam a suak, ni nganak a si."},"24":{"text":"Cun Pathian in, “Innzuat sumhnam a phunphun le hramlakih ramsa a tum siseh, a fate siseh, a bokvakmi phunzakip leilung in suah seh,” ti ah a ti. A ti bangtuk in an cang."},"25":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian in innzuat sumhnam a phunphun le hramlak ramsa a tum siseh, a fate siseh, bokvak ih a caang theimi hmuahhmuah tla a tuah. Pathian in a tuah ciami a zoh tikah a ṭha, a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cun Pathian in, “Milai tuah thlang uhsi; kanmah ih hmuihmel kengin kanmah bangin kan tuah pei. Ti sung um nga le vanih a zammi vate tlunah siseh, innzuat sumhnam le hramlak ramsa a tum a seen parah siseh, bokvak ih a caang theimi tlun khalah siseh, thu an nei pei,” ti ah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian in milai cu a seemsuah; Pathian in amah ih hmuihmel vekin a seemsuah. Pathian in mipa le nunau a seemsuah a si."},"28":{"text":"Cun Pathian in an hnenah thluasuah a pek ih, “Fa tampi nei in pungzai uhla leilung hi nan luahkhat pei ih nan thuthu in nan umter pei. Ti sungih nga siseh, lei parih a vakmi ramsa tinkim a tum a seen le vanih vate hmuahhmuah tlun khalah siseh, thuneihnak ka lo pe,” ti ah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Pathian in, “Leilung tlunah thlaici a phunphun le thingtheirah a phunphun nan ei dingah ka lo pe a si;"},"30":{"text":"vate phunzakip le ramsa tum le te phunzakip, a bokvak theimi ih an rawl dingah hramhring le thingrah ka pe a si,” ti ah a ti. A ti bangtuk in an si."},"31":{"text":"Cun Pathian in a tuah ciami hmuahhmuah a zoh tikah a ṭha ngaingai ti ah a ti. Zanlam a liam ih zinglam a suak, ni ruknak a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuticun leilung siseh van tla siseh, lei parih a ummi hmuahhmuah le van ih a ummi hmuahhmuah thawn Pathian in a tuah ṭheh."},"2":{"text":"Ni ruk sungah Pathian in a hnaṭuan cu a ṭheh ih ni sarih ni ah a hnaṭuannak ihsin a cawl."},"3":{"text":"A hnaṭuanmi a ṭheh ih a ni sarihnak ah a colh ruangah Pathian in cuih ni cu thluasuah a pek ih ni sunglawi ah a canter."},"4":{"text":"Lei le van a tuahnak thuhla cu cubangtuk in a si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian in lei le van a tuah ṭheh tikah lei parah thing le hrampi a um lo; thlaici keuh ding khal a um hrih lo; ziangahtile Pathian in ruah a surter hrih lo. Leiram ṭuantu dingah milai khal an um hrih lo.","title":"Eden Hmuan"},"6":{"text":"Ruah a sur hrih lo nan leilung sungin ti a put ih leilung cu a hnawngter ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian in leidip a lak ih milai ah a tuah. A hnar sungah nunnak thaw a vun thawt ih minung ah a cang."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian in nisuahnak lamih a ummi Eden ah hmuan a tuah ih acuih hmuanah cun a tuahmi minung cu a umter."},"9":{"text":"Rah ṭha a rahmi le a mawi zetzetmi thingkung a phunphun acuih hmuanah cun a keuhter. Hmuan laifangah nunnak thingkung, a ṭha le a sia theihthiamnak thingkung khal a keuhter."},"10":{"text":"Cun hmuan hnawngtertu dingah Eden ihsin tiva pakhat a luang ih hmuan leng a thlen tikah tiva pali ah a ṭhek aw."},"11":{"text":"Pakhatnak tiva ih hmin cu Pishon a si ih Havilah ram kimvelah a luang. Havilah ram ahcun sui a um."},"12":{"text":"Havilah ram ih sui cu sui phun ṭha a si ih thingthling mankhung le Oniks lungvar sen tla an um."},"13":{"text":"A pahnihnak tiva cu Gihon a si ih Kush ram kimvel ah a luang."},"14":{"text":"A pathumnak tiva cu Tigris a si ih Assiria ram nisuahnak lamah a luang. A palitnak tiva cu Eufrates a si."},"15":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian in a seemsuah mi pa cu loram ṭuantu le kilkhawitu dingin Eden hmuan ahcun a umter."},"16":{"text":"Pathian in a hnenah, “Hmuan sungih a ummi thingrah hmuahhmuah na ei thei;"},"17":{"text":"asinain a ṭha le a sia theihthiamnak thingkung ih rah cu na ei hrimhrim lo pei. Na ei asile na ei ni in na thi ding,” ti ah a sim."},"18":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian in, “Minung hi amah lawngih a um ding cu a rem lo; amah bawmtu ah rualpi ka tuahsak ding,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cule Pathian in leilung a lak ih ramsa a phunphun le vate a phunphun ah a tuah ih ziangtin a ko pei ti ah cu pa hnenah cun a fehpi hai. Cule cu pa in hmin a rak sak ciar vekin an hmin ah a cangta."},"20":{"text":"Cuticun cu pa in hramlak ramsa siseh, innzuat sumhnam le van ih a zammi vate hmuahhmuah siseh hmin a sak hai a si. Sikhalsehla amah ih hrangah bawmtu le rualpi a um hrih lo."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa Pathian in cu pa cu ihhmuh thawzetin a itthatter ih a ihthat sungah a hnakruh pakhat a lak ih a titsa in a phih sal."},"22":{"text":"Mi pa sung ihsin a lakmi hnakruh cun nunau a tuah ih mi pa hnenah a ratpi."},"23":{"text":"Cuih mi pa cun, “Atu lawngah maw keimah vek minung, Ka ruh in tuahmi ruh, Ka titsa in tuahmi titsa ka ton. Mi pa sungin lakmi a si ruangah, Mi nu tiin kawh siseh,” ti ah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah mipa in a nu le a pa a taanta ih a nupi thawn an kom-aw. Cutiin tisa khatah an cang."},"25":{"text":"An pahnih in lawngfangkheh in an um naón ningzah an thiam lo."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Pathian ih tuahmi hmuahhmuah lakah rulpi cu a hrokhrawl bikmi ramsa a si. Rulpi cun nunau hnenah, “Hmuan sungih thingkung pakhatkhat ih rah nan ei lo pei ti ah Pathian in a lo ti ngaingai maw?” ti ah a sut.","title":"Milai Sualnak"},"2":{"text":"Nunau nu cun, “Hmuan sungih thingrah hmuahhmuah kan ei thei ko;"},"3":{"text":"asinain hmuan laifangih a ummi thingrah cu kan ei thei lo, ziangahtile acuih thingrah cu ‘Nan ei lo pei; a tham khal nan tham lo pei, nan ei asile nan thi ding a si,’ ti ah Pathian in in ti,” ti ah rulpi cu a ti."},"4":{"text":"Rulpi cun, “Cutin a si lo, nan thi hrimhrim lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Nan ei asile nan ei ni in nan mit a vaang ding ih amah Pathian vekin a ṭha le a sia theihthiamnak nan nei ding, ti kha Pathian in a theih cia ruangah a lo khamnak a si,” ti ah nunau hnenah a sim."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun nunau nu in hmuan laifangih thingkung mawizia le a rah thawt dingzia cu a hmu ih fim cu ziang tluk duhnungza so a si ding, tiin a ruat. Curuangah thingrah cu a lo ih a ei. Cuih hnuah a pasal a pek ih anih khal in a ei ve."},"7":{"text":"Thingrah an ei ṭheh vete in an mit vaangin theihtheinak an nei ih lawngte ih um an si kha an thei aw. Curuangah theipi hnah an ṭhitkhawm ih an hup aw."},"8":{"text":"A cuih zanlam simneem ah Bawipa Pathian cu hmuan sungah a ra. A rat thawm an theih tikah a hnen ihsin hmuan sungih thingruul lakah an relh."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa Pathian in mi pa cu a ko ih, “Khui lamah so na um?” ti ah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cupa in, “Hmuan ih na rat thawm ka theih ih ka lawngfangkheh ka si ruangah ka thin a phang ih ka relh a si,” ti ah a ti."},"11":{"text":"“Zo in so lawngfangkheh ih na um cu a lo sim? Thingrah ei hlah aw ka lo timi na ei maw si?” ti ah Pathian in a sut."},"12":{"text":"Mi pa in, “Ka hrangih na tuahmi nunau nu in thingrah cu i pek ih ka ei a si,” ti ah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule Bawipa Pathian in nunau nu hnenah, “Zianghrangah hiti in thil na tuah?” ti ah a sut. Cun nunau nu in, “Rulpi in i bum ih ka rak ei a si,” ti ah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun rulpi hnenah Bawipa Pathian in, “Nunau nu na bum ruangah cawhkuan ka lo pe; Ramsa hmuahhmuah lakah nangmah lawng in hi camsiatnak hi na tuar ding; Atu thokin a bokin na vak ding ih, Na nunsung hmuahhmuah na ei ding rawl cu leidip a si ding.","title":"Pathian Ih Cawhkuan Peknak"},"15":{"text":"Nunau thawn ka lo raal awter ding ih, Nan tesinfa tiangin nan raal aw ding. Na lu a lo subeek ding ih, Nang in a kedil na cuk ding,” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Pathian in nunau hnenah, “Fa na vun tikih na harnak cu ka ṭhanter ding, Na hrin tikih a natnak cu ka karhter ding. Cu cingin na pasal cu na duh thotho ding ih, A lo uktu a si ding,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule Pathian in mi pa hnenah, “Na nupi thu na ngai sawn ih, Ei lo ding ka timi thingrah na ei ruangah, Leiram cu nangmah ruangah siatserh a si; Na pumcawmnak ah zonzai zetin, Na nunsung hmuahhmuah hna na ṭuan ding."},"18":{"text":"Leilung in hling le so le hrampi a phunphun a suah pei ih, Culak ih a keuhmi hramrawl na ei pei."},"19":{"text":"Leidip in tuahmi na si ih, Leilung ih na can sal tiang, Na nunnak hrangah na thlanhriput in hna na ṭuan ding. Leidip in tuahmi na si ih, Leidip ah na cang sal ding,” ti ah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun mi pa in a nupi cu minung hmuahhmuah ih nu a si hrangah Evi ti ah a ko."},"21":{"text":"Cule Bawipa Pathian in Adam le a nupi hrangah savun hnipuan a tuahsak ih a hrukter."},"22":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian in, “Minung cu a ṭha le a sia thleidan a thiam zo hrangah kanmah vek a si zo. Nunnak thingkung ih rah ei sal in kumkhua in a nung pang ding,” ti ah a ti.","title":"Adam le Evi Hmuan Leng Ah"},"23":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa Pathian in minung cu a seemnak leilung thlo dingin Eden hmuan ihsin a dawi."},"24":{"text":"Pathian in minung cu a dawisuak ih nunnak thingkung kiangih zohman rat ngam lonak dingah hmuan ih nisuahnak lamah Cherubim le a tle zukzo ih a her-aw luailomi ralnam a ret."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Adam le a nupi Evi cu an pawl-aw ih Evi cu nau a keng. Fapa a nei ih, “ Bawipa ih bomnak in fapa ka nei a si,” ti ah a ti. Cuhrangah a hmin ah Kain a sak.","title":"Kain Le Abel"},"2":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a naupa Abel a hring sal. Abel cu tuukhal a si ih Kain cu lothlo a si."},"3":{"text":"Caan a hung rei deuh tikah Kain cun a lo sungih a suakmi rawl pawl kha Bawipa a pek."},"4":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Abel khal in a tuu faate suak hmaisa bik pawl a that ih a sa ṭhatnak bik Bawipa a pek ve. Abel tlun le a pekmi parah Bawipa cu a lung a kimzet;"},"5":{"text":"asinain Kain le a pekmi parah Bawipa cu a lung a kim lo. Cutikah Kain cu a thin a heng ih a mithmai a sia."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Kain hnenah, “Ziangah so na thin a heng? Ziangah so na mithmai a siat?"},"7":{"text":"A ṭhami tuah cila cohlan na si ko ding; sikhalsehla a ṭha lomi na tuah ruangah sualnak in nangmah neh dingah sahrang bangin sangka in a lo bawh; uk a lo tum; asinain na neh hrimhrim a ṭul ding,” ti ah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule Kain in a naupa Abel hnenah, “Hramlak ah feh uhsi,” ti ah a ti. Hramlak an thlen tikah Kain in Abel cu a zon ih a thah."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Kain cu Bawipa in, “Na nau Abel khui-ah so a si?” ti ah a sut. Kain in, “Ka thei lo. Ka nau kilkhawitu-ah zo in so i tuah?” ti ah a let."},"10":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in, “Zianghrangah hivek ṭihnungza thil hi na tuah? Phuhlam duh ih a aumi aw bangin na naupa ih thisen in leilung ihsin i hun ko rero a si."},"11":{"text":"Atu-ah nang cu camsiat na si ih hi na umnak hmun ihsin dawihlo na si ding; ziangahtile na kut ih na suahmi na nau ih thisen cu kaa ang tahratih donmi vekin leilung in a hawp zo a si."},"12":{"text":"Rawl na ciin khalle leilung in zianghman a suah lo ding ih umnak inn nei loin mivakvai na si ding,” ti ah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Kain in Bawipa hnenah, “Hremnak i pekmi cu a na tuk."},"14":{"text":"Hi ram le na hmaika in i dawihlo ih tlunah lei parah hin inn nei lo le mivakvai ka si ding ih i hmutu pohpoh in in that ding,” ti ah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in, “Cutin a si lo; nangmah a lo thattu cu a letsarih ih phulak a si ding,” ti ah a ti. Cuhrangah Kain cu a hmutu pohpoh ih an thah lonak dingah Bawipa in a parah hminsinnak a ret."},"16":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Kain cu Bawipa ih hmaika in a tlan ih Eden hmuan ih nisuahnak lam Nod, timi ramah a um."},"17":{"text":"Kain le a nupi an pawl-aw ih a nupi cu nau a keng. Fapa a hring ih a hminah Enok a sak. Cule Kain cun khawpi pakhat a toh ih a fapa hmin suangin Enok a sak.","title":"Kain Ih Tesinfa Pawl"},"18":{"text":"Cun Enok in fapa a nei ih a hminah Irad a sak; Irad ih fapa cu Mehujael a si; Mehujael ih fapa cu Methushael a si; Methushael ih fapa cu Lamek a si."},"19":{"text":"Lamek cun nupi pahnih a nei; pakhat cu Adah a si ih pakhat cu Zillah a si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Adah in fapa a nei ih Jabal ti ah a ko. Jabal cu cawkhal pawl le puanthlam ih a ummi pawl cithlahtu a si."},"21":{"text":"A naupa cu Jubal a si ih tingrisit le phirivau tumtu pawl cithlahtu a si."},"22":{"text":"Cule Zillah in fapa a nei ih Tubal-Kain a si. Tubal-Kain cu thir le dar soser pawl cithlahtu a si. Tubal-Kain ih farnu cu Naamah a si."},"23":{"text":"Cun Lamek in a nupi pawl ih hnenah, “Ka nupi Adah le Zillah, i ngaihnik uh, I thawi ruangah tleirawl pakhat ka that; I tuahmawh ruangah mi ka that a si."},"24":{"text":"Kain a thattu parah letsarih ih phuhlam a si ahcun, Kei i tuahmawhtu cu let sawmsarih let sarih in phulak a si ding,” ti ah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Adam le a nupi cu an pawl-aw sal ih fapa pakhat an nei. “Kain in Abel a that ih a ai-ah Pathian in fapa i pe a si,” ti ah Evi in a ti ih a hminah Seth a sak.","title":"Seth Le Enosh"},"26":{"text":"Seth in fapa a run nei ih Enosh ti ah an ko. A cuih thokin minung pawl in Bawipa cu a hmin ko in an biak."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tanglam pawl cu Adam ih tesinfa an si. Pathian in minung a sersiam tikah amah Pathian hmuihmel kengin a sersiam.","title":"Adam Ih Tesinfa Pawl (1 San. 1.1-4)"},"2":{"text":"Pathian in mipa le nunau a tuah ih seemsuah an si ni ih thokin thluasuah a pek ih, “Minung,” ti ah a ko."},"3":{"text":"Adam cu kum za le sawmthum a kim tikah amah ih hmuihmel kengin fapa a nei ih a hmin ah Seth a sak."},"4":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zariat a nung lai. Fanu le fapa dangdang tla a nei ih,"},"5":{"text":"kum zakua le sawmthum a ti ah Adam cu a thi."},"6":{"text":"Seth cu kum za le kum nga a ti tikah fapa Enosh a nei."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zariat le kum sarih a nung ih faate dang tla a nei."},"8":{"text":"Kum zakua le kum hleihnih a ti ah a thi."},"9":{"text":"Enosh cu kum sawmkua a ti tikah fapa Kenan a nei."},"10":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zariat le kum hleinga a nung ih faate dang tla a nei."},"11":{"text":"Kum zakua le kum nga a ti ah a thi."},"12":{"text":"Kenan cu kum sawmsarih a si tikah fapa Mahalalel a nei."},"13":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zariat le sawmli a nung ih faate dang tla a nei."},"14":{"text":"Amah cu kum zakua le kum hra a kim ah a thi."},"15":{"text":"Mahalalel cu kum sawmruk le kum nga a si ah fapa Jared a nei."},"16":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zariat le sawmthum a nung ih faate dang tla a nei."},"17":{"text":"Kum zariat sawmkua le kum nga a ti ah a thi."},"18":{"text":"Jared cu kum za le sawmruk le kum hnih a si ah fapa Enok a nei."},"19":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zariat a nung ih faate dang tla a nei."},"20":{"text":"Kum za kua sawmruk le kum hnih a ti tikah a thi."},"21":{"text":"Enok cu kum sawmruk le kum nga ah fapa Methuselah a nei."},"22":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Pathian thawn pawlkom aw-in kum zathum a nung ih faate dang tla a nei."},"23":{"text":"Enok cu kum zathum sawmruk le kum nga a nung."},"24":{"text":"Pathian thawn pawlkom-aw in a nung ih a hlota, ziangahtile Pathian in a lak a si."},"25":{"text":"Methuselah cu kum za le sawmriat le kum sarih a si tikah fapa Lamek a nei."},"26":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum za sarih sawmriat le kum hnih a nung ih faate dang tla a nei."},"27":{"text":"Kum zakua sawmruk le kum khua a ti ah a thi."},"28":{"text":"Cun Lamek cu kum za le sawmriat le kum hnih a si ah fapa a nei ih,"},"29":{"text":"“ Bawipa ih siatserhmi leilung par hrimhrim ahhin hi fapa cu kan zonzaihnak sung ihsin in suahtu a si ding,” ti ah a ti ih a hmin ah Noah a sak."},"30":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Lamek cu kum zanga sawmkua le kum nga a nung ih faate dang tla a nei."},"31":{"text":"Kum zasarih sawmsarih le kum sarih a ti ah a thi."},"32":{"text":"Cun Noah cu kum zanga a si tikah fapa pathum a nei: Shem, Ham le Jafet an si."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leilung pumpuluk ah milai cu an karhzai vivo ih fanu tampi tla an hring.","title":"Minung Sualnak"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian ih fapa pawl in acuih fala pawl an mawizia an hmuh tikah an duhmi an hril ih an ṭhit."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Milai hnenah ka thlarau cu kumkhua cun ka umter lo pei, ziangahtile taksa neimi an si. Atu thok ihsin kum za le kum kul hnakih tam an nung lo pei,” ti ah a ti."},"4":{"text":"A cuih san le cuih hnu san hmanah Pathian ih fapa pawl le milai ih fanu pawl an pawl-aw ih an hrinmi faale pawl cu mikei vekih a tum zetzetmi an si. Anmah tla cu khuahlan san ih mi hminthang le mi ralṭhazet pawl an si."},"5":{"text":"Pathian cun leilung par milai hmuahhmuah cu an ṭha lozet ih an thinlung ah ruahnak siava lawnglawng a khat ti kha a hmuh tikah,"},"6":{"text":"leilung parih milai a tuah cu a sir-aw sal ih a riah a siazet."},"7":{"text":"Cuhrangah, “Ka tuah ciami milai pohpoh, khuitawkih an um khalle ka siat thluh ding. Ramsa hmuahhmuah le vate hmuahhmuah khal, a bokvakmi tiangin ka siat thluh ding, ka rak tuah cu ka sir-aw a si,” ti ah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Noah parah cun Bawipa cu a lung a awi."},"9":{"text":"Noah ih faale pawl cu hi pawl hi an si: fapa pathum a nei ih Shem, Ham le Jafet an si. Noah cu mi ṭhazet a si ih acuih san ahcun amah pakhat lawnglawng Pathian ih lungkimmi a si. Pathian thawn a umtlangmi a si.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla midang hmuahhmuah cu Pathian ih mithmai ah an siavazet ih an siatnak cu khuazakip ah a zai vivo."},"12":{"text":"Cun Pathian in leilung cu ṭha lozet in a hmu, ziangahtile mi hmuahhmuah ṭhatlonak in an khat."},"13":{"text":"Cun Pathian in Noah hnenah, “Milai cu leilung par ihsin cemter dingah ka ruat zo a si. Ka siatsuah thluh ding, ziangahtile leilung hi an sualtuahnak in a khat.","title":"Noah In Tangphawlawng A Tuah"},"14":{"text":"Nangmah ih hrangah saipras thing ṭha phun in tangphawlawng tuah aw. A sungah khaan tampi tuah awla, a sunglam le a lenglam hmuahhmuah ah farthling hnih aw."},"15":{"text":"A cuih lawng cu pi zali sawmnga sau, pi sawmsarih pi nga kau, pi sawmli pi nga saangin tuah aw."},"16":{"text":"A khuh tuah awla a khuh le a phar karlak kha zung hleiriat zuah aw. Cun dot thum in tuah awla a siir-ah sangka tuah aw."},"17":{"text":"Leilung parah tilik ka thlenter ding ih a nungmi hmuahhmuah a siatsuah thluh ding. Leilung parih a nungmi hmuahhmuah an thi ṭheh ding."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nangmah thawn thukamnak ka tuah ding. Na nupi le na fapa pawl le an nupi pawl thawn lawng sungah nan lut ding."},"19":{"text":"An nun venak dingah ramsa tinkim in a nu le a pa, khuahkhat fingfing, lawng sungah na khum pei."},"20":{"text":"Vate phun tinkim sungin pahnih ciar, ramsa sungin a tum siseh a fate siseh pahnih ciar, an nun suaknak dingah lawng sungah na luhpi pei."},"21":{"text":"Ei ṭha tirawl phunkim na khawl pei ih, nanmah le an hrangah na ret pei. Himi cu lawng sungih nan ei dingmi a si,” ti ah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Pathian ih thupekmi vek cekci in Noah cun a tuah ṭheh."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Noah hnenah Bawipa in, “Nan sungte in lawng sungah lut uh; ziangahtile leilung mi hmuahhmuah lakah nangmah pakhat lawng ka mithmuh ah a dingmi na si.","title":"Tilik"},"2":{"text":"Saram thiang ei ṭha phunkim in phunkhat ah khuah sarih ciar keng aw; asinain a thiang lo ramsa cu phunkhat ah a nu le a pa khuah khat ciar lawng la aw."},"3":{"text":"Vate khal a phunkim in phunkhat ah khuah sarih ciar in keng aw. Himi pawl cu leilung ih cithlah saaltu dingah an si."},"4":{"text":"Tuih hnu ni sarih ah leilung parah ni sawmli le zan sawmli sung ruah ka surter ding ih ka tuah cia a nungmi hmuahhmuah a siatsuah thluh ding a si,” ti ah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih thupekmi vek cekci in Noah cun a tuah ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Tilik a thawh tikah Noah cu kum zaruk a si."},"7":{"text":"A nupi le a fapa pawl le an nupi pawl thawn tilik ihsin him dingah lawng sungah an lut."},"8":{"text":"Ramsa le vate a thiang siseh thiang lo siseh a phunkim in a nu pakhat le a pa pakhat ciar,"},"9":{"text":"Pathian ih thupek vekin Noah thawn lawng sungah an lut."},"10":{"text":"Ni sarih hnuah leilung tlunah tilik a tlung."},"11":{"text":"Noah kum zaruk a kim hnu thla hnihnak ni hleisarih ni ah, leilung hnuai ih tipi cu hmunkip in an put ciamco; cun van tukvirh hmuahhmuah a ong-aw ih ruah a thlet in a thle aw;"},"12":{"text":"cuticun leilung parah ni sawmli le zan sawmli ruah cat loin a sur thlurthlo."},"13":{"text":"Cuih ni ah Noah le a nupi, a fapa pathum Shem, Ham le Jafet le an nupi pawl cu lawng sungah an lut."},"14":{"text":"Anmah thawn hmun khatah hramlak ramsa siseh, innzuat ṭilva siseh, a vak thiammi hmuahhmuah le vate a phunphun tla an lut."},"15":{"text":"Ramsa a phunkim in, a nu le a pa ciar in, Noah thawn lawng sungah Pathian ih thupekmi vekin an lut."},"16":{"text":"Cule Noah a luh ngah in Bawipa in sangka a khar."},"17":{"text":"Ni sawmli ti a lik hnu ah tidai a tam dutdo deuhdeuh ih an lawng cu tidai in a phuanter."},"18":{"text":"Tidai a thuk deuhdeuh ih tidai parah lawng cu a phuan."},"19":{"text":"Tilik cu a thuk sinsin ih tlang saangbik pawl khal a khuh thluh."},"20":{"text":"Cuih tlunah tidai cu tlangzim tlunah pi kul hluannga a kai."},"21":{"text":"Leilung parih a nungmi hmuahhmuah, minung siseh, ramsa le vate siseh, cucik kharbok tiangin an thi thluh."},"22":{"text":"Leilung parih nunnak a neimi hmuahhmuah in an thi thluh."},"23":{"text":"Leilung parih a vak thiammi hmuahhmuah - minung le ramsa le vate a fate bik tiangin Bawipa in a thihter thluh. Siatsuah lomi cu Noah le amah thawn lawng sungih a ummi lawng an si."},"24":{"text":"Tidai cu lei parah ni za le ni sawmnga sung ṭum loin a um."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian cun Noah le amah thawn lawng sungih a ummi ramsa tinkim cu a thei ringring. Curuangah leilung tlunah thli a hranter ih tidai cu a kang vivo.","title":"Tilik Cemnak"},"2":{"text":"Leilung hnuai ih tipi ihsin a hung putmi tidai pawl le van ihsin ruah a rung surnak van tukvirh pawl cu an kharphit aw thluh. Vanruah a han ih,"},"3":{"text":"tidai cu a kang vivo. Ni za le sawmnga hnuah tidai a ṭum deuhdeuh ih,"},"4":{"text":"thla sarihnak ni hleisarih ni ah, lawng cu Ararat ram ih tlangpar ah a taang."},"5":{"text":"Tidai cu a ṭum deuh vivo ih thla hranak ni khat ni ah tlangzim pawl an lang."},"6":{"text":"Ni sawmli hnuah Noah cun lawng ih tukvirh a ong ih,"},"7":{"text":"tlang-ak pakhat a thlah. Tlang-ak cu a ra kir lo, leilung parih tidai a kaan thluh hlan lo a suk le a so ah a zam rero."},"8":{"text":"Cule Noah in tidai a kang ngaingai maw ti thei dingah thuro pakhat a thlah."},"9":{"text":"Asinain tidai in leilung a khuh thluh lai thotho ruangah thuro cu futnak a hmu thei lo. Cutikah Noah cun a kut a hei suah ih thuro cu lawng sungah a lak sal."},"10":{"text":"Ni sarih a hngah hnu ah thuro cu a thlah sal."},"11":{"text":"A cuih zanlam ah thuro cu a ra kir ih a hmur in Oliv thinghnah hring a rak thiar kha Noah in a hmu. Cutikah tidai a kang ngaingai zo ti ah Noah in a thei."},"12":{"text":"Cun Noah in ni sarih a hngak sal ih thuro cu a thlah sal lala. Cuih ṭum cu a ra kir sal nawn lo."},"13":{"text":"Noah kum zaruk le kum khat a ti kum, thla hmaisa bik, ni khatnak ni ah leilung parih tidai cu a kang thluh. A lawngkhuh a ong ih a zoh tikah leilung a ro thluh kha a hmu."},"14":{"text":"A thla hnihnak, ni kul hluansarih ni ah leilung cu a ro ngah thluh."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in Noah hnenah,"},"16":{"text":"“Na nupi, na fapa pawl le an nupi pawl thawn lawng sung ihsin suak uh."},"17":{"text":"Ramsa hmuahhmuah, vate, innzuat sumhnam le a vak theimi hmuahhmuah tiangin hruai thluh awla, leilung parah an ci zaih in pungzai hai seh,” ti ah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cuticun Noah cu a nupi le a fapa le an nupi pawl thawn lawng sung ihsin an suak."},"19":{"text":"Cun hramlak ramsa siseh, innzuat sumhnam siseh, vate le a vak theimi hmuahhmuah tiangin, anmah an phun ciar a burbur in lawng sung ihsin an suak."},"20":{"text":"Cule Noah cun Bawipa ih hrangah biakṭheng a don ih a thiangmi ramsa le vate tla phunkhat in pakhat ciar a lak ih meisa biakṭheng parah Pathian hrangah mei-ur thawinak a pek.","title":"Noah In Thawinak A Pek"},"21":{"text":"Noah ih pekmi rimthaw cu Bawipa in a theih tikah a thinlung in, “Minung ih thiltuahmi ruangah leilung cu siat ka serh nawn lo pei. Minung cu an no lai ihsin ṭhatlonak lawnglawng an ruat ti ka thei. Sikhalsehla atuih ṭum bangtuk in ziangtik hmanah a nungmi pawl ka siatsuah nawn lo pei."},"22":{"text":"Leilung a him sung hmuahhmuah, Thlaici tuh caan le rawl lak caan a um ding; Khawsik le khuahlum, fur le ṭhal caan a um ding; Sun le zan a um ding ih, A cem nawn lo pei,” ti ah a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Pathian in Noah le a fapa pawl cu a thluasuah ih an hnenah, “Fa tampi nei in pungzai uhla, leilung khuazakip ah nan tesinfa pawl khat hai seh.","title":"Noah Hnenih Pathian Thukam"},"2":{"text":"Lei parih a um ramsa hmuahhmuah, vate le nga pawl, lei parih a vak theimi ramsa fatebik tiangin an lo ṭih ding. Na kuthnuai ah ret thluh an si."},"3":{"text":"Cule ramsa a nungmi hmuahhmuah le hanghnah hangrah pawl na ei ding; na rawl hrangah ka lo pe a si."},"4":{"text":"Asinain a sa sungih a thi a um laiah cun na ei lo pei, ziangahtile thi cu nunnak a si."},"5":{"text":"Cun mi a thattu cu thah a si ve ding. Mi a siatsuahtu ramsa cu siatsuah a si ve ding."},"6":{"text":"Mi a thattu cu Mi kutin a thi ve ding. Ziangahtile milai cu Pathian in amah bangin a tuahmi a si."},"7":{"text":"Cule fa tampi nan nei ding ih nan tesinfa pawl cu leitlun khuazakip ah an khat ding ih an karhzai ding,” ti ah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Pathian in Noah le a fapa pawl hnenah,"},"9":{"text":"“Atu-ah thu ka lo kam; nanmah le nan tesinfa pawl hnenah siseh,"},"10":{"text":"nanmah thawn lawng sung ihsin a suakmi ramsa hmuahhmuah, vate le innzuat ṭilva le hramlak ramsa zate hnenah siseh,"},"11":{"text":"thukamnak ka tuah: ziangtik hmanah leilung parih nunnak a neimi hmuahhmuah tilik in a siatsuah nawn lo pei. Tilik in leilung cu a siatsuah nawn lo pei, tiin ka lo kam,” ti ah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Pathian in, “Nangmah le na hnenih a ummi ramsa hmuahhmuah hnenih kumkhua daih ka thukammi hminsinnak ah,"},"13":{"text":"Mero lakah vangro ka ret, Ka thukammi theihternak ah a si."},"14":{"text":"Lei parih mero a zaam tinte in, Mero parah vangro nan hmu ding."},"15":{"text":"Leilung ih nunnak a neimi hmuahhmuah cu tilik ih siatsuah nawn lo dingin nangmah le ramsa pawl hmuahhmuah hnenih ka thukam cu ka ciing ringring ding."},"16":{"text":"Keimah le leilung parih a nungmi hmuahhmuah karlakih ka thukammi cu mero lakih vangro a langtinte in ka ciing ringring ding,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule Noah hnenah Pathian in, “Himi cu leilung par nunnak a neimi hmuahhmuah hnenih thu ka kammi hminsinnak a si,” ti ah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Lawng sung ihsin a suakmi Noah ih fapa pawl cu Shem, Ham le Jafet an si. (Ham cu Kanaan ih pa a si.)","title":"Noah Le A Fapa Pawl"},"19":{"text":"Hi Noah ih fapa pathum cu leilung milai hmuahhmuah cithlahtu an si."},"20":{"text":"Noah cu lothlo a si ih hmaisa bik sabit hmuan tuahtu a si."},"21":{"text":"Voikhat cu sabit a in hnuah a ri ih lawngfangkheh in a thlam sungah a it."},"22":{"text":"Cumi cu Kanaan ih pa Ham in a hmuh tikah a unau an pahnih in a va sim."},"23":{"text":"Cule Shem le Jafet cun puan an lak ih an liang dungah zaar tahratin an pa lawngte ih a ummi zoh ngam lo ah dungsip in thlam sungah an pan ih an pa cu an puan kenmi in an vung khuh. Kaa dang an hoi ruangah an pa lawngfangkheh ih a um cu an hmu lo."},"24":{"text":"Cule Noah cu a ritnak in a fim sal ih a fapa nauta bik in a parih a tuahmi a theih tikah,"},"25":{"text":"“Kanaan cu camsiatmi siseh, A unau pawl ih sal ah cang seh!"},"26":{"text":"Shem ih Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh, Kanaan cu Shem ih salah cang seh!"},"27":{"text":"Pathian in Jafet cu ṭhangso pungzaiter seh, A tefa pawl cu Shem ih milai pawl thawn umtlang hai seh; Kanaan cu Jafet ih sal siseh!” ti ah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Tilik hnuah Noah cu kum zathum le sawmnga a nung ih,"},"29":{"text":"kum zakua le sawmnga a ti ah a thi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tilik a tlun hnu, Noah ih fapa Shem, Ham le Jafet tla-ih hrinmi tefa pawl cu a hnuailam vekin an si.","title":"Noah Fapa Pawlih Tesinfa"},"2":{"text":"Jafet ih fapa pawl cu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek le Tiras tla an si."},"3":{"text":"Gomer ih fapa pawl cu Ashkenaz, Rifath le Togarmah an si."},"4":{"text":"Javan ih fapa pawl cu Elishah, Tarshish, Kit mi le Dodan mi pawl tla an si."},"5":{"text":"Anmah cu tipikap le tikulh parih a ummi miphun pawl cithlahtu an si. Jafet ih tesinfa an si ih an hrin ciar in anmah ih ṭong ciar hmangin ram dangdang ah an um."},"6":{"text":"Cun Ham ih fapa pawl cu Kush, Izipt, Libia le Kanaan an si."},"7":{"text":"Kush ih fapa pawl cu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah le Sabteka an si. Raamah ih fapa cu Sheba le Dedan tla an si."},"8":{"text":"Kush ih fapa pakhat cu Nimrod a si ih amah cu leilung tlunah a hmaisa bik minehtu hminthang a si."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih bomnak in amah cu sakap hminthang ah a cang ih, curuangah mi in, “Nimrod bangin Bawipa in sakap hminthang ah lo tuah seh,” an ti ṭheu."},"10":{"text":"Nimrod ih a ukmi ram hmaisa bik pawl cu Babilonia ram sungih a ummi Babilon, Erek le Akkad ram thum tla an si."},"11":{"text":"Cuih ram ihsin Assiria ramah a feh ih Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Kalah le,"},"12":{"text":"Nineveh le Kalah khawpi karlakih a ummi Reson timi khawpi tla a toh."},"13":{"text":"Izipt cu Lidia mi, Anam mi, Lehab mi, Naftuh mi,"},"14":{"text":"Patrus mi, Kasluh mi le Kaftor mi pawl ih pa a si. Filistin mi pawl cu Kaftor ih cithlahmi an si."},"15":{"text":"Cule Kanaan cu a fapa upa bik Sidon le a nau Heth,"},"16":{"text":"cuih hnuah Jebus mi, Amor mi, Girgash mi,"},"17":{"text":"Hiv mi le Arka mi, Sin mi,"},"18":{"text":"Arvad mi, Zemar mi le Hamath mi pawl ih pa a si. Cuih hnuah Kanaan ih tefa pawl cu an karhzai ih,"},"19":{"text":"an ram cu Gerar lamah Sidon in Gaza tiang, cun Sadom, Gomorrah, Admah le Zeboiim lamah Lasha tiang a kau."},"20":{"text":"A tlunih miphun pawl hi Ham ih tesinfa pawl an si ih ram dangdang ah anmah an hrin ciar in anmah ih an ṭong ciar hmangin an um."},"21":{"text":"Jafet ih u-pa Shem cu faate dang tla a nei ih Hebru mi pawl hmuahhmuah ih cithlahtu a si."},"22":{"text":"Shem ih fapa pawl cu Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud le Aram an si."},"23":{"text":"Aram ih fapa pawl cu Uz, Hul, Gether le Mash an si."},"24":{"text":"Arpakshad cu Shelah ih pa a si ih Shelah cu Eber ih pa a si."},"25":{"text":"Cun Eber in fapa pahnih a nei. Pakhat cu Peleg ti ah an ko, ziangahtile Peleg san laiah leilungih milai pawl cu an ṭhen-aw thluh. Cule a naupa ih hmin cu Joktan a si."},"26":{"text":"Joktan ih tesinfa pawl cu Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,"},"27":{"text":"Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,"},"28":{"text":"Obal, Abimael, Sheba,"},"29":{"text":"Ofir, Havilah le Jobab an si. Hi pawl hi an zatein Joktan ih tesinfa an si."},"30":{"text":"An umnak ram cu Mesha ihsin Sefar lamah nisuahnak lamih tlangram tiang a si."},"31":{"text":"A tlunih miphun pawl cu Shem ih tesinfa pawl an si ih ram dangdang ah anmah an hrin ciar in anmah ih ṭong ciar hmangin an um."},"32":{"text":"A tlunih hrin le hnam pawl cu Noah ih tesinfa an si ih anmah ih an hrin ciar in miphun tampi ah an cang. Leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah cu tilik hnu Noah fapa pawl ih cithlahmi an si."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hlanah cun leilung tlun mi hmuahhmuah in ṭong phunkhat lawng an nei ih ṭongfang bangrep an hmang.","title":"Babel Lungdawl"},"2":{"text":"Nisuahnak lamah an vai ih Babilonia nelrawn an thleng ih cutawkah khua an to."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah, “Rahnik uh, phahlei tuah in meisa ah rawh uhsi,” ti ah pakhat le pakhat an ti-aw. Cutiin inn saknak ah tlakrawh an nei ih a erhnak ah ṭhung an tuah."},"4":{"text":"Cuṭheh in, “Ra uh; Kan hrangah khawpi kan tuah pei ih van dai in lungdawl kan tuah pei. Kanmah ih hrangah hmin nei ve seh; cule leilung khuazakip ah darhdai loin kan um ding a si,” ti ah an ti-aw."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah milai ih an tuahmi khawpi le lungdawl zoh dingah Bawipa cu a rung ih,"},"6":{"text":"“Zohhnik uh, hi pawl hi an zatein miphun phunkhat an si ih ṭong pakhat an hmang. An tuahmi hi thil tuah an tummi a hramthawhnak lawng a si lai. A rei hlanah tuah an duhmi hmuahhmuah an tuahsuak thei ding."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah kan vung feh pei ih pakhat le pakhat an aan ciing-aw lo dingin an ṭong kan cokrawi thluh pei,” ti ah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutiin Bawipa in milai pawl cu leilung khuazakip ah a ṭhekdarh thluh ih khawpi cu an sak ṭheh suak lo."},"9":{"text":"A cuih khawpi cu Babel ti ah an ti, ziangahtile cutawkah milai ih ṭong cu Bawipa in a cokrawi sak thluh ih, leilung tlun khuazakip ah a ṭhekdarh thluh hai a si."},"10":{"text":"Shem ih tesinfa cu a hnuailam pawl hi an si. Tilik a tlun hnu kum hnih ah, Shem cu kum zakhat a ti ih, fapa pakhat Arpakshad a nei.","title":"Shem Ih Tesinfa Pawl"},"11":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zanga a nung ih fapa dang le fanu dang khal a nei."},"12":{"text":"Arpakshad cu kum sawmthum le kum nga a si tikah fapa Shelah a nei."},"13":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zali le kum thum a nung ih fapa dang le fanu dang tla a nei."},"14":{"text":"Shelah cu kum sawmthum a kim tikah fapa Eber a nei."},"15":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zali le kum thum a nung ih fapa dang le fanu dang tla a nei."},"16":{"text":"Cun Eber cu kum sawmthum le kum li a si tikah fapa Peleg a nei."},"17":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zali le sawmthum a nung ih fapa dang le fanu dang tla a nei."},"18":{"text":"Peleg cu kum sawmthum a si tikah fapa Reu a nei."},"19":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zahnih le kum kua a nung ih fapa dang le fanu dang tla a nei."},"20":{"text":"Reu cu kum sawmthum le kum hnih a si tikah fapa Serug a nei"},"21":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zahnih le kum sarih a nung ih fapa dang le fanu dang tla a nei."},"22":{"text":"Serug cu kum sawmthum a si tikah fapa Nahor a nei."},"23":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum zahnih a nung ih fapa dang le fanu dang tla a nei."},"24":{"text":"Nahor cu kum kul hluankua a si tikah fapa Terah a nei."},"25":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kum za le hleikua a nung ih fapa dang le fanu dang tla a nei."},"26":{"text":"Cule Terah cu kum sawmsarih a si tikah fapa pathum Abram, Nahor le Haran a nei hai."},"27":{"text":"Terah ih tesinfa pawl cu Abram, Nahor le Haran an si. Haran cu Lot ih pa a si.","title":"Terah Ih Tesinfa Pawl"},"28":{"text":"Haran cu a pa Terah a nun laiah Khaldea ram, a suahnak Ur khua ah a thi."},"29":{"text":"Cun Abram in Sarai a ṭhit ih Nahor in Haran ih fanu Milkah a ṭhit. Haran cu Iskah ih pa khal a si."},"30":{"text":"Sarai cu faate a nei lo, ziangahtile nucing a si."},"31":{"text":"Cule Terah cun a fapa Abram le a fasuan, Haran ih fa, Lot le Abram ih nupi Sarai cu a lak hai ih Kanaan ram feh dingah Khaldea ram Ur khua cun a pok. Asinain Haran khua tiang an feh ih cutawkah cun umhmun an khuar."},"32":{"text":"Terah cu kum zahnih le kum nga a si tikah Haran khua ahcun a thita."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in Abram hnenah, “Na ram, na miphun le na pa ih inn taanta awla ka lo hmuh dingmi ramah feh aw.","title":"Pathian In Abram A Ko"},"2":{"text":"Tefa tampi ka lo pe ding ih miphun tumpi-ah an cang ding. Ka lo thlawsuah ding ih na hmin ka thanter ding; cutiin thlawsuah mi na si ding."},"3":{"text":"A lo thluasuahtu cu ka thlawsuah ve ding, Asinain siat a lo camtu cu ka camsia ve ding; Nangmah ka lo thlawsuah vekin, Leitlun mi hmuahhmuah in thlawsuah in dil ding,” ti ah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Abram cu kum sawmsarih le kum nga a ti tikah, Bawipa ih a fial vekin, Haran khua cun a suak. Lot khal in a thlun ve."},"5":{"text":"Abram cu a nupi Sarai le a nau ih fapa Lot le Haran khua ih an neihmi sal pawl le an thil neih hmuahhmuah thawn Kanaan ramah cun an feh. Kanaan ram an thlen tikah,"},"6":{"text":"Abram cu a feh vivo ih hmun thianghlim Shekhem khua Moreh hmunih sasua kung ah a va thleng. Cuih caanah Kanaan mi pawl acuih ramah an um lai."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu Abram hnenah a lang ih, “Na tesinfa hnenih ka pek dingmi ram cu hi ram hi a si,” ti ah a ti. Cule cutawkah Abram in a hnenih a langmi Bawipa hrangah biakṭheng a don."},"8":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Abram cu thlanglam ah, Bethel khua ihsin nisuahnak lam tlangpar ram ah a ṭhawn ih nitlaknak lamah Bethel, nisuahnak lamah Ai khua, cuih karlakah riahbuk a sak. Cutawk khalah cun biakṭheng a don ih Bawipa cu a biak."},"9":{"text":"Cun thlanglam Negev ram lamah riahbuk pakhat hnu pakhat sak in a ṭhawn vivo."},"10":{"text":"A cuih ramah nasazetin paam a tlung ih rawl ei ding a um lo ruangah Abram cu Izipt ramah caan tawite sung um dingin a vung feh.","title":"Abram Izipt Ram A Thleng"},"11":{"text":"Izipt ramri a thlen zik tikah a nupi Sarai hnenah, “Nang hi nunau hmelṭha na si."},"12":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl ih an lo hmuh tikah Abram nupi a si, an ti ding ih nangmah co duh ah keimah riangri in that pang ding."},"13":{"text":"An lo sut asile a farnu ka si na ti pei. Cuticun nangmah ih ruangah ka luat ding ih in zohṭha ding a si,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Izipt ramsung an vung lut tikah Izipt mi pawl cun, “Sarai cu mimawi a si,” an ti ngaingai."},"15":{"text":"Bawi pawl in an hmuh ve tikah a mawizia cu an siangpahrang hnenah an va sim ih siangpahrang inn ah an fehpi."},"16":{"text":"Sarai ruangah Izipt siangpahrang in Abram cu ṭhazet in a zoh ih tuu le me pawl, caw le laak le kalauk pawl a ruun a ruun in a ṭhen ih sal tampi tiangin a pek."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Sarai cu siangpahrang ih inn a thlen ruangah Bawipa in siangpahrang le a innsungih a ummi hmuahhmuah parah ṭihnungza natnak a tlunter."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Faro siangpahrang in Abram cu a ko ih, “Ziang hrangah hi bangtuk in i tuah? Ziangah so ka nupi a si, ti ah fiangtein i sim lo?"},"19":{"text":"Ziangruangah ka farnu a si ti ah na ti? Ka farnu a si na ti ruangah a si nupi ih ka lak. Atu zamrangin na nupi hi lak awla suak uh,” ti ah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Faro in a kuthnuai mi hnenah thu a pek ih Abram cu a nupi Sarai le an neihmi hmuahhmuah tla thawn Izipt ram ihsin an dawi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cutiin Izipt ram in Abram cu a suak ih saklam ram Negev lamah a nupi le a neihmi hmuahhmuah thawn an feh. A hnenah Lot khal a tel.","title":"Abram Le Lot An ṭhen Aw"},"2":{"text":"Abram cu milianzet a si ih tuu, me, caw pawl tampi a nei ih sui le ngun khal a nei."},"3":{"text":"Negev in a pok ih riahbuk pakhat hnu pakhat a ṭhawn vivo ih, hmaisa bikih riahbuk a saknak Bethel le Ai karlakih ram lamah a feh."},"4":{"text":"A hmaisaih biakṭheng a tuahnak hmun a thlen tikah Bawipa ih a hmin a ko."},"5":{"text":"Cule Abram thawn a feh ve mi Lot khal in tuu le me le caw pawl tampi a nei ih hnenum tla a nei."},"6":{"text":"Abram le Lot cu ṭilva tampi an nei veve ih rannung ei ding hrampi khopkham a um lo ruangah hmunkhat ah an umtlang thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah an ṭilva kiltu pawl karlakah napi ih tawh awknak a suak. Culai ahcun Kanaan mi le Periz mi pawl cuih ramah an um lai hrih a si."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Abram in Lot hnenah, “Sungkhat kan si ih na minung pawl le ka minung pawl hi to-aw rero ding an si lo."},"9":{"text":"Kan ṭhen-aw sawn pei. Na duhmi ram hril awla cutawkah feh aw. Kei hmun dangah ka feh pei,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Lot cu khua a cuan ih, Bawipa ih hmuan le Izipt ram vek a si mi Jordan tiva kap phairawn cu Zoar tiang tidai tamzet ih ngahmi ramṭha a si kha a hmu. Culai ahcun Sodom le Gomorrah pawl cu Bawipa in a siatter hrih lo."},"11":{"text":"Lot cun amah ih hrangah Jordan tiva kap phairawn zatein a hril ih nisuahnak lamah a cer. Cuticun an ṭhen-awta."},"12":{"text":"Abram cu Kanaan ramah cun a um ih Lot cu phairawn ih khawpi lakah a um. Sodom khua kiangah buk a sak."},"13":{"text":"Sodom khuasung mi cu miṭha lozet an si ih Bawipa hmaiah an sual ngaingai."},"14":{"text":"Lot ih a tlansan hnu cun Abram hnenah Bawipa in, “Na umnak hmun ihsin sak le thlang, nisuah le nitlak, khuazakip hi ṭhatein zohhnik.","title":"Abram Hebron Ah A Cer"},"15":{"text":"Na hmuhmi ram hmuahhmuah hi nangmah le na tesinfa hnenah ka lo pe ding ih kumkhua in nan ram a si ding."},"16":{"text":"Tesinfa tampi ka lo pe ding ih leilung parih leidip siar cawk lo an si bangin na tesinfa khal siar cawk lo an si ding."},"17":{"text":"Cutiin hi ram hi a tung a vang in haal thluh aw; ziangahtile a zatein ka lo pe thluh ding a si,” ti ah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah Abram cu a riahbuk a ṭhawn ih Hebron khua Mamre sasua kung kiangah hmun a khuar. Cutawkah Bawipa hrangah biakṭheng a don."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih caanah siangpahrang pali: Babilonia siangpahrang Amrafel, Ellasar siangpahrang Ariok, Elam siangpahrang Khedorlaomer le Goiim siangpahrang Tidal pawl in,","title":"Abram In Lot A Run"},"2":{"text":"a dang siangpahrang panga: Sodom siangpahrang Bera, Gomorrah siangpahrang Birsha, Admah siangpahrang Shinab, Zeboiim siangpahrang Shemeber le Bela (a si lole Zoar) siangpahrang pawl tla an do."},"3":{"text":"Atuih Rili Thi timi Siddim nelrawn ah khin cuih siangpahrang panga cu an kom-aw ih an ṭang tlang."},"4":{"text":"Anmah cu kum hleihnih sung Khedorlaomer in a rak uk zo ih a kum hleithumnak ah amah do dingin ral a thotu an si."},"5":{"text":"A kum hleilinak ah Khedorlaomer le a ṭanpi pawl cun an ralkap zate thawn an do ciamco ih Ashteroth Karnaim ah Refaim an neh, Ham ah Zuzim an neh, Kiriathaim hmunrawn ah Emim an neh ih,"},"6":{"text":"vunnel rawn kiangih ummi Elparan tiang, Seirih tlang parah Hor mi pawl tla an neh thluh a si."},"7":{"text":"Cun dunglamah an kir ih Kadesh (Kadesh a si lole Enmishpat) an thlen tikah Amalek mi pawl ih ram hmuahhmuah an hun lak phah ih Hazazon Tamar ih ummi Amor mi khal an neh thluh a si."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim le Bela khua ih siangpahrang pawl cun an ralkap neihmi hmuahhmuah an khawm ih,"},"9":{"text":"Elam siangpahrang Khedorlaomer, Goiim siangpahrang Tidal, Babilonia siangpahrang Amrafel le Ellasar siangpahrang Ariok pawl thawn Siddim nelrawn ah siangpahrang panga le siangpahrang pali an do-aw ciamco."},"10":{"text":"Siddim nelrawn cu zinan suahnak khur in a khat ih, Sodom le Gomorrah siangpahrang pawl cu an raldonak in an tlan tikah acuih khur sungah an tla ciamco. A dang pathum pawl cu tlang parah an tlan hlo."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang pali pawl cun Sodom le Gomorrah khuasungih a ummi thil hmuahhmuah, an ei ding rawl tiangin an lak ih an tlan."},"12":{"text":"Sodom khuasungih a ummi Lot khal a neihmi hmuahhmuah thawn an kai ih an hruai."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla raltlan pa pakhat cu Hebru mi Abram hnenah a ra ih Lot an kaihnak thu a ra sim. Abram cu Amor mi Mamre ih sasua kung kiangah a um. Mamre ih unau pawl cu Eshkol le Aner an si ih an pathum in Abram ṭantu an si."},"14":{"text":"Abram cun a sungkhat pa an kaihnak thu a theih tikah a milai pawl a kokhawm ih pacang hlir zathum le hleiriat an pok ih ral pawl cu Dan tiang an dawi."},"15":{"text":"Cutawk hmunah Abram milai pawl cu bu hnih ah an ṭhen-aw ih zanah an ral pawl cu an do ih an neh. An ral pawl cu Damaskas khua saklam ih a ummi Hobah tiang an hun dawi."},"16":{"text":"A sungkhat pa Lot le Lot ih neihmi hmuahhmuah le nunau pawl le ral kaihmi dangdang thawn a long thluh ih a kirpi sal thluh."},"17":{"text":"Abram cu Khedorlaomer le siangpahrang dang pawl a va nehnak ihsin a kir tikah Sodom siangpahrang cun Shaveh phairawn (Siangpahrang Phairawn ti khalih timi) in a rak hmuak.","title":"Melkhizedek In Abram A Thlawsuah"},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Salem siangpahrang Melkhizedek khal in sang le sabitti a keng ih Abram cu a hmuak ve. Melkhizedek cu Cungnungbik Pathian ih puithiam khal a si ih Abram cu thluasuahnak hiti in a pek:"},"19":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Pathian, Lei le van tuahtu in, Abram cu thlawsuah hram seh."},"20":{"text":"Na ral pawl parih nehnak a lo petu, Cungnungbik Pathian cu thangṭhat in um seh,” ti ah a ti. Cule Abram in ralkut ihsin a lakmi hmuahhmuah sungih ṭhenhra ih ṭhenkhat Melkhizedek hnenah a pek."},"21":{"text":"Cule Sodom siangpahrang in Abram hnenah, “Na lakmi thil hmuahhmuah cu nangmah in co aw; asinain minung pawl cu keimah i pe sal hram aw,” ti ah a dil."},"22":{"text":"Asinain Abram in, “Van le leilung Tuahtu Cungnungbik Pathian Bawipa ih hmaiah baan phar in thu ka kam-aw:"},"23":{"text":"Na ta a si mi hmuahhmuah pat-hlum le kedamhri ih thokin ziangthil hman ka la lo ding. Curuangah ‘Abram a liantertu cu keimah ka si,’ na ti thei dah lo ding."},"24":{"text":"Ka hrangah cun zianghman ka la lo pei. Ka milai pawl ih an ei an in ciami le, i ṭanpitu pawl ih covo lawnglawng ka saang ding; cule Ener, Eshkol le Mamre khal in an covo an la ve ding,” ti ah Sodom siangpahrang hnenah a ti."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Abram hnenah Bawipa a lang ih, “Abram, na thinphang hlah; Keimah cu a lo humtu phaw ka si. Na hnenih ka laksawng cu a uakzet ding,” ti ah a sim.","title":"Abram Hnenih Pathian Thukam"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Abram in, “Maw Pathian Bawipa, fa le ka nei lo. Ka hnenih na laksawng cu ziangso a si ding? Ka rocotu cu Damaskas khua ih Eliezer lawng a si."},"3":{"text":"Fa pakhatte hman i pe lo ih, curuangah ka ro cu ka salpa pakhat in a co a ṭul ko,” ti ah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in Abram hnenah, “Hi na salpa hi na rocotu a si lo ding; na rocotu cu nangmah ih fapa ngaingai a si ding,” ti ah a sim sal."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Abram cu lengah a suahpi ih, “Van khi zoh awla arsi pawl khi na siar thei asile siar hnik; khi arsi zat in na tesinfa pawl cu an tam ding a si,” ti ah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cule Abram in Bawipa cu a zum ih acuih zumnak cu Bawipa in dingnakah a co sak."},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in Abram hnenah, “Keimah cu Bawipa ka si. Hi ram hi na ta siter dingah Khaldea ram Ur khua ihsin ka lo ṭhawnter a si,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Abram in, “Maw Pathian, ka Bawipa ziangtinso ka ta a si ti ka theih ding?” ti ah a sut."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in, “Ka hnenah kum thum kim cawla, kum thum kim mela, kum thum kim tuucang, thuro pakhat le laileng pakhat rak keng aw,” ti ah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Abram in Pathian hnenah a zatein a rak keng ih an laifang ciar in phel hnih ah a phel ih phel khat cu a dang phel khat hmaiah artlang in tlar hnih ah a ret; vatesa cu a phel lo."},"11":{"text":"Langta pawl in sa cu an rung tlan naón Abram in a rak dawi hai."},"12":{"text":"Zanlam ni a tlak cuahco tikah Abram cu a itthat. Cutikah a hnenah ṭihnung tuksumza khuathim a rung thleng."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in a hnenah, “Na tesinfa pawl cu ramdang ah mivai an si ding. Cuih ramah cun sal an si ding ih kum zali sung hremmi an si ding."},"14":{"text":"Asinain na tesinfa a tisiattu ram cu ka hrem ding; thilri tampi thawn cutawk cun an suak leh ding."},"15":{"text":"Nang cu tlamtling in tarkuun tiang na nung ding ih thinlung thlangamte in na thi ding; cule phum na si ding."},"16":{"text":"Na tesinfa pawl cu san li hnuah hi ramah an rakir sal ding; ziangahtile hi tawkih Amor mi pawl hi miṭha lozet ah an cang ding ih hremnak an tuar tik lawngah hi ram ihsin ka dawi leh hai ding,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun ni a tlak ih khua a thim tikah, hmakhatte-ah a khu ih a alh hluahhlo mi beel le a alh hluahhlo mi meifar an lang ih sa tlar hnih ih retmi karlak ihsin an lan zuahzo."},"18":{"text":"A cuih ni ah Bawipa in Abram hnenah thukamnak a tuah ih, “Hi ram hmuahhmuah hi na tesinfa pawl hnenah ka pe ding ti ah ka lo kam a si. Izipt ramri ih tiva ihsin Eufrates vapi tiang a si ding;"},"19":{"text":"cun Ken ram, Keniz ram, Kadmon ram,"},"20":{"text":"Hit ram, Periz ram, Refaim ram,"},"21":{"text":"Amor ram, Kanaan ram, Girgash ram le Jebus ram pawl tla an tel ding,” ti ah a ti."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Abram nupi Sarai cun fa pakhat hman a nei lo. Asinain Sarai in Izipt mi Hagar timi salnu a nei.","title":"Hagar Le Ishmael"},"2":{"text":"Sarai in Abram hnenah, “Zohhnik, Bawipa in fa i neihter duh lo hi! Ziangah so ka salnu thawn nan ittlang ko lo? Anih cun ka hrangah faate a nei thei men ding,” ti ah a ti. Cule Abram in Sarai ih thu cu a ngai."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Sarai in a salnu, Izipt nunau Hagar cu Abram ih nupi dingah a pek. Kanaan ramah Abram kum hra a um hnuah hi thil hi a cang."},"4":{"text":"Abram le Hagar cu an pawl-aw ih Hagar cu fa a vun. Hagar in fa a vun ti a theih awk tikah a puarthau ih Sarai cu a hmuhsuam."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Sarai cun Abram hnenah, “Hagar in hiti ih i hmuhsuam hi nangmah ih mawh a si. Ka salnu cu keimah in ka lo pe. Asinain fa a vun ti a theih awk vete in i hmuhsuam ciamco. Bawipa in nang maw kei so, zo a dik deuh ti thu in ṭhen hram seh,” ti ah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cule Abram cun, “Hagar cu na salnu a si; nangmah in na uk; na duhduh in tuah aw,” ti ah Sarai hnenah a ti. Cutikah Sarai in Hagar cu a tuahsiat ih Hagar cu a tlan."},"7":{"text":"Cutiin Hagar cu Shur lamah a tlan ih ramṭhing lakih cerhti kiangah Bawipa ih vancungmi in a tong."},"8":{"text":"Vancungmi in a hnenah, “Sarai ih salnu Hagar, khui inso na rat ih khui ah so na feh zik?” ti ah a sut. Hagar in, “Ka bawinu Sarai hnen ihsin ka tlan,” ti ah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi in, “Sarai hnenah kirsal awla a kut hnuai ah va um aw;"},"10":{"text":"“Zohman ih siar cawk lo, Tesinfa tampi ka lo pe ding;"},"11":{"text":"Fapa na nei ding ih, A hminah Ishmael na sak ding; Ziangahtile Bawipa in na zonzaihnak a thei."},"12":{"text":"A sinan na fapa cu, Laak hee vek a si ding. Mikip a raal ding ih, Mikip in an raal ve ding. Sungkhat thawn hman an umtlang lo ding,” ti ah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Hagar in, “Pathian cu hitawk ah hin ka tong ngaingai ih ka nung lai maw si?” ti ah amah le amah a ti-aw. Cule a hnenah ra in a ṭongtu Bawipa cu a hminah, “El-roi,” ti ah a ko."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Kadesh le Bered karlakih tikhur cu mi hmuahhmuah in, “Beer-lahai-roi,” ti ah an ko ṭheu."},"15":{"text":"Cun Hagar in Abram fapa cu a hring ih a hminah amah Abram in Ishmael ti ah a sak."},"16":{"text":"Abram cu Hagar in fapa a hrin tikah kum sawmriat le kum ruk a si."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abram cu kum sawmkua le kum kua a si tikah Bawipa a hnenah a lang ih, “Keimah cu Ziangkimtithei Pathian ka si. Na nunsung hmuahhmuah ka thu thlun awla soisel lomi si aw.","title":"Serhtan Cu Thukam Hminsinnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka thukam na hnenah ka tuah ding ih tesinfa tampi ka lo pe ding,” ti ah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule Abram cu a hmai leilung dai in a kuun ih Pathian in,"},"4":{"text":"“Nangmah thawn ka fekter dingmi ka thukam cu hihi a si: Leilung tlun miphun tampi cithlahtu na si ding, ti ah ka lo kam."},"5":{"text":"Na hmin hi Abram si nawn loin, Abraham a si thlang ding; ziangahtile miphun tampiih pa ah ka lo tuah ding."},"6":{"text":"Tesinfa tampi ka lo pe ding ih a hrekkhat cu siangpahrang tla an si ding. Tesinfa tampi na nei ding ih miphun tampi ah an cang ding."},"7":{"text":"“Ka thukam cu ka fekter ding ih nangmah le na tesinfa pawl hnenah, sankhat hnu sankhat, kumkhua daih thukamnak a si ding. Keimah cu na Pathian ka si ding ih na tesinfa pawl ih Pathian khal ka si ding."},"8":{"text":"Atu na umnak ram, mikhual na sinak ram hi nangmah le na tesinfa hnenah ka lo pe ding. Kanaan ram hmuahhmuah hi kumkhua in nan ta a si ding ih keimah cu nan Pathian ka si ding,” ti ah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Pathian in Abraham hnenah, “Nangmah khal in ka thukam cu na fekter pei ih na thlun pei; na tesinfa pawl khal in sankhat hnu sankhat an thlun ringring pei."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah le na tesinfa pawl in ka thukam nan fekternak dingah mipa hmuahhmuah in serh nan tan thluh pei."},"11":{"text":"Atu thokin mipa pohpoh cu ni riat an ti ni ah an serh nan tan ding; nan innsung suak sal siseh, ramdang ih nan leimi sal siseh, nan tan thluh ding. Himi cu keimah le nanmah karlakih thukamnak langtertu a si ding.","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"Serhtan an si ṭheh ding; himi cu kumkhua in nan hnenih ka thukamnak a langnak dingah nan taksa parih hminsinnak a si ding."},"14":{"text":"Serhtan lomi mipa cu ka thukam a thlun lo ruangah a miphun sung ihsin hlon a si ding,” ti ah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cule Pathian in Abraham hnenah, “Na nupi hi Sarai ti ah na ko nawn lo pei; atu thokin a hmin cu Sarah a si zo."},"16":{"text":"Sarah cu ka thlawsuah ding ih amah sung ihsin fapa ka lo pe ding. Ka thlawsuah pei ih miphun tampiih nu ah a cang ding. A tesinfa pawl sungin siangpahrang tampi an suak ding,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Abraham cu a hmai leilung dai in a kuun ih a hni; cule thu a ruat ih, “Milai in kum zakhat ti hnuah fa a nei thei pei maw? Kum sawmkua a ti hnuah hin Sarah in fa a nei thei ngaingai pei maw?” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Abraham in Pathian hnenah, “Ishmael tal cu na hmaiah mithmai ṭha ngah hram seh,” ti ah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in, “Abraham, cutiin a si lo. Na nupi Sarah hrimhrim in fapa a lo hrin ding ih a hminah Isaak ti ah na ko ding. Amah hnenah siseh, a tesinfa pawl hnenah siseh, ka thukam cu ka fekter ding. Ziangahtile kumkhua daih thukamnak a si."},"20":{"text":"Nang in Ishmael thu ah i dil ih ka thei zo; kei in ka tuah dingmi cu hiti in a si: Ishmael cu ka thlawsuah ding ih tefa tampi le tesinfa tampi ka pe ding. Amah cu siangpahrang hleihnih ih pa ah a cang ding. A tesinfa pawl cu miphun tumzet ah ka canter ding."},"21":{"text":"Hmaikum tu tikcu ah Sarah ih hrin dingmi na fapa Isaak hnenah ka thukam ka hngetter ding,” ti ah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cule Abraham hnenih thusim a ṭheh tikah Pathian cun a fehsan."},"23":{"text":"A cuih sun rori ah Pathian ih a simta vekin Abraham cun a fapa Ishmael le a sal hmuahhmuah, innsuak sal siseh, a leimi sal siseh, a innsungih a ummi mipa pohpoh, an serh a tan ṭheh hai."},"24":{"text":"Abraham cu serh a tan tikah kum sawmkua le kum kua a kim."},"25":{"text":"A fapa Ishmael cu kum hleithum a kim."},"26":{"text":"Cuih ni ah an pa fa, le"},"27":{"text":"an innsungih a ummi sal hmuahhmuah thawn serhtan tlang an si."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu Mamre sasua kung hmunih a ummi Abraham hnenah a rung lang. Abraham cu a riahbuk sangka ah, sun niling laifangah a to ih,","title":"Isaak Suahnak Thutiam"},"2":{"text":"a hun zoh tikah veikhatte-ah milai pathum an rung din kha a hmu. A hmuh vete in va hmuak dingah a sangka cun a va tlan. A hmai leilung dai in a bok ih,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka bawipa, in zaangfah thei ahcun ka inn ah cawl phah loin in taan siang hlah uh. Nan salpa ka si ih nan duh vekih a lo riantu ding ka si ko."},"4":{"text":"Nan ke kholhnak dingah tidai ka rak kengter pei ih hi thingkung hnuai ah nan cawlta hrih pei."},"5":{"text":"Rawl ka rak keng pei ih nan lamzin fehnak ah thazaang nan nei deuh ding. Ka inn nan ra thleng zo ih nanmah tuamhlawmtu ding ka si ko,” ti ah a ti. Annih in, “A ṭha, na sim vekin tuah aw,” ti ah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Abraham cu a riahbuk sungah zamrangin a feh ih Sarah hnenah, “Na sangvut lakih a ṭha bikmi tah thum in suak awla, zamrangin pawnghmuk tuah aw,” ti ah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun a cawrual lakah a va tlan ih caw note pakhat, a thau ih a sathawt laifang a si mi a va hruai ih a hnenum hnenah zamrangin suan dingah a pek."},"8":{"text":"Abraham cun cawhnawi thur, cawhnawi le an suanmi cawsa cu a lak ih a mikhual pawl ih hmaiah ei dingah a hun. Annih in an ei; cule Abraham cun thing hnuai ah ding tahratin a kil hai."},"9":{"text":"Cule a mikhual pawl in, “Na nupi Sarah khuiah a si?” ti ah an sut. “Riahbuk sungah a um ko,” ti ah a let."},"10":{"text":"A mikhual pakhat in, “Na nupi Sarah in hmai kum atuih caanah fapa a nei ding; cutikah ka ra sal ding,” ti ah thu a tiam. Sarah in an mikhual pa ih dunglam an riahbuk sangka ihsin a thusim mi cu a rak ngai ringring."},"11":{"text":"Abraham le Sarah cu an tarzet thlang ih Sarah cu nunau daan a nei nawn lo."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Sarah in, “Kei cu ka upa tuk zo, mipa thawn pawl-aw in nomnak ka nei ngai pei maw? Cuih tlunah ka pasal le a tar tuk ve zo,” ti ah hni phah in a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Abraham hnenah, “Ziangah Sarah cu hni phah in, ‘Ka tar zo hnuah hin fa ka nei thei ngaingai pei maw?’ a ti."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa hrangah a harmi a um maw si? Hmaikum a tikcu a kim tikah ka ra sal ding ih Sarah in fapa a nei tengteng ding,” ti ah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Sarah cu a thin a phang ih, “Ka hni hrimhrim lo,” ti ah a phat. Bawipa in, “Phat duh hlah, na hni ko,” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun a mikhual pawl cu an tho ih Sodom khua an vun hmuh theinak hmun ah an feh. Abraham cun a hei thlah hai.","title":"Sodom Hrangah Abraham Thla A Cam"},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Thil ka tuah dingmi hi Abraham hnen ihsin ka thup thei nawn lo."},"18":{"text":"A tesinfa pawl cu miphun tum le miphun cak ah an cangṭheh ding ih amah ka thlawsuah zo vekin leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah in thlawsuah in dil ding."},"19":{"text":"A dikmi le a dingmi tuah tahratin ka thupekmi pawl an thlun theinak dingah a fapa pawl le a sungkhat pawl zirhsuak dingin amah cu ka hril zo a si. Cuticun ka tiamkam ciami hmuahhmuah cu a parah ka kimter thluh ding a si,” ti ah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in, “Sodom le Gomorrah an mawhthluknak pawl hi a nasa ngaingai ih an sualnak hi a tum ngaingai."},"21":{"text":"Ka vung feh pei ih an mawhnak ka theihmi hi ka vung zingzoi pei ih thufiang ka thei ding,” ti ah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Abraham ih mikhual pahnih cu Sodom khua lamah cun an feh; asinain Bawipa cu Abraham hnenah a taang."},"23":{"text":"Abraham in Bawipa cu a hei naih ih, “Mi ṭha lomi lakah mi ṭha khal na siatsuah cih thluh thotho ding maw?"},"24":{"text":"Sodom khawsung ah mi ṭha sawmnga an um tibang sehla, a khawpi zatein maw na siatsuah ko ding? Mi ṭha sawmnga him dingah hi khua hi na zuah lo ding maw?"},"25":{"text":"Mi ṭha lomi thawn hmun khatah mi ṭhami tla cu na that ko ding maw? A cangthei lo, na ti dah lo ding. Cutiih na tuah ahcun a mawhmi bangtuk in a dikmi khal daan peknak an tuar ve ding maw? Cucu a cangthei lomi a si. Leilung tlun hmuahhmuah ih thuṭhentu cun dingthluk lairelnak thawn thu a ṭhen lo ding maw si?” ti ah Abraham in a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Sodom khuasungah mi ṭha sawmnga an um a si ahcun acuih sawmnga ruangah a khuapumin ka zuah ko ding,” ti ah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Abraham in, “Maw Bawipa, kei cu leidip le vutcam lawng ka si ih na hnenah zianghman sim theinak ka nei lo. A ral a va ṭha ve ti ah i ti siang hram hlah aw."},"28":{"text":"Thuṭhimnak ah Sodom khawsungah mi ṭha sawmnga si loin sawmli le panga um hai sehla, minung panga sam ruangah hi khawpi hi na siatsuah thotho pei maw?” ti ah a ti. Bawipa in, “Mi ṭha sawmli le panga an um ahcun ka siatsuah lo ding,” ti ah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cun Abraham in, “Sawmli lawng um hai sehla teh,” ti ah a ti sal. Bawipa in, “Sawmli an um ahcun ka siatsuah lo ding,” a ti."},"30":{"text":"Abraham in, “ Bawipa , na thinheng hram hlah aw, ka lo sut hrih ko pei; sawmthum lawng um hai sehla ziangtin a si pei?” ti ah a sut lala. Bawipa in, “Sawmthum an um a si ahcun ka siatsuah lo ding,” ti ah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Abraham in, “Ka lo sut ngam vivonak hi, Bawipa , i ngaithiam hram aw; thuṭhimnak ah kul lawng um hai sehla ziangtin a si pei?” ti ah a sut lala. Bawipa in, “A ṭhami kul an um ahcun hi khawpi ka siatsuah lo ding,” ti ah a ti thotho."},"32":{"text":"Cule Abraham in, “ Bawipa , na thin heng hram hlah aw, veikhatte in ka lo sut hrih ko pei: pahra lawng um hai sehla teh, ziangtin a si pei?” ti ah a sut. Bawipa in, “Pahra an um taktak ahcun ka siatsuah lo ding,” ti ah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Abraham in cutiih thu a suh hnuah Bawipa cu a fehhlo ih Abraham cu a inn ah a tlung."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zanlam nitla zawng ah vancungmi pahnih Sodom khua an thlen tikah Lot cu minung an ton awk ṭheunak khuasuah ah a rak to. Lot in vancungmi pahnih a hmuh tikah hmuak dingin a va feh. Leilung dai in a kuun ih,","title":"Sodom Mipawl An Sualzia"},"2":{"text":"“Ka bawipale uh, in zaangfah asile ka inn ah ra riak hram uh. Ka inn ah ra riak uhla nan ke tla ra kholh uh. Thaizing ah zingpit tein nan feh sal leh ding,” ti ah a ti. Annih in, “A si thei lo ding; tuih zan cu hi khawpi-ih kotthler ah kan riak ding,” ti ah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Asinain Lot in a innih riak ding cun a leem rero ih neta bik ah a innih riak ding cun an lung a kim sal. Cule Lot cun thilnu tel lo sang a tuah ih zanriah thawzet a dar ih an ei."},"4":{"text":"Cuih zan cu a mikhual pawl an ih hlanah, Sodom khuasungmi in Lot ih inn cu an kulh ṭheh. Upa nauhak ti loin an zatein an tel ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Lot cu an vun ko ih, “Na hnenih tuih zan a ra riakmi na mikhual pawl khuiah an si? Rak suah hnik, kan sualpi pei,” ti ah an au."},"6":{"text":"Lot cu sangka in a va suak ih a kharsal hnuah,"},"7":{"text":"“Rualle uh, cuvek thil ṭha lo cu a tuah tum hram hlah uh, ti ah ka lo dil."},"8":{"text":"Zoh uh, hinah fanu himte pahnih ka nei. Ka rak suahpi pei ih nan duh bangtuk in tuah uh. Asinain hi mi pawl parah cun zianghman tuah hram hlah uh; ziangahtile ka mikhual an si ih ka inn ah an thleng zo a si,” ti ah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Asinain annih in, “Nang ramdang mi taak ko; in kian sawn; cucu tuah uh, khakha tuah uh, ti ah ziangtinso nang in in ti thei? ṭhawn sawn aw; culole nangmah riangri kan lo tuahmawh ngah sawn ding,” an ti ih Lot cu an tuul ih a sangka cu a bauh an tum."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah a mikhualte pahnih cun Lot cu sangka cun an hei dawh ih innsungih an hnuh lut hnuah sangka cu an khar."},"11":{"text":"Cuih hnuah sangka lengih a ummi mipi pawl cu nauta bik in upa bik tiang an mit an cawtter thluh ih sangka an hmu thei nawn lo."},"12":{"text":"Cun a mikhual pahnih in Lot hnenah, “Sungte dang na nei lai maw? Na fapa pawl, na fanu pawl le na fanu ih pasal pawl ko thluh awla zamrangte in hi khua in suak uh;","title":"Lot Cu Sodom Khua In A Suak"},"13":{"text":"ziangahtile hi khua hi kan siatsuah thluh ding a si. Bawipa in hi khawsungmi sualnak le borhhlawhnak a theifiang zo ih Sodom khua hi siatsuah dingah in thlah a si,” ti ah an sim."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Lot cu zamrangte in a feh ih a fanu pawl ih pasal dingmi tlangval pawl hnenah, “Zamrangte in hi hmun in suak uh; ziangahtile Bawipa in hi khawpi cu a siatsuah ding a si,” ti ah a sim hai. Asinain annih cun capoh men ah an ruat."},"15":{"text":"Zingpit khuafing a cah in vancungmi cun Lot hnenah, “Zamrang aw; na nupi le na fanu pahnih hruai awla suak zaang aw; hi khua hi siatthluh a si ih a hloral tikah nan tel ve pang dah pei,” ti ah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Lot cu a ṭhukṭhun deuh. Cutikah Bawipa in a zaangfah thotho ih Lot le a nupi le a fanu pahnih cu vancungmi in an kut in an hruai ih khuapawn ah an fehpi."},"17":{"text":"Khawpawn an thlen tikah vancungmi pakhat in, “Nan nunsuaknak dingah tlan uh; nan dunglam hoikir hlah uhla hmunrawn ahhin tangphah hlah uh. Tlang parah tlan uhla nan thi lo ding,” ti ah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Asinain Lot in, “ Bawipa , cuticun si hram hlah seh,"},"19":{"text":"i zaangfah ih ka nunnak cu i zuah zo. Tlangpar cu ka thleng thei hrimhrim lo ding; a hlazet lai ih khitawk ka thlen hlanah siatsuahnak in i man thotho ding."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa , khi khua fate khi na hmu ko. Khi khua fate cu a naite pam ih ka thleng man ko ding. Ka luatnak dingah khi khua ah ka feh ko pei,” ti ah a dil."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah vancungmi in, “Na dil vekin ka lo lungkimpi a si; khi khua cu ka siatsuah lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Zamrang in tlan zaang aw. Khi khua na thlen hlan cu zianghman ka tuah lo ding,” ti ah a ti. A cuih khua cu, “Khua fate,” ti ah Lot in a ti ruangah Zoar ti ah an run kota."},"23":{"text":"Ni a hung suak ih Lot cu Zoar khua a va thlen tikah,","title":"Sodom Le Gomorrah Siatsuahnak"},"24":{"text":"Bawipa in Sodom le Gomorrah khua parah kaat mei-alh van in a suurter."},"25":{"text":"Cuticun khawpi pawl le nelrawn pawl, khuasungih a ummi minung hmuahhmuah le leiram parih a khomi hmuahhmuah thawn Bawipa in a siatsuah thluh."},"26":{"text":"Asinain Lot ih nupi cu dunglam a hoikir ruangah ciṭhuamah a cangta."},"27":{"text":"A thaizing ah Abraham cu Pathian thawn an ton awknak hmunah zamrangte in a feh."},"28":{"text":"Sodom le Gomorrah khua le nelrawn tluan cu a vun zoh tikah cahmang meipikhu vekin meikhu a kai luailo kha a hmu."},"29":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in nelrawn ih khawpi pawl a siatsuah tikah Abraham cu a hngilh lo ih Lot cu himte in a luatter."},"30":{"text":"Lot cu Zoar khua ih um a ṭih ruangah a fanu pahnih thawn tlangpar ah an ceer ih lungpuk sungah an um.","title":"Moab Mi Le Ammon Mi Suahkehnak"},"31":{"text":"Cutikah a upa deuh nu in a naunu hnenah, “Ka pa hi a tar vivo thlang a si. Faate kan neih theinak dingah a daan keelih in ra ṭhitu ding leilung parah mipa an um fawn lo."},"32":{"text":"Curuangah ra hnik, ka pa thawn pawl aw-in faate tla kan neih theinak dingah sabitti ri ko in kan tul hnik pei,” ti ah a ti."},"33":{"text":"A cuih zan cu an pa cu sabitti an pek ih a upa nu le a pa cu an pawl aw; asinain sabitti a rit tuk ruangah a pa cun an pawl awk cu a thei lo."},"34":{"text":"A thaisun ah a naunu hnenah, “Mizan ah ka pa thawn kan pawl aw. Tuihzan khal sabitti kan pe lala pei ih nangmah thawn nan pawl aw pei. Cuticun kan pahnih in kan pa ih fa kan nei ding,” ti ah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Curuangah acuih zan khal an pa cu sabitti an pek ih a ri lala ih a fanu nauta thawn an pawl aw. Ahmaisa vekin an pa cu sabitti a rit tuk ruangah a fanu nauta thawn an pawl awk cu a thei thotho lo."},"36":{"text":"Cutiin Lot ih fanu pahnih cu an pa ih fa an vun veve."},"37":{"text":"A fanu upa sawn in fapa a nei ih a hmin ah Moab ti ah a fanu in a sak. Cuih fapa cu tuihsan Moab mipawl cithlahtu a si."},"38":{"text":"A fanu nauta khal in fapa a nei ve ih, Ben-ammi ti ah a fanu cun hmin a sak. Ben-ammi cu tuihsan Ammon mipawl cithlahtu a si."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham cu Mamre ihsin Negev ramah a ceer ih Kadesh le Shur karlakah a um. Cuih hnu Gerar ih a um laiah,","title":"Abraham Le Abimelek"},"2":{"text":"Abraham in a nupi Sarah cu ka farnu a si, a ti ruangah Gerar siangpahrang Abimelek in a nupi dingah a lak."},"3":{"text":"Cuih zan cu Abimelek ih mangah Pathian a lang ih Pathian in, “Na thi ding, ziangahtile Sarah hi mi nupi a si,” ti ah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Asinain Sarah cu Abimelek in a ihpi hrih lo hrangah, “Bawipa, miṭha khal na that ko ding maw?"},"5":{"text":"Abraham in ka farnu a si a ti ih amah Sarah khal in Abraham cu ka u-pa a si a ti fawn. Curuangah hi thil ka tuahmi hi thinlung thiangte ih ka tuahmi a si; sualnak zianghman ka tuah lo,” ti ah Abimelek in a ti."},"6":{"text":"A mang thotho ahcun Pathian in, “Asi, thinlung thiangte in na tuahmi a si ti ka thei; curuangah keimah hmaiih misual na si lonak dingah Sarah ka lo thamter lonak cu a si."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu ihsin Sarah cu a pasal hnenah fehter aw. A pasal cu Profet a si ih na thih lonak dingah na hrangah thla a lo cam sak ding. Asinain na kirter lo ahcun nangmah le nan sungkurun in nan thi tengteng ding; ralrinnak atu in ka lo pe a si,” ti ah a ti."},"8":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah Abimelek cu a tho ih a hnenum pawl a ko thluh ih acuih thu pawl cu kimtein a sim ṭheh. A hnenum pawl cu an thin a phang ngaingai."},"9":{"text":"Cun Abimelek in Abraham cu a ko ih a hnenah, “Kan parih na tuah mi hi ziangvek thil so a si? Ziang sualnak na parih ka tuah ruangah so hi thil ṭihnungza hi keimah le ka ram parah na thlen ter? Ka parih na tuahmi vek hi cu zohman in an tuah dah lo."},"10":{"text":"Ziangah so hivek cun na tuah?” ti ah a sut."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Abraham in, “Pathian a ṭihzahtu hi ramah hin an um lo ding ih ka nupi co duh ah in that men ding, ti ah ka ruah ruangah a si."},"12":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Sarah hi ka farnu taktak a si ko. Amah cu ka pa ih fanu a si; asinain ka nu ih fanu cu a si lo; curuangah ka ṭhit a si."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian in ka pa ih inn taan tahratin ka thlen dah lonak ramih i thlah tikah, ‘Ka parih zumtlak ngaingai na sinak langter dingah, ka ṭapa a si, ti ah kan fehnak tinah na ti pei,’ tiin Sarah cu ka tiam ciami a si,” ti ah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Abimelek in Sarah cu Abraham hnenah a pek sal; cuih tlunah tuu le caw le sal tampi tla a pek cih."},"15":{"text":"Cule Abraham hnenah, “Hi ram hmuahhmuah hi ka ta a si; na duhnak poh ah um aw,” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Sarah hnenah, “Na ṭapa hnenah ngun tangka thawngkhat ka pek. Himi cu na kiangkapih a ummi minung hmuahhmuah hnenah mawh nei lo na sinak kha langter dingah a si. Mi hmuahhmuah in sualnak zianghman na tuah lo ti an thei ding,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Abraham nupi Sarah parah cutiih thil an rak tuah ruangah Bawipa in Abimelek innsungih a ummi nunau hmuahhmuah cu faate nei thei lo dingin a tuah hai."},"18":{"text":"Asinain Abraham in Abimelek hrangah thla a cam ih Pathian in Abimelek le a nupi le a salnu pawl tla cu a damter thluh ih faate khal an nei thei sal a si."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tiamcia vekin Bawipa in Sarah cu a thluasuah ih,","title":"Isaak Suahnak"},"2":{"text":"Sarah cu nau a keng ih Abraham tar zawng ah fapa a hring. Pathian ih a sim ciami tikcu a thlen in fapa an nei."},"3":{"text":"Abraham in a fapa cu Isaak ti ah hmin a sak."},"4":{"text":"Cule Pathian ih thupek bangtuk in Abraham in Isaak cu ni riat a ti tikah serh a tan."},"5":{"text":"Isaak a suah tikah Abraham cu kum zakhat a ti."},"6":{"text":"Sarah in, “Pathian in lungawinak le hnihnak i pek a si. Hi thu a theitu hmuahhmuah in in lungawipi ding,” ti ah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cuih tlunah, “Sarah in fapa te hnawi a fawh ding ti ah Abraham hnenah zo tal in an sim dah pei maw? Asinain a tar hnuah amah hrangah fapa ka hring zo,” ti ah Sarah in a ti."},"8":{"text":"A fapa cu a ṭhang deuhdeuh ih hnawifawh a baan ni ah Abraham in rawldar puai tumpi a tuah."},"9":{"text":"Nikhat ah Izipt nu Hagar le Abraham ih an hrinmi Ishmael le Sarah ih fapa Isaak an lek tlang.","title":"Hagar Le Ishmael An Dawi"},"10":{"text":"Cumi cu Sarah in a hmuh tikah Abraham hnenah, “Hi salnu le a fapa hi dawi aw. Ka fapa Isaak ih co dingmi na ro hi hih salnu ih fapa in malte hman dai hlah seh,” ti ah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Abraham cu a thinlung a harzet, ziangahtile Ishmael khal cu a fapa thotho a si."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Pathian in Abraham hnenah, “Hi na fapa le a nu Hagar hrangah na don har hlah. Sarah ih a lo sim vekin tuah aw; ziangahtile ka lo kam ciami siar cawk lo na tesinfa pawl cu Isaak sung ihsin an suak ding a si."},"13":{"text":"Na salnu ih fapa hnen khalah tefa tampi ka pek ding ih miphun tumpi ah an cang ding. Ziangahtile anih khal na fapa a si ve,” ti ah a ti."},"14":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah Abraham cu a tho ih Hagar hnenah rawl le tidai thawl khat a pek. A fapa Ishmael cu Hagar a pawkter ih a fehter. Cutiin Hagar cu a feh ih Beersheba ramṭhing lakah a vakvai."},"15":{"text":"An tidai kenmi a cem tikah a fapa te cu hrambur hnuai ah a ret ih,"},"16":{"text":"“Ka faate thih lai cu ka zoh thei lo,” a ti ih a feh ih kaih zakhat hlat ah a va to. Cutiih a to phahin a ṭap."},"17":{"text":"Cule Pathian in naute ṭah aw khal a thei ih Pathian ih vancungmi cun vancung in a hnenah, “Hagar, ziangah so vansaangin na um? Na thin phang hlah. Pathian in naute aw a thei zo."},"18":{"text":"Tho aw; na naute va la awla ngamter-aw. A tefa pawl cu miphun tumpi ah ka tuah hai ding a si,” ti ah a run ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in Hagar mit cu a vangter ih tikhur pakhat a hmu. A va feh ih tithawl khattein ti a than ih a fapa cu tidai a pek."},"20":{"text":"Pathian in a umpi ih a fapa cu a ṭhang vivo. Paran ram ramṭhing lakah a um ih amah cu sakapzet ah a cang."},"21":{"text":"Cule a nu in nupi ah Izipt nu a ṭhit sak."},"22":{"text":"Culai ahcun Abimelek cu a ralkap uktu bawi Fikol thawn Abraham hnenah a ra ih, “Na thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah ah Pathian in a lo umpi a si.","title":"Abraham Le Abimelek Lungkimnak"},"23":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah keimah le ka faate pawl le ka tesinfa tla in bum lonak dingah Pathian hmaiah thu i kam aw. Na hnenah zumtlak in ka um zo ih nang khal keimah parah le hi na umnak ram parah zumtlakmi na sinak dingah thukamnak tuah aw,” ti ah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Abraham in, “Ka kam aw a si,” ti ah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cule Abimelek hnenum pawl ih an lonmi tikhur thu cu Abraham in Abimelek hnenah a hun salhsuah."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Abimelek in, “Hi thu hi ka thei dah lo. Nangmah in i sim dah fawn lo; atu hi hmaisa bik ka theihnak a si,” ti ah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun Abraham in Abimelek cu tuu le caw a ṭhen ih an pahnih in lungkimnak an tuah."},"28":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Abraham in a tuurual sung ihsin tuunu no pasarih a lak ih hmun dangah a ret."},"29":{"text":"“Ziangah so hiti in na tuah?” ti ah Abimelek in a sut tikah,"},"30":{"text":"Abraham in, “Hi tikhur laitu cu nangmah na si ti ih i tinak dingah hi tuunu no pasarih cu i saan a ṭul,” ti ah a sawn."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah acuih hmun cu Beersheba ti ah an ko; ziangahtile an pahnih ih thu an tiam awknak hmun a si."},"32":{"text":"Cutiin Beersheba ih lungkimnak an tuah hnuah Abimelek le a ralkap uktu bawi Fikol cu Filistin ramah an kir sal."},"33":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Beersheba ah Abraham in thingkung pakhat a phun ih kumkhua ih a nungmi Pathian Bawipa cu a biak."},"34":{"text":"Cuticun Filistin ram sungah Abraham cu reipi a um."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Pathian in Abraham cu a hniksak ih, “Abraham,” ti ah a ko. Abraham in, “ Bawipa , hinah ka um,” ti ah a ti.","title":"Pathian In Abraham A Hniksak"},"2":{"text":"Pathian in, “Na duh zetmi na fapa neihsun Isaak cu hruai awla Moriah ram ah fehpi aw. Cutawk ramih a ummi ka lo hmuh dingmi tlang parah Isaak cu mei-ur thawinakah pe aw,” ti ah a ti."},"3":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitte-ah Abraham cu a tho ih a laak tokham a dam ih a fapa Isaak le a hnenum pahnih thawn an feh. Thawinak hrangih hman dingah zanthing a khawm ih Pathian ih a sim ciami ramah a feh."},"4":{"text":"A ni thumnak ni ah acuih hmun cu hlavang in a hei hmu."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah a hnenum pawl hnenah, “Laak thawn hitawk ah rak um uh. Kei le ka fapa cu Pathian kan va bia ding ih nan hnenah kan ra kirsal ding,” ti ah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Abraham in thawinak hrangih zanthing cu a fapa a phurhter; amah in meiṭek le kawlnam a keng ih an pafa an feh."},"7":{"text":"A rei hlanah Isaak in, “Ka pa,” ti ah a ko. A pa in, “Ziang a si ka fa?” ti ah a ti. Isaak in, “Meiṭek le zanthing hmuah kan keng ih thawinak hrangih tuu faate khui-ah so?” ti ah a sut."},"8":{"text":"Cule Abraham in, “Amah Pathian in in pe leh ko ding, ka fa,” ti ah a ti. Cutiin an pafa an feh vivo."},"9":{"text":"Cule Pathian ih a sim ciami hmun an thlen tikah, Abraham in biakṭheng a don ih a parah zanthing a ret. Cun a fapa Isaak cu a ṭem ih biakṭheng par zanthing tlunah cun a hlum."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah a fapa that dingin a kawlnam cu a vun zuuk."},"11":{"text":"Cu laifangah Bawipa ih vancungmi in vancung ihsin, “Abraham, Abraham!” ti ah a ko. Abraham in, “ Bawipa , hinah ka um!” ti ah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah vancungmi in, “Na fapa that hlah; zianghman ti-aw hlah. Na fapa neihsun ka hrangih na sian ruangah Pathian na ṭihzah zet a si ti kha ka thei zo,” ti ah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule Abraham in a kiangkap a hei zoh ih tuucang pakhat hri-hnok lakah a ki ih awk awmi a hmu. A va lak ih a fapa ai-ah mei-ur thawinakah a hmang."},"14":{"text":"Cuih hmun cu Abraham in, “Yahweh Jireh,” ti ah hmin a sak. Curuangah tuih san tiangin, “ Bawipa ih tlang ah Bawipa in a pek,” ti ah mi in an run tita."},"15":{"text":"Cun Bawipa ih vancungmi in Abraham cu vancung ihsin a ko sal ih,"},"16":{"text":"“ Bawipa in hiti in a ti: Ka hmin in thu ka lo kam - hi thil na tuah ih na fapa neihsun ka hrangih na sian ruangah tlamtling zetin ka lo thlawsuah ding."},"17":{"text":"Na tesinfa pawl cu ka karhzaiter ding ih vanih arsi zat in le tifinriat vunnel zat in an tam ding a si. Na tesinfa pawl in an ral pawl cu an neh thluh ding."},"18":{"text":"Cun annih ka thlawsuah bangtuk in leilung tlunih miphun kip in thlawsuah in dil ding. Hi thil hmuahhmuah cu keimah ih thu na ngai ruangah a si,” ti ah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Abraham cu a hnenum pawl hnenah a kir ih an zatein an umnak Beersheba ah an tlung sal."},"20":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Abraham in a unau pa Nahor le Milkah in fapa an neih kha a thei.","title":"Nahor Ih Tesinfa Pawl"},"21":{"text":"Upa bik cu Uz a si ih a naupa cu Buz a si; Aram ih pa Kemuel le"},"22":{"text":"Khesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaf le Bethuel tla an si."},"23":{"text":"(Bethuel cu Rebekah ih pa a si.) Nahor ih nupi Milkah in hi fapa pariat hi a hrinmi an si."},"24":{"text":"Cule Nahor ih nusun Reumah in Tebah, Gaham, Tahash le Maakah a hring."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sarah cu kum za le kulhluan sarih a nung ih,","title":"Sarah Hrangah Thlanhmun A Lei"},"2":{"text":"Kanaan ram Hebron (a si lole Kiriath-arba timi) khua ah a thi. Abraham cu a ninghang in Sarah thih cu a ul ih a ṭah."},"3":{"text":"Cule a nupi ruak kiang ihsin a tho ih Hit mi pawl hnenah,"},"4":{"text":"“Kei hi a laangte ih um mikhual le mivai ka si. Ka nupi phumnak dingah nan ram hi malte talin in zorh hram uh,” ti ah a dil."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah annih in,"},"6":{"text":"“Bawipa, kan simmi hi in ngai hram aw; kanmah lakah nang cu a lian zetmi lal na si. Cuhrangah kan neihmi thlaan hmuahhmuah lakih a ṭha bikmi ah na nupi cu phum ko aw. Na nupi phumnak ahcun zohman in kan thlaanhmun kan ui lo ding,” ti ah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Abraham cu a tho ih an hmaiah a kun ih,"},"8":{"text":"“Hi ramih ka nupi phum ding nan lung a kim ahcun Hit mi pa Zohar ih fapa Efron in,"},"9":{"text":"Makpelah lungpuk cu i zorh dingah i dilsak hram uh. A lungpuk cu a loram netnak ah a si.
