Thlanhmun ka neih thei venak dingah nan zate hmaiah hin a duhzat i ngen in i zorh hram seh,” ti ah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutiih Hit mi pawl an tonkhawm awknak khuasuah ahcun Efron khal a tel ve hrangah senpi theih-ah Efron in,"},"11":{"text":"“Bawipa, cuticun si hlah seh, i ngai hrih hram aw; ka ram zate in a lakin ka lo ṭhen ih a sungih ummi lungpuk khal nei cih aw. Ka miphunpi theihhngan ah ka loram cu ka lo ṭhen; na nupi na phumnak dingah,” ti ah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Sihmansehla Abraham cu misenpi hmaiah a lu a kun ih,"},"13":{"text":"senpiih theih dingin Efron hnenah, “Na thinlung ngaingai a si ahcun i ngai hnik aw: na ram zatein ka lo lei pei. A man i la hram aw. Cun ka nupi ka phum ding a si,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Efron in Abraham cu,"},"15":{"text":"“Bawipa, ka loram man cu ngun tangka zali lawng a si ih, nang le kei ih lakah ziangtlakso a si lem! Cunah na nupi cu phum ko aw,” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Abraham cu a lung a kim ih Hit mi pawl theih hnganah Efron ih ngun tangka zali a ngenmi cu sumtuahtu pawl ih an hmantlangmi cuai in a khai ih a pek."},"17":{"text":"Cutiin Mamre ihsin nisuahnak lam Efron ih Makpelah leiram cu Abraham ih ramah a cangta. A sungih lo le lungpuk le thingkung hmuahhmuah khal a ta an si thluh."},"18":{"text":"Cuih an tonkhawm awknak ih a telmi Hit mi hmuahhmuah in Abraham ih ram a si cu an theihpi thluh a si."},"19":{"text":"Cutiin Kanaan ram acuih lungpuk ah Abraham in a nupi Sarah cu a phum."},"20":{"text":"Cuhrangah Hit mi pawl ih ram a rak si dahmi cuih ram le a sungih a ummi lungpuk pawl cu Abraham ih ramah a rung cang ih thlaanmual ah a tuah."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham cu a kum a upa ih a tarzet thlang; Pathian in a tuahmi le a ṭuanmi hmuahhmuah ah a thluasuah.","title":"Isaak Hrangah Nupi An Hawl"},"2":{"text":"Cule Abraham in a thil neihmi hmuahhmuah a kilkhawitu, a hnenum upa bik pa ih hnenah, “Na kut ka cawn karlakah re hram-awla thu i kam aw."},"3":{"text":"Van le lei ih Pathian Bawipa ih hmai le ka hnenah, ka fapa Isaak ih nupi dingah ka umnak Kanaan ramih nunau ka la hrimhrim lo pei, ti ah siatserh in thu i tiam aw."},"4":{"text":"A hlanih ka rak umnak ka khuaram ah na feh pei ih ka sungkhat pawl sung ihsin ka fapa ih hrangah nupi na va hawl pei,” ti ah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah a hnenum pa in, “Asile cuih nunau nu in i thlun duh loin a innih um duh sawnsehla ziangtinso a si ding? Na fapa sawn na rak umnak na khuaram ahcun ka kirpi sal ding maw?” ti ah a sut."},"6":{"text":"Cule Abraham in, “Ka fapa cu kirpi hrimhrim lo dingin ruat cia aw;"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa vanih Pathian in ka pa ih inn le ka suahkehnak ram ihsin i suahter ih atu hi ram hi, ‘Na tesinfa hnenah ka pe ding,’ ti ah siatserh in i tiamkam ciami a si. Amah Pathian in a vancungmi na hmaiah a fehter ding ih ka fapa hrangih nupi cu na ngah thei ko ding."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nunau in a lo thlun duh lo ngaingai a si ahcun ka hnenih na kammi thutiam-awhnak ihsin na luat ding. Ziang a si khalle, ka fapa cu cutawk ram ahcun na kirpi hrimhrim lo pei,” ti ah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cuticun a hnenum pa cun a bawipa Abraham ih cawn karlakah a kut a ret ih a simmi pawl tuah tengteng dingah siatserh in thu a tiam aw."},"10":{"text":"Cun a hnenum pa cun a bawipa ih kalauk rual sungin pahra a lak ih a tim a tuah ih laksawng dingah thilmankhung tampi a keng. Cule Mesopotamia ram Nahor umnak khua ah a feh."},"11":{"text":"Cuih khua a va thlen tikah hnarpawn ih tikhur kiangah a kalauk pawl cu a bawhter. Zanlam a si zo hrangah khuasungih nunau pawl cu tidai khai dingin an ra."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Abraham ih hnenum pa cu thla a cam ih, “Maw Bawipa , ka bawipa Abraham ih Pathian, ka bawipa hnenih na thukammi kimter in tuihsun tikcu caanah i hlawhtlingter hram aw."},"13":{"text":"Hi ka dinnak tikhur ahhin tidai khai dingah khuasung in fala pawl an ra ding."},"14":{"text":"Fala pakhat hnenah, ‘Zaangfahte in na tithawl run ṭhum awla tidai ka in ding,’ ti ah ka ti pei ih anih in, ‘In aw, na kalauk pawl khal ti ka tul hai pei,’ ti ah a ti asile cuih fala cu na salpa Isaak hrangih na hrilmi fala si hram seh. Cutiih a can ngaingai le ka bawipa hnenih na thukam na kimter a si, ti ah ka thei ding,” ti ah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cule a thlacam hman a ṭheh hlanah Rebekah an timi fala cu a liang parah tithawl pu tahratin a ra. Rebekah cu Bethuel ih fanu a si. Bethuel cu Milkah ih fapa a si ih Milkah cu Abraham ih unaupa Nahor ih nupi a si."},"16":{"text":"Rebekah cu fala himte a si ih a mawizet fawn. Tikhur ahcun a vungṭum ih a tithawl khat ko ti a than hnuah a hung sal."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Abraham ih hnenum pa cu a va tlan ih a hnenah,” Zaangfahte in na tithawl sungih tidai i in ter hram aw,” ti ah a dil."},"18":{"text":"Rebekah cun, “Bawipa in aw,” ti ah a ti ih a tithawl cu zamrangte in a liang par ihsin a ṭhum ih tithawl khal cu fektein a kaihsak ih a inter."},"19":{"text":"Tidai a inter hnuah Rebekah in, “Na kalauk pawl hrang khalah tidai ka khai pei ih an duhzat in in hai seh,” ti ah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Zamrangte in ṭilva tikuang sungah a tidai cu a thlet ta ih kalauk pawl an khawh hlan lo tidai cu a khaisak rero."},"21":{"text":"Abraham ih milai pa cun Bawipa in i hlawhtlinter pei maw, ti ah daitein a zoh ringring."},"22":{"text":"Cun kalauk pawl cu Rebekah in ti a pek ṭheh hnuah Abraham ih hnenum pa cun a man a khung zetmi sui hnarthlaih a vun suah ih a hnar ah a thlaih; cun sui faute tumzet pahnih a lak ih a kutah a hruk."},"23":{"text":"Cule, “Zo fanu so na si? Na pa ih inn ah kan hrangah riahnak khaan a um pei maw?” ti ah a sut."},"24":{"text":"Rebekah in, “Nahor le Milkah ih fapa Bethuel ih fanu ka si."},"25":{"text":"Na ṭilva hrangah hrampi le rawl tampi kan nei ih nan riahnak dingah khaan khal a um,” ti ah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Abraham ih hnenum pa cun lukuun in, Bawipa Pathian cu a biak ih,"},"27":{"text":"“Ka Bawipa Abraham ih Pathian, Bawipa cu thangṭhat in um seh. Amah in ka bawipa Abraham hnenih a thukamnak le rintlak a sinak cu a kimter zo. Ka bawipa Abraham ih unau inn ah Pathian in i thlengter a si,” ti ah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Falanu cu a nu hnenah a tlan ih cuih thuhla hmuahhmuah cu a sim."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah Rebekah ih ṭapa Laban in cuih thuhla cu a thei ih,"},"30":{"text":"Rebekah ih hnarthlaih le a ngeel parih faute tla a hmuh tikah tikhur lamah a va tlan ih Abraham ih hnenum pa cu tikhur kiangah a kalauk pawl thawn an rak din kha a va hmu."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah Laban in, “Kan inn ah ra aw, Bawipa ih thlawsuahmi na si. Ziangah so khawlengah na din? Kan inn cu nan riahnak dingah ka simsial zo ih na kalauk pawl hrang khalah hmun a um a si,” ti ah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cuticun Laban in an inn ah a luhpi hai ih kalauk parih thil pawl cu a ṭhum thluh ih hrampi le rawl tla a pek. Cutiin Abraham ih hnenum le a minung pawl ke kholhnak dingah tidai a rak keng."},"33":{"text":"Cun zanriah ei an tuah tikah Abraham ih hnenum pa in, “Ka thusim duhmi ka sim hlan cu rawl ka ei hrih lo ding,” ti ah a ti. Cule Laban in, “Na sim duhmi cu sim aw,” ti ah a ti."},"34":{"text":"A thu cu a vun thok ih, “Kei cu Abraham ih hnenum ka si."},"35":{"text":"Pathian in ka bawipa cu tlamtling zetin bawngmal a sawm ih milianzet ah a tuah. Bawipa in tuu le me le caw a rualrual in a pek ih sui le ngun, salnu le salpa, kalauk le laak tampi tla a pek."},"36":{"text":"Cule ka bawipa ih nupi Sarah in a tar hnuah fapa a hring. Ka bawipa in a neihmi thil hmuahhmuah cu a fapa a pek thluh."},"37":{"text":"Ka bawipa in, ‘Ka fapa Isaak ih nupi dingah atu ka umnak Kanaan ramih fala pawl sung ihsin na hril lo pei."},"38":{"text":"Ka pa ih miphun le ka laicin pawl hnenah ka fapa hrangah nupi na va hawl lo ahcun na parah siatserhnak thleng seh,’ ti ah a hmai rori ah thutiamnak i tuahter."},"39":{"text":"Cule ka bawipa ih hnenah, ‘Cuih nunau nu in i thlun duh lo sehla ziangtinso a si ding?’ tiih ka suh tikah,"},"40":{"text":"ka bawipa in, ‘A thu ka thlun ringringmi Pathian in a vancungmi na hnenah a thlah ding ih a lo hlawhtlinter ding. Ka pa ih sungkhat le ka laicin sung ihsin ka fapa nupi cu na ṭhi tengteng ding."},"41":{"text":"Cutiih na tuah asile ka siatserhnak sungin na luat ding; cun ka laicin hnenah na feh ih an lo el a si ahcun ka siatserhnak sungin na luat ding,’ ti ah i ti."},"42":{"text":"“Tuihsun tikhur kiangih ka ra thlen tikah ka thlacammi cu, ‘ Bawipa , ka bawipa Abraham ih Pathian, ka thil tuahmi parah hlawhtlinnak i pe hram aw."},"43":{"text":"Zohhnik, tikhur kiangih ka din laiah tidai khai dingih falanu a rat tikah a hnenah, na tithawl sungih tidai i pe hram aw ti ah ka ti pei ih,"},"44":{"text":"falanu in, in aw, na kalauk tla tidai ka pe hai ding, a ti a si ahcun cuih fala cu ka bawipa fapa ih nupi dingah Bawipa in a hrilmi siseh,’ ti ah ka ti."},"45":{"text":"Cutiin daitein thla ka cam ih ka thlacam hman ka ṭheh hlanah Rebekah in a liangah tithawl pu in a ra ih tikhur ah tidai a vung khai. Cule a hnenah, ‘Zaangfahte in tidai i pe aw,’ ti ah ka ti."},"46":{"text":"Zamrangte in a liangih a tithawl cu a ṭhum ih, ‘In aw; na kalauk pawl khal ti ka pe hai ding,’ ti ah i ti. Cuticun a tidai cu ka in ih ka kalauk pawl khal tidai a pek."},"47":{"text":"‘Na pa zoso a si?’ tiih ka suh tikah, ‘Nahor le Milkah ih fapa Bethuel ih fanu ka si,’ ti ah i ti. Cutikah a hnar ah hnarthlaih ka thlaih, a ngeel ah faute ka hruk."},"48":{"text":"Cun ka lu ka kun ih ka bawipa Abraham ih Pathian, ka lam tluangzet ih i hruaitu Bawipa cu ka biak ih ka thangṭhat a si. Pathian in ka bawipa ih unau hnenah i thlenpi; cule ka bawipa fapa ih nupi hrangah a fanu ka tong zo."},"49":{"text":"Cutiin a si ih ka bawipa ih hrangah thuṭha nan ruat thei ih rem nan ti a si ahcun atu-ah i hliah hram uh. Kan thuhla a rem thiam lo nan ti a si khalle i sim uhla hmun dang ah feh ka tum pei,” ti ah a ti."},"50":{"text":"Cutikah Laban le Bethuel in a hnenah, “Hi thu cu Bawipa ih hnen ihsin a rami a si hrangah kannih relcat ding a si lo."},"51":{"text":"Cuhrangah hinah Rebekah a um; hruai awla fehpi ko aw. Bawipa amah ih a sim zo vekin na bawipa fapa ih nupi-ah si ko seh,” ti ah an ti."},"52":{"text":"Cuih thu a theih tikah Abraham ih hnenum pa cu Bawipa Pathian hmaiah leilung dai in a lu a kun ih lungawi thu a sim."},"53":{"text":"Cule sui le ngun hlawnthil le thilthuam tla a suah ih Rebekah cu a pek; a ṭapa le a nu khal thil mankhung zetzet a ṭhen hai."},"54":{"text":"Cuticun Abraham hnenum le a milai pawl cu rawl ei le in in cuih zan cu an riak. A thaizing an thawh tikah, “Ka bawipa ih hnenah i kirter hram uh,” ti ah a ti."},"55":{"text":"Asinain a nu le a ṭapa in, “Kan fala cu kan hnenah ni malte, nihra tluk talin um hrih seh; cuih hnuah a feh leh ding,” ti ah an ti."},"56":{"text":"Anih in, “In kai hram hlah uh; Bawipa in ka lamzin a tluanter zo. Curuangah ka bawipa ih hnenah i kirter ko uh,” ti ah a dil hai."},"57":{"text":"Cule annih in, “Kan falanu kan ko pei ih amah kan sut pei, ziangtin a ruat pei maw,” an ti."},"58":{"text":"Rebekah cu an ko ih, “Hi pa thawn feh dingah na lung a kim maw?” ti ah an sut. Rebekah in, “Ka lung a kim,” ti ah a ti."},"59":{"text":"Curuangah an farnu Rebekah cu amah a rak umtu nunau pakhat thawn Abraham ih hnenum pa le a milai pawl hnenah an fehter."},"60":{"text":"Cun Rebekah cu hiti in thlaza an camsak: “Kan farnu, mi thawng tampi ih nu ah cang hram aw, Na tefa pawl in an raal ih khawpi pawl neh thluh hram hai seh,” ti ah an ti."},"61":{"text":"Cule Rebekah le a hnenum nunau pawl cu kalauk parah an to ih Abraham ih hnenum pa cu an thlun. Hnenum pa in a hruai hai ih an fehta."},"62":{"text":"Culai ah Isaak cu, “Beer-lahai-roi” timi ihsin a ra thawn ih Negev ramah a um."},"63":{"text":"Nikhat siimlam ah Isaak cu lam a leng ih kalauk pawl an ra rero kha a hmu."},"64":{"text":"Cule Rebekah khalin Isaak cu a hmu ih a kalauk parin a ṭum lohli."},"65":{"text":"Abraham ih hnenum pa hnenah, “Hramlakih kanmah tong dingah a ra rero mi pa khi zoso a si?” ti ah a sut. Hnenum pa in, “Ka bawipa a si,” ti ah a ti. Cutikah Rebekah in a hmaikhuhnak puanpaate cu a lak ih a hmai a khuh aw."},"66":{"text":"Cule hnenum pa in a tawlrelmi thu le hla hmuahhmuah cu Isaak hnenah a sim thluh."},"67":{"text":"Cule Isaak in Rebekah cu a nu Sarah rak umnak puanthlam ah a hruai ih a nupi ah a cang. Isaak in Rebekah cu a duhdawt ih a nu Sarah thih hnuah amah hnemtu ah a cang."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham in nupi dang a ṭhi ih a hmin cu Keturah a si.","title":"Abraham Ih Tesinfa Dang (1 San. 1.32-33)"},"2":{"text":"Keturah thawn an hrinmi fapa pawl cu Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak le Shuah an si."},"3":{"text":"Cun Jokshan ih fapa pawl cu Sheba le Dedan an si ih Dedan ih hrinmi fapa pawl cu Asshurim, Letushim le Leummim an si."},"4":{"text":"Midian ih fapa pawl cu Efah, Efer, Hanok, Abida le Eldaah an si. An zatein Keturah ih tefa pawl an si."},"5":{"text":"Abraham in a neihmi hmuahhmuah cu Isaak a rohta."},"6":{"text":"Asinain a thih hlanah a nupi dangih fapa pawl hnenah laksawng a zem ve hai ih Isaak thawn umtlang lo dingin hmundang nisuahnak ramah a fehter hai."},"7":{"text":"Abraham cu kum za le sawmsarih le kum nga tiang a nung;","title":"Abraham Thihnak Le Vuinak"},"8":{"text":"Tarkuun khuuksuang in a nun hnuah a thi ih a miphunpi hnenah finkhawm in a um."},"9":{"text":"Hit mi Zohar ih fapa Efron hnen ihsin ram a leimi, Mamre ih nisuahnak lam Makpelah lungpuk ah a fapa Isaak le Ishmael in an phum."},"10":{"text":"Hit miphun hnen ihsin amah Abraham ih rak lei ciami ram a si. A nupi Sarah thawn an pahnih in cutawkah phum an si."},"11":{"text":"Abraham thih hnuah a fapa Isaak cu Pathian in a thluasuah ih, “Beer-lahai-roi” timi tikhur kiangah a um."},"12":{"text":"Sarah ih salnu, Izipt mi Hagar thawn an hrinmi Abraham ih fapa Ishmael ih tesinfa pawl cu a hnuailam bangtuk an si.","title":"Ismael Ih Tesinfa Pawl (1 San. 1.28-31)"},"13":{"text":"Ishmael ih fapa pawl hmin cu a sangsangin, upa bikah Nebaioth, cun Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,"},"14":{"text":"Mishma, Dumah, Massa,"},"15":{"text":"Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Nafish le Kedemah an si."},"16":{"text":"Himi pawl hi Ishmael ih fapa pawl an si ih an khua le an umnak ram hmin cu anmah ih hmin ciar suang ih sakmi an si. Anmah tla cu miphun hnam hleihnih ih cithlahtu an si."},"17":{"text":"Ishmael cu kum za le sawmthum le kum sarih a nung. A thi ih a miphunpi hnenah finkhawm in a um."},"18":{"text":"Ishmael ih tesinfa pawl cu Izipt ram in nisuahnak, Assiria ram fehnak lam, Havilah le Shur karlak ramah an um. Abraham tesinfa hnenih um loin a dangte in an um."},"19":{"text":"Abraham fapa Isaak ih thuanthu cu hiti in a si.","title":"Esau Le Jakob Suahnak Thu"},"20":{"text":"Mesopotamia ram Aram mi Bethuel ih fanu, Laban ih farnu, Rebekah a ṭhit tikah Isaak cu kum sawmli a si."},"21":{"text":"Rebekah in fa a neih lo ruangah Isaak in Bawipa ih hnenah thla a camsak. Bawipa in a thlacam cu a thei ih Rebekah cu fa a vun."},"22":{"text":"A pum sungah faphir an seem ih an eng-awk rero kha a theih tikah a don a har ih, “Hiti a si ahcun ziangso ka nun man a um?” ti ah a ti. Cule Bawipa hnenah thla a cam ih,"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Na pum sungah miphun pahnih an um. A ral-aw phun hrimhrim in an suak ding; Pakhat cu a dang pa hnakin a cak deuh ding ih, A upa sawn in a naupa a rian ding,” ti ah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Rebekah cu a nithla a kim tikah faphir a hring."},"25":{"text":"A suak hmaisa pa cu misen a si ih a pumpuluk in hmul a nei. Curuangah Esau ti ah a hmin an sak."},"26":{"text":"A nauta pa a rung suah tikah a upa Esau ih kedil kaihnget tahratin a suak. Curuangah a hminah Jakob an sak. Fapa a neih tikah Isaak cu kum sawmruk a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun an unau an ṭhang vivo ih Esau cu sakapzet a si ih hramlakih ramtawi duh zettu-ah a cang. Jakob cu midai a si ih inn lawnglawng ah a um.","title":"Esau In A Fatir Covo A Zuar"},"28":{"text":"A sakahmi a ei ṭheu ruangah Isaak in Esau cu a duh deuh; asinain a nu Rebekah cun Jakob a duh sawn."},"29":{"text":"Nikhat cu Jakob in pehang a suan laifangah a ramtawihnak in Esau cu a ra tlung."},"30":{"text":"A ril a rawn tuk ruangah a naupa Jakob hnenah, “Ka ril a rawng tuk lawmmam, na tihang sente kha kaa khatte talin i pe aw,” ti ah a dil. (Curuangah Edom tiih an kawhnak a si.)"},"31":{"text":"Asinain Jakob in, “Na fatir covo i pe awla ka lo pe ding,” ti ah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cutikah Esau in, “Ka lo pe ding; rilrawng in ka thi zik thlang ih ka covo cu ka hrangah ziangso ṭhathnemnak a neih?” ti ah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cule Jakob in, “Ka covo ka lo pe tengteng ding, tiin thu i kam hmaisa aw,” ti ah a ti. Cutiin Esau cun thu a kam ih fatir a sinak covo cu Jakob hnenah a zuar."},"34":{"text":"Cule Jakob in sang le pehang a suanmi cu a pek. Esau in a in a ei hnuah a tho ih a feh. Fatir a sinak covo cu zianghman ah a siar lo."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham sanih paam voikhat a rak tlun hlei ah hi ram ah paam a tlung sal. Curuangah Gerar ih a ummi Filistin siangpahrang Abimelek hnenah Isaak cu a feh.","title":"Gerar Le Beer-sheba Ah Isaak A Um"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa cu Isaak hnenah a lang ih a hnenah, “Izipt ramah cun na feh lo pei; na um ding ka lo tinak ram ah um aw."},"3":{"text":"Hitawk ah tikcu tawite sung um awla, na hnenah ka um ding ih ka lo thlawsuah ding; ziangahtile nangmah le na tesinfa pawl hnenah hi ram hmuahhmuah cu ka lo pe ding a si. Na pa Abraham hnenih ka rak tuahmi thukam cu ka kimter ding."},"4":{"text":"Van ih arsi zat in tesinfa ka lo pe ding ih an hnenah hi ram hmuahhmuah cu ka pe ding. Na tesinfa pawl ka thlawsuah bangin leilung tlunih miphun hmuahhmuah in thlawsuah in dil ding."},"5":{"text":"Abraham in ka thukham a thlun ih ka thu a ngai ruangah nangmah cu ka lo thlawsuah ding,” ti ah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutiin Isaak cu Gerar ah a um."},"7":{"text":"Cuih khuami pawl in a nupi thu an suh tikah, “Ka nupi a si,” ti ngam loin, “Ka farnu a si,” a ti. Ziangah a ngam lo tile Rebekah cu a mawi ngaingai ih Rebekah co duh ah in that pang ding ti a phan ruangah a si."},"8":{"text":"Cun Isaak cu tikcu rei nawn hi ramih a um hnuah voikhat cu Filistin siangpahrang Abimelek cu a tukvirh in khua a cuan ih Isaak in Rebekah a pom lai kha a hmu."},"9":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Abimelek in Isaak cu a ko ih, “Rebekah hi na nupi a si, a si ko lo maw? Ziangah so ka farnu a si, na ti?” ti ah a sut. Cutikah Isaak in, “Ka nupi a si, ka ti ahcun in that ding, ti ka ruah ruangah a si,” ti ah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule Abimelek in, “Ziangah so kan parah hiti in thil na tuah? Ka milai pakhatkhat na nupi parah a sual ih mawhphurh kan si le nangmah ih ruangah a si ding,” ti ah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Abimelek in, “Hi te nupa, Isaak a si lole Rebekah hi zohman in nan tisia lo pei; a tisiatu nan um ahcun thah nan tong ding,” ti ah a milai pawl hnenah thu a pek."},"12":{"text":"Cun Isaak in cutawk ramah thlaici a tuh ih acuih kum cu a tuhmi ih let zakhat a khawm; ziangahtile Pathian in a thluasuah ruangah a si."},"13":{"text":"A ṭhangso vivo ih milianzet ah a cang."},"14":{"text":"Cutiin caw le tuu a ruunruun in a nei ih sal khal tampi a neih hrangah Filistin mi pawl in an iksiik zet."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah a pa Abraham nun laiih a hnenum pawl ih laih mi tikhur hmuahhmuah cu leilung an silhsak thluh."},"16":{"text":"Cule Abimelek in Isaak hnenah, “Kannih hnakin na cah tuk zo ruangah hmun dangah feh aw,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Isaak cu a suak ih Gerar phairawn ah buk a sak ih a um."},"18":{"text":"Cutawkah tikhur pawl, a pa Abraham sanih laihmi, a thih hnu ih Filistin pawl in an silhmi pawl cu a lai sal thluh ih a pa ih hmin sakmi vekin Isaak in hmin a pek sal thluh a si."},"19":{"text":"Cun voikhatah Isaak ih hnenum pawl in acuih phairawn ah tikhur an lai ih tipuut ṭhazet pakhat an tong."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Gerar khua ih tuukhal pawl in, “Hi tidai cu kanmah ih ta a si,” ti ah Isaak ih tuukhal pawl hnenah an ti ih an to-aw. Cutiih an tawh-awk ruangah Isaak in acuih tikhur cu, “Esek,” ti ah hmin a sak."},"21":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Isaak ih hnenum pawl in tikhur dang an lai ih el awknak a um thotho ruangah Isaak in acuih tikhur cu, “Sitnah,” ti ah a ko."},"22":{"text":"Cun Isaak cu acuih hmun in a ceer ih tikhur dang a lai lala. El awknak a um nawn lo ruangah acuih tikhur cu, “Rehoboth,” ti ah a ko. Cule Isaak in, “Atu cu Bawipa in hi ramah luatnak i pe zo ih kan ṭhangso thlang ding,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Isaak cu Beer-sheba ah a hung ceer ih,"},"24":{"text":"acuih zanah Bawipa cu a hnenah a lang ih, “Keimah cu na pa Abraham ih Pathian ka si. Zianghman ṭih hlah, na hnenah ka um. Ka salpa Abraham ih vaangah ka lo thlawsuah ding ih tefa tampi ka lo pe ding,” ti ah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cutawkah Isaak in biakṭheng a don ih Bawipa a biak. Cun umhmun a khuar ih a hnenum pawl in tikhur an lai."},"26":{"text":"Cule Abimelek cu Gerar ihsin a ralkap uktu Fikol le ruahnak petu Ahuzzath thawn Isaak tong dingin an ra.","title":"Isaak Le Abimelek Ih Thutiam Awknak"},"27":{"text":"Cutikah Isaak in, “Zianghrangah ka hnenah nan ra? In ngaih lo ruangah nan khua le nan ram in in dawi a si lo maw?” ti ah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cule annih in, “Pathian cu na hnenah a um hrimhrim a si, ti ah atu cun kan thei zo ih kan karlakah siatcam in thutiam awknak um sehla tiin kan ruat. Na parih siatsuahnak kan thlenter lo bangtuk in,"},"29":{"text":"nang khal in kan parah siatsuahnak na thlenter lonak dingah thu in kam-aw, ti kan duh. Na hnenih zaangfahnak kan rak neih ruangah daitein kan lo fehter. Atu-ah cun Bawipa ih thlawsuah tampi na dong a si,” ti ah an ti."},"30":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Isaak in rawl thawzetin a suang ih acuih zan cu puar zetin an ei."},"31":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitte in siatcam thutiam awknak an tuah ih Isaak thawn rualpi ṭhazet cang in an ṭhen-aw."},"32":{"text":"Cuih ni-ah Isaak ih hnenum pawl an ra ih tikhur an laihnak thu a hnenah an ra sim. “Tidai kan tong zo,” ti ah an ti."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah cuih tikhur cu Shibah ti ah a ko. Atu tiangin acuih khawpi cu Beer-sheba ti ah an run kota."},"34":{"text":"Esau cu kum sawmli a ti tikah Hit mi Beeri ih fanu Judith a ṭhit. Cuih hnuah Hit mi thotho Elon ih fanu Basemath a ṭhi lala.","title":"Esau Ih Ramdang Nupi Pawl"},"35":{"text":"Cuticun Isaak le Rebekah thinlung hartertu-ah an cang."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Isaak cu a tarzet zo ih a mit khal a mal thlang. Curuangah a fapa upa bik Esau cu a ko ih, “Ka fapa,” ti ah a ti. Esau in, “Hinah ka um,” ti ah a ti.","title":"Isaak in Jakob Thlawsuah A Pek"},"2":{"text":"Isaak in, “Ka tar zo ih ka thi cing men ding."},"3":{"text":"Na hriamnam, na li le thal la awla, ka hrangah hramlakah sa va hawl aw."},"4":{"text":"Cuih sa cu ka duhzawng in thawte in suang awla i rak pe aw. Ka ei pei ih ka thih hlanah ka thlawsuah ka lo peta ding,” ti ah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutiih Isaak in a fapa Esau hnenih a ṭong cu Rebekah in a rak ngai ringring. Cun Esau in a pa hrangah hramlakih sa a hawl sungah,"},"6":{"text":"Rebekah in Jakob hnenah, “Na pa in Esau hnenah,"},"7":{"text":"‘Sa i sum awla rawl thawte in i son aw. Ka ei pei ih ka thih hlanah Bawipa ih hmaiah thlawsuah ka lo peta ding,’ ti ah tubaite ah a ti ka thei."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah ka fapa, ka thu ngai awla ka lo simmi tuah aw."},"9":{"text":"Kan ṭilva ruun lakah va feh awla, me note pahnih va hruai awla ka hnenah rak keng aw. Ka suang pei ih na pa ih duhzawng in ka tuah pei."},"10":{"text":"Cuticun na pa hnenah a ei dingah na hei keng pei; a thih hlanah a thlawsuah a lo pe ding,” ti ah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Asinain Jakob in a nu hnenah, “Ka nu, ka u Esau cu hmul tampi a nei ih kei cu taksa naalmi ka si, ti na thei ko."},"12":{"text":"Ka pa in i tham men ding sikhawh, ka bum ti i thei thotho lo ding maw? Cuticun thlawsuah si sawn loin camsiatnak riangri ka parah ka thlenter pang ding,” ti ah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah a nu in, “Ka fapa, camsiatnak a thleng asile keimah ih parah siseh; ka lo simmi cu tuah sawn aw; va fehzaang awla me note cu ka hrangah va la aw,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Jakob cu a va feh ih a nu hnenah me note cu a rak keng; cule a nu in a pa ih duhzawng in rawl cu a suang."},"15":{"text":"Cun Esau ih hnipuan ṭha bik, a nu ih ret sakmi cu Rebekah in a lak ih Jakob a hrukter."},"16":{"text":"A nu in Jakob ih baan tluan le hmul um lonak a hngawng cu mephaw in a tuam thluh."},"17":{"text":"Cun rawl a thawmi le sang a tuahmi cu a nu in Jakob a hei kenter."},"18":{"text":"Cutiin Jakob cu a pa hnenah a feh ih, “Ka pa,” ti ah a va ti. A pa in, “Awi, ka fa, zo deuh so na si?” ti ah a rak ti."},"19":{"text":"Jakob in, “Na fa upa Esau ka si, na sim vekin ka tuah zo. Zaangfahte in ra to awla ka lo summi sa hi ra ei in thlawsuah i pe aw,” ti ah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Isaak in, “Cuti zamrangin ziangtinso na va ngah, ka fapa,” a ti. Cutikah Jakob in, “ Bawipa na Pathian in i bawm ih ka ngah a si,” ti ah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cule Isaak in Jakob hnenah, “Khuihnik, ka lo tham theinak dingah i rak naih deuh aw. Ka fapa Esau na si ngaingai maw, si lo so?” ti ah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Jakob in a pa cu a hei naih tikah a pa in a rak tham ih, “Na aw cu Jakob ih aw a bang naón na baan cu Esau ih baan a bang fawn,” ti ah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Isaak in Jakob cu a rak theih thiam lo, ziangahtile Esau ih baan bangin hmul a nei thluh ve. Thlawsuah pek a hun tum tikah a pa cun,"},"24":{"text":"“Ka fapa Esau na si ngaingai maw?” ti ah a sut sal. Jakob in “Ka si ko,” ti ah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Isaak in, “Na suanmi sa cu i pe aw; ka eita pei ih thlawsuah ka lo pe ding,” ti ah a ti. Jakob in sa cu a pek ih in dingah sabitti khal a pek."},"26":{"text":"Cun a pa in, “Ka fa, i rak naih awla i hnam aw,” ti ah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cutiin Jakob cun a pa cu a hei naih ih a hnam tikah a pa in a hnipuan rim a hnim ih cuih hnuah thlawsuah a pek. “Hi ka fapa ih rim cu, Bawipa ih a thlawsuahmi hramlak rim a bang;"},"28":{"text":"Pathian in vanih daifiim lo thlak in, Na leiram cu leiṭha si hram seh; Fang le sabitti tampi lo pe seh."},"29":{"text":"Miphun tampi in na hna ṭuan hai sehla, Mi tampi na hmaiah kun hai seh. Na sungkhat pawl ih tlunah lal na si pei ih, Na unau ih tesinfa pawl cu na hmaiah kun hai seh. A lo camsiattu cu camsiat si ve hai sehla, A lo thluasuahtu cu thlawsuah si ve hai seh,” ti ah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cutiih a pa Isaak in thlawsuah a pek ṭheh hnuah Jakob cu a suak. Cu ṭheh vete in a ramtawihnak in Esau cu a ra tlung.","title":"Esau In Isaak Ih Thlawsuah A Dil"},"31":{"text":"Anih khal in rawl thawthaw a suang ih a pa ih hnenah a hei keng. “Ka pa, zaangfahte in to awla, na fapa ih ka rak kenmi sa cu ei in thlawsuah i pe hram aw,” ti ah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Isaak cun, “Zoso na si?” ti ah a sut. Anih in, “Na fa upa Esau ka si,” ti ah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cutikah Isaak cu a pumpuluk hnin koin a thir thlohthlo ih, “Cuti asile sa a kap ih ka hnenih a rak kengtu cu zoso a si? Na rat hlante-ah ka rak ei zo. A neta bik ka thlawsuahnak cu amah ka pe zo ih amah ih ta kumkhua in a si zo,” ti ah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Esau in cumi a theih tikah, ninghangin napi in a ṭap ruangro; “Ka pa, na thlawsuahnak i pe ve aw,” ti ah a ṭap phah in a dil."},"35":{"text":"Asinain Isaak in, “Na naupa a ra ih i bum a si. Na thlawsuahnak a co thluh zo,” ti ah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cule Esau in, “Atu hi a voihnih i bumnak a si. Jakob tiih an kawh hi a dik a si. A hmaisaah fatir ka sinak i long zo; atu-ah ka thlawsuahnak i long fawn. Ka hrangah thlawsuahnak ziangtetal na nei nawn lo maw?” ti ah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cutikah Isaak in, “Amah cu na tlunah lal ah ka tuah zo ih a sungkhat pawl tiangin a hnaṭuantu dingah ka tuah thluh zo. Rawl le sabitti khal ka pe thluh zo. Ziang so na hrangah a taang nawn pei? ka fa,” ti ah Esau cu a ti."},"38":{"text":"Asinain Esau in a dil hrih thotho. “Maw ka pa, thlawsuahnak pakhat lawng maw si na neih? Kei khal i thlawsuah ve hram ko aw,” ti ah a ti ih Esau cu napi in a ṭap."},"39":{"text":"Cutikah Isaak in, “Na hrangah lei le ram ṭha a um nawn lo, Na leiram hrangah vanih daifiim khal a um lo."},"40":{"text":"Na hriamnam rinsan in na nung pei ih, Na naupa ih siahhlawh na si pei. Sikhalsehla ral na tho asile, A lo uknak sungin na suak ding,” ti ah a ti."},"41":{"text":"A pa in Esau co dingmi thluasuahnak cu Jakob a pek thluh ruangah Esau in Jakob cu a hua ih, “Ka pa hi rei a nung nawn lo ding; a thih hnuah Jakob cu ka that tengteng pam ding,” ti ah a thinlungte in a ruat."},"42":{"text":"Asinain Esau ih tummi cu Rebekah in a thei ih Jakob cu a ko. “Ngaihnik, na u Esau in lehrul a tum ih nangmah lo thah a tum a si."},"43":{"text":"Cu a si ruangah, ka fapa, ka lo sim vekin tuah aw. Zamrang in na tim tuah awla Haran khua ih ka ṭapa Laban hnenah tlan aw."},"44":{"text":"Na upa ih thinhengnak a reh ih,"},"45":{"text":"a hnenih na thil tuahmi pawl a hngilh thluh hlantiang na pu hnenah va um aw. Cuih hnuah mi pakhatkhat ka thlah pei ih ka lo kirter leh ding. Ziangah so ni khat sungah ka fapa pahnih hloral ding cu ka sian ding?” ti ah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Cule Rebekah in Isaak hnenah, “Esau ih ṭhitmi hnamdang nupi pawl hi ka ning tuk ih ka khop tuk zo. Hi vek Hit phun nunau Jakob in a ṭhi ve tla a si ahcun kei cu ka thih ah a ṭha sawn ding,” ti ah a ti."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Isaak in Jakob cu a ko ih a thluasuah hnuah, “Kanaan nunau cu na ṭhi lo pei.","title":"Isaak In Laban Hnenah Jakob A Thlah"},"2":{"text":"Na tim tuah awla Mesopotamia ram, na nuih pa Bethuel ih inn ah va feh aw. Cutawkih nunau, na pu Laban ih fanu pakhatkhat va ṭhi aw."},"3":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian in nan ṭhit awknak cu lo thlawsuah hramsehla faate tampi nei in miphun tampiih pa ah lo canter hram seh."},"4":{"text":"Pathian in Abraham a thlawsuah zo vekin nangmah le na tesinfa pawl cu lo thlawsuah hram seh; Pathian in Abraham hnenih a pekmi na umnak ram hi co hram aw,” ti ah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule Isaak in Jakob cu Mesopotamia ram Aram mi Bethuel ih fapa Laban hnenah a thlah. Laban cu Jakob le Esau ih nu Rebekah ih ṭapa a si."},"6":{"text":"Cule Isaak in Jakob cu a thluasuah ih nupi va ṭhi dingah Mesopotamia ramah a thlah ti kha Esau in a thei. Cuih tlunah a pa in Jakob a thluasuah tikah Kanaan mi nunau cu ṭhi lo dingin a kham ih,","title":"Esau In Nupi Dang A ṭhi"},"7":{"text":"Jakob in a nu le a pa ih thu a ngai ruangah Mesopotamia ramah a feh a si ti khal a thei fawn."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah a pa Isaak in Kanaan nunau cu a duh lo ti cu Esau in fiangtein a thei ngah."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Abraham ih fapa Ishmael hnenah Esau cu a feh ih, a neih ciami a nupi pawl ih tlunah, a dang pakhat Ishmael ih fanu, Nebaiothih farnu, Mahalath a ṭhit."},"10":{"text":"Cun Jakob cu Beer-sheba in a suak ih Haran lamah a feh.","title":"Bethel Ah Jakob Ih Mang"},"11":{"text":"Hmun pakhat ah a thleng ih ni a tlak zo ruangah cutawkah a riak. Lungto pakhat lukhamah a hmang ih a it."},"12":{"text":"Cule a mangah leilung in van a banmi kailawn saupi a hmu. Pathian ih vancungmi pawl tla cu cuih kailawn parah an ṭum an kai."},"13":{"text":"Cun Bawipa cu a kiangah a ding. Cutikah Bawipa in, “Keimah cu Abraham le Isaak ih Pathian Bawipa ka si. Na ihnak hmun le ram hi nangmah le na tesinfa pawl ka lo pe ding."},"14":{"text":"Na tesinfa pawl cu leilung parih leivut zat an si ding. An ram cu nisuah nitlak, saklam le thlanglam ah an kauh vivo ding. Nangmah le na tesinfa pawl ka lo thlawsuah bangtuk in leilung tlunih miphun hmuahhmuah in thlawsuah in dil ding."},"15":{"text":"Na hnenah ka um ding; na fehnak kipah ka lo humhim ding ih hi ramah ka lo kirter sal ding. Ka lo tiammi hmuahhmuah hi ka kimter thluh hlan lo ka lo tanta hrimhrim lo ding, ti cu ciing ringring aw,” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob cu a ṭhang ih, “ Bawipa cu hi hmun ah a um nan homaw thei loih ka rak um,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Jakob cu a thin a phang ih, “Ziangtluk rapthlakza hmun so a si. Vancung kotka le Bawipa ih inn ngaingai a rak sihi!” ti ah a ti."},"18":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitte in Jakob cu a tho ih lukhamih a hmanmi lungto cu a lak hnuah hngilhlonak lungphunah a phun. Cule hriak a toih ih Pathian hnenah a ap."},"19":{"text":"Jakob in a cuih hmun cu Bethel ti ah hmin a sak. A hlanah cun a cuih khua cu Luz ti ah an ko."},"20":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jakob in Bawipa Pathian hnenah, “Ka hnenah na um ih ka fehnak lamzinah i humhim ih ei ding rawl le hruk ding hnipuan i pek ih tlunah,"},"21":{"text":"ka pa ih inn ah himdamte in ka thlen sal thei a si ahcun Bawipa nangmah cu ka Pathian ngaingai na si ding."},"22":{"text":"Hi ka phunmi hngilhlonak lungphun hi Pathian nangmah ih inn a si ding ih i pekmi hmuahhmuah sung ihsin ṭhenhra-ih ṭhenkhat ka lo pe tengteng ding,” ti ah thukam-awhnak a tuah."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Jakob cu a pok sal ih nisuahlam mi pawl ih ram lamah cun a feh.","title":"Jakob Cu Laban Ih Inn A Thleng"},"2":{"text":"Cule rin lopi in hramlakih tikhur pakhat ah a va thleng ih a kiangkapah tuurual rual thum an bok kha a hmu. Cuih tikhur ihsin tuu pawl cu tidai an inter ṭheu. Tikhursin lungpher cu a tum ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Tuu hmuahhmuah an thlen kim tikah tuukhal pawl in lungpherpi cu an ṭhawn ih an tuu pawl cu ti an inter ṭheu. An in ṭheh hnuah tikhur cu an sin sal ṭheu."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob in an hnenah, “Rualle uh, khuitawk in nan ra?” ti ah a sut ih annih in, “Haran khua in,” ti ah an ti."},"5":{"text":"“Nahor ih fapa Laban nan thei maw?” ti ah a suh tikah, “Asi, kan thei,” ti ah an ti."},"6":{"text":"“A dam maw?” tiih a suh sal tikah, “Asi, a dam; zohhnik, a fanu Rachel cu a pa ih tuurual thawn a rat khi!” ti ah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule Jakob in, “Ni a saanglai ih tuu pawl tlun a cu hrih lo hrangah ziangah so nan tuu pawl ti tulh in nan tlanter sal lo?” ti ah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Annih in, “Cuticun a si lo ding; tuurual pawl an thlen kim tikah lungpherpi hi kan ṭhawn hmaisa ding; cuih hnu lawngah ti kan ṭul ding,” ti ah an ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutiih Jakob le tuukhal pawl an biak-awk rero laifangah Rachel cu a pa ih tuurual thawn a ra thleng. A pa ih tuukhal cu amah Rachel cu a si."},"10":{"text":"Cun a pu Laban ih tuurual thawn Rachel a rat cu Jakob in a hmuh tikah tikhur ah a va feh ih lungpherpi cu a ṭhawn ih, a nu ih ṭa-pa, a pu Laban ih tuurual cu tidai a pek."},"11":{"text":"Cule Rachel cu a hnam ih aw-ring in a ṭap."},"12":{"text":"A hnenah, “Na pa ih farnu Rebekah ih fapa ka si,” ti ah a sim. Cutikah Rachel cu zamrangin a tlan ih a pa a va sim."},"13":{"text":"A pa Laban cu a tupa Jakob ih thuhla a theih tikah hmuak dingah a tlan ih a ton tikah a pom ih a hnam. Cule a inn ah a hruai. Cun Jakob in a thuhla hmuahhmuah cu a pu Laban hnenah kimtein a sim."},"14":{"text":"Laban in, “Ka thi le ka sa ngaingai na si,” ti ah a ti. Cutiin Jakob cu a pu hnenah thla khat pum a um."},"15":{"text":"Laban in Jakob hnenah, “Ka sungkhat na si ruangah a lakin ka hna na ṭuan rero ding cu a cang thei lo. Ziangzat so hlawhman ka lo pek ding?” ti ah a sut.","title":"Jakob In Laban Ih Hna A ṭuan"},"16":{"text":"A pu Laban cu fanu pahnih a nei; a fanu upa deuh ih hmin cu Leah a si ih a nauta deuh cu Rachel a si."},"17":{"text":"Leah cu a mit a mawi; Rachel cu a ruangrai a ṭha ih a hmel khal a ṭha."},"18":{"text":"Jakob in Rachel cu a duh ruangah a pu Laban hnenah, “Na fanu nauta Rachel co dingah na hna kum sarih sung ka ṭuan ding,” ti ah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Laban in, “A rem ko ding, ka hnenah um aw. Midang hnenih ka fanu umter hnakin na hnenih umter ka duh sawn lo maw,” ti ah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Jakob cu Rachel co dingah kum sarih sung hna a ṭuan; asinain Rachel a duhzet ruangah kum sarih cu caan tawite vekin a thei."},"21":{"text":"Cule Jakob in Laban hnenah, “Kan ni tiammi a kim zo ih ka nupi si dingah na fanu cu i ṭhiter thlang aw,” ti ah a dil."},"22":{"text":"Cuhrangah Laban in ṭhit awknak puai a tuah sak ih an khuasung mi zatein an sawm ṭheh."},"23":{"text":"Asinain cuih zanah Rachel si loin Leah sawn cu a pa in Jakob hnenah a pek ih Jakob in Leah cu a ihpi."},"24":{"text":"Laban in a fanu Leah kilkhawitu dingah a salnu Zilpah cu Leah hnenah a pek."},"25":{"text":"A thaizing lawngah Leah a si ti kha Jakob in a thei. Cutikah Jakob in Laban cu, “Ka parah zianghrangah hivek na tuah? Rachel co dingah na hna ka ṭuan a si lo maw? Ziangah so hiti in i bum?” ti ah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cule Laban in, “Kan ramah fanu upa pasal neih hlanah fanu nauta sawn pasal neih daan a si lo."},"27":{"text":"A dang kum sarih sung ka hna na ṭuan hrih ding asile mopuai zarh khat sung hi hngak awla Rachel cu ka lo pe ding,” ti ah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cumi cu Jakob a lung a kim ih zarh khat sung ṭhit awknak puai a cem tikah Laban in a fanu Rachel cu Jakob ih nupi dingah a pek."},"29":{"text":"Rachel kilkhawitu dingah a salnu Bilhah khal Rachel hnenah a pek."},"30":{"text":"Cun Jakob in Rachel khal cu a ihpi ih Rachel cu Leah hnakin a duh sawn. Cuticun Laban ih hna ṭuan in a dang kum sarih a um sal."},"31":{"text":"Jakob in Leah cu a duh deuh lo ti kha Bawipa Pathian ih a hmuh tikah faate a neihter, asinain Rachel cu fa nei loin a um.","title":"Jakob Ih Faale Pawl"},"32":{"text":"Leah cu fa a vun ih fapa a hring. Cule, “ Bawipa in ka zonzaih zia a hmu zo; atu cu ka pasal in i duh thlang ding,” ti ah a ti ih a fapa hminah Reuben ti ah a sak."},"33":{"text":"Cun fa a vun sal ih fapa a nei. Cule Leah in, “Pasal ih duh lomi ka si hi Bawipa in i thei; curuangah fapa i pe a si,” a ti ih a fapa hmin ah Simeon a sak."},"34":{"text":"Fa a vun sal ih fapa a nei lala. Cutikah, “Fapa pathum ka hrin zo ruangah ka pasal cu ka hnenah a kop deuh thlang ding,” ti ah a ti ih a fapa hmin ah Levi a sak."},"35":{"text":"Cuih hnuah fa a vun sal lala ih fapa dang pakhat a nei lala. “Atu cu Bawipa ka thangṭhat ding,” a ti ih a hminah Judah a sak. Cuih hnu cun faate a nei nawn lo."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A pasal Jakob hrangih fa pakhat hman a hrin lo cu Rachel in a ruat tikah a u Leah cu a nahsiik zet. Jakob hnenah, “Faate i pe aw; culole ka thi ding,” ti ah a ti."},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob cu a thin a heng ih, “Pathian ih ai cu ziangtinso ka awh thei ding? Faate a lo neiterlotu cu amah Pathian a sisi!” ti ah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule Rachel in, “Asile ka hrangah faate a neih ih cuticun kei khal naute ih nu ka si ve theinak dingah hi ka salnu Bilhah thawn pawl aw uh,” ti ah Jakob cu a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuticun Rachel in a salnu Bilhah cu a pasal hnenah a pek ih a pasal in Bilhah cu a ihpi."},"5":{"text":"Bilhah cu nau a keng ih Jakob cu fapa a hrin."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Rachel in, “Pathian cu keimah ih lam ṭangin thu a rel a si. Ka thlacamnak a thei ih fapa i pek,” ti ah a ti ih a hminah Dan a sak."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a salnu Bilhah cu nau a keng sal ih Jakob ih fapa pahnihnak a hring."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Rachel in, “Ka u neh dingah nasa zetin ka zuam ih ka neh suak a si,” ti ah a ti ih a hmin ah Naftali a sak."},"9":{"text":"Cun Leah khal in faate a neih sal lohli lo kha a theih awk tikah a salnu Zilpah cu Jakob ih ihpi dingah a pek."},"10":{"text":"Cule Zilpah cun fapa a hring."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Leah in, “Ka van a ṭha a si,” a ti ih a hminah Gad a sak."},"12":{"text":"Leah ih salnu Zilpah in fapa a nei sal ih,"},"13":{"text":"Leah cun, “Ziangtluk in so ka lung a awi. Atu cun nunau hmuahhmuah in mi lungawi ti ah in ko ding,” a ti ih a hminah Asher a sak."},"14":{"text":"Cule sangvut lak caanah Reuben cu hramlakah a feh ih lengai rah a hmu ih a nu Leah hnenah a pek. Cutikah Rachel in Leah cu, “Na fapa ih rak kenmi lengai rah cu malte in i ṭhen ve aw,” ti ah a dil."},"15":{"text":"Asinain Leah cun, “Ka pasal i lon hi tawk na ti lo maw? Ka fapa ih lengai rah khal maw a lak hrih na tum?” ti ah a ti. Cule Rachel in, “Na fapa ih lengai rah i pek asile tuihzan cu Jakob hnenah na it ding,” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cuih zanlam ah Jakob cu hramlak in a rung tlun tikah Leah cun a va hmuak ih a hnenah, “Tuihzan cu ka hnenah na ih a ṭul, ziangahtile ka fapa ih lengai rah in Rachel hnen ihsin ka lo saang a si,” ti ah a ti. Cutiin cuihzan cu Leah thawn an pawl aw."},"17":{"text":"Cule Pathian in Leah ih thlacamnak cu a theih hrangah fa a vun ih Jakob cu fapa panganak a hrin."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Leah cun, “Ka salnu cu ka pasal hnenih ka pek ruangah Pathian in ka laksawng i pek zo a si,” ti ah a ti. Cuhrangah a fapa cu Issakhar ti ah hmin a sak."},"19":{"text":"Leah cu fa a vun lala ih fapa a paruknak a hring."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Leah cun, “Pathian in laksawng sunglawi i pek. Fapa paruk ka hrin zo hrangah atu cun ka pasal in i duh thlang ding,” ti ah a ti. Cuhrangah a fapa hminah Jebulun a sak."},"21":{"text":"Cuih hnuah fanu pakhat a nei ih a hminah Dinah a sak."},"22":{"text":"Asinain Pathian in Rachel cu a hngilh lo. A thlacamnak a thei ih fa nei thei dingin a tuah."},"23":{"text":"Rachel cu fa a vun ih fapa a hring. Cutikah, “Faate nei thei loih ka ningzahnak cu Pathian in i lak sak zo."},"24":{"text":"Pathian in fapa dang i pe hrih hram seh,” ti ah a ti ih a hminah Josef a sak."},"25":{"text":"Josef suah hnuah Jakob in Laban hnenah, “I thlah thlang aw, ka khua le ka ram ah kir ka duh thlang.","title":"Jakob Le Laban Thu An El Aw"},"26":{"text":"Ka nupi pawl le ka faate pawl tla cu i pe awla ka tlung ding; anmah co duh ah ziangtlukin na hna ṭhatein ka ṭuan ti cu na thei ko,” ti ah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cutikah Laban in, “Thusimnak tikcu i pe hram aw! Nangmah ka hnenih na um ruangah Bawipa in thlawsuah vanluh i pek ih ka ṭhangso tihi tinzohnak in ka thei a si."},"28":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah na hlawhman i sim awla ka lo pe ding,” ti ah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cule Jakob cun, “Ziangtluk in na hna ka ṭuan ih na ṭilva pawl ka khalh sungah ziangtlukin an pungzai ti cu na thei thluh ko."},"30":{"text":"Na hnenih ka thlen pekte ih malte lawng na neihmi atu-ah siar cawk lo an si thlang. Keimah ruangah Bawipa cun thlawsuah vanluh a lo pe taktak a si. Atu cu keimah ih hrang ka ruah caan a si ve thlang,” ti ah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah Laban cun, “Cuti asile ziangso ka lo pek ding?” ti ah a sut. Jakob in, “Hlawhman zianghman ka duh lo. Ka lo ngenmi i pek ding asile na ṭilva pawl hi ka kilkhawi hrih ding. Ka lo ngen mi cu:"},"32":{"text":"tuihsun ah na ṭilva pawl lakah ka vak ding ih tuu note a dummi hmuahhmuah le a ṭialmi tuu pohpoh ṭialcip ih a ṭialmi siseh, ṭialkau ih a ṭialmi siseh - ka lak ding. Cule a ṭialmi me pohpoh ṭialcip ih a ṭialmi siseh, ṭialkau ih a ṭialmi siseh - ka lak ding. Cuvial cu ka hlawhman ah ka duhmi a si."},"33":{"text":"Cuticun ka fel le fel lo hmailamah na thei ding. Ka hlawhman cu na thei fel duh ih na zingzoi tikah tuu a dum lomi le me a ṭial lomi ka neih na hmuh asile a rukih rukmi a si ti ah na thei ding,” ti ah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Cutikah Laban in, “A ṭha a si, na sim vekin ka tuah pei,” a ti."},"35":{"text":"Sikhalsehla acuih sun rori ah Laban cun mecang ṭialcip le ṭialkau ih a ṭialmi le mepi ṭialcip le ṭialkau ih a ṭialmi pohpoh, a si lole a raangin a ṭialmi hmuahhmuah le tuu a dummi hmuahhmuah tla a lak thluh ih a fapa pawl ih khalh dingin a ret."},"36":{"text":"Cule Jakob ih umnak ihsin ni thum ban ah a fehpi hai. Cun a taangmi Laban ih tuu le me pawl cu Jakob in a run khal."},"37":{"text":"Cule Jakob cun ṭhil, ṭhuang le hriang kungih a ṭeek pawl a lak ih a hawng a hrekin a hawk ih funghreu ṭial ah a tuah."},"38":{"text":"Cuih funghreu ṭial pawl cu ṭilva pawl ih tidai innak tikuang sungah atung in ṭilva pawl hoih in a ret. Ziangah hiti in a ret tile tidai in dingih ṭilva pawl an rat tikah an pawl-awk ṭheu ruangah a si."},"39":{"text":"Cuticun funghreu ṭial hmaiah me pawl cu an raih-aw vivo ih faate an hrinmi pawl cu a ṭialmi ṭialngaan, ṭialcip le ṭialkau mi - lawnglawng an si."},"40":{"text":"Cun Jakob in Laban ih tunu pawl cu a dan ih a pa thawn a dangah a ret; cu ṭheh in Jakob ih tuucang ṭial le a dum pawl thawn lawngin a pawl awkter. Cuticun Laban ih tuurual sung ihsin Jakob cun a tuurual kha a zaiter vivo a si."},"41":{"text":"Cule ṭilva lakih a harhdammi le a cakmi an pawl-awk tikah fa ṭial an vun theinak dingah a funghreu ṭial pawl cu tikuang sungah an hmai hoih in a ret."},"42":{"text":"Asinain ṭilva ṭawnṭai pawl an pawl-awk tikah funghreu ṭial cu a ret lo. Curuangah ṭilva ṭawnṭai pawl cu Laban ih ta ah an cang ih a cak deuh pawl hmuahhmuah cu Jakob ih ta ah an cang."},"43":{"text":"Cutiin a rei hlanah Jakob cu milianzet ah a cang. Ṭilva tampi, salnu salpa le kalauk le laak tampi a nei."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Voikhat cu Laban fapa pawl in, “Kan pa ih ta a si mi hmuahhmuah Jakob in a lak ṭheh a si. Kan pa ih neihmi a lak ruangah hiti in a lian a si,” ti ah an ti kha Jakob in a thei.","title":"Jakob Cu Laban Hnenin A Tlan"},"2":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Laban cu a hlan bangtuk in a parah a mithmai a ṭha nawn lo ti kha Jakob in a hmu."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Jakob hnenah, “Na sungkhat le na laicin ih ramah kir thlang aw. Na hnenah ka um ding,” ti ah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah ṭilva pawl a khalhnak hmunah amah ra tong dingin Rachel le Leah cu a cah."},"5":{"text":"An hnenah, “Nan pa ih mithmai cu ka parah a hlan bangtuk a si nawn lo tihi ka thei a si; asinain ka pa ih Pathian cu ka hnenah a um ringring ko."},"6":{"text":"Ka thazaang neihmi hmuahhmuah thawn nan pa ih hna ka ṭuan cu nan pahnih in nan thei."},"7":{"text":"Asinain nan pa in i bum ih ka hlawhman hi voi hra a ṭhin zo. Sikhalsehla ka parih siatsuahnak a thlenter ding cu Pathian in i siang lo a si."},"8":{"text":"Nan pa Laban in, ‘A ṭialcipmi me pohpoh cu na hlawhman a si ding,’ i ti tikah me pohpoh in a ṭialcipmi faate an nei. Cule ‘A ṭialkaumi me pohpoh cu na hlawhman an si ding,’ i ti tikah me pohpoh in a ṭialkaumi faate an nei."},"9":{"text":"Pathian cun nan pa hnen ihsin ṭilva pawl kha a lak ih keimah i pek a si."},"10":{"text":"“Cun ṭilva an hur caanah mang ka nei ih ka mangah mepi a pawltu mecang pohpoh cu ṭialngaanmi le ṭialcipmi le ṭialkaumi hlir an si kha ka hmu."},"11":{"text":"Cule Pathian ih vancungmi in ka mangah cun, ‘Jakob,’ ti ah i ko ih, ‘Hinah ka um!’ ti ah ka ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule vancungmi cun, ‘Zohhnik, mepi a pawltu mecang pohpoh cu ṭialngaan le ṭialcip le ṭialkau hlir an si. Hitiih cang dingin keimah ih tuahmi a si. Ziangahtile na parah Laban ih thil a tuahzia ka hmu thluh."},"13":{"text":"Keimah cu hriak toih in hngilhlonak lung na phun ih thu na kamnak Bethel ah na hnenih a rak langmi Pathian ka si. Atu cu na tim tuah awla hi ram hi taan in na suahnak khua le ramah kir thlang aw,’ i ti,” ti ah a sim hai."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Rachel le Leah in, “Kan pa hnen ihsin kan co ding ro zianghman a um lo."},"15":{"text":"Kannih tla cu ramdangmi tlukah in ruat ko lo maw? Kannih cu in zuar ih kan manih a ngahmi paisa hmuahhmuah cu a hmang thluh zo fawn."},"16":{"text":"Pathian in kan pa hnen ihsin a lakmi lennak hmuahhmuah cu kanmah le kan faate pawl ih ta a si zo. Curuangah Pathian ih a lo sim bangtuk in tuah ko aw,” ti ah an ti."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Jakob cu Kanaan ramih a pa hnen feh dingah a tim a tuah thluh. A nupi le a faate pawl cu kalauk a toter."},"18":{"text":"A ṭilva hmuahhmuah cu hmaiah a fehter ih Mesopotamia ram a um sungih a ngahmi thilri hmuahhmuah thawn a pok."},"19":{"text":"Laban cu a tuu pawl ih hmul met dingah a feh ih a um lo sungah Rachel in a pa ih innsang biakmi milem pawl a rak ruk."},"20":{"text":"Aram mi Laban cu Jakob in a bum ih a fehnak ding thu cu sim lotein a um."},"21":{"text":"A neihmi hmuahhmuah a keng ih a tlan. Cawl loin a feh ih Eufrates tiva a tan ih Gilead tlang lamah a feh."},"22":{"text":"Nithum hnuah Jakob a tlan a si ti ah Laban an sim.","title":"Laban In Jakob Cu A Dungin A Dawi"},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Laban in a hnenum pawl a ko ih Jakob cu ni sarih sung an dawi ih Gilead tlang ah an man."},"24":{"text":"Cuih zanah Laban ih mangah Pathian a lang ih a hnenah, “Ralring aw, Jakob cu ziangti hmanin hringhro cetci hlah,” ti ah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Laban in a hei man tikah Jakob cu tlang parah riahbuk a rak sak zo; Laban khal Gilead tlang ah riahbuk a sak ve."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Laban in Jakob hnenah, “Zianghrangah i bum ih ka fanu pawl ral kaihmi nunau bangih na tlanpi?"},"27":{"text":"Zianghrangah i bum ih keimah sim loin a thupte in na rak tlan ziar? I rak sim cila, na feh tikah khan lungawinak le hlasaknak thawn khuang le dar le ṭingṭang tum phahin ka lo thlah ding a sisi!"},"28":{"text":"Ka fanu pawl le ka tule pawl hman i hnamterta lo. Na tuahmi hi aat-thlakza thil ṭha lo zet a si."},"29":{"text":"Nangmah siatsuah theinak cu ka nei ve ko; asinain mizanah na pa ih Pathian in, ‘Ralring aw, Jakob cu ziangti hmanin hringhro cetci hlah,’ ti ah i ti."},"30":{"text":"Na tlannak hi na pa ih inn zamrangih thlen na duhtuk ruangah a si ti ka thei ko. Sikhalsehla zianghrangah ka milem pawl tla na rak fir?” ti ah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob in, “Na fanu pawl hi an duh na loin i long pang ding ti ka phan ruangah a si."},"32":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kan sungte lakih pakhatkhat parah na milem na hmu asile amah cu thah a si pei. Kan milai pawl hi thu theihpitu an si pei ih, hawl awla na ta a si mi pohpoh cu lak aw,” ti ah a ti. Rachel in a pa ih milem pawl a rak ru ti kha Jakob in a thei lo."},"33":{"text":"Cutikah Laban cu Jakob ih riahbuk sungah a lut ih a hawl; cuih hnuah Leah ih riahbuk sungah a feh; cuih hnuah an salnu pahnihte ih riahbuk sungah a lut lala. Asinain a milem pawl cu a hmu lo. A neta bikah Rachel ih riahbuk sungah a lut."},"34":{"text":"Rachel cun innsang milem pawl cu a rak lak ih kalauk phurhmi dip sungah a khum ih a rak toh-nen. Laban cun riahbuk pumpuluk in a hawl naón a hmu lo."},"35":{"text":"Cutikah Rachel in a pa ih hnenah, “Na rung luh ih ka din lo hi bawipa na thinheng hram hlah aw; nunau daan ka neih laifang a si,” ti ah a ti. Cuticun Laban in a hawl rero naón a innsang milem pawl cu a hmu thei lo."},"36":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob cu a ai a thok ih thinheng zetin Laban cu, “Ziang mawhnak so ka neih ih ziangvek daan ka tisiat ruangah so hiti ih i dawi ih i hawl ciamco?"},"37":{"text":"Ka thilri zatein na zoh thluh zo; na ta a si mi ziangtal na hmu maw? Na hmuh asile na sungkhat le ka sungkhat hmaiah hin suah hnik; zo kan dik sawn ti kha relcat hai seh."},"38":{"text":"Na hnenah kum kul sung rori ka um ih cuhmuah ka um sungah na tuu le na me voikhat hman an fa a siat dah lo; na tuurual sung ihsin tuucang pakhatte hman ka ei hrih lo."},"39":{"text":"Sahrang in na tuu a deh tikah keimah sualnak a si lo ti langter duh in a sa na hnenah ka rak keng dah lo, a ai-ah keimahte in ka rak ruul mai ringring sawn. Sun ah siseh, zanah siseh, rukru pawl in an ru asile na kuan pei i ti."},"40":{"text":"Voi tamzet sunih niling ka tuar ih zanih khawsik khal ka tuar. Ka it thei dah lem lo."},"41":{"text":"Kum kul khengte na hnenih ka um sung hmuahhmuah cutiin ka rak tuar cuahco a si. Na fanu pahnih hrangah kum hleili na hna ka ṭuan; na tuuruun pawl kum ruk sung ka khal. Cucing hmanin ka hlawhman voi sawmsahra na ṭhin."},"42":{"text":"Ka pa ih Pathian, Abraham ih Pathian le Isaak ih biakmi Pathian ka hnenah um hlah sehla ka kut lawngin i dawihlo zo ding. Asinain Pathian in ka hnaṭuanmi le ka zonzaihnak a hmuh ruangah mizanah a lo kawk a si kha!” ti ah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Cule Laban in, “Hi nunau pawl hi keimah ih fanu an si; na faale pawl khal hi keimah ih faale an si ih ṭilva rual khal hi keimah ih ta hlir an si. Na hmuh mi pohpoh hi ka ta an si thluh. Asinain tuih hnuah cun hi ka fanu pawl le an faale pawl hrangah zianghman ka tuah thei nawn lo.","title":"Jakob Le Laban Thukamnak"},"44":{"text":"Curuangah ra awla thukamnak kan tuah sawn pei ih hminsinnakah lungdawl kan tuah pei,” ti ah Jakob cu a ti."},"45":{"text":"Curuangah Jakob in lungpher pakhat a lak ih hngilhlonak lung a phun."},"46":{"text":"Cule a hnenum pawl cu lungto peng dingin a fial. Lungto cu an peng ih an lungpen kiangah cun rawl an ei."},"47":{"text":"Cuih lungpen cu Laban in Jegar Sahadutha ti ah hmin a sak ih Jakob in Galeed ti ah hmin a sak."},"48":{"text":"Laban in, “Hi lungpen cu nangmah le keimah karlakah thutheitu a si ding,” ti ah a ti. Cutiin cuih hmun cu Galeed ti ah an tita."},"49":{"text":"Cule Laban in, “Kan ṭhen-awk tikah Bawipa in kan umnak fingfingah in kilkhawi hram seh,” ti ah a ti. Curuangah cuih hmun cu Mizpah ti ah hmin an sak lala."},"50":{"text":"Laban cun Jakob hnenah, “Ka fanu pawl na tisiat hai ih, nupi dang tla na ṭhit le keimah ih ka theih lo hmanah Pathian in in hmu ringring ti thei aw."},"51":{"text":"Hitawk ah kan pahnih karlakah hngilhlonak lungphun le lungpen tla an um ti na hmuh ko."},"52":{"text":"Hi lungpen le hngilhlonak lungphun cu kan thutheitu an si ding. Nangmah do dingah hi lungpen hi ka lan lo pei ih, nang khal in keimah do dingah hi lungpen, a si lole hi lungphun hi na lan lo pei."},"53":{"text":"Abraham ih Pathian le Nahor ih Pathian cu kan karlakih thureltu a si ding,” ti ah a ti. Cutikah Jakob cun a pa Isaak ih biakmi Pathian hmin in siatcam in thu a kam."},"54":{"text":"Cule Jakob in ṭilva pakhat a that ih tlangpar ah thawinak a pek. A sungkhat pawl a ko ṭheh ih zanriah an ei tlang hnuah tlangpar ahcun an riak."},"55":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah Laban cu a tho ih a fasuan pawl le a fanu pawl a hnamta ih thlaza a camta hnuah a khua lamah a kir."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob cu a pok sal ih lamzinah Pathian ih vancungmi pawl in an rak tong.","title":"Jakob Cu Esau Tong Dingah"},"2":{"text":"Jakob in a hmuh tikah, “Pathian ih ralkap pawl an si,” ti ah a ti. Curuangah cuih hmun cu Mahanaim ti ah hmin a sak."},"3":{"text":"Cule Jakob cun Edom ram Seir an timi hmunih a um mi a u-pa Esau tong dingin mi a hei thlah."},"4":{"text":"A thlahmi pawl hnenah, “Ka bawipa Esau hnenah ṭihzahnak thawn na siahhlawh keimah Jakob in thu ka lo cah a si. Laban hnenah kum reipi ka um ih atu lawngah ka ra kir."},"5":{"text":"Caw le laak pawl, tuu le me pawl le salnu le salpa ka nei a si. Ka u nangmah mithmai ṭha co thei dingah hiti in thu ka lo cahnak a si,” ti ah va sim dingin a tirh."},"6":{"text":"A thlahmi an ra kir tikah Jakob hnenah, “Na u Esau hnenah kan va feh ih amah cu nangmah tong dingin a ra pok zo. Minung zali thawn an ra,” ti ah an sim."},"7":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Jakob cun a ṭih ih a thin a phang thlohthlo. Curuangah a hnenih ummi a milai pawl le tuu le me pawl, caw le kalauk pawl cu bur hnih ah a ṭhen."},"8":{"text":"Ziangah cutiin a ṭhen tile, “Esau in bur khat pawl a thah khalle a dang bur khat tal cu an luat na hman maw!” tiih a ruah ruangah a si."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob cu thla a cam ih, “Maw Pathian, ka pu Abraham le ka pa Isaak ih Pathian, i ngai hram aw. Bawipa , nangmah in, ‘Na khua le na sungkhat hnenah kir sal awla na hrangah na lamzin ka tluangter ding,’ i ti."},"10":{"text":"Kei na salpa hnenih na thlentermi na zaangfahnak le rinsantlak na sinak hi a cotu si dingah malte hman ka tlak lo. Zianghman nei loin kianghrol pakhat lawng thawn Jordan tiva ka rak tan; atu-ah cun minung le ṭilva bur hnih thawn ka ra kir sal zo."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah ka u Esau ih kutsung ihsin, maw Bawipa , i run hram aw. Ka u Esau a ra ding ih nunau le nauhak hman zuah loin in that thluh pang ding ti ka phang tuk a si."},"12":{"text":"‘Na lamzin ka tluangter ding ih tesinfa tampi ka lo pe ding; na tesinfa pawl cu tifinriat kapih vunnel zat in an tam ding ih siarcawk lo an si ding,’ ti ah thu i kammi kha vun mangsal hram aw,” ti ah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutawkih zan khat a riak hnuah, a u Esau laksawng pe dingin a neihmi sung ihsin a tanglam pawl a hril."},"14":{"text":"Mepi zahnih le mecang kul, tuupi zahnih le tuucang kul,"},"15":{"text":"hnawisawr mi kalauk sawmthum le an faate ciar, cawpi sawmli le cawcang pahra, laakpi kul le laakcang pahra tla an si."},"16":{"text":"Ṭilva phun khat cu hnenum pakhat ciar a kilter ih an hnenah, “Ka hmaiah feh uhla bur khat le bur khat cu hlat aw nawn in feh uh,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Hmaisa bikih a fehtupa hnenah, “Ka u Esau in a lo tong ih, ‘Na bawipa zo a si? Khuiah na feh ding? Na hmaiih ṭilva pawl neitu zo a si?’ tiih a lo sut tikah,"},"18":{"text":"‘Hi ṭilva pawl cu na siahhlawh Jakob ih ta an si ih a bawipa nangmah Esau hrangah laksawng a lo pekmi an si. Amah Jakob cu kan dungte-ah a ra lai,’ na rak ti pei,” ti ah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Hmaisa bik pa hnenih a ti bangtuk in pahnihnak, pathumnak le an zate hnen khalah bangrep in thu a pek. “Esau nan ton tikah,"},"20":{"text":"‘Asi, na salpa Jakob cu kan dungte-ah a ra lai,’ ti ah nan rak ti pei,” ti ah a ti. Jakob cun ka hmaiih ka fehtermi laksawng in a thinlung cu ka nemter deuh ding ih ka ton ngaingai tikah i ngaithiam thei men ding, ti ah a ruat."},"21":{"text":"A laksawng pawl hmaiah a fehter ih amah cu cuihzan cu a riahbuk ah a riak."},"22":{"text":"A cuih zan zankhuathim ah Jakob cu a tho ih a nupi pahnih le a nusun pahnih le a faate hleikhat thawn Jabbok tiva an tan.","title":"Jakob le Vancungmi An Buan Aw"},"23":{"text":"A innsangmi pawl tiva ralih a hruai thluh hnuah a neihmi dang hmuahhmuah khal tiva ralah a hei ṭhawn thluh."},"24":{"text":"Amah lawng a rung taang. Cuih zanah mi pakhat in Jakob cu zing khuavang zik tiang a rung buan ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Jakob a neh thei lo ti kha a buantu pa in a theih tikah, Jakob ih khel kha a sawh in a sawh ih, an buan-awk rero laiah cun Jakob ih khel hlikhlok a pelh."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah mi pa in, “I thlah aw, khua a van zik thlang hi!” ti ah a ti. Sikhalsehla Jakob cun, “I thlawsuah lo ahcun ka lo thlah lo ding,” ti ah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule mi pa in, “Na hmin zoso a si?” ti ah a sut ih Jakob in, “Jakob ka si,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cule mi pa in, “Atu thok ihsin na hmin cu Jakob a si nawn lo pei. Milai thawn siseh, Pathian thawn siseh nan tawng aw ih na neh ruangah na hmin cu Israel ti a si pei,” ti ah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob in, “Na hmin i sim hram aw,” ti ah a dil. Anih in, “Ziangah so ka hmin i suh?” ti ah a ti ih cuih hnuah Jakob cu thluasuah a pek."},"30":{"text":"Jakob cun, “Pathian cu hmaiton tein ka tong zo; asinain ka nung lai a si,” ti ah a ti ih acuih hmun cu Peniel ti ah hmin a sak."},"31":{"text":"Peniel ihsin a pawh zawng ah ni a hung suak cerco. Jakob cu a ke a bai; ziangahtile a khelruh a pelh ruangah a si."},"32":{"text":"Curuangah tuih san tiangin Israel ih tesinfa pawl cun sakhel hlikhlok parih satit ei loin an run iikta; ziangahtile Jakob ih khel sawhpelhnak a rak ton ruangah a si."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob in Esau cu milai zali thawn an rat kha a hmuh tikah a faate pawl cu Leah, Rachel le a nusun pahnih hnenah a ṭhendarh thluh.","title":"Jakob In Esau A Tong"},"2":{"text":"A nusun pahnih le an faate pawl cu hmaisabik ah a ret; a sangtu ah Leah le a faate pawl a ret ih neta bikah Rachel le Josef a ret hai."},"3":{"text":"Amah Jakob cu an hmaiah a feh ih voi sarih tiang a hmai leilung dai in a lu a kuun hnuah a u hnenah a va thleng."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Esau in Jakob a hmuh tikah tong dingah a va tlan ih Jakob cu a pom; a hngawng in a kuah ih a hnam. Cule an pahnih in an ṭaptlang."},"5":{"text":"Cule Esau cu khuadang a tang ih nunau le nauhak pawl a hmu. “Na hnenih nunau le nauhak pawl hi zoso an si?” ti ah a sut. Cutikah Jakob in, “Na siahhlawhpa keimah hi Pathian in i zaangfah ih i pekmi faale pawl an si,” ti ah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun a nusun le an faate pawl an ra ih upat pe in an lu an kuun."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Leah le a faate pawl an ra kuun; cule a neta bikah Josef le Rachel an ra ih an lu an ra kuun ve."},"8":{"text":"Cule Esau in, “Ṭilva rual ka rak ton zomi kha ziang sullam so a si?” ti ah a sut. Jakob in, “Bawipa, na hmaiṭha ka co theinak dingah an si,” ti ah a hun ti tikah,"},"9":{"text":"Esau in, “Ka duhzat cu ka nei ve ko, ka naupa; na ta pawl kha cu nangmah in nei ko aw,” ti ah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jakob cun, “Cuticun a si lo pei; na mithmaiṭha i coter a si ahcun ka laksawng cu na sang hram pei. Atu cu ka parah na thinlung tluangzet in a um ih ka hrangah na mithmai hmuh cu Pathian ih mithmai hmuh bangtuk a si."},"11":{"text":"Zaangfahte in na hrangih ka rak kenmi laksawng cu co hram aw; Pathian in i zaangfah ih ka ṭulmi pohpoh cu i pek a si,” ti ah a ti. Cutiin Esau ih a san hlan lo a hneek zok rero. Cule Esau cun a saang."},"12":{"text":"Cun Esau in, “Kan tim kan tuah pei ih kan feh pei. Keimah in hmai ka lo hruai ding,” ti ah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Asinain Jakob in, “Bawipa, kan faale pawl hi an nauhak tuk lai hrih ti cu na thei ko; cule kan tuu le kan caw pawl tla ka ruah a ṭul fawn; hnawifawp lai hlir an si. A khaaltu pawl in ni khatah hlat tuk an dawi a si ahcun an thi thluh ding."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah bawipa, nang hmaiah rak feh sung aw; Seir ramih na hnen ka thlen tiang, rannung le nauhak pawl an feh thei tawkin ka hun lo dawi ding,” ti ah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Esau in, “Cuti asile na hnenah ka milai pawl a hrekin ka taanta pei,” ti ah a ti. Asinain Jakob cun, “Na thuruah thiamnak parah ka lung a awi, bawipa, sikhalsehla an taan a ṭul lem lo ding,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cuhrangah Esau cu Seir ramah cuih ni ah a kir sal."},"17":{"text":"Jakob cu a pok ih Sukkoth ah a feh. Cutawkah amah ih hrangah inn a sak ih a rannung hrangah deu a suang. Curuangah cuih hmun cu Sukkoth ti ah hmin an sak."},"18":{"text":"Jakob cu Mesopotamia ram ihsin a kir tikah Kanaan ram Shekhem khua himdamte in a thleng. Shekhem khua pawnah a puan inn cu a sak."},"19":{"text":"A cuih hmun cu Shekhem ih pa Hamor ih tefa pawl hnen ihsin ngun tangka zakhat in a lei."},"20":{"text":"Cutawkah biakṭheng a don ih a hmin ah El, Israel ih Pathian, ti ah a sak."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leah thawn an hrinmi Jakob ih fanu Dinah cu cuih ramih nunau pawl hnenah a va leng.","title":"Dinah An Sualpi"},"2":{"text":"Cuih ramih lal a si mi Hiv mi Hamor ih fapa Shekhem in Dinah cu a hmuh tikah a kaihrem ih a duh naloin a sualpi."},"3":{"text":"Cule Dinah ih tlun lawngah a thinlung a taap ih a duhzet fawn hrangah a leem ciamco."},"4":{"text":"Cule a pa Hamor hnenah, “Hi falanu hi ka nupi dingah i biak sak aw,” ti ah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Jakob in a fanu Dinah cu a thang an siatter zo ti a thei naón a fapa pawl hramlakah caw khal in an um hrangah an ra tlun hlan cu zianghman ti loin a um."},"6":{"text":"Cule Shekhem ih pa Hamor cu Jakob bia dingin a feh ih,"},"7":{"text":"Jakob ih fapa pawl hramlak ihsin an ra thlen caan fangah a va thleng ve. An farnu an sualpi ti thu le Shekhem in hi bangtuk thil borhhlawh le ningzakza a tuah ruangah Israel miphun a hmuhsuam ih a nautat ti thu pawl an theih tikah an ai a thok ih an thin a ling."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Hamor in an hnenah, “Ka fapa Shekhem in nan fanu cu a duhzet ruangah a ṭhit theinak dingah zaangfah hram uh."},"9":{"text":"Ṭhit awknak in rual kan kai aw pei. Nan fanu pawl kan ṭhi pei ih nannih khal in kan fanu pawl nan ṭhi ve pei."},"10":{"text":"Cuticun kan hnenah kan ram sungah nan um pei ih hnangamte in nan duhnak pohpoh ah nan um ding. Thilri nan nei ding ih nan duhduh in sum nan tuah pei,” ti ah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule Shekhem in Dinah ih pa le ṭapa pawl hnenah, “Nan mithmaiṭha i coter hram uh; nan duhmi hmuahhmuah ka lo pe ding."},"12":{"text":"Ziang laksawng so nan duh, i sim uh; nan farnu man cu nan duhzat ngen uh; in ṭhitter siang a si ahcun nan dilmi pohpoh ka lo pe ding,” ti ah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob ih fapa pawl cun, Shekhem in Dinah a thangsiatter zo ruangah, an leemsiah ih an thu cu an zom buum ih,"},"14":{"text":"an hnenah, “Serhtan lomi cu kan farnu kan pasalter thei lo; neihter kan siang tibang sehla kan hrangah ziangtluk ningzakza so a si ding."},"15":{"text":"Kanmah bangtuk in mipa pohpoh serh nan tan thluh lawngah kan lung a kim thei ding."},"16":{"text":"Cuti a si lawngah kan fala pawl nan ṭhi thei ding ih kannih khal in nan fala pawl kan ṭhi ve ding. Nanmah lakah khua kan sa ding ih nanmah thawn miphun pakhat ah kan cang ding."},"17":{"text":"Asinain kan thu nan pom thei lo ih serh nan tan lo a si ahcun kan farnu cu kan lak ding ih kan feh ko ding,” ti ah an ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutiin Jakob fapa pawl ih thu cu Hamor le a fapa Shekhem cun thil remcaangzet ah an ruat."},"19":{"text":"Cuhrangah Shekhem cun rei lote-ah an sim vekin a tuah ṭheh. Ziangahtile Jakob ih fanu cu a duh ngaingai ruangah a si. Shekhem cu a sungte lakah mi ih hmaizah bikmi a si."},"20":{"text":"Hamor le a fapa Shekhem cu an tlung ih an khuasuah ah an khawpi pawl thawn an tongkhawm-aw ih an hnenah,"},"21":{"text":"“Jakob le a sungkhat pawl thawn kan rem-aw zet ko; kan ramah hin kan hnenah um ve ko hai sehla, an duhnak poh ah tlangleng hai seh. Anmah ih hrang daih in kan ram khal a kau pam a si. An fanu pawl kan ṭhi pei ih annih khal in kan fanu pawl ṭhi ve hai seh."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla anmah bangtuk ih mipa hmuahhmuah serh kan tan ṭheh lawngah kan hnenah um in kanmah thawn miphun khat si ding cu an lung a kim ding."},"23":{"text":"Cuti a si lawngah an ṭilva, an thilri le an cawrual pawl cu kan ta ah an cang ding. Curuangah kanmah lakih an um theinak ding cu tuah ve uhsi,” ti ah an ti."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah khuasungmi hmuahhmuah in Hamor le Shekhem ih thu cu an zom ih khuasungih mipa hmuahhmuah cu serh an tan ṭheh."},"25":{"text":"Cuticun ni thumnak a kim ih an serhtannak a besiat laifangah, Jakob ih fapa pahnih, Dinah ih ṭapa Simeon le Levi cu ralnam kengin khuasungah zohmanih theihthiam lo dingin an lut ih an mipa hmuahhmuah cu an that ṭheh."},"26":{"text":"Hamor le a fapa Shekhem khal an lu an tan ih an farnu Dinah cu Shekhem innsung ihsin an lak ih an tlanpi."},"27":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Jakob ih fapa dang pawl in an farnu an thangsiatter zomi ningna in hriamhmapu mi pawl khal an that suak thluh lawlaw ih khuasungih thilri hmuahhmuah tiangin an lak ṭheh."},"28":{"text":"Tuu siseh, caw siseh, laak siseh, khuasung le lo ih an neihmi tiangin fai koin an lak ṭheh."},"29":{"text":"An sumsaw le an hlawnthil, innsangih khuasaknak thilri hmuahhmuah tiangin an lak ih nunau le nauhak khal an kaih ṭheh."},"30":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob in a fapa Simeon le Levi hnenah, “Harsatnak sungah in thlenter zo; hi ram sungih a ummi Kanaan mi le Periz mi pawl in in hua thlang ding. Kei le milai tampi nei ka si lo. Annih pawl hmun khatah an ṭan ih in do a si ahcun kan zatein kan ci in mit rori ding a si,” ti ah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Asinain annih in, “Kan farnu cu hlawhhlang nunau ah maw an tuah ding?” ti ah an ti."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in Jakob hnenah, “Na tim tuah in Bethel ah feh awla va um aw. Na u Esau hnen ihsin na tlan laiih na hnenih a langmi Pathian hrangah biakṭheng don aw,” ti ah a ti.","title":"Pathian In Bethel Ah Jakob A Thlawsuah"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob in a sungkhat le a hnenih a ummi hmuahhmuah hnenah, “Ram dang khawzing lem nan neihmi hmuahhmuah cu hlon ṭheh thlang uh; thianghlimter-aw uhla hnipuan thiang hruk uh."},"3":{"text":"Hi hmun hin kan suak pei ih Bethel ah kan feh pei. Cutawkah ka thlaphan laiih ka thla i rak ngamtertu le ka vahvaihnak kipih i umpitu Pathian hrangah biakṭheng ka don ding a si,” ti ah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah ram dang khawzing lem an neihmi le an khaih laimi hnakhai pawl an lak ih Jakob hnenah an pek. Jakob in Shekhem khuakiangih a ummi sasua kung hnuai ah cu pawl cu a phumta."},"5":{"text":"Jakob le a fapa pawl cutawk ihsin an suah tikah a kiangkapih khuasungmi pawl cun an khua siksem suakin an ṭih hai ruangah Jakob le a fapa pawl cu zohman in an dungin an dawi ngam lo."},"6":{"text":"An feh vivo ih an milai pawl thawn Kanaan ram Luz khua (Bethel timi khua) an thleng."},"7":{"text":"Cutawkah biakṭheng a don ih a u hnen ihsin a tlan laiih Pathian a hnenih a langnak a si ruangah cu hmun cu Pathian hrangah tiin El-Bethel ti ah hmin a sak."},"8":{"text":"Cun Rebekah umtu Deborah a thi ih Bethel ihsin thlanglam ih a ummi sasua kung hnuai ah an phum. Curuangah acuih thingkung cu, “Allon Bacuth” ti ah an ti."},"9":{"text":"Jakob cu Mesopotamia ram ihsin a kir tikah Pathian cu a hnenah a lang sal ih thluasuah vanluh a pek."},"10":{"text":"A hnenah, “Na hmin cu Jakob a si, sikhalsehla atu thokin Israel na si thlang ding,” ti ah a ti. Curuangah amah cu Israel ti ah kawh a si."},"11":{"text":"Cule Pathian in a hnenah, “Keimah cu Ziangkimtithei Pathian ka si. Faate tampi nei in ci tampi na thlah ding ih a hrekkhat cu siangpahrang tla an si ding. Na tesinfa pawl cu an tamzet ding ih miphun tampi-ah an cang ding."},"12":{"text":"Abraham le Isaak hnenih ka pekmi ram cu nangmah hnenah ka lo pe ding; cule na hnu ih na tesinfa pawl hnen khalah ka pe ding,” ti ah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutiih an biak awknak hmunah cun Jakob cu Pathian in a taanta."},"14":{"text":"Cutawkah Jakob in hngilhlonak lungphun a phun ih in thawinak hrangah sabitti a burh hnuah hriak a toih."},"15":{"text":"Cutawk hmun cu Bethel ti ah hmin a sak."},"16":{"text":"Bethel ihsin an ṭhawn ih Efrath khua an thlen hlan deuhte-ah Rachel cu a nithla a kim ih a nauneih pumnat cu a besia zet.","title":"Rachel A Thi"},"17":{"text":"Culaifang ah nau dongtu in, “Phang hlah aw, mipa a si,” ti ah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Asinain Rachel cu a thi; a thihzik a hnuk a cah zawng ah a fapa cu Ben-oni ti ah hmin a sakta. Asinain a pa in Benjamin ti ah a ko."},"19":{"text":"Rachel cu a thi ih atuih Bethlehem timi Efrath lamzinah an phum."},"20":{"text":"Cule Jakob in a thlaan ah hngilhlonak lung a phun ih, “Rachel lungphun,” ti a si ih cumi cu atu tiangin a um lai."},"21":{"text":"Cun Jakob cu a feh vivo ih Eder lungdawlih ralah riahbuk a sak."},"22":{"text":"Jakob cutawkih a um laiah, a pa ih nupisun Bilhah cu Reuben in a sualpi. Cumi cu a pa Jakob in a theih tikah a thin a heng ngaingai. Jakob cu fapa hleihnih a nei.","title":"Jakob Ih Fapa Pawl (1 San. 2.1-2)"},"23":{"text":"A nupi Leah thawn an hrinmi fapa cu upa bikah Reuben, cun Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakhar le Zebulun an si."},"24":{"text":"Rachel thawn an hrinmi fapa cu Josef le Benjamin an si."},"25":{"text":"Rachel ih salnu Bilhah thawn an hrinmi fapa cu Dan le Naftali an si."},"26":{"text":"Cun Leah ih salnu Zilpah thawn an hrinmi fapa cu Gad le Asher an si. Hi fapa pawl cu Jakob in Mesopotamia ih a hrinmi an si."},"27":{"text":"Abraham le Isaak an umnak Mamre khua ah a pa Isaak hnenah Jakob cu a thleng. (Mamre cu Kiriath Arba a si lole Hebron ti tla in an ko.)","title":"Isaak Thihnak"},"28":{"text":"Isaak cu tarkuun in a nung ih kum za le sawmriat a ti ah a thi."},"29":{"text":"Cule a fapa Esau le Jakob in an phum."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Esau ih tesinfa pawl cu a hnuailam bangtuk in an si. (Esau cu Edom ti tla-in an ko.)","title":"Esau Ih Tesinfa Pawl (1 San. 1.34-37)"},"2":{"text":"Esau cu Kanaan nunau pawl nupi ah a nei. Hit mi Elon ih fanu Adah, Hiv mi Zibeon ih fapa Anah ih fanu Oholibamah, le"},"3":{"text":"Ishmael ih fanu Nebaioth ih farnu Basemath tla an si."},"4":{"text":"Esau ih nupi Adah in Elifas a hring; Basemath in Reuel a hring ih,"},"5":{"text":"Oholibamah in Jeush, Jalam le Korah a nei. Hi pawl cu Esau in Kanaan ramih a neihmi fapa pawl an si."},"6":{"text":"Cun Esau in a nupi pawl, a fanu le a fapa pawl, a sungkhat pawl le a cawrual le Kanaan ram a um sungih a neihmi hmuahhmuah a lak ih a nau Jakob thawn an umtlangnak ihsin a ṭhawn ih hmun dangah a feh."},"7":{"text":"Ziangah a ceer tile Jakob thawn an umnak loram in a daih hai lo ruangah a si. Ṭilva tamtuk an nei ih curuangah hmun khatah an umtlang thei nawn lo."},"8":{"text":"Esau cu a feh ih tlangpar ram Seir ah a um. Esau cu Edom ti a si."},"9":{"text":"Cun Edom miphun ih pa Esau cu tlangpar ram Seir ahcun a um ih tesinfa tampi a nei."},"10":{"text":"Esau ih fapa pawl cu Adah ih hrinmi Elifas le Basemath ih hrinmi Reuel tla an si."},"11":{"text":"Elifas ih fapa panga pawl cu Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam, le Kenas an si."},"12":{"text":"Esau fapa Elifas ih nusun pakhat cu Timna a si ih amah in Amalek a hring. Hi pawl cu Esau nupi Adah ih faate pawl an si."},"13":{"text":"Reuel ih fapa pali pawl cu Nahath, Zerah, Shammah le Mizzah tla an si. Hi pawl cu Esau nupi Basemath ih faate pawl an si."},"14":{"text":"Cule Zibeon ih fapa Anah fanu Esau ih nupi Oholibamah in fapa pathum a neihmi tla cu Jeush, Jalam le Korah an si."},"15":{"text":"Esau ih tesinfa sung ihsin cithlahtu pawl cu hihi an si. Esau ih fapa upa bik Elifas ih fapa pawl cu Teman, Omar, Zefo, Kenas,"},"16":{"text":"Korah, Gatam le Amalek an si. Edom ramih Elifas sungsuak ih cithlahtu pawl cu hihi an si. Anmah tla cu Adah ih tesinfa pawl an si."},"17":{"text":"Esau ih fapa Reuel ih hrinmi fapa, cithlahtu pawl cu Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, le Mizzah tla an si. Edom ramih Reuel sungsuak ih cithlahtu pawl cu anmah hi an si. Anmah tla cu Esau nupi Basemath ih tesinfa pawl an si."},"18":{"text":"Cun Esau nupi Oholibamah ih fapa, cithlahtu pawl cu Jeush, Jalam le Korah tla an si. Anmah cu Anah ih fanu Esau ih nupi Oholibamah ih hrinmi an si."},"19":{"text":"Hi pawl cu Esau ih tesinfa, Edom ih phunhnam tla an si."},"20":{"text":"Hihi Hor miphun Seir ih fapa pawl, a ramih rak um ciami an si. Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,","title":"Seir Ih Tesinfa Pawl (1 San. 1.38-42)"},"21":{"text":"Dishon, Ezer le Dishan tla an si. Annih cu Edom ramih ummi Seir fapa an si ih Hor miphun ih cithlahtu pawl an si."},"22":{"text":"Lotan ih fapa cu Hori le Heman an si. Timna cu Lotan ih farnu a si."},"23":{"text":"Shobal ih fapa pawl cu Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shefo le Onam an si."},"24":{"text":"Zibeon ih fapa pahnih tla cu Aiah le Anah an si. Hi Anah cu a pa Zibeon ih laak pawl a khalh laiah ramcaar lakih cirhti hlum a hmu suaktu kha a si."},"25":{"text":"Anah ih faale pawl cu Dishon le a fanu Oholibamah an si."},"26":{"text":"Dishon ih fapa pawl cu Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran le Kheran an si."},"27":{"text":"Ezer ih fapa pawl cu Bilhan, Zaavan le Akan an si."},"28":{"text":"Dishan ih fapa cu Uz le Aran an si."},"29":{"text":"Cun Hor miphun ih cithlahtu pawl cu Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,"},"30":{"text":"Dishon, Ezer le Dishan tla an si. Anmah cu Seir ramah Hor miphun pawl ih cithlahtu an si."},"31":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang pawl in an uk hlanih Edom ram a uktu siangpahrang pawl cu hihi an si.","title":"Edom Ram Ih Siangpahrang Pawl (1 San. 1.43-54)"},"32":{"text":"Beor fapa Bela in Edom ram a uk ih a khawpi hmin cu Dinhabah a si."},"33":{"text":"Bela cu a thi ih a ai ah Bozrah khuami Zerah ih fapa Jobab in Edom ram cu a run uk."},"34":{"text":"Jobab a thi ih a ai ah Teman miphun pawl ih ram sungih ummi Husham in a uk."},"35":{"text":"Husham cu a thi ih a ai ah, Moab ramih Median mi a nehtu Bedad ih fapa Hadad in a uk. A khawpi hmin cu Avith a si."},"36":{"text":"Hadad cu a thi ih a ai ah Masrekah khua ih Samlah in a uk."},"37":{"text":"Samlah cu a thi ih a ai ah Eufrates tiva kap Rehoboth khuami Shaul in a uk."},"38":{"text":"Shaul cu a thi ih a ai ah Akbor ih fapa Baal Hanan in a uk."},"39":{"text":"Cun Akbor ih fapa Baal Hanan cu a thi ih a ai ah Hadad in a uk. A khawpi hmin cu Pau a si. A nupi hmin cu Mehetabel a si ih Matred ih fanu a si. Matred cu Mezahab ih fanu a si."},"40":{"text":"Hi pawl cu an hnam le an umnak khua ciarih lal an si ih Esau ih tesinfa pawl an si: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,"},"41":{"text":"Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,"},"42":{"text":"Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,"},"43":{"text":"Magdiel le Iram an si. Anmah tla cu an umnak ciarah ram neitu le lal an si ih Edom ram sungah hotu an si. Edom miphun ih pa cu Esau a si."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob cu a pa umnak Kanaan ramah a umta.","title":"Josef Le A Unau Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Jakob ih innsang thuanthu cu hi vekin a si. Josef cu tlangval no kum hleisarih a si ih a pa ih nusun Bilhah le Zilpah ih fapa pawl, a ule pawl hnenah tuu le me a khal ve ṭheu. A ule pawl ih thiltuah sualmi pawl cu a pa a sim ṭheu."},"3":{"text":"Josef cu a pa Jakob in a tar hnu ih a neihmi a si ruangah a fapa dang hnakin a duh cuang. Curuangah angki saupi baanfual a ṭhit sak."},"4":{"text":"Cutiih an pa in Josef a duh deuh cu a ule pawl in an hmuh tikah Josef cu an hua ih awkaa ṭha-in an biak hrimhrim dah lo."},"5":{"text":"Voikhat ah Josef cu mang a man ih a mang cu a ule hnenah a sim. A mang a sim tikah a ule cun an hua sinsin."},"6":{"text":"An hnenah, “Ka mang cu ngaihnik uh."},"7":{"text":"Ka mangah lo ah kan zatein kan feh ih sangvut kan teel ciamco; cutikah ka sangvut teel cu a tho ih dingzetin a ding. Cule nan sangvut teel pawl cu ka sangvut teel ih kimvelah an ding ih an kuun,” ti ah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah a u le pawl cun, “Kan tlunah siangpahrang si dingin le thunei dingah na ruat-aw maw si?” ti ah an sut. Cun a mang a sim ruangah a ule pawl cun an huat a luar sinsin."},"9":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Josef cun mang a man lala ih a u le hnenah, “Mang ka man ih ka mangah ni le thlapi le arsi hleikhat cu ka hmaiah an kuun ka hmu,” ti ah a sim."},"10":{"text":"A mang cu a pa le a ule hnenah a sim ih a pa in, “Ziangvek mang ngelcel so na man? Na nu le na unau pawl le keimah tiangin na hmaiah ra in kan kuun ding maw si?” ti ah a kawk ciamco."},"11":{"text":"A u le pawl cun an nahsiik ngaingai. Asinain a pa cun acuih thuhla pawl cu a thinlungte-ah a ret ringring."},"12":{"text":"Cun Josef ule pawl cu an pa ih ṭilva khal dingah Shekhem ah an feh.","title":"Izipt Ah Josef An Zuar"},"13":{"text":"Cule a pa Jakob in Josef hnenah, “Na ule pawl cu Shekhem ah ka ṭilva an khal. Na tim tuah awla an hnenah ka lo thlah ding,” ti ah a ti. Josef cun, “Ka tim aw thluh zo,” ti ah a ti."},"14":{"text":"A pa in a hnenah, “Va feh awla na ule pawl le ṭilva pawl an himdam maw va zoh aw. Ra kir sal awla an thuhla i ra sim sal aw,” ti ah a ti. Cuhrangah a pa in Josef cu Hebron phairawn ihsin a hei tirh. Cutiin Josef cu Shekhem a thlen tikah,"},"15":{"text":"mipa pakhat in hramlakih a vah rero kha a hmu. “Ziang so na hawl rero?” ti ah Josef cu a sut."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in, “Ka ule pawl ka hawl a si; ṭilva khuitawkah so an khalh, i sim hram aw,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cupa cun, “Hi tawkah an um nawn lo. Dothan ah kan feh ding an ti cu ka theita,” ti ah a ti. Curuangah Josef cu Dothan ah a feh ih a ule pawl hnenah a va thleng."},"18":{"text":"A ule pawl in an hnen a ra thlen hlan a hlatpi in an rak hmu. Cuvete in thusia an ruatkhawm ih amah that dingin thu an phiar."},"19":{"text":"“Mang man pa a ra."},"20":{"text":"Rahnik uh, kan that pei ih a ruak cu hi tikhur caar pakhatkhatah kan hlon pei. Sahrang in a deh a si kan ti leh ding. Cule a mang pawl ziangtin a cang kan zohhnik pei,” ti ah pakhat le pakhat an ti aw."},"21":{"text":"Cutiin an ti cu Reuben in a thei ih Josef cu hum a tum. Reuben in, “A thah lawmmam cu that hlah uhsi."},"22":{"text":"Josef cu that hram hlah uh. Hi ramṭhing lakih tikhur caar sungah hin thla uh. Asinain amah cu tuahmawh hlah uh,” ti ah a ti. Himtein a humsuak a si ahcun a pa hnenih kuat kir leh dingin Reuben ih tummi a si."},"23":{"text":"Josef cu a ule hnen a thlen ngaingai tikah a angkifual baansau cu an hlit."},"24":{"text":"An kaihrem ih tikhur caar sungah an thlak."},"25":{"text":"Rawl an ei laiah khualtlawng mi ruunkhat Ishmael mi pawl Gilead ihsin Izipt ram pan ih an feh kha rin lopi-ah an hmu. An kalauk pawl cun pazuksi, thingthling le masala pawl an phur."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Judah in a unau pawl hnenah, “Kan naupa kan thah ih laithat kan sinak cu kan thup khalle kan hrangah ziangso a ṭhahnem?"},"27":{"text":"Hi Ishmael mi pawl hnenah kan zuar sawn pei. Cutiih kan zuar asile amah kan tuahmawh a ṭul lem lo; thu ngai ih kan ti asile kan nau a si ih kan thii le kan sa a si,” ti ah a ti. Cutiih a timi cu a unau dang pawl khal an lung a kim."},"28":{"text":"Cun Midian mi sumtuah pawl an ra thlen tikah tikhur sung ihsin Josef cu an suah ih Ishmael mi hnenah ngun tangka kul ah an zuar. Cuticun Ishmael mi in Josef cu Izipt ramah an hruai."},"29":{"text":"Cun Reuben in tikhur sung cu a zoh ih Josef a hmuh lo tikah a ning a hang ih a riahsiatnak langter dingah a hnipuan a thlek thluh."},"30":{"text":"Cule a unau hnenah a kir ih, “Kan naupa tikhur sungah a um nawn lo. Ziangtin so kan ti ding?” ti ah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cun a unau pawl cun me an that ih Josef ih korfualpi cu me thisen sungah an hnim."},"32":{"text":"Cule korfualpi cu an pa ih hnenah an keng ih, “Hihi kan hmu, na fapa ta a si maw, zohhnik?” ti ah an ti."},"33":{"text":"Cutikah an pa in Josef ih korfualpi a si kha a thei lohli ih, “A si, amah ih ta a si!
