Sahrang in maw a deh zo! Josef cu thlekbauh thluh zo a si cu!” ti ah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Jakob cu a hnipuan a thlek ih a riahsiatnak langter dingah buri a hruk ih reipi mithi ngai in a um cuahco."},"35":{"text":"A fapa le a fanu pawl an ra ih an ra hneem rero; asinain an hneem thei cuang lo. “Amah hnen mithi khua ih ka thlen ve lai hlan lo, ka fapa ngai in ka um ding,” ti ah a ti. Curuangah a fapa Josef ngai in nitin a ṭap."},"36":{"text":"Cule Josef cu Midian mi pawl in Izipt ramah an fehpi ih Izipt siangpahrang ih inn kiltu ralbawipa Potifar hnenah an zuar."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih caanah Judah cun a unau pawl a taanta ih Adullam khuami Hirah hnenah a vung um.","title":"Judah Le Tamar"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkah Kanaan mipa Shua ih fanu a hmu ih a nupi ah a ṭhit."},"3":{"text":"A nupi cu fa a vun ih fapa a hring ih a hminah Er a sak."},"4":{"text":"A nupi cu fa a vun sal ih fapa a hring lala ih a hminah Onan a sak."},"5":{"text":"A nupi in fapa a hring lala ih a hminah Shelah a sak. A nupi ih Shelah a hrin laiah Judah cu Khezib khua ah a um."},"6":{"text":"Cun Judah in a fapa upa bik Er cu nupi a holh ih a nupi hmin cu Tamar a si."},"7":{"text":"Asinain Er cu Bawipa hmaiah misiava a si ruangah Bawipa in a nunnak a cemter."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Judah in Onan hnenah, “Na u-ih nupi cu ihpi awla na u in tesinfa a neih theinak dingah a pasal ih unau na si bangtuk in na ṭuanvo cu kimter aw,” ti ah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Asinain faate a neih khalle amah ih tefa an si lo ding ti kha Onan in a thei. Curuangah a u-ih nupi thawn an pawl-awk tinin a u-ih hrangah faate seem thei lo dingin a ci cu leilungah a tlakter."},"10":{"text":"A nuncan cu Bawipa ih lungkimmi a si lo hrangah Bawipa in a nunnak a cemter ve."},"11":{"text":"Cule Judah in a fapa ih nupi Tamar hnenah, “Ka fapa Shelah a ṭhan ih tlangval a si hlan cu na pa ih inn ah va kir hrih awla nuhmei in va um hrih aw,” ti ah a ti. Hitiih a tinak cu a ule pahnih an thih vekin Shelah khal a thi ve pang ding ti a phan ruangah a si. Curuangah Tamar cu a pa ih inn ah a kir."},"12":{"text":"Caan a hung rei deuh tikah Shua ih fanu, Judah ih nupi cu a thi. A mithi ngai a reh tikah a tuurual pawl ih hmul an mehnak Timnah khua ah a rualpi Adullam khuami Hirah thawn an feh."},"13":{"text":"Cule Tamar hnenah, “Na pasal ih pa cu a tuu pawl hmulmet dingah Timnah ah a feh a si,” ti ah mi in an sim."},"14":{"text":"Cuhrangah a hruk ringringmi nuhmei hnipuan cu a phoih ih hmaihuhnak puanpaate in a hmai a hup ih, Timnah lamzinih a ummi Enaim khuasung luhnak ah a to. Shelah cu a tlangval zo naón amah cu Shelah hrangah ṭhit an tum lo ti kha Tamar in a thei."},"15":{"text":"Judah in Tamar cu a hmu ih a hmai a huh awk ruangah hlawhhlang a si ti ah a ruat."},"16":{"text":"A hnenah lamzin kapah a va feh ih, “Ra awla kan ittlang ding,” ti ah a ti. A fapa ih nupi a si kha a thei lo. Cutikah Tamar in, “Ziang so i pek ding?” ti ah a sut."},"17":{"text":"Judah in, “Ka ṭilva sung ihsin me note pakhat ka lo kuat ding,” ti ah a ti. Tamar in, “Na run kuat hlan tiang thutiamkamnak i pekta a si ahcun na sim vekin si ko seh,” ti ah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Judah in, “Ziang so thutiamkamnak ah ka lo pek ding?” ti ah a suh tikah, Tamar in, “Na hminkhennak le a hridai le atuih na kenmi na kianghrol i pe aw,” ti ah a ti. A ti vekin a pek. Cun an pawl-aw ih Tamar cu fa a vun."},"19":{"text":"Tamar cu a tho ih inn ah a feh. A hmaihuhnak puan cu a phoih ih a nuhmei hnipuan a hruk sal."},"20":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Judah cun a thutiamkamnak thil va tlen sal dingah Adullam khuami a rualpipa cu me note pakhat thawn Tamar hnenah a hei tirh; asinain Tamar cu a va hmu nawn lo."},"21":{"text":"A kiangkapih mi pawl cu, “Enaim lamzin kiangih a ummi hlawhhlangnu kha khuiah so a si?” ti ah a suh tikah annih in, “Cutawkah hlawhhlangnu a um dah lo,” an ti."},"22":{"text":"Cuhrangah Judah hnenah a kir ih, “Nunau nu ka tong lo; a kiangkap mi pawl in, ‘Cutawkah hlawhhlangnu a um dah lo,’ an ti,” ti ah a sim."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Judah in, “A hnenih ka thilri pawl cu lak sal tum nawn hlah; mual kan pho pang ding. Na va tong thei lo naón me note ka kuat ngaingai cu a tawk zo,” ti ah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Thla thum hnuah Judah cu, “Na fapa ih nupi Tamar cu hlawhhlang a ṭuan ih midang thawn fasawn a vun zo,” ti ah mi in an sim. Cutikah Judah in, “Khawsung ihsin suah uhla mei in ur that uh,” ti ah thu a pek."},"25":{"text":"Tamar cu an suah ih an hruai laiah a pasal ih pa Judah hnenah thu a cah ih, “Hi thilri a neitupa ih fa ka vun a si; hi thilri hi zo ih ta so a si, zohhnik uh; hminkhennak le a hridai le kianghrol an si hi,” ti ah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cumi cu Judah in a theih tikah, “Hi nu hi midik a si ih keimah sawn misual ka si. Ka fapa Shelah hrangah ṭhi zo ding ka rak si naón,” ti ah a ti. Cuih hnu cun Tamar cu a ihpi nawn lo."},"27":{"text":"Cun a nithla a kim tikah faphir a ken kha an thei."},"28":{"text":"A pum a na ih culaiah a fa pakhat in a kut pakhat a run suah. Cutikah nau dongtu in a ngel ah pat hrisen a rak khih ih, “Hihi suak hmasa a si,” ti ah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Asinain a kut cu a dirhsal ih a dang pakhat sawn hmaisa-ah a suak. Cutikah nau dongtu in, “Nangmah riangri maw a rung suak hmaisa,” ti ah a ti. Cuhrangah a hmin ah Perez an sak."},"30":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a unau a suak ih a kutih patsen khihmi a si. A hmin ah Zerah an sak."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josef cu Ishmael mi pawl in Izipt ram an thlenpi ih Izipt siangpahrang ih inn kiltu bawi Izipt mi Potifar hnenah an zuar.","title":"Josef Le Potifar Ih Nupi"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu Josef hnenah a um ih a hrangah ziang hmuahhmuah a tluang thluh. Josef cu Izipt mi a bawipa ih inn ah a um."},"3":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian cu Josef hnenah a um ih a thil tuahmi hmuahhmuahah a hlawhtling ti cu a bawipa in a hmu."},"4":{"text":"Josef ih ziaza Potifar in a zoh tikah a lung a kim ngaingai ih a innsungsang le a neihmi hmuahhmuah kilkhawitu-ah a tuah."},"5":{"text":"A cuih thok ihsin Josef ruangah Izipt mi pa ih inn cu Pathian in thluasuah a pek. A inn sungih a neihmi le a lo sungih a ummi tla Bawipa in a thluasuah a si."},"6":{"text":"Potifar in a neihmi hmuahhmuah cu Josef kutah a ret ṭheh ih a eimi rawl siar lo zianghman a ruah ṭulmi a um lo. Josef cu a ruangrai a ṭhazet ih a piangzet fawn."},"7":{"text":"Caan a rei deuh tikah a bawipa ih nupi in Josef cu sualpi duhnak mit in a zoh ringring. Voikhat ah a bawipa ih nupi in, “Ka hnenah ra it aw,” ti ah Josef cu a leem."},"8":{"text":"Asinain Josef cun a el ih a hnenah, “Keimah hitawk ih ka um ruangah ka bawipa in hi innsungsang thuhla pawl zianghman a helhkam ṭul loin a um. A neihmi hmuahhmuah kilkhawitu-ah i tuah a si."},"9":{"text":"Hi innsungah amah tlukin thu ka nei ih a nupi nangmah siar lo a dang zianghman ka hrangah uimi a nei lo. Cuti a si hrangah ziangtinso cutluk thilsia ka tuah ding ih Pathian hmaiah ka sual ding?” ti ah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Josef cu a bawipa ih nupi in nitinte a leem rero naón a thu a ngai dah lo ih voikhatte hman a ihpi dah lo."},"11":{"text":"Asinain ni khatah Josef cu innsung hnaṭuan ṭuan dingah a lut ih midang zohman inn sungah an um lo."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah a bawinu cun Josef cu a angki in a kai ih, “Ka hnenah it aw,” ti ah a ti. Asinain Josef cu lengah a tlansuak ih a angki cu a bawinu ih kutah a taangta."},"13":{"text":"Josef in a angki a taanta ih innsung ihsin a tlanhlo ti a hmuh tikah,"},"14":{"text":"a bawinu cun a innsangih hnenum pawl a ko ih, “Zohhnik uh; ka pasal in hi Hebru pa hi kan innsangah a rak hruai; asinain atu-ah in hmuhsuam a si. Ka khaan sungah a rung lut ih amah thawn ittlang dingah i sawm; asinain ka au ciamco."},"15":{"text":"Cutiih ka au ruangah ka kiangah a kor taanta in a tlan ih lengah a suak a si,” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Josef ih bawipa a thlen hlan lo a kor cu amah hnenah a ret ringring."},"17":{"text":"A pasal a thlen tikah cuih thu cu a sim. “Hebru salpa na hruai mi pa kha i hmuhsuam tum in ka khaan sungah a lut."},"18":{"text":"Asinain ka au ruangah a tlanhlo ih a kor lawng ka kiangah a taanta,” ti ah a rak ti."},"19":{"text":"Josef ih bawipa cu a nupi in, “Na salpa in hiti in i tuah a si,” tiih a rak sim tikah a thin a heng ngaingai ih,"},"20":{"text":"Josef cu a kai ih siangpahrang ih thawngtla pawl an retnak thawnginn ah a ret. Cutawkah Josef cu thawng sungah a um."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa Pathian cu Josef hnenah a um ih a zaangfah hrangah thawnginn uktu bawipa khal Josef parah zaangfahnak thinlung a neihter."},"22":{"text":"Curuangah thawngtla pawl kilkhawitu-ah Josef cu a tuah ih thawnginn sungih thil a cangmi hmuahhmuah zohtu-ah a ret."},"23":{"text":"Josef ih ṭuanvo lakmi pohpoh cu thawnginn uktu pa ih zohsal a ṭul nawn hrimhrim lo. Ziangahtile Bawipa Pathian cu Josef hnenah a um ih a thil tuahmi hmuahhmuahah hlawh a tlinter."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Caan a hung rei deuh tikah Izipt siangpahrang ih sabitti petu le sangtuah hotu in an bawipa cu a thin an hengter.","title":"Josef In Thawngtla Mang A Let"},"2":{"text":"Faro cu a hnaṭuantu pahnih parah a thin a heng ngaingai ih,"},"3":{"text":"Josef an retnak hmun, siangpahrang inn kiltu bawipa ih innah thawngah a thlak hai."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn kiltu bawi in Josef cu cuih thawngtla pahnihte hnenah a ret ih an hna a ṭuanter. Cutiin thawng sungah caan reipi an umtlang."},"5":{"text":"Zan khatah thawnginn ah Izipt siangpahrang ih sabitti petu le sangtuah hotu an pahnih in sullam neimi mang an man veve."},"6":{"text":"Zingpit ah Josef cu an hnenah a va feh ih an thinlung nuamlozet ih an um ngiongio kha a hmu."},"7":{"text":"Josef in, “Zianghrangah tuih sun hi nan riah a siazet cuang?” ti ah a suh tikah,"},"8":{"text":"annih in, “Mang kan man veve ih kan mang in leh saktu hitawk ah zohman an um lo,” ti ah an ti. Cutikah Josef in, “Mang leh theinak cu Pathian ih pekmi a si. Nan mang cu i sim hnik uh,” ti ah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah sabitti petu in a mang cu a sim ih, “Ka mangah sabit hri pakhat ka hmaiah ka hmu ih,"},"10":{"text":"hnge pathum a nei. Sabit hnge pawl cu an cerh ih an cerhvete in a par an par ih a rah pawl tla an hmin."},"11":{"text":"Faro ih hai ka keng ih sabit rah pawl cu ka lo ih hai sungah ka sawr. Cule Faro hnenah ka pek,” ti ah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in, “Atican cu hiti in a si: A hnge pathum cu ni thum a si."},"13":{"text":"Nithum sungah Faro in a lo thlah ding; a lo ngaithiam ding ih na hnaṭuanmi na ṭuan sal ding. Sabitti petu na rak si bangin sabit hai cu Faro hnenah na pe sal ding."},"14":{"text":"Cutiih na lamzin a tluan ṭheh tikah hi thawnginn ihsin i suah theinak dingah i hngilh hlah awla ka thuhla cu Faro hnenah rak sim hram aw."},"15":{"text":"Thungai in kan ti asile, Hebru mi pawl ih ram ihsin rukmi ka si. Hitawk khalah thawng in thlak theinak dingah zianghman tuah sualmi ka nei lo,” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Josef ih mang a lehmi cu thuṭha lam a si kha sangtuah hotupa in a hmuh tikah, “Kei khal mang ka nei ve; ka mangah ka lu parah sang kho thum an um ih,"},"17":{"text":"a tlunta bikih kho sungah Faro hrangih sang rawh mi a phunphun an um. Asinain cuih rawl pawl cu vate in an ei ciamco,” ti ah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in, “Atican cu hiti in a si: Kho pathum cu ni thum a si."},"19":{"text":"Nithum ah Faro in a lo suah ding ih na lu a lo tan ding. Na ruak cu thingkung parah a thlai ding ih vate in na sa cu an ei ciamco ding,” ti ah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cuvek ngaingai in ni thumnak ni, Faro suah camah, Faro in a kuthnuai-ih bawi pawl hmuahhmuah hrangah puai a tuah ih sabitti petupa le a sangtuah hotupa cu thawnginn ihsin a suah ih a bawi pawl hmaiah an rak hruai."},"21":{"text":"Sabitti petupa cu a hlanih a ṭuanmi hna a ṭuanter sal."},"22":{"text":"Asinain sangtuah hotupa cu a hngawng in a thlai ih a thi. Josef ih lehsakmi vek cekci in an mangih tican cu a kim ṭheh."},"23":{"text":"Asinain sabitti petupa in Josef cu thei nawn loin a hngilhta."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum hnih a kim hnuah Faro in mang a man ih a mangah cun Nail tivapi kapah a ding ih,","title":"Josef In Faro Ih Mang A Let"},"2":{"text":"tiva sung ihsin cawpi a thauzetmi le mawizetmi pasarih an hung suak ih hrampi note an hung ei hmuarhmo kha a hmu."},"3":{"text":"Cuih hnuah cawpi dang pasarih, a ṭawl ṭenṭen le a mawi lozet, tiva sung ihsin an hung suak ih a hmaisa cawpi thau pasarih kiangah tiva kapah an hung ding."},"4":{"text":"Cule cawpi ṭawl pasarih pawl in cawpi thau pasarih pawl cu an ei ṭheh. Cun Faro cu a ṭhang."},"5":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a itthat sal ih mang a man sal. A mangah fangcang kung pakhat ihsin a bor ṭhazet le ah a cuzet mi fangvui pasarih an suak."},"6":{"text":"Cun nelrawn thli ih nuai siat reprepmi le a hivai sialsialmi fangvui pasarih an suak ve."},"7":{"text":"Cule a siazetmi fangvui in a borzetmi fangvui pasarih cu an dolh ṭheh. Cun Faro cu a hung ṭhang ih a mang a si kha a thei."},"8":{"text":"A thaizing cu a lung a nuam lo ngaingai ih Izipt ram sungih pol pawl le mifim hmuahhmuah a ko ṭheh. A mang cu a sim ṭheh hai naón a simfiang theitu zohman an um lo."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah sabitti petupa in Faro hnenah, “Bawipa, ka mawh zia cu tuih sunah ka phuang ding."},"10":{"text":"Na hnaṭuantu pawl ih tlunah na thin a heng ih sangtuah hotupa le kei cu siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl hotu bawi ih inn ah thawng in thlak."},"11":{"text":"Zan khatah kan pahnih in mang kan man. Kan mang cu sullam nei veve an si."},"12":{"text":"Culai ah Hebru tlangval pakhat siangpahrang inn kiltu bawi ih hnenum pa cu kan hnenah a um ve ih kan mang pawl cu amah kan sim. Kan mang cu in lehsak ih a sullam in sim."},"13":{"text":"Cule a sim vek rori in a kim ṭheh; kei in ka hnaṭuan ka ṭuan sal ih sangtuah hotupa cu na that a si,” ti ah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in Josef cu a ko ih zamrangte in thawnginn ihsin a suah. Josef cu a meetfai-aw ih a hnipuan a thleng-awk hnuah Faro hmai ah a ra."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in, “Mang ka nei ih zohman in an let thei lo. Nang cu mang an lo simmi fiangtein na let thei ti in sim,” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Josef in, “Kei ih ti theimi a si lo; Pathian lawngin fiangtein a lo sim thei ding,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in, “Ka mangah Nail tiva kapah ka ding ih,"},"18":{"text":"tiva sung ihsin cawpi thauzet le mawizet pasarih an hung suak ih hrampi note an hung ei hmuarhmo."},"19":{"text":"Cuih hnuah cawpi dang pasarih, a ṭawl ṭenṭenzet ih ruh lawng a taangmi, tifiamfiam in an hung suak. Izipt ram pumpi sungah cuvek cawpi ṭawnṭai ka hmu dah lo."},"20":{"text":"Cule cawpi ṭawl pawl in cawpi thau pawl cu an ei ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an ei ṭheh hnu khalah zohman in cawpi thau pasarih an ei ti ah an thei thei lo ding; a hlan vekin an ṭawl ṭenṭen thotho. Cutikah ka hung ṭhang."},"22":{"text":"Cun mang ka man lala ih ka mangah fangcang kung pakhat ihsin fangvui pasarih, a borzetmi le a cuzetmi an suak."},"23":{"text":"Cuih hnuah nelrawn thli ih nuaisiat reprepmi, hivai sialsialin fangvui pasarih an hung suak."},"24":{"text":"Cule fangvui siazet pawl in fangvui ṭhazet pasarih pawl cu an dolh ṭheh. Ka mang cu pol ka sim hai naón i lehsak theitu pakhat hman an um lo,” ti ah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in Faro hnenah, “Na mang pahnih ih sullam cu an bangrep a si. Pathian in a tuah tummi a lo theihternak a si."},"26":{"text":"Cawpi thau pasarih cu kum sarih a si ih fangvui ṭhazet pasarih khal cu kum sarih thotho a si. An sullam cu thuhmunkhat a si."},"27":{"text":"Neta-ih a hung suakmi cawpi ṭawl pasarih le nelrawn thli ih nuaisiatmi le a hivai sialsialmi fangvui pasarih cu paam kum kum sarih a si."},"28":{"text":"Ka lo sim zo vekin Pathian in a tuah dingmi a lo hmuhnak a si."},"29":{"text":"Izipt ram sung hmuahhmuah ah paṭhat ngaingai kum kum sarih a um ding."},"30":{"text":"Cuih hnuah paam kum kum sarih a tlung ding ih Izipt ram sungih paṭhat kum hmuahhmuah cu hngilh thluh a si ding. Paam ruangah Izipt ram cu a siat thluh ding."},"31":{"text":"Paṭhat caan cu zohman in an ciing nawn lo ding. Ziangahtile neta-ih a tlung dingmi paam caan cu a nasa ngaingai ding."},"32":{"text":"Na mang voihnih rori na mannak cu Pathian in hi thu cu a nemhnget zo ih rei lote-ah a thleng ding tinak a si."},"33":{"text":"Cu a si hrangah atu-ah mi pakhat, khuaruatthiam le mifim hril awla, Izipt ram pumpi ṭuanvo latu dingah ret aw."},"34":{"text":"Ram sungih hnaṭuantu dingah hotu pawl tla ret awla, paṭhat kum kum sarih sungih neihmi rawl sung ihsin ṭhen nga-ih ṭhen khat khawlter aw."},"35":{"text":"Hi rawl hmuahhmuah cu a ra dingmi paṭhat kum sungah khawm ṭheh hai seh. Nangmah ih thu in hna an ṭuan pei ih khawpi kipah rawl cu an khawl pei ih an kil pei."},"36":{"text":"Hi rawl pawl cu paam kum kum sarih a ra thlen tikah Izipt ram sung minung pawl an thih ṭheh lonak dingah khawl ciami rawl a si ding,” ti ah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Josef ih thusimmi cu Faro le a tlangsuak pawl an lung a kim tuk lawmmam ih,","title":"Josef Cu Izipt Ram Uktu Ah A Cang"},"38":{"text":"Faro in, “Hi pa vekin Pathian thlarau-ih umpimi midang khui-ah so kan hmuh ding,” ti ah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Cule Faro in Josef hnenah, “Pathian in hi thil hmuahhmuah hi a lo hmuh hrangah nangmah hnakin thil a theithiam sawn le a fim sawn zohman an um lo."},"40":{"text":"Curuangah nangmah hi ka ram zohtu-ah ka lo tuah pei ih ka minung pawl in na thu an lo ngai ding. Siangpahrang ka sinak lawng hi ka lo hleihnak a si ding."},"41":{"text":"Atu ihsin Izipt ram pumpi uktu bawi ah ka lo tuah a si,” ti ah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Cuṭheh in Faro in siangpahrang hmin khenmi zunghruk cu a phoih ih Josef ih zungah a hrukter; a mawi le a mankhungmi hnipuan in a thuam ih suiṭhi a hngawng ah a orhter."},"43":{"text":"Siangpahrang tonak sangtu rangleng ah a toter ih amah kiltu ralkap pawl in a hmai ihsin, “Nan lu kun uh,” ti ah an au hluarhlo. Cuticun Izipt ram pumpi uktu bawi ah Josef cu a cang a si."},"44":{"text":"Cun Faro in Josef hnenah, “Keimah cu siangpahrang ka si; asinain nangmah ih thu loin Izipt ram sungah zohman an kutke an caangkhai thei lo ding,” ti ah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Cule Josef cu Zafenath Paneah ti ah Izipt hmin a sak. Heliopolis khua ih puithiam Potifera ih fanu Asenath cu nupi ah a ṭhitsak."},"46":{"text":"Josef cu Izipt siangpahrang Faro ih hnaṭuan a thawh tikah kum sawmthum a si. A feh ih Izipt ram a kiil le a deng tiangin a tlawng."},"47":{"text":"Paṭhat kum kum sarih sungah rawl cu ei cawk loin an nei."},"48":{"text":"Paṭhat kum kum sarih sung rawl tamzet an neih sung hmuahhmuah Josef in Izipt ram sungih rawl cu a khawm ciamco ih khawpiih kipah a khawl. Khua kiangkapih lo rawl pawl cu a cuih khawsungah a khawl."},"49":{"text":"Rawl a khawlmi cu a tam ngaingai ih tifinriat ih vunnel a bang. A rawl khawlmi cu a tamtuk thlang hrangah a tah khal an tah nawn lo; ziangahtile tah cawk ding a si lo."},"50":{"text":"Paam kum a thlen hlanah Josef cu, Heliopolis khua puithiam Potifera ih fanu, a nupi Asenath in fapa pahnih a hrin."},"51":{"text":"Josef in, “Ka zonzaihnak hmuahhmuah le ka pa ih innsang thu khal Pathian in i hngilhter zo,” ti ah a ti ih a fapa hmaisa cu Manasseh ti ah hmin a sak."},"52":{"text":"Cun, “Harsat ka tonak ram ah Pathian in faate i pek,” a ti ih a fapa pahnihnak hminah Efraim a sak."},"53":{"text":"Izipt ram sungih paṭhat kum kum sarih cu a rung cem ih,"},"54":{"text":"Josef ih a rak sim cia bangtuk in paam kum cu a rung thleng ngaingai. Izipt ram lawng si loin ram dang hmuahhmuah khalah paam a tlung ve; asinain Izipt ram sungah cun khuazakipah rawl a um."},"55":{"text":"Izipt ram sung hmuahhmuahih paam a thlen tikah ram sung minung pawl in Faro hnenah rawl an dil. Cutikah Faro in, “Josef hnenah feh uhla a lo sim vekin tuah uh,” ti ah a ti."},"56":{"text":"Izipt ram sungah paam cu a nasazet ih ram sungmi pawl rilrawng ih an um tikah Josef in rawl retnak innpi pawl cu a ong ih rawl cu Izipt mi hnenah a zorh ciamco hai."},"57":{"text":"Leilung tlun hmuahhmuahah paam cu nasazet ih a tlun ve ruangah mi hmuahhmuah cu pursum dingin Izipt ramah Josef hnenah an ra ciamco."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob in Izipt ramah rawl a um ti a theih tikah a fapa pawl hnenah, “Ziangah so hiti ih nan um men?","title":"Josef Ih Unau Tla Izipt Ah An Ra"},"2":{"text":"Izipt ramah rawl a um ti ka thei. Rawl loih kan thih thluh lonak dingah vung feh uhla rawl vung lei uh,” ti ah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cubangin Josef ih unau pawl pahra cu Izipt ramah rawl lei dingah an feh."},"4":{"text":"Asinain Jakob cun Josef thawn nukhat hrin a si mi Benjamin cu a fehter lo. Ziangahtile tuahmawh a tong pang ding ti a phang."},"5":{"text":"Kanaan ram sungih paam a tlun ve ruangah mi dang vekin Jakob fapa pawl cu rawl lei dingah an feh."},"6":{"text":"Josef cu Izipt ram uktu bawi a si hrangah ramkip ihsin a rami mikip hnenah rawl a zuar. Cuhrangah Josef ih ule pawl khal Josef hmaiah an ra ih upatnak in an hmai leilung dai in an kun."},"7":{"text":"Josef in a hmuh tikah a ule an si kha a thei naón a thei lo vekin a umter-aw. Ṭonghrang zetin an hnenah, “Khuilaminso nan rat?” ti ah a sut. Annih in, “Rawl lei dingah Kanaan ram in kan ra,” ti ah an sawn."},"8":{"text":"Josef cun a ule an si ti a thei naón annih cun an thei lo."},"9":{"text":"A mangih anmah ih thuhla a rak man tla a vun cing ih, “Nannih cu mi thlingthlatu nan si. Kan ramih ṭonṭaihnak zawn theih duh ah nan ra a si,” ti ah a ti hai."},"10":{"text":"Asinain annih cun, “Bawipa, kan si hrimhrim lo. Kannih na sal le pawl hi rawl lei ding lawngih ra kan si."},"11":{"text":"Kan zatein unau rual kan si. Bawipa, mi dik kan si ko; mi thlingthlatu kan si hrimhrim lo,” ti ah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Josef cun, “Asilo, kan ram derdainak thlingthlak duh ah nan ra a si ko,” a ti thotho."},"13":{"text":"Cule annih in, “Bawipa, kan zate cun unau hleihnih kan si ih Kanaan ramih um mi pakhat ih fapa kan si. Kan nau nauta bik cu atu-ah kan pa hnenah inn ah a um ih kan unau pakhat cu a thi zo,” ti ah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in, “Ka ti zo vekin nannih cu mi thlingthlatu nan si ko."},"15":{"text":"Nan si le si lo fianternak ah hiti in ka lo hniksak ding: Faro hmin in ka lo kam; nan nau nauta bik hitawk a rat lo ahcun nan tlung thei lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Nanmah lak ihsin pakhatkhat in va hruai uh. Nan thu a fiang hlan lo a dang pawl cu thawngah ka lo thla ding. Cuti a si lole Faro hmin saal in ka sim: nannih cu thlingthlatu nan si tengteng,” ti ah a ti hai."},"17":{"text":"Cuticun an unauza in ni thum sung thawngah a thlak hai."},"18":{"text":"A ni thumnak ni ah Josef in, “Pathian hmai ka zah ruangah hiti ih nan tuah asile thihnak in nan luat ding."},"19":{"text":"Mi dik nan si ngaingai ahcun atu nan umnak thawnginn ah pakhat cu nan taangta pei ih midang cu rilrawng in a ummi nan innsang hnenah nan leimi nan rawl thawn nan va tlung pei."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nan simmi a dik le dik lo theihnak ah nan nau nauta bik ka hnenah nan rak hruai tengteng pei. Cuti nan tuah asile nan thi lo ding,” ti ah a ti. Cumi cu an unauza an lung a kimtlang."},"21":{"text":"Anmah le anmah cu, “Kan naupa Josef, kha tiih kan rak ti kha kan mawh ngaingai a si. Harsatnak a tuar lai kan hmu ko ih i zaangfah hram uh ti ah in leem rero naón kan zaangfah duh lo. Cu ruangah a si atu hiti ih harsatnak kanmah kan tuar,” ti ah an ti-aw."},"22":{"text":"Reuben in a unau pawl hnenah, “Kan naupa-ih tlunah zianghman thil ṭha lo tuah hlah uh, ka lo ti tho lo maw? Ka thu nan ngai duh lo. Atu-ah a thih man phulaknak kan tuar thlang a si,” ti ah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cutiih an ṭong cu Josef in a thei ṭheh; asinain annih cun in thei ṭheh ti an thei lo. Ziangahtile Josef thawn an biak-awk tikah ṭonglettu an hmang."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Josef cu hmun dangah a va feh ih a va ṭap. A ṭah a baan tikah an hnenah a ra sal ih anmah ih lakin Simeon cu a vun dir ih an mithmuh rori-ah a ṭeemter."},"25":{"text":"Josef in, “An dip khatión rawl than uh, an paisa cu an dip sung ciarah ret sal uhla lamzin hrang lamcaw ken uh,” ti ah thu a pek ih a thupek vekin a ule pawl parah an tuah.","title":"Josef ih Ule Pawl Kanaan Ram Ah An Tlung"},"26":{"text":"A ule pawl cun an leimi rawl cu an laak parah an suang ih an tlung."},"27":{"text":"Cuih zan an riahnak ah an unau pakhat in a laak rawl pek dingin a dip cu vun ong khua a paisa cu a dip sung tlunta bikah a hmu."},"28":{"text":"“Ka paisa in khirh sal a si, ka dip sungah a um,” ti ah a au ih a unau pawl cu a sim. An lung a phang thluh ih thir rero in, “Pathian in kan parah ziang thil tak so a tuah hi?” ti ah pakhat le pakhat an sut-aw."},"29":{"text":"Kanaan ramih an pa Jakob hnen an thlen tikah an tonmi le an tuarmi hmuahhmuah cu an pa ih hnenah an sim."},"30":{"text":"“Izipt ram uktupa cu kan parah a ṭong a hrangzet ih thlingthlatu nan si, in ti ih sual in puh;"},"31":{"text":"thlingthlatu kan si lo, midik zumtlakmi kan si."},"32":{"text":"Pa pakhat ih fa unau hleihnih kan si ih kan nau pakhat cu a thi zo; nauta bik cu Kanaan ramah kan pa ih hnenah innah a um, ti ah kan sim."},"33":{"text":"Asinain acuih bawipa cun, zumtlakmi nan si le si lo ka theihnak ah ka hnenah pakhat cu nan taangta ding; a dang pawl cu rilrawng ih a ummi nan innsang hrangah rawl hei phurh uh."},"34":{"text":"Cule nan nau nauta bik nan rak hruai pei. Cuih hnu lawngah thlingthlatu si loin zumtlakmi nan si ti kha ka theih ngah hnuah nan unau pa ka thlah sal ding ih kan ram ah nan duhduh in thil nan zuar nan lei thei ding, ti ah in ti,” ti ah an pa an sim."},"35":{"text":"Cun an phurhmi rawl cu an suah tikah an dip sung ciarah an paisa cu an hmu ih an pafarual in an lung a phang ngaingai."},"36":{"text":"Cutikah an pa Jakob in, “Faate pakhat loin maw in taan ding. Josef cu a thi zo; Simeon le a hlo zo fawn. Atu Benjamin a lak nan tum lala. Kei hi a tuartu bik ka si hi!” ti ah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Reuben in, “Benjamin na hnenih ka kirpi sal lo asile ka fapa pahnih hi that hai aw. Benjamin cu ka kut sungah re ko awla ka rak kirpi tengteng ding,” ti ah a pa ih hnenah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Asinain a pa in, “Ka fapa cu ka thlah thei lo ding. A ule a thi zo ih atu amah lawng a taang. Lamzin ah tonlo a va tong pang ding. Cuvek riahsiatnak tuar thei ding ka si nawn lo; ka tar tuk zo ih ka thi ngaingai ding,” ti ah a ti."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kanaan ram ah paam cu a luar sinsin ih,","title":"Izipt Ram Ah Benjamin An Fehpi"},"2":{"text":"Jakob ih sungte pawl cu Izipt ram ihsin an leimi rawl an ei ṭheh tikah Jakob in a fapa pawl hnenah, “Vung feh sal uhla kan hrangah rawl vung lei sal uh,” ti ah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Judah in, “Nan naupa nan ratpi lo ahcun ka hmel hman in hmu thei lo ding, ti ah Izipt ramih bawipa in fiangtein ralrinnak in pe zo."},"4":{"text":"Kan naupa kan hnenih na fehter a si ahcun kan feh ding ih na hrangah rawl kan lei ding."},"5":{"text":"Na fehter siang lo a si ahcun kan feh lo ding. Ziangahtile cupa cun nan naupa nan rak hruai lo a si ahcun in tong thei lo ding, ti ah in ti zo,” ti ah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah an pa Israel in, “Ziangtin so ka zawn maltetal ruat loin nau pakhat kan nei hrih ti tiangtiang cupa ih hnenah nan va sim?” ti ah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule a fapa pawl in, “Nan pa a nunglai maw? Unau dang nan nei maw? ti ah kanmah le kan innsang thuhla lawnglawng cupa cun in sut ih, let loin kan um thei fawn lo. Nan naupa nan rak hruai pei ti ah in ti ding ti cu kan rak ruat hrimhrim lo,” ti ah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Judah in a pa ih hnenah, “Kan naupa cu keimah hnenah fehter aw. Kan tim kan tuah pei ih kan feh ding. Cutiih kan tuah lawngah nangmah siseh kan faate pawl le kanmah siseh kan zatein rilrawng thihnak in kan luat thei ding a si."},"9":{"text":"Kan naupa hrangah ka nunnak in ka kam a si; mawhphurh ding a um khalle keimah in ka phur ko pei. Na hnenah damte le himte ih ka kirpi lo a si ahcun ka nunsung hmuahhmuah na hmaiah mawhthluk ka tuar pei."},"10":{"text":"Hitiin rei hlah uhsila Izipt ram ah feh in voihnih hman kan let man zo ding naón,” ti ah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah an pa in, “Cuti ding thotho a si ahcun hiti in tuah uh: Kan ramsung ihsin a suakmi lakih a ṭha bik pawl thingthling, khuaitizu, rimhmui, khumkhal le mekei rah maltete ciar keng uhla cupa cu laksawng vung pe uh."},"12":{"text":"Nan dip sungih paisa nan hmuh salmi pawl tla cu nan khirh a ṭul ding hrangah paisa khal a let hnih in nan keng pei. Paisa an lo khirh cu an tisual a si ding."},"13":{"text":"Nan tim tuah in nan naupa cu hruai uhla cupa ih hnenah cun fehpi uh."},"14":{"text":"Nan unau pakhat pa le Benjamin cu nan hnenih an rakir sal theinak dingah Ziangkimtithei Pathian in cupa cu nan parah zaangfahnak thinlung neiter hram seh. Kei cu ka faate pawl hloral thluh ding hi ka tuar ding hrimhrim a si ahcun ka tuar a si ko pei cu,” ti ah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cuhrangah laksawng pawl an keng ih paisa khal a let hnih in an pai. An tim an tuah ih Izipt ram ahcun an feh. Benjamin khal an hruai ih Josef cu an va tong."},"16":{"text":"An hnenih Benjamin a tel cu Josef in a hmuh tikah a hnenum pa hnenah, “Hi pawl hi ka inn sungah hruai hai aw; ṭilva pakhat that awla suang aw; ziangahtile tuih sunah keimah thawn rawl kan eitlang ding,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Josef ih a sim vekin a hnenum pa in a tuah ih a inn sungah a fehpi hai."},"18":{"text":"Josef inn an thlen tikah an thin a phang ngaingai. Ziangahtile, “Hmaisa rawl kan lei ṭumih kan paisa pawl kan dip sungih a um hrangah hitawk ah in thlenpi. Kan sual hawl in rin lopi in sal ah in kai men ding. Kan laak pawl tla in long thluh ding a si hi,” ti ah an ruat."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Josef hnenum pa hnenah sangka kiangah an va feh ih,"},"20":{"text":"“Bawipa, rawl lei dingah hi tawk voikhat kan ra thleng zo."},"21":{"text":"Kan tlung ih lamzin kan riahnak ah kan dip sung kan zoh tikah rawl leinak man paisa kan pekmi kimtein kan dip sung tlunta bikah kan hmu fingfing. Cuih paisa cu atu-ah kan rak keng."},"22":{"text":"Cule rawl lei saalnak ah paisa dang tla kan keng a si. Kan dip sungah zo in maw paisa a rak ret ti cu kan thei lo,” ti ah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Josef hnenum pa cun, “ṭih hlah uh, nan thin khal phang hlah uh. Nan Pathian le nan pa ih Pathian in paisa cu nan dip sungah a ret a si ding. Rawl man paisa kimtein ka ngah ko,” ti ah a ti. Cuih hnuah an hnenah Simeon a rak hruai."},"24":{"text":"Cule hnenum pa in an unau rual in Josef inn sungah a fehpi hai ih an ke kholhnakah tidai a pek ih an laak khal rawl a pek."},"25":{"text":"Sun ah Josef a ra ding ih anmah thawn rawl a ra ei ding ti an theih tikah an kenmi laksawng pawl an suah ih Josef pek dingah tiar ciain an ret."},"26":{"text":"Josef a ra thleng ngaingai ih laksawng an kenmi pawl cu a inn sungah cun an pek ih a hmaiah leilung dai in an kun."},"27":{"text":"Cule Josef in an thuhla cu kimteih a sut ṭheh hnuah, “Kan dung nan rat laiah a tarzet nan timi nan pa ih thuhla in sim. Atu ziangtin a um? A harh dam lai maw?” ti ah a sut hai."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Kan pa, na siahhlawh, cu a dam lai a si,” ti ah an ti hnuah an khuk an bil ih a hmaiah an kun."},"29":{"text":"Cule Josef in a nau Benjamin a hmuh tikah, “A thuhla in sim reromi nan nauta bik pa cu amah hi maw a si?” a ti ih, “Pathian in thlawsuah lo pe seh, ka fapa!” ti ah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cuti a ti hnuah Josef cu hmakhatte-ah a khaan sungah a lut, ziangahtile a nau a hmuh sal tikah a lung a hno. A suup-awk thei lo ruangah a khaan sungah cun a feh ih a ṭap ciamco."},"31":{"text":"A hmai a phiah-awk hnu ah a ra suak ih a lunghnomi suup-aw phah in, “Rawl tuah uh,” ti ah a hnenum pawl thu a pek."},"32":{"text":"Josef cu cabuai pakhat ah rawl an tuah sak; a unau pawl a dang cabuai ah rawl an pek ih Josef hnen rawl ei ding ih a rami Izipt bawi upa pawl cu cabuai dangte-ah rawl an ei. Ziangah Izipt mi pawl a dangte-ah an ei tile Hebru mi pawl thawn rawl eitlang cu ningzakza a si, tiin an ruat."},"33":{"text":"A unau pawl cu Josef hmai hoi in an toter hai ih an kum vekin upabik in nautabik tiang a sangsangin an to. Cuti an to cu an hmuh tikah mangbangin pakhat le pakhat an zoh aw."},"34":{"text":"Josef cabuai ih a ummi rawl pawl an lak ih a unau pawl cu an bet, asinain Benjamin cu a unau pakhat ih comi let nga tam in rawl an pek. Cuticun an ei an in ih nuamzetin caan an hmang."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josef in a inn kiltu hnenum pa ih hnenah, “Hi pawl ih dip sungah an phurh thei zat in rawl than awla, an dip sungih tlunta bik ciarah an paisa ret aw.","title":"A Hlomi Ngun Khuathai"},"2":{"text":"Cule ka ngun khuathai hi an nauta bikih dip sung tlunta bikah a paisa thawn ret aw,” ti ah a fial. A ti bangtuk in a hnenum pa cun a tuah thluh."},"3":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitte in an laak pawl thawn an tlunter hai."},"4":{"text":"Khua ihsin malte an feh hnuah Josef in a inn kiltu hnenum pa hnenah, “Zamrang in kha milai pawl kha va dawi aw. Na man hai tikah, ‘A ṭhami cu ziangah so a sia in nan rulh,’"},"5":{"text":"‘Ziangah so ka bawipa ih ngun khuathai nan ruk? Ka bawipa ih sabitti innak a si ih, tinzohnak ih a hmanmi khal a si. Thil ṭha lo ngaingai nan tuah a si,’ ti ah na ti pei,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"A hnenum pa cun a dawi ih a man tikah Josef ih sim vekin a va ti."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Bawipa hiti ih na ṭong rero hi na ti duhmi ziangso a si? Cuvek lawmmam tuah cu kan ruah dah lomi a si."},"8":{"text":"Kan dip sungih kan hmuhmi paisa cu Kanaan ram ihsin kan run keng ih na hnenah kan lo khirh sal ti na thei ko. Cuih hnuah cun ziangah so na bawipa inn ihsin sui le ngun cu kan ruk ding?"},"9":{"text":"Cuhrangah bawipa, kanmah lakah pakhatkhat in kan ruk a si ahcun cupa cu thah siseh; cule a dang pawl cu na salah in kai ko aw,” ti ah an ti."},"10":{"text":"Anih in, “Asi, nan timi cu ka lung a kim; asinain nanmah lakih pakhatkhat hnenah ngun khuathai ka hmuh a si ahcun cupa lawng cu ka sal ah a cang pei ih midang cu nan tlung thei ko ding,” ti ah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah zamrangin an dip pawl cu an ṭhum ih an dip ciar cu an ong."},"12":{"text":"Josef ih hnenum pa cun upabik pa ih dip ihsin nautabik pa ih dip tiang feltein a hawl tikah Benjamin ih dip sungah ngun khuathai cu a hmu."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah an riahsia in an hnipuan an thlek ih an laak pawl parah an thilri cu an suang sal ih khuasung ah an kir sal."},"14":{"text":"Judah le a unau pawl Josef innih an thlen sal tikah Josef cu inn ah a rak um lai. A hmaiah an bok ih,"},"15":{"text":"Josef in, “Nan thil tuahmi hi ziangso a si? Keimah vekih thuneimi bawi cun tinzohnak hmang in in kai thotho ding ti nan thei lo maw?” ti ah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Judah in, “Bawipa, na hnenah ṭong ding zianghman kan nei lo. Ziangtin so kan lo el thei ding? Ziangtin so thiam kan co awkter thei ding? Pathian in kan mawhnak cu a langter thluh zo. Curuangah bawipa, a dip sungih ngun khuathai an hmuhmi pa lawng si loin kan zatein na sal kan cang ko pei,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in, “Si hlah ee, cuticun ka ti lo ding. A dip sungih ka ngun khuathai an hmuhmi pa lawng ka salah a cang ding. Mi dang pawl cu nan pa ih hnenah harhdam tein va tlung uh,” ti ah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule Judah cun Josef cu a hei naih ih, “Bawipa, zaangfahte in thusimnak caan i pe hrih hram aw. Ka parah na thin heng hram hlah aw, bawipa, nang cu amah Izipt ram siangpahrang vek thotho na si.","title":"Judah In Benjamin Hrang A Dil"},"19":{"text":"Bawipa nangmah in, ‘Pa nan nei maw? Unau dang teh nan nei maw? tiih in suh tikah,"},"20":{"text":"‘Pa kan nei ih a tarzet zo; nau kan nei ih tlolsam a si lai hrih. Kan pa a tarzet hnu ih a suakmi a si. Kan naupa ih u-pa a thi zo ih amah thawn nukhat sungsuak ahcun amah lawng a nung lai a si; curuangah kan pa in amah cu a duh cuang,’ ti ah kan lo sim."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah bawipa nangmah in, ‘Nan naupa cu rak hruai uh, a hmuh ka duh a si,’ ti ah in ti laiah khan,"},"22":{"text":"‘Kan pa a taan thei lo ding; a taan ahcun kan pa cu a thi men ding,’ ti ah kan lo ti."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah nangmah in, ‘Nan hnenih nan naupa a rat ve lo ahcun ka hmel hman in hmu thei lo ding,’ ti ah in ti."},"24":{"text":"“Na salpa a si mi kan pa hnenih kan kir tikah, na ti vekin kan sim."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah anih in, ‘Vung fehsal uhla kan hrangah rawl vung lei sal uh,’ in ti."},"26":{"text":"Kannih in, ‘Kan feh lo ding; ziangahtile kan nau nautabik a tel lo ahcun kan lo simmi pa kan vung tong thei lo ding. Kan nau nautabik a tel lawngah kan feh ding,’ kan ti tikah,"},"27":{"text":"kan pa cun, ‘Ka nupi Rachel in fapa pahnih i hrin ih,"},"28":{"text":"pakhat cu a um nawn lo. Sahrang in a thlekbauh thluh a si pei ti ka zum; ziangahtile tuih sun tiangin ka hmu nawn lo."},"29":{"text":"Cuih tlunah hi a taangmi ka fapa nan lak lala ih ziangmaw tiih a thih pang asile riahsia thinhar in ka thi ngaingai ding a si,’ ti ah in ti."},"30":{"text":"“Curuangah bawipa, ka pa hnenah keimah lawng ka kir ih ka nau a hmuh lo asile kan pa cu a thi rori ding a si. Kan pa ih nunnak le hi pa ih nunnak cu a zom-aw a si."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah bawipa, kan pa hi a tar zawng ah thihpi tlak riahsiatnak a parah kan thlenter ngaingai ding."},"32":{"text":"Cuih tlunah bawipa, hi ka nauhakpa ih hrangah ka pa hnenah ka nunnak ka kamta a si. ‘Na hnenih hi nauhakpa ka rak kirpi lo asile na hmaiah ka nunsung hmuahhmuah mawh ka phur ding,’ ka ti zomi a si."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah bawipa, hi nauhakpa cu a ule pawl thawn tlungter hram awla, keimah sawn hi na salah ka rung taang pei."},"34":{"text":"Nauhakpa tel locun ziangtinso ka pa ih hnenah ka tlun ngam ding? Ka pa ih tuar dingmi riahsiatnak cu ziangtinso ka hmuh ngam ding?” ti ah a ti."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cutikah Josef cu a lunghno suup-aw thei nawn loin a hnenum pawl hnenah, “Mi hmuahhmuah suakter uh,” ti ah a auh hai. An suak thluh ih a unau pawl hnenah Josef ka si ti a phuan-awk tikah an kiangah zohman an um lo.","title":"Josef A Unau Hnenah A Phuang Aw."},"2":{"text":"Josef cu a ṭap ih napi in a ṭah ruangah Izipt mi pawl in an thei. Cuih thuhla cu siangpahrang inn tiangin a thang."},"3":{"text":"Josef in a unau pawl hnenah, “Josef ka si. Ka pa a nunglai maw?” ti ah a sut. Asinain a unau pawl cun an ṭih tuk ruangah an sawn ngam lo."},"4":{"text":"Josef cun, “I rak naih deuh uh,” ti ah a ti ih an hei naih tikah Josef in, “Izipt ramih nan rak zuarmi nan nau Josef kha ka si."},"5":{"text":"Asinain hi ramih in zuar ruangah nan riahsia in mawhthluk aw rero hlah uh. Mi nunnak run dingah hitawk ih i thlentertu ngaingai cu Pathian a si."},"6":{"text":"Tuih kum hi hi ram sungah paam kum a kum hnihnak lawng a si lai. Paam kum kum nga a um hrih lai ding a si ih cuih sungah leileh le rawlkhawm ti khal a um lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Nan tesinfa tiang an nun theinak dingah nan hlanah Pathian in i thlenter a si. Mi tampi ka run theinak ding le nanmah tla nan nunnak dingah thlahmi ka si."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah hitawk ram i thlentertu ngaingai cu nannih nan si lo; Pathian a si. Pathian in, Faro hrangah a pa vekah i tuah ih a ramsung hmuahhmuah hi ka ṭuanvo a si ih Izipt ram hmuahhmuah uktu ka si."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah ka pa ih hnenah zamrangin va kir uhla na fa Josef in, ‘Pathian in Izipt ram hmuahhmuah uktu-ah i tuah zo. Ka hnenah zamrangin ra aw."},"10":{"text":"Keimah thawn kan hlat-awk tuk lonak dingah Goshen lamah na um pei ih nangmah le na faale pawl le na tesinfa pawl le na neihmi ṭilva - tuu le me le caw hmuahhmuah tla thawn nan um pei."},"11":{"text":"Goshen ih nan um ahcun ka lo kilkhawi phah thiam ding a si. Paam kum kum nga a baak lai a si ruangah nangmah siseh, na innsang le na neihmi ṭilva siseh, ei ding nei loih nan um pang ding cu ka duh lo, a ti,’ ti ah nan va sim pei."},"12":{"text":"Atu cu nanmah le ka naupa Benjamin in nan hnenih a ṭong rerotu hi Josef ka si, ti nan mit rori in in hmu thluh zo."},"13":{"text":"Izipt ram sungih huham ka neihzia hi ka pa ih hnenah va sim uhla, nan tonmi le nan hmuhmi hmuahhmuah dang khal nan va sim thluh pei. Zamrangte in va kir uhla amah rak hruai uh,” ti ah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Josef in a naupa Benjamin cu a pom ih a ṭap. Benjamin khal in a pom ih a ṭap ve."},"15":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Josef in a ule pawl cu pakhat hnu pakhat ṭap phah in a pom ih a hnam vivo hai. Cuṭheh in a unau pawl thawn an totlang ih thunuam an rel."},"16":{"text":"Josef ih unau pawl an ra ti thu cu siangpahrang inn tiangin a thang thluh ih Faro le a kuthnuai bawi pawl khal an lung a awi ngaingai."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in Josef hnenah, “Na unau pawl kha an laak thawn rawl phur-aw hai sehla Kanaan ram ah va tlung hai seh."},"18":{"text":"An pa le an sungte dang pawl va hruai hai sehla ka hnenah ra hai seh. Izipt ram sungih ram ṭha bik ka pe ding ih kan ram sungih a suakmi a ṭha bik an ei ding."},"19":{"text":"An nupi pawl le an faate note pawl to dingah Izipt ram ihsin rangleng tla hei keng hai seh. An pa run hruai hai seh ti felfai tein sim hai aw."},"20":{"text":"An thilri taanmi zaangraam hlah hai seh. Ziangahtile Izipt ram sungih a ṭha bik cu anmah ih ta a si paam ding a si,” ti ah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Jakob ih fapa pawl cun a sim vekin an tuah. Faro ih thu a pek vekin Josef in rangleng pawl tla a pek ih lampi hrangah lamcaw khal a pek."},"22":{"text":"Cuih tlunah a unau pawl cu hnipuan voikhat thleng awknak ciar a pek, asinain Benjamin cu ngun tangka zathum le hnipuan voinga thleng awknak a pek."},"23":{"text":"Izipt ram sungih suakmi thil ṭha bik pawl laak pahra phurin a pa a kuat. Cun a pa a ratnak ding lamcaw hrangah rawl le sang le rawl phun dangdang laak pahra phur a kuat fawn."},"24":{"text":"A unau pawl cu malte a hei thlah ih, “Lampi ah va to-aw hlah uh,” ti ah a cahta."},"25":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin an suak ih Kanaan ram an pa Jakob hnenah an va thleng."},"26":{"text":"“Josef a nunglai sokhaw! Izipt ram hmuahhmuah uktu a si!” ti ah an pa cu an sim. An pa cu a mangbangin a thir dukdi ih a zum thei hrimhrim lo."},"27":{"text":"Asinain Josef ih thusimmi hmuahhmuah an sim tikah le Izipt ram a fehnak dingah Josef ih a kuatmi rangleng pawl tla a hmuh tikah Jakob cu a lungawi in a thla a tlung sal."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob cun, “Ka fapa Josef a nunglai ngaingai ti ka fiang, in sim a ṭul nawn lo. Ka feh pei ih ka thih hlanah ka va tongta ding,” ti ah a ti."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob cu a neihmi thil hmuahhmuah thawn a pok ih Beersheba a thleng. Cutawkah a pa Isaak ih Pathian hnenah thawinak a pek.","title":"Jakob Le A Innsang Izipt Ah An Feh"},"2":{"text":"A cuih zanah langnak a hmu ih Pathian in, “Jakob, Jakob!” ti ah a ko. Jakob in, “ Bawipa , hinah ka um,” ti ah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in, “Keimah cu Pathian, na pa ih Pathian ka si. Izipt ramih feh ding cu ṭih aw hlah. Cutawk ram ah na tesinfa pawl cu miphun tumzet ah ka tuah ding."},"4":{"text":"Izipt ram ah nangmah hnenah ka feh ding ih na tesinfa pawl cu hitawk ram ah ka kirter leh ding. Na thih tikah Josef cu na kiangah a um ding,” ti ah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Beersheba ihsin Jakob cu a pok ih a fapa pawl in an pa Jakob le an fanote pawl le an nupi pawl cu Faro ih a rak kuatmi rangleng pawl parah an toter."},"6":{"text":"Kanaan ramih an neihmi ṭilva hmuahhmuah le thilri hmuahhmuah thawn an pok ih Izipt ram ah an feh. Jakob cun a tesinfa pawl,"},"7":{"text":"a fapa pawl le a tupa pawl, a fanu pawl le a tunu pawl, an zatein a fehpi ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Izipt ramih a fehmi Jakob ih tefa pawl ih hmin cu a hnuailam vek an si: Jakob ih fapa upabik Reuben,"},"9":{"text":"Reuben ih fapa pawl: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron le Karmi."},"10":{"text":"Simeon ih fapa pawl: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakhin, Zohar le Kanaan nunau nu ih fapa Shaul."},"11":{"text":"Levi ih fapa pawl: Gershon, Kohath le Merari."},"12":{"text":"Judah ih fapa pawl: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez le Zerah. (Asinain Er le Onan cu Kanaan ramah an thita.) Perez ih fapa pawl: Hezron le Hamul."},"13":{"text":"Issakhar ih fapa pawl: Tola, Puvah, Jashub le Shimron."},"14":{"text":"Zebulun ih fapa pawl: Sered, Elon, le Jahleel."},"15":{"text":"(Hi pawl cu a fanu Dinah siarcih in Leah in Mesopotamia ram ah a pasal Jakob a hrinmi fapa pawl an si. Leah thawn an hrinmi tefa pawl cu an zatein sawmthum le pathum an si.)"},"16":{"text":"Gad ih fapa pawl: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi le Areli."},"17":{"text":"Asher ih fapa pawl: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, le an farnu Serah. Beriah ih fapa pawl: Heber le Malkhiel."},"18":{"text":"(Hi minung hleiruk cu Laban in a fanu Leah hnenih a fehter mi a salnu Zilpah ih a hrin sakmi Jakob ih tefa an si.)"},"19":{"text":"Jakob ih nupi Rachel ih hrinmi fapa pawl: Josef le Benjamin."},"20":{"text":"Cun Heliopolis khua ih puithiam Potifera ih fanu Asenath in Izipt ramah Josef thawn fapa pahnih Manasseh le Efraim an hring."},"21":{"text":"Benjamin ih fapa pawl: Bela, Bekher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, le Ard."},"22":{"text":"(Hi minung hleili cu Rachel ih hrinmi Jakob ih tefa pawl an si.)"},"23":{"text":"Dan ih fapa cu Hushim a si."},"24":{"text":"Naftali le a fapa pawl: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer le Shillem."},"25":{"text":"(Hi minung pasarih cu Laban in a fanu Rachel hnenih a fehtermi a salnu Bilhah ih a hrinsakmi Jakob ih tefa an si.)"},"26":{"text":"Izipt ramih a fehmi Jakob ih tefa pawl cu, a fapa pawl ih nupi pawl tel loin an zatein sawmruk le paruk an si."},"27":{"text":"Izipt ramah Josef in fapa pahnih a nei ih, curuangah Jakob ih sungte cu an zatein Izipt ram an thlen tikah minung sawmsarih an si."},"28":{"text":"Jakob in Josef tong dingah Judah kha hmaiah a thlah ih, “Goshen in in rak hmuak seh,” ti ah a cah. A sungkhat pawl Goshen ram an thlen tikah,","title":"Izipt Ram Ah Jakob Le A Sungte"},"29":{"text":"Josef cu a rangleng a to ih a pa Jakob hmuak dingah a feh. A pa a ton tikah Josef cu a pa ih hngawng a kuah ih reipi a ṭap."},"30":{"text":"Cutikah Jakob in Josef hnenah, “Atu cu na hmel ka lo hmu ih na nung ti ka thei zo. Ka thih khalle poi ka ti nawn lo,” ti ah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cule Josef in a unau pawl le a pa ih sungkhat pawl hnenah, “Faro hnenah ka va feh pei ih ka unau le ka pa ih sungkhat pawl Kanaan ramih a ummi cu ka hnenah an thleng zo."},"32":{"text":"Annih tla cu tuukhal an si ih ṭilva vulh pawl an si. Atu-ah an tuurual le an cawrual le an neihmi dang hmuahhmuah thawn an ra thleng zo a si, ka va ti ding."},"33":{"text":"Faro in a lo kawh ih, ‘Ziang hna so nan ṭuan?’ tiih thu a lo suh tikah,"},"34":{"text":"nannih in, ‘Bawipa, kan pu le kan pa pawl vekin kan nauhak lai ihsin tuu kan khal a si,’ nan ti pei. Cuticun Goshen ram ah nan um thei ding,” ti ah a ti. Izipt mi pawl in tuukhal pawl cu an ningsin zawng a si ruangah Josef in hiti ih a simnak cu a si."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josef cu Faro hnenah a feh ih, “Ka pa le ka unau pawl Kanaan ihsin an tuu le an cawrual le an neihmi hmuahhmuah tla thawn an ra thleng zo. Atu-ah Goshen ram ah an um,” ti ah a va sim."},"2":{"text":"Cule amah hnenih a fehpimi a unau panga cu Faro hnenah a hmuh."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in, “Nan hnaṭuan ziangso a si?” ti ah a sut ih annih in, “Bawipa, kan pu le kan pa vekin kannih khal tuukhal kan si."},"4":{"text":"Hi ram ah hin bawipa, kan ra zo. Ziangahtile Kanaan ramah paam a besia tuk ih kan ṭilva pawl hrangah hrampi hman a um lo. Curuangah bawipa, zaangfahte in Goshen ram ah in umter hram aw,” ti ah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in Josef hnenah, “Atu cu na pa le na unau pawl an ra thleng zo ih,"},"6":{"text":"Izipt ram cu an ta a si ko. Goshen ram ahcun um ko hai seh; kan ram sungih a ṭha bik hmun pakhat a si. Cun anmah lakih rinsantlak an um asile keimah ih ṭilva khaaltu pawl hotu ah ret aw,” ti ah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Josef in a pa Jakob cu a fehpi ih Faro a tonter. Jakob in Faro cu thluasuah a pek."},"8":{"text":"Cule Faro in, “Kum ziangzatso na si?” ti ah a sut."},"9":{"text":"Jakob in, “Leilung ah vakvai in kum za le sawmthum ka nung zo. Ka pu le ka pa pawl an vahvaihnak kum cu ka zat lo. Ka kum hi a mal naón ka nunsung san hi a har ngaingai a si,” ti ah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Jakob in Faro cu thluasuah a pekta ih a feh."},"11":{"text":"Josef in a pa le a unau pawl cu Faro ih thupek bangtuk in Izipt ram sungih ram a ṭhatnak bik Rameses khawpi kiangah a umter."},"12":{"text":"A pa le a unau pawl le, a pa ih sungkhat pawl hmuahhmuah cu nauta bik tiangin Josef in an ei ding rawl a pek ṭheh."},"13":{"text":"Paam cu a luar deuhdeuh ih leilung tlun khui hmanah rawl a um lo. Izipt le Kanaan ramih minung pawl cu rilrawng in an cau ṭheh.","title":"Josef In Ram A Uk Daan"},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Izipt le Kanaan ram sung minung pawl in rawl leinak ih an hmanmi tangka hmuahhmuah cu Josef in a khawm ṭheh ih Faro inn ah a ret."},"15":{"text":"Ramsungmi pawl ih neihmi paisa a cem thluh tikah Izipt mi pawl cu Josef hnenah an ra ih, “Rawl in pe aw. Kan paisa le a cem ṭheh zo. Ziangtal in ruahsak lo ahcun kan thi thluh ding,” ti ah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in, “Nan paisa a cem ṭheh zo a si ahcun nan ṭilva rak keng uhla rawl in ka lo thleng hai ding,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Josef hnenah an ṭilva pawl rang, tuu, me, caw le laak pawl cu an rak keng ih Josef in rawl in a rak thleng. Cuih kum cu an ṭilva hmuahhmuahih manah rawl a pek hai."},"18":{"text":"A hmai kum cu Josef hnenah an ra sal ih, “Bawipa, nang cu kan lo pheh lo pei; kan paisa a cem ṭheh zo ih kan ṭilva hmuahhmuah khal na ta an si ṭheh zo. Bawipa, kan leiram le kan taksa ruangpi siar lo zianghman lo pek ding kan nei nawn lo."},"19":{"text":"In thiter siang hram hlah awla, ziangtal in ruahsak aw. Kanmah kan minung le kan leiram tla rawl in in lei aw. Faro ih sal kan cang thluh ko pei ih kan ram hmuahhmuah khal amah ih ta-ah si ṭheh ko seh. Rawl loih kan thih ṭheh lonak ding le kan ram pawl tla ramṭhingih an can ṭheh lonak dingah rawl le rawlci in pe hram aw,” ti ah an dil."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in Izipt ram sungih leiram hmuahhmuah cu Faro hrangah a lei ṭheh. Paam cu a besiat zet hrangah Izipt mi hmuahhmuah in an loram an zuar ṭheh. Izipt ram hmuahhmuah cu Faro ih ta ah a cang thluh."},"21":{"text":"Izipt ram khatlam deng ihsin khatlam deng tiang a ummi minung hmuahhmuah cu hnaṭuantu salah a tuah ṭheh hai."},"22":{"text":"Josef ih a lei lomi leiram cu puithiam pawl ih leiram lawnglawng an si. Puithiam pawl cu an leiram an zuar a ṭul lo; ziangahtile Faro in an cawm awknak a pek a si."},"23":{"text":"Cule Josef in Izipt mi pawl hnenah, “Atu-ah nanmah le nan leiram pawl cu Faro ih hrangah ka lo lei thluh zo a si ti nan hmu. Hinah thlaici nan hrangah a um ih nan lo ah va cing uh."},"24":{"text":"Rawlkhawm tikcu ah nan neihmi rawl ṭhen nga ṭhen khat Faro nan pek pei. A taangmi hmuahhmuah cu nanmah ih hrangah a si pei; nan loih nan tuh ding thlaici le nanmah le nan sungkhat pawl le nan faate pawl tla-ih cawm awknak hrangah a si pei,” ti ah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Kan nunnak in run ngah zo; bawipa, kan tlunah na ṭha ngaingai ih kannih cu Faro ih sal kan si ko ding,” ti ah an ti."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah an rawl neihmi-ih ṭhen nga ṭhen khat cu Faro pek dingin Izipt ram sungah Josef in daan a tuah. Cuih daan cu atu tiangin an hmang lai a si."},"27":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Izipt ram Goshen ah cuticun an um. An neinung, leiram an nei ih an karhzai ngaingai.","title":"Jakob Ih Netabik Rocahmi"},"28":{"text":"Jakob cu Izipt ramah kum hleisarih a um ih, amah ih kum cu za sawmli kum sarih a si."},"29":{"text":"Cun Jakob cu a thih caan a nai thlang hrangah a fapa Josef a ko ih, “Na mithmai ṭha ka co a si ahcun ka hnenah thukamnak tuah hram aw. Na kut cu ka cawn karlakah ret awla ka parah thungai zetin, rinsantlak na sinak ding le Izipt ram sungih i phum lonak dingah Bawipa hmin in thu kam aw."},"30":{"text":"Ka thih tikah Izipt ram ihsin i fehpi awla ka pu le ka pa vekin an thlaan ah i phum aw,” ti ah a ti. Josef in, “Na sim vekin ka tuah ding,” ti ah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Jakob in, “Ka tuah tengteng ding ti ah siatcam in thu i kam aw,” ti ah a ti ih Josef in thu cu a kam. Cutikah Jakob cu a ihkhun lu lamah lukuun in lungawi thu a sim."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tawkfang a rei hnuah Josef cu, “Na pa a na a si,” ti ah an sim. Curuangah Josef cu a fapa pahnih Manasseh le Efraim thawn a pa veh dingah an feh.","title":"Jakob In Efraim Le Manasseh A Thlawsuah"},"2":{"text":"“Na fapa Josef cu nangmah zoh dingah a ra a si,” ti ah an sim tikah, Jakob cu a to thei nalo cingin ihkhun parah a hung to."},"3":{"text":"Jakob in Josef hnenah, “Ziangkimtithei Pathian cu Kanaan ram Luz khua ah ka hnenah a lang ih thlawsuah i pek."},"4":{"text":"Pathian in, ‘Tefa tampi ka lo pek ding ih na tesinfa pawl cu miphun tampi-ah an cang ding. Hi ram cu na tesinfa pawl hnenah kumkhua in anmah ih ta-ah ka pe ding,’ ti ah i ti."},"5":{"text":"Na fapa pahnih Izipt ram ka ra thlen hlanih na hrinmi tla cu ka fapa ngaingai ah siar an si ding. Reuben le Simeon ka fapa an si tlukin Efraim le Manasseh khal ka fapa an si ding."},"6":{"text":"Asinain anmah ih hnu ih na hrinmi na faate pawl cu nangmah ih ta an si ding. Roconak ahcun an u Efraim le Manasseh thawn ṭawmcih an si ding."},"7":{"text":"Hitiih ka tinak cu ziangah a si tile Mesopotamia ram ihsin ka ra kir ih Kanaan ramsung ka thlen hnu Efrath khua kan thlen hlan deuhte ah, ka riahsiattertu bikah, na nu Rachel in in thihsan ih Efrath lamzin ah ka phumta a si,” ti ah a ti. (Efrath cu atu ahcun Bethlehem tiin kawh a si.)"},"8":{"text":"Josef ih fapa pahnih cu Jakob in a hmuh tikah, “Hi nauhak pawl cu zoso an si?” ti ah a sut."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in, “Annih cu hi Izipt ram ah Pathian ih i pekmi ka fapa an si,” ti ah a ti. Cule Jakob in, “Ka hnenah rak hruai awla thlawsuah ka pe hai ding,” ti ah a ti."},"10":{"text":"A tar zo hrangah Jakob cu a mit a mal thlang ih ṭhatein khua a hmu thei lo. Josef in a fapa pawl cu a pa ih hnenah a hruai ih a pa cun a pom ih a hnam hai."},"11":{"text":"Jakob in Josef hnenah, “Nangmah ton sal ding hman hi ka rak zum dah lo. Asinain atu cu Pathian in na faate pawl tla i hmuhter a si,” ti ah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in a pa ih cawn par ihsin a faate pawl cu a lak hnuah a pa ih hmaiah leilung dai in a kuun ih upatnak a pek."},"13":{"text":"Josef in a fapa pahnih cu an kut veve in a kai ih a pa Jakob ih kehlam um dingah Efraim cu a vorhlam kut in a hruai ih, a pa ih vorhlam um dingah Manasseh cu a kehlam kut in a hruai ih a fehpi."},"14":{"text":"Asinain Jakob in a kut kalh-aw in a nauta deuh Efraim ih lu parah a vorhlam kut a suang ih a upa deuh Manasseh ih lu parah a kehlam kut a suang."},"15":{"text":"Cule Josef cu thlawsuahnak a pek ih: “Ka pu Abraham le ka pa Isaak in An nun sungih an renmi Pathian, Cuih Pathian in nannih cu thluasuah lo pe hai hram seh. Tuihsun tiangin i fingkhawitu Pathian in nannih cu bawngmal lo sawm hram seh."},"16":{"text":"Siatsuahnak tinkim sung ihsin i runtu vanmi in, Nannih cu thluasuah lo pe hram seh. Ka hmin le ka pu Abraham le ka pa Isaak ih hmin cu, Anmah thawngin nung ringring hram seh. Te le fa tampi nei in, Leilung parah miphun tampi ah cang hai seh,” ti ah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun a pa in a vorhlam kut cu Efraim lu parih a suan kha Josef in a hmuh tikah a lung a kim lo ngaingai ih a pa ih kut cu Efraim ih lu ihsin Manasseh ih lu ah ṭhawn dingin a lak sak."},"18":{"text":"Cule a pa hnenah, “Ka pa, khati cun a si lo ding. Hi pa hi fa upa a si ruangah a lu parah na vorhlam kut re aw,” ti ah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Asinain a pa in a duh lo; “Ka thei ko ka fapa, ka thei ko. Manasseh ih tesinfa pawl khal miphun tumzet ah an cang ve ko ding. Asinain anih hnakin a naupa cu a tum sawn ding ih a tesinfa pawl cu miphun tumzet ah an cang ding,” ti ah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutiin cuih ni-ah thluasuahnak a pek hai: “Israel mi pawl in midang hrangah Pathian ih thluasuah an dil tikah, ‘Efraim le Manasseh thluasuah vanluh teih an um bangin, Pathian in lo thluasuah hram seh,’ an ti ding,” ti ah a ti. Cuticun Jakob in Efraim cu Manasseh hlanah a ret."},"21":{"text":"Cun Jakob in Josef hnenah, “Kei cu ka thi cing ding. Asinain Pathian cu na hnenah a um ding ih na pu le na pa pawl ih ram ah a lo kirter leh ding."},"22":{"text":"Cule Amor mi pawl hnen ihsin ka li le ka nam thawn ka lakmi ram hmuahhmuah lakih ram ṭhabik Shekhem cu na unau pawl coter loin nangmah hnenah ka lo pek a si,” ti ah a ti."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Jakob in a fapa pawl a ko ih, “Hmun khatah khawm-aw uhla hmailamah nan tlunih thil a cang dingmi ka lo sim cia hai ding,” ti ah a ti.","title":"Jakob In A Fapa Pawl Hrang A Netabik Thucahnak"},"2":{"text":"“Ra uhla ngai uh, Jakob ih fapa pawl, Nan pa Israel thusimmi ngai uh."},"3":{"text":"“Reuben, ka fatir, Nang cu ka thazaang na si, Patling ka si hnu ih ka neih hmaisa bik na si, Ka fapa pawl lakah a cak bik le a hngal bik;"},"4":{"text":"Nang cu tilian bangin mi thinsahlap na si, Mi thupi bik na si dah lo ding, Ziangahtile na pa ih nusun rori na sualpi, Na pa ih ihkhun parah na kai ih na baalter."},"5":{"text":"“Simeon le Levi cu unau an si, An hriamhrei cu mi-ih thisen luannak ah an hmang;"},"6":{"text":"An thuthup relnak ah ka tel lo pei, An khawkhannakah siarcih ka si lo pei, Ziangahtile an ai a thok tikah mi an that, Nomnak menah cawcang kaiza an sat cat."},"7":{"text":"An thinhengnak parah camriamnak um seh, Ziangahtile an thinhengnak a luar tuk. An thinlingnak par khalah camriamnak um seh, Ziangahtile a siakha tuk. Jakob ram sungah ka ṭhekdarh thluh hai ding, Israel mi lakah ka ṭhekdarh thluh hai ding."},"8":{"text":"“Judah, nang cu na unau pawl in an lo thangṭhat ding, Na ral pawl an hngawng in na kai ding ih, Na hmaiah na unau pawl an kuun ding."},"9":{"text":"Judah cu kiosa no bangtuk a si, Sa a deh thluh in a rolnak ah a kir sal, ka fapa, Judah cu kiosa vek a si; A dok aw ṭhunṭho ih a vung bok sal, Zohman in an ṭhang ngam lo."},"10":{"text":"A siangpahrang fung a keng ih, A tesinfa pawl cu uktu an si ringring ding. Miphun tampi in ngunkhuai an pe ding ih, Upatnak in a hmaiah an kuun ding."},"11":{"text":"A laak no cu sabit kuangah a hren, Sabit kuang ṭha bikah. A hnipuan cu sabitti in a sawp, Thii bangin a senmi sabitti ah."},"12":{"text":"Sabitti a in nakah a mit cu thii bangin a sen hreihrei, Cawhnawi a in ruangah a ha cu vur bangin a vaar fiahfiah."},"13":{"text":"“Zebulun cu tifinriat kapah a um ding, A tikap tla cu tangphawlawng colhnak a si ding; A ram cu Sidon tiang a kau ding."},"14":{"text":"“Issakhar cu a cakzetmi laak a si, A phurhmi thilrit tom hnih karlakah a bok;"},"15":{"text":"A colhnak hmun a ṭhatzia le, A ram a nomzia a hmuh ruangah, Thilrit phur dingah a zaang cu a tun ih, Hnaṭuan khung ṭuantu sal ah a cang."},"16":{"text":"“Dan cu a miphun uktu a si ding, Israel miphun pawl vek thotho a si ding."},"17":{"text":"Dan cu lamzin kapih rul vek a si ding, Zintlang ih tur neimi rulha vek a si. Rang kebeu ah a cuk ih rang totu cu dunglamah a hlon."},"18":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , nangmah ih runnak ka hngak."},"19":{"text":"“Gad cu fifir pawl in an siim ding; Asinain a do ding ih a dawi suak ding."},"20":{"text":"“Asher ih loram ihsin rawlṭha a suak ding, Siangpahrang ih ei tlak rawl a si ding."},"21":{"text":"“Naftali cu a tlang dualdomi zuknengpi, Fano mawi zetzet neimi vek a si."},"22":{"text":"“Josef cu hramlak ih laak, Cerhti kiangih a tlangmi laak bangtuk a si, Tlang parih laak note vek a si."},"23":{"text":"Zaangfahnak nei loin a ral pawl in an hual, An li le an thal thawn an dawi."},"24":{"text":"Asinain Jakob ih Pathian, Ziangkimtithei ih cahnak le, Israel ih Lungpi, Israel Khaltu thawngin A li cu a kiak thei ve lo ih A baan tha cu a cak teltelzet a si."},"25":{"text":"Na pa ih Pathian, nangmah a lo bawmtu le, A lo thluasuahtu Ziangkimtithei Pathian in, Van ihsin thlawsuahnak cu ruah bangin, Lei hnuai khalin tidai bangin, Te le fa, ṭilva sumhnam thlawsuahnak thawn,"},"26":{"text":"Fangvui fual le rawlhan tlingin, Thlaithlak le rawl ṭuan thlawsuahnak; Khuahlan ihsin a rak ummi tlang ih thlawsuahnak le, Kumkhua a hmunmi tlangpar ih duhnungza thil pawl cu, A unau lakih mi hleice dingin sersiammi, Josef ih lu parah thleng thluh hram seh."},"27":{"text":"“Benjamin cu a hrang zetmi cinghnia paak a si; A deh ciami cu zinglamah a ei, Zanlam ah a ngahmi sa cu a ṭhendarh ciamco,” ti ah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Hi pawl hi Israel miphun hleihnih an si ih an hnenah an pa ih thucahmi an si. Pakhat hnu pakhat anmah thawn a mawitawk in thluasuah a pek ciar a si."},"29":{"text":"Cun Jakob in a fapa pawl hnenah, “Ka pu le ka pa hnenih feh ding ka si thlang. Kanaan ram Mamre ihsin nisuahnak lam Makpelah ah,","title":"Jakob Thihnak Le Phumnak"},"30":{"text":"Hit mi pa Efron hnen ihsin ram le lungkua cu thlaan hrangah Abraham ih leimi a um. Cutawkah in run phum pei."},"31":{"text":"Cutawkah Abraham le a nupi Sarah phum an si. Isaak le a nupi Rebekah khal cutawkah phum an si thotho. Keimah in ka nupi Leah khal cutawkah ka phum zo."},"32":{"text":"Cuih ram le a sungih a ummi lungkua cu Hit mi pa hnen ihsin leimi a si,” ti ah a ti."},"33":{"text":"A fapa pawl hnenih a thucahmi a ṭheh vete in Jakob cu a ihkhun parah a ke a com ih a thaw a cemcihta. Cuticun a pu le a pa hnenah a fehta a si."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cutikah Josef in a pa ih ruak cu a pom ih ṭap rero phahin a hmai a hnam."},"2":{"text":"Cun a kuthnuai-ih hna a ṭuantu sibawi pawl cu a pa ih ruak siat loih erh dingah a fial ih a fial vekin an tuah."},"3":{"text":"Miruak siat lo dingih an tuah tikah a rei ṭheu bangtuk in ni sawmli sung an rei. Cun Izipt mi pawl in Jakob thih cu ni sawmsarih sung an ul ih an ṭah."},"4":{"text":"A pa an ṭah ni a cem hnuah Josef in siangpahrang ih bawi pawl hnenah, “In zaangfah a si ahcun hiti in Faro hnenah i va sim sak uh:"},"5":{"text":"‘Ka pa a thih hlan deuhah Kanaan ram ah amah hrang rori ih a laihmi thlaan ah keimah ih phum dingin thukamnak i tuahter ih thukamnak cu ka tuah. Curuangah ka pa va phum dingah i thlah hram aw. Zamrangte in ka ra kir sal ko ding a ti,’ ti ah in sim sak uh,” ti ah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cule Faro in, “Thu na kam vekin phum dingah va feh aw,” ti ah thu a khirh sal."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah a pa phum dingin Josef cu a feh. Faro kuthnuai-ih bawi hmuahhmuah, a innsangih mi upa deuh le Izipt ram sungih hruaitu deuhdeuh tla in Josef cu an thlun."},"8":{"text":"Cun Josef ih innsang hmuahhmuah, a unau pawl le a pa ih sungte pawl tla an feh thluh. An nauhak pawl le an tuu, an me le an caw pawl lawnglawng Goshen ram ah an taang."},"9":{"text":"Rangleeng in siseh, rangpar in siseh, an feh dutdo ih an tam ngaingai."},"10":{"text":"Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lamih a ummi Atad ih fangcilnak rawn an thlen tikah reipi mithiphum pumkhawmnak an tuah. Cule Josef in ni sarih sung mithi zuun a ngai."},"11":{"text":"Cuticun Atad hmunih an mithi ngai daan cu Kanaan mi in an hmuh tikah, “Izipt mi pawl in mithi ngainak nasazet an tuah a sihi,” ti ah an ti. Curuangah cuih hmun cu Abel Mizraim ti ah an ko ih Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lamah a si."},"12":{"text":"Cuticun Jakob ih thupek vekin a fapa pawl in an tuah."},"13":{"text":"Kanaan ram ahcun a ruak cu an phur ih Hit mi pa Efron hnen ihsin thlaan hrangah Abraham in a rak leimi ram, Mamre ihsin nisuahnak lamih a ummi Makpelah-ih lungkua ah an phum."},"14":{"text":"A pa a phum ṭheh tikah Josef cu a unau pawl le a pa phum dingih a fehmi hmuahhmuah tla thawn Izipt ah an kir."},"15":{"text":"An pa a thih hnuah Josef ih unau pawl in, “Josef in in rak hua ziar laiin a tlunih harsatnak kan thlentermi hmuahhmuah ruangah in lehrul tum sehla ziangtinso kan ti ding? ti ah an ti-aw ih an thin a phang ngaingai.","title":"Josef In A Unau Pawl An Hna A Ngamter"},"16":{"text":"Curuangah Josef hnenah, “Na pa in a thih hlanah thu in cahta:"},"17":{"text":"‘Josef rak sim uhla, thil ṭha lo a tlunih nan tuahmi sualnak le siatnak cu lo ngaithiam seh,’ a ti. Curuangah kannih na pa ih Pathian ih siahhlawh pawl hi in ngaithiam hram aw,” ti ah thu an cah. A cuih thu an sim tikah Josef cu a ṭap."},"18":{"text":"Cun a unau pawl cu an ra ih a hmaiah an kuun ih, “Na hmaiah na sal kan si ko,” ti ah an ti."},"19":{"text":"Asinain Josef in, “Phang hlah uh. Pathian ai cu ka awh thei lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Keimah siatsuah dingah khua nan khang naón Pathian in thil ṭha-ah a canter a si. Cucu tuih sunih kan hmuh vekin mi tampi humhimnak dingah a si."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah nan thin phang hlah uh. Nanmah siseh, nan faate pawl siseh, ka lo cawm hai ding,” ti ah a ti. Cuticun Josef in ṭong thlum in a hneem hai ih an hna a ngam sal."},"22":{"text":"Josef cu Izipt ramah a pa ih sungkhat pawl thawn an um ih kum za le kum hra a ti ah a thi.","title":"Josef Thihnak"},"23":{"text":"A thih hlanah Efraim ih faate pawl suan thum tiang a hmuta. Manasseh ih fapa Makhir in faate a neih tikah Josef in a sungkhat ah a siarcih."},"24":{"text":"Cun a unau pawl hnenah, “Kei cu ka thi thlang ding. Asinain Pathian in a lo kilkhawi ding ih hi ram ihsin a lo suah hai ding; Abraham, Isaak le Jakob hnenih a kam ciami ramah a lo hruai tengteng hai ding a si,” ti ah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cule Josef in Israel ih fapa pawl cu siatcam in thu a kamter ih, “Pathian in a lo veh caan a thlen ih hi ram ihsin a lo suahpi hai tikah ka ruh nan lak pei ih nan fehpi pei,” ti ah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cuticun Josef cu kum za le kum hra a ti ah Izipt ram ahcun a thi. Siat thei lo dingin an erh ih ruak kuang sungah Izipt ramah cun an ret."}}}}},"2":{"info":{"name":"Suahlannak","shortname":"Suah","abbr":[],"desc":"Suahlannak"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob le anmah ih innsang ciar thawn Izipt ramih a fehmi a fapa pawl ih hmin cu:","title":"Israel Mi Izipt Ram Ah Hremnak"},"2":{"text":"Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah,"},"3":{"text":"Issakhar, Zebulun, Benjamin,"},"4":{"text":"Dan, Naftali, Gad le Asher tla an si."},"5":{"text":"Jakob ih sungsuak tefa pawl cu an zatein sawmsarih an si. Josef cu Izipt ramah a rak um zo."},"6":{"text":"Caan a hung rei deuh hnuah Josef le a unau pawl cu an thi ih an khukṭhi pawl khal an thi thluh."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl in faate tampi an nei ih Izipt ram khat ko in an zai ih a cah khal an cak."},"8":{"text":"Cuih caanah Josef ih thuhla thei dah lotu mi thar pakhat Izipt ramah siangpahrang a cang."},"9":{"text":"Anih cun a milai pawl hnenah, “Zohhnik uh, hi Israel mi pawl hi an tamzet ih tlunah an cakzet fawn ih kan hrangah phan ding a um a si."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah i ngai uh, Israel mi pawl hi an tam sinsin lonak dingah fimkhur zetin an thu hi kan ruah a ṭul a si. Ral kan neih pang asile kan ral pawl hnenah an ṭang pei ih kan ram sungin an suak pang ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah an thinpit koin hnaṭuan khung ṭuantertu dingah an tlunah salkhawngtu pawl an ret. Cuticun Israel mi pawl in rawl khawlnak dingah Pithom le Rameses khawpi pawl cu Faro hrangah an sak."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Izipt mi pawl ih an hrem deuhdeuh tikah Israel mi pawl cu an pungzai deuhdeuh. Izipt mi in Israel mi pawl cu an huazet ih an ṭihzet fawn."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah sal zonzai ah an tuah hai;"},"14":{"text":"tlakrawh ser le tlakrawh tuah hnaṭuan khung ṭuannak ah an nun cu a har sinsin. Hnaṭuan har tinkim cu zaangfahnak nei loin hranhram in an ṭuanter hai."},"15":{"text":"Cun Hebru nunau a bawmtu nau dongtu sayama pawl hnenah Izipt siangpahrang in thu a sim. Pakhat cu Shifrah a si ih a dang pakhat cu Puah a si."},"16":{"text":"An hnenah, “Hebru nunau in fa an hrin ih nan tuamhlawm tikah naute cu mipa asile nan that pei; nunau a si ahcun nan that lo pei,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nau dongtu sayama pawl cun Pathian an ṭihzah ruangah siangpahrang ih thu cu an thlun lo. Mipa naute khal that loin an zuah ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in nau dongtu sayama pawl cu a ko ih, “Zianghrangah hiti in nan tuah ih mipa naute tla nan zuah ṭheh?” tiah a sut."},"19":{"text":"Cule annih in, “Hebru nunau pawl cu Izipt nunau vek an si lo. An cakvak ih an fahrin a olzet; nau dongtu sayama kan va thlen hlanah naute cu a rak suak zo ṭheu,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Pathian ih ṭhatnak cu nau dongtu sayama pawl ih tlunah a thleng. Israel mi pawl cu an ṭhangso ih an cak sinsin."},"21":{"text":"Nau dongtu sayama pawl in Pathian an ṭihzah ruangah annih khal in faate an nei ve."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in a ramsung mi hnenah, “Hebru nunau-ih hrinmi fapa hmuahhmuah cu Nail tiva sungah nan hlon pei; a sinan fanu cu hlon loin nan zuah pei,” tiah thu a pek."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih caanah Levi mi pakhat in a phunpi nunau pakhat a ṭhi.","title":"Moses Suahnak"},"2":{"text":"A nupi cu fa a vun ih fapa a hring. Fapa mawizet a si tikha a nu in a hmuh tikah thla thum sung a thup."},"3":{"text":"Asinain a thuh thei nawn lo tikah phaipheng ih tuahmi bawm pakhat a lak ih tidai lut thei lo dingin cingthling le khuaiseng a hnih. A sungah naute cu a hlum ih tivapi kap hrampi sang zetzet lakah a ret."},"4":{"text":"Ziang a cang pei ti theih duh ah a u nu cun hlat nawn in a thlir."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Faro ih fanu tibual dingah tiva ah a ra ih a zawng-um nunau pawl cu tivakap ahcun lam an leng. Faro ih fanu in hrampi lakih bawm cu a hmuh tikah la dingah a zawng-um nu a fial."},"6":{"text":"Faro ih fanu in bawm cu a on tikah naute cu ṭap rero ih a um kha a hmu. A zaangfahzet ih, “Hebru naute a si hi!” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah cuih a u nu cun, “Hi naute a lo zohsaktu dingah Hebru nunau pakhat ka va ko pei maw?” tiah a sut."},"8":{"text":"Cule Faro ih fanu in, “Va ko aw,” a ti. A va feh ih amah ih nu rori a va ko."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Faro ih fanu cun, “Hi naute hi i rak zohsak awla na zoh man cu ka lo pe ding,” tiah a ti. Curuangah cuih naute cu a nu in a lak ih ṭhatein a zoh."},"10":{"text":"Naute cu a hung upat deuh tikah a nu cun Faro ih fanu hnenah a hei fehpi ih Faro ih fanu cun amah ih fapa-ah a tuah. “Tidai sungin ka suahmi a si,” a ti ih a hminah Moses a sak."},"11":{"text":"Tawkfang a hung rei hnu, Moses a upat deuh tikah a miphun pawl a va leng. Cutiih a va len tikah a miphun pawl cu Izipt mi pawl in hranhram ih hnaṭuan khung an ṭuanter kha a hmu. Cuih tlunah a phunpi Hebru mi pakhat Izipt mi pa ih a vuak kha a hmu.","title":"Midian Ram Ah Moses A Tlan"},"12":{"text":"A kiangkap a zoh ih zohman a hmuh lo tikah Izipt mipa cu a that ih a ruak cu vunnel sungah a thup."},"13":{"text":"A thaisun ah a phunpi pawl hnenih a va feh sal tikah Hebru mi pahnih an sual-awk rero kha a hmu. Cutikah a mawh deuhtu pa ih hnenah, “Ziangah so na phunpi cu na thawi?” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah anih cun, “Zoin so kan tlunih uktu le thuṭhentu dingah a lo tuah? Izipt pa na thah vekin a thah i tum maw si?” tiah a ti. Cutikah Moses cu a thin a phang ih, “Ka thil tuahmi hi midang in an thei zo a sihi!” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cumi thu cu Faro ih a theih tikah Moses cu thah a tum. Asinain Moses cu a tlan ih Midian ramih um dingin a feh. Midian ram a thlen tikah tikhur pakhat kiangah a cawl."},"16":{"text":"Midian ramih puithiam Jethro in fanu pasarih a nei. A fanu pawl cu tikhur ah an ra ih, an pa ih tuu le me hrangah tidai an khai ih an ṭilva tidai innak kuang sungah an thlet."},"17":{"text":"Culaifang ah tuukhal pawl an ra ih an ra dawi hai. Sikhalsehla Moses in nunau pawl cu a ṭan ih an ṭilva cu tidai a peksak."},"18":{"text":"Cule an pa hnenih an va kir tikah an pa cun, “Ziangtin so tuihsun bul tuanih nan tlun thei?” tiah a sut."},"19":{"text":"“Izipt pa in tuukhal pawl hnenin in run ruangah a si,” tiah an ti. “Kan hrangah tidai hman in khai sak ih ṭilva pawl tla a tul a si,” an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah an pa cun, “Khuiah so a um? Ziangah so cupa cu nan taanta? Va ko uhla kan hnenah rawl ra ei seh,” tiah a fanu pawl cu a fial."},"21":{"text":"Cuticun Moses cu Midian ramah cun a um ih Jethro in a fanu Zipporah cu Moses ih nupi dingah a pek."},"22":{"text":"Zipporah in fapa a nei ih, “Tluang ramah ramdang mi ka si,” a ti ih a hminah Gershom a sak."},"23":{"text":"Kum tampi hnuah Izipt siangpahrang cu a thi. Asinain Israel mi pawl cu sal an tuarnak ruangah an aihram ih an raak an kio lai thotho. Cuti an aihramnak aw cu Pathian hnenah a thleng ih,"},"24":{"text":"an raak an kionak aw cu Pathian in a thei. Cun Abraham, Isaak le Jakob hnenih a thukammi khal a ciing."},"25":{"text":"Israel mi pawl an sal tuarnak cu Pathian in a hmu ih an parah seherhnak a nei."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses cu Midian ramih puithiam a pu Jethro ih tuu le me pawl a khal ṭheu. Voikhat ah a ṭilva pawl cu nelrawn ramṭhing ah a fehpi ih Pathian tlang Sinai timi ah a va thleng.","title":"Pathian In Moses A Ko"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ih vancungmi hrambur sungih meisa-alh in a hnenah a lang. Moses in a zoh ih hrambur cu a alh rero naón a kang lo, ti kha a hmu."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah, “Mangbangza thil hi naih deuhin ka zohhnik pei. Ziangah so hrambur a kang lo?” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Moses ih a naih vivo cu Bawipa in a hmuh tikah hrambur sung ihsin, “Moses, Moses!” tiah a ko. Moses in, “ Bawipa , hinah ka um,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in, “Rak naih nawn hlah. Na kedam phuak aw, ziangahtile na dinnak hmun cu hmun thianghlim a si."},"6":{"text":"Keimah cu na pu le na pa ih Pathian ka si. Abraham ih Pathian, Isaak ih Pathian le Jakob ih Pathian ka si,” tiah a ti. Cuvete in Moses cu a hmai a hup; ziangahtile Pathian cu a zoh ngam lo."},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in, “Ka milai pawl Izipt ih hrem an tuar cu fiangtein ka hmu zo. Salkhawngtu pawl kutsung ihsin luat dingih an aihramnak tla ka thei zo. An tuarnak hmuahhmuah khal ka thei a si."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Izipt mi pawl ih kut sungin a suahtu ding le cuih ram ihsin suak tahratih ramṭha le ramkau-ih thlenpitu dingah ka rung thleng zo a si. Cuih ram cu cawhnawi le khuaitizu a luannak ram, atu ahcun Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Amor mi, Periz mi, Hiv mi le Jebus mi pawl an umnak ram a si."},"9":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ih ṭah-ainak aw cu ka hnen a thleng ih Izipt mi pawl in ziangtluk in an neh-nen hai, ti khal ka hmu a si."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah ka milai Israel mi pawl Izipt ram sung ihsin suah dingah nangmah cu Faro hnenah ka lo thlah ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Pathian hnenah, “Keimah cu zoso ka si ih Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi suakter dingah Faro hnenih ka va feh ding cu?” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Pathian in, “Na hnenah Keimah ka um ding ih a lo thlahtu Keimah ka sinak a langtertu cu himi hi a si ding: Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl na suahpi tikah, hi tlang parah hin in bia ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Moses in Pathian hnenah, “Israel mi hnenah ka feh ih ‘Nan pu le nan pa ih Pathian in nan hnenah i thlah a si,’ ka ti tikah, ‘A hmin zoso a si?’ in ti asile ziangtinso ka sim ding?” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in, “Keimah cu Keimah ka si. Keimah a si mi in nan hnenah i thlah a si, tiin Israel mi hnenah na sim pei,” tiah Moses hnenah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cule Pathian in Moses hnenah hiti in a ti sal. “ Bawipa , nan pu le nan pa ih Pathian, Abraham ih Pathian, Isaak ih Pathian le Jakob ih Pathian in nan hnenah i thlah a si tiin Israel mi pawl hnenah na sim pei. Hihi a kumkhua-in ka hmin a si ih hmailam san minung hmuahhmuah khal in hiti in in ko ding."},"16":{"text":"Va feh awla Israel hruaitu pawl ko khawm awla an hnenah, Bawipa , nan pu le nan pa ih Pathian, Abraham, Isaak le Jakob ih Pathian cu ka hnenah a lang ih hiti in nanmah sim dingah i fial a si! ‘Nan hnenah ka ra zo ih Izipt mi pawl in nan tlunih an tuahmi cu ka hmu zo."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah hrem nan tuarnak Izipt ram ihsin lo suah ding le Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Amor mi, Periz mi, Hiv mi le Jebus mi pawl ih umnak ram lo thlenpi dingah ka ruatcat zo a si. Cuih ram cu cawhnawi le khuaitizu a luannak ram a si,’ tiah na ti pei."},"18":{"text":"Na simmi thu cu an lo ngai ding. Cun Israel mi hruaitu pawl thawn Izipt siangpahrang hnenah nan feh pei ih a hnenah, ‘Hebru mi pawl ih Pathian, Bawipa in in tong zo. Curuangah ni thum sung nelrawn ramṭhingah kan feh ih Bawipa kan Pathian hnenih thawinak kan pek theinak dingah in thlah hram aw,’ tiah nan dil pei."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kut cakih a hneek dah ti lo ahcun Izipt siangpahrang cun a lo thlah lo ding, ti cu ka thei ko."},"20":{"text":"Ka cahnak ka hmang pei ih ka tuah dingmi mangbangza pawl in Izipt mi pawl cu ka hrem ding. Cuih hnuah a lo thlah ding a si."},"21":{"text":"“Cuih tlunah ka milai pawl cu Izipt mi pawl ih upat tlak in ka tuah pei ih Izipt ram ihsin nan suah tikah nan kut lawngin nan suak lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Israel nunau hmuahhmuah in an innsungih a ummi Izipt nunau hnenin siseh, an innhnenih Izipt mi hnenin siseh, hnipuan le hlawnthil, sui le ngun an dil pei ih, nan fanu le nan fapa pawl in an hruk pei. Cutiin Izipt mi pawl cu an thilri hmuahhmuah nan laksak thluh ding a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in, “Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl in in zum lo ih ka simmi ngai loin, ‘ Bawipa cu na hnenah a lang lo a si,’ in ti asile, ziangtinso ka ti ding?” tiah a ti.","title":"Moses Hnenah Huham A Pek"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in, “Na kutah ziangso na ken?” tiah Moses cu a sut. “Kianghrol ka keng,” tiah Moses in a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, “Lei parah vun hlon aw,” tiah a ti ih, Moses in a vun hlon tikah rul ah a cang. Cutikah Moses cu dungah a siip."},"4":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in, “Vun dawh awla a mei in kai aw,” tiah Moses cu a ti. Cule Moses in a vun dawh ih a kaih tikah a kut parah cun kianghrol ah a cang sal."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Himi cu Israel mi pawl hnenah an pu le an pa ih Bawipa Pathian, Abraham ih Pathian, Isaak ih Pathian le Jakob ih Pathian cu na hnenah a lang a si, ti an zum theinak dingah a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Moses hnenah Pathian in thu a sim sal ih, “Na kut cu na angki sungah ret aw,” tiah a ti. A ti bangtuk in Moses in a ret. A kut a suah sal tikah a phar ṭheh ih vur bangin a rangmi hma in a kut cu a khat ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, “Na kut cu na angki sungah ret sal aw,” a ti. A ti bangin Moses in a ret. A kut cu a suahsal tikah a dam ṭheh ih a taksa dang bangtuk ah a cang sal."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “A hmaisaih tican neimi hminsinnak an pom thei lo ih an lo zum lo a si khalle a pahnihnak ih tican neimi hminsinnakih ruang talah an lo zum ding."},"9":{"text":"Hi hminsinnak pahnih ih hnuah an zum lo thotho ih na simmi khal an ngai lo a si ahcun Nail tiva ihsin tidai la awla leiro parah thle aw. Leiro parih na thletmi tidai cu thisen ah a cang ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Moses in Bawipa hnenah, “Bawipa, kei cu i thlah hramhram hlah aw. Thusim thiam khal ka si dah lo. Nangmah ih i ton hnu khalah thusim thiam ka si hlei cuang lo. Santlai lo ka si ih ka ṭong a fung ih ka aw a hak fawn si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Minung cu zo in so hmurka a pek? Zoin so hnaset le ṭong thei lo khi a tuah? Zoin so khawhmuh theinak a pek? Asilole zo in so a mit a cawtter? Bawipa Keimah ka si lo maw!"},"12":{"text":"Cu a si ruangah feh aw; na ṭongnak ah ka lo bawm ding ih na ṭong dingmi khal ka lo sim ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Asinain Moses in, “Bawipa, i zaangfah hram awla midang pakhatkhat thlah sawn aw,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa cu Moses parah a thin a heng ih, “Levi mi na unau Aaron a um a si lo maw? Amah cu ṭong a thiamzet ti ka thei ko. Thungai tile amah cu atu-ah nangmah tong dingin a ra lai ih a lo ton ding cu a hlawptlozet a si."},"15":{"text":"Amah thawn nan biak-awk hnuah a ṭong dingmi cu nangmah in na sim pei. Nan pahnih in nan ṭong dingmi cu ka lo bawm ding ih nan pahnih ih nan tuah dingmi tla ka lo sim ding."},"16":{"text":"Mi hnenah nangmah ai-awh in Aaron a ṭong ding ih amah cu na hmurka a si ding. Nangmah cu amah ih hrangah Pathian bangtuk na si ding ih a ṭong dingmi simtu na si ding."},"17":{"text":"Hi kianghrol hi na kut in keng awla mangbangza tuahnak ah va hmang aw,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun Moses cu a pu Jethro hnenah a feh ih, “Izipt ramih ka sungkhat pawl an nunglai maw ti zoh dingah Izipt ramih kir dingin i thlah hram aw,” tiah a ti.
