Cule a pu Jethro cu a lung a kim ih, “Damte in feh aw,” tiah a ti.","title":"Moses Cu Izipt Ram Ah A Kir"},"19":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses cu Midian ramih a um laiah, “Atu cu Izipt ramah kir thlang aw, ziangahtile thah a lo duhtu pawl cu an thi ṭheh zo,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Moses in a nupi le a fapa pawl a hruai ih laak parah a toter hai ih Izipt ramah a kirpi. Pathian ih pekmi kianghrol cu a keng ringring."},"21":{"text":"Cule Pathian in Moses hnenah, “Atu cu Izipt ramih kir thlang ding na si ruangah tuah ding ka lo timi mangbangza hmuahhmuah cu Faro hmaiah na tuah thluh pei. Asinain Faro ih thinlung cu ka hakter ding ih ka minung pawl cu a fehter lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Faro ih hnenah, ‘Israel cu ka fatir a si."},"23":{"text":"Keimah i biak theinak dingah ka fapa cu thlah aw ka lo ti naón na thlah duh lo. Curuangah na fatir ka that ding a si, tiin Bawipa in a ti,’ tiah na sim pei,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Lamzin ih an riahnak hmunah Bawipa in Moses cu a tong ih thah a tum."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Zipporah in lunghriam pakhat a lak ih a fapa ih serh a tan. Cuih lunghriam cun Moses ih ke a daiter ih Zipporah in, “Nang cu serhtannak thisen suahtertu ka pasal na si,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in Moses nunnak cu a zuah. Serhtannak thisen ruangah a nupi Zipporah in, “Nang cu serhtannak thisen suahtertu ka pasal na si,” a tinak cu a si."},"27":{"text":"Cun Aaron ih hnenah Bawipa in, “Moses tong dingah nelrawn ah va feh aw,” tiah a ti. A ti bangin Bawipa ih tlang ah Moses tong dingin a feh. Cule Moses a ton tikah a hnam."},"28":{"text":"Moses cun Bawipa in a thlah zawng ih a hnenih a simmi hmuahhmuah le Bawipa in mangbangza a tuahnak le thu a peknak pawl tla cu kimtein Aaron a sim ṭheh."},"29":{"text":"Cun Moses le Aaron cu Izipt ram ah an feh ih Israel mi hruaitu pawl an ko khawm ih,"},"30":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenih a simmi thu hmuahhmuah cu an hnenah Aaron in a sim thluh. Cule misenpi hmaiah Moses in mangbangza a phunphun a tuah."},"31":{"text":"Cutiin misenpi in an zum. Cule Bawipa cu an hrangah seherhnak a nei ih hrem an tuarnak pawl tla a hmu thluh a si, ti kha an theih tikah a hmaiah kuun in an biak."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Moses le Aaron cu Faro hnenah an feh ih a hnenah, “Israel ih Pathian in, ‘Ka minung pawl cu nelrawn ramṭhing ah an feh ih keimah ih hrangah biaknak puai an tuah theinak dingah Izipt ram in suah hai seh,’ a lo ti,” tiah an ti.","title":"Faro Hmaiah Moses Le Aaron"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in, “ Bawipa cu zoso a si? Ziangah so Bawipa ih thu cu ka ngai ding ih Israel cu ka fehter ding? Bawipa cu kei ih ka theihmi a si lo. Curuangah Israel cu ka suahter lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule annih in, “Hebru pawl ih Pathian cu kan hnenah a lang a si. Bawipa kan Pathian hnenih thawinak kan va pek theinak dingah nelrawn ramṭhing ah ni thum sung va feh dingin in thlah hram aw. Cutiih kan tuah lo asile, doral in maw, natnak in maw, in that ding a si,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Izipt siangpahrang in Moses le Aaron hnenah, “Nan milai pawl hna ṭhateih ṭuan thiam lo dingin nan tawlrel cu ziang nan duhnak so a si? Hi sal pawl hi an hnaṭuannak ah fehter uh!"},"5":{"text":"Nan milai pawl hi kan ramsung minung ngaingai hnakin an tam sawn thlang. Cuih tlunah maw, an hna ṭuanlonak ding nan tumtah hrih!” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cuih ni ah Faro in Izipt mi salkhawngtu le Israel mi hnaṭuantu pawl hotu hnenah thu a pek ih,"},"7":{"text":"“A hlan bangtuk in tlakrawh tuahnak ah hramro nan pe nawn lo pei; anmah tein hramro cu hawl hai seh."},"8":{"text":"Asinain tlakrawh cu a hlanih an tuahzat thotho in tuah dingah nan fial pei; ṭhum hrimhrim hlah uh. An zaangzel ruangah an phunzai ih, ‘Pathian hnenah thawinak pe dingin kan feh pei,’ tiah an tinak hi a si."},"9":{"text":"Tam sinsin le har sinsin in hna nan ṭuanter pei. Thuphan lawnglawng a ṭongtu pawl ih thu ngai loin an hnaṭuannak ah taima sawn hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah salkhawngtu le hnaṭuan hotu pawl cu an minung pawl hnenah an feh ih, “Faro in, ‘Hramro ka lo pe nawn lo ding;"},"11":{"text":"nan hmuh naknak ah nan hawl pei ih nan la pei; asinain tlakrawh cu nan tuah ṭheumi zat thotho nan tuah pei,’ a ti,” tiah an sim."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi pawl cu hramro hawl ah Izipt ram a suk le a so-ah an vak."},"13":{"text":"Salkhawngtu pawl cun an nawtzok rero ih, “Hramro pek nan si laiih ni khatih nan tuah ṭheu zat thotho ni khatah nan tuah a ṭul a si,” an ti."},"14":{"text":"Faro ih minung, salkhawngtu pawl in Israel hnaṭuan hotu pawl an hnaṭuanmi hmuahhmuahah ṭuanvo pekmi pawl cu, “Zianghrangah so a hlanih ni khat sungih nan tuah ṭheumi tlakrawh cu atu-ah nan tuah thei lo?” tiah an kawk ih an vuak ciamco hai."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi hnaṭuan hotu pawl cu Faro hnenah an feh ih, “Bawipa, zianghrangah so na siahhlawh pawl hiti ih in tuah?"},"16":{"text":"Atu-ah hramro in pe nawn lo; asinain bawipa, ‘Tlakrawh tuah uh’ in ti thotho fawn. Cuih tlunah bawipa, vuak tiangin kan tuar fawn. Na minung pawl ih mawh hrimhrim a si,” tiah an va phunzai."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in, “Nanmah pawl hi mizee nan si; mi zaangzel phun hrimhrim nan si ruangah, ‘Kan feh pei ih Bawipa hnenah thawinak kan pe ding,’ tiah nan ti ciamco."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah atu rori nan hnaṭuan thok uh! Hramro malte hman pek nan si lo ding; asinain tlakrawh cu nan tuah dingzat thotho nan tuah hrimhrim pei,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Israel mi hnaṭuan hotu pawl cun, “Nan tuah ṭheumi zat thotho nitinte in tlakrawh nan tuah pei,” tiah Faro in a ti thu an theih tikah kan harsa riai a sihi, ti an thei."},"20":{"text":"Faro hnen ihsin an suak ih anmah a rak hngaktu Moses le Aaron an ton tikah,"},"21":{"text":"an hnenah, “Nan thil tuahmi hi Bawipa in hmu hramsehla, Faro le a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih in huatnak ding nan phiar ruangah Bawipa in lo cawh hram seh. Kanmah pawl thahnak dingah hin an kut sungah namsau nan ret zo a si,” tiah an ti."},"22":{"text":"Cule Moses cu Bawipa ih hnenah a feh sal ih, “ Bawipa , ziangah so hi Israel mi pawl parah harsatnak na thlenter? Ziangah so an hnenah keimah hi i thlah?","title":"Moses Thlacamnak"},"23":{"text":"Nangmah ai-awh in Faro hnenih ka thlen vete in na minung pawl hi a tuahsiat ringring zo a si. Nang in le anmah runsuak ding zianghman na tuah fawn lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in Moses hnenah, “Atu thok ihsin Faro hnenih ka thil tuah dingmi cu na hmu ding. Israel mi pawl thlah dingah ka kut cak in ka hneek ding. Thungai in tile ka kut cak ih ka hneek hnuah cun amah hrimhrim in a ram sung ihsin a dawi hai ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"Pathian in Moses hnenah, “Keimah cu Bawipa ka si.","title":"Pathian In Moses A Ko Sal"},"3":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian tiin Abraham, Isaak le Jakob hnenah ka lang. Asinain an hnenah Bawipa timi ka hmin in ka lang-awter lo."},"4":{"text":"Cule ramdang mi bangtuk ih an rak um dahnak Kanaan ram cu ka lo pe ding, tiah anmah thawn thukamnak ka tuah zo."},"5":{"text":"Atu-ah Izipt mi pawl in salih an kaihmi Israel mi pawl aihramnak cu ka thei ih ka thukam cu ka ciing ṭha a si."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah nangmah in Israel mi hnenah ka thu cu na sim pei, ‘Keimah cu Bawipa ka si. Izipt mi pawl in hramhram ih an lo ṭuantermi hnaṭuan khunghar sung ihsin ka lo luatter ding. An sal nan sinak sungin ka lo run ding. Ṭihnungza hremnak thawn an thu ka ṭhen ding ih ka baan thacak thawn ka lo humhim hai ding."},"7":{"text":"Ka minung ah ka lo tuah ding ih Keimah cu nan Pathian ka si ding. Izipt mi pawl in nan parih an suanmi hnaṭuan khunghar sung ihsin a lo suahtu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si kha in thei ding a si."},"8":{"text":"Abraham, Isaak le Jakob hnenih ka hmin saal in ka kam ciami ramah ka lo thlenpi hai ding. Cuih ram cu nanmah ih ta si dingin ka lo pe ding. Keimah cu Bawipa ka si,’ a ti tiah va sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Pathian ih a sim bangtuk in Moses in Israel mi hnenah a sim. Asinain Moses ih thusimmi cu an ngai lo; ziangahtile an saltuarnak cu a na tuk ih an thin a pit ih an bei a dong ṭheh ruangah a si."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah,"},"11":{"text":"“Izipt siangpahrang Faro hnenah feh awla, Israel mi pawl cu na ramsung ihsin na suakter hrimhrim pei, tiah va ti aw,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa ih hnenah Moses in, “Israel mi hman in ka thu in ngai lo a si ahcun ziangtinso Faro cun i ngai ding? ṭong lam ahcun ka hlawhsam tuk lawmmam a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Moses le Aaron cu Izipt ramsung ihsin Israel mi pawl hruaisuak tengteng dingih a thlahmi an si ti cu Israel mi pawl le Izipt siangpahrang sim dingin a fial."},"14":{"text":"An sungkhat ih cithlahtu pawl cu hihi an si. Israel ih fatir Reuben ih fapa-ah Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, le Karmi an si. Hihi Reuben ih sungkhat tesinfa cithlahtu an si.","title":"Moses Le Aaron Ih Thawhkehnak"},"15":{"text":"Simeon ih fapa-ah Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakhin, Zohar le Kanaan nu-ih fapa Shaul tla an si. Hihi Simeon ih sungkhat tesinfa cithlahtu an si."},"16":{"text":"Levi ih fapa pawl ih hmin cu, an tefa pawl thawn, Gershon, Kohath le Merari an si. Hihi Levi ih sungkhat cithlahtu an si. Levi cu kum za le sawmthum le kum sarih a nung."},"17":{"text":"Gershon ih fapa pawl cu Libni le Shimei an si ih tefa tampi an nei."},"18":{"text":"Kohath ih fapa pawl cu Amram, Izhar, Hebron le Uzziel an si. Kohath cu kum za le sawmthum le kum thum a nung."},"19":{"text":"Merari ih fapa pawl cu Mahli le Mushi an si. Hi pawl cu Levi ih sungkhat, an tesinfa pawl ih thuanthu thawn an si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Amram in a pa ih farnu Jokhebed a ṭhit ih Aaron le Moses a hrin. Amram cu kum za le sawmthum le kum sarih a nung."},"21":{"text":"Izhar ih fapa pawl cu Korah, Nefeg, le Zikhri an si."},"22":{"text":"Uzziel ih fapa pawl cu Mishael, Elzafan le Sithri an si."},"23":{"text":"Aaron in Amminadab ih fanu, Nahshon ih farnu Elisheba a ṭhi ih Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar a hrin."},"24":{"text":"Korah ih fapa pawl cu Assir, Elkanah, le Abiasaf an si. Hihi Korah mi pawl ih sungkhat an si."},"25":{"text":"Aaron ih fapa Eleazar in Putiel ih fanu lakah pakhat a ṭhit ih Finehas a hrin. Hihi an sungte ciar in Levi miphun ih cithlahtu pawl an si."},"26":{"text":"Hi Aaron le Moses hi Bawipa in, “Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl cu suakter uh,” tiih a fialmi cu an si."},"27":{"text":"Izipt siangpahrang hnenah Israel pawl Izipt ram ihsin thlah dingin a va simtu cu anmah thotho an si."},"28":{"text":"Izipt ramih Moses hnenah Bawipa in thu a sim tikah,","title":"Moses Le Aaron Hnenah ih Thupekmi"},"29":{"text":"“Keimah cu Bawipa ka si. Ka lo simmi hmuahhmuah cu Izipt siangpahrang hnenah va sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Asinain Moses in Bawipa hnenah, “ṭong lamah cun ka hlawhsam tuk lawmmam. Ziangtin so Izipt siangpahrang in ka thu cu a ngai duh ding?” tiah a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Zohhnik, Faro hnenah nangmah cu Pathian bangtuk ah ka lo tuah pei ih, na u Aaron cu a hnenah na profet bangtuk in thu a sim ding."},"2":{"text":"Thu ka lo pekmi hmuahhmuah Aaron na sim pei ih, amah in Faro hnenah a ramsung ihsin Israel mi suakter dingin a sim pei."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Faro ih thinlung cu ka hakter pei ih Izipt ram sungah mangbangza a phunphun ka tuah khalle,"},"4":{"text":"Faro in nan thu a ngai lo ding a si. Cutikah an ram cu napi in ka hrem pei ih Izipt mi pawl cu nasa zetin cawhkuan ka pe pei; cutiin ka minung Israel mi pawl cu a bur a bur in Izipt ram ihsin ka hruaisuak hai ding."},"5":{"text":"An ram ihsin Israel mi ka hruaisuak ih an tlunih ka baan thacak ka hawi tik lawngah Izipt mi pawl in Bawipa ngaingai ka si ti in thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih a fial bangtuk in Moses le Aaron in an tuah."},"7":{"text":"Faro hnenih thu an va sim tikah Moses cu kum sawmriat a si ih Aaron cu kum sawmriat le kum thum a si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenah,","title":"Aaron Ih Kianghrol"},"9":{"text":"“Faro in, ‘Ziangngai nan si le si lo, mangbangza cu tuah hnik hmen uh,’ a lo ti asile, nang Moses in Aaron hnenah, ‘Na kianghrol la awla Faro hmaiah hlon aw; cule rulah cangter aw,’ na ti pei,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Moses le Aaron cu Faro hnenah an feh ih Bawipa ih thupek vekin an tuah. Faro le a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih hmaiah Aaron in a kianghrol cu a hlon ih rulah a cang ngaingai."},"11":{"text":"Cule Faro in a mifim pawl le a dawithiam pawl a ko ih an dawithiamnak in Aaron ih tuah vekin an tuah ve."},"12":{"text":"An kianghrol cu an hlon ih rulah an canter ve. Asinain an rulpi pawl cu Aaron ih rul in a dolh thluh."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa ih a sim cia bangtuk in Faro ih thinlung cu a hak ngaingai ih Moses le Aaron ih thu cu a ngai duh hrimhrim lo."},"14":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Faro ih thinlung cu a hak ngaingai. Ka minung pawl cu a thlah duh lo a si.","title":"Izipt Ram Ah Mangbangnak A Thleng Thisen"},"15":{"text":"Faro cu zinglamih Nail tiva-ih a feh tikah va tong aw. Tivapi kap in rak hngak awla, rulih a cang dahmi kianghrol kha keng aw."},"16":{"text":"Cule Faro hnenah, ‘Hebru mi pawl ih Pathian Bawipa in na hnenah i thlah ih, ka minung pawl in ramṭhing ah in biak theinak dingah ka minung pawl cu thlah seh, a lo ti. Asinain atu tiang cu a thu na ngai lo."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa ih thu cu hiti in a si: Bawipa ka sinak cu ka tuah dingmi thil in na thei ding. Zohhnik, hi kianghrol hin tivapi ih tidai cu ka vuak pei ih tidai cu thisen ah a cang ding."},"18":{"text":"Nga hmuahhmuah an thi thluh ding ih tiva cu a nam tuk lawmmam ding ruangah Izipt mi pawl in tivapi ih tidai cu an in thei lo ding,’ tiah na va ti pei,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Aaron kha, ‘Na kianghrol la awla Izipt ram sungih a ummi tiva siseh, tihriat siseh, tili siseh, tidai hmuahhmuahih tlunah na kianghrol cu thlir aw. Tidai cu thisen ah a cang ding ih Izipt ramsung khuazakip ah, tikuang sungih tidai le lungbeel sungih an khawlmi tidai tiangin thisen ah an cang thluh ding,’ tiah sim aw,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa ih a fial bangtuk in Moses le Aaron in an tuah. Faro le a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih hmai rori-ah Aaron in a kianghrol cu a thlir ih tivapi cu a thawi. Cuvete in tidai cu thisen ah a cang ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Tiva sungih nga hmuahhmuah an thi ṭheh; curuangah a nam ngaingai ih Izipt mi pawl in tiva ih tidai cu an in thei lo. Izipt ram cu thisen lawnglawngin a khat."},"22":{"text":"Cun Izipt ramih dawithiam pawl in an dawi in cubangtuk cu an tuah ve. Faro ih thinlung cu a hah keelin a hak thotho. Bawipa ih a rak sim cia vekin Moses le Aaron ih thu cu a ngai hrimhrim lo."},"23":{"text":"Hi bangtuk mangbangza hman cu poisa loin Faro cu a siangpahrang innpi ah a kir."},"24":{"text":"Cule Izipt mi pawl cun tiva ih tidai an in thei nawn lo ruangah tiva kapah tikhur an lai ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa in tiva a vuak hnuah ni sarih a rei."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Faro hnenah feh awla, Bawipa ih thu cu hiti in a si, ‘Ka minung pawl in in biak theinak dingah na thlah pei.","title":"Butlak"},"2":{"text":"Ngaihnik, na thlah duh lo a si ahcun na ram cu butlak in ka hrem ding."},"3":{"text":"Tiva cu butlak in a khat ṭheh ding. Tiva in an suak ding ih na siangpahrang inn le na ihnak khaan, na ihkhun par le na kuthnuai bawi pawl le na minung pawl ih inn tiangin an lut ding. Na tappi le na beel sung tiangin an thleng thluh ding."},"4":{"text":"Na minung, na kuthnuai bawi pawl le nangmah ih par tiangah an ra dawp ding,’ a ti va ti aw,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Aaron hnenah, ‘Tivapi tlunah siseh, tihriat tlunah siseh, tili tlunah siseh, na kianghrol thlir awla, Izipt ram sungah butlak suakter aw,’ tiin sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"A ti bangtuk in Aaron in a kianghrol cu tidai tlunah a thlir ih butlak an suak ngaingai ih Izipt ram cu an khat sohso ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla dawithiam pawl khal in an dawi in butlak cu an ram ah an suakter ve."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in Moses le Aaron cu a ko ih, “Keimah le ka minung pawl ih hnen in butlak pawl a laakhlo theinak dingah Bawipa hnenah thla cam hram uh. Bawipa hnenih thawinak pe thei dingin nan minung pawl cu ka thlah ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cule Moses in Faro hnenah, “Butlak pawl cu nan inn hmuahhmuah sung ihsin an tlan thluh ih Nail tiva sung lawnglawngih an umnak dingah ziangtikah so nangmah, na kuthnuai bawi pawl le na minung pawl hrangih thla ka cam ding; a tikcu i sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Faro in, “Thaisun ah cam aw,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Moses in, “ Bawipa kan Pathian bangtuk Pathian dang a um lo a si, ti na theihnak dingah na tivek ngaingai in a cang ding."},"11":{"text":"Butlak in nangmah siseh, nan inn pawl siseh, na kuthnuai bawi pawl le na minung pawl siseh, an lo taan dingih Nail tiva sung lawnglawngah an um ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Moses le Aaron cu Faro hnen ihsin an suak ih Faro hnenih a thlentermi butlak thu-ah Moses in Bawipa hnenah thla a cam."},"13":{"text":"Moses ih a dil vekin Bawipa in a kimter ih innsungih a ummi butlak le hmuansung le lo sungih a ummi butlak an thi ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl in butlak cu a bur tumpipi ah an peng ih an ram cu butlak rimsia nam in a khat."},"15":{"text":"Faro in butlak pawl an thi ṭheh thlang ti a hmuh tikah a thinlung cu a hak sal lala. Bawipa ih simcia vekin Moses le Aaron ih thu cu a ngai duh lo."},"16":{"text":"Moses hnenah Bawipa in, “Aaron hnenah, ‘Na kianghrol in leilung vua awla, Izipt ramsung hmuahhmuahih leivut cu fikfa-ah an cang ding,’ tiin sim aw,” tiah a ti.","title":"Fikfa"},"17":{"text":"Cubangtuk in an tuah. Aaron in a kianghrol cu a lak ih leilung a vuak. Cutikah leivut cu fikfa-ah a cang ih milai le ramsa parah an fu hluarhlo ciamco. Izipt ramsungih leivut hmuahhmuah cu fikfa-ah an cang ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Izipt ramih dawithiam pawl in fikfa cu a tuah an tum ve naón an tuah thei lo. Khawzakip ah fikfa cu milai le ramsa parah an khat."},"19":{"text":"An dawithiam pawl cun Faro hnenah, “Himi cu Pathian ih thiltinak a si,” tiah an ti. Sikhalsehla Faro ih thinlung cu a hak thotho ih, Bawipa ih rak simcia vekin Moses le Aaron ih thu cu a ngai duh hrimhrim lo."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Tiva-ih Faro a feh tikah Faro tong dingin zingpitah va feh awla a hnenah, Bawipa in, ‘Keimah in biak theinak dingah ka minung pawl thlah aw.","title":"Thothe"},"21":{"text":"Na thlah lo asile nangmah le na kuthnuai bawi pawl le na minung pawl parah le na inn sungah thothe ka khatter ding, tiah atu ihsin ka lo tiamcia. Izipt mi pawl ih inn siseh, an dinnak hmun leilung tiangin thothe a khat ṭheh ding a si."},"22":{"text":"Asinain cuih ni ahcun ka minung pawl ih umnak Goshen ram cu ka zuah ding; Keimah cu Bawipa ka si ih hiti in thil a titu cu Keimah ka si kha na theihnak dingah Goshen ramah cun thothe pakhat hman a leeng lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Cuticun ka minung le na minung karlakah thleidannak ka tuah ding. Cuih mangbangza cu thaisun hrimhrim ah a thleng ding,’ a ti tiah va sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa in mangbangza cu a tuah ngaingai ih thothe cu siarcawk loin Faro siangpahrang inn le a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih inn ah le Izipt ramsung hmuahhmuah ah an khat nohno. An ram cu thothe in a siatsuah ṭheh a si."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Moses le Aaron cu Faro in a ko ih, “Feh uhla kan ram sungah hin nan Pathian hnenah thawinak cu pe ko uh,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cule Moses in, “Cuticun a cang thiam lo ding; zianghrangah tile Bawipa kan Pathian hnenih thawinak kan pekmi rannung cu Izipt mi pawl thinhengtertu a si ding. Izipt mi pawl mithmuh ah thawinak kan tuah ih kan rannung thahmi cu Izipt mi thinhengtertu ih a can ahcun lungto in in deng that ding a si."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah kan Pathian ih thu in pek bangtuk in Bawipa hnenih thawinak pek dingah nelrawn ramṭhing ah ni thum sung kan feh a ṭul hrimhrim a si,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Faro in, “Hla tuk tiang nan feh lo ding a si ahcun Bawipa nan Pathian hnenih thawinak pe dingah ramṭhing ah ka lo thlah ding. Keimah hrangah thla cam aw,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in, “Ka feh vete in Bawipa hnenah thla ka cam pei ih thaisun ah thothe pawl cu na hnen le na kuthnuai bawi pawl ih hnen le na minung pawl hnen ihsin an hlo ṭheh ding. Asinain ka minung pawl in Bawipa hnenih thawinak an pek theinak ding thu-ah in bum sal nawn hrimhrim hlah aw,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Faro hnen ihsin Moses cu a feh ih Bawipa hnenah thla a cam."},"31":{"text":"Cule Moses ih a dil vekin Bawipa in a run kimter. Faro le a kuthnuai bawi pawl le a minung pawl hnen ihsin thothe cu pakhat hman taang loin an kiang reprep."},"32":{"text":"Asinain Faro ih thinlung cu a hak sal thotho ih Israel mi pawl cu a suahter duh hrimhrim lo."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Faro hnenah feh awla a hnenah, ‘Hebru mi ih Pathian Bawipa in, hiti in a ti: Keimah in biak theinak dingah ka minung pawl cu thlah aw.","title":"Ṭilva An Thi"},"2":{"text":"Na thlah duh lo ih na hren thotho hai a si ahcun,"},"3":{"text":"napi in ka lo hrem ding ih na ṭilva - na rang pawl, na laak pawl, na kalauk pawl, na cawrual, na tuurual le na me pawl - tlunah natnak ṭha lo a tlung ding."},"4":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ih ṭilva le Izipt mi pawl ih ṭilva cu ka thleidang pei ih Israel mi pawl ih ṭilva cu pakhat hman an thi lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in tikcu a tin zo ih thaisun rori-ah a thlengter ding a si,’ tiin va ti aw,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih a sim vekin a thaisun ah natnak ṭha lo cu a thleng ngaingai ih Izipt mi pawl ih ṭilva hmuahhmuah cu an puul ṭheh. Asinain Israel mi pawl ih ṭilva cu pakhat hman an thi lo."},"7":{"text":"Faro in cuih thuhla cu a zingzoi ih Israel mi pawl ih ṭilva cu pakhat hman an thi lo ti cu a thei. Sikhalsehla Faro ih thinlung cu a hak thotho ih Israel mi pawl ih feh ding cu a duh hrimhrim lo."},"8":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenah, “Tappi-ih vutcam ṭhuam hnihthum in lak uhla Faro ih hmaiah acuih vutcam cu Moses in van ah theh seh.","title":"Khuaihli Hma"},"9":{"text":"Izipt ramsung hmuahhmuah ah leidip bangtuk in a ṭhen-aw thluh ding ih khuazakip ah khuaihli hma a suakter ding ih minung le ramsa pawl cu an hma hluahhlo ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cuticun vutcam cu tappi ihsin an lak ih Faro ih hmaiah cun an va ding. Moses in vutcam cu van ah a theh ih minung le ramsa parah khuaihli a cang ih an hma hluahhlo."},"11":{"text":"Izipt ramih dawithiam pawl cu Moses hmaiah an ra suak thei lo; ziangahtile a dang Izipt pawl vek thotho in annih khal khuaihli hma an tuar thluh ve."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Faro ih thinlung cu Bawipa in a hahter thotho. Moses hnenah Bawipa ih a sim cia bangtuk in Israel mi pawl cu a fehter duh cuang lo."},"13":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Zingthlapit tein feh awla Faro va tong aw. Cule a hnenah, ‘Hebru mi pawl ih Pathian, Bawipa in na hnenah: Ka minung pawl ih in biak theinak dingah thlah aw.","title":"Rial"},"14":{"text":"Tuih ṭum cu nangmah pumpak tlun le na kuthnuai bawi pawl le na milai pawl par hrimhrim ah leilung tlunah keimah bangtuk zohman an um lo ti nan theihnak dingah nasa zetin ka lo hrem ding."},"15":{"text":"Nangmah le na minung pawl parah ka kut hawi in natnak thlenter ningla nang cu siatsuah thluh relrel na si zo ding."},"16":{"text":"Sikhalsehla leilung tlun hmuahhmuah ah ka hminthannak a zai theinak dingah ka cahnak ka lo hmuh ih na nunnak ka lo zuah hrih a si."},"17":{"text":"Asinain nangmah cu ka minung pawl ih tlunah na puarthau thotho ih na thlah duh hai lo."},"18":{"text":"Ngaihnik, thaisun tuih tikcu ah Izipt ram thuanthu-ih a um dah lomi rial napi in ka tlakter ding."},"19":{"text":"Cu a si hrangah, ṭilva siseh, thildang hmuahhmuah siseh, a lengih a ummi hmuahhmuah khum thluh dingin thu pe aw. A lengih a um mi minung le ṭilva tlunah rial cu a tla ding ih innsungih khum lomi pohpoh cu an thi ṭheh ding a si,’ tin va sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭongmi cu an theih tikah Faro ih kuthnuai bawi pawl a hrek cu an thin a phangzet ih an sal pawl le an ṭilva pawl cu inn ah an khum."},"21":{"text":"Asinain a hrekkhat cun Bawipa ih ṭongmi cu zianghman ah an siar lo ih an sal pawl le an ṭilva pawl cu innlengah an taan thluh."},"22":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Na kut vanah thlir awla Izipt ramsung hmuahhmuah ih minung siseh, ṭilva siseh, lo sungih rawlkung tlun tiangin rial a tla ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cule Moses cun a kianghrol cu van ah a thlir ih, Bawipa in nimthlakau le khuari le rial thawn leilung cu a burh ciamco. Bawipa in rial cu Izipt ramah a tlakter a si."},"24":{"text":"A nasa ngaingai mi rial a si ih nimthlakau cu khuazakip ah a hrawh aw zohzo. Izipt ram a thok ihsin cumi cu a roh bikmi thlisia a si."},"25":{"text":"Izipt ramsung khuazakip ah innlengih a ummi pohpoh, minung siseh ṭilva siseh, rial cun a siatsuah thluh. Lo sungih rawlkung hmuahhmuah an tlu thluh ih hramlakih thingkung hmuahhmuah an kiak ṭheh."},"26":{"text":"Goshen ram Israel mi-ih umnak lawnglawng a him; rial pakhat hman a tla lo."},"27":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in Moses le Aaron cu a ko ih, “Tuih ṭum cu keimah ka sual ih Bawipa cu a dik a si. Keimah le ka minung pawl kan mawh."},"28":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah thla cam hram uh. Hi khawri le rial cu kan khop zo. Nan suak hrimhrim ding, tiah ka lo kam. Rei nan um ding hman a ṭul nawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Moses in Faro hnenah, “Hi khawpi sung ihsin ka suah vete in Bawipa hnenah ka baan ka phar ding. Cutikah khawri a reh pei ih rial khal a tla nawn lo ding. Cuticun leilung hi Bawipa ih ta a si ti na thei ding."},"30":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nangmah le na kuthnuai bawi pawl in Bawipa Pathian cu nan ṭih hrih lo ti ka thei a si,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Rial in khumla kung le barli sangvut pawl cu a deng siat ṭheh. Ziangahtile khumla cu a cuut laifang a si ih barli sangvut khal a rah laifang a si."},"32":{"text":"Asinain sangvut le fangtlor cu an siat lo. Ziangahtile an cuut a tlai deuh."},"33":{"text":"Moses cu Faro taan in khawpi sung ihsin a suak. Cule Bawipa hnenah a baan phar in thla a cam ih cuvete in khuari le rial tla cu an reh ih ruah khal a han."},"34":{"text":"Faro in ruah a han ih rial a tla nawn lo ih khuari khal a reh ti a hmuh tikah a sual sal ih a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih hnenah a ṭang lala."},"35":{"text":"Moses hnen ihsin Bawipa ih a sim cia vek thothoin Faro ih thinlung cu a ruh sinsin ih Israel mi pawl cu a thlah duh lo."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Faro hnenah va feh aw. Hi bangtuk mangbangza ka tuahsuaknak dingah amah le a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih thinlung cu ka hakter zo.","title":"Kharbok"},"2":{"text":"Anmah lakah hi bangtuk mangbangza ka tuah ih Izipt mi pawl kha hnihsuahsainak menih ka hman hi na tu le na fa hnenih na run sim dingah a si. Bawipa ka si hi nan zatein nan thei leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cuhrangah Moses le Aaron cu Faro hnenah an feh ih a hnenah, “Hebru mi pawl ih Pathian, Bawipa ih a simmi cu: ‘Ka hmaika-ah ziangtik tiangso lungnem tangdor duh loin na um ding? Keimah in biak theinak dingah ka minung pawl cu feh hai seh."},"4":{"text":"Ka minung pawl thlah ding na el thotho a si ahcun thaisun ah na ramsung ah kharbok ka run thlah ding."},"5":{"text":"Kharbok cu an tam tukah leilung malte hman lang loin an khuh mepmep ṭheh ding. Rial ih a siatsuah lomi thil hmuahhmuah an ei ding ih na ram sungih thingkung hmuahhmuah an ei ṭheh ding."},"6":{"text":"Culawng si loin na siangpahrang inn, na kuthnuai bawi pawl ih inn le na minung pawl hmuahhmuahih inn khal an khat ṭheh ding a si. Na pu le na pa pawl le nan cithlahtu pawl hi ram an thlen pek ihsin thokin an ton dah keel lomi thil siava a si ding,’ a ti,” tiah an ti. Cule an her sal ih Faro hnen ihsin an suak."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Faro ih kuthnuai bawi pawl in, “Ziangtik tiangso hi pa in hnaihnawhnak in pek ding? Bawipa an Pathian cu an biak theinak dingah mipa pawl cu feh ko hai seh. Ziangahtile Izipt ram a siat zo hi na hmu lo maw?” tiah Faro cu an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Moses le Aaron cu an va ko sal ih Faro in an hnenah, “Nan va feh pei ih Bawipa nan Pathian cu nan va biak a si pei cu! Asinain zo pawl so a feh ding?” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cule Moses in, “Kan zatein kan feh ding; kan fanau le kan nutar le kan patar pawl khal an tel ding. Kan fapa kan fanu, kan tuu le kan me le kan caw pawl thawn kan feh ding, ziangahtile Bawipa hrangah thawinak puai kan tuah ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in an hnenah, “A ṭha ko; Bawipa in lo bawm seh. Sikhalsehla nan fanau le nan nunau pawl cu nan fehpi lo pei. Kan hrangih harsatnak suahter dingah in phiar rero a si ti cu a fiang."},"11":{"text":"Annih cu an feh lamlam zik lo! Mipa lawnglawng nan feh pei ih Bawipa cu nan biak pei. Nan dilmi cu cumi a sisi,” tiah a ti. Cuthluh in Faro hnenin a dawi in an dawi hai."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Izipt ram sungih kharbok a thlennak dingah na baan cu phar aw. Thingkung hramkung a nungmi hmuahhmuah le rial ih a siatsuah lomi pohpoh cu an ei thluh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah Moses cun a kianghrol a thlir ih Bawipa in nisuahnak lam ihsin thli a rak hranter ih sun nihlawh le zan khuavar a hrang. Zinglam ah thli cun kharbok pawl cu a rak hrancih ciamco."},"14":{"text":"Izipt ram khuazakip ah an thleng ih a ram pumpuluk in an khat. Kharbok cu an tamtuk ih cubangtuk cu an hmu dah lo. Hmailam khalah cubangtuk cu an hmu nawn lo ding."},"15":{"text":"Leiram lang loin an khuh ṭheh ih an khuh tukah a dum in a dum hmerhmer. Rial ih a siatsuah lomi thingkung hramkung le thingrah hmuahhmuah an ei ṭheh. Izipt ramsung hmuahhmuah ah thingkung le hramkung parah hnah hring pakhat hman a taang nawn lo."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in Moses le Aaron cu zamrangte in a ko ih, “ Bawipa nan Pathian hmai le nanmah hmaiah ka sual zo a si."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah atu voikhat cu ka sualnak i ngaithiam hram uhla hi in pekmi ṭihnungza hremnak hi ka hnen ihsin la sal dingah Bawipa nan Pathian hnenah i dil sak hram uh,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule Faro hnen ihsin Moses cu a suak ih Bawipa ih hnenah thla a cam."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in nisuahnak lam thli cu nitlaknak lam thli cakzetah a vun thleng ih acuih thli cun kharbok pawl cu Tipi Sen sungah a hran thlak thluh. Izipt ram pumpi ah kharbok pakhat hman a taang nawn lo."},"20":{"text":"Asinain Faro ih thinlung cu Bawipa in a hakter thotho ih Israel mi pawl cu a fehter duh cuang lo."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “A sah ih tuk taakah pah luihlo tlak thimkhawzing in Izipt ram sung khuh ṭheh dingah na baan cu van ah phar aw,” tiah a ti.","title":"Thimkhawzing"},"22":{"text":"Curuangah Moses in a baan cu van ah a phar ih Izipt ram cu thimkhawzing sahzetin ni thum sung a khuh thluh."},"23":{"text":"Cutiih khua a thim ruangah Izipt mi pawl cu pakhat le pakhat an hmu aw thei lo ih ni thum sung zohman lengah an suak thei lo. Asinain Israel mi umnak ram ahcun khua a vang ringring ko."},"24":{"text":"Faro in Moses a ko ih a hnenah, “ Bawipa biak dingah feh uh. Nan nunau pawl le nan nauhak pawl khal nan hnenah feh ko hai seh. Asinain nan tuu, nan me le nan caw pawl lawngte nan taanta pei,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cule Moses in, “ Bawipa kan Pathian hnenah mei-ur thawinak le thawinak dang hrangih a ṭulmi ṭilva pawl cu nangmah in in ruahsak a ṭul ding."},"26":{"text":"Cuhrangah kan ṭilva pawl cu kan hnenah an feh thluh a ṭul a si; pakhat hman kan taanta lo pei. Bawipa kan Pathian biaknak ih kan hman dingmi ṭilva cu kan hril ding ih a hmun kan va thlen hlanah cun kanmah khal in Bawipa kan biaknak ah khuimi kan hmang pei ti kan thei ve hrih lo,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Asinain Faro ih thinlung cu Bawipa in a hakter ruangah Israel mi pawl cu a fehter duh thotho lo."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in Moses hnenah, “Ka hmuh ban lonak ah tlanhlo aw. Ka lo hmuh sal nawn lonak dingah ralring aw, ziangahtile ka lo hmuh sal citcet ahcun cuih ni cu na thih ni a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cule Moses in, “Na ti bangin si ko seh; ziangtik hmanah ka hmai i hmu nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses hnenah Bawipa in, “Faro le Izipt mi hnenah hremnak pakhat lawng ka thlengter thlang ding. Cuih hnuah a lo fehter ding. Thungai tile a lo thlah tikah cun hitawk ram ihsin a dawi in a lo dawi hlohhlo hai ding.","title":"Moses In Fatir Thihnak Thu A Than"},"2":{"text":"Cuhrangah Israel mi pawl hnenah sim aw: Nunau khal mipa khal an innhnen pawl kha hlawnthil sui le ngun dil ciar hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in hna a ṭuan ruangah Izipt mi pawl in Israel mi pawl cu an upat hngin ih, Moses tla cu bawi pawl siseh misenpi pawl in siseh mimakzet ah an ruat."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Faro hnenah, “ Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu hiti in a si: ‘Zanṭim ah Izipt mi pawl hnenah ka feh pei ih,"},"5":{"text":"Izipt ram sungih fapatir hmuahhmuah, siangpahrang rocotu ding Faro ih fapatir ihsin thokin fang rialnak ih hnaṭuantu salnu ih fapatir tiangin an thi ding. Ṭilva hmuahhmuahih fatir khal an thi ṭheh ding."},"6":{"text":"Kan dunglam khalah a um dah hrih lo ih kan hmailam khalah a um nawn lo dingmi ṭah le raak cu Izipt ram sungah a khat ding a si."},"7":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in Izipt mi le Israel mi cu a thleidang a si, ti nan theihnak dingah Israel mi pawl cu uico pakhatte hman in, ṭilva siseh milai siseh, a bo lo ding,’ a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah na kuthnuai bawi pawl hmuahhmuah cu ka hnenah an ra ding ih an lu an kuun ding ih, ‘Feh uh, nangmah le na mi pawl feh thlang hram uh,’ an ti ding. Cutikah ka feh ding a si,” tiah a ti. Cule thinheng zetin Moses in Faro cu a tlansan."},"9":{"text":"Moses hnenah Bawipa in, “Izipt ram sungih mangbangza tam deuh ka tuahnak dingah Faro cun na thu a ngai lo ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Moses le Aaron cun Faro ih hmaiah mangbangza hizat an tuah zo. Asinain Faro ih thinlung cu Bawipa in a hakter ih Israel mi pawl in Izipt ram an taan ding cu a siang hrimhrim lo."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Izipt ram thotho ah Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenah cun,","title":"Lantak Puai"},"2":{"text":"“Tuih thla hi nan hrangah kum khat sungih thla hmaisabik a si."},"3":{"text":"Cuhrangah Israel miburpi hnenah: Tuih thla a ni hranak ah mipa hmuahhmuah in an innsang hrang ciarah, innsang pakhat ah tuu note asilole me note pakhat ciar hril hai seh."},"4":{"text":"Innsang pakhat in an ṭilva thahmi an ei thluh thei lo ding asile an minung zat zoh in an innhnen te thawn ṭilva pakhat ṭawm aw hai seh. Minung ziangzat an um ti le ziangzat ciar an ei thei ding ti zoh in a man khal zuul hai seh."},"5":{"text":"A ṭilva cu a him raitluan a si pei ih, a pa kum khat ti a si pei. Tuu asilole me an hril pei."},"6":{"text":"A cuih thla ni hleili ni tiang an ret pei ih a ni hleili zanlam ah Israel mi zatein ṭilva cu an that pei."},"7":{"text":"Cun a thisen hrekkhat cu an lak pei ih, acuih sa an einak ding inn sangka tunrel le sangka tlunah an hnih pei."},"8":{"text":"Zan ah acuih sa cu meisa-ah an em pei ih thilnu tel lo sang le anfangkha thawn an ei pei."},"9":{"text":"A hel in nan ei lo pei. A suan khalin nan ei lo pei. A pum in a lu le a ke le a sungril thawn nan em pei ih cutiin ei ding a si."},"10":{"text":"A sa malte hman zinglam tiang nan hlah lo pei. Nan hlahmi a um pang le meisa-ah nan ur ral pei."},"11":{"text":"Nan ei ding daan cu hiti in a si pei: Nan hnipuan nan taai ah nan ṭem pei, nan kedam nan hruk pei ih nan kianghrol nan kai fekfek pei ih zamrangte in nan ei pei. Ziangahtile Bawipa ih Lantak puai a si."},"12":{"text":"Cuih zanah Izipt ram pumpi sungah ka feh ding ih minung siseh ṭilva siseh an fatir cu ka that ṭheh ding. Keimah cu Bawipa ka si ih Izipt ramih an khawzing hmuahhmuah tlunah thu ka ṭhen ding."},"13":{"text":"Sangka ih thisen hnihmi cu nan umnak inn a si ti hminsinnak a si ding. Thisen ka hmuh tikah ka lo lanta ding. Izipt ram ka hrem tikah nannih cu siatsuahnak nan tong lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Cuih ni cu nan hrangah nan ciin ringring dingmi ni a si ding ih, Bawipa hnenah biaknak puai tiah nan tuah ringring pei. Sankhat hnu sankhat, kumkhua cat loin puai ni a si tiah nan tuah ringring pei,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ni sarih sung thilnu tel lomi sang nan ei pei. Nikhat ni-ah nan inn ihsin thilnu hmuahhmuah cu nan hlon thluh pei; ziangahtile mi pakhatkhat in ni khat ni in ni sarih ni tiang thilnu telmi sang a ei ahcun Israel miphun sungin nan suah pei.","title":"Thilnu Tel Lo Sang Puai"},"16":{"text":"Ni khat ni le ni sarih ni-ah biakkhawmnak nan tuah pei. Hi ni hnih sungah ziang hna hman ṭuan ding a si lo. Senpi hrangah rawl lawngte nan suang thei."},"17":{"text":"Hi thilnu tel lo puai hi ṭhatein nan ul pei, ziangahtile a hi ni-ah Izipt ram ihsin nan zatein ka lo hruaisuak a si. Sankhat hnu sankhat hi ni cu a kumkhua in puai ni-ah nan hmang pei."},"18":{"text":"Thla hmaisa bikih ni hleili ni zanlam in ni kul hluan khat ni zanlam tiang thilnu tel lo sang nan ei pei."},"19":{"text":"Ni sarih sung cu nan innsung pohpoh ah thilnu nan ret lo pei; ziangahtile mi pakhatkhat, ram dangmi siseh, nan phunpi siseh, thilnu rawimi a ei a si ahcun Israel miphun sung ihsin dawi a si ding."},"20":{"text":"Thilnu telmi nan ei hrimhrim lo pei. Nan innsung pohpoh ah thilnu tel lo sang lawnglawng nan ei pei, tiin thu than aw,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Israel hruaitu upa pawl a ko ih an hnenah, “Feh uh la nan innsang hrangah tuu note a si lole me note va hril uhla Lantak aihnak puai hrangah that uh.","title":"A Hmaisa Bik Lantak Puai"},"22":{"text":"Cun hissop thingṭeek pakhat in lak uhla kheng sungih a ummi thisen sungah hnim in sangka tunrel le sangka tlunlam tlang ah hnih uh. A thaizing khua a van hlan lo zohman nan inn ihsin nan suak lo pei."},"23":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl that dingah Izipt ram sungih Bawipa a feh tikah nan sangka tunrel le a tlunlam tlang ih thisen hnihmi a hmu pei ih siatsuahtu vanmi cu mi that dingah nan innsungah a lutter lo ding."},"24":{"text":"Cuih tlunah hi daan pawl cu nanmah le nan tesinfa pawl hrangah kumkhua hrangih thupekmi a si ih nan thlun tengteng ding."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa ih a lo kam cia bangtuk in a lo pek dingmi ramih nan thlen tik khalah hi daan hi nan thlun pei."},"26":{"text":"Nan faate pawl in, ‘Hitiih kan hman daan hi ziang tican so a si?’ tiah an lo sut asile,"},"27":{"text":"nannih in, ‘ Bawipa hnenih pekmi Lantak raithawinak a si; ziangahtile Izipt mi pawl a thah hai tikah Israel mi pawl ih inn tla cu a lanta ih kan inn cu a zuah a si,’ nan ti pei,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Israel mi pawl cun an khuk an bil ih an biak."},"28":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an feh ih cuih thu cu an thlun. Moses le Aaron hnenih Bawipa ih thupekmi vekin Israel mi cun an tuah ṭheh."},"29":{"text":"Cun zanṭim ah Bawipa in Izipt ram sungih fatir hmuahhmuah, Faro ih fapatir, siangpahrang rocotu ding a si mi ihsin thokin leilung hnuai thawnginn ih thawngtla mi ih fapatir tiangin a that ṭheh; ramsa hmuahhmuahih fatir khal an thi ṭheh relrel.","title":"Fatir Thihnak"},"30":{"text":"Cuih zan cu Faro le a kuthnuai bawi pawl le Izipt mi pawl cu an tho ih Izipt ram cu ṭah le raaknak hlir in a khat; ziangahtile fapa thih lonak inn pakhat hman a um lo."},"31":{"text":"Cuih zan thotho ahcun Faro in Moses le Aaron cu zamrang in a ko ih, “Pok uh! Nanmah le Israel mi pawl zamrangte in tlan uh. Ka minung pawl cu taanta uhla feh uh. Nan dil vekin nan Bawipa cu va biak uh."},"32":{"text":"Nan tuu le nan me le nan caw pawl khal nan dil vekin hruai uhla feh uh. Keimah hrang khalah thluasuah in dil sak uh,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl khal in zamrangte ih an ramsung ihsin suak hlohhlo dingah an fial hai; ziangahtile, “An feh lo asile kan thi thluh ngaingai ding,” an ti."},"34":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi pawl cun thilnu tel lo sangvut cu an lak ih an sang tuahnak beel sungah an hnipuan in an tuam ih an liang in an phur ciamco."},"35":{"text":"Moses ih thucah bangtuk in Izipt mi pawl ih hlawnthil sui le ngun le hnipuan pawl cu Israel mi in an dil."},"36":{"text":"Bawipa in hna a ṭuan ruangah Israel mi cu Izipt mi pawl in an hmaizah hngin ih an dilmi hmuahhmuah an ngah. Cuticun Israel mi pawl in Izipt mi pawl ih thilri cu an laksak ṭheh."},"37":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Rameses in an pok ih Sukkoth lamah an feh. Nunau le nauhak siar loin mipa patling hlir thawng zaruk an ke in an feh.","title":"Izipt Ram Ihsin Israel Mi An Suak"},"38":{"text":"Israel mi a si lomi midang tampi le tuu, me le caw tampi tla an hnenah an feh."},"39":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin an kenmi sangvut cu thilnu tel loin sangah an tuah. Thilnu tel lomi sang a si, ziangahtile rinlopi-ah Izipt ram in dawimi an si. Anmah hrangih rawl suannak caan khal an nei lo."},"40":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu kum zali le sawmthum Izipt ram ah an um."},"41":{"text":"Kum zali le sawmthum a kim ni-ah Bawipa ih miburpi cu Izipt ram in an suak a si."},"42":{"text":"Cuih zan cu Izipt ram sung ihsin suak dingah Bawipa in a kilven zan a si. Curuangah cuih zan cu Israel mi pawl Bawipa ih a kilven zan tiah nehhnu san tiangin ulta dingah Bawipa ih hnenah an pek."},"43":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenah, “Lantak puai ih thlun ding daan cu hiti in a si ding: Ramdang mi in Lantak puai rawl an ei lo pei.","title":"Lantak Puai Ih Thlun Ding Daan"},"44":{"text":"Asinain nan leimi sal cun a serh nan tan hnu lawngah a ei thei pei."},"45":{"text":"A laangte ih a ummi le nan saancopmi kuli pawl cun an ei lo pei."},"46":{"text":"Inn pakhat sungah nan ei pei ih a lengah zianghman nan suahpi lo pei. Cun nan thahmi ṭilva cu a ruh nan khiak lo pei."},"47":{"text":"Israel mi zatein puai cu nan tuah pei."},"48":{"text":"Ramdangmi nan hnenah an um ih Lantak puai Bawipa upatnak ih tuah an duh a si ahcun hmaisabik ah mipa hmuahhmuah an serh nan tan ṭheh pei; cuihnu lawngah puai ah an tel thei ding; nan sungsuak Israel mi bangtuk ah rel an si thlang ding. Sikhalsehla serh tan lomi pa cun a ei lo pei."},"49":{"text":"Hi daan pawl in Israel hrin a si mi le nan lakih a ummi ramdangmi khal a huap a si,” tiah a ti."},"50":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi pohpoh in an thlun ih Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenih thu a pekmi vekin an tuah."},"51":{"text":"A cuih ni-ah Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa in a burpipi in a suahter hai a si."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Pathian Hnenih Fatir Peknak"},"2":{"text":"“Fapatir hmuahhmuah cu keimah hnenah nan pek ding. Israel mi lakih fapatir pohpoh cu ka ta an si; ṭilva lak khalah a pa fatir cu ka ta an si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Moses in Israel mi hnenah, “Izipt ram, salih nan tannak ram ihsin nan suah ni, tuihsun hi ciing ringring uh; ziangahtile Bawipa in a baan thacak in a lo suah ni a si. Thilnu telmi sang nan ei hrimhrim lo pei.","title":"Thilnu Tel Lo Sang Puai"},"4":{"text":"Abib thla, tuihsun ah Izipt ram in nan suak a si hi!"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Amor mi, Hiv mi le Jebus mi tla-ih umnak ram cu nan hnenih pe dingin nan pu le nan pa hnenah Amah ih hmin saal in thu a rak kam zo. Cuih ram cu cawhnawi le khuaitizu a luannak ram a si. Curuangah cuih ram nan thlen tikah Abib thla tengteng ah thilnu tel lo sang puai tuah cu nan hngilh lo pei."},"6":{"text":"Ni sarih sung cu thilnu tel lo sang nan ei pei ih a ni sarihnak ah Bawipa hrangah puai nan tuah pei."},"7":{"text":"Ni sarih sung cu thilnu tel lo sang nan ei pei. Thilnu telmi sang siseh, thilnu siseh nan ramsung hrimhrim ah nan umter lo pei."},"8":{"text":"‘Hi hmuahhmuah kan tuahnak cu Izipt ram ihsin kan suah tikah kanmah hrangah Bawipa ih thil tuahmi hngilh lonak a si,’ tiah cuih ni-ah nan faale pawl hnenah nan sim pei."},"9":{"text":"Hiti nan tuahnak cu dunglam thu a lo theih tertu, nan kutah siseh, nan cal ah siseh hminsinnak bangtuk a si ding ih, cuti lawngin Bawipa ih daan cu a sim le a rel nan dai lo ding; ziangahtile a cahnak huham thawn Bawipa in Izipt ram ihsin a lo suah hai a si."},"10":{"text":"Kum khat hnu kum khat a camah feltein nan tuah ringring pei."},"11":{"text":"“ Bawipa in Kanaan mi pawl ih ramah a lo thlenter hai ding; ziangahtile Amah ih hmin saal in nan pu le nan pa hnenah thu a rak kam zo. Cuih ram cu nan hnenih a lo pek tikah,","title":"Fatir Hlannak"},"12":{"text":"nan fapatir hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa hnenah nan hlan ding. Nan ṭilva-ih hrin hmaisa bik fatir a pa tla Bawipa ih ta an si."},"13":{"text":"Asinain laak fatir a pa cu tuu faate in nan tlen pei; nan tlen duh lo asile a hngawng nan khiak pei. Nan fapatir pohpoh cu nan tlen sal pei."},"14":{"text":"Nehhnu ah nan fapa in, ‘Hitiih nan tuah mi hi a tican ziangso a si?’ tiih a lo sut asile, ‘ Bawipa in kan saltaannak Izipt ram ihsin a cahnak huham thawn in rak suah a si."},"15":{"text":"Faro a thinlung a hak ih Izipt ram ihsin in suah duh lo tikah, Izipt ramih fapatir hmuahhmuah, milai fapa siseh, ramsa fa siseh Bawipa in a rak that ṭheh. Curuangah fapatir pohpoh cu Bawipa hnenih hlan an sinak a si; asinain ka fapatir cu ka tlen sal a si,’ tiah nan ti pei."},"16":{"text":"Hitiih nan tuahnak cu dunglamih thu a lo theihtertu, nan kutah siseh, nan cal ah siseh hminsinnak bangtuk a si ding; ziangahtile Izipt ramsung ihsin Bawipa in a cahnak huham thawn in suah a si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Faro in Israel mi pawl a fehter tikah, Filistia tipikap ih a fehmi lamzin cu a tawi bik asinain Bawipa in hi lamzin cun a hruai hai lo. Ziangahtile Pathian in, “Ral an do dingmi pawl an hmuh tikah an thinlung thleng aw in Izipt ramih an kirsal ding cu ka duh lo,” tiah a ti.","title":"Mero Zual Le Meisa Zual"},"18":{"text":"Cuih lamzin ai-ah, nelrawn ramṭhing zin ihsin Tipi Sen lamah Bawipa in a heelpi a si. Israel mi pawl cu ral do dingah timtuah cia in Izipt ihsin an suak."},"19":{"text":"Moses in Josef ih ruh khal a keng; ziangahtile amah Josef in Israel mi pawl cu siatcam in thu a kamter ciami an si. An hnenah, “Pathian in a lo runsuak hai ding a si. Cutikah hitawk ihsin nan suah tikah ka ruh nan keng pei,” tiah Josef in a rak ti."},"20":{"text":"Sukkoth ihsin Israel mi pawl cu an pok ih nelrawn kiangte Etham ah an riak."},"21":{"text":"Sun ah an lamzin hmuhtu dingah mero zual in Bawipa cu an hmaiah a feh. Zan a si tikah tleunak pe dingah le a sun a zanih an feh theinak dingah meisa zual in Bawipa cu an hmaiah a feh."},"22":{"text":"Israel mi hmaiah cat loin sunah mero zual a um ih zanah meisa zual a um."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Tipi Sen An Tan"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl cu dungah siip dingin le Pi-hahiroth hmai, Migdol le Tifinriat karlak ah Baalzefon lam hoih in riak dingah sim aw. Cuih hmun Tipi Sen kapah riak hai seh."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in, ‘Israel mi pawl cu vansaangin an vakvai ih nelrawn ah an taang a si,’ tiah a ruat ding."},"4":{"text":"Cun Faro ih thinlung cu ka hakter ding ih Israel mi pawl cu an dung in a dawi sal ding. Cutikah Faro le a ralkap pawl ka neh ding ih cumi cun ka hmin i thangter ding. Cutik lawngah Izipt mi pawl in Bawipa ka si kha an thei ding a si,” tiah a ti. A sim vek cun Israel mi pawl in an tuah."},"5":{"text":"Israel mi pawl an luat zo tiin Izipt ram siangpahrang an sim tikah, amah le a kuthnuai bawi pawl cu an thinlung a thleng aw sal ih, “Kan thil tuahmi hi ziangso a si? Ziangah so kan sal an sinak ihsin Israel mi pawl kan suahter?” tiah an ti ciamco."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Faro in a raldonak rangleng pawl cu tim a tuahter ih a ralkap pawl cu a fehpi."},"7":{"text":"An rangleng lakih a ṭha bikmi rangleng zaruk, le a parah ralbawi pakhat ciar to in a dang Izipt pawl ih rangleng tla in an dawi."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in Faro ih thinlung a hahter ruangah, ralṭhazet ih a fehsuakmi Israel pawl cu a dawi a si."},"9":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl cun an rang hmuahhmuah thawn Faro ih rangleng le a mawngtu pawl le a ralkap tla thawn Israel mi pawl cu an dawi ih Baalzefon hmai, Pi-hahiroth kiang Tipi Sen kapih an riahnak ah an man."},"10":{"text":"Faro in a hei naih vivo tikah Israel mi pawl cun anmah dawi ih Izipt mi an rat kha an hmu tikah an ṭih ngaingai ih Bawipa hnenah an ṭap an ai."},"11":{"text":"Cule Moses hnenah, “Izipt ramih thlaan a um lo ruangah maw hitawk nelrawn ramṭhing ahhin thi dingih in rak hruai? Izipt ram ihsin in suah ih na thil tuahmi hi zohhnik!"},"12":{"text":"Izipt ramih kan um lai ihsin hitivek a si ding ti cu kan lo sim cia tho lo maw? ‘In hnaihnok duh hlah; Izipt mi hnenah sal kan si ko pei,’ kan lo ti tho lo maw? Hi nelrawn ramṭhing sungih thih hnakin sal si cu kan hrangah a ṭha sawn a si,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Israel mi hnenah, “Phang hlah uh; hnget zetin ding uhla, tuihsun ah nanmah run dingah Bawipa ih tuah dingmi rak zoh uh. Tuihsun ih nan hmuhmi Izipt mi pawl hi nan hmu nawn lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Nanmah ih ai-ah Bawipa in a lo do sak ding. Nannih tuah ding zianghman a um lo. Thlangamtein um uh,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Ziangah so ka hnenah na au rero? Israel mi kha hmailamih nor dingin sim aw."},"16":{"text":"Na kianghrol khai awla, tifinriat tlunah na baan phar aw. Cule tidai cu a ṭhen-aw ding ih Israel mi pawl cu leicaar parin an feh lan thei ding a si."},"17":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl ih thinlung cu hakzet in ka tuah pei ih khuitawk khalah an lo dawi ding. Cutikah Faro le a ralkap pawl le a rangleng le a rangleng mawngtu pawl ka neh ding ih cumi in ka hmin a sunglawiter ding."},"18":{"text":"Cutiin Faro le a rangleng le a rangleng mawngtu pawl tlunih nehtu ka si ih ka hmin sunloih a si tik lawngah Izipt mi pawl in Bawipa ka si hi an thei ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Israel ralkap burpi hmaiih a feh ṭheutu Pathian ih vancungmi cu a ṭhawn ih dunglamin a khor hai. An hmaiih a um ṭheumi mero zual khal cu dunglamah a ṭhawn aw."},"20":{"text":"Izipt ralkap pawl le Israel mi burpi karlakah a ceer. Mero a um ih Izipt ralkap hrangah khua a thim; asinain Israel mi hrangah a vaang. Curuangah zanvaar naih aw thei veve loin Izipt ralkap pawl le Israel mi cu an um."},"21":{"text":"Moses in tifinriat tlunih a baan a phar tikah, Bawipa in nisuahnak lam thli cu napi in a hranter ih zanvaar a hran hnuah tifinriat tawphah-ih leiro a hung lang. Tidai cu a ṭhen aw ih,"},"22":{"text":"tifinriat sungih leiro par in Israel mi pawl cu an feh. An sir le sirah tidai cu phar bangtuk in a tiang aw."},"23":{"text":"Cule Izipt mi pawl cun Faro ih rang hmuahhmuah le a rangleng pawl le a mawngtu pawl tla thawn tifinriat sungah cun an hei dawi thotho."},"24":{"text":"Zinglam khawfingcat ah Bawipa in meisa zual le mero zual parin Izipt ralkap pawl cu a vun zoh ih vansaanglamin a tuah hai."},"25":{"text":"An rangleng ke pawl cu a tarhakter ruangah harsa zetin an ṭhawn-aw thei ceu. Cutikah Izipt ralkap pawl in, “ Bawipa in Israel mi a ṭan ih kannih cu in do a si, kan tlan pei,” tiah an ti."},"26":{"text":"Culaifang ah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Tifinriat tlunah na baan phar awla Izipt mi pawl le an rangleng pawl le an rangleng mawngtu pawl ih parah tidai a ra kirsal ding ih a phim ṭheh hai ding,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule Moses in a baan cu tifinriat tlunah a phar ih khua a van tikah cun tidai cu a ra kirsal ih amah keelah a cang sal. Izipt mi pawl cu tlansuah an tumnak ah tidai cu an pah ih Bawipa in tidai sungah a hlon ṭheh hai."},"28":{"text":"Tidai cu a ra kirsal ih tifinriat sung tiangin Israel mi a dawitu, Faro ih ralkap hmuahhmuah le an rangleng le a mawngtu pawl tla cu a khuh ṭheh hai a si. Pakhat hman an luat lo."},"29":{"text":"Asinain Israel mi pawl cu an sir le sirah tidai cu phar bangin a tiang aw ih tifinriat sungih leiro parin an fehsuak."},"30":{"text":"Cuih ni-ah Izipt mi pawl kut sung ihsin Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa in a runsuak ih Izipt mi pawl ih ruak cu Israel mi pawl in tikap ah an hmu."},"31":{"text":"Ziangtluk huham cak thawn Bawipa in Izipt mi pawl a do ti cu Israel mi pawl in fiangtein an hmuh ruangah Bawipa cu an ṭih; curuangah Bawipa le a salpa Moses parah rinsannak an nei."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Moses le Israel mi pawl cun hi hla hi Bawipa hnenah an sak, “Mangbangza in a neh ruangah, Bawipa ih hnenah hla ka sak ding. Ti sungah rang le a cuangtu pawl, A hlon ṭheh zo.","title":"Moses Ih Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka cahnak le ka thazaang a si, I runsuaktu khal Amah a si. Ka Pathian a si ih ka thangṭhat ding; Ka pa ih Pathian, a maksaknak ka cawimawi ding."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu ralnehtu a si; A hminah Bawipa a si."},"4":{"text":"Faro ih rangleng le ralkap pawl, Tifinriat sungah a paih ṭheh. A kuthnuai bawi ṭhaṭha pawl, Tipi Sen sungah an pil ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"A thukmi tipi cun a khuh hai ih, A tawne ah lungto bangin an pil."},"6":{"text":"Na vorhlam baan thacak cu, Maw Bawipa mangbangza a si. Na vorhlam baan thacak cu, Ral pawl ṭhio thluhtu a si."},"7":{"text":"A nasami na mi nehnak in, Na ral pawl na hlon ṭheh ih, Na thinhengnak a alh tikah, Annih cu fang kuang ro bangin an kaang ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Na hnar na phawt tikah, Tidai pawl an tiang aw, A luanglaimi tidai cu, Phar bangin an ding. A thuk zetmi tifinriat cu, Tikhal bangin a khal ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Kan ral in, ‘Ka dawi pei ih ka man mai ding; An hlawn le an thil hmuahhmuah ka ṭhen thluh pei ih, An hnen ihsin ka duh pohpoh ka duh zatzat ka lak ding; Ka ralnam ka zuk pei ih, An ci ka mit ṭheh ding,’ a ti."},"10":{"text":"Asinain na thaw voikhat na phawt tikah, Tifinriat in a khuh ṭheh hai. Ṭihnungza tidai sungah, Suantum bangin an pil ṭheh."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , leilungih khawzing pawl lakah, A lo bangtu zoso a um? Nangmah a lo bangtu zoso a um? Thianhlimnak ah na ropi, Sunlawinak ah ṭihnungza, Thilti theinak ah mangbangza."},"12":{"text":"Na vorhlam baan na phar ih, Kan ral pawl cu leilung in a dolh thluh."},"13":{"text":"Na duhdawtnak ah rintlak na si, Na tlen ciami pawl na hruai hai. Na cahnak in na minung pawl hi Na hmun thianghlim tiang na khor hai."},"14":{"text":"Leitlun ih ramtin in an thei ih, ṭihphang in an khur. Nausuaknat ih thlaphannak bangin, Filistin mi cu an thla a phang."},"15":{"text":"Cun Edom ram ih uktu pawl cu, ṭihnak thawn an bei a dong. Moab ram ih micak pawl cu, An thin a thir thlohthlo. Kanaan ram ih a ummi hmuah tla, An ralṭhatnak a reh."},"16":{"text":"Ṭihnak le thlaphannak in an khat, Na baan thacak an hmuh tikah cun; Lungto bangin caang loin an ding, Maw Bawipa na luattermi Na minung pawl an lan hlanah cun."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah in na hruai hai dingih, Nangmah ih tlangpar ah na phun hai ding. Maw Bawipa na umnak dingih Na tuah mi hmunah, Maw Bawipa nangmah ih na sakmi biakinn ah na fehpi hai ding."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa cu kumkhua in kumkhua tiang, Siangpahrang a si ding,” an ti."},"19":{"text":"Izipt rang pawl, rangleng le a mawngtu pawl cu Israel mi dawi in ti sungih an vung luh tikah, Bawipa in tidai cu a ciip awkter sal ih annih cu a khuh ṭheh hai. Asinain Israel mi pawl cu tifinriat sungih leiro parin an feh a si.","title":"Miriam Ih Hla"},"20":{"text":"Aaron ih farnu, nunau profet a si mi, Miriam in khuang pakhat a lak ih a dang nunau tla in khuang tum phah in an laam ih Miriam cu an thlun."},"21":{"text":"Miriam cun an hnenah, “ Bawipa hnenah hla sak uh, Sunglawi zetin a neh zo. Rang le rang ralkap pawl cu, Ti sungah a thlak ṭheh zo,” tiah a sak."},"22":{"text":"Moses in Israel mi pawl cu an tim a tuahter ih Tipi Sen ihsin pok dingin a fial. Cule Shur nelrawn ah an feh. Nithum sung nelrawn ah an feh naón tidai an tong lo.","title":"Tidai Khaa"},"23":{"text":"Cutiin Marah ah an va thleng naón cutawkih tidai cu a khaat tuk ruangah an in thei lo. Curuangah Marah tiih an kawhnak a si."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Moses hnenah, “Ziang so kan in ding?” tiah an phunzai."},"25":{"text":"Moses cu napi in Bawipa hnenah thla a cam ih, Bawipa in Moses hnenah thingtan pakhat a hmuh. Cuih thingtan cu Moses in ti sungah a vun thlak ih tidai cu a kha nawn lo. Cutawkah Bawipa in a hniksak hai ih an thlun ringring dingah daan a pek."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Keimah nan Bawipa le nan Pathian thu feltein nan ngai ih a dik ka timi nan tuah ih ka thukham thlun in ka daan hmuahhmuah nan ul asile, Izipt mi pawl hnenih ka thlenter mi natnak pawl kha pakhatte hman nan tuar lo ding. Keimah cu a lo damtertu Bawipa ka si,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cuih hnuah cirh hleihnih le tuumkung sawmsarih umnak Elim ah an va thleng. Cutawkih tikap ah buuk an saam."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi miburpi cu Elim ihsin an pok ih, Izipt ram in an pawhsuak thlahnihnak ni hleinga ni-ah Elim le Sinai karlakih a ummi Sin nelrawn an thleng.","title":"Manna Sang Le Vanim Sa"},"2":{"text":"Cule cuih nelrawn ramṭhing ahcun an zatein Moses le Aaron hnenah an phunzai ih,"},"3":{"text":"“Izipt ramah khan Bawipa in in rak that thluh sawnta sehla kan va duh so! Izipt ram ahcun sakheng kan hil ih rawl kan duh zat in kan ei. Asinain nanmah in in suahpi ih hitawk nelrawn ramṭhing ahhin rilrawng in in thiter thluh ding a sihi!” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Atu-ah nan zate hrangah van ihsin ruah bangin sang ka surter ding. Israel mi cu nitinte an riahbuk in an suak pei ih acuih ni hrang daih in sang cu an sar ṭheu pei. Cuticun ka thupekmi an thlun le thlun lo ka hniksak ding."},"5":{"text":"Ni ruknak ni-ah cun ni dangih an sar keelih lethnih tam in an sar pei ih ei dingin an timtuah pei,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cuhrangah Moses le Aaron cun Israel mi zate hnenah, “Tuihzan zanlam ah Izipt ram ihsin in suahtu cu Bawipa a si ti kha nan thei ding."},"7":{"text":"Cule zinglamah Bawipa ih sunlawinak nan hmu ding. A parih nan phunzainak a thei zo. Asi! Bawipa Amah ih parah nan phunzai. Ziangahtile kannih cu phunzai san tlak kan si ual lo!” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule Moses in, “Zanlam ei dingah sa a lo petu ding le zinglam ei dingah nan duh zat sang a lo petu ding cu Bawipa a si. Ziangahtile voi tamzet a parih nan phunzaimi cu a thei zo. Kannih thamtham cu ziangti tlak kan si ual lo! Nan phunzainak cu kan parah a si lo; Bawipa ih parah a si sawn,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Moses in Aaron hnenah, “Israel mi zate hnenah, ‘Ra uhla Bawipa ih hmaiah ra ding uh; ziangahtile nan phunzainak a thei zo a si,’ tiin sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"An zate hnenih Aaron a ṭong vete in nelrawn lam an hoi ih hmakhatte-ah Bawipa ih sunlawinak tleu cu mero parah a lang."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah,"},"12":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl ih phunzainak cu ka thei zo; an hnenah, ‘Zanlam khawmawt zawng ah ei ding sa nan ngah ding ih zinglamah nan duh zat rawl nan ngah ding. Cutikah Bawipa keimah cu an Pathian ka si hi an thei ding,’ tiin sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule zanlam ah vanim tampi an ra ih Israel mi an riahbuk hrawng cu an khat ṭheh. Zinglam ah riahbuk kiangkapah cun daiti thuah khat a tla."},"14":{"text":"Cuih daiti cu a ro tikah nelrawn leilung parah cun thil phunkhat, a paa ih a peer zetmi, leilung parih tikhal paate bangtuk a um."},"15":{"text":"Cumi cu Israel mi pawl in an hmuh tikah ziang a si ti an thei lo ih pakhat le pakhat, “Ziang so a si?” tiah an sut-aw ton vivo. Cutikah Moses in, “Himi hi Bawipa in nan ei dingah sang a lo pekmi cu a si."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek bangtuk in nanmahte nan ṭul zat ciar nan sar khawm pei ih mi pakhat hrangah khuat li ciarin nan sar pei. Mi pakhat in a riahbuk sungih a ummi zate hrangih a ṭulmi zat ciar nan lak pei,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cun Moses ih sim vekin an tuah; mihrek cun tam an khawm ih mihrek cun mal an khawm."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an tah tikah tam deuh a khawmmi pawl in tamtuk an nei cuang lo ih mal deuh a khawmmi pawl khalin maltuk an nei cuang fawn lo. A khawmtu hmuahhmuah in an ṭul tawk zat ngaingai ciar an khawm a rak si."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in, “Zohman in thaisun hrangah tiah nan ret lo pei,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Asinain mi hrekkhat cu Moses ih thu ngai loin sang malte cu thaisun hrangah tiah an rak ret. A thaizing ahcun a siat ṭheh ih tholung a rak khah ruangah a nam hiamhiam. Cutikah Moses cu an parah a thin a heng ngaingai."},"21":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cun zingtinte an ṭul zat ciar an khawm ṭheu; asinain sunih ni a ling tikah leilung parih a taangmi cu a zup thluh ṭheu."},"22":{"text":"Niruknak ni-ah cun rawl cu lethnih tam in minung pakhat hrang khuat riat ciarin an khawm. Israel mi hruaitu pawl cu an ra ih cuih thu cu Moses hnenah an sim."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in, “Himi hi Bawipa ih thupek a si, ‘Thaisun cu colh ni, Bawipa hnenih ni, sabbath thiang a si. Em nan duhmi atu ah em uhla, suan nan duhmi atu-ah suang uh. Nan hlahmi pohpoh cu a dangte in khawl uhla thaisun hrangah ret uh,’ a ti a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cule Moses ih sim vekin an hlahmi cu a thaisun tiang an ret ih a uih hrimhrim lo; tholung khal a um lo."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in, “Himi hi tuihsun ah ei uh; ziangahtile tuihsun cu Bawipa hrangih sabbath a si ruangah khawlengah zianghman nan hmu lo ding."},"26":{"text":"Niruk sung nan khawm pei. Asinain ni sarihnak ni cu sabbath a si ruangah zianghman a um lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Asinain mi hrekkhat cu rawl hawl dingah khawlengah an feh ih an hawl thotho naón an hmu lo."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Ziangtik tiangso ka thukham le ka daan pawl hi thlun duh loin nan um ding?"},"29":{"text":"Sabbath a lo tuahsaktu cu Bawipa Keimah ka si ti cu thei uh. Curuangah a si ni hnih hrang daih in ni ruk ni-ah rawl ka lo pek. Nisarih ni cu zozo khal mah ih umnak ciarah um ding a si. Zokhal mah ih inn ihsin suak lo ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Curuangah nisarih ni-ah Israel mi pawl cu an cawl."},"31":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in a cuih an rawl cu manna tiah an ti. Manna cu Koriander ci a bang. A raang ih a thawtzia cu khuaitizu rawimi sangpheng vek a si."},"32":{"text":"Cule Moses in, “ Bawipa ih thupek cu hiti in a si, ‘Manna sang cu dawng pakhat sungah ret uh. Izipt ram ihsin ka lo suakter ih nelrawn sung nan feh laiih nan ei dingah ka lo pekmi rawl a si, ti nan tesinfa pawl ih an hmuh leh dingah ṭhatein ret uh,’ a ti,” tiah Israel misenpi hnenah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cun Moses in Aaron hnenah, “Beel pakhat in la awla manna sang khuat li-in a sungah thun aw; na tesinfa pawl hrangah Bawipa hmaiah ret aw,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenih thu a pek bangtuk in Aaron in a tuah ih thukam retnak kuang hmaiah a himnak dingah a ret."},"35":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Kanaan ram an thlen hlan, kum sawmli sung cu manna an ei. Manna cu umhmun an khuarnak Kanaan ram an thlen tiang an ei a si."},"36":{"text":"(Omer pakhat cu efah pakhat ih ṭhen hra ṭhen khat a si.)"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an zatein Sin an timi nelrawn ramṭhing ihsin an pok ih Bawipa ih thupek bangtuk in hmunkhat in hmunkhatah an riak vivo. Voikhat cu Refidim ah an riak ih cutawk hmunah an hrangah tidai a um lo.","title":"Lungpi Ihsin Tidai A Suak (Mipum 20.1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Moses thawn an to-aw ih Israel mi pawl in, “Tidai in ding in pe-aw he,” an ti. Cutikah Moses in, “Ziangah so keimah cu in tawh? Zianghrangah Bawipa cu nan hniksak?” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Asinain mipi pawl cu an ti a haal tuk ruangah Moses parah an phunzai thotho. “Ziangah so Izipt ram ihsin in suahpi? Kan ṭilva le kan tefa pawl thawn tihal in thi thluh hai seh ti in duh ruangah maw a si?” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule Moses cu nasazetin Bawipa hnenah thla a cam ih, “Himi pawl hi ziangtinso ka ti ding? Keimah lehlam lungto in a deen in tum zuakzo thlang a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Israel mi hruaitu lakin a hrekkhat rak hruai awla, mi burpi ih hmaiah rak feh sung uh. Nail tiva na vuaknak na kianghrol kha keng awla feh aw."},"6":{"text":"Sinai tlang ih lungpi parah na hmaiah ka rak ding ding. Lungpi cu vua awla misenpi hrangah in ding tidai a suak ding,” tiah a ti. Bawipa ih a ti bangtuk in Israel mi hruaitu pawl ih hmaiah cun Moses in a tuah."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hmun cu, “Massah,” le “Meribah,” tiah an ko; ziangahtile Israel mi pawl an to-aw ih Bawipa cu hniksak tahrat in, “ Bawipa kan hnenah a um maw, um lo so?” tiah an tinak hmun a si."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Refidim ah Amalek mi pawl in an ra do.","title":"Amalek Mi Pawl An Do"},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Joshua hnenah, “Kanmah lakin mi hrekkhat hril awla, Amalek pawl va do dingah thaisun ah feh aw. Kei cu tlang parah ka ding pei ih Pathian ih i pek mi kianghrol hi ka thlir ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Moses ih fial bangtuk in Joshua in a tuah ih Amalek pawl do dingah a feh; cule Moses, Aaron le Hur cu tlang parah an kai."},"11":{"text":"Moses in a baan a thlir sung pohpoh cu Israel mi pawl in an ral an neh vivo; asinain a baan a ṭhum tikah cun Amalek mi pawl in an rak neh deuh ṭheu."},"12":{"text":"Cun Moses cu a baang zet; a baan tla a zawng ih Aaron le Hur in lungto an lak ih a hnuai ah an ret, acuih parah Moses cu a to ih annih pahnih cu a kapah dingin a baan pawl cu an kai ih an thlir sak. Zanlam nitlak tiang a baan cu an thlir sak ringring."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah Amalek pawl cu Joshua in a neh ṭheh a si."},"14":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Ciin ringringmi a sinak dingah hi ralnehnak thu hi cabu sungah ngan aw; cun Joshua khal sim aw. Cule Amalek mi pawl cu hloral tata dingin ka tuah ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutawkah Moses in biakṭheng a don ih, “ Bawipa cu ka Thantar a si,” tiah hmin a sak."},"16":{"text":"Cule Moses in, “ Bawipa ih thantaar khaisaang uh. Ziangahtile Bawipa in Amalek mi pawl cu sankhat hnu sankhat a do ringring ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Midian ramih puithiam, Moses ih pu Jethro in Moses le a minung Israel mi pawl hrangah Pathian ih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah le Izipt ram ihsin Bawipa ih a suahternak thu tla cu a rak thei ṭheh.","title":"Moses Hnenah Jethro A Leng"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Moses ih nupi, a pu hnenih a kuatmi, Zipporah cu Jethro in Moses hnenah a ratpi."},"3":{"text":"Jethro in Zipporah ih fapa pahnih, Gershom le Eliezer khal a rak hruai. Moses in, “Tluang ramah ramdang mi ka si,” tiin a fapa pakhat cu a hmin ah Gershom a sak ih,"},"4":{"text":"a pahnihnak cu, “Ka pa ih Pathian cu i bawmtu a si ih Faro ih ralnam ihsin i run a si,” a ti ih a hminah Eliezer a sak."},"5":{"text":"Jethro cu Zipporah le a fapa pahnih thawn Pathian tlang thiang kiangih Moses a riahnak ramṭhing ahcun an ra."},"6":{"text":"Cun Moses hnenah a pu in, “Keimah na pu Jethro cu na nupi le na fapa pahnih thawn kan ra a si,” tiah thu a hei than."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Moses cu amah hmuak dingah a feh ih a ton tikah a hmaiah a kun ih a hnam. Cule an harhdam le dam lo thuhla an sut-awk hnuah Moses ih riahbuk sungah an lut."},"8":{"text":"Moses cun Israel mi pawl ih ruangah Bawipa in Faro le Izipt mi pawl parih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu Jethro hnenah a sim ṭheh. Lamzin ih harsatnak an tonmi le Bawipa ih a runnak thu tla a sim ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Cutiih Izipt mi kutsung ihsin a runsuaknak ruangih Bawipa ih ṭhatnak thu a theih tikah Jethro cu a lung a awi ngaingai ih,"},"10":{"text":"“Faro le Izipt mi pawl hnen ihsin a lo runtu Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh. Izipt mi pawl hnuai ih saltuarnak ihsin a minung a runsuaktu Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa cu khawzing dang hmuahhmuah hnakin a tum sawn a si ti ka thei; ziangahtile Izipt mi pawl in Israel mi pawl ih parah huatnak thawn hna an ṭuan laiah hi thil hmuahhmuah hi a tuah a si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Jethro in Pathian hnenah raithawinak le mei-ur thawinak a pek ih, Aaron le Israel mi hruaitu pawl cu Moses ih pu Jethro thawn Bawipa ih hmaiah rawl an hil tlang a si."},"13":{"text":"A thaisun ah Moses cu a minung pawl ih thuṭhen dingah a to ih, a hmaiah mipi pawl cu zing ihsin zanlam tiang an ding.","title":"Thuṭhentu Pawl An Hril (Daan 1.9-18)"},"14":{"text":"Moses ih pu Jethro in cumi a hmuh tikah Moses hnenah, “Mipi pawl hrangih thiltuah na tummi hi ziangso a si? Ziangah so nangmah lawng hiti in na to ih midang hmuahhmuah cu na kimvelah zing ihsin zanlam tiang an din ringring?” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in, “Hitiih ka tuah cu a ṭul hrimhrim a si. Ziangahtile Pathian ih duhmi ziangso a si ti theih duh ah mipi pawl cu ka hnenah an ra."},"16":{"text":"Mi pahnih thu an el awk tikah ka hnenah an ra ih cutikah zoso a mawh, zoso a mawh lo tiin thu cu ka relcat sak ih an hnenah Pathian thukham le daan pawl cu ka sim,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Jethro in, “Na thil tidaan hi a dik lo."},"18":{"text":"Nangmah le nangmah na siatsuah-aw ding ih hi mipi pawl khal na siatsuah ding a si. Na thil timi hi a tam tuk. Nangmah pakhat lawngin na ti cawk lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah ka thu i ngai aw. Ruahnak ṭha ka lo pe ding ih na hnenah Pathian a um ding. Nang cu Pathian hnenah misenpi ih palai na si pei ih an thu cu a hnenah na thlen ding."},"20":{"text":"Cun Pathian thukham le daan pawl cu an hnenah na zirh ding ih an nundaan ding le an tuah dingmi cu na simfiang ding."},"21":{"text":"Asinain thilti theinak a neimi mi hrekkhat hril awla cu pawl cu Israel mi hruaitu dingah ret aw. A thawngthawng, a zaza, sawmnga le pahra-ih hruaitu tla an si ding. Anmah cu Pathian ṭihzahtu le rinsan tlakmi an si pei ih nawhthuh pek theih lomi an si pei."},"22":{"text":"Cumi pawl cu a kumkhua in mipi pawl ih thuṭhentu si hai seh. Thuhar deuhdeuh cu na hnenah an thlen pei. Asinain thu nepnawi pawl cu anmah tein rel hai seh. Cutiin na tuah asile na thilrit an lo phurh bawm ah a cang ih na nuam deuh ding a si."},"23":{"text":"Pathian ih duhnak a si bangin cutiin na tuah asile nangmah le nangmah na siatsuah-aw lo ding ih mipi ih thu cu relcat sak ṭheh an si ding ruangah an innah thawsuakin an kir ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Moses in Jethro ih thu cu a ngai ih a tivek cun a tuah."},"25":{"text":"Israel mi sung ihsin thil titheinak a neimi pawl a hril ih misenpi hruaitu dingah a ret hai. A thawngthawng, a zaza, sawmnga nga le pahra hra-ih hruaitu an si."},"26":{"text":"An nunsungah cat loin misenpi ih thuṭhentu an ṭuan. Thu harsa pawl cu Moses hnenah an thlen. Asinain thu nepnawi pawl cu anmah tein an rel."},"27":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Moses in a pu cu cibai a buk ih Jethro cu a ramah a tlung."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Izipt ram ihsin an suah hnu thlathumnak ni khat ni-ah Sinai nelrawn ah an thleng.","title":"Israel Mi Pawl Sinai Tlang Parah"},"2":{"text":"Refidim ihsin an pok ih Sinai nelrawn an thlen tikah Sinai tlang hmaizawn ah an riak."},"3":{"text":"Cule Moses cu Pathian tong dingah tlang parah a kai. Tlangpar ihsin Bawipa in Moses cu a ko ih a hnenah, “Jakob ih tesinfa pawl Israel mi hnenah hiti in sim aw,"},"4":{"text":"‘Izipt mi pawl parih ka tuahmi cu nan hmu zo a si ih nannih cu muvanlai in a thla parih a fano a thiar bangtuk in ka hnenah ka lo thiar, ti khal nan hmu zo. Cuticun hitawk ka hnenah ka lo thlenpi hai a si."},"5":{"text":"Atu ka thu nan ngai ih ka thukham nan thlun asile nannih cu keimah ih minung nan si ding. Leilung pumpi hi ka ta a si, asinain nannih cu keimah ih hrilmi, ka minung hleice nan si ding."},"6":{"text":"Nannih cu keimah hrangih pekmi miphun thiang, puithiam hnaṭuannak sungah keimah i riantu miphun nan si ding,’ tiin Israel mi pawl hnenah sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Moses cu a feh ih Israel mi hruaitu pawl a ko khawm ih Bawipa ih thupekmi hmuahhmuah cu an hnenah a sim."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah misenpi in, “ Bawipa ih sim bangtuk in kan tuah thluh ding,” tiah hmunkhatah an let tlang. Moses in Israel mi pawl ih thulehnak cu Bawipa hnenah a va sim sal."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Nangmah ih hnenih thu ka sim tikah mipi pawl in an theih ih an lo zum ringringnak dingah na hnenah mero sahzet sungin ka ra ding a si,” tiah a ti. Cule mipi pawl ih thulehnak cu Moses in Bawipa ih hnenah a va sim sal."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Mipi pawl hnenah feh awla, Bawipa bia dingah tuihsun le thaisun an tim tuah-aw hai seh. An hnipuan an sawp pei ih,"},"11":{"text":"tipsun ahcun timtuah ciain an um pei. Cuih ni-ah mi zate ih hmuh dingin Sinai Tlang ah ka rung ṭum ding."},"12":{"text":"Sinai tlang a kimvel in mipi pawl hrangah ramri na tuah pei ih, ‘Tlang parih nan kai lonak dingah le a hram tla nan tham lonak dingah ralring uh. Mi pakhatkhat in a tham asile cu pa cu thah a si ding."},"13":{"text":"Amah cu zohmanih tham loin lungto ih den that a si ding, a si lole thal in kah that a si ding. Minung a si khalle ṭilva a si khalle thah a si ding,’ tiin sim aw. Tuucang ki an tum tik lawngah mipi pawl cu tlang ah an kai pei,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Moses cu tlangpar ihsin a ṭum ih, Pathian bia dingah mipi pawl cu an tim a tuahter. An hnipuan an sawp ih,"},"15":{"text":"Moses in, “Tipsun cu timtuah ciain um uh; nunau hnen khalah it hlah uh,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"A ni thumnak ni zinglamah cun tlang parah khua a ri ih nimthla a kau zukzo. Mero sahzet a um ih tuucangki ringzet ih tummi a thang. Riahbuk ih a ummi hmuahhmuah cu an thinphang in an khur."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in mipi pawl cu Pathian tong dingah an riahbuk ihsin a suahpi hai ih tlang hramah cun an ding."},"18":{"text":"Sinai tlang hmuahhmuah cu meikhu in a tuam ṭheh. Ziangahtile Bawipa cu tlang parah meisa in a rung. Meikhu cu cahmang meikhu vekin a kai ih Sinai tlang cu a pumpi in a hnin durdo."},"19":{"text":"Tuucang ki tummi cu a thang sinsin. Moses a ṭong tikah Pathian in khuari in a run let."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa cu Sinai tlang parih a rung ṭum tikah Bawipa in Moses cu tlangzim parah a ko ih a kawh vekin a hung feh."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Vung feh awla keimah ra zoh duh ah ramri tla an lan lonak dingah mipi pawl ralrinnak vung pe aw. Culo ahcun mi tampi an thi ding a si."},"22":{"text":"Ka hnenih a rami puithiam pawl hman an thianfaiter-awk a ṭul; culole ka cawh hai ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cule Moses in Bawipa ih hnenah, “Mipi pawl cu an hung thei lo ding. Ziangahtile hi tlang cu a ri tuah uhla tlang thiangah ret uh, tiah ralrinnak Nangmah in pe zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Vung feh awla na hnenah Aaron hun hruai aw. Asinain puithiam pawl le mipi pawl cun ramri lan hrimhrim hlah hai seh. Culo ahcun ka hrem hai ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah Moses cu a vung ṭum ih misenpi hnenah a vung sim."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in hiti in an hnenah a sim:","title":"Thukham Pahra (Daan 5.1-21)"},"2":{"text":"“Keimah cu salih nan taannak Izipt ram ihsin a lo suaktertu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si."},"3":{"text":"“Keimah siar lo pathian dang nan bia lo pei."},"4":{"text":"“Vancung ah siseh, leilung parah siseh, leihnuai tidai sungah siseh a ummi pawl hmuihmel cuangin nan hrangah milem nan tuah lo pei."},"5":{"text":"Milem nan bia lo pei; a hmaiah nan lu khal nan kun lo pei; ziangahtile keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si ih thiik nei Pathian ka si. Keimah i huatu parah cun an sualnak ruangah ka hrem hai ding ih an tesinfa san, santhum sanli tiang cawhkuannak ka thlenter ding."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla keimah i duhtu le ka thukham pawl a thluntu ih parah cun ka duhdawtnak cu cat loin san thawng tampi tiang ka thlenter a si."},"7":{"text":"“ Bawipa nan Pathian ih hmin cu duhdah menin nan saal lo pei; ziangahtile Bawipa Keimah in ka hmin cuti a hmangsualtu cu ka hrem ding."},"8":{"text":"“Sabbath ni thiangte in nan ul pei."},"9":{"text":"Niruk sungah nan hna hmuahhmuah nan ṭuan pei,"},"10":{"text":"ni sarih ni cu sabbath ni a si ih Bawipa nan Pathian hrangah a si. Cuih ni-ah cun hna nan ṭuan lo pei; nanmah siseh, nan faate pawl siseh, nan sal pawl, nan ṭilva pawl le nan khawsungih a ra ummi miphundang pawl khal siseh hna an ṭuan lo pei."},"11":{"text":"Niruk sung Bawipa in van le leilung, tipi le a sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah a tuah ih a ni sarih ni-ah a cawl. Curuangah Bawipa in sabbath cu a thlawsuah ih amah ih hrangah a thianter a si."},"12":{"text":"“Nan nu le nan pa nan upat pei; cuticun Bawipa nan Pathian ih ka lo pekmi leiram parah cun san sau in nan nung ding."},"13":{"text":"“Mi nan that lo pei."},"14":{"text":"“Ṭaangṭawm sualnak nan tuah lo pei."},"15":{"text":"“Ruk nan ru lo pei."},"16":{"text":"“Nan innhnen parah a dik lo theihpitu nan si lo pei."},"17":{"text":"“Mi thil nan daw lo pei. Mi inn siseh, mi nupi le mi sal pawl siseh, an caw, an rang le midang ih neih mi hmuahhmuah nan daw lo pei,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in khuari le tuucangki tummi thawm an theih ih nimthlakau zohzo le meikhu suak hluahhlo tlang an hmuh tikah an ṭih tuk ih an khur thlohthlo. Curuangah a hlapi ah an va ding.","title":"Israel Mi Pawl An Thin A Phang (Daan 5.22-33)"},"19":{"text":"Cule Moses hnenah, “Nangmah kan hnenah ṭong awla kan lo ngai ding; Pathian kan hnenih a ṭong ahcun kan thi rori ding,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in an hnenah, “ṭih hlah uh! Ziangahtile Pathian cu amah nan ṭihzah ih nan sual lonak dingah nanmah hniksak ding lawngah a ra a si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Asinain Israel mi pawl cu lam hlatpi ah an ding thotho. Pathian umnak khuadur kiangah cun Moses lawng a va feh."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Israel mi pawl hnenah hiti in sim aw, ‘Nan hnenah van ihsin ka ṭong ih nan hmu zo.","title":"Biakṭheng Hrangih Daan"},"23":{"text":"Keimah thawn ceemcih ih biak dingah ngunih tuahmi khuavang siseh, sui ih tuahmi khawzing siseh, nan hrangah nan tuah lo pei."},"24":{"text":"Leilung ih tuahmi biakṭheng ka hrangah nan tuah pei ih a parah nan mei-ur thawinak le nan pawlkom thawinak pawl, nan tuu le nan caw pawl in nan thawi pei. Keimah biak dingih ka lo simnak hmun kipah nan hnenah ka ra ding ih ka lo thlawsuah hai ding."},"25":{"text":"Ka hrangih lungto biakṭheng nan tuah tikah thirkhen hmangin nan kher lo pei, ziangahtile nan borhhlawhter pang ding."},"26":{"text":"Ka biakṭheng nan sak tikah a parih kainak dingah tiah kailawn thawn nan sak lo pei; nan sak asile nan kai tikah nan zahmawh nan langter sual pang ding, a ti,’ tiah sim aw,” a ti."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Hi a thuailam daan pawl cu Israel mi hnenih na pek dingmi an si:","title":"Sal Neih Daan (Daan 15.12-18)"},"2":{"text":"Hebru mi salih nan lei tikah kum ruk sung sal a si ding. Kum sarihnak ahcun zianghman kuan ṭul loin a luat pei."},"3":{"text":"Sal si a thok tikah nupi nei lo a si ahcun nupi nei loin a luat pei. Nupi nei cia a si ahcun a nupi thawn an luat tlang pei."},"4":{"text":"Asinain sal a si sungah a bawipa in nupi a ṭhit sak ih fanu fapa a nei asile a nupi le a faate pawl cu a bawipa ih ta an si pei ih amah lawng a luat pei."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a salpa in, ‘Ka bawipa, ka nupi le ka faate pawl ka duh hai a si, luat ka duh lo,’ a ti ahcun,"},"6":{"text":"a bawipa in Pathian hnenah a hruai pei ih sangka ah, a si lole sangka tunrel ah a fehpi hnuah a hna a vit pei. Cuticun kumkhua-in a salah a cangta pei."},"7":{"text":"“Mi pakhat in a fanu salih a zuar a si ahcun mipa vekin nunau cu a luat thei lo pei."},"8":{"text":"Nupi ih tuah a tumtu a bawipa ih thinlung a nomter lo a si ahcun a pa in a tlen sal thei ding.
