Phar kil pahnih ih phar tlep pahnih pawl cu a cutiih tuah thluhmi an si."},"30":{"text":"Cuhrangah phar tlep riat an um ih tlepkhat ah tawdam pahnih ciar in ngun tawdam hleiruk an um."},"31":{"text":"Cule lawithing in phartlang an tuah ih, saklam phar hrangah phartlang panga,"},"32":{"text":"thlanglam phar hrangah phartlang panga le nitlaknak lam thlam ih dunglam phar hrangah phartlang panga an tuah."},"33":{"text":"Phar laifang zawnih an bunmi phartlang cu kil khat ihsin kil khat tiang a saumi a si."},"34":{"text":"Phar siseh phartlang siseh, sui in an khuut ih phar parih an bunmi sui kual sungah phartlang pawl cu an hrolh."},"35":{"text":"Puanzar cu mepian, sendup, a senmi tuuhmul le phiarmi puan mankhung, cherub timi ramsa lem pawl cuangin coihcinmawi ṭelhmi puan pawl in an tuah."},"36":{"text":"Puanzar thlainak ah lawithing in ṭhuam pali an tuah ih cuih ṭhuam pawl cu sui in an khuut ih suikual pawl a parah an bun. Ṭhuam pawl dotu-ah ngun tawdam pali an tuah."},"37":{"text":"Puanthlam sung luhnak puanzar cu mepian, sendup, a senmi tuuhmul le phiarmi puan mankhung coihcinmawi ṭelhmi puan in an tuah."},"38":{"text":"Ṭhuam panga an tuah ih cuih parah a kual pawl an bun. Ṭhuam le a zim pawl cu sui in an khuut. Cuih ṭhuam pawl hrangah dar thawn tuahmi tawdam panga an tuah."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bezalel in Thukam Kuang cu lawithing thawn a tuah ih dong hnih le hrek a sau, dong khat le hrek a kau ih dong khat le hrek a sang.","title":"Thukam Kuang An Tuah (Suah 25.10-22)"},"2":{"text":"A sunglam siseh a lenglam siseh sui hlir in a khuut ih a kimvel cu sui in a vel."},"3":{"text":"Sui kual pali a tuah ih khatlamah pahnih veve in a ke pali ah a bun."},"4":{"text":"Lawithing in zawnfung pali a tuah ih sui in a khuut."},"5":{"text":"Thukam Kuang zawnfung cu khatlam kap veve ih suikual ahcun a hrolh."},"6":{"text":"Thingkuang sin cu sui hlir in a tuah ih dong hnih le hrek a sau ih dong khat le hrek a kau."},"7":{"text":"A sinih khatlam le khatlam zim veve ah cherub timi ramsa lem pahnih sui in a tuah ih,"},"8":{"text":"zim khatah pakhat veve a ret. A dangte in si loin a sin thawn an peh-aw thluh."},"9":{"text":"Cherub timi ramsa lem pawl cu a tlunah an thla an pharh ih kuangsin cu an thla in an phen. Hmai hoih-aw in kuangsin cu an zoh veve."},"10":{"text":"Bezalel in lawithing thawn cabuai a tuah ih dong hnih a sau, dong khat a kau ih dong khat le hrek a sang.","title":"Hunmi Sang Hrangah Cabuai A Tuah (Suah 25.23-30)"},"11":{"text":"Sui hlir in a khuut ih a kimvel cu sui in a khap."},"12":{"text":"A tlangkap cu zung li kau in a tuah ih a kimvel cu sui thotho in a khap."},"13":{"text":"Sui kual pali a tuah ih a ke kiang cabuai kiil li ah a bun."},"14":{"text":"Cuih sui kual pali cu cabuai zawnfung a kaitu an si hrangah cabuai tlangkap ri zawn ah a bun."},"15":{"text":"Zawnfung pawl cu lawithing in a tuah ih sui in a khuut."},"16":{"text":"Cabuai parih inmi thawinak hrangah pakan pawl, hai pawl, khuat le kheng pawl cu sui hlir in an tuah ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Bezalel in meivannak fung cu sui hlir in a tuah. A tawdam le a fung cu ṭhazet ih sermi sui in a tuah. A mawitertu pangpar, a mum le a parh pawl tla cu a fung thawn an peh-aw thluh.","title":"Meivannak Fung A Tuah (Suah 25.31-40)"},"18":{"text":"A fung ihsin a ṭeek paruk a suak ih kap khatah ṭeek thum veve an um."},"19":{"text":"A ṭeek ih kipah almon pangpar bangtuk in a mum le a parh thawn a mawitertu pangpar pathum ciar an um."},"20":{"text":"Meivannak fungah almon pangpar bangtuk in a mum le a parh thawn a mawitertu pangpar pali an um."},"21":{"text":"A ṭeek khuahkhat hnuai ah pangpar mum pakhat fingfing a um."},"22":{"text":"Pangpar mum pawl le a ṭeek pawl cu meivannak fung thawn an peh-aw ṭheh; sermi sui pakhat in tuahmi a si."},"23":{"text":"Meivannak fung pakhat parah meivanmi pasarih a tuah ih caiceh le darkheng pawl cu sui hlir in a tuah."},"24":{"text":"Meivannak fung le a thilri hmuahhmuah tuahnak ah sui pawng zakhat a hmang."},"25":{"text":"Lawithing thawn rimthaw urnak hrangah biakṭheng a don. A tung le a vang a can aw ih dong khat sau le kau a si. A saanlam cu dong hnih a sang. A parih a bunmi thingzum pawl cu biakṭheng thawn an peh-aw thluh.","title":"Rimthaw Urnak Biakṭheng (Suah 30.1-5)"},"26":{"text":"A par siseh a parih thingzum bunmi pawl le a kap pali tla siseh, sui hlir in a khuut ṭheh ih a kimvel cu sui in a khap."},"27":{"text":"Suikual pahnih a tuah ih cuih biakṭheng putnak zawnfung pawl hrolhnak hrangah a tlangzim ih hnuai kap hnih ah acuih suikual pawl cu a bun."},"28":{"text":"Zawnfung pawl cu lawithing in a tuah ih sui in a khuut ṭheh."},"29":{"text":"A thianghlimmi hriak culhnak hrangah siti le zihmui tuahtu pawl ih an tuah ṭheu vekin a hmuizetmi zihmui a tuah.","title":"Hriak Le Rimhmui A Tuah (Suah 30.22-38)"}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bezalel in mei-ur thawinak hrangah biakṭheng cu lawithing in a don. A tung le a vang dong nga veve an si. A saanlam cu dong thum a si.","title":"Mei-ur Thawinak Hrang Biakṭheng (Suah 27.1-8)"},"2":{"text":"A parih bunmi thingzum cu a kil kil li ah a bun ih biakṭheng thawn an peh-aw ṭheh. A zatein dar in a tuam."},"3":{"text":"Cuih biakṭheng hrangih thilri pawl: khengkhuar, cawhleek, kheng, thil awh-nak le beel pawl tla cu dar in a tuah ṭheh."},"4":{"text":"Khohriik vekin darpheng a tuah ih biakṭheng a saanlam ih hrek a thlennak dingah acuih darpheng cu biakṭheng ih zim hnuai ah a ret."},"5":{"text":"Biakṭheng putnak hrangah darkual pali a tuah ih zawnfung pawl hrolhnak ah acuih darkual pawl cu darpheng ih kiil li ah a bun."},"6":{"text":"Zawnfung pawl cu lawithing in a tuah ih dar in a tuam."},"7":{"text":"Cule biakṭheng putnak ah a siir pahnih ih a ummi darkual ahcun zawnfung pawl cu a hrolh. Biakṭheng cu thingpheng in a tuah ih a sung a kuatter."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa umnak Puanthlam sung luhnak kotka-ih hna a ṭuantu nunau pawl ih neihmi dar thlalang pawl ihsin kut kholhnak darkheng le dar tawdam pawl a tuah.","title":"Kut Kholhnak Kheng (Suah 30.18)"},"9":{"text":"Puanthlam kulhnak a tuah tikah thlanglam kap kulhnak cu kaih sawmnga a saumi puan mankhung, a phiarih phiarmi in a tuah.","title":"Umnak Puanthlam Kulhnak A Tuah (Suah 27.9-19)"},"10":{"text":"Ṭhuam kul le a tawdam kul pawl cu dar in a tuah ih ṭhuamtlang pawl le ṭhuamtlang khihnak kual pawl cu ngun in a tuah."},"11":{"text":"Saklam kapih kulhnak khal cu kaih sawmnga a saumi puanzar in a tuah ih puanzar thlainak ṭhuam kul le a tawdam kul cu dar in a tuah; cule ṭhuamtlang le ṭhuamtlang kaihnak kual pawl cu ngun in a tuah."},"12":{"text":"Nitlaknak lam kulhnakah kaih kul hluannga a sau mi puanzar a hmang ih puanzar thlainak ah ṭhuam pahra le a tawdam pahra a tuah; ṭhuamtlang le ṭhuamtlang kaihnak kual pawl cu ngun in a tuah."},"13":{"text":"Nisuahnak lamah luhnak kotka a um ih kulhnak puanzar a hmanmi cu kaih kul hluannga thotho a sau."},"14":{"text":"Luhnak kotka ihsin khatlam kapih puanzar cu kaih sarih le a hrek a kau ih ṭhuam pathum le tawdam pathum an um."},"15":{"text":"Kotka ihsin khatlam kap khal cuvek thotho in a tuah; cuhrangah a kulhnak kotka ihsin vorhlam le kehlamah puanzar kaih sarih le a hrek veve a kau ih, ṭhuam pathum le tawdam pathum veve a tuah a si."},"16":{"text":"Puanthlam kulhnak hrangih hmanmi puanzar hmuahhmuah cu a phiarih phiarmi puan mankhung hlir in a tuah."},"17":{"text":"Ṭhuam tawdam pawl cu dar in a tuah ih ṭhuam parih a ummi ṭhuamtlang kaihnak kual pawl le ṭhuamtlang pawl le ṭhuam lu tuamnak pawl cu ngun in a tuah. A kulhnak hrangih hmanmi ṭhuam hmuahhmuah cu ngunih tuahmi ṭhuamtlang in a kai ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"A kulhnak kotka-ih puanzar pawl cu coihcinmawi ih ṭelhmi a si ih mepian, sendup le a senmi tuuhmul le puan mankhung, a phiarih phiarmi in a tuah. Cuih puanzar cu a kulhnak hrangih hmanmi puanzar dang vek thotho in, kaih hra a sau ih kaih hnih le a hrek a hlai."},"19":{"text":"Hi puanzar cu darih tuahmi tawdam pali ih bunmi ṭhuam pali ah a thlaih. Ṭhuamtlang kaihnak kual, ṭhuam luzim khuhnak le ṭhuamtlang pawl cu ngun in a tuah."},"20":{"text":"Puanthlam hrangah siseh, a kulhnak hrangah siseh, puanzar awh-nak kual hmuahhmuah cu dar in a tuah ṭheh a si."},"21":{"text":"Thukham ngannak lungpheng pahnih an retnak Puanthlam sungih an hmanmi thilri pawl cu cazin an tuah ih a hnuailam bangtuk a si. Cuih cazin tuah ding cu Moses in a fial ih puithiam Aaron ih fapa Ithamar kuthnuai ih hnaṭuantu Levi mi pawl in an tuah.","title":"Ih Puanthlam ih Hmanmi Thilri"},"22":{"text":"Judah miphun Hur ih tupa Bezalel, Uri ih fapa cun Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek vekin thil hmuahhmuah cu a tuah ṭheh."},"23":{"text":"Bezalel bawmtu, Dan miphun Ahisamak ih fapa Oholiab cu lungkher lamih zungthiam, pungsan suai thiam le mepian, sendup, a senmi tuuhmul le puan ṭha mankhung pawl tahthiamtu a si."},"24":{"text":"Hmun thianghlim hrangih a cemmi sui hmuahhmuah, Bawipa hnenih an pekmi sui cu biakinn cuai thlainak ih thlai tikah pawng thawnghnih za le sawmkua le pawng nga a rit."},"25":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in mipum siar caanih an pekmi ngun hmuahhmuah cu biakinn cuai thlainak ih thlai tikah pawng thawngsarih zanga le sawmnga a rit."},"26":{"text":"Himi cu Israel pawl in mipum ih an siarmi mi pakhat in, mah-ih pek ding zat ciar an pekmi komkhawmin biakinn cuai khainakih an khaimi zat a si. Mipum siar tikah kum kul le a tlunlam cu an zatein minung thawngzaruk thawngthum zanga le sawmnga an si."},"27":{"text":"Ngun an pekmi zate sung ihsin hmunthiang hrangah siseh, puanzar hrangah siseh, ṭhuam tawdam an tuahmi hmuahhmuah hrangah pawng thawngsarih le zanga an hmang. Pawng thawngsarih le zanga cu tawdam zakhat hrang a si ruangah ngun pawng sawmsarih le pawng nga cu tawdam pakhat hrangah an hmang a si."},"28":{"text":"A taanglaimi ngun pawng sawmnga thawn ṭhuam hrangih ngunkual, ṭhuam luzim tuamnak le ṭhuamtlang pawl a tuah a si."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih an pekmi dar cu a zatein pawng thawngnga zathum le pawng hra a rit."},"30":{"text":"Cuih dar cun Puanthlam sungih luhnak kotka ṭhuam pawl ih tawdam pawl, biakṭheng le khohriik vekih tuahmi darpheng le biakṭheng hrangih thilri hmuahhmuah an tuah."},"31":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Puanthlam kulhnak ṭhuam ih tawdam, kotka ṭhuam ih tawdam le Puanthlam hrangah siseh, a kulhnak hrangah siseh, puan awh-nak kual hmuahhmuah cu hi dar in an tuah a si."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Puithiam pawl in hmun thiang sungah hnaṭuan caanih an hruh dingah tuuhmul in mepian, sendup le a senmi hnipuan sunglawi an tuah. Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek vekin Aaron hrang khalah hnipuan thianghlim an tuah.","title":"Puithiam Hrangah Hnipuan An Tuah (Suah 28.1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Ṭaangthlaih angki thianghlim cu sui, mepian, sendup le a senmi tuuhmul le phiarmi puan mankhung thawn an tuah."},"3":{"text":"Sui cu a tlep a tlep i a phel hnuah mepian, sendup le a senmi pat lakah mawizetih ṭelhcih theih dingin paatete in an aat sal."},"4":{"text":"Cuih ṭaangthlaih angki sihnak ah liangbah hri an tuah ih a sir ah an sih veve."},"5":{"text":"Mawizet ih tahmi taikhap cu acuih liangbah hri pahnih thawn an peh-aw. Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek vekin hi taikhap khal hi sui, mepian, sendup le a senmi tuuhmul le phiarmi puan mankhung a si."},"6":{"text":"A senmi lungmankhung an taat ih a kimvel ihsin sui in an khap. Lung parih mi hmin an kher ṭheu vekin Jakob fapa hleihnih pawl ih hmin cu cuih lungmankhung parah cun an kher."},"7":{"text":"Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in, Israel miphun hleihnih pawl theihsaalnak lungmankhung ih cang dingin liangbah hri pawl parah cun cuih lungmankhung pawl cu an ben."},"8":{"text":"Ṭaangthlaih angki vekin mawizet ih ṭelhmi ṭaangben tla cu an tuah. Sui, mepian, sendup le a senmi tuuhmul le phiarmi puan mankhung in an tuah.","title":"Puithiam Sang Ih Ṭaangben (Suah 28.15-30)"},"9":{"text":"A tung le a vang an can-aw ih bil hnih ah an bil; zungpi bok pakua a saumi le a kaumi a si."},"10":{"text":"Cuih ṭaangben parah lungmankhung tlar li an ben: tlar khatnak ah a sen, a mepian le a sendupmi lungmankhung an ben."},"11":{"text":"Tlar hnihnak ah a taangphaw, a pawl le daimon lungvar an ben."},"12":{"text":"Tlar thumnak ah sendup, a sen le a engmi lungmankhung an ben."},"13":{"text":"Tlar linak ah tangphaw, sendup le a varmi lungmankhung an ben. Hi lungmankhung pawl cu an kimvel in sui in an vel."},"14":{"text":"Lungmankhung hleihnih an ben ih a parah Jakob fapa hleihnih pawl hmin kher in an ngan. Hmin khermi vekin an kher ih lungmankhung pakhat parah Israel miphun pakhat hmin ciar an kher fingfing."},"15":{"text":"Ṭaangben hrangah hrihrual bangtuk in a hrual-awmi sui hlir in sui ṭhi an tuah."},"16":{"text":"Sui tlangkap pahnih le sui kual pahnih an tuah ih sui kual pahnih cu ṭaangben ih tlunlam kiil veve-ah an ben."},"17":{"text":"Cuih sui kual pahnih ah sui hri pahnih an khit ih,"},"18":{"text":"sui hri khatlam zim pahnih cu sui tlangkap pahnih ah an khih. Cuticun ṭaangthlaih angki ih hmailam liangbah parah sui tlangkap pahnih cu an thlaih."},"19":{"text":"A dang sui kual pahnih an tuah ih ṭaangben hnuailam kiil veve ah a sunglam zim ṭaangthlaih angki sangtu-ah an sih."},"20":{"text":"Sui kual pahnih an tuah lala ih ṭaangthlaih angki hmailam liangbah hnuailam ah an khit ih ṭhazet ih tahmi taikhap tlunlam ah an sih."},"21":{"text":"Ṭaangben parih sui kual pahnih cu ṭaangthlaih angki ih sui kual pawl thawn mepian hrihrual in an ṭawnkom ih cuhrangah ṭaangben cu taikhap ih tlunah seep puakpo lo-in, Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek vek cekci in ṭaangben cu a bek thlepthli."},"22":{"text":"Ṭaangthlaih angki hnuai ih hrukmi angki fualpi cu mepianmi tuuhmul hlir in an tuah.","title":"A Dang Puithiam Thuam An Tuah (Suah 28.31-43)"},"23":{"text":"Angki fualpi-ah lu hrolhnak ong pakhat an tuah. Cuih ong kimvel cu an hruk tikah tlek lo dingin a tlang an khul."},"24":{"text":"Cuih angki hnuailam zim cu mepian, sendup le a senmi tuuhmul le puan mankhung pawl in tale rah cuangin an ṭelh."},"25":{"text":"Sui hlir in khingte an tuah ih tale rah karlak hnuailam zim kimvelah khingte cu an thlaih."},"26":{"text":"Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek vekin puithiam hna an ṭuan ih an hrukmi angki fualpi ih thuailam zim kimvelah tale rah zuk ṭelhmi le khingte thlaihmi an um."},"27":{"text":"Aaron le a fapa pawl hrangah puan mankhungih tahmi angki pawl an tuah;"},"28":{"text":"cule lupawng le lukhum tla puan mankhung in an tuah ih, bawngbi tawi pawl cu phiarmi puan mankhung in an tuah."},"29":{"text":"Tai ṭemnak cu Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupeknak vekin phiarmi puan mankhung le mepian, sendup le a senmi tuuhmul thawn an tuah ih mawizetin an ṭelh."},"30":{"text":"Sui hlir in calben thianghlim an tuah ih cakhennak parih cangan bangin a parah, “ Bawipa hnenih pekmi,” tiah an khen."},"31":{"text":"Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupekmi vekin cuih calben pheng cu an lupawng parah an ṭemcih."},"32":{"text":"Bawipa ih umnak inn Puanthlam cu an ṭheh. Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek vekin Israel pawl in an tuah ṭheh.","title":"Hnaṭuan An ṭheh (Suah 35.10-19)"},"33":{"text":"Bawipa ih umnak inn Puanthlam le a thilri pawl, puan awhnak, phar le phartlang, a ṭhuam le a ṭhuam tawdam pawl;"},"34":{"text":"a par khuh hrangah tuucang phaw a senih buhmi, a khuh sintu-ah saphaw ṭha le a khaptu dingih puanṭha mankhung pawl;"},"35":{"text":"lungpheng pahnih an retnak Thukam Kuang le a sin le a zawnfung pawl;"},"36":{"text":"cabuai le cabuai ih thilri le Pathian hrangih hunmi sang;"},"37":{"text":"sui hlirih tuahmi meivannak fung, a meivannak, meivanmi a tlar ih ret ding pawl, a thilri dangdang le meivannak hrangih siti pawl,"},"38":{"text":"sui ih tuahmi biakṭheng, hriak culhnak hrangih siti, zihmui rimthaw, thlam sung luhnak sangka puanzar,"},"39":{"text":"darih tuahmi biakṭheng, khohriik vek darpheng, a zawnfung pawl le a thilri hmuahhmuah, kut kholhnak kheng le a tawdam;"},"40":{"text":"kulhnak hrangah puanzar, kulhnak ṭhuam le ṭhuam tawdam pawl, kulh luhnak puanzar, a hridai pawl le puanthlam hrangih thil bah-nak pawl, Pathian Umnak Puanthlam sungih hnaṭuan tikah a ṭulmi thilri hmuahhmuah;"},"41":{"text":"hmunthiang sungih hnaṭuan tikah puithiam pawl ih hrukmi hnipuan sunglawi, puithiam hna an ṭuan tikah Aaron le a fapa pawl ih hruk dingmi hnipuan thianghlim pawl cu Moses hnenah an rak keng."},"42":{"text":"Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek vekin Israel mi pawl in hnaṭuan cu an ṭheh."},"43":{"text":"An tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu Moses in ṭhatein a zoh ih Bawipa ih thupek vekin an tuah ṭha a si, tiah a hmu. Cuhrangah cupawl cu Moses in thluasuah a pek."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Pathian Hnenah Puanthlam Hlannak"},"2":{"text":"“Thla hmaisa bikih ni khat ni-ah Bawipa ih Umnak Puanthlam cu nan din pei."},"3":{"text":"Cuih thlam sungih Thukam Kuang sungah Thukham Pahra cu nan ret pei ih thingkuang cu puanzar phenah nan ret pei."},"4":{"text":"Cabuai khal nan ret pei ih a thilri pawl khal a parah na ret pei. Meivannak fung ret uhla a parah mei nan vang pei."},"5":{"text":"Thukam Kuang ih hmaizawn ah zihmui rimthaw urnak sui ih tuahmi biakṭheng cu nan ret pei ih luhnak sangka ah puanzar nan thlai pei."},"6":{"text":"Cule Puanthlam ih hmaiah mei-ur thawinak biakṭheng cu nan ret pei."},"7":{"text":"A cuih biakṭheng le Puanthlam karlakah kut kholhnak kheng nan ret pei ih a sungah tidai khal nan ret pei."},"8":{"text":"A kulhnak pawl cu nan bun thluh pei ih luhnak kotka ah puanzar khal nan thlai pei."},"9":{"text":"“Cun hriak nan lak pei ih, Pathian Umnak Puanthlam le a sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah nan culh pei. Cubangtuk in Puanthlam le a thilri hmuahhmuah cu Pathian hnenah nan hlan pei ih inn thianghlim ah a cang ding."},"10":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinak biakṭheng le a thilri pawl khal hriak nan culh pei. Cubangtuk in Pathian hnenah nan hlan pei ih a thianghlim zetmi biakṭheng a si ding."},"11":{"text":"Kut kholhnak le a tawdam khal hriak nan culh pei ih cubangtuk in Pathian hnenah nan pek pei."},"12":{"text":"“Aaron le a fapa pawl cu Puanthlam sangka ah ra hai sehla tidai in kholh-aw hai seh."},"13":{"text":"Aaron cu hnipuan thianghlim pawl hrukter uhla ka hrangih puithiam hna a ṭuan theinak dingah hriak culh in thianghlimter uh."},"14":{"text":"A fapa pawl khal a kiangah ra hai sehla angki hrukter uh."},"15":{"text":"An pa hriak nan culh vek thothoin a fapa pawl khal hriak culh uh; cuticun ka hrangah puithiam hna an ṭuan ding. Hriak culhmi an si ruangah kumkhua in puithiam hna an ṭuan ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek vekin Moses in a tuah."},"17":{"text":"Cuhrangah Izipt ram an taan hnu kum hnihnak, thla hmaisa bikih ni khat ni-ah Bawipa ih Umnak Puanthlam cu an dingter."},"18":{"text":"Amah Moses rori in a dingter a si. Moses in ṭhuam tawdam pawl cu a ret ih ṭhuam pawl cu a phun; phartlang pawl khal a bun ih phar pawl khal a song ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"A khuh pawl cu a pharh ih Bawipa ih thupek vekin Puanthlam cu a khuh."},"20":{"text":"Cun thukham ngannak lungpheng pawl cu a lak ih Thukam Kuang sungah a ret. Zawnfung pawl cu thingkuang parih thlaihmi a kual sungah a hrolh ih thingkuang cu a sin."},"21":{"text":"Pathian umnak Puanthlam sungah Thukham Kuang cu a ret ih lang lo dingin puanzar in a phenter. Bawipa ih thupek bangtuk in thukham ngannak lungpheng pawl retnak kuang cu puanzar in hitivek in a phenter a si."},"22":{"text":"Puanthlam sungah cun cabuai khal a ret; thlam sung saklam kap deuhah puanzar lengah a ret ih,"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek vekin Bawipa ih hrangih hunmi sang cu cabuai parah a ret."},"24":{"text":"Thlam sung thotho ahcun thlanglam kap cabuai ih siir zawn ah meivannak fung a ret."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek vekin Bawipa ih hmai ahcun meivannak parih van dingmi mei-inn pawl a ret."},"26":{"text":"Sui ih tuahmi zihmui rimthaw urnak biakṭheng cu puanzar hmai zawn ah a ret."},"27":{"text":"Cuih biakṭheng parah Bawipa ih thupek bangtuk in zihmui rimthaw cu mei in a ur."},"28":{"text":"Puanthlam sung luhnak sangka ah puan a zaar."},"29":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinak hrangih biakṭheng cu sangka hmaiah a ret. Cuih biakṭheng parah pekmi rawl a ret ih mei-ur thawinak khal a tuah ih Bawipa ih thupek vekin sa pawl cu cem koin a kangter thluh."},"30":{"text":"Cuih biakṭheng le Puanthlam karlakah kut kholhnak kheng a ret ih kholh awknak dingah tidai khal a ret."},"31":{"text":"Cuih tidai cun Moses, Aaron le Aaron ih fapa pawl in an kut le an ke an kholh."},"32":{"text":"Bawipa ih Puanthlam sungih an luh tikah siseh, biakṭheng ih an feh tikah siseh, Bawipa ih thupek vekin an kholh-aw hmaisa ṭheu."},"33":{"text":"Puanthlam le biakṭheng kimvelih kulhnak hruang tla cu Moses in a tuah ṭheh ih kulhnak kotka khalah puan a zaar. Cuticun Moses in hnaṭuan hmuahhmuah cu a ṭheh."},"34":{"text":"Puanthlam cu mero in a tuam ih Bawipa ih sunlawinak tleu in a khat.","title":"ih Puanthlam Tlunih Mero (Mipum 9.15-23)"},"35":{"text":"Cutiin Bawipa ih sunlawinak tleu in a khah ruangah a sungah Moses a lut thei lo."},"36":{"text":"Hmunkhat ihsin hmun dangih Israel mi pawl an ṭhawn tikah Pathian umnak Puanthlam ihsin mero a kian tik lawnglawngah an ṭhawn ṭheu."},"37":{"text":"Mero a kiang lo asile hmun dangah an ṭhawn lo."},"38":{"text":"Ramṭhing lakih an vahvaih sung hmuahhmuahah Bawipa an hnenah a um ti langternak ah Puanthlam tlunah sunah mero an hmu ih zanah mei a vang ringring ti an hmu."}}}}},"3":{"info":{"name":"Puithiam Hnaṭuannak","shortname":"Pui","abbr":[],"desc":"Puithiam hnaṭuannak (leviticus)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses cu Bawipa umnak Puanthlam ihsin a ko ih,","title":"A Pum Ih Mei-ur Thawinak"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Pathian hnenih thawinak an pek tikih thlun dingah a hnuailam daan pawl cu a pek. Zokhal Bawipa hnenih thawinak a pek asile a cawrual sung ihsin, a si lole a tuu le a merual sung ihsin a si pei."},"3":{"text":"A cawrual sung ihsin mei-ur thawinak a pek ahcun raitluanmi cawcang a si pei. Bawipa ih cohlanmi a sinak dingah a cawcang cu Bawipa umnak Puanthlam sangka ah a rak keng ding."},"4":{"text":"Cule a cawcang ih lu parah a kut a suang pei; cumi cu Bawipa in sualngaithiamnak raithawi-ah a cohlan sak ding."},"5":{"text":"Cutawkah a cawcang cu a that pei ih Aaron fapa puithiam pawl in cawcang ih thisen cu Bawipa hnenih an pek hnuah Puanthlam sangka ih a ummi biakṭheng ih kap li-ah cun an theh pei."},"6":{"text":"Cun a cawcang cu a vun a hawk pei ih a sa a can thluh pei."},"7":{"text":"Aaron fapa puithiam pawl in biakṭheng parah cun zanthing an ret pei ih meisa an muah pei."},"8":{"text":"Cule can ciami sa cu a lu le a thau pawl thawn meisa parah an ret pei."},"9":{"text":"Amah in a sungril pawl le a dunglam ke pawl cu a kholh pei ih puithiam in sa cu biakṭheng parah a zatein a ur thluh pei. Himi cu Bawipa hrangah a rim a thawmi mei-ur thawinak a si."},"10":{"text":"Zokhal a tuurual sungin, a si lole a merual sungin thawinak a pek asile, raitluanmi tuucang, a si lole mecang a si pei."},"11":{"text":"Biakṭheng ihsin saklam kapah a ṭilva cu a that pei ih a thisen cu biakṭheng ih kap li-ah puithiam pawl in an theh pei."},"12":{"text":"Cule a sa cu a can ṭheh hnuah puithiam in a zatein a lu le a thau thawn meisa parah a ret pei."},"13":{"text":"Amah in a sungril le a dunglam ke pawl a kholh pei ih puithiam in thawinak sa cu Bawipa ih hnenah a pek pei ih biakṭheng parah cun a zatein a ur pei. Himi cu Bawipa ih hrangah a rim a thawmi mei-ur thawinak a si."},"14":{"text":"Mi pakhat in vate cu mei-ur thawinakih a pek asile thuro a si lole laileng note a si pei."},"15":{"text":"Puithiam in vate cu biakṭheng ah a keng pei ih a hngawng a merhtan pei ih a lu cu biakṭheng parah a ur pei. A thisen cu biakṭheng ih kap ah kang ko in a thler pei."},"16":{"text":"A cur le a cur sung ummi pawl a lak pei ih vutcam an retnak, biakṭheng ihsin nisuahnak lamah a hlon pei."},"17":{"text":"A thla in a kai pei ih a thla pawl cat lo tein a ruangpi cu a bauh pei ih biakṭheng parah a ur pei. Cumi cu Bawipa lungawi tertu rimthaw thawinak a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi pakhat in Bawipa hnenih thlairawl thawinak a tuah tikah hmaisabik ah a fang cu a rial dip thluh pei ih sangphut ah a cang ding. Cuih hnuah olif siti le rimhmui a toih pei ih,","title":"Thlairawl Thawinak"},"2":{"text":"Aaron hrin puithiam pawl ih hnenah a keng pei. Rialdip ciami sangphut cu puithiam in zate-khat in a lak pei ih, siti le rimhmui pawl thawn Bawipa hnenih pekmi a si, ti langternak ah biakṭheng parah a ur pei. Cutiih fang urmi rim cu Bawipa hrangah rimthaw a si."},"3":{"text":"A taangmi sangphut cu puithiam pawl ih ta a si. Bawipa hnenih pekmi sangphut sung ihsin lakmi a si ruangah a thiangmi a si."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih an pekmi thlairawl thawinak cu rawhnak ih rawh ciami sangrawh a si ahcun thilnu rawi lomi a si pei. Cutiih urmi rawlrim cu Bawipa ih hrangah rimthaw a si."},"10":{"text":"Thlairawl thawinak sung ihsin a taangmi pawl cu Aaron le a fapa pawl ih ta a si; Bawipa hnenih pekmi rawl sung ihsin lakmi a si hrangah a thiang zetmi a si."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih thlairawl thawinak nan pekmi hmuahhmuah cu thilnu rawi lomi an si thluh pei. Thawinak nan pekmi hmuahhmuah ci phulh ṭheh uh."},"14":{"text":"Thlaithar hmaisa bikmi thlairawl thawinak Bawipa hnenih nan pek tikah nan kan ciami, a si lole nan den ciami a si pei."},"15":{"text":"Cuih tlunah olif siti nan toih pei ih rimhmui tla nan toih pei."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih mei-ur thawinak pekmi a si, ti langternak dingah nan pekmi sangphut hrekkhat le siti le rimhmui hmuahhmuah cu puithiam in a ur ṭheh pei."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi pakhat in remnak hrangih thawinak tuah dingah a caw a pek asile cawcang a si lole cawpi raitluan a si pei.","title":"Remnak Thawinak"},"2":{"text":"A caw-ih lu parah a kut a suang pei ih Bawipa umnak Puanthlam ih sangka ahcun a caw cu a that pei. Cule Aaron hrin puithiam pawl in biakṭheng ih kap li-ah caw thisen cu an theh pei ih,"},"3":{"text":"a dang sa pawl cu Bawipa ih hnenah an pek pei: a sungril parih a kopmi thau pawl,"},"4":{"text":"a kaileng pawl le a parih ummi thau pawl le a thinhnun parih a ummi thau pawl an si pei."},"5":{"text":"Hi pawl hmuahhmuah cu mei-ur thawinakih pekmi pawl thawn puithiam pawl in biakṭheng parah an ur pei. A tuu ih thisen cu Aaron hrin puithiam pawl in biakṭheng ih kap li-ah an theh pei."},"9":{"text":"Cule a hnuailam ih sa pawl cu Bawipa hnenah an pek pei: a sungih a ummi a hlap hmuahhmuah, a sungril parih a ummi thau hmuahhmuah,"},"10":{"text":"a kaileng pawl le a parih a ummi thau pawl le a thinhnun parih ummi thau hmuahhmuah an si pei."},"11":{"text":"Hi hmuahhmuah Bawipa hnenih pekmi pawl cu puithiam in biakṭheng parah a ur pei. Himi cu Bawipa hnenih mei-ur thawinakih pekmi rawl a si."},"12":{"text":"Mi pakhat in me a pek asile,"},"13":{"text":"a me-ih lu parah a kut a suang pei ih Puanthlam ih hmaiah a that pei. Cule puithiam pawl in a thisen cu biakṭheng ih kap li-ah an theh pei ih,"},"14":{"text":"a tanglam ih sa pawl cu Bawipa hnenah an pek pei: a sungril parih ummi thau hmuahhmuah,"},"15":{"text":"a kaileng pawl le a kaileng parih ummi thau pawl le a thinhnun parih ummi thau hmuahhmuah an si pei."},"16":{"text":"Himi hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa hnenih urmi rimthaw si dingah puithiam in biakṭheng parah a ur pei. A thau hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih ta a si."},"17":{"text":"A thau siseh a thisen siseh, Israel mi cun nan ei hrimhrim lo pei; himi cu san khat hnu san khat, khuitawk hmunih nan um khalle nan thlun dingmi daan a si."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat a sual ih Bawipa ih thukham a buar pang a si ahcun, a hnuailam ih daan pawl cu thlun tengteng dingah Israel mi hnenih sim dingah Bawipa in Moses cu thu a pek.","title":"Sualthlah Thawinak","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Hriakculh Puithiam Sang a sual ih Israel mi hnenih mawhnak a thlenter a si ahcun, a sual thlahnak ah raitluan cawcang a keng pei ih Bawipa ih hnenah thawinak a tuah pei."},"4":{"text":"A cawcang cu Bawipa umnak puanthlam sangka ah a hruai pei, a caw lu parah a kut a suang pei-ih Bawipa hmaiah cutawk ahcun a that pei."},"5":{"text":"Cule cuih puithiam cun a caw-ih thisen hrekkhat a lak pei ih Puanthlam sungah cun a fehpi pei."},"6":{"text":"A cuih thisen sungah a mehtok kutzung a hnim pei ih a thiangmi puanzar ih hmaiah voi sarih tiang thisen cu a theh pei."},"7":{"text":"Cule Puanthlam sungih rimhmui urnak biakṭheng ki pawl parah acuih thisen hrekkhat cu a hnih pei ih a taang hrihmi thisen cu Puanthlam sung vung lutnakih a ummi mei-ur thawinak hrangih hmanmi biakṭheng hram ah a thlet thluh pei."},"8":{"text":"Hi caw-ih thau hmuahhmuah, a sungril pawl ih thau le,"},"9":{"text":"a kaileng pawl le a thau cu a lak pei ih mei-ur thawinak biakṭheng parah a ur pei."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a vun, a sa hmuahhmuah, a lu, a ke pawl le a sungril hmuahhmuah a lak pei ih,"},"12":{"text":"an riahnak hmun ihsin hnarpawn vutcam an thletnak hmun thiangfai ih thingpen parah a ur pei."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa ih thukham buar pangih Bawipa hmaiih a sualtu cu Israel mipi an zate an si ahcun,"},"14":{"text":"an A man cu upa pawl ih khiah vekin a si pei."},"16":{"text":"A pek lomi Bawipa ih thil thiang pawl cu a kuan sal pei ih cuih tlunah a hlei in zateek kul a kuan pei. Hi thawinak cu a thiang zetmi a si.","title":"Mawhnak Thawinak"},"2":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinak hrangih sa pawl an thahnak hmun, biakṭheng saklam kapah hi thawinak sa cu an that pei ih a thisen cu biakṭheng ih kap li-ah hnih a si pei."},"3":{"text":"A thau hmuahhmuah cu an lak pei ih biakṭheng parah thawinakah pek a si pei: a meifi thau, a sungril parih a kopmi thau pawl,"},"4":{"text":"a kaileng pawl le a kaileng parih a kopmi thau pawl le a thinhnunih thau pawl an si pei."},"5":{"text":"A thau hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa hnenih mei-ur thawinak in pekmi a si ruangah puithiam in biakṭheng parah a ur pei. Himi cu mawhnak thawinak a si."},"6":{"text":"Puithiam hrinih mipa cun an ei thei. Thawinak thiang a si ruangah hmun thiang sung hrimhrim ah an ei pei."},"7":{"text":"Sualthlah thawinakah siseh, mawhnak thawinakah siseh, bangrep ih hman dingmi daan pakhat cuih thawinakih hmanmi sa pawl cu thawinak a petu puithiam ih ta an si, tihi a si."},"8":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinakih pekmi sa-ih a vun cu thawinak a petu puithiam ih ta a si."},"9":{"text":"Sang rawhnak ih rawhmi siseh, uhkang a si lole thirbel ih kan ciami thlairawl thawinak hmuahhmuah cu Pathian hnenih a petu puithiam ih ta a si."},"10":{"text":"Asinain kan lomi le suan lomi thlairawl thawinak hmuahhmuah cu a ro a si khalle siti thawn rawimi a si khalle, Aaron hrin puithiam pawl ih ta a si ih anmah sungah bangrep in an zem aw pei."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih pekmi remnak thawinak an tuah tikah a tanglam ih daan pawl hi thlun ding a si.","title":"Remnak Thawinak"},"12":{"text":"Mi pakhat in a lungawinak Pathian hnenah phuan a duh ih thawinak a pek a si ahcun thawinak ṭilva le thilnu tel lo sang thawn a pek pei. Sang cu sangphut ih tuahmi, olif siti thawn rawi ih a sah zetih tuahmi, asilole olif siti ih hnihmi sang paate, a si lole sangphut ih tuahmi olif siti thawn rawimi a si pei."},"13":{"text":"Cuih tlunah thilnu thawn rawi ih rawhmi sang pawl tla a pek pei."},"14":{"text":"Sang phun khat ihsin malte ciar a hleice laksawng ah Bawipa hnenah a pek pei; cumi cu biakṭheng parah sathi a thehtu puithiam ih ta a si pei."},"15":{"text":"An thah sunah sa cu an ei tengteng pei; a thaizing tiang zianghman an taangter lo pei."},"16":{"text":"Mi pakhat in a thukammi kimternakah remnak thawinak a pek, asilole amah ih lungtho in a pekmi thawinak a rak ken a si ahcun an thah sunah a sa cu an ei pei; an hlahmi a um asile a thaisun ah an ei thluh pei."},"17":{"text":"A ni thumnak tiang a taangmi sa cu an ur thluh pei."},"18":{"text":"A ni thumnak tiang a taangmi sa an ei a si ahcun cupa ih thawinak cu Pathian in a saang lo ding. A peknak cu thawinak ah siar a si lo pei ih thil borhhlawh sawnah ruat a si pei ih, a eitu in a raibuar man cu a tuar ding a si."},"19":{"text":"A cuih thawinak sa cu thil thiang lo thawn an dai aw a si ahcun ei a si lo pei; a zatein ur ṭheh ding a si. Cuih sa cu mithiang pawl in an ei thei pei;"},"20":{"text":"thian lonak a neitu pawl in an ei asile a eitu cu Pathian ih miphun sungah siarcih a si nawn lo pei."},"21":{"text":"Cuih tlunah milai siseh, ṭilva siseh, a thiang lomi thil pakhatkhat a dai hnuah hi thawinak sa a ei asile amah cu Pathian ih miphun sungah siarcih a si nawn lo pei."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi pawl hrangah,"},"23":{"text":"a tanglam ih daan pawl hi Moses hnenah a pek. Caw thau siseh, tuu thau siseh, asilole me thau khal siseh, an ei lo pei."},"24":{"text":"Amahte a thimi, asilole sahrang ih dehmi ṭilva ih thau khal an ei hrimhrim lo pei. Asinain poihai dang an ṭulnak ahcun an hmang thei pei."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih pekmi thawinak sathau a eitu cu Pathian ih miphun lakah siarcih a si nawn lo pei."},"26":{"text":"Khuitawk hmunih an um a si khalle Israel mi cun vate thisen siseh ṭilva thisen siseh an ei lo pei."},"27":{"text":"Hi daan a buartu cu Pathian ih miphun sungah siarcih a si nawn lo pei."},"28":{"text":"Israel mi hrangah a tanglam ih daan pawl cu,"},"29":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah a pek. Remnak thawinak a petu in a pekmi hrekkhat cu a hleice in Bawipa hnenah laksawngah a pek pei."},"30":{"text":"A pek tikah amah ih kut rori in a keng pei. Ṭilva ih thau cu a ir thawn a keng pei ih laksawng hleice ah Bawipa hnenah a pek pei."},"31":{"text":"A thau cu puithiam in biakṭheng parah a ur pei. Asinain a ir cu puithiam pawl ih ta a si."},"32":{"text":"A vorhlam kawng cu remnak thawinak thau le thisen Bawipa hnenih a petu puithiam hnenah,"},"33":{"text":"a hleice ih laksawngah pek a si pei."},"34":{"text":"A ir sa cu laksawng hleice a si; a vorhlam kawng cu Bawipa in Israel mi hnen ihsin a lak ih puithiam pawl hnenah a pek a si, ti langternak ih pekmi a si. Himi cu a kumkhua in Israel mi pawl in an pek ringring dingmi a si."},"35":{"text":"Himi cu Aaron le a fapa pawl hriakculhnak an ngah ih puithiam an can ni ah Bawipa hnenih an pekmi rawl sung ihsin Aaron le a fapa pawl ih covo an si."},"36":{"text":"Cuih ni ah hi thawinak sung ihsin puithiam pawl pek dingah Bawipa in Israel mi hnenah thu a pekmi a si. Himi cu sankhat hnu sankhat Israel mi in an thlun dingmi daan a si."},"37":{"text":"A tlunlam ih daan cu mei-ur thawinak, thlairawl thawinak, sualthlah thawinak, mawhnak thawinak, hriakculh thawinak, le remnak thawinak pawl hrangih daan an si."},"38":{"text":"Hi daan pawl cu nelrawn hramlak Sinai Tlang parah Pathian in Moses hnenah Israel mi pawl ih tuah ding thawinak thu pawl a sim ni ah a pekmi an si."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Aaron Le A Fapa Pawl Hriakculhnak (Suah 29.1-37)"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron le a fapa pawl cu Thukham retnak Puanthlam ih sangka ah fehpi hai awla puithiam thilthuam pawl, hriak culhnak ding siti, sualthlah thawinak hrangih cawcangte pakhat, tuucang pahnih le thilnu tel lo sang bawm khat pawl tla keng aw."},"3":{"text":"Cule Israel miphun zatein cutawkah cun ko thluh hai aw,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek bangtuk in Moses cun a tuah ih an zate ih an pumkhawm tikah,"},"5":{"text":"Moses in, “Ka tuahmi pawl hi Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a fapa pawl cu hmaiah a suahpi ih thiannak ah ti a kholh awkter hai."},"7":{"text":"Aaron cu kor le korfualpi a hrukter ih taiṭemnak in a taai a ṭem. Cule ṭaangthlaih thianghlim a hrukter ih mawi zetih tahmi taikhap in a tai a khap."},"8":{"text":"Cuih hnuah ṭaangben a benter ih a sungah Urim le Thummim a ret."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek vekin lupawng a pawnter ih a lupawng ih hmailamah cun “ Bawipa hnenih pekmi,” tiih cakhenmi sui pheng a ben."},"10":{"text":"Cun Moses in hriakculhnak siti cu a lak ih Bawipa umnak Puanthlam le a sungih a ummi thil hmuahhmuah cu a hnih thluh ih an zatein Bawipa hnenih thiantermi-ah an cang."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa hrangih thianter dingah Moses in hriak hrekkhat cu a lak ih biakṭheng le a thuamhnaw pawl, maihum le a tohkaal pawl le a hram pawl cu voi sarih tiang a theh."},"12":{"text":"Cule Moses in Aaron cu a lu ah hriak toih tahrat in pumpeknak le hriakculhnak a tuahsak."},"13":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Moses in Aaron ih fapa pawl cu hmaiah a suahpi ih korfual a hrukter hai ih an tai ah taiṭemnak in a ṭem ih Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in lukhuh a khumter."},"14":{"text":"Cule sualthlah thawinak hrangih cawcang cu Moses in a rak hruai ih Aaron le a fapa pawl in cawcang ih lu parah an kut an suang."},"15":{"text":"Moses in cawcang cu a that ih a thisen hrekkhat a lak hnuah Bawipa hnenih thiantermi a si ti-nakah biakṭheng ki parah thisen cu a kutzung in a hnih. Cule a taangmi thisen cu biakṭheng hramah a thlet. Cuticun Moses in Bawipa hnenah a pek ih biakṭheng cu a thianter."},"16":{"text":"Moses in a sungril parih thau hmuahhmuah, a kaileng pawl, a kaileng parih thau pawl le a thinhnun parih thau pawl a lak ih a zate in biakṭheng parah a ur ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Cun Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in a sa dang hmuahhmuah - a sa, a vun, a sungril - hmuahhmuah cu an riahnak lengah a ur ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Cun Moses in mei-ur thawinak hrang tuucang cu a rak keng ih Aaron le a fapa pawl in tuucang ih lu parah an kut an suang."},"19":{"text":"Moses in tuucang cu a that ih a thisen cu biakṭheng ih kap li ah a theh."},"20":{"text":"Tuucang cu a can thluh ih tidai in a sungril pawl le a dunglam ke pawl a kholhfai ih Bawipa ih thupeknak vekin tuucang sa hmuahhmuah, a lu le a thau pawl thawn, biakṭheng parah meisa in a ur. Hi mei-ur thawinak cu thlairawl thawinak a si hrangah Bawipa hrangah rimthaw a si.","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"Cun puithiam pawl hriakculhnak hrangih hman dingmi tuucang pahnihnak cu Moses in a rak keng ih Aaron le a fapa pawl in tuucang ih lu parah an kut an suang."},"23":{"text":"Moses in tuucang cu a that ih a thisen hrekkhat a lak ih Aaron ih vorhlam hna-rah parah le a vorhlam kutzungpi le a vorhlam kezungpi ah a hnih."},"24":{"text":"Cule Aaron ih fapa pawl cu hmaiah a suahter ih tuucang ih thisen hrekkhat cu an vorhlam hna-rah le an vorhlam kutzungpi le an vorhlam kezungpi tla ah a hnih. A taangmi thisen cu Moses in biakṭheng ih kap li ah a theh."},"25":{"text":"A thau, a meifi thau, a sungril tuamtu thau hmuahhmuah, a thinhnun parih thau, a kaileng pawl le a kaileng parih thau, le a vorhlam kawng a lak."},"26":{"text":"Cule Bawipa hnenih pekmi thilnu tel lo sangbawm sung ihsin sang zawl khat, siti thawn tuahmi sang zawl khat le an rawhmi sang paate phel khat a lak ih tuucang thau le a vorhlam kawng parah a ret."},"27":{"text":"Hi pawl hmuahhmuah cu Aaron le a fapa pawl ih kut ah a pek ih annih in Bawipa hnenah a hleice laksawngah an pek."},"28":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Moses in acuih rawl pawl cu a lak ih mei-ur thawinak tlunah cun hriakculh thawinakah biakṭheng parah a ur. Himi thawinak cu thlairawl thawinak a si ruangah Bawipa hnenah rimthaw a si."},"29":{"text":"Cun a ir cu Moses in a lak ih a hleicemi laksawngah Bawipa hnenah a pek. Himi cu hriakculhnak tuucang sa sung ihsin Moses ih covo a si. Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in Moses cun a tuah thluh."},"30":{"text":"Hriakculhnak siti le biakṭheng parih a ummi sathi hrekkhat cu Moses in a lak ih Aaron le a fapa pawl le an sinfen parah a theh. Cuticun anmah le an sinfen pawl cu Bawipa ih hnenah a thianfaiter a si."},"31":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a fapa pawl hnenah, “Sa cu Bawipa umnak Puanthlam sangka ah suang uhla Bawipa in nan tuah dingah thu i pek zo bangtuk in hriakculh ni-ih pekmi thawinak bawm sungih a ummi sang thawn cutawkah cun ei uh."},"32":{"text":"Nan hlahmi sa le rawl cu nan ur thluh pei."},"33":{"text":"Nan hriakculh thawinak nan ṭheh lai hlan lo Puanthlam luhnak sangka ah ni sarih sung suahsan loin nan um ringring pei."},"34":{"text":"Nan sualthlahnak dingah tuihsun ih kan tuahmi hi tuah dingah Bawipa in thu i pekmi a si."},"35":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupekmi cu nan tuah pei ih Puanthlam luhnak sangka ahcun ni sarih sung a sun a zan in nan um pei. Cutiin nan tuah lo asile nan thi ding. Himi cu Bawipa ih thu in pekmi a si,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Curuangah Moses hmang tahratin Bawipa in thu a pek ih, a thupekmi cu Aaron le a fapa pawl in kimtein an tuah ṭheh."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A ni riat ni ah Moses in Aaron le a fapa pawl le Israel hotu pawl a ko khawm.","title":"Aaron In Thawinak A Pek"},"2":{"text":"Aaron hnenah, “Cawcangte pakhat le tuucang pakhat, raitluan veve la awla Bawipa hnenah pe aw; cawcang cu sualthlah thawinakah a si pei ih tuucang cu mei-ur thawinakah a si pei."},"3":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl sim awla sualthlah thawinak hrangah mecang pakhat, mei-ur thawinak hrangah raitluanmi caw note le tuu note kum khat ti veve, rak keng hai seh;"},"4":{"text":"remnak thawinak hrangah cawcang pakhat le tuucang pakhat khal rak keng hai seh. Siti rawimi thlairawl thawinak thawn Bawipa hnenah an pek pei. Ziangahtile tuihsun ah Bawipa cu an hnenah a lang ding a si,” tiah Moses in a ti."},"5":{"text":"Moses ih thupekmi bangtuk in a zatein Puanthlam hmaiah cun an rak keng thluh ih Israel mi an zatein cutawkah Bawipa biak dingah an ding."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in, “ Bawipa ih sunlawinak tleu cu nan hnenih a langnak dingah hi hmuahhmuah hi tuah dingah Bawipa in thu a lo pek zo a si,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule Aaron hnenah, “Biakṭheng ah feh awla na sualnak le mi zapi ih sualnak cu thlahsak an sinak dingah hi sualthlah thawinak le mei-ur thawinak cu tuah aw. Hi thawinak cu mipi sual thlahnak dingah Bawipa ih thupeknak bangin tuah aw,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Aaron cu biakṭheng ah a feh ih amah ih sualthlahnak hrangih cawcangte cu a that."},"9":{"text":"A fapa pawl in cawcang thisen cu a hnenah an pek ih acuih thisen sungah a kutzung a hnim hnuah thisen cu biakṭheng ih kil li ki pawl ah a hnih; a taangmi thisen cu biakṭheng hramah a thlet."},"10":{"text":"Cun biakṭheng parah a thau, a kaileng pawl le a thinhnun thau pawl cu Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in a ur."},"11":{"text":"Asinain a sa le a vun cu an riahnak lengah a ur."},"12":{"text":"Amah hrangih mei-ur thawinak ṭilva cu a that. A fapa pawl in sathi cu an dong ih amah an pek ih biakṭheng ih kap li ah Aaron cun a theh."},"13":{"text":"A lu le a sa dang pawl an pek ih anih in biakṭheng parah a ur."},"14":{"text":"A sungril le a dunglam ke pawl a kholhfai hnuah mei-ur thawinak tlunih biakṭheng parah a ur."},"15":{"text":"Cuih hnuah mipi hrangah thawinak a pek. Misenpi sualthlahnak hrangih pek dingmi mecang cu a lak ih amah ih sualthlahnak hrangih a tuah vekin a that ih a pek."},"16":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinak hrangih ṭilva khal a lak ih a daan bangtuk in thawinak a pek."},"17":{"text":"Thlairawl thawinak khal a pek ih sangphut zate-khat a lak ih biakṭheng parah a ur. Himi cu zingtin tuahmi mei-ur thawinakih hlei ah a si."},"18":{"text":"Misenpi hrang remnak thawinak cawcang le tuucang khal a that. Cuih thisen cu a fapa pawl in an rak dong ih amah an pek ih anih in biakṭheng ih kap li ah a theh."},"19":{"text":"Aaron in a thau - a meifi thau, a sungril thau, a kaileng le a kaileng tuamtu thau, a thinhnun thau pawl tla a lak ih,"},"20":{"text":"a ir sa parih a ret hnuah biakṭheng parah a ur."},"21":{"text":"Cule Moses ih fial bangtuk in a ir le a vorhlam kawng pawl cu a hleice pekmi-ah Aaron in puithiam pawl hrangah Bawipa hnenah a pek."},"22":{"text":"Aaron in thawinak hmuahhmuah a ṭheh tikah misenpi tlunah a baan pahnih in a phar ih thluasuah a pek. A pek ṭheh in a ṭum."},"23":{"text":"Cule Moses le Aaron cu Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam sungah an lut ih an ra suah tikah misenpi pawl cu thluasuah an pek ih an zate tlunah a tleumi Bawipa ih sunlawinak cu a lang."},"24":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Bawipa in meisa a run thlak ih biakṭheng parih thawinak sa hmuahhmuah le a thau pawl tla cu a kaang ṭheh. Cumi cu misenpi in an hmuh tikah an au hluarhlo ih an hmai leilung dai in an bok."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron ih fapa Nadab le Abihu in meiling laknak thirkheng an lak veve ih meiling an ret ih rimhmui an pa ih hnuah Bawipa hnenah an pek. Asinain hi meisa cu a thiang lomi a si, ziangahtile annih ih tuah dingah Bawipa ih thupekmi a si lo.","title":"Nadab Le Abihu Sualnak"},"2":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Bawipa ih hmai ihsin meisa alh a suak ih meisa cun a kaang hai ih an thi."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Aaron hnenah, “ Bawipa in, ‘Ka hna a ṭuantu hmuahhmuah in ka thianhlimnak an upat pei; ka miphun pawl hnenah ka huham ka langter ding,’ a ti tikah a ti duhnak cu himi sokhaw a si,” a ti. Sikhalsehla Aaron cu zianghman a ṭong lo."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Aaron ih paseu Uzziel ih fapa Mishael le Elzafan a ko ih, “Ra uhla nan unau ruak pawl hi Puanthlam thianghlim ihsin lak uhla riahnak lengah va ret uh,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"A ti vek cun an ra ih ruak pawl cu an hnipuan in an khai ih Moses ih thupek bangtuk in riahnak lengah an ret."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Aaron le Aaron ih fapa Eleazar le Ithamar pawl hnenah, “Mithi ngai tahratin nan hnipuan thlek in nan sam khal hriat loin um hlah uh. Nan sam tla nan hriat lo ih nan hnipuan nan thlek a si ahcun nan thi ding ih Bawipa cu Israel miphun zate parah a thin a heng ding. Sikhalsehla Bawipa ih thlentermi meisa in a kang thatmi mithi pawl hi nan phunpi Israel midang pawl cun an ngai thei ding."},"7":{"text":"Puanthlam sangka ihsin suak hlah uh; nan suah ahcun nan thi tengteng ding; ziangahtile Bawipa ih hriakculhnak siti thawn thianhlimtermi nan si zo,” tiah a ti. Moses ih sim vek cun an tuah."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in Aaron hnenah,","title":"Puithiam Pawl Hrangah Daan"},"9":{"text":"“Sabitti siseh zu siseh in tahratin ka umnak Puanthlam sungah nangmah le na fapa pawl nan lut lo pei. Nan lut asile nan thi ding. Hi daan cu nan tesinfa hmuahhmuah in an thlun pei."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa ih ta a si mi le senpi ih hmantlang dingmi thil pawl cu nan thleidan thiam a ṭul a si; thil thiang le thil thiang lo khal nan theihthiam a ṭul a si."},"11":{"text":"Moses hnen ihsin ka lo pekmi daan hmuahhmuah cu Israel mi pawl na zirh thluh pei,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a nunglaimi a fapa pahnih Eleazar le Ithamar hnenah, “ Bawipa hnenih pekmi rawl sung ihsin a taangmi thlairawl thawinak cu lak uhla cumi cun thilnu tel lo sang tuah in biakṭheng kiangah ei uh, ziangahtile himi cu a thiangzetmi thawinak a si."},"13":{"text":"Hmun thianghlim sungah ei uh; Bawipa hnenih pekmi rawl sung ihsin nanmah le nan fapa pawl ih covo a si. Himi cu Bawipa in ka hnenih thu i pekmi a si."},"14":{"text":"Asinain nanmah le nan sungkhat pawl cun puithiam pawl hrangih Bawipa hnenah a hleice ih pekmi pawl, a kawng le a ir cu nan ei thei ding. Cumi cu a thiannak hmun ah nan ei pei. Israel mi pawl in remnak thawinak an pekmi sung ihsin nanmah le nan tefa pawl covo-ah himi cu an pek zo a si."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah thawinak an tuah ih a thau pawl tla an pek tikcu ah a kawng le a ir cu a hleice ih pekmi ah an rak keng pei. Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in hi nan covo pawl cu nanmah le nan tefa pawl in a kumkhua in nan co ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Sualthlah thawinak ding hrang timi me thu cu Moses in a suh tikah meisa in an ur zo ti kha a thei. Cutikah Aaron ih fapa pahnih Eleazar le Ithamar parah Moses cu a thin a heng ngaingai ih,"},"17":{"text":"“Ziangah so sualthlah thawinak sa cu hmun thiang sungah nan ei lo? Israel miphun an sualthlahnak hrangah Bawipa in nan ei dingah a lo pek zomi a si ih a thianghlim zetmi a si."},"18":{"text":"A thisen cu Puanthlam thianghlim sungih kenmi a si lo hrangah ka lo sim cia vekin hi thawinak sa cu hmun thianghlim ih nan ei ding hrimhrim a si,” tiah napi in a kawk hai."},"19":{"text":"Aaron in, “Israel mi pawl in tuihsun ah Bawipa ih hnenah an sualthlah thawinak le an mei-ur thawinak pawl an pe zo. Ka parah hivek thusia a thlen laiah hin sualthlah thawinak sa cu kei in rak ei ningla Bawipa cu a lung a awi cuang ding maw?” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cumi Moses ih a theih tikah a lung a kim sal."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel miphun hrangah a tanglam daan pawl cu,","title":"Eiṭha Ramsa Pawl (Daan 14.3-21)"},"2":{"text":"Moses le Aaron hnenah a pek. Leilung tlun ramsa,"},"3":{"text":"ketin ṭeek nei le rawlret ṭhial nei hmuahhmuah nan ei pei."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kalauk pawl, meingan pawl, le sabek pawl cu nan ei lo pei. Hi ramsa pawl cu ramsa thiang lo an si; ziangahtile rawlret an ṭhial naón ketin ṭeek an nei lo.","merge":"5"},"7":{"text":"Voksa nan ei lo pei; ketin ṭeek an nei naón rawlret an ṭhial lo."},"8":{"text":"Hi ramsa pawl cu nan ei lo pei; an ruak khal nan tham lo pei. Ramsa thiang lo an si."},"9":{"text":"Ṭeh le kep a neimi nga hmuahhmuah cu nan ei thei."},"10":{"text":"Asinain ti sungih a ummi ṭeh le kep a nei lomi cu ei ding an si lo."},"11":{"text":"Sa thiang lo-ah siar ding an si. Hi pawl cu nan ei lo pei; an ruak khal nan tham lo pei."},"12":{"text":"Ti sungih a ummi ṭeh le kep a nei lomi hmuahhmuah nan ei lo pei."},"13":{"text":"A tanglamih va pawl hi nan ei lo pei; ziangahtile fihnungza an si. Muvanlai, langta, langta dum;"},"14":{"text":"khaute, khaupi,"},"15":{"text":"tlang-ak,"},"16":{"text":"kalauk vate, sumbuh, sumbuh hmultawi, sumbuh hmulsau, zan khaute,"},"17":{"text":"sumbuh fate, cenbai, sumbuh rang,"},"18":{"text":"cirhdawt, ngathur, pelikan,"},"19":{"text":"vaca, rih-ar, vasuangtuar le palap pawl tla an si."},"20":{"text":"An khirnak dingih ke hlikhlok neimi siar lo,"},"21":{"text":"thla a nei ih ke li neimi cucik kharbok hmuahhmuah cu ei thiang lo an si."},"22":{"text":"Kharbok, umzir le bawkhring pawl cu nan ei thei ding."},"23":{"text":"Asinain a dang cucik kharbok thla a nei mi le a bokvakmi pawl hmuahhmuah cu ei thiang lo an si."},"24":{"text":"Zokhal sisehla a thuailam ramsa pawl ih ruak a thamtu cu zanlam tiang mithiang lo an si ding."},"25":{"text":"Zokhal sisehla hi pawl ih ruak a latu cu an hnipuan an sawp pei ih zanlam tiang mithiang lo an si ding."},"26":{"text":"Ketin ṭeek nei ih rawlret ṭhial nei ramsa siar lo, ketin ṭeek lo ramsa hmuahhmuah le ke li nei ih ketin hriam ramsa hmuahhmuah cu ramsa thiang lo an si. Zokhal hi ramsa pawl ih ruak a thamtu cu an tham sun zanlam tiang mithiang lo-ah an cang ding; zokhal hi ramsa pawl ih ruak a phurtu cu a phurh laiih a hrukmi hnipuan pawl a sawp thluh pei. Cuih hnu khalah zanlam tiang mithiang lo a si thotho ding.","merge":"27"},"29":{"text":"Duum, hramlak zinghnam, inn zinghnam, thangkawng, ngangdol a phunphun le laiking pawl cu ei thiang lo an si.","merge":"30"},"31":{"text":"Zokhal a tlunih pawl a thamtu le an ruak a daitu pawl cu acuih sun zanlam tiang mithiang lo an si ding."},"32":{"text":"An ruak pawl tla thil pakhatkhat parih a tlak asile acuih thil cu a thiang lo-ah rel a si ding. Zanthing siseh hnipuan siseh, savun siseh, dip siseh, ziangih hmanmi a si khalle a thiang lo-ah rel a si ding. Hi thil cu tidai sungah hnim a si pei; sikhalsehla zanlam tiang thilri thiang lo a si thotho ding."},"33":{"text":"Cun an ruak pawl beelnu sungih an tlak asile acuih beel sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah cu a thiang lo a si ding ih acuih beelnu cu nan khuai pei."},"34":{"text":"Cun acuih beel sung tidai ih toihmi rawl pohpoh cu rawl thiang lo a si ding; cubangtuk beel sungih in ṭha hmuahhmuah cu in ṭha lo-ah a cang ding."},"35":{"text":"Hi saruak pawl ih tlakmi hmuahhmuah cu a thiang lomi an si; tlak ih tuahmi lungthu a si ahcun nan khuai thluh pei."},"36":{"text":"Hi saruak pawl ih an daimi hmuahhmuah cu a thiang lomi an si; asinain dawhhna le tikuang pawl cu a thiangah rel an si ding."},"37":{"text":"Hi saruak pakhatkhat cu tuh dingmi thlaici parih a tlak khalle cuih thlaici cu a thiang thotho a si."},"38":{"text":"Asinain tidai sungih ciahmi thlaici parih a tlak pang a si ahcun cuih thlaici cu a thiang lo a si."},"39":{"text":"Ei thiangmi ramsa pakhatkhat a thi ih cuih saruak a thamtu cu zanlam tiang mithiang lo a si ding."},"40":{"text":"Zozo khal hi sa a ei a si ahcun a hnipuan a sawp thluh pei; sikhalsehla cuih zanlam tiang mithiang lo a si thotho ding. Zokhal hi saruak a phurtu cu a hnipuan a sawp thluh pei; sikhalsehla cuih zanlam tiang cu mithiang lo a si thotho ding."},"41":{"text":"Lei parih a vak murhmo mi ramsa,"},"42":{"text":"a pum leilung rawt ih a vakmi siseh, ke keli ih a vakmi le ke tampi a neimi siseh, nan ei hrimhrim lo pei."},"43":{"text":"Hi pawl hi ei tahrat in nanmah le nanmah mithiang lo-ah nan tuah-aw lo pei."},"44":{"text":"Keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si ih keimah ka thianhlim bangtuk in nannih khal nan thianghlim ve pei."},"45":{"text":"Keimah cu nan Pathian si dingah Izipt ram ihsin a lo suahsuaktu Bawipa ka si. Keimah cu a thianghlim mi ka si bangtuk in nannih khal nan thianghlim ve pei."},"46":{"text":"Ramsa, vate le ti sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah le lei parih a vakmi ramsa hmuahhmuah thawn peh-aw ih daan cu hihi an si."},"47":{"text":"Raitluang le raitluang lo siseh, ramsa ei thiang le ei thiang lo siseh, thleidang thiam dingah nan ralring pei."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tanglam ih daan pawl hi Israel mi hrangah Bawipa in,","title":"Nau Neih Hnu Ih Thianfaiter Awknak"},"2":{"text":"Moses hnenah a pek. Nunau pakhat in fapa a hrin tikah, thlatin a neihmi thi ruangih mi thiangfai loih rel a si bangtuk in ni sarih sung mi thiangfai lo a si."},"3":{"text":"Ni riatnak ni-ah a fapa cu serhtan a si pei."},"4":{"text":"Nunau nu cun a thianfai lai hlan lo ni sawmthum le ni thum a hngak hrih pei. A thianfaiter awknak caan a kim lai hlan lo a thianghlimmi thil zianghman a tham lo pei ih Puanthlam thianghlim sung khalah a lut lo pei."},"5":{"text":"Fanu a hring asile thlatin a neihmi thi ruangih mi thiangfai lo a si bangtuk in ni hleili sung mi thiangfai lo a si. A thi suahnak ihsin a thianfai lai hlan lo ni sawmruk le ni ruk sung a hngak pei."},"6":{"text":"Fapa a hring ih, a si lole fanu a hring ih a thianfaiter awknak caan a kim tikah kum khat a timi tuufa pakhat mei-ur thawinak hrangah Bawipa umnak Puanthlam luhnak sangka ih um puithiam hnenah a rak keng pei. Laileng pakhat a si lole thuro pakhat khal sualthlah thawinak hrangah a rak keng pei."},"7":{"text":"A kenmi thawinak cu puithiam in Bawipa hnenah a pek pei ih a borhhlawhnak cu tlengfai dingah a thawi pei; culawng ah nunau thiangfai ah a cang ding. Himi cu nau neih borhhlawh thianfainak ah nunau in a tuah ṭulmi daan a si."},"8":{"text":"Nunau in tuufa pakhat hman a nei lo a si ahcun thuro pahnih a si lole laileng pahnih, pakhat cu mei-ur thawinak hrangah, a dang pakhat cu sualthlah thawinak hrangah a keng pei. A borhhlawhnak tlengfai dingah puithiam in thawinak a tuahsak pei ih cu nu cu mi thiangfai ah a cang ding."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses le Aaron hnenah hi daan pawl cu Bawipa in a pek.","title":"Phaarnat Thu-ah Thlun Ding Daan"},"2":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat in a vun ah hma a neih ahcun, a thlingmi a si lole, hnai a khuarmi a si lole, a bolmi menmen a si hmanah, misuan thei phaarnat ih a can thei ruangah amah cu Aaron hrin puithiam pakhatkhat hnenah fehpi a si pei."},"3":{"text":"Amah cu puithiam in a zoh pei ih a hma sungih hmul pawl a raan ih a hma cu a kiangkapih vun hnakin a thuk deuh asile phaarnat a si. Puithiam in a zoh ṭheh hnuah amah cu mi thiangfai lo a si tiah a than pei."},"4":{"text":"Asinain a vun a hmami cu a raang ih a kiangkap vun hnakin a thuk deuh cuang lo ih a sungih hmul pawl tla a raan lo ahcun amah cu puithiam in ni sarih sung a dangte in a ret pei."},"5":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ah puithiam in a zoh sal pei ih a hmuhnak ah a hma cu amah keel a si ih a besiat cuang lo a si ahcun ni sarih sung a dangte in a ret sal pei."},"6":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ah puithiam in a zoh sal lala pei ih a hma cu besia sinsin loin a dam deuh a si ahcun amah cu a thiangfai a si, tiah a than pei. A hma cu hma menmen lawng a si. A hnipuan a sawp thluh pei ih mi thiangfai a si ding."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla puithiam in a zoh ih a thiangfai a si a ti hnuah a hma a besiat sal a si ahcun puithiam hnenah a feh sal pei."},"8":{"text":"Puithiam in a rak zoh sal pei ih a hma a karh sinsin a si ahcun mi thiangfai lo a si tiah a than pei. Phaarnat a si."},"9":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat phaarnat a neih tikah amah cu puithiam hnenah fehpi a si peh ih,"},"10":{"text":"puithiam in a zoh pei. A vun hma cu a raan ih a hma sungih hmul pawl tla a raan ih a hnai a um ahcun,"},"11":{"text":"a dam thei lomi phaarnat a si. Puithiam in mi thiangfai lo a si tiah a than pei. Mi thiangfai lo a si zo hrangah a dangte ih ret ih zoh a ṭul nawn lo."},"12":{"text":"Cun a hma cu a zai vivo ih a taksa ruangpi a khah ṭheh ahcun,"},"13":{"text":"puithiam in a zoh sal pei. A taksa ruangpi a khat ṭheh ngaingai a si ti a hmuh ahcun mi thiangfai a si, a ti pei. A vun zatein a raan ṭheh ruangah mi thiangfai a si."},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a titsa ngaingai a hmat ahcun cutiih a hmat vete in amah cu mi thiangfai lo a si."},"15":{"text":"Puithiam in a zoh sal pei ih a titsa a hmami a hmuh ngaingai ahcun amah cu mi thiangfai lo a si, tiah a than pei. A titsa tiangih a hmat ahcun phaarnat a si ruangah amah cu mi thiangfai lo a si, miphaar a si."},"16":{"text":"Asinain a titsa hma a dam ih a raang menmen lawng a si sal ahcun puithiam hnenah a feh pei."},"17":{"text":"Puithiam in amah cu a zoh pei. A titsa hma cu a raang ih a can sal ahcun puithiam in mi thiangfai a si, tiah a than pei ih mi thiangfai ah a cang pei."},"18":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat khuaihli hma a nei ih a dam hnuah,"},"19":{"text":"a damnak hmun ihsin a thling ih a raan a si ahcun, a si lole sen-ngo-thlak in a bol mi a suak sal a si ahcun puithiam hnenah a hmuh-aw pei."},"20":{"text":"Puithiam in a zoh pei ih a hma cu a kiangkapih vun hnakin a thuk deuh ih a hma sungih hmul pawl a raan ahcun mi thiangfai lo a si, tiah puithiam in a than pei. Khuaihli hma in a thok naan phaarnat a si."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla puithiam in a zoh tikah a hma sungih hmul pawl a raang lo ih a kiangkap vun hnakin a hma cu a thuk lo ih a pianzia cu a raang nawn a si ahcun puithiam in amah cu a dangte in ni sarih sung a ret pei."},"22":{"text":"A hma a zai vivo a si ahcun puithiam in mi thiangfai lo a si tiah a than pei."},"23":{"text":"Asinain a hma cu amah keelin a um ih a zai cuang lo a si ahcun khuaihli hma sii lawng a taang a si hrangah amah cu mi thiangfai a si, tiah puithiam in a than pei."},"24":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat meisa in a kang ih a titsa a raan ahcun, a si lole sen-ngo-thlak a si ahcun,"},"25":{"text":"puithiam in a zoh pei ih a hma sungih hmul pawl a raan ih a kiangkap vun hnakin a thuk deuh ahcun meisa kangnak ihsin a suakmi phaarnat a si ih, puithiam in mi thiangfai lo a si, tiah a than pei."},"26":{"text":"Asinain a hma sungih hmul pawl a raang loih a kiangkap vun hnakin a thuk deuh lo a si ih a pianzia a raang nawn a si ahcun, puithiam in amah cu ni sarih sung a dangte in a ret pei."},"27":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ah puithiam in a zoh sal pei ih a hma cu a zai vivo a si ahcun phaarnat a si hrangah puithiam in mi thiangfai lo a si, tiah a than pei."},"28":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a hma cu a keel in a um ih a zai lo ih a pianzia cu a raang nawn a si ahcun phaarnat a si lo, a thling men a si. Curuangah amah cu puithiam in mi thiangfai a si tiah a than pei; ziangahtile meikang hma sii lawng a si."},"29":{"text":"Mipa siseh nunau siseh, a lu ah, asilole a khabe ah, hma a neih asile,"},"30":{"text":"puithiam in a zoh pei. A hma cu a kiangkap vun hnakin a thuk deuh ih a sungih hmul pawl a aihre ih a fatet ahcun phaarnat a si ih puithiam in mi thiangfai lo a si, tiah a than pei."},"31":{"text":"Puithiam in a zoh tikah a hma cu a kiangkap vun hnakin a thuk deuh lo naón a hma sung hmul pawl cu hmul keel an si thotho lo ahcun puithiam in ni sarih sung a dangte in a ret pei."},"32":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ah puithiam in a zoh sal pei ih a hma cu a zai lo ih a hma sung hmul cu a aihre lo ih tlunah a kapih vun hnakin a thuk sawn lo a si ahcun,"},"33":{"text":"mi dam lo pa cun, a hma kapih hmul siar lo, a lu a met-aw pei. Cun puithiam in ni sarih sung a dangte in a ret sal pei."},"34":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ah puithiam in a zoh sal lala pei ih a hma cu zai loin a kapih vun hnakin a thuk sawn fawn lo a si ahcun puithiam in amah cu mi thiangfai a si, tiah a than pei. Cupa cu a hnipuan a sawp pei ih mi thiangfai ah a cang ding."},"35":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mi thiangfai a si, ti hnuah a hma cu a zai sal a si ahcun,"},"36":{"text":"puithiam in a zoh sal pei. A hma a zai ngaingai a si ahcun a hmul a aihre le aihre lo khal zoh a ṭul nawn lo; mi thiangfai lo a si ko."},"37":{"text":"Sikhalsehla puithiam ih hmuhnak ah a hma cu a zai lo ih a hma sungah hmul tla ṭha tein a khoh a si ahcun a hma cu a dam a si ih puithiam in mi thiangfai a si, tiah a than pei."},"38":{"text":"Mipa siseh nunau siseh a vun parah a raang ṭhukṭhi a um asile,"},"39":{"text":"amah cu puithiam in a zoh pei. A raang in a ṭialmi pawl cu a raang duakdi a si ahcun a vun parah a raang in a suak men a si ruangah amah cu mi thiangfai a si."},"40":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhatih sam cu a hmailam siseh, a dunglam siseh, a tlok khalle mi thiangfai lo a si lo. Lukawng menmen a si.","merge":"41"},"42":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a lukolh ah sen-ngo-thlak hma a um a si ahcun phaarnat a si."},"43":{"text":"Puithiam in amah cu a zoh pei ih sen-ngo-thlak hma a um ngaingai a si ahcun,"},"44":{"text":"puithiam in mi thiangfai lo a si, tiah a than pei. Ziangahtile a lu ah misuan thei hma a nei a si."},"45":{"text":"Zokhal siseh phaarnat a neimi cu hnipuan tlek a hruk pei, a sam hriat loin a thlah pei ih a hmur hup in, “Mi thiangfai lo ka si, mi thiangfai lo ka si,” tiah a au pei."},"46":{"text":"Hi nat a neih sung hmuahhmuah cu mi thiangfai lo ringring a si pei ih hnarpawn ah amah lawng a um pei."},"47":{"text":"Tuuhmul hnipuan siseh, a si lole pat hnipuan siseh, hnipuan a mawr a si ahcun,","title":"Thil Mawr Pawl Um Tikih Tuah Dingmi"},"48":{"text":"a si lole tuuhmul hnipuan siseh, pat hnipuan siseh, hnipuan khuimaw parih a mawr malte a um a si ahcun, a si lole savun parah siseh, savun ih tahmi thilri pakhatkhat parah siseh, a mawr a um a si ahcun,"},"49":{"text":"a pianzia a tangphaw nawn a si lole a sen nawn a si ahcun, a zai mi mawr a si hrangah puithiam hnenah hmuh ding a si."},"50":{"text":"Puithiam in a zoh pei ih ni sarih sung cuih thil cu a dang tein a ret pei."},"51":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ah a zoh sal pei ih a mawrmi cu a zai a si ahcun cuih thil cu thil thiangfai lo a si."},"52":{"text":"Puithiam in meisa in a ur pei, ziangahtile a zai thei mi mawr a si hrangah meisa in ur ding a si."},"53":{"text":"Sikhalsehla puithiam in a zoh tikah a mawr cu cuih thil parah a zai lo a si ahcun,"},"54":{"text":"cuih thil cu a sawpter pei ih ni sarih sung an ret sal pei."},"55":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a zoh sal pei ih a zai lo naón a mawr ih pianzia a lamdang cuang lo a si ahcun thil thiangfai lo thotho a si pei. A mawrnak cu dunglam a si khalle hmailam a si khalle cuih thil cu nan ur pei."},"56":{"text":"Asinain puithiam in a zoh sal tikah a mawr cu a reh zo a si ahcun hnipuan a si lole savun ih a mawrnak zawnte lawnglawng a thlek pei."},"57":{"text":"Cule a mawr sal lala ih a zai vivo a si ahcun a neitu in a thil cu a ur pei."},"58":{"text":"A thil cu a sawp ih a mawrnak neh a hlo thei a si ahcun a sawp sal hnuah a thil cu thil thiangfai ah a cang ding."},"59":{"text":"Himi cu tuuhmul hnipuan siseh, pat hnipuan siseh, hnipuan a mawr tikah, a si lole pat hnipuan siseh, tuuhmul hnipuan ih khuimaw zawn ah siseh, a si lole khuimaw zawnih savun ih tuahmi thil a mawr tikah siseh, tuah dingmi daan a si."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Misuan thei phaarnat ihsin a dammi mi pakhat thawinak hrangah,","title":"Phaarnat A Dam Tikih Thawinak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in hi daan pawl cu Moses hnenah a pek. Phaarnat nei pa a dam ih mi thiangfai a si ti ih an ti ni ah amah cu puithiam hnenah an fehpi pei ih,"},"3":{"text":"puithiam in khawlengah a fehpi pei ih a zoh pei. A phaarnat a dam ngaingai asile,"},"4":{"text":"puithiam in raitluan vate pahnih, sidar zanthing le puansen le hissop kung a hnge tete thawn rak keng dingah thu a pek pei."},"5":{"text":"Cun vate pakhat cu tidai thiangfai retnak khuhriang tlunah that dingin puithiam in thu a pek pei."},"6":{"text":"Cule puithiam in a dang vate pakhat cu a lak pei ih thah ciami vate ih thisen sungah sidar zanthing, puansen le hissop kung thawn a hnim pei."},"7":{"text":"A phaarnat ihsin thianfaiter dingmi pa cu puithiam in vate thisen cun voi sarih tiang a theh pei ih cuih hnuah a thiangfai a si tiah a ti pei. A nungmi vate cu hramlak ah a thlah pei."},"8":{"text":"Cun mi pa in a hnipuan a sawp thluh pei; a sam a met thluh pei ih ti a kholh-aw pei; cuticun mi thiangfai a si ding. Khawsung ah a lut pei, asinain a inn lengah ni sarih sung cu a um pei."},"9":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ah a lu a met sal pei; a khahmul, a mit hmul le a taksa parih hmul hmuahhmuah a meet thluh pei; a hnipuan a sawp pei ih ti a kholh-aw pei; cuticun mi thiangfai a si pei."},"10":{"text":"A ni riatnak ah kum khat a timi raitluan tuucang pahnih le tuula pakhat a rak keng pei ih olif siti thawn rawimi sangvut reel khat le olif siti khuat khat tla a rak keng pei."},"11":{"text":"Cupa le a kenmi pawl cu puithiam in Thukham retnak Puanthlam ah a fehpi pei."},"12":{"text":"Cule puithiam in tuucang pakhat cu a lak pei ih olif siti khuat khat thawn mawhnak thawinakah a pek pei. Himi pawl cu Bawipa hnenah puithiam hrangih a hleice pekmi laksawng an si."},"13":{"text":"Sualthlah thawinak hrang le mei-ur thawinak hrangih ṭilva an thahnak hmun ah acuih tuucang cu puithiam in a that pei. Himi cu a tuah tengteng dingmi a si, ziangahtile mawhnak thawinak cu sualthlah thawinak bangtuk in puithiam ih covo a si ih a thianghlim zetmi a si."},"14":{"text":"Puithiam in tuucang ih thisen hrekkhat cu a lak pei ih thianfaiter dingmi pa-ih vorhlam hna-rah le a vorhlam kutzungpi le a vorhlam kezungpi ah a hnih pei."},"15":{"text":"Cun puithiam in olif siti hrekkhat cu a lak pei ih amah ih kehlam zaphak sungah a thlet pei;"},"16":{"text":"acuih siti sungah a vorhlam mehtok kutzung a hnim pei ih Bawipa mithmuh ah voi sarih tiang a theh pei."},"17":{"text":"A kut zaphak sungih a ummi siti hrekkhat le tuucang ih thisen hrekkhat a lak pei ih thianfaiter dingmi pa-ih vorhlam hna-rah le a vorhlam kutzungpi le a vorhlam kezungpi ah a hnih pei."},"18":{"text":"A kut zaphak sungih a taang hrihmi siti cu cupa ih lu ah a hnih thluh pei. Cuticun thianfaiternak cu puithiam in a tuah pei."},"19":{"text":"Cule puithiam in sualthlah thawinak cu a pek pei ih thianfainak a tuah pei. Cuih hnuah mei-ur thawinak hrangih ṭilva cu a that pei ih,"},"20":{"text":"biakṭheng ah thawinak a pek pei. Thlairawl thawinak tla a tuah pei. Cuticun puithiam in thianfainak a tuah pei ih cupa cu mi thiangfai ah a cang pei."},"21":{"text":"Cupa cu a farah ih zianghman a lei thei lo a si ahcun a thianfainak hrangah tuucang pakhat lawng a keng pei ih mawhnak thawinakah a pek pei. Himi cu Bawipa hnenah a hleice ih pekmi a si. Olif siti thawn rawimi sangvut tla rel tan lawng thlairawl thawinak hrangah a keng pei ih olif siti khuat khat a keng fawn pei."},"22":{"text":"Thuro pahnih a si lole laileng pahnih a keng fawn pei ih pakhat cu sualthlah thawinakah le a dang pakhat cu mei-ur thawinak hrangah a si pei."},"23":{"text":"Himi pawl cu a thianfainak ni riat ni ah Puanthlam ih sangka ah puithiam hnenah a pek pei."},"24":{"text":"Puithiam in tuucang le olif siti cu a lak pei ih Bawipa hnenah a hleice laksawngah puithiam pawl hrangah a pek pei."},"25":{"text":"Tuucang cu a that pei ih a thisen hrekkhat a lak hnuah cumi pa-ih vorhlam hna-rah le a vorhlam kutzungpi le a vorhlam kezungpi-ah a hnih pei."},"26":{"text":"Cun puithiam in siti hrekkhat cu amah ih kehlam zaphak sungah a thlet pei ih,"},"27":{"text":"a vorhlam mehtok kutzung in Bawipa ih mithmuh ah siti hrekkhat cu voi sarih tiang a theh pei."},"28":{"text":"Tuucang thisen a hnihnak a vorhlam hna-rah le a vorhlam kutzungpi le a vorhlam kezungpi ah siti cu a hnih pei."},"29":{"text":"A zaphak sungih a taang hrihmi siti cu cupa ih lu ah a hnih thluh pei. Cuticun thianfainak cu a tuah pei."},"30":{"text":"Cun thuro pakhat a si lole laileng pakhat cu,"},"31":{"text":"sualthlah thawinakah a pek pei ih a dang pakhat cu mei-ur thawinakah thlairawl thawinak thawn a pek pei. Cuticun puithiam in thianfainak cu a tuah pei."},"32":{"text":"Himi cu misuan thei phaarnat a nei ih midang bangin thawinak a tuah thei lomi pawl hrangih pekmi daan a si."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenah,","title":"Inn Mawr"},"34":{"text":"Kanaan ram, Israel mi pawl co dingih a pek dingmi ramih an luh tikah an inn sungah mawr a um ih cuih mawr cu a zai vivo asile a hnuailam ih daan pawl hi an thlun dingih a pekmi an si."},"35":{"text":"Mi pakhat in a inn a mawr ti a hmuh tikah puithiam hnenah a feh pei ih a sim pei."},"36":{"text":"Cutikah inn zoh dingih a va feh hlanah puithiam in inn sungih a ummi thilri hmuahhmuah cu thilri thiangfai loih rel an si lonak dingah ṭhawn thluh dingin thu a pek pei. Cuih hnuah a va feh pei ih,"},"37":{"text":"inn mawr cu a va zoh pei. A mawr pianzia cu a tangphaw nawn a si lole a sen nawn in a ṭial ih phar tla a ei a si ahcun,"},"38":{"text":"cuih inn cu a taan pei ih ni sarih sung tawh a kalh pei."},"39":{"text":"A ni sarihnak ah inn cu a va zoh sal pei. A mawr a zai asile,"},"40":{"text":"a mawr umnak lungto pawl cu lak tahratih khawpi leng hmun thiangfai loih va hlon dingin thu a pek pei."},"41":{"text":"Cuih hnuah phar a sunglam hmuahhmuah cu ziat thluh dingah le phar maannak tlak pawl cu lak thluh ih khawpi lengih hmun thiangfai lo ah hlon dingin a fial hai pei."},"42":{"text":"Cun an lakih an hlonmi lungto ai-ah a dang lungto pawl an hmang pei ih phar cu a thar in tlak an maan sal pei."},"43":{"text":"Lungto pawl an hlon ih a phar pawl an ziat ih an maan sal thluh hnuah a inn cu a mawr thotho a si ahcun,"},"44":{"text":"puithiam in a va zoh sal pei. A mawr a rak zai ngaingai a si ahcun cuih inn cu inn thiangfai lo a si."},"45":{"text":"Cuih inn cu bal ding a si ih a lungto pawl, zanthing pawl le an maanmi tlak pawl hmuahhmuah cu an phur pei ih khawpi leng hmun thiangfai lo ah an hlon pei."},"46":{"text":"Hi inn tawh an kalh sungah a sungih a luttu cu cuih sun zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"47":{"text":"Hi inn sungah a itmi le rawl a eitu cun a hnipuan a sawp fai thluh pei."},"48":{"text":"Puithiam a rat ih a zoh tikah in phar pawl an maan sal hnuah a mawrmi a suak sal nawn lo a si ahcun a mawr cu a reh zo a si ruangah puithiam in cuih inn cu inn thiangfai a si, tiah a ti pei."},"49":{"text":"Inn thianfaiternak ah puithiam in vate pahnih, sidar zanthing, pathri sen le hissop kung pakhat a keng pei."},"50":{"text":"Vate pakhat cu tidai thiangfai retnak ih tuahmi khuhriang tlun ah a that pei."},"51":{"text":"Cule sidar zanthing, hissop kung, pathri sen le vate nung cu a lak pei ih a thahmi vate ih thisen sungah le tidai thiangfai retmi sungah cun a hnim pei. Cuih hnuah inn cu voi sarih tiang a theh pei."},"52":{"text":"Cuticun vate thisen, tidai thiangfai, vate nung, sidar zanthing, hissop kung le pathri sen pawl in inn cu a thiangfaiter ding."},"53":{"text":"Cule vate nung cu khawpi lengah hramlakah a thlah pei. Cubangtuk in thianfaiternak cu inn hrangah a tuah pei ih inn thiangfai ah a cang ding."},"54":{"text":"Himi pawl cu mi suan thei phaarnat,"},"55":{"text":"hnipuan siseh inn siseh a mawrmi,"},"56":{"text":"hma, khuaihli a si lole hma sia pawl,"},"57":{"text":"a thiangfai le thiangfai lo, tiih langternak ah pekmi daan pawl an si."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenah a tanglam daan pawl cu,","title":"Taksa Sungin Hnai Dokmi"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ih thlun dingah a pek. Mi pakhatkhat a zahmawh sungin hnai a dok asile a thiangfai lo a si."},"3":{"text":"Cat loih a dok ah siseh, a pih ah siseh, cupa cu a thiangfai lo a si."},"4":{"text":"A tonak, a si lole a ihnak ihkhun cu a thiangfai lo a si."},"5":{"text":"Cupa ih ihkhun cu mi pakhatkhat in a tham,"},"6":{"text":"a si lole a rak tonak ih a to asile a thamtu, a si lole a totu in a hnipuan a sawp fai thluh pei ih ti a kholh-aw pei ih cuih sun cu zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"7":{"text":"Hnai dok pa cu mi pakhatkhat in a dai asile a daitu cun amah ih hnipuan a sawpfai thluh pei ih ti a kholh-aw pei ih cuih sun cu zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"8":{"text":"Hnai dok pa in thianfai lonak zianghman a nei lo mi pakhat parah a cil a phui asile cupa cu a hnipuan a sawp fai thluh pei; ti a kholh-aw pei ih cuih sun cu zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"9":{"text":"Hnai dok pa ih tonak rangkung, a si lole tokham cu a thiangfai lo a si."},"10":{"text":"Hi pa ih tonak thil pohpoh a thamtu cu zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si. Hi pa ih tonak a phurtu pohpoh cun amah ih hnipuan a sawpfai thluh pei ih ti a kholh-aw pei ih cuih sun cu zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"11":{"text":"Hnai dok pa in a kut pawl kholh hmaisa loin mi pakhatkhat a tham a si ahcun cupa cun amah ih hnipuan a sawpfai thluh pei ih ti a kholh-aw pei ih cuih sun cu zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"12":{"text":"Hi pa ih a thammi tlakbeel cu nan khuai pei ih thingkheng a thammi cu nan kholh pei."},"13":{"text":"Hnai dok pa a dam tikah ni sarih sung a cawl pei ih cuih hnuah a hnipuan a sawpfai pei ih tidai thiang in a kholh-aw pei. Cuticun mi thiangfai ah a cang ding."},"14":{"text":"A ni riatnak ah thuro pahnih a si lole laileng pahnih Thukham retnak Puanthlam sangka ah a keng pei ih puithiam hnenah a pek pei."},"15":{"text":"Puithiam in vate pakhat cu sualthlah thawinakah a pek pei ih a dang pakhat cu mei-ur thawinakah a pek pei. Cuticun puithiam in hnai dok pa ih hrangah thianfaiternak a tuah pei."},"16":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat a bua a suak asile a pumpuluk in ti a kholh-aw pei ih cuih sun cu zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"17":{"text":"Cuih bua a tlaknak, pat in tuahmi siseh, savun in tuahmi siseh, thilri hmuahhmuah cu sawpfai ṭheh ding an si ih zanlam tiang thilri thiangfai lo an si pei."},"18":{"text":"Nu le pa an pawl-awk hnuah an pahnih in ti an kholh-aw pei ih cuih sun cu zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo an si pei."},"19":{"text":"Nunau in thlatin thi a neih tikah ni sarih sung mi thiangfai lo a si pei. Cuih nunau a daitu cu zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"20":{"text":"Thi a neih sung a tonak, a si lole a ihnak cu a thiangfai lo a si."},"21":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat in a ihkhun a tham ahcun amah ih hnipuan a sawpfai pei ih tidai in a kholh-awk hnuah zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"22":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat in a tonak pakhatkhat a tham ahcun amah ih hnipuan a fawpfai pei ih a kholh-awk hnuah zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"23":{"text":"A ihkhun siseh, a tonak pakhatkhat siseh, a tham a si ahcun zanlam tiang mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"24":{"text":"Thi a neih sungih mipa thawn an pawl-awk asile a pawltupa khal mi borhhlawh ah a cang ih ni sarih sung cu mi thiangfai lo a si ve; a ihnak ihkhun khal ihkhun thiangfai lo a si."},"25":{"text":"Nunau pakhat in thlatin thi a neih mi hlei ah ni tampi thi a neih ahcun, a si lole nunau daan keel lengih thi a neih ahcun, thi a neih sung hmuahhmuah cu, nunau daan a neih sung vek thotho in mi thiangfai lo a si."},"26":{"text":"Cutiih thi a neih sung hmuahhmuah a ihnak le a tonak pawl cu thil thiangfai lo an si thluh."},"27":{"text":"Cuih thil pawl a thamtu cu mi thiangfai lo a si ih a hnipuan a sawpfai pei ih ti a kholh-aw pei; cuih sun zanlam tiang cupa cu mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"28":{"text":"A thi a reh hnuah ni sarih sung a zoh-aw hrih pei ih cuih hnuah mi thiangfai a si pei."},"29":{"text":"A ni riatnak ah thuro pahnih a si lole laileng pahnih a lak pei ih Bawipa umnak Puanthlam sangka ih ummi puithiam hnenah a keng pei."},"30":{"text":"Puithiam in pakhat cu sualthlah thawinakah a pek pei ih a dang pakhat cu mei-ur thawinakah a pek pei. Cuticun acuih nunau nuih thianfainak cu puithiam in a tuah sak pei."},"31":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ih thianfai lonak ruangah an riahnak laifangih a ummi Bawipa umnak Puanthlam an borhhlawhter lonak ding Israel mi pawl sim dingah Bawipa in Moses a fial. Puanthlam an baalter ngaingai asile thihnak an tong ding."},"32":{"text":"Mipa pakhat a zahmawh ihsin hnai a dokmi, a si lole a bua a suakmi,"},"33":{"text":"nunau pakhat thlatin thi a neimi, a si lole mi pakhat nunau thiangfai lo thawn an pawl-awk thu-ih thlun ding pawl cu a tlun lamih daan pawl hi an si."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah a thianghlim lomi mei-ur thawinak an pek ruangih Aaron fapa pahnih an thih hnuah Bawipa in Moses hnenah hiti in thu a sim.","title":"Remnak Ni"},"2":{"text":"“Na u Aaron kha ṭhatein sim awla puanzar dungih Hmun Thianghlim Bik ahcun a tikcu caan lawngah luh ding a si, ziangahtile cutawk cu Thukam Kuang sin tlunah mero sungin ka langnak hmun a si. Ka sim vekih a thlun lo asile a thi rori ding."},"3":{"text":"Sualthlah thawinak hrangah cawcangte le mei-ur thawinak hrangah tuucang a rak ken hnu lawngah Hmun Thianghlim Bik ahcun a lut thei ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in a hnuailam ih daan pawl hi a pek. Hmun Thianghlim Bik sungih a luh hlanah Aaron cu a kholh-awta pei ih a puithiam thilthuam - korfual mankhung, sunghruk pawl, taikhap le lupawng pawl cu a hruk pei."},"5":{"text":"Israel mipi in Aaron hnenah sualthlah thawinak hrangah mecang pahnih le mei-ur thawinak hrangah tuucang pakhat an pe pei."},"6":{"text":"Amah ih sualthlahnak le a innsang pawl ih sualthlahnak ah cawcang pakhat thawinakah a pe pei."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Bawipa umnak Puanthlam sangka ah mecang pahnih cu a keng pei."},"8":{"text":"Cutawkah cun, “ Bawipa hrangah,” timi le “Azazel hrangah,” tiih khenmi lungto pahnih in camcawh fung zuhnak a tuah pei."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa hrangih hrilmi mecang pakhat cu Aaron in sualthlah thawinak hrangah a pe pei."},"10":{"text":"Cule Azazel khawsia hrangih hrilmi mecang cu a nung in Bawipa hnenah hlan a si pei ih, Israel miphun sualthlahnak dingah nelrawn khawsia Azazel hnenah a thlah pei."},"11":{"text":"Aaron in amah ih sualthlahnak le a innsang sualthlahnak ih cawcang thawinak a pek tikah,"},"12":{"text":"biakṭheng ihsin meilingvam kheng khat le rimhmui thaw ṭhuam hnih a lak pei ih Hmun Thianghlim Bik ahcun a keng pei."},"13":{"text":"Cutawkih Bawipa umnak hmunah cun rimhmui cu a ur pei ih rimhmui khu in Thukam Kuang sin cu a zeel ding; cuticun Thukam Kuang sin cu a hmu lo ding ih a thi lo ding a si."},"14":{"text":"Cawcang ih thisen hrekkhat cu a lak pei ih a mehtok in kuangsin ih hmailam kap cu a theh pei; cule a hrekkhat cu Thukam Kuang ih hmailam kapah voi sarih tiang a theh fawn pei."},"15":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Israel mi ih sualthlahnak hrangah me cu a that pei ih a thisen cu Hmun Thianghlim Bik ah a keng pei. Cule cawcang thisen a theh bangtuk in cuih thisen cu Thukam Kuangsin ah le hmailam kapah a theh pei."},"16":{"text":"Cubangtuk in Israel miphun ih thianhlim lonak le sualnak ihsin Hmun Thianghlim Bik cu thianfaiter dingah thawinak a tuah pei. A thiangfai lomi riahnak laifangih a um ruangah Aaron in Puanthlam cu cubangtuk in a thianfaiter pei."},"17":{"text":"Thianfaiter dingah Hmun Thianghlim Bik ah Aaron a luh ih a suah sal hlan lo zohman Puanthlam sungah an um lo pei. Amah ih hrang, a innsang hrangah le Israel mipi hrangih thianfaiternak a tuah thluh hnuah,"},"18":{"text":"Hmun Thianghlim Bik ihsin a suak pei ih mei-ur thawinak peknak hmunah biakṭheng thianfaiter dingah a feh pei. Cawcang ih thisen hrekkhat le mecangih thisen hrekkhat cu a keng pei ih biakṭheng par a kil ih a ummi ki pali pawl cu a kimvel in a hnih thluh pei."},"19":{"text":"A kutzung in cuih thisen hrekkhat thawn biakṭheng cu voi sarih tiang a theh pei.
