Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek vekin pakhat pakhat in cazin ah an khum a si."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Mithiangfai Lo Pawl"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl in anmah lakih phaarnat a tuarmi le a thihnai a dokmi le miruak a dai ruangih a thiangfai lomi hmuahhmuah cu an riahnak hmun ihsin an dawi thluh pei."},"3":{"text":"An hnenih ka umnak an riahnak hmun cu an balhter lonak dingah a thiangfai lomi hmuahhmuah cu nunau siseh, mipa siseh, dawi thluh hai seh,” tiah thu a pek."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek bangtuk in Israel mi pawl cun an thlun ih mi thiangfai lo pawl cu an riahnak ihsin an dawi thluh."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah","title":"Sual Ruangih Kuansalnak"},"6":{"text":"a tanglamih daan pawl cu Israel mi pawl hrangah a pek. Mipa siseh, nunau siseh, midang parah sualnak tuah tahrat in Bawipa hmaiah rintlak lo a si ahcun,"},"7":{"text":"a sualnak cu a phuang pei ih a tisual man cu cupa hnenah kimte in a kuan hlei ah zateek kul a beet pei."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a tuahmawhmi cu a thi ih a kuanmi saangtu dingah sungkhat suahpi zohman a neih lo a si ahcun puithiam ih hman dingah Bawipa ih hnenah a pek pei. Hi pekmi cu sualthlah thawinak hrangih tuucang a pekmi hlei ah beetmi a si pei."},"9":{"text":"Cun Israel mi pawl in Bawipa ih hnenah a hleice ih thawinak an pekmi pohpoh cu a rak saangtu puithiam ih ta a si pei."},"10":{"text":"Puithiam poh in a hnenih an pekmi laksawng cu a co pei."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Nupi Parih Lunghrinnak"},"12":{"text":"a tanglam daan pawl cu Israel mi hrangah a pek. Pasal neimi nunau in mipa dang thawn a sual ih miborhhlawh ah a cang;"},"13":{"text":"asinain a sual cu phuang loin a thup ringring; a sual lai an kai lo ih a hmutu le an um fawn lo naón a pasal cun zum lonak a nei ih a nupi parah a lung a hring ringring."},"14":{"text":"Culole a nupi cun sualnak zianghman a tuah lo naón a pasal in a zum lo. A nupi a thiik ruangih zum lo meen a rak si."},"15":{"text":"Ziangziang a si khalle hi bangtuk ih thu a um ahcun a pasal in a nupi cu puithiam hnenah a fehpi pei. Thlairawl thawinak hrangih a ṭulmi barli sangvut cuai hrek a keng pei ih thawinak a pek pei. Asinain olif siti le frankincense rimhmui cu a toih lo pei. Ziangahtile himi cu lunghringtu a pasal in thudik theih duh ruangih a pekmi thawinak a si."},"16":{"text":"Puithiam in cuih nunau nu cu biakṭheng hmaiah a suahpi pei ih Bawipa ih hmai ahcun a dingter pei."},"17":{"text":"Cun puithiam in tlak beel pakhat a lak pei ih a sungah tidai thiangfai tawkfang a ret pei; cule Bawipa umnak Puanthlam sungih leivut a lak pei ih, tidai cu khaa dingin, tidai ah a phulh pei."},"18":{"text":"Cuih hnuah puithiam in nunau nuih samtom a phoih pei ih nunau nuih kut sungah thawinak sangvut a ret pei. Amah puithiam in siatserhnak thlentertu tidai cu a beel in a keng pei."},"19":{"text":"Cule puithiam in nunau nu cu, “Mipa dang thawn na sual lo a si ahcun siatserhnak a thlentu hi tidai in lo siatsuah hlah seh."},"20":{"text":"Asinain pasal nei cingin mipa dang thawn nan sual ngaingai a si ahcun,"},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in na hmin cu na miphun lakih midang camsiatnak ah hmang seh. Bawipa in na pumpi thlingter sehla na zahmawh caarter seh."},"22":{"text":"Hi tidai cu na pum sungah lut in na pumpi cu thlingter ciamco sehla na zahmawh khal caarter thluh seh,” tiah siatserhnak a tuahter pei. Cutikah nunau nu cun, “Si hram seh, Amen,” tiah a sawn pei."},"23":{"text":"Cun cuih siatserhnak cu puithiam in a ngan pei ih a nganmi cu beel sungih thlalet cammi siatti sung ahcun a tleuh pei."},"24":{"text":"Tidai cu nunau nuih pum sungih natnak besia suakter dingin a inter hlan ah,"},"25":{"text":"puithiam in nunau nu kut sungih a ummi thlairawl thawinak sangvut cu a lak pei ih Bawipa ih hnenah a hun thlir hnuah biakṭheng parah a ret pei."},"26":{"text":"Cun thawinakih pekmi a si ti langternak ah sangvut cu zatekhat a lak pei ih biakṭheng parah a ur pei. Cule neta bikah tidai cu nunau nu a inter pei."},"27":{"text":"Mipa dang thawn an sual ngaingai asile tidai cun a pum a natter ding ih a pumpi a ṭhang vivo ding ih a zahmawh khal a caar vivo ding. A hmin cu a miphun lakah siatserhmi a si pei."},"28":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a sual lo a si ahcun siatsuahnak a tong lo pei ih fa khal a nei thei ding."},"29":{"text":"Hi daan cu mipa pakhat in a thuneihnak thuaiih a ummi a nupi a thiik ih mipa dang thawn an sual ruangah zum lonak a neih tikah thlun ding mi daan a si."},"30":{"text":"Culole a nupi a thiik meen ruangih zum lonak a neih ruangah a si khalle thlun dingmi daan a si. Cutiin biakṭheng hmaiah nunau nu cu a dinter pei ih puithiam in hi thawinak cu a tuah pei."},"31":{"text":"A pasal cu mawh a phur lo pei; asinain a nupi cu a sual a si ahcun sualman a tuar pei."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Nazir Thukamnak Tuahtu Pawl Hrangih Daan"},"2":{"text":"a tanglam daan pawl cu Israel mi pawl hrangah a pek. Mipa siseh, nunau siseh, a hlei ih pumpe-awmi Nazir si dingah thukamnak a tuah ih Bawipa hnenah pe-aw in a hrante ih a um sungah cun,"},"3":{"text":"Sabit le zu a dai lo pei. Sabit rah ih tuahmi sabitti siseh, sabit zu siseh, ziang hman a in lo pei; sabit rah cu a hring in siseh, a car in siseh, a ei lo pei."},"4":{"text":"Nazir a si sung hmuahhmuah ah sabit kung ihsin ngahmi pohpoh, a mu le a rah le a hawng tiangin, a ei lo pei."},"5":{"text":"Nazir thukamnak thuaiih a um sung hmuahhmuah a sam a met lo pei ih a hmurhmul siseh, a khahmul siseh, a met lo pei. Bawipa hnenih a pumpek thukamnak in a kaihrem sung hmuahhmuah a sam le a khahmul a zuah pei."},"6":{"text":"Miruak kiangah a feh lo pei."},"7":{"text":"A nu a pa, a u a nau ih ruak a si hmanah a naih lo pei. Miruak kiangah feh tahrat in a borhhlawh-awter lo pei; Bawipa hnenih a pumpeknak hminsinnak cu a sam le a hmul a si."},"8":{"text":"Nazir a si sung hmuahhmuah Bawipa ih hnenah a thianghlim a si."},"9":{"text":"Mi pakhat rin lopi in Nazir kiangte-ah a thi ih Nazir ih sam a borhhlawhter a si ahcun ni sarih sung a hngak hnuah a sam le a khahmul pawl cu a met pei; cuticun a borhhlawhnak in a thiang ding."},"10":{"text":"Ni riat ni ah thuro pahnih, a si lole laileng pahnih, puithiam hnenah Bawipa umnak Puanthlam sangka ah a rak keng pei."},"11":{"text":"Puithiam in thuro pakhat cu sualthlah thawinakah a pek pei ih a dang pakhat cu mei-ur thawinakah a pek pei. Cuticun miruak a dai pang ruangih sualthlahnak cu puithiam in a tuah pei. Cuih ni ah a lu cu a thianghlimter sal ding ih,"},"12":{"text":"Nazir si dingah a pum cu Bawipa ih hnenah a pek sal pei. A rak thianhlimter ciami a sam cu a borhhlawhter ruangah a cuih hlanih a tikcu hmuahhmuah cu a lak a si thluh. Cule mawhnak thawinakah kum khat ti tuucangte pakhat a keng pei."},"13":{"text":"Nazir sinak thukammi tikcu a cem tikah a tanglam thawinak a tuah pei. Puanthlam sangka ah a feh pei ih,"},"14":{"text":"raitluan ṭilva pathum Bawipa ih hnenah a pek pei: mei-ur thawinak hrangah kum khat ti tuucangte pakhat, sualthlah thawinak hrangah kum khat ti tuula pakhat le, remnak thawinak hrangah tuucang pakhat a pek pei."},"15":{"text":"Cuih tlunah thilnu tel lo sang bawm khat: olif siti thawn rawi tahratih tuahmi sang sah zet pawl, a paa zetih olif siti hnihmi sang pawl le a ṭulmi thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak pawl a pek pei."},"16":{"text":"Cupawl cu puithiam in Bawipa ih hnenah a keng pei ih sualthlah thawinak le mei-ur thawinak pawl cu a pek pei."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih remnak thawinak hrangah tuucang pakhat le sang bawm khat khal a pek pei ih thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak khal a pek pei."},"18":{"text":"Nazir cun Puanthlam sangka ah a sam cu a met pei ih remnak thawinak an urnak meisa-ah a sam cu a va paih pei."},"19":{"text":"Cun puithiam in an suanmi tuucang ih a liangsa a lak pei ih thilnu tel lo a sahzetmi sang le bawm sungih sang paazet thawn Nazir ih kut sung ahcun a ret pei."},"20":{"text":"Cuih hnuah puithiam in Bawipa ih hnenah a pek pei; hi pekmi pawl cu puithiam hrangah laksawng thianghlim an si ih, tuucang ih cawn le ir thawn puithiam ih co ding hrimhrim an si. Cuih hnuah Nazir cun sabitti a in thei ding."},"21":{"text":"A tlunih daan pawl cu Nazir pawl hrangah an si; asinain Nazir pakhatkhat in a ṭulmi hnakih tam sawn pek dingin thu a kam a si ahcun a thukammi vekin a thlun fekfek thluh pei."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah thu a pek ih,","title":"Puithiam Thlawsuahnak"},"23":{"text":"“Aaron le a fapa pawl in Israel mi pawl thlawsuahnak an pek tikah a thuailam bangtuk in:"},"24":{"text":"‘ Bawipa in lo thlawsuah in lo kilveng hram seh,"},"25":{"text":"Bawipa cu nan parah zaangfahnak le lainatnak nei hram seh,"},"26":{"text":"Bawipa in a mithmai ṭha lo pe in daihnak lo pe hram seh,’ an ti pei."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah Israel mi hrangih thla an cam tikah hi thlawsuah peknak hi an hman a si ahcun Bawipa in a thlawsuah hai ding a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in Bawipa umnak Puanthlam a din ṭheh ni ah Puanthlam le a thuamhnaw pawl, biakṭheng le a thuamhnaw pawl cu hriak a culh ih Bawipa ih hnenah apnak a tuah.","title":"Hotu Pawlih Pekmi"},"2":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Israel phun sungah an hrin ciarih hotu pawl, mipum siar ih ṭuanvo pekmi pawl cun,"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah apnak an tuah. An pekmi pawl cu a khuh neimi cawleng paruk le cawcang hlei hnih, hotu pahnih in cawleng pakhat le hotu pakhat in cawcang pakhat ciar an pek a si. An laksawng an pek ṭheh tikah,"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,"},"5":{"text":"“Puanthlam hrangih hnaṭuannak ah hi laksawng pawl hi sang aw; cule hnaṭuan an neih ciarmi vekin Levi mi pawl hnenah pe aw,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih a ti bangtuk in Moses cun cawleng le cawcang pawl cu Levi mi hnenah a pek."},"7":{"text":"Cawleng pahnih le cawcang pali cu Gershon hrin pawl hnenah a pek ih,"},"8":{"text":"cawleng pali le cawcang pariat cu Merari hrin pawl hnenah a pek. An hnaṭuanmi hmuahhmuah cu Aaron fapa Ithamar ih ho in an ṭuan ding a si."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Moses in Kohath hrin pawl hnenah cawleng siseh, cawcang siseh, a pe lo; ziangahtile annih cu thilri thianghlim pawl ṭuanvo latu an si ih an liang in zawntu ding an si."},"10":{"text":"Cun biakṭheng cu hriak an culh ih Pathian hnenih apnak an tuah ni ah hotu pawl cun laksawng an pek. An laksawng cu biakṭheng ih an rak ken tikah,"},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Sim hai awla, biakṭheng apnak hrangih an laksawng cu ni khatah hotu pakhat, nitin in ni hleihnih sung an pek pei,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah an laksawng cu a tanglam bangtuk in a sangsang in an pek: Ni khatnak ah Judah hrin Amminadab ih fapa Nahshon in a pek. Ni hnihnak ah Issakhar hrin Zuar ih fapa Nethanel in a pek. Ni thumnak ah Zebulun hrin Helon ih fapa Eliab in a pek. Ni linak ah Reuben hrin Shedeur ih fapa Elizur in a pek. Ni nganak ah Simeon hrin Zurishaddai ih fapa Shelumiel in a pek. Ni ruknak ah Gad hrin Deuel ih fapa Eliasaf in a pek. Ni sarihnak ah Efraim hrin Ammihud ih fapa Elishama in a pek. Ni riatnak ah Manasseh hrin Pedahzur ih fapa Gamaliel in a pek. Ni kuanakah Benjamin hrin Gideoni ih fapa Abidan in a pek. Ni hranak ah Dan hrin Ammishaddai ih fapa Ahiezer in a pek. Ni hleikhatnak ah Asher hrin Okhran ih fapa Pagiel in a pek. Ni hleihnihnak ah Naftali hrin Enan ih fapa Ahira in a pek. Hi hotu pakhat fingfingih an pekmi laksawng cu a bangrep ciar a si: upa-ih khiahmi cuaithlainak in cuai khat le ṭikal sawmthum a ritmi ngun kheng pakhat, ṭikal sawm sarih a ritmi ngun maihum pakhat, an pahnih in thlairawl thawinak hrang a ṭulmi siti thawn rawimi sangphut an khat veve; cun ṭikal pahra a rit ih rimhmui khatte-in a ummi sui pakan pakhat; mei-ur thawinak hrangah cawcangte pakhat, tuucang pakhat le kum khat ti tuucangte pakhat; sualthlah thawinak hrangah me pakhat; remnak thawinak hrangah cawcang pahnih, tuucangte panga, mecang panga, le kum khat ti tuucang panga ciar an pek a si.","merge":"13"},"84":{"text":"Hotu hleihnih in biakṭheng apnak hrangih laksawng an pekmi zate cu a tanglam bangtuk in a si: Ngun kheng hleihnih le ngun maihum hleihnih, an zate in cuai kul hluanli a rit. Sui pakan hleihnih an si ih cuai khat le ṭikal kul a rit; an zatein rimhmui an khat ṭheh. Mei-ur thawinak hrangah cawcang hleihnih, tuucang hleihnih, kum khat ti tuucangte hleihnih le cumi thawn pek tlang ding thlairawl thawinak. Sualthlah thawinak hrangah me hleihnih. Remnak thawinak hrangah cawcang kul hluanli, tuucang sawmruk, me sawmruk le kum khat ti tuucangte sawmruk an si.","merge":"85"},"89":{"text":"Moses cu Bawipa thawn bia-aw dingih Puanthlam sungih a luh tinte in Thukam Kuang parih a ummi cherubim pahnih karlak ihsin Bawipa ih aw cu a thei ṭheu."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Meivannak An Ret"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron kha sim awla meivannak ṭhuam ah meisa pasarih a van tikah hmailam tleu dingin vang seh,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"A ti bangtuk in Aaron cun meivannak ṭhuam ih meisa cu hmailam tleu dingin a vang."},"4":{"text":"Cuih meivannak ṭhuam cu, Bawipa in Moses hnenih a riruang hmuh zo vekin a zik in a tawhram tiang sosutmi sui ih tuahmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Levi Mi Thianfaiternak"},"6":{"text":"“Levi mi pawl cu Israel misenpi lakin a dangte in ret awla hiti in thianfaiter hai aw:"},"7":{"text":"An thianfainak dingah tidai theh awla an taksa pumpi in an hmul an met hnuah an hnipuan sawp hai seh. Cuticun an thiangfai ding a si."},"8":{"text":"Levi mi pawl in cawcangte pakhat le thlairawl thawinak hrangih a ṭulmi olif siti thawn rawimi sangphut an keng pei; cule nang in sualthlah thawinak hrangah a dang cawcang pakhat na keng pei."},"9":{"text":"Cun Israel misenpi cu pumkhawmter awla Levi mi pawl cu ka umnak Puanthlam hmaiah ra hai seh."},"10":{"text":"Cule Israel misenpi pawl in Levi mi pawl ih lu parah an kut an suang pei ih ka hna an ṭuannak dingah Aaron in ka hnenah a ap pei."},"11":{"text":"Anmah cu Israel mi lakin a dangte in a hleice ih apmi an si pei."},"12":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Levi mi pawl in cawcang pahnih ih lu parah an kut an suang pei. Levi mi pawl thianfaiternak dingah cawcang pakhat sualthlah thawinakah pek a si pei ih, a dang pakhat cu mei-ur thawinakah pek a si pei."},"13":{"text":"“Levi mi pawl cu a dangte in le a hleice in ka hnenah i pe awla, anmah hotu-ah Aaron le a fapa pawl ret hai aw."},"14":{"text":"Cuticun Levi mi pawl cu Israel misenpi hnen ihsin a dangte-ah ret awla keimah ih minung an si ding."},"15":{"text":"Levi mi pawl cutiih na thianfaiter hnu le na ap hnu ahcun Puanthlam sungih hnaṭuantu dingah an tlak ding."},"16":{"text":"Israel miphun ih fapatir hmuahhmuah aiah ka ham zomi an si ih keimah ih bulta an si."},"17":{"text":"Izipt ramih Izipt mi fatir hmuahhmuah ka thihter tikah Israel mi fapatir hmuahhmuah le an ṭilva ih fatir hmuahhmuah cu keimah ih ta dingah ka thianhlimtermi an si."},"18":{"text":"Israel mi fapatir hmuahhmuah aiah Levi mi pawl cu ka lakmi an si."},"19":{"text":"Puanthlam ih hnaṭuan dingah le Hmun Thianghlim ah Israel mi pawl an rat ih thihnak an ton pang lonak ding kilkhawitu-ah anmah cu Aaron le a fapa pawl hnenah ka pek. Cuih tlunah annih cu Israel mi pawl lak ihsin a hleice in ka hnenih apmi si dingah ka hrilmi an si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in Moses hnenih thu a pek bangtuk in Moses le Aaron le Israel mi hmuahhmuah in Levi mi pawl cu Pathian hnenah an ap."},"21":{"text":"Levi mi pawl cu an thianfai aw-ih an hnipuan an sawp ih Aaron in Bawipa ih hnenah laksawng hleice-ah anmah cu a pek. An hrangah sualthlah thiannak khal a tuah sak."},"22":{"text":"Cuticun Levi mi pawl cu Aaron le a fapa pawl ih ho in Puanthlam sungih hnaṭuantu ah a tlakmi ah an cang. Bawipa in Moses hnenah Levi mi pawl parih tuah ding thu a pek vekin misenpi pawl cun an tuah thluh."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,"},"24":{"text":"“Levi mi pawl cu ka umnak Puanthlam ah kum kul hluannga an ti in hnaṭuan an thok pei ih,"},"25":{"text":"kum sawmnga an ti-ah an cawl pei."},"26":{"text":"Cuih hnu cun Puanthlam sungih hnaṭuan an duh lai hrih asile an rualpi pawl bawmtu lawng an si thei pei. Anmahte cun hna an ṭuan nawn lo pei. Cubangtuk in Levi mi pawl ih hnaṭuannak cu na tawlrel sak pei,” tiah a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi an suah hnu a kum hnihnak thla hmaisabik ah Sinai nelrawn ah hiti in a sim.","title":"Lantak Puai Voihnihnak"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl in Lantak Puai cu a tikcu a kim tinte in tuah hai seh."},"3":{"text":"Hi thla ni hleili nitlak vete in tuah ding timi le thlun ding timi daan hmuahhmuah vekin an tuah pei,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Moses in Lantak Puai tuah ding cu a sim ih,"},"5":{"text":"a sim vek cun thla hmaisa bikih ni hleilinak siim lamin Sinai nelrawn ahcun an tuah. Bawipa in Moses hnenih thu a pek bangtuk in Israel mi pawl cun an tuah thluh."},"6":{"text":"Asinain mi hrekkhat cu miruak an tham ruangah mi thiangfai lo an si ih cuih ni-ih Lantak Puai ah an tel thei lo. Curuangah Moses le Aaron hnenah an feh ih,"},"7":{"text":"“Miruak kan tham ruangah kannih cu mi thiangfai lo kan si. Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl in Bawipa hnenih thawinak an pek tikah tel thei lo dingin ziangah so in kham?” tiah an sut."},"8":{"text":"Moses in, “Nan hrangih Bawipa ih thupekmi ka ngah hlan lo cu rak hngak hrih uh,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Israel mi pawl than dingah Moses hnenah,"},"10":{"text":"“Anmah siseh, an tesinfa pawl siseh, miruak dai ruangih mi thiangfai lo an si tikah siseh, khual lamhla an tlawn tikah siseh, Lantak Puai an hmang duh thotho a si ahcun,"},"11":{"text":"thla hnihnak ni hleili zanlam khuathim zawng in an hmang thei ve pei. Cumi puai cu thilnu rawi lo sang le ankha hnah thawn an tuah pei."},"12":{"text":"An thahmi tuu ih ruh cu pakhat hman an khiak lo pei ih, rawl cu a thaizing tiang hlah-mi an nei lo pei. Lantak Puai cu thlun ding timi daan vekin an ul pei."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mi pakhatkhat thianfai lonak ziang hman a nei lo ih khual khal a tlawng lo naón Lantak Puai a tuah lo a si ahcun amah cu ka miphun sungah siarcih a si nawn lo pei. Ziangahtile a tikcu ah ka hnenih thawinak a pek lo ruangah a si. A sualman cu amah in a tuar pei."},"14":{"text":"“An lakih a um ramdang mi in Lantak Puai a tuah duh ve a si ahcun tuah ding le thlun ding timi daan vekin a thlun pei. Israel mi siseh, ramdang mi siseh, an thlun dingmi daan cu a bangrep thluh a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam an din ni ah mero a rung zaam ih Puanthlam cu a run zeel thluh. Zanvarte mero cu meisa vekin a tleu.","title":"A Tleumi Mero (Suah 40.34-38)"},"16":{"text":"Cubangtuk ringring in a si: sunah mero in a khuh ih zanah cun meisa bangtuk a si."},"17":{"text":"Mero a kian tinte in Israel mi pawl cu an riahnak hmun an ṭhawn ih mero a rung zaam tinte in riahnak hmun an khuar sal ṭheu."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupeknak vekin Israel mi pawl cu an riahnak an ṭhawn ih a thupek vek thothoin an sak sal ṭheu. Puanthlam tlunih mero a zaam sung hmuahhmuah cu an riahbuk ah an caam."},"19":{"text":"Mero cu tikcu reipi ṭhawn loih a um tikah Bawipa ih duhnak an thlun ih ṭhawn loin an um ve."},"20":{"text":"Voikhat khat cu Puanthlam tlunah ni malte sung lawng mero a zaam; an riahnak hmunih an riah tikah siseh, an riahnak an ṭhawn tikah siseh, Bawipa ih duhnak vekin an thlun."},"21":{"text":"Voikhatkhat cu khuathim ihsin zinglam tiang lawng mero a zaam ih cuih mero a kian vete in an ceer ve ṭheu. Sun zan ti loin mero a kian tinin an riahnak cu an thawn ṭheu a si."},"22":{"text":"Ni hnih siseh, thla khat siseh, a si lole kum khat sung khal siseh, Puanthlam parih mero a zaam sung hmuahhmuah cu an ṭhawn hrimhrim lo; asinain mero a kian vete cun an ṭhawn ve a si."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hmang in thu a pekmi pawl cu an thlun ruangah an riahnak cu an ṭhawn ih umhmun an khuar sal ṭheu."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Ngun Tawtawrawt"},"2":{"text":"“So ih sutmi ngun tawtawrawt pahnih na tuah pei ih Israel mi pawl pumkhawm kawhnak ah le riahhmun ṭhawn ding thannakah na hmang pei."},"3":{"text":"Tawtawrawt a pahnih in rei zet an phawt tikah misenpi an zatein ka umnak Puanthlam luhnak sangka ah an ra pumkhawm ding."},"4":{"text":"Asinain tawtawrawt pakhat lawng an phawt a si ahcun an hrin ciarih hotu pawl lawnglawng na hnenah an ra ding."},"5":{"text":"Cun ringzet le tawizet ih tawtawrawt an phawt tikah nisuahnak lamih a riakmi hrin pawl an ṭhawn pei."},"6":{"text":"Cule cubangtuk thothoin a voihnihnak ringzet le tawizet ih an phawt asile thlanglam ih a riakmi hrin pawl an ṭhawn pei. Curuangah riahnak ṭhawn ding ahcun ringzet le tawizet in tawtawrawt an phaw pei ih,"},"7":{"text":"misenpi tongkhawm ding ahcun reizet in an phaw ding."},"8":{"text":"Tawtawrawt cu Aaron fapa puithiam pawl lawnglawng in an phaw pei. “A tanglamih daan pawl cu hmailamah nan tesinfa pawl tiang an thlun dingmi an si."},"9":{"text":"Nan ram sungih a lo neh-nentu ral pawl nan do tikah hi tawtawrawt pawl hi raldo tawtawrawt phawtin nan phaw pei. Bawipa nan Pathian keimah in ka lo bawm ding ih nan ral pawl ih kut ihsin ka lo run ding."},"10":{"text":"Cun lungawi tikcu, thla thar caan ih nan Thla Thar Puai pawl le nan biaknak puai dangdang pawl hrangah siseh, mei-ur thawinak le remnak thawinak nan pek tik khalah siseh, hi tawtawrawt pawl cu nan phaw pei. Cuticun ka lo bawm hai ding. Keimah hi Bawipa nan Pathian ka si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Izipt ram in an suah hnu kum hnihnak a thla hnihnak ni kul ni ah Bawipa umnak Puanthlam tlunih mero cu a kiang ih,","title":"Israel Mi An Riahnak An ṭhawn"},"12":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Sinai nelrawn ihsin an suak. Cule Paran nelrawn an thlen in mero cu a cawl."},"13":{"text":"Moses hnenih Bawipa thupekmi bangtuk in Israel mi pawl cu an ṭhawn a si."},"14":{"text":"Riahnak an ṭhawn tinin, Judah thantaar hnuai ih a ummi hmuahhmuah cu hmaisabik ah an feh; Judah hrin pawl hotu cu Amminadab fapa Nahshon a si."},"15":{"text":"Issakhar hrin pawl hotu cu Zuar ih fapa Nethanel a si ih,"},"16":{"text":"Zebulun hrin pawl hotu cu Helon ih fapa Eliab a si."},"17":{"text":"Cun Puanthlam cu an ṭhet ih Gershon le Merari hrin pawl in an phur ih midang bangin an pok ve."},"18":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Reuben thantaar hnuai ih a ummi pawl an feh. Reuben hrin pawl hotu cu Shedeur ih fapa Elizur a si."},"19":{"text":"Simeon hrin hotu cu Zurishaddai ih fapa Shelumiel a si ih,"},"20":{"text":"Gad hrin hotu cu Deuel ih fapa Eliasaf a si."},"21":{"text":"Cule Kohath hrin, thilri thianghlim pawl a phurtu cu an pok ve ih riahhmun an khuarnak an va thlen tikah cun Puanthlam cu din cia in a rak um zo."},"22":{"text":"Cuṭhehin Efraim thantaar hnuai ih a ummi pawl an feh. Efraim hrin hotu cu Ammihud ih fapa Elishama a si,"},"23":{"text":"Manasseh hrin hotu cu Pedahzur ih fapa Gamaliel a si ih,"},"24":{"text":"Benjamin hrin hotu cu Gideoni ih fapa Abidan a si."},"25":{"text":"Neta bikah Dan thantaar hnuai ih a ummi pawl cu dunglamih ral kiltu-ah a bur a bur in an feh. Dan hrin hotu cu Ammishaddai ih fapa Ahiezer a si."},"26":{"text":"Asher hrin hotu cu Okhran ih fapa Pagiel a si ih,"},"27":{"text":"Naftali hrin hotu cu Enan ih fapa Ahira a si."},"28":{"text":"Israel mi pawl an riahnak an ṭhawn ih a bur a burih an fehdan cu cuticun a si."},"29":{"text":"Moses in Midian mi a pu Reuel ih fapa, a nupi ih ṭapa Hobab hnenah, “ Bawipa in pe dingih in tiammi ram ah kan feh thlang ding. Bawipa in Israel mi cu mineinung zet dingih tuah dingin thu in kam zo; curuangah kan hnenah ra ve awla kan lennak cu kan lo hlawm ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Hobab cun, “Ka ra lo ding; ka ram le ka miphun hnenah ka kir sawn ding a si,” tiah a sawn."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in, “In tlansan hram hlah aw. Hramlak ramṭhing kan thlen tikah riahnak hmun ṭha na thei sawn ding a si. Curuangah in hruai theitu na si ding."},"32":{"text":"Kan hnenih na rat asile Bawipa ih in pekmi thlawsuahnak hmuahhmuah cu nangmah thawn kan hlawm aw ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Israel misenpi cu, tlang thianghlim Sinai tlang cun an pok ih ni thum ban khual lamhla-ah an feh. Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu an hmaiah a rak feh ih colhnak hmun a rak hawl.","title":"Misenpi An Feh"},"34":{"text":"An riahnak hmun pakhat in pakhat ih an ṭhawn tikah Bawipa ih mero cu sunvu an tlunah a um ringring."},"35":{"text":"Cun Thukam Kuang cu riahhmun ihsin a ṭhawn tinte in Moses in, “Maw Bawipa , tho awla na ral pawl cu ṭhekdarh thluh hai aw; a lo huatu pawl cu na hmai ihsin tlanhlo thluh hai seh,” tiah a ti ṭheu."},"36":{"text":"Cule Kuang a colh tinin, “Maw Bawipa , Israel mi a thawng le a za hnenah hin ra kir hram aw,” tiah a ti ṭheu."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl harsatnak an tuar ruangah Bawipa ih parah an phunzai ciamco. Cutiih an phunzainak cu Bawipa in a theih tikah a thin a heng ih an parah mei-alh a run thlak. An lakah meisa cu a alh ih an riahnak kap hmun khat a kang ciamco.","title":"Taberah Timi Hmun"},"2":{"text":"Misenpi cu bomnak dil in Moses hnenah an au. Moses cun Bawipa hnenah thla a cam ih meisa cu a mit sal."},"3":{"text":"Cutiin Bawipa ih meisa an lakih a alh ruangah cuih hmun cu Taberah tiah an ko."},"4":{"text":"Israel mi pawl lakih a feh vemi ram dangmi hrekkhat cu sa an hiar ngaingai. Anmah Israel mi lala khal cu an tlok an ciar ih, “Sa ei ding um sehla maw!","title":"Moses In Hruaitu Sawmsarih A Hril"},"5":{"text":"Izipt ramah cun ngasa tla a lak in kan ngah sikhawh. Kan ei ṭheu mi fanghma pawl, kawl fanghma pawl, tlang purun pawl, khasuansen le khasuanrang pawl tla kan vun ngai ringring."},"6":{"text":"Asinain atu ahcun kan tha a cem; kan caar cuahco. Ei ding ziang hman a um lo; ni khat hnu ni khat manna lawnglawng, manna lawnglawng,” an ti."},"7":{"text":"Manna cu thlaici fate vek a si ih a pianzia cu a rang nawn, aihre nawn a si."},"8":{"text":"A cuih manna cu Israel misenpi pawl in an va khawm ih phut ko in an rial, a si lole sum ah an den ih an suan hnuah sangphak ah an tuah. A thawtdan cu olif siti thawn rawhmi sang vek a si."},"9":{"text":"Manna cu an riahhmun ih zandai a tlak tikah a tla vemi a si."},"10":{"text":"Misenpi pawl an riahbuk sangka ciarah ding tahratih an phunzai rero kha Moses in a thei. Bawipa cu an parah a thin a heng. Moses cu a riah a sia ngaingai ih,"},"11":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah, “Zianghrangah so na salpa kei hi hiti lawmmam ih i ti siat? Ziangah so na mithmai ṭha ka co thei lo? Ziangah so hi minung pawl kilkhawi ding thilrit hi ka phurh dingah ka parih na thlenter?"},"12":{"text":"Hi minung pawl hringtu ka si lo ih seemtertu khal ka si lo. Nau umtu in naute a baan ih a cawi ringring vekin ziang hrangah so hi minung pawl hi an pupa pawl hnenih na kam ciami ramtiam tiang cawi dingah i fial?"},"13":{"text":"Minung hizat hrangah hin sa cu khuitawk in so ka laak cawk ding? Cat loin an raak an kio ih sa an ngen ringring fawn."},"14":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: minung hizat hrangah keimah lawng cun ṭuanvo ka la cawk lo a si. Ka thil a rit tuk."},"15":{"text":"Hiti thotho ding a si ahcun i ti siatnak ihsin ka luat theinak dingah i zaangfah awla hmakhatte-ah i that lawlaw aw,” tiah a dil."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Miseenpi lakih rinsan tlak le zum tlak hruaitu sawm sarih ko khawm in ka umnak Puanthlam ah ratpi hai awla na kiangah ding hai seh."},"17":{"text":"Ka rungṭum pei ih nangmah thawn kan bia-aw ding ih ka lo pek ciami thlarau cu na hnen ihsin a hrekkhat ka la pei ih an hnenah ka pe ding. Cuticun hi misenpi pawl kilkhawinak thilrit cu an lo sawng pei ih nangmah lawngin na phur nawn lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah misenpi pawl cu, ‘Thaisun hrangah thianfai-aw hai seh; sa ei ding nan ngah thlang ding. Nan ṭahnak le sa ei nan hiar ih nan ngennak le, “Izipt ramah cun sa kan khopzet naón, nan tinak pawl cu Bawipa in a thei a si. Atu ah Bawipa in sa a lo pe hai ding ih sa ei ding nan ngah thlang ding."},"19":{"text":"Sa ei ding cu ni khat, ni hnih, ni nga, ni hra, a si lole ni kul sung, lawng si loin,"},"20":{"text":"a lo ngei ih nan luak a suak neknek tiangin thla khat pumhlum sung nan ei ding. Ziangahtile Bawipa Pathian nan hnong ih a theih hngan rori-ah Izipt ram ihsin rak suak lo ding kan si naón, ti-ih nan phunzai ruangah a si,’ tiah sim aw,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cule Moses in Bawipa hnenah, “Atu tiang ka hruaimi misenpi hi thawng zaruk an si. Thla khat sung an khop ei dingah sa ka pe hai ding na ti maw?"},"22":{"text":"Caw le tuu pawl an khop in thah ding a um cawk ding maw? Tifinriat ih nga hmuahhmuah hman an khop pei maw?” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Ka huham le ka cah-nak hin ti thei lomi a nei maw si? Ka ṭong vekih a can ngaingai le can ngaingai lo cu rei lo te-ah na hmu mai ding,” tiah Moses cu a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cule Moses cu a suak ih Bawipa ih simmi pawl cu misenpi hnenah a sim sal. Hruaitu sawm sarih pawl cu Puanthlam kimvelah cun a pumkhawmter."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa cu mero sungin a rung ih Moses hnenah cun thu a run sim. Moses hnenih a pek zomi thlarau hrekkhat cu a lak ih hruaitu sawm sarih pawl hnenah a pek. An hnenih thlarau a thlen vete cun profet vekin an ṭong celcel. Asinain cumicu a rei hlanah a reh sal."},"26":{"text":"Hruaitu sawm sarih lakih a tel vemi pahnih Eldad le Medad cu Puanthlam ah feh loin an riahnak ah an rak um. Cutawk an riahbuk ahcun an hnenah thlarau cu a thleng ih hmakhatte ah profet vekin an ṭong ciamco ve."},"27":{"text":"Eldad le Medad umdan cu tlangval pakhat in a hmu ih a va tlan ih Moses a va sim."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah a no lai ihsin Moses bawmtu a si ringring mi Nun ih fapa Joshua cun Moses hnenah, “Ka bawipa, cute pahnih cu kham hai aw,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, “Ka hrangah ziang a cang pei ti lawng na ruat maw si? Aw, Bawipa in a minung pawl ih parah a thlarau cu thlengter in an zatein profet bangin ṭong thluh hai sehla ti ka va duh so!” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Moses le Israel hruaitu sawm sarih pawl cu an riahnak ah an tlung."},"31":{"text":"Rin lopi-ah Bawipa in thli a hranter ih tifinriat lam in vanim pawl cuih thli cun leilung ihsin pi thum sangin a rak hranpi ih an riahhmun ihsin nisuahnak lam, nitlaknak lam, saklam, thlanglam, ni khat thlen ban sung hmuahhmuah cu vanim hlir an ril teptep.","title":"In Vanim A Suahter"},"32":{"text":"Curuangah misenpi pawl cu a cuih sun in a thaisun tiang a sun a zan it lo siing loin vanim an khawm. Minung pakhat hman haan sawmnga hnakih mal sartu an um lo. An riahhmun ih kimvel ah caar dingin an pho ciamco."},"33":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an vanimsa a cem hlan, ei ding tampi an neih laiah, misenpi parah Bawipa cu a thin a heng ih an parah pulhnat a tlunter."},"34":{"text":"Sa a hiartu mi tampi cu cutawkah phum an si ruangah cutawk hmun cu Hibroth Hataavah tiah an ko; a tican cu Hiarnak Thlan ti ai a si."},"35":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin misenpi cu an suak ih Hazeroth an timi an thleng ih cutawkah riahhmun an khuar."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hazeroth ih an um laiah cun, Moses in Kush nunau a ṭhit; curuangah Miriam le Aaron in Moses cu an thangsiat.","title":"Miriam Hremnak A Tuar"},"2":{"text":"Annih in, “ Bawipa cu Moses hnen lawng in maw thu a sim? Kannih hnen in teh a sim ve lo maw si?” an ti. Cutiih an ti cu Bawipa in a thei ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Moses cu mitangdor zetmi a si ih leilung tlunah amah tluk mitangdor zohman an um lo."},"4":{"text":"Hmakhatteah Bawipa cun Moses le Aaron le Miriam hnenah, “Nan pathum in ka umnak Puanthlam ah ra hnik uh,” a ti. An va feh ih,"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa cu mero zual sungin a runglang ih Puanthlam sangka ahcun a ding ih, “Aaron! Miriam!” tiah a ko. An pahnih cun hmaiah an va suak ih,"},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka ṭong hi ciing ṭha uh! Nanmah ih lakih profet an um tikah an hnenah langnak in ka lang ih an mangah thu ka sim."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Moses cu ka miphun Israel mi pawl kilkhawitu-ah ṭuanvo ka pek ruangah,"},"8":{"text":"anih hnen ahcun hmaitonte rori in ka ṭong a si; thupolh in ka ṭong lo, fiangzet le tluangzet in ka ṭong a si. Ka pianhmang hman a hmu zo a si. Cutluk ih ka milai a si mi Moses cu ziangtinso nan thangsiat ngam?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa cun an parah thinheng ngaingai in a feh santa."},"10":{"text":"Cule mero cu Puanthlam ihsin a hlitih, cu vete in Miriam cu phaarnat in a khat ih a vun tla cu vur bangin a rang thluh. Aaron in Miriam cu a zoh ih phaarnat in a khat ṭheh a si ti a hmu."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Aaron in Moses hnenah, “Ka bawipa, in zaangfah hram awla, aat-thlakza thil sual kan tuah zo naón kan sual man cu in tuarter siang hram hlah aw."},"12":{"text":"A thicia in a nuih pumsung in a suak ih a taksa hrekkhat a ṭawt thluh zomi naute bangtuk ah Miriam cu canter hram hlah aw,” tiah a dil."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Bawipa cu a ko ih, “Maw Bawipa , zaangfahte in Miriam hi run damter hram aw,” tiah a dil."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Thuṭhimnak ah a pa in a fanu ih hmai cil in phui sehla, ni sarih sung ningzak in a um ding a si lo maw? Cubangin nan riahhmun lengah Miriam cu ni sarih sung suah uh, cuih hnuah nan lak sal leh ding,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"A ti bangin Miriam cu an riahhmun lengah ni sarih sung an suah ih an lak kir sal hlan lo misenpi cu ṭhawn loin an um."},"16":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Hazeroth hmun ihsin an suak ih Paran hramlak ramṭhingah riahhmun an khuar."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Thlingthlatu Pawl (Daan 1.19-33)"},"2":{"text":"“Israel miphun hleihnih sungin phun khatah hruaitu pakhat ciar hril awla ka pek hai dingmi Kanaan ram zoh dingah le thlingthla dingah thlah aw,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek vekin Moses cun a tuah ih a tanglam Israel mi lakih hruaitu pawl cu an riahhmun Paran in a thlah hai:"},"4":{"text":"Reuben hrin in Zakkur ih fapa Shammua,"},"5":{"text":"Simeon hrin in Hori ih fapa Shafat,"},"6":{"text":"Judah hrin in Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb,"},"7":{"text":"Issakhar hrin in Josef ih fapa Igal,"},"8":{"text":"Efraim hrin in Nun ih fapa Hoshea,"},"9":{"text":"Benjamin hrin in Rafu ih fapa Palti,"},"10":{"text":"Zebulun hrin in Sodi ih fapa Gaddiel,"},"11":{"text":"Manasseh hrin in Susi ih fapa Gaddi,"},"12":{"text":"Dan hrin in Gemalli ih fapa Ammiel,"},"13":{"text":"Asher hrin in Mikhael ih fapa Sethur,"},"14":{"text":"Naftali hrin in Vofsi ih fapa Nahbi, le"},"15":{"text":"Gad hrin in Makhi ih fapa Geuel, pawl an si."},"16":{"text":"Hi pawl cu Moses in Kanaan ram zoh dingih a thlahmi an si. Nun fapa ih hmin Hoshea cu Joshua ah Moses in a thleng sak."},"17":{"text":"Cutiin Moses ih a thlah tikah an hnenah, “Kanaan ram sung thlanglam ah hung feh uhla, cuih hnuah an tlangram ah hung feh uh."},"18":{"text":"An ram cu ziangbangtuk ram a si, minung ziangzat an um, a ummi pawl cu micak an si maw si lo, ti pawl ṭhatein nan zingzoi pei."},"19":{"text":"An ram cu ram ṭha a si maw si lo, ti le mi pawl cu khawte ah maw ralhruang kulhmi khawpi ah so an um, ti pawl;"},"20":{"text":"cule an ram cu a leilung a ṭha maw, cun tupi teh a um maw, a si lole leenkolh a tam maw, ti pawl ṭhatein nan zoh pei. Cun an ramih a rahmi thingrah hrekkhat cu nan run keng tengteng pei,” tiah thu a cah. Cuih tikcu cu sabit rah hmin tikcu a si."},"21":{"text":"Israel hruaitu pawl cu an feh ih Kanaan ram cu an hung zoh. An ram thlanglam ih a ummi Zin timi nelrawn ihsin saklam ih Hamath Tlangkawn kiangih Rehob tiang an feh."},"22":{"text":"Cuih sin an feh lala ih Anakim timi mitum zetzet pawl ih cithlah Ahiman, Sheshai le Talmai pawl ih sungkhat pawl an umnak Hebron khua an thleng. Hebron cu Izipt ramih Zoan khua an tlak hlan kum sarih ih tlakmi a si."},"23":{"text":"Cule Eshkhol Phairawn an thleng ih cutawkah bawr khat a rahmi sabit cu a hnge in an tan ih a rihzet ruangah minung pahnih in fung in an zawn. Taleti le thei khal an lo ih an phur."},"24":{"text":"Cutawk hmun cu Israel hruaitu pawl ih sabit bawr khat an sahnak a si ruangah Eshkhol Phairawn tiah hmin an sak."},"25":{"text":"Kanaan ram cu ni sawmli sung an zoh hnuah,"},"26":{"text":"Moses le Aaron le Israel misenpi rak umnak Paran nelrawnih an riahnak hmun Kadesh ahcun an ra thleng. An hmuhmi hmuahhmuah cu an sim ih an rak phurhmi thingrah pawl cu an hmuh."},"27":{"text":"Moses hnenah, “Zoh dingih in thlahmi ram cu kan va zoh ih cawhnawi le khuaitizu in a khatmi ram a si. Thingrah pawl tla hinah kan rak keng."},"28":{"text":"Asinain cutawkih a ummi pawl cu micakzet an si. An khawpi tla cu an tum zetzet ih ralhruang ih kulhmi fekfek an si. Cuih tlunah mikei vekih mitum zetzet pawl tla kan hmu."},"29":{"text":"Amalek mi pawl cu an ram thlanglam ah an um. Hit mi, Jebus mi le Amor mi pawl cu tlangpar ram ah an um ih Kanaan mi pawl cu Mediterranean Tifinriat kiangah le Jordan Tiva kap tluanah an um,” tiah an ti."},"30":{"text":"Cule Moses hmaiah misenpi pawl cu an phunzai ciamco. Cutikah Kaleb in dai koin a tuah hnuah, “Cumi pawl cu atu rori ah kan do pei ih an ram cu kan lak mai ding. Anmah neh dingah cun kan cakzet pam a si,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Kaleb thawn a feh vemi Israel hruaitu pawl cun, “Sihlah ee, annih do dingah kan cak lamlam lo; kannih hnakin an cak deuh ngaingai a si,” an ti."},"32":{"text":"Cutiin an va zohmi ram thu cu Israel misenpi hnenah thinnau dingin a dik lo zawng in an sim. Annih in, “Kan hung thlingthlakmi ram cu an ram sung minung pawl hman a dolhthluhtu ram a si."},"33":{"text":"Kan hmuhmi minung hmuahhmuah cu mitum le misang zetzet an si ih Anak ih tesinfa pawl tla cu mikei an si ko. Kannih tla cu an hnenah cun kharbok tluk fang kan si ih annih ih in hmuhnak khalah cu thotho kan si ko ding,” tiah an ti."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel misenpi pawl cu an riahsia in zanvar an ṭap.","title":"Misenpi An Phunzai"},"2":{"text":"Moses le Aaron parah an phunzai ih, “Izipt ramah khan rak thih sawn taak ding. Culo talle hramlak ahhin thi sawn nungna a ṭha ding naón!"},"3":{"text":"Ziangah so Bawipa in hi ram ahhin in thlenpi ngelcel? Ral ah kan thi thluh ding ih kan nupi le kan faate pawl tla ral in an kai thluh ding a si. Izipt ram ah kir sal sehla a ṭha sawn lo ding maw?” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule pakhat le pakhat, “Izipt ramih in hruai kirtu dingah hotu kan hril pei,” an ti-aw."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Moses le Aaron cu Israel mi misenpi hmaiah an bok."},"6":{"text":"Cun Kanaan ram zoh dingih an thlahmi lakih a tel vemi pahnih, Nun ih fapa Joshua le Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb cu an riahsiat tukah an hnipuan an thlek ih,"},"7":{"text":"Israel misenpi hnenah cun, “Kan va zohmi ram cu ram ṭha ngaingai a si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cu kan parih a lung a awi a si ahcun Amah in in hruai ding ih cawhnawi le khuaitizu in a khatmi ram cu in thlenpi ding ih in pe ding."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa cu dodal hlah uhla cutawk ramih a ummi pawl tla cu ṭih hlah uh. Olte in kan neh ko ding. Bawipa cu kan hnenah a um ih anmah humhimtu an khawzing pawl cu a siatsuah thluh zo a si. Ṭih hrimhrim hlah uh,” tiah an ti."},"10":{"text":"Asinain Israel misenpi pawl cun anmah riangri cu lungto in den that an tum. Sikhalsehla rin lopi-ah misenpi in Bawipa ih huham tleu kha Puanthlam tlunih a lang kha an hmu."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Hi minung pawl in ziangtik tiangso in nautat ding? An lakah mangbangza tampi ka tuah zo naón keimah rinsan duh loin ziangtik tiangso an um ding?","title":"Misenpi Hrangah Moses Thla A Cam"},"12":{"text":"Pulhnat natsia ka tlunter ding ih ka siatsuah thluh hai ding. Anmah hnakih lian deuh le cak deuh miphun pakhat ka seemter ding ih nangmah hi an pa na si ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Bawipa ih hnenah, “Nangmah ih cahnak huham in himi pawl cu Izipt ram ihsin na rak suahpimi an si. Na minung pawl parih thil na tuahmi hi Izipt mi pawl in an rak hmu zo sikhawh,"},"14":{"text":"hi ramih a ummi hnenah an sim ko ding. Bawipa nangmah cu kan hnenah na um ih nangmah ih mero cu kan tlunah cawl tahratin langhngan ih in umpi zia cu hi ram minung pawl in an thei zo. Cuih tlunah sunah mero zual, zanah meisa tom ih in hruai ringring ṭheu hi an theih thluh zomi a si fawn."},"15":{"text":"Cubangtuk hnu ih na minung pawl na thah thluh hai a si ahcun na hmin a lo theitu miphun hmuahhmuah in,"},"16":{"text":"‘An Pathian in a minung pawl cu a tiam ciami ram ah thlenpi thei loin hramlakah a that thluh hai a si,’ tiah an lo ti pang ding."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa , nang cun ‘Thinheng ol mi ka si lo, duhdawtnak neimi ka si, rinsan tlak ka si, sualnak le dodalnak ngaithiamtu ka si ih pupa sin sual ruangah san thum san li tiang an tesinfa pawl tlolh loih a hremtu ka si fawn,’ tiih na rak ti vek khan, maw Bawipa , na huham le na thiltitheinak cu run langter awla in tiamciami cu kimter hram aw.","merge":"18"},"19":{"text":"Izipt ramih an suah thok ihsin tuihsun tiang na ngaithiam hai bangtuk in, a thukmi le a thleng-aw dah lomi na duhdawtnak in hi na minung pawl cu ngaithiam hram hai aw,” tiah zaangfah a dil."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “I dil bangtuk in ka ngaithiam hai ding."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a nungmi Pathian ka si ih ka sunlawinak huham in leilung cu a khuh thluh ruangah ka hmin in thu ka lo kam:"},"22":{"text":"Kanaan ram an luh tikah himi pawl cu zohman a nungmi an um lo ding. Izipt ram ah siseh, hramlak nelrawn ah siseh, mangbangza ka tuah mi le ka sunlawinak tleuvar cu an hmu ṭheh ko naón in rinsan lo ih in zum duh hrimhrim lo. Keimah sawn voisawm le voiza in hniksak a si."},"23":{"text":"An pu le an pa hnenih ka kam ciami ram cu an thleng hrimhrim lo ding."},"24":{"text":"Asinain ka salpa Kaleb cu a ruahnak phundangte a si ih a thinlung zatein i thlun a si. Curuangah a va zohmi ram cu ka thlengter ding ih a tesinfa pawl in cuih ram cu an co ding."},"25":{"text":"Amalek mi le Kanaan mi pawl an umnak phairawn tla cu an ta a si ding. Thaisun in nan dung nan let pei ih Tipi Sen lam zawh in hramlak nelrawn ah nan feh kir pei,” tiah Moses cu a ti."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenah,","title":"In Israel Mi A Hrem"},"27":{"text":"“Ziangtik tiangso hi miṭha lo pawl hi ka parah an phunzai ding? An tlawhciarnak hi ka thei tamtuk zo!"},"28":{"text":"Curuangah an hnenah, ‘A nungmi Pathian ka si ih siatcam in thu ka lo kam: Ka hnenih nan dil vek cekci in nan parah ka tuah ding. Bawipa a si mi keimah in ka ṭong zo."},"29":{"text":"Nan thi ding ih hi hramlak ahhin nan ruak pawl cu ṭhekdarh thluh an si ding. Ka parih nan phunzai ruangah nan lakih kum kul tlun minung zohman Kanaan ram nan thleng lo ding."},"30":{"text":"Hi ram co dingah thu ka rak lo kam. Asinain Kaleb le Joshua siar lo pakhat hman nan thleng lo ding."},"31":{"text":"Ral in kan faate pawl an kai thluh pang ding nan ti. Asinain cuih nan faate pawl riangri cu nan duh lo taak ram ahcun ka thlenpi thluh hai dingih an ram ah a cang ding."},"32":{"text":"Nannih cu hi hramlak ahhin nan thi thluh ding."},"33":{"text":"Nan zate nan thih thluh hlan lo nan faate pawl cu hi ramṭhing ahhin kum sawmli sung an vakvai ding ih cuticun nan zuanzam man an tuar ding."},"34":{"text":"Kanaan ram nan va zoh ni zat, ni khat ai ah kum khat in, ni sawmli hrangah kum sawmli sung nan sualman nan tuar ding ih keimah dodal a harzia cu nan thei ding."},"35":{"text":"Keimah dodaltu miṭha lo senpi pawl nan par hrimhrim ah a tlun ih hremnak pawl cu ka tlunter hrimhrim ding, tiah siatcam in thu ka lo kam a si. Hi ramṭhing ah hin pakhat hman luat loin nan thi thluh ding. Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo,’ a ti, tiah nan sim pei,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Moses in Kanaan ram thlingthla dingih a thlahmi hruaitu pawl in thusia an sim ruangah misenpi pawl Bawipa ih parih an phunzainak cu a si."},"37":{"text":"Curuangah Moses ih a thlahmi hruaitu pawl parah natsia a thleng ih an thi."},"38":{"text":"Thlingthlatu minung hleihnih sungah Joshua le Kaleb lawng an nung."},"39":{"text":"Moses in Bawipa thusimmi hmuahhmuah cu Israel mi hnenih a sim tikah napi in an ṭap.","title":"Kanaan Ram Neh An Tum (Daan 1.41-46)"},"40":{"text":"Cule a thaizing cu tlangpar ram ah an hung feh ih, “Kan sual zo ngai a si. Atu cun Bawipa ih in tiammi ram ah kan feh thlang ko pei,” an ti."},"41":{"text":"Asinain Moses cun, “Ziangah so atu khalah Bawipa ih thu cu nan thlun duh lo? Zianghman nan si cuang lo ding!"},"42":{"text":"Feh hlah uh. Bawipa cu nan hnenah a um lo ih nan ral pawl in an lo neh ding."},"43":{"text":"Khitawk ah Amalek mi le Kanaan mi thawn nan do awk tikah nan thi thluh mai ding. Bawipa ih thu thlun nan duh lo ruangah Amah cu nan hnenah a um hrimhrim lo ding,” a ti."},"44":{"text":"Sikhalsehla feh an tum thotho. Asinain Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang siseh, amah Moses siseh, an riahhmun ihsin an pok lo."},"45":{"text":"Cutikah cutawkih a rak ummi Amalek mi le Kanaan mi pawl cun an rak nam hai ih an run neh ih Hormah khua tiang Israel pawl cu an run dawi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Thawinak Hrangih Daan"},"2":{"text":"a tiam ciami ram an thlen tikih Israel mi pawl thlun dingah a tanglam daan pawl hi a pek."},"3":{"text":"“Mei-ur thawinak siseh, thukam-awh kimter thawinak siseh, mah lungtho teih pekmi thawinak siseh, biaknak puai tikcu ih thawinak siseh, Bawipa hnenih nan pek tikah cawcang, a si lole tuu, a si lole me, nan pek pei. Hi pekmi meisa thawn thawinak pawl cu Bawipa ih hrangah rim thawmi an si."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah cubangtuk thawinak a petu hmuahhmuah in olif siti khuat khat thawn rawi mi sangphut cuai hrek in thlairawl thawinak khal an pek cih pei."},"5":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinakah tuucangte a pek tinin sabitti khuat khat cu inmi thawinak ah a pek cih pei."},"6":{"text":"Cun an pekmi cu tuucang asile, inmi thawinakah sabit khuat khat le a hrek, thlairawl thawinak ah olif siti khuat khat le a hrek thawn rawi mi sangphut cuai khat khal a pek pei."},"7":{"text":"Hi bangtuk thawinak pekmi cu Bawipa ih hrangah a thawmi rimhmui a si."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa ih hnenah cawcang cu mei-ur thawinak ah siseh, thukam-awh kimter thawinak ah siseh, mah lungtho teih pekmi thawinakah siseh, a pek tikah,"},"9":{"text":"thlairawl thawinak ah olif siti khuat hnih thawn rawimi sangphut cuai khat, inmi thawinak ah,"},"10":{"text":"Sabit khuat hnih khal a pek cih pei. Hi thawinak cu Bawipa ih hnenah a thawmi rimhmui a si."},"11":{"text":"Thawinak ah cawcang siseh, tuucang siseh, tuu le me siseh, an pek tikah hi a tlunih thil pawl cu pek cih vivo an si pei."},"12":{"text":"Cule ṭilva pakhat hnakih tam deuh an pek a si ahcun a tam zat in thilri dang pekmi pawl cu ṭhan an si ve ding."},"13":{"text":"Ram sung minung hmuahhmuah in Bawipa hnenih a rim a thawmi thlairawl thawinak an pek tikah a tlun ih tuah ding pawl cu an tuah thluh pei."},"14":{"text":"Cule ramdangmi pakhatkhat in, a laangte ih a um ah siseh, kumkhua in nan lakih a um ah siseh, Bawipa hnenih rimthaw thlairawl thawinak a pek a si ahcun a tlunih daan pawl cu a thlun ve pei."},"15":{"text":"Nanmah siseh, ramdangmi nan lakih a ummi siseh, hi daan pawl cu sanmureng tiang nan thlun dingmi a si. Nanmah le anmah cu Bawipa hmaiah nan bangrep a si."},"16":{"text":"Nan hrangah siseh, an hrangah siseh, daan le thiltidan cu a bangrep a si, tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Bawipa ih pekmi ram an thlen tikah,"},"18":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ih an thlun dingah a tanglam ih daan pawl cu Bawipa in Moses hnenah a pek a si."},"19":{"text":"Cutawk ramih a suakmi rawl an ei tikah rawl hrekkhat cu Bawipa hnenah a dangte in laksawngah an pek pei."},"20":{"text":"Kumtin rawl an lak ṭheh tikah, fangtharih tuahmi sang zawl khat cu Bawipa ih hnenah laksawngah an pek pei. Himi cu fang an ciilmi sungin laksawngih an pek ṭheu vekin an pek pei."},"21":{"text":"Fang an lak ṭheh ih sangphut an tuahmi sung ihsin hi laksawng cu Bawipa ih hnenah a kumkhua in an pek ringring pei."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa keimah in Moses hnenih ka pekmi daan pawl hi mi pakhatkhat in tumhrimnak nei loin a thlun lo pang tikah siseh,"},"23":{"text":"hmailam ni khat khatah Bawipa ih thupekmi hi Israel misenpi in thlun loin an um tikah siseh,"},"24":{"text":"misenpi in thutheih lo ruangih an tuah pangmi a si ahcun, mei-ur thawinakah cawcang an pek pei. Himi cu Bawipa hnenih pekmi rimthaw a si ih thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak thawn an pek cih pei. Cuih tlunah sualthlah thawinak hrangah mecang khal an pek pei."},"25":{"text":"Misenpi hrangah mawhnak thawinak cu puithiam in a tuah pei ih ngaihthiam an si ding. Ziangahtile tihrimmi si loin tipangmi a si ih sualthlah thawinak le mei-ur thawinak Bawipa hnenih an pekmi a si."},"26":{"text":"Cuih thilti sualmi-ah an zate ih an tel ruangah Israel misenpi siseh, an lakih um ramdangmi siseh, ngaithiam thluh an si ding."},"27":{"text":"Mi pakhat in pumpak in sualnak a tuah pang a si ahcun a sualthlah thawinakah kum khat ti menu a pek pei."},"28":{"text":"Bawipa ih mithmuh ah a sualnak ihsin thianter dingah mawhnak thawinak cu puithiam in a tuah sak pei ih amah cu ngaithiam a si pei."},"29":{"text":"Hi daan cu Israel mi siseh, hrindangmi siseh, ramsungmi hmuahhmuah in, thil an tipang tikah thlun dingmi daan a si."},"30":{"text":"Asinain Israel mi siseh, ramdangmi siseh, ramsungih ummi pawl in tihrim sualnak an tuah ih Bawipa an hmuhsuam a si ahcun thah an si pei."},"31":{"text":"Ziangahtile Bawipa ih ṭongmi thu cu an duh lo ih a thupekmi cu an pah hrim ruangah an thihnak cu a si, tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Voikhat cu Israel mi pawl hramlak nelrawnih an um laiah mipa pakhat Sabbath ni ah zanthing a khawm.","title":"Sabbath A Buartu"},"33":{"text":"Amah cu an kai ih Moses le Aaron le misenpi hmaiah an suahpi."},"34":{"text":"Ziang tuah ding an theih ve lo ruangah annih in thawngah an khum ih an kil."},"35":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Sabbath buartu cu thah ding a si. Riahhmun lengah nan suahpi pei ih misenpi in lungto in deng that hai seh,” a ti."},"36":{"text":"Curuangah riahhmun lengah an fehpi ih Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in amah cu lungto in an deng ih a thi."},"37":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses cu","title":"Puan Feem"},"38":{"text":"Israel mi hnenih sim dingah thu a pek ih, “Nan hnipuan ziik ah a fem nan thlaih pei ih a fem tinah mepian pat nan ṭelh pei. Cumi cu nan tesinfa tiang nan tuah dingmi a si."},"39":{"text":"Hi puanfeem nan hmuh tinte in ka thupekmi hmuahhmuah nan thei sal ding ih nan thlun ding. Cuticun nan zuanzamnak, nan thinlung hiarnak, le nan mit ih hmuhmi poh nan tuah duhnak tla suup-aw tahratin keimah cu in dungtun lo ding a si."},"40":{"text":"Ka thupekmi hmuahhmuah a lo mangter ding ih keimah ih ta hrimhrim nan si ding."},"41":{"text":"Keimah hi Bawipa nan Pathian ka si. Nan Pathian si dingah Izipt ram ihsin a lo suahtu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si. Keimah cu Bawipa ka si,” a ti."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Levi hrin Kohath sungkhat Izhar ih fapa Korah cu a fim-awter ih Moses a dodal. Amah cu Reuben hrin Eliab ih fapa pahnih Dathan le Abiram, le Peleth ih fapa On in an thlun. Cuih tlunah misenpi ih hrilmi mi hminthang Israel mi zahnih le sawmnga pawl khal in an thlun.","title":"Korah, Dathan Le Abiram In Moses An Dodal","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Moses le Aaron hmaiah cun an ra ih, “Nan luantuk a si! Kan zatein Bawipa ta kan si ih Bawipa cu kan zate hnenah a um a si. Ziangah so Bawipa ih minung pawl ih tlunah nan cuan hleice?” tiah an zuam hai."},"4":{"text":"Cumi cu Moses in a theih tikah leilung ah bok tahrat in thla a cam."},"5":{"text":"Cule Moses in Korah le a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Thaizing ah Bawipa in amah ih minung a si mi cu in hliah ding; amah ih minung a si mi le amah hrangih a hril ciami pawl cu biakṭheng ah a ratter ding."},"6":{"text":"Thaizing zingpitah nangmah le na dungthluntu pawl in mei laknak kheng nan keng pei;"},"7":{"text":"meiling nan lak pei ih a parah rimhmui nan ret hnuah biakṭheng ah nan keng pei. Cutikah zoso Bawipa in in hril, ti cu kan hmu ding. A luan tukmi cu nanmah Levi mi sawn nan si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Moses in Korah hnen ahcun, “Levi fapa pawl, ngai uh!"},"9":{"text":"Amah kiangih nan rat theinak dingah le Bawipa ih Puanthlam sungih hnaṭuantu nan sinak dingah le misenpi hrangih hna nan ṭuannak dingah Pathian in Israel misenpi sung ihsin a dangte ih a lo hrilnak hi thil tenau-ah mawsi nan ruat?"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in amah ih kiangih naihtu dingah nangmah le Levi mi pawl cu a lo hril zo a si. Atu-ah puithiam hnaṭuan laak nan tum lala!"},"11":{"text":"Aaron parih nan phunzai hi a ngaingai cun nangmah le na dungthluntu pawl in Bawipa nan dodal a si,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Moses in Dathan le Abiram cu a ko, asinain annih in, “Kan ra lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Hitawk ramṭhing le ramcaar lakih thi dingah Izipt ram, cawhnawi le khuaitizu a luannak ram ihsin in suahpi hi a tawk zo lo maw si? Cuih tlunah maw kan tlunih na bawi duh hrih?"},"14":{"text":"Cawhnawi le khuaitizu in a khatmi ram cu in thlenpi lo-ih, lo le sabit hmuan khal kan co dingah in pe fawn lo; a bum lawnglawng in tum rero a si lo maw? Kan ra naisai lo ding,” tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Moses cu a ai a thok ih Bawipa hnenah, “Himi pawl ih an lo pekmi thawinak pawl cu zianghman saang hlah aw. An laak pakhatte hman ka lak sak dah lo. Ka tisiatmi pakhat hman an um hrih lo,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule Moses in Korah hnenah, “Thaisun ah nangmah le a lo thluntu minung zahnih le sawmnga cu Bawipa ih Puanthlam ah nan ra pei. Cunah Aaron khal a ra ve ding."},"17":{"text":"Mei laknak kheng nan keng ciar pei ih a parah rimhmui nan ret hnuah Bawipa ih mithmuh ah nan pek pei,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah an mei laknak kheng cu an keng ciar ih meiling an ret hnuah a parah rimhmui cu ret in Puanthlam sangka ahcun Moses le Aaron thawn an ding."},"19":{"text":"Cun Korah in misenpi pawl cu a kokhawm ih Puanthlam sangka ah Moses le Aaron hmaihoih in an ding. Cule hmakhatte-ah Bawipa ih huham cu tleunak in misenpi hnenah a rung lang ih,"},"20":{"text":"Moses le Aaron hnenah Bawipa in,"},"21":{"text":"“Nannih cu dungah siip uhla himi pawl hi atu rori-ah ka siatsuah thluh hai ding,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Asinain Moses le Aaron cu leilungah an bok ih, “Maw Pathian, nang cu nunnak hmuahhmuahih hramṭoh-nak na si. Mi pakhat a sual tikah misenpi parah na thin a heng ding maw?” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah,"},"24":{"text":"“Seenpi pawl cu Korah, Dathan le Abiram pawl ih deuthlam ihsin ṭhawn dingah sim hai aw,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cule Moses cu Israel hotu pawl in an thlun ih Dathan le Abiram hnenah an feh."},"26":{"text":"Cule misenpi hnenah cun, “Hi misuaksual pawl ih deuthlam ihsin tlan uh; an thilri zianghman a dai in dai hlah uh. Culole an sual ruangah anmah thawn nannih khal siatsuah thluh nan si ding,” a ti."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah Korah, Dathan, le Abiram ih deuthlam ihsin misenpi pawl cu an tlan. Dathan le Abiram cu an nupi le an faate pawl thawn an ra suak ih an deuthlam sangka ah an ding."},"28":{"text":"Cule Moses in senpi hnen ahcun, “Hi thil tuah dingah Bawipa in i thlah. Keimah ih duhnak in ka tuah mi a si lo, ti cu himi hin nan thei ding."},"29":{"text":"Hi minung pawl hi Pathian hnen ihsin hremnak zianghman tong loin mahte thih ih an thih a si ahcun Bawipa ih thlahmi ka si lo ding."},"30":{"text":"Sikhalsehla leilung par minung ih theih dah lomi thil Bawipa in a tuah ih leilung kak in an neihmi zate thawn a dolh thluh hai ih an nungcung in mithi khua Sheol ah an feh a si ahcun hi minung pawl in Bawipa an hnon ruangah a si, ti nan thei ding,” a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cutiih a ti ṭheh vete in Dathan le Abiram an dinnak leilung cu a kak ih,"},"32":{"text":"anmah le an innsang pawl le Korah dungthluntu pawl le an thilri hmuahhmuah pawl thawn a dolh thluh."},"33":{"text":"Cuticun an nungcung in an thilri pawl thawn mithi khua ah an lut. An tlunih leilung cu a ciip-aw sal ih an hlota."},"34":{"text":"An ṭah le an ai kha cutawk kiangkapih Israel mi pawl in an theih tikah an tlan ciamco ih, “Tlan uh, zaam uh; leilung in in dolh thluh ve ding,” tiah an au ciamco."},"35":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in mei-alh a run thlak ih rimhmui thawinak a petu zahnih le sawmnga pawl cu a kaang that ṭheh."},"36":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Mei Laknak Kheng"},"37":{"text":"“Puithiam Aaron ih fapa Eleazar cu sim awla mei laknak darkheng pawl cu a thianghlimmi a si ruangah meisa ih a kang thatmi miruak vutcam umnak ihsin kheng pawl cu lak in meiling pawl cu hmun dangah ṭhekdarh thluh seh."},"38":{"text":"Bawipa ih biakṭheng ih peknak an tuah tikah hi kheng pawl cu thilri thianghlim ah an cang a si. Curuangah an sual ruangih thihnak a tuartu pawl ih mei laknak kheng cu la awla pakan bangtuk in peer ko in deng aw. Cule biakṭheng khuhah tuah aw. Israel mi pawl in ralrinnak ah an hmang ding,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"A ti bangtuk in puithiam Eleazar in mei laknak kheng pawl cu a lak ih pakan peerah a deen ih biakṭheng khuhah a tuah."},"40":{"text":"Himi cu Aaron hrin siar lo zohman Bawipa ih biakṭheng ah ra tahratin rimhmui an ur thei lo pei, ti ralrin ternak a si. A tuahtu an um asile Korah le a minung pawl vekin siatsuah an tong ding a si. Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek bangtuk in hi a tlunih tuah ding pawl cu Eleazar in a tuah ṭheh."},"41":{"text":"A thaisun ah Israel misenpi pawl cu Moses le Aaron parah an phunzai ih an hnenah, “Nanmah in Bawipa ih minung hrekkhat pawl nan that a si,” an ti.","title":"Aaron In Misenpi A Run"},"42":{"text":"An tongkhawm aw ih Moses le Aaron parih an phunzai thluh hnuah Puanthlam lam an hei zoh ih mero in Puanthlam cu a tuam ih Bawipa ih huham tleu a lang kha an hmu."},"43":{"text":"Cutikah Moses le Aaron an feh ih Puanthlam hmaiah cun an ding ih,"},"44":{"text":"Bawipa in an hnenah,"},"45":{"text":"“Hi minung pawl hnen ihsin dungah siip uh; hmakhatte-ah ka siatsuah thluh hai ding,” a ti. Cutikah leilung ah an bok ih,"},"46":{"text":"Moses in Aaron hnenah, “Na mei laknak kheng keng awla a sungah biakṭheng ih meiling ret in meilingvam parah cun rimhmui thlak aw. Cule misenpi hnenah zamrangin feh awla an hrangah mawhnak thawinak tuah aw. Zamrang aw! Bawipa ih thinhengnak a thok zo ih pulhnat a thleng zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"47":{"text":"A ti vek cun Aaron in a tuah ih a mei laknak kheng a keng ih misenpi lak ahcun a va tlan. Pulhnat in an na zo, ti a hmuh tikah khulrangin meilingvam parah rimhmui cu a thlah ih misenpi hrangah mawhnak thawinak cu a tuah."},"48":{"text":"Cumi in pulhnat cu a rehter ih mithi le minung karlakah Aaron cu a ding."},"49":{"text":"Korah ralthawh ṭumih a thimi pawl siar loin hi pulhnat ih a thimi cu thawng hleili le za sarih an si."},"50":{"text":"Pulhnat a reh tikah Aaron cu Puanthlam sangka kiang Moses hnenah cun a kir sal."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Aaron Ih Kianghrol"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl sim awla hrin khatah kianghrol pakhat ciar in kianghrol hleihnih lo pe hai seh. An kianghrol parah an hmin ciar ngan awla,"},"3":{"text":"Levi hrin kianghrol parah Aaron ih hmin ngan aw. An hrin hotu pakhat hrangah kianghrol pakhat ciar a si pei."},"4":{"text":"Cuih kianghrol pawl cu ka umnak Puanthlam sung, ka lo ton ṭheunak Thukam Kuang hmaiah ret aw."},"5":{"text":"Cule ka hril mipa ih kianghrol cu a cerh ding. Cuticun Israel mi pawl ih phunzai ringringnak hi ka kham thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Moses cun Israel mi pawl cu a sim ih an hotu ciar in kianghrol pakhat ciar, hrin hleihnih hrangah kianghrol hleihnih, Moses an pek. Aaron ih kianghrol khal a tel ve."},"7":{"text":"Moses in kianghrol hmuahhmuah cu Puanthlam sung, Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang hmaiah cun a ret."},"8":{"text":"A thaisun ah Puanthlam sungah Moses cu a lut ih Levi hrin ai-awhtu Aaron ih kianghrol a cerh kha a hmu. A cerh lawng si loin a mum hnuah a par ih almon a hminmi almon rah a rah."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in kianghrol zatein a lak ih Israel mi pawl hnenah a hmuh. Cutiih thil a cangmi an hmuh hnuah hotu pawl cun anmah an ta ciar an lak sal."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Aaron ih kianghrol cu Thukam Kuang hmaiah ret sal aw. An phunzainak an baan lo ahcun mi dodaltu Israel mi cu an thi ding, tiih ralrin ternak ah ret ringring ding a si,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek vekin Moses cun a tuah thluh."},"12":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl cun Moses hnenah, “Kan cem a si. Kan thi cem thluh ding a si ko."},"13":{"text":"Puanthlam kiangih a ra menmenmi a thih ahcun kan cem riai a si. Pakhatte hman taang loin maw kan cimih thluh ding!” an ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Aaron hnenah, “Ka umnak Puanthlam sungih hna thiang nan ṭuannak nan mawh man cu nangmah le na fapa pawl le na phunpi Levi pawl in nan tuar ding. Asinain puithiam nan ṭuannak ih nan mawh man cu nangmah le na fapa pawl lawngin nan tuar ding.","title":"Puithiam Le Levi Pawl ṭuanvo"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah le na fapa pawl in Puanthlam sungih hna nan ṭuan tikah nangmah thawn ṭuan tlang dingah le a lo bawmtu dingah Levi hrin na sungkhat pawl cu lutter ve aw."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah hnenih an neihmi ṭuanvo siseh Puanthlam hrangih an neihmi ṭuanvo siseh, an ṭuan suak pei. Sikhalsehla Hmun Thianghlim le biakṭheng ih thilri thiang pawl cu an dai hrimhrim lo pei. An dai asile anmah siseh, nanmah siseh, nan thi ding."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah ih hnenah hna an ṭuan pei ih Puanthlam sungih an ṭuanvo hmuahhmuah cu an ṭuansuak thluh pei. Asinain hnaṭuan dingih a tlak lomi cu nan hnenah an tel lo pei."},"5":{"text":"Israel mi pawl parih ka thinhengnak a thlen sal lonak dingah nangmah le na fapa pawl lawnglawng in Hmun Thianghlim le biakṭheng ih hnaṭuan ding pawl cu ṭuanvo lak in nan ṭuansuak pei."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi pawl sung ihsin nan hrangih laksawngah nan sungkhat Levi mi pawl a lo hril saktu cu keimah ka si. Anmah tla cu Puanthlam sungih hnaṭuan an ṭuansuak theinak dingah keimah ih hnenih hlanmi an si."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nangmah le na fapa pawl lawnglawng in biakṭheng le Hmun Thianghlim Bik sungih puithiam hnaṭuan pawl cu nan ṭuansuak pei. Puithiam hnaṭuan cu laksawngah ka lo pek zo hai ruangah nan ṭuanvo a si. Hi hnaṭuan ṭuan dingih a tlak lomi pawl cu thilri thianghlim kiangih an rat asile thah an si ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in Aaron hnenah, “Zohhnik, mei-ur thawinak pekmi siar lo a dang laksawng ka hnenih an pekmi hmuahhmuah cu nangmah ka lo pek a si. Hi laksawng pawl cu nangmah le na fapa pawl hrangah kumkhua ih nan co dingah ka lo pek a si.","title":"Puithiam Pawlih Covo"},"9":{"text":"Biakṭheng ih mei-ur thawinak ah ur lomi laksawng thianghlim cu a tanglam pawl hi an si: thlairawl thawinak, sualthlah thawinak, le mawhnak thawinak an si. Ka hnenih in pekmi, hi thawinak thianghlim pawl cu a zatein nangmah le na fapa pawl ih covo an si ding."},"10":{"text":"Hi thawinak thianghlim pawl cu hmun thianghlim ah na ei pei; mipa dang khal in an ei thei pei. Nan hrangah a thianghlimmi an si."},"11":{"text":"“Cuih tlunah Israel mi pawl in a hleice ih an pekmi laksawng khal na ta an si ding. Nangmah le na fapa le na fanu pawl hrangah sanmureng tiang nan covo dingah ka lo pe a si. Nan innsang sungih mithiangfai pawl hmuahhmuah in an ei thei ding."},"12":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl in kumtin an neih hmaisa bik lakih a ṭha bik fang, sabit le olif siti pawl in pekmi cu nangmah ka lo pek."},"13":{"text":"A zatein nangmah ih ta an si pei. Na innsang sungih mithiangfai pawl hmuahhmuah in an ei thei ding."},"14":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl in ka hnenah in pekmi hmuahhmuah cu na ta an si."},"15":{"text":"“Ka hnenih an pekmi minung siseh, ṭilva siseh, fatir hmuahhmuah cu na ta an si ding. Asinain milai fatir siseh, ṭilva fatir raitluan lomi siseh, an tlen sal tikah a tlennak paisa cu na sang pei."},"16":{"text":"Naute cu a tlennak man an khiah bangtuk in ngun tangka fang nga in thla khat a ti-ah an tlen sal pei."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ṭilva fatir: caw le tuu le me pawl cu tlen sal ding an si lo. A pum in keimah ih ta an si ih thawinakah pek ding an si. An thisen cu biakṭheng kapah na theh pei ih an thau pawl cu thawinak pekmi rawlhun thawinak le rimthaw-ah meisa in na ur pei."},"18":{"text":"A sa pawl, a ir le a vorhlam cawn cu a hleice ih pekmi na covo an si."},"19":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl in ka hnenih an pekmi, ahleicemi laksawng pawl cu kumkhua in nangmah le na fapa le na fanu pawl hrangah ka lo pe a si. Himi cu siatbal thei lomi thukamnak nangmah le na tesinfa pawl hnenih ka tuahmi a si,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in Aaron hnenah, “Co theihmi rothil na la lo pei ih Israel ram sungah leiram comi khal na nei lo pei. Ziangahtile Bawipa keimah hi na ro le na covo ka si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel mi pawl in ka hnenih ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat an pekmi hmuahhmuah cu Levi mi pawl hnenah ka pek zo. Himi cu ka umnak Puanthlam an kilkhawi ih a sungih hna an ṭuan ruangah pekmi a si.","title":"Levi Mi Pawlih Covo"},"22":{"text":"Israel mi zohman in Puanthlam cu an naih lo pei. An naih asile an sual manah thih an tuar ding."},"23":{"text":"Atu thokin Levi mi lawnglawng in Puanthlam cu an kilveng pei ih thil an tisual a si ahcun anmah in an tuar pei. Hi daan cu na tesinfa pawl khal in an thlun dingmi a si. Levi mi pawl in Israel mi lakah kumkhua ih comi rothil an nei lo pei."},"24":{"text":"Ziangahtile Israel mi pawl ih in pekmi ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat cu an co dingah ka pe zo a si. Cuti a si ruangah Israel ram sungah kumkhua ih comi rothil nan nei lo pei, tiah ka tinak a si,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Levi Mi Pawl Pekmi ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat"},"26":{"text":"Levi mi pawl hiti ih sim dingah thu a pek, “ Bawipa hnenih an pekmi ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat Israel mi hnen ihsin nan ngah tikah, cuih nan ngahmi sungin ṭhenhra ih ṭhenkhat cu a hleice ih pekmi laksawng a si ih Bawipa hnenah nan hlan pei."},"27":{"text":"Hi laksawng cu lothlo pawl ih fang thar le sabit thar an pekmi tlukah ruat ding a si pei."},"28":{"text":"Cubangtuk in Israel mi hnen ihsin nan ngahmi ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat hmuahhmuah sung ihsin Bawipa hnenah ṭhen hra ṭhen khat nan pek pei. Nan ngahmi hmuahhmuah sung in Bawipa hnenih nan pek dingmi cu puithiam Aaron hnenah nan pek pei."},"29":{"text":"Nan ngahmi sungih a ṭha bik miangmo nan pek pei."},"30":{"text":"Cutiih a ṭha bik nan pek hnuah cun a taangmi cu nan ta a si pei ih nan fang ciilnak le nan sabit rialnak ih suak vemi tlukah siar a si pei."},"31":{"text":"Puanthlam sung nan hnaṭuan hlawhman a si ruangah nanmah le nan innsang pawl in nan duhnaknak hmunah nan ei pei."},"32":{"text":"Nan neihmi lakih a ṭha bikmi Bawipa nan pek ahcun nan ei tikah mawhthluknak nan tong lo ding. Cun Israel mi pawl ih pekmi laksawng thianghlim a ṭha bikmi Bawipa hnenih pek hlanah ei tahrat in borhhlawhter hlah uh; nan borhhlawhter asile nan thi ding a si,” a ti."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenah,","title":"Cawla Sen Ih Vutcam"},"2":{"text":"a hnuailam ih daan pawl Israel mi hnenih pe dingah thu a pek: Raitluan mi le hna a ṭuan hrih lomi cawla sen rak keng hai sehla,"},"3":{"text":"puithiam Eleazar hnenah pe hai seh. Riahhmun lengah an suahpi pei ih Eleazar hmaiah an that pei."},"4":{"text":"Cule Eleazar in a thisen hrekkhat cu a lak pei ih Puanthlam hmailam ahcun a mehtok in voisarih tiang a theh pei."},"5":{"text":"A sa zatein - a vun le a tit, a thisen le a sungril pawl thawn - puithiam hmuh hngan rori ahcun ur thluh a si pei."},"6":{"text":"Cule puithiam in sidar thing, hissop thingṭeek le puan sen a lak pei ih meisa sungah cun a paih pei."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a hnipuan a sawp pei ih ti a bual ṭheh hnuah riahhmun ah a kir sal pei. Asinain cuih zanlam tiang cu mithiangfai lo a si ding."},"8":{"text":"Caw a thattu pa khal in a hnipuan a sawp pei ih ti a bual pei. Asinain cuih zanlam tiang cu mithiangfai lo a si ve pei."},"9":{"text":"Cun a thianghlim pa pakhat in caw senih vutcam cu a lak pei ih riahhmun leng hmun thiangfai ah a ret pei. Cumi cu Israel mi pawl in thianfainak hrangih tidai an hman tikah cuih tidai thianfaiternak ah an hmang pei. Cumi cu sual thianfainak hrangih urmi a si."},"10":{"text":"Cuih vutcam a latu cun a hnipuan a sawp pei. Asinain cuih zanlam tiang cu mithiangfai lo a si pei. Hi daan cu Israel mi siseh, an lakih ummi ramdangmi siseh, kumkhua in an thlun dingmi a si."},"11":{"text":"Miruak a daitu cu ni sarih sung mithiangfai lo a si pei.","title":"Miruak An Tham Tikah"},"12":{"text":"Thianfaiternak tidai in ni thumnak ni le ni sarihnak ni ah a thiangfai awk lo ding ih cuticun mithiangfai ah a cang ding. Asinain ni thumnak ni le ni sarihnak ni ah a thiangfai awkter lo a si ahcun mi thiangfai lo a si pei."},"13":{"text":"Miruak a daitu cu thianfainak tidai a toih-awk lo ahcun mithiangfai lo a si ringring. Bawipa ih Thukam retnak Puanthlam a borhhlawhter ruangah Bawipa ih minung lakah siarcih a si nawn lo pei."},"14":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat a deuthlam sungih a thih ahcun a thih laiih a deuthlam sungih a ummi siseh, a leng ihsin a rung lutmi siseh, ni sarih sung cu mithiangfai lo an si pei."},"15":{"text":"Sin a nei lomi palang le beel khal an thiangfai ve lo a si."},"16":{"text":"Cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in riahhmun lengah mi pakhatkhat hriamhma in siseh, mahte thih in siseh, a thi ih cuih ruak a thamtu cu ni sarih sung mithiangfai lo a si pei. Milai ruh siseh, milai thlaan siseh, a thamtu cu ni sarih sung mithiangfai lo a si pei."},"17":{"text":"Hi bangtuk ih thianfai lonak a um tikah sual thianfainak dingih urmi caw senih vutcam an lak pei ih beel sungih an ret hnuah tidai fai an burh pei."},"18":{"text":"A hmaisa-ah a thiangfaimi mi pakhat in hissop thing ṭeek pakhat la tahratin cuih tidai sungah a hnim pei ih deuthlam le a sungih ummi thilri hmuahhmuah le minung pawl a theh thluh pei. A neta-ah a thiangfaimi mi dang pakhat in tidai cu a lak pei ih miruh le miruak le thlaan a thamtu cu a theh pei."},"19":{"text":"Cun a thiangfaimi mi pakhatkhat in ni thumnak ni le ni sarihnak ni ah cuih tidai cun mithiangfai lo cu a theh pei. Ni sarihnak ni ahcun cupa cu a thianfaiter ding ih a hnipuan a sawp hnuah ti a kholh-aw pei ih zanlam nitla ah mithiangfai a cang pei."},"20":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat mithiangfai lo a si ih thianfainak tidai in a kholh-awk lo ahcun thianfai termi a si lo ruangah mithiangfai lo ringring a si. Cubangtuk mi cu Bawipa ih Puanthlam a borhhlawhter ruangah Pathian ih minung lakah siarcih ding a si nawn lo pei."},"21":{"text":"Hi daan cu a kumkhua ih nan thlun dingmi a si. Cule thianfainak tidai a thehtu khal in a hnipuan a sawp thluh pei. Hi tidai a thamtu cu zanlam tiang mithiangfai lo a si pei."},"22":{"text":"Ziang khal mithiangfai loih tham mi pohpoh cu a thiangfai lo pei ih zokhal cumi a thamtu pohpoh cu zanlam tiang mithiangfai lo a si pei."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thla hmaisabik ah Israel misenpi pawl cu Zin nelrawn an thleng ih Kadesh ah riahhmun an khuar. Cutawkah Miriam cu a thi ih an phum.","title":"Kadesh Ah Lungpi Sungin Tidai A Suak (Suah 17.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Cule misenpi hrangah tidai a um lo ruangah Moses le Aaron hnenih phunzai dingin an tongkhawm aw ih,"},"3":{"text":"“Hitiih si hnak cun kan unau Israel mi hrekkhat pawl thawn Bawipa ih Puanthlam hmaiah khan thi ve nungla a ṭha sawn ding naón!"},"4":{"text":"Ziangah so hi bangtuk ramṭhing ah hin in thlenpi? Hitawkih kan ṭilva pawl thawn thi dingah maw?"},"5":{"text":"Zianghrangah so hivek ram ṭha lo, zianghman a khoh thei lonak ramih hruai dingah cun Izipt ram ihsin in suahpi? Hinah zianghman a um lo: fang le theipi, sabit le taleti tla a um lo! Tidai in ding rengreng hman a um lo!” tiah an phunzai ciamco."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah misenpi hmai ihsin Moses le Aaron cu an ṭhawn ih Puanthlam sangka hmaiah an ding. Cutawkah leilung ah an bok ih an hnenah Bawipa ih huham tleu cu a rung lang."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,"},"8":{"text":"“Thukam Kuang hmaiih a ummi kianghrol kha la awla nangmah le na u Aaron in misenpi pawl cu kokhawm uh. Cutawkah misenpi hmuh hngan rori ahcun khitawk ih a ummi lungpi khi tidai suak dingin sim uhla tidai a suak ding. Cuticun khi lungpi sungin tidai na suakter ding ih misenpi siseh, an ṭilva pawl siseh, tidai an in ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Moses cu Bawipa thupeknak bangtuk in a feh ih kianghrol cu a lak."},"10":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in Israel misenpi pawl cu lungpi hmai ahcun an kokhawm ih Moses in, “Ngai uh, nannih raltho pawl! Nanmah ih hrangah a si lo maw hi lungpi ihsin tidai suahter rero a ṭul cu?” a ti ih,"},"11":{"text":"Moses in a kianghrol cu a thlir ih lungpi cu voihnih a vuak. Cutikah tidai cu a puut zurzo ih misenpi le ṭilva pawl cun an in."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa in Moses le Aaron cu, “Ka thianhlimnak huham nan zum kim lo ruangah Israel misenpi hmaiah tlamtling in in upat lo; curuangah hi misenpi pawl pek dingih ka tiammi ram ah nannih in nan hruai suak hai lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cuih hmun cu Israel mi pawl in Bawipa hnenih an phunzainak le Bawipa in a thianhlimnak huham a langternak a si ruangah Meribah tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Moses in Kadesh ihsin Edom siangpahrang hnenah palai a thlah. Cuih palai pawl in Edom siangpahrang hnenah, “Na unau Israel hrin pawl in thu an lo cah. Ziangtluk in harsatnak kan tong ti cu na thei thluh ko.","title":"Edom Siangpahrang In A El"},"15":{"text":"Kan pu le kan pa pawl cu Izipt ramah an feh ih kum reipi an vung um. Izipt mi pawl in kan pupa le kanmah pawl in tisiat tuk ruangah,"},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah bomnak dil in kan au. Kan aunak in thei ih vancungmi pakhat a run thlah ih Izipt ram in in suahpi. Atu-ah cun na ramri kiangih Kadesh khua ah kan um."},"17":{"text":"In zaangfah awla na ram sungin in fehter siang hram aw. Kanmah siseh, kan ṭilva pawl siseh, lamzin ihsin zinsak zinthlangah kan pial lo ding. Nan lo ah siseh, nan sabit hmuan khal ah siseh, kan lut lo ding. Cun nan tikhur pawl ih tidai khal kan in hrimhrim lo ding. Na ram sung ihsin kan liam hlan lo lamzinpi lawnglawng kan zawh ding, an ti a si,” tiah an sim."},"18":{"text":"Asinain Edom mi pawl cun, “Kan ram cu a pal in nan pal hrimhrim lo pei. Nan pal a si ahcun kan ra suak pei ih kan lo do ding a si,” an ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi pawl cun, “Lamzinpi lawnglawng kan zawh ko ding. Kanmah in siseh, kan ṭilva pawl in siseh, nan tidai kan in pang a si khalle a man kan kuan ko ding. Nan ram voikhat pal phahte lawng khi kan lo dilmi cu a si,” an ti."},"20":{"text":"Edom mi pawl cun, “Kan ram nan pal thei lo,” an ti ih Israel mi pawl do dingah an ralkap tamzet, hriamnam ṭhazet thawn an pok."},"21":{"text":"Cutiin Edom mi pawl ih an ram pal an sian lo ruangah Israel mi pawl cu an kir ih lamzin dang an thlun."},"22":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Kadesh hmun ihsin an pok ih Edom ramri kiangih ummi Hor Tlang an thleng.","title":"Aaron A Thi"},"23":{"text":"Cutawk ahcun Bawipa in Moses le Aaron hnenah,"},"24":{"text":"“Aaron cu Israel mi hnenih pek dingah ka tiammi ram a thleng lo ding. Ziangahtile nan pahnih in Meribah ah ka thupekmi nan thlun duh lo ih in dodal ruangah Aaron cu a thi ding."},"25":{"text":"Aaron le a fapa Eleazar cu Hor Tlang ah fehpi awla,"},"26":{"text":"Aaron ih puithiam thilthuam cu hlit awla Eleazar hrukter aw. Aaron cu khitawk ah a thi ding,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa ih a ti vek cun Moses in a tuah ṭheh. Misenpi hmuhah Hor Tlang cu an kai ih,"},"28":{"text":"Moses in Aaron ih puithiam thilthuam cu a hlit sak ih Eleazar a hrukter. Cule Aaron cu cutawk tlangpar ahcun a thi ih Moses le Eleazar cu an rung kir."},"29":{"text":"Israel misenpi in Aaron a thih an theih tikah an zatein ni sawmthum sung mithi ngai in an um."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kanaan ram thlanglam kapih a ummi Kanaan siangpahrang Arad in Israel mi pawl Atharim lam in an ra ti a theih tikah a rak do ih a hrekkhat cu a kai.","title":"Kanaan Mi An Neh"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi pawl in Bawipa ih hnenah, “Hi miphun pawl hi in nehter a si ahcun anmah siseh an khua pawl siseh, nangmah hnenah kan lo hlan thluh ding ih kan siatsuah thluh ding,” tiah siatcam in thu an kam."},"3":{"text":"Cumi cu Bawipa in a thei ih Kanaan mi pawl cu a nehter. Curuangah Israel mi pawl in Kanaan mi pawl cu an that thluh ih an khua pawl khal an siatsuah thluh. Cuih hmun cu Hormah tiah an ko tata."},"4":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Hor Tlang ihsin an feh ih Edom ram heel in Tipi Sen lamin an feh. Asinain lamlakah an thin a ṭeu ih,","title":"Daar Ih Tuahmi Rul"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa le Moses an thangsiat. “Hitawk hmun, tidai le rawl um lonak ih thi dingah hin ziangah so Izipt ram ihsin in suahpi? Hi rawl siava pawl cun in ning tuk zo a si!” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in micuk hrang tur neimi rul pawl an lakah a suahter ih Israel mi tampi an cuk ih an thi."},"7":{"text":"Misenpi cu Moses hnenah an ra ih, “ Bawipa le nangmah kan lo dodal hi kan sual a si. Hi rul pawl hi cemter dingin Bawipaói hnenah in dilsak hram aw,” tiah an ti. Cutikah Moses in misenpi hrangah thla a cam."},"8":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Rul tuah awla ṭhuam parah thlai aw. Rul ih a cukmi hmuahhmuah in cumi an zoh asile an nung ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"A ti bangtuk cun Moses in daar rul cu a tuah ih ṭhuam parah a thlai. Rul cukmi pawl cuih daar rul zohtu hmuahhmuah in an nung."},"10":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an feh sal ih Oboth ah riahhmun an khuar.","title":"Moab Phairawn An Thleng"},"11":{"text":"Cule Oboth ihsin an feh sal lala ih Moab ram ihsin nisuahnak lam nelrawnih a ummi Iye-Abarim ah riahhmun an khuar."},"12":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin an pok sal ih Zered Phairawn ah riahhmun an khuar."},"13":{"text":"Zered Phairawn ihsin an feh sal lala ih Amor ramri tiang a kaumi nelrawn ah an thleng ih Arnon tiva saklam ah riahhmun an khuar. Arnon cu Moab mi le Amor mi pawl ih ramri a si."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa Raldonak Cabu sungih: “Sufah pengah Waheb khua le a phairawn, Arnon Tiva le phairawn pawl;"},"15":{"text":"horkuam lo tlang pawl in Ar khua tiang, Moab ramri tiangin,” tiih a umnak cu a si."},"16":{"text":"Cutawk in an feh ih Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Miseenpi pawl cu kokhawm awla tidai ka pek hai ding,” a tinak Tikhur timi hmun ah an riak."},"17":{"text":"Cuih caanah cun Israel mi pawl in a tanglam hla hi an sak: “Maw tikhur, na tidai suah awla, Hla in kan lawm ding."},"18":{"text":"Hi tikhur cu lal pawl le, Mi hotu pawl ih laihmi a si. Lal pawl in an fung an hmangih, Hotu pawl in an kianghrol an hmang a si,” tiin an sak. Cuih phairawn ihsin Mattanah ah an ṭhawn ih,"},"19":{"text":"cutawk ihsin Nahaliel ah, Nahaliel ihsin Bamoth ah,"},"20":{"text":"cule Bamoth ihsin Moab ram phairawn Pisgah Tlang zik hnuai nelrawn vun hmuh theinak ah an ṭhawn."},"21":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl cun Amor siangpahrang Sihon hnenah palai an thlah ih,","title":"Siangpahrang Sihon Le Og An Neh (Daan 2.26—3.11)"},"22":{"text":"“Na ram sungin in fehter hram aw. Kanmah siseh, kan ṭilva siseh, lamzinpi in kan pial lo ding. Na lo ah siseh, na sabit hmuan ah siseh, kan lut lo ding. Na tikhur ih tidai khal kan in lo ding. Na ram kan lan lai hlan lo lamzinpi lawnglawng in kan feh ding,” tiah an sim."},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Sihon in Israel mi pawl ih a ram an pal ding cu a siang lo. A ralkap pawl a kokhawm ih Jahaz phairawn ah an feh ih Israel mi pawl cu an do."},"24":{"text":"Asinain an do awknak ah Israel mi pawl cun tampi an that ih an ram cu Arnon Tiva in saklam ih Jabbok tiang, cuti cun Ammon ramri tiang, an lak ṭheh."},"25":{"text":"Cutiin Israel mi pawl in Amor mi ih khawpi pawl, Heshbon le a kiangih khua pawl tla an lak ih an luah ṭheh."},"26":{"text":"Heshbon cu Amor siangpahrang Sihon umnak khawpi a si. Sihon cu a hlanih Moab siangpahrang a rak nehtu le a ram hmuahhmuah Arnon Tiva tiang a rak long ṭhehtu a si."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah hla phuahtu pawl in: “Heshbon ah ra uh, Sihon khawpi ah, Din salmi khawpi ah cang seh."},"28":{"text":"Hi Heshbon khawpi in an rak suak, Meisa bangin Sihon ralkap pawl cu, Moab mi khawpi Ar an siatsuah, An ur ṭheh Arnon hmunsang pawl cu."},"29":{"text":"Riahsiatza nan si, Moab mi pawl, Nan cem a si, Khemosh betu pawl.
