Nan khawzing in a faale pawl cu raltlan ah a lo canter ih, Nunau pawl cu Amor siangpahrang sal ah a lo canter a si."},"30":{"text":"Atu-ah an tefa pawl cu siatsuah thluh an si, Heshbon in Dibon thleng tiang, Nashim in Medeba kiang Nofah khua tiang,” an ti."},"31":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi pawl in Amor mi pawl ih ram cu an luah ih an um."},"32":{"text":"Cule Moses in Jazer khawpi donak lamzin zohtu dingah mi a thlah. Israel mi pawl cun Jazer khawpi le a kiangkapih khua pawl cu an neh ih cutawkih a ummi Amor mi pawl cu an dawihlo ṭheh."},"33":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl cu an kir ih Bashan lamah an feh. Cutikah Bashan siangpahrang Og cu Israel do dingah a ralkap thawn Edrei ah ṭanhmun an khuar."},"34":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Hi siangpahrang cu ṭih hlah. Amah le a minung pawl le a ram tlunah nehnak ka lo pe ding. Heshbon bawi, Amor miphun siangpahrang Sihon hnenih na tuah vekin hi Bashan siangpahrang Og tlun khalah na tuah ding,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"A ti vek cun Israel mi pawl in Og le a fapa pawl le a ramsung minung, pakhat hman taang loin an that ṭheh ih an ram cu an luah ṭheh a si."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an feh sal ih Jerikho khua ih khatlam ral, Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lam, Moab hmunrawn ah an riak.","title":"Moab Siangpahrang In Balaam A Sawm"},"2":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl in Amor mi tlunih thil an tuahmi pawl kha Moab ram siangpahrang Zippor ih fapa siangpahrang Balak in a hmu ih,"},"3":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an tamzet fawn ruangah amah in siseh, a minung pawl in siseh, an ṭih ngaingai."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Moab mi pawl in Midian mi hotu pawl hnenah, “Cawcang ih hrampi a piat thluh ṭheu vekin hi mi burpi in kan kiangkap cu an ciil siat thluh ding a si ko,” tiah an ti. Cule Siangpahrang Balak in,"},"5":{"text":"Amaw ram, Eufrates Tivapi kiang Pethor khua ih a ummi Beor fapa Balaam hnenah palai a thlah. Cuih palai pawl hnen ihsin Balak in thu a cah ih, “Miphun phun khat pumpi Izipt ram in an suak ih atu-ah hin an minung pawl cu khuazakipah an darh-aw ih kan ram luah ṭheh an tum a si."},"6":{"text":"An minung zat ṭuat tikah in hleih tuk fawn. Curuangah i zaangfah hram awla hi mi pawl hi in ra camsiat sakta aw. Cuticun kan neh ding ih kan ram in kan dawi suak thei ding. Nangmah ih na thluasuahmi cu thluasuah an ngah ih na camsiatmi cu camsiat an si, ti ka thei,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Moab hotu pawl le Midian hotu pawl cu camsiat man phalh ding keng in an pok ih Balaam hnen an thleng ih Balak ih thucah mi cu an sim."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Balaam cun an hnenah, “Tuihzan cu hinah riak uhla thaisun ah Bawipa ih i simmi poh cu ka lo theihter hai ding,” tiah a ti. Curuangah Moab mi hotu pawl cu Balaam hnenah cun an riak."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa in Balaam hnen ahcun, “Na hnenih a riakmi pawl hi zoso an si?” tiah a sut."},"10":{"text":"Balaam in, “Moab siangpahrang Balak ih palai pawl an si ih,"},"11":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin a ra suakmi miphun phun khat an ram ah an khat thluh a si ruangah cumi pawl do tahratih a dawi suaknak dingin camsiat dingah in ra fial a si,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in Balaam hnenah, “An hnenah tel ding na si lo; Israel mi pawl tla na cam lo pei; ziangahtile ka thlawsuah mi an si,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"A thaizing ah Balak palai pawl hnenah Balaam cu a feh ih, “Va kir uh; nan hnenih feh ve ding cu Bawipa in i kham a si,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Balak hnenah cun an kir ih an hnenih Balaam a tel duh lonak thu cu an sim."},"15":{"text":"Cule Balak in hotu thupi deuhdeuh le tam deuh a hei thlah sal."},"16":{"text":"An va feh ih Balaam hnen ahcun, “Zaangfahnak in ka hnenih rat ding cu zianghman in lo kham hram hlah seh."},"17":{"text":"Laksawng tam ngaingai ka lo pe ding ih na simmi hmuahhmuah ka tuah thluh ding. Ra hramhram awla himi pawl hi ka aiah in camsiat sak aw,” tiah Balak ih thucahmi cu an sim."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Balaam cun, “Balak in a siangpahrang inn sungih a ummi sui le ngun hmuahhmuah i pe hmansehla Bawipa ih thu cu ka el thei lo; thil fate thu hmanah Bawipa ka Pathian ih thupekmi cu ka el thei hrimhrim lo a si."},"19":{"text":"Asinain midang bangin tuih zan cu hinah riak uhla Bawipa in thudang sim ding i neih asile tuihzan ah ka thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cuih zanah Pathian cu Balaam hnenah a ra ih, “Himi pawl in an hnenih feh ding an ra lo sawm a si ahcun feh dingah na tim tuah aw. Asinain ka lo simmi lawnglawng tuah aw,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cuhrangah a thaizing cu Balaam in a laak cu a kung a tuah ih Moab hotu pawl hnen ahcun a feh."},"22":{"text":"Balaam a feh ruangah Pathian cu a thin a heng. Balaam cu a hnen-um pahnih in an thlun ih a laak to in a feh laiah a lamzin kham dingah Bawipa ih vancungmi pakhat a hmaiah a rak ding.","title":"Balaam Le A Laak"},"23":{"text":"Balaam ih laak in ralnam a kengtu vancungmi pakhat lamzinih a din kha a hmuh tikah lamzin ihsin a pial ih hram lakah a feh. Balaam in a laak cu a vuak ih lamzin ah a kirter sal."},"24":{"text":"Cule vancungmi cu lamzin cepthernak, sabit hmuan pahnih karlak, lungtlap pipi a zin kap hnih ih son awknak hmun ah a rak ding."},"25":{"text":"A laak in vancungmi a hmuh tikah a khir ih Balaam ih ke cu lungtlap ah a rialcih. Cutikah Balaam in a laak cu a vuak sal."},"26":{"text":"Vancungmi cu hmaiah a rak feh lala ih pial-awk thei lonak lamzin ceprep ah a rak ding."},"27":{"text":"Vancungmi a hmuh tikah a laak cu a bok. Balaam in a thin a suup thei nawn lo ih a laak cu a fungin a vuak ciamco."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in laak cu a ṭongter ih Balaam hnenah, “Ziang ka lo ti ruangah so voi thum tiangtiang i vuak?” a ti."},"29":{"text":"Balaam in a laak hnen ahcun, “Lehnak menih i hman ruangah a si. Ralnam keng ningna cu atu rori-ah ka lo saat that ding naón,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cutikah laak cun, “Na nun sung tutiang in na to ringringmi laak thotho ka si lo maw? Atu bangtuk in a hlanah ka lo ti dah maw?” a ti. “I ti dah lo,” tiah Balaam in a sawn."},"31":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Balaam ih mit cu a vangter ih vancungmi pakhat a ralnam thawn a din kha a hmuhter. Cutikah Balaam cu leilung ah a bok."},"32":{"text":"Cule vancungmi cun, “Ziangah so hi bangtuk in na laak cu voi thum tiang na vuak? Hi lam feh ding na si lo naón na feh ruangah na lamzin ka lo kham a si."},"33":{"text":"Na laak in i hmu ih voi thum tiang a pial a si. Cutiin pial hlah sehla na laak cu ka zuah ding ih nang sawn hi ka lo that zo ding,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Cutikah Balaam in, “Ka sual a si. Ka lamzin i kham ih lamzinih na din kha ka theih lo ruangah a si. Hi lam ka feh vivo hi na lung a kim lo a si ahcun inn ah ka kir ding,” tiah vancungmi hnenah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Asinain vancungmi in, “Himi pawl hnenah feh ko aw; asinain sim ding ka lo timi lawng na sim pei,” a ti. Curuangah Balaam cu a ra kotu pawl hnenah a feh sal."},"36":{"text":"Balak in Balaam a ra ti a theih tikah a feh ih Moab ramri Arnon Tiva kapih Ar khua in a va hmuak.","title":"Balak In Balaam A Hmuak"},"37":{"text":"Cutikah Balak in Balaam hnenah, “Ka lo sawm rero naón ziangah so na rat lo? Laksawng ṭhahnem i pe thei lo ding tiih na ruah ruangah maw si?” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cutikah Balaam in, “Atu cu ka ra thleng zo a sihi! Asinain ziang poh sim theinak ka nei lo. Pathian ih i simtermi lawnglawng ka sim ding a si,” a ti."},"39":{"text":"Cuticun Balaam cu Balak thawn Kiriath Huzoth khua ah an feh ih,"},"40":{"text":"Balak in caw le tuu that in thawinak a tuah ih a sa hrekkhat cu Balaam le amah thawn a ummi hotu pawl a pek."},"41":{"text":"A thaizing ah Balak in Balaam cu Bamoth Baal tlang ah a fehpi. Cutawk ihsin Balaam in Israel mi burpi umnak hmuahhmuah cu a hmu thei a si.","title":"Balaam Ih ṭongmi Voi Khatnak"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cutikah Balaam in Balak hnenah, “Hitawk ah ka hrangah biakṭheng pasarih in dawl awla cawcang pasarih le tuucang pasarih i rak ken aw,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"A sim vekin a tuah ih Balak le Balaam in biakṭheng pakhat ah cawcang pakhat le tuucang pakhat fingfing biakṭheng pasarih ah thawinak an pek."},"3":{"text":"Cule Balaam in Balak hnenah, “Na mei-ur thawinak kiangah hin rak ding hrih awla kei cu Bawipa in i tong duh maw tong duh lo ka va hliahta hrih pei. Bawipa in ka hnenih a langtermi hmuahhmuah cu ka lo sim ding,” tiah a ti. Cule Balaam cu tlang parah a feh ih,"},"4":{"text":"Pathian in Balaam cu a tong. Balaam in, “Biakṭheng pasarih ka dawl zo ih pakhat parah cawcang pakhat le tuucang pakhat fingfing ka thawi a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Balak hnenah kir awla ka thucahmi va sim aw,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Balaam cu a kir ih Balak cu a mei-ur thawinak kiangah Moab mi hotu pawl thawn a rak din hrih kha a hmu."},"7":{"text":"Cule Balaam in a tanglam vekin profet ṭongkam in a ṭong: “Moab siangpahrang Balak in i ko, Aram le nisuahnak lam tlang ihsin, ‘Ka aiah ra sim aw,’ i ti, ‘Israel mi pawl camsiat aw,’ i ti."},"8":{"text":"Pathian ih camsiat lomi ziangtinso ka camsiat thei ding? Pathian ih camriam lomi ziangtinso ka camriam thei ding?"},"9":{"text":"Lungpi tlangsaang in anmah cu ka cuan, Tlangzik par ihsin anmah ka hmu. Anmahte a nungmi miphun an si, Miphun dang lakah a siarcih awmi an si lo."},"10":{"text":"Jakob ih tefa pawl cu vunnel zat an si, Israel cithlah pawl cu siar cawk an si lo. Pathian ih minung bangin ka nunnak ni cu liamseh, Miding bangin daihnak in thi ning law,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Balak in Balaam hnenah, “Ka parih na thil tuahmi hi ziangvek so a si? Ka ral pawl camsiat dingah hinah ka lo ko. Asinain anmah riangri thlawsuah na pek,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Balaam in, “Keiih ka simmi cu Bawipa in sim dingih i fialmi lawng a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Balak in Balaam hnenah cun, “Ra awla Israel mi hrekkhat lawng na hmuh theinak hmunah kan feh pei. Cutawk ihsin ka aiah camsiat hai aw,” a ti.","title":"Balaam Ih ṭongmi Voi Hnihnak"},"14":{"text":"Balak in Balaam cu Pisgah Tlang zik, Zofim ih lo ah a fehpi. Cutawk ahcun biakṭheng pasarih a dawl ih biakṭheng pakhat parah cawcang pakhat le tuucang pakhat fingfing thawinakah a pek."},"15":{"text":"Cule Balaam in Balak hnenah, “Hitawk na mei-ur thawinak kiangah rak ding awla khitawk ah Pathian ka va tong ta pei,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in Balaam cu a tong ih a ṭong dingmi pawl cu a sim ih Balak sim dingah a kirter."},"17":{"text":"Balaam cu a kir ih Balak a mei-ur thawinak kiangah Moab mi hotu pawl thawn a din hrih kha a hmu. Cutikah Balak in, “ Bawipa in ziang a ti so?” tiah a rak sut."},"18":{"text":"Balaam cun a thok ih profet ṭongkam in hiti in a ti: “Ra aw, Zippor fapa Balak, ra aw, Ka sim dingmi hi ra ngai hnik aw."},"19":{"text":"Pathian cu thuphan per hmang milai vek a si lo, A thinlung a thleng leuhleuhmi milai vek khal a si lo. A tiamkammi hmuahhmuah cu a tuah suak, A ṭong ih tuah thluh an si."},"20":{"text":"Thlawsuah pek ding lawng hi in fialmi a si, Pathian in thlawsuahnak a pek zo ih ka khir sal thei nawn lo."},"21":{"text":"Israel mi pawl hmailamih an fehnak dingah, Vanduainak le harsat tonnak ding ka hmu lo. Bawipa an Pathian cu an hnenah a um ih, Pathian cu an Siangpahrang ah an aupi a si."},"22":{"text":"Pathian in Izipt ram ihsin a suahpi hai ih, An hrangah cawcang hraang bangin a ṭang a si."},"23":{"text":"Dawi siseh polsia siseh a um lo, Israel miphun dodal ding ahcun. Miphun pawl in Israel an hmuh tikah, ‘Zohhnik uh, Pathian thiltuah hi,’ an ti ding."},"24":{"text":"Israel miphun cu a cakzetmi kiosa vek a si, A deh ciami sa a bauh thluh le a ei thluh hlan lo, A thisen a in thluh hlan lo cu colh ti a nei lo,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Balak in Balaam hnenah, “Israel mi pawl camsiat ding cu na el thla rori a sihi! Sikhalsehla thlawsuahnak tal cu pe loin um aw,” a ti."},"26":{"text":"Asinain Balaam cun, “ Bawipa ih i fialmi lawnglawng ka tuah ding, tiah ka lo sim cia zo lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Balak in Balaam hnenah, “Ka hnenah ra awla hmun dangah ka lo fehpi ding. Cutawk ihsin cun ka ai-ih Israel mi pawl camsiat dingah Bawipa in a lo siang khal a si thei men,” a ti.","title":"Balaam Ih ṭongmi Voi Thumnak"},"28":{"text":"Curuangah Balak in Balaam cu nelrawn hmuh theinak Peor Tlang zik ah a fehpi."},"29":{"text":"Cule Balaam in Balak hnenah, “Ka hrangah biakṭheng pasarih hitawk ah dawl awla cawcang pasarih le tuucang pasarih i rak ken aw,” a ti."},"30":{"text":"A tivek cun Balak in a tuah ih biakṭheng pakhat parah cawcang pakhat le tuucang pakhat fingfing thawinakah a pek."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi pawl thluasuah pe dingah i duh ti kha Balaam in a thei zo ih curuangah a hlan bangtuk in aizingnak tla tuah dingah a feh nawn lo. Nelrawn lamah cun a hoi kir ih,"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi pawl a hrin a hrin ciarih an riah kha a hmu. Pathian ih thlarau cu a hnenah a rung thleng ih,"},"3":{"text":"profet ṭongkam in hiti in a phuang: “Beor fapa Balaam ih thuphuanmi, Fiangte ih a hmu theitu pa-ih ṭongkam cu,"},"4":{"text":"Pathian simmi a theitu pa-ih thucah mi cu. Ka mit meng tahrat in ka hmu, Ziangkimtithei Pathian ih langnak cu."},"5":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ih puanthlam cu an mawi a si,"},"6":{"text":"A tluantluan ih ciin mi ungkung bangin, Tiva kiangih hmuan pawl an bang, Bawipa ih ciinmi khukthli vek, Tidai kiangih sidar thing vek an si."},"7":{"text":"Vanruah cat loin an ngah ding, Tidai a ciapmi lo sungah thlaici an tuh ding. An siangpahrang cu Agag hnakin a nasa deuh, A ukmi ram cu a kau ngaingai."},"8":{"text":"Pathian in Izipt ram ihsin a suahpi, An hrangah cawcang hraang bangin a ṭang; An ral pawl cu an dolh thluh, An ruh an rialdip ih an thal pawl an khiak ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Israel cu a cak zetmi kiosa bangtuk a si, A ihthat lai ahcun zohman in an ṭhang ngam lo. Israel a thluasuahtu cu thlawsuah an si ve ding, Israel a camsiattu cu camsiat an si ve ding,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Balak cu a thin hengin a kut a tum ih Balaam hnenah, “Ka ral pawl camsiat dingah ka lo ko; asinain voi thum rori thlawsuah na pek a si."},"11":{"text":"Atu zamrangin na inn ah kir aw. Laksawng pe dingah ka lo tiam naón Bawipa in laksawng ngah ding cu a lo kham a si,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Balaam in, “Ka hnenih palai na rak thlahmi pawl hnenih ka sim zo vekin,"},"13":{"text":"na siangpahrang inn sungih a ummi sui le ngun a zatein i pek hmanah Bawipa ih thupekmi el tahrat in, a ṭha a sikhal le a sia a si khalle, keimah ih thu cun ka nung thei lo. Bawipa in sim dingih i fialmi lawnglawng ka sim ding a si,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Balaam in Balak hnenah, “Atu cu ka minung pawl hnenah ka kir thlang ding. Asinain ka feh hlanah hmailam caanah Israel mi pawl in na minung pawl parih an tuah dingmi hi ralrinnak ka lo sim cia duh a si,” a ti.","title":"Netabik Balaam ṭongmi"},"15":{"text":"Cule a thokih profet ṭongkam in hiti in a ṭong: “Beor fapa Balaam ih thuphuanmi, Fiangte ih a hmu theitu pa-ih ṭongkam,"},"16":{"text":"Pathian simmi a theitu le, A Sang Bik ih a ummi hnen ihsin fimnak a cotu in, Ka mit meng tahrat in ka hmu; Ziangkimtithei Pathian ih langnak cu."},"17":{"text":"Hmailam tikcu caan sung khi ka hei zoh ih, Israel miphun ka hei hmu a si. Cuih miphun sung ihsin, Arsi bangtuk ih a tleumi Siangpahrang a suak ding. Deirel arsi bangin Israel miphun sungin a suak ding. Moab hotu pawl cu a vuak hai ding ih, Seth mi pawl cu a vuakthlak hai ding."},"18":{"text":"Edom ramih a ral pawl cu a neh ding ih, An ram cu amah ih ta-ah a cang ding. Israel cu nehtu a si ringring ding."},"19":{"text":"Israel cun a ke thuaiah a pal hai ding ih, A luatmi lakih neta bik tiangin a that ding,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule Balaam in langnak a hmuhmi ah Amalek mi pawl a hmu ih hiti in a phuang: “Amalek cu miphun lakah a cak bikmi a si, Asinain neta bikah cun kumkhua in a hloralta ding,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun langnak a hmuhmi ahcun Ken mi pawl a hmu ih Balaam in hiti in a ṭong lala, “Atu na umnak hmun cu a himzet a si, Khaam saangpi lungpi parih vate bu vek a si;"},"22":{"text":"Asinain nannih Ken mi pawl cu nan cem ding, Nan ral Assiria in a lo kaih tikah cun,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Balaam in hiti in a ṭong: “Saklam ih a tongkhawm mi pawl hi zoso an si?"},"24":{"text":"Saipras ihsin mi dotu pawl tangphawlawng in an ra ding. Assiria le Eber an neh ding; Asinain annih khal kumkhua-in an hloralta ding,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cule Balaam cu a tho ih a khua ah a tlung; Balak khal a tlung ve."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Shittim ih an um laiah an mipa pawl in Moab nunau pawl cu an sualpi ṭheu.","title":"Peor Ah Israel Mi An Thleng"},"2":{"text":"Hi Moab nunau pawl cun an khawzing an biaknak le an raithawinak puai ah Israel mi pawl cu an sawm. Israel mi pawl in rawl an ei ih,"},"3":{"text":"Peor ih khawzing Baal cu an biak ve. Curuangah Bawipa cu an parah a thin a heng ih,"},"4":{"text":"Moses hnenah, “Israel mi hotu pawl kokhawm awla senpi hmuhah cupawl cu that hai aw. Cuticun Israel mi parah ka thin a dai ding,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Israel hotu pawl hnenah, “Nan hrin sungin Peor ih Baal khawzing a betu cu nan that ciar pei,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Moses le Israel misenpi pawl cu an riahsia in Bawipa umnak Puanthlam sangka ah an ṭap. Culai fangah an zate mithmuh ah Israel mipa pakhat in Midian nunau pakhat cu a deuthlam sungah a luhpi."},"7":{"text":"Cumi cu Eleazar fapa, Aaron ih fapa sin, Finehas in a hmuh tikah a tho ih misenpi lakin a suak. Feipi a keng ih,"},"8":{"text":"cuih mipa le nunau nu cu a fuuk ih an deuthlam sungah cun an pahnih in a sun that. Curuangah Israel pawl parih a thlengmi natsia cu a reh."},"9":{"text":"Asinain Israel mi thawng kul hluanli natsia in an rak thi zo."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,"},"11":{"text":"“Finehas in Israel mi parih ka thinhengnak cu a daiter zo a si. Anih cu keimah siar lo pathian ziangvek hman biak ding a duh hrimhrim lo. Curuangah Israel mi pawl ka siatsuah thluh lonak cu a si."},"12":{"text":"Finehas cu sim awla kumkhuadaih in amah thawn thukamnak ka tuah ding."},"13":{"text":"Keimah dodaltu ziangvek khawzing hman a pom thei lo ih, Israel misenpi ih sual ngaithiamnak khal a suahter ruangah amah le a tesinfa pawl cu kumkhua-in puithiam an si ding,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Israel mipa, Midian nunau nu thawn, thahnak a tuartu cu Salu fapa Zimri a si. Amah cu Simeon cithlah sungah hrin pakhat ih lu a si."},"15":{"text":"Nunau an thahmi ih hmin cu Kozbi a si ih a pa Zur cu Midian hnam lakah hrin khatih lal a si."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses cu,"},"17":{"text":"“Midian mi pawl cu do awla siatsuah thluh aw."},"18":{"text":"Ziangahtile Peor ah nanmah an lo bum ih thil ṭha lo an tuah ruangah le Peor-ih natsia a thlen laiih thihnak a tuartu Kozbi ruangah siatsuah thluh ding an tlak a si,” tiah thu a pek."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Natsia a reh hnuah Bawipa in Moses le Aaron fapa Eleazar hnenah,","title":"Voi Hnihnak Mipum Siarnak"},"2":{"text":"“Israel misenpi, kum kul le a tlunlam, ralkap a ṭuan thei dingmi hmuahhmuah innsang pakhat hnu pakhat in mipum siarnak nan tuah pei,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupekmi cu Moses le Eleazar in an thlun ih kum kul le a tlunlam mipa hmuahhmuah hmun khatah an kokhawm. Jerikho kiang, Jordan Tiva ralih Moab hmunrawn ah an tongkhawm aw. Izipt ram ihsin a suakmi Israel mi pawl cu a hnuailam bangtuk an si:","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Reuben phunhnam ihsin (Reuben cu Jakob fapa upabik a si): Hanok, Pallu,"},"6":{"text":"Hezron le Karmi hrin pawl an si."},"7":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl sungah minung thawng sawmli thawng thum zasarih le sawmthum an kim."},"8":{"text":"Pallu ih tesinfa pawl cu Eliab le,"},"9":{"text":"a fapa Nemuel, Dathan, le Abiram an si. Hi Dathan le Abiram cu misenpi ih hrilmi kha an si. Moses le Aaron ih thu an el ih Bawipa an dodal tikah Korah dungthluntu pawl hnenah an tel ve."},"10":{"text":"An dinnak ih leilung a kak ih a dolh thluh hai. Cule meisa in minung zahnih le sawmnga a ur that tikah Korah le a dungthluntu pawl hnenah an thi a si. Misenpi hrangah ralrinternak ah an cang."},"11":{"text":"Asinain Korah ih fapa pawl cu an thi lo."},"12":{"text":"Simeon hnam ihsin Nemuel, Jamin, Jakhin,"},"13":{"text":"Zerah le Shaul hrin pawl an si."},"14":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl sungin minung thawng kul hluanhnih le zahnih an kim."},"15":{"text":"Gad hnam ihsin Zefon, Haggi, Shuni,"},"16":{"text":"Ozni, Eri,"},"17":{"text":"Arod le Areli hrin pawl an si."},"18":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl sungin minung thawng sawmli le zanga an kim."},"19":{"text":"Judah hnam ihsin (Judah fapa lakin pahnih, Er le Onan, cu Kanaan ramah an thi zo):"},"20":{"text":"Shelah, Perez, Zerah,"},"21":{"text":"Hezron le Hamul hrin pawl an si."},"22":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl sungin minung thawng sawmsarih thawngruk le zanga an kim."},"23":{"text":"Issakhar hnam ihsin Tola, Puah,"},"24":{"text":"Jashub le Shimron hrin pawl an si."},"25":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl sung ihsin minung thawng sawmruk thawng li le zathum an kim."},"26":{"text":"Zebulun hnam ihsin Sered, Elon, le Jahleel hrin pawl an si."},"27":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl sung ihsin minung thawng sawmruk le zanga an kim."},"28":{"text":"Josef hnam pawl ihsin fapa pahnih Manasseh le Efraim an si."},"29":{"text":"Manasseh hnam ihsin Manasseh fapa Makhir cu Gilead ih pa a si ih a tanglam hrin pawl cu Gilead ih cithlahmi an si."},"30":{"text":"Iezer, Helek,"},"31":{"text":"Asriel, Shekhem."},"32":{"text":"Shemida, le Hefer hrin pawl an si."},"33":{"text":"Hefer fapa Zelofehad cu fapa a nei lo; fanu lawng a nei ih an hmin cu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, le Tirzah an si."},"34":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl sung ihsin minung thawng sawmnga thawnghnih le zasarih an kim."},"35":{"text":"Efraim hnam ihsin Shuthelah, Bekher, le Tahan hrin pawl an si."},"36":{"text":"Eran hrin cu Shuthelah cithlahmi an si."},"37":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl sung ihsin minung thawng sawmthum thawnghnih le zanga an kim. Hi pawl cu Josef ih tesinfa, an hrin ciar ih cithlah mi an si."},"38":{"text":"Benjamin hnam ihsin: Bela, Ashbel, Ahiram,"},"39":{"text":"Shefufam, le Hufam hrin pawl an si."},"40":{"text":"Ard le Naaman hrin pawl cu Bela cithlah an si."},"41":{"text":"Hi pawl cu Benjamin tesinfa sungin an hrin ciar ih cithlah mi an si; minung thawng sawmli thawngnga le zaruk an kim."},"42":{"text":"Dan hnam ihsin Shuham hrin an si."},"43":{"text":"Dan ih tesinfa pawl cu minung thawng sawmruk thawngli le zali an kim."},"44":{"text":"Asher hnam ihsin Imnah, Ishvi, le Beriah hrin pawl an si."},"45":{"text":"Heber le Malkhiel hrin pawl cu Beriah cithlahmi an si."},"46":{"text":"Asher in Serah timi fanu pakhat a nei."},"47":{"text":"Hi pawl cu Asher tesinfa an si ih an hrin sungin minung thawng sawmnga thawngthum le zali an kim."},"48":{"text":"Naftali hnam ihsin Jahzeel, Guni,"},"49":{"text":"Jezer, le Shillem hrin pawl an si."},"50":{"text":"Hi pawl cu Naftali tesinfa pawl an si ih an hrin sungin minung thawng sawmli thawngnga le zali an kim."},"51":{"text":"An zatein Israel mi mipa hmuahhmuah cu thawng zaruk thawng khat zasarih le sawmthum an si."},"52":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,"},"53":{"text":"“An tam le an mal zoh in ram cu hi hrin pawl hi zem hai aw."},"54":{"text":"Ram cu camcawhfung zuk in ṭhen awla ramṭhen tum deuh cu mi tam deuh hrin hnenah pe awla ramṭhen fate deuh cu mi mal deuh hrin hnenah pe aw,” a ti.","merge":"55"},"57":{"text":"Levi hnam ihsin Gershon, Kohath, le Merari hrin pawl an si."},"58":{"text":"A dang Levi hrin pawl cu Libni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi le Korah cithlahmi an si. Kohath cu Amram ih pa a si ih,"},"59":{"text":"Amram in Izipt ramih a suakmi Levi ih fanu Jokhebed a ṭhi. Cule Jokhebed in Amram cu fapa pahnih Aaron le Moses le an farnu Miriam a hrin a si."},"60":{"text":"Aaron in fapa pali a nei ih Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar an si."},"61":{"text":"Nadab le Abihu cu Bawipa hnenih a thianghlim lomi thawinak an pek ruangah an thi zo."},"62":{"text":"Levi mi pawl cu mipa thla khat le thla khat tlunlam an zatein thawng kul hluanthlum an si. Levi mi pawl cu Israel ram sungah ram covo pekmi an si ve lo ruangah Israel midang pawl thawn rawi loin a dang teih cazin lakmi an si."},"63":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl hmuahhmuah cu Moses le Eleazar in Jerikho kiang, Jordan Tiva ral Moab hmunrawnih Israel mi pawl mipum siarnak an tuah tikah cazin an lakmi pawl an si."},"64":{"text":"Moses le puithiam Aaron in Sinai Nelrawn ih cazin an rak lak laiih minung pawl cu pakhat hman an taang nawn lo."},"65":{"text":"Bawipa in an zatein hramlak ramthing ah an thi ṭheh ding, a ti bangtuk in Jefunneh fapa Kaleb le Nun fapa Joshua siar lo, an thi ṭheh ngaingai a si."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josef fapa Manasseh, Manasseh fapa Makhir, Makhir fapa Gilead, Gilead fapa Hefer, Hefer fapa Zelofehad a si. Zelofehad in fanu lawng a nei ih anmah tla cu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah le Tirzah an si.","title":"Zelofehad Ih Fanu Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Cuih a fanu pawl cu Moses, puithiam Eleazar, hruaitu pawl le misenpi hmaiah Puanthlam sangka ahcun an feh ih,"},"3":{"text":"“Kan pa in hramlak ah in thihsan zo; fapa pakhat hman a nei lo. Bawipa a dodaltu Korah ih dungthluntu lakah anih cu a tel lo. Amah ih sual ruangah a thi a si."},"4":{"text":"Fapa neih lo ruangah zianghrangah so kan pa ih hmin cu a sungkhat lak ihsin a hlohral ta ding? Kan pa ih unau lakah kannih khal covo in pe ve uh,” tiah an dil."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah an thu cu Moses in Bawipa a ron."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in a hnenah,"},"7":{"text":"“Zelofehad fanu pawl ih an dilmi cu a dik a si. An pa ih unau lakah annih khal covo pe ve aw. An pa ih ro cu anmah in co hai seh."},"8":{"text":"Cun Israel mi pawl cu sim awla, mi pakhatkhat fapa nei loih a thih ahcun a ro cu a fanu in a co pei."},"9":{"text":"Fanu a neih lo asile a unau in an co pei."},"10":{"text":"Unau khal a neih lo a si ahcun a pa ih unau in an co pei."},"11":{"text":"A pa khal unau a neih lo a si ahcun a sungkhat lakih a nai bik in a co pei ih, amah ih ta ah a cang ta pei. Himi cu Bawipa keimah ih thupekmi a si ih Israel mi pawl in an thlun dingmi daan a si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Abarim Tlangah hung feh awla Israel mi pawl hnenih ka pek dingmi ram cu va thlir aw.","title":"Moses Ai-awh Ah Joshua (Daan 31.1-8)"},"13":{"text":"Na thlir ṭheh cun na u Aaron a nunnak a cem bangtuk in nang khal a cem ve ding."},"14":{"text":"Ziangahtile Zin hramlakih ka thupekmi nan pahnih in nan el ruangah a si. Meribah ah Israel misenpi in in dodal tikah keimah ih thianhlimnak huham cu nan dinpi duh lo a si,” a ti. Meribah cu Zin hramlak Kadesh ih cirhti a si."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in,"},"16":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa nunnak hmuahhmuahih hramṭohnak Pathian,"},"17":{"text":"na minung pawl hi tuukhaltu nei lo tuurual bangtuk an si lonak dingah mi hruai theitu le raldo tikih mi ho theitu mi pakhat hril hram aw,” tiah a dil."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Moses hnenah, “Thilti theinak a nei mi Nun ih fapa Joshua cu ko awla a lu parah na kut suang aw."},"19":{"text":"Puithiam Eleazar le misenpi hmaiah cun dingter awla an zate ih hmaiah cun nangmah ih ai-awhtu a si, tinak thu than aw."},"20":{"text":"Cun Israel misenpi in a thu an thlunnak dingah na thuneihnak hrekkhat cu amah pe aw."},"21":{"text":"Joshua in puithiam Eleazar cu a rinsanzet pei ih Eleazar cun keimah ih duhnak thei dingah Urim le Thummim a hmang pei. Cuticun Joshua le Israel misenpi cu Eleazar in a ho pei ih amah ih thu in ziangtinkim ah an um pei,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk cun Moses in a tuah ṭheh. Puithiam Eleazar le misenpi hmaiah cun Joshua cu a dinter ih,"},"23":{"text":"Joshua-ih lu parah a kut a suang ih amah ai run awhtu dingah nemhngetnak a tuah."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in rimthawmi rawlhun thawinak pawl Bawipa ih hnenah a tikcu kim tikih an pek dingah sim dingin Bawipa in Moses hnenah thu a pek.","title":"A Tikcu Caan Ih Thawinak Pekmi Pawl (Suah 29.38-46)","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih rawlhun thawinak nan pek dingmi pawl cu hihi an si: nitin mei-ur thawinak hrangah raitluanmi kum khat ti tuucangte pahnih;"},"4":{"text":"tuucangte pakhat cu zinglamah, a dang pakhat cu zanlam ah, nan pek pei."},"5":{"text":"Cumi thawinak thawn hmun khatah fanghun thawinak tla nan pek pei ih olif siti ṭha bik khuat khat thawn rawimi sangphut reeltan a si ding."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih rimthaw thawinak pekmi a si ih Sinai Tlang parih hmaisa bik nan rak thawi bangtuk in hi thawinak cu nitinte meisa ur in thawinak a si."},"7":{"text":"Cumi pakhatnak tuucangte pekmi thawn inmi thawinak khal nan pek pei ih sabit khuat khat biakṭheng ah nan toih pei."},"8":{"text":"Zinglam thawinak nan pekmi bangtuk in pahnihnak tuucangte cu zanlam ah nan pek pei ih inmi thawinak khal nan pek pei. Himi cu rawlhun thawinak a si ih Bawipa ih hrangah rimthaw a si."},"9":{"text":"Sabbath ni ah kum khat ti raitluan tuucangte pahnih, thlairawl thawinak hrangah olif siti thawn rawimi sangphut reel khat cu inmi thawinak thawn nan pek pei.","title":"Sabbath Ni Thawinak"},"10":{"text":"Hi mei-ur thawinak cu nitinte pekmi fanghun thawinak le inmi thawinak hlei ah Sabbath nitin pekmi thawinak a si pei."},"11":{"text":"Thlatin ni hmaisabik ah Bawipa ih hnenah a tanglam pawl cu nan pek pei: cawcangte pahnih, tuucang pakhat, kum khat ti tuucangte pasarih, an zatein raitluan an si pei.","title":"Thlatin Ni Hmaisabik Ah Thawinak"},"12":{"text":"Cuih tlunah olif siti thawn rawimi thlairawl thawinak, cawcang pakhat ah sangphut reel khat le a tan, tuucang pakhat ah sangphut reel khat thawn,"},"13":{"text":"kum khat ti tuucangte pakhat ah sangphut reel tan thawn nan pek pei. Hi mei-ur thawinak pawl cu rawlhun thawinak an si ih Bawipa ih hrangah rimthaw an si."},"14":{"text":"Felzet ih inmi thawinak pekmi a si ahcun cawcang pakhat ah sabit khuat hnih, tuucang pakhat ah khuat khat le a hrek, kum khat ti tuucangte pakhat ah khuat khat nan pek pei. Kum khat sung thlatin ni hmaisa bikih mei-ur thawinak pek tikah thlun ding daan an si."},"15":{"text":"Cun nitin mei-ur thawinakah sabitti an telh ih hlei ah sualthlah thawinak hrangah mecang pakhat pek a si pei."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ih upat cawimawinak ih tuahmi Lantak Puai cu thla hmaisa bik ni hleili ni ah tuah a si pei.","title":"Thilnu Rawi Lo Puai ih Thawinak (Pui 23.5-14)"},"17":{"text":"Ni hleinga ni ihsin biaknak puai a thok pei ih ni sarih sung a si pei. Cuih sung hmuahhmuah cu thilnu tel lo sang nan ei pei."},"18":{"text":"Puai ni hmaisa bik ni ahcun ziang hnaṭuan hman nan ṭuan lo pei. Pathian biak dingah nan pumkhawm sawn pei."},"19":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinak pek uhla cumi cu Bawipa hnenih pekmi rawlhun thawinak a si pei: cawcangte pahnih, tuucang pakhat, kum khat ti tuucangte pasarih, an zatein raitluan nan pek pei."},"20":{"text":"Fanghun thawinak feltein tuah uhla olif siti thawn rawi uh; cawcang pakhat ah sangphut reel khat le a tan, tuucang pakhat ah reel khat,"},"21":{"text":"tuucangte pakhat ah reeltan a si pei."},"22":{"text":"Cuih tlunah sualthlah thawinak hrangah mecang pakhat nan pek pei ih cuticun misenpi thianhlimnak hrangah mawhnak thawinak cu tuah a si pei."},"23":{"text":"Himi cu nitinte tuahmi mei-ur thawinak hlei ah nan pek pei."},"24":{"text":"Cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in ni sarih sung Bawipa ih hnenah rawlhun thawinak, a hrangih rimthawmi cu nan pek pei. Himi cu nitinte nan pekmi mei-ur thawinak le inmi thawinak hlei ah nan pek pei."},"25":{"text":"Ni sarih ni ah a thianghlim mi pumkhawmnak nan nei pei ih zianghman nan ṭuan lo pei."},"26":{"text":"Nan Rawllak Puai ni hmaisa bik Bawipa hnenih fangthar nan pek tikah Pathian biak dingah nan pumkhawm pei ih zianghman hna nan ṭuan lo pei.","title":"Rawllak Puai ih Thawinak (Pui 23.15-22)"},"27":{"text":"Bawipa hrangah rimthaw, mei-ur thawinak nan pek pei ih, cawcang pahnih, tuucang pakhat, le kum khat ti tuucangte pasarih, an zatein raitluan an si pei."},"28":{"text":"Cumi thawn olif siti rawimi, felteih tuahmi thlairawl thawinak nan pek pei ih cawcang pakhat ah sangphut reel khat le a tan, tuucang pakhat ah reel khat le,"},"29":{"text":"kum khat ti tuucangte pakhat ah reel tan a si pei."},"30":{"text":"Cuih tlunah sualthlah thawinakah mecang pakhat nan pek pei ih cuticun misenpi thianhlimnak hrangih sualthlah thiannak cu nan tuah pei."},"31":{"text":"Hi thawinak pawl le inmi thawinak cu nitin nan tuahmi mei-ur thawinak le thlairawl thawinak hlei ah nan pek pei."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thla sarihnak ni hmaisa bik ni ah pumkhawmnak thianghlim nan nei pei ih hna zianghman nan ṭuan lo pei. Cuih ni ah tawtawrawt nan tum pei.","title":"Kum Thar Puai ih Thawinak (Pui 23.23-25)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah rimthaw mei-ur thawinak nan pek pei: raitluan cawcangte pakhat, tuucang pakhat, le kum khat ti tuucangte pasarih, an si pei."},"3":{"text":"Olif siti thawn rawimi sangphut in thlairawl thawinak felzetin nan tuah pei. Cawcang hrangah sangphut reel khat le a tan, tuucang hrangah reel khat,"},"4":{"text":"kum khat ti tuucangte pakhat ah reel tan an si pei."},"5":{"text":"Cuih tlunah sualthlah thawinak hrangah mecang pakhat nan pek pei ih cuticun misenpi thianhlimnak hrangah sualthlah thiannak nan tuah pei."},"6":{"text":"Hi thawinak pawl cu thla thar ni hmaisa bikih mei-ur thawinak le thlairawl thawinak, nitin mei-ur thawinak le thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak pawl ih hlei ah nan pek pei. Hi rawlhun thawinak pawl cu Bawipa ih hrangah rimthaw an si."},"7":{"text":"Thla sarih thla, ni hra ni ah Pathian biak dingah nan pumkhawm pei. Rawl nan ei lo pei, hna khal nan ṭuan lo pei.","title":"Sualthlah Ni Ih Thawinak (Pui 23.26-32)"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah rimthawmi mei-ur thawinak pek uh: cawcangte pakhat, tuucang pakhat le kum khat ti tuucangte pasarih, an zatein raitluan an si pei."},"9":{"text":"Olif siti thawn rawimi sangphut in thlairawl thawinak felzetin nan pek pei: cawcang pakhat hrangah sangphut reel khat le a tan, tuucang hrangah reel khat,"},"10":{"text":"kum khat ti tuucangte hrangah reel tan a si pei."},"11":{"text":"Cule misenpi thianhlimnak hrangih sualthlah thiannak, nitin mei-ur thawinak, thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak pawl ih hlei ah sualthlah thawinak hrangah mecang pakhat nan pek pei."},"12":{"text":"Thla sarih, ni hleinga ni ah pumkhawmnak thianghlim nan nei pei. Bawipa sunloihnak ah hi puai cu ni sarih sung nan tuah pei ih hna zianghman nan ṭuan lo pei.","title":"Rawllak Puai ih Thawinak (Pui 23.33-44)"},"13":{"text":"Hi puai ni hmaisa bik ni ah Bawipa ih hnenah meisa thawn rawlhun thawinak rimthaw nan pek pei: cawcangno hlei thum, tuucang pahnih, le kum khat ti tuucangte hleili, an zatein raitluan an si pei."},"14":{"text":"Olif siti thawn rawimi thlairawl thawinak cu feltein nan tuah pei: cawcang pakhat hrangah sangphut reel khat le a tan, tuucang pakhat hrangah reel khat,"},"15":{"text":"kum khat ti tuucangte pakhat hrangah reel tan le inmi thawinak pawl nan pek pei."},"16":{"text":"Cuih tlunah sualthlah thawinak hrangah mecang pakhat nan pek pei. Hi thawinak pawl cu nitin mei-ur thawinak le thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak hlei ih pekmi an si pei."},"17":{"text":"Ni hnihnak ni ah cawcangno hleihnih, tuucang pahnih le kum khat ti tuucangte hleili nan pek pei. An zatein raitluan an si pei."},"18":{"text":"Cule thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak tla cawcang hrang, tuucang hrang le tuucangte hrangah a zat an khiah cia vekin nan pek cih pei."},"19":{"text":"Cuih tlunah nitin nan pekmi mei-ur thawinak, thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak pawl cu sualthlah thawinak hrangih mecang pakhat nan pekmi thawn nan pek cih pei."},"20":{"text":"Ni thumnak ni ah cawcangno hleikhat, tuucang pahnih le kum khat ti tuucangte hleili nan pek pei. An zatein raitluan an si pei."},"21":{"text":"Cule thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak tla cawcang hrang, tuucang hrang le tuucangte hrangah a zat an khiah cia vekin nan pek cih pei."},"22":{"text":"Cuih tlunah nitin nan pekmi mei-ur thawinak, thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak pawl cu sualthlah thawinak hrangih mecang pakhat nan pekmi thawn nan pek cih pei."},"23":{"text":"Ni linak ni ah cawcangno pahra, tuucang pahnih le kum khat ti tuucangte hleili nan pek pei. An zatein raitluan an si pei."},"24":{"text":"Cule thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak tla cawcang hrang, tuucang hrang le tuucangte hrangah a zat an khiah cia vekin nan pek cih pei."},"25":{"text":"Cuih tlunah nitin nan pekmi mei-ur thawinak, thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak pawl cu sualthlah thawinak hrangih mecang pakhat nan pekmi thawn nan pek cih pei."},"26":{"text":"Ni nganak ni ah cawcangno pakua, tuucang pahnih le kum khat ti tuucangte hleili nan pek pei. An zatein raitluan an si pei."},"27":{"text":"Himi thawn hmun khatah ni khatnak ni ih nan pekmi thawinak dang pawl khal a zatein nan pek cih pei.","merge":"28"},"29":{"text":"Ni ruknak ni ah cawcangno pariat, tuucang pahnih le kum khat ti tuucangte hleili nan pek pei. An zatein raitluan an si pei."},"30":{"text":"Himi thawn hmun khatah ni khatnak ni ih nan pekmi thawinak dang pawl khal a zatein nan pek cih pei.","merge":"31"},"32":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ah cawcangno pasarih, tuucang pahnih le kum khat ti tuucangte hleili nan pek pei. An zatein raitluan an si pei."},"33":{"text":"Himi thawn hmun khatah ni khatnak ni ih nan pekmi thawinak dang pawl khal a zatein nan pek cih pei.","merge":"34"},"35":{"text":"Ni riatnak ni ah pumkhawm thianghlim nan tuah pei ih hna zianghman nan ṭuan lo pei."},"36":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah mei-ur thawinakih pekmi thlairawl thawinak rimthawmi cu nan pek pei: cawcangno pakhat, tuucang pakhat le kum khat ti tuucangte pasarih, an zatein raitluan nan pek pei."},"37":{"text":"Himi thawn hmun khatah ni khatnak ni ih nan pekmi thawinak dang pawl khal a zatein nan pek cih pei.","merge":"38"},"39":{"text":"Hi thawinak pawl hmuahhmuah cu a tikcu ciarah Bawipa hnenah nan pek pei. Mei-ur thawinak pawl, thlairawl thawinak pawl, inmi thawinak pawl le sualthlah thawinak pawl cu nan pek thluh pei. Hi pawl cu nan thukam kimternakih pumpak ciarih pekmi thawinak, a si lole mah lungtho teih pekmi thawinak pawl hlei ih nan pekmi an si pei."},"40":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa ih thupekmi hmuahhmuah cu Moses in Israel misenpi hnenah a sim ṭheh."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in a hnuailam ih daan pawl cu Israel mi hnam tinih hotu pawl hnenah a pek.","title":"Thukam awknak Tuah Tikih Thlun Ding Daan"},"2":{"text":"“Mi pakhat in Bawipa ih hnenah thil pakhat pek dingin thu a kam-awk tikah siseh, a si lole thil pakhat tuah lo dingin thu a kam-awk tikah siseh, cuih a thukammi cu a bal sal lo pei. Ka ti ding a timi cu kimtein a tuah thluh pei."},"3":{"text":"Fala pakhat in a pa ih innih a um laiah Bawipa hnenih ziangmaw pek dingah thu a kam-aw, a si lole ziangmaw tuah lo dingin thu a kam-awk tikah,"},"4":{"text":"cuih a thukammi cu a pa in a theih tikah lungkim lonak a neih dah ti lo ahcun a thukammi vekin a thlun thluh pei."},"5":{"text":"Asinain a thukammi cu a pa in a theih ih a kham a si ahcun a thlun a ṭul lo pei. A thukammi vekih tuah ding cu a pa in a kham ruangah Bawipa in a ngaithiam ding a si."},"6":{"text":"Pasal nei hrih lomi nunau pakhat in, tumtahnak nei fetfet in maw, a si lole tumtahnak mumal nei lem lo in maw, thil pakhatkhat tuah hrimhrim lo dingin thu a kam-awk hnuah pasal a nei ih,"},"7":{"text":"cumi cu a pasal in a theih tikah a lung a kim loih a kham dah tilo ahcun a thukammi vekin a thlun thluh pei."},"8":{"text":"Asinain a thukammi cu a pasal in a thei ih a kham a si ahcun a thlun a ṭul lo pei. Bawipa in a ngaithiam ding a si."},"9":{"text":"Nuhmei siseh, leengleh siseh, tuah dingih thu a kam awkmi, a si lole tuah lo dingih thu a kam awkmi cu a thlun thluh pei."},"10":{"text":"Pasal a neimi nunau in thil pakhatkhat tuah lo dingih a kammi cu,"},"11":{"text":"a pasal in a theih tikah a lung a kim loih a kham dah tilo ahcun a thukam vekin a thlun thluh pei."},"12":{"text":"Asinain a thukammi cu a pasal in a thei ih a kham a si ahcun a thlun a ṭul lo pei. A pasal in a kham a si ruangah Bawipa in a ngaithiam ding a si."},"13":{"text":"Nunau pakhat in siatcam ih thu a kammi, a si lole thu a tiammi kha hngetter ding, a si lole phiatsak dingah a pasal in thu a nei a si."},"14":{"text":"Asinain a nupi ih thukammi a theih sunah lungkim lonak zianghman a langter lo ahcun a thukammi vekin a thlun a ṭul a si. A theih vete in a nupi cu a kham lo ruangah a lungkimpi ah a cang."},"15":{"text":"Cun a nupi ih thukammi a theih hnupi-ah a bal sak a si ahcun a nupi ih mawhnak cu amah in a tuar pei,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Hi daan pawl cu Bawipa in Moses hnenah pasal neimi nunau in siseh, pasal nei hrih lo a pa ih innih um laimi fala in siseh, thukamnak an tuah tikih thlun dingah a pekmi an si."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Midian Ral An Do"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl parih thil an tuahmi ruangah Midian mi pawl parah phu va hlam aw. Cumi na tuah ṭheh in leilung parih na nunnak cu a cem ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Israel mi pawl hnenah, “ Bawipa ih parih thil an tuahmi ruangah Midian mi pawl do ding le hrem dingin nan tim tuah uh."},"4":{"text":"Israel hnam khat in ralkap thawng khat ciar suah uh,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Israel hnam khat in minung thawng khat ciar an suak ih ral do dingah ralkap thawng hleihnih an tiar-aw."},"6":{"text":"Cule Moses in puithiam Eleazar ih fapa, thilri thianghlim pawl kilvengtu, Finehas cu an hotu dingah le raldo thupeknak tawtawrawt pawl kengtu dingah a tuah ih ralkap thawng hleihnih cu a thlah."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenih thu a pek bangtuk in Midian mi pawl cu an do ih mipa hmuahhmuah an thah ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Midian siangpahrang panga - Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, le Reba tla an thi. Midang tla tampi an that ih Beor fapa Balaam khal nam in an that."},"9":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Israel mi pawl cun Midian nunau le nauhak pawl cu an kai ih an caw le an tuu le an ṭilva dang hmuahhmuah le an sumsaw hmuahhmuah tla khal an long ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"An khawpi pawl le an riahbuk pawl khal an ur ṭheh a si."},"11":{"text":"An lonmi thilri hmuahhmuah le ṭilva pawl le ralkaihmi pawl cu,"},"12":{"text":"Jerikho khua in Jordan Tiva khatlam ral, Moab hmunrawnih a ummi Moses, Eleazar le Israel misenpi pawl hnenah cun an fehpi."},"13":{"text":"Moses, Eleazar, le Israel hotu dang pawl hmuahhmuah cu ralkap pawl hmuak dingah an feh.","title":"Ralkap An Kir"},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Moses cu raldonak ihsin a ra kirmi ralbawi thawngkhat hotu le zakhat hotu pawl parah cun a thin a heng ngaingai ih,"},"15":{"text":"“Zianghrangah nunau hmuahhmuah khal nan that lo?"},"16":{"text":"Balaam thu ngai tahratin Peor ah Israel misenpi pawl Bawipa ih hmaiah misual hlawhhlang bangtuk ih a cantertu cu hi nunau pawl hi an si, ti nan thei lo maw? Curuangah a si Bawipa ih minung pawl parih natsia a thlennak kha!"},"17":{"text":"Curuangah mipa pohpoh cu nauhak tiangin that uhla mipa a pawl ciami nunau hmuahhmuah khal that ṭheh uh."},"18":{"text":"Asinain fala pawl le mipa a pawl hrih lomi nunau hmuahhmuah cu nanmah ih hrangah zuah uh."},"19":{"text":"Cule mi a thattu le miruak a thamtu hmuahhmuah cu ni sarih sung riahhmun lengah nan um ding. Ni thumnak ni le ni sarihnak ni ah nanmah pawl thianghlimter aw uhla nan kaihmi nunau pawl khal thianghlimter uh."},"20":{"text":"Hnipuan siseh, savun in tuahmi thil siseh, mehmul le zanthing in tuahmi thil siseh, pakhat hman hrelh loin nan thiangfaiter ṭheh pei,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cule puithiam Eleazar in raldonak ihsin a rami ralkap pawl hnenah, “ Bawipa in Moses hnenih thu a pekmi cu hi pawl hi an si."},"22":{"text":"Meisa in a kangciam thei lomi sui, ngun, dar, thir, rangva, le suan pawl hmuahhmuah cu,"},"23":{"text":"meisa in nan huul pei ih cuticun nan thianfaiter pei. A dang hmuahhmuah cu thianfainak tidai in nan kholhfai thluh pei."},"24":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ah nan hnipuan nan sawp thluh pei. Cuticun nan thiangfai pei ih riahhmun sungah luhter nan si pei,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Thil Lonmi An Zem"},"26":{"text":"“Nangmah le Eleazar le misenpi hotu pawl thawn an lonmi thilri, ṭilva, le an kaihmi minung cu siar thluh uh."},"27":{"text":"Cule bangrep in ṭhen hnih ah ṭhen uh. Ṭhen khat cu ral a dotu pawl hrangah a si pei ih a dang ṭhen khat cu Israel misenpi hrangah a si pei."},"28":{"text":"Ralkap pawl ih co dingmi sungin ralkaihmi zanga ah pakhat cu Bawipa hrangih siah ah nan lak pei. Caw, laak, tuu, le me tla cuvek thotho in nan lak pei ih,"},"29":{"text":"Bawipa ih ta dingah Eleazar hnenah nan pek pei."},"30":{"text":"Cule misenpi pawl ih co dingmi sungin ralkaihmi sawmnga ah pakhat cu siah ah la awla, caw, laak, tuu, le me khal cuvek thotho in na lak pei. Cule Bawipa ih Puanthlam kilvengtu Levi mi pawl hnenah na pek pei,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa ih tivek cun Moses le Eleazar in an tuah ṭheh."},"32":{"text":"A tanglam pawl cu ralkap pawl in anmah hrangih an retmi hlei ih an lakmi le an kaihmi pawl an si: tuu thawng zaruk thawng sawmsarih le thawng nga, caw thawng sawmsarih le thawng hnih, laak thawng sawmruk le thawng khat, le falahim thawng sawmthum le thawng hnih.","merge":"33"},"36":{"text":"Hi sungin a hrek ralkap pawl ih an co mi cu: tuu thawng zathum thawng sawmthum thawng sarih le zanga an si ih, Bawipa hnenih pekmi siah ah zaruk sawm sarih le panga; caw thawng sawmthum le thawng ruk a si ih, Bawipa hnenih pekmi siah ah sawm sarih le pahnih an pe; laak thawng sawmthum le zanga a si ih, Bawipa hnenih pekmi siah ah sawmruk le pakhat an pe; cule falahim thawng hleiruk an si ih Bawipa hnenih pekmi siah ah sawmthum le pahnih an pe.","merge":"37"},"41":{"text":"Cun Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in Bawipa ih siah cu Moses in Eleazar hnenah a pek."},"42":{"text":"Cun Israel misenpi ih covo cu: tuu thawng zathum thawng sawmthum le thawng sarih le zanga, caw thawng sawmthum le thawngruk, laak thawng sawmthum le zanga, le falahim thawnghleiruk an si.","merge":"43"},"47":{"text":"Hi sungin Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in minung siseh, ṭilva siseh, sawmnga ah pakhat cu Moses in a lak ih Bawipa ih Puanthlam kilvengtu Levi mi pawl hnenah a pek."},"48":{"text":"Cule ralkap pawl hotu ralbawi pawl cu Moses hnenah an feh ih,"},"49":{"text":"Moses hnenah cun, “Bawipa, kan homi kan ralkap pawl cu kan siar thluh ih an kim ṭheh a si."},"50":{"text":"Curuangah kan lak ciarmi sui hlawnthil, baannaal pawl, faute pawl, zunghruk pawl, hnakhai pawl, le ṭhi pawl kan rak keng a si. In tlennak dingah hi hlawnthil pawl hi Bawipa ih hnenah kan nunnak aiah kan pek a si,” an ti."},"51":{"text":"Cutikah Moses le Eleazar in an rak kenmi sui hlawnthil pawl cu an rak sang."},"52":{"text":"Ralbawi pawl ih pekmi sui hlawnthil cu azate in cuai za le cuai hra leng lo a rit."},"53":{"text":"Ralbawi a si lomi pawl cun an lak mi hlawnthil cu anmah ih hrang ciarah an ret."},"54":{"text":"Moses le Eleazar in Bawipa ih Israel mi pawl a humnak dingah sui hlawnthil pawl cu Puanthlam sungah an ret."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Reuben le Gad hrin pawl cu ṭilva tampi an nei. An ṭilva hrangah Jazer le Gilead ram pawl cu ramṭha an si kha an hmuh tikah,","title":"Jordan Ih Nisuahnak Lam Ummi Pawl (Daan 3.12-22)"},"2":{"text":"Moses le puithiam Eleazar le Israel hruaitu pawl hnenah an ra ih,"},"3":{"text":"“Hi ram sung um Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, le Beon khua pawl,"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa bomnak ih Israel mi pawl in kan luahmi khua pawl hi ṭilva hrangah ram ṭhazet an si. Kannih le ṭilva tamzet nei kan si fawn."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah in zaangfah uhla hi ram hi kan co dingah in zem hram uh. Jordan Tiva khatlam ralih um dingah Jordan Tiva cu in tanter hram hlah uh,” tiah an dil."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Moses in Gad le Reuben hrin pawl hnenah cun, “Nan unau Israel mi pawl raldo dingih an feh laiah nannih pawl hitawk ah maw a um nan tum?"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih a pekmi ram sungih lut lo le Jordan Tiva tan lo dingin ziangtinso Israel mi pawl cu an thin nan nauter ngam?"},"8":{"text":"Atuih nan tuahmi vekin nan pa le pawl in hi ram thlingthla dingih Kadesh Barnea in ka thlah hai tikah an rak tuah zo."},"9":{"text":"Annih in Eshkol Phairawn tiang an feh ih ram cu an ra zoh. Asinain an kir tikah Bawipa ih a pekmi ramih feh tum loin Israel mi pawl ih thinlung cu an derdaiter thluh a si."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa cu cuih ni ah a thin a heng ih,"},"11":{"text":"‘Ka parih rinsannak an neih lo ruangah Izipt ram ihsin a suakmi sungin kum kul le a tlunlam mipa hmuahhmuah cu Abraham, Isaak le Jakob hnenih ka tiam ciami Kanaan ramah zohman an thleng hrimhrim lo ding,’ tiah siatcam in thu a kam zo a si."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih rinsannak a neitu Keniz mi Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb le Nun ih fapa Joshua siar lo, midang hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih camsiatmi sungah an tel ṭheh a si."},"13":{"text":"Israel misenpi parah Bawipa cu a thin a heng ih Bawipa a lungawi lotertu pawl an thih thluh hlanlo kum sawmli sung thlaler ramṭhing lakah vakvai in a tuah hai a si."},"14":{"text":"Cule atu-ah nannih santhar misualral pawl, Israel mi parah tuar ding ṭha lo Pathian ih thinhengnak thlengter sal dingin nan pupa pawl ih can-ai nan awh ve a sihi!"},"15":{"text":"Nannih Reuben le Gad hrin pawl, atu-ah Bawipa ih dungthlun nan duh lo ngaingai a si ahcun hi Israel misenpi pawl hi Bawipa in hramlakah hin a dungtun lala hai ding ih siatsuah thluh an si ding ih nanmah hi mi siatsuahtu nan si ding,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah annih in Moses cu an dil sal ih, “Kan tuu pawl hrangah lungto in hruang kan kulh pei ih kan fanau pawl hrangah kulhmi khawpi pawl kan din hmaisa pei."},"17":{"text":"Cuih hnuah kan unau Israel mi pawl thawn raldo tlang dingah kan timtuah pei ih an luah ding ram kan lak thluh hlanlo kanmah ih hmaihruai vekin kan ral pawl cu kan do pei. Cutiih kan do sungah kan fanau pawl hitawk kulhmi khawpi sungah an rak um pei ih hitawk ramih a rak ummi miphun pawl ih siatsuahnak an tuar lo pei."},"18":{"text":"Israel hrin pawl in an co dingmi ram an luah thluh hlanlo kan ram le kan khua ah kan kir lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Hitawk Jordan Tiva ih nisuahnak lamah hin kan covo kan ngah zo ruangah Jordan khatlam ralah kannih in zianghman Israel hrin dangdang pawl lakah covo kan la lo ding,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule Moses in an hnenah, “Nan simmi hi nan thinlung ngaingai a si ahcun atu ihsin Bawipa ih mithmuh ah raldo dingin nan tim tuah uh."},"21":{"text":"Nan ralkap zatein pakhat hman hrelh loin Jordan Tiva nan tan pei ih Bawipa ih ho in ral cu nan do pei. Bawipa in kan ral a neh thluh hlanlo le,"},"22":{"text":"ram a lak ṭheh hlanlo nan do pei. Cuih hnu Bawipa ih hnenah le nan unau Israel mi pawl ih parah nan ṭuanvo nan ṭheh hnu lawngah nan kir thei ding. Cuticun Jordan Tiva in nisuahnak lam hitawk ram hi Bawipa in nan ta dingah a hngetter ding."},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nan thutiammi nan thlun lo a si ahcun, atu ihsin thei cia uh, Bawipa ih parah misual nan si ding. Kan theih ual lo, tiah ti leh hlah uh. Nan sualnak in a lo hawl suak thotho ding a si."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah nan khawpi pawl cu din uhla nan tuu pawl hrangah hruang cu kulh uh. Cun nan kam awk vekin tuah suak rori uh,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cule Gad le Reuben hrin pawl cun, “Bawipa, na thupekmi vekin kan tuah pei."},"26":{"text":"Kan nupi le kan faate pawl le kan caw le kan tuu pawl cu hitawk Gilead ram khawpi pawl ah hin an rak um ko pei."},"27":{"text":"A dang hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih ho in raldo dingah kan timtuah thluh a si. Na ti bangtuk in Jordan Tiva cu kan tan ding ih ral kan do ding,” tiah Moses cu an ti."},"28":{"text":"Curuangah Moses in Eleazar, Joshua, le Israel hruaitu dang pawl hnenah cun thu a pek ih,"},"29":{"text":"“Gad le Reuben hrin pawl in Jordan Tiva an tan ih Bawipa ih ho in raldo dingah an feh ih, anmah ih bomnak in ram cu nan neh ṭheh a si ahcun an co dingah Gilead ram cu pek uh."},"30":{"text":"Sikhalsehla annih in Jordan Tiva an tan loih nanmah hnenah ral an do lo a si ahcun nanmah vek thotho in Kanaan ramah an covo cu an ngah ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah Gad le Reuben hrin pawl cun Moses hnenah, “ Bawipa Pathian ih thupekmi bangtuk in kan tuah ding."},"32":{"text":"Amah ih hmaiah hriamnam thawn Kanaan ram ahcun kan feh ding ih kan do ding; sikhalsehla Jordan Tiva ihsin nisuahnak lam hi ram hi cu kanmah ih covo thotho in a um ding,” an ti."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah Moses in Amor siangpahrang Sihon le Bashan siangpahrang Og pawl ih ram hmuahhmuah cu, a kiangkapih khua le ram pawl thawn, Gad le Reuben hrin pawl le Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl hnenah a pek."},"34":{"text":"Gad hrin pawl in pharih kulhmi Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,"},"35":{"text":"Atroth Shofan, Jazer, Jogbehah,"},"36":{"text":"Beth Nimrah, le Beth Haran khawpi pawl cu an din sal. An tuu hrangah hruang tla an sak."},"37":{"text":"Cule Reuben hrin pawl in Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,"},"38":{"text":"Nebo, Baal Meon (hi khua hmin cu an thleng), le Sibmah khawpi pawl cu an din sal. An din salmi khawpi pawl cu hmin thar an pek thluh."},"39":{"text":"Cun Manasseh fapa Makhir hrin pawl in Gilead ram an do ih an luah hnuah cuih ramih a ummi Amor mi pawl cu an dawihlo."},"40":{"text":"Curuangah Moses in Gilead ram cu Makhir hrin pawl hnenah a pek ih cutawkah an um."},"41":{"text":"Manasseh hrin Jair in khawte pawl a do ih a lak hnuah Jair Khawte pawl tiah hmin an pek."},"42":{"text":"Nobah khal in Kenath khua a do ih a kiangkap khawte pawl thawn a lak ih amah ih hmin suangin Nobah tiah hmin a sak."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Izipt ram in an suak ih Moses le Aaron ho in an riahnak hmunih hmin pawl cu a tanglam pawl hi an si.","title":"Izipt In Moab Tiang"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in Moses in an riahhmun pawl ih hmin cu a sangsang in a ngan."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Izipt ram in an suah kum, thla hmaisa bik ni hleinga ni a hmaisa bik Lantak Puai ih thaisun ah Izipt ram ihsin an suak. Bawipa ih humhimnak in Rameses khawpi in an pok."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih thahmi an fapa upa bik pawl an phum ih a buai rerotu Izipt misenpi ih hmuhhnganah Israel mi pawl cu an suak luilo. Hi bangtuk a si ruangah Bawipa cu Izipt ih khawzing pawl hnakin a cak sawn ticu Bawipa Amah in fiangtein a langter a si."},"5":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Rameses in an suak ih Sukkoth ah riahhmun an tuah."},"6":{"text":"Sukkoth in an suak ih hramlak nelrawn kiangih ummi Etham ah riahhmun an tuah."},"7":{"text":"Etham in an suak ih Baal Zefon in nisuahnak lamih ummi Pi Hahiroth lamah an kir ih Migdol kiangah riahhmun an tuah."},"8":{"text":"Pi Hahiroth in an suak ih Tipi Sen an tan hnuah Etham nelrawn ramṭhing an thleng. Cuih nelrawn ramṭhing ah ni thum sung an feh ih Marah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"9":{"text":"Marah in an suak ih Elim ah riahhmun an tuah. Elim ah cerhti hmun hleihnih a um ih ṭhulhfau kung sawmsarih khal a um."},"10":{"text":"Elim in an suak ih Tipi Sen tikel kiangah riahhmun an tuah."},"11":{"text":"Cutawk in an suak ih Sin nelrawn ramṭhing ah riahhmun an tuah."},"12":{"text":"Sin nelrawn ramṭhing in an suak ih Dofkah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"13":{"text":"Dofkah in an suak ih Alush ah riahhmun an tuah."},"14":{"text":"Alush in an suak in Refidim ah riahhmun an tuah. Refidim ahcun misenpi hrangah tidai in ding a um lo."},"15":{"text":"Refidim in an suak ih Sinai nelrawn ramṭhing ah riahhmun an tuah."},"16":{"text":"Sinai nelrawn ramṭhing in an suak ih Kibroth Hattaavah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"17":{"text":"Kibroth Hattaavah in an suak ih Hazeroth ah riahhmun an tuah."},"18":{"text":"Hazeroth in an suak ih Rithmah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"19":{"text":"Rithmah in an suak ih Rimmon Perez ah riahhmun an tuah."},"20":{"text":"Rimmon Perez in an suak ih Libnah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"21":{"text":"Libnah in an suak ih Rissah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"22":{"text":"Rissah in an suak ih Kehelathah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"23":{"text":"Kehelathah in an suak ih Shefer Tlang ah riahhmun an tuah."},"24":{"text":"Shefer Tlang in an suak ih Haradah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"25":{"text":"Haradah in an suak ih Makheloth ah riahhmun an tuah."},"26":{"text":"Makheloth in an suak ih Tahath ah riahhmun an tuah."},"27":{"text":"Tahath in an suak ih Terah ah ruahhmun an tuah."},"28":{"text":"Terah in an suak ih Mithkah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"29":{"text":"Mithkah in an suak ih Hashmonah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"30":{"text":"Hashmonah in an suak ih Moseroth ah riahhmun an tuah."},"31":{"text":"Moseroth in an suak ih Bene Jaakan ah riahhmun an tuah."},"32":{"text":"Bene Jaakan in an suak ih Hor Haggidgad ah riahhmun an tuah."},"33":{"text":"Hor Haggidgad in an suak ih Jotbathah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"34":{"text":"Jotbathah in an suak ih Abronah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"35":{"text":"Abronah in an suak ih Ezion Geber ah riahhmun an tuah."},"36":{"text":"Ezion Geber in an suak ih Zin nelrawn ramṭhingah riahhmun an tuah. (Zin cu Kadesh ti a si.)"},"37":{"text":"Zin nelrawn ramṭhing in an suak ih Edom ram kiangte Hor Tlang ah riahhmun an tuah."},"38":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in puithiam Aaron cu Hor Tlang ah a kai ih Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl an suahnak kum sawmli kum, thla nganak ni hmaisa bik ni ah a thi."},"39":{"text":"Aaron cu a kum za le kul hluanthum a ti ah Hor Tlangah cun a thi a si."},"40":{"text":"Cun Thlanglam Kanaan ramih a ummi siangpahrang Arad in Israel mi pawl an ra ti kha a thei."},"41":{"text":"Hor tlang in an suak ih Zalmonah ah riahhmun an tuah."},"42":{"text":"Zalmonah in an suak ih Punon ah riahhmun an tuah."},"43":{"text":"Punon in an suak ih Oboth ah riahhmun an tuah."},"44":{"text":"Oboth in an suak ih Moab ram Iye Abarim ah riahhmun an tuah."},"45":{"text":"Iye Abarim in an suak ih Dibon Gad ah riahhmun an tuah."},"46":{"text":"Dibon Gad in an suak ih Almon Diblathaim ah riahhmun an tuah."},"47":{"text":"Almon Diblathaim in an suak ih Nebo Tlang kiang Abarim Tlang ah riahhmun an tuah."},"48":{"text":"Abarim Tlang in an suak ih Beth Jeshimoth le Akasia Phairawn karlak,"},"49":{"text":"Jerikho zawn Jordan Tiva ral, Moab hmunrawn ah riahhmun an tuah."},"50":{"text":"Jerikho khua zawn Jordan Tiva khatlam ral, Moab hmunrawn ahcun Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Jordan Tan Hlan An Thlun Ding Thupekmi"},"51":{"text":"Israel mi pawl hrangah daan a pek: “Jordan Tiva nan tan ih Kanaan ram nan luh tikah,"},"52":{"text":"ram sungih a ummi miphun pawl cu nan dawi thluh hai ding. Lungto in siseh, thir in siseh, milem an tuahmi hmuahhmuah le an khuavang biaknak pawl hmuahhmuah cu nan siatsuah thluh pei."},"53":{"text":"An ram cu nan luah pei ih cunah nan um pei. Ziangahtile nan umnak dingah ka lo pe zo a si."},"54":{"text":"Kanaan ram cu nan hnam le nan hrin sungah camcawhfung zukin nan zem aw pei ih, hrin tam deuh pawl cu ram tum deuh, hrin mal deuh pawl cu ram fate deuh, tiin nan zem pei. Camcawhfung zukin an zemmi ram cu a zuktu in a co tata ding."},"55":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ram sungih a rak ummi pawl nan dawisuak hai lo a si ahcun nan lakih a taangmi pawl cu nan hrangah mit sungih hnawm bangtuk le nan hnak sungih misuntu hling bangtuk in hnaihnoktu le harnak a lo petu an si ding ih nan umnak kipah a lo do ringringtu an si ding."},"56":{"text":"Nan dawisuak lo a si ahcun anmah siatsuah thluh ding ka tum vekin nanmah khal ka lo siatsuah thluh hai ding a si,” a ti."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah","title":"An Ram Ih Ramri"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi pawl hrangah a tanglam thu pawl cu a pek: “Kanaan ram nan luh tikah nan ramih ramri pawl cu a tanglam bangtuk in a si ding."},"3":{"text":"Thlanglam nan ramri cu Zin nelrawn in a thok pei ih Edom ramri in a feh ding. Tipi Thi thlanglam kap nisuahnak lam a thleng ding."},"4":{"text":"Cun Akrabbim Tlangkawn lamah a vung suk pei ih Zin in a feh ding ih Kadesh Barnea tiang thlanglam ah a vung ding. Cule saklam nitlaknak lamah Hazar Addar ah a so ding ih Azmon tiang a feh ding."},"5":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin Izipt ramri tiva lamah a her-aw ding ih Mediterranean Tifinriat ah a net ding."},"6":{"text":"“Nitlaklam ramri cu Mediterranean Tifinriat a si ding."},"7":{"text":"“Saklam ramri cu Mediterranean in Hor Tlang tiang a feh pei ih,"},"8":{"text":"cutawk ihsin Hamath Tlangkawn tiang a feh pei. Cule Zedad le,"},"9":{"text":"Zifron tiang a feh pei ih Hazar Enan ah a net ding."},"10":{"text":"“Cun nisuahlam ramri cu Hazar Enan in Shefam tiang dingtein a feh ding."},"11":{"text":"Cuih hnu ah Ain in nisuahnak lamih a ummi Harbel ah a vung suk ding ih cutawk in Galilee Tili nisuahnak lam kamih tlang ah a vung ding ih,"},"12":{"text":"Jordan Tiva thlun in thlanglam ah Tipi Thi tiang a suk ding. Himi pawl cu nan ram kimvelih ramri an si ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Moses in Israel mi pawl hnenah, “Hi ram cu Bawipa in nanmah hrin hrin kua le a hrek pawl hnenih a lo pekmi ram a si ih camcawhfung zukin nan co dingmi ram a si."},"14":{"text":"Reuben le Gad hrin pawl le Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl cu,"},"15":{"text":"Jordan Tiva ih nisuahnak lam Jerikho khatlam ralah an innsang ciarin ram an zem-aw zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Ram Zem Ding Hotu pawl"},"17":{"text":"“Puithiam Eleazar le Nun ih fapa Joshua in ram zem-awk cu ṭuanvo an lak ding."},"18":{"text":"Cule anmah bawmtu dingah hrin khat in hotu pakhat fingfing hril awla,"},"19":{"text":"a tanglam bangtuk in la aw: Judah hrin in Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb,"},"20":{"text":"Simeon hrin in Ammihud ih fapa Shelumiel,"},"21":{"text":"Benjamin hrin in Khislon ih fapa Elidad,"},"22":{"text":"Dan hrin in Jogli ih fapa Bukki,"},"23":{"text":"Josef tefa Manasseh hrin in Efod ih fapa Hanniel,"},"24":{"text":"Efraim hrin in Shiftan ih fapa Kemuel."},"25":{"text":"Zebulun hrin in Parnak ih fapa Elizafan,"},"26":{"text":"Issakhar hrin in Azzan ih fapa Paltiel,"},"27":{"text":"Asher hrin in Shelomi ih fapa Ahihud,"},"28":{"text":"Naftali hrin in Ammihud ih fapa Pedahel,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Hi hotu pawl cu Kanaan ram ah Israel mi pawl hrangih ram zemtu dingah Bawipa ih fialmi an si."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerikho khua zawn Jordan Tiva khatlam ral, Moab hmunrawn ah Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Levi Mi Pawl Hnenih Pekmi Khawpi Pawl"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl sim awla an comi ram sung ihsin Levi mi pawl umnak ah khawpi pawl le khawpi kiangah ṭilva tlannak ram pawl an pek pei."},"3":{"text":"Hi khawpi pawl cu Levi mi pawl comi an si pei ih cutawkah an um pei. A kiangkap cu an caw le an ṭilva dangdang pawl hrangah a si pei."},"4":{"text":"An khua kiang ṭilva tlannak ram cu khua phardawl ihsin tah in pi thawngkhat le zanga in a thok ding ih khua vuakvel ah a um ding."},"5":{"text":"Cun ṭilva tlannak ram cu an khua ihsin pi thawng thum a kau pei ih khua vuakvel ah a um ding ih a laifangah khawpi cu a um ding."},"6":{"text":"Levi mi pawl hnenah rolnak khawpi paruk nan pek pei ih mi pakhatkhat in lai a thah pang tikih a rolnak dingah a si pei. Hi hlei ah a dang khawpi sawmli le pahnih pek uhla,"},"7":{"text":"a zatein an tlangram pawl thawn khawpi sawmli le pariat an si ding."},"8":{"text":"An hrin ram ciar sungih Levi mi pawl ih khawpi zat ding cu an ram tum le fatet thu-in zoh a si pei,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenah,","title":"Rolnak Khawpi Pawl (Daan 19.1-3 ; Jos 20.1-9)"},"10":{"text":"Israel mi pawl sim dingin thu a pek ih, “Jordan Tiva nan tan ih Kanaan ram nan luh tikah,"},"11":{"text":"mi pakhat in milai a thah pang tikih a rolnak dingah khawpi pawl nan hril pei."},"12":{"text":"Cutawk ah a rol pei ih a thahmi sungkhat pawl in phuhlam an duh khalle a him ding. Mithah an puhmi pa cu misenpi hmaiih a thu an relcat hlan ahcun an that lo pei."},"13":{"text":"Khawpi paruk hril uh:"},"14":{"text":"Jordan Tiva in nisuahnak lamah khawpi pathum, Kanaan ramah khawpi pathum nan hril pei."},"15":{"text":"Hi khawpi pawl cu Israel mi siseh, hrin dangmi a laangte ih a ummi, a si lole reipi a ummi siseh, milai an thah pang tikah an rolnak khawpi an si pei."},"16":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla mi pakhat in thir hriamhrei hmang tahrat in mi a thah a si ahcun laithat a si ruangah amah cu thah a si ve pei."},"17":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat in lungto hmang tahrat in mi a thah a si ahcun laithat a si ruangah amah cu thah a si ve pei."},"18":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat in thingtan lak tahrat in mi a thah a si ahcun laithat a si ruangah amah cu thah a si ve pei."},"19":{"text":"A thahmi pa ih sungkhat nai bik in laithat pa cu a that ve ding. A hmuh tik pohah a that pei."},"20":{"text":"“Mi pakhat in midang pakhat cu a hua ih khaam ah a tuul thlak, a si lole a bawh ih ziangin maw a deng,"},"21":{"text":"a si lole a kuttum in a thong ih a thih a si ahcun laithat a si ruangah amah cu thah a si pei. A thah mi-ih sungkhat nai bik in laithat pa cu a that ve ding. A hmuh tik pohah a that pei."},"22":{"text":"“Mi pakhat in a huatmi a si lo naón midang pakhat a tuul thlak pang, a si lole bawh loin ziangin simaw a deng pangih a thi;"},"23":{"text":"a si lole ṭhatein zohta loin mi pakhat in lungto a deng ih tumhrim si lo, a ral khal a si lo naón midang pakhat a deng that pang a si ahcun,"},"24":{"text":"misenpi pawl in a thu an ṭhen sak tikah a thi mi-ih sungkhat, phulak tumtu ṭan loin mi a that pangtu ṭan in a thu cu an rel pei."},"25":{"text":"Misenpi pawl in laithat an puhmi pa cu phulak a duhtu, a thi mi pa-ih sungkhat pawl hnen ihsin nan humsuak pei ih a rak rolnak khua ahcun nan kuat sal pei. Mi a thah laiih Puithiam Sang a ṭuantu a thih hlanlo cu cutawk khua ah a um pei."},"26":{"text":"Laithat pa cu a rolnak khua in a suak ih,"},"27":{"text":"a thah mi ih sungkhat in an hmu ih an thah a si ahcun himi cu phuhlam a si ruangah laithat a si lo."},"28":{"text":"Laithat pa cu rolnak khawpi ah Puithiam Sang a nun sung hmuahhmuah cu a um pei. Puithiam Sang a thih hnuah cun a inn ah a kir thei pei."},"29":{"text":"Hi daan pawl cu nanmah le nan tesinfa pawl in khuitawkih nan um khal asile nan thlun dingmi a si."},"30":{"text":"“Laithah an puhmi pa cu thutheitu pahnih maw, pahnih hnakih tam maw an um lawngah laithat tiin thah theih a si pei. Thutheitu pakhat ih theihnak lawng cu laithat ti dingah a kim lo."},"31":{"text":"Laithat cu thah a si pei. Thahnak in luat dingah paisa in a tlen-aw thei lo pei."},"32":{"text":"Rolnak khawpiih a rol zomi pa cu Puithiam Sang a thih hlan ahcun a khua ah kir sal dingah tlennak paisa a pek khalle nan sang lo pei."},"33":{"text":"Nan kirter asile nan umnak nan ram cu nan ti borhhlawh a si. Laithahnak in ram cu nan borhhlawhter ih mi pakhatkhat an thahnak ram thianter dingah laithat pa an thah ve dah ti lo ahcun sualthlah thiannak dang zianghman a um lo."},"34":{"text":"Nan umnak ram cu borhhlawhter hlah uh, ziangahtile keimah hi Bawipa ka si ih Israel mi lakah ka um a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josef ih fapa Manasseh ih fapa Makhir ih fapa Gilead hrin pawl innsang fingfingih hotu ciar cu Moses le a dang hruaitu pawl hnenah an feh ih,"},"2":{"text":"an hnenah, “ Bawipa in hi ram cu Israel mi hnen ah camcawhfung zukin zem dingah thu a lo pek a si. Cuih tlunah kan unau Zelofehad ih ram cu a fanu pawl hnenih pek dingah thu a lo pek fawn a si."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a fanu pawl in Israel miphun sungih hrin dangmi an pasal ahcun an ram cu cute hrinih ta ah a cang dingih kannih kan zate ih kan ngahmi ram cu a fiak vivo ding a si."},"4":{"text":"Thilri le leiram zuar ciami hmuahhmuah a rak nei hmaisatu hnenih khirh sal kum a ra thlen hmanah Zelofehad fanu pawl ih ram cu a kumkhua in an pasal pawl hrinih leiram a si tata ding ih kannih hrin hrangah cun kan sung ngaingai ding a si,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Moses in Israel mi hnenah Bawipa ih fial bangtuk in thu a pek: “Josef hrin hotu pawl ih an simmi thu hi thudik a si."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa ih thupekmi cu hi bangtuk in a si: Zelofehad fanu pawl cun an duhmi zokhal an pasal thei ding. Asinain anmah ih hrin sungmi lawng an si pei."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi kip in an ram neihmi cu anmah ih hrin lengah an fehter lo pei."},"8":{"text":"Israel miphun sungah nunau in ram a neih a si ahcun amah ih hrin sung lawngah pasal a nei pei. Cuticun Israel mi kipin an pupa ih ram cu an co thei pei ih,"},"9":{"text":"leiram cu hrin khat in hrin khatah a feh lo pei. An hrin tinin an leiram ciar cu an co ringring pei,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Zelofehad ih fanu pawl cun Bawipa in Moses hnenih thu a pek bangtuk in an tuah."},"11":{"text":"Zelofehad fanu Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah, le Noah pawl cun an pa-ih unau sungkhat ih fapa pawl an pasal a si."},"12":{"text":"Josef fapa Manasseh hrin sungmi mipa pawl an pasal ih an ram cu an pa ih hrin sungah a um ringring."},"13":{"text":"Hi daan pawl le thupekmi pawl cu Jerikho khua zawn, Jordan Tiva ral Moab hmunrawn ah Bawipa in Israel mi hrangah Moses hnenih a pekmi an si."}}}}},"5":{"info":{"name":"Daan Peksalnak","shortname":"Daan","abbr":[],"desc":"Daan peksalnak (deuteronomy)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu hi Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lam nelrawnih an um laiah Moses in Israel mi hnenih a simmi thu tla an si. Israel mi pawl cu Jordan phairawn Suf khua kiangah an um; Paran khua cu cutawk ihsin khatlam ah a um ih, Tofel, Laban, Hazeroth le Dizahab khua pawl cu khatlam ralden ah an um.","title":"Thu Hramthawhnak"},"2":{"text":"Sinai tlang in Kadesh Barnea cu Edom tlangpar lamzin in ni hleikhat feh a si."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Izipt ram in an suah hnu kum sawmli kum, thla hleikhat thla, ni khat ni ah Bawipa in sim dingih thu a pekmi hmuahhmuah cu Moses in misenpi hnenah a sim."},"4":{"text":"Cumi cu Heshbon khawsungih a ummi Amor siangpahrang Sihon, le Ashtaroth le Edrei khawpiih a ummi Bashan siangpahrang Og pawl a neh hnuah a simmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Jordan in nisuahnak lam Moab ram sungih an um laiah Moses in Bawipa ih pekmi daan pawl le thuzirhmi pawl cu a simfiang."},"6":{"text":"Moses in, “Sinai Tlangih kan rak um laiah khan, Bawipa kan Pathian in ka hnenah ‘Hi Tlangah reipi nan um zo a si."},"7":{"text":"Pok uhla feh uh; Amor tlangpar ram le a kiangkapih ram hmuahhmuah ah - Jordan phairawn, tlangpar ram le hmunrawn ram, thlanglam ram le Maditerranean tifinriat tiangin feh uh. Cule Kanaan ram le Lebanon Tlang lan in Eufrates tivapi tiang feh uh."},"8":{"text":"Zohhnik uh, hi ram pawl cu Bawipa Keimah in nan pupa Abraham, Isaak le Jakob hnenah le an tesinfa hnen tiangin pek dingah ka kam ciami a si,’ in ti,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Moses in, “Culai ah khan nan hnenah, ‘Nanmah misenpi hruai hi ka hrangah thilrit tuk a si. Keimah pakhat lawng cun ka daih-aw cawk lo.","title":"Moses In Thuṭhentu Pawl A Ret (Suah 18.13-27)"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian in a lo zaiter hai ih atu ahcun vanih arsi zat nan si."},"11":{"text":"Nan pupa pawl ih Pathian Bawipa cun a lo tiam hai bangtuk in a let thawngkhat in lo pungzaiter in lo ṭhangsoter hram seh!"},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ziangtinso keimah pakhat lawng cun nan tawh awknak le nan thubuai pawl cu ka phurh cawk ding?"},"13":{"text":"Curuangah nanmah nan hrin ciar sungin mifim, rinsantlak le thilti thei pawl hril uhla nanmah hotu-ah ka ret hai ding,’ tiah ka rak ti."},"14":{"text":"Thil ṭha a si ngai, nan ti ih nan lung a kim."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah nanmah nan hrin sung ciar ihsin nan hrilmi mifim le rinsantlak pawl cu nanmah hotu-ah ka ret hai a si. Mi hrekkhat cu thawngkhat hotu, mi hrekkhat cu zakhat hotu, a hrekkhat cu sawmnga hotu, a hrekkhat cu pahra hotu an si. Nan hrin sung ciarah hotu dangdang khal ka ret."},"16":{"text":"“Culai ahcun an hnenah, ‘Nan minung pawl hnenin thubuai a rami cu ṭhatein ngaihsak uhla nan minung pawl ih thu a si ah siseh, nan lakih a um miphun dang pawl ih thu a si khalle diktein rel sak uh."},"17":{"text":"Thu nan relcat tikah ṭanbul nei hlah uh. Zovek milai an si hmanah thleidannak nei loin an thu umdaan vekin rel uh. Zohman ṭih hlah uh. Ziangahtile nan thurelcatnak cu Pathian hnenin a rami a si. Thu pakhatkhat cu nan hrangah relcat dingih a har tuk a si ahcun ka hnenah ratpi uhla keimah in ka relcat ding,’ tiah ka sim hai."},"18":{"text":"Cuih tlunah nanmah pawl khal thil nan ti ding daan hmuahhmuah kimtein ka lo sim a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Moses in, “ Bawipa kan Pathian ih thupekmi cu kan tuah. Sinai tlang in kan suak ih kha tluk a kau-mi le ṭihnungza nelrawn lakin kan vak ih Amor tlangpar ram lamah kan feh. Kadesh Barnea kan thlen tikah,","title":"Kadesh Barnea Ah Thlingthlatu (Mipum 13.1-33)"},"20":{"text":"nan hnenah, ‘ Bawipa kan Pathian ih in pek dingmi ram, Amor tlangpar ram cu nan thleng zo."},"21":{"text":"Zohhnik uh, nan pupa pawl ih Pathian Bawipa in a lo pekmi cu hi ram hi a si. Amah ih thupeknak bangtuk in feh uhla hi ram cu luah uh. Zohman ṭih hlah uh. Nan thin khal nau hlah uh,’ tiah ka rak lo ti."},"22":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla ka hnenah nan ra ih, ‘Hi ram thlingthlatu dingah le fehnak lamzin zohtu dingah le ziangvek khawpi tla an um tiih zohtu dingah thlingthlatu kan thlah hmaisa pei,’ tiah nan ti."},"23":{"text":"“Cumi cu ruahnak ṭha a si ngai lo maw, tiah ka ti ih nan hrin sung ciar in mi pakhat fingfing, an zate ah minung hleihnih ka hril ih,"},"24":{"text":"an feh ih tlangpar ram cu Eshkhol phairawn tiang an hung zoh a si."},"25":{"text":"An zohmi ramih thingrah khal an lo ih in run sum. Bawipa kan Pathian ih in pek dingmi ram cu ramṭha ngaingai a si, tiah in rung sim."},"26":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla Bawipa nan Pathian ih thupekmi cu nan el ih cuih ramih luh cu nan duh lo."},"27":{"text":"Nanmah lakah nan phunzai, nan tlokciar ih, ‘ Bawipa in in hua a si; hi Amor mi pawl ih thah thluh dingah Pathian in Izipt ram ihsin in suahpi ih an kutah in thlenter thluh a si."},"28":{"text":"Curuangah ziangah so cuih ram ahcun kan feh ding? Kan ṭih a sisi! Kan thlah mi thlingthlatu pawlin le cutawkih a ummi pawl cu kannih hnakin an tum, an sangdeuh ih an cak deuh fawn, tiah in rung sim zo. Khawpi sung hlir ah an um ih an khawpi kulhnak ralhruang pawl tla cu van a dai a si, in ti. Mikei tiatia milai an um in ti fawn,’ tiah nan ti."},"29":{"text":"“Sihmansehla nan hnenah cun, ‘Himi pawl cu ṭih hlah uh."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian in a lo hruai ding ih Izipt ram le,"},"31":{"text":"nelrawn ramcaar sungih thil a tuah zo vekin nanmah ih ai-ah nan ral cu a do ding a si. A pa in a fapa a cawi ṭheu bangin nan lamzin tluanah a lo cawi ih hitawk tiang a lo thlenpi zo a sisi,’ ka lo ti."},"32":{"text":"Cutluk in ka lo sim zo naón nannih cun,"},"33":{"text":"nan hmaiah a rak fehtu le nan riah hmun tiangin a rak lo hawl sak ih nan lamzin hmuh dingah zan ah meitleu in, sun ah mero in, nan hmaiah a feh ringringtu Bawipa cu nan rinsan thotho lo."},"34":{"text":"“ Bawipa in nan phunzai ringringmi a theih tikah a thin a heng ih,","title":"Pathian In Israel Mi a Hrem (Mipum 14.20-45)"},"35":{"text":"‘Hi san misual pawl nannih cu nan pupa hnenih ka tiam ciami ram ṭha ahcun zohman nan lut lo ding."},"36":{"text":"Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb lawng a lut ding. Kaleb cun keimah i rinsan ruangah a hung zohmi ram cu amah le a tesinfa hnenah ka pek ding,’ tiah siatcam in a ti."},"37":{"text":"Nanmah ih ruangah Bawipa cu ka parah a thin a heng ih, ‘Moses, nangmah tiang hman in Kanaan ram na thleng lo ding."},"38":{"text":"A lo bawmtu Nun ih fapa Joshua cu a thleng ding. Curuangah Joshua cu tha pe aw; Israel mi pawl cu amah in a hruai pei ih Kanaan ram cu an luah ding,’ i ti."},"39":{"text":"“Cule Bawipa in ka hnenah, ‘A sia a ṭha a theithiam hrih lomi, ral pawl in an that thluh ding tiih nan timi nan faate pawl lawng an lut ding. An hnenah ram cu ka pe ding ih anmah in an luah ding."},"40":{"text":"Asinain nannih pawl cu kir uhla Tipi Sen lam ihsin nelrawn ah feh uh,’ in ti,” a ti."},"41":{"text":"“Cun nannih in ka hnenah, ‘ Bawipa ih parah kan sual zo a si. Sikhalsehla atu cu Bawipa kan Pathian in thu in pek bangtuk in kan ral cu kan do ding,’ in ti. Cule nan zatein raldo dingah nan tim nan tuah. Tlangpar ram do cu a ol pam ding, tiah nan ruat.","title":"Israel Mi An Sung (Mipum 14.39-45)"},"42":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa in, ‘Doter hai hlah aw. Ziangahtile an hnenah ka um lo ding ih an ral pawl in an neh ding a si,’ tiah ralrinnak i pek."},"43":{"text":"Bawipa ih i simmi cu ka lo sim rero naón zohman in nan ngai duh lo. Bawipa ih thu cu nan el ih puarthau zetin tlangpar ramah cun nan hung feh."},"44":{"text":"Cutikah tlang parih a rak ummi Amor mi pawl cu khuai vekin an suak ih an lo dawi ciamco. Cule Edom tlangpar ram Hormah khua tiang an lo that phah vivo."},"45":{"text":"Curuangah nan ra kir sal tikah Bawipa ih hnenah nan ṭap. Asinain Bawipa cun a lo ngai duh lo ih zianghman ah a lo siar hai lo."},"46":{"text":"Curuangah sokhaw Kadesh ah hitluk reipi nan um cu!"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“A netnak ah Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in kan kir ih Tipi Sen lamin nelrawn ramcaar ahcun kan feh ih Edom tlangpar ramah reipi kan vakvai a si.","title":"Nelrawn Ah Kum Reipi"},"2":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in ka hnenah,"},"3":{"text":"‘Hi tlangpar ramah hin reipi nan vakvai zo ih atu cu saklam ah hung feh thlang uh,’ i ti."},"4":{"text":"A tanglamih daan pawl cu nan hnenih pek dingah i sim: ‘Atu cun nan laicinpi a si vemi Esau ih tesinfa pawl umnak Edom tlangpar ram pal phah in nan feh ding. Annih cun an lo ṭihzet ding;"},"5":{"text":"asinain annih cu do hlah uh. Ziangahtile an ram cu ka lo pe lo ding; ke zaphak tia hman nan co lo ding. Edom ram cu Esau ih tesinfa pawl hnenah ka pe zo a si."},"6":{"text":"Rawl le tidai cu nan ei nan in dingah nan lei thei ding,’ a ti."},"7":{"text":"“ Bawipa nan Pathian cun nan tuahmi ziangtinkim ah a lo thlawsuah a si ti kha cing ringring uh. Hi tluk kaumi nelrawn ramcaar ih nan vahvaih sung hmuahhmuah ah amah in a lo kilkhawi a si. Kum sawmli liangluang nan hnenah a um ringring ih zianghman hlawhsammi nan nei dah lo."},"8":{"text":"“Curuangah Elath khua le Eziongeber khua in a rami Arabah lamzin ihsin kan pial ih Tipi Thi lamah kan feh; cutawk ihsin kan her sal ih saklam Moab ram lamah kan hung feh."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, ‘Lot ih tesinfa Moab mi pawl cu hnaihnawhnak pe hlah uh. A do khal do hlah uh. Ar khawpi cu an hnenah ka pe zo ih an ram cu malte hman nan co ding a um lo a si,’ i ti,” tiah a sim."},"10":{"text":"Ar khawpi-ah cun Emim an timi mikei vekih mi tumzetzet miphun phunkhat an rak um. Emim pawl cu Anakim pawl vekin mi saangzetzet phun an si ve."},"11":{"text":"Anakim pawl cu Refaim ti tla in an ko ih Emim pawl khal Refaim ti tla in an ko a si. Asinain Moab mi cun Emim tiah an ko."},"12":{"text":"Edom ramah Hor mi pawl an rak um naón Israel mi pawl in Bawipa ih a pekmi ram sungih a rak ummi pawl an dawisuak bangtuk in Hor mi pawl cu Esau ih tesinfa pawl in an dawisuak ih an miphun in an ti hloral ih an ram cu an run luahta."},"13":{"text":"“Cun Bawipa ih in fial vekin Zered tiva cu kan tan."},"14":{"text":"Kadesh Barnea in kan suak ih Zered tiva kan tan tiang tikcu cu kum sawmthum le kum riat a rei. Bawipa ih a rak sim cia bangtuk in cuih sungah ral do thei mipa hmuahhmuah cu an zate rori in an thi ṭheh a si."},"15":{"text":"Cupawl cu pakhat hman luat lo tiangih an thih thluh hlan lo Bawipa in a hrem."},"16":{"text":"“Raldo thei mipa hmuahhmuah an thih ṭheh tikah,"},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in,"},"18":{"text":"‘Tuihsun ah Ar khua lamzin in Moab ram cu nan tan phah ding a si."},"19":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Lot ih tesinfa Ammon mi pawl ih ram kiang tiang nan thleng ding. Anmah cu hnaihnok hlah uhla a do khal do hlah uh. Ziangahtile an hnenih ka pek ciami ram cu malte hman nan hnenah ka lo pe lo ding,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cuih ram cu Refaim mi pawl an rak um dah ruangah Refaim ram ti khalin an ko. Asinain Ammon mi pawl cun Zamzummim tiah an ko."},"21":{"text":"Anmah tla cu Anakim pawl vekin an sang; an tamzet ih a cah khal an cak ngaingai. Asinain Bawipa in a siatsuah thluh hai ih an ram cu Ammon mi pawl in an long ih an luah thluh."},"22":{"text":"Cutivek thotho in Edom tlangpar ramih a ummi Esau tesinfa Edom mi pawl parah Bawipa in a rak tuah zo a si.
