Moses an upat vekin a Joshua khal a nun sung hmuahhmuah an upat ve."},"15":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Joshua hnenah,"},"16":{"text":"“Thukam Kuang a zawntu puithiam pawl cu Jordan tiva sung ihsin hung suak dingah thu pe aw,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa ih fial vekin Joshua cun thu a pek."},"18":{"text":"Puithiam pawl tikap ah an hung suak ih lei ro an pal vete in Jordan tiva cu a luan keel in a luang sal ih tidai cu a kawr a khat."},"19":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Jordan tiva cu thla hmaisa bik ni hra ni ah an tan ih Jerikho ihsin nisuahnak lamih a ummi Gilgal khua ah an riak."},"20":{"text":"Cutawkah Jordan tiva ihsin an lakmi lungto hleihnih cu Joshua in a phun."},"21":{"text":"Joshua in Israel mi pawl hnenah, “Hmailamah nan fanau pawl in, ‘Hi lungto pawl cu a tican ziangso a si?’ tiih an lo sut tikah,"},"22":{"text":"‘Israel mi in Jordan tiva an tan tikah leiro par ihsin an feh, tican a si,’ tiah nan sim pei."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian in Tipi Sen kan tan thluh hlan lo a roter vek thotho in nan hrang khalah Jordan tiva cu nan tan thluh hlan lo a roter ve a si."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah leilungmi hmuahhmuah in Bawipa ih thilti theinak an thei ding ih nannih khal in Bawipa nan Pathian cu a kumkhua in nan upat pei,” tiah a ti."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jordan tiva ihsin nitlaknak lamih a um Amor siangpahrang pawl le Mediterranean Tifinriat kapih a ummi Kanaan siangpahrang pawl cu Israel mi pawl in Jordan tiva an tan tikah Bawipa in tiva a kangter ṭheh, ti kha an thei thluh. Curuangah an ṭih ih thinphang le thinnau in an um.","title":"Serhtannak Le Lantak Puai"},"2":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Joshua hnenah, “ṭeklung namte tuah awla Israel mi pawl hi an serh tan sal aw,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Joshua cun ṭeklung namte a tuah ih Israel mi pawl cu Serhtannak Tlang an timi ah an serh a tan."},"4":{"text":"Zianghrangah an serh a tan tile Izipt ram ihsin an suah laiih raldo theimi mipa hmuahhmuah cu an tar zo ih hramlakih khual an tlawnnak lamzin ah an thi thluh zo."},"5":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin a suakmi mipa hmuahhmuah cu serhtanmi an si naón hramlak an feh laiih a suakmi pawl cu serhtan hrih lomi lawnglawng an si ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Hramlak an vahvaihnak ah Israel mi pawl cu kum sawmli an feh. Bawipa ih thu an ngai lo ruangah Izipt ram ihsin raldo thei ciami mipa hmuahhmuah cu an thi thluh zo. An pipu hnenah ka lo pek ding tiih siatcam in a rak kam ciami, cawhnawi le khuaitizu a luannak ram cu ka thlengter hrimhrim lo ding, tiah Bawipa in a ti."},"7":{"text":"Anmah ih ai-awhtu an fapa pawl cu serhtan hrih lomi an si. Cuih mino pawl cu Joshua ih serh a tanmi pawl an si."},"8":{"text":"An zatein serh an tan ṭheh tikah an hma a dam ṭheh hlan lo an zatein an riahbuk ah an um thluh."},"9":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Joshua hnenah, “Izipt ram sal nan taannak ruangih ningzahnak cu tuih sunah ka hlon thluh zo,” tiah a ti. Curuangah acuih hmun cu Gilgal tiah hmin an saknak a si; tuih sun tiang cuticun an ko lai."},"10":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Gilgal ih an um laiah, Jerikho kiangih hmunrawn ahcun cuih thla ni hleili zanlam ihsin Lantak Puai an tuah."},"11":{"text":"A thaisun ah Kanaan ram ihsin a suakmi rawl, vaikan le thilnu telh lomi sang an ei."},"12":{"text":"Cuih ram ihsin a suakmi rawl an ei vete cun van ihsin manna sang a rung tla nawn lo; nehhnu khalah Israel mi in an hmu nawn lo. Cuih kum thok in Kanaan ramih a suakmi rawl lawng an ei."},"13":{"text":"Joshua cu Jerikho kiang a thlen tikah khua a hun tang ih, ralnam zuuk ciami keng in a hmaiah mipa pakhat a din kha a hmu lohli. Joshua cun a hei naih ih, “Kanmah ih milai na si maw, kan ral so na si?” tiah a sut.","title":"Joshua Le Ralnam A Neitu"},"14":{"text":"Cutikah cupa cun, “Zo ih milai hman ka si lo; Bawipa ih ralkap pawl hotu ka si ih hinah ka ra,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Joshua cu leilungah upatnak thawn a bok ih, “ Bawipa , kei na salpa hnenah hin ziangso na sim duhmi a um?” tiah a sut."},"15":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih ralkap hotu pa cun, “Na kedam phuak aw; hmun thianghlim ah na ding a si,” tiah a ti. A ti bangtuk in Joshua cun a phuak."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl lut thei hlah hai seh tiah Jerikho khua cu fektein an kulh ih kotka an khar. A lut a suakmi zohman an um lo.","title":"Jerikho Khua An Lak"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Joshua hnenah, “Ngaihnik! Jerikho khua le an siangpahrang le an ralkap pawl an zatein na kutah ka lo pek."},"3":{"text":"Hi khawpi cu nangmah le na ralkap pawl in ni khatah voikhat in ni ruk sung nan vel pei."},"4":{"text":"Puithiam pasarih, tuucangki pakhat ciar kengin Thukam Kuang hmaiah cun an feh pei. Ni sarihnak ni ahcun nangmah le na ralkap pawl in khawpi cu vel sarih nan vel pei ih puithiam pawl cun an tuucangki tawtawrawt an phaw pei."},"5":{"text":"Cule saupi in voikhat an phaw pei ih cumi an theih vete in senpi pawl cu napi in an au pei ih an khawpi kulhnak ralhruang cu a cim rupri ding. Cutikah ralkap pawl cu anmah ih hmai zawn ciar in khawsung ah an lut pei,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cuhrangah Joshua in puithiam pawl cu a ko ih, “Thukam Kuang la uhla, nanmah ih lakah pasarih in tuucangki pakhat ciar keng in Thukam Kuang hmaiah nan feh pei. Cule ralkap pawl cu nanmah ih hmaiah an feh ding,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Israel mi pawl hnenah Joshua in, “Pok uhla feh uh. Khawpi cu vel uhla Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang hmaiah ralkap pawl feh hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Joshua ih thupekmi bangtuk in Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang hmaiah puithiam pasarih cu tawtawrawt phaw phah in an feh."},"9":{"text":"Tawtawrawt a phawtu puithiam pawl ih hmaiah hmaituangtu ralkap pawl cu an feh ih dungkhortu ralkap pawl in Thukam Kuang dungin an thlun. Cat loin tawtawrawt cu an phawt."},"10":{"text":"Asinain Joshua in mipi hnenah, “Au thlang uh, ka ti lai hlan lo cu zohman nan au lo pei. Kam khat khal nan ṭong lo pei,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang thawn puithiam pawl cu Joshua ih a thlah vekin khawpi cu vel khat an vel. Cule an riahnak hmun ah an ra kir ih an buk ah zanah an riak."},"12":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah Joshua cu a tho; puithiam pawl in Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu an zawn."},"13":{"text":"A cuih puithiam pasarih pawl cu tawtawrawt pasarih phaw phah in hmaiah an feh. Hmaituangtu ralkap pawl cu an hmaiah an feh ih dungkhortu ralkap pawl cu Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang ih dungin an thlun. Cat loin tawtawrawt cu an phaw."},"14":{"text":"Ni hnihnak ni khalah khawpi cu vel khat an vel ih an riahnak ah an ra kir sal. Ni ruk sung cuticun an tuah."},"15":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ahcun zingpitte in an tho ih a hlan bangtuk in khawpi cu an vel ih vel sarih an vel. Voi sarih an vel cu cuih sun lawnglawng ah a si."},"16":{"text":"Vel sarihnak an vel tikah puithiam pawl in tawtawrawt cu an tum ih Joshua in a mi pawl hnenah, “Au thlang uh! Hi khawpi cu Bawipa in nan kut sungah a lo pek a si."},"17":{"text":"Khawpi cu siatsuah thluh a si pei ih a sungih ummi hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih hnenah pek thluh a si pei. Thlingthlatu kan thlahmi pawl himte in a rak thuh thei ruangah hlawhhlangnu Rahab le a innsang pawl lawng nan zuah pei."},"18":{"text":"Cun lak lo ding timi pawl cu nan naih hrimhrim lo pei. Lak lo ding timi thil pakhatkhat nan lak pang a si ahcun Israel mi parah harsatnak le siatsuahnak nan thlenter tengteng ding a si."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla sui le ngun, dar le thir ih tuahmi thilri hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih hrangah nan pek thluh ding. Bawipa ih tangka retnak inn ah ret thluh ding an si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah puithiam pawl cun tawtawrawt cu an phawt ih mipi pawl in an theih tikah napi in an au ciamco. Cuvete in khua kulhnak ralhruang cu a cim rupri. Cule ralkap pawl cu anmah ih hmaizawn ciar in khawpi sungah cun an lut ih khawpi cu an lak."},"21":{"text":"An ralnam in khuasungih a ummi hmuahhmuah nunau siseh mipa siseh nauhak upa ti loin an that thluh. Caw le tuu le laak pawl khal an thah cih thluh."},"22":{"text":"Thlingthlatu an thlahmi pahnih cu Joshua in a ko ih, “Hlawhhlangnu Rahab hnenah cun va feh uhla nan thukammi bangtuk in amah le a innsang pawl cu rak hruai suak uh,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah an va feh ih Rahab cu a pa, a nu, a ṭapa pawl le a innsang dang pawl thawn an ratpi. An innsang le an sal pawl tla thawn an hruai ih Israel mi pawl ih riahnak buk lengah an ret."},"24":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jerikho khawpi cu a sungih ummi hmuahhmuah thawn meisa in an ur. Meisa in ur lomi sui le ngun, dar le thir ih tuahmi thilri pawl hmuahhmuah cu an lak ih Bawipa ih tangka retnak inn ah an ret."},"25":{"text":"Asinain hlawhhlangnu Rahab le a sungte pawl cu Jerikho khua thlingthlatu pahnih a rak thuh ruangah Joshua in that loin a zuah. Tuih sun tiangin Rahab ih tefa pawl cu Israel ram sungah an um lai."},"26":{"text":"Cun Joshua in camsiatnak thawn: “Hi Jerikho khawpi sak sal a tumtu cu, Bawipa ih camsiatnak tong seh; Hi khawpi din sal dingah khur a laitu cu, A fapa upa bik thi seh. Hi khawpi kotka pawl a tuah saltu cu, A fapa nauta bik thi seh,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Joshua hnenih Bawipa a um ruangah Joshua hmin cu an ram pumpuluk ah a thang."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lak lo dingih khammi hmuahhmuah zianghman nan dai lo pei, tiih Bawipa ih thupekmi cu Israel mi pawl in an thlun lo. Thilri a latu cu Akhan a si. Akhan cu Karmi ih fapa a si, Karmi cu Zabdi ih fapa a si. Zabdi cu Zerah hrin a si ih Zerah cu Judah miphun a si. Akhan in thilri a lak ruangah Israel mi parah Bawipa cu a thin a heng ngaingai.","title":"Akhan-ih Sualnak"},"2":{"text":"Joshua in Israel mi hrekkhat Jerikho ihsin Ai ah khua le ram zoh dingin a thlah. Ai khua cu Bethel ihsin nisuahnak lam, Bethaven khua kiangteih a ummi khua a si. Cuhrangah an feh ih Ai khua cu an va thlingthla."},"3":{"text":"An ra kir ih Joshua hnenah, “Kan zate ih feh a ṭul lo ding. Ai khua va nam ding ahcun minung thawng hnih thawng thum tluk thlah awla a tawk ko ding. Mi hmuahhmuahih do dingah a tlak lo. Mi malte an si,” tiah an ra sim sal."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Israel ralkap thawng thum tluk an feh. Asinain Ai khua ih ralkap pawl in an rak neh ih an tlan thluh."},"5":{"text":"Israel ralkap cu sawmthum le paruk an thi. An khawsuah ihsin Shebarim an timi lungto laknak tiang Ai khua ralkap pawl in Israel ralkap pawl cu an dawi ih an tlannak tlangtluan ah ral in an that phah vivo. Cuhrangah Israel mi pawl cu an thin a phang, an ṭih ngaingai ih an tha a nau sualso."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Joshua cu a riahsia in a hnipuan a thlek in Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang hmaiah leilung ah a bok. Israel mi hruaitu pawl khal an riahsia in an lu parah leivut an phulh aw ih Joshua hnenah cun zanlam tiang an bok ve."},"7":{"text":"Cule Joshua in Bawipa hnenah, “Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, zianghrangah so Jordan tiva ralah hin in rak thlenpi? Amor mi pawl ih kut sung tla dingah le siatsuah hloral thluhta dingah maw in ti? Ziangah so Jordan khatlam ralah khan kan rak um sawn lo?"},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Israel mi pawl ralih an dawi rero hnuah cun ziangso ka ṭong ngam nawn ding?"},"9":{"text":"In dawinak thuhla Kanaan mi le midang tla in an theih tikah in kulh thluh ding ih kan ci in hmit thluh ding. Na hmin thanter salnak dingah ziangso na tuah ding?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Joshua hnenah, “Tho aw; ziangah so na bok ringring?"},"11":{"text":"Israel mi pawl an sual zo. Thlun ding tiih kan kam awkmi an thlun lo a si. Lak lo ding tiih khammi thilri an lak. An ruk ih an pheh ih an thilri lakah an thup."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi in nan ral nan do thei lonak a si. Ral donak ihsin nan zam ih atu cu siatsuah thluh ding nan si thlang. Nan rukmi thilri nan siatsuah thluh lo ahcun nan hnenah ka um nawn lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Tho aw; na minung pawl an sual thianfai awla keimah i tong hai seh. Thaisun ah i tong hai seh, ṭhatein sim aw; ziangahtile keimah Israel ih Pathian in an hnenih ka ṭong duhmi hiti in a si: ‘Maw Israel, lak lo ding ka timi thilri nan lak. A cuih thilri nan hlon thluh hlan cu nan ral pawl nan neh thei lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah zinglamah a hnam a hnam in nan suak pei. Bawipa ih hrilmi hnam sung ihsin a hrin a hrin in nan suak pei. Bawipa in a hril pei ih Bawipa ih hrilmi hrin sung ihsin sung khat sung khat in nan suak pei. Cule Bawipa ih hrilmi sung khat sung ihsin minung pakhat pakhat in nan suak pei."},"15":{"text":"Lak lo ding tiih khammi thilri a latu cu a innsang le a neihmi hmuahhmuah thawn meisa in ur a si pei. Ka thukam a thlun lo ruangah Israel miphun parah ningzakza thil ṭha lo tumpi a thlenter a si,’ na ti pei,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Joshua cu zingpitte in a tho ih Israel mi pawl cu a hnam a hnam in a ratter. Cuih hnam pawl sung ihsin Judah miphun pawl thursuak an si."},"17":{"text":"Judah miphun sung ihsin a hrin a hrin in a suahter ih Zerah hrin an thursuak. Zerah hrin pawl cu innsang innsang in a suahter lala ih Zabdi ih innsang an thursuak."},"18":{"text":"Cule Zabdi innsang sung ihsin minung pakhat pakhat in a suahter ih Akhan cu mawh an phurhter. Akhan cu Karmi ih fapa a si ih Zabdi ih tupa a si."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Joshua in Akhan cu, “Ka fapa, Israel ih Pathian Bawipa ih hmaiah hin thutak sim awla na sualnak phuang aw. Na tuahmi cu i sim hnik. Zianghman phehmi nei lotein sim thluh aw,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule Akhan cun, “Asi, Israel ih Pathian Bawipa ih hmaiah ka sual zo. Ka tuahmi cu himi a si."},"21":{"text":"Kan lonmi thilri sungah khan Babilon puan mawite pakhat, pawng nga tluk a ritmi ngun tum le, pawng khat tluk a ritmi sui tum ka hmu ih ka duhzet ruangah ka lak a si. Ka buuk sungah ka phum ih nan hmu ko ding; a hnuaita bikah ngun tum cu ka ret,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Joshua in mi hrekkhat pawl a thlah ih Akhan ih buk ahcun zamrangin an va tlan ih a buk sungah a phummi thil pawl cu an va hmu; ngun tum cu a hnuaita bikah an hmu ngaingai."},"23":{"text":"An va phorh ih Joshua le Israel mi pawl hnenah an rak keng ih Bawipa ih hmaiah cun an ret."},"24":{"text":"Cule Joshua le Israel mi pawl cun Akhan le a ngun tum, a sui tum le Babilon puan mawi le, a fapa pawl, a fanu pawl, a caw, a rang, a tuu le a neihmi hmuahhmuah an lak ih Harsatnak Phairawn timi ah an fehpi."},"25":{"text":"Cutawkah cun Joshua in, “Zianghrangah so kan parah ningzah harsatnak na thlenter? Bawipa in na parah harsatnak a thlenter ve ding,” a ti ih an zatein Akhan cu lungto in an deng ciamco ih a thi. A innsang pawl le a neihmi hmuahhmuah khal an deng that ih meisa in an ur thluh."},"26":{"text":"Cutawk Akhan ih thihnak ahcun lungto an pengkhawm ih tuih sun tiangin acuih lungpen cu a um lai. Curuangah acuih hmun cu Akhor, Harsatnak Phairawn, tiah an tita. Cuih hnuah Bawipa ih thinhengnak cu a reh."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Joshua hnenah, “ṭih hlah, na thin khal nauter hlah. Na ralkap hmuahhmuah thawn Ai khua ah va feh aw. An siangpahrang, an minung, an khua le an ram zatein na ta an si ding.","title":"Ai Khua An Lak"},"2":{"text":"Jerikho khua le an siangpahrang parih na tuah bangtuk in Ai khua le an siangpahrang parah na tuah pei; asinain tuih ṭum cu an thilri le an ṭilva pawl nanmah in nan co pei. Curuangah Ai khua cu do dingin timtuah uhla dunglam in va nam uh,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cuticun Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu Ai khua do dingin an tim aw. Ralṭhami ralkap thawng sawmthum a hril ih zanthimah a fehter."},"4":{"text":"An hnenah cun Joshua in, “Ai khua ih dunglam ah va feh uhla va thup-aw uh. A hlat tukah va um hlah uh; hmakhatte ih nam dingin ralring uh."},"5":{"text":"Kei le ka hnenih a ummi ralkap hmuahhmuah in hi lam ihsin kan rak pan ding. Ai khua ralkap pawl ih in do tikah, a hmaisa vek thotho in, khawsung ihsin an ra suak ding. Cutikah kannih dungah kan siip ding."},"6":{"text":"Dung kan siip tikah in dawi ding ih an khua an taan thluh tiangin in dawi ding. A hmaisa-ih an tlan vekin an tlan lala a si hi, an ti ding."},"7":{"text":"Culaifang ah nan relhnak ihsin nan suak pei ih an khawpi cu nan lak pei. Bawipa nan Pathian in an khawpi cu nan kut sungah a lo pek ding a si."},"8":{"text":"An khua nan lak ṭheh tikah an khawpi cu meisa in ur uh. Bawipa ih thupekmi vekin tuah uh. Thu ka lo pek hai a si!” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Joshua in a ralkap pawl cu zanah a thlah ih Ai khua ihsin nitlaknak lam, Ai le Bethel khua karlakah an va relh. Joshua cu an riahbuk ah a riak."},"10":{"text":"Joshua cu a thaizing zingpitah a tho ih ralkap pawl cu a khawm ih Israel hotu pawl thawn Ai khua lamah an feh."},"11":{"text":"Khawpi kotka lamah cun an feh ih Ai khua saklam ah an riak. An riahnak le Ai khua karlakah horkuam a um."},"12":{"text":"A ralkap thawng nga tluk cu Ai le Bethel khua karlak, Ai ihsin nitlaknak lamah a relhter."},"13":{"text":"Cutiih an relh laiah ralkap burpi sawn cu Ai khua ih saklam ah an um. Cutiin ral do dingah an tiar aw. Amah Joshua cu horkuam ah a riak."},"14":{"text":"Cule Ai khua siangpahrang in Joshua le a ralkap pawl an kiangih an um kha a theih tikah a ralkap pawl thawn hmakhatte-ah an pok; cun a hmaisa-ih an do awknak hmun ah Israel do ding in Arabah phairawn lamah cun a feh. Dunglam in in nam ding ti a thei lo."},"15":{"text":"Joshua le a ralkap pawl cun dunglamah an siip bum ih nelrawn lamah an tlan vivo."},"16":{"text":"Ai khuasungih a ummi mipa hmuahhmuah cu Israel ralkap pawl dawi dingah an ko-aw thluh ih Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu an khua ihsin hlapi tiang an dawi vivo."},"17":{"text":"Israel pawl dawi dingah mipa hmuahhmuah an pok ṭheh; an khawpi Ai kiltu dingah zohman an um lo."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Joshua hnenah, “Na feipi kha Ai lam hoi in hngirh aw; hi khawpi cu na kut sungah ka lo pe ding a si,” tiah a ti. Bawipa ih ti vekin Joshua in a feipi cu a hngirh."},"19":{"text":"A kut a hun thlir vete cun Ai khua nam dingih a thup-awmi ralkap pawl cu an suak lohli ih Ai khua cu an lak. Hmakhatteah acuih khawpi cu meisa in an ur."},"20":{"text":"Ai khua mi ralkap pawl cun an dunglam an hawi sal tikah an khua ihsin meisa khu van tiangih a kai kha an hei hmu. Cule hramlak lamih a tlan reromi Israel ralkap pawl an dung an let-aw ih a dawitu ralkap pawl cu an do. Ai ralkap hrangah luatnak a um lo."},"21":{"text":"Ai khua an lakih meisa in an ur zo, ti kha Joshua le a ralkap pawl in an hmuh tikah an dung an let ih Ai khua ralkap pawl cu an that ciamco."},"22":{"text":"Khawpi sungih a um ciami Israel ralkap pawl cu an suak ih an ral pawl cu an dung lam in an do. Israel ralkap pawl in an dung le an hmai in an kulh thluh ih, an siangpahrang siar lo, minung pakhat hman luat loin an that thluh a si."},"23":{"text":"Cun Ai khua siangpahrang cu an kai ih Joshua hnenah an fehpi."},"24":{"text":"Hramlak tiangin ral a dawitu Ai khua ralkap pawl cu pakhat hman luat loin Israel ralkap pawl in an that thluh. Cun Ai khawsungah an kir sal ih khua ih ummi milai an zatein an that thluh lala."},"25":{"text":"An khuaseen in an that thluh ih an thahmi mipa nunau an zatein thawng hleihnih an si."},"26":{"text":"Khawsung mi an zate ih an thah thluh hlan lo Joshua in a feipi cu Ai khua lam hoi in a sawh ringring."},"27":{"text":"Cule Joshua hnenih Bawipa ih sim bangtuk in Ai khua sungih an lonmi ṭilva le thilri pawl cu Israel mi pawl in anmah ih hrangah an lak."},"28":{"text":"Cuticun Joshua in Ai khua cu ziangtik hmanih umnak ṭha nawn lo dingin a ur ih tuih san tiangin khawrop ah a cangta."},"29":{"text":"Ai khua siangpahrang cu thingkung parah Joshua in a thlai ih cutawkah a ruak cu zanlam tiang a ret. Ni a tlak tikah Joshua in thu a pek ih a ruak cu thingpar ihsin an lak hnuah khawpi luhnak kotka zinah an hlon. A ruak parah cun lungto an pen ih acuih lungpen cu atuih san tiangin a um lai a si."},"30":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian Bawipa ih hrangah Joshua in Ebal tlang parah biakṭheng a don.","title":"Ebal Tlang Parah Pathian Pekmi Daan An Siar"},"31":{"text":"Cuih biakṭheng cu Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses in Israel mi hnenih a pek tami Moses Daan cabu sungih an nganmi vek in, “thir hriamhrei ih aat lo lungto in dawlmi biakṭheng” a si. A cuih biakṭheng parah meisa-ur thawinak Bawipa ih hnenah an pek ih, remnak thawinak khal an pek."},"32":{"text":"Cutawkah Israel mi pawl ih mithmuh ah Moses ih nganmi Thukham cu Joshua in lungto parah a ngan."},"33":{"text":"Israel mi zatein, an hotu pawl, an bawi pawl, an thuṭhentu pawl le anmah ih lakih a ummi ramdangmi pawl tla thawn Thukam Kuang a zawntu Levi mi puithiam pawl hoih in Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang ih sir veve ahcun an ding. Israel mi a hrek cu Gerizim tlang dungtun in an ding ih a hrek cu Ebal tlang dungtun in an ding. Israel mi pawl thluasuah pek an si tikah cubangtuk in ding dingah Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses ih thupek tami a si."},"34":{"text":"Thukham cabu sungih nganmi vekin, thluasuahnak thu le camsiatnak thu pawl thawn, Thukham cu Joshua in ringzet in a siar."},"35":{"text":"Nunau, nauhak le miphun dang pawl tla telin Israel misenpi hmaiah Moses ih thupekmi cu pakhat hman hrelh loin Joshua cun a siar ṭheh."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua in hi khua pawl a nehnak thu cu Jordan ihsin nitlaknak lamih a ummi siangpahrang pawl le tlang parih a ummi siseh, hmunrawn ih a ummi siseh, Mediterranean Tifinriat kapih a ummi pawl, saklam ah Lebanon ramih a ummi tiangin an thei thluh. Cutiin Hit mi, Amor mi, Kanaan mi, Periz mi, Hiv mi le Jebus mi tla-ih siangpahrang pawl in an theih tikah,","title":"Gibeon Mi Pawl In Joshua An Bum"},"2":{"text":"Joshua le Israel mi pawl do dingin an ṭangkhawm."},"3":{"text":"Joshua in Jerikho le Ai khua parih a tuahmi kha Hiv miphun Gibeon khua mi pawl in an theih tikah,"},"4":{"text":"Joshua cu a bum an tum. A tlekmi dip in rawl an thun ih belhmi savun ih tuahmi sabit thawl thawn laak pawl an phurhter."},"5":{"text":"Belhcop mi kedam le hnipuan siava an hruk ih lamcaw an kenmi tla cu a car cia le a mawrmi sang lawnglawng an si."},"6":{"text":"Cule Gilgal ih an riahnak ahcun an feh ih Joshua le Israel mi hnenah cun, “Nan hnenah lam hlapi ihsin kan ra ih rem awknak thukam kan tuah hram pei,” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Hiv mi hnen ahcun Israel mi pawl in, “Lam naite ih ummi tla nan si ahcun ziangtinso rem awknak thukam cu kan tuah thei ding?” an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Joshua hnenah, “Bawipa, kannih cu na sal kan si,” tiah an ti. Joshua in, “Zoso nan si? Khuitawk in so nan rat?” tiah a sut."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Na Bawipa Pathian ih thil a tuahmi kan theih ruangah khawhlapi ihsin kan ra a si. Izipt ramih thil a tuah mi siseh,"},"10":{"text":"Jordan ihsin nisuahnak lamih a ummi Amor miphun siangpahrang pahnih - Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon le Ashtaroth ih a ummi Bashan siangpahrang Og parih a tuahmi thil pawl siseh, kan thei ṭheh."},"11":{"text":"In hotu pawl le kan ram mi hmuahhmuah in, ‘Rawl keng uhla Israel mi pawl va tong uh; nan sal kan si ih rem awknak thukam kanmah thawn tuah hram uh,’ tiih sim dingah in fial a si."},"12":{"text":"Kan kenmi sang pawl hi zohhnik. Nangmah tong dingih kan inn ihsin kan pawh tikah a hlum lai hrih a si. Asinain atu-ah cun a car ih a mawr thluh zo."},"13":{"text":"Cun sabitti thunnak savun thawl pawl hi zohhnik. A tharte an si naón atu-ah cun an tlek ṭheh zo. Kan hnipuan le kan kedam pawl khal hi zohhnik. Lamhlazet ihsin kan ra ih an ṭet thluh zo a si,” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Rawl an kenmi cu Israel hotu pawl in an saang ih an ei. Asinain Bawipa ih duhnak an hawl hmaisata lo."},"15":{"text":"Cutiin Joshua in remnak a tuah ih thah an tuar lonak dingah anmah thawn thukamnak a tuah. Cule Israel hotu pawl in acuih thukamnak cu an hngetter."},"16":{"text":"Thukamnak an tuah hnu ni thum hnuah Gibeon mi pawl cu lam naite ih a ummi an si ti kha Israel mi pawl in an thei."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi pawl cu an feh ih Gibeon mi umnak Gibeon khua, Khefirah khua, Beeroth khua le Kiriath Jearim khua ahcun an thleng."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl in Gibeon mi pawl cu thah dingah a cang thei nawn lo, ziangahtile an hotu pawl in anmah thawn Israel ih Pathian Bawipa ih hmin in thukamnak an rak tuah zo a si. Cuih thu ruangah Israel misenpi pawl cu an hotu pawl parah an phunzai ciamzo."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an hotu pawl cun, “ Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian hmin sal in thukamnak kan tuah zo. Ziangti hman in annih kan dai thei nawn lo."},"20":{"text":"Thu kan kam zo ruangah kan zuah tengteng a ṭul a si. Kan zuah lo a si ahcun Pathian in kanmah in hrem ding."},"21":{"text":"Cu a si ruangah um ve ko hai seh; asinain kan hrangah zanthing an hrep pei ih tidai an khai pei,” tiah an ti. An hotu pawl ih sim vek cun misenpi pawl in an thlun."},"22":{"text":"Joshua in Gibeon mi pawl cu a ko ih, “Kan kiangteih ummi nan si naón ziangah so lam hlatpi in kan ra tiah in bum?"},"23":{"text":"Hitiih in bum ruangah Pathian siatserhmi nan si. Tu-ihsin thokin ka Pathian ih inn hrangah zanthing hreptu le tidai khaitu, hnaṭuantu sal nan si ringring ding,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Gibeon mi pawl cun, “ Bawipa na Pathian in a siahhlawh Moses hnenah thu a pek ih hi ram pumpi cu na kut sungih pek dingah le hi ram sungih a um mi hmuahhmuah cu thah thluh dingin a sim a si, ti fiangtein kan thei. In that thluh ding ti kan phang ih kan lo ṭih tuk ruangah hiti ih kan lo tinak a si."},"25":{"text":"Atu cu na kut sungah kan um zo ih a dik na ti vekin in tuah ko aw,” tiah an ti."},"26":{"text":"Cuhrangah Israel mi pawl ih thah lo dingin Gibeon mi pawl cu Joshua in a humhim a si."},"27":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa ih biakṭheng hrang le misenpi hrangih tidai khaitu le thing hreptu hnen-um ah a tuah. Bawipa in Amah biaknak hrangih a hrilmi hmun kipah hnaṭuantu pawl cu tuih san tiangin anmah an si."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua in Jerikho khua a siatbal thluh ih an siangpahrang khal a thah vekin Ai khua khal a siatbal thluh ih an siangpahrang khal a that a si ti kha Jerusalem siangpahrang Adonizedek in a thei. Cule Gibeon mi pawl in Israel mi pawl thawn remnak an tuah ih an lakah an um ti khal a thei fawn.","title":"Amor Mi Pawl An Neh"},"2":{"text":"Gibeon khua cu a dang khawpi tlukin a tum ih Ai khua hnakin a tum sawnmi a si. An ralkap khal ralṭhami an si ruangah Jerusalem mi pawl cu an thin a phang ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Adonizedek in Hebron siangpahrang Hoham, Jarmuth siangpahrang Piram, Lakhish siangpahrang Jafia le Eglon siangpahrang Debir pawl hnenah thu a cah:"},"4":{"text":"“Gibeon mi pawl in Joshua le Israel mi thawn rem awknak thukam an tuah hrangah ra uhla Gibeon mi pawl do in ra bawm uh,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"A cah bangtuk in Amor miphun siangpahrang panga: Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lakhish, le Eglon khua ih siangpahrang pawl cu an ralkap zate thawn an tongkhawm aw ih Gibeon khua cu an kulh ih an do."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Gibeon mi pawl in Israel mi pawl riahnak Gilgal ih a um mi Joshua hnenah, “Bawipa, dung in tun hlah aw. Zamrangte in ra awla in ra bawm aw. Tlangpar ramih a ummi Amor siangpahrang pawl an kom aw ih in do a si. In ra run hramhram aw,” tiah bomnak an dil."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu, a ralkap ṭhabik pawl thawn, Gilgal ihsin an hung feh."},"8":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Joshua hnenah, “Na thin phang hlah. Nehnak ka lo pe zo a si. Zohman a lo do theitu an um lo ding,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Joshua cu Gilgal ihsin Gibeon tiang zanvar a hung feh ih rinlopi-ah an ral pawl cu a nam."},"10":{"text":"Israel ralkap pawl an hmuh tikah ral pawl cu an thin phang ṭheh ko in Bawipa Pathian in a tuah. Cutikah Israel ralkap pawl in Gibeon khua ahcun ral pawl cu an that ciamco. Cule Beth Horon tlangkawn ihsin an vun dawi ih Azekah le Makkedah khua tiang an vun that phah vivo."},"11":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Israel ralkap ṭih ih Beth Horon tlangkawn ihsin Azekah khua tiang an tlan laiah van ihsin Bawipa in bokbawn tiatia rial a tlakter ih tampi an thi. Rial ih tlak thatmi pawl cu Israel ralkap ih ralnam thawn thahmi hnakin an tam sawn."},"12":{"text":"Pathian bomnak in Israel mi in Amor mi pawl an neh ni ahcun Israel mi pawl theihhngan ah Joshua in Bawipa ih hnenah hiti in a au: “Maw Ninu, Gibeon khua tlunah ding law; Maw Thlapa, Aijalon Horkuam tlunah cawl law,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"A ti vekin Israel mi pawl in an ral pawl an neh thluh hlan lo ni cu a ding ih thlapi cu a cawl ngaingai. Hi thu cu Jashar Cabu sungah an ngan a si. Ni cu feh nawn loin van laifangah ni khat pumhlum a cawl."},"14":{"text":"A cuih sun bangtuk, Pathian in Israel mi a ṭan ih Bawipa in milai ih thu a ngai caan, leilung hramthawh ihsin a um dah keel lo. Bawipa cu Israel lam ṭangin ral a do a si."},"15":{"text":"Cule Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu an riahnak Gilgal ah an tlung."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang panga pawl cu an tlan suak ih Makkedah lungpuk ah an relh.","title":"Joshua In Amor Siangpahrang Panga A Kai"},"17":{"text":"Cutawkih an relh kha an theih tikah Joshua an sim."},"18":{"text":"Joshua in, “A cuih lungpuk kaa-ah cun lungto tumpipi va peng uhla a kiltu va ret uh."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nanmah cu cutawkah um hlah uh; ral pawl cu dawi uhla an dunglam in that vivo uh; zohman an khawpi sung thleng hlah hai seh. Bawipa nan Pathian in nan kut sungah a lo pe zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Joshua le a ralkap pawl in ral pawl cu an that vivo ih an neh thluh. An thah lomi hnihkhat cu an khawpi ralhruang sung an thleng thei ih cupawl cu an that hai lo."},"21":{"text":"Cule a ralkap pawl cu Joshua hnenah an riahnak Makkedah ahcun himdamte in an thleng thluh. Cuih hnuah Israel mi parah zohman in zianghman an ṭong ngam nawn lo."},"22":{"text":"Cule Joshua in, “Lungpuk kaa cu ong thlang uhla siangpahrang panga pawl cu ka hnenah rak hruai uh,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"A ti vekin an tuah. Jerusalem khua siangpahrang, Hebron khua siangpahrang, Jarmuth khua siangpahrang, Lakhish khua siangpahrang le Eglon khua siangpahrang pawl cu an rak hruai."},"24":{"text":"A cuih siangpahrang pawl Joshua hnenih an ra thlen tikah Joshua in Israel mi hmuahhmuah a ko ih amah thawn ral a dotlangtu a kuthnuai bawi pawl cu, “Hinah ra uhla hi siangpahrang pawl ih hngawng hi nan ke in ra pal uh,” tiah a ti. A ti vek in siangpahrang pawl ih hngawng cu an pal."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Joshua in an hnenah, “ṭih hlah uhla nan tha khal nau hlah seh. Cak uhla nan ral ṭha uh, ziangahtile nan ral pawl parah Bawipa in hi bangtuk in a tuah ṭheh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cuih hnuah siangpahrang pawl cu Joshua in a that ih an ruak cu thingkung kung nga ah a thlai. Cuticun zanlam tiang an thlai."},"27":{"text":"Ni a tlak tikah Joshua ih thupek bangtuk in an ruak an lak ih a hlanih an relhnak lungpuk sungah an vun hlon. Cule lungpuk kaa-ah cun lungto tumpipi an pen ih acuih lungpen cu tuih san tiangin a um lai a si."},"28":{"text":"Cuih ni ah Makkedah khua cu Joshua in a do ih a neh ih an siangpahrang bawipa khal a kai. An siangpahrang bawi le an khawsung mi zatein pakhat hman hrelh loin a that thluh. Jerikho siangpahrang parih a tuah vek thotho in Makkedah siangpahrang par khal ah a tuah.","title":"Joshua In Amor Ram Tampi A Lak"},"29":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu Makkedah ihsin an feh in Libnah khua an do."},"30":{"text":"Pathian in nehnak a pek bangtuk in Israel mi pawl cun acuih khua le an siangpahrang bawipa khal cu an neh. Khawsung mi pawl cu pakhat hman taang loin nam in an saat that thluh. Jerikho siangpahrang parih an tuah vek thotho in Libnah siangpahrang khal an tuah a si."},"31":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu Libnah ihsin Lakhish ah an feh. Lakhish cu an kulh ih an do."},"32":{"text":"Pathian in Israel mi hnenah nehnak a pek ih Lakhish khua cu ni hnihnak ah an neh. Libnah mi an thah thluh vekin Lakhish khua mi khal pakhat hman taang loin an that thluh."},"33":{"text":"Cule Gezer siangpahrang Horam cu Lakhish run dingah a ra naón Joshua in a neh ih amah le a ralkap pawl cu pakhat hman luat loin a that thluh."},"34":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu Lakhish ihsin Eglon ah an feh. Eglon khua cu an kulh ih an do."},"35":{"text":"A cuih sun thotho ah an lak ih Lakhish khua an tuah vekin Eglon khua mi pawl khal pakhat hman luat loin nam in an sah that thluh."},"36":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu Eglon ihsin Hebron ah an hung feh ih an do."},"37":{"text":"Hebron khua an lak ih an siangpahrang an that ih khawsung mi hmuahhmuah le a kiangkap khua mi pawl khal an that thluh. Hebron cu an siatsuah thluh. Eglon khua an tuah vekin Hebron khawsung khal ah mi pakhat hman taang loin an that thluh a si."},"38":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu Debir lamah an her ih Debir khua an do."},"39":{"text":"An siangpahrang an kaih ih acuih khua le a kiangkap khua pawl tla an lak. An minung an zatein an that thluh. Hebron le Libnah khua mi pawl le an siangpahrang an thah thluh vek thotho in Debir khua mi pawl le an siangpahrang bawipa cu pakhat hman zuah loin an that thluh a si."},"40":{"text":"Cuticun cuih hrawng ram pumpuluk Joshua in a neh thluh. Tlangpar ram le Negev nelrawn ram siseh, hmunrawn ram le tlangtluan ram siseh, an siangpahrang bawi pawl thawn a neh thluh a si. Israel Bawipa Pathian thupekmi bangtuk in minung pakhat hman luat loin a that fai thluh a si."},"41":{"text":"Joshua in thlanglam ram Kadesh Barnea ihsin tipi kapih ummi Gaza tiang, Goshen ram hmuahhmuah le saklam ramih ummi Gibeon tiang a neh thluh."},"42":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cun Israel mi pawl a ṭanpi ruangah hi ram hmuahhmuah le an siangpahrang pawl tla cu ṭumkhat raldo-ah Joshua in a neh thluh hai a si."},"43":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Joshua le a ralkap pawl cu an riahnak Gilgal ah an kir sal."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel in ral an nehnak thu pawl cu Hazor siangpahrang Jabin in a rak theih tikah Madon siangpahrang Jobab, Shimron khua siangpahrang, Akshaf khua siangpahrang,","title":"Jabin Le A ṭanpitu Pawl An Neh"},"2":{"text":"saklam tlang par siangpahrang pawl, Galilee Tili ihsin thlanglam ih ummi Jordan horkuam siangpahrang pawl, tlanghram hmunrawnih ummi siangpahrang pawl le nitlaknak lamih Dor kiangkap siangpahrang pawl thu a cah."},"3":{"text":"Cun Jordan tiva kap hnih ih a ummi Kanaan mi pawl, Amor mi pawl, Hit mi pawl, Periz mi pawl, tlangpar ramih ummi Jebus mi pawl, le Mizpah ram Hermon Tlang hram hrawngih ummi Hiv mi pawl a cah thluh."},"4":{"text":"A cah vekin an ra ih an ralkap pawl cu tifinriat kap ih vunnel zat an si. Rang le rangleng tampi an keng."},"5":{"text":"Hi siangpahrang pawl cun an ralkap pawl an finkhawm ih Israel do dingah Merom ih ummi Merom Cerh timi kapah an tong khawm aw."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Joshua hnenah, “ṭih hlah. An zatein thaisun atu tikcu-ah Israel kut sungah ka lo pe ding ih an thi thluh ding. An rang pawl ih kaizatha cu sat cat awla an rangleng pawl cu meisa in ur thluh aw,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Joshua le a ralkap pawl cun an rin lo laiah Merom Cerh kiang ahcun an do ciamco."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in nehnak cu Israel kut sungah a pek ih an nam tikah an neh ih saklam ah a ummi Sidon le Misrefoth Maim tiang, nisuahnak lamah Mizpah horkuam tiang, an ral pawl cu an dawi. Minung pakhat hman taang nawn lo tiangin an that thluh a si."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in Joshua cun an rang pawl ih kaizatha cu a sat cat ih an rangleng pawl cu meisa in a ur ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Cule Joshua cu a kir sal ih Hazor khua a neh ih an siangpahrang bawipa tla a that. A cuih san ahcun Hazor khua siangpahrang cu siangpahrang ukmi pawl lakah an hotu bik a si."},"11":{"text":"Hazor khawsung mi pawl cu pakhat hman taang loin an that thluh ih an khua khal an ur ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Cutawk hrawngih siangpahrang pawl le an khawpi pawl cu Joshua in a neh thluh. Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses ih thupeknak bangtuk in Joshua cun a that thluh hai a si."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla tlang fatete parih an tohmi khua lakah Joshua ih urmi Hazor khua siar lo khawpi dang pakhat hman Israel mi in an ur lo."},"14":{"text":"Hi khawpi pawl ihsin an lonmi thil mankhung le ṭilva pawl hmuahhmuah cu Israel mi pawl in anmah ih hrangah an lak. Asinain minung cu an zatein an that thluh; pakhat hman an luat lo."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian in a siahhlawh Moses hnenah thu a pek ih Moses in Joshua hnenah cuih thu cu a pek; acuih thu bangtuk in Joshua cun a thlun ṭheh. Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in Joshua cun a tuah thluh a si."},"16":{"text":"A cuih ram cu Joshua in a neh thluh: tlangpar ram, Negev ram hmuahhmuah, Goshen ram hmuahhmuah, nitlaklam tlanghram, Jordan phairawn, Israel ram sungih tlangpar ram le hmunrawn pawl,","title":"Joshua In Ram Pumpi A Neh"},"17":{"text":"Seir ram lamih a hungfehmi Halak tlang ihsin Hermon Tlang thuai ih a ummi Lebanon Phairawn ram sungih Baal Gad tiang a neh thluh. Hi ramih siangpahrang pawl cu a kaih hnuah a vuak ih a that hai."},"18":{"text":"Caan reipi hi siangpahrang pawl cu a do."},"19":{"text":"Gibeon khua ih a ummi Hiv mi pawl siar lo, khui khua hman in Israel mi thawn remnak thukam an tuah lo. An zatein do-awk hnu lawngih nehmi an si thluh."},"20":{"text":"Zaangfahnak zianghman um loin thah thluh le siatsuah thluh an sinak dingah an thinlung cu Israel mi do dingah Bawipa in a khohter. Cutiih tuah dingah Bawipa in Moses cu a rak tiam cia zo a si."},"21":{"text":"A cuih caan ah tlangpar ramih a ummi: Hebron khua, Debir khua, Anab khua le Judah le Israel tlangpar ram pawl ih a ummi, mitum zetzet Anak mi pawl cu Joshua in a that thluh. An minung pawl an ci in a mihter ih tlunah an khawpi pawl tla a siatsuah thluh a si."},"22":{"text":"Israel ram sungah Anak mi pakhat hman an taang nawn lo. Asinain Gaza, Gath le Ashdod khua ahcun malte an taanglai a si."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa in Moses hnenih thu a pek bangtuk in acuih ram pumpuluk cu Joshua in a neh thluh. Cule acuih ram cu Joshua in anmah ih comi ro si dingah Israel mi hnenah a pek; Israel miphun zat in ram cu a ṭhen ih ṭhen khat fingfing a pek a si. Cuticun an ram cu ral nei loin a cawl."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ih nehmi le luahmi ram pawl cu Jordan ihsin nisuahnak lamah - Arnon phairawn ihsin Jordan tiva kuam in saklam ah Hermon Tlang tiang a si. Israel ih nehmi siangpahrang cu:","title":"Moses Nehmi Siangpahrang Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Heshbon ih a ummi Amor mi pawl ih siangpahrang Sihon a si ih a ukmi ram cu Arnon phairawn kapih ummi Aroer khua ihsin acuih phairawn laifang in Ammon mi pawl ramri-ih a luangmi Jabbok tiva tiang a si ih Gilead ram tla a hrek a tel cih."},"3":{"text":"Cule Jordan tiva kuam Tipi Thi ihsin nisuahnak lamah cun Galilee Tili ihsin Beth Jeshimoth lamah thlanglam ramih a ummi Pisgah Tlang tluan tiang a si."},"4":{"text":"Cun Refaim phun sung ihsin a um sun Bashan siangpahrang Og khal an neh. Og cu Ashtaroth le Edrei khua ihsin uktu a rak si."},"5":{"text":"A ram ukmi sungah Hermon Tlang le Salekah, Bashan peng pumpuluk, Geshur le Maakah mi pawl ih ramri tiang, Gilead ram hrek Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon ih ukmi ram tiang an tel."},"6":{"text":"Hi siangpahrang pawl cu Moses le Israel mi pawl in an neh. Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses in an ram cu a long, an co dingah Reuben hrin, Gad hrin le Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl hnenah a pek."},"7":{"text":"Jordan ihsin nitlaknak lam ram, Lebanon horkuam ih ummi Baalgad ihsin Seir lamah cun Halak Tlang tiang, Joshua le Israel mi pawl in an neh. Hi ram cu an miphun zat in Joshua in a ṭhen ih a kumkhua ih an co dingah a pek hai.","title":"Joshua Nehmi Siangpahrang Pawl"},"8":{"text":"Hi ram sungah hin tlangpar ram, nitlaknak ram, Jordan tiva kuam, tlanghram tluan pawl, nelrawn ram le Negev ram pawl an tel a si. Hi ram cu Hit mi, Amor mi, Kanaan mi, Periz mi, Hiv mi le Jebus mi pawl umnak ram a rak si."},"9":{"text":"An nehmi siangpahrang pawl cu: Jerikho siangpahrang, Ai siangpahrang (Bethel khua kiang),"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem siangpahrang, Hebron siangpahrang,"},"11":{"text":"Jarmuth siangpahrang, Lakhish siangpahrang,"},"12":{"text":"Eglon siangpahrang, Gezer siangpahrang,"},"13":{"text":"Debir siangpahrang, Geder siangpahrang,"},"14":{"text":"Hormah siangpahrang, Arad siangpahrang,"},"15":{"text":"Libnah siangpahrang, Adullam siangpahrang,"},"16":{"text":"Makkedah siangpahrang, Bethel siangpahrang,"},"17":{"text":"Tappuah siangpahrang, Hefer siangpahrang,"},"18":{"text":"Afek siangpahrang, Lasharon siangpahrang,"},"19":{"text":"Madon siangpahrang, Hazor siangpahrang,"},"20":{"text":"Shimron Meron siangpahrang, Akshaf siangpahrang,"},"21":{"text":"Taanak siangpahrang, Megiddo siangpahrang,"},"22":{"text":"Kedesh siangpahrang, Jokneam siangpahrang (Karmel ih um),"},"23":{"text":"Dor siangpahrang (Tifinriat kap ummi), Goiim siangpahrang (Galilee ih ummi), le"},"24":{"text":"Tirzah siangpahrang tla an si. An zatein siangpahrang sawmthum le pakhat an si."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua cu a tarzet thlang. Bawipa Pathian in, “Na tarzet thlang; asinain neh dingmi ram tampi a um lai.","title":"Neh Hrih Lomi Ram Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Neh hrih dingmi ram pawl cu: Filistin ram hmuahhmuah le Geshur ram hmuahhmuah,"},"3":{"text":"Izipt ramri ih a ummi Shihor tiva ihsin saklam ih Ekron ramri tiang a zatein Kanaan mi ramah siar a si; Filistin mi uktu pawl cu Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath le Ekron khua pawl ah an um; thlanglam ah Avvim peng hmuahhmuah,"},"4":{"text":"Kanaan mi ram, le Mearah peng (Mearah cu Sidon mi ram a si), Amor ramri kiangih a ummi Afek tiang;"},"5":{"text":"Gebal ram, nisuahnak lamah Lebanon ram hmuahhmuah, Hermon Tlang hramih a ummi Baal Gad ihsin Lebo Hamath tlangkawn tiang an si."},"6":{"text":"Hi sungah hin tlangpar ram: Lebanon tlang pawl le Misrefoth Maim karlakih a ummi Sidon mi hmuahhmuah an tel a si. Israel mi-ih an nor vete in himi pawl cu ka dawi thluh ding. Thu ka lo pek zo bangtuk in hi ram cu Israel mi-ih co dingah ṭhen awla zem aw."},"7":{"text":"Atu ihsin an co dingah Israel miphun phun kua le Manasseh phun a hrek pawl hnenah hi ram cu ṭhen awla zem aw,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Reuben hrin, Gad hrin le Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl ih comi ram cu Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lamah a si. Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses ih a pekmi ram cu hi ram pawl hi an si.","title":"Manasseh, Reuben Le Gad Comi Ram"},"9":{"text":"An ram cu Arnon Horkuam ri-ih a ummi, Aroer ihsin horkuam laifangih a ummi khawpi le Medeba rawn a zatein Dibon tiang a si."},"10":{"text":"Heshbon khua ihsin ram uktu Amor siangpahrang Sihon ih ukmi khawpi pawl a zatein Ammon ramri tiang a tel."},"11":{"text":"Gilead ram, Geshur mi le Maakah mi an umnak ram, Hermon Tlang a zatein, Bashan ram a zatein Salekah tiang a tel thluh."},"12":{"text":"Ashtaroth le Edrei ihsin ram uktu Og siangpahrang ih ukmi ram tla a tel. Og cu Refaim miphun sungih a taangsunmi a si. Himi pawl cu Moses ih rak nehmi le dawihlomi an si."},"13":{"text":"Asinain Geshur mi le Maakah mi pawl cu Israel mi in an dawi lo. Israel ram sungah an um lai a si."},"14":{"text":"Moses in Levi hrin pawl cu ram a pe lo. Ziangahtile Bawipa in Moses hnenih a rak tiamcia bangtuk in, Israel mi pawl in Bawipa hnenih mei-ur thawinak an pekmi pawl an co ding a si."},"15":{"text":"Moses in Reuben hnam pawl cu an hrin ciar in ram a pek.","title":"Reuben Hnenih Pekmi Ram"},"16":{"text":"An ram cu Arnon tiva kuam ri-ih a ummi, Aroer ihsin horkuam laifangih a ummi khawpi le Medeba kiangkapih a ummi hmunrawn hmuahhmuah a si;"},"17":{"text":"cun Heshbon le hmunrawnih khawpi: Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baalmeon,"},"18":{"text":"Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mefaath,"},"19":{"text":"Kiriathaim, Sibmah, hmunrawnih a ummi tlangpar khua Zereth Shahar,"},"20":{"text":"Beth Peor, Pisgah tlangtluan hmuahhmuah, Beth Jeshimoth,"},"21":{"text":"hmunrawnih khawpi dang pawl le Heshbon ah a um ih ram uktu Amor siangpahrang Sihon ih ukmi khawpi hmuahhmuah pawl an tel thluh a si. Siangpahrang Sihon cu Moses in a neh ih Midian ram uktu Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, le Reba pawl tla a neh. Hi bawi pawl cu siangpahrang Sihon kuthnuai ih ram uktu an si."},"22":{"text":"Israel mi ih an thahmi lakah Beor ih fapa, pol a si mi Balaam khal a tel a si."},"23":{"text":"Reuben hrinih ramri cu Jordan tiva a si. Hi khawpi pawl le khawte pawl cu Reuben hrin pawl an innsang tam le mal zoh in an zemmi a si."},"24":{"text":"Moses in Gad hrin pawl khal an innsang zoh in an co dingah ram a pek.","title":"Gad Hnenih Pekmi Ram"},"25":{"text":"An ram sungah cun Jazer le Gilead pengih khawpi hmuahhmuah; Ammon ram hrek, Rabbah ihsin nisuahnak lamih a ummi Aroer khua tiang;"},"26":{"text":"Heshbon ihsin Ramath Mizpah le Betonim tiang; Mahanaim ihsin Lodebar ramri tiang an tel."},"27":{"text":"Cule Jordan phairawn ah Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Sukkoth, Zafon le Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon ih ukmi ram a taangmi hmuahhmuah an tel thluh. Nitlaknak lamah an ramri cu Jordan tiva a si ih saklam ah Galilee Tili tiang a si."},"28":{"text":"Hi khawpi pawl le khawte pawl cu Gad hrin innsang pawl ih comi ram an si."},"29":{"text":"Moses in Manasseh hrin a hrek innsang pawl hnenah an co dingin ram a pek.","title":"Manasseh Hnenih Pekmi Ram"},"30":{"text":"An ram cu Mahanaim ihsin Bashan peng a zate le Bashan siangpahrang Og ih ukmi ram hmuahhmuah le Bashan peng sungih Jair ih khawte sawmruk pawl tla an tel."},"31":{"text":"Gilead ram a hrek, Bashan ram sung Og siangpahrang ih ukmi khawpi Ashtaroth le Edrei pawl an tel a si. Hi ram le khawpi pawl cu Manasseh ih fapa Makhir ih tefa hrekkhat innsang pawl hnenih pekmi an si."},"32":{"text":"Cuticun Jordan tiva le Jerikho khua ihsin nisuahnak lam ram cu Moab hmunrawnah Moses in a ṭhen a si."},"33":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Levi hrin pawl co dingah Moses in ram a pek lo. “Israel ih Pathian Bawipa hnenih pekmi cu nan covo a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi ih an lakmi Kanaan ram cu puithiam Eleazar, Nun ih fapa Joshua le Israel miphun hotu pawl in Israel mi hnenah an zem a si.","title":"Jordan Ihsin Nitlak Lam Ram An Zem Aw"},"2":{"text":"Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in Israel miphun phun kua le a hrek pawl ih co dingmi Jordan ihsin nitlaknak lam ram cu camcawhfung zuk in an ṭhen."},"3":{"text":"Jordan ihsin nisuahnak lam ram cu Moses in Israel miphun phun hnih le a hrek hnenah a pek zo; asinain Levi mi pawl hnenah ram a pek lo."},"4":{"text":"Josef ih tesinfa pawl cu ṭhen hnih ah an ṭhen aw; Manasseh le Efraim an si. Levi mi pawl cu comi ram an nei lo. Leiram ai-ah umnak khawpi an nei ih an caw le an ṭilva hrangah ṭilva tlannak leiram an nei."},"5":{"text":"Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in Kanaan ram cu Israel mi pawl in an zem aw."},"6":{"text":"Gilgal ah Judah mi pawl cu Joshua hnenah an ra. Keniz mi Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb cun Joshua hnenah, “Pathian ih minung Moses hnenah nangmah le keimah ih thu Bawipa in Kadesh Barnea timi hmunih a simmi cu na thei thluh zo.","title":"Hebron Cu Kaleb Hnenah An Pek"},"7":{"text":"Kadesh Barnea ihsin hi ram thlingthla dingah Bawipa siahhlawh Moses ih i thlah tikah kum sawmli ka rak ti. Ka feh hnuah felzetin Moses hnenah ka than."},"8":{"text":"Keimah thawn a fehtu pawl cun misenpi lung an phangter thluh. Asinain kei cun famkim zetin Bawipa ka Pathian ih thu cu ka thlun a si."},"9":{"text":"Cule Moses cun, ‘ Bawipa ka Pathian ih thu cu famkim zetin na thlun hrangah atuih na fehnak ram hi nangmah le na tefa pawl in nan co ding,’ i ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule vun ruat ve hnik! Cutiih Bawipa in Moses hnenih a sim cu kum sawmli le kum nga a si zo. A cuih caan ahcun Israel mi cu nelrawn sungih an feh lai caan a si ih, cuih sungah hin Bawipa in harhdam zetin i kilkhawi ringring a si. Atu-ah i zohhnik aw! Kum sawmriat le kum nga ka si zo."},"11":{"text":"Asinain tuih ni tiang Moses ih i rak thlah lai vek thotho in ka cak lai hrih. Raldo dingah siseh, a dang hnaṭuan ding vo ka neihmi ah siseh, ka cakzet lai hrih a si."},"12":{"text":"Cu a si ruangah kha laiih Bawipa ih i tiamkam cia bangtuk in atu-ah hi tlangpar ram cu i pe hram aw. Anak mi, mitum zetzet pawl cu ralhruang kulhmi khawpi pawl sungah an um, tiah acu laiah ka rak lo sim zo. Na hnenah ka um ding, tiih i tiam cia vekin ka hnenih Bawipa a um ngaingai a si ahcun acuih Anak pawl cu ka dawi thluh ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Joshua in Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb cu thlawsuah a pek ih a covo-ah Hebron khua a pek."},"14":{"text":"Keniz mi Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb in Israel ih Pathian Bawipa ih thu felzetih a thlun ruangah Hebron cu tuih san tiangin Kaleb tefa pawl ih ram a si."},"15":{"text":"A cuih hlanah Hebron cu Kiriath Arba khua tiah an ko. Arba cu Anak miphun lakih mi nasa bik a rak si. Cuticun an ram cu ral nei loin a cawl."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A hnuailam ih ram cu Judah hrinmi innsang khat ciarih comi ram a si: An ram cu thlanglam ah Edom ramri ihsin thlanglam bikih Zin nelrawn tiang a si.","title":"Judah Comi Ram"},"2":{"text":"Hi thlanglam an ramri cu Tipi Thi ih thlanglam tikel ihsin,"},"3":{"text":"thlanglam ah a vung ih Akrabbim tlangkawn ihsin Zin tiang a si. Cule Negev ihsin Kadesh Barnea tiang a hung ih Hezron a lan ih Addar tiang; cule Karka lamah a feh ih,"},"4":{"text":"Azmon lamih a feh hnuah Izipt ramri ih tiva thlun in Mediterranean Tifinriat a thleng ih cu tawkah a net. Judah ramih thlanglam ramri cu cu bangtuk in a si."},"5":{"text":"Nisuahnak lamih an ramri cu Tipi Thi a si ih saklam ah Tipi Thi sungih Jordan tiva a vung luhnak kaa tiang a si. Cutawk tikel ihsin saklam ramri a thok ih,"},"6":{"text":"Beth Hoglah le saklam sin ah Beth Arabah tiang a si. Cutawk ihsin saklam ah Bohan ih Lungpi tiang, Bohan cu Reuben ih fapa a si;"},"7":{"text":"cule Akhor, Harsatnak Horkuam an timi ihsin Debir tiang saklam ah a hung so ih horkuam thlanglam kapih a ummi Adummim tlangkawn a vun hoihtu Gilgal lamah a keel. Cutawk ihsin Enshemesh ih cirh pawl le Enrogel lamah a phei ih,"},"8":{"text":"Hinnom fapa ih phairawn an timi ihsin a so ih Jerusalem khua a umnak Jebus tlangtluan ih thlanglam ah a hung. Cule Refaim phairawn ih saklam zimah nitlaknak lam Hinnom phairawn thawn a zawn awmi tlang zim ihsin a hung."},"9":{"text":"Cutawkih tlang zim ihsin Neftoah ih Cerhti umnak ah a hung ih Efron Tlang kiangih khawpi pawl a hung thleng. Cule Baalah, a si lole Kiriath Jearim, lamah a keel ih,"},"10":{"text":"Baalah ih nitlaknak lam ihsin Seir tlang a vel ih Jearim, a si lole Khesalon, Tlang ihsin Beth hemesh a vung thleng ih Timnah a lan."},"11":{"text":"Cule an ramri cu Ekron ih saklam tlangtluan ah a hung feh ih Shikkeron lamah a keel ih Baalah Tlang a lan hnuah Jabneel a thleng. An ramri cu Mediterranean Tifinriat a thleng ih cutawk cu a netnak a si."},"12":{"text":"Nitlaknak lam ramri cu Mediterranean Tifinriat a si. Judah hrin sungkhat pawl ih ramri cu a tlunih kan timi bangtuk in a si."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in Joshua hnenih a sim bangtuk in Judah hrin Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb hnenah Judah mi pawl ih ram a hrekkhat cu pek a si. A cuih khua pakhat cu Hebron a si. Hebron cu Anak ih pa Arba ih khawpi a si.","title":"Kaleb In Hebron Le Debir A Neh (Thuṭ 1.11-15)"},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Anak ih fapa pathum, Sheshai, Ahiman, le Talmai pawl cu hi khua ihsin a dawi suak."},"15":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Kaleb cu a feh ih Kiriath Sefer ti ih an rak kawh ṭheumi, Debir khuami pawl a do."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Kaleb cun, “Kiriath Sefer khua a neh theitu cu ka fanu Aksah ka pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule Kaleb ih unau Kenaz ih fapa Othniel in cuih khua cu a lak; curuangah Kaleb in a fanu Aksah cu a pek."},"18":{"text":"A pasal Othniel hnenih a thlen tikah a pa Kaleb hnen ihsin lo pakhat dil dingah a pasal Othniel cun a rak fial. A fial vekin a pa Kaleb hnenah cun laak in a va feh. Laak par ihsin a ṭum tikah a pa cun, “Ziang so na poi?” tiah a rak sut."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Aksah in, “Thil ka lo dil duhmi a um. Negev ramcaar ih ram i pek ruangah tikhur kan ṭul ih i zaangfah hram aw,” tiah a ti. Curuangah a pa cun saklam tikhur le thlanglam tikhur a rak pek."},"20":{"text":"Judah hrin an innsang ciarih an comi ram cu hihi an si:","title":"Judah Ram Ih Khawpi Pawl"},"21":{"text":"An comi khawpi pawl, Edom ram kiangih a ummi, thlanglam bik khawpi pawl cu, Kapzeel, Eder, Jagur,"},"22":{"text":"Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,"},"23":{"text":"Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,"},"24":{"text":"Zif, Telem, Bealoth,"},"25":{"text":"Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (a si lole Hazor),"},"26":{"text":"Amam, Shema, Moladah,"},"27":{"text":"Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,"},"28":{"text":"Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,"},"29":{"text":"Baalah, Iim, Ezem,"},"30":{"text":"Eltolad, Khesil, Hormah,"},"31":{"text":"Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,"},"32":{"text":"Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain le Rimmon an si. A kiangkap ih khawte pawl thawn an zatein khua kul hluan kua an si."},"33":{"text":"Tlang hramih khawpi pawl cu, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah;"},"34":{"text":"Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,"},"35":{"text":"Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,"},"36":{"text":"Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, le Gederothaim an si. An kiangkapih khawte pawl thawn an zatein khua hleili an si."},"37":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,"},"38":{"text":"Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,"},"39":{"text":"Lakhish, Bozkath, Eglon,"},"40":{"text":"Kabbon, Lahmam, Khitlish,"},"41":{"text":"Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, le Makkedah khawpi pawl tla an tel. An kiangkapih khawte pawl thawn an zatein khua hleiruk an si."},"42":{"text":"Khawpi dang pawl cu Libnah, Ether, Ashan,"},"43":{"text":"Iftah, Ashnah, Nezib,"},"44":{"text":"Keilah, Akzib, le Mareshah an si. An kiangkapih khawte pawl thawn an zatein khua kua an si."},"45":{"text":"Cun Ekron khawpi, a kiangkapih ummi khawpi le khawte pawl le,"},"46":{"text":"Ekron le Tifinriat karlakih ummi, Ashdod khua kiangih khawte pawl tla an tel."},"47":{"text":"Cule Ashdod le Gaza tla, an kiangkapih khawte pawl thawn an tel ih Izipt ramri ih tiva le Mediterranean Tifinriat a thleng."},"48":{"text":"Tlangpar ramih khawpi pawl cu Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,"},"49":{"text":"Dannah, Kiriath Sefer (a si lole Debir),"},"50":{"text":"Anab, Eshtemoa, Anim,"},"51":{"text":"Goshen, Holon, le Giloh an si. An kiangkapih khawte pawl thawn khua hleikhat an si."},"52":{"text":"Cule a dang khawpi pawl cu Arab, Dumah, Eshan,"},"53":{"text":"Janim, Beth Tappuah, Afekah,"},"54":{"text":"Humtah, Kiriath Arba (a si lole Hebron), le Zior an si. An kiangkapih khawte pawl thawn khua kua an si."},"55":{"text":"Cule Maon, Karmel, Zif, Juttah,"},"56":{"text":"Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,"},"57":{"text":"Kain, Gibeah, le Timnah tla an si.An kiangkapih khawte pawl thawn khua hra an si."},"58":{"text":"A dang khawpi pawl cu Halhul, Bethzur, Gedor,"},"59":{"text":"Maarath, Beth Anoth, le Eltekon an si. An kiangkapih khawte pawl thawn khua ruk an si."},"60":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Kiriath Baal (a si lole Kiriah Jearim) le Rabbah tla an tel. An kiangih khawte pawl thawn khua hnih an si."},"61":{"text":"Nelrawn ramah Beth Arabah, Middin, Sekakah,"},"62":{"text":"Nibshan, Ci khawpi timi le Engedi khawpi pawl an um. An kiangkapih khawte pawl thawn khua ruk an si."},"63":{"text":"Asinain Jerusalem ih a ummi Jebus mi pawl cu Judah mi pawl in an dawisuak thei lo. Curuangah Jebus mi le Judah mi pawl cu tuih san tiangin Jerusalem khua ah an umtlang a si."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josef tesinfa pawl hnenih pekmi ramih thlanglam ramri cu Jerikho khua kiang Jordan tivakap um Jerikho cirhti ihsin nisuahnak lamah nelrawn ram tiang a si. Cule Jerikho khua ihsin tlangpar ramah Bethel tiang a hung feh.","title":"Efraim Le Nitlak Lam Manasseh Comi Ram"},"2":{"text":"Bethel ihsin Luz ah a feh ih Arkhi mi pawl an umnak Ataroth Addar ah a va phei."},"3":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin nitlaknak lamah Jaflet mi ram tiang a feh ih Thlanglam Beth Horon tiang a thleng. Cule Gezer ah a feh ih a netnak cu Mediterranean Tifinriat ah a si."},"4":{"text":"Josef ih tefa Manasseh le Ephraim hrin pawl in Nitlak lam Manasseh ram cu an co."},"5":{"text":"Efraim sungkhat pawl comi ram cu hihi a si. Nisuahnak lam an ramri cu Ataroth Addar ihsin Beth Horon tiang a hung thleng.","title":"Efraim"},"6":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin Mediterranean Tifinriat tiang a thleng. Saklam ih ramri cu Mikmethath a si. Nisuahnak lamih an ramri cu Taanath Shiloh lamah a keel ih acuih khua a lan hnuah Janoah tiang a thleng."},"7":{"text":"Cule Janoah ihsin Ataroth le Naarah ah a vung ih Jerikho khua ihsin Jordan tiva ah a net a si."},"8":{"text":"Cun nitlaknak lam ramri cu Tappuah ihsin Kanah tiva a thleng ih cutawk ihsin Mediterranean Tifinriat ah a net a si. Hi ram cu Efraim sungkhat pawl ih comi ram a si."},"9":{"text":"Manasseh ram sungih a ummi khawpi le khawte pawl thawn Efraim sungkhat pawl hnenih pekmi an si ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Gezer ih a ummi Kanaan mi pawl cu an dawi suak lo. Curuangah Efraim mi lakah Kanaan mi cu tuih san tiangin an um lai a si. Asinain sal hnaṭuan in an um."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh cu Josef ih fapa upa bik a si ruangah Jordan ihsin nitlaknak lam ram a hrekkhat cu Manasseh ih tefa pawl an pek. Cun Gilead ih pa Makhir cu Manasseh ih fapa upa bik a si ih ralkap hminthang a si. Curuangah Jordan ihsin nisuahnak lamih ummi Gilead le Bashan tla cu Makhir an pek.","title":"Nitlak Lam Manasseh"},"2":{"text":"Cun Manasseh ih tefa pawl Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shekhem, Hefer, le Shemida pawl tla ram an zem ve. Hi pawl cu Josef ih fapa Manasseh ih tefa pawl an si ih hrin khatih hotu ciar an si."},"3":{"text":"Asinain Manasseh ih fapa Makhir, Makhir ih fapa Gilead, Gilead ih fapa Hefer, Hefer ih fapa Zelofehad an si; cule Zelofehad in fapa pakhat hman a nei lo; fanu lawng a nei. A fanu pawl ih hmin tla cu: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, le Tirzah an si."},"4":{"text":"Anmah tla cu puithiam Eleazar, Nun ih fapa Joshua le an hotu pawl hnenah an ra ih, “Kanmah siseh, kan sungkhat pawl siseh, bangrep ih ram co ve dingah Bawipa in Moses hnenah thu a pek a si lo maw?” tiah an ra ti. Curuangah Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in an pa ih unau pawl lakah an covo ram cu an ngah sal a si."},"5":{"text":"Cutiih a fapa pawl vek thotho in Manasseh ih fanu pawl tla in ram covo an ngah ve ruangah Jordan tiva ralah Manasseh in Gilead le Bashan ih hlei ah a hleimi ram covo pahra a ngah sal a si. Gilead ram cu Manasseh fapa dang pawl hnenah an pek.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Manasseh ram cu Shekhem ih nisuahnak lamah Asher ihsin Mikmethath a thleng. An ramri cu Mikmethath ihsin thlanglam ah a vung ih Jashib Entappuah a thleng."},"8":{"text":"Tappuah ram cu Manasseh ta a si. Asinain ramri kapih a ummi Tappuah khua cu Efraim ih tefa pawl ta a si."},"9":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin an ramri cu Kanah tiva tiang a vung. Hi tiva ihsin thlanglam ih a ummi khawpi pawl cu Manasseh ih khawpi pawl lakah an um naón Efraim ih khawpi pawl an si. Manasseh ramih ramri cu acuih tiva-ih saklam kap tluan in a si ih Mediterranean Tifinriat ah a netnak a si."},"10":{"text":"Efraim ram cu thlanglam ah a si ih Manasseh ram cu saklam ah a si. An ram hnih ih nitlaknak lam ramri cu Mediterranean Tifinriat a si. Saklam ah Asher tiang, nisuahnak lamah Issakhar tiang a kau."},"11":{"text":"Cun Issakhar le Asher ram sung hmanah Beth Shean le a kiangkapih khua pawl, Ibleam ih a ummi pawl, (tipikap ih a ummi) Dor khua, Endor khua, Taanak khua, Megiddo khua le an kiangkap ciarih a ummi khua pawl hmuahhmuah cu Manasseh ta an si."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Manasseh mi pawl in acuih khua pawl ih a ummi Kanaan mi pawl cu an dawisuak thei lo ruangah tuih san tiangin an umta a si."},"13":{"text":"Israel mi pawl an cak deuh ngaingai tik hmanah Kanaan mi pawl cu an dawisuak lo; asinain Israel mi pawl anmah riantu ah an tuah hai."},"14":{"text":"Josef ih tefa pawl in Joshua hnenah, “Ziang hrangah so kan co dingah ram ṭhen khat lawnglawng in pek? Pathian in thlawsuah vanluh in pek ih kan minung cun kan tamzet. Ram kau deuh kan ṭul a si,” tiah an ti.","title":"Efraim Le Nitlak Lam Manasseh In Ram An Dil Sal"},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Joshua in, “Minung nan tam ih Efraim tlangpar ram nan hrangih a fiak tuk a si ahcun Periz ram le Refaim ramah hung feh uhla an ramih tupi pawl cu nan hrangah hung vaat uh,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Josef ih tefa pawl cun, “Atu kan umnak tlangpar ram cu kan hrangah a fiak tuk rori a si. Hmunrawnih a ummi Kanaan mi pawl cun thir rangleng tla an nei. Cuih tlunah Beth Shean le a kiangkap khawte sungih a ummi Kanaan mi pawl tla in an nei ve ih, Jezreel phairawnih a ummi pawl khal in thir rangleng cu an nei thluh a si,” tiah an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Joshua in Efraim le Nitlak lam Manasseh hrin pawl hnenah cun, “Minung nan tamzet ngai ih a cah khal nan cakzet a si. Curuangah covo pakhat hnakih tam deuh nan ngah ding."},"18":{"text":"Tlangpar ram cu nan ta a si pei. Tupi hlir asinain nan vaat pei ih khatlam kap ihsin khatlam kap tiang nan co pei. Kanaan mi pawl tla cu thir rangleng an neih ih an cahzet khalle nan dawisuak thotho ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kanaan ram an neh thluh hnuah Israel mi cu an zatein Shiloh ah an ra ih Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam inn an sak.","title":"A Taangmi Ram An ṭhen"},"2":{"text":"Israel miphun hleihnih sungah phun sarih cu ram covo nei hrih lo mi an si."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Joshua in an hnenah, “Nan pipu pawl ih Pathian, Bawipa ih a lo pekmi ram cu luah lohli loin ziangtik tiangso nan hngah ding?"},"4":{"text":"Hrin khat ihsin minung pathum fingfing ka hnenah ratter uhla hi ram sungah ka thlah ding. Hrin khat fingfingih co dingah a mawi tawkzawn a si tiih an hmuhnak bangtuk in a thuhla an ngan pei ih ka hnenah an ra kir pei."},"5":{"text":"Hi ram cu ṭhen sarih ah an ṭhen ding. Judah hrin cu anmah ih ram thlanglam ah an um pei ih Josef hrin cu anmah ih ram saklam ah an um pei."},"6":{"text":"Ram ṭhen ṭhen sarih ih thuhla cu nan ngan pei ih ka hnenah nan rak keng pei. Cuih hnuah nanmah ih ai-awh in Bawipa nan Pathian ih mithmuh ah camcawhfung zuhnak ka tuah ding."},"7":{"text":"Levi mi pawl cu nanmah vek in comi ram an nei lo ding. Ziangahtile an covo cu Bawipa ih puithiam hnaṭuan a si. Cun Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses ih a zem zo bangtuk in Gad, Reuben, le Manasseh hrinih a hrek pawl tla cu Jordan ihsin nisuahnak lamih ram an co zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Joshua ih a fial bangtuk in ram zohtu ding pawl cu an pok ih Joshua in an hnenah, “Ram kipah va feh uhla a thuhla va ngan uh. Cule ka hnenah ra sal uh. Nanmah ih ai-awh ah Shiloh ah hin Bawipa ih mithmuh ah camcawhfung zuhnak ka tuah ding a si,” tiah thu a cah."},"9":{"text":"Cuticun Kanaan ram khuazakipah an feh ih a thuhla cu ca sungah an ngan. Ram cu ṭhen sarih ah an ṭhen ih khua hmin pawl khal an ngan thluh. Cuih hnuah Shiloh ih an riahnak ahcun Joshua hnenah an ra kir sal."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Joshua in Bawipa ih mithmuh ah camcawhfung zuhnak cu a tuah ih ram ṭhen khat cu Israel hrin khat fingfing hnenah a zem."},"11":{"text":"Benjamin hrin pawl in camcawhfung an zuk ih an ngahmi ram cu Judah hrin le Josef hrin pawl ih comi karlak ram a si.","title":"Benjamin Hrin ih Comi Ram"},"12":{"text":"Saklam ah an ramri cu Jordan tiva ihsin a thok ih Jerikho ih tlangtluan tiang a hung so. Cuihsin nitlaknak lamah a phei ih tlangpar ram ihsin Bethaven nelrawn a thleng."},"13":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin Luz lamah a suk ih Luz tlangtluan (a si lole Bethel) a thleng ih Ataroth Addar ah a suk sal ih cuih hnuah Thlanglam Beth Horon ihsin thlanglam tlang tiang a si."},"14":{"text":"Cutawk tlang cu a vel ih Beth Horon tlang nitlaknak lam kap ihsin a suk sal ih Judah mi an umnak Kiriath Baal (a si lole Kiriath Jearim) khawpi a vung thleng. Cumi cu nitlaknak lam ramri a si."},"15":{"text":"Thlanglam ramri cu Kiriath Jearim khua kap ihsin a thok ih nitlaknak lamah a phei ih Neftoah Tipuut a va thleng."},"16":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin Hinnom fapa ih horkuam timi zawnih a ummi tlangtluan kap le Refaim horkuam ih saklam kapah a vung suak. Cule En Rogel lamah Jebus tlangtluan thlang ihsin Hinnom horkuam ah a vung thleng."},"17":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin En Shemesh ah a kel so ih Adummim Tlangkawn zawnih Geliloth ah a thleng. Reuben fapa Bohan ih Lungpi an timi ah a suk sal ih,"},"18":{"text":"Beth Arabah tlangtluan sak ihsin a lan ih Jordan Kuam a vung thleng."},"19":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin a so sal ih Beth Hoglah tlangtluan sak ihsin Tipi Thi saklam kap, Jordan tiva a vung luhnak ah a netnak a si. Himi cu thlanglam ramri a si."},"20":{"text":"Nisuahnak lam ramri cu Jordan tiva a si. Benjamin hrin pawl ih comi ramih ramri cu a tlunlam bangtuk in an si."},"21":{"text":"Benjamin hrin pawl ih an comi khawpi pawl cu Jerikho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,"},"22":{"text":"Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,"},"23":{"text":"Avvim, Parah, Ofrah,"},"24":{"text":"Khefar Ammoni, Ofni, le Geba an si. Khawpi hlei hnih le an kiangkapih khawte pawl tla an si."},"25":{"text":"A dang khawpi tla cu Gibeon, Ram Ah, Beeroth,"},"26":{"text":"Mizpah, Kefirah, Mozah,"},"27":{"text":"Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,"},"28":{"text":"Zela, Haelef, Jebus khua (Jerusalem timi), Gibeah, le Kiriath Jearim an si. Khawpi hlei li le an kiangkapih khawte pawl tla an si. Benjamin sungkhat pawl ih comi ram cu hipawl hi an si."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A pahnihnak ih zemmi cu Simeon hrin an si. An comi ram cu Judah hrinih comi ram a thleng.","title":"Simeon Hrin ih Comi Ram"},"2":{"text":"An ram sungah Beersheba (a si lole Sheba), Moladah,"},"3":{"text":"Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,"},"4":{"text":"Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,"},"5":{"text":"Ziklag, Beth Markaboth, Hazar Susah,"},"6":{"text":"Beth Lebaoth, le Sharuhen khawpi pawl an um. Khawpi hlei thum le an kiangkapih khawte pawl tla an si."},"7":{"text":"A dang khawpi pawl cu, Ain, Rimmon, Ether, le Ashan an si. Khawpi pali le an kiangkapih khawte pawl tla an si."},"8":{"text":"Hi khawpi kiangkapih a ummi khawte hmuahhmuah cu Baalath Beer le Negev ramih Ramah kiangkap tiangin an tel thluh a si. Himi cu Simeon hrin pawl ih an comi ram a si."},"9":{"text":"Judah ih comi ram cu an hrangih a kauh tuk ruangah an ram sungah Simeon hrin in comi ram an nei."},"10":{"text":"A pathumnak ih zemmi cu Zebulun hrin pawl ih comi ram a si. An ngahmi ram cu Sarid tiang a thleng.","title":"Zebulun Hrin ih Comi Ram"},"11":{"text":"An ramri cu Sarid ihsin nitlaknak lamah a so ih Mareal a thleng; Dabbesheth kap le Jokneam ihsin nisuahnak lamih tiva kap in a feh."},"12":{"text":"Sarid khua ihsin khatlam kapih ramri cu nitlaknak lamah a feh ih Kisloth Tabor ihsin Daberath ah a so ih Jafia a hung thleng."},"13":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin nisuahnak lamah a feh ih Gath Hefer le Eth Kazin a thleng ih Neah lamah a kel ih Rimmon lamzin a tan phah."},"14":{"text":"Saklam ramri cu Hannathon lamah a kel ih Iftah El horkuam ah a netnak a si."},"15":{"text":"An khawpi pawl cu Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, le Bethlehem an si. An zatein khawpi hleihnih an um ih an kiangkapah khawte pawl tla an um."},"16":{"text":"Hi khawpi le khawte pawl hmuahhmuah cu Zebulun hrin pawl ih comi an si."},"17":{"text":"A palinak ih zemmi ram cu Issakhar hrin pawl ih comi ram a si.","title":"Issakhar Hrin Ih Comi Ram"},"18":{"text":"An ram sungah cun Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,"},"19":{"text":"Hafaraim, Shion, Anaharath,"},"20":{"text":"Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,"},"21":{"text":"Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah, le Beth Pazzez khawpi pawl tla an um."},"22":{"text":"An ramri cu Tabor, Shahazumah, le Beth Shemesh khua pawl tla a dai phah ih Jordan tiva ah a netnak a si. An zatein khawpi hlei ruk an um ih an kiangkapah khawte dang pawl khal an um."},"23":{"text":"Hi khawpi le khawte pawl cu Issakhar hrin pawl ih comi ram a si."},"24":{"text":"A panganak ih zemmi cu Asher hrin pawl an si.","title":"Asher Hrin Ih Comi Ram"},"25":{"text":"An ram sungah Helkath, Hali, Beten, Aksaf,"},"26":{"text":"Allam Melek, Amad, le Mishal khawpi pawl an um. An ramri cu nitlaknak lamah Karmel le Shihor Libnath a thleng."},"27":{"text":"Cun nisuahnak lamah Beth Dagon lamah a kel ih Zebulun ramri dai phah in Iftah El horkuam ihsin saklam ah Beth Emek le Neiel a hung thleng. Cutawk ihsin a so sal ih Kabul,"},"28":{"text":"Ebdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, le Sidon khawtumpi tiang a hung thleng."},"29":{"text":"Cule Ramah lamah a kel ih ralhruang in kulhmi ṭai-ar khawpi a va thleng. Cun a kel sal ih Hosah ihsin Mediterranean Tifinriat ah a netnak a si. Khawpi dang pawl cu Mahalab, Akzib,"},"30":{"text":"Ummah, Afek, le Rehob an si. An zatein khawpi kul hluanhnih an um ih an kiangkapah khawte pawl tla an um."},"31":{"text":"Hi khawpi le khawte pawl cu Asher hrin pawl ih comi ram sungih ummi khua an si."},"32":{"text":"Paruknak ih zemmi cu Naftali hrin pawl an si.","title":"Naftali Hrin ih Comi Ram"},"33":{"text":"An ramri cu Helef ihsin Zaanannim ih a ummi sasua kung in a feh ih Adami-nekeb le Jabneel ihsin Lakkum tiang, cule Jordan ah a netnak a si."},"34":{"text":"Nitlaknak lamah cun a feh vivo ih Aznoth Tabor tiang a thleng; cutawk ihsin Hukkok ah a kel ih thlanglam ah Zebulun ramri, nitlaknak lamah Asher ramri le nisuahnak lamah Judah ramri Jordan tiva ah a netnak a si."},"35":{"text":"Ralhruang ih kulhmi khawpi pawl cu Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Khinnereth,"},"36":{"text":"Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,"},"37":{"text":"Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,"},"38":{"text":"Yiron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, le Beth Shemesh tla an si. An zatein khawpi hleikua an um ih an kiangkapah khawte pawl tla an um."},"39":{"text":"Hi khawpi le khawte pawl cu Naftali hrin pawl comi ram sungih ummi khua an si."},"40":{"text":"Pasarihnak ih an zemmi cu Dan hrin pawl an si.","title":"Dan Hrin ih Comi Ram"},"41":{"text":"An ram sungah Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,"},"42":{"text":"Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,"},"43":{"text":"Elon, Timnah, Ekron,"},"44":{"text":"Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,"},"45":{"text":"Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,"},"46":{"text":"Me Jarkon, le Rakkon khawpi pawl le Joppa khua ralkhat ih a ummi ram tla an tel."},"47":{"text":"Dan hrin pawl ih ram cu lon a si tikah Leshem ah Dan hrin pawl cu an feh ih an va do. A cuih khua cu an neh ih khawsungmi pawl an thah thluh. Anmah ih hrangah an ham ih an luahta. Cule an pu Dan ih hmin suangin cuih khawpi hmin cu Leshem ihsin Dan ah an thleng."},"48":{"text":"Hi khawpi le khawte pawl cu Dan hrin pawl ih comi ram sungih ummi khua an si."},"49":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ram an zem awk ṭheh tikah, Nun ih fapa Joshua khal a co dingah ram an pek ve.","title":"Ram Zem Netnak"},"50":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupekmi thlun in amah Joshua ih dilmi Efraim tlangpar ramih khawpi Timnath Serah an pek. Cuih khawpi cu Joshua in a sak sal ih cunah a umta."},"51":{"text":"Shiloh ih an sakmi Bawipa umnak Puanthlam sangka kiangah puithiam Eleazar, Nun ih fapa Joshua le Israel miphun pawl ih sungkhat ciar hotu pawl cun camcawhfung zuk in Bawipa ih duhnak vekin ram cu an zem aw. Cuticun ram an zem awknak cu an ṭheh a si."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Joshua hnenah,","title":"Rolnak Khawpi Pawl"},"2":{"text":"“Hitiin Israel mi hnenah sim aw, ‘Moses hnen ihsin ka lo sim zo vekin mithattu an rolnak ah khawpi pawl hril uh."},"3":{"text":"Tumtahnak zianghman nei loih mi a that pangtu an um tikah phuhlamtu hnen ihsin an luatnak dingah nan hrilmi khawpi pawl cu an rolnak hmun a si pei."},"4":{"text":"Mithattu cu hi khawpi pakhatkhatah a tlan pei ih khawsung luhnak kotka ah cawl tahrat in khawsung upa pawl hnenah a thuhla cu a sim pei. Cuih hnuah khawsungah an lutter pei ih a umnak hmun an ngaihtuah sak pei."},"5":{"text":"Phuhlam duhtu in cutawk khua tiang a rak dawi asile a kut sungah mithattu cu pe hlah hai seh. Huat awknak zianghman nei loin a thah pang a si ruangah khawsung mi in an rak hum pei."},"6":{"text":"Khawsung misenpi hmaiih a thu an rel hlan sung le, culai ih Puithiam Sang a thih lai hlan lo, acuih khua ah a um ringring pei. Cuih hnuah a duh a si ahcun a ra tlannak khua ah a kir thei sal ding,’ tiin sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Jordan in nitlaknak lamah Naftali tlangpar ram Galilee pengah Kedesh khua, Efraim tlangpar ramah Shekhem khua, Judah tlangpar ramah Kiriath Arba (cucu Hebron) khua,"},"8":{"text":"Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lamah Jerikho khua in nisuahnak kapih a ummi tlangrawn ah Reuben hrin pawl ram Bezer khua, Gad hrin pawl ih ram sung Gilead ah Ramoth khua, le Manasseh hrin pawl ih ram sung Bashan ah Golan khua an hril."},"9":{"text":"Hi khua pawl cu Israel mi hrangah siseh, anmah ih lakih a ummi ramdangmi hrangah siseh, an rolnak hrangih hrilmi an si. Tumtahnak nei loih mi a that pangtu cu hi khua pawlah hin humhimnak an ngah pei. Cu tawkah misenpi hmaiah a thu an rel hlanah cun phuhlamtu in an that thei lo ding a si."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Levi hrin hotu pawl cu puithiam Eleazar, Nun ih fapa Joshua le Israel miphun an hrin ciarih hotu pawl hnenah an ra ih,","title":"Levi Mi Ih Khawpi Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Kanaan ramih an riahnak Shiloh ahcun an hnenah, “Moses hnen ihsin Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in kan umnak hrangah khawpi pawl le kan ṭilva hrangah tlimno umnak ram cu in pe ve hram uh,” tiah an ra dil."},"3":{"text":"An dil vek le Bawipa ih thupekmi bangtuk in Israel mi pawl cun anmah ih comi ram sung ihsin khawpi le ṭilva tlannak ram pawl cu Levi mi hnenah an pek."},"4":{"text":"Levi mi lakah hmaisa bikih khawpi pekmi pawl cu Kohath hrin an si. Puithiam Aaron ih cithlahmi Levi mi pawl cu Judah, Simeon, le Benjamin hrin pawl ih ram ihsin khawpi hleithum an pek."},"5":{"text":"A taangmi Kohath hrin pawl cu Efraim, Dan le Nitlak lam Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl ih ram ihsin khawpi pahra an pek."},"6":{"text":"Cun Gershon mi pawl cu Issakhar, Asher, Naftali le Bashan ih a ummi Nisuah lam Manasseh hrin pawl ih ram ihsin khawpi hleithum an pek."},"7":{"text":"Merar hrin pawl cu Reuben, Gad le Zebulun hrin pawl ih ram sungin khawpi hleihnih an pek."},"8":{"text":"Cuticun Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupek bangtuk in camcawhfung zuuk in Israel mi pawl cun an khawpi pawl le ṭilva tlannak ram pawl tla cu Levi mi hnenah an pek a si."},"9":{"text":"Judah le Simeon phun pawl ih khawpi pawl lak ihsin Levi mi,"},"10":{"text":"Aaron tefa pawl lakih Kohath sungkhat pawl an pekmi khawpi cu hihi an si. Anmah cu hmaisa bikih pekmi an si."},"11":{"text":"Judah tlangpar ram Hebron timi Kiriath Arba khua le a kimvel ram cu Kohath mi hnenah an pek. Arba cu Anak ih pa a si."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Kiriath Arba khua kiangih lo le khawte pawl cu Jefunneh ih fapa Kaleb an pek."},"13":{"text":"Cun puithiam Aaron ih tefa pawl hnenih an pekmi khua (mithattu rolnak) Hebron khua tlunah Libnah,"},"14":{"text":"Jattir, Eshtemoa,"},"15":{"text":"Holon, Debir,"},"16":{"text":"Ain, Juttah, le Beth Shemesh khua pawl, an kiangkap ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an pek a si. Judah le Simeon phun pawl ih ram sungin khawpi pakua pek an si."},"17":{"text":"Cule Benjamin hrin pawl ih ram sung in Gibeon, Geba,"},"18":{"text":"Anathoth le Almon khua pawl, khawpi pali cu an ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an pek."},"19":{"text":"Puithiam Aaron ih tefa pawl puithiam hna a ṭuantu pawl hnenah an ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn a zatein khawpi hleithum an pek."},"20":{"text":"Levi miphun Kohath ih hrin pawl cu Efraim hrin ram sungin khawpi hrekkhat pek an si."},"21":{"text":"An pekmi cu Efraim tlangpar ramih ummi Shekhem khua le a kiangkap ram pawl (Shekhem cu mi thattu rolnak ih hrilmi khua a si), Gezer khua,"},"22":{"text":"Kibzaim khua le Beth Horon khua, an ṭilva tlannak ram thawn a zatein khawpi pali an si."},"23":{"text":"Dan hrin pawl ih hnen in Eltekeh, Gibbethon,"},"24":{"text":"Aijalon, le Gath Rimmon, a zatein khawpi pali cu an ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an pek."},"25":{"text":"Nitlaknak lam Manasseh a hrek ram in Taanak le Gath Rimmon khawpi pahnih cu an ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn pek an si."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah Kohath ih hrin pawl cun an ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn khawpi pahra an co."},"27":{"text":"Levi hrin a si vemi Gershon mi pawl cun nisuahnak lamih ummi Manasseh hrin pawl hnen ihsin khawpi pahnih an co. Bashan pengah mi thattu rolnak khua Golan khua le, Be Eshterah khua, an ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an co."},"28":{"text":"Issakhar hrin hnen ihsin Kishion, Daberath,"},"29":{"text":"Jarmuth, le En Gannim khawpi pawl, an kiangkapih ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn, khawpi pali an co."},"30":{"text":"Asher hrin hnen ihsin, Mishal, Abdon,"},"31":{"text":"Helkath le Rehob khawpi pawl, khawpi pali, an kiangkapih ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an ngah a si."},"32":{"text":"Naftali hrin hnen ihsin, Galilee pengih Kedesh khua (Kedesh cu mithattu rolnak khua a si), Hammoth Dor khua le Kartan khua pawl, khawpi pathum, an kiangkapih ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an ngah."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah Gershon hrin pawl ih ngahmi khawpi pawl cu a kiangkapih ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn a zatein hleithum a si."},"34":{"text":"Levi hrin thotho a si mi Merari mi pawl cun Zebulun hrin hnen ihsin Jokneam, Kartah,"},"35":{"text":"Dimnah le Nahalal khawpi pawl, a zatein khawpi pali, an kiangkapih ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an ngah."},"36":{"text":"Reuben hrin hnen ihsin Bezer, Jahaz,"},"37":{"text":"Kedemoth, le Mefaath khua pawl, khawpi pali, an kiangkapih ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an ngah."},"38":{"text":"Gad hrin hnen ihsin Gilead pengah Ramoth (Ramoth cu mithattu rolnak khua) le Mahanaim,"},"39":{"text":"Heshbon, le Jazer khua pawl, khawpi pali, an kiangkapih ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an ngah."},"40":{"text":"Curuangah Levi hrin Merari mi pawl in a zatein khawpi hleihnih an co a si."},"41":{"text":"Israel ih comi ram sung ihsin a zatein khawpi sawmli le pariat cu Levi mi hnenah an pek a si."},"42":{"text":"Hi khawpi pawl kiangkapah ṭilva tlannak ram a um thluh."},"43":{"text":"Bawipa in an pupa pawl hnenih a rak tiam cia bangtuk in Israel mi hnenah Kanaan ram cu a pek. Ram an lak ṭheh tikah umhmun an khuar ih an um.","title":"Israel Mi In Kanaan Ram An Luah"},"44":{"text":"Cule an pupa pawl hnenih a rak tiam cia bangtuk in an ram sung le an kiangkap hmunkipah daihnak a um. Bawipa in nehnak a pek ruangah an ral ziang bangtuk hman in Israel mi cu an neh dah lo."},"45":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi hnenih a tiamkammi hmuahhmuah cu pakhat hman a pelh mi a um lo; a zatein a kim thluh a si."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua in Reuben mi, Gad mi le Nisuahnak lam Manasseh mi a hrek pawl cu hmun khatah a ko ih an hnenah,","title":"Joshua In An Ramah A Tlunter"},"2":{"text":"“ Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses ih thupekmi hmuahhmuah cu nan thlun ṭheh ih keimah ih thupekmi tla a zatein nan thlun thluh."},"3":{"text":"Tuihsun tiangah hin nan unau Israel mi pawl voikhat hman nan tlansan hrih lo. Tuihsun tiangah hin Bawipa nan Pathian ih thupekmi cu felzetin nan thlun a si."},"4":{"text":"Atu-ah an hnenih a rak tiam cia bangtuk in nan unau Israel mi pawl hnenah Bawipa in colhnak a pek. Curuangah Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses ih a lo pekmi nan ram, Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lamah cun va tlung thlang uh."},"5":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses in, ‘ Bawipa nan Pathian cu duhdaw uh; a lamzin in feh uhla a thukham thlun uh; Bawipa cu hngette in pom uh; nan thinlung le nan nunnak zate thawn a hna ṭuan uh,’ tiih thu a lo pekmi cu felfai zetin thlun suak tum uh,” tiah thu a cah."},"6":{"text":"Cule Joshua in thlawsuah a pek ih an khua ah an tlung."},"7":{"text":"Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl cu Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lam Bashan timi pengah Moses in leiram a pek; asinain a hrek cu hrindang pawl thawn hmun khatah Jordan tiva ihsin nitlaknak lamah leiram a pek. Reuben hrin, Gad hrin le Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl cu an khua ih an tlun tikah Joshua in,"},"8":{"text":"“Atu nan khua ciarah, sumsaw le ṭilva tampi, sui, ngun, dar, thir le hnipuan tampi thawn lianzet in nan tlung a si. Nan ral hnen ihsin nan lonmi hi thilri pawl cu nan unau Israel mi pawl thawn va zem-aw uh,” tiah thu a cah."},"9":{"text":"Cutiin Reuben hrin, Gad hrin le Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl cu Jordan tiva nisuahnak lamah an khua ah an tlung.
