Kanaan ram Shiloh ih an riahnak ahcun Israel midang pawl cu an taanta ih Bawipa in Moses hnen ihsin thu a pek zomi vekin an comi anmah ih ram Gilead ahcun an feh."},"10":{"text":"Kanaan ram, Jordan tiva kapih a ummi Geliloth an thlen tikah Reuben hrin, Gad hrin le Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl cun tiva kapah cun biakṭheng tumzet pakhat cuang zetin an don.","title":"Jordan Tiva Kap Ah Biakṭheng"},"11":{"text":"Cutikah, “Ruat hnik uh, Reuben hrin, Gad hrin le Manasseh hrinih a hrek pawl cun Jordan tiva khatlam kap, Kanaan ramri kiang, Geliloth ah biakṭheng an don a si,” tiah mi in an rel ciamco."},"12":{"text":"Cumi cu Israel mipi in an theih tikah an zatein Shiloh ahcun an khawm-aw ih Reuben hrin, Gad hrin le Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl cu do an tum."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah puithiam Eleazar ih fapa Finehas cu Israel mi in Gilead ram Reuben hrin, Gad hrin le Nisuahlam Manasseh hrin a hrek pawl hnenah an thlah."},"14":{"text":"Amah lawng si loin Israel hrin khat in pakhat ciar hotu pahra Finehas thawn an feh. Cuih palai pawl cu hrin khatih lu bik ciar an si."},"15":{"text":"Gilead ramah cun an thleng ih Reuben mi, Gad mi le Nisuah lam Manasseh mi a hrek pawl hnenah,"},"16":{"text":"“Zianghrangah hi bangtuk thil ṭha lo cu Israel ih Pathian hmaiah nan tuah? Hi biakṭheng nanmah hrangih nan don ruangah Bawipa nan dodal a si. Amah nan thlun nawn lo."},"17":{"text":"Peor ah Israel mi sualnak ruangih Bawipa in a minung pawl a hrem kha nan ciing lo maw si? A cuih sualnak ruangah atu tiangin kan tuar lai hrih a si. Cuhmuah cu a tawk thlang lo maw?"},"18":{"text":"Atu in maw Bawipa cu nan dungtun ding? Bawipa tuihsun nan dodal a si ahcun thaisun ah Israel misenpi parah a thin a heng ding."},"19":{"text":"Cule nan ram hi a baal zo ih Bawipa biaknak hrangih a tlak nawn lo nan ti a si ahcun Bawipa ih ram a puanthlam umnak ah ra uh. Kanmah ih lakah covo ra la uh. Sikhalsehla Bawipa kan Pathian biakṭheng siar lo biakṭheng dang nanmah ih hrangah sak tahrat in Bawipa cu dodal hlah uh; kannih tla Bawipa dodaltu-ah in canter hlah uh."},"20":{"text":"Siatsuah thluh ding tiih thupekmi Zerah fapa Akhan in a thlun duh lo ruangah Israel pumpi in hremnak kan tuar kha nan cing nawn lo maw si? Akhan sualnak ruangah hin amah lawng a thi a si lo,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Reuben mi, Gad mi le Manasseh mi a hrek pawl in Israel miphun hotu pawl hnenah cun,"},"22":{"text":"“Ziangkimtithei Pathian! Amah cu Bawipa a si! Ziangkimtithei Pathian! Amah cu Bawipa a si! Hi thil kan tuahnak thu hi Bawipa amah in a thei; Israel mi khal in nan theih a ṭul a si. Bawipa kan dodal ih kan zuarthlai a si ahcun tuihsun ah hin in nunter hlah uh."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa ih thu thlun loin kan hersan ih kanmah hrangih mei-ur thawinak, thlairawl thawinak le remnak thawinak dingah biakṭheng kan don a si ahcun Bawipa amah rori in in hrem seh."},"24":{"text":"Hitiih biakṭheng kan donnak cu ziangruangah a si tile: hmailamah nan tefa pawl in, ‘Israel ih Pathian, Bawipa thawn ziang peh awknak so nan neih?"},"25":{"text":"Reuben mi le Gad mi pawl, nannih le kannih karlakih ramri si dingah Pathian in Jordan tivapi a tuah zo. Bawipa thawn nannih cu pehtlaihnak nan nei nawn lo,’ tiah kan tefa pawl hnenah an ti pang ding, ti kan phan ruangah a si. Cutiin ti ngaingai hai sehla nan tefa pawl in kan tefa pawl cu Pathian biak an kham a si lo ding maw?"},"26":{"text":"Curuangah peknak le meisa-ur thawinak tuahnak hrangah si loin,"},"27":{"text":"Bawipa cu mei-ur thawinak le raithawinak le remnak thawinak tla thawn a Puanthlam thianghlim hmaiah kan biak a si, ti kha nanmah le kanmah karlakah siseh, nan tefa le kan tefa karlak khalah siseh, hminsinnak le thutheitu ah hi biakṭheng cu kan don a si. Hitiih kan tuah asile nan tefa pawl in kan tefa pawl cu, ‘ Bawipa thawn zianghman pehtlaihnak nan nei lo,’ tiah hmailamah an ti thei lo ding."},"28":{"text":"Cutiih an ti hman ah kannih in, ‘Zoh uh, Bawipa ih biakṭheng vek rori in kan pupa pawl in biakṭheng pakhat an don ve a si. Thawinak hrang le mei-ur thawinak hrangah si loin kan pahnih karlakih hminsinnak thutheitu ah a si,’ kan ti thei ding, tiah kan ruahnak a si."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa amah umnak Puanthlam hmaiih a ummi Bawipa kan Pathian ih biakṭheng siar lo, mei-ur thawinak le thawinak dang le thlairawl thawinak hrangah a dang biakṭheng pakhat don tahratin Bawipa cu dodal kan tum hrimhrim lo. Amah thlun lo khalin um kan tum lo a si,” tiah an ti."},"30":{"text":"Cutiih an ti cu puithiam Finehas le a hnenih a telmi Israel phun hotu pawl in an theih tikah Reuben mi, Gad mi le Nisuah lam Manasseh mi a hrek tlunah cun an lung a awi ngaingai."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah Reuben mi, Gad mi le Manasseh mi hnenah puithiam Eleazar ih fapa Finehas cun, “ Bawipa nan dodal lo hrangah Bawipa cu kan hnenah a um a si, ti kan thei. Bawipa ih cawhkuannak tuar lotein Israel mi pawl cu nan luatter a si,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cule Finehas le Israel phun hotu pawl cu Gilead ramih ummi Reuben mi le Gad mi hnen ihsin an kir ih Kanaan ramih ummi Israel mi hnenah cuih thuhla cu an va sim."},"33":{"text":"An simmi thu an theih tikah Israel mi cu an lung a awi ngaingai. Pathian an thangṭhat ih Reuben mi le Gad mi an umnak ram siatsuah dingih ral thawh ding thu cu an rel nawn lo."},"34":{"text":"Reuben mi le Gad mi pawl in an donmi biakṭheng cu “Theihpitu,” tiah an ko; ziangahtile “ Bawipa cu Pathian a si, ti kha kan zate hrangah theihpitu a si,” an ti."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tikcu a hung rei ih an kiangkapih an ral pawl thawn daihnak Bawipa in Israel mi hnenih a pek hnuah Joshua cu a tarzet thlang.","title":"Joshua Ih Thucahmi"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi hmuahhmuah an upa pawl, an hruaitu pawl, thureltu pawl le an bawi pawl thawn a ko ih, “Kei hi ka tarzet thlang."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian in nanmah ih ruangah hi ramih a rak ummi miphun pawl parah thil a tuahmi cu nan hmu thluh zo. Nanmah lam ṭang in Bawipa nan Pathian in ral a do a si."},"4":{"text":"Ngai uh; kan neh hrih lomi miphun pawl siseh, kan neh zomi nisuahnak lamah Jordan ihsin nitlaknak lamah Mediterranean Tifinriat tiang a ummi miphun pawl siseh, nanmah ih pawl nan co dingah ka lo pe zo a si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian in hi miphun pawl cu nan hmai ihsin a dawi ding ih an tlan vivo ding. Cule Bawipa nan Pathian ih a lo tiamkam vekin an ram cu nan luah ding."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah cakzet le fimkhur zetin nung uh. Moses ih pekmi Daan cabu sungih an ngan vekin tuah uhla thlun uh; malte hman vorhlamah siseh, kehlamah siseh, pial hlah uh."},"7":{"text":"Nanmah lakih a taang hrihmi hi ram minung pawl thawn cawkrawi-aw in ṭhi-aw hlah uh; an khawzing pawl ih hmin tla sal hlah uh, an hmin in siatcamnak khal tuah hlah uh, an hna khal ṭuan hlah uhla an hmaiah nan lu khal kun hlah uh."},"8":{"text":"Tuihsun tiang Bawipa nan pomhnget bangin hmailam khalah pomhnget ringring uh."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa in a cakmi le a nasazetmi miphun cu, hmailam nan nor vivo tikah, a rak dawi ih a lo do theitu zohman an um hrih lo."},"10":{"text":"A lo tiamkam bangtuk in nanmah ṭan in Bawipa nan Pathian in a do ruangah nanmah lakih mi pakhat hman in nan ral thawngkhat nan dawi thei a si."},"11":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah Bawipa nan Pathian duhdawtu si dingah fimkhur zetin nung uh."},"12":{"text":"Dunglet her tahrat in nan kiangih a um hrih mi miphun pawl hi nan kom ih nan ṭhit awk a si ahcun,"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian in hi miphun pawl cu a dawi nawn lo ding, ti kha atu ihsin thei cia uh. Nan hrangah korhrum bangtuk le thang bangtuk in ṭihnungza an si pei ih nan zaang vuaknak fung le nan mit sungih hling bangin nan tuar ding. Bawipa nan Pathian in a lo pekmi hi ramṭha ihsin nan cem thluh lai hlan lo cuticun nan tuar ding a si."},"14":{"text":"“Kei cu ka thi cing ding. Bawipa nan Pathian in thil ṭha a lo tiamkammi hmuahhmuah cu a zatein tlamtling zetin a kimter thluh zo, ti cu nan thinlung zatein nan theih kerker thluhmi a si. A tiamkammi hmuahhmuah cu a kimter thluh zo, pakhatte hman a pelh lo."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian in tuahsuak ding ih a lo tiamkam mi hmuahhmuah cu a tuah ṭheh zo a si. Sikhalsehla nan tlunih thil ṭha a tuahsuaktu Pathian ih thu nan thlun lo a si ahcun nan parah thil ṭha lo a thlenter ding."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian in thlun ding tiih thu a lo pekmi thukamnak cu nan thlun lo ih khawzing dangdang tla nan thlun ih nan biak sawn a si ahcun nan parah a thin a heng ding ih a lo pek ciami hi ram ṭha-ah hin milai pakhat hman taang loin nan cemral thluh ding a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shekhem ah Israel mi pawl cu an zatein Joshua in a ko ṭheh. Upa pawl, hotu pawl, thureltu pawl le bawi pawl an zatein a ko ih Pathian hmaiah cun an rak suak ciar.","title":"Shekhem Ah Joshua In Thu A Sim"},"2":{"text":"Cule Joshua in an hnenah, “Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cun nan hnenah hiti in a ti: ‘Hlanlaipi ah nan pupa pawl cu Eufrates Tiva ih khatlam ralah an rak um ih khawzing dangdang an rak biak. A cuih nan pupa lakih pakhat cu Abraham le Nahor ih pa Terah a si."},"3":{"text":"Cun Eufrates tiva ral ihsin Abraham cu ka lakih Kanaan ram khawzakipah ka hruai. Tefa tampi tla ka pek. A fapa Isaak ka pek ih,"},"4":{"text":"Isaak hnenah Jakob le Esau tla ka pek. Cule Seir timi tlangpar ram cu a co dingah Esau ka pek ih Jakob le a faale pawl cu Izipt ramah an vung feh."},"5":{"text":"Cun Moses le Aaron ka ko ih Izipt ramah siatnak tampi ka thlenter. Cuih hnuah nan zatein ka lo hruaisuak."},"6":{"text":"Nan pu le nan pa pawl cu Izipt ram ihsin ka hruai suak ih Tipi Sen an thleng. Izipt mi pawl in an rangleng le rang ralkap pawl thawn an rak dawi."},"7":{"text":"Mangbang vansaang in Israel mi pawl in ka hnenih an au tikah anmah le Izipt mi pawl karlakah khawthim ka ret. Izipt mi pawl tlunah tipi ka ratter ih tidai in a khuh thluh hai. Izipt mi pawl tlunih ka thil tuahmi cu nan mit in nan hmu. “‘Hramlak nelrawn ah caan reipi nan um."},"8":{"text":"Cule Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lamih a ummi Amor mi ram ah ka lo thlenpi. An lo do naón nehnak cu nan hnenah ka lo pek. An ram nan lak ih nan fehnak kipah anmah cu ka siatsuah vivo."},"9":{"text":"Cule Zippor ih fapa Moab siangpahrang Balak in Israel mi cu a lo do. Cuih tlunah Beor ih fapa Balaam hnenah nanmah cam dingah thu a cah."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Balaam ih thu cu ka ngai lo; thlawsuahnak sawn a lo pek hai ih cutiin Balak ih huham sung ihsin ka lo luatter hai a si."},"11":{"text":"Cun Jordan tiva nan tan ih Jerikho khua nan thleng. Cutikah Jerikho khua mi lawng si loin Amor mi, Periz mi, Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Girgash mi, Hiv mi le Jebus mi pawl in an lo do. Asinain an zate ih tlunah nehnak ka lo pe."},"12":{"text":"Lungphan thinlaunak nan hmaiah ka thlah ih cumi in Amor siangpahrang pahnih cu a dawi hai a si; nan ralnam le nan li cahnak zianghman a tel lo."},"13":{"text":"Nan ṭuan dah lomi loram ka lo pe ih nan sak dah lomi khawpi pawl ah nan um; nan ciin dah lomi sabit hri ihsin sabit nan ei ih nan phun dah lomi tanluan kuang ihsin tanluan rah nan ei a si,’ a ti."},"14":{"text":"“Curuangah Bawipa cu ṭihzahnak thawn biak uhla amah ih hna cu rintlakzet le thinlung taktein ṭuan uh. Nan pupa pawl in Mesopotamia ram le Izipt ramih an rak biakmi khawzing dangdang pawl cu hnong thlang uhla Bawipa cu rian uh."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa nan ren duh lo a si ahcun tuihsun ah hin hril uh; Mesopotamia ram nan pupa pawl ih an rak biakmi khawzing pawl maw nan biak sawn ding; a si lole atuih nan umnak ram Amor miphun pawl ih khawzing pawl deuh so nan biak ding, hril uh. Kei le ka innsang cun Bawipa kan biak ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi pawl cun, “ Bawipa tlansan tahratin khawzing dangdang biak ding cu kan tum dah lo ding."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian in kan pupa pawl siseh, kanmah siseh, Izipt ram sung saltaannak ihsin in suah ih thil mangbangza a tuahmi pawl cu kan hmu zo. Miphun tampi lakah kan feh ih kan fehnak kipah amah in himte in in kilkhawi."},"18":{"text":"Hmailam kan feh vivo tikah Bawipa amah thotho in hi ram sungih a ummi miphun le Amor mi pawl cu a dawi thluh a si. Curuangah kannih khal Bawipa kan biak ve ding. Amah cu kan Pathian a si,” tiah an ti."},"19":{"text":"Joshua in an hnenah, “ Bawipa cu nan rian thei lem pei maw? Ziangahtile amah cu a thianghlimmi Pathian a si ih thiik nei Pathian a si. Nan mawhnak le nan sualnak khal a lo ngaithiam lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa tlansan tahratin ramdang khawzing nan biak a si ahcun nan parah caan reipi rak ṭha zo hman sehla amah in a lo ral ding ih a lo hrem ding; a lo siatsuah ṭheh hai ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi pawl in Joshua hnenah, “A si lo, Bawipa lawnglawng kan rian ding a si,” tiah an ti."},"22":{"text":"Cule Joshua in, “Amah ih hnaṭuan tum in Bawipa nan hrilnak thu a theitu cu nanmah lala nan si,” tiah a ti. Annih in, “A si, kanmah hi thutheitu kan si,” an ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Joshua in, “Cuti asile nan lakih a ummi ramdang pathian lem pawl cu hlon thluh thlang uhla Israel ih Pathian Bawipa hnenah nan thinlung cu pe thluh uh,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Israel misenpi in, “ Bawipa kan Pathian kan biak ding ih amah thupekmi kan thlun ding,” tiah an ti."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah Joshua in cuihsun ah thukamnak cu Israel mi hrangah a tuah ih Shekhem ahcun daan le an thlun ding mi pawl a pek."},"26":{"text":"A cuih daan pawl cu Joshua in Pathian ih pekmi Daan cabu sungah a ngan. Cule Joshua in lungto tumpi a lak ih Pathian hmun thianghlim ih sasua kung hnuai ah a phun."},"27":{"text":"Cun an hnenah, “Hi lungphun hi zohhnik uh! Kan karlakah kan thu in theihpitu a si ding. Bawipa in kan hnenih a simmi thu hmuahhmuah cu hi lungphun in a thei thluh. Curuangah nan Pathian dodal tahratih ral nan thawh lonak dingah kan thu in theihpitu lungphun a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cule misenpi cu Joshua in a ṭiakter ih anmah ih comi ram ciar ah an tlung."},"29":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Nun ih fapa Joshua, Bawipa siahhlawh cu kum za le kum hra a kimah a thi.","title":"Joshua Le Eleazar An Thi"},"30":{"text":"Gaash tlang ihsin saklam, Efraim tlangram ih a ummi amah ih ram sung Timnath Serah ah an phum."},"31":{"text":"Joshua a nun sung hmuahhmuah ah Israel mi cun Bawipa an biak ih a thih hnu khalah Israel hrangih Bawipa ih thil timi a thei thluhtu Israel hotu pawl an nun sung cu Bawipa an biak thotho."},"32":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl in an kenmi Josef ruh pawl cu Shekhem ah an phum. Cuih an phumnak hmun cu Shekhem ih pa Hamor tesinfa hnen ihsin Jakob in ngun tangka zakhat in a leimi a si. Josef tesinfa pawl in ro ih an comi a si."},"33":{"text":"Aaron ih fapa Eleazar a thi ih Efraim tlangram ih a ummi a fapa Finehas an pekmi Gibeah khua ah an phum."}}}}},"7":{"info":{"name":"Thuṭhentu","shortname":"Thuṭ","abbr":[],"desc":"Thuṭhentu (judges)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua a thih hnuah Israel mi pawl in, “Kanmah lakah Kanaan mi pawl do ding in zo hrin so a feh hmaisa bik ding?” tiah Bawipa an sut.","title":"Adonibezek An Kai"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Judah hrin pawl an feh hmaisa bik pei. Hi ram cu an hnenah ka pe zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule Judah mi pawl in an unau Simeon mi pawl hnenah, “ Bawipa ih in zemmi ram ah kanmah pawl thawn hmun khatah kan feh pei ih Kanaan mi pawl cu kan do tlang pei. Cuih hnuah an lo zemmi ram ah kan feh leh pei,” tiah an sawm. Curuangah Simeon mi pawl le,"},"4":{"text":"Judah mi pawl cu hmun khatah ral an do tlang. Kanaan mi le Periz mi pawl tlunah nehnak Bawipa in a pek ih Israel mi in Bezek ah mi thawnghra an that."},"5":{"text":"Cutawkah siangpahrang Adonibezek a rak um ih an do. Kanaan mi le Periz mi pawl cu an neh."},"6":{"text":"Adonibezek cu a tlan; a sinan an dawi ih an kaih hnuah a kut zungpi le a ke zungpi an tan."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Adonibezek cun, “An kut zungpi le an ke zungpi tan ṭheh mi siangpahrang sawm sarih in ka cabuai hnuaiih rawl ṭilfuan an rak sar ṭheu. Atu-ah an parih ka rak tuah vekin Pathian in ka parah a tuah ve a si hi,” tiah a ti. Amah cu Jerusalem khua ah an fehpi ih cutawkah a thi."},"8":{"text":"Cun Judah mi pawl in Jerusalem an nam ih an lak. Khawsung mi pawl an thah ṭheh hnuah an khua cu meisa in an ur.","title":"Jerusalem Le Hebron An Neh"},"9":{"text":"Cuih hnuah tlangpar ram, Negev ram le hmunrawn ram ih a um mi Kanaan mi pawl do dingah an feh."},"10":{"text":"Judah mi pawl cun a hlan ih Kiriath Arba khawpi an timi Hebron khua sungih a ummi Kanaan mi pawl cu an do ih Sheshai, Ahiman, le Talmai tla an neh a si."},"11":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin Judah mi cu an feh ih a hlan ih Kiriath Sefer an rak timi Debir khua cu an do.","title":"Othniel In Debir Khawpi A Neh (Jos 15.13-19)"},"12":{"text":"Cule anmah lakih pakhat Kaleb in, “Kiriath Sefer a nehsuaktu cu ka fanu Aksah ka pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Kaleb ih naupa Kenaz ih fapa Othniel in Debir khawpi cu a neh ih curuangah Kaleb in a fanu Aksah cu a nupi ah a pek."},"14":{"text":"A hnenih a thlen tikah a pasal Othniel cun a pa hnen ihsin lo pakhat dil dingah a fial. Curuangah a pa Kaleb hnen ahcun a feh ih a laak par ihsin a ṭum tikah a pa in, “Ziang so na poi?” tiah a rak sut."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah a fanu Aksah cun, “Thil ka lo dil a si. Negev ram ramcaar ih i umter ruangah tikhur kan ṭul ih i zaangfah hram aw,” tiah a ti. Curuangah a pa cun saklam tikhur le thlanglam tikhur a rak pek."},"16":{"text":"Moses ih puzon Ken miphun ih tefa sin pawl cu Judah mi pawl thawn Ungkung Khawpi an ti mi Jerikho ihsin Judah ram Arad thlanglam ih a ummi ram caar lamah an feh ih cutawk ahcun Amalek mi pawl lakah an vung um.","title":"Judah Le Benjamin Pawl Nehmi"},"17":{"text":"Cule Judah mi pawl cu Simeon mi pawl thawn an feh ih Zefath khua ih um Kanaan mi pawl an neh ih an that thluh. Cuih khua cu an camsiat ih an siatsuah; cule Hormah tiah hmin an sak."},"18":{"text":"Cun Gaza khua, Ashkelon khua, le Ekron khua pawl cu an ukmi ram ciar thawn an lak ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Judah mi pawl cu Bawipa in a bawm ruangah tlangpar ram khal an lak thluh. Asinain tipikap hmunrawn ih a ummi pawl cu thir rangleng tla an neih ruangah an neh thei lo."},"20":{"text":"Moses ih thu a rak pekmi vekin Hebron cu Kaleb hnenah pek a si. Cule Kaleb in Anak ih fapa pathum pawl cu Hebron ihsin a dawi."},"21":{"text":"Asinain Benjamin hrin pawl cun Jerusalem ih a ummi Jebus mi pawl cu an dawi suak lo. Curuangah Jebus mi pawl le Benjamin hrin pawl cu Jerusalem ah tuih san tiangin an um tlang a si."},"22":{"text":"Josef hrin Efraim le Manasseh phun pawl in Luz ti ih an rak kawh mi Bethel khawpi an va do. An hnenah Bawipa cu a um. Bethel khawpi ahcun mi thlingthlatu pawl an thlah ih,","title":"Josef Hrin Pawl In Bethel An Neh","merge":"23"},"24":{"text":"khawsung ihsin mi pakhat a ra suakmi an hmu ih a hnenah, “Hi khawpi sungih luh theinak in sim hnik aw; zianghman kan lo ti lo ding,” tiah an ti."},"25":{"text":"Cutiin a sim hai ih cupa le a innsang zate siar lo Josef hrin pawl cun Bethel khawsung mi hmuahhmuah cu an that ṭheh."},"26":{"text":"Cupa cu Hit mi pawl ih ramah a feh ih khawpi pakhat a sak ih Luz tiah hmin a sak. Tuih san tiangin a cuih khua hmin cu Luz a si lai."},"27":{"text":"Manasseh hrin pawl cun Beth Shan khua, Taanak khua, Dor khua, Ibleam khua, Megiddo khua pawl le an kiangkap khawte pawl sung um Kanaan mi pawl cu an dawi suak lo. Atu tiangin acuih khua ahcun an um lai.","title":"Dawi Suak Lomi Pawl"},"28":{"text":"Israel mi pawl an hung cah deuhdeuh tikah Kanaan mi pawl cu hranhram in hna an ṭuanter; a sinan a dawi cu an dawi suak thluh lo."},"29":{"text":"Efraim hrin pawl in Gezer khawpi ih a ummi Kanaan mi pawl cu an dawisuak thluh lo ruangah tuihsun tiangin cutawk ah an um lai a si."},"30":{"text":"Zebulun hrin pawl in Kitron le Nahalol khawpi ih um Kanaan mi pawl cu an dawi suak thluh lo hrangah cutawk ahcun tuihsun tiangin an um lai. Zebulun hrin pawl in hranhram in anmah riantu ah an canter."},"31":{"text":"Asher hrin pawl in Akko khua, Sidon khua, Ahlab khua, Akzib khua, Helbah khua, Afek khua, le Rehob khawpi pawl ih a um a ummi Kanaan mi pawl cu an dawi suak thluh lo."},"32":{"text":"Cutiih an dawisuak thluh lo ruangah cutawk ahcun Asher mi le Kanaan mi pawl cu an um tlang a si."},"33":{"text":"Naftali hrin pawl in Beth Shemesh le Beth Anah khawpi ih a ummi Kanaan mi pawl an dawi suak thluh lo ruangah hmun khat ah an um tlang. Asinain Kanaan mi pawl cu Naftali hrin pawl in hranhram in anmah riantu ah an canter."},"34":{"text":"Amor mi pawl in Dan hrin pawl cu tlangpar ram ah an dawi ih hmunrawn ram ih ṭum an kham."},"35":{"text":"Cule Amor mi pawl cu Heres Tlang, Aijalon le Shaalbim ah an um thotho; asinain Josef hrin Efraim le Manasseh tesinfa pawl in an uk hai ih hranhram in an hna an ṭuanter."},"36":{"text":"Amor mi pawl ih ramri cu Akrabbim Tlangkawn ihsin Sela in saklampi tiang a hung thleng."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi cu Gilgal ihsin Bokhim ah a feh ih Israel mi hnenah, “Izipt ram ihsin ka lo suahter ih nan pupa hnenih ka tiamkammi ramah ka lo thlenpi. Nan hnenih ka thukamnak cu ka bal lo ding.","title":"Bokhim Ah Bawipa ih Vancungmi"},"2":{"text":"‘Nannih khal in hi ramih a ummi miphun dang pawl thawn thukamnak nan tuah ve lo pei ih an biakṭheng pawl cu nan bal thluh sawn pei,’ tiah ka lo ti zo kha! Asinain ka lo ti vekin nan tuah dah lo. Nan tuah sawn mi hi zohhnik uh!"},"3":{"text":"Curuangah fiangtein ka lo sim: hmaiih nan nor tikah himi pawl cu ka dawi lo ding. Nan ral an si dingih nan hrangah an khawzing pawl cu a lo awktu thang an si ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutiih vancungmi ih simmi an theih tikah Israel pawl cu napi in an ṭap ciamco."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah cuih hmun cu Bokhim tiah an ko. Cule Bawipa hnen ah cutawkah cun thawinak an pek."},"6":{"text":"Joshua in Israel mi pawl cu an comi ram ciarah a tlunter hai.","title":"Joshua Thihnak"},"7":{"text":"Joshua ih nun sung hmuahhmuah le a thih hnu tiang khalah Bawipa ih thiltuahmi a theitu upa pawl an nun sung cu Israel mi pawl in Bawipa an bia."},"8":{"text":"Nun ih fapa Joshua, Bawipa ih salpa cu kum za le kum hra a ti ah a thi."},"9":{"text":"Amah cu Gaash tlang ihsin saklam, Efraim tlangram ih a ummi amah ih ram sungah Timnath Heres ah an phum."},"10":{"text":"Cule cuih san ih Israel mi pawl cu an thi ih cuih hnu ih a hung suakmi san thar cun Bawipa siseh, Bawipa in Israel hrangih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah siseh, an thei lo."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah Israel mi cu an sual ih Baal khawzing pawl an biak sawn.","title":"Israel In A Dungtun"},"12":{"text":"An pupa pawl ih Pathian, Izipt ram ihsin anmah a hruai suaktu Bawipa kha bia nawn loin an kiangkap pawl ih khawzing tla biak an thok. Cuih khawzing hmaiah an kun ih Bawipa a thin an hengter."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa an tlansan ih Baal khawzing le Ashtarte khawzing pawl sawn an biak."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Israel parah Bawipa cu a thin a heng ngaingai ih damiah le rukru pawl ih rukmi le rammi ah a canter. An kiangkap ih an ral pawl in an nor vivo ih Israel pawl cu anmah le anmah hman an hum-aw thei nawn lo."},"15":{"text":"A rak sim cia zo vekin raldo ih an feh tinte in Bawipa in a hnong hai a si. Curuangah Israel mi cu an van a saang ngaingai."},"16":{"text":"Cule mi ramtu damiah pawl ih kut ihsin an himnak dingah Israel mi hnenah Bawipa in thuṭhentu pawl a pek."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hi thuṭhentu pawl ih thu khal an ngai cuang lo. Bawipa ih hrangah cun hlawhhlang vek an si ih khawzing dang pawl an biak. An pupa pawl cun Bawipa ih thupekmi an thlun naón ahi santhar minung pawl cun an thlun nawn lo."},"18":{"text":"An hrangih hotu a pekmi an nun sung cu Bawipa in a bawm ih an ral kut ihsin a luatter ringring hai ṭheu. Ziangahtile an ral pawl hremnak ruangih an aihramnak kha Bawipa in a theih tikah a zaangfah a si."},"19":{"text":"Asinain an hotu a thih vete cun Israel mi pawl cu an nuncan hlun keel ah an kirsal ih a hlan hnakin an luar sawn. Khawzing dangdang an thlun ih an hmaiah an kun ih an biak. Cutiih an nuncan siava cu thlah siang hrimhrim loin an thlun fetfet."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa cu Israel mi tlunah a thin a heng ngaingai ih, “An thlun hrimhrim dingah an pupa hnenih ka thukam cu hi miphun in an bal ṭheh zo a si. Cutiih ka thu an thlun lo ruangah,"},"21":{"text":"Joshua in a thih zawng ih a taanta mi miphun dang pawl cu ka dawisuak lo ding."},"22":{"text":"An pupa pawl in ka thu an thlun vekin hi Israel mi pawl hin ka thu an thlun maw thlun lo ding ti zoh-nakah hi miphun dang pawl ka hmang ding,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah acuih miphun dang pawl tla cu Bawipa in Joshua kut sungah a pe lo; zamrang khal in dawi loin cutawk ih a umternak a si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kanaan ram sungih ral a do hrih lomi Israel mi pawl hniksaknak ah hi ram sungah Bawipa in miphun dang malte a taanter.","title":"A Taangmi Miphun Dang Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi pawl hrek khat raldo hi ziangvek a si ti a thei hrih lo pawl in raldo an zirnak le an theihnak dingah a taanter hrimmi an si."},"3":{"text":"Kanaan ram sungah a taangmi pawl cu: Filistin khawpi panga, an zatein Kanaan mi, Sidon mi, le Baal Hermon Tlang ihsin Hamath Tlangkawn tiang Lebanon Tlangih a ummi Hiv mi pawl an si."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in an pupa pawl hnenah Moses hmangin a thupek kha Israel mi pawl ih an thlun le thlun lo theih hliahnak ah cuih miphun dang pawl cu a umter hrim a si."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi pawl cun Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Amor mi, Periz mi, Hiv mi le Jebus mi pawl lakah umhmun an khuar ih an um."},"6":{"text":"Nupi pasal ah nei-aw in an khawzing tla an biak ve."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Bawipa an Pathian cu an hngilh; Bawipa ih duhlomi an tuah, an sual ih Baal khawzing le Asherah khawzing pawl an biak.","title":"Othniel"},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi parah Bawipa ih thinhengnak cu meisa bangin a alh ih Mesopotamia siangpahrang Kushan Rishathaim a nehter. Cuticun Israel mi pawl in Mesopotamia siangpahrang cu kum riat sung an rian."},"9":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa hnenah an aihram ih Bawipa in anmah luatter dingah mi pakhat a thlah. Cupa cu Kaleb ih naupa Kenaz ih fapa Othniel a si."},"10":{"text":"Othniel cu Bawipa ih thlarau in a umpi ih Israel pawl hotu ah a cang. Othniel cu raldo in a feh ih Bawipa in a hnenah Mesopotamia siangpahrang va nehnak a pek."},"11":{"text":"Israel ram cu kum sawmli sung ral a dai. Cule Kenaz ih fapa Othniel cu a thi."},"12":{"text":"Israel mi cu Bawipa ih hmaiah an sual lala. Curuangah Moab siangpahrang Eglon cu Bawipa in Israel hnakin a cakter.","title":"Ehud"},"13":{"text":"Cule Eglon cun Ammon mi le Amalek mi pawl a sawm ih Israel mi pawl an neh ih Ungkung Khawpi an ti mi Jerikho khua an lak."},"14":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Moab siangpahrang Eglon cu kum hleiriat sung an rian."},"15":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa hnenah an au ih anmah luatter dingah mi pakhat a thlah. Amah cu Benjamin hrin sung ihsin Gera ih fapa, kehtlakpa Ehud a si. Cutikah Israel mi pawl in an siah pekmi thawn Ehud cu Moab siangpahrang Eglon hnen ahcun an thlah."},"16":{"text":"Ehud cun kap hnih hriam ralnam pakhat, dong khat sau amah ih hrangah a tuah ih a vorhlam siir a angki fual sungah a ṭemcih."},"17":{"text":"Cuticun an siah cu Ehud in Eglon a va pek. Eglon cu mi thauzet a si."},"18":{"text":"Ehud in a pek ṭheh hnuah siah a phurtu pawl cu a tlunter."},"19":{"text":"Asinain amah cu Gilgal ih an phunmi lungṭelh ihsin a kir sal ih, “Maw Siangpahrang, thuthup sim ding pakhat ka lo nei a si,” a ti. Cutikah siangpahrang bawipa in a sal pawl hnenah, “Midang cu suak thluh uh,” tiah thu a pek. A ti bangtuk in an suak thluh."},"20":{"text":"Cutiin Siangpahrang bawipa cu amahte lawng a daizetmi a inn tlun colhnak khaan ih a um laiah Ehud cu a hnenah a feh ih, “Na hrangah Pathian hnen ihsin thu pakhat ka rak keng a si,” tiah a ti. Cule siangpahrang bawipa cu a ding."},"21":{"text":"A din laifangah Ehud cun a vorhlam siir ih a thuhmi nam cu a kehlam kut in a vun zuk ih siangpahrang bawipa ih thinhna ah a sun."},"22":{"text":"A nam cu a pil thluh; a hlok tiangin a pil ih a dunglam ah a tlang suak. Cule Ehud in a phawi nawn lo ruangah a nam cu a thau in a khuh thluh."},"23":{"text":"Ehud cu lengah a suak ih sangka pawl a hren ṭheh in a tlansan."},"24":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa ih hnen-um pawl an ra ih sangka pawl hren thluh mi an hmuh tikah siangpahrang bawipa cu inn sungah pawng a thawh lai a si pei, tiah an ruat."},"25":{"text":"Reipi an hngak naón sangka cu a ong dah lo. Curuangah tawhfung an lak ih sangka cu an on; cutikah an bawipa cu zial parah a thi in an hmu."},"26":{"text":"Hnen-um pawl in an bawipa an hngak sungah Ehud cu a rak tlan hlo. Khermi lungphun a lan ih Seirah ah a tlan."},"27":{"text":"Seirah a va thlen tikah Israel mi, Efraim tlang parah Israel mi pawl cu ral tho dingin Ehud in tuucangki a phaw ciamco. A cuih tlang ihsin amah rori in a hruai."},"28":{"text":"“I thlun uh; Bawipa Pathian in nan ral Moab mi pawl ih tlunah nehnak a lo pek zo a si,” tiah a ti. Cule Israel mi pawl cun an vun thlun ciamco ih Moab mi pawl Jordan tiva an tan zik zawng ah an va kaih thluh. Mi pakhat hman Jordan tiva an tan man lo."},"29":{"text":"Cuih ṭum ah a cakzet mi Moab ralkap thawng hra tluk an that. Zohman an luat lo."},"30":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun Israel mi pawl in Moab mi pawl cu an neh. Cun Israel ramah kum sawmriat sung daihnak a um."},"31":{"text":"Ehud hnuah an hotu cu Anath ih fapa Shamgar a si. Shamgar in Filistin mi zaruk caw vuaknak fungzum in a vuak that thluh. Anih khal Israel mi runsuaktu a si.","title":"Shamgar"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ehud a thih hnuah Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa ih hmaiah an sual lala.","title":"Deborah Le Barak"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in Hazor khawpi ih a um mi Kanaan siangpahrang Jabin cu Israel a nehter. Siangpahrang Jabin ralkap pawl hotubik cu Zentail pawl ih khawpi Harosheth ih a ummi Sisera a si."},"3":{"text":"Jabin cun thir rangleng zakua a nei ih Israel mi pawl cu zaangfahnak neilo le ṭha lo zetin kum kul sung a neh-nen hai. Cule Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa hnenah an aihram lala."},"4":{"text":"Culai ih Israel pawl thu rak ṭhensaktu cu Lappidoth ih nupi nunau profet Deborah a si."},"5":{"text":"Efraim ih tlangpar ram, Ramah le Bethel karlak ah ungkung pakhat a um ih acuih ungkung hnuai ahcun Deborah cu a to ṭheu ih Israel mi ih thu pawl cu a ṭhensak ṭheu. Israel mi pawl in a cuih hmun ahcun an va fuk ṭheu."},"6":{"text":"Cule Naftali ram, Kedesh khawpi ih ummi Abinoam ih fapa Barak cu Deborah in a ko ih, “ Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in, ‘Feh aw la na minung pawl cu Tabor Tlangah hruai hai aw. Naftali le Zebulun hrin pawl sung ihsin ralkap thawng hra la awla,"},"7":{"text":"Jabin ralkap pawl hotu Sisera cu nangmah do dingah Kishon Tiva ah ka ratpi ding. Rangleeng pawl le ralkap pawl thawn a ra ding naón amah ih tlunih nehnak ka lo pe ding,’ a ti a si,” tiah a sim."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Barak in, “Ka hnenih na feh asile na sim vekin ka feh ding; na feh lo ahcun ka feh ve ce lo ding,” tiah Deborah cu a sawn."},"9":{"text":"Cule Deborah in, “A ṭha, ka feh ding; sikhalsehla ral kan neh tikah ziang hman hminthannak na ngah lo ding, ziangahtile Bawipa in Sisera cu nunau kut sungah a pe ding a si,” tiah a ti. Cule Deborah cu a pok ih Kedesh ah Barak thawn an feh."},"10":{"text":"Zebulun le Naftali mi pawl sung ihsin Barak in ralkap thawng hra a lak ih Kedesh ah a fehpi. Deborah khal a feh ve."},"11":{"text":"Culai ah Ken mi pa Heber in Kedesh kiang Zanannim ih a ummi sasua kung kiangah a puanthlam a sak. Heber cu Moses farnu ih pasal Hobab ih tefa sin pawl Ken miphun hnen ihsin a cer ih Kedesh kiangah a thleng."},"12":{"text":"Sisera cu Abinoam ih fapa Barak, Tabor Tlang a thleng zo tiah an sim."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah a thir rangleng zakua le a ralkap hmuahhmuah a khawm ih Zentail mi khawpi Harosheth ihsin Kishon Tiva tiang an feh."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Deborah in Barak hnenah, “Feh aw; tuihsun hi Bawipa in Sisera na kut sungih a thlenter ni a si. Bawipa in a lo hruai a si,” tiah a ti. Cule Barak cu a ralkap thawng hra thawn Tabor Tlang ihsin a vung feh."},"15":{"text":"Barak le a ralkap pawl cun an nam ih cu vete cun Sisera le a rangleng le a ralkap pawl hnenah Bawipa in buainak a thlenter. Sisera cu a rangleng ihsin zamrang in a ṭum ih a ke in a tlan."},"16":{"text":"Barak in Sisera ih rangleng pawl le ralkap pawl cu Zentail mi khawpi Harosheth tiang a dawi ih ralkap pakhat hman zuah loin a that ṭheh a si."},"17":{"text":"Sisera cu a tlan vivo ih Ken miphun Heber ih nupi Jael ih thlam lam a pan; ziangahtile Hazor khua siangpahrang Jabin le Heber innsang cu an rual-aw zet."},"18":{"text":"Cun Jael cu a feh ih Sisera a va hmuak ih a hnenah, “Ra aw, ka bawipa, ka thlam ah ra aw: ziang hman ṭih ding a um lo,” tiah a rak ti. Curuangah Sisera cu a feh ih Jael cun a puanthlam ih puanzar phenah a thup."},"19":{"text":"Cule Sisera in, “Ka ti a haal ih tidai i pe hram aw,” tiah a dil. Jael in saphaw tithawl a ong ih cawhnawi a lakih a pek; a in thluh hnuah a thup sal."},"20":{"text":"Cun Sisera in, “Thlam kaa ah khan ding awla mi pakhatkhat a rat ih thlam sungah zo tal an um maw ti ih a lo sut asile um hlah, tiah rak ti aw,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cule Sisera cu a bangtuk ruangah ihhmuh thawzet in a it that. Cutikah Jael cun sobul le puanthlam khennak fungzum a lakih a thup tein a peel ih a hnakhang ihsin leilung tiang tlang ko in a khencih. Cunah Sisera cu a thi."},"22":{"text":"Barak cu Sisera hawl in a rat tikah Jael in a va hmuak ih a hnenah, “Hinah ra awla na hawl reromi mipa cu ka lo hmuh ding,” tiah a ti. Barak in Jael cu a thlun ih, a lu ihsin fungzum thluah niarniar in leilungah Sisera a rak thih kha a hmuh."},"23":{"text":"Cuih sunah Israel mi hrangah Bawipa in Kanaan siangpahrang Jabin cu a neh."},"24":{"text":"Israel mi in Siangpahrang Jabin cu an nor deuh deuh ih a neta bik ah an thah."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih sunah Deborah le Abinoam ih fapa Barak in hi hla hi an sak:","title":"Deborah Le Barak Ih Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Israel hotu nasa zetin an ṭang, Israel mi pawl tha tho zetin ral an do ruangah, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh."},"3":{"text":"Maw siangpahrang pawl, ngai uh; Maw uktu pawl, theihnik uh; Bawipa hnenah awnmawi ka tum dingih hla ka sak ding, Bawipa Israel Pathian hnenah."},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Seir tlang ihsin na pok ih, Edom ram rawn na pal tikah, Leilung a hnin durdo ih van ihsin ruah a sur; Asi, khawdur ihsin tidai an tla."},"5":{"text":"Sinai tlang ih Bawipa hmai ahcun, Tlang pawl an hnin aw; Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian hmai ahcun."},"6":{"text":"Anath ih fapa Shamgar sanah, Jael ih san ahcun, Khual tlawnnak lamzin a ṭhing reprep, A tlawng pawl cun zinte an zawh."},"7":{"text":"Israel khua pawl an ṭhing thluh, Riangvai za in an dai ṭhepṭhep; Israel ih nu a si mi Deborah na thlen hlanah cun."},"8":{"text":"Israel in khawzing thar pawl a hril tikah, Doral an khua kotka an ra thleng; Israel mi thawng sawmli lakah, Phaw le feipi kengtu pakhat tal an um maw?"},"9":{"text":"Ka thinlung Israel ralbawi pawl hnenah a caam ringring; Thinlung tho teih ral a dotu Israel mi hnenah cun. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"},"10":{"text":"Hi thu cu sim ciar uh, Laak raang parih a to mi pawl; Rang todan parih a tomi pawl le, Ke lawngte in a fehtu pawl khal in sim ciar uh."},"11":{"text":"Ngai hnik uh! Tikhur kiangih mipi au thawm cu, Bawipa ih nehnak an aupi a si; Israel miphun ih nehnak cu! Bawipa ih minung pawl cu an khua ihsin an vung feh."},"12":{"text":"Tho aw, Deborah, tho awla hruai aw; Tho aw, hlasak phah in hruai hai aw. Hmai ah, Abinoam ih fapa Barak, Na kaih mi pawl hruai hai aw."},"13":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an hotu hnenah an rung; Bawipa ih minung pawl raldo dingin an ra."},"14":{"text":"Efraim hrin pawl phairawn an thleng, Benjamin hrin pawl in an run thlun. Makhir ihsin ralbawi pawl, Zebulun in bawi pawl an rung."},"15":{"text":"Issakhar hotu pawl cu Deborah thawn an ra, Asi, Issakhar a ra, Barak thawn, Phairawn ram ahcun an vun thlun. Reuben hrin pawl an cu ṭhen aw, Feh ding thu an relcat thei lo."},"16":{"text":"Ziangah so tuukhal pawl dungah an din ringring? An tuu kawhnak ngai dingah maw? Asi, Reuben hrin pawl cu an ṭhenṭhek aw; Tel ve dingah an relsuak thei lo."},"17":{"text":"Gad hrin pawl Jordan khatlam ralah an um, Dan hrin pawl cu ṭilva tlannak ramah an um. Asher hrin pawl cu tifinriat kapah an um, Tikap ahcun an um meen ringring."},"18":{"text":"Asinain Zebulun le Naftali hrin pawl cu, Sa le ral lakah an nunnak pek an ngam a si."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang pawl an ra ih ral an do, Megiddo tiva kiang Taanak khua ahcun; Kanaan siangpahrang tla in an do, Asinain sumsaw lon mi an nei lo."},"20":{"text":"Van ih arsi pawl khal in, Van ih an fehnak ihsin, Sisera cu an do ciamco."},"21":{"text":"Kishon tiva a lian ih a fen thluh hai, A luang kumkhua mi Kishon cun. Cak sinsin in hmaiah ka nor ding."},"22":{"text":"Cule rang pawl cu an tlan ciamco, An ketin in leilung an khawn ciamco."},"23":{"text":"“Meroz cu siatserh si ko seh, Khawsung mi pawl siatserh si ko seh; Ziangahtile Bawipa bawm dingah an suak lo, Bawipa ih ral an do lo,” tiah Bawipa ih vancungmi in a ti."},"24":{"text":"Jael cu nunau lakah vannei bik a si, Ken mi Heber ih nupi cu; Puanthlam ih a ummi nunau lakah, Jael cu mi sunglawi bik a si."},"25":{"text":"Sisera in tidai a dil ih cawhnawi a pek, Kheng mankhung in cawhnawi hlap a pek."},"26":{"text":"A kehlam kut in puanthlam khennak fungzum a kai, A vorhlam kut in hnaṭuantu-ih sobul a thlir, Sisera ih lu a hnakhang cu a khen, A tlang ih a sop thluh."},"27":{"text":"Sisera cu a sawn ih a ril, Jael ih ke hram ahcun a ril riai; A ke hram ahcun a sawn ih a ril, A rilhnak hmun ahcun a thi."},"28":{"text":"Sisera ih nu cun sangkate in khua a cuan, Tukvirh ong in khawza a thlir; “Ziangah so a rangleng a thlen dah lo? Ziangah so a rang pawl hi an tlai e,” a ti."},"29":{"text":"A nunau lakih a fimbik pawl in an sawn, An simmi cu amah in a nolh sal vivo."},"30":{"text":"“An lon mi thil le sumsaw an zem aw, Ralkap pakhat hrangah fala pakhat maw pahnih maw, Sisera hrangah puan ṭelh mankhung, Siangpahrang nuih hngawng hrangah coihcinmawi puan mankhung,” an ti."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah, Maw Bawipa, na ral pawl cu hloral hai seh, Asinain nangmah a lo duhdawtu cu, Zinglam ih a suakmi ni bangtuk in cak hai seh. Cun ram sungah raldaihnak kum sawmli sung a um."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah Israel mi pawl cu an sual lala curuangah Midian mi pawl ih kut sungah Bawipa in kum sarih sung a umter.","title":"Gideon"},"2":{"text":"Midian mi in Israel mi cu nasa zetih an neh-nen hai ruangah Israel mi cu tlang parih lungpuk, leikua le himnak hmun kipah an relh."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi in lo an rih tikah Midian mi, Amalek mi le nelrawn miphun pawl an ra ih an ra do ṭheu."},"4":{"text":"Cu lawng si loin Israel ram sungah buk an sam ih an thlaikho hmuahhmuah cu thlanglam ih a um mi Gaza khua kiangkap tiangin an siatsuah thluh ṭheu. Israel mi pawl cawm awknak hrangah tuu, caw le laak pakhatte hman zuah loin an lonsak thluh ṭheu."},"5":{"text":"Minung lawng si loin an ṭilva le an puanthlam pawl thawn an ra cer ih an tamzia cu kharbok zat an si. Anmah le an kalauk pawl cu siar cawk an si lo. Israel ram cu an siatsuah ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"Asinain Israel mi pawl cun tuah theimi ziang hman an nei lo ih an caang thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Midian mi pawl in an hrem ruangah Israel mi pawl in Bawipa an ko ih,"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in an hnenah profet pakhat a run thlah. A cuih profet in Israel ih Bawipa Pathian ih thu cu hiti in an hnenah a sim, “Sal nan tannak Izipt ram ihsin keimah in ka lo suah a si."},"9":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl le hi ram ih a lo dotu pawl kut sung ihsin ka lo run a si. Nan hmai ihsin nan ral pawl cu ka dawi ih an ram pawl nanmah ka lo pek."},"10":{"text":"Keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si ih an ram sungih nan umnak Amor mi ih khawzing pawl nan biak lo pei tiah fiangtein ka lo sim zo. Asinain ka thu nan ngai duh lo,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa ih vancungmi a ra ih Abiezer hrin Joash ih khua Ofrah an timi khua kiangih sasua kung hnuai ah a to. Cule Joash fapa Gideon cu Midian mi pawl hmuh phan ah a thup-aw ih sabitti sawrnak sungah a thupte in sangvut a ciil rero."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi cu Gideon hnenah a lang ih, “Nangmah cu mi ralṭha na si ih Bawipa na hnenah a um a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Gideon in vancungmi hnenah cun, “Bawipa, thu pakhat ka lo sut hnik pei: Bawipa Pathian kan hnenih a um ngaingai asile ziangah so hi bangtuk thil pawl hi kan parah a thlen? Izipt ram ihsin Bawipa in in suahpi a si, tiih kan pupa pawl ih in simmi Pathian ih tuah mi mangbangza pawl cu atu khui-ah so an si thluh? Bawipa cun in dungtun zo a si. Midian mi pawl ih kut sungah in hlonta a si hi,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Feh awla, na cahnak hmuahhmuah hmang awla Israel mi pawl cu Midian mi kut sungih sin luatter aw. Keimah in ka lo fial a si,” tiah thu a pek."},"15":{"text":"Cule Gideon in, “Sikhalsehla Bawipa , ziangtinso Israel cu ka luatter thei ding? Manasseh hrin lakah ka sungkhat pawl cu a ṭawnṭai bik an si ih ka sungkhat lakah kei hi farah nautabik ka si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in, “Keimah ih ka lo umpi ruangah na tuah thei ding. Midian mi pawl cu minung pakhat neh tlukin ol zetin na neh thluh ding,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Gideon in, “Na mithmai ṭha ka co a si ahcun ka hnenih a ṭongtu hi nangmah rori na si ti fiangternak ah thil pakhatkhat ka hnenah langter aw."},"18":{"text":"Cule na hnenih pek ding laksawng thawinak ka rak ken lai hlan lo hitawk hmun ihsin rak ṭhawn hram hlah aw,” tiah a dil. Cun vancungmi cun, “Na ra kir sal hlan lo ka um ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Gideon cu a feh ih me thuangte a suang ih bawm sungih sangphut ihsin thilnu tello sang a tuah. A suanmi sa cu a bawm sungah a san, tihang beel in a kengih sasua kung hnuai ih vancungmi hnenah cun a fehpi ih a va pek."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah vancungmi in, “Sa le sang cu hi lungto parah hin ret awla na kenmi tihang cu a parah toih aw,” tiah a fial. A fial vek cun Gideon in a tuah ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih vancungmi in a vun dawh ih a kut in a kenmi funghreu zim in sa le sang cu a vun tawh. Cu vete in lungto ihsin meisa a suak ih sa le sang pawl cu a kang thluh. Cule vancungmi cu a hlo."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa ih vancungmi ngaingai a si ti kha Gideon in a thei fiang ih, “Ailaw! Cungnungbik Pathian! Bawipa Pathian ih vancungmi hmaitontein ka hmu ual,” tiah khur phah in a ti."},"23":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in, “Phang aw hlah. Hnangamtein um aw. Na thi lo ding,” tiah Gideon cu a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cutawkah Bawipa hnenah Gideon in biakṭheng a don ih, “ Bawipa cu daihnak a si,” tiah hmin a sak. (Biakṭheng a donmi cu Abiezer hrin pawl ih khua Ofrah ah tuihsan tiangin a um lai.)"},"25":{"text":"Cuih zanah Bawipa in Gideon cu, “Na pa ih cawcang le a dang cawcang kum sarih ti lak aw; Baal khawzing hrangih a donmi na pa ih biakṭheng cu bal awla a kiangih a phunmi thingih tuahmi milem Asherah hi hau aw."},"26":{"text":"Cule hi tlangmual ahhin Bawipa na Pathian hrangah fekzet le ṭhazet in biakṭheng don aw. Cun a pahnihnak cawcang cu that awla a parah mei-ur thawinakah pek aw; a urnak ah na haumi milem Asherah zanthing kha hmang aw,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Gideon in hnen-um pahra a hruai ih Bawipa ih a sim bangtuk in a tuah thluh. A sungkhat pawl le khawsung mi ih hmuh a phan ruangah sunah tuah ngam loin zanah a tuah."},"28":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah khawsung mi pawl an tho ih Baal hrangih biakṭheng le milem Asherah pawl balsiat thluh ih a um kha an hmu. Cuih tlunah cutawkih donmi biakṭheng parih cawcang meisa in urmi tla an hmu fawn."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah, “Zoso hiti in a tuah?” tiah pakhat le pakhat an sut aw. A thuhla an zingzoi vivo ih a neta bikah Joash ih fapa Gideon in a tuah a si, ti kha an thei."},"30":{"text":"Cule Joash hnenah khawsung mi pawl in, “Na fapa rak suah awla kan that ding. Baal biakṭheng a bal ih a kiangih milem Asherah a hau a si,” tiah an ti."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah a rak fuktu mi senpi hnenah Joash in, “Baal lam ṭang in maw nan tong? Baal cu nan run ding maw si? Baal a ṭantu hmuahhmuah cu zingthlapit ah thah thluh nan si ding. Baal cu pathian a si ngaingai ahcun a biakṭheng an bal ruangah a mahte in ṭan-aw seh,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cuih thok ihsin Gideon cu Jerub-baal tiah an ti, ziangahtile Joash in, “Baal cu amahte in ṭan-aw seh; amah ih biakṭheng a sisi an bal,” a ti ruangah a si."},"33":{"text":"Cule Midian mi, Amalek mi le nelrawn mi pawl hmuahhmuah an khawm-aw ih Jordan Tiva an tan hnuah Jezreel phairawn ah an riak."},"34":{"text":"Bawipa ih thlarau cu Gideon parah nasa zetin a rung thleng. Tuucang ki tawtawrawt a phawt ih Abiezer hrin pawl cu amah thlun dingin a ko."},"35":{"text":"Manasseh hrin pawl ih ramsung hmuahhmuah ah mi a thlah ih amah thlun dingin a ko ṭheh. Asher hrin, Zebulun hrin le Naftali hrin pawl hnen khalah mi a thlah ih amah thlun dingin an pan ciamco."},"36":{"text":"Cutikah Gideon in Pathian hnenah, “Israel runtu dingah ka lo hmang duh a si, i ti."},"37":{"text":"I hmang duh ngaingai asile sangvut kan ciilnak hmunah tuuhmul ka ret. Thaizing ah tuuhmul par lawnglawng ah daitla a um ih a hnuai leilung a ro a si ahcun Israel mi runtu dingah i hmang duh ngaingai a si, ti ka thei ding,” a ti."},"38":{"text":"A ti vek cun a cang ngaingai. A thaizing zingpitte-ah Gideon cu a tho ih tuuhmul a sawr tikah daitla cu kheng khat a sawr."},"39":{"text":"Cule Gideon in Pathian hnenah, “ Bawipa , na thin heng hram hlah aw. Voikhat tein na hnenah ka ṭong hrih ko pei. Zaangfah tein tuuhmul in hniksaknak ka tuah hrih pei. Tuih ṭum cu tuuhmul sawn hul in leilung ah dai tla sawnseh,” tiah a ti"},"40":{"text":"Cuih zanah a ti vek cun Bawipa in a tuah thluh. Tuuhmul lawng a hul ih a hnuai ih leilung cu daitla in a ciar ṭheh."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gideon (Jerub Baal) le a milai pawl cu zingpit in an tho ih Harod Cerhti kiangah an riak. An saklam Moreh tlang kiangih hmunrawn ah Midian pawl an riak.","title":"Gideon In Midian Mi A Neh"},"2":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Gideon hnenah, “Midian pawl neh dingah ka hrangih na neihmi ralkap an tamtuk. Keimah hnenih thangṭhatnak si sawn loin anmah ih thazaang ih neh bangin tluangkhawnnak ah an hmang pang ding."},"3":{"text":"Na milai pawl hnenah than awla, ṭihnak a neimi hmuahhmuah cu Gilead tlang ihsin inn ah kir hai seh,” tiah a ti. Cutikah minung thawng kul hluanhnih an kir ih minung thawng hra an taang."},"4":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Gideon hnenah, “Na milai an tamtuk lai thotho. Tiva ah vun fehpi awla keimah in ka lo ṭhen sak ding. Na hnenah fehseh, ka timi cu a feh pei. Na hnenah feh hlah seh, ka timi cu a feh lo pei,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutiin a milai pawl cu Gideon in tiva ah a vun fehpi ih, Bawipa cun, “Uico bangtuk in a lei in tidai a liak ih a intu pawl le khukbil tahrat ih tidai a in tu pawl ṭhen aw,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"An sumpi in tidai a la ih a liaktu cu an zate in zathum an si. A dang pawl hmuahhmuah cu an khuk an bil ih tidai cu an in fingfing."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Ka lo bawm ding ih tidai a liaktu minung zathum thawn Midian mi pawl cu nan neh ding. A dang pawl cu tlung hai seh,” tiah Gideon hnenah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cuhrangah minung zathum siarlo a dang Israel mi hmuahhmuah cu an inn ciarah a tlunter; asinain an lamcaw le an tuucangki tawtawrawt pawl cu an taan thluh. Midian mi pawl ih riahbuk cu an umnak ihsin thuailam horkuam ah a si."},"9":{"text":"A cuih zan cu Bawipa in Gideon hnenah, “Hmakhatte-ah vung feh awla Midian mi pawl cu an riahnak ah vung nam aw. Ziangahtile na kut sungah nehnak ka lo pe ding a si."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na ṭih a si ahcun na hnen-umpa Purah thawn vung feh hmaisa uh."},"11":{"text":"An ṭongmi pawl nan thei pei ih do dingah na ngam ding,” tiah a ti. Curuangah Gideon le a hnen-umpa Purah cu an ral pawl ih umnak kiang tontir ralvennak tiang an vung feh."},"12":{"text":"Midian mi, Amalek mi le nelrawn miphun pawl cu acuih kuam ahcun a ramih kipah kharbok bangin an tor; an kalauk an tamzia cu tifinriat kap ih vunnel zat an si."},"13":{"text":"Cule Gideon cutawkih a vung thlen tikah mipa pakhat in mang a man ih acuih a mang cu a rualpi pakhat hnenih a sim rero lai kha a thei. “Ngaihnik! Ka mangah barli sangvut ih tuahmi sang zawl khat kan riahnak ah hin a rung ril. Kan riahnak ih puanthlam pakhat a run ngah ih acuih puanthlam cu a tlu; a tluk hnuah a linglet-aw ih lei parah a pharh aw,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah a rualpi cun, “Na mangih tican cu Joash ih fapa, Israel mi Gideon ih ralnam a si; a tican hi thil dang a si hrimhrim lo ding. Midian mi pawl le kan ralkap hmuahhmuah cu Pathian in Gideon kut ah a pek zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"A cuih mang le a tican cu Gideon in a theih tikah khukbil in Bawipa a biak. Cuih hnuah Israel mi pawl ih riahnak ah a feh ih, “Tho uh! Midian ralkap pawl parah Bawipa in nehnak a lo pek ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule a ralkap zathum pawl cu ṭhen thum ah a ṭhen ih tawtawrawt pakhat fingfing le a sungih meisa van ciami thawl pakhat fingfing a pek."},"17":{"text":"“Midian ralkap pawl riahnak kiang kan thlen tikah keimah i zoh uhla ka tuah mi vekin tuah uh."},"18":{"text":"Keimah le ka minung pawl in kan tawtawrawt kan tum tikah an riahnak kimvel in nan tawtawrawt nan tum ciar pei ih, ‘ Bawipa hrang le Gideon hrangah,’ tiah napi in nan au pei,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Gideon le a minung zakhat pawl cu zanṭim hlan deuh ah Midian ralkap pawl riahnak kiang tontir ralvennak an thleng ih riahbuk kiltu ralveng pawl an rak thleng awk pekte a si. Cutikah an tawtawrawt cu an tum ih an kenmi thawl cu an khuai ciamco."},"20":{"text":"An bu thum in an tawtawrawt cu an tum ih an thawl an khuai. An kehlam kut in meisa an khai ih an vorhlam kut in tawtawrawt an keng. “ Bawipa hrang le Gideon hrangah ralnam!” tiin an au ciamco."},"21":{"text":"An riahnak kiangih an dinnak hmun ciar ahcun an ding. Cule Midian ralkap pawl cu mangbangin an au phah ih an tlan ciamco."},"22":{"text":"Cutiih minung zathum an tawtawrawt an tum rero lai ahcun Midian ralkap pawl cu Bawipa in anmah le anmah a thah awkter. An zaam ih Zererah lamah Beth Shittah tiang, cule Tabbath kiangih Abel Meholah khua tiang an zaam."},"23":{"text":"Naftali miphun, Asher miphun le Manasseh miphun sungin ralkap an ko-aw ih Midian mi pawl cu an dawi."},"24":{"text":"Cule Gideon in Efraim tlangpar ram hmuahhmuah ah mi a thlah ih, “Rung uhla Midian mi pawl rung do uh. An tlansuak lonak dingah Jordan tiva le tivate dang pawl ihsin Bethbarah tiang rak khan hai uh,” tiah a cah. Efraim mi pawl cu a ko khawm ih Jordan tiva le tiva dang pawl ihsin Bethbarah tiang an khan khelh hai."},"25":{"text":"Midian lal pahnih, Oreb le Zeeb, an kai. Oreb Lungto ah Oreb cu an that ih, Zeeb sabitti sawrnak ah Zeeb cu an that. Midian mi pawl cu an dawi vivo; cuih hnuah Oreb le Zeeb ih lu pawl cu Jordan tiva ral ah Gideon hnenah cun an hei keng."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Efraim mi pawl cu Gideon hnenah an ra ih, “Midian mi do dingih na feh tikah ziangah so kannih in sawm ve lo? Zianghman ah in siar lo a si lo maw?” tiah an ti ih nasazet in an phunzai.","title":"Midian Mi An Neh"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Gideon cun, “Nan tuah mi thawn ṭhim tikah kei ka tuah mi cu zianghman a si ual lo. Nannih Efraim mi pawl ih tuahmi thil fate hman cu keimah ih miphun pawl ih tuahmi hmuahhmuah hnakin a thupi sawn a si."},"3":{"text":"Midian mi pawl ih lal Oreb le Zeeb tla cu Pathian in nan kut sung rori ah a lo pek a si. Hi pawl thawn ṭhim tlak dingah kei ka tuah mi ziangso a um?” tiah a ti. Cumi an theih tikah an thin a dai sal."},"4":{"text":"Gideon le a ralkap zathum pawl cu an ra ih Jordan Tiva an tan hnu ah an baangzet naón Midian pawl cu an dawi vivo thotho."},"5":{"text":"Sukkoth khua an thlen tikah khawsung mi hnenah, “Midian siangpahrang Zebah le Zalmunna pawl kan dawinakah ka ralkap pawl an baangzet thlang a si. Zaangfah tein ka ralkap pawl hrangah sang in pek hram uh,” tiah Gideon in a dil."},"6":{"text":"Asinain Sukkoth khua ih upa pawl cun, “Zebah le Zalmunna pawl na kut sungih um zo vekih na hei rel; ziangah so na ralkap pawl cu sang kan pek sapbai ding! Nan kai hrih ual lo!” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Gideon in, “A ṭha! Zebah le Zalmunna cu Bawipa in ka hnenih i pek tikah nelrawnih ummi hling le so in nan taksa ka lo hriattlek thluh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule Gideon cu Penuel ah a feh ih khawsung mi pawl cu rawl a dil sal; a sinan Sukkoth khuami vek thotho in an rak el."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah an hnenah, “Harhdamteih ka ra kir sal tikah nan ralhruang ka bal thluh leh ding sokhaw,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Zebah le Zalmunna cu an ralkap pawl thawn Karkor ah an um. Nelrawn miphun ralkap pawl hmuahhmuah sung ihsin thawng hlei nga lawnglawng an taang. Thawng zakhat le thawngkul cu an thi thluh zo."},"11":{"text":"Cule Gideon cu Nobah le Jogbehah ihsin nisuahnak lam ih a ummi deuthlam ih a ummi pawl lamzin in a so ih acuih ralkap pawl ralring loih an um laifangah hmakhatte-ah a nam ciamco."},"12":{"text":"Midian siangpahrang pahnih Zebah le Zalmunna cu an zaam; a sinan Gideon in a dawi ih an pahnih in a kaih. An ralkap pawl cu an ṭekvai thluh."},"13":{"text":"Joash ih fapa Gideon cu a raldonak ihsin a kir ih Heres Tlangkawn in a feh."},"14":{"text":"Cule Sukkoth khua tlangval pakhat a kai ih thu a sut. A cuih tlangvalpa cun Sukkoth khua ih lal pawl le khawsung upa sawm sarih le pasarih pawl ih hmin a ngan sak thluh."},"15":{"text":"Cule Gideon cu Sukkoth khua ah a feh ih khawsung mi pawl cu, “In dodal ih in setet kha nan cing lai maw? ‘Zebah le Zalmunna pawl na kut sungih um zo vekih na hei rel! Ziangah so na ralkap pawl cu sang kan pek sapbai ding,’ in rak ti kha! Atu zoh uh, an pahnih in hinah an um,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule nelrawn ih hling le so pawl cu a lak ngaingai ih Sukkoth khua ih upa pawl hremnak ah a hmang."},"17":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Penuel khua ih ralhruang cu a bal ṭheh ih khawsung mipa pawl a that."},"18":{"text":"Cule Zebah le Zalmunna cu Gideon in, “Tabor ah nan rak thah mi minung pawl cu zovek so an si?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Nangmah vek an si. An zate in siangpahrang fapa an bang thluh,” an ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Gideon in, “Ka unau hlir an si; ka nu ih fapa pawl rori an si. Bawipa ih hminsaal in ka lo sim: Anmah pawl rak that hlah uhla cu ka lo that ve lo ding naón!” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule a fapa upabik Jether hnenah, “Tho awla that hai aw!” tiah a fial. Sikhalsehla Jether cun a nam khal a zuuk lo. Tlangval no a si ruangah a ṭih."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Zebah le Zalmunna in, “Ra awla, nangmah in in ra that hmen. Pacang that dingah cun pacang a ṭul,” tiah an ti. Curuangah Gideon in Zebah le Zalmunna cu a thah ih an kalauk pawl hngawng ih an thlaih mi hlawnthil pawl a lak."},"22":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl in Gideon cu, “Kan siangpahrang si-aw, nangmah le na fapa le na fapa ih fapa tiangin! Midian mi pawl ih kut sungih sin in run suak a sisi,” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Gideon in, “Nanmah ih uktu cu kei ka si lo ding; ka fapa khal a si lo ding. Nanmah ih uktu cu Bawipa a si ding,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cule an hnenah, “Thil pakhat ka lo dil hai ding: ral pawl hnenih nan lonmi hnakhai pawl kha in pe thei pei maw?” tiah a ti. Midian mi pawl cu nelrawn mi an si ih sui hnakhai an khai."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah, “Lungawi aipuang tein kan lo pe ding,” an ti. Puan pakhat an phah ih ral hnen ihsin an lonmi sui hnakhai pawl cu acuih puan parah cun an thlet ciamco."},"26":{"text":"Gideon ih dil mi sui hnakhai pawl cu a zatein pawng sawmruk a rit. Himi sungah an orh mi hlawnthil, ṭhi pawl le Midian siangpahrang pawl ih hrukmi puan mankhung pawl le an kalauk pawl hngawng ih thlaih mi hlawnthil pawl a tel hrih lo."},"27":{"text":"Gideon cun sui milem a tuah ih a khawpi Ofrah ah a ret. Israel mi an zatein Pathian an dungtun ih acuih khua ah an feh ih milem cu an biak. Gideon le a innsang hrangah cuih milem cu thang siahmi bangtuk a si."},"28":{"text":"Cubangtuk in Midian mi pawl cu Israel mi pawl in an neh ih Israel mi hrangah phan ding ral a um nawn lo. Gideon a nun sung, kum sawmli sung cu Israel ram sungah daihnak a um."},"29":{"text":"Joash ih fapa Gideon cu a tlung ih amah ih inn ah a um.","title":"Gideon A thi"},"30":{"text":"Nupi tampi a neih ruangah fapa sawm sarih a nei."},"31":{"text":"Shekhem khua khal ah nusun pakhat a nei ih acu nu cun fapa pakhat a hrin; a fapa cu Gideon in a hmin ah Abimelek a sak."},"32":{"text":"Joash ih fapa Gideon cu mi sanṭha zet a si. A thih tikah Abiezer phun pawl ih khua Ofrah ah a pa Joash ih thlaan ah an phum."},"33":{"text":"Gideon a thih hnuah Israel mi pawl in Pathian cu dungtun in an uiret san ih Baal khawzing pawl an biak. Baal-berith cu an khawzing ah an tuah ih an biak."},"34":{"text":"An kiangkap ral pawl kut sungih sin a runsuaktu Bawipa an Pathian cu an thei nawn lo."},"35":{"text":"Israel mi hrangah a tuah thei sung thil ṭhahnem zet a tuahtu Gideon innsang par khalah lungawi hna an thiam lo."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gideon ih fapa Abimelek cu a nu lamih sungkhat pawl an umnak Shekhem khua ah a va feh.","title":"Abimelek"},"2":{"text":"A nuih sungkhat pawl hnen ahcun, “Hi khawsung mi pawl hi ‘Gideon fapa minung sawm sarih ih uk nan duh maw? Asilole minung pakhat ih uk nan duh sawn maw?’ tiah sut hnik uh. Keimah cu nanmah ih thi le sa rori ka si tla hi hngilh hlah uh,” tiah ti."},"3":{"text":"A nuih sungkhat pawl cun khawsung mi hnenah a ti vek cun an sim. An sungkhat a si ruangah khawsung mi pawl cun Abimelek sawn an hril."},"4":{"text":"Cule Baal-berith biakinn sungih ngun tangka sawm sarih an pek; Abimelek in acuih tangka cun amah thluntu dingah zianghman ih ṭhahnem lo, mi hlothlau pawl minung sawm sarih a saang."},"5":{"text":"Cule a pa ih khua Ofrah ah a feh ih a pa Gideon sungsuak rori, a unau sawm sarih cu lungto pakhat parah a that ṭheh. Asinain an nauta bik Jotham cu a rak relh ruangah a luat."},"6":{"text":"Cun Shekhem khua le Bethmillo ih khawsung mi pawl cu an khawm aw ih Shekhem khua ih sasua kungah an feh hnuah Abimelek cu siangpahrang ah an canter."},"7":{"text":"A cuih thu cu Jotham in a theih tikah a feh ih Gerizim Tlang zim ah a ding ih a aw neih patawp in, “Maw Shekhem khawsung mi pawl, i rak thei hram uhla, Pathian khal in lo thei hram seh."},"8":{"text":"Khuahlan laiah thingkung pawl in anmah ih hrangah siangpahrang an rak hril. An zatein olif thingkung cu ‘Kan siangpahrang si aw,’ an ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah olif thingkung in, ‘Zanthing dang pawl uktu meen ah khawzing le minung upatnak ih hmanmi ka hriak hi ka taan siang ding maw si?’ a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun thingkung pawl cun theikung hnenah, ‘Nang kan siangpahrang si aw,’ an ti."},"11":{"text":"Asinain theikung in hiti in a let, ‘Nanmah pawl uk ding meen ah ka rah thawzet hi ka taan siang ding maw si?’ a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule thingkung pawl in sabit hri hnenah, ‘Nang tal kan siangpahrang ah cang aw,’ an ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah sabit hri in hiti in a ti, ‘Nanmah pawl uk ding meen ah khawzing le milai pawl lungawi tertu ka sabitti kha ka taan siang ding maw si?’ a ti thotho."},"14":{"text":"Cuih hnuah zanthing pawl in hlingbur hnenah, ‘Nang tal kan siangpahrang ra cang aw,’ tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah, ‘Nan siangpahrang ih in duh ngaingai a si ahcun ra uhla ka thladem ah ra cawl uh. Nan ra cawl lo asile hlingbur sung ihsin meisa a hung suak ding ih Lebanon ih a ummi sidar zanthing pawl kha a kaang ral thluh ding a si,’ tiah hlingbur cun a ti."},"16":{"text":"“Nan thinlung takte le thinlung thiangte in Abimelek hi siangpahrang ah nan cangter a si maw? Gideon le a innsang parah thil dik kan tuah tiin nan ruat maw? Hnaṭuan ṭha a ṭuan man a ngah tlakmi a ngah tiin nan zum maw?"},"17":{"text":"Ciing ṭha uh; ziangtluk inso ka pa in nan hrangah ral a do! Midian mi pawl ih kut sung ihsin nan luatnak dingah amah ih nunnak hman a ruat lo a si kha!"},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla tuihsun ah nannih cun a innsang pawl cu an ci in mih nan tum. A fapa sawm sarih cu ni khatah lungto pakhat parah nan that; cuih tlunah a salnu thawn an hrinmi a fapa Abimelek sawn cu nan sungkhat a si ruang men ah Shekhem siangpahrang ah nan tuah."},"19":{"text":"A ṭha ko; tuihsun ih Gideon le a innsang parih nan tuahmi hi thinlung takte le thinlung thiangte ih nan tuahmi a si ahcun Abimelek parah nan thinlung kim ko uh; amah Abimelek khal nan parah a lung awi ko seh."},"20":{"text":"Asinain, cuti a si lo ahcun, Abimelek in meisa suahter sehla Shekhem le Bethmillo minung pawl cu kaang that thluhseh. Shekhem le Bethmillo mi pawl hnen khal in meisa suak sehla Abimelek cu kaang that hram seh,” tiah a au ciamco."},"21":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jotham cu a tlan hlo. A unau Abimelek a ṭih ruangah a feh ih Beer ah a va um."},"22":{"text":"Abimelek in Israel cu kum thum sung a uk."},"23":{"text":"Cule Shekhem khua mi le Abimelek hua-aw dingah Pathian in rem-awk lonak thinlung a pek ih khawsung mi le Abimelek cu an ral aw."},"24":{"text":"Hiti a sinak cu Gideon ih fapa sawm sarih pawl a thattu Abimelek par le mi that dingih Abimelek a forhfialtu Shekhem khawsung mi pawl ih parah phulak dingah Pathian ih tuahmi a si."},"25":{"text":"Abimelek bawh dingah Shekhem khua mi pawl in tlangpar ah mi an thlah. An thlah mi pawl cun acuih lamzin a zawhtu hmuahhmuah cu an ram ih Abimelek khal in acuih thu cu a thei."},"26":{"text":"Culai ah Ebed ih fapa Gaal cu a unau pawl thawn Shekhem khua ah an thleng ih Shekhem khawsung mi pawl cun Gaal cu an rinsanzet."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah an lo ah an feh ih an sabit rah an lo ih sabitti an tuah ih puai an tuah ciamco. Cule an khawzing biakinn ah an feh ih an ei an in hnuah Abimelek cu ṭongsia in an cam an riam."},"28":{"text":"Gaal in, “Ziangah so Abimelek cu kan rian rero? Shekhem khua mi pawl cu ziangce so kan si? Amah cu ziangso a si leem? Gideon ih fapa a si ko lo maw? Amah thu ih a nungmi cu Zebul lawng a si ko lo maw? Ziang hrangah so Abimelek cu kan rian rero ding? Nan cithlahtu Hamor ih minung pawl rian sawnta hmen uh."},"29":{"text":"Aw, hi miphun ih hotu si ningla ka va duh so! Abimelek hnenah, ‘Na ralkap pawl thawn ra suak uhla kan tawng aw hnik pei cu!’ ka ti ding ih Abimelek cu a van a duaimai ding naón!” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cuti ih Gaal ih ṭongka cu Shekhem khua uktu Zebul in a theih tikah a thin a heng ngaingai."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah Arumah ah Abimelek hnen ahcun mi a thlah ih, “Ebed ih fapa Gaal le a unau pawl cu Shekhem ah an ra ih khawsung mi pawl nangmah dodal dingin an ra forh rero a si."},"32":{"text":"Curuangah na ralkap pawl thawn a zanzan in ra pok uhla hramlak in bawh uh."},"33":{"text":"Cule thaizing nisuak ah tho in rinlopi-ah Shekhem khua cu nam uh. Gaal le a ralkap pawl in an lo do tikah nasazet in do uh,” tiah a cah."},"34":{"text":"Curuangah Abimelek le a ralkap pawl cu a zanzan in an pok ih bur li in Shekhem khua kiangkap ah an thup-aw."},"35":{"text":"Gaal cu khawsung ihsin a feh ih hnarpawn ah a va ding. Cule Abimelek le a ralkap pawl cu an thuh awknak ihsin an suak."},"36":{"text":"Abimelek le a ralkap pawl cu Gaal in a hmuh tikah Zebul hnenah, “Zohhnik, tlang par ihsin mi an run khi!” a ti. Cutikah Zebul cun, “Khikhi cu tlangpar ih phenthlam an si ih, minung ah na neih men a si ko lo maw,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cule Gaal cun, “Zohhnik aw, tlangkawn ihsin minung an run khi; a hrek cu Pol Sasuakung timi lamzin ihsin an run khi!” tiah a ti thotho."},"38":{"text":"Cutikah Zebul cun Gaal hnenah, “Na porh-awk rero sikhawh ziangtinso? Ziangah so Abimelek cu kan rian duh rero ding, a titu cu nangmah na sisi. Himi pawl cu hnihsuahsainak ih na hmanmi pawl an si ko lo maw! Va feh awla va do hnik hmen!” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Gaal in Shekhem khawsung mi pawl cu a hruai ih Abimelek cu an va do."},"40":{"text":"Asinain Abimelek in a neh ih Gaal cu a zaamhlo. A ralkap pawl tampi an thi ih an khua hnarpawn tiang an ruak cu a ril teptep."},"41":{"text":"Abimelek cu Arumah ah a kir sal; cule Gaal le a unau pawl cu Shekhem khua ah um thei lo dingin Zebul in a dawi."},"42":{"text":"A thaisun ah Shekhem khawsung mi pawl cu hramlak ah an feh ih acuih thu cu Abimelek in a thei."},"43":{"text":"Abimelek cun a ralkap pawl a ko khawm ih hmun thum ah a ṭhen hnuah hramlak in an rak bawh. Khawsung ihsin an suah kha Abimelek in a hmu ih an bawhnak ihsin a suak ih a do."},"44":{"text":"Abimelek le a homi ralkap bu khat pawl cu zamrangte in hmaiah an nor ih khua kotka sangka ah an ṭang. A dang ralkap bu hnih pawl in an ral pawl cu an do ciamco ih hramlak ahcun an thah ṭheh."},"45":{"text":"Cule Abimelek in khawsung mi pawl cu sun nihlawh a do. Cuih khua cu a lak ih khawsung mi pawl a thah ṭheh. An khawpi a balsiat thluh ih leilung cu ci a phulh ruangah ci in a khuh thluh."},"46":{"text":"A cuih thu cu Shekhem khua ralhruang ih a ummi khawsung upa pawl in an theih tikah Baal-berith khawzing biakinn ruhkulh sungah an relh."},"47":{"text":"Cutawkih an relh cu Abimelek in a thei."},"48":{"text":"Curuangah a ralkap pawl thawn Zalmon tlang parah an kai. Hreitlung a lak ih thinghnge a tan ih a liang in a put. A ralkap pawl khal amah vekih tuah thluh dingin thu a pek."},"49":{"text":"Cutiin thinghnge cu an khawm fingfing ih Abimelek cu an thlun ih ruhkulh kap ahcun an pen. Meisa in an ur ih Shekhem ruhkulh sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah cu an thi thluh. A thi mi cu nunau mipa an zate in thawngkhat tluk an si."},"50":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Abimelek cu Thebez khua ah a feh ih a kulh thluh hnuah cuih khua cu a lak."},"51":{"text":"An khawsung ahcun a fek zetmi ralhruang a um ih a sungah cun nunau siseh, mipa siseh, an hotu pawl tiangin an relh thluh. A sunglam in sangka an hren ih inn diphun ah an kai."},"52":{"text":"Cule Abimelek in ralhruang cu a ra do. Ralhruang cu meisa in ur dingah sangka a rak naih."},"53":{"text":"Culai fangah nunau pakhat in tlunlam in fang rialnak lungphengpi in a lu ah a vun thlak ih a luruh a kuai."},"54":{"text":"Cutikah Abimelek cun a hriamnam kengtu tlangvalpa cu zamrang tein a ko ih, “Na ralnam zuuk awla i that aw. Nunau kut in a thi a si, tiih an rel ding ka duh lo,” tiah a ti. Curuangah tlangvalpa cun Abimelek cu a dawt ih a thi."},"55":{"text":"Cule Israel ralkap pawl in Abimelek a thih an hmuh tikah an inn ciarah an tlung thluh."},"56":{"text":"Cuticun a unau sawm sarih a thah ih a pa parih thil sual a tuah mi ruangah Pathian in Abimelek cu a thungrul ve a si."},"57":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in an nun sualnak ruangah Shekhem khua mi pawl khal Pathian in a thungrul ve. Gideon ih fapa Jotham in a camsiat vekin an parah a kim ṭheh a si."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Dodo ih fapa cu Puah a si; Puah ih fapa cu Tola a si. Cule Abimelek thih hnuah Tola cu Israel luattertu ah a cang. Tola cu Issakhar miphun a si ih Efraim tlangpar ram Shamir khua ih ummi a si.","title":"Tola"},"2":{"text":"Tola cu kum kul hluanthum sung Israel hotu a ṭuan. A thih tikah Shamir khua ah an phum."},"3":{"text":"Tola thih hnuah Gilead ih Jair cu hotu ah a cang. Jair in kum kul hluanhnih sung Israel ih thuṭhentu a ṭuan.","title":"Jair"},"4":{"text":"Fapa sawmthum a nei ih laak sawmthum parih to ṭheu mi an si. Gilead ram sungah khawpi sawmthum an nei ih tuihsan tiangin cuih khua pawl cu Jair ih Puanthlam Khawpi pawl an ti ringring."},"5":{"text":"Jair cu a thi ih Kamon khua ah an phum."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa ih hmaiah an sual lala. Baal timi khawzing pawl, Astartes timi khuazing pawl, le Siria ih khawzing pawl, Sidon ih khawzing pawl, Moab ih khawzing pawl, Ammon ih khawzing pawl, le Filistin ih khawzing pawl, an biak. Bawipa Pathian cu an dungtun ih an bia duh nawn lo.","title":"Jefthah"},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa cu Israel mi parah a thin a heng ih Filistin mi pawl le Ammon mi pawl a nehter."},"8":{"text":"A cuih kum cun Israel mi pawl an neh ih an hrem. Amor mi pawl an umnak Jordan Tiva ihsin nisuahnak Gilead ram ih a ummi Israel mi hmuahhmuah cu kum hleiriat sung an hrem."},"9":{"text":"Cun Amor mi pawl in Judah mi, Benjamin mi le Efraim mi pawl do dingah Jordan tiva an tan. Curuangah Israel mi pawl cu vansaanglam in an um."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa ih hnenah an ṭap an ai ih, “Kan Pathian, nangmah ih parah kan sual zo; kan lo dungtun ih Baal khawzing pawl kan biak a si,” tiin an ko."},"11":{"text":"Cule Bawipa cun an hnenah, “A cem zomi tikcu caan sungah Izipt mi, Amor mi, Ammon mi, Filistin mi,"},"12":{"text":"Sidon mi, Amalek mi le Maon mi pawl in an lo hrem tikah ka hnenah nan ṭap nan ai ringring. Cutikah nanmah run suak loin ka um dah maw si?"},"13":{"text":"Asinain kei cu in dungtun ih khawzing dang nan bia thotho; curuangah atu cu ka lo run duh nawn lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Va feh uhla nan hril sawnmi khawzing pawl hnenah va ṭap in va ai uh. Harsatnak nan ton tikah anmah in lo run hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl cun, “Kan sual tuk zo. Na duh vekin in tuah ko awla zaangfahte in tuihsun ah in run hram aw,” tiah Bawipa cu an dil."},"16":{"text":"Cutiin hnamdang khawzing an neihmi pawl cu an hlon thluh ih Bawipa cu an biak. Cule Israel mi pawl ih zonzaih tuarnak cu a hmuh tikah Bawipa cu a thin a nuam thei nawn lo."},"17":{"text":"Cun Ammon ralkap pawl cu an khawm-aw ih Gilead ah ṭanhmun an khuar. Israel ralkap pawl khal an khawm-aw ih Mizpah ah ṭanhmun an khuar ve."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Gilead mi pawl le an hruaitu pawl cun, “Ammon mi pawl do dingah zoso in hruai ding? In hruaitu cu Gilead mi hmuahhmuah tlunah hotu a si ding,” tiah pakhat le pakhat an sut-aw rero."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gilead miphun Jefthah cu ralṭha zetmi ralkap pakhat a si. A pa ih hmin cu Gilead a si ih a nu cu hlawhhlang a si."},"2":{"text":"Gilead le a nupi in fapa tampi an nei ih an fapa pawl cu an hung upat tikah Jefthah hnenah cun, “Kan pa hnen ihsin roco ding zianghman na nei lo; nu dang fapa na si ko lo maw!” tiah an ti ih an hnawh."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah a unau pawl hnen ihsin Jefthah cu a tlan ih Tob ram ah a um. Cutawk ramih mihlotlau pawl in an thlun vivo ih cu pawl thawn mi an ram vivo."},"4":{"text":"Tikcu a hung rei deuh tikah Ammon mi pawl in Israel mi pawl an do."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Tob ram ihsin ra kir sal dingah Gilead hotu pawl in Jefthah cu an sawm."},"6":{"text":"“Ra awla nangmah in in ho aw; Ammon mi pawl kan do ding,” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Jefthah in, “Kei cu in hua ih ka pa ih inn ihsin in dawi a sisi. Ziangah so vansaannak nan ton tik lawngah ka hnenah nan rat?” tiah a rak ti."},"8":{"text":"Asinain Jefthah hnenah cun, “Cutiih vansaannak kan ton ruangah a si na hnenih kan ratnak cu; kan hnenah ra in Ammon mi do dingah kan lo duhzet a si. Gilead mi hmuahhmuah hi in ra ho hram aw,” tiah an dil ciamco."},"9":{"text":"Jefthah in an hnenah, “Nan hnenah ra tahrat in Ammon mi pawl ka do ih Bawipa in nehnak i pek asile keimah in ka lo uk hai ding, nan lung a kim pei maw?” tiah a sut."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Kan lung a kim. Bawipa kan thutheitu a si,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah Jefthah cu Gilead hruaitu pawl thawn an feh ih Gilead mi pawl cun anmah uktu le hotu ah an tuah. Cule Mizpah ah Bawipa ih hmaiah Jefthah in an tiamkam awknak hmuahhmuah cu a sim sal thluh."},"12":{"text":"Cule Jefthah in Ammon siangpahrang hnenah palai a thlah ih, “Zianghrangah kan ram in do? Kan parah ziangso lungkim lonak na neih?” tiah a sut."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Ammon siangpahrang in Jefthah ih palai hnenah cun, “Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl an suah laiah Arnon Tiva ihsin Jabbok Tiva le Jordan Tiva tiang ka ram an lak a si. Atu-ah cumi cu pontam lotein in pek sal uh,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule Jefthah in Ammon siangpahrang hnenah cun palai a thlah sal ih,"},"15":{"text":"hiti in thu a let, “Israel mi pawl in Moab ram siseh Ammon ram siseh an lak dah lo."},"16":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin an suah laiah nelrawn lakin an feh ih Tipi Sen ihsin Kadesh an thleng."},"17":{"text":"Cule Edom siangpahrang hnenah palai an thlah ih a ram sungih feh theinak thu an va dil. Asinain Edom siangpahrang cun a rak siang lo. Cule Moab siangpahrang an dil lala naón anih khal in a rak siang thotho lo. Curuangah Israel mi pawl cu Kadesh ah an umta a si."},"18":{"text":"Cuih hnuah nelrawn ihsin an feh. Edom ram le Moab ram vel in an feh ih Moab ram ihsin nisuahnak lam, Arnon Tiva khatlam ralah an thleng. Cutawkah an riak naón Arnon Tiva an tan lo; ziangahtile Arnon Tiva cu Moab ram ih ramri a si."},"19":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl cun Amor miphun Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon hnenah palai an thlah ih a ram sung tan tahrat ih an ram ih feh theinak thu an dil."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla siangpahrang Sihon in a rak siang lo. A ralkap hmuahhmuah a ko khawm ih Jahaz ah ṭanhmun an khuar ih Israel mi an do riangri."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian cun Israel hnenah nehnak a pek ih Sihon le a ralkap pawl cu an neh. Cutawk ram sungih a ummi Amor mi pawl ih ram hmuahhmuah cu Israel mi pawl in an lon ṭheh."},"22":{"text":"Amor ram thlanglam ih Arnon ihsin saklam ih Jabbok tiang, nisuahnak lamih nelrawn ihsin nitlaknak lamih Jordan tiang, a zatein an luah thluh a si."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah amah ih mi Israel miphun hrangih Amor mi pawl a dawi hlotu cu Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian a si."},"24":{"text":"Cumi cu a lak sal na tum maw si? Na khawzing Khemosh ih a lo pek mi hmuahhmuah na co ding hrimhrim a si. Cuvek thotho in Bawipa kan Pathian ih in pekmi hmuahhmuah cu kan co ding hrimhrim a si ve."},"25":{"text":"Zippor ih fapa, Moab siangpahrang Balak hnakin ka cuang deuh tiah na ruat-aw maw si? Balak in Israel cu a dodal dah lo; a do khal a do ngaingai dah lo. A do dah tiin na ruat maw si?"},"26":{"text":"Heshbon khua, Aroer khua le an kiangkap ih khua pawl le Arnon Tiva kapih khua pawl tla Israel mi in kum zathum sung rori an luah a si. Kum hizat sungah ziangah so nan rak lak sal dah lo?"},"27":{"text":"Na parah thil ti sualmi zianghman kan nei lo. Nangmah sawn in in do ruangah na mawh a si. Bawipa cu thuṭhentu a si ih tuihsun ahhin Israel mi le Ammon mi karlakah thu a ṭhen ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Asinain Jefthah ih thucah mi cu Ammon siangpahrang cun ziang hmanah a siar lo."},"29":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih thlarau cu Jefthah parah a rung thleng. Jefthah cu Gilead le Manasseh ram sung ihsin a feh ih Gilead ram Mizpah ah a thleng. Cutawk ihsin Ammon ah a feh vivo."},"30":{"text":"Cutikah Jefthah in Bawipa hnenah, “Ammon mi pawl parah nehnak i pek a si ahcun,"},"31":{"text":"ka ral nehnak ihsin ka ra kir tikah keimah hmuak dingah ka inn ihsin a suak hmaisa biktu cu mei-ur in thawinakah ka pek ding. Zo a si khalle na hnenah thawinakah ka pek ding,” tiah thu a kam."},"32":{"text":"Cubangtuk in Jefthah cun Ammon do dingah tiva cu a tan ih Bawipa in nehnak a pek ngaingai."},"33":{"text":"Aroer ihsin Minnith kiangkap tiang, a zate-ah khua kul rori a neh ih Abel Keramin khua tiang Ammon mi pawl cu a that vivo. Mi tam ngaingai an thi ih Ammon mi cu Israel mi in an nehta a si."},"34":{"text":"Jefthah cu Mizpah an inn ih a tlun tikah a fanu cu khuang tum phah le lam phah in a pa hmuak dingah a ra suak. Hi a fanu cu a fa neihsun a si; fapa dang le fanu dang a nei lo.","title":"Jefthah Ih Fanu"},"35":{"text":"A fanu a hmuh tikah Jefthah cu a riahsia in a hnipuan a thlek ṭheh ih, “Ai law! Ka fanu! Ka thinlung i kuaiterta ci ee! Ziang hrangah so ka thin nattertu ah nang ngelcel na rak si? Bawipaói hnenah amah ih hminsaal in thukamnak ka tuah zo ih ka pelh thei nawn lo a si!” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cutikah a fanu cun, “Maw ka pa, Bawipaói hnenih thukamnak na tuah zo a si ahcun ka parah tuah dingih na relmi cu tuah ko aw. Na ral Ammon mi pawl ih parah phulaknak Bawipa in a lo pek zo a sisi,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Asinain a pa ih hnenah, “Maw ka pa, hi thil pakhatte hi cu i zaangfah hram aw. Thla hnih sung i thlah awla falat laiih thi dingmi ka si ruangah riahsia ninghang in fing le tlang ah ka rualpi pawl thawn kan lengta ding,” tiah a dil."},"38":{"text":"A pa cun, “Feh aw he!” a ti ih thla hnih sung a thlah. A fanu cu falahim ih thi ding a si ruangah cun a rualpi pawl thawn an feh ih riahsia lungleng in fing le tlang ah an tawivak."},"39":{"text":"Thla hnih hnuah a pa hnenah cun a ra kir ih Bawipa hnenih a kamcia vekin a pa cun a tuah. Cuticun falahim in a thita. Cumi cu Israel ram sungah daan hramthawhnak ah a cang ih,"},"40":{"text":"Gilead mi Jefthah ih fanu zuunngai in kum khatah ni li sung Israel nunau pawl hramlak ah an feh ih an ul ṭheu."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Efraim mi pawl an ko khawm-aw ih Jordan Tiva an tan hnuah Zafon an thleng ih Jefthah hnenah, “Ziangah so Ammon mi pawl do dingih na feh laiah kannih pawl in sawm duh lo? Na inn meisa in kan ur dingih na lu parah meisa a tla ding,” tiah an ti.","title":"Jefthah Le Efraim Mi Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Asinain Jefthah in, “Keimah le ka minung pawl cu Ammon mi pawl thawn thu el awknak nasazet kan neita a si. Cutikah i ra run dingah nanmah pawl ka lo ko naón zohman nan ra lo."},"3":{"text":"I ra run dingah zohman nan ra lo ti ka hmuh tikah ka nunnak hman ruat loin ka feh ih Ammon mi pawl cu ka do a si. Bawipa in i zaangfah ih ka neh. Ziangah so atu-ah keimah riangri do dingih nan rat?” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule Jefthah in Gilead mi pawl hmuahhmuah hmun khatah a kawh khawm ih Efraim mi pawl cu an do ih an neh. Ziangahtile Efraim mi pawl in, “Efraim le Manasseh ramih a ummi nannih Gilead mi pawl cu Efraim ihsin mitlanrol pawl nan si ko lo maw,” an ti ringring ruangah a si."},"5":{"text":"Gilead mi pawl in Efraim mi pawl an tlansuak lonak dingah Jordan tiva tan theinak zawn hmuahhmuah in an rak kan khelh. Efraim mi luat tum in khatlam tiva ral fehnak a dil tikah Gilead ralkap pawl in, “Efraim mi na si maw?” tiah an sut. “Efraim mi ka si lo,” a ti ahcun,"},"6":{"text":"“Shibboleth tiah sal hnik,” an ti ih, feltein sal thiam loin “Sibboleth,” ti ih an sal tikah Gilead ralkap pawl cun an kaih ih cutawk Jordan Tiva tannak ahcun pakhat hnu pakhat an that. Cuih ṭum ah Efraim ralkap thawng sawmli le thawng hnih an thi a si."},"7":{"text":"Gilead mi Jefthah cun Israel thuṭhentu kum ruk sung a ṭuan. A thih tikah Gilead ram amah ih khua ah an phum."},"8":{"text":"Jefthah thih hnuah Israel cu Bethlehem khua mi Ibzan in a ho.","title":"Ibzan, Elon, le Abdon"},"9":{"text":"Ibzan in fapa sawmthum le fanu sawmthum a nei. A fanu sawmthum pawl cu hrindang mi pasal a neihter hai ih, a fapa sawmthum hrangah khal hrindang mi nupi a neihter. Ibzan in Israel cu kum sarih sung a ho."},"10":{"text":"A thih tikah Bethlehem khua ah an phum."},"11":{"text":"Ibzan thih hnuah Zebulun mi Elon in Israel cu kum hra sung a ho."},"12":{"text":"Elon cu a thi ih Zebulun ram sung Aijalon khua ah an phum."},"13":{"text":"Elon thih hnuah Pirathon khua mi Hillel ih fapa Abdon in Israel cu a ho."},"14":{"text":"Abdon in fapa sawmli le tupa sawmthum a nei ih laak sawm sarih parih a to ṭheu mi an si. Abdon in Israel cu kum riat sung a ho."},"15":{"text":"A thi ih Amalek mi pawl ih tlangpar ram, Efraim ram sungih Pirathon khua ah an phum."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah Israel mi pawl cu an sual lala ruangah Bawipa in Filistin mi kut hnuai ah a thlenter hai ih kum sawmli sung Filistin pawl in Israel mi an uk.","title":"Samson Suahnak"},"2":{"text":"Culai ah Manoah an timi mipa pakhat a um. Amah cu Zorah khua mi a si ih Dan miphun a si. A nupi cu fa nei lo nucing a si."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi a nupi hnenah a lang ih a hnenah, “Nang cu nucing na si ih faate na nei lo; sikhalsehla atu thok ihsin nau na keng ding ih fapa na hring ding."},"4":{"text":"Ralringzet in um awla sabitti le zu in hlah aw; ei thiang lomi rawl khal ei aw hlah;"},"5":{"text":"ziangahtile nau na keng ding ih fapa na nei ding. Cuih na fapa cu a sam na met lo pei, ziangahtile a suah ni ihsin Pathian hnenih pekmi a si ding ih Nazir mi a si ding. Amah cu Filistin kut sung ihsin Israel mi runsuak dingah a thoktu a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah zamrangin a feh ih a pasal hnenah, “Pathian ih minung pakhat ka hnenah a ra ih Pathian ih vancungmi bangtuk a si ih ṭihzah tlak ngaingai a si.
