Khuitawk inso na rat, ti khal ka sut lo; cule anih khal in a hmin i sim ve lo."},"7":{"text":"Asinain, ‘Nau na keng dingih fapa na nei ding,’ tiah i sim. ‘sabitti le zu na in lo pei; ei thianglo rawl khal na ei lo pei, ziangahtile cuih na fapa cu Pathian hnenih pek mi a si ding ih a nun sung hmuahhmuah ah Nazir mi a si ding,’ i ti,” tiah a sim."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah a pasal Manoah cu Bawipa hnenah thla a cam ih, “Maw Bawipa , in zaangfah hram awla na rak thlahmi na minung cu kan hnenah rak thlah sal awla kan neih dingmi fapa cu ziangtinso kan kilkhawi ding, in ra sim hram seh,” tiah a dil."},"9":{"text":"Manoah ih thlacamnak cu Bawipa in a thei ih a vancungmi cu Manoah ih nupi hnenah cun a thlah sal. Culai ah Manoah ih nupi cu lo sungah a to; a hnenah a pasal a um lo."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah zamrangte in a pasal hnenah a va tlan ih, “Zohhnik, kan dungih a rami pa cu atu ka hnenah a lang sal a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Manoah cu a tho ih a nupi cu a hei thlun. Mi pa hnenah cun Manoah in, “Ka nupi hnenih a ṭongtu cu nangmah maw na si?” tiah a sut. Cule mi pa in, “Asi, keimah ka si,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Manoah cun, “Cuti asile, na simmi a kim tikah nauhakpa cu ziangtinso a um ding? Ziang so a tuah ding?” tiah a sut."},"13":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih vancungmi in, “Ka sim vekih thlun thluh dingah na nupi cu fimkhur zetin um seh."},"14":{"text":"Sabit hri ihsin a suakmi hmuahhmuah zianghman ei hlah seh. Sabitti siseh, zu siseh a in lo pei ih, ei thianglomi rawl khal a ei lo pei. Ka simmi hmuahhmuah cu a tuah thluh pei,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi a si, ti thei loin Manoah cun a hnenah, “Feh hrih hram aw hlah. Na hrangah me thuangte kan that ding,” a ti. Sikhalsehla vancungmi in, “Ka um hrih a si khalle na rawl cu ka ei zik lo. Asinain me na that asile meisa ur in Bawipa hnenah thawinak pe aw,” tiah a ti.","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Manoah in vancungmi hnenah, “Na simmi hi a kim tikah upat hmaizahnak kan lo pek theinak dingah na hmin in sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule vancungmi cun, “Ziangah so ka hmin theih cu na duh? Ka hmin zohman ih theih ding a si lo,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cule Manoah in me thuangte le fang malte a keng ih lungto biakṭheng parah mangbangza in hna a ṭuantu Bawipa hnenah thawinak a pek."},"20":{"text":"Biakṭheng ihsin meisa a alh ih Manoah le a nupi in an zoh lai fangah mei-alh lakin Bawipa ih vancungmi cu van ih a kai lai kha an hmu. Cu vete in Manoah le a nupi cu leilung ah an bok."},"21":{"text":"Cule vancungmi cu an hmu sal nawn lo. Cutikah Bawipa ih vancungmi a si ti kha Manoah in a thei."},"22":{"text":"Manoah in, “Pathian kan hmuh ruangah kan thi tengteng ding a si,” tiah a nupi hnenah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Asinain a nupi in, “ Bawipa in in that duh ngaingai sisehla thawinak kan pekmi kha a saang lo ding a si; hi bangtuk thil mangbangza hi in hmuh lo ding a si ih atu vek tikcu ahhin a theih khal in theiter lo ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"A nupi cun fapa a run hring ih a hmin ah Samson a sak. Naute cu a ṭhang vivo ih Bawipa in thluasuahnak a pek."},"25":{"text":"Zorah le Eshtaol karlak, Dan ralkap riahbuk ah Samson cu Bawipa ih thlarau in a run ṭhangphawk thok a si."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samson cu Timnah khua ah a vung leng ih cutawkah Filistin fala pakhat a hmu.","title":"Samson Le Timnah Fala"},"2":{"text":"An innih a tlun sal tikah a nu le a pa hnenah, “Timnah khua ah Filistin fala pakhat ka hmu. I biaksak hram uh. Ka ṭhi duh a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Asinain a nu le a pa cun, “Ziangah so serhtan lomi Filistin mi pawl ih nunau cu nupi ah na duh ngelcel? Kan sungkhat le kan miphun pawl lak ahhin na duhmi fala pakhat hman an um lo maw si?” tiah an ti. Asinain Samson in, “In ṭhitsak dingih ka duhmi cu amah pakhat lawng hi a si. Amah lawng ka duhmi a si,” tiah a pa hnenah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl do dingah Bawipa in tikcu ṭha a hawl ruangah Bawipa in Samson cu hiti in thil a tuahter a si, ti kha a nu le a pa in an thei lo. Culai ahcun Israel mi uktu cu Filistin mi an si."},"5":{"text":"Samson cu a nu le a pa thawn Timnah ah an vung feh. Cutawk lampi sabit lo sungih an feh laiah Samson cu kiosa note pakhat in a rak hngirhngir."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa ih thlarau cu Samson parah nasa zetin a thleng ih me note bauhthlek sehla cubangin kiosa cu a kut lawngin a bauhthlek thluh. Cutiih a tuahmi cu a nu le a pa a sim lo."},"7":{"text":"Cule falanu hnen ahcun a feh ih thu tla an rel tlang ih a lung a kimzet."},"8":{"text":"Tikcu malte a rei hnuah acuih fala ṭhi dingah Samson cu a vung feh lala. A feh laiah cun a rak thahmi kiosa ruak zoh dingah lamzin ihsin malte a pial duak ih a zoh tikah kiosa ruak sungah cun khuaibu khat a tizu thawn a hmu."},"9":{"text":"Khuaitizu cu a lakih a feh phah in a ei vivo. A nu le a pa hnenah a va thleng ih khuaitizu cu a pek ve. Annih khal in an ei; asinain kiosa ih ruak sung ihsin a lak thu a nu le a pa a sim lo."},"10":{"text":"Samson ih pa cu falanu ih inn ahcun a feh ih, culai tlangval pawl ih tuah ṭheu mi daan bangtuk in Samson in puai a tuah."},"11":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl in Samson an hmuh tikah a hnenih um dingah tlangval sawmthum an pek."},"12":{"text":"Cule Samson in an hnen ahcun, “Thu ka lo polh hai ding. Nupi ṭhitnak puai ni sarih sungah ka thupolhmi ih tican in sim thei a si ahcun sunghruk puannemte zun sawmthum le hnipuan thlengnak korfual zun sawmthum ka lo pe hai ding."},"13":{"text":"Asinain in sim thei lo a si ahcun sunghruk puannemte zun sawmthum le hnipuan thlengnak korfual zun sawmthum in pe ding,” tiah a ti. Annih in, “Na thupolh cu in sim hnik-aw he. Kan ngai hnik pei cu,” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Samson cun: “Sa eitu sungin ei ding a suak, A cak sungin a thlummi a suak,” a ti. Ni thum sung a thupolhmi cu an ruat rero naón an thei thei lo."},"15":{"text":"A ni linak ah Samson ih nupi hnenah cun, “A thupolhmi hi na hnenih phuang dingin na pasal hi leem aw. Cutiih na leem lo asile na pa ih inn kan ur pei ih nangmah khal kan lo ur cih ding. Hi puai ih in sawm hi farah thluh hai seh ti in duh ruangah maw a si?” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah Samson cu a nupi in ṭap phah in a pan ih, “I duh ngaingai lo a si; i hua a si hi! Ka rualpi pawl cu thu na polh ih a tican cu keimah rori hman i sim duh lo hi!” tiah a ti. Samson in a nupi hnenah, “Ruat ve hnik! I hringtu ka nu le ka pa hman ka sim lo. Ziangtin so nang ka lo sim thei ding?” tiah a sawn."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah ni sarih sung puai a reh lai hlanlo nitinte a pasal cu a ṭah hnawh ringring. Cutiih thlah loih a ngiar tuk ruangah a ni sarihnak ahcun a thupolhmi ih tican cu a nupi hnenah a sim. Cule a nupi cun a rualpi pawl a sim sin."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah ni sarihnak ni, a ihnak khaan sungih Samson a luh hlanah, khuasung mi pawl cun, “Khuaitizu hnakin a thlum sawn ziangso a um ding? Kiosa hnakin a caksawn ziangso a um ding?” tiin a thupolhmi cu an let. Cutikah Samson in, “Ka caw late thawn leilet hlah uhla cu, Nan thei lo ding nan ka thupolh mi cu,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih thlarau in Samson cu nasa zetin a umpi. Ashkelon ah a vung feh ih cutawk ah minung sawmthum a that ih an hnipuan a lak ṭheh ih a thupolhmi a let theitu pawl cu a pek. Cule a thinheng zetin a pa ih inn ah a tlung sal."},"20":{"text":"A nupi cu Samson ih rualpi ṭha bik, a nupi ṭhit lai ih a dinpitu an neihter."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tikcu a hung rei deuh ih sangvut khawm caan a si tikah Samson cu a nupi leng dingah a feh ih me thuangte khal a hrangah a keng. Samson in, “Ka nupi ihnak khaan sungah ka lut duh,” tiah a puzon cu a sim. Asinain a puzon cun a lutter duh lo."},"2":{"text":"A puzon cun, “Ka fanu cu na hua ngaingai a si, tiin ka zum ruangah sokhaw na rualpi pa hnenah ka pek. Asinain, a ngaingai ti ahcun anih hnakin a naunu sokhaw a mawi sawn. Na duh ahcun amah sawn hi ṭhi aw,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Samson cun, “Tuihṭum cu Filistin mi parah thil ṭha lo ka tuah khalle mawhthluk ka si lo ding,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah a feh ih cinghnia zathum a va kai. Cinghnia cu pahnih pahnih in an mei a ṭem ih an mei karlak ahcun meifar a ṭem cih."},"5":{"text":"Meifar cu a vang ih Filistin mi pawl ih sangvut lo lakah cun cuih cinghnia pawl cu a thlah ciamco. Cuticun an khawm ciami sangvut lawng si loin an lo sungih a um laimi sangvut tiangin a kangter thluh. Olif hmuan pawl khal a kang ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Filistin mi pawl in, “Hitiih a tuahtu cu zoso a si?” an ti ih Samson a si ti kha an thei. Ziangah cutiin a tuah tile Timnah mi a puzon in a nupi a lon sal ih a rualpi pa hnenah a pek ruangah a si. Curuangah Filistin mi pawl an feh ih cuih nunau nu cu meisa in an ur that ih a pa ih inn khal an ur thluh."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Samson in, “Hitiin maw nan thil tidaan a si! Siatcam in thu ka lo kam: nan parih phu ka lak hlanlo ka cawl lo ding,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah nasazet in a do ih Filistin mi tampi an thi. Cuih hnuah a vung feh ih Etam khaam ih lungpuk sungah a vung um."},"9":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl cu an hung ih Judah ram ah ṭanhmun an khuar ih Lehi khua an nam.","title":"Samson In Filistin Mi Pawl A Neh"},"10":{"text":"Cule Judah mi pawl in, “Ziangah so kannih in do?” tiah an sut tikah, Filistin mi pawl in, “Samson kaih kan duh ruangah a si; in tuah vekin kan tuah ve ding,” an ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Judah mi thawng thum cu Etam khaam ih lungpuk ah an vung feh ih Samson hnen ahcun, “Filistin mi pawl cu kanmah uktu an si hi na thei lo mawsi? Kan parih na thlentermi thil hi zohhnik!” tiah an ti. Samson cun, “Ka parih an tuahmi vekin an parah ka tuah ve a si ko,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Judah mi pawl in, “Nangmah lo ṭawnhrem tahrat in Filistin mi pawl hnenih pek dingah kan ra a si,” tiah an ti. Samson cun, “Cuti asile, kanmah cun kan lo that lo ding, tiah siatcam in thu i kam uh,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Asi, a ṭawn lawng kan lo ṭawn pei ih an hnenah kan lo pek ding. Kan lo that hrimhrim lo ding,” tiah thu an kam. Curuangah hridai tharte pahnih in an ṭawn ih khaam ih lungpuk cun an hun suahpi."},"14":{"text":"Samson cu Lehi khua a thlen tikah Filistin mi pawl a hnenah au phah in an ra tlan ciamco. Cutikah Samson cu Bawipa ih thlarau in nasa zetin a umpi ih a baan le a kut ih an ṭawnnak hridai pawl cu olte in a botcat thluh; a ol tukah pat phang khat meisa ih ur cat vekin an cat mai."},"15":{"text":"Cule laak khaberuh pakhat Samson in a hmuh ih a vun dawh ih a lak hnuah cumi cun Filistin mi thawng khat a vuak that."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Samson cun, “Laak khaberuh pakhat in milai thawng khat ka that, Laak khaberuh pakhat in miruak a thuah in ka thuah,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cuih hnuah laak khaberuh cu a hlon. Cuih hmun cu Ramath Lehi tiah an ti."},"18":{"text":"Samson cu a ti a haal ngaingai ih Bawipa a ko ih, “Maw Bawipa , na salpa kei hi ralnehnak tumpi i pe zo. Atu hi tihal in ka thi zik thlang; hiti in mawsi tihal in ka thih ding ih serhtan lo Filistin mi pawl ih kut sung ka thlen ding?” tiah a au."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in cutawk Lehi ih leilung sung ihsin kua a ongter ih cutawk ihsin tidai a hung put. A cuih tidai cu Samson in a in ih a tha a kim sal ih a cak sal. Curuangah acuih cirh cu En-Hakkore tiah hmin an sak. Tuihsan tiangin Lehi ah a um lai a si."},"20":{"text":"Filistin mi in an ram an uk laiah Samson in Israel hotu kum kul sung a ṭuan."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samson cu Gaza ah a feh ih cutawkah hlawhhlang nu pakhat a hmu ih a hnenah a it.","title":"Gaza Ah Samson"},"2":{"text":"Gaza khua mi pawl in an khua ih Samson a um kha an theih tikah an kulh ih zanvarte khawpi kulhnak kotka ihsin an bawh. Zanvar zianghman an tuah lo, an dai khepkhep. An thinlung tein, “Khawvang tiang kan bawh pei ih cutikah kan that leh pei,” tiah an ruat."},"3":{"text":"Asinain Samson cu zanṭim tiang lawng a it. Cun a tho ih khawpi kulhnak kotka khar cu a ṭhuam pawl le a hrolh pawl le a thilri zate thawn a phawi ih a liang parih a suan hnuah tlangpar ram, Hebron khua ihsin ralden ih a ummi tlangpar tiang a phur ih cutawkah a tanta."},"4":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Samson cun Sorek Phairawn ih a ummi nunau pakhat, a hminah Delilah an timi a ngai.","title":"Samson Le Delilah"},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Filistin hotu lal panga pawl Delilah hnen ah an feh ih, “Na tlangvalpa hi a hnik rak del aw; ziangtión so hi tluk lawmmam ih a cak tile, ziangtión so kan neh thei ding ih kan kaih ih kan ṭem thei ding, ti pawl a theih rak zuam hnik aw. Na ti thei asile ngun tangka thawngkhat le zakhat ciar kan lo pe ding,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Delilah in Samson hnen ahcun, “Ziangti in so hiti lawmmam ih na cah, i sim hnik aw he. Thuṭhimnak ah midang in a khih le a kaih lo tum bang hai sehla ziangti talin an lo kai thei lo ding maw?” tiah a sut."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Samson in, “A caar hrih lomi thalhri thar pasarih in i khit hai sehla ka tha a cem thluh ding ih midang vek thotho ka si ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule Filistin hotu pawl cun a caar hrih lo mi thalhri thar pasarih cu Delilah an pek ih cumicun Samson cu a ṭawn."},"9":{"text":"Inn khaan pakhat sungah mi a hrekkhat a ret ih Delilah in, “Samson, Filistin mi an ra!” tiah a au ciamco. Cutikah meisa urmi pat bangtuk in thalhri pawl cu Samson in olte in a botcat. Samson ih cahnak thuthup cu an thei lo."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Delilah cun, “Ruat hnik, thuphan i sim ih capohnak men ah i hman hi! Atu cu ṭhatein i sim thlang aw, ziangtinso mi in an lo ṭemtar thei ding,” tiah Samson cu a sut."},"11":{"text":"Cule Samson cun, “Zohman ih hman dah hrih lomi hrihrual in in ṭem a si ahcun ka tha a cem pei ih midang vek thotho ka si ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Delilah in hrihrual tharte tampiin a lak ih Samson cu a ṭem hnuah, “Samson, Filistin mi an ra!” tiah a au. Mi a hrekkhat in khatlam khaan sung ihsin an rak bawh. Asinain Samson cun a kut an ṭemnak hrihrual cu pat phang khat vekin a botcat thluh thotho."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Samson hnenah, “Caponak men ah i hmang ih i bum thotho a si. I sim ko aw, ziangtinso an lo ṭem thei ding?” tiah Delilah in a sut. Cule Samson in, “Ka samphiar phiar sarih hi thiam ah tak awla, thiamtleeng in hngette in khawncih awla, cule thiamtlang ah ṭemcih awla, ka tha a cem ding ih mi dang vek thotho ka si ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule Delilah in Samson cu a thlim ih a ihthah lai ah a samphiar phiar sarih cu a lak ih thiam ah a tah; thiamtleeng in hngette in a khawncih, thiamtlang ah a ṭemcih ih, “Samson, Filistin mi an ra!” tiah a au. Samson cu a ṭhang ih a ṭhuam pawl thawn a thiambu pi in a thawhpi luihlo mai."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Delilah cun, “Na thinlung in i duh ngaingai lo naón ziangah so ka lo duh tiah i ti? Voithum tiang rori i hmuhsuam ih ziangruangah so hiti ih na cah, ti hman i sim duh lo,” tiah Samson cu a ti."},"16":{"text":"Nikhat hnu ni khat, “I sim thlang aw he,” tiah Samson cu a ngiar ringring. Cutiin thlah loih a ningcerh tuk ruangah Samson cu a thin a pit ih thih hman a duh sawn thlang."},"17":{"text":"Cule a netnak ah a thuthup cu a phuan. “Ka sam hi meh dah lomi a si. Ka suah thlak vete in Bawipa hnenih pekmi Nazir mi ka si. Ka sam hi met sisehla ka tha a cem thluh ding ih midang vek ka si ko ding,” tiah a sim."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah thuhman i sim zo a si, ti kha Delilah in a thei. Filistin hotu pawl hnenah thu a cah ih, “Atu voikhatte cu ra hrih uh. A thuthup i sim zo a si,” tiah a ti. An ra ih tangka khal cu an rak keng."},"19":{"text":"Delilah in Samson cu a cawn parah a thlim, a ihthatter ih mi pakhat a kawh ih Samson ih samphiar phiar sarih cu a hleptan thluh. Cule Delilah in neh hram a thok. Samson ih thazaang cu a cem ih a cah-nak hmuahhmuah a hlo ṭheh."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Delilah in, “Samson, Filistin mi pawl an ra!” tiah a au. Samson cu a ṭhang ih, “A hlan vek thotho in ka tho ding ih ka luat ko ding,” tiah a ruat. Bawipa in a fehsan zo kha a thei lo."},"21":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl in an kai ih a mit an phorh ih Gaza ah an vun hruai. Cutawk ahcun dar ih tuahmi hreng an sut. Thawng sungah sangvut an rialter."},"22":{"text":"Asinain a sam cu a cerh vivo sal."},"23":{"text":"Lungawi ih aih ding le an khawzing Dagon hnenih thawinak nasazet pek dingah Filistin siangpahrang pawl cu hmun khatah an khawm aw ih, “Kan khawzing in kan ral Samson, Kan kut sungah a thlenter zo,” tiah hla an sak.","title":"Samson A Thi"},"24":{"text":"Misenpi in Samson an hmuh tikah an khawzing Dagon an thangṭhat ih, “Samson in kan ram cu kan ruak in a khahter, Kan khawzing in kan ral cu kan kut sungah a thlenter,” tiah hla an sak ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Misenpi cu an nuamzet ih, “Samson ko uh, hnihsuah capoh sainak ah kan hmang pei,” tiah an ti. Thawnginn ihsin Samson cu an rak hruai ih hnihsuah capoh sainak ah an hmang. Cule ṭhuam le ṭhuam karlak ah an dinter."},"26":{"text":"A kut kai tahrat in a rak hruaitu nauhakpa hnenah Samson in, “Hi inn ṭhuam pawl i thamter hnik aw, a hngauhsan ka duh,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cuih inn sungah nunau le mipa a khat in an um. Filistin siangpahrang panga pawl khal an um ih hnihsuahnak ih an hman rero mi Samson zoh duh ah minung thawng thum tlunta don ah an um."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Samson cu thla a cam ih, “Maw Cungnungbik Bawipa , i run thei hram aw. Maw Pathian, nangmah ih zaangfahnak in tuihṭum ṭum khatte hi cu thacahnak i run pe hrih hram awla ka mit pahnih an phorh manah an tlunih phu ka lak theinak dingin i zaangfah hram aw,” tiah Pathian hnenah a dil."},"29":{"text":"Samson cun inn dotu sutpi pahnih cu a pom ih kut khat in sutpi pakhat veve a kaih ih a nawp-aw ih,"},"30":{"text":"“Filistin mi pawl thawn thi tlang ko ning law,” tiah au phah in sutpi pahnih cu a tha neih tawp in a tuul ciamco ih innpi cu misenpi le siangpahrang pawl parah cun a vung cim luailo. Samson in cutawk ih a thahmi minung pawl cu a nun sungih a thahmi hmuahhmuah hnakin an tam sawn."},"31":{"text":"A unau pawl le a sungkhat pawl in a ruak cu an vung lak. A ruak cu an tlunpi ih Zorah le Eshtaol karlak a pa Manoah ih thlaan ah an phum. Samson in kum kul sung Israel hotu a ṭuan."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Efraim tlangpar ramah Mikah an timi mipa pakhat a um.","title":"Mikah Ih Milem Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Voikhat cu a nu hnenah, “Na ngun tangka thawngkhat le zakhat an ruk laiah a rutu kha na cam ciamco a si. Na cam lai rori ka lo thei a si. Zohhnik, na ngun tangka cu ka hnenah an si. Keimah in ka lak,” tiah a ti. Cutikah a nu in, “ Bawipa in lo thlawsuah hram seh, ka fapa,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule a fapa in ngun tangka thawngkhat le zakhat cu a nu hnenah a pek sal. Cutikah a nu in, “Ka siatserhnak cu na parih thleng lo dingah hi tangka hi atu ihsin Bawipa hnenah ka pek ih thing ih tuah mi milem le burmi milem tuahnak ah a si pei. Curuangah hi tangka cu atu na hnenah ka lo pek sal a si,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Mikah cun a nuih hnenah tangka cu a khirh sal. A nu in ngun tangka zahnih a lak ih ngunsertu hnenah a pek. Cule ngunsertu cun milem ah a bur ih a tuah. Cule Mikah ih inn ah an ret."},"5":{"text":"Mikah cu amahte in biaknak inn a nei. Milem pawl a tuah ih puithiam angki ṭaangthlaih khal a tuah. Cule a fapa pawl lakah pakhat cu puithiam ah a ret."},"6":{"text":"Culai ahcun Israel ram sungah siangpahrang an um lo ih mikip in an duhduh in an nung."},"7":{"text":"Judah ram Bethlehem khua ah tlangval pakhat a um. Amah cu Judah ramih a ummi Levi miphun a si."},"8":{"text":"Voikhat cu khawdang vai dingin Bethlehem khua ihsin a suak. A feh vivo ih Efraim tlangpar ih a um mi Mikah innah cun a thleng."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Mikah in, “Khuitawk inso na rat?” tiah a sut. Tlangval pa cun, “Judah ram Bethlehem khua ihsin ka ra ih Levi miphun ka si. Umhmun khuarnak ka hawl vivo a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Mikah in, “Ka hnenah hin um aw. Ka hrangah remruattu le puithiam si awla kum khatah ngun tangka fanghra ka lo pek ding. Hnipuan khal ka lo pek ding ih rawl khal ka lo cawm ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Levi tlangval pa cun Mikah hnenih um cu a lung a kim ih a fapa vek rori ah a cang."},"12":{"text":"Cule Mikah in a puithiam ah a tuah ih a inn ah a um."},"13":{"text":"Mikah cun, “Levi mi ka puithiam ih ka neih ruangah atu cun Bawipa in i hlawhtlingter ding ti ka thei,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Culai ahcun Israel ramah siangpahrang an um lo. Dan miphun pawl cu ram luah ding an hawl rero, ziangahtile culaiah Israel mi lakah ram luah ding an rak co ve lo.","title":"Mikah Le Dan Miphun"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah an hrin sungih innsang hmuahhmuah lak ihsin pacang ṭha bik an timi panga an hril ih Zorah khua le Eshtaol khua karlak ih ram zoh dingah le thlingthla dingah an thlah. An feh ih Efraim tlangpar ram an thleng ih Mikah inn ahcun an riak."},"3":{"text":"Cutawkih an um sungah cuih inn ih a ummi tlangval pa cu a aw-thluk in Levi mi a si ti kha an thei thiam. Cutikah amah cu an pan ih, “Hinah zoso a lo hruai? Hinah ziangso na tuah? Ziangah so hinah na um?” tiah an sut."},"4":{"text":"Anih in, “Mikah thawn thukamnak kan nei a si. A puithiam ka ṭuan ih ka hlawhman amah in i pek,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule annih in, “Kan khualtlawnnak ahhin kan hlawhtling pei maw hlawhtling lo so, Pathian in hun ron sak hnik aw,” tiah an dil."},"6":{"text":"Cuih Puithiam pa cun, “Hnangamtein va feh uh. Nan fehnak ah Bawipa in a lo kilkhawi a si,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah an panga cun an feh ih Laish khua an thleng. Cutawkih a ummi minung pawl kha an zoh tikah lungphannak zianghman nei lo, Sidon mi pawl bangtuk in hnangamzet in an um kha an hmu. Pakhat le pakhat tlunah thunei cuang um loin rualrem zet le tluangtlam zetin an um ih, hlawhsam mi zianghman nei lo ih a nungmi an si. An umnak cu Sidon mi pawl umnak ihsin a hlatzet ih miphun dang thawn pawl awknak le pehzomnak zianghman an nei lo."},"8":{"text":"Mi panga pawl cu an kir ih Zorah le Eshtaol an thlen tikah an phunpi pawl in an hmuh mi le an tonmi thu cu an rak sut."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Thok uh, Laish cu kan do ding. Ram cu kan va zoh ih ramṭha ngaingai a si. Ziangah so nan um thuaithi men! Zamrang tein pok uh! Feh lohli uhla an ram cu luah zaang uhsi."},"10":{"text":"A hmun nan thlen tikah helhkam nei lo, ralmuang zetih ummi an si ti kha nan hmu ding. An ram cu a kauzet ih Pathian ih a lo pek zomi ram a si. Milai ih poihai mi thil hmuahhmuah kim ṭhehnak ram a si,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Zorah le Eshtaol khua ihsin Dan hrin pawl minung zaruk cu ralthuam kimtein an keng ih an feh."},"12":{"text":"A so lamah an hung feh ih Judah ram sung Kiriath Jearim ihsin nitlaknak lam ah an riak. Curuangah tuihsan tiangin cutawk hmun cu Dan Riahnak tiah an tita."},"13":{"text":"Cutawk cun an feh sal ih Efraim tlangpar ramih ummi Mikah inn ah an thleng."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Laish kiangkap hrawngih ram a rak zohtu le a rak thlingthlatu minung panga pawl in an rualpi pawl hnenah, “Hi nan hmuhmi inn pakhat sungah hin puithiam korfual ṭaangthlaih, thing ih tuahmi milem le burmi milem an um, ti hi nan thei maw? Ziangtin so kan ti ding ruat hnik uh?” tiah an sut."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Levi tlangvalpa umnak Mikah ih inn pan in an pial ih, “Na dam lai maw,” tiah cibai an buk."},"16":{"text":"Culai ahcun raldo dingih a tiar-awmi Dan ralkap zaruk pawl cu kotka kiangah an rak ding."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah thlingthlatu mi panga pawl cu hmakhatte-ah Mikah ih innsung ahcun an lut ih puithiam korfual ṭaangthlaih, thingih tuahmi milem le burmi milem dang pawl cu an lak. Culai ah puithiam pa cu ralkap zaruk pawl thawn kotka ahcun a rak um."},"18":{"text":"Mi panga pawl in Mikah ih innsung ihsin milem pawl an lak a hmuh tikah puithiam pa in, “Ziang so nan tuah rero?” tiah a sut."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Daite in um sawn aw! Kam khat hman ṭong hlah! Kan hnenah ra awla kan puithiam le kan remruattu ah ra cang aw. Minung pakhat innsang hrangih puithiam si hnak cun Israel miphun phunkhat pumpi ih puithiam si cu na duh sawn lo maw?” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah puithiam pa cu a lung a awizet ih milem pawl cu a lak ih an hnenah a thlun ve."},"21":{"text":"Cuticun an khua lamah an kir ih an fanau, an ṭilva le an thilri pawl cu an hmaiah an khor vivo."},"22":{"text":"Mikah ih inn ihsin hla nawn an thlen tikah Mikah cun a innhnen pawl cu raldo dingah a ko. Dan ralkap pawl cu an dawi ih,"},"23":{"text":"an auh phah vivo. Dan ralkap pawl cu dunglet an hoi ih Mikah an hmuh tikah, “Ziangah so in dawi? Minung kha zatzat ziangah so na run hruai?” tiah an sut."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Mikah in, “Ka puithiam le ka tuahmi milem ka pathian pawl nan lak ih nan rak tlanpi ziar a si. Ziangtiih tuah so in tum? ‘Ziangah so in dawi?’ nan ti ngam lai sapbai!” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Dan ralkap pawl cun, “In auh hlah! Um men sawn aw! Hi ralkap pawl an thin na hengter a si ahcun nangmah le na innsang zatein nan thi men ding,” tiah an ti."},"26":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Dan mi pawl cu an feh. An cak tuk ih do ding rual an si lo, ti kha Mikah in a hmuh tikah a inn ah a kir sal."},"27":{"text":"Dan mi pawl in Mikah ih tuahmi thil pawl le a puithiam cu an tlanhlo pi. Cule an feh ih mi daizet le mi ralmuang pawl ih khua Laish cu an do. Khawsung mi pawl an that ih an khua cu meisa in an ur."},"28":{"text":"An khua cu Sidon khua ihsin a hlazet ih pawlkommi le pehzommi zokhal an neih lo ruangah runtu zohman an nei lo. Laish khua cu Beth Rehoh khua kiang horkuam ih a ummi a si. Dan mi pawl in cuih khua cu an din sal ih cutawkah an um."},"29":{"text":"Jakob ih fapa an pu Dan ih hmin suangin cuih khua cu Dan tiah hmin an sak sal. Cuih hlan ahcun Laish tiih an rak kawh ringring mi a si."},"30":{"text":"An milem cu biak dingah a umnak an tuah sak. Cule Moses ih fapa Gershom ih fapa Jonathan cu Dan mi pawl ih puithiam ah a cang. A tefa pawl khal Dan mi pawl ral ih an kaih thluh hlan tiang puithiam ṭuantu an si ringring."},"31":{"text":"Pathian ih biakinn Shiloh ih a um sung hmuahhmuah Mikah ih milem khal cutawk ah a um ringring."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Culai ahcun Israel mi pawl cu siangpahrang an nei lo. Efraim tlangpar ram dengah Levi pa pakhat a um ih Judah ram Bethlehem khua ih nunau pakhat a nupisun ah a lak.","title":"Levi Mipa Le A Nupisun"},"2":{"text":"Voikhat cu a pasal parah a thin a heng ih Bethlehem khua a pa ih hnenah khua a tlan. Cutawkah thla li sung a um."},"3":{"text":"Cule a pasal cu a hnen-um pakhat le a laak pahnih hruai in va leem ih va hruai sal tum in a feh. A nupisun in a pa ih inn ah ṭhatein a rak tlunter. A pa khal in aipuang zetin a rak hmuak."},"4":{"text":"A puzon in a kaih ruangah ni thum sung a caam. A nupisun thawn ti in rawl ei tlang in an riak."},"5":{"text":"Cule a ni linak zingah an tho ih feh dingin an tim an tuah. Asinain a puzon cun a maakpa ih hnenah, “Rawl ei hmaisata hrih uh. Nan ril a rawng pang ding. Nuamte in nan feh leh pei,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah an pu-tu in an totlang ih an in an ei tlang. Cutikah a puzon cun, “Tuihzan cu riak hrih awla nuamzetin um hrih ko aw,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Levi pa cu a pok tum thotho; asinain a pu in a kaih ruangah cun a ṭul sal ih zankhat cu a riak sal."},"8":{"text":"A ni nganak zingah a tho ih feh dingin a tim a tuah. Asinain a puzon cun, “Rawnhru tal eita awla nuam huahho in um hrih aw. Simneem na feh leh pei cu,” a ti ih an pahnih cun rawl an ei tlang lala."},"9":{"text":"Cun Levi mipa le a nupisun le a hnen-um pa cu an pok. Sikhalsehla a nupisun ih pa cun, “Zohhnik, zanlam a si thlang hi; tuihzan cu riak lawlaw hrih aw. A rei hlanah khua a thim cing ding a si. Curuangah tuihzan cu riak hrih awla um huahho hrih aw. Thaizing ah zingpit tein na tho pei ih na tlung leh pei,” tiah a kaih lala."},"10":{"text":"Asinain Levi mipa cun zankhat riah hrih cu a duh nawn lo ih a nupisun thawn an laak pahnih cu a todan an dan ih an feh suak. Jebus khua (Jerusalem timi) kiang an thlen tikah khua a thim zik thlang ih hnen-umpa in a bawipa ih hnen ahcun, “Ziangah so tuihzan cu hi Jebus khawpi ahhin kan riah mai lo?” tiah a sut.","merge":"11"},"12":{"text":"Cutikah a bawipa in, “Israel miphun an um lonak khua ahcun kan riak lo ding. Kan lan pei ih Gibeah ah kan feh ding."},"13":{"text":"Ra uh, kan feh hrih pei ih Gibeah ah a si lole Ramah ah kan riak pei,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Jebus khua cu an lan ih an feh. Nitlak zawng ah Benjamin phun ih ram sung Gibeah khua ah an thleng."},"15":{"text":"Cuih khua ih riak dingin zinpi ihsin an vung pial. Levi mipa cu khawsungah a feh ih an mual ah a to. Asinain zan riahnak tlun-inn an tong lo."},"16":{"text":"Culaitak fangah cun patarpa pakhat a lo ih hnaṭuannak ihsin a rung tlung. Cupa ih suahsemnak cu Efraim tlangpar ram asinain Gibeah khua ih a rung ummi a si. Gibeah khuami pawl cu Benjamin miphun an si."},"17":{"text":"Mikhualpa mual ih a to mi cu patarpa in a hmuh tikah, “Khuitawk inso na rat? Khuitawk ah so na feh zik?” tiah a sut."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Levi mipa cun, “Judah ram Bethlehem khua ihsin kan ra ih kan umnak Efraim tlangpar ram dengah kan feh ding. Bethlehem ka vung tlawng ih atu cu ka innah ka tlunglam a si. Riahnak dingah khuihman ah tlun-inn kan tong lo."},"19":{"text":"Kan laak hrangah rawl le hrampi kan nei; ka nupisun le keimah le ka hnen-umpa hrang khalah sang le sabitti lamcaw kan nei a si. Kan ṭul mi hmuahhmuah kan nei thluh,” tiah a sawn."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah patarpa cun, “Hnangam in um awla, ka inn ah rung riak uh. Nan sam mi hmuahhmuah keimah in ka lo pe ding. Hi mual ahcun riak hlah uh,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a inn ahcun a fehpi hai ih an laak pawl cu rawl a pek. Mikhual pawl cu an ke an kholh ih zanriah an ei."},"22":{"text":"Cutiih nuamzet ih an um laifang ahcun khawsungih mi sualral pawl in an inn cu an kulh ih sangka an run den ih inn neitu patarpa cu, “Na inn ih a tlung mipa cu rak suah aw; a sualpi kan duh a si,” tiah an auh ciamco."},"23":{"text":"Asinain patarpa cu lengah a va suak ih, “Unaule uh, a si lo. Cubangtuk a sualmi le thil ṭha lo ningsinza cu tuah hlah uh. Hi pa cu ka mikhual a si."},"24":{"text":"I ngai hnik uh; hinah ka fanu fala le hi pa ih nupisun an um. Atu ka rak suahpi pei ih nan minung an si. Nan duh vek in rak tuah in rak sualpi hai uh. Asinain hi patarpa ih par ahcun a ṭha lomi zianghman tuah hram hlah uh,” tiah a leem ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a thu cu an ngai duh hrimhrim lo. Curuangah Levi mipa cun a nupisun cu innleng ah an hnen ahcun a hei suah. Cutikah a nupisun cu an kaihrem ih an sualpi ih zanvar in an hmuhsuam."},"26":{"text":"Zinglam khawfingcat ah nunau nu cu a ra ih patarpa ih inn, a pasal riahnak inn ih sangka kiang a thlen tikah a sawn. Nisuah hnu tiang cutawk ahcun a um lai hrih."},"27":{"text":"A pasal cu zingah a tho ih a innih tlung dingin sangka a hei on tikah a nupisun cu sangka kiangah a kut sangka tlang pawk in a bok kha a hmu."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah a pasal in, “Tho aw, kan feh pei,” tiah a ti naón anih cun a sawn nawn lo. Cutikah a pasal cun a ruak cu a lak ih laak parah a suan ih a inn ah a tlung."},"29":{"text":"A inn a thlen tikah innsung ah a vung lut ih namte a lak. Cule a nupisun ih ruak cu ṭhen hleihnih ah a can thluh hnuah Israel ram khuazakip ah a kuat ṭheh."},"30":{"text":"Cumi a hmutu hmuahhmuah in, “Hi vek thil kan hmu dah keel lo. Israel mi Izipt ram ihsin kan suah ni ih thokin hivek thil hi a um dah lo a si. Ruat hnik uh! Ziangtal kan tuah lo ding maw?” tiah an ti cio."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel miphun pawl, saklam bik Dan ihsin thlanglam bikih Beersheba tiang, le nisuahnak lam ih Gilead ram tiangin, an zatein an suak ih thinlung khat pu in Mizpah ah Bawipa ih hmaiah an tongkhawm thluh.","title":"Raldo Dingah Israel A Tiar-aw"},"2":{"text":"Hitiih Pathian minung pawl a khawmmi lakah Israel miphun pawl ih hotu kimtein an tel thluh. Ke ralkap lawnglawng thawng zali an si."},"3":{"text":"Israel miphun pawl hmuahhmuah Mizpah ah an feh thluh ti kha Benjamin mi pawl in an thei. Cule Israel mi pawl cun, “Na nupisun an thahnak thuhla in sim hnik,” tiah Levi miphun pa cu an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah a nupisun an thah mipa Levi pa cun, “Ka nupisun le keimah cu Benjamin ram sung Gibeah khua ah zan riak dingin kan feh."},"5":{"text":"Gibeah mi pawl cu an ra ih keimah thah tum in kan riahnak inn cu zan ah an kulh ṭheh. Ka nupisun sawn an sualpi ih a thi."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah a ruak cu ka phur ih ka can thluh ih Israel ram khuazakip ah ka kuat. Hi khua mi pawl in thil ṭha lo le thil borhhlawh kan parah an tuah a si."},"7":{"text":"Hitawkih a ra suakmi hi Israel mi hlir kan si. Ziangtin so tuah sehla a ṭha ding tiah nan ruat?” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah an zatein hmun khat ah an ding ih, “Zohman inn ah kan tlung lo pei. Deu sungih a ummi kan si khalle, inn ngaingai sungih a ummi kan si khalle, kan tlung lo pei."},"9":{"text":"Kan tuah dingmi cu hiti in a si pei: Gibeah khua dotu dingah camcawhfung zuk in mi kan hril pei."},"10":{"text":"Israel minung zate ih ṭhen hra ṭhen khat in kan ralkap pawl hrangah rawl kan phur pei. A dang hmuahhmuah cun Israel ram sungih thil borhhlawh an tuah ruangah Gibeah mi pawl kan hrem pei,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi hmuahhmuah cu thukhat vua in Gibeah khawpi siim dingah an khawm-aw."},"12":{"text":"Israel miphun pawl cun Benjamin miphun ih ram sung khuazakip ah mi an thlah ih, “Ziangtluk thil ṭha loso nan tuahmi hi a si?"},"13":{"text":"Gibeah khawsung ih mi huatsuak pawl cu kan hnenah rak keng uh; kan that ding ih cuticun Israel ram kan thianfaiter ding,” tiah an ti. Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl ih ṭongmi cu Benjamin mi pawl in zianghman ah an siar lo."},"14":{"text":"Cule Benjamin ram sungih khawpi hmuahhmuah in mi tampi Israel do dingin Gibeah khua ah an ra."},"15":{"text":"Cuih sun lawnglawng ah an khawpi pawl ihsin ralkap thawng kul hluanruk, ralnam keng fetfet, an ko. Cuih tlunah Gibeah khua mi pawl in a hleice ih hrilmi ralkap za sarih an khawm."},"16":{"text":"Ralkap hizat sung ihsin an hrilce mi kehtlak minung za sarih cu an zatein, lungherhden thiam lamah cun, samphang pakhat hman ṭhelh loih sai thei pawl an si."},"17":{"text":"Cun Israel mi pawl cun Benjamin mi siar loin raldo thiamzet nam keng ralkap thawng zali an ko khawm."},"18":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Bethel khua ih Pathian biaknak hmun ah an feh ih Pathian hnenah, “Zohrin inso Benjamin cu a do hmaisa ding?” tiah an ron. Bawipa in, “Judah hrin in do hmaisa hai seh,” a ti.","title":"Benjamin Mi An Do"},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi pawl cu a thaizing an tho ih Gibeah khua kiangah an riak."},"20":{"text":"Cule Benjamin do dingah an pok ih ralkap pawl cu Gibeah khua ih hmai zawn ah an ṭang."},"21":{"text":"Benjamin ralkap pawl cu khawsung ihsin an ra suak ih an do-aw ih cuih ni ah Israel ralkap thawng kul hluanhnih an that."},"22":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Bethel ah an hung feh ih Bawipa ih hmaiah zanlam tiang ninghang riahsia in an ṭap. Cule annih in, “Kan unau Benjamin mi do dingah kan feh sal pei maw?” tiah Bawipa an ron sal. Cutikah Bawipa in, “Feh uhla do sal uh,” tiah a ti. Curuangah Israel ralkap pawl cu an tha a tho sal ih an ralkap pawl a hmaisa ih an ṭannak hmun thotho ah an ṭanter sal.","merge":"23"},"24":{"text":"Hihi Benjamin do dingah a voihnihnak an tiar awknak a si."},"25":{"text":"Cule a hmaisa vek thotho in Benjamin ralkap pawl cu Gibeah khawsung ihsin an ra suak ih Israel ralkap raldo thiamzet pawl cu thawng hleiriat an that lala."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi hmuahhmuah Bethel ah an hung feh ih ninghang riahsia in an ṭap ciamco. Bawipa ih hmaiah cun zanlam tiang rawl khal ei loin an to. Cule remnak thawinak le meiur thawinak pawl cu Bawipa ih hnenah an pek."},"27":{"text":"Culai ahcun Pathian Thukam Kuang cu Bethel ah a rak um ih,"},"28":{"text":"Eleazar ih fapa Finehas in puithiam a ṭuan. Eleazar cu Aaron ih fapa a si. Cun Bawipa hnenah thu an ron sal ih, “Kan unau Benjamin mi pawl do dingah kan pok sal pei maw, a si lole kan baang dingso?” tiah an ti. Cutikah Bawipa in, “Do uh. Thaisun cu anmah nehnak ka lo pe ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi pawl cun Gibeah kiangkap ah ralkap hrekkhat a thupte in an bawhter."},"30":{"text":"Cule a ni thumnak ni ah Benjamin do dingah an feh ih a hlan vek thotho in an ralkap pawl cu Gibeah khua ih hmaiah cun an ṭang."},"31":{"text":"Benjamin ralkap pawl cu a hlan vek thotho in an khawsung ihsin an ra suak ih Israel ralkap hrekkhat pawl Bethel lamzin le Gibeah lamzin le hramlak ah an that. An thahmi cu ralkap sawmthum tluk an si."},"32":{"text":"Benjamin ralkap pawl cun, “A hlan vek thotho in kan neh ding a sihi,” an ti. Asinain Israel mi pawl cun, “Dunglam ah kan siip vivo pei ih Benjamin ralkap pawl an khua suahsan thluh hai sehla lamzinpi hi run zawh hai seh,” an ti."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah Israel ralkap pawl tam sawn cu dunglamah an siip ih Baal-tamar ah an khawm-aw thluh sal. Cule Gibeah khua kiangih a rak thup-awmi ralkap pawl cu an thuh awknak ihsin an ra suak."},"34":{"text":"Israel mi sung ihsin hrilcemi ralkap thawng hra pawl in Gibeah khua cu an nam ciamco ih nasazet in an do-aw. Asinain Benjamin mi pawl cun kan van a duai thlang ding a si, ti an thei lo."},"35":{"text":"Benjamin ralkap pawl parah nehnak cu Bawipa in Israel mi hnenah a pek zo. Curuangah Israel mi pawl in ni khat sungah Benjamin ralkap thawng kul hluannga le zakhat an that."},"36":{"text":"Cutik lawngah Benjamin mi pawl in kan sung a si ti an thei. Israel mi pawl cun Gibeah kiangkapih a thup awmi an ralkap hrekkhat pawl kha an rinsan ruangah Benjamin ralkap pawl ih hmai ahcun dunglam ah an siip vivo."},"37":{"text":"Hi a thup awmi ralkap pawl cu hmakhatte-ah Gibeah khua sungah an lut ih an ṭhek-aw ih khawsung mi hmuahhmuah cu an that thluh."},"38":{"text":"Israel mi pawl le a thup awmi an ralkap pawl cu tiam awknak an rak nei. An tiam awknak cu: Gibeah khua sung ihsin meikhu tamzet van ih a kaimi an hmu asile,"},"39":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ral an donak ah dunglam siip nawn loin hmailam ih nor ding an si. Benjamin mi pawl in cutiang ahcun Israel mi sawmthum an that zo ih anmah le anmah cu, “A hlan vek thotho in kan neh a sihi,” an ti aw rero."},"40":{"text":"Cutikah an tiam-awk cia vek in Gibeah khawsung ihsin meikhu a suak ngualngo kha an hmu. Benjamin ralkap pawl in an dunglam an hei zoh tikah an khua cu a pum tein a kang rero kha an hmu ih an mang a bang ngaingai."},"41":{"text":"Cuvete in Israel ralkap pawl cu an her sal ih, an nor ciammam ih, Benjamin ralkap pawl cu an lung hmuah a aa thluh; ziangahtile kan ci in hmit thluh thlang ding a si ti an thei."},"42":{"text":"Curuangah dunglamah an siip ih hramlak lamah an tlan. Asinain an tlan suak thei lo. Israel ralkap burpi pawl le khawsung ihsin a ra mi ralkap pawl in an ciipton ih an sat that ciamco."},"43":{"text":"Cutiih an ciipton hnuah an dawi ih Gibeah ihsin nisuahnak lam tiang an dawi vivo ih lamzin tluanah an thah phah vivo."},"44":{"text":"Benjamin ralkap ṭha bik pawl thawng hleiriat an that."},"45":{"text":"A dang pawl cu Rimmon ih Lungpi lamah hramlak ah an tlan. Lam tluanah thawngnga an that. A taanglaimi pawl cu Israel mi pawl in Gidom tiang an dawi ih an saat that phah vivo. Cunah thawnghnih an that."},"46":{"text":"Azate kom ah, Benjamin ralkap ralṭha zetzet lawnglawng thawng kul hluannga an that."},"47":{"text":"Asinain minung zaruk cu Rimmond Lungpi lamah hramlak ah an tlan suak ih cutawkah thla li an um.","title":"Israel Mi In An Neh"},"48":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl cu an kir sal ih khawsungah an feh ih mipa siseh, nunau siseh, nauhak le ṭilva tiangin an hmuhmi hmuahhmuah an thah thluh. Cuih kiangkapih khua hmuahhmuah khal an ur thluh fawn."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Mizpah ah Bawipa ih hnenah thukamnak fekzet pakhat an tuah. An thukam mi cu, “Kanmah lakah zohman in kan fanu pawl cu Benjamin miphun pawl ih ṭhit dingah kan pe lo pei,” ti a si.","title":"Benjamin Mi Pawl Hrangah Nupi An Hawl"},"2":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl cu Bethel ah an ra ih, Bawipa ih hmaiah zanlam siim hnu tiang an to ih napi in an ṭap ciamco."},"3":{"text":"An ṭah phah cun, “Maw Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, ziangah so hivek thil hi kan parih a thlen? Israel miphun lakah hrin khat cu a hlohralta ding hi!” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah Israel mi pawl cu an tho ih cutawkah biakṭheng an dawl. Remnak thawinak pawl le mei-ur thawinak pawl cu Bawipa hnenah an pek."},"5":{"text":"Cule annih in, “Israel miphun pawl sungah Bawipa ih hmai ih pumkhawmnak ah hin a ra suak lomi zo so a um?” tiah an sut-aw. Mizpah ah Bawipa ih hmai ih a ra suak lomi cu thah an si ding, tiah fekzetih thukamnak an rak neih zomi a si."},"6":{"text":"Asinain an unau Benjamin phun hrangah cun Israel mi pawl cu an riah a sia ngaingai. “Tuihsun ahhin Israel mi pawl in kan phunpi pakhat pumpi in kan hloter a si."},"7":{"text":"Anmah ih sung ihsin a taangmi pawl hrangah ziangtinso nupi kan holh ding. Kan fanu pawl cu an ṭhit dingah kan pe lo pei tiah Bawipa ih hnenah siat kan serh zo fawn,” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule pakhat le pakhat, “Israel miphun pawl sungin zoso Mizpah ah Bawipa ih hnenah a ra lomi a um?” tiah an sut-aw. Cutikah Gilead ram ih Jabesh ihsin pakhat hman an pumkhawmnak ah an ra lo, ti an thei."},"9":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an siar-awk tikah Jabesh ihsin pakhat hman an tel lo ngaingai."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah an ralkap lakih ralṭha bik pawl thawng hleihnih an thlah ih, “Hung feh uhla Jabesh khawsung ih a ummi hmuahhmuah nunau le nauhak tiangin hung that thluh uh."},"11":{"text":"Fala siar lo mipa siseh nunau an zatein that thluh uh,” tiah thu an pek. Cule an thupekmi vek cun an tuah thluh."},"12":{"text":"Jabesh khawsungah fala note zali an rak um ih cu pawl cu that loin Kanaan ram, an riahnak Shiloh ahcun an run hruai."},"13":{"text":"Cule a pumkhawmmi pawl cun Rimmon Lungpi ih a ummi Benjamin mi pawl hnenah cun mi an hei thlah ih ralremnak thu an cah."},"14":{"text":"Benjamin mi pawl cu an ra kir ih Israel mi pawl cun Jabesh khua ihsin that loih an run hruai mi fala pawl cu nupi ah an pek. Asinain fala in an daih lo."},"15":{"text":"Israel miphun pawl pumkhat vekih a rak ummi cu Bawipa in a ṭhenṭhek thluh ruangah Israel mi pawl cu Benjamin mi pawl hrangah an riah a sia ngaingai."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah a khawmmi hotu pawl cun, “A taang hrih mi Benjamin mipa pawl hrangah ziangtinso nupi kan hawl sak ding? Benjamin miphun ih nunau pawl le thah thluh an si zo fawn."},"17":{"text":"Israel miphun phun hleihnih sungih sin phun khat hman hloralta ding cu kan siang lo. Benjamin miphun a nun theinak dingin lamzin kan hawl suak tengteng a ṭul a si."},"18":{"text":"Asinain kan fanu pawl an ṭhit ding cu a cang thei fawn lo,” tiah an ti. Ziangahtile, zohman in nan fanu cu Benjamin mi ih nupi dingah nan pe lo pei, tiih siatcam ih thu an rak kam zo ruangah a si."},"19":{"text":"Annih in, “Shiloh ah Bawipa hrangih kumtin tuah ṭheu mi puai cu rei lote-ah a um thlang ding a si,” an ti. Shiloh khua cu Bethel ihsin saklam ah, Lebonah ihsin thlanglam ah, le Bethel le Shekhem karlak lamzin ihsin nisuahnak lamah a um."},"20":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Benjamin mi pawl hnen ahcun, “Va feh uhla sabit hmuan sungah va relh uh."},"21":{"text":"Cule rak zoh ṭha uhla hi puai sungah Shiloh khua ih fala pawl an ra ding ih an laam ding a si. Cutikah sabit hmuan sung ihsin suak uhla cuih fala pawl sung ihsin nan duhmi ciar cu an duh lo cingin kai uhla hruaimai uh. Cule nan Benjamin ram ah fehpi uh."},"22":{"text":"An pa le an ṭapa pawl kan hnenih an rat ih an lungkim lonak an ra sim a si khalle kannih in, ‘Ngaithiam hai uh; nan fanu pawl cu co ko hai seh. Ziangahtile raldo laiah an nupi dingah kan kaihmi an si lo. Nan lungkim in nan pek mi an si fawn lo. Nan pekmi an si lo ruangah siatcam ih kan thukam mi nan buar fawn lo,’ tiin kan rak sawn ding,” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah an sim vek in Benjamin pawl cun an tuah. A laammi fala pawl sung ihsin an nupi dingah pakhat ciar an kaih ih an tlanpi. Cule an ramah an tlung ih umhmun an khuar ih an khawpi pawl an sak sal."},"24":{"text":"Culai ah Israel mi pawl khal cu an ṭiak ih anmah ih hnam le hrin le innsang ciar in an khua le an ram ciar ah an tlung."},"25":{"text":"Culai ah Israel mi pawl in siangpahrang an nei lo. Mi hmuahhmuah in an duhduh in an nung."}}}}},"8":{"info":{"name":"Ruth","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Ruth"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thuṭhentu pawl in Israel ram an rak uk laiah an ram sungah paam a rak tlung. Curuangah Judah ram Bethlehem khua ih a ummi mipa pakhat cu Moab ram ih um dingah a nupi le a fapa pahnih thawn an vung feh.","title":"Elimelek Le A Innsang Cu Moab Ram An Thleng"},"2":{"text":"Cupa ih hmin cu Elimelek a si; a nupi cu Naomi a si ih an fapa pahnih hmin cu Mahlon le Chilion an si. Anmah cu Efrath hrin an si. Moab ramah cun an vung thleng ih an vung um. Moab ram ih an um lai ah,"},"3":{"text":"Elimelek cu a thi ih Naomi cu a fapa pahnih thawn an hmei."},"4":{"text":"A fapa pahnih cun Moab fala an ṭhit. Pakhat ih hmin cu Orpah a si ih a dang pakhat ih hmin cu Ruth a si. Cule cutawk ramsungih kum hra tluk an um hnuah,"},"5":{"text":"Mahlon le Chilion an thi lala ih Naomi cu pasal lo le fapa loin amah pakhat lawnglawng a rung taang."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in amah ih minung pawl thluasuahnak a pek ih rawl an paṭhazet a si ti kha Moab ramih a um laiah Naomi in a thei.Curuangah a fapa le ih nupi pawl thawn Moab ram taanta dingah an tim an tuah.","title":"Bethlehem Ah Naomi A Kir Ih Ruth In A Thlun"},"7":{"text":"Cule Judah ramih kir dingah cun hmun khatah an pok."},"8":{"text":"Asinain lamzinah Naomi cun, “Nan inn ah kir uhla nan nu-ih hnen veve ah vung um uh. Keimah le in thihsan zotu pawl parih nan ṭhat bangin Bawipa cu nan parah ṭha ve hram seh."},"9":{"text":"Cule pasal nei sal in hnangamte ih nunkhuasak sal thei dingah Pathian in thlawsuah lo pe hram seh,” tiah an hnenah a ti. Curuangah Naomi cun damte in va kir uh, tiah a hnam hai. Asinain a fapa ih nupi pahnih cu napi in an ṭap ih,"},"10":{"text":"“In taanta hram hlah aw; na miphun hnenah kan lo thlun ko pei,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Naomi in, “Asilo, fanu le uh; nan kir tengteng a ṭul a si. Ziangah so ka hnenih feh cu nan duh? Nan pasal dingah fapa pawl ka nei nawn ding maw si?"},"12":{"text":"Inn ah vung tlung uh; kei pasal nei sal dingah cun ka tar tuk zo. Cun ruahsannak a um lai, tiah ti tahrat in tuih zanah pasal nei in fapa pawl ka neih khalle,"},"13":{"text":"patling an si lai hlan lo nan pasal dingah nan hngak thei ding maw si? Pasal dang neih a lo dawntu ah an cang sawn lo ding maw? Fanu le uh, a cang thei lomi a si ti nan thei ko. Bawipa in mi vanduai ah i tuah ih nan hrangah hin ka riah a sia ngaingai a si,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule ring zetin an ṭap sal thotho. Cun Orpah in a ni cu damte in tiah a hnamta ih a miphun hnenah a kir. Sikhalsehla Ruth cu kir loin a ni cu a kaih fetfet."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Naomi in, “Ruth, na pasal unau ih nupi cu a miphun le a khawzing hnenah a kir zo. Nang khal amah thawn inn ah vung tlung aw,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Asinain Ruth cun, “Nangmah lo taanta ih kir ding cu i fial nawn hlah aw. Na hnenah ka feh ve hram pei. Na fehnak kipah ka feh ve ding; na umnak kipah ka um ve ding. Na miphun cu ka miphun a si ding ih na Pathian cu ka Pathian a si ve ding."},"17":{"text":"Na thihnak ah ka thi ding ih cutawkah phum ka si ve ding. Nang le kei hi thihnak siar lo zianghman in in ṭhen hlah seh. Thu dang ruangah ṭhen dingih ka lung a kim pang a si ahcun Bawipa ih hremnak ṭihnungza cu ka parah thleng seh,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutiih feh ve a tumtah zia cu Naomi in a hmuh tikah zianghman a ṭong nawn lo."},"19":{"text":"An pahnih in an feh ih Bethlehem khua cu an thleng. An thlen thu an theih tikah khuasungmi pawl cu lungawi in an sa hiamhiam. Cule nunau pawl in, “Naomi kha maw na si?” tiah an sut."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Naomi in, “Naomi, tiah i ko nawn hlah uh. Marah, tiah i ko sawn uh; ziangahtile Ziangkimtithei Pathian in riahsiatpi tlak in i tuah zo a si."},"21":{"text":"Hitawk ihsin ka rak feh laiah khan neinungzet le famkimzet tein ka rak feh; asinain atu-ah Bawipa in i hruai kir tikah ka lawngte in ka thleng a si. Hitiin Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in i hnong ih i tisiat tikah hin ziangah so nannih in, Naomi, tiah in kawh duh rero?” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cuticun Naomi cu a fapa ih nupi Moab nunau Ruth thawn Moab ram ihsin an ra kir ih barli fang an ah thok pekte-ah Bethlehem khua ah an ra thleng."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Naomi cun a thizomi a pasal Elimelek ih lam in sungkhat a nei ih cupa ih hmin cu Boaz a si. Boaz cu milian le upattlak a si.","title":"Boaz Ih Lo Ah Ruth A Feh"},"2":{"text":"Ruth in Naomi hnenah, “Lo ah ka feh pei ih fang attu pawl ih hrelhmi fanglep ka va hawl pei. I zaangfahtu hnenah ka va feh pei ih ka va hawl pei,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Naomi cun, “Va feh awla va hawl he, ka fanu,” tiah a let."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Ruth cu lo ah a feh ih rawl ṭuantu pawl ih dunglam in a thlun ih fanglep cu a lak vivo. A fehnak cu Elimelek ih sungkhat Boaz ih lo a rak si."},"4":{"text":"Khua a hung tlai deuh tikah Bethlehem ihsin amah Boaz cu a ra thleng. “ Bawipa cu nan hnenah um hram seh,” tiah rawl ṭuantu pawl cu cibai a buk. Cule annih in, “ Bawipa in lo thlawsuah hram seh,” tiah an sawn."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Boaz in a rawl ṭuantu pawl hotu, a hnen-umpa hnenah, “Khi nu khi khuilam fala so a si?” tiah a sut."},"6":{"text":"A hnen-umpa cun, “Naomi in Moab ram ihsin a rak tlunpimi nunau a si."},"7":{"text":"‘Zaangfah tein rawl ṭuantu pawl hi an dung ka thlun pei ih an hrelh mi fanglep ka lak hram pei,’ tiah i dil. Zingpit ihsin tutiang a ṭuan ih tubaite ah khan deu sungah a vung cawl a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Boaz in Ruth hnenah cun, “Ka fanu, thu ka lo sim ding. Khui hmanah feh hlah aw; hi lo lawngah hin rawl cu hawl ko aw. Hinah um awla ka rawl khawmtu nunau pawl hnenah hin ṭuan aw."},"9":{"text":"Rawl an ahnak kha zoh awla, fang attu mipa pawl cu nangmah lo hnaihnok lo dingin ka tiam zo a si. Na ti a haal a si khalle mipa pawl ih an khai ciami thawl sungih ta kha rak in aw,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Ruth cu a hmai leilung dai in a kun ih Boaz hnenah cun, “Ziangah so kei miphun dang nunau hi hitlukin i zaangfah ih ka zawn i ruat?” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Boaz in, “Na pasal a thih hnuah na ni parih na tuahmi hmuahhmuah a zatein mi in in sim thluh a si. Na nu le na pa le na suahnak ram na taantanak le na hmuh dah lomi le na theih dah lomi miphun hnenih na rat thu khal ka thei thluh."},"12":{"text":"Hitiih na tuah ruangah hin Bawipa in lo rul hram seh. A thla hnuai ih humhimnak na hawlmi Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in a laksawng cu famkim zetin lo pe hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Ruth in, “I zaangfahzet a si, bawipa. Na hnen-um pawl lakih pakhat tluk hman ka si lo naón awkam ṭhazet ih i biak ruangah ka hna i ngamter zo a si,” tiah a sawn."},"14":{"text":"Suncaw ei caan a si tikah Boaz in Ruth hnenah cun, “Ra awla sang hi ra ei ve aw; sabitti sungah ciah in ra ei aw,” tiah a ti. Curuangah Ruth cu fang attu pawl lakah cun a to ve ih Boaz cun vaikan a rak pek. Khop zetih a ei hnuah a hlahmi tla a um lai."},"15":{"text":"Cule fanglep hawl dingih a feh hnuah Boaz in a hnaṭuantu pawl cu, “Fangcang phal pawl lak khalah fang cu hawl ve ko seh, dawn hlah uh."},"16":{"text":"Fangteel sung ihsin malte zuk uhla a sar dingah taanta hrim uh. A kawk khal kawk hlah uh,” tiah thu a pek."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Ruth in lo sungah fanglep cu zanlam tiang a hawl ih a ngah mi hmuahhmuah cu a vuak ṭheh tikah han khat lai a kim."},"18":{"text":"A fang phur in inn ah a tlung ih fang a khawmmi cu a ni hnenah cun a hmuh. Cule a suncaw hlahmi khal a ni hnenah a pek."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Naomi in, “Tuihsun khuitawkah so fanglep na hawl? Zo ih lo ah so na ṭuan? A lo zaangfahtu pa cu Pathian in thlawsuahnak pe hram seh,” a ti. Cule Ruth in, “Boaz an timi pa ih lo ah ka ṭuan a si,” tiah Naomi cu a sim."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Naomi cun, “A nungmi parah siseh, a thi ciami par khal ah siseh, zaangfahnak a thlenter ringringtu Bawipa in Boaz cu thlawsuah hram seh,” a ti. Cule Ruth hnenah, “Boaz cu kan hrinpi, kan sungkhat ngaingai sokhaw a si. Kannih in kilkhawitu ding khal amah a si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Ruth in, “A si ngai ding. ‘Rawl ṭuan kan ṭheh hlan lo cu ka hnaṭuantu pawl hnenah ra ṭuan ringring aw,’ i ti hngehnge,” tiah a ni cu a sim."},"22":{"text":"Naomi in Ruth hnenah, “A si ko, ka fanu; midang loih na feh ahcun hmuhsuamnak tla na tong pang ding. Boaz lo ih nunau hnaṭuantu pawl hnenih na ṭuan cu a ṭha bik a si,” tiah a sawn."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah Ruth cu Boaz ih hnaṭuantu pawl lakah hna a ṭuan ih barli fang le sangvut an ah ṭheh hlan lo fanglep cu a hawl. Cule a ni hnenah cun a um ringring."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Naomi in Ruth hnenah, “Ka fanu, innpawn suak ding le nunkhuasak nuam dingin ka lo tawlrel sak pei.","title":"Ruth In Pasal A Tong"},"2":{"text":"Na theih vekin, a nunau hnaṭuantu pawl thawn hna nan ṭuannak lo neitu Boaz cu kan sungkhat a si. Cule, ngaihnik, amah cu tuihzan ah fang ciilnak ah barli fang a thlir ding."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah ti kholh awla, rimhmui tla hnih awla, na hnipuan ṭha bik hruk aw. Cule fang a thlirnak ahcun va feh aw; asinain a in a ei hlan cu cutawkih na um kha lo thei hlah seh."},"4":{"text":"Cun a ih tikah a ihnak hmun kha hminsin aw. A ihthat tikah feh in a ke lam in puan kha ong awla a kiangah it ve aw. Cule amah in ziang tuah ding ti kha a lo sim ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Ruth in, “I sim vek in ka tuah thluh ding,” tiah Naomi cu a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Ruth cu Boaz ih fang thlirnak hmun ahcun a feh ih a ni ih simmi vek cun a tuah thluh."},"7":{"text":"Cule Boaz cu a in a ei ih nuam huahhi in a um ih, barli fang tampi an retnak ah a feh ih a it. A ihthat tikah Ruth cu thawthaang lo tein Boaz hnenah cun a feh ih a ke khuhnak puan a hliip hnuah a kiangah cun a it ve."},"8":{"text":"Zanṭim hrawngah Boaz cu a ṭhanghoi ih a siir a her tikah a ke kiang ih nunau pakhat a ih kha a hmu ih a mang a bang ngaingai."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Boaz in, “Zoso na si?” tiah a sut. Ruth in, “Na siahhlawh nu Ruth ka si. Na sungte ngaingai ka si ih i tlentu ding na si. Na puan kilte i zawn hram aw,” tiah Ruth cun a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Boaz cun, “Ruth, Pathian in thlawsuah lo pe hram seh. Na ni Naomi parih na tuahmi hnakin atu ih na tuahmi ihsin sungkhat duh awknak cu na langter sinsin. Milian siseh, mi farah siseh, tlangval deuh sawn pasal ah na hawl lo a si."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah zianghman phang hlah aw. Nunau ṭha na si hi khawsungmi hmuahhmuah khal in an thei thluh. Na duhmi hmuahhmuah ka lo tuah sak thluh ding."},"12":{"text":"Na sungkhat ngaingai ka si cu a dikmi a si. Sikhalsehla kei hnakin a nai sawnmi, na sungkhat tlentu, mipa pakhat a um."},"13":{"text":"Tuihzan cu hitawk ah hin um ko awla thaizing ah cuih na sungkhat pa cun na hrangah sungkhat ih ṭuanvo a la duh maw duh lo ti cu kan hliahter ding. A lak duh a si ahcun a ṭha ko; a lak duh lo asile a nungmi Pathian hmin sal in ka lo kam: Na hrangah ṭuanvo cu keimah in ka lak ding. Khawvang tiang hitawk ah it ko aw,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah zinglam tiang a kiangah cun a it. Asinain a kiangah Ruth a it ti kha mi ih an theih ding cu Boaz in a duh lo ruangah Ruth cu khawvang hlanah a tho."},"15":{"text":"Cule Boaz in, “Na korfualpi kha phuak awla hitawk ah phah aw,” a ti. A ti vek cun Ruth in a korfualpi cu a phuak ih a phah. Boaz cun barli fang han hnih tluk a pek ih a phurhter. Cule Ruth cu inn ah a tlung."},"16":{"text":"Inn a thlen tikah a ni Naomi cun, “Ka fanu, ziang na bang?” tiah a rak sut. Cutikah Ruth cun Boaz hnenih a hmuhmi le a theihmi hmuhhmuah a sim."},"17":{"text":"“Cuih tlunah na lawngte ih kir ding cu a rem lo a ti ih barli fang hizat hi i ṭhen a si,” tiah Ruth in a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule Naomi cun, “Ka fanu, cuih thu a hliah awk hlan cu hnangam tein um ko aw. Hi thu cu tuihsun ah Boaz in a fianter ko ding, a um men lo ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khawsung mi an tonkhawm awk ṭheunak khawsuah ah Boaz cu a feh ih a to. Boaz ih a rel mi Elimelek ih sungkhat pa cu cutawk lam ahcun a ra ih Boaz in a hmin in a ko ih, “Hinah ra to hnik,” tiah a ti. A ti vek cun a ra to.","title":"Boaz In Ruth A ṭhit"},"2":{"text":"Cule Boaz in khawsung upa pahra a ko ih, “Hinah ra to hrih uh,” a ti ih an ra to ve."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Boaz in a sungkhat tlentu pa hnenah cun, “Naomi cu Moab ram ihsin a ra kir sal zo ih kan sungkhat a si mi, a pasal Elimelek ih lo cu atu-ah a zuar a si."},"4":{"text":"Ka lo sim duhmi cu, loram cu na tlen duh asile hi upa pawl theih hngan ahhin tlen-aw. Na tlen duh lo a si ahcun keimah i sim aw; ziangahtile hi loram tlen theinak dingah cun nangmah na hmaisa ih kei ka neta sawn a si,” tiah a ti. Cupa cun, “Ka tlen ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Boaz in, “Cutiih Naomi hnen ihsin loram na tlen a si ahcun, loram cu mithi pa ih innsang kut sungih a um ringringnak dingah Moab mi leengleh nu Ruth cu na tlencih a ṭul ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah cupa cun, “Cuti a si ahcun loram cu tlen loin ka um sawn pei, ziangahtile ka ro hmuahhmuah ka sung thluh pang ding ti ka phang. Nangmah in tlen aw. Kei cu ka tlen lo sawn pei,” tiah Boaz cu a ti."},"7":{"text":"Culai ahcun Israel ram sungah thilri le leiram an zuar ah siseh, an thleng awk tikah siseh, an thlunmi daan cu: a zuartu in a kedam a phuak ih a tlentu hnenah a pek daan a si. Cuticun an thuhla a cat ti langternak a si."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Boaz hnenah, “Nangmah in tlen aw,” tiih a sungkhat pa ih a ti tikah a kedam a phuak ih Boaz a pek."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Boaz in upa pawl le cutawkih a rami hmuahhmuah hnenah, “Elimelek le a fapa Chilion le Mahlon pawl ih thilri le leiram hmuahhmuah cu Naomi hnen ihsin ka tlen zo ih tuihsun ahhin nannih cu nan zatein thutheitu nan si."},"10":{"text":"Cuih tlunah a thi zomi Mahlon ih nupi, Moab nunau Ruth tla cu ka nupi ah a cang a si. Cuticun thilri le leiram cu mithi pa ih innsang sungah a um ding ih a miphun lak le a khawsungah a innsang pawl cu an tel ringring ding a si. Tuihsun ah nanmah hi thutheitu nan si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah upa pawl le a ra telmi pawl cun, “Asi, thutheitu kan si. Na innsang sungih a ra thleng dingmi hi nunau nu cu Jakob hrangih faate tampi a hringtu Rachel le Leah bangtuk ah Bawipa in tuah hram seh. Efrath hrin sungah milian si hram awla Bethlehem khua ah na hmin thang hram seh."},"12":{"text":"Judah le Tamar ih fapa Perez ih innsang bangtuk in hi nunau nu sungih sin Bawipa in a lo pek dingmi na faale pawl in na innsang cu mawiter hram hai seh,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule Boaz in Ruth cu a inn ah a tlunpi ih a nupi ah a cang. Bawipa in Ruth cu thluasuahnak a pek ih fa a vun ih fapa a hring.","title":"Boaz Le A Tefa Pawl"},"14":{"text":"Cule khawsung nunau pawl in Naomi hnenah, “ Bawipa cu thangṭhat si ko seh. Nangmah a lo kilkhawitu dingah Bawipa in tuihsun ah tupa a lo pek zo. Israel ram sungah hi nauhakpa cu a hmin thang hram seh!"},"15":{"text":"Amah cu nunnak thar a lo petu le na tar tikah a lo hnemtu si hram seh. Cule a thi zomi na fapa ih nupi Ruth cu a lo duhdawtu a si ih fapa pasarih hnakih miṭhahnem sawn a si,” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Naomi cun a kut in naute cu a cawi; a ṭaangah a pom ih naute kilkhawitu ah a cang."},"17":{"text":"Cule naute cu an inn hnen nunau pawl in Obed tiah a hmin an sak ih, “Naomi in fapa a nei zo,” tiah an tomi poh an sim. Obed cu Jesse ih pa a rung si ih, Jesse cu David ih pa a rung si."},"18":{"text":"Hi pawl hi Perez ihsin David tiang an cithlah awk daan a si. Perez in Hezron a hring; Hezron in Ram a hring;"},"19":{"text":"Ram in Amminadab a hring;"},"20":{"text":"Amminadab in Nashon a hring, Nashon in Salmon a hring;"},"21":{"text":"Salmon in Boaz a hring; cun Boaz in Obed a hring;"},"22":{"text":"Obed in Jesse a hring ih Jesse cu David ih pa a si."}}}}},"9":{"info":{"name":"1 Samuel","shortname":"1 Sam","abbr":[],"desc":"1 samuel"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Efraim an timi tlangpar ramah Ramah timi khua a um ih cutawk khua ah Efraim miphun sung ihsin Elkanah an timi mipa pakhat a rak um. Amah cu Zuf miphun Tohu ih cithlah a si mi Elihu ih fa Jeroham ih fapa a si.","title":"Shiloh Khua Ih Elkanah Le A Innsang"},"2":{"text":"Elkanah cu nupi pahnih a nei ih Hannah le Peninnah an si. Peninnah cun fa a nei, asinain Hannah cun fa pakhat hman a nei lo."},"3":{"text":"Cule Elkanah cu a khua ihsin Shiloh khua ah kumtinte Ziangkimtithei Bawipa bia dingah le thawinak pe dingah a feh ṭheu. Shiloh khua ah Bawipa ih puithiam cu Eli ih fapa pahnih Hofni le Finehas an si."},"4":{"text":"Cun Elkanah in Bawipa hnenih thawinak a pek tikah a nupi Peninnah le a faale pawl hnenah an covo ciar a pek hai."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a nupi Hannah cu a duhdawtzet ko naón a covo pakhat lawng a pek, ziangahtile Bawipa in faate a pek lo ruangah a si."},"6":{"text":"Cutiih fa neilo a si ruangah a huatu Peninnah cun Hannah cu a tisiat ih a ning a zakter ṭheu."},"7":{"text":"Cuticun kum khat hnu kum khat a si vivo. Bawipa ih inn ih an feh tikah Peninnah in Hannah cu a riah a siatter ṭheu ih Hannah cu rawl hman ei loin a ṭap ṭheu."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah a pasal Elkanah cun, “Hannah, ziangah so na ṭah ih rawl tla na ei lo? Ziangah so riahsia ih na um ringring? Na hrangah keimah hi fapa pahra hnakin ka sunglawi sawn lo maw?” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Voikhat cu Shiloh khua ah rawl an ei ṭheh tikah Hannah cu a tho ih a thinlung a hartuk ruangah Bawipa ih hnenah ṭap phah in thla a cam. Puithiam hna a ṭuantu Eli cu Bawipa ih biakinn ih sangka kiangah a tokham parah a to.","title":"Hannah Le Eli","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Hannah cu thla a cam ih, “Maw Bawipa , Cungnungbik Pathian, kei na salnu hi i run hmu hram aw. Ka zonzaihnak hi i theihsak in kei hi i ciing hram aw. I hngilh hram hlah aw. Fapate i zaangfah a si ahcun a nunsung hmuahhmuah na hrangah ka lo pe ding ih a sam khal meh a si dah lo ding, tiah ka lo kam a si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Hannah cu Bawipa hnenah reizet thla a cam ih Hannah ih hmur cu Eli in a zoh ringring."},"13":{"text":"Daite ih thla a cam hrangah a hmur cu a caang rero naón a aw a suak lo. Cutiih a um cu zu a ri a si tiah Eli in a ruah hrangah,"},"14":{"text":"Hannah hnenah, “Zu ri tahratin mualpho in um nawn hlah. Feh awla va fimharh ta aw,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Hannah in, “Asilo, bawipa, zu ka ri lo. Zu hrimhrim ka in lo, sabitti khal ka in lo. Ka thin a hartuk ruangah Bawipa ih hnenah ka vansannak ka thlet thluh a si."},"16":{"text":"Nunau hlolak a si tiah i ruat hram hlah aw. Ka thin a pit ih ka van a san tuk ruangah hiti ih thla ka cam a si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Eli in, “Hnangamtein va feh awla Israel ih Pathian in a hnenih na dilmi cu lo pe hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule Hannah in, “Ka parah zaangfahnak thinlung nei ringring aw,” tiah a ti ih a feh. Cuih hnuah rawl malte a ei ih a riah khal a sia nawn lo."},"19":{"text":"A thaizing ah Elkanah le a innsang pawl cu an tho ih Bawipa Pathian cu an biak. Cuih hnuah Ramah khua an inn ah an kir. Cule Elkanah le a nupi Hannah cu an pawl-aw ih Hannah ih thlacamnak cu Bawipa in a theihsak.","title":"Samuel Suahnak Le Apnak"},"20":{"text":"Cutiin Hannah cu fa a vun ih fapa a hring. A fapa cu Samuel tiah hmin a sak, ziangahtile “ Bawipa hnenih ka dilmi a si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cule Elkanah le a innsang pawl cu kumtinte an pek ṭheumi thawinak le a thukam cia bangtuk in a hleice ih thawinak Bawipa hnenih pek dingah Shiloh khua ah an feh lala."},"22":{"text":"Asinain Hannah cu a feh lo. A pasal hnenah, “Ka fapa cu hnawi a thlah vete in Bawipa inn ah ka fehpi pei ih cutawkah a nunsung hmuahhmuah a um ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Elkanah in, “A ṭha bik na timi cu tuah awla naute hnawi a thlah hlan cu inn ah um ko aw. Cun Bawipa in na thukammi cu kimter hram seh,” tiah a ti. Cutiin Hannah cu inn ah a um ih a fapa cu ṭhatein a zoh."},"24":{"text":"Hnawi a thlah tikah a nu in Samuel cu Shiloh ah a fehpi ih kum thum a timi cawcang pakhat, sangphut han khat le sabit thawl khat tla an keng. Nauhakte asinain Samuel cu a nu in Shiloh khua Bawipa ih inn ahcun a fehpi."},"25":{"text":"Cawcang cu an that ih Samuel cu Eli hnenah an fehpi."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Hannah in, “Bawipa, i hngilh zo maw si? Hitawk ah dingin Bawipa hnenah thla a cammi nunau kha keimah ka si."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah fapa te ka dil ih atu-ah ka dilmi cu i pek zo."},"28":{"text":"Curuangah amah cu Bawipa hnenah ka pek. A nunsung hmuahhmuah amah cu Bawipa ih ta a si ding,” tiah a ti. Cule Bawipa cu cutawkah an biak."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hannah cu hiti in thla a cam: “ Bawipa in ka thinlung cu lungawinak in a khahter zo; A tuahcia mi ruangah ka lung a awi. Ka ral pawl ka hnihsan thei zo; I bom zo ruangah ka lung a awi.","title":"Hannah-ih Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa bangtuk a thianghlim mi zohman an um lo; Kan Pathian vekih Lungpi dang zohman an um lo."},"3":{"text":"Thangzetih nan tluangkhawnnak bang thlang uh; A puarthau zetmi nan ṭongkam cu daiter uh. Ziangahtile Bawipa cu ziangtinkim a theitu Pathian a si; Minung pawl ih tuahmi hmuahhmuah parah thureltu a si."},"4":{"text":"A cakmi ralkap pawl ih li le thal a kiak ṭheh; Asinain mi ṭawnṭai pawl cu an cak sal."},"5":{"text":"Rawl a khopzetmi pawl rawl hawl ah hlawhfa an tla ih, Rilrawng pawl an pum a puar sal. Fa nei thei lo nunau in fa pasarih a nei ih, Fa tampi a neimi nu fa nei lo ah a cang sal."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in a thihter ih nunnak a pe sal; Mithi khua ah a thlenter hai ih, A thi mi pawl tla a nunter sal."},"7":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat a farah terih a hrek cu a lianter; A hrekkhat mi nauta a canter ih, A dang cu mi pipa ah a canter."},"8":{"text":"Mi nauta pawl leivut lak ihsin a khaisaang ih, Mi tlasam pawl vutcam lak ihsin a cawisaang a si. Siangpahrang ih fapa pawl thawn a toter ih, upatnak hmun ah a toh hai. Leilung hramṭohnak pawl cu Bawipa ih ta an si; Cuih parah leilung hi a dinter a si."},"9":{"text":"“A mithianghlim pawl ih ke feh a kilkhawi; Asinain mi siava pawl cu khawthim lakah an hlo ralta; Milai cahnak lawngin hlawhtlinnak a um lo."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa a dodaltu pawl cu siatsuah thluh an si ding; Vancung ihsin khawri bangin a run tlir hai ding. Bawipa in leilung pumpi thu a rel ding; A siangpahrang hnenah cahnak a pe ding; A hrilciami siangpahrang cu nehtu a siter ding,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Elkanah cu Ramah ah a kir. Asinain Samuel cu Shiloh ah a umta ih puithiam Eli ih kuthnuai ah Bawipa ih hna a ṭuan."},"12":{"text":"Eli ih fapa pawl cu misualral an si. Bawipa Pathian khal zianghman ah an siar lo.","title":"Eli-ih Fapa Pawl"},"13":{"text":"Israel mi pawl hnen ihsin puithiam pawl ih covo an ngahdan pawl tla an tisual thluh. An daan bangtuk in mi pakhat in Pathian hnenih thawinak a pek tikah puithiam ih hnen-um pa cu ṭeek thum a ṭeekmi darhai thawn a ra. Thawinak sa an suan rero laiah,"},"14":{"text":"beel sungih sa cu a darhai cun a vun sawh ih a thur theimi poh cu puithiam hrangah a si. Thawinak pe dingah Shiloh khua ih a rami Israel mi pawl hmuahhmuah hrangah cubangtuk in an tuah ringring a si."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Eli ih fapa pawl ih san ahcun an thahmi sa ih a thau hman mei ih an ur hlanah puithiam ih hnen-um pa a ra ih thawinak a tuahtu pa hnenah, “Puithiam hrangih em dingah sa i pe aw. Suan ciami cu a saang lo ding. Sahring lawnglawng a saang a si,” tiah a ra ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah thawinak a petu pa in, “A thau hi mei in kan ur hmaisa pei ih cuih hnuah na duhmi na lak leh pei,” tiah a ti tikah, puithiam ih hnen-um pa cun, “Asilo, atu-ah i pe aw. I pek lo asile hranhram in ka lak ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cuticun Eli ih fapa pawl ih sualnak cu Bawipa ih hmaiah a tum ngaingai, ziangahtile Bawipa hnenih pek mi thawinak pawl kha nautatnak thawn an borhhlawhter a si."},"18":{"text":"Nauhakpa te Samuel cu Bawipa ih puithiam hna a ṭuan ih puan nemte ih tuahmi ṭaangthlaih angki a hruk ṭheu.","title":"Shiloh Khua Ah Samuel"},"19":{"text":"Kumtinte a nu in korfual a ṭhit sak ih, kum khatah voikhat thawinak a pasal thawn an pek tikah a cuih korfual cu a fapa a pek ṭheu."},"20":{"text":"Cule Elkanah le a nupi cu Eli in thluasuahnak a pek hai ih Elkanah hnenah, “ Bawipa hnenih na pekmi fapa aiah hi na nupi sung ihsin Bawipa in faate dang lo pe hram seh,” tiah a ti. Cuih hnuah an khua ah an tlung ṭheu."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in Hannah cu a thluasuah ngaingai ih faate dang fapa pathum le fanu pahnih tla a nei sal. Nauhak pa Samuel cu Bawipa ih hna ṭuan in a ṭhang vivo."},"22":{"text":"Eli cu a tarzet thlang. Israel mi pawl parih a fapa pawl an nuncan le Pathian umnak Puanthlam sung luhnak sangka-ih hnaṭuantu nunau pawl hman an sualpinak thu a thei ringring.","title":"Eli Le A Fapa Pawl"},"23":{"text":"Cutikah a fapa pawl hnenah, “Ziangah hi vekin nan nung? Mi hmuahhmuah in thil sualral nan tuahnak thu hi in sim a si."},"24":{"text":"Faale uh, cuvek cu tuah nawn hlah uh. Bawipaói minung pawl ih an rel rero mi hi thu ṭha lozet a si."},"25":{"text":"Mi pakhat in midang parih a sual ahcun thuremtu ah Pathian a um. Sikhalsehla mi pakhat in Pathian parih a sual ahcun zo in so remnakthu a tuah thei ding?” tiah a ti. An pa in a kawk rero naón an lung duh lo, ziangahtile anmah tla cu that dingah Bawipa in a ruat cia zo a si."},"26":{"text":"Nauhak pa Samuel cu Pathian hmai le minung hmaiah mithmai ṭha co in a ṭhang vivo."},"27":{"text":"Profet pakhat Eli hnenah a ra ih Bawipa ih thu cu hiti in a ra sim, “Nan pu Aaron le a sungkhat pawl Izipt ram sungih Faro ih sal an si laiah Aaron hnenah ka rak lang.","title":"Eli Ih Innsang Parah Thusia A Thleng"},"28":{"text":"Ka puithiam an sinak dingah le biakṭheng ah ka hna ṭuan in rimthaw zihmui tla an ur ih ka hrangah korfual thianghlim a phurtu an sinak dingah amah ih sungkhat pawl cu Israel miphun hmuahhmuah sungih sin ka hril zo a si. Cuih tlunah biakṭheng parih meisa ur in thawinak an pekmi sung ihsin an ngah venak dingah covo ka pek hai a si."},"29":{"text":"Cutiin a si ko naón ziangah so keimah ih thupekmi vekih an thawimi le saserh an pekmi duhhamnak thawn na zoh ih na nahsuah? Ziangah so ka miphun Israel mi pawl ih thawinak an pekmi hmuahhmuah lakih sathaw bik cu na fapa pawl eiter tahrat in nanmah hmuah nan thau thluh? Keimah hnakin na fapa pawl na sunloih sawn maw si?"},"30":{"text":"Na sungkhat siseh, na phunpi siseh kumkhua in keimah ih puithiam nan ṭuan pei tiah Israel ih Bawipa Pathian, Keimah hrimhrim in ka lo tiam cia zo. Sikhalsehla cubangtuk in a si nawn lo pei, tiah atu-ah ka lo sim. I sunloihtu sawn kha ka sunloih ve pei ih i hmuhsuamtu cu ka hmuhsuam ve ding."},"31":{"text":"Ruathnik, na sungkhat sungah tarkunih a nungmi an um lonak dingah na sungkhat le na phunpi sungih tlangval hmuahhmuah ka thihter thluhnak tikcu a ra thleng ding."},"32":{"text":"Cutikah na ning a hang ding ih Israel mi pawl hnenih thluasuah ka pekmi na nahsik zet ding, asinain na sungkhat lakah tarkun tiang a nungdammi pakhat hman an um dah lo ding."},"33":{"text":"Na tesinfa sung ihsin mi pakhat lawnglawng a nungdam ding ih ka puithiam hna a ṭuan ding. Amah cu a mit a caw ding ih thinpit beidong in a um ding. Na tesinfa dang hmuahhmuah cu saarthih in an thi thluh ding."},"34":{"text":"Cun na fapa pahnih Hofni le Finehas tla cu ni khat ni rori ih an thih tikah ka thusimmi pawl hi a dik a si, ti a lang ding."},"35":{"text":"Cuih hnuah ka hrangih rintlak a si mi puithiam pakhat ka hril ding ih tuah ka duhmi hmuahhmuah a tuah thluh ding. Tesinfa tampi ka pe ding ih anmah tla cu ka hril mi siangpahrang ih hmaiah hna an ṭuan ringring ding."},"36":{"text":"Na tesinfa lakah nungdammi an um asile rawl ei ding an ngahnak dingah siangpahrang hnenah feh in paisa le rawl an dil ding ih puithiam pawl bawmtu an si theinak ding tla an dil ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nauhakpa Samuel cu Eli ih kuthnuai ah Bawipa ih hnaṭuanin a um. Cuih tikcu ah Bawipa ih ṭongkam a mal vivo ih Bawipa ih langnak khal a um tuk nawn lo.","title":"Samuel Hnenah A Lang"},"2":{"text":"Eli cu a mit a mal thlang. Zankhat cu a ihnak khaan ah a it ih,"},"3":{"text":"Samuel cu Bawipa ih thukam kuang retnak khaan ah a it ve. Khua a vang hrih lo, Bawipa ih mei-inn a vanglai."},"4":{"text":"Samuel cu Bawipa in a run ko. Samuel in, “ Bawipa , ka um ko,” tiah a ti ih,"},"5":{"text":"Eli hnenah a va tlan ih, “Ka ra zo, ziangah so i kawh?” tiah a ti. Eli in, “Ka lo ko lo, feh awla va it sal aw,” tiah a ti. Curuangah Samuel cu a va it sal."},"6":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, “Samuel” tiah a ko sal. Samuel cu a tho ih Eli hnenah a feh ih, “Ka ra zo, ziangah so i kawh?” tiah a ti. Eli cun, “Ka fapa, ka lo ko lo; feh awla va it sal aw,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Samuel cun Bawipa in i ko, ti a thei lo; ziangahtile Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu Samuel hnenah phuan in a um dah lo."},"8":{"text":"Voithum tiang Bawipa in Samuel cu a ko. Samuel cu a tho ih Eli hnenah a feh lala ih, “Ka ra zo, ziangah so i kawh?” tiah a ti. Cutikah Samuel kotu cu Bawipa a si, tiah Eli in a thei ih a hnenah,"},"9":{"text":"“Va feh awla va it sal aw; a lo ko sal asile ‘ Bawipa na sim duhmi sim aw; na aw ka thei a si,’ tiah na ti pei,” a ti. Cutiin Samuel cu a va it sal."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ra ih a kiangah a ding, “Samuel, Samuel,” tiah a hlan bangtuk thotho in a ko. Cutikah Samuel in, “ Bawipa , na sim duhmi cu sim aw. Na salpa in na aw ka thei a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, “Israel mi pawl ih parah ṭihnungza thil pakhat ka tuah ding ih cuih ka tuahmi a theitu hmuahhmuah in an tuk a sum ding."},"12":{"text":"A cuih ni ahcun Eli ih sungkhat pawl hrangah thusia ka simmi hmuahhmuah ṭongkam pakhat hman hrelh loin ka kimter thluh ding."},"13":{"text":"A fapa pawl in ka thang in siatter ruangah a sungkhat pawl cu ka hrem hai ding a si, tiah Eli ka sim cia zo. A fapa pawl ih thil ṭha lo an tuahmi a thei naón a kham lo."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah ziangvek thawinak le thil an pek khalle hitluk sualnak tum an tuahmi cu a tlengfai thei nawn lo pei, tiah Eli sungkhat pawl hnenah fiangtein ka run phuang a si,” tiah Samuel hnenah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Samuel cu khawvang tiang a it. Cuih hnuah a tho ih biakinn sangka pawl a ong. A hmuhmi le a theihmi pawl cu Eli hnenah a sim ngam lo."},"16":{"text":"Cule Eli in, “Ka fapa, Samuel,” tiah a ko. Samuel in, “Hinah ka um!” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Eli in, “ Bawipa in ziangso a lo sim? Zianghman pheh hlah aw. Ka hnenih na sim ṭheh lo asile Pathian in nasazet in a lo hrem ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah Samuel in a sim ṭheh. A phehmi pakhat hman a um lo. Cule Eli in, “Amah cu Bawipa a si ih a mithmuh ah a ṭha bik a timi tuah ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Samuel cu a ṭhang vivo. Bawipa a hnenah a um ih a simmi hmuahhmuah Bawipa in a kimter ṭheh."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi hmuahhmuah in, an ram zim le dengih a ummi pawl tiangin, Samuel cu Bawipa ih profet a si tiah an thei ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Samuel hnenih a langnak le a ṭongnak hmun Shiloh ahcun Bawipa cu cat loin a lang ringring a si. Cule Samuel a ṭong tikah Israel mi pawl in an ngai duhzet."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A cuih caanah Filistin mi pawl do dingah Israel mi pawl cu an pok. Israel ralkap pawl cu Ebenezer ah an riak ih Filistin ralkap pawl cu Afek ah an riak.","title":"Thukamnak Thingkuang An Lon"},"2":{"text":"An tim-awk thluh hnuah Filistin pawl in Israel pawl cu an do ih nasazet ih an do awk hnuah Israel mi cu an neh ih minung thawng li tluk an that."},"3":{"text":"A luatmi ralkap pawl cu an riahnak hmun an thlen tikah Israel mi hruaitu pawl in, “Ziangah so Filistin pawl ih in neh dingah Pathian in a tuah? Pathian kan hnenih a feh venak dingah le kan ral pawl ih kutsung ihsin kan luatnak dingah kan feh pei ih Shiloh ihsin Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu kan lak pei,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Shiloh ah mi an thlah ih cherub timi thlanei ramsa lem pahnih karlakah tokham parih a totu Ziangkimtithei Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu an va lak. Cunah cun Eli ih fapa pahnih Hofni le Finehas khal an tel ve."},"5":{"text":"Thukam Kuang an thlenpi tikah Israel mi pawl cu an au ciamco ih an au tuk ruangah leilung tiangin a hnin ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Cutiih an au cu Filistin mi pawl in an theih tikah, “Hebru mi pawl an riahnak ih an au ciamco cu ngaihnik uh! Ziang so an duhnak a si?” tiah an ti-aw. Cule Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang Hebru mi pawl ih riahnak ah a thleng zo a si ti an theih tikah,"},"7":{"text":"an thin a phang ih, “An riahnak ah khawzing pakhat a ra thleng zo. Curuangah kannih cu kan cem a si. Hi bangtuk thil cu kan thei dah keel lo."},"8":{"text":"Hi bangtuk ih huham a nei mi khawzing pawl ih kutsung ihsin zoso in runsuak thei ding? Nelrawn ih Izipt mi pawl a that thluhtu cu hi khawzing pawl hi an si."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Filistin mi pawl, nan ral ṭha uh! Pacang bangin do uh. Culole kan sal an si vekin anmah Hebru pawl ih sal ah kan cang tengteng ding. Curuangah pacang vekin do uh!” tiah Filistin mi pawl an au ciamco ve."},"10":{"text":"Cule Filistin mi pawl cun ralṭha zetin an do. Israel mi pawl cu an sung ih an inn lamah an tlan thluh. Mi tampi an thi: Israel ralkap thawng sawmthum an thi a si."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang khal Filistin mi pawl in an lon ih Eli ih fapa Hofni le Finehas khal an that."},"12":{"text":"Ral an do awknak hmun ihsin Benjamin hrin mi pakhat cu Shiloh lamah a tlan ih cuih ni ah a va thleng. A riahsiatnak langnak ah a hnipuan a thlek ih a lu ah leivut a phulh aw.","title":"Eli Thihnak"},"13":{"text":"Eli cu lamzin kiangah tokham parah khawruahhar zetin a to. Pathian Thukam Kuang thu a ruah tikah a helhkam ngaingai. Culai ah raltlan pa cun khawsungah thu a rung than ih khawsung mi pawl cu lung phang in an ṭap ciamco."},"14":{"text":"Cuih thawmvang cu Eli in a theih tikah, “Ziang thawmvang so a si?” tiah a sut. Ral tlan pa cu zamrang in Eli hnenah thuthang sim dingin a va tlan."},"15":{"text":"Eli cu kum sawmkua le kum riat a si zo ih khua a hmu nawn lo."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah ral tlan pa cun, “Raldonak hmun ihsin ka luat ih tuihsun ah hitawk tiang ka ra tlan a si,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Eli in, “Ziang a cang, ka fapa?” tiah a sut."},"17":{"text":"Cupa cun, “Filistin mi pawl in in neh ih Israel mi pawl cu an tlan ṭheh. Kan sung thla rori a si. Cuih tlunah na fapa pahnih Hofni le Finehas khal an thi; Pathian Thukam Kuang khal in long a si,” tiah a sim."},"18":{"text":"Cutiih Thukam Kuang thu a vun sim vete in Eli cu kotka kiangih a tokham ihsin dunglam ah a ril. A tar tuk zo ih tlunah a khiing khal a rit tuk ruangah a rilhnak ah a hngawng a kiak ih a thi. Eli cu Israel mi pawl hotu kum sawmli sung a ṭuan a si."},"19":{"text":"Eli ih fapa Finehas ih nupi cu fa a vun ih, a nithla a kim zik thlang. Cule Pathian Thukam Kuang cu Filistin mi pawl in an long ih a pasal ih pa Eli le a pasal Finehas tla an thi ti a theih tikah ruah lopi in a pum a na ih fa a hring.","title":"Finehas Ih Nupi A Thi"},"20":{"text":"Amah cu nauhrin natnak ihsin a thihzik zawng ah a tuamhlawmtu nunau nu in, “Na thinphang hlah aw; fapa na hring a si,” tiah a ti. Asinain Finehas ih nupi cun zianghman a sawn lo; zianghman ti theimi a nei nawn lo."},"21":{"text":"A fapa cu Ikhabod tiah hmin a sak, a tican cu, “Pathian ih sunlawinak in Israel a tlansan a si,” tinak a si. A sim duhmi cu Pathian ih Thukam Kuang an lonnak le a rang Eli le a pasal Finehas an thihnak thu a si."},"22":{"text":"“Pathian ih Thukam Kuang an lon ruangah Pathian ih sunlawinak in Israel cu a tlansan zo a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian Thukam Kuang cu Filistin mi pawl ih an lon ngah hnuah Ebenezer ihsin Ashdod khua ah an phur.","title":"Filistin Mi Hnenah Thukam Kuang"},"2":{"text":"Dagon an timi an khuazing biaknak inn ah an fehpi ih Dagon kiangah an ret."},"3":{"text":"A thaizing ah Pathian ih Thukam Kuang hmaiah Dagon ih lempi cu a bokkhup in a tluk kha Ashdod khuami pawl in an hmu. An tung saal ih a um keel in an ret."},"4":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang hmaiah Dagon ih zukpi cu a bokkhup in a tluk sal lala kha an hmu.
