A lu le a ban pawl a tan-aw thluh ih sangka kiangah an ril teptep. A ruangpi lawnglawng a taang."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah tuihsan tiangin Ashdod khua ih puithiam pawl le Dagon a biatu pawl cun Dagon a tluknak hmun cu pal loin an lan ṭheu."},"6":{"text":"Ashdod khuami pawl cu Bawipa in nasazet in a hrem ih an thin a phang ringring. Ashdod khuami lawng si loin a kiangkap khuami pawl khal a hrem ih khuaihli hma in an hma thluh."},"7":{"text":"Cutiih a si cu misenpi in an hmuh tikah, “Israel mi pawl ih Pathian in kanmah le kan khawzing Dagon tiangin in hrem a si. Thukam Kuang cu hitawk ih umter hrih dingah a cang nawn lo,” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah mi an thlah ih Filistin mi pawl hotu lal panga an ko khawm ih, “Israel mi pawl Pathian ih Thukam Kuang hi ziangtinso kan tuah ding?” tiah an sut. Cutikah annih in, “Gath ah va ret uh,” an ti. An ti bangtuk in Gath ahcun an va ret."},"9":{"text":"Asinain Gath ih an ret vete in Bawipa in Gath khawsungmi pawl a hrem ih an van a sang ngaingai. Gath khawsungmi hmuahhmuah a tum a sen in khuaihli hma an tuar ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Thukam Kuang cu Ekron khua ah an kuat. Ekron khua an thlenpi vete in khuasungmi pawl cu, “Israel mi Pathian ih Thukam Kuang an rak thlenpi ih in that thluh ding,” tiah an au ciamco."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah Filistin mi pawl ih lal pawl cu an ko khawm lala ih, “Israel mi pawl ih Thukam Kuang cu a rak umnak ah kuat sal uh; cuticun kanmah le kan sungkhat pawl kan thi lo ding,” tiah an ti. Nasazet in Pathian in a hrem hai ruangah khawsungmi pawl cu an awlok a song ngaingai."},"12":{"text":"A thi lomi pawl khal cu khuaihli hma in an na ih mi hmuahhmuah in an khawzing pawl hnenah bomnak dil in an au ciamco."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu Filistin ramah thla sarih a um hnuah,","title":"Thukam Kuang An Kuatsal"},"2":{"text":"Filistin mi hotu pawl in an puithiam le pol pawl an ko ih, “ Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang hi ziangtin so kan tuah ding? A umnak hmunih kan kuat sal asile ziangthawn so kan kuat ding?” tiah an sut."},"3":{"text":"“Israel mi Pathian ih Thukam Kuang cu nan kuat sal asile nan mawhnak ngaidamnak dingah Pathian hnenah laksawng nan pek pei ih cumi thawn nan kuat pei. Laksawng tel loin Thukam Kuang cu nan kuat lo pei. Laksawng thawn nan kuat kir sal asile nan dam dingih Pathian in ziangah so in rak hrem ti cu nan thei ding,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"“Ziang laksawng so kan pek ding?” tiah an sut. Cutikah annih in, “Sui ih tuahmi khuaihli hma zuk panga le zinghnam zuk panga, Filistin lal pakhat hrangah zuk pakhat ciar in nan pek pei. Ziangahtile hremnak cu nan zate le Filistin lal panga in nan tuar a si."},"5":{"text":"Nan khua le nan ram a siatsuahtu khuaihli hma zuk le zinghnam zuk pawl cu nan tuah pei ih Israel mi pawl ih Pathian hnenah nan sualnak nan phuang pei. Cutiih nan tuah asile nanmah, nan khawzing le nan ramih hremnak nan tuarnak ihsin a lo luatter men ding."},"6":{"text":"Ziangah so Faro le Izipt mi bangin mi lungruh nan si duh rero? Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl an suahter hlan lo Izipt mi pawl tla cu Pathian in a duhduh in a puahcok rero hai ti nan hngilh lo pei."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah cawleng a thar pakhat le leng a hnuk dah lomi cawpi pahnih in ngaihtuah uh. Cuih caw cu lengah barh uhla an faate pawl kha caw inn ah khum uh."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang kha lak uhla cawleng parah ret uh. Cule nan mawhnak ngaidamnak dingah Pathian hnenih nan pekmi sui zuk pawl cu thingkuang dangin a cuih Thukam Kuang kiangah ret uh. Cun cawleng cu amahte in mawngtu loin fehseh."},"9":{"text":"Cule a feh cu zoh uh. Beth Shemesh khua lamih a feh a si ahcun kan parih siatsuahnak a thlentertu cu Israel mi pawl ih Pathian a si, ti a lang ding. Asinain Beth Shemesh khua lamih a feh lo a si ahcun natnak petu cu Israel mi pawl ih Pathian a si lo; kan vansiat ruangah a si men, ti kan thei ding,” tiah an ti."},"10":{"text":"Puithiam le pol pawl ih sim vekin an tuah thluh. Cawpi pahnih cu an hruai ih cawleng ah an barh ih caw faate pawl cu caw inn ah an khum."},"11":{"text":"Pathian Thukam Kuang cu an lak ih, sui ih tuahmi khuaihli hma zuk le zinghnam zuk pawl an retnak thingkuang thawn cawleng sungah cun an ret."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah caw pawl cu an feh ih khuilam hmanah pial lotein Beth Shemesh khua lamah dingtein an feh vivo. An feh phah ah an paw rero. Filistin mi ih lal panga in Beth Shemesh khua ramri tiang an hei thlun."},"13":{"text":"Beth Shemesh khuami pawl cu phairawn ah sangvut an at lai rero. Khua an hun cuan ih Thukam Kuang an hmuh tikah an lung a awi ngaingai."},"14":{"text":"Beth Shemesh khuami Joshua ih lo sungah cawleng cu a ra thleng ih lungto tumpi kiangah a cawl. Cuih khuami pawl cun zanthing ih tuahmi leng cu an satbal ih caw pahnih cu an that ih Bawipa ih hnenah meisa ur in thawinak ah an pek."},"15":{"text":"Levi mi pawl in Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang le sui ih tuah mi zuk pawl retnak kuang cu an cawi ih lungto tumpi parah cun an ret. A cuih ni ah Beth Shemesh khuami pawl in mei-ur thawinak le thawinak dangdang tla Bawipa ih hnenah an pek."},"16":{"text":"Filistin mi lal panga cun Beth Shemesh khuami pawl ih thiltuah mi cu an zoh ṭheh hnu a cuih ni thotho ah Ekron ah an kirsal."},"17":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl in an khawpi panga - Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath le Ekron hrangah, khua khatah pakhat ciar in, sui in tuahmi khuaihli hma zuk panga cu Bawipa hnenah an mawhnak ngaidamnak dingah an pek."},"18":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Filistin mi lal panga ih ukmi kulhmi khawpi siseh, kulh lomi khawte siseh, lal pakhat ukmi khua pawl cu sui ih tuahmi zinghnam zuk pakhat ciar an pek fawn. Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang an retnak, Beth Shemesh khuami Joshua lo sungih a ummi lungto tumpi cu cutawkih a cangmi thutheihpitu ah atu tiangin a um lai a si."},"19":{"text":"Beth Shemesh khuami pawl in Thukam Kuang sung an bih ruangah Bawipa in mi hrekkhat cu a that. Minung sawm sarih an thi a si. Cutiih mi tampi Bawipa in a thihter ruangah cuih khuami pawl cu an riah a sia ngaingai."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Beth Shemesh khuami pawl in, “Hi Bawipa , a thianghlim mi Pathian ih hmaiah zoso a ding thei ding? Kan hnenih a um nawn lonak dingah khuitawk ah so kan kuat ding?” tiah an ti.","title":"Kiriath Jearim Khua Ah Thukam Kuang"},"21":{"text":"Cule Kiriath Jearim khawpi ah mi an thlah ih, “Filistin mi pawl in Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu an rak khirh. Rung lak hram uh,” tiah thu an cah."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu Kiriath Jearim khua mi pawl in an phur ih, tlang parih a ummi Abinadab ih inn ah an ret. Abinadab ih fapa Eleazar kha a kiltu dingah an fial ih Pathian hnenih pumpeknak an tuahsak."},"2":{"text":"Kiriath Jearim khua ah Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu kum kul lai a um. Hi sung hmuahhmuah ah Israel mi pawl in Pathian hnenah bomnak dil in an ai-hram ringring.","title":"Samuel In Israel A Uk"},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Nan thinlung taktak ih Bawipa nan pan duh a si ahcun ramdang khawzing pawl le Astartes khawzingnu ih zuk pawl hi nan hlon ṭheh pei. Nan nunnak a zatein Bawipa hnenah pek ṭheh uhla amah lawng biak uh. Cuticun Filistin mi pawl ih nehnak sung ihsin Bawipa in a lo luatter ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi pawl in Baal khawzing le Astartes khawzingnu ih zuk pawl cu an hlon ṭheh ih Bawipa lawnglawng an biak."},"5":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl cu Mizpah khua ah tongkhawm aw dingin Samuel in a cah hai ih, “Cutawkah Pathian hnenah nan hrangah thla ka cam ding,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Mizpah ahcun an tong-aw khawm ṭheh. Tidai an khai ih Bawipa hnenih thawinak peknak ah tidai cu an thlet. Cule sunvu rawl an ul. “ Bawipa ih parah kan sual a si,” tiah an sual an phuang. Mizpah ah Israel mi pawl ih thu an neih mi cu Samuel in a ṭhensak."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Mizpah ih an khawm-awk ṭhehnak thu cu Filistin mi pawl in an rak theih tikah ra do dingah Filistin ih lal panga le an ralkap pawl cu an pok. Cuih thu cu Israel mi pawl in an theih tikah an ṭih ngaingai ih,"},"8":{"text":"Samuel hnenah, “Filistin pawl ih kut sungin in run suak theinak dingah Bawipa kan Pathian hnenah cat loin thlacam aw,” tiah an ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in tuu faate a that ih a pum in mei-ur thawinak ah Bawipa hnenah a pek. Israel mi bawm dingah Bawipa hnenah Samuel in thla a cam ih a thlacamnak cu Bawipa in a theih sak."},"10":{"text":"Samuel in thawinak a pek rero laifangah rin lopi in Filistin mi pawl in an run nam ciamco. Cutikah Bawipa in van ihsin khawripi in a ron tlir durdo ih Filistin mi pawl cu thinphang in an buai ih an tlan thluh."},"11":{"text":"Cuvete in Israel mi pawl cun Filistin mi pawl cu Mizpah ihsin Bethkar thleng tiang an dawi hai. An dawinak lamtluan ah Filistin mi pawl cu an that phah vivo."},"12":{"text":"Cule Samuel in lungto a lak ih Mizpah le Shen khua karlak ah a phun ih, “ Bawipa in lamzin tluan in bawm a si,” a ti ih “Ebenezer,” tiah hmin a sak."},"13":{"text":"Cutiin Filistin mi cu ral an sung ih Samuel ih nunsung hmuahhmuah Israel ram do thei lo dingah Bawipa in a kham."},"14":{"text":"Ekron le Gath khua karlak ih a ummi khua hmuahhmuah Filistin mi pawl ih an lonmi khua pawl cu Israel mi hnenah an pek sal ih cuticun Israel mi in an ram hmuahhmuah cu an ngah sal a si. Cule Israel mi le Kanaan mi karlak khalah remnak a um."},"15":{"text":"Samuel cu a nunsung hmuahhmuah Israel uktu a si."},"16":{"text":"Kumtin tein Bethel, Gilgal le Mizpah ah a feh ih thubuainak a ummi pawl thu a ṭhensak vivo."},"17":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Ramah khua ih a inn ah a kirsal ṭheu ih Ramah khalah cun Israel pawl ih thuṭhentu a ṭuan. Cule Ramah khua ah Bawipa hrangah biakṭheng a don."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel cu a tar thlang ih curuangah a fapa tla cu Israel mi lakih thuṭhentu a ṭuanter.","title":"Israel Mi In Siangpahrang An Duh"},"2":{"text":"A fapa upa cu Joel a si ih a nauta cu Abijah a si. Beersheba khua ah thuṭhentu an si."},"3":{"text":"Asinain an pa ih nuncan vekin an nung thei lo. Paisa ngahnak lawng an ruat ih curuangah nawhthuh tla an lak ih dingthluk lairelnak thawn thu an ṭhen lo."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Israel hruaitu pawl cu an tongkhawm aw ih Samuel hnenah Ramah ah an feh ih,"},"5":{"text":"a hnenah, “Zohhnik, nang le na tar zo ih na fapa pawl in na nuncan an thlun fawn lo. Curuangah miphun dang pawl ih an neih vekin in uktu dingah siangpahrang in pe aw,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutiih siangpahrang an dil cu a lung a kim lo ruangah Samuel cu Bawipa hnenah thla a cam."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Na hnenih an simmi thu hmuahhmuah hi ngai ko aw. Nangmah an lo hnong a si lo. Keimah an siangpahrang in hnong sawn a si."},"8":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin ka suahpi ihsin thokin tuihsun ni tiangah ka hnen ihsin an tlan ih khawzing dangdang an bia ringring. Ka parih an tuah ringring mi atu na parah an tuah ve thlang a si."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah an thu ngai ko aw. Asinain ziangvek in an siangpahrang in an uk ding, ti kimtein an hnenah sim cia awla ralrinnak tla feltein pe cia hai aw,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang a diltu Israel mi pawl hnenah Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu Samuel in a sim thluh."},"11":{"text":"An hnenah, “Hi vek in nan siangpahrang in a lo uk ding: Nan fapa pawl cu a ralkap ah a tuah ding; a hrek cu raldonak rangleng mawngtu ah an cang ding. A hrek cu a rang ralkap ah an cang ding. A hrek cu rangleng hmai ih tlantu ralkap an si ding."},"12":{"text":"A hrek cu a ralkap thawngkhat uktu ralbawi an si dingih a hrekkhat cu ralkap sawmnga uktu an si ding. Nan fapa pawl hrekkhat cu a siangpahrang ih lothlotu an si dingih a lo sungih rawl khawmtu, a hriamnam tuahtu le a raldonak rangleng pawl ih thilri tuahtu an si ding."},"13":{"text":"Nan fanu pawl a hrangah rimhmui an tuah a ṭul ding ih a rawl suangtu le a sangrawhtu tla an si ding."},"14":{"text":"Nan lo lakih a ṭha bik, nan sabit hmuan lakih a ṭhabik le nan olif hmuan lakih a ṭha bik pawl cu nan siangpahrang in a lo lak sak pei ih a kuthnuai bawi pawl a ṭhen thluh ding."},"15":{"text":"Nan khawmmi rawl le sabit sung ihsin ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat a lak pei ih a zung hnaṭuan bawi pawl le a bawi dang pawl a ṭhen thluh ding."},"16":{"text":"Nan hnen-um pawl nunau siseh mipa siseh a lak ih tlunah nan caw le nan rang lakih a ṭha bik pawl a lak pei ih amah hrangih hnaṭuantu ah a tuah thluh ding."},"17":{"text":"Nan ṭilva sung khalin ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat a lak ding. Nanmah khal a sal ah nan cang thluh ding."},"18":{"text":"Cuvek tikcu a hung thlen ngaingai tikah nan lungtho ih nan hrilmi siangpahrang ruangah nan phunzai ciamco leh ding; asinain nan phunzainak cu Bawipa in a lo theih sak lo ding a si,” tiah Samuel in a sim."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Samuel ih thu cu an ngai duh lo. “Asilo, siangpahrang kan duh hrimhrim a si."},"20":{"text":"Kanmah ih siangpahrang in in uk dingih kan ral pawl donak ah in ho ding. Cuticun miphun dang bangtuk kan si ve ding,” tiah an ti thotho."},"21":{"text":"Misenpi pawl ih simmi thu cu kimtein Samuel in a ngai ih Bawipa a va sim."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “An duh mi cu tuah ko awla siangpahrang cu pe hai aw,” tiah a ti. Cuih hnuah Israel mi pawl cu Samuel in an inn ciarah a tlunter thluh."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin ramah Kish an timi pa pakhat a um. Amah cu Abiel ih fapa a si. Abiel cu Zeror ih fapa a si. Zeror cu Bekorath ih fapa a si. Bekorath cu Afiah ih fapa a si ih Afiah cu Benjamin phun a si. Kish cu milian le mi ih upat mi a si.","title":"Saul In Samuel A Tong"},"2":{"text":"Kish in Saul timi fapa a nei. Saul cu a sanṭhat laifang a si ih a piangzet fawn. Israel mi pawl hmuahhmuah lakah a piang bik a si ih mi dang hnakin pi khat a sang fawn."},"3":{"text":"A pa Kish ih laak hrekkhat pawl cu an vakhlo ih curuangah a pa in, “Kan hnen-um pakhat hruai awla kan laak pawl va hawl uh,” tiah Saul cu a fial."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Efraim tlangpar ram le Shalishah ramah an feh ih an hawl naón an hmu lo. Shaalim peng sungah a ram pumpi in an hawl naón laak cu an um lo. Cuih hnuah Benjamin ram sungah an hawl ih an hmu cuang lo."},"5":{"text":"Zuf peng sung an thlen tikah Saul in, “Kan tlung thlang pei. Ziangahtile laak thu ruat loin ka pa in kanmah riangri tla in helhkamter pang ding,” tiah a hnen-um pa hnenah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah a hnen-um pa in, “Um hrihhnik; hih khua ah hin Pathian ih minung pakhat a um ih mi in an upat zetmi a si; ziangahtile a simmi hmuahhmuah a dik ṭheu. A hnenah kan va feh pei ih kan laak pawl umnak tla in sim thei men ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"“Kan va feh asile ziangso kan pek ding? Kan zaal sungah rawl a um nawn lo, zianghman pek ding kan neih ual lo,” tiah Saul in a ti."},"8":{"text":"A hnen-um pa in, “Ngun tangka fangkhat ka pai ih cumi ka pek pei. Kan laak pawl an umnak in sim ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Culai ahcun mi pakhat in Pathian hnenih sut duhmi a neih tikah, “Hmutu hnenah kan feh pei,” tiah a ti ṭheu. Ziangahtile cuih san ahcun profet cu hmutu tiah an rak ko."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “Na ruahnak a ṭha a si. Kan feh pei,” a ti ih Pathian ih minung pa umnak khua ahcun an feh."},"11":{"text":"An khuataw so an soh rero laifangah tidai khai dingih a rami fala pawl an tong. “Nan khawsung ih hmutu a um maw?” tiah fala pawl cu an sut."},"12":{"text":"Fala pawl cun, “A um sokhaw! Nan hlan deuhte ah a ra thleng. Zamrang uhla nan hei man ding. Khawsung mi pawl in tuihsun tlangpar ih biakṭheng ah khawrai thawinak an pek ding."},"13":{"text":"Khawsung nan luh vete in tlangpar ih rawl ei ding a feh hlanah nan tong ko ding. Tlangpar ih amah a thlen lo ahcun misenpi pawl rawl an ei lo ding; ziangahtile khawrai thawinak cu amah in thla a cam hmaisa ding ih cuih hnu lawngah senpi cu rawl an ei ding. Atu-ah feh uhla hmakhatte-ah nan tong ko ding,” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cuticun an feh ih khawsung an luh zawng ah Samuel cu biaknak hmun ih feh dingin a ra suah kha an hmu."},"15":{"text":"Saul a thlen ni ih a mizan sun ah Bawipa in Samuel hnen ah,"},"16":{"text":"“Thaisun atu tikcu ah Benjamin phun ihsin mipa pakhat na hnenah ka rak thlah ding. Ka minung Israel pawl uktu ah amah cu hriakculh awla Filistin pawl ih kut ihsin a humhim hai ding. Ka minung pawl ih tuarnak le zonzaihnak ka hmu zo ih bomnak dilih an aihramnak ka thei zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Samuel in Saul cu a hmuh tikah, Bawipa in Samuel hnenah, “Ka lo timi cu hi pa hi a si. Ka minung pawl amah in a uk ding,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule Saul cu Samuel hnenah kotka kiangah a va feh ih, “Khuiah so hmutu pa ih inn a um, i sim hram aw,” tiah a va ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel cun, “Keimah hi hmutu cu ka si. Biaknak hmunah ka hmaiah feh aw. Tuihsun ah nan pahnih in ka hnenah rawl nan ei ding. Thaizing ah nan thusuh duhmi hmuahhmuah ka lo let pei ih cuih hnuah nan fehnak dingah ka lo thlah leh ding."},"20":{"text":"An hlohnak ni thum a si zomi nan laak pawl cu helhkam duh hlah uh, ziangahtile an hmu zo. Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl ih an ṭul zetmi cu zoso a si? Nangmah na si! Nangmah le na pa ih hrin pawl nan si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Saul in, “Kei cu Benjamin phun ka si; Israel miphun lakah phun fate bikmi ka si. Cun kan phunkhat sungah kannih sung cu santlai lo bik sung kan si fawn. Curuangah ziangtinso hiti in ka hnenah na ṭong?” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in Saul le a hnen-um pa cu rawl einak khaan tumpi sungah a hruai ih, an sawmmi minung sawmthum tluk an tonak cabuaipi ih lu lamah a toter."},"23":{"text":"Cule Samuel in rawl suang pa ih hnenah, “A dangte ih ka lo rettermi sa kha rak keng aw,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cule rawl suang pa cun sacawn le a kopmi thau pawl a hun suah ih Saul ih hmaiah cun a ret. Samuel in, “Himi cu nangmah hrangih retmi a si. Ei aw, ka sawmmi pawl thawn ei tlang dingah na hrangih retmi a si,” tiah a ti. Cuticun cuih ni ah Saul cu Samuel hnenah rawl a ei."},"25":{"text":"Biaknak hmun ihsin khawsungih an vung kirsal tikah inn diphun parah Saul ih ihnak an tuah ih, cutawkah Saul cu a it."},"26":{"text":"Zingpit ah an tho ih Samuel in Saul cu a hun ko ih, “Tho awla na fehnak ding zinah ka lo thlah ding,” a ti. Saul cu a tho ih Samuel thawn hmun khatah an feh."},"27":{"text":"Khawhnar an thlen tikah Samuel in, “Na hnen-um pa hi hmaiah rak fehter aw,” tiah Saul cu a ti. Hnen-um pa cu hmaiah a rak feh. Cutikah Samuel in, “Malte in taangta hrih awla Pathian ih ṭong mi ka lo sim ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Samuel in olif hriak palang khat a lak ih Saul ih lu parah a toih ih Saul cu a hnam hnuah, “ Bawipa in a miphun Israel pawl uktu dingah nangmah cu hriak a lo culh a si. A minung pawl na uk ding ih an ral pawl ih kutsung ihsin na luatter ding. Amah ih minung pawl uk dingah Bawipa in a lo hril zo a si, ti theihthiamnak cu hi bangtuk in a si ding:","title":"Saul Cu Samuel In Hriak A Culh"},"2":{"text":"Tuihsun kan ṭhen awk hnuah Benjamin ram sungih a ummi Zelzah khua ih Rachel ih thlaan kiangah mi pahnih na tong ding. Nan hawl rero mi laak pawl cu an hmu zo ih na pa cu laak hrangah helhkam nawn loin nangmah a lo helhkam ih, ‘Ka fapa hrangah ziangso ka tuah ding?’ tiah atu le atu mi a sut leuhleuh, tiah an lo sim ding."},"3":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin na feh ding ih Tabor an timi hmunih sasuapi kung na thlen tikah Bethel khua ah Pathian hnenih saserh thawinak pe dingah a fehmi pacang pathum na tong ding. Pakhat pa cun me faate pathum a hruai ding ih, pahnihnak pa in sang zawl thum a keng ding. A pathumnak pa cun savun thawl khatin sabitti a keng ding."},"4":{"text":"An lo cibai ding ih sang zawl hnih an lo pe ding. Cumi cu na rak sang pei."},"5":{"text":"Cule Filistin ralkap pawl ih riahbuk umnak Gibeah khua ih a ummi Pathian Tlangah na feh pei. Khawsung vung luhnak hnar ah, tlangpar biakṭheng ihsin profet burpi, ṭingṭang le khuang, phirivau le tingrisit pawl tum phah in a rung tlungmi na tong ding. Anmah tla cu profet ṭong in an ṭong ding ih an laam an au phahphah ding."},"6":{"text":"Cule Pathian ih thlarau in a lo kai ve ding; anmah bangtuk in profet ṭong in na ṭong ve ding; na laam na au phahphah ve ding ih mi phundangpi ah na cang ding."},"7":{"text":"Cu bangtuk ih na parih a kim ṭheh tikah Pathian ih a lo hruainak bangtuk in tuah aw."},"8":{"text":"Ka hlanah Gilgal ah na rak feh pei. Cutawkah ka lo tong ding, mei-ur thawinak le rem-awk thawinak pawl tla Pathian hnenah ka pek ding. Ka ra thlen hlan lo ni sarih sung i hngak awla cuih hnuah na tuah ding mi ka lo sim ding,” tiah Samuel in a ti."},"9":{"text":"Saul cu feh dingih a vung her-awk laiah Pathian in Saul cu thinlung thar a pek. Samuel ih a simmi hmuahhmuah kha cuih ni ah a kim ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Saul le a hnen-um pa cu Gibeah an thlen tikah profet pawl in an rak tong. Pathian ih thlarau in Saul cu a kaiih profet pawl bang in profet ṭong in a ṭong ih a laam a au phahphah ve."},"11":{"text":"A hlanih a rak theitu pawl in Saul khal cuti ih a um cu an hmuh tikah, “Kish fapa hi ziang a cang a si pei? Saul khal profet a cang zo maw si?” tiah pakhat le pakhat an ti-aw."},"12":{"text":"Cutawk khua ih a ummi pacang pakhat in, “Midang profet pawl teh, an pale pawl profet an si ciar maw si?” tiah a ti. Cuticun, “Saul khal profet a cang zo maw si?” tihi ṭongnak ah an hmang ṭheu."},"13":{"text":"Saul cu profet pawl vekih a laam le a au a reh tikah tlangpar ih biakṭheng ah a feh."},"14":{"text":"A paseu in Saul le a hnen-um pa cu, “Khuiah so nan si?” tiah a rak sut. Cutikah Saul in, “Kan laak pawl kan hawl. Kan hmuh lo tikah Samuel kan va tong,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"“Samuel in ziangso a lo sim?” tiah a paseu in a sut sal."},"16":{"text":"“Laak pawl cu an hmu zo a si, tiah in sim,” tiah a ti. Siangpahrang na cang ding tiih Samuel ih a simmi pawl cu a paseu hnenah a sim lo."},"17":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Mizpah ah, Bawipa ih hnenah, Samuel in a kokhawm.","title":"Saul Cu Siangpahrang An Canter"},"18":{"text":"Samuel in an hnenah, “ Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in, ‘Izipt ram ihsin ka lo suahter ih Izipt mi pawl le a lo hremtu pawl ih kut sung ihsin ka lo luatter a si."},"19":{"text":"Keimah cu nan harsatnak le nan zonzaihnak sung ihsin a lo runtu nan Pathian ka si. Sikhalsehla tuihsun ah kei cu in hnong ih siangpahrang in dil. Curuangah nan phun ciar le nan hrin ciar in ka hmaiah hin ding hnik uh,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"20":{"text":"Cule an phunhnam ciar in phunkhat hnu phunkhat Samuel in hmailamah a suahter hai ih Bawipa in Benjamin phun a hril."},"21":{"text":"Cun Benjamin phun sung ihsin hrinkhat hnu hrinkhat Samuel in a dinter tikah Matri ih hrin kha Bawipa in a hril. Cule Matri ih hrin pawl cu an mipum in hmailam ih an ra suah tikah Kish ih fapa Saul a hril. Asinain Saul cu an hawl ih an hmu lo."},"22":{"text":"“Mi dang hril ding an um maw?” tiah Bawipa cu an sut. Cutikah Bawipa in, “Khinah Saul a um ko; thilri lakah a relh a si,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah an va tlan ih Saul cu mipi hmaiah an rak suahpi. Midang lakih a din tikah midang hnakin pi khat in a sang deuh."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Pathian ih a hrilmi cu hi pa hi a si. Kanmah lakah amah bangtuk zohman kan um lo,” tiah a ti. Cutikah mi hmuahhmuah in, “Siangpahrang a san sauseh!” tiah an au hluarhlo."},"25":{"text":"Siangpahrang ih covo le ṭuanvo pawl cu Israel mi pawl hnenah Samuel in feltein a simfiang ih cazual sungih a ngan hnuah a cuih cazual cu hmun thianghlim ah a ret. Cuih hnuah misenpi cu an inn ciarah a tlunter."},"26":{"text":"Saul khal Gibeah ih a inn ah a tlung ve. Pathian ih an thinlung a tong ngahmi micak le ralṭhazet hrekkhat pawl in Saul cu a inn ah an thlun."},"27":{"text":"Asinain mi hlolak hrekkhat cun, “Hi pa cun ziangtinso in run thei ding?” tiah an ti. Saul cu an nautat ih laksawng khal an pe duh lo."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thla khat tluk a rei tikah Ammon siangpahrang Nahash cu Gilead ram sungih a ummi Jabesh khua do dingin a feh. Nahash ih ralkap pawl in Jabesh khua cu an kulh thluh. Curuangah Jabesh khawsungmi pawl in Nahash hnenah, “Lungkimnak cakhen kan tuah pei ih in uktu ah kan lo hmang ding,” tiah an ti.","title":"Saul In Ammon Mi Pawl A Neh"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Nahash cun, “Nan vorhlam mit ciar ka lo phorh thluh ih Israel miphun parih ningzahnak ka thlenter hnu lawngah nanmah thawn lungkimnak cakhen ka tuah thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Jabesh khua ih hotu pawl in, “Israel ramsung hmuahhmuah ih mi kan thlah theinak dingah ni sarih sung tikcu in pe hram aw. Zohman in in bawm lo ding asile na hnenah kan lut ko ding,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"An thlahmi pawl cu Saul umnak khua Gibeah an va thleng ih an thuhla an sim tikah khawsungmi pawl cu riahsia in an ṭap ciamco."},"5":{"text":"Culaifang ah Saul cu lo ihsin a caw pawl thawn a rung tlung. Cule Saul in, “Ziang thupoi so a um? Ziangah so mikip ih an ṭah ciamco?” tiah a sut. Jabesh khua ihsin an rak thlahmi palai pawl ih thusia cu an sim."},"6":{"text":"A cuih thu cu Saul in a theih tikah Pathian ih thlarau in a kaiih a thin cu meisa alh in a alh."},"7":{"text":"Cawcang pahnih a that ih an sa a satcip hnuah Israel ramsung hmuahhmuah ih fehpi dingah mi a thlah ih, “Ral donak ah Saul le Samuel a thlun lotu pa ih cawcang cu hi vekin can ṭheh a si ve pei,” tiah thu a cah thluh. Bawipa in ziangtin in tuah pei, tiah Israel mi pawl cun an ṭih ih an zatein thinlung khatein an suak khawm."},"8":{"text":"Saul in Bezek ah a hruai khawm ih Israel mi thawng zathum an ti ih, Judah mi thawng sawmthum an ti."},"9":{"text":"Jabesh khua ihsin an rak thlah mi palai pawl hnenah, “Nan khuami pawl va sim uh: thaisun sun hlanah runsuak an si ding,” tiah an ti. A cuih thu an theih tikah Jabesh khuami cu an lung a awi ngaingai."},"10":{"text":"Cule Nahash hnenah, “Thaisun cu na hnenah kan ra lut pei ih na duh vekin in tuah a si ko pei cu,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"A thaizing ah Saul in a ralkap pawl cu bu thum ah a ṭhen ih zingthlapit ah an ral pawl cu an riahnak ah an nam ciammam. Sun a hung si tikah Ammon mi pawl cu an that thluh. A luatmi hnihkhat pawl cu an ṭhendarh-aw thluh ih a dang ciarah an tlanhlo ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl in Samuel hnenah, “Saul kan siangpahrang si hlah seh, a titu kha zoso an si? Kan hnenah in pe awla kan that thluh ding,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Asinain Saul in, “Tuihsun ah zohman nan that lo pei, ziangahtile tuihsun cu Bawipa in Israel a runsuak ni a si,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Samuel in, “Kan zate in Gilgal ah kan feh pei ih Saul kan siangpahrang a si, tiah kan hngetter sal pei,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah an zatein Gilgal ah an feh ih cutawk hmun Bawipa ih hmai ahcun Saul cu siangpahrang ah an hngetter. Rem-awk thawinak tla Bawipa ih hnenah an pek ih Saul le Israel mi pawl cu lungawizet in puai an tuah."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel in Israel mi pawl hnenah, “ṭuan dingih in fialmi cu kan ṭuan zo. Nanmah a lo uktu dingah siangpahrang ka ret zo.","title":"Samuel Ih Netabik Thusimmi"},"2":{"text":"A lo hruaitu dingah nanmah ih ta a si zo. Kei cu ka tar zo ih ka ṭuak khal a par ṭheh zo. Ka fapa pawl khal nan lakah an tel a si. Ka no lai ihsin atu tiang nan hotu ka si ringring."},"3":{"text":"Atu-ah nan hmaika ah ka um. Thilsual ka tuah mi pakhatkhat a um asile Bawipa Pathian le amah ih hrilmi siangpahrang ih hmaiah atu-ah nan lungkim lonak phuang uh. Mi caw ka la dah maw? Mi laak ka ru dah maw? Mi pakhatkhat ka bum in ka neh-nen dah maw? Zo ih hnenin nawhthuh ka la dah maw? A dik loih ka lakmi a um a si ahcun ka lakmi zat in ka sam sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi pawl in, “Zohman in bum lo; in neh-nen lo ih zohnen hmanin zianghman na la dah lo,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule Samuel in, “Tuihsun ih mawhnak nei loih in hmuhnak ahhin in theihpitu cu Bawipa Pathian le amah ih hrilmi siangpahrang an si,” tiah a ti. Cutikah annih in, “ Bawipa cu in theihpitu a si,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cule Samuel in, “Moses le Aaron a hriltu le nan pupa pawl Izipt ram ihsin a suaktertu cu Bawipa a si."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah nan umnak ciarah ding uhla nanmah le nan pupa pawl run dingah Bawipa ih mangbangza thil a tuahmi pawl ka lo sim ding ih Bawipa ih hmaiah nan sualnak ka phuang ding."},"8":{"text":"Jakob le a sungkhat pawl Izipt ramih an thlen tikah Izipt mi pawl in an hrem ruangah Bawipa ih hnenah bomnak dil in an au. Bawipa in an aunak cu a thei ih Moses le Aaron a thlah ih anmah in nan pupa pawl cu Izipt ram ihsin an suahpi ih hi ram ahhin an thlenpi a si."},"9":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa an Pathian an hngilh ruangah Pathian in Hazor khua ih ralkap pawl hotu ralbawi Sisera le Filistin mi pawl le Moab siangpahrang pawl kha Israel a doter ih a nehter."},"10":{"text":"Cun Bawipa hnenah bomnak dil in an au lala ih ‘Maw Bawipa , na lamzin ihsin kan pial ih Baal khawzing le Astartes khawzingnu pawl kan bia. Kan sual a si. Asinain kan ral pawl ih kutsung ihsin in luatter hram awla nangmah kan lo bia ding,’ an ti."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in Jerub-baal, Barak, Jefthah le Samuel pawl a thlah ih nan ral pawl ih kutsung ihsin an lo run ih hnangam zetin nan um."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Ammon siangpahrang Nahash in in do ding ti nan theih vete in Bawipa cu nan siangpahrang si dingah nan duh nawn lo ih, ‘In uktu dingah siangpahrang in pe aw,’ tiah in dil."},"13":{"text":"Atu-ah nan hrilmi siangpahrang a um zo. Nan dilmi a si ih Bawipa in a lo pek a si."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah nanmah le nan siangpahrang in Bawipa nan Pathian cu nan thlun, a thu khal nan ngai, a thupekmi bangtuk in nan tuah ih amah ṭihzah upatnak in a hna khal nan ṭuan a si ahcun a ṭha ko ding."},"15":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa thu nan ngai duh loih a thupekmi tla nan el a si ahcun, nan pupa pawl ih an rak tuar bangin, nanmah le nan siangpahrang in nan tuar ding a si."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah nan umnak hmun ciarah ding uhla Bawipa ih thil makzet a tuah dingmi hi zohhnik uh."},"17":{"text":"Atu hi ṭhal tikcu a si lo maw? Thla ka cam pei ih Bawipa in khua a ritter ding ih ruah a surter ding. Cumi cu nan hmuh tikah Bawipa hnenih siangpahrang nan dil ruangah hin Pathian hnenah sualnak tumzet nan tuah a si, ti cu fiangtein nan thei ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in thla a cam ih cuih ni rori ah Pathian in khua a ritter ih ruah khal a surter. Cule mi hmuahhmuah in Bawipa le Samuel cu an ṭihzet ih,"},"19":{"text":"Samuel hnenah, “Kan thih lonak dingah zaangfahteón Bawipa na Pathian hnenah thla in cam sak hram aw. Kan sualnak siar cawk loih tlunah siangpahrang kan dil ruangah hin kan sual bet a si,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Nan thin phang hlah uh. Thil ṭha lo nan tuah zo naón Bawipa ih hnen ihsin pial nawn hlah uh. Nan thinlung zatein amah ih hna ṭuan sawn uh."},"21":{"text":"Pathian lem pawl hnenah feh hlah uh. Annih pawl cun an lo bawm loih an lo run thei fawn lo, ziangahtile annih cu a lem an si."},"22":{"text":"Pathian cun a hmin sal in thu a lo kam ih ziangtik hmanah a lo taan lo ding; ziangahtile amah ih minung si dingah a lo tumtah cia zo a si."},"23":{"text":"Kei cu ziangtik hmanah nan hrangih thlacam ka cawl lo ding; ka cawl asile Bawipa ih hmaiah misual ka si ding. A ṭha mi le a dikmi pawl tuah dingah ka lo zirh sawn ding."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa cu ṭihzah uhla rinsantlak zetin nan thinlung zate thawn amah ih hna ṭuan uh. Nan hrangih thilmak zetzet a tuah mi pawl ziangtik hmanah hngilh hlah uh."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla thil ṭha lo nan tuah thotho a si ahcun nan zatein nan siangpahrang thawn siatsuah thluh nan si ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul cu siangpahrang a can tikah kum … sawmthum a ti ih Israel siangpahrang kum … sawmli hnih sung a ṭuan.","title":"Filistin Mi An Do"},"2":{"text":"Saul in Israel mi pawl sung ihsin minung thawngthum a hril ih midang pawl cu an inn ah a tlunter. Minung thawnghnih Bethel tlangram ih Mikmash an timi hmunah amah hnenah a ret. Cun a dang thawngkhat cu Benjamin ram Gibeah khua, a fapa Jonathan hnenah a ret."},"3":{"text":"Geba khua ah Jonathan in Filistin ralbawipa a that ih cuih thu cu Filistin mi pawl in an thei thluh. Cutikah Saul in Hebru mi pawl raltho dingih ko dingah mi a thlah ih a ramsung hmuahhmuah ah tawtawrawt tum in an feh ciamco."},"4":{"text":"Filistin ralbawipa Saul in a that ti in le Israel mi cu Filistin mi pawl in an nautat zet a si, tiah Israel mi hmuahhmuah hnenah an sim thluh. Curuangah raltho dingih kawh an si tikah Saul hnen Gilgal khua ah an feh."},"5":{"text":"Israel mi pawl do dingah Filistin mi pawl cu an pum-aw ciammam ih raldonak rangleng thawng sawmthum, rang ralkap thawngruk le tifinriat kapih vunnel zat ralkap an khawm aw. Beth-aven ihsin nisuahnak lamih a ummi Mikmash ah an feh ih cutawkah an riak."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu nasazet in an do. Filistin mi pawl an cak deuh ruangah Israel mi pawl cu an van a sang ih a hrekkhat cu lungpuk le lungkua ah, a hrekkhat cu lungphen le leilungkua le tikhur sung tla ah an relh."},"7":{"text":"A hrekkhat cu Jordan tiva an tan ih Gad le Gilead ram tla an thleng. Saul cu Gilgal ah a um ih amah thawn a ummi pawl cu an thinphang in an thir thlohthlo."},"8":{"text":"Samuel in hngak dingih a tiamta vekin ni sarih sung Saul cun a hngak; asinain Samuel cu Gilgal ah a thleng dah lo. Saul cu a minung pawl in an tlansan rero thlang."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah an hnenah Saul in, “Mei-ur thawinak le remnak thawinak pawl rak keng hnik uh,” a ti. An rak ken tikah amah in thawinak cu a pek."},"10":{"text":"A pek ṭheh vete in Samuel cu a ra thleng. Samuel a rat vete in Saul cun va hmuak dingah a pok."},"11":{"text":"Cule Samuel in, “Ziang so na rak tuah?” tiah a ti. Cutikah Saul in, “Ka ra thleng ding, na ti tikcu ah na thleng lo ih ka milai pawl in in tlansan deuhdeuh ih tlunah Filistin mi pawl Mikmash ah an khawm-aw ciamco fawn."},"12":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi pawl in Gilgal ah in do ding tin ka zum ih Pathian ih bomnak le ka dil hrih lo ruangah thawinak ka pek lo ahcun a cang thei nawn lo a si, ka ti ih keimah tein thawinak ka rak pek a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Na tuah mi hi aatthlak a si. Bawipa na Pathian ih thupekmi na thlun lo a si. Rak thlun cila nangmah le na tesinfa pawl hi Pathian in a kumkhua in Israel a lo ukter ding naón."},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu cu na uknak hi rei a awh lo ding. Pathian in amah ih duhmi minung a hawl ding ih a minung pawl uktu dingah a tuah ding. Ziangahtile Bawipa ih thu na ngai lo a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Samuel cu Gilgal ihsin a feh. Midang hmuahhmuah in Saul an thlun ih a ralkap pawl hnenah Saul le mipi cu an feh. Gilgal ihsin Benjamin ramih a ummi Gibeah ah an feh. Saul in a ralkap pawl cu a khawm ih zaruk an kim."},"16":{"text":"Saul le a fapa Jonathan le an ralkap pawl cu Benjamin ramsung Geba khua ah an riak. Filistin pawl cu Mekmash ah an riak."},"17":{"text":"Filistin ralkap pawl cu raldo dingih an feh tikah bur thum in an ṭhen aw. Bur khat cu Shual ram Ofrah khua lamah an feh."},"18":{"text":"Bur hnihnak cu Beth Horon khua lamah an feh ih, bur thumnak cu Zeboiim phairawn ihsin khatlam ral thlaler ramṭhing lamah an feh."},"19":{"text":"A cuihsan laiah Israel ramsungah sodeng pakhat hman an um lo; ziangahtile Filistin mi pawl in nam le fei pawl ser lo dingin Hebru mi pawl cu an kham."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi pawl cu an tuhmui, an tupheng, an hreitlung le an namtong pawl hriam ko ih ser dingah Filistin mi pawl hnenah an fehpi ṭheu."},"21":{"text":"Hreitlung le namtong ser man cu ngun tangka tamat a si ih, tuhmui le tupheng ser man cu ngun tangka ngamu a si."},"22":{"text":"Curuangah ral an do awk tikah Israel mi sungah Saul le a fapa Jonathan siar lo, zohman fei le nam kengtu an um lo."},"23":{"text":"Cule Mikmash lamzin kiltu dingah Filistin pawl in ralkap bur khat an thlah."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nikhat cu Jonathan in a hriamnam kengtu tlangval pa ih hnenah, “Filistin pawl ih riahnak lamah kan va feh hnik pei,” tiah a ti. A cuih thu cu Jonathan in a pa a sim lo.","title":"Jonathan In Ralṭhazet in A Do"},"2":{"text":"Saul cu Gibeah kiangte Migron khua ih tale kung tumpi hnuai ah a riak. A hnenah ralkap zaruk an um."},"3":{"text":"Cun puithiam ṭaangthlaih angki a kengtu cu Ahitub ih fapa Ahijah a si; Ahitub cu Ikhabod ih unau a si ih Ikhabod cu Finehas ih fapa a si. Finehas cu Shiloh khua ih Bawipa ih puithiam Eli ih fapa a si. Cutawkih a ummi ralkap pawl cun Jonathan a feh zo ti kha an thei lo."},"4":{"text":"Filistin ralkap pawl ih riahnak ah feh dingin Jonathan ih a zawh ding mi tlangkawn ih khatlam veve ah a zumzetmi lungtumpi pahnih an um. Lungto pakhat ih hmin cu Bozez an ti ih a dang pakhat cu Seneh an ti."},"5":{"text":"Bozez cu lamzin saklam, Mikmash lamah a um ih, Seneh cu lamzin ih thlanglam, Geba lam kapah a um."},"6":{"text":"Jonathan in tlangval pa ih hnenah, “Pathian awi lo Filistin ralkap pawl ih riahnak ah kan va feh pei. Pathian in in bawm men ding. In bom ngaingai ahcun ziangtlukih mi malte kan si hmanah kan neh thotho hai ding. Bawipa ih in bomnak cu zohman in an kham thei zik lo,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Tlangvalpa cun, “Na tummi cu tuah ko aw; na hnenah ka thinlung zatein ka ṭang a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Jonathan in, “A ṭha! Kan va feh pei ih in rak hmu hai seh."},"9":{"text":"‘In rak hngak uh, nan hnenah kan ra ding,’ in ti a si ahcun hi tawk ihsin kan hngak ding."},"10":{"text":"‘Kan hnenah hung uh,’ in ti a si ahcun kan hung feh pei; ziangahtile ‘Hung uh,’ in tile cu Pathian bomnak in kan neh ding ti langnak a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule Filistin mi pawl ih hmuh dingin an lang-awter ih cutikah Filistin mi pawl cun, “Zohhnik uh, an relhnak lungkua sungin Hebru mi a hrekkhat an ra pawt zo khi,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Filistin ralkap pawl cun Jonathan le a hriamnam kengtu tlangvalpa cu, “Hinah hung hnik uh. Thu lo sim ding kan nei a si,” tiah an ti. Cutikah Jonathan in a tlangvalpa hnenah, “I thlun zaang aw. Pathian in nehnak in pe zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Jonathan cu bokvak in a hung vak ih tlangvalpa cun a thlun vivo. Jonathan in Filistin pawl cu a nam ih a vuak thlak ih tlangvalpa in a that vivo hai."},"14":{"text":"Hmaisa bikih an thahnak hmun inn hmun tia tlukah Jonathan le a tlangvalpa in Filistin mi pawl kul tluk an that a si."},"15":{"text":"Filistin mi hmuahhmuah in an thin a phang ngaingai ih ralvengtu ralkap le riahnak ih a ummi ralkap pawl tla an khur ṭheh. Leilung tiangin a hnin ih Filistin mi pawl cu ṭih le khur in an buai ciamco."},"16":{"text":"Benjamin ram, Gibeah khua ih Saul ih ralvengtu pawl in Filistin mi suk le so ih an tlan rero kha an hmuh tikah,","title":"Filistin Mi An Neh"},"17":{"text":"Saul in, “Ralkap pawl, siar-aw hnik uh; a kim lo nan um maw!” tiah a ti. An siar-awk tikah Jonathan le a hriamnam kengtu tlangvalpa an um lo ti kha an thei."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in puithiam Ahijah hnenah, “Puithiam ṭaangthlaih angki cu hinah rak keng aw,” tiah a fial. Ziangahtile Israel mi hmai ih puithiam angki kengtu cu amah a si."},"19":{"text":"Puithiam Ahijah hnenih Saul a ṭong rero laiah Filistin ralkap pawl cu an riahnak ahcun an buai sinsin. Curuangah Saul in Ahijah hnenah, “Na aizing cu bangta hrih aw,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule Saul le a ralkap pawl cu hmakhatte-ah Filistin mi do dingah an feh. Filistin pawl cu an buaituk thlang ih an minung khal thei-aw nawn loin anmah le anmah an that-aw rero."},"21":{"text":"Filistin pawl hnenih a rak ṭangtu Hebru mi pawl tla Saul le Jonathan an hmuh tikah an hnenah an let-aw sal."},"22":{"text":"Cun Efraim tlangram ah a tlan ih a relhmi Israel ralkap pawl tla Filistin mi an sung ti an theih tikah Saul le Jonathan hnenah an ṭang sal ih Filistin mi pawl cu an do."},"23":{"text":"A cuih ni ah Israel cu Bawipa in a runsuak ih Israel mi pawl in Bethaven khua lan tiang an hei dawi a si."},"24":{"text":"Saul in, “Ka ral pawl parih phu ka lak hlan lo, tuihsun ah zohman rawl nan ei lo pei. Nan ei asile nan buarsual a si ding,” tiah siatcam in thu a pek. Curuangah cuih ni cu Israel mi pawl an ril a rawng ngaingai ih an ṭaamsawl thluh. Sunvu zianghman an ei lo.","title":"Ral An Do Hnu Ih Thil A Cangmi"},"25":{"text":"Tupi sung an thleng ih cutawkah khuaitizu tampi a um."},"26":{"text":"Tupi sung cu khuaitizu in a khat naón Saul ih siatcamnak an ṭih ruangah zohman in an ei ngam lo."},"27":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jonathan in a pa ih siatcamnak thupekmi cu a theih lo ruangah a kenmi fung cun khuaithlar cu a dawt ih khuaitizu malte a ei. Cuticun a rilrawn cu a ṭha deuh."},"28":{"text":"Cumi a hmuh tikah ralkap pa pakhat in, “Zokhal rawl kan ei lo ruangah tha kan nei nawn lo a si. Na pa in, ‘Tuihsun ih rawl a eitu cu siatserh siseh,’ a ti ruangah kan ei ngam lo a si,” tiah a sim."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah Jonathan in, “Kan minung parah ka pa in thil ṭha lo ngaingai a tuah a si. Zohhmen uh, khuaitizu ka ei ruangah ka ṭha deuh ngaingai a si."},"30":{"text":"Tuihsun Filistin pawl an neh ih rawl an lon mi hmuahhmuah kha lak tahratin ei hai sehla ziangtlukin an hrangah a ṭhahnem ding. Ziangtluk in so Filistin mi an that tam sinsin ding, ruathnik hmen uh,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"A cuih ni ah Israel mi pawl in Filistin mi pawl cu Mikmash ihsin Aijalon tiang an nor. Israel mi cu an ril a rawn ruangah an ṭaamsawl thluh."},"32":{"text":"Curuangah ral pawl ih ta an lonmi tuu le caw pawl cu a hmunah an that ih an sa cu a thi thawn an ei ciamco."},"33":{"text":"Cule Saul hnenah, “Na ralkap pawl in a thi thawn sa an ei ciamco ih Bawipa ih hmaiah an sual a si,” tiah mi in an sim. Cutikah Saul cun, “Kan miphun zuarthlaitu nan si,” tiah a au. Cuih tlun ah, “Lungto tumpi hinah rak hril uh,” a ti."},"34":{"text":"“Mi hmuahhmuah hnenah va feh uhla an caw le an tuu pawl hinah rak keng dingin va sim uh. Sa cu a thi thawn an ei lonak dingah le Bawipa ih hmaiah an sual lonak dingah an ṭilva cu hinah ra that hai sehla ei hai seh,” tiah a ti. Curuangah a cuih zan cu an zatein an caw an rak keng ih cutawkah cun an that."},"35":{"text":"Saul in biakṭheng a dawlih Bawipa hrangih a dawlmi hmaisa bik a si."},"36":{"text":"Cule Saul in a ralkap pawl hnenah, “Kan vung feh pei ih zanah Filistin mi pawl kan vung do pei. Zinglam khawvang tiang kan vung siim ding ih kan vung that thluh hai ding,” tiah a ti. “A ṭha bik na timi poh cu tuah ko aw,” tiah an ti. Asinain puithiam in, “Pathian kan ron hmaisa hrih pei,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Curuangah Saul in Pathian hnenah, “Filistin pawl ka do pei maw? Kan do asile kan neh pei maw?” tiah a sut. Asinain cuih ni cu Pathian in a sawn lo."},"38":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in Israel hruaitu pawl hnenah, “Ra hnik uh, tuihsun ah ziang mawhnak so nan tuah, hawl hnik uh."},"39":{"text":"A nungmi Bawipa , Israel Runtu ih hmin in ka lo kam a si: ka fapa Jonathan hman a mawh a si ahcun thah a si pei,” tiah a ti. Midang cu zianghman an ṭong lo."},"40":{"text":"Cule Saul in, “Nan zatein khi lamah va ding uh. Kei le ka fapa Jonathan hinah kan ding pei,” a ti. “Na duh vekin si ko seh,” tiah misenpi in an ti."},"41":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian hnenah, “ Bawipa , ziangah so tuihsun ah zianghman i sawn lo? Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, atu-ah Urim le Thummim in in run let hram aw. Keimah ih mawh, a si lole Jonathan ih mawh a si ahcun Urim in in let aw. Israel misenpi pawl an mawh a si ahcun Thummim in in let aw,” tiah a ti. Urim in a run let ruangah Jonathan le Saul cu mimawh an si ih Israel mi pawl cu mawh lo ah an cang."},"42":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “Keimah le ka fapa Jonathan ah zoso a mawh?” tiah a sut sal tikah Jonathan parah a tlu."},"43":{"text":"Cule Saul in Jonathan cu, “Ziang so na tuah sual?” tiah a sut. Cutikah Jonathan in, “Khuaitizu malte ka ei a si. Thih ding a si ahcun ka thi ko pei cu,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"Saul in, “Nangmah na thih lo ahcun keimah hi Pathian in i run that seh,” tiah siat a cam."},"45":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl in Saul hnenah, “Israel hrangih ral a nehtu Jonathan a thi ding maw? Thi hrimhrim hlah! A lu parih samphang pakhat hman leilung parah a tla lo pei, tiah a nungmi Bawipa ih hmin in thu kan kam aw. Tuihsun ih a tuahmi cu Bawipa ih bomnak in a tuahmi a si,” tiah an ti. Cutiin Israel mi pawl in Jonathan cu thi loin an hum suak."},"46":{"text":"Cuihhnu cun Saul in Filistin mi pawl cu dawi nawn loin a kirsan ih Filistin pawl cu an ramah an tlung."},"47":{"text":"Saul cu Israel siangpahrang a can hnuah khuazakip ah ral a do. Moab mi pawl, Ammon mi pawl le Edom mi pawl a do ih Filistin mi pawl le Zobah siangpahrang pawl tla a do. Ral a donak tinah nehtu a si ringring.","title":"Saul Ih Uknak Le A Innsang"},"48":{"text":"Ralṭhazet in ral a do ih Amalek pawl khal a neh. Israel mi a siimtu pawl ih kut ihsin a hum ngah hai a si."},"49":{"text":"Saul ih fapa pawl cu Jonathan, Ishvi le Malkhishua an si. A fanu upa sawn cu Merab a si ih a nauta sawn cu Mikhal a si."},"50":{"text":"A nupi cu Ahimaaz ih fanu Ahinoam a si. A ralkap uktu bawi cu a paseu Ner ih fapa Abner a si."},"51":{"text":"Saul ih pa Kish le Abner ih pa Ner cu Abiel ih fapa an si."},"52":{"text":"Saul in a nunsung hmuahhmuah nasazet in Filistin pawl a do. Micak le mi ralṭha a hmuhmi le a tonmi hmuah in a ralkap ah a lak ṭheu."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel in Saul hnenah, “Pathian minung Israel mi pawl uktu siangpahrang si dingih hriak lo culhtu dingah Bawipa in i thlah zo. Curuangah Bawipa ih simmi cu ngai aw.","title":"Israel Mi In Amalek Pawl An Do"},"2":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl an suah laiah, Israel mi a rak dodaltu Amalek mi pawl cu Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in hrem a tum a si."},"3":{"text":"Feh awla Amalek mi pawl cu va do uh. An neihmi hmuahhmuah siatsuah thluh uh. Zianghman zuah hlah uh; mipa, nunau, nauhak le a suak pekte naute tiangin that thluh uh. Caw, tuu, kalauk le laak pawl khal that thluh uh,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Saul in a ralkap pawl a ko ih Telaim ah an khawm aw. Israel ihsin ralkap thawng zahnih le Judah ihsin ralkap thawnghra an ra."},"5":{"text":"Cule Saul le a ralkap pawl cu Amalek khawpi lam ahcun an feh ih tiva car sung ihsin ral an bawh."},"6":{"text":"Saul in Ken mi pawl hnenah, “Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl an suah laiah Israel mi parah nannih cu nan rak ṭha a si. Amalek mi pawl hnenih kan lo thah cih thluh lonak dingah Amalek mi pawl cu tlansan uhla fehsuak uh,” tiah ralrinnak a pek. Curuangah Ken mi pawl cu an suak."},"7":{"text":"Saul in Amalek mi pawl cu Izipt ram nisuahnak lam Havilah ihsin Shur tiang a neh thluh."},"8":{"text":"Amalek siangpahrang Agag cu a nung in a kai ih midang pawl cu a that ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Saul le a ralkap pawl in Agag ih nunnak cu an zuah ih, a ṭha bikmi tuu le caw, tuu faate le caw faate pawl le a ṭha an timi pohpoh cu an that lo. Ṭhathnemnak nei lomi le man nei lomi hmuahhmuah cu an that thluh."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in Samuel hnenah thu a sim sal ih,","title":"Saul Cu Pathian In A Hnong"},"11":{"text":"“Saul hi siangpahrang ih ka canter cu ka siir aw ngaingai. A dung i tun ih ka thupek a thlun lo a si,” tiah a ti. Samuel cu a thin a heng ngaingai ih zanvarte Bawipa hnenah thla a cam."},"12":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah Saul tong dingin a feh. Saul cu amah ih hmin hngilh lonak dingah lung a dawlnak Karmel khua ah a feh ih cuih hnuah Gilgal ah a feh a si, ti thu cu Samuel in a thei."},"13":{"text":"Cun Samuel cu Saul hnenah a va thleng ih Saul cun a rak cibai ih, “ Bawipa in lo thluasuah hram seh, Samuel. Bawipa ih thupekmi ka thlun ko a si,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Cuti asile ziangtinso tuu a meekmi le caw a pawmi ka theih rero?” tiah a sut."},"15":{"text":"Saul in, “Amalek mi pawl hnen ihsin ka ralkap pawl ih an lakmi a si. Tuu siseh caw siseh a ṭha bikmi cu Bawipa na Pathian hrangih thawinak pek dingah an ret ih a dang cu kan that thluh a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Samuel in, “Cawl hrih awla mizan ah Bawipa ih thu i simmi ka lo sim pei,” tiah a ti. “I sim hnik aw,” tiah Saul in a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Nangmah cun zianghman ka si lo tiah na ruat-aw ding naón Israel miphun pawl hotu na si. Bawipa in Israel siangpahrang ah hriak a lo culh a si."},"18":{"text":"Cun mi siava Amalek mi pawl that thluh dingah Bawipa in thu a lo pek ih an zate ih na thah thluh hlan lo do dingin feltein a lo tiam a si."},"19":{"text":"Cuti asinain ziangah so a thu na ngai lo? Ziangah so thilri lonmi pawl cuh dingah zamrang sawn in na pan ih Bawipa ih lungkim lomi cu na tuah?” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Saul in, “ Bawipa ih thu ka ngai ko sokhaw! I fial vekin ka feh ih Amalek siangpahrang Agag lawng a nungin ka rak thlenpi. Midang hmuahhmuah cu ka that ṭheh a si."},"21":{"text":"Asinain ka ralkap pawl cun an kaihmi lakih tuu le caw ṭha bik pawl cu an that lo. Gilgal khua ah Bawipa na Pathian hnenih thawinak pek dingah an rak keng sawn a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Khuimiso Bawipa in a duh sawn? Amah ih thu thlun maw, a si lole saserh peknak le thawinak so? Tuu a ṭha bikmi thawn a hnenih raithawi hnakin amah ih thu thlun cu a ṭha sawn a si. Amah dodal cu polsia dawihmang tlukin a ṭha lo a si."},"23":{"text":"Puarthau ih nun cu milem biak tlukin a sual a si. Bawipa ih thupekmi na duh lo bangtuk in anih khal in siangpahrang ah a lo duh ve lo,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “Ka sualzet a si. Bawipa ih thupekmi le nangmah ih thucahmi ka thlun lo. Ka milai pawl ka ṭih deuh ruangah an duhnak bangin ka thlun."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa ka biak theinak dingah ka sualnak cu i ngaithiam hram awla ka hnenah Gilgal ah kirsal aw, tiah zaangfah ka lo dil,” a ti."},"26":{"text":"Samuel in, “Na hnenah ka kir sal lo ding. Bawipa ih thupekmi na duh lo ruangah nang khal Israel ih siangpahrang si dingah a lo duh nawn ve lo a si,” a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule Samuel cu tlung dingin a pok. Asinain Saul in a puan in a kai ih a puan cu a tlek."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “ Bawipa in tuihsun ah Israel ram uknak cu na hnen ihsin a lak ih nangmah hnakih a ṭha deuhmi hnenah a pek zo."},"29":{"text":"Israel ih sunloihmi Pathian cu thuphan a per lo ih a thin a thleng-aw rero lo. Minung a si lo ruangah a thin a thleng rero lo a si,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cule Saul in, “Ka sual zo a si. Asinain Israel mi hmuahhmuah le ka minung hruaitu pawl ih hmai talah hin i upatnak cu langter hram awla Bawipa na Pathian ka biak theinak dingah ka hnenah kir ve hram aw,” tiah a dil ciamco."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah Samuel cu Saul hnenah a kirsal ih Saul cun Bawipa cu a biak."},"32":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Ka hnenah siangpahrang Agag cu rak hruai uh,” tiah thu a pek. Agag cu lungawizet in Samuel ih hmaiah cun a ra ih, “Thih ding ka luat zo a si hi!” tiah amahte a ruat."},"33":{"text":"Cule Samuel in, “Na ralnam in nunau tampi cu faate neilo ih a tuah bangtuk in atu-ah na nu khal faate neilo ah a cang ve ding,” a ti. Cutiin Gilgal ih biakṭheng hmai rori ahcun Agag cu Samuel in a that ih a satcip ṭheh a si."},"34":{"text":"Cun Samuel cu Ramah ah a feh ih Saul cu Gibeah ih a inn ah a tlung."},"35":{"text":"Samuel cun a nunsung hmuahhmuah ah siangpahrang Saul cu a tong sal nawn lo; asinain a hrangah riahsia in a um ringring. Saul cu Israel siangpahrang ih a rak tuah ruangah Bawipa Pathian cu a siir-aw ngaingai."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Samuel hnenah, “Ziangtik tiangso Saul hrangah na riah a siat ding? Israel siangpahrang a sinak in ka hnong zo a si. Curuangah olif siti malte in la awla keng aw. Bethlehem khua ah Jesse an timi pa hnenah ka lo thlah ding. Ziangahtile a fapa pawl lakin pakhat cu siangpahrang dingah ka hril zo a si,” tiah a ti.","title":"David Hriakculhnak"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Cumi cu ziangtinso ka tuah ngam ding? Saul ih a theih a si ahcun i that ding a sisi,” tiah a ti. Bawipa in, “Caw faate pakhat hei hruai phah awla Bawipa hnenih thawinak pek dingah ka ra tiah ti aw."},"3":{"text":"Jesse kha thawinak peknak ah sawm awla cuih hnuah na tuah ding mi cu ka lo sim ding. Hriak culh aw, ka lo timi pa cu siangpahrang si dingah hriak na culh pei,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih a tivek cun Samuel in a tuah ih Bethlehem ahcun a feh. Bethlehem khawsungih upa pawl cun an rak hmuak ih khur rero in, “Thu ṭha thawn in ra tlawng a si maw?” tiah an rak sut."},"5":{"text":"Samuel in, “Asi, Bawipa hnenih thawinak pe dingah ka ra a si. Thiangfai-awter uhla ka hnenah ra uh,” tiah a ti. Jesse le a fapa pawl khal thiangfai aw dingin a sim ih thawinak ahcun a sawm hai."},"6":{"text":"An ra thlen tikah Jesse ih fapa Eliab cu Samuel in a hmuh tikah a thinlung tein, “ Bawipa hmaiih a dingmi a fapa hi Pathian hrilmi a si rori ding,” tiah a ruat."},"7":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in a hnenah, “Hi pa hi mi saangzet le mi piangzet sihmansehla zoh duh hlah. Amah cu ka hnon zomi a si, ziangahtile milai zoh daan in kei Bawipa cun ka zoh lo. Milai cun a lenglam thil nan zoh, kei cun an thinlung ka zoh a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Jesse in a fapa Abinadab a ko ih Samuel hnenah cun a ratpi. Asinain Samuel in, “Asilo, anih cu Bawipa ih hrilmi asilo,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Jesse in a fapa Shammah a rak hruai ih Samuel in, “Anih khal Bawipa ih hrilmi a si lo,” a ti lala."},"10":{"text":"Cutiin Jesse cun a fapa pasarih pawl cu Samuel ih hmaiah a rak hruai ṭheh naón Samuel in, “Pakhat hman Bawipa ih hrilmi a si lo,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Samuel in, “Fapa dang na nei nawn lo maw?” tiah a sut. Jesse in, “A nauta bik pa a um lai naón hramlak ah tuu a khal,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Samuel in, “Amah cu ko awla ra seh. A rat hlan lo Bawipa ih hnenah thawinak kan pe hrih lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Jesse in a ko. David cu mi piangzet, mi harhdam zet tlangval note a si ih a mitmen tla cu a ṭha ngaingai. Bawipa in Samuel hnenah, “Ka hrilmi cu amah a si, hriak culh aw,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Samuel cun olif hriak a lakih a unau pawl ih hmaiah cun David cu hriak a culh. Cule Bawipa ih thlarau cu a cuih ni ihsin thokin David hnenah nasa zetin a thleng. Cuih hnuah Samuel cu Ramah ah a tlung."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa ih thlarau in Saul cu a tlansan ih Bawipa ih fialmi thlarau ṭha lo in a hrem.","title":"Saul Ih Inn Ah David A Thleng"},"15":{"text":"A hnen-um pawl in, “Pathian ih fialmi thlarau ṭha lo in a lo hrem a si, ti kan thei."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah bawipa, thu in pe awla ṭingṭang tum a thiam zetmi kan hawl pei. Thlarau ṭha lo in a lo kaih tikah amah cun ṭingṭang a tum pei ih na ṭha sal ding a si,” tiah an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “ṭingṭang tum a thiam zetmi cu i hawl sak uhla rak hruai uh,” tiah thu a pek."},"18":{"text":"Cule a hnen-um pakhat pa in, “Bethlehem khuami Jesse in ṭingṭang tum thiamzet fapa pakhat a nei. Amah cu mi ralṭhazet a si ih raldo tla a thiamzet. Thusim a thiam ih a piangzet fawn. A hnenah Bawipa a um a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Saul in Jesse hnenah mi a thlah ih, “Tuu a khaltu na fapa David cu ka hnenah rak thlah hram aw,” tiah a cah."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Jesse cun sabitti saphaw thawl khat le mete pakhat le sang an phurhter mi laak pakhat thawn David cu Saul hnenah a thlah."},"21":{"text":"David cu Saul hnenah a va thleng ih Saul ih hnaṭuantu ah a cang. Cun Saul in David cu a duhzet ih a hriamnam kengtu ah a tuah."},"22":{"text":"Cule Saul in Jesse hnenah, “David cu ka duhzet a si. Ka hnenah um hrih ko seh,” tiah thu a cah."},"23":{"text":"Cun Pathian ih fialmi thlarau ṭha lo in Saul cu a kaiṭheu ih cuti ih a kaih tinte David in a ṭingṭang a lak ih a tum ṭheu. Cutikah thlarau ṭha lo cu a tlan sal ih Saul cu a ṭha deuh ih a dam sal ṭheu."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl cu raldo dingah an ko-aw ih Judah ram Sokoh khua ah an khawm-aw. Cule Sokoh le Azekah karlak ih a ummi Efes Dammim an timi hmunah an riak.","title":"Goliath In Israel Mi Pawl A Zuam"},"2":{"text":"Saul le Israel mi pawl cu an ko khawm-aw ih Filistin mi do dingah an timtuah-aw ih Elah Rawn ah an riak."},"3":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl cu tlang pakhat parah an ṭang ih Israel mi pawl khal tlang dang pakhat parah an ṭang ve. An karlak ah horkuampi a um."},"4":{"text":"Gath khua mi Goliath an timi pa cu Filistin mi pawl umnak ihsin Israel mi zuam dingah a ra suak. Goliath cu dong ruk le khap khat a sang."},"5":{"text":"Dar lukhuh a khummi le ralthuam a hrukmi pawl cu cuai sawmli le cuai ruk tluk a rit."},"6":{"text":"A ke pawl cu darphaw in a tuam thluh ih darih tuahmi feipi cu a liangah a pai."},"7":{"text":"A feipi cu a hlai lam thiamtleeng tia a si ih a feipi lu cu cuai nga lenglo a rit. A ralphaw phurh saktu ralkap pakhat cu a hmaiah a feh."},"8":{"text":"Goliath cun ding tahratin Israel mi pawl cu, “Saul ih sal rual pawl, raldo dingah maw si nan ra suah? Kei cu Filistin mi ka si ih keimah do dingah nanmah lak ihsin pakhat hril aw uh."},"9":{"text":"I neh ih i that a si ahcun nan salah kan cang ding; asinain ka neh ih ka that a si ahcun kan salah nan cang ding."},"10":{"text":"Atu rori-ah hin Israel ralkap pawl ka lo zuam a si. Keimah do dingah nanmah lak ihsin mi pakhat hril aw uhla ra suak seh,” tiah a auh ciamco."},"11":{"text":"Cumi cu Saul le a ralkap pawl ih an theih tikah an riah a sia ih an thin a phang ngaingai."},"12":{"text":"David cu Judah ram Bethlehem khua ih Efrath mi Jesse ih fapa a si. Jesse cun fapa pariat a nei ih Saul kha siangpahrang a can tikah Jesse cu a tar zo.","title":"Saul Ih Riahnak Ah David A Thleng"},"13":{"text":"A fapa upa pathum cu raldonak ah Saul hnenah an feh ve. A upabik cu Eliab a si. A sangtu cu Abinadab a si ih a pathumnak cu Shammah a si."},"14":{"text":"David cu nauta bik a si. A ule pathum Saul hnenih an tel ve laiah,"},"15":{"text":"David cu a caancaan ah Bethlehem ah a va tlung ih a pa ih tuu pawl a va khal ṭheu."},"16":{"text":"Cun Israel mi pawl cu Goliath in do-aw dingah zingtin zantin ni sawmli sung a va zuam ringring hai."},"17":{"text":"Voikhat ah David cu a pa Jesse in, “Vaikan bawm khat le sang zawl hra hi phur awla ralkap pawl riahnak ah na ule pawl hei sum aw."},"18":{"text":"Cun a khal mi cawhnawi hlom hra in keng awla ralkap hotu ralbawipa va pek aw. Na ule pawl an dam le dam lo va zoh awla, an dam a si, ti theihnak ah an thil pakhatkhat run keng aw."},"19":{"text":"Saul siangpahrang le na ule pawl le Israel ralkap pawl cu Filistin ral an do ih Sasuapi Rawn ah an um a si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah David cu a thaizing zingpitah a tho ih tuu pawl khaltu dingah mi pakhat a ai-awh ah a retta ih a pa Jesse ih a fial vekin ei ding rawl pawl kengin a feh. Israel ralkap pawl cu Filistin pawl do dingah au phah in raldonak hmunih an feh ciamco laifangah David cu ralkap riahnak ahcun a va thleng."},"21":{"text":"Filistin ralkap pawl le Israel ralkap pawl cu do-aw dingah ṭanṭhat an khuar veve ih hmaiton in an um."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah David cu rawl lamih ṭuanvo latu ralbawi hnenah a rawl kenmi cu taanta in raldonak ah a va tlan ih a ule pawl cu an dam le dam lo a va zoh."},"23":{"text":"A ule pawl thawn an biak awk rero laiah Goliath cu hmaiah a rasuak ih a hlanih a ti ṭheu bangtuk in Israel ralkap pawl cu a zuam lala. Cumi cu David in a thei."},"24":{"text":"Goliath cu Israel ralkap pawl in an hmuh tikah an ṭih tuk ih an tlan ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat, “Zohhnik uh, khi pa lawmmam khi! A mi zuam daan cu ngaihnik uh! Khi pa a that theitu cu kan siangpahrang in milian ah a tuah rori ding; a fanu a ṭhitter ding ih a pa ih sungte pawl cu ngunkhuai a olh thluh ding a si ko,” tiah an ti-aw rero."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah David in a kiangkap ih a ummi pawl hnenah, “Hi Filistin pa a thattu le hi bangtuk ningzah phurhnak ihsin Israel mi a luattertu in ziangso a ngah ding. Thungai ih ti ahcun, a nungmi Pathian ih ralkap pawl zuamtu dingah cun hi Pathian awi lo Filistin pa cu ziangso a va si lem,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule Goliath a thattu cu laksawng tampi a ngah ding tiah an sim."},"28":{"text":"Cutiih David le ralkap pawl an biak awk rero cu David ih u Eliab in a theih tikah a thin a heng ih, “Hinah ziangso na ra tuah? Ramlak ih na tuu pawl zoso a rak khal? Nang mi doksang pa! Raldo awk zoh dingah na ra a sihi!” tiah a kawk."},"29":{"text":"David in, “Ziang sualnak so ka tuah? Thu tal mi ka sut thei lo ding maw?” a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cun hmundang a hoi ih midang hnenah cuih thu cu a sut sal. Thu a suh mi hmuahhmuah in an thulehnak a bangrep thluh."},"31":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat in David ih ṭong cu an thei ih Saul an va sim. Cule Saul in David cu a ko."},"32":{"text":"Cutikah David in Saul hnenah, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, hi Filistin pa cu zohman in ṭih ding a si lo. Keimah in ka va do mai ding,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Saul in, “Asilo, ziangtinso na do thei ding? Nang cu nauhak na si ih anih cu a sansung hmuahhmuah ralkap a si zo,” a ti."},"34":{"text":"Asinain David cun, “Maw siangpahrang, kei cu ka pa ih tuu ka khal ṭheu. Kiosa a si lole savom in ka tuu note a tlanpi tikah,"},"35":{"text":"sahrang cu ka dawi ih ka nam ciamco ih tuu note cu ka hum suak ṭheu a si. Cun kiosa a si lole savom in i zon tikah, a bakhmul in ka kai ih ka vuak that ṭheu."},"36":{"text":"Kiosa le savom tampi ka that zo a si ih a cuih pawl ka thah vekin hi Pathian awi lo Filistin pa, a nungmi Pathian ih ralkap pawl a zuamtu cu ka that ve ding a si."},"37":{"text":"Kiosa le savom pawl hnen ihsin i humtu Bawipa cun hi Filistin pa ih kutsung khal in i hum ko ding,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Saul in, “A ṭha ko; va feh awla Bawipa Pathian in lo umpi hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cule Saul in a ralthuam cu David ih hruk dingah a pek. David ih lu ah dar lukhuh a khumterih a ralthuam a hrukter."},"39":{"text":"David in a hrukmi ralthuam parah cun Saul ih ralnam a pai ih feh a tum. Asinain a hruk dah lomi an si ruangah a fehpi thei lo. Cutikah David in, “Hi vek thaw cun ka do thei lo ding. Ka hruk dahmi an si lo,” tiah Saul hnenah a ti. Curuangah a phuak sal thluh."},"40":{"text":"A tuu khalhnak funghreu a keng ih tiva kapih lungto hlum fate panga a sar ih a vaidip ah a san. Cutiin a lungherhden thawn Goliath do dingah a feh."},"41":{"text":"Filistin mi Goliath cun David cu a rak naih. A raldonak phaw a phurtu pa cu a hmaiah a fehter. A rak naih vivo ih,","title":"David In Goliath A Neh"},"42":{"text":"Ṭhate ih David a hmuh ngahnak hmun ihsin a zoh tikah, David cu mi piangzet tlangval note a si ko lo maw tiah a nautat ngaingai."},"43":{"text":"Cutikah David cu, “Kha-ih funghreu kha ziangtinak ah so na ken? Uico ah maw i ruat?” tiah a auh ih amah ih khawzing hmin ko in David cu a cam ciamco."},"44":{"text":"David cu a zuam ih, “Ra hnik aw, na sa cu vate le ramsa pawl ka eiter ding,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Nang cun nam le fei le thal keng in do i tum. Sikhalsehla kei cu na zuammi Israel pawl ih Pathian Ziangkimtithei Bawipa ih hmin in nangmah do dingah ka ra a si."},"46":{"text":"Tuihsun rori ah Bawipa ih thawngin nangmah cu ka kutsung ah na thleng ding, ka lo neh ding. Na lu ka lo tan ding. Filistin ralkap pawl ih sa cu vate le ramsa pawl ih ei dingah ka pe ding. Israel cun Pathian a nei a si, ti kha hi ram mi hmuahhmuah in an thei ding."},"47":{"text":"Pathian cun amah ih minung pawl run dingah nam le fei pawl a ṭulter lo a si, ti cu mi hmuahhmuah in an hmu ding a si. Bawipa cu ral nehtu a si ih nanmah khal hi nan zatein kan kutsung ah a lo thlenter ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"48":{"text":"Cule Goliath in David cu a rak naih sinsin ih David cun amah do dingah Filistin pawl lamah cun zamrang in a va tlan."},"49":{"text":"David in a vaidip sung a vun pur ih lungto hlumte pakhat a vun lak hnuah a lungherhden in Goliath cu a sai. Goliath ih calpadar ah a ngah ih a luruh a kuai. Curuangah Goliath cu a bokkhup in a ril."},"50":{"text":"Cutiin ralnam hmang lotein David in Goliath cu lungherhden le lungto in a neh a si."},"51":{"text":"David cu a tlan ih Goliath parah a va ding. Cun Goliath ih ralnam cu a kawm sung ihsin a zuk ih a hngawng a tan ih Goliath cu a thi. Filistin ralkap pawl cu an micak bik pa a thih an hmuh tikah an tlanhlo."},"52":{"text":"Cule Israel le Judah ram ihsin a rami ralkap pawl cun hmakhatte-ah an dawi hai ih au phah in Gath le Ekron kotka tiang an dawi. Filistin ralkap pawl ih ruak cu Gath le Ekron tiang Shaaraim lamzin ah an ril teptep."},"53":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Israel ralkap pawl cu an kir ih Filistin ralkap riahnak ih thilri pawl cu an lak ṭheh."},"54":{"text":"David in Goliath ih lu cu a lak ih Jerusalem ah a phur. Asinain Goliath hriamnam pawl cu amah ih buuk sungah a ret."},"55":{"text":"Goliath do dingih David a feh kha Saul in a rak hmuh tikah a ralkap hotu ralbawipa Abner a ko ih, “Khi nauhak pa khi zoso a si?” tiah a sut. Abner in, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, zoso a si ti ka thei lo,” tiah a sawn.","title":"David In Saul A Tong"},"56":{"text":"“Va feh awla zo ih fapa so a si, ti va hliah aw,” tiah Saul in a ti."},"57":{"text":"Cun a thah hnu ih an riaknak ih David a rathlen tikah, David cu Abner in Saul hnenah a fehpi. David in Goliath ih lu cu a keng thotho."},"58":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “Tlangvalpa, zoso na si?” tiah a sut. Cule David in, “Bethlehem khuami na salpa Jesse ih fapa ka si,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul le David cu thu an rel tlang thluh hnu in Saul fapa Jonathan ih thinlung cu David hnenah a kop ih amah le amah a duh awk vek rori in David cu a duhdawt."},"2":{"text":"Curuangah cuih ni thokin Saul in David cu a inn ah tlunter siang loin a hnenah a umter."},"3":{"text":"Jonathan in David cutluk ih a duh ruangah kumkhua ih rualpi ṭha si dingin thu a kam."},"4":{"text":"A hruk laimi angki fualpi a phuak ih David a pek. A ralthuam, a ralnam, a li le a taikhap pawl khal a pek."},"5":{"text":"Cun Saul in David cu raldo dingah a thlah ṭheu ih a thlah tin in ral pawl cu a va neh ṭheu. Curuangah Saul in David cu ralbawi pakhat ah a tuah ih ralbawi dang pawl le ralkap pawl cu an lung a awi ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"David in Goliath a thah hnu ih Israel ralkap pawl an ra tlun tikah Israel ramsung khua pawl ihsin nunau hmuahhmuah an tho ih Saul siangpahrang hmuak dingah an feh. Lungawinak hla an sa ih khuang le dar le ṭingṭang tum phah in an laam ciamco.","title":"Saul In David A Nahsiik"},"7":{"text":"Lungawi ih an laam phah ah nunau pawl in; “Saul cun a thawng a sawm in a that; David cun a thawng a za in a that,” tiah hla an sak."},"8":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Saul cu a lung a kim lozet ih a thin a heng ngaingai. “David cu a thawng a za that ah an ruat ih kei cu a thawng a sawm lawng that ah in ruat. David hrangah cun siangpahrang ih hung can ding lawng a sam a si,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Saul cun a cuih ni ih thokin David cu a nahsiikta a si."},"10":{"text":"A thaisun ah Pathian ih thlahmi thlarau ṭha lo in Saul cu a kai ih a inn sungah miaa vekin a phun rero. Cule ni dangih a tuah ṭheu vekin David in ṭingṭang a tum ih Saul cun feipi a keng."},"11":{"text":"A thinlungte in, “Phar sansiah ah ka khawh pei,” tiah a ruat. Cule voihnih a khawh ih a voihnih in David cu a rak pet man ih a khawh ngah lo."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in Saul cu a tlansan ih David hnenih a um kha a hmuh tikah Saul in David cu a ṭih ngaingai."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah ralkap thawngkhat hotu ralbawi ah a tuah ih raldo dingah a thlah. Raldonak ah David in a ho hai ih,"},"14":{"text":"Bawipa cu a hnenih a um ruangah ral pawl cu a neh ih a thil timi hmuahhmuah ah a hlawhtling."},"15":{"text":"David cu a thiltinak tinkim ah a hlawhtling ti kha Saul in a hmuh tikah Saul cun a ṭih sinsin."},"16":{"text":"Asinain Israel le Judah ram sung mi hmuahhmuah in David cu an duhzet, ziangahtile hotu ṭha ngaingai a si."},"17":{"text":"Cule Saul in David hnenah, “Ralṭha le rinsan tlak in ka hna na ṭuan ih Bawipa Pathian ih ral tla na do a si ahcun ka fanu upadeuh Merab na nupi ah ka lo pe ding,” tiah a ti. Saul ih ruahnak ahcun David cu amah ih thah ṭul loin Filistin pawl a donak ah an that leh pam ding, ti a si.","title":"David In Saul Ih Fanu A ṭhi"},"18":{"text":"David in, “Kei hi zoso ka si ih zo ih sungkhat ka si ruangah so siangpahrang ih maakpa ka si zik?” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Asinain David thawn an ṭhit awknak ding tikcu a thlen tikah Merab cu Meholah khuami Adrial an timi pa sawn a neihter."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Saul ih fanu Mikhal cu David thawn an ngai-aw ih cu mi cu Saul in a theih tikah a lung a awizet."},"21":{"text":"Saul cun, “Mikhal cu David ka neihter ding; ziangahtile Mikhal cu David hrangah thang a si pei ih Filistin pawl in David an that ding,” tiah a ruat. Curuangah Saul in David cu, “Ka maakpa na si ding,” a ti. Hiti ih a ti cu a voihnihnak a si."},"22":{"text":"“David cu a thupte in va tong uhla, ‘Siangpahrang bawipa cu na parah a lung a awi ngaingai a si ih, a kuthnuai bawi pawl khalin an lo duhzet a si. Siangpahrang fanu cu atuih na ṭhit le a ṭhabik ding,’ tiah va sim uh,” tiah Saul in a kuthnuai bawi pawl cu thu a pek."},"23":{"text":"Cumi cu David an sim ih cutikah David in, “Siangpahrang ih maakpa si ding cu sunloih ding ngaingai a si. Keimah vek mifarah le mi nauta hrangah cun ruah ban ding hman a si lo,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Bawi pawl in David ih ṭong cu Saul an sim."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “David cu va sim uh; ‘Siangpahrang in a fanu man ah ziangdang duhmi a nei lo. A ral pawl phulaknak ah Filistin ralkap pawl ih zahmawh vunzim zakhat lawng a ngen a si,’ va ti uh,” tiah a kuthnuai bawi pawl hnenah thu a pek. David cu Filistin pawl in an that pei, tiah Saul ih tumtah mi cu a si ringring."},"26":{"text":"Saul ih ṭongkam cu a kuthnuai bawi pawl in David an va sim tikah David cu siangpahrang ih maakpa si ding kha a ruah tikah a hni suamso. Ṭhit awk ding ni a thlen hlanah,"},"27":{"text":"David le a ralkap pawl cun Filistin pawl an va do ih minung zahnih an that. David in Filistin ralkap pawl ih zahmawh vunzim cu Saul siangpahrang hnenah a fehpi ih a maakpa si duh ah a hmai rori ah a va siarsak. Cule Saul in a fanu Mikhal cu David a neihter."},"28":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian cu David hnenah a um ti le a fanu Mikhal khal in David cu a duhzet ti kha Saul in fiangtein a thei."},"29":{"text":"Curuangah David cu a ṭih sinsin ih a nunsung hmuahhmuah a ralah a cangta."},"30":{"text":"Filistin ralkap pawl in Israel mi pawl cu atu le atu an ra do ṭheu. Asinain David in ralbawi dang hmuahhmuah hnakin a neh thei deuh ringring ruangah David cu a hmin a thang ngaingai."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul in David thah tengteng a tumnak thu kha a fapa Jonathan le a kuthnuai bawi pawl a sim. Jonathan in David cu a duhzet ruangah,","title":"Saul In David Harsatnak A Pek"},"2":{"text":"“Ka pa in thah a lo tum a si. Thaizing cu ralring awla hmun thup pakhatkhatah rak relh aw."},"3":{"text":"Hramlak na umnak ih ka pa a rat tikah ka rak thlun ve ding ih na thuhla cu ka sim ding. Thu theihmi ka nei asile ka lo sim ding,” tiah David cu a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule a pa ih hnenah Jonathan in David ṭhatnak thu a sim ih, “Bawipa, David na salpa hi a siatnak tuah hlah aw. Anih in na parah zianghman siatnak a tuah dah lo ih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu na hrangih a ṭhahnem mi sawn an si."},"5":{"text":"Goliath a thah laiah khan a nunnak hman ruat loin a tuahmi a si ih Bawipa in Israel hrangah ral tumpi a neh a si. Cumi na hmuh tikah na lung a rak awizet. Cuti a si ruangah ziangah so mawhnak nei lomi David cu ziang thu hman um loin a thah na tum?” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Jonathan ih thusimmi cu Saul in a ngai ih Bawipa in hmin sal in, “David cu thah a si lo pei” tiah thu a kam."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Jonathan in David cu a ko ih a pa ih ṭongmi hmuahhmuah cu a sim ṭheh. Cuih hnuah a pa ih hnenah a fehpi ih David cu a hlan bangtuk in siangpahrang ih hnaṭuantu ah a cang sal."},"8":{"text":"Israel le Filistin pawl ral an do-aw sal ih David in a nam hai ih nasa zetin a neh ruangah Filistin pawl cu a suk le a so ah an tlan ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Nikhat ah Bawipa ih thlah mi thlarau ṭha lo in Saul cu a kai lala ih a inn sungah Saul cu feipi kengin a to. David cu Saul hrangah ṭingṭang a tum rero."},"10":{"text":"Culaifang ah Saul in feipi cun a khawh ih David a rak pet man ruangah a feipi cu phar parah a phun-aw cukci. David cu a tlan ih a luat."},"11":{"text":"Saul in a cuih zanah David ih inn va thlingthla dingah le a thaizing ih David that dingah mihrek khat a thlah. Asinain a nupi Mikhal in, “Tuih zanih na tlan lo asile thaizing ahcun na thi rori ding,” tiah ralrinnak a pek."},"12":{"text":"A nupi cun sangkate ihsin a lengah a vun thlak ih David cu a tlanhlo ih a luat."},"13":{"text":"Cun an innsang milem a lak ih an ihkhun parah Mikhal cun a ret. Me hmul ih tuahmi lukham a lu lamah a ret ih puan in a khuh."},"14":{"text":"Cule Saul ih milai pawl David kai dingih an rat tikah Mikhal in, “David a dam lo a si,” tiah a rak ti."},"15":{"text":"Asinain Saul in, “Nan mit hrimhrim in va zoh uh. A ihkhun thawn hitawk ah rak zawn uhla ka that ding,” tiah a tiih a minung a thlah sal."},"16":{"text":"David inn sungih an vung luh tikah ihkhun parah innsang milem le a lu lamih mehmul in tuahmi lukham cu an hmu."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “Ziangah so hiti in i bum ih ka ral na luatter?” tiah Mikhal cu a sut. Cule Mikhal in, “Ka luatnak ding i bawm aw. Culole ka lo that ding, i ti ruangah a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"David cu a tlan vivo ih Ramah khua ah Samuel hnenah a va thleng. Saul in a parih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu Samuel a sim thluh. Cuih hnuah David le Samuel cu Naioth ah an feh ih cutawkah an um."},"19":{"text":"David cu Ramah khua kiang Naioth khua ah a um, tiah Saul an sim."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah David kai dingah Saul in mi a hei thlah. Naioth khua an thlen tikah Samuel ih ho in profet pawl profet ṭong in an ṭong ih an phun an tlok ruri kha an hmu. Cutikah Saul ih milai pawl khal Pathian ih thlarau in a kai ih an phun an tlok ciamco ve."},"21":{"text":"Cuih thu Saul in a theih tikah mi tam deuh a thlah. Asinain annih khal cuti thotho in an um ve. Voithum tiang mi a thlah ih cuti thotho cun an um."},"22":{"text":"Cuih hnuah amah Saul siangpahrang rori a pok ih Ramah ahcun a feh. Seku an timi tikhur tumpi a va thleng ih, cutawkah Samuel le David umnak a suh tikah Ramah kiang Naioth khua ah an um, tiah mi in an rak sim."},"23":{"text":"Lamzin ih a feh laiah Bawipa ih thlarau in Saul khal cu a kai ve ih profet ṭong in a ṭong ih phun phah le tlok phah in Naioth cu a va thleng."},"24":{"text":"Samuel ih hmuhhngan ah a hnipuan a hlit ṭheh ih a phun a tlok ciamco. Cuticun a lawngfangkheh in sunvu le zanvar cutawkah a it. Curuangah, “Saul khal profet a si ve maw si?” ti ih ṭongṭhimnak ih a cantanak a si."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David cu Ramah khua kiang Naioth khua ihsin a tlan ih Jonathan hnenah a thleng sal ih a hnenah, “Thil sual ziangso ka tuah? Ziang mawhnak so ka neih? Na pa ih parah ziangvek thilsia ka tuah ruangah so hiti ih thah i tum?” tiah a ti.","title":"Jonathan In David A Bawm"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Jonathan in, “Pathian in na thih ding cu lo siang hram hlah seh. Ka pa in a tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu thupi siseh, thute siseh i sim thluh ṭheu. Thah a lo tum sisehla i pheh lo ding. I sim ko ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule David in, “Nangmah in kei hi ziangtluk i duh ti cu na pa in a theih ruangah a tumtahmi cu na thinlung natter ding a phan ruangah lo theihter a tum lo a si. Ka thihnak ah kar khat lawng a sam ti cu Bawipa ih hmin in ka kam ngam a si,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Jonathan in, “Tuahter i duhmi pohpoh ka tuah ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Thaisun hi Thla Thar Puai a si ih siangpahrang hnenih rawl ei ding ka si. Asinain na lung a kim ve asile hramlakah ka feh pei ih tipsun zanlam tiang ka va thup-aw ding."},"6":{"text":"Rawl ei tikcu ih ka um lo tikah na pa in i hlam asile Bethlehem an inn ah zamrangin a va tlungta; ziangahtile an sungkhat in kumtin an pek ṭheumi thawinak pek tikcu a si ih keimah i simta a si, tiah run ti aw."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah na pa in, ‘A ṭha ko,’ a ti ahcun phan ding zianghman a um lo. Asinain a thin a heng a si ahcun i siatsuah tengteng a tum ti na thei ding."},"8":{"text":"I zaangfah hram awla ka hnenih Pathian hmin sal in thukamnak na tuah mi cu thlun hram aw. Sikhalsehla keimah lehlam ka mawh a si ahcun nangmah sawn in i that aw. Ziangah so na pa ih kut cun ka thih ding?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Jonathan in, “Cuticun a si lo pei. Ka pa in thah a lo tum ngaingai a si, ti ka theihfiang a si ahcun ziangtinso nangmah sim loin ka um thiam ding?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule David in, “Na pa thinheng zetin a ṭong, ti cu zoso in sim sal ding?” tiah Jonathan cu a sut."},"11":{"text":"Jonathan in, “Hramlakah feh uhsi,” tiah a sawm. Curuangah hramlakah an feh."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah David hnenah Jonathan in, “Israel ih Bawipa Pathian cu in theihpitu si hram seh. Thaisun le tipsun atu tikcu ah hin ka pa cu thu ka rak sut ding. A thinlung na parih a ṭhat a si ahcun thu ka lo than ding."},"13":{"text":"Asinain siatsuah a lo tum a si ahcun, ka lo theihter ding ih na rak tlan pei. Ka lo theihter lo ih siatsuahnak na tong a si ahcun Pathian in i that seh. Ka pa hnenih Bawipa a rak um bangin na hnenah um ve hram seh."},"14":{"text":"Cun ka nun hrih a si ahcun na thukamnak thianghlim cu hmunter awla ka hrangah rintlakmi si hram aw. Asinain ka thih ahcun,"},"15":{"text":"a kumkhua in ka innsang pawl hnenah na zaangfahnak run langter hram aw. Cun Bawipa in na ral hmuahhmuah an ci a hmih thluh tik khalah,"},"16":{"text":"kan thukamnak cu ziangtik hmanah cat hlah seh. A cat asile Bawipa in nangmah a lo mawhthluk ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Jonathan in David cu a duhdawtnak thu a kam sal, ziangahtile amah le amah a duh-awk vek rori in Jonathan in David cu a duhdawt a si."},"18":{"text":"Cule Jonathan in, “Thaisun cu Thla Thar Puai a si ih na tel lo ahcun na tokham a lawng ding ih na um lo a langzet ding."},"19":{"text":"Na tel lo kha tipsun ahcun a lang sinsin ding. Curuangah kan dungih na thuh awknak hmunah khan va feh sal awla cutawkih lungkhon reprep phenah khan va relh aw."},"20":{"text":"Hmuibat bangin cutawk cu thal pathum in ka rak sai ding."},"21":{"text":"Cule thal pawl hawl dingah ka hnen-um pa ka rak thlah ding. A hnenah, ‘Thal pawl cu na umnak ihsin hi lam kap ah an um; rak lak hai aw,’ ka ti a si ahcun na hrangah phan ding zianghman a um lo, na ra suak thei, tinak a si ding. Phan ding a um lo ti cu Bawipa ih hmin in ka sim a si."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a hnenah, ‘Thal pawl cu na umnak ihsin khatlam kapah an um a si,’ ka ti ahcun rak tlan aw. Bawipa in hmun dangih feh dingah a lo duh, tinak a si."},"23":{"text":"Kan karlak ih thukamnak kan tuahmi thu ahcun kumkhua ih ka hmun ternak dingah Bawipa in a kimter ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah David cu hramlak ah a thup aw. Thla Thar Puai rawl ei-nak ah Saul siangpahrang cu a ra lut ih,"},"25":{"text":"a to ṭheunak phar kiangah a to. A sangtu ah Abner a to ih, Jonathan cu cabuai ih khatlam kap, Saul ih hmaizawn ah a to. David ih tokham cu a lawng."},"26":{"text":"Asinain cuih ni ah Saul cun zianghman a sim lo, ziangahtile, “A thianhlim lonak thil pakhatkhat a um a si ding,” tiah a ruat."},"27":{"text":"A thaisun, Thla Thar Puai hnu ni khatnak ah, David ih tokham cu a lawng thotho. Curuangah Saul in, “Ziangah so mizan sun siseh, tuihsun siseh rawl einak ih David a suah lo?” tiah Jonathan a sut."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Jonathan in, “Bethlehem ih feh dingah thungai thlak in i dil ih,"},"29":{"text":"‘Ka sungkhat pawl kan khua ah raithawinak puai an tuah ih ka u pa in tel tengteng dingah i rak cah a si; curuangah ka rual ṭha na si ahcun i thlah hram awla ka sungkhat pawl ka va tong hai ding,’ i ti. Curuangah hi rawl einak ih a tel thiam lonak a si,” tiah a sim."},"30":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Saul in a theih tikah a thin a heng tuk ih, “Nang mihlotlau, raltho le rintlaklo nunau ih fapa! Jesse ih fapa David na ṭan a si tihi fiangten ka thei zo. Na nuih thang na siatter ih nangmah ih thang khal na siat-aw a si."},"31":{"text":"David a nunsung hmuahhmuah cu hi ramih siangpahrang na si dah lo ding, ti na thei lo maw? Atu zamrangin va feh awla David cu hitawk ah va hruai aw - a thih a ṭul a si!” tiah Jonathan cu a kawk ciamco."},"32":{"text":"Cutikah Jonathan in, “Ziangah so a thih ding? Ziang so a sual?” a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in Jonathan sunthat dingin a feipi a vun lak ih a khawh.
