Cuih hnu cun a pa in David thah tengteng a tum a si, ti cu Jonathan in feltein a thei."},"34":{"text":"Cabuai ihsin Jonathan cu thinheng zetin a tho ih cuih ni Thla Thar Puai a ni hnihnak ni cu zianghman ei loin a um. A pa Saul in David cu mualpho tukih a tuah ruangah Jonathan cun a ninghanpi ngaingai."},"35":{"text":"An tiam awk cia bangtuk in a thaizing ah Jonathan cu David tong dingah hramlakah a feh. Jonathan cun tlangval note pakhat a fehpi."},"36":{"text":"A cuih tlangval pa ih hnenah, “Ka sai ding mi thal pawl hi va tlan awla va hawl aw,” tiah a ti. Tlangvalpa cu a tlan ih Jonathan in thal cu hlatpi ah a sai."},"37":{"text":"Thal a tlaknak zawn a va thlen tikah Jonathan cu na pi in a au ih, “Thal cu hlatpi ah a um a si."},"38":{"text":"Khatawkah ding men hlah. Zamrang in feh aw,” tiah a ti. Tlangvalpa cun thal cu a sar ih a bawipa ih hnenah a thlenpi."},"39":{"text":"Asinain a tican zianghman a thei lo. Jonathan le David hrangah cun tican a nei thluh."},"40":{"text":"Cule li le thal pawl cu khawsungih hei fehpi dingah Jonathan in a tlangvalpa cu a pek."},"41":{"text":"Tlangvalpa a feh hnuah a relhnak lungkhon phen ihsin David cu a tho ih leilung dai rori in voithum tiang a lu a kun. David le Jonathan cu an hnam-aw ih an ṭap veve. David ih riahsiatnak cu Jonathan ih riahsiatnak hnakin a zual sawn."},"42":{"text":"Cule Jonathan in, “Na hnenah Pathian um hram seh. Bawipa in kan pahnih karlak le na tesinfa le ka tesinfa karlak ih Bawipa ih hmin sal in thukamnak kan tuah mi cu kan hngetkhohter ringringnak dingah in bawm hram seh,” tiah David hnenah a ti. Cule David cu a feh ih Jonathan cu khawsungah a kir."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David cu Nob khua puithiam Ahimelek hnenah a feh ih Ahimelek cun thinphang zetin a rak hmuak; “Ziangah so nangmah lawng na rat? Zotal ih an lo thlun lo?” a rak ti.","title":"David A Tlan"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Siangpahrang in hnaṭuan i fial ruangah ka ra a si. Cuih i fialmi thu cu zohman sim lo dingah i tiam fawn. Ka ralkap pawl cu hmunkhat khatih i tong dingin ka tiam hai a si."},"3":{"text":"Cun ei ding ziangso na neih? Sang zawl nga a si lole na neihmi pohpoh i pe aw,” tiah a dil."},"4":{"text":"Cule puithiam cun, “Sang menmen pawl ka nei lo. Ka neih mi cu sang thianghlim a si. Na ralkap pawl in tunai hrawngah nunau an pawl lo a si ahcun nan ei thei ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Nunau an pawl hrimhrim lo. Nunau hrimhrim kan hnenah an um lo. Thupi um lem lo ih khual kan tlawn hmanah ka ralkap pawl cu, an thuamhnaw pawl thawn, thianghlim zetin an um ringring. Atu cu a hleice ih thupi mi hnaṭuan kan neih ruangah a hleice in an thianghlim a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah puithiam Ahimelek in David cu sang thianghlim a pek, ziangahtile a neihmi sang cu Pathian hrangih hunmi sang lawng a si ih cabuai thianghlim ihsin an lak zomi, a ai ah sang thar tla an ret sal zomi, sang a si."},"7":{"text":"Cule Edom mi Doeg cu Pathian biak ah cutawk ahcun a rak um ve ngelcel. Doeg cu Saul siangpahrang ih tuukhaltu pawl hotu a si."},"8":{"text":"David in Ahimelek hnenah, “Keimah pek dingah fei a si lole nam tal na nei maw? Siangpahrang in zamrangih i fial ruangah ralnam zianghman ka la man lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Ahimelek in, “Elah Rawn ih na thah mi Filistin mi Goliath ih ralnam cu ka nei. Puithiam ṭaangthlaih angki ih phenah puan in kan tuam ih a um ko. Hinah cumi lawng hriamnam a um. Na duh asile la aw,” tiah a ti. David in, “I pe aw. Khuihman ah hi bangtuk ralnam a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun David cu a feh sal. Saul ih hmuh thei lonak ah a feh ih Gath ram siangpahrang Akhish hnenah a va thleng."},"11":{"text":"Gath ramih bawi pawl cun an siangpahrang Akhish hnenah, “Hi pa hi amah ramih siangpahrang a si vemi David a si lo maw? ‘Saul in a thawng a sawm in a that ih David cun a thawng a za in a that,’ tiah nunau pawl an laam phah ih hla ih an phuah mi pa kha amah hi a si,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"An ṭong cu David in a thei thluh ih curuangah Gath siangpahrang Akhish cu David in a ṭih ngaingai."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah an zate ih hmuh ah a aa awter. An hmaiah cun a umdaan a lamdang awter ih an khua ih kotka par tla ah thuphan pipi a ngan ih, a cil tla cu a khahmul parah a luang thluahthlo."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Akhish in a kuthnuai bawi pawl hnenah, “Hi pa hi a aa a sisi. Ziangah so ka hnenah nan ratpi?"},"15":{"text":"Miaa ka hlawhsam ah maw si nan ruat? Ka inn sung hnaihnoktu dingah ziangah so hi miaa pa hi nan rak hruai?” tiah a ti."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gath khua ihsin David a tlan sal ih Adullam khua kiangih a um mi lungkua ah a thleng. Cutawkah a um ti kha a unau pawl le a sungkhat pawl in an theih tikah a hnenah an va feh.","title":"Puithiam Pawl An That"},"2":{"text":"Hremnak a tuarmi le leiba a neimi le lungkim lonak a neimi hmuahhmuah tla cu a hnenah an va feh ih anmah pawl hotu ah a cang. An zatein minung zali hrawng an si."},"3":{"text":"Cun David cu Moab ram, Mizpah khua ah a va feh ih Moab siangpahrang hnenah, “Pathian in ka hrangih a tumtahnak fiangteih ka theih hlan lo cu na hnenah hin ka nu le ka pa ra um thei hram hai sehla tiah zaangfah ka lo dil,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah David in a nu le a pa cu Moab siangpahrang hnenah a taan ih lungkua ih a relh sung hmuahhmuah Moab siangpahrang hnenah cun an um."},"5":{"text":"Cule profet Gad cu David hnenah a ra ih, “Hitawk hmunah um nawn hlah. Zamrang in Judah ramah feh aw,” tiah a ra ti. Curuangah David cu Hereth tupi sungah a feh."},"6":{"text":"Saul cu Gibeah khua ah a um ih ni khat cu a feipi kengin tlang parih tuumkung hnuai ah a to. A kuthnuai ih bawi pawl in an kil ṭhepṭhep. Cule David le a milai pawl umnak kan thei, tiah Saul cu an ra sim."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in a kuthnuai bawi pawl hnenah, “Benjamin mi pawl, i ngai uh! David in lo le sabit hmuan in pe ding ih a ralkap sungah thawngkhat hotu le zakhat hotu ralbawi ah in tuah thluh ding, tiah nan ruat maw si?"},"8":{"text":"A cuih ruangah maw siatsuah dingah in phiar ciamco? Ka fapa rori David hnenih a ṭan ih thukamnak a tuah tla zohman in in sim lo. Zohman in in ninghanpi hrimhrim lo. Ka sungsuak ka fapa rori in a forh ruangah ka minung a si mi David in atu-ah keimah thah theinak tikcu lawnglawng a hawl ti tla zohman in in sim dah lo,” tiah a hrang ciamco."},"9":{"text":"Saul ih kuthnuai bawi pawl hnenah Edom mi Doeg a rak ding ve ih anih in, “Nob khua ih a ummi Ahitub ih fapa Ahimelek hnenih David a feh ka hmu."},"10":{"text":"David hrangah Ahimelek in Bawipa ih hnenah thla a cam ih rawl tla a pek ih Filistin mi Goliath ih ralnam khal a pek a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Saul siangpahrang in puithiam Ahimelek le Nob khua ih puithiam a ṭuan ve mi a sungkhat pawl hmuahhmuah cu a ko ih a hnenah cun an ra."},"12":{"text":"Cule Saul cun, “Ahitub ih fapa Ahimelek ka thusimmi hi ngaihnik!” tiah a ti. Ahimelek in, “Ka lo ngai a si, bawipa,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule Saul in, “Ziangah so David le nangmah in kei hi in phiar rero? Ziangah so David cu rawl le ralnam na pek ih Pathian hnenih thla na cam sak? Atu-ah David cu keimah i ral ih tikcu ṭha lawng a bawh a si,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Ahimelek in, “Na kuthnuai ih bawi hmuahhmuah lakah David bangtuk rintlak zoso a um? Na maakpa rori a si, nangmah a lo kilvengtu ralkap pawl ih bawi a si; cun na kuthnuai mi hmuahhmuah in an upat thluh a si."},"15":{"text":"A hrangih thla ka cam cu atu hi a hmaisa bik a si lemlo. Asinain nangmah siatsuah dingih phiar thu ahcun keimah siseh, ka sungkhat siseh in puh hrimhrim hlah. Hi thu cu samphang tia hman ka theih mi a um lo,” tiah a sawn."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in, “Ahimelek, nangmah le na sungkhat pawl cu ka lo that ṭheh ding,” a ti ih,"},"17":{"text":"a kiangih a dingmi ralkap pawl hnenah, “ Bawipa ih puithiam pawl hi that ṭheh uh. David thawn in phiar ih David a tlan zo ti khal an thei ringring naón in sim duh lo a si,” tiah thu a pek. Asinain Pathian ih puithiam pawl thah ding cu an duh loih ralkap pawl cu an kut hman an hawi duh lo."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah Saul in Doeg cu, “Nangmah in puithiam pawl hi that ṭheh aw,” tiah a fial ih, a fial vekin Doeg cun a that ṭheh. Cuih ni ah Bawipa Pathian ih puithiam pawl sawmriat le panga a that a si."},"19":{"text":"Cuih tlunah puithiam khua an ti ṭheu mi Nob khawsungih a um mi minung hmuahhmuah khal thatthluh dingin Saul in thu a pek ruangah mipa siseh, nunau siseh, nauhak siseh, naute suakpek siseh, caw, laak le tuu pawl tiangin an that thluh a si."},"20":{"text":"Asinain Ahimelek ih fapa pawl sungah Abiathar an timi pa cu a luat ih David hnenah a tlan suak."},"21":{"text":"Pathian ih puithiam pawl cu Saul in a that thluh a si, tiah David cu a va sim."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Nikhat ih Doeg ka hmuh tikah khan Saul a va sim tengteng ding, tiah ka zum tho a si. Curuangah Abiathar, na sungkhat pawl an thih thluh cu keimah ih ruangah a si."},"23":{"text":"Ka hnenah hin um awla na thinphang hlah aw. Nangmah le keimah thah ding cu Saul ih duhbikmi a si. Asinain ka hnenah cun na him ko ding,” tiah Abiathar cu a ti."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Filistin pawl in Keilah khua an siim ih an khawm tharmi thlai rawl tla an ru ciamco, tikha David in a thei.","title":"David In Keilah Khua A Run"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa Pathian hnenah, “Filistin pawl ka va do pei maw?” tiah a sut. Cutikah, “Do awla Keilah khua cu runsuak aw,” tiah Bawipa in a ti."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a milai pawl in David hnenah, “Judah ram sungah phan ding tampi kan nei sikhawh, Keilah khua ah feh tahratin Filistin pawl kan do asile kan harsa sinsin ding,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah David in Bawipa cu a ron sal ih Bawipa in, “Keilah ah Filistin pawl cu va do aw; ziangahtile na neh hai ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah David le a ralkap pawl cu Keilah ah an feh ih Filistin pawl an do. Filistin pawl cu tampi an thi ih an ṭilva pawl tla tampi an long. Cuticun Keilah khua cu David in a runsuak a si."},"6":{"text":"Ahimelek ih fapa Abiathar cu a tlan ih David hnenih a thlen tikah puithiam kor ṭaangthlaih a keng."},"7":{"text":"Cule Keilah khua ah David a thleng tikha Saul an sim tikah Saul cun, “Tlakrawh ih kulhmi, kotkalh le hauhruang ih kulhmi khua ah David a thleng zo ih amah le amah a kharhkhum-aw zo. Bawipa in ka kut sungah a ret zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Saul in Keilah khua do dingah le David le a ralkap pawl kai dingah a ralkap pawl cu a ko thluh."},"9":{"text":"Saul in i do tum a si, tikha David in a theih tikah, “Puithiam kor ṭaangthlaih cu rak keng aw,” tiah puithiam Abiathar cu a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule David in, “Maw Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, na salpa keimah ruangah hin Saul cu Keilah ah a ra ding ih a siatsuah thluh ding, tiah ka thei."},"11":{"text":"Keilah khawsungmi pawl hin Saul ih kutah in pe pei maw? Ka theih vekin Saul cu a ra ngaingai pei maw? Maw Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, ka lo suhmi hi i let hramhram aw,” tiah a dil. “Saul cu a ra tengteng ding,” tiah Bawipa in a run let."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Keilah khawsungmi pawl hin Saul ih kutah keimah le ka milai pawl hi in pe ding maw?” tiah a sut. “An lo pe ding” tiah Bawipa in a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah David le a ralkap zaruk tluk cu Keilah khua ihsin zamrangin an suak ih an tlan. David a tlan zo ti kha Saul in a theih tikah a tumtahmi cu a ṭul sal."},"14":{"text":"David cu a relh ih Zif khua kiang hramlak ah a um. Saul in a sun a zan in David cu a hawl naón Saul kutsungih thlen ding cu Pathian in a siang lo.","title":"Hramlakah David A Um"},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Saul in a thah lawnglawng a tum ruangah David cu a thin a phang thotho. Zif khua kiang thlaler ramṭhing ih Horesh an timi hmunih David a um laiah,"},"16":{"text":"Jonathan cu a hnenah a va feh ih Bawipa ih hmin in thinnau lo dingah tha a pek."},"17":{"text":"David hnenah cun, “Na thinphang hlah. Ka pa Saul in a lo that thei hrimhrim lo ding. Israel siangpahrang na si leh ko ding ih keimah khal nangmah sangtu ka si ko ding. Cumi cu ka pa in a thei thluh ko,” tiah Jonathan in a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun rualpi ṭha an sinak cu Pathian hmaiah thu an kam-aw sal. David cu Horesh ah a um ih Jonathan cu inn ah a tlung."},"19":{"text":"Zif khuami hrekkhat cu Gibeah khua ah Saul hnenah an va feh ih, “David cu kan ram sungah a um ih Judea ramṭhing thlanglam kap, Hakhilah tlang, Horesh timi hmunah a relh a si."},"20":{"text":"Maw siangpahrang bawipa, David kaihsuak ding cu ziangtlukin so na duh ti khal kan thei thluh ko. Curuangah kan ramah ra awla na kaihsuak theinak dingin kan ngaihtuah ding,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “Hi tlukih ka zawn in ruah ruangah Pathian in lo thluasuah hram seh."},"22":{"text":"Va feh uhla khuitawk fangah so a um ih zo in so a hmu ti tla va hliah ṭha uh. David cu mi depdezet a si tiah ka thei a si."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah a relhnak hmun rori va hawlsuak uhla pelh loin ka hnenah i ra sim sal uh. Cule nan hnenah ka feh pei ih Judah ram pumpi ka hawl a ṭul khalle cuih ram hrawngih a um hrih a si ahcun ka hawlsuak rori ding,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah an pok ih Saul thlen hlanah Zif khua ah an kir. David le a milai pawl cu Judea hramlak thlanglam kap ramṭhing ah Maon an timi hramlak ah an um."},"25":{"text":"Cule Saul le a ralkap pawl cu David hawl dingah an pok. Cuih thu cu David in a rak theih tikah Maon hramlak sungih lungto hlir in a khatmi horkuam ah a feh ih cutawkah a um. A cuih thu cu Saul in a theih ve tikah David cu a hei dawi."},"26":{"text":"Lungto horkuam ih khatlam tlang ah Saul le a ralkap pawl cu an va thleng ih David le a milai pawl cu a khatlam tlang ah an um. David le a milai pawl cu kaih ding phangin an tlan ih Saul le a ralkap pawl in an dawi vivo ih an kai zik thlang."},"27":{"text":"A culaifang ah mi pakhat Saul hnenah a ra ih, “Zamrang in rakir aw. Filistin mi pawl in kan ram in do a si,” tiah a ra sim."},"28":{"text":"Curuangah Saul in David cu dawi nawn loin Filistin pawl do dingah a kir. Curuangah a cuih hmun cu Sela Hammah-lekoth tiah an tita."},"29":{"text":"David cu cutawkin a feh ih En-gedi an timi hmunah lungkua-ah a relh."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Filistin a donak ihsin Saul a rakir tikah David cu En-gedi kiang ramcaar lakah a relh a si, tiah an rak sim.","title":"David In Saul Ih Nunnak A Zuah"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in Israel ram ralkap lakih a ṭhabik mi thawngthum thawn David le a milai pawl cu Zaathar Khaam an timi hmun ihsin nisuahnak lamah an va hawl."},"3":{"text":"Cutawk lamzin kiangah tuu hruang an um ih a cuih kiangah cun lungpuk pakhat a um. A cuih lungpuk sung deng bikah David le a milai pawl cu an rak thup aw. Saul cu cutawk lungpuk a thlen tikah pawngthawh dingin lungpuk sungah a vung lut."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah David cu a milai pawl in, “Tikcu remcaangzet na ngah a si. Na ral cu na kut sungah ka lo pe ding, tiah Bawipa in a lo ti bangtuk in a lo pe ngaingai a si ih a parah na duh vekin na tuah thei,” tiah an ti. Cule David cu a thupte in a vak ih Saul ih theih loin a kor fualpi ih zimte a tansak."},"5":{"text":"Asinain Saul puanzim cutiih a tansak ruangah David cu a thin a nuam lo zet ih,"},"6":{"text":"a milai pawl hnenah, “Pathian in siangpahrang ih a hrilmi ka bawipa cu ka tuahmawh lonak dingah Bawipa Pathian in i kil hram seh. Pathian ih hrilmi siangpahrang a si ruangah amah cu ka siatsuah hrimhrim lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule David in a milai pawl cu Saul that lo dingin a sim. Saul cu a tho ih lungpuk sung ihsin a suak ih a feh."},"8":{"text":"Cule David cun a hei thlun ih, “Maw siangpahrang,” tiah a hei ko. Saul cu a dunglet a ra hoi ih cutikah David cu upatnak thawn leilung ah a bok ih,"},"9":{"text":"“Bawipa, David in a lo that tum a si, tiah a lo simtu pawl ih thu cu ziangah so na zum?"},"10":{"text":"Tuih sunah lungpuk sungah nangmah cu Bawipa Pathian in ka kut sungah a lo thlenter ti cu na mit rori in na hmu ko a si. Mi hrekkhat pawl cun nangmah that dingah in forh, asinain ka lo zaangfah ih Pathian ih hrilmi siangpahrang na si ruangah malte hman ka tuahmawh lo ding, tiah ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Zohhnik, ka bawipa, na korfual zimte ka kenmi hi! Keimah rori ih ka tanmi a si. Asinain ka lo that lo. Himi na hmuh tikah hin nangmah do dingah le siatsuah dingah tummi ka nei lo, ti hi theifiang ding na si. Nang cun that dingah i hawl rero naón kei cun zianghman ka lo ti dah lo."},"12":{"text":"Zo sawn kan mawh ti cu Bawipa Pathian in run rel hram seh. Nangmah cu malte hman ka lo tuahmawh lo ih nang cun i ral ruangah Pathian in lo cawh hram seh."},"13":{"text":"‘Thil ṭha lo cu mi ṭha lo pawl in an tuah,’ ti ih ṭongṭhimnak cu na thei ko. Sikhalsehla kei cun ka lo tuahmawh hrimhrim lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Cule Israel siangpahrang ih thah a tum rero mi hi zohhnik! A dawi vivo mi hi zohhnik! Uico ruak tluk fang a si. Uihli tluk fang a si."},"15":{"text":"Zo sawn kan mawh ti kha Bawipa Pathian in in zoh ding ih in relsak ding. Hi thuhla cu Bawipa in in tawlrel sak seh; i ṭan sehla i run hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutiih David in thu a sim ṭheh tikah Saul in, “Ka fapa David na si ngaingai maw?” a ti ih a ṭap."},"17":{"text":"Cule Saul in David hnenah, “Nangmah na dik ih keimah ka sual a si. Ka parah na ṭhazet naón kei cu na parah ka sia ngaingai."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian in na kut sungah i ret naón i thah lo ruangah ka parah ziangtlukinso miṭha na si ti cu tuihsun ah na langter zo."},"19":{"text":"Zo inso a ral khi a kaih hnuah himte in a thlah sal dah? Ka parih tuihsun ih na tuahmi ruangah hin Pathian in lo thluasuah hram seh."},"20":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang na si ding ih Israel ram na uknak cu a cat lo ding, ti cu atu ihsin fiangtein ka thei zo a si."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka hmin le ka innsang hmin cu hlo lo dingah, ‘Na tesinfa pawl cu ka zuah hai ding,’ tiah Bawipa ih hmin in thu i kam aw,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"A ti bangin David cun thu a kam. Cun Saul cu a inn ah a tlung ih David le a milai pawl cu an relhnak hmunah an kir."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel cu a thi ih Israel mi hmuahhmuah an ra ih an ṭah. Cun Ramah khua ih a innah an phum. Cuih hnuah David cu Paran ram thlaler ramcaar ah a feh.","title":"Samuel A Thi"},"2":{"text":"Cun Maon khua ah Kaleb miphun Nabal an ti mi pa a um ih Karmel khua ah leiram tla a nei. Milian zet a si ih tuu thawngthum le me thawngkhat a nei."},"3":{"text":"A nupi ih hmin cu Abigail a si. Abigail cu a mawizet ih a fimzet fawn; a sinan a pasal Nabal cu mi thinlung ṭha lo le hawizawng lo a si. Voikhat ah Nabal cu Karmel khua ah a tuu pawl ih hmul a met."},"4":{"text":"Ramṭhing ih a umnak ihsin a cuih thu cu David in a thei."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah a milai pahra tla cu Karmel khua feh dingah le Nabal tong dingah a thlah."},"6":{"text":"Hitiin thu a cah, “Nangmah le na innsang le na neihmi hmuahhmuah parah thluasuah vanluhnak um ko seh, tiah David in thlaza a lo cam a si."},"7":{"text":"Karmel khua ah na tuu pawl ih hmul na met, tihi David in a thei. Cun na tuukhal pawl cu kanmah hnenah an um ringring ih pakhat hman kan tuahmawh dah lonak thu tla hi na theih dingah a duhzet. Karmel khua ih an um sung hmuahhmuah ah an thil neihmi zianghman a hlo dah lo."},"8":{"text":"Anmah tla hi sut awla an lo simfiang ko ding. Cun Karmel khua ah puai ni ah kan ra ding ih David in a milai pawl ṭhate-ih na rak zohṭhat dingah a lo dil a si. Curuangah na rual ṭha David hrangah le na sal pawl kanmah hrangah na pek thei zatzat in pe hram aw, nan ti pei,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"David ih thucahmi cu Nabal hnenah David ih milai pawl cun an va sim. Cule an hngak.","title":"David Le Abigail"},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Nabal in, “David cu zoso a si? Jesse fapa cu zoso a si? Ka theih dahmi a si ual lo. Tuihsan cu kan ramah hin a tlanhlomi sal an tampi."},"11":{"text":"Ka sang le ka tidai le ka tuuhmul mettu pawl hrangih ka thahmi ṭilva sa pawl cu khuitawkin so an rat ti hman ka theih lomi hnenah cun ziangah so ka pek ding?” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"David ih milai pawl cu zamrangin an kir ih David hnenah Nabal ih ṭongmi cu an sim."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Nan zatein nan ralnam pai ṭheh uh,” a ti ih an pai ṭheh. Amah David khal in a ralnam a pai ih a milai zali thawn an feh. A milai zahnih in an thilri an run kil."},"14":{"text":"Nabal ih hnen-um pakhat pa in Nabal ih nupi Abigail hnenah, “Na thei zo maw? David in hramlak a umnak ihsin kan bawipa hnenah mi a rak thlah ih thil malte ṭhen dingah zaangfah an ra dil. Asinain kan bawipa in a rak kawk ciammam."},"15":{"text":"A ngaingai ti ahcun, annih cu kan parah an ṭhazet a si. Ziangtik hmanah in hmuhsuam dah lo. Hramlak an hnenih kan um sung hmuahhmuah ah kan thil zianghman a hlo dah lo."},"16":{"text":"Anmah thawn kan um sungah kan tuu pawl tla cu ṭhatein an kilkhawi ih a sun a zan in kanmah tla in hum a si."},"17":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah hih thu hi ziangti tuah ding a si ti ruat ṭha aw. Kan bawipa le a innsang hrangah a poimawhzet theimi thu a si. Amah kan bawipa cu mi thinlung ṭha lozet a si ih zo ih thu hman a ngai duh fawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cuvete in Abigail in sang zawl zahnih le sabit savun thawl hnih, a pum ih kio mi tuu panga, vaikan bawm hnih, caar ciami sabit rah bawr zakhat le caar ciami theirah hlom zahnih pawl cu zamrangte in a khawm ih laak pawl a phurhter."},"19":{"text":"Cule a hnen-um pawl hnenah, “Hmaiah rak feh uhla ka lo thlun ding,” tiah a ti. Asinain a pasal hnenah cun zianghman a sim lo."},"20":{"text":"Abigail cu a laak parah a to ih tlangmual ih lamzin a kelnak zawn a thlen fangah rin lopi in David le a ralkap pawl amah lamih a ra mi thawn an tong aw."},"21":{"text":"A culaifang ah David cun a thinlungte in, “Ziangah so hi hramlak ahhin Nabal ih neihmi pawl cu ka rak kil sak ngelcel? A thil pakhat hman a hlo dah lo, asinain hitluk ih ka bomnak parih i lehrulh daan cu a mawi lozet a si."},"22":{"text":"Thaizing ah an sungkurun in pakhat hman taang loin ka thah thluh lo asile Pathian in keimah i that sawn seh,” tiah a ruat."},"23":{"text":"David a hmuh vete in Abigail cu a laak parih sin a ṭum ih leilung ah David ih kehram ah a bok ih,"},"24":{"text":"“Bawipa ka ṭong i ngai hram aw. Mawhthluknak cu keimah in ka tuar ko pei."},"25":{"text":"Zianghman ih ṭhahnem lo pa Nabal ih thu cu zianghman ah siar hram hlah aw. Anih cu a hmin Nabal a si vek cekci in hawizawng lo a si. Bawipa, mi na rak thlahmi pawl cu kei cun ka rak tong hai lo."},"26":{"text":"Na ral pawl ih parah phulaknak zianghman tuah lo le na ral pawl that loih na um thei ṭheunak cu Bawipa Pathian in a lo kilkhawi ruangah a si. Cun na ral pawl le nangmah siatsuah a lo duhtu pawl cu Nabal bangin hrem an si ding, tiah a nungmi Bawipa ih hmin in atu-ah ka kam-aw ngam a si."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah bawipa, ka rak lo kenmi laksawng hi zaangfahte in i sang hram awla na milai pawl tla pe hram aw."},"28":{"text":"Ka tisualmi a um pang khalle i ngaithiam hram aw. Na nun sung hmuahhmuah ah thilṭha lo cu na tuah lo ding ih, Bawipa ih ral pawl tla na do vivo ruangah, Pathian amah in siangpahrang ah a lo tuah ding ih na tesinfa pawl khal siangpahrang ah a tuah hai ding a si."},"29":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat in an lo do ih a thah an lo tum khalle milai in an sumsaw an kil ṭheu vekin Bawipa na Pathian in himte in a lo kilkhawi ding. Sikhalsehla mi pakhat in saihlum cu hlo ko ih a sai ṭheu vekin na ral pawl cu Bawipa Pathian in a lo hlonsak ding a si."},"30":{"text":"Cun a lo kam cia bangtuk in Bawipa Pathian in na parih a ṭha mi thil hmuahhmuah kimteih a thlenter tikah le Israel siangpahrang ih a lo tuah tikah,"},"31":{"text":"thuhla zianghman um loih mi thah le phulak ruangah riahsiat ding le sir awk ding cu, maw bawipa, zianghman na nei lo ding. Cuti ih Bawipa Pathian in a lo thluasuah tikah, bawipa, kei hi i hngilh hram hlah aw,” tiah Abigail in a rak tlon."},"32":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Keimah tong dingih tuihsun ah a lo thlahtu Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cu thangṭhat si ko seh."},"33":{"text":"Laithahnak le phulaknak ihsin i luattertu dingih tuihsun ih thil na tuahmi le thinlung na neihmi ruangah Pathian cu ka lawm ih ka thangṭhat a si."},"34":{"text":"Nangmah tuahmawh loih i kilvengtu cu Bawipa a si. Zamrang in i ra tong hlah cila thaizing ahcun Nabal le a sungte pawl cu nan ci lo hmit thluh dingin a nungmi Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian hmin in thu ka rak kam-aw a si,” tiah Abigail cu a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cule Abigail ih rak kenmi thil pawl cu David in a sang ih, “Na inn ah va tlung awla va helhkam nawn hlah. I dilmi cu ka tuah thluh ding a si,” tiah Abigail cu a ti."},"36":{"text":"Abigail cu inn ah a tlung. A pasal Nabal cu a inn ah siangpahrang ei ding tlak ih a thawmi rawl mankhung khung suangin rawl donak puai a rak tuah laifang a si. A pasal cu zu a ri ih nuam zetin a um laifang a si ruangah Abigail in a thaizing tiang ziangthu hman a sim lo."},"37":{"text":"Cule a fimharh hnuah thuhla cu kimten a ruah. Cumi a theih vete in Nabal cu a thin a thir dukdi ih a lungphu a cawl ih a zengta."},"38":{"text":"Nihra hnuah Bawipa in a run bet ih Nabal cu a thi."},"39":{"text":"Nabal a thih cu David in a theih tikah, “Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh. Nabal in i hmuhsuam ruangah a parah Bawipa in phu a lak ih kei a salpa hi thil ṭha lo tuahnak ihsin i luatter. Nabal cu miṭha lo a si ruangah Bawipa in a cawh zo a si,” tiah a ti. Cule Abigail va bia dingah David in mi a thlah."},"40":{"text":"A hnen-um pawl cu Karmel ah Abigail hnenah cun an va feh ih, “David in a nupi dingih hruai dingah na hnenah in thlah a si,” tiah an va ti."},"41":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Abigail cu a lu a kun ih, “Keimah cu a salnu ka si ko ih a sal pawl ih ke kholhtu ding lawng ka si,” a ti."},"42":{"text":"Cule a tho lohli ih a laak parah a to. A hnen-um nunau panga in an thlun ih David ih hnen-um pawl thawn an feh. Cule Abigail cu David ih nupi ah a cang."},"43":{"text":"Jezreel khuami Ahinoam cu David in a rak ṭhi zo ih cuticun an pahnih in a nupi ah an cang."},"44":{"text":"Cule David ih a ṭhitmi Saul ih fanu Mikhal cu a pa Saul in pasal dang a neihter. A pasal ih hmin cu Gallim khua mi Laish ih fapa Palti a si."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gibeah khua Saul hnenah Zif khuami hrekkhat an ra ih Judea ramṭhing kiangih tlang pakhat Hakhilah tlang ah David cu a relh a si, tiah an ra sim.","title":"David In Saul Ih Nunnak A Zuah Lala"},"2":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Saul cu Israel ralkap lakih a ṭhabik ralkap thawngthum thawn Zif ih ramlak ahcun David hawl dingin an feh."},"3":{"text":"Hakhilah tlang kainak lamzin ah Saul cu a riak. Cuih hramlak ahcun David cu a rak um lai ih amah hawl ah Saul a ra ti a theih tikah,"},"4":{"text":"David cun thlingthlatu a thlah ih Saul cu a um ngaingai ti a thei."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah David cu a feh ih Saul le Saul ralkap pawl uktu Ner ih fapa Abner ih ihnak hmun rori kha feltein a zohhliah. Saul cu an riahnak laifang bikah a it ih a ralkap pawl cu a kimvel ah an riak."},"6":{"text":"Cule David in, “Keimah thawn Saul riahnak ah zoso a feh ding?” tiah Hit mi Ahimelek le Joab ih unau Zeruiah ih fapa Abishai cu a sut. “Keimah ka feh ding,” tiah Abishai in a ti."},"7":{"text":"A cuih zanah David le Abishai cu Saul ih riahnak ah an feh ih an riahnak laifangih Saul a ih kha an hmu. A lu kiangah a feipi tla leilung ih a phun-awk kha an hmu. Saul ih kiangkap ahcun Abner le a ralkap pawl tla an it that thluh."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Abishai in, “Tuihzan ah Pathian in na ral cu na kut sungah a lo pek. Amah ih feipi lala hin tlang koin ka vun sun pei. Voikhat sun a tawk ko ding, voihnih a ṭul hrimhrim lo ding,” tiah David cu a ti."},"9":{"text":"Asinain David in, “Tuahmawh hrimhrim hlah aw. Bawipa ih hriak a culh ciami siangpahrang a tuahmawhtu pohpoh cu hremnak tuar loin an luat lo ding."},"10":{"text":"Amah ih thih caan kimih thi dingin, a si lo talle raldonak ih thi dingin Bawipa in Saul cu a nunnak a cemter ko ding, ti cu a nungmi Bawipa ih hmin sal in ka sim ngam a si."},"11":{"text":"Pathian in siangpahrang ih a canter mi tuahmawh ding cu Bawipa Pathian in i siang hram hlah seh. A feipi le a tithawl lak uhsila feh uhsi,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule David cun Saul lukiang rori ih a ummi feipi le tithawl cu a lak ih Abishai thawn an feh. Zohman in an hmu loih an thei fawn lo. A ṭhanghoi khal an um lo. Ziangahtile Bawipa in an zatein ihhmuh thawzetin a ihthatter hai a si."},"13":{"text":"Cun David cu hlat nawn a feh ih khatlam ral tlangpar a thlen tikah,"},"14":{"text":"“Maw Abner! I thei thei maw?” tiah Abner le Saul ih ralkap pawl cu a auh ciamco. “Cutiih siangpahrang a auh ciamcotu cu zoso a si?” tiah Abner in a sut."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Pacang na si, a si lo maw? Israel mi lakah mi nasa bik na si lo maw? Asinain ziangah so siangpahrang na bawipa cu ṭhatein na kil lo? Na bawipa that dingah tupekte ah nan riahnak sungah mi an lut."},"16":{"text":"Abner, na ṭuanvo na ṭhelh a si! A nungmi Bawipa ih hmin salin ka lo sim: thitlak na si; nan zatein thih tlak nan si. Ziangahtile Bawipa Pathian in siangpahrang ih a cantermi nan bawipa cu ṭhatein nan kil lo. Zohhnik! Khuiah so siangpahrang ih feipi a um? A lu kiangih tithawl teh khuiah so a si?” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"David ih aw cu Saul cun a theithiam ih, “David ka fapa, nangmah maw na si?” a ti. Cutikah David in, “Maw siangpahrang, keimah sokhaw ka si."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa, ziangah so kei na salpa hi i dawi lai rero? Ziang bangtuk sualnak ka tuah ruangah so hiti ih in hual rero?"},"19":{"text":"Maw bawipa, ka thusim mi hi rak ngaihnik aw. Hitiih i ral hi Bawipa Pathian ih a lo fial ruangah a si ahcun thawinak pe sehla a lung a ṭhum men ding. Asinain minung forhfialnak ruangah a si ahcun Bawipa ih siatserhnak an parah thleng hram seh. Ziangahtile ramdang khawzing tiang be dingah in dawihlo ih Bawipa in a miphun hnenih a pekmi ram sungih kei ka covo hmuahhmuah cu ka sung thluh zo a si."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian a um lonak, miphun dang pawl ih ram sungah ka thisen luangter hram hlah. Uihli tluk fang a si mi kei hi nang Israel siangpahrang in ziangah so thah i tum rero? Hramlak vate an peel bangin ziangah so i peel rero?” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “Ka sual zo a si. David ka fapa, rakir sal aw. Tuihsun ih ka nunnak i zuah ruangah nangmah siatsuah ding cu ka tum nawn hrimhrim lo ding. Ka aa tuk lawmmam! Thil ka ti sual zo a si,” tiah David hnenah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cule David in, “Maw siangpahrang, na feipi cu hinah a um. Na milai pakhatkhat rak thlah awla ra la seh."},"23":{"text":"Midik le rinsan tlak minung cu Bawipa in an ṭhat man a pek a si. Nangmah cu tuihsun ah Bawipa in ka kut sungah a lo ret a si. Sikhalsehla Bawipa ih hriak culhmi na si ruangah zianghman ka lo ti lo."},"24":{"text":"Na nunnak ka sunloih ih tuihsun ih ka lo zuah vekin Bawipa in ka nunnak cu sunloih in i zuah ve hramsehla, zonzaih harsatnak in i luatter hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “Pathian in lo thluasuah hram seh, ka fapa. Thil nasa zetzet na tuah pei ih na tuahmi kipah na hlawh a tling ding,” tiah a ti. Cuih hnuah David cu a feh ih Saul cu inn ah a tlung. S"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David cu a thinlungte in, “Nikhat khatah Saul in i that leh ko ding. Ka hrangih a ṭha bik cu Filistin ramih tlanhlo a si. Cutiih ka tlanhlo ahcun Israel ram sungah Saul in i hawl nawn lo dingih ka him ding,” tiah a ruat.","title":"Filistin Hnenah David A Thleng"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah David le a ralkap zaruk cu zamrangte in Gath siangpahrang Akhish, Ma-ok ih fapa, hnenah an feh."},"3":{"text":"David le a ralkap pawl cu an innsang pawl thawn Gath ram ahcun an um. David cu nupi pahnih a nei: Jezreel khuami Ahinoam le Karmel khuami Nabal ih thihsan mi Abigail an si."},"4":{"text":"David cu Gath ramah a tlan zo ti Saul in a theih tikah David hawl ding cu a tum nawn lo."},"5":{"text":"Cun David in Akhish hnenah, “Na rualpi ngaingai ih i ruat a si ahcun ka umnak hrangah khua pakhat i pe ve aw. Siangpahrang nangmah thawn na khawpi sungih umtlang hi a mawi lem lo,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Akhish in David cu Ziklag an timi khua a pek. A cuihsan thokin Ziklag khua cu Judah siangpahrang ih ta a si ringring."},"7":{"text":"Filistin ramah David cu kum khat le thlali a um."},"8":{"text":"David le a milai pawl in a cuih ram sungih kum reipi a rak um zo mi Geshur mi, Girzi mi le Amalek mi pawl cu an do ṭheu. Izipt ram thleng tiangin an siim hai ṭheu ih,"},"9":{"text":"nunau siseh, mipa siseh, an that thluh ṭheu. Cun an tuu, an caw, an laak le an kalauk pawl an lak ih an hnipuan tiangin an long thluh. Cule Akhish hnenih a thlen sal tikah,"},"10":{"text":"Akhish cun, “Tuihṭum khui ram so na siim?” tiih a suh tikah David cun, Judah ram thlanglam kapah ka feh, a ti tawk; a si lole Jerahmeel miphun ramah ka feh, a ti tawk; a si lole Ken mi pawl umnak ramah ka feh, a ti tawk a si ṭheu."},"11":{"text":"David in nunau siseh, mipa siseh a that thluh ṭheu ih Gath ramah feh tahratin David le a ralkap pawl ih thil tuahmi va simtu dingah milai an um ṭheu lo. Filistin ramih a um sung hmuahhmuah David in cubangtuk in a tuah ṭheu."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Akhish in, David cu a zumzet ruangah a thinlungte in, “Amah ih milai Israel mi pawl in an huat tuk ruangah a nunsung hmuahhmuah ka hnaṭuan in a um ko ding,” tiah a ruat."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tikcu a hung rei deuh tikah Filistin pawl cu Israel do dingah an ralkap pawl an khawm ciamco. Cutikah David cu Akhish in, “Nang le na ralkap pawl cu kan hnenah ṭangin Israel nan do ding a si lo maw?” tiah a sut."},"2":{"text":"David in, “Si e; na salpa ka si ih ka thil titheizia na zoh pei cu,” a ti. Cutikah Akhish in, “A ṭha! Kumkhua keimah kiltu ah ka lo tuah ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Samuel cu a thi zo ih Israel mi hmuahhmuah in an ṭah ih amah ih khua Ramah ah an phum. Israel ramsung ihsin kutṭial zohthiam le pol hmuahhmuah cu Saul siangpahrang in a dawitlan thluh.","title":"Saul In Tinzohtu A Leng"},"4":{"text":"Filistin ralkap pawl cu an khawm-aw ih Shunem khua kiangah an riak. Israel ralkap pawl cu Saul in a kokhawm ih Gilboa tlang parah an riak."},"5":{"text":"Saul in Filistin ralkap pawl a hmuh tikah a thin a phang ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Saul in Bawipa thu a ron. Asinain Bawipa in mang in siseh, Urim le Thummim zohnakin siseh, profet in siseh thu a let hrimhrim lo."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in a kuthnuai bawi pawl cu, “Tin ka len theinak dingah nunau pakhat, pol a si mi ka hrangah hawl uh,” tiah thu a pek. “Endor khua ah pakhat a um,” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Saul cu midang ah a tuah-aw ih hnipuan phundang a hruk ih, a milai pahnih thawn a cuih nunau nu hnenah cun khawthim hnuah an feh. Cule Saul in, “Na khuavang i kawh sak awla hmailam ah ziang a cang ding ti i suh sak aw. A hmin ka lo sim mi mithi pa i kawh sak aw,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Asinain nunau nu cun, “Israel ramsung ihsin Saul siangpahrang in kutṭial zohthiam pawl le pol hmuahhmuah a dawi thluh a si ti cu na thei ko. Ziangah so pol ka sinak hi thei hai sehla that hai seh tiih a bum i tum?” tiah a rak ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in thukamnak a tuah ih, “A nungmi Bawipa ih hmin sal in ka lo kam: hih mithi kawh ruangah cun an lo that hrimhrim lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule nunau nu cun, “Zoso ka lo kawh sak ding?” tiah a sut. “Samuel ko aw,” tiah Saul in a ti."},"12":{"text":"Nunau nu cun Samuel a hmuh tikah a raak ciamco. “Ziangah so i bum? Saul siangpahrang na sisi!” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Saul in, “ṭihhlahaw. Ziang so na hmuh?” tiah a sut. Nunau nu in, “Leilung sung ihsin mithi thlarau pakhat a hung suah ka hmu,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"“Ziangvek so a si?” tiah Saul in a sut. “A hung suakmi cu patar pa a si. Kor fualpi a hruk,” tiah nunau nu cun a ti. Cutikah Samuel a si ti kha Saul cun a thei ih upatnak in leilung ah a kun."},"15":{"text":"Cule Samuel in Saul cu, “Ziangah so i hnaihnok? Ziangah so i kir ter sal?” tiah a sut. Saul in, “Ka van a sang ngaingai a si. Filistin mi pawl in in do ih Pathian in i dungtun zo. Ka thusuhmi pawl i let lo. Profet in siseh, mang in siseh, i let hrimhrim nawn lo. Curuangah ziangso ka tuah ding, ti i simtu dingah ka lo ko a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Samuel in, “Ziangah so Pathian ih a lo dungtun hnuah le na ral ih a can hnuah kei cu i kawh duh?"},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnen ihsin a lo simmi kha na parah a kim ter zo - na ram uknak cu na hnen ihsin a lakih na ai-ah David a pek zo a si."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupekmi na thlun lo ih Amalek mi pawl le an neih mi hmuahhmuah a zatein na siatsuah thluh lo. Curuangah Bawipa in hiti ih a lo tuahnak a si."},"19":{"text":"Nangmah le Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa in Filistin mi pawl kut sungah a lo pek ding. Thaisun ah nangmah le na fapa pawl cu ka hnenah nan rung thlang ding. Cule Israel ralkap pawl cu Bawipa in Filistin mi pawl ih kut sungah a pek thluh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Saul cu hmakhatte-ah a tlu ih leilung ah a ril. Samuel ih simmi thu cu a ṭih tuk lawmmam. Sunvu le zanvar zianghman a ei fawn lo ruangah Saul cu a ṭamsawl ih tha a nei lo."},"21":{"text":"Pol nu in Saul ih tluknak ahcun a va pan ih a thin a phangzet ti a hmuh ruangah a hnenah, “Bawipa, ka nunnak hman ruat loin i fial mi cu ka tuah a si."},"22":{"text":"Curuangah atu ka lo fial mi hi tuah ve hram aw. Na hrangah rawl malte ka lo tuahsak pei. Ei awla na lamzin fehnak ah tha na nei deuh ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Saul in a ei duh lo; “Zianghman ka ei lo ding,” a ti. Asinain a kuthnuai bawi pawl khal in ei dingah an hneek ve ih a neta bik ahcun an thu cu a thlun. Leilung ihsin a tho ih ihkhun parah a to."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah nunau nu cun thauseh ti ih a rak cawm rero mi caw note pakhat zamrangin a that. Sangphut a lak ih a hmal thluh hnuah thilnu tello sangah a tuah."},"25":{"text":"Saul le a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih hmai ahcun rawl cu a hun ih an ei. Cule a cuih zan ahcun an kir."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl in an ralkap pawl cu Afek ah an khawm ih, Israel mi pawl cu Jezreel Phairawn ih cerhti kiangah an riak.","title":"Filistin Mi In David An Hnong"},"2":{"text":"Filistin lal panga pawl cu an ralkap zakhat rual le thawngkhat rual pawl thawn hmailam ah an feh zutzo ih David le a ralkap pawl cun dunglam ihsin Akhish thawn an thlun."},"3":{"text":"Filistin ralbawi pawl in, “Hi Hebru mi pawl hi hitawk ah ziangso an tuah ve?” tiah an sut. Cutikah Akhish in, “Hi pa hi Israel siangpahrang Saul ih ralbawi David a si. Ka hnenih a umnak a rei nawn thlang. Ka hnenih a rathlen thokin tuihsun tiangah thilsual a tuahmi zianghman ka hmu lo,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Filistin ralbawi pawl cu an thin a heng ih Akhish hnenah, “Hi pa cu umnak khua na pekmi ah kirter sal aw. Kan hnenah cun fehter hrimhrim hlah. Ziangahtile ral kan do tikah kanmah siatsuahtu kanmah ih ral riangri-ah a cang pang ding. A bawipa thawn an rem-awk salnak dingah cun kan ralkap pawl ih luhlohnak cu amah ih hrangah lamzin ṭha bik a si!"},"5":{"text":"Thungai ti ahcun, nunau pawl ih an laam phah ah: ‘Saul cun a thawng a sawm in a that; David cun a thawng a za in a that,’ ti ih hla an phuahmi kha amah David hi a sisi!” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Akhish in David cu a ko ih a hnenah, “A nungmi Bawipa ih hmin salin ka lo sim: ka hrangah rintlak ngaingai na si ih ka hnenah feh tahratin ral do ve cila ka duh zet. Ka hnenih na rathlen thok ihsin na mawhnak ka hmu hrih lo. Asinain Filistin lal dang pawl in an lo duh lo."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah daitein va kir aw; an thinhengnak ding zianghman tuah hlah aw,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Ziang so ka sual? Na hnen ka thlen ih na hna ka ṭuan thok ihsin, bawipa, ka mawhnak zianghman na hmu lo. Ziangah so ka bawipa le ka siangpahrang nangmah thawn ka feh lo ding? Ziangah so na ral pawl do loin ka kir men ding?” tiah a el ciamco."},"9":{"text":"Akhish in, “David, nang cu Pathian ih vancungmi tlukih a felmi na si ti ka thei ko. Sikhalsehla Filistin ralbawi pawl in ral donak ah kan hnenah feh hlah seh, tiah an lo ti zo."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Saul siangpahrang taan tahratin ka hnenih a rami hmuahhmuah nan zatein thaizing khua a van vete in nan kir ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah David le a milai pawl cu Filistin ramih kir dingah a thaizing zingpit in an pok. Filistin ralkap pawl cu Jezreel lamah an feh."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni thumnak ah David le a ralkap pawl cu Ziklag khua an thleng. Amalek mi pawl in Judah ram thlanglam kap kha an rak ram ih Ziklag khua khal an rak lak ih meisa in an ur thluh.","title":"Amalek Mi An Do"},"2":{"text":"Nunau hmuahhmuah an kai ih, zohman an that lonain an zatein an hruai thluh."},"3":{"text":"David le a ralkap pawl an va thlen tikah an khua cu a rak kang thluh zo ih an nupi le an fanu le an fapa pawl cu an rak hruaihlo thluh zo."},"4":{"text":"David le a milai pawl cu ringzet in an ṭap ih an tha cem in an ṭah thei nawn lo tiangin an ṭap."},"5":{"text":"David ih nupi pahnih Ahinoam le Abigail khal an hruaimi pawl lakah an rak tel ve."},"6":{"text":"David cu vansanglam in a um. Ziangahtile a milai pawl ih faate pawl cu salih hruai thluh an si ruangah an thin a na ngaingai ih David cu lungto ih den an tum. Asinain a Bawipa Pathian hnen ihsin thazaang cahnak a ngah."},"7":{"text":"Cule David in Ahimelek ih fapa puithiam Abiathar hnenah, “Puithiam ṭaangthlaih kor cu i pe aw,” tiah a ti ih, Abiathar cun a pek."},"8":{"text":"David cun Bawipa ih hnenah, “In ramtu pawl cu ka dawi pei maw? Ka dawi asile ka kai hai pei maw?” tiah a sut. Cutikah Bawipa in, “Dawi aw; na kai hai dingih an hruai mi pawl khal na runsuak ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah David cu a ralkap zaruk thawn an pok ih Besor Tiva an thleng; cutawkah mi hrekkhat an taangta."},"10":{"text":"A milai sung ihsin zahnih cu an baang tukih tiva an tan thei lo ruangah an taangta. David le a milai zali pawl in an dawi vivo."},"11":{"text":"Cule a milai pawl in hramlakah Izipt nauhakpa pakhat an sar ih David hnenah an fehpi. Ti le rawl an pek."},"12":{"text":"Theirah car malte le an carmi sabit rah bawr hnih tla an pe. A ei hnuah a ṭamsawl cu a ṭha. Nithum sung zianghman in lo le ei loin a rak um a si."},"13":{"text":"Cule David in, “Na bawipa zoso a si? Khuitawk in so na rat?” tiah a sut. Cutikah anih in, “Izipt mi ka si ih Amalek mi pa pakhat ih sal ka si. Ka nat ruangah hitawk ah hin ka bawipa in i taanta a si. I taannak ni thum a si zo."},"14":{"text":"Kereth ram thlanglam kap hrawng, Judah ram thlanglam kap le Kaleb miphun pawl ih ram tla kan ram ih Ziklag khua tla kan ur thluh,” tiah a sim."},"15":{"text":"David in, “A cuih miramtu pawl hnenah cun i hruai pei maw?” tiah a sut. Nauhak pa in, “Ka lo that hrimhrim lo ding ih na bawipa ih hnen khalah ka lo pek lo ding, tiah Pathian hmin sal in thu i kam a si ahcun ka lo hruai ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah cupa in David cu a hruai. Amalek mi pawl in Filistin ram le Judah ram ihsin ral thilri an lakmi pawl cu a tam ngaingai ruangah, an aih ih zu an in, sa an ei, puai an tuah ih hmun kipah an darh-aw ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Culai ah David in a nam hai ih zingpit ihsin zanlam khawthim tiang a do. Tlangval zali cu kalauk an to ih an tlanhlo. Cupawl siarlo, pakhat hman luat loin an that ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Amalek mi pawl ih an kaihmi le an lakmi hmuahhmuah, amah ih nupi pahnih thawn a runsuak ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Zianghman a hlosuakmi a um lo. An fanu le an fapa pawl siseh, an thilri pawl siseh, David in a lak kirsal thluh a si."},"20":{"text":"Tuu le caw pawl khal a rual a rual in a ngah sal thluh. A milai pawl in ṭilva pawl cu hmaiah an khor vivo ih, “David ih ta an si,” tiah an au phah vivo."},"21":{"text":"Cun David a thlun thei nawn lo ih Besor Tiva ih a taangta mi a milai zahnih hnenah David cu a va thleng sal. A cuih a milai pawl cun David le a ralkap pawl cu an rak hmuak ih David tla in an hnen a thlen tikah lungawi zetin cibai a buk hai a si."},"22":{"text":"Asinain David hnenih a feh vemi halhsik neimi le hawizawng lo mihlotlau hrekkhat pawl in, “Annih cu kan hnenih an feh ve lo ruangah thilri kan lakmi pawl hi kan zem hai lo ding. An nupi le an faale pawl hi la hai sehla feh ko hai seh,” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Asinain David in, “Unaule uh, Bawipa ih in pekmi thilri parah cutiin nan tuah thei lo ding. Amah in in kilkhawi ih mi ramtu pawl ih parah nehnak in pek."},"24":{"text":"Nan simmi cu zohman an lung a kim thei lo ding. Zozo khal bangrep tein co ciar ding a si. Thilri kan taanmi hnenih a rung taang mi khal in raldonak ih a fehmi co zat thotho in a co ve pei,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cumi cu David in daanah a tuah ih Israel ramsungah atu tiangin an thlun dahta a si."},"26":{"text":"David cu Ziklag ih a thlen sal tikah ral hnen ihsin an lakmi thilri pawl hrekkhat cu Judah mi hotu, a rualpi pawl hnenah a kuat ih, “ Bawipa ih ral pawl hnen ihsin kan lakmi thilri malte laksawng ah kan lo ṭhen,” tiah a cah vivo."},"27":{"text":"Bethel ih a ummi, Judah ram thlanglam Ramah ih a ummi, Jattir peng khua pawl ih a ummi,"},"28":{"text":"Aroer khua, Sifmoth khua, Eshtemoa khua,"},"29":{"text":"Rakal khua, Jerahmeel miphun ih khua pawl, Ken miphun ih khua pawl,"},"30":{"text":"Hormah peng, Borashan peng le Athak peng le,"},"31":{"text":"Hebron ram sungih a ummi khawsungmi hmuahhmuah hnenah a kuat. Amah David le a milai pawl an rak thlennak khua hmuahhmuah ah a kuat thluh."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Filistin mi le Israel mi pawl cu Gilbon tlang ah nasa zetin an do aw. Cutawkah Israel mi tampi an thi ih, a taangmi cu Saul le a fapa pawl thawn an tlan thluh.","title":"Saul Le A Fapa Pawl An Thi (2 Sam 1.4-12 ; 1 San. 10.1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl in Saul le a fapa pawl cu an man ih a fapa Jonathan, Abinadab le Malkhishua pawl cu an that."},"3":{"text":"Ral a luar vivo ih Saul cu conkiang in an ngah ih besia zetin an hriam."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Saul in a hriamnam kengtu tlangvalpa ih hnenah, “Hi serhtan lo Filistin pawl in dekcoknak menah in hman ih in thah ding hnak cun na ralnam zuuk awla nangmah in i that sawn aw,” tiah a ti. Asinain tlangvalpa cun a ngam lo. Curuangah Saul cun a ralnam zik zum a tluk cih ih a thi."},"5":{"text":"Saul a thih kha tlangvalpa in a hmuh tikah anih khal a ralnam a zuuk ih a tlukcih ih Saul hnenah a thi ve."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun Saul le a fapa pathum le tlangvalpa cu hmun khatah an thi. Cuih ni ah Saul ih milai pawl cu an thi ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Jezreel horkuam ralih a ummi le Jordan Tiva ihsin nisuahnak lamih a ummi Israel mi pawl in Israel ralkap pawl an tlan thluh ih Saul le a fapa pawl khal an thi thluh ti an theih tikah an khua pawl cu an taan ih an tlanhlo thluh. Cuih hnuah Filistin mi pawl an ra ih cuih khua pawl cu an ra luah."},"8":{"text":"An do-awk ni ih thaisun ah a thimi pawl ih ralthuam la dingah Filistin pawl an feh ih Gilboa tlang an thlen tikah Saul le a fapa pathum ih ruak an ril teptep kha an hmu."},"9":{"text":"Saul ih lu cu an tan hnuah a ralthuam pawl an lak. Cule a cuih thuthang cu an milem pawl le misenpi hnenih sim dingah Filistin ram khuazakip ah mi an thlah ciamco."},"10":{"text":"Cun Saul ih ralthuam cu Astartes khawzingnu an biaknak inn ah an ret ih a ruak cu Bethshan khawpi kulhnak hauhruang parah an taar."},"11":{"text":"Filistin pawl in Saul ih ruak parih an tuah daan cu Gilead ramih Jabesh khuami pawl in an theih tikah,"},"12":{"text":"anmah lakih ralṭha bik pawl an pok ih zanvarte Bethshan khua ahcun an feh. Hauhruang parih sin Saul le a fapa pawl ruak cu an lak ih Jabesh khua ah an zawn ih cutawkah meisa in an ur."},"13":{"text":"Cule an ruh pawl cu an lak ih an khawsung tuumkung hnuai ah an phum ih ni sarih sung rawl an ul."}}}}},"10":{"info":{"name":"2 Samuel","shortname":"2 Sam","abbr":[],"desc":"2 samuel"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul a thih hnuah David cu Amalek ral a nehnak ihsin a ra kir ih Ziklag khua ah ni hnih a um.","title":"David In Saul Ih Thih A Thei"},"2":{"text":"A thaisun ah Saul thihnak hmun ihsin tlangval pakhat a ra thleng. A riahsiat ruangah a hnipuan a thlek ih a lu ah leivut a phulh aw. David hnenah a feh ih leilung dai in upatnak pekin a lu a kun."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Khuitawk inso na rat?” tiah a sut. Anih in, “Israel ralkap pawl lakin ka ra tlan,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"“Ziang an cang, i sim hnik,” tiah David in a ti. Cutikah tlangvalpa cun, “Israel ralkap pawl cu an tlan thluh ih tampi an thi fawn. Saul le a fapa Jonathan khal an thi,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"“Saul le Jonathan an thi, tiah ziangtinso na theih?” tiah David in a sut sal."},"6":{"text":"Tlangvalpa in, “Gilboa tlang parah ka rak um ve ih an ral pawl rangleng le rang ralkap pawl in an hun naih vivo ih culaiah Saul cu a feipi pawk in a din kha ka hmu."},"7":{"text":"A her-aw ih keimah i hmu ih i ko. “Bawipa, ziangso?” tiah ka ti."},"8":{"text":"“Zoso na si?” tiah i sut ih, “Amalek mi ka si,” tiah ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah, “Besiazet in in tuahmawh zo ih ka thi cing ding. Ra awla i ra that aw,” tiah i ti."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah a umnak ah ka hung so ih ka that, ziangahtile a tlu ding ih a tluk vete cun a thi thotho ding, ti ka thei. Cun a lu parih a siangpahrang lukhuh le ralnam khamnak baanhrolh cu ka lak ih atu na hnenah ka rak keng a si, bawipa,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"David cu riahsia le ninghang in a hnipuan a thlek thluh ih a milai pawl hmuahhmuah khal in an thlek thluh ve."},"12":{"text":"An ṭaang cuum aw in an ṭap ih, Bawipa ih minung Israel mi tampi ralih an thih ruangah le Saul le Jonathan tla an hlohral ruangah zan tiang rawl ul in an um."},"13":{"text":"Cule David in hi thu a ra simtu tlangvalpa cu, “Khuilam mi so na si?” tiah a sut. “Amalek mi ka si naón na ram sungah hin ka um,” tiah a sawn."},"14":{"text":"David in, “Ziangtin so Bawipa in siangpahrang ih a hril mi cu na thah ngam?” tiah a ti ih,"},"15":{"text":"a ralkap pakhat ko tahratin, “Hi pa hi that aw,” tiah thu a pek. Curuangah ralkap pa cun Amalek tlangvalpa cu a sah thluk ih a that."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Na thisen cu na lu parah tlaseh. Bawipa Pathian in siangpahrang ih a hrilmi ka that a si, tiah na hmurka rori ih na phuan ruangah nangmah le nangmah na nunnak na cemter-aw a sihi,” tiah Amalek pa cu a ti."},"17":{"text":"David in Saul le a fapa Jonathan cu hla in a ṭah ih,","title":"David In Saul Le Jonathan A ṭah"},"18":{"text":"a cuih hla cu Judah mi pawl ih zir dingin thu a pek. (Hi thihhla cu Jashar Cabu sungah an ngan.)"},"19":{"text":"“Maw mi vanduai Israel bawi pawl, Nan ram tlangmual ih nan thih hi, Ralṭha hleice pawl vanduai ni a suah hi."},"20":{"text":"Gath khua ah va sim hlah uh, Ashkelon khua ih lamzin ah phuang hlah uh; Filistin nunau an lung a awi pang ding. Khawvel fanu pawl an di a riam tuk pang ding."},"21":{"text":"Maw Gilboa tlang, Na parah ruah le dai khal tla hlah seh, Na leiram cu caar le kolh in thlairawl zianghman suah hlah seh! Ziangahtile ralṭha pawl ih ralphaw cu a rop duahdo ih, Saul ih ralphaw cu a tlap ṭheh."},"22":{"text":"Jonathan ih li le thal cu mi hriamah a hmual a na, Saul ih ralnam cu mizaangfah a nei lo. Micak zet pawl khal a ṭhio thluh ih, Ral pawl khal a saattan thluh."},"23":{"text":"Maw Saul le Jonathan, Nan duh awknak mangbangza a si; Nunnak ah nan hmun khat ih thihnak khalah nan hmunkhat; Muvanlai hnakin nan rangdeuh, Kiosa hnakin nan cakdeuh."},"24":{"text":"Maw Israel nunau pawl, Saul cu ṭah cio uh; Hnipuan mankhung sunglawi in, sen thliaithliai ih a lo thuamtu amah a si; Hlawnthil mankhung le suingun in a lo mawitertu amah a si."},"25":{"text":"Ral ṭha hleice ralkap pawl an van a duai ee, Raldonak ah an hloral ta; Tlang parah Jonathan cu a thita."},"26":{"text":"Maw Jonathan, ka unau duh, nangmah ruangah ka riah a sia, Ziangtluk duhnungza so ka hrangah na si! I duhdawtnak cu ziangtluk mangbangza so a si, Nunau ih duhdawtnak hnakin a thlum sawn."},"27":{"text":"Kan miṭha pawl an ral zo, An hriamnam pawl khal an hloral thluh zo,” tin a ṭah."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah David in, “Judah ramih khua pakhatkhatah ka hung feh pei maw?” tiah Bawipa a ron. “Feh aw,” tiah Bawipa in a ti. Cule David in, “Khui khua ah so ka feh ding?” tiah a sut sal. Cutikah Bawipa in, “Hebron ah feh aw,” tiah a ti.","title":"David Judah Siangpahrang Ah A Cang"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah David cu a nupi pahnih, Jezreel khuami Ahinoam le Nabal ih thihsanmi Karmel khuami Abigail thawn Hebron ah a feh."},"3":{"text":"A milai ralkap pawl le an innsang pawl khal a fehpi ih Hebron khua ah a um."},"4":{"text":"Cule Judah mi pawl Hebron khua ahcun an ra ih Judah siangpahrang ah David cu hriak an culh. Gilead ramih Jabesh khuami pawl in Saul cu an phum ti kha David in a theih tikah,"},"5":{"text":"mi a thlah ih, “Nan bawipa Saul parah upatnak nan nei ih ṭhatein nan rak phum ruangah Pathian in lo thlawsuah hram seh."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa cu nan parah zaangfah thinpemnak a neimi le rinsantlak ringringmi Pathian si hram seh. Hi bangtuk ih nan tuah ruangah keimah khal in ka lo zoh ṭha ve ding."},"7":{"text":"Cak uhla nan ralṭha uh. Nan siangpahrang Saul cu a thi ih atu ah keimah cu Judah mi pawl in an siangpahrang sinakah hriak in culh zo a si,” tiah thu a cah."},"8":{"text":"Ner ih fapa Abner, Saul ralkap hotu cu, Saul ih fapa Ishbosheth thawn an tlan ih Jordan tiva khatlam ral Mahanaim ah an va thleng.","title":"Ishbosheth Cu Israel Siangpahrang A Cang"},"9":{"text":"Cutawkah Abner in Ishbosheth cu siangpahrang ah a canter ih Gilead, Asher, Jezreel, Efraim le Benjamin ram le Israel ram pumpi a uk."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang a can tikah Ishbosheth cu kum 40 a si ih kum hnih sung a uk. Sikhalsehla Judah miphun cun David an ṭan ih,"},"11":{"text":"David in Judah mi pawl cu Hebron khua ihsin kum sarih le a hrek sung a uk."},"12":{"text":"Abner le Ishbosheth ralkap pawl cu Mahanaim ihsin an pok ih Gibeon khawpi ah an feh.","title":"Israel Le Judah An Do-aw"},"13":{"text":"Joab, (a nu cu Zeruiah a si), le David ralkap pawl cu Hebron ihsin an pok ih Gibeon khua ah an feh ve. Gibeon khua ih tili kapah an tong aw. Abner le a ralkap pawl cu tili kap khatah ṭanhmun an khuar ih Joab le a ralkap pawl cu khatlam kapah ṭanhmun an khuar ve."},"14":{"text":"Cule Abner in, “Kan tlangval pawl hrekkhat suak veve in pakhat le pakhat tawng aw hai sehla a ṭha ding,” tiah Joab cu a ti. Cule Joab in, “Sihen seh!” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Ishbosheth le Benjamin phun ai-awh ah minung hleihnih an suak ih David ih milai pawl ai-awh ah hleihnih an suak ve."},"16":{"text":"An do awk tikah mahih hmaton ral kha an lu in an kai ih an thinhna ah an ralnam in an dawt aw ih hmunkhat ah an zatein an tlu ih an thi thluh. Curuangah Gibeon khua kiang a cuih hmun cu Helkath-hazzurim “Ralnam Hmun,” tiah an kotata."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah do awknak nasa zetin a um ih Abner le Israel mi pawl cu David ralkap pawl in an neh."},"18":{"text":"Zeruiah ih fapa pathum Joab, Abishai le Asahel tla an pathum in an tel. Cule zukneng tlukih tlan a cakmi Asahel in,"},"19":{"text":"Abner cu a dawi ih khuadang tang loin a dawi vivo."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Abner cu dunglam a rak hoi ih, “Asahel maw na si?” tiah a ti. “A si, Asahel ka si,” tiah a sawn."},"21":{"text":"Abner in, “I dawi nawn hlah aw. Ralkap pakhatkhat dawi sawn awla a kenmi long sawn aw,” a ti. Asinain Asahel cun a dawi thotho."},"22":{"text":"Cule Abner in, “I dawi nawn aw hlah! Ka lo that ngaingai ding sokhaw. Ka lo thah asile ziangtinso na u Joab mithmai ka zoh ngam nawn ding?” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Asinain Asahel cun a dawi cu a bang cuang lo. Curuangah Abner in a feipi cu dungkhawh in a khawh ih Asahel cu a thinhna ihsin a zaang ah tlang ko in a khawh ngah. Asahel cu a sawn ih a thi. Cule Asahel ruak umnak an thlen tikah zozo khal an cawl ih cutawkah an ding."},"24":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Joab le Abishai in Abner cu an dawi sal ih ni a tlak cuarco ah Giah ihsin nisuahnak lam, Gibeon ramlak fehnak lamzin ih a ummi Ammah tlang an thleng."},"25":{"text":"Benjamin mi pawl cu Abner hnenah an finkhawm aw sal ih tlangpar ahcun ṭanhmun an khuar."},"26":{"text":"Cule Abner in Joab cu a auh ih, “Hitiin maw kumkhua kan do awk rero ding? A netnak ahcun huat awk sinsinnak lawng a suak ding, tihi na thei lo maw si? Kannih tla hi na phunpi rori kan si! Na minung pawl in kanmah in dawi hi dawn loin maw na um men ringring ding?” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cutikah Joab in, “Cuvekin hung ṭongsuak hlah cila, a nungmi Pathian hmin salin ka lo sim: ka ralkap pawl in thaizing tiang an lo dawi rero ko ding naón,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cule Joab in tawtawrawt a tum ih a ralkap pawl in Israel mi pawl cu an dawi nawn lo. Curuangah an do awknak cu an bang."},"29":{"text":"Abner le a ralkap pawl cu Jordan tivakap phairawn ah zanvar an feh ih, Jordan tiva an tan hnuah a thaisun sunhlan an feh ih Mahanaim an thleng."},"30":{"text":"Abner an dawi nawn lo hnuah Joab in a ralkap pawl cu a khawm ih Asahel tel loin hleikua an thi."},"31":{"text":"David ralkap pawl ih an thah mi Benjamin mi, Abner ralkap pawl cu zathum le sawmruk an si."},"32":{"text":"Joab le a ralkap pawl in Asahel ruak cu an zawn ih Bethlehem khua, an innsang thlaan ah an phum. Cule zanvar an feh ih a thaizing zingpit ah Hebron an thleng sal."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul ih sungkhat pawl a ṭantu ralkap pawl le David le a ralkap pawl cu reipi an do-aw ringring. David cu ni khat hnu ni khat a cak deuhdeuh ih a ral pawl cu ni khat hnu ni khat an ṭawnṭai vivo."},"2":{"text":"Hebron ih a suakmi David fapa pawl cu a hnuailam pawl hi an si. Pakhatnak cu Amnon a si ih a nu cu Jezreel khuami Ahinoam a si.","title":"David Ih Fapa Pawl"},"3":{"text":"A pahnihnak cu Khileab a si ih a nu cu Nabal ih thihsan mi, Karmel khuami Abigail a si. A pathumnak cu Absalom a si ih a nu cu Geshur ram siangpahrang Talmai ih fanu Maakah a si."},"4":{"text":"A palinak cu Adonijah a si ih a nu cu Haggith a si. A panganak cu Shefatiah a si ih a nu cu Abital a si."},"5":{"text":"A paruknak cu Ithream a si ih a nu cu Eglah a si. Hi fapa pawl cu Hebron ih suakmi an si."},"6":{"text":"Saul sungkhat a ṭantu ralkap le David ralkap pawl an do awknak a rei vivo tikah Saul sungkhat ṭantu ralkap pawl sungah Abner cu thuneitu a si deuhdeuh.","title":"David Hnenah Abner A ṭangsal"},"7":{"text":"Nikhat ah Saul ih fapa Ishbosheth in Abner cu Saul ih nupisun Aiah ih fanu Rizpah thawn an ittlang a si, tiah sual a puh."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Abner cu a thin a heng ngaingai ih, “Mi phiartu ah maw i ruat? Judah riantu ah maw i ruat? A hramthok ihsin na pa le a unau pawl le a rualpi pawl hnenah a ṭang ringringtu ka si ih, David ih kut sungah ka lo thlenter dah lo. Cuti asinain tuih ni ah nunau thawn sual i puh."},"9":{"text":"Hi ram cu Saul le a tesinfa pawl hnenih sin ka lak pei ih David cu Israel le Judah ram, khatlam zim Dan ihsin khatlam zim Beersheba tiang, uk thluhtu siangpahrang ah ka canter ding, tiah Bawipa Pathian in David cu a tiam zomi a si. Cuvek ih ka tuahsuak lo asile Pathian in i that seh,” tiah a ti.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Ishbosheth in Abner cu a ṭih tuk ih kam khat hman a sawn ngam lo."},"12":{"text":"Culai ah David cu Hebron ah a um ih a hnenah Abner in palai a thlah ih, “Hi ram hi zo in so a uk cuang ding? Keimah thawn lungkimnak cakhen tuah awla Israel ram na neh thluhnak dingah ka lo bawm ding,” tiah a cah."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “A ṭha! Lungkimnak ka tuah pei. Asinain ka hnenih na rat tikah Saul ih fanu Mikhal na rak hruai lawnglawng ah kan tuah thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Ishbosheth hnen khalah David in palai a thlah ih, “Ka nupi Mikhal i pe sal aw. Amah co dingah a man ah Filistin mi zakhat ih vunzim ka pek a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Ishbosheth in Mikhal cu Laish ih fapa a pasal Paltiel hnen ihsin a hruai sal."},"16":{"text":"Paltiel cun a nupi Mikhal cu a sian lo tuk ruangah a ṭap thluahthlo ih Bahurim khua tiang a thlun. Cutikah Abner in, “Kir thlang aw,” a ti ih Paltiel cu a kir."},"17":{"text":"Abner cu Israel mi hotu pawl hnenah a feh ih, “David nan siangpahrang si dingih nan duhnak cu a reipi zo."},"18":{"text":"Atu hi nan hrangah tikcu ṭha bik a si. Bawipa Pathian in, ‘Ka salpa David ka hmang pei ih ka minung Israel pawl cu Filistin pawl le an ral dang pawl kut sung ihsin ka run ding,’ tiah a timi kha nan thei thluh ko,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Abner cu Benjamin mi pawl khal thu a sim phah vivo ih, cuih hnuah Israel le Benjamin mi pawl ih lungkimnak sim dingah Hebron ah David hnenah cun a feh."},"20":{"text":"Hebron ih David hnenah cun Abner cu minung kul thawn an feh ih David in an hrangah rawl ei puai a tuahsak."},"21":{"text":"Cule Abner in David hnenah, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, ka va feh pei ih Israel ram cu a zatein na uknak sungah ka ratpi ding. An siangpahrang ah an lo pom ko ding. Cuticun na lungthlitum cu na ngah ding ih hi ram cu a pumpi in na uk ding a si,” tiah a ti. Abner cu David in hnangamte in a fehter."},"22":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Joab le David ih ralkap pawl cu mi an va siimnak ihsin an rakir ih hransaw thil an lakmi pawl tampi an rak keng. Abner cu himte in David in a thlah zo ruangah Hebron ah a um nawn lo.","title":"Abner An That"},"23":{"text":"Joab le a ralkap pawl an thlen tikah Abner cu David siangpahrang hnenah a ra ih himte in David in a kuat sal zo, tiah an rak sim."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Joab cu David hnenah a feh ih, “Ziang so na rak tuah? Na hnenah Ebner a ra ih ziangtinso cutimen in na fehter?"},"25":{"text":"Nangmah bum duh ah le na fehnak hmuahhmuah le na tuahmi hmuahhmuah hliah duh ah na hnenah a ra a si ti na thei lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"David hnen ihsin a feh hnuah Abner hruai dingah Joab in mi a thlah ih, Sirah tikhur ihsin an rak kirpi sal. A cuih thu cu David in zianghman a thei lo."},"27":{"text":"Abner cu Hebron an thlenpi tikah thuthup sim ding bangin kotka kiangah Joab in a hruai ih a thinhna ah a sun ih a thi. Cuticun Joab in Abner cu a that, ziangahtile a naupa Asahel a rak thah zo ruangah a phu a lak a si."},"28":{"text":"A cuih thu David in a theih tikah, “Ka milai pawl le kei cun Abner an thahnak thu cu kan thei hrimhrim lo a si, ti cu Bawipa Pathian in a thei."},"29":{"text":"A thisen cu amah Joab le a innsang parah thleng seh. Sankhat hnu sankhat, Joab ih sungkhat hnenah thisen sungdok nat maw, phaarnat maw, a si lole mahte feh thei loin kianghrol thawn a feh mi maw, raldonak ih a thimi maw, a si lole rawl eiding khopkham nei lo mi maw, um ringring hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Gibeon ih an do awknak ah Abner in an nau Asahel a rak thah ruangah Joab le a nau Abishai in Abner an thahnak cu a si."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah David in Joab le a milai pawl cu an hnipuan thlek tahrat in buri hnipuan hruk ih Abner ṭah dingah thu a pek. Cun an phum tikah ruak kuangih dungah David siangpahrang cu a ke rori in a feh.","title":"Abner An Phum"},"32":{"text":"Abner cu Hebron ah an phum ih a thlaan ah David siangpahrang cu napi in a ṭap. Mi hmuahhmuah khal an ṭap ṭheh."},"33":{"text":"David cun hla in a ṭah ih: “Mi aa bangin Abner na thi maw si?"},"34":{"text":"Na kut an lo ṭem lo, Na ke tla an lo khit lo; Misual pawl ih thahmi na bang hi,” a ti. Mi hmuahhmuah khal in an ṭah sal."},"35":{"text":"Ni a tlak hlanah ziangtal ei dingah David cu a minung pawl in an fial rero naón a duh lo. “Nitlak hlanih ziang maw ka ei hnak cun Pathian in i that sawnseh,” tiah thu a kam."},"36":{"text":"Cutiih a ti cu senpi in an hmuh tikah an lung a kimzet. Siangpahrang ih thil a tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu an lungkim zawng a si thluh."},"37":{"text":"Abner ih lu hlohnak ah hin siangpahrang a tel lo a si, ti cu David ih milai pawl le Israel mi hmuahhmuah in an thei."},"38":{"text":"Cun David in a kuthnuai bawi pawl hnenah, “Tuihsun ah Israel ram hruaitu ṭha le mimak pakhat a thi, tihi nan thei maw?"},"39":{"text":"Keimah cu Pathian ih hrilmi siangpahrang ka si naón tuihsun cu ka thin a nau ngaingai a si. Hi Zeruiah fapa pawl cu ka hrangah tuar an har tuk. Anmah ih tuah vekin hi misual pawl parah Pathian in hremnak thlenter hram seh,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hebron ah Abner an that a si, ti kha Saul fapa Ishbosheth in a theih tikah a thin a phang ngaingai ih Israel mi hmuahhmuah khal an thin a nuam lo.","title":"Ishbosheth An That"},"2":{"text":"Midang an siim tikih an hotu bawi pahnih Ishbosheth in a nei ih an hmin ah Baanah le Rekhab an si. Anmah cu Benjamin miphun, Beeroth khua Rimmon ih fapa an si. Beeroth cu Benjamin ram sungah siarcih a si."},"3":{"text":"Beeroth ih a rak um hmasatu pawl cu Gittaim ah an tlan ih cutawk minung ah an cangta."},"4":{"text":"Cun Saul ih fapa Jonathan in fapa pakhat a nei ih a hmin cu Mefibosheth a si. Saul le Jonathan an thihnak thu Jezreel ihsin a ra than tikah Mefibosheth cu kum nga a kim. Amah a umtu nu in a lak ih a tlanpi. Asinain zamrang tukin a tlanpi ruangah a thlak pang ih Mefibosheth cu a ke pahnih in a bai ta."},"5":{"text":"Rekhab le Baanah cu Ishbosheth ih inn lamah an feh ih sunah an va thleng. Ishbosheth cu sunih a colh laifang a si."},"6":{"text":"A sangka kiltu nunau nu cu sangvut a hrik rero laiah a ih a hmu ih a it that. Cutiih a ihthat laiah Rekhab le Baanah cu a thupte in an vung lut."},"7":{"text":"Innsung an thlen vete in Ishbosheth ihnak khaan sungah an lutih a ihthat laifangah Ishbosheth cu an sun ih an that. A lu an tan ih an lak hnuah zanvar Jordan Phairawn in an feh ih Hebron khua ah an thleng."},"8":{"text":"Ishbosheth ih lu cu David hnenah an fehpi ih a hnenah, “A lo raltu le a thah a lo tumtu Saul ih fapa Ishbosheth ih lu cu hihi a si. Tuihsun ah Bawipa Pathian in Saul le a tesinfa pawl parih phulaknak cu siangpahrang na hnenah a lo pek a si,” tiah an ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Ṭihphannak hmuahhmuah sung ihsin i runtu a nungmi Bawipa ih hmin in siat ka serh a si!"},"10":{"text":"Ziklag ah ra tahrat in Saul ih thihnak thu i ra simtu cun thuṭha ka phur tiah a ruat. Asinain amah cu ka kai ih ka that. Thuthang a rak ken ruangih hlawhman ka pekmi cu thih a si."},"11":{"text":"Mawhnak nei lomi amah ih inn sungih a it lai mi rori a va thattu misual pawl ih hrangah cun ziangtlukin so a har sinsin ding. Ishbosheth nan thah ruangah atu rori ah nan parah phu ka lak ding ih lei parah hin nan ci ka hmit thluh ding,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"David in thu a pekih a ralkap pawl in Rekhab le Baanah cu an that ih an kut le an ke pawl an tan ih Hebron ih tili kiangah an thlai. Cun Ishbosheth ih lu cu an lak hnuah Hebron ahcun Abner ih thlaan ah an phum."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel miphun pawl hmuahhmuah cu Hebron ih David hnenah an ra ih, “Kannih cu na thi le na sa kan si.","title":"David Cu Israel Le Judah Siangpahrang Ah A Cang (1 San. 11.1-9 ; 14.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Kan dunglai ih kan siangpahrang Saul a rak si laiah, Israel mi pawl cu raldonak ah na hruai ih, Amah Pathian rori in a minung pawl tuukhal bangin kilkhawitu dingah le uktu dingah a lo kam a si,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Israel mi hotu pawl hmuahhmuah cu Hebron khua David hnenah cun an ra. Pathian hmaika ah David in anmah thawn thukamnak a tuah ih Israel siangpahrang ah David cu hriak an culh."},"4":{"text":"David cu siangpahrang a can tikah kum sawmthum a si ih kum sawmli sung siangpahrang a ṭuan."},"5":{"text":"Hebron ihsin Judah ram cu kum sarih le a hrek a uk ih, Jerusalem ihsin Israel le Judah ram zatein kum sawmthum le kum thum a uk a si."},"6":{"text":"David le a ralkap pawl cu Jerusalem khua nam dingin an feh. A cuih khua ih a rak ummi Jebus mi pawl in David cun in neh dah lo ding, tiah an ruat ih, “Na lut thei dah lo ding; mitcaw le kebai mi khal in an lo kham thei ding,” tiah an rak ti."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla David in Zion khua ih ral pawl an ṭannak ruhkulh cu a lak ṭheh ih Zion khua cu David ih khawpi ah a cangta."},"8":{"text":"Cuih sunah David in a milai pawl hnenah, “Jebus mi pawl ka huat tlukin a huatu nan um maw? Kan thah thluh le a tawk nan ti maw? Tiluannak kua ah hung feh uhla mitcaw le kebai mi pawl tiangin hung that thluh uh,” tiah a ti. Curuangah, “Mitcaw le kebai mi pawl cu Bawipa ih inn ah an lut thei lo ding,” tiih an tinak a si."},"9":{"text":"Cule ral ṭannak ih an sakmi ruhkulh a lak hnuah David cu cutawk ah a um ih, “David ih Khawpi,” tiah hmin a sak. Millo an ti mi hmun ihsin a thok ih ral ṭannak a dawl vivo ih cuih khua kimvel in a dawl ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa Pathian cu a hnenih a um ruangah David cu ni khat hnu ni khat a cak vivo."},"11":{"text":"Ṭaiar siangpahrang Hiram in an ram ai-awh in David hnenah palai a thlah ih David ih inn saknak dingah sidar thing tla a kuat. Inn saktu dingah zungthiam pawl le lung inn dawlthiamtu pawl tla a kuat."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Israel siangpahrang ah Bawipa Pathian in i nemhnget zo a si, ti le a minung Israel pawl ih ruangah a uknak cu a ṭhansoter a si, ti kha David in a theifiang a si."},"13":{"text":"Hebron ihsin Jerusalem ih a ṭhawn hnuah David in Jerusalem ah nupi le nupisun pawl tam sinsin a nei ih fanu le fapa tampi a nei."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem ih a hrinmi a faale pawl cu Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,"},"15":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, Nefeg, Jafia,"},"16":{"text":"Elishama, Eliada le Elifelet tla an si."},"17":{"text":"David cu Israel siangpahrang a cang zo, ti kha Filistin mi pawl in an theih tikah an ralkap zatein an pok ih David kai dingah an feh. David in cuih thu a theih tikah ral ṭannak ruhkulh innah a vung feh.","title":"Filistin Pawl An Neh (1 San. 14.8-17)"},"18":{"text":"Filistin ralkap pawl cu Refaim Phairawn timi an thleng ih cutawk cu an luah."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Filistin pawl hi ka do pei maw? Ka do asile ka neh pei maw?” tiah Bawipa a sut. Bawipa in, “Feh awla do aw. Nehnak ka lo pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah David cu Baal Perazim ah a feh ih Filistin pawl cu a neh. “Tilian bangin Bawipa in ka ral pawl cu a pah suak a si,” tiah David in a ti. Curuangah a cuih hmun cu Baal Perazim tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Filistin pawl in an milem pawl an tlansan thluh ruangah David le a ralkap pawl in an lak ṭheh."},"22":{"text":"Cule Filistin ralkap pawl cu Refaim Phairawn ah an ra kir sal ih an luah sal."},"23":{"text":"David in Bawipa cu a ron sal ih Bawipa in, “Hitawk ihsi cun na do lo pei. Heel awla an dunglam in balsam thingkung pawl umnak kiang ihsin rak nam hai aw."},"24":{"text":"Thingkung zim parah ke feh thawm na theih asile hmakhatte-ah nam hai aw. Ziangahtile Filistin ralkap pawl neh dingah na hmaiah Bawipa Keimah ka feh zo tinak a si,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"David in Bawipa ih sim vekin a tuah ih Filistin ralkap pawl cu an tlan ih Geba ihsin Gezer tiang a dawi hai."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Israel ralkap lakih a ṭha bik pawl a khawm ih thawng sawmthum an kim.","title":"Thukam Kuang Jerusalem Ah An Fehpi (1 San. 13.1-14 ; 15.25—16.6, 43)"},"2":{"text":"Cherub pahnih karlakih a siangpahrang tokham parih a to Ziangkimtithei Bawipa ih hmin an putter mi Thukam Kuang la dingah acuih ralkap pawl cu a hruai ih Judah ram Baalah khua ah an feh."},"3":{"text":"Thukam Kuang cu cawleng thar parah an ret ih tlang parih Abinadab ih inn ihsin an suahpi. Abinadab ih fapa Uzzah le Ahio in Thukam Kuang a phurtu cawleng cu an kilkhawi phah vivo."},"4":{"text":"Cawleng hmaiah Ahio a feh."},"5":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih hmaiah an lungawi in hla an sak ih tingrisit, ṭingṭang, khuang, mumeek le darsumsel pawl an tum ih David le Israel mi pawl cu an laam thei patawp in an laam ciamco."},"6":{"text":"Cule Nakon ih fang cilnak puum an thlen tikah leng hnuktu cawcang cu an bah ih curuangah Uzzah in a hei dawh ih Thukam Kuang cu a kai ngah."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa Pathian ih thinhengnak cu Uzzah parah meisa bangin a alh ih cutiih ṭihzahnak a neih lo ruangah Uzzah cu Thukam Kuang kiangah cun a thihter."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa a thin a heng ruangah Uzzah a that a si, ti kha David in a theih tikah a ai a thok ih a cuih hmun cu Perez Uzzah tiah an ko. Tuihsun tiangin cuticun an ko ta."},"9":{"text":"Cule David in Bawipa cu a ṭih ih, “Ziangtin so atu-ah Thukam Kuang cu ka ken ngam ding?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah amah ih khua Jerusalem ah fehpi lo dingin a ruat. Git khua ih ummi Obed Edom ih innah a fehpi."},"11":{"text":"Cutawkah Thukam Kuang cu thlathum a um ih Bawipa in Obed Edom le a innsang pawl cu mal a sawm."},"12":{"text":"Thukam Kuang an inn ih a um ruangah Obed Edom le a innsang pawl le a neihmi hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa in mal a sawm, ti kha David in a theih tikah Thukam Kuang cu Jerusalem ih ken dingah lungawi le thatho zetin Obed ih inn ihsin a lak."},"13":{"text":"Cule Thukam Kuang a phurtu pawl kar ruk an kar tikah David in Bawipa ih hnenah cawcang pakhat le a thau mi tuu faate pakhat thawinak ah a pek."},"14":{"text":"Cun David cu puan nemte pakhat lawng a thlaih ih Bawipa thangṭhatnak ah a laam thei patawp in a laam ciamco."},"15":{"text":"Cutiin David le Israel mi pawl in au phah le mumeek tum phah in Thukam Kuang cu Jerusalem khua an thlenpi."},"16":{"text":"Thukam Kuang Jerusalem khua sungih a thlen tikah, Saul ih fanu Mikhal in sangkate in khua a hei zoh ih David cu Bawipa ih hmaiih a laam le a khir rero kha a hmuh tikah David parah a mitkem ngaingai."},"17":{"text":"David ih sak ciami Puanthlam sungah Thukam Kuang cu an rak keng ih an ret. Cuih hnuah David in mei-ur thawinak le remnak thawinak Bawipa ih hnenah a pek."},"18":{"text":"Thawinak pawl a pek ṭheh hnuah Israel mi pawl cu Ziangkimtithei Bawipa ih hminin thluasuah a pe hai."},"19":{"text":"Cun nunau siseh, mipa siseh sang zawlkhat ciar, a ro ih kiomi sa semkhat ciar, le caarmi sabit rah hlom khat ciar a zem hai. Cuih hnuah misenpi cu an inn ciarah an tlung."},"20":{"text":"Amah David khal a innsang tong dingin a tin ve ih Saul ih fanu, a nupi Mikhal in a rak hmuak ih, “Tuihsun Israel siangpahrang cu a hmin a thangzet ual! A hnaṭuantu fala pawl hmaiah mi aa bangin puan paate thawn ningzah hman thiam loin a laam ciamco kha!” tiah a rak ti."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “A minung Israel mi hruaitu ah i tuah ih na pa le a sungkhat pawl lan tahratin keimah sawn i hriltu Bawipa Pathian sunloihnak ah ka laam a si. Bawipa sunloihnak ahcun ka laam rero ko ding ih,"},"22":{"text":"mualpho sinsin khal ka si ko ding. Nang cun zianghman ah i siar lo ding, asinain na timi fala pawl cun in uar zet ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Saul ih fanu Mikhal cu a thih tiang faate a nei lo."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David siangpahrang cu ral nei loin ram uktu a si ih a siangpahrang inn ah daitein a um ngah tikah,","title":"David Hnenah Nathan Thucah Mi (1 San. 17.1-15)"},"2":{"text":"Profet Nathan hnenah, “Zohhnik, kei ka umnak hi sidar thingih sakmi inn a si ih, Pathian ih Thukam Kuang sawn cu thlam sungih ret a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Nathan in, “Tuah na duhmi cu tuah aw. Bawipa na hnenah a um a si,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a cuih zan ah Bawipa in Nathan hnenah,"},"5":{"text":"“David ka salpa hnenah va feh awla, ‘Ka umnak dingah biakinn a saktu ding cu nangmah na si lo."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Izipt ram in ka suahpi ihsin tuihsun tiang biakinn sungah ka um dah lo. Ka fehnak kipah puanthlam sungah ka um ringring."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi pawl thawn ka fehnak hmuahhmuah ah Israel hotu dingih ṭuanvo ka pekmi hruaitu pawl hnenah, ziangah so ka hrangah sidar thingih biakinn nan sak lo, tiah ka ti dah lo."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah David cu sim awla Keimah Ziangkimtithei Bawipa ih ṭongmi cu hiti in a si: Ka minung Israel mi pawl hruaitu dingah nangmah cu hramlakih tuu na khalhnak ihsin ka lo ko."},"9":{"text":"Keimah cu na fehnak hmuahhmuahah ka tel ih na ral pawl ka neh thluh. Cule leilung tlunih mi tum bik tlukin mi hminthangzet ah ka lo tuah ding."},"10":{"text":"Ka minung Israel hrangah hmun ka hril ding ih cutawkah zohmanih hnaihnok nawn loin an um ding. Hi ram an thlen thok ihsin anmah cu mi puarthau pawl in an do ringring. Sikhalsehla cuticun a si nawn lo ding. Na ral pawl hnen ihsin ka lo hum ding ih tefa sin tampi ka lo pe ding, tiah thu ka lo kam.","merge":"11"},"12":{"text":"Na nunnak a cem ih na pu le na pa hnenah phum na si tik khalah na fapa pakhat cu siangpahrang ah ka tuah ding ih a ukmi ram cu ka cakter ding."},"13":{"text":"Ka hrangah biakinn a sak pei ih a tefa sin pawl ih ram an uknak cu kumkhua in a hmun ding."},"14":{"text":"Keimah cu a pa ka si ding ih amah cu ka fapa a si ding. Sualnak a tuah tik khalah a pa in a fapa cu nun a sim ṭheu vekin amah cu nun ka sim ding. Milai in nunsimnak ah fungfeek an hman bangin ka hmang ding."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a hnen ihsin ka duhdawtnak cu ka lakir lo ding. Nangmah siangpahrang na sinak dingih Saul hnen ihsin ka duhdawtnak ka lakkir vek cun ka lakir lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Tesinfa na nei vivo ding ih na uknak cu a kumkhua in ka hmunter ding. Na siangpahrang uknak cu a cem dah lo ding,’ tiah va sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Pathian in a hnenih a run phuan mi hmuahhmuah cu Nathan in David hnenah a sim thluh."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang David cu Bawipa umnak Puanthlam ah a feh ih a to ih thla a cam: “Maw Bawipa Pathian, kei hi zianghman ka si lo! Ka hrangih thil na tuah mi hmuahhmuah co dingah ka tlak hrimhrim lo. Ka innsang pawl khal an tlak lo.","title":"David Ih Lungawinak Thlacam (1 San. 17.16-27)"},"19":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian, hi hnakih tam deuh khal na tuah lai ding a si. Hmailam tikcu ih ka tesinfa pawl hrangah thukamnak na tuah zo. A cuih thu cu, maw Bawipa , ka hnenah na fiangter zo."},"20":{"text":"Maw Pathian, lo dil ding zianghman a um nawn lo. Na salpa kei hi i thei thluh ko."},"21":{"text":"Hi thil hmuahhmuah hi na tuahmi le na tummi an si. Hi tlukih mangbangza thil hi nangmah in i theiter thluh zo."},"22":{"text":"Maw Bawipa Pathian, ziangtluk mangbangza so na si? Nangmah bangtuk zohman an um lo; kanmah rori ih kan theih thluh zo vekin nangmah bangtuk Pathian zohman an um lo."},"23":{"text":"Nangmah ih minung si dingih na run zomi Israel mi vek leilung tlunah zo miphun hman an um lo. Nangmah in na hmin cu na thanter ih na minung pawl hrangah thil maksak le mangbangza tampi na tuah a si. Mi phundang pawl le an khawzing pawl cu na minung pawl lamzin tluangter dingah na dawihlo ṭheh. Israel mi pawl cu na ta si dingah Izipt ram ihsin na luatter zomi an si."},"24":{"text":"Na miphun Israel pawl cu kumkhua in na minung ah na tuah ih Bawipa Nangmah cu an Pathian na si zo."},"25":{"text":"“Curuangah Bawipa Pathian, keimah le ka innsang hrangih na thukammi hmuahhmuah cu a kumkhua in kimter hram awla, ka tuah ding na timi cu tuah thluh ko aw."},"26":{"text":"Na hmin cu kumkhua in a thang ding ih mi in, ‘Cungnungbik Bawipa cu Israel uktu Pathian a si,’ tiah an ti ding. Cun ka tesinfa pawl cu cat loin siangpahrang siter hram aw."},"27":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, ka tesinfa pawl siangpahrang an si ringringnak ding cu keimah na salpa hnenih na langter zo ruangah na hnenih ral ṭhazet in thla ka cam ngamnak a si."},"28":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa Pathian, nang cu Pathian na si ih, na thukammi cu na kimter ringring. Ka hnenah hitluk ṭha thukamnak na tuah zo."},"29":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa , na mithmai ṭha cotu an si ringringnak dingah ka tesinfa pawl cu nangmah in atu-ah thlawsuahnak pe hram aw. Bawipa Pathian, nangmah in hi thukamnak cu na tuah zo ih ka tefa pawl ih parah na thlawsuahnak cu a kumkhua in um hram seh,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Filistin pawl cu a neh ih Filistin mi pawl ih an ukmi ram pawl khal a long thluh.","title":"David Ih Ral Nehnak (1 San. 18.1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Moab mi pawl khal a neh ih a kaihmi pawl cu leilung parah a bawhter ih hridai in a tah hnuah milai ṭhenthum ih ṭhenhnih cu a that ih ṭhenkhat cu a zuah. Cutiin Moab mi pawl cu David ih kuthnuai ah an um ih ngunkhuai an pek."},"3":{"text":"Cule tlunta Eufrates Tiva kiangkap ih ram pawl neh kir duh ih a feh zawng ah Zobah ram siangpahrang, Rehob ih fapa Hadadezer cu David in a do ih a neh."},"4":{"text":"David in Hadadezer ih rang ralkap thawngkhat zasarih le ke ralkap thawng kul a kai ih leng hnuktu rang pawl cu an kaiza tha a sat cat thluh.
