Amah cu Dodo ih fapa a si ih Ahoh hrin a si. Voikhat ah Eleazar le David in raldo dingih a khawm-aw mi Filistin mi pawl cu ṭih loin an dinhnawh ngam a si. Israel mi pawl cu an tlanhlo ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Asinain Eleazar cu a umnak hmun ihsin a ṭang ih Filistin mi pawl cu a ralnam in a sat ciamco hai ih a kut a hit ṭheh ih a ralnam humnak hman pharh thei nawn lo tiangin a that. A cuih ni ah Bawipa in a cakzet mi ral a neh. Cuṭheh in Israel mi pawl cu a thi mi pawl ih ralthuam lak ding lawngah Eleazar ih hnenah an ra kir."},"11":{"text":"Pathumnak cu Harar mi, Agee ih fapa Shammah a si. Filistin ralkap pawl cu Lehi ah an khawm aw. Lehi ahcun bete lo pakhat a um. Filistin mi in Israel mi pawl cu an dawi thluh."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Shammah cu lo sungih a dinnak hmun in a ṭang ih lo cu a kil ih Filistin mi pawl tampi a that. A cuih ni ah Bawipa in a cakzet mi ral a neh a si."},"13":{"text":"Lo ih rawlkhawm a cut zik thlang tikah Filistin ralkap pawl bur khat cu Refaim Phairawn ah an um. Cule “Mi Sawmthum,” sungih pathum pawl cu Adullam Lungpuk ah David hnenah an vung feh."},"14":{"text":"David cu ralhruang sungah a um ih, Filistin ralkap bur khat cu Bethlehem ah an um."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah David cu a lung a leng ih, “Aw, Bethlehem kotka kiangih a ummi tikhur ih tidai kha khuat khat talin in petu um hai sehla ka va duh ve,” tiah a hrum ruangro."},"16":{"text":"Cule hminthang zet mi ralkap pathum pawl cun Filistin ral pawl cu an umnak ah an va nor ih tikhur ihsin tidai an khai ih David cu an pek. Sikhalsehla David in a in lo. Bawipa hnenih thawinak tidai ah a hmang."},"17":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , hi tidai cu ziangtinso ka in thei ding?. An nunnak pek ngam ih an khaimi a si ruangah hi tidai ka in ahcun ka ralkap pathum ih thisen in ka bang ding,” a ti. Curuangah a cuih tidai cu in loin thawinakah a thlet. A tlunih porh tlak hnaṭuanmi pawl cu hminthang ralkap pathum ih tuah mi an si."},"18":{"text":"Joab ih nau Zeruiah ih fapa, Abishai cu “Mi Sawmthum,” ih hotu a si. Voikhat cu a feipi pakhat thawn ral zathum a do ih a that thluh. Curuangah “Mi Sawmthum,” sungah a hmin a thang ngaingai."},"19":{"text":"Sawmthum sungih hminthang bik a si ruangah an hotu ah a cang. Asinain “Mi Pathum,” pawl cu a tluk lo."},"20":{"text":"Cun Kabzeel khuami, Jehoiada ih fapa, Benaiah cu ralkap hminthangzet le raldonak ih ralṭhazet a si. Moab ralkap hminthangzet pahnih tla a that. Vur a tlak sun ni khat ah khur sungah luhhnawh tahratin kiosa pakhat tla a that."},"21":{"text":"Cule Izipt mi pa mi tumzet, feipi a kengtu pa tla a that. Benaiah cun talhtum thawn a nam ih Izipt pa ih kut sungih sin feipi cu a long ih amah ih feipi lala cun a thatta."},"22":{"text":"Benaiah ih ralṭhat zia cu cubangtuk a si. Amah cu “Mi Sawmthum,” lakih pakhat a si."},"23":{"text":"Sawmthum lakah mi hleice a si. Asinain pathum pawl cu a tluk lo. David in amah kilvengtu pawl hotu ah a ret."},"24":{"text":"Hminthang “Sawmthum,” sungih a telmi midang pawl cu a tanglam pawl hi an si: Joab ih nau Asahel, Bethlehem ihsin Dodo ih fapa Elhanan,"},"25":{"text":"Harod ihsin Shammah, Harod ihsin Elika,"},"26":{"text":"Pelet ihsin Helez, Tekoa ihsin Ikkesh ih fapa Ira,"},"27":{"text":"Anathoth ihsin Abiezer, Hushah ihsin Mebunnai,"},"28":{"text":"Ahoh ihsin Zalmon, Netofah ihsin Maharai,"},"29":{"text":"Netofah ihsin Baanah ih fapa Heleb, Benjamin ram Gibeah ihsin Ribai ih fapa Ittai,"},"30":{"text":"Pirathon ihsin Benaiah, Gaash kiang phairawn ram ihsin Hiddai,"},"31":{"text":"Arabah ihsin Abialbon, Bahurim ihsin Azmaveth,"},"32":{"text":"Shaalbon ihsin Eliahba, Jashen ih fapa pawl, Jonathan,"},"33":{"text":"Harar ihsin Shammah, Harar ihsin Sharar ih fapa Ahiam,"},"34":{"text":"Maakah ihsin Ahasbai ih fapa Elifelet, Gilo ihsin Ahithofel ih fapa Eliam,"},"35":{"text":"Karmel ihsin Hezro, Arab ihsin Paarai,"},"36":{"text":"Zobah ihsin Nathan ih fapa Igal, Gad ihsin Bani,"},"37":{"text":"Ammon ihsin Zelek, Beeroth ihsin Joab ih hriamnam phurtu Zeruiah ih fapa Naharai."},"38":{"text":"Jattir ihsin Ira. Jattir ihsin Gareb,"},"39":{"text":"Hit mi pa Uriah. An zateón ralkap hminthang sawmthum le pasarih an um."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel parah Bawipa cu a thin a heng sal ih an hnenih harsatnak thlenter dingah David cu, “Feh awla Israel le Judah mi pawl mipum siar aw,” tiah a forh.","title":"David In Mipum A Siar (1 San. 21.1-27)"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah David in a ralkap hotu ralbawi Joab cu a ko ih, “Na kuthnuai ih bawi pawl thawn kan ram khatlam deng Dan ihsin khatlam deng Beersheba tiang feh awla Israel miphun hmuahhmuah mipum va siar aw. Minung ziangzat an um ti a theih ka duh,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Asinain Joab in, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, Bawipa na Pathian in Israel mi pawl cu atu hnakin a let za in pungzaiter hram sehla na nunsung ah cumi cu hmu dingin run tuah hram seh. Asinain maw siangpahrang bawipa, ziangah so mipum siar cu na duh?” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla siangpahrang in Joab le a kuthnuai ih bawi pawl cu a thupek mi vekin a thlunter ih curuangah an suak ih Israel mi siar dingah an feh."},"5":{"text":"Jordan tiva an tan ih Gad ram sung phairawn ih a ummi Aroer khawpi ih thlanglam ah an riak. Cutawk ihsin Jazer ah an hung feh ih,"},"6":{"text":"Gilead le Hit ramsung Kadesh ah an hung thleng. Cule Dan an hung thlen hnuah cutawk ihsin nitlaknak lamah an her-aw ih Sidon an va thleng."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hnuah ralhruang ih kulh mi khawpi ṭai-ar khua ah an vung feh ih cutawk ihsin Hiv khawpi pawl le Kanaan khawpi pawl ah an thleng. A netabik ah Judah ram thlanglam bikih a ummi Beersheba khua an thleng."},"8":{"text":"Cuticun an ram pumpuluk an tlawng ṭheh ih thla kua le ni kul an rei hnuah Jerusalem khua ah an kir."},"9":{"text":"Siangpahrang hnenah, “Raldo dingin hriamnam a keng theitu mipa cu Israel ram ah thawng zariat an um ih, Judah ram ah thawng zanga an um,” tiah an va sim."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cutiih mipum siarnak an tuah ngah tikah, David cu a thin a nuam lo ngaingai ih Bawipa ih hnenah, “Thil sualzet ka tuah zo a si. Maw Bawipa , ka sualnak i ngaidam hram aw. Aatthlakza ka tuah a si,” tiah a dil."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah David ih puithiam a ṭuantu, profet Gad hnenah Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu a ra thleng ih, “David ih hril dingah thil pathum ka pek. Pakhatkhat hril-aw sehla a parah ka kimter ding, tiah David va sim aw,” a ti. A thaizing David a thawh tikah,","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"profet Gad cu a hnenah a ra thleng ih Bawipa ih ṭongmi cu a ra sim. “Hi pathum lakah khuiso na hril ding? Na uk sung hmuahhmuah ah paam kum thum sung thlen maw? Asilole na ral pawl hnen ihsin thlathum sung tlan rero maw? Asilole na ram sungih ni thum sung pulhnat thlen so na hril sawn ding? ṭhatein ruatta awla, Bawipa hnenih va sim kir dingah thu i let aw,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Ka mang a bangtuk aw! Sikhalsehla minung kut sungih thlen hnak cun Bawipa ih kut sungah thleng ninglaw! Ziangahtile Bawipa cu mi zaangfah thiam a si,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in Israel ram sungah a cuih zing ih thokin a tiamkammi tikcu tiang pulhnat a tlunter. Israel ram pumpuluk ah Israel mi thawng sawmsarih an thi."},"16":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih vancungmi in Jerusalem khua a siatsuah zik tikah, Israel mi hrem nawn lo dingin Bawipa cu a thinlung a thleng-aw sal ih mi a that rerotu vancungmi hnenah cun, “Bang aw! Tawk thlang seh,” tiah a ti. Culai fangah vancungmi cu Jebus mi Araunah ih fang cilnak puum kiangah a um."},"17":{"text":"Cule Israel mi a that rerotu vancungmi cu David in a hmuh tikah Bawipa ih hnenah, “A mawhtu cu keimah ka si. Thilsual a tuahtu cu keimah ka si. Hi mizonzai na milai pawl in ziang sualnak so an tuah? Na hremnak cu keimah le ka innsang parah thleng sawnseh,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"A cuih ni ah profet Gad cu David hnenah a va feh ih, “Araunah ih fang cilnak puum ah hung feh awla Bawipa ih hrangah biakṭheng hung dawl aw,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Gad ih simmi Bawipa ih thupek cu David in a ngai ih a hung feh."},"20":{"text":"Cule Araunah in a vun zoh tikah siangpahrang bawipa le a kuthnuai ih bawi pawl an hun rero kha a vun hmu. Cuvete in a feh ih David ih hmaiah leilung dai in a kun ih,"},"21":{"text":"“Maw siangpahrang bawipa, ziangah so kei na salpa hi i ra len?” tiah a rak sut. Cutikah David in, “Mi tampi an thihnak pulhnat hi a reh theinak dingah na fang cilnak puum hi lo lei tahratin Bawipa ih hrangih biakṭheng dawl ka duh ruangah ka ra a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Araunah in, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, na ṭul mi hmuahhmuah lak awla Bawipa ih hnenah cun pe aw. Biakṭheng parih mei-ur thawinak hrangah hinah cawcang an um. Cun tih ding zanthing ah caw hngawngkol le fang cilnak zial pawl an um,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Araunah in a neihmi hmuahhmuah cu siangpahrang hnenah a pek ih, “ Bawipa na Pathian in na thawinak cu lo sang hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Asinain siangpahrang bawipa in, “Asilo, a man ka lo pe thluh ding. A man zianghman ka pek lomi cu Bawipa ka Pathian hnenih thawinak ah ka pe lo ding,” a ti. Cule Araunah ih puum le cawcang cu ngun tangka sawmnga in a lei."},"25":{"text":"Cutawkah biakṭheng cu a dawl ih mei-ur thawinak le remnak thawinak cu Bawipa ih hnenah a pek. Cuticun Bawipa in a thlacamnak cu a ngai ih Israel ram sungih pulhnat cu a reh."}}}}},"11":{"info":{"name":"1 Siangpahrang","shortname":"1 Sian.","abbr":[],"desc":"1 siangpahrang (1 kings)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang David cu a tarzet zo ih puan an thuah rero naón a khua a hlum thei lo.","title":"David A Tar Zo"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah a kuthnuai ih bawi pawl in, “Siangpahrang bawipa, na hnenih um dingah le a lo tuamhlawmtu dingah fala pakhat kan hawl pei. Na hnenah a it pei ih na khua a hlum ding,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Israel ramsung hmuahhmuah ah fala mawi an hawl ih Shunem khua ah Abishag timi fala an hmu ih siangpahrang hnenah an rak keng."},"4":{"text":"Abishag cu fala mawizet a si ih siangpahrang bawipa cu ṭhatein a zoh ih a tuamhlawm. Asinain siangpahrang bawipa cun nupi vekin a ihpi lo."},"5":{"text":"Absalom a thih hnuah David le Haggith ih fapa Adonijah cu a nungmi lakah fapa upa bik a si. Mi piangzet a si ih siangpahrang can a tum ringring mi a si ih “Siangpahrang ka si ding” a ti ṭheu. Asinain ziangthu hmanah David in a kawk dah lo. Adonijah in amah ih hrangah rang le rangleng pawl a ret ih, amah kilvengtu dingah minung sawmnga a ret.","title":"Adonijah In Siangpahrang A Cuh","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Adonijah in Zeruiah fapa Joab le puithiam Abiathar tla a tong ih annih khal in a tummi cu an lungkimpi. (Zeruiah cu Joab ih nu a si.)"},"8":{"text":"Asinain puithiam Zadok, Jehoiada fapa Benaiah, profet Nathan, Shimei, Rei le David kilvengtu ralkap pawl cu Adonijah lamah an ṭang lo."},"9":{"text":"Voikhat ah Adonijah in Enrogel tikhur kiangih a ummi Roheleth Lungpi an timi hmunah thawinak a pek ih tuu le caw le a thau zetmi caw faate tampi a that ih, rawl ei dingah a unau dang pawl le siangpahrang David kuthnuai ih bawi pawl a sawm thluh."},"10":{"text":"Asinain a nau Solomon le profet Nathan le Benaiah cu a sawm lo. Siangpahrang kilvengtu pawl khal zohman a sawm lo."},"11":{"text":"Cule Nathan cu Solomon ih nu Bathsheba hnenah a feh ih, “Haggith fapa Adonijah siangpahrang a cang zo a si tihi na thei zo lo maw? Cuih thu cu siangpahrang David in zianghman a thei lo.","title":"Solomon Siangpahrang A Cang"},"12":{"text":"Nangmah ih nunnak le na fapa Solomon ih nunnak na hum duh a si ahcun na tuah dingah thu ka lo sim ding."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang David hnenah zamrangte in va feh awla a hnenah, ‘Maw Siangpahrang bawipa, ka fapa Solomon cu nangmah ih ai-awhtu si dingah thu i kam zo a si lo maw? Ziangtin so atu ah Adonijah sawn siangpahrang ih a can riangri?’ tiah va ti aw."},"14":{"text":"Cutiih siangpahrang bawipa na biak laiah cun keimah khal ka rung lut ding ih na thusimmi a dik a si tinak ka ra sim ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Bathsheba cu siangpahrang ihnak khaan ah David tong dingah a feh. David cu a kum a upa zet thlang a si ruangah Shunem mi falanu Abishag cun a rak tuamhlawm rero."},"16":{"text":"Bathsheba cu Siangpahrang David hmaiah a kun ih David in, “Ziang so na hai?” tiah a rak sut."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Bathsheba in, “Siangpahrang bawipa, ka fapa Solomon cu nangmah ih ai-awhtu siangpahrang si dingah Bawipa na Pathian hmin saal in thu na kam zo a si."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu-ah Adonijah siangpahrang a cang zo ih nang in cuih thu cu zianghman na thei lo."},"19":{"text":"Caw tampi le tuu le a thaumi caw faate tampi that in thawinak a pek ih, rawl eitlangnak ah na fapa pawl, puithiam Abiathar le ralkap hotu bawi Joab pawl a sawm a si. Asinain na fapa Solomon cu a sawm lo."},"20":{"text":"Maw Siangpahrang bawipa, nangmah hnuah zoso siangpahrang a ṭuan ding ti theih duh ah, ziangtikah so siangpahrang bawipa in thu in than ding tiah Israel mi hmuahhmuah in nangmah lawng an lo zoh a si."},"21":{"text":"Na simta lo a si ahcun, na thih hnuah keimah le ka fapa Solomon cu mi zuarthlaitu tlukah in tuah ding a si,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutiih a ṭong rero lai ahcun,"},"23":{"text":"profet Nathan a ra thleng, tiah siangpahrang bawipa cu an sim. Cule Nathan cu a vung lut ih, siangpahrang hmaiah cun a kun ih,"},"24":{"text":"siangpahrang bawipa cu, “Maw Siangpahrang bawipa, Adonijah cu nangmah ai-awh dingah na than zo maw si?"},"25":{"text":"Tuih sunah thawinak hmunah a feh ih caw tampi le tuu le a thaumi caw faate tampi that in thawinak a pek; na fapa pawl, na ralkap hotu bawi Joab le puithiam Abiathar a sawm. Atu-ah hin rawl einak puai an tuah ih, ‘Siangpahrang Adonijah a nunkhua sauseh,’ tiah an au ciamco."},"26":{"text":"Asinain keimah le, puithiam Zadok le, Benaiah le, Solomon cu in sawm lo."},"27":{"text":"Na kuthnuai bawi pawl hman nangmah ih ai-awhtu zo a si ding ti na sim hrih lo ih hibangtuk thil an tuah hi siangpahrang bawipa nangmah ih lungkimmi a si maw?” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Siangpahrang David in, “Bathsheba hei ko sal uh,” a ti. Bathsheba cu a rung lut ih David ih hmai ahcun a ding."},"29":{"text":"Cule Siangpahrang David in Bathsheba hnenah, “Harsatnak a phunphun ihsin i humhimtu Bawipa hmin saal in thu ka lo kam a si:"},"30":{"text":"Na fapa Solomon cu keimah ai-awhtu siangpahrang a si ding, tiah Israel ih Pathian Bawipa hmin saal in thu ka lo kam cia mi cu tuih sunah ka kimter ding,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah Bathsheba cu a kun ih, “Siangpahrang ka bawipa cu a nunkhua sau hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Siangpahrang David in Zadok, Nathan le Benaiah ko dingin thu a pek. An ra thleng ih,"},"33":{"text":"an hnenah, “Ka kuthnuai ih bawi pawl thawn feh uhla ka fapa Solomon cu ka rang parah toter uhla, Gihon Tivate ah vun thlun uh."},"34":{"text":"Cutawkah puithiam Zadok le profet Nathan in Solomon cu Israel siangpahrang ah hriak nan culh pei. Cule tawtawrawt nan tum pei ih, ‘Siangpahrang Solomon a nunkhua sau hram seh,’ tiah nan au pei."},"35":{"text":"Cun hitawk ah nan hun thlun sal pei ih ka siangpahrang tokham parah a to pei. Solomon cu Israel le Judah uktu dingih ka hril zomi a si ruangah keimah ai-awhtu a si pei,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cutikah Jehoiada fapa Benaiah in, “Na sim vekin tuah a si pei. Bawipa na Pathian in hngetter hram seh."},"37":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian cu nangmah siangpahrang bawipa hnenih a um vekin Solomon hnen khalah um hramsehla, a uknak cu nangmah ih uknak hnak hman in ṭhangso sin hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cule Zadok le Nathan le Benaiah le siangpahrang kiltu ralkap pawl in Solomon cu Siangpahrang David ih rang parah an toter ih Gihon Tivate ahcun an vun fehpi."},"39":{"text":"Puanthlam thianghlim sung ihsin a rak kenmi olif hriak dur cu Zadok in a lak ih Solomon hriak a culh. Cuthluh in tawtawrawt an tum ih an zatein, “Siangpahrang Solomon a nunkhua sau hram seh,” tiah an au."},"40":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon cu an zatein siangpahrang inn ah an hun thlun sal ih, phirivau tum phah in, lungawi aipuang in an au ciamco ih cuih an thawmvang ruangah leilung tiang a hnin ṭheh."},"41":{"text":"Adonijah le a sawmmi pawl in an rawl ei an ṭheh zawng ah cuih thawmvang cu an thei. Joab in tawtawrawt tummi cu a theih tikah, “Khawsung ih thawmvang cu ziangso a si?” a ti."},"42":{"text":"A ṭong hman a cem hlanah puithiam Abiathar ih fapa Jonathan a ra thleng. Cule Adonijah in Jonathan hnenah cun, “Rung lut aw. Nang cu rinsantlak na si ih thu ṭha na rak keng hmang ding,” a ti."},"43":{"text":"Jonathan in, “Thu ṭha a si lo. Siangpahrang bawipa David in Solomon cu siangpahrang ah a tuah zo."},"44":{"text":"David in Zadok le Nathan le Benaiah le siangpahrang kiltu ralkap pawl a thlah ih Solomon an thlun. Siangpahrang ih rang an toter ih,"},"45":{"text":"Gihon Tivate ah Zadok le Nathan in hriak an culh. Cule an kir ih mi hmuahhmuah lungawi in an au ih khawpi sung cu a buai celcel a si. Nan theih mi cu cuih thawmvang a si."},"46":{"text":"Solomon cu siangpahrang a si zo."},"47":{"text":"Cuih tlunah siangpahrang kuthnuai ih bawi pawl siangpahrang David hnenah an feh ih upatnak an pek hnuah, ‘Na Pathian in Solomon cu nangmah hnakih hminthang deuh ah tuah hram seh. A uknak cu nangmah ih uknak hnakin ṭhangso hram seh,’ an ti. Cule Siangpahrang David cu Pathian upat in a ihkhun parah a lu a kun ih,"},"48":{"text":"‘Ka sungsuak ka faate pakhat cu keimah ai-awhtu siangpahrang ih a tuah ruangah le cumi hmuta ding ih ka nunnak i zuah ruangah Israel ih Pathian, Bawipa cu thangṭhat in umseh,’ tiah thla a cam,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Cutikah Adonijah ih rualpi pawl cu thinphang in an pok ih anmah ih duhnak ciarah an tlung."},"50":{"text":"Adonijah khal Solomon a ṭih ruangah a thin a phang ih Puanthlam Thianghlim sungah a feh ih biakṭheng ki pawl a va pom."},"51":{"text":"Adonijah in Solomon a ṭih ruangah biakṭheng ki a pom ti kha Siangpahrang Solomon an sim. Adonijah in, “Hmaisabik ah, keimah that lo dingin Siangpahrang Solomon in ka hnenah thu kamseh,” tiah a ti ih cumi khal Siangpahrang Solomon hnenah an sim."},"52":{"text":"Cutikah Solomon in, “Ka hnuai ih a dor a si ahcun a lu parih samphang khat hman dai a si lo pei. Asinain ka hnuai ih a dor lo ahcun a thi pei,” tiah a ti."},"53":{"text":"Cule Siangpahrang Solomon in Adonijah cu a ko ih biakṭheng ihsin an va hruai. Adonijah cu a ra ih siangpahrang hmaiah cun a kun. Solomon in, “Inn ah va tlung aw,” a ti."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David cu a thihnak tikcu a nai thlang ih a fapa Solomon a ko ih thu a cah:","title":"David In Solomon Thu A Cah"},"2":{"text":"“Kei cu ka thi thlang ding. Ka thih hnuah ralṭhazet le pacang bang in um awla,"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa na Pathian ih thupekmi pawl cu tuah aw. Moses Daan sungih ngan vekin, Bawipa ih Daan le thupekmi hmuahhmuah cu thlun awla, cuticun na thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah ah le na fehnak kipah na hlawh a tling ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah, ‘Na tesinfa pawl in ka thupekmi an thinlung le an thazaang zate thawn an thlun a si ahcun Israel ram an uk ringring ding’ tiah thu i kam a si. A Daan le a thupekmi pawl na thlun a si ahcun Bawipa in a thukamnak cu a kimter ding."},"5":{"text":"“Cuih tlunah thil dang na theih dingih ka duhmi cu Joab ih i ti daan hi a si. Israel ralkap pawl hotu, Ner fapa Abner le Jether fapa Amasa cu Joab in a that a si. Ral an do laiih mi an thahmi phulak in ral um nawn lo hnuah an thisen a luanter. Mawhnak a nei lomi a thah ih, a taikhap le a kedam ah thisen a hnih ruangah, mimawh a si."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah ruat ṭha awla, daitein tar thih ih a thih tiang cu na zuah lo pei."},"7":{"text":"“Asinain Gilead mi Barzillai ih fapa pawl cu ṭhatein na zoh pei. Ziangahtile na u Absalom ṭih ih ka tlan laiah i zaangfahtu an si."},"8":{"text":"“Cule Benjamin ram Bahurim khua ih Gera fapa Shimei khal na hngilh lo dingah ka duh. Mahanaim ka thlen ni ah nasa zetin i cam ciamco. Asinain Jordan Tiva ka thlen tikah i rak hmuak ih amah cu that lo dingah Bawipa hmin saal in thu ka kamta a si."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cuti men cun na luatter lo pei. Thuruat thiam na si ih that lo cun na zuah hrimhrim lo pei,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cuih hnuah David cu a thi ih Jerusalem ah an phum.","title":"David a Thi"},"11":{"text":"Israel ram kum sawmli sung a uk. Hebron in kum sarih sung a uk ih Jerusalem in kum sawmthum le kum thum a uk."},"12":{"text":"David ih ai ah a fapa Solomon siangpahrang a cang ih a ram cu hngetzet in a uk."},"13":{"text":"Cule Adonijah cu Solomon nu Bathsheba hnenah a leng. Adonijah ih nu cu Haggith a si. Bathsheba in Adonijah hnen ah, “Thu ṭha in na ra leng maw?” tiah a sut. Adonijah in, “Asi, thuṭha in ka ra.","title":"Adonijah A Thi"},"14":{"text":"Thil pakhat dil duhmi ka lo nei,” a ti. Bathsheba in, “Ziang so a si?” tiah a sut."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Adonijah in, “Siangpahrang cang zo ding ka si ih, Israel mi khal in siangpahrang a si ding, tiah in rak zum ti cu na thei. Asinain zumnak vekin thil a cang lo ih Bawipa ih lungkimnak in ka nau Solomon sawn siangpahrang a cang."},"16":{"text":"Cu a si ruangah thil pakhat ka lo dil duh ih i el hram hlah aw,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Bathsheba in, “Ziang so a si? I sim hnik!” a ti. Adonijah in, “Shunem mi fala Abishag cu ka nupi dingah Siangpahrang Solomon i biak sak aw, nang cu a lo el lo ding tiah ka zum,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Bathsheba in, “A tha! Siangpahrang ka lo ton sak ding,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"A tivek in Bathsheba cu a feh ih Adonijah ai-awh in siangpahrang a va tong. A nu a rat kha a hmuh tikah siangpahrang Solomon cu a ding ih a nu ih hmaiah cun upatnak in a lu a kun. Cuih hnuah a siangpahrang tokham ah a to ih, a nu cu a vorhlam ah tokham dang pakhat parah a to."},"20":{"text":"Cule a nu in, “Thil pakhat ka lo dil duh ih i el siang hlah aw,” a ti. “Ziang so a si, ka nu? Ka lo el lo ding,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"A nu in, “Abishag hi na u Adonijah ih nupi ah coter aw,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in, “Ziangah so Adonijah ih hrangah Abishag cu i dil? A hrangah siangpahrang tokham tla hi dil lawlawta he! Adonijah cu ka u a si ih puithiam Abiathar le Joab tla amah ih hnenah an ṭang a sisi!” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cule Solomon in,” Adonijah in himi i dil ruangah amah ih nunnak in a kuan pei. A nunnak in a kuan lo a si ahcun Pathian in keimah i that seh."},"24":{"text":"Ka pa David ih tokham parah Bawipa in hngetzet in i toh zo. Bawipa in a thukamnak a kimter ih uknak cu keimah le ka tesinfa pawl hnenah in pek zo a si. Curuangah a nungmi Pathian hmin saal in thukamnak ka tuah: Tuih sunah Adonijah cu a thi pei,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah Siangpahrang Solomon in Benaiah hnenah thu a pek ih, Benaiah cu a feh ih Adonijah a va that."},"26":{"text":"Cule Siangpahrang Solomon in puithiam Abiathar hnenah, “Na khua le na ram Anathoth ah tlung aw. Thi tlak na si naón ka pa David hnenih na um laiah Bawipa ih Thukham retnak Kuang kiltu na rak si ih, ka pa ih harsatnak hmuahhmuah a tuarpitu na si ruangah atu ahcun ka lo that lo ding,” tiah a ti.","title":"Abiathar An Dawi, Joab A Thi"},"27":{"text":"Solomon in Abiathar cu Bawipa ih puithiam hna a ṭuannak ihsin a dawi ih, cuticun Bawipa in Shiloh ah puithiam Eli le a tesinfa pawl thu a rak phuannak a kimter a si."},"28":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Joab in a rak thei. (Joab cu Absalom ṭantu a si lo naón Adonijah ṭantu a si.) Curuangah Bawipa ih Puanthlam ah a tlan ih biakṭheng ki pawl cu a va pom."},"29":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon hnenah, Joab cu Bawipa ih Puanthlam ah a tlan ih biakṭheng kiangah a um, ti thu a than tikah Solomon in Joab hnenah mi a thlah ih biakṭheng ih a tlannak thu an va sut. Joab in, “Solomon ka ṭih ruangah Bawipa hnenah ka tlan a si,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Joab that dingin Solomon in Benaiah a thlah."},"30":{"text":"Benaiah cu Bawipa ih Puanthlam ah a va feh in Joab hnenah, “Siangpahrang in ra suakseh a lo ti,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Joab in, “Ka suak lo ding. Hinah ka thi sawn ding,” a ti. Benaiah cu siangpahrang hnenah a va kir ih Joab ih ṭongmi cu a va sim."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah Solomon in, “Joab ih ṭongmi vekin tuah aw. That aw la phum aw. Cuti cun Joab in mawhnak nei lo minung pahnih a thah ruangah keimah le ka tesinfa pawl cu mawhphurtu kan si nawn lo ding."},"32":{"text":"Ka pa David ih theih loin mi a thah ruangah Bawipa in Joab parah phuba a la ding. Joab in amah hnakih a ṭha deuh mi minung pahnih, mawhnak nei lomi, Israel ralkap hotu Abner le Judah ralkap hotu Amasa a that a si."},"33":{"text":"A thahmi pawl ih thisen cu Joab le a tefa sin pawl ih parah kumkhua in a tla ding. Sikhalsehla siangpahrang tokham parih a totu David ih tesinfa pawl parah cun Bawipa ih thlawsuahnak cu kumkhua in a thleng ding a si,” a ti."},"34":{"text":"Curuangah Benaiah cu Bawipa ih Puanthlam ah a va feh ih Joab cu a that hnuah hramlakah amah ih inn ah a phum."},"35":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in Joab ai ah Benaiah cu ralkap hotu bawi ah a tuah ih Abiathar ai ah Zadok kha puithiam ah a tuah."},"36":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Shimei a ko ih a hnenah, “Na hrangah Jerusalem ahhin inn sak aw. Hinah um awla hi khua ihsin khui hmanah feh hlah aw.","title":"Shimei Thihnak"},"37":{"text":"Na suak ih Kidron Tivate na lan a si ahcun na thi ding. Cutikah mawh phurtu cu nangmah na si ding,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cutikah Shimei in, “A ṭha, Siangpahrang Bawipa; na sim vekin ka tuah ding,” tiah a ti. Cuticun Jerusalem ah reipi a um."},"39":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kum thum hnuah Shimei ih sal pahnih cu Gath siangpahrang, Maakah fapa Akhish hnenah an tlan. Gath ramah a sal pahnih an um ti Shimei in a theih tikah,"},"40":{"text":"a laak cu a kung a dam ih a sal hawl dingah Gath siangpahrang Akhish hnenah a feh. A sal pawl cu a va hmu ih a kirpi hai."},"41":{"text":"Shimei ih thil tuahmi cu Solomon in a theih tikah,"},"42":{"text":"Shimei cu a ko ih a hnenah, “Jerusalem taan lo dingin thu ka lo kamter ih, na taan a si ahcun na thi ding, tiah ralrinnak fiangtein ka lo pek. Na lung a kim ih ka sim vekih thlun dingah i kamta a si lo maw?"},"43":{"text":"Ziangah so na thukam mi na bal ih ka thupekmi cu na thlun lo?"},"44":{"text":"Ka pa David parih thilsual na tuahmi hmuahhmuah na thei ṭheh a si. Hi ruangah hin Bawipa in a lo hrem ding."},"45":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa in kei cu i thlawsuah ding ih David uknak cu kumkhua in a hngetter ding,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Siangpahrang in thu a pek ih, Benaiah a feh ih Shimei cu a that. Solomon ih uknak cu a hnget sinsin."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Izipt siangpahrang fanu a ṭhit ih cuticun Izipt siangpahrang thawn ṭantlangnak cakhen a tuah. A nupi cu a hruai ih, a siangpahrang inn, Bawipa ih Biakinn, le khawpi kulhnak phardawl a sak ṭheh hlantiang David Khawpi ah a umter.","title":"Solomon In Fimnak A Dil (2 San. 1.3-12)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hrangah Biakinn sak hrih lo a si ruangah, senpi pawl cu hmun dangdang biakṭheng ah thawinak an pek."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in Bawipa cu a duhdawt ih a pa David ih daan pekmi pawl cu a thlun. Asinain biakṭheng dangdang khalah ṭilva pawl a that ih thawinak a pek vivo."},"4":{"text":"Voikhat ah Solomon cu Gibeon ah thawinak pek dingah a feh. Ziangahtile Gibeon cu hminthang bik biakṭheng umnak a si. Cutawk ah mei-ur thawinak cu a thawng a za in a rak pek zo."},"5":{"text":"Cuih zan cu a mangah Bawipa a hnenah a lang ih Bawipa in, “Ka lo pek dingah ziangso na duh?” tiah a sut."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Solomon in, “ Bawipa , ka pa David na salpa, hnenah cun na duhdawtnak catbaang loin na langter ih na hmaika ah rinsantlak le ṭhazet le felzet in a nung a si. Amah na duhdawtnak cu a cat cuang loih tuihsun khalah na langter ih amah ai ah a fapa cu ram uktu ah na tuah."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , mino ka si hrih ruangah ram uknak thu zianghman ka thei lo naón, ka pa aiah siangpahrang i cangter."},"8":{"text":"Atu-ah na ta dingih na hrilmi na miphun, zohman ih siar cawk lomi minung lakah ka um."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah hi na minung pawl ṭhazet le dingzet ih ka uk theinak dingah le a ṭha le a sia ka thleidan theinak dingah ka ṭulmi fimnak i pe aw. Culo ahcun hitluk a tammi na minung hi ziangtinso ka uk thei ding?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Bawipa cu a lung a awi ngaingai ih,"},"11":{"text":"Solomon hnenah cun, “Nun saunak le lennak le na ral pawl thihnak dil loin, na minung pawl dingteih uk theinak ah fimnak i dil ruangah,"},"12":{"text":"na dil vekin ka lo pe ding. Fimnak le theihthiamnak ka lo pe ding ih nangmah hlanah siseh nangmah hnuah siseh nangmah vekih fimnak le theihthiamnak a neitu zohman an um lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Na dil lomi khal ka lo pe cih ding: Na nunsung hmuahhmuah ah lennak le hminthannak na nei ding ih zovek siangpahrang hman in an lo bang lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Cun na pa David vekih ka thu i thlun ih ka thukham le ka daan pekmi pawl na tuah a si ahcun na nunnak khal ka sauter ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Solomon cu a hung ṭhang ih Pathian in a mangah thu a sim kha a thei. Cule Jerusalem ah a feh ih Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang hmaiah a ding ih Bawipa ih hnenah mei-ur thawinak le remnak thawinak a pek. Cuih hnuah a kuthnuai ih hnaṭuantu pawl hrangah rawl eitlangnak puai a tuah sak."},"16":{"text":"Voikhat ah hlawhhlang nunau pahnih Siangpahrang Solomon hmaiah an ra thleng.","title":"Solomon In Thuharsa A ṭhen"},"17":{"text":"Nunau pakhat in, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, hi nunau nu le keimah cu inn pakhat ah kan um. Cuih innih kan um laiah cun faate ka hring ih mipa a si."},"18":{"text":"Nau ka neih hnu ni thumnak ah anih khal in faate a hring ih mipa a si ve. Cuih inn ahcun midang zohman an um lo. Kanmah pahnih lawng kan si."},"19":{"text":"Zan khatah a fapa te cu a nen pang ih a thi."},"20":{"text":"Cule zan ahcun a tho ih ka ihthat sungah ka naute cu ka hnen ihsin a lak ih a ihkhun ah a ret. Cule a thimi a fapa cu ka ihkhun ah a ret."},"21":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah ka tho ih ka faate cu pawhte fawh ka tum tikah a thi ti kha ka hmu. Ṭhateih ka zohsal tikah a thimi cu ka faate a si lo ti kha ka thei,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah a dang nunau nu in, “Asilo! A nungmi hi ka faate a si ih, a thimi kha na fa a si,” tiah a ti. A hmaisatu nunau nu in, “Si hlah ee! A thimi hi na fa a si ih a nungmi kha ka fa a si,” a ti ve. Cuticun siangpahrang hmaiah cun an el-aw rero."},"23":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in, “Nan pahnih in a nungmi fa cu ka fa a si nan ti veve ih a thimi cu ka fa a si lo, nan ti veve,” a ti ih,"},"24":{"text":"ralnam run keng dingah thu a pek. Ralnam cu an run ken tikah,"},"25":{"text":"Solomon in, “A nungmi naute hi ṭhen hnih ah ṭhen awla, hi nunau nu pahnih hnenah ṭhen khat veve pe aw,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah a nu ngaingai a si mi nunau nu cun, a fapa hrangih duhdawtnak a neih ruangah siangpahrang hnenah, “Maw Siangpahrang bawipa, naute cu that hram hlah aw. Hi nu hnenah pe sawn aw,” a ti. Asinain a dang nunau nu cun, “Zohnen hmanah in pe hlah. Ṭhen hnih ahcun ṭhen aw,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cutikah Solomon in, “Naute cu that hlah. Pakhatnak nunau nu hnenah pe aw. A nu a si,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Solomon thuṭhennak cu Israel mi pawl in an theih tikah dingteih thu ṭhen thiamnak cu Pathian in a pek a si, ti an thei ih Solomon cu an upat ih an ṭihzah ngaingai."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon cu Israel ram pumpi uktu siangpahrang a si ih,","title":"Solomon Kuthnuai Ih Bawi Pawl"},"2":{"text":"a tanglam pawl hi a kuthnuai ih bawi pawl an si: Zadok fapa Azariah cu puithiam a si."},"3":{"text":"Shisha fapa pawl Elihoref le Ahijah cu sungṭuan an si ih Ahilud fapa Jehoshafat cu Acozah Cazin Khumtu a si."},"4":{"text":"Jehoiada fapa Benaiah cu ralkap hotu bawi a si. Zadok le Abiathar cu puithiam an si."},"5":{"text":"Nathan fapa Azariah cu ramṭhen uktu pawl hotu a si. Nathan fapa puithiam Zabud cu siangpahrang ruahnak petu a si."},"6":{"text":"Ahishar cu Siangpahrang inn hnaṭuantu pawl hotu a si. Abda fapa Adoniram cu hranhram ih hnaṭuan fialmi pawl hotu a si."},"7":{"text":"Solomon in Israel ramṭhen hleihnih uktu bawi hleihnih a ret. Anmah in siangpahrang le a innsang pawl hrangah an ramṭhen ciar ihsin rawl an run phurh ih uktu pakhat in kum khat sungah thlakhat hrang ciar ṭuanvo lakin rawl an phurh."},"8":{"text":"A thuailam pawl hi cuih bawi pawl le an hnaṭuannak ramṭhen pawl ih hmin an si: Efraim tlangpar ram uktu cu Benhur a si."},"9":{"text":"Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, Elon le Beth Hanan khawpi pawl uktu cu Bendeker a si."},"10":{"text":"Arubboth le Sokoh khawpi pawl le Hefer ram hmuahhmuah a uktu cu Benhesed a si."},"11":{"text":"Dor ram a pumpi in a uktu cu Solomon fanu Tafath a ṭhitu Benabinadab a si."},"12":{"text":"Taanak le Megiddo khawpi pawl le Jezreel khua ih thlang, Bethshan le Zarethan khua kiangih a ummi ram hmuahhmuah, Abelmeholah le Jokmeam khua tiangin a uktu cu Ahilud ih fapa Baana a si."},"13":{"text":"Gilead ramih Ramoth khua le Manasseh ih fapa Jair hrin ih Gilead kiangkap ih khawte pawl le Bashan ram sungih Argob ram thawn a zate in, phardawl thawn kulhmi le dar kothrolh ih kalhmi khawpi sawmruk uktu cu Bengeber a si."},"14":{"text":"Mahanaim peng uktu cu Iddo ih fapa Ahinadab a si."},"15":{"text":"Naftali ram uktu cu Solomon ih fanu pakhat Basemath ṭhitu Ahimaaz a si."},"16":{"text":"Asher ram le Bealoth khua uktu cu Hushai ih fapa Baana a si."},"17":{"text":"Issakhar ram uktu cu Paruah ih fapa Jehoshafat a si."},"18":{"text":"Benjamin ram uktu cu Ela ih fapa Shimei a si."},"19":{"text":"Amor siangpahrang Sihon le Bashan siangpahrang Og ih rak ukmi Gilead ram uktu cu Uri ih fapa Geber a si. Hi ram uktu hleihnih pawl ih tlunah ram pumpi uktu bawi pakhat a um."},"20":{"text":"Judah le Israel ram sungih a ummi minung pawl cu tifinriat kapih vunnel zat in an tam. An ei an in ih an nun a nuamzet.","title":"Solomon Ukmi Ram A ṭhangso"},"21":{"text":"Solomon ih ukmi ram cu nisuahnak lamah Eufrates Tiva in nitlaknak lamah Filistin ram tiang, thlanglam ah Izipt ramri tiang a kau. A uksung mi pawl in siah an pek ih Solomon a dam sung hmuahhmuah ah amah riantu an si."},"22":{"text":"Solomon in rawl ei dingah nitin a hai mi pawl cu, a dip zetmi sangphut haan za le sawmnga, le fang haan zathum;"},"23":{"text":"cawm thaumi caw pahra, hramlak ih a tlangmi caw kul, tuu zakhat le zukneng, sakhi, zaatum le erh thaumi ar tla an si."},"24":{"text":"Solomon ih ukmi ram cu Eufrates Tiva in nitlaknak lam hmuahhmuah, Eufrates Tiva kapih ummi Tifsah ihsin nitlaknak lamah Gaza khawpi tiang a si. Eufrates Tiva in nitlaknak lamih a ummi siangpahrang pawl cu Solomon ih ukmi an si ṭheh ih, a kiangkap ih ramdang pawl thawn remte in an um."},"25":{"text":"A dam sungah cun Judah mi le Israel mi pawl cu hnangam zetin an um ih innsang hmuahhmuah in sabit kung le theipi kung pawl anmah ih ta an nei ciar a si."},"26":{"text":"Solomon in a ranginn sungah raldonak rangleng hnuktu rang thawng sawmli a nei ih rang ralkap hrangah rang thawng hleihnih a nei."},"27":{"text":"A kuthnuai ih ramṭhen uktu bawi hleihnih pawl in, an ṭuanvo neihnak thla khat sung ciarah, Siangpahrang Solomon le a inn sungih rawl eitu hmuahhmuah hrangah an ei ding rawl an tawlrel sak. An ṭulmi hmuahhmuah kimtein an pek."},"28":{"text":"Cuih bawi pawl in a thla a thla in, a ṭul tik pohpoh ah barli fang le hrampi cu, rangleng hnuktu rang pawl le hnaṭuantu ṭilva pawl hrangah an pek ringring a si."},"29":{"text":"Pathian in Solomon cu fimnak le theihthiamnak a pek ih a fimthiamnak cu tah cawk lo a si."},"30":{"text":"Solomon cu nisuahnak lam mifim pawl hnakin a fim sawn ih Izipt mifim pawl hnak khalin a fim sawn."},"31":{"text":"Minung hmuahhmuah lakah mifim bik a si. Ezrah mi Ethan hnakin le Mahol fapa Heman, Kalkol, le Darda pawl hnakin a fim sawn. An kiangkap ram kipah a hmin a thang."},"32":{"text":"Phungthluk thawngthum le hla fing thawngkhat lenglo a phuah."},"33":{"text":"Thingkung le hramkung thuhla a rel ih Lebanon ih a khomi sidar thing le phar parih a kho mi hissop kung pawl ih thuhla tiangin a rel. Ramsa, vate, a bokvak ramsa le nga pawl ih thuhla khal a rel."},"34":{"text":"Leilung tlun siangpahrang pawl in Solomon ih fimnak cu an thei ih mi tampi a fimnak ngai dingah a hnenah mi an thlah."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ṭaiar khua Siangpahrang Hiram cu David ih rualpi ṭhazet a si. David ih ai-ah a fapa Solomon siangpahrang a cang ti a theih tikah Hiram in Solomon hnenah palai a thlah.","title":"Solomon In Biakinn Sak A Tum (2 San. 2.1-18)"},"2":{"text":"Cule Solomon in Hiram hnenah hiti in thu a cah,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka pa David in Bawipa a Pathian hrangah Biakinn sak a duh naón a kiangkap ram pawl thawn an do awk ringring ruangah a sak thiam lo a si, ti cu na rak theih ciami a si. A ral pawl parih nehnak Pathian in a pek hlanah cun Bawipa ih inn saknak cu a um thiam lo."},"4":{"text":"Asinain atu-ah cun Bawipa ka Pathian in himnak i pek ih ka ram sungah daihnak a um. Ral ka nei lo. Do i tumtu khal an um lo."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in ka pa David hnenah, ‘Na ai ih siangpahrang a ṭuantu na fapa in ka hrangah Biakinn a sak ding,’ tiah thu a rak kam. Atu-ah cuih biakinn cu Bawipa ka Pathian hminthannak ah sak dingin ka ruatcat zo."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Lebanon ih sidar thing hau dingin na milai pawl rak kuat awla, ka milai pawl thawn an ṭuantlang pei. Cule na khiah mi vekin na milai pawl ih hlawhman cu ka pe ding. Na theih vekin kei ih milai pawl cu na milai pawl bangtuk in thing hau an thiam lo a si,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Solomon thucah mi cu Hiram in a theih tikah a lung a awi ngaingai ih, “A makzetmi miphun uktu siangpahrang si dingah David hnenih hi bangtuk fapa fim a petu Bawipa cu tuihsun ahhin thangṭhat si ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule Hiram in Solomon hnenah hiti in thu a cah, “Na thucahmi ka rak thei ih i dil bangtuk in sidar thing le far thing pawl cu ka lo pe ding."},"9":{"text":"Ka milai pawl in thingtum cu Lebanon ihsin tifinriat ah an run tholh pei ih puum ih an tuah hnuah tifinriat kap in na duhnak hmun tiang an run fehpi ding. Cutawkah ka milai pawl in an ṭemnak hri cu an phoih pei ih na milai pawl in thingtum cu an lak ding. Cule nang in in tuahsak dingmi cu ka milai pawl hrangah tirawl in ngaihtuah sak ve pei,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Hiram in Solomon cu a duhmi sidar thing le farthing pawl cu a pek ih,"},"11":{"text":"Solomon in kumtin tein Hiram ih milai pawl hrangah sangvut haan thawng za le kul hluannga le olif hriak ṭha bik pung thawng kul hluan sarih le za nga a pek."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in a thukammi a kimter ih Solomon cu fimnak a pek. Hiram le Solomon karlakah remnak a um ih ṭangtlang dingin lungkimnak cakhen khal an tuah."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in hna ṭuantu ah Israel ram pumpi sungin minung thawng sawmthum a lak ih,"},"14":{"text":"Adoniram cu anmah hotu ah a ret. Cuih minung pawl cu thawnghra in ṭhen thum ah a ṭhen ih ṭhen khat cu a ha a ha in Lebanon ah thla khat, inn ah thla hnih fingfing in an um."},"15":{"text":"Cuih tlunah tlangpar ramih lungto latu dingah minung thawng sawmriat a ret ih, cuih lungto phurtu dingah minung thawng sawmsarih a ret."},"16":{"text":"Cuih hnaṭuantu pawl a khawngtu ah minung thawngthum le zathum a ret fawn."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon ih thupeknak vekin biakinn hramṭohnak lungphum hrangah sermi lungto tumpipi ṭhazet in an lak."},"18":{"text":"Solomon milai, Hiram milai le Byblos khuami pawl in biakinn saknak hrangah lungto an ser ih thing tla an salh."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi an suah hnu kum zali le sawmriat, Israel ram a uknak kum li kum, thla hnih thla - Ziv thla ah Solomon in Biakinn sak a thok.","title":"Solomon In Biakinn A Sak"},"2":{"text":"Biakinn cu a sunglam in pi sawmkua a sau, pi sawmthum a kau ih, pi sawmli le pi nga a sang."},"3":{"text":"Biakinn sung vung luhnak ih a ummi khaan cu pi hleinga a sau ih biakinn tia in pi sawmthum a kau."},"4":{"text":"Biakinn phar ahcun tukvirh an um ih cuih tukvirh ong pawl cu a lenglam ah a fate ih a sunglam ah a tum."},"5":{"text":"Phar ih lenglam ah, a siirlam le a dunglam ah innkhaan dang dot thum in an sak ih, dot khat cu pi sarih le a hrek fingfing a sang."},"6":{"text":"Hnuaita bik khaan cu pi sarih le a hrek a kau, a laita khaan cu pi kua a kau ih, tlunta bik khaan cu pi hra le a hrek a kau. Biakinn phar cu dot khat hnu dot khat a tlunta a paa vivo ih, innkhaan zial donnak khansuk pawl cu phar sungih dawl cih ṭul loin phar parah cun a khan in an khang."},"7":{"text":"Biakinn saknak lungto pawl cu lungto laknak hmunah ser ciami an si ruangah Biakinn an sak tikah sobul, hreitlung le a dang thir hriamhrei ih tuah le ser rero an ṭul lo ih thawmvang awn ruri zianghman a um lo."},"8":{"text":"Innpeh hnuaita bik dot luhnak sangka cu biakinn thlanglam kap in a si ih dot hnihnak le dot thumnak tiang kailawn kel a um."},"9":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Biakinn sak cu a ṭheh. A tlun diphun cu sidar thing in an tuah ih innbo pawl khal sidar thing hlir an si."},"10":{"text":"Phar lenglam ih inn khaan dang dot thum a sakmi, pi sarih le a hrek ciar a saangmi cu sidar thing in Biakinn parah cun an hreng."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in Solomon hnenah,"},"12":{"text":"“Ka daan le ka thukham pawl na thlun thluh a si ahcun na pa David hnenih ka kammi hmuahhmuah na parah ka kimter ding."},"13":{"text":"Ka minung Israel mi lakah hi na sakmi Biakinn ahhin ka um ding ih ziangtik hmanah ka dungtun hai lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cuticun Solomon in Biakinn cu a sak ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Biakinn phar sunglam cu zial ihsin siling tiang sidar thingpheng in an khuh. A zial cu farthing in an don.","title":"Biakinn Sunglam Mawiternak"},"16":{"text":"A sungta khaan, Hmun Thianghlim Bik, timi cu Biakinn sung dunglam bikah a um. Cuih khaan cu pi sawmthum a sau ih, sidar thingpheng in zial ihsin siling tiang an dan."},"17":{"text":"Biakinn khaanpi cu pi sawmruk a sau."},"18":{"text":"Sidar thingpheng par ahcun uum mum le uum par zuk pawl cuangin an ceimawi. Inn sunglam hmuahhmuah cu sidar thing in an khuh ṭheh ih phar ih lungdawl pawl cu pakhat hman an lang lo."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang retnak ah sungta khaan cu Biakinn sung dunglam bikah an tuah."},"20":{"text":"Hi khaan cu pi sawmthum a kau, pi sawmthum a sau ih, pi sawmthum a sang. A zatein sui in an khuut. Biakṭheng cu sidar thingpheng in an khuh."},"21":{"text":"Biakinn a sunglam cu sui in an khuut; sungta khaan khal sui in khuutmi a si ih a luhnak sangka ahcun sui ṭhihrual an thlai."},"22":{"text":"Biakinn sunglam cu Hmun Thianghlim Bik khaan le a khaanpi thawn, sui lawnglawng in an khuut a si."},"23":{"text":"Cherubim timi thla nei ramnung lem zuk pahnih cu olif thing in an tuah ih Hmun Thianghlim Bik ahcun an ret. Pi hleinga an sang veve."},"24":{"text":"An pahnih in an tia-aw ih an bangrep fawn. Thla pahnih veve an nei ih an thla pakhat cu pi sarih le a hrek a sau ih khatlam thla zim ihsin khatlam thla zim tiang pi hleinga a sau.","merge":"25"},"27":{"text":"Hmun Thianghlim Bik ahcun artlang in an ret ih an thla cu a khaan laifangah an dai-aw. Cule an thla dang in phar an dai veve."},"28":{"text":"Cuih cherubim cu an pahnih in sui khuutmi an si."},"29":{"text":"Biakinn sung khaanpi le sungta khaan pawl ih phar cu cherubim zuk le tuumkung zuk le pangpar zuk in an ceimawi."},"30":{"text":"A zial khal sui in an khuut ṭheh a si."},"31":{"text":"Hmun Thianghlim Bik luhnak sangka cu kap hnih nei a si ih olif thing in an tuah ih sangka ih lu lam cu a fate vivo ih a zik cu a zum. Kil nga nei sangka a si."},"32":{"text":"Sangka par ahcun cherubim zuk le tuumkung zuk le pangpar zuk in mawiternak an tuah. Sangka kap hnih le cherubim le tuumkung pawl cu sui in an khuut."},"33":{"text":"Biakinn khaanpi sung luhnak sangka pahnih cu kil li nei veve an si ih olif thing in tuahmi an si."},"34":{"text":"Cuih sangka cu a kap hnih in bil theimi an si ih farthing in tuahmi an si."},"35":{"text":"Cherubim le tuumkung le pangpar zuk in ceimawi mi a si ih bangraan tein sui in khuutmi an si."},"36":{"text":"Biakinn hmaiih innkhaan pakhat an sakmi cu phar in an kulh ih cuih phar cu lungto thuah thum ah sidar thing thuah khat in an thlak."},"37":{"text":"Hi Biakinn ih lungphum an thoknak cu Solomon in siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum li kum, thla hnih thla - Ziv an timi thla ah a si."},"38":{"text":"Solomon siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum hleikhat kum, thla riat thla - Bul an timi thla ah, biakinn cu an tumtah vekin kimten an sak ṭheh. Hi Biakinn cu Solomon in kum sarih sung a sak a si."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in amah ih hrangah siangpahrang inn khal a sak ih kum hleithum a rei.","title":"Siangpahrang Solomon Inn"},"2":{"text":"Cuih siangpahrang inn sungih Lebanon Tupi Khaan an timi cu pi za le sawmnga a sau, pi sawmsarih le pi nga a kau ih pi sawmli le pi nga a sang. Sidar thing in tuahmi ṭhuam tlar thum a um ih tlar khatah ṭhuam hleinga fingfing an um. Cuih ṭhuam pawl cu innbo pawl dotu an si. Siiling khal sidar thing ih tuahmi a si ih thilri retnak khaan pawl khal siling a um ṭheh ih ṭhuam ih domi an si ṭheh.","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Khatlam phar ah tukvirh tlar thum a um ih khatlam phar khalah tlar thum thotho a um."},"5":{"text":"A tlar a tlar in a ummi khatlam phar le khatlam phar ih sangkate pawl cu an zawn aw fingfing. Sangka le sangkate pawl cu kil li nei an si ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Ṭhuampi Khaan an timi cu pi sawmsarih le pi nga a sau ih, pi sawmli le pi nga a kau. Hulhliap cu tlunkhuh ṭhatein an tuah ih cuih tlunkhuh hrangah ṭhuam dang an phun."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang Tokham Khaan, a si lole Thuṭhennak Khaan an timi Solomon in thuṭhennak ih a hmanmi khaan cu a zial ihsin innbo tiang, a phar pawl le thuam pawl cu sidar thingpheng in an khuh ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Solomon umnak inn, Thuṭhennak Khaan timi dunglam ih an sakmi cu inn dang pawl vek thotho ih sakmi a si. Cuvek thotho in Izipt siangpahrang fanu a ṭhitmi a nupi hrang khalah inn pakhat a sak."},"9":{"text":"Hi inn pawl hmuahhmuah cu innhram ṭoh-nak ihsin disaapthla tiang, lungto laknak hmunih sermi le a tum a fatet tah tahrat ih tan mi, a sunglam le a lenglam tiang kaih-aw dingih atmi lungto in sakmi an si."},"10":{"text":"Innhram ṭoh-nak pawl cu lungto laknak hmunah a hrek pi hleihnih sau le a dang pi hleinga sau lungto tumpipi ser mi pawl in tuahmi an si."},"11":{"text":"Cuih lungto tumpipi tlunah a tum a fatet tah tahrat ih atmi lungto le sidar thing in an dawl."},"12":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn, Biakinn sung khaanpi le biakinn sung luhnak innkhaan ih phar pawl cu atmi lungto thuah thumah sidar thing thuah khat ih thlakmi an si."},"13":{"text":"Solomon in ṭai-ar khua ih a ummi, daar ser thiam Huram an timi pa a ko.","title":"Dar Ih Ceimawinak"},"14":{"text":"A pa cu a thi zo ih a nun laiah cun a fapa vekin dar lamih kut zungmawi a si. A pa khal cu ṭai-ar khua mi a si. A nu cu Naftali phun a si. Huram cu mi fimvar a si ih kum reipi daar lamih ṭuan ṭhangtu a si. Solomon ih a kawh bangtuk in a feh ih daar lam hnaṭuannak hmuahhmuah cu amah in a ho."},"15":{"text":"Huram in daarṭhuam pahnih, pi kul hluansarih a saangmi le a kimvel in pi hleiriat a tummi a ser ih Biakinn sangka kiangah a phun."},"16":{"text":"Cuih tlunah daar lubol pahnih, pi sarih le a hrek a saangmi, cuih daarṭhuam pahnih parih ret dingah a tuah."},"17":{"text":"Daarṭhuam ih lu cu daar cikcin kulh ih zuk cuang le,"},"18":{"text":"daar taleti rah lem tlar hnih cuangin an ceimawi."},"19":{"text":"Ṭhuam lubol cu daidimpar lem cuang in, pi ruk sang in an tuah ih,"},"20":{"text":"Ṭhuam lu ih daar cikcin zuk tlunah cun an ret. Ṭhuam lubol parah cun a kimvel in taleti rah zahnih lem tlar hnih an um."},"21":{"text":"Cuih daarṭhuam pahnih cu Biakinn sangka hmaiah Huram in a phun: Pakhat cu thlanglam kapah a phun ih Jachin tiah an ko; a dang pakhat cu saklam kapah a phun ih Boaz tiah an ko."},"22":{"text":"Daidimpar lem cuang ih dar lubol pahnih cu cuih ṭhuam pahnih parah cun an ret. Cuticun daarṭhuam tuah cu an ṭheh."},"23":{"text":"Huram in pi sarih le a hrek a thuk mi, pi hleinga a kau ih a kimvel in pi sawmli le pi nga a tummi daar tikuang hluum pakhat a tuah.","title":"Daar Tikuang (2 San. 4.2-5)"},"24":{"text":"Cuih daar tikuang tlang kimvel ahcun daar ih tuahmi uum lem pi sawmli le pi nga sau in tlar hnih in a tuah. Daar tikuang le daar ih tuahmi uum lem cu a peh-aw ih tuahmi a si."},"25":{"text":"Cuih daar tikuang phurtu cu daar cawcang hleihnih an si ih, saklam thlanglam, nisuahnak lam le nitlaknak lam kha cawcang pathum fingfing in an hoi."},"26":{"text":"Daar tikuang cu lethmat pathum a sah. A tlangzim cu khuathai tlangzim bangtuk a si ih pangpar zim vekin a lenglam ah a parh. Tidai pung thawnghnih le zanga a dawl a si."},"27":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Huram in daar cawleng pahra a tuah. Pi ruk sau, pi ruk kau le pi li le a hrek a saangmi an si fingfing.","title":"Daar Cawleng"},"28":{"text":"Cawleng ih a lengraan cu a tia-aw mi kil li nei thing a si ih,"},"29":{"text":"a parah kiosa pawl, cawcang pawl le cherubim pawl an zuk. A fungpi par, kiosa le cawcang zuk pawl ih tlun le thuai ah pangpar kual an zuk."},"30":{"text":"Cawleng pakhat in daar lengke pali le dar kehrolh fung an nei fingfing. Cawleng ih kil li ah maihum dotu daar tawdam an um fingfing. Cuih tawdam pawl cu pangpar kual zuk in an ṭelh."},"31":{"text":"Maihum tlunah cun a hluummi fung a um. Cuih fung cu cawleng tlunah lethmat hleiriat a suak ih cawleng sungah lethmat pasarih a lut. A pumte in ṭelhmi a si."},"32":{"text":"Lengke cu pi kul hluannga a sang ih lengtlang thuai ah a um. Cule a kehrolh fung cu cawleng thawn thing pakhat ih tuahmi a si."},"33":{"text":"Lengke cu rangleng ke bangtuk a si ih a kehrolh fung, a ke tlangzim, a kehrolh fung le a kehrolh fung khamtu pawl cu daar hlir ih tuahmi an si."},"34":{"text":"Cawleng kil li ih hnuailam ah dotu pakhat fingfing an um ih cawleng thawn thing pakhat ih tuahmi an si."},"35":{"text":"Cawleng tlunlam kimvel ah lengkhap a um. Leng dotu le a tlangpi pawl cu leng thawn thing pakhat ih tuahmi an si."},"36":{"text":"Dotu le leng tlangpi pawl cu cherubim le kiosa le tuumkung zuk pawl in an mawiter ih a lawngnak kipah pangpar kual zuk a cuang wvivo a si."},"37":{"text":"Cubangtuk in cawleng an tuah daan cu a si: an zatein an bangrep ih an tia-aw thluh fawn."},"38":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Huram in cawleng pakhat hrangah maihum pakhat fingfing in maihum pahra a tuah. Maihum pakhat cu pi ruk a kau ih tidai pung sawmnga a dawl."},"39":{"text":"Biakinn thlanglam kapah cawleng panga a ret ih, a dang panga cu biakinn saklam kapah a ret. Tikuang cu thlanglam nisuahnak lam kapah a ret a si."},"40":{"text":"Huram in beel pawl, cawhleek pawl le kheng pawl khal a tuah. Solomon ih fial vekin Huram in Bawipa ih Biakinn hrangih a hnaṭuan hmuahhmuah cu a ṭheh. A tuahmi pawl cu a tanglam pawl hi an si: ṭhuam pahnih ṭhuam parih retmi, kheng a bangmi lubol pahnih ṭhuam lubol ceimawinak daar cikcin zuk pawl ṭhuam lubol parih tlar hnih in zukmi taleti lem rah zali Cawleng pahra Maihum pahra Tikuang pakhat Tikuang phurtu cawcang hleihnih Beel pawl, cawhleek pawl le kheng pawl. Siangpahrang Solomon hrangih Huram in a tuahmi hi Biakinn thilri pawl cu ngilzet ih hnawtmi daar an si.","title":"Biakinn Thilri Pawl (2 San. 4.11—5.1)","merge":"41"},"46":{"text":"Jordan Phairawn, Sukkoth le Zarethan karlak ih daar sernak so-thlam ih tuahmi hlir an si."},"47":{"text":"Daar in tuahmi hi thilri pawl cu Solomon in cuai a thlaiter lo. A tamtuk ruangah cuai ziangzat an rit ti siar cawk ding a si lo."},"48":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Biakinn hrangah Solomon in sui thilri pawl khal a tuahter. Cupawl cu sui biakṭheng, sang serh hrangah sui cabuai,"},"49":{"text":"Biakinn sung Hmun Thianghlim Bik sungta khaan hmai ih retmi sui meivannak pahra - thlanglam ah panga, saklam ah panga ret mi; sui pangpar pawl, sui mei-inn pawl, sui caiceh pawl,"},"50":{"text":"sui khuathai pawl, sui caicehte pawl, suikheng pawl, rimhmui retnak ih sui pakan pawl, meivam kennak suikheng pawl le Biakinn khaanpi le Hmun Thianghlim Bik luhnak sangka ih sui kopza pawl an si."},"51":{"text":"Solomon in Biakinn hnaṭuan a ṭheh tikah a pa David in Bawipa hnenih a rak pekmi sui le ngun le a dang thilri pawl cu Biakinn thilri retnak khaan sungah a zatein a ret ṭheh."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Israel hotu pawl, an phun ciarih hotu pawl le an innsang ciarih hotu pawl cu, Bawipa Thukam Kuang kha David Khawpi, Zion khua ihsin biakinn ih keng dingah Jerusalem ah a kokhawm.","title":"Thukam Kuang Biakinn Ah An Keng (2 San. 5.2—6.2)"},"2":{"text":"Thla sarih thla, Ethanim an timi thla sung, Puanthlam Puai tikcu ah an tongkhawm aw."},"3":{"text":"An hotu pawl hmuahhmuah an thlen ṭheh tikah puithiam pawl in Thukam Kuang cu an lak ih,"},"4":{"text":"Levi pawl tla in an bawm ih, Bawipa ih Puanthlam cu a sungih thilri pawl hmuahhmuah thawn Biakinn ah an phur."},"5":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon le Israel misenpi pawl cu Thukam Kuang hmaiah an pumkhawm aw ih thawinak ah a siar ih siar cawk lo tuu le caw an that."},"6":{"text":"Cule puithiam pawl in Thukam Kuang cu an lak ih biakinn sungta khaan Hmun Thianghlim Bik hmun, cherubim pawl ih thla hnuai ah an ret."},"7":{"text":"A pharh-aw mi cherubim thla pawl cun Thukam Kuang le a zawnnak fung pawl cu an khuh ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"A zawnnak fung pawl cu an sauzet ih, Hmun Thianghlim Bik sungta khaan hmai ih Biakinn khaanpi sungin a zim pawl cu hmuh a theih, asinain a leng cun hmuh a theih lo. A zawnnak fung pawl cu tuihsun tiang cutawk ah an um lai."},"9":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi an suak ih Bawipa in an hnenah thukam a tuahnak Sinai Tlang parih Moses in lungpher pahnih a rak ret mi siar lo Thukam Kuang sungah a dang zianghman a um lo."},"10":{"text":"Puithiam pawl in Biakinn an taan ih an taan ṭheh vete in Biakinn sung cu mero a rung khat lohli."},"11":{"text":"Biakinn cu Bawipa ih sunlawinak huham in a khah thluh ruangah puithiam pawl cu Biakinn ah kir tahratin an hna an ṭuan thei lo."},"12":{"text":"Cule Solomon in, “Maw Bawipa , nangmah in ni cu vanah khin na ret, Asinain mero sahzet le thimzet sungih um na hril sawn;"},"13":{"text":"hittawk ah biakinn mawizet ka lo sak sak zo, Kumkhua na umnak hrangah,” tiah thla a cam."},"14":{"text":"Cutawkih misenpi an din laiah siangpahrang Solomon cu anmah lam hoi in a ding ih an hrangah Pathian thlawsuah a dil.","title":"Mipi Hnenih Solomon Thusimmi (2 San. 6.3-11)"},"15":{"text":"“Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cu thangṭhat in um seh!. Ziangahtile ka pa David hnenah,"},"16":{"text":"‘Izipt ram ihsin ka minung Israel mi pawl ka hruaisuak ni ih thokin tuihsun tiang Israel ram pumpi sungah keimah in biaknak dingah Biakinn an saknak ding hmun le khawpi khui hmanah ka hril lo. Sikhalsehla ka minung pawl uktu dingah nangmah David ka lo hril,’ ti ih a thukam cu a kimter a si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Solomon in, “Ka pa David in Israel ih Pathian Bawipa biaknak ah Biakinn sak a rak duhzet,"},"18":{"text":"asinain Bawipa in ka pa David hnenah, ‘Na tumtahmi parah ka lung a awizet."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Biakinn saktu cu nang na si lo ding, na fapa a si sawn ding,’ tiah a rak ti."},"20":{"text":"Atu-ah cuih a thutiam cu Bawipa in a kimter ih ka pa David to-nak Israel siangpahrang ih tokham cu keimah in ka luah zo. Cule Israel ih Pathian Bawipa biaknak ah Biakinn khal ka sak zo."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in kan pi le kan pu pawl Izipt ram ihsin a rak suahpi lai ih thukamnak a rak tuahmi ngannak lungpher pahnih retnak kuang khal hi Biakinn sungah ka ret zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cule misenpi hmuhhngan ah Solomon cu a feh ih biakṭheng hmaiah a va ding. A baan phar tahratin thla a cam.","title":"Solomon Thlacamnak (2 San. 6.12-42)"},"23":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, van ah siseh, leilung ah siseh, nangmah bangtuk Pathian khuihmanah an um lo. Na thukammi cu na kimter ringring ih thinlung takte ih a lo thluntu na minung pawl parah cun a cat dah lomi duhdawtnak na langter a si."},"24":{"text":"Ka pa David hnenih na kammi na kimter ih tuihsun ah cuih na thukamnak cu na tuahsuak zo."},"25":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, ka pa David hnenah, ‘Ka thu na ngai vekin na tesinfa pawl in ka thu an ngai ve a si ahcun Israel uktu dingah na tesinfa pawl cu siangpahrang ah ka tuah ringring hai ding,’ tiih na thukamnak khal kimter hram aw."},"26":{"text":"Maw Israel ih Pathian Bawipa , ka pa David na siahhlawh hnenih na thutiam cu run kimter hramhram aw, tiah ka lo dil a si."},"27":{"text":"“Asinain Pathian cu leilung parah a um thei ngaingai ding maw? Khawza vanrang hman hi na hrangah cun a fiak tuk a si. Curuangah hi Biakinn ka sakmi ahhin ziangtinso na tlem ding?"},"28":{"text":"Sikhalsehla, Bawipa ka Pathian, ka thlacamnak le ka lo dilnak i ngaihram awla, tuihsun ih ka aunak le ka lo ngennak cu i thei hram aw."},"29":{"text":"Nangmah kan lo biaknak dingah na hril mi hi hmun le hi Biakinn hi a sun a zan in kilveng hram aw. Hi Biakinn sungih ka thlacamnak hi run thei hram aw."},"30":{"text":"Keimah siseh, ka minung pawl siseh, hi hmunih thla kan cam tikah run ngai hram aw. Vancung ih na umnak ihsin in run ngai awla, in run thei in kan sualnak in ngaithiam hram aw."},"31":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat midang parah sual an puh ih, ‘Ka sual lo a si,’ tiih siatcam tuah dingah hi Biakinn ih biakṭheng ah an rak hruai a si ahcun,"},"32":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , an thu cu van ihsin run ngai awla na sal pawl an thu run ṭhen hram aw. Misual cu a sual vekin hrem awla a mawh lotu cu a mawh lo vekin run thlah hram aw."},"33":{"text":"“Na minung Israel pawl na parih an sual ruangah an ral pawl in an neh tikah sualsir in na hnenah an kir ih nangmah thangṭhat phah in sual ngaidam dingah hi Biakinn sungin zaangfah an lo dil a si ahcun,"},"34":{"text":"vancung ihsin run thei hai aw. Na minung pawl ih sualnak cu ngaidam hram awla an pipu hnenih na pek ciami ramah hruaikir sal aw."},"35":{"text":"“Na minung pawl in na parah an sual ih ruah surter loin na hrem hai tikah, an sual an sir-aw ih hi Biakinn lam hoi in le na hmin ko in thla an cam ih nangmah an lo thangṭhat a si ahcun,"},"36":{"text":"vancung ihsin run thei hram aw. Na siahhlawh pawl, Israel mi pawl sualnak cu ngaidam hram aw. An thlun ding lamzin dik hmuh awla kumkhua an neih dingih na pekmi an ram ahcun ruah surter hram aw."},"37":{"text":"“An ramah paampi a tlun tikah siseh, pulhnat a thlen tikah siseh, an lo rawl pawl thli hrang le kharbok tla in a siatsuah tikah siseh, na minung pawl ral in an ra siim tikah siseh, an parah natsia a si lole tlangrai a thlen tikah siseh,"},"38":{"text":"na hnenih an thlacamnak cu run thei hram aw. Na minung Israel mi pakhatkhat thinhar riahsia ngaingai in hi Biakinn lam hoi tahratin baan phar ih thla a cam a si ahcun,"},"39":{"text":"a thlacamnak run ngai hram aw. Na umnak vancung ihsin run ngai awla, a sualnak run ngaidam awla run bawm hram aw. Nangmah lawngin mi hmuahhmuah ih thinlung cu na thei. Mi pakhat fingfing parah an umdaan vekin tuah awla,"},"40":{"text":"cuticun kan pipu pawl hnenih na rak pekmi ramih an um sung hmuahhmuah ah na minung pawl in nangmah cu an lo ṭihzah ding a si."},"41":{"text":"“Lam hlatpi ih a ummi ramdangmi in na hmin thannak le na minung pawl hrangih thil maksak na tuahmi pawl an theih ih nangmah biak dingah le hi Biakinn ih thlacam dingah an rat a si ahcun,","merge":"42"},"43":{"text":"an thlacamnak cu ngai hram aw. Na umnak vancung ihsin run thei hram awla, an lo dilmi cu tuahsak hram aw. Cuticun na minung pawl bangtuk in hi leilung tlun mi hmuahhmuah in nangmah cu an lo thei ding ih an lo ṭihzah ding. Cule hi ka sakmi Biakinn ahhin nangmah cu biak ding na si ti an thei ding."},"44":{"text":"“Na minung pawl cu an ral pawl do dingih thu na pek tikah hi na hril zomi khawpi le na hrangih ka sak zomi hi Biakinn lam hoi in thla an cam a si ahcun,"},"45":{"text":"an thlacamnak cu ngai hram aw. Vancung ihsin run thei awla an ral pawl ih parah nehnak pe hram aw."},"46":{"text":"“Milai ziang bangtuk an si khalle an sual ṭheh vekin, na minung pawl khal na parah an sual ih na thinheng in an ral pawl kut sungah na pek, sal ah an kai ih ram dangih an hruai tikah ziangvek ram hla a si khalle,"},"47":{"text":"na minung pawl ih thlacamnak cu ngai hram aw. Cutawk ramah sual sir in na hnenah thla an cam ih an rak sualzia le an rak ṭhat lo zia na hnenih an phuan a si ahcun, Maw Bawipa , zaangfah an lo dilnak cu ngai hram aw."},"48":{"text":"Cuih ram ihsin thungaite le thinlung takte in an sir-aw ih an pipu hnenih na pek zomi hi ram le, na hril zomi hi khawpi le, na hrangih ka sak zomi hi Biakinn lam hoi in thla an cam ahcun,"},"49":{"text":"an thlacamnak run ngai hram aw. Na umnak vancung ihsin run thei awla run zaangfah hram aw."},"50":{"text":"An sualnak hmuahhmuah le an lo dodalnak hmuahhmuah ngaidam awla, an ral pawl khal an parah zaangfahnak thinlung neihter hram aw."},"51":{"text":"An hrangah thir vaamternak somei bangtuk a si mi Izipt ram ihsin na suahter zomi pawl hi na minung le na ta an si ko."},"52":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa Pathian, na minung Israel mi le an siangpahrang parah na mithmai ṭha langter ringring hram awla bomnak an lo dil tikah an lo dilnak cu theihsak hram aw."},"53":{"text":"Leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah lakin anmah cu na ta si dingah na hril zo ih, cuih thu cu na siahhlawh Moses hnen ihsin Izipt ram in kan pipu pawl na hruaisuak tikah na rak sim zo a si,” tiah thla a cam."},"54":{"text":"Solomon cu Bawipa hnenih van lamah baan phar le, biakṭheng hmaiah khuk bil ih thla a camnak hmun ihsin a hung ding.","title":"Netabik Thlacamnak"},"55":{"text":"Cutawkih a khawm-awmi misenpi pawl hrangah ringzet in Pathian thluasuah a dil."},"56":{"text":"“Ka lo pe hai ding, tiah na kam cia vekin na minung pawl hnenih daihnak a petu Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh. A siahhlawh Moses hnen ihsin famkim zetih a thukammi hmuahhmuah cu a kimter ṭheh a si."},"57":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian cu kan pipu pawl hnenih a rak um vekin kan hnen khalah um hram seh. In dungtun in in taanta hram hlah seh."},"58":{"text":"Amah ih duhnak vekih kan nun theinak dingah le kan pipu pawl hnenih a rak pekmi daan le thukham pawl kan thlun theinak dingah a thu thlun theitu in siter hram seh."},"59":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian in tuihsun ih ka thlacamnak le ka dilnak cu a kumkhua in ciing ringring hram seh. Israel mi pawl le an siangpahrang parah nitin ih an ṭulmi vekin zaangfahnak nei hram seh."},"60":{"text":"Cuticun leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah in Bawipa lawng hi Pathian a si ih Pathian dang an um lo, ti an thei ding."},"61":{"text":"Nannih amah ih minung pawl khal in tuihsun ih a thu nan ngai vek hin a daan le a thupekmi hmuahhmuah cu thlun uhla Bawipa kan Pathian ih rintlak in um ringring uh,” tiah a ti."},"62":{"text":"Cule Siangpahrang Solomon le Israel misenpi pawl in cutawkah Bawipa hnenah thawinak an pek."},"63":{"text":"Solomon in remnak thawinak ah cawcang thawng kul hluanhnih le tuu thawng zakhat le thawng kul a that. Cuticun Siangpahrang Solomon le Israel misenpi pawl in Biakinn cu Bawipa Biaknak inn ah an hlan a si."},"64":{"text":"Cuih ni ah Biakinn hmai ih a ummi a laita bik tual khal Solomon in a hlan ih, cutawkah mei-ur thawinak, thlairawl thawinak le remnak thawinak ih sathau pawl tla a pek. Hi thawinak pawl cutawk tual laifangih a peknak cu Biakinn sungih daar biakṭheng cu hi thawinak pekmi hmuahhmuah hrangah a fatet tuk ruangah a si."},"65":{"text":"Cule Solomon le Israel mi hmuahhmuah, saklam Hamath Tlangkawn ihsin thlanglam Izipt ramri tiang, an zatein Bawipa Pathian mithmuh ah Puanthlam Puai ni sarih sung an tuah."},"66":{"text":"Niriat ni ah Solomon in senpi pawl cu an inn ciarah a tlunter. An zate in Solomon cu an lawm ciamco. Bawipa in a siahhlawh David le a minung Israel mi pawl parih malsawmnak a pek ruangah lungawi aipuang zetin an inn ciarah an tlung."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Biakinn le siangpahrang inn le sak a duh mi hmuahhmuah a sak ṭheh tikah,","title":"Solomon Hnenah Pathian A Lang Sal (2 San. 7.11-22)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu Gibeon khua a hnenih a rak lang vekin, a hnenah a lang sal."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in a hnenah, “Na thlacamnak ka thei zo. Keimah biaknak hrangih na sakmi hi Biakinn cu ka thianghlimter ih hi innah ka hmin ka ret zo. Ka kilveng dingih kumkhua in ka hum ding a si."},"4":{"text":"Na pa David in dikzet le felzetin ka hna a ṭuan vekin nang khal keimah i rian ih ka thupekmi le ka daan pekmi hmuahhmuah na thlun a si ahcun,"},"5":{"text":"na pa David hnenah, ‘Na tesinfa pawl in Israel an uk ringring ding,’ tiih ka rak kammi cu ka kimter ding."},"6":{"text":"Asinain nangmah siseh na tesinfa pawl siseh keimah in thlun lo ih ka daan pekmi le ka thupekmi pawl nan bal ih khawzing dangdang nan rian ih nan biak a si ahcun,"},"7":{"text":"ka minung Israel mi pawl cu ka pek ciami ramsung ihsin ka ṭhio thluh hai ding a si. Keimah biaknak hrangih ka thianhlimtermi hi Biakinn hi ka hnong ding ih leilung tlun mi hmuahhmuah in Israel mi pawl cu an hmuhsuam ding ih an nautatzet ding."},"8":{"text":"Hi Biakinn cu innrop ah a cang ding ih a kiangkap ih a fehtu hmuahhmuah an mang a bangzet ding ih, ‘Ziangah so hi ram le hi Biakinn parah Bawipa in hi lawmmam in a tuah?’ tiah an ti rero ding."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah midang pawl in, “Israel mi pawl in an pipu pawl Izipt ram ihsin a hruaisuaktu Bawipa an Pathian an dungtun ih khawzing dangdang an rian ih an biak ruangah an parah Bawipa in hi bangtuk siatsuahnak a thlenter a si,’ an ti ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Solomon in Biakinn le a siangpahrang inn cu kum kul sung a sak ih a ṭheh.","title":"Solomon Le Hiram Lungkimnak (2 San. 8.1-2)"},"11":{"text":"A hnaṭuannak hrangih a ṭulmi sidar thing, farthing le sui pawl hmuahhmuah cu ṭai-ar Siangpahrang Hiram in a pek. Inn pawl a sak ṭheh hnuah Galilee peng ih khua khawkul cu Solomon in Hiram a pek."},"12":{"text":"Cuih khua kul pawl zoh dingah Hiram cu a feh ih a zoh tikah a duh lem lo."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah Solomon hnenah, “I pekmi khua pawl cu a hi-so-maw an si, unau pa!” tiah a ti. Curuangah cuih ram cu Kabul tiah tuihsan tiangin an kota."},"14":{"text":"Hiram in Solomon cu sui phurh za le phurh kul hluannga a rak kuat a si."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in hranhram hneek copih hnaṭuan a fialmi hnaṭuantu pawl in Biakinn le siangpahrang inn cu an sak. Khawpi in nisuahnak lamah leilung khahsilh tahrat in Millo a din suah ih khawpi kulhnak phar khal an dawl. Cule Hazor khua, Megiddo khua le Gezer khua pawl tla an din sal.","title":"Solomon Hnaṭuanmi Dangdang (2 San. 8.3-18)"},"16":{"text":"Izipt ram siangpahrang in Gezer khua cu a rak do ih a rak lak. Khawsung mi pawl a that ih an khua cu mei in a ur ṭheh. Cule a fanu in Solomon a pasal tikah a pasal neihnak laksawng ah cuih khua cu a fanu a ṭhen."},"17":{"text":"Cule Solomon in a din sal a si. Cuih tlunah hranhram ih hneekmi hnaṭuantu pawl hmangin Thlanglam Beth Horon,"},"18":{"text":"Baalath le Judah hramlak ih a ummi Tamar khua,"},"19":{"text":"a rawl retnak khua pawl le a rang le a rangleng retnak khua pawl, Jerusalem ah siseh, Lebanon ah siseh, a ukmi ramsung hmundang hmuahhmuah ah siseh, dinsal a duhmi khua pawl cu Solomon in a dinsal thluh a si."},"20":{"text":"Cutiih a hmanmi a hnaṭuantu pawl cu Israel mi pawl in Kanaan ram an lak tikah an rak thah lomi Kanaan mi pawl ih tesinfa pawl an si. Cumi pawl cu Amor mi, Hit mi, Periz mi, Hiv mi le Jebus mi an si ih an tesinfa pawl cu tuihsan tiangin sal an si lai hrih.","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"Solomon in Israel mi pawl cu salah a hmang lo. Annih cu a ralkap pawl, a kuthnuai bawi pawl, a ralkap hotu pawl, a leng mawng hotu pawl le a rang ralkap pawlah a hmang a si."},"23":{"text":"Solomon in a sakmi inn a phunphun a ṭuantu pawl hmuahhmuah hotu dingah hotu zanga le sawmnga a ret."},"24":{"text":"Izipt ram siangpahrang fanu, Solomon ih nupi cu David khawpi ihsin a suak ih Solomon in a hrangih a sakmi siangpahrang inn ah a ṭhawn; cuih hnuah Solomon in leilung khahsilh tahrat in Millo khawpi a sak."},"25":{"text":"Kum khatah voithum Solomon in mei-ur thawinak le remnak thawinak pawl Bawipa hrangih a dawlmi biakṭheng parah a pek. Bawipa hnenah rimhmui khal a ur ih a pek. Cuticun Solomon in Biakinn sak cu a ṭheh."},"26":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Eziongeber khua ah tangphawlawng tampi a tuah. Eziongeber cu Edom ram, Aqaba Tifinriat tikel ih um Elath khua kiangih a ummi khua a si."},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hiram in a tangphawlawng ralkap thiamzet pawl cu Solomon ih tangphawlawng ralkap pawl thawn ṭuantlang dingah a kuat."},"28":{"text":"Cu pawl cu Ofir ramah an feh ih Solomon hrangah sui phurh zali hrawng an rak phurh a si."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sheba ram siangpahrangnu in Solomon hminthan zia a theih tikah hniksak dingah thusuhnak har zetzet thawn Jerusalem ah a feh.","title":"Siangpahrangnu Sheba A Ra Tlawng (2 San. 9.1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Hnen-um tampi thawn a feh ih, rimhmui pawl, lungmankhung pawl, le sui tampi phurtu dingah kalauk tampi a keng ih Jerusalem khawpi a thleng. An ton awk tikah Sheba siangpahrangnu cun a thinlung ih a suakmi pohpoh thu tampi a sut."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in a thusuhmi cu a let thei ṭheh. A leh thei lomi thu zianghman a um lo."},"4":{"text":"Solomon ih mangbangza fimnak cu Sheba siangpahrangnu in a thei ih, siangpahrang inn a sakmi khal a hmu."},"5":{"text":"Cabuai parih a rawl eimi, a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih um daan, a hnaṭuantu pawl ih hrukmi hnipuan mawizia, a hnen-um pawl ih cangvaih daan le Biakinn ih thawinak a pekmi pawl, a zoh ih a hmuh tikah Sheba siangpahrangnu cu a thinlung a tong ngaingai. A hmuhmi hmuahhmuah in siangpahrangnu cu a mang a bangter tuk ih a lung hmuah a mit ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Cule Siangpahrang Solomon hnenah, “Ka ram ihsin na thuhla le na fimnak thu pawl ka rak theihmi cu a dik a si."},"7":{"text":"Asinain hinah ra tahratin ka mit rori ih ka hmuh hlanah cun ka zum thei dah lo. Ka theihmi cu atu ka mit ih ka hmuhmi ih hrek hman a rak si lo. Na fimnak le na lennak hi in rak simmi hnakin a nasa sawn a si."},"8":{"text":"Na nupi pawl an van a va ṭha ve! Na hnenah um in na fimnak ṭongkam a thei ringringtu na hnen-um pawl hi van an va nei so!"},"9":{"text":"Bawipa na Pathian cu thangṭhat in um ko seh! Israel siangpahrang ih a lo tuah ruangah na parah a lung a awi ti cu a langter zo a si. Israel mi pawl a duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun ruangah dingthluk lairelnak le felnak thawn anmah uk dingah nangmah an siangpahrang ah a lo tuah zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule Sheba Siangpahrangnu in Solomon cu sui phurh zakhat le phurh kul hluannga lenglo le rimhmui le lungmankhung tam ngaingai a pek. Sheba Siangpahrangnu in a pekmi rimhmui cu Solomon in ṭumkhat ih a ngahmi laksawng hmuahhmuah lakah a tam bik a si."},"11":{"text":"Hi thilri pawl hmuahhmuah tlunah Ofir ram ihsin sui a rak phurtu Hiram ih lawng pawl in sandal thing le lungmankhung pawl tampi an rak phurh fawn."},"12":{"text":"Hi thing cu Solomon in Biakinn le siangpahrang inn kulhnak ah a hmang ih awnmawi tumtu pawl hrangih tingrisit le ṭingṭang ah a tuah fawn. Israel ram sungih an phurhmi sandal thing hmuahhmuah lakah a ṭha bikmi thing a si. Cubangtuk thing ṭha cu an hmu dah nawn lo."},"13":{"text":"Sheba ram siangpahrangnu ih a dilmi hmuahhmuah cu Solomon in a pek ṭheh. Hi a pekmi cu siangpahrang pakhat in a dang siangpahrang hnenih an pek ṭheumi laksawng tlunah a si. Cuih hnuah Sheba siangpahrangnu cu a thluntu pawl thawn Sheba ramah an tlung."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in kumtin te in sui phurh zaruk le phurh kul hluannga a ngah ringring.","title":"Solomon Lenzia (2 San. 9.13-29)"},"15":{"text":"Himi cu sumtuahtu pawl hnen ihsin ngunkhuai a lakmi le pursumtu pawl hnen ihsin a miat a ngahmi le Arabia siangpahrang pawl le Israel ramṭhen uktu bawi pawl hnenin ngunkhuai a lakmi ih tlunah a si."},"16":{"text":"Solomon in ralphaw tumpi zahnih a tuah ih ralphaw pakhat cu sui cuai nga thawn khuutmi a si."},"17":{"text":"Cuih tlunah ralphaw fate deuh pawl zathum a tuah ih ralphaw pakhat cu sui cuai khat le hrek thawn khuutmi a si. Hi ralphaw pawl cu Lebanon Tupi Khaan timi a inn khaan sungah a ret."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang tokham tumpi pakhat vuiho le sui ṭha bik in a khuut."},"19":{"text":"Cuih siangpahrang tokham parih hung kai-nak ah kailawn paruk a um ih kailawn pakhat ah kiosa lem pahnih fingfing an ret ih a zatein kiosa lem hleihnih a um. Siangpahrang tokham dunglamah cawcang lu lem a um ih, tokham par kut retnak pahnih kapah kiosa lem pahnih, khatlamah pakhat fingfing in an um. Hi bangtuk tokham cu zo siangpahrang hman in an nei dah keel lo.","merge":"20"},"21":{"text":"Solomon ih hmanmi khuat hmuahhmuah cu sui ih tuahmi an si ṭheh. Lebanon Tupi Khaan sungih hmanmi beel le kheng pawl khal sui hlir ih tuahmi an si ṭheh. Ngun cu zianghman ah an hmang lo, ziangahtile Solomon san ahcun ngun cu man nei lo ah an ruah mi a si."},"22":{"text":"Solomon in tipi thuanthum fehmi tangphawlawng khal tampi a nei ih, Hiram ih lawng pawl thawn an fehtlang ṭheu. Kum thum ah voikhat a lawng pawl cu an ra tlung ih sui, ngun, vuiho, le zawng tumpi pawl le zawng dang pawl tla an rak phur ṭheu a si."},"23":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon cu siangpahrang dang hmuahhmuah hnakin a lian deuh ih a fim khal a fim deuh."},"24":{"text":"Pathian ih a pekmi fimnak theih duh le ngai duh ah leilung tlun khuazakip in mi tampi a hnenah an ra ṭheu."},"25":{"text":"Kum khat hnu kum khat a hnenih a rami pawl in laksawng an rak ken ṭheu ih an pekmi laksawng pawl cu, sui le ngun ih tuahmi thilri, korfual pawl, hriamnam pawl, rimhmui pawl, rang pawl le laak pawl tla an si."},"26":{"text":"Solomon in raldonak rangleng thawngkhat le zali a nei ih rang cu thawng hleihnih a nei. A hrek cu Jerusalem ah a ret ih a hrek cu khua dangah a ret."},"27":{"text":"Solomon in ram a uk sungah ngun cu Jerusalem ih lungto zat in a tam ih sidar thing cu Judah Phairawn ih theipi kung zat in a tam."},"28":{"text":"A rang pawl cu Izipt le Silisia ihsin leimi an si. A milai pawl ih a man an khiah zat in Silisia ihsin an lei ṭheu."},"29":{"text":"Izipt ramah raldonak rangleng pakhat man cu ngun tangka zaruk a si ih rang pakhat man cu ngun tangka za le sawmnga a si. Solomon ih milai pawl in rang le raldonak rangleng pawl cu Hit siangpahrang le Siria siangpahrang hnenah an zuar sin ṭheu."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in ramdang nunau tampi a ngai. Izipt siangpahrang fanu a ṭhit tlunah, Hit nunau, Moab nunau, Ammon nunau, Edom nunau, le Sidon nunau pawl tla a ṭhi.","title":"Pathian Hnen Ihsin Solomon A Pial"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in khawzing dangdang an rian pang ding ti phan ah, ramdang mi pawl ṭhi lo dingin Israel mi pawl cu Pathian in thu a pek naón, Solomon in cuih miphun ih nunau pawl cu a ṭhi thotho."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in nupi za sarih a nei ih an zate in siangpahrang phun lawnglawng an si. Cuih tlunah nusun zathum a nei fawn. Cuih a nupi pawl in Solomon cu Pathian hnen ihsin an pialter ih,"},"4":{"text":"patar a si tikah cun ramdang khawzing biaknak ah an hruaisuak. A pa David vek si loin Solomon cu a thinlung khawzing dangdang hnen a pan ih Bawipa a Pathian hmaiah rintlak lo a si."},"5":{"text":"Sidon mi pawl ih khawzingnu Astartes a biak ih, Ammon mi pawl ih fihnungza khawzing Milkom khal a biak."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih parah a sual ih thil ṭha lo a tuah; a pa David vekin Pathian hmaiah diktein a nung lo."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem ihsin nisuahnak lam tlangpar ah Moab mi pawl ih fihnungza khawzing Khemosh biaknak hrangah hmun pakhat a dawl ih Ammon mi pawl ih fihnungza khawzing Molek biaknak hrang khalah hmun pakhat a dawl."},"8":{"text":"Ramdang mi a nupi pawl in rimhmui an ur ih an khawzing hnenih thawinak an pek theinak dingah biaknak hmun tampi a tuah fawn."},"9":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cu Solomon hnenah voihnih a lang ih ramdang khawzing biak lo dingah thu a pek naón, Bawipa thu cu Solomon in a ngai cuang lo ih a lamzin ihsin a pial a si. Curuangah Bawipa cu Solomon parah a thin a heng ih,","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"a hnenah, “Ka hnenih na thukammi cu tumhrim in na siatsuah ih, ka thupekmi khal na thlun lo ruangah hiti in ka lo sim: na ram uknak cu ka lak ding ih na kuthnuai bawi pakhatkhat hnenah ka pe ding."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na pa David ih ruangah cumi cu na nun sungah cun ka tuah lo ding. Na fapa ih san ah ka tuah ding a si."},"13":{"text":"Cuhmanah a uknak zate cun ka lak sak lo ding. Ka siahhlawh David le ka ta ih ka tuah zomi Jerusalem khawpi ruangah, a hnenah hrin hrinkhat cu ka taan ding,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in Edom siangpahrang ih sungkhat a si mi Hadad cu Solomon do dingah a fial.","title":"Solomon Ih Ral Pawl"},"15":{"text":"Hlanlaipi ah David in Edom ram a rak neh tikah a ralkap pawl hotu Joab cu Edom ramih a thimi pawl ruak phum dingah a rak feh. Culai ah Joab le a ralkap pawl cu Edom ramah thla ruk an rak um. Cuih sungah Edom mi mipa hmuahhmuah cu,","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Hadad le a pa ih hnen-um pawl hrekkhat siar lo, an rak that ṭheh a si. Hadad le a pa ih hnen-um pawl cu Izipt ramah an rak tlan ih, culai ahcun Hadad cu nauhakte a rak si."},"18":{"text":"Midian ihsin an pok ih Paran ah an feh. Cutawkah mipa hrekkhat pawl in an beet ih, cuticun Izipt ram an va thleng. Izipt siangpahrang hnenah an feh ih, Izipt siangpahrang in Hadad cu leiram le inn le rawl tla a rak pek."},"19":{"text":"Hadad in Izipt siangpahrang ih thinlung a tong ih rualpi ṭhazet ah an cang. Curuangah siangpahrang in a nupi Tahpenes ih unau cu a nupi dingah Hadad a pek."},"20":{"text":"A nupi thawn Genubath timi fapa an nei ih siangpahrang bawinu in siangpahrang inn ahcun a cawm ih siangpahrang fapa pawl thawn an ṭhang tlang."},"21":{"text":"Izipt ram a umnak ihsin Hadad in David a thi zo ih David ih ralkap hotu Joab khal a thi zo ti thuthang a rak theih tikah Izipt siangpahrang hnenah a feh ih, “Ka khua le ka ramah i kirter thlang aw,” tiah a dil."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Izipt siangpahrang in, “Ziangah so kir cu na duh? Na duh mi ka lo pek thei lo ruangah maw a kir cu na duh?” tiah a sut. Hadad in, “Ziangkhal sisehla i thlah ko aw,” tiah a let. Curuangah Hadad cu a ramah a kir. Hadad cu Edom siangpahrang a cang ih mi ṭha lo a siruangah Israel mi pawl ih ral ṭihnung bikah a cang."},"23":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Eliada fapa Rezon khal Bawipa in Solomon dodaltu ah a tuah. Himi cu David in Hadadezer a neh ih Hadadezer ṭantu Siria ralkap pawl a thah thluh hnu ih a cangmi a si. Rezon le a homi pawl cu an feh ih Damaskas khua ah an va um. Cutawkah amah cu a milai pawl in Siria siangpahrang ah an tuah."},"25":{"text":"Solomon nun sung hmuahhmuah ah Rezon cu Israel mi pawl ih ral pakhat ah a cang."},"26":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon a dodaltu pakhat cu Efraim ram Zeredah khua ih Nebat fapa Jeroboam a si. Ahijah cu korfualpi thar hruk in a ra."},"30":{"text":"Cuih a korfualpi thar cu a hlit ih ṭhen hleihnih ah a thlek hnuah,"},"31":{"text":"Jeroboam hnenah cun, “Na hrangah ṭhen hra hi la aw.
