Solomon in ka thu a ngai lo. Thilsual a tuah ih ka daan le ka thupekmi pawl cu a pa David vekin a thlun lo a si."},"34":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a ram pumpi cun ka long lo ding. Ka rak hrilmi, ka daan le ka thupekmi pawl a thluntu ka siahhlawh David ruangah Solomon cu a nunsung hmuahhmuah ah thuneitu ka siter ding."},"35":{"text":"Solomon fapa san ihsin a ram cu ka long dingih na hnenah miphun phun hra ka lo pe ding."},"36":{"text":"Solomon fapa cu miphun phunkhat ka coter ve ding ih, cuticun ka hmin in kawhnak dingih ka hril ciami Jerusalem khawpi ah ka siahhlawh David ih tesinfa pakhatkhat tal cu ram uktu ah ka ret ding."},"37":{"text":"Nangmah Jeroboam cu Israel siangpahrang ah ka lo tuah ding ih na duhzat ram na uk ding."},"38":{"text":"Ka siahhlawh David vekin ka thu na ngai ih ka daan pekmi in na nung ih ka thupekmi na thlun ih ka lung i kimter a si ahcun na hnenah ka um ringring ding. David vekin nangmah cu Israel siangpahrang ah ka lo tuah dingih na tesinfa pawl khal na hnuah siangpahrang ah ka tuah vivo ding."},"39":{"text":"Solomon ih sualnak ruangah David ih tesinfa pawl parah hremnak ka thlenter ding, asinain kumkhua cun a si lo ding,’ a ti a si,” tiah a sim."},"40":{"text":"Cule Solomon in Jeroboam cu thah a tum naón Izipt siangpahrang Shishak hnenah a tlan ih cutawk ah Solomon a thih hlan lo a um."},"41":{"text":"Solomon hnaṭuannak le a thuhla dang pawl le a fimnak thu pawl cu Solomon Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan ṭheh a si.","title":"Solomon Thihnak (2 San. 9.29-31)"},"42":{"text":"Jerusalem ihsin Israel ram pumpi kum sawmli sung a uk."},"43":{"text":"A thi ih Jerusalem ah an phum. Cule a fapa Rehoboam in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rehoboam cu amah siangpahrang canter dingih Israel mi pawl an tonkhawmnak Shekhem ah a feh.","title":"Saklam Hrin Pawl Ral An Tho (2 San. 10.1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Cuih thu cu siangpahrang Solomon ṭih ah Izipt ram ih a tlantu Nebat fapa Jeroboam hnenah a thleng. Cule Jeroboam cu Izipt ram ihsin a kir."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in amah cu an sawm ih an zatein siangpahrang Rehoboam hnenah an feh ih,"},"4":{"text":"“Na pa Solomon in in hrem ih kan phur a rihter a si. Cutiin an tlung."},"6":{"text":"Cule Rehoboam in a pa Solomon ih thuron ṭheumi patar pawl cu a ron ih, “Hi Israel misenpi pawl hi ziangtinso ka sawn ding?” tiah a sut."},"7":{"text":"Annih in, “Hi misenpi pawl hi ṭhate ih uk na duh a si ahcun, tuihsun ah an hrangah ṭhatein hna ṭuan awla, an lo dil vekin ti sak hai awla, cuticun rintlak ih a lo riantu ringring ah an cang ding,” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Rehoboam in an ruahnak cu zianghman ah a siar sak lo. Amah thawn a ṭhang tlangmi a thuron ṭheu mi mino pawl sawn hnenah a feh ih,"},"9":{"text":"“Nan ruahnak in sim hnik uh. ‘Na pa in kan parah a retmi thilrit cu zaangter hram aw’ tiih i diltu pawl hi ziangtinso ka sawn ding?” tiah a sut."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “‘Ka hngete hi ka pa ih taai hnakin a tum sawn!"},"11":{"text":"Ka pa in nan thil a ritter; kei khal in ka ritter sinsin ding. Ka pa in nuangfung in a lo vuak, kei in varngen tawpir thawn ka lo hrem hai ding,’ va ti aw,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"A tiam vekin ni thum hnuah Jeroboam le Israel mi pawl cu Siangpahrang Rehoboam hnenah an ra ih,"},"13":{"text":"Rehoboam in a rak zawt ciamco hai. Patar pawl ih ruahnak pekmi cu la lo-in,"},"14":{"text":"a rualpi mino pawl ih ruahnak pekmi sawn a lak ih, “Ka pa in nan thil a ritter; kei khal in ka ritter sinsin ding. Ka pa in nuangfung in a lo vuak; kei in varngen tawpir thawn ka lo hrem hai ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Rehoboam in Israel mi pawl ih dilmi a elnak cu Bawipa ih forhnak ruangah a si. Profet Ahijah hmangin Jeroboam hnenih thu a kam zomi kim ternak dingah a si."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang in an dilmi zianghman ih a siar lo kha Israel mi pawl in an theih tikah an au ih: “David le a sungkhat pawl hnen in ziang covo so kan neih? Cuvete in Rehoboam cu a rangleng a to ih zamrangte in Jerusalem ah a tlan."},"19":{"text":"Cuih thokin Israel ram timi saklam ram pawl in David tesinfa pawl ih ram uknak cu an engtai ringring a si."},"20":{"text":"Israel misenpi pawl in Izipt ram ihsin Jeroboam a ra kir sal zo a si, ti kha an theih tikah misenpi tonkhawmnak ah an sawm ih amah cu Israel siangpahrang ah an tuah. Bawipa ih thupekmi cu an ngai ih an inn ah an tlung ṭheh."},"25":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Jeroboam in Efraim tlangpar ramih a ummi Shekhem khawpi cu ralhruang in a kulh ih cutawk ah tikcu malte sung a um. Cuih hnuah cutawk ihsin a suak ih Penuel khawpi cu ralhruang in a kulh sal.","title":"Pathian Lamzin In Jeroboam A Pial"},"26":{"text":"A thinlung sungin, “Atu vek a si ringring ih ka minung pawl Jerusalem Biakinn ah feh tahratin Bawipa hnenih thawinak an pek ringring a si ahcun an thinlung cu Judah Siangpahrang Rehoboam lamah a her-aw ding ih kei cu in that leh ding,” tiah a ruat.","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"Rei nawn a ruat-awk hnuah, sui in cawcang lem pahnih a tuah ih a minung pawl hnenah, “Pathian biak dingih Jerusalem ih nan fehnak hi a rei thlang. Maw Israel mi pawl, Izipt ram ihsin a lo suahtu nan pathian pawl cu hinah an um,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cuih cawcang lem pakhat cu Bethel ah a ret ih a dang pakhat cu Dan ah a ret."},"30":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi pawl cu sui cawcanglem biak dingah Bethel le Dah ah an feh ih misual ah an cang."},"31":{"text":"Jeroboam in khawzing biaknak hmun khal tlangbol kipah a tuah ih, Levi hrin a si lomi sungin puithiam tla a hril."},"32":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Jeroboam in Judah ramih biaknak puai a um vekin thla riat thla ni hleinga ni ah biaknak puai pakhat a thok ve. Bethel ih sui cawcanglem a retnak biakṭheng parah Jeroboam in thawinak pawl a pek ih an khawzing biaknak hrangih a hrilmi puithiam pawl tla a ret."},"33":{"text":"Amah in Israel mi pawl hrangih a thokmi puai, amah in a bunmi ni, thla riat thla, ni hleinga ni ahcun Bethel ah a feh ih, puai a tuah ih biakṭheng parah thawinak a pek a si."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupeknak bangtuk in Judah ihsin profet pakhat cu Bethel ah a feh ih thawinak pek dingah biakṭheng hmai ih Jeroboam a din laifangah a va thleng.","title":"Bethel Ih Biakṭheng A Siat"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupeknak thlun in profet in biakṭheng cu siat a serh ih, “Maw biakṭheng, biakṭheng, Bawipa in hiti in a ti: Naute pakhat, a hmin ah Josiah an timi cu David sungkhat lak ihsin a suak ding. Na parih thawinak a petu khawzing biaknak biakṭheng ih hnaṭuantu puithiam pawl cu na parah hin a that ding. Cule na parah hin milai ruh a ur ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cuih hnuah profet in a bet sal ih, “Hi biakṭheng hi a cim ṭheh ding ih a parih vutcam hi darh ṭheh a si ding. Cutikah atu ih ka ṭongmi hi Bawipa ih ṭongkam a si, ti nan thei ding,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cumi cu siangpahrang Jeroboam in a theih tikah, a kutzung a hei khih ih, “Kha pa kha kai uh!” tiah thu a pek. Profet in Bawipa hnenah thla a cam ih siangpahrang kut cu a dam sal."},"7":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in profet hnenah, “Ka inn ah ra awla, rawl ra ei aw. Laksawng lo pek ka duh a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah profet in, “Na neih mi hmuahhmuah ih hrek hman i pe cila na inn ahcun ka ra lo ding. Na hnenah zianghman ka ei ka in lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa in zianghman ei lo ding le in lo ding le ka ratnak lamzin ihsin kirsal lo dingah thu i pek a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah a ratnak lamzin ihsin tlung loin lamzin dang in a tlung."},"11":{"text":"Culai ahcun Bethel ah profet tarpa pakhat a um. A fapa pawl a hnenah an ra ih Judah ram profet in Bethel ah siangpahrang Jeroboam hnenah a ṭongmi le a hnaṭuan mi dangdang pawl tla an sim.","title":"Bethel Ih Profet Tarpa"},"12":{"text":"Profet tarpa cun, “A kir lamah khuitawk lamzin so a zawh?” tiah a sut hai. An dam ṭheh in a laak cu a to ih,"},"14":{"text":"Judah ram profet a kirnak lamzin ihsin a vun dawi. Cule sasuapi kung thuai ih a to laiah a vun man. “Judah ramih profet na si maw?” tiah a sut. “Ka si,” tiah a rak ti."},"15":{"text":"Anih in, “Ka inn ah ra awla rawl ra ei aw,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Asinain Judah ram profet in, “Na inn ahcun ka lo thlun thei lo ding. Na hnenah zianghman ka in ka ei thei lo ding,"},"17":{"text":"ziangahtile Bawipa in zianghman ei lo ding le in lo dingin thu i pek ih ka ratnak lamzin khal zawh kir lo dingin i fial a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule Bethel ih profet patarpa in, “Keimah khal nangmah vekin profet ka si ve ih, Bawipa ih thupekmi vekin ka inn ih lo sawm dingah vancungmi in i fial a si,” tiah a ti. Asinain profet patarpa cu thuphan a per a si."},"19":{"text":"Cutiih a sawm ruangah Judah ram profet cun a thlun ih profet patarpa hnenah cun rawl a va ei."},"20":{"text":"Cutiih rawl an ei tlang laifangah Bawipa ṭongkam cu profet patarpa hnenah a ra ih,"},"21":{"text":"a mikhualpa hnenah cun, “ Bawipa in, ‘Ka thu na ngai lo ih tuah dingih ka lo fialmi na tuah lo ruangah le,"},"22":{"text":"kir tahratin ei lo ding ka tinak hmunih rawl na ei ruangah, nangmah cu thah na si ding ih na ruak cu na pipu pawl ih thlaan ah phum a si lo ding,’ a ti,” tiah a au ciamco."},"23":{"text":"Rawl an ei ṭheh tikah profet patarpa in Judah ram profet pa ih hrangah laak kung a damsak ih a feh."},"24":{"text":"Lamzin ah kiosa pakhat a tong ih cuih kiosa cun a keu that. A ruak cu lamzin ah a ril ih a laak le kiosa cu a kiangah an ding."},"25":{"text":"Khual tlawng pawl in a ruak cu an hmu ih, a kiangih kiosa a din khal an hmu. Bethel ah an feh ih an hmuh vekin an vung sim."},"26":{"text":"Cuih thu cu profet tarpa in a theih tikah, “Pathian thupekmi a thlun duh lotu cu amah a si. A tiam cia vekin Bawipa in kiosa a thlah ih kiosa in a zon ih a thah a si cu!” a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule a fapa pawl hnenah, “Ka laak kung i damsak uh,” tiah a fial. An damsak ih,"},"28":{"text":"a vung feh tikah profet ih ruak cu lamzin ah a ril in a hmu ih, a kiangah laak le kiosa khal an ding lai in a hmu. Kiosa in profet ih ruak cu a ei lo ih laak khal cu a deh lo."},"29":{"text":"Profet patarpa in cuih ruak cu a laak parah a suang ih ṭah ding le phum dingah Bethel ah a phur."},"30":{"text":"Anmah ih sung thlaan ah an phum ih amah le a fapa pawl in, “Mi vanduai unaupa ee,” tiah an ṭah."},"31":{"text":"An phum ṭheh hnuah profet tarpa in a fapa pawl hnenah, “Ka thih tikah hi thlaan ahhin i run phum uhla ka ruh cu hi pa ih ruh kiangah run ret uh."},"32":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭongkam bangtuk in Bethel ih biakṭheng le Samaria khua pawl ih biaknak hmun pawl parih lungkim lonak a simmi hmuahhmuah cu a ṭong vekin an kim thluh leh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jeroboam cu thilsual a tuahnak lamzin ihsin a kir cuang lo ih cuih hlan vekin biakṭheng a dawlnak hmun ih hnaṭuantu dingah mi menmen sungin puithiam a hril thotho. Zokhal puithiam can a duhtu cu hriak a culh hluahhlo.","title":"Jeroboam Ih Sualnak Poimawhbik"},"34":{"text":"Cutiih a sual ruangah amah ih hrin in Israel ram uk ringring theinak ding cu a siatsuah a si."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih caanah Siangpahrang Jeroboam ih fapa Abijah a na.","title":"Jeroboam Ih Fapa A Thi"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah Jeroboam in a nupi hnenah, “Zohman ih theihthiam lo dingin phundang in tuah awla, profet Ahijah umnak Shiloh khua ah va feh aw. ‘Israel siangpahrang na cang ding,’ tiih a rak simtu cu amah profet Ahijah a si."},"3":{"text":"A hrangah sang zawl hra, sangrawh malte le khuaitizu palang khat hei keng aw. Ahijah cu a tarzet zo ih a mit khal a mal zo."},"5":{"text":"An fapa a nat ruangih Jeroboam a hnenih a ratnak ding thu kha Pathian in a rak sim cia zo. Jeroboam nupi cu a feh ih midang vekah a tuah-aw ih Ahijah hnen ah a va thleng."},"6":{"text":"Asinain sangka kiang a thlen kha Ahijah in a theih tikah, “Rung lut aw. Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in a hnenah hiti in a ti a si: ‘Miseenpi sung ihsin nangmah cu ka miphun Israel mi uktu dingah ka lo hril."},"8":{"text":"Ram uknak cu David tesinfa pawl hnen ihsin ka lak ih nangmah ka lo pek. Sikhalsehla ka thu famkim zetin a ngai ih, ka thupekmi thlun tahrat in ka lungkim mi lawnglawng a tuahtu ka siahhlawh David vek cu na si lo."},"9":{"text":"Na hlanih ram a rak uktu siangpahrang pawl hnakin luar deuh in na sual a si. Keimah i hnong zo ih biak dingah milem le zuk pawl na tuah ruangah ka thin i hengter zo. Kei cu na dunglamah i hlon zo a si."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah na uknak parah thil poimawh ka thlengter dingih na tesinfa pawl mipa hmuahhmuah upa siseh nauhak siseh, ka thiter thluh ding. Bawipa a si mi Keimah in ka sim zo,’ a ti va ti aw,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Ahijah in Jeroboam nupi hnenah cun, “Atu va tlung aw. Nan khua na thlen vete in nan fapa cu a thi ding."},"13":{"text":"Israel mi hmuahhmuah in an ṭah ding ih an phum ding. Jeroboam innsang sungah amah lawnglawng ṭhate ih phummi a si ding. Ziangahtile khawzingnu Asherah ih lem an tuah ruangah Bawipa ih thin an hengter zo."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel cu a dungtun ding, ziangahtile Jeroboam in sualnak a tuah ih Israel mi pawl khal sualnak sungah a hruai thluh zo, tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Jeroboam nupi cu a suak ih Tirzah ah a tlung. Cule a fapa Nadab in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"21":{"text":"Solomon fapa Rehoboam cu kum sawmli le kum khat a ti tikah Judah siangpahrang a cang ih, Bawipa an biaknak dingah Bawipa amah in Israel ram hmuahhmuah sungin a hrilmi Jerusalem khawpi ihsin kum hleisarih sung a uk. Rehoboam ih nu cu Ammon mi Naamah a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Rehoboam (2 San. 11.5—12.15)"},"22":{"text":"Judah mi pawl in Bawipa ih parah sualnak an tuah ih an pipu pawl ih sualnak an tuahmi hmuahhmuah hnakin Bawipa ih thinhengnak tam sawn an suahter."},"23":{"text":"Pathian biaknak hmun tampi an dawl; an biak dingah tlangpar le thingpi thuai ah lungserh an phun ih thingserh khal an phun."},"24":{"text":"Cuih khawzing biaknak hmun ahcun nunau siseh mipa siseh hlawhhlang an um ih cumi cu thildang hmuahhmuah hnakin fihnungza bik a si. Israel mi pawl Kanaan ram sung an luh laiah Bawipa in Kanaan mi a dawihlo mi pawl in fihnungza le ningzakza thil an rak tuahmi pawl kha Judah mi pawl in an tuah ṭheh ve a si."},"25":{"text":"Rehoboam in siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum nga a tinak kumah Izipt ram siangpahrang Shishak in Jerusalem khua a do ih a neh."},"26":{"text":"Biakinn sung le siangpahrang inn sungih a ummi hlawnthil le thil mankhung pawl hmuahhmuah, Solomon ih a tuahmi sui ralphaw pawl tiangin a lak ṭheh."},"27":{"text":"Cuih an lakmi pawl ai ah siangpahrang Rehoboam in daar ralphaw a tuah ih cu pawl cu siangpahrang inn kiltu bawi pawl ih kutah a ret."},"28":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa Biakinn a feh tin in inn kiltu pawl in ralphaw cu an keng ih cuih hnuah inn kiltu umnak khaan ah an retsal ṭheu."},"29":{"text":"Siangpahrang Rehoboam in a tuahmi dangdang pawl cu Judah Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah kimten an ngan a si."},"30":{"text":"Kum hi hmuah sungah hin Rehoboam le Jeroboam cu cat loin an do aw ringring."},"31":{"text":"Rehoboam cu a thi ih David khawpi siangpahrang pawl phumnak thlaan ah an phum. A nu cu Ammon mi Naamah a si. Cule a fapa Ahijah in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel Siangpahrang Jeroboam in ram a uknak kum hleiriat kumah Abijah cu Judah siangpahrang a cang ih,","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Abijah (2 San. 13.1—14.1)"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem ihsin kum thum sung a uk. A nu cu Absalom fanu Maakah a si."},"3":{"text":"A pa ih a rak tuahmi sualnak pawl a tuah thluh ve ih a pu David vek si loin Abijah cu Bawipa a Pathian hnenah a fel lo a si."},"4":{"text":"Asinain David ruangah, Jerusalem khua humtu dingah le amah hnuah Jerusalem ihsin ram uktu dingah Bawipa a Pathian in Abijah cu fapa pakhat a pek."},"5":{"text":"Hit mi Uriah ih thu lawngah David parah Bawipa ih lungkim lonak a um; thudang ahcun David in Bawipa cu a lung a awiter ih a thupekmi pakhat hman a el lo ruangah hibangtuk in Abijah parah Bawipa in hna a ṭuannak a si."},"6":{"text":"Abijah ih ram a uk sung hmuahhmuah ah Abijah le Jeroboam cu cat loin an do aw ringring."},"7":{"text":"Abijah ih tuahmi dangdang pawl cu Judah Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah kimtein an ngan a si."},"8":{"text":"Abijah cu a thi ih David khawpi ah an phum. Cule a fapa Asa in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"9":{"text":"Israel Siangpahrang Jeroboam in ram a uknak kum kul kum ah Asa cu Judah siangpahrang a cang ih,","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Asa (2 San. 15.16—16.6)"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem ihsin kum sawmli le kum khat sung a uk. A pi cu Absalom ih fanu Maakah a si."},"11":{"text":"Asa in a pu David vekin Bawipa ih lungawinak thil a tuah."},"12":{"text":"An ram sungih khawzing biaknak hmun pawl ih nunau siseh mipa siseh hlawhhlang pawl hmuahhmuah cu ramsung ihsin a dawi ṭheh ih, amah hlanih siangpahrang a ṭuantu pawl ih rak tuahmi milem le lemzuk pawl hmuahhmuah a hlon ṭheh."},"13":{"text":"A pi Maakah khal leilung ṭhattertu khawzingnu Asherah ih lemzuk cu bia dingih a tuah ruangah siangpahrang ih nu dinhmun ihsin a hlon. Asa in cuih lemzuk cu a hau ih Kidron Tiva kiangah a ur."},"14":{"text":"Asa in khawzing biaknak hmun hmuahhmuah an zatein a balsiat thluh lo naón a nun sung hmuahhmuah ah Bawipa rinsan le ṭihzah in a um."},"15":{"text":"A pa ih Pathian hnenih a rak pekmi thilri hmuahhmuah cu Biakinn sungah a ret; amah ih pekmi sui le ngun ih tuahmi beelkheng pawl khal a ret."},"16":{"text":"Judah Siangpahrang Asa le Israel Siangpahrang Baasha cu ram uktu an si sung hmuahhmuah ah cat loin an do aw ringring."},"17":{"text":"Ṭum khatah Baasha in Judah ram a do ih Judah ram in a suakmi le a lutmi pawl kham ṭheh tum in Ramah khua ralhruang in a kulh ciamco."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Siangpahrang Asa in Biakinn le siangpahrang inn ih a ummi sui le ngun hmuahhmuah a lak ih a kuthnuai bawi pawl hrekkhat ih kut in Damaskas ah a kuat. Hezion ih tupa, Tabrimmon ih fapa a si mi Siria siangpahrang Benhadad hnenah hiti in thu a cah:"},"19":{"text":"“Kan pa le pawl an rak ṭantlang vekin kannih khal kan ṭangtlang pei. Laksawng ah hi sui le ngun hi ka lo kuat. Siangpahrang Baasha thawn ṭangtlangtu nan sinak cu rak phiat awla ka ram sungih a retmi a ralkap pawl cu Baasha in a ko sal thluh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Asa ih thucah mi cu Siangpahrang Benhadad a lung a kim ih a ralbawi pawl Israel ramih khua hrekkhat pawl siim dingin a thlah. Ijon khua, Dan khua, Abel Beth Maakah khua, Galilee Tipi kiangih ram pawl le Naftali ram hmuahhmuah an lak."},"21":{"text":"Cuih thu cu siangpahrang Baasha in a theih tikah Ramah khua ralhruang ih a kulh reromi cu a bang ih Tirzah khua ah a kir."},"22":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Asa in Judah ramsung hmuahhmuah ah thu a pek ih a ramsung minung pawl pakhat hman hrelh loin a ko ih Baasha in Ramah khua kulhnak ih a hmanmi lungto le thingpheng pawl cu an thiar ciamco. Cuih lungto le thing cun Asa in Mizpah le Benjamin ram sungih a ummi Geba khua a sak."},"23":{"text":"Siangpahrang Asa ih tuahmi dangdang, a ralṭhatnak thu pawl le khua a kulhnak thu pawl cu, Judah Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah kimten an ngan. Asinain a tar zawng ah a ke a na ih a awl ta."},"24":{"text":"Asa cu a thi ih David khawpi siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Cule a fapa Jehoshafat in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"25":{"text":"Judah Siangpahrang Asa in ram a uknak kum hnih kum ah Siangpahrang Jeroboam ih fapa Nadab cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih kum hnih sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Nadab"},"26":{"text":"A pa vekin Bawipa ih hmaiah a sual ih Israel mi pawl cu sualnak sungah a hruai."},"27":{"text":"Issakhar phun Ahijah ih fapa Baasha in Nadab cu a phiar ih Nadab le a ralkap pawl in Filistin ramih Gibbethon khawpi an do ih an kulh ṭheh laifangah Baasha in Nadab cu a that."},"28":{"text":"Nadab an thah cu Judah siangpahrang Asa in ram a uknak kum thum kum ah a si. Cuih hnuah Baasha in Israel siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"29":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Baasha in Jeroboam ih innsang le sungkhat pawl hmuahhmuah a that ciamco. Bawipa ih siahhlawh Shiloh khuami profet Ahijah hnen ihsin Bawipa ih ṭong mi vekin Jeroboam ih sungkhat hmuahhmuah cu thah ṭheh an si. Pakhat hman an luat lo."},"30":{"text":"Hi bangtuk thil a suahnak cu Jeroboam in sualnak a tuah ih Israel khal sualnak sungih a hruai ruangah Israel ih Pathian Bawipa a thin a hengter ruangah a si."},"31":{"text":"Nadab ih tuahmi dangdang cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah kimtein an ngan a si."},"32":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Asa le Israel Siangpahrang Baasha cu siangpahrang an si sung hmuahhmuah ah cat loin an do aw ringring."},"33":{"text":"Judah Siangpahrang Asa in ram a uknak kum thum kumah Ahijah fapa Baasha cu Israel rampi ih siangpahrang a cang ih, Tirzah khua ihsin kum kul hluanli sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Baasha"},"34":{"text":"A hlanih siangpahrang a ṭuantu Jeroboam vekin Bawipa ih parah sualnak a tuah ih Israel mi pawl khal sualnak ah a hruai."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Hanani fapa profet Jehu hnenah, Baasha va sim dingah hiti in thu a sim:"},"2":{"text":"“Leivut lak ihsin ka lo cawisaang ih ka minung Israel mi pawl ih siangpahrang ah ka lo tuah. Asinain na sual ih Jeroboam vekin Israel mi pawl na hruaisual a si. An sualnak in ka thin i hengter ruangah,"},"3":{"text":"Jeroboam parih ka tuah zo vekin na par khalah ka tuah ding ih, nangmah le na sungkhat pawl cu ka lo hlon ṭheh ding."},"4":{"text":"Khawpi sungih a thimi na sungkhat pawl cu uico in an ruak an ei ding. Hramlak ih a thimi pawl cu langta in an ruak an ei ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Baasha ih tuahmi dang hmuahhmuah le a ralṭhatnak thu pawl cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Baasha cu a thi ih Tirzah ah an phum. Cule a fapa Elah in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"7":{"text":"Baasha le a sungkhat pawl parih Bawipa ih siatserhnak ṭongkam a thlentu cu profet Jehu a si. Baasha cu Bawipa ih parih a sual ruangah hi bangtuk siatserhnak a hnenih a thlennak a si. Amah hlanih siangpahrang a ṭuantu Jeroboam vekin Baasha khal in ṭhatlonak a tuah ruang lawngah si loin Jeroboam le a innsang pawl an zate ih a thah ṭheh ruangah Bawipa ih thin a hengter a si."},"8":{"text":"Judah Siangpahrang Asa in ram a uknak kum kul hluanruk kum ah Baasha fapa Elah cu Israel siangpahrang a ṭuan ih Tirzah ihsin kum hnih sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Elah"},"9":{"text":"Cule a kuthnuai ih bawi pakhat, siangpahrang rangleng hrek khat hotu Zimri in a phiar. Siangpahrang cu a inn kiltu pawl hotu Arza inn ih zu a rit laiah,"},"10":{"text":"Zimri cu a ra lut ih Siangpahrang Elah a thah hnuah amah in siangpahrang a run ṭuan. Himi cu Judah siangpahrang Asa in ram a uknak kum kul hluansarih kum ah a si."},"11":{"text":"Zimri cu siangpahrang a ṭuan vete in Baasha ih innsang pawl hmuahhmuah a that ṭheh. A sungkhat le a rualpi ṭha mipa hmuahhmuah khal a that ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Profet Jehu hmangin Baasha parih Bawipa ih ṭongkam a rak ummi vekin Baasha ih innsang pawl cu Zimri in a that ṭheh a si."},"13":{"text":"Baasha le a fapa Elah in milem an bia ih Israel an hruaisual ruangah Israel ih Pathian Bawipa a thin an hengter."},"14":{"text":"Elah ih tuahmi dang pawl hmuahhmuah cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"15":{"text":"Judah Siangpahrang Asa ih ram uknak kum kul hluansarih kum ah Tirzah khua ihsin Israel ram cu Zimri in ni sarih sung a uk. Israel ralkap pawl in Filistin ram Gibbethon khawpi an do ih an kulh ṭheh fangah,","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Zimri"},"16":{"text":"Zimri in an siangpahrang a phiar ih a that ti kha an theih tikah, cutawk rori ahcun anmah hotu ralbawi Omri cu Israel siangpahrang ah an tuah."},"17":{"text":"Omri le a ralkap pawl in Gibbethon khua cu an tlansan ih Tirzah khua sawn an kulh."},"18":{"text":"Zimri in a ral pawl kutah a khawpi Tirzah a thleng zo ti a hmuh tikah, a innsung ral ṭannak sungtakhaan ah a lut ih siangpahrang inn cu meisa in a ur ih amah khal a kang that a si."},"19":{"text":"Hi bangtuk vanduainak thil cu Bawipa parih a sual ruangah a suakmi a si. A ai-awh mi Jeroboam bangtuk in anih khal a sual ih Israel mi pawl khal a sualter thluh ruangah Bawipa cu a lungawiter lo."},"20":{"text":"Zimri ih tuahmi dang hmuahhmuah cu, mi a phiarnak thu thawn, Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"21":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu ṭhenhnih ah an ṭhen aw: a hrekin Ginath fapa Tibni siangpahrang canter an duh, a hrekin Omri an ṭan.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Omri"},"22":{"text":"A netnak ah Omri ṭantu pawl in an neh. Tibni cu a thi ih Omri siangpahrang ah a cang."},"23":{"text":"Cuticun Judah siangpahrang Asa in ram a uknak kum sawmthum le kum khat kum ah Omri cu Israel siangpahrang ah a cang. Israel ram kum hleihnih sung a uk. A hmaisa kum ruk sung cu Tirzah khua ihsin a uk."},"24":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Shemer timi pa hnen ihsin Samaria tlang cu tangka thawngruk in a lei. Omri in Samaria tlang cu ralhruang in a kulh ih cunah khawpi a din. A tlang rak neitu Shemer hmin suangin cuih khawpi hmin cu Samaria tiah a sak."},"25":{"text":"A hlanih siangpahrang a rak ṭuantu pawl hnakin Omri cu Bawipa ih parah a sual sinsin."},"26":{"text":"A hlanih siangpahrang a rak ṭuantu Jeroboam vekin, amah ih sualnak ruangah le Israel mi pawl milem biaknak le sualnak sungih a hruailut ruangah, Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cu a thin a hengter."},"27":{"text":"Omri ih tuahmi dang hmuahhmuah le a san sungih thil a cangmi pawl cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"28":{"text":"Omri a thi ih Samaria ah an phum. Cule a fapa Ahab in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"29":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Asa in ram a uknak kum sawmthum le kum riat kum ah Omri fapa Ahab cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria khua ihsin kum kul hluanhnih sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Ahab"},"30":{"text":"Amah hlanih siangpahrang a rak ṭuantu pawl hnakin Bawipa ih parah a sual sawn."},"31":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jeroboam vekih sualnak tuah cu tawk a ti hrih loih Sidon siangpahrang Ethbaal ih fanu Jezebel a ṭhi ih Baal khawzing tiangin a biak."},"32":{"text":"Samaria khawpi ah Baal khawzing hrangah biakinn a sak ih biakṭheng a dawl ih biakinn sungah cun Baal khawzing cu a ret."},"33":{"text":"Zingnu Asherah biaknak ah a zarhmi thingserh khal a ret. Amah hlanih Israel siangpahrang a rak ṭuantu pawl hmuahhmuah hnakin amah pakhat in Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cu a luar in a thin a hengter."},"34":{"text":"Amah in Israel ram a uk sungah Bethel khuami Hiel in Jerikho khua cu a din sal. Cutikah Nun ih fapa Joshua hmangin Bawipa in a rak sim cia vekin Jerikho khua din salnak an thok tikah Hiel ih fapa upabik Abiram a thi ih kotka pawl an tuah laiah a fapa nautabik Segub a thi lala."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gilead ram Tishbe khua ihsin Elijah an timi profet pakhat cu siangpahrang Ahab hnenah a feh ih, “A nungmi Bawipa Israel ih Pathian, ka biak mi Bawipa ih hminin ka lo sim: Keimah in sur thlangseh ka ti hlanlo, atu ihsin hmailam kum hnih kum thum sung cu daitla siseh ruah sur siseh a um lo ding,” tiah a sim.","title":"Elijah Le Ruah A Sur Lonak Thu"},"2":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Elijah cu,"},"3":{"text":"“Hi hmun hi tlansan awla, nisuahnak lamah feh in Jordan Tiva ihsin nisuahnak lamih a ummi Kherith Tiva kap ah va relh aw."},"4":{"text":"Cuih tiva ihsin tidai in ding na ngah ding ih cutawkih rawl a lo petu dingah tlang-ak pawl ka fial zo,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Elijah in Bawipa ih thu cu a ngai ih Kherith Tiva kap ahcun a va relh."},"6":{"text":"Cuih tiva ihsin tidai a in ih tlang-ak pawl in a hrangah zingtin le zantin rawl le sa an rak pek."},"7":{"text":"Malte a rei hnuah ruah a sur lo ruangah cuih tiva cu a kang."},"8":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Elijah hnenah,","title":"Elijah Le Nuhmei Thu"},"9":{"text":"“Sidon khua kiang Zarefath khua ah va feh awla va um aw. Cutawkih a ummi nuhmei pakhat cu nangmah lo cawmtu dingah ka fial zo,” tiah a sim."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Elijah cu Zarefath khua ah a va feh ih khawsung luhnak kotka a thlen tikah nuhmei pakhat zanthing khawm rero a hmu. Cuih nuhmei nu hnenah cun, “Zaangfahnak in tidai in ding i pe aw,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Tidai suak dingih nuhmei nu a feh laiah cun, “Rawl ei ding khal i rak ken aw,” tiah a hei auh."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah nuhmei nu in, “ Bawipa na Pathian hmin saal in ka lo sim a si: Rawl zianghman ka nei lo. Ka neihmi cu beel sungah sangphut zatekhat le palang sungah olif hriak malte lawng a si. Hitawkih zanthing malte ka khawmmi hin rawl ka neihmi malte cu ka fapa le keimai hrangah ka suang ding ka ti. Cumi cu rawl kan eimi neta bik a si ding. Cuih hnu cun rawl loin kan thi thlang ding a si ko,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in, “Phang hlah! Va feh awla na rawl cu va suang aw. Asinain hmaisabik ah na neihmi sungin hlom khat fate in la awla ka hnenah rak keng aw. Cule a taangmi cu nangmah le na fapa hrangah suang aw."},"14":{"text":"Ziangahtile a hi thu ahhin Israel ih Pathian Bawipa in, ‘Beel sungih sangphut cu a cem dah lo ding ih palang sungih hriak khal a cem dah lo ding, Bawipa keimah in ruah ka surter ni a thlen hlanlo cu,’ a ti a si,” tiah a sim."},"15":{"text":"Nuhmei nu cu a feh ih Elijah ih sim vekin a tuah ṭheh. Cuticun ni tinte, Elijah hrang siseh, nuhmei nu le a innsang hrangah siseh, an zatein rawl ei ding an nei ringring."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ih thutiammi Elijah ih a sim bangtuk in beel sungih sangphut cu a cem dah lo ih palang sungih hriak khal a cem dah lo."},"17":{"text":"Malte a rei deuh tikah nuhmei nu ih fapa cu a na. A besia deuhdeuh ih neta bik ahcun a thaw a cem."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah a nu in Elijah hnenah, “Pathian ih milai pa, ziangah ka parah hi bangtuk thil hi na thlenter? Ka sualnak pawl Pathian theihter tahratih ka fapa thihter dingah maw hitawk ih na rat?” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in, “Na fapa cu hinah rak cawi aw,” tiah a ti. Elijah in nuhmei nu ih fapa cu a nu kut ihsin a lak ih a umnak tlunta khaan ah a hun cawi ih ihkhun parah a hlum."},"20":{"text":"Cule Elijah in, “Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, ziangah so hi nuhmei nu ih parah thil ṭha lozet na tuah? Ka parah zaangfahnak a nei ih i kilkhawi a si. Atu-ah a fapa na thihter!” tiah napi in thla a cam."},"21":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Elijah cu cuih nauhakpa ih parah voithum a bok ih, “Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, hi nauhakpa hi nungter sal hram aw,” tiah thla a cam."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in Elijah ih thlacam cu a thei ih, nauhakpa cu a thaw a thaw sal ih a hung nung sal."},"23":{"text":"Elijah in nauhakpa cu hnuaita khaan ah a vun cawi sal ih a nu hnenah a pek. “Zohhnik! Na fapa a nun sal hi!” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah a nu in, “Atu cun Pathian milai ngaingai na si ih na hnen ihsin Bawipa cu a ṭong taktak a si ti ka thei zo,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tikcu a hung rei ih ruah sur lo kum kum thumnak ah Bawipa in Elijah hnenah, “Va feh awla Siangpahrang Ahab va tong aw. Cule ruah ka surter ding,” tiah a ti.","title":"Elijah Le Baal Profet Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah Elijah cu a feh. Samaria ah paampi cu a luar ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Ahab in siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl hotu Obadiah a ko. Obadiah cu Bawipa zumtu ṭhazet a si ih,"},"4":{"text":"Jezebel in Bawipa ih profet pawl a thah rero tikah Obadiah in profet zakhat tluk a hruai ih lungpuk sungah sawmnga sawmnga in a thup ih an ei ding tidai le rawl tla a pek."},"5":{"text":"Ahab in Obadiah hnenah, “Kan feh pei ih cirh kap le tiva kap hmuahhmuah ah hrampi kan hawl pei. Hrampi kan hmu a si ahcun kan rang le kan laak pawl hi an nung meen ding. Kan ṭilva pawl pakhat hman thah ṭul lo tla in kan tuah thei meen ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"An fehnak ding ram an zem-aw ih hmun dangdang ah an feh."},"7":{"text":"Obadiah cu a feh rero laiah rinlopi ah Elijah a tong. Elijah a si ti a theithiam lohli ih, a hmaiah a kun ih, “Bawipa, nangmah maw na si?” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Elijah in, “Asi! Elijah ka si. Va feh awla siangpahrang na bawipa cu, ‘Elijah hinah a um’ tiah va sim aw,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Obadiah in, “Ziang ka tuah ruangah so hi bangtuk hnaṭuan i fial? Siangpahrang Ahab in i that meen ding a sisi!"},"10":{"text":"A nungmi Bawipa na Pathian hmin saal in ka lo sim: Leilung tlun ram tinah siangpahrang in a lo hawl ringring a si. Khui ram khalin na um lonak thu siangpahrang Ahab hnenih an rak sim tikah, na um lonak thu thungai a si ti theinak an ram uktu cu thu a kamter a si."},"11":{"text":"Cule atu-ah siangpahrang hnenah feh tahratin hitawk ih na um thu va sim aw tiah i fial."},"12":{"text":"Ka feh vete in kan theih lonak hmunah Bawipa ih thlarau in lo phur hlo bangsehla ziangtinso kan ti ding? Hitawkih na um thu Ahab ka va sim ih anih ih a lo hmuh saal lo tikah kei cu i that ding a si. Na theih vekin keimah cu ka nauhak lai ihsin Bawipa biatu le ṭihzahtu ka si."},"13":{"text":"Jezebel in Bawipa ih profet pawl a thah rero tikah profet zakhat lungpuk sungah sawmnga sawmnga in ka thuh ih an ei ding le an in ding ti le rawl khal ka pek ti na thei dah lo maw si?"},"14":{"text":"Curuangah ziangtinso hitawk ih na um thu kha siangpahrang sim ding i fial? I that ding a sisi!” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in, “Ka biakmi Ziangkimtithei Bawipa hmin in ka lo kam: Tuihsun ah siangpahrang ka tong ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah Obadiah cu Siangpahrang Ahab hnenah a va feh ih a va sim. Cule Ahab cu hmakhatte-ah Elijah tong dingah a suak."},"17":{"text":"Ahab in Elijah a hmuh tikah a hnenah, “Nangmah maw na si, nang Israel ram sungih mi hnaihnoktu bik pa!” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in, “Mi hnaihnoktu cu kei ka si lo. Nangmah na si sawn. Nangmah le na pa nan si. Bawipa ih thupekmi nan thlun duh lo ih Baal khawzing sawn nan biak."},"19":{"text":"Israel mi hmuahhmuah hnenah thu pe awla Karmel Tlang ah i ra tong hai seh. Siangpahrang bawinu Jezebel ih kilkhawi mi Baal profet zali le sawmnga le khawzingnu Asherah ih profet zali pawl khal ratpi hai aw,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Ahab in Israel mi hmuahhmuah le Baal profet hmuahhmuah cu Karmel Tlang ah a kokhawm thluh."},"21":{"text":"Elijah cu misenpi hmaiah a ding ih, “Ziangtik tiang so nan thinlung ṭhen thei loin nan um hrih ding? Bawipa cu Pathian a si ahcun bia uh; a sinan Baal cu Pathian a si nan ti ahcun bia uh,” tiah a ti. Asinain misenpi pawl cu zianghman an ṭong lo, an dai khepkhep."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in, “ Bawipa ih profet cu keimah lawng ka taang zo. Asinain Baal profet cu zali le sawmnga an um lai a si."},"23":{"text":"Cawcang pahnih rak keng uh. Cawcang pakhat cu Baal profet pawl in la hai seh; that hai sehla a sa can tahratin zanthing parah re hai seh. Sikhalsehla meisa cu muah hlah hai seh. Kei in cawcang pakhat cu vekin ka ti ve ding."},"24":{"text":"Cule Baal profet pawl cu an khawzing hnenah thla cam hai sehla kei khal ka Bawipa hnenah thla ka cam ve ding. Kan thlacamnak thei in meisa a run thla tutu cu Pathian ngaingai a si ding,” tiah a ti. Misenpi pawl cu an lungkim in an au ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Cule Elijah in Baal profet pawl hnenah, “Nannih cu mi tampi nan si ruangah hmaisa ah cawcang pakhat lak uhla timtuah uh. Nan khawzing hnenah thla cam uh. Asinain zanthing cu meisa in muah hrih hlah uh,” a ti."},"26":{"text":"A tivek in annih in an rak kenmi cawcang pakhat cu an lak ih an thah, an timtuah ih Baal hnenah cun sun tiang thla an cam. “Maw Baal, in run thei law,” tiah an au ciamco. Cule an dawlmi biakṭheng kimvel ah an laam ciamco. Asinain a run let dah lo."},"27":{"text":"Ni a sun tikah Elijah in zokzeet phah in, “Ring deuh in cam uh! Baal cu khawzing a sisi! Thudang a ruat lai tla a si ding. Asilole a eek a thawh lai a si ding. Khual tla rak tlawng sehla theih lo sokhaw! Asi lole a it that lai a si ding ih nan ṭhang tla a ṭul meen ding!” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Baal profet pawl cu ring deuhdeuh in thla an cam. Anmah ih daan a si vekin fei le nam in an sun-aw ih an thisen a suak thluahthlo."},"29":{"text":"Sun hnu tiang an au an kiau, an hruum an raak; a sinan zianghman thu a let lo. Ziang aw-aan hman a um lo. Thawmvang zianghman an thei lo."},"30":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in misenpi hnenah, “I rak naih deuh uh,” a ti ih, an zatein a kimvel ah an ra; Bawipa hrangah rak dawlmi biakṭheng a siat zomi kha a rem phah."},"31":{"text":"Jakob ih tesinfa miphun hleihnih pawl ai-ah lungto hleihnih a lak. Jakob cu Bawipa in Israel tiah hmin a sak mi pa a si."},"32":{"text":"Cuih lungto hleihnih in Bawipa biaknak ding biakṭheng a dawl. Cule biakṭheng kimvel ah tidai pung hnih tluk tlemmi khur a lai."},"33":{"text":"Biakṭheng parah cun zanthing a peng ih cawcang cu a sahtan ṭheh hnuah zanthing parah cun a ret. Elijah in, “Ralca beel pali khat in tidai than uhla sa le zanthing hi toih uh,” tiah a fial. A tivek in an tuah."},"34":{"text":"Anih in, “Toih saal uh,” a ti ih, an toih saal. “Toih saal hrih uh,” a ti ih an toih saal lala."},"35":{"text":"Biakṭheng par ihsin tidai cu a liam ih a kimvel ih a laihmi khur cu a khat ṭheh."},"36":{"text":"Sun hnu thawinak pek tikcu a si tikah profet Elijah cu biakṭheng kiangah a feh ih, “Maw Bawipa , Abraham, Isaak le Jakob ih Pathian, nangmah cu Israel ih Pathian na si tinak atu-ah run langter aw; keimah khal hi na siahhlawh ka si ih hi thil pawl hi nangmah ih thupeknak vekih ka tuahmi an si tinak khal run langter aw."},"37":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i run let hram awla cuticun hi minung pawl in Bawipa nangmah cu Pathian taktak na si ti an lo thei ding ih na hnenah na hruai kirsal ding a si,” tiah thla a cam."},"38":{"text":"Cuvete in Bawipa in meisa a run thlak ih thawinak sa le zanthing le lungto pawl cu an kang ṭheh. Leilung khal a ur caar ṭheh ih khur sungih tidai khal a kang ṭheh a si."},"39":{"text":"Cumi cu misenpi pawl in an hmuh tikah leilung ah an bok ih, “ Bawipa cu Pathian a si; Bawipa lawng Pathian a si,” tiah an au ciamco."},"40":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in, “Baal profet pawl hi kai ṭheh uh. Pakhat hman luatter hlah uh!” tiah thu a pek. Baal profet pawl cu misenpi in an kai ṭheh ih Kishon Tiva ah Elijah in a hruai ih a that ṭheh."},"41":{"text":"Elijah in Siangpahrang Ahab hnenah, “Atu va feh awla rawl va ei aw. Ruah a rat thawm ka thei,” a ti.","title":"Ruah a Sur Saal"},"42":{"text":"Ahab rawl ei dingih a feh laiah Elijah cu Karmel Tlang zim ah a hung kai ih a khuk le khuk karlak ah a lu retin leilung dai tiangin a kun."},"43":{"text":"Cule a hnen-um pa hnenah, “Feh awla tifinriat lam vun zoh hnik,” tiah a ti. A hnen-um pa cu a feh ih a rakir ih, “Zianghman ka hmu lo,” a ra ti. Elijah cun a fial saal. Voi sarih tiang va zoh dingah a fial."},"44":{"text":"A voi sarihnak ahcun, “Mero fate kuttum tia tifinriat ihsin a ra ka hmu,” a ti. Elijah in a hnen-um pa cu, “Va feh awla Siangpahrang Ahab va sim aw: A rangleng to in ruah ih a kham hlanah a inn ah tlung seh,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Rei lote ah van ah khawdur a khat ih thli a hrang ih nasa zetin ruah a sur. Ahab cu a rangleng a to ih Jezreel ih kir dingin a pok."},"46":{"text":"Bawipa ih huham cu Elijah parah a rung thleng ih a hnipuan pawl a taai ah fektein a ngerh ih Ahab ih hmai ahcun Jezreel khua kiangte tiang a tlan ciamco."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elijah ih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah, Baal profet pawl a thah ṭhehnak thu pawl cu siangpahrang Ahab in a nupi Jezebel a sim ṭheh.","title":"Sinai Tlang Ah Elijah"},"2":{"text":"Cule Jezebel in Elijah hnenah thu a cah ih, “Baal profet pawl parih na tuah vekin thaisun atu tikcu ah na parih ka tuah ve lo a si ahcun khawzing pawl in keimah i that hai seh,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah cu a thin a phang ih a tlan. A hnen-um pa thawn Judah ram Beersheba ah an feh. Cutawkah a hnen-um pa taan tahratin,"},"4":{"text":"Elijah cu hramlak ah ni khat sung a feh. Thingpi hnuai ah a cawl ih a to; thih a duh sawn. “ Bawipa , tawk thlang seh, ka zuam nawn lo. Ka nunnak hi run la aw. Ziangahtile ka pu le ka pa pawl hnakih ka ṭhat deuh cuang si lo!” tiah thla a cam."},"5":{"text":"Thingpi hnuai ahcun a zau ih a it-thatta. Rinlopi ah vancungmi pakhat in a rung tham ih, “Tho awla rawl ei aw,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cule a kiangkap a zoh tikah a lu kiangah em tharte sang zawl khat le tidai thawl khat a hmu. A ei a in ih a it sal."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi cu a ra sal ih a voihnihnak a ra tham sal ih, “Tho awla rawl ei aw; lamzinah na hartuk pang ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Elijah cu a tho ih a ei a in hnuah a tha a um sal ih, ni sawmli le zan sawmli, Pathian ih tlang, tlang thianghlim, Sinai Tlang ah a feh."},"9":{"text":"Cutawkih lungpuk sungah zanah a riak. Hmakhatte-ah Bawipa in a hnenah, “Elijah, hinah ziangso na tuah?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Elijah in, “ Bawipa , Ziangkimtithei Pathian, nangmah lawnglawng ka lo rian ih na hrangah ka ṭangzet a si. Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl in nangmah thawn an thukammi cu an balsiat zo; na biakṭheng pawl an bal ih na profet pawl an that ṭheh. Keimah lawnglawng ka taang ih atu ah keimah hman cu a thah in tum a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Va suak awla tlang parah khin ka mithmuh ah va ding aw,” tiah a ti. Cule Bawipa cu a kiangte in a lan ih, thlisia a hranter ih tlang tla a hnin ṭheh ih lungto pawl tla an kuai ṭheh. Asinain Bawipa cu thli sungah a um lo. Thli a reh hnuah ling a hnin ciamco; asinain Bawipa cu linghnin sungah a um lo."},"12":{"text":"Linghnin a reh hnuah meisa a kaang ciamco; asinain Bawipa cu meisa sungah a um lo. Cule meisa hnuah aw dimte pakhat a ra."},"13":{"text":"Cumi cu Elijah in a theih tikah a puan in a hmai a hup ih lungpuk sung ihsin a va suak ih a kaa kiangah a va ding. Cule aw in, “Elijah, hinah ziangso na tuah?” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Elijah in, “ Bawipa , Ziangkimtithei Pathian, nangmah lawnglawng ka lo rian ih na hrangah ka ṭangzet a si. Sikhalsehla Israel mi pawl in nangmah thawn an thukammi cu an balsiat zo; na biakṭheng pawl an bal ih na profet pawl an that ṭheh. Keimah lawnglawng ka taang ih atu-ah keimah hman cu a thah in tum a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Kir awla Damaskas khua kiangih thlaler ramṭhing in va feh aw. Khawpi sung na thlen tikah Hazael cu Siria siangpahrang ah hriak culh awla,"},"16":{"text":"Nimshi fapa Jehu cu Israel siangpahrang ah hriak culh aw. Nangmah a lo ai-awhtu dingah Abel Meholah khawmi Shafat fapa Elisha cu hriak culh aw."},"17":{"text":"Hazael in ralnam thawn a that hai ding ih a thah ngah lomi pawl cu Jehu in a that ding; cule Jehu ih a thah ngah lomi pawl cu Elisha in a that ding."},"18":{"text":"Asinain Israel ram sungah minung thawng sarih ka zuah ding - keimah i rinsantu, Baal khawzing hnenih lu a kun hrih lotu le a Baal lemzuk a hnam hrih lotu pawl an si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Elijah cu a va feh ih Shafat ih fapa Elisha kha cawcang pawl thawn lei a let rero a va hmu. Lei lettu cawcang pawl cu an zatein haal hleikhat an si ih Elisha cu a neta bik haal thawn a ṭuan. Elijah in a puan a hlit ih Elisha parah a vun sin.","title":"Elisha Kawhnak"},"20":{"text":"Cule Elisha in a cawcang haal cu a taan ih Elijah cu a hei dawi ih a hnenah, “Ka nu le ka pa cibaibuk in ka va hnamta ding ih cuih hnuah ka lo thlun ding,” tiah a ti. Elijah in, “A ṭha, va feh aw; ka lo kham lo,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Elisha cu a cawcang haal khat umnak ah a va feh ih a that hai ih, cawsa cu a suang; caw hngawngkol cu a suannak zanthing ah a hmang. A suanmi cawsa cu misenpi a pek ih an ei. Cule Elijah cu a thlun ih a bawmtu ah a cang."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siria Siangpahrang Benhadad in a ralkap hmuahhmuah a khawm ṭheh ih, amah ih ralkap pawl ih tlunah ramdang uktu bawi sawmthum le pahnih in an bawm ih an rang le an raldonak rangleng pawl thawn Benhadad ho in an feh. Samaria khawpi an kulh ih an do ciamco.","title":"Siria Thawn An Do Aw"},"2":{"text":"Khua sungah palai a vun thlah ih Israel Siangpahrang Ahab hnenah, “Siangpahrang Benhadad in,"},"3":{"text":"na sui le na ngun pawl, na nupi mawi bik pawl le na faate lakih a cak bik pawl i hun peseh, a lo ti,” tiah an vung sim."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Ahab in, “Ka bawipa Benhadad cu va sim uh: I dil vekin ka lung a kim a si. Keimah le ka neihmi hmuahhmuah khal a duh ahcun a ta kan si thei ko,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Benhada ih palai pawl cu Ahab hnenah an ra sal ih, “Na sui le na ngun, na nupi pawl le na faate pawl, i pe ding, tiah ka lo cah."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu-ah ka kuthnuai ih bawi pawl ka run thlah pei ih, na umnak inn le na kuthnuai bawi pawl ih inn an rung hawl ṭheh ding; man nei thil an hmuhmi pohpoh an la ding. Thaisun atu tikcu ah an ra thleng ding, a lo ti,” tiah an sim."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahab in a ram sungih hotu pawl hmuahhmuah a kokhawm ih an hnenah, “Hi pa hi in siatsuah duh ruangah thusia lawnglawng a hawl a si. Ka nupi pawl, ka faate pawl, ka sui le ka ngun pawl i dil ih pek ding cu ka el lo,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Hotu pawl le misenpi pawl in, “A thu cu zianghman ah siar duh hlah aw. A lo dilmi zianghman pe hlah,” an ti."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Ahab in Benhadad ih palai pawl hnenah, “Nan siangpahrang ka bawipa cu hung sim uh: ‘A hmaisaih i dilmi cu pe dingah ka lung a kim ko. Asinain a neta ih i dilmi cu ka lung a kim thei lo a si’ va ti uh,” tiah a ti. Cule Benhadad ih palai pawl cu an tlung;"},"10":{"text":"a sinan Benhadad in palai a run thlah kir sal ih hiti in thu a run cah sal: “Na khawpi an siat thluh hnu ih a leivut le a hnawmhne hman an kutih thiar thluh theitu ralkap siar cawk lo ka runpi ding. Ka tivek ih ka tuah lo a si ahcun khawzing pawl in keimah i that hai seh,” a run ti."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahab in thu a khirh ih, “Siangpahrang Benhadad cu hung sim uh: Ralkap ṭha taktak cun ral a do ṭheh hlan ah tluang a khawng dah lo; ral a neh hnu lawngah tluang a khawng a si,” tiah a rak ti."},"12":{"text":"Ahab ih thucahmi cu Benhadad le a ṭantu bawi pawl an riahhmun ih zu an in laiah a va thleng. Hmakhatte-ah Samaria do dingin Benhadad in thu a pek ih a ralkap pawl cu an ṭannak hmun ciarah tiar cia in an um."},"13":{"text":"Culaifang ah Israel siangpahrang Ahab hnenah cun profet pakhat a feh ih, “ Bawipa in, ‘Hi ralkap pawl hi an tam ruangah ṭih hlah uh. An tlunah nehnak ka lo pe ding ih Keimah cu Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"14":{"text":"Ahab in, “Ka do tikah zo in so a ho ding?” tiah a sut. Profet in, “Ramṭhen uktu bawi pawl hnuai ih ralkap mino pawl in ho hai seh, tiah Bawipa in a ti,” tiah a sim. “Hmaisa bikih a nortu pawl cu zo in so a ho ding?” tiah Ahab in a sut sal. Profet in, “Nangmah in na ho ding,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang in ramṭhen uktu bawi pawl hnuai ih ralkap mino pawl cu a ko ṭheh ih an zatein zahnih le sawmthum le pahnih an si. Cule Israel ralkap pawl a kokhawm ih an zatein thawng sarih an si."},"16":{"text":"An ral pawl cu sun laifangah an do; Benhadad le a ṭantu bawi sawmthum le pahnih pawl cu an riah hmunah zu an rak ri."},"17":{"text":"Ralkap mino pawl in hmai bik ah an nor. Benhadad ih thlahmi thlingthlatu pawl in, “Samaria ihsin ralkap bur khat an ra suak,” tiah an sim."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Benhadad in, “Raldo dingih an rat khal asile, remnak tuah dingih an rat khal asile, a nung in kai hai uh,” tiah thu a pek."},"19":{"text":"Ralkap mino pawl cun an do hmaisa ih an dungin Israel ralkap burpi pawl in an thlun."},"20":{"text":"An domi an hmaiih an tonmi ral cu pakhat fingfing an that. Cutikah Siria ralkap pawl cu an tlan ih Israel ralkap pawl in an dawi vivo; amah Benhadad khal rang ralkap pawl in an kil ih rang to in a tlan suak."},"21":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahab ho in rang tampi le rangleng tampi an lak ih Siria ralkap pawl cu nasa zetin an siatsuah."},"22":{"text":"Cule profet cu siangpahrang Ahab hnenah a feh ih, “Kir awla na ralkap pawl cu tam deuh le ṭha deuh in timtuah aw. Ziang hmuahhmuah ralring zetin tawlrel aw, ziangahtile hmaikum ṭhal ah Siria siangpahrang in a lo do sal ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Siangpahrang Benhadad cu a kuthnuai bawi pawl in, “Israel khawzing pawl cu tlangpar khawzing an si. Curuangah in neh. Sikhalsehla phairawn ih kan do hai a si ahcun kan neh tengteng ding.","title":"Siria Pawl In An Do Sal"},"24":{"text":"Tuih ṭumih in bawmtu bawi sawmthum le pahnih pawl hi ralkap an honak in hlon awla anmah ih ai ah raldo ṭhangtu ralbawi ret thluh aw."},"25":{"text":"Cule a lo tlansantu ralkap zat in ralkap a thar in la awla, rang le rangleng pawl khal a thar in la aw. Israel ralkap pawl cu phairawn ah kan do ding ih tuih ṭum cu kan neh tengteng ding,” tiah an ti. Siangpahrang Benhadad a lung a kim ih an ruahnak cu a thlun."},"26":{"text":"Ṭhal a hung suah tikah a ralkap pawl a kokhawm ih Israel do dingah Afek khua ah an feh."},"27":{"text":"Israel ralkap pawl khal an kokhawm aw ve ih ralthuam ih thuam aw aw in an feh ih Siria ralkap pawl ih riahhmun ralden hmun hnih ah an va riak. Thingkung le hrampi zat a si mi Siria ralkap pawl lakah cun Israel ralkap pawl cu a malzet mi merual rual hnih an bang."},"28":{"text":"Profet cu siangpahrang Ahab hnenah a feh sal ih, “ Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu hiti in a si: Keimah hi tlangpar khawzing a si ih phairawn khawzing a si lo, tiah Siria pawl in in ti. Curuangah ralkap hizat parah hin nehnak ka lo pe ding ih nanmah le nan misenpi pawl in keimah cu Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding, a ti a si,” tiah a sim."},"29":{"text":"Siria ralkap pawl le Israel ralkap pawl cu an riahhmun fingfing ih ralden in ni sarih sung tiar cia ṭhepṭhep in an um. A ni sarih ni ah an do aw ciammam ih Israel ralkap in Siria ralkap ni khatah thawng zakhat an that."},"30":{"text":"A luatmi pawl cu Afek khua ah an tlan. Cun cutiih an tlan laiah Afek khua kulhnak ralhruang a cim ih Siria ralkap thawng kul hluansarih a tlak that a si. Benhadad khal khawpi sungah cun a lut ve ih inn pakhat ih dunglam khaan sungah a relh."},"31":{"text":"A kuthnuai bawi pawl a hnen ah an feh ih, “Israel siangpahrang cu mi zaangfah thiam an si ti kan thei. Atu-ah na lung a kim asile Israel siangpahrang hnenah kan taai ih buri puan ṭeem in le kan lu ih hridai ṭeem in kan va feh hnik pei. Na nunnak tla a lo zuah thei men a si,” tiah an ti."},"32":{"text":"Curuangah an taai ah buri puan an ṭeem ih an lu ah hridai an ṭeem ih Ahab hnenah cun an feh. “Na siahhlawh Benhadad in a nunnak zuah dingah a lo dil a si,” tiah siangpahrang Ahab an va ti. Cutikah Ahab in, “A nunglai mawsi? A ṭha! Ka unau vekih ka ruah mi si maw a si,” a rak ti."},"33":{"text":"Benhadad kuthnuai ih bawi pawl cun Ahab in ziangtin a ti pei tiih thinhar zetih an um laiah Ahab in, “Ka unau vek,” a hun ti cun hmakhatte-ah an thok ve ih, “Na tivek in Benhadad cu na unau a si ngai,” tiah an ti. Cutikah Ahab in, “Ka hnenah rak hruai uh,” tiah thu a pek. Benhadad a ra thlen tikah amah ih hnenah rangleng parah a toter."},"34":{"text":"Cule Benhadad in, “Na pa hnen ihsin ka pa ih a rak lonmi khua pawl cu na hnenah ka lo khirhsal ding. Ka pa in Samaria khawsungih dawrpi a rak tuah vekin nang khal Damaskas khawpi sungah dawrpi tuah ve aw,” tiah a ti. Cule Ahab in, “Cuti a si ding taak ahcun ka lo thlah ding,” a ti ih, lungkimnak cakhen an tuah hnuah Benhadad cu a thlah."},"35":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupeknak in a buur ih a ummi profet lakah pakhat in a rualpi profet pakhat cu, “I thawi aw,” tiah a ti. Asinain cupa cun a el."},"36":{"text":"Curuangah a hnenah, “ Bawipa ih thupek mi na el ruangah na feh vete in kiosa in a lo deh ding a si,” tiah a ti. A feh ih a feh vete in kiosa in a thlun ih a deh ngaingai."},"37":{"text":"Cule cuih profet cu midang pakhat hnenah a feh ih, “I thawi aw,” a ti. A ti vekin a thawi ih a tuahmawh.","title":"Profet In Ahab A Mawhthluk"},"38":{"text":"Cuih profet in a hmai cu puan in a tuam ih midang vekah a tuah aw ih lamzin kiangah a ding. Israel siangpahrang cuih lamzin in ra lan ding a hngak."},"39":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang cu a ra lan ngaingai ih profet cun, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, ral kan do laiah khan ral kaihmi pakhat ka hnenah ralkap pakhat in a hun hruai ih, ‘Hi pa hi kil ṭha aw. Na tlanter a si ahcun na nunnak in na kuan ding. Asilole tangka thawngthum na kuan ding,’ i ti."},"40":{"text":"Ka kil ṭha ko naón, thil dangdang tuah phahnak ah ka buaituk ih cupa cu ka tlanter pang,” tiah ringzet in a hun ti. Siangpahrang in, “Na thu cu nangmahte na relcat zo a si cu! Na sualman cu na kuan ding,” a ti."},"41":{"text":"Cutikah profet in a hmai tuamnak puan cu a phoih ih siangpahrang in profet a si ti kha hmakhatte ah a thei."},"42":{"text":"Cule profet in siangpahrang hnenah, “ Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu hiti in a si: ‘Thah ding ka timi na thlah ruangah na nunnak in na kuan ding ih a ralkap pawl na luatter ruangah nangmah ih ralkap pawl an cem ding,’ a ti a si,” tiah a sim."},"43":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang cu thinlung baangzet le riahsia zetin Samaria ah a kir."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jezreel khua siangpahrang Ahab inn kiangah sabit hmuan pakhat a um ih a neitu cu Naboth a si.","title":"Naboth Ih sabit Hmuan"},"2":{"text":"Voikhat ah Ahab in Naboth hnenah, “Na sabit hmuan hi kei ka co pei. Ka inn kiangah a um ih hanghnah hangrah cinnak hmuanah ka duh. A ai ah a ṭha deuhmi sabit hmuan a dang pakhat ka lo pe ding. Asilole na duh sawn a si ahcun a man a mawitawk in ka lo pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Naboth in, “Hi sabit hmuan cu ka pipu pawl ih ro a si. Nang ka lo pek ding cu Bawipa in i kham hram seh,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Ahab cu Naboth ih a rak el ruangah a hmai siazet le thinheng in a inn ah a tin. A ihkhun ah phar lam hoi in a it ringring ih rawl khal a ei duh lo."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah a nupi Jezebel cu a hnenah a feh ih, “Ziangah so na riah a siat? Ziangah so rawl na ei lo?” tiah a sut."},"6":{"text":"Ahab in, “Naboth ih ṭong ruangah a si. A sabit hmuan lei ka tum ih a lei na sian lo le a ai ah sabit hmuan a dang pakhat ka lo pe ding ka ti naón, a siang thotho lo. Na co thei lo ding, tiah i ti,” tiah a let."},"7":{"text":"Cule a nupi Jezebel in, “Israel ram siangpahrang na si lo sawm? Tho! It nawn hlah. Thinnuam in um awla, rawl tla ei aw. Naboth ih sabit hmuan cu keimah in ka lo ngah sak ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Jezebel cun Ahab ih hmin in ca a ngan ih siangpahrang hmin a ṭhutter ih Jezreel khawpi sungih bawi pawl le hotu pawl hnenah a kuat."},"9":{"text":"A ca sungah cun, “Rawl ulh ni tuah uhla misenpi kokhawm uh. Naboth kha cutawkah upatnak hmunah toter uh."},"10":{"text":"Cule misualral pahnih ko uhla, ‘Naboth hi Pathian le siangpahrang a camtu a si,’ tiah sualpuh hai seh. Cuih hnuah Naboth cu hnarpawn ah fehpi uhla lungto in deengthat uh,” tiah a ngan."},"11":{"text":"Jezebel ih thupek vekin khawsung bawi pawl le hotu pawl in an tuah."},"12":{"text":"Rawl ulh ni an tuah ih misenpi pawl an kokhawm ih Naboth cu upatnak hmunah an toter."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah misualral pahnih cun senpi hmaiah, “Hi pa hi Pathian le siangpahrang a camtu a si,” tiah sual an puh ciamco. Cu thluh cun Naboth cu hnarpawn ah an hruai ih lungto in an den that."},"14":{"text":"Cule Jezebel hnenah, “Naboth cu a thi zo,” tiah thu an hei than."},"15":{"text":"Cuih thu a theih vete in Jezebel in Ahab hnenah, “Naboth cu a thi zo. Va feh awla a lo zorh duh lomi a sabit hmuan cu na ta a si thei zo,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Ahab cu hmakhatte-ah a tho ih sabit hmuan ham dingah a feh."},"17":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Tishbe khua profet Elijah hnenah,"},"18":{"text":"“Samaria Siangpahrang Ahab hnenah feh aw. Naboth ih sabit hmuan la dingah a feh ih hmuan sungah na tong ding."},"19":{"text":"A hnenah, ‘Amah Naboth na thah hnuah a leiram khal na lak hrih ding maw? Uico pawl in Naboth ih thisen an liahnak hmunah na thisen an liak ve ding,’ tiah Bawipa in a ti va ti aw,” tiah a fial."},"20":{"text":"Ahab in Elijah a hmuh tikah, “Aize, i hmu suak maw si, ka ralpa!” tiah a rak ti. Cutikah Elijah in, “Asi, ka lo hmu a sihi! Bawipa ih mithmuh ah thilsual lawnglawng na tuah a si."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in na hnenah, ‘Na parah vanduainak ka thlengter ding ih na nunnak ka cemter ding. Na innsang ih mipa hmuahhmuah, nauhak tilo, upa tilo, ka hloralter thluh ding."},"22":{"text":"Israel mi pawl sualnak sungah na luhpi ih ka thinhengnak cu meisa vekih na alhter ruangah na innsang pawl cu Nebat fapa siangpahrang Jeroboam le Ahijah fapa siangpahrang Baasha ih innsang pawl an bang ding,’ a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, ‘Jezebel ih ruak cu Jezreel khawpi sungah uico in an ei ding,’ a ti."},"24":{"text":"Khawsungih a thimi na sungkhat pawl ih ruak cu uico in an ei dingih hramlak ih a thimi pawl cu langta in an ei ding,’ a ti a si,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa ih mithmuh ah Ahab vekih thilsual lawnglawng a tuahtu zohman an um lo. A zatein a nupi Jezebel ih forhfialnak lawnglawng in a tuah."},"26":{"text":"A thilsual tuahmi lakah fihnungza bik cu Israel mi pawl Kanaan ram an luh tikah Bawipa in a rak dawimi Amor mi pawl vekin milem a biaknak kha a si."},"27":{"text":"Elijah in thu a sim ṭheh tikah, Ahab cu a hnipuan a thlek ṭheh ih buri hnipuan a hruk ih rawl khal ei loin a um. Buri puan sin in a it ih riahsia zet le mithmai sia ṭeemṭeem in a um."},"28":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in profet Elijah hnenah,"},"29":{"text":"“Ka hmaiah Ahab a thinlung niam in tangdor ih a umzia hi na hmu maw? Hitiih a um ruangah a nunsung ahcun hloh-ral vanduainak ka thlenter lo ding. A fapa sanah Ahab ih sungkhat parah ka thlenter ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel le Siria karlakah kum hnih sung ral a dai.","title":"Profet Mikaiah In Ahab Ralrinnak A Pek (2 San. 18.2-27)"},"2":{"text":"Asinain a kum thumnak ah Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu Israel siangpahrang Ahab tong dingah a feh."},"3":{"text":"Cule Ahab in a kuthnuai bawi pawl hnenah, “Ziangah so Gilead ramih Ramoth khua cu Siria siangpahrang kutsung ihsin a lak kan tum lo? Kanmah ih ta a sisi!” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat hnenah, “Ramoth ka do ding ih i bawm pei maw?” tiah a sut. Jehoshafat in, “Ka lo bawm ding. Ka ralkap pawl le ka rang ralkap pawl khal an tiar aw ko."},"5":{"text":"Asinain hmaisabik ah Bawipa kan ron hnik pei,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Ahab in profet pawl a ko ih an zatein zali an ra. An hnenah, “Ramoth ka do pei maw?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Do aw. Bawipa in nehnak a lo pe ding,” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Asinain Jehoshafat in, “ Bawipa kan ron theinak dingah profet dang an um nawn lo maw?” tiah a sut."},"8":{"text":"Ahab in, “A dang pakhat a um hrih. Amah cu Imlah fapa Mikaiah a si. Asinain anih cu ka hua. Ziangahtile ka hrangah thu ṭha a ṭong dah lo. Thusia lawnglawng a sim ṭheu,” a ti. Jehoshafat in, “Cuticun ṭong hlah aw,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang Ahab in zamrangte ih Mikaiah va ko dingah a zungih bawi pakhat a fial."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang pahnih, Ahab le Jehoshafat cu an siangpahrang thuam hruk in Samaria khawpi kulhnak hauhruang kotka lengih fang rialnak hmunah siangpahrang tokham parah an to ih, an hmaiah cun profet pawl cu profet ṭong in an ṭong rero."},"11":{"text":"Anmah lakih profet pakhat, Khenaanah ih fapa Zedekiah in thir ki a tuah ih Ahab hnenah, “ Bawipa in, ‘Hi ki hin Siria pawl nan do ding ih an ci nan hmit thluh ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"12":{"text":"Profet dang pawl khal in cuvek thotho in an sim ṭheh. “Ramoth khua do uhla nan neh ding, Bawipa in nehnak a lo pe ding,” tiah an ti cio."},"13":{"text":"A culaiah Mikaiah ko dingih thlahmi bawi in Mikaiah cu, “Profet dang pawl in kan siangpahrang ih neh ding thu lawng an sim a si. Nang khal cutiin sim ve aw,” tiah a forh."},"14":{"text":"Asinain Mikaiah in, “ Bawipa ih hminin ka sim: Bawipa ih sim ding i fialmi lawng ka sim ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Mikaiah cu siangpahrang hmai ih a thlen tikah siangpahrang bawipa in, “Mikaiah, siangpahrang Jehoshafat le keimah in Ramoth khua kan do pei maw, do lo so, sim hnik?” tiah a ti. Mikaiah in, “Do aw he! Na neh ding. Bawipa in nehnak a lo pe ding,” tiah a sawn."},"16":{"text":"Asinain Ahab in, “ Bawipa hmin saal in ka hnenih thu na sim tikah thudik lawnglawng i sim aw, tiah voi ziangzat so ka lo ti ding?” tiah a kawk."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Mikaiah in, “Israel mi pawl cu khaaltu nei lo tuurual bangin tlang parah vakvai in an um ṭheh ka hmu. Bawipa in, ‘Hi misenpi pawl hi hotu an nei lo; an inn ah tlung thluh hai seh,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"18":{"text":"Cule Ahab in Jehoshafat hnenah, “Hi pa cu ka hrangah thuṭha a ṭong dah lo, ka lo ti tho lo maw? Thusia lawnglawng a sim ṭheu a si,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Mikaiah in a hun peh ih, “Atu Bawipa ih ṭongkam rak ngai aw! Bawipa cu vancung a Siangpahrang tokham parah to in a vancungmi pawl a kiang vorhlam le kehlam ah an din kha ka hmu."},"20":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, ‘Ahab cu Ramoth khua ah feh in thihnak a tonnak dingah zoso a vung bum ding?’ a ti. Vancungmi hrekkhat in thu pakhat an sim; a dang in thudang an sim."},"21":{"text":"Netabik ah thlarau pakhat in Bawipa cu a hei naih ih a hnenah, ‘Keimah ka vung bum pei,’ a ti. ‘Ziangtin so na bum ding?’ ti ih Bawipa ih a sut tikah,"},"22":{"text":"anih in, ‘Ka vung feh pei ih Ahab ih profet hmuahhmuah thuphan ka perter ṭheh ding,’ a ti. Cutikah Bawipa in, ‘Vung feh awla vung bum aw. Na ti thei ngaingai ding,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Mikaiah in a hun peh bet ih, “A tivek in a si ngaingai hi! Bawipa in na profet pawl na hnenah thuphan a perter ṭheh a si. Bawipa amah rori in na parah siatsuahnak thleng dingin lai a rel zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Zedekiah in Mikaiah cu a hun naih ih a hnakhang ah a beng ih, “Ziangtin so Bawipa ih thlarau cu na hnen ṭong dingah ka hnen ihsin a ra ceer?” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Mikaiah in, “Inn dunglam khaan sungih na relh rero tikah cuih thu cu na thei leh ding,” a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Ahab in a kuthnuai bawi pakhat hnenah, “Mikaiah hi kai awla khawpi uktu Amon le ka fapa Joash hnenah hei hruai aw."},"27":{"text":"Va sim awla himdamte ih ka rakir sal hlanlo thawngah rak thla hai sehla sang le tidai rak pe hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Mikaiah in, “Himdamteih na rakir a si ahcun keimah hmangin Bawipa a ṭong lo a si ding. Mi hmuahhmuah in ka ṭong mi hi i theihpi uh,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Ahab le Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu Gilead ram Ramoth khua do dingah an suak.","title":"Ahab A Thi (2 San. 18.28-34)"},"30":{"text":"Ahab in Jehoshafat hnenah, “Ral kan do tikah kei cu midang vekah ka tuah aw ding ih nang cu siangpahrang vekin na thuam-aw pei,” a ti. Cuticun Israel siangpahrang cu midang vekih tuah-aw in raldonak ahcun a feh."},"31":{"text":"Siria siangpahrang in Israel siangpahrang siar lo a dang zohman do lo dingin a rangleng ralkap hotu sawmthum le pahnih pawl cu thu a pek."},"32":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Jehoshafat an hmuh tikah Israel siangpahrang a si hmang tiah an ruat ih an do ciamco. Asinain Jehoshafat a au tikah,"},"33":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang a si lo ti an thei ih an cawl."},"34":{"text":"Siria ralkap pakhat in batmi nei cuang leem loin a conkiang a hei sai meen ih a vanduainak ah siangpahrang Ahab cu daar ih tuahmi a ralthuam ih peh awknak ongte in a hei ngah. Cutikah Ahab cu, “In hriam ee!” tiah a au ih, a rangleng mawngtupa cu, “Zamrang in i tlanpi aw,” tiah thu a pek."},"35":{"text":"An do awknak a nasa ngaingai ih siangpahrang Ahab cu a rangleng parah do cop in Siria ralkap pawl ṭannak lam hoi in a um. An hriamnak hma ihsin a thi a luang ih a rangleng zial cu a thisen in a khat ṭheh. Cule zanlam ah a thi."},"36":{"text":"Ni a liam zawng ah Israel ralkap pawl hnenah, “Nan khua le nan ram ciarah tlung thluh uh,” tiah thu an than."},"37":{"text":"Cuticun siangpahrang Ahab cu a thi. A ruak cu Samaria khua ah an phur ih an phum."},"38":{"text":"A rangleng cu Samaria tili ah an tleuhfai ih Bawipa ih a rak sim cia vekin a thisen cu uico in an liak. Cutawk cu hlawhhlang pawl tla ti an bual ṭheunak a si."},"39":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahab ih tuahmi dang hmuahhmuah, vuiho ih ceimawimi a siangpahrang inn thu le khua a dinmi pawl ih thu cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah kimten an ngan a si."},"40":{"text":"A thih tikah a fapa Ahaziah in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"41":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Ahab in ram a uknak kum li kum ah Asa ih fapa Jehoshafat cu Judah siangpahrang a cang.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jehoshafat (2 San. 20.31—21.1)"},"42":{"text":"Culai ah amah cu kum sawmthum le kum nga a si ih, Jerusalem ihsin kum kul hluannga sung ram a uk. A nu cu Shilhi ih fanu Azubah a si."},"43":{"text":"A pa Asa vekin Bawipa ih mithmuh ah thil ṭha a tuah. Asinain khawvel pawl ih milem biaknak hmun pawl cu a siatbal lo; curuangah mi tampi in cuih biaknak hmun pawl cu raithawinak ah an hmang thotho."},"44":{"text":"Jehoshafat in Israel siangpahrang thawn remnak a tuah."},"45":{"text":"Jehoshafat ih tuahmi dang hmuahhmuah, a raldonak le a ralṭhatnak pawl thawn, Judah Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan."},"46":{"text":"A pa Asa san ihsin a tanglaimi, an khawzing biaknak ih hlawhhlang hna a ṭuantu pawl hmuahhmuah, nunau siseh mipa siseh, a that ṭheh hai a si."},"47":{"text":"Culai ah Edom ram cu uktu siangpahrang a nei lo. An ram uktu cu siangpahrang bawmtu lawng an si ih Judah siangpahrang ih hnaṭuan pekmi an si."},"48":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jehoshafat in Ofir ram ihsin sui leinak dingah tipi thuanthum feh thei tangphawlawng tampi a tuah. Asinain Ofir ah an feh thei lo, ziangahtile Ezion-geber ah an lawng pawl a siat."},"49":{"text":"Cule Israel siangpahrang Ahaziah in a milai tipi thuanthum khual tlawng pawl le Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat ih milai tipi thuanthum khual tlawng pawl khual tlawng tlang dingah a sawm. Asinain Jehoshafat in a el."},"50":{"text":"Jehoshafat cu a thi ih David khawpi siangpahrang pawl phumnak hmun ah an phum. Cule a fapa Jehoram in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"51":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat in an ram a uknak kum hleisarih kumah Ahab ih fapa Ahaziah cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria khawpi ihsin kum hnih sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Ahaziah"},"52":{"text":"A pa Ahab, a nu Jezebel le siangpahrang Jeroboam ih sualnak lamzin a thlun ih Bawipa ih parah a sual ve. Siangpahrang in, “Ziangah nan kir?” tiah a rak sut."},"6":{"text":"Annih in, “Mi pakhat kan tong ih a lo thlahtu siangpahrang hnenah va kir uhla a hnenah Bawipa in, ‘Zianghrangah Ekron ih Baalzebub khawzing tong dingin mi na thlah? Israel ramah Pathian a um lo maw si? Na nung lo ding na tuahmawh awknak in na thi ding,’ tiah va sim uh, in ti ruangah kan kir a si,” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in, “Nan tonmi pa cu ziangvek milai so a si?” tiah a sut."},"8":{"text":"Annih in, “Savun ih tuahmi korfualpi a hruk ih savun taikhap a khap a si,” an ti. Cutikah siangpahrang in, ‘Elijah a si cu!” tiah a hun ti."},"9":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in Elijah hruai dingah ralbawi pakhat le ralkap sawmnga a thlah. Elijah cu tlang parih a to laiah ralbawipa in a va hmu ih a hnenah, “Pathian ih milaipa, siangpahrang in rung seh a lo ti,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in, “Pathian ih milai ka si ahcun van ihsin meisa rung tla sehla nangmah le na milai pawl lo kaang thluhseh!” tiah a ti. A ti vete in van ihsin meisa a rung tla ih ralbawipa le a ralkap pawl cu an kaangthat thluh."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang in a dang ralbawi pakhat le ralkap sawmnga a thlah sal ih Elijah hnenah an va feh. Ralbawipa in, “Pathian ih milaipa, siangpahrang in zamrangte in rungseh a lo ti,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in, “Pathian ih milai ka si ahcun van ihsin meisa rung tla sehla nangmah le na ralkap pawl lo kaang thluhseh!” a ti. A ti vete in van ihsin Pathian ih meisa a rung tla ih ralbawipa le a ralkap pawl cu an kangthat thluh."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang in a dang ralbawi pakhat le ralkap sawmnga a thlah lala. Ralbawipa cu Elijah hnenah a hung feh ih Elijah hmaiah a khuk a bil ih, “Maw Pathian ih milaipa, keimah le ka milai pawl parah hin zaangfahnak nei hram awla kan nunnak cu in zuah hraam aw."},"14":{"text":"Ka hlanih ralbawi pahnih le an ralkap pawl cu vanih meisa in a kaangthat thluh. Asinain kei cu i zaangfah hram aw,” tiah a dil."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa ih vancungmi in Elijah hnenah, “Amah thawn vung feh aw. Zianghman ṭih duh hlah,” tiah a ti. Curuangah Elijah cu ralbawipa thawn siangpahrang hnenah an feh ih,"},"16":{"text":"a hnenah, “ Bawipa in ‘Israel ramih Pathian um lo bangin Ekron khua Baalzebub khawzing hnenih mi na thlah ruangah tuih na ihnak ihkhun khan na tho nawn lo ding. Na thi ding a si,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"17":{"text":"Elijah hnen ih Bawipa ih ṭongkam vekin Ahaziah cu a thi. Ahaziah cu fapa a neih lo ruangah a unau Joram in, Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat ih fapa Jehoram ih siangpahrang a ṭuan kum hnihnak ah, Israel siangpahrang a ṭuan."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahaziah ih hnaṭuanmi hmuahhmuah cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah ngan ṭheh a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Elijah cu phusiing in vancung ih a lak tikcu a thleng. Kei cu Bawipa in Bethel feh dingah i fial a si,” a ti. Asinain Elisha in, “ Bawipa ih hmin saal in le nangmah ih nunnak thawn thu ka kam aw: Ka lo kirsan hrimhrim lo ding,” a ti. Curuangah an pahnih in Bethel ahcun an feh."},"3":{"text":"Cutawkih a ummi profet pawl cu Elisha hnenah an ra ih, “ Bawipa in na bawipa hi tuihsun ah na hnen ihsin a lak ding, tihi na thei maw?” tiah an sut.
