Kei cu Bawipa in Jerikho feh dingah i fial a si,” a ti. Sikhalsehla Elisha in, “ Bawipa ih hmin saal in le na nunnak thawn thu ka kam aw: Ka lo kirsan hrimhrim lo ding,” a ti. Curuangah Jerikho ah an feh tlaang."},"5":{"text":"Cutawkih a ummi profet pawl cu Elisha hnenah an ra ih, “ Bawipa in na bawipa hi tuihsun ah na hnen ihsin a lak ding, tihi na thei maw?” tiah an sut. Elisha in, ‘Asi, ka thei. Asinain cuih thu cu rel hlah uhsi,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cule Elijah in Elisha hnenah, “Nang hitawk ah rak um aw. Kei cu Bawipa in Jordan Tiva ih vung feh dingin i fial a si,” a ti. Asinain Elisha in, “ Bawipai ” hmin saal in le na nunnak thawn thu ka kam aw: Ka lo kirsan hrimhrim lo ding,” a ti. Curuangah an pahnih in an feh ih,"},"7":{"text":"profet sawmnga in Jordan Tiva tiang an vun thlun. Elijah le Elisha cu Jordan Tiva kap ahcun an ding ih profet sawmnga pawl cu a hlat nawnah an ding."},"8":{"text":"Cule Elijah in a korfualpi cu a hlit ih a zual hnuah cumi cun tidai cu a vuak; hmakhatte ah tidai cu a ṭhen-aw ih Elijah le Elisha cu leihul par in khatlam ral ah an feh."},"9":{"text":"Cutawkah Elijah in Elisha hnenah, “Kei cu na hnen ihsin lak hlo ka si thlang ding. Cutiih lak hlo ka si hlanah ziangso i tuahsak seh ti na duh?” tiah a sut. “Nangmah ai-awhtu ka sinak dingah ka covo dingih let hnih in na huham i pe aw,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Elijah in, “I dilmi cu lo pek dingah a harzet a si. Asinain na hnen ihsin keimah lak hlo ka si lai i hmu na si ahcun i dilmi cu na ngah ding; i hmulo a si ahcun na ngah lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Thu rel phah in an feh ih rinlopi ah an karlakah meisa rang pawl ih hnukmi meisa rangleng a rung thleng ih Elijah cu phusiing in van ah a zuanpi."},"12":{"text":"Cumi cu Elisha in a hmu ih, “Ka pa, Ka pa! Rangleeng le rang ralkap bangin Israel hum theitu!” tiah a au. Cuih hnu cun Elijah cu a hmu nawn lo. A riahsia in Elisha in a hnipuan ṭhen hnih ah a thlek."},"13":{"text":"A hlitta mi Elijah ih korfualpi cu Elisha in a sar hnuah a kir ih Jordan Tiva kapah a ding."},"14":{"text":"Elijah ih korfualpi cun tidai cu a vuak ih, “Khuitawkah so Bawipa , Elijah ih Pathian cu a um?” tiah a ti. Tidai a vuak tikah a ṭhen-aw ih Elisha cu khatlam ralah a hei tansuak."},"15":{"text":"Jerikho ih ummi profet sawmnga in amah cu an hmuh tikah, “Elijah ih huham cu Elisha parah a um a si,” tiah an ti. An va hmuak ih a hmaiah an kun ih,"},"16":{"text":"“Micak hlir minung sawmnga hinah kan um a si. Kan feh pei ih na bawipa kan hawl pei. Bawipa ih thlarau in a cawi ih tlang parah maw, horkuam ah maw, hmunkhat khatah a taanta a si ding,” tiah an ti. Cutikah Elisha in, “Asilo, nan feh lo pei,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an ngen tuk ruangah a fehter hai. Minung sawmnga cu an feh ih a suk le a so ramkipah ni thum sung an hawl. Asinain Elijah cu an hmu lo."},"18":{"text":"Elisha in Jerikho khua in a rak hngak ih a hnenih an ra kir tikah, “Feh hlah uh ka lo ti tho lo maw?” a rak ti."},"19":{"text":"Jerikho khawsungmi hrekkhat pawl cu Elisha hnenah an ra ih, “Bawipa, na theih vekin hi khua ih hmunram cu a ṭhazet a si. Asinain tidai a ṭha lo ih fa siatnak a suahter ringring,” an ti.","title":"Elisha Ih Mangbangza Tuahmi"},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in, “Kheng thar sungah cite ret uhla ka hnenah rak keng uh,” a ti. A ti vekin an rak kengih,"},"21":{"text":"an khua dawhhna ah a feh ih cite cu a va paih hnuah, “ Bawipa in, ‘Hi tidai cu ka thiangfaiter zo ih thihnak le fa siatnak a suakter nawn lo ding,’ a ti a si,” tiah a sim."},"22":{"text":"Cuih thokin Elisha ih a sim bangtuk in cuih tidai cu tidai thiangfai ah a cangta."},"23":{"text":"Elisha cu Jerikho ihsin a suak ih Bethel lamih a feh laiah khua pakhat sungin mipa nauhak an rasuak ih hnihsuak sainak ah an hmang ih, “Feh aw, lu thlung kolh pa, feh aw,” tiah an auh."},"24":{"text":"Elisha cu dunglam a her ih meet phah in Bawipa ih hmin in a cam hai. Cule hramlak in savom pinu pahnih an hung suak ih mipa nauhak sawmli le pahnih cu an bauhthlek thluh."},"25":{"text":"Cuih sin Elisha cu Karmel Tlaangah a hung feh ih cuih hnuah Samaria ah a kir."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat in an ram a uknak kum hleiriatnak ah Ahab fapa Joram cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria khua in kum hleihnih sung a uk.","title":"Israel Mi Le Moab Mi An Do Aw"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah sualnak a tuah; asinain a pa le a nu Jezebel tluk lawmmam cun a sual lo. A pa ih Baal biaknak milem pawl a tuahmi cu a bal ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Asinain amah hlanih siangpahrang a ṭuantu Nebat fapa Jeroboam vekin Israel mi pawl cu sualnak lamzin ah a hruailut ih cuih sualnak cu a baansan duh lo."},"4":{"text":"Moab siangpahrang Mesha in tuu a zuat ih kumtinte in siah ah tuu no thawng zakhat le tuu thawng zakhat ih hmul cu Israel siangpahrang hnenah a pek ṭheu."},"5":{"text":"Asinain Israel siangpahrang Ahab a thih tikah Israel do dingin Mesha cu ral a tho."},"6":{"text":"Hmakhatteah siangpahrang Joram cu Samaria in a suak ih a ralkap pawl a kokhawm ciammam."},"7":{"text":"Cule Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat hnenah, “Moab siangpahrang cu keimah do dingin ral a tho a si. Amah do dingah i ra bawm thei pei maw?” tiah thu a cah. Cutikah siangpahrang Jehoshafat in, “Ka lo bawm ding. Keimah le ka ralkap pawl le ka rang pawl cu na duhduh ih hman ding kan si ko."},"8":{"text":"Khuitawk lam in so kan nam ding?” tiah a sut. Joram in, “Edom ramih hramlak in kan feh pei,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Israel siangpahrang Joram cu Judah siangpahrang le Edom siangpahrang pawl thawn an pok. Ni sarih an feh hnuah an tidai kenmi a cem. Minung hrangah siseh ṭilva hrangah siseh zianghman a um nawn lo."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Joram in, “Kan cem riai a si! Moab siangpahrang ih duhduh ih tuah dingah Bawipa in kannih pathum hi in rak ruat cia a sihi!” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Jehoshafat in, “ Bawipa kan ron theinak dingah hinah profet zotal an um lo maw?” tiah a sut. Cutikah siangpahrang Joram ih ralbawi pakhat in, “Shafat fapa Elisha a um sokhaw. Amah cu Elijah rak bawmtu a si,” tiah a sim."},"12":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jehoshafat in, “Elisha cu profet dik a si,” a ti. Curuangah an pathum in Elisha hnenah an feh."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in Israel siangpahrang hnenah, “Ziangah so ka hnenih na rat? Na nu le na pa ih an leen ṭheumi profet pawl kha va tong aw,” tiah a rak ti. Joram in, “Asilo; kannih siangpahrang pathum hi Moab siangpahrang ih duhduh ih tuah theinak dingah in rettu cu Bawipa a si,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Elisha in, “Ka renmi a nung Bawipa ih hmin saal in ka lo sim: Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat ka upatnak um hlah sehla nang cu a zoh hman ka lo zoh duh lo ding."},"15":{"text":"Ziangkhal va sisehla ṭingṭang tum thiam i holh aw he,” tiah a ti. Ṭingṭang tum thiam pa cun ṭingṭang cu a tum ih, culaifang ah Bawipa ih huham cu Elisha hnenah a thleng ih,"},"16":{"text":"Elisha in, “ Bawipa in, ‘Hi a caarmi tiva luannak ahhin khur lai uh."},"17":{"text":"Thli le ruah nan hmu lo ding naón hi tiva luannak cu tidai in a khat ding ih nanmah le nan ralkap le nan ṭilva pawl hrangah tidai tampi a um ding,’ a ti a si."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla himi cu Bawipa hrangah cun thil olte a si. Cuih hlei ah Moab mi pawl tlunah nehnak cu Bawipa in a lo pek fawn ding a si."},"19":{"text":"Mawizet ih an tuahmi le ṭhazet ih an kulhmi an khawpi pawl nan lak ṭheh ding. A rahzetmi an thingkung pawl nan hau ṭheh ding. An cerhti hmuahhmuah nan caarter ṭheh ding ih, an loram ṭha hmuahhmuah khal lungto in deng tahrat in nan siatsuah ṭheh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"A thaizing, zinglam thawinak pek tikcu ah Edom lam in tidai a rung luang ih leilung cu a khuh ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Kanmah do dingah siangpahrang pathum an ra zo, ti kha Moab mi pawl in an theih tikah hriamnam keng theitu mipa hmuahhmuah, upabik in nauhak bik tiang, an kokhawm ṭheh ih an ramri ah ṭanhmun an khuar."},"22":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitih an thawh tikah ni in tidai cu a tlet ih thisen vekih sen thluh in an hmu."},"23":{"text":"“Thisen a si ual! Kan ral ralkap bur thum pawl anmah le anmah an do-aw ih an that-aw thluh a si ding. Kan va feh pei ih an riahbuk kan va ram pei,” tiah an ti."},"24":{"text":"Cuticun an feh, asinain Israel pawl ih riahbuk an thlen tikah Israel pawl in an rak nam ciamco ih an rak khir. Israel pawl cun an dawi ih Moab mi pawl cu tampi an that ih,"},"25":{"text":"an khua tampi an siatsuah. An fehnak ih loram ṭha hmuahhmuah parah Israel mi pakhat in lungto pakhat ciar an deng ih an loram hmuahhmuah cu lungto in a khat ṭheh. An cerhti pawl an caarter ṭheh ih, an thingthei kung pawl khal an hau ṭheh. Netabik ah an khawpi bik Kir Haresheth lawng a taang ih Israel mi lungherhden thiam pawl in an kulh ih an do."},"26":{"text":"Moab siangpahrang in a ralkap pawl an sung vivo ti kha a theih tikah ralnam hmang ralkap za sarih thawn a ral pawl ih an kulhnak hmun pakhat zawn in pahsuak ih Siria siangpahrang hnenah tlan a tum. Asinain a pahsuak thei lo."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah amah ai-awh ih siangpahrang cangtu ding, a fapa upabik a ko ih an khawpi kulhnak ralhruang parah Moab khawzing hnenih mei-ur thawinak hrangah a that ih a pek. Israel ralkap pawl in cumi an hmuh tikah thinphang in cuih khawpi ihsin dungah an siip ih an ramah an tlung."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Profet burpi sung ihsin profet pakhat ih nupi cu Elisha hnenah a feh ih, “Bawipa, na salpa ka pasal in i thih san. Na theih vekin amah cu Pathian duhzettu a si. Asinain atu-ah lei a baak mipa a ra ih ka fapa pahnihte leiba ai-ah sal ah kaih a tum a si,” tiah a ra ti.","title":"Elisha In Farah Nuhmei A Bawm"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in, “Ziang so ka lo tuah sak ding? Inn ah ziangso na neih?” tiah a sut. Anih in, “Olif siti langkhat siarlo zianghman neihmi dang ka nei lo,” tiah a sim."},"3":{"text":"Elisha in, “Va feh awla na innhnen pawl hnen ihsin palang lawng tampi in va saang aw."},"4":{"text":"Cuthluh in nangmah le na fapa pahnih cu inn sungah lut uhla sangka khar uhla palang lawng sungah cun na siti palang sungih siti cu than vivo uh. An khah vete in palang pawl cu a dangah re cingcing uh,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah nuhmei nu cu a fapa pawl thawn inn sungah an lut ih sangka a khar hnuah, a fapa pawl ih rak kenmi palang sungah a neih cia mi siti cu a thun vivo."},"6":{"text":"Palang hmuahhmuah khat ṭheh ko ih a thun hnuah, “Palang lawng dang a um lai maw?” tiah a sut. A fapa pakhat in, “Palang lawng dang a um nawn lo,” tiah a ti. Cutikah siti a thlet reromi cu a pit ve."},"7":{"text":"Profet Elisha hnenah cun a va feh sal ih, Elisha in, “Na siti zuar awla na leiba hmuahhmuah sam thluh aw. Cuih tlunah nangmah le na fapa pawl nunnak dingah paisa hlei a um hrih thotho ding,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Nikhat ah Elisha cu Shunem khua ah a feh. Cuih khua ahcun nunau milian pakhat a um ih Elisha cu rawl ei dingah a ko ih,","title":"Elisha Le Shunem Khua Milian Nu"},"9":{"text":"cuih thok ihsin Shunem khua a thlen tinte in cuih inn ah Elisha cu rawl a ei ringring. Cule a pasal hnenah, “Kan innih a ra ringring pa hi mi thianghlim a si ding tiah ka zum."},"10":{"text":"Kan inn diphun parah khaan pakhat kan tuahsak pei ih cuih khaan sungah ihkhun pakhat, cabuai pakhat, tokham pakhat le mei-inn pakhat kan retsak pei ih in ra tlawn tinin cutawkah a riak ṭheu pei,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Nikhat cu Shunem khua ah Elisha cu a ra tlawng ih a khaan sungah cun a hung cawl."},"12":{"text":"Cule a hnen-um pa Gehazi cu, “Inntek nu va ko aw,” tiah a fial. Inntek nu a rat tikah,"},"13":{"text":"Elisha in Gehazi hnenah, “Hi tluk ih in tuamhlawm ruangah le kan hrangih a zonzaih ai ah ziangso a hrangah ka tuahsak thei ding, sut hnik aw. Siangpahrang maw, ralkap hotu ralbawipa maw va ton sak in ziangthu tal va sim sak a duh maw?” tiah a ti. Inntek nu cun, “ṭulmi zianghman ka nei lo. Ka miphunpi lakah hin sammi zianghman ka nei lo,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule Elisha in, “Cuti asile a hrangah ziangso ka tuahsak ding?” tiah Gehazi cu a sut. Gehazi in, “Sammi pakhat cu a nei: fapa a nei lo. A pasal le a tar zo fawn,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"“Hitawk ah ra seh,” tiah Elisha in a ti. Inntek nu cu a ra ih sangka ah a ding."},"16":{"text":"Cule Elisha in, “Hmaikum tu tikcu ah na ṭaangah fapa te na cawi ding,” a ti. Cutikah anih in, “Aa, bawipa, nang Pathian ih minung na sisi; thuphan cu i sim hlah aw!” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Asinain Elisha ih a tivek in cuih hnu kum khatah fapa a hring ngaingai."},"18":{"text":"A hung upat deuh tikah voikhat cu fang at dingah, fang attu dang pawl thawn a pa cu lo ah a feh. An fapa te khal a pa hnenah a feh ve."},"19":{"text":"Cule rinlopi-ah, “Ka pa, ka lu a na, ka lu a na,” tiah a ai ciamco. Cutikah a pa in, “A nu hnenah vun pawk aw,” tiah a hnen-um pakhat a fial."},"20":{"text":"Hnen-umpa in a nu hnenah cun a vun pawk ih a nu in a cawn parah sun tiang a cawi ih a thi."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah a nu in Elisha ih khaan ah a ruak cu hun cawi in ihkhun parah a ret ih sangka a khar hnuah a taan."},"22":{"text":"Cule a pasal a ko ih, “Hnen-um pakhat laak pakhat thawn rak thlah aw. Profet Elisha hnenah ka va feh pei ih zamrang zetin ka ra kirsal ding,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"A pasal in, “Ziangah so tuihsun kherkher ih feh cu na duh? Sabbath ni a si lo, Thla Thar Puai khal a si lo,” tiah a ti. Anih in, “A poi lo, a ṭha ko ding,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Laak cu a kung an dan ṭheh tikah hnen-um pa cu, “Laak hi zamrang in nawt awla ka lo sim lai hlanlo fuungter aw hlah,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cuticun a pok ih Elisha umnak Karmel Tlangah a feh. Shunem khua ih nunau nu a rat kha Elisha in hla nawn ah a hei hmu ih a hnen-um Gehazi hnenah, “Zohhnik, Shunem khua ih nunau nu a rat khi!"},"26":{"text":"Zamrang in a hnenah va tlan awla, amah le a pasal le an fapa te an dam maw, va sut hnik,” tiah a ti. Gehazi hnenah cun, “Thawmvang a ṭha ko,” tiah a rak ti."},"27":{"text":"Asinain Elisha hnenih a thlen tikah cun a hmaiah a kun ih Elisha ih ke cu a kuah. Gehazi in tuul-hloh a tum naón Elisha in, “Tuul hlah aw. Vansang in a um tihi na hmu lo mawsi? Bawipa in a vansaannak thu i sim fawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah nunau nu in, “Bawipa, fapa ka lo dil dah leem mawsi? Thuphan i sim hlah aw ka lo ti lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Elisha in Gehazi hnenah, “Zamrang aw! Ka kianghrol hi la awla a tlan in tlan aw. Lamzin ah zohman bia-aw hlah. Mi ih an lo biak khalle bia kir hlah aw. A inn ah va feh awla a fapa ih tlunah ka kianghrol hi va thlir aw,” a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cule nunau nu in, “ Bawipa ih nunnak le nangmah ih nunnak saal in thu ka lo kam: Ka lo taan lo ding,” tiah Elisha cu a ti. Curuangah an pahnih in an feh tlang."},"31":{"text":"Gehazi cu an hmaiah a rak feh ih, an fapa te ih tlunah cun Elisha ih kianghrol cu a va thlir. Asinain ziang thawthaang hman a nei lo; cang khal a caang lo. Curuangah a kir ih Elisha hnenah, “Nauhak pa cu a nung thei cuang lo,” a ti."},"32":{"text":"Elisha a thlen tikah amah lawng a khaan sungah a lut ih ihkhun parah nauhak pa ih ruak cu a hmu."},"33":{"text":"Sangka a khar ih Bawipa hnenah thla a cam."},"34":{"text":"Cule nauhak pa ih parah cun a bok ih a kaa zawn ah a kaa, a mit zawn ah a mit, le a kut zawn ah a kut ret in a nen. Cuticun nauhak pa ih ruak cu malte a hung hlum."},"35":{"text":"Cun Elisha cu a tho ih a khaan sung ahcun khatlam le khatlam ah a vak zok rero; cuih hnuah nauhak pa ih ruak cu a va nen sal. Cuti ih a tuah hnuah nauhak pa cu voi sarih a hahthio ih a mit a hun meng."},"36":{"text":"Cule Gehazi a ko ih, “A nu vung ko aw,” a ti. A nu cu a ra ih Elisha in, “Na fapa hi ra la aw,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cutikah a nu cu Elisha ih kehram ah a bok ih a hmai leilung dai in upatnak a pek. Cule a fapa te cu a cawi ih a fehpi."},"38":{"text":"Voikhat cu an ram pumpi ah paam a tlung ih cutikah Elisha cu Gilgal ah a kir. Elisha in profet pawl thu a zirh rero laiah a hnen-um pa hnenah, “Tap parah beel tumpi toh awla hi profet pawl hrangah sa-buber suang aw,” a ti.","title":"A Dang Mangbangza Pahnih"},"39":{"text":"Hnen-um pakhat cu vauhrial hawl ah hramlakah a feh. Hramlak uumhri a hmu ih uumrah a lo ih a phurh theizat in a puan in a fun. Inn ah a tlung ih ziang a si ti thei loin hramlak uum cu a sat ih sa-buber ah a suang."},"40":{"text":"An ei dingah sa-buber cu an suak ih an teh tikah, “Ai law, thihsii a si ee!” tiah an au ciamco ih an ei ngam nawn lo."},"41":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in, “Sangphut malte in i pek uh,” a ti. Cumi cu beel sungah a vun thlah ih, “An ei dingah sa-buber cu suak uh,” tiah a ti. An suah sal tikah cun ei ṭha ah a cang ṭheh."},"42":{"text":"Cun voikhat cu Baal Shalishah ihsin mi pakhat a ra ih cuih kum ih lak hmaisa bik barli sangvut ih tuahmi sang zawl kul le fangthar lak mi a vui in Elisha hrangah a rak phur. Elisha in, “Hi rawl cu profet pawl pe aw, ei hai seh,” tiah a hnen-umpa a fial."},"43":{"text":"Asinain a hnen-umpa in, “Minung zakhat hrangah hi cu zianghman titham a si ual lo,” a ti. Elisha in, “An ei dingah pe ko aw, ziangahtile Bawipa in, ‘An ei dingih an hlahmi tla a um ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"44":{"text":"Curuangah profet pawl cu a pek hai ih an zate ih an ei hnuah, Bawipa ih ti vekin, an hlahmi a um ngaingai."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Naaman cu Siria ralkap hotu ralbawipa pakhat a si ih amah thawngin Siria ralkap pawl cu Bawipa in a bawm ih an ral pawl an neh ringring. Curuangah an siangpahrang in ralbawi Naaman cu a uar zetih a upatzet fawn. Ralbawi makzet a si; asinain phaarnat a tuar ngelcel.","title":"Naaman A Damter"},"2":{"text":"Voikhat ah Israel mi an do laiah Siria ralkap pawl in Israel nauhak nu pakhat an kai. An hruai ih Naaman nupi ih hnen-um ah a cang."},"3":{"text":"Nikhat ah a bawinu hnenah, “Ka bawipa hi Samaria ih a ummi profet hnenah va feh sehla ka va duh so! A phaarnat hi a damter rori ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Naaman in a theih tikah siangpahrang hnenah a va feh ih a va sim."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in, “A ṭha, va feh awla hi ka cakuat hi Israel siangpahrang va pe phah aw,” tiah a ti. Naaman cu a feh ih ngun tangka thawng sawmthum, sui tlep thawngruk le thleng awknak hnipuan zuun hra a keng."},"6":{"text":"A kenmi cakuat sungah cun, “Hi cakuat a lo petu hi ka ralbawi Naaman a si ih na rak theihnak dingah hi ca hi ka lo kuat. A natnak hi rak damter hram aw,” tiah a ngan."},"7":{"text":"Cuih cakuat cu Israel siangpahrang in a rak siar tikah mangbang in a hnipuan a thlek ṭheh ih, “Ziangtin so Siria siangpahrang in hi pa hi rak damter aw tiah i ti men? Nunnak le thihnak huham nei Pathian ah maw i ruah? Keimah thawn tawh awknak a hawl a si ko ding,” tiah awloksong in a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cuih thu cu profet Elisha in a theih tikah siangpahrang hnenah cun, “Ziangah so riahsia in na hnipuan na thlek ṭheh? Israel ram sungah profet a um a si, ti a theihnak dingah cupa cu ka hnenah ratter aw,” tiah thu a cah."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Naaman cu a rang le a rangleng pawl thawn a feh ih Elisha innih kotka ah a va ding."},"10":{"text":"Elisha in a hnen-um pakhat a hei thlah ih Naaman hnenah cun, “Feh awla Jordan Tiva ah voi sarih in ti va bual aw. Na titsa an cerh sal ding ih na dam ding,” tiah a va sim."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Naaman cu a thinheng in a kir ih, “Cu lawmmam! Ka hnenah ra in Bawipa a Pathian hnenah thla cam tahratin ka natnak hma parah a kut suangin i damter hmang ding, tiah ka ruat naón cuvek zianghman a um ual lo."},"12":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Damaskas ih a luangmi Abana le Pharpar tiva pawl cu Israel ramih tiva hnakin an ṭha deuh a si lo maw? Cuih tiva pawl ah ti bual ningla ka dam sawn lo ding maw?” tiah a phunzai ciamco. Cuticun thinheng in a kir."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah a hnen-um pawl in an hei naih ih, “Bawipa, profet in thil harsa deuh tuah dingah lo fial sehla na tuah ko ding a si. Ziangah so tiva sungih ti bual ih dam cu na duh lo?” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Naaman cu Jordan Tiva ah a vung feh ih, ti sungah cun Elisha ih ti vekin voi sarih a hnim aw ih, cuṭheh cun a dam ngaingai! A taksa cu a dam ṭheh ih naute taksa bangin a ngil lellel. Cuticun mi thiangfai ah a cang."},"15":{"text":"Cule Elisha hnenah cun a minung pawl thawn an va kir ih, “Atu cun Israel ramih Pathian siar lo leilungtlun khuitawk hmanah Pathian dang a um lo, ti ka thei zo. Curuangah Bawipa, ka lungawinak laksawng hi i saang hram aw,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Elisha in, “Ka biakmi a nung Pathian hmin saal in ka lo sim: laksawng zianghman ka la lo ding,” tiah a ti. A laksawng la dingah Naaman cun a hneek rero naón Elisha in a duh lo."},"17":{"text":"Cule Naaman in, “Ka laksawng i co sak thei lo a si ahcun ka khua ih phurh dingah laak pahnih phur in leilung i lakter hram aw; ziangahtile atu thok ihsin Bawipa ih hnenah siar lo pathian dang zohnen hmanah raithawinak le mei-ur thawinak pawl cu ka pe nawn lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Siria khawzing Rimmon biakinn ah ka siangpahrang a feh ih ka thlun tikah anih in khawzing a biak tikah cun ka biak ve a ṭul ding ih cutik lawngah Bawipa in i ngaithiam hram seh. Bawipa cun i ngaithiam ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in, “Damte in va feh aw,” a ti. Cule Naaman cu a feh. Asinain malte lawng a feh man."},"20":{"text":"Elisha ih hnen-um pa Gehazi in, “Ka bawipa in zianghman laksawng lak loin Naaman a fehter. Siria ralbawipa ih a pekmi cu saan ding a si naón! A nungmi Bawipa ih hmin saal in ka sim: ka dawi dingih ziangtal ka dil ding,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah Naaman cu a dawi. Naaman in a dunglam ih a ra tlan rero mi pakhat a hmuh tikah a rangleng par ihsin a ṭum duak ih a rak tong ih, “Thupoi a um maw?” tiah a rak sut."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Gehazi in, “Thupoi zianghman a um lo. Asinain Efraim tlangpar ramih profet pawl lakin minung pahnih an ra thleng ih an hnenah ngun tangka thawngthum le hnipuan thleng awknak zuun hnih ka bawipa in pek a duh ih cumi cu nangmah in na rak pe thei pei maw ti lo sim dingah i thlah a si,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Naaman in, “Ngun tangka thawngruk in la aw,” a ti. Ngun tangka cu dip pahnih sungah a thun sak ih la dingin a hneek. Cumi le thleng awknak hnipuan zuun hnih cu a hnen-um pahnih a phurh terih Naaman ih thupeknak bangin Gehazi ih hmaiah cun an feh."},"24":{"text":"Elisha umnak tlang an thlen tikah Gehazi in dip pahnih cu a lak ih inn sungah a ret. Cuih hnuah Naaman ih hnen-um pahnih cu a kirter."},"25":{"text":"Inn sungih a ra lut sal tikah Elisha in, “Khuiah so na feh?” tiah Gehazi cu a sut. Gehazi in, “Khuitawk hmanah ka feh hrimhrim lo,” tiah a pheh."},"26":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Elisha cun, “Naaman cu a rangleng in a ṭum ih a lo ton laiah khan ka thlarau in na hnenih tel ve lo ah maw si i ruah? Atuih caan hi paisa le hnipuan, olif hmuan le sabit hmuan, tuu le caw, salnu le salpa, laak caan a si lo."},"27":{"text":"Asinain Naaman ih nat in a lo kai ding ih nangmah le na tesinfa pawl cu cuih natnak a kumkhua in nan nei ta ding a si,” tiah a ti. Gehazi cu lengah a suak ih cuih nat cu a tuar ngaingai - a vun cu vur bangin a rang ṭheh."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Voikhat ah Elisha ih ho mi profet pawl cu Elisha hnenah an ra ih, “Zohhnik aw, kan umnak hi a fate tuk.","title":"Hrei Fang An Ngah Sal"},"2":{"text":"Kan umnak inn a tum deuh ih sak dingah thing hau dingin Jordan ah in fehter aw,” tiah an ti. Elisha in, “A ṭha, feh uh,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule profet pakhat in feh ve dingah Elisha cu a sawm ih a lung a kim."},"4":{"text":"Cule an zatein an feh tlang. Jordan an thlen tikah thing cu an hau."},"5":{"text":"Pakhat pa in thing a hau laiah rinlopi-in ti sungah a hrei fang a tla pang. “Ailaw, ka bawipa, ziangtinso ka tuah ding? Ka saan mi a si fawn,” tiah a au ciamco."},"6":{"text":"Elisha in, “Khuitawk zawn ah so a tlak?” tiah a sut. Cupa cun a tlaknak zawn cu a sim. Cutikah Elisha in funghreu pakhat a saat ih tidai sungah a vun hlon ih hrei fang cu a hung phuan."},"7":{"text":"Elisha in, “Vun la aw,” a ti ih cupa cun a vun dawh ih a lak."},"8":{"text":"Voikhat ah Siria siangpahrang in Israel ram a do. A ralbawi pawl thawn an tongkhawm aw ih, “Cutawk zawn, khatawk zawn in nan nam pei?” tiah thu a pek.","title":"Siria Ralkap An Sung"},"9":{"text":"Cule Elisha in Israel siangpahrang hnenah, “Cutawk, khatawk ahcun feh hlah uh. Siria ralkap pawl in an lo bawh a si,” tin thu a cah."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Israel siangpahrang in cutawk lamih a fehmi ralkap pawl cu ralrinnak a pek ih ralring zetin an um. Cuticun voi tampi an luat."},"11":{"text":"Cumi cu Siria siangpahrang in a theih tikah a thin a heng ngaingai. A ralbawi pawl a ko ih, “Zoso Israel siangpahrang lamah a ṭangtu kan lakah a um?” tiah a sut."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah a ralbawi pakhat in, “Maw siangpahrang, zohman in kan lo zuar lo. Na khaan sungih na relmi na thuthup hman kha profet Elisha in Israel siangpahrang hnenih a sim cingcing ruangah a si,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Siria siangpahrang in, “Cupa ih umnak cu i sim uhla ka kai ding,” tiah a ti. Elisha cu Dothan ah a um, ti ih an sim tikah,"},"14":{"text":"rang le rangleng pawl thawn ralkap tampi cutawkah a hei thlah. Dothan khua cu zanah an va thleng ih an kulh ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"A thaizing zingthlapit ih Elisha ih hnen-um pa a thawh tikah inn lengah a va suak ih, Dothan khua kulhtu Siria ralkap pawl, an rang le rangleng pawl thawn an tiar awk ṭhepṭhep kha a hmu. Elisha hnenah a vung tlan ih, “Ailaw, bawipa, kan cem a si! Ziangtin so kan um ding?” tiah thinphang in a au."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in, “Na thinphang hlah; annih hnenih a ummi hnakin kannih hnenih a ummi an tam sawn,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih hnenah thla a cam. “Maw Bawipa , a mit run vaangter awla khua run hmuhter aw,” a ti. Bawipa in a thlacamnak cu a run thei ih Elisha ih hnen-um pa cun khua a hun thlir tikah Elisha ih kiangkap tlangtluan hmuahhmuah cu rang le meisa rangleng in an khah ṭhepṭhep kha a hmu."},"18":{"text":"Siria ralkap pawl in an run nam tikah Elisha in thla a cam ih, “Maw Bawipa , hi ralkap pawl hi an mit run cawter aw,” a ti. Bawipa in a thlacamnak cu a run thei ih an mit a cawtter ṭheh ngaingai."},"19":{"text":"Cule Elisha cu an hnenah a va feh ih, “Nan lamzin nan hlo a si. Nan hawl reromi khua cu himi a si lo. I thlun uhla nan hawl mipa umnak ah ka lo hruai hai ding,” tiah a ti. Cuticun Samaria ah a hruai hai."},"20":{"text":"Khua sungih an thlen vete in Elisha in thla a cam ih, “Maw Bawipa , an mit run damter awla khua hmu hai seh,” a ti. Bawipa in a thlacamnak cu a run thei; an mit a run damter ih Samaria khua sungih an um kha an hmu."},"21":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang in Siria ralkap pawl a hmuh tikah, “Bawipa, hi ralkap pawl hi ka that thluh pei maw?” tiah Elisha a sut."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in, “Na that lo pei. Ral nan donak ih nan kaihmi ralkap pawl hman nan that lo pei. An ei ding ti le rawl pe hai uhla an siangpahrang hnenah tlung hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah Israel siangpahrang in anmah ih hrangah rawl ei puai tumzet a tuahsak ih an in an ei ṭheh hnuah Siria siangpahrang hnenah an tlung. Cuih ṭum thokin Siria ralkap pawl in Israel ram an rung do nawn lo."},"24":{"text":"Tikcu a hung rei deuh tikah Siria siangpahrang Benhadad in a ralkap hmuahhmuah a kokhawm ih Israel a do ih Samaria khawpi cu a kulh ṭheh.","title":"Samaria An Siim"},"25":{"text":"Cutiih caan reipi a kulh ṭheh ruangah cun Samaria khua sungah rawl a har ciammam ih laak lu pakhat cu ngun tangka sawmriat a man ih tlangpurun mehtok kilh khatah ngun tangka fangnga a man."},"26":{"text":"Nikhat ah Israel siangpahrang cu khawpi kulhnak lungdawl kapih lam a leen laiah nunau nu pakhat in, “Maw siangpahrang Bawipa, i bawm hram aw,” tiah a auh."},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang Bawipa in, “ Bawipa Pathian in a lo bawm lo a si ahcun kei in ziangso ka lo bawm thei ding? Sangvut le sabit nei ah maw si i ruah?"},"28":{"text":"Ziang so na poi?” tiah a ti. Nunau nu in, “Kan dungah hi nunau nu hin, ‘Na faate kan ei pei ih, thaisun ah kei ih faate kan ei leh pei,’ tiah i ti."},"29":{"text":"Curuangah ka faate cu kan suang ih kan ei thluh. A thaisun ah na faate kan ei thlang pei, ka ti naón a thuphlo a si,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cuih thu cu siangpahrang in a theih tikah a riahsia in a hnipuan a thlek ṭheh. Khawpi kulhnak lungdawl parih a feh laiah a kiangkap ih a ummi pawl in a hnipuan hnuai ah buri a hruh kha an hmu."},"31":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang bawipa cun, “Tuihsun rori ih Shafat fapa Elisha a hngawng ka tan lo a si ahcun Bawipa in keimah i that seh,” a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cule Elisha kai dingin mi a thlah. Culai ah Elisha cu a inn ah a rak um ih upa hrekkhat pawl in an rak leeng. Siangpahrang ih thlahmi milai a ra thlen hlan deuh ah Elisha in, “Khi laithat pa in keimah that dingah mi pakhat a rak thlah a si,” tiah upa pawl cu a sim. “A thlah mipa a ra thlen tikah sangka khar uhla inn sungah lutter hlah uh. Siangpahrang amah khal a ra thleng cing ve ding,” a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cutiih a ṭong hman a cem hlanah siangpahrang cu a ra thleng ngaingai ih anih in, “Hi bangtuk harsatnak kan parih a thlengtertu hi Bawipa a si. Ziangtin so amah ih bomnak cu ka rin thei nawn ding?” a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in, “ Bawipa ih thusimmi hi ngai uh! Thaisun atu tikcu ah Samaria khua ih dawr ahhin sangvut ṭha bik cuai khat, a si lole barli sangvut cuai hnih cu ngun tangka fangkhat in nan lei thei ding a si,” a ti."},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang thluntu bawi pakhat in Elisha hnenah, “Thil cang thei a si lo- Bawipa amah in van tukvirh ong in fang run thla ciamco hmansehla a cang thei zik lo!” tiah a sawn. Cule Elisha in, “A cang dingih na mit rori in na hmu ding; asinain nang cun na ei ngah lo ding,” tiah a let."},"3":{"text":"Phaarnat a tuartu mina pali cu khawpi kotka ah an um ih pakhat le pakhat hnenah, “Ziangah so kan thih thlak tiang hitawk ih kan um duh rero ding?","title":"Siria Ralkap An Tlan"},"4":{"text":"Khawsungih kan vungluh khalle a ṭhahnem lo, rawl loin kan thi ko ding; hitawk ih kan um khalle kan thi thotho ding. Curuangah Siria ralkap pawl ih riah hmunah kan va feh sawn pei. In thah asile kan va thi ko pei; asinain that loin in zuah khal a si thei men sokhaw,” tiah an ti aw."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah khua a thim zawng ah Siria ralkap pawl riahhmun ahcun an va feh. Asinain an va thlen ngaingai tikah pakhat hman an rak um nawn lo."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in Siria ralkap pawl ih hnathlam sungah thawmvang a thanter ih cuih thawmvang cu ralkap tam ngaingai, rang le rangleng tampi thawmvang vek a si. Israel siangpahrang in Hit siangpahrang le Izipt siangpahrang, an ralkap pawl thawn a sawm ih in ra do tum a sihi, tiah Siria ralkap pawl cun an ruat."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah thih ṭih ah Siria ralkap pawl cu lusam hman mang loin an tlan ih, an puanthlam, an rang le an laak pawl khal cuh man loin an riahhmun cu amah keel in an taan."},"8":{"text":"Miphar pali cu riahhmun an thlen tikah puanthlam pakhat sungah an lut ih puanthlam sungih ummi rawl cu an ei an in hnuah an tonmi sui, ngun le hnipuan pawl cu zamrang in an cuh ih anmah ih hrangah an thup. An rakir ih puanthlam a dang pakhat sungah an lut ih cuti thotho in an tuah."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah anmah le anmah, “Hitiih kan tuahmi hi thildik a si lo. Thuthang ṭha kan nei a si ih kanmah ih hrang lawngah siseh ti ding a si lo. Thaizing tiang kan hngah asile mawh kan phur tengteng ding. Atu rori ah kan feh pei ih siangpahrang kuthnuai ih bawi pawl kan va sim pei,” tiah an ti aw."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Siria ralkap pawl ih riahhmun cun an suak ih Samaria khawsungah an lut ih kotka kiltu pawl hnenah, “Siria ralkap pawl ih riah hmunah kan va feh ih zohman kan hmu lo, a ṭhing. An rang le an laak pawl hri hman an suut ta lo! An puanthlam pawl khal Siria ralkap pawl ih an tlansan vek rori in an um lai a si,” tiah an sim."},"11":{"text":"Cuih thu cu kotka kiltu pawl in siangpahrang hnenah an vung sim."},"12":{"text":"Zan asinain siangpahrang bawipa cu a tho ih a kuthnuai bawi pawl hnenah, “Siria ralkap pawl ih tummi ka lo sim ding. Khawsungih rawl a um lo hi an thei. Curuangah an riahhmun ihsin an suak ih hramlakah an thup-aw a si. Rawl hawl ah khawsung ihsin an rasuak ding ih cutikah a nungin kan kai ṭheh dingih an khawpi khal kan la suak ding a si, tiah an ruat a si,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah a kuthnuai ih bawi pakhat in, “Ziang a sihmanah kan hlanih a thi zomi pawl vekin hi khawsungih a ummi hmuahhmuah cu kan thi thluh thotho ding a si. Curuangah thil umdaan ziangvek ngaingai so a si, ti kan theihnak dingah a nung hrihmi rang panga thawn mi hrekkhat kan hei thlah hnik pei,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah milai hrekkhat an hril ih Siria ralkap pawl khui ah an si, ti zoh dingah siangpahrang in rangleng pahnih in a thlah."},"15":{"text":"An feh ih Jordan an thleng. Lamzin tluanah Siria ralkap pawl in an tlan phah ih an thlaumi an hnipuan le an hriamnam pawl an hmu. An ra kir ih cuih thu cu siangpahrang an sim."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Samaria khawsungmi mi burpi pawl cu pah that-aw thluh zik in an ra suak ih Siria ralkap pawl ih riahhmun cu an va ram ciamco. Cule Bawipa ih ṭongmi vek cekci in sangvut ṭha bik cuai khat, a si lole barli sangvut cuai hnih ah ngun tangka fangkhat in an zuar ngaingai."},"17":{"text":"Cuih ṭum ngelcel ah Israel siangpahrang in amah a rak thlun ṭheutu a kuthnuai ih bawi cu kotka kiltu pawl hotu ah a ret. Cule misenpi pawl Siria ralkap riahhmun lamih an nor awk ciamco tikah cuih hotu pa cu an pal that; Elisha tong dingin siangpahrang a feh ṭum ih Elisha ih ṭong vekin cupa cu a thi ngaingai."},"18":{"text":"Elisha in siangpahrang hnenah, “Thaisun tu tikcu ah Samaria khua ih dawr ahhin sangvut ṭha bik cuai khat, a si lole barli sangvut cuai hnih cu ngun tangka fangkhat in an zuar ding,” a rak ti tikah,"},"19":{"text":"cuih siangpahrang thluntu bawi cun, “A cang thei mi a si lo- Bawipa amah in hmakhatte-ah van tukvirh ong in fang run thla ciamco hmansehla a cang thei zik lo,” tiah a rak sawn. Cule Elisha cun, “A cang dingih na mit rori in na hmu ding; asinain nang cun na ei ngah lo ding,” tiah a rak let."},"20":{"text":"A ti vekin a parah a thleng ngaingai; misenpi in khawpi kotka ah an pal that a si."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shunem khua ih um, a fapa a nunter sal mi nunau hnenah, “Tho awla Bawipa in a zonzon in kum sarih sung paam a tlunter ding ruangah, nangmah le na innsang pawl thawn hmun dangah feh in nan um le a ṭha ding” tiah Elisha in a ti.","title":"Shunem Nunau Nu A Ra Kir"},"2":{"text":"A thusimmi cu ngai in a innsang pawl thawn Filistin ram ah an feh ih cutawkah kum sarih sung an um."},"3":{"text":"Kum sarih hnuah cuih nunau nu cu Israel ramah a ra kir sal ih a inn le a lo pawl ngah thei sal dingah siangpahrang dil ding a feh."},"4":{"text":"Culai ah siangpahrang cu Elisha hnen-um pa Gehazi thawn thu an rak ruah aw rero. Elisha ih mangbangza tuahmi pawl cu siangpahrang in theih a duhzet."},"5":{"text":"Elisha in nauhak pa a nunter salnak thu cu Gehazi in siangpahrang a sim rero laiah Shunem nunau nu cun siangpahrang hnenih a ngenmi thu cu a hun sim. Cutikah Gehazi in, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, ka lo simmi nunau nu le Elisha ih a nunter salmi a fapa te cu hinah an ra,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang in thu a suh vivo tikah Gehazi ih simmi cu thudik a si kha a thei vivo. Cule siangpahrang in a kuthnuai ih bawi pakhat a ko ih cuih nunau nu hnenah a hlanih a ta a rak si mi hmuahhmuah le a um lo kum sarih sung a lo sung suak rawl man hmuahhmuah tla pe thluh dingin thu a pek."},"7":{"text":"Voikhat ah Elisha cu Damaskas khua-ah a feh. Culai ah Siria siangpahrang Benhadad cu a rak na ngelcel. Elisha cu Damaskas khua sungah a um, ti kha siangpahrang in a theih tikah,","title":"Elisha Le Siria Siangpahrang"},"8":{"text":"a kuthnuai bawi pakhat Hazael a ko ih, “Profet cu laksawng va pe awla ka nung ding maw, nung lo ding Bawipa i sut sak hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Hazael cun Damaskas in a suakmi thilri a ṭha bik pawl a phunkim in a lak ih kalauk sawmli a phurhter ih Elisha hnenah cun a feh. Hazael in Elisha a ton tikah, “Na siahhlawh Siria siangpahrang Benhadad in a natnak in a dam ding maw, dam lo ding ti lo sut dingah i thlah a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in, “Nan siangpahrang bawipa cu a thi ding, tiah Bawipa in ka hnenah a phuang zo a si; asinain va feh awla na nung ding, tiah va sim aw,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule Elisha cun a mithmai sia in Hazael a meet ringring ih Hazael cu a um a nuam lo ih a hmai tiangin a sen ṭheh. Cun Elisha cu rinlopi in a ṭap."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Hazael in, “Bawipa, ziangah so na ṭah?” tiah a sut. Elisha in, “Israel mi parih thil siava na tuah dingmi hi ka hmuh ruangah ka ṭap a si. An ralhruang na ur ṭheh ding, an tlangval pawl ralnam in na cihmit thluh ding, an faate pawl leilung ah na vua that thluh ding ih nau keng nunau pawl na zaithlek thluh hai ding a si,” tiah a sawn."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Hazael cun, “Ziangtin so cutiih tuah theinak huham ka neih ding? Kei cu uico tluk fang ka sisi; zianghman ka si ual lo,” a ti. Elisha cun, “ Bawipa in i hmuh zo ih Siria ram siangpahrang na si ding,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Hazael cu a kir ih Benhadad cun, “Elisha in ziang a lo ti so?” tiah a rak sut. Cutikah Hazael in, “A nung ding, a lo ti,” tiah a sim."},"15":{"text":"Asinain a thaisun ah Hazael in puan sahzet pakhat a lak ih tidai sungah a ciah hnuah siangpahrang ih hmai a tuam ih siangpahrang cu a that. Cuticun Hazael cu Siria siangpahrang ah a cang."},"16":{"text":"Ahab fapa Joram cu Israel siangpahrang a sinak kum, kum nganak ah Jehoshafat ih fapa Jehoram cu,","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jehoram (2 San. 21.1-20)"},"17":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang ṭuan a thok. Siangpahrang a si tikah kum sawmthum le kum hnih a si ih Jerusalem khua in kum riat sung a uk."},"18":{"text":"A nupi cu Ahab ih fanu a si ih Ahab innsung saang vekin Jehoram khal cun Israel siangpahrang pawl ih tuahmi thil ṭha lo a thlun ve. Bawipa ih parah sualnak a tuah;"},"19":{"text":"asinain Judah ram cu Bawipa in a siatsuah siang lo, ziangahtile a salpa David hnenah a tefa pawl in ram an uk ringring ding, ti ih thu a rak kam zo ruangah a si."},"20":{"text":"Jehoram siangpahrang a si laiah Judah do dingin Edom mi pawl ral an tho ih anmahte uk awknak an ngah."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Jehoram cu a rangleng pawl thawn Zair ah a feh ih cutawkah Edom ralkap pawl in an kulh ṭheh. Zanṭim ah Jehoram le a rangleng mawng hotu pawl cun anmah kulhtu Edom ralkap pawl cu an pahsuak ih an luat; an ralkap pawl cu an inn ciarah an tlan ṭheh."},"22":{"text":"Cuih thokin Edom cu Judah ram thawn peh-aw nawn loin mahte uk awknak a ngahta. Cuih ṭum thotho ah Libnah khawpi tla ral an tho a si."},"23":{"text":"Jehoram ih hnaṭuan mi dangdang pawl cu Judah Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu timi sungah an ngan."},"24":{"text":"Cule Jehoram cu a thi ih Jerusalem David khawpi, siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Cuih hnuah a fapa Ahaziah in a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan."},"25":{"text":"Ahab ih fapa Joram in Israel siangpahrang a ṭuan ih kum hleihnihnak ah Jehoram ih fapa Ahaziah in,","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Ahaziah (2 San. 22.1-6)"},"26":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan thok. Siangpahrang a ṭuan tikah amah cu kum kul hluanhnih a si. A ram cu Jerusalem in kum khat a uk. A nu Athaliah cu Israel siangpahrang Omri ih tunu a si."},"27":{"text":"Ahaziah cu ṭhit awknak in siangpahrang Ahab thawn an peh awk ruangah Ahab innsang vek thotho in Bawipa ih parah sualnak a tuah a si."},"28":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahaziah in Israel siangpahrang Joram a ṭanpi ih Siria siangpahrang Hazael cu an do. Gilead ram Ramoth ah an tawng-aw ih Joram cu hriamhma a pu."},"29":{"text":"Curuangah Jezreel khawpi ah dam duh ah a kir sal. Siria siangpahrang Hazael in Israel ram,"},"33":{"text":"Jordan in nisuahnak lam hmuahhmuah, Arnon Tiva kapih a ummi Aroer khawpi tiangin thlanglam ah a vun lak ṭheh. Misenpi in an za an beng ih, “Siangpahrang a nunkhua sau hram seh!” tiah an au."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawinu Athaliah in misenpi le mikiltu pawl an au thawmvang cu a theih tikah misenpi an tonkhawmnak Biakinn ahcun zamrang tein a va feh."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang thar cu, a daan bangtuk in, Biakinn sung luhnak ṭhuam kiangah an dinter ih ralbawi pawl le tawtawrawt tumtu pawl in an kil ṭhepṭhep. Misenpi cu lungawizet in an au; tawtawrawt tum ih an um kha Athaliah cun a hmu. A riahsia in Athaliah cun a hnipuan a thlek ih, “Phiarnak!
