Jehoiada in Biakinn ah mikiltu a ret ih,"},"19":{"text":"amah le ralbawi pawl, siangpahrang kiltu le siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl in siangpahrang bawipa cu Biakinn ihsin siangpahrang inn ah an fehpi ih misenpi pawl in an thlun. Joash cu Mivengtu Kotka timi in a lut ih siangpahrang tokham parah a to."},"20":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah ih thinlung cu lungawinak in a khat; siangpahrang inn sungih ralnam thawn Athaliah an thah hnu cun an khawpi cu a dai."},"21":{"text":"Kum sarih a ti ah Joash cu Judah siangpahrang ah a cang."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Jehu in Israel ram a uknak kum sarihnak ah Joash cu Judah siangpahrang a cangih Jerusalem in kum sawmli sung a uk. A nu cu Beersheba khuami Zibiah a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Joash (2 San. 24.1-16)"},"2":{"text":"Joash cu puithiam Jehoiada in a zirh ruangah a dam sung hmuahhmuah ah Bawipa ih duhzawng a tuah."},"3":{"text":"Asinain khawvelmi pawl ih khawzing an biaknak hmun pawl siatsuah loin a zuah ih mi tampi in cutawk hmun ah raithawinak le mei-ur thawinak pawl cu an pe ringring."},"4":{"text":"Joash in puithiam pawl a ko ih, “Pathian betu pawl in an tuah ringringmi thawinak thawn an pek cihmi paisa siseh, anmah lungtho teih pekmi paisa siseh, Biakinn sungih tuahmi thawinak thawn peh-aw ih an pekmi paisa hmuahhmuah cu nan khawl a ṭul ding."},"5":{"text":"Puithiam in hna nan ṭuan sakmi Pathian betu pawl ih an pekmi paisa cu ṭhatein nan kil fingfing pei ih a ṭul tik poh ah Biakinn remnak ah hman a si pei,” tiah thu a pek."},"6":{"text":"Asinain siangpahrang Joash in ram a uknak kum kul hluanthum a kim tikah puithiam pawl in Biakinn cu a zianghman hman an rem hrih lo."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Joash in Jehoiada le a dang puithiam pawl a ko ih, “Ziangruangah atu tiang Biakinn nan rem dah lo? Atu thokin nan ngahmi paisa cu nanmah in nan kil lo pei. Paisa nan ngahmi hmuahhmuah nan ap pei ih Biakinn kan rem pei,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Anmah in paisa la nawn lo ding le Biakinn khal anmah ih rem lo ding in puithiam pawl an lung a kim."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jehoiada in kuang pakhat a lak ih a siin ah ong a tuah hnuah biakṭheng kiang, Biakinn vung luh ih vorhlam kamah a ret. Pathian betu pawl ih an pekmi paisa cu Biakinn sangka ih hnaṭuantu puithiam pawl in an rak lak ih cuih kuang sungah cun an san."},"10":{"text":"Kuang sungah paisa a tam thlang a si, ti an theih tikah siangpahrang cazi le Puithiam Sang in paisa cu an siar ih ṭhatein dip in an fun."},"11":{"text":"A zat kha cazin sungah ṭhatein an ngan hnuah Biakinn remtu pawl hotu ih kut ah an pek. Cuticun Bawipa ih Biakinn ih hnaṭuantu zungthiam le inn satu pawl,"},"12":{"text":"lung dawltu le lung sertu pawl ih hlawhman ah an pek. Biakinn remnak ih a ṭulmi thing-ah, lungto pawl le a dangdang a cemmi hmuahhmuah leinak ah an hmang."},"13":{"text":"Asinain cuih paisa cu ngun khuathai, kheng, tawtawrawt le mei-inn vannak ih hmanmi thilri le a dangdang sui le ngun ih tuahmi thilri leinak ahcun an hmang lo."},"14":{"text":"Biakinn remnak ih a ṭulmi thilri le a remtu pawl hlawhman lawnglawng ah an hmang."},"15":{"text":"Cuih hnaṭuantu pawl hotu pawl cu rintlak ngaingai an si ih an paisa hman daan kha zingzoi rero a ṭul hrimhrim lo."},"16":{"text":"Kuansal thawinak ih pekmi paisa le sualthlah thawinak ih pekmi paisa pawl cu cuih kuang sungah an san lo; puithiam pawl ih covo an si."},"17":{"text":"Culai ah Siria siangpahrang Hazael in Gath khawpi a do ih a lak; cule Jerusalem khawpi do a tum."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Judah siangpahrang Joash in a hlanih siangpahrang a rak ṭuantu Jehoshafat, Jehoram le Ahaziah pawl in Pathian hnenih an rak pekmi thawhlawm pawl le Bawipa ih Biakinn tangka retnak sungih a ummi sui hmuahhmuah le siangpahrang inn ih a ummi sui hmuahhmuah cu a lak ṭheh ih siangpahrang Hazael hnenah laksawng ah a kuat. Cutikah Hazael cu Jerusalem do loin a ralkap pawl thawn an kir sal."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang Joash ih tuahmi dangdang pawl cu Judah Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"20":{"text":"Siangpahrang Joash cu a kuthnuai ih ummi bawi pawl in an phiar ih, bawi pahnih Shimeath ih fapa Jozakar le Shomer ih fapa Jehozabad in an that. Silla khua ih vung fehnak lamzin, Millo horkuam ih a ummi inn ah Joash cu an that a si. Jerusalem, David khawpi, siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum ih a fapa Amaziah in a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan.","merge":"21"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahaziah fapa Joash cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan kum kul hluanthumnak ah Jehu fapa Jehoahaz Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria in kum hleisarih sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Jehoahaz"},"2":{"text":"A hlanih siangpahrang a ṭuantu, Israel mi pawl sualnak ih a hruailuttu siangpahrang Jeroboam bangtuk in Bawipa parah sualnak a tuah ih a thilsual tuahmi cu a thlah thei dah lo."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa cu Israel tlunah a thin a heng ih Siria siangpahrang Hazael le a fapa Benhadad in Israel cu voi tampi an neh."},"4":{"text":"Cun Jehoahaz in Bawipa hnenah thla a cam ih, Israel mi pawl Siria siangpahrang in siava tukih a hrem kha Bawipa in a hmuh ruangah a thlacamnak cu a theih sak."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi hnenah hotu a pek ih cuih hotu cun Siria kut sungin a luatter hai ih a hlan bangtuk in Israel mi pawl cu hnangam in an um sal."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla siangpahrang Jeroboam in Israel a sualternak ih sualnak cu annih khal in tlansan loin an tuah rero thotho; khawzingnu Asherah ih lem cu Samaria ah a um lai ringring."},"7":{"text":"Jehoahaz cun ralkap tampi a nei lo; Siria siangpahrang in a cihmit thluh ih fangcil caan ih leivut bangin a ke hnuai ih a pal beek ṭheh hai ruangah a neihmi zate cu rang ralkap sawmnga, rangleng pahra le ke ralkap thawnghra lawng an si."},"8":{"text":"Jehoahaz hnaṭuanmi dangdang le ralṭha zetih a tuahmi pawl cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"9":{"text":"A thi ih Samaria ah an phum. Cule a fapa Jehoash in a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan."},"10":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Joash in Judah ram a uk kum sawmthum le kum sarihnak ah Jehoahaz fapa Jehoash cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria in kum hleiruk sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Jehoash"},"11":{"text":"Anih khal Israel a hruai sualtu siangpahrang Jeroboam ih sualnak cu a tuah ve ih Bawipa ih parah a sual a si."},"12":{"text":"Jehoash hnaṭuannak hmuahhmuah Judah siangpahrang Amaziah thawn an do awk laiah ralṭha zetih a donak pawl cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"13":{"text":"Jehoash cu a thi ih Samaria khua, siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Cule a fapa Jeroboam pahnihnak in a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan."},"14":{"text":"Profet Elisha cu besia zetin a na ih a thih zik zawng ah Israel siangpahrang Jehoash in a va veh. “Maw ka pa, maw ka pa; rangleng le rang ralkap bangin Israel hum theitu!” tiah ṭah phah in a ti.","title":"Elisha A Thi"},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha in, “Li le thal pawl va la aw,” a ti. A tivek cun Jehoash in a lak ih,"},"16":{"text":"Elisha in “Sai aw,” a ti ih siangpahrang in a sai tum tikah Elisha in a kut cu siangpahrang ih kut parah a vun ret."},"17":{"text":"Cule profet ih fial vekin siangpahrang cun Siria lamih a ummi sangkate a vun ong. “Na thal cu sai thlang aw,” tiah Elisha cun a ti. Siangpahrang in thal a vun sai vete in profet cun, “Nangmah hi Bawipa ih thal na si ih nangmah hmangin Siria cu a neh ding. Siria pawl cu Afek an timi hmun ah na do ding ih na neh hai ding,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun Elisha in siangpahrang cu, “Na thal dang pawl la awla leilung ah sai aw,” a ti. A tivek cun siangpahrang in leilung cu voi thum a sai."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Elisha cu a thin a heng ih, “Voi nga, voi ruk tluk sai cila Siria pawl na neh lanta ding naón! Atu cu voithum tiang lawng na neh ding a si,” tiah siangpahrang cu a ti."},"20":{"text":"Elisha cu a thi ih an phum. Kumtinte Moab mi, a burbur ih ummi damiah pawl in Israel ram cu an ram ṭheu."},"21":{"text":"Voi khat cu mithi an phum laiah cubangtuk damiah bur khat an hmu. Mithi phumtu pawl in an miruak cu Elisha ih thlaan sungah an hlonta ih an tlan. Cule miruak le Elisha ih ruh pawl an dai awk vete in mithi cu a nungsal ih a hung ding."},"22":{"text":"Jehoahaz in Israel ram a uk sung hmuahhmuah ah Siria siangpahrang Hazael in Israel mi pawl cu siava zetin a hrem.","title":"Israel Le Siria An Do Aw"},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa cu Israel parah zaangfahnak le lainatnak a nei ih an zawn a ruat; an siat thluh ding cu a siang lo; Abraham, Isaak le Jakob hnenih a thukamnak ruangah Israel mi pawl a bawm ringring. A minung pawl a hngilh dah lo."},"24":{"text":"Siria siangpahrang Hazael a thih tikah a fapa Benhadad siangpahrang a cang."},"25":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang Jehoash in Benhadad cu voithum tiang a neh ih Jehoash ih pa Jehoahaz siangpahrang a si lai ih Benhadad in a rak lakmi khawpi pawl cu a long sal ṭheh a si."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoahaz fapa Jehoash in Israel siangpahrang a ṭuan, a kum hnihnak ah Joash fapa Amaziah cu Judah siangpahrang a cang.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Amaziah (2 San. 25.1-24)"},"2":{"text":"Amah cu kum kul hluannga a si. Jerusalem in kum kul hluankua sung ram a uk. A nu cu Jerusalem khua mi Jehoaddin a si."},"3":{"text":"Amaziah in Bawipa ih duhzawng a tuah; asinain a hlanih siangpahrang David bangtuk cu a si lo. A pa Joash vekin a tuah."},"4":{"text":"Khawvel mi pawl ih khawzing biaknak pawl a bal lo ruangah mi tampi in thawinak an pek ih rimhmui an ur thotho."},"5":{"text":"Amaziah in hngetzet ih ram a hun uk thei tikah a pa, siangpahrang a thattu bawi pawl cu a that hai."},"6":{"text":"Asinain an faale pawl cu a that hai lo; Moses Thukham sungih Bawipa ih thupekmi, “An faale pawl sual ruangah an nu le an pa thah an si lo pei; nu le pa sual ruangah an faale pawl thah an si lo pei; amah ih sualnak ruang lawngah minung cu thah a si pei,” timi kha a thlun sawn."},"7":{"text":"Cun Amaziah in Tipi Thi thlanglam ih Cite Phairawn an timi ah Edom ralkap thawnghra a that. Sela khua a lak ih Joktheel ti ah a hmin a thleng. Tuihsun tiang cutiin an ko."},"8":{"text":"Cule Amaziah in Israel siangpahrang Jehoash hnenah, “Do awk ka lo zuam a si,” tiah thu a cah."},"9":{"text":"Asinain siangpahrang Jehoash in, “Voikhat ah Lebanon tlang ah, hlingbur pakhat in Sidar thing hnenah thu a cah ih, “Ka fapa hrangah na fanu i pe aw,” a ti. Sahrang pakhat a kiangin a ra ih hlingbur cu a pal kiak thluh a si."},"10":{"text":"Atu-ah Edom mi na neh ruangah na puarthau ih na hngalzet. Na mi nehnak parah na lungkim awla daitein um meen aw. Nangmah le na minung pawl hrangih siatsuahnak a si dingmi thil hi ziangah so na tokhrok rero?” tiah thu a khirh sal."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Amaziah in cuih thu cu a ngai duh lo. Curuangah siangpahrang Jehoash cu a ralkap pawl thawn an feh ih Judah ram Beth Shemesh an timi hmunah siangpahrang Amaziah thawn an do aw."},"12":{"text":"Amaziah ralkap pawl cu an sung ih an inn ah an tlan ṭheh."},"13":{"text":"Jehoash in Amaziah cu a kai ih a khawpi Jerusalem khal a lak; khawpi kulhnak lungdawl cu Efraim Kotka in Khawkil Kotka tiang, kaih zahnih sung, a bal ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"A hmuhmi sui le ngun hmuahhmuah, Biakinn thilri le siangpahrang inn ih paisa le hlawnthil hmuahhmuah a lak ih Samaria ah a phur ṭheh. Ral kaihmi tampi tla a hruai."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jehoash ih thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah, ralṭha zetih Judah siangpahrang Amaziah a donak pawl thawn, Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu ah an ngan ṭheh a si."},"16":{"text":"Jehoash cu a thi ih Samaria ih siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Cule a fapa Jeroboam pahnihnak in a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan."},"17":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Jehoash a thih hnuah Judah siangpahrang Amaziah cu kum hleinga a rung nung.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Amaziah A Thi (2 San. 25.25-28)"},"18":{"text":"Amaziah ih hnaṭuan mi hmuahhmuah cu Judah Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem khua sungah Amaziah thah dingih an phiar ruangah Amaziah cu Lakhish ah a tlan; asinain a phiartu pawl cun an thlun ih cutawkah an that."},"20":{"text":"A ruak cu rang in Jerusalem ah an phur ih David khawpi, siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum."},"21":{"text":"Cule Judah mi pawl in Amaziah ih fapa, kum hleiruk a timi Uzziah cu a ai ah siangpahrang ah an tuah."},"22":{"text":"A pa a thih hnuah Elath khua a la saaltu le a din saaltu cu amah Uzziah a si."},"23":{"text":"Joash fapa, siangpahrang Amaziah in Judah ram kum hleinga a uk kumah Jehoash ih fapa Jeroboam pahnihnak cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria in Israel ram cu kum sawm li le kum khat sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Jeroboam Pahnihnak"},"24":{"text":"A hlanih Judah siangpahrang a rak ṭuantu, Israel a hruaisualtu, Nebat ih fapa Jeroboam ih tuahmi thil ṭha lo a thlun ve ruangah Bawipa ih parah a sual a si."},"25":{"text":"Israel ram a rak si dahmi, saklam ah Hamath tlangkawn in thlanglam ah Tipi Thi tiang a lak sal ṭheh. Hi a lakmi cu Gath Hefer khua ih Amittai fapa profet Jonah hnen ihsin Bawipa , Israel Pathian ih pekmi thukam kimternak a si."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi pawl, sal siseh miluat siseh, an zate ih an zonzaihnak le an tuarnak cu a hmu ṭheh; asinain zohman bawmtu an nei lo."},"27":{"text":"Israel siatsuah tata ding cu Bawipa ih duhmi a si lo ruangah siangpahrang Jeroboam pahnihnak hmangin Israel cu a hum a si."},"28":{"text":"Jeroboam ih thil tuahmi dang hmuahhmuah, ralṭha zetih ral a donak le Damaskas le Hamath a lak sal thu pawl cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"29":{"text":"Jeroboam pahnihnak cu a thi ih siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum; cule a fapa Zekhariah in a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Jeroboam pahnihnak in Israel ram a uknak kum kul hluansarih kum ah Amaziah ih fapa Uzziah cu,","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Uzziah (2 San. 26.1-23)"},"2":{"text":"kum hleiruk a ti ah Judah siangpahrang a cang. Jerusalem khua in Judah ram cu kum sawmnga le kum hnih sung a uk. A nu cu Jerusalem khuami Jekoliah a si."},"3":{"text":"Uzziah in a pa bangtuk in Bawipa ih duhzawng a tuah."},"4":{"text":"Asinain khawvel pawl ih an khawzing biaknak pawl a siatsuah lo ruangah mi tampi in cutawkah rai an thawi ih rimhmui urnak an pek."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Uzziah parah phaarnat a thlenter ih a nun sung phaarnat a nei tata. A hnaṭuanmi hmuahhmuah mi dangin an sawng ih amah ih inn ah hlimphir in a um; a fapa Jotham in ram pumpi hrangih hnaṭuan cu a ṭuan."},"6":{"text":"Uzziah ih hnaṭuanmi a dang pawl cu Judah Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan."},"7":{"text":"Uzziah cu a thi ih Jerusalem David khawpi, siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang Uzziah in Judah ram a uknak kum sawmthum le kum riat kum ah Jeroboam pahnihnak ih fapa Zekhariah cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Israel ram cu Samaria khua in thla ruk sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Zekhariah"},"9":{"text":"Nebat fapa, Israel a hruai sualtu, siangpahrang Jeroboam sualnak a thlun ve ruangah a hlanih siangpahrang a ṭuantu pawl vek thotho in Bawipa ih parah sualnak a tuah."},"10":{"text":"Jabesh fapa Shallum in siangpahrang Zekhariah cu phiar tahrat in Ibleam ah a that ih a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan."},"11":{"text":"Zekhariah ih hnaṭuanmi a dangdang pawl cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan."},"12":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa in siangpahrang Jehu hnenah thu a kam ih, “Na tesinfa pawl lakin san linak tiang Israel siangpahrang an ṭuan ding,” a timi cu a kim a si."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang Uzziah in Judah ram a uknak kum sawmthum le kum kua kumah Jabesh fapa Shallum cu Israel siangpahrang ah a cang ih Samaria khua in thla khat sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Shallum"},"14":{"text":"Gadi fapa Menahem cu Tirzah in Samaria ah a feh ih siangpahrang Shulam a thah hnuah a ai ah siangpahrang a cang."},"15":{"text":"Shallum ih hnaṭuanmi a dang pawl, mi a phiarnak thuhla pawl thawn, Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan."},"16":{"text":"Menahem cu Tirzah ihsin Samaria lamih a feh laiah, Tappuah khawpi in a kotka a rak on duh lo ruangah cuih khua cu a siatbal thluh; khawsungmi pawl a that thluh ih a kiangkap khawte pawl tla a siatsuah ṭheh. Favun nunau hmuahhmuah tiangin a zaithlek thluh hai a si."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang Uzziah in Judah ram a uknak kum sawmthum le kum kua kumah Gadi ih fapa Menahem cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria khua in kum hra sung a uk."},"18":{"text":"Nebat fapa, a thih tiangih Israel a hruai sualtu, siangpahrang Jeroboam ih sualnak cu Menahem in a thlun ve ih Bawipa ih parah sualnak a tuah a si."},"19":{"text":"Cule Assiria siangpahrang Tiglath Pileser in Israel ram a do ih Assiria siangpahrang kut thuai ih Israel siangpahrang a ṭuan thei thothonak dingah Tiglath Pileser hnenah ngun tangka a phurh in phurh thawngkhat a pek."},"20":{"text":"Israel ram sungih mi neinung deuhdeuh hnen ihsin mi pakhat ah ngun tangka sawmnga ciar siah a lak. Cuticun Tiglath Pileser cu a ram ah a kir sal."},"21":{"text":"Menahem ih hnaṭuanmi dangdang cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Menahem"},"22":{"text":"Menahem cu a thi ih an phum. Cule a fapa Pekahiah in a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan."},"23":{"text":"Siangpahrang Uzziah in Judah ram a uknak kum sawmnga kumah Menahem ih fapa Pekahiah cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria khua in kum hnih sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Pekahiah"},"24":{"text":"Nebat fapa, Israel a hruai sualtu, siangpahrang Jeroboam ih sualnak a thlun ruangah Bawipa ih parah sualnak a tuah."},"25":{"text":"Pekahiah ralkap sungih ralbawi pakhat, Remaliah ih fapa Pekah in, Gilead mi minung sawmnga thawn Pekahiah a phiar ih Samaria khua, siangpahrang inn sungtabik khaan ah Argob le Areih thawn a that ih a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan."},"26":{"text":"Pekahiah ih hnaṭuanmi dangdang cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan."},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang Uzziah in Judah ram a uknak kum sawmnga le kum hnihnak ah Remaliah ih fapa Pekah cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria khua in Israel ram kum kul sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Pekah"},"28":{"text":"Israel a hruai sualtu, Nebat fapa siangpahrang Jeroboam ih sualnak a thlun ve ruangah Bawipa ih mithmuh ah sualnak a tuah a si."},"29":{"text":"Pekah in Israel siangpahrang a ṭuan laiah hin Assiria siangpahrang Tiglath Pileser in Ijon, Abel Beth Maakah, Janoah, Kadesh le Hazor khawpi pawl a lak. Gilead ram, Galilee ram le Naftali ram pawl khal a lak ṭheh ih cuih ram mi tampi Assiria ah salah a hruai hai."},"30":{"text":"Uzziah fapa Jotham in Judah siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum kulnak kumah Elah ih fapa Hoshea in siangpahrang Pekah cu a phiar ih a that; cule a ai ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"31":{"text":"Pekah ih hnaṭuanmi dangdang cu Israel Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan."},"32":{"text":"Remaliah ih fapa Pekah in Israel ram a uk kum hnihnak kumah Uzziah fapa Jotham cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jotham (2 San. 27.1-9)"},"33":{"text":"Amah cu siangpahrang a ṭuan ah kum kul hluannga a ti ih Jerusalem ihsin kum hleiruk sung a uk. A nu cu Zadok ih fanu Jerusha a si."},"34":{"text":"Jotham cun a pa Uzziah ih dungthlun in Bawipa ih duh zawng a tuah."},"35":{"text":"Asinain khawvelmi pawl ih khawzing biaknak pawl a siatsuah lo ih mi tampi in cutawkah rai an thawi ih rimhmui an ur ringring. Bawipa ih Biakinn ih Saklam Kotka a tuahtu cu amah Jotham a si."},"36":{"text":"Jotham ih thil tuahmi dangdang cu Judah Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"37":{"text":"Jotham in Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan laiah Bawipa in Siria siangpahrang Rezin le Israel siangpahrang Pekah cu Judah do dingin a thlah."},"38":{"text":"Jotham cu a thi ih Jerusalem khua, David khawpi siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Cule a fapa Ahaz in a ai ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Remaliah ih fapa Pekah in Israel ram a uk kum hleisarih kumah Jotham ih fapa Ahaz cu Judah siangpahrang a cang.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Ahaz (2 San. 28.1-27)"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang a ṭuan ah Ahaz cu kum kul a si ih Jerusalem in Judah ram cu kum hleiruk sung a uk. A pu David ih tuahmi thilṭha pawl cu a tuah lo; Bawipa a Pathian ih duh lo zawng a tuah ih,"},"3":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang dang pawl ih dung a thlun. Israel mi pawl Kanaan ram an luh laiah Kanaan ramih a rak ummi, Bawipa ih a dawihlomi pawl ih tuahmi thil fihnungza pawl a tuah ve. Amah ih fapa rori hman milem hnenah mei-ur thawinak ah a pek."},"4":{"text":"Tlangzim parah le thingpi niim hnuai kipih khawvel mi pawl khawzing biaknak hmun kipah Ahaz cun rai a thawi ih rimhmui a ur vivo."},"5":{"text":"Siria siangpahrang Rezin le Israel siangpahrang Pekah in Jerusalem khua an do ih an kulh ṭheh; asinain Ahaz cu an neh thei lo."},"6":{"text":"Culai ah Edom siangpahrang in Elath khawpi a lak sal ih cutawkih a ummi Judah mi pawl cu a dawi thluh. Elath khua ah Edom mi an um ih tuihsan tiangin an um lai a si."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Ahaz in Assiria siangpahrang Tiglat Pileser hnen ah thu a cah ih, “Kei cu a lo riantu na siahhlawh le na fapa ka si. Siria siangpahrang le Israel siangpahrang in in do ruangah in ra run hram aw,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Ahaz in Biakinn ih sui le ngun le siangpahrang inn ih sui le ngun pawl a lak ih Assiria siangpahrang hnenah laksawng ah a kuat."},"9":{"text":"Ahaz ih dil vekin Tiglath Pileser cu a ralkap pawl thawn an pok ih Damaskas a do ih a lak; Siangpahrang Rezin cu a thah ih khawsung mi pawl cu Kir khua ah salah a hruai hai."},"10":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Ahaz cu siangpahrang Tiglath Pileser tong ding in Damaskas khua ih a feh tikah cutawkah biakṭheng a hmu ih cumi vek cekci ih don dingah a ruangrai zingmi pawl kimtein puithiam Uriah hnenah a kuat."},"11":{"text":"Cumi ruangrai vek cun Uriah in biakṭheng pakhat a dawl ih Ahaz a kir sal hlanah a ṭheh thluh."},"12":{"text":"Ahaz cu Damaskas ihsin a rung kir tikah biakṭheng an ṭheh zo ti a hmu ih,"},"13":{"text":"a parah cun thawinakih pekmi ṭilva pawl a ur ih sangphut thawinak pawl tla a pek; cuih tlunah inding thawinakih pekmi sabitti in a toih ih remnak thawinakih pekmi sathi a theh."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa ih hrangih thiantermi, darih tuahmi biakṭheng cu biakṭheng thar le Biakinn karlakah a ummi a si ih cumi cu biakṭheng tharih saklam ah a ṭhawn."},"15":{"text":"Cule Uriah cu, “Hi ka biakṭheng tumpi cu zinglam mei-ur thawinak le zanlam sangphut thawinak ah hmang awla, siangpahrang le misenpi pawl ih mei-ur thawinak le sangphut thawinak hrangah hmang aw; misenpi ih pekmi inding thawinak hrang tla ah a si ding. Thawinak ih pekmi ṭilva hmuahhmuahih sathi cu a parah toih aw. Asinain dar biakṭheng cu keimah ih hrang lawngah a si pei ih tinzohnak ah ka hmang ding,” tiah thu a pek."},"16":{"text":"Uriah cun siangpahrang ih thupekmi vekin a tuah ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Ahaz in Biakinn sungih ummi lengke pawl a bal ih a parih ummi maihum pawl a lak; cule dar cawcang hleihnih dunglam ih ummi dar tikuang a lak ih lungpher phahmi parah a ret."},"18":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Assiria siangpahrang lungawiternak dingah Ahaz cun Biakinn sungih ummi siangpahrang tokham retnak donhleisang cu a lak hlo ih Biakinn sungih siangpahrang luhnak lamzin cu a phit ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahaz ih hnaṭuan mi dangdang cu Judah Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan."},"20":{"text":"Ahaz cu a thi ih Jerusalem, David khawpiih siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Cule a fapa Hezekiah in a ai ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahaz in Judah ram a uknak kum hleihnih kumah Elah ih fapa Hoshea cu Israel siangpahrang a cang ih Samaria khua ihsin Israel ram kum kua sung a uk.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Hoshea"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih parah sualnak a tuah; asinain a hlanih Israel a uktu siangpahrang pawl tluk cun a sual lo."},"3":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang Shalmaneser in a do ih Hoshea a sun ruangah kumtinte in Shalmaneser hnenah siah a pek."},"4":{"text":"Asinain voikhat cu Hoshea in Izipt siangpahrang So hnenah mi thlah in bomnak a dil ih kum dang vekin Assiria siangpahrang hnenah siah a pe lo. Cumi cu Shalmaneser in a theih tikah Hoshea cu a kai ih thawngah a thlak."},"5":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang Shalmaneser in Israel ram a do ih Samaria khawpi a kulh ṭheh. Kum thum sung a kulh ih a kum thumnak,","title":"Samaria An Lak"},"6":{"text":"Hoshea in Israel ram a uknak kum kua-nakah Assiria siangpahrang in Samaria khawpi cu a lak. Israel mi pawl cu Assiria ah salah a hruai hai; a hrekkhat cu Halah khua ah a umter, a hrek cu Gozan peng Habor Tiva kiangah a umter ih a hrek cu Media ih khawpi pawl ah a umter hai."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Izipt siangpahrang kut sungin a runsuaktu le Izipt ram in a hruaisuaktu Bawipa an Pathian parih an sual ruangah Samaria khawpi cu ral pawl in an lak a si. Khawzing dang pawl an biak ih,"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa ih a dawihlomi miphun pawl ih daan an thlun ih Bawipa ih duh lomi, Israel siangpahrang pawl ih tuahcopmi daan an thlun."},"9":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Bawipa an Pathian ih lungkim lomi thil tampi an tuah. An khawtin ah khawfate in khawtum bik tiang khawvel mi pawl ih khawzing biaknak biakinn pawl an sak ih,"},"10":{"text":"tlangzim kip le thingpi niim hnuai kipah an khawzing lungphun an phun ih Asherah khawzingnu ih lem an ret."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa ih a dawihlomi miphun pawl ih thiltuah daan cawngin khawzing biaknak biakṭheng parah rimhmui an ur. An thiltuahmi a siatvaat tuk ruangah Bawipa ih thin an hengter;"},"12":{"text":"milem nan biak lo pei, tiih Bawipa ih thukham pawl cu an siatbal ṭheh."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi le Judah mi pawl hnenah a palai pawl le profet pawl a thlah ih, “Thil ṭha lo nan tuahmi taanta uhla nan pipu hnenah ka phuanmi le ka palai profet pawl hmangin nan hnenih ka lo pekmi ka thukham le ka Daan pawl cu thlun uh,” tiah ralrinnak voi tampi a pek."},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an ngai duh lo; Bawipa an Pathian a rak rinsan lotu an pupa pawl vekin an thinlung cu a ruh."},"15":{"text":"A thupekmi pawl an thlun duh lo; an pupa pawl thawn thukamnak a tuahmi an hngetter lo ih a ralrinnak pekmi zianghman ah an siar lo. A ṭhahnem lomi milem pawl an biak ih mi ṭhahnem lo ah an cang. An kiangkapih ummi miphun pawl ih thiltuah daan pawl an cawng ih, “Nan cawng lo pei,” tiih Bawipa ih thupek an el."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa an Pathian ih pekmi Daan hmuahhmuah an balsiat ṭheh ih daar ih tuahmi cawcang pahnih an biak. Cuih tlunah khawzingnu Asherah ih lem an tuah, arsi an biak ih Baal khawzing an rian."},"17":{"text":"Khawvel pawl ih khawzing hnenah an fanu le an fapa pawl mei-ur thawinak ah an pek; pol pawl le kutṭial zohthiam pawl an leeng ih Bawipa hmaiih thil ṭha lo an theihmi hmuahhmuah kimtein an tuah. Curuangah Bawipa ih thin an hengter a si."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa cu Israel mi parah a thin a heng ih a hmuh lonak ramah a dawihlo hai a si; curuangah Judah ram lawng a zuah."},"19":{"text":"Asinain Judah mi pawl tla in Bawipa an Pathian ih thupekmi an thlun lo; Israel mi ih thiltuah daan an zir ve."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi pawl cu a hnong, a hrem ih mi zaangfah nei lo an ral pawl ih kutah a pek hai; neta bikah a hmuh lonak ramah a dawihlo hai a si."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel ram cu Judah ram ihsin a ṭhensuak tikah Nebat fapa Jeroboam cu Israel mi pawl in an siangpahrang ah an tuah. Jeroboam ruangah an Bawipa cu an tlansan ih tuksumza sualnak sungah a hruailut hai a si."},"22":{"text":"Jeroboam an thlun ih sualnak a tuahmi cu an tuah ve ringring;"},"23":{"text":"neta bikah, profet a sal pawl hnenin, “Ka tuah ding,” tiih ralrinnak a pek vekin, a hmuh lonak hmunah a dawihlo hai a si. Cuticun Israel mi pawl cu Assiria ramah hruai ṭheh an si ih atu khalah cutawkah an um lai."},"24":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang in Babilon, Kuth, Ivvah, Hamath, le Sefarvaim khawsungmi pawl a suahter hai ih thawngih a thlakmi Israel mi pawl ai-ah Samaria ram khawpi pawl ahcun a umter hai. Cuih khawpi pawl cu an luah ih an um.","title":"Israel Ram Ah Assiria Mi An Um"},"25":{"text":"An um pek ahcun Bawipa an bia duh lo; curuangah Bawipa in kiosa pawl a thlah ih minung tawkfang an deh."},"26":{"text":"Cumi thu cu Assiria siangpahrang an sim ih Samaria khawpi pawl sungih a umtermi pawl in cuih ram khawzing ih daan an theih lo ruangah an khawzing in kiosa a thlah ih a deh hai a si, tiah a thei."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah Assiria siangpahrang in, “Thawng ih kan thlakmi an puithiam lakih pakhat cu kuat kir uh; kir in vung um sehla cuih ram khawzing ih daan cu cuih khawsungih mi pawl hnenah zirh seh,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Curuangah Samaria in an rak hruai ih Assiria ramih thawng an thlak mi puithiam pakhat cu an fehter ih Bethel ah a um; cutawkah cun Bawipa biak daan pawl a zirh."},"29":{"text":"Asinain Samaria ih a ummi pawl cun an rak biakmi khawzing lem cu an tuah cio ih Israel mi pawl ih an rak sakmi khawzing biakinn sungah cun an ret. An umnak ciar khawpi sungah cun an hrin ciar in milem an tuah;"},"30":{"text":"Babilon mi pawl in an khawzing Sukkoth Benoth lem an tuah; Kuth mi pawl in an khawzing Nergal lem an tuah; Hamath mi pawl in an khawzing Ashima lem an tuah;"},"31":{"text":"Ivvah mi pawl in an khawzing Nibhaz le Tartak lem an tuah; Sefarvaim mi pawl in an khawzing Adrammelek le Anammelek pawl hnenah an faale pawl cu mei-ur thawinak ah an pek."},"32":{"text":"Annih in Bawipa tla an bia ve thotho ih an khawvel khawzing biaknak hmunih puithiam ṭuantu dingah le an hrangih thawinak petu dingah anmah lakih sin miphun dangdang an hril."},"33":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa biak le anmah ih khawzing ciar biak cu an ceem; an rak ratnak khua le ramih thiltuah daan cu an thlun thotho."},"34":{"text":"Tuihsun tiangah hin cuih an thiltuah daan hlun cu an thlun lai. Bawipa cu an bia nawn lo; Bawipa in Jakob tesinfa pawl Israel tiih a kawhmi hnenih a pekmi daan le thukham pawl tla an thlun lo."},"35":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi thawn thukamnak a rak tuah tikah an hnenah, “Khawzing dangdang nan bia lo pei; an hmaiah nan kuun lo pei ih nan rian lo pei; thawinak tla nan pe lo pei."},"36":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin huham le baan thacak thawn a lo suahtu Bawipa keimah lawng hi in ṭihzah pei. Keimah hnenah thawinak pawl nan pek pei ih ka hmaiah nan kuun pei."},"37":{"text":"Nan hrangih ka nganmi daan le thukham hmuahhmuah nan thlun ringring pei. Khawzing dang pawl ih thu nan thlun lo pei;"},"38":{"text":"nanmah thawn ka tuahmi thukam cu nan hngilh lo pei."},"39":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian keimah cu in ṭihzah pei ih nan ral pawl ih kut sung ihsin ka lo runsuak hai ding,” tiah thu a rak pek."},"40":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hi miphun pawl cun an ngai lo; an thiltuah daan hlun sawn an thlun ringring."},"41":{"text":"Cuticun hi miphun pawl in Bawipa biak le an milem pawl biak cu an ceem; tuihsun tiangin an tesinfa pawl in cuticun an tuah ringring a si."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elah ih fapa siangpahrang Hoshea in Israel ram a uk kum thumnak ah Ahaz ih fapa Hezekiah cu Judah siangpahrang a cang.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Hezekiah (2 San. 29.1-2 ; 31.1)"},"2":{"text":"Amah cu kum kul hluannga a ti ah siangpahrang a ṭuan ih Jerusalem in Judah ram cu kum kul hluankua sung a uk. A nu cu Zekhariah ih fanu Abijah a si."},"3":{"text":"Amah cu a pu David dungthlun in Bawipa ih duhzawng a tuah."},"4":{"text":"Khawvel mi ih khawzing biaknak hmun pawl a siatsuah ṭheh ih an lungphun thianghlim pawl a khuai ṭheh; khawzingnu Asherah hrangih an phun mi thamzarh ṭhuam pawl tla a hau ṭheh. Moses ih a rak tuahmi dar rul Nehustan tiih an kawhmi, cuihsan tiang Israel mi pawl in upatnak thawn a hmaiih rimhmui an urmi cu, a khuai seksek thluh."},"5":{"text":"Hezekiah in Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian cu a rinsan a si. A hlanah siseh, a hnu khalah siseh, Judah siangpahrang lakah Hezekiah bangtu siangpahrang zohman an um lo."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah rintlak a si ih a thu a el dah lo; Moses hnenih Bawipa ih thupekmi hmuahhmuah felzetin a thlun."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa cu a hnenah a um ih a thiltuahmi hmuahhmuah ah a hlawhtling a si. Assiria siangpahrang tla a do ih siah peknak in a luat."},"8":{"text":"Filistin mi a neh ih an khua le ram pawl cu khawfate bik ihsin khawpi bik tiang, Gaza le a kiangkap khua pawl tla a ram ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Hezekiah in Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan kum linak, le Hoshea in Israel siangpahrang a ṭuan kum sarih kumah Assiria siangpahrang Shalmaneser in Israel ram cu a do ih Samaria khawpi cu a kulh ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Kum thum sung a kulh hnuah Samaria cu a lak. Himi cu Hezekiah in Judah ram a uk kum ruknak le Hoshea in Israel ram a uk kum kuanak ah a si."},"11":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang in Israel mi pawl cu Assiria ramah a hruai hai ih a hrek cu Halah khua, a hrek cu Gozan peng Habor Tiva kiangkap le a hrek cu Media khawpi pawl ah a umter."},"12":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Bawipa an Pathian ih thupekmi an ngai lo ruangah Samaria cu Assiria mi in an lak a si. Bawipa salpa Moses hnen ihsin Israel mi thawn Bawipa ih thukamnak a tuahmi cu an siatbal thluh ih an thlun duh lo. A thu an ngai lo ih a thukam khal an thlun lo."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah in Judah ram a uk kum hleilinak ah Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib in Judah ram sungah ralhruang ih kulhmi khawpi pawl a do ih tampi a lak.","title":"Assiria Ralkap In Jerusalem An Kulh (2 San. 32.1-19 ; Isai 36.1-22)"},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Hezekiah in Sennakherib hnenah, Lakhish ih a um laiah mi a thlah ih, “Ka mawh a si; i do nawn hlah aw; i ngenmi hmuahhmuah ka lo pe thluh ding,” tiah a ti. Assiria siangpahrang in thu a run khirh ih a ngenmi cu ngun tangka a phurh in phurh zahnih le sawmnga le sui phurh kul hluannga a si."},"15":{"text":"Hezekiah in Bawipa ih Biakinn sungih ngun tangka hmuahhmuah le siangpahrang inn ih ngun tangka pawl a kuat;"},"16":{"text":"Biakinn sangka sui ih khuutmi le Hezekiah amah rori in sangka ṭhuam pawl sui in a khuutmi ih sui pawl cu a lak ih Sennakherib a kuat."},"17":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang cun Lakhish ihsin Jerusalem ih ummi Hezekiah do dingah ralkap tampi a run thlah ṭhiamṭhiam. Cuih ralkap pawl cu a kuthnuai ih bawi tumbik pathum in an ho. Jerusalem khua cu an thleng ih Tlunta Tili ihsin tidai rung luannak horkuam kiang, hnipuan taktu pawl umnak lamzin ah an um."},"18":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Hezekiah cu an ko ih anih in a kuthnuai bawi pathum - siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl hotu Hilkiah ih fapa Eliakim, siangpahrang zungih sungṭuan Shebna le cazin kaih lamih hotu Asaf ih fapa Joah a thlah."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah Assiria bawi pakhat in an hnenah, “Ziangah so siangpahrang Hezekiah hi hiti lawmmam ih a rinsan awk tihi kan siangpahrang ih theih duhmi a si!"},"20":{"text":"Raldonak lamih thiamnak le cahnak hi kaa lawngin a ai rawl thei ding, tiah nan zum maw si? Assiria do dingah zo ih ṭanpinak so nan rinsan?"},"21":{"text":"Izipt in in bawm ding nan ti maw? Rinsan duh hlah uh! Nan rinsan asile phaikung kianghrol hmang vek nan si ding - a kiak ding ih nan kut riangri a lo aat hai ding. A rinsantu hrangah Izipt cu cuti ringring a si ko."},"22":{"text":"“Asilo talle, ‘ Bawipa kan Pathian kan rinsan a si,’ in ti ding maw? Nan siangpahrang Hezekiah amah a si lo maw, Bawipa ih biakinn pawl le biakṭheng pawl cu a siatbal thluh ih Jerusalem ih biakṭheng lawngah Pathian nan biak ding, tiah Judah mi le Jerusalem khawsungmi pawl a titu cu?"},"23":{"text":"Nan ngam ngai maw? Assiria siangpahrang hmin in ka lo zuam hai a si: rang to theitu milai thawnghnih nan um a si ahcun rang thawnghnih ka lo pe thei hai ding!"},"24":{"text":"Assiria ralkap sungih ralbawi nauta bik hman nan tluk loih nannih cun Izipt mi pawl in rangleng le rang ralkap pawl in kuat hai sehla, nan hei ti."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa ih bomnak tel loin nan ram hi kan do ih kan siatsuah ah maw si nan ruat? Thungai ih ti ahcun, Bawipa amah rori in nan ram hi do ding le siatsuah dingah thu i pek sokhaw,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Eliakim, Shebna le Joah cun Siria bawi hnenah, “Bawipa, kannih hnenah cun Aramaik ṭong in ṭong aw. Kan thei ko a si. Hebru ṭong cun ṭong hlah aw; khawpi kulhnak lungdawl parih minung pawl in in ngai a si,” an ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule anih in, “Siangpahrang in i thlah tikah, hipawl hi nanmah le nan siangpahrang hnen lawngih ṭong dingah i thlah ah maw si nan ruat? Asilo sokhaw! Nanmah le ralhruang parih a tomi, mah ih eek a ei ding le mah ih zun a in dingmi pawl, nan zate hnenih ṭong dingah a si i thlah,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cule ding tahratin Hebru ṭong in, “Maw milai pawl, Assiria siangpahrang ih a lo simmi hi ngai uh!"},"29":{"text":"Hezekiah hin lo bum rero hlah seh, tiah ralrinnak a lo pe a si. Hezekiah cun a lo run thei hrimhrim lo ding."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa rinsan dingih a lo simmi tla hi zum hlah uh. Bawipa cun in run dingih Assiria ralkap pawl in kan khawpi cu an la lo ding, tiah ruat duh hlah uh."},"31":{"text":"Hezekiah ih thu cu ngai hlah uh. Assiria siangpahrang in thu a lo pek hai a si: khawpi sungin rasuak uhla remnak ra tuah uh. Assiria siangpahrang in nanmah ih ram a bangmi ram sungah, sabit ngahnak dingah sabit hri a umnak, sang tuahnak dingah fang a umnak, olif umnak le olif hriak le khuaitizu umnak ram sungih a lo umter hlan lo cu,"},"32":{"text":"nanmah ih sabit hri in sabit rah nan ei ding, nanmah ih theipi kung in theipi nan ei ding ih nanmah ih tikhur in tidai nan in ko ding. Bawipa in in hum ding, tiah Hezekiah hin lo bum rero hlah seh."},"33":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang ih neh lo dingin khawzingih a runsuakmi mi phun dang pawl an um maw? I sim hnik uh!"},"34":{"text":"Khuiah so Hamath khawzing le Arpad khawzing pawl an si ṭheh? Khuiah so Sefarvaim khawzing, Hena khawzing le Ivvah khawzing pawl an hlohral ṭheh? Zotal in Samaria khawpi an hum thei maw?"},"35":{"text":"Ziangtik ah so hi ram pawl hi an khawzing pawl in an hum ih Assiria siangpahrang kut in an luat, ti nan theih dah? Jerusalem cu Bawipa in a hum ding, tiah ziangtinso nan zum thei?” tiah a au ciamco."},"36":{"text":"Misenpi pawl cu an dai khepkhep! Siangpahrang Hezekiah ih a sim hai vekin zohman in zianghman an ṭong lo."},"37":{"text":"Cule Eliakim, Shebna le Joah cu an riahsia in an hnipuan an thlek ih Assiria ralbawi ih ṭong cu siangpahrang hnenih sim dingin an ra."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah in cuih thu a theih vete in a riahsia in a hnipuan a thlek ih buri hnipuan a hruk ih Bawipa ih Biakinn ah a feh.","title":"Hezekiah In Isaiah A Sut (Isai 37.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn kiltu bawi Eliakim, Siangpahrang zungih sungṭuan Shebna le puithiam hotu deuhdeuh pawl cu Amoz ih fapa profet Isaiah hnenah siangpahrang in a thlah hai. A thlahmi pawl tla buri hnipuan an hruk ve."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang in Isaiah hnenah cun, “Tuihsun cu lungphang le thinpit ih kan um sun a si; kawk kan tuar ni a si ih ningzak mualpho ih kan um ni khal a si. Thazaang a neih lo ruangih nau a hring thei nawn lomi nunau kan bang."},"4":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang in a kuthnuai bawi lakih upabik a run thlah ih a nungmi Pathian cu a hmuhsuam ciamco. Bawipa na Pathian in hi hmuhsuamnak ṭongkam hi thei in cutiih a ṭongtu cu run hrem hram seh. A nung hrihmi kan minung pawl hrangah Pathian hnenah thla in cam sak hram aw,” tiah a cah."},"5":{"text":"Isaiah in siangpahrang ih thucahmi a theih tikah,"},"6":{"text":"hiti in thu a khirh: “ Bawipa in, ‘Assiria siangpahrang kuthnuai bawi pawl in an lo hro ih keimah in hmuhsuamnak ṭong ruangah zianghman thinphannak nei hlah."},"7":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang sungah thinlung ka ret ding; cutikah thuvaivuan a thei ding ih a ramah a kir ding; cutawkah amah ih ram sungih ralnam in ka thihter ding,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cuih Assiria bawi in an siangpahrang cu Lakhish a suahsan ih a kiangih ummi Libnah khawpi a do, ti a theih tikah, a kir ih cutawk ahcun amah tong dingin a feh.","title":"Assiria Ih Hronak (Isai 37.8-20)"},"9":{"text":"Cun Assiria siangpahrang in, anmah Assiria ralkap pawl do dingah Izipt ralkap pawl cu Ethiopia Siangpahrang Tirhakah ho in an ra, tiah thu a thei. Cutikah Assiria Siangpahrang in Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah hnenah palai a thlah sal ih,"},"10":{"text":"“Na rinsanmi na Pathian cun ka kut sungih tla lo dingin thu a lo sim, asinain cumi cun lo hnangamter pang hlah seh."},"11":{"text":"Assiria Siangpahrang in ‘Ka siatsuah ding,’ tiih ka ti hnuhnu cu an ram ziangti in a um ṭheu ti cu na theih cia a si ko. Ka luat thei ding, tiah na ruat maw si?"},"12":{"text":"Ka pupa pawl in Gozan, Haran le Rezef khawpi pawl an siatsuah thluh zo ih Telassar ih ummi Betheden mi pawl an that ṭheh; an khawzing zotal in an hum thei ti na thei dah maw?"},"13":{"text":"Atu-ah Hamath, Arpad, Sefarvaim, Hena le Ivvah khawpi ih siangpahrang pawl cu khuiah so an um?” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah in Assiria siangpahrang ih cakuat mi cu a palai pawl ih kut in a lak ih a siar. Cule Bawipa ih Biakinn ah a feh ih Bawipa ih mithmuh ah cuih ca cu a ret ih,"},"15":{"text":"thla a cam: “Maw Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, cherub ih thla tlun sunloihnak bawi tohkham ih a totu, Nangmah lawng Pathian na si ih leilung tlunih peng le ram hmuahhmuah tla a uktu na si. Lei le van hi nangmah ih tuahmi an si."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , atu kan parih a thlengmi thil hi in run hmuhsak hram aw. Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib in a nungmi Pathian nangmah a lo nautatnak ṭongkam hmuahhmuah cu run thei aw."},"17":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Assiria siangpahrang pawl in miphun tampi an siatsuah ih an ram pawl an ṭhingter;"},"18":{"text":"pathian a si lomi an khawzing pawl - khawzing hman si lo, milai kut ih thing le lung tuahcopmi - milem pawl cu an ur ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa kan Pathian, leilung pumpi in Bawipa , nangmah pakhat lawnglawng Pathian taktak na si kha an lo theih theinak dingah Assiria mi pawl ih kut sungin in runsuak hram aw,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule Isaiah in Siangpahrang Hezekiah hnenah thu a cah ih, “ Bawipa in na thlacamnak a thei zo.","title":"Isaiah In Siangpahrang Thu A Cah (Isai 37.21-38)"},"21":{"text":"Assiria Siangpahrang Sennakherib dodal in Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu hiti in a si: ‘Zion ih fala in a lo nautat, Zion fala him in a lo hmuhsuam; Jerusalem fanu in a lu a thing, Dungsiip ih na tlanhlo tikah cun."},"22":{"text":"Na camriam, na hmuhsuam reromi, Zo a si tiah so na ruat? Na auh reromi hi zoso a si? Israel ih Pathian thianghlim, Keimah i hmuhsuam sokhaw na si."},"23":{"text":"Ka hnenih tluangkhawng dingin, na palai na thlah; Ka rangleng pawl thawn tlang sang bik ka neh, Lebanon tlangzim tla ka thleng, Sidar thing saangbik ka hau thei, Mirang farthing ṭha bik tla, Tupi sungih a deng bik hmun ka thleng, Ram netnak phuul tiang, na ti."},"24":{"text":"Hrindangmi ramah tikhur ka lai, Cutawkih tidai ka in, Ka ralkap pawl in Nail Tiva pawl an ke rori in an pal, Car ṭheh in an pal, tiah na porh aw."},"25":{"text":"‘Hitiih na tuahmi hmuahhmuah hi Hlanlaipi in Keimah ih tumcia mi a si, tihi na thei dah lo maw? Atu lawngah ka tuahsuak a si! Ralhruang kulh mi khawpi pawl cu Siatbal thluh theinak ah huham ka lo pek;"},"26":{"text":"Khawsungih ummi minung pawl cu, Thilti theinak an nei riai lo. Ṭihnak le thlaphannak in an khat. Lo sungih a kho mi belh le Inn parih a khomi hrampi vek an si, Thlisia a hran ih a nuai tikah an vuai ṭheh."},"27":{"text":"‘Na thuhla cu a zatein ka thei ṭheh zo, Na tuahmi le na fehnak pawl thawn; Ka parih na thinhenzia pawl thawn Kimtein ka thei ṭheh."},"28":{"text":"Ka hnenih na thinhennak le Ka parih na hngalnak pawl cu, Ka hna an thleng ṭheh. Curuangah na hnar ah sio ka thlaih ding ih, Na kaa ah kakharh ka kharh ding, Cuticun na ratnak lamzin in, Ka lo hruaikir sal ding,’” a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cule Isaiah in Siangpahrang Hezekiah hnenah, “A cang dingmi thil hminsinnakah hiti in a si ding: Tuihkum le hmaikum cu hramlakih a khomi fang nan ei ding. Asinain kum thumnak kum ahcun nanmah in rawlci nan tuh pei ih nanmah in rawl nan lak ding; sabit tla nan ciing pei ih sabit rah nan ei ding."},"30":{"text":"Judah ramah a nung ih a taangsunmi pawl cu a thukpi ah hrihhram a dawt ih rah a rahmi thingkung vek an si ding."},"31":{"text":"Jerusalem le Zion Tlang tla ah a taangmi an um ding; ziangahtile Bawipa in a kimter tengteng ding a si."},"32":{"text":"“Assiria siangpahrang thu ahcun Bawipa in hiti in a ti: ‘Hi khawpi sungah a lut lo ding, Thal pakhat khal a sai lo ding. Ralphaw thawn a ralkap pawl cu, khawpi hmai an ra thleng lo ding. Phardawl lengih raldonak leidawl, khahsilh mi tla an dawl lo ding,"},"33":{"text":"A ratnak lamzin in a kirsal pei, Hi khawpi sungah cun a lut lo pei. Bawipa Keimah in ka phuang zo a si."},"34":{"text":"Hi khawpi cu ka ṭan pei ih ka hum pei, Ka hmin thannak hrangah le Ka salpa David hnenih ka thukam mi ruangah.’” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cuih zan cu Bawipa ih vancungmi pakhat Assiria ralkap pawl ih riahhmun ah a feh ih ralkap thawng zakhat thawng sawmriat le thawngnga a thah. A thaizing zingpit ahcun an zatein an thi ṭheh."},"36":{"text":"Cule Assiria Siangpahrang Sennakherib cu dungah a siip ih Nineveh ah a kir."},"37":{"text":"Voikhat ah a khawzing Nisrok biakinn ih a khawzing a biak laiah a fapa pahnih Adrammelek le Sharezer in an ralnam in an sun that ih cuih hnuah Ararat ramah an tlan. A ai ah a fapa Esarhaddon in siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih ṭumah Siangpahrang Hezekiah cu besia zetin a na. Amoz ih fapa profet Isaiah in a va veh ih a hnenah: “ Bawipa in, ‘Ro na cah duhmi tla cahta aw; ziangahtile na nung lo ding; na thi ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim.","title":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah A Na (Isai 38.1-8 , 21-22 ; 2 San. 32.24-26)"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Hezekiah cu phar lamah a her ih thla a cam,"},"3":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , nangmah ih rinsantlak le thinlung ka neihmi zate thawn na hna ka ṭuan ih na hmaiah a ṭhami lawnglawng ka tuah, ti na thei thluh ko,” a ti ih napi in a ṭap."},"4":{"text":"Isaiah cu a suak ih a feh; asinain siangpahrang inn ih khaan laifang a lan hlanah Bawipa in,"},"5":{"text":"“ Bawipa ih minung pawl uktu Hezekiah hnenah kirsal awla a hnenah, ‘ Bawipa keimah, na pu David ih Pathian in na thlacamnak cu ka thei ih na mitthli cu ka hmu zo. Ka lo damter ding ih ni thum sungah Biakinn ah na feh thei ding."},"6":{"text":"Tuih hnu kum hleinga na nung hrih ding. Nangmah le hi khawpi cu Assiria siangpahrang kut in ka lo runsuak ding. Hi khawpi cu ka hminthannak ah le ka salpa David hnenih ka thukam mi ruangah ka hum ding, a ti,’ va ti aw,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule Isaiah in siangpahrang hnen-um pawl hnenah, “A khuaihli hma ah theipi rah ih tuahmi sii hnih uhla a dam ding,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah cun, “ Bawipa in i damter dingih ni thum sungah Biakinn ah ka feh thei ding, tiih khihhmuhnak cu ziangso a si ding?” tiah a sut."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Isaiah in, “ Bawipa in a thukam mi a kimter ding, ti langternak ah khihhmuhnak a lo pe ding. Phenthla cu hmailam ah karbak pahra ṭhawnter na duh maw, asilole dunglam ih karbak pahra kirter na duh sawn?” tiah a sut."},"10":{"text":"Hezekiah in, “Phenthla hmailam ih kar hra ṭhawn cu a ol deuh ding; dunglam ah kirter aw,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Isaiah in, Bawipa ih hnenah thla a cam ih, Bawipa in phenthla cu Siangpahrang Ahaz ih tuahmi kailawn ih a suh vivo laiah dunglam ah kar hra a kirter a si."},"12":{"text":"Cuih caanah Baladan ih fapa, Babilon Siangpahrang Merodak Baladan in siangpahrang Hezekiah a na, ti a thei ih ca le laksawng a run kuat.","title":"Babilon In Palai An Ra (Isai 39.1-8)"},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Hezekiah cun Babilon ihsin a rami palai pawl cu ṭhazet in a rak zoh hai ih a lennak hmuahhmuah, a sui le a ngun, a rimhmui pawl le a ralkap pawl ih hriamnam pawl tiangin a hmuh thluh hai. A thilri le a thilthuam pawl retnak khaan ta siseh, a ram sungih ummi thilri dangdang siseh, a hmuh lomi zianghman a um lo."},"14":{"text":"Cule profet Isaiah cu Siangpahrang Hezekiah hnenah a feh ih, “Hi milai pawl cu khuitawk inso an rat? Na hnenah ziangso an reel?” tiah a sut. Cutikah Hezekiah in, “Annih cu ram hlapi, Babilon ram in an ra a si,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Isaiah in, “Siangpahrang inn sungah ziangso an zoh?” a ti. Hezekiah cun, “Ziang hmuahhmuah an zoh ṭheh. Thilri retnak sungih ta ka hmuh hai lomi zianghman a um lo,” tiah a sawn."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Isaiah in siangpahrang hnenah, “ Bawipa in,"},"17":{"text":"‘Na pupa pawl in tuihsun tiang an khawlmi thilri pawl hi Babilon a thlen thluh caan a ra thleng ding. Zianghman a taang lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Nangmah ih sungsuak na tefa hrekkhat pawl tla an hruai hai ding ih Babilon siangpahrang inn ah an til per tahratin hnaṭuantu an si ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"19":{"text":"Cutiih a timi cu Siangpahrang Hezekiah cun, “Ka nun sungah cun daihnak le humhimnak a um ding a si cu,” tiih a ruah ruangah Isaiah hnenah, “ Bawipa ih ṭong, in run thanmi cu a ṭha a si,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah ih thil tuah mi dangdang, ralṭha zetih hna a ṭuannak, khawpi hrangah tidai khawlnak tumpi a tuah ih leihnuai in tikong a tuahmi pawl thuhla cu Judah Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"21":{"text":"Hezekiah cu a thi ih a fapa Manasseh in a ai ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh cu kum hleihnih a ti ah Judah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem ihsin Judah ram kum sawmnga le kum nga sung a uk. A nu cu Hefzibah a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Manasseh (2 San. 33.1-20)"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi Kanaan ram an luh laiah Bawipa ih a dawihlo mi miphun pawl ih fihnungza thiltuah daan pawl a thlun ruangah Manasseh cu Bawipa ih parah a sual."},"3":{"text":"Manasseh in a pa Hezekiah ih a siatbal thluh zomi khawzing an biaknak inn pawl cu a thar in a sak sal; Baal khawzing biaknak biakṭheng pawl a don ih Israel Siangpahrang Ahab ih a rak tuah zo bangin khawzingnu Asherah lem tla a tuah. Manasseh cun arsi pawl tla a biak."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in amah biaknak hrangah a timi Bawipa Biakinn sungah cun khawzing dang pawl biaknak hrangah biakṭheng pawl a dawl."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa Biakinn ih khaan pahnih sungah arsi pawl biaknak ah biakṭheng pahnih a dawl."},"6":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinak hrangah a fapa tiangin a pek. Aizingnak le mitkher a tuah; kutṭial zohthiam pawl le tinzohthiam pawl a leeng. Bawipa ih mithmuh ah a sualnak cu a siazet ih Bawipa thin a hengter."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih Biakinn hmun thu ah Bawipa in David le a fapa Solomon hnenah, “Jerusalem khawpiih hi Biakinn cu Israel miphun hleihnih pawl ih ram hmuahhmuah lakah keimah biaknak hrangih ka hril mi hmun a si."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in ka thupekmi an ngai ih ka salpa Moses ih pekmi Daan cu kimten an thlun ṭheh a si ahcun an pupa hnenih ka rak pekmi hi ram ihsin zohman in an dawisuak hai lo ding,” tiah a rak ti."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Judah mi pawl in Bawipa ih thu cu an ngai lo. Kanaan ram an luh laiah Bawipa ih dawihlo mi miphun pawl ih thilsual an tuahmi hnakin luar deuh in thilsual Manasseh in a tuahter hai a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in a siahhlawh profet pawl hnenin a phuang ih,"},"11":{"text":"“Kanaan mi pawl ih rak tuahmi sualnak hnakin thilsual deuh, fihnung tuksumza sualnak cu Manasseh in a tuah zo a si; a milem pawl biaknak in Judah cu a sualter zo a si."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Israel Pathian Bawipa keimah in Jerusalem le Judah parah siatsuahnak nasa zetin ka thlenter ding ih a hmutu le a theitu pawl an mang a bang ṭheh ding."},"13":{"text":"Samaria ka hrem vekin le Israel Siangpahrang Ahab le a tefa pawl ka hrem bangtuk in Jerusalem ka hrem ding. Jerusalem cu milai zohman um lo tiangin ka thenfai thluh ding - an hnawtfai mi pakan cu a khupih an ret vekin Jerusalem cu ka kholhfai thluh ding."},"14":{"text":"A taangsunmi milai pawl khal ka dungtun ding ih an ral pawl kutah ka pe hai ding; an ral pawl le a dotu pawl in an ram cu an siim dingih an thilri pawl an ram thluh ding."},"15":{"text":"Keimah ih miphun an si ko naón, Izipt ramih an suah ni thokin tuihsun tiang ka parah an sual ringring. Ka thin in hengter tuk thlang ruangah hi bangtuk thil cu an parah ka tuah ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Manasseh in mawhnak zianghman a nei lomi minung pawl tamtuk a that ih Jerusalem khawpi lamzin ah thisen a luang ciamco. Himi cu Judah mi pawl milem biaknak ah a hruai hai ruangah Bawipa parih misual a siternak hlei ah a tuahmi sualnak a si."},"17":{"text":"Manasseh thil tuahnak dangdang le a sual tuahmi pawl cu Judah Siangpahrang Pawlih Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"18":{"text":"Manasseh cu a thi ih siangpahrang innih hmuan, Uzza hmuanah an phum. Cule a fapa Amon in a ai ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"19":{"text":"Amon cu kum kul hluanhnih a ti tikah Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan ih Jerusalem ihsin kum hnih sung a uk. A nu cu Jotbah khuami Haruz ih fanu Meshullemeth a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Amon (2 San. 33.21-25)"},"20":{"text":"A pa Manasseh vekin Bawipa ih mithmuh ah a sual;"},"21":{"text":"a pa ih thiltuahmi a cawng ih a pa ih biakmi milem pawl cu a bia ve."},"22":{"text":"A pu le a pa pawl ih Pathian Bawipa cu a hnong ih a thupekmi a thlun duh lo."},"23":{"text":"A kuthnuai ih bawi pawl in Amon cu an phiar ih siangpahrang inn sungah an that."},"24":{"text":"Asinain Judah mi pawl in Amon thattu bawi pawl cu an that ih a ai ah a fapa Josiah siangpahrang ah an tuah."},"25":{"text":"Amon ih hnaṭuanmi dang pawl cu Judah Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"26":{"text":"Amon cu Uzza hmuan sungah an phum; cule a fapa Josiah in a ai ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah cu kum riat a ti ah Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan ih Jerusalem ihsin kum sawmthum le kum khat sung a uk. A nu cu Bozkath khuami Adaiah ih fanu Jedidah a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Josiah (2 San. 34.1-2)"},"2":{"text":"Josiah cu Bawipa ih duhzawng a tuah; a pu siangpahrang David ziaza a thlun ih Pathian ih thupekmi pawl felzet in a thlun a si."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah in Judah ram a uknak kum hleiriatnak ah Meshullam ih tupa, Azaliah ih fapa, siangpahrang zungih sungṭuan Shafan cu Bawipa ih Biakinn ah a thlah ih,"},"4":{"text":"“Puithiam Sang Hilkiah hnenah va feh awla mi pawl ih pekmi paisa cu Biakinn sangka kiltu puithiam pawl in ziangzat an khawl zo, ti va sut aw."},"5":{"text":"Cuih paisa cu Biakinn remtu pawl hotu hnenih pek dingah va sim aw. Hnaṭuantu hotu pawl in,"},"6":{"text":"zungthiam, inn satu, le lungdawltu pek dingah le inn remnak ih a ṭulmi zanthing le lungto pawl leinak ah an hmang pei."},"7":{"text":"Hnaṭuan hotu pawl cu zumtlak ngaingai an si ih an paisa hmannak pawl zingzoi rero a ṭul lo ding,” tiah thu a pek."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang ih thupekmi cu Shafan in Hilkiah a va sim. Cutikah Hilkiah in Biakinn sungih Daan cabu a sarnak thu a rak sim. Hilkiah in cuih cabu cu Shafan a pek ih Shafan cun a siar.","title":"Daan Cabu An Sar (2 San. 34.8-28)"},"9":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang hnenah a kir ih, “ Bawipa ih Biakinn sungih paisa cu na salpa pawl in an lak ih hnaṭuan hotu pawl hnenah an pe ko."},"10":{"text":"Cun hinah Hilkiah ih i pekmi cabu a um,” tiah a ti. Cule siangpahrang hnenah ringzet in a siar."},"11":{"text":"Cumi Daan cabu sungih thu cu siangpahrang in a theih tikah a ninghang in a hnipuan a thlek."},"12":{"text":"Puithiam Hilkiah, Shafan ih fapa Ahikam, Mikaiah ih fapa Akbor, sungṭuan Shafan le siangpahrang bawmtu Asaiah pawl a ko ih an hnenah,"},"13":{"text":"“Feh uhla hi cabu-ih zirhmi thu-ah keimah le Judah mi pawl ai-awh in Bawipa va ron hnik uh. Kan parah Bawipa a thin a heng; ziangahtile hi cabu ih tuah ding, a timi cu kan pupa pawl in an thlun lo a si; kanmah thuhla ah hi cabu sungih nganmi vek in an thlun lo,” tiah thu a pek."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah puithiam Hilkiah, Shafan, Ahikam, Akbor le Asaiah pawl cu Jerusalem vengthar ih a ummi profet nu Huldah tong dingah an feh. (A pasal Shallum, Tikvah ih fapa le Harhas ih tupa, cu Biakinn korfualpi pawl kiltu a si.) An thuhla cu an sim ih,"},"15":{"text":"Huldah cun an hnenah, “Siangpahrang hnenah va kir uhla,"},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭong cu hiti in a si, va sim uh: ‘Siangpahrang ih a siar zomi cabu sungih a um bangin Jerusalem le khawsung mi pawl ka hrem ding."},"17":{"text":"Keimah in hnong ih khawzing dangdang hnenah thawinak an pek; an milem tuahmi hmuahhmuah in ka thin in hengter. Ka thinhengnak cu mei-sa bangin a alh ih zianghman in a toihdai thei lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang amah parah cun Bawipa keimah Israel ih Pathian in hiti in ka sim: Cabu sungih nganmi cu na thei ih,"},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem le a khawsungmi pawl hmuahhmuah ka hrem ding, ti na theih tikah siir aw in na hnipuan na thlek ih ṭap phah in ka hmaiah na thinlung a neem ruangah na thlacamnak ka lo theihsak a si. Jerusalem le a khawsungmi pawl ka hremzia mi tampi in an hmuh tikah tuksumza an ti ding ih a hmun cu midang camnak ih hmanmi hminah a cang ding."},"20":{"text":"Asinain Jerusalem ka hremnak ding tikcu tiang cu na nung lo ding; hnangamnak thawn na nunnak cu ka cemter ding,’ a ti va ti uh,” tiah a ti. Cuih thu thawn annih cu Siangpahrang Josiah hnenah cun an kir."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah in Judah ram le Jerusalem khua ih hotu pawl a ko ih,","title":"Josiah In A Siatsuah ṭheh (2 San. 34.3-7 , 29-33)"},"2":{"text":"cupawl thawn Bawipa ih Biakinn ahcun a feh. Puithiam le profet pawl, Jerusalem khawsung mi zatein, milian siseh mifarah siseh an thlun ṭheh. An zate ih hmaiah Biakinn sungih an hmuhmi Thukamnak cabu cu ringzet in a siar ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang dinnak hrangih tuahmi ṭhuam kiang ahcun Josiah cu a ding ih cuih cabu sungih a um vekin Bawipa ih thu ngai dingah, a thinlung le a nunnak zatein a daan le a thupekmi hmuahhmuah thlun dingah le thukam sungih a ummi vekih tuah ṭheh dingah Bawipa ih hnenah thukam a tuah. Misenpi khal in Bawipa ih pekmi thukam cu thlun ding in thu an kam ve."},"4":{"text":"Cule Josiah in Baal khawzing biaknak ih hmanmi thilri hmuahhmuah, khawzingnu Asherah biaknak le arsi pawl biaknak ih hman mi thilri hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih Biakinn ihsin suah thluh dingah Puithiam Sang Hilkiah, a bawmtu puithiam pawl le Biakinn sangka ih ṭuanvo neitu pawl hnenah thu a pek. A thupek vekin an suah thluh ih cuih thilri pawl cu siangpahrang in Jerusalem khawpi leng, Kidron Horkuam kiangah a ur ṭheh ih a vutcam pawl cu Bethel ah a kuat."},"5":{"text":"A hlanih Judah siangpahrang a ṭuantu siangpahrang pawl ih hnaṭuan pekmi puithiam pawl, Jerusalem kiangkap le Judah ram sungah khawzing biakṭheng parih thawinak petu puithiam pawl le Baal khawzing, ni, thla, arsi le van ih a ummi hmuahhmuah hnenih thawinak petu puithiam pawl hmuahhmuah cu an hnaṭuan in a dawi ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih Biakinn ih Asherah khawzingnu hrangah phunmi ṭhuam thianghlim cu a phawi in Jerusalem khawleng, Kidron Horkuam ah a ur ih dip tein a deen ṭheh hnuah misenpi phumnak thlaanmual ah a theh ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa Biakinn thawn peh-aw in an sakmi hlawhhlang pawl ih umnak inn pawl cu a bal ṭheh. (Cutawk ahcun nunau pawl in khawzingnu Asherah biaknak ah puan an tah a si.)"},"8":{"text":"Judah ram sung khawpi pawl ihsin puithiam pawl cu Jerusalem ah a khawm ṭheh ih an raithawinak biakṭheng cu ramsung khuazakip ah, Geba ihsin Beersheba tiang, a borhhlawhter ṭheh. Khawpi luhnak kotka kehlam ih a ummi, khawpi uktu bawi Joshua ih sakmi kotka kiangih me-khawsia hrang tiin sakmi, biakṭheng pawl tla a balsiat ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Cuih puithiam pawl cu Bawipa ih Biakinn sungah hnaṭuantu an si thei lo; asinain an rualpi puithiam pawl hrangih pekmi thilnu tel lo sang cu an ei thei ve."},"10":{"text":"Cun Josiah in Molek khawzing hnenih an fanu le an fapa mei-ur raithawinak in an pek thei nawn lonak dingah Hinnom Horkuam ih an khawzing biaknak hmun Tofeth cu a borhhlawhter ṭheh."},"11":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang pawl ih an rak tuahmi, ni biaknak le upatnak ah an timi rang pawl cu a siatsuah ih rangleng pawl khal a ur ṭheh. (Hi rang le rangleng pawl cu Bawipa ih Biakinn hmuan sung kotka kiang, Nathan Melek timi bawi upa inn ihsin naite ah an retmi a si.)"},"12":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang pawl in siangpahrang inn diphun parih an rak donmi biakṭheng pawl le Bawipa ih Biakinn ih khaan pahnih sungih siangpahrang Manasseh in biakṭheng a donmi pawl cu siangpahrang Josiah in a bal ṭheh; biakṭheng pawl cu dip seksek in a deen ih Kidron Horkuam ah a hlon."},"13":{"text":"Olif Tlang ihsin thlanglam, Jerusalem in nisuahnak ih siangpahrang Solomon in ningsinza khawzing pawl, Sidon mi khawzingnu Astartes, Moab mi khawzing Khemosh le Ammon mi khawzing Milkom hrangih a donmi biakṭheng pawl cu a borhhlawhter ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Cuih khawzing pawl hrangih lungphun pawl cu a khuai ṭheh ih khawzingnu Asherah hrangih an ṭhuam phunmi pawl a hau ṭheh ih an rak dinnak hmun pawl cu milai ruh in a khuh ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Nebat fapa, Israel mi pawl sualnak sungih a hruailuttu, siangpahrang Jeroboam in Bethel ah khawzing biaknak a sakmi cu Josiah in a balsiat ṭheh. Biakṭheng tla a bal hnuah lungphun pawl a khuai ṭheh ih dip ko in a deng thluh. Asherah biaknak hrangih an ṭhuam thianghlim tla a ur."},"16":{"text":"Cun Josiah in a kiangkap a hun zoh ih tlang parah thlaan pawl a hmu. A sungih ruh pawl cu a phorhter hai ih biakṭheng parah a ur. Cuticun biakṭheng cu a borhhlawhter ih, hlanlaipi ih puai caanah cuih biakṭheng kiangih siangpahrang Jeroboam a rak din laiah profet in a rak sim ciami cu a kimter. Siangpahrang Josiah cun a kiangkap a hun zohsal ih cuih thu a rak simtu profet ih thlan cu a hmu."},"17":{"text":"“Zo ih thlaan so a si?” tiah a sut. Bethel khuami pawl in, “Judah ihsin ra tahratin hih biakṭheng parih na tuahmi thil pawl hi a cang leh ding a si, tiih a rak simtu profet thlaan a si,” tiah an ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Josiah in, “Hi thlaan cu zohman in dai hlah uh; hiti te in umseh. A ruh pawl khal nan phorh lo pei,” tiah thu a pek. Curuangah a ruh pawl cu an phorh lo. Samaria in a rami profet pawl ih ruh khal an phorh lo."},"19":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Israel siangpahrang pawl ih an rak tuahmi, Bawipa ih thin a hengtertu biakṭheng pawl cu Israel ramah tampi an um. Cuih khawvel biakṭheng pawl cu Israel khawpi tinah an um ih Josiah in a bal ṭheh. Bethel khua biakṭheng parih a tuah vekin hi biakṭheng pawl ih par khalah a tuah."},"20":{"text":"Cuih khawvel biakṭheng ih hnaṭuantu puithiam pawl cu an hnaṭuannak biakṭheng parah cun a that ṭheh. Cule biakṭheng tinih parah milai ruh a ur. Cuih hnuah Jerusalem ah a kir."},"21":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah cun Thukam cabu sungih a um bangtuk in Bawipa an Pathian upatnak ah Lantak Puai tuah dingin misenpi hnenah thu a pek.","title":"Josiah In Lantak Puai A Tuah (2 San. 35.1-19)"},"22":{"text":"Thuṭhentu pawl in Israel ram pumpi an uk thok ihsin Israel siangpahrang pawl in siseh, Judah siangpahrang pawl khal in siseh, siangpahrang zohman in tuihṭum ih Lantak Puai an tuah vek cun an tuah dah lo."},"23":{"text":"A netnak ah Josiah in siangpahrang a ṭuan kum hleiriatnak ah Lantak Puai cu Jerusalem ah an tuah suak a si."},"24":{"text":"Puithiam Sang Hilkiah in Bawipa ih Biakinn sungih a hmuhmi cabu sungih a ummi daan pawl cu thlunsuak tengteng ding in Jerusalem khua le Judah ram sungih a ummi pol pawl le kutṭial zohthiam pawl cu siangpahrang Josiah in a dawi ṭheh; innsang milem pawl, khawzing lem pawl le an khawzing biaknak thilri hmuahhmuah tla a siatbal ṭheh.","title":"Josiah Ih Thil Remmi Dangdang"},"25":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah bangtuk ih Bawipa ih hnaṭuan, a thinlung zate, a fimnak zate le a thazaang zate in a ṭuan ih Moses Daan a thlun thluhtu siangpahrang an um dah lo; amah ih hnu khalah amah vek cu an um dah hrih lo a si."},"26":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa ih thinhengnak cu siangpahrang Manasseh ih thiltuah mi ruangah Judah mi parah mei bangin a sa ih atu khalah a dai lo."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel parih ka thiltuah mi bangin Judah par khalah ka tuah ding: Ka mithmuh lonak ramah Judah mi cu ka dawihlo hai ding; ka hrilcia mi Jerusalem khawpi le keimah in biak ringringnak dingah ka timi Biakinn cu ka hnong ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah ih hnaṭuanmi dangdang cu Judah Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si.","title":"Siangpahrang Josiah A Thi (2 San. 35.20—36.1)"},"29":{"text":"Josiah cu Judah siangpahrang a si laiah Izipt siangpahrang Neko in a ralkap pawl a ho ih Assiria siangpahrang bawm dingah Eufrates Tiva lamah a feh. Cumi cu siangpahrang Josiah in kham a tum; Megiddo ah Izipt siangpahrang thawn an do-aw ih Josiah cu an that."},"30":{"text":"A kuthnuai bawi pawl in a ruak cu rangleng in Jerusalem ah an phur ih siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Cule Judah mi pawl in Josiah ih fapa Jehoahaz cu a pa ai-awhtu dingah an hril ih hriak an culh ih siangpahrang ah an canter."},"31":{"text":"Jehoahaz cu kum kul hluanthum a ti ah Judah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem ihsin thla thum sung a uk. A nu cu Libnah khuami Jeremiah ih fanu Hamutal a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jehoahaz (2 San. 36.2-4)"},"32":{"text":"Jehoahaz cun khuahlan a pupa pawl ih ziaza a thlun ruangah Bawipa ih mithmuh ah a sual."},"33":{"text":"Izipt siangpahrang Neko in a kai ih Hamath ram, Riblah khua ah thawngah a thlak; cule Judah mi pawl in Izipt siangpahrang hnenah ngun tangkafai in cuai thawnghnih le sui cuai kul siah an pek."},"34":{"text":"Siangpahrang Neko in Josiah ih fapa Eliakim cu Josiah ai-awhtu ah Judah siangpahrang ah a tuah ih a hmin cu Jehoiakim ah a thleng. Jehoahaz cu siangpahrang Neko in Izipt ramah a hruai ih cutawkah a thita."},"35":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Jehoiakim cun Izipt siangpahrang ih siah dil mi tlin dingah misenpi hnen in an len le an farah zoh in, ngunkhuai a lak.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jehoiakim (2 San. 36.5-8)"},"36":{"text":"Jehoiakim cu kum kul hluannga a ti ah Judah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem in kum hleikhat sung a uk. A nu cu Rumah khuami Pedaiah ih fanu Zebidah a si."},"37":{"text":"Jehoiakim in a pupa pawl ih ziaza a thlun ruangah Bawipa ih mithmuh ah a sual."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoiakim Judah siangpahrang a si laiah Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Judah ram cu a do ih kum thum sung Nebuchadnezzar kuthnuai ah a um. Cuih hnuah ral a tho.","title":"Ral Pawl In Judah An Neh"},"2":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in Babilon mi, Siria mi, Moab mi le Ammon mi pawl cu Jehoiakim do dingah le Judah ram siatsuah dingah a thlah. Himi cu Bawipa in a hnaṭuantu profet pawl hnen in a rak sim ciami a kimternak dingah a si."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang Manasseh sualnak hmuahhmuah ruangah le, a bik in, sualnak nei lomi pawl ih thisen tamtuk a luanter ruangah Bawipa in Judah mi pawl cu a mithmuh lonak ramih dawihlo ṭheh a tum ruangah hi thil pawl cu Amah ih thupeknak in a cangmi an si. Bawipa in Manasseh cu a ngaithiam thei lo.","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Jehoiakim ih hnaṭuanmi dangdang cu Judah Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"6":{"text":"Jehoiakim cu a thi ih a fapa Jehoiakhin in a ai-ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"7":{"text":"Izipt siangpahrang le a ralkap pawl cu an ram ihsin ram dangah voikhat hman an fehsal thei nawn lo; ziangahtile Izipt ih rak ukmi ram tampi Babilon siangpahrang in a lak ṭheh ih Eufrates Tiva ihsin Izipt Tiva tiang a uk ṭheh a si."},"8":{"text":"Jehoiakhin cu kum hleiriat a ti ah Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan ih Jerusalem ihsin thla thum sung a uk. A nu cu Jerusalem khuami Elnathan ih fanu Nehusta a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jehoiakhin (2 San. 36.9-10)"},"9":{"text":"Jehoiakhin cu a pa ih ziaza a thlun ruangah Bawipa ih parah a sual a si."},"10":{"text":"Jehoiakhin Judah siangpahrang a si laiah Babilon ralkap pawl Nebuchadnezzar ih ralbawi pawl ho in Judah ram ah an rung ih Jerusalem khawpi an kulh."},"11":{"text":"An kulh sungah cun Nebuchadnezzar amah rori Jerusalem ah a ra ih,"},"12":{"text":"siangpahrang Jehoiakhin cun a nu, amah a riantu hnen-um pawl, a kuthnuai bawi pawl le siangpahrang ralkap hotu bawi pawl thawn Nebuchadnezzar hnenah a feh ih a kuthnuai ah a lut. Nebuchadnezzar in Babilon ram a uknak kum riat kumah Jehoiakhin cu a kaih ih,"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa ih Biakinn le siangpahrang inn ih a ummi sui le ngun pawl cu Babilon ah a phur ṭheh. Bawipa ih a rak sim cia vekin Nebuchadnezzar in Bawipa ih Biakinn ih hman dingah Solomon in sui ih a tuahmi thilri pawl a khuai ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem khawsungmi, siangpahrang sungkhat le hotu pawl hmuahhmuah, an zate in thawnghra, Babilon ah Nebuchadnezzar in salah a hruai. Zungthiam pawl le sodeng pawl tiangin a hruai ṭheh ih Judah ramah cun mifarah bik pawl lawng a taan a si."},"15":{"text":"Cun Nebuchadnezzar in siangpahrang Jehoiakhin cu a nu le a nupi pawl, a kuthnuai bawi pawl le Judah ram hotu pawl thawn Babilon ah salah a hruai."},"16":{"text":"Micak le mi thupi pawl, ralkap ṭuan theitu le raldo dingah a tiar-aw cia pawl thawng sarih, le zungthiam pawl le sodeng pawl minung thawng khat, Babilon ah a hruai."},"17":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in Jehoiakhin ih paseu, Mattaniah cu Judah siangpahrang ah a tuah ih a hmin cu Zedekiah ah a thleng."},"18":{"text":"Zedekiah cu kum kul hluan khat a ti ah Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan ih Jerusalem ihsin kum hleikhat a uk. A nu cu Libnah khuami Jeremiah ih fanu Hamutal a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Zedekiah (2 San. 36.11-12 ; Jer. 52.1-3a)"},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jehoiakim ih sualnak tuahmi cu siangpahrang Zedekiah khal in a tuah ih Bawipa ih parah misual a si."},"20":{"text":"Jerusalem le Judah mi parah Bawipa cu a thin a heng ngaingai ih a mithmuh lonak ramah a dawihlo hai."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar cu a kuthnuai ih ummi Judah siangpahrang Zedekiah in a do. Curuangah Nebuchadnezzar cu a ralkap pawl thawn a ra ih Zedekiah in Judah ram a uk kum kua-nak, thla hra-nak ih ni hra ni ah Jerusalem cu a do. Jerusalem khua an kulh ih a leng kimvel in phardawl lan theinak ah leilung an khahsilh ih cutiin ṭanhmun an khuar.","title":"Jerusalem An Lak (2 San. 36.13-21 ; Jer. 52.3b-11)"},"2":{"text":"Cuticun Zedekiah in ram a uk kum hleikhatnak tiang an kulh."},"3":{"text":"Cule cuih kum, thla linak ih ni kua ni ah, khawsung mi pawl cu zianghman ei ding an neih nawn lo tikah,"},"4":{"text":"khawpi kulhnak hruang cu an bauh ih Babilon ralkap pawl cun an kil ṭhepṭhep naón zanah Zedekiah le a ralkap pawl cu an suak thluh. Siangpahrang hmuan ih lamzin zawh in phar pahnih karlak kot in an suak ih Jordan Phairawn lamah an tlan."},"5":{"text":"Asinain Babilon ralkap pawl in siangpahrang Zedekiah cu an duum ih Jerikho khua kiangih hmunrawn ah an man ih an kai; a ralkap pawl cun an tlansan thluh."},"6":{"text":"Zedekiah cu Babilon ralkap pawl in an hruai ih Riblah khua ih siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar a rak um laiah a hnenah an thlenpi. Cutawkah Nebuchadnezzar in a thu a ṭhen."},"7":{"text":"Zedekiah mithmuh hngan rori ah a fapa pahnih cu an that; cule Zedekiah ih mit cu a pahnih in an phorh ih dar cikcin in an khih hnuah Babilon khua ah an hruai."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Babilon ram a uk kum hleikuanak, thla nganak ih ni sarih ni ah siangpahrang ralkap pawl hotu le siangpahrang ruahnak petu a si mi Nebuzaradan cu Jerusalem khawsung ah a lut.","title":"Ih Biakinn An Siatsuah (Jer. 52.12-33)"},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih Biakinn, siangpahrang inn le Jerusalem ih bawi le upa deuhdeuh pawl ih inn pawl a ur ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Cule a ralkap pawl in khawpi ralhruang cu an bal ṭheh."},"11":{"text":"Cun Nebuzaradan in Jerusalem ih a taangmi senpi pawl, zungthiam pawl le Babilon mi hnenih a rak ṭangtu pawl cu Babilon ah a hruai ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Judah ram sungih a taantami pawl cu thilri zianghman a nei lomi farah bik pawl an si ih cupawl cu sabit hmuan le lo sungah hna a ṭuanter."},"13":{"text":"Babilon ralkap pawl cun Bawipa ih Biakinn sungih a ummi dar ih tuahmi ṭhuam pawl le ṭhuam dinnak pawl cu an khiak an khuai ṭheh. Dar ih tuahmi tidai retnak maihum tumpi cu an khuai ṭheh ih dar pawl cu Babilon ah an phur ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Cawhleek pawl, biakṭheng ih vutcam lawhnak kheng pawl, mei-inn kilkhawinak ih hmanmi thilri pawl, thawinak ih pekmi ṭilva ih thisen donnak maihum pawl le rimhmui urnak kheng pawl le Biakinn sungih hmanmi dar ih tuahmi thilri dangdang pawl tla an lak ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Cuih tlunah sui le ngun ih tuahmi thilri hmuahhmuah, maihum fatete pawl le meivam kennak kheng pawl tla an lak."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ih Biakinn hrangih Solomon in dar ih a tuahmi ṭhuam pahnih, ṭhuam dinnak pawl le tidai retnak maihum tumpi pawl cu an tum zetzet ih a cuai khai thei ding pawl an si lo."},"17":{"text":"Ṭhuam pahnih cu an tia-aw ih pi kul hluan sarih an sang ih ṭhuam pakhat ih lubo cu pi li le a hrek a sang. Cuih ṭhuam lubo kimvel cu dar in an tuah ih taleti zuk cuangin an mawiter."},"18":{"text":"Cun ralkap hotu ralbawipa Nebuzaradan cun Puithiam Sang Seraiah, a sangtu puithiam Zefaniah le a dang Biakinn upa bikbik pathum pawl a kai ih a hruai.","title":"Judah Mi Pawl Babilon An Thleng (Jer. 52.24-27)"},"19":{"text":"Cuih tlunah khawpi sungih ralkap hotu ralbawipa, siangpahrang ruahnak petu panga, ralkap lamih cazin kaitu, ralkap hotu bawipa bawmtu le a dangdang mi upa sawmruk pawl tla a kai."},"20":{"text":"Cupawl cu Babilon siangpahrang, Hammath ram Riblah khua ih a um laiah,"},"21":{"text":"Nebuzaradan in a fehpi ih siangpahrang ih thupek vekin cutawkah an hrem ih an that ṭheh. Cuticun Judah mi pawl cu an ram ihsin an thawng tlaknak ramah an hruai hai a si."},"22":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Ahikam fapa, Shafan ih tupa, Gedaliah cu Babilon ramih thawng thlak lomi, Judah ramih a taangmi pawl hotu ah Judah ram uktu bawi ah a tuah.","title":"Judah Ram Uktu Bawi Gedaliah (Jer. 40.7-9 ; 41.1-3)"},"23":{"text":"Cumi cu siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar kuthnuai ih a lut lomi Judah ralbawi pawl le ralkap pawl in an theih tikah Gedaliah hnenah Mizpah khua ah an ra. Cuih ralbawi pawl cu Nethaniah fapa Ishmael, Kareah fapa Johanan, Netofah khuami Tanhumeth ih fapa Seraiah le Maakath mi Jezaniah an si."},"24":{"text":"Cule Gedaliah in anmah le an ralkap pawl hnenah cun, “Thungai in ka lo sim: Babilon bawi pawl ṭih ding zianghman a um lo. Judah ramah hin um uhla Babilon siangpahrang hna cu ṭuan uh. Cuticun ziang hmuahhmuah a rem ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Asinain cuih kum, thla sarih thla ah Nethaniah fapa, Elishama ih tupa, Judah siangpahrang ih sungkhat a si mi Ishmael cu ralkap pahra thawn Mizpah ah an feh ih Gedaliah cu an that. Gedaliah hnenih a ummi Israel mi le Babilon mi pawl tla an that ṭheh."},"26":{"text":"Cule Israel misenpi pawl cu a lian siseh a farah siseh, ralbawi pawl thawn Babilon mi an ṭih ruangah an suak ih Izipt ramah an tlan."},"27":{"text":"Evilmerodak cu Babilon ram siangpahrang a cang ih a can kum rori ah Judah siangpahrang Jehoiakhin cu a zaangfah ih thawng ihsin a suah. A suah ni cu Jehoiakhin thawng a tlaknak kum sawmthum le kum sarihnak, thla hleihnih thla ih ni kul hluan sarih ni ah a si.","title":"Jehoiakhin Thawng In A Suak (Jer. 52.31-34)"},"28":{"text":"Evilmerodak in Jehoiakhin cu ṭhazet in a zoh ih amah thawn Babilon ramih thawng an thlakmi siangpahrang dangdang hnakin upatnak a pek cuang a si."},"29":{"text":"Jehoiakhin cu a thawngtla hnipuan a thlengter ṭheh ih a nunsung hmuahhmuah ah Babilon siangpahrang thawn rawl an ei tlang."},"30":{"text":"A dam sung cu nitinte in a ṭulmi leinak ah paisa tla a pek ringring."}}}}},"13":{"info":{"name":"1 Sansiarnak","shortname":"1 San.","abbr":[],"desc":"1 sansiarnak (1 chronicles)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Adam cu Seth ih pa a si, Seth cu Enosh ih pa a si, Enosh cu Kenan ih pa a si,","title":"Adam Ihsin Abraham San Tiang (Seem 5.1-32 ; 10.1-32 ; 11.10-26)"},"2":{"text":"Kenan cu Mahalalel ih pa a si, Mahalalel cu Jared ih pa a si."},"3":{"text":"Jared cu Enok ih pa a si, Enok cu Methuselah ih pa a si, Methuselah cu Lamek ih pa a si,"},"4":{"text":"Lamek cu Noah ih pa a si. Noah in fapa pathum a nei ih Shem, Ham le Jafeth an si."},"5":{"text":"Jafeth ih fapa pawl cu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek le Tiras an si ih an hrinmi miphun pawl in anmah hringtu ih hmin ciar an keng."},"6":{"text":"Gomer ih tefa pawl cu Ashkenaz mi, Riphath mi le Togarmah mi an si."},"7":{"text":"Javan ih hrin pawl cu Elishah mi, Tarshish mi, Saipras mi le Rodes mi pawl an si"},"8":{"text":"Ham ih fapa pawl cu Kush, Izipt, Libia, le Kanaan an si ih an hrinmi miphun pawl in anmah hringtu ih hmin ciar an keng."},"9":{"text":"Kush ih tefa pawl cu Seba mi, Havilah mi, Sabtah mi, Raamah mi le Sabteka mi an si. Raamah tefa pawl cu Sheba le Dedan mi an si."},"10":{"text":"(Kush in fapa Nimrod a nei ih Nimrod cu leilung tlunah mi nehtu hminthang hmaisa bik a si.)"},"11":{"text":"Izipt ih tefa pawl cu Lidia mi, Anam mi, Lehab mi, Naftuh mi,"},"12":{"text":"Pathrus mi, Kasluh mi le Krete mi an si. (Krete mi pawl cu Filistin mi pawl cithlahtu an si.)"},"13":{"text":"Kanaan ih fapa upabik cu Sidon a si ih, a sangtu ah Heth a si ih an hrinmi miphun pawl in anmah hringtu ih hmin ciar an keng."},"14":{"text":"Kanaan ih cithlahmi cu Jebus mi, Amor mi, Girgash mi,"},"15":{"text":"Hiv mi, Arka mi, Sin mi,"},"16":{"text":"Arvad mi, Zemar mi le Hamath mi tla an si."},"17":{"text":"Shem ih fapa pawl cu Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether le Meshek an si ih an hrinmi miphun pawl in anmah hringtu ih hmin ciar an keng."},"18":{"text":"Arpakshad cu Shelah ih pa a si, Shelah cu Eber ih pa a si."},"19":{"text":"Eber in fapa pahnih a nei, pakhat cu Peleg a si, ziangahtile amah ih sanah leilungtlun milai pawl cu an ṭhen-aw thluh; pahnihnak cu Joktan a si."},"20":{"text":"Joktan ih tefa pawl cu Almodad mi, Shelef mi, Hazarmaveth mi, Jerah mi,"},"21":{"text":"Hadoram mi, Uzal mi, Diklah mi,"},"22":{"text":"Ebal mi, Abimael mi, Sheba mi,"},"23":{"text":"Ofir mi, Havilah mi le Jobab mi an si."},"24":{"text":"Shem ih cithlah pawl cu Shem, Arpakshad, Shelah,"},"25":{"text":"Eber, Peleg, Reu,"},"26":{"text":"Serug, Nahor, Terah le"},"27":{"text":"Abram an si.
