Assiria siangpahrang Tiglath Pileser in a hrin sungih hotu bik Beerah cu a kai ih a hruaihlo.","merge":"5"},"7":{"text":"An sungkhat thu ih canganmi sungah cun Reuben hrin hotu pawl cu a tanglam hi an si: Jeiel, Zekhariah,"},"8":{"text":"le Bela an si ih Bela cu Azaz fapa, Shema ih fasuan a si ih Shema cu Joel hrin a si. An hrin pawl cu Aroer khua ah le cutawk ihsin saklam ah Nebo le Baal Meon karlak ramah an um."},"9":{"text":"Gilead ramah ṭilva tampi an neih ruangah Eufrates Tiva thlengih a kaumi nelrawn tiang nisuahnak lamah ram an luah."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang Saul ih sanah Reuben hrin in Hagrit mi pawl an do ih tampi an that hnuah an ram, Gilead in nisuahnak lam ram cu an luah."},"11":{"text":"Gad hrin pawl cu Reuben hrin pawl umnak saklam Bashan ramah an um ih nisuahnak lamah Salekah tiang an um.","title":"Gad Tesinfa Pawl"},"12":{"text":"An phun sungih a cak bik hrin hotu cu Joel a si; a pahnihnak hrin hotu cu Shafam a si. Janai le Shafat cu a dang hrin pawl hotu an si."},"13":{"text":"Gad phun sungih hrin dangdang pawl cu: Mikhael hrin, Meshullam hrin, Sheba hrin, Jorai hrin, Jakan hrin, Zia hrin le Eber hrin pawl an si."},"14":{"text":"Annih pawl hi Huri ih fapa Abihail tesinfa pawl an si ih an pupa pawl cu Abihail, Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Mikhael, Jeshishai, Jahdo le Buz an si."},"15":{"text":"Hi hrin pawl lakih lu bik cu Abdiel ih fapa le Guni ih fasuan Ahi a si."},"16":{"text":"Bashan le Gilead ram sungih khawpi ah an um ih Sharon ram ṭilva tlannak ṭha ahcun an um ṭheh a si."},"17":{"text":"(Hi an thuhla pawl cu Judah siangpahrang Jotham le Israel siangpahrang Jeroboam san ih ngankhummi a si.)"},"18":{"text":"Reuben, Gad le Nisuahnak lam Manasseh hrin pawl sungin ralphaw, ralnam, li le conkiang hmang thiamzet ralkap thawng sawmli le thawngli le zasarih le sawmruk an um.","title":"Nisuahnak Lam Hrin Ih Ralkap Pawl"},"19":{"text":"Hi pawl in Hagrit mi, Jetur, Nafish le Nodab hrin pawl an do."},"20":{"text":"Pathian an rinsan ih a hnen ihsin bomnak an dil ruangah Pathian in an dilnak cu a theihsak ih Hagrit mi le a ṭantu pawl ih tlunah nehnak a pek."},"21":{"text":"An ral pawl ih rannung: kalauk thawng sawmnga, tuu thawng zahnih le thawng sawmnga, le laak thawnghnih an long. Ral pawl thawng zakhat an kai."},"22":{"text":"Pathian an hnenih a ṭan ruangah an ral pawl tampi an that. Cutawkah cun an sal taan caan tiang an um ringring."},"23":{"text":"Nisuahnak lam Manasseh mi pawl cu Bashan ram le saklam ah Baal Hermon, Senir le Hermon Tlang tiangin an um ih an minung pawl cu an karhzai ngaingai.","title":"Nisuahnak lam Manasseh Mi Pawl"},"24":{"text":"An hrin pawl ih hotu tla cu Efer, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah le Jahdiel an si. Hi hotu pawl cu ralkap ralṭha zetzet le hminthang zetzet an si."},"25":{"text":"Himi pawl cu Pathian ih rinsantlak in an um lo ih an pupa pawl ih Pathian cu an tlansan ih Pathian ih a dawihlomi miphun pawl ih khawzing pawl an biak.","title":"Nisuahlam Phun Pawl An Dawi"},"26":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian in Assiria siangpahrang Pul cu (Tiglath Pileser ti tla in an ko), an ram a doter. Siangpahrang Pul cun Reuben, Gad le nisuahnak lam Manasseh hrin pawl cu a hruaihlo ih Halah, Habor, Hara le Gozan Tiva kapah a umter hai."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Levi in fapa pathum a nei ih Gershon, Kohath le Merari an si.","title":"Puithiam Sang Tesinfa Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Kohath in fapa pali a nei ih Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel an si."},"3":{"text":"Amram in fapa pahnih Aaron le Moses a nei ih fanu pakhat Miriam a nei. Aaron in fapa pali a nei ih Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar an si."},"4":{"text":"Eleazar tesinfa pawl cu sankhat hnu sankhat a tanglam pawl hi an si: Finehas, Abishua,"},"5":{"text":"Bukki, Uzzi,"},"6":{"text":"Zerahiah, Meraioth,"},"7":{"text":"Amariah, Ahitub,"},"8":{"text":"Zadok, Ahimaaz,"},"9":{"text":"Azariah, Johanan,"},"10":{"text":"Azariah (Jerusalem ih siangpahrang Solomon sakmi Biakinn ih hna a ṭuantu),"},"11":{"text":"Amariah, Ahitub,"},"12":{"text":"Zadok, Shallum,"},"13":{"text":"Hilkiah, Azariah,"},"14":{"text":"Seraiah le Jehozadak an si."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in Judah mi le Jerusalem mi pawl siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar kutin saltaannak ih a hruaihlo laiah Jehozadak khal a tel ve a si."},"16":{"text":"Levi in fapa pathum a nei ih Gershon, Kohath le Merari an si.","title":"Levi Tesinfa Dang Pawl"},"17":{"text":"Annih tla in fapa an nei ciar. Gershon cu Libni le Shimei ih pa a si;"},"18":{"text":"Kohath cu Amram, Izhar, Hebron le Uzziel ih pa a si;"},"19":{"text":"Cule Merari cu Mahli le Mushi pa a si."},"20":{"text":"Gershon hrin pawl cu sankhat hnu sankhat a sangsang in: Libni, Jahath, Zimmah,"},"21":{"text":"Joah, Iddo, Zerah le Jeatherai an si."},"22":{"text":"Kohath hrin pawl cu sankhat hnu sankhat a sangsang: Amminadab, Korah, Assir,"},"23":{"text":"Elkanah, Ebiasaf, Assir,"},"24":{"text":"Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah le Shaul an si."},"25":{"text":"Elkanah in fapa pahnih Amasai le Ahimoth a nei."},"26":{"text":"Ahimoth ih tesinfa pawl cu sankhat hnu sankhat ah hipawl hi an si: Elkanah, Zofai, Nahath,"},"27":{"text":"Eliab, Jeroham le Elkanah."},"28":{"text":"Samuel in fapa pahnih a nei: Upa cu Joel a si ih nauta cu Abijah a si."},"29":{"text":"Merari tesinfa pawl cu sankhat hnu sankhat ah a sangsang in: Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah,"},"30":{"text":"Shimea, Haggiah le Asaiah an si."},"31":{"text":"Thukam Kuang Jerusalem ih an ṭhawn hnuah siangpahrang David in Pathian biaknak hmunih hla hotu ih a retmi pawl cu a tanglam hi an si:","title":"Biakinn Ih Hla hruaitu Pawl"},"32":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Biakinn a sak hlan sung hmuahhmuah Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam sungah a haha tein hla lamah ṭuanvo an lak."},"33":{"text":"Hla hruaitu le an tesinfa pawl cu: Kohath hrin sungin Heman cu hmaisa bik hlarem hotu a si; amah cu Joel ih fapa a si. A pupa pawl cu Jakob ih cithlahmi an si ih a sangsang in: Heman, Joel, Samuel,"},"34":{"text":"Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah,"},"35":{"text":"Zuf, Elkanah, Mahath, Amasai,"},"36":{"text":"Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zefaniah,"},"37":{"text":"Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaf, Korah,"},"38":{"text":"Izhar, Kohath, Levi le Jakob tla an si."},"39":{"text":"Cun Asaf cu hlarem pahnihnak hruaitu a si. A pupa pawl cu Levi cithlahmi an si ih a sangsang in: Asaf, Berekhiah, Shimea,"},"40":{"text":"Mikhael, Baaseiah, Malkhijah,"},"41":{"text":"Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah,"},"42":{"text":"Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei,"},"43":{"text":"Jahath, Gersho le anmah cithlahtu Levi an si."},"44":{"text":"Merari hrin ihsin Ethan cu hlarem pathumnak hotu a si. A pupa pawl cu Levi cithlah an si ih a sangsang in: Ethan, Kishi, Abdi, Malluk,"},"45":{"text":"Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah,"},"46":{"text":"Amzi, Bani, Shemer,"},"47":{"text":"Mahli, Mushi, Merari le anmah cithlahtu Levi an si."},"48":{"text":"An Levi hrinpi pawl cu Pathian biaknak ih hnaṭuan a phunphun kaitu an si."},"49":{"text":"Aaron le a tesinfa pawl in rimhmui an ur ih biakṭheng par in thawinak an pe. pek."},"62":{"text":"Gershon hrin hnenah a innsang a innsang in Issakhar ram, Asher ram, Naftali ram le nisuahnak lam Manasseh, Bashan ram sungih khua hleithum an pek."},"63":{"text":"Cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in Merari hrin hnenah a innsang a innsang in Reuben ram, Gad ram le Zebulun ram sungah khawpi hleihnih an pek."},"64":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi in Levi mi pawl hnenah an umnak dingah khawpi pawl le a kiangkap ih ṭilva tlannak ram pawl thawn an pe a si."},"65":{"text":"(A tlunih simcia mi Judah ram, Simeon ram le Benjamin ram sungih khawpi pawl tla camcawhfung zukin an pek hai a si.)"},"66":{"text":"Kohath hrin innsang hrekkhat pawl hnenah Efraim ramih khawpi pawl le ṭilva tlannak ram pawl an pek."},"67":{"text":"Cuih khawpi pawl cu Efraim tlangpar ramih ummi rolnak khawpi Shekhem le a dang khawpi pawl Gezer,"},"68":{"text":"Jokmeam, Beth Horon,"},"69":{"text":"Aijalon le Gath Rimmon an si."},"70":{"text":"Nitlaknak lam Manasseh ram sungah Aner le Bileam khawpi pawl cu pawl cu an kiangkap ih ṭilva tlannak ram thawn an pek: Zebulun ramah Rimmono le Tabor khua,"},"78":{"text":"Reuben ram, Jerikho khua ihsin nisuahnak lam Jordan Tiva lanah mualrawn ih um Bezer le Annih tla cu Tola hrinih lubik ciar an si ih ralkap hminthang an si. Siangpahrang David sanah an minung zate in thawng kul hluanhnih le zaruk an ti."},"3":{"text":"Uzzi in fapa pakhat Izrahiah a nei. Anmah cu an hrin ciarih lubik an si."},"4":{"text":"Nupi tampi le faate tampi an nei ih an tefa pawl cu ralkap ṭuan thei thawng sawmthum le thawngruk an kim."},"5":{"text":"Cazin an nganmi vek a si ahcun Issakhar hrin hmuahhmuah ah ralkap ṭuan thei minung thawng sawmriat le thawng sarih an ti."},"6":{"text":"Benjamin in fapa pathum Bela, Becher le Jediael a nei.","title":"Benjamin Le Dan Tesinfa Pawl"},"7":{"text":"Bela in fapa panga a nei ih Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth le Iri an si. An tefa pawl cu ralkap ṭuan thei lawnglawngah minung thawng kul hluanhnih le sawmthum le pali an si."},"8":{"text":"Becher in fapa pakua a nei: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Eleoenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth le Alemeth an si."},"9":{"text":"Cazin sung vek a si ahcun an hrin ciar in siar tikah an tefa pawl cu ralkap ṭuan thei thawng kul le zahnih an ti."},"10":{"text":"Jediael in fapa pakhat Bilhan a nei. Bilhan cun fapa pasarih a nei ih Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Khenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish le Ahishahar an si."},"11":{"text":"An hrinih lu ciar an si ih ralkap hminthang lawnglawng an si. An tefa pawl cu ralkap ṭuan thei thawng hleisarih le zahnih an ti."},"12":{"text":"Shuppim le Huppim tla cu Ir ih hrin an si. Dan ih tesinfa pawl cu Hushim le Aher ih fapa pawl an si."},"13":{"text":"Naftali in fapa pali a nei ih Jahziel, Guni, Jezer le Shallum an si. (Hi pawl cu Bilhah ih tefa sin pawl an si.)","title":"Naftali Tesinfa Pawl"},"14":{"text":"Manasseh in nusun, Aramean nunau nu, a nei ih fapa pahnih Asriel le Makhir an nei. Makhir cu Gilead ih pa a si.","title":"Manasseh Tesinfa Pawl"},"15":{"text":"Makhir in Huppim le Shuppim ih farnu nupi ah a ṭhit. Cunu hmin cu Maakah a si. Makhir ih fapa pahnihnak cu Zelofehad a si; Zelofehad in fanu lawnglawng a nei."},"16":{"text":"Cun Makhir ih nupi Maakah in fapa pahnih a hring ih an hminah Peresh le Sheresh an sak. Hi pawl cu Gilead tesinfa pawl an si ih, Gilead cu Makhir fapa le Manasseh ih fasuan a si."},"18":{"text":"Cun Gilead farnu Hammolekheth in fapa pathum a nei ih Ishod, Abiezer le Mahlah an si."},"19":{"text":"Shemida in fapa pali a nei ih Ahian, Shekhem, Likhi le Aniam an si."},"20":{"text":"Efraim ih tesinfa pawl cu sankhat hnu sankhat a sangsang in a tanglam pawl hi an si: Shuthelah, Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,","title":"Efraim Tesinfa Pawl"},"21":{"text":"Zabad, le Shuthelah an si. Efraim in a dang fapa pahnih Ezer le Elead a nei; asinain Gath ih a ummi pawl ih caw a ruk an tum laiah an rak that a si."},"22":{"text":"An pa Efraim cu mithi ngai in a um ih a unau pawl in an ra topi."},"23":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a nupi thawn an pawl-aw ih a nupi cu fa a keng ih fapa pakhat a nei. An fapa cu, an innsang ih riahsiatnak an ton hrangah, a hminah Beriah an sak."},"24":{"text":"Efraim in fanu pakhat Sheerah a nei. Sheerah cun Tlunta le Thuaita Beth Horon khua le Uzzen Sheerah khua thar a toh."},"25":{"text":"Efraim in fapa dang pakhat Refah a nei ih Refah ih tesinfa pawl cu Reshef, Telah, Tahan,"},"26":{"text":"Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama,"},"27":{"text":"Nun le Joshua an si."},"28":{"text":"Himi pawl in an luah mi le an umnak khua pawl cu Bethel le a kiangkap khua pawl, nisuahnak lamah Naaran tiang, cule nitlaknak lamah Gezer le a kiangkap khua pawl tiang, a si. Shekhem le Ayyah khua le a kiangkap khawpi pawl tla an tel."},"29":{"text":"Manasseh tesinfa pawl in Beth Sean, Taanak, Megiddo le Dor khawpi pawl le an kiangkap ih khua pawl an uk. Hi ramah hin Jakob fapa Josef ih tesinfa pawl an um."},"30":{"text":"Asher ih tefa sin pawl cu a tanglam hi an si. Asher in fapa pali a nei ih Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi le Beriah an si. Fanu pakhat a nei ih a hmin cu Serah a si.","title":"Asher Tesinfa Pawl"},"31":{"text":"Beriah in fapa pahnih Heber le Malkhiel a nei. Fanu pakhat a nei ih Shua a si."},"33":{"text":"Jaflet in fapa pathum a nei ih Pasak, Bimhal le Ashvath an si."},"34":{"text":"A nau Shomer in fapa pathum a nei ih Rohgah, Jehubbah le Aram an si."},"35":{"text":"A nau Hotham in fapa pali a nei ih Zofah, Imna, Shelesh le Amal an si."},"36":{"text":"Zofah ih tesinfa pawl cu Suah, Harnefer, Shual, Beri, Imrah,"},"37":{"text":"Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran le Beera an si."},"38":{"text":"Jether tesinfa pawl cu Jefunneh, Pispa le Ara an si;"},"39":{"text":"Ulla tesinfa pawl cu Arah, Hanniel le Rizia an si."},"40":{"text":"An zatein Asher ih tesinfa pawl an si. An zatein an hrinih lubik ciar an si ih ralkap hminthang le hotu ṭhazet pawl an si. Anmah lakah ralkap ṭuan thei minung thawng kul hluanruk an um."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin in fapa panga a nei. Upa bik in nauta bik tiang a sangsang in Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,","title":"Benjamin Tesinfa Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Nohah le Rafa an si."},"3":{"text":"Bela ih tesinfa pawl cu Addar, Gera, Abihud,"},"4":{"text":"Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,"},"5":{"text":"Gera, Shefufan le Huram an si."},"6":{"text":"Ehud tesinfa pawl cu Naaman, Ahijah le Gera an si. Geba ah an um ih an hrin ciar ih lubik an si; asinain an dawi hai ih Manahath ih um ding in an ceer. Uzza le Ahihud ih pa Gera ih honak in an ṭhawn.","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Shaharaim in a nupi pahnih Hushim le Baara cu a maak. A fapa pawl cu an sungkhat ih lubik ciar an si."},"11":{"text":"Shaharaim cun a nupi Hushim thawn fapa pahnih an nei ih Abitub le Elpaal an si."},"12":{"text":"Elpaal in fapa pathum a nei: Eber, Misham le Shemed an si. Shemed cu Ono le Lod khawpi le an kiangkap ih khawte pawl dintu a si."},"13":{"text":"Beriah le Shema cu Aijalon khua ih a ummi anmah ih sungkhat pawl lubik veve an si ih Gath khua ih a rak ummi pawl tla an dawisuak a si.","title":"Gath Le Aijalon Ram Ah Benjamin Mi Pawl"},"14":{"text":"Beriah tesinfa pawl cu Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,"},"15":{"text":"Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,"},"16":{"text":"Mikhael, Ishfah le Joha an si."},"17":{"text":"Elpaal ih tesinfa pawl cu Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,","title":"Jerusalem Ih Benjamin Mi Pawl"},"18":{"text":"Ishmerai, Izliah le Jobab tla an si."},"19":{"text":"Shimei tesinfa pawl cu Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi,"},"20":{"text":"Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,"},"21":{"text":"Adaiah, Beraiah le Shimrath tla an si."},"22":{"text":"Shashak tesinfa pawl cu Ishfan, Eber, Eliel,"},"23":{"text":"Abdon, Zikri, Hanan,"},"24":{"text":"Hananiah, Elam, Anthothija,"},"25":{"text":"Ifdeiah le Penuel tla an si."},"26":{"text":"Jeroham tesinfa pawl cu Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,"},"27":{"text":"Jaareshiah, Elijah le Zikri tla an si."},"28":{"text":"Himi pawl cu an pupa san ihsin Jerusalem ih ummi an tesinfa san tiangin lubik pawl an si."},"29":{"text":"Jeiel in Gibeon khua a toh ih a um. An tesinfa pawl cu Jerusalem khua ah an hrin sungkhat dang pawl kiangah an um."},"33":{"text":"Ner cu Kish ih pa a si ih, Kish cu Saul ih pa a si. A tlun ih hmin nganmi pawl cu an zatein Benjamin hrin lawnglawng an si."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an hrin ciarin cazin sungih nganmi an si ih cumi cu Israel Siangpahrang Pawlih Cabu timi a si. Judah mi pawl cu an sual ruangah Babilon ah sal ah an taang.","title":"Saltaannak Ihsin An Kir"},"2":{"text":"An khua le an inn ih a kir hmaisa bik pawl cu Israel mipi hrekkhat, puithiam pawl, Levi mi pawl le Biakinn ih hnaṭuantu pawl an si."},"3":{"text":"Judah hrin, Benjamin hrin, Efraim hrin le Manasseh hrin pawl cu Jerusalem ah an feh ih an um."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Judah hrin innsang zaruk le sawmkua an um. Judah fapa Perez ih tesinfa pawl hotu cu Uthai a si; Uthai cu Ammihud fapa a si ih Omri ih fasuan a si. A pupa dang cu Imri le Bani an si. Judah fapa Shelah ih tesinfa pawl hotu cu Asaiah a si ih an sungih lubik a si. Judah fapa Zerah ih tesinfa pawl hotu cu Jeuel a si.","merge":"5"},"7":{"text":"Benjamin hrin sungin a tanglam mi pawl cu Jerusalem ah an um: Meshullam ih fapa Sallu; Meshullam cu Hodaviah ih fapa a si ih, Hodaviah cu Hassenuah ih fapa a si. Jeroham ih fapa Ibneiah; Uzzi ih fapa le Mikri ih fasuan Elah; Shefatiah ih fapa Meshullam; Shefatiah cu Reuel ih fapa a si ih Reuel cu Ibnijah ih fapa a si.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Jerusalem ah an hrin sungin innsang zatein zakua le sawmnga paruk an um. A tlunih hmin nganmi pawl cu sungkhat ih lubik ciar an si."},"10":{"text":"A tanglam hi Jerusalem ih ummi puithiam pawl an si: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib le Jakhin. Hilkiah ih fapa Azariah cu Biakinn ih hotu bik a si. A pupa pawl cu Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth le Ahitub an si. Jeroham ih fapa Adaiah; a pupa pawl cu Pashhur le Malkhijah an si. Adiel ih fapa Maasai; a pupa pawl cu Jedaiah, Meshullam, Meshillemith le Immer an si.","title":"Jerusalem Ih Ummi Puithiam Pawl","merge":"11"},"13":{"text":"Innsang ciarih lu a si mi puithiam zatein thawngkhat zasarih le sawmruk an um. Anmah tla cu Biakinn ih hnaṭuannak ah a thiamzetmi an si."},"14":{"text":"A tanglam pawl cu Jerusalem ih um Levi mi an si: Hasshub ih fapa Shemaiah; a pupa pawl cu Azrikam le Hashabiah, an si ih Merari hrin an si. Bakbakkar, Heresh le Galal; Mika ih fapa Mattaniah; a pupa pawl cu Zikri le Asaf an si. Shemaiah ih fapa Obadiah; a pupa pawl cu Galal le Jeduthun an si. Asa ih fapa le Elkanah ih fasuan Berekhiah; amah cu Netofah mi pawl ih ram sungah a ummi a si.","title":"Jerusalem Ih Um Levi Mi Pawl","merge":"15"},"17":{"text":"A tanglam pawl cu Jerusalem Biakinn kiltu an si: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon le Ahiman. An hotu cu Shallum a si.","title":"Jerusalem Biakinn Kiltu Pawl"},"18":{"text":"Tuihsan tiangin an hrin pawl cu nisuahnak lam sangka, Siangpahrang Kotka ah an ret. Ahlan ahcun Levi mi pawl riahhmun kotka kiltu an si."},"19":{"text":"Kore ih fapa le Ebiasaf ih fasuan Shallum cu Korah hrinpi dangdang pawl thawn, Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam luhnak sangka kiltu an si; an pupa pawl tla Bawipa ih riahhmun an kil laiah cuvek cun an rak kil zo."},"20":{"text":"Eleazar ih fapa Finehas in a rak ho hai; Bawipa cu a hnenah um hram seh!"},"21":{"text":"Meshelemiah ih fapa Zekhariah khal Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam sangka kiltu a si ve."},"22":{"text":"An zate-ah minung zahnih le hleihnih cu sangka le kotka pawl kiltu dingah an hril. Anmah tla cu an umnak khua ciarih cazin lak mi an si. An pupa pawl cu zumtlak an si ruangah siangpahrang David le profet Samuel in cubangtuk hnaṭuan thupi cu an rak ṭuanter."},"23":{"text":"Anmah le an tesinfa pawl tiangin Biakinn cu an kil ringring."},"24":{"text":"A kiil pali: saklam, thlanglam, nisuah le nitlak lamah kotka pakhat fingfing a um ih a kiltu upabik an um fingfing."},"25":{"text":"Hi kotka kiltu pawl cu khawte ih a ummi an sungkhat pawl in an bawm hai ih a haha in ni sarih sung an kil ṭheu."},"26":{"text":"Kotka kiltu upabik pali pawl cu Levi mi an si ih ṭuanvo tumbik an nei. Biakinn sungih khaan pawl le a sungih an retmi thilri pawl tla an kilkhawi."},"27":{"text":"Biakinn kilkhawi le zingtin kotka on cu an ṭuanvo a si ruangah Biakinn kiangah an umnak cu a si."},"28":{"text":"A dang Levi mi pawl cu Biakinn sung Pathian biaknak ih hmanmi bungbeel pawl kilkhawitu an si. An hman hlanah an siar ih an hman hnu khalah an siarsal.","title":"Levi Mi Dangdang"},"29":{"text":"A dang pawl cu hmanmi thilri thianghlim dang pawl, sangphut, sabitti, olif hriak, rimhmui le thakthiing vut pawl zohtu an si."},"30":{"text":"Asinain thakthiing vut tuah ih cokrawi hnaṭuan cu puithiam pawl ih ṭuanvo a si."},"31":{"text":"Korah hrin, Shallum ih fapa upabik, Levi mi pa Mattithiah ih ṭuanvo cu sangrawh thawinak hrang timtuah a si."},"32":{"text":"Kohath mi pawl cu Sabbath ni Biakinn ih hman dingah sangreu thianghlim tuahtu an si."},"33":{"text":"Levi mi hrekkhat pawl cu Biakinn ih hla satu pawl an si. Innsang ih lubik pawl an si ih Biakinn kap a khaan sungah an um. A sun a zan ih hnaṭuan an neih ṭheu ruangah hnaṭuan dang zianghman an nei lo."},"34":{"text":"A tlunih an hmin nganmi pawl cu Levi mi innsang ih lubik ciar le anmah hrin ciarah hotu an si. Jerusalem ih a ummi pawl lakah hotu an si."},"35":{"text":"Jeiel cu Gibeon khawsattu a si ih cutawkah a um. A nupi cu Maakah a si ih,","title":"Siangpahrang Saul Ih Pupa Le Tesinfa (1 San. 8.29-38)"},"36":{"text":"a fapa upabik cu Abdon a si. A fapa dang pawl cu Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,"},"37":{"text":"Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah le Mikloth an si."},"38":{"text":"Mikloth cu Shimeah ih pa a si. An tesinfa pawl cu an hrin sungkhat pawl kiangkap Jerusalem ah an um."},"39":{"text":"Ner cu Kish ih pa a si ih Kish cu Saul ih pa a si. Cule Saul in fapa pali a nei ih Jonathan, Malkhishua, Abinadab le Eshbaal an si."},"40":{"text":"Jonathan cu Meribbaal ih pa a si ih Meribbaal cu Mikah ih pa a si."},"41":{"text":"Mikah in fapa pali a nei: Pithon, Melek, Tarea le Ahaz an si."},"42":{"text":"Ahaz cu Jarah ih pa a si ih, Jarah cun fapa pathum a nei: Alemeth, Azmaveth le Zimri an si. Zimri cu Moza ih pa a si ih,"},"43":{"text":"Moza cu Binea ih pa a si; Binea cu Refaiah ih pa a si; Refaiah cu Eleasah ih pa a si ih, Eleasah cu Azel ih pa a si."},"44":{"text":"Cule Azel in fapa paruk a nei: Azrikam, Bokheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah le Hanan an si."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Filistin mi le Israel mi cu Gilboa Tlang ah an do aw. Israel mi tampi an thi ih a taangmi pawl cu, siangpahrang Saul le a fapa pawl thawn, an tlan thluh.","title":"Siangpahrang Saul A Thi (1 Sam 31.1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Asinain Filistin ralkap in Saul le a fapa pawl cu an man ih a fapa Jonathan, Abinadab le Malkhishua cu an that."},"3":{"text":"Saul umnak kimvelah cun nasa cuangin an do-aw ih cu ruangah Saul cu ral pawl ih conkiang in a ngah ih besia zetin hma a pu."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah a hriamnam kengtu tlangvalpa hnenah, “Na ralnam zuuk-awla i that aw; culole hi serhtan lomi Filistin pawl hi ra in in puahcok pang ding,” a ti. Asinain cuih tlangvalpa cun a tuk a sum ih a ti ngam lo. Curuangah Saul cun amah ih ralnam cu a zuuk ih a zum lamin a nen that-aw."},"5":{"text":"Saul a thih kha tlangvalpa in a hmuh tikah a ralnam a suah ve ih a zum lamin a nen ih a thi ve."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun Saul le a fapa pathum cu hmunkhatah an thi ih a ram uknak tla a cem veta a si."},"7":{"text":"Cule Jezreel phairawn ih a ummi Israel pawl in an ralkap pawl an tlan ṭheh ih, Saul le a fapa pawl an thi, ti an theih tikah an khua ciarin an suak ih suk le so ah an tlanhlo ṭheh. Filistin mi pawl cu an ra ih cuih khua pawl cu an luahta."},"8":{"text":"An do awk ih thaisun ah a thimi pawl ih thilri la dingah Filistin mi pawl an feh ih Saul le a fapa pawl ih ruak cu Gilboa Tlang parih an lum teptep kha an hmu."},"9":{"text":"Saul ih lu cu an tan ih a ralthuam pawl an hlit ih a lu le a hriamnam pawl phur tahrat in an khawzing le an minung pawl hnenih thuthang ṭha phuang dingin mi an thlah."},"10":{"text":"Saul ih hriamnam cu an khawzing biakinn ah an ret ih, a lu cu an khawzing Dagon ih biakinn ah an thlai."},"11":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl in Saul parih cuti an tuahmi cu Gilead ram Jabesh mi in an theih tikah,"},"12":{"text":"mi ralṭha bik pawl an pok ih Saul le a fapa pawl ruak cu Jabesh khua ah an phur. Cutawkih sasuapi thuai ah an ruh cu an phum ih ni sarih sung rawl an ul."},"13":{"text":"Saul cu Bawipa parih a sual ruangah thihnak a tong a si; Bawipa ih thupekmi a thlun lo; Bawipa thuron tahrat in a duhnak thlun sawn loin,"},"14":{"text":"pol leeng tahrat in mithi thla a ko sawn a si. Curuangah Bawipa in a that ih a uknak cu Jesse ih fapa David hnenah a pek."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an zatein David umnak Hebron ah an ra ih, “Kannih cu na thii le na sa kan si.","title":"David Cu Judah Le Israel Siangpahrang A Cang (2 Sam 5.1-10)"},"2":{"text":"A fehzo mi tikcu caan, Saul kan siangpahrang a si lai hmanah Israel mi pawl cu raldonak ah na hruai ih cutiih hruai dingah le anmah uktu si dingah Bawipa na Pathian in thu a lo tiam zo a si,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cuticun David hnenah Israel mi hotu pawl cu Hebron ahcun an ra ṭheh. Cule Bawipa ih mithmuh ah David thawn thukamnak an tuah ih Samuel hnenin Bawipa ih thutiam vekin David cu Israel siangpahrang ah hriak an culh a si."},"4":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang David le Israel mi pawl cu an zatein an feh ih Jerusalem khawpi an do. Jerusalem khawpi cu culai ahcun Jebus an ti; a rak um hmaisa bik Jebus mi pawl cu cutawkah an um lai."},"5":{"text":"Jebus mi pawl in David cu, “Kan khawpi sungah cun na lut thei dah lo ding,” an ti. Asinain Zion ih an ralhruang cu David in a lak ih an khawpi cu “David Khawpi,” ah a cang."},"6":{"text":"David in, “Jebus mi a that hmaisa biktu cu ka ralkap hotu bawi a si ding,” a ti. Zeruiah fapa Joab ho in an do ih amah cu ralkap hotu bawi ah a cang ngaingai."},"7":{"text":"Ralhruang sungah David cu a feh ih a umta ruangah, “David Khawpi,” tiah an ko tata."},"8":{"text":"Cuih ralhruang ih nisuahnak lam Millo an tinak hmunih thokin khawpi kimvel ralhruang cu David in a rem ih khawpi sung cu Joab in a rem."},"9":{"text":"A hnenih Ziangkimtithei Bawipa a um ruangah David cu ni khat hnu ni khat a cak deuhdeuh."},"10":{"text":"David ih ralkap hminthang pawl cu a tanglam pawl hi an si. Anmah in Israel midang pawl thawn siangpahrang cang dingah David cu an bawm ih, Bawipa ih thutiam vekin, a uknak cu cak sinsin in an tuah.","title":"David Ih Ralkap Hminthang Pawl (2 Sam 23.8-39)"},"11":{"text":"Hmaisa bik cu Hakmon hrin Jashobeam a si ih amah cu, “Ralṭha Pathum,” lakah hotu a si. Jashobeam in an ral minung zathum kha a feipi thawn a do ih ṭum khatah an zatein a that ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Hi “Ralṭha Pathum Pawl,” lakih a pahnihnak cu Ahoh hrin Dodo ih fapa Eleazar a si."},"13":{"text":"Pas Dammim an timi hmunah Filistin ral pawl cu David thawn an do. Barli sangvut lo sungah ṭanhmun khuar ih Israel ralkap pawl an tlan rero laiah,"},"14":{"text":"Eleazar le a ralkap pawl cu lo sungah cun an ṭang ih Filistin pawl cu an do ciamco. Bawipa ih thawngin an ral cu nasa zetin an neh."},"15":{"text":"Voikhat ah Filistin ral pawl cu Refaim phairawn ih an um laiah, an hmin a thang zetmi Israel ralbawi sawmthum sungin pathum cu Adullam lungpuk kiang lungto lakih David a um laiah a hnenah an feh."},"16":{"text":"David cu ralhruang kulhmi tlang parah a um ih culaiah Bethlehem cu Filistin mi pawl in an lak zo."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah David cu inn a ngai ngaingai ih, “Aw, Bethlehem kotka kiang tikhur ih tidai kha in dingah pakhatkhatión i pe hai sehla ka va duh so e!” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah ralkap hminthang pathum cu an feh ih Filistin ralkap pawl umnak lakin an nor suak ih cuih tikhur ihsin tidai an khai ih David cu an ra pek. Sikhalsehla David cun a in lo; Bawipa hnenih hlanmi tidai ah tiah a thlet ih,"},"19":{"text":"“Ziangtin so hi tidai cu ka in thei ding! An nunnak hman ruat loih an khaimi tidai a si hrangah hi tidai in cu an thisen in vek a si ding,” a ti. Curuangah cuih tidai cu a in lo. Ralkap hminthang Pathum Pawl ih hnaṭuan ṭha pawl lakah himi cu pakhat a si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Joab unau Abishai cu “Hminthang Sawmthum Pawl,” lakah mi hminthang a si. A feipi thawn minung zathum a do ih a that ṭheh. Cutiin hminthang sawmthum lakah hminthang a si."},"21":{"text":"Sawmthum Pawl lakih hminthang bik a si ruangah an hotu ah a cang; asinain “Ralṭha Pathum,” tluk cun a hmin a thang lo."},"22":{"text":"Kabzeel khua mi Jehoiada fapa Benaiah cu ralkap hminthang zet a si. Ralṭha zet ih a hnaṭuan mi tampi a um; Moab ralbawi cak zetzet pahnih tla a that. Voikhat cu vur tampi a tlak ni ah kuahrum sungah a vung ṭum ih kiosa a that."},"23":{"text":"Cule mitum zet le misaang zet: pi sarih le a hrek a saangih feipi thiamtleeng tia a kengtu Izipt mipa khal a that. Behaiah cun talhtum thawn a zon ih Izipt pa kutih feipi rori long tahrat in cupa thahnak ah a hmang."},"24":{"text":"Cumi pawl cu Benaiah ralṭha zet ih hnaṭuannak pawl an si; amah cu, “Sawmthum Pawl,” lakah pakhat a si ve."},"25":{"text":"“Sawmthum Pawl,” lakah cun hminthang pakhat a si; asinain “Pathum Pawl,” cu a tluk lo. David in amah kilvengtu pawl hotu ah a ret."},"26":{"text":"A tanglam pawl hi ralkap hminthang an si: Joab unau Asahel Bethlehem ihsin Dodo ih fapa Elhanan Harod ihsin Shammoth Pelet ihsin Helez Tekoa ihsin Ikkesh ih fapa Ira Anathoth ihsin Abiezer Hushah ihsin Sibbekai Ahoh ihsin Ilai Netofah ihsin Maharai Netofah ihsin Baanah ih fapa Heled Benjamin ram Gibeah ihsin Ribai ih fapa Ithai Pirathon ihsin Benaiah Gaash kiang hmunrawn ihsin Hurai Arbah ihsin Abiel Bahurum ihsin Azmaveth Shaalbon ihsin Eliahba Gizon ihsin Hashem Harar ihsin Shagee ih fapa Jonathan Harar ihsin Sakhar ih fapa Ahiam Ur ih fapa Elifal Mekherah ihsin Hefer Pelon ihsin Ahijah Karmel ihsin Hezro Ezbai ih fapa Naarai Nathan unau Joel Hagrit ih fapa Mibhar Ammon ihsin Zelek Beeroth ihsin Naharai. Naharai cu Joab hriamnam phurtu a si. Jattir ihsin Ira le Gareb Hit mi Uriah Ahlai ih fapa Zabad Shiza ih fapa Adina. Adina cu Reuben hrin sungah hminthang a si ih ralkap sawmthum a neitu a si. Maakah ih fapa Hanan Mithan ihsin Joshafat Ashterah ihsin Uzzia Aroer ihsin Hotham ih fapa Shamma le Jeiel Tiz ihsin Shimri ih fapa Jediael le Joha Mahavah ihsin Eliel Elnaam ih fapa Jeribai le Joshaviah Moab ihsin Ithmah Zobah ihsin Eliel, Obed le Jaasiel.","merge":"27"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Saul, Kish ih fapa in a mithmuh ah David um lo dingin a dawihlo hnuah David cu Ziklag ah a um. Cutawkah mi tampi a hnenah an ra ih an um ve. Annih pawl cu raldo ṭhangmi le rinsantlak zetzet ralkap lawnglawng an si ih,","title":"Benjamin Mi David Thluntu Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang Saul vekin Benjamin miphun an si. Li le conkiang siseh, lungherhden siseh, an duhduh in keh le vorh ih sai le denthiam thiam an si."},"3":{"text":"An hotu pawl cu Gibeah ihsin Shemaah ih fapa Ahiezer le Joash an si. An ralkap pawl cu a tanglam vekin an si: Azmaveth ih fapa Jeziel le Pelet, Anathoth ihsin Berakah le Jehu,"},"4":{"text":"Ralkap hminthangzet le “Sawmthum Pawl,” sungih hotu pakhat a si mi, Gibeon ihsin Ishmaiah, Gederah ihsin Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan le Jozabad;"},"5":{"text":"Harif ihsin Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah le Shefatiah;"},"6":{"text":"Korah hrin in Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer le Jashobeam;"},"7":{"text":"Gedor ihsin Jeroham ih fapa Joelah le Zebadiah."},"8":{"text":"Nelrawn ah ralhruang kulhmi hmunih David a um laiah Gad mi ralkap hminthang pawl ra in a hnenah an um. Anmah cu raldo ṭhangtu an si ih phaw le fei hmannak lamah cun an thiam ngaingai; an mithmai cu zoh tikah kiosa bangin ṭihnungza an si ih an zam a ṭhatzia cu tlangpar zukneng vek an si.","title":"Gad Hrin In David Thluntu Pawl"},"9":{"text":"Anmah lakih hotu bik ihsin nautabik tiang a sangsang in hipawl hi an si: Ezer, Obadiah, Eliab, Mishmannah, Jeremiah, Attai, Eliel, Johanan, Elzabad, Jeremiah, le Makbannai an si.","merge":"10"},"14":{"text":"Hi Gad mi pawl hi a hrek cu ralbawi upa an si ih ralkap thawngkhat hotu an si; a hrek cu ralbawi nauta deuh an si ih zakhat hotu an si."},"15":{"text":"Kum khat sungih thla hmaisa bik thla, Jordan Tiva ti a lian ih phai a hrut laifangah tiva cu an tan ih tiva ihsin nisuahnak lam siseh, nitlaknak lam siseh, a rak ummi minung pawl cu suk le so ah an dawihlo thluh."},"16":{"text":"Nikhat ah Benjamin le Judah hrin in milai hrekkhat cu David umnak ruh-kulh sungah cun an va thleng.","title":"Benjamin Le Judah Mi David Thluntu Pawl"},"17":{"text":"David cun a rak hmuak hai ih an hnenah, “Keimah bawm dingah rualpi ṭha in nan rat a si ahcun kan hnenah ra uh. Asinain ka ral pawl hnenih zuar tum in nan rat a si ahcun, nanmah tuahmawh ding cu ka tum dah lo naón, nan tummi cu kan pupa ih Pathian in a hmu ding ih a lo cawh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah, “Sawmthum Pawl,” sungah hotu a rung cang lehmi Amasai parah thlarau a rung thleng ih anih in: “Maw David, na minung kan si; Maw Jesse fapa, nangmah ih lam ṭang kan si. Na parah daihnak umseh, A lo bawmtu hnenah hnangamnak umseh, Pathian na hnenah a um,” a ti. Cule David in annih cu amah ih minung ah a tuah ih a ralkap sungah hotu ah a ret hai."},"19":{"text":"David le Filistin mi pawl cu siangpahrang Saul do dingih an feh laiah Manasseh hrin sungin ralkap hrekkhat pawl cu David hnenah an ra. David in Filistin mi a bawm a si lo; an feh tlang hnuah Filistin lal pawl in a bawipa a rak si dahmi Saul hnenah in zuar pang ding ti an phan ruangah David cu Ziklag ah an kirter a si.","title":"Manasseh Hrin Ihsin David Thluntu Pawl"},"20":{"text":"Ziklag ih a kir zawng ah Manasseh hrin a hnenih a rami ralkap pawl cu: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Mikhael, Jozabad, Elihu le Zillethai an si. Manasseh ramih an um laiah cun ralkap thawngkhat hotu ciar an si."},"21":{"text":"Ralkap hminthang zetzet an si ruangah David ralkap pawl hotu bawi ah an cang. Neta lamah cun Israel ralkap sungah ralbawi an si."},"22":{"text":"Nitinte in David hnenah midang an ra vivo ih a rei hlanah David ralkap cu an tam ih an cak ngaingai."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa thutiamnak vekin David cu Saul ai-ih siangpahrang cangter dingin raldo ṭhang ralkap tampi cu Hebron ah David hnenah cun an ra ciamco. A ra mi pawl cu a tanglam vekin an si:","title":"David Ralkap Pawl Cazin"},"24":{"text":"Judah hrin in ralthuam a keng fetfet mi thawngruk le zariat; phaw le feipi an keng ciar;"},"25":{"text":"Simeon hrin in raldo zir cia ralkap thawngsarih le zakhat;"},"26":{"text":"Levi hrin in ralkap thawngli le zaruk;"},"27":{"text":"Aaron tesinfa pawl hotu Jehoiada a thluntu ralkap thawngthum le zasarih;"},"28":{"text":"Raldo thiam mino Zadok ih sungkhat minung kul hluanhnih; anmah cu hotu hlir an si;"},"29":{"text":"Benjamin hrin in ralkap thawng thum; Saul cu Benjamin hrin a si hrangah Benjamin mi tam sawn in cuih sun tiang Saul an ṭan."},"30":{"text":"Efraim hrin in, an hrin sungih ralkap hminthang, thawng kul le zariat;"},"31":{"text":"Nitlaknak lam Manasseh in, David siangpahrang cangtertu ding ih hrilmi pawl, minung thawng hleiriat;"},"32":{"text":"Issakhar hrin in hotu zahnih le an kuthnuai ih ralkap ciar thawn; himi pawl cu Israel hrangah ziang kan tuah ah a ṭha bik tile ziangtikah tuah ding a si, ti a theitu pawl an si."},"33":{"text":"Zebulun hrin in raldo hiarzet le rinsan tlakzet, ziangvek hriamnam khal a hmangthiamtu ralkap thawng sawmnga;"},"34":{"text":"Naftali hrin in phaw le feipi thawn a thuam awmi ralkap bawi thawngkhat le ralkap thawng sawmthum le thawng sarih;"},"35":{"text":"Dan hrin in raldo zir cia ralkap thawng kul hluanriat le zaruk;"},"36":{"text":"Asher hrin in raldo zir cia ralkap thawng sawmli;"},"37":{"text":"Jordan Tiva in nisuahnak lamih ummi Reuben, Gad le Nisuahnak lam Manasseh hrin pawl in hriamnam a phunphun hmangthiam ko ih zirh ciami ralkap thawng za le thawng kul."},"38":{"text":"Ralkap hizat cu raldo dingin an timtuah cia ṭheh in Hebron ah an feh; an tumtahmi cu David kha Israel siangpahrang canter ding lawnglawng a si. Israel mi dangdang khal cubangtuk tumtahnak nei in an um ṭheh."},"39":{"text":"Ramsung minung pawl ih rak tawlrel sak ciami ti le rawl, in le ei in cutawkah David thawn ni thum sung an umtlang."},"40":{"text":"Saklampi ih a ummi Issakhar, Zebulun le Naftali hrin pawl tiangin laak, kalauk, rang le caw pawl in sangphut, theipi sangrawh, sabit caar, sabitti le olif hriak, pawl an run phur ciamco. An ei dingah caw le tuu tla an keng. Hitiih an ken ciamco cu an ram pumpi in lungawinak an neihzia a langnak a si."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David cu a ralkap thawngkhat hotu le zakhat hotu ralbawi pawl thawn an tongkhawm aw.","title":"Thukam Kuang Kiriath Jearim In An ṭhawn (2 Sam 6.1-11)"},"2":{"text":"Cule cutawkih a ratu Israel mi pawl hnenah cun, “Nannih nan lung a kim ih Bawipa kan Pathian tla a lung a kim a si ahcun kan ramsung minung pawl, puithiam le Levi mi pawl hnenah mi kan thlah pei ih kanmah hnenih ra pumkhawm ve dingah kan sim pei."},"3":{"text":"Cun kan feh pei ih Saul siangpahrang a si lai ih thlauthlakmi Pathian ih Thukam Kuang cu kan lak pei,” tiah a than."},"4":{"text":"A thupol mi cu an lung a kim ih an lung tla a awi ngaingai."},"5":{"text":"Cuticun David hnenah Israel mi pawl cu thlanglam ah Izipt ramri in le saklam ah Hamath Tlangkawn ih a ummi tiangin an ra. Kiriath Jearim khawpi ihsin Thukam Kuang la dingin an rakhawm ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Cule David le Israel mi pawl cu Judah ram Kiriath Jearim khawpi, (a si lole Baalah khawpi timi) ahcun Cherubim tlun, sunlawinak hmunih a totu Bawipa in hmin a kengtu Thukam Kuang cu lak dingah an feh."},"7":{"text":"Abinadab inn an thlen tikah Thukam Kuang cu an lak ih cawleng thar parah an ret. Uzzah le Ahio in cawleng cu an khor ih,"},"8":{"text":"David le Israel misenpi pawl cu Pathian thangṭhat in an tha neih patawp in an laam ciamco. Hla an sak ih ṭingṭang, khuang, dar sumsel le tawtawrawt an tum."},"9":{"text":"Khidon an timi hmunih fang ciilnak puum an thlen tikah cawcang pawl cu an bah ih curuangah Uzzah in a hei dawh ih Thukam Kuang cu a hei dom."},"10":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Bawipa cu Uzzah parah a thin a heng ih Thukam Kuang a tham ruangah a that. Cutawk Bawipa ih hmai ahcun a thi."},"11":{"text":"Cutiih Uzzah parah Bawipa a thin a heng ruangah David cu a thin a heng ngaingai. Curuangah cuih hmun cu Perez Uzzah tiah an tita."},"12":{"text":"Cule David in Pathian cu a ṭih ngaingai ih, “Hi Thukam Kuang cu ziangtinso atu ahcun ka fehpi ngam ding?” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah David in Thukam Kuang cu Jerusalem ah a fehpi lo. Gath khuami pa Obed Edom an timi pa inn ah a taanta."},"14":{"text":"Cutawkah cun thla thum a um ih Bawipa in a innsang le a neihmi hmuahhmuah cu thluasuah a pek."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ṭaiar siangpahrang Hiram in David hnenah palai a thlah ih siangpahrang inn saknak hrangah sidar thing pawl, lung sertu pawl le zungthiam pawl tla a kuat.","title":"Jerusalem Ah David Ih Cangvaihnak (2 Sam 5.11-16)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel siangpahrang ah i tuah zo ih Amah ih minung pawl ruangah ka uknak cu a ṭhangso a si, ti cu David in a thei."},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ahcun David in nupi tampi a ṭhi ih fapa le fanu tampi a nei."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem ih a hrinmi a fapa pawl ih hmin cu: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,"},"5":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,"},"6":{"text":"Nogah, Nefeg, Jafia,"},"7":{"text":"Elishamma, Beeliada le Elifelet an si."},"8":{"text":"Filistin mi pawl in Israel ram pumpi tlunah David cu siangpahrang a si zo, ti an theih tikah kai dingin an ralkap pawl an feh. Cumi cu David in a theih tikah Filistin ralkap do dingin a pok.","title":"Filistin Ral A Neh (2 Sam 5.17-25)"},"9":{"text":"Filistin pawl cu Refaim phairawn an thleng ih cuih hrawng mi pawl an ram ciamco."},"10":{"text":"David in Bawipa hnenah, “Filistin mi pawl hi ka do ding maw? Ka neh hai ding maw?” tiah a sut. Bawipa in, “Do aw, na neh ding,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah David in Filistin mi pawl cu Baal Perazim ah a do ih a neh. Cutikah David in, “Ral pawl nehsuak dingah Bawipa in tilian bangin i hmang a si,” a ti. Curuangah cuih hmun cu Baal Perazim tiah an ko."},"12":{"text":"Cutawkah Filistin mi pawl in an milem pawl tla an tlansan thluh ih cupawl cu ur dingah David in thu a pek ih an ur ṭheh."},"13":{"text":"A rei hlanah phairawn ih ummi pawl kha Filistin mi pawl in an ra ram sal lala."},"14":{"text":"David in Bawipa a sut lala ih Bawipa in, “Hitawk lam cun do hlah aw; heel awla khatlam in balsam theikung pawl umnak kiangin do aw."},"15":{"text":"Cuih theikung tlunih mi feh thawm vek na theih tikah do aw; ziangahtile Filistin ralkap nehtu dingah na hmaiah Keimah ka feh ding,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"David cun Pathian ih thupekmi vekin a tuah ih Filistin ral pawl cu Gibeon in Gezer thleng tiang a dawihlo."},"17":{"text":"David ih hmin cu khuazakip ah a thang ih Bawipa ih ruangah miphun hmuahhmuah in amah cu an ṭih."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in amah ih hrangah Jerusalem ah inn tampi a sak. Pathian Thukam Kuang hrangah hmun pakhat a zuah ih cutawkah puanthlam a sak.","title":"Thukam Kuang Ṭhawn An Tum"},"2":{"text":"Cule David in, “Levi mi pawl cu Thukham Kuang phurtu dingah le amah ih hnaṭuantu dingah Pathian ih hrilmi an si ruangah anmah lawng in Pathian ih Thukam Kuang cu an phur ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Puanthlam a sakmi sungih Thukam Kuang ret dingah Israel mi pawl cu David in Jerusalem ah a kokhawm ṭheh."},"4":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Levi mi pawl le Aaron tesinfa pawl a ko."},"5":{"text":"Kohath hrin Levi mi sung in Uriel a ra ih a hrinpi minung za le kul hotu a si."},"6":{"text":"Merari hrin in Asaiah a ra ih a hrinpi zahnih le kul hotu a si."},"7":{"text":"Gershom hrin in Joel a ra ih a hrinpi za le sawmthum hotu a si."},"8":{"text":"Elizafan hrin in Shemaiah a ra ih a hrinpi zahnih hotu a si."},"9":{"text":"Hebron hrin in Eliel a ra ih a hrinpi minung sawmriat hotu a si."},"10":{"text":"Uzziel hrin in Amminadab a ra ih a hrinpi minung za le hleihnih hotu a si."},"11":{"text":"Cun David in puithiam Zadok, Abiathar le Levi mi paruk Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, le Amminadab pawl a ko ih,"},"12":{"text":"an hnenah, “Nanmah hi Levi hrin pawl ih hotu cu nan si. Ka sak ciami inn sungih Bawipa , Israel Pathian ih Thukam Kuang nan run ret theinak dingah nanmah le nan Levi hrinpi pawl cu tithiangfai aw uh."},"13":{"text":"Hitiih Thukam Kuang phurhnak ih nan tel hi a hmaisa bik a si lo; Bawipa lungkim zawng in kan biak lo ruangah Bawipa kan Pathian in in hrem a si kha,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian ih Thukam Kuang la dingin puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl cu an tithiangfai awter."},"15":{"text":"Levi mi pawl in Thukam Kuang cu an liangah laang in an zawn ih Bawipa in Moses hnenih thu a pek vekin an tuah."},"16":{"text":"David in Levi mi hotu pawl hnenah an unau Levi mi pawl cu hla satu, ṭingṭang tumtu le darsumsel pawl tumtu tiah ṭhen dingin thu a pek."},"17":{"text":"Hla saktu pawl sungin Joel fapa Heman, a sungkhat Berekhiah ih fapa Asaf le Merari hrin in Kushaiah ih fapa Ethan cu darsumsel tumtu dingah an hril. Anmah bawmtu dingah a hnuailam Levi mi pawl cu ṭingṭang aw-feem tumtu dingah an hril: Zekhariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah le Benaiah. Cun ṭingṭang aw-pawr tumtu dingah a hnuailam Levi mi pawl cu an hril: Mattithiah, Elifelehu, Mikneiah, Azaziah le Biakinn kilvengtu Obed Edom le Jeiel tla an si.","merge":"18"},"22":{"text":"Levi mi awn-mawi tumtu pawl hotu dingah hla thiamzetmi Khenaniah an hril;"},"23":{"text":"Thukam Kuang kiltu dingah Berekhiah le Elkanah an hril."},"24":{"text":"Thukam Kuang hmai ih tawtawrawt tumtu dingah puithiam Shebaniah, Joshafat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zekhariah, Benaiah le Eliezer pawl an hril. Obed Edom le Jehiah khal Thukam Kuang retnak sangka kiltu an si ve."},"25":{"text":"David, Israel hruaitu pawl le ralkap hotu ralbawi pawl cu Thukam Kuang la dingin Obed Edom inn ahcun an feh ih lungawinak puai tumpi an tuah.","title":"Jerusalem Ah Thukam Kuang An ṭhawn (2 Sam 6.12-22)"},"26":{"text":"Pathian ih bomnak Thukam Kuang phurtu Levi mi pawl ih an co tengtengnak dingah cawcang pasarih le tuu pasarih that in thawinak an tuah."},"27":{"text":"David le awn-mawi tumtu pawl, an hla hotu Khenaniah le Thukam Kuang phurtu Levi mi pawl cu puan mawi le puan mankhung an sin ciar. Cuih tlunah David cun puithiam angki ṭaangthlaih a hruk."},"28":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi hmuahhmuah in Thukam Kuang cu an thlun ih lungawi in an au phah ih tawtawrawt, tuuki, darsumsel le ṭingṭang tum phah in Jerusalem ah an fehpi."},"29":{"text":"Thukam Kuang cu khawpi sungih an luhpi tikah Saul ih fanu Mikhal in tukvirh in a hei zoh ih siangpahrang David khir phah rero ih a laam kha a hmuh tikah a mitkem in a nautat ngaingai."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David ih sakmi puanthlam ahcun Thukam Kuang cu an fehpi ih a sungah an ret. Cule mei-ur thawinak le rem-awk thawinak pawl Bawipa ih hnenah an pek."},"2":{"text":"David in cuih thawinak a ṭheh tikah misenpi pawl cu Bawipa ih hminin thlawsuah a pek ih,"},"3":{"text":"rawl a zem hai. Israel mi an zatein nunau siseh, mipa siseh, mi pakhat ah sang zawl khat, sa em semkhat ciar le sabit caar malte ciar a pek."},"4":{"text":"David in Levi mi hrekkhat pawl cu Thukam Kuang hmai ih Pathian thangṭhat ding le hla thawn cawimawi ding le Bawipa Israel ih Pathian a betu pawl hotu dingah a ret."},"5":{"text":"Cupawl lakih hotu bik cu Asaf a si ih a bawmtu cu Zekhariah a si. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed Edom le Jeiel pawl tla in an bawm. Annih cu ṭingṭang tumtu an si ih Asaf cu darsumsel tumtu a si."},"6":{"text":"Puithiam pahnih Benaiah le Jahaziel cu Thukam Kuang hmaiah a tikcu caan te ih tawtawrawt tum ringringtu an si."},"7":{"text":"Cutiin Asaf le a unau Levi mi pawl cu David in Pathian thangṭhat dingih ṭuanvo hmaisa bik a rak peknak a si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh; A hmin cu phuang uh. A thil tuahmi cu mi hmuahhmuah hnenah than uh.","title":"Pathian Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah thangṭhatnak hla sak uh, Thil mangbangza a tuahmi sim uh."},"10":{"text":"Amah ih ta kan si ruangah nan lungawi uh; Amah betu hmuahhmuah in nan lungawi uh."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa le a cahnak hawl uh; Catbaang loin a mithmai zoh uh."},"12":{"text":"Khawruahhar a tuahmi ruat uh, Mangbangza a tuahmi cing ṭha uh, A thuṭhennak pawl tla;"},"13":{"text":"Pathian salpa Jakob tefa pawl, Pathian hrilmi Israel ih tefa pawl tla,"},"14":{"text":"Bawipa cu kan Pathian a si, Thil maksak a tuahmi hngilh hlah uh, A thuṭhennak leilung a khat."},"15":{"text":"Pathian ih thukam cu hngilh hrimhrim hlah uh; Kumkhaw daih ih a tuahmi a si;"},"16":{"text":"Abraham hnenih a thukam le Isaak hnenih a thutiam cu."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in Jakob hnenah a thukam a nemhnget, Israel hnenah kum khua daih dingin a hngetter."},"18":{"text":"“Kanaan ram ka lo pe ding, Na covo a si ringring ding,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Pathian ih minung pawl cu an malte, Kanaan ramah mikhual ah an cang."},"20":{"text":"Ram khat in ram khatah an vak, Uknak pakhat in a dang pakhat ah an ceer."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla zohman ih neh-nen mi an si lo; Pathian in a hum hai ih anmah ṭanah siangpahrang pawl a kawk."},"22":{"text":"“Ka hrilmi ka milai pawl cu dai hlah uh, Ka profet pawl tham hlah uh,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Leilungpi in Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh; A runnak thuthangṭha cu ni khat hnu ni khat phuang uh."},"24":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah a sunlawinak cu aupi uh; Mikip hnenah a thil tithei zia sim sin uh."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa cu a nasa ngaingai ih hlorh tlak a si; Khawzing dangdang hnakin ṭihzah ding a si."},"26":{"text":"Miphun dangdangih khawzing cu a lem lawng an si; Asinain vanih um thil hmuahhmuah hi Bawipa ih siammi an si."},"27":{"text":"Amah cu huham le sunlawinak in a kulh ṭheh; A Biakinn cu huham le lungawinak in a khat."},"28":{"text":"Leitlun mi hmuahhmuah in Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh; A huham le a sunlawinak hlorh uh."},"29":{"text":"A hmin sunglawi cawimawi cio uh; Thawinak pe in a Biakinn ah ra uh. Thianghlim Mi a lang tikah a hmaiah kun uh;"},"30":{"text":"Leilung miphunkip a hmaiah khur in um seh. Leilungpi a dinhmun a hnget zo, ṭhawn theih ding a si lo!"},"31":{"text":"Maw lei le van, nan lungawi uh; Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si, tiah mikip hnenah than uh."},"32":{"text":"Au uh, tifinriat le a sung ummi pawl tla; Lungawi uh, leiram le a parih ummi tla."},"33":{"text":"Tupi sung thingkung pawl cu lungawi in an au ding, Lungawi in Bawipa ih hmaiah Hla an sak ding. Leilung uk dingih Bawipa a rat tikah cun."},"34":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah nan lung awi uh; Ziangahtile Amah cu a ṭha; Amah ih duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun a si."},"35":{"text":"A hnenah, “Maw Pathian, kannih in Runtu, in run hram aw, Hmun khatah in khawm awla, Miphun tampi kut in in hum aw; Cuticun na parah lungawi thu kan rel ding ih, Na hmin thianghlim cu kan thang ṭhat ding,” ti uh."},"36":{"text":"Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian cu thangṭhat uh; Amah cu kumkhua in kumkhua tiang thangṭhat uh. Cutikah misenpi in “Amen,” an ti ih Bawipa cu an thangṭhat."},"37":{"text":"David in Asaf le a unau Levi mi pawl cu Thukam Kuang retnak hmunih hnaṭuan ringringtu dingah a ret. Nitinte in an ṭuanvo cu an tuahsuak ding a si.","title":"Jerusalem Le Gibeon Ah Pathian Biaknak"},"38":{"text":"Anmah bawmtu ah Jeduthun ih fapa Obed Edom le a hrinpi minung sawmruk le pariat an um. Obed Edom le Hosah cu kotka kiltu an si."},"39":{"text":"Puithiam Zadok le a unau puithiam pawl cu Gibeon ih ummi Bawipa ih biaknak hmunah hnaṭuantu an si."},"40":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi hnenih a pekmi Daan sungih a um vekin puithiam pawl cun zingtin le zantin mei-ur thawinak an pe ringring."},"41":{"text":"Anmah thawn hmun khatah Heman le Jeduthun le a hleice ih hrilmi pawl cu, “Kumkhua ih a hmunmi Bawipa ih duhdawtnak” tiin thangṭhat dingah an um."},"42":{"text":"Thangṭhatnak hla an sak tikah an tummi tawtawrawt, darsumsel le tummi thilri pawl tla Heman le Jeduthun cun an zoh phah fawn. Cule Jeduthun fapa pawl in kotka an kil."},"43":{"text":"Cun misenpi cu inn ah an tlung ih David khal a innsang thlawsuah dingin a tlung ve."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang David cu a siangpahrang inn ahcun a um. Nikhat ah David in profet Nathan a ko ih, “Kei cu sidar zanthing ih sakmi inn ah ka um, asinain Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu puanthlam sungah kan ret,” tiah a ti.","title":"David Hnenih Nathan Thusim (2 Sam 7.1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Nathan in, “Pathian cu na hnenih a um ruangah na thinlung ih a ummi cu tuah ko aw,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Asinain cuih zanah cun Pathian in Nathan hnenah,"},"4":{"text":"“Feh awla ka siahhlawh David hnenah, ‘Ka umnak dingih biakinn a satu ding cu nang na si lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Izipt ram in ka hruaisuak ihsin tuih sun tiangah biakinn sungah ka um dah lo; ka umnak cu puanthlam a si ih hmun khatión hmun khatah ka ceer."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi pawl thawn ka khualtlawnnak hmuahhmuah ah ka hrilmi an hotu zohman, ziangah so sidar thing in ka hrangah biakinn na sak lo, tiah ka ti dah lo,’ a ti,” va ti aw."},"7":{"text":"“Ka siahhlawh David hnenah cun va sim awla Keimah Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in amah ka sim duh mi cu, ‘Hramlakih tuu na khalhnak in ka lo lak ih ka minung Israel uktu ah ka lo tuah."},"8":{"text":"Na fehnak hmun kipah ka lo umpi ih na lamzin ih na ral hmuahhmuah ka lo nehsak ṭheh. Leilung tlunih mi nasa bik tlukin na hmin ka thanter ding."},"9":{"text":"Zohman ih an hrem thei lonak dingah an hrangah hmun ka hril ih ka miphun Israel pawl cu cuih hmunah ka umter. Hitawk ram an thlen vete in mi siatsuah lawng a duhtu pawl in an do ringring; asinain tuih hnu ahcun cubangtuk cu a um nawn lo ding. Na ral pawl hmuahhmuah neh dingah le tesinfa tampi nei dingah thu ka lo kam a si.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Na thih ni a kim ih na pupa hnenih phum na si tikah na fapa pawl sungin pakhat cu siangpahrang ah ka tuah ding ih a uknak cu ka cakter ding."},"12":{"text":"Ka hrangah amah in biakinn a sak ding ih a uknak cu kumkhua in ka hngetter ding."},"13":{"text":"Keimah cu a pa ka si dingih amah cu ka fapa a si ding. Nangmah siangpahrang canter duh ah ka dawihlo mi Saul ka tlansan vek cun anih cu ka tlansan lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Ka miphun le ka uknak zohtu le kiltu ah kumkhua in ka tuah ding. A uknak cu a cem dah lo ding,’ va ti aw,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Pathian ih a phuanmi hmuahhmuah cu Nathan in David a sim ṭheh."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang David cu Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam ahcun a feh ih a to hnuah thla a cam: “Maw Bawipa Pathian, keimah le ka innsang hrangih na thil tuahmi pawl hi ka ruah tikah ka hlawh hrimhrim lo.","title":"David Lungawi Thlacamnak (2 Sam 7.18-29)"},"17":{"text":"Cuih tlunah hi hnakih thil thupi deuh sawn ka hrangah na tumtah ih ka tesinfa pawl an hmailam kum tampi hrang tiang thukam na tuah zo; Bawipa Pathian, kei hi mi nasazet vekin i zoh a si."},"18":{"text":"Hi tlunah ziangso kei cun ka sim thei nawn ding? Na siahhlawh kei hi i thei ṭheh ko naón hi tlukih i cawisan lawmmam hi!"},"19":{"text":"Hi bangtuk thil ka hrangih tuah le hmailam ka sunlawinak pawl tuah hi na duh mi le na tumtah mi hrimhrim a rak si!"},"20":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah bangtu zohman an um lo; nangmah lawng Pathian na si. Kanmah hrimhrim in kan thei zo."},"21":{"text":"Saltaannak in na runsuak ih na miphun ih na tuahmi Israel mi bangtuk leilung tlunah an um lo. An hrang ih khawruahhar le mangbangza na tuah ruangah leilung pumpi ah na hmin cu a thang ṭheh. Izipt ram ihsin na minung cu na suahter ih hmaiih an nor tikah miphun dangdang cu na dawihlo ṭheh."},"22":{"text":"Kumkhua hrangin Israel cu na minung ah na tuah zo ih, maw Bawipa , nang cu an Pathian na si zo."},"23":{"text":"“Curuangah maw Bawipa , ka hrang le ka tesinfa pawl hrangih na thukam tuahmi cu kimter awla, ka tuah ding na timi cu tuahsuak hram aw."},"24":{"text":"Na hmin cu a thang ding ih mi hmuahhmuah in, ‘Ziangkimtithei Bawipa cu Israel tlun ah Pathian a si,’ tiah kumkhua in an ti ding. Cule ka uknak cu sanikhuk na hmunter ding."},"25":{"text":"Na salpa ka hnenah hin na tumtahmi na phuang ih, ‘Na tesinfa pawl cu siangpahrang an si ding,’ ti tiang i sim zo ruangah hi thlacamnak hi na hnenih ka hun thlenter ngamnak cu a si."},"26":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nang cu Pathian na si ih hi bangtuk mangbangza thukamnak hi ka hnenah na tuah zo."},"27":{"text":"Na mithmaiṭha hmutu an si ringringnak dingah ka tesinfa pawl cu thlawsuah pe hram aw, tiah zaangfah ka lo dil a si. Bawipa nangmah in thlawsuah na pe zo; na thlawsuah cu an parah kumkhua in um hram seh,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tawkfang a rei hnuah David in Filistin mi pawl a do ih a neh. Gath khawpi le a kiangkap ih khawte pawl tla a lak ṭheh.","title":"David Ih Ralnehnak (2 Sam 8.1-18)"},"2":{"text":"Cule Moab mi pawl a do ih a neh. A kuthnuai minung ah an cang ih siah an pek."},"3":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Siria ram sung Zobah peng siangpahrang Hadadezer in Eufrates Tiva hna lamih ram pawl neh dingih a feh laiah Hamath ram kiangah David in a do ih a neh."},"4":{"text":"David in a rangleng thawng khat, rang ralkap thawng sarih le ke ralkap thawng kul a kai. Rangleeng zakhat hrangah rang cu a zuah ih a dang pawl cu an kaizatha a satcat ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Cule Damaskas ih ummi Siria mi pawl in siangpahrang Hadadezer bawm dingah ralkap an kuat. Cupawl tla cu David in a neh ih ralkap thawng kul hluanhnih a that."},"6":{"text":"An ram sungah a ralkap a ret ih a ukmi ah an cang ih siah an pek. Bawipa in David cu khuazakipah nehtu a siter."},"7":{"text":"Hadadezer kutthuai bawi pawl ih kenmi sui phaw pawl cu David in a long ih Jerusalem ah a tlunpi."},"8":{"text":"Hadadezer ih ukmi Tibbath le Kun khawpi pawl ihsin dar tamzet a lak. Cumi pawl cu Solomon in Biakinn sungih khokheng pawl, ṭhuam pawl le maihum tumpipi tuahnak ah a hmang."},"9":{"text":"David in Hadadezer ralkap a neh thluh thu Hamath siangpahrang Toi in a thei."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang David lawm dingah le lungawipi dingah Toi cun a fapa Joram a thlah; ziangahtile Toi in Hadadezer cu voi tampi a rak do zomi a si. Joram in David cu sui, ngun le dar ih tuahmi thilri tampi laksawng a pek."},"11":{"text":"Cuih thilri cu David in Edom mi, Moab mi, Ammon mi, Filistin mi le Amalek mi pawl hnenin a lonmi sui le ngun pawl thawn Bawipa biaknak ih hman dingah a pek."},"12":{"text":"Cun Zeruiah ih fapa Abishai in Edom mi cu Cite Phairawn ah thawng hleiriat a that."},"13":{"text":"Edom ram sungah ralkap a ret ih cuticun Edom mi pawl cu David ih uk mi ah an cang. Bawipa in David cu khuazakip ah nehtu a siter."},"14":{"text":"David in Israel ram le a minung pawl cu dingthluk lairelnak in a uk."},"15":{"text":"Abishai ih u Joab cu ralbawi upa bik a si. Ahilud fapa Jehoshafat cu rampi cazin kaitu a si."},"16":{"text":"Ahitub fapa Zadok le Abiathar fapa Ahimelek cu puithiam an si. Seraiah cu siangpahrang zungih sungṭuan a si."},"17":{"text":"Jehoiada ih fapa Benaiah cu siangpahrang kiltu Kereth mi le Peleth mi pawl hotu a si. David ih fapa pawl cu a pa ih uknak sungah hnaṭuan tumpipi ṭuantu an si."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tikcu a hung rei deuh tikah Ammon siangpahrang Nahash a thi ih a fapa Hanun siangpahrang a cang.","title":"David In Ammon Mi Le Siria Mi A Neh (2 Sam 10.1-19)"},"2":{"text":"David in, “A pa Nahash cu ka parih a ṭhat vekin Hanun parah rualpi ṭha ka sinak ka langter ve ding,” a ti. Curuangah Hanun va topi dingah David in a ai-awh ah palai a thlah. Ammon ram an thleng ih siangpahrang Hanun hnen an feh tikah,"},"3":{"text":"Ammon ram hotu upa pawl in an siangpahrang hnenah cun, “Na pa upatnak ah David in hi palai pawl hi nangmah topi dingah a thlah a si, tiah na ruat maw? Cutiih na ruah asile na palh tengteng ding! Kan ram neh duh ah hipawl hi thlingthlatu-ah a rak thlah a si sawn,” an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Hanun in David mithlah mi palai pawl cu a kai ih an khahmul a meet ṭheh ih an korfualpi cu an taai ri-in a tansak ṭheh hnu ah a thlah."},"5":{"text":"An ningzak in inn hmanah an tlung ngam lo. Cuih thu cu David in a theih tikah an khahmul a sau hlan lo Jerikho ih um ding in thu a cah."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hanun le Ammon mi pawl in David an ral ih an canter kha an theihsaal tikah ngun tangka cuai thawng hleiriat le zariat tluk pe in tlunlam Mesopotamia le Siria khawpi Maakah le Zobah in ralkap an saang."},"7":{"text":"An saanmi rangleng thawng sawmthum le thawnghnih le Maakah siangpahrang ralkap pawl cu an ra ih Medeba kiangah ṭanhmun an khuar. Ammon mi pawl khal an khua ciar in an pok ih raldo dingin an tiar aw."},"8":{"text":"Cuih thu cu David in a theih tikah ralbawi Joab le Israel ralkap zatein cu pawl va do dingah a fehter."},"9":{"text":"Ammon mi pawl cu an suak ih Rabbah khawpi hnarpawn in ṭanhmun an khuar. Anmah bawm dingih a rami siangpahrang pawl cu hramlak in ṭanhmun an khuar ve."},"10":{"text":"Ral pawl in hmailam le dunglam in in do ding ti kha Joab in a theih tikah Israel ralkap sungih ralkap ṭhabik pawl a hril ih Siria ralkap do dingah a bawhter."},"11":{"text":"A dang Israel ralkap hmuahhmuah cu a unau Abishai a hoter ih Ammon ralkap pawl do dingin an bawh ve."},"12":{"text":"Cule Joab in Abishai hnenah, “Siria ralkap pawl in kei in neh a si ahcun in ra bawm pei. Ammon ralkap pawl in nang an lo neh a si le ka ra lo bawm ding."},"13":{"text":"Cakzet le ralṭha zetin um aw! Kan miphun le kan Pathian ih khawpi pawl hrangah nasa tak in kan do pei. Bawipa ih duhnak vekin si ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cuṭheh vete in Joab le a ralkap pawl cun an nor ciammam ih Siria ralkap pawl cu an tlan ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Siria ralkap pawl an tlan ti kha Ammon ralkap pawl in an theih tikah Abishai do ngam loin an zaam ih khawpi sungah an siip ṭheh. Cuih hnuah Joab cu Jerusalem khua ah a tlung."},"16":{"text":"Israel pawl in in neh seksek a si tikha Siria mi pawl in an theih tikah Eufrates tiva in nisuahnak lamih a ummi Siria ramsung minung pawl ralkap ah an lak ih Zobah peng siangpahrang Hadadezer ih ralkap hotu upa bik Shobak an hoter."},"17":{"text":"Cuih thu cu David in a theih tikah Israel ralkap pawl cu a kokhawm lala ih Jordan tiva a tan hnuah Siria ralkap do ding in ṭanhmun a khuar. An do aw ciammam ih,"},"18":{"text":"Israel pawl in an neh lala. David le a ralkap pawl in Siria rang ralkap thawng sarih le ke ralkap thawng sawmli an that. Siria ralbawi upa bik Shobak tla an that."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hadadezer kuthnuai siangpahrang pawl in Israel ralkap in in neh thluh a si, ti an theih tikah David thawn remnak an tuah ih a ukmi ah an cang."},"20":{"text":"Cuih hnu cun Siria mi in Ammon mi cu an bawm duh nawn lo."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khua a hung ṭhal ih siangpahrang pawl an raldo caan a hung cuut tikah, Joab le a ralkap cu an feh ih Ammon ram an do. An khawpi Rabbah an kulh ṭheh. Culai ah David cu Jerusalem ah a um. Joab in Rabbah cu a do ih a siatsuah ṭheh.","title":"David In Rabbah A Lak (2 Sam 12.26-31)"},"2":{"text":"Cule Ammon mi in Molek an timi khawzing lem an nei ih a sui lukhuh cu cuai kul a rit. A sungah lungmankhung a um ih cumi cu David in a lak ih a siangpahrang lukhuh ah a bun. Khawpi sungih hransaw tampi tla a lak."},"3":{"text":"Khawsung mi pawl cu a hruai hai ih hluah le tupheng le hreitlung thawn hna a ṭuanter. Ammon ram khua dangdang mi pawl tla cuvek thotho in a tuah. Cuih hnuah a ralkap pawl thawn Jerusalem ah an kir."},"4":{"text":"Cuih hnuah, Filistin mi pawl thawn Gezer ah an do aw. Israel mi in an neh. Cuih ṭum ah Hushah mi Sibbekai in mikei tia a si mi Sippai an timi a that.","title":"Filistin Mitumzet Pawl An Do (2 Sam 21.15-22)"},"5":{"text":"Cule Filistin thawn an do-aw lala ih Jair fapa Elhanan in Gath mi Goliath ih unau Lahmi a that; a feihlung cu thiamtleeng tia a si."},"6":{"text":"Gath ah an do-aw sal ih cuih khua ahcun a kut khatlam ah kutzung paruk veve, a ke khatlam ah kezung paruk veve a neimi a um. Amah cu khuahlan mitum zetzet pawl ih tesinfa a si."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu a dodal ih David ih unau Shammah ih fapa Jonathan in cupa cu a that."},"8":{"text":"Hi minung pathum, David le a ralkap pawl ih an thahmi hi Gath khua ih mitum zetzet tefa pawl an si."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Satan in Israel parah harsatnak thlenter a duh ruangah David cu thusia a forh ih Israel mipum siar duhnak thinlung a neihter.","title":"David In Mipum A Siar (2 Sam 24.1-25)"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah David in Joab le a ralbawi dangdang hnenah, “Israel ram khatlam deng Beersheba ihsin khatlam deng Dan tiang feh uhla mipum siar hnik uh. Minung ziangzat an um ti theih ka duh,” tiah thu a pek."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Joab in, “ Bawipa in Israel mi pawl cu atu hnakih a let zakhat in karhzaiter hram seh! Ziangzat an va si khalle Bawipa nangmah cu an siangpahrang na si ih an zatein na sal an si ko. Ziangah so an mipum siar cu na duh? An mipum na siarsuak ngaingai asile Israel miphun cu mawhphurtu na canter ding a si!” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla David in a thu cu a ṭhin duh cuang lo. Curuangah Joab cu Israel ram pumpi hmuahhmuah ah a feh ih cuih hnuah Jerusalem ah a kir."},"5":{"text":"Siangpahrang David hnenah cun thu a than ih, “Ralkap ṭuan thei ding lawnglawng Israel ah million khat le thawng zakhat an um ih, Judah ah thawng zali le thawng sawmsarih an um,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Joab in David ih thupekmi a lung a kim lo ruangah Levi mi le Benjamin mi pawl cu mipum a siar lo."},"7":{"text":"Cuih thil an tuahmi parah Bawipa cu a lung a awi lo ih Israel pawl cu a hrem."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah David in, “Maw Bawipa , thil ṭha lozet ka tuah ih ka sual zo a si. I ngaithiam hram aw. Aat hna ka ṭuan a si,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in David ih profet Gad hnenah,"},"10":{"text":"“Va feh awla David va sim aw; thil hril ding pathum ka pek. Pakhatkhat a hril pei ih cumi cu ka tuahsuak ding,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Gad cu David hnenah a feh ih Bawipa ih ṭongmi cu a sim, “Khuimi so na hril ding?"},"12":{"text":"Kum thum sung paam maw? Asilole na ral pawl in thla thum sung dawi le hual rero maw? Asilole ni thum sung Bawipa ralnam cu a vancungmi in hmang in Israel ram sungah natsia le thihnak thlenter maw? Pakhatkhat hril awla cumicu Bawipa ka sim ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah David in Gad hnenah, “Ka awlok a song tuk lawmmam! Asinain milai kut sungih tlak hnak cun Pathian kut sungih tlak ka duh sawn; ziangahtile Bawipa cu zaangfahnak neitu a si,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in Israel mi tlunah pulhnat a tlunter ih thawng sawm sarih an thi."},"15":{"text":"Pathian in Jerusalem siatsuah thluh dingah vancungmi a thlah; asinain a thinlung a thleng sal ih vancungmi hnenah cun, “Cawl aw; tawk thlang seh,” a ti. Cule vancungmi cu Jebus mi Araunah ih fang ciilnak puum kiangah a ding."},"16":{"text":"David in a hun zoh tikah van le leilung karlakah Jerusalem siatsuah dingih namsaupi thlir in vancungmi a din kha a hmu. Cutikah David le Israel mi hotu pawl cu buri puan hruk in an hmai leilung dai tiangin an kuun."},"17":{"text":"David in, “Maw Pathian, a sualtu cu keimah ka si. Mipum siar dingih thu petu cu keimah ka si. Himi pawl in ziangso tuah sual mi an neih? Maw Bawipa, ka Pathian, keimah le ka innsang hi in hrem awla hi na minung, na tuurual hi cu luatter hram aw,” tiah thla a cam."},"18":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih vancungmi in Gad hnenah, “David cu feh sehla Bawipa ih hrangah Jebus mi Araunah fang ciilnak hmunah biakṭheng donseh,” tiah thu a pek."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupekmi cu Gad ih sim vekin David cun a thlun."},"20":{"text":"Araunah le a fapa pali cu sangvut an ciil rero. Vancungmi an hmuh tikah a fapa pawl cu an zaam ih an relh."},"21":{"text":"Araunah in amah ih lamih siangpahrang David a rat rero kha a hmuh tikah zamrangte in a tlan ih a hmai lei dai in David hmaiah cun a kun."},"22":{"text":"David in, “Na sangvut ciilnak hmun hi i zorh aw; Bawipa hrangah biakṭheng ka dawl duh a si. Culo cun pulhnat hi a reh lo ding. A man cu na ngenzat ka lo pe ko ding,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Araunah cun, “Bawipa, la ko aw; na duh vekin hmang aw. Biakṭheng parih mei-ur thawinakah hinah cawcang an um; thing hrangah puum ih donmi zial an um ih thlairawl thawinak hrangah sangvut a um ko. Ka lo pe thluh ding,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Asinain siangpahrang bawipa cun, “Asilo, a man kimtein ka lo pe ding. Na ta cu a lakin ka la lo ding, keimah ih a man ka pek lomi cu Bawipa ih hnenah pek ka duh lo,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cule Araunah cu sui tangka fai zaruk a pek."},"26":{"text":"Cutawkah Bawipa ih hrangah biakṭheng a dawl ih mei-ur thawinak le remawk thawinak a pek. Thla a cam ih Bawipa in a theihsak ruangah van ihsin meisa a run thlak ih biakṭheng parih a pekmi thawinak pawl cu a kang ṭheh."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa in vancungmi cu a namsau re sal dingin thu a pek ih a ret sal."},"28":{"text":"Cumi cu David in a hmuh tikah Bawipa in ka thlacamnak i theih sak a si, ti a thei ih Araunah fang ciilnak hmunih a dawlmi biakṭheng parah cun thawinak a tuah."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam, Moses in ramṭhing ih a sak mi le thawinak pawl an urnak biakṭheng cu cuih caanah Pathian an biaknak hmun Gibeon ah a um laifang a si."},"30":{"text":"Asinain David cu Bawipa bia dingah cutawkah cun a feh ngam lo; ziangahtile Bawipa ih vancungmi ih namsaupi cu a ṭih tata."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule David in, “hittawk ah hin Bawipa ih Biakinn cu a um ding. hittawk ah hin Israel mi pawl in mei-ur thawinak an pe ding,” a ti."},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang David in Israel ram sungih a ummi ramdangmi hmuahhmuah a kokhawm ih hna a ṭuanter hai. Cule serthiam pawl in Biakinn saknak ah lungto an ser.","title":"Biakinn Sak Dingin An Timtuah"},"3":{"text":"Tlawngkhen le sangka kaihnak kopza tampi a pek ih dar tla cu zohman ih a cuai khai thei cawk lo tiangin a pek hai."},"4":{"text":"Ṭai-ar le Sidon mi pawl in sidar thing an run pek."},"5":{"text":"David cun, “Ka fapa Solomon ih a sak dingmi Bawipa ih Biakinn cu a ṭha taktak mi le leilung tlunih hminthang a si a ṭul. Solomon cu a no hrih ih zianghman a tithiam hrih lo ruangah keimah in ziang hmuahhmuah ka timtuahta thluh a ṭul a si,” a ti. Curuangah David in a nunsungah thilri tampi a khawl a si."},"6":{"text":"David in a fapa Solomon cu a ko ih Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian Biakinn sak dingah thu a pek."},"7":{"text":"A hnenah, “Ka fapa, Bawipa ka Pathian hminthannak ah biakinn sak ka duh."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa in, ‘Ral tamtuk na do ih mi tamtuk na that zo a si,’ i ti. Thisen tamtuk ka luanter zo ruangah a hrangih biakinn sak ding cu i sen lo a si."},"9":{"text":"Asinain thu i tiam ih, ‘Fapa na nei ding ih a ral pawl kut in ka humhim ding ruangah daihnak thawn ram a uk ding. Amah ih hmin cu Solomon a si ding; ziangahtile amah ih uk sungah Israel ramah daihnak le humhimnak ka leenter ding."},"10":{"text":"Amah in ka hrangah Biakinn a sak ding. Amah cu ka fapa a si ding ih kei cu a pa ka si ding. Amah ih uknak cu Israel tlunah kumkhua in ka hmunter ding,’ a ti."},"11":{"text":"“Curuangah ka fapa, Bawipa na Pathian cu na hnenah um hram seh; amah ih thutiam bangin na Bawipa hrangih Biakinn cu tlamtling zetin sak suak hram aw."},"12":{"text":"Israel ram cu Amah ih Daan vekin na uk theinak dingah Bawipa na Pathian in fimnak le theihthiamnak lo pe hram seh."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel hrangih Moses hnenih a pekmi Daan pawl na thlun a si ahcun na lamzin a tluang ding ih na hlawhtling ding. Cakzet le ralṭhazet in um awla, zianghman ṭih le phannak khal nei hlah."},"14":{"text":"Biakinn saknak ah sui phurh thawng zakhat le ngun phurh million khat biakinn saknak ah harsa zetin ka khawl zo. Cuih hlei ah dar le thir cu phurh siar cawk lo a um a si. Thing le lungto pawl tla ka khawl zo ih nangmah khal in na run beet hrih pei."},"15":{"text":"Hnaṭuantu tampi na nei. Lungto laitu, lungto sertu, zungthiam le kutzungthiam dang a phunphun,"},"16":{"text":"sui le ngun serthiamtu le dar le thir serthiamtu tampi an um. Atu in hnaṭuan thok awla Bawipa in lo umpi hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule David in Israel mi hruaitu pawl cu Solomon bawm dingah thu a pek."},"18":{"text":"“ Bawipa nan Pathian in nan ram pumpuluk ah daihnak a lo pek. Hi ramih a rak um miphun pawl cu i nehter thluh ih atu ahcun nan kuthnuai le Bawipa ih kuthnuai ah an um ṭheh zo."},"19":{"text":"Atu ihsin nan thinlung zate le nan thazaang zate thawn Bawipa ih hna cu ṭuan uh. Bawipa Thukam Kuang le amah biaknak ih hmanmi thilri thianghlim pawl retnak ah le a hminthannak ah Bawipa ih Biakinn cu sak uh,” tiah a ti."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David cu a kum a upa zetzo ih patar a si thlang ruangah Israel siangpahrang dingah a fapa Solomon cu a ret."},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang David cun Israel hotu pawl, puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl cu a kokhawm.","title":"Levi Mi Pawl Hnaṭuannak"},"3":{"text":"Levi mi mipa, kum sawmthum le a tlunlam hmuahhmuah an mipum a siar ih, thawng sawmthum le thawngriat an ti."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang in thawng kul hluanli cu Biakinn hnaṭuan hotu ah a ret; thawngruk cu cazin kaitu le thuṭhentu ah a ret;"},"5":{"text":"thawngli cu inn le kotka kiltu ah a ret ih a dang thawngli cu siangpahrang ih a retmi awn-mawi phunkim tum tahrat in Pathian thangṭhattu ah a ret."},"6":{"text":"David in Levi miphun pawl cu anmah ih hrin ciar in, Gershom hrin, Kohath hrin le Merari hrin tiah ṭhen thumah a ṭhen."},"7":{"text":"Gershom in fapa pahnih a nei ih Ladan le Shimei an si."},"8":{"text":"Ladan in fapa pathum a nei ih Jehiel, Zetham le Joel an si ih,"},"9":{"text":"Ladan tesinfa ahcun an hrin ciarah lu an si. (Shimei in fapa pathum a nei ih Shelomoth, Haziel le Haran an si.)"},"10":{"text":"Shimei in fapa pali a nei sal ih Jahath, Zina, Jeush le Beriah an si. Jeush le Beriah cu tesinfa an neih lo ruangah hrin khatah siar an si.","merge":"11"},"12":{"text":"Cun Kohath in fapa pali a nei ih Amram, Izhar, Hebron le Uzziel an si."},"13":{"text":"Upabik Amram cu Aaron le Moses ih pa a si. Aaron le a tesinfa pawl cu thilri thianghlim a kumkhua in a kilkhawitu, Bawipa biak tikih rimhmui urtu, Bawipa hnaṭuantu le a hmin in misenpi thlawsuah petu dingah retmi an si."},"14":{"text":"Asinain Pathian minung Moses ih tesinfa pawl cu Levi mi lakah siarcih an si."},"15":{"text":"Moses in fapa pahnih Gershom le Eliezer a nei."},"16":{"text":"Gershom fapa lakah Shebuel cu upa bik a si."},"17":{"text":"Eliezer cun fapa pakhat Rehabiah lawng a nei. Rehabiah in tesinfa tampi a nei."},"18":{"text":"Kohath fapa pahnihnak Izhar in fapa pakhat Shelomith a nei ih amah cu an hrinih lubik a si."},"19":{"text":"Kohath fapa pathumnak Hebron in fapa pali a nei ih Jeriah, Amariah, Jehaziel le Jekameam an si."},"20":{"text":"Kohath fapa palinak Uzziel in fapa pahnih Mikah le Isshiah a nei."},"21":{"text":"Merari in fapa pahnih Mahli le Mushi a nei. Mahli khal in fapa pahnih a nei ve ih Eleazar le Kish an si."},"22":{"text":"Asinain Eleazar cu fapa nei loin a thi; fanu lawng a nei. A fanu pawl cun an unau, Kish ih fapa pawl an pasal."},"23":{"text":"Merari fapa pahnihnak Mushi in fapa pathum a nei ih Mahli, Eder le Jeremoth an si."},"24":{"text":"Hi pawl cu Levi tesinfa, an hrin le an sungkhat ciarih siarmi le pakhat pakhat ciarih hmin khummi an si. A tesinfa sungah kum kul le a tlunlam hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih Biakinn ah hnaṭuan nei ciar an si."},"25":{"text":"Cun David in, “Israel ih Pathian in a minung hnenah daihnak a pek zo ih amah khal kumkhua in Jerusalem ah a um ding."},"26":{"text":"Atu cun Levi mi pawl in Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam le Pathian biaknak thilri pawl an zawn rero a ṭul nawn lo ding,” a ti."},"27":{"text":"David ih netabik thupeknak bangtuk in Levi mi hmuahhmuah cu kum kul an kim vete in hnaṭuantu ah lak an si."},"28":{"text":"An ṭuanvo cu Aaron tesinfa pawl Biakinn ih Pathian biak tikah an hnaṭuanmi, inn hmuahhmuah le a kiangkap le innkhaan pawl kilkhawinakah le thilri thianghlim pawl borhhlawhter loih an zohnak ah bawmtu an si."},"29":{"text":"Cuih hlei ah Pathian hnenih sang hunmi, thawinak ih pekmi sangphut pawl, thilnu tello sangpaate pawl, sangrawh pekmi pawl, siti thawn rawimi sangphut pawl le Biakinn ih thawinak pekmi pawl cuai khai ding le tah sak ding pawl kha an ṭuanvo a si."},"30":{"text":"Zingtin le zantin Bawipa thangṭhattu le cawimawitu an si fawn."},"31":{"text":"Cule Sabbath ni, thlathar puai le puai dangdang caanih mei-ur thawinak Bawipa hnenih peknak a um tikah Bawipa thangṭhattu le cawimawitu an si fawn. Ṭum khatah Levi mi pawl cu a zat khiahmi nei in hna an ṭuan ding, tiah daan a um thluh. Ziangtik caan khalah an ṭuanvo cu Bawipa thangṭhat a si."},"32":{"text":"Bawipa ih umnak Puanthlam le Biakinn zohtu an si ih an sungkhat Aaron tesinfa pawl Pathian biaknak ih an hnaṭuanmi bawmtu tla an si."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron tesinfa pawl cu a tanglam vekin hnaṭuan an zem aw. Aaron in fapa pali a nei ih Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar an si.","title":"Puithiam Pawl Hnaṭuan"},"2":{"text":"Nadab le Abihu cu an pa hlanah an thi ih faate tla an neih lo ruangah an unau Eleazar le Ithamar lawng puithiam an ṭuan."},"3":{"text":"David in Aaron tesinfa pawl cu an hnaṭuanmi tikcu caan vekin a ṭhen. Hiti a ṭhen tikah David cu Eleazar ih tefa Zadok le Ithamar ih tefa Ahimelek in an bawm."},"4":{"text":"Eleazar tesinfa pawl cu ṭhen hleiruk ah an ṭhen ih Ithamar tesinfa pawl cu ṭhen riat ah an ṭhen. Eleazar tesinfa lakah mipa, innsang ih lubik a si mi an tam deuh ruangah ṭhen tam deuh ih an ṭhennak cu a si."},"5":{"text":"Eleazar le Ithamar tesinfa lakah Biakinn upa le thlarau lam hotu an um fingfing ruangah hnaṭuantu dingih an ṭhen tikah camcawhfung zuk in an ṭhen."},"6":{"text":"Eleazar tesinfa le Ithamar tesinfa pawl in a haha in camcawhfung cu an zuk. Cutiih an tuah tikah Levi mi cazi Nethanel fapa Shemaiah in cabu sungah a khum. Cule siangpahrang bawipa, a kuthnuai bawi pawl, puithiam Zadok, Abiathar fapa Ahimelek, puithiam innsang ih lubik ciar le Levi mi innsang ih lubik ciar cu theihpitu an si."},"7":{"text":"Pakhatnak Jehoiarib, Pahnihnak Jedaiah,"},"8":{"text":"Pathumnak Harim, Palinak Seorim,"},"9":{"text":"Panganak Malkhijah, Paruknak Mijamin,"},"10":{"text":"Pasarihnak Hakkoz, Pariatnak Abiah,"},"11":{"text":"Pakuanak Jeshua, Pahranak Shekaniah,"},"12":{"text":"Hleikhatnak Eliashib, Hleihnihnak Jakim,"},"13":{"text":"Hleithumnak Huppah, Hleilinak Jeshebeab,"},"14":{"text":"Hleinganak Bilgah, Hleiruknak Immer,"},"15":{"text":"Hleisarihnak Hezir, Hleiriatnak Happizzez,"},"16":{"text":"Hleikuanak Pethahiah, Kulnak Jehezkel,"},"17":{"text":"Hluankhatnak Jakhin, Hluanhnihnak Gamul,"},"18":{"text":"Hluanthumnak Delaiah, Hluanlinak Maaziah."},"19":{"text":"Himi pawl cu Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian thupek vekin le an pupa Aaron ih daan rettami vekin, Bawipa ih Biakinn hnaṭuantu dingah ṭhenmi an si."},"20":{"text":"Levi tesinfa pawl an hrinih lu ciar cu hihi an si: Shebuel hrin in Amram tesinfa Jehdeiah;","title":"Levi Mi Pawl"},"21":{"text":"Rehabiah tesinfa Isshiah;"},"22":{"text":"Shelomith hrinah Izhar tesinfa Jahath;"},"23":{"text":"Hebron hrinah a sangsang in Jeriah, Amariah, Jehaziel le Jekameam;"},"24":{"text":"Mikah sungin Uzziel tesinfa Shamir;"},"25":{"text":"Mikah unau Isshiah sungin Uzziel tesinfa Zekhariah;"},"26":{"text":"Merari tesinfa pawl Mahli, Mushi le Jaaziah."},"27":{"text":"Jaaziah in fapa pathum a nei ih Shoham, Zakkur le Ibri an si."},"28":{"text":"Mahli in fapa pahnih Eleazar le Kish a nei. Eleazar cu fapa a nei lo;"},"29":{"text":"Kish in fapa pakhat Jerahmeel a nei."},"30":{"text":"Mushi cun fapa pathum Mahli, Eder le Jerimoth a nei. Hi pawl cu Levi mi ih sungkhat pawl an si."},"31":{"text":"An sungkhat, Aaron tesinfa puithiam pawl ih an rak tuah zo vekin an hnaṭuan dingmi hrilnakah an innsang ih lubik le a naule pawl lak ihsin mi pakhat in camcawhfung an zuk fingfing. Siangpahrang David, Zadok, Ahimelek, puithiam sungkhat ih lubik le Levi mi innsang ih lubik pawl cu a hmutu tetti an si."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David le Levi mi lakih hotu bawi pawl in a tanglam hrin pawl cu Pathian biaknak ih hotu dingah an hril: Asaf, Heman le Jeduthun. Annih cu ṭingṭang, tingrisit le darsumsel thawn Pathian ih thu, profet ṭong in, a phuangtu an si. Pathian biak tikah anmah ih hnaṭuannak ciarah a tanglam pawl cu hotu ah hrilmi an si.","title":"Hla saktu Le Awn-mawi Tumtu Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Asaf ih fapa pali cu: Zakkur, Josef, Nethaniah le Asarelah an si. An hotu Asaf a si ih siangpahrang in thu a pek tikah Pathian ih thu cu a phuang ṭheu."},"3":{"text":"Jeduthun fapa paruk: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah le Mattithiah an si. An pa ih ho in ṭingṭang tum phah in Pathian ih thu cu an phuang ih thangṭhatnak hla an sak."},"4":{"text":"Heman fapa hleili pawl cu: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir le Mahazioth an si."},"5":{"text":"Heman cu siangpahrang ih profet a si ih, a rak tiamcia bangtuk in Heman cu Pathian in fapa hleili le fanu pathum thawn a sunloih."},"6":{"text":"Biakinn ih Pathian an biak caanah an pa ih ho in darsumsel, ṭingṭang le tingrisit an zatein an tum ṭheu. Asaf, Jeduthun le Heman cu siangpahrang ih thupekmi ngai in an um."},"7":{"text":"Hi mipa kul hluanli cu an tuahmi ciar ah an thiam theizet. An hnaṭuanpi Levi mi pawl tla hlasak thiam le awn-mawi tum thiam hlir an si. An zatein zahnih le sawmriat le pariat an si."},"8":{"text":"An hnaṭuan dingmi hrilnakah mino siseh, upa siseh, hlathiam cia siseh, a zir pekte siseh, an zatein camcawhfung an zuk fingfing."},"9":{"text":"Hi minung zahnih sawmriat pariat tla cu anmah le sungkhat ciar zoh in bur kul hluanli ah ṭhen an si ih, bur khatah minung hleihnih ciar an si. Bur khat in hotu pakhat ciar an nei ih a thuailam vekin a haha tein hna an ṭuan ṭheu: Pakhatnak cu Josef, Asaf hrin hotu, Pahnihnak Gedaliah,"},"10":{"text":"Pathumnak Zakkur,"},"11":{"text":"Palinak Izri,"},"12":{"text":"Panganak Nethaniah,"},"13":{"text":"Paruknak Bukkiah,"},"14":{"text":"Pasarihnak Jesharelah,"},"15":{"text":"Pariatnak Isaiah,"},"16":{"text":"Pakuanak Mattaniah,"},"17":{"text":"Pahranak Shimei,"},"18":{"text":"Hleikhatnak Uziel,"},"19":{"text":"Hleihnihnak Hashabiah,"},"20":{"text":"Hleithumnak Shubael,"},"21":{"text":"Hleilinak Mattithiah,"},"22":{"text":"Hleinganak Jeremoth,"},"23":{"text":"Hleiruknak Hananiah,"},"24":{"text":"Hleisarihnak Joshbekashah,"},"25":{"text":"Hleiriatnak Hanani,"},"26":{"text":"Hleikuanak Mallothi,"},"27":{"text":"Kulnak Eliathah,"},"28":{"text":"Hluankhatnak Hothir,"},"29":{"text":"Hluanhnihnak Giddalti,"},"30":{"text":"Hluanthumnak Mahazioth,"},"31":{"text":"Hluanlinak Romamti Ezer."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biakinn kiltu pawl ih hnaṭuan cu a tanglam vekin an ṭhen.
