Korah hrin Asaf tesinfa sungih Kore ih fapa Meshelemiah in,","title":"Biakinn Kiltu Pawl"},"2":{"text":"fapa pasarih a nei ih a sangsang in a tanglam hi an si: Zekhariah, Jediael, Zebadiah, Jathniel,"},"3":{"text":"Elam, Jehohanan le Eliehoenai an si."},"4":{"text":"Obed Edom cu Pathian malsawmnak a dong ih fapa pariat a nei: a sangsang in Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sakhar, Nethanel,"},"5":{"text":"Ammiel, Issakhar le Peullethai an si."},"6":{"text":"Obed Edom ih fapa upabik Shemaiah cun fapa paruk a nei ih thil tithei an si ruangah an hrinah hminthang an si."},"7":{"text":"An hmin cu Othni, Refael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu le Semakhiah an si. Nautabik pahnih tla cu a hleice in thil tithei an si."},"8":{"text":"Hi hnaṭuannak ah Obed Edom sungkhat in thil tithei zetzet minung sawmruk le pahnih an um."},"9":{"text":"Meshelemiah sungkhat in thil tithei zetzet minung hleiriat an um."},"10":{"text":"Merari sungkhat ah Hosah a um ih fapa pali a nei: Shimri (amah cu upabik a si lo naón a pa in hotu ah a tuah),"},"11":{"text":"Hilkiah, Tebaliah le Zekhariah an si. Hosah sungkhat in an zate ah biakinn kiltu hleithum an um."},"12":{"text":"Levi mi vekin biakinn kiltu pawl cu an sungkhat ciar in an ṭhen ih biakinn hnaṭuan cu an pek hai."},"13":{"text":"An kil dingmi kotka hrangah sungkhat fingfing in minung an tam an mal ti loin, camcawhfung an zuk ciar."},"14":{"text":"Shelemiah in nisuahnak lam kotka kil ding a zuk ngah ih a fapa mi dang hnenih ruahnak ṭha a pe thei ringringtu Zekhariah in saklam kotka kil ding a zuk ngah."},"15":{"text":"Obed Edom in thlanglam kotka kil ding a zuk ih a fapa pawl cu thilri retnak inn kiltu ding an si."},"16":{"text":"Shuppim le Hosah in nitlaknak lam kotka kil ding an zuk ih saklam hung fehnak Shalleketh kotka tla a kil phahtu ding an si. An kil tikah a haha in an sawng aw."},"17":{"text":"Nisuahnak lam kotka cu nitinte paruk in an kil; saklam cu pali in an kil ih thlanglam tla pali in an kil. Thilri retnak inn pahnih cu minung pali in, inn khat pahnih veve in an kil."},"18":{"text":"Nitlaknak lam ih ummi ṭhuam tumpipi umnak lamzin ah pali an um ih a ṭhuam kiltu ah pahnih an um."},"19":{"text":"Cumi cu Korah le Merari sungkhat pawl ih biakinn an kilnak hnaṭuan daan a si."},"20":{"text":"A dang Levi mi pawl cu biakinn tangka le Pathian hnenih pekmi thilri retnak inn kiltu an si.","title":"A Dang Biakinn Hnaṭuan Pawl"},"21":{"text":"Gershom hrin sungah Ladan cu sungte tampi ih pu a si ih Jehiel sungkhat ih pu tla a si."},"22":{"text":"Hi sungkhat sungin Zetham le a unau Joel cu biakinn tangka le thilri retnak inn kiltu an si."},"23":{"text":"Amram, Izhar, Hebron le Uzziel tesinfa pawl tla hnaṭuan pekmi an si."},"24":{"text":"Moses fapa Gershom hrin sungin Shebuel cu biakinn tangka kiltu pawl hotu upa bik a si."},"25":{"text":"Gershom unau cu Eliezer a si ih cu ruangah Shebuel le Shelomith cu sungkhat ah an cang. Eliezer cu Rehabiah ih pa a si; Rehabiah cu Jeshiah ih pa a si; Jeshiah cu Joram ih pa a si; Joram cu Zikhri ih pa a si; Zikhri cu Shelomith ih pa a si."},"26":{"text":"Shelomith le a sungkhat pawl cu Pathian hnenah siangpahrang David, sungkhat ciarih lubik pawl, hrinkhat sungih hotu pawl le ralbawi pawl ih pekmi laksawng pawl kiltu an si."},"27":{"text":"Raldonak ih an lakmi hransaw hrekkhat pawl cu an lak ih Biakinn sungih hmanmi thilri ah an tuah."},"28":{"text":"Shelomith le a sungkhat pawl cu Biakinn sung hman ding thilri an pekmi hmuahhmuah, profet Samuel, siangpahrang Saul, Ner fapa Abner le Zeruiah fapa Joab pawl ih an pekmi tiangin a kiltu an si."},"29":{"text":"Izhar tesinfa sungin Khenaniah le a fapa pawl cu zung hnaṭuantu, cazin kaitu le misenpi ih thuṭhentu an si.","title":"Levi Mi A Dang Pawlih ṭuanvo"},"30":{"text":"Hebron tesinfa sungin Hashabiah le a sungkhat pawl hminthang zetzet, minung thawngkhat le zasarih cu Jordan Tiva in nitlaknak lamah biaknak lam thu siseh, nitin misenpi nun khawsaknak thuhla siseh, tawlreltu le ngaihtuahtu an si."},"31":{"text":"Hebron tesinfa pawl lakah Jeriah cu an hotu bik a si. David ih siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum sawmli kumah Hebron ih tesinfa pawl thuhla an zingzoi tikah ralkap hminthang zetzet Gilead ram Jazer khua ih an um kha an thei."},"32":{"text":"Curuangah David in Jeriah ih sungkhat pawl, an hrin sungih hminthang le lubik pawl minung thawng hnih le zasarih a hril ih Reuben ram, Gad ram le nisuahnak lam Manasseh ram sungih an biaknak lam thu le nitinte an nun khawsaknak thuhla tawlreltu le ngaihtuahtu dingah a ret."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi an innsang ih lu ciar le an hrin ih hotu ciar le an ram sungih tawlreltu bawi pawl cu a tanglam pawl hi an si. Kum khat sungah thlatinte bur dangdang thleng-aw in hnaṭuan an nei ih bur khatah minung thawng kul hluanli ciar in hotu pawl ih kut hnuai ah hna an ṭuan.","title":"Ralkap Le Misenpi Hoha-awk Daan"},"2":{"text":"A tanglam pawl hi thla khat sungih ralkap hotu ciar an si: Thla khatnak ah: Zabdiel ih fapa Jashobeam. (Amah cu Judah phun, Perez hrin a si.) Thla hnihnak ah: Ahohi ih tesinfa Dodai. (Amah bawmtu cu Mikloth a si.) Thla thumnak ah: Puithiam Jehoiada ih fapa Benaiah. Amah cu “Sawmthum Pawl,” ih hotu a si. (A fapa Amizzabad in a ai-ah hotu a ṭuan.) Thla linak ah: Joab nau Asahel. (A fapa Zebadiah in a ai-ah hotu a ṭuan.) Thla nganak ah: Izhar ih tesinfa Shamhuth. Thla ruknak ah: Tekoa khua mi Ikkesh ih fapa Ira. Thla sarihnak ah: Pelon in Efraim mi Helez. Thla riatnak ah: Hushah khua in Sibbekai. (Amah cu Judah phun, Zerah hrin sungmi a si.) Thla kuanak ah: Benjamin hrin Anathoth khua in Abiezer. Thla hranak ah: Netofah hrin in Maharai (Amah cu Zerah tesinfa a si.) Thla hleikhatnak ah: Efraim hrin, Pirathon tesinfa Benaiah. Thla hleihnihnak ah: Netofah hrin in, Heldai. (Amah cu Othniel tesinfa a si.)","merge":"3"},"16":{"text":"A tanglam pawl hi Israel hrin pawl uktu an si: Reuben hrinah Zikhri ih fapa Eliezer; Simeon hrinah Maakah ih fapa Shefatiah; Levi hrinah Kemuel ih fapa Hashabiah; Aaron hrinah Zadok; Judah hrinah Siangpahrang David ih u Elihu; Issakhar hrinah Mikhael ih fapa Omri; Zebulun hrinah Obadiah ih fapa Ishmaiah; Naftali hrinah Azriel ih fapa Jeremoth; Efraim hrinah Azaziah ih fapa Hoshea; Nitlaknak lam Manasseh hrinah Pedaiah ih fapa Joel; Nisuahnak lam Manasseh hrinah Zekhariah ih fapa Iddo; Benjamin hrinah Abner ih fapa Jaasiel; Dan hrinah Jeroham ih fapa Azarel.","title":"Israel Miphun Pawl Uk-awk Daan","merge":"17"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi pawl cu vanih arsi zat in an tam ding tiah thutiam a tuah zo ruangah David in Israel mi kum kul hnuailam cu mipum a siar lo."},"24":{"text":"Zeruiah ih fapa Joab in mipum siar cu a thok; asinain a ṭheh lo. Hi mipum siarnak ruangah Bawipa in Israel cu hremnak a pek a si. Cu ruangah siangpahrang David ih cazin sungah an mipum zat ngaingai cu an rak ngan dah lo."},"25":{"text":"A tanglam pawl cu siangpahrang thilri zohtu pawl an si: Siangpahrang thilri retnak inn zohtu: Adiel ih fapa Azmaveth; Khawte thilri retnak inn pawl zohtu: Uzziah ih fapa Jonathan; Lo hnaṭuantu zohtu: Khelub ih fapa Ezri; Sabit hmuan zohtu: Ramah khua in Shimei; Sabit rialnak zohtu: Shefam khua in Zabdi; Olif le theipi kung pawl (nitlaknak lam tlang hram ummi) zohtu: Geder in Baalhanan; Olif siti retnak inn zohtu: Joash; Sharon Phairawn caw pawl zohtu: Sharon in Shitrai; Horkuam ih caw pawl zohtu: Adlai ih fapa Shafat; Kalauk pawl zohtu: Ishmael mi Obil; Laak pawl zohtu: Meronoth in Jehdeiah; Tuu le me pawl zohtu: Hagrit mi Jaziz.","title":"Siangpahrang Thilri Zohtu Pawl","merge":"26"},"32":{"text":"David ih paseu Jonathan cu cathiam le mifim zet a si ih ruahnak ṭha petu ṭhazet tla a si. Jonathan le Hakmoni ih fapa Jehiel cu siangpahrang fapa pawl cazirhtu an si.","title":"David Ruahnak Petu Pawl"},"33":{"text":"Ahithofel cu siangpahrang ruahnak petu a si ih Ark khuami Hushai cu siangpahrang rualpiṭha le remruattu a si."},"34":{"text":"Ahithofel a thih hnuah Abiathar le Benaiah ih fapa Jehoiada in a ai an awh. Joab cu siangpahrang ralkap pawl uktu bawi a si."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Israel ram sungih upa le bawi hmuahhmuah cu Jerusalem ah suak thluh dingin a kokhawm. Curuangah Israel hrin hmuahhmuah ih bawi upa pawl, Israel ram uktu bawi pawl, an hrinih hotu ciar, siangpahrang le a fapa pawl thilri le ṭilva pawl zohtu upa pawl hmuahhmuah, siangpahrang inn ih bawi pawl le ralbawi pawl le khawsung upa pawl hmuahhmuah cu Jerusalem khua ah an tongkhawm aw.","title":"Biakinn Hrangih David Thucah Mi"},"2":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang David cu an zate hmaiah a ding ih an hnenah, “Ka ramsung minung ulenau pawl, i ngaihnik uh! Thukam Kuang ret ringringnak dingah le Bawipa kan Pathian in a ke a retnak dingah inn pakhat sak ka tum. Pathian hminthannak hrangih biakinn saknak ah thilri pawl ka tawlrel thluh zo."},"3":{"text":"Asinain raldotu ka rak si ih thisen tampi ka luanter zo ruangah cuih inn keimah ih sak ding cu Bawipa in i kham a si."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa Israel ih Pathian in keimah le ka tesinfa pawl cu kumkhua in Israel uktu si dingah in hril zo. Judah hrin cu mi hotu si dingah a hril ih Judah hrin sungin ka pa ih innsang a hril. Ka pa ih innsang sungin Israel ram hmuahhmuah uktu siangpahrang dingah keimah Bawipa in i hril a si."},"5":{"text":"Amah in fapa tampi i pe ih cuih sungin Bawipa ih uknak Israel ram siangpahrang dingah Solomon a hril."},"6":{"text":"“Cule Bawipa in ka hnenah, ‘Ka Biakinn a satu cu na fapa Solomon a si ding. Amah cu ka fapa si dingah ka hril zo ih keimah cu a pa ka si ding."},"7":{"text":"Ka daan le ka thupekmi ralringzet in atu vekih a thlun ringring asile a uknak cu kumkhua hrangin ka hngetter ding,’ a ti."},"8":{"text":"“Curuangah ka ramsung mipawl, hi nan luahmi ramṭha hi nan co thei ringringnak dingah le nan tesinfa hnenah sankhat hnu sankhat nan co thei ringringnak dingah Bawipa kan Pathian ih thupekmi pawl cu fimkhur zetin nan thlun pei, tiah Bawipa ih mithmuh ah le Bawipa ih minung hih Israel mi a ra khawmmi theihhngan ah thu ka lo cah hai a si."},"9":{"text":"“Cule nang, ka fapa Solomon, na pa ih Pathian cu ṭihzah awla lung khat nei in a thu thlun duhnak thinlung thawn a hna cu ṭuan hram aw. Amah in kan ruahnak le kan thinlung cu a zatein a thei ṭheh. A hnenih na rat a si ahcun amah in a lo pom ding; asinain na dungtun a si ahcun kumkhua in a lo thlauthla ding."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in a Biakinn thianghlim satu dingah a lo hril zo hi ciing ringring aw. Cuih hnaṭuan cu thok awla taimak suah in ṭuan aw,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun David in Solomon hnenah Biakinn sak dingmi hrangih ruangrai zingmi pawl: Biakinn hrangah hulhliap ih ruangrai, thilri retnak khaan ruangrai, inn khaan dangdang ruangrai le sual ngaithiamnak hrangah timi Hmun Thianghlim Bik khaan ruangrai pawl cu a pek."},"12":{"text":"A thinlung in a tumtahmi Biakinn sung a khaan pawl le a kimvel ih khaan pawl ruangrai, biakinn thilri retnak khaan le Bawipa hnenih pekmi laksawng retnak khaan ruangrai pawl tla a pek."},"13":{"text":"Cuih hlei ah David in puithiam le Levi mi pawl an ṭuanvo zem awknak le Biakinn ih an hnaṭuan ding pawl le biakinn thilri an zohnak ding hrangih an ṭuan dingmi pawl a pek ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Biakinn khokheng hrangah sui le ngun a cem ding zat,"},"15":{"text":"mei-vannak pawl hrang le mei vannak ṭhuam hrangah sui le ngun a cem ding zat,"},"16":{"text":"Pathian hnenih pekmi sang pawl retnak sui cabuai le ngun cabuai pawl hrangah sui le ngun a cem ding zat kha kimtein a cah ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Cuih tlunah thirthul pawl, maihum pawl le khuat pawl hrangah sui hlir ziangzat a cem ding tile, pakan pawl tuahnak ah sui le ngun ziangzat a cem ding tile,"},"18":{"text":"rimhmui urnak biakṭheng le Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang tlunah an thla pharh in a ummi Cherubim timi pawl an cuannak leng hrangah sui hlir in ziangzat a cem ding tikha feltein a cah ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang David in, “Hi hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa amah rori in a kut in a ngan ih ka hnenah tuahsuak dingih i cahmi an si,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang David in a fapa Solomon hnenah cun, “Hngetkhoh zet le ralṭha zetin um awla taima zetin ṭuan aw; zianghman in na thin lo nauter hlah seh. Bawipa Pathian, ka biakmi Pathian cu na hnenah a um ding. A lo dungtun lo ding ih a lo thlauthla fawn lo ding; a Biakinn sak na ṭheh hlanlo na hnenah a um ringring ding."},"21":{"text":"Puithiam le Levi mi pawl cu Biakinn hna an ṭuan dingmi zem ṭheh an si zo. Hnaṭuantu le zungthiam a phunphun nangmah bawmtu dingah an um ih misenpi le an hotu pawl cu na thupekmi vekih ṭuan dingah an tiar-aw thluh zo a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang David in a rakhawmmi hmuahhmuah hnenah, “Ka fapa Solomon cu Pathian ih hrilmi a si; asinain mino a si ih thilti ṭhang a si hrih lo. A hnaṭuan ding mi hi milai umnak siangpahrang inn a si lo ih Bawipa Pathian umnak ding Biakinn a si ruangah a thupi zetmi a si.","title":"Biakinn Saknak Ah Laksawng"},"2":{"text":"Ka ti thei tawkin inn saknak thilri cu ka khawl zo: sui, ngun, dar, thir, thing, lungmankhung le lungvar, mawiternak ah lung phun dangdang le lungto pawl ka khawl thluh zo."},"3":{"text":"Hi ka khawl ciami thilri pawl hlei ah Pathian Biakinn hrang ka ruah tuk ruangah, keimah hrimhrim in sui le ngun tampi ka pek."},"4":{"text":"Biakinn phar pawl mawiternak ah le zungthiam pawl ṭuan dingah sui ṭha bik pawl cuai thawng sawmnga le thawnghnih, le ngun ṭha bik pawl cuai thawng zakhat leng lo ka pek zo a si."},"5":{"text":"Nan lakah zoso Bawipa ih hnenah siang zetin a pe ding?” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah an hrin ih lubik pawl, an hrin ih hotu le upa pawl, ralkap hotu ralbawi pawl le siangpahrang thilri a kiltu le a zohtu pawl hmuahhmuah in,"},"7":{"text":"Biakinn hrangah cun an pek ciamco. An pekmi cu a zatein sui cuai thawng sawmriat le thawngriat, ngun cuai thawng za le sawmsarih le thawngruk, dar phurh thawng hleisarih, thir phurh thawng sawmkua le thawnghnih leng lo a si."},"8":{"text":"Lungmankhung a neitu pawl in Biakinn tangka kiltu Gershom hrin Levi mi Jehiel hnenah lungmankhung an pek."},"9":{"text":"Misenpi pawl cun lungtho zetin an pek ih cu zatzat an pek thei cu an lung a awizet. Siangpahrang David khal a lung a awi ngaingai."},"10":{"text":"David in misenpi hmaiah cun Bawipa a thangṭhat ih, “Kan pupa Jakob ih Pathian Bawipa , na hmin cu thangṭhat in um ringring seh.","title":"David In Pathian A Thangṭhat"},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah cu cungnungbik, huham neitu, a maksak mi le sunloih bik le a sang bik siangpahrang na si. Lei le van ih thil ummi hmuahhmuah na ta an si ih ziang hmuahhmuah ih tlunah siangpahrang le uktu bawi bik na si."},"12":{"text":"Thilri neihnak le lennak hmuahhmuah na hnen ihsin a rami an si; na cahnak le na huham thawn ziangzongza na uk ṭheh; na duh ahcun zohnen khalah thil titheinak le cahnak pe theitu na si."},"13":{"text":"Atu-ah kan Pathian, kan lungawinak kan lo sim ih na hmin sunglawi kan thangṭhat."},"14":{"text":"“Asinain ka minung pawl le kei hi zianghman kan si lo; kan lo pek taktak thei mi zianghman a um lo; ziangahtile kan neihmi hmuahhmuah cu nangmah ih in pekmi laksawng an si ṭheh ih na ta a si ciami kan lo pek salmi lawng an si."},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah ih in theih vekin, kan pu le kan pa bangtuk in nunnak lamzin ahhin ralkaihmi le mikhual vekih a vakvaimi kan si. Kan damsung caan hi a hlosalmi phenthla vek a si ih thihnak in luat dingah ruahsannak kan nei lo."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa kan Pathian, na hmin thianghlim cawimawinak ah hi thilri hmuahhmuah cu kan khawl zo; sikhalsehla na hnenih sin a rami lawnglawng an si ih a zatein na ta an si ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Mi thinlung cu na hniksak ih thinlung tluang a neimi parah na lung a awi, ti ka thei. Thinlung tluangzet le thinlung taktein hi thil hmuahhmuah hi ka lo pek ih hitawk ih a rami pawl khal in lungawi aipuangte in na hnenah an lo pek, ti ka hmu zo."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa , kan pupa Abraham, Isaak le Jakob ih Pathian, cubangtuk pek duhnak thinlung cu na minung pawl ih lung sungah kumkhua in run cakter awla, na hrangah rintlak minung si dingin run kilkhawi hai aw."},"19":{"text":"Na daan le na thupekmi hmuahhmuah a thlun theinak dingah le a thilri tla ka khawl thluh zo mi Biakinn cu a saksuak theinak dingah ka fapa Solomon hi ruahnak ṭha le thinlung famkim run pe hram aw,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule David in misenpi cu: “ Bawipa nan Pathian cu thangṭhat uh,” a ti hai ih misenpi pawl cun Bawipa , an pupa ih Pathian cu an thangṭhat. An lu an kun, leilungah an bok ih Bawipa Pathian le an siangpahrang hnenah upatnak an pek."},"21":{"text":"A thaisun ah rannung an that ih Bawipa ih hnenah thawinak le mei-ur thawinak pawl an pek. Cawcang thawng khat, tuucang thawng khat le tunote thawng khat an that ih Israel misenpi hrang inmi thawinak sabit an pek ih thawinak dang tla tampi tla an pek."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah cun an in an ei ih lungawizet in cuih ni cu an hmang. Cule David fapa Solomon cu siangpahrang ah a voihnihnak an tuah. Bawipa ih hmin in an siangpahrang ah hriak an culh ih Zadok khal puithiam ah an culh ve."},"23":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa ih a hngehtermi siangpahrang tokham ahcun a pa David ih aiah Solomon cu an toter a si. Siangpahrang hna cu hlawhtlingzet in a ṭuansuak ih Israel misenpi in a thu an ngai."},"24":{"text":"Bawi le upa hmuahhmuah le ralkap pawl le David fapa dangdang pawl tla in Solomon cu an siangpahrang dingah upatnak thukam an pek."},"25":{"text":"Solomon cu an ram pumpi in an ṭihzah ih Israel ram a uktu siangpahrang hmuahhmuah lakah sunloih bikmi siangpahrang ah Bawipa in a tuah."},"26":{"text":"Jesse ih fapa David in Israel ram pumpi cu,","title":"David Uknak A Tawi Zawngin"},"27":{"text":"kum sawmli sung a uk. Hebron khua in kum sarih sung a uk ih Jerusalem khua ihsin kum sawmthum le kum thum sung a uk."},"28":{"text":"Mi lianzet le mi ih upat zetmi si in tarzet in a thi ih a fapa Solomon in a ai a run awh."},"29":{"text":"Siangpahrang David ih thuanthu cu a hramthokin a cem net tiang profet pathum Samuel, Nathan le Gad ih thuanthu khumnak sungah kimten an ngan."},"30":{"text":"Ram a uk daan, huham a neihzia, a parih a ra thlengmi thuhla pawl le Israel le an kiangkap ram pawl hnenih a cangmi thuhla pawl tla kimten an ngan a si."}}}}},"14":{"info":{"name":"2 Sansiarnak","shortname":"2 San.","abbr":[],"desc":"2 sansiarnak (2 chronicles)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David ih fapa Solomon in Israel ram a uknak cu a hnget deuhdeuh; Bawipa a Pathian in a thlawsuah ih mi maksak ngaingai ah a tuah.","title":"Solomon In Fimnak A Dil (1 Sian. 3.1-15)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in a ralbawi ralkap thawngkhat hotu le zakhat hotu pawl hmuahhmuah, innsang ih hotu pawl, acozah bawi upa pawl le a ra khawmmi misenpi pawl cu,"},"3":{"text":"Gibeon ih Pathian biaknak hmun feh dingah thu a pek. Pathian siahhlawh Moses in hramlak ramṭhing an feh laiih a rak sakmi Bawipa ih Puanthlam umnak Gibeon ahcun an zatein an feh."},"4":{"text":"Thukam Kuang cu David in Kiriath Jearim ihsin Jerusalem ah a lak zo ruangah Jerusalem khua ih Puanthlam a sakmi sungah a um."},"5":{"text":"Hur fapa Uri ih fapa Bezalel ih tuahmi dar biakṭheng khal Gibeon ah Bawipa Puanthlam hmaiah a um. Cutawkah Solomon le misenpi cun Pathian an biak."},"6":{"text":"Puanthlam hmaiih ummi dar biakṭheng parah thawinak pe in Solomon cun Bawipa a biak; rannung thawngkhat a that ih biakṭheng parah cun mei-ur thawinak ah a pek."},"7":{"text":"Cuih zanah Pathian cu Solomon hnenah a lang ih, “Ziang so ka lo pek ding? Na duhmi i dil aw,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Solomon in, “Ka pa David parah duhdawtnak tumpi na rak nei ringring ih atu-ah a ai-ah siangpahrang i ṭuanter."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa Pathian, ka pa ih hnenih na thukammi hmuahhmuah cu kimter aw; ziangahtile siarcawk lo minung tlunah siangpahrang ah i tuah zo."},"10":{"text":"Minung hizat ka uk theinak dingah ka ṭul bikmi fimnak le theihnak i pe hram aw. Culo cun na minung hitluk tam hi ziangtinso ka uk thei ding?” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Solomon hnenah, “A dikmi na hril a si. Lennak le sumsaw, a si lole hminthannak maw, na ral pawl thihnak maw, a si lole nangmah ih hrangah nun khawsaunak maw, dil loin ka minung pawl uktu siangpahrang ah ka lo tuah ih anmah uk theinak ah fimnak le theihnak i dil ruangah,"},"12":{"text":"i dil vekin fimnak le theihnak ka lo pe ding. Cuih hlei ah zovek siangpahrang hmanih an rak neih dah lomi le an neih dah lo dingmi lennak, sumsaw le hminthannak ka lo pe ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule Solomon cu Pathian biaknak hmun, Puanthlam thianghlim umnak Gibeon ihsin Jerusalem ah a kir ih Israel ram cu a uk.","title":"Solomon Ih Maksaknak Le Lennak (1 Sian. 10.26-29)"},"14":{"text":"Rang le rangleng tampi neih a tum ih rangleng thawngkhat le zali, le rang ralkap hrangah rang thawng hleihnih a nei. A hrekkhat cu Jerusalem khawsungah a ret ih a hrekkhat cu khawpi dangdang ah a ret."},"15":{"text":"Israel ram a uk sungah sui le ngun cu Jerusalem khawsungah lungto zat in a tam ih sidar thingkung cu theipi kung zat in a tam."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang hrang thilri leitu pawl in Izipt le Kue ihsin rang pawl cu an lei ih,"},"17":{"text":"rangleng khal Izipt in an lei. Rangleeng pakhat cu ngun tangka zaruk in an lei ih, rang pakhat cu ngun tangka za le sawmnga an lei. Rang le rangleng an leimi pawl cu Hit siangpahrang le Siria siangpahrang hrang hnen khalah an zorh hai ṭheu."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Bawipa ih Biakinn sak ding le amah ih hrang siangpahrang inn pakhat sak dingah a relcat ih a tawlrel.","title":"Biakinn Saknak An Tawlrel (1 Sian. 5.1-18)"},"2":{"text":"Inn saknak thing nawltu dingah minung thawng sawm sarih a lak ih lungto sertu dingah minung thawng sawm riat a lak. An hnaṭuannak zoh le hotu dingah minung thawng thum le zaruk a ret."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in ṭai-ar siangpahrang Hiram hnenah hiti in thu a cah: “Ka pa siangpahrang David na rak bawm ih a siangpahrang inn saknak ah sidar thing na rak pek bangin kei khal i bawm ve dingah zaangfah ka lo dil a si."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ka Pathian hminthannak ah biakinn pakhat sak ka tum. Bawipa ka Pathian hminthannak le upatnak ah keimah le ka milai pawl, zingtin zantin Sabbath ni le Thla Thar puai caan le a dang ni thianghlim ni ah mei-ur thawinak kan peknak hmun a si pei ih cat loin Bawipa hnenih sang thianghlim kan hunnak hmun le rimhmui a phunphun ur in Bawipa kan biaknak hmun a si ding. A kumkhua hiti ih tuah dingin Bawipa in Israel mi hnenah thu a pek zomi a si."},"5":{"text":"Kan Pathian cu khawzing dangdang hnakin a maksak ih a lian bikmi a si ruangah a tum ngaingai mi Biakinn pakhat sak ka tum hrimhrim a si."},"6":{"text":"Asinain van tumzet le kauzetmi hmanah a tlem lomi Pathian a si ruangah Pathian umnak hrangah ti ngaingai cun zohman in Biakinn kan sak thei lo ding. Pathian hnenih rimhmui urnak biakinn fang dah ti lo cu kei in ziangso ka sak thei ding?"},"7":{"text":"Curuangah ka pa David in a hrilcia mi Judah ramsung le Jerusalem khua ih zungthiam pawl thawn hnaṭuan tlang dingah mi pakhat, lung ṭelhthiam, sui le ngun, dar le thir serthiam, mepian puan, puan sendup le puan sen pawl tah thiamtu i run kuat hram aw."},"8":{"text":"Na minung pawl thing-ah an thiamzia tla ka theih ruangah Lebanon in sidar thing, mirang far thing le hual thing pawl i run kuat hram aw. Biakinn ka sak tummi cu a tumzet le a mawizetmi a si ding ruangah,"},"9":{"text":"thing-ah tam ngaingai ka ṭul ih na minung pawl in in rak tawlrel sak hai sehla anmah bawmtu dingah ka minung pawl tla ka hun thlah ding."},"10":{"text":"Na minung pawl ih ei dingah sangvut haan thawng zakhat, barli sangvut haan thawng zakhat, sabitti lang thawng zali le thawng sawmli, le olif hriak lang thawng zali le thawng sawmli ka lo kuat ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule ṭai-ar siangpahrang Hiram in Solomon hnenah a thucahmi ca in a run khirh. A ca sungah cun, “ Bawipa in a minung pawl a duhdawt ruangah an siangpahrang ah a lo tuah zo."},"12":{"text":"Lei le van tuahtu Bawipa Israel ih Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh. Amah in siangpahrang David hnenah fimnak le theihnak in a khatmi Bawipa ih hrangah Biakinn le amah ih hrangah siangpahrang inn sak a tumtu fapa pakhat a pek a si."},"13":{"text":"Atu-ah mifimzet le kutzung thiam ngaingaimi Huram ka run thlah."},"14":{"text":"A nu cu Dan hrin a si ih a pa cu ṭai-ar khuami a si. Huram cu sui, ngun, dar, thir, lung le thing in ziang hmuahhmuah a serthiamtu a si. Puan mepian, puan sendup, puan sen le puan phangfem tla a tah thei thluh. A ṭelh a phunphun a tuah thiam ih a ruangrai nan sim hnuhnu cu tuah thiam lomi a nei lo. Na pa siangpahrang David hnaṭuantu pawl le na hnaṭuan zungthiam pawl thawn ṭuan tlang hai seh."},"15":{"text":"Cule kuat dingih in tiammi sangvut, barli sangvut, sabitti le olif hriak pawl cu in hun kuat aw."},"16":{"text":"Lebanon tlang ah na ṭulzat in sidar thing pawl cu kan hau ding ih pakhat le pakhat ṭemcih in puumpher ah kan tuah pei ih Joppa tiang tifinriat par in kan run kuat ding. Cutawk ihsin Jerusalem ah nang in na rak thiar pei,” tiah a ngan."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Israel ram sungih ummi ram dangmi pawl kha, a pa David ih a rak tuah vekin mipum siarnak a tuah. An zatein ram dangmi pawl cu thawng za le sawmnga le thawngthum le zaruk an um.","title":"Biakinn Sak An Thok (1 Sian. 6.1-38)"},"18":{"text":"Cuih sungin thawng sawmsarih cu zanthing nawltu ah, thawng sawmriat cu tlang parih lungto laitu le sertu ah a tuah hai ih a dang thawngthum le zaruk cu hnaṭuantu zoh le hotu ah a ret."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon cun Bawipa ih Biakinn cu Jerusalem khua, a pa siangpahrang David hnenih Bawipa a langnak Moriah Tlangmual ah sak a thok. Cuih hmun cu Jebus mi Araunah in a fang ciilnak puum ih a rak hmanmi a si ih David in a rak simsial thluh zo mi a si."},"2":{"text":"Solomon siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum li le thla hnihnak ah Biakinn sak cu a thok."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon ih a sakmi Biakinn cu pi sawmkua a sau ih pi sawmthum a kau."},"4":{"text":"Biakinn hmai ih hulhliap cu Biakinn tia in pi sawmthum a kau ih pi za le sawmriat a sang. Cuih hulhliap a phar sunglam cu sui in an khuut."},"5":{"text":"A laifang khaan cu sidar thing in an ṭelh ih sui in an khuut ih tuumkung le cikcin zuk an cuanter."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang in Biakinn cu lungmankhung le Parvaim ram ihsin lei mi sui in a ceimawi."},"7":{"text":"Biakinn phar pawl, innbo le luanglu pawl, le sangka pawl cu sui in a khuut. A phar ah zungthiam pawl in cherubim lem pawl an cuanter."},"8":{"text":"A sungta bik khaan cu Hmun Thianghlim Bik an timi a si ih pi sawmthum a sau ih Biakinn tia in pi sawmthum a kau. Hmun Thianghlim Bik phar pawl khuutnakah sui pawng thawng sawmli le thawng nga an hmang;"},"9":{"text":"tlawngkhen an hmanmi cu sui in an tuah ih tlawngkhen hrangah sui pawng khat lenglo a rit. Tlunta khaan phar pawl tla sui hlir in an khuut."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang in a hnaṭuantu pawl cu thir in cherubim lem pahnih a tuahter ih Hmun Thianghlim Bik ahcun a ret."},"11":{"text":"Cuih cherubim lem pawl cu sangka lam hoi in a ret hai ih artlang in an dinter. Cherubim pakhat in thla pahnih a nei ih a thla pakhat cu pi sarih le a hrek a sau; cuhrangah an thla an pharh tikah a khaan laifangah an thla cu a tong-aw ih khatlam thla in phar an dai veve; cuticun a khaan kauh lam pi sawmthum cu an thla in a dai ṭheh.","merge":"12"},"14":{"text":"Puanzar pakhat an tuah ih cuih puanzar cu pat phangfemte ih tah mi le mepian, sendup le a sen in buhmi a si; cuih puanzar cu cherubim lem pawl cuangin an ṭelhmi a si."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang in pi sawmnga le pi hnih a saangmi dar ṭhuam pahnih a tuah ih Biakinn hmaiah a phun. Ṭhuam ih lubo cu pi sarih le a hrek veve a sang.","title":"Dar ṭhuam Pahnih (1 Sian. 7.15-22)"},"16":{"text":"Ṭhuam ziik cu ṭhi kual a peh-aw thluhmi le dar ih tuahmi taleti zakhat in an ceimawi."},"17":{"text":"Ṭhuam pahnih cu Biakinn vung luhnak saklam le thlanglam ah an phun; thlanglamta cu Jakhin an ti ih saklamta cu Boaz an ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in dar in biakṭheng pakhat a tuah; pi sawmthum a sau, pi sawmthum a kau ih pi hleinga a sang.","title":"Biakinn Hrang Thilri (1 Sian. 7.23-51)"},"2":{"text":"Cule dar in pi sarih le hrek a thuk ih a kaa a puum mi maihum tumpi a tuah; khatlam tlang ihsin khatlam tlang cu pi hleinga a si ih a kimvel cu sawmli le pi nga a si."},"3":{"text":"A tlang ih lenglam kimvel ah thuaita le tlunta ti in mawiternak tlar hnih in an tuah. An mawiternak cu cawcang zuk cuang in an ṭelh ih maihum thawn peh aw in buurmi a si."},"4":{"text":"Tidai khawlnak maihumpi cu dar hlir in tuah mi cawcang lem hleihnih parah an ret ih, saklam thlanglam, nisuah lam le nitlak lam ah cawcang pathum fingfing an hoiter. Cawcang ih tawlam cu a laifang ah an tong-aw thluh zik."},"5":{"text":"Maihum phar cu pi thum a sah; a tlangzim cu khuat tlangzim vek, a si lole pangpar a par laimi vekin lenglam ah pharh nawn in a um. Cuih maihum cu tidai pung thawnghnih lenglo a tlem."},"6":{"text":"Cule kanto pahra tla an tuah ih panga cu Biakinn thlanglam ah, a dang panga cu Biakinn saklam ah an ret. Cuih kanto tidai cu mei-ur thawinak ih pekmi sa pawl kholhnakah an hmang. Maihum tumpi sungih tidai cu puithiam pawl in kholh awknak ah an hmang."},"7":{"text":"An tuah ṭheumi ruangrai vekin sui meivannak pahra le cabuai pahra an tuah ih Biakinn a laifang khaanpi sungah an ret; saklam ah meivannak panga le cabuai panga, thlanglam ah meivannak panga le cabuai panga an ret. Cuih hlei ah suikheng zakhat an tuah.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"A sunglam tual le a lenglam tual an tuah ih a sunglam tual cu puithiam pawl hrangah a si. A sunglam le a lenglam tual karlakih kotka kharnak sangka pawl cu dar hlir in an tuam."},"10":{"text":"Maihumpi cu Biakinn nisuahnak lam thlanglam kilah an ret."},"11":{"text":"Cun Huram in beel pawl, cawhleek pawl le kheng pawl a tuah, Siangpahrang Solomon hnenah tuah dingih a tiammi Biakinn thilri hmuahhmuah cu a tuah ṭheh: ṭhuam pahnih, ṭhuam parih retmi kheng ruangrai in ṭhuambo pahnih, ṭhuambo parih ṭhi kual peh-awmi pawl, ṭhuambo velkim ih a tlun le a hnuai ti ih retmi dar in tuahmi taleti zali, Cawleng pahra, Kanto pahra, Maihum, Maihum a hun dotu cawcang hleihnih, Bel pawl, cawhleek pawl le haiṭeek pawl an si. Zungthiam Huram in hi thilri pawl cu siangpahrang Solomon thupeknak bangtuk in Bawipa ih Biakinn sungih hman dingah hnawt tleumi dar in a tuah ṭheh.","merge":"12"},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang in Jordan Phairawn, Sukkoth le Zeredah karlakih a ummi dar sodennak hmunah a tuahter ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"An tuahmi thilri a tamtuk hrangah an hmanmi dar ziangzat a rit ti cu zohman ih tuat theih a si lo."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Biakinn sung hman dingmi thilri pawl cu kimtein a tuahter ṭheh. Ruangrai um cia vekin sui biakṭheng, Bawipa hrangih hunmi sang retnak cabuai pawl,"},"20":{"text":"meivannak ṭhuam pawl le Hmun Thianghlim Bik hmaiih van dingmi sui ṭha bikih tuahmi mei-inn pawl;"},"21":{"text":"Biakinn mawiternak pangpar pawl, mei-inn pawl, sui ṭha bikih tuahmi caiceh pawl;"},"22":{"text":"mei-inn meica cehnak pawl, kheng pawl, rimhmui urnak kheng pawl le meivam kennak kheng pawl an si. An zatein sui hlirih tuahmi an si. Biakinn lenglam sangka pawl le Hmun Thianghlim Bik ih luhnak sangka pawl cu sui ih khuutmi an si ṭheh."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Biakinn sak a ṭheh tikah a pa David in Bawipa hnenih a rak pekmi thilri-sui, ngun le a dang thilri pawl cu biakinn thilri retnak khaan sungah a ret thluh."},"2":{"text":"Cuih hnuah siangpahrang Solomon in Israel miphun, hrin dangdang ih lubik le hotu pawl cu David Khawpi Zion ihsin Bawipa ih Thukam Kuang cu la tahrat in Biakinn sungih ret dingah Jerusalem ah a kokhawm ṭheh.","title":"Biakinn Sungah Thukam Kuang (1 Sian. 8.1-9)"},"3":{"text":"An zatein thla sarihnak Puai caanah an tongkhawm-aw."},"4":{"text":"An hotu pawl hmuahhmuah an tonkhawm awk tikah Levi mi pawl in Thukam Kuang cu an zawn ih,"},"5":{"text":"Biakinn ah an fehpi. Puithiam le Levi mi pawl in Thukam Kuang, Puanthlam le a thilri hmuahhmuah cu Biakinn ah an ṭhawn thluh."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon le Israel mi hmuahhmuah cu Thukam Kuang hmaiah an pum aw ih tuu le caw siarcawk lo an that ih thawinak ah an pek."},"7":{"text":"Cule puithiam pawl in Thukam Kuang cu an zawn ih Biakinn sungah an luhpi hnuah Hmun Thianghlim Bik hmun, cherubim pahnih thla hnuai ah an ret."},"8":{"text":"Cherubim thla pharhmi cun Kuang le a zawnnak fung pawl cu a khuh thluh."},"9":{"text":"Cuih fungzim pawl cu Hmun Thianghlim Bik hmaizawn lawngin a lang thei; hmun dang cun hmuh a theih lo. Cuih fung pawl cu atu khalah an um lai."},"10":{"text":"Thukam Kuang sungah cun thil dang zianghman a um lo; Israel mi pawl Izipt ram in an suak ih anmah thawn Bawipa in thukamnak a rak tuah lai ih Moses in Sinai Tlang parah cuih Kuang sungih a rak retmi lungtlep pahnih lawng a um."},"11":{"text":"A pawl a pawl in a ṭhen-awmi puithiam hmuahhmuah an zatein, zo pawl ti um cuang loin thianhlimnak an tuah ṭheh.","title":"Sunlawinak"},"12":{"text":"Cule Levi mi hla saktu pawl-Asaf, Heman, Jeduthun le an sungkhat hmuahhmuah, an zatein pat phangfem ih tahmi puan mankhung an sin ih biakṭheng in nisuahnak lamah darsumsel, ṭingṭang le tingrisit pawl thawn an ding; an hnenah puithiam za le kul an um ih an zatein tawtawrawt an tum."},"13":{"text":"Hla saktu pawl le tawtawrawt tumtu pawl in an aw rualzet in, tawtawrawt, darsumsel pawl le tummi awnmawi dangdang thawn Pathian an thangṭhat ih: “ Bawipa cu a ṭha, In duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun,” tiah an sak. Puithiam pawl Biakinn in an suah vete in, hmakhatte-ah Biakinn cu Bawipa ih sunlawinak in mero bangin a tuam."},"14":{"text":"Tleunak in a khat ṭheh ih Bawipa biak khal an peh thei nawn lo."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Solomon in thla a cam ih: “ Bawipa, mero le khawdur sungah ka um ding na ti;","title":"Solomon Thusimmi (1 Sian. 8.12-21)"},"2":{"text":"Asinain na hrangah Biakinn mawizet ka sak zo, Bawipa kumkhua na umnak hrangah,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi hmuahhmuah cutawkah an ding. Siangpahrang cu anmah lam a hoi ih an hrangah Pathian thlawsuah a dil."},"4":{"text":"Solomon cun, “ Bawipa, Israel ih Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh. Ka pa David hnenah thukamnak a tuah ih,"},"5":{"text":"‘Ka minung pawl Izipt ram in ka suahter ni thokin tuihsun tiang, Israel ramsung khuitawk khawpi hmanah keimah in biaknak ah tiah biakinn saknak hmun ka hril lo ih ka minung Israel hotu ding khalah zohman ka hril hrih lo."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu ahcun keimah in biaknak hmunah Jerusalem ka hril ih ka minung pawl uktu dingah David nangmah ka lo hril a si,’ a rak timi hmuahhmuah cu a kimter thluh zo."},"7":{"text":"“Ka pa in Bawipa, Israel ih Pathian biaknak ah biakinn sak a rak tum;"},"8":{"text":"asinain Bawipa in, ‘Biakinn sak na thinlung in na tummi cu thil ṭhazet a si."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nangmah cun na sak lo pei. Na fapa, nangmah ih sungsuak na fapa in ka biakinn cu a sak ding,’ a ti."},"10":{"text":"“Atu-ah Bawipa in cuih a thutiammi cu a kimter zo. Ka pa ih ai-ah keimah Israel siangpahrang ka cang ih, Bawipa Israel ih Pathian biaknak ah Biakinn cu ka sak ṭheh zo."},"11":{"text":"Cule Biakinn sungah Bawipa in Israel mi thawn thukamnak a tuah ih cuih thukam ngannak lungtlep pawl umnak Thukam Kuang cu ka ret zo,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun misenpi hmuhah Solomon cu a feh ih biakṭheng hmaiah a ding ih baan phar in thla a cam.","title":"Solomon Thlacamnak (1 Sian. 8.22-53)"},"13":{"text":"Solomon in donhleisang pakhat dar in a tuah ih tual laifangah a ret. Cuih donhleisang cu pi riat sau, pi riat kau a si ih pi nga a sang. Cuih donhleisang parah cun a kai ih misenpi hmuh ah a khuk a bil ih a kut vanlam phar in thla a cam."},"14":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa, Israel ih Pathian, lei le vanah nangmah bangtuk Pathian dang an um lo. Na thupekmi thinlung takte ih an thlun tikah cun na minung pawl parah na thukamnak na kimter ih na duhdawtnak na langter."},"15":{"text":"Ka pa David hnenih na thutiam cu na fekter ih tuihsun ahhin pakhat hman hrelh loin a kim ṭheh a si."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah maw Bawipa, Israel ih Pathian, ka pa bangin na Daan an thlun ih na thu ṭhatein an ngai a si ahcun a tesinfa pakhatkhatión Israel siangpahrang an ṭuan ringring pei, tiih ka pa hnenih na thutiam mi tla kimter hram aw."},"17":{"text":"Na siahhlawh David hnenih na tiam mi hmuahhmuah cu maw Bawipa, Israel ih Pathian, pakhat hman hrelh loin kimter hram aw."},"18":{"text":"“Asinain maw Pathian, leilung minung lakah na um thei taktak pei maw? Van ih van sin hmanah na tlem lo ruangah kei ih ka sakmi Biakinn ahhin ziangtinso na tlem ding?"},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa ka Pathian, kei na siahhlawh ih thlacamnak le ka lo ngennak hi i run theihsak hram aw. Na hnenih ka dilmi le ka aunak hi i ngai hram aw."},"20":{"text":"Hi Biakinn hi a sun a zan in in kilsak hram aw. ‘In biaknak hmun a si ding,’ na tinak hih Biakinn lam hoi in thla ka cam tikah i theihsak hram aw."},"21":{"text":"Hi Biakinn hoi in ka thlacamnak le na minung Israel mi thlacamnak in theihsak hram aw. Na umnak vancung in in run thei awla kan sualnak in ngaithiam hram aw."},"22":{"text":"“Mi pakhat in midang parah thil tisual mi a nei ti in sual an puh ih a sual lonak kha siatcam ih thukamnak tuah dingah hi Biakinn na biakṭheng hmai an thlenpi tikah,"},"23":{"text":"maw Bawipa, vancung in run thei awla na minung pawl ih thu cu run relsak aw. A mawhmi cu a mawhnak vekin hrem awla a sual lotu cu run luatter aw."},"24":{"text":"“Na parih an sual ruangah na minung Israel pawl cu an ral pawl in an neh ih sualsir-aw in ngaithiamnak dil in hi Biakinn ah thla an ra cam tikah,"},"25":{"text":"van in run thei hram aw. Na minung pawl ih sualnak cu ngaithiam in an hnen le an pupa hnenih na pekmi ramah cun hruai kir hram aw."},"26":{"text":"“Na minung pawl na parih an sual ruangah vanruah na surter lo ih sualsir aw ih hi Biakinn hoi in thla an cam tikah,"},"27":{"text":"maw Bawipa, vancung in run thei awla Israel mi na minung pawl ih sualnak cu ngaithiam hram aw. A dikmi tuah dingah nangmah in zirh hai awla, na minung pawl hnenih kumkhua an ta si dingin na pekmi hi ramah hin vanruah surter hram aw."},"28":{"text":"“Hi ram sungah paam maw, natsia maw a thleng, a si lole an rawl thlisia in maw, kharbok in maw a siatsuah ṭheh; a si lole na minung pawl an ral in an do tikah le tlangrai in an nat thluh tikah,"},"29":{"text":"an thlacamnak run theihsak hram aw. Na minung Israel mi burpi in siseh, pakhatkhat in siseh, thinpit vansaang in hi Biakinn lam hoi in thla an cam tikah,"},"30":{"text":"run theihsak hram aw. Vancung na umnak in run thei awla an sualnak run ngaithiam aw. Minung ih thinlung le ruahnak cu nangmah lawng in na thei. An tuahmi ciar zoh in an thu run rel awla,"},"31":{"text":"cuticun kan pupa hnenih na rak pekmi ramih an um sung hmuahhmuah ah na minung pawl in an lo ṭihzah ding ih na thu an lo ngai ding a si."},"32":{"text":"“Israel mi a si lo miphun dang pakhatkhat lam hlapi ih a ummi asinain na huham le na cahnak le na thil titheizia a theih ruangah a ra ih, hih Biakinn hoi in thla a cam tikah,"},"33":{"text":"a thlacamnak cu run theihsak hram aw. Vancung na umnak ihsin run thei awla a lo dilmi cu tuahsak hram aw; cuticun na minung Israel mi in an lo theih ih an lo ṭihzah vekin, leilungtlun milai hmuahhmuah in an lo thei ding ih an lo ṭihzah ding. Cule hi ka sakmi Biakinn hi nangmah biaknak ding hmun a si, ti an thei ding."},"34":{"text":"“Na minung pawl cu raldo dingah thu na pek ih an fehnak hmun kipah hi na hrilmi khawpi le na hrangih ka sak mi Biakinn lam hoi in na hnenih thla an cam tikah,"},"35":{"text":"an thlacamnak cu run thei hram aw. Vancung in run thei awla nehnak run pek hai aw."},"36":{"text":"“Na minung pawl cu na parah an sual thluh, zohman misual lo an um lo; na thinheng in an ral pawl na nehter ih an ral pawl in an kai ih ram hlapi-ah an hruai tikah,"},"37":{"text":"na minung pawl ih thlacamnak cu thei hram aw. An saltaannak ramah an siir aw ih na hnenah thlacam in an sualnak le an ṭhatlonak an phuan ahcun, maw Bawipa an thlacamnak run theihsak hram aw."},"38":{"text":"Cutawk ram in thinlung taktein le thungaithlak in an sual siir aw in kan pupa hnenih na pekmi hi ram le na hrilmi hi khawpi le na hrangih ka sak mi hi Biakinn lam hoi in na hnenah thla an cam a si ahcun,"},"39":{"text":"an thlacamnak cu run theihsak hram aw. Na umnak vancung ihsin run thei in zaangfah hai awla an sualnak tla cu ngaithiam hram aw."},"40":{"text":"“Maw ka Pathian, atu-ah na mit in in run hmu awla hitawk hmun ih ka thlacamnak hi na hna in run ngai hram aw."},"41":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian, atu-ah tho in na cahnak langtertu Thukam Kuang thawn Biakinn sungah lut awla kumkhua in umta hram aw. Puithiam pawl an hnaṭuannak tinkim ah thlawsuahnak pe in an parih na ṭhatnak ruangah na minung pawl cu lungawi aipuang ringring in um hai seh."},"42":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian, hriak na culh zomi siangpahrang hi hnong hram hlah aw. Na siahhlawh David hnenih na duhdawtnak cu thei ringring hram aw,” tiah a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon cu thla a cam thluh tikah van in meisa a rung ih an thilpekmi thawinak pawl cu a kaang ṭheh; cule Bawipa ih sunlawinak huham in Biakinn cu a khat ṭheh.","title":"Pathian Hnenah Biakinn An Hlan (1 Sian. 8.62-66)"},"2":{"text":"Biakinn cu tleunak in a khah ruangah puithiam pawl a sungah an lut thei lo."},"3":{"text":"Van in meisa a rungmi le Biakinn cu tleunak in a khah kha Israel mi pawl in an hmuh tikah an dinnak tual ahcun an lu an kun ih Pathian bia in amah cu an thangṭhat, “ Bawipa cu a ṭha, A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Siangpahrang Solomon le misenpi in Bawipa ih hnenah thawinak an pek."},"5":{"text":"Cuih thawinak hrangah Solomon in caw thawngkul hluanhnih le tuu thawng zakhat le thawngkul a pek. Cuticun siangpahrang le misenpi in Biakinn cu Bawipa ih hnenah an hlan."},"6":{"text":"Puithiam pawl cu an hnaṭuannak hmun ciarah an ding ih Levi mi pawl cu an lam hoi in an ding. Siangpahrang David ih a rak hmanmi awn-mawi a phunphun thawn, “A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun,” timi hla sak phah in Bawipa cu an thangṭhat. Puithiam pawl in tawtawrawt an tum laiah misenpi pawl cu an ding thluh."},"7":{"text":"Cule Solomon in a tual laifang, Biakinn hmaizawn cu a thianhlimter hnuah cutawkah mei-ur thawinak, thlairawl thawinak, le remnak thawinak pawl pekmi ih sathau cu Pathian hnenah a hlan. Hizat thawinak hrangah cun dar biakṭheng a tuahmi cu a fatet tuk ruangah cutawkah thawinak pawl a pek a si."},"8":{"text":"Solomon le Israel mi pawl in Puai cu ni sarih sung an tuah. Puai hmun ih a rami pawl cu an tam ngaingai; saklam ah Hamath khua luhnak tlangkawn in le thlanglam ah Izipt ramri tiangin an ra."},"9":{"text":"A netnak ni ah puai an tuah. Biakṭheng hlannak ah ni sarih an rei ih puai tuahnak ah a dang ni sarih an rei lala."},"10":{"text":"Thla sarih thla, ni kul hluanthum ni ah Solomon in misenpi cu an inn ciarah a tlunter thluh. Bawipa in Israel mi le David le Solomon hnenah thluasuah a pek ruangah misenpi cu lungawi aipuang tein an tlung."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in Biakinn le siangpahrang inn cu a saduhthah le a ruangrai suaimi sungih a um vekin tlamtlingte in a sak ṭheh.","title":"Solomon Hnenah Pathian A Langsal (1 Sian. 9.1-9)"},"12":{"text":"Cule Bawipa cu Solomon hnenah zanah a lang ih a hnenah, “Na thlacamnak ka thei ih hi Biakinn cu ka hnenih thawinak nan peknak hmun dingah ka lungkim mi a si."},"13":{"text":"Vanruah ka surter lo tikah maw, rawl ei ṭhehtu dingah kharbok ka thlah tikah maw, a si lole ka minung pawl parih natsia ka thlenter tikah maw,"},"14":{"text":"ka hmin in kawhmi ka minung pawl in ka hnenah lungsiir in thla an cam ih ka mithmai an hawl ih an thil ṭha lo tuahnak ihsin an kirsal a si ahcun van in an thlacamnak ka thei ding ih an sualnak ka ngaithiam ding ih an ram cu ka damter ding."},"15":{"text":"Hi hmun cu ka kilveng ding ih hitawk ihsin ka hnenih thla an camnak cu ka thei ding."},"16":{"text":"Hi Biakinn cu ka hril zomi a si ih a kumkhua ih keimah biaknak hmunah ka thianhlimter zo mi a si. Hi hmun cu ka kilveng ding ih a kumkhua in ka humhim ding a si."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah ih cungcang thu ahcun na pa David bangtuk in ka daan le ka thupekmi pawl na thlun ih rinsantlak le felzetin ka hna na ṭuan ahcun,"},"18":{"text":"na tesinfa in Israel cu an uk ringring ding, tiah na pa David hnenih thukamnak ka rak tuahmi cu ka kimter ding."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nangmah le na minung pawl in ka daan le ka thupekmi pawl nan thlun lo ih khawzing dangdang tla nan biak asile,"},"20":{"text":"ka lo pekmi ram ihsin ka lo dawihlo hai dingih keimah in biaknak hmunah tiih ka thianhlimter ciami Biakinn cu ka taanta ding; Israel cu mi hmuahhmuah ih hmuhsuammi le nautatmi ah a cang ding."},"21":{"text":"“Atu ahcun hi Biakinn cu mikip ih porhmi a si; asinain cutikah cun a siatral thluh ding ih mi sukso pawl in an hmuh tikah mangbang khawruahhar in, ‘Ziangah so Bawipa in hi ram le hi Biakinn cu hiti lawmmam in a tisiat?’ an ti tikah,"},"22":{"text":"mikip in, ‘ Bawipa an Pathian, Izipt ram ihsin an pupa a hruaisuaktu cu an dungtun, an hnong ih khawzing dang hmaiah an kuun ih an biaksan ruangah Bawipa in an parah hi tlukin siatsuahnak a thlenternak a si,’ an ti ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Biakinn le a siangpahrang inn a sak ih kum kul a rei.","title":"Solomon Ih Hnaṭuanmi Dangdang (1 Sian. 9.10-28)"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hiram in a pekmi khawpi pawl tla a dinsal ih cuih khawpi sungah cun Israel mi pawl a umter."},"3":{"text":"Hamath le Zobah ram tla a lak ih,"},"4":{"text":"nelrawn ih ummi Jadmor khawpi tla ralhruang in a kulh ṭheh. Hamath ramih khawpi pawl tla a din sal thluh ih rawl retnak hmunah a tuah."},"5":{"text":"Solomon ih din salmi khawpi pawl cu: Beth Horon Sakta le Beth Horon Thlangta, an pahnih in ralhruang ih kulhmi an si ih an kotka pawl cu khar ih hren theihmi an si,"},"6":{"text":"Baalath khawpi, rawl a retnak khawpi hmuahhmuah le a rang le a rangleng pawl a retnak khawpi pawl an si. Jerusalem khua le Lebanon le a ukmi ram sungah inn sak dingih a tummi hmuahhmuah cu a duh vekin a saksuak ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Kanaan ram an lak laiah an thah lomi Kanaan mi pawl ih tesinfa pawl cu a hnaṭuantu an si. Hranhram in hna a ṭuanter mi pawl cu Hit mi, Amor mi, Periz mi, Hiv mi le Jebus mi an si ih an tesinfa pawl cu tuihsan tiangin sal an si.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu sal vekin hna a ṭuanter mi pakhat hman an um lo. Annih cu a ralkap pawl, a kuthnuai bawi pawl, rangleng ralkap le rangleng ralkap hotu pawl an si."},"10":{"text":"Inn sak hnaṭuantu pawl zohtu dingah siangpahrang Solomon kuthnuai ah hotu bawi zahnih le sawmnga an um."},"11":{"text":"Solomon in a nupi, Izipt siangpahrang ih fanu cu David khawpi timi Jerusalem khawhlun ihsin a hrangih sakmi inn ah a ṭhawnter. Solomon cun, “Ka nupi cu Israel siangpahrang David ih inn ahcun um ding a si lo, ziangahtile Thukam Kuang a thlennak poh cu hmunthianghlim a si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Solomon in Biakinn hmaiih a dawlmi biakṭheng ahcun Bawipa ih hnenah thawinak a pek."},"13":{"text":"Moses Daan sungih a um vekin puai ni tinte in mei-ur thawinak a pe ringring. Cuih puai pawl cu Sabbath ni, Thla Thar Puai kum tinte tuah mi Thilnu Tello Sang Puai, Thlaithar Puai le Puanthlam Puai an si."},"14":{"text":"A pa David in thlun ding daan pawl a rak tuah zo vekin puithiam pawl le hlasaknak thawn puithiam pawl a bawmtu Levi mi pawl cu nitinte ih an hnaṭuan dingmi a ngaihtuah sak cia ṭheh. Cuvek thotho in Pathian ih minung David thupek bangtuk in Biakinn kiltu pawl khal cu kotka an hnaṭuannak hmun ciarah nitin an ṭuan dingmi an tuahsak cia ṭheh a si."},"15":{"text":"David in thilri retnak inn pawl thuhla ah puithiam le Levi mi pawl a cahtami vekin ziang hmuahhmuah cu an tuah ṭheh a si."},"16":{"text":"Solomon ih tumtahmi hmuahhmuah cu a kim ṭheh. Bawipa ih Biakinn sak hram an thawh ni in an ṭheh tiang, an hnaṭuannak hmuahhmuah tlamtling lomi zianghman a um lo."},"17":{"text":"Cule Solomon cu Edom ram, Agaba Tipi kapih khawpi pahnih Eziongeber le Elath ah a feh."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hiram in tangphawlawng pawl a run kuat ih, tangphawlawng uktu bawi pawl le a mawng ṭhangtu minung pawl thawn a run kuat. Solomon kuthnuai ih bawi pawl thawn Ofir ramah an feh tlang ih Solomon hrangah sui pawng thawngthum an rak phur."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sheba ram siangpahrang bawinu in siangpahrang Solomon hmin thannak a thei ih thusuhnak harzetzet thawn hniksak dingah Jerusalem ah a ra. Mi tampi in an thlun ih rimhmui, lungmankhung le sui tampi phurtu kalauk pawl thawn an ra. Solomon a ton tikah a thinlung ih a ruahmi thusuhnak hmuahhmuah cu a sut ṭheh.","title":"Sheba Siangpahrang Bawinu A Ra Tlawng (1 Sian. 10.1-13)"},"2":{"text":"A thusuhmi cu Solomon in a let ṭheh, a leh thei lomi pakhat hman a um lo."},"3":{"text":"Cutiin Sheba siangpahrang bawinu in Solomon fimzia cu a hmu ih siangpahrang innpi a sakmi,"},"4":{"text":"a cabuai parih a rawl ei ding an hunmi pawl, a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih inn pawl, siangpahrang zungih hnaṭuantu pawl an uk awkzia le an thilthuam pawl, a rawl ei tikih a zohtu hnen-um pawl le a tlanleen tikih a kiltu pawl le an hnipuan hruk daan pawl le Bawipa ih Biakinn ih thawinak a pekmi pawl hmuahhmuah a hmuh tikah cun a mang a bangtuk ih a thinlung a hlo ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Cuih hnuah siangpahrang bawinu in Solomon hnenah cun, “Ka ram ihsin na thil titheizia le na fimnak thuhla ka theihmi cu a dik a si."},"6":{"text":"Keimah rori ra in ka mit ih ka ra lo hmuh hlanah cun in simmi cu ka zum thei lo. Ka hna lawngin ka rak theihmi cu na fimnak ngaingai ih hrek hman a rak si lo. An lo rel hnakin na fim sawn a si."},"7":{"text":"Na minung pawl le na kuthnuai ih hnaṭuantu pawl cu ziangtluk mi vanneiso an si! Ni tinte in na fimnak ṭongkam an thei ringring."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa na Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh. Na parah Bawipa cu a lung a awi ih amah ih hmin in mi uktu hrimhrim si dingah siangpahrang ah a lo tuah a sihi! Amah ih minung Israel pawl cu a duhdawt ruangah le kumkhua in a humhim duh ruangah nangmah cu an parih thudik le dingthluk lairelnak thawn uktu si dingah siangpahrang ah a lo tuah a si,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawinu in siangpahrang Solomon cu laksawng ah sui pawng thawngkua, rimhmui tampi le lungmankhung pawl a pek. Sheba ram siangpahrang bawinu in siangpahrang Solomon hnenih a pekmi rimhmui bangtuk rimhmui ṭha cu khui hmanah a um dah lo."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hiram le siangpahrang Solomon tla ih milai pawl, Ofir ihsin sui a rak phurtu pawl in hual thing le lungmankhung pawl tla an rak phur."},"11":{"text":"Solomon in cuih thing cu Biakinn le siangpahrang innih kailawn pawl tuahnak ah le hla saktu pawl ih ṭingṭang le tingrisit pawl tuahnak ah a hmang. Judah ramah cubangtuk cu an hmu dah lo."},"12":{"text":"Solomon in laksawng a ngahmi pawl ai-ah Sheba siangpahrang bawinu hnenah laksawng tampi a pek ih a ngahmi hnakin tam sawn a pek. Siangpahrang bawinu ih a dilmi hmuahhmuah a pek ṭheh a si. Cuih hnuah a thluntu pawl thawn Sheba ram ahcun an kir sal."},"13":{"text":"Kum tinte siangpahrang Solomon in sui pawng thawng sawm nga zikte a ngah ringring.","title":"Siangpahrang Solomon Lennak (1 Sian. 10.14-25)"},"14":{"text":"Himi cu sumtuahtu le dawrtuahtu pawl ih pekmi ngunkhuai tlunah a ngahmi a si. Arabia ram siangpahrang pawl le Israel ram sungih mi-uk bawi pawl in sui le ngun tampi an pek fawn."},"15":{"text":"Solomon in ralphaw a tummi zahnih a tuah ih ralphaw pakhat cu deenmi sui pawng hleinga ciarih khuhmi a si."},"16":{"text":"Cuih tlunah a fate deuhmi ralphaw zathum a tuah ih pakhat cu deenmi sui pawng riat ciarih khuhmi a si. Cuih ralphaw pawl cu a zatein Lebanon Tupi thingih sakmi siangpahrang innkhaan pakhat sungah a ret."},"17":{"text":"Solomon in siangpahrang tokham tumpi pakhat vuiho in a tuah ih sui hlir in a khuut."},"18":{"text":"Cuih tokham kainak dingah kaarbak paruk a um ih a hmai ahcun sui ih tuammi ke retnak a um. Vorhlam le kehlam ah kut retnak a um ih a siir ah kiosa lem pakhat veve an dinter."},"19":{"text":"Karbak paruk ih siir le siir ah kiosa lem hleihnih an ding. Hi bangtuk siangpahrang tokham cu khui ram hmanah a um dah lo."},"20":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon ih khuathai hmuahhmuah cu sui hlir ih tuahmi an si ih Lebanon Tupi Khaan sungih beelkheng pawl tla sui hlir ih tuahmi an si ṭheh. Solomon sanah ngun cu sunloihmi a rak si lo."},"21":{"text":"Cule tangphawlawng tampi a nei ih siangpahrang Hiram ih tangphawlawng thawn Tarshish khua ah an fehter ṭheu. Cuih a tangphawlawng pawl cun sui, ngun, vuiho, zawng le utawng pawl an phur."},"22":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon cu leilung tlun siangpahrang hmuahhmuah lakah a fimbik le a lianbik a si."},"23":{"text":"Pathian ih a pekmi fimnak theih duh ah siangpahrang hmuahhmuah in thu an ra ron ṭheu."},"24":{"text":"Solomon cu laksawng a phunphun sui, ngun, korfualpi, hriamnam, rimhmui, rang le laak pawl an pek. Cuih cabu sungah Israel siangpahrang Jeroboam pakhatnak ih thuhla khal an ngan ve.","title":"Solomon Uknak Thutlangpi (1 Sian. 11.41-43)"},"30":{"text":"Solomon in Israel ram pumpi cu Jerusalem khua ihsin kum sawmli sung a uk."},"31":{"text":"Solomon cu a thi ih David Khawpi, Jerusalem ah an phum. Cule a fapa Rehoboam in a ai-ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saklam hrin Israel mi pawl Rehoboam siangpahrang cangter ding in Shekhem ih an rak feh cia ruangah Rehoboam cu Shekhem ah a feh.","title":"Saklam Hrin Pawl Ral An Tho (1 Sian. 12.1-20)"},"2":{"text":"Nebat fapa Jeroboam cu siangpahrang Solomon ṭih ah Izipt ramah a tlan; asinain Rehoboam thu a theih tikah Izipt ram in a kirsal."},"3":{"text":"Saklam Israel mi pawl in Jeroboam cu an sawm ih an zatein hmun khatah Rehoboam hnenah cun an feh ih a hnenah,"},"4":{"text":"“Na pa in kan thil in ritter tuk. An thilrit zaanter dingih i fialtu pawl hnenah ziangtinso thu ka leh ding?” tiah thu a ron."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah annih cun,” ‘Ka zungte cu ka pa ih cawn hnakin a tum sawn a si."},"11":{"text":"Ka pa in nan phurh a ritter; kei khal in ka ritter sinsin ding. Ka pa in nuangfung in a lo vuak, kei in varngen tawpir thawn ka lo hrem hai ding!” tiah aw hrangzet in a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in profet Ahijah hmangin Nebat fapa Jeroboam hnenih a rak simmi kimter dingah Bawipa Pathian ih tummi a si. Cutikah siangpahrang Abijah cu Zemaraim Tlangah a kai ih Jeroboam le Israel mi pawl cu, “Maw Jeroboam le Israel mi pawl, i ngai hnik uh!"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in David hnenah amah le a tesinfa pawl cu Israel mi hmuahhmuah tlunah siangpahrang si ringring theinak thu pe in bal theih nawn lomi thukam a rak tuah zo, ti kha nan thei lo maw si?"},"6":{"text":"Cubangtuk asinain Nebat ih fapa Jeroboam cun Pathian ih hrilmi siangpahrang Solomon dodal in ral a tho."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hnuah zianglam hmanih santlai lo mihuatsuak pawl a kokhawm ih Solomon ih fapa Rehoboam cu a tuah duh lomi thil tiangin an tuahter. Neta bikah Bawipa in Jeroboam cu a hrem ih a thi."},"21":{"text":"Asinain Abijah cu a cak deuhdeuh. Nupi hleili a nei ih fapa kul hluanhnih le fanu hleiruk a nei."},"22":{"text":"Abijah ih thuanthu dang, a thusimmi le a thil tuahmi pawl cu Profet Iddo Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Abijah cu a thi ih David khawpi, siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Asa ih kuthnuai ah Judah ram cu kum hra sung daihnak an ngah.","title":"Asa In Sudan Mi Pawl A Neh"},"2":{"text":"Asa cun a dik le a ṭhami a tuah ruangah Pathian lung a awiter."},"3":{"text":"Ramdangmi pawl ih biakṭheng pawl le an khawzing biaknak hmun pawl cu a bal thluh; an serhmi lungphun pawl a khuai ih an khawzing nu Asherah lem pawl tla a siatbal ṭheh."},"4":{"text":"An pupa pawl ih Pathian Bawipa ih duhnak tuah dingah le a zirhnak le a thupekmi pawl thlun dingah Judah mi pawl cu thu a pek hai."},"5":{"text":"Judah ram khawpi hmuahhmuah ih ummi khawzing biaknak hmun le rimhmui urnak biakṭheng pawl a siatbal ṭheh ruangah a ukmi ram sungah daihnak a um."},"6":{"text":"Cuih caanah Judah ram khawpi pawl cu ralhruang in a kulh ih Bawipa in daihnak a pek ruangah kum tampi sung do awknak a um lo."},"7":{"text":"Judah mi pawl hnenah, “Kan khawpi pawl kimvel cu ralhruang in kan kulh ṭheh pei. Khuaram thlirnak innsang pipi kan sak pei ih khar theihmi le hren theihmi kotka kan tuah pei. Pathian duhnak kan tuah ruangah kan ram cu feltein kan uk thei. Amah in khuazakip ah humhimnak in pek a si,” tiah a ti. Curuangah a tivek cun an sak ih an ṭhangso sinsin."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang Asa in Judah mi sungin ralphaw le fei kengtu ralkap thawng zathum le Benjamin mi sungin ralphaw le conkiang neitu ralkap thawng zahnih le thawng sawmriat a nei. An zatein ralṭha zet le raldo zir cia hlir an si."},"9":{"text":"Ethiopia mi, Zerah an timi pa in ralkap million khat le rangleng zathum thawn Judah ram a do ih Mareshah tiang a hun nor."},"10":{"text":"Asa cu Zerah do dingah a pok ih an kap hnih in Mareshah kiang Zefathah Phairawn ah ṭanhmun an khuar veve."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Asa in Bawipa a Pathian hnenah thla a cam ih, “Maw Bawipa , ralkap cak zetmi siseh, ralkap ṭawnṭai zetmi siseh, na duh ahcun olte in na bawm thei a si. Maw Bawipa kan Pathian, nangmah lawng kan lo rinsan ih na hmin in ralkap hizat tam hi do dingah kan rasuak zo a si; atu-ah in bawm hram aw. Bawipa , nangmah cu kan Pathian na si ih zohman in nangmah neh ding cu an tum ngam lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Asa le Judah ralkap in an do tikah Bawipa in Ethiopia ralkap pawl cu a neh. Ethiopia ralkap pawl cu an tlan ih,"},"13":{"text":"Asa le a ralkap pawl in Gerar tiang an dawi. Ethiopia ralkap pawl cu tamzet thah an si ruangah raldo thei an si nawn lo. Bawipa le a ralkap pawl in an neh hai ih ralkap pawl in hransaw tampi tla an long."},"14":{"text":"Cutawk hrawngih a ummi pawl in Bawipa cu an ṭih tuk ruangah Judah ralkap pawl in Gerar kiangkapih ummi khawpi pawl cu an siatsuah ṭheh. Khawpi tamzet an ram ih hransaw tamzet an lak."},"15":{"text":"Tuukhal pawl riahhmun hrekkhat pawl tla an nam ih tuu le kalauk tampi an long. Cuih hnuah Jerusalem ah an tlung."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ih thlarau cu Oded ih fapa Azariah parah a rung thleng ih,","title":"Asa In A Tharsuah"},"2":{"text":"siangpahrang Asa hnenah a feh ih, “Siangpahrang Asa, Judah le Benjamin mi pawl, i ngaihnik uh! Bawipa lamih nan ṭan sung cu Bawipa in a lo ṭan ve a si. Amah nan hawl a si ahcun ton theih in a um ding; asinain nan dungtun a si ahcun a lo dungtun ve ding."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu caan reipi Pathian dik nei lo, zirhtu puithiam nei lo le daan nei loin an um."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla harsatnak an ton tikah Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian hnenah an kir sal. Bawipa cu an hawl ih an tong ṭheu."},"5":{"text":"Culai caan ah khuazakipah ṭihphannak le remlonak a um ruangah khui hmanah zohman an suakvak ngam lo."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in an parah harsatnak le vansaannak a thlenter ruangah ram khat le ram khat, khua khat le khua khat an rem-aw lo."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih cu cakzet le ralṭha zetin nan um pei ih nan hnaṭuan man nan co ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Asa in Oded ih fapa profet Azariah ih thuphuanmi a theih tikah a tha a tho zet. Judah le Benjamin ram le Efraim tlangpar ram an lakmi khawpi hmuahhmuah sungih a ummi milem pawl cu a hlonsak ṭheh. Cule Biakinn tualih a ummi Bawipa ih biakṭheng tla a rem."},"9":{"text":"Efraim ram, Manasseh ram le Simeon ram ihsin minung tampi Asa hnenah an ra ih a ram sungah an um; ziangahtile a hnenah Bawipa a um ti an hmu. Asa in cuih a rami pawl le Judah mi le Benjamin mi pawl cu a kokhawm."},"10":{"text":"Asa siangpahrang a ṭuan kum hleinga kum, thla thumnak ah Jerusalem ah an tongkhawm aw."},"11":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun an ral pawl hnenin an lonmi hransaw sungin caw zasarih le tuu thawng sarih Bawipa ih hnenah thawinakah an pek."},"12":{"text":"An pupa ih Pathian Bawipa cu an thinlung le an thazaang zate thawn bia dingah an zate lungkim in thukam an tuah."},"13":{"text":"Zozo khal, mino siseh, upa siseh, nunau mipa tilo in, Bawipa a bia lotu cu thah si dingin thu an kam-aw."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmin in cuih an thukam cu thlun dingah ringzet in siat an cam ih tawtawrawt le tuucangki tum in napi in an au ciamco."},"15":{"text":"An thinlung taktein thukam an tuah ruangah Judah mi hmuahhmuah cu an lung a awi ngaingai. Pathian an biaknak parah lunghmuinak an nei. Pathian ih pommi miphun ah an cang ih khuazakip ah daihnak a pek."},"16":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang Asa ih pi Maakah in khawzingnu Asherah lem a tuah ruangah siangpahrang bawinu ih nu a sinak in Asa in a hlon a si. Asa in milem cu a hauthluk ih a tan seksek hnuah Kidron Horkuam ah meisa in a ur."},"17":{"text":"Asa cun Israel ram sungih khawhrum biaknak hmun hmuahhmuah cu a siatbal thluh lo naón a damsung hmuahhmuah ah Bawipa rinsan in a nung."},"18":{"text":"Pathian hnenah a pa Abijah ih pekmi thilri pawl le amah ih pek mi sui le ngun in tuahmi bungbeel pawl cu Bawipa ih Biakinn sungah a ret ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Judah ram a uknak kum sawmthum le kum nga sung cu a ram sungah do awknak a um lo."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Asa ih Judah ram a uknak kum sawmthum le kum ruknak ah Israel siangpahrang Baasha in Judah ram cu a do ih, Judah ramsung suah luhnak kham thluh dingah Ramah khawpi ralhruang in a kulh.","title":"Israel Thawn Do Awknak (1 Sian. 15.17-22)"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Asa in Bawipa ih Biakinn le siangpahrang inn ih an retmi sui le ngun pawl cu a lak ih Damaskas ah Siria siangpahrang Benhadad hnenah a kuat. Cuih tlunah,"},"3":{"text":"“Kan pa le pawl ṭangkhat an rak si vekin kannih khal kan ṭangkhat pei. Hi sui le ngun hi laksawngah ka lo ṭhen a si. Israel siangpahrang Baasha in a ram sung ihsin a ralkap pawl kirpi dingah amah thawn nan ṭantlangnak cu phiat thlang aw,” tiah thu a cah."},"4":{"text":"Benhadad in Asa ih thucahmi cu a lungkim ih Israel khawpi pawl do dingah a ralbawi pawl le an homi ralkap pawl a thlah. Israel cu an do ih Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maakah le Naftali ramih rawl an retnak khawpi pawl an lak ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Baasha in a theih tikah Ramah ralhruang kulhnak tuah nawn loin a tlansan."},"6":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Asa in Judah ramsung hmunkip in milai a khawm ih Baasha in Ramah kulhnak ih a hmanmi lungto le zanthing pawl cu a phurhter hai ih Geba le Mizpah khawpi kulhnakah an hmang."},"7":{"text":"Culai ah profet Hanani cu Judah siangpahrang Asa hnenah a feh ih, “ Bawipa na Pathian rinsan lo in Siria siangpahrang na rinsan sawn ruangah Israel ralkap pawl cu na kut sung ihsin an luat thluh zo a si.","title":"Profet Hanani"},"8":{"text":"Ethiopia le Libia ralkap pawl cu rangleng le rang ralkap an nei tam deuh ngaingai a si lo maw? Cutluk tam an si naón Bawipa na rak rinsan ruangah Bawipa in nehnak a lo pek a si."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa cun Amah rinsannak thinlung a neitu hnenah thazaang cak pe dingin leilung pumpi hi a zoh ringring a si. Aatthlakzet ih thil na tuah zo ruangah atu thokin ral na do ringring ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cumi thu a theih tikah Asa cu profet Hanani parah a thin a heng ngaingai ih thawngah a thlak ih thir cikcin in a hren. Cuih caan hrawngah Asa in a ramsungmi hrekkhat pawl cu zaangfahnak nei loin a hrem hai."},"11":{"text":"Asa ih Judah ram a uk sung thil a cangmi hmuahhmuah cu a hramthokin a net tiang, Judah Le Israel Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si.","title":"Asa Ih Uknak A Cem (1 Sian. 15.23-24)"},"12":{"text":"Asa cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum sawmthum le kum kua kumah a ke ah besia zetin hma sia a tuar. Asinain Pathian rinsan loin sibawi pawl a rinsan sawn."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum sawmli le kum khat kumah a thi ih,"},"14":{"text":"David khawpi ah amah hrangih a rak kherciami lung thlaan ah an phum. A ruak phumnak ah rimhmui le siti rimthaw pawl an hmang ih amah upatnak ah meipi nasa zetin an tik."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asa a thih tikah a fapa Jehoshafat in a ai-ah Judah siangpahrang a run ṭuan ih Israel do dingah a tha a cakter sinsin.","title":"Jehoshafat Siangpahrang A Cang"},"2":{"text":"A ralkap pawl cu Judah khawpi tampi ah le hramlakah le Asa in Efraim ram a lakmi khawpi sung tla ah a ret vivo."},"3":{"text":"A pa no laiih nunzia thlun in Baal khawzing a biak lo ruangah Bawipa in Jehoshafat cu thlawsuah a pek."},"4":{"text":"Jehoshafat cun a pa ih biakmi Pathian rian in a thupekmi vekin a thlun ih Israel siangpahrang dang pawl vekin thil ṭha lo a tuah lo."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in amah cu Judah ram feltein a ukter ih mi hmuahhmuah in a parah lungawi in laksawng an pek ciamco ruangah milianzet le upat ṭihzah zetmi ah a cang."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnaṭuan a uar zet ih Judah ram sungih khawhrum biaknak hmun pawl le Asherah lem pawl khal a siatbal ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan kum thumnak ah a tanglam ih bawi pawl: Benhail, Obadiah, Zekhariah, Nethanel, le Mikaiah cu Judah ram khua pawl sungih mi zirhtu dingah a thlah."},"8":{"text":"A tlunih bawi pawl cu Levi mi pakua: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, Tobadonijah le puithiam pahnih Elishama le Jehoram in an thlun."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih Daan cabu an keng ih Judah ram khua hmuahhmuah ah an feh ih misenpi an zirh vivo."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa ih huham ruangah Judah ram kiangkap ih a ummi ram hmuahhmuah in Jehoshafat do ding cu an ngam lo.","title":"Jehoshafat Lennak"},"11":{"text":"Filistin mi hrekkhat pawl in Jehoshafat cu laksawng tampi an pek ih ngunkhuai ah ngun tampi tla an pe. Arab mi pawl khal in tuu thawng sarih le zasarih le me thawng sarih le zasarih an pe."},"12":{"text":"Cuticun Jehoshafat cu a ṭhangso deuhdeuh ih a cak deuhdeuh fawn. Judah ram sungah rawl le thilri khawlnak khua pawl a tuah ih ralhruang in a kulh."},"13":{"text":"Cuih a dinmi khua pawl ahcun thilri tampi a ret. Jerusalem khua ah ralbawi le ralkap ṭha bik pawl"},"14":{"text":"a hrin a hrin in a ret. Judah hrin sungin Adnah cu ralkap hotu bawi a si ih a kuthnuai ah ralkap thawng zathum an um."},"15":{"text":"Pahnihnak cu Jehohanan a si ih a kuthnuai ah ralkap thawng zahnih le thawng sawmriat an um."},"16":{"text":"Pathumnak cu Zikhri ih fapa Amasiah a si ih ralkap thawng zahnih a nei. Amasiah cu pum pe-aw in Bawipa ih hnaṭuantu a si."},"17":{"text":"Benjamin hrin sungin ralkap hotu bawi cu ralkap hminthangzet Eliada a si ih ralphaw le conkiang hriamnam kengtu ralkap thawng zahnih hotu a si."},"18":{"text":"Eliada sangtu bawi cu Jehozabad a si ih hriamnam kimzet thawn ralkap thawng zakhat le thawng sawmriat a nei."},"19":{"text":"Hi ralkap pawl cu Judah ram khawpi pawl ih a retmi ralkap pawl hlei ah Jerusalem ih siangpahrang riantu an si."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu milianzet le mi hminthangzet a hung can tikah a sungkhat hrekkhat pawl le Israel siangpahrang Ahab ih sungkhat pawl thawn ṭhit-umnak in pehtlaih awknak a tawlrel.","title":"Mikaiah In Ahab Ralrinnak A Pek (1 Sian. 22.1-28)"},"2":{"text":"Cuih hnu kum reipi hnuah Jehoshafat cu Ahab tlawng dingin Samaria khua ah a feh. Jehoshafat le a thluntu pawl upatnak ah Ahab in puai tumpi a tuah ih caw le tuu tampi a thah. Cule Ahab in Gilead ramih Ramoth khua do dingah Jehoshafat cu a sawm."},"3":{"text":"Ahab in, “Ramoth ka do ding ih na tel thei ve pei maw?” tiah a ti. Jehoshafat in, “Ka lo ṭanpi ding. Na man tikah i sim awla kei le ka ralkap pawl kan pok ding."},"4":{"text":"Asinain hmaisabik ah Bawipa kan ron ta pei,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Ahab in profet zali tluk a ko ih, “Ramoth ka do ding maw, do lo dingso?” tiah a sut hai. Profet pawl cun, “Do aw. Pathian in nehnak a lo pe ding,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jehoshafat in, “ Bawipa kan ron theinak dingah Bawipa ih profet pakhat tal an um lo maw?” tiah a sut."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Ahab in, “A dang pakhat a um hrih. Imlah fapa Mikaiah a si. Asinain Mikaiah cu ka hua; ziangahtile ziangtik hmanah ka hrangah thuṭha a phuang dah lo; a simmi cu thuṭha lo a si ringring,” tiah a ti. Jehoshafat cun, “Cuvek ṭong cu siangpahrang na hmurka in suakter hram hlah aw,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang Ahab in a kuthnuai bawi pakhat a ko ih Mikaiah zamrangih ko dingah a fial."},"9":{"text":"Cule Ahab le Jehoshafat cu an siangpahrang thuam in an thuam-aw ih Samaria khawpi kotka leng fangrialnak hmunah siangpahrang tokham veve ah an to ih an hmaiah cun profet pawl cu profet ṭong in thu an sim rero."},"10":{"text":"Profet pawl lakah pakhat Khenaanah ih fapa Zedekiah in thir in tuuki pawl a tuah ih Ahab hnenah, “ Bawipa in, ‘Hi bangtuk ki pawl thawn Siria mi nan do ding ih nan neh ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"11":{"text":"Profet dang khal in cubangtuk in an sim ciar. “Ramoth do dingah feh awla na neh mai ding. Bawipa in nehnak a lo pe ding a si,” an ti."},"12":{"text":"Cu sungah Mikaiah kawh an fialmi pa cun Mikaiah hnenah, “Profet dang hmuahhmuah in siangpahrang ih neh dingah an sim ciar. Nang khal an sim vekin na sim le a ṭha ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Asinain Mikaiah cun, “ Bawipa ih hmin saal in ka lo sim: Ka Bawipa ih i simtermi lawnglawng ka sim ding,” tiah a sawn."},"14":{"text":"Mikaiah cu Ahab siangpahrang hmai ih a thlen tikah siangpahrang in, “Mikaiah, siangpahrang Jehoshafat le keimah in Ramoth kan do ding maw, do lo ding, i sim aw?” tiah a ti. Cutikah Mikaiah in, “Do hnik hmen uh! Nan neh meen ding! Bawipa in nehnak a lo pe ko ding,” tiah a sawn."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Ahab in, “ Bawipa ih hmin in ka hnenih na ṭong tikah thudik na ṭong pei tiah voi ziangzatso ka lo sim ding?” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule Mikaiah cun, “Israel ralkap pawl cu fing le tlangpar ah khaaltu nei lo tuu pawl bangin suk le so ah an vakvai ka hmu. Cule Bawipa in, ‘Himi pawl cu hotu an nei lo; daitein an inn ah tlung hai seh,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Ahab in Jehoshafat hnenah, “Hi pa cun ka hrangah thuṭha a sim dah lo, ka lo ti tho lo maw? Ziangtik khalah thusia ringring a sim,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule Mikaiah cun, “ Bawipa ih ṭong cu ngai hrih uh. Bawipa cu a vancungmi pawl in a kimvel in an kil ih vancung a bawi tokham parih a to khi ka hmu."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa in, ‘Ahab cu Ramoth ah feh tahrat in thah tong ding ah zo in so a vung buum ding? tiah a suh tikah vancungmi hrekkhat in phunkhat an sim; a dang in phundang an sim."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah thlarau pakhat cu hmaiah a ra suak ih Bawipa cu a rak naih ih, ‘Keimah in ka vung buum ding,’ tiah a ti. Bawipa in, ‘Ziangtin so na buum ding?’ tiih a suh tikah,"},"21":{"text":"cuih thlarau cun, ‘Ka vung feh pei ih Ahab ih profet hmuahhmuah thuphan ka perter thluh ding,’ tiah a sawn. Bawipa in, ‘Feh awla vung buum aw. Na buum suak thei ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"22":{"text":"Cule Mikaiah in, “Cuvek cekci in a cang ngaingai a si. Bawipa in na profet pawl hmuahhmuah cu na hnenah thuphan a relter ṭheh hai. Sikhalsehla Bawipa Amah in vanduainak na tonnak dingah lai a rel zomi a si,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah profet Zedekiah cu Mikaiah hnenah a hung feh ih Mikaiah cu a biang ah a beng ih, “Ziangtik in so Bawipa thlarau in i tlansan ih na hnenah thu a lo sim?” tiah a sut."},"24":{"text":"Mikaiah cun, “A thuuk bik khaan sungih na relh tikah na thei leh ko ding,” tiah a sawn."},"25":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Ahab in a kuthnuai bawi pakhat hnenah, “Mikaiah hi kai awla khawpi uktu bawi Amon le siangpahrang fapa Joash hnenah hei hruai aw."},"26":{"text":"Himdamteih ka ra thlen sal hlanlo thawng ah rak thla hai sehla thawngtla rawl, tidai le sang rak pe ve hai seh,” tiah a fial."},"27":{"text":"Cutikah Mikaiah in, “Himdamteih na rakir sal thei a si ahcun Bawipa in ka hnenah a ṭong lo a si ding. Ka sim mi hi mi hmuahhmuah in thei hai seh,” tiah ringzet in a au."},"28":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang Ahab le Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu Gilead ramih Ramoth khawpi do dingah an feh.","title":"Ahab A Thi (1 Sian. 22.29-35)"},"29":{"text":"Cule Ahab in Jehoshafat hnenah, “Ral kan do tikah nang cu na siangpahrang thuam hruk awla kei cu mi meenmeen vekin ka thuam-aw ding,” tiah a ti. Cuticun Israel siangpahrang cu midang vekin tuah-aw tahrat in ral a do."},"30":{"text":"Siria siangpahrang in a rangleng ralkap hotu bawi pawl cu Israel siangpahrang bawipa siar lo midang zohman tuahmawh lo dingin thu a pek."},"31":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Jehoshafat an hmuh tikah Israel siangpahrang ah an ruat ih an nam ciamco. Asinain Jehoshafat cu a au ih Bawipa Pathian in a run ih a hualtu pawl cu an kir."},"32":{"text":"Rangleeng ralkap hotu bawi pawl in Israel siangpahrang a si lo kha an theih tikah an dawi nawn lo."},"33":{"text":"Asinain Siria ralkap pakhat pa in bah-mi nei cuca loin a conkiang a hei sai ih siangpahrang Ahab cu a awmphaw le ralthuam peh awknak a hliah zawnte-ah a hei ngah. Cutikah Ahab cu, “In ngah ee!” tiah a au ih a rangleng mawngtupa cu raldonak hmun ihsin tlanpi dingah thu a pek."},"34":{"text":"Cuih ni an do-awk cu a nasa ngaingai ih Ahab cu a rangleng parah do cop in Siria ralkap pawl lam hoi in a zau ih nitlak zawng ah a thi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu himdam tein Jerusalem khua a inn ah a kir sal.","title":"Profet In Jehoshafat Nun A Sim"},"2":{"text":"Cule Hanani ih fapa profet Jehu cu siangpahrang Jehoshafat tong dingah a feh ih a hnenah, “Mi ṭha lo pawl bom le Bawipa a huatu pawl hnenih ṭan hi a ṭha tiah na ruat maw si? Hitiih na tuah ruangah nangmah ih parah Bawipa ih thinhengnak na thlenter."},"3":{"text":"Asinain na ṭhatnak khal cu a um ve: midang ih an biakmi khawzingnu Asherah lem pawl na hlon ṭheh ih Bawipa ih duhnak na hawl ringring,” tiin nun a sim."},"4":{"text":"Jehoshafat cu Jerusalem khawpi ah a um naón Judah a ram sungah thlangta bik Beersheba in sakta bik Efraim tlangpar ramri tiang khual a tlawng ringring ih a minung pawl cu an pupa ih Pathian Bawipa hnenih hoikir sal dingah a forh vivo.","title":"Jehoshafat Ih A Tharsuahmi"},"5":{"text":"Judah ram sungih khawpi kipah thuṭhentu pawl a ret ih,"},"6":{"text":"an hnenah, “Thu nan rel ih thuṭhennak nan tuah tikah ralringzet in nan tuah pei; thu nan ṭhen tikah nanmah ih thuneihnak in thu nan ṭhen a si lo; Bawipa ih thuneihnak in a si; cule thu nan ṭhen tikah Amah cu nan lakah a um a si."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihzah uhla ralringzet in hna ṭuan uh; ziangahtile Bawipa in mibum, mi thleidan le nawhthuh ei pawl a zawi thei hrimhrim lo,” tiah thu a cahta vivo."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem khua khalah siangpahrang Jehoshafat in thuṭhentu ah Levi mi, puithiam pawl le khawsung upa hminthang pawl a ret hai ih Bawipa ih daan an buar tikah le khawsungmi taza an cuai-awk tikah thuṭhentu an si."},"9":{"text":"An hnenah, “Nan ṭuanvo cu Bawipa ṭihzah phah in felte le thleidannak nei lotein nan ṭuan pei."},"10":{"text":"Khua dangdang ihsin nan unau pawl, pakhat le pakhat an thah pang awknak thu-ah siseh, Bawipa ih daan le thupekmi an buarnak thu-ah siseh, nan hnenih an thlen tikah Bawipa parih sualnak an neih lonak dingah ralringzet in an ṭuanvo ciar cu nan simfel pei. Cumi nan tuah lo a si ahcun nanmah le nan unau pawl in Bawipa ih thinhengnak nasa zetin nan tuar ding. Sikhalsehla feltein nan ṭuanvo nan tuah a si ahcun mawh nan phur lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Biaknak lam thu hmuahhmuah ah puithiam sang Amariah cu thuneitu bik a si ding; khawsungmi pawl ih thu ahcun Judah ram uktu bawi Ishmael ih fapa Zebadiah thuneitu bik a si ding. Thuṭhentu pawl ih thuṭhenmi tuahsuak dingah ṭuanvo a neitu cu Levi mi pawl an si ding. Ralṭhazet in ṭuan uhla hi ka lo cahmi thu bangin tuah uh; Bawipa cu midik pawl parah um hram seh,” tiah a ti."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tikcu a hung rei tikah Moab ralkap le Ammon ralkap pawl in, anmah ṭantu Meunim mi pawl thawn Judah ram an do.","title":"Judah Mi In Edom Mi An Do"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jehoshafat hnenah thuphurtu an ra thleng ih, “Edom ram in ralkap tam ngaingai an ra ih Tipi Thi khatlam ral in a lo do an tum a si. Hazazon Tamar khua tla an la zo,” tiah an sim. (Hazazon Tamar cu En-gedi ti khal in an ko.)"},"3":{"text":"Jehoshafat cu a thin a phang ih thlacam in Bawipa ih hruainak a dil. Cule a ramsungmi hmuahhmuah rawl ul dingah thu a pek."},"4":{"text":"Judah ram khawkip in Jerusalem ah Bawipa ih hruainak dil dingin an ra."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem khuasungmi pawl thawn Biakinn tual thar ah an tongaw khawm. Siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu an hmaiah a va ding ih,"},"6":{"text":"ring zetin thla a cam: “Maw Bawipa , kan pu le kan pa ih Pathian, na umnak van ihsin leitlun miphun hmuahhmuah nangmah in na uk ṭheh. Cahnak le huham hmuahhmuah nangmah ih ta an si ih a lo dodal theitu zohman an um lo."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah cu kan Pathian na si. Na mi Israel pawl hitawk ram an ra thlen tikah hitawk ih a rak ummi miphun pawl cu na dawi hai ih na rualpa Abraham ih tesinfa pawl hnenah hi ram cu kumkhua an ta si dingin na pek."},"8":{"text":"Hi ram sungah an um ih nangmah upatnak ah Biakinn an sak."},"9":{"text":"Harsat vansaannak a phunphun-raldo siatsuahnak, natsia le paam an hnenih a thlen tikah hi Biakinn hmaiah ding in an lo bia, an lo ngennak hmun ah an tuahmi a si. Na hnenih thla an ra cam tikah na theih sak ih na run hai ṭheu."},"10":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , atu-ah Ammon mi, Moab mi le Edom mi pawl in in do. Kan pupa pawl Izipt ram ihsin an rak suah laiah hi ram pawl hi an pal phah ding na rak siang lo; curuangah kan pupa pawl in an ram cu an heel ih an siatsuah lo."},"11":{"text":"Cucingin atu-ah in thungrulh tum daan hi zohhnik-in pekcia mi ram ihsin a dawihlo in tum a si."},"12":{"text":"Maw Pathian, kan Pathian, Nangmah in hrem hai aw. In dotu ralkap hizat hmaiah cun kan caang thei hrimhrim lo. Ziang hman kan tuah theimi a um nawn lo; nangmah ih bom ding lawng kan hngak a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Judah mi hmuahhmuah an nupi le an faate pawl thawn Biakinn tual ahcun an ding."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa ih thlarau cu misenpi lakih a ummi Levi mipa pakhat hnenah a rung thleng. Amah cu Jahaziel a si ih Zekhariah ih fapa, a si. Zekhariah cu Benaiah ih fapa a si; Benaiah cu Jeiel ih fapa a si; Jeiel cu Mattaniah ih fapa a si; Mattaniah cu Levi miphun Asaf hrin a si."},"15":{"text":"Cule Jahaziel cun, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa le Judah ram mi le Jerusalem khuami pawl, Bawipa in, ‘Nan ral pawl an tam ruangah phang hlah uh, nan thin tla nau hlah seh. Raldonak cu nan thu a si lo, Pathian lairel a si."},"16":{"text":"Thaisun ah nan do pei. Ziz tlangkawn in an ra ding ih Jeruel kiang phairawn a netnak, hramlak a thoknak zawn ah nan tong hai ding."},"17":{"text":"Nannih in nan do a ṭul lo ding. Ṭanhmun khuar uhla tiarcia in um uh; cule Bawipa in nehnak a lo pek kha nan hmu ding. Judah le Jerusalem mi pawl, ṭih hrimhrim hlah uh; nan thin khal nau hlah seh. Ral do dingah feh uhla Bawipa Keimah nan hnenah ka um ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu a hmai leilung dai tiangin a kun, misenpi khal an kun ih Bawipa cu an biak."},"19":{"text":"Levi phun Kohath le Korah hrin pawl an hung ding ih ring zetin Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cu an thangṭhat."},"20":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitte in an tho ih Tekoa kiang hramlak lamah cun an feh. An pawh zawng ah Jehoshafat in an hnenah, “Judah le Jerusalem mi pawl, Bawipa nan Pathian cu rinsan uhla hnget zetin nan ding thei ding. Amah ih profet pawl thusimmi zum uhla nan hlawhtling ding,” tiah a cah."},"21":{"text":"Misenpi pawl thu a ron hnuah hla saktu hrekkhat pawl cu puai caanih an hruk ṭheumi korfualpi hruk ih ralkap hmaiah feh tahrat in: “ Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh, In duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun,” tiah hlasak phah dingah thu a pek."},"22":{"text":"Hla saktu pawl in Bawipa thangṭhatnak hla an sak vete in Bawipa in Judah ram a dotu ral pawl cu nasa zetin an lung a phanter."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Ammon mi le Moab mi an ṭangtlang ih Edom ralkap pawl kha an ṭhuat ciammam ih Edom ralkap pawl cu an that ṭheh.
