Cuih hnuah anmah le anmah nasa zetin an do aw lala."},"24":{"text":"Judah ralkap pawl cu tlangbo an thlen tikah an hei zoh ih an ral pawl cu lei parah ril teptep in an hmu. Pakhat hman luat loin an thi thluh."},"25":{"text":"Jehoshafat le a ralkap pawl cu an ral pawl ih thilri la dingin an va feh. Caw, rawl, hnipuan le thil mankhung a phunphun tampi an hmu. Cuih thilri hransaw pawl cu ni thum sung an thiar rero naón an thiar cawk lo."},"26":{"text":"Ni linak ah Berakah Phairawn ah an khawm-aw ih Pathian an thangṭhat. Cuih phairawn cu atu tiangin Berakah tiah an ko tata."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa in an ral pawl a nehter hnuah Jehoshafat le a ralkap cu Jerusalem ah ralneh lungawinak thawn an kir sal."},"28":{"text":"Jerusalem an thlen tikah ṭingṭang le phirivau le tawtawrawt tum phah in Biakinn ah an feh."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel ih ral pawl a nehsak ṭheh ti a rak theitu ram hmuahhmuah cu an thin a phang thluh."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa in a ram sung khuazakip a humhim ruangah Jehoshafat in daitein a uk."},"31":{"text":"Jehoshafat cu kum sawmthum le kum nga a ti ah Judah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem in kum kul hluannga sung a uk. A nu cu Shilhi fanu Azubah a si.","title":"Jehoshafat Ram Uk Netnak (1 Sian. 22.41-50)"},"32":{"text":"A pa Asa bangtuk in Bawipa ih hmaiah thil ṭha a tuah;"},"33":{"text":"asinain khuavang an biaknak hmun pawl cu a siatbal lo. Misenpi cun an pupa ih Pathian cu an thinlung hmuahhmuah in an bia lo a si."},"34":{"text":"Jehoshafat ih tuahmi dangdang cu, a thokin a netnak tiang, Israel Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu timi sungih a telmi Hanani Fapa Jehu Thuanthu Cabu timi sungah an ngan a si."},"35":{"text":"Voikhat ah Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat in thil ṭha lo tampi a tuahtu Israel siangpahrang Ahaziah thawn ṭantlangnak cakhen a tuah."},"36":{"text":"Eziongeber an timi tangphawlawng colhnak hmun Tarshish lam fehtu ding tangphawlawng pawl an tuah ciamco."},"37":{"text":"Asinain Mareshah khuami Dodavahu ih fapa Eliezer in Jehoshafat cu, “Ahaziah thawn nan ṭantlang ruangah na tuahmi pawl cu Bawipa in a siatsuah thluh ding,” tiah ralrinnak a pek. A sim vekin an tangphawlawng pawl cu a siat thluh ih Tarshish ahcun a feh lo."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoshafat cu a thi ih Jerusalem khuahlun, David khawpi, siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Cule a fapa Jehoram in a ai-ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"2":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat ih fapa Jehoram in unau paruk a nei: Azariah, Jehiel, Zekhariah, Azariahu, Mikhael le Shefatiah tla an si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jehoram (2 Sian. 8.17-24)"},"3":{"text":"An pa in sui, ngun le thilri mankhung tampi a pek ih Judah ram sung ralhruang kulhmi khawpi pakhat ciarah hotu-ah a ret hai. Asinain Jehoram cu upa bik a si hrangah Jehoshafat in a ai-awhtu ah a tuah."},"4":{"text":"Jehoram in Judah ram a uknak a hnget deuh tikah a unau pawl cu a that ṭheh ih Israel bawi hrekkhat pawl tla a that."},"5":{"text":"Jehoram cu kum sawmthum le kum hnih a ti ah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem ihsin kum riat sung a uk."},"6":{"text":"Ahab fanu pakhat a ṭhit ruangah a nunzia a ṭha lomi siangpahrang Ahab le Israel siangpahrang dang pawl ih nunzia a cawng. Cuticun Bawipa ih mithmuh ah sualnak a tuah."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa in David hnenah thukamnak a rak tuah ih a tesinfa pawl in ram an uk ringring ding tiah a rak tiam zo ruangah David ih thokmi ram-uknak cu Bawipa in a siatsuah siang lo."},"8":{"text":"Jehoram in Judah ram a uk laiah cun Edom mi pawl ral an tho ih mahte uknak an lak."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Jehoram le a ralbawi pawl cu an pok ih rangleng thawn Edom ram an do. Cutawkah Edom mi pawl in an rak kulh ṭheh; asinain a thupte in zanah an suak ih an luat."},"10":{"text":"Cuihsin thokin Edom ram cu mahte uk-awmi ramah a cangta. Jehoram in a pupa ih Pathian Bawipa cu a dungtun ruangah cuih caan thotho ah Libnah khuami pawl tla ral an tho ve."},"11":{"text":"Judah tlangpar ramah khuavang biaknak tiangin a sak ciamco ih cuticun Judah le Jerusalem mi pawl cu Bawipa ih hmaiah misual ah a canter a si."},"12":{"text":"Cule profet Elijah in Jehoram cu ca a kuat ih a ca sungah cun, “Na pa Jehoshafat le na pu Asa vekih na nun lo ruangah nan cithlahtu David ih Pathian Bawipa in a lo hnong a si."},"13":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang pawl ih nunzia na thlun ih, Ahab le amah ih ai-awhtu pawl in Israel cu lam an pialter vekin, Judah le Jerusalem mi pawl lam na pialter a si. Nangmah hnakin miṭha deuh a si mi na unau pawl na that ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in na minung pawl le na faate le na nupi pawl nasa zetin a hrem ding ih na neihmi thilri hmuahhmuah an hloral ṭheh ding."},"15":{"text":"Nangmah cu pumnat na nei ding ih na ril a pawtsuak tiangin ni khat hnu ni khat a besia sinsin ding,” tiah a ngan."},"16":{"text":"Culai ah Filistin hrekkhat le Arab mi hrekkhat pawl cu tipikap ih a um Ethiopia mi pawl kiangkap ah an rak um. Cuih pawl cu Jehoram do dingah Bawipa in a forh."},"17":{"text":"Judah ram cu an do ih siangpahrang inn an ram ih a fapa nauta bik Ahaziah siar lo siangpahrang nupi pawl le a fapa hmuahhmuah an hruai ih thawngah an thlak."},"18":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Bawipa in siangpahrang cu a pum a natter."},"19":{"text":"A nat a luar deuhdeuh ih kum hnih hnuah a tuar harzet in a thi. A uk mi minung pawl in amah hlanih siangpahrang a ṭuantu pawl hrangih meipi an tih ṭheu vekin a thih tikah meipi hman an tik lo."},"20":{"text":"Jehoram cu kum sawmthum le kum hnih a ti ah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem in kum riat sung a uk. A thih tikah zohman an ning a hang lo. David khawpi Jerusalem khawhlun ah an phum; siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum lo."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Arab pawl in Jerusalem an do laiah mi hrekkhat in siangpahrang Jehoram fapa hmuahhmuah, a nauta bik Ahaziah siar lo, an that ṭheh. Curuangah Jerusalem mi pawl in a pa ai-awh ah Ahaziah cu siangpahrang ah an tuah.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Ahaziah (2 Sian. 8.25-29 ; 9.21-28)"},"2":{"text":"Ahaziah siangpahrang a can tikah kum kul hluanhnih a ti ih Jerusalem in kum khat a uk. A nu cu Israel siangpahrang Omri ih tunu, Ahab fanu Athaliah a si."},"3":{"text":"A nu in thusia a forh ruangah Ahaziah cun siangpahrang Ahab ih innsang nunzia a cawng ih thil ṭha lo a tuah."},"4":{"text":"A pa thih hnuah siangpahrang Ahab innsang pawl cu siangpahrang Ahaziah ruahnak petu an si ih ruahnak ṭha lo an pek ruangah Bawipa ih parah a sual ih amah dirthlatu ah an cang."},"5":{"text":"An thu a lung ih Israel siangpahrang Joram hnenah ṭang tahrat in Siria siangpahrang Hazael an do. Gilead ram Ramoth ah an ral pawl thawn an do-aw ih Joram cu hriamhma a pu."},"6":{"text":"A hma tuamhlawm dingah Joram cu Jezreel khua ah a kir ih cutawkah Ahaziah in a veh."},"7":{"text":"Ahaziah in Joram a veh cu Bawipa in Ahaziah cemter dingah caan ṭha a ti. Ziangtin tile cutawkih Ahaziah a caam laiah Ahab ih a rak thokmi uknak siatsuah dingin Bawipa ih a hrilmi Nimshi, Jehu fapa, in Ahaziah le Joram a zuam hai."},"8":{"text":"Pathian ih thurel ciami a tuahsuaktu cu Jehu a si ruangah Ahaziah thluntu Judah ram hotu pawl le Ahaziah unau ih fapa pawl thawn an tong aw. Cutikah Jehu cun an zatein a that ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Ahaziah cu an hawl ih Samaria khua ih a relhnak ah an kai. Jehu hnenah an hruai ih Jehu cun a rak that. Cule Bawipa ih hna a theih tawkih a ṭuan vemi a pu Jehoshafat an upat ruangah Ahaziah ruak cu ṭhatein an phum. Ahaziah sungkhat sungin ram a uk theitu ding pakhat hman an um lo."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahaziah ih nu Athaliah in a fapa an thah thu a theih vete in Judah ram siangpahrang sungkhat pawl hmuahhmuah a thatter ṭheh.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Bawinu Athaliah (2 Sian. 11.1-3)"},"11":{"text":"Ahaziah in farnuseu pakhat Jehosheba a nei ih a pasal cu puithiam Jehoiada a si. Jehosheba cun a thupte in Ahaziah fapa pakhat Joash an timi a lak; thah ding a si mi a unau dang pawl hnenin a tlanhlopi ih a kiltu ding sayama pakhat thawn Bawipa ih Biakinn ih ihnak khaan pakhat sungah a thup. Cutiih a humsuak ruangah Athaliah kutih thihnak ihsin Joash cu a luat."},"12":{"text":"Athaliah siangpahrang bawinu a ṭuan sung kum ruk sung cu cutawkah a relh ringring."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sarihnak ah puithiam Jehoiada cun thil pakhatkhat tuah caan a kim tiah a ruat. Curuangah ralbawi panga: Jeroham ih fapa Azariah, Jehohanan ih fapa Ishmael, Obed ih fapa Azariah, Adaiah ih fapa Maaseiah le Zikhri ih fapa Elishafat pawl thawn thutiamnak pakhat an tuah.","title":"Athaliah An Phiar (2 Sian. 11.4-16)"},"2":{"text":"Judah ram sung khua hmuahhmuah ah an feh ih Levi mi pawl le an hrin ciarih lubik pawl an zatein Jerusalem ah an ko ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Misenpi cu Biakinn ah an pumkhawm ih siangpahrang fapa Joash thawn thutiamnak an tuah. Cule Jehoiada in an hnenah, “In thihsantu kan siangpahrang ih fapa cu hinah a um. Bawipa in David tesinfa pawl cu siangpahrang an si ringring ding ti ih thu a rak kam cia vekin atu-ah amah cu siangpahrang a si ding."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang a cannak dingah hiti in kan tuah pei. Puithiam le Levi mi pawl, Sabbath ni hnaṭuan dingih nan rat tikah ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat in Biakinn kotka pawl nan kil pei;"},"5":{"text":"a dang ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat in siangpahrang inn nan kil pei; a dang ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat in Hramṭonak Kotka nan kil pei. Senpi pawl cu Biakinn tualah nan khawm-aw pei."},"6":{"text":"Hnaṭuan neitu puithiam le Levi mi pawl siar lo zohman Biakinn sungah nan lut lo pei. Puithiam le Levi mi pawl cu thianhlimter mi nan si ruangah nan lut thei pei; asinain midang pawl cu Bawipa ih thupekmi vekin a lengah nan um pei."},"7":{"text":"Levi mi pawl cun nan ralnam zuuk cia in siangpahrang nan kil pei ih a fehnak kipah nan thlun pei. Biakinn sung luh a tumtu cu zo a si khalle nan that pei,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Levi mi pawl le Judah misenpi pawl in Jehoiada ih thupekmi an ngai ih a sim vek cun an tuah ṭheh. Hnaṭuan a nei nawn lotu pawl khal an inn ah an tlunter lo ruangah hnaṭuan hotu bawi pawl in hnaṭuan a thok dingmi pawl siseh, a ṭheh zotu pawl siseh, ho dingah milai cat loin an nei ringring."},"9":{"text":"Puithiam Jehoiada in Biakinn sungih an ret ringring mi siangpahrang David ih feipi le ralphaw pawl cu bawi pawl hnenah a pek."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang humhim dingah mi tampi cu an ralnam zuuk cia in Biakinn hmailam kimvel ah a ret."},"11":{"text":"Cule Jehoiada in Joash cu a suahpi ih a lu ah siangpahrang lukhuh a khumter. Siangpahrang ih thlun dingmi daan cabu pi an pek ih cuticun siangpahrang ah an tuah. Puithiam Jehoiada le a fapa pawl in Joash cu hriak an culh ih mi hmuahhmuah in, “Siangpahrang a nunkhua sau hram seh!” tiah an au ciamco."},"12":{"text":"Senpi pawl in siangpahrang an thangṭhat le an cawimawi thawmvang cu Athaliah in a theih tikah misenpi an pumkhawmnak Biakinn ahcun zamrangte in a va feh."},"13":{"text":"Cule cutawkah siangpahrang thar cu siangpahrang hrangah timi Biakinn sangka ṭhuam kiangah ralkap bawi pawl le tawtawrawt tumtu pawl in an kulh ih a din kha a hmu. Mi hmuahhmuah lungawi aipuang zetin an au ih an tawtawrawt an tum ih, hla satu pawl cu an thiltum mi pawl thawn cuih an cawimawinak ahcun mi hotu bik an si. Cutikah Athaliah cun a ninghang riahsia in a hnipuan a thlek ih, “Phiar thupnak! Phiar thupnak!” tiah a au ciamco."},"14":{"text":"Biakinn kapih Athaliah thah ding cu Jehoiada in a duh lo ruangah ralbawi pawl a thlah ih, “Ralkap pawl in a siir veve in kil hai sehla hruai hai seh; zo a si hmanah Athaliah run a tumtu cu that uh,” tiah thu a pek."},"15":{"text":"A ti vekin an kai ih siangpahrang inn ah an hruai ih Rang Kotka timi hmunah an that."},"16":{"text":"Jehoiada ih tawlrelnak thawngin Siangpahrang Joash in misenpi pawl thawn Bawipa ih minung si dingah Bawipa ih hnenah thukamnak an tuah.","title":"Jehoiada Ih Thil Remmi Pawl (2 Sian. 11.17-20)"},"17":{"text":"Cule an zatein Baal khawzing biakinn ah an feh ih an balsiat ṭheh. An biakṭheng pawl le milem pawl cu ṭok seksek in an deen ih biakṭheng hmai rori ah Baal puithiam Mattan cu an that."},"18":{"text":"Cun Jehoiada in puithiam le Levi mi pawl cu Bawipa ih Biakinn ih hnaṭuantu si dingah ṭuanvo a pek. Siangpahrang David ih ṭuanvo rak zem cia vekih hnaṭuantu si dingah Moses Daan bangtuk in Bawipa hnenih an pekmi thawinak pawl cu meisa in an ur ding. Biakinn hlasak ding le lungawipuai tuahnak pawl tla anmah ih ṭuanvo a si ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Jehoiada cun Biakinn sungah raitluan lo zohman lut lo dingin khamtu ah Biakinn kotka ah kotka kiltu pawl a ret."},"20":{"text":"Ralbawi pawl, bawi dangdang pawl le khawsung upa hminthang pawl in Jehoiada an thlun ih an zatein siangpahrang bawipa cu Biakinn ihsin siangpahrang inn ah an fehpi. Tlunta kotkapi in an lut ih siangpahrang bawipa cu siangpahrang tokham parah a to."},"21":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah lungawi aipuang in an um ih, Athaliah a thih zo ruangah khawpi sung khal cu hnahnawhnak zianghman a um nawn lo."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joash cu kum sarih a ti in Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan ih Jerusalem in kum sawmli sung ram a uk. A nu cu Beersheba khuami Zibiah a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Joash (2 Sian. 12.1-16)"},"2":{"text":"Puithiam Jehoiada a dam sungah cun Joash in Bawipa ih hmaiah thilṭha a tuah ih Bawipa ih lung a awiter."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang Joash hrangah Jehoiada in nupi pahnih a hrilsak ih fanu le fapa tampi an hrin."},"4":{"text":"Caan malte sung siangpahrang a ṭuan hnuah Joash in Bawipa ih Biakinn rem a tum."},"5":{"text":"Puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl cu Judah ramsung khawkip ah a thlah ih kumtin Biakinn remnak hrangih a ṭulmi paisa khuan dingah thu a pek. Zamrangte ih tuah dingah a fial naón Levi mi pawl cun zamrangte in an tuah lo."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah an hotu Jehoiada cu a ko ih, “ Bawipa umnak Puanthlam zohnak ah senpi pawl in ngunkhuai an pek pei, tiah Bawipa ih siahhlawh Moses in thu a taanta mi cu ziangah so Judah le Jerusalem mi pawl hnen ihsin Levi mi pawl na khuanter lo?” tiah a sut."},"7":{"text":"Misual nu Athaliah le a thluntu pawl in Bawipa ih Biakinn cu tampi an siatsuah ih thilri thianghlim tampi tla Baal khawzing biaknak ah an rak hmang."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang bawipa ih a fial vekin Levi mi pawl in paisa retkhawmnak ding thingkuang pakhat an tuah ih Biakinn kotka ah an ret."},"9":{"text":"Pathian siahhlawh Moses in hmaisa bik ngunkhuai cu hramlakih a rak khuan bangtuk in Bawipa hnenih ngunkhuai pe ding in Jerusalem le Judah ramsung hmuahhmuah ah thu an than."},"10":{"text":"Cuih an thuthanmi an theih tikah misenpi le an hotu pawl an lung a awi ngaingai ih an ngunkhuai cu an pek ciamco ih thingkuang an tuahmi cu a khat."},"11":{"text":"Nitinte in ṭuanvo neitu siangpahrang kuthnuai ih bawi pakhat hnenah cuih kuang cu Levi mi pawl in an hei phur ṭheu. Thingkuang a khat zo ti an hmuh tikah paisa cu siangpahrang bawipa ih sungṭuan le Puithiam Sang ih palai pa in an lak ih thingkuang cu an retnak keel ah an ret sal. Cuticun paisa tam ngaingai an khawl."},"12":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang Joash le puithiam Jehoiada in Biakinn rem hnaṭuan hotu pawl hnenah paisa cu an pek ih annih in Biakinn remtu ah lungsertu, zungthiam le thir tuahtu pawl an lak."},"13":{"text":"Hnaṭuantu hmuahhmuah in taima zetin an ṭuan ih Biakinn cu an sak pek vekin ṭhazet le fekzet in an rem thei sal."},"14":{"text":"An rem ṭheh tikah a hleimi sui le ngun pawl cu siangpahrang bawipa le puithiam Jehoiada hnenah an khirhsal ih annih in Biakinn hrangih a ṭulmi beelkheng pawl tuahnak ah an hmang. Jehoiada a damsung cu Biakinn ah cat loin thawinak an tuah."},"15":{"text":"Jehoiada cu tarkuun tiang a nung ih kum za le sawmthum a ti ah a thi."},"16":{"text":"Israel misenpi hrang, Pathian hrang le Bawipa ih Biakinn hrangih thilṭha tuahtu a si ruangah Jehoiada cu David khawpi, Jerusalem khawhlun siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum."},"17":{"text":"Jehoiada a thih hnu ahcun Judah hotu pawl in siangpahrang Joash cu an forh ih anmah ih thu thlun in a nung.","title":"Jehoiada Hnaṭuanmi An Phiat"},"18":{"text":"Curuangah misenpi in Bawipa ih Biakinn ah an pupa ih Pathian biak nawn loin milem le Asherah khawzingnu pawl an biak. Cutiih an sual ruangah Judah le Jerusalem parah Bawipa ih thinhengnak a thleng."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa in a hnenih kirsal dingah an hnenah profet pawl a thlah naón an thu an ngai duh lo."},"20":{"text":"Cule Pathian ih thlarau cu puithiam Jehoiada fapa Zekhariah hnenah a thleng ih misenpi in an hmuh theinak hmunah ding tahrat in an hnenah, “ Bawipa in, ‘Ziangruangah ka thukham nan thlun lo ih nan parah siatsuahnak nan thlengter?’ tiah thu a lo sut a si. Bawipa nan dungtun ruangah a lo dungtun ve,” tiah a au."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Joash le misenpi in an phiar ih Zekhariah cu Biakinn tualah siangpahrang thupek in lung in an deng that."},"22":{"text":"Zekhariah pa Jehoiada in a rak zaangfah ih a rak kilkhawi reronak cu siangpahrang Joash in a theih nawn lo ruangah Zekhariah a that a si. Cule Zekhariah in a hnukcah zawng ah, “Nan thilti mi hi Bawipa in hmu hramsehla nan parah phu la hram seh,” tiah a au."},"23":{"text":"Cuih kum ṭhal caan a hung suak ih Siria ralkap in Judah ram le Jerusalem khua an do. Judah mi hotu pawl hmuahhmuah an that ih thilri le paisa tampi an lak hnuah Damaskas khua ah an phur.","title":"Joash Uknak A Cem"},"24":{"text":"Siria ralkap cu an malte naón Judah mi pawl in an pupa ih Pathian Bawipa an dung tun ruangah Bawipa in a tamzet mi Judah ralkap pawl cu a nehter a si. Siangpahrang Joash in Bawipa ih hremnak a tong ngaingai."},"25":{"text":"Ral an donak ahcun besia zetin hma a pu ih, an ral pawl an kirsal hnuah, a kuthnuai ih bawi pahnih in an phiar ih puithiam Jehoiada ih fapa an thahmi phulaknak ah a ihkhun parah an that. David khawpi ah an phum ih cuticun siangpahrang thlaan ih phum hman a tong lo."},"26":{"text":"Joash a phiartu cu Ammon nunau Shimeath ih fapa Zabad le Moab nunau Shimrith ih fapa Jehozabad an si."},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu Simfiangnak sungah a fapa pawl ih thuanthu, amah ih hrang profet thuphuan mi pawl le Biakinn a remnak pawl cu an ngan a si. Cuih hnuah a fapa Amaziah in a ai ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaziah cu kum kul hluannga a ti ah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem ihsin kum kul hluankua sung a uk. A nu cu Jerusalem khuami Jehoaddin a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Amaziah (2 Sian. 14.2-6)"},"2":{"text":"Amaziah in Bawipa ih hmaiah thilṭha a tuah ih Bawipa ih lung a awiter; asinain a thinlung zate cun a pe lo."},"3":{"text":"Judah ram hngette ih a uk thei vete in a pa a rak thattu bawi pawl a that."},"4":{"text":"Asinain an faate pawl cu a that lo. “An faate pawl ih sualnak ruangah an nupa pawl nan that lo pei; cule an nupa pawl ih sualnak ruangah an faate pawl nan that lo pei. Mi pakhat cu amah in a tuahmi sualnak ruang lawnglawng ah thah ding a si,” tiah Moses Daan sungih Bawipa ih thupekmi a thlun."},"5":{"text":"Cule Amaziah in Judah miphun le Benjamin sungih mipa hmuahhmuah ralkap ah a lak ṭheh ih an hrin ciar in a ṭhen ih thawngkhat hotu le zakhat hotu ralbawi a ret vivo. Mipa kum kul ihsin a tlunlam hmuahhmuah a lak ih an zatein thawng zathum an si. Raldotu dingah raldo thiam cia, feipi le ralphaw hmang thiamtu an si.","title":"Edom Ram An Do (2 Sian. 14.7)"},"6":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Israel ihsin ralkap thawng zakhat a sang ih a san man ah ngun phurh zakhat a pek."},"7":{"text":"Asinain profet pakhat siangpahrang bawipa hnenah a feh ih, “Hi Israel ralkap pawl cu na hnenah tel hlah hai seh. Hi Saklam Ram ih ralkap, hi Efraim mi pawl hnenah Bawipa a um lo."},"8":{"text":"Anmah an tel ahcun ral do tikah ka cak deuh ding tiah na ruat ding; sikhalsehla an tel ahcun na ral in an lo neh ding, ziangahtile nehnak le sunnak cu Bawipa ih thu a si,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Amaziah in, “Cuti asile ka pek ciami ngun hmuahhmuah cu ziangtinso ka tuah ding?” tiah profet cu a sut. Profet in, “Cuhnakih tam sawn Bawipa in a lo pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Amaziah in a sanmi ralkap pawl cu a thlah ih an ramah a tlunter ṭheh. Israel ralkap pawl cu Judah mi pawl parah thin na zetin an tlung."},"11":{"text":"Cule Amaziah in ṭihnak zianghman nei nawn loin a ralkap pawl cu Cite Phairawn ah a hruai hai. Cutawkah cun an do-aw ih Edom ralkap thawng hra an that."},"12":{"text":"Cuih tlunah a nungin thawng hra an kai. An kaihmi pawl cu Sela khua ih khaam zimah an hruai ih cutawkin an tulthlak thluh ih a hnuai ih lungto lakah cun an thi, an parh ṭheh a si."},"13":{"text":"Culai ah Amaziah in raldonak ah fehter loih a khammi Israel ralkap pawl khan Judah ram khawpi Samaria le Beth Horon karlakih a ummi pawl an do ih minung thawngthum an that ih hransaw tampi an lak."},"14":{"text":"Amaziah cu Edom ralkap a nehnak in a rakir tikah Edom milem pawl a rak phur ih a pathian ah a tuah ih a biak; cuih milem pawl hmaiah rimhmui tla a ur."},"15":{"text":"Cuti a tuah ruangah Amaziah parah Bawipa cu a thin a heng ih profet pakhat a thlah. Profet cun, “Na cahnak a neh thei lo ih a milai pawl hman a humhim thei lotu ramdang ih khawzing pawl cu ziangah so na biak?” tiah siangpahrang Amaziah cu a sut."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Amaziah in, “Ziangtik in so siangpahrang ruahnak petu-ah kan lo tuah? ṭong nawn hlah; culole ka lo that ding!” a ti. Profet cu a ṭong nawn lo; asinain a baan hlanah, “Hitiin thil na tuah ih ka thusimmi tla na ngai lo ruangah nangmah siatsuah ding ah Pathian in a ruatcat zo, ti ka thei a si,” tiah a tita."},"17":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Amaziah in Israel ram phiar a duh. Curuangah Israel siangpahrang Jehoash hnenah do awk zuamnak thu a cah. Jehoash cu Jehoahaz ih fapa a si ih Jehoahaz cu Israel siangpahrang a rak si mi Jehu ih fapa a si.","title":"Judah Mi In Israel Mi An Do (2 Sian. 14.8-20)"},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Jehoash in Amaziah cu hiti in thu a khirh: “Voikhat ah Lebanon Tlangah hlingbur pakhat in sidar thing hnenah thu a cah ih, ‘Ka fapa ih nupi dingah na fanu i pe aw,’ a ti. Cule sahrang pakhat a kiangin a ra ih hlingbur cu a pal beek thluh."},"19":{"text":"Atu-ah Edom mi pawl ka neh tiah na hngal ih na puarthau zet; asinain ṭhatein ka lo sim; daitein na inn ah rak um sawn aw. Nangmah le na minung pawl hrangih siatsuahnak a si dingmi thil cu ziangah so na tawhhrawh duh rero?” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Amaziah in cuih thu cu a ngai duh lo. Edom mi pawl ih milem a biak ruangah Amaziah cu sung dingin Bawipa ih tumtah ciami a si."},"21":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang Jehoash cu Judah siangpahrang Amaziah do dingin a feh. Judah ram Beth Shemesh ah an tawng aw."},"22":{"text":"Judah ralkap pawl cu an sung ih inn lamah an tlan ṭheh."},"23":{"text":"Jehoash in Amaziah cu a kai ih Jerusalem ah a hruai. Cule Jerusalem kulhnak ralhruang cu Efraim Kotka in Khawkil Kotka tiang, kaih zahnih sung a bal ṭheh."},"24":{"text":"Hransaw a lakmi Biakinn sui le ngun pawl, Obed Edom tefa pawl ih an kilmi Biakinn thilri pawl le siangpahrang inn ih sumsaw hmuahhmuah Samaria ah a fehpi ṭheh. Sal ih a kaihmi pawl tla a fehpi a si."},"25":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Amaziah cu Israel siangpahrang Jehoash hnakin kum hleinga a nung rei sawn."},"26":{"text":"Amaziah ih uknak hramthok in a cem tiangih a tuahmi dangdang pawl cu Judah le Israel Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah kimtein an ngan a si."},"27":{"text":"Amaziah in Bawipa a dungtun thok ihsin Jerusalem ah Amaziah phiartu an um ringring; cu ruangah Lakhish khua ah a tlan; asinain cutawkah a phiartu pawl cun an thlun ih an that."},"28":{"text":"A ruak cu Jerusalem ah rang in an phur ih David khawpi, siangpahrang a thlaan ah an phum."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah mi in Amaziah ih fapa, kum hleiruk ti, Uzziah cu a pa ai ih siangpahrang ṭuan dingah an hril.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Uzziah (2 Sian. 14.21-22 ; 15.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"A pa Amaziah thih hnuah Uzziah in Elath khua a la sal ih a rem."},"3":{"text":"Uzziah cu kum hleiruk a ti ah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem ihsin kum sawmnga le kum hnih sung a uk. A nu cu Jerusalem khuami Jekoliah a si."},"4":{"text":"A pa ih nunzia thlun in Bawipa ih hmaiah thilṭha a tuah ih Bawipa ih lung a awiter."},"5":{"text":"Uzziah cu Zekhariah in Bawipa ṭihzah upat dingah a zirh ih Zekhariah a damsung ahcun Bawipa ih hna felzetin a ṭuan. Curuangah Bawipa in mal a sawm a si."},"6":{"text":"Cule Uzziah in Filistin ram a do. Gath, Jamnia le Ashdod khua pawl kulhnak ralhruang a bal ṭheh ih Ashdod kiangkap le Filistin ram hmun dangdangah ralhruang ih kulhmi khua tampi a dinter."},"7":{"text":"Pathian bomnak in Filistin mi, Gurbaal ih um Arab mi le Meun mi pawl a neh."},"8":{"text":"Ammon mi in Uzziah hnenah siah an pek. Uzziah cu a cakzet ih Izipt ram tiangin a hmin a thang."},"9":{"text":"Uzziah in Jerusalem kulhnak ralhruang cu fek deuhdeuh in a sak ih Khawkil Kotka, Phairawn Kotka le ralhruang a kelnak zawn kipah ralvennak inn donhleisang a sak."},"10":{"text":"Hramlak nelrawn khalah ralhruang ih kulh mi ralvennak innsanghlei a sak. Rannung tampi a neih ruangah nitlaknak lam tlanghram ah le hmunrawn khalah tikhur tampi a lai. Lo thlawh lam ngainami a si ruangah tlangpar ram le ram ṭhatnak hmun kipah sabit hmuan le lo tuah dingin misenpi a forh ciamco."},"11":{"text":"Raldo zir ciami ralkap tamzet a nei. Ralkap mipum cazin cu siangpahrang kuthnuai ih ralbawi pakhat Hananiah ho in siangpahrang sungṭuan pahnih Jeiel le Maaseiah in an kai."},"12":{"text":"A ralkap pawl hotu-ah ralbawi thawnghnih le zaruk an um."},"13":{"text":"An kutthuai ah ralkap thawng zathum le thawng sarih le zanga cu siangpahrang ral dotu dingah timtuah cia ringring in an um."},"14":{"text":"Uzziah in a ralkap pawl cu ralphaw, feipi, thir lukhuh, thir angki, li le conkiang pawl le lungherhden hrangah lungto tiangin a pek."},"15":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ralvennak innsanghlei le ralhruang kiil in conkiang le lungherhden saitu le lungto tumpipi sai theitu pawl ih an hman dingah hriamnam tuah thiamtu pawl in thilthuam a phunphun an tuah. Uzziah hmin cu khuazakip ah a thang; Pathian bomnak nasa zetin a ngah ruangah a cak ngaingai."},"16":{"text":"Asinain siangpahrang Uzziah cu a rung cah ngaingai tikah mi hngalzet ah a cang ih cumicun a dirhthlak a si. Bawipa a Pathian a dodal ruangah Biakinn sungah feh tahratin rimhmui urnak biakṭheng ah rimhmui a ur.","title":"A Hngal Ruangah A Tuar"},"17":{"text":"Puithiam Azariah le mi cakzet le ralṭhazet puithiam sawmriat in,"},"18":{"text":"kham dingah siangpahrang cu an thlun. Puithiam pawl in, “Uzziah, nang in Bawipa ih hnenah rimhmui ur theinak thu na nei lo. Aaron tesinfa a si mi puithiam pawl lawnglawng hi hna ṭuantu dingah thianhlimtermi an si. Hi hmun thianghlim ihsin tlan aw. Bawipa Pathian cu a thin na ṭeuter ih thlawsuah a lo pe nawn lo ding a si,” tiah an ti."},"19":{"text":"Uzziah cu Biakinn sung rimhmui biakṭheng kiangah cun a ding ih rimhmui urnak kheng cu a kai ringring. Puithiam pawl parah a thin a heng ih cuvete in phaarnat in a cal ah a run tlak."},"20":{"text":"Azariah le puithiam dang pawl cun tuksum in siangpahrang bawipa ih cal cu cat loin an zoh ih cuih hnuah Biakinn ihsin tlan dingah an dawisuak. Cule Pathian in a hrem ruangah amah khal zamrangte in leengah a suak duh."},"21":{"text":"A nunsung hmuahhmuah a phar ruangah siangpahrang Uzziah cu mithiang lo ah a cang. Biakinn sungah a lut thei nawn lo ih a innsung lawngah a um; a hnaṭuan hmuahhmuah cu an sawng ih a fapa Jotham in ram a uk."},"22":{"text":"Siangpahrang Uzziah in ram a uk sungih hna a ṭuanmi dangdang pawl cu Amoz ih fapa Isaiah in cabu sungah a ngan thluh a si."},"23":{"text":"Uzziah cu a thi ih siangpahrang thlaanmual ah an phum; asinain a natnak ruangah siangpahrang pawl an phum ṭheunak thlan ahcun an phum lo. A fapa Jotham in a ai-ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jotham cu kum kul hluannga a ti ah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem ihsin kum hleiruk sung a uk. A nu cu Zadok fanu Jerushah a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jotham (2 Sian. 15.32-38)"},"2":{"text":"A pa vekin Bawipa ih hmaiah thilṭha a tuah ih Bawipa ih lung a awiter; asinain a pa vek cun Biakinn sungah lut tahratin thilsual a tuah lo. Misenpi pawl in sualnak thil ṭha lo an tuah ringring."},"3":{"text":"Biakinn ih Saklam Kotka a saktu le Jerusalem khawsung Ofel veng an timi kiangih khawpi kulhnak ralhruang nasa zetih a saktu cu amah Jotham a si."},"4":{"text":"Judah ram tlangpar ah khua tampi a din ih hramlak khalah raldo ṭannak le ralvennak innsanghlei pawl a sak."},"5":{"text":"Ammon siangpahrang le a ralkap pawl a do ih a neh. Cule Ammon mi cu siah kumtinten kum thum sung a hnenih pe dingah thu a pek. A thupekmi vekin kumtin an pekmi siah cu ngun pawng thawng sarih le za nga, sangvut haan thawng sawmnga le barli sangvut haan thawng sawmnga an si."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa a Pathian ih thu cu feltein a thlun ruangah Jotham cu siangpahrang cakzet ah a cang."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang a can sungih thil a tuahmi, a raldonak le a thil tumtah mi dang pawl cu Israel le Judah siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah kimten an ngan a si."},"8":{"text":"Jotham cu kum kul hluannga a ti in siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem in kum hleiruk sung a uk."},"9":{"text":"A thi ih David khawpi ah an phum. Cule a fapa Ahaz in a ai ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahaz cu kum kul a ti ah siangpahrang a cang ih Jerusalem ihsin kum hleiruk sung a uk. A cithlahtu Siangpahrang David ih nunzia cu a cawng lo; Bawipa ih lungawi lonak thil sawn a tuah;","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Ahaz (2 Sian. 16.1-4)"},"2":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang pawl ih nunzia a thlun. Thir in Baal khawzing lem pawl a bur ih a tuah;"},"3":{"text":"Hinnom Phairawn ah rimhmui a ur ih, Israel mi pawl Kanaan ram an luh laiih Bawipa in a dawimi miphun pawl ih fihnungza thil tuahmi pawl a cawn ruangah a fapa pawl tiangin milem hnenih thawinak ah a pek."},"4":{"text":"Khuavang biaknak le khawhrum umnak hmun kipah le tlangpar kipah le thinghneem hnuai kipah Ahaz cun thawinak a pek ih rimhmui a ur vivo."},"5":{"text":"Ahaz a sual ruangah Bawipa a Pathian in Siria siangpahrang hnenah nehnak a pek ih Judah mi tampi kai in Damaskas ah thawngah an thlak. Bawipa ih bomnak thotho in Israel siangpahrang Remaliah ih fapa Pekah in Ahaz cu a neh ih ni khat ah Judah ralkap ralṭha bik pawl thawng zakhat le thawngkul an that. Bawipa an dungtun ruangah Bawipa , an pupa ih Pathian in hi bangtuk ih cang dingah thu a pek.","title":"Judah In Siria Le Israel A Do (2 Sian. 16.5)","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Cule Israel ralkap pakhat Zikhri an timi pa in siangpahrang Ahaz ih fapa Maaseiah le siangpahrang inn uktu Azrikam le thuneihnak lamah siangpahrang sangtu Elkanah pawl a that ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Judah mi cu an unau an si naón Israel ralkap in Judah nunau le nauhak thawng zahnih kai in Samaria ah an hruai ih thawngah an thlak hai. Hransaw thilri tampi tla an long ih Samaria ah an tlunpi."},"9":{"text":"Culai ah Bawipa ih profet pakhat, Oded an timi Samaria khua ah a um. Raldonak ihsin a ratlungmi Israel ralkap pawl cu khawsung an luh zikah a va hmuak ih an hnenah, “ Bawipa , nan pupa ih Pathian cu Judah mi parih a thin a heng ruangah Judah mi pawl cu a lo nehter a si; asinain nan thin a heng tuk ruangah suup-aw loin mi tamtuk lawmmam nan thahnak thu cu van a thleng a si.","title":"Profet Oded Ih ṭong"},"10":{"text":"Cule atu-ah Jerusalem le Judah ihsin mipa nunau ti loin nan sal ah tuah ṭheh nan tum fawn. Bawipa nan Pathian hmaiah sualnak nan tuah ve hi nan thei lo maw?"},"11":{"text":"I ngai hnik uh! Hi nan kaihmi pawl hi nan unau le nan far le pawl an si. Thlah sal ṭheh uh; culole Bawipa a thinheng in a lo hrem hai ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Saklam Ram ih hminthangzet minung pali Jehohanan ih fapa Azariah, Meshillemoth ih fapa Berekhiah, Shallum ih fapa Jehizkiah le Hadlai ih fapa Amasa in ralkap pawl ih thiltuahmi cu an lung a kim loih,"},"13":{"text":"ralkap pawl hnenah, “Nan kaihmi pawl cu hinah rak hruai hlah uh. Bawipa ih hnenah kan sual zo ih kanmah hrem duh tiangin a thin kan hengter zo. Cuih tlunah kan sualnak tam sinsin dingin hi bangtuk thiltuah hi nan duh hrih,” an rak ti."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah ralkap pawl in an kaihmi pawl le an lonmi hransaw thilri pawl cu misenpi le an hotu pawl hnenah an pek ih,"},"15":{"text":"an lonmi hransaw thilri le hnipuan pawl zemtu dingah an kaihmi pawl sung ihsin upa pali an hril. Cuih pali pawl in an hruk dingah hnipuan nei lo pawl hnipuan le kedam an pek; ti le rawl ṭhatein an pek ih an hma pawl cu olif hriak an hnihsak. A feh thei nawn lomi pawl cu laak parah an toter ih an kaih mi zatein Judah ram, tuumkung khua an timi Jerikho khua tiang an hei kuat. Cule Israel mi pawl cu Samaria ah an tlung."},"16":{"text":"Cun Edom mi pawl in Judah ram cu atu le tu an siim ih mi tampi kai in salah an hruai ṭheu. Curuangah siangpahrang Ahaz in Assiria siangpahrang Tiglath Pileser hnenah bomnak a dil.","title":"Ahaz In Assiria Bomnak A Dil (2 Sian. 16.7-9)","merge":"17"},"18":{"text":"Culaifang ah Filistin mi pawl in nitlaknak lam tlanghram le Judah ram thlanglam pawl an siim. Beth Shemesh, Aijalon le Gederoth khua pawl an lak ih tlun ah Soko, Timnah le Gimzo khua pawl le an kiangkapih ummi khawte tla an la ih an luah tata."},"19":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Ahaz in a milai pawl parah thil mawi lo le thil dik lo tampi tuah in Bawipa a dodal ruangah Judah ramah Bawipa in harsatnak a thlenter a si."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Assiria siangpahrang Tiglath Pileser in Ahaz cu a bom lam tum loin a dodal ih harsatnak tampi a pek."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Ahaz in Biakinn paisa le thilri pawl, siangpahrang inn thilri le paisa pawl le Judah ram hotu upa pawl ih neihmi hmuahhmuah tiangin a lak ṭheh ih Assiria siangpahrang a pek; asinain a bawm duh cuang lo."},"22":{"text":"Ahaz sualnak cu a nasa ngaingai a si! A ram sungih harsatnak a thlen deuhdeuh tikah Bawipa ih hmaiah a sual deuhdeuh.","title":"Ahaz Sualnak Pawl"},"23":{"text":"Amah a nehtu Siria mi pawl ih khawzing hnen tiangah thawinak a pek. “Siria siangpahrang cu an khawzing in an bawm ruangah kei khal in thawinak ka pek a si ahcun in bawm ve ding,” tiah a ruat. Cumi cun amah le a ram minung parah siatsuahnak a thlenter sinsin."},"24":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Biakinn beelkheng hmuahhmuah a lak ih a deen kuai ṭheh. Bawipa ih Biakinn cu a khar ih Jerusalem khawsung hmun tampi ah biakṭheng a tuah ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Judah ram khawpi ah siseh khawte ah siseh, ramdang khawzing pawl hnenih rimhmui urnak ah khuavang biaknak khawhrum hmun a tuah vivo. Cuticun a pupa ih Pathian Bawipa ih thinhengnak cu amah ih parah a thlengter sinsin."},"26":{"text":"Siangpahrang a ṭuan sungih thil a cangmi le a tuahmi dang pawl cu a thokin a cemnak tiang Judah le Israel Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahaz cu a thi ih Jerusalem khua ah an phum; asinain siangpahrang thlaan ahcun an phum lo. A fapa Hezekiah in a pa ih ai-ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah cu kum kul hluannga a ti in siangpahrang a ṭuan ih Jerusalem ihsin kum kul hluankua sung a uk. A nu cu Zekhariah ih fanu Abijah a si.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Hezekiah (2 Sian. 18.1-3)"},"2":{"text":"A cithlahtu Siangpahrang David bangtuk in Bawipa ih lungawinak a tuah."},"3":{"text":"Hezekiah siangpahrang a can kum thla khatnak ah Biakinn kotka pawl cu Hezekiah in a ong sal ih a rem sal ṭheh.","title":"Biakinn Thianternak"},"4":{"text":"Cule Biakinn ih nisuahnak lam kap tual ah puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl a kokhawm ih,"},"5":{"text":"“Nannih Levi mi pawl, nan pupa ih Pathian Bawipa ih Biakinn cu nan thianternak dingah nanmah nan thianter-aw hmaisa pei. Cuih hnuah Biakinn a borhhlawhtertu thil hmuahhmuah nan hlon thluh pei."},"6":{"text":"Kan pu le kan pa pawl cu Bawipa kan Pathian hmaiah thilsual an tuah ih a riah an siatter. Bawipa cu an hnong ih a umnak hmun an dungtun a si."},"7":{"text":"Biakinn sangka pawl an khar ih an vanmi mei-inn an mitter. Israel Pathian ih Biakinn sungah rimhmui an ur nawn lo; thawinak pawl khal an pe nawn lo."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa cu Judah le Jerusalem parah a thin a heng ngaingai ih an parih a tuahmi thil pawl in mi hmuahhmuah tuk a suumter. Cuih thu cu nan thei thluh ko."},"9":{"text":"Kan pale pawl cu raldonak ah an thi ih kan nupi le kan faate pawl sal ah an hruai."},"10":{"text":"“Hiti a si ruangah Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian cu kan parih a thin a heng nawn lonak dingah amah thawn thukam tuah dingin ka ruatcat zo."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah ka faale pawl, daithlang men hlah uh. A hnenih rimhmui urtu dingah le misenpi in Pathian an biak tikah hotu si dingah Bawipa in nanmah hi a lo hril zomi nan si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"A tanglam ih Levi mi pawl hin hnaṭuan cu an thok: Kohath hrin in Amasai fapa Mahath le Azariah fapa Joel, Merari hrin in Abdi fapa Kish le Jehallelel fapa Azariah, Gershon hrin in Zimnah fapa Joah le Joah fapa Eden, Elizafan hrin in Shimri le Jeuel, Asaf hrin in Zekhariah le Mattaniah, Heman hrin in Jehuel le Shimei, Jeduthun hrin in Shemaiah le Uzziel.","merge":"13"},"15":{"text":"Himi pawl in an unau Levi mi pawl cu an kokhawm ih an zatein an thianfai awknak an tuah. Cule siangpahrang ih thupek vekin Biakinn cu Bawipa ih Daan pekmi bangtuk in an thianfaiter."},"16":{"text":"Puithiam pawl cu Biakinn sungah an lut ih an thianter; a thiang lomi hmuahhmuah Biakinn tualah an suah thluh ih cutawk ihsin Levi mi pawl in Kidron Phairawn ah an fehpi."},"17":{"text":"Hnaṭuan cu thla khatnak thla, ni khat ni in an thok ih ni riat ni ah an ṭheh; Biakinn sungih vung luhnak khaan tla an thianfai ṭheh. Cule a dang ni riat sung, ni hleiruk ni tiang an ṭuan sal ih Biakinn cu Pathian biaknak hrangih ṭha dingin an tuah kim ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang Hezekiah hnenah Levi mi pawl in thu an than ih, “Biakinn cu thawinak pawl urnak biakṭheng le beelkheng pawl, sang thianghlim hunnak cabuai le a beelkheng pawl thawn kan thiangfaiter thluh zo.","title":"Pathian Hnenah Biakinn An Hlan Sal"},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahaz in Bawipa ih hmaiah thilsual a tuah laiih a lakmi thilri pawl tla kan lak sal ih kan thianter thluh zo. Bawipa ih biakṭheng hmaiah a zatein kan ret zo,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah zamrangte in siangpahrang Hezekiah cun khawsung upa pawl a kokhawm ih hmun khattein Bawipa ih Biakinn ahcun an feh."},"21":{"text":"Siangpahrang innsang le Judah misenpi pawl sual ngaithiamnak le Bawipa ih Biakinn thianhlimternak thawinak hrangah cawcang pasarih, tuucang pasarih, tuufaate pasarih le me pasarih an keng. Cule siangpahrang bawipa in Aaron tesinfa puithiam pawl cu biakṭheng parah cuih rannung pawl thawinakih pek dingah a fial."},"22":{"text":"Puithiam pawl cun hmaisabik ah cawcang an that; cule tuucang, cuih hnuah tuufaate an that ih cuih thisen cu biakṭheng ah a sangsang in an theh."},"23":{"text":"Neta bikah me pawl cu an lak ih siangpahrang bawipa le Pathian biatu pawl misenpi in cuih me pawl parah an kut an suang."},"24":{"text":"Cule puithiam pawl in an that ih, siangpahrang bawipa in Israel mi hmuahhmuah hrangah mei-ur thawinak le sual ngaithiam thawinak cu tuah ding a si, tiih thu a pek bangtuk in cuih thisen cu misenpi sual ngaihthiam thawinak hrangah biakṭheng parah an thlet."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa in Siangpahrang David hrangih profet a rak ṭuantu profet Gad le profet Nathan hmangin David hnenih a rak pekmi daan pawl cu siangpahrang Hezekiah in a thlun ih Levi mi pawl tla Biakinn sungah darsumsel, ṭingṭang le tingrisit pawl thawn a ret."},"26":{"text":"Levi mi pawl cu siangpahrang David ih a rak hmanmi awn-mawi thilri pawl kengin an ding ih puithiam pawl cu tawtawrawt thawn an ding."},"27":{"text":"Cule Hezekiah in mei-ur thawinak pe dingah thu a pek; cutiin thawinak an pek vete in senpi pawl in Pathian thangṭhatnak hla an sak ih awnmawi tumtu pawl in an tawtawrawt le a dang tummi pawl an tum ciamco."},"28":{"text":"Biakinn ih a rami hmuahhmuah in hmun khatah Pathian an bia ih an hlasak le an tummi cu thawinak pawl an ur thluh hlan lo cat loin an tum ringring."},"29":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang bawipa le senpi pawl cu an khuk an bil ih Pathian an bia."},"30":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah le Judah mi hotu pawl in David le profet Asaf ih nganmi thangṭhatnak hla pawl sak dingah Levi mi pawl an fial. An fial vekin lungawi aipuang zetin an sak ih khuk bil tahratin Pathian an bia."},"31":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah in senpi pawl cu, “Atu cu nan thianghlim zo ih Bawipa hnenih lungawi langternak ah thawinak cu Amah ih hnenah pe uh,” tiah a ti. A ti vek cun an tuah ih mi hrekkhat in mei-ur thawinak hrangah lungthote in rannung pawl an pek."},"32":{"text":"An rak kenmi pawl cu cawcang sawmsarih, tuucang zakhat le tuufaate zahnih an si ih Bawipa ih hnenah mei-ur thawinakah an pek."},"33":{"text":"Cuih tlunah misenpi ih ei dingah cawcang zaruk le tuu thawngthum thawinakah an pek."},"34":{"text":"Rannung hizat thattu dingah puithiam tlamtling in an um lo ruangah cuih hnaṭuan a cem hlan lo Levi mi pawl in an bawm. Cuih tikcu ahcun puithiam tam deuh an thiangfai awter zo. Thianhlimnak thu ahcun puithiam pawl hnakin Levi mi pawl an thu a fek deuh."},"35":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinak an pek hlei ah senpi pawl ih ei mi thawinak rannung thau pawl meisa ih ur ding le mei-ur thawinak thawn pek cih mi sabitti pawl thlet ding tla cu puithiam pawl ih ṭuanvo a si. Cuticun Biakinn ih Pathian biaknak cu a thar in an thok sal."},"36":{"text":"Pathian bomnak thawngin cuih hnaṭuan pawl cu zamrangzet ih an ṭheh thei ruangah siangpahrang Hezekiah le senpi pawl cu an lung a awi ngaingai."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thla khatnak thla ahcun a thianghlimmi puithiam tlamtling in an um hrih lo ih misenpi tla tlamtling in Jerusalem an thlen thei hrih lo ruangah a tikcu caanah Lantak Puai cu an tuah thei lo. Cuhrangah siangpahrang Hezekiah le a kuthnuai ih bawi pawl le Jerusalem mi pawl in thla hnihnak thla ih tuah dingah an lung a kim. Cuih Puai ah ra thei dingin Israel mi le Judah mi hmuahhmuah cu siangpahrang bawipa in a sawm. Efraim le Manasseh phun pawl hnenah ca a ngan ih Israel ih Pathian Bawipa ih hminthannak hrangah Jerusalem Biakinn ih Lantak Puai ra zawh dingah a hleice in sawmnak ca a kuat.","title":"Lantak Puai Timtuahnak","merge":"2"},"4":{"text":"Saklam ah Dan ihsin thlanglam ah Beersheba tiang, Israel mi hmuahhmuah sawm ih kum dang hnakin Jerusalem ah mi tam deuh ngaingai ra ih Daan vekin Lantak Puai tuah dingih an tawlrel ruangah siangpahrang bawipa le misenpi pawl cu an ai a puang ngaingai.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang le a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih thupek vekin Judah ram le Israel ram sungah mi an thlah ih an mi sawmnak cu hiti in an ngan: “Israel mi ulenau, Assiria mi in kan ram an neh naón nannih cu nan luat. Atu cu Abraham ih Pathian, Isaak ih Pathian le Jakob ih Pathian Bawipa ih hnenah kir thlang uhla, amah tla nan hnenah a kir ve ding."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa an Pathian hmaiah rinsantlak loih a rak ummi nan pupa le nan unau Israel mi vek cun um nawn hlah uh. Nan theih thluh vekin annih pawl cu Bawipa in nasazet in a hrem a si."},"8":{"text":"Anmah vekin nan lung ruh hlah seh; Bawipa ih thu cu thlun sawn uh. Nan parah Bawipa cu a thin a heng nawn lonak dingah Bawipa nan Pathian in a kumkhua ih thianghlim dingah a tuahmi Jerusalem Biakinn ah ra in Amah ra bia uh."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih nan kirsal a si ahcun nan unau sungkhat pawl hruaihlo tahrat in thawngih a thlatu pawl khal in an parah zaangfah lainatnak thinlung an nei ding ih inn ah an tlunter ding a si. Bawipa nan Pathian cu zaangfahnak le lainatnak neitu a si ih Amaió hnen ih nan kir asile a lo pom hai ding,” tiah an ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule an mi thlahmi pawl cu Efraim le Manasseh ram sungih khua kipah an feh ih saklam bik Zebulun ram tiang an hung thleng; asinain misenpi in an rak hnihsan ih caponak men ah an rak hman hai."},"11":{"text":"Asher phun, Manasseh phun le Zebulun phun sungin mi hrekkhat cu Jerusalem khua ah ra duhtu an um."},"12":{"text":"Cule Judah mi lakah Pathian hna a ṭuan ih siangpahrang bawipa le a kuthnuai bawi pawl thupekmi vekin Bawipa ih thu thlun dingah senpi pawl cu tumtahnak bangrep an nei."},"13":{"text":"Thla hnihnak thla ah, Thilnu tello Sang Puai tuah dingah minung tam ngaingai Jerusalem khua ah an ra.","title":"Lantak Puai An Tuah"},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem khawsung ih thawinak le rimhmui urnak biakṭheng a ummi pawl an bal ṭheh ih Kidron Horkuam ah an hlon."},"15":{"text":"Cule cuih thla ni hleili ni ah Lantak Puai hrang thawinak ih tuu pawl an that. A thianghlim lomi puithiam le Levi mi pawl cu an ning a zah tuk ruangah Bawipa ih hnenah thianhlimnak an tuah copcop ih cuticun Biakinn sungah thawinak an pe ve."},"16":{"text":"Pathian ih siahhlawh Moses Daan pekmi bangtuk in Biakinn sungah cun umnak an co ve. Levi mi pawl in thawinak hrangih rannung thisen cu puithiam hnenah an pek ih puithiam pawl in biakṭheng parah an theh."},"17":{"text":"Mi tampi cu mithiang lo an si ruangah Lantak Puai hrangih tuu pawl an that thei lo; curuangah an ai-ah Levi mi pawl in an that ih Bawipa ih hnenah tuu cu an pek."},"18":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Efraim phun, Manasseh phun, Issakhar phun le Zebulun phun sung ihsin a rami mi tampi cu thianternak a tuah hrih lo mi an si ih Lantak Puai cu a daan loin an tuah. Cutikah Siangpahrang Hezekiah in an ai-ah thla a cam ih,"},"19":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , kan pupa ih Pathian, mithiang lo an si naón thinlungtak teih a lo betu pawl cu na zaangfahnak thawn ngaithiam hramhram aw,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in Hezekiah thlacamnak cu a theihsak ih cu pawl cu a ngaithiam; harsatnak zianghman an parah a thlenter lo."},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ih a rami hmuahhmuah in Thilnu tello Sang Puai cu lungawi aipuangte in ni sarih sung an tuah; ni khat hnu ni khat puithiam le Levi mi pawl in Bawipa cu an thaneih zat in an thangṭhat."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa biaknak ah mi hruai daan a thiamzettu Levi mi pawl cu siangpahrang Hezekiah in a lawm hai. Cuticun ni sarih sung puai an tuah ih Bawipa ih hnenah remnak thawinak an pek ih an pupa ih Pathian cu an thangṭhat."},"23":{"text":"Cuih hnuah an zatein ni sarih sung puai tuah pehsal dingah an lung a kimih a dang ni sarih sung lungawi aipuang in puai cu an tuah sal."},"24":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah in cuih puai ih misenpi pawl ei dingah cawcang thawngkhat le tuu thawng sarih a pek ih a kuthnuai bawi pawl in cawcang thawngkhat le tuu thawnghra an pe ve. Puithiam tampi in anmah thianhlimnak an tuah."},"25":{"text":"Cuticun mi hmuahhmuah Judah mi, puithiam pawl, Levi mi pawl, saklam ram ihsin a rungmi pawl le Israel le Judah ram sungih a um ringring mi ramdangmi pawl tla an zatein an lung a awi ngaingai."},"26":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi cu lungawinak in a khat; cubangtuk lungawinak cu David fapa Siangpahrang Solomon san hnuah a um dah lo."},"27":{"text":"Puithiam le Levi mi pawl in senpi pawl cu Bawipa ih thlawsuah an dil sak. Vancung a inn ihsin an thlacamnak cu Pathian in a thei ih a co sak hai a si."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"An puai tuah mi an ṭheh tikah Israel mi hmuahhmuah an zatein Judah ramsung khua kipah an feh ih lungphun thianghlim pawl an khuai, khawzingnu Asherah hrang timi thingphun thianghlim pawl an hau ih biakṭheng le an khuavang biaknak hmun pawl an siatbal ṭheh. Judah ram lawngah si loin Efraim ram, Benjamin ram le Manasseh ram tla ah cubangtuk in an tuah ih cuih hnuah an inn ciarah an tlung.","title":"Hezekiah In Daan A Rem Sal"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah in puithiam le Levi mi pawl ih hnaṭuan cu a thar in a rem sal ih cuticun puithiam le Levi mipawl ṭuanvo an nei fingfing. An hnaṭuan cu mei-ur thawi peknak, remnak thawinak le Biakinn sung Pathian biaknak ih tel ding le Biakinn sung khaan kipah Pathian thangṭhat le Pathian hnenih lungawinak sim tla an si."},"3":{"text":"Zinglam le zanlam ih mei-ur thawinak pekmi hrangah le Sabbath ni le Thla Thar Puai hrangah siseh, Bawipa ih Daan pekmi bangtuk in tuah ding a ṭulmi puai dangdang hrangah siseh, siangpahrang Hezekiah in a cawrual le a tuurual sungin rannung tampi a pek."},"4":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Bawipa ih Daan vekih puithiam le Levi pawl in an tikcu neihzat caan an pek theinak dingah misenpi pawl in covo an neih mi thawinak pawl cu rak pe dingin siangpahrang in Jerusalem khuami hnenah thu a pek."},"5":{"text":"Siangpahrang thupekmi an theih vete in Israel mi pawl in laksawng an rak kengih an neihmi lakih a ṭha bik sangphut, sabitti, olif hriak, khuaitizu le an lo ihsin a suak mi dangdang an pek; cule an neihmi hmuahhmuah sungin ṭhen hra ṭhen khat tla an pek."},"6":{"text":"Judah khua pawl ih a ummi hmuahhmuah in, Israel mi siseh, Judah mi siseh, an caw le an tuu pawl ṭhen hra ṭhen khat an pek; cuih tlunah Bawipa hnenih an hlan ciami thilri thiang sung in ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat an pek fawn. An pekmi cu vuun liailiai in a um."},"7":{"text":"Thla thumnak thla in an laksawng pek cu an thok ih thla sarih thla tiang cat loin an pek."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah le a kuthnuai bawi pawl in cubangtuk in vuun liailiai ih an pekmi laksawng an hmuh tikah Bawipa an thangṭhat ih Israel mi pawl hrangah thlawsuah an dil sak."},"9":{"text":"Cuih laksawng thu cu siangpahrang bawipa in puithiam le Levi mi pawl hnenih a suh tikah,"},"10":{"text":"Zadok tesinfa Puithiam Sang Azariah in, “ Bawipa Biakinn ih laksawng an rak ken thok ihsin ei-in ding cu tlamtling zetin kan nei ih a hleimi khal hitluk tam hi a si. Bawipa in a minung pawl mal a sawm ruangah hitluk tam hi kan nei a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa ih Biakinn kapih thil retnak khaan pawl sak dingin siangpahrang in thu a pek;"},"12":{"text":"a thupek vekin an tuah ih misenpi ih pekmi thawhlawm, laksawng le ṭhen hra ṭhen khat pawl cu cutawkah felzet in an ret. Levi mi Konaniah cu a kiltu ah an ret ih a unau Shimei cu a sangtu ah an ret."},"13":{"text":"An kuthnuai ih hnaṭuantu dingah Levi mi pahra an ret ih Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakhiah, Mahath le Benaiah an si. Hi an retmi pawl cu siangpahrang Hezekiah le Puithiam Sang Azariah thupek vekih retmi an si."},"14":{"text":"Biakinn Nisuahnak lam Kotka kiltu Levi mi Imnah ih fapa Kore cu Bawipa hnenih an rak kenmi laksawng a rak sangtu le a zemtu a si."},"15":{"text":"Puithiam umnak khua dangah cuih hnaṭuan cu Levi mi amah bawmtu dangdang in an ṭuan; a bawmtu pawl cu Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah le Shekaniah an si. An hnaṭuan mi zoh in an unau Levi mi pawl hnenah a tam a mal bangrep in an zem."},"16":{"text":"Cu hrin kha hrin, tiin an zem lo. Biakinn ih hnaṭuan nei mipa kum sawmthum le a tlunlam hmuahhmuah cu an hnaṭuan thlun in an zem ciar a si."},"17":{"text":"Puithiam pawl cu an hrin ciar in hnaṭuan an nei; Levi mi mipa kum kul le a tlunlam pawl cu a bur a bur in hnaṭuan an nei."},"18":{"text":"An hnaṭuan sunglawi cu ziangtik caan khalah a ṭuantu ding an si hrangah an nupi, an fanote, an fanu le an fapa pawl thawn siarcih thluh an si."},"19":{"text":"Aaron tesinfa khawsungih a ummi puithiam pawl, a si lole khua kiangkapih rannung tlannak ram sungih a ummi puithiam pawl lakah ṭuanvo neitu mipa an um ih anmah pawl in puithiam sungkhat mipa hmuahhmuah le Levi miphun mipum siarnak sungih a telmi hmuahhmuah cu an covo ciar an zem hai."},"20":{"text":"Judah ram sung hmuahhmuah ah Siangpahrang Hezekiah in Bawipa a Pathian ih lungawinak le a dikmi thil a tuah."},"21":{"text":"Biakinn hrang hnaṭuannak ah siseh, Daan thu thlunnak ah siseh, thinlung taktein Pathian hnenah a pek awk ruangah a hlawhtling a si."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah in Bawipa rinsan in hna a ṭuan ih hi bangtuk thil pawl a tuah hnuah, Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib in Judah ram a do; ralhruang ih kulhmi khua tampi a kulh ih a ralkap pawl cu khua kulhnak lungdawl pawl siatsuah thluh dingin thu a pek.","title":"Assiria Mi In Jerusalem Lak An Tum (2 Sian. 18.13-37 ; 19.14-19 , 35-37 ; Isai 36.1-22 ; 37.8-38)"},"2":{"text":"Sennakherib in Jerusalem khawpi tla do a tum a si, ti kha Hezekiah in a hmuh tikah,"},"3":{"text":"Assiria ralkap pawl Jerusalem an thlen khalle tidai in ding nei hlah hai seh, tiah siangpahrang Hezekiah le a kuthnuai ih bawi pawl in khawpi lengih a ummi an dawhhna pawl kha a phih thluh an tum. Bawi pawl ho in khawsungmi tampi an pok ih dawhhna ti hmuahhmuah an phit thluh; curuangah tidai zianghman a luang nawn lo.","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in raldo ih an ṭannak ding pawl cu ṭha sinsin in a tuah; khawpi kulhnak phar a rem; a tlunah ralvennak innsanghlei a sak; khawpi kulhnak lenglam phar tla a dawl. Jerusalem khua hlun nisuahnak lamih a ummi raldo ṭannak hrangih an sakmi pawl khal a rem. Feipi le ralphaw tam ngaingai a tuah."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem khawsungmi mipa hmuahhmuah cu ralbawi pawl a hoter; khawpi kotka kiang mualrawn ah an zatein a pumkhawmter ih an hnenah forhnak thu a sim:"},"7":{"text":"“Cakzet le ralṭhazet in um uh; nan thin khal nau hlah seh. Assiria siangpahrang siseh, a homi ralkap pawl siseh, ṭih hlah uh. An lamih ṭangtu hnakin kan lamih ṭangtu a cak sawn."},"8":{"text":"Anih a neihmi cu milai cahnak lawng a si; asinain kannih cun in bawmtu le kan hrangih dotu dingah Bawipa kan Pathian kan nei a si,” tiah a ti. Cuih thu an theih tikah senpi pawl cu an tha a tho ngaingai."},"9":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Sennakherib le a ralkap pawl cu Lakhish ih an um laiah Jerusalem khua ih a ummi siangpahrang Hezekiah le Judah mi pawl hnenah Sennakherib in mi a run thlah ih hiti in thu a run cah:"},"10":{"text":"“Assiria siangpahrang keimah Sennakherib ih thucah mi hi rak ruat uh: Judah mi pawl, ziang nan rinsan ruangah so ral ih kulhmi Jerusalem khawsungah nan um?"},"11":{"text":"‘Assiria siangpahrang kut sung thleng lo dingin Bawipa kan Pathian in in hum ding,’ tiah Hezekiah in a lo sim; sikhalsehla a lo bum a si; rawl lo le ti loin nan thi ding."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian biaknak hmun pawl le biakṭheng pawl a siatbal thluhtu cu amah Hezekiah a si ih Judah le Jerusalem cu biakṭheng pakhat lawngah Pathian biak dingah le rimhmui ur dingah a lo fialtu cu amah thotho a si."},"13":{"text":"Miphun dang le ramdang pawl tlunah ka pupa pawl in siseh, keimah in siseh, kan thiltuah mi pawl nan thei thluh zo lo maw? Zo ih pathian tal in an minung pawl Assiria siangpahrang keimah ih kut sung thleng lo dingah an hum thei dah maw?"},"14":{"text":"Ziangtik talah hi kan siatsuahmi miphun pawl ih pathian pawl in an ram cu kan kut ihsin an runsuak dah maw? ‘Kan Pathian in in hum ding,’ tiah ziangtinso nannih bul nan zum thei?"},"15":{"text":"Hezekiah bummi le hruaisualmi si duh hlah uh, a zum khal zum hlah uh. Ziangbangtuk miphun ih pathian hman in an miphun cu Assiria siangpahrang kut cun an hum thei dah lo. Nanmah pawl ih pathian sinsin cun a lo hum thei lo ding!” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Sennakherib ih thlahmi palai pawl in Bawipa Pathian le a siahhlawh Hezekiah an hmuhsuamnak cu hi hnakih luar deuh in an ṭongmi a um lai hrih."},"17":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Assiria siangpahrang in Israel ih Pathian dodal nautatnak ah ca hiti in a ngan: “Miphun dangdangih khawzing pawl in an minung pawl cu ka cahnak kut sungin an run thei dah lo; Hezekiah ih Pathian khal in a minung pawl cu ka kut sungin a run thei cuang lo ding,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi kulhnak phar parih a ummi Jerusalem mi pawl hro duh ah le ṭhihṭhaih duh ah cuih palai pawl cun Hebru ṭong in cuih thu cu ringzet in an aupi ciamco."},"19":{"text":"Milai kutih tuahcopmi miphundang ih khawzing pawl ih thuhla an rel vekin Jerusalem ih Pathian thuhla khal an rel ve a si."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Siangpahrang Hezekiah le Amoz fapa profet Isaiah in thla an cam ih bomnak dil in Pathian hnenah an au."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in vancungmi pakhat a thlah ih cuih vancungmi cun ralṭhazet Assiria ralkap pawl le an ralbawi pawl cu an riahhmun ah a that ṭheh hai. Curuangah Assiria siangpahrang cu ningzak le mithmai sia in a ramah a kirta. Cule a khawzing biaknak innih a luh tikah a fapa hrekkhat pawl in an ralnam in an sun ih a thi."},"22":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa in siangpahrang Hezekiah le Jerusalem khuami pawl cu Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib le a ral pawl kut in a hum a si. Bawipa in an ram khuazakip ah daihnak a umter."},"23":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ah mi tampi an ra ih Bawipa hnenih thawinak le Hezekiah hrangah laksawng tampi an keng; cuih ihsin thok in miphun dang hmuahhmuah in Hezekiah cu an upatzet."},"24":{"text":"Cuih caanah Hezekiah cu thizik in a na. Bawipa ih hnenah thla a cam ih Bawipa in a thlacamnak a saang ih a dam ding tiah hminsinnak a pek.","title":"Hezekiah Natnak Le Hngalnak (2 Sian. 20.1-3 , 12-19 ; Isai 38.1-3 ; 39.1-8)"},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Hezekiah cu a hngal tuk ih Bawipa in a parih thil ṭha a tuahmi hrangah lungawinak zianghman a langter lo; curuangah Judah le Jerusalem mi parah Bawipa a thin a heng."},"26":{"text":"Asinain Hezekiah le Jerusalem mi pawl cu an lung a nemsal ruangah Hezekiah nunsung ahcun Bawipa ih hremnak zianghman an tong lo."},"27":{"text":"Hezekiah cu a lian ngaingai ih mi hmuahhmuah in upatnak an pek. A sui le a ngun, lungmankhung le rimhmui, ralphaw le a dang thilri mankhung pawl retnak ah inn tampi a sak.","title":"Hezekiah Lennak Le Sunlawinak"},"28":{"text":"Cuih tlunah a neihmi rawl le sabitti le olif hriak retnak ah inn pawl a sak; a caw retnak ah caw inn a sak ih a tuu retnak ah tuu inn a sak."},"29":{"text":"Cuih hlei ah Pathian in tuu le caw tampi a pek ih sumsaw dangdang tla tampi a pek ruangah khua tampi a din."},"30":{"text":"Gihon Cerhti luannak a kham ih leihnuai in Jerusalem khawpi kulhnak pharih sunglam tiang tidai luang ko ih a tuahtu khal amah siangpahrang Hezekiah a si. A thiltuah mi hmuahhmuah ah Hezekiah cu hlawhtlinnak a nei."},"31":{"text":"A thinlung le a ziaza theih duh ah Pathian in Hezekiah cu a duhduh in a tlanleenter; culai hmanah a ram sungih mangbangza thil a cangmi pawl zingzoi dingah Babilon siangpahrang in a palai pawl a run thlah."},"32":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah in a tuahmi dangdang le Bawipa hnenih rinsannak thawn a ṭuanmi dang pawl cu Amoz Fapa Profet Isaiah Langnak Hmuhmi Cabu le Judah le Israel Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si.","title":"Hezekiah Uknak A Cem (2 Sian. 20.20-21)"},"33":{"text":"Hezekiah cu a thi ih siangpahrang thlaan tlunta lamah an phum. A thih tikah Judah mi le Jerusalem khua mi hmuahhmuah in upatnak an pek. A fapa Manasseh in a ai-ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh cu kum hleihnih a ti ah Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan ih Jerusalem ihsin kum sawmnga le kum nga sung a uk.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Manasseh (2 Sian. 21.1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah thilṭha lo a tuah ih a sual a si. Israel mi pawl Kanaan ram an rak luh laiih a rak um cia, Bawipa in a dawimi pawl ih thil tuahmi thlun in fihnungza thil pawl a tuah."},"3":{"text":"Manasseh in a pa Hezekiah ih a rak balmi khuavang an rak biaknak hmun pawl cu a sak sal. Culawng si loin Baal khawzing biaknak ah biakṭheng pawl a don; Asherah khawzingnu lem a tuah ih tlunah arsi pawl tla a bia."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih Biakinn sung ‘Kumkhua in Keimah in biaknak hmunah,’ tiah Bawipa Amah in a rak timi ahcun khuavang biakṭheng pawl a don."},"5":{"text":"Biakinn tual pahnih ah arsi biaknak biakṭheng pawl a don."},"6":{"text":"Hinnom Phairawn ah a fapa pawl mei-ur thawinak ah a pek. Ai a zing, dawi a hmang, kutṭial a zohter, tin a zoh. Bawipa ih hmaiah thilṭha lozet a tuah ih Bawipa ih thin a hengter."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa Biakinn sungah milem a ret. Bawipa in David le a fapa Solomon hnenah, “Hi Jerusalem khua, hi Biakinn hmun cu keimah in biaknak dingah Israel miphun hleihnih ih ramsung ihsin ka hrilmi hmun a si."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in ka thukham le ka thupekmi hmuahhmuah an thlun ih ka siahhlawh Moses in an hnenih a pekmi Daan pawl kimtein an tuah a si ahcun an pupa hnenih ka pekmi hih ram ihsin zohman in an dawi hai lo ding,” tiin a rak sim hnawhsan ciami Biakinn sung rori ah milem cu a ret a si."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih minung Israel mi pawl Kanaan ram an luh laiih Bawipa in a dawihlomi miphun pawl ih sualnak hnak hmanin a luar sawnmi sualnak sungah Judah mi pawl cu Manasseh in a hruailut hai a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in Manasseh le a minung pawl cu ralrinnak a pek naón an ngai duh lo.","title":"Manasseh A Siir Aw"},"11":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in Assiria ralbawi pawl cu Judah ram a doter. Cutikah Manasseh cu an kai ih a hnar ah sio an thlaih; thir cikcin thawn hreng an sut ih Babilon ah an hruai."},"12":{"text":"Cutiin vansaanglam ih a um ruangah a lung nem in Bawipa a Pathian hnenah a hoikir sal ih thlacam in Bawipa ih bomnak a dil."},"13":{"text":"Manasseh thlacamnak cu Pathian in a theihsak ih Jerusalem ah kirter sal in Judah ram cu a ukter sal. Cuticun Manasseh in Bawipa cu Pathian ngaingai a si, ti a thei ngah."},"14":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Manasseh in Jerusalem khua kulhnak phardawl cu nisuahnak lamih ummi Gihon Cerh rawn ihsin saklam Nga Kotka le Ofel an timi khua tiang a dawl ih saang sinsin in a tuah. Judah ram sung ralhruang ih kulhmi khua kipah ralbawi pakhat le a kuthnuai ralkap pawl a ret vivo."},"15":{"text":"Cule Biakinn ih a rak retmi ramdang khawzing pawl le milem pawl cu a lak ṭheh ih tlunah Biakinn an saknak tlangtluan le Jerusalem khawsung ih a ummi khuavang biakṭheng pawl hmuahhmuah a bal ṭheh. Cuih pawl cu a lak ih Jerusalem khua lengah a hlonhlo ṭheh a si."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa biaknak ih biakṭheng cu a rem ih remnak thawinak le lungawi thawinak pawl a pek. Judah mi hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa Israel ih Pathian bia dingah a forh ciamco."},"17":{"text":"Senpi pawl cun hmun dangdang khalah thawinak an tuah; asinain an pekmi ngaingai cu Bawipa ih hnen lawngah a si."},"18":{"text":"Manasseh ih tuahmi dangdang, a Pathian hnenih a thlacam mi le Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian hminin profet pawl in a hnenih thu an phuanmi pawl cu kimtein Israel Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si.","title":"Manasseh Ih Ram Uknak A Cem (2 Sian. 21.17-18)"},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang Manasseh thlacamnak le Pathian ih a lehnak, sualnak le ṭhat lonak a tuah mi pawl, khuavang biaknak le Asherah khawzingnu lem a tuahmi pawl le milem a biaknak thu pawl cu kimtein Profet Pawl Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si."},"20":{"text":"Manasseh cu a thi ih siangpahrang inn ah an phum; cule a fapa Amon in a ai-ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"21":{"text":"Amon cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan ah kum kul hluanhnih a ti ih Jerusalem in kum hnih sung a uk.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Amon (2 Sian. 21.19-26)"},"22":{"text":"A pa Manasseh vekin Bawipa ih hmaiah a sual ih a pa ih rak biakmi milem pawl a bia ve."},"23":{"text":"Asinain a pa vek a si lo; a thinlung a nem loih Bawipa khal a hoikir sal lo; a pa hnakin a sual a luar a si."},"24":{"text":"Cun a kuthnuai ih bawi pawl in an phiar ih a siangpahrang inn sungah Amon cu an that."},"25":{"text":"Asinain Amon thattu pawl cu Judah mi pawl in an that ve lala ih Amon fapa Josiah cu siangpahrang ah an tuah."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan ah kum riat a ti ih Jerusalem ihsin kum sawmthum le kum khat sung a uk.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Josiah (2 Sian. 22.1-2)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah thilṭha a tuah ih Bawipa ih lung a awiter. A pupa siangpahrang David dung a thlun ih Pathian ih thupekmi hmuahhmuah feltein a thlun."},"3":{"text":"Josiah cu siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum riatnak, mino a si lai ihsin a pupa siangpahrang David ih Pathian biak hram a thok. Kum li hnuah khuavang an biaknak hmun pawl, Asherah khawzingnu ih lem pawl le milem dangdang pawl cu a bal ciamco.","title":"Josiah In Rai Biaknak A Hlon"},"4":{"text":"A thupek vekin a minung pawl in Baal an biaknak hrangih biakṭheng pawl cu an siatbal thluh; a kiangih rimhmui urnak biakṭheng pawl an deng kuai ṭheh ih Asherah khawzing nu ih lem pawl le a dang milem pawl cu an rialdip thluh hnuah a vut cu thawinak a rak petu mi pawl ih thlaan ah an phulh ciamco."},"5":{"text":"Khuavang puithiam pawl ih ruh cu an khuavang biaknak biakṭheng parah a ur ih cuticun Judah le Jerusalem cu Josiah in a thianfaiter sal."},"6":{"text":"Manasseh ram, Efraim ram le Simeon ram sung hmunkip le khua kipah, saklam ah Naftali thlengin cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in a tuah."},"7":{"text":"Saklam Ramsung khuazakip ah biakṭheng pawl a siat sal, Asherah lem pawl a hau ṭheh, milem pawl a rialdip ṭheh ih rimhmui urnak biakṭheng pawl a den kuai thluh. Cuih hnuah Jerusalem ah a kir."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah in Judah ram a uknak kum hleiriatnak kum, a ramsung le Bawipa ih Biakinn sungih khuavang biaknak a thianfaiter hnuah, Josiah cun Bawipa Pathian ih Biakinn rem dingah mi pathum: Azaliah ih fapa Shafan, Jerusalem uktu bawi Maaseiah le bawi upa pakhat Joahaz ih fapa Joah pawl ṭuanvo a pek.","title":"Daan Cabu An Hmu (2 Sian. 22.3-20)"},"9":{"text":"Levi mi Biakinn kiltu pawl in Efraim mi, Manasseh mi, Saklam Ram mi pawl, Judah mi Benjamin mi le Jerusalem khawsung mi pawl hnen ihsin Biakinn ih paisa an rak kenmi an khawm ih Puithiam Sang Hilkiah hnenah an fehpi."},"10":{"text":"Cuih paisa cu Biakinn an remnak lamih hnaṭuan hotu pawl hnenah an pek ih,"},"11":{"text":"inn saktu le zungthiam pawl hlawhman an pek ih cuih tlunah lungto leinak le Judah siangpahrang daithlan ruangih a siatmi inn pawl remnak hrangih a ṭulmi zanthing pawl leinak ah an hmang."},"12":{"text":"Cuih hnaṭuantu pawl cu mifelzet le rinsan tlakzet an si. An hotu pawl cu mi pali: Levi mi Merari hrin Jahath le Obadiah, Levi mi Kohath hrin Zekhariah le Meshullam an si. Levi mi cu an zatein hlathiam an si."},"13":{"text":"A dang Levi mi pawl in thilri phurtu pawl an ho ih hnaṭuantu dangdang zohtu tla an si; a dang Levi mi pawl cu sungṭuan, cazi le sangka kiltu tla an si."},"14":{"text":"Thilri retnak khaan ihsin paisa an suah laiah Hilkiah in Moses hnenih Pathian pekmi Daan, Bawipa ih Daan cabu a sar ngah."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Hilkiah in, “Hi Biakinn sungah Daan cabu ka sar,” tiah Shafan a sim. Hilkiah in cuih cabu cu Shafan a pek ih,"},"16":{"text":"Shafan in siangpahrang hnenah a fehpi. Shafan in siangpahrang hnenah cun, “Na thupekmi bangtuk in ziang hmuahhmuah kan tuah ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Biakinn sungih retmi paisa tla kan suah ih hnaṭuantu pawl le an hotu pawl hnenah kan pek,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"“Cun hinah Hilkiah ih i pekmi cabu a um,” tiah a ti. Cule siangpahrang hnenah ringzet in a siar."},"19":{"text":"Cumi cu siangpahrang in a theih tikah a ninghang in a hnipuan a thlek."},"20":{"text":"Cule Puithiam Sang Hilkiah, Shafan ih fapa Ahikam, Mikaiah ih fapa Abdon, cangantu Shafan le siangpahrang kiltu Asaiah pawl a ko ih an hnenah hiti in thu a pek,"},"21":{"text":"“Feh uh la keimah le Israel le Judah ram sungih a taanglai mi minung pawl hrangah Bawipa va ron uh. Hi cabu ih a zirh mi hi feltein theisuak uh. Hi cabu ih tuah ding a timi kan pupa pawl in an tuah loih Bawipa ih thu an ngai lo ruangah kan parah Bawipa a thin a heng a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Siangpahrang thupek vekin Hilkiah le a rualpi pawl cu Jerusalem khawthar ih a ummi nunau profet Huldah an timi tong dingah an feh. Hasrah ih tupa, Tikvah ih fapa Shallum cu Huldah pasal a si ih Biakinn hnipuan pawl kilkhawitu a si. Cule annih in an tonmi thuhla pawl cu Huldah an sim."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Huldah in, “Siangpahrang hnenah va kir uhla,"},"24":{"text":"Bawipa in, ‘Siangpahrang hnenih nan siarmi cabu sungih nganmi thusia siatcamnak vekin Jerusalem le misenpi pawl cu ka hrem hai ding."},"25":{"text":"Keimah in hnong ih khawzing dang hnenah thawinak an pek; hiti ih an tuahmi ruangah an parah ka thin a heng a si. Jerusalem parih ka thinhengnak cu a dai lo ding."},"26":{"text":"Siangpahrang amah hrangah Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian Keimah in hiti in ka sim: Hi cabu sungih nganmi thu na ngai ih,"},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem le a minung pawl ka hrem ding thu na theih tikah na hnipuan thlek le ṭap rero in na siir aw ih na thinlung a nem ruangah na thlacamnak ka thei zo."},"28":{"text":"Jerusalem ka hremnak cu na hmu man lo ding. Daite in na caan ka cemter ding,’ a ti va ti uh,” tiah a sim. Cuih thu thawn Hilkiah le a rualpi pawl cu siangpahrang Josiah hnenah an kir."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Josiah in Judah le Jerusalem hotu pawl a ko ṭheh ih,","title":"Ih Thu Thlun Dingin A Kam (2 Sian. 23.1-20)"},"30":{"text":"hmun khatah puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl le Jerusalem khawsung mi pawl thawn mifarah milian ti loin Biakinn ah an zatein an feh. Biakinn sungih an hmuhmi thukam cabu cu a zatein ring zetin an hmaiah siangpahrang bawipa in a siar."},"31":{"text":"Cule Josiah cu a siangpahrang ṭhuam kiangah a ding ih cuih cabu sungih a ummi vekin, thukamnak sungih kam awkmi pawl tuah suak dingah siseh, Bawipa ih thukham cu a thinlung le a thazaang zatein thlun dingah le Bawipa ih thu ngai dingah Bawipa ih hnenah thukamnak a tuah."},"32":{"text":"Cuih thukamnak thlun dingah Jerusalem ih a ummi hmuahhmuah le Benjamin mi pawl cu thutiamnak a tuahter. Cuticun Jerusalem mi pawl in an pupa ih Pathian hnenih an tiamkammi thukam hmuahhmuah cu an thlun."},"33":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Josiah in Israel ram sungih a ummi fihnungza milem pawl cu a siatsuah ṭheh. A nun sungah senpi pawl cun an pupa ih Pathian Bawipa thlun cu an pialsan nawn lo."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah in Bawipa ih hmin thangṭhatnak ah Lantak Puai cu Jerusalem khua ah a tuah; thla hmaisa bik ni hleilinak ni ah cuih puai cu an tuah ih rannung pawl an that.","title":"Josiah In Lantak Puai A Tuah (2 Sian. 23.21-23)"},"2":{"text":"Puithiam pawl hnenah Biakinn ih an hnaṭuan dingmi a pek ih felte ih tuahsuak dingah a forh hai."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih thianhlimter mi, Israel mi zirhtu Levi mi pawl tla thu a cah ih, an hnenah, “David fapa siangpahrang Solomon ih sakmi Biakinn sungah Thukam Kuang cu ret uh. Hi Thukam Kuang cu hmunkhat ihsin hmun dangah nan phur nawn lo pei ih Bawipa nan Pathian le Amah ih minung Israel mi pawl ih hna lawnglawng nan ṭuan pei."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang David le a fapa siangpahrang Solomon in ṭuanvo an lo pek bangtuk in Biakinn ah nan sungkhat fingfing in ṭuanvo nan lak pei."},"5":{"text":"Israel mi sungah innsang pakhatkhat bom an ṭul tikah bawm theitu si ding in nan zuam pei."},"6":{"text":"Nanmah in Lantak Puai hrangih tuu le me pawl cu nan that pei. Cule Bawipa in Moses hnenih a pekmi Daan bangtuk in nan unau Israel mi pawl ih an thlun ve nak dingah nanmah cu thiangfaiter aw uhla, thawinak pekmi pawl cu timtuah uh,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah in Lantak Puai tikcu ih misenpi pawl hrangah amah ih rannung rual pawl sung ihsin tuu le tuuno, le menote a zate ah thawng sawmthum a pek; cawcang khal thawng thum a pek."},"8":{"text":"A kuthnuai bawi pawl khal in senpi pawl, puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl hrangah an pek ve. Biakinn kiltu upa pawl: Puithiam Sang Hilkiah, Zekhariah le Jehiel in cuih puai tikcu ih thawinak pek dingah puithiam pawl hnenah tuuno le meno thawng hnih le zaruk, le cawcang zathum an pek."},"9":{"text":"Levi mi hotu pawl Konaniah, Shemaiah le a unau Nethanel, Hashabiah, Jeiel le Jozabad pawl in tuuno, le meno thawng nga le cawcang zanga cu Levi mi pawl ih thawinak hrangah an pek."},"10":{"text":"Lantak Puai hrangih ziang hmuahhmuah an tawlrel ṭheh tikah siangpahrang ih thupekmi vekin puithiam le Levi mi pawl cu an hnaṭuannak hmun ciarah an um."},"11":{"text":"Tuu le me pawl thah an si tikah Levi mi in a phaw an hawk ih a thisen cu puithiam pawl in biakṭheng ah an theh."},"12":{"text":"Cule Moses Daan sung vekih mei-ur thawinak an pek theinak dingah rannung sa cu sungkhat sungkhat ciarin misenpi pawl an zem."},"13":{"text":"A daan bangtuk in Lantak Puai thawinak sa cu Levi mi pawl in meisa ah an em ih thawinak thianghlim cu beel le thir beel le uhkang tumpipi in an suang ih senpi pawl hnenah zamrangte in an zem."},"14":{"text":"Cu ṭheh hnu lawngah Levi mi pawl in anmah ih hrang le Aaron tesinfa puithiam pawl hrangah sa an zem; ziangahtile mei-ur thawinak le a thau pawl pekmi an urnak ah puithiam pawl cu zan khawthim tiang an man hrimhrim lo."},"15":{"text":"Cun Asaf hrin hla satu pawl tla siangpahrang David ih thupekmi vekin an hnaṭuannak hmun ciarah an um. Asaf hrin pawl, Heman le siangpahrang profet Jeduthun le Biakinn kotka kiltu pawl cu an hnaṭuannak ihsin hmun dangih feh rero a ṭul lo; ziangahtile an hrangah Levi mi pawl in ziang hmuahhmuah an tawlrel sak a si."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang Josiah ih thupek vekin Lantak Puai ulhnak le biakṭheng parih mei-ur thawinak pekmi pawl le cuih ni ih Bawipa biaknak ziang hmuahhmuah cu famkim zetin an tuah thluh a si."},"17":{"text":"Cutawkih a telmi Israel mi hmuahhmuah in Lantak Puai le Thilnu tello Sang Puai cu ni sarih sung an tuah."},"18":{"text":"Profet Samuel san hnuah Lantak Puai cu hi vekin an tuah dah lo. Israel siangpahrang dang khal in Lantak Puai cu siangpahrang Josiah in puithiam pawl, Levi mi pawl, Judah mi, Israel mi le Jerusalem khawsungmi pawl thawn a tuahmi vek cun an tuah dah lo."},"19":{"text":"Josiah siangpahrang a ṭuan kum hleiriat kumah hi Lantak Puai cu an tuah a si."},"20":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah in Bawipa ih Biakinn hrangah hibangtuk hna a ṭuan ṭheh hnuah, Izipt siangpahrang Neko in Eufrates Tivapi kapih ummi Karkhemish ah raldo dingin a ralkap pawl thawn an pok. Cumi cu Josiah in kham a tum.","title":"Siangpahrang Josiah Ram Uk Netnak (2 Sian. 23.28-30)"},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Neko in Josiah hnenah thu a cah ih, “Maw Judah siangpahrang, hi ka raldo ding mi hi i hnaihnok duh hlah, nang thawn zianghman a seng aw lo; nangmah do dingah ka ra lo. Ka ral pawl do ding lawngah ka ra ih Pathian in zamrangte ih feh dingah i fial a si. Pathian cu ka hnenah a ṭang ih Amah cu do duh hlah; na do asile a lo siatsuah sawn ding,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Josiah cun a ngai lo ih a do tum thotho; curuangah theihthiam lo dingin a tuah-aw ih raldonak ah a feh. Siangpahrang Neko hmangin Pathian ih thusimmi cu a ngai duh lo ih Megiddo phairawn ah raldo dingin a feh."},"23":{"text":"An do awk tikah Izipt conkiang in siangpahrang Josiah cu a ngah. Cutikah a siahhlawh pa hnenah, “I tlanpi aw! Besiazet in in ngah a si,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"A rangleng ihsin an cawi ih a rangleng pahnihnak ah an ret ih Jerusalem ah an kirpi. Cutawkah a thi ih siangpahrang thlaan ah an phum. Judah mi le Jerusalem mi pawl in a thih cu an ul ih an ṭap."},"25":{"text":"Profet Jeremiah in siangpahrang Josiah hrangah ṭahhla a phuah ih an siangpahrang an ṭah tikah hla satu pawl in nunau siseh mipa siseh, cuih ṭahhla cun an ṭah ṭheu. Cutiih mithi ṭah cu Israel mi daan ah a cang ih cuih hla cu ṭahhla cabu sungah a um a si."},"26":{"text":"Josiah in Bawipa a rinsannak, Daan a thlunzia,"},"27":{"text":"a uknak hramthokin a net tiang, a thiltuahmi hmuahhmuah le amah ih thuanthu cu Israel le Judah Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah kimtein an ngan a si."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah mi pawl in Josiah fapa Joahaz siangpahrang ah an hril ih Jerusalem khua ah hriak an culh.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Joahaz (2 Sian. 23.30-35)"},"2":{"text":"Joahaz cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan tikah kum kul hluanthum a ti ih Jerusalem ihsin thla thum sung a uk."},"3":{"text":"Izipt siangpahrang Neko in a kaih ih thawngah a thlak; cule Judah mi in Neko cu ngun pawng zasarih le sawmnga, le sui pawng sawmsarih le pawng nga siah ah an pek."},"4":{"text":"Neko in Joahaz unau Eliakim cu Judah siangpahrang ah a tuah ih a hmin Jehoiakim ah a thleng. Joahaz cu Neko in Izipt ramah a hruai."},"5":{"text":"Jehoiakim cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan ah kum kul hluannga a ti ih Jerusalem ihsin kum hleikhat sung a uk. Bawipa a Pathian hmaiah thil ṭha lo a tuah.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jehoiakim (2 Sian. 23.36—24.7)"},"6":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Judah ram cu a siim ih Jehoiakim cu kai tahrat in thir cikcin in an khit ih Babilon ah an hruai."},"7":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in Bawipa ih Biakinn thilri mankhung hrekkhat pawl a lak ih Babilon a siangpahrang inn ah a ret."},"8":{"text":"Jehoiakim ih tuahmi hmuahhmuah, ningsinza thil a tuahmi cu a sualnak pawl tiangin, Israel Le Judah Siangpahrang Thuanthu Cabu sungah an ngan a si. A fapa Jehoiakhin in a ai-ah siangpahrang a run ṭuan."},"9":{"text":"Jehoiakhin cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan tikah kum hleiriat a ti ih Jerusalem ihsin thla thum le nihra sung a uk. Anih khal Bawipa ih hmaiah a sual.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Jehoiakhin (2 Sian. 24.8-17)"},"10":{"text":"Khawsik a reh ih ṭhal a hungsuah tikah siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in a kai ih Babilon ah a hruai. Bawipa ih Biakinn thilri mankhung pawl tla a phur ṭheh. Cule Nebuchadnezzar in Jehoiakhin ih unau Zedekiah cu Judah le Jerusalem siangpahrang ah a tuah."},"11":{"text":"Zedekiah cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan tikah kum kul hluankhat a ti ih Jerusalem ihsin kum hleikhat sung a uk.","title":"Judah Siangpahrang Zedekiah (2 Sian. 24.18-20 ; Jer. 52.1-3a)"},"12":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah sualnak a tuah; Bawipa ih thu a phuangtu profet Jeremiah ih thusimmi a ngai lo."},"13":{"text":"Zedekiah cu siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar do dingah ral a tho. Cutikah Nebuchadnezzar in a kuthnuai um dingah Pathian hmin saal in thu a kamter. Zedekiah in Bawipa Israel ih Pathian hnenah sualsir-aw in Pathian hnenih hoikir sal a tum hrimhrim lo.","title":"Jerusalem Khawpi An Lak (2 Sian. 25.1-21 ; Jer. 52.3b-11)"},"14":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Judah mi hotu pawl, puithiam le misenpi pawl khal in an kiangkap ih um miphun pawl ih sualnak keneh cu an thlunih an uire a si. Cuticun Bawipa amah rori in a thianhlimter mi Biakinn cu an borhhlawhter ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa , an pupa ih Pathian in a minung pawl le a Biakinn cu a zuah duh ruangah an hnenih ralrinnak pe dingah cat loin profet a thlah."},"16":{"text":"Asinain Pathian ih thlahmi palai le profet pawl cu an rak hmuhsuam; an hnihsan men ih zianghman ah an siar lo. A netnak ahcun an parah Bawipa ih thinhengnak cu a luar tukih an luat theinak lamzin a um nawn lo."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in Babilon siangpahrang a thlah ih Judah mi mino pawl cu Biakinn sung hmanah a that; zovek tlun hmanah zaangfahnak a nei lo; mino siseh, upa siseh, nunau mipa tilo in, a na mi le harhdam mi tla an zatein a kut sungah Bawipa in a pek ṭheh a si."},"18":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang in Bawipa ih Biakinn a siim ih thilri le sumsaw, siangpahrang le a kuthnuai bawi pawl thilri mankhung hmuahhmuah a lak ih Babilon ah a phur ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi le Bawipa Biakinn, siangpahrang innpi le a sung thilri pawl tla meisa in a ur ṭheh."},"20":{"text":"Ralnam in thah ngah lomi, a taanglai mi pawl cu Babilon ah a hruai thluh ih cutawkah, Persia uknak a thlen hlan lo, Babilon siangpahrang le a tesinfa pawl ih sal ah an cang."},"21":{"text":"Cuticun profet Jeremiah hmangin Bawipa ih a rak simmi, “An ulh lomi Sabbath colhnak kimter dingah an ram cu kum sawmsarih sung a ṭhing ding,” a timi thu cu a kim a si."},"22":{"text":"Persia siangpahrang Sairas in siangpahrang a ṭuan kum khatnak ah Bawipa ih fial vekin ca a ngan ih a uk sung khuazakipih siar ding in a kuat. Himi cu profet Jeremiah hmangin Bawipa ih thusimmi kimnakah a si. A thusuahmi cu hiti in a ngan:","title":"Sairas In Judah Mi A Kirter (Ezra 1.1-4)"},"23":{"text":"“Himi cu Persia siangpahrang Sairas thusuah mi a si. Bawipa vanih Pathian in leilung pumpuluk uktu ah i tuah ih Judah ram Jerusalem khua ah amah hrangih Biakinn sak dingah ṭuanvo i pek. Cu a si ruangah nannih Pathian minung hmuahhmuah cutawkah feh thluh uh; Bawipa nan Pathian cu nan hnenah um hram seh,” tiah a ngan."}}}}},"15":{"info":{"name":"Ezra","shortname":"Ezra","abbr":[],"desc":"Ezra"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia siangpahrang Sairas in siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum khatnak ah Bawipa in a thinlung a thoter ih ca ngan in thu pakhat a suah ih a ramsung hmuahhmuahih siar dingah a kuat. Himi cu profet Jeremiah hmangin Bawipa ih thusimmi kimternak dingah a si.","title":"Sairas In Judah Mi A Kirter"},"2":{"text":"A thusuah mi sungah cun hiti in a ngan: “Himi cu Persia siangpahrang Sairas ih thupek mi a si. Bawipa , Van ih Pathian in keimah cu leilung pumpuluk uktu dingah i tuah zo ih Judah ram Jerusalem khua ah amah hrangih biakinn sak dingah ṭuanvo i pe a si."},"3":{"text":"Pathian cu a minung nan zate hnenah um hram seh.
