Judah ram Jerusalem khua ah kir uhla Jerusalem ih a ummi Pathian, Israel ih Bawipa Pathian biakinn cu saksaal uh."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa minung lakah hi saltaannak ihsin kir dingah bom a ṭulmi pawl cu an innhnen pawl in bawm hai seh. Sui le ngun, rawl le thil phurtu rannung le Jerusalem khua ah Pathian hnenih pek dingmi thawinak pawl tla pe hai seh,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Judah mi le Benjamin mi sungkhat ih hotu pawl puithiam le Levi mi pawl le Bawipa in Jerusalem ih Bawipa ih Biakinn sak dingah an thinlung a thawhtermi hmuahhmuah cu feh dingah an tim an tuah ciamco."},"6":{"text":"An innhnen pawl in thilri tampi an pek; an pekmi thilri pawl cu ngun beelkheng pawl, sui, rawl, thil phurtu rannung, a dang thil mankhung pawl le biakinn ih thawinak pek ding mi pawl an si."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem ihsin a lakih a khawzing pawl biakinn sungih a rak retmi kheng le khuat pawl cu siangpahrang Sairas in an hnenah a pek sal."},"8":{"text":"Hi khuat le kheng pawl cu Judah uktu bawi Shehbazzar hrangah siangpahrang thilri kiltu upabik Mithredath ih tuahmi an si. Sairas in cuih khuat le kheng pawl cu Mithredath hnenah cun a pek."},"9":{"text":"A pekmi pawl cu a tanglam pawl hi an si:","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"A zate cun sui le ngun kheng pawl le khuat le bungbeel dangdang thawn thawng nga le zali a si ih Babilon ihsin Jerusalem ih an kir tikah Sheshbazzar in a kirpi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon ramih saltaang mitampi cu Jerusalem le Judah ram an khua ciarih kir dingah Babilon ihsin an suak. Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in sal ih a kaih caan ihsin innsang tampi cu Babilon ramah an rak um ringring.","title":"Babilon Ihsin A Kirmi Minung Cazin (Neh. 7.4-73)"},"2":{"text":"A kirmi pawl hotu cu Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum le Baanah an si. Babilon ihsin a kirmi Israel hrin pawl cu an minung zat ciar thawn a tanglam bangtuk in an si:"},"3":{"text":"Parosh hrin ihsin 2,172 Shefatiah hrin ihsin 372 Arah hrin ihsin 775 Pahath Moab (Jeshua in (Jeshua tesinfa pawl) 973 Immer hrin in 1,052 Pashhur hrin in 1,247 Harim hrin in 1,017","merge":"37"},"40":{"text":"Levi mi a kirmi pawl cu a tanglam vekin an si: Jeshua le Kadmiel (Hodaviah tesinfa) hrin in 74"},"41":{"text":"Biakinn hla satu (Asaf tesinfa) pawl 128"},"42":{"text":"Biakinn kotka kiltu (Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita le Shobai tesinfa) pawl 139"},"43":{"text":"A kirmi lakah a tanglam ih Biakinn satu pawl cu an innsang ciar thawn an tel: Ziha, Hasufa, Tabbaoth, Keros, Siaha, Padon, Lebanah, Hagabah, Akkub, Hagad, Shamlai, Hanan, Giddel, Gahar, Reaiah, Rezin, an innsang ciar thawn a kirmi pawl cu a tanglam hi an si: Sotai, Hassofereth, Peruda, Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel, Shefatiah, Hattil, Pokhereth, Hazzebaim le Ami.","merge":"56"},"58":{"text":"biakinn saktu pawl ih tesinfa pawl le Solomon hnen-um pawl ih tesinfa pawl a kirmi an zatein 392 an si."},"59":{"text":"Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kherub, Addan le Immer khua ihsin Delaiah hrin, Tobiah hrin le Nekoda hrin pawl, an zatein 652 a kirmi lakah an tel. Asinain Israel pawl ih tesinfa an sinak fiangtein an simsuak thei lo.","merge":"60"},"61":{"text":"Puithiam Habaiah hrin, Hakkoz hrin le Barzillai hrin pawl tla in an pupa ih thawhkehnak canganmi an hmu lo. Barzillai hrin ih an pu in Gilead ram Barzillai hrin nunau a rak ṭhit ih a puzon ih hmin a rak lakta ruangah Barzillai hrin ti an si. An pupa zo an si ti an theih lo ruangah annih pawl cu puithiam ah an pom thei lo a si.","merge":"62"},"63":{"text":"Judah mi uktu bawi in, Urim le Thummim timi a hmang thiamtu puithiam an um hlan cu Pathian hnenih pekmi rawl thianghlim ei lo dingin a kham a si."},"64":{"text":"Babilon saltaannak ihsin a kirmi an zatein thawng sawmli thawng hnih zathum le sawmruk an si. Nunau siseh, mipa siseh an hnen-um zatein thawng sarih zathum sawmthum pasarih an si. Hla saktu nunau siseh, mipa siseh an zatein zahnih an si. Cule an kirpi mi rannung ah rang zasarih sawmthum paruk, laak zahnih sawmli panga, kalauk zali sawmthum panga le thilphur laak thawngruk zasarih le kul an si.","merge":"65"},"68":{"text":"Saltaang pawl cu Jerusalem khua Bawipa ih Biakinn an thlen tikah an sungkhat ih hotu hrekkhat pawl in lungtho teih pekmi thilri an pek ih Biakinn cu a hlanih a dinnak hmunah sak sal an tum."},"69":{"text":"Biakinn saknak hrangah cun an pek theizat an pek ih an pekmi pawl cu sui cuai zahnih le cuai sawmruk, ngun cuai thawngkhat zariat le sawmthum, le puithiam pawl hrangah korfual zakhat a si."},"70":{"text":"Cule puithiam le Levi mi pawl le misenpi hrekkhat pawl cu Jerusalem khua le a kiangkap ah an um ih hla satu pawl le Biakinn kiltu pawl le Biakinn hnaṭuantu pawl cu Jerusalem kiang khawte sungah an um. Israel midang pawl cu an pu le an pa ih khua ciarah an um."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thla sarihnak thla ah, Israel mi pawl cu an khua ciarih an um hnuah, an zatein Jerusalem ah an tongkhawm aw ih,","title":"Pathian Biak An Thok Sal"},"2":{"text":"Jozadak ih fapa Joshua le a hawipi puithiam pawl le Shealtiel ih fapa Zerubbabel le a sungkhat pawl in Pathian ih milai Moses pekmi Daan bangtuk in mei-ur thawinak an pek theinak dingah Israel Pathian hrangah biakṭheng an don sal."},"3":{"text":"An ram sungih um midang pawl an ṭih naón biakṭheng cu a rak dinnak hmun keelah an dawl sal. Cule cuih biakṭheng parah cun Bawipa ih hnenah zingtin zantin thawinak an pek."},"4":{"text":"A daan vekin Puanthlam Puai an tuah ih ni khat hrangih tuah ding timi thawinak cu nitinte pelh loin an pek."},"5":{"text":"Cuih tlunah an pek ringring ṭheu mi mei-ur thawinak, Thla Thar Puai ih pek mi thawinak, Israel mi an tonkhawm tikih an pek ṭheumi thawinak le Bawipa hnenih lungtho teih pekmi thawinak pawl an pek."},"6":{"text":"Senpi pawl in Biakinn sak cu an thok hrih lo naón thla sarih thla, ni khat ni ah Bawipa ih hnenah mei-ur thawinak pek an thok a si."},"7":{"text":"Cun misenpi pawl in lungsertu le zungthiam pawl pek dingah paisa an pek ih Lebanon ramih sidar thing thlengnak dingah le ṭai-ar le Sidon khua ih kuat dingin ei ding le in ding pawl le siti pawl an pek. Sidar zanthing cu tidai par in Joppa ah run phurh ding a si. Hi pawl hmuahhmuah cu Persia siangpahrang Sairas ih lungkimnak vekin an tuah ṭheh.","title":"Biakinn Sak Sal An Thok"},"8":{"text":"Cuticun Jerusalem ih an kirnak ah Bawipa ih Biakinn hmunah cun hnaṭuan an thok. Shealtiel ih fapa Zerubbabel, Jozadak ih fapa Joshua, le Jerusalem ih a ra kir salmi hmuahhmuah - an unau Israel mi pawl, puithiam le Levi mi pawl - in Biakinn saknak hnaṭuan cu an thok. Cule kum kul le a tlun a timi Levi mi pohpoh cu hnaṭuan zohtu-ah an ret."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Levi mi Jeshua le a fapa pawl le a sungkhat pawl, Hodaviah hrin Kadmiel le a fapa pawl cu Biakinn sak hnaṭuan zohtu an si ṭheh. Anmah cu Levi mi Henadad hrin pawl in an bawm."},"10":{"text":"Biakinnpi saknak a hram lungphum an hun thok cun puithiam pawl cu an umnak ciarah an ding ih tawtawrawt an keng ciar ih Asaf hrin Levi mi pawl in darsumsel an keng fingfing. Siangpahrang David ih thucahtami vekin an zatein Bawipa cu an thangṭhat."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa thang ṭhatnak hla Bawipa ih hnenah an sak ih: “ Bawipa cu a ṭha; Israel a duhdawtnak cu Kumkhua in a hmun,” timi saknolhnak cu atu le atu an sak. Biakinn hram lungphum an thawh zo ruangah Bawipa cu an thangṭhat ih zozo khal an aw neih tawpin an au ciamco."},"12":{"text":"Kum upadeuh puithiam pawl, Levi pawl le an hrin ciarih hotu pawl cun a hmaisa Biakinn kha an rak hmu zo. Atu-ah a thar in Biakinn hram lungphum an hmuh tikah napi in an ṭap. Asinain cutawkih a ummi hrek khat pawl cu lungawi in an au ciamco."},"13":{"text":"An au thawm cu a ring tuk ih hlapi tiang a than ruangah zohman in ṭah au asile lungawi au a si ti an thleidang thei lo."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Judah mi le Benjamin mi a rak huatu pawl in Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian ih Biakinn sak cu saltaannak ihsin a ra kirmi pawl in an thok zo ti kha an thei.","title":"Biakinn Sak Lungkim Lo Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Cupawl cu Zerubbabel le an hrin ciarih hotu pawl hnenah an feh ih, “Nan biakinn sak cu kan lo bawm ding. Nan biakmi Pathian cu kannih khal in kan bia ve ih Assiria siangpahrang Esarhaddon in hi ramih um dingah in run kuat vete in a hnenah thawinak kan pek ringring a si,” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Zerubbabel, Joshua le an hrin ciar ih hotu pawl cun, “ Bawipa kan Pathian hrang Biakinn saknak ah nannih bom kan ṭul lo. Persia siangpahrang Sairas ih thupek vek in kanmah tein kan sak ko pei,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah cuih ramih a rung ummi milai pawl cun Biakinn sak lo dingah le an tha nau dingah Judah mi pawl cu an hro ciamco."},"5":{"text":"Cuih hlei ah Biakinn sak cawlter hai seh tiah Persia Acozah bawi pawl kha nawhthuh an pek ih an tumtahmi tuahsuak thei lo ding le an beidong dingin siangpahrang Sairas in ram a uk sung hmuahhmuah le siangpahrang Darias bawi a ṭuan tiangin cubangtuk in thil ṭha lo an tuah a si."},"6":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Xerxes a hung bawi tikah Judah le Jerusalem ih a ummi pawl zuarnak ca cu siangpahrang hnenah an pek."},"7":{"text":"Persia siangpahrang Artakzaksis in ram a uk laiah, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel le an rualpi pawl in siangpahrang hnenah ca an ngan. Cuih ca cu Aramaik ṭong in an ngan ih an rak siar tikah leh a ṭul.","title":"Siangpahrang Hnenih Cakuat Mi"},"8":{"text":"Cule ram uk bawi Rehum le ramsung sungṭuan Shimshai tla in Jerusalem thu cu siangpahrang Artakzaksis hnenah a tanglam vekin ca an ngan:"},"9":{"text":"Ram uk bawi Rehum, ramsung sungṭuan Shimshai le anmah bawmtu pawl, thuṭhentu pawl, le Erek, Babilon le Elam ram Susa khawsungmi a rak si ih atu ah bawi a ṭuantu pawl,"},"10":{"text":"cuih tlunah milian le micak Ashurbanipal in an khua le an ram ihsin a ṭhawn ih Samaria khua le Eufrates Nitlaknak lam Ram ih a umtermi senpi pawl in cuih ca cu an ngan."},"11":{"text":"An cangan mi cu hivek in a si: Eufrates in Nitlaknak lam ih a ummi na sal pawl in siangpahrang Artakzaksis na hnenah ca kan lo kuat."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa, na ramsung hmun dangdang ihsin Judah mi hitawk ah an ra thleng ih Jerusalem khua ah an um ih hi khua ṭha lo le ral thawh hmang khua cu an din sal rero. Khua kulhnak phar tla an dawl sal ih a hram lungphummi tla an rem ih an ṭheh cing ding."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa, hi khua hi an dinsuak ngaingai ih a phar pawl tla an dawl ṭheh ngaingai a si ahcun hitawk ih misenpi pawl cun siah siseh, ngunkhuai siseh, an lo pe nawn lo ding ih na siahkhawlmi a ṭum ding a si."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa, na kuthnuai ummi kan si ih na ram sungih thuhla lo theihter ding cu kan hnaṭuan a si. Siah an pek lo ding le na siahkhawlmi a ṭum ding cu kan duh lo zetmi a si."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah na pupa pawl ih an taanmi an thuhla khummi hminsinnak cabupi sungah rak zoh awla, cuih sungah hi khua hi khua hlanlai ihsin raltho hmang khua a rak sizia le siangpahrang le ram uk bawi pawl harsatnak a petu ringring a si kha na hmu ding. Hi khawsungmi pawl hi uk har minung an rak si ringring. Curuangah sokhaw hi khua an rak siatsuah thluhnak cu!"},"16":{"text":"Hi khua an dinsuah ngaingai ih a phar pawl tla an dawl ṭheh ngaingai ahcun, siangpahrang bawipa, Eufrates Nitlaknak lam Ram cu na uk thei nawn lo ding, ti cu fiangtein kan hmu a si,” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa in hiti in ca a khirh: “Ram uk bawi Rehum, ramsung sungṭuan Shimshai, le Samaria le Eufrates Nitlaknak lam ih a ummi anmah bawmtu pawl, cibai ka lo buk hai a si.","title":"Siangpahrang ih Cakhirh"},"18":{"text":"“Ka hnenih nan cakuat cu ṭong an let ih ka theih ah an siar."},"19":{"text":"Nan sim vekin thu hminsinnak cabu sungah zingzoi dingin thu ka pek ih an zingzoi tikah khua hlanlai ihsin Jerusalem khua cu siangpahrang a rak dodaltu le mi hnaihnok le raltho pawl umnak a rak si ringring, ti cu an hmu ngaingai."},"20":{"text":"Siangpahrang cak zetzet in Jerusalem le Eufrates in Nitlaknak lam Ram cu an rak uk ih siah le ram-nga pawl an rak lak a si."},"21":{"text":"Cuih ruangah thu ka lo than sal hlan lo an khua dinsalnak hnaṭuan cu cawl dingin thu rak pe uh."},"22":{"text":"Daithlang loin zamrang in rak tuah uh; ka uk sungah thil ṭha lo an suahpi pang ding,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Siangpahrang Artakzaksis cakuat cu Rehum, Shimshai le anmah bawmtu pawl hmai ih an siar ṭheh vete in zamrang zetin Jerusalem ah an feh ih hranhram in an hnaṭuan cu an cawlter."},"24":{"text":"A hlan khalah cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in Biakinn sak cu an rak cawlter zo ih Persia siangpahrang Darias bawi a ṭuan kum hnihnak tiang zianghman tuah thei loin an cawl a si."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun profet pahnih Haggai le Iddo ih fapa Zekhariah in Israel Pathian ih thu cu Judah le Jerusalem ih a ummi Judah mi hnenah an phuang vivo.","title":"Biakinn Sak An Thok Sal"},"2":{"text":"An thuphuanmi cu Shealtiel ih fapa Zerubbabel le Jehozadak ih fapa Joshua in an theih tikah Jerusalem Biakinn sak cu an thok sal. Cule cuih profet pahnih in an bawm."},"3":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Eufrates Nitlak lam ram uktu Mangki bawi Tattenai le Shethar Bozenai le an kuthnuai bawi dangdang pawl cu Jerusalem ah an feh ih Biakinn saktu pawl cu, “Hi Biakinn sak dingah le a sung thilri pawl tuah dingah zo in so thu an lo pek?” an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuih Biakinn sak a bawmtu pawl hmuahhmuah ih hmin tla an sut ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Asinain Pathian in Judah hotu pawl cu a zoh a kilkhawi ringring; cule Persia bawi pawl cun siangpahrang Darias hnenah ca an kuat ih a cakhirh an ngah hlan sung cu zianghman khamnak an tuah lo."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang Darias hnenih thu an thanmi cu hiti in a si:"},"7":{"text":"“Siangpahrang Bawipa, na uknak sungah daihnak um hram seh!"},"8":{"text":"“Siangpahrang bawipa na theih dingih kan ruah mi cu: Judah pengah kan feh ih Judah mi pawl in a maksakmi Pathian ih Biakinn cu an sak sal; lungto tumpipi in an sak ih a phar tla ah thing-ah tumpipi an song. Taimak suah le felzetin an sak ih an hnaṭuan cu an hma a sawtzet a si."},"9":{"text":"“Zo ih thupeknak in so hi Biakinn hi nan sak sal ih a sung thilri tla nan tuah ciamco, tiah kan sut."},"10":{"text":"An hotu pawl zo an si, ti na theihnak dingah hi an hnaṭuannak ih hotu pawl hmin tla kan sut."},"11":{"text":"“In lehnak ahcun, ‘Van le leilung ih Pathian ih siahhlawh kan si ih a cakzetmi Israel siangpahrang in Biakinn a rak sak ih a sung thilri pawl tla a rak tuah ṭheh; cuih Biakinn cu kan sak sal a si."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kan pupa pawl in Van ih Pathian cu a thin an hengter ruangah cuih Pathian in Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar a nehter. Biakinn cu a siatsuah ṭheh ih minung pawl cu Babilon ah salah a hruai."},"13":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Sairas in Babilon siangpahrang a si kum khatnak ah hi Biakinn cu sak sal dingin thu a rak pek."},"14":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem Biakinn ihsin a lak ih Babilon biakinn ih a retmi sui le ngun le bungbeel pawl tla cu siangpahrang Sairas in Judah peng uktu dingah a tuahmi Sheshbazzar hnenah a rak pek."},"15":{"text":"Cuih thilri pawl cu Jerusalem Biakinn ah fehpi sal dingah le Biakinn cu a hlanih a rak umnak hmun keelih sak sal dingin amah cu siangpahrang in a rak fial a si."},"16":{"text":"Cule Sheshbazzar cu Judah peng a thleng ih Jerusalem Biakinn saksaal dingin a hram lungphum tla a phum; cuih ihsi thokin atu tiang Biakinn sak hna cu kan ṭuan, asinain kan ṭheh hrih lo,’ in ti."},"17":{"text":"“Curuangah siangpahrang bawipa na lungkim a si ahcun Babilon ah siangpahrang thuhla khummi hminsinnak cabupi sungah rak hawl uhla hi biakinn sak sal dingah siangpahrang Sairas in thu a rak pek ngaingai le pek ngaingai lo rak zohhnik uh; cule hi thu cu in run than sal hram aw,” tiah an ti."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang Darias in Babilon ih siangpahrang thuhminsinnak cabupi sungah cuih thu cu hawl dingin thu a pek.","title":"Sairas Thupekmi An Hmu Sal"},"2":{"text":"Cule Media peng, Ekbatana khua ah cazual pakhat an hmu ih a sungah:"},"3":{"text":"“Siangpahrang a can kum khatnak ah, siangpahrang Sairas in thawinak peknak ah le mei-ur thawi peknak ah Jerusalem ih Biakinn cu saksaal dingin thu a pek. Cuih Biakinn cu pi sawmkua a sang ding ih pi sawmkua a kau ding."},"4":{"text":"A phar pawl cu lungto le thing in an tuah dingih lungto thuah thum ah thing thuah khatión a si ding. Inn saknak ih a cemmi hmuahhmuah cu siangpahrang tangka sungin pek a si ding."},"5":{"text":"Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Babilon ih a retmi sui, ngun le beelkheng pawl cu khirh thluh a si ding ih Jerusalem Biakinn ih an rak retnak hmun ciar ah ret sal a si pei,” tiih nganmi an hmu."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Darias in hiti in ca a khirh: “Eufrates Nitlaknak lam peng uktu Mangki bawi Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai le Eufrates Nitlaknak lam pengih a ummi bawi upa pawl: “Biakinn kiangkapah tla rak um hlah uh;"},"7":{"text":"an hnaṭuan tla rak hnaihnok hlah uh. Judah peng uktu bawi le Judah mi hotu pawl in Pathian Biakinn cu a rak dinnak keel ah sak ko hai seh."},"8":{"text":"An ṭulnak kipah rak bawm sawn uh. Ka thupekmi cu hiti in a si: Cawlbaang loih hna an ṭuan theinak dingah Eufrates Nitlaknak lam ihsin siangpahrang hrangih an pekmi siah sungin inn saknak ih an cemmi hmuahhmuah cu zamrangin anmah nan rak pe pei."},"9":{"text":"Jerusalem ih puithiam pawl in an lo dil tikah an hnenah nitinte pelh loin an ṭulmi pawl-cawcang, tuu a si lole tuu faate pawl Van ih Pathian hnenih mei-ur thawinak an pek dingah sangvut, cite, sabitti le olif hriak pawl tla nan rak pe pei."},"10":{"text":"Van ih Pathian hnenah a cotlak in thawinak an pek ih keimah le ka fapa pawl hrang tla ah thlaza in camsak theinak dingah a tlunih ka thupekmi pawl cu nan rak tuah tengteng pei."},"11":{"text":"Hi ka thupekmi a thlun lotu cu a inn ihsin kaan nan zuuk pei ih nan zum hnuah amah cu nan dawt pei."},"12":{"text":"Jerusalem cu Amah an biaknak hmun si dingih a hriltu Pathian in hi ka thupekmi a eltu le hi Biakinn siatsuah a tumtu siangpahrang le miphun cu siatsuah seh. Keimah Darias in hi thu cu ka pek a si. Ka thupekmi cu kimtein thlun thluh ding a si,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Eufrates Nitlaknak lam ram uktu Mangki bawi Tattenai le Shethar Bozenai le a dang bawi upa pawl in siangpahrang Darias thupekmi vek cun taimak suah in an tuah thluh.","title":"Biakinn Cu Pathian Hnenah An Hlan"},"14":{"text":"Judah mi hotu pawl in Biakinn cu an sak ih profet Haggai le profet Zekhariah thuphuanmi thawngin an hnaṭuan cu a sawtzet. Cule Israel ih Pathian le Persia siangpahrang Sairas, Darias le Artakzaksis pawl ih thupek vekin an ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Darias in siangpahrang a ṭuan kum ruknak Adar thla ni thum ni ah Biakinn cu an sak ṭheh."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Israel mi pawl - puithiam le Levi mi le Babilon saltaannak ihsin a rakirmi hmuahhmuah in - lungawi zetin Biakinn cu Pathian hnenah an hlan."},"17":{"text":"Cuih ni ah Pathian hnenih thawinak hrangah cawcang zakhat, tuucang zahnih le tunote zali an pek; cuih tlunah Israel miphun hleihnih hrang sualthlah thawinakah me hleihnih an pek."},"18":{"text":"Moses cabu sungih tuah ding daan a um vekin Jerusalem Biakinn sungih hnaṭuantu dingah puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl cu a bur a bur in an ṭhen."},"19":{"text":"Babilon saltaannak ihsin a kirmi pawl in thla khatnak thla ni hleili ni ah Lantak Puai an tuah.","title":"Lantak Puai"},"20":{"text":"Puithiam hmuahhmuah le Levi pawl hmuahhmuah in thianfainak an tuah ih an thiangfai ṭheh. Levi mi pawl in saltaannak ihsin a ra kirmi pawl hrang le puithiam pawl le anmah ih hrangah Lantak Puai hrang thawinak rannung pawl an that."},"21":{"text":"Thawinak ih an pekmi sa cu a rakirmi Israel mi hmuahhmuah le Judah ram sungih a ummi khuavang betu pawl ih biaknak a dungtun tu pawl le Bawipa Israel ih Pathian bia dingih a rami pawl in an ei."},"22":{"text":"Ni sarih sung, Thilnu tello Sang Puai cu lungawi aipuang tein an tuah. Bawipa in Assiria siangpahrang cu Judah mi parah thinlung ṭha a neihter ih Israel Pathian ih Biakinn sak sal hnaṭuannak ah tampi a bom hai ruangah a hlei in an lung a awi cuang."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum a hung rei ih Artakzaksis cu Persia siangpahrang a si tikah, Ezra an timi pa a um. Ezra ih pupa pawl cu Puithiam Sang Aaron ih cithlah an si. Ezra cu Seraiah fapa a si, Seraiah cu Azariah fapa a si, Azariah cu Hilkiah fapa a si;","title":"Jerusalem Ah Ezra A Thleng"},"2":{"text":"Hilkiah cu Shallum fapa a si, Shallum cu Zadok fa a si, Zadok cu Ahitub fapa a si;"},"3":{"text":"Ahitub cu Amariah fapa a si, Amariah cu Azariah fapa si, Azariah cu Meraioth fapa a si;"},"4":{"text":"Meraioth cu Zerahiah fapa a si, Zerahiah cu Uzzi fapa a si, Uzzi cu Bukki fapa a si;"},"5":{"text":"Bukki cu Abishua fapa a si, Abishua cu Finehas fapa a si, Finehas cu Eleazar fapa a si, Eleazar cu Aaron fapa a si."},"6":{"text":"Ezra cu Daan thiamzet a si ih Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in Moses hnenah a pekmi Daan thu cu a thei ngaingai. Ezra cu Bawipa in thlawsuah a pek ruangah a dilmi hmuahhmuah cu siangpahrang in a pek."},"7":{"text":"Artakzaksis siangpahrang a ṭuan kum sarihnak kum ah Ezra cu Babilon ihsin Jerusalem ah Israel mi le puithiam pawl Levi mi pawl, Biakinn hla saktu pawl, Biakinn kotka kiltu pawl le hnaṭuantu pawl thawn an feh."},"8":{"text":"Thla khat thla, ni khat ni ah Babilon ihsin an suak ih Pathian bomnak thawngin Jerusalem cu thla nga thla, ni khat ni ah an thleng.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Ezra in a tikcu hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih pekmi Daan zirnak ah le thlunnak ah siseh, cuih daan le thupekmi pawl cu Israel mi pawl zirhsinnak ah siseh, a hmang."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang Artakzaksis in a tanglam ih cangan mi cu Bawipa in Israel mi hnenih a pekmi daan le thupekmi pawl a thei zettu, puithiam le cathiam zetmi Ezra hnenah a pek:","title":"Artakzaksis In Canganmi Ezra A Pek"},"12":{"text":"“Siangpahrang Artakzaksis hnen in van ih Pathian ih Daan thu a thei zettu puithiam Ezra hnenah,"},"13":{"text":"Ka uk sung khuazakip ih um Israel mi, puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl, Jerusalem ih kir a duhmi hmuahhmuah cu na hnenah an kir thei ding, tiah thu ka pe a si."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang keimah le ruahnak i petu ka minung pasarih in, na ṭuanvo ih retmi Pathian ih pekmi Daan cu Judah le Jerusalem ah ziang bangtuk in an thlun, ti vung zoh dingah kan lo thlah a si."},"15":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian, Jerusalem khua Biakinn a neitu hnenah, keimah le ruahnak i petu ka minung pasarih in pek kan duhmi sui le ngun na keng pei."},"16":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Israel mi le an puithiam pawl in Jerusalem ih ummi Pathian Biakinn hrangih an pekmi pawl le Babilon peng sung ihsin na khawm ciami sui le ngun pawl khal na keng pei."},"17":{"text":"“Hi tangka pawl cu cawcang, tuucang, tunote, sangphut le sabitti pawl leinak ah fel zetin na hmang pei ih cupawl cu Jerusalem Biakinn ah thawinak - thlairawl thawinak le inmi thawinak ah na pek pei."},"18":{"text":"A taanglai mi sui le ngun a um hrih asile nangmah le na ramsungmi pawl ih a mawi nan tinak ah le nan Pathian ih duhnak bangtuk in nan hmang thei ding."},"19":{"text":"Biakinn sung hnaṭuannak le Pathian biaknak ih hman dingah an lo pekmi bungbeel pawl hmuahhmuah cu Jerusalem khua, Pathian hrangah na pe thluh pei."},"20":{"text":"Biakinn hrangah na ṭulmi dangdang a um hrih asile siangpahrang tangka sungin na hmang thei ding."},"21":{"text":"“Siangpahrang Artakzaksis keimah in, puithiam le Van ih Pathian ih Daan thu a thiamzet mi Ezra ih a dilmi hmuahhmuah cu zamrangte ih pek dingah, Eufrates Nitlaknak lam peng sungih a ummi tangka kiltu pawl hmuahhmuah cu thu ka pe zo."},"22":{"text":"A dilmi hmuahhmuah cu-ngun talent zakhat tiang, sangvut haan zaruk sawmnga tiang, sabitti pung za le sawmnga tiang, olif hriak pung za le sawmnga tiang, cite cu a ṭul zat, nan pek thei ding, ka ti."},"23":{"text":"Van ih Pathian in a biakinn hrangih a haimi hmuahhmuah cu pe thluh dingin taimak zetin ṭuan awla Pathian cu ka parah le ka hnu ih ram a uktu parah ziangtik hmanih a thinheng lo dingin fimkhur zetin tuah aw."},"24":{"text":"Puithiam pawl, Levi mi pawl, hla satu pawl, kotka kiltu pawl, hnaṭuantu pawl le hi Biakinn thawn a pehtlai awmi hmuahhmuah hnen ihsin siah siseh, ngunkhuai le a dang khawlmi khal siseh, lak theinak thu hrimhrim nan nei lo a si."},"25":{"text":"“Ezra nangmah in, na Pathian ih a lo pekmi fimnak cu hmangin Eufrates Nitlaknak lam pengah Bawipa ih pekmi Daan vekin a nungmi pawl uktu dingah ram uktu bawi le thuṭhentu pawl na ret pei. A thei hrih lo pawl hmuahhmuah hnenah hi daan cu na zirh pei."},"26":{"text":"Zokhal in na Pathian ih daan, a si lole ramsung daan cu a thlun lo a si ahcun thah in maw, dawihlo in maw, a thilri hmuahhmuah long ṭheh in maw, thawngthlak in maw, hmakhatte-ih hrem a tuar ding a si,” a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cutikah Ezra in, “Kan pupa ih Pathian, Bawipa cu thangṭhat in umseh! Amah in hna a ṭuan ih hi bangtuk in Jerusalem ih a ummi Bawipa ih Biakinn parah siangpahrang in upatnak a neih hi!","title":"Ezra In Pathian A Thangṭhat"},"28":{"text":"Pathian ih zaangfahnak in siangpahrang le a ruahnak petu pawl le thuneizettu a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih mithmai ṭha ka tong zo a si. Bawipa ka Pathian in ralṭhatnak i pek ih Israel hrin sungih sungkhat lubik ciar tampi cu keimah thawn kir dingin ka leem thei a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Artakzaksis siangpahrang a si laiah Babilon ram sal taannak ihsin Ezra thawn Jerusalem ih a kirmi pawl, an hrin ih lubik ciar cazin cu a tanglam vekin a si:","title":"Saltaannak Ihsin A Kirmi Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Finehas hrin in Gershom, Ithamar hrin in Daniel, David hrin in Shekaniah ih fapa Hattush, Parosh hrin in Zekhariah le a hrinpi minung za le sawmnga thawn, (an suahnak hminsinnak cazin a um ciar.) Pahath Moab hrin in Zerahiah fapa Eliehoenai, minung zahnih thawn; Zattu hrin in Jahaziel fapa Shekaniah, minung zathum thawn; Adin hrin in Jonathan fapa Ebed, minung sawmnga thawn; Elam hrin in Athaliah fapa Jeshaiah, minung sawm sarih thawn; Shefatiah hrin in Mikhael fapa Zebadiah, minung sawmriat thawn; Joab hrin in Jehiel fapa Obadiah, minung zahnih le hleiriat thawn; Bani hrin in Josifiah fapa Shelomith, minung za le sawmruk thawn; Bebai hrin in Bebai fapa Zekhariah, minung kul hluanriat thawn; Azgad hrin in Hakkatan fapa Johanan, minung za le pahra thawn; Adonikam hrin in Elifelet, Jeuel le Shemaiah, minung sawmruk thawn; (Neh hnu deuh ah a kirmi an si.) Bigvai hrin in Uthai le Zakkur, minung sawmsarih thawn, Jerusalem ah an kir.","merge":"3"},"15":{"text":"Ahava khua ih a luangmi tiva kapah misenpi pawl cu ka kokhawm ih cutawkah ni thum sung kan caam. Misenpi lakah puithiam an um naón Levi mi pakhat hman an um lo.","title":"Ezra In Levi Mi a Hawl"},"16":{"text":"Curuangah hotu pakua: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekhariah le Meshullam le zirhtu Saya pahnih: Joiarib le Elnathan ka ko ih,"},"17":{"text":"Kasifia khua ih lubik a si mi Iddo hnenah, amah le a bawmtu pawl le biakinn saktu pawl va tong dingah le Biakinn sungih Pathian hnaṭuantu minung rak kuat dingah a tlunih upa pawl ka thlah."},"18":{"text":"Pathian zaangfahnak in, Mahli hrin Levi mi, thil tithei zetmi Sherebiah in rak kuat ih a fapa le a unau sungin minung hleiriat thawn an ra."},"19":{"text":"Cule Merari hrin Hashabiah le Jeshaiah tla an sungkhat minung kul thawn in rak kuat."},"20":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Levi mi pawl bawmtu dingah siangpahrang David in an pupa pawl hnaṭuan a rak pekmi Biakinn hnaṭuantu minung zahnih le kul tla an tel. An zatein cazin sungah an hmin khum an si ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Cuih Ahava Tiva kiang ahcun kan zate in Pathian hmaiah rawl ul dingah le kan lung neemter dingah ka forhfial ih kan lamzin ah kanmah le kan faate pawl le kan thilri neih mi pawl in hum dingah Pathian hnenah kan dil.","title":"Thla An Cam, Rawl An Ul"},"22":{"text":"Kan fehnak lamzin ah ral pawl kutin in kiltu dingah siangpahrang hnen ihsin rang ralkap pawl dil dingah ka ning a zak fawn, ziangahtile kan Pathian cun amah a rinsantu cu a thlawsuah ih amah a dungtuntu parah cun a lung a awi lo a si, tiah siangpahrang hnenah ka rak sim zo."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah rawl kan ul ih in humhim dingah Pathian hnenah thla kan cam; cule kan thlacamnak cu in theihsak a si."},"24":{"text":"Cun puithiam upa pawl sung ihsin Sherebiah le Hashabiah le a dang pahra ka hril.","title":"Biakinn Hrang Laksawng"},"25":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang bawipa ruahnak petu pawl, a kuthnuai bawi dangdang pawl le Israel mi pawl in Biakinn ih hman dingah an pekmi sui le ngun le bungbeel pawl cu cuai ka thlai ih puithiam pawl hnenah cun ka pek."},"26":{"text":"Ka pekmi pawl cu a tanglam pawl hi an si: Ngun cuai thawng hleiruk zahnih le sawmnga; Ngun beelkheng zakhat, ngun cuai sawmnga man; Sui cuai thawnghnih le zanga; Suikheng kuum kul, sui cuai li man; Darkheng ṭhazet pahnih, suikheng tluk in a man a khungmi an si.","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"An hnenah cun, “Nannih cu nan pupa ih Pathian Bawipa ih hnenah mi thianghlim nan si ih a hnenah lungtho teih an pekmi sui le ngun bungbeel pawl tla hi a thianghlimmi an si."},"29":{"text":"Biakinn nan thlenpi hlan lo ralring zetin kil uh. Cutawkah puithiam pawl ih khaan ah cuai thlai uhla Jerusalem khua ih um Israel mi hotu upa pawl, puithiam upa pawl le Levi mi upa pawl hnenah pe uh,” ka ti."},"30":{"text":"Cuticun sui le ngun le bungbeel pawl cu Jerusalem Biakinn ih ret dingah puithiam pawl le Levi pawl in an lak."},"31":{"text":"Jerusalem cu thlakhat thla, ni hleihnih ni ah feh dingah Ahava tiva in kan pok. Kan lamzin tluanah Bawipa cu kan hnenah a um ih ral siimnak le damiah bawhthupnak tong lotein in hum a si.","title":"Jerusalem Ah An Kir"},"32":{"text":"Jerusalem kan thlen tikah ni thum sung kan cawl."},"33":{"text":"Cule ni linak ah Biakinn ah kan feh ih sui le ngun le bungbeel pawl cu cuai kan thlai hnuah Uriah fapa puithiam Meremoth hnenah kan pek. Meremoth thawn cutawkah Finehas fapa Eleazar le Levi mi pahnih, Jeshua fapa Jozabad le Binnui fapa Noadiah khal an um."},"34":{"text":"A zatein cuai an thlai ih an siar ṭheh in kimtein cazin sungah an khum."},"35":{"text":"Cun Babilon saltaannak ihsin a rakir mi hmuahhmuah in Israel Pathian hnenah mei-ur thawinak an pek. An pekmi pawl cu Israel mi zate hrangah cawcang hleihnih, tuucang sawmkua le paruk, tunote sawmsarih le pasarih, le sualthlah thawinak hrangah mecang hleihnih an si. Hi rannung pawl cu mei-ur thawinak in Bawipa ih hnenah an pek."},"36":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa ih canganmi an kenmi tla cu Eufrates Nitlaknak lam pengih ram uktu mangki bawi le bawi dang pawl hnenah an pek ih annih khal in misenpi hnenah le Biakinn sung Pathian biaknak hrangah bomnak an pek."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih thil pawl an tuah ṭheh hnuah, Israel hotu upa hrekkhat pawl ka hnenah an ra ih, “Miseenpi siseh, puithiam le Levi mi pawl siseh, hlimphir in an um lo; kan kiangkap ramih a ummi Kanaan mi, Ammon mi, Moab mi le Izipt mi pawl thawn an um tlang ih Hit mi, Periz mi, Jebus mi le Amor mi pawl thawn an cokrawi-aw ṭheh a si. Hi miphun pawl ih an tuahmi ningsinza thil a si mi pawl tla an tuah ve.","title":"Miphun Dang Nupi Neih Thu Ezra In A Thei"},"2":{"text":"Judah mipa pawl in miphun dang nunau an ṭhi ih Pathian miphun thianghlim cu cokrawimi le miphun borhhlawh ah a cang zo. A luar bik cu hotu le bawi pawl an si,” tiah in ti."},"3":{"text":"Cuih thu ka theih tikah ninghang riahsia in ka hnipuan ka thlek, ka sam le ka khahmul ka bot ih thinpit beidong in ka to."},"4":{"text":"Zanlam thawinak pek tikcu tiang riahsia in ka to ih mi hrekkhat cu ka kiangah an ra. Saltaannak ihsin a ra kirmi pawl sualnak thu Israel ih Pathian in a phuan ruang ih thinphang mi pawl an ra."},"5":{"text":"Zanlam thawinak pek tikcu a kim tikah ninghangih ka tonak ihsin ka tho ih, ka hnipuan tlekpi thawn baan phar le khukbil in Bawipa ka Pathian hnenah cun thla ka cam."},"6":{"text":"“Maw Pathian, ka ning a zak tuk ih na hmai ka zoh ngam lo. Kan sualnak hi kan lu hnakin a sang sawn ih van a hun dai."},"7":{"text":"Kan pupa ih san in atu tiang kannih na minung pawl hi kan sual ngaingai. Cutiih kan sual ruangah kanmah le kan siangpahrang pawl le kan puithiam pawl tiangin ramdang siangpahrang pawl ih kutsung kan thleng. An duhduh in in that, kan thilri in long, thawng ah in thlak ih tuihsun tiangin ningzak hmaisia in in tuah."},"8":{"text":"Atu-ah tikcu tawite sung, Bawipa kan Pathian, nangmah in in zaangfah ih mi hrekkhat pawl cu nungdam in in luatter ih hi hmun thianghlim ahhin himdam in kan um. Saltaannak ihsin in runsuak ih nunnak thar in pe."},"9":{"text":"Sal kan si naón saltaannak ah in taanta lo. Persia siangpahrang pawl cu kan parah an mithmai na ṭhatter ih Judah le Jerusalem ah himdamte ih um sal dingah le a siat thluh zomi na Biakinn sak sal dingah in thlah."},"10":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla atu-ah, maw kan Pathian, hi bangtuk ih thuhla a um hnuah ziangso kan sim ngam nawn ding? Na siahhlawh profet pawl hnen ihsin,"},"11":{"text":"in pekmi thukham hmuahhmuah cu kan siatbal thluh. Na profet pawl in kan luah dingmi ram cu ram sung minung pawl in an baalter ih ram pumpuluk ah ningsinza thil le thil ṭha lo in an khahter ruangah ram thianglo a si, tiah in sim."},"12":{"text":"Cuih tlunah hi kan luah dingmi ram cu ramnuam si dingah kan duh ih kan tesinfa pawl hnenih roh dingah kan duh ngaingai a si ahcun hi ramih a rak um ciami pawl thawn ṭhitpolh awknak tuah hrimhrim lo dingah le an hlawhtling dingih bawm hrimhrim lo dingah in tiam fawn."},"13":{"text":"Kan sual ruang le kan ṭhat lo ruangih hitluk hremnak kan tuar hnuah hin, maw kan Pathian, nang cun kan tuar dingmi hnakih deem deuh in in hrem ih atu bangtuk in nungdam in in umter, ti kan thei."},"14":{"text":"Cubangtuk hnuah hin ziangtinso hi mi ṭha lo pawl thawn ṭhitpolh awknak tuah tahratin na Thukham pawl cu kan dungtun thei nawn ding? Cutiih kan tuah ahcun na thin kan lo hengter tuk ding ih pakhat hman luat loin kan ci in hmit thluh thlang lo ding maw?"},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, nang cu na dingfel ih atu khalah in luatter mi, a taangsun kan si. Na mithmuh ah kan sualnak thawn kan um; na hmaiah a ra ngam ding khal kan si lo,” tiah ka ti."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ezra cu ṭap phah le sual phuangin Biakinn hmai ih thla a cam rero laiah, Israel miburpi cu a hnenah mipa, nunau le nauhak tiangin an ra ih napi in an ṭap.","title":"An Ṭhitpolh Awknak An Siat"},"2":{"text":"Cule Elam hrin, Jehiel ih fapa Shekaniah in Ezra hnenah, “Miphun dang nunau kan ṭhi ih Pathian hmaiah zum tlak in kan um nawn lo. Sikhalsehla Israel hrangah ruahsannak a um lai."},"3":{"text":"Atu ihsin hi nunau pawl le an faate pawl cu dawi dingin Pathian hnenah thu kan kam pei. Nangmah le Pathian thupekmi a upattu pawl ih sim vekin kan tuah ding. Pathian ih in pekmi Daan vekin kan thlun ding."},"4":{"text":"Tho awla thok aw; himi cu nangmah ih ṭuanvo a si, kan lo bawm ding. Ralṭha zetin tuah aw,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Ezra in Shekaniah ih simmi vekin tuah thluh dingah puithiam upa pawl, Levi mi pawl le senpi pawl cu siatcam in thu a kamter."},"6":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Biakinn hmaiah cun a feh ih Eliashib ih fapa Jehohanan umnak inn ah cuih zan cu a riak. Saltaannak in a kirmi pawl ih sualnak thu ruatin riahsia ninghang in a um ih zianghman a ei a in lo."},"7":{"text":"Cule saltaannak in a kirmi pawl hmuahhmuah Jerusalem ih rakhawm ṭheh dingin Jerusalem le Judah ramsung khuazakip ah thu an than."},"8":{"text":"Cumi cu uktu pawl le misenpi hotu pawl ih thupek vekih an than mi a si. Zokhal sisehla ni thum sungih a ra suak lomi cu a thilri hmuahhmuah lon ṭheh a si dingih a ra kirmi pawl sungah telh a si nawn lo pei, an ti."},"9":{"text":"Nithum sung, thla kua thla, ni kul ni ah Judah le Benjamin ram sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah cu Jerusalem ah an ra ih Biakinn tualah an khawm aw. Nasa zetin ruah a sur. Cutiih ni khua a siat ruangah le an tonkhawmnak a thupit ruangah mi hmuahhmuah an khur ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah puithiam Ezra cu a tho ih an hnenah, “Miphun dang nunau nupi ah nan ṭhi ih Israel sualnak cu nan luarter sinsin."},"11":{"text":"Atu-ah nan pupa ih Pathian, Bawipa hnenah nan sualnak cu phuang uhla Amai’ lungawinak tuah uh. Kan ram sungih um miphun dang pawl thawn rawi loin hlimphir in um uhla miphun dang nan nupi pawl cu dawi thluh uh,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Senpi pawl cu an au ih, “Na simmi hmuahhmuah kan tuah ding."},"13":{"text":"Asinain minung kan tam tuk; ruah le napi in a sur fawn. Khawlengah hiti cun kan ding thei cawk lo ding. Hi sualnak ahhin zozo khal kan tel thluh ruangah ni khat ni hnih sungih ṭheh theih dingmi a si lo."},"14":{"text":"Kan hotu upa pawl in kan zate ai-ah hi thu cu tawlrel hai seh. Kan khua ciar in miphun dang nupi a neitu hmuahhmuah cu an tinmi tikcu ah an khua sungih hotu le thuṭhentu pawl thawn ra suak hai seh. Cuticun hi sualnak ruangah kan parih Pathian thinhengnak cu a dem ding,” an ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutiih an timi a eltu cu Asahel fapa Jonathan le Tikvah ih fapa Jahzeiah lawng an si; annih pahnih hnenah Meshullam le Levi mi Shabbethai tla an ṭang ve."},"16":{"text":"Saltaannak ihsin a kirmi pawl an lung a kim ruangah puithiam Ezra in an hrin ciarih hotu pawl sungin mi a hril ih an hmin an ngan ṭheh. Cule an hnaṭuan cu thla hra thla, ni khat ni in an thok ih,"},"17":{"text":"thla thum sungah miphun dang nupi a neitu pawl ih thu cu an zingzoi ṭheh a si."},"18":{"text":"Miphun dang nupi neitu pawl cu a tanglam vekin an si. Puithiam pawl an hrin ciar in: Jehozadak fapa Joshua hrin le a unau pawl: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib le Gedaliah.","title":"Miphun Dang Nupi Neitu Pawl"},"19":{"text":"An nupi pawl dawi dingah thu an kam-aw ih sualthlah thawinak hrangah tuucang pakhat an pe."},"20":{"text":"Immer hrin in: Hanani le Zebadiah."},"21":{"text":"Harim hrin in: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel le Uzziah."},"22":{"text":"Pashur hrin in: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad le Elasah."},"23":{"text":"Levi mi pawl sungin: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (Kelita ti tla in an ko) Pethahiah, Judah le Eliezer."},"24":{"text":"Hla saktu pawl sung ihsin Eliashib. Biakinn kiltu pawl ihsin Shallum, Telem le Uri."},"25":{"text":"Mi dangdang: Parosh hrin in: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkhijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkhijah le Benaiah."},"26":{"text":"Elam hrin in: Mattaniah, Zekhariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth le Elijah."},"27":{"text":"Zattu hrin in: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad le Aziza."},"28":{"text":"Bebai hrin in: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai le Athlai."},"29":{"text":"Bani hrin in: Meshullam, Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, le Jeremoth."},"30":{"text":"Pahath Moab hrin in: Adna, Khelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui le Manasseh."},"31":{"text":"Harim hrin in: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malkhijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, Benjamin, Malluk le Shemariah.","merge":"32"},"33":{"text":"Hashum hrin in: Mattenai, Mattatiah, Zabad, Elifelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, le Shimei."},"34":{"text":"Bani hrin in: Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaiah, Bedeiah, Kheluhi, Vani ah, Meremoth, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Mattenai le Jaasu.","merge":"35"},"38":{"text":"Binnui hrin in: Shimei, Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah, Maknadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah, Shallum, Amariah le Josef.","merge":"39"},"43":{"text":"Nebo hrin in: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, le Benaiah."},"44":{"text":"Hi pawl cu miphun dang nupi neitu an si. An nupi pawl an ṭhen ih an faate pawl thawn an dawi hai a si."}}}}},"16":{"info":{"name":"Nehemiah","shortname":"Neh.","abbr":[],"desc":"Nehemiah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hakaliah ih fapa Nehemiah ih ṭuansuahmi thuanthu cu hiti in a si. Artakzaksis siangpahrang a ṭuan kum kulnak, Kislev thla ah keimah Nehemiah cu Susa khawpi ah ka um."},"2":{"text":"Culai ah ka unau pakhat Hanani cu a rualpi dang pawl thawn Judah ram ihsin an ra thleng; cule Babilon ram saltaannak ihsin Jerusalem ih a kirmi Judah mi pawl thuhla ka sut."},"3":{"text":"Cutiih ka suh tikah, saltaannak in a suak ih an khua le an ram a thlengmi pawl cu harsatnak tampi an tong ih an kiangkap ih ummi miphun dang pawl in an hmuhsuam hai a si tiah in sim. Cuih tlunah Jerusalem kulhnak phar pawl cu an cim thluh ih, an ur thluh hnu in kotka pawl tla cu an tuah sal hrih lo a si, ti tla in sim."},"4":{"text":"Cuih thu ka theih tikah ka to ih ka ṭap. Ni tampi sung riahsia in ka um ih zianghman ei loin rawl ka ul. Pathian hnenah thla ka cam ih,"},"5":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa, Van ih Pathian, nang cu na maksak ih kan lo ṭihzah ngaingai. Nang cu rintlak na si ih a lo duhdawtu le na thupekmi a thluntu pawl parah cun na thukam cu na kimter ringring."},"6":{"text":"Maw ka Bawipa, na mit in i run zoh awla Israel mi na siahhlawh pawl hrangah sunzan ih thla ka camnak hi na hna in i run theihsak hram aw. Na parah Israel mi pawl cu kan sual ngaingai zo ih cuih kan sualnak cu ka phuang a si. Ka pupa pawl an rak sual ih keimah tla ka sual a si."},"7":{"text":"Ṭha lozet le mawi lozetin na hmaiah kan nung a si. Na thupekmi kan tuah lo; na siahhlawh Moses hnen ihsin in pek mi daan pawl cu kan thlun lo."},"8":{"text":"Asinain Moses hnenah, ‘Nannih Israel mi pawl zumtlak lo nan si ahcun ram dang le miphun dang lakah ka lo ṭhekdarh thluh ding."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka hnenah nan kirsal ih ka thupekmi nan thlun a si ahcun, vanrang deng tiang ṭhekdarh thluhmi sikhal uhla, keimah in biaknak dingah ka hril zomi hmun ahcun ka lo kirter sal ding a si,’ tiih na rak timi kha cingkeng hram aw."},"10":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa, hi milai pawl hi na siahhlawh an si, nangmah ih minung an si. Na baan thacak le na huham in na runsuak mi an si.","title":"Jerusalem Hrangah Thla A Cam"},"11":{"text":"Kei ka thlacamnak le na hmin upat a lo duhtu na siahhlawh dang pawl ih thlacamnak hi run ngai hram aw. Tuihsun ahhin i hlawhtlingter hram awla Siangpahrang Bawipa cu ka parah zaangfahnak neiter hram aw,” ka ti. Culai ahcun keimah cu siangpahrang bawipa ih sabitti petu ka si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Artakzaksis in siangpahrang a ṭuan kum kulnak, Nisan thla ah, voikhat cu siangpahrang bawipa rawl a ei laiah sabitti cu ka pe. Hi hlan ahcun mithmaisia ih ka um i hmu dah lo.","title":"Nehemiah Jerusalem Ah A Feh"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah, “Ziangah so na riah a siat? Na dam lo a si lo ahcun na lung a dam lo a si hi!” tiah i ti. Cutikah ka thin a phangzet ih,"},"3":{"text":"“Maw Siangpahrang bawipa, na nunkhua sau hram seh. Ka pupa pawl an phumawknak khawpi siatbal thluh in le a kotka pawl ur ciam thluh ih a um laiah hin ziangtinso riahsia lo cun ka um thei ding?” tiah ka ti."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa cun, “Ziang tuah so na duh?” tiah i sut. Cutikah Van ih Pathian hnenah thla ka cam hnuah,"},"5":{"text":"siangpahrang hnenah cun, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, ka parah na lung a awi ih ka lo dilmi i pe ding a si ahcun Judah ram, ka pupa pawl an rak phumawknak khawpi ah i thlah hram aw; cuih khawpi dinsal ka duh a si,” tiah ka ti."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawinu cu a kiangah a to ih siangpahrang bawipa cun, “Ziang can so na rei ding? Ziangtikah so na rakir sal thei ding?” tiah i sut. Ka rei ding can cu ka sim ih thlah dingah a lung a kim."},"7":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang hnenah cun, “Bawipa, na lung a kim a si ahcun Judah ram tiang ka feh suak theinak dingah Eufrates Nitlaknak lam pengih ram uktu Mangki bawi pawl hnenah ca i ngan sak hram aw. Judah ram ka thlen hlan lo anmah in tluang tein in fehter ding."},"8":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang ih tupi thing pawl kiltu Asaf hnen ihsin Biakinn hauhruang kotka hrang, khawpi kulhnak phar hrang le ka umnak inn hrangah zanthing i pek theinak dingin a hnenah ca i ngan sak hram aw,” tiah ka dil. Mi zaangfahnak neitu Pathian kut cu ka hnenih a um ruangah, ka dilmi hmuahhmuah cu siangpahrang bawipa in i pek ṭheh a si."},"9":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa in keimah thlahtu ah ralbawi hrekkhat pawl le rang ralkap pawl a fial ih Eufrates Nitlaknak ram lam ahcun ka feh. Ka thlen tikah cuih peng uktu Mangki bawi pawl hnenah siangpahrang bawipa ih ca cu ka pek."},"10":{"text":"Asinain Beth Horon khuami Sanballat le Ammon mi bawi pakhat Tobiah in, Israel mi pawl ṭhatnak le thawvennak ngaihtuah dingah mi pakhat a ra, ti an theih cun thin nuam lo zetin an um."},"11":{"text":"Cun Jerusalem khawpi ah ka va thleng ih ni thum sung ka cawl."},"12":{"text":"Jerusalem hrang hnaṭuan dingah Pathian in ka thinlung sungih i simmi cu zohman ka sim lo. Cule zanah ka tho ih ka rualpi mi malte thawn kan feh. Zianghman kan keng lo; ka tomi rang pakhat lawng kan keng."},"13":{"text":"Nitlaknak lam Phairawn Kotka in ka suak ih thlanglam ah suk in Rulhreng Cerhti ka lan ih Hnawm Kotka ka thlen ah zan a si lai. Ka feh phah ah khawpi kulhnak phar pawl a siatmi pawl le mei ih an ur thluhmi kotka pawl cu ka zoh phah vivo."},"14":{"text":"Cun ka so ih Cerhti Kotka le Siangpahrang Tili ka thleng. Ka tomi rang cun a cimmi lung le thing lakah lamzin a hmu thei lo."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Kidron phairawn sungah ka ṭum ih rang par in phar pawl cu ka zoh phah vivo. Ka pawhnak hmun ka thleng sal ih Phairawn Kotka cun khawpi sungah ka lut sal."},"16":{"text":"Bawi pawl pakhat hmanin khuitawk ka feh ti le ziang ka tuah, ti an thei lo. Judah mi pawl, puithiam pawl, an hotu pawl, an bawi pawl le hnaṭuannak ih a teltu ding pawl pakhat hnen hmanah zianghman ka ṭong hrih lo."},"17":{"text":"Atu lawngah an hnenah hiti in ka sim: “Jerusalem khua cu a siat thluh ih kotka pawl tla ur thluh a si ruangah ziangtluk vansaannak sungah so kan um, ti cu nan hmu. Khawpi kulhnak phardawl cu dinsal uhsila kan thangsiatnak hi rehter uhsi,” tiah ka ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule Pathian ka hnenih a umzia le i bomnak pawl ka sim ih siangpahrang bawipa ih ṭongmi pawl tla ka sim ṭheh. Cutikah, “Tho uhsila dinsal uhsi,” an ti. An tim an tuah ih hnaṭuan cu an thok lohli."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Sanballat, Tobiah le Arabia mipa Geshem an timi in kan thil tuah tummi cu an theih tikah in hnihsan ih, “Ziang kan tuah, tiah so nan ruah? Siangpahrang kan dodal ding nan ti maw si?” ti tiangin in hmuhsuam."},"20":{"text":"Cule kei in, “Van ih Pathian in hlawhtlinnak in pe ko ding. Kannih cu a siahhlawh kan si ih a siatmi saksaal ding cu kan ṭuan ko ding. Asinain nannih cu Jerusalem ahhin covo nan nei lo; thu nan nei lo ih ham ding zianghman nan nei lo,” ka ti hai."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khawpi kulhnak Phar cu hiti in an dawl sal. Puithiam Sang Eliashib le a unau puithiam pawl in Tuu Kotka timi an rem; an thiangter ih kotka pawl tla an tuah. Phar cu Zakhat donhleisang timi le Hananel donhleisang timi tiang an rem.","title":"Khawpi Kulhnak Phar An Dawl Sal"},"2":{"text":"A sangtu phar cu Jerikho khuami pawl in an rem. A sangtu cu Imri ih fapa Zakkur in a rem."},"3":{"text":"Hassenaah hrin in Nga Kotka an tuah. A tlang an ran ih kotka pawl cu an tuah; kotka kharnak ah a hren le a kalh pawl tla an tuah."},"4":{"text":"A sangtu cu Uriah ih fapa, Hakkoz ih tupa, Meremoth in a rem. Berekhiah ih fapa, Meshezabel ih tupa, Meshullam in a sangtu cu a rem. Baana ih fapa Zadok in a sangtu cu a rem."},"5":{"text":"Tekoa khuami pawl in a sangtu cu an rem. (Asinain khawsung upa pawl cun hnaṭuan hotu pawl ih hnaṭuan fialmi ṭuan cu an nautat ih an el.)"},"6":{"text":"Paseah ih fapa Joiada le Besodeiah ih fapa Meshullam in Jeshanah Kotka an tuah. A tlang an tuah ih kotka pawl an rem hnuah kotka kharnak ah a hren le a kalh pawl an tuah."},"7":{"text":"Gibeon mi Melatiah, Meronoth mi Jadon le Gibeon khawsungmi le Mizpah khawsungmi pawl in a sangtu phar cu an dawl ih Eufrates Nitlaknak peng uktu Mangki bawipa ih inn tiang an vun rem."},"8":{"text":"A sangtu cu suisertu Harhaiah ih fapa Uzziel in a rem. A sangtu cu rimhmui tuahtu Hananiah in Phar Kaupi tiang a rem."},"9":{"text":"Hur ih fapa Refaiah, Jerusalem peng a hrek uktu pa in a sangtu phar cu a rem."},"10":{"text":"Harumaf ih fapa Jedaiah in a sangtu phar, a inn kiangte, cu a rem. Hashabneiah ih fapa Hattush in a sangtu a rem."},"11":{"text":"Harim ih fapa Malkhijah le Pahath Moab ih fapa Hasshub in a sangtu phar le Lungthu donhleisang timi an rem."},"12":{"text":"Hallohesh ih fapa Shallum, Jerusalem peng a hrek uktu bawi in a sangtu a rem. (A fanu pawl in an bawm.)"},"13":{"text":"Hanun le Zanoah khawsung ummi pawl in Phairawn Kotka an rem. Kotka pawl an tuah sal ih a kharnak ah a hren le a kalh pawl an tuah; phar cu pi thawngkhat le zanga sung Hnawm Kotka tiang an rem."},"14":{"text":"Rekhab fapa Malkhijah, Beth Hakkherem peng uktu in Hnawm Kotka cu a rem. Kotka pawl cu a rem ih a kharnak ah a hren le a kalh pawl a tuah."},"15":{"text":"Kolhozeh ih fapa Shallum, Mizpah peng uktu in Cerhti Kotka a rem. A tlun a khuh ih kotka pawl a tuah ṭheh hnuah a hren le a kalh pawl tla a tuah. Siangpahrang hmuan a hun sangtu Shelah Tikhur phar cu a rem ih David Khawpi ih vungṭumnak kailawn thlengin a tuah."},"16":{"text":"Azbuk ih fapa Nehemiah, Beth Zur peng a hrek uktu in a sangtu phar cu a rem ih David thlaan, tikhur le ralkap pawl umnak inn tiang a tuah."},"17":{"text":"A tanglam Levi pawl in phar cu an rem: Bani ih fapa Rehum in a sangtu phar cu a rem. Keilah peng hrek uktu Hashabiah in a peng sung ai-awh in a sangtu phar a rem.","title":"Levi Mi Phar Remtu Pawl"},"18":{"text":"Henadad ih fapa Bavvai, a dang Keilah peng hrek uktu in a sangtu phar a rem."},"19":{"text":"Mizpah uktu, Jeshua fapa Ezer in a sangtu phar, ral hriamhrei tuahnak hmai ihsin phar a keelnak tiang a tuah."},"20":{"text":"Zabbai ih fapa Baruk in a sangtu phar cu Puithiam Sang Eliashib inn luhnak sangka tiang a rem."},"21":{"text":"Uriah ih fapa le Hakkoz tusuan Meremoth in a sangtu cu Eliashib inn netnak tiang a tuah."},"22":{"text":"Phar remtu pawl lakah a thuailam puithiam pawl tla an tel a si: Jerusalem khua kiangkap ih puithiam pawl in a sangtu phar cu an tuah.","title":"Phar Remtu Puithiam Pawl"},"23":{"text":"Benjamin le Hasshub in a sangtu phar, an inn hmai zawn an rem fingfing. Maaseiah ih fapa le Ananiah tusuan Azariah in a sangtu, a inn hmai zawn ralden a tuah."},"24":{"text":"Henadad ih fapa Binnui in a sangtu Azariah inn ihsin a kelnak phar kiil tiang a rem."},"25":{"text":"Uzai ih fapa Palal in a sangtu cu phar kiil le Siangpahrang tlunta inn ih innsanghlei, inn kiltu pawl ih inn zawn in a rem. Parosh ih fapa Pedaiah in a sangtu cu a rem ih nisuahnak lamah Tidai Kotka le biakinn kilnak innsang tiang a rem. (Himi cu biakinn saktu pawl umnak Ofel an timi khua kiangte a si.)","merge":"26"},"27":{"text":"Tekao khuami pawl in a sangtu phar cu an rem; an hnaṭuan ṭumhnihnak a si; biakinn kilnak innsanghlei tumpi hmaizawn ihsin Ofel kiangih phar tiang an rem.","title":"Hnaṭuantu Dangdang"},"28":{"text":"Puithiam bur khat in a sangtu phar an rem ih Rang Kotka in a saklam ah anmah an inn hmaizawn ciar an rem."},"29":{"text":"Immer ih fapa Zadok in a sangtu, amah ih inn hmaizawn a rem. Nisuahnak lam Kotka kiltu, Shekaniah fapa Shemaiah in a sangtu a rem."},"30":{"text":"Shelemiah fapa Hananiah le Zalaf fapa paruknak Hanun in a sangtu phar cu, a ṭumhnihnak ah an rem. Berekhiah ih fapa Meshullam in a sangtu, amah ih umnak inn hmaizawn a rem."},"31":{"text":"Suisertu Malkhijah in a sangtu phar a rem. A remmi cu saklam nisuahnak lam phar kiil tlunta khaan kiang, biakinn fehnak kotka kiangih ummi, dawr tuahtu le biakinn saktu pawl umnak inn tiang a tuah."},"32":{"text":"Suisertu pawl le dawrtuahtu pawl in a sangtu phar cu phar kiil ih khaan ihsin Tuu Kotka tiang an rem."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kannih Judah mi pawl in Jerusalem kulhnak phar kan rem sal rero kha Sanballat in a theih tikah a ai a thok ih a thin cu tisa so in a so.","title":"Nehemiah Le Hnaṭuan A Duh Lotu Pawl"},"2":{"text":"A rualpi pawl le Samaria ralkap pawl hmaiah in hmuhsuam ih, “Hi Judah mi ṭawnṭai pawl hi ziang kan tuah ti in so an ruah awk? Khawpi dinsal an tum maw si? Thawinak pawl pe tahrat in ni khat ah kan ṭuan ṭheh ding, tiah an ruat-aw maw si? A cimmi le a kaang ciami hmang tahrat in inn saknak lungto kan tuah thei ding, an ti maw si?” a ti ciamco."},"3":{"text":"Ammon mi Tobiah cu a kiangah a um ih anih khal cun, “Ziangvek phar so hipawl cun an dawl thei ding? Cinghnia hman a parah kai sehla a cim thei ding a sisi!” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah kei Nehemiah in thla ka cam ih, “Maw Pathian, in hmuhsuam zia hi run thei hram aw. An ṭongsia cu anmah ih lu parah tla hram seh. An neihmi hmuahhmuah lon thluhmi le ramdang ih thawngthlakmi ah cang hai seh."},"5":{"text":"Mahte ih phar remtu le tuahtu pawl in hmuhsuam ruangah an ṭhatlonak hi ngaithiam hlah awla, an sualnak hi hngilh hram hlah aw,” ka ti."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun phar cu kan song vivo ko ih misenpi pawl hnaṭuan an lawt tuk ruangah a rei hlanah a saanlam ih hrek cu a thleng."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem kulhnak phar kan dawl ih sawtzet in kan tuah thei ih phar ongmi pawl tla kan phit vivo, ti kha Sanballat le Tobiah, Arabia mi pawl, Ammon le Ashdod in an theih tikah an thin a heng ngaingai."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah thurual zetin Jerusalem ra do ih hnaihnok ṭheh ko ih tuah dingah a phiar in tum."},"9":{"text":"Asinain kan Pathian hnenah thla kan cam ih ralvengtu dingah a sunzan in mi kan ret."},"10":{"text":"Culai ah Judah mi pawl ih an sak ṭheu mi hla cu: “Kan ṭuan a khung tukih kan cau deuhdeuh, Hnawm hlon ding a tam hrih fawn; Ziangtin so phar hi kan din thei ding?” ti a si."},"11":{"text":"Kan ral pawl cun, “In theih hlan le in hmuh hlanah an hnenah kan thleng ding ih kan that hai ding; cuticun an hnaṭuanmi cu a cawlta ding,” tiah an ruat."},"12":{"text":"Cule kan ral pawl lakih a ummi Judah mi pawl in ral pawl ih in do tumnak thu pawl cu atu le atu in sim cingcing."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah senpi pawl cu ralnam, feipi le conkiang pawl ka pek ih a hrin a hrin in kan ṭheh hrih lonak phar phen ah ka ṭanter vivo."},"14":{"text":"Cule senpi pawl an um a nuam deuh lo ti ka hmuh tikah senpi pawl le an hotu le an bawi pawl cu, “Kan ral pawl cu ṭih hrimhrim hlah uh. Kan Bawipa ziangtluk cak le ṭihnungza a si, ti ciing ringring uhla nan unau pawl, nan faate pawl, nan nupi pawl le nan innsang hrang ruat in do uh,” ka ti."},"15":{"text":"Kan ral pawl in in phiarnak kan theih kha an thei ih an tumtah mi cu Pathian in a phelhsolh zo ti kha an thei. Cuih hnuah kan zatein hnaṭuan cu kan thok sal."},"16":{"text":"Cuihsin thokin ka minung pawl a hrekin hna an ṭuan ih a hrek in feipi, ralphaw, conkiang le thir angki thawn ral an veng. Cule phar a remtu Judah mi pawl cu an hotu pawl in nasa zetin an ṭanpi hai."},"17":{"text":"Phar dawlnak thil a phurtu hmuahhmuah in an kut khatlam in an thil an kai ih khatlam in hriamnam an keng."},"18":{"text":"Hnaṭuantu hmuahhmuah in an taai ah ralnam an ṭeem fingfing. Poipeng ih tawtawrawt tumtu ding pa cu ka kiangah a um ringring."},"19":{"text":"Senpi pawl, an hotu le an bawi upa pawl cu, “Kan ṭuan mi hi a kau tukih kan darhdai-awk tuk ruangah pakhat le pakhat hi kan hlat aw tuk a si."},"20":{"text":"Tawtawrawt tum nan theih ahcun hmakhatte-ah ka kiangah in ra pan ṭheh uh. Kan Pathian in kan ai-ah a do ding a si,” ka ti."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah nitinte zing thlapit in zan thlavang tiang, a hrekin hna kan ṭuan ih a hrekin feipi thawn ral kan veng."},"22":{"text":"Cuih tlunah hnaṭuantu hmuahhmuah le anmah bawmtu hmuahhmuah cu zanah ralveng ding le sunah hnaṭuan dingin Jerusalem khawsung ih riak dingah ka sim."},"23":{"text":"Keimah le ka rualpi pawl, ka hnen-um pawl le i kiltu pawl thawn kan zatein kan thilthuam khal zanah kan hlit lo. Kan hriamnam kan keng fingfing."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tikcu a rei deuh tikah nunau ti lo mipa ti loin an unau Judah mi ṭhenkhat tlunah lungkim lonak an nei.","title":"Mifarah Pawl An Namsuk"},"2":{"text":"“Sungrual kan si ih kan nunnak dingah rawl kan khop lo,” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat in, “Rawl loih thih hnak cun, tiah kan inn kan lo le kan sabit hmuan tiangin kan pawng a si,” an ti."},"4":{"text":"A dang mi ṭhenkhat in, “Kan lo le kan sabit hmuan hrangih ngunkhuai pek dingah tangka kan cawi a ṭul a si."},"5":{"text":"Judah mi unau pawl hi thiikhat le sakhat kan si; Annih poihai mi le kannih poihai mi hi a bangrep lo maw? An faate cu an hrangih an sunlawi vekin kan faate pawl cu kan hrangah an sunglawi ve lo maw? Asinain kan faate pawl cu salah kan tuah hai a ṭul. Kan fanu hrekkhat pawl cu salah zuar an si zo. Kan titheimi zianghman a um lo, ziangahtile kan lo le kan sabit hmuan pawl cu in long thluh a si,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutiih an phunzainak ka theih tikah ka thin a heng ngaingai ih,"},"7":{"text":"thil pakhatkhat ka tuah a ṭul a si, ka ti. An hotu pawl le an bawi upa pawl cu ka kawk ih an hnenah, “Nan unau pawl parih nan thil tuah mi hi aṭha lo a si,” tiah ka sim. Cule cuih thu rel dingah misenpi ka kokhawm ih,"},"8":{"text":"an hnenah, “A can thei nawn lo ruangah miphun dang hnenah a zuar-awmi kan unau Judah mi pawl hman a si thei tawkin kan lei kir sal rero. Culai ah nannih in nan unau pawl cu zuar-aw dingin nan rak hneek rero lehlam,” ka ti. An hotu pawl cu an dai khepkhep ih ṭong ding zianghman an nei lo."},"9":{"text":"Cun, “Nan tuah mi hi thilsual a si! Kan ral pawl, Zentail mi pawl ih hmuhsuam lonak dingah Pathian ṭihzah in a dikmi tuah ding nan si sawn."},"10":{"text":"Mipi pawl kha ka hnen ihsin paisa le rawl ka cawiter hai. Cuvekin ka hnaṭuanpi pawl le ka hnaṭuantu pawl khal in an coih ve. Atu thok ihsin in cawimi pawl cu zohman in kan cawh sal nawn lo pei."},"11":{"text":"Atu rori in an lo, an sabit hmuan, an olif hmuan le an inn pawl cu pek sal ṭheh uh. Tangka maw, fangfai maw, sabitti maw, olif hriak maw, an lo baakmi hmuahhmuah atu ihsin daih thluh uh,” ka ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah hotu pawl in, “Na sim vek cun kan tuah thluh ding; an thilri cu kan pek sal ding ih in baakmi cu kan cawh nawn lo ding,” tiah in ti. Cule puithiam pawl ka ko ih an thutiam vekih tuahsuak dingah an hmaiah siat ka camter."},"13":{"text":"Ka taaiven puan ka phoih ih an hmaiah cun ka thin. “Nan thukam vekih nan tuah lo a si ahcun Pathian in hi taaiven puan vekin a lo thing ding. Pathian in nan inn pawl le nan neihmi hmuahhmuah a lo long ṭheh ding ih nan lawng fangkheh in a lo taan hai ding,” tiah ka ti. Cutawkih a ummi hmuahhmuah in, “Amen,” an ti ih Bawipa an thangṭhat. Cule an thuthiam mi cu an thlun."},"14":{"text":"Artakzaksis Siangpahrang a ṭuan kum kulnak ihsin kum sawmthum le kum hnihnak tiang, kumpi kum hleihnih, Judah ram uktu Mangki bawi ka si sungah hin keimah siseh ka sungkhat pawl siseh ram uktu bawi ih ei dingmi rawl kan ei dah hrih lo.","title":"Nehemiah, Mi Tirhsiang"},"15":{"text":"Ka hlanih ram uktu Mangki bawi a rak ṭuantu pawl cu misenpi hrangah thilrit an rak si ih nitinte an rawl le an zu hrangah ngun tangka sawmli an hmang ringring. An hnen-um pawl tiangin misenpi tisiatu an si. Sikhalsehla kei cu Pathian ka ṭih ruangah cutin ka tuah lo."},"16":{"text":"Ka thazaang neihmi hmuahhmuah cu khawpi ralhruang kulhnakah ka hmang ih ka hrangah ziangbangtuk thilri hman ka hawl lo. I riantu ka hnen-um pawl hmuahhmuah khal cuih phar dawl hna an ṭuan thluh."},"17":{"text":"Ka rawl einak cabuai ah Judah mi le an hotu pawl za le sawmnga rawl ka eipi ringring ih hlei ah kan kiangkap ram ihsin ka hnenih a ra mi hmuahhmuah ka cawm a si."},"18":{"text":"Ka ei dingah nitinte cawcang pakhat, tuu ṭha bik paruk le ar tampi kan that ringring ih nihra ah voikhat sabitti a thar in ka suah ringring. Cubangtuk a si naón misenpi pawl an zonzai tuk ruangah ram uktu Mangki bawi ih ngah ding timi zat hman ka lo la lo."},"19":{"text":"Hi tlukin misenpi hrangih ka tuah mi hi Pathian in ka ṭhatnak hrangah i theihsak hram seh."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem le kan ral pawl hmuahhmuah in khawpi ralhruang kan kulh ṭheh ih ralhruang ah ong a um nawn lo, ti an thei. (Kotka umnak tiih kan zuahmi ah kotka kan tuah hrih lo.)","title":"Nehemiah An Phiar"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah Sanballat le Geshem in thu in than ih Ono Hmunrawn ih khawte pakhat ih tong-aw dingin in sawm. Himi cu keimah ziangmaw ti ih tuahmawh duh ah in bumnak a si."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah mi ka thlah ih, “Hnaṭuan thupizet ka neih ruangah ka rung thei lo ding. Nanmah tong dingih kan run ahcun hnaṭuan kan colh thluh a ṭul ding ih ziangti hmanin hnaṭuan cu ka cawlter thei lo,” ka ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in voi li tiang thu in hun cah. Kei khal in cuti thotho cun ka vun khirh."},"5":{"text":"A voi nganak ah Sanballat in ca a ngan ih erh loin a hnen-um pakhat a hun phurhter."},"6":{"text":"A ca sungah cun, “Nangmah le Judah mi pawl cu ral thawh an tum ruangah khawpi ralhruang an rem rero a si, tiah kiangkap mi pawl in an rel rero tiin Geshem in i sim. Cuih tlunah Nehemiah cu amah le amah siangpahrang ah a tuah-aw ding ih,"},"7":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang ah Nehemiah a si, tiah Jerusalem khua ih phuangtu dingah Profet pawl tla a ret thluh zo, tiah in sim fawn. Hi thu cu siangpahrang bawipa in a thei leh thotho ding ih curuangah nangmah le keimah tong-aw in thu ruat tlang sehla ka duh a si,” tiah a ngan."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah ca ka khirh ih, “Na sim mi hi pakhat hman a dikmi a um lo. Nangmah ih phuahcop hlir an si,” tiah ka ti."},"9":{"text":"An zatein kan hnaṭuanmi baang dingah in hro ciamco. Asinain Pathian in i cakter sinsin zo!"},"10":{"text":"Cuih tikcu hrawngah Delaiah ih fapa le Mehetabel ih fasuan Shemaiah cu inn ihsin khui hmanah suakvak thei loih a um ruangah va leng dingin ka feh. Cutikah anih in, “Nangmah le keimah kan feh pei ih Biakinn ah kan relh pei; sangka hmuahhmuah tawh in kan hren thluh pei; ziangahtile nangmah that dingah an ra ding. Zan ah ra in an lo that ding a si,” tiah i ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule kei in, “Kei cu a tlan le a relh ding pawl ka si lo. Ka nunnak hum dingah Biakinn ah a relh ding tiah maw i ruah? Ka relh lo ding,” ka ti."},"12":{"text":"Ka ruah sal tikah Pathian in a hnenih thu a sim ruangah a si lo, Tobiah le Sanballat in nawhthuh an pek ruangah hiti ih a ṭongnak cu a si, ti ka vun thei sal."},"13":{"text":"Ka thangsiatnak le ka ningzahter duh ah nawhthuh an pek ih sualnak tuahter duh ah mi an fial a rak si."},"14":{"text":"Thla ka cam ih, “Maw Pathian, Tobiah le Sanballat thil timi hi ciingṭha awla hrem hai aw. A thin phang seh tiih i ti rero vetu profet nu Nodiah le a dang profet pawl tla hi ciing ṭha aw,” ka ti."},"15":{"text":"Hnaṭuan cu Elul thla ni kul hluannga ni ah kan ṭheh; a zate-ah ni sawmnga le ni hnih sung kan rei.","title":"Hnaṭuan An ṭheh"},"16":{"text":"Kan kiangkap ih a ummi kan ral pawl in an theih tikah an mithmai a sia ngaingai; ziangahtile Pathian bomnak in kan tuahsuak kha zozo khal in an thei."},"17":{"text":"Cuih caan sung hmuahhmuah ah Judah hotu pawl le Tobiah cu ca an kuat-aw ringring."},"18":{"text":"Tobiah cu Arah ih fapa Shekaniah ih maak-pa a si ruangah Judah ramsung mi tampi cu a lamah an ṭang. Cuih tlunah a fapa Jehohanan in Berekhiah ih fapa Meshullam ih fanu a ṭhit."},"19":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat pawl cun Tobiah ih ṭhatnak lawnglawng ka theih hngan ah an rel ih, ka ṭongmi hmuahhmuah cu a hnenah an sim ṭheh. Tobiah cun a thin phang seh tiah ca i kuat ringring."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ralhruang kulh cu kan ṭheh ih kotka pawl kan tuah thluh; biakinn kiltu pawl, hla saktu pawl le Levi mi pawl cu hnaṭuan kan zem ciar."},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem khua uktu dingah ka unau Hanani le ralhruang kiltu ralbawi Hananiah ka ret. Hananiah cu Pathian ṭihzahtu le rinsan tlakzet, zo hman ih bang lomi a si."},"3":{"text":"An pahnih in Jerusalem kotka pawl cu nisuah hnu lawngah on dingah le nitlak zawng kotka kiltu pawl hman an tlun hlanah khar ih hren ṭheh dingah ka sim. Jerusalem ih a ummi sungin khua kilvengtu lakih mi hrekkhat a ṭulnak zawn ah ralvengtu ah ret ih mihrek cu anmah ih inn ciar kilveng dingin ret dingah ka sim."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi cu a tumzet naón a sungih ummi minung cu an tam lo; inn tla tampi an sak hrih lo.","title":"Saltaang Kir Cazin (Ezra 2.1-70)"},"5":{"text":"Pathian in ka thinlung i thawhter ih misenpi le an bawi pawl le an hotu pawl cu ka kokhawm ih an innsang ciarih mipum cazin ka la. Saltaannak ihsin hmaisa bikih a kirmi pawl ih cazin cu ka tong ih a tanglam vek in a si."},"6":{"text":"A thuailam pawl cu Judah pengih a ummi, Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Babilon ah a hruai ih cutawk ihsin ra kir salih Jerusalem le Judah ramsung anmah ih khua ciarih tlung salmi an si."},"7":{"text":"A kirpitu upa pawl cu Zerubbabel, Joshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum le Baanah an si."},"8":{"text":"Sal taannak ihsin a ra kir mi Israel hrin pawl le an hrin ih mipum zat ciar cu hihi an si: Parosh hrin in thawnghnih za sawmsarih le pahnih, Shefatiah hrin in zathum sawmsarih le pahnih, Arah hrin in zaruk sawmnga pahnih, Pahath Moab (Jeshua le Joab tefa sin pawl) in thawnghnih zariat le hleiriat, Elam hrin in thawngkhat zahnih sawmnga le pali, Zattu hrin in zariat sawmli le panga, Zakkai hrin in zasarih le sawmruk, Binnui hrin in zaruk sawmli le pariat, Bebai hrin in zaruk le kul hluanriat, Azgad hrin in thawnghnih zathum le kul hluanhnih, Adonikam hrin in zaruk sawmruk le pasarih, Bigvai hrin in thawnghnih sawmruk le pasarih, Adin hrin in zaruk sawmnga le panga, Ater (Hezekiah) hrin in sawmkua le pariat, Hashum hrin in zathum le kul hluanriat, Bezai hrin in zathum kul hluanli, Harif hrin in za le hleihnih, Gibeon hrin in sawmkua le panga.","merge":"9"},"26":{"text":"An pupa pawl a hnuailam khua ah a rak ummi ih tesinfa pawl a kir mi cu hihi an si: Bethlehem le Netofah khuami tesinfa ah za sawmriat le pariat, Anathoth khuami tesinfa ah za le kul hluanriat, Beth Azmaveth khuami tesinfa ah sawmli le pahnih, Kiriath Jearim, Khefirah le Beeroth khuami tesinfa ah zasarih sawmli le pathum, Ramah le Geba khuami tesinfa ah zaruk le kul hluankhat, Mikmas khuami tesinfa ah za le kul hluanhnih, Bethel le Ai khuami tesinfa ah za le kul hluanthum, A dang Nebo khuami tesinfa ah sawmnga le pahnih, A dang Elam khuami tesinfa ah thawngkhat zahnih sawmnga le pali, Harim khuami tesinfa ah zathum le kul, Jerikho khuami tesinfa ah zathum sawmli le panga, Lod, Hadid le Ono khuami tesinfa ah zasarih le kul hluankhat, Senaah khuami tesinfa ah thawngthum zakua le sawmthum.","merge":"27"},"39":{"text":"Puithiam pawl hrin sungin a kirmi pawl cu hihi an si: Jedaiah (Jeshua tesinfa) hrin in zakua sawmsarih le pathum, Immer hrin in thawngkhat sawmnga le pahnih, Pashhur hrin in thawngkhat zahnih sawmli le pasarih, Harim hrin in thawngkhat le hleisarih.","merge":"40"},"43":{"text":"Levi mi hrin in a kirmi pawl cu hihi an si: Jeshua le Kadmiel hrin (Hodaviah tesinfa) in sawmsarih le pali,"},"44":{"text":"Biakinn hla satu pawl (Asaf tesinfa) in za sawmli le pariat,"},"45":{"text":"Biakinn kiltu pawl (Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita le Shobai tesinfa) in za sawmthum le pariat."},"46":{"text":"Biakinn saktu pawl an hrin ciar thawn a kirmi pawl cu hihi an si: Ziha, Hasufa, Tabbaoth, Keros, Sia, Padon, Lebana, Hagaba, Shalmai, Hanan, Giddel, Gahar, Reaiah, Rezin, Nekoda, Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah, Besai, Meunim, Nefusesim, Bakbuk, Hakufa, Harhur, Bazlith, Mehida, Harsha, Barkos, Sisera, Temah, Neziah le Hatifa.","merge":"47"},"57":{"text":"Solomon hnen-um pawl, an hrin ciar thawn a kirmi pawl cu hihi an si: Sotai, Sofereth, Perida, Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel, Shefatiah, Hattil, Pokhereth, Hazzebaim le Amon.","merge":"58"},"60":{"text":"Biakinn saktu pawl le Solomon hnen-um pawl, a kirmi ih tesinfa cu an zatein zathum sawmkua le pahnih an si."},"61":{"text":"Tel Melah khua, Tel Harsha khua, Kherub khua, Addon khua le Immer khua in Delaiah hrin, Tobiah hrin le Nekoda hrin, an zate ah minung zaruk sawmli le pahnih a kirmi an um naón Israel miphun hrin an sinak kha an simsuak thei lo.","merge":"62"},"63":{"text":"Puithiam Hobaiah hrin, Hakkoz hrin le Barzillai hrin pawl tla in an pupa ih thawhkehnak ca khummi cazin an hmu lo. (Barzillai hrin ih an pu in Gilead ram Barzillai hrin nunau a rak ṭhit ih a puzon ih hmin a rak lakta ruangah Barzillai hrin ti an si.) An pupa pawl zo an si, ti an theih lo ruangah annih pawl cu puithiam ah an pom thei lo.","merge":"64"},"65":{"text":"Judah ram uktu bawi in, Urim le Thummim timi a hmang thiamtu puithiam an um hlan cu Pathian hnenih pekmi rawl thianghlim ei lo dingin Mangki bawipa in a kham a si."},"66":{"text":"Saltaannak ihsin a kirmi mipum zate cu thawng sawmli thawnghnih, zathum le sawmruk an si."},"67":{"text":"Hnen-um zate nunau mipa ti loin, thawngsarih zathum sawmthum le pasarih an si. Hla saktu nunau mipa an zate ah zahnih sawmli le panga an si. Rang zasarih sawmthum le paruk, laak zahnih sawmli le panga, kalauk zali sawmthum le panga, laak fate phun thawngruk zasarih le kul an si.","merge":"68"},"70":{"text":"Mi tampi in Biakinn sak saalnak ah tangka le thilri tampi an pek: Ram uktu bawi in sui cuai li, thawinak hrang kheng sawmnga, le puithiam korfual zanga le sawmthum a pek. An hrin ih hotu pawl in sui cuai sawmriat le cuai nga, le ngun cuai zariat le cuai nga an pek. Senpi pawl in sui cuai zariat le cuai nga, ngun cuai zasarih le sawmthum, le puithiam korfual sawmruk le pasarih an pek.","merge":"71"},"73":{"text":"Cule puithiam pawl, Levi mi pawl, biakinn kiltu pawl, hla saktu pawl, biakinn saktu pawl le Israel mi hmuahhmuah cu khawpi siseh khawte siseh khua kipah an um vivo."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thla sarih thla ah Israel mi pawl cu an khua ciarah an um ṭheh. Cuih thla ni khat ni ah lungrual zetin Jerusalem khua, Tidai Kotka hmaiah an tongkhawm aw. Cule Daan cabu la dingah Ezra an fial. Ezra cu puithiam a si ih Bawipa in Israel mi hnenah Moses kut sungin a pekmi Daan thuhla a thei zetmi pa a si.","title":"Ezra In Daan Cabu A Siar"},"2":{"text":"Ezra in Daan cabu cu a lak ih misenpi an khawmnak hmun ahcun a feh. Cutawkah nunau, mipa le thu ciingthei hmuahhmuah an zatein an khawm-aw thluh."},"3":{"text":"Kotka kiang mualrawn ah Ezra in Daan cabu cu zinglam khawfingcah in sun tiang ringzet in a siar ih misenpi pawl cun ṭhazet in an ngai."},"4":{"text":"Cuti siarnak hrangih an donmi donhleisang parah Ezra cu a ding. A vorhlam ah Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah le Maaseiah an dingih a kehlam ah Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkhijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zekhariah le Meshullam an ding."},"5":{"text":"Cuih donhleisang parih Ezra a din cun an zate in an mit hman ṭhep loin an zoh. Cule Daan cabu a vun on vete in an zatein an ding."},"6":{"text":"Ezra in, “A maksak Bawipa Pathian cu thangṭhat uh!” a ti. Cutikah misenpi cun vanah an kut an phar ih, “Amen, Amen,” an tiah an let. An khuk an bil ih an hmai leilung dai tiangin kuun in Pathian an biak."},"7":{"text":"Cule misenpi cu an tho ih an umnak ciarah an ding ih Levi mi Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan le Peliah pawl in Ezra ih siarmi Daan cu an fianter."},"8":{"text":"Misenpi ih an theih theinak dingah cuih Pathian Daan an siar mi cu ṭong an let copcop."},"9":{"text":"Pathian Daan ih tican ngaingai an theih tikah an lung a zuur ih an ṭap. Cutikah ram uktu mangki bawi Nehemiah, puithiam le Daan theitu Ezra le senpi hnenih Daan a fiangtertu Levi mi pawl in, “ Bawipa nan Pathian hrangah tuihsun cu ni thianghlim a si. Riahsia in ṭap hlah uh."},"10":{"text":"Nan inn ah tlung uhla rawl thawthaw ei uhla sabit thawthaw in uh. Nan rawl le nan sabit cu a nei ve lomi thawn hlawm-aw uh. Tuihsun cu Bawipa ih hrangah ni thianghlim a si, riahsia in um hlah uh. Bawipa ih lungawinak a lo pekmi cu nan cahnak a si,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Levi mi pawl in senpi pawl cu daite-ih um dingah an leem ih, ni thianghlim a si ruangah riahsia ih um lo dingin an sim."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah senpi pawl cu inn ah an tlung ih lungawi zetin an ei an in ih an rualpi pawl thawn an hlawm-aw; an hnenih an lehsakmi Daan ih tican an theih fiang ruangah aipuang zetin an um."},"13":{"text":"A thaisun ah an hrin ciarih hotu pawl cu puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl thawn Daan ih tican ngaingai zir dingah Ezra hnenah an feh.","title":"Puanthlam Puai"},"14":{"text":"Moses hmang in Israel mi hnenih Bawipa in a pekmi Daan sungah cun Puanthlam Puai sung cu a laangte ih deu tuah tahratin cuih deu sungih um dingah Israel mi hnenih thupekmi a um kha an hmu."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Jerusalem le khuadang hmuahhmuah ah hiti in thu an pek: “Tlangpar ah feh uhla Daan sungih thupekmi a um vekin, deu saknak ah olif hnge, far hnge, lenhmui hnge, tum hnah pawl le hnah-nei thing dangdang tla va la uh,” an ti."},"16":{"text":"Senpi pawl cu an feh ih deu saknak ah thinghnge pawl an lak ih an inn tlunih diphun rawn parah, an tual le Biakinn tual ah siseh, Tidai Kotka le Efraim Kotka kiangih senpi tlannak mualrawn tla ah siseh, deu cu an sak ciamco."},"17":{"text":"Saltaannak in a ra kirmi hmuahhmuah in deu cu an sak ih a sungah cun an um. Himi cu Nun ih fapa Joshua san hnu ahcun an tuah hmaisa bikmi a si. An zatein lungawi aipuang in an um."},"18":{"text":"An puai tuah ni khat ni in a netnak ni tiang nitinte Pathian ih Daan cu an siar. Ni sarih sung puai an tuah ih, Daan pekmi sungih a um vekin niriatnak ni ah an puai an ṭiak."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih thla ni kul hluanli ni ah Israel mi pawl cu hmunkhat ah an tong-aw khawm ih an sualsirnak langternak ah rawl an ul; buri puan an sin ih an lu ah leivut an phulh.","title":"Senpi Pawl In An Sual An Phuang"},"2":{"text":"Ramdang mi thawn rawi-aw loin hlimphir in an um. Cule an ding ih anmah le an pupa pawl ih sualnak cu an phuang."},"3":{"text":"Nazi pathum sung Bawipa an Pathian ih Daan an siarmi cu an ngai ih cuih hnu nazi pathum sung an sual phuangin Bawipa an Pathian an biak."},"4":{"text":"Levi mi pawl hrangah donhleisang an don ih cuih parah Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani le Khenani pawl an ding ih ringzet in Bawipa an Pathian ih hmin an ko."},"5":{"text":"Cule Levi mi Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, le Pethahiah in biak kawhnak ah hiti in an saal: “Ding uhla Bawipa nan Pathian cu thangṭhat uh, Kumkhua in kumkhua tiang amah cu thangṭhat uh, A hmin sunglawi cu mikip in thangṭhat uh, Milai thangṭhatnak cu a kim lo naón mi kipin thangṭhat uh,” an ti. Cule Israel pawl cu hiti in thla an cam:"},"6":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , nangmah lawng Bawipa na si, Van le arsi pawl khi nangmah in na tuah. Nangmah in lei le tipi le a sung ummi hmuahhmuah na tuah ṭheh. Ziang hmuahhmuah nunnak na pek, Van ih a ummi hmuahhmuah in nangmah cu kuun in an lo bia."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian, nangmah in Abram na hril, Babilon ram Ur khua in na ko; A hmin cu Abraham ah na thleng."},"8":{"text":"Rinsan tlak ih na hmuh ruangah, Amah thawn thukamnak na tuah. Kanaan ram pek dingah thu na kam, Hit mi, Amor mi le Perez mi pawl Jebus mi le Girgash mi ram cu; A tesinfa pawl umnak ramah na ti. Na thukamnak bangin na kimter, A dingfel mi na si ruangah."},"9":{"text":"“Izipt ramih kan pupa pawl an tuar zia cu na hmu, Tipi Sen ah bomnak an lo dil mi cu na thei;"},"10":{"text":"Faro dodal in khawruahhar mangbangza na tuah, A kuthnuai bawi pawl le a ram minung pawl dodal in, Na minung pawl an hrem tuk hai ruangah. Culai ah na rak neh ih, Atu khal ah na hmin a thang."},"11":{"text":"Tipi satcat in na minung hrang lamzin na tuah, Leiro par in na hruai hai. A duumtu pawl cu tipi thuuk sungah an tla, Tipisuar lakih lungto pil bangin."},"12":{"text":"Sun ah khawdur in na hruai hai, Zan ah an lamzin cu meifar na van."},"13":{"text":"Sinai Tlang parah van ihsin na rung ṭum tikah, Cutawkah na minung pawl hnenah na ṭong, An hnenah daan ṭha le thudik zirhnak na pek."},"14":{"text":"Sabbath ni thiangter dingah na zirh ih, Na siahhlawh Moses hnenin na daan pawl na pek."},"15":{"text":"“An ril a rawn tikah van ihsin sang na run thlak, An ti a haal tikah lungpi sungin an in ding tidai na suahter. An thlennak ding ram cu luah dingah na sim, An hnenih pek dingih na tiam cia mi ram cu."},"16":{"text":"Asinain kan pupa pawl cu an hngal ih an lung a ruh, Na thupekmi thlun an duh lo."},"17":{"text":"Na thu an thlun duh lo ih na thil tuahmi an hngilh ṭheh; Mangbangza na tuah mi pawl cu an ciing nawn lo. An hngalnak thawn hotu an hril, Izipt saltaannak ih kirpi dingah. Asinain nang cu mi ngaithiamtu Lainatu Pathian na si, Zaangfahnak le duhdawtnak na nei, Na thinheng a fuung ngaingai. Na thinpemnak cu a tum ngaingai, Na dungtun siang hai lo a si."},"18":{"text":"Cawcang pian in khawzing lem an siam, Izipt ram ihsin in suahtu pathian a si an ti; Bawipa , ziangtlukin so an lo hmuhsuam hi!"},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nelrawn ahcun na hnongta hai lo, Na zaangfahnak a tum ruangah. Khawdur le meisa cu na lak kir siang lo, Sunzan in an lam hmuhtu pawl cu."},"20":{"text":"Na ṭhat ruangah an tuah ding mi na sim, Manna in na cawm hai, An in dingah tidai na pek."},"21":{"text":"Kum sawmli sung nelrawn ah, An ṭulmi hmuahhmuah na pek ṭheh, An hnipuan a ṭet dah lo, An ke tla naa in a thling dah lo."},"22":{"text":"“Ram tampi le miphun tampi na nehter, An ram kiangkap ih ram pawl cu. Sihon ukmi Heshbon ram an neh, Og Siangpahrang a ṭuannak Bashan ram tla."},"23":{"text":"Van arsi zat in tesinfa na pek, Ram na nehter ih na luahter; An pupa hnenih na tiam ciami an luah dingmi ram cu."},"24":{"text":"Kanaan ram cu an lak; A rak ummi pawl na neh ṭheh; Na minung pawl hnenah an duhmi tuah theinak huham na pek, Kanaan ram Siangpahrang pawl le an minung pawl parah cun."},"25":{"text":"Na minung pawl cun kulh mi khawpi pawl an lak, Ram ṭha le tikhur laih cia tla, Sumpai in a khat mi inn pawl, Olif kung, thingrah kung le sabit hmuan pawl thawn. An duhzat in an ei ih an thau, Na pekmi thilṭha lakah an nuam ngaingai."},"26":{"text":"“Cu cingin na minung pawl cu ral an tho, Na thu an thlun duh lo, Na Daan pekmi an dungtun. Na thu zirhtu profet pawl an that, Ralrinnak petu le na hnen ra kir dingih thusimtu pawl cu. An lo hmuhsuam hi a nasa ngaingai."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah an ral kut sungah na thlenter ih, Annih in an uk ih an hrem hai. An vansaan tikah na bomnak duh ah an lo ko, Van in an aunak aw na run thei. Na mi zaangfahnak a tum ruangah, An hnenah hotu pawl na run thlah, An ral kut sung in runtu dingah."},"28":{"text":"Hnangamnak an hmuh tikah cun an sual sal, An ral kut sungah na thlenter sal. Asinain an sual an siirih nunnak an lo dil tikah, Van ihsin na run thei ih, Avei siarcawk lo na run hai a si; Na zaangfahnak a tum ruangah."},"29":{"text":"Na thupekmi thlun dingah ralrinnak na pek, Asinain puarthau in na daan cu an hnong; Na Daan thlun cu nunnak lamzin a si ko naón! Lungruh le thulungkhen nei in an thlun duh talo."},"30":{"text":"Kumkhat hnu kum khat lungsau in ralrinnak na pek hai, Na profet pawl in an sim rero nan, Na minung pawl cu an hna a seet. Curuangah na minung pawl cu Miphun dang pawl in an uk."},"31":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na zaangfahnak a tum ruangah, Na hnong loih na siatsuah hai lo; Nang cu zaangfahnak le thinpemnak neitu Pathian na si!"},"32":{"text":"“Maw Pathian, Ziangkimtithei Pathian, ṭihnungza le ziangzongza tuah theitu Pathian; Na thukam mi cu famkimzet in na kimter ṭheh. Assiria Siangpahrang pawl ih in hrem thokin, Tuihsun tiang kan tuar mi hi, Thu-tenau ah in ruahsak hram hlah aw. Kan siangpahrang pawl le kan hotu pawl, Kan puithiam le kan profet pawl, Kan pupa pawl le kan mi senpi pawl ih an tuarmi, Hi tluk kan tuarmi hi run theisak hramhram aw."},"33":{"text":"In hrem ṭheu hi na dik ko, hrem tlak kan si; Nang cu rintlak na si, kannih kan sual a si."},"34":{"text":"Kan pupa le kan siangpahrang pawl thokin, Kan hotu pawl le kan puithiam pawl tla in Na Daan cu an thlun lo a si. Na thupekmi le na ralrin pekmi cu, An ngai duh hrimhrim lo."},"35":{"text":"Na thlawsuah peknak thawngin Siangpahrang in na minung an uk. Na pekmi ramkau le ramṭha sung an um lai ahcun. Asinain sualnak sungin an kir loih Na hna cu an ṭuan lo a si."},"36":{"text":"Atu ahcun in pekmi ram sungah sal ah kan cang, Ei in ding in petu hih ramṭha sungah hin."},"37":{"text":"Kan ram sungin a suak mi hmuahhmuah cu, Siangpahrang hnenah a feh ṭheh; Kan sual ruangah kan tlunih na retmi bawi hnenah cun.
