Kanmah siseh, kan rannung siseh, an duhduh in in tuah, Kan van a sang ngaingai,” tiah an ti."},"38":{"text":"Kan parih thil a cangmi pawl ruangah hin, kannih Israel mi pawl hin atu-ah ca ngan in lungkimnak cakhen kan tuah ih kan hotu pawl, kan Levi mi pawl le kan puithiam pawl in a parah an hmin an khen.","title":"Lungkimnak Ca An Ngan"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hmaisa bikih a hmin ngantu cu ram uktu mangki bawi, Hakaliah ih fapa Nehemiah a si; cuih hnuah Zedekiah in a hmin a ngan. Hmin ngantu midang pawl cu:"},"2":{"text":"Puithiam pawl: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah, Pashhur, Amariah, Malkhijah, Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluk, Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah, Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruk, Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin, Maaziah, Bilgai, le Shemaiah.","merge":"3"},"9":{"text":"Levi mi pawl: Azaniah ih fapa Jeshua, Henadad hrin in Binnui, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan, Mika, Rehob, Hashabiah, Zakkur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Bani le Beninu.","merge":"10"},"14":{"text":"Misenpi hotu pawl: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani, Bunni, Azgad, Bebai, Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin, Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur, Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai, Harif, Anathoth, Nebai, Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir, Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua, Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah, Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub, Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek, Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah, Ahiah, Hanan, Anan, Malluk, Harim le Baanah.","merge":"15"},"28":{"text":"Kannih Israel mi, puithiam pawl, Levi mi pawl, biakinn kiltu pawl, biakinn ih hla satu pawl, biakinn kilkhawitu pawl le a dangdang tla in, Pathian pekmi Daan thlun in kan ram sungih a ummi miphun dang pawl thawn thleidang aw in hlimphir teih kan um hnuah, kan nupi pawl, kan fanu kan fapa, le thuciing thei kan faate pawl le,","title":"Lungkimnak Cakhen"},"29":{"text":"in hotu kan unau pawl thawn hmunkhat ah kutsih in, hi thukamnak kan bal asile siatcamnak tuar dingah Moses kutin Pathian ih in pekmi Daan thlun in kan Pathian ih thukham hmuahhmuah cu kan ngai pei ih, a daan le a thupekmi pawl ralringte in kan thlun ding tiah hi thukamnak cu kan tuah a si."},"30":{"text":"Kan ram sungih a ummi miphun dang pawl thawn ṭhit awknak kan tuah lo pei."},"31":{"text":"Sabbath ni ah siseh, ni dang ni thianghlim ni ah siseh, rawl le a dang thilri pawl in rak zorh khalle kan lei lo pei. Kum sarih kum a kimtinte in kan leiram cu kan thlo lo pei ih cuih kum ahcun leiba hmuahhmuah kan olh pei."},"32":{"text":"Kumtinte kan Pathian ih Biakinn hnaṭuannak hrangah tangka fangkhat ih ṭhenthum ṭhen ṭhenkhat kan pek ringring pei."},"33":{"text":"Kan Bawipa Biakinn ih Pathian kan biaknak hrangah sangreu thianghlim, nitin thlairawl thawinak pekmi, nitin mei-ur thawinak pekmi rannung, Sabbath ni, Thlathar Puai le puai dangdang hrang thawinak thianghlim pawl, thawinak thianghlim dangdang hrang le Israel sualthlah thawinak hrangah a ṭulmi hmuahhmuah kan pek pei."},"34":{"text":"Kannih misenpi pawl, puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl in, Daan sungih a um bangtuk in, Bawipa kan Pathian hnenih mei-ur thawinak kan pek tikah zo hrin in ziangtikah zanthing a keng ding ti theihfiangnak ah kumtinten camcawhfung kan zuuk pei."},"35":{"text":"Kumtinte in kan rawl a cu hmaisa bik le kan thingkung ih a rah hmaisa bik cu Biakinn ah kan pek pei."},"36":{"text":"Daan sungih a um bangtuk in Pathian Biakinn ih a ṭuantu puithiam pawl hnenah, Pathian hnenih pek dingah kan fapa upa bik, kan caw fatir, kan tuu le kan me fatir pawl cu kan pek pei."},"37":{"text":"Pathian Biakinn ah le Biakinn ih hnaṭuantu puithiam pawl hnenah, kumtinte kan lak hmaisa bik fang ih tuahmi sangphut le sabitti, olif hriak, le a dang kan neihmi thingrah a phunphun kan pek pei. Lo kan thlawhnak kan lo ihsin, thawhlawm a khawmtu Levi mi pawl hnenah, kan khua kan ram sungin a suakmi rawl ṭhenhra ih ṭhenkhat cu kan pek pei."},"38":{"text":"Aaron tesinfa puithiam pawl cu thawhlawm khawm tikah Levi mi pawl hnenah an tel ve pei ih, Levi mi pawl in an khawm ciami thawhlawm hmuahhmuah sungin ṭhenhra ih ṭhenkhat cu Biakinn hnaṭuannak hrangah Biakinn rawlretnak khaan ah an ret pei."},"39":{"text":"Rawl, sabitti le olif hriak an pekmi pawl cu Israel mi le Levi mi pawl in Biakinn beelkheng an retnak khaan, Biakinn hnaṭuantu puithiam pawl, Biakinn kiltu pawl le Biakinn ih hla satu pawl umnak khaan ah an ret pei. Kan Pathian ih Biakinn cu kan daithlan lo pei."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hotu pawl cu Jerusalem khawpi ah an um; misenpi sungin innsang pahra sungah pakhat cu Jerusalem ih um dingah camcawhfung an zuuk ih, a dang hmuahhmuah cu khawdang le khawte sungah an um.","title":"Jerusalem Ih A Ummi Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem khawsungah keimah ka um pei tiah lungkimte ih a ti theitu pawl cu misenpi pawl in an lawm ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Israel misenpi, puithiam pawl, Levi mi pawl, Biakinn saktu pawl le Solomon hnen-um pawl ih tesinfa pawl cu khua dang le khawte sungah anmah ih leiram ciarah an um. Judah peng sungin Jerusalem ih a ummi upa hminthang deuh pawl cu a tanglam pawl hi an si:"},"4":{"text":"Judah hrin sungin Jerusalem ih a ummi pawl: Uzziah ih fapa le Zekhariah ih tu Athaiah. A pupa dang pawl cu Amariah, Shefatiah le Mahalalel an si ih Judah ih fapa Perez ih tesinfa an si."},"5":{"text":"Baruk fapa le Kolhozeh ih tu Maaseiah. A pupa dang pawl cu Hazaiah, Adaiah, Joiarib le Zekhariah an si ih Judah ih fapa Shelah ih tefa sin an si."},"6":{"text":"Perez ih tesinfa sungin mi hminthang zali sawmruk le pariat Jerusalem ah an um."},"7":{"text":"Benjamin hrin sungin Jerusalem ih a ummi pawl: Meshullam ih fapa le Joed ih tu Sallu. A pupa dang pawl cu Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, Ithiel le Jeshaiah an si."},"8":{"text":"Sallu sungkhat Gabbai le Sallai. An zate-ah Benjamin innsang sungin zakua kul hluanriat Jerusalem ah an um."},"9":{"text":"Zikhri ih fapa Joel cu an hotu a si ih Hassenuah ih fapa Judah cu Jerusalem khawsung ih bawi upa bik sangtu a si."},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem ih a ummi Puithiam pawl: Joiarib ih fapa Jedaiah le Jakhin."},"11":{"text":"Hilkiah ih fapa le Meshullam ih tu Seraiah. A pupa dang pawl cu Zadok, Meraioth le Puithiam Sang Ahitub an si. Ahitub cu Biakinn zohtu upa a si."},"12":{"text":"An zate-ah an hrin sungin zariat le kul hluanhnih cu Biakinn ih hnaṭuantu an si. Jeroham ih fapa le Pelaliah ih tu Adaiah. A pupa dang pawl cu Amzi, Zekhariah, Pashhur le Malkhijah an si."},"13":{"text":"An zate-ah an hrin sungin zahnih sawmli le pahnih cu innsang hotu pawl an si. Azarel ih fapa le Ahzai ih tu Amashsai. A pupa dang pawl cu Meshillemoth le Immer an si."},"14":{"text":"An hrin sungin za le kul hluanriat cu ralkap hminthangzet an si. An hrin sungih upa Zabdiel cu an hotu a si ih Haggedolim fapa a si."},"15":{"text":"Jerusalem ih a ummi Levi mi pawl: Hasshub ih fapa le Azrikam ih tu Shemaiah. A pupa dang pawl cu Hashabiah le Bunni an si."},"16":{"text":"Biakinn lengah hnaṭuan neitu Levi mi hminthang Shabbethai le Jozabad."},"17":{"text":"Mika ih fapa le Asaf tesinfa Zabdi ih fapa sin Mattaniah; lungawi thlacamnak hla an sak tikah Mattaniah cu hla hruaitu a si. Mattaniah bawmtu Bakbukiah. Shammua ih fapa le Jeduthun tefa sin Galal ih fapa sin Abda."},"18":{"text":"An zate-ah Jerusalem khua thianghlim sungah Levi mi zahnih sawmriat le pali an um."},"19":{"text":"Biakinn kiltu Jerusalem ih a ummi: Akkub, Talmon, le a sungkhat pawl za le sawmsarih le pahnih."},"20":{"text":"A dang Israel mi pawl, puithiam le Levi mi dangdang pawl cu Judah ramsung khawpi le khawte sungah anmah ih leiram ciarah an um."},"21":{"text":"Biakinn tuamhlawmtu pawl cu Jerusalem khua Ofel vengah an um ih an hotu cu Ziha le Gishpa an si."},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem ih a ummi Levi mi pawl hotu cu Bani ih fapa le Hashabiah ih tu Uzzi a si. A pupa dang pawl cu Mattaniah le Mika an si ih Asaf hrin an si. Asaf hrin pawl cu Biakinn khawm tikah hla satu an si."},"23":{"text":"Hrinkhat hnu hrinkhat nitinte Biakinn ih hlasak cu a haha teih sawng aw dingah Siangpahrang ih thupeknak a um."},"24":{"text":"Judah phun, Zerah hrin, Meshezabel ih fapa Pethahiah cu Persia siangpahrang zungah Israel mi pawl ih palai a si."},"25":{"text":"Mi tampi cu an lothlawhnak kiangih khua ah an um. Judah hrin pawl cu Kiriath Arba khua, Dibon leh Jekabzeel khua le an kiangkap ih khawte pawl ah an um.","title":"Khua Dangdang Ih Ummi Pawl"},"26":{"text":"Cule Jeshua khua, Moladah khua, Bethpelet khua le"},"27":{"text":"Hazarshual khua tla ah an um ih Beersheba khua le a kiangkap khawte pawl ah an um."},"28":{"text":"Ziklag khua le Mekonah khua le a kiangkap khawte ah an um."},"29":{"text":"Enrimmon khua, Zorah khua, Jarmuth khua,"},"30":{"text":"Zanoah khua, Adullam khua le an kiangkap khawte pawl ah an um. Lakhish khua le a kiangih an thlawh mi lo ah le, Azekah le a kiangih khawte pawl ah an um. Cuticun Judah mi pawl cu thlanglam Beersheba ihsin saklam Jerusalem khua kiang Hinnom Phairawn tiang, khua kipah an um."},"31":{"text":"Cun Benjamin hrin pawl cu Geba khua, Mikmash khua, Ai khua, Bethel khua le a kiangkap khawte ah le"},"32":{"text":"Anathoth khua, Nob khua, Ananiah khua,"},"33":{"text":"Hazor khua, Ramah khua, Gittaim khua,"},"34":{"text":"Hadid khua, Zeboiim khua, Neballat khua,"},"35":{"text":"Lod khua, Ono khua le Zungthiam Phairawn ah an um."},"36":{"text":"Judah ram sungih a rak ummi Levi mi hrekkhat pawl cu Benjamin mi pawl thawn hmunkhatah an umter."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon saltaannak ihsin Shealtiel ih fapa Zerubbabel le Puithiam Sang Joshua thawn a ra kirmi puithiam le Levi mi pawl cu a tanglam pawl hi an si:","title":"Puithiam Le Levi Mi Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Puithiam pawl: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra, Amariah, Malluk, Hattush, Shekaniah, Rehum, Meremoth, Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah, Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah, Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah, Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah le Jedaiah. Hi pawl cu Joshua sanih an unau puithiam pawl lakah hotu an si.","merge":"3"},"8":{"text":"Levi mi pawl: Lungawinak hla an sak tikah a tanglam pawl cu hla hruaitu an si: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah le Mattaniah."},"9":{"text":"Bakbukiah le Unno cu an unau Levi mi pawl thawn hlarem sawn-awtu an si."},"10":{"text":"Joshua cu Joiakim ih pa a si; Joiakim cu Eliashib ih pa a si; Eliashib cu Joiada ih pa a si.","title":"Puithiam Sang Joshua Tesinfa Pawl"},"11":{"text":"Joiada cu Jonathan ih pa a si; Jonathan cu Jaddua ih pa a si."},"12":{"text":"Puithiam Sang Joiakim sanah a tanglam pawl hi puithiam hrin ih hotu pawl an si: Seraiah hrin ah Meraiah, Jeremiah hrin ah Hananiah, Ezra hrin ah Meshullam, Amariah hrin ah Jehohanan, Mallukhi hrin ah Jonathan, Shebaniah hrin ah Josef, Harim hrin ah Adna, Meroioth hrin ah Helkai, Iddo hrin ah Zekhariah, Ginnethon hrin ah Meshullam, Abijah hrin ah Zikhri, Miniamin hrin ah … Moadiah hrin ah Piltai, Bilgah hrin ah Shammua, Shemaiah hrin ah Jehonathan, Joiarib hrin ah Mattenai, Jedaiah hrin ah Uzzi, Sallai hrin ah Kallai, Amok hrin ah Eber, Hilkiah hrin ah Hashabiah, Jedaiah hrin ah Nethanel.","title":"Puithiam Hrin Ih Hotu Pawl","merge":"13"},"22":{"text":"Puithiam Sang Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan le Jaddua pawl sanah Levi mi innsang pawl le puithiam innsang pawl hotu cazin cu ṭhatein an ret. Cuih cazin cu Darias in Persia siangpahrang a ṭuan laiah an tuah ṭheh mi a si.","title":"Puithiam le Levi Mi Innsang Pawl"},"23":{"text":"Levi mi innsang hotu pawl ih cazin cu Eliashib ih tu Johanan san tiang siangpahrang thu hminsinnak cabu sungah an khum."},"24":{"text":"Levi mi pawl cu Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua, Binnui le Kadmiel ho in bu tampi ah an ṭhen. Pathian ih minung, siangpahrang David ih thupeknak vekin ṭum khatah bu hnih bu hnih in a sawn-aw in Pathian an thangṭhat ih Pathian hnenah lungawinak an sim.","title":"Biakinn Hnaṭuan Zemmi"},"25":{"text":"Biakinn kotka pawl kiangih thilri retnak inn pawl kiltu cu a tanglam pawl hi an si: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon le Akkub."},"26":{"text":"Himi pawl cu Joshua fapa le Jehozadak ih tu Joiakim san le ram uk Mangki bawi Nehemiah san le Daan thei zettu le puithiam Ezra san ih a ummi an si."},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi phardawl cu Pathian hnenih an hlan tikah dar sumsel, ṭingṭang le tingrisit tum thawn mi hmuahhmuah in lungawinak hla an sak ih lungawi aipuang in puai ih an tel thei ciarnak dingah Levi mi pawl cu an umnak kipin Jerusalem ah an ko ṭheh.","title":"Khawpi Phardawl Cu Pathian Hnenah An Hlan"},"28":{"text":"Levi mi hla satu pawl cu an umnak hmun ihsin le Jerusalem kiangkap Netofah kiangkap khua pawl,"},"29":{"text":"Beth Gilgal, Geba le Azmaveth khua pawl in an rasuak khawm."},"30":{"text":"Puithiam le Levi mi pawl cun anmah thianhlimnak thawinak le misenpi hrang thawinak, kotka pawl le khawpi phardawl thianhlim thawinak cu an pek."},"31":{"text":"Cule Judah mi hotu upa pawl cu phardawl parah cun ka kaiter hai ih Pathian hnenah lungawi thusim phah ih khawpi veltu dingah bu tum pipi bu hnih ah ka ṭhen. Bu khat cu phardawl parah cun vorhlam ihsin Hnawm Kotka lamah an feh."},"32":{"text":"Hla saktu pawl ih dungin Hoshaiah a feh ih amah cu Judah mi hotu a hrekin an thlun."},"33":{"text":"Cuih dungah a tanglam ih puithiam pawl in tawtawrawt tum phah in an thlun. Hmaisa bik ah Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam, Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah le Jeremiah an si. A sangtu ah Jonathan ih fapa le Shemaiah ih tu Zekhariah a si. (A pupa pawl cu Mattaniah, Mikaiah le Zakkur an si ih Asaf hrin an si.)","merge":"34"},"36":{"text":"Zekhariah cu a hrinpi unau pawl: Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah le Hanani pawl in an thlun ih an zatein Pathian ih minung Siangpahrang David ih a rak tummi awnmawi vek an keng ciar. Hi pawl cu an feh tikah Daan thiam Ezra in hmai a ṭhi."},"37":{"text":"Cerhti Kotka an thlen in David Khawpi ih hung fehnak kailawn an kai ih David Siangpahrang inn an lan hnuah khawpi nisuahnak lam Tidai Kotka ih phardawl ahcun an ra thleng sal."},"38":{"text":"Lungawi thusimtu bu dang pakhat cu phardawl parah cun kehlam ah an feh ih keimah le mi ṭhenkhat in kan thlun. Kan feh ih Meikhu suahnak Innsangpi timi kan lan ih Phar Kaupi timi kan thleng."},"39":{"text":"Cutawkin Efraim Kotka, Jeshanah Kotka, Nga Kotka, Hananel donhleisang le Zakhat donhleisang kan lan ih Tuu Kotka kan thlen hnuah Ralveng Kotka ah kan netter."},"40":{"text":"Cuticun an bu hnih in Pathian thangṭhat phah in Biakinn kiang an thleng. Ka hnenih a fehmi hotu pawl hlei ah,"},"41":{"text":"tawtawrawt tum phah in puithiam Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Mikaiah, Elioenai, Zekhariah le Hananiah pawl an tel."},"42":{"text":"Cule hla satu pawl ah Jezrahiah ho in Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkhijah, Elam le Ezer pawl an tel ih an aw neih patawp in hla an sak."},"43":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun thawinak tampi an pe ih lungawinak thawn an khat, ziangahtile Pathian in lungawizet dingin a tuah hai. Cuih lungawinak puai ahcun nunau le nauhak pawl tla an tel ih an thawmvang cu hlapi tiang a thang."},"44":{"text":"Culai ahcun an rawl hmaisa bik a cu mi le an thingrah kumtinte a rah hmaisa bik pawl le thawhlawm, ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat le a dangdang Biakinn hrangih an pekmi pawl retnak inn pawl kiltu dingah mi an ret. Hi an retmi pawl cun thilri retnak inn an kil ih tlunah, Daan sungih a um vekin puithiam pawl le Levi mi pawl hrangih an pek mi pawl cu khawpi kiangih a ummi lo ihsin an va khawm. Judah mi hmuahhmuah cu puithiam le Levi mi pawl parah an lung a awi ngaingai.","title":"Biakinn Ih An Pekmi Pawl"},"45":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pathian ih thupekmi vekin thil an tuah ih felzetin thianhlim thawinak tla an tuah a si. Cule biakinn hla satu pawl le biakinn kiltu pawl khalin siangpahrang David le a fapa Solomon ih thupekmi vekin, an hnaṭuan cu feltein an ṭuan."},"46":{"text":"Hlanlai ih siangpahrang David le hlathiam Asaf san lai ihsin hla satu pawl cu thangṭhatnak hla sak tikah le Pathian hnenih lungawi thusim tikah mi hotu an si ringring."},"47":{"text":"Zerubbabel san le Nehemiah san khalah Biakinn hla satu pawl le biakinn kiltu pawl pumcawmnak hrangah cun Israel mi pawl in nitinte thawhlawm an pe ringring a si. Senpi pawl in thawinak thianghlim cu Levi mi pawl hnenah an pek ih Levi mi pawl in an pek ding zat cu Aaron ih tesinfa puithiam pawl hrangah an pe ve."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih caanah Moses Daan cu ring zetin misenpi hnenah an siar ih an siar mi caang khat ah, Ammon mi le Moab mi pawl cu ziangtik khalah Pathian ih minung pawl lakah an tel thei lo pei, timi an hmu.","title":"Ramdang Mi Thawn An ṭhen Aw"},"2":{"text":"Ziangah cutin a um tile, Israel mi pawl Izipt ram ihsin an rak suah laiah Ammon mi le Moab mi pawl in in ei ding ti le rawl an rak pek lo ruangah a si. In ei ding ti le rawl an pek lo lawng si loin, Israel mi pawl camsiat dingah Balaam hnen riangri ah paisa an rak pek; asinain cuih camsiatnak cu kan Pathian in thlawsuahnak ah an hrangah a canter."},"3":{"text":"Israel misenpi in cuih Daan siarmi cu an theih tikah anmah sung ihsin ramdang mi pawl cu an dawi ṭheh a si."},"4":{"text":"Biakinn thilri retnak khaan pawl a uktu puithiam Eliashib le Tobiah cu caan reipi rualrem zetin an rak um.","title":"Nehemiah Ih A Remmi Pawl"},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Tobiah cu khaan tumpi pakhat a luahter; cuih khaan cu thawinak hrangih pekmi sangphut le rimhmui; Biakinn ih hmanmi thilri; puithiam pawl hrangih thawinak pek mi pawl; Levi mi pawl hnenih pek mi thawhlawm, ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat, le sabit le olif siti pawl, biakinn hla satu le biakinn kiltu pawl hrangih an pekmi hmuahhmuah retnak ah timi a si."},"6":{"text":"Cuti a si laiah cun Jerusalem khua ah ka um lo; Artakzaksis in Babilon Siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum sawmthum le kum hnih kum ah amah tong ding le thuhla than dingah ka feh. Malte a rei hnuah amah ih lungkimnak in,"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ah ka ra kir. Cule Biakinn thilri retnak khaan pakhat Eliashib in Tobiah a hmanter ti ka hmuh tikah ka thin a heng ngaingai."},"8":{"text":"Ka thinheng in Tobiah ih thilri hmuahhmuah cu ka hlon ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Cun thilri retnak khaan pawl cu thianhlim thawinak tuah dingah le a sungah Biakinn thilri, thawinak sangphut le rimhmui pawl ret dingah thu ka pek."},"10":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Levi mi pawl le Biakinn hla satu pawl cu misenpi pawl in rawl ei khop an pek thei lo ruangah Jerusalem an suahsan ih an lo ciarah an tlung thluh ti ka thei."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah hotu bawi pawl cu, “Ziangah so Bawipa ih Biakinn cu nan daithlan ih nan ṭhinter?” tiah ka mawhthluk hai. Levi mi le hla satu pawl cu ka ko sal ih an hnaṭuan cu ka ṭuanter sal."},"12":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl in an thawhlawm rawl, sabitti le olif hriak pawl cu Biakinn thilri retnak khaanah an rak keng sal."},"13":{"text":"A tanglam mi pawl cu thilri retnak khaan kiltu ah ka ret: puithiam Shelemiah, Daan thiamtu Zadok le Levi mi Pedaiah. Zakkur ih fapa le Mattaniah ih tu Hanan cu anmah bawmtu ah ka ret. Himi pawl cu hnaṭuantu dang an unau hnenah ti rawl ṭhatein an zem ding, tiih ka rinsan mi an si."},"14":{"text":"Maw ka Pathian, nangmah biaknak le na Biakinn hrangih hi thil ka tuah mi hmuahhmuah hi hngilh hram hlah aw."},"15":{"text":"Culai ah Judah mi pawl in Sabbath ni ah sabit rah an rial rero kha ka hmu. Midang tla an sangphut, an sabitti le sabit rah, an theipi rah, le thil dangdang pawl an laak parah suangin Jerusalem ih an phurh rero kha ka hmu. Sabbath ni ahcun zianghman zuar lo dingin ralrinnak ka pek hai."},"16":{"text":"Cule ṭai-ar khua mi Jerusalem ih a ummi pawl in Sabbath ni ah kan milai pawl hnenih zuar dingah nga le thildang a phunphun an run phur."},"17":{"text":"Judah mi hotu pawl cu ka kawk ih, “Thil ṭha lo nan tuah mi hi zohhnik uh! Sabbath ni nan buar a si."},"18":{"text":"Hi vek hi nan pupa pawl in an tuah ruangah sokhaw Pathian ih hremnak an tuar ih hi khawpi tla siatsuah thluh a rak si! Cucingin Sabbath ni cu nan borhhlawhter ih Israel parah Pathian thinhengnak nan thlenter sinsin,” tiah ka mawhthluk hai."},"19":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah zanlam tikcu a thlen ih Sabbath ni a thok tinte in khua kotka pawl cu khar dingah le acuih Sabbath ni a cem hlan lo kotka cu on lo dingin thu ka pek. Sabbath ni ahcun khawsungah thilri zianghman luhter lo dingin ka minung hrekkhat pawl cu kotka pawl ka kilter fawn."},"20":{"text":"Voihnih voikhat cu dawrtuahtu thil a phunphun zuartu pawl cu khawpi hauhruang lengah tlawngkai ni nga zanvaarte an riak ṭheu."},"21":{"text":"Cupawl hnenah cun, “Thaizing tiang hngak duh hlah uh, nan hngak lak ding. Nan zuar tum thotho asile napi in ka lo tuah ding,” tiah ralrinnak ka pek. Cuih hnu cun Sabbath ni ah an rasal nawn lo."},"22":{"text":"Cule Levi mi pawl cu anmah thianhlimnak tuah dingah le Sabbath ni thianghlim teih ul dingah kotka cu ṭhatein nan kil pei, tiah thu ka pek. Maw ka Pathian, hi thil ka tuah mi hmuahhmuah hi hngilh hram hlah awla na duhdawtnak a tum vekin na zaangfahnak cu ka hnenah thlenter hram aw."},"23":{"text":"Culai ahcun Judah mi mipa tampi in miphun dang nunau Ashdod mi, Ammon mi le Moab mi pawl an ṭhi ti ka thei."},"24":{"text":"An hrinmi an faate a hrek pawl cu Ashdod ṭong le ṭong dangdang an ṭong ih kan ṭong an thiam nawn lo."},"25":{"text":"Cuih mipa pawl cu ka kawk ih ka cam ka riam hai. Ka vuak ka velh hai ih an sam tla ka phawisak. Cule anmah siseh, an faate pawl siseh, miphun dang pawl ih fanu ṭhi nawn lo ding le an fapa pawl pasal nawn lo dingah Pathian hmin saal in siatcam thukamnak ka tuahter."},"26":{"text":"An hnenah, “Siangpahrang Solomon sualtertu cu ramdang nunau an si. Amah cu miphun dang siangpahrang hmuahhmuah hnakin a tum sawn. Pathian in amah cu a duhdawt ih Israel mi zate tlunah Siangpahrang ah a tuah. Asinain cuih sualnak sungah a tla."},"27":{"text":"Cutiin maw nan ziaza ṭha lo cu thlun in miphun dang nunau nan ṭhit dingih nan Pathian ih thupekmi cu thlun loin kan um ve ding?” tiah ka ti."},"28":{"text":"Puithiam Sang Eliashib ih fapa cu Joiada a si. Asinain Joiada fapa pakhat in Beth Horon khuami Sanballat fanu a ṭhi. Curuangah amah Joiada cu Jerusalem ihsin ka dawi suak."},"29":{"text":"Maw ka Pathian, himi pawl in puithiam hnaṭuan le, puithiam le Levi mi pawl thawn thukamnak na tuahmi an buar zia hi ciing ringring hram aw."},"30":{"text":"Cun senpi pawl cu an lakah mi phundangta zianghman um hrimhrim lo dingin thianfainak ka tuahter thluh. Puithiam le Levi mi pawl in an hnaṭuan theifel dingah daan pawl ka tuahsak."},"31":{"text":"Tikcu khiah mi kim tikih thawinak pekmi pawl urnak dingah zanthing le rawlthar le thingrah thar thawinak hrangih pek dingmi pawl khal ka ngaihtuah sak. Maw ka Pathian, hipawl hi a ṭha lamin i run thei hram aw."}}}}},"17":{"info":{"name":"Esther","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Esther"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Xerxes cu siangpahrang a si ih Persia ram khawpi Susa ih a siangpahrang tokham ihsin India in Ethiopia tiang ramṭhen za le kul hluansarih a uk.","title":"Vashti In Siangpahrang Xerxes Thu A El","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang a ṭuan kum thumnak ah a kuthnuai bawi pawl le a ramṭhen uktu bawi pawl hrangah rawl ei puai tumpi pakhat a tuah. Cuih puai ahcun Persia le Media ralkap pawl le ramṭhen uktu bawi le phun upa tampi an tel."},"4":{"text":"A thilri neihzia le a lenzia cu mi ih zoh dingah thlaruk sung rori a hmuh."},"5":{"text":"Cuih hnuah cun siangpahrang bawipa in Susa khawpi sungih a ummi mipa hmuahhmuah, milian siseh, mi farah siseh, an zate hrangah rawl ei puai a tuah. Siangpahrang inn tualah zarh khat sung puai cu a tuah."},"6":{"text":"Tual cu pat puanzar a rang le mepian pawl in an ceimawi ih cuih puan pawl cu pat phangfem in lungrang ṭhuam parih ngunkual ah an khih. Tual cu lungrang, lungsen, lungvar, lung mepian le lunghring pawl in an phah ih cuih parah cun sui le ngun in tuahmi tokham tampi an hung."},"7":{"text":"Sabitti cu sui khuat a phunphun in an pek. Siangpahrang a si bangtuk in sabitti cu tirhsiang zetin a pek a si."},"8":{"text":"An sabitti in ding cu a zat leiteek an tuah lo. An duhzat ciar in in hai seh, tiah Siangpahrang in a hnaṭuantu pawl cu thu a pek."},"9":{"text":"Culai ahcun Siangpahrang inn ah Siangpahrang bawinu Vashti in nunau hrangah rawl ei puai a rak tuah ve."},"10":{"text":"Rawl ei puai a tuahnak ni sarih ni ah siangpahrang bawipa cu a sabitti in mi in a thinlung a puamter. Curuangah tilper mi amah riantu pasarih Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar le Karkas a ko ih,"},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawinu Vashti cu a sui lukhuh khum tahrat in a hnenih ratpi dingah thu a pek. Siangpahrang bawinu cu mi mawi ngaingai a si ih a sawmmi le a kuthnuai bawi pawl ih hmaiah a nupi mawizia cu uarawknak thawn a hmuh hai."},"12":{"text":"Asinain siangpahrang bawinu an va sim tikah siangpahrang bawipa ih thu cu a el ih a ra duh lo. Cutikah Siangpahrang bawipa cu a thin a heng ngaingai; a thinhengzia cu a so in a so."},"13":{"text":"Cun thil thupi le thu harsa a um tikah siangpahrang bawipa in ruahnak petu pawl ih ruahnak cu a sut hmaisa ṭheu. Curuangah amah ruahnak petu pawl, ziangtuah le a ṭha ding ti a theitu pawl a sut."},"14":{"text":"An ruahnak a suh bik ṭheumi pawl cu: Karshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena le Memukan an si. Hi bawi pasarih cu Persia le Media ramah bawi upa bik pawl an si ih Siangpahrang ton theinak neitu an si."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa cun an hnenah, “Keimah siangpahrang Xerxes in ka hnen-um pawl ka thlah ih siangpahrang bawinu raseh, tiah thu ka pek. Asinain a ra duh lo. Curuangah a daan vekin ziangso ka tuah ding?” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Memukan in Siangpahrang bawipa le a kuthnuai bawi pawl hnenah cun, “Siangpahrang bawinu Vashti in Siangpahrang bawipa a hmuhsuam a si; Siangpahrang bawipa a hmuhsuam lawng si loin a kuthnuai ih a ummi bawi pawl le a ram sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah khal in hmuhsuam ṭheh ve a si."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawinu ih nuncan hi an theih tikah na uknak sungih a ummi nunau hmuahhmuah in an pasal cu zianghman ah an siar nawn lo ding. Nunau hmuahhmuah in, ‘Siangpahrang bawipa Xerxes in siangpahrang bawinu Vashti a ko naón a feh duh lo,’ an ti thlang ding."},"18":{"text":"Persia ram le Media ram sungih a ummi fala hmuahhmuah in siangpahrang bawinu ih nuncan cu tuihsun ni a tlak hlanah na kuthnuai bawi pawl hnenah an sim thluh ding. Cuticun na thu ngaih lonak le hnahnawhnak cu ziangtik hmanah a reh thei nawn lo ding a si."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Siangpahrang bawipa na lung a kim ahcun, ‘Siangpahrang bawipa cu ziangtik hmanah Vashti in a tong thei nawn lo ding,’ tiah Persia ram le Media ramsung daan cabu sungah nganter aw. Cule a ai-awhtu ah aṭha deuhmi siangpahrang bawinu dang hawl aw."},"20":{"text":"Hi tluk a tum le a kaumi na uknak ram sungah hin na thupekmi a than ṭheh tikah cun nunau hmuahhmuah in an pasal cu, milian an si khalle, mifarah an si khalle, an upat ciar ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cuih thu cu siangpahrang bawipa le a kuthnuai bawi pawl in an theih tikah an lung a kim ṭheh ih Memukan simmi vek cun siangpahrang bawipa in a tuah."},"22":{"text":"A ram sungah cun ca a kuat ṭheh ih innsang pakhat sungah an pasal cu thuneitu bik a si ding, tiah an peng le an ram ciarah an ṭong ciar in thu a than ṭheh."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah, a thinhengnak a daihsal tikah, siangpahrang bawipa cun Vashti thil tuahmi le a tlunih thu a pekmi cu a ruat sal.","title":"Esther Cu Siangpahrang Bawinu A Cang"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah a ruahnak petu hrekkhat pawl in, “Ziangah so na hrangah fala mawi pakhatkhat kan hawl lo?"},"3":{"text":"Na uk sung ramṭhen kipah na kuthnuai ih bawi pawl thlah awla fala mawi hmuahhmuah cu hi siangpahrang umnak Susa Khawpi ih siangpahrang nusun pawl umnak inn ahhin rak hruai hai sehla nunau kiltu tilpermi Hegai zohter aw. Cunah rak ceimawi hai seh."},"4":{"text":"Cule na duh bikmi fala cu la awla Vashti ai-ah siangpahrang bawinu ah tuah aw,” tiah an ti. Cumi cu siangpahrang lungkim zawng a si ih an tivek cun a tuah."},"5":{"text":"Cuih Susa Khawpi ahcun Mordekai an timi Judah mi pakhat a um. Mordekai cu Jair ih fapa a si ih Benjamin phun, Kish le Shimei tesinfa a si."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Judah Siangpahrang Jehoiakhin le a minung pawl Babilon ah sal ih a hruai tikah Mordekai khal a rak tel ve."},"7":{"text":"Mordekai hnenah a paseu ih fanu Esther an timi a um; Esther ih Hebru hmin cu Hadassah a si. A nu le pa an thih hnuah Esther cu Mordekai in a cawm ih a fanu ngaingai vekin a zoh. Esther cu fala mawizet a si ih a ruangrai khal a ṭhazet."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang thupekmi an than ih fala tampi Susa Khawpi ih an ratpi tikah Esther khal cu an hruai ve. Esther cu siangpahrang inn ih nunau umnak khaan ahcun an ret ih Hegai in a zoh."},"9":{"text":"Hegai in Esther cu a duhzet ih ṭha deuh in a zoh. Ceimawi awknak a phunphun a pek; a taksa a hmehsak ih rawl tla ṭha cuangin a pek. Esther zohtu dingah siangpahrang inn ihsin a hrilmi fala pasarih a ret."},"10":{"text":"Cun Esther in Judah mi a si kha a phuang dah lo; Mordekai in phuang lo dingih a tiam ruangah Esther cun a thup ringring."},"11":{"text":"Nitinte in Mordekai cu Esther ziangvekin a um ti le ziangtin a um leh pei, ti theih duh ah siangpahrang nusun pawl umnak inn tual hmaiah a feh ṭheu."},"12":{"text":"Cuih fala pawl ceimawi dingah kum khat a rei. Thla ruk sung mura zihmui thawn an taksa an hmehsak ih, a dang thlaruk sung balsam zihmui thawn an taksa an hmehsak. Cuih hnuah fala pawl cu pakhat pakhat in siangpahrang Xerxes hmaiah cun fehpi ding an si."},"13":{"text":"An umnak inn ihsin Siangpahrang inn ih an feh tikah an duhmi ziangvek khal an hruk thei."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn ahcun zanlam ah feh ding an si ih a thaizing ah a dang nunau pawl umnak inn ah feh ding an si. Cutawkah cun siangpahrang nusun pawl zohtu tilpermi Shaashgaz in a zoh hai ding. Siangpahrang in a duh ih a hmin in a kawh sal lomi cu zo fala hman siangpahrang hnenah fehsal ding an si nawn lo."},"15":{"text":"Ni khat cu Esther feh caan a ra thleng. Esther, Modekai paseu Abihail ih fanu, Mordekai in amah fanu ngaingai bangtuk ih a cawmmi cu, a hmutu hmuahhmuah ih uarmi a si. Siangpahrang hnen ih a feh tikah cun siangpahrang nusun pawl umnak inn zohtu Hegai ih simmi hnipuan cu a hruk."},"16":{"text":"Cuticun Xerxes Siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum sarih kum, thlahra thla, Tebeth thla ahcun Siangpahrang inn sung siangpahrang Xerxes hmaiah Esther cu a thleng."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa in fala dang pawl hnakin Esther cu a duh cuang; mithmai a pekmi le a ngaimi fala dang pawl hnak khalin Esther cu a ngai sawn a si. Curuangah siangpahrang lukhuh cu Esther a khumter ih Vashti ai-ah Esther cu siangpahrang bawinu ah a tuah."},"18":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in Esther upatnak ah rawl ei puai tumpi a tuah ih a kuthnuai bawi pawl hmuahhmuah le ramṭhen uktu bawi pawl a ko ṭheh. A uksung hmuahhmuah ah colh-um caan a pek ih a thil neih vekin siang zetin laksawng a zem ciamco."},"19":{"text":"Cule fala pawl a voihnihnak an khawm-awk tikah, Mordekai cu hnaṭuan pakhat siangpahrang in a pek.","title":"Mordekai In Siangpahrang A Hum Suak"},"20":{"text":"Mordekai ih a rak tiam cia vekin Esther cun Judah mi a si cu a phuang dah lo. Phuang lo dingin Mordekai in a tiam ih nauhakte a si laiih a thu a rak ngai vekin atu khalah Mordekai ih thu cu a ngai a si."},"21":{"text":"Mordekai cu siangpahrang zungih hnaṭuantu pakhat a si laiah siangpahrang innkhaan sangka pawl kiltu tilpermi pahnih Bigthana le Teresh in Siangpahrang Xerxes cu an ngaih deuh lo ruangah an phiar ih a thah an tum."},"22":{"text":"Cumi cu Mordekai in a thei ih siangpahrang bawinu Esther a sim. Esther in cuih thu cu siangpahrang bawipa a sim sin."},"23":{"text":"An zingzoi tikah thudik a si ti an thei ih an pahnih in thlaithahnak parah an thlai that hai. Cuih thu hmuahhmuah cu siangpahrang ih thupeknak vekin kimtein siangpahrang ramsung thu hminsinnak cabu sungah an khum."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tikcu a hung rei deuh tikah, siangpahrang Xerxes in Haman an ti mipa cu a kuthnuai bawi pawl hmuahhmuah lakih bawi upa bik ah a tuah. Haman cu Hammedatha ih fapa a si ih Agag ih tesinfa a si.","title":"Haman In Judah Mi Siatsuah A Tum"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang in a kuthnuai ih hnaṭuantu hmuahhmuah hnen ah, “Haman cu nan upat pei ih a hmai ah khukbil in nan lu nan kun pei,” tiah thu a pek. Curuangah an zatein Siangpahrang ih thupekmi vek cun an tuah. Asinain Mordekai cun a tuah duh lo."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang hnaṭuantu bawi dang pawl in, “Ziangah so siangpahrang thu cu na thlun duh lo?” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Nikhat hnu ni khat an sim rero naón an thu cu a ngai thotho lo. Mordekai cun, “Kei cu Judah mi ka si ih Haman hmai ahcun ka lu ka kun thei lo,” a ti. Cuih thu cu Haman an sim ih Mordekai ih um daan hi a zawi-aw thei ngai pei maw, tiah an mang a bang."},"5":{"text":"Haman hmaiah Mordekai cu a khukbil in a lu a kun lo ding, ti a theih tikah Haman cu a thin a heng ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Mordekai cu Judah mi a si ti a theih tikah cun Mordekai pakhat lawng hrem ding cu a lung a kim nawn lo. Persia ram sungih Judah mi hmuahhmuah thah ṭheh a tum."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang Xerxes in siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum hleihnih kum, thlakhat thla, Nisan thla ahcun, mi a phiarnak ding ni le thla theih duh ah Haman in “Purim,” an timi camcawhfung zuuk dingah thu a pek. An zuh tikah thla hleihnih thla, Adar thla ni hleithumnak an zuuk."},"8":{"text":"Cule Haman in Siangpahrang hnenah, “Bawipa, na uksung le na ramṭhen kipah hin mi phunkhat an um ih an thil tidaan tla cu miphun dang pawl ih thil tidaan thawn an bang aw lo. Cuih tlunah na ukmi ram sungih daan khal an thlun duh lo. Curuangah hiti ih zoh men dingah hin na hrangah a ṭha lo a si."},"9":{"text":"Na lung a kim a si ahcun himi pawl hi thah ṭheh dingah thu pe aw. Cutiih na tuah asile na ram uknak hrangih hman dingah na tangka inn sungah ngun tangka cuai thawng zahnih le thawng sawmli keimah hrimhrim in ka pek thei ding, tiah ka lo kam a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in a thupekmi pawl hmual nei dingah a hminkhennak zunghruk cu a phuak ih Judah mi pawl a huatu Agag tesinfa Hammedatha ih fapa Haman hnenah cun a pek."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang in Haman cu, “Cuih tangka cu na kut sungah ka lo pek; minung pawl khal ka lo pek cih. Ṭha na ti bangin na duhduh in tuah aw,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah thlakhat thla, ni hleithumnak ni ah, Haman in siangpahrang ih sungṭuan pawl cu a ko ih thuthan ding mi cu a auh hai. Ramsung ramṭhen kipih an hmanmi ca in siseh, miphunkip hnenah anmah ih ṭong ciar in siseh, an kuat ih ramṭhen uktu bawi le bawi dangdang hnen tla ah an kuat ṭheh. Cuih ca cu Siangpahrang Xerxes hmin in an ngan ih a zunghruk in tacik an khen."},"13":{"text":"Mi an thlah mi pawl in an ramsung khuazakip ah an fehpi. Thla hleihnih thla, Adar thla, ni hleithum ni, ni khat sungah Judah mi hmuahhmuah cu nunau, mipa ti lo, upa nauhak ti loin, thah thluh ding an si. Zaangfahnak zianghman um loin an ci ih hmih thluh ding an si; an thilri hmuahhmuah khal lon thluh ding an si."},"14":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in an theih ih cuih ni ih an timtuah ciarnak dingah cuih ca cu ramṭhen tin ah than thluh ding a si zo."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang ih thupek vekin mi an thlah mi pawl cun zamrangte in khuazakip ah cuih thu cu an than. Susa Khawpi khalah cuih thu cu an than. Cule cuih thuthannak ruangah Susa khawsungmi pawl cu mangbang ih an um lai ah siangpahrang bawipa le Haman cu an to ih zu an in tlang."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule cutiih thil tawlrelnak a um cu Mordekai in a theih tikah a thinpit in a hnipuan a thlek ṭheh. Cule buri hnipuan in a thuam aw ih a lu ah vutcam phulh aw in ṭap phah le ai phah in khawpi sungah a feh.","title":"Mordekai In Esther Bomnak A Dil"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn kotka a va thleng; asinain a sungah cun a lut lo, ziangahtile thilthuam ṭhateih thuam awk locun zohman luh daan a si lo."},"3":{"text":"Persia ramsung khuazakipah, siangpahrang ih thupekmi an thannak kipah cun Judah mi pawl cu ṭap le ai in an um ṭheh. Rawl an ul, an ṭap, an raak; buri hnipuan an sin ih vutcam lakah an it."},"4":{"text":"Mordekai cutiih a um cu Esther ih nunau hnen-um pawl le amah kiltu tilpermi pawl in Esther cu an sim tikah a thin a nuam lo ngaingai. Mordekai hnenah hnipuan thlengnak ding Esther in a kuat naón Mordekai cun a la duh fawn lo."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang bawipa in amah kiltu dingih a retmi tilper mipa Hathak cu Esther in a ko ih Mordekai cutiih a umnak thuhla va sut dingah a hei thlah."},"6":{"text":"Hathak cu Mordekai hnenah, siangpahrang inn kotka hmai ih tualrawn ahcun a va feh."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Mordekai in thuhla hmuahhmuah cu a rak sim ih Judah mi hmuahhmuah thah ṭheh an si ahcun siangpahrang tangka inn ah Haman in tangka pek dingih a kammi zat tla a sim ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Judah mi siatsuah thluh dingah thupeknak Susa Khawpi ih an suah mi tla cu Hathak hnenah pakhat a pek. Mordekai in cuih ca cu Esther pe tahratih thu um daan khal simfiang dingin le siangpahrang hnenah Esther cu feh in a phunpi pawl hrangih zaangfahnak dil dingah Esther cu thu a cah."},"9":{"text":"Mordekai thucahmi vek cun Hathak in a tuah ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Esther in Hathak cu Mordekai hnenah a thlah sal ih,"},"11":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat, nunau siseh, mipa siseh, siangpahrang bawipa ih kawh loin siangpahrang umnak khaan sungih a luh a si ahcun thah a si pei, ti cu daan a si. Siangpahrang ruahnak petu pawl thokin ramṭhen sungih mi hmuahhmuah in cuih daan cu an thei ṭheh. Hi daan ihsin luat theinak lamzin ziangti hman in a um lo; Siangpahrang bawipa in a sui kianghrol a thlir lawngah cupa, a si lole cunu cu thihnak ihsin a luat thei. Keimah khal siangpahrang bawipa in i kawh lonak thla khat a si zo,” tiih sim dingah a fial."},"12":{"text":"Mordekai in Esther ih thucahmi cu a theih tikah,"},"13":{"text":"Esther hnenah cun hiti in ralrinnak a pek: “Siangpahrang inn ih na um ruangah Judah midang pawl hnakin ka him deuh ding, tiah ruat duh hlah."},"14":{"text":"Hi bangtuk tikcu ahhin daiziar ih na um a si ahcun, van ihsin Judah mi bomnak cu a ra ding ih in run ding; asinain nang cu na thi ding ih na pa ih innsang cu a cem ding a si. Hi bangtuk tikcu hrangah siangpahrang bawinu ih na cannak khal hi a rak si lo ding maw si? Zoso a thei?” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Esther in Mordekai hnenah thu a cah sal ih,"},"16":{"text":"“Feh awla Susa Khawpi ih Judah mi hmuahhmuah kokhawm aw; rawl ul uhla ka hrangah thlacam uh. Ni thum le zan thum sung ziang hman ei lo le in loin rak um uh. Kei le ka hnen-um nunau pawl tla cuticun kan rak um ve ding. Cuih hnuah, daan a si lo naón, Siangpahrang hnenah ka feh ding. Curuangih ka thih ahcun ka thi ko pei,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule Mordekai cu a feh ih Esther ih thucahmi vekin a tuah thluh."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni thum sung rawl a ulh hnuah Esther cu siangpahrang bawinu thuam in a thuam-aw ih siangpahrang inn sungta khaan ah a feh ih siangpahrang tokham lam hoi in a va ding. Siangpahrang bawipa cu sangka lam hoi in a siangpahrang tokham parah a rak to.","title":"Esther In Siangpahrang Le Haman Rawl Ei A Ko"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa in siangpahrang bawinu Esther sangka lengih a din kha a hmuh tikah mithmai ṭha a pek ih a sui kianghrol cu a thlir. Esther in a hei naih ih a kianghrol zim cu a tham."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang bawipa in, “Ziang so na duh, Siangpahrang bawinu Esther? Na duhmi cu i sim awla ka ram ukmi a hrek a si khalle ka lo pe ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Esther in, “Siangpahrang bawipa na lung a kim ahcun, rawl ka suang ih tuihzan nangmah le Haman cu ka hnenih zanriah ei dingah ka lo sawm a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Esther duhnak kimter dingah Siangpahrang bawipa in Haman cu zamrangih kawh dingah thu a pek. Cuih zan cu Esther hnenah zanriah an ei."},"6":{"text":"Sabitti an in ih siangpahrang in, “Na duhmi cu i sim aw, ka lo pe ding. I dilmi cu, ka ram ukmi a hrek a si khalle ka lo pe ding,” tiah Esther cu a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule Esther in,"},"8":{"text":"“Siangpahrang bawipa na lung a kim ih ka lo dilmi i pek tum a si ahcun thaizan Haman thawn ka hnenah zanriah ei hrih dingin ka lo sawm. Cutikah ka lo dil duhmi cu ka lo sim leh ding,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Haman cu zanriah a einak ihsin lungawizet le thinnuamzet in inn ah a tin. Siangpahrang inn kotka kiangah Mordekai a hmu ih a kiangih a feh tikah Mordekai cun upatnak zianghman a pe lo ih a thawh hman a tho lo; curuangah Haman cu a thin a heng ngaingai.","title":"Haman In Mordekai Thah A Tum"},"10":{"text":"Asinain a thin a suup ih inn ah a tlung. A inn ah a rualpi pawl a sawm ih a nupi Zeresh tla a ko ih,"},"11":{"text":"an hnenah cun a lennak le fapa tampi a neihnak, siangpahrang in bawi upa bikih a tuahnak le bawi dang hnakin amah a thupit zia pawl cu a rel ih tluang a khawng ciamco."},"12":{"text":"“Hi hmuahhmuah tlunah siangpahrang bawinu Esther in siangpahrang bawipa le keimah lawng zanriah in do; thaizan khal a hnenah zanriah kan ei hrih ding."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla khi Judah pa Mordekai, siangpahrang kotka kiangih a to ka hmuh sungah cun hi ka relmi pawl khal hi ka hrangah thulolak ah a cang ṭheh,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah a nupi le a rualpi pawl in, “Ziangah so minung thlai thahnak pi sawmsarih le pi nga saangin na tuah lo? Thaizing ah Mordekai thlai dingin siangpahrang na sim pei ih zanlam ah thinnuam tein rawl na zawh leh pei,” tiah an ti. Cuih an simmi cu Haman in ruahnak ṭhazet a si, tiah a ruat ih thlaithahnak cu a tuah."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih zan cu siangpahrang bawipa a itthat thei lo; curuangah a ram uk sungih hnaṭuanmi thu hminsinnak cabu kha a siarter.","title":"Siangpahrang In Mordekai Upatnak A Pek"},"2":{"text":"An siarmi sungah cun siangpahrang innkhaan pawl a kiltu tilpermi pahnih Bigthana le Teresh in siangpahrang cu an phiar ih a thah an tum; asinain cumicu Mordekai in a thei ih a phuang, ti thu a tel."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in, “Hi bangtuk thil ṭha a tuah ruangah Mordekai cu hminṭhatnak laksawng ziangtal kan pe maw?” tiah a sut. A hnen-um pawl in, “A hrangah zianghman tuahmi a um lo,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in, “Atu-ah ka inn ahhin ka kuthnuai bawi pakhat tal an um maw?” tiah a sut. Culai ahcun, Haman cu Siangpahrang hnen ihsin Mordekai thahnak thu dil dingah siangpahrang inntual ah a ra thleng ve; Mordekai thlainak ah tiah thlaithahnak cu a tuah thluh zo."},"5":{"text":"Cule a hnen-um pawl cun, “Haman a um; nangmah ton a lo duh a si,” tiah Siangpahrang cu an ti. Siangpahrang bawipa cun, “Rung lutseh,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Haman cu a vung lut ih, siangpahrang in a hnenah, “Upatnak ka pek duhzetmi pakhat a um. A hrangah ziangso ka tuah ding?” tiah a sut. Cutikah Haman cun, “Siangpahrang in hitluk lawmmam ih upatnak a pek duhmi cu zo a si pei? Keimah ti lo zoso a um cuang ding,” tiah a thinlung tein a ruat."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang hnen ahcun, “Bawipa, upatnak na pek duhzet mipa hrangah cun na siangpahrang thuam le nangmah ih to ṭheumi rang le na sui lukhuh lak suakter aw.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Cule na kuthnuai bawi pawl lakih upa bik pakhat in cupa cu na thilthuam pawl cun thuamter sehla na rang parah toter in khawsung in rang cu hruaisak seh. Cule na kuthnuai bawipa cun an feh phah ahcun, ‘Siangpahrang bawipa in upatnak pek a duhmi parah upatnak a pek zia hi zohhnik uh,’ tiah au phah seh,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in Haman hnenah cun, “Zamrang in feh awla ka thilthuam le ka rang cu va la awla Judah mi Mordekai va pe aw. Atuih na sim vekcun Mordekai hrangah tuah thluh aw. Siangpahrang inn kotka kiangah Mordekai cu a um ding,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Haman in siangpahrang thuam le rang cu a va lak ih thuam cu Mordekai a hrukter. Rang parah Mordekai cu a toter ih Haman in khawsung ahcun rang cu a hruaisak ih an feh phah ahcun, “Siangpahrang bawipa in upatnak pek a duhmi parah upatnak a pek zia hi zohhnik uh,” tiah a au phah vivo."},"12":{"text":"Mordekai cu siangpahrang inn kotka ahcun a kir ih Haman cu ningzak in innah ningzak hmaihup phah in a tin."},"13":{"text":"Cuih thuhla hmuahhmuah cu a nupi le a rualpi pawl hnenah a sim thluh. Cutikah a nupi le mifimzet a rualpi pawl in a hnenah, “Mordekai in a lo laan deuh zo a si cu! Anih cu Judah mi a si ih ziangti hmanin na ti thei nawn lo ding. A lo neh tengteng ding a si,” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutiih an ṭong rero lai ahcun siangpahrang inn ih tilpermi pawl an ra ih Haman cu Esther ih zanriah do-nakah zamrangin an feh pi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuticun siangpahrang le Haman cu rawl ei dingah Esther hnenah,","title":"Haman An That"},"2":{"text":"a voihnihnak an feh. Sabitti an in ih siangpahrang in Esther cu, “Atu-ah, siangpahrang bawinu Esther, na duhmi cu i sim awla ka lo pe ko ding. Ka ram ukmi a hrek hman ka lo pe ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang bawinu Esther in, “Maw Siangpahrang bawipa, tangdornak thawn ka lo dilmi i pek tum a si ahcun, ka nunnak le ka miphun pawl ih nunnak hi in zuah hram aw, ti ka lo dil a si."},"4":{"text":"Ka miphun pawl le keimah hi thah thluh dingah phiartu an um; kannih hi siatsuah thluh ding le kan ci ih hmit thluh ding kan si. Sal ih zuar ding lawng si nungla cu siangpahrang bawipa zianghman hnahnawhnak pek loin daiziar in ka um ding naón, atu cu cuvek a si lo; kan ci ih hmit thluh ding kan si,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Xerxes in, “Cubangtuk thil tuah a tum ngamtu cu zoso a si? Khuiah so a um?” tiah Esther cu a sut."},"6":{"text":"Esther in, “In raltu le in hremtu cu hi miṭha lo pa Haman hi a si,” tiah a ti. Cumi a theih tikah Haman cu a khur thlohthlo ih zianghman a ṭong thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang cu a thinheng in a tho ih a leng ih hmuan ah a va feh. Siangpahrang in i zuah lo ding, ti cu Haman cun a thei keukeu. Curuangah a tonak ahcun a to ih a nunnak hum dingah siangpahrang bawinu Esther cu a dil ciamco."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu hmuan ihsin rawl einak khaan sungih a rung luhsal tikah, zaangfahnak dil phah in Haman cu Esther ih tokham parah a sep-aw. Cutikah Siangpahrang bawipa cun, “Hi pa hi ka innsung le ka hmaika rori ah siangpahrang bawinu a kaihrem tum maw si?” tiah a au ciamco. Cumi hman siangpahrang in a ṭong ṭheh hlanah amah kiltu pawl in Haman ih hmai cu an khuh."},"9":{"text":"Cule anmah lakih pakhat pa Harbonah in, “Siangpahrang bawipa ih nunnak a hum suaktu Mordekai thlainak ah tiah Haman in a inn ah thlaithahnak hman a tuah thluh zo sokhaw. Cuih thlaithahnak cu pi sawmsarih le pi nga a sang a si,” tiah a ti. Siangpahrang in, “Cutawkah Haman hi va thlai uh,” tiah thu a pek."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Haman cu Mordekai thahnak ih a tuah mi thlaithahnak ahcun an thlai that. Cule Siangpahrang ih thin cu a dai sal."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih sunah siangpahrang Xerxes in Judah mi a huatu Haman ih thilri hmuahhmuah cu siangpahrang bawinu Esther hnenah a pek. Cuih si cun Mordekai cu siangpahrang umnak ah a lut thei.","title":"Judah Mi Pawl In Do Ve Ding An Sim"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang in a hminkhennak, (Haman hnenih sin a lakmi) a zunghruk cu a phuak ih Mordekai a pek. Cule Esther in Mordekai cu Haman thilri kiltu dingah a ret."},"3":{"text":"Cun Esther in siangpahrang kehram ah ṭap phah in a sep-aw ih siangpahrang bawipa cu a biak sal. A thilri pawl tla Esther ka pe thluh zo."},"8":{"text":"Asinain siangpahrang hmin in le siangpahrang hminkhennak ih khen ciami thuthannak cu bal sal a theih nawn lo a si. Sikhalsehla nan duh ahcun Judah mi hnenah nan duhmi hmuahhmuah ngan uh; ka hmin in ngan uhla ka hminkhennak in khen uh,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cuih ni cu thla thum thla, Sivan thla, ni kul hluanthum ni a si. Mordekai in siangpahrang cangantu hmuahhmuah a ko ih, India in Ethiopia tiang a kaumi ram, ramṭhen za le kul hluansarih uktu bawi le ram uktu bawi pawl le Judah mi pawl hnenih kuat dingmi ca cu a auh. Cuih ca cu ramṭhen kipih an hmanmi an ṭong ciar in le Judah mi hnenah cun Judah ṭong in an ngan."},"10":{"text":"Mordekai in cuih ca cu siangpahrang Xerxes hmin in a ngan ih siangpahrang hminkhennak in a khen. Mi an thlah mi pawl cun siangpahrang ranginn ih a ummi rang pawl to in cuih ca cu khuazakip ah an tlanpi."},"11":{"text":"Cuih ca sungah cun, siangpahrang in khawkip ih a ummi Judah mi pawl cu kom-aw in ṭantlang theinak thu a pek. Khuitawk ramṭhen le zo miphun an si hmanah hriamnam thawn Judah mi pawl an do a si ahcun Judah mi pawl in do kir dingah thu a pek. An do kir lawng hman si loin an faate le an nupi pawl thawn thah thluh ding, mi pakhat hman zuah loin thah thluh ding le an thilri hmuahhmuah tla lak thluh dingin thu a pek."},"12":{"text":"Cuih thupekmi cu Persia ram sung hmuahhmuah ah Judah mi pawl thah ding ni, thla hleihnih thla, Adar thla, ni hleithum ni ah tuah suak ding a si."},"13":{"text":"Cuih thu cu thlun ṭulmi daan a si ding ih cumi a kim tikah Judah mi pawl an rak ṭan thei venak dingah ramṭhen kipah than ding a si."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang thupek vekin, rangtotu pawl cu siangpahrang rang to in zamrang in an tlan. Cuih thu cu siangpahrang umnak Susa Khawpi tla ah an than."},"15":{"text":"Mordekai cu siangpahrang inn ihsin siangpahrang hnipuan a raang le mepian, phangfemte ih tahmi puansen hruk in le a mawi ngaingai mi sui lukhuh khum in a suak. Cutikah Susa Khawpi lamzin ah mi tampi cu lungawi thanuam in an au."},"16":{"text":"Ziangahtile Judah mi hrang ahcun lungawinak le thawsuahnak, thinnomnak le nehnak thinlung a um."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang thupekmi an thannak ramṭhen kip le khawkip ah Judah mi pawl cun lungawinak puai an tuah ciamco. Judah mi pawl an ṭih deuh ruangah midang tampi tla Judah mi ah an cang."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Adar thla, ni hleithum ni cu a ra thleng. Cuih ni cu siangpahrang thuthan mi an tuah suak ni, Judah mi a huatu pawl in Judah mi parih diriam in thil ṭha lo tuah dingih an beisei ni a si. Asinain Judah mi sawn in an neh riangri.","title":"Judah Mi In An Ral Pawl An Siatsuah"},"2":{"text":"Cuih ramsung khua ih Judah mi umnak veng kipah Judah mi pawl siatsuah a duhtu pawl siatsuah dingah Judah mi pawl cu hmunkhat ah an ṭang. Mi hmuahhmuah in Judah mi pawl cu an ṭih, a dodal theitu ding zohman an um lo."},"3":{"text":"Ramṭhen uktu bawi, ram uktu bawi, bawi dangdang le siangpahrang palai thlahmi pawl tla in Judah mi cu an bawm; ziangahtile Mordekai an ṭih."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn ah Mordekai cu thuneitu a si ih a thuneihnak cu a ṭhang deuhdeuh ti cu Persia ram sungah theih thluhmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Judah mi pawl in an ral pawl cu an duhduh in an tuah. Ralnam in an sat, an that ih an siatsuah thluh a si."},"6":{"text":"Susa Khawpi khalah Judah mi pawl in minung zanga an that."},"7":{"text":"Judah mi a raltu Hammedatha ih fapa Haman ih fapa pahra pawl: Parshandatha, Dalfon, Asfatha, Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha, Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai le Vaizatha tla an that. Asinain zo ih thil hman an long lo.","merge":"8"},"11":{"text":"Cuih ni ah Susa Khawpi ah mi ziangzat an that ti siangpahrang an sim."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in siangpahrang bawinu Esther hnenah, “Susa Khawpi lawnglawngah Judah mi pawl in minung zanga le Haman ih fapa pahra an that zo. Ramṭhen dangah ziangtlukin that na hai maw! Ziang so na duh hrih? Ka lo pe ding. Na duhmi i sim hrih awla ka lo pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Esther cun, “Siangpahrang bawipa na lung a kim ahcun Judah mi pawl in tuih sunah Susa Khawpi ih an tuahmi vek hi thaisun khalah tuah hrih hai seh. Cule Haman ih fapa pahra ih ruak cu thlaithahnak parah thlai siseh,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Esther timi vekcun siangpahrang in thu a pek ih Susa ah thu an than. Haman ih fapa pahra ih ruak cu senpi hmuh ah an thlai."},"15":{"text":"Cule Adar thla, ni hleili ni ah Judah mi pawl cu hmunkhat ah an khawm aw ih Susa Khawpi ah a dang minung zathum an that. Asinain zo ih thil hman an long lo."},"16":{"text":"Ramṭhen kipah Judah mi pawl cu an tongkhawm aw ih an ṭang tlang. Anmah huatu an ral pawl cu minung thawng sawmsarih le thawngnga an that. Asinain thil an long lo."},"17":{"text":"Cuih ni cu Adar thla, ni hleithum ni a si. A thaisun ni hleili ni cu thah awknak zianghman a um lo ih lungawi puai tuah ni ah an hmang."},"18":{"text":"Asinain Susa Khawpi ih Judah mi pawl cun ni hleithum ni le ni hleili ni ah mi an that ih ni hleinga ni ah an colh hrangah ni hleinga ni cu puai ni ah an hmang."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah khawte lam hla deuh ih a ummi Judah mi pawl cun Adar thla ni hleili ni cu lungawi puai tuah ni, rawl einak puai an tuah ni le pakhat le pakhat laksawng an pek awk ni ah an hmang."},"20":{"text":"Cun hi thil a cangmi pawl hmuahhmuah cu Mordekai in ca sungah a khum thluh. Persia ukmi ram sungih a ummi Judah mi hmuahhmuah hnenah ca a ngan ih,","title":"Purim Puai"},"21":{"text":"kumtinte Adar ni hleili ni le ni hleinga ni cu puai ni ih hmang ringring dingah thu a than."},"22":{"text":"Hi ni cu Judah mi pawl in an ral pawl an cemter ni an si. Hi thla riahsiatnak le vansaannak cu lungawinak le thinnomnak ih an canter thla a si. Hi ni hnih cu lungawinak puai, rawl eitlangnak puai le pakhat le pakhat laksawng an pek awk ni le mifarah pawl thil an ṭhen ni si dingah thu a than."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah Mordekai thuthan mi cu Judah mi pawl in an thlun ih an puai cu kumtin tuahmi puai ah a cangta."},"24":{"text":"Agag tesinfa Judah mi a raltu, Hammedatha ih fapa Haman in Judah mi pawl siatsuah duh ah le an ci ih hmih thluh duh ah “Purim,” timi camcawhfung a rak zuuk."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Esther cu siangpahrang hnenih a feh ruangah siangpahrang in thu a pek ih, Judah mi pawl hremnak ah a timi cu amah Haman in a tuar riangri; amah le a fapa pahra pawl cu thlaithahnak parah thlai an si."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah Judah mi pawl ih an tuah mi puai cu, “Purim,” an ti; Purim ti cu “Camcawhfung,” tican a si. Mordekai ih cakuat mi ruangah le an parih thil a cangmi pawl ruangah,"},"27":{"text":"Judah mi pawl in anmah hrang, an tesinfa pawl hrang le Judah mi ih can a duhmi pawl hrangah, hi ni hnih cu kumtinte a tikcu caan ah, Mordekai ih thuthan mi vekin, ul ringring dingah daan an tuah a si."},"28":{"text":"Judah mi innsang ciar in, sankhat hnu sankhat, khuatin le ramtin ah cat nawn loin hi Purim puai cu an ulh ringring ding mi a si."},"29":{"text":"Cun Abihail ih fanu siangpahrang bawinu Esther in Mordekai ih a rak nganmi Purim thu ih cakuat mi hlei ah hmualneizet a dang cakuat cu Mordekai thawn a ngan a si."},"30":{"text":"Esther cakuat cu Judah mi hmuahhmuah hnenah le Persia ukmi ram, ramṭhen za le kul hluansarih ah an kuat thluh. Cuih cakuat sungah cun Judah mi pawl ih daihnak le humhimnak hrang thlaza camnak a telh ih,"},"31":{"text":"rawl ulhnak le riahsiatnak caan hrangih daan an neih vekin Purim puai ni pawl cu feltein an tesinfa san tiangin a tikcu caan ah hmang dingah thupeknak tla a telh. Himi cu Mordekai le Esther an pahnih ih thupekmi a si."},"32":{"text":"Esther ih thupekmi in Purim puai hman daan pawl cu a hngetter ih a thupekmi cu ca sungah an khum thluh."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Xerxes in a ram uksung tipikap ih a ummi miphun le a ram laifangih a ummi miphun pawl cu hranhram in hna a ṭuanter.","title":"Xerxes Le Mordekai An Maksakzia"},"2":{"text":"Mangbangza thil a tuahmi pawl le a kuthnuai bawi upa bik ih Mordekai a tuahnak thuanthu pawl cu kimten Persia le Media ram siangpahrang thu hminsinnak cabu sungah an khum thluh a si."},"3":{"text":"Judah mi Mordekai cu thuneihnak lamah cun siangpahrang Xerxes sangtu a si. Judah mi pawl in Mordekai cu an upat ih an duh ngaingai. A miphun ṭhatnak le hmailam san tampi tiang humhimnak dingah thil ṭha tuahtu a si."}}}}},"18":{"info":{"name":"Job","shortname":"Job","abbr":[],"desc":"Job"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uz an timi ramah mi pakhat a rak um ih a hmin cu Job a si. Job cu Pathian betu le a rinsan zettu a si. Amah cu miṭhazet a si ih thil ṭha lo zianghman tuah a duh lo.","title":"Job Le A Innsang"},"2":{"text":"Fapa pasarih le fanu pathum a neih ih tlunah,"},"3":{"text":"tuu thawng sarih, kalauk thawng thum, caw thawng khat le laak zanga a nei. Hnenum tampi tla a nei ih Nisuahnak lam hmuahhmuah ah milian bik a si."},"4":{"text":"A fapa pawl cun a haha tein rawl ei puai an tuah ṭheu ih hmun khatah rawl an ei khawm ṭheu; an farnu pawl tla an sawm ṭheu."},"5":{"text":"An puai a cem tikah a thaizing zingpitah Job cu a tho ih a faate pawl thianfaiternak ah thawinak a pe ṭheu. Tumtah hrimnak um loin Pathian an hmuhsuam ding ih an sual pang ding ti a phan ruangah cuticun a tuah ringring a si."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah vanmi pawl an ra suah ni a thlen tikah Satan khal cu an hnenah a tel ve.","title":"Pathian Le Satan Biakawknak"},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Khuilam inso na rat?” tiah Satan cu a sut. Satan in, “Leilung pumpuluk, suk le so ka vahnak in ka ra,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka siahhlawh Job khi na hmu maw? Leilung pumpuluk ah amah bangtuk miṭha le rinsantlak zohman an um lo. Keimah i bia ih thil ṭha lo zianghman a tuah lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Satan in, “Zianghman ngah hlah sehla a lo bia duh leem pei maw?"},"10":{"text":"Amah siseh, a innsang siseh, a neihmi hmuahhmuah tiangin na humhim ih na kilkhawi. Thil a tuahmi hmuahhmuah parah mal na sawm ih rannung na pekmi pawl an tamtuk ih an ramah a khat ṭheh a si."},"11":{"text":"A neihmi hmuahhmuah khi laksak ṭheh cila na hmaika rori ah a lo cam mai ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in Satan hnenah, “Na ti bangtuk cun siseh. A neihmi hmuahhmuah na kut sungah a um. Amah Job lawngte na siatsuah lo pei,” tiah a ti. Cule Satan cu a feh."},"13":{"text":"Voikhat ah Job ih faate pawl cu an upa bik pa ih inn ah rawl ei khawmnak puai an tuah laifangah,","title":"Satan In Job A Hniksak"},"14":{"text":"mi pakhat cu Job hnenah a ra tlan ih, “Caw thawn lei kan let rero ih laak pawl cu kan kiangkapah hrampi an piat rero laiah,"},"15":{"text":"rinlopi in Sabean mi pawl in an ra siim ih kan rannung hmuahhmuah in long ṭheh. Keimah siar lo na hnenum hmuahhmuah an that ṭheh. Keimah lawnghi zualkotu ah ka tlan man a si,” tiah Job cu a ra sim."},"16":{"text":"Cupa ih ṭong a cem hlanah hnenum dang pakhat a ra thleng ih “ṭeek in na tuurual le na tuukhal pawl a tlak ih an zatein an thi ṭheh. Keimah lawng hi zualkotu ah ka tlan man a si,” tiah Job cu a ra ti."},"17":{"text":"A ṭong hman a cem hlanah hnenum dang pakhat a ra tlan lala ih, “Khaldean mi damiah rual bu thum in in siim ih kalauk hmuahhmuah an lak thluh ih tlunah keimah siar lo na hnenum dang hmuahhmuah an that ṭheh. Keimah lawnghi zualkotu ah ka tlan man a si,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"A ṭong hman a cem hlanah, hnenum dang pakhat a ra lala ih, “Na fanu le na fapa pawl cu na fapa upa bik inn ih rawl ei puai an tuah laifangah,"},"19":{"text":"nelrawn ihsin thlisia a ra hrangih an inn a nuaithluk ih a sung um minung hmuahhmuah an thi ṭheh. Keimah lawnghi zualkotu ah ka tlan man a si,” tiah Job cu a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Job cu a tho ih riahsia in a hnipuan a thlek ṭheh. A sam a meetkolh ṭheh ih leilung ah bok tahrat in,"},"21":{"text":"“Lawngfangkheh in ka suak ih lawngfangkheh in ka thi ding. Bawipa in i pek ih atu-ah a lak sal. A hmin thangṭhat si ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"A hnenah hibangtuk thil a thleng naón Job cun Pathian a mawhthluk lo ih Pathian hmaiah a sual lo."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah vanmi pawl an ra khawm ni a thleng sal ih Satan khal cu an hnenah a tel ve lala.","title":"Satan In Job A Hniksak Sal"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Khui inso na rat?” tiah a sut. Satan in, “Leilung pumpuluk suk le so ka vahnak in ka ra,” tiah a let."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka siahhlawh Job khi na hmu maw? Leitlun ah amah bangtuk miṭha le rinsantlak zohman an um lo. Keimah i bia ih thil ṭha lo zianghman a tuah lo. Zianghman thuhla um loin Job cu, ‘Ka siatsuah ding,’ na ti ih i leem ruangah ka lo lungkimpi; asinain Job cu a hlan vek thotho in rintlak in a nung a si,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Satan in, “Zovek milai khal sisehla amah ih nunnak hnak cun a neih mi hmuahhmuah a hnong sawn ding a si."},"5":{"text":"A taksa khi vun tuahmawh ngaingai cila hmaiton rori ah a lo cam mai ding,” tiah a sawn."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in, “Na tivek cun si ko seh. Na kut sungah a um a si. Asinain amah cu na that lo pei,” tiah Satan kha a ti."},"7":{"text":"Satan cu Bawipa ih umnak ihsin a feh ih Job ih taksa pumpuluk ah, a luzim ihsin a kezik tiang, hma sia a suahter ciamco."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Job cu a feh ih vutcam lakah to tahrat in a hma cu hlamphei thawn a kheuh."},"9":{"text":"A nupi in a hnenah, “A hlan vek thotho in rinsantlak in na um lai hrih mawsi? Ziangah so Pathian cu cam tahratin na thih sawn lo!” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Job in, “Nunau aa vekin na ṭong a si cu! Pathian in thilṭha in pek tikah kan lung a awi. Harsatnak kan hnenih a thlenter tikah ziangah so kan phunzai rero ding?” tiah a ti. Hi bangtuk in a tuar naón Job cun Pathian parah ṭongsia kam khat hman a ṭong lo."},"11":{"text":"Job ih rualpi pathum cu Teman khua in Elifas, Shuah ram in Bildad le Naamah ram in Zofar an si. Job ih zonzaih retheih tuarnak kha an theih tikah a hnenah va leng in riahsiatpi ding le hneem dingah an feh.","title":"Job Ih Rualpi Pawl An Ra"},"12":{"text":"Hla nawnih an hei hmuh tikah Job cu an theithiam lo. Job a si ti an theih ngah tikah cun riahsia ninghang in an ṭap an raak ih hnipuan thlek in leivut kha vanah an khirh ih an lu tla ah an theh aw."},"13":{"text":"Cule leilung parah ni sarih le zansarih sung an to ih a tuar natsatzia an hmuh ruangah zohman kaa khat hman an ṭong lo."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job cu daitein a um thei nawn lo ih a suah ni kha siat a serh ciamco: Job","title":"Pathian Parah Job a Phunzai"},"2":{"text":"“Ka suah ni cu siatserh siseh; ‘Fapate a suak’ an ti zan khal!","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Ka suah ni cu thimnak ni ah cang seh; Cuih ni cu Pathian in ciing nawn hlah seh; Cuih ni ah tleunak khal tlang hlah seh."},"5":{"text":"Riahsiat ni le a pitzet mi thimnak ni ah cang seh; Khawdur in tuam sehla van ih ni khal khi phiat thluh seh."},"6":{"text":"Cuih zan cu kum siarnak sungah telh loin hnawtfai sisehla, Ziangtik hmanah siar cih si nawn hlah seh;"},"7":{"text":"Zianghman a seem lo zan, zan ṭhahnem lo le, lungawinak um lo zanah tuah siseh."},"8":{"text":"Cuih ni camtu dingah polsia pawl sim sehla, Tipi sungih ramsa Leviathan thu a pe theitu polsia pawl cu!"},"9":{"text":"Zing arsi deirel tlang hlah seh; Khawfing a cat ding, tiih beisei nak zianghman um hlah seh."},"10":{"text":"Cuih zan cu siatserh siseh, ka suah zan a si ruangah; Zonzaih retheihnak tong lo dingih i hum lo ruangah."},"11":{"text":"Ka nu ih pum sungah rak thi ningla ka va duh so! Asilole ka suah thlak vete in rak thita ningla ka va duh so!"},"12":{"text":"Ziangah so ka nu in a cawn parah i cawi? Ziangah so a pawhte tla i fawh?"},"13":{"text":"Cunah rak thi ningla atu ahcun ka cawldai zo ding naón,"},"14":{"text":"Khuahlan khawpi rop a dinsuah saaltu, Daite ih a itmi siangpahrang le uktu bawi pawl bangin."},"15":{"text":"An inn sungah sui le ngun khat ko ih a khawltu, Siangpahrang bangtuk in le,"},"16":{"text":"thi ciaih a suakmi naute bangin ka it zo ve ding naón!"},"17":{"text":"Thlan sungah cun miṭha lo pawl an siatnak a reh; A baangzet mi hnaṭuantu pawl colhnak an ngah."},"18":{"text":"Thawngtla pawl hman daitein an um thei; Kawk le auhnak in an luat."},"19":{"text":"Cutawkah milian, mifarah an kim; Sal pawl tla an luat a si."},"20":{"text":"Ziangah so zonzaih harsatnak a tuarmi an nun ringring? Ziangah so riahsiatu pawl hnenah tleunak a thlen?"},"21":{"text":"Thih ding lawng an hngak, Asinain thihnak a ra thleng dah lo. Ziangvek thil mankhung hawl hnakin thlaan thlen an duh sawn."},"22":{"text":"An thih ih phum an si hlan cu an lung a awi dah lo;"},"23":{"text":"An hmailam thu cu Pathian in a thuhsak; An kimvel in hauhruang in a kulh ṭheh fawn."},"24":{"text":"Ka ṭahnak cu ka ti rawl an si; Ka aihramnak cu reh ti a nei lo."},"25":{"text":"Ka ngam lomi le ka ṭih thlohthlo mi hmuahhmuah a zatein ka tuar thluh zo."},"26":{"text":"Hnangamnak ka nei lo, colh ni ka nei lo; Ka zonzaihnak a reh dah fawn lo."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job, kei ṭong ve ningla na hua pei maw? Daite cun ka um thei nawn lo.","title":"Biakson Awk A Hmaisabik (4.1—14.22) Elifas in hiti in a ti:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Nangmah in mi tampi na zirh zo, baan thacak lo pawl an baan tha na cakter."},"4":{"text":"Mi an baang ih an sawn an rilh rero tikah, Na ṭong fangkhat cu an dinsalnak a si ṭheu."},"5":{"text":"Atu na hrangih harsatnak tikcu a ra thlen ve tikah, na ning a hang ih na thin a nau."},"6":{"text":"Na Pathian biak hi na hnangamnak a si lo maw? Mithiang na si ruangah beiseinak ziangtal na nei lo maw?"},"7":{"text":"Ṭhatein ruat hnik! Miding mi siatsuahnak an tong, ti na thei dah maw? Mawh nei lo mi hlohralnak an tong, ti na thei dah maw?"},"8":{"text":"Mi tampi in ṭhatlonak cu lo bangin an thlo ih, Siatnak cu thlaici bangin an tuh, ti ka hmu zo. Ṭhatlonak le siatnak cu rawl bangin an khawm ve ko."},"9":{"text":"An parah Pathian a thin a hengih thlisia bangin a siatsuah a si."},"10":{"text":"Miṭha lo pawl cu kiosa bangin an kio an huuk, Asinain Pathian in a vuakdai hai ih an ha pawl tla a khiak ṭheh."},"11":{"text":"Deh ding le ei ding neilo kiosa bangin an thi, An faate pawl cu an ṭhekdarh aw ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Voikhat cu ka hnenah a thupte in thu a ra thleng; Dimte in a rat ruangah ka thei thei ceu a si."},"13":{"text":"It that thei loih i tuahtu zan mangsia bangtuk a si."},"14":{"text":"Ka thin a phang ih ka thir, Ka pumpuluk in ka khur."},"15":{"text":"Thlarau in ka hmai thli bangin i hun seem, Ka hmul a tho surso."},"16":{"text":"Cuih thlarau cu ka hmaiah a ding ka hmu; Ka zoh rero naón ziang a si ti ka hliah thei lo. Cule a dai zirziar mi sung ihsin aw ka thei:"},"17":{"text":"“Pathian hmaiah miding an um thei ngai pei maw? Siamtu hmaiah minung zotal a thianghlim thei pei maw?"},"18":{"text":"Pathian cun a palai pawl hman a zum thei lo; A vancungmi pawl lak hmanah palhnak a hmu."},"19":{"text":"Cuti a si ahcun tlak ih tuah mi milai hi, Leivut ihsin seemsuah mi, phehlep vekih olte ih rialdip thei mi milai cu a rinsan dingah na zum maw?"},"20":{"text":"Milai cu zinglam ah a nung ko, Asinain zanlam ah zohman ih theih loin a thi ziar thei a si."},"21":{"text":"A neih ciami hmuahhmuah cu lon ṭheh a si; Fimnak tlasam in a thi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Job, hun ko hnik! A lo awitu zotal an um pei maw? Na va pan dingah vancungmi pakhat tal an um maw?"},"2":{"text":"Thinheng ringring ih nun cu Mi aa pawl thattu a si. Iksiknak cu thinlung mal pawl philtu a si."},"3":{"text":"Mi aa pawl hnangamzet ih an um ka hmu zo; Asinain rinlopi-ah an innsang cu siatcamnak a tong."},"4":{"text":"An faate pawl cu humhimnak an tong thei dah lo; Thuṭhennak hmunah zohman in anmah ṭan ah an ding lo."},"5":{"text":"Mi aa pawl ih lorawl cu rilrawng mi pawl in an ei ding; Hling lakih a khomi rawl tiangin; An lennak cu tihal pawl in an halhsik a si"},"6":{"text":"Ṭhatlonak cu leilung sungin a kho lo; Harsatnak khal leilung sungin a ṭhangmi a si lo."},"7":{"text":"Meici cu meisa sung ihsin a suak ṭheu bangin, Minung parih a thlengmi harnak cu amah minung lala-ih suahter a si."},"8":{"text":"Kei cu nang si ningla, Pathian lam ka hoikir ding, Ka thu cu a hnen ka thlenter ding."},"9":{"text":"Thilmak zetzet a tuahmi pawl cu kan thei thei dah lo ding; Mangbangza a tuahmi pawl cu cemni a nei dah lo ding."},"10":{"text":"Leiram parah ruah a surter ih loram pawl a ciarter."},"11":{"text":"A si, milungnem a cawisaangtu le riahsia mi hmuahhmuah hnenih lungawinak a petu cu Pathian a si."},"12":{"text":"Mi depde pawl ih tumtah mi cu a siatsuah sak ih, Mifim pawl cu an khawkhannak in a awkter a si. Cutin an tuah mi ziangvek hmanah an hlawh a tling lo ih,","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Sun vang hmanah zan khawthim sung bangin an tawivak."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in mifarah pawl cu thihnak in a hum ih, Mi tlasam pawl cu namsuknak sungin a run hai a si."},"16":{"text":"Mi zonzai pawl hnenah ruahsannak a pek, Asinain miṭha lo pawl cu a vuakdai hai a si."},"17":{"text":"Pathian ih nun a simmi cu milungawi an si! Nun a lo sim asile na ninghang duh hlah."},"18":{"text":"Pathian in a tuahmawh mi cu amah lala in a tuamhlawm; A kut in hma a baih ih a kut lala in a damter sal."},"19":{"text":"Amah in harnak phun ruk sungin a lo hum ding, Pasarih sung khalah ṭhat lonak zianghman in a lo dai thei lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Paam a thlen khalle a lo thiter lo ding; Raldo a um hmanah thihnak ralnam sungin a lo run ding."},"21":{"text":"Mi-ih relsiatnak sungin Pathian in a lo hum ih, Siatsuahnak a thlen hmanah na him ko ding."},"22":{"text":"Thisen luannak le rilrawnnak na hmu ṭheh ding naón, Na hnihsan men ding ih, Sahraang khal na ṭih lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Na thlawh mi loram ah lungto a um lo ding ih, Sahraang pawl thawn tla rualrem tein na um ding."},"24":{"text":"Na puanthlam sungah thlangam tein na um ding ih, Na tuu pawl na zoh tik khalah an himdam kim kha na hmu ding."},"25":{"text":"Na tefa pawl cu an tamzet ding, Leilung ih hrampi zat an si ding."},"26":{"text":"Rawl lak tikcu tiang himte ih a nungmi sangvut bangin, Kum reipi le san ṭha zetin na nung ding."},"27":{"text":"Job, hi thu pawl cu kum reipi kan zir ih kan theih mi a si. Thudik a si, curuangah pom thlang aw,” a ti."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tuarnak le riahsiatnak hi Cuaithlainak ah a khing thlai sisehla,","title":"Job in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Tifinriat ih vunnel hnakin an rit sawn ding. Ka ṭong hraang in lo mangbangter hlah seh."},"4":{"text":"Cungnungbik Pathian ih conkiang in ka sungah i kalh; A tur cu ka taksa pumpi ah a zai. Pathian in ṭihnungza thil pawl ka hmaiah a song."},"5":{"text":"Laak cu hrampi a piat tikah a lung a kim ko; Caw khal daitein hrampi ro a ei."},"6":{"text":"Asinain thawtnak neilo, ci phulh lo rawl cu zoso a ei thei ding? Arti hawng in ziang thawtnak so a neih?"},"7":{"text":"Cubangtuk rawl ei ding cu ka hiar hrimhrim lo; Ka ei mi hmuahhmuah cu ka ning seksek thluh."},"8":{"text":"Ziangah so ka dilmi cu Pathian in i pek lo ding? Ziangah so ka thlacamnak cu i leh lo ding?"},"9":{"text":"Pathian in dip seksek in i rial sehla, A kut suah in i cemter sawn sehla ka va duh so!"},"10":{"text":"I that ding ti thei ningla lungawi in ka khir ding, Ziangtluk ih ka tuar hmanah! Pathian cu a thianghlim, ka thei. A thupekmi cu ziangtik hmanah ka el dah lo."},"11":{"text":"Nung hrih dingah ziang bangtuk thazaang so ka neih lai? Beiseinak zianghman nei loin ziangah so ka nun duh rero?"},"12":{"text":"Lungto ih tuahmi maw ka si? Ka ruangpi hi dar maw a si?"},"13":{"text":"Hum-aw thei dingin thazaang ka nei nawn lo; Bomnak duh ah pan ding ka nei fawn lo."},"14":{"text":"Atu vekih zonzaih caan ahcun, Pathian ka dungtun ah siseh, dungtun lo ah siseh, rinsantlak rualpi ka ṭul a si."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih ka rualpi pawl cu, Ruah a sur lo tikih a caar mi tiva bangin i phiartu nan si."},"16":{"text":"Cuih tiva pawl cu vur le tikhal in an khat naón,"},"17":{"text":"Ni a sat tikah an zup ṭheh, a tawne tiangin a kang thluh."},"18":{"text":"Rannung thawn khualtlawng mi lamzin an hlo, Tidai hawl in an vak ih nelrawn ah an thi."},"19":{"text":"Sheba le Tema khua ihsin ṭilva ruun thawn khualtlawng mi pawl tla in an hawl."},"20":{"text":"Asinain a caar mi tiva kapah an ruahsannak a cem."},"21":{"text":"Nannih tla cu ka hrangah cun cuih tiva vek nan si. Ka sizia in hmu tikah nan mang a bang ih in ṭih."},"22":{"text":"Laksawng i ra pe uh ka lo ti maw si? Ka ai ah mi pakhatkhat nawhthuh pek ka lo fial maw si?"},"23":{"text":"Culole ka raal le zaangfah nei lo mihremtu kut in i ra hum uh, ka lo ti maw si?"},"24":{"text":"Asile i zirh hnik hmeen uh! Ka sualnak i sim hnik uh! Ṭong loin daitein ka um ding ih ka lo ngaihnik hai ding."},"25":{"text":"Ṭong tluangtlam cu lung a lut, Asinain nan ṭong mi pawl cu thulolak lawng a si."},"26":{"text":"Ka ṭong mi hi thli meen a si tiah nan ruat! Asile ziangah so ka thinpihnak ṭongkam pawl cu in leh duh rero?"},"27":{"text":"Ngakṭah farah nauta pawl cu camcawhfung zuknak ah nan hmang ih, Nan rualpi ṭha bik nekrawk ih nanmah lian ding nan tum."},"28":{"text":"Ka mithmai i zohhnik uh! Thuphan ka per lo ding."},"29":{"text":"Nan luan tuk zo! Mi namnuai nawn hlah uh! I hnong hlah uh! Ka thu cu a dik a si."},"30":{"text":"Asinain thuphan per rero ah in ruat; A dik le dik lo thleidang thiam lo ah in ruat."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Milai nunnak hi hranhram ih ṭuantermi ralkap nunnak bangtuk, Hnaṭuan khung lawng a ṭuantu ih nunnak bangtuk le,"},"2":{"text":"Thinghnuai daihnem lawnglawng a ngaitu sal ih nunnak vek le, A hlawhman a hngak ringringtu siahhlawh pa bangtuk a si."},"3":{"text":"Thlakhat hnu thlakhat nun san zianghman ka nei lo; Zankhat hnu zankhat riahsiatnak lawng i pe vivo."},"4":{"text":"Itthat dingih ka zau tikah tikcu a sau cuang; Zanvarte ka lawng ka taal ih khuafing cah ding lawng ka hngak."},"5":{"text":"Ka taksa cu tholung in a khat, Ka vun an puar ih an kek sal, Ka hma in hnai an dok thluahthlo!"},"6":{"text":"Ka nunnak ni cu ruahsannak um loin an liam vivo; Thiamtaktu ih thiamhrolh hnakin zamrang sawn in an liam."},"7":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka nunnak cu thaw lawng a si hi thei ringring aw; Ka lungawinak cu a cem zo."},"8":{"text":"Atu-ahcun i hmu, a sinan i hmu sal nawn lo ding. I hawl khalle ka um nawn lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Mero a kiang ih a hlohta bangin, Milai cu a thi, a kirsal nawn lo."},"10":{"text":"A inn a pan sal thei nawn lo ih, A theitu khalin an hngilh thluh zo."},"11":{"text":"Atu cu daiteón ka umthei nawn lo! Ka thinheng in ka ṭong suak ding, Ka lung a sia, ka dai nawn lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Ziangah so i kil ringring? Tipi sungih rulpi ah maw i ruah? Tifinriat rulhrengah maw i ruah?"},"13":{"text":"Ka zau ih ihkhun ah colh ka tum, Ka tuarmi hi deem deuh thei pang sehla ka ti."},"14":{"text":"Asinain nangmah hrimhrim in mangsia in ka tuk i sumter! Hmuhnak a phunphun i hmuh ih ka thin i phangter."},"15":{"text":"Hiti vekin harfualfo ih nun cuahco hnak cun, Ka hngawng ih deek tahrat in thih ka duh sawn."},"16":{"text":"Ka thin a pit! Nun ka zuam nawn lo. Keimah lawngte in i taan aw, Nun man ka nei lo."},"17":{"text":"Milai hi ziangso a si ih hitluk lawmmam in na thupitter? Amah cu ziangruangah so na seherh ringring?"},"18":{"text":"Zingtinte na veh ih tu le tu na hniksak ringring hi!"},"19":{"text":"Ka cil ka lem caan sungte tal khawdang na hoi lo ding maw?"},"20":{"text":"Nang, milai thinlung zohhliahtu, Ka sualnak in a lo tuahmawh mawsi? Na hmuibahmi ah ziangah so i tuah? Kei hi na hrang thilrit maw ka si?"},"21":{"text":"Ka sualnak cu i ngaithiam thei dah lo maw? Ka mawhnak cu i ngaidam thei hrimhrim lo maw? Reilote ah thlaansung ah ka it ding; I ra hawl hman cila ka um nawn lo ding."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thli vek a si mi thulolak na ṭong rero cu na ṭheh zo maw?","title":"Bildad in hiti in a ti:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Pathian in thuding cu a merh dah lo; A dik lo khal a tuah dah lo."},"4":{"text":"Na faate pawl Pathian parih an sual ruangah, An sualnak vekin cawhkuan a pek."},"5":{"text":"Asinain atu cun Ziangkimtithei Pathian dil aw."},"6":{"text":"Na thiang ngaingai ih na fel taktak a si ahcun, Pathian in a ra lo bawm ding ih Na innsang a lo tungding sal pei, Laksawng tla a lo pe ding a si."},"7":{"text":"Na lennak na sunmi pawl cu zianghman an si lo ding, Pathian ih a lo pek dingmi thawn ṭhim ahcun."},"8":{"text":"Khuahlan laiih fimnak pawl vun zohsal hnik, Kan pupa pawl ih an theihmi thutak pawl vun ruatsal hnik."},"9":{"text":"Kan nunnak hi a tawi tuk ih kan theihmi zianghman a um lo. Leilung parah hin phenthlam bangin kan lan."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla khuahlan mifim pawl in lo zirh hai seh, An sim ṭheumi hi ngaihnik aw;"},"11":{"text":"“Papairas cu tidai um lonak ah a kho dah lo; Phaipheng cu a ciarlonak hmunah a um dah keel lo."},"12":{"text":"An noteet lai ih hman tlak an si hlan hmanah Tidai a kang a si ahcun an vuai hmaisa bik a si."},"13":{"text":"Pathian thei lotu pawl cu cuvek an si. An ruahsannak a cem, Pathian tel loih an nun hnu ahcun!"},"14":{"text":"Pat phangkhat, maimom innraang phangkhat khi an rinsan;"},"15":{"text":"Maimom innraang phangkhat an hngauhsan ahcun a din ding maw? Pat phangkhat an vawk ahcun an ding sal thei ngai ding maw?”"},"16":{"text":"Miṭha lo pawl cu sun ni tlang ih hrampi bangin an kho, Hmuan ih a hrih a khat ṭheh mi hrampi bangin a kho a si."},"17":{"text":"An hrih in lungto an ngerh ih Lung a ummi pohpoh an zeel ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Asinain vun bawt-awla an cem fai; Cutawkih an um kha zohman in an thei nawn lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Asi, miṭha lo pawl ih lungawinak cu cuvek in a cem; Midang an ra ih an umnak an luah ṭheh."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in mifel cu a hnong lo ding. Miṭha lo pawl ih baan khal a cakter cuang lo ding."},"21":{"text":"Na mithmai ah lungawinak a cuang ding ih, Na kaa cu hnihnak in a khat ding."},"22":{"text":"Asinain a lo huatu pawl cu an ning a zakter ding; Miṭha lo pawl ih innsang cu an hloralta ding."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asiko, cu pawl cu ka theih cia mi hlir an si ko. Sikhalsehla ziangtinso milai in Pathian hmaiah ahcun miding a si thei ding?","title":"Job in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Ziangtin so Pathian cu thu a el thei ding? Zohman ih leh thei lo dingmi thu thawngkhat khal a sut thei a sisi!"},"4":{"text":"Pathian ih fimnak cu a thuk tuk, A huham neihmi a kau tuk; Zohman amah dodal in a hmaiah an ding thei lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Tlang pawl a ṭhawnter hluahhlo, A thinheng in a siatsuah ṭheh, In ṭhawn a si ti khal an thei lo."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in ling a hninter ih, Leilung le a hramṭohnak pawl tla an hnin ṭheh a si."},"7":{"text":"Pathian cun a thu in ni khi suak lo dingin a kham thei, Arsi pawl tla zanah vang lo dingin a dawn thei."},"8":{"text":"Van khi puan bangin a zaar tikah Zohman in an bawm lo. Tipi sung rulhrengih zaang a ke in a palcih theitu Amah lawng a si."},"9":{"text":"Pathian in vanih arsi - zaangkhua, siruk, likhuk cangthum, ngambawm le zawltling pawl a tuah a si."},"10":{"text":"Thilmak zetzet a tuahmi pawl kan thei thei dah lo ding; Mangbangza a tuahmi pawl khal kan siar cawk dah lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Pathian cu ka kiang in a lan, Asinain ka hmu thei lo. A feh vivo ko naón ka thei thei cuang lo."},"12":{"text":"A duhduh mi a lak, zohman ih kham theih a si lo. ‘Ziang so na tuah?’ ti ih thusuh ngam khal a si lo."},"13":{"text":"Pathian thinhengnak cu a dai lo, A ral pawl Tipi rulhreng Rahab le a bawmtu pawl cu a palbeek thluh."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah ziangtinso Pathian cu ka let thei ding? Ziangtin so amah el theinak ah ṭongfang ka hawl thei ding?"},"15":{"text":"Mawh nei lo ka si naón anih cu ka let thei lo, ‘I zaangfah hram aw,’ tiah ka thuṭhentu Pathian hnen ih dil lawng hi ka ti theimi a si."},"16":{"text":"Ka ṭongnak ah tikcu i pe hman sehla, Ka ṭongmi i ngai ding ti ka zum thei lo."},"17":{"text":"Thuhla zianghman um loin, Keimah nuai dingah thlisia a kuat; I tuahmawhnak cu a zai deuhdeuh."},"18":{"text":"Thaw thawtnak caan hman i pe lo, Ka parih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah in ka ning i hanter sinsin."},"19":{"text":"Kei thacahnak ka suah ding maw? Pathian tlukih thacak zoso a um? Dingnak thu ah ti sehla, Zoin so zungah a thlenpi thei ding?"},"20":{"text":"Mawh neilo rintlak ka si ko naón Ka awkaa in i mawh thluk, Soisel ding um lo ka si ko naón Ka ṭongmi pohpoh in mawh in phurh."},"21":{"text":"Sualnak zianghman ka nei lo, Asinain zianghman a dang nawn lo. Nun hi ka paih nawn lo. Kan sual siseh, kan sual lo khal siseh a dang lo. Pathian in in siatsuah thluh ko ding.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Rin lopi in mawh nei lomi a thih tikah Pathian in a hnihsan."},"24":{"text":"Pathian in leilung cu miṭha lo kutah a pek. Thuṭhentu pawl ih mit cu puan in a hup ṭheh.
