Cu pawl cu Pathian in a tuah lo, nan ti asile zo in so a tuah?"},"25":{"text":"Ka tikcu cu ṭhatnak um loin an liam vivo, Zualkotu hnakin a zamrang sawn."},"26":{"text":"Ka nunnak ni cu a lan vivo, Papairas ih tuahmi lawng bangin; Ar a namtu khaupi bangin a zamrang a si."},"27":{"text":"Ka tuarnak cu hngilh tahrat in, Lungawi sopar ih um ka tum hmanah, Ka zonzaihnak cu keimah duum dingah an ra kirsal cing ding."},"28":{"text":"Ka harsat tuarnak hi ka ṭih, Pathian in mawh i phurh ti ka thei."},"29":{"text":"Pathian ih mawh i phurh hnuah cun Ziangah so ka ṭan duh rero ding?"},"30":{"text":"Ka sualnak cu ziangvek satpia, khal in a tlengfai thei lo ding;"},"31":{"text":"Pathian in fihnungza kuahrum sungah i thlak; Ka hnipuan hman in in zahpi a si."},"32":{"text":"Pathian hi minung va sisehla, ka let thei nasa ding; Kan thu rel dingah zungah kan feh ding ih kan thu relcat a si ding."},"33":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kan karlak ah palai an um lo; Pathian le kei karlak ah thuṭhen theitu zohman an um lo."},"34":{"text":"Pathian, i hrem nawn hlah; ṭih na nunnak in ka thin i phangter hlah seh."},"35":{"text":"Cutin zianghman ṭihnak um loin ka ṭong ve thlang ding; Ziangahtile ka thinlung cu keimah in ka thei bik a si."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nun hi ka ning thlang, A siakha zetmi ka phunzainak hi ngaihnik aw! Ninghangzet in ka sim ding."},"2":{"text":"Maw Pathian, mi mawh na si i ti siang hrih hlah; Ziangvek sual so i puh, i sim hnik!"},"3":{"text":"Zaangfah nei loih i namsuk rero hi a dik na ti mawsi? Na kutzungih na tuahmi nautat hi a dik na ti mawsi? Miṭha lo pawl ih tumtahmi hnihsan men hi a ṭha na ti mawsi?"},"4":{"text":"Milai ih hmuhdan vekin thil na hmu ve mawsi?"},"5":{"text":"Kan nunnak a tawi vekin na nunnak a tawi ve maw?"},"6":{"text":"Ziangah so ka sualnak lawnglawng na hawl ih, Ka mawhnak fate bik khal na coih suak ṭheh?"},"7":{"text":"Mawhnak ka neih lo hi na thei, Asinain zohman in na kut sung ihsin in runsuak thei lo ding tikhal na thei ko."},"8":{"text":"Na kut in i tuah ih i siam; Atu-ah cuih na kut cun i siatsuah."},"9":{"text":"Tlak in i siam hi hngilh hlah aw. Leivut cang sal ding in i rialdip ding maw si?"},"10":{"text":"Ka pa kha keimah hrin theinak thazaang na pek ih, ka nu ih pum sungah i ṭhanter."},"11":{"text":"Ka ruangpi cu ruh le tha in na tuah ih, Ka ruh cu tit le vun thawn na pehcih."},"12":{"text":"Nunnak i pek ih duhdawtnak khal i neihter. I kilkhawi ruangah ka nung a si."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na lung sungah a thupte ih in na retmi, Na thin sungah na ret thupmi cu ka thei ngah a si:"},"14":{"text":"Ziangtikah sual pei maw, tiin i bawh ringring; Ka sualnak a ummi cu malte hman ngaidam na tum hrimhrim lo."},"15":{"text":"Mawhnak ka neih vete in miharsa le mivanduai ah ka cang. Thil ṭha ka tuah khalle lom ka tong cuang lo. Ka awloksong in ningzak in ka um."},"16":{"text":"Hlawhtlinnak hnihkhat ka neih le kiosa bangin i hawl. Keimah tuahmawh duh ah mangbangza tla na tuah."},"17":{"text":"Ka thu a theitu na nei ringring; Ka parih na thinhengnak cu a luar deuhdeuh; Ka parah na huham cu a thleng ih a thuah a thuah in in nuai ciamco."},"18":{"text":"Pathian, ziangah so ka nu ih pum sung ihsin i suahter? Zohman ih hmuh man hlanah rak thih sawn taak ding."},"19":{"text":"Ka nu ih pum sung ihsin thlaan ah rak lanta ningla, A va ṭha deuh ngaingai ding naón, A rak seem dah lo bangin."},"20":{"text":"Ka nunnak hi a cem zik thlang a si lo maw? I hnaihnok duh nawn hlah! Tikcu malte ka neihsun cu lungdai in ka hmang pei."},"21":{"text":"Ka feh cing ding, ‘Kir sal nawn lonak ram ah’! Riahsiatnak ram le khuathimnak ramah ka feh ding."},"22":{"text":"Thimnak le thihnak phenthlam le buairuainak thawn a khat mi, Tleunak hman a thim thothonak ram ahcun ka feh ding."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thulolak ṭong hi zotal in kan let lo ding maw? Mi ṭongtam ti men in thiam an co ding mawsi?","title":"Zofar in hiti in a sim:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Job, kan lo let thei lo ah mawsi na ruat? Na puarthau ṭong hin in vuakdai dingah mawsi na zum?"},"4":{"text":"‘Ka ṭongmi le ka ruahmi hi a dik, Pathian hmaiah ka thianghlim,’ na ti."},"5":{"text":"Pathian in lo let ve sehla ka va duh so!"},"6":{"text":"Fimnak ah hin thuah tampi a umzia, Minung thluak ih theih thei lomi thil tampi a umzia, Na hnenah run phuang hnik sehla, Thungaite ih ti ahcun Pathian cun na tuar ding zat hnakih deem deuh in a lo hrem sokhaw!"},"7":{"text":"Pathian ih natsatzia hi a ramri na thei thei pei maw? Ziangkimtithei ih huham maksakzia hi a suum na tah thei pei maw?"},"8":{"text":"A huham cu van hnakin a sang, Nang in ziangso na ti thei? Mithi khua Sheol hnakin a thuk, Nang in ziangso na theih thei?"},"9":{"text":"Pathian natsatnak cu leilung pumpi hnakin a tum deuh ih, Tipi thuanthum hnakin a kau sawn a si."},"10":{"text":"Pathian in lo kai tahratin thawng ah lo thlak sehla, Thuṭhennak zungah lo fehpi sehla, zoso a kham thei ding?"},"11":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl zo an si ti cu Pathian in a thei ṭheh; A ṭha lomi an hnaṭuannak tla a hmu ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Mi-aa pawl an fim sal thei pei maw? Hramlak laak kha a ngam cia in a suak dah pei maw?"},"13":{"text":"Job, na thinlung diktein ret aw, Na baan pharin Pathian lam hoi aw."},"14":{"text":"Na innih ṭhatlonak le na kutih sualnak pawl cu hlon ṭheh aw."},"15":{"text":"Cutiin mithmai baal loin um awla, Ral ṭha zet le hngetkhoh zetin nung aw."},"16":{"text":"Cutiin na zonzaihnak cu an reh vivo ding ih, A luanglan mi tilik na theih nawn lo vekin na ciing nawn lo ding."},"17":{"text":"Cutiin na nunnak cu sun nitleu hnakin a tleu sawn ding ih, A thimzet na timi na nunnak cu zing khawvang bangin a vang ding."},"18":{"text":"Thlangam zet le nunnuam zetin na um ding; Pathian in a lo hum dingih colhnak a lo pe ding."},"19":{"text":"Na zau huahho ding ih ṭihmi ziang hman na nei lo ding, Mi tampi in bomnak an lo dil ding."},"20":{"text":"Asinain miṭha lo pawl cu riahsia in khua an cuan ding ih, Luatnak lamzin an hmu lo ding. A neta bik an thawthawt kha, ruahsannak an neihsun a si ding."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asiko, na ṭong mi cu misenpi ruahnak a si. Nan thih tikah nan fimnak cu a cem ve ding.","title":"Job in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Asinain nanmah tlukin fimnak ka nei ve ko; Nannih hnakin ka nauta cuang lo; Nan ṭong mi cu zokhal ih theih thluh cia mi a si."},"4":{"text":"Ka rualpi pawl hman in atu ah in hnihsan; Soi ding um lo, a ding mi ka si naón an hni thotho; Sikhalsehla Pathian in ka thlacam mi i leh caan a um."},"5":{"text":"Nannih cu harsatnak nan tong lo, Curuangah hnihsuahsainak meen ah in hmang; A sawn ciami pa cu nan vuak beet."},"6":{"text":"Asinain rukru le Pathian thei lo pawl cu hnangam zetin an um; An pathian cu an kut ih an ken theimi a si."},"7":{"text":"Vate le ramsa hman in tampi an lo zirh thei ding;"},"8":{"text":"Leilung par ramsa le ti sung nga hnen in fimnak dil uh."},"9":{"text":"An zatein Pathian kutih tuahmi an si kha an thei ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Pathian in a ramsa hmuahhmuah a uk ṭheh, Milai ih nunnak cu a kut ah a um."},"11":{"text":"Nan lei in rawl a thawtzia a theih bangin, Nan hna in mi ṭong theih cu a duh zet a si."},"12":{"text":"Kum upa pawl in fimnak an nei, Sansau pawl in theihthiamnak an nei,"},"13":{"text":"Asinain Pathian cun fimnak le huham a nei; A hnenah ruahnak ṭha le theih thiamnak a um a si."},"14":{"text":"Pathian ih a balmi cu zoso a sak sal thei ding? Pathian ih thawng a thlakmi cu zoso a suah thei ding?"},"15":{"text":"Pathian in ruah a kham tikah cun ziang hmuahhmuah an car ṭheh; Tidai a thlah sal tikah cun tilik in ziangtinkim a siatsuah ṭheh."},"16":{"text":"Pathian cu a cak ih nehtu a si ringring; Bumtu le bummi pawl khal amah ih ukmi an si."},"17":{"text":"Remruattu pawl ih fimnak cu a siatter ṭheh; Hruaitu pawl cu mi aa bangin hna a ṭuanter."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang in hreng a khenmi pawl cu a phuaksak hai ih, Thawng ah siangpahrang pawl a thlak hai ih an taai ah taikhap a khap."},"19":{"text":"Puithiam le thuneitu pawl cu an ning a zahter."},"20":{"text":"Rinsan zetmi pawl a vuakdai ih Kum upa pawl ih theihthiamnak cu a long ṭheh a si."},"21":{"text":"Thuneitu pawl cu mualpho in a ret ih, Uktu pawl an thuneihnak a cemter a si."},"22":{"text":"Khawthim sungih thuthup a langter ih, A pit zetmi khawdur kha tleunak ah a thlengter."},"23":{"text":"Miphun tampi a tumter ih a cakter; Asinain a neh ih a siatsuah ṭheh."},"24":{"text":"An hotu pawl cu a aatter ih, Lamzin thei loin an vakvai."},"25":{"text":"Khawthim sungah an vak ih Zuri bangin an sawn an ril."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nan ṭongmi hmuahhmuah cu ka mit ih ka hmuh ciami le ka hna ih ka theih cia hlir an si. Ka theithiam lomi a um lo. Nanmah theih zat poh ka thei ko. Nanmah hnak in ka nau cuang lo.","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Asinain nannih thawn thu kan el aw lo; Ziangkimtithei, Pathian thawn kan el aw a si. Ka thu cu Pathian thawn el awk ka duh."},"4":{"text":"Nan thutheih lozia hi thuphan in nan khuh; Zohman a damter thei lotu sibawi vek nan si."},"5":{"text":"Ṭong lotein um sawn uhla, Mi in mifim ah an lo ruat ding."},"6":{"text":"Ka ṭongmi ngai hrih uhla Ka thu feh daan ruat hnik uh."},"7":{"text":"Ziangah so thuphan hlir nan rel? Nan thuphan hi Pathian hrangah a ṭhahnem ding nan ti mawsi?"},"8":{"text":"Pathian nan ṭan tum ngai mawsi? Thuṭhennak hmunah a hnen ṭangin in el tum maw?"},"9":{"text":"Pathian in lo zingzoi ngai sehla Thil ṭha pakhatte tal na parah a hmu ding maw? Milai nan bum thei vekin Pathian bum thei nan tum maw si?"},"10":{"text":"A thupte ih mi thleidannak nan neih a si ahcun, Amah in a lo phuang ding ih nun a lo sim ding."},"11":{"text":"A huham in a lo phangter ih, A ṭih nunnak na tlunah a tla lo ding maw?"},"12":{"text":"Nan ṭongṭhimnak pawl cu vutcam vek an si; Nan thu-el thiamnak pawl cu tlak vek lawng an si."},"13":{"text":"Daite in rak um hrih uh, ka ṭong ve ding; A piannaknak ah piang seh!"},"14":{"text":"Ṭihphannak hmun ka thleng, Ka nunnak ka ui nawn lo."},"15":{"text":"Beiseinak ka nei nawn lo, Pathian in i that leh ko ding; Sikhalsehla ka thuhla cu a hnenah, a hmai rori ah ka thlenpi ding."},"16":{"text":"Ka ralṭhatnak hin i hum thei meen ding, Ziangahtile miṭha loin Pathian an tong ngam dah keel lo."},"17":{"text":"Ka simfiangnak ṭong hi ngai uh, Ka thusimmi hi nan hna ah lut seh."},"18":{"text":"Ka thuhla cu ka ngaihtuah kim zo, Thiam in coter ding, ziangahtile ka thu a dik a si, ti ka thei."},"19":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ra tahrat in sual i puh ngaingai ding maw? Cutiin asile kei cu daiziar in ka um ding ih ka thi sawn ding."},"20":{"text":"Thil pahnih lo dil duhmi ka nei; Na lungkim awla na hnen ihsin ka relh lo ding."},"21":{"text":"I hremnak cu bang thlang awla, Na ṭihnunnak in ka thin i phangter nawn hlah."},"22":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nang ṭong hmaisa awla ka lo let ding. Culole kei ka ṭong hmaisa ding ih i let aw."},"23":{"text":"Ka mawhnak le daan ka buarnak ziangzat so an si? Ka sualnak le ka tlaksamnak pawl i sim hnik?"},"24":{"text":"Ziangruangah so na hmai na thuh? Ziangruangah so ral vekih i zoh?"},"25":{"text":"A thin phang seh i ti maw si? Kei cu zianghman ka si ual lo, Hnahrawp ka si ko lo maw? Fangkungro pakhat na do rero vek a si ko!"},"26":{"text":"A mawi lo zetmi sualnak tla i puh ciamco, Ka no lai ih ka rak tuah mi thil sual pawl tla."},"27":{"text":"Thir cikcin in ka ke na ṭeem; Ka ke kar na zoh hliah ih Ka keneh tiangin na zingzoi ṭheh."},"28":{"text":"Curuangah thingrop bangin ka tlu ih, A muatmi hnipuan bangin ka zaam ṭheh."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nunau sung suak milai hmuahhmuah, An nun a tawi ih zonzaih an tuar."},"2":{"text":"Pangpar bangin an ṭhang ih an ziam sal; Phenthlam bangin an hloralta, Rei an awh lo."},"3":{"text":"Pathian, na mitsiir hmanin i zoh duh ding maw? Ka thu ṭhen dingah na hmaiah i suahpi ngai ding maw?"},"4":{"text":"A thiang lomi milai sung ihsin a thiangmi a suak thei ding maw? A suak thei dah lo ding."},"5":{"text":"A nun ding kum zat cu khiah cia a si ih, A thla zat tla ruah cia in a um. Na lairel ciami an si ih thleng theih an si nawn lo."},"6":{"text":"Hmundang hoisan awla amah lawng taanta mai aw; A nunnak harsatnak ni cu a nuampi thei tawkin nuampi seh."},"7":{"text":"Hau ciami thingkung hrang hmanah ruahsannak a um; A cerh ding ih a nung sal ding, A hram note a ṭhang vivo ding."},"8":{"text":"A hram pawl an tar ih, a bul cu leilung ah rop hmansehla,"},"9":{"text":"Tidai a ngah cun a cerh ding ih thing note bangin a kho sal ding."},"10":{"text":"Asinain milai a thih ahcun a cem thla a si. A thih hnu khuiah so a um?"},"11":{"text":"A car mi tiva bangin le a kang mi tipi bangin,"},"12":{"text":"Minung a thih cun a tho nawn lo, Van hmuah a hlohral ṭheh hlanlo an ṭhang sal nawn lo ding; An ihnak ihsin an tho nawn lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Mithi khua Sheol ah i thup cila ka va duh so; Na thinheng a reh hlan lo i thup aw. Cule nangmah in a tikcu khiak awla, i theih salnak caan ret aw."},"14":{"text":"Milai a thih cun a nung sal thei ding maw? Asinain tikcu ṭha ka hngak ding, Atu-ih harsatnak caan a liam tiang ka hngak ding."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah i ko dingih kei in ka lo awi ding, Na kutih sersiammi kei in ka parih na lungawinak ka hmu ding."},"16":{"text":"Ka ke kar cu na zoh hliah ding, Asinain ka sualnak cu na zingzoi rero lo ding."},"17":{"text":"Ka mawhnak cu i ngaidam ding ih a tompi in na hlon hlo ding; ṭhat lonak ka tuahmi hmuahhmuah na hnawtfai ṭheh ding a si."},"18":{"text":"Tlang pawl an cim ṭhehnak tikcu a thleng ding, Lungto tumpi pawl tla phong ṭheh an si ding."},"19":{"text":"Tidai in lungto a ei ṭheh, Lihong in leilung a fehpi ṭheh; Cuvekin milai ih nunsung ruahsannak hmuahhmuah na feh hlo ṭheh a si."},"20":{"text":"Milai cu kumkhuadaih in na neh ih an hloral ṭheh; A thih tikah a hmel na thleng ih na dawihlo."},"21":{"text":"A fapa pawl in hminṭhatnak an ngah, Asinain a thei nawn lo; An hmin a siat tik khalah a thei cuang lo."},"22":{"text":"A taksa ruangpi a nat lawng a thei, A thinlung harsatnak lawng a tuar."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job, na ṭongmi hi thulolak lawnglawng a si. Nisuah ihsin a rami thli bangtuk lawng a si.","title":"Biakson Awk A Voihnihnak (15.1—21.34) Elifas in hiti in a ti:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Na ṭong vekin mifim zohman an ṭong lo ding; Tican nei lo ṭong cun zohman in anmah ṭannak ah an hmang lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Pathian ṭihzah lo dingin mi thapetu na si, A hnenih thlacam duh lo dingin na tuah hai a si."},"5":{"text":"Na ṭhat lonak in na hmur a zirh; Na hrilmi cu depdetnak lei a si."},"6":{"text":"Kei ih lo hnon a ṭul lo; Na ṭongkam in sual a lo puh ih a lo hnong zo a si."},"7":{"text":"A suak hmaisa bikmi ah na ruat aw maw si? Pathian in tlang pawl a siam laiah na rak um zo maw si?"},"8":{"text":"Pathian ih tumtahnak na rak thei cia maw si? Milai fimnak hi nangmah lawngih neih ah maw na ruat?"},"9":{"text":"Na theih mi hi kan theih lomi zianghman a um lo. Na theihthiammi kan theihthiam lomi ziangso a um?"},"10":{"text":"Kan fimnak hi ṭuakpaar cia upa, Na pa hnakih upa sawn hnen ihsin kan zirmi a si."},"11":{"text":"Pathian in hlemnak thu a lo ruah, Hmurka neemte ṭong hi na hrangah zianghman a ṭangkai lo maw? Ziangah so na pom duh thotho lo?"},"12":{"text":"Na ti hlehle ih na thinheng in in zoh ciamco."},"13":{"text":"Pathian parah na ning a hang ih a thang na siat ciamco. Na hmur in ṭongsia a suak ciamco."},"14":{"text":"A thianghlim milai an um thei ngai ding maw? Pathian hmaiah miding an um ngai pei maw?"},"15":{"text":"Pathian in a vancungmi hman a zum lo ih, A hmaiah anmah hman an thiang lo."},"16":{"text":"A borhhlawh mi milai, felnak zianghman nei lo, Tidai in vekih siatnak lawng a intu milai cu, ziangtlukin so a thianghlim lo sinsin ding?"},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Job, ka theih ve mi hi ngaihnik! Ka hmuhmi na hnenah ka phuang ding."},"18":{"text":"Mifim pawl in an pale hnen ihsin An zirmi fimnak thutak in zirh, An thuhmi zianghman a um lo."},"19":{"text":"An ram sungah ramdang mi zohman an rak um lo ih, Pathian hnenin a hruaisualtu ding milai zohman an um lo a si."},"20":{"text":"Miṭha lo le misual in a nunsung hmuahhmuah ah harsatnak a tong. Zaangfah nei lo hrangah hremnak cu retsak cia in a um."},"21":{"text":"Ṭihphannak aw cu a hna sungah cat loin a thang. Ka him a si, a ti laifangah rukru in an ram."},"22":{"text":"Thimnak sungin luat thei dingah ruahsannak a nei lo, Khuitawk hmun in simaw ralnam in a rak hngak."},"23":{"text":"A ruaksa ei dingah langta pawl in an thlir. Ka hmailam cu a thimzet, ti a thei."},"24":{"text":"A cakzet mi siangpahrang in mi a do bangin, Siatsuahnak in do dingah a bawh ringring."},"25":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei a dodaltu le, Pathian hnenih a kuttum a hawi rerotu milai ih nunnak lamzin cu cu bangtuk in a si."},"26":{"text":"Mi puarthau le mi luhlul in, Thinlung ruhzet in a ralphaw cu a khai ih Pathian do dingah hmaiah a nor ciamco.","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"Khua tampi a nehtu le Innram pawl a luahtu cu amah a si. Asinain raldonak a um tikah cun cuih khua le inn pawl cu a siat ṭheh ding."},"29":{"text":"Kum rei a lian lo ding, A neihmi pawl rei an awh lo ding, A phenthlam tiang in a hlo ding."},"30":{"text":"Thimnak sungin a luat lo ding; A hnge meisa in a kaang ṭhehmi, A par thlisia in a nuai ṭhehmi thingkung bangtuk a si ding."},"31":{"text":"A aat hraat ih siatnak lawng a rinsan ahcun, A comi cu siatnak lawng a si ding."},"32":{"text":"A tikcu a kim hlanah a vuai ding, Thinghnge bangin a ro ding ih a hring sal nawn lo ding."},"33":{"text":"A hmin hlan ih a rah a ṭil ṭhehmi Sabit kuang vek a si ding, A par a ṭilmi Olif kung vek a si ding."},"34":{"text":"Pathian thei lo pawl cun tesinfa an nei lo ding, Nawhthuh tangka in an sak mi inn cu meisa in a kang ṭheh ding."},"35":{"text":"Annih cu mi siatsuah a tumtu le ṭhatlonak a tuahtu an si; An thinlung cu mi bumnak lawngin a khat."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuvek ṭong cu voi tampi ka thei zo, In hlemnak cu ka hrangah tuar sinsinnak lawng a si.","title":"Job in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Catbaang loin maw nan ṭong rero ko ding? Kan ṭongnet hlan lo tiah maw nan ti ringring ding?"},"4":{"text":"Ka umnak ah nannih um in, nan umnak ah kei um ningla, Nan ṭongmi vek hi cu ka ṭong thei ve ko ding. Uang aw zetin ka lu ka thle hngualhngo ding ih, Ka ṭongmi tilik zat sungah, ka lo phim hai ding."},"5":{"text":"Ruahnak ṭhaṭha in nan thazaang ka cakter ding ih, Ka hmurka in a suakmi ṭongkam cun a lo hneem thei zet ding."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka ṭongmi hin zianghman ṭhathnemnak i pe lo; Daiziar ih ka um khalle ka tuar a deem cuang lo."},"7":{"text":"Maw Pathian, i bangter tuk zo, Ka innsang pawl na thihter ṭheh zo."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah in i hrem, ka ral na si. Ka vun le ka ruh lawng an taang; Cumi ruangah mi in keimah mawh ah in ruat."},"9":{"text":"A thinheng ah Pathian in i bauh i thlek ṭheh; Huatnak thawn a ha i rial hnawh; I mitkem ih cat loin i zoh."},"10":{"text":"Mipi in an kaa ang in in hnihsan, Ka kiang an ra ih ka hmai in beng; An ṭangtlang ih in dodal."},"11":{"text":"Pathian in miṭha lo pawl ih kut sungah i thlenter, Pathian ṭihzah lotu pawl hnenah i hlon."},"12":{"text":"Daite ih ka um laiah i siatsuah, Pathian in ka or in i deek ih i sawp ciamco ih i deen. Pathian in a hmuibah mi ah i tuah;"},"13":{"text":"Khawzakipin conkiang thawn i sai, Conkiang in i ngah ih i hriam; Ka kaileng i ngah, ka hnitkha leilung ah a luang, Cuih hnu hmanah zaangfahnak zianghman a nei lo."},"14":{"text":"Atu le atu hma i baih leuhleuh, Ralkap thinṭeu bangin i nam ciamco."},"15":{"text":"Mithi ngai in ka um ih ka vun khuhnak ah buri hnipuan ka hruk; Atu leivut lakah thinpit in ka to."},"16":{"text":"Ka ṭahnak ah ka hmai a sen ṭheh; Ka mit tla an cuur ṭheh ih Ka mit vun a dup ṭiamṭiam ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mi thisen luannak ah ka kutin zianghman a tuah lo; Pathian hnenih ka thlacamnak cu a tluangtlam a si."},"18":{"text":"Maw Leilung, ka parih thilsual an tuahmi hi thup hram hlah; Dingnak um seh tiih ka aunak aw hi daiter hram hlah."},"19":{"text":"Ka thu a theitu vanah khin a um, I ṭantu cu a saannak hmunah a um."},"20":{"text":"I simsaktu cu ka rualpi a si, Pathian amah lawng cat loin ka mitthli thawn ka zoh."},"21":{"text":"Minung in a rualpi a ṭan ciamco ṭheu vekin Mi pakhatkhat in Pathian hmaiah i ṭan sehla ka va duh so!"},"22":{"text":"Ka kum cu a liam vivo ih, Dungkir nawn lonak lamzin ka zawh."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka nunnak a cem zik thlang; Ka thaw hman ka thaw thei nawn lo. Thlan in i rak hngak."},"2":{"text":"I hmuhsuamtu pawl in in kulh ṭheh, Cupawl cu cat loin ka zoh hai."},"3":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka thuhrennak ah, keimah hi i co hram aw; Kei i ṭantu ding zoso a um cuang?"},"4":{"text":"Thuruah thiamnak neilo dingin an thinlung na phit ṭheh; Curuangah nehtu siter hram hlah aw."},"5":{"text":"Khuahlan ṭongṭhimnak ah, ‘Mi pakhat in tangka duh ah a rualpi a phiar asile, a faate an mit a caw ding’ ti a um."},"6":{"text":"Cuih ṭongṭhimnak cu ka parah an thlenter; Ka hnenah mi an ra ih ka hmaiah cil in phui."},"7":{"text":"Ka riahsia in ka mit khal a mal thluh zik thlang; Ka kut le ka ke pawl cu phenthlam vekin an ṭawl."},"8":{"text":"Ka fel tiih a ruat-awmi pawl an khawruah a har ih, An zatein Pathian thei lo tiah in hnong ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Upat tlak ka si tiih a ruat-awmi pawl in, Kan dik a si, tiah an zum sinsin."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an zatein ka hmaiah ra ding hnik hai sehla, An lakah mifim pakhatte hman ka hmu lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Ka nunnak ni cu a liam vivo; Ka tumtah mi pawl an hlo deuhdeuh; Ka saduhthah pawl an cem."},"12":{"text":"Asinain ka rualpi pawl cun zan khi sun an ti; Khua a vang zik thlang an ti, Asinain kei cu khawthim sung thotho ah ka um."},"13":{"text":"Ka ruahsanmi cu mithi khua Sheol lawng a si; Cutawkah khuathim sungah ka ihphah ka phah ding."},"14":{"text":"Khawhrum cu ‘Ka pa,’ ka ti dingih, I eitu tholung pawl cu, ‘Ka nu’ culole ‘ka farnu,’ ka ti ding."},"15":{"text":"Cuti asile ka beiseinak cu khuiah so a um? Ka ruahsanmi i hmuhsaktu zotal an um maw?"},"16":{"text":"Mithi khua Sheol ka feh tikah Ruahsannak in i thlun thei lo ding."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job, nangmah vek milai hi, Daite in na um thei lo maw si? Kan thu ngai dingin cawl hrih awla Kan lo sim ve hnik pei.","title":"Bildad in hiti in a sim:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Rannung vek ih aa ah in ruat, Ziangtin so ramsa tlukih in ruah?"},"4":{"text":"Na thin a heng ruangah na tuar deuhdeuh a si; Nangmah ih ruangah leilung hi a ṭhing ding maw si? Nangmah ih ruangah tlang pawl hi an ṭhawn ding maw?"},"5":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih mei-inn cu an mit ding; An meisa cu ziangtik hmanah a alh sal nawn lo ding."},"6":{"text":"A puanthlam sung ih tleunak cu khawthim ah canter a si ding. An kiangih mei-inn an mit ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"A ke kar a rak hngetzet, Asinain atu cu a ke a awl; Amah ih ruahnak ruangah a ril riai."},"8":{"text":"Sur sungah a feh ih a ke in a awk, Kuahrum sungah a tla."},"9":{"text":"Thang in a kedil a awk, Cutiin luat loin a taarhaak."},"10":{"text":"Leilung parah palphum an siah ih, A lamzin ah thang an kam."},"11":{"text":"A kimvel in tuksumza in a bawh, Khuitawk lam a feh hmanah a thlun."},"12":{"text":"Milian a si ṭheu naón atu cu rilrawng in a tha a cem. A kiangin siatnak in a bawh, A rilhbah ding lawng a hngak."},"13":{"text":"A pumpuluk in natsia in a tlun, A kut le a ke pawl an ṭawt ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Thlangam zetih a umnak puanthlam sungih sin an dirsuak, Thihnak Siangpahrang tong dingah an caih hlo."},"15":{"text":"Atu-ah zokhal a puanthlam sungah a um thei; Natsia um nawn hlahseh tiah Kaat meialh thawn an ur hnuah cun!"},"16":{"text":"A hnuailam ah a hrih a thi ih, a tlunlam ah a ṭeek pawl an vuai."},"17":{"text":"A hmin cu an khua le an ramah, ramdang khalah a cem riai; Lamzin ah zohmanin an cing nawn lo."},"18":{"text":"Minung umnak leilung ihsin dawihlo a si ding; Tleunak ihsin thimnak sungah dawihlo a si ding."},"19":{"text":"Cithlah tesinfa zohman a nei lo, A nehhnu ih a nungtu an um nawn lo."},"20":{"text":"Nisuahnak ihsin nitlaknak tiang mipi in cuih thu an theih tikah, an thinphang in an khur thlohthlo."},"21":{"text":"Miṭha lo pawl ih tonmi le dinhmun cu cubangtuk a si; Pathian zianghman ih a siar lotu pawl cu!"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangtik tiang lawmmam so nan ṭong in in hrem rero ding?","title":"Job in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"A voi siarcawk lo in hmuhsuam, Hitiih in hmuhsuam ruangah ningzah nan thiam fawn lo."},"4":{"text":"Sualnak ka tuah ngai hman sisehla, Nannih natnak ziangso a um?"},"5":{"text":"Keimah hnakih miṭha deuh ah nan ruat aw; Ka tuarnak ruangah ‘A mawh’ tiah in ruat."},"6":{"text":"Mawhnak ih i retu cu Pathian a si hi nan thei thei lo maw? Keimah awk duh ah thang a kam a si."},"7":{"text":"‘Thisen a luanter,’ tiih ka au khalle zohman in an ngai lo; ‘I bawm uh’ ka ti khalle dingnak a um cuang lo."},"8":{"text":"Pathian in ka lamzin a phit ih ka feh thei nawn lo; Ka lamzin cu khawthim in a khahter."},"9":{"text":"Ka sunlawinak hmuahhmuah i long ṭheh zo; Ka hminthannak hmuahhmuah a cemter ṭheh zo."},"10":{"text":"A kaa kipin i vuak ih i cemter, Ka ruahsannak cu zanthing bangin a hram in a phong, Vuai ding le thi dingah i taanta."},"11":{"text":"Ka parah a thinhengnak cu meisa bangin a alh; A ral ṭihnung bikah i ruat."},"12":{"text":"Keimah do dingah a ralkap pawl a thlah; Phardawl lan thei dingah a lengin leilung an dawl ih an khahsilh; Ka deuthlam an kulh ṭheh."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in a forh ih ka unau pawl in in tlansan ṭheh; I thei ciatu pawl khal mikhual ah an cang ṭheh;"},"14":{"text":"Ka sungkhat pawl in in tlansan, Ka rualpi pawl in in taanta."},"15":{"text":"Ka inn ih a riak ṭheumi pawl in in hngilh ṭheh zo; Ka siahhlawh nunau pawl in mikhual le ramdangmi ah in ruat."},"16":{"text":"Ka hnen-um ka ko ih i awi lo, Bomnak dil ih ka leem hmanah in pan duh lo."},"17":{"text":"Ka nupi in ka thaw namsia a tuar thei lo; Ka suahpi ka unau hman in in fih."},"18":{"text":"Nauhak pawl in in hmuh tikah in hmuhsuam ih in hnihsan."},"19":{"text":"Ka rualpi ṭha bik pawl hman in in ningsin, Ka duhdawt bikmi pawl ka ralah an cang."},"20":{"text":"Ka ruh parah ka vun a thlai aw niarniar; A nung ti theih fangfang ka si."},"21":{"text":"Nannih cu ka rualpi nan si! I zaangfah hram uh! Pathian kut in i vuak thluk a si."},"22":{"text":"Pathian ih i hrem vekin ziangah so nannih tla cun in hrem? Hi tluk in tuarter hi tawk nan ti lo maw si?"},"23":{"text":"Hitiih ka ṭong mi hi zotal in rak khum hai sehla, Cazual sungah rak ngan hai sehla ka va duh so!"},"24":{"text":"Culole thirkhen thawn lungpheng parah ṭelh in, Kumkhua hmun dingin ngan hai sehla ka va duh so!"},"25":{"text":"Asinain keimah i ṭantu cu a nung ti ka thei; A netnak ah leilung parah a ding leh ding."},"26":{"text":"Natnak in ka vun cu ei ṭheh hmansehla, Hitiih ka tisa thawn Pathian cu ka hmu ding."},"27":{"text":"Ka mit rori in amah ka hmu ding, Midang si loin keimah rori in ka hmu ding a si. Cumi cu ka thinlung in a hngakhlap."},"28":{"text":"‘Ziangtin so kan hrem thei ding?’ nan ti ruangah ka tha hmuah a poih ṭheh zo. Keimah hrem duh ah thudang nan hawl."},"29":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu cun ralnam ṭih thlang uh! Sualnak parih Pathian thinhengnak a thlengtertu ralnam cu! Cutiin thuṭhentu a um sokhaw ti nan thei ding."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job, ka riah i siatter; Na thu let loin ka um thei nawn lo.","title":"Zofar in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Na ṭong cia mi pawl hi hmuhsuam nak ṭong an si; Asinain ziangvek in ka lo sawn ding, ti ka thei, theihthiamnak ka nei."},"4":{"text":"Na theih vekin, hlanlaipi leilung parih minung an um hramthok ihsin,"},"5":{"text":"Miṭha lo lungawinak cu tikcu tawite lawng a si."},"6":{"text":"Ṭhangso in van tiang hmansehla, A lu in vanrang dai hmansehla,"},"7":{"text":"Leivut vek thli in a semhlo ding; A rak thei ciatu pawl in ‘Khuiah so a si’ an ti rero ding."},"8":{"text":"Zanmang bangin a hlo ding; Mang ih hmuh mi bangin ziangtik hmanah hmuh sal a um nawn lo ding."},"9":{"text":"A hmutu mit in an hmu lo ding; A um ṭheunak hmun in a hlo ding."},"10":{"text":"Farah zonzai hnen ihsin a ruk mi thilri pawl cu, A fapa pawl in an lennak sungin an pek kir ding."},"11":{"text":"A nonal ih a cakvakmi a ruang cu, Rei lote-ah leivut ah a cang ding."},"12":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo cu a thlum zetin a thei; Curuangah a hrekkhat a ka sungah a hmawm."},"13":{"text":"A lei hnuai ah reipi a ret, A thlummi kha a phui siang lo."},"14":{"text":"Asinain cuih rawl a eimi cu a pumpi sungah a kha; Thihsii vekin a kha a si."},"15":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo in a rukmi thilri cu a luak sal ṭheh; Pathian in a long sal, a pumpi sung ta hman a phorh sal ṭheh."},"16":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo ih a dolh mi cu thihsii a si; Rul hraang ih tur bangin mi a that."},"17":{"text":"Tiva bangin olif siti a luangmi cu a hmu lo ding; Cawhnawi le khuaitizu a luangmi khal a hmu lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Hna a ṭuan sanmi hmuahhmuah ei loin a hlon a ṭul ding; A lennak thilri pawl nuam in a hmang man lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Ziangahtile farah pawl a namsuk ih zianghman ah a siar hai lo. Mi inn sak cia pawl tla a long."},"20":{"text":"A duhhamnak cu cem ti a nei lo; Curuangah a sunloih mi thilri hman hum theimi zianghman a nei lo."},"21":{"text":"A in a ei ih a hlah mi zianghman a um lo; A lennak cu a rei hlanah a cem."},"22":{"text":"Hlawhtling zetin a um laifangah, Vansan malmaknak a ra thleng; Harsatnak le riahsiatnak nasa zetin a hnenah a thleng a si."},"23":{"text":"A duhzat in ei ko seh! Pathian thinhengnak cu a hnenah meisa bangin a alh ding ih ruah bangin a parah a sur ding."},"24":{"text":"Tlan a tum ih thir ralnam in a luat hmanah, Dar conkiang in a ngah ih a thin a sun ngah."},"25":{"text":"Conkiang cu a pum ah a phun aw, Cuih conkiang cu an suah ngah; A tleumi a zik hriam ihsin thisen for khat hnu for khat a tla; Cutikah a thinlung cu tuksumnak in a khat."},"26":{"text":"A khawl ciami thilri hmuahhmuah cu siatsuah an si; Milai ih muah lomi meisa in amah le a innsang an kaang ṭheh."},"27":{"text":"Hi pa sualnak cu van in a langter; Amah do dingah leilung cu a tho."},"28":{"text":"Pathian thinhengnak cu tilik bangin a ra ding ih, A lennak hmuahhmuah a zatein a siatsuah ding."},"29":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih tonmi cu cu bangtuk a si; An hrangah Pathian ih lairel ciami a si."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ṭongmi hi ngaihnik uh! In hnem theinak cu cumi lawng a si.","title":"Job in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Ṭong theinak tikcu i pe uh, Ka ṭheh tikah nan duh asile i hnihsan leh uh."},"4":{"text":"Mihring thawn thu kan el-aw a si lo! Ka thin a tawi khalle ka mawh lo."},"5":{"text":"I zohhnik uh! Mangbang tuksum le ṭong loin nan kaa nan hup a si!"},"6":{"text":"Ka parih thil cangmi ka ruah ah, Ka khawruah har tukah ka khur rero."},"7":{"text":"Ziangah so Pathian in miṭha lo pawl hi an nunnak a zuah? An san a sauter ih milian sinsin ah a tuah hai?"},"8":{"text":"An tu le an fa pawl pitlin tiang hmuta man ih an nun?"},"9":{"text":"Pathian in an innsang ah harsat vansaannak a thlengter lo ih, Thinphan thlaṭemnak tla an tong dah lo."},"10":{"text":"Asi, an caw pawl tla an him ih vansiatnak tong lotein an pungzai."},"11":{"text":"An faate pawl cu suk le so ah an tlan ih, tuu faate bangin an lek."},"12":{"text":"Ṭingṭang le khuangte tum in an laam detdo."},"13":{"text":"Hnangam zetin tarkuun an nung ih harsatnak tuar lo daiteón an thita."},"14":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo in “In tlansan aw,” tiah Pathian an ti; “Na lamzin hi a theih khal kan duh lo,” an ti."},"15":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei kan biak rero a ṭul lo, A hnenih thlacam rero khal a ṭhahnem lo, tiah an ruat."},"16":{"text":"‘Kan cahnak in kan hlawhtling pam,’ an ti. Asinain an ruahdan cu ka pom thei lo."},"17":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo ih meifar cu a mit dah maw? Anmah lakah zotal in harsatnak an tong dah maw? Pathian in a thinheng in mi ṭha lo pawl a hrem dah maw?"},"18":{"text":"Hrampi ro vekin thli ih sem dingah le Leidip vekin thlisia ih nuai hlo dingah a tuah hai maw?"},"19":{"text":"A pa sualnak ruangah a fa parah Pathian cawhkuan a thleng, nan ti. A si lo, misual parah Pathian hremnak thleng seh. Nan sual ruangah ka lo hrem a si, ti tla fiangtein langter seh."},"20":{"text":"Misual pawl in an sualman siatsuahnak tuar hai seh; Ziangkimtithei Pathian ih thinhengnak tong hai seh."},"21":{"text":"Mi pakhat a nunnak ni a cem tikah a taantami a innsang le faate ih thu a hun thei nawn ding maw si?"},"22":{"text":"Zotal in Pathian a zirh thei ding maw? Van ih a ummi pawl par hmanah thu a ṭhentu Cungnungbik parah cun!"},"23":{"text":"Mihrek cu an thih ni tiang mi harhdam an si; Lungawi le thinnuam in an um ih an taksa ṭhazet cing in an thi.","merge":"24"},"25":{"text":"Mihrek cu lungawinak an nei dah hrimhrim lo; Thinhar in an nung ih thinhar in an thi cihta."},"26":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cute pahnih cu an thi ih phum an si; An pahnih in tholung in an khat ṭheh veve."},"27":{"text":"Ziangvek ruahnak nan nei, ti ka thei. Keimah siatsuah dingah ruahnak ṭha lo nan nei ti ka thei."},"28":{"text":"Nannih in, “Milian pa ih inn cu khuiah so a si? Thilsual a tuahtu pa cu khuiah so a um?” tiah nan sut."},"29":{"text":"Khualtlawng pawl thawn nan bia aw dah lo maw? Annih ih an ra simmi thu nan thei dah lo maw?"},"30":{"text":"Pathian a thin a heng ih mi a hrem tikah, A luattu cu mi ṭha lo an si ṭheu."},"31":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pa sual puhtu ding zotal an um maw? A tuahmi hmuahhmuah a thungrultu zotal an um maw?"},"32":{"text":"A thih tikah ṭhateih kilmi thlaanmual ah an zawn."},"33":{"text":"A thlaan ih leilung an silh mi hman a hrangah a neem; Mi thawng tampi in an thlah, A hmaiih siar cawk lo a rak feh ciami pawl vek khan."},"34":{"text":"Nannih pawl cun thulolak in a hnem in tum; Nan ṭongmi hmuahhmuah hi thuphan hlir a si."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangvek milai, mifim bik khal sisehla, Pathian hrang ih mi ṭhahnem an um ngai ding maw?","title":"Biakson Awk Voithumnak (22.1—27.23) Elifas in hiti in a ti:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Thildik na tuahmi cu Pathian hrangah a sawtnak a um maw? Asilole na ṭhatnak in Pathian ziangtal a bawm maw?"},"4":{"text":"Nun a lo zirh ih hniksak na ton hi Pathian na ṭihzah ruangah a si lo."},"5":{"text":"Na ṭhatlonak a nasat ruangah le Na sualnak a tamtuk ruangah a si sawn."},"6":{"text":"Na unau in tangka an lo baakmi kuanter dingah thuhrennak na lak; A hnipuan cu na long ṭheh ih hruk ding dang zianghman nei loin na ret."},"7":{"text":"Thabaang ih tihal mi pawl hnenah tidai na pe lo ih, Rilrawng mi pawl hnenah rawl na pe duh fawn lo."},"8":{"text":"Huham na neihnak le mi upa na sinak cu, Ram pumpi luah thluhnak ding lawngah na hmang."},"9":{"text":"Nuhmei pawl na bawm duh lo lawng si loin Ngakṭah farah pawl an thil na long ih na siatsuah hai."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah na kiangkapah a lo awktu ding thang tampi an um; Rinlopi in ṭihphannak in na khat;"},"11":{"text":"Thimnak a sah tuk ih zianghman na hmu thei lo; Tilik in a lo khuh a si."},"12":{"text":"Vancung saangbikah Pathian a um; Arsi pawl cu an saang ve naón, Pathian in a run zohsuk hai a si lo maw?"},"13":{"text":"Asinain nang in, “Pathian cun ziangso a theih ding? Mero in a phen a sisi! Ziangtin so ka thu a ṭhen thei ding?” tiah na ti."},"14":{"text":"Vankuumpi parah Pathian lam a len tikah, Mero sahzet in a phen ih i hmu lo ding, tiah na ruat!"},"15":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih an thlun ringring mi lamzin hlun cu, Thlun dingah na duh thotho maw si?"},"16":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu an tikcu a kim hlanah tilik in a fen hai; Hrihram an neihmi hmuahhmuah thawn a fenhlo thluh hai a si."},"17":{"text":"Himi pawl cu Pathian a eltu le Kan parah zianghman a tuah thei lo ding, tiih a ruattu an si."},"18":{"text":"Asinain anmah a liantertu cu Pathian Amah thotho a si; Mi ṭha lo pawl ih ruahnak cu ka ngaih lo zawng hrimhrim a si."},"19":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl hremnak an tuar tikah cun, Mi ṭha pawl an lung a awi ih mawh nei lo pawl an hni."},"20":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih thil neihmi hmuahhmuah cu a cem, A taangsun cu meisa in a kaang ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah Job, Pathian thawn rem aw uh, Amah cu na ral ah ruat nawn hlah, Cutin asile a lo thlawsuah ding."},"22":{"text":"A thuzirh mi cu pom awla, A ṭong cu na lung sungah ret aw."},"23":{"text":"A si, tangdornak thinlung thawn Ziangkimtithei hnenah kir awla, Na inn sungih thil ṭha lo hmuah cu a hlapi ah hlon aw; Cutin a lo hlawhtlingter sal ding."},"24":{"text":"Na sui hlawnthil hlon ṭheh aw; Ofir ihsin na sui ṭha bik khal tikua lungto bangin hlon ṭheh aw."},"25":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian cu na sui a si ding ih, Amah cu hril hleice mi ngun bangtuk na hrangah a si ding."},"26":{"text":"Cutiin Pathian cu na lungawinak a si ringring ding ih, Mithmai ṭha thawn Amah lam thinnuam in na hoi ding."},"27":{"text":"Thla na cam tikah a lo let ding; Na tiamkammi pawl cu feltein na kimter ding."},"28":{"text":"Na thu relcatmi hmuahhmuah tuahsuak an si ding ih, Na fehnak lamzin a tleu ding."},"29":{"text":"Pathian in mi puarthau pawl a ṭhum ih, Mi tangih a dor pawl a hum a si."},"30":{"text":"Na tuah mi a thiang ih mawhnak neilo na si ahcun Amah in a lo run ding."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian parih ka phunzainak cu a besia deuhdeuh, Ka hrumraknak khal a zual sinsin, Ka parih a kut a rih tuk ruangah.","title":"Job in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"A fehnak lamzin thei ningla, A umnak hmun khal thei ningla, ka va duh so!"},"4":{"text":"A hnenah ka thu ka thlenter ding; Ka thu cu famkim zetin ka sim ding."},"5":{"text":"Ka hnenih a ṭong dingmi le I son dingzia tla theih ka duhzet."},"6":{"text":"A huham neih zat in Pathian in i do pei maw? Do hlah e, ka ṭong mi ṭhatein a ngai sawn ding."},"7":{"text":"Ka fel a si, Pathian thawn thu kan rel tlang ding; Mawhnak na nei lo, tiah kumkhua daih in i ti ding."},"8":{"text":"Nisuahnak lamah ka hawl zo, Cunah Pathian a um lo. Nitlaknak lamih ka hawl khalle a um thotho lo."},"9":{"text":"Pathian cu saklam le thlanglam ah hna a ṭuan; Asinain ka hmu thei cuang lo."},"10":{"text":"Pathian in ka kekar kar khat tiangin a hmu, I hniksak asile sui vekih ka thian kha a thei ding."},"11":{"text":"Ka hrangih a hrilmi lamzin cu feltein ka thlun; Vorhlam ah siseh, kehlam ah siseh, ka pial hrimhrim lo."},"12":{"text":"A hmurka ihsin a suakmi thupekmi cu pialsan loin ka tuah ringring; Ka duhmi si loin amah ih duhmi ka thlun ringring."},"13":{"text":"Pathian cu a thleng aw dah lo; Zohman in an dodal thei lo ding ih, A tuah duhmi cu zohman in an kham thei lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Ka hrangih tumtahnak a neih mi pawl a kimter ding, Cuih tumtahnak tlunah tumtahnak dang tampi a nei."},"15":{"text":"A hmaiah ṭihphang in ka khur, Cumi ka ruah tikah cun ka ṭih."},"16":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian in ralṭhatnak ka neih mi hmuahhmuah a hlohralter ṭheh; Thimnak in ka mit cawtter hmansehla, I ṭihtertu ngaingai cu thimnak a si lo, Pathian Amah a si.","merge":"17"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangah so Pathian in thuṭhennak ni a khiah lo? Amah a riantu pawl in thudik an conak dingah!"},"2":{"text":"Milai in ram tam deuh ngah duh ah ramri lungphun an ṭhawn; Tuu an rak fir ih anmah ih tuu lakah an ret."},"3":{"text":"Ngakṭah farah pawl ih laak tla an fir; A leiba a kuan ṭheh hlan lo nuhmei nu ih cawcang an hren."},"4":{"text":"Mi zonzai pawl an palcih hai ih, Mi tlasam pawl cu anmah ṭih ah an relh."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah mifarah pawl cu hramlak laak bangin ramcaar ah rawl an hawl; Khuitawk hmanah an faate hrangah rawl an ngah thei lo."},"6":{"text":"Midang lo sungah rawl an lak; Mi ṭha lo pawl ih sabit hmuanah sabit rah an khawm."},"7":{"text":"Zan ah puan loin lawngte in an it, An taksa hlumtu zianghman a um lo."},"8":{"text":"Tlang par ih ruah in a ciah hai; Beunak a um lo ruangah lungpi phenah an bek."},"9":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl in pa nei lo nauta pawl salah an zuat; Mifarah ih faate pawl cu leiba ai ah an lak."},"10":{"text":"Mi zonzai pawl hnipuan nei loin khawleng ah an feh; Fangteel an phur rero naón an ril a rawng thotho."},"11":{"text":"Siti dingah olif an rial, Sabitti dingah sabit rah an rial; Asinain an ti a haal thotho."},"12":{"text":"Khawpi sungah hriamhma pu mi le A thi cuahco mi pawl an au rero; Asinain an thlacamnak cu Pathian in Zianghman ah a siar lo."},"13":{"text":"Annih cu tleunak duh lotu an si; A theih khal an thei lo ih a lamzin an thlun duh lo."},"14":{"text":"Zinglam khawfingcatah mithattu cu farah le mitlasam that dingah a pok, Cule zanah mi thil a fir."},"15":{"text":"Uire pa cu khawthimah mi a hngak, ‘Zohman in in hmu lo ding’ a ti; Theih ṭih ah a hmai a khuh-aw."},"16":{"text":"Fifir in zan ah inn an bauh, Asinain sun ahcun inn ah an relh; Tleunak cu an hrial."},"17":{"text":"Sun vang cu an ṭih; Asinain zan khawthim cu an ngam. [Zofar]"},"18":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo cu tilian in a fenhlo; A ram neihmi cu Pathian ih siatcam mi ram a si; A sabit hmuan ih hnaṭuan dingah an feh nawn lo."},"19":{"text":"Vur cu a satnak le a caarnak hmun ahcun a ziam vekin, Misual cu a nungmi umnak ram in an hlo a si."},"20":{"text":"Zohman in an thei lo, amah ih nu hman in a ciing nawn lo; Tholung in an ei ih zanthing tlu bangin a rop ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Ziangahtile nuhmei a tisiat, Fa nei lo a cingmi nunau parah, Zaangfahnak zianghman a nei lo."},"22":{"text":"Pathian in a huham in micak pawl a siatsuah, A caangvai ih miṭha lo an thi."},"23":{"text":"Pathian in himnak hmunah a umter, Asinain a mit in a thlingthla ringring."},"24":{"text":"Caan tawi sung cu mi hlawhtling zet a si; Asinain rei lote-ah hrampi bangin a vuai sal; Ah ciami fangkung bangin."},"25":{"text":"Ka simmi vekin a si lo, tiah a el theitu nan um maw? Ka ṭongmi hi a dik lo, tiah a langter theitu nan um maw?"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian hnenah cahnak le huham a um, Amah cu maktara a si; Curuangah zokhal in nan ṭih pei, A ukmi vancung ramah daihnak a um.","title":"Bildad in hiti in a ti:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Zotal in amah riantu vancungmi an siar thei pei maw? Pathian tleunak a thlen lonak hmun khui talah a um maw?"},"4":{"text":"Pathian mithmuh ah, nunau hrinmi milai lakah miding an um pei maw? Zotal a thiangmi an um pei maw?"},"5":{"text":"A mithmuh ah thlapi khal a vaang lo ih arsi khal an fai lo."},"6":{"text":"Cuti a si ahcun milai cu cucik kharbok le tholung tluk fang a si; Pathian mithmuh ziangtluk inso a fai lo sinsin ding."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hrangah ziangtluk bawmtu ṭha so na si! Mifarah, miṭawnṭai kei hi!","title":"Job in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Ruahnak ṭhazet mi na pe thei, Kei vek mi aa na fimnak na hlawm duh hi!"},"4":{"text":"Hizat na ṭong hi zo in so ngai cawkseh na ti? Hi vek ṭong dingah zoso a lo fial? [Bildad]"},"5":{"text":"Mithi pawl ih thlarau cu an khur, Leilung thuai ih tidai sungah."},"6":{"text":"Mithi khua Sheol cu Pathian hmai ah a lang ṭheh; Hlohralnak hmun cu phentu ziang hman a nei lo."},"7":{"text":"Pathian in saklam van cu a pharh; Van thlahawmpi sungah leilung cu a thlai."},"8":{"text":"Mero sungah tidai a ret; Tidai a rit zet naón a pah lo, Pathian in a kham."},"9":{"text":"Thlapi cu mero phen ah a thup; A hmai hmuahhmuah a khuhter ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Tipithuanthum parah rikhaam a riin ih Cutiin tleunak cu thimnak in a ṭhen."},"11":{"text":"Van hun dotu ṭhuam pawl an hnin, A hro hai tikah an thin a phang ih ṭihnak thawn an khur ciamco."},"12":{"text":"A thazaang cakin tifinriat a neh; A thiamnak in rulhreng Rahab a that."},"13":{"text":"A thaw thawt in van a faiter ih, A kut in rulpi a tlanmi cu a that."},"14":{"text":"Asinain hi pawl cu a cahnak zimte lawng an si; Kan theih mi hi cu a thlizil fang a si; Pathian a maksakzia taktak cu zoso a thei thei ding?"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian, ding thluk lairelnak i coter lotu le, Ninghang in i tuahtu a nungmi Pathian hmin saal in thu ka kam:","title":"Job in a peh sal:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Pathian in nunnak thaw i pekmi ka neih sungah cun, Pathian ih i pekmi ka hnar ih ka thawt sungah cun,"},"4":{"text":"Ka hmur in ṭongsia a suak lo ding ih, Ka lei in thuphan a per lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Nannih nan dik tiah ka ti dah lo ding; Mawhnak ka nei lo tiah ka thih ni tiangin ka ṭang ding."},"6":{"text":"Thudik ih ka dinnak cu ka thlah thei dah lo ding; Ka lung a thiang; ka thinlung in ‘Ka mawh ngai’ a ti dah lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Keimah i raltu le i dotu pawl cu Mi ṭha lo le miding lo vekin hrem si hai seh."},"8":{"text":"Pathian a thei lotu pawl in ziang ruahsannak so an neih ding, Pathian in an nunnak a cemter tikcu caan ahcun?"},"9":{"text":"Harsatnak an ton ih an au tikah, Pathian in an aunak a thei ding maw?"},"10":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian ah an lung a awi pei maw? A hnenah thla an cam ringring ngai pei maw?"},"11":{"text":"Pathian huham a makzia cu ka lo sim hai ding; Ziangkimtithei Pathian ih tumtah mi cu ka lo theihter hai ding."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nanmah rori in nan hmu fingfing zo; Curuangah ziangah so hivek thulolak nan ṭong rero? [Zofar]"},"13":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian in mi ṭha lo, thisen suah ṭih lo pawl A hrem haizia cu hivek in a si:"},"14":{"text":"Fapa tampi an neih hmanah ralah an thi ṭheh ding; An faate pawl in rawl khopkham ei ding an nei dah lo ding."},"15":{"text":"A nungsun hnihkhat cu natnak in an thi thotho ding, An nupi pawl hman in an ṭah hai lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl in ngun siar cawk lo an nei ding; Hnipuan tla vuun liailiai in, an ṭulmi hnakih tam an nei ding."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla miṭha hrekkhat in cuih hnipuan cu an hruk ding, Mifel hrekkhat in an ngun cu an co ding."},"18":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih sakmi inn cu a hnget lo; Maimom innraang vek le, lo kiltu sal pawl ih sakmi deute vek a si."},"19":{"text":"Caan khat sung cu lian zetin an it ding ih, An hung ṭhang tikah an lennak cu A rak cem ṭheh ti an hmu ding."},"20":{"text":"Rinlo tilik vekin tuksumnak in a tlak ding; Zan thli hrang in a semhlo ding."},"21":{"text":"Nisuahnak lam thlisia in an inn ihsin a semhlo hai ding."},"22":{"text":"Luat an tum rero lai hmanah, Zaangfah nei loin a nuai hai ding."},"23":{"text":"An tlan phah ah thlisia cun a hran vivo ih, ṭihnung zetin a nuai hai a si."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngun an laihnak khur a um; Sui an thianternak hmun a um.","title":"Fimnak Thupitzia"},"2":{"text":"Milai in thir cu leilung sungin an lai, Dar cu lungto sungin an titter."},"3":{"text":"Milai cu a thuk bik thimnak hmun tiang an thleng; Leilung sung a thuknak ah an lut, Thimnak sungah lungto an hawl."},"4":{"text":"Milai umnak ihsin a hlatzet ah Milai ke ih pal dah lonak hmunah lungmankhung an lai leikua sungah; Cutawkah anmah lawng hna an ṭuan, Khur sungah hri in an thlai aw."},"5":{"text":"Leilung parah thlairawl a kho; Asinain cuih leilung sung cu Meisa kaang vekin an ling an so ih an let aw hluahhlo."},"6":{"text":"Leilung ih lungto sungah mepian lungmankhung a um; A leivut lakah sui an hmu."},"7":{"text":"Cuih khur sung fehnak lamzin cu khaupi in a thei lo; Langta hman a tlunah a zam dah lo."},"8":{"text":"Kiosa siseh, sahrang dang siseh, Cuih lamzin cu an zawh dah lo."},"9":{"text":"Milai in a hak bikmi lungto an lai; Tlang hman a hram in an lailet ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Lungto lakih kua an laih tikah Lungto mankhung an hmu."},"11":{"text":"Tiva hna tla an hmusuak ih Leilung sungih thuh mi thil an phorh suak."},"12":{"text":"Asinain fimnak cu khuiah so ton a theih ding? Theihthiamnak cu khuiah so zir a thei ding?"},"13":{"text":"Fimnak taktak cu minung umnak hi leilung ahhin a um lo; A man ngaingai cu zohman in an thei lo."},"14":{"text":"A thuukmi tifinriat le a thuukmi tipithuanthum in, ‘Hinah fimnak a um lo,’ an ti."},"15":{"text":"Fimnak cu sui in lei a theih lo; Ngun khal in lei a theih lo."},"16":{"text":"Sui ṭha bik le lungmankhung pawl khal in a man an tluk lo."},"17":{"text":"A man cu sui hnakin a tam sawn; Sui kheng le thlalang ṭha bik man hnakin a tam sawn."},"18":{"text":"Fimnak man ngaingai cu lungvar mankhung, lungsen mankhung le Lung sendup mankhung man hnakin a tam sawn."},"19":{"text":"A ṭha bikmi lung-aihre mankhung le sui ṭha bik thawn khal fimnak cu ṭhim theih ding a si lo."},"20":{"text":"Khuiah so fimnak hram cu a si? Khuiah so theihthiamnak cu a um?"},"21":{"text":"Leitlun ih a nungmi minung le ramsa in an hmu dah lo; Van ih a zammi vate khal in an hmu dah lo."},"22":{"text":"Thihnak le siatsuahnak hman in, “A thluathlam ih relmi lawng kan thei,” an ti."},"23":{"text":"Pathian lawngin lamzin a thei; Amah lawngin fimnak lamzin le a hmun cu a thei."},"24":{"text":"Ziangahtile amah in leilung deng tiang a hmu ih, Vanrang hnuai thil hmuahhmuah khal a hmu ṭheh a si."},"25":{"text":"Pathian in thli cu hmual a neihter ih, Tifinriat hrangih ramri a rak tuah tikah,"},"26":{"text":"Ruah a surnak ding hmun a ruat cia ih, Khawri le ṭeektla hrang lamzin a rak sial tikah,"},"27":{"text":"Culai ah Pathian in fimnak cu a hmu ih man a neihzia a hniksak. Cule a lungkim in a hngetter."},"28":{"text":"Pathian in milai hnenah, “Fimnak neih nan duh asile Pathian ṭihzah uh; Theihthiamnak neih nan duh asile a ṭha lomi hrial uh,” a ti."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job cu hiti in a ṭong sal:","title":"Neta Bik Job Ih Simmi"},"2":{"text":"Ka nunnak hi a hram in thok thei sal sehla, Pathian in i rak zoh camcin lai vek khan!"},"3":{"text":"Pathian ih mei-inn cu ka lu parah a tleu ih, Khawthim sung ka feh tikah tleunak i pek."},"4":{"text":"Culai ahcun ka rak neinung zet ih Pathian ih pawlkomnak ruangah ka innsang cu a him."},"5":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian ka hnenah a rak um ih, Ka faate pawl khal ka kiangkap ah kimtein an um."},"6":{"text":"Ka caw le ka me pawl in hnawi tampi in pek; Lungkhol lak khalah ka olif kung an kho thei."},"7":{"text":"Khawsung upa pawl an ton awknak khawpi kotka ih ka to ve tikah,"},"8":{"text":"In hmuh vete in mino pawl cu an kiang, Upa pawl tla in upatnak langter in an ding."},"9":{"text":"An hotu pawl an ṭong nawn lo, An hmurka huh mi an bang."},"10":{"text":"An lakih mi upa pawl tla an dai khepkhep. An lei a caang nawn lo."},"11":{"text":"I hmutu le ka thu i theitu pawl hmuahhmuah in, Ka hnaṭuanmi ruangah in porh zet."},"12":{"text":"Mifarah an au tikah ka bawm, Ngakṭah zonzai zohman bawmtu nei lo ka zoh hai."},"13":{"text":"Awloksong vansaanglam mi pawl in in thangṭhat zet, Nuhmei pawl tla himnak le thinlung nomnak ka hawl sak."},"14":{"text":"Dingfelnak cu hnipuan bangin ka hruk ih, Dingthluk lairelnak cu puanfual le lupawng bangin ka hruk."},"15":{"text":"Mitcaw pawl hrangah an mit can-ai ka si; Ke-awl pawl hrang khalah an ke can-ai ka si."},"16":{"text":"Farah zonzai hrangah pa ka si ih Ka theih lo mikhual pawl harsatnak an ton tikah ka ṭan hai."},"17":{"text":"Zaangfahnak nei lo thuneitu pawl ka siatsuah ih, An hremmi pawl ka luatter hai."},"18":{"text":"Kum reipi nung dingah le Ka inn sungah thlangamte ih thi dingah ka ruat aw ringring."},"19":{"text":"A hrihram in tidai a ngahtu le A hnge in daitla a dong ringringtu thingkung vek ka rak si."},"20":{"text":"Zokhal in in lawm, i relsiatu zohman an um lo; Ka thazaang a ṭum suk lo."},"21":{"text":"Midang hnen ruahnak ka pek tikah Daite in ka thu cu an ngai."},"22":{"text":"Ka sim ṭheh tikah kam khat hman, El ding le beet ding an nei lo. Ka ṭongmi cu an sungah ruahti bangin a pil."},"23":{"text":"Zokhal in ka ṭong ngai ding an hiar zet, Lothlo pawl in ṭoruah an duh zet bangin."},"24":{"text":"An thin a nau tikah ka mithmai ṭha ka langter; Hni suamso ih ka um tikah an thin a nuam sal."},"25":{"text":"Hotu hna ka ṭuan ih thurel ṭulmi ka relcat; Siangpahrang in a ralkap pawl a ho vekin ka ho; An riah a siat asile ka hnem hai a si."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asinain atu-ah cun ka hnak ih mino deuh tla in, Hnihsuahsainak meen ah in hmang; An pa le pawl cu zianghman ih ṭhahnem lo, Ka tuu kiltu ka uico bawmtu hmanah ka duh lomi pawl an rak si."},"2":{"text":"Tha nei lo micor pawl, ka hrangah zianghman ṭuan thei ding lo pawl kha!"},"3":{"text":"An farah, an ril a rawng tuk ih Zan khawthim ramṭhing tla ahcun Thinghram ro hman a nget rero ding pawl an si."},"4":{"text":"Nelrawn hrambur an bawt ih an ei, Thawtnak zianghman nei lomi hmunphiah kung tla an ei."},"5":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in an hauh ih an dawihlo; Fifir nan hauh vek khin!"},"6":{"text":"Lungpuk le khaam ih an laih mi kua sungah an um."},"7":{"text":"Hramlak ah ramsa bangin an ai, Hrambur thuai ah an ben aw."},"8":{"text":"Mi ṭhahnem lo, zianghman ih siartlak lo rual, Ram sung ihsin dawihlomi an si."},"9":{"text":"Atu ahcun an ra ih in ra hnihsan, Kei cu an puahcokmi lawng ka si."},"10":{"text":"In ti daan cu luaksuakza a si; Ka hrangah cun mi ṭha tukah an ruat aw, Ra tahrat in ka hmaiah cil in ra phui."},"11":{"text":"Pathian in mi ṭawnṭai le bawmtu nei lo ih i tuah ruangah, An thinhengnak cu ka parah an burh ciamco."},"12":{"text":"Miburpi in suupnak neiloin in do, In dawi ih tlanhloter in tum; Neta bik siatsuah ding an timtuah."},"13":{"text":"Ka luatnak lamzin in in khan ih a siatsuah in tum; A rak khamtu zohman an um lo."},"14":{"text":"Ka ṭankhuarnak hruang pawl an pahtlang ih, Ka parah an rung tla ciamco."},"15":{"text":"Ṭihphannak in i neh, Ka hminthannak le huham ka neihmi cu thli vekin an hlo ṭheh. Ka lennak cu mero vekin a hlo."},"16":{"text":"Atu cu thih ding lawng ka baak; Ka tuarnak a deem deuh ti a um dah cuang lo."},"17":{"text":"Zan ah ka ruh hmuahhmuah in a na; I ṭam rerotu cu reh ti a um dah cuang lo."},"18":{"text":"Pathian in ka angki hngawng in i kai ih, Ka hnipuan peeng ṭheh in i dirh."},"19":{"text":"Ciarbeek sungah i hlon ih Hnawmhne le vutcam tluk ka si zo."},"20":{"text":"Pathian, ka lo ko naón i sawn dah lo; Thla ka cam khalle i umsan meen."},"21":{"text":"Zaangfah nei loin i tisiat a si. Na tha neih tawp in i hrem."},"22":{"text":"Thli i sem hloter; Thlisia lakah nangmah in i hlon ciamco."},"23":{"text":"Milai zokhal ih ton ciar dingah relcat ciami, Thihnak ah i thlenpi tum a si, ti ka thei."},"24":{"text":"Zaangfahnak dil dah ti lo, zianghman a ti thei nawn lotu, A thinlung le a taksa a siat ṭheh zo mipa cu ziangah so na do duh rero?"},"25":{"text":"Harsatnak a tongtu hnenah ka ṭap ih, Mi tlasam hrangah ka riah a sia, a si lo maw?"},"26":{"text":"Lungawinak le tleunak ka ruahsan mi an si naón, Vansaannak le thimnak riangri an ra thleng."},"27":{"text":"Ka thinlung cu donharnak le natnak thawn a buai nasa, Nitinte tuarharnak in i tlun sinsin."},"28":{"text":"Natnak ka tuar ih ka dum ṭheh, Tleunak malte hman ka ngah lo; Misenpi hmaiah ding tahrat in bomnak ka dil."},"29":{"text":"Ka aw cu hramlak ih cinghnia le sumbuh ai bangin, Riahsia le lunglengza aw a si."},"30":{"text":"Ka vun hmuah a dum ṭheh; Khurhnat in ka na ih ka taksa cu meisa ling in a ling."},"31":{"text":"Lungawinak hlasak thawm ka rak theihnak hmunah, Atu cu riahsiatnak le ṭahnak aw lawng ka thei."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sual duhnak thawn fala zoh lo dingah siatcam in thu ka kam zo."},"2":{"text":"Van ih um Ziangkimtithei Pathian hnenin ka covo ziangso a um? Milai hnaṭuannak parah ziangtin so ro a zem hai?"},"3":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak a tuahtu hnenah cun Siatsuah le hlohralnak a thlenter."},"4":{"text":"Pathian in ka tuahmi hmuahhmuah a thei ṭheh, Ka ke kar khal a hmu ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Thuphanper in ka feh dah lo; Midang bum khal ka tum dah lo."},"6":{"text":"Pathian amah in a dikmi cuai in i thlai seh, Mawhnak ka neih lo zia kha a hmu ko ding."},"7":{"text":"A dikmi lamzin in ka pial ih, Thilsual tuah duhnak in i leem ih, Sualnak in ka kut ka borhhlawhter a si ahcun,"},"8":{"text":"Ka lo rawl siat ṭheh sehla, Ka cinmi rawl cu midang in ei ṭheh hai seh."},"9":{"text":"Ka innhnen pa ih nupi cu mawi in ka hmu ih, A inn sangka lengah relh in ka bawh a si ahcun,"},"10":{"text":"Ka nupi in mipa dang hrang rawl suang sehla, Mipa dang in a ihkhun ah ihpi seh."},"11":{"text":"Cubangtuk sualnak cu a siava mi a si ruangah daan vekin cawhkuan pek ding a si."},"12":{"text":"Cubangtuk sualnak cu ka neih cia mi hmuahhmuah a kang ṭhehtu Hell meisa bangtuk a si."},"13":{"text":"Ka hnen-um pakhatkhat ka parah lungkim loin a phunzai a si ahcun, A simmi ṭhatein ka ngaihsak ding, Cule diktein a parah ka nung ding."},"14":{"text":"Cutiih ka tuah lo asile, Pathian hmai ka zoh ngam ding maw? Ka thu ṭhen ding ih a rat tikah, Ziang so ka ṭong thei ding?"},"15":{"text":"Ka nu pum sungih i siamtu Pathian cu, Ka siahhlawh pawl a siamtu Pathian thotho a si."},"16":{"text":"Mifarah bawm ding ka el dah lo; Nuhmei pawl khal riahsia in ka ret dah lo."},"17":{"text":"Kei rawl ka ei laiah ngakṭah farah rilrawng in ka umter dah lo."},"18":{"text":"An hnenah pa bangtuk in ka um ih, Ka nun sung ṭhatein ka kilkhawi hai a si;"},"19":{"text":"Mi tlasam zet ka hmu ih an farah tuk ruangah hruk ding hnipuan hman an lei thei lo a si ahcun,"},"20":{"text":"Ka tuurual ihsin ka lakmi tuuhmul hnipuan ka pe ṭheu. Cutin ka parah an lung a awizet ṭheu."},"21":{"text":"Thuṭhennak hmunah ka neh ding ti thei in, Ngakṭah farah ka bum a si ahcun,"},"22":{"text":"Ka baan kiak ṭheh sehla, Ka liang ihsin tlongthluh hai seh."},"23":{"text":"Pathian ih cawhkuan pek ka ṭih ruangah, Cubangtuk thil ṭha lo cu ka tuah dah lo ding."},"24":{"text":"Sui parah ka rinsannak ka re lo, Sui ṭha bik khal ka ring cuang lo;"},"25":{"text":"Mi neinung ka si ruangah ka puar dah lo; Lennak tampi ka khawm ruangah ka puarthau dah lo."},"26":{"text":"A tleu-aw tiah ni ka bia dah lo; A mawi-aw tiah thlapi hmaiah ka kun dah lo."},"27":{"text":"Cubangtuk sualnak tuah dingah thlemnak ka tong dah keel lo; Anmah upatnak ah ka kut zaphak khal ka hnam dah lo."},"28":{"text":"Cuvek sualnak a tuahtu cu thah tlak a si; Ziangahtile Pathian a dungtun ih a hnong a si."},"29":{"text":"Ka ral pawl harsatnak an tuar tikah ka lung a awi lo; Siatsuahnak an ton tik khalah ka di a riam lo."},"30":{"text":"An thihnak ding siatcam thlacam in ka sual dah keel lo."},"31":{"text":"Ka hrangih hnaṭuantu pawl in Mikhual pawl ka inn ih ka tlunter cu an thei ṭheh ko."},"32":{"text":"Sukso tawivak pawl ka inn ah ka riahter ih, Lamzin ah ka itter dah lo."},"33":{"text":"Midang cun an sual an thup tum; Asinain kei cu ka sualnak ka thup dah lo."},"34":{"text":"Mipi in ziangtin in rel ding ti ka phang dah lo; In hnihsan pang ding ti phang in innsung khalah ka khum-aw dah lo."},"35":{"text":"Ka ṭong hi zotal in in ngai lo ding maw? Siatcam in ka kam: Ka thusimmi hi kam khat hman a dik lo a um lo. Ziangkimtithei Pathian in i sawnseh. I raltu pawl in mawh in phurhnak cu Ka hmuh dingah ngan suak thei hai sehla,"},"36":{"text":"Hmaihngal zetin ka liangah ka pu ding ih, Sui lukhuh bangin ka lu ah ka khum ding."},"37":{"text":"Pathian hnenah ka tuah mi hmuahhmuah ka sim ṭheh ding; A mithmai ah hngalzet in ka um ding."},"38":{"text":"Ka thlawhmi lo in i mawhthluk ih, Riahsia in a mitthli ka tlakter a si ahcun,"},"39":{"text":"A khomi rawl ka ei ih, Lo a thlotu sawn rilrawng ih ka ret a si ahcun,"},"40":{"text":"Ka lo ah sangvut le fang ai ah Hrampi le hling kho sawnseh. Job ih ṭong cu cutiin a cemta."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job ih rualpi pathum in Job cu an sawn duh nawn lo, ziangahtile mawh nei lo ah a ruat aw tuk.","title":"Elihu Ih A Simmi (32.1—37.24)"},"2":{"text":"Cutiin Job cu miding ah a ret-aw ih Pathian a mawhthluk ruangah an kiangih a dingtu Elihu an timi pa cu a thin a rak hengzet ih a suup aw thei nawn lo. (Elihu cu Ram hrin a si mi Buz tesinfa Barakel ih fapa a si.)"},"3":{"text":"Elihu cu Job rualpi pathum par khalah a thin a heng, ziangahtile Job ih ṭong an leh thei lo ruangah Pathian a palh a si, ti thawn a bang aw."},"4":{"text":"Elihu cu nauta bik a si ruangah midang an ṭong a cem hlan lo daitein a rak um meen."},"5":{"text":"Asinain a rualpi pathum in Job thu an leh thei lo tikah a thin a ṭeu ih hiti in a ti."},"6":{"text":"Kei cu nauhak ka si ih nannih cu upa nan si; Curuangah kei ka ruahmi hun sim ding hi ka hreh zet.","title":"Elihu in:"},"7":{"text":"Nannih ṭong hmaisa ding nan si, Upa deuh in nan fimnak in ṭawm ding nan si, tiah ka ti."},"8":{"text":"Asinain minung hnenah ra in fimnak in petu cu, Ziangkimtithei Pathian ih thlarau a si."},"9":{"text":"Minung cu an tar ruangah an fim a si lo ih, Thudik khal an thei a si cuang lo."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah i ngai ve hnik uh ti ka duh, Ka ruahmi ka lo sim ve ding."},"11":{"text":"Nan ṭong sung hmuahhmuah kha thin sau zetin ka rak ngai, Fimnak ṭongkam nan hawl rero laiah ka lo hngak ringring."},"12":{"text":"Ṭhatein ka lo ngai ih nan neh lo a si ti ka thei. Job ih a ṭongmi pawl nan el thei lo a sihi!"},"13":{"text":"Ziangtin so fimnak neitu kan si tiah nan ti ngam? Job a sawn theitu cu Pathian a si, Nannih cun nan ti thei nawn lo."},"14":{"text":"Job cu nan hnenah a ṭong, ka hnenah a ṭong lo; Asinain a thu nan leh vek cun ka let dah lo ding."},"15":{"text":"Job, ṭong ding an thei nawn lo; Na thu an lo sawn thei lo."},"16":{"text":"Daite ih an um tiang maw ka hngah ding? Ṭong ding zianghman nei nawn loin an ding meen!"},"17":{"text":"Asilo, keimah in atu ah ka lo sawn ding; Ka ruahnak ka lo sim ding."},"18":{"text":"Ṭong loin ka um thei nawn lo, Ka sungah ka ṭong dingmi a khat tuk thlang."},"19":{"text":"Ṭongnak tikcu ka neih lo asile sabitti thar a khatmi saphaw thawl a kuai vekin ka puak kuai ding."},"20":{"text":"Ka ṭong hrimhrim a ṭul a si, Cuti lawngin ka thaw a suak ding; Ka kaa in ka simsuak hrimhrim ding."},"21":{"text":"Hi thu ah zohman ṭan cuangmi ka nei lo ding; Zohman ka porh hlei lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Mi porh khal ka thiam lo; Mi ka porh asile hmakhatte ah Pathian in i hrem ding."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Curuangah Job, ka ṭong dingmi hmuahhmuah hi ṭhatein ngaihnik."},"2":{"text":"Ka thinlung ih a ummi ka hmurka in a suak ding;"},"3":{"text":"Ka ṭongmi hmuahhmuah hi ka thinlung ih ummi thungai an si; Felte in ka sim ding."},"4":{"text":"Pathian ih thlarau in i tuah ih, Ziangkimtithei ih thaw in nunnak i pek."},"5":{"text":"I let hnik, i leh thei asile, Na ṭong dingmi cu ruat hnik! Ka hmaiah ding in ṭang hnih!"},"6":{"text":"Nang le kei cu Pathian hmaiah kan bangrep. Kan pahnih in tlaklei ih tuahmi kan si."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah i ṭih duh hlah; Ka lo neh-nen ciamco lo ding."},"8":{"text":"Na ṭong ka theih mi cu:"},"9":{"text":"“Mawhnak ka nei lo, thilṭha lo zianghman ka tuah lo; Mawh nei lo ka si ih sualnak in ka luat."},"10":{"text":"Asinain Pathian in i do duh ruangah thu a hawl ih, a ral vekah i tuah."},"11":{"text":"Ka ke thir cikcin in a ṭeem ih Ka ke kar hmuahhmuah tla a zohhliah a si,” na ti."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Job, fiangtein ka lo sim: Na palh a si! Pathian cu zovek milai hnak hman in a tumsawn a si."},"13":{"text":"Ziangah so milai ih phunzainak a sawn dah lo tiah, Pathian cu na mawhthluk rero?"},"14":{"text":"Pathian cu milai hnenah atu le atu a ṭong, Asinain a ṭongmi cu zianghman ah an siar lo."},"15":{"text":"Milai an itthat lai, an mang ah Mang le langnak in an hnenah a ṭong."},"16":{"text":"A ṭongmi ngai dingah an hna a ongter ih a sim, Ralrinnak a simmi kha an ṭih."},"17":{"text":"Sualnak tuah nawn lo dingah le Mi puarthau si nawn lo dingin a sim."},"18":{"text":"Thlankhur sung a thlenter hai lo; Thihnak ihsin a run hai a si."},"19":{"text":"Pathian in milai nun a sim tikah natnak a tuarter, An taksa pumpi in natnak a tuar."},"20":{"text":"Mi dam lo pawl cun rawl ei an hiar lo; Rawl thaw bik hman an luak a suak."},"21":{"text":"An taksa a cem deuhdeuh ih An ruh lawng a taang."},"22":{"text":"Thlankhur an pan deuhdeuh, Mithi khua an thleng cing ding."},"23":{"text":"Milai ṭuanvo simfiangtu dingah, Pathian vancungmi thawng tampi lakah pakhat tal, Cuih milai bawm ding le a dikmi sim dingah a ra meen ding."},"24":{"text":"Vancungmi in zaangfahnak thinlung thawn, “Anih kha cu thlah uh! Mithi khua ih feh dingmi a si lo; Amah tlennak man hinah a um,” a ti ding."},"25":{"text":"Cutiin a taksa cu a no ding ih a cak sal ding."},"26":{"text":"Thla a cam tikah Pathian in a let ding, Lungawi in Pathian a bia ding ih, Pathian in a hrangah ziang hmuahhmuah a tluangter sal ding."},"27":{"text":"Cule anih in misenpi hmaiah, “Ka sual a si, a dik lo ka tuah, Asinain Pathian in ka nunnak i zuah."},"28":{"text":"Thlankhur feh ding i siang loih Sun khawtleu ka hmu hrih a si,” a ti ding."},"29":{"text":"Cutiin Pathian in atu le atu hna a ṭuan;"},"30":{"text":"Mi nunnak cu thlankhur thleng loin a run ih, A san sungah lungawinak a pek."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah Job, ka lo sim mi hi ngai aw; Daite in um awla ka ṭong hrih ding."},"32":{"text":"Asinain thusim ding na neih asile sim aw, ka ngai ding; Lungawite in na dik a si ka ti ding."},"33":{"text":"Cuti a si lo ahcun daitein um awla i ngai aw; Fimnak thu ka lo sim ding."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nannih mifim le thuthei pawl, Ka thusimmi hi ngaihnik uh.","title":"Elihu in hiti in a peh sal:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Rawl cu nan tep ih a thawt le thawt lo nan thei; Nan hna in thu nan thei ih thudik a si le si lo nan thei."},"4":{"text":"Na thu cu thudik a si le si lo kan hril pei; Thu ṭha a si le si lo khal kan ruat hnik pei."},"5":{"text":"Job in, “Mawhnak ka nei lo; Ka parah Pathian in dingtein thu a ṭhen lo;"},"6":{"text":"Ziangtin so ka mawh ngai a si, tiah thuphan cu ka rel thei ding? Ka hma hi dam thei sal ding rual a si lo, Asinain sualnak cu ka nei lo,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Job vek milai nan hmu dah maw? Pathian hmuhsuamnak cu ol tein a rel; A hrangah cun tidai in tluk in a ol a si."},"8":{"text":"Miṭha lo pawl thawn pawl awk a duh ih, Misual pawl thawn an feh tlang ringring."},"9":{"text":"Pathian ih rualpi ṭha si hi Zianghman ṭhathnemnak a um lo, a ti."},"10":{"text":"Nannih theihthiamnak a nei pawl I ngai uh! Pathian in thil ṭha lo a tuah ding maw? Ziangkimtithei in thil sual a tuah ngai ding maw?"},"11":{"text":"Milai cu an hnaṭuan thawn kaih-aw in hlawhman Pathian in a pek, An tuahmi ziaza thawn mil-aw in an parah a thlenter a si."},"12":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian cu zo ih par hmanah a ding lomi a tuah lo; Zokhal bangraan tein a zoh."},"13":{"text":"Midang zotal in Pathian hnenah thuneihnak an pe maw? Leilung pumpi hi kil aw, tiah zotal in ṭuanvo an pe maw?"},"14":{"text":"Pathian in a thlarau a lak ih nunnak thaw a lak kir a si ahcun,"},"15":{"text":"Nunnak nei mi hmuahhmuah hi an thi ding ih, Minung hi leivut ah a cang sal ding a si."},"16":{"text":"Fimnak nan neih ngaingai a si ahcun i ngaihnik uh!"},"17":{"text":"A dingmi le a nasami Pathian nan hnong a si maw? Pathian in thudik a hua, sisehla ziangtinso leilung a uk thei ding?"},"18":{"text":"Pathian in siangpahrang le hotu pawl a hnong, Santlai lo le mi ṭha lo an si ahcun."},"19":{"text":"Pathian in mi hmuahhmuah a tuah, Zohman a thleidang lo; Uktu bawi a ṭan loih mifarah hua in milian a duh cuang lo."},"20":{"text":"Milai cu rinlopi in zanah an thi thei; Pathian in a vuakthluk ih an hlota. Micak zet khal ziangtitham loin a cemter a si."},"21":{"text":"Pathian in minung lamzin a zoh, Milai ih ke kar cu a zohhliah!"},"22":{"text":"Ziangvek thimnak a si khalle misual hmu lo dingin Pathian a phen theitu thimnak a um lo."},"23":{"text":"Pathian hmaiah milai feh tahrat in a thu ṭhen dingah, Pathian in tikcu khiah a ṭul lo."},"24":{"text":"Hotu pawl hnong tahratin hotu dang re dingah, Pathian in an thu zingzoi rero ta a ṭul lo."},"25":{"text":"Ziangahtile an tuahmi fate bik khal a thei ṭheh; Zan ah a hlon hai ih a siatsuah ṭheh."},"26":{"text":"Misenpi hmuh theinak hmunah misual pawl a hrem;"},"27":{"text":"Ziangahtile amah an thlun duh nawn lo ih, A thukham hmuahhmuah tla an poisa nawn lo."},"28":{"text":"Anmah pawl in mifarah an tisiat ruangah an hui ih an ṭap; Mifarah pawl ih bom dilnak aw cu Pathian in a thei."},"29":{"text":"Pathian in umsan meen dingih a ruah ahcun, Zoin so an mawhthluk thei ding? A hmai a thuh ahcun milai in ziangso an ti thei ding?"},"30":{"text":"Anmah uktu ah Pathian thei lo, mi-neh-nen hmang ret hman sehla, Ram sungmi pawl in ziangso an ti thei cuang ding?"},"31":{"text":"Job, Pathian hnenah na sualnak na phuang zo maw? Sual nawn lo dingin thu na kam-aw zo maw?"},"32":{"text":"Ka mawhnak i hmuh hram aw, tiah na dil maw? Thil ṭha lo tuah nawn lo dingin na lung a kim zo maw?"},"33":{"text":"Pathian ih hnaṭuannak na soisel zo hnuah, Na duhmi lo tuahsak dingah na beisei lai mawsi? Hi thu cu nangmah ruahcat ding a si, Kei ih ruahcat ding a si lo! Atu-ah na ruahnak in sim hnik!"},"34":{"text":"Thu a ruat thei pawl cu an lung a kim ko ding; Ka thusimmi a theitu mifim pawl an ti ve ko ding:"},"35":{"text":"Job hi thuhla thei ngah loin a rak ṭong pang a sihi! A ṭong mi hi sullam a rak nei lo a sihi! an ti ko ding."},"36":{"text":"Job ih ṭong hi ṭhateih nan ruat a si ahcun, Miṭha lo pakhat vekin a ṭong a si, ti nan hmu ko ding."},"37":{"text":"A sualnak ih tlunah dodalnak a beet ih, Kan mithmuh le kan hna theih ah Pathian a hnihsan, a hmuhsuam a si."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job, nang in, “Pathian hmaiah mawhnak ka nei lo,” na ti hi a dikmi a si tiah na ruat mawsi?","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"“Ka sual lonak hin ziangso i ṭhathnempi? Sual ningla teh kei hrangah ziang so a sawt cuang?” tiah na ti."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah siseh, na rualpi pawl siseh Keimah in thu ka lo let ding."},"5":{"text":"Van khi hun zohhnik! Khawdur tla khi hun zohhnik! Ziangtluk in so nang hnakin an saan?"},"6":{"text":"Na sual a si hmanah Pathian cu harsatnak a pe lo. Thilsual voi tampi na tuah hmanah Pathian cu a hnaihnok lo."},"7":{"text":"Na dingfel ruangah Pathian ka bawm tiah na ruat mawsi? Na hnen ihsin Pathian ih haimi zianghman a um lo."},"8":{"text":"Na sual ruangih a tuartu cu nangmah ih rualpi an si. Na ṭhatnak ih a bommi cu anmah thotho an si."},"9":{"text":"Milai cu hremnak an tuar tikah an hui an aihram ṭheu; Runtu pakhatkhat hnenah runnak duh ah an dil ih an au."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla harnak caan ngaingai a thleng ih anmah thazaang a petu, Anmah Siamtu Pathian cu an hoih duh lo."},"11":{"text":"Ramsa le vate hnakin fimvar deuh ih in tuahtu, Pathian cu an pan duh hrimhrim lo."},"12":{"text":"Bomnak duh ah an au, an ṭap, Asinain Pathian in a sawn hai lo; Miṭha lo le mihngal an si ruangah."},"13":{"text":"An au rero man a um lo, Ziangkimtithei Pathian in a hmu lo; A theih khal a thei hai lo a si."},"14":{"text":"Job, nang cun Pathian ka hmu lo na ti; Asinain thinsau zetin hngak aw, Na thuhla a hmaiah a thleng a si."},"15":{"text":"Pathian ih thinhengnak in mi a hrem lo, Sualnak khal a poisa lo, tiah na ruat."},"16":{"text":"Sullam nei loin na ṭong men, Na ṭong reromi ih tican ziang a si ti zianghman na thei lo."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elihu in a thu hiti in a zom sal:"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ai-awh in ka ṭongmi hi Thinsau in rei deuh ngai hrih aw."},"3":{"text":"I Siamtu Pathian hi a ding a si ti langternak ah, Ka thutheihnak a kim nasami hi ka theih tawkin ka hmang ding."},"4":{"text":"Na hnenih ka ṭongmi hi a dik lomi a um lo; Na hmaiah mifim taktak cu a um ih na hmu a si."},"5":{"text":"Pathian cu a maksak ngaingai ih hmuhsuam mi a nei lo; Theih lomi khal a nei lo."},"6":{"text":"Misual pawl cu a zuah lo; Mifarah pawl thu cu dingtein a relsak a si."},"7":{"text":"Miding pawl cu a hum; Siangpahrang vekin mi uktu ah a tuah ih, Kumkhua in sunlawi upatnak a coter."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla milai in anmah ih thil tuahnak ruangah, Zonzaihnak an tuar ih cikcin ih ṭemṭawnnak an ton ahcun,"},"9":{"text":"Pathian in an sualnak le an puarthaunak an hnenah a langter."},"10":{"text":"Ṭhatlonak ihsin kir sal dingah an hna a ongter ih ralrinnak thu a sim."},"11":{"text":"Pathian thu an thlun ih amah an rian a si ahcun, An nundam sungah hnangamnak le neihnunnak an dong a si."},"12":{"text":"Pathian thu an thlun lo ahcun ralnam in a siatsuah hai ding ih, Zianghman thei loin an thi ding."},"13":{"text":"Pathian thei lo pawl cu an thin a ṭeu ringring; Harsatnak an ton hmanah bomnak dil in thla an cam lo."},"14":{"text":"An san ṭhat laiah an thi ih An nunnak cu ningzahnak in a cem."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in minung cu an harsat tuarnak sungin a run ih, Harsatnak cu an mit vangtertu ah a vanter a si."},"16":{"text":"Pathian in harsatnak sungin a lo suah ih, Himnak sungah nuamzetin a lo ret; Na cabuai cu eiding rawl in a khat."},"17":{"text":"Asinain atu-ah miṭha lo pawl ih an tuar ṭheumi hremnak na tuar; Na sualnak thawn mil-aw in na tuar a si."},"18":{"text":"Ralring aw! Nawhthuh ei-nak in lo bum hlah seh, Lennak in lo hruaisual hlah seh."},"19":{"text":"Bomnak duh ah na au rero khalle a ṭhahnem lo ding, Thazaang na neih mi hmuahhmuah in a lo bawm thei lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Zan a ra thlen dingmi cu hngakhlap duh hlah; Miphun tampi an hlohralnak tikcu a si."},"21":{"text":"A ṭha lomi lamah feh hlah; Culam hoi lo dingin a lo khamtu dingah harsat tuarnak tontermi na si."},"22":{"text":"Pathian ih huham a tumzia cu cing ringring aw; Pathian cu zirhtu saya ṭha bik a si."},"23":{"text":"Zohman in Pathian cu hnaṭuan an fial thei lo ding, Thilsual tuah tla an puh thei lo ding."},"24":{"text":"Pathian cu a thil tuahmi ruangah an thangṭhat ringring; Nannih khal in amah cu nan thangṭhat ve pei."},"25":{"text":"A thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu zokhal in an hmu zo, Asinain lamhlapi lawngin kan cuan thei a si."},"26":{"text":"Pathian ih maksakzia cu kan thei kim dah lo; Pathian ih kum khal siarcawk rual a si lo."},"27":{"text":"Leilung ih tidai la tahrat in Vanruah ih a sur tertu cu Pathian a si."},"28":{"text":"Thlaici cingtu milai hmuahhmuah hrangah Pathian in, Khawdur ihsin ruah a surter a si."},"29":{"text":"Pathian umnak vanah ziangvekin khawdur a feh tile, Ziangtin khua a ri durdo ti zohman in an thei lo."},"30":{"text":"Amah in vanrang deng tiang nimthla a kauter, Asinain tifinriat ih tawdeng cu a thim thotho."},"31":{"text":"Cutiin amah in ruah a surter ih milai a cawm hai; An ei ding rawl tampi a pek."},"32":{"text":"Nimthlakau a kut in a huam ih, A hmuitin ngah dingin ṭektla cu thu a pek."},"33":{"text":"Thlisia a rat ding kha khawri in a than; Cawrual khal in a rat ding cu an thei."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thlisia le ruahhrang in nasazet in ka thin an khurter,"},"2":{"text":"Nan zatein Pathian ih aw thawm ngai uh, A kaa sung ihsin a suakmi khawri thawm cu."},"3":{"text":"Van ahl nimthlakau khuazakip ah a thlah; Leilung kilkip ah a thleng."},"4":{"text":"Cule a awkhawk cu kan thei; A nasa zetmi khawri cu a thang durdo; Culai ah nimthlakau cu cat loin a tleu zohzo."},"5":{"text":"Pathian ih thupek in mangbangza thil a cang, Kan theih ban lomi khawruahhar thil pawl cu."},"6":{"text":"Leilung parah vur tla dingin thu a pek; A thupek vekin ruahpi vanbong in a sur."},"7":{"text":"Hnaṭuantu milai pawl a cawlter, Ziangbangtuk hna a ṭuan thei ti kha theihter a duh."},"8":{"text":"Ramsa pawl an puuk ah an lut, An kua ah an lut ih an kual."},"9":{"text":"Thlisia cu thlanglam in a hung hrang, Khawsik cu saklam in a rung thleng."},"10":{"text":"Pathian ih thaw in tidai a khangter, Cule a hak zetmi tikhal ah an cang."},"11":{"text":"Khawdur lakah tidai a ret, Nimthlakau an tleu zohzo."},"12":{"text":"Pathian thu an thlun ih leilung kilkip an kap zukzo, Pathian ih thupek bangtuk in an um ṭheh, Leilung pumpi khuazakip ah!"},"13":{"text":"Pathian in leilung ciar dingah ruah a surter; Milai hremnak ah maw, Asilole a lungkimnak langternak ah maw, ruah cu a surter a si."},"14":{"text":"Job, malte sung cawlta awla ngaihnik, Pathian ih thil mangbangza a tuah mi hi ruat hnik!"},"15":{"text":"Ziangtin Pathian in thu a pek ih Khawdur ihsin nimthlakau a tleu zohzo ti na thei thei maw?"},"16":{"text":"Khawdur cu vanah ziangtin a thawn luailo ti na thei maw? Pathian ih thil thiam zia hi!"},"17":{"text":"Sim thli a hung hran ih leilung a sat tikah, Na hnipuan le na thawsa thawn na tuar cuahco."},"18":{"text":"Pathian in van khi a pharh ih, Thlalang vek hak in a tuah tikah, Nang na bawm theimi ziang a um?"},"19":{"text":"Pathian hnenih kan ṭong dingmi in sim hnik, Kan thu ah ṭong ding kan nei lo, Kan thinlung ah zianghman a um lo."},"20":{"text":"Ka ṭong ding hi Pathian dilta ka ṭul mawsi? Pathian ih siatsuah ding cu mi in ziangah so an hril rero ding?"},"21":{"text":"Van ih tleunak cu a tle nasa, A tleu tukih kan zoh ngam lo; Van cu thli in a sem fai ṭheh."},"22":{"text":"Saklam in sui vekih a tleumi a lang, Pathian sunlawinak maktara thawn kan thinlung cu a khat."},"23":{"text":"Pathian ih huham a nasa tuk ih kan naih ngam lo; Dingzet le felzet in minung hnen ah thu a rel."},"24":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in an ṭih hi an mawh lo; Ka fim a ti-awtu pawl cu Pathian in zianghman ah a siar lo."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule phusiing sung ihsin Bawipa cu Job hnenah a ṭong. Bawipa in hiti in a ti:","title":"Bawipa In Job Hnenah Thu A Let"},"2":{"text":"Zoso na si, ka fimnak thu a el ṭohṭotu cu? Theihnak nei lopi in na tlok rero ve cu!"},"3":{"text":"Pacang vekin na timtuah in ding awla, Thu ka lo suh dingmi pawl hi i let hnik aw."},"4":{"text":"Leilung ka rak seemsuah laiah nang khuiah na um? Thu na theizet ngai a si ahcun i sim hnik."},"5":{"text":"Leilung hi ziangtia a si ding ti a relcattu zoso a si? A tlunih ramri tahnak zoso a zam? Na theimi a um maw?"},"6":{"text":"Leilung a hun dotu ṭhuam pawl ziang parah so an din? Zo in so a kilphum lung a phum?"},"7":{"text":"Cuih ni khawfingcat ah arsi pawl hmun khatah hla an sak; Vanmi pawl cu lungawi in, an au ciamco."},"8":{"text":"Leilung pum sung ihsin tifinriat a rak suah laiah, A khamtu ding kotka zo in so a rak khar?"},"9":{"text":"Tifinriat kha khawdur in a khuhtu le, Thimnak in a tuamtu cu Keimah ka si."},"10":{"text":"Tifinriat hrangah ramri ka tuah ih, Kalhmi kotka sungah ka ret."},"11":{"text":"“Hi tiang lawng ra awla, hi hlei na feh thei lo; A cak zetmi na tilet pawl hinah an cawl pei!” tiah tipi cu ka ti."},"12":{"text":"Job, na nun sungah ni khatkhat, ‘Khua vaang thlang aw’ na ti dah maw? ‘Khawfing cat thlang aw’ tiah thu na pe dah maw?"},"13":{"text":"Khawfingcat in leilung tlet dingah le, Miṭha lo pawl an relhnak hmunih va hnin suak dingah thu na pe dah maw?"},"14":{"text":"Nitlang in tlang le horkuam pawl fiangtein a langter, Puan buh mi bangin le tlak parih hmin ngannak hminkhen mi bangin a langfiang."},"15":{"text":"Sun nitleu cu miṭha lo hrangah a tleu tuk ih, Thisen luanter ding a kham a si."},"16":{"text":"Tifinriat tawdeng ih tipuutnak na thleng dah maw? Tipithuanthum tawdeng ah lam na leng dah maw?"},"17":{"text":"A thimzet mithi khua ih kotka le A kiltu pawl zo in an lo hmuh dah maw?"},"18":{"text":"Leilung hi ziangtia a si ti na thei maw? Na theih asile i sim hnik!"},"19":{"text":"Tleunak hi khuitawk in a ra ti na thei maw? Thimnak teh khuiinso a suah?"},"20":{"text":"An fehnak ding lamzin le An kirnak ding hmun na sim thei maw?"},"21":{"text":"Na tarzet thlang ih leilung a seem lai ih Na rak suak zo a si ahcun na sim thei ding ka zum."},"22":{"text":"Vur le rial ka retnak khaan na pal dah maw?"},"23":{"text":"Harsatnak tikcu caan hrang le Ral awknak le do awknak caan hrangah ka ret a si."},"24":{"text":"Ni a hung suahnak hmun khi na thleng dah maw? Asilole nisuahnak lam thli a rat nak na pal dah maw?"},"25":{"text":"Ruah ti luannak horkuam cu zo in so a hriat? Khawri le thlisia hrangah zo in so lamzin a sial?"},"26":{"text":"Milai um lonak hmun thlaler ramṭhing ah zoso ruah a surter?"},"27":{"text":"Hrampi hring kho hai seh tiah Ramro le ramcaar zo in so tidai a toih?"},"28":{"text":"Ruah in pa a nei maw? Daitla in hringtu a nei maw?"},"29":{"text":"Zo ih pum sung ah so vur a seem? Zo ih pum sung inso tikhal a suah?"},"30":{"text":"Zoin so tidai cu lungto vekah a canter ih, Tifinriat ih hmai cu a khangter?"},"31":{"text":"Siruk rawlṭawm khi hmun khatah na ṭem thei ding maw? Likhuk caang thum ṭemnak hri na phoih thei ding maw?"},"32":{"text":"Arsi anmah le an caan ciar ih Suak dingin na fial thei ding maw? Ngambawm le zawltling khi lamzin na hmuh thei ding maw?"},"33":{"text":"Van ih a ummi thil pawl thlunmi daan umzia na thei maw? Leilung ahhin thu na run neihter thei pei maw?"},"34":{"text":"Khawdur khi, “Ruah in i run surh aw” tiah na fial thei pei maw?"},"35":{"text":"Nimthlakau khi thu pe cila, anih in, “Na thu vekin siseh,” a lo ti ding maw?"},"36":{"text":"Zoin so ciinphung vate cu ti a lian ding tiah a simter?
