Zoin so butlak cu ruah a sur ding tiah a thanter?"},"37":{"text":"Zoin so khawdur siar thei tlak in a fim? Zoso tidai run thle dingah van tikuang khi thu a pe thei?"},"38":{"text":"Khawdur ihsin ruah a sur tikah Zoso leivut pawl a erh awkter ih leilung cu thir bangin a hakter?"},"39":{"text":"Kiosa pawl rawl ei ding na hawl sak maw? Kiosa no rilrawng pawl an pum na puarter maw?"},"40":{"text":"Kiosa note tla an kua sungah an um ih lungpuk sungih an relh laiah zo in so rawl a pek?"},"41":{"text":"Tlang-ak rilrawng in an vak ih An faate tla rawl duh ah ka hnen an ai tikah zo in so rawl a pek?"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangtikah khaamlak zaathar in faate an nei ti na thei maw? Zukneng ih faate hrin lai na hmu dah maw?"},"2":{"text":"An faate thlaziat an pai ti na thei maw? Ziangtikah an hring ding ti na sim thei maw?"},"3":{"text":"Ziangtikah so a nu a bok ding ih a pum sungin a suah ding ih, Leilung a thlen ding ti na thei thei maw?"},"4":{"text":"An faate pawl cu hramlak ah an tlang ih an cakzet; Anmah ih duhnak ah an feh ih an nu hnenah an kir sal nawn lo."},"5":{"text":"Hramlak laak cu zo in so duh tawkih tlan theinak thu a pek? Zoin so a thlah ih an duhnak ah a vakter?"},"6":{"text":"Milai umlonak nelrawn ramṭhing kha an inn ah ka pek ih, Hrampi umlonak cite hmunrawn ah ka umter."},"7":{"text":"Thawmvang tamnak khawpi sungah cun an um duh lo; Zohman in hrem tahrat in hna an ṭuanter thei lo."},"8":{"text":"Tlangpar cu an hrampi piatnak hmun a si; Ei dingah a hring pohpoh an hawl."},"9":{"text":"Sele in na hna a lo ṭuansak duh ding maw? Na caw inn ah zankhat hman a riak duh ding maw?"},"10":{"text":"Hridai in khit tahratin lei na letter thei ding maw? Leileh cia mi rawnrual seh, tiah leirual ternak na dirter thei ding maw?"},"11":{"text":"A khunghar na hna ṭuantu dingah, A cahnak na rinsan thei ding maw?"},"12":{"text":"Na fang ciilnak puum ah a ra kir sal ding tiah na zum maw? Na puum ah thlairawl na khawmter thei ding maw?"},"13":{"text":"Kalauk vate ih thlakhawn cu ziangtlukinso a zamrang? Asinain ziangvek kalauk vate khal ngathur vek cun a zuang thei lo."},"14":{"text":"Kalauk vate in a ti cu leilung parah a taan; Leilung ih hlumter dingah!"},"15":{"text":"Mi in an pal kuai pang ding, tile ramsa khal in an ciilkuai pang ding, ti a thei lo."},"16":{"text":"A faate pawl cu amah ih fa lo vekin a tuah; A zonzaihnak cu a lak a si ding ti a poisa lo."},"17":{"text":"Hiti vekih a aattertu le fimnak a pe lotu cu Pathian a si."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nasa zetih a tlan cengmang ahcun, Rang le rangtotu hman a titham lo ih a hnihsan meen a si."},"19":{"text":"Job, rang a caktertu cu nang na si maw? A tuanghmul fualzet ih a khotertu cu nang na si maw?"},"20":{"text":"Kharbok vekih an khir hi nang in maw na khirter? Mi an hro ih an hnar an phiit khi nang in maw na phiitter?"},"21":{"text":"Thatho zetin phairawn ah an ke an tiim; Raldonak hmunah an tha neih tawp in an nor."},"22":{"text":"Ṭih khal an nei loih ziangvek ralnam hman in a khir thei lo."},"23":{"text":"Rangtotu ih an kenmi hriamnam: Conkiang bawm, feipi le nam pawl an khawng-aw ih nisa ah an tle zohzo."},"24":{"text":"Raldonak tawtawrawt an tum cun daitein an um thei nawn lo; An tha a tho ih hmaiah an tlan vurvo."},"25":{"text":"Tawtawrawt an tumtin in an hnar an phiit; Raldonak rim lamhlat in an thei, Ralkap hotu bawi ih thupeknak aw khal an thei."},"26":{"text":"Khaute cu na hnen in mawsi zuan a zir? Thlanglam zuan ding ih a thla a pharh tikah khan?"},"27":{"text":"Muvanlai in na thu a ngai mawsi? Tlangsang parih bu a sak tikah?"},"28":{"text":"Lungkham saangbikah bu a tuah ih Lunghriam le lungzum pawl a ralhruang ah a hmang."},"29":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin thah ding le ei ding kha, A hlat a nai ah a thlir ciamco."},"30":{"text":"Saruak umnak ah langta an khawm aw, A thii cu an fano pawl in an dawk."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job, Ziangkimtithei Pathian cu na engtai a si, Dung na siip ding maw, a thu na let ding so?","title":"in Job hnenah:","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Aatthlakza in ka ṭong zo, Bawipa, Kei in ziangso ka lo leh thei ding? Zianghman ka ṭong nawn lo ding.","title":"Job in hiti in a sawn:","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Ka ṭong dingzat hnakih tam ka ṭong zo."},"6":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in phusiing sungin Job hnenah hiti in a let:"},"7":{"text":"Job, pacang bangin ding awla, Ka thusuhmi pawl i let hnik."},"8":{"text":"A ding lo ah i tuah tum mawsi? Kei hi misual ah re tahratin, Nang sawn a dikmi ah na ruat-aw tum mawsi?"},"9":{"text":"Nang, keimah tlukin na cak maw? Na aw teh keimah ih aw khawri vekin a ring maw?"},"10":{"text":"Cuti asile hminthannak le hmaihngalnak na neih mi thawn ding aw; Sunlawinak le huham na neih mi thawn thuam aw."},"11":{"text":"Mi puarthau pawl zoh hai aw; Na thinhengnak suah nasa awla an ningzak koin tuahhnik."},"12":{"text":"Asi, zoh awla ṭhum hai hnik aw; Miṭha lo pawl cu an dinnak hmunah ciil ciammam aw."},"13":{"text":"Leilung sungah phum ṭheh aw; Mithi ramah hreng hai aw."},"14":{"text":"Cutiin na tuah thei asile A lo thangṭhat hmaisa biktu cu Keimah ka si ding. Nangmah in i neh a si, ka ti ding."},"15":{"text":"Sahrang Behemoth khi zohhnik; Nangmah ka lo tuah vekin anih khal ka tuah. Cawcang bangin hrampi a piat."},"16":{"text":"Asinain ziangtluk thazaang cak so a ruangpi ah a um? Ziangvek cahnak so a taksa ah a um?"},"17":{"text":"A mei cu sidar thingkung bangin a khoh, A kawng tha tla a cak ngaingai."},"18":{"text":"A ruh cu dar bangin a khoh, A ke tla cu thir tluan a bang."},"19":{"text":"Ka sersiammi hmuahhmuah lakah mangbangza bik ramsa a si; Amah nehtu cu amah siamtu lawng a um."},"20":{"text":"Sahrang an tlannak tlangsaang ah, A rawl ding hrampi a kho."},"21":{"text":"Hlingkung hnuai ah a bok; Cirhduup ih phaipheng lakah a relh."},"22":{"text":"Tivakap ih hlingkung le partiam kung in daihnem an pek."},"23":{"text":"Tilian hman a ṭih lo; Jordan tisuar in a hmai deeng rero hmansehla daitein a um meen."},"24":{"text":"Zoin so a mit hup tahratin a kai thei ding? Zoin so a hnar ihsin sio in a awk thei ding?"}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tisung sahrang Leviathan cu sio in na awk thei ding maw? A lei cu hridai in na khit thei ding maw?"},"2":{"text":"A hnar vit in hri na thluah thei ding maw? Siopi in a khabe na dawttlang thei ding maw?"},"3":{"text":"‘I thlah hram aw,’ a lo ti ding maw? Zaangfah a lo dil ding mawsi?"},"4":{"text":"Nangmah thawn lungkimnak tuah in Kumkhua lo rian dingah thu a lo kam ding maw?"},"5":{"text":"Na hnenum nunau pawl ih zoh nuam ah, Na innzuat vate bangin na khit thei ding maw?"},"6":{"text":"A sa zuar duh ah ngakaitu pawl an neep-aw rero ding maw? Sumtuah pawl in zuar dingah a sa an can ding maw?"},"7":{"text":"A vun cu feipi in na dawttlang thei ding maw? A lu cu hridai thluah mi fei in na sun thei ding maw?"},"8":{"text":"Na kut in hun dai hnik; Nan sual aw nasa ding; Neh hnuah na ti ngam nawn zik lo."},"9":{"text":"Leviathan cu an hmuh meen hmanah An ṭih tuk ih leilung ah an ril."},"10":{"text":"A ai a thawh cun ṭihnungza ngaingai a si; A hmai ih ding ngamtu zohman an um lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Leviathan a do ih a him thei an um pei maw? Lei tlunah zohman an um lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Leviathan ih kebeu tha le, a thahrum cahzia thuhla sim loin ka um meen thei lo."},"13":{"text":"Zohman in a hrukmi a korleng cu an hlit thei lo ding; A thir angki khal an suntlang thei lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Zoso a khabe a bauh thei ding: ṭihnungza a hatian pawl thawn?"},"15":{"text":"A zaangtluan ih kep cu ralphaw tampi thuah bangin, An thuah aw ṭhepṭhep ih lungto vekin a hak."},"16":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat an peh awknak a pit tuk ih, Thli hman a lut thei lo ding."},"17":{"text":"Hnget tukin an peh-aw ih Zianghman in a dircat thei lo ding."},"18":{"text":"A hahthio tikah tleunak a suak zohzo; A mit cu zingpit nisuak bangin a tle."},"19":{"text":"A kaa sungin mei alh an suak zohzo ih, Meici tla an ṭek hluahhlo."},"20":{"text":"A hnar sung in meikhu a suak; A tlok hluahhlo mi beel hnuai ih hrampi kang khu bangin."},"21":{"text":"A thaw in meisa a alhter ih A kaa sungin meivam a suak."},"22":{"text":"A hngawng cu a cah tukah, A tongtu hmuahhmuah in an ṭih."},"23":{"text":"A vun nemnak zawn khui hmanah a um lo, Thir vekin a hak ih a kiak thei ding rual a si lo."},"24":{"text":"A thinlung cu lungto vekin a ruh ih ṭih a nei lo; A hakmi le a kuai thei lomi fang rialnak lungto vek a si."},"25":{"text":"A hung thawh tikah a cak bik pawl hman in an ṭih; Thinphang in an lung a hlo ṭheh."},"26":{"text":"A hlen theitu ralnam a um lo; A sun pem theitu fei le thal zianghman a um lo."},"27":{"text":"A hrangah thir cu fangkung ro vek a si; Dar cu thing rop vek a si."},"28":{"text":"Conkiang hman in a dawitlanter thei lo; Lungto ih deen khalle a hrangah hramro vek a si."},"29":{"text":"Talhtum cu a hrangah phaipheng kung vek a si; Feipi in an khawh tik khalah a hnihsan meen."},"30":{"text":"A pum vun cu hlamphei hriam a bang. A feh phah ah a ciarmi leilung cu leilet bangin a hrutbal ṭheh."},"31":{"text":"Ukang sung tiso bangin tifinriat cu a soter; Siti beel liam bangin tipi cu a liamter."},"32":{"text":"A feh tikah a dunglam ih tidai cu a tleu zurzo; Tifinriat cu a phuulter ih tibuanra ah a canter ṭheh."},"33":{"text":"Leilung tlunah amah thawn ṭhim ding an um lo; ṭihnak zianghman nei lo ramsa a si."},"34":{"text":"A puarthau bik ramsa pawl hman ziangah a siar lo; Hramlak ramsa hmuahhmuah ih siangpahrang a si."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Job in Bawipa cu hiti in a let:"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa , nang cu ziangtinkim titheitu na si, Na duhmi hmuahhmuah cu na tuah thei ti ka thei."},"3":{"text":"‘Zianghman theilopi in ka fimnak na zo ihnit ngam mawsi?’ tiah i sut. Asi, ka theih lomi thu tampi ka ṭong, Ka theih ban lomi mangbangza thu ka rel."},"4":{"text":"‘Ka ṭongmi ngai awla ka thusuh mi i let aw?’ tiah i ti."},"5":{"text":"Culai ahcun ka hna lawngin ka lo thei; Atu-ah cun ka mit rori in ka lo hmu zo."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah ningzak in ka fih aw ih, Leivut le vutcam lakah to in ka siir-aw a si."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa in hi hmuahhmuah Job hnenih a ṭong hnuah Elifas hnenah, “Nangmah le na rualpi pahnih parah ka thin a heng, ziangahtile ka siahhlawh Job cun ka thuhla hi dik zetin a sim naón nannih cun nan sim lo.","title":"Thunetnak"},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Job hnenah cawcang pasarih le tuucang pasarih in hei keng uhla nan hrangah thawinak va pe uh. Job in nan hrangah thla a cam ding ih a thlacamnak cu ka ngai ding ih nan aat tluk in mual ka lo photer lo ding. Amah vekin ka thuhla dik zetin nan sim lo a si,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih a fial vekin Elifas, Bildad le Zofar cun an tuah ih Bawipa in Job ih thlacamnak cu a thei."},"10":{"text":"Cule Job in a rualpi pathum hrangih thla a cam hnuah, Bawipa in amah cu a tungding sal ih a hlanih a neihmi hmuahhmuah ih lethnih tam in a pek."},"11":{"text":"A unau pawl a farnu pawl le a rualpi hlun pawl an ra leng ih a inn ah rawl ei puai an tuah. Pathian in a parah harsatnak a thlenter ruangah an zaangfahnak le an hnemnak thu an sim. Tangka le sui zunghruk pakhat fingfing an pek."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in Job cu a netsan ah a hlan hnakih tam sinsin in thlawsuah a pek. Job in tuu thawng hleili, kalauk thawng ruk, cawcang khuah thawng khat le laak thawng khat a nei."},"13":{"text":"Fapa pasarih le fanu pathum a nei."},"14":{"text":"A fanu upa bik cu Jemimah a ti ih a pahnihnak cu Keziah a ti ih a nauta bik cu Keren Happuk a ti."},"15":{"text":"Job fanu pawl vekih a mawimi leilung tlunah nunau zohman an um lo. An pa in a fapa pawl ro a zem vekin a fanu pawl khal a zem ve a si."},"16":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Job cu kum za le sawmli a nung ih a tu le a fa pawl sanli tiang a hmu hai a si."},"17":{"text":"Kum tamzet a nung ih tarkuun in a thi."}}}}},"19":{"info":{"name":"Saam Hlabu","shortname":"Saam","abbr":[],"desc":"Saam hlabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih ruahnak pekmi a saang lo ih, Mi sual lamzin a thlun lotu le Pathian a hmuhsuamtu pawl lakih a tel lotu cu mi thluasuak a si.","title":"Bu Khatnak (Saam 1—41) Lungawinak Taktak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih Daan thlun cu a lungawinak a si, Cuih Daan cu sunzan in a ruat."},"3":{"text":"Amah cu tiva kapih a khomi thingkung, A tikcu ih a rahmi le a hnah tla A vuai dah lomi bangtuk a si. A tuahmi kipah a hlawhtling."},"4":{"text":"Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu cubangtuk an si lo; Thli ih semhlo mi fanghi vek an si."},"5":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu Pathian in a hnong ding; Mi sual pawl cu mi ding lakah an tel lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in mi ding fehnak lamzin cu a kilveng ringring; Sikhalsehla mi ṭha lo cun siatralnak lamzin a zawh."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangah so hi miphun pawl in ral an thawh? Ziangah so hi minung pawl in a ṭhahnem lomi phiarsawmnak khua an khan?","title":"Pathian Ih Hrilmi Siangpahrang"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa le a hriakculhmi siangpahrang an dodal ih, An siangpahrang pawl ral an tho; An hotu pawl ṭangtlang in phiarnak an ngaihtuah ih,"},"3":{"text":"“In uknak ihsin luat uhsila, In ṭeemnak pawl cu hlon uhsi,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu vancung a siangpahrang tokham ihsin a hni, Anmah pawl cu a hnihsan a si."},"5":{"text":"A thinheng in a kawk hai ih, A thin ai-thok in mangbang vansaang in a tuah hai."},"6":{"text":"“Ka tlang thianghlim, Zion tlang parah, Ka siangpahrang cu ka toter zo,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang cun, “ Bawipa ih thuruahmi cu ka than ding, Bawipa in ka hnenah ‘Nangmah cu ka fapa na si; Tuihsun ihsin na pa ka si zo."},"8":{"text":"I dil awla miphun hmuahhmuah na ro ah ka lo pe ding; Leilung pumpi hi na ta a si ding."},"9":{"text":"Thirfung in na vuakkuai ṭheh hai ding ih, Tlak beel an sutkuai bangin na sukuai ṭheh ding,’ i ti,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang pawl, ngai hnik uh; Mi uktu pawl tla, rak thei uh,"},"11":{"text":"Bawipa cu ṭihzahnak le phannak thawn in rian uhla,"},"12":{"text":"Khur phah in a hmaiah kuun uh. Culole a thin a heng ding ih nan hloral ding; Ziangahtile hmakhatte-ah a thin a heng thei a si. Amah a beentu cu mi thluasuak an si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka ral hi an va tam lawmmam so! Mi tamzet keimah dotu ah an cang.","title":"Zinglam Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka thuhla an rel ih, “Pathian in a bawm lo ding,” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Asinain maw Bawipa , nang cu ka himnak phaw na si ih, ṭihphannak ihsin i hum ringring. Nangmah in nehnak i pek ih, Ralṭhatnak tla i pek sal."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu napi in ka ko ih, A tlang thianghlim ihsin i run let."},"5":{"text":"Ka zau ih ka itthat; Cule himte in ka ṭhang sal, Ziangahtile Bawipa in i kilveng a si."},"6":{"text":"Ka kiangkap ih i kulhtu, A thawng le a za ka ral pawl tla, Ka ṭih hrimhrim lo."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , tho awla, Maw ka Pathian, i run aw. Ka ral pawl cu nangmah in na neh ih, Mi ṭha lo pawl cu na siatsuah ṭheh a si."},"8":{"text":"Runnak cu Bawipa na hnen ihsin a ra, Na minung pawl parah, Na thlawsuahnak um hram seh."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lo kawh tikah i let hram aw, Maw i ṭantu Pathian! Thinpit ih ka um tikah na ra ih, Ka thaw i ongter. I zaangfah awla ka thlacamnak hi ngai hram aw.","title":"Zanlam Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Maw milai pawl, ziangtik tiangso ka sunlawinak cu ningzahnak ah nan canter ding? Ziangtik tiangso thil ṭhahnem lo hi nan duh hrih ding ih, Thuphan hi nan thlun hrih ding?"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in mi ding pawl cu amah ih ta dingah i hril zo ih, Ka kawh tikah i thei a si, tihi thei ringring uh."},"4":{"text":"Ṭih uhla sual nawn hlah uh, Nan ihkhun ah daitein um uhla, ruat ciamciam uh."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah a dikmi thawinak pe uhla, Amah cu rinsan uh."},"6":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , thlawsuah in pe sinsin hram maw! Zaangfahnak thawn in run zoh hram aw!” tiih thlacamtu an tam ngaingai."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah ih i pekmi lungawinak cu, Rawl le sabit tampi neitu pawl ih Lungawinak hnakin a nasa sawn."},"8":{"text":"Ka ih vete in thlangamte in ka itthat; Maw Bawipa , nangmah lawng i himtertu na si."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka ṭongmi hi ngai hram awla, Ka hui ka aihramnak hi thei hram aw.","title":"Himnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka Siangpahrang le ka Pathian, Bomnak dil ih ka au-nak hi I ngaisak hram aw. Maw Bawipa , na hnenah thla ka cam,"},"3":{"text":"Zingtin ka thlacamnak cu na thei, Ni a suah tikah ka thuhla cu na hnenah ka thlenter; Cule na thulehnak hngak in ka um."},"4":{"text":"Sual tuahnak ah lungawitu Pathian na si lo; ṭhat lonak cu na hnenah na umter lo."},"5":{"text":"Mi tluangkhawng pawl cu na hmu thei lo; Mi ṭha lo hmuahhmuah na hua a si."},"6":{"text":"Thuphan pertu hmuahhmuah na siatsuah ih, Thisen suah hiartu le mibum hmang pawl cu na fih hai."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a hmunmi na duhdawtnak a natsat ruangah, Kei cu na inn sungah ka lut ding; Na Biakinn thianghlim sungah ka lo bia ding ih, ṭihzahnak thawn na hmai ah ka kun ding."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka ral an tam ngaingai, Na duhmi tuah dingah i hruai aw. Ka thlun theinak dingah na lamzin tluangter aw."},"9":{"text":"Ka ral pawl ih ṭongkam cu rintlak a um hrimhrim lo; Mi siatsuah lawng an duh. An kaa cu thlaanka ong-aw vek a si, An lei cu a naalzet ih mibum a thiam ngaingai."},"10":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , annih pawl cu hnong awla hrem hai aw. An khawkhannak ṭha lo cu an tluknak ah canter aw. An sualnak a tam ruangah le Nangmah an lo dodal ruangah Na umnak ihsin hlon suak hai aw."},"11":{"text":"Na hnenih himnak a tongtu cu an lung a awi ding, Lungawi in hla an sak ringring ding. A lo duhdawtu cu na hum hai a si. Nangmah ih ruangah annih cu mi lungawi taktak an si."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , mi ding pawl cu na thlawsuah hai ih, Na zaangfahnak thawn phaw bangin na hum a si."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , thinheng in i kawk hram hlah aw, Na thin ai-thok in i hrem hram hlah aw.","title":"Vansan Caan Ih Zaangfah Dilnak"},"2":{"text":"I zaangfah hram aw, Ziangahtile ka baang ih ka vuai thluh; Ka tha tlungter saal hram aw, Ziangahtile ka baang tuk ih ka soprop thluh."},"3":{"text":"Ka nunnak tiangin vansaang a lam, Maw Bawipa , ziangtik tiangso hiti ih ka um ding?"},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ra awla i run aw, I zaangfahnak thawng in thihnak ihsin i runsuak hram aw."},"5":{"text":"Thih hnuah cun zoso a lo thei thei ding, Sheol ah zoso a lo thangṭhat ding?"},"6":{"text":"Ka hui ka aihramnak in ka vuai thluh zo; Zantin ka ṭah ruangah ka ihkhun a ciar ih, Ka lukham cu ka mitthli in a ciap ringring."},"7":{"text":"Ka ṭahnak ah ka mit an thling ṭheh ih; Zianghman ka hmu thei lo. Ka ral pawl ruangah hiti in ka cang."},"8":{"text":"Nannih thilsual tuahtu pawl, tlan ṭheh uh; Bawipa in ka ṭahnak a thei a si."},"9":{"text":"Bomnak dil ih ka au-nak cu a ngai ih Ka thlacamnak a thei."},"10":{"text":"Ka ral pawl cu an sun ruangah ningzak in an um ding, Mangbang le vansaang in an tlan thluh ding a si."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka Pathian, nangmah cu ka beunak na si. I duumtu pawl hnenih sin i run awla i hum aw.","title":"Dingnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Cuti lo cun zohman ih in run thei nawn lonak hmun ah, Kiosa bangin in thiarhlo ding ih Cutawkah in botthleek thluh ding a si."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, Mi pakhatkhat parah thil ka ti sual ih,"},"4":{"text":"Ka lamṭang pawl ka phiarsawm ih, A um meenmi ka ral ka tuahmawh a si ahcun,"},"5":{"text":"Ka ral in i dawi in i kai seh; I saat aw sehla i that seh, Ka ruak cu mualpho in leidip lakah taan seh."},"6":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thinheng in tho aw; Ka ral pawl ih thin ai-thawhnak do dingah ding aw. ṭhang awla i bawm aw, Ziangahtile dingthluk lairelnak thawn thu ṭhen cu na duhmi a si."},"7":{"text":"Na kiangkap ah mi hmuahhmuah kokhawm awla, Tlunlam ihsin run uk hai aw."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Nang cu mi hmuahhmuah ih thuṭhentu na si; Curuangah ka felnak le ka ṭhatnak bangin ka thu ṭhen aw."},"9":{"text":"Nang cu a dingmi Pathian na si, Kan ruahnak le kan duhnak tla thu na ṭhen. Mi ṭha lo pawl ih ṭhat lonak cemter awla, Mi ṭha pawl laksawng pe aw."},"10":{"text":"Pathian cu ka ralphaw a si ih i humtu a si. Amah ih duhnak a thlun tu pawl a humtu a si."},"11":{"text":"Pathian cu a dingmi thuṭhentu a si; Mi ṭha lo pawl cu a hnong ringring a si."},"12":{"text":"Milai pawl an siir awk lo a si ahcun, Pathian in a ralnam a taat ding; A li a nawp ih sai dingah a tiar zo."},"13":{"text":"A mi thahnak hriamnam pawl a lak ih, A vaam hluahhlomi a conkiang pawl a bih."},"14":{"text":"Zohhnik uh, mi ṭha lo pawl ih thupol mi cu ṭhat lonak lawng a si, Siatsuahnak lawng an ngaihtuah ih Mi bum hlir in khua an sa."},"15":{"text":"Leilung ah khur thuk zet an lai, Cule an laihmi khur sungah anmah riangri an tla."},"16":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak an tuahmi cu an hnenah a thlengkir ih, Mi thisen an suahmi cu an lu parah a thleng sal."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa cu a dingmi a si ruangah lungawi thu ka sim ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa ih hnenah Thangṭhatnak hla ka sak ding."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , kan Bawipa, Leilung pumpi ih na hmin a than zia hi! Nangmah an lo thangṭhatnak van a thleng a si;","title":"Pathian Sunlawinak Le Milai Sunlawinak"},"2":{"text":"Nauhak le naute pawl tla in hla in an sak. Na ral pawl le a lo dodaltu pawl kham dingah, Ralhruang cu nangmah in na tiang hnget zo."},"3":{"text":"Na kut ih tuahmi van ka zoh ih, An umnak ciarih na retmi thlapi le arsi ka hmuh tikah,"},"4":{"text":"Milai hi ziangso a si ih na seherh ringring? Mihring taak ko hi ziangso a si ih a zawn na ruah?"},"5":{"text":"Asi, minung cu nangmah hnakih niam deuh fangin na tuah ih, Sunlawinak le upatnak cu lukhuh bangin na khumter."},"6":{"text":"Na seemsuahmi hmuahhmuah tlunah uktu na siter ih, Ziang tinkim a ke tangah na ret."},"7":{"text":"Tuu le caw, hramlak ih ramsa pawl,"},"8":{"text":"Vate le tisung um nga le ti sungih a nungmi hmuahhmuah tlunah na ret zo a si."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , kan Bawipa, Leilung pumpi ih na hmin a than zia hi! A va mak so!"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka thinlung zatein nangmah cu ka lo cawimawi ding, Mangbangza na tuahmi ka sim ding.","title":"A Dingnak Ruangah Pathian Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah ih ruangah lungawi zetin hla ka sak ding, Maw Cungnungbik, na hnenah thang ṭhatnak hla ka sak ding."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah na lang tikah ka ral pawl cu an kir sal, An ril ih an thi."},"4":{"text":"A dingmi thuṭhentu na si ih na tokham parah na to; Keimah ṭan in thu na ṭhen a si."},"5":{"text":"Pathian thei lo miphun pawl na hnong ih, Mi ṭha lo pawl cu na siatsuah hai a si. Annih cu kumkhua in an hloralta ding."},"6":{"text":"In dotu kan ral pawl an cem thlata ih theih an si nawn lo, An khawpi pawl cu na ṭhio ṭheh ih, Theih sal ding an si nawn lo."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa cu kumkhua in siangpahrang a si. Thuṭhen dingah a siangpahrang tokham parah a to."},"8":{"text":"Leilung pumpi cu dingnak thawn a uk ih, ṭan bulmi nei loin mi hmuahhmuah ih thu a ṭhen."},"9":{"text":"Neh-nen hremnak a tuartu hrangah Bawipa cu relhnak ralhruang a si. Harsatnak caanah himnak ralhruang a si."},"10":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na hmin a lo theitu cun an lo rinsan ding, Ziangahtile na hnenih a rami cu Na dungtun dah lo."},"11":{"text":"Zion ihsin uktu Bawipa ih hnenah thangṭhatnak hla sak uh. A thil tuahmi cu mi hmuahhmuah hnenah sim uh."},"12":{"text":"Mi zonzai pawl ih tuarnak cu Pathian in a thei, An ai-hramnak cu a hngilh dah lo; Curuangah thisen a luantertu pawl parah phu a lak."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa , i zaangfah hram aw. I huatu pawl ih in tisiatnak hi hmu hram aw. Maw Bawipa , thihnak ihsin i runsuak hram awla."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem khawsungmi pawl hmaiah ding tahratin, Nangmah ka lo cawimawinak thuhla pawl hi ka sim ding. I runsuak ruangah lungawi thu ka sim ding."},"15":{"text":"Pathian thei lo miphun pawl cu anmah ih laihmi khurah an tla; Thang an kam ih anmah an awk aw."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa cu a dingmi a thuṭhennak in a lang awter; Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu anmah ih tuahmi lala ah an awk-aw a si."},"17":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl le Pathian a dungtuntu miphun pawl ih lamzin netnak cu thihnak Sheol a si."},"18":{"text":"Asinain mi farah pawl thlauthlak ringring an si lo ding ih, Mi rethei pawl ih beiseinak cu kumkhua in namthlak a si lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Maw Bawipa tho thlang aw; Minung in nangmah dodal in tluangkhawng nawn hlah hai seh. Miphun hmuahhmuah cu na hmai ah kokhawm awla, an thu cu ṭhen aw."},"20":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , an thin phangter aw; Mihring meen an si kha theiter hai aw."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ziangah so hlapi ih na um ringring? Ziangah so kan harsat caan ah in relhsan ṭheu?","title":"Dingnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl an puarthau ih Mi farah pawl an neh-nen, an hrem. Anmah ih kam ciami thang ah awk-aw hram hai seh."},"3":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo in a ruahnak ṭha lo kha a uanpi zet ih, Mi duhham in Bawipa cu a cam ih a hnong."},"4":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo in Bawipa cu zianghman ah a siar lo, “Pathian cun i hmu zik lo,” tiah puarthau in a ti. A ruahnak hmuahhmuah ah, “Pathian a um lo,” tihi a si."},"5":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo cu a thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah ah a hlawhtling; Pathian ih thuṭhennak cu a theih banmi a si lo. A ral pawl tla a hnihsan meen."},"6":{"text":"A thinlung te cun, “Ka tlasam dah lo ding; Ziangtik hmanah vansaannak ka tong lo ding,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"A kaa cu camnak, thuphan pernak le midang hronak lawngin a khat; Midang huat zawng le ṭongsia ṭong dingah a lei cu a zamrang zet."},"8":{"text":"Khawkip ah a relhthup aw; Cutawk mi a bawhnak ihsin misual lo tla a that. Bawmtu nei lo mi vanduai pawl kha a thupte in a thlingthla ziar a si."},"9":{"text":"Kiosa bangin a thuh awknak hmun ihsin mi a bawh; A thah dingmi pawl a bawh a si. A thang in a awk ih a thiarhlo."},"10":{"text":"Zianghman tithei lo pawl thah an tuar; Thacak pawl in an bawh, an peel, an hrual neknek hai a si."},"11":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo cun, “Pathian in minung cu zianghman ah a siar lo. A mit a siing zo ih i hmu dah lo ding,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , tho awla mi ṭha lo pawl hi nor hai aw; Maw Pathian, harsatnak a tuartu pawl tla hngilh hlah aw."},"13":{"text":"Ziangtin so mi ṭha lo in Pathian a hmuhsuam ih, “Pathian cun i hrem lo ding,” a ti thei?"},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nang cun na hmu a si; An tuarnak le an riahsiatnak cu na hmu ih, Anmah bawm dingah na khul a fung dah lo. Zianghman tithei lotu in na hnen ah a nunnak a pek; Ngakṭah pawl bawmtu cu nangmah na si ṭheu."},"15":{"text":"Misual le mi ṭha lo pawl ih cahnak thazaang khiak thluh aw; An sualnak ruangah hrem hai awla, ṭhat lonak a reh tiangin hawl suak hai aw."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa cu kumkhua in siangpahrang a si. Curuangah Pathian thei lo pawl cu A ram sungih sin an hloral ding."},"17":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , thinlung nemmi ih saduhthah cu na thei; Cule an thinlung na cakter ih an thlacamnak na thei."},"18":{"text":"Milai in ṭihphannak an suahter nawn lonak dingah, Ngakṭah farah pawl le neh-nenmi pawl ih aunak cu theihsak awla, anmah ṭan in thu ṭhen hram aw."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka beunak a si. Ziangtin so nannih in, “Vate bangin tlangpar ah zam aw,","title":"Rinsannak"},"2":{"text":"Ziangahtile mi ṭha lo pawl in an li an nawp ih, Khawthim sung ihsin mi ṭha pawl sai dingah an conkiang an bih."},"3":{"text":"Leilungpi hramṭohnak a siat thluh tikah, Mi ṭha in ziangso tuah theimi a neih ding?” tiah in ti thei?"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu a biakinn thiang sungah a um ih, A siangpahrang tokham cu vancung ah a um. Mi hmuahhmuah amah in a hmu ih An tuahmi hmuahhmuah khal a thei ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Mi ṭha le mi ṭha lo an pahnih a hniksak hai ih, Daan nei lo minekrawk hmang pawl cu a thinlung zatein a hua."},"6":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo parah meiling vaam a tlakter ding ih, Kaat mei-alh le meihliopi in a hrem hai ding."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu miding a si ih a dingmi hnaṭuan a duh; Amah ih duhnak a thluntu pawl cu a hmai an hmu ding."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i bawm hram aw. Mi ṭha zohman an um nawn lo. Mifel pawl hmuh an theih nawn lo.","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in thuphan an sim-aw ton ih, Porh awknak thawn an bum-aw ton rero a si."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , a porh-aw reromi lei pawl cu hlep awla, Tluang a khawng reromi kaa pawl cu phit aw."},"4":{"text":"Annih in, “Kan ṭongkam in mi kan neh ding, Ka kaa hi kanmah ih ta a sisi; Zoso kan tlunah lal a ṭuan thei ding?” an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in, “Mi farah zonzai pawl an namthlak ih, An hremmi pawl harnak tuar in an hui an aihram ruangah, Atu cu ka ra ding. An hiarhal zetmi humhimnak cu ka pe ding,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih thukamnak cu rintlak a si. A thiangmi a si ih somei ih voi sarih tiang sermi ngun eerlet bangtuk a si."},"7":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl khuazakip ah an vakdarh ih, Zozo khal in ṭhat lonaktu sawn hi an uar a si. Maw Bawipa , nangmah in in kilveng awla, Cubangtuk minung hnen ihsin in hum hram aw.","merge":"8"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ziangtik tiangso i hngilh ding? Kumkhua in maw i hngilh ta ding? Ziangtik tiangso na mithmai na thuh hrih ding?","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Ziangtik tiangso hiti in ka tuar hrih ding? Ziangtik tiangso a sun a zan in ka thinlung a nat ding? Ziangtik tiangso ka ral pawl hi ka parah thu an neih ding?"},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, i zoh awla i sawn hram aw; Ka thih lonak dingah ka tha tlungter sal hram aw."},"4":{"text":"Ka ral pawl in, “Amah cu kan neh zo a si,” tiah an ti pang ding; Ka sun ruangah an lungawi hlah hai seh."},"5":{"text":"Asinain kei cun a thleng-aw dah lomi na duhdawtnak ka ring, I luatter ruangah ka lung a awi zet ding."},"6":{"text":"Ka parih a ṭhat ruangah Bawipa cu hla in ka thangṭhat ding."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi aa cun a thinlung in, “Pathian a um lo,” a ti. Milai cu an siat ṭheh a si; Ningsinza thil tampi an tuah. Thil ṭha a tuahtu pakhat hman an um lo.","title":"Milai Ih ṭhatlonak (Saam 53)"},"2":{"text":"Minung lakah fimnak a neitu le Pathian a hawl ih a biatu an um maw? ti theih duh ah, Bawipa in minung pawl cu, Vancung ihsin a run zoh."},"3":{"text":"Asinain an zatein an pial ṭheh; An thinlung sung tiangin a thu ṭheh a si. Zohman thilṭha tuahtu an um lo, Pakhatte hman an um lo."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Hi mi ṭha lo pawl hi theihthiamnak zianghman a nei lomi maw an si? saang an ei vekin ka minung pawl an ei baar ṭheh a si. Ka hnenah thla an cam fawn lo,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Asinain annih cu ṭih phang in an um ding; Ziangahtile a dingfelmi hnen lawngah Pathian cu a um."},"6":{"text":"Mi lungnem ih khawkhannak cu nan siatsuah, Sikhalsehla annih ih beunak cu Bawipa a si."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi runnak cu Zion ihsin ra suak sehla ka va duh so! Bawipa in a minung pawl mal a sawm sal tikah, Jakob ih tesinfa pawl cu an lung a awi ding ih Israel mi pawl cu an ai a puang ding."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na biakinn ah zoso a lut ding? Na tlang thianghlim Zion ah zoso a kai ding?","title":"Zoso Pathian Ih Inn Ah A Lut Ding"},"2":{"text":"Ziang tinkim ah soisel um loih a nungtu le a dingfel ringringtu, Thungai le thudik a ruat a reltu;"},"3":{"text":"Midang a relsia lotu, A rualpi pawl hnenah thil ṭha lo a tuah lo ih, A innhnen pawl tla a relsia lotu;"},"4":{"text":"Misual pawl zianghman ah a siar lo ih, Bawipa , a ṭihzahtu pawl upatnak a petu, Ziangtluk a hrangah a nat khalle A thutiam cia vekih a thlun suak ringringtu;"},"5":{"text":"Tangka ṭhang thawn midang a coih lotu le Mawh nei lo mawhphurter dingah nawhthuh a la lotu pawl an si ding. Hi bangtuk a tuahtu pawl cu an tlu dah lo ding."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, kei i hum hram aw; Ziangahtile nang cu ka beunak na si ih ka lo rinsan.","title":"Rinsannak Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah, “Nangmah cu ka Bawipa na si ih, Nangmah locun ṭhatnak zianghman ka nei lo,” ka ti."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa ih mi thiang pawl cu ziangtluk in so an mawi! Anmah thawn um cu ka lungawinak bik a si."},"4":{"text":"Khawzing dangdang hnenih a tlan rerotu pawl cu Anmahte vansaannak an pe aw a si. An raithawinak ah ka tel lo ding; An khawzing pawl ih hmin tla ka hmur in ka sal lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah cu ka ro le ka covo na si; Ka hai mi hmuahhmuah nangmah in i pek. Ka nunnak cu na kut sungah a um."},"6":{"text":"Ramri i tuahsakmi cu ziangtluk in so an mawi! Ka hrangah ro sunglawi an si."},"7":{"text":"Rem i ruahsaktu Bawipa cu ka thangṭhat; Zan khalah ka thinlung in ralrinnak i pek."},"8":{"text":"Ka hnenih Bawipa a um cu ka thei ringring; Ka vorhlam ih a um ruangah, Zianghman in i hnin thei lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah lungawinak le thinnomnak in ka khat; Ka hna a ngam ringring a si."},"10":{"text":"Ziangahtile mithi khua ahcun i fehter siang lo ding ih, Nangmah a lo rinsantu cu khur sungah cun na tanta lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Nangmah in nunnak lamzin cu i hmuh ding; Na umnak ah lungawinak a kim ih, Na ban thacak ah nomnak kumkhua in a um."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , dingfelnak hrangih Ka thlacamnak hi ngai hram aw. Bomnak dil ih ka aunak cu ruat hram aw. Ka thlacamnak cu thei hram aw; Bum hmang lo ka hmurka ih thla ka camnak hi!","title":"Hremtu Kut Ihsin Luatnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Thudik na theih ruangah Keimah ṭan in thu na ṭhen ko ding."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah in ka thinlung na thei; Zan ah i rung veh ih, I hlathlai thluh hmanah, ka sungah ṭhat lonak zianghman na hmu lo. Ka hmurka in ṭongsia ka ṭong lo."},"4":{"text":"Midang ih tuah vek cun ka tuah lo, Na thukham ka thlun ih Mi nunsia pawl ih lamzin ka thlun lo."},"5":{"text":"Na lamzin ah ka feh ringring ih Ziangtik hmanah ka bah dah lo."},"6":{"text":"Maw Pathian, thla ka cam tikah Nang cun i run let ringring. Atu khalah na hna i tun awla Ka thu hi i theihsak aw."},"7":{"text":"Maw in Runtu, na duhdawtnak mangbangza cu run langter hram aw. Na kiangih a um hmuahhmuah cu ral pawl ih kut in an him a si."},"8":{"text":"Na mitmu na kilven vekin i kilveng hram aw; Na thladem thuaiah i thup hram aw;"},"9":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl in in do ih, Mithah hiar ka ral pawl in in kulh ṭheh a si."},"10":{"text":"Zaangfahnak zianghman nei loin, Puarthau zetin an ṭong."},"11":{"text":"Ka fehnak kip in zawt ih in kulh ṭheh, Dirthlu dingah caan ṭha lawng an bawh."},"12":{"text":"Kiosa vek an si ih bauhthlek thluh lawng in tum. Kiosa no vekin an kua ihsin in bawh a si."},"13":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , tho awla ka ral pawl cu do in neh hai aw. Ka nunnak hi mi ṭha lo pawl kut ihsin na ralnam thawn i hum aw."},"14":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na ban thacak in i hum hram aw, Leitlun covo lawng a neimi pawl kut sung ihsin. An hrangih na khawl ciami hremnak in hrem hai aw, An faale hrangah hremnak um sehla, An tesinfa pawl hrang tla ah taang hrih seh."},"15":{"text":"Asinain kei cun dingnak thawn na hmai ka hmu ding; Ka ṭhangharh tikah na mithmai ka hmu ding ih, Ka lungawinak a kim ding."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ziangtluk in so ka lo duh! Nang cu ka cahnak na si.","title":"David Ih Sakmi Nehnak Hla (2 Sam 22.1-51)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka lungpi, ka ralhruang le i runtu a si. Ka Pathian cu ka beunak lungpi, ka ralphaw le ka rundam cahnak a si; Amah sungah cun ka him."},"3":{"text":"Thangṭhat tlak Bawipa cu ka ko ih, Ka ral pawl kut sung ihsin i luatter."},"4":{"text":"Thihnak hrihrual in i ngerh ih Siatnak tilian in i khuh."},"5":{"text":"Sheol hridai in i awk ih Thlaan in thang i kam."},"6":{"text":"Harsat ka ton laiah Bawipa cu ka ko; I bawm dingah ka Pathian cu ka ko a si. A biakinn ihsin ka aw a thei; Ka aunak aw a hna sungah a lut."},"7":{"text":"Pathian a thin a heng ruangah Leilung cu a hnin ih a thir, Tlang pawl ih hram ṭoh-nak tla cu An khur ih an ṭhia thlohthlo."},"8":{"text":"A hnarkua in meikhu a suak ih, A kaa ihsin meihlio le meivam a suak zukzo."},"9":{"text":"Van a caihkuur ih a rung ṭum, Khawdur sahzet a ke hnuai ah a um."},"10":{"text":"Cherub parah to in a rung zam; Thli ih thla parah to in zamrang tein a ra."},"11":{"text":"Khawthim in a tuam aw; Tidai in a khatmi mero sahzet a kimvel ah a um."},"12":{"text":"A hmaiih nimthlakau tle sungin Rial le meivam an rung tla ih Khawdur sahzet cu a run pah suak."},"13":{"text":"Cule Bawipa cu van ihsin khawri bangin a ri durdo; Cungnungbik in a aw a suah."},"14":{"text":"A conkiang a sai ih a ral pawl a ṭhio ṭheh; A nimthla a kauter ih a tlanter ṭheh hai a si."},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thinheng in na ral pawl na kawk ih na huuk ciamco tikah cun, Tipi thuanthum ih tawne a lang ih Leilung ih hramṭohnak tla an lang ṭheh a si."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in tlun ih van ihsin i run dawh ih i run kai; Tithukpi sung ihsin i dirh suak."},"17":{"text":"A cakzetmi ka ral pawl ih kut sungin i suah; I huatu le ka hrangih a cak tukmi kut sungin."},"18":{"text":"Ka vanduai ni ah annih in in do; Asinain Bawipa in i hum."},"19":{"text":"Ṭihphannak ihsin himnak hmun kaupi ah i suah; Ka parih a lung a awi ruangah i run."},"20":{"text":"A dikmi ka tuah ruangah Bawipa in laksawng i pek; Ka kut a thianhlim vekin i lehrul a si."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa ih lamzin cu ka zawh; Ka Pathian hnen ihsin hlothlau zetin ka tlansuak dah lo."},"22":{"text":"A daan hmuahhmuah ka hmai ah an um ringring ih, A thupekmi pakhatte hman ka hnong dah lo."},"23":{"text":"A hmaiah mawh nei lo ka si ih Sual phuhrunawknak ihsin hlimphirte in ka um zo."},"24":{"text":"Dingfelte ih ka um ruangah laksawng i pek; A mithmuh ih ka kut a thianhlim vekin i lehrul a si."},"25":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , rintlakmi hnenah rintlak in na lang ih, Mawh neilo mi hnenah mawh nei lo in na lang."},"26":{"text":"Mi thianghlim hnenah thianghlim in na lang, Sikhalsehla mi khermei hrangah cun na khermei ve a si."},"27":{"text":"Mi tangdor pawl cu na run suak ṭheu, Asinain mi hngal pawl cu na nam thlak a si."},"28":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah in ka mei-inn na vang ih, Ka Pathian, nangmah in ka thimnak tla na tleuter."},"29":{"text":"Ka ral pawl do theinak ah le An ṭannak hruang pawl lan thei nakah thazaang ṭha i pek."},"30":{"text":"Hi Pathian ih lamzin cu a famkim a si; Bawipa ih thutiamnak cu rintlak a si! A hnenih beunak a hawltu hrangah Amah cu ralphaw a si."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa siar lo Pathian dang zoso a um? Kan Pathian hlei ah lungpi dang a um mawsi?"},"32":{"text":"Amah cu i caktertu Pathian a si ih, Ka lamzin khalah himnak a umter."},"33":{"text":"Zukneng bangin ka ke zuan a zaangter ih, A saannak hmun ah himte in i umter."},"34":{"text":"Dar ih tuahmi li hman nawp thei dingah, Amah in ral do i zirh a si."},"35":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah in na rundamnak phaw i pek; Na vorhlam kut in i kaifek ih, Na nunneemnak in i tumlianter."},"36":{"text":"Ka fehnak lamzin na kauter ih, Ka rilbah dah lo."},"37":{"text":"Ka ral pawl ka dawi ih ka man hai a si; Ka siatsuah ṭheh hlan lo ka kir lo."},"38":{"text":"Ka saat hai ih an tho thei nawn lo; Ka kehram ah an ril."},"39":{"text":"Nangmah in hi raldonak ah thazaang i pek ih, Ka ral pawl cu ka hnuai ah an tlu ṭheh."},"40":{"text":"Ka hnen ihsin ka ral pawl cu na tlanter ih, I huatu hmuahhmuah ka siatsuah ṭheh a si."},"41":{"text":"Bomnak dil in an au, Asinain zohman in an run hai lo. Bawipa ih hnenah an au, Asinain a sawn hai lo."},"42":{"text":"Ka deengcip vivo hai ih, Thli ih semmi leivut vekah an cang. Ka palcih vivo hai ih, Lamzin ih ciarbek vekah an cang."},"43":{"text":"Dodal hmang miphun sung in i run ih, Miphun tampi uktu ah i tuah. Ka theih dah lomi pawl cu i riantu ah an cang."},"44":{"text":"Ka thuhla an theih cun ka thu an thlun; Ramdang mi tla ka hmaiah kun in an ra."},"45":{"text":"Annih tla cu an thin a phang ih An ralhruang sung ihsin ṭhia thlohthlo in an ra suak."},"46":{"text":"Bawipa cu a nung a si! Ka ṭannak lungpi cu thangṭhat si ko seh. Ka rundamnak Pathian cu hlorh in um seh."},"47":{"text":"Phuba i laksaktu amah a si ih, Mi hmuahhmuah ka ke thuaiah a ret."},"48":{"text":"I raltu pawl ih kut ihsin i runsuak. Maw Bawipa , ka ral pawl ih tlunah i khaisaang; Mi suaksual pawl lakin i runsuak."},"49":{"text":"Curuangah maw Bawipa , miphun tampi lakah ka lo lawm ding; Na hmin thangṭhatnak hla in ka sak ding."},"50":{"text":"Pathian in a siangpahrang hnenah nehnak tumpi a pek; Hriak a culh zomi David le a tesinfa hnenah kumkhua in A hmunmi a duhdawtnak cu A langter ringring a si."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Van pawl khin Pathian sunlawinak an sim ih, Tlolak kaupi cun a kutsuak an langter.","title":"Sersiammi Parah Pathian Sunlawinak"},"2":{"text":"Sun in sun hnenah thu a sim ih, Zan in zan hnenah theihnak a thlenter."},"3":{"text":"Ṭong an hmang lo, aw khal an suah lo; Thawmvang zianghman theih a si lo."},"4":{"text":"Asinain an aw cu leilung khua zakip ah a thang; An thuthanmi cu vanhram deng a thleng. Van ahl khin Pathian in ni hrangah puanthlam a zar sak;"},"5":{"text":"Ni cu a inn ihsin mo neitu tlangval pa bangin a rung suak, Tlan zuamnak ih a teltu tlangval ṭha bangin."},"6":{"text":"Khatlam vanhram dengin a thok ih, Khatlam deng tiang a heel ih a tlan. A satnak ihsin zohman a relh theitu an um lo."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih daan cu a famkim, Nunnak thartertu a si. Bawipa ih thupek mi pawl cu rintlak an si, A fim lomi fimnak petu a si.","title":"Ih Daan"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa ih daan pawl cu a dikzet, A thluntu hrangah lungawinak a si. A thukham pawl cu a dikzet, Thinlung mit vaangtertu a si."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihzah cu a thiangfai, Kumkhua in a hmun ringring. Bawipa ih thu ṭhennak cu a dik, Ziangtik khalah a dik a si."},"10":{"text":"Sui hnakin duh a um sawn, Sui ṭha bik hnak khal in. Khuaitizu hnakin a thlum sawn, Khuaithlar ihsin a formi khuaitizu hnak khal in."},"11":{"text":"Na siahhlawh i fimtertu a si, Na daan thlun cu hlawknak tumpi a si."},"12":{"text":"Mah ih palhnak a thei theitu zoso a um? Thupte mawhnak in i thiangter aw."},"13":{"text":"Tumhrim sualnak khal in i hum awla, I uktu ah cang hram hlah hai seh. Cuticun mi famkim ka si ding ih Tuksumza sualnak in ka luat ding."},"14":{"text":"Ka hmur in a suakmi ṭongkam le Ka thinlung ih khawruahnak tla hi, Maw Bawipa , na hmaiah cotlak si hram seh; Ka beunak lungpi le i runtu."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangbang vansaangih na um ni ah Na aunak aw cu Bawipa in lo thei hram seh. Jakob ih Pathian in lo hum hram seh.","title":"Nehnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"A biakinn ihsin bomnak lo pe sehla, Zion Tlang ihsin ṭanpinak lo pe hram seh."},"3":{"text":"Na thawinak pekmi hmuahhmuah lo saang sehla, Mei-ur thawinak na pekmi parah a lungawi hram seh."},"4":{"text":"Na lungthlitum hmuahhmuah lo pe sehla, Na tumtahmi ah lo hlawhtlingter hram seh."},"5":{"text":"Cutiih na neh ruangah lungawi in kan au ding ih, Kan Pathian hmin in kan thantaar saangah kan khai ding. Bawipa in na dilmi hmuahhmuah cu lo pe hram seh."},"6":{"text":"Hriak a culhmi siangpahrang cu, Bawipa in a bawm ti ka thei. A vancung thianghlim ihsin a aunak a run thei ih, A vorhlam kut in mi nehtu a siter."},"7":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat in an raldonak rangleng an ring, A hrek in an rang an ring; Asinain kannih cun Bawipa kan Pathian ih cahnak kan rinsan."},"8":{"text":"Annih cu an bah ding ih an rilta ding, Asinain kannih cu kan thosal ding ih kan ding hnget ding."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , siangpahrang cu nehnak pe hram aw; Kan lo kawh tikah in sawn hram aw."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , siangpahrang cu na cahnak ah a lung a awi. Nehtu na siter ruangah lungawinak in a khat.","title":"Nehnak Hrangih Lungawinak"},"2":{"text":"A lungthlitum na pek zo; A lo dilmi hmuahhmuah na el lo."},"3":{"text":"A hnenah malsawmnak a phunphun thawn na ra ih, A lu parah sui lukhuh na khumter."},"4":{"text":"Nunnak a lo dil ih na pe zo, Kumkhua tlaitluan ih damnak cu!"},"5":{"text":"Na bawm ruangah a sunlawinak a tum, Lennak le hminthannak na pe."},"6":{"text":"Na thluasuah cu a parah kumkhua in a hmun, Na umpi ruangah lungawinak in a khat."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang in Cungnungbik Bawipa a rinsan; A thleng-aw dah lomi Bawipa ih duhdawtnak ruangah, Anih cu hnial thei loin siangpahrang a si ding."},"8":{"text":"Na ral hmuahhmuah na kut cak in na kai ding; A lo huatu hmuahhmuah tla na kai ṭheh ding."},"9":{"text":"Na lang tikah annih pawl cu Somei vaam bangin na ur thluh hai ding. Bawipa in a thinhengin a dolh thluh hai ding ih, Meisa in a kangral ṭheh ding."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang in an faale pawl an ci a hmit ding ih, An tesinfa pawl tla a ṭhiam thluh hai ding."},"11":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo an ngaihtuah ih an phiar khalle, An hlawhtling lo ding."},"12":{"text":"A conkiang in a sai hai ding ih An pet an zuang ciamco ding."},"13":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na cahnak hi hlorh in um-aw sehla, Na thilti theinak cu hla in kan cawimawi ding."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pathian, ka Pathian, Ziangah so i tlansan? Bomnak dil in ka au rero laiah, Ziangah so hlapi ih i um san?","title":"Vansan Aunak Le Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Maw ka Pathian, sun ah ka lo ko, Asinain i awi lo. Zan khal ah ka au rero naón Colhdamnak ka ngah cuang lo."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nang cu siangpahrang tokham parah, Thianghlim bik in na to; Israel mi in hla ih thangṭhatmi na si."},"4":{"text":"Kan pupa pawl in nangmah an lo rinsan; An lo rinsan ih na run hai a si."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah an lo ko ih ṭihphannak in an luat; An lo rinsan ih an mualpho lo."},"6":{"text":"Asinain kei cu milai ka si nawn lo, cangcel ka si ko; Mi hmuahhmuah ih hmuhsuammi le nautatmi ka si."},"7":{"text":"I hmutu hmuahhmuah in hnihsuahsainak ah in hmang; An lei in khaak ih an mit in phen."},"8":{"text":"“ Bawipa na rinsan a sisi; Ziangah so a lo run lo? Bawipa in a lo duh asile, Ziangah so a lo bom lo?” in ti."},"9":{"text":"Ka nu ih pum sung ihsin damte in i suah tertu cu nangmah na si; Ka nu ih hnawi ka fawh lai khalah Himteih i kilkhawitu cu nangmah na si."},"10":{"text":"Ka suah vete in nangmah ka lo rinsan; Ka suah ihsin nangmah cu ka Pathian na si."},"11":{"text":"Ka hnen ihsin feh hram hlah aw; Harsatnak ka kiang a thleng, Zohman bawmtu ka nei lo."},"12":{"text":"Ral tampi in cawcang bangin in kulh; Ka kiangkap ah an um ṭheh. Bashan ramih cawcang hee vek an si."},"13":{"text":"Kiosa vekin an kaa an ang; An huuk ih bauhthlek thluh in tum."},"14":{"text":"Ka tha a cem, Leiro parih tidai thletmi vekin, Ka tha a poih ṭheh a si. Ka ruh pawl an pelh thluh zo; Ka thinlung cu meisa kiangih khuailul vekin, Ka sungah a zup thluh a si."},"15":{"text":"Ka dang cu peibung vekin a caar ih, Ka lei cu ka saangkhar ah a erh aw a si. Nang in a thi zo ah i ruat ih leivut lakah i taanta."},"16":{"text":"Uico pawl cu ka kiangah an um. Mi ṭha lo pawl in in kulh ṭheh; Ka kut le ka ke pawl an suntlang ṭheh a si."},"17":{"text":"Ka ruh pawl an lang thluh, Ka ral pawl cun in zoh ih in diriam ngaingai."},"18":{"text":"Ka hnipuan pawl an ṭhen aw ih, Ka korfual ngah dingah camcawh fung an zuuk."},"19":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka hnen ihsin tlan hram hlah aw! I Runtu, zamrang in ra awla i ra bawm aw!"},"20":{"text":"Ralnam ihsin i run awla; Ka nunnak cu hi uico pawl sungin in hum hram aw!"},"21":{"text":"Hi kiosa pawl kaa sungin i suah aw; A hee zetmi cawcang pawl ki ihsin i runsuak zo."},"22":{"text":"Na tuahmi hmuahhmuah hi ka miphun hnenah ka sim ding; An tonkhawmnak ah ka lo thangṭhat ding:"},"23":{"text":"“Amah cu thangṭhat uh, nannih Bawipa ih siahhlawh pawl; Amah cu upat uh, nannih Jakob ih tefa sin pawl; Amah cu bia uh, nannih Israel mi pawl;"},"24":{"text":"Mi farah a thlauthla lo ih Mi zonzai pawl tuarnak tla a umsan meen lo. Annih pawl a dungtun lo. Asinain bomnak dil ih an au tikah A awi hai a si,” tiah ka ti ding."},"25":{"text":"Na thil tuahmi ruangah hin An pumkhawmnak thupi ah ka lo thangṭhat ding. Thawinak pe dingih ka rak lo kam cia zo bangin, A lo ṭihzahtu pawl hmai ah ka pe ding."},"26":{"text":"Mi farah pawl in an duhzat in an ei ding; Bawipa hnenih a rami pawl in amah an thangṭhat ding. Lungawi aipuang in um ringring hram hai seh."},"27":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah in Bawipa cu an thei sal ding ih, Vanrang deng khal in a hnenah an kir ding. Citin le hnamtin in amah an bia ding."},"28":{"text":"Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si; Miphun hmuahhmuah a uk hai a si."},"29":{"text":"Mi hngal le mi neinung pawl a hmai ah an bok ding; A thi theimi milai hmuahhmuah a hmai ah an kun ding; Mahte a nung awter thei lotu pawl cu."},"30":{"text":"An tesinfa pawl in Bawipa ih hna an ṭuan ding; A ra dingmi san khalah Bawipa ih thu cu an sim ding."},"31":{"text":"A suak lai dingmi pawl hnen khal ah, “ Bawipa in a minung pawl a run a si,” tiah an sim ding."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu i khaaltu a si; Sammi zianghman ka nei lo.","title":"Cu I Khaltu A si"},"2":{"text":"Tlimno lakah i bawhter ih, A thiangmi tiva kamah i hruai."},"3":{"text":"Ka thazaang a tlunter saal i, I tiam cia vekin lamzin dingah i hruai."},"4":{"text":"A thimmi thihnak horkuam sung zawh hman ningla, Maw Bawipa , ka ṭih lo ding; Ziangahtile nang cu ka hnenah na um, Na talhtum le na kianghrol in ka hna in ngamter."},"5":{"text":"Ka ral pawl ih hmuhhngan ah cabuai parah rawl i hun; Ka lu ah hriak i culh ih, Ka khuathai khal a liam thluahthlo."},"6":{"text":"Ka nunsung hmuahhmuah ah, ṭhatnak le duhdawtnak cun Pelh loin i thlun ringring ding. Bawipa ih inn ah kumkhua in ka um ding."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leilung pumpi le a sungih ummi hmuahhmuah cu, Bawipa ih ta an si. Leilung le a parih ummi tla Amah ih ta an si.","title":"A Tumlian Siangpahrang"},"2":{"text":"Ziangahtile ti thukpi parah Leilungpi cu a dinter ih, A hram cu tipi thuanthum ih tawne ah a phun."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa ih tlang ah zoso a kai ding? A biakinn thiang sungah zoso a lut ding?"},"4":{"text":"A tuahnak le a ruahnak a thianghlim mi, Milem a bia lomi le Thuphan a per lomi a si ding."},"5":{"text":"Amah cu Bawipa in thluasuah a pe ding ih a run ding; Pathian in, “Mawh nei lo na si,” a ti ding."},"6":{"text":"Pathian hnenih a rami cu cubangtuk an si; Jakob ih Pathian mithmai a hawltu pawl cu!"},"7":{"text":"Maw kotkhar pawl, rak khaisaang aw uh; Maw kumkhua sangka pawl, khaisaang aw uh; A sunglawimi siangpahrang a lut ding."},"8":{"text":"A sunglawimi siangpahrang cu zoso a si? A cakmi le a nasa zetmi Bawipa , Raldonak ih mi nehtu Bawipa a si."},"9":{"text":"Maw kotkhar pawl, rak khaisaang aw uh; Maw kumkhua sangka pawl, khaisaang aw uh; A sunglawimi siangpahrang a lut ding."},"10":{"text":"A sunglawimi siangpahrang cu zoso a si? Amah cu mi hmuahhmuahih Bawipa , Sunloih mi siangpahrang a si."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka nunnak ka lo hlan;","title":"Hruainak Le Himnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka Pathian, nangmah ka lo ring, Mualpho ningzahnak ihsin i luatter hram aw; Ka ral pawl cu ka parah an di riam hlah hai seh."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah a lo ringtu cu an ning a zak dah lo; Nangmah a lo phiartu cu mualpho in um hai seh."},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na lamzin i zirh aw; Na lamzin cu i theihter hram aw."},"5":{"text":"Na thudik vekih nung dingah i zirh aw; Ziangahtile nangmah cu i Runtu na si; Sunvute nangmah ka lo hngak!"},"6":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , khuahlan lai ihsin na rak langtermi, Na mi zaangfahnak le a thleng-aw dah lomi na mi duhdawtnak cu, vun ruat sal hram aw."},"7":{"text":"Ka no laiih ka mawhnak le ka thil tisualmi pawl I ngaidam hram aw. A thleng-aw dah lomi na duhdawtnak le na ṭhatnak ruangah, Maw Bawipa , kei hi i hngilh hram hlah aw."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cu a dik ih a ṭha; Misual pawl lamzin ṭha a zirh."},"9":{"text":"Mi tangdor pawl cu lamzin dik ah a hruai ih, Mi lungnem pawl cu a lamzin a zirh hai a si."},"10":{"text":"A thukham le a thupekmi a thluntu pawl cu, A duhdawtnak le rintlak a sinak thawn a hruai hai a si."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na hmin ih vaangah, A besia zetmi ka sualnak cu i ngaidam hram aw."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa a ṭihzahtu cu zoso an si? An thlun dingmi lamzin Pathian ih zirhmi pawl an si."},"13":{"text":"Annih cu mi neinungzet an si ringring ding ih, An faale pawl khal himdam zetin An ram an luah ding."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa cu a thu a thluntu pawl ih rualpi a si, A thukam a theihter hai a si."},"15":{"text":"Bomnak duh ah Bawipa cu ka zoh ringring, Cule thang sung ihsin i luatter."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i hoih awla i zaangfah hram aw; Ziangahtile ka lung a leeng ih ka tha a nau."},"17":{"text":"Ka thinlung donharnak zatein in i sawng awla, Ka harnak sung in i run hram aw."},"18":{"text":"Ka harsatnak le ka tuarnak hi i theihsak awla; Ka sualnak hmuahhmuah i ngaidam hram aw."},"19":{"text":"Ka ral pawl hi zohhnik aw! Ziangtluk in so an tam ih, Ziangtluk lawmmam in so in huat!"},"20":{"text":"I hum awla i run hram aw; Ningzahnak in i luatter hram aw; Beunak duh ah na hnenah ka ra."},"21":{"text":"Ka ruahsannak na hnenih a um ruangah, maw Bawipa, ṭhatnak le felnak in i himter hram seh."},"22":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na minung Israel mi pawl hi, An harsatnak hmuahhmuah sung ihsin luatter hram aw."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , mawh neilo a si, tiah i ti hram aw; Ziangahtile a dikmi ka tuah ih, Ka thinlung zatein nangmah ka lo ring a si.","title":"Miṭha Ih Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i zingzoi awla i hniksak hnik aw; Ka duhnak le ka ruahnak khal hi khingkhai hnik aw."},"3":{"text":"A thleng-aw dah lomi na duhdawtnak in i kil ih, Rintlak na sinak in i hruai ringring."},"4":{"text":"Mi hlothlau pawl cu ka kom hai lo ih, Mi ti-awter pawl hnen khal ah ka tel lo."},"5":{"text":"Mi hrokhrawl pawl hnenih tel cu ka hua ih, Mi ṭha lo pawl cu ka hrial hai a si."},"6":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , mawh neilo ka si langternak ah ka kut ka kholh ih, Nangmah bia phah in na biakṭheng cu ka heel."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah hnenah lungawinak hla ka sak ih, Mangbangza na thil tuahmi pawl thu ka sim."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na umnak inn cu ka ngaina, Na huham a umnak hmun cu!"},"9":{"text":"Misual pawl lakah i siatter ve hlah awla, Laithat pawl thawn khal i hloralter hram hlah aw."},"10":{"text":"Annih cu cat loin sualnak thil ṭha lo a tuahtu le, Nawhthuh a la ringringtu an si."},"11":{"text":"Asinain kei cu thildik a tuahtu ka si; I zaangfah awla i hum hram aw."},"12":{"text":"Ṭihphannak hmun ihsin hmun rawnpi ka thleng zo; Mi zapi khawmnak hmunah Bawipa Ka thangṭhat ding."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka tleunak le ka rundamnak a si; Zoso ka ṭih ding? Bawipa cu ka beunak lungpi a si; Zianghman ka ṭih lo ding.","title":"Thangṭhat Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo ka ral pawl in in do ih a thah in tum tikah, Anmah riangri an bah ih an ril."},"3":{"text":"Ralkap burpi ih in kulh ṭheh hmanah, ka ṭih lo ding; Ka ral pawl ih in nor ciamco hmanah, thlaphang loin, Pathian cu ka rinsan thotho ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah thil pakhat ka dil; Cuih thil pakhat lawng cu ka duhmi a si: Bawipa ih inn sungah ka nun sung hmuahhmuah um ka duh; A mawinak zoh dingah le amah ih duhmi hawl ding, hi a si."},"5":{"text":"Harsat caanah amah ih puuk sungah i thup ding; A Biakinnpi sungah himte in i kilkhawi ding ih, A saangmi lungpi parah hnangamte in i umter ding."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun ka kiang ih a ummi ka ral pawl cu ka neh ding. Lungawinak thawn au phah in a Biakinnpi sungah thawinak ka pe ding. Hla ka sak ding, Bawipa cu ka thangṭhat ding."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka lo kawh tikah i thei hram aw; I zaangfah awla i let hram aw."},"8":{"text":"“Ra awla Bawipa ih mithmai hawl aw,” na ti tikah, “ Bawipa , na mithmai ka hawl ding,” tiah ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Na mithmai i hersan hram hlah aw. Ka parah na thinheng loin, Na siahhlawh hi i khir hram hlah aw. Nangmah cu i bawmtu ringring na si. Maw Pathian, I Runtu, I taanta hlah awla i dungtun hram hlah aw."},"10":{"text":"Ka nu le ka pa cun in dungtun hman hai sehla, Bawipa cun ṭhatein i tuam hlawm ding."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , tuahter i duh mi cu i zirh awla, A dingmi lamzin ah i hruai aw. Ziangahtile ka ral an tam ngaingai a si."},"12":{"text":"Thuphan le hro-nak hlir in i dotu ka ral pawl hnenah cun, i taanta hram hlah aw."},"13":{"text":"A nungmi pawl ih ram ah Bawipa ih ṭhatnak cu Ka hmu tengteng ding tiah ka zum."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa cu hngak uh; Cakzet le ralṭha in um uh; Bawipa cu hngak uh."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka Lungpi, Nangmah ka lo ko. Ka aunak aw i thei hram aw! Daiziar ih i umsan a si ahcun, Mithi khua ih a fehmi lakah ka tel ding.","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Bomnak dil in ka lo ko; Na Biakinnpi thianghlim lam ban phar in ka hoi tikah, Ka aunak aw i theih sak hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Siatnak hlir a tuahtu pawl le An ṭongkam cu a thlum naón An thinlung huatnak ih a khatmi, Mi ṭha lo pawl hnenah i hnong hram hlah aw."},"4":{"text":"An thil tuahmi, thilsual an tuahmi vekin lehrul hai aw; An hnaṭuanmi, an kutih an ṭuan sualmi vekin hrem hai aw."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnaṭuanmi le a kutih a tuahmi pawl cu ziang hmanah an siar lo. Curuangah siatbal hai awla, Ziangtik hmanah an tho sal nawn lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah thangṭhatnak pe uh; Zaangfah ka dilnak aw a thei zo."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka thazaang le ka ralphaw a si, Amah ka rinsan. I bom ruangah ka lung a awi. Amah cawimawinak cu hla in ka sak."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl a hum. A hrilmi siangpahrang cu a ṭan ih a run."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na minung pawl hum awla, Na ta a si mi pawl cu thlawsuah pe hai aw. Anmah khaaltu si awla, Kumkhua in kilkhawi hai aw."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw vanmi pawl, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh; A sunlawinak le a cahnak cu thangṭhat uh.","title":"Pathian Cahnak Le Sunlawinak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmin sunglawi cu thangṭhat uh; A sunlawinak thawn a lang tikah Thianghlim bik hmai ah kun uh."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa ih aw cu tifinriat parah a thang; Sunglawi bik Pathian cu khawri bangin a ri durdo. A aw cu tipithuanthum parah a khawk ruangro."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih aw cu huham a nei zet ih a nasa ngaingai."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa ih aw in sidar thingkung a khiak, Lebanon ih sidar thingkung tiangin a khiak thluh."},"6":{"text":"Amah in Lebanon tlang pawl cu, cawte turcaai bangin a khirter ih, Hermon Tlang cu sele note bangin a petter."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih aw in nimthla a kauter."},"8":{"text":"A aw in nelrawn a hninter, Kadesh ih nelrawn khal cu."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih aw in zukneng pinu ih fa a suakter; Thingkung pawl tla an hnah a kolhter ṭheh. Cule a Biakinn sungah, “Pathian cu sunglawi seh,” tiah an au."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in tipi thuk pawl a uk; Siangpahrang a si ih kumkhua in a uk a si."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl cu thazaang cahnak a pek; Hnangamnak thawn a thlawsuah hai a si."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i run suak zo ih Ka ral pawl ih diremmi ka si lo ruangah nangmah ka lo thangṭhat.","title":"Lungawi Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, na hnenah bomnak dil in ka au ih nangmah in i damter."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , mithi khua ihsin Nangmah in i kirter sal. Thihnak khur sungah ka tla lawk naón nangmah in ka nunnak cu na humsuak sal a si."},"4":{"text":"Maw rinsantlak a mithiang pawl, Bawipa cu hla in thang ṭhat cio uh. Thianghlim bik ih a tuahmi kha ciing uhla, Lungawinak a hnenah pe uh."},"5":{"text":"A thinhengnak cu mitṭhep fang a rei; Asinain a ṭhatnak cun sansung a daih. Zan ah ṭahnak um hmansehla, Zinglam ah lungawinak a thleng a si."},"6":{"text":"Ka rinsan awk deuh tikah ka thinlungte in, “Neh mi ka si nawn lo ding,” tiah ka ti aw."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka parah na ṭha ngaingai ih, Tlangpar ih ralhruang sung um vekin himte in i ret. Sikhalsehla ka hmuh lonak ih na thuh-awk tikah cun, Ka thinlung cu ṭihnak in a khat."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah ka lo ko; Na zaangfahnak ka lo dil."},"9":{"text":"Ka thih ahcun ziang ṭhatnak so na hrangah a um ding? Thlaan ih ka feh ahcun ziangso na hlawk cuang ding? Mithi in an lo thangṭhat ding maw si? A cat dah lomi na ṭhatnak hi an phuang thei ding maw?"},"10":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i thei awla i zaangfah hram aw. Bawipa , i bawmtu si hram aw."},"11":{"text":"Ka riahsiatnak cu lungawi ih laamnak ah i thleng sak zo. Ka riahsiatnak khumdip puan cu i hliit sak ih, Lungawinak hnipuan i hrukter zo."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah daiziarzi cun ka um lo ding; Nangmah thangṭhatnak hla ka sak ding. Maw Bawipa , nangmah cu ka Pathian na si. Na hnenah lungawinak kumkhua in ka sim ding."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na hnenah beunak hawl in ka ra; Ningzak in i umter hlah aw. Nang cu a dingmi Pathian na si ruangah I run hram aw.","title":"Pathian Rinsan Ih Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka lo dilnak aw thei in zamrang tein i run hram aw. Ka beunak si awla i hum hram aw; I ṭantu si awla i run hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Nang cu ka beunak lungpi le ka ralhruang na si. I tiam cia vekin i kil awla i hruai hram aw."},"4":{"text":"Ka hrangih an kam ciami thang ihsin i luatter hram aw. Nang cu ka beunak na si."},"5":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu na kut sungah ka lo hlan. Maw Bawipa , i hum hram aw; Nang cu rintlak Pathian na si."},"6":{"text":"Santlai lo milem a biatu pawl cu na hua. Asinain kei cun nang ka lo rinsan."},"7":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak ruangah Ka lung a awi ding ih ka ai a puang ding. Ka tuar zia na hmu ih ka harsat zia na thei."},"8":{"text":"Ka ral pawl ih kut sungah i thlengter lo. Ka duhnakah luatzet in ka feh."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka parah zaangfahnak nei hram aw. Vansang in ka um a si. Ka ṭahnak ah ka mit a cuur ṭheh; Ka tha khal a cem ṭheh zo."},"10":{"text":"Riahsiatnak ruangah ka nun a tawi ih, Ka ṭahnak in ka kum a ralter. Ka zonzai tuk ih ka taksa khal in a daih lo. Ka ruh tiangin an rop a si."},"11":{"text":"Ka ral pawl in capoh-nakah in hmang; Ka innhnen pawl in in hnihsan. I theitu pawl cun in ṭih; Lamzin ih in hmuh tikah an tlanhlo."},"12":{"text":"Zohman in in thei nawn lo; mithi tluk ah in ruat. Beelkuai hlonmi vek ka si."},"13":{"text":"Ka ral pawl thuthup an sim-aw ka thei. Ka kiangkap cu phannak in a khat. Keimah phiarnak khua an khang; A thah in tum a si."},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla maw Bawipa, Ka rinsanmi cu nangmah na si; Nangmah cu ka Pathian na si."},"15":{"text":"Ka ziangzongza na kut ah a um. Ka ral pawl le i hremtu pawl kut in i hum hram aw."},"16":{"text":"Kei cu na siahhlawh ka si, Zaangfahnak thawn i zoh hram aw. A hmunmi na duhdawtnak in i run aw."},"17":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah ka lo ko; Ningzahnak ah i thlengter hram hlah aw. Mi ṭha lo pawl cu an ningzak ko seh; Mithi khua ah ṭong ding nei loin um hai seh."},"18":{"text":"Mihngal le mi puarthau pawl, Hmuhsuamnak thawn miṭha pawl ih thu a reltu pawl, Thuphan an simnak kaa cu phit hram aw."},"19":{"text":"Nangmah a lo ṭihzahtu pawl hrangih na khawl ciami thil ṭha a tam zia cu! Nangmah a lo ringtu pawl na humnak thu mi hmuahhmuah mithmuh ih a mawizia cu!"},"20":{"text":"Na thladem hnuai ah himte in na ret hai, Mi phiarnak ihsin an luat. Na puuk sungah hnangamte in na thup hai, An ral pawl ih hmuhsuamnak in an luat a si."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat siseh. In kulh ih ka van a san laiah I duhdawtnak na langter zia cu mangbangza a si!"},"22":{"text":"Ka thin a phang ih ka lung in: ‘A umnak ihsin i hlon zo a sihi!’ tiah ka ruat. Asinain bomnak dilih ka lo kawh tikah ka aunak aw i thei thotho."},"23":{"text":"Maw mithiang pawl, Bawipa cu duhdaw uh; Amah rinsantu cu Bawipa in a hum ih mi hngal pawl cu nasa zetin a tuah hai a si."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa ah ruahsannak a neitu pawl cu cak le ral ṭha in um uh."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A mawhnak ngaithiam a si mi le, A sualnak thlahsak a si mi cu mi thlawsuak a si.","title":"Sualphuannak Le Ngaidamnak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in sual a puh lomi le, A lung sungah mibumnak a neilotu cu mi thlawsuak a si."},"3":{"text":"Ka sualnak phuang loih ka um tikah cun, Sunvu ka ṭahnak ah ka taksa a vuai ṭheh."},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , a sun a zan in na kut in i nen; Ka thazaang cu, ṭhal ni ling ih daitla a roter bangin, a roter ṭheh a si."},"5":{"text":"Cule na hnenah ka sualnak cu ka phuang; Ka thil tisual mi pakhat hman ka pheh lo. Ka sualnak cu na hnenih phuang dingin ka ruat cat; Cule nangmah in ka sualnak cu i ngaithiam ṭheh a si."},"6":{"text":"Nangmah a lo tlaihsantu hmuahhmuah in, An harsat caan ah na hnenah thla cam hai seh. Tilik lianpi a thlen tikah an hnen a thleng lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka beunak hmun na si. Harnak in i hum ding. Nangmah ih i run ruangah I runnak cu hla in ka sak ding."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Na thlun dingmi lamzin ka lo sim ding. Ka lo zirh dingih ka lo hmuh ding."},"9":{"text":"Rang le laak vek cun aa hlah; Na thu ngaitu si dingah annih cu Kakharh le hmurhri in dirh an ṭul,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih tuarmi cu a tam ngaingai; Asinain Bawipa a rinsantu cu A hmunmi a duhdawtnak in a hum hai a si."},"11":{"text":"Nannih miding pawl, Bawipa ah lungawi aipuang in um uh. Nannih thinlung ṭha pawl, nuamzet in au uh."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nannih miding pawl, Bawipa ih thil tuahmi ruangah nan lungawi uh. Nannih a thu thluntu pawl, Amah thangṭhat uh.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah ṭingṭang thawn lungawinak thu sim uh. Hri pahra nei tingrisit thawn a hnenah hla sak uh."},"3":{"text":"A hnenah hla thar sak uh. Mawi zetin tingrisit tum uhla ring zetin hla sak uh."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih thu cu a dik; A tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu rintlak an si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in dingnak le thudik a duh; A duhdawtnak in leilung hi a khat."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in vanih ummi hmuahhmuah a thu in a seemsuah. A ṭong in ni, thlapi le arsi pawl a tuah."},"7":{"text":"Tifinriat tidai pawl cu rial tithawl sungih tidai thun vekin hmunkhat ah a finkhawm; Tipithuanthum tithukpi pawl cu A thilri retnak khaan sungah a khum."},"8":{"text":"Leilung pumpi in Bawipa cu ṭih seh. Leilungtlun mi hmuahhmuah in Bawipa cu ṭihzah cio hai seh."},"9":{"text":"A ṭong tikah leilung cu seemsuah a si ih, A thupeknak in ziang hmuahhmuah a suak a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in leitlun miphun pawl ih tumtahmi cu a phelhsolh. An tawlrelmi tuahsuak lo dingah a kham hai."},"11":{"text":"Asinain amah ih tumtahmi cu kumkhua in a hmun ih, A tawlrelmi pawl cu sanikhuk a hnget."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa kha an Pathian ah a neitu miphun cu, mi thlawsuak phun an si. Bawipa in a rothil ah a hrilmi pawl cu mi thlawsuak an si."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa cun vancung ihsin a run zoh ih, Miphun hmuahhmuah a hmu."},"14":{"text":"A lalnak hmun ihsin leilung ih a ummi hmuahhmuah a run zoh."},"15":{"text":"Amah cu an ruahnak hmuahhmuah a sersiamtu le, An tuahnak hmuahhmuah a theitu a si."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang in ral a neh tikah A ralkap bu an cahzet ruangah a si lo. Ralkap khal in ral a neh tikah Amah ih tha a cah ruangah a si lo."},"17":{"text":"Raldonak rang pawl cu ral nehnak ngaingai ahcun, Santlai lo an si. An cahzet hmanah zohman an run thei lo."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa in amah ṭihzahtu le A hmunmi a duhdawtnak a ringtu cu A kilveng ringring a si."},"19":{"text":"Thihnak ihsin a run hai ih Paampi a tlun tik khalah an nunnak a hum a si."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah ruahsannak kan nei. Amah cu in bawmtu le in humtu a si."},"21":{"text":"Amah ih ruangah kan lung a awi. A hmin thianghlim kan ring a si."},"22":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na hnenih ruah saannak kan neih bangin, A hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu Kan hnenah um hram seh."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih parah ka lung a awi ringring ding. Amah thangṭhat cu ka bang dah lo ding.","title":"Pathian Ih ṭhatnak A Lawm"},"2":{"text":"A thil tuahmi ruangah amah cu ka thangṭhat ding. Rethei zonzai pawl in thei uhla nan lungawi uh."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa ih maksak zia cu in cawimawi pi uhla, Amah ih hmin cu thangṭhat tlang uhsi."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah thla ka cam ih amah in i let. Ka ṭihphannak hmuahhmuah sungin i luatter."},"5":{"text":"Mi zonzai pawl in amah cu an zoh ih an lung a awi. Ziangtik hmanah an ning a zak nawn lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Bawmtu nei lo pawl in amah an ko ih a sawn hai. An harsatnak hmuahhmuah in a luatter hai."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa a ṭihzahtu pawl cu a vancungmi in an kil ih, ṭihphannak in a run hai a si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭhatzia cu nanmah tein tep ciar hnik uh; A hnenih himnak a ngahtu cu mi thlawsuak an si."},"9":{"text":"Maw amah ih minung pawl, Bawipa cu ṭihzah uh. Amah a ṭihzahtu cu tlaksammi zianghman an nei lo."},"10":{"text":"Kiosa hman rilrawng in an um ṭheu; Sikhalsehla Bawipa ih duhnak a thluntu cu, Thil ṭha an hlawhsam dah lo."},"11":{"text":"Ra uh, mino pawl, i ra ngai hnik uh. Bawipa ṭihzah daan ka lo zirh hai ding."},"12":{"text":"Leilung tlunah hin nuam zetih nun nan duh maw? Nun sau le lungawi nan duh maw?"},"13":{"text":"Nan duh asile a ṭha lomi ṭong lo dingah le Thuphan sim lo dingah ralring uh."},"14":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo cu hrial uhla a ṭhami tuah uh. Daihnak tumtah uhla a cangthei tawkin ngah zuam uh."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in miding pawl cu a zoh ringring hai ih an aunak khal a thei."},"16":{"text":"Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu a dodal hai a si. An thih tikah an hmin hngilh tata dingah a phiatfai a si."},"17":{"text":"Miding pawl in Bawipa cu an ko ih an aw a thei; An harsatnak hmuahhmuah sungin a luatter hai."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa in thinnau mi pawl cu a naih hai ih, Beiseinak zianghman a nei nawn lotu pawl cu a run hai a si."},"19":{"text":"Mi ṭha khal harnak tampi a tuar ṭheu; Asinain Bawipa in cu hmuahhmuah sung khal in a suah ṭheu."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in ṭhazet in a kil, A ruh pakhatte hman a kiak lo."},"21":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo cu ṭhatlonak in a that ding; Miding a huatu pawl cu hremnak an tong ding."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in a siahhlawh pawl cu a tlen hai ding; Beunak duh ah a hnenih a fehtu cu, an him ding."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i ralsantu pawl ralsan ve awla, I dotu pawl do ve aw.","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Na ralphaw le na raldonak thuam la awla, Keimah bawm dingah pok aw."},"3":{"text":"Na feipi le na hriamhrei la awla, I dawitu pawl cu kham hai aw. Cule, “Nangmah Runtu ka si,” tiah i tiam hram aw."},"4":{"text":"Keimah thah i tumtu pawl cu Sung hai sehla ningzak in um hai seh; Keimah siatsuah ding ih i phiartu pawl cu, Thinnau le thinlung hnok in kir hai seh."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi in a dawi hai tikah, Thli ih a semhlomi fanghi vek si hai seh."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi in a vuak hai tikah, An lamzin thim sehla naalzet seh."},"7":{"text":"Ziangthu hman um loin keimah kai dingah, Thang in kam ih khur thuk an lai."},"8":{"text":"Asinain an theih hlanah siatsuahnak in a man ding; Anmah ih kam ciami thang in a awk hai ding ih, Siatsuahnak sungah an tla ding."},"9":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ah ka lung a awi ding; I hum ruangah ka ai a puang ding."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah ka thinlung zatein, “Nangmah bangtuk zohman an um lo; Mi ṭawnṭai pawl cu mi cak pawl kut ihsin na humhim ih, Mi farah zonzai pawl cu Hmuhsuamtu pawl ih kut ihsin na humhim hai a si,” ka ti ding."},"11":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ka sual hawltu ah an suak ih, Ka theih dah lomi sual in puh ciamco."},"12":{"text":"Ṭhatnak cu siatnak in in lehrul ih, Thinnau le riahsia in ka um."},"13":{"text":"An dam lo tikah riahsia in buri hnipuan ka hruk ih, An hrangah rawl ka ul. An hrangah lu kun in thla ka cam,"},"14":{"text":"Ka rualpi le ka unau hrangih riahsia bangin. Mi pakhatkhat a nu ih zuun a ngai bangin, An hrangah riahsia in ka kuun ih ka feh."},"15":{"text":"Asinain harsatnak ka ton tikah, Annih pawl cu an lung a awi; Keimah hnihsan dingah in kulh, Tluangmi pawl khal in in vua, Cat loin in vaw ringring."},"16":{"text":"Ke-awl an hmuhsuam ih an puahcok bangin, In hua ih in mitkem ciamco."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa , ziangtik tiangso hiti in i zoh meen ding? Hitiih in vuaknak ihsin i run hram awla, Ka nunnak cu hi kiosa pawl kut sungin i hum hram aw."},"18":{"text":"Cuticun a pumkhawmmi na minung lakah ka lo lawm ding, An zate hmaiah ka lo thangṭhat ding."},"19":{"text":"Thuphanpertu ka ral pawl cu kham hai aw, Ka sun ruangah diriam in um hlah hai seh; Thuhla um loin i huatu pawl cu kham hai aw, Ka riahsiat ruangah an lungawi in hni suamso hlah hai seh."},"20":{"text":"Rualpi ṭha ṭong in an ṭong lo, Rualremnak a duhtu pawl kha thuphan a phunphun an puh hai."},"21":{"text":"Sual in puh ih, “Na tuahmi kan thei,” tiah an au."},"22":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa nang in hi thil hi na hmu thluh; Curuangah Bawipa daitein um hram hlah aw; Lamhla ah i umsan hram hlah aw."},"23":{"text":"Tho awla Bawipa i hum aw; Ding awla ka Pathian ka thu i simsak aw."},"24":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nang cu a dingmi na si; Curuangah sual nei lo a si tiah i phuan sak aw. Ka ral pawl cu hni suamso in umter hlah hai aw."},"25":{"text":"“Kan dawihlo zo, kan duh mite kan tuah ngah zo,” an ti lonak dingah nangmah in kham hai aw."},"26":{"text":"Hi tluk ka tuarnak parih a hni sursotu pawl cu, Ningzak le buai in um hai seh. “Anih hnakin kan ṭha deuh,” i titu pawl cu, Mualpho le thangsia in um hai seh."},"27":{"text":"Keimah thiamcotermi ka si ding, i duhsaktu cu lungawi aipuang in um hai sehla, “ Bawipa cu a maksak a si; A siahhlawh hlawhtlinnak a ngah ruangah a lung a awi a si,” tiah cat loin au hai seh."},"28":{"text":"Cuticun na dingnak cu ka than ding ih, Sun nihlawh in ka lo thangṭhat ding."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sualnak in mi ṭha lo ih thinlung sungah thu a vun sim; Cutiin Pathian an hnong ih malte hman Pathian ṭihnak an nei lo.","title":"Minung Ih ṭhatlonak"},"2":{"text":"Anmah le anmah an porh awk tuk ruangah an sualnak an hmu thei loih an hua thei fawn lo."},"3":{"text":"An kaa ih a suakmi cu sualnak le thuphan hlir an si. Ṭhatnak zianghman tuah dingah fimnak an nei nawn lo."},"4":{"text":"A ihkhun ih a zau phah ah thilṭha lo a ngaihtuah; Theinacing in zinsia a zawh; Ziangbangtuk sualnak hman hrial mi a nei lo."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , a hmunmi na duhdawtnak vancung a thleng ih, Rintlak na sinak in van khi a dai a si.","title":"Pathian Ih ṭhatnak"},"6":{"text":"Na dingfelnak cu tlang saangpi bangtuk in a saang ih, Na dingthluk lairelnak cu tipi thuanthum bangtuk in a thuk. Maw Bawipa , nang cun minung siseh ramsa siseh na zaangfah hai a si."},"7":{"text":"Maw Pathian, a hmunmi na mi duhdawtnak cu a va sunglawi ve! Mi in na thladem ah humhimnak an ngah."},"8":{"text":"Na inn sungih ei cawk lo rawl cu an ei-ih, Na lungawinak tiva ihsin tidai na pek hai."},"9":{"text":"Ziangahtile na hnenah nunnak cerhti a um; Na tleunak sungah tleunak kan hmu."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah a lo theitu hnenah, Na duhdawtnak cat loin um sehla, Thinlung a dingmi hnenah, Na ṭhatnak cat loin um hram seh."},"11":{"text":"Mihngal pawl cun i siim hram hlah hai seh; Mi ṭha lo pawl cun i tlanter hram hlah hai seh."},"12":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl an tlaknak khi zohhnik! Khi tawkah an ril ih an thosal thei nawn lo."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo an um ruangah donhar in um hlah. Sualnak a tuahtu pawl khal va daw hlah.","title":"Mi ṭha Le Mi ṭha Lo Thlennak Ding Hmun"},"2":{"text":"Annih cu hrampi ro bangin an hlo ding ih, Hramkung vuai bangin an thita ding."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu rinsan awla thil ṭha tuah aw. Cuticun hi ram sungah himdamte in na um ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ah na lungawinak hawl awla, Na lungthlitum a lo pe ding."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah na nunnak pe aw; Amah rinsan awla a lo bawm ding."},"6":{"text":"Na ṭhatnak cu sun khawvang bangin a vangter ding ih, Na dingnak cu sun nitleu bangin a tleuter ding."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah daiteón um aw, Amah ih cangvaihnak cu thinsau in hngak aw; Mi neinung an um ruangah ninghang in um hlah; Mi ṭha lo pawl khawkhannak an hlawhtlin ruangah thin ṭeu in um hlah."},"8":{"text":"Na thinheng hlah! Na ai khal thok hlah! Na don tla har hlah! Thil ṭha lo a suahter a si."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa a rinsantu cu hi ram sungah hnangamte in an um ding. Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu dawihlo an si ding."},"10":{"text":"Reilote-ah mi ṭha lo pawl cu an hlo ding. Na hawl khalle na hmu nawn lo ding a si."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla lungnem pawl cun, Ram cu an luah ding. Daihnak le neihnunnak an co ding."},"12":{"text":"Mi ṭha loin mi ṭha an phiar, An hacang an rial ih huatnak mit in a zoh."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in mi ṭha lo cu a hnihsan; An cem cing ding ti a theih ruangah."},"14":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo cun an ralnam an zuuk ih an li an nawp; Mi farah le zonzai thah an tum. Mi ṭha le mi fel thah ṭheh an tum a si."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla anmah ih zuh mi ralnam in a dawt hai ding ih, An li pawl cu khiah ṭheh an si ding."},"16":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih neihmi thil tampi liangluang hnakin, Mi tha pawl ih neihmi thil malte man a nei sawn."},"17":{"text":"Ziangahtile Bawipa in, Mi ṭha lo ih thazaang cahnak cu a khiak ding ih, Mi ṭha pawl cu a humhim ding."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa in amah ih thu a thluntu pawl cu a kilkhawi hai; Hi ram cu kumkhua in anmah ih ta a si ding."},"19":{"text":"Harsat caanah mual an pho lo ding; Paam caan khalah ei khop an ngah ringring ding."},"20":{"text":"Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu an hloral ding; Bawipa a raltu pawl cu hramlak pangpar bangin an ziam ding, Meikhu bangin an hlota ding."},"21":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo cun mi thil an cawi ih an sam sal nawn lo; Asinain mi ṭha cun mi a zaangfah ih a tirh a siang."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa ih thlawsuahmi pawl in hi ram hi an co ding; Asinain a camsiatmi pawl cu dawihlo an si ding."},"23":{"text":"Minung ih fehnak lamzin cu Bawipa in a sial sak ih An nuncan parah a lung a awi."},"24":{"text":"A bah hmanah a rilta lo ding, Ziangahtile Bawipa in a tho saal ding."},"25":{"text":"Ka seenlai ihsin ka tar tiang, Bawipa in mi ṭha a tlansan ka hmu dah lo. An faale pawl khal rawl diltu an si ka hmu dah lo."},"26":{"text":"Ziangtik khalah siang zetin mi a pe ih mi a coih, A faale pawl cu thlawsuah ah an cang."},"27":{"text":"Siatnak cu tlansan awla ṭhatnak tuah aw; Cutin hi ram sungah kumkhua in na um ding."},"28":{"text":"Ziangahtile Bawipa cun a dikmi a duh ih, Amah rinsantu pawl cu a dungtun hai lo a si. Annih cu kumkhua in a hum hai. Asinain mi ṭha lo ih tefa pawl cu dawihlo an si ding."},"29":{"text":"Miding pawl in hi ram cu an luah ding ih, Hnangamtein kumkhua in an um ding."},"30":{"text":"Mi ṭha pawl ih kaa in fimnak a suak; An lei in dingnak a sim."},"31":{"text":"Pathian ih daan cu a thinlung sungah a ret ih, Ziangtik hmanah a pialsan dah lo."},"32":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo in mi ṭha cu a zoh thup ringring ih thah a tum."},"33":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in a ral ih kut sungah a taanta lo ding ih, A thu an rel tik khalah a hnongta lo ding."},"34":{"text":"Nan ruahsannak cu Bawipa ih hnenah ret uhla, A thupekmi pawl thlun uh. Hi ram co theinak thazaang a lo pe hai ding. Cule mi ṭha lo pawl siatsuah thluh an si cu na hmu ding."},"35":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pakhat thu neizet le porh-aw zettu ka hmu zo; Lebanon sidar thingkung bangin midang hnakih saang deuh ah a ret aw."},"36":{"text":"Asinain nehhnu ih ka zoh sal tikah a um nawn lo. Ka hawl khalle ka hmu nawn lo."},"37":{"text":"Mi ṭha cu zohhnik uh, Mi ding cu thlir hnik uh; Mi lungnem le midai cun te le fa an nei."},"38":{"text":"Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu an hloral ṭheh, An tefa pawl cu an cimit ṭheh a si."},"39":{"text":"Mi ding pawl ih runnak cu Bawipa hnen in a ra. Harsatnak caan ah an beunak lungpi a si."},"40":{"text":"Bawipa in annih cu a bawm ih a run; A hnenah beunak duh ih an feh ruangah, Mi ṭha lo kut ihsin a hum hai a si."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thinheng in i kawk hram hlah aw. Na thin-aithok in i hrem hram hlah aw.","title":"Harsatnak Tuartu-ih Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Na conkiang in i tuahmawh zo; Ril ko in i vuak zo."},"3":{"text":"Na thin a heng ruangah besia zetin ka na; Ka sualnak ruangah ka ruangpi cu natnak in a khat."},"4":{"text":"Ka sualnak tilian sungah ka pil; I delh tuk ih ka phur thei lo."},"5":{"text":"Ka aat ruangah ka hma pawl cu Hnai an khuar ih an thu, an nam ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"Ka eel a kuun ih ka bokta. Sun nihlawh in ka ai, ka hruum."},"7":{"text":"Ka tak a sa ih ka khur ciamco; Ka besia ih ka thi zik thlang."},"8":{"text":"Ka tha a cemthla ih ka bei a dong ngaingai. Ka thinhar in ka hui ka ai rero."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka thinlung duh mi cu na hmu, Ka hruumnak khal na thei."},"10":{"text":"Ka lung a hnin ih tha ka nei nawn lo.
