Ka mit khal khua a hmu nawn lo."},"11":{"text":"Hma tampi ka neih ruangah ka rualpi le, Kan innhnen pawl in in hrial; Keimah ih innsung saang hman hlimphirte in an um."},"12":{"text":"Thah i duhtu pawl in thang in kam. Tuahmawh i duhtu pawl in siatsuah dingah in hro. Sun nihlawh in keimah phiarnak an tawlrel."},"13":{"text":"Hnaset ka bang, zianghman ka thei thei lo. Dangpit ka bang, zianghman ka ṭong thei lo."},"14":{"text":"Mi ṭong a theih thei lo ruangah, Mi thusuh a let thei lomi ka bang."},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah ka lo hngak; Bawipa ka Pathian, nangmah in i sawn hram aw."},"16":{"text":"Harsatnak ka ton ruangah ka ral in in direm hlah hai seh; Ka bah ruangah porh-aw hlah hai seh."},"17":{"text":"Ka bah zik ringring ih Cat loin harsatnak ka tuar."},"18":{"text":"Ka sualnak ka phuang, Ka thinlung donharnak in a khat."},"19":{"text":"Ka ral pawl cu an harhdam zetih an cakzet fawn. Ziangthu hman um lo ih i huatu an tamzet fawn."},"20":{"text":"A dikmi tuah ka tum ruangah Keimah i duh lotu pawl cun ṭhatnak cu siatnak in in lehrul a si."},"21":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i dungtun hram hlah aw; Maw ka Pathian, a hlatnak ah i umsan hram hlah aw."},"22":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i Runtu, atu-ah zamrangin i ra bawm hram aw."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka thil tuahmi ka ralring pei, Ka lei in i sualter hlah seh; Ka ral pawl ka kiangkap ih an um sungah cun, ṭong lotein ka hmur ka ciip ding,” tiah ka ti.","title":"Harnak A Tuartu Ih Sualphuannak"},"2":{"text":"Daiziar in ka um ih kam khat hman ka ṭong lo; Thil ṭha thu hman rel lotein ka um. Asinain ka harsat tuarnak cu a zual deuhdeuh ih,"},"3":{"text":"Ka thinlung donharnak in a khat. Ka ruat tam deuhdeuh, ka thin a ling deuhdeuh. Curuangah Pathian hnenah:"},"4":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , ziangtik tiangso hiti in ka nun ding? Ka thi mai sawn lo ding maw? Tuan ah ka nunnak hi a cem ko lo ding maw? I theihter hram aw!” tiah sut loin ka um thei lo."},"5":{"text":"Ka nunnak hi na va tawiter tuk lawmmam so! Na hmaiah ka nun caan tawite hi ziangti tham a si lo. Minung nunnak cu kan thaw ih kan thawt mi thli lawng hi a si."},"6":{"text":"Kan phenthlam tluk fang a rak si. A ṭuanmi hmuahhmuah cu thu lolak hlir ah an cang. Ro a khawl vivo naón a cotu ding ngaingai a thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Cuti asile maw Bawipa , ziangso beisei ding ka neih? Ka ruahsanmi cu nangmah lawng na si."},"8":{"text":"Ka sualnak hmuahhmuah sungin i luatter awla, Mi aa pawl ih hnihsuahsainak ah i cangter hram hlah aw."},"9":{"text":"Hi tluk harsatnak tuar dingih i tuah ruangah, Daite in ka um ding; Kam khat hman ka ṭong lo ding."},"10":{"text":"I hrem nawn hlah aw. I vuak ruangah ka thi zik thlang."},"11":{"text":"Minung sualnak cu kawknak thawn na lehrul, A sunsakmi thil hmuahhmuah cu, sunhrul bangin na siatsuah ṭheh a si. Asi, minung cu kan thawtmi thaw vek fang a si."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka thlacamnak i thei hram awla, Ka lo dilmi hi i ngaisak hram aw. Na hnenih ka ṭah tikah daitein i um san men hlah aw. Ka pu le ka pa pawl vekin kei hi caan tawite sung lawng na mikhual ka si."},"13":{"text":"Hi leilung hi ka fehsan ih ka um nawn lo tikcu caan a thlen deuh hlan ahhin lungawi hnadai ih ka um theinak dingah khatlam i hoisan hram aw."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih bomnak cu thinsau in ka hngak ringring, Cule i run ngai ih ka aunak a thei.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ṭihnungza khur thukpi sungin i dir suak; Ciarbeek duuppi in a khatmi kua sung ihsin, Lungto parah himte in i dinter ih Hnangamtein i ret."},"3":{"text":"Hla thar sak ding i zirh, Kan Pathian faknak hla cu; Hi ka tonmi thil hi mi tampi in an hmuh tikah, An ṭih ding ih Bawipa cu an rinsan ding."},"4":{"text":"Khawzing pawl biaknak ih a tel lotu le mi puarthau a kom lo ih Bawipa sawn a rinsantu cu mi thlawsuak an si."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa kan Pathian, Kan hrang thil tampi na tuah zo. Nangmah bangtuk zohman an um lo. Kan hrangah mangbangza tumtah mi na nei; A zate in sim le phuan ṭheh tum sehla, ka sim cawk dah lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Raithawinak le thawhlawm pekmi pawl hi na duhmi an si lo. Biakṭheng parih ṭilva mei-ur thawinak pek khal na dilmi a si lo. Sualthlah thawinak pek khal na lungawimi a si lo. Cu ai-ah na thu theih theinak ah hna i pek ih,"},"7":{"text":"Na hnenah, “Hinah ka um. Ka hrangih na retmi na cazual sungah ka thuhla ngan in a um."},"8":{"text":"Maw ka Pathian, na duhnak thlun cu ziang tlukin so ka duh! Na thupekmi cu ka thinlung sungah ka ret,” tiah ka lo ti."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na minung pawl an pumkhawmnak hmun ah, In runnak thuthangṭha ka sim. Cuih thusim cu ka cawl dah lo ding, ti cu na thei ko."},"10":{"text":"Na runnak thuthang cu keimah hnen lawngah ka ret lo. Rintlak na sinak le in bomnak thu cu ka sim ringring a si. A hmunmi na duhdawtnak le na felnak cu, Na minung pawl an tonkhawmnak hmunah daiteón ka umpi meen lo."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka parih zaangfahnak na neihmi cu cemter hram hlah aw. Na duhdawtnak le in tlaihsannak cun in humhim ringring ding."},"12":{"text":"Harsatnak tampi in i kulh, siarcawk khal an si lo. Ka sualnak in i kai ngah, khua khal ka hmu thei lo. Ka lu parih sam hnakin an tam deuh ih ka thin a phang zo.","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacamnak (Saam 70)"},"13":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i run awla zamrang in i bawm hram aw."},"14":{"text":"Keimah thah i tumtu pawl cu Ningzak le thinlung aa in um hai seh. Harsatnak ka ton ruangih lungawitu pawl cu, Dungah kirsal hai sehla mualpho in um hai seh."},"15":{"text":"Hnihsuahsainak ih i hmangtu pawl cu, An sun ruangah ningzak in um hai seh."},"16":{"text":"Na hnenih a rami pawl cu Lungawi le thinnuam in um hai seh. Na rundamnak a sunloihtu pawl cun, “ Bawipa ih maksak zia cu!” ti ringring hai seh."},"17":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , kei cu mi rethei le mi tlasam ka si; Asinain nang cun i ruatzet. Nang cu i bawmtu le i Runtu na si; Maw Pathian, i ra bawm zaang aw."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi farah pawl zawnruattu cu mi thlawsuak an si, An harsat caan ah Bawipa in a bawm ding.","title":"Nat Caan Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in a kilkhawi ding ih a nunnak a humhim ding; Hi ram sungah hin mi lungawi a siter ding; A ral pawl ih kut sungah a taanta lo ding."},"3":{"text":"A nat tikah Bawipa in a bawm ding ih a damter sal ding."},"4":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih hnenah, “Maw Bawipa , na parah ka sual zo. I zaangfah hram awla i damter hram aw,” ka ti."},"5":{"text":"Ka ral pawl in in nahsiik ih in ṭongsanmi cu a sia ngaingai. “Ziangtikah so a thih ding ih, A hmin a hlohta ding cu?” in ti."},"6":{"text":"I ra vehtu pawl cu thinlung tak in a rami an si lo. Ka parih thusia lawnglawng an hawl ih an kir sal tikah khawzakip ah in rel."},"7":{"text":"I huatu pawl cun ka thu hlir thuthup ah an rel. Ka hrangih a sia pittawp tiangin an ruat."},"8":{"text":"Annih in, “Besiazet in a na ih, A ihkhun ihsin a tho nawn zik lo,” in ti."},"9":{"text":"Ka rualpi ṭha bik, ka rinsan bikmi le ka rawl i ṭawmtu rori in i phiarsawm zo."},"10":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i zaangfah awla i damter hram aw; Ka ral pawl ka lehrul theinak dingah."},"11":{"text":"Ka ral pawl ih in neh lo a si ahcun, Ka parah na lung a awi a si, ti ka thei ding."},"12":{"text":"A dikmi ka tuah ruangah nangmah in i bawm ding; Na hnenah kumkhua in i umter ding."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian cu thangṭhat uh. Amah cu atu le kumkhua in thangṭhat uh. Amen, Amen."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zukneng in zo tidai a ngai duahdo vekin, Maw Pathian, nangmah cu ka lo ngai a si.","title":"Harsat Caan Ih Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Maw Pathian, a nungmi Pathian, Ka nunnak in nangmah cu tidai bangin a lo haal a si. Ziangtikah so na hnen ka thlen ih, Na mithmai ka hmuh ding?"},"3":{"text":"A sun a zan in ka ṭap ih, Mitthli lawng hi ka rawl a si. Ka ral pawl in, “Khui-ah so na Pathian cu a um?” tiah cat loin in sut."},"4":{"text":"A cem ciami tikcu ka ruah sal tikah ka lung a kuai ṭheu. Mi senpi thawn Pathian inn ih kan rak feh ṭheu kha; Cutiih kan feh tikah keimah cu an hruaitu ka rak si; Lungawi aipuang in, au phah le Pathian thangṭhatnak hla sak phah in kan rak feh kha!"},"5":{"text":"Ziangah so hi tluk lawmmam in ka riah a siat? Ziangah so hi tluk lawmmam in ka thinlung a bang? Asinain ka ruahsanmi cu Pathian lawng a si. Amah cu ka thangṭhat sal ding; I Runtu le ka Pathian cu!"},"6":{"text":"Kan saltaannak hmun ah ka lung a kuai ṭheh zik thlang; Jordan ram in le Hermon le Mizar Tlang kiang ihsin Amah cu ka ciing ding."},"7":{"text":"Tipithuanthum thuk in ti thuk dang a ko; Riahsiatnak cu ka nunnak sungah tisuar bangin le tilik bangin an ra thleng. Riahsiatnak tisuar an bang."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in nitinte in in duhdawtnak langter hram seh. Zan ah a hla cu ka thinlung ah a caam. Ka nunnak Pathian hnenah thla ka cam ding."},"9":{"text":"Pathian, i ṭantu ka lungpi hnenah, “Ziangah so i hngilh zo? Ziang hrangah so ka ral pawl ih in tisiatnak cu ka tuar rero hrih ding?” tiah ka ti."},"10":{"text":"In ṭongsannak cu ka hrangah hma hnaikhuar bangin a na; Cat bang loin, “Na Pathian cu khui-ah so a um?” in ti."},"11":{"text":"Ziangah so hitluk lawmmam in ka riah a siat? Ziangah so hitluk lawmmam in ka thinlung a bang? Asinain ka ruahsanmi cu Pathian lawng a si. Amah cu ka thangṭhat sal ding. I Runtu le ka Pathian cu!"}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka thu i rel sak awla, Pathian thei lomi pawl ih hmaiah, Sual nei lo ka sinak hi i than sak aw. Mi ṭha lo le mibum thiam pawl ihsin i run aw.","title":"Saltaannak Ih Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah cu i humhimtu na si; Ziangah so i thlauthlak? Ka ral pawl ih in tisiatnak cu Ziangah so ka tuar hrih ding?"},"3":{"text":"Na tleunak le na thudik i pe hram awla, Na tlang thianghlim Zion ah le Na umnak na Biakinnpi ah i hruai kir hram hai seh."},"4":{"text":"Cuticun maw Pathian na biakṭheng ah ka feh ding; Lungawinak le aipuannak i pek ruangah maw Pathian, ka Pathian, Tingrisit tum phah in thangṭhatnak hla ka sak ding."},"5":{"text":"Ziangah so hitluk lawmmam in ka riah a siat? Ziangah so hitluk lawmmam in ka thinlung a bang? Asinain ka ruahsanmi cu Pathian lawng a si. Amah cu ka thangṭhat sal ding. I Runtu le ka Pathian cu!"}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, kan hna in kan thei zo, Kan pu le kan pa pawl in in sim zo; Khuahlan laiih thil mangbangza na tuahmi pawl cu!","title":"Humhimnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah in Pathian thei lo pawl na dawi ih, Na minung pawl hi ram luahtu ah na tuahnak cu! Miphun dang pawl cu na hrem hai naón, Na minung pawl cu mi neinung ih na tuahnak pawl cu!"},"3":{"text":"Na miphun pawl in hi ram cu an ralnam in an neh a si lo; An cahnak in an neh khal a si lo. Na vorhlam ban thacak le huham, an hnenih na um ringringnak le, Na duhdawtnak an hnenih na langternak in an neh a si."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka siangpahrang le ka Pathian na si. Na minung hnenah ral nehnak na pe."},"5":{"text":"Na huham in kan ral pawl cu kan neh; Na hmin in in dotu pawl leilung ah kan palcih."},"6":{"text":"Ka li hi ka rinsan lo; Ka ralnam khal hi i run theitu a si lo."},"7":{"text":"Kan ral pawl ih kut ihsin in hum zo ih, In huatu pawl na neh hai a si."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah cu kan lo thangṭhat ding ih, Kumkhua in kan lo cawimawi ding."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla maw Pathian, Nangmah in in hnong ih kan ral in in neh sal zo. Kan ralkap bu pawl hnenah na feh nawn lo."},"10":{"text":"Kan ral pawl hmai ihsin in tlanter zo, Kan ral in kan thilri pawl in long ṭheh zo."},"11":{"text":"Tuu vekih thah thluh dingah in siang zo; Ram dangdang ah in ṭhekdarh thluh zo a si."},"12":{"text":"Na minung pawl na zuar hai ih An man na ngenmi cu zianghman reltlak a si lo. Na zuarmi man in zianghman hlawknak na ngah fawn lo."},"13":{"text":"Kan parih na thil tuah mi hi kan kiangkap pawl in an hmuh tikah, In hmuhsuam ih in hnihsan."},"14":{"text":"Miphun tampi lakah nautat phun ah kan cang; Nautat hmuhsuamnak thawn an lu in suthnawh ciamco."},"15":{"text":"In duh lotu le ka ral pawl Hmuhsuamnak le relsiatnak ka theih ruangah,"},"16":{"text":"Ningzahnak in puan bangin i khuh ih, Mualpho in ka um ringring a si."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah cu kan lo hngilh lo ih Kanmah thawn na thukamnak tla kan balsiat lo naón, Hi bangtuk thil hi kan parah a thleng."},"18":{"text":"Kan thinlung hi a zuangzam dah lo; Kan ke khal na lamzin ihsin an pial dah lo."},"19":{"text":"Asinain zohman bawmtu nei loin ramsa lakah in taanta ih, Thihnak khawthim sungah in hlonta a si."},"20":{"text":"Kan Pathian biak kan cawl ih Ram dang khawzing hnenah thla kan cam sibang sehla,"},"21":{"text":"Nangmah in in thei thluh zo ding a si; Ziangahtile nang cu minung ih Ruahnak thup tla a thei ṭhehtu na si."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nangmah ih ruangah Sun nihlawh thah tuar rero in kan um; Thah dingmi tuu tlukih ruah mi kan si."},"23":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ṭhang thlang aw! Ziangah so na ih ringring? Tho thlang aw! Kumkhua cun in taanta hram hlah aw."},"24":{"text":"Ziangah so kan hnen ihsin na relh ringring? Kan harsatnak le kan tuarnak hi in hngilh sak hlah aw."},"25":{"text":"Lei parih palcih mi kan si; Ral in in neh ih leivut lakah in thluk."},"26":{"text":"Tho awla in bawm aw. A hmunmi in duhdawt ruangah in run hram aw."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka thinlung cu ṭongṭha le ṭongmawi in a khat, Siangpahrang hrangih hi hla ka phuah tikah hin, Ka lei cu cangan thiam pa ih cafung bangtuk a si.","title":"Siangpahrang Nupi ṭhitnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Nang cu mipa hmuahhmuah lakah a piangbik na si, Na hmurka khal a thlum bik; Pathian in a lo thlawsuah a si."},"3":{"text":"Maw siangpahrang bawipa, na taai ah na ralnam thlaih aw; Nang cu huham nei le mi sunglawi na si."},"4":{"text":"Thudik le dingnak ṭan in, Mi dang hnakin a cuang in nehnak lamzin ah feh aw. Na ban thacak in nehnak tampi a lo pe ding."},"5":{"text":"Na conkiang an hriam ngaingai; Na ral pawl ih thinhna a suntlang a si. Miphun tampi cu na ke hramah an tlu ding."},"6":{"text":"Pathian ih a lo pekmi siangpahrang tokham cu, Kumkhua in kumkhua tiang a hmun ding. Na uknak cu lal kianghrol thawn dingtein na uk a si."},"7":{"text":"A ṭhami cu na duh ih a ṭha lomi cu na hua; Curuangah Bawipa na Pathian in a lo hril zo ih, Siangpahrang dang hmuahhmuah hnakin na parah lungawinak hriak cu a burh zo a si."},"8":{"text":"Na hnipuan tla cu myrr rimhmui, aloes rimhmui le kassia rimhmui pawl hnih mi an si ih an hmui vurvo. Vuiho ih cermi siangpahrang inn ah hlathiam pawl in awnmawi thawn an lo nompi a si."},"9":{"text":"Na umnak innpi sungih a ummi nunau pawl cu Siangpahrang fanu an si. Na siangpahrang tokham ih vorhlam kap ah Ofir sui ṭha bik hlawnthil a hruktu Siangpahrang bawinu a um."},"10":{"text":"Maw siangpahrang ih fala, Ka sim mi hi i thei sak hram aw: Na minung le na sungkhat pawl hngilh ta aw."},"11":{"text":"Na mawi ruangah siangpahrang in a lo hahio ding. Na bawipa a si ih amah ih thu cu na ngai pei."},"12":{"text":"Ṭai-ar khua nunau pawl in laksawng an lo pe ding. Mi lian pawl in nangmah ih tlaihsan duh ah paisa an hmang ding."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang fanu cu siangpahrang inn sungah a um. Fala mawizet a si! A hnipuan cu sui pat ih tahmi a si."},"14":{"text":"A hnipuan a mawi zetmi sin in siangpahrang hnenah an fehpi, Amah kilkhawitu nunau pawl in an thlun ih, Annih khal cu bawipa ih hnenah an fehpi."},"15":{"text":"Lungawi aipuang in an feh ih Siangpahrang inn sungah an lut."},"16":{"text":"Maw ka siangpahrang, fapa tampi na nei ding ih, Na pu le na pa ih ai-awhtu an si ding. Cule leilung pumpi uktu ah na tuah hai ding."},"17":{"text":"Hi ka hla phuahmi in na hmin cu kumkhua in a nungter ding. Mi hmuahhmuah in nangmah cu Kumkhua in an lo thangṭhat ding."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian cu kan beunak le kan thazaang a si; Harsat caan ah cat loih in bawmtu a si.","title":"Pathian Kan Hnenah A Um"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah zianghman kan ṭih lo ding; Leilung pi a hnin ṭheh ih, Tipithuanthum thuuk sungah tlangsaang pawl an cim ṭheh ih,"},"3":{"text":"Tifinriat pawl tilet tho in a huuk ih tlang pawl an hnin an cim hman ah kan ṭih lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Pathian khawpi sungah le, Cungnungbik ih inn thianghlim sungah lungawinak a rak luanpitu tiva pakhat a um."},"5":{"text":"Cuih khawpi ah Pathian a um ih Ziangtik hmanah siatsuah a si dah lo ding. Zingthlapit ah cuih khua bawm dingin a ra ding."},"6":{"text":"Miphun pawl an tuk a sum, Uknak ram pawl an hnin ṭheh; Pathian in a aw a suah ih leilung pumpi cu a ziam ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa cu kan hnenah a um. Jakob ih Pathian cu kan beunak lungpi a si."},"8":{"text":"Ra uh; Bawipa ih a tuahmi hi zohhnik uh, Leilung tlun ih thil a siatsuah thei zia hi!"},"9":{"text":"Leilung pumpi ah ral a daihter; Li pawl a khiak ṭheh, fei pawl a sattan ṭheh ih, Ralphaw pawl mei in a ur ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Amah in, “Nan do awknak cu baang thlang uh, Keimah hi Pathian ka si kha thei uh; Miphun hmuahhmuah tlunah bawi bik ka si ih leilung pumpi tlun khal ah bawi bik ka si thotho,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa cu kan hnenah a um. Jakob ih Pathian cu kan beunak lungpi a si."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw leilung mi pawl, lungawi in nan za beng uh; Pathian cu ring zetin hla in thangṭhat uh.","title":"Uktu Cungnungbik"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa , Cungnungbik cu maktara Pathian a si. Amah cu a lian bik siangpahrang a si ih leilung pumpi uktu a si."},"3":{"text":"Amah in miphun tampi tlun ah nehnak in pe ih, Miphun tampi uktu ah in tuah."},"4":{"text":"Kan hrangah kan umnak leiram hi a hril; A duhdawt a minung pawl ih comi, Jakob ih uarmi ram sunglawi cu!"},"5":{"text":"Pathian cu a siangpahrang tokham ah a hung feh. Lungawi ih au thawm le tawtawrawt tum thawm a um, Bawipa a hung feh tikah cun."},"6":{"text":"Pathian hnenah thangṭhatnak hla sak uh. Kan siangpahrang hnenah cawimawi- nak hla sak uh."},"7":{"text":"Pathian cu leilung pumpi tlunah siangpahrang a si. Amah cu hla in thangṭhat uh."},"8":{"text":"Pathian cu a siangpahrang tokham thianghlim ah a to. Miphun hmuahhmuah a uk ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Leilung miphun uktu pawl cu Abraham Pathian ih minung pawl thawn hmunkhat ah an tongkhawm. Raldotu ih ralphaw hmuahhmuah cu Pathian ta an si ṭheh. Amah cu a hleice ih sunloihmi a si."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu a mak ngaingai ih Nasa zetih thangṭhat ding a si. Kan Pathian ih khawpi ah, A tlang thianghlim parah cun!","title":"Pathian Khawpi Zion"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ih tlang, Zion tlang cu A saang ih a mawi zet fawn. Siangpahrang khawpi cu leilung pumpuluk ih lungawinak a si."},"3":{"text":"Pathian in cuih khawpi sung, A umnak ralhruang sungah cun, Himnak a um tiah a langter zo."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang pawl hmunkhat ah an tongkhawm aw, Zion Tlang do dingah an ra."},"5":{"text":"Asinain Zion Tlang an hmuh tikah an mang a bang; An ṭih ih an tlan thluh."},"6":{"text":"Ṭihnak le phannak in an khat, Nau hring zik nunau bangin."},"7":{"text":"Pathian in Tarshish lawng tumpi Nisuahlam thlisia hmang in a siatter ṭheh hai bangin."},"8":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa kan Pathian in a khawpi sungah, thil a tuahmi pawl kan thei zo; Atu-ah kan mit in kan hmu lala. Amah in a khawpi cu kumkhua in a humhim ding."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na Biakinn sungah a hmunmi na duhdawtnak hi kan ruat ṭheu."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah cu leilung khawzakip mi in an lo cawimawi ih, Na hmin cu leilung pumpi ah a thang. Dingnak thawn ramkip na uk."},"11":{"text":"Zion ih minung pawl an lungawi ko seh. Na ṭhuthennak cu a dik a si. Judah khawpi pawl sungah lungawinak um ko seh."},"12":{"text":"Zion tlang kimvel in feh uhla zohhnik uh. Ralvennak inn donhleisang pawl cu siarhnik uh."},"13":{"text":"A phar pawl cu zoh ṭha uhla A ralhruang pawl cu hniksak uh; San thar mino pawl hnenih nan sim dingah."},"14":{"text":"“Hi Pathian cu kumkhua in kumkhua tiang kan Pathian a si. Sanikhuk amah in in hruai ding.”"}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in thei uh! Khawzakip ih a um minung pawl,","title":"Thilri Rinsan Cu Aat Hna A Si"},"2":{"text":"Upa nauta le milian farah in Ngaihnik uh."},"3":{"text":"Ka ṭongmi cu fimnak ṭongkam a si. Ka ruahnak cu sullam neimi an si."},"4":{"text":"Phungthluk thu ka ruat ding ih Tingrisit tum phah in a tican ka fianter ding."},"5":{"text":"Ka ral pawl in in kulh ih ṭihnak can hmanah, Ka thin a phang lo."},"6":{"text":"An thilri a rinsantu pawl le an lennak a porh ciamco pawl in in kulh hmanah zianghman ka ṭih lo."},"7":{"text":"Zohman in amah ih nunnak cu a tlen thei lo ding. A nunnak ih man cu Pathian a pe thei lo ding."},"8":{"text":"Ziangahtile a nunnak ih man cu a khungtuk ih, Thihnak ihsin humhimnak ngah ding le,"},"9":{"text":"Kumkhua nunnak ngah ding ih a pek theimi man hman in a daih lo ding."},"10":{"text":"Zokhal in mifim pawl an thi ih Mi aa le mi-hmuk pawl tla an thi thotho ti an hmu. An zatein an thilri cu an tefa an roh."},"11":{"text":"An thlaan cu kumkhua in an inn a si. Cutawkah kumkhua in an um; Hlan ah leiram an rak nei naón!"},"12":{"text":"Minung cu a lennak in thihnak ihsin a hum thei lo ding. Ramsa vekin an hloral ve ding."},"13":{"text":"Mah le mah a rinsan awzet pawl khi, Ziang an cang ti zohhnik uh! An lennak ih diriam pawl vanduai zia cu!"},"14":{"text":"Tuu bangin a thi ding lawng an si, Thih cu anmah khaaltu a si ding. Miding pawl cu anmah nehtu an si ding, Thihnak khua ah an ruangpi a thut ih, An inn ihsin lam hlapi ih an um tik ahcun!"},"15":{"text":"Pathian in kei cu i hum ding; Thihnak huham sung ihsin i runsuak ding."},"16":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat a len vivo tikah le, A lennak cu a karh sinsin tikah na lung sia hlah."},"17":{"text":"A thih tikah zianghman a keng thei lo ding; A lennak in thlaan ah a thlun lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat leilung tlun a nunnak ah hin lungdaihnak a ngah ih a hlawhtlin ruangih an porhzet hman ah,"},"19":{"text":"Thihnak a ton tikah cun kumkhua ih khawthimnak hmunah A pu le a pa pawl a vun thlun thotho ding."},"20":{"text":"Minung cu a sunlawinak in thihnak ihsin a hum thei lo ding. Ramsa vekin a hloral ve ko ding."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian Bawipa cu a ṭong; Nisuahnak ihsin nitlaknak tiang, leilung pumpi cu a ko.","title":"Biaknak Taktak"},"2":{"text":"Pathian cu Zion ihsin ni bangin a tlang; Mawinak famkim a neitu Zion khawpi cun!"},"3":{"text":"Kan Pathian cu a ra, a sinan daiteón a ra lo. A hmailam ah mei a alh hluahhlo ding ih, A kimvel ah nasa zetin thlipi a huuk ding."},"4":{"text":"A minung pawl thu a ṭhen tikah theihpitu ah lei le van a ko ih,"},"5":{"text":"“Thawinak pek tahratin keimah thawn thukamnak a tuahtu ka mithiang pawl cu ka hnenah rak kokhawm hai uh,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Van pawl cun Pathian cu a ding, Amah cu thuṭhentu a si, tiah an aupi."},"7":{"text":"“Maw ka minung pawl, ngai uh, ka ṭong ding. Maw Israel, fiangtein ka lo theiter ding. Keimah hi Pathian, nan Pathian ka si."},"8":{"text":"Ka hnenih nan pek ringring mi thawinak le mei-urthawinak pawl ruangah ka lo kawk hai a si lo."},"9":{"text":"Nan inn ihsin nan rak kenmi nan cawcang ka ṭul lo; Nan ṭilva rual lakih nan me pawl khal ka ṭul lo."},"10":{"text":"Ziangahtile hramlak ih ramsa hmuahhmuah ka ta an si ih, Siarcawk lo tlangpar ih ṭilva pawl khal ka ta an si."},"11":{"text":"Vate hmuahhmuah le hramlak ih a nungmi hmuahhmuah khal ka ta an si ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Ka rilrawng hman sehla nannih ka lo sim hai lo ding; Ziangahtile leilung pumpi le a sung ummi hmuahhmuah hi ka ta an si."},"13":{"text":"Cawcang sa ka ei mawsi? Me thii ka in mawsi?"},"14":{"text":"Nan lungawinak hi Pathian hnen ih nan pekmi thawinak si sawnseh. Cule pek ding tiih nan kam ciami hmuahhmuah cu Ziangkimtithei hnenah pe uh."},"15":{"text":"Harsatnak a thlen tikah keimah i ko uhla ka lo run hai ding ih, Nannih in in thangṭhat ding,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Asinain mi ṭha lo hnenah Pathian in, “Ka thupekmi cu ziangah so nan saal duh rero? Ka thukam cu ziangah so nan rel duh rero?"},"17":{"text":"Nan ziaza rem ding cu nan duh lo ih ka thupekmi pawl cu nan dungtun ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Fifir nan hmuh tikah a rualpi ah nan cang; ṭaangṭawm sualnak a tuahtu pawl thawn nan kom aw."},"19":{"text":"Ṭong ṭha lo ṭong ding ahcun nan zamrang zet. Thuphan sim ding ahcun nan ṭhukṭhun dah lo."},"20":{"text":"Nan unau pawl ih ṭhat lonak hawl le sualpuh ding ahcun tiar cia in nan um ringring."},"21":{"text":"Hi tluk thil ṭha lo nan tuah naón kei cun zianghman ka ṭong dah lo. Curuangah keimah tla hi nanmah tlukfangah in ruat. Asinain atu cu nun ka lo sim ding, Fiangtein ka lo sim hai ding."},"22":{"text":"Zianghman ah i siar lotu pawl, Hi thu hi ṭhatein ngai uh; Culole ka lo siatsuah thluh hai ding. Zohman runtu nan nei lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Ka hnenih lungawinak nan langtermi hi keimah in upat nan raithawinak a si. Ka thu a thluntu hmuahhmuah cu Ka run hrimhrim ding,” a ti."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, a hmunmi na duhdawtnak ruangah, Kei hi i zaangfah hram aw. Na zaangfahnak a tum ruangah Ka sualnak cu hnawtfai thluh hram aw.","title":"Sual Ngaidamnak Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Ka ṭhat lonak cu kholhfai thluh awla, Ka sualnak ihsin i thiangter hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Ka tuah sualmi cu ka thei ih, Ka sualnak cu ka ciing ringring."},"4":{"text":"Na parah, na par hrimhrim ah, ka sual; Na mithmuh ah thil ṭha lo ka tuah zo. Curuangah thuṭhennak i pekmi cu a dikmi a si; Mimawh ih i ret khal a dikmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Ka suahthlak in mi ṭha lo ka si, Ka nu ih pum sung ihsin misual ka si zo."},"6":{"text":"Thutak le thinlung tak cu na duhmi an si. Ka thinlung cu na fimnak in khatter aw."},"7":{"text":"Ka sualnak hi hyssop thawn fai tein i hlonsak awla mi thiangah ka cang ding. I kholh awla vur hnakin ka vaar sawn ding."},"8":{"text":"Thinnomnak le lungawinak awkam i theiter hram aw. Cutin na siatsuah ciami ka taksa cu thinnuam le hnangam in a um sal ding."},"9":{"text":"Ka sualnak zoh duh hlah awla, Ka ṭhat lonak kha i hnawtfai sak thluh aw."},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian, thinlung thiang ka sungah seemter aw. Ka sungah a thar le a dikmi lungput run ret aw."},"11":{"text":"Na umnak ihsin i dawi hram hlah awla, Na thlarau thianghlim cu ka hnen ihsin la hram hlah aw."},"12":{"text":"Na runnak ihsin a rami thinnomnak cu i pe sal awla, Ka thlarau cu na thu ngaitu siter hram aw."},"13":{"text":"Cutin misual hnenah na thupek mi cu ka zirh ding ih, Na hnenah an ra kir saal ding."},"14":{"text":"Maw Pathian, i Runtu, ka nunnak cu zuah hram awla, Na dingnak cu lungawi zetin ka aupi ding."},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka hmur run ong awla, Ka kaa in na thangṭhatnak ka phuang ding."},"16":{"text":"Thawinak pekmi cu na duhmi a si lo. Na duh sisehla ka lo pe zo ding. Mei-ur thawinak khal na lungawi mi a si lo."},"17":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka lo pekmi thawinak cu, A kekkuaimi thinlung a si. A kekkuaimi le sualsir thinlung cu na hnong lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Maw Pathian, Zion parah zaang- fahnak nei awla bawm hram aw. Jerusalem khua kulhnak pawl cu dawl sal hram aw."},"19":{"text":"Cutin thawinak pawl le mei-ur thawinak pawl parah, Na lung a awi ding ih Na biakṭheng parah cawcang pawl cu thawinakah pek an si ding."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw micak pa, ziangah so thil sual na tuahmi cu tluang na khawnpi rero? Pathian ih rintlak sinak cu kumkhua in a hmun.","title":"Pathian Thuṭhennak Le Zaangfahnak"},"2":{"text":"Nang cun midang siatsuah ding na ngaihtuah; Na lei cu lumehnak namte vekin a hriam. Cat loin thuphan na per ringring."},"3":{"text":"A ṭhami hnakin a siami na duh sawn ih, Thudik hnakin thudik lo na tlaihsan sawn a si."},"4":{"text":"Maw thuphanper pa, na ṭongkam in midang thinlung natter khi nuam na ti zet."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian in a lo siatsuah ding, kumkhua in; A lo kaihrem dingih na puanthlam ihsin a lo phih suak ding. Minung umnak ram ihsin a lo hlon ding."},"6":{"text":"Cumi cu midang pawl in an hmuh tikah an ṭih ding. An lo hnihsan ding ih,"},"7":{"text":"“Zohhnik uh, humhimnak duh ah Pathian rinsan loin amah ih lennak sawn a rinsantu, Lung hnangamnak cu ṭhat lonak in a hawltu pa hinah a um,” tiah an lo ti ding."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kei cu Pathian inn kiangih a kho mi, Olif thingkung bangtuk ka si. A hmunmi a duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in ka rinsan a si."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na thil tuah cia mi ruangah, Ka lo lawm ringring ding. Na minung pawl ih tonkhawmnak hmun ah na ṭhat zia cu ka aupi ringring ding."}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi aa pawl cun an thinlung tein, “Pathian a um lo,” an ti. Minung hi ziangtlukinso an siat? Tuksumza thil tampi an tuah! Thil ṭha tuahtu pakhatte hman an um lo.","title":"Minung Ih ṭhat Lo Zia (Saam 14)"},"2":{"text":"Minung lakah fimnak a neitu le Pathian a betu pakhat tal an um maw tiah Pathian in vancung ihsin a run zoh."},"3":{"text":"Asinain an zate in an pial ṭheh! An nunzia tiangin a borhbah ṭheh a si. Zohman thilṭha tuahtu an um lo. Pakhatte hman an um lo."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Hi mi ṭha lo pawl hi, Theihthiamnak zianghman a nei lo mi maw an si? Minung in saang an ei vekin, Ka minung pawl an ei ṭheh a si. Ka hnenah thla an cam fawn lo,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla annih cu ṭihphang in an um ding. An neih dah keel lomi ṭihphannak an nei ding. Ziangahtile Pathian in nan ral pawl ih ruh cu a ṭhekdarh thluh. An tumtahmi hmuahhmuah a cemter ṭheh, Ziangahtile annih cu a hnonmi an si."},"6":{"text":"Zion ihsin Israel hnenah runnak ra sehla ka va duh so! Pathian in a minung pawl a ṭhansoter saal tikah, Jakob ih tesinfa pawl an lung a awi ding ih, Israel mi pawl an ai a puang zet ding a si."}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na huham in i run awla, Na cahnak in i luatter hram aw.","title":"Himnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka thlacamnak ngai awla, Ka ṭongkam i theihsak hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Mi puarthau pawl keimah do dingah an ra ih, Mi zaangfah nei lo pawl keimah that dingah an ra. Pathian zianghman ih a siar lo minung pawl cu!"},"4":{"text":"Pathian cu i bawmtu a si ih Bawipa cu ka nunnak a cawmdawltu a si, ti ka thei."},"5":{"text":"Pathian in ka ral pawl cu anmah ih ṭhat lonak in hrem seh. Rinsan tlak a si ruangah ka ral pawl cu a siatsuah hai ding."},"6":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , lungawi zetin na hnenah thawinak ka pe ding. Lungawi in ka lo thangṭhat ding. Ziangahtile nang cu na ṭha."},"7":{"text":"Ka harsatnak hmuahhmuah sungin i luatter zo ih, Ka ral pawl an sun kha ka mit in ka hmu zo."}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka thlacamnak hi thei hram awla, Ka lo ngennak hi dungtun hram hlah aw.","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"I ngai awla i sawn hram aw. Ka donhar ruangah ka baang zo."},"3":{"text":"Ka ral pawl ih in hro ruangah le Mi ṭha lo pawl ih in hmuhsuam ruangah ka bei a dong. Harsatnak ka parah an thlenter. Ka parah an thin a heng ih in hua fawn."},"4":{"text":"Ṭihnak in ka thinlung cu a khat ih, Thih ṭihnak in i delh a si."},"5":{"text":"Ṭihphannak le khurhnakin i kai, Tuksum in ka ṭhia thlohthlo."},"6":{"text":"Aw, thuro bangin thla nei ningla ka va duh so! Ka zam hlo ding ih colhnak ka ngah ding naón."},"7":{"text":"Hlapi ah ka zam ding ih nelrawn ah umnak inn ka sak ding."},"8":{"text":"Thlisia ruahpi tuar lo dingah Zamrangte in beunak ka hawl ding."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka ral pawl an lung aa ter awla, An ṭong hnokhnaiter thluh aw. Ziangahtile khawpi sungah sual nak le tawh awknak lawng ka hmu."},"10":{"text":"A sun a zan in khawpi kulhnak phar par ihsin khawpi cu an vel, Khawpi cu buainak le tuahmawhnak lawngin a khat."},"11":{"text":"Hmunkip ah siatsuahnak lawng lawng a um ih, Khawsung lamzin tla cu huatsuah le bum awknak lawngin a khat."},"12":{"text":"I zawmtaitu cu ka ral si sehla Ka tuar thei paam ding. I hmuhsuamtu cu i ngaih lotu si sehla ka relhsan mai ding."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu ka ral cu nangmah ka theih mi, Ka hnaṭuanpi le ka rualpi na rak si."},"14":{"text":"Nuam zetin thu kan ruah aw ih Biakinnpi ah misenpi thawn kan feh tlang ṭheu."},"15":{"text":"Rin lopi ah thihnak cu ka ral pawl parah thleng seh; Mithi khua Sheol ah an nungcung in feh hai seh. An innsang sung le an thinlung sungah ṭhat lonak hlir khatseh."},"16":{"text":"Bomnak dil in Bawipa Pathian ka ko. Amah in i run ding."},"17":{"text":"Ka phunzainak le ka aihramnak cu a hnenah, Zing, sun le zan ah a thleng ih Ka aw cu a thei ding."},"18":{"text":"Ral tampi ka donak hmun ihsin Him damteón i kirpi ding."},"19":{"text":"Kumkhua in uktu bawi a si ringringtu Pathian in, Ka aunak a thei ding ih ka ral pawl cu a neh ding. Annih cun zianghman an tuah thei lo ding. Ziangahtile Amah ṭihzahnak zianghman an nei lo."},"20":{"text":"A hlanih ka rualpi in a rualpi pawl a do. A thukam ciami cu a balsiat ṭheh a si."},"21":{"text":"A kaa cu sahriak hnakin a naal sawn; Asinain a thinlung sungah huatnak a khat. A ṭongkam cu siti hnakin a neem sawn; Asinain ralnam vekin mi a aat."},"22":{"text":"Nan thilrit cu Bawipa hnenah ṭhum uhla, Nan tha a lo damter ding. Miding cu ziangtik hmanah a rilsawnter dah lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla maw Pathian, nang cun mi thattu pawl le Thuphanpertu pawl cu an san kauseu hlanah khur thukpi sungah na thlak hai ding. Asinain kei cun nangmah lawng ka lo rinsan a si."}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, zaangfahnak ka parah nei hram aw; Ka ral pawl in in do ih cat loin in hrem a si.","title":"Pathian Rinsan Ih Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Sun nihlawh in ka ral pawl in in do. Keimah dotu hi an tam ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Ṭihphannak ka neih tikah, Maw Ziangkimtithei Bawipa , Nangmah ka lo rinsan a si."},"4":{"text":"Pathian ka ring ih a thukamnak ka thangṭhat. Amah ka rinsan ih zianghman ka ṭih lo ding. Mihring cun ka parah ziangso an tuah thei ding?"},"5":{"text":"Ka ral pawl in sun nihlawh harsatnak in pe. Keimah tuahmawh ding lawng a phunphun in an ruat."},"6":{"text":"Keimah thah duh ah an relhnak hmunah an tongkhawm aw ih, Ka tuahmi hmuahhmuah in zoh thup ringring."},"7":{"text":"An ṭhat lonak ruangah, maw Pathian, hrem hai aw. Na thinheng in hlonhlo thluh hai aw."},"8":{"text":"Ziangtluk in ka thin a baang ti cu na thei. Ka mitthli cu na palang sungah na khum zo. Na cabu sungah na ngan zo a si lo maw?"},"9":{"text":"Nangmah ka lo kawh ni ihsin Ka ral pawl dungah an siip ding. Hi thil pakhat ka thei: Pathian cu keimah lam ah a ṭang."},"10":{"text":"Pathian cu ka rinsan ih a thukamnak ka thangṭhat. Bawipa ih thukamnak cu ka thangṭhat a si."},"11":{"text":"Amah cu ka rinsan ih zianghman ka ṭih lo ding. Mihring cun ka parah ziangso an tuah thei ding?"},"12":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka lo tiamkam ciami cu ka lo pe ding. Nangmah cawimawinak cu ka raithawinak ai-ah ka lo pe ding."},"13":{"text":"Ziangahtile thihnak ihsin i luatter ih, Rilhbahnak ihsin i hum zo a si. Curuangah Pathian nangmah ih mithmuh ah ka feh, Nunnak lamzin tleu ah."}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I zaangfah hram aw; Maw Pathian, i zaangfah hram aw; Na hnenah himnak duh ah ka ra. Ṭihphannak a cem thluh hlan lo, Na thladem thuaiah humhimnak ka ngah a si.","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ka ko, Cungnungbik cu! Ka ṭulmi hmuahhmuah i petu Pathian cu ka ko."},"3":{"text":"Van ihsin i run awi ding ih i run ding; I palcih rerotu cu ningzak koin a tuah hai ding. Pathian in a hmunmi a duhdawtnak le rintlak a sinak cu ka hnenah a langter ding."},"4":{"text":"Kiosa lakah ka it, Mi ei-tu kiosa lakah; An ha cu feipi le conkiang vek an si ih, an lei cu ralnam hriam bangtuk an si."},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na maksak zia cu vanah khin langter awla, Na sunlawinak khal leilung tlun hmuahhmuah ah langter aw."},"6":{"text":"Keimah kaih duh ah ka ral pawl in suurthang in kam. Mangbang vansaangin ka lu ka kun. Ka fehnak lamzin ah khur an lai. Asinain anmah riangri an tla."},"7":{"text":"Ka thinlung cu a hnget ko, Maw Pathian, ka thinlung cu a hnget a si. Hla ka sak ding ih ka lo thangṭhat ding."},"8":{"text":"Maw ka thlarau, ṭhang thlang aw. Ka ṭingṭang le ka lemlawi pawl, tho thlang uh. Ni khal ka ṭhang ding."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , miphun tampi lakah ka lo lawm ding! Minung tampi lakah ka lo cawimawi ding!"},"10":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu vancung a thleng; Rintlak na sinak in van a dai."},"11":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na maksak zia cu van ah khin langter awla, Na sunlawinak cu leilung pumpuluk ah langter aw."}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw uktu pawl, dik zetin thu hi nan ṭhen ngaingai maw? Mi hmuahhmuah diktein an thu nan ṭhen sak ngaingai maw?","title":"Mi ṭha Lo Hremnak Ding Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Asilo! Thil ṭha lo tuah nan tummi lawnglawng nan ruat ih, Hi ram sung thisen a luangtertu cu nanmah nan si."},"3":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu an nu ih pum sung ihsin an ṭha lo cia; An suahthlak in an pial ih thuphan an per a si."},"4":{"text":"Rul vekin tur an nei ih an tur cu thihsii a si. Thu theih duh lo ah an hna an phit."},"5":{"text":"Rul ai nei ih aw siseh, mitkher thiam ih aw siseh, A thei thei nawn lotu rulngan hnaset bangtuk an si."},"6":{"text":"Maw Pathian, an ha pawl khiak ṭheh aw; Maw Bawipa , hi ṭihnungza kiosa pawl ih ho cu thlong ṭheh aw."},"7":{"text":"A dokmi tidai bangin cem ṭheh hai sehla, Lamzin ih palbeek mi hrampi bangin vuai ṭheh hai seh."},"8":{"text":"Kharkhem a feh phah ah a hnang ih a cemral bangin si hai seh. A thi cia in a suakmi naute Khawtleu a hmuh dah lo vekin si hai seh."},"9":{"text":"Cuih thu an theih hlanah hram bur bangin tan ṭheh an si. Pathian thinhengnak in an nun lai rori ah thlisia bangin a semhlo thluh hai ding."},"10":{"text":"Miding pawl in misual pawl hremnak an tuar kha an hmuh tikah an lung a awi ding. Mi ṭha lo pawl ih thisen ah an ke an kholh ding."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah mi in, “Miding pawl in laksawng an ngah ngaingai, Leilung pumpi thuṭhentu Pathian a um ngaingai a sihi!” an ti ding."}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pathian, ka ral pawl ih kut sungin i run hram aw. Keimah i dotu pawl ihsin i hum hram aw.","title":"Himnak Hrangih Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Hi mi ṭha lo pawl kut ihsin i hum awla, Hi mi thattu pawl kut ihsin i luatter hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Zohhnik! Keimah do dingah in bawh. Zaangfah nei lo pawl cu keimah do dingah an tiar aw cia. Sualnak le mawhnak ka neih ruangah a si lo;"},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka sualnak zianghman a um lo naón, Hi bangtuk in an umnak hmun ciar ah an tiar aw cia."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Ziangkimtithei Pathian, tho awla i ra bawm aw. Israel ih Pathian, nangmahte in zoh ve hnik aw! Ṭhang awla hi pawl hi hrem hai aw. Hi mi ṭha lo mi zuarthlai pawl parah cun Zianghman zaangfahnak nei hlah aw."},"6":{"text":"Zanlam ah an ra sal, Khawpi sung sukso ah an vak ih, Uico bangin an hngirhngir phahphah."},"7":{"text":"An ṭongmi hi ngaihnik aw! An lei cu an ka sungah ralnam vek a si. Asinain annih in, “Zoso in thei ding?” an ti."},"8":{"text":"Asinain maw Bawipa , nang cun na hnihsan hai. Cubangtuk miphun cu hnihsuahsainak ah na hmang a si."},"9":{"text":"Maw i ṭantu, na thazaang a si ka rinsan; Maw Pathian, nangmah cu ka beunak lungpi na si."},"10":{"text":"I duhdawtu ka Pathian cu ka hnenah a ra ding. Ka ral pawl an sung cu amah in i hmuhter ding."},"11":{"text":"Maw Pathian, that ṭheh hlah aw, Ka minung pawl in an hngilh thluh pang ding. Na cahnak in ṭhekdarh thluh hai awla neh thluh hai aw. In humtu kan Bawipa!"},"12":{"text":"An hmur ah sualnak a um; An ṭongkam cu sual ṭongkam a si. An puarthaunak ahcun awk-aw hai seh. Mi an cam ih thuphan an per ruangah,"},"13":{"text":"Na thinheng in siatsuah hai aw; Pakhat hman zuah lo in siatsuah thluh hai aw. Cule mi hmuahhmuah in, Israel ram cu Pathian in a uk ih A uknak cu leilung khuazakip ah a thleng ṭheh, ti an thei ding."},"14":{"text":"Ka ral pawl cu zanlam ah an ra kir sal, Uico vekin hngirhngir phah in khawpi sungah an vak."},"15":{"text":"Uico rawl hawl bangin an tawi an vak ih, Ei khop an ngah lo tikah an kio an ai."},"16":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na cahnak cu hla in ka sa ding. Zingtinte a hmunmi na duhdawtnak thu cu ring zetin ka sa ding. Nang cu ka beunak lungpi na si, Ka harsat caanah ka dornak na si."},"17":{"text":"Maw i ṭantu, nangmah ka lo thangṭhat ding. Ka beunak cu Pathian a si; I duhdawtu Pathian cu."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, kannih cu in hnong zo ih in tisiat zo. Kan parah na thin a heng zo; Asinain kan lam hoikir saal hram aw.","title":"Luatnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Kan ram hmuahhmuah na hnin thluh ih na saat kuai ṭheh zo. A hma cu damter saal aw, Ziangahtile a tla kuai thluh pang ding."},"3":{"text":"Na minung pawl cu harsatnak tamzet na tuarter zo. In ritertu sabit in pe ih kan sawn kan ril."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah a lo ṭihzahtu pawl hrangah thantaar na thlai sak. An ral pawl kut sung ihsin an luat theinak dingah."},"5":{"text":"Na cahnak in in run aw. Na duhdawtmi na minung an luat theinak dingah Kan thlacamnak in let hram aw."},"6":{"text":"A hmunthiang sung ihsin Pathian in “Lungawi zetin Shekhem cu ka ṭhen ding; Sukkoth phairawn cu ka miphun hnenah ka zem ding."},"7":{"text":"Gilead ram cu ka ta a si, Manasseh khal ka ta a si. Efraim cu ka lukhuh a si; Judah cu ka bawi kianghrol a si."},"8":{"text":"Asinain Moab ram cu ka kut kholhnak kheng ah ka hmang ding; Edom ramah ka kedam ka hlon ding, Ka ta a si ti theihnak ah. Filistin ram parah neh-nak aw thawn ka au ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ralhruang kulhmi khawpi ah zoso i feh pi ding? Edom ah zoso i hruai ding?"},"10":{"text":"In thlauthla ngaingai mawsi? Kan ralkap pawl thawn na feh ve lo ding maw?"},"11":{"text":"Kan ral in do bawm aw. Ziangahtile milai bomnak cu a lak a si."},"12":{"text":"Kan hnenih Pathian a ṭan ahcun kan neh ding; Kan ral pawl a neh ding a si."}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka aunak ngai hram awla, Ka thlacamnak i theihsak hram aw.","title":"Humhimnak Hrangih Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Ka thin a pih ruangah vanhram deng ihsin nangmah ka lo ko. Keimah hnakih a saangmi himnak lungpi ah i khor hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Ziangahtile nang cu ka beunak lungpi na si; A khoh zetmi ka ṭannak ralhruang na si."},"4":{"text":"Ka nundam sung hmuahhmuah, Na puanthlam sungah i umter aw. Na thla hnuai ah himnak i coter hram aw."},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka thutiam pawl na thei zo ih, Nangmah a lo ṭihzahtu pawl ih ro cu i coter ve a si."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang ih nunkhua sauter hram aw. Kum tampi nung vivo hram seh."},"7":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na hmaika ah kum reipi uktu si hram seh. A hmunmi duhdawtnak le rintlak na sinak in hum hram aw."},"8":{"text":"Cuticun ka thutiammi nitinte kimter phah in, Na hmin thangṭhatnak cat loin hla in ka sak ding."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian amah lawng ka nunnak in daitein a hngak; Ka rundamnak cu amah hnen ihsin a ra.","title":"Pathian Humhim Rinsannak"},"2":{"text":"Amah lawng hi ka lungpi le i runtu a si. I ṭantu cu amah a si ruangah zohman in in neh lo ding."},"3":{"text":"Nannih pawl in ziangtik tiangso, Phar bang a sawn zomi le, Hauhruang vekih a tlu zik zomi, Mi pakhat cu nan do hrih ding?"},"4":{"text":"Upat a conak hmun ihsin dirh thlak lawng hi nan duhmi a si. Thuphan rel hi nuam nan ti zet. Nan hmurka cun thlawsuahnak ṭongkam a suak naón, Nan thinlung ngaingai cun nan camriam a si."},"5":{"text":"Pathian amah lawng ka nunnak in daitein a hngak; Ka ruahsannak cu a hnen lawngah a um."},"6":{"text":"Amah lawng hi ka lungpi le i runtu a si. I ṭantu amah a si ruangah zohman in in neh lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Ka rundamnak le ka sunlawinak cu Pathian hnenah a um; Amah cu a cak zetmi i humtu a si ih, Ka beunak lungpi khal a si."},"8":{"text":"Misenpi pawl, ziangtik khal ah Pathian rinsan ringring uh. Amah cu kan beunak lungpi a si, Nan harnak hmuahhmuah a hnenah sim uh."},"9":{"text":"Minung cu thawthawt khat vek fang an si; Mitum mite, zianghman an si lo. Cuai ah khai awla zianghman an si zik lo. Thaw hnakin an zaang deuh a si."},"10":{"text":"Thazaang ih mi nehnak rinsan hlah; Ruk ru in ziang khal ngah ding tumtah hlah; Cuti tuah in na len sinsin khal le cupawl cu rinsan duh hlah."},"11":{"text":"Voikhat hnakih tam Pathian ih ṭong ka thei zo: Huham hmuahhmuah cu amah ih ta a si;"},"12":{"text":"A mi duhdawtnak cu a thleng aw dah lo. Maw Bawipa , mi hmuahhmuah cu an ṭuan vekin, An ṭuanman cu nangmah in na pe a si."}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nang cu ka Pathian na si ih nangmah ka lo ngai. Ka nunnak pumpi in nangmah a lo ngai a si. Leiro, leicaar le tidai um lonak leilung in tidai a haal vekin, Ka nunnak in nangmah a lo haal a si.","title":"Pathian Ngainak"},"2":{"text":"Hmun thianghlim ah nangmah ka lo tong ih, Na cahzia le na sunlawi zia ka hmu zo."},"3":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu Nunnak hnakin a sunglawi sawn; Curuangah ka lo thangṭhat ding."},"4":{"text":"Ka nundam sung hmuahhmuah ah Na hnenih lungawi thusim ka daiter lo ding. Ka kut thlir in na hnenah thla ka cam ding."},"5":{"text":"Ka nunnak hi rawl thaw ei bangin a tlai zet a si. Nangmah thangṭhatnak hla lungawi in ka sak ding."},"6":{"text":"Ihkhun tlun ih ka zau tikah nangmah ka lo thei; Zanvar nangmah lawng ka lo ruat."},"7":{"text":"Ziangahtile nang cu i bawmtu na si ringring; Na thladem hnuai ah lungawi in hla ka sak."},"8":{"text":"Ka nunnak in nangmah a lo pawk, Na vorhlam kut in i himter."},"9":{"text":"Keimah thah i tumtu pawl cu Mithi khua ah an vung thleng ding."},"10":{"text":"Raldonak ah ralnam in an thi ding ih, An ruak cu cinghnia in an ei ding."},"11":{"text":"Pathian nangmah ruangah siangpahrang a lung a awi ding. Pathian hmin in thukamnak a tuahtu pawl an lung a awi ding. Asinain thuphan reltu pawl ih kaa cu phih an si ding."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, harsatnak ka tong; Ka thlacamnak ngai hram aw. Ṭihnungza ka ral pawl kut ihsin i run hram aw.","title":"Humhimnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih phiarthupnak in i hum awla, Misual burpi lakin i run aw."},"3":{"text":"An lei cu ralnam hriam bangin an taat ih, An ṭong siava cu conkiang bih in an bih."},"4":{"text":"Mi an bawhnak ihsin an conkiang in mi ṭha pawl an sai; Rinlopi ah an sai; Phanmi zianghman an nei lo."},"5":{"text":"Thu ṭha lo tawlrelnak ah pakhat le pakhat an forh aw. An thangkammi ṭhate ih thup ding lawng an ruat. “Zohman in hmu lo ding,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo an ngaihtuah ih, “Mi siatsuah dingah fel zetin kan tawlrel zo,” an ti. Minung ih thin le lung hi mangbangza a va si so!"},"7":{"text":"Asinain Pathian cun a conkiang in a sai hai ding ih, Rinlopi ah hma an pu ding."},"8":{"text":"An ṭongkam a siat ruangah a siatsuah hai ding, Anmah a hmutu hmuahhmuah in tuksum in an lu an thing ding."},"9":{"text":"An zate in ṭihphang in an um ding; Pathian ih thiltuahmi cu an sim ding ih, A hnaṭuanmi pawl an ruat ding."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa ih thiltuahmi ruangah Miding pawl an lung a awi ding. A hnenah himnak an tong ding. Mi ṭha pawl hmuahhmuah in amah cu an thangṭhat ding."}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, Zion ah kan lo thangṭhat ding ih, Kan thukammi cu kan kimter ding;","title":"Lungawinak Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Mi thlacam na theihsak ruangah. An sualnak a tam ruangah khuazakip in,"},"3":{"text":"Mi tampi na hnenah an ra ding. Kan sualnak in in neh ṭheu naón, Nangmah in in tlengfai sak ṭheu."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah ih na hrilmi pawl cu mi lungawi an si; Na hmun thianghlim ih na umter mi tla mi lungawi an si. Na innih thil ṭha le na Biakinn thianghlim ih thlawsuahnak in kan hna in ngamter ding."},"5":{"text":"Thil mangbang maksak tuah tahrat in in run let ih in run. Leilung khuazakip le tipi ral ih minung khal in nang an lo rinsan."},"6":{"text":"Na cahnak in tlang pawl cu na toh ih, Cuticun na huham na langter."},"7":{"text":"Tifinriat awn thawm le tisuar thawmvang pawl na daihter ih, Mi tampi ih awn-au thawm khal Nangmah in na daiter a si."},"8":{"text":"Thil maksak pawl na tuah ruangah, Leilung pumpi in an lo ṭih. Na thil tuahmi ruangah lungawi au-nak thawm cu, Leilung khatlam dengin khatlam deng tiang a khawk a si."},"9":{"text":"Leiram na duh ruangah ruah na surter, Leiram ṭha le leiram thlum-al ah na tuah. Na tuahmi tiva pawl cu an caar dah lo ih, Lei parah lo rawl an ṭoter. Cutluk fel in thil na tuah."},"10":{"text":"Leileh mi ah ruah tampi na surter ih tidai in na ciarter. Leilung cu ruahti in na nemter, Cule thlaikho pawl na ṭhanter."},"11":{"text":"Na ṭhatnak in ziangtluk rawl tam so a suahter! Na fehnak kipah ziang hmuahhmuah duhzat in a um."},"12":{"text":"Hramhring lakah cun ṭilva an khat; Tlangtluan pawl cu lungawinak in an khat."},"13":{"text":"Leenkolh hmuahhmuah cu tuurual in an khat ih, Phairawn pawl cu sangvut in a khat thluh. Lungawi in an au ih hmunkhat ah hla an sak."}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitlun mipawl, Pathian thangṭhat in lungawi in au uh.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Le Lungawinak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Amah hmin sunloihnak hla sa uh. Sunglawi zetin a hnenah cawimawinak pe uh."},"3":{"text":"Pathian hnenah, “Na thil tuahmi pawl hi mangbangza an si, Na huham a nasa tukih na ral pawl hman ṭihnak in na hmaiah an bok."},"4":{"text":"Leilung mi hmuahhmuah in na hmaiah kuun in an lo biak; Na thangṭhatnak hla an sak. Na hmin cawimawinak hla an sa,” tiah ti uh."},"5":{"text":"Pathian ih tuahmi hi ra zohhnik uh! Minung lakih a tuahmi mangbangza hi!"},"6":{"text":"Tifinriat cu leilung ro ah a canter; Kan pu kan pa pawl in tivapi cu an ke in an tan; Cutiih a tuah ruangah a parah kan lung a awi."},"7":{"text":"A cahnak in a uk kumkhua ih Miphun kip a mit in a zoh ringring. Ziangvek ral hman amah dodal in tho hlah hai seh."},"8":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah pawl, kan Pathian thangṭhat uh. Nan thangṭhatnak cu thang ṭheh seh."},"9":{"text":"Amah in in nundamter zo ih In bahter sianglo a si."},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian, in hniksak zo; Ngun cu somei ih an hniksak bangin, Kannih khal in hniksak zo a si."},"11":{"text":"Thang an kammi sungah in tlakter ih, Kan zaang parah thilrit ngaingai na suang."},"12":{"text":"Kan ral pawl ih palcih mi ah in tuah ih, Meisa le tilian lakin kan feh. Asinain atu cu himnak hmun ah in thlenpi zo."},"13":{"text":"Na inn ah mei-ur thawinak pawl ka rak keng ding; Ka lo kam ciami cu ka lo pe ding."},"14":{"text":"Harsatnak ka ton laiih ka thukammi cu ka kimter ding."},"15":{"text":"Biakṭheng parih ur dingah tuu ka lo pe ding; Mecang urnak rimthaw khal a um ding; Cawcang le mecang pawl thawinak ah ka pe ding; A meikhu cu vanah a kai ding."},"16":{"text":"Pathian a upattu pawl, ra uhla ngai uh; Ka hrangih a thil tuahmi pawl ka lo sim hai ding."},"17":{"text":"A hnenah bomnak dil in ka au. Hla in ka thangṭhat."},"18":{"text":"Ka sualnak hi zianghman poisa loin um ningla, Bawipa in ka thlacamnak a ngai lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Asinain Pathian in i thei zo; Ka thlacamnak a ngai zo a si."},"20":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak a hnong lo ih A hmunmi a duhdawtnak khal ka hnen ihsin a lakkir lo ruangah Pathian cu ka thangṭhat a si."}}},"67":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, in zaangfah awla in thlawsuah hram aw; Zaangfah thinpemnak thawn in run zoh hram aw.","title":"Lungawinak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Cuticun leilung pumpi in na duhnak an thei ding ih, Mi phunkip in nangmah ih runnak thu an thei ding."},"3":{"text":"Maw Pathian, minung in lo thangṭhat hai seh; Mi hmuahhmuah in nangmah lo thangṭhat cio hai seh."},"4":{"text":"Minung pawl dingthluk lairelnak thawn an thu na ṭhensak ih, Miphun hmuahhmuah na hruai hai ruangah lungawi in hla sa hai seh."},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, minung in lo thangṭhat hai seh; Mi hmuahhmuah in nangmah lo thangṭhat cio hai seh."},"6":{"text":"Leiram in rawl a suah zo; Pathian, kan Pathian in in thlawsuah zo a si."},"7":{"text":"Pathian in mal in sawm zo. Amah cu vanrang tangmi hmuahhmuah in upat hai seh."}}},"68":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian tho sehla a ral pawl ṭhekdarh seh; Amah a huatu pawl cu tlanhlo thluh hai seh.","title":"Ralnehnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Meikhu cu thli ih a semhlo bangin amah in a semhlo ding; Khuailul cu meisa hmai ih a zup thluh bangin, Mi ṭha lo pawl cu Pathian hmai ahcun siatral thluh hai seh."},"3":{"text":"Asinain miding pawl cu a mithmuh ah an lung a awi ding. An lung a awi ngaingai ding a si."},"4":{"text":"Pathian hnenah hla sak uh; Amah ih hmin thangṭhat uh; Mero parih a totu hrangah lamzin rak sial uh; Amah ih hmin cu Bawipa a si; A hmai ah nan lungawi uh."},"5":{"text":"Pathian, a Biakinn thianghlim sungih a umtu cun, Nu le pa nei lo farah zawn a ruatih nuhmei pawl a hum a si."},"6":{"text":"Inn nei lo lungleng vakvai pawl umnak innsang a pek ih, Thawngtla mi pawl kha lungawiza zalennak ah a hruai. Asinain raltho hmang pawl cu ramcaar lakah an taang ding."},"7":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na minung pawl na hruaisuak tikah, Nelrawn tan ih na fehpi hai tikah khan,"},"8":{"text":"Leilung a hnin durdo ih van in ruah a run burh; Sinai Pathian, Israel ih Pathian a thlen tikah cun."},"9":{"text":"Ruah tampi na surter ih, Phuul ram cu na hnawngter sal."},"10":{"text":"Na minung pawl in cutawkah umhmun an khuar; Na ṭhat ruangah mi farah pawl tla na cawm hai."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in thu a pek ih Nunau tampi in thuthang cu an fehpi ih:"},"12":{"text":"“Siangpahrang pawl le an ralkap pawl an tlanhlo a si,” an ti. Inn ih ummi nunau pawl in thilri lonmi an zem aw."},"13":{"text":"Ngun ih tuam mi thuro, An thla pawl sui bangin an tleu zohzo. (Ziangah so raldo laiah mi hrek khat tuuhruang sungih nan um men?)"},"14":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian in Zalmon Tlang parah siangpahrang pawl a ṭhekdarh thluh hai tikah Cutawkah vur a tlakter."},"15":{"text":"Maw Bashan tlang, tlangbol tampi neitu tlang lian,"},"16":{"text":"Ziangah so Pathian in amah umnak dingih a hrilmi tlang cu na tlangbol par ihsin nautatnak thawn na vun zoh? Bawipa cu a hrilmi tlang ah kumkhua in a um ding."},"17":{"text":"Rangleeng mak zetzet, siar cawk lo thawng tampi thawn, Bawipa cu Sinai tlang ihsin hmun thianghlim ah a ra."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa cu tlangzim ah a hung kai; A ral kaihmi tampi a fehpi. Ral thotu pawl hnenin laksawng tampi a ngah. Bawipa Pathian cu cunah a um ding."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat si ko seh. Amah in kan thilrit nitinte in a phur; Amah cu in runtu Pathian a si."},"20":{"text":"Kan Pathian cu mi runtu Pathian a si; Amah cu Bawipa a si ih thihnak ihsin in runsuaktu kan Bawipa a si."},"21":{"text":"Pathian in a ral pawl le, Sualnak lamzin a thlun ringring tu pawl ih lu cu a khuai thluh ding."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Nan ral pawl cu Bashan ihsin ka rak hruai ding ih, Tipithuanthum tawne ihsin ka hun suahpi hai ding."},"23":{"text":"Cuticun nan ke cu an thisen ah nan kholh ding ih, Nan uico khal in an duhzat in an liak ding,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na feh lai cu mi hmuahhmuah in an hmu; Ka Pathian le ka siangpahrang, a hmunthiang ih feh lai cu!"},"25":{"text":"Hmaisabik ah hla satu pawl an feh; Dunglam ah awnmawi tumtu pawl an feh; An karlakah khuangte tumtu fala pawl an feh."},"26":{"text":"“Pathian cu a minung pawl tonkhawmnak ah thangṭhat uh; Bawipa cu Israel tesinfa pawl hmuahhmuah in thangṭhat uh,” an ti."},"27":{"text":"Hmaisabik ah an hrin lakih fa nauta bik Benjamin mi an ra; Cumi saangtu ah Judah hotu pawl, Anmah ih ho ciar thawn an ra. Cule Zebulun le Naftali hotu pawl in an thlun."},"28":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na huham run langter aw; Kanmah hrangih na hmanmi na huham cu!"},"29":{"text":"Siangpahrang pawl in laksawng an lo peknak, Jerusalem khua na Biakinnpi ihsin run langter aw."},"30":{"text":"Phaikung lakih a ummi ramsa vek a si mi Izipt kha kawk awla, Caw note pawl thawn a tlangmi Cawcang rual vek a si mi miphun pawl cu kawk hai aw; Na hmaiah an kun ih an ngun pawl an lo pek hlanlo nun zirh hai aw. Raldo lawnglawng a duhtu pawl cu ṭhekdarh thluh aw."},"31":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin thlahmi rampalai pawl an ra ding; Ethiopia mi pawl cun Pathian hnenah ban phar in thlacam an cam ding."},"32":{"text":"Maw leilung tlun ram pawl, Pathian hnenah hla sak uh; Bawipa hnenah thangṭhatnak hla sak uh;"},"33":{"text":"Kumkhua ih a hmunmi van, Cuih van pawl a totu hnen ahcun! Amah ih aw, nasa zetih a aunak aw cu ngai uh."},"34":{"text":"Pathian ih huham thangter uh. A makmi a sunlawinak cu Israel parah a um. A cahnak cu vandum ah khin a um."},"35":{"text":"A hmunthiang sungah Pathian cu Ziangtluk maktara so a si! Israel ih Pathian cu! Amah ih minung hnenah cahnak le huham a pek. Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh."}}},"69":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian i run hram aw. Tidai ka hngawng a tiang.","title":"Bom Dilnak"},"2":{"text":"Cerhduuppi sungah ka pil, Leilung hak zianghman a um lo. Ti thukpi sungah ka um ih Tisuar in i khuh zik thlang."},"3":{"text":"Bomnak dil in ka lo kawh-nakah ka tha a cem; Ka dang tla a caar ṭheh; Nangmah ih bomnak hngak in ka zoh-nakah ka mit a kham thluh zo."},"4":{"text":"Ziangthu hman um loih i huatu pawl cu ka lu par sam hnakin an tam sawn; Thuphanper tahratih ka ral ih a cangtu pawl cu, Mi cak zetzet an si ih a thah lawnglawng in duh. Ka ruk lomi thil pawl tla khirh thluh seh, in ti."},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka sualnak pawl cu Na hmai ihsin thuh theih a si lo. Ka aatzia cu nangmah in na thei."},"6":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa Pathian Cungnungbik, Nangmah a lo rinsantu pawl cu Keimah ih ruangah ningzak in um hlah hai seh. Maw Israel ih Pathian, Nangmah a lo biatu pawl cu, Keimah ih ruangah mualphonak thleng hram hlah hai seh."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah ih ruangah hmuhsuamnak ka tong ih, Ningzahnak tam ngaipi ka tuar."},"8":{"text":"Ka unau hnenah mikhual ka bang ih ka sungkhat hnenah mi phun dang ka bang."},"9":{"text":"Na Biakinnpi ka tlaihsannak cu ka sungah meisa bangin a alh; Nangmah an lo hmuhsuamnak hmuahhmuah cu ka parah an tla ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Rawl ul tahrat in mi tangdor in ka um; Asinain keimah nautatnak ah a cang."},"11":{"text":"Riahsiatnak hnipuan hruk in ka nung; Asinain caponak ah in hmang."},"12":{"text":"Lamzin ah keimai thu an rel ih, Zuri pawl in hla ah in phuah."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kei cun, Bawipa, na hnenah thla ka cam ding; Maw Pathian, na duhnak tikcu ah i let aw; Ziangahtile na duhdawtnak cu a tum ih, Mi run dingih na thukamnak cu na kimter."},"14":{"text":"Cerhduup sungih pilnak ihsin i run hram aw; Ka ral pawl ihsin i hum awla, Ti thuk sung ihsin i suah hram aw."},"15":{"text":"Tilik cu ka parah thlengter hram hlah aw; A thukmi ih tawne ah i tlater hlah awla, Thlan thukpi sungah i pilter hram hlah aw."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i let hram aw; A hmunmi na duhdawtnak le na ṭhatnak thawn, Na lainatnak a nasat ruangah ka hnenah hoikir sal aw."},"17":{"text":"Kei na siahhlawh hnen ihsin relh hram hlah aw; Harsatnak tumpi ka tong, a tu ah i run let hram aw."},"18":{"text":"Ka hnenah ra awla i hum aw; Ka ral pawl hnen in i runsuak hram aw."},"19":{"text":"In nautat zia cu nangmah in na thei ṭheh ko; Ningzak le thangsia in in tuah zia cu na thei ih, Ka ral pawl hmuahhmuah khal nangmah in na hmu."},"20":{"text":"In nautat tuk ruangah ka thinlung a kuai; Bawmtu zohman ka nei lo. Zaangfahnak ka beisei naón khui hmanah a um lo; Hnemtu ka hawl naón khui hmanah ka tong lo."},"21":{"text":"Ka ril a rawn tikah thihsii in pek, Ka ti a haal tikah sabit thur in pek."},"22":{"text":"An rawl daarmi pawl cu an tluknak ah cang seh; An puai pawl cu an rilhnak ah cang seh."},"23":{"text":"Khua hmu thei lo dingin an mit cawtter aw. Tha nei loin thir thlohthlo hai seh."},"24":{"text":"Na thinhengnak cu an parah run burh awla, Na ai-thawhnak in run kaiseh."},"25":{"text":"An riah hmun pawl cu taan in ṭhing reprep seh, An riahbuk sungah a nungmi zohman um hlah seh."},"26":{"text":"Na vuak thlak ciami pawl an hrem hai ih, Na hliam ciami pawl ih tuarnak thu an rel fawn."},"27":{"text":"An sualnak pawl cu hminsin ṭheh awla, Na runnak sungah tel hrimhrim hlah hai seh."},"28":{"text":"An hmin pawl cu nunnak cabu sungin phiah sisehla, Na minung pawl ih cazin sungah telhcih sihlah hai seh."},"29":{"text":"Asinain kei cu zonzai le natnak tuar in ka um; Maw Pathian, i cawisaang awla i run hram aw."},"30":{"text":"Pathian cu hla in ka thangṭhat ding; Lungawinak a hnenah sim in A maksak zia cu ka tlang-aupi ding."},"31":{"text":"Cumi in Bawipa cu caw ka pekmi le, Cawcang thawinak hnakin a lung a awiter sawn ding."},"32":{"text":"Mi tlasam pawl in cumi an hmuh tikah an lung a awi ding; Pathian a biatu pawl an tha a tho ding."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa in mi tlasam pawl ih ṭulnak cu a thei; Thawng sungih a minung pawl a hngilh lo a si."},"34":{"text":"Maw lei le van, tipi le a sung ih ummi pawl, Pathian cu thangṭhat uh."},"35":{"text":"Zion cu a hum ding ih, Judah khawpi pawl cu a din sal ding. A minung pawl cutawkah an um ding ih cuih ram an luah ding."},"36":{"text":"A siahhlawh pawl ih tesinfa pawl in an co ding ih, A mah a duhdawtu pawl cutawkah an um ding."}}},"70":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, i run aw. Maw Bawipa , atu-ah i bawm aw.","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacam (Saam 40.13-17)"},"2":{"text":"Thah i duhtu pawl cu ningzak le Thinlung hnokhnai in um hai seh. Harsatnak ka ton ruangih lungawitu pawl cu, Dung ah kirsal in mualpho in um hai seh."},"3":{"text":"Hnihsuahsainak ih i hmangtu pawl cu, An sun ruangah ningzak in um hai seh."},"4":{"text":"Na hnen ih a rami pawl cu Lungawi le nunnuam in um hai seh. Na rundamnak a duhtu pawl cun, “ Bawipa ih makzia cu!” ti ringring hai seh."},"5":{"text":"Kei cu mi derdai le mi farah ka si; Maw Pathian, zamrang in ka hnenah ra hram aw. Nangmah cu i bawmtu le i runtu na si. Maw Bawipa , rei nawn hlah aw."}}},"71":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah cu ka beunak na si; Ziangtik hmanah ningzak in i umter hlah aw.","title":"Patar Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"A dingmi na si ruangah i bawm awla i hum aw. Na hna in i ngai awla i run aw."},"3":{"text":"Ka beunak lungpi si hram awla, I humtu ralhruang ṭha zet si hram aw; Nangmah cu ka lungpi le ka ralhruang na si."},"4":{"text":"Maw ka Pathian, mi ṭha lo pawl kut ihsin i hum aw; Zaangfah nei lo le mi siava pawl kut ihsi cun!"},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka beiseinak cu nangmah ah a um; Maw Bawipa , ka senlai ihsin nangmah ka lo rinsan zo."},"6":{"text":"Ka nunsung hmuahhmuah nangmah ka lo rinsan; Ka suah thlak ihsin nangmah in i hum zo; Ka lo thangṭhat ringring ding."},"7":{"text":"Mi tampi hrangah ka nunnak hi ralrinnak petu a si; Asinain nang cu a khoh zetmi ka ralhruang na si."},"8":{"text":"Sun nihlawh nangmah ka lo thangṭhat ding ih, Na sunlawinak ka than ding."},"9":{"text":"A tar-aw pat tiah i hnong hram hlah; Santlai lo a si-aw pat tiah i dungtun hram hlah."},"10":{"text":"Ka ral pawl in a thah in duh; An relkhawm ih in phiar."},"11":{"text":"Annih in, “Pathian in a dungtun zo, Dawi uhsi la kai uhsi; A humtu ding zohman an um lo,” an ti."},"12":{"text":"Maw Pathian, lam hlapi ah i um san hram hlah aw; Maw ka Pathian, zamrang in atu-ah i bawm aw."},"13":{"text":"Keimah i dotu pawl cu Ningzak in um hai sehla siatsuah ṭheh si hai seh. Tuahmawh i tumtu pawl cu Ningzak le mualpho in um hai seh."},"14":{"text":"Ka beiseinak cu na hnenah ka ret ringring ding. Nangmah cu ka lo thangṭhat sinsin ding."},"15":{"text":"Na dingnak ka rel ding, Na rundamnak sun nihlawh ka sim ding; Ka theih cawk lomi an si naón!"},"16":{"text":"Maw Cungnungbik Bawipa, na cahnak ka cawimawi ding. Na dingnak, nangmah ih dingnak lawng ka aupi ding."},"17":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka nauhak lai ihsin nangmah in i zirh zo; Atu tiang na thil tuahmi mangbangza cu ka sim a si."},"18":{"text":"Maw Pathian, a tar zo ih a ṭuak a par-aw, tiah I dungtun hram hlah aw. A ra dingmi santhar hnenih na huham le, Na cahnak ka aupi tikah ka hnen ah um hram aw."},"19":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na dingnak in van a dai; Thil mak zetzet na tuah zo; Nangmah bangtu zohman an um lo."},"20":{"text":"Harsatnak le zonzaihnak ka parah na thlenter; Asinain ka thazaang cu na kimter sal ding ih, Thlaan ihsin i runsuak ding."},"21":{"text":"A hlan hnakin i cawisaang ding Nangmah in i hneem sal ding."},"22":{"text":"Ka ṭingṭang thawn ka lo thangṭhat hrimhrim ding; Maw ka Pathian, na rintlaknak cu ka thangṭhat ding; Ka lemlawi tum phah in na hnenah hla ka sak ding; Maw nang, Israel mi ih Mi Thianghlim."},"23":{"text":"Na hrangih awnmawi ka tum phah ah lungawi in ka au ding; I run zo ruangah ka nunnak zatein hla ka sak ding."},"24":{"text":"Keimah siatsuah i tumtu pawl, Ningzak le mualpho ih an um zo ruangah, Sun nihlawh in na dingnak thu ka sim ding."}}},"72":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, dingthluk lairel- nak thawn thuṭhentu a sinak dingah nangmah in siangpahrang cu zirh aw. Na dingfelnak coter ve awla,","title":"Siangpahrang Hrang Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Cuticun na minung pawl feltein Thu a ṭhen sak thei ding ih Dingnak thawn namsuk mi pawl a uk thei ding."},"3":{"text":"Hi ram in nunnomnak co aw sehla Dingnak a sungah leeng hram seh."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang in mi farah pawl ih thu cu dikte in relseh. Mi tlasam pawl bawm sehla, Mi hmuhsuamtu pawl palcih seh."},"5":{"text":"Na minung pawl in ni a tlan sung hmuahhmuah le, Thlapi a van sung hmuahhmuah, san mureng tiang, Nangmah lo bia ringring hai seh."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu hrampi parih a surmi ruah bangtuk sisehla, Leiram parih a tla mi ruahti bangtuk si hram seh."},"7":{"text":"A nundam sung hmuahhmuah ah dingnak karhzai sehla, Thlapi a um sung hmuahhmuah ah daihnak um ringring hram seh."},"8":{"text":"A ram ukmi cu tifinriat in tifinriat tiang; Eufrates Tivapi in leilung netnak tiang a kau ding."},"9":{"text":"Nelrawn ih minung pawl a hmaiah an kun ding ih, A ral pawl cu leivut lakah an bok ding."},"10":{"text":"Spain ram siangpahrang pawl le Tikulh siangpahrang pawl in laksawng an pe ding. Arabia le Ethiopia siangpahrang pawl khal in siah an pe ding."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang hmuahhmuah in upatnak thawn, A hmai ah an kuun ding ih Miphun hmuahhmuah in an rian ding."},"12":{"text":"Amah a kotu mi farah pawl cu a run hai; Mi tlasam le thlauthlakmi pawl khal a hum hai a si."},"13":{"text":"Mi derdai le mi farah parah zaangfahnak a nei ih, An nunnak a hum hai a si."},"14":{"text":"Hmuhsuamnak le thisen luannak sungin a run; An nunnak cu a hrangah a sunglawi a si."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu a nunkhua sau hram seh. Arabia ram ih sui a hnenah pek siseh. Cat loin a hrangah thlacamnak um ringring seh; Pathian ih malsawmnak a parah um ringring seh."},"16":{"text":"Hi ram sungah thlairawl tam ngaingai um seh; Tlang pawl cu lorawl in khat seh, Lebanon ih thingrah bangin an rah tamzet seh. Khawpi pawl minung in khat sehla, Hramlak ih hrampi zat si hai seh."},"17":{"text":"A hmin cu ziangtik hmanah hngilh hlah hai seh. Ni a tlan sung hmuahhmuah a hmin thang seh. Miphun hmuahhmuah in amah cu thangṭhat hai seh; Siangpahrang thluasuah a pek ih, Cubangtuk in thluasuah ngah ve dingah midang in Pathian hnenah dil ve hai seh."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa thangṭhat uh; Israel ih Pathian cu! Amah lawng in hi bangtuk mangbangza a tuah."},"19":{"text":"A hmin sunglawi kumkhua in thangṭhat uh; A sunlawinak leilung pumpi ah khat seh. Amen! Amen!"},"20":{"text":"Jesse fapa David ih thlacam netnak a si."}}},"73":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian cu Israel mi hnenah le Thinlung thiang a neimi pawl hnenah a ṭha a si.","title":"Pathian Ih Dingnak"},"2":{"text":"Asinain kei cu ka tlu zik thlang; Ka ke pawl an naal zik thlang a si."},"3":{"text":"Ziangahtile mi hngal pawl khi ka iksiik ih, Mi ṭha lo pawl mi lian ih an can khi ka hmu thei lo."},"4":{"text":"Annih pawl cu natnak zianghman an tuar lo; An harhdam zetih an cak zet fawn."},"5":{"text":"Midang tuar zat in an tuar lo; Harsatnak khal midang tlukin an tong fawn lo."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah an hngalnak cu ṭhi bangin an orh ih, Thazaang ih mi nehnak cu angki bangin an hruk."},"7":{"text":"An thau tukah an mit a cuur liailiai; An thinlung cu aatnak in a liam hluahhlo."},"8":{"text":"Mi dang cu caponak ah an hmang ih mi siatnak thu an rel. An hngal zetih mi hmuhsuamnak thu lawng an rel."},"9":{"text":"Vancung ih Pathian an relsiat ih Leilung tlun minung hnenah hngal zetin thu an pe."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian ih minung pawl hman an lam an hoi ih, An relmi hmuahhmuah cu lungtho zetin an zum."},"11":{"text":"Annih in, “Ziangtin so Pathian in a theih thei ding? Anih Cungnungbik cun theih theinak a nei mawsi?” an ti."},"12":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu hi bangtuk an si ko; Thil tamzet an nei naón tam sinsin neih an duh."},"13":{"text":"Thianghlim zetin ka um ih ka kut khal sualnak tuah loih an um hi a lak maw a si ṭheh ding?"},"14":{"text":"Maw Pathian, sun nihlawh i tuarter zo; Zingtin in hremnak i pek."},"15":{"text":"Cubangtuk cun keimah in rak sim ningla, Na minung pawl zuarthlaitu ah ka cang zo ding."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah hi thu cu thu harzet sihmansehla, Theihthiam ding napi in ka zuam."},"17":{"text":"Cule na Biakinn sungah ka feh, Cutik lawngah mi ṭha lo parah Ziangvek thil a thleng ding, ti ka thei ngah a si."},"18":{"text":"Lamzin naalnak ah annih cu na ret ih, Siatnak sungah na tlakter hai."},"19":{"text":"Hmakhatteah hlohralnak an tong; An cem netnak cu rapthlakza a si."},"20":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , annih cu Zinglam ih a hlo ṭhehmi mang vek an si; Na ṭhang tikah ziang an bang ti hman na ciing nawn lo."},"21":{"text":"Ka lung a sia ih Ka thin a natzet tikah,"},"22":{"text":"Mi aa ka bang ih zianghman ka ruat thei lo; Na hnenah ramsa bangin ka nung."},"23":{"text":"Asinain cat loin na hnenah ka um ih ka kut in i kai."},"24":{"text":"Na remruahnak in i hruai ih, A netnak ahcun upat hmin thannak thawn nangmah in i pom ding."},"25":{"text":"Vancung ah nangmah siar lo ziangso ka neih? Nangmah ka lo neih hnu ahcun Leilung tlunah ziangso ka hai?"},"26":{"text":"Ka thinlung le ka taksa hi ṭumsuk deuhdeuh hmansehla, Pathian cu ka cahnak a si. Amah lawng hi kumkhua ih ka covo a si."},"27":{"text":"Nangmah a lo dungtuntu pawl cu an thi tengteng ding; Nangmah ah mizuangzam pawl cu Nangmah in na siatsuah ṭheh ding."},"28":{"text":"Asinain Pathian kiangih ka um hi ziangtlukinso a ṭhat! A thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah sim le rel dingah, Bawipa Pathian cu ka beunak ah ka tuah zo."}}},"74":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ziang ruangah so kannih hi in dungtun? Na tuu pawl kan parah hin kum khua in maw na thin a heng ding?","title":"Luatnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Na ta si dingah hlanlaipi ih na rak hrilmi, Na minung pawl hi hngilh hlah aw. Nangmah ih ro na miphun si ding ih na tlenmi pawl cu! Na umnak Zion Tlang cu ciing ringring hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Ra awla hi siatsuah thluhmi parah hin ra fehhnik aw; Kan ral pawl in Biakinn sung thilri an siatsuah ṭheh a si."},"4":{"text":"Na minung pawl na ton ṭheunak na Biakinnpi ah, Na ral pawl an au ciamco, Cutawkah nehnak thantaar an tar."},"5":{"text":"Anmah tla cu thing hautu pawl an bang, Hreitlung ih thing hautu pawl bangin."},"6":{"text":"An hreitlung le an nam in zanthing ih tuahmi, sangka le a dangdang an mawiter mi pawl cu, An ceek ih an khuai ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Na Biakinnpi cu an bal ih meisa in an ur; Nangmah kan lo biaknak hmun thianghlim an borhhlawhter. Ziang hmuahhmuah an siatbal ṭheh a si."},"8":{"text":"Kan ci hmih ṭheh in tum. Kan ram sungih hmunthiang hmuahhmuah cu, Meisa in an ur ṭheh a si."},"9":{"text":"Hminsinnak thianghlim kan neih mi pawl cu an cem; Profet pakhat hman an um nawn lo; Hi vek in ziangtik tiang a si ding ti cu, Zohman ih theih lomi a si."},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ziangtik tiangso kan ral pawl in, Caponak ah an lo hman ding? Na hmin cu kumkhua in maw an relsiat ding?"},"11":{"text":"Ziangah so in bom duh lo? Ziangah so na kut dunglet na sih?"},"12":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa , a hramthok ihsin nangmah cu, Kan siangpahrang na si zo; Leilung tlun ah runnak a thlen tertu nangmah na si."},"13":{"text":"Na thacak in tifinriat cu na ṭhen; Tifinriat ih rulhreng tum zetzet ih lu pawl cu na deen kuai."},"14":{"text":"Leviathan timi rulpi lu pawl na rial dip ih, A sa cu nelrawn ramsa pawl ei dingah na pek."},"15":{"text":"Nangmah in cerhti le tikhur pawl na luanter ih, Tivapi khal na caarter."},"16":{"text":"Nangmah in sun le zan na tuah, Ni le thlapi tla an umnak ciar ah na ret."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah in leilung ih ramri cu na tuah ih, ṭhal caan le khawsik caan khal na tuah a si."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla maw Bawipa, na ral pawl in, Caponak ih an lo hman cu hngilh hlah aw; Pathian thei lo pawl in na hmin an hmuhsuam a si."},"19":{"text":"Zianghman tithei lo na minung pawl cu, Zaangfah nei lo an ral pawl kut sungah hnong hram hlah aw. Hremnak tuartu na minung pawl hi thei ringring aw."},"20":{"text":"Kanmah thawn thukamnak na tuah mi kha thei ringring aw; Hi ram khawthimnak kil kip ah, Nunsiatnak le dodalnak a um."},"21":{"text":"Hmuhsuamnak le hremnak tuartu pawl cu, Ningzak in umter hai hlah aw. Asinain mi farah le mi tlasam pawl in, Nangmah lo thangṭhat hai seh."},"22":{"text":"Maw Pathian, tho awla na thuhla cu dinpi aw; Pathian thei lotu pawl in sun nihlawh caponak ih an lo hman cu ciing ringring aw."},"23":{"text":"Na ral pawl thinheng ih an aunak le, A lo dodaltu pawl cat loih thawm vang an neih cu hngilh hlah aw."}}},"75":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na hnenah lungawi thu kan sim; Nangmah hnenah lungawi thu kan sim a si. Na maksak zia cu kan tlang aupi, Mangbangza na tuahmi pawl thu kan sim.","title":"Thuṭhen Tu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"Pathian in, “Thuṭhennak ni ka tin zo ih, Cuih ni ah diktein thu ka ṭhen ding."},"3":{"text":"Leilung le a parih a nungmi hmuahhmuah an sawn ṭheh hmanah, Leilung hramṭohnak pawl cu ka hngetter ding."},"4":{"text":"Mi hngal pawl porh-aw rero nawn lo dingin ka sim; Mi ṭha lo pawl puarthau lo dingin ka fial."},"5":{"text":"An porh awknak baang dingah le An hngalnak cawl thlang dingah ka sim hai,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Thuṭhennak cu nisuahnak le nitlaknak in siseh, Saklam le thlanglam khal in siseh a ra lo."},"7":{"text":"Mi thu a ṭhentu Pathian in Mihrek cu a hnong ih Mihrek cu a thlah."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in a kut sungah khuathai a keng; Cuih khuathai cu a thinhengnak sabitti cang in a khat. A thletih mi ṭha lo hmuahhmuah in an in; Neta bik a taangmi forkhat tiangin an in a si."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jakob ih Pathian thu le hla, sim le rel cu ka baang dah lo ding. A hnenih thangṭhatnak hlasak khal ka cawl lo ding."},"10":{"text":"Amah in mi ṭha lo pawl ih ki cu a khiak ding; Asinain miṭha pawl ih ki cu a sauter sinsin ding."}}},"76":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah ram ah Pathian cu zokhal in an thei ṭheh; Israel ram ahcun a hmin an upat.","title":"Nehtu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem ah inn a nei ih Zion Tlang ah amah a um."},"3":{"text":"Cutawkah a ral ih conkiang pawl, Ralphaw le ralnam pawl a khiak; Asi, an hriamnam hmuahhmuah a khiak ṭheh a si."},"4":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na sunlawi zia hi! Na ral pawl na nehnak tlang ihsin na rakir ih, Na sunlawi zia cu!"},"5":{"text":"An ralkap ralṭha zetzet ih thilri pawl, Lon ṭheh an si tikah cun An itthat ih thihnak ah an it lanta! An hriamnam hmangtu ding pakhat hman an um nawn lo."},"6":{"text":"Maw Jakob ih Pathian, annih cu na hro hai tikah, An rang le a totu pawl cu an ril ih an thi."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ṭih na nun zia hi! Na thin a heng tikah, Zoso na hmaiah a ding ngam ding!"},"8":{"text":"Na thuṭhennak cu vancung ihsin na run theihter. Leilung cu a ṭih tukah caang lotein a um."},"9":{"text":"Leilung tlunih hmuhsuam hremnak a tuartu pawl, Run dingah le thuṭhennak than dingih na din tik ahcun."},"10":{"text":"Minung thinhengnak a um tikah Nangmah thangṭhatnak a tam sinsin. Raldonak ihsin a luattu pawl in Na puai pawl an run tuah ṭheu ding."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian hnenah nan tiamkam ciami cu pe uh. Kiangkap ih ram pawl nannih khal in a hnenah laksawng pe uh. Pathian in minung pawl cu amah ṭih dingin a tuah."},"12":{"text":"Siangpahrang fapa hngal zetzet pawl cu mual a photer hai ih, Siangpahrang tum zetzet pawl khal ṭihphang in a umter hai."}}},"77":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian hnenah napi in ka au; Napi in ka au ih amah in i thei.","title":"Harsat Caan Ih Hnangamnak"},"2":{"text":"Harsat caanah Bawipa ih hnenah thla ka cam; Thlacam in zanvar ka ban ka phar, Asinain hnemnak ka ngah lo."},"3":{"text":"Pathian ka ruat ih thinlung har in ka hui ih ka aihram; Thuk deuh in thu ka ruat ih ka thin a nau sinsin."},"4":{"text":"Pathian in zanvarte itthat loin i tuah; Ka thinlung a har tuk ih ka ṭong thei lo."},"5":{"text":"A cem ciami ni le thla ka vun ruat; A lan ciami kum pawl ka vun mang sal."},"6":{"text":"A phunphun khawruat in zan ka var. Ka ngaihtuah vivo ih ka thinlung in thu ka suut aw:"},"7":{"text":"“ Bawipa in in hnong kumkhua ding maw? Kan parah a lung a awi dah nawn lo ding maw?"},"8":{"text":"In duhdawtnak cu a cemta rori ding maw? A thukamnak hi ziangtik hmanah kim ti a nei lo ding maw?"},"9":{"text":"Pathian in zaangfahnak a nei nawn lo maw si? A lainatnak cu a thinhengnak in a airawl zo maw si?"},"10":{"text":"Ziang dang hnakin ka thin i nattertu bik cu: Pathian in thil ti theinak Zianghman a neih nawn lo hi a si,” tiah ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thil tuahmi, Mangbangza pawl ka ciing ring ring ding; A cem ciami caan ih khawruahhar na tuahmi pawl kha, Ka vun mang sal ding a si."},"12":{"text":"Na hnaṭuan ciami hmuahhmuah ka ruat sal pei; Na tuahmi a zatein ka ngaihtuah sal pei."},"13":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah hi, An thianghlim a si; Nangmah bangtuk a tummi Pathian zohman a um lo."},"14":{"text":"Nang cu mangbangza tuahtu Pathian na si; Miphun tampi hnenah na cahnak na langter."},"15":{"text":"Na huham in na minung pawl cu na hum; Jakob le Josef ih tefa pawl cu."},"16":{"text":"Maw Pathian, tidai pawl in an lo hmuh tikah an lo ṭih; Tipithuanthum tla cu a tawdeng tiangin a khur ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Khawdur in ruahti a run burh; Van ihsin khua a ri durdo ih, Nimthla cu khuazakip ah a kau zukzo."},"18":{"text":"Na khawri cun cat thiam loin khuazakip a tlir ih, Na nimthlakau in leilung pumpi a tlet; Leilung pumpi cu a khur ih a hnin hlurhlo."},"19":{"text":"Nang cu tifinriat na tan ih na feh; A thuk zetmi tipithuanthum khal na tan thei. Asinain na keneh pawl cu hmuh an theih lo."},"20":{"text":"Na minung pawl cu tuukhal bangin na hruai; Moses le Aaron cu a hotu an si."}}},"78":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw ka minung pawl, ka lo zirh mi thu hi ngai uhla, Ka thusimmi hi nan hna tun hnik uh.","title":"Pathian Le A Minung Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Nan hnenah thu ka sim ding; A cem ciami kum le san ih, Thuthuk ka lo sim ding."},"3":{"text":"Kan hna ih theih ciami le Kan thinlung khalih theih ciami, Kan pupa pawl ih in sim ciami thu pawl cu."},"4":{"text":"Cuih thu cu kan faate pawl hnen ihsin kan thup lo ding ih, Bawipa ih huham le cahnak mangbangza pawl, Thil mangbangza a tuahmi pawl cu A ra lai dingmi san khal ah kan sim ding."},"5":{"text":"Israel mi pawl hnenah daan a pek ih, Jakob ih tefa pawl hnenah thukham a pek. An faale pawl hnenih zirh dingah Kan pu le kan pa pawl hnenah daan a pek a si."},"6":{"text":"An faale pawl in anmah ih faale hnenah an zirh ih, Cuih faale pawl in anmah ih faale hnenih zirhsin vivo ding ah a pek a si."},"7":{"text":"Cuticun annih khal in Pathian an rinsan ding ih, A thil mangbangza tuahmi kha hngilh loin an um ding ih, A thukham pawl cu an thlun ringring ding a si."},"8":{"text":"Annih pawl cu an pu le an pa, Mi lungruh le dodal hmang pawl, Pathian an rinsannak ziangtik hmanih a hnget dah lo pawl le, Pathian rintlak ih a um dah lo pawl bangtuk cu an si lo pei."},"9":{"text":"Li le conkiang thawn raldotu Efraim mi pawl cu, Raldo tikcu a thlen ngaingai cun an tlanhlo ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Pathian thawn an thukammi an thlun lo; A daan an thlun fawn lo a si."},"11":{"text":"Mangbangza tuahmi thil pawl le An hnenih thil khawruahhar a langter mi pawl cu, an hngilh zo a si."},"12":{"text":"Izipt ram sung, Zoan nelrawn, Pathian ih mangbangza tuahmi cu an pupa pawl in an hmu."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in tifinriat a ṭhen ih cutawkin a hruai hai.
