Tidai pawl cu phar bangin a dinter."},"14":{"text":"Sun ah khawdur thawn a hruai ih Zan ah meitleu thawn a hruai hai a si."},"15":{"text":"Nelrawn ramṭhing ih lungto tumpipi a khuai ih an in dingah, Leilung thuk zetih tidai cu a putter."},"16":{"text":"Lungto ihsin tidai a putter ih Tidai cu tiva bangin a luanter."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian parah an sual thotho ih, Cungnungbik Bawipa dodal in, Nelrawn ramṭhing ahcun ral an tho ṭhiamṭhiam."},"18":{"text":"Pathian cu an hniksak hrim, An hiarmi rawl an dil hrim."},"19":{"text":"Pathian an soi ih, “Nelrawn ahhin Pathian in Cabuai thawn rawl in pe thei ngai pei maw?"},"20":{"text":"Lungto cu a vuak ih tidai a puut zurzo ngai; Asinain saang in pe thei ngai pei maw? Ei dingah sa in pe ngai pei maw?” tiah an sut lai hrih."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa cu an parah a ai a thok ih, Cutiih a parah zumnak an neih lo ruangah le, In runsuak thei ding ti ih an rinsan lo ruangah,"},"22":{"text":"Meisa hmang in a hrem hai ih A minung pawl parah a thin a heng deuhdeuh."},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla tlunlam van hnenah thu a sim ih, A sangka pawl ong dingah thu a pek."},"24":{"text":"Van ihsin rawl a pek hai ih An ei dingah manna a run thlak."},"25":{"text":"Cuticun vancungmi pawl ih rawl kha an ei ih, An ei thei zat in Pathian in a pek hai a si."},"26":{"text":"Cuih hnuah nisuahnak lam thli a hrangter; Thlanglam thli a huham in a thoter ih,"},"27":{"text":"An hnenah vate cu leidip zat in a run thlak; Tifinriat kap ih vunnel zat in a run thlak an si."},"28":{"text":"An riahhmun laifang, an puanthlam kiangkap ahcun, A tortor in an tla hnenhnen."},"29":{"text":"Cuticun an duhzat an ei ih an lung a kim, Pathian in an duhmi hmuahhmuah a pek a si."},"30":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an ei rero laiah, Diriam ko ih an ei ngah hlanah,"},"31":{"text":"Pathian cu an parah a thin a heng ih, Anmah lakih mi cak bik pawl, Israel mi lakih mino ṭha bik pawl a that hai."},"32":{"text":"Hi bangtuk mangbangza tampi tuah hmansehla, A minung pawl cu an sual thotho. An Pathian cu an rinsan cuang lo."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah an damsung ni cu thaw bangin a tawiter ih, An nunnak cu rinlopi ah siatsuah nak a tong a si."},"34":{"text":"Cutin mi hrekkhat pawl a thihter hnuah, A dang pawl cu amah hnenah an kir sal. An sual an siir-aw ih thinlung taktein a hnenah thla an cam."},"35":{"text":"Pathian cu anmah humtu a si kha an thei sal ih, Cungnungbik cu an runtu a si kha an ciing sal."},"36":{"text":"Asinain an hmurka in an porh an bum ih, An ṭongmi hmuahhmuah cu thuphan hlir a si. Thungai zianghman a um lo."},"37":{"text":"Amah tlaihsannak zianghman an nei lo. Amah thawn an thukammi cu an kimter cuang lo."},"38":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian cu a minung pawl hnenah, Zaangfahnak lainatnak a nei ih an sualnak cu a ngaidam. Curuangah a siatsuah thluh hai lo. Voi tampi thinheng loin a suup, A aithoknak cu a daiter thei sal a si."},"39":{"text":"A minung pawl cu mihring lawng an si ih, Thli vekin a hrangih a hlosalmi lawng an si, ti kha a ciing ringring."},"40":{"text":"Voi ziangzat mengso thlaler ramṭhing ah, Pathian dodal in ral an thawh! Voi ziangzatso a riah an siatter!"},"41":{"text":"Atu le atu Pathian cu an hnik sak ih, Israel ih Pathian Thianghlim cu a thin an hengter."},"42":{"text":"A huham a tumzia cu an hngilh! An ral pawl kut sung ihsin A hum hainak tikcu kha an thei nawn lo!"},"43":{"text":"Izipt ramsung, Zoan nelrawn ih Mangbangza le khawruah har a tuahmi pawl an ciing nawn lo."},"44":{"text":"An tiva pawl cu thisen ah a canter ṭheh, Cuticun Izipt mi pawl cu an tiva ihsin tidai an ngah thei nawn lo."},"45":{"text":"An lakah thothe a thlah ih a hrem hai; Butlak khal a thlah ih an lo pawl a siatsuah ṭheh."},"46":{"text":"Kharbok a thlah ih an rawl pawl an ei ṭheh; Cuih kharbok cun an lo pawl an tisiat ṭheh."},"47":{"text":"An sabit hri pawl cu rial in a thah ih, An theipi kung pawl cu vur in a thihter ṭheh."},"48":{"text":"An caw pawl rial in a thah ih An tuu pawl cu ṭeek in a thah ṭheh."},"49":{"text":"A nasa zetmi a thinhennak le A lingsa zetmi a ai-thawhnak cu An parah a run burh ciamco. Awloksong le vansaanglam in a tuah hai ih, Mi siatsuahtu vancungmi an hnenah a vun thlah."},"50":{"text":"A thinheng khal a suup lo; An nunnak khal a zuah lo. Pulhnat in a thihter hai a si."},"51":{"text":"Izipt mi innsung saang hmuahhmuah ih, Fapa upa bik a thah ṭheh a si."},"52":{"text":"Cule tuukhal bangin a minung pawl cu a hruaisuak ih, Nelrawn ramṭhing ah a khor hai. Nelrawn tan in a hruai a si."},"53":{"text":"Thlangamten a hruai ih ziang hman an ṭih lo; An ral pawl sawn cu tifinriat in a khuh ṭheh hai a si."},"54":{"text":"A minung cu a ram thianghlim ah a fehpi; Amah ih a nehmi tlang parah cun a hruai hai a si."},"55":{"text":"A minung pawl hmaiih an nor deuhdeuh tikah, Cuih ram a rak umtu pawl cu a dawihlo; Ram cu Israel miphun pawl hnenah a zem ih, An khua le an inn ciarah a umter hai a si."},"56":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Ziangkimtithei Pathian cu an hniksak ih, Amah do dingah ral an tho; A thukham pawl an thlun lo."},"57":{"text":"An pu le an pa pawl vekin ral tho duh pawl le, Mi dodal duh pawl an si; A ngawimi li ihsin saimi conkiang vekin rintlak lomi pawl an si."},"58":{"text":"An khawzing biaknak hmun pawl an tuah ruangah, Pathian a thin an hengter. An milem pawl ruangah thiik an neihter a si."},"59":{"text":"Cumi pawl a hmuh tikah Pathian cu a ai a thok ngaingai ih, A minung pawl cu a dungtun hai a si."},"60":{"text":"Minung hnenih a rung um ṭheunak a inn, Shiloh ih a puanthlam cu a suahsan."},"61":{"text":"A huham le a sunlawinak pawl a langnak Thukam Kuang cu ral pawl a longter."},"62":{"text":"Amah ih minung parah a thin a heng ih, An ral pawl a thahter hai."},"63":{"text":"Raldonak ah tlangval hmuahhmuah an thi ṭheh ih, Fala pawl hrangah pasal ding an um nawn lo."},"64":{"text":"Puithiam pawl khal ralnam in an thi ih, An nupi pawl khal in an ṭah lo."},"65":{"text":"Neta bik ah Bawipa cu, Ihnak ihsin hung ṭhang vek khin a tho; Micak zet pa cu sabitti ih a tha a thawhter vekin a tho a si."},"66":{"text":"A ral pawl cu an dunglam ah a nor vivo; An ningzak koin a neh hai ih an tho thei nawn lo."},"67":{"text":"Asinain Josef ih tefa pawl cu a hnongta; Efraim phun pawl khal a hril nawn lo."},"68":{"text":"An ai ah Judah phun le A duh zetmi Zion Tlang a hril."},"69":{"text":"Cutawkah vancungih a umnak inn bangin a Biakinn a thianghlimmi cu a sak. Leilungpi bangtuk ih san khat hnu san khat fek dingah a sak ih a hngetter a si."},"70":{"text":"Amah in a siahhlawh David a hril; Tuu a khalhnak ihsin le"},"71":{"text":"Tuu note a kilkhawinak ihsin a ko. Israel siangpahrang ah a tuah, Pathian ih minung pawl khaaltu dingah."},"72":{"text":"Thinlung zate pek in a kilkhawi ih, Felnak le thiamnak thawn a hruai hai a si."}}},"79":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nangmah a lo thei lotu pawl in na ram an ra siim. Na Biakinnpi thianghlim an borhhlawhter ih Jerusalem an siatsuah ṭheh a si.","title":"Miphun Luatnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Na minung pawl ih ruak cu langta ei dingah an taanta; Na siahhlawh pawl ih ruak khal ramsa ei dingah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Na minung pawl ih thisen cu tidai bangin an suahter; Jerusalem khuasung hmunkip ah thisen cu tidai bangin a luang. Ruak pawl phumtu dingah zohman an taang lo."},"4":{"text":"Kan kiangkapih miphun dangdang pawl in caponak ah in hmang; In hnihsan ih in nautat a si."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , kan parah ziangtik tiangso na thin a heng ding? Kumkhua in maw? Na thinhengnak hi meisa bangin maw a alh ringring ding?"},"6":{"text":"Nangmah a lo bia lotu miphun pawl le na hmin a ko lotu pawl parah cun na thin khal heng ko aw!"},"7":{"text":"Ziangahtile na minung pawl an that zo ih, Kan ram khal an siatsuah zo a si."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kannih cu kan pupa pawl ih sualnak ruangah cun in hrem hram hlah aw. Zaangfahnak kan parah nei zaang hram aw. Ziangahtile ruahsannak zianghman kan nei nawn lo."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, in bawm awla in run aw. Na hmin sunlawinak dingah, Kan sualnak in ngaithiam awla in tlen hram aw."},"10":{"text":"Ziangah so miphun dangdang in, “Nan Pathian khui-ah so a um?” tiah in suut ringring ding? Na siahhlawh pawl ih thisen an suah ruangah hi miphun dangdang pawl kan mithmuh ah hrem hai aw."},"11":{"text":"Thawngtla pawl ih hruumnak aw cu ngai hram awla, Thah dingih thuṭhen ciami pawl Na cahnak huham in luatter hram hai aw."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thangsiatnak na hnen an hun thlenter ruangah, Hi miphun dangdang pawl parah A letsarih in phu la hram aw."},"13":{"text":"Cuticun kannih na minung, na tuu rual pawl hin, Kumkhua in na hnenah lungawinak thu kan rel ding ih, San khat hnu san khat in kan lo thangṭhat ringring ding."}}},"80":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Israel Tuukhal, in ngai hnik aw. Maw tuurual hotu bangin Josef a hruaitu, in thei hnik aw. Cherubim tlun, siangpahrang tokham ih a totu,","title":"Israel Tundinsalnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Ni bangin rung tlang awla, Efraim, Benjamin le Manasseh hrin pawl hnenah rung lang aw. Na cahnak in hmuh awla in ra run hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Maw Pathian, in tungding sal hram aw; Na zaangfahnak mithmai in hmuh awla runnak kan ngah ding a si."},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Ziangkimtithei Pathian, ziangtik tiangso na minung pawl ih thlacamnak parah na thin a heng hrih ding?"},"5":{"text":"Kan ei dingah riahsiatnak in pek ih, Kan in dingah mitthli, khuathai tumpi khat, in pek."},"6":{"text":"Kan kiangkap miphun dangdang Nangmah ih lungkimnak thawn kan ram sungah an do aw. Cule kan ral pawl in caponak ah in hmang."},"7":{"text":"Maw Ziangkimtithei Pathian, in tungding sal hram aw; Na zaangfahnak mithmai in hmuh awla runnak kan ngah ding a si."},"8":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin sabit hri pakhat na keng ih, Miphun dangdang na dawi hnuah An ram sungah cuih sabit hri cu na phun."},"9":{"text":"A ṭhannak dingah hmun na simsial sak; A hram pawl cu leilung sung thukpi ah an lut; A ṭhang ih ram pumpi a khuh ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Tlang pawl cu a hneem thuaiah an um; Hnge tampi a neimi sidar thing tumpipi bangin!"},"11":{"text":"A hnge cu Mediterranean Tifinriat le Zufrates Tivapi thleng tiang a zaam a si."},"12":{"text":"A kimvel ih kulh mi hauhruang cu ziangah so na bal ṭheh? A kiangih a fehtu poh in a rah an fir thei a si."},"13":{"text":"Ngalcang in a palsiat ṭheh ih, Hramlak ramsa pawl in an ei a si."},"14":{"text":"Maw Ziangkimtithei Pathian, Kanmah lam hoikir sal aw. Vancung ihsin in run zoh awla Na sabit hri cu rung veh hram aw."},"15":{"text":"Ra awla nangmah rori ih na phun mi, sabit cakzetih na tuah zomi, Na sabit cerh hi ra run hram aw."},"16":{"text":"Kan ral pawl in cuih sabit cu Meisa in an ur ih an saattan. A saattantu pawl cu na thinheng in zoh awla siatsuah hai aw."},"17":{"text":"Na hrilmi na minung cu hum aw; Na hrangah cakzetih na tuah zomi minung cu!"},"18":{"text":"Na hnen ihsin kan pial nawn hrimhrim lo ding; In nungter awla kan lo cawimawi ding a si."},"19":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Ziangkimtithei Pathian, in tungding saal hram aw. Na mithmai ṭha kan parah run tlangter awla, Runnak kan ngah ding a si."}}},"81":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"In ṭantu kan Pathian hnenah lungawi in au uh; Jakob ih Pathian hnenah thangṭhatnak hla sak uh.","title":"Puai Tuahnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Hla sak uhla khuang tla tum uh. Ṭingṭang le tingrisit thawn hlamawi sak uh."},"3":{"text":"Thla a deet tikah siseh, thla a thulh tikah siseh, Puai tuahnak tawtawrawt tum uh."},"4":{"text":"Hihi Israel ram sung daan a si; Jakob Pathian ih thupekmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Izipt ram a do laiah khan Israel mi pawl hnenih a pekmi thukham a si. Ka theih dah lomi aw ka thei ih,"},"6":{"text":"“Nan zaang parih thilrit cu ka lo sawng ih, Nan hnaṭuannak bawm cu ka lo ṭhumter a si."},"7":{"text":"Harsatnak nan ton tikah in ko ih ka lo run, Ka relhnak thlipi sung ihsin ka lo awi. Meribah tipuut ah ka lo hniksak hai a si."},"8":{"text":"Ka milai pawl, ralrinnak ka lo pekmi hi ngaihnik uh. Maw Israel, ka thu hi ngai uhla ka va duh so!"},"9":{"text":"Ramdang khawzing nan rian hrimhrim lo pei. Keimah siar lo pathian dang nan bia lo pei."},"10":{"text":"Keimah hi Bawipa , nan Pathian cu ka si. Izipt ram in a lo suahtu ka si. Nan kaa ang uhla rawl ka lo fah hai ding."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka minung pawl in ka thu an ngai lo. Israel in ka thu an thlun lo."},"12":{"text":"An thulungkhen neih vekin ka fehter hai. An duhmi poh ka tuahter hai a si."},"13":{"text":"Ka minung pawl in ka thu ngai hai sehla ka va duh so! Ka thu thlun hai sehla ka va duh so!"},"14":{"text":"An ral pawl zamrang zetin ka neh ding ih, Anmah dotu pawl cu ka hrem ciamco hai ding naón!"},"15":{"text":"I huatu pawl cu ṭihnak thawn ka hmaiah an lu an kuun ding; Anmah ka hremnak cu a peh-aw tluan ding a si."},"16":{"text":"sangvut ṭha bik in ka lo cawm hai ding ih, Lung lak khuaitizu in ka lo khopkhamter hai ding,” a ti."}}},"82":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vancung ah pathian pawl tonkhawmnak a um ih Pathian in hotu a ṭuan; Cuih tonkhawmnak ahcun Pathian in thuṭhennak a tuah.","title":"Cungsin Uktu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"“A dik loih thuṭhennak nan baang thlang pei. Mi ṭha lo pawl nan ṭan cuang nawn lo pei."},"3":{"text":"Mi tlasam le ngakṭah farah pawl nan bawm pei ih, Bawmtu nei lo le mi zonzai pawl parah dingthluk lairelnak thawn thu nan ṭhen pei."},"4":{"text":"Mi farah le mi tlasam pawl nan hum pei ih, Mi ṭha lo pawl kut sung ihsin nan run pei."},"5":{"text":"Zianghman nan va thei lo lawmmam so! Nan va aa lawmmam so! Khawthim sungah nan um ih, Dingthluk lairelnak cu lei tlun ihsin a hloral zo."},"6":{"text":"‘Nanmah tla cu pathian nan si,’ tiah ka lo sim zo. Nan zatein Cungnungbik ih fapa nan si."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla milai vekin nan thi ve ding. Zovek siangpahrang fapa a si hmanah a nunnak a cem ṭheu vekin, Nannih khal nan cem ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ra awla leilung hi thu ra ṭhen aw. Miphun hmuahhmuah hi nangmah ih ta an si."}}},"83":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ṭong lo in um hlah aw; Daite in um hlah, maw Pathian; Dai zirziar in um hlah aw.","title":"Ral Nehnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Zohhnik, na ral pawl an tho ciamco; A lo huatu pawl ral an tho a si."},"3":{"text":"Na minung pawl a thupte in a phiar an tum; Na hummi pawl an dodal tum a si."},"4":{"text":"“Ra uh, an miphun in an ci hmit uhsi, Israel cu a kumkhua in, Hngilh lantami miphun ah cang seh,” an ti."},"5":{"text":"An khawkhanmi ah an lung a rual aw; Nangmah dodal duh ah an ṭang tlang a si."},"6":{"text":"Edom mi, Ishmael mi, Moab mi le Hagar mi pawl,"},"7":{"text":"Gebal mi, Ammon mi, Amalek mi, Filistin mi le ṭai-ar mi pawl,"},"8":{"text":"Assiria mi le a cak zetmi Lot ih tefa, Ammon mi le Moab mi pawl tla an tel a si."},"9":{"text":"Midian mi parih na tuah vekin, Kishon Tiva ah Sisera le Jabin parih na tuah vekin, Annih par khal ah tuah ve aw."},"10":{"text":"Endor ah na neh hai ih An ruak cu leilung parih a thut thluh vek khan!"},"11":{"text":"Oreb le Zeeb parih na ti vekin An uktu bawi par khal ah tuah ve aw. Zebaj le Zelmunna na neh vekin An hotu pawl cu neh ve aw."},"12":{"text":"Annih cun, “Pathian ta a si mi ram cu, Kanmaió ram ah kan cangter ding,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Maw Pathian, leivut vekin ṭhekdarh thluh hai aw; Fanghii thli ih a sem hlo thluh vekin."},"14":{"text":"Meisa in tupi a kaang ih Meihliau in tlang pawl a ur ṭheh vekin."},"15":{"text":"Anmah cu na thlisia in dawihlo awla, ṭihnungmi na thlipi in an thin phanter aw."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na hmin an theihnak dingah, An mithmai cu ningzahnak in khatter aw."},"17":{"text":"Ral ih neh ringringmi si hai sehla, Kumkhua in an thinphang seh. Mualpho neekneek in thi hai seh."},"18":{"text":"Leilung pumpi uktu Bawipa cu Nangmah lawng na si ti hi thei hai seh."}}},"84":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Ziangkimtithei Pathian, na Biakinnpi cu ziangtluk in so ka duh!","title":"Pathian Ih Inn An Ngai"},"2":{"text":"A sung thlen cu ziangtluk in so ka hiar! Bawipa ih Biakinn sung thlen cu ka ngaizet a si. Ka thinlung zatein a nungmi Pathian hnenah lungawi in hla ka sa."},"3":{"text":"Sunṭam hman in bu an sak ih Vanva khal in inn an nei. Na biakṭheng kiangah cun an fano an ret. Maw Ziangkimtithei Bawipa , Ka siangpahrang le ka Pathian."},"4":{"text":"Na Biakinn thiang sungih a ummi Na hnenih thangṭhatnak cat lo ih a satu pawl cu, Mi lungawi an va si so!"},"5":{"text":"Na hnen ihsin thazaang a latu Zion Tlang lamih thinlung a retu pawl cu, Mi thlawsuak an va si so."},"6":{"text":"A caarmi Baka horkuam sung an feh hmanah, Tidai puutnak hmunah a cang; ṭoruah in tikhur pawl cu a khahter theh a si."},"7":{"text":"An feh phah in an cak deuhdeuh; Annih cun pathian lakih Pathian bik cu Zion ah an hmu ding."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa Pathian, Ziangkimtithei, ka thlacamnak ngai hram aw; Maw Jakob ih Pathian, ka aunak i theihsak hram aw."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, kan siangpahrang i humtu hi thlawsuahnak pe aw, Na hril ciami siangpahrang cu."},"10":{"text":"Na Biakinnpi sungih ni khat um cu, Hmundang ih ni thawng khat um hnakin a ṭha sawn. Ka Pathian ih inn sangka kil cu Mi ṭha lo pawl inn sungih um hnakin ka duh sawn."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa cu in humtu le a sunglawimi siangpahrang a si. Zaangfahnak le sunlawinak thawn in thlawsuah a si. Thil dik a tuahtu hnenah cun Thil ṭha pek dingah zianghman a ui lo."},"12":{"text":"Nangmah a lo rinsantu cu, Maw Ziangkimtithei Pathian, mi thlawsuak an si."}}},"85":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na ram parah zaangfahnak na nei zo; Israel cu neinung zetin na umter sal a si.","title":"Miphun ṭhatnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Na minung pawl ih mawhnak na ngaidam ih, An sualnak hmuahhmuah cu na thlahsak a si."},"3":{"text":"An parih na thinhengnak cu na rehter ih, Na ai-thawhnak cu na daiter zo."},"4":{"text":"Maw Pathian in runtu, in tungding sal awla, Kan parah lungawi loin um nawn hlah aw."},"5":{"text":"Kumkhua in maw kan parah na thin a heng ding? Na ai-thawhnak cu a reh nawn lo ding maw?"},"6":{"text":"Kan thazaang cakter sal awla Na minung pawl hin kan lo thangṭhat ding."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , a hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu in hmuh awla, Na rundamnak le bomnak cu in pe aw."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian ih simmi cu ka ngai; Kannih a minung pawl hnenah hnangamnak in tiam a si; Kan aatnak lamzin ih kan kir sal lo a si ahcun!"},"9":{"text":"A sunlawinak kan ramih a um theinak dingah, A rundamnak cu amah a upattu pawl hnenah a pe ding."},"10":{"text":"A hmunmi duhdawtnak le rintlaknak an tong aw ding; Dingfelnak le daihnak an hnam aw ding."},"11":{"text":"Minung ih rintlaknak cu leilung ihsin van a thleng ding; Pathian ih dingfelnak cun vancung ihsin in run zoh ding."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in neinungzet ah in tuah ding ih, Kan ram in rawl tampi a suah ding."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah dingfelnak cu a feh ding ih, A hrangah lamzin a rak sial ding."}}},"86":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka lam hoi awla i run sawn aw, Ziangahtile mi derdai le bawmtu nei lo ka si.","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Thihnak ihsin i hum aw, Ziangahtile nangmah a lo tlaihsantu ka si. I run aw, ziangahtile na siahhlawh ka si ih, Nangmah a lo rinsantu ka si."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah cu ka Pathian na si ruangah ka parah zaangfahnak nei hram aw. Sun nihlawh na hnen thla ka cam."},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, na siahhlawh hi a nunnuamter aw, Ziangahtile ka thlacamnak cu na hnenah a hung thleng."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nang cu na ṭha ih mi na ngaithiam; Na hnenih thla a camtu pawl hrangah cun a hmunmi duhdawtnak in na khat a si."},"6":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka thlacamnak ngai aw; Zaangfah dil ih ka aunak thei hram aw."},"7":{"text":"Harsatnak ka ton tikah nangmah ka lo ko; Ziangahtile ka aunak na thei ṭheu a si."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah a lo bangtu pathian dang an um lo. Na tuah theimi tuah theitu zohman an um lo."},"9":{"text":"Na seemsuahmi miphun pawl hmuahhmuah in na hnenah an ra ding ih an lu an kuun ding. Na hmin an thangṭhat ding;"},"10":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pathian nangmah lawng a cak zetmi na si ih, Nangmah lawng mangbangza tuahtu na si."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , tuahter i duhmi cu i zirh awla, Rintlak zetin na thu ka thlun ding. Thinlung takte ih a lo riantu si dingah nangmah in i zirh hram aw."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa ka Pathian, ka thinlung zatein ka lo thangṭhat ding. Na maksak zia hi kumkhua in ka tlang-aupi ding."},"13":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak hi Ka hrangih a tumzia cu! A thukmi Sheol ihsin i runsuak zo a si."},"14":{"text":"Maw Pathian, mi puarthau pawl keimah ral dingin an ra; Mi zaangfah nei lo pawl in a thah in tum a si. Nangmah zianghman ih a lo siar lotu pawl cu!"},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nang cu mi zaangfahtu le mi duhdawtu Pathian na si; Mi thinsau na si ih thinpemnak na nei ringring; Rintlak Pathian na si."},"16":{"text":"Ka lam hoikir awla i zaangfah hram aw; Ka tha cakter awla i run hram aw. Ziangahtile i hringtu ka nu ih a lo ren vekin, Nangmah ka lo rian a si."},"17":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na ṭhatzia cu langter hram aw; Hnemnak le bomnak i pekmi an hmuh tikah i huatu pawl cu an ning a zak ding."}}},"87":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in tlang thianghlim parah a khawpi a din.","title":"Jerusalem Lomnak"},"2":{"text":"Israel ram hmun dang hmuahhmuah hnakin Jerusalem khawpi cu a duh bik a si."},"3":{"text":"Maw Pathian khawpi, ngaihnik! A lo lom zia hi!"},"4":{"text":"“Keimaió thu a ngaitu ram pawl hmin ka khum tikah, Izipt le Babilon ram ka telh cih ding; Filistin, ṭai-ar le Ethiopia mi pawl cu Jerusalem sungah an tel, ka ti ding,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Zion cu mi hmuahhmuah seemnak hmun a si ih, Cungnungbik in a cakter ding, tiah an ti ding."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in mi hmuahhmuah cazin a tuah ding ih, Jerusalem khawsungmi ah a ret thluh hai ding a si."},"7":{"text":"Cutawk ummi cu hla an sak ih an laam: “Nangmah cu kan dawhhna na si,” an ti."}}},"88":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa Pathian, i runtu, sun nihlawh ka lo ko; Zan ah na hmai ah ka ra.","title":"Bom Dilnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak ngai awla, Bomnak dil ih ka aunak hi i theihsak hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Harsatnak tam tuk in i tlun ih Sheol ka thleng zik thlang."},"4":{"text":"Mithi zik dang vek thotho ka si; Ka tha a poih ṭheh zo."},"5":{"text":"Mithi lakih taanta mi ka si. An thah ih thlaan ih an retmi, Na hngilh fai zomi le bom ding khal ih na ruah ban nawn lomi vek ka si."},"6":{"text":"Thlaan tawdeng bikah nangmah in i hlon zo; A thim bik le a thuk bik khur sungah i thlak a si."},"7":{"text":"Ka parih na thinhengnak cu a rit ngaingai; Na ai-thawhnak tisuar in i delh tuk a si."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah ih forhfialnak thawngin, Ka rualpi pawl in in hrial, I theitu pawl in in fih a si. Kharhkhummi ka si ih ka suak thei nawn lo."},"9":{"text":"Zonzai ka tuar tuknak ah ka mit a mal; Maw Bawipa , nitinte ka lo ko ih ban phar in na hnen ah thla ka cam."},"10":{"text":"Mithi hrangah mangbangza na tuah dah maw? Mithi pawl tho saal in an lo thangṭhat dah maw?"},"11":{"text":"A thleng aw dah lomi na duhdawtnak thu cu, thlaan sungah an rel dah maw? Na rintlaknak cu hlohralnak Abaddon hmunah an sim dah maw?"},"12":{"text":"Mangbangza na tuahmi cu khaw- thimnak hmun ah an hmu maw? Na ṭhatnak cu hngilhnak ram ah an thei maw?"},"13":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , bomnak dil in ka lo ko; Zingtinte na hnenah thla ka cam."},"14":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ziangah so i hnon? Ziangah so ka hnen ihsin na relh?"},"15":{"text":"Ka no lai ihsin thi zik in ka tuar ringring; I hrem ruangah ka vuai ṭheh zo."},"16":{"text":"Mei bangin a alhmi na thin- hengnak cu ka parah a hlio; Na ṭihnungza thil in i siatsuah ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Sun nihlawh tisuar bangin in kulh; Ka kimvel in in naih cuahco."},"18":{"text":"I duhtu le ka rualpi ṭha bik khal na tlanter thluh hai ih Ka rualpi neihsun cu khawthim lawng hi a si."}}},"89":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , a hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu hla in ka sak ringring ding. Rintlak na sinak cu kumkhua in ka than ding.","title":"Harsat Caan Ih Hla"},"2":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a fek ding ih, Rintlak na sinak cu van vekin a hmun ding, ti ka thei."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah in, “Ka hrilmi pa thawn thukamnak ka tuah zo; Ka siahhlawh David hnenah thu ka tiam zo;"},"4":{"text":"‘Na tefa pawl in cat loin siangpahrang an ṭuan ding; Na uknak cu kumkhua in ka hngetter ding,’ ka ti,” tiah na sim."},"5":{"text":"Van pawl khin mangbangza na tuahmi cu an thangṭhat; Bawipa , rintlak na sinak cu, Vancung ih na mi thianghlim pawl in hla in an sak."},"6":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , vancung ah nangmah bangtuk an um lo. A lo bangtu pathian an um lo."},"7":{"text":"Mi thianghlim pawl tonkhawmnak ah nangmah cu an lo upat ih, Na kiangkapih ummi pawl in an lo ṭih a si."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa Pathian, Ziangkimtithei, nangmah vekih a cakmi zohman an um lo. Maw Bawipa , ziangtinkim ah nang cu rintlak na si."},"9":{"text":"Huham a neizetmi tifinriat cu na uk ih, A cak zetmi tisuar cu na daiter."},"10":{"text":"Ramsa ṭihnungza Rahab cu na sutbeek ih na that; Na ral pawl cu na cahnak in na ṭhekdarh ṭheh a si."},"11":{"text":"Leilung hi na ta a si; Van khal khi a si thotho. Leilung pumpi hi na seemsuah ih a sungih ummi khal na tuah."},"12":{"text":"Thlanglam le saklam khal nangmah ih seemsuah mi an si. Tabor Tlang le Hermon Tlang cu Lungawi in na hnenah hla an sa."},"13":{"text":"Huham na neih zia hi! Na thazaang a cah zia cu!"},"14":{"text":"Na tokham cu dingfelnak le dingthluk lairelnak parah na toh; A hmunmi duhdawtnak le rintlak na sinak in ziang hmuahhmuah na tuah."},"15":{"text":"Hla thawn a lo biatu pawl cu mi lungawi an si; Na mithmai ṭha tleunak sungih a tlanglengtu pawl cu, Bawipa , Mi thlawsuak an si."},"16":{"text":"Ziangahtile nangmah ih ruangah sun nihlawh an nun a nuam; Na ṭhatnak ruangah nangmah cu an lo thangṭhat."},"17":{"text":"Ral nehnak nasa zetzet in pek; In zaangfah ih nehtu ah in tuah."},"18":{"text":"Ziangahtile in humtu cu, Bawipa nangmah ih hrilmi a si. Nang, Israel mi ih Mi Thianghlim in siangpahrang in pek."},"19":{"text":"Hlanlaipi ah na langnak in, Na siahhlawh pawl hnenah thu na rak phuang ih, “Ralkap hminthang zet parah, Siangpahrang lukhuh ka ret zo; A miphun sung ihsin hrilmi pa ih hnenah, Siangpahrang tokham ka pe zo.","title":"David Hnenih Pathian Thukam"},"20":{"text":"Ka siahhlawh David cu ka hril zo ih, Nan siangpahrang ah hriak thianghlim ka culh zo."},"21":{"text":"Ka cahnak cu a hnenah a um ringring ding ih, Ka huham in mi cakzet a siter ding."},"22":{"text":"A ral pawl in an fimhleih lo ding ih, Mi ṭha lo pawl khal in an ti ngam lo ding."},"23":{"text":"A ral pawl cu ka ciil ding ih, A huatu pawl cu ka that ding."},"24":{"text":"Amah cu a hmunmi duhdawtnak thawn ka duh ding ih, Ka tlaihsan ringring ding. Ral neh ringringtu ah ka tuah ding."},"25":{"text":"A ukmi ram cu Mediterranean Tifinriat in Eufrates Tivapi tiang ka kauter ding."},"26":{"text":"Anih in, ‘Nang cu ka pa le ka Pathian na si; Ka lungpi le i rundamtu na si,’ i ti ding."},"27":{"text":"Amah cu ka fapatir ah ka tuah ding ih, Siangpahrang lakih siangpahrang tum bikah ka tuah ding."},"28":{"text":"A hnenih ka thukammi cu ka kimter ding ih, Amah thawn thukam ka tuahmi cu, kumkhua in a hmun ding."},"29":{"text":"A tefa in siangpahrang an ṭuan ringring ding ih, A uknak cu van vekin a hmun ding."},"30":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a tefa pawl in ka daan an thlun lo ih, Thukham ka pekmi vekin an nung lo a si ahcun,"},"31":{"text":"Ka thupekmi pawl zianghman ah an siar lo ih, Ka thukham pawl an thlun lo a si ahcun,"},"32":{"text":"Anmah ih sualnak ruangah nuang fung thawn ka hrem hai ding. Anmah ih mawhnak ruangah ka vuak hai ding a si."},"33":{"text":"Sikhalsehla David cu ka duhdawt ringring ding ih, A hnenih ka thukammi tla ka kimter ringring ding."},"34":{"text":"Amah thawn ka thukam cu ka bal lo ding ih, A hnenih ka tiam ciami thukamnak pakhatte hman ka la kir lo ding."},"35":{"text":"Kumkhua daih in a hnenah ka hmin thianghlim in thukamnak ka tuah zo. David hnenah thuphan ka sim lo ding."},"36":{"text":"Cat loin tesinfa a nei ding ih, Ni a tlan sung hmuahhmuah ah A ram uknak cu ṭhatein ka zoh ding."},"37":{"text":"Van ih a ummi thu theihpitu Thlapi vekin kumkhua in a hmun ding a si,” na rak ti."},"38":{"text":"Asinain na hrilmi siangpahrang parah na thin a heng; Amah cu na tlansan zo ih na hnong zo a si.","title":"David Ralsun ṭahhla"},"39":{"text":"Na siahhlawh amah thawn thukam na tuahmi na siatbal thluh zo. A siangpahrang lukhuh cu leivut lakah na hlon sak."},"40":{"text":"A khawpi kulhnak phar pawl cu na balcim ṭheh ih, A ralhruang pawl cu na siatsuah thluh a si."},"41":{"text":"A feh sukso pawl in a thilri an ruk sak ih, A inn hnen pawl in caponak ah an hmang."},"42":{"text":"Ralnehnak cu a ral pawl hnenah na pek ih, An lung na awiter ṭheh a si."},"43":{"text":"A hriamnam pawl cu santlai lo na canter ih, Raldonak ah na sunter."},"44":{"text":"A siangpahrang kianghrol cu na long saal ih, A siangpahrang tokham cu leilung ah na tuul thluk."},"45":{"text":"Tar a cu lo naón na tarter ih, Ningzah mualphonak in na khahter."},"46":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , kumkhua in maw na relh ringring ding? Ziangtik tiangso na thinhengnak cu meisa bangin a alh ding?","title":"Luatnak Hrang Thlacam"},"47":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , milai nunnak a tawizia hi hngilh hlah aw; Mi hmuahhmuah a thi ding ih na tuah hi ciing hram aw."},"48":{"text":"Thi lo ih a nung ringringtu zoso a um? Sheol thleng lo ih a luat theitu zoso a um?"},"49":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , in duhdawt zia a hlan ih na langtermi pawl kha khui-ah so an si? David hnenih na tiam ciami Na thukamnak pawl kha atu khui-ah so an um?"},"50":{"text":"Kei na siahhlawh hmuhsuam ka si zia hi hngilh hram hlah aw. Khawvel pawl ih nautatnak ka tuar zia hi!"},"51":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na ral pawl in na hril cia mi Siangpahrang cu an va hmuhsuam lawmmam so! A fehnak kip ah an hmuhsuam a si."},"52":{"text":"Bawipa cu kumkhua in thangṭhat uhsi! Amen! Amen!"}}},"90":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nang cu kumkhua in kan inn na si.","title":"Pathian Le Minung"},"2":{"text":"Tlang pawl na tuah hlanah le, Leilung pumpi na seemsuah hlan ihsin nang cu thawhnak le cemnak nei loin, A kumkhua in Pathian na si ringring."},"3":{"text":"Minung cu leilungih kir sal dingin thu na pek ih, Leilung ah na canter a si."},"4":{"text":"Kum thawng khat cu na hmaiah ni khat bangtuk a si; A cem ciami manisun vek a si ih Zan ih tikcu tawite sung vek a si ko."},"5":{"text":"Tilian vekin minung cu na fen hlo hai; Mang hnakin rei deuh an awh cuang lo."},"6":{"text":"Zinglam ih a khomi hrampi, a ṭhang ih a par; Asinain a vuai ih zanlam ah a thimi bangtuk an si."},"7":{"text":"Na thinhengnak in in siatsuah ṭheh; Na ai-thawhnak in in ti hloral ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Kan sualnak pawl cu na mithmuh ah na ret; A thupte ih kan sualnak khal na hmu ṭheh a si."},"9":{"text":"Kan nundam ni cu na thinhengnak in a tawiter; Kan nunnak cu dimte ih ṭongmi aw vekin a cem."},"10":{"text":"Kan nundam kum cu kum sawm sarih sung a si; Kan dam cak asile kum sawmriat khal a si thei. Asinain hi kan nunsung kum ih in summi cu, Harsatnak le donharnak lawng a si. Nunnak cu rei lo ah a cem ih kan hlota."},"11":{"text":"Na thinhennak a cahzia hi zoso a thei thei? Na ai-thawhnak ih a thlentermi ṭihnak cu zoso a hmu cawk ding?"},"12":{"text":"Kan nun tawizia siar daan in zirh awla, Cule mifim ah kan cang ding."},"13":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ziangtik tiangso na thin a heng ding? Na siahhlawh pawl hi in zaangfah hram aw."},"14":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak thawn zingtinte in khatter aw; Cuticun kan nundam sung nunnuam le hlasa in kan um ding."},"15":{"text":"Harsat zonzaihnak kan tuar kum sung hmuahhmuah ahhin, Riahsiatnak in pek zat tal in Lungawinak in pe ve hram aw."},"16":{"text":"Kannih na siahhlawh pawl hi na thil tuahmi a nasa zet pawl in hmuh aw; Kan tefa pawl khal na thacahnak sunglawi cu hmuhter ve hai aw."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian, na mithmai ṭha kan hnenah um hram seh; Kan tuahmi hmuahhmuah ah hlawh tlinnak in pe aw. Asi, kan tuahmi hmuahhmuah ah hlawhtlinnak in pe hram aw."}}},"91":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cungnungbik hnenah himnak duh ah feh tahratin, Ziangkimtithei thladem thuai ih a umtu cun,","title":"In Humtu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah, “Nang cu ka beunak le ka ralhruang na si; Ka Pathian na si ih ka lo rinsan a si,” a ti thei ding."},"3":{"text":"A lang lomi ṭihphannak ihsin a lo hum ding ih, Natsia a phunphun sungin a lo luatter ding."},"4":{"text":"A thla in a lo hup ding ih, A lo kilkhawinak sungah na him ding; Rintlak a sinak cu na ral phawpi le phawte an si."},"5":{"text":"Zan ih ṭihphan ding tla na phang lo ding ih, Sun ih conkiang khal na ṭih lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Khawthim lakih a vakmi pulhnat, Sun khawvang ih mi thah hmang siatsuahtu khal na ṭih lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Na siir ah thawng khat an tlu ding ih, Na kiangkap ah thawng hra an ril ding, Sikhalsehla nang cu tuahmawh na si lo ding."},"8":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl hremnak an tuarzia cu, Na zoh ding ih na hmu ding."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa cu a lo ṭantu ah na tuah ih, Cungnungbik cu a lo humtu ih na hman ruangah,"},"10":{"text":"Siatsuahnak zianghman na tong lo ding; Na inn kiangah thisen luannak a thleng lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Na fehnak hmunkip ih a lo humtu dingah le, A lo kilvengtu dingah Pathian in A vancungmi pawl a ret ding."},"12":{"text":"An kut in an lo cawi ding ih Na ke cu lungto ah na khawng lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Kiosa le rul na pal ding; A heer zetmi kiosa le tur nei rul pawl cu na pal ding a si."},"14":{"text":"Pathian in, “Keimah i duhtu pawl cu ka run ding ih, Bawipa ka si hi i theitu pawl cu ka hum ding."},"15":{"text":"In kawh tikah ka awi hai ding; Harsatnak an ton tikah an hnenah ka um ding; Ka luatter ding ih hmin ṭhatnak ka pe hai ding."},"16":{"text":"Nun saunak laksawng ka pe ding ih, Ka runsuak tengteng hai ding,” a ti."}}},"92":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih lungawi thu rel le, Cungnungbik Pathian, na hmin thannak hla ih sak cu a va nuam so!","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu zingtinte phuang in, Rintlak na sinak cu zantinte phuang sehla,"},"3":{"text":"Hri a nei ih tum theihmi awnmawi: ṭingṭang le tingrisit pawl thawn, Rintlak na sinak zantinte thanter cu a va nuam so!"},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thil tuahmi mangbangza in ka lung i awiter. Na tuahmi ruangah lungawi in hla ka sak."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thil tuahmi hi a va mak so! Na ruahnak cu a va thuk lawmmam so!"},"6":{"text":"Mi aa pawl ih theih thei ding a si lo; Mi hmuk pawl ih ruah ban ding khal a si lo."},"7":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu hrampi bangin an kho ding; Thilsual tuahtu pawl cu an ṭhangso zet ding. Asinain annih cu siatsuah ṭheh an si ding."},"8":{"text":"Ziangahtile Bawipa nang cu kumkhua in na Cungnungbik a si."},"9":{"text":"Na ral pawl an thi ding ti kan thei; Mi ṭha lo pawl cu an sung ding ih ṭhekdarh ṭheh an si ding."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah in sele bangin i cakter; Nunnomnak thawn i thluasuah zo a si."},"11":{"text":"Ka ral pawl an sun kha ka hmu, Mi ṭha lo pawl an aihram ka thei zo."},"12":{"text":"Mifel pawl cu tum kung bangin an ṭhang hluarhlo ding; Lebanon ih sidar thing bangin an ṭhang ding."},"13":{"text":"Anmah cu Bawipa ih inn sung phunmi thingkung bangtuk an si. Kan Pathian Biakinn sungah an ṭhang ih,"},"14":{"text":"An tar hnu khalah rah an rah; A kumkhua in an hring ih an khohzet a si."},"15":{"text":"Himi in Bawipa cu miding a si, ti a langter. Amah cu ka lungpi a si ih A sungah dingfel lonak zianghman a um lo."}}},"93":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si. Sunlawinak huham in a thuam aw ih thazaang cahnak in a khat. Leilungpi cu a umnak ah na ret zo ih ṭhawn theih a si nawn lo.","title":"Pathian Cu Siangpahrang A Si"},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na siangpahrang tokham cu, A hramthok ihsin a rak hnget zo. Caan a um hlanah nang cu na rak um zo."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , tipithuanthum a thukmi pawl in an aw an suah. An aw an suah ih a huuk in an huuk."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu vancung ah uktu bawi bik a si. Tipithuanthum ih huuk aw hnakin a nasa sawn ih, Tifinriat ih tisuar hnakin a cak sawn."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na daan pawl cu kumkhua in an hnget ih, Kumkhua in kumkhua tiang na Biakinn cu a thianghlim a si."}}},"94":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nang cu phuba latu Pathian na si; Na thinhengnak langter aw.","title":"Thuṭhentu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"Nang cu mi hmuahhmuah thuṭhentu na si; Tho awla mi puarthau pawl an sual man pe hai aw."},"3":{"text":"Ziangtik tiangso mi ṭha lo pawl hi an lung a awi ding? Maw Bawipa , ziangtik tiangso?"},"4":{"text":"Thilsual tuahtu hi ziangtik tiangso hngal zet le Puarthau zetin an sualnak hi an aupi hrih ding?"},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na minung pawl an palcih hai; Na ta a si mi pawl an hrem hai."},"6":{"text":"Nuhmei le ngakṭah farah pawl an that ih, Kan ram sungih a ummi mikhual pawl an phil."},"7":{"text":"Annih in, “ Bawipa cun in hmu lo paam; Israel ih Pathian cun in hliah leem lo,” an ti."},"8":{"text":"Maw ka minung pawl, ziangtinso hiti lawmmam ih thinlung mal le mi aa nan si? Ziangtikah so nan beng a var ding?"},"9":{"text":"Kan hna a tuahtu Pathian cun, Thei loin a um ding maw? Kan mit a tuahtu Pathian cun, Hmu loin a um ding maw?"},"10":{"text":"Miphunkip hotu cun a hrem hai lo ding maw? Mi hmuahhmuah zirhtu cun a thei thluh lo ding maw?"},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in milai ih thinlung cu a hmu ṭheh; An ngaihtuahmi zianghman a si lozia khal a thei ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah ih nun na zirh mi le, Na daan na zirhmi pawl cu mi thlawsuak an si."},"13":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo hrangih thlaan laih a si hlan tiang, Harsatnak ni sungin colhnak na pek a si."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl a dungtun lo ding; Amah ih ta a si mi pawl cu a tlansan lo ding."},"15":{"text":"Thuṭhennak hmunah dingthluk lairelnak thawn thuṭhennak a um sal ding ih, Miding hmuahhmuah in an thlun ding."},"16":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl do dingah zoso ka hrangah a ding ding? Mi siava pawl tawng dingah zoso ka lamah a ṭang ding?"},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in i bawm hlah sehla, Daiziar ih umnak ram ah zamrang zetin ka feh zo ding."},"18":{"text":"“Ka rilsawn thlang ding a si hi!” ka ti tikah, Maw Bawipa , a hmunmi na duhdawtnak in i dingter."},"19":{"text":"Thinphang le donhar ih ka um tikah, Nangmah in i hneem ih ka lung i awiter."},"20":{"text":"Nang cu nawhthuh laak ih thuṭhentu pawl, A dik lomi khi a dik tiah a titu pawl,"},"21":{"text":"Mi ṭha a phiartu pawl le sual nei lomi thah dingih thu a ṭhentu pawl thawn Nan ṭang tlang lo a si."},"22":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in i ṭan ih, Ka Pathian cu ka beunak lungpi a si."},"23":{"text":"An siatvaat manah Pathian in a hrem hai ding ih, An sual manah a siatsuah ṭheh hai ding. Bawipa kan Pathian in a tisiat hai ding a si."}}},"95":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ra uh, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uhsi! In humtu le in runtu hnenah Kan lungawinak hla in sa uhsi!","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Lungawinak thawn a hmaiah feh uhsila, Thangṭhatnak hla cu aipuang in sa uhsi!"},"3":{"text":"Ziangahtile Bawipa cu a mak zetmi Pathian a si. Khawzing hmuahhmuah tlun ah a tum bik siangpahrang a si."},"4":{"text":"Leilung pumpi hi a kut sungah a um; A thuk bikmi khur ihsin a saang bikmi tlang zim tiang, Amah in a uk ṭheh a si."},"5":{"text":"Amah tuahmi tifinriat khi a uk ih a seemsuahmi leilung khal a uk a si."},"6":{"text":"Ra uh, kan lu kuun in a mah cu bia uhsi; Bawipa , in tuahtu hmai ahcun kan khuk bil uhsi."},"7":{"text":"Amah cu kan Pathian a si. Kannih cu a kilkhawi mi a minung kan si ih, A khalh mi tuurual kan si. A thusimmi cu tuihsun ah ngai hnik uh:"},"8":{"text":"“Nan pu le nan pa Meribah ah, Mi lungruh an rak sivek cun si ve hlah uh. Massah nelrawn ih an rak si vek si ve hlah uh."},"9":{"text":"In rak hniksak ih an hrangih ka tuahmi hmuahhmuah An hmu ko naón in rak dodal thotho."},"10":{"text":"Kumpi kum sawmli sung hi minung pawl ih nunzia cu ka khop neekneek a si. ‘Ziangtluk rintlak lo minung so an si? Ka thukham pakhatte hman an thlun duh lo hi!’ ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Ka thin a heng ngaingai ih, ‘Colhnak ka lo pe hai ding, ka timi ram cu, Nan thleng hrimhrim lo pei!’ tiah siatcam in thu ka kam a si,” a ti."}}},"96":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah hla thar sa uh! Leilung pumpi in Bawipa ih hnenah hla sa uh.","title":"Pathian Cungsin Nung Siangpahrang"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah hla sak uhla a hmin cu thangṭhat uh. Nitinten in rundamnak thuthang ṭha sim uh."},"3":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah a sunlawi zia than uhla, Mi hmuahhmuah hnenah thil a ti thei zia cu phuang uh."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu a tum ih a saang bik ah thangṭhat ding a si. Khawzing dang hmuahhmuah hnakin ṭih sawn ding a si."},"5":{"text":"Miphun dang pawl ih khawzing tla cu milem an si; Asinain Bawipa cu van ih ummi hmuahhmuah tuahtu a si."},"6":{"text":"Sunlawinak le hminthannak cu a kimvel ah an um; Huham le mawinak cu a Biakinn sungah an um."},"7":{"text":"Leilungtlun mi hmuahhmuah tla, Bawipa cawimawi uh; A sunlawinak le a cahnak thangṭhat uh."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmin sunglawi cu thangṭhat uh; Thawinak kengin a Biakinn ah ra uh."},"9":{"text":"Thianghlim Bik Amah a lang tikah a hmaiah kuun uh. Leilung pumpi cu a hmaiah khur seh."},"10":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah, “ Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si; Leilung cu a umnak ah hngette in a um zo ih, ṭhawn theih a si nawn lo. Mi hmuahhmuah cu dingthluk lairelnak thawn an thu a ṭhen sak ding,” tiah sim uh."},"11":{"text":"Maw lei le van, nan lungawi uh! Tifinriat le a sungih ummi pawl tla au uh!"},"12":{"text":"Lo le a sungih ummi pawl tla, nan aipuang uh! Tupi sungih thingkung pawl khal Bawipa ih hmaiah lungawi in hla sak uh."},"13":{"text":"Ziangahtile leilung uk dingah Bawipa cu a ra; Leilungtlun mi hmuahhmuah cu dingthluk lairelnak le felnak thawn a uk hai ding."}}},"97":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si! Leilung hi lungawi in um seh! Maw tifinriat ih um tikulh pawl, nan aipuang uh!","title":"Cungsin Uktu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"Khawdur le khawthim cu a kimvel ah an um; A tokham cu dingfelnak le dingthluk lairelnak parah a ṭoh."},"3":{"text":"A hmai ah meisa a feh; A kiangkap ih um a ral pawl a kaang ṭheh hai."},"4":{"text":"A nimthlakau in leilung pumpi a vaangter; Cumi cu leilung in a hmu ih a khur."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah tlang pawl cu khuailul bangin an zup; Leilung pumpi ih Bawipa ih hmaika ahcun!"},"6":{"text":"Van pawl in a dingnak thu an phuang ih, Mi hmuahhmuah in a sunlawinak huham an hmu."},"7":{"text":"Milem a biatu pawl cu ningzak in an um; Milem a porh rerotu pawl cu! Khawzing hmuahhmuah in Bawipa ih hmaiah an kuun a si."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thuṭhennak ruangah Zion mi pawl cu an lung a awi ih, Judah khawpi pawl cu an thin a nuam."},"9":{"text":"Maw Ziangkimtithei Bawipa , Nang cu leilung pumpi uktu na si. Khawzing hmuahhmuah hnakin na tum sawn."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in thil ṭha lo a huatu pawl cu a duhdawt; A minung pawl ih nunnak cu a hum, Mi ṭha lo pawl ih kut sungin a run hai a si."},"11":{"text":"Miding parah tleunak a thleng; Mi ṭha parah lungawinak a thleng."},"12":{"text":"Nannih miding pawl, nan lungawi uh; Bawipa ih thil tuahmi ruangah cun; Thianghlim bik Amah ih a tuahmi cu ciing ringring uhla, A hnenah lungawinak pe uh."}}},"98":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah hla thar sa uh; Mangbangza thil pawl a tuah zo. A huham le a baan thianghlim in Ral a neh ṭheh zo.","title":"Leilung Pumpi Uktu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in a ral neh thu cu a than; Mi a run theinak huham cu miphun kip hnenah a theihter zo a si."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi parih a thukammi a kimter; An parah a hmunmi a duhdawtnak le a tlaihsannak cu cat loin a hmunter a si. Vanrang thuai mi hmuahhmuah in Kan Pathian ih ral nehnak cu an hmu ṭheh."},"4":{"text":"Maw leilung mi pawl, Bawipa ih hnenah lungawinak hla sa uh. Amah cawimawinak hla sak uhla lungawi in au uh."},"5":{"text":"Tingrisit thawn Bawipa ih hnenah thangṭhatnak hla sa uh. Lemlawi thawn hla mawi tum uh."},"6":{"text":"Tawtawrawt le tuucang ki thawn, Siangpahrang kan Bawipa ih hmaiah lungawi aipuang in au uh."},"7":{"text":"Maw tifinriat le a sungih ummi pawl, au ciamco uh; Maw leilung le a parih ummi pawl, hla sa uh."},"8":{"text":"Maw tipithuanthum pawl, nan zaa beeng cio uh; Maw tlang pawl Bawipa ih hmai ah lungawinak hla sa tlang uh."},"9":{"text":"Ziangahtile leilung uk dingah Bawipa cu a ra a si; Amah in leilung pumpi ih minung hmuahhmuah cu, Dingthluk lairelnak le felnak thawn a uk ding a si."}}},"99":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si, Leilung minung pawl an khur; Bawipa cu cherubim tlunih a siangpahrang tokham ah a to; Leilung cu a hnin ṭheh.","title":"Pathian, Cungsin Siangpahrang"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu Zion ah a um ih a nasa ngaingai; Miphun hmuahhmuah Cungsin Uktu a si."},"3":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in a maksakmi le a sunglawimi, A hmin cu an cawimawi ding. Amah cu a thianghlim a si."},"4":{"text":"Maw a cak bik siangpahrang, nang cun a dikmi na duh; Israel hnenah dingthluk lairelnak na thlenter; Nangmah in dingfelnak le bangrannak na thlenter a si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian cu thangṭhat uh; A siangpahrang tokham hmai ah kuun uhla bia uh; Amah cu a thianghlim a si."},"6":{"text":"Moses le Aaron a puithiam an si. Samuel khal amah a biatu a si. Bawipa an ko ih a run let."},"7":{"text":"An hnenah khawdur zual sung ihsin thu a sim; An hnenah daan le thukham pawl a pekmi cu annih in an thlun."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa kan Pathian, na minung pawl na run let hai. An sual ruangah na hrem hai naón, Minung sualnak ngaithiamtu na si zia cu an hnenah na langter."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian cu thangṭhat uh; A tlang thianghlim ah bia uh; Bawipa kan Pathian cu a thianghlim a si."}}},"100":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw leilung tlun minung pawl, Bawipa thangṭhatnak hla lungawi in sak uh.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Aipuang in Bawipa cu bia uh. Lungawinak hla thawn a hmaiah ra uh."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu Pathian a si kha hngilh hlah uh; Amah in in tuah ih amah ih ta kan si; Kannih cu a minung kan si; A khalh mi tuu kan si."},"4":{"text":"A biakinn sungah lungawinak thawn ra uh; A hmun thianghlim ah thangṭhatnak thawn; A parah lungawi uhla a hmin thangṭhat uh."},"5":{"text":"Ziangahtile Bawipa cu a ṭha. A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun, Rintlak a sinak cu san khat hnu san khat a hmun a si."}}},"101":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rintlaknak le dingthluk lairel- nak thu cu hla in ka sak ding. Maw Bawipa , na hnenah ka sak ding.","title":"Siangpahrang Thukam"},"2":{"text":"Soiselnak um lo nuncan ka zir; Ziangtikah so ka hnen na thlen thei ding? Ka inn sungah thinlung dingtein ka nung ding."},"3":{"text":"A ṭha lomi cu ka zawi thei hrimhrim lo ding. Pathian lamzin ihsin a pialmi ih thiltuahmi cu ka hua a si. Annih thawn kan peh awknak zianghman a um lo."},"4":{"text":"Zumtlak loin ka um lo ding ih, Thil ṭha lo cu a ruah hman ka ruat lo ding."},"5":{"text":"A rualpi thupte in a relsiatu cu Keimah in ka siatsuah ding. Mi hngal le mi puarthau cu Ka zoh meen lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Pathian rintlak ih a nungtu cu Ka mithmai ṭha an tong ding ih Ka siangpahrang inn ah ka umter hai ding. Soisel um lo pawl in ka hna an ṭuan ding."},"7":{"text":"Thuphan a pertu cu ka siangpahrang inn ah a um lo ding. Mibum a hmangtu cu ka mithmai ah a leeng lo ding."},"8":{"text":"Nikhat hnu ni khat kan ram sung ih mi ṭha lo pawl cu ka siatsuah hai ding. Thilsual tuahtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih khawpi sung in ka dawi thluh hai ding."}}},"102":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka thlacamnak ngai awla, Bomnak dil ih ka aunak cu thei hram aw.","title":"Harsatnak Tuartu-ih Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Harsatnak ka ton tikah ka hnen ihsin relh aw hlah; I thei awla, ka lo kawh tikah Zamrangte in i sawn aw."},"3":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu meikhu bangin a hlo; Ka taksa cu meisa kangh in a kaang."},"4":{"text":"In vuak thlak ih hrampi bangin ka vuai. Rawl ei khal ka hiar nawn lo."},"5":{"text":"Naapi in ka hruum ruangro, Ka ruh le ka vun lawng a taang."},"6":{"text":"Nelrawn ih ngathur vate bangtuk ka si; ṭio sanmi khawrop ih sumbuh ka bang."},"7":{"text":"Itthat thei loin ka meng; Luanglu parih vate lungleng ka bang."},"8":{"text":"Sun nihlawh ka ral pawl in in hmuhsuam; Caponak ih i hmangtu pawl in Ka hmin cu mi camnak ah an hmang."},"9":{"text":"Ka rawl cu vutcam a si ih, Na thinhengnak le na aithoknak ruangah,"},"10":{"text":"Ka inmi khal ka mitthli thawn a rawi aw thluh. Nangmah in i cawi ih i hlon hlo."},"11":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu zanlam ih phenthlam vek a si; Hrampi ro bangin ka si."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla maw Bawipa, Nang cu kumkhua in siangpahrang na si. Sankhat hnu sankhat nang cu an lo thei ringring ding."},"13":{"text":"Na tho ding ih Zion cu na zaangfah ding; Zion zaangfahnak caan ṭha cu a thleng. A thleng zo a si."},"14":{"text":"Na siahhlawh pawl in an duh ih A lungto tiangin an ngaina. An zaangfah ih a leivut tiangin an tlaihsan."},"15":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah in Bawipa cu an ṭih ding. Leitlun siangpahrang hmuahhmuah in a huham cu an ṭih ding."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in Zion khawpi a din sal tikah, Amah ih sunlawinak cu a langter ding."},"17":{"text":"A tlansan zomi a minung pawl ih aw cu a thei ding ih, An thlacamnak a ngai ding."},"18":{"text":"A ra dingmi san hrangah Bawipa ih tuahmi cu ngan siseh; A suak hrih lomi pawl khal in Bawipa an thangṭhatnak dingah."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa cun a saangmi a hmun thianghlim in a vun zoh; Vancung ihsin leilung cu a vun zoh a si."},"20":{"text":"Thawngtla pawl ih aihramnak thei dingah le Thah dingih thuṭhen ciami pawl an luatnak dingah."},"21":{"text":"Cuticun minung in Zion ah, Bawipa ih hmin cu an aupi ding; Jerusalem ah an lungawinak cu a hnenah an thlenpi ding;"},"22":{"text":"Miphun pawl le uknak pawl hmunkhat ah an ra ih, Bawipa an biak tlang tikah."},"23":{"text":"Ka no lai ah Bawipa in ka tha a ṭumter; Ka nunnak a tawiter a si."},"24":{"text":"Maw ka Pathian, atu-ah ka nunnak cu la hrih hlah aw; Ka san ṭhat laitak a si. Maw Bawipa , nang cu kumkhua ih a nungmi na si."},"25":{"text":"Khuahlan laipi ah leilung hi na rak seemsuah; Na kutzung in van pawl hi na tuah."},"26":{"text":"An zate in an hloral ṭheh ding. Asinain nang cu kumkhua in na hmun ding; An zate in hnipuan bangtuk in an ṭet thluh ding; Hnipuan vekin na thleng hai ding ih an hloral ṭheh ding."},"27":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nang cu nangmah keel thotho na si; Na nunnak cu cem ti a nei lo."},"28":{"text":"Kan tefa pawl hnangam zetin an um ding ih, An tesinfa pawl nangmah ih humhimnak sungah kumkhua in an um ding a si."}}},"103":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat aw; Ka sungih ummi hmuahhmuah in, A hmin thianghlim cu thangṭhat uh.","title":"Pathian Ih Duhdawtnak"},"2":{"text":"Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat awla, A ṭhatnak hmuahhmuah hngilh hlah aw."},"3":{"text":"Amah in ka sualnak hmuahhmuah i ngaithiam ih, Ka natnak hmuahhmuah i damter."},"4":{"text":"A thukmi thlaan ihsin i suah ih, A hmunmi duhdawtnak le lainatnak thawn i thlawsuah."},"5":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu thil ṭha in a khahter ih, Muvanlai bangin cak le no in i umter a si."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa cun an namthlakmi pawl ṭan in thu a ṭhen, An co ding mawi a coter hai."},"7":{"text":"A tumtahmi cu Moses hnenah a sim ih, Thil a ti thei zia cu Israel hnenah a langter."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cu zaangfahnak le lainatnak a nei; A thin a sau ih a hmunmi duhdawtnak in a khat."},"9":{"text":"Mi a kawk ringring lo ding ih, Kumkhua in a thin a heng fawn lo ding."},"10":{"text":"Kan tuar ding zat in in tuarter siang lo ih, Kan sualnak le kan mawhnak man zat in in cawh lo."},"11":{"text":"Ziangahtile van cu, Leilung hnakih a saanzet bangin, Amah a ṭihzahtu hrangah, A duhdawtnak cu a saangzet a si."},"12":{"text":"Nisuahnak cu nitlaknak ihsin, A hlatzet bangin, Kan sualnak pawl cu kan hnen ihsin hlatzet ah a ret a si."},"13":{"text":"Pa in a faale pawl cu, A zaangfahzet hai bangin, Cubangtuk in Bawipa in Amah a ṭihzahtu pawl cu a zaangfah hai a si."},"14":{"text":"Ziangahtile Amah in kan taksa siam daan cu a thei ih, Leivut lawng kan si kha, A ciing ringring a si."},"15":{"text":"Milai ih nunnak cu hrampi vek a si; A ṭhang ih hramlak pangpar bang in a par;"},"16":{"text":"Thli in a hran ih a hloralta, Zohman in an hmu sal nawn lo."},"17":{"text":"Asinain amah a upattu hrangah cun Bawipa ih duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun ih,"},"18":{"text":"A thukamnak vekih a nungtu le A thukham vekih a thlun ringringtu hrangah cun, A ṭhatnak cu sankhat hnu sankhat a hmun a si."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa in a siangpahrang tokham cu vancung ah a ret ih, Amah cu ziangzongza ih tlun ah siangpahrang a si."},"20":{"text":"Maw nannih vancung mi pawl, a cak le thil tithei, A ṭong a ngai ih a thupekmi a thluntu pawl, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh."},"21":{"text":"Maw nannih van ralkap pawl, a duhmi tuahsak ih, Amah a riantu pawl, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa ih seemsuahmi pawl, A uk sung khuazakip ih um pawl, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh. Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat aw."}}},"104":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat aw; Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, na va nasa so! Upatnak le sunlawinak cu hnipuan bangin na hruk ih,","title":"Seemsuahtu Pathian Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Tleunak in na thuam aw. Van tla khi puanthlam bangin na pharh ih,"},"3":{"text":"Tlun ih tidai parah na inn cu na sak; Khawdur cu na rangleng ah na hmang ih, Thli ih thla par in na feh."},"4":{"text":"Thli pawl cu na palai ah na hmang ih, Nimthlakau tleu cu na siahhlawh ah na tuah."},"5":{"text":"Leilung ṭoh-nak hram cu hnget zetin na tuah ih, Ziangtik khal ah a ṭhawn aw dah lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Tipithuanthum cu leilung ṭoh-nak parah puan bangin na phah ih, Tidai in tlang pawl tla a khuh."},"7":{"text":"Asinain tidai cu na kawk tikah an tlan; Na thupeknak aw an theih tikah zamrang in an tlanhlo."},"8":{"text":"Tlangpar ihsin an dawp ih phai rawn ah an tlan; An hrangih na tuah ciami hmun an pan."},"9":{"text":"An lan thei lo dingmi ramri na tuah sak, Leilung an khuh sal lonak dingah."},"10":{"text":"Cerh pawl cu horkuam ihsin na puutter ih, Tlang karlak in tidai na luanter."},"11":{"text":"Tivate in ramsa phunkip tidai an pe ih, Hramlak rang khal in an tihal an riamter."},"12":{"text":"Tiva kap ih thingkung parah Vate in bu an sak ih hla an sak."},"13":{"text":"Van ihsin tlangpar ah ruah na surter ih, Leilung cu na thlawsuahnak in a khat."},"14":{"text":"Ṭilva hrangah hrampi na cerh ter ih, Milai hrangah thingkung le hrampi na khohter. Thlai rawl a ciing ih,"},"15":{"text":"A thin nuamtertu dingah sabit, A lungawitertu dingah olif hriak le A tha caktertu dingah rawl na tuahsak a si."},"16":{"text":"Lebanon ih sidar thingkung in ruah tampi a ngah, A phun ciami Bawipa ih thingkung pawl cun."},"17":{"text":"Cutawkah vate phunkim in bu an tuah; Vaca tla cun farthing parah a inn a sak."},"18":{"text":"Zaathar pawl cu tlangsaang par ah an um ih, Meingan pawl cu khaam lakah an relh."},"19":{"text":"Thla siarnak ah thlapi na tuah, Ni khal in tlak caan a thei."},"20":{"text":"Zan na tuah ih khawthim lakah Hramlak ramsa hmuahhmuah an suak."},"21":{"text":"Kiosa no pawl cu sa deh duh ah an huuk ih, Pathian ih pekmi an rawl an hawl."},"22":{"text":"Ni a suah tikah an tlung sal, Anmah ih kua ciar ah an bok."},"23":{"text":"Milai pawl cu hnaṭuan dingah an feh ih, Zanlam tiang hna an ṭuan."},"24":{"text":"Maw Bawipa na tuahmi hi an tam ngaingai; Fimnak thawn na tuah ṭheh hai. Leilung cu na tuahmi thil nung in an khat a si."},"25":{"text":"Tipithuanthum cu a tum zetih a kau ngaingai fawn. Siar cawk lo thilnung a tum a seen in a sungah an um."},"26":{"text":"A parah lawng an feh ih, Na tuahmi ṭihnungza ramsa Leviathan cu a sungah a lek."},"27":{"text":"An zatein nangmah an lo zoh, An ei tik caanih rawl ngah dingah."},"28":{"text":"Rawl na pek hai ih an ei; Na kut in rawl na pek ih an pum a puar."},"29":{"text":"Khatlam na hoisan tikah an thin a phang; An thaw na lak sak tikah cun an thi ih an seemnak leilung ah an kir sal."},"30":{"text":"Asinain thaw na pek tikah cun an nung; Leilung nunnak thar na pek a si."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa ih sunlawinak huham cu kumkhua in hmun hram seh. Bawipa cu a tuah ciami parah a lungawi hram seh."},"32":{"text":"Bawipa in a run zoh ih leilung cu a khur; Tlang pawl a run tham ih meikhu an suak."},"33":{"text":"Ka nunsung hmuahhmuah Bawipa hnenah hla ka sak ding; Ka dam sung hmuahhmuah Bawipa thangṭhatnak hla ka sak ding."},"34":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka hla ah a lungawi hram seh, Ziangahtile ka lung i awiter cu Amah a si."},"35":{"text":"Misual pawl cu leilung in hloral hai seh; Mi ṭha lo pawl cu um nawn hlah hai seh. Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat aw; Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh."}}},"105":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah lungawi thu sim uhla a hmin cu aupi uh; A thil tuahmi cu miphun zate hnenah sim uh.","title":"Pathian Le A Minung Pawl (1 San. 16.8-22)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah hla sa uh; Amah thangṭhatnak hla sa uh. Mangbangza a tuahmi pawl cu phuang uh."},"3":{"text":"Amah ih ta kan si ruangah nan lungawi uh; Bawipa riantu hmuahhmuah in nan aipuang uh."},"4":{"text":"Bomnak dil in Bawipa ih hnenah feh uh; A mithmuh ah um ringring uh."},"5":{"text":"Nannih a siahhlawh Abraham ih tefa pawl, A hrilmi Jakob ih tefa pawl, A nasa zetmi le mangbangza a thil tuahmi le a thuṭhennak pawl cu, ciing ringring uh.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu kan Pathian a si; A thukham cu leilung pumpi hrangah a si."},"8":{"text":"A thukam cu kumkhua in a nungter ding ih, A thutiam cu san thawng khat tiang a thlun ding,"},"9":{"text":"Abraham hnenih a thukam le Isaak hnenih a thutiam mi pawl cu."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel hnenah, Kumkhua daih in thukamnak a tuah; Jakob hnenah san siar cawk lo hrangin thutiamnak a tuah."},"11":{"text":"“Kanaan ram ka lo pe hai ding; Nan ro a si ding,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Pathian ih minung pawl cu mi malte an si; Ram sungah mi vakvai an si."},"13":{"text":"Ram khat ihsin ram dangah an ṭhawn; Mi phun khat ihsin phun dang hnenah an ceer."},"14":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in zohman a hremter lo; Anmah humhim dingah siangpahrang tampi a kawk."},"15":{"text":"“Ka hrilmi ka siahhlawh pawl dai hlah uh; Ka profet pawl tisiat hlah uh,” tiah Bawipa in a ti."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in an ram sungah paam a tlunter ih, An rawl hmuahhmuah a lak ṭheh tikah,"},"17":{"text":"Sal ih zuarmi Josef cu Hmai ah a rak thlah sung a si."},"18":{"text":"A ke cu thir cikcin in an ṭem, A hngawng ah thir kual an thlaih;"},"19":{"text":"A thu sim ciami a kim hlan lo! Bawipa ih thu in miding a si kha a langter."},"20":{"text":"Cule Izipt ram siangpahrang in a thlah; Miphun tampi uktu bawi cun a luatter."},"21":{"text":"A ram uknak hotu bikah a ret; A ram sung hmuahhmuah uktu bawi ah a tuah."},"22":{"text":"Siangpahrang kut thuai ih bawi pawl tlunah thuneihnak a pek; A thuronmi pawl tlun khalah thu a nei thei a si."},"23":{"text":"Cule Jakob cu Izipt ram ah a vung ih cuih ram ahcun a um."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl cu a punzaiter ih, Anmah hremtu pawl hnakin a cakter hai a si."},"25":{"text":"A minung pawl hua dingah le A siahhlawh parih mi depde si dingah, Izipt mi pawl ih thinlung cu a lehter a si."},"26":{"text":"Cule a hrilmi a siahhlawh Moses le Aaron a thlah."},"27":{"text":"Pathian ih mangbangza thil an tuah ih, Izipt ramah thil khawruahhar an langter."},"28":{"text":"An ram sungah thimnak a thlenter; Asinain Izipt mi in a thupekmi an thlun lo."},"29":{"text":"An tiva pawl cu thisen ah a canter ṭheh ih An nga pawl a thihter ṭheh."},"30":{"text":"An ram cu butlak in a khat; An siangpahrang inn tiangin a khat a si."},"31":{"text":"Pathian in thu a pek ih an ram cu thothe le fikfa in a khat."},"32":{"text":"An ram sungah ruah sur ai ah, Rial a tlakter ih nimthla a kauter."},"33":{"text":"Sabit kung le theipi kung pawl a siatsuah ih, Thingkung pawl a khiak ṭheh."},"34":{"text":"Amah thupek in kharbok an ra; Siar cawk loin an ra a si."},"35":{"text":"Ram sungih thinghnah le hrampi an ei ṭheh; Thlaikho hmuahhmuah an piat bul ṭheh."},"36":{"text":"Izipt mi innsang hmuahhmuah ih Fapa upabik a thah ṭheh a si."},"37":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl a suahpi, Annih in an sui le an ngun tla an keng; An zate in mi cak le mi harhdam hlir an si."},"38":{"text":"Israel mi pawl an suah tikah, Izipt mi pawl cu an lung a awi; Ziangahtile an ṭih zetmi an si."},"39":{"text":"Pathian in a minung pawl ih tlun ah khawdur a umter; Zan ih tleunak petu ah meisa a vaangter."},"40":{"text":"A hnenah an dil ih vanim a pek; Vancung ihsin rawl a pek ih khop zetin an ei a si."},"41":{"text":"Lungpi a ongter ih tidai a put; Nelrawn ah tiva bangin a luang."},"42":{"text":"A siahhlawh Abraham hnenih A thukam thianghlim kha a ciing ringring a si."},"43":{"text":"Cutin a minung pawl cu lungawi zetin a suahpi; A hril ciami pawl cu hla sak le au phah in a hruaisuak hai a si."},"44":{"text":"Miphun dang pawl ih ram cu a minung hnenah a pek; An thlawh ciami lo cu a coter hai a si."},"45":{"text":"A minung pawl in a daan an thlun ih, A thukham pawl an thlunnak dingah a tuah ṭheh a si. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"}}},"106":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Bawipa ih hnenah lungawi thu sim uh, Ziangahtile amah cu a ṭha. A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun a si.","title":"Ih ṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Mangbangza a tuahmi pawl zoso Tlamtling in a sim thei ding? Amah thangṭhatnak cu zoso a saal cawk ding?"},"3":{"text":"A thupekmi a thluntu le thudik a tuah ringringtu cu mi lungawi an si."},"4":{"text":"Na minung pawl na bom tikah, Maw Bawipa , kei khal i thei hram aw. Na run hai tikah kei khal i telhcih hram aw."},"5":{"text":"Na hrilmi pawl mineinung an si tik caan cu i hmuter ve hram aw; Na miphun ih lungawinak ah i telh ve awla, Nangmah ih ro an si ruangih nunnomnak cu i coter ve hram aw."},"6":{"text":"Kan pu le kan pa pawl vekin, Kannih khal kan sual zo; Thil ṭha lo kan tuah ih misual taktak kan si."},"7":{"text":"Kan pupa pawl Izipt ramih an um laiah Pathian ih mangbangza a tuahmi kha an thei thei lo. A duhdawtnak a langter ringring naón an hngilh cingcing. Tipi Sen an thlen tikah, Cungnungbik Bawi cu an dodal."},"8":{"text":"Asinain a kam cia vekin a hum thotho hai; A cakmi a huham langter duh ah,"},"9":{"text":"Tipi Sen cu thu a pek ih a caar; Lei parih a hruai hai vekin, A minung pawl a fehpi."},"10":{"text":"A huatu pawl hnen ihsin a run hai ih, An ral pawl ih kut ihsin a hum hai a si."},"11":{"text":"Tidai in an ral pawl cu a khuh ṭheh ih, A luatmi pakhat hman an um lo."},"12":{"text":"Cuih hnu lawngah a thukammi an zum ih, A hnenah thangṭhatnak hla an sa."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla rei lote-ah, A tuahmi hmuahhmuah an hngilh sal ih, Bawipa ron hmaisa loin thil an tuah."},"14":{"text":"Nelrawn ramṭhingah rawl hiarnak in an khat ih, Pathian cu an hniksak."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah an dilmi a pek hai; Asinain thacem natsia an hnenah a thlenter."},"16":{"text":"Cuih nelrawn ah Moses le, Bawipa ih mi thianghlim Aaron cu an nahsiik."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah leilung a kak ih Dathan a dolh hlo, Abiram le a innsang tla an pil ṭheh a si."},"18":{"text":"Anmah thluntu pawl parah meisa a rung tla ih, Cuih mi ṭha lo pawl cu a kaang ṭheh hai a si."},"19":{"text":"Horeb ah sui in cawnote zuk an tuah ih cuih cawlem cu an biak."},"20":{"text":"Pathian sunlawinak huham cu Hrampi a eitu ṭilva in a ai an awhter."},"21":{"text":"Anmah runtu cu an hngilh; Izipt ramih mangbangza tuahtu Pathian cu!"},"22":{"text":"Izipt ramih thil mak zetzet a tuahtu le, Tipi Sen ih thil khawruahhar tuahtu cu!"},"23":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian in Amah ih minung pawl cu siatsuah a tum. Asinain a hrilmi a siahhlawh Moses cu Pathian hmaiah a ding ih anmah siatralter lo dingah Pathian thinhengnak cu a nemter."},"24":{"text":"Cule ramṭha le ramnuam cu, Zianghman ah an siar lo; Pathian ih thukam cu an zum lo."},"25":{"text":"An phunzai an tlokciar ih an puanthlam ah an to; Bawipa ih thu cu an ngai lo."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah siatcam in ralrinnak a pek hai; “Nelrawn ramṭhing ah nan thi ding;"},"27":{"text":"Nan tefa pawl cu lawki mi lakah ka ṭhekdarh ding ih, Miphun dang pawl ih ram ah an thi ding,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cule Pathian ih minung pawl cu Peor ih Baal khawzing biaknak ah an tel ve. Nunnak nei lo an khawzing hnenih an pekmi raithawinak ti rawl pawl an ei ve."},"29":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian ih thin an ṭeuter ih, An lakah natsia a suak."},"30":{"text":"Asinain Finehas a ding ih misual pawl thu a ṭhen; Cuticun pulhnat cu a reh."},"31":{"text":"Cumi cu Finehas ih felnak ah ruahsak a si; Kumkhua in ruahsak a si ding."},"32":{"text":"Meribah cerhti ah Bawipa a thin an hengter; Anmah ruangah Moses cu harsatnak a tong."},"33":{"text":"Moses a thin an hengter tuk ruangah a ṭong lo ding tiangin a ṭong a si."},"34":{"text":"Pathian thei lo minung pawl that thluh dingin, Bawipa ih thupekmi a si naón an that lo."},"35":{"text":"Pathian thei lo pawl thawn an ṭhi-aw ton ih, An khawvel daan cu an cawng."},"36":{"text":"Pathian ih minung pawl cun milem an bia ih, Anmah awktu thang ah a cang."},"37":{"text":"An fanu le an fapa pawl an pek; Khawzing pawl biak thawinak ah!"},"38":{"text":"Mawh nei lo thisen, A fanu le an fapa pawl ih thisen cu an suahter; Kanaan ram khawzing lem thawinak hrangah cun, Cuih thisen ruangah cuih ram cu an baalter a si."},"39":{"text":"Cutiih an tuah ruangah, Anmah tla cu mi borhhlawh an si, Pathian hmaiah mi uire ah an cang."},"40":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa cu a minung pawl parah a ai a thok; A hril ciami parah a thinlung a uih;"},"41":{"text":"Khawvel pawl kut sungah a taanta hai ih, An ral pawl in an uk a si."},"42":{"text":"A huatu pawl in an hrem ih, An kut hnuai ahcun an tuar cuahco a si."},"43":{"text":"Voi ziangzat mengso Bawipa in a runsuak hai? Cucing in Bawipa an dodal thotho ih, An sualnak cu a thuk sinsin."},"44":{"text":"Asinain an aunak cu Bawipa in a ngai ih, An vansaannak cu a thei."},"45":{"text":"Anmah zawnruah ah a thukam cu a ciing; A hmunmi a duhdawtnak a tum ruangah a thinlung a ṭhum."},"46":{"text":"A minung a neh-nentu pawl ih thinlung sungah zaangfahnak a umter a si."},"47":{"text":"Maw Bawipa kan Pathian, in run hram aw; Miphun dangdang lak ihsin in finkhawm sal hram aw; Cuticun na hmin thianghlim kan thangṭhat ding ih, Lungawi in kan lo cawimawi ding."},"48":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh, Israel ih Pathian cu! Atu le kumkhua in thangṭhat uh! Mi hmuahhmuah in “Amen,” ti thluh hai seh. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!."}}},"107":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah lungawi thu sim uh, Ziangahtile amah cu a ṭha; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun.","title":"Pathian ṭhatzia Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu kan thangṭhat pei, A run zomi pawl in; Nan ral kut sungin a lo run ih,"},"3":{"text":"Nisuah, nitlak, saklam le thlanglam ih a ummi, Ram dangdang ihsin a lo kirter hai a si."},"4":{"text":"Mihrek cu nelrawn ramṭhing ah, Lamzin an hlo ih an vakvai; An umnak ding khawpi an pan thei hrimhrim lo."},"5":{"text":"An ril a rawng, an ti a haal; An bei a dong ih an thin a cem."},"6":{"text":"An harnak sung ihsin Bawipa an ko ih, An zonzaihnak ihsin a luatter."},"7":{"text":"A hruaisuak hai ih lamzin ṭha ah a fehpi; An umnak ding khawpi thleng in."},"8":{"text":"A hmunmi a duhdawtnak le An hrangih mangbangza a tuahmi ruangah Bawipa cu thangṭhat hai seh."},"9":{"text":"Tihal pawl an tihal a riamter ih, Rilrawng pawl cu thil ṭha in a cawm hai a si."},"10":{"text":"Mihrek cu thinpihnak le khawthim sungah an um; Thawngtla an si ih thir cikcin khihnak an tuar;"},"11":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian ih thukham an duh lo ih, A thupekmi an el ruangah a si."},"12":{"text":"Hnaṭuan khung an ṭuannak ah an baang tuk ih an tlu; Asinain zohman bawmtu le thotu an nei lo."},"13":{"text":"An harsatnak sung ihsin Bawipa an ko ih, An zonzaihnak ihsin a luatter hai."},"14":{"text":"An riahsiatnak le khawthim sung ihsin a suahter hai ih, An thir cikcin pawl cu a ticat ṭheh a si."},"15":{"text":"A hmunmi a duhdawtnak le an hrangih mangbangza a tuahmi ruangah Bawipa cu thangṭhat hai seh."},"16":{"text":"Dar ih tuahmi sangka pawl cu a khuai ṭheh ih, Thir ih tuahmi kothrolh pawl cu a deen kiak ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Mihrek cu an aa, an sual ruangah an na a si; An ṭhat lo ruangah an tuar a si."},"18":{"text":"Rawl an fih ih a zoh hman an duh lo; Rilrawng in an thi zik cuahco thlang."},"19":{"text":"An harsatnak sung ihsin Bawipa cu an ko ih, An zonzaihnak sung ihsin a luatter hai a si."},"20":{"text":"A ṭongkam in a damter hai; Thihnak khur sung ihsin a suah hai a si."},"21":{"text":"A hmunmi a duhdawtnak le An hrangih mangbangza a tuahmi ruangah Bawipa cu thangṭhat hai seh."},"22":{"text":"Thawinak pe in amah hnenah lungawinak an pe pei; Lungawinak hla thawn a thil tuahmi pawl cu an phuang pei."},"23":{"text":"Mihrek cu tipithuanthum parah tangphawlawng in khual an tlawng; Ti par khualtlawnnak in pumcawm- nak an hawl."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa ih thil tuahmi pawl an hmu; Ti parih mangbangza a tuahmi pawl cu!"},"25":{"text":"Thu a pek ih thlipi a huuk ciamco, Tifinriat ih tisuar pawl an tho ciamco."},"26":{"text":"Tangphawlawng pawl cu tlun ah a hlirh ih, Ti hnuai ah a pilter hai. Cubangtuk ṭihnungza tikcu ahcun, Milai ih ralṭhatnak cu an hlo ṭheh."},"27":{"text":"Zuri bangin an tlu, an sawn; Thiamnak an neihmi pawl cu a lak an si ṭheh."},"28":{"text":"An harsatnak sung ihsin Bawipa cu an ko ih, An zonzaihnak sungin a luatter hai a si."},"29":{"text":"Thlipi cu a rehter ih Tisuar cu a daiter a si."},"30":{"text":"Daihnak a um ruangah an lung a awi; An feh duhnak khua-ah him damteón A thlenpi hai a si."},"31":{"text":"A hmunmi a duhdawtnak le an hrangih mangbangza a tuah ruangah Bawipa cu thangṭhat hai seh."},"32":{"text":"Mi senpi khawmnak hmunah a mak zia cu an tlang-au pi pei ih, Upa pawl an tonkhawmnak hmunah an thangṭhat pei."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa in tiva pawl cu, Hul verver in a caarter ih, Ticawm pawl khal a kangter ṭheh."},"34":{"text":"Ram ṭha cu ram caar le ram phul ah a canter; Cutawk ummi pawl ih ṭhat lonak ruangah a si."},"35":{"text":"Nelrawn cu ticawm umnak hmunah a tuah ih, Lei ro le lei caar cu cerhti in a khahter a si."},"36":{"text":"Mi rilrawng pawl cutawk ah a umter ih, An umnak dingah khawpi an din."},"37":{"text":"Lo ah thlaici an tuh ih hmuan ah sabit an phun; A let tampi in an khawm sal."},"38":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl cu mal a sawm ih tefa tampi an nei; An ṭilva pawl khal an ṭum suk dah lo."},"39":{"text":"Pathian ih minung pawl cu, Hremnak le harnak a phunphun in Hmuhsuammi le palcihmi ih an can tikah,"},"40":{"text":"A hremtu pawl cu Bawipa in a namsuk hai ih, Lamzin um lo nelrawn ramṭhing ah, Mi vakvai ah a tuah hai."},"41":{"text":"Asinain mi zonzai pawl cu, An retheihnak ihsin a run hai ih An innsang cu tuurual bangin, a karhzaiter a si."},"42":{"text":"Cumi cu miding pawl in an hmuh tikah an lung a awi; Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu ṭong ding nei loin an dai khepkhep."},"43":{"text":"Mifim pawl cun hi thil pawl hi ruat ṭha hai seh; A hmunmi Bawipa ih duhdawtnak cu thei fel hai seh."}}},"108":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka thinlung zatein ka lo rinsan. Hla in ka lo thangṭhat ding; Maw ka thlarau, ṭhang thlang aw!","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacam (Saam 57.7-11 ; 60.5-12)"},"2":{"text":"Ka ṭingṭang le ka phirivau pawl tho thlang uh! Ni ka ṭhangphawk ding!"},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , miphun tampi lakah ka lo lawm ding. Minung tampi lakah ka lo cawimawi ding."},"4":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak vancung a thleng; Rintlak na sinak in van a dai."},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na maksaknak cu, Van ah khin langter aw; Na sunlawinak huham cu, Leilung pumpuluk ah langter aw."},"6":{"text":"Na cahnak in in run aw; Na duhdawtmi na minung pawl an luatnak dingah, Ka thlacamnak in let hram aw."},"7":{"text":"A hmun thianghlim sung ihsin Pathian in, “Lungawi zetin Shekhem cu ka ṭhenṭhek ding; Sukkoth phairawn cu ka miphun hnenah ka zem ding."},"8":{"text":"Gilead cu ka ta a si; Manasseh khal ka ta a si. Efraim cu ka lukhuh a si; Judah cu ka bawi kianghrol a si."},"9":{"text":"Asinain Moab cu ka kut kholhnak kheng ah ka hmang ding ih, Edom ram cu ka kedam hlonnak ah ka hmang ding, ka ta a si ti theihnak ah. Filistin ka neh ruangah ka au ding,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ralhruang kulhmi khawpi ah zoso i feh pi ding? Edom ah zoso i hruai ding?"},"11":{"text":"Maw Pathian, in dungtun ngaingai zo maw si? Kan ralkap pawl hnenah na tel lo ding maw si?"},"12":{"text":"Kan ral pawl in do bawm hram aw; Ziangahtile milai ih bomnak cu man nei lo a si."},"13":{"text":"Kan hnenih Pathian a ṭan ahcun kan neh ding; Kan ral pawl a neh ding a si!"}}},"109":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nangmah ka lo thangṭhat; Daite in um hlah aw.","title":"Harnak Tuartu Ih Phunzainak"},"2":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl le, Mi bumhmang pawl in in do ciamco; Ka thuhla an rel ih thuphan an per a si."},"3":{"text":"Ṭong mawi lo zetzet hmang tahratin in rel; Thuhla zianghman um loin in dodal ciamco."},"4":{"text":"Anmah cu ka duhdawt hai ih, An hrangah thla ka cam naón, Annih cun in ral thotho a si."},"5":{"text":"Ṭhatnak cu siatnak in in sam ih, Duhdawtnak cu huatnak in in ruul."},"6":{"text":"Ka ral thuṭhentu dingah mi ṭha lo hril awla, A huatu cu sual a puhtu ah re aw."},"7":{"text":"A thu an rel tikah mi sual a si ti in thuṭhen si hram seh; A thlacamnak hman cu mawhnak ah ruahsak siseh."},"8":{"text":"A san tawi sehla A hnaṭuan cu midang in co seh."},"9":{"text":"A faale pawl cu pa nei lo farah si-aw hai sehla, A nupi cu nuhmei ah cang seh."},"10":{"text":"A faale pawl cu inn nei lo, Rawl diltu ah cang-aw hai sehla, An umnak deu siava ihsin dawi vivo si hai seh."},"11":{"text":"Paisa a coihtu pawl in, A neihmi hmuahhmuah long thluh hai sehla, Mikhual pawl in a hlawhmi hmuahhmuah kha la ṭheh hai seh."},"12":{"text":"A parah zohman in, Zaangfahnak nei hlah hai seh; A faale khal zohman in kilkhawi hlah hai seh."},"13":{"text":"A cithlah hmuahhmuah thi ṭheh aw hai sehla, Amah ih hmin cu sankhat hnu cun hngilh fai siseh."},"14":{"text":"A pupa pawl ih ṭhat lonak cu, Bawipa in ciing ringring-aw sehla, A nu ih sualnak cu, Ziangtik khalah ngaidam hlah seh."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in an mawhnak cu thei camcin seh; Asinain anmah cu hngilh fai ṭheh mi si hai seh."},"16":{"text":"Cupa cu mi zaangfahnak a nei hrimhrim lo; Mi farah, mi tlasam le bawmtu nei lo pawl, A hrem ih a that hai a si."},"17":{"text":"Midang camsiat cu a hiar ṭeuṭeu, Amah sawn camnak tuar seh. Midang thlawsuah pek cu a duh hrimhrim lo; Zohman in thlawsuahnak pe hlah hai seh."},"18":{"text":"Hnipuan a hruk tluk in, Midang cu ol zetin siat a cam; A micamnak in a ruangpi cu tidai bangin ciah sehla, A ruh sung khalah siti bangin lut ṭheh seh."},"19":{"text":"Hnipuan bangin amah khuhtu ah cang-aw sehla, Taikhap bangin a kimvel in kulh ringring seh."},"20":{"text":"Siazet ih i reltu ka ral pawl parah a tlun vekin Bawipa in hrem hai seh."},"21":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa ka Pathian, i tiam cia vekin, Nangmah in kei cu i bawm ih, Na mi duhdawtnak a ṭhat ruangah kei cu i hum a si."},"22":{"text":"Kei cu mi rethei le mi tlasam tuk ka si; Ka thinlung cu a muril tiangin hliamnak a tuar."},"23":{"text":"Zanlam ih thlahliap vekin a hloral mi ka si; Pa-ngang vekin hlon meenmi ka si."},"24":{"text":"Rawl ka ei lo ruangah ka khuk a ṭhia; Ka taksa a ṭawl ih ka ruh le ka vun lawng a taang."},"25":{"text":"Mi in in hmuh tikah in hnihsan; In hmuhsuam ih an lu in thin."},"26":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, i bawm hram aw. A hmunmi duhdawtnak na nei ih I run hramhram aw."},"27":{"text":"Nangmah lawng i runtu na si hi Ka ral pawl theiter hram aw."},"28":{"text":"Annih in in cam hman hai sehla, Nang cun i thlawsuah ding. I hremtu pawl cu sung hai seh. Cule kei na siahhlawh hi ka lungawi seh."},"29":{"text":"Ka ral pawl cu mualphonak in khuh hai sehla, An ningzahnak cu korfual bangin hruk hai seh."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah ringzet in lungawinak thu ka sim ding; Misenpi hmaiah amah cu ka thangṭhat ding."},"31":{"text":"Ziangahtile farah zonzai pawl hnenah a ṭang ih, Anmah thah a tumtu pawl kut sung ihsin a run hai a si."}}},"110":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in siangpahrang ka Bawipa hnenah, “Na ral pawl na ke hnuai ih ka ret hlan lo, Hitawk ka vorhlam kapah to aw,” a ti.","title":"Pathian Le A Hrilmi Siangpahrang"},"2":{"text":"Zion ihsin na uknak cu Bawipa in a kauter ding; “Na ral pawl uk hai aw,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Na ral pawl na do ni in, Na milai an tho ciamco ding. Zing thlapit ih daitla bangin, Tlang thianghlim ah na mino pawl Na hnenah an ra ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in thukamnak cu siatcam in a tuah zo ih A let saal nawn lo ding. “Puithiam Melkhizedek bangtuk in, Kumkhua in puithiam na si ding,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa cu na vorhlam kapah a um; A thin a heng ni ah siangpahrang pawl cu a neh ding."},"6":{"text":"Miphun kip an thu a ṭhen ding, An raldonak hmun cu miruak in a khahter ding. Leilung pumpi ah Siangpahrang pawl cu a neh hai ding."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu lamzin kap tiva ih tidai a in ding; A tha a tlung ding ih nehtu a si ding."}}},"111":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Misenpi tonkhawmnak ah ka thinlung zate in Bawipa ka thangṭhat ding.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih thil tuahmi pawl, Ziangtluk mangbangza so an si, Cuih thil tuahmi parih lungawitu cun a tican an thei thiam a si."},"3":{"text":"A tuahmi cu upat tlak an si ih, Sunlawinak in an khat. A dingnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in mangbangza a tuah mi pawl cu in hngilhter lo; Amah cu zaangfahnak le, lainatnak neitu a si."},"5":{"text":"Amah a ṭihtu pawl cu ei ding rawl a pek hai; A thukam cu a hngilh dah lo."},"6":{"text":"A thil tithei zia cu a minung pawl hnenah a langter ih, Miphun dang pawl ih ram cu a pek hai a si."},"7":{"text":"A thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu, Rintlak an si ih an ding ṭheh. A thukham pawl cu rintlak an si."},"8":{"text":"Kumkhua in a hngetmi an si ih, Felzet le dikzetih pekmi an si."},"9":{"text":"A minung pawl hnenah runnak a thlenter ih, Anmah thawn kumkhua hrangin thukamnak a tuah. A thianghlimmi le huham nei zetmi a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihzah cu fim hramthawhnak a si; Cubangtuk ih a tuahtu pawl cu, Theih thiamnak ṭhazet an nei. Amah cu kumkhua ih thangṭhat ding a si."}}},"112":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Bawipa a ṭihzahtu le a thupekmi a thluntu cu mi thlawsuak an si.","title":"Mi ṭha Pa Ih Lungawinak"},"2":{"text":"A faale pawl cu hi ram sungah mi cak bik an si ding; Mi ṭha ih tesinfa pawl cun malsawm an dong ding."},"3":{"text":"A innsang cu milian le sumsaw nei zet an si ding ih, A dingfelnak cu kumkhua in a hmun ding."},"4":{"text":"Mi ṭha pawl hrangah cun Khawthim sung khalah tleunak a suak ṭheu; Lainatnak, zaangfahnak le dingnak a neitu pawl hrangah cun."},"5":{"text":"Tirhsiang zetin mi a coih ih Dik zetin mah ih hna a ṭuantu cu mi lungawi an si."},"6":{"text":"Mi ṭha cu a tlasam dah lo ding. Ziangtik hmanah an hngilh lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Thusia theih ding kha a hreh hrimhrim lo; A zumnak a khoh ih Bawipa ah a rinsannak cu hngetzet in a bun."},"8":{"text":"Donhar a nei lo, ṭih khal a nei lo; A ral pawl an sun kha a mit rori in a hmu ding."},"9":{"text":"Mi harsa le mi farah hnenah siang zetin a pek; Mi a zaangfahnak cu a ṭhum dah lo. Thil tithei a si ih zozo khalih upatmi a si."},"10":{"text":"Cumi cu mi ṭha lo pawl in an hmuh tikah an riah a sia; An mitkem in an ha an rial ih an tlan hlo; Beiseinak an neihmi cu kumkhua in a cem a si."}}},"113":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa thangṭhat uh!
