Maw Bawipa ih siahhlawh pawl, a hmin cu thangṭhat uh.","title":"Ih ṭhatzia Lomnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmin cu atu le kumkhua in thangṭhat siseh."},"3":{"text":"Nisuahnak ihsin nitlaknak tiang Bawipa ih hmin cu thangṭhat in um seh."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in miphun hmuahhmuah a uk; A sunlawinak cu van hnakin a saang sawn."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian bangtu zohman an um lo; Amah bangtuk ih a saang bikah um tahratin,"},"6":{"text":"Lei le van pawl suk zoh ih a run zoh theitu zoso a um ding?"},"7":{"text":"Mi farah pawl cu leivut lak ihsin a khaisaang ih, Mi tlasam pawl cu an harsatnak ihsin a cawi hai;"},"8":{"text":"Annih cu uktu pawl le bawi pawl ih hawipi ah a tuah hai a si."},"9":{"text":"Fa nei lo nucing pawl cu, An inn ah mithmai ṭhatnak a coter; Faate a pek ih an lung a awiter a si. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"}}},"114":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi Izipt ram ihsin an suah tikah, Jakob tefa pawl khi miphun dang ram an tlansan tikah,","title":"Lantak Puai Hla"},"2":{"text":"Judah cu Bawipa ih miphun thianghlim ah a cang ih, Israel cu amah ih ta ah a cang."},"3":{"text":"Tipi Sen in a hmuh tikah a tlan hlo; Jordan Tivapi cu luang loin a cawl."},"4":{"text":"Tlang saang pawl cu me bangin an pet; Tlang niam deuh pawl cu tuu bangin an khir."},"5":{"text":"Maw Tipi, ziang inso a lo tlan hloter? Maw Jordan, ziangah so luang loih na colh?"},"6":{"text":"Maw Tlang saang pawl, ziangah so me bangin nan pet? Maw Tlang niam pawl, ziangah so tuu bangin nan khir?"},"7":{"text":"Maw leilungpi, Bawipa a rat tikah khur aw; Jakob ih Pathian hmai ahcun."},"8":{"text":"Lungpi cu amah in ticawm ah a canter ih, ṭeklung tlangtluan pawl cu tipuut ah a canter a si."}}},"115":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na hnen lawngah, Kan hnenah si loin, Nangmah ih hnen lawngah, Sunlawinak cu pek siseh; A hmunmi na duhdawtnak le zumtlak na sinak ruangah hin.","title":"A Dikmi Pathian Pakhat"},"2":{"text":"“Khuiah so nan Pathian cu a si?” tiah ziangah so miphun dangdang pawl in in suut rero ding?"},"3":{"text":"Kan Pathian cu vancung ah a um ih a duh poh a tuah."},"4":{"text":"An khawzing pawl cu sui le ngun ih tuahmi, Milai kut ih tuahmi an si."},"5":{"text":"Kaa an nei naón an ṭong thei lo. Mit an nei naón an hmu thei lo."},"6":{"text":"Hna an nei naón an thei thei lo. Hnar an nei naón rim an thei thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Kut an nei naón an tham thei lo. Ke khal an nei naón an feh thei lo. An awn-au thiam lo."},"8":{"text":"Hi khawzing pawl a tuahtu le a rinsantu pawl cu, An tuahmi milem vekah cang thluh hai seh."},"9":{"text":"Maw Israel mi pawl, Bawipa rinsan uh! Amah cu a lo bawmtu le a lo humtu a si."},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian ih puithiam pawl, Bawipa rinsan uh! Amah cu a lo bawmtu le a lo humtu a si."},"11":{"text":"Maw Pathian ṭihzah tu pawl, Bawipa rinsan uh! Amah cu a lo bawmtu le a lo humtu a si."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa cun in thei ringring ih thlawsuahnak in pe ding. Israel mi le Pathian ih puithiam pawl cu Pathian in a thlawsuah hai ding."},"13":{"text":"Amah a ṭihzahtu cu a tum a seen in a thluasuah hai ding."},"14":{"text":"Nanmah le na tesinfa pawl cu Bawipa in tefa lo pe hram seh."},"15":{"text":"Lei le van tuahtu Bawipa in Thlawsuah lo pe hram seh."},"16":{"text":"Van khi Bawipa ih ta an si; Amah ih ta lawnglawng an si ṭheh. Asinain leilung cu minung kutah a pek."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa cu mithi pawl in an thangṭhat lo; ṭong thei lonak hmun a thlengtu pawl cun an thangṭhat lo a si."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kannih a minung pawl cun atu le kumkhua in amah kan thangṭhat ding. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"}}},"116":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka duh; Ka thlacamnak le zaangfah ka dilnak a theih ruangah.","title":"A Dam Saal Mi Ih Lungawinak"},"2":{"text":"Ka kawh tinte ka aw a thei."},"3":{"text":"Thihnak cun a hridai in i run ngerh ih, ṭihnungza thlaan in i naih deuhdeuh ruangah, Donharnak le ṭihphannak in ka khat."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka ko ih, “Maw Bawipa , zaangfah ka lo dil, i run hram aw,” ka ti."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ṭha ih zaangfahnak a nei; Kan Pathian cu zaangfah lainatnak in a khat."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in bawmtu nei lo pawl cu a hum; ṭihphannak hmun ihsin i luatter."},"7":{"text":"Maw ka nunnak, hnangamte in cawl aw, Ziangahtile Bawipa cun ka zawn i ruat ringring a si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cun thihnak ihsin i luatter; Ka mitthli a hulter ih ka ke khal tlukbahnak ihsin a luatter."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa ih hmaiah ka feh ih, A nungmi pawl ih ram ahcun ka leeng."},"10":{"text":"“Ka cem riai a si hi,” ka ti hmanah ka zumnak a der cuang lo."},"11":{"text":"Ṭihphannak ka neih ih, “Zumtlak zohman an um lo,” ka ti hmanah ka rinnak cu a ṭum cuang lo."},"12":{"text":"Ka parih a ṭhat ruangah hin Bawipa cu ziangso ka pek ve ding?"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in i run ruangah A hnenah in ding thawinak ka pe ding ih a hmin ka ko ding."},"14":{"text":"A hnenih ka kam ciami cu A minung pawl tonkhawmnak ah amah ka pe ding."},"15":{"text":"Amah ih minung pakhatkhat an thih tikah, Bawipa ih hrangah ziangtluk in so a man a khun?"},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , kei hi na siahhlawh ka si; Ka nu vekin kei khal in nangmah ka lo rian; Nangmah in zalennak i pe zo."},"17":{"text":"Lungawi thawinak ka lo pe ding, Na hmin cu ka ko ding."},"18":{"text":"Na minung pawl an tonkhawmnak le Jerusalem ih na Biakinn khaan sungah,"},"19":{"text":"Na hnenih ka tiamkam ciami cu Ka lo pe ding a si. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"}}},"117":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw miphun hmuahhmuah tla, Bawipa thangṭhat uh! Mi hmuahhmuah in Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!","title":"Pathian Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"A duhdawtnak cu kan hrangah a fek ih, Rintlak a sinak cu kumkhua in a hmun a si. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"}}},"118":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah lungawi thu sim uh; Ziangahtile amah cu a ṭha, A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun a si.","title":"Nehnak Hrang Lungawi Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in, “A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun,” ti hai seh."},"3":{"text":"Pathian ih puithiam pawl in, “A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun,” ti hai seh."},"4":{"text":"Amah a ṭihzahtu pawl in, “A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun,” ti hai seh."},"5":{"text":"Ka harsat laiah Bawipa cu ka ko; Ka kawhnak a thei ih luatnak i pek."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka hnenah a um; Zianghman ka ṭih lo ding. Milai in ka parah ziangso an tuah thei ding?"},"7":{"text":"I bawmtu cu Bawipa amah a si; Ka ral an sun kha ka mit in ka hmu ding."},"8":{"text":"Milai rinsan hnakin Bawipa rinsan a ṭha sawn."},"9":{"text":"Leilung uktu pawl rinsan hnakin Bawipa rinsan a ṭha sawn."},"10":{"text":"Ka ral pawl ka kiangkap ah an um ṭheh; Asinain Bawipa ih huham in ka siatsuah ṭheh hai."},"11":{"text":"Ka kimvel in in kulh ṭheh; Asinain Bawipa ih cahnak in ka cemter ṭheh hai."},"12":{"text":"Khuai bangin in herh ciamco; Asinain hrambur meisa kaang bang in an kaang ṭheh. Bawipa ih huham in ka siatsuah ṭheh hai a si."},"13":{"text":"Neh ding rori in nasa zetin in do ih ih neh cuahco; Asinain Bawipa in i bawm."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in huham neizet le cakzet ah i tuah; Amah cu i runtu a si."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa ih minung pawl an puanthlam ihsin nehnak lungawi ih an au ciamco cu ngaihnik uh; “ Bawipa ih baan thacak in a neh zo."},"16":{"text":"A huham in nehnak in pe zo; A ral nehnak huham cak cun!” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Ka thi lo ding, ka dam ding ih Bawipa ih thil tuahmi pawl ka aupi ding."},"18":{"text":"Nasa zetin i hrem zo; Asinain i thiter siang lo a si."},"19":{"text":"Ka hrangah dingfelnak kotka i on sak hram uh; Ka lut ding ih Bawipa ih hnenah lungawi thu ka sim ding."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa ih kotka cu hihi a si; A dingmi lawng an lut thei ding."},"21":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka aunak aw i thei ih, Nehnak i pek ruangah ka lo thangṭhat a si."},"22":{"text":"Inn saktu pawl in santlai lo, ti ih an hnonmi lungto cu, A ṭhahnem bikmi lungto ah a cang zo."},"23":{"text":"Cumi cu Bawipa ih tuahmi a si; Zohthanungza a va si so!"},"24":{"text":"Tuih ni hi Bawipa ih tuahmi ni a si; Lungawi aipuang in um uhsi!"},"25":{"text":"In hum aw, Bawipa, in hum hram aw; Maw Bawipa , hlawhtlinnak in pe hram aw!"},"26":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmin in a rami cu, Pathian in thlawsuah hram seh! Bawipa ih Biakinn ihsin thlawsuahnak kan lo pek."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa cu Pathian a si; Kan hnenah tleunak in pe zo. Nan kutah thinghnge keng in puai cu tuah uhla, Biakṭheng cu heel rero uh."},"28":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka Pathian na si ih, Lungawinak thu ka sim ding; Na maksaknak ka tlang-au pi ding."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah lungawi thu sim uh, Ziangahtile a mah cu a ṭha; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun a si."}}},"119":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A nunnak ah soisel ding a um lo mi le, Bawipa ih daan vekih a nungtu pawl cu mi lungawi an si.","title":"Ih Daan"},"2":{"text":"A thinlung zate in Bawipa ih thu a ngaitu le, A thupekmi pawl a thluntu cu mi lungawi an si."},"3":{"text":"Asi, thilsual zianghman tuah loin Bawipa ih lamzin ahcun an feh."},"4":{"text":"Na daan pawl cu in pe zo ih Felte ih thlun dingah in tiam zo."},"5":{"text":"Na daan terek pawl tiangin, Felte in thlun thei ningla ka va duh so!"},"6":{"text":"Taima zetih na thukham pawl ka thlun ahcun, Ningzak in ka um lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Thinlung thiang in ka lo thangṭhat ding, Na thuṭhennak felzia ka theih hnu ahcun!"},"8":{"text":"Na daan pawl cu ka thlun ding; I taanta hram hlah aw!"},"9":{"text":"Ziangtin so mino in ziaza thiang a neih thei ding? Na thupekmi thlun lawngin a nei thei ding.","title":"Ih Daan Thlunnak"},"10":{"text":"Ka thinlung zatein nangmah lo rian dingah ka pe-aw, Na thukham pialsan lo dingah i kilkhawi aw."},"11":{"text":"Ka thinlung sungah na daan cu ka ret zo, Na parih ka sual lonak dingah."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah ka lo thangṭhat; Na daan pawl i zirh hram aw."},"13":{"text":"Na thukham in pekmi pawl cu ring zetin ka saal ringring ding."},"14":{"text":"Sumsaw tampi neih hnakin Na thupekmi thlun ah ka lung a nuam sawn."},"15":{"text":"Na nunsimnak cu ka zir ding ih, Na thuzirhmi pawl cu ka ruat ṭha ding."},"16":{"text":"Na daan pekmi ah lungawinak ka nei ih, Na thupekmi pawl cu ka hngilh lo ding."},"17":{"text":"Ka nundam ih na thu ka thlun theinak dingah, Kei na siahhlawh parah hin ṭha hram aw.","title":"Ih Daan-ah Lungawinak"},"18":{"text":"Na daan sungah mangbangza thudik ka hmuh theinak dingah ka mit cu vaangter hram aw."},"19":{"text":"Leitlun ahhin rei lote sung lawng ka um; Ka hnen ihsin na thukham cu thup hram hlah aw."},"20":{"text":"Na thuṭhennak theih ka duh ringring ruangah, Ka thinlung cu mei bangin a hlio ringring."},"21":{"text":"Mi puarthau na kawk hai ih Na thupekmi a pahtu pawl cu, Siat na serh hai a si."},"22":{"text":"Na thukham ka thlun zo ruangah ka parih hmuhsuam le nautatnak an neihmi in i luatter hram aw."},"23":{"text":"Hotu pawl an tonkhawm ih in phiar rero hmanah, Kei na siahhlawh in na daan cu ka zir thotho ding."},"24":{"text":"Na thuzirhmi pawl cu lungawinak i petu an si ih ruahnak ṭha i petu khal an si."},"25":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu leivut lakah namnuai in a um; Na thutiam cia vekin ka tha tlungter sal hram aw.","title":"Ih Daan Thlun Tumnak"},"26":{"text":"Ka tuah mi hmuahhmuah ka phuang ih nang in i thei; Na thupekmi pawl i zirh hram aw."},"27":{"text":"Na daan thlun thei dingah i zirh awla, Mangbangza na thuzirhmi cu feltein ka ruat ṭha ding."},"28":{"text":"Riahsiatnak ruangah ka thinlung a zup ṭheh; Na thutiam cia vekin ka tha tlungter sal hram aw."},"29":{"text":"Zin peeng ka zawh lonak dingah i kilveng aw; Na ṭhat ruangah na daan cu i zirh aw."},"30":{"text":"Na thu thluntu si dingah ka ruat cat zo; Na thukham pawl cu ka hmai ah ka ret zo."},"31":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thuzirhmi pawl cu ka thlun zo; Mualpho in i ret hram hlah aw."},"32":{"text":"Nangmah in theihthiamnak i pek ding ruangah, Na thupekmi cu thatho zetin ka thlun ding."},"33":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thupekmi ih tican i sim awla, Ziangtik khalah cat loin ka thlun ringring ding.","title":"Daan Theihthiamnak Hrangih Thlacamnak"},"34":{"text":"Na daan pawl cu i zirh fiang awla ka thlun hai ding; Ka thinlung zate in ka thlun ding."},"35":{"text":"Na thukham thlun thei dingah i hruai aw; Ziangahtile cutawkah lungawinak ka ngah a si."},"36":{"text":"Lennak duhtu si loin na thupekmi thlun duhtu sawn i siter aw."},"37":{"text":"Thil ṭhahnem lo a hawl rerotu Ka si lonak dingah i kilkhawi aw. Na thutiam cia vekin ka parah ṭha hram aw."},"38":{"text":"Nangmah a lo ṭihzahtu pawl hnenih na thukamnak cu, Kei na siahhlawh hnen ahhin kimter hram aw."},"39":{"text":"Ka ṭihzetmi nautatnak ihsin i luatter hram aw; Na thupekmi pawl cu mangbangza ngaingai an si!"},"40":{"text":"Na thupekmi cu ka sunsak a si; A dingmi na si ruangah i nungter hram aw."},"41":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i duhdawtnak a maksakzia langter hram aw, Na thutiam cia bangtuk in i run hram aw.","title":"Ih Daan Rinsannak"},"42":{"text":"Cuticun i nautattu pawl cu An thu ka sawn thei hai ding; Ziangahtile na ṭongkam cu ka rinsan a si."},"43":{"text":"Thudik a sim ngam ringringtu si dingah thazaang i pe aw; Ziangahtile na thuṭhennak khi ka beiseimi a si."},"44":{"text":"Na daan pawl cu ka thlun ringring ding; Kumkhua cat nawn loin ka thlun ding a si."},"45":{"text":"Na thupekmi pawl thlun dingih ka hawl suak ruangah, A famkimmi zalennak sungah ka nung ding."},"46":{"text":"Na thupekmi cu siangpahrang pawl hnenah ka than ding; Ka zahpi hrimhrim lo ding."},"47":{"text":"Na thukham pawl thlun cu ka diriamnak a si. Ziangahtile ka ngainatmi an si."},"48":{"text":"Na thukham pawl cu Ka uar mi le ka duhmi an si; Na thupekmi cu ka thinlung ah ka ruat ṭha ringring ding."},"49":{"text":"Na siahhlawh kei ka hnenih, Na thutiam cu hngilh hram hlah aw; Beiseinak i neihter zo.","title":"Ih Daan-ah Lungkimnak"},"50":{"text":"Ka vansaan caan hmanah i hnemtu a si; Ziangahtile na thutiam in nunnak i pek."},"51":{"text":"Mi puarthau pawl in in hmuhsuam; Asinain na daan pekmi ihsin ka pial dah lo."},"52":{"text":"Kan dung caan reipi laiih i pekmi na thu pawl cu, ka ciing ringring; Maw Bawipa , ka hrangah hneemtu an si."},"53":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl in na daan an balsiat kha ka hmuh tikah, Ka thin a heng ngaingai."},"54":{"text":"Hi leitlun khual ka tlawnnak ramah hin, Na thukham pawl cu ka hlasakmi an si."},"55":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , zan khalah nangmah ka lo ruat ih, Na daan khal ka ruat a si."},"56":{"text":"Na thupekmi thlun cu Ka lungawinak a si."},"57":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka duhmi cu nangmah lawng na si; Na daan thlun dingah thu ka kam zo.","title":"Ih Daan Tlaihsannak"},"58":{"text":"Ka thinlung taktein ka lo ngen a si; Na thutiam cia bangin, Ka parah zaangfahnak nei hram aw."},"59":{"text":"Ka nunnak ih a zawhmi lamzin hi ka zoh sal ih, Na thupek thlun dingah ka lo kam a si."},"60":{"text":"Khulfung loin na thukham thlun dingah zamrang in ka tho."},"61":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cun an thang in fekzet in in khit; Asinain na thupekmi ka hngilh lo."},"62":{"text":"Zanṭim ah ka ihnak ihsin ka ṭhang; A dingmi na thuṭhennak thangṭhat dingah."},"63":{"text":"Na daan a thluntu le A lo riantu hmuahhmuah ih rualpi ka si."},"64":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , leilung pumpi hi a hmunmi na duhdawtnak in a khat. Na thukham pawl i zirh hram aw."},"65":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thutiammi cu na kimter ih, Kei na siahhlawh hnenah na ṭha a si.","title":"Ih Daan Man A Nei"},"66":{"text":"Fimnak le thuruah thiamnak i pe hram aw; Ziangahtile na thukham ka rinsan a si."},"67":{"text":"Hrem ka si hlan ahcun zinpeng ka zawh ṭheu; Asinain atu ahcun na thu ka thlun."},"68":{"text":"Na ṭhatzia le mi na zaangfah zia cu! Na thukham pawl i zirh hram aw."},"69":{"text":"Mi hngal pawl in ka thu cu Thuphan hlir in an rel; Asinain ka thinlung zate in na daan cu ka thlun."},"70":{"text":"Hi bangtuk minung pawl cun Theihthiamnak an nei lo; Asinain na daan sungah lungawinak ka nei."},"71":{"text":"I hremnak cu ka hrangah a ṭha; Ziangahtile na thupekmi i zirter a si."},"72":{"text":"I pekmi na daan cu leilung pumpi ih sui le ngun hmuahhmuah hnakin ka hrangah a sunglawi sawn."},"73":{"text":"Nangmah in i seemsuah ih nangmah in himte in i kilveng; Na daan pawl ka zirnak dingah ruahthiamnak thinlung i pe hram aw.","title":"Ih Daan Cu A Ding"},"74":{"text":"A lo ṭihzahtu pawl cun In hmuh tikah an lung a awi ding; Ziangahtile na thu cu ka rinsan."},"75":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thupekmi pawl cu an dik a si ti ka thei; Zumtlak na si ruangah I hrem a si ti khal ka thei."},"76":{"text":"Kei na siahhlawh i tiamkam cia vekin, A hmunmi na duhdawtnak in i hneem hram seh."},"77":{"text":"I zaangfah awla ka nung ding; Ziangahtile na daan sungah ka lung a awi a si."},"78":{"text":"Mi puarthau pawl in, Sual in puh ruangah an ningzak seh; Kei cun ka thinlung sungah, Na daan pawl cu ka ruat ṭha ding."},"79":{"text":"Na thupekmi a theitu pawl le Nangmah a lo ṭihzahtu pawl cu ka hnenah ra hai seh."},"80":{"text":"Ningzak mualpho ih ka um ve lonak dingah, Na thukham cu famkim zetin thlun thei hram ning law!"},"81":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah runnak Ka hngahnak ah ka hnang ṭheh; Na thu cu ka rinsan fawn si!","title":"Luatnak Hrangih Thlacam"},"82":{"text":"Na thutiammi ka zoh-nakah Ka mit a kham ṭheh zo; “Ziangtik ah so i bom ding?” tiah sut loin ka um thei fawn lo!"},"83":{"text":"An hlon ciami savun sabit thawl vekin santlai lo ka si; Asinain na thupekmi cu ka hngilh hrih lo."},"84":{"text":"Ziangtik tiangso ka lo hngah hrih ding? I hremtu pawl hi ziangtik ah so na hrem ve hai ding?"},"85":{"text":"Na daan a thlun lotu mi hngal pawl in, Ka tlaknak dingah khur tampi an lai."},"86":{"text":"Na thukham pawl cu rintlak zet hlir an si; Mi hngal pawl cun thuphan hlir in in hrem zok rero; I bawm hram aw."},"87":{"text":"Atu-ah cun in that thei zik ngaingai thlang; Asinain na thupekmi pawl cu ka daithlan cuang lo."},"88":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak ruangah Ka parah ṭha hram aw. Cuticun na daan pawl cu ka thlun thei ding."},"89":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thu cu kumkhua in a hmun ding; Vancung ih a hnget zomi thu a si.","title":"Ih Daan Zumnak"},"90":{"text":"Zum tlak na sinak cu Sankhat hnu sankhat a hmun; Leilungpi hi nangmah in na retih Na retnak ihsin a ṭhawn dah lo."},"91":{"text":"Ziang hmuahhmuah na thupek vekin tuih sun tiang an hmun; Ziangahtile an zatein a lo riantu an si."},"92":{"text":"Na daan pawl hi ka lungawinak ih hrampi sihlah sehla, Ka zonzaihnak ah ka thi zo ding."},"93":{"text":"Na thupekmi pawl ziangtik hmanah ka daithlan lo ding; Ziangahtile cupawl cu na hmang ih nunnak i pek."},"94":{"text":"Kei cu na ta ka si, I run hram aw. Na thupekmi thlun ding lawng ka tummi a si."},"95":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl in thah dingah in bawh; Asinain na daan cu ka thinlung in ka ruat ṭha ding."},"96":{"text":"A famkimmi zianghman a um lo, ti ka thei zo; Asinain na thukham cu a famkim a si."},"97":{"text":"Aw, na daan pawl ka duh zia cu! Sun nihlawh in acu lawng ka ruat!","title":"Ih Daan Ka Duh"},"98":{"text":"Na thukham cu ka hnenah a caam ringring; Ka ral pawl hmuahhmuah hnakin i fimter deuh a si."},"99":{"text":"I zirhtu pawl hmuahhmuah hnakin ka thei deuh, Na thuzirhmi pawl ka ruah ṭha ruangah."},"100":{"text":"Patar pawl hnakin ka fim deuh, Na thupekmi ka thlun ruangah."},"101":{"text":"Ziaza ṭha lo cu ka hrial zo, Na thu thlun ka duh ruangah."},"102":{"text":"Na thuzirhmi ka daithlan lo, I zirhtu nangmah na si ruangah."},"103":{"text":"Na thupekmi pawl an thlum zia cu! Khuaitizu hnakin an thlum sawn."},"104":{"text":"Na thukham pawl ihsin fimnak ka ngah ih, Nuncan ṭha lo hmuahhmuah cu ka hua a si."},"105":{"text":"Na thu cu ka ke hrangah mei-inn a si ih, Ka lamzin hrangah tleunak a si.","title":"Ih Daan Ihsin Tleunak"},"106":{"text":"Siatcam ih thu ka kam vekin, A dikmi na thuzirhnak cu ka thlun ding."},"107":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka tuarzia cu a nasa ngaingai; I tiamkam zo vekin i nungter hram aw."},"108":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka lungawi thlacamnak cu saang hram awla, Na thupekmi cu i zirh hram aw."},"109":{"text":"Nitin ka nunnak pe dingin ka tiar aw; Na daan pawl ka hngilh lo a si."},"110":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl in ka hrangah thang an kam; Asinain na thupekmi pawl cu ka pah lo."},"111":{"text":"Na thukham pawl cu kumkhua in ka ta an si; Ka thinlung nuamtertu an si."},"112":{"text":"Na thupekmi pawl cu ka thih ni tiangih thlun dingah, ka ruat cat zo a si."},"113":{"text":"Na hnenih thinlung reprai Nei lotu pawl cu ka mit an kem; Asinain na daan cu ka duh.","title":"Ih Daan Ah Himnak"},"114":{"text":"Nang cu ka beunak le ka ralphaw na si; Na thutiam ah beiseinak ka nei."},"115":{"text":"Maw misual pawl, ka hnen ihsin tlan uh; Ka Pathian ih thukham pawl cu ka thlun ding."},"116":{"text":"I kam cia vekin thazaang i pe awla ka nung ding; Ka ruahsannak ah ka riah i siatter hlah aw."},"117":{"text":"I kai awla ka him ding; Cule na thupekmi pawl cu ka seherh ringring ding."},"118":{"text":"Na daan a pahtu pawl cu na hnon hai; An mibum thiamnak cu a lak a si."},"119":{"text":"Mi tha lo pawl cu hnawmhne tlukah na ruat hai; Curuangah na thuzirhnak cu ka duh zet."},"120":{"text":"Nangmah ih ruangah ka thin a phang; Na thuṭhennak ruangah ṭihnak in ka khat."},"121":{"text":"A dikmi le a ṭhami cu ka tuah zo; Ka ral pawl ih kut sungah i taanta hlah aw.","title":"Ih Daan Thlun Theinak"},"122":{"text":"Ka lo bawm ding tiah, Na siahhlawh kei hi i tiam aw; Mi puarthau pawl in i neh-nen hlah hai seh."},"123":{"text":"Na runnak le bomnak zoh ah ka mit a kham ṭheh zo; Na tiam ciami luatnak ka zohnak ah!"},"124":{"text":"A hmunmi na duhdawtnak thawn i zoh awla, Na thupekmi pawl i zirh aw."},"125":{"text":"Kei hi na siahhlawh ka si, Theihthiamnak i pe aw; Na thuzirhmi pawl ka theih theinak dingah."},"126":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na hnaṭuan thok a cu thlang, Milai in na daan an pah vivo!"},"127":{"text":"Na thukham cu sui hnakin ka duh sawn; Leitlun ih sui ṭha bik hnakin."},"128":{"text":"Curuangah na thuzirhmi pawl hmuahhmuah ka thlun ih, Um daan dik lo pawl cu ka hua."},"129":{"text":"Na thuzirhmi pawl cu mangbangza in an ṭha; Curuangah ka thinlung zate in ka thlun.","title":"Ih Daan Thlun Duhnak"},"130":{"text":"Na thuzirh fiangtermi in tleunak a pek; Mi lungmol hnenah fimnak a pek a si."},"131":{"text":"Na thupekmi pawl ka hiar tuk ruangah, Ka kaa ang in tidai haal in ka haal."},"132":{"text":"Nangmah a lo duhtu pawl na zaangfah bangin, Ka lam hoi awla i zaangfah hram aw."},"133":{"text":"I tiamkam cia bangin i bahter hram hlah aw; ṭhat lonak ih uk ding cu i siang hram hlah aw."},"134":{"text":"I neh-nentu pawl ih kut ihsin i hum awla, Na thupekmi cu ka thlun ding."},"135":{"text":"Na mithmai ṭha cu ka parah, Ni bangin tlangter awla, Na daan pawl cu i zirh hram aw."},"136":{"text":"Ka mitthli cu tidai bangin a luang; Milai in na daan an thlun lo ruangah."},"137":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nang cu a dingmi na si ih, Na thupekmi khal an dik.","title":"Ih Daan A Dingzia"},"138":{"text":"Na thuzirhmi cu an fel ih, Rintlak an si ih an ṭha."},"139":{"text":"Ka thinhengnak cu meivam bangin a ling, Ka ral pawl in na thukham an poisat lo ruangah."},"140":{"text":"Na thukam cu ziangtluk in so rintlak a si! Na siahhlawh in ziangtluk in so ka duh!"},"141":{"text":"Mi nauta le nautatmi ka si naón, Na thupekmi pawl cu ka daithlan lo."},"142":{"text":"Na dingnak cu kumkhua in a dingmi an si ih, Na daan cu an dik ringring."},"143":{"text":"Harsatnak le donharnak in ka khat; Asinain na thukham in lungawinak i pek."},"144":{"text":"Na thuzirhnak cu kumkhua in a dik; Theihthiamnak i pe awla ka nung ding."},"145":{"text":"Ka thinlung taktein ka lo ko; Maw Bawipa , i sawn awla na thu ka thlun ding.","title":"Luatnak Hrang Thlacamnak"},"146":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka lo ko; I hum awla na daan ka thlun ding."},"147":{"text":"Khua a van hlan ihsin, Na bomnak dil in ka lo ko; Na thukam ah beiseinak ka nei."},"148":{"text":"Zanvarte itthat loin ka um; Na thuzirhmi pawl ngaihtuahnak ah!"},"149":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na duhdawtnak ruangah i run ngai hram aw! Na ṭhatnak ruangah ka nunnak cu zuah hram aw!"},"150":{"text":"Mi zaangfah nei lo i hremtu pawl cun in naih deuhdeuh; Na daan a thlun dah lotu pawl cun!"},"151":{"text":"Asinain maw Bawipa , nang cu ka kiangah na um; Na thukam cu kumkhua hrang a si."},"152":{"text":"Na thuzirhmi cu hlanlaipi in ka zir zo; Kumkhua daih ih na pekmi an si."},"153":{"text":"Ka harsatnak hi zoh awla i run aw; Na daan cu ka daithlan dah lo!","title":"Runnak Hrang Dilnak"},"154":{"text":"I ṭan awla i luatter hram aw; Na thutiam cia vekin nundamnak i pe aw."},"155":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu runmi an si lo ding; Na daan an thlun dah lo ruangah!"},"156":{"text":"Asinain maw Bawipa , Na lainatnak cu a tum ngaingai; I zaangfah awla i run hram aw."},"157":{"text":"I raltu le i hremtu tampi an um; Asinain na daan cu thlun loin ka um dah lo!"},"158":{"text":"Mi phiartu pawl ka hmuh tikah, Ka mit an kem nasa; Na thupekmi an thlun dah fawn lo!"},"159":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thuzirhmi ka duh zia hi zohhnik! A hmunmi na duhdawtnak ruangah i hum hram aw."},"160":{"text":"Na daan ih muruh cu thutak a si; A dikmi na thukham pawl cu kumkhua in an hmun."},"161":{"text":"Ziang thu hman um loin, Mi upa cak zetzet pawl in in raal; Asinain ka upatmi cu na daan lawng a si.","title":"Daan Sungih Thinlung Peknak"},"162":{"text":"Na thukam ruangah ziangtluk in so ka lung a awi; Thilri mankhung sartu bangin."},"163":{"text":"Thuphan hmuahhmuah cu ka hua ih ka fih; Asinain na daan cu ka ngaina."},"164":{"text":"Na hnenah nitin voi sarih lungawinak thu ka sim, Na thuṭhennak a fel ruangah."},"165":{"text":"Na daan a duhtu pawl cu, Humhimnak famkim an ngah; Zianghman in a bahter thei hai lo a si."},"166":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i run dingah ka lo hngak; Na thupekmi ka thlun a si."},"167":{"text":"Na daan pawl cu ka thlun hai; Ka thinlung zate in ka duh a si."},"168":{"text":"Na thupekmi le na thuzirhmi pawl cu ka thlun; Ka tuahmi hmuahhmuah na hmu ṭheh a si."},"169":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , bomnak dil ih ka aunak cu, Na hnenah thleng hram seh. Na thutiam vekin theihthiamnak i pe aw.","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacam"},"170":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak cu na hmaiah thleng hram seh; Na thutiam vekin i run hram aw."},"171":{"text":"Cat loin ka lo thangṭhat ding; Na thu i zirh zo ruangah."},"172":{"text":"Na daan cu hla in ka sa ding; Na thupekmi pawl an dik ruangah."},"173":{"text":"Keimah bawm dingah tiar cia in um hram aw; Na thukham ka thlun ruangah."},"174":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na runnak ka ngai zia cu! Na daan sung lawngah lungawinak ka nei a si!"},"175":{"text":"Nunnak i pe hram aw, Ka lo thangṭhat ringring ding; Na thuzirhmi in i bawm hram seh."},"176":{"text":"A hlomi tuu vekin ka vakvai; Ra awla kei na siahhlawh hi i ra hawl hram aw; Na thupekmi ka daithlan lo a si."}}},"120":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangbang vansaang ih ka um laiah Bawipa ka ko; Cule amah in i let.","title":"Bom Dilnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , thuphanper le mibum hmang pawl hnen ihsin, i run hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Maw thuphanper pawl, Pathian in ziangtinso a lo ti hai ding? Ziangtin so a lo hrem daan ding cu!"},"4":{"text":"A hriam zetmi ralkap conkiang le A sen zetmi meivam thawn."},"5":{"text":"Nan lakih um cu Meshek ram ih um tlukin a har, Asilole Kedar mi pawl hnenih um tlukin a har a si."},"6":{"text":"Remnak a huatu pawl hnenah Rei tuk ka um zo."},"7":{"text":"Rem thu ka rel tinte in Ral-awknak thu an rel ve a si."}}},"121":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tlangpar khi ka hei cuan; Khui-inso bomnak ka hnenah a rat ding?","title":"Cu I Humtu A Si"},"2":{"text":"Keimah bomnak cu Bawipa ih hnen ihsin a ra; Lei le van tuahtu Bawipa ih hnen in."},"3":{"text":"Amah cun a lo bahter lo ding. A lo humtu cu a itthat lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Israel mi humtu cu a itthat dah lo; A sing khal a sing dah lo."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in a lo kilveng ding; Nangmah lo hum dingah na kiangah a um."},"6":{"text":"Sun ah ni in a lo siatsuah lo ding ih, Zan ah thlapi khal in a lo tuahmawh lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Ṭihphannak hmuahhmuah ihsin, Bawipa in a lo hum ding. Thlaphang lotein a lo humhim ding."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cun na suah le na luh ah a lo kilveng ding; A tu le kumkhua in."}}},"122":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“ Bawipa ih innah feh uhsi!” in ti tikah ka lung a awi.","title":"Jerusalem Lomnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Atu ah hinah kan um; Jerusalem kotka sungah kan ding."},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi cu mawizet le remzet ih tundin salmi a si."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupek vek in Israel hrin pawl cun, Bawipa hnenih lungawinak pe dingah an rat ṭheunak khawpi a si."},"5":{"text":"Hi khawsungah bawi thuṭhennak tokham a um ih, Siangpahrang in a minung pawl thu ṭhen in a tonak hmun a si."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem daihnak hrangah thlacam uh: “Nangmah a lo duhtu pawl cu ṭhangso hai seh;"},"7":{"text":"Na khua kulhnak hruang sungah daihnak um sehla, Na siangpahrang inn sungah himnak um hram seh,” ti in."},"8":{"text":"Ka sungkhat le ka hawipi pawl ruangah Jerusalem hnenah, “Daihnak na hnenah um ko seh,” tiah ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian ih innsang zawn ruat in, Neinung zetih na umnak dingah ka dil a si."}}},"123":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na tonak hmun Vancung lam cu ka hun thlir.","title":"Zaangfahnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Hnen-umpa in a bawipa a rinsan bangtuk le Zawng-umnu in a bawinu a rinsan bangtuk in, Bawipa kan Pathian, nangmah lawng kan lo rinsan; Kan parih zaangfahnak na neih lai hlan lo kan lo thlir a si."},"3":{"text":"In zaangfah aw, maw Bawipa , In zaangfah hram aw. Nautatnak kan tuar tuk zo si!"},"4":{"text":"Milian pawl in caan rei tuk in hnihsan zo ih, In neh-nentu mi hngal pawl in in hmuhsuam tuk zo."}}},"124":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu kan lamah ṭang hlah sehla, Ziang kan cang ding? Maw Israel!","title":"A Milai Pawl Runtu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"“ Bawipa cu kan lam ah ṭang hlah sehla, Kan ral pawl in in do tikah,"},"3":{"text":"Kan parih an thinhengnak nasa zet thawn, Kan nung cungin in dolh hlo thluh zo ding."},"4":{"text":"Cule tilik cun in fen hlo ding ih, Tidai sungah kan pil hlo thluh zo ding."},"5":{"text":"Tilian in in phim ṭheh zo ding,” tiah ti aw."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah lungawi thu sim uhsi; Kan ral pawl in bauhthlek thluh loih in humtu, Bawipa hnenah cun!"},"7":{"text":"Thangkamtu ih thang sung ihsin, A suakmi vate bangin kan suak. Thang cu khiah ṭheh a si ih kan luat thei a si."},"8":{"text":"Kan hrangih bomnak cu Bawipa hnen ihsin a ra; Lei le van tuahtu Bawipa hnen ihsin!"}}},"125":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa a rinsantu pawl cu ṭhawn theih lo le hnin theih lomi Zion tlang bangtuk an si.","title":"Pathian Ih Minung Pawl Himnak"},"2":{"text":"Tlang pawl cun Jerusalem an kulhvel bangin, Bawipa cu a minung pawl ih kimvel ah, Atu le kumkhua in a um a si."},"3":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo in Pathian minung pawl ih ram cu, An uk ringring lo ding. An uk ringring asile Pathian ih minung pawl in ṭhat lonak an tuah ve pang ding."},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , mi ṭha hnen ahcun ṭha ve awla, Na thupekmi a thluntu pawl hnen khalah ṭha hram aw."},"5":{"text":"Misual pawl na hrem hai tikah, An lamzin ṭha lo a thluntu pawl cu hrem ve hai aw. Israel ram ah daihnak um hram seh."}}},"126":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Zion ih in thlenpi sal tikah cun, mang lam vek a si.","title":"Luatnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Kan hni kan kheek ih lungawi in hla kan sak; Kan kiangkap ih miphun dangdang pawl in, “ Bawipa in an hrang ah thil maksak a tuah,” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Asi, kan hrangah thil nasa zetzet a tuah a si; Kan lung a awi zia cu!"},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ruah na surter ih Negeb tiva ah, Tidai a luan sal bangtuk in, Mi neinung in siter sal hram aw."},"5":{"text":"Mitthli thawn thlaici vorhtu in Lungawi zetin an khawm sal ding."},"6":{"text":"Ṭap phah in thlaici vorh ih a fehtu pawl cu, Lungawinak hla sak in, Fangteel thawn in an kir sal ding."}}},"127":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in inn cu a sak lo ahcun, Inn saktu pawl ih hnaṭuan cu a lak a si. Bawipa in khawpi cu a kil lo ahcun, Khua kiltu pawl ih kilvennak cu a lak a si.","title":"Pathian ṭhat Zia"},"2":{"text":"Nan pum cawmnak ah zingpit in nan tho ih, zanlam siimzet ah nan it. Zonzai ih hna nan ṭuanmi hi a lak a si. Ziangahtile Bawipa in a duhdawtmi hnenah cun, An ṭulmi cu an ihthat sung hmanah a pek a si."},"3":{"text":"Faate cu Bawipa ih laksawng an si; Amah ih malsawmnak an si."},"4":{"text":"No lai ih neihmi fapa cu, Ralkap ih kenmi conkiang bangtuk an si."},"5":{"text":"Cubangtuk conkiang tampi neitu cu mi lungawi an si. Thuṭhennak hmun ih a ral pawl thawn an ton awk tikah, A sung hrimhrim lo ding."}}},"128":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa a ṭihzahtu pawl le A thupekmi vekih a nungtu cu mi lungawi an si.","title":"Ih Thu Thlun Man"},"2":{"text":"Na ṭuan man theitlai khopkham in na ei ngah ding; Mi lungawi le mi neinung na si ding."},"3":{"text":"Na inn sungah na nupi cu a rah zetmi sabit hri vek a si ding; Na cabuai kimvelih na fapa tla Olif kung note vek an si ding."},"4":{"text":"Asi, Bawipa ih thu a ngaitu cu cubangtuk ih thlawsuahnak cotu a si ding."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Zion ihsin lo thlawsuah hram seh; Na nundam sung hmuahhmuah ah Jerusalem ih neihnunnak cu hmu hram aw."},"6":{"text":"Na fa ih faate pawl hmutu si hram aw. Israel ramah daihnak um hram seh."}}},"129":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Israel, na no lai ihsin na ral pawl in, Zaangfahnak nei loih an lo hremnak kha in sim hnik aw.","title":"Israel Ral Pawl Camnak"},"2":{"text":"“Ka no lai ihsin ka ral pawl in, Zaangfahnak zianghman um loin in hrem; Asinain in neh suak dah lo."},"3":{"text":"Ka zaang ah in dawt ih, Lei an leh bangin thuk zetzet in in rai."},"4":{"text":"Asinain a dingmi Bawipa cun Saltaannak ihsin in luatter zo,” ti aw."},"5":{"text":"Zion a huatu hmuahhmuah cu, ningzak in a sungmi le, a dawi kirmi si hai seh."},"6":{"text":"A ṭhan reh hlanih a vuai salmi, Inn parih a khomi hrampi bangtuk si hai seh."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hrampi cu zohman in an finkhawm lo ih, Fangteel bangin zohman in an phur fawn lo."},"8":{"text":"A kiangih fehtu zohman in, “ Bawipa in lo thlawsuah hram seh! Bawipa ih hmin in thlawsuah kan lo pe!” an ti lo ding."}}},"130":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka vansaannak hmun thukpi ihsin ka lo ko;","title":"Bomnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka lo kawhnak i ngaisak hram awla, Bomnak dil ih ka aunak i theih sak hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Kan sualnak pawl cu cazin sungah khum cila, Maw Bawipa , zoso sual thuṭhennak ihsin a luat ding?"},"4":{"text":"Asinain nang cun kan sualnak in ngaidam, Curuangah nangmah kan lo ṭihzah ding a si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa ih bomnak cu hngakhlap zetin ka hngak ih, Amah ih thu cu ka rinsan a si."},"6":{"text":"Ralvengtu in zinglam khawvan a hngakhlap vekin, Asi, ralvengtu in zinglam khawvan a hngakhlap hnak hman ih luar sawn in, Bawipa cu ka hngak a si."},"7":{"text":"Maw Israel, Bawipa rinsan aw; Ziangahtile a duhdawtnak cu a thleng aw dah lo ih, Milai run duhnak thinlung a nei ringring a si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung Israel mi pawl cu, An sualnak ihsin a run hai ding."}}},"131":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka hngalnak cu ka hlon zo ih, Ka puarthaunak khal ka taan zo. Ka hrangih thil thupi zetzet pawl le, Ka tuah thei lomi thil har zetzet pawl cu thil poimawh ah ka ruat nawn lo a si.","title":"Tangdornak Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Cu aiah thinnuam le lungdai in ka um zo. Naute cu a nu-ih ṭang sungih a hna a ngam vekin, Ka thinlung cu hnangamnak in a khat."},"3":{"text":"Maw Israel, Bawipa cu Atu le kumkhua in rinsan aw."}}},"132":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , David cu ciing ringring awla, A tuarmi hmuahhmuah khal hngilh hram hlah aw.","title":"Hmun Thianghlim Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Jakob ih Pathian, Cungnungbik Bawi, na hnenih thu a tiammi le siatcam ih thu a kammi cu ciing hram aw:"},"3":{"text":"“Inn ah ka tlung lo ding ih, Ihkhun khal ah ka kai lo ding;"},"4":{"text":"Ka cawl lo dingih a ih khal ka it lo ding;"},"5":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian Cungnungbik hrangih hmun ka hmuh hlan lo le, Bawipa hrangih umnak inn ka sak hlan ahcun,” a rak ti kha!"},"6":{"text":"Thukam Kuang thu cu Bethlehem in ka thei ih, Jearim ih lo sungah kan hmu zo."},"7":{"text":"“ Bawipa ih innah feh uhsila, A siangpahrang tokham hmaiah kun in bia uhsi,” kan ti."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na huham lang tertu na Thukam Kuang thawn, Na colhnak hmunah ra thlang awla, kumkhua in ra um aw."},"9":{"text":"Na puithiam pawl cu dingnak thawn thuam-aw hai sehla, Rintlak na minung pawl cu lungawi in au hai seh."},"10":{"text":"Na siahhlawh David hnenah thu na tiam zo; Maw Bawipa , na hril ciami siangpahrang cu hnong hlah aw."},"11":{"text":"David hnenah siatcam in thu na tiam zo ih, Na la kir sal lo ding: “Na fapa pawl sungin pakhat cu, Siangpahrang ah ka tuah ding; Na aiah siangpahrang a si ding."},"12":{"text":"Na fapa pawl in ka thukam an thlun ih, ka thupekmi pawl an ngai a si ahcun, Anmah ih fapa pawl khal na neh hnuah kumkhua in siangpahrang an ṭuan ding,” na rak ti kha!"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in Zion a hril zo; A umnak dingah a duh a si."},"14":{"text":"“hittawk ah kumkhua in ka um ding; Ka umnak hrangah ka duh a si."},"15":{"text":"Zion ih ṭulmi hmuahhmuah cu, Famkim zetin ka pe ko ding; A mi farah pawl ka cawm hai ding."},"16":{"text":"A puithiam pawl cu, An hnaṭuannak kipah ka thlawsuah ding ih, A minung pawl cu lungawi in an au ding ih hla an sak ding."},"17":{"text":"David ih tefa pakhat cu, Siangpahrang ka siter ding ih, Ka hrilmi siangpahrang ih uknak cu, hitawk ah ka hmunter ding."},"18":{"text":"A ral pawl cu ningzahnak in tuam hai ding; Asinain anih uknak cu a kau sinsin dingih, a ṭhangso vivo ding a si,” a ti."}}},"133":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian minung pawl unau bangin hmunkhat ih umtlang hi a ṭha in a va nuam so!","title":"Unau Duhdawtnak"},"2":{"text":"Aaron ih lu ihsin a khahmul le A korfual hngawng tiang, A luangmi olif hriak sunglawi bangtuk a si."},"3":{"text":"Hermon Tlang ih daitla, Zion tlangpar ih a rung tlami daitla bangtuk a si. Cutawkah Bawipa in thu in tiam ih thlawsuah in pek. Cuih a thlawsuah cu kumkhua nunnak a si."}}},"134":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih siahhlawh pawl le, Zan ih a Biakinn hnaṭuan pawl, Ra uhla Bawipa thangṭhat uh!","title":"Pathian Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Biakinn sungah kut thlir in thlacam uhla, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"},"3":{"text":"Lei le van tuahtu Bawipa in Zion ihsin lo thlawsuah hram seh."}}},"135":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa thangṭhat uh! Bawipa ih siahhlawh pawl, a hmin cu thangṭhat uh!","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih inn sung Kan Pathian hmun thianghlim ih a dingtu pawl, Bawipa ih hmin cu thangṭhat uh!"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh; Amah cu a ṭha a si! A hmin thangṭhatnak cu hla in sak uh; Zaangfahnak a neih ruangah."},"4":{"text":"Jakob cu amah ih hrangah a hril, Israel mi khal amah ih ta dingah a hril a si."},"5":{"text":"Kan Bawipa cu a maksak a si ti ka thei; Khawzing dang pawl hnakin a tum sawn a si."},"6":{"text":"Van le leilung ah siseh, Tipi le tipithuk hnuai ah siseh, Tuah a duhmi cu a tuah thei ṭheh a si."},"7":{"text":"Vanhram deng ihsin khawdur a rak keng ih, Ruah le thlipi hrangah lakah nimthlakau a tuah; A thilri retnak sung ihsin thli a suahter."},"8":{"text":"Izipt ram ah milai siseh, ṭilva siseh, An fatir hmuahhmuah a that ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Cutawkah khawruahhar le mangbangza a tuah ih, Faro le a kut hnuai bawi pawl a hrem."},"10":{"text":"Miphun tampi a siatsuah ih Siangpahrang cak zetzet pawl a that a si."},"11":{"text":"Amor siangpahrang Sihon, Bashan siangpahrang Og le Kanaan ram sung siangpahrang hmuahhmuah a that hai a si."},"12":{"text":"An ram cu amah ih minung, Israel mi hnenah a pek."},"13":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na hmin cu kumkhua in a thang ding; Sankhat hnu sankhat ah na thawm a thang ringring ding."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl a ṭan ding ih, A siahhlawh pawl parah lainatnak a nei ding."},"15":{"text":"Miphun dangdangih milem pawl cu, Sui le ngun in tuahmi an si. Milai kut ih tuahcopmi an si."},"16":{"text":"Kaa an nei naón an ṭong thei lo; Mit an nei naón an hmu thei lo."},"17":{"text":"Hna an nei naón an thei thei lo; Kaa an nei naón thaw an nei lo."},"18":{"text":"Cuih milem pawl a tuah ih a rinsantu pawl cu, An tuahmi milem bangtuk ah cang ṭheh hai seh!"},"19":{"text":"Maw Israel mi pawl, Bawipa thangṭhat uh! Maw Pathian ih puithiam pawl, amah cu cawimawi uh."},"20":{"text":"Maw Levi mi pawl, Bawipa thangṭhat uh! Amah a biatu in Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"},"21":{"text":"Bawipa cu Zion ah thangṭhat uh! A umnak Jerusalem ah cawimawi uh! Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko uh!"}}},"136":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah lungawinak thu sim uh; Ziangahtile amah cu a ṭha; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun.","title":"Lungawinak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Khawzing pawl lakih a tum bik Pathian hnenah lungawi thu sim uh; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"3":{"text":"Bawi hmuahhmuah lakih bawi bik hnenah lungawi thu sim uh; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"4":{"text":"Amah lawng in mangbangza a tuah; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"5":{"text":"A fimnak in van tla khi a tuah; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"6":{"text":"Leilung cu tithuukpi parah a dinter a si; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"7":{"text":"Amah in ni le thlapi khal a tuah; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"8":{"text":"Ni cu sun uktu ah a tuah; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"9":{"text":"Thlapi le arsi pawl zan uktu ah a tuah; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"10":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl ih fapa upa bik a that ṭheh, A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"11":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Izipt ram ihsin a hruai suak; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"12":{"text":"A ban thacak le a kut thawm lian in; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"13":{"text":"Tipi Sen cu a ṭhen awkter; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"14":{"text":"Cuih sung cun a minung pawl a hruai; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"15":{"text":"Faro le a ralkap pawl cu, Ti sungah a pilter ṭheh hai; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"16":{"text":"A minung pawl nelrawn ramṭhing ah a hruai: A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang cak zetzet a that ṭheh a si; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang hmin thang zetzet tla a that; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"19":{"text":"Amor siangpahrang Sihon a that; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"20":{"text":"Bashan siangpahrang Og tla a that; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"21":{"text":"An ram cu a minung pawl hnenah ro ah a pek; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"22":{"text":"Cuih ro cu a siahhlawh Israel hnenah a pek: A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"23":{"text":"Ral kan sun tikah in hngilh lo; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"24":{"text":"Kan ral pawl kut sungin in luatter; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"25":{"text":"Minung le ramsa hmuahhmuah rawl a pek; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."},"26":{"text":"Vancung Pathian hnenah lungawi thu sim uh; A duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun."}}},"137":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon tiva kap ah kan to ih kan ṭap, Cutawkah kan ṭap, Zion kan ngai caan ahcun.","title":"Israel Saltaang Pawl ṭahhla"},"2":{"text":"Kan kiangih partiam kung parah, Kan ṭingṭang pawl kan thlai ṭheu."},"3":{"text":"In kaitu pawl in hlasak in fial; Anmah lungnuamtertu dingah: “Zion thu kha hla in in sak sak uh,” an ti."},"4":{"text":"Ziangtin so Bawipa ih hla cu, Miphun dang ram ahcun kan sak thei ding?"},"5":{"text":"Ṭingṭang tum thiam nawn loin um ninglaw, Jerusalem nang ka lo hngilh ahcun!"},"6":{"text":"Nang lo cing nawn loin ka um ih, Jerusalem kha ka lungawinak saang bik ih ka ret lo ahcun, Ka lei hi ka saangkhar ah bet seh."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Jerusalem an lak ni ah, Edom mi pawl ih an tuahmi kha cing ringring aw: “Balsiat ṭheh uh, balsiat ṭheh uh,” ti ih an au kha hngilh hlah aw."},"8":{"text":"Maw Babilon, nang cu balsiat ṭheh na si ding; Kan parih na tuahmi hmuahhmuah ruangah na parih phu a latu cu mi thlawsuak a si."},"9":{"text":"Na fa note pawl la tahratin, Lungto parih a vuatu cu mi thlawsuak a si."}}},"138":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka thinlung zate in ka lo lawm; Khawzing pawl hmaiah na thang- ṭhatnak cu hla in ka sak ding.","title":"Lungawinak Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Na Biakinn thianghlim hoih in ka kuun ih, Na hmin cu ka thangṭhat; A thleng-aw dah lomi na duhdawt- nak le rintlak na sinak ruangah; Na hmin le na thupekmi pawl cu A saangbik ih na langter ruangah; Na hmin ka thangṭhat a si."},"3":{"text":"Ka lo kawh tikah i run awi; Na thazaang in i cakter."},"4":{"text":"Leilung tlun siangpahrang hmuahhmuah in, Maw Bawipa , an lo thangṭhat ding. Ziangahtile na thutiammi an thei ṭheh zo a si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa ih thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah le, A sunlawinak huham cu hla in an sak ding."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa cu a saang bikah a um naón mi nauta pawl ih zawn a ruat. A mithmuhnak ihsin mi puarthau an relh thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Harsatnak tampi in in kulh ṭheh khalle, A heng zetmi ka ral pawl i do sak ih, Na vorhlam kut in i run a si."},"8":{"text":"In tiamkam ciami hmuahhmuah cu, Na kim ter ṭheh ding; Maw Bawipa , na duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun; Na kut in na thawh ciami na hnaṭuan cu ṭheh suak hram aw."}}},"139":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa , nangmah in i hliakhlai thluh zo ih, I thei ṭheh zo.","title":"Pathian In In Thei ṭheh"},"2":{"text":"Ka thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah na thei ṭheh a si. Lam hlatzet ihsin ka thinlung ruahmi na thei ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Hna ka ṭuan le ka colh khal i hmu; Ka tuahmi hmuahhmuah na thei ṭheh a si."},"4":{"text":"Ka ṭong hlan ihsin ka ṭong dingmi cu na rak thei zo."},"5":{"text":"Ka kimvelah nang cu na um; Na huham in i hum."},"6":{"text":"I theih thei zia hi mangbangza ngaingai a si; Ka hrangah a thuuk tuk, ka thei thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Na hnen ihsin khuiah so ka relh ding? Na mithmuh ihsin khuiah so ka tlan cuang ding?"},"8":{"text":"Vancung ah kai ningla cunah nang na um ding; Mithi pawl ram Sheol ah it khal ningla cunah na um thotho ding."},"9":{"text":"Thla nei bangin nisuahnak lan in zuang khal ningla; Asilole nitlaknak a hlat bik hmunah um khal ningla,"},"10":{"text":"Cutawkah na kut in i hruai ding ih, Keimah bawm dingah na rak um thotho ding."},"11":{"text":"Thimnak cu ‘I thup aw,’ ti in, Ka kiang ih tleunak cu ‘Thimnak ah cang aw,’ tiah ti khal ningla,"},"12":{"text":"Nang na hrangah thimnak cu a thim lo! Zan cu sun tluk in a vang ih, Na hrangah thimnak le tleunak cu an bang-aw a si!"},"13":{"text":"Ka sungril tiang a tuah ṭhehtu cu nangmah na si; Ka nu ih pum sungih i seemtertu khal nangmah na si."},"14":{"text":"Ṭih-um zet le lamdang zet ih in tuah ruangah, Ka lo thangṭhat. Na tuahmi hmuahhmuah hi mangbang le khawruahhar an si. Cucu ka thinlung zate in ka thei."},"15":{"text":"Seemsuah dingah ka ruangrai na zing ih, Ka nu ih pum sungah ka thi le ka sa na pehcih laiah, A thupte in cutawk ih ka ṭhan rero laiah khan, I hmu ṭhehtu nangmah na si."},"16":{"text":"Ka suah hlan ihsin i hmu zo; Ka hrangih na tuahmi kum le caan pawl cu, Na cabu sungah khum cia an rak si zo, Nikhat hman a thok hlan ihsin."},"17":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na ruahnak pawl cu, Ka hrangah a thuuk ih a har. Na ruahnak an tam zia hi ka ruat ban lo."},"18":{"text":"Siar khal ningla vunnel hnakin an tam sawn ding; Ka ṭhang khalle na hnen thotho ah ka um a si."},"19":{"text":"Maw Pathian, mi ṭha lo pawl cu, That ṭheh hai cila ka va duh so! Thisen suah a hiartu pawl cun, I tlansan ṭheh hai sehla ka va duh so!"},"20":{"text":"Na thu cu mawi lo zetzet in an sim; Na hmin cu ngai tlak loin an rel."},"21":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , a lo huatu pawl ziangtluk in so ka huat hai! Nangmah a lo raltu pawl cu, ziangtluk in so ka mit an kem!"},"22":{"text":"Anmah cu huat tithum in ka hua; Ka ral ih ka ruahmi an si."},"23":{"text":"Maw Pathian, i hliakhlai awla, Ka thinlung hi thei hram aw; I hniksak awla ka ruahnak hi hmu hram aw."},"24":{"text":"Ka sungah ṭhat lonak a um le um lo zohfiang aw; Cule kumkhua nunnak lamzin ah i hruai aw."}}},"140":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , mi ṭha lo pawl kut ihsin i hum aw; Mi puarthau pawl kut ihsin i run aw.","title":"Humhimnak Hrang Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Annih pawl cun ṭhat lonak lawng an hawl ih, Tawhawknak lawng an ngaihtuah."},"3":{"text":"An lei cu rul cukhrang lei vekin a hriam, An ṭong cu rulngan ih tur vek a si."},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , mi ṭha lo pawl kut ihsin i hum aw; Keimah thlak ding le thisen suah ding lawng a hiartu pawl ih kut ihsin i run aw."},"5":{"text":"Mi hngalhngawng pawl in thang in kam; Palphum thang an siah ih, Keimah awk dingah lamzin tluan in thang an kam."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah, “Nangmah cu ka Pathian na si,” ka ti. Maw Bawipa , bomnak dil ih ka aunak i ngai hram aw!"},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka Pathian le i humtu cak, Raldonak hmunah ka lu cu ralphaw thawn na hum ngah zo."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , mi ṭha lo pawl cu an duhmi pe hlah aw; Mi an phiarnak tla hlawhtlinter hram hlah aw."},"9":{"text":"Ka ral pawl cu nehtu siter hlah aw; In hro siatnak cu an parah tla hram seh."},"10":{"text":"A vaam zetmi meiling cu an parah tla hram seh; Khur sungah suak thei nawn lo dingin hlonmi si hai seh."},"11":{"text":"A dik loih midang sualpuhtu cu, hlawhtling hlah hai seh; Thisen suah a hiartu pawl cu, ṭhat lonak in man sehla siatsuah si hram hai seh."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nang cun mi farah pawl ih thu le, Mi tlasam pawl ih covo cu na ṭan a si, ti ka thei."},"13":{"text":"Miding pawl cun an lo thangṭhat zet ding; Miding cu na mithmuh ah an um ding a si."}}},"141":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah ka lo ko; Atu ah i bawm hram aw. Ka lo kawh tikah i ngai hram aw.","title":"Zanlam Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak cu, Rimhmui ai-ah i co sak awla, Ka kut ka thlir mi cu, zanlam thawinak ai-ah i san sak hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka kaa ah kiltu re awla, Ka hmur ih sangka ah vengtu re hram aw."},"4":{"text":"Thilsual tuah duh lotu si dingah i bawm awla, Mi ṭha lo pawl ih ṭhat lonak ah tel lo dingin i kham aw. An puai tuahnak khalah tel hram hlah ning law!"},"5":{"text":"Mi ṭha cun zawnruahnak in i kawk ding ih i hrem ko ding; Sikhalsehla mi ṭha lo in ka lu ih an toihmi cawimawinak hriak cu, ka saang dah lo ding; Ziangahtile a tuahmi thil ṭha lo duh loin thla ka cam ringring."},"6":{"text":"Anmah uktu pawl lungpang khaam ihsin hlon hlo an si tikah, Ka thu a dik zia kha minung pawl in an phuang leh ding."},"7":{"text":"An phel ih an sutkuai ṭhehmi lungto bangin, An ruh pawl cu thlaan kaa ah, ṭhekdarh ṭheh an si ding."},"8":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa Pathian, kei cun ka lo rinsan ringring; Nangmah ih humhimnak lawnglawng ka hawl; I thiter hram hlah aw."},"9":{"text":"Ka hrangih an kammi thang ihsin i hum aw; ṭhat lonak lawng a tuahtu pawl ih thang ihsin i hum hram aw."},"10":{"text":"Kei cu himdamte ih ka tlanleen laiah mi ṭha lo pawl cu anmah ih kammi thang ah tla hai seh!"}}},"142":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah bomnak dil in ka au; Amah cu zaangfah ka dil ciamco.","title":"Bom Dilnak Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Ka phunzainak hmuahhmuah Bawipa hnenah ka thlenter; Ka harsatnak hmuahhmuah amah ka sim."},"3":{"text":"Vansang beidong ih ka um laiah, Ka tuah dingmi theitu cu amah a si; Ka fehnak lamzin ah ka ral pawl in a thupte in thang in rak siah."},"4":{"text":"Ka kiangkap ka zoh tikah, I bawmtu ding zohman ka hmu lo; I humtu ding zohman ka hmu lo, Zohman in ka zawn in ruat lo."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , bomnak dil in na hnenah ka au: “Maw Bawipa , nang cu i humtu ka beunak na si, Hi leitlun nunnak ram ahhin nang lawng hi ka covo na si,” ka lo ti."},"6":{"text":"Bomnak dilih ka aunak i theihsak hram aw; Ziangahtile beidonnak sungah ka pil zo. Kei hnakih a cak deuhmi ka ral pawl kut sungin i run hram aw."},"7":{"text":"Ka harsatnak sungin i luatter aw; Cule na minung pawl an tonkhawmnak ah ka lo thangṭhat ding; Ka parih na ṭhatnak ruangah!"}}},"143":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka thlacam i ngai awla, Dingnak na neih ruangah zaangfah ka lo dilnak i theih sak hram aw. Rintlak na si ruangah i let hram aw.","title":"Bom Dilnak Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Na thuṭhennak hmun ah, Kei na siahhlawh hi i suahpi hram hlah aw; Na mithmuh ah zohman mi ding an um lo."},"3":{"text":"Ka ral pawl in in hual ih nasa zetin in neh zo; A thimmi thawng inn sungah in ret ih, Khuahlan laiih a rak thi zomi ka bang."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah ka bei a dong, Awloksong, vansaang laam in ka um."},"5":{"text":"A liam ciami ni le thla ka vun thei sal; Na thil tuahmi pawl ka vun mang sal ih, Na kut ih tuahmi hmuahhmuah ka thinlung in ṭhatein ka ruat sal."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah na hnenah ka kut thlir in thla ka cam; Lei caar in tidai a haal bangin, Ka nunnak in nangmah a lo haal a si."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i sawn hram aw; Ruahsannak zianghman ka nei nawn lo; Ka hnen ihsin relh hram hlah aw! Culole mithi ramih a fehtu lakah, Kei khal ka tel ve pang ding."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah lawnglawng ka lo rinsan; A hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu, zingtinte in i theiter hram aw. Ka thlacamnak cu na hnenah ka thlenpi; Ka fehnak ding zin i hmuh hram aw."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , humhimnak duh ah na hnen ka ra; Ka ral pawl ih kut in i luatter aw."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka Pathian na si; Na duhmi tuahtu si dingah i zirh aw. Na thlarau cu ka parah ṭha hram sehla, Lamzin rawn ah i hruai hram aw."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , i tiamkam cia vekin i run hram aw; Na ṭhat ruangah ka harnak sungin i luatter aw."},"12":{"text":"Kei i duh ruangah ka ral pawl cu that hai aw; I neh-nentu pawl tla siatsuah ṭheh hai aw; Ziangahtile na siahhlawh ka si."}}},"144":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka beunak lungpi Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Raldo daan le ral nam zia cu, Amah in i zirh.","title":"Siangpahrang In Pathian A Thangṭhat"},"2":{"text":"Amah cu i humtu le ṭantu a si; Ka beunak le i runtu khal a si; Ka himnak ah amah ka ring. Miphun dang pawl cu ka hnuai ah a ret hai."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , milai hi ziangso a si ih na seherh ringring? Mihring taak ko hi ziangso a si ih, a zawn na ruah?"},"4":{"text":"Minung cu thaw vek fang a si; A nundam sung cu, A liam cingmi phenthlam vek a si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa , van khi run ong awla rung lang aw; Tlang pawl khi tham awla meikhu an suah ding."},"6":{"text":"Nimthla kauter awla na ral pawl ṭhekdarh hai aw. Na conkiang sai awla tlanter ṭheh hai aw!"},"7":{"text":"Tlun ihsin run dawh awla, Ti thuuk sung ihsin i dir suak in i run hram aw. Thudik a sim dah lo mi le,"},"8":{"text":"Siatcam in thuphan a pertu, Ram dangmi pawl ih kut sung ihsin i hum hram aw."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na hnenah hla thar ka sak ding; ṭingṭang tum in hla ka lo sak sak ding."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang pawl hnenah nehnak na pek ih, Na siahhlawh David cu na run suak a si."},"11":{"text":"Zaangfah nei lo ka ral pawl kut in i hum awla, Thudik a sim dah lo tu le, Siatcam in thuphan a reltu pawl, Ramdang mi ih kut sungin i run hram aw."},"12":{"text":"Kan fapa pawl cu mino an si lai ihsin, ṭhazet le cakzet ih a ṭhangmi, Thingkung bangtuk si hai seh. Kan fanu pawl cu siangpahrang inn mawi tertu, Inn kilih phunmi lungser bangtuk si hai seh."},"13":{"text":"Kan cuam pawl cu rawl phunkim in khat seh; Kan loram sungih tuu pawl cu, A thawng a saang in fano nei hai seh."},"14":{"text":"Kan caw rual tla karhzai ciamco hai sehla, Hloral le fahrulh ti um hlah seh. Kan lamzin ah riahsia ninghang ih, ṭahnak awn-au um hlah seh."},"15":{"text":"Cubangtuk a si mi ram cu ram thlawsuak a si; Bawipa kha an Pathian ah a neitu miphun cu, mi thlawsuak phun an si."}}},"145":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na maksak zia cu ka tlang aupi ding ka Pathian le siangpahrang; Kumkhua in kumkhua tiang na hnen ah lungawi thu ka sim ding.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Nitinte ka lo lawm ding; Kumkhua cat loin ka lo thangṭhat ding."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu a tumlian ih, Nasa zetih thangṭhat ding a si. Maktara a si ih theih ban ding a si lo."},"4":{"text":"Na thil tuahmi pawl cu sankhat hnu sankhat ah, Thangṭhat ringring a si ding. Mangbangza na tuahmi pawl cu an thanter ding."},"5":{"text":"Minung in na sunlawinak le na huham an sim an rel ding ih, Mangbangza na tuahmi pawl cu Ka thinlung in ka ngaihtuah ringring ding."},"6":{"text":"Thil maktara na tuahmi pawl cu mi in an sim ding ih, Kei in na tumlian zia ka phuang ding."},"7":{"text":"Na ṭhat zia an rel ding ih, Zaangfahnak na neih zia hla in an sak ding."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cu mi duhdawtu le mi zaangfahtu a si; A thinheng a har ih a hmunmi duhdawtnak in a khat."},"9":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah parah a ṭha; A tuahmi hmuahhmuah tlunah lainatnak a nei."},"10":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na seemsuahmi hmuahhmuah in, An lo thangṭhat ding ih, Na minung pawl in lungawi thu na hnenah an sim ding."},"11":{"text":"Na uknak sunlawi zia le na cah zia cu annih in an sim ding."},"12":{"text":"Cuticun mi hmuahhmuah in mangbangza na tuahmi le, Na uknak huham sunglawi cu an thei ding."},"13":{"text":"Na uknak cu kumkhua in a hmun; Nang cu kumkhua in siangpahrang na si. Pathian cu a thutiammi hmuahhmuah ah rinsantlak a si; A thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah ah zaangfahnak a nei."},"14":{"text":"Harsatnak a tuartu hmuahhmuah a bawm ih, Mi lungnem hmuahhmuah a cawisaang a si."},"15":{"text":"Nunnak neitu hmuahhmuah in, Beiseinak thawn nangmah an lo zoh. An ṭul tikah nang in rawl na pek hai a si."},"16":{"text":"Khopkham in na pek hai ih A tum a seen ih ṭulmi hmuahhmuah na pek a si."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa cu a tuahmi kipah a ding; A tuahmi tin ah zaangfahnak a nei."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa cu amah a kotu ih kiangah a um ringring; Thinlung taktein a kotu ih kiang ah a um ringring a si."},"19":{"text":"Amah a ṭihzahtu pawl ih poihai mi cu a pe, An aunak a thei ih a run hai a si."},"20":{"text":"Amah a duhtu hmuahhmuah a hum; Asinain mi ṭha lo hmuahhmuah cu a ti hloral ding."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka thangṭhat ringring ding; A seemsuahmi hmuahhmuah in a hmin thianghlim cu, Kumkhua in thangṭhat hai seh."}}},"146":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat aw!","title":"Runtu Pathian Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka nunsung hmuahhmuah amah ka thangṭhat ding; Ka nunsung cat loin ka Pathian hnenah hla ka sak ding."},"3":{"text":"Milai hotu pawl ih parah nan rinsannak ṭhum hlah uh; A lo run thei lotu ih parah cun!"},"4":{"text":"An thi ih leivut ah an cang; Cuih ni ah an tumtahmi hmuahhmuah a cem ṭheh a si."},"5":{"text":"Amah bawmtu dingah Jakob ih Pathian a neitu cu, Mi thlawsuak a si."},"6":{"text":"Lei le van, tifinriat le a sung ummi hmuahhmuah tuahtu, Bawipa Pathian a rinsantu cu mi lungawi a si. Bawipa cun a thutiammi a kimter ringring."},"7":{"text":"Namthlakmi pawl ṭan in thu a rel ih, Rilrawngmi pawl hnenah rawl a pek. Bawipa in thawngtla mi pawl a luatter ih,"},"8":{"text":"Mitcaw pawl khua a hmuhter. Tangdor pawl a khaisaang ih, Miding pawl a duhdaw hai a si."},"9":{"text":"Ram sungih ummi miphun dang pawl a hum hai ih, Nuhmei le ngakṭah fa pawl a bawm. Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl ih tumtahnak cu a siatsuah a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa cu kumkhua in siangpahrang a si ding; Maw Zion, na Pathian cun kumkhua in a uk ding. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"}}},"147":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Kan Pathian hnenih, Thangṭhatnak hlasak cu a ṭha. Amah thangṭhat cu a nuammi le a dikmi a si.","title":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in Jerusalem cu a din sal; Saltaang Israel mi pawl a kirpi sal a si."},"3":{"text":"Thinlung kuaimi pawl a damter ih, An hma pawl a tuam sak."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in arsi um ding zat a khiah; Pakhat hnu pakhat an hmin ciar in a ko."},"5":{"text":"Kan Bawipa cu a nasa mi le a maksak mi a si; A thil theih theizia cu tah theih ding rual a si lo."},"6":{"text":"Mi tangdor pawl cu a cawisaang; Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu, leilung ah a palcih hai a si."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah thangṭhatnak hla sak uh! Ṭingṭang thawn kan Bawipa hnenah hla mawi sak uh."},"8":{"text":"Van ah khin khawdur a pharh ih, Leilung hrangah ruah a surter. Cule tlangpar ah hrampi a khoter."},"9":{"text":"Amah in ramsa pawl rawl a pe ih, Tlang-ak note pawl khal an ai tikah rawl in a cawm hai."},"10":{"text":"A lungawinak cu rang cak zetzet parah a um lo; A thinnomnak khal ralkap ralṭha zetzet parah a um lo."},"11":{"text":"Asinain amah a ṭihzahtu le, A hmunmi a duhdawtnak a rinsantu pawl parah a um sawn a si."},"12":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, Bawipa cu thangṭhat aw! Maw Zion, na Pathian cu thangṭhat aw!"},"13":{"text":"Amah in na kotka a hngetter ih, Na minung pawl thlawsuah a pek."},"14":{"text":"Na ramri pawl a himter ih, sangvut ṭha bik in a lo cawm."},"15":{"text":"Amah in leilung cu thu a pek ih, A thupekmi zamrang in tuah a si."},"16":{"text":"Patpar bangin vur a tlakter; Vur tla cu leivut bangin a ṭhekdarh."},"17":{"text":"Rial cu lungte hluum bangin a tlakter; A thlenter mi khawsik cu, zohman in an tuar thei lo."},"18":{"text":"Thu a pek sal ih tikhal pawl an zup ṭheh; Thli a hranter ih tidai a luang."},"19":{"text":"A thu cu Jakob hnenah a pek ih, A thu zirhmi le a daan pawl cu Israel a pek."},"20":{"text":"Hi bangtuk cun miphun dang hnenah a tuah lo; A daan pawl an thei lo a si. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"}}},"148":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Bawipa cu vancung in thangṭhat uh! Tlun hmun saang ah thangṭhat uh.","title":"Ziang Hmuahhmuah In Thangṭhat Ding"},"2":{"text":"A vancungmi hmuahhmuah in amah thangṭhat uh; A van ralkap hmuahhmuah tla in!"},"3":{"text":"Ni le thlapi tla, amah thangṭhat uh! A tleumi arsi pawl tla, amah thangṭhat uh!"},"4":{"text":"Vancung saang bik pawl le, Van tlunih tidai pawl khal in amah thangṭhat uh!"},"5":{"text":"An zate in Bawipa hmin thangṭhat hai seh; Amah in thu a pek ih seemsuah an si."},"6":{"text":"A thupeknak in an hmun ciar ah, Kumkhua in an hmun; A thu an el thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Leilung ihsin Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Tipi sungih ramsa tumpipi, tipi thuuk in,"},"8":{"text":"Nimthlakau, rial, vur, Khawdur le thlisia pawl, A thu a ngaitu hmuahhmuah in thangṭhat uh!"},"9":{"text":"Tlangniam le tlangsaang in amah thangṭhat uh! Rah a rahmi thingkung le tupi thingkung pawl in;"},"10":{"text":"Inn zuat ṭilva, hramlak ramsa, Vate pawl le a bokvakmi ramsa pawl khal in, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang pawl le miphun kip, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Bawi le uktu pawl hmuahhmuah in,"},"12":{"text":"Fala le tlangval pawl khal in, Nutar patar le nauhak pawl tla in, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh."},"13":{"text":"An zate in Bawipa ih hmin cu thangṭhat hai seh. A hmin cu hmin dang hmuahhmuah hnakin a nasa sawn a si. A sunlawinak cu lei le van tlun ah a thang."},"14":{"text":"A minung pawl ih ram cu a cakter, Cuticun a ngainatmi Israel miphun, Amah ih minung hmuahhmuah cun an thangṭhat ding. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"}}},"149":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Bawipa hnenah hla thar sa uh! Amah a rinsantu a minung pawl ih, tonkhawmnak ah thangṭhat uh!","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Maw Israel, a lo Siamtu ruangah na lungawi aw! Maw Zion mi pawl, nan siangpahrang ruangah nan aipuang uh!"},"3":{"text":"Laam phah in a hmin cu thangṭhat uh; Amah thang ṭhatnak ah khuang le, ṭingṭang pawl tum uh!"},"4":{"text":"A minung parah Bawipa a lung a awi; Mi tangdor pawl cu ral nehnak thawn upatnak a pek hai."},"5":{"text":"An nehnak ruangah Bawipa ih mi pawl cu lungawi in um hai seh; Aipuangzet in an puai caan ah zanvar hla sak hai seh."},"6":{"text":"Pathian thangṭhat phah in, Ring zetin au ciamco hai seh; A hriammi ralnam an kutah kengin,"},"7":{"text":"Miphun dangdang neh dingah le, Mi hmuahhmuah hrem dingah;"},"8":{"text":"An siangpahrang pawl khit ding le An hotu pawl thir cikcin in ṭeem dingah;"},"9":{"text":"Pathian ih thupeknak vekin, Miphun dang pawl hrem dingah a si. Himi cu Pathian mi pawl ih nehnak a si. Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh!"}}},"150":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa thangṭhat uh! A Biakinn sungah Pathian cu thangṭhat uh! Vancung ah a cahnak cu thangṭhat uh!","title":"Thangṭhat Uh!"},"2":{"text":"Thil mak zetzet a tuah ruangah thangṭhat uh! Ziang hmuahhmuah ih hnakin a tum lian bik ruangah thangṭhat uh!"},"3":{"text":"Tawtawrawt thawn thangṭhat uh! Ṭingṭang le tingrisit thawn thangṭhat uh!"},"4":{"text":"Khuang le dar thawn laam phah in thangṭhat uh! Ṭingṭang le phirivau thawn thangṭhat uh!"},"5":{"text":"Dar sumsel thawn thangṭhat uh! Darkhuang thawn thangṭhat uh!"},"6":{"text":"Nunnak a neimi hmuahhmuah in, Bawipa cu thangṭhat uh! Bawipa thangṭhat uh!"}}}}},"20":{"info":{"name":"Thufim","shortname":"Thufim","abbr":[],"desc":"Thufim (proverbs)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David fapa, Israel siangpahrang, Solomon ih thufim tla:","title":"Thufim Sunlawinak"},"2":{"text":"Fimnak, ruahnak ṭha le thudik simmi theih theinak na neih theinak dingah a lo bawm theitu ding thufim a um a si."},"3":{"text":"Cuih thufim cun umtlan thiamnak le dingnak, Fimkhur zet le tlaitluang zetih nun theinak a lo zirh ding."},"4":{"text":"Ruahnak mal pawl kha a fimter thei ih, Mino pawl kha theihthiamnak le ruahthiamnak a pe."},"5":{"text":"Hi thufim in mifim pawl kha an fimnak a karhter ding ih, Mithiam pawl khal lam a hruai ding a si."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah mifim pawl ih an suahpi mi thufim simfiangnak thukzet pawl le, Thu harsa pawl kha an thei suak ding."},"7":{"text":"Pathian ṭihzah cu fimnak ih hramthoknak a si, Mi aa pawl in fimnak le zirnak kha ziang an siar lo.","title":"Mino Pawl Ruahnak Pekmi"},"8":{"text":"Ka fapa, na nu le na pa ih simmi thu kha ṭhatein ngai aw."},"9":{"text":"An lo zirhmi thu in na nuncan ziaza a ṭhatter ding ih na lu hrangah lupawng mawizet le, na hngawng hrangah ṭhi mawi an si ding."},"10":{"text":"Ka fapa, misual pawl in an lo lemsiah tikah lung aw hlah."},"11":{"text":"Annih in, “Ra awla mi pakhat tal that dingah hawl uhsi, Sualnak a nei lotu pawl kha bawh thup uhsi!"},"12":{"text":"Mithi khua in mi a dolh bangin an nungcungin dolh uhsi, Sualnak an nei lo naón khur sungih a vung tla bangtuk si hai seh."},"13":{"text":"Thilri mankhung pawl kha kan lak ding ih, Kan inn pawl kha thilri mankhung thawn khatter uhsi!"},"14":{"text":"Kan hnenah ra tel ve awla, Kan firmi pawl kan lo zem ve ding,” tiah an lo ti tikah,"},"15":{"text":"Ka fapa, cuvek mi pawl hnenah feh aw hlah, An lamzin kha va hrial aw."},"16":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo tuah ding ahcun an zam a rang ih, Mi that dingah an ralring cia ringring."},"17":{"text":"Vate hmuh cingih suurthang kam cu zianghman a ṭhahnem lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Asinain hivek mi ṭha lo pawl in anmah le anmah thang an kam aw ih, Cuih thangkammi sung ahcun an awk that aw leh ding."},"19":{"text":"Neh-lon ih mi thil a longtu pawl cun cubangtuk in thihnak an hawlh aw ṭheu."},"20":{"text":"Ngai hnik uh! Lamzinpi le thil zuarnak hmun ihsin fimnak au aw cu!","title":"Fimnak Ih Kawhnak"},"21":{"text":"Khawpi kotka le mi tonkhawmnak hmun ihsin napi in a au."},"22":{"text":"Mi aa pawl, ziangtik tiangso nan aat hrih ding? Ziangtik tiangso fimnak hmuhsuam hi nuam nan ti ding ih, Fimnak hi nan huat hrih ding?"},"23":{"text":"Nun ka lo sim laiah ṭhatein ngai uh, Ruahnak ṭha ka lo pe ding ih, Ka fimnak kha ka lo seu ve ding a si."},"24":{"text":"Ka hnenah ra dingin ka lo ko naón nan ra duh lo; Ka kut ka lo zaap ih nan ngaisaang lo."},"25":{"text":"Ruahnak ṭha ka lo pekmi pawl tla ziangsiar loin nan um ih, Nan nuncan ziaza remsak ding khal nan duh lo."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah harsatnak nan ton tikah ka lo hnihsan ding ih ṭihnung rapthlak in a lo tlunhnawh tikah ka hni thup ding."},"27":{"text":"Harsatnak cu thlisia bangin a ra thlen tik le, ṭihnungza in phusiing bangin a lo nuai tikah, Vansang le thinlung rethei in na um ding."},"28":{"text":"Cutik ahcun in ko ding, Asinain ka lo sawn lo ding; Hmunkip ah in hawl ding naón in tong lo ding."},"29":{"text":"Thutheihnak cu nan hua ih, Bawipa ṭihzah cu nan hril lo a si."},"30":{"text":"Ruahnak ka lo pekmi pawl tla nan duh lo ih, Nun ka lo sim tikah nan ngai duh fawn lo."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah nanmah ih ṭuanmi vekin nan ngah leh ding, Nan tuahmi pawl in natnak a lo pe ding a si."},"32":{"text":"Ruahnak mal deuh pawl in fimnak an hnon ruangah an thi, Mi aa pawl cu an daithlannak in a siatsuah a si."},"33":{"text":"Asinain ka thu a ngaitu pawl cu an him ding ih, ṭihphannak zianghman an nei lo ding."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka lo simmi hi zir awla, Tuah dingih ka lo simmi kha na thinlung ah khum aw.","title":"Fimnak Ih Man"},"2":{"text":"Fimnak hi ziang a si ti kha ngai awla, Theithiam dingin na thinlung thawn zuam aw."},"3":{"text":"A si, hmuhnak le theihnak kha na ko ih, Theihthiamnak khal na dil ahcun;"},"4":{"text":"Ngun bangin ngah na duh ih, Hlawnthil thuh mi bangin na hawl ahcun,"},"5":{"text":"Cutin na tuah asile Bawipa ṭihzah cu ziang a si ti na thei ding ih, Pathian theihnak cu na hmu suak ding a si."},"6":{"text":"Fimnak petu cu Bawipa a si ih, Amah ih hnen ihsin fimthiamnak le theihthiamnak an ngah a si."},"7":{"text":"Miding pawl le mi thinlung tluang pawl cu A bawm ih a humhim a si."},"8":{"text":"Midang parah thuding a tuahtu pawl a humhim ih Amah a duhdawtu pawl kha a kilveng a si."},"9":{"text":"Ka thu na ngai a si ahcun a dikmi, a ṭha mi le Ka tuah ding mi ziang a si ti kha na thei thei ding."},"10":{"text":"Fimnak na lung sungah a lut ding ih, Na theihnak in a lo lungawi ter ding."},"11":{"text":"Na fimnak le na theih thiamnak khan a lo humhim ding ih,"},"12":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo lakin a lo kham ding. Ṭong ṭha lo a hmangtu pawl lak ihsin a lo kilveng ding."},"13":{"text":"Cu pawl cun lamthim ih feh dingah lam dik cu an tlansan;"},"14":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo tuah kha an duhzawng a si ih, Thilsual tuahnak hmun ah an lung a awi ṭheu."},"15":{"text":"Rinsan tlak lo le zum tlak lomi pawl an si."},"16":{"text":"Ṭongkam naal zet thawn a lo bumtu nunau ṭha lo hnen ihsin a lo run suak ding;"},"17":{"text":"Cu nu cu a pasal parah dingnak neilotu le, Pathian hnenih a thukam ziang a siarlotu a si."},"18":{"text":"A inn ah na feh a si ahcun thihnak lamzin ah a fehtu na si."},"19":{"text":"A hnenah a fehtu cu zokhal an kirsal nawn lo. Nunnak lam an tong sal nawn lo."},"20":{"text":"Cu a si ruangah miṭha pawl ih lam cu na zawh dingih Miding pawl ih nun bangin na nung ding."},"21":{"text":"Miding mi le miṭha famkim pawl cu hi leilung ah an um ding."},"22":{"text":"Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu cuih ramsung ihsin Pathian in a dawihlo ding ih, Mi hrokhrawl pawl cu phawi hlo an si ding."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka lo zirh mi pawl tla kha hngilh hlah, Tuah dingih ka lo sim mi pawl kha ciing ringring aw.","title":"Mino Pawl Hnenah Ruahnak Peknak"},"2":{"text":"Ka lo zirh mi in nun saunak le nun nomnak a lo pe ding a si."},"3":{"text":"Na hnen ihsin felnak le rintlak sinak khan ziangtik hmanah lo suahsan hlah seh; Na hngawng ah ngerh awla, na thin sungah ngan aw."},"4":{"text":"Cubangtuk in na tuah asile Pathian hmai le minung hmaiah duhsaknak le hminṭhatnak na co ding."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa cu na thinlung zate in rinsan aw. Nangmah ih ruahnak le theihnak kha rinsan aw hlah."},"6":{"text":"Na tuah mi kipah Pathian cu thei ringring awla, Amah in lamzin dik a lo hmuh ding a si."},"7":{"text":"Ka fim paam tiin ruat aw hlah; Bawipa cu ṭih awla, sualnak tansan aw."},"8":{"text":"Cubangtuk in na tuah asile na taksa hrangah damnak a si ding ih, Na ruh hrangah sii ṭha a si ding."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa cu na sumsaw le na thlairah hmaisa bik in thangṭhat aw."},"10":{"text":"Cubangtuk in na tuah asile na rawl inn cu rawlin a khat dingih, Na sabit ralca beel cu sabit thar in a liam thluahthlo ding."},"11":{"text":"Ka fapa, Bawipa ih nun simnak cu ziang rel loin va um hlah, A lo kawk tikah na thin na hlah."},"12":{"text":"Ziangahtile pa in a duhdawt zetmi a faate nun a sim bangin, Bawipa in a duhdawt mi pawl cu nun a sim a si."},"13":{"text":"Fimnak a hmutu cu mi lungawi a si, Theihthiamnak a neitu khal a lung a awi ve."},"14":{"text":"Fimnak cu ngun hnakin a ṭha sawn ih, Sui hnakin a man a khung sawn a si."},"15":{"text":"Fimnak cu lungvar hnakin a man a khung deuh ih, Thil dang thawn tahṭhim theih a si lo."},"16":{"text":"Fimnak in nun saunak le lennak le upatnak a lo pek a si."},"17":{"text":"A lamzin cu nunkhua nomnak lamzin a si ih, A lamzin hmuahhmuah cu hnangamnak a si."},"18":{"text":"Fimnak neitu tla cu an lung a awi ih, Fimnak in nunnak a pek a si."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa in leilungpi cu a fimnak thawn a sersiam ih, A theihthiam theinak thawn van cu a hngetter."},"20":{"text":"A fimnak in tiva a luanter ih, Leilung ih ruah sur dingah mero a umter."},"21":{"text":"Ka fapa, na fimnak le na ruahthiamnak kha kai hnget aw, Na hnen ihsin ziangtik hmanah tlanter hlah aw."},"22":{"text":"Na thlarau hrangah nunnak a si dingih, Na hngawng hrangah mawinak a si ding."},"23":{"text":"Na lamtluan ah himdamte in na feh thei ding ih, Rilhbahnak khal na tong dah lo ding."},"24":{"text":"Zan na ih tikah na ṭih lo dingih, Ih hmuh thawte in zanvaar na ih that ding."},"25":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl hnenah thlisia bangin siatnak a thlen tikah, Zianghman donharnak na hrangah a um lo ding."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa in himdamte in a lo fingkhawi ding ih, Thang sungah a lo tlater dah lo ding."},"27":{"text":"A ṭul a sammi pawl hnenah na tuah thei zat tiangin thil ṭha kha tuah aw."},"28":{"text":"Na innhnen kha tu rori ah na bom thei mi asile thaizing tiang hngakter aw hlah."},"29":{"text":"Nangmah rinsan in na kiangah a ummi na innhnen kha a tlun ah harsatnak tuah dingin tum aw hlah."},"30":{"text":"Na parah siatnak a tuah dah lotu va to rero hlah."},"31":{"text":"Mi helhlong kha va daw hlah, Amah bangih tuah ding khal va ruat hlah."},"32":{"text":"Zianghrangah tile, Bawipa in ṭhat lonak a tuahtu pawl cu a hua ih, Miding pawl cu a humhim a si."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa in mi sualral pawl ih inn kha a camsiat ih, Miding pawl ih inn cu thluasuahnak a pek."},"34":{"text":"Miziang siar lotu pawl cu ziangah a siar ve lo ih, Mi tangdortu pawl parah duhdawtnak a langter."},"35":{"text":"Mifim pawl in upatnak le sunlawinak kha an ngah dingih, Mi aa pawl cu ningzahnak lawng an co ding."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka faale tla, nan pa ih a lo zirh mi pawl hi ṭhate in ngai uhla, Theihthiamnak nan neih theinak dingah cing ṭha uh.","title":"Fimnak Ih Ṭhathnemnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka lo zirh mi cu a ṭhat ruangah cingkeng ring ring uh."},"3":{"text":"Ka nu le ka pa ih fapa neihsun ka si ih, Ka sentet lai ihsin,"},"4":{"text":"Ka pa in hiti in nun i sim, “Ka sim mi thu kha cingkeng ringring awla, Ziangtik hmanah hngilh hlah aw. Ka sim bangin tuah awla na nung ding a si."},"5":{"text":"Fimnak le theihfiangnak kha la awla, Ka simmi thu hi ziangsiar loin dungtun hlah."},"6":{"text":"Fimnak kha tlansan hlah awla a lo kilveng ding, Duhdawt awla himdamte in a lo humhim ding."},"7":{"text":"Fimnak neih cu na tuah thei mi thil thupi bik a si, Na neihmi hmuahhmuah hman man sehla fimnak cu nei aw."},"8":{"text":"Fimnak cu duh awla a lo khaisaang ding, Pomhnget awla upatnak a lo pe ding."},"9":{"text":"Amah cu na lu parah a mawi mi pangpar rual a si ding ih, Na sunlawinak sui lukhuh a si ding.”"},"10":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka thu hi ngai aw, Ka sim mi hi thungai thlak in ruat awla na nunkhua a sau ding."},"11":{"text":"Nundaan ṭha ka lo hmuh zo ih, Fimnak tla ka lo zirh zo."},"12":{"text":"Fimkhur zet ih na feh asile na lamtluan ah zianghman in a lo kham thei lo ding ih, Na tlan tik khal ah na bah lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Na zir mi pawl hi kaihnget awla, ṭhatein kilkhawi aw. Na nunnak a si."},"14":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih fehnak ah khan feh hlah aw; Mi siava pawl ih nunzia kha cawng hlah."},"15":{"text":"Tuah hrimhrim hlah! Mi ṭha lo pawl hnenin tlan awla, Pialsan awla feh vivo aw."},"16":{"text":"Misual pawl cu thilsual ziangtal an tuah lo ahcun an itthat thei lo, Mi pakhatkhat tal an tuahmawh lo ahcun an ih a hmu lo."},"17":{"text":"Sualnak cu saang bangin an ei ih, Mi tuahmawhnak cu zu bangin an in."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla miding pawl ih lamzin cu, Zing khawvang ihsin sun tiang a tleu sinsin mi tleunak bangtuk a si."},"19":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl lamzin cu zanthim bangtuk a si, Ziang kan pal ih kan ril ti khal an thei lo."},"20":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka lo sim mi thu hi ṭhatein ngai awla, Ka ṭongkam hi ṭhatein thlun aw."},"21":{"text":"Na hnen ihsin ziangtik hmanah hloter hrimhrim hlah, Ciing ringring awla na lung sungah felte in ret aw."},"22":{"text":"A theithiamtu hmuahhmuah hrangah an nunnak a si ih, A hmutu hrangah an taksa harhdamnak a si."},"23":{"text":"Ralringte in khua ruat aw, Ziangahtile na ruah mi in na nunnak a siamrem ding."},"24":{"text":"A dik lomi thu zianghman rel hlah, ṭong hawizawng lo le thuphan va sim hlah."},"25":{"text":"Hmailam dingtein zoh awla rinsan aw zet in feh aw; Na ningzak in leisin bih aw hlah."},"26":{"text":"Na tuah ding mi kha ṭhatein khuakhang cia awla, Cutin na tuah mi pawl cu felte in na tuah suak vivo ding."},"27":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo kha hrial awla hmailam ah dingtein feh aw, Lamzin dik ihsin kal khat hman pial hlah aw."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka fimnak le ka theihnak kha ṭhatein ngai awla felte in ngaihtuah aw.","title":"Nu Le Pa Sualnak Parah Ralrinnak"},"2":{"text":"Cule ziangtin ziaza ṭha ka nei ding ti na thei suak dingih, Na ṭongkam in na thu theihnak kha a langter ding."},"3":{"text":"Nunau zuangzam hmurka cu khuaitizu bangin a thlum dingih, A ṭongkam cu olif siti bangin a naal ding."},"4":{"text":"Asinain a netnak ahcun a kha mi le harsatnak siarlo, A dang zianghman a tanta lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Amah in mithi khua ah a lo hnuk suk dingih, A zawh mi lamzin cu thihnak a thleng ding."},"6":{"text":"Nunnak lamzin ah um loin a vakvai ih, Ziang ka cang ti khal a thei aw lo."},"7":{"text":"Ka fapa, i rak ngai awla, Ziangtik hmanah ka simmi thu hi hngilh hlah aw."},"8":{"text":"Cubangtuk nunau cu hrial aw. A sangka kiang hmanah feh hlah aw."},"9":{"text":"Na hrial lo asile mi upatnak na neih cia mi kha An lo lawng dingih zaangfahnak a nei lotu pawl ih kutin, Na no laiah na thi ding."},"10":{"text":"Mi phundang pawl in na lennak kha an lo lawng dingih, Na ṭuan man kha midangpi in an co ding."},"11":{"text":"Na thih zawng ah na hacang na rial dingih, Na tit le na sa cu a ṭumṭawl ding."},"12":{"text":"Cule, “Ziang ruangah so ka zirta lo? Ziang ruangah nun in sim mi ziang siar loin ka rak um?"},"13":{"text":"I zirhtu pawl ih thu ka ngai lo; I simtu pawl ziang hmanah ka siar fawn lo."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah ruah lopi in midang hmaiah, Ningzahnak ka tuar a si,” tiah na ti leh ding."},"15":{"text":"Na nupi parah rintlak in um awla, Amah pakhat lawng kha duhdawt aw."},"16":{"text":"Midang nunau thawn na neih mi faate tla in, Na parah ṭhatnak zianghman an tuah lo ding."},"17":{"text":"Na faate tla cu nangmah bawmtu dingah an ṭhang dingih, Mi phun dang cun an lo bawm lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah na no lai na nupi parah lungawi awla, A parah lungawi nomnak nei aw."},"19":{"text":"Cun amah cu zukneng bangin a mawi mi le duhnungza a si. A duhnunnak cun a lo lungawiter dingih, A lo duhdawtnak in a lo zeel ding a si."},"20":{"text":"Ka fapa, ziang ruangah nunau dang na duh? Ziang ruangah midang nupi ih duhnunnak cu na duh sawn?"},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in na tuah mi hmuahhmuah a hmu ṭheh, Na fehnak kipah a lo zoh vivo."},"22":{"text":"Mi siava pawl ih sualnak tla cu thangkam mi vek a si, Anmah ih sualnak suur sungah an awk aw."},"23":{"text":"Amah le amah a fingkhawi awk thei lo ruangah a thi, A aat tuknak in amah ih thlankhur ah a thlenpi leh ding."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa, midang ih lei an baak awknak ah, Kamawknak na nei dah maw?","title":"Ralrinnak Dang"},"2":{"text":"Nangmaió ṭongkam in a lo awk ih, Nangmaió kamawknak in a lo hreng maw?"},"3":{"text":"Cuti asile ka fapa, cu pai kut sungah na um ih, Hiti lawng in na hlit aw thei ding. A hnenah zamrang in va feh awla suah va dil aw."},"4":{"text":"Itthat in cawl meen aw hlah."},"5":{"text":"Sakap pa ih kut sung ihsin vate le zukneng an tlan suak bangin Thang sung ihsin suah ding tum aw."},"6":{"text":"Mi zaangzel pawl cun sihte khi va zoh seh, Sihte nuncanzia zoh in zir seh."},"7":{"text":"Annih cu hruaitu upabik le lal le uktu an nei lo;"},"8":{"text":"Asinain ṭhal sungah rawl an khawl ih, Thlatang hrangah an ralring cia."},"9":{"text":"Mi zaangzel pa cu ziangtik tiang so a ihthat hrih ding?
