Ziangtikah so a thawh ding?"},"10":{"text":"Amah cun, “Malte sung ka zauta pei, Caan malte sung kutsih in ka cawlta pei,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Asinain a ihthat sungah farahnak a tong ding, Hriamnam thawn rukru in a thilri an lon mipa bangin, Tlasam in a um ding."},"12":{"text":"Santlai lo le mi siava pawl cu Thuphan per dingin an tawi vak ṭheu."},"13":{"text":"Mitsinhnak le mithmai hmuh awknak in an lo leemsiah ding."},"14":{"text":"Cutiin an thinlung siava in ṭhat lonak khua an khang ih, Hmun kipah harsatnak an suahter a si."},"15":{"text":"Cuih ruangah an hnenah harsatnak kha rinlopi in a thleng dingih, Thihpi tlak in hriamhma an pu ding."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in a huat mi thil paruk a um, A fih mi thil pasarih a um. Puarthau mithmai, thuphan pertu lei, misual lo a thattu kut, sualralnak lawng khuakhangtu thinlung, thilsual tuah dingah a khul a rangtu ke, thuphan per tahrat in thu theihpitu sinak, unau pawl lakih harsatnak a suahpi ṭheutu pa, Hi pawl hi Bawipa ih fih mi an si.","merge":"17"},"20":{"text":"Ka fapa, na pa ih sim bangin tuah awla, Na nu ih zirh mi kha ziangtik hmanah hngilh hlah aw.","title":"Nu Le Pa Sualnak Parah Ralrinnak"},"21":{"text":"An sim mi thu tla kha ciing ringring awla, Na thinlung sungah khum aw."},"22":{"text":"Khual na tlawn tikah an lo zirhmi thu tla in a lo hruai dingih, Zan ah a lo kilkhawi dingih, sunah ruahnak a lo pe ding."},"23":{"text":"An lo zirhnak cu a tleu ringring dingih, An nun simnak khan nundaanzia a lo zirh ding."},"24":{"text":"Nunau ṭha lo le mi nupi pawl ih leemsiahnak ihsin a lo humhim ding."},"25":{"text":"Na thinlung in an mawinak hahio hlah awla, An mitpar in lo kai hlah seh."},"26":{"text":"Mi pakhat in hlawhhlangnu cu, saang hlom khat man thawn a saang thei, Asinain nu le pa sualnak cun a nunnak ih sumsaw hmuahhmuah A cemralter ding a si."},"27":{"text":"Na puan kaang lotein na ṭaangah meisa na ret thei maw?"},"28":{"text":"Na ke kaang loin meiling parah na feh thei maw?"},"29":{"text":"Cubangin midang nupi thawn ih tlang hi a ṭihnung zet mi a si ih, A ih pitu poh cu hremnak an tuar ding a si."},"30":{"text":"Rilrawng ih rawl a firtu khi an nautat lemlo,"},"31":{"text":"Asinain an kaih asile a let sarih in a ruul sal dingih, A neih hmuahhmuah in a pek ding."},"32":{"text":"Asinain midang nupi thawn a sualtu cu ruahnak nei lo mi aa a si. Amah le amah a siatsuah aw."},"33":{"text":"Hremnak tuar in a hmin a sia ding; Kumkhua in ningzah a phur ding."},"34":{"text":"Pasal in a nupi a zum nawn lo asile, Nasazet in a thiik ih a lehrulhnak cu a dai thei nawn lo."},"35":{"text":"Ziangvek sum le saw pek khalle a saang duh lo ih, Ziangvek luh lemnak khal in a thinlung a daiter thei lo."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka simmi hi ciing ringring awla, Tuah dingih ka lo sim hi hngilh hlah."},"2":{"text":"Ka sim bangin tuah awla na nung ding, Ka lo zirhmi thu pawl kha na mitmu bangin kilkhawi aw."},"3":{"text":"Ka lo zirh mi hi ciingkeng ringring awla, Na thinlung sungah ngan aw."},"4":{"text":"Fimnak cu ka farnu ti awla, Theihfiangnak cu ka rualpi ṭhabik na si tiah ti aw."},"5":{"text":"Mi nupi le mi bum hmang ṭongkam thiam nunau ihsin a lo humhim ding."},"6":{"text":"Voikhat cu ka inn tukvirh ihsin lenglam ka cuan ih,","title":"Nunau Sual"},"7":{"text":"Khawruah nei lo mi mino pawl lakah, A aa deuh mi tlangval pakhat khi ka hmu."},"8":{"text":"Amah cu cuih nunau ṭha lo umnak lampi kel lam ahcun a feh. A inn kiang lam a hei pan rero."},"9":{"text":"Zanlam khuathim hnuah a si."},"10":{"text":"Cule nunau ṭha lo nu in a ra hmuak, Cuih nunau nu cu hlawhhlang vekin a thuam aw."},"11":{"text":"Amah cu ralṭha le ningzah nei lomi nunau a si, Inn hluum rep loin a vak ringring ih,"},"12":{"text":"A caancaan ah lamkel kip le kotthler le thil zuarnak hmunin tlangval a bawh ṭheu."},"13":{"text":"Tlangvalpa cu a rak pom ih a hnam, ningzak loin a zoh ih,"},"14":{"text":"“Tuihsun ah raithawinak ka tuah ih, thawinak sa khal ka nei a si."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah nangmah hawl dingin ka ra suak ih atu-ah ka lo tong ngah zo."},"16":{"text":"Ka ihkhun cu Izipt ram ih patzai puan mawi zet ka phah zo."},"17":{"text":"Ka ihkhun cu mura, aloes le sinnamon rimhmui tla ka theh zo."},"18":{"text":"Ra awla, zanvaarte nomnak ah kan ciah aw pei, Pom aw in nuam tlang uhsi."},"19":{"text":"Ka pasal cu inn ah a um lo, Ram hlatpi ah khual a tlawng."},"20":{"text":"Paisa zaal khat in a keng ih, Thla thul hlan lo cu a ra tlung lo ding,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Duhnungza a ṭongkam thlumte thawn a leem ngah ih A mi lom thiamnak in a hruai hlo."},"22":{"text":"Cawcang in thahnak ding hmun a pan bangin le,"},"23":{"text":"Conkiang ih kah dingah zukneng in thang a pal bangin, Cuih nunau nu cu a thlun. Vate thang parih a fut bangin A nunnak tuksumza a si kha a thei lo"},"24":{"text":"Curuangah ka fapa le tla, ngaihnik uh. Ka lo sim mi thu hi ṭhatein ruat uh."},"25":{"text":"Cuvek nunau ṭha lo lam kha nan thinlung pan ter hlah uh, A dung khal thlun hlah uh."},"26":{"text":"Amah ih ruangah mi tampi an siatral ih a thih ter zo a si."},"27":{"text":"A inn ah nan feh a si ahcun mithi khua lamzin a si ih, Thihnak khur sungih vungṭum bangtuk a si."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaihnik! Fimnak in a lo ko ih, Theihthiamnak cu a au rero a si.","title":"Fimnak Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Lamzin kiang tlangzim parah le, Zinṭeek ah a ding ih,"},"3":{"text":"Khawpi luhnak kotka kiang in a au ih,"},"4":{"text":"“Milai pawl, mi hmuahhmuah hnenah ka lo dil, Leitlun um mi hmuahhmuah ka lo ko a si."},"5":{"text":"Ruahnak pitling hrihlo pawl, ruahnak pitling dingin zir uh. Mi aa pawl, ruahnak ṭha zir uh."},"6":{"text":"A sunglawi mi ka thu tla ngai uh, Ka simmi hi a dik a si."},"7":{"text":"Ka simmi hi thutak a si. Thuphan cu ka huat zawng a si."},"8":{"text":"Ka kaa ihsin a suakmi thu hmuahhmuah cu a dik, Mi hruai sualnak le thu dik lo a um lo."},"9":{"text":"Theithiamtu pawl hrang ahcun a fiang ṭheh ih, Fimnak hmutu pawl hrang ahcun a dik ṭheh a si."},"10":{"text":"Tangka hnakin ruahnak ka lo pekmi hi hril sawn uh, Sui ṭhabik hnakin fimthiamnak khi hril sawn uh."},"11":{"text":"Keimah cu fimnak ka si ih lungvar hnakin ka ṭha sawn, Na duhmi ziangdang thaw khalin na ṭhim thei lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Keimah hi fimnak ka si ih, theihfiangnak khal ka nei. Theihnak le thu ṭhen theinak ka nei."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihzah cu sualnak huat khi a si. Hngalnak le puarthaunak, sualnak lamzin le a dik lo mi ṭongkam ka hua."},"14":{"text":"Khawkhan tumtah ciami ka nei ih ka ṭuansuak ṭheh, Theihtheinak ka nei ih ka cak fawn a si."},"15":{"text":"Ram uknak ah siangpahrang pawl ka bawm ih, Uktu pawl uknak daan ṭha tuah dingin ka bawm a si."},"16":{"text":"Leitlun ih ram uktu pawl, ramhrang hnaṭuantu pawl le, Uknak lam ih upa pawl tla cu keimahih bomnak thawn ram an uk a si."},"17":{"text":"Keimah i duhdawtu pawl ka duhdawt ih, I hawltu in in hmu ding."},"18":{"text":"Lennak le hminthannak ka nei ih, Mi neinung sinak le mi nehnak tla ka ta an si."},"19":{"text":"Ka hnen ihsin na ngah mi tla cu, A ṭhabik mi sui le ngun hnakin a ṭha sawn."},"20":{"text":"Dingnak lampi ah ka feh ih, Lamzin dik kha ka thlun."},"21":{"text":"I duhdawtu pawl hnenah lennak ka pek ih, An inn cu hlawnthil thawn ka khahter."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in hlanlaipi ih a tuah hmaisabik mi lakah, Keimah hi in sersiam hmaisabik a si."},"23":{"text":"Leilungpi seem hlanah keimah cu a hmaisabik ih tuah mi ka si."},"24":{"text":"Tipi thuanthum le tiva pawl an um hlanah ka suak zo."},"25":{"text":"Fing le tlang pawl an um hlanah, Keimah cu ka suak zo ih,"},"26":{"text":"Leilung le ram pawl a hmaisabik sersiam mi, Leivut zatekhat hman Pathian in a tuah hlanah in tuah zo."},"27":{"text":"Van a seemsuah lai le tipi thuanthum kimvel a tuah lai ah khan ka um zo ih,"},"28":{"text":"Mero pawl tla van ih a hun ret laiah siseh, Tipi thuanthum ih tihna pawl a umter laiah khan siseh;"},"29":{"text":"Tipi tla a suahnak hnak ih saangah a kai lonak dingih thu a pek laiah siseh, ka um. Leilungpi a hram a ṭoh lai khalah ka um a si."},"30":{"text":"Inn ruangzingtu thil thiamzet bangin a kiangah ka um, Nitinte a lungawinak bik cu keimah ka si ih, A hmaiah ka lung a awi ringring."},"31":{"text":"Leilungpi le a tlun um minung pawl parah, Ka lung a kim a si."},"32":{"text":"Ka faale pawl, ka sim mi thu hi ngai uh. Ka simmi bangin tuah uhla nan lung a awi ding."},"33":{"text":"Ka lo zirhmi kha ngai uhla fim zir uh, Hi thu cu ziangsiar loin um hlah uh."},"34":{"text":"Ka thu a ngai ih nitinte ka sangka kiangah um in, Ka innsung luh a hngaktu cu an lung a awi ding."},"35":{"text":"Keimah i hmutu cu nunnak a co dingih, A parah Bawipa a lung a awi ding."},"36":{"text":"Keimah i tong lotu cu amai nunnak siatsuahtu a si ih, I huatu pohpoh cu thih a duh sawntu a si."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Fimnak in a inn a sak zo ih a ṭhuam pasarih kha a phun.","title":"Fimnak le Aatnak"},"2":{"text":"Puai tuahnak hrangah ṭilva a that, A sabitti ah rimhmui a rawi ih cabuai khal a hung zo."},"3":{"text":"Khawsung hmun saangbik ihsin au dingah A hnen-um nunau pawl a thlah ih,"},"4":{"text":"“Ruahnak mal deuh pawl hmuahhmuah hitawk ah hin ra uh,” an ti. Mi aa deuh pawl hnenah,"},"5":{"text":"“Ra uhla ka saang ra ei uh, Ka rawi cia mi sabitti ra in uh."},"6":{"text":"Aatnak cu tanta uhla nung thlang uh, Fimnak lamzin kha thlun uh,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Mi puarthau pa nun na sim ahcun a lo hmuhsuam ding. Mi ṭha lo pa na mawhthluk ahcun hriamhma na tuar ding."},"8":{"text":"Mi puarthau ziangtik hmanah nun va sim hlah, Nun na simnak ruangah a lo hua ding. Asinain mifim nun na sim ahcun a lo upat ding a si."},"9":{"text":"Mifimpa nun sim aw, a fim sin ding; Midingpa thu sim aw, a thiamnak a tam sin ding."},"10":{"text":"Pathian ṭih cu fimnak hramthoknak a si. A Thiang Mipa na theih ahcun theihthiamnak fimnak na nei."},"11":{"text":"Fimnak in na san a sauter ding."},"12":{"text":"Fimnak na neih ahcun ṭhathnemnak a lo pe ding, Fimnak na hnon ahcun harnak tuartu nangmah na si ding."},"13":{"text":"Aatnak cu a kam a tam ih ruahnak zianghman a nei lo, Ningzah nei lo ṭongtam nunau vek a si."},"14":{"text":"A inn sangka ah a to, Asilole khuasung hmun saangbik ah a to ih,"},"15":{"text":"Maió hnaṭuannak thu ruat phah ih lamzin a feh mi pawl kha,"},"16":{"text":"“Ruahnak nei lo mi pawl, hitawk lam ah ra uh,” a ti. Mi aa pa hnenah,"},"17":{"text":"“Firmi tidai cu a thlum deuh ih, Firmi saang cu a thaw deuh,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"A inn ih a fehtu pawl an thi ih, A innsung lut ngah zotu pawl cun, Mithi khua thukpi ah kan um ti kha an thei lo."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Himi pawl hi Solomon ih thufim an si. Fapa fim in a pai lung a awiter; Fapa aa in a nui riah a siatter.","title":"Solomon Ih Thufim"},"2":{"text":"A dik loih na ngah mi in ṭhatnak a lo pe lo ding. Asinain dingnak in na nunnak a lo humhim thei."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in miṭha pawl rilrawng ih um ding a sianglo, Asinain miṭha lo pawl ih duhnak cu a hloh sak ṭheu."},"4":{"text":"Zaangzelnak in farahnak a suah ter, Lawtnak in lennak a suah ter."},"5":{"text":"Rawlkhawm cut caan ih a khawmtu pa cu mifim a si, Rawlkhawm caan ih ihthat cu ningzahnak a si."},"6":{"text":"Miṭha pa in thluasuah a co ding, Miṭha lo pai ṭongkam in a ṭhatlonak nunzia a thup."},"7":{"text":"Miṭha pawl ciin ringring hi thluasuah a si, Asinain miṭha lo pawl ih hmin cu a ṭawtruai ding."},"8":{"text":"Mifim pawl in ruahnak ṭha pek mi an cosaang, Mi aa ṭongtam pawl cu siatralnak ah an thleng ding."},"9":{"text":"Miding pawl cu an himdam ih hnangamte in an um, Asinain midinglo pawl cu mi in an thei ngah ding."},"10":{"text":"Thudik a thuptu cun harnak a suahter, Asinain langhngan in a kawktu cun daihnak a suahter."},"11":{"text":"Miṭha pa ih ṭongkam cu nunnak cerhti a si, Asinain miṭha lo pa ih ṭongkam in ṭhat lonak nunzia a thup."},"12":{"text":"Huatnak in remlonak a suahter, Asinain duhdawtnak in sual palhnak hmuahhmuah a ngaithiam."},"13":{"text":"Mifim cun sullam nei mi an ṭong, Asinain mi aa pawl cu hrem an ṭul."},"14":{"text":"Mifim in fimnak an khawlkhawm, Asinain mi aa pawl ih ṭongkam cu harsatnak thawn a hlat aw lo."},"15":{"text":"Lennak in milian pawl a humhim, Farahnak in mifarah pawl a siatsuah."},"16":{"text":"Ṭhatnak tuah man cu nunnak a si, Asinain sualnak cun sual sinsinnak lam ah mi a hruai."},"17":{"text":"Nunsimnak a ngaitu pawl cu an nung ding, Asinain ka sual a ti duh lotu cu ṭihphannak sungah an um."},"18":{"text":"Huatnak thinlung thup a neitu cu thuphan per an si, Mi thangsiatnak a simtu cu mi aa an si."},"19":{"text":"Tamdeuh na ṭong le tamdeuh na sual ding, Mifim na si ahcun na ṭong suup aw."},"20":{"text":"Miṭhapa ih ṭongkam cu ngun ṭhabik bangtuk a si, Miṭha lo pa ih ruahnak cu man a nei lo."},"21":{"text":"Miṭhapa ih ṭongkam in mi tampi a ṭhathnemter, Asinain na aatnak in nangmah le nangmah na that aw thei."},"22":{"text":"Bawipaió thluasuahnak cu a lo liantertu a si, Hnaṭuan tamzet na ṭuannak in a lo lianter cuang lo."},"23":{"text":"Thilsual tuah hi a nuam a titu cu mi aa a si, Mifim pawl cu fimnak sungah lungawinak an nei."},"24":{"text":"Miding pawl in an saduhthah mi an ngah, Asinain miṭha lo pawl cu an ṭih bik mi an tong ding."},"25":{"text":"Thlisia a hran tikah miṭha lo pawl cu a hranhlo ding, Asinain miding pawl cu an him ding."},"26":{"text":"Na hnaṭuantu dingah mi zaangzel lak hlah, Na lak asile na ha hrangih sabit thur bangtuk le, Na mit hrangih meikhu bangtuk a si ding."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa cu upat aw, na nunkhua a sau ding, Miṭha lo pawl cu an san kim hlanah an thi ṭheu."},"28":{"text":"Miṭha pawl ih ruahsannak in lungawinak a suahter. Miṭha lo pawl ih ruahsan mi cu thulolak a si."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa in miding pawl a humhim, Asinain thil ṭha lo a tuahtu pawl cu a siatsuah."},"30":{"text":"Miding pawl cu himnak an nei camcin ding, Asinain miṭha lo pawl cu ram sungah umnak an nei lo ding."},"31":{"text":"Miding pawl in fimnak thu kha an sim, Asinain miṭha lo pawl ih lei cu tan a si ding."},"32":{"text":"Miding pawl cun sim ding mawi an thei, Asinain miṭha lo pawl cun mi siatsuahnak thu lawng an rel ṭheu."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuai dik lo a hmangtu pawl cu Bawipa in a hua, Asinain cuailung dikmi ah a lung a awi."},"2":{"text":"A porh awmi pawl cun hmuhsuamnak an tong ding, Curuangah tangdor ih um a ṭha deuh."},"3":{"text":"Miṭha cu dingnak in lam a hruai, Zum awk tlak lomi pawl cu anmah ihó ding lonak in a siatsuah."},"4":{"text":"Thihnak a thlen ni ahcun lennak hi a ṭhahnem lo, Asinain dingnak in na nunnak a lo humhim thei a si."},"5":{"text":"Dingnak in miṭhapa ih nunnak a nuamter, Asinain miṭha lo pawl cu an ṭhatlonak in an nunnak an tluksawn ter."},"6":{"text":"Dingnak in miding a luatter, Asinain zumtlak lomi cu amah ih duhhamnak in a awk."},"7":{"text":"Miṭha lo pa a thih tikah amah ih ruahsannak khal a thihcih, Lennak a rinsantu cu zianghman a ṭhahnem lo."},"8":{"text":"Miding pawl cu harsatnak ihsin run an si, Miṭha lo pawl hnen sawnah harsatnak a thleng."},"9":{"text":"Pathian ziangsiar lotu pawl ih ṭongkam in a lo siatsuah thei, Asinain miding pawl ih fimnak in a lo run thei a si."},"10":{"text":"Miding pawl vanṭhatnak an ton tikah khawpi an lung a awi, Miṭha lo pawl an thih tikah lungawi in an au."},"11":{"text":"Miding pawl in thluasuah an pek tikah khua cu a ṭhangso, Asinain miṭha lo pawl ih ṭongkam in khawpi cu a siatter."},"12":{"text":"Mi hmuhsuamnak ṭong a ṭongtu cu mi aa an si, Mifim na si ahcun na ṭong suup aw."},"13":{"text":"Katam pawl in thuthup an phuang ṭheu, Asinain zumtlak mi pawl in an thup thei."},"14":{"text":"Kaihhruainak um lo ahcun ram an siat, Ruahnak ṭha petu tamnak ah himnak a um."},"15":{"text":"Na theih lo mipa kha a leiba samsak dingah thu na kam ahcun na siir aw leh ding, Na tel lole na hrangah a ṭha deuh."},"16":{"text":"Zaangfah thiam minu cu upat mi a si, Asinain ziaza ṭhatnak a nei lo minu cu ningzakza a si. Mi zaangzel in sumsaw a nei dah lo ding, Asinain mitaima pawl cu an lian ding."},"17":{"text":"Mi zaangfah thiam na si ahcun nangmah le nangmah hmaiṭhatnak na pe aw, Mi zaangfah nei lo na si ahcun nangmah le nangmah na siatsuah aw."},"18":{"text":"Miṭha lo pawl in hlawknak ngaingai an tong thei lo, Asinain thildik na tuah ahcun laksawng pek na si hrimhrim ding."},"19":{"text":"Zokhal ṭhatnak tuah ding a ruattu cu an nung ding, Asinain zokhal ṭhat lonak a tuah ringringtu cu an thi ding."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in thinlung ṭha lo pawl a hua, Asinain thildik a tuahtu pawl cu a duh."},"21":{"text":"Miṭha lo pawl hrem an si ding ticu a fiang, Asinain miding pawl cu an luat ding."},"22":{"text":"A mawizet naón khawruah thiamnak a nei lo mi nunau cu, Vok hnar ih sui khaih bangtuk a si."},"23":{"text":"Miṭha pawl duhnak cu ṭhatnak ah a suak ṭheu, Miṭha lo pawl in an duhmi an ngah tikah mi hmuahhmuah an thin a heng ṭheu."},"24":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat siangzet in an paisa an hmang naón an lian deuh deuh, A dang pawl cu an ralring zet naón an farah sinsin."},"25":{"text":"Siangzet in nung awla na lian ding, Midang va bawm awla an lo bawm ve ding."},"26":{"text":"A man kai deuh hngak in rawl a zuar siang lotu cu mi in an cam siat, Asinain zuar a siangtu cu mi in an lawm."},"27":{"text":"Na hmuitin mi a ṭhat a si ahcun upat na si ding, Asinain harsatnak na hawl ahcun, cumicu na ngah ding."},"28":{"text":"Lennak a rinsantu pawl cu ṭhal caan thinghnah bangin an ṭil ding. Asinain miding pawl cu tlimno bangin an hninghno ding."},"29":{"text":"A innsungsang tlunah harsatnak a thlentertu cu a netnak ah zianghman a nei lo ding, Mi aa pawl cu mifim pawl ih hnen-um an si ringring ding."},"30":{"text":"Dingnak ih rah cu nunnak a si, Asinain ṭhat lonak in nunnak a hlohter."},"31":{"text":"Miṭha pawl in leitlun ah ṭhatman an ngah ahcun, Miṭha lo le misual pawl in ziangtluk hremnak an ngah ding ti cu a fiang a si."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Fimnak a duhtu pawl cun an sual tikah nunsim an duh. Nunsimnak a huatu cu mi aa an si."},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in mi ṭha pawl cu a lawm; Asinain ṭhat lonak khua a khangtu pawl cu a hnong."},"3":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak in mi a humhim lo; Asinain miding pawl cu hngetzet in an ding."},"4":{"text":"Nupi ṭha cu a pasal ih sui lukhuh a si; Asinain a pasal tlun ih ningzahnak a thlentertu nupi cu, a pasal ruh sungih khensar natnak vek a si."},"5":{"text":"Miding cun tluang zetin mi an kom, Mi ṭha lo pawl cun mi bum ding lawng an duh."},"6":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih ṭongkam cu mi thahnak thu a si; Asinain miding pawl ih ṭongkam in mi a runsuak."},"7":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu thihnak an tong ih an ci a mit; Asinain miding innsungsaang pawl cu an santluan in a ṭha."},"8":{"text":"Mifim na si ahcun mi in an lo lawm ding; Mi aa na si ahcun mi in an lo hmuhsuam ding."},"9":{"text":"Mah ih nunnak hrang hna a ṭuan rerotu mizaraan si cu, Mi thupi zet vekin um ih rilrawn hnakin a ṭha deuh."},"10":{"text":"Mi ṭha pawl in an ṭilva an fingkhawi; Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cun an ṭilva zaangfahnak an nei lo."},"11":{"text":"A law-mi lothlo pa in ei ding tampi a nei; Asinain a ṭhathnem lomi hnaṭuan ih caan cemtertu cu mi aa an si."},"12":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih duhmi cu thil ṭha lo tuah ding hawl khi a si. Asinain miding pawl ih hrihram cu fektein a ding."},"13":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo cu amah ih ṭongkam in a awk aw; Asinain mi ṭha cu harnak ihsin amahte a luat awter."},"14":{"text":"Na simmi le na tuahmi parah na covo a um; Nangmah ih tawkzawn in na ngah ding."},"15":{"text":"Mi aa pawl in miding kan si tiah an ruat aw ringring ṭheu; Mifim pawl cun ruahnak pekmi an ngai."},"16":{"text":"Mi aa cun a thinhennak zamrangin a langter; Mifim cun mi ih zomtaihnak hman daitein a um san."},"17":{"text":"Thudik na simnak in felnak a langter; Asinain thuphan in fel lonak lamah a hruai."},"18":{"text":"Ruahnak nei cuca lo ṭongkam cun nam vekin thuk zetin mi a sun; Asinain mifim ih ṭongkam in hma a damter."},"19":{"text":"Thuphan in nunnak caan tawite a nei; Asinain thudik cu kumkhua in a nung."},"20":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak thil a ngaituahtu cu amah le amah a bum aw; Asinain daihnak remreltu pawl hnenah lungawinak a um."},"21":{"text":"Miding pawl hnenah thil ṭha lo a thleng lo; Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cun harnak lawnglawng an tong."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in thuphan pertu pawl a hua; Asinain miding rintlak pawl cu a lawm."},"23":{"text":"Mifim pawl cu an theihmi thu khalah dai tein an um; Asinain mi aa pawl cun an aatnak kha an langter ṭheu."},"24":{"text":"Hnaṭuan taimaknak in uknak huham a lo pe ding ih, Zaangzelnak in sal ah a lo canter ding."},"25":{"text":"Donharnak in na lungawinak a dawi hlo ding; Asinain zaangfahnak ṭongkam in thazaang a lo pe ding."},"26":{"text":"Miding pa cu a rualpi ih lamhruaitu a si; Asinain mi ṭha lo pa ih lamzin in rualpi pawl lam a pialter."},"27":{"text":"Mi zaangzel pawl cun ram an toih hmanah sakahmi an nei lo; Asinain mi taima pawl cun thil man sunglawi bik an khawm."},"28":{"text":"Dingnak cu nunnak lampi a si ih, ṭhat lonak cu thihnak lampi a si."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Fapa fim cu a pa in nun a sim tikah a ngai; Asinain mi hngal cun ka sual ngai a ti dah lo."},"2":{"text":"Mi ṭha cun an ṭongkam ih rah an ei ding; Asinain mibum hmang pawl cun ṭhat lonak lawng an hiar."},"3":{"text":"Na simmi ralring awla na nunnak kha humhim a si ding; Ralring loih a ṭongtu cun amah le amah a siatsuah aw."},"4":{"text":"Mi zaangzel cun thil tampi a duh zet ṭheu; Asinain zianghman a ngah cuang lo; Hnaṭuan zetmi cun a duh mi pohpoh a ngah ding."},"5":{"text":"Miding pawl in thudik lo an hua, Asinain mi ṭha lo ṭongkam pawl cu ningzakza le fihnungza a si."},"6":{"text":"Dingnak in sualnak nei lo pawl a humhim; ṭhat lonak cu misual pawl ih tluknak a si."},"7":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat pawl cu milian vekin an um; Asinain zianghman an nei lo; Mi hrekkhat cu farah vekin an um, Asinain thilri tampi an nei."},"8":{"text":"Milian in an nunnak tlennak ah paisa hman ding an nei; Asinain mi farah cu zohman in an hringhro lo."},"9":{"text":"Miding pawl ih tleunak cu a tleu cuang a bang; Mi ṭha lo pawl ih meikhuat cu a mit cing ding."},"10":{"text":"Puarthaunak cun harsatnak lawng a suahter; Mi dang ruahnak thuron cu fimdeuhnak a si."},"11":{"text":"Ol-ai deuh ih na ngahmi lennak cu, A rei hlanah a hlo vivo ding; Harsazet ih na hlawhmi cu rei a daih ding."},"12":{"text":"Ruahsannak ngah lohli lo tikah thinlung a na; Asinain saduhthah mi a kim tikah nunnak cu lungawinak in a khat."},"13":{"text":"Nunsimnak thu zianghman a siar lotu pawl cu anmah le anmah an siat awter ding; Nunsimnak thu a thlun mi pawl cu an him ding a si."},"14":{"text":"Mifim mi pawl ih zirhnak cu nunnak cerhti a si; Cu pawl in na nunnak cu ṭihphannak sungih a um tikah, an luatter ding."},"15":{"text":"Fimthiamnak in upatnak a hlawh, Asinain zumtlak a si lomi pawl cu siatnak lamzin ah an feh."},"16":{"text":"Mifim pawl cu thil an tuah hlanah khua an ruatta ṭheu; Asinain mi aa pawl cun an aatnak sawn an phuang."},"17":{"text":"Rinsan tlak lo tlang-autu pawl in harnak an suahter; Asinain zumtlakmi palai pawl in daihnak an suahpi."},"18":{"text":"Nunsimnak ngai duh lo cu farahnak le mualphonak a si; Asinain nunsimnak a ngaitu cu upatnak an co ding."},"19":{"text":"Saduhthah mi ngah hi ziangtluk in a ṭha; Mi aa pawl cun ṭhat lonak ihsin kirsal ding an duh lo."},"20":{"text":"Mifim pawl thawn umtlang awla na fim ding; Mi aa na pawl a si ahcun harnak na tong ding."},"21":{"text":"Misual pawl cu harsatnak in hmunzakip ah a thlun; Asinain miding pawl cu ṭhatnak laksawng an co ding."},"22":{"text":"Mi ṭha in a tu le a fa tiangin a lennak a roh ding; Asinain misual pawl ih lennak cu miding pawl kutah a thleng ding."},"23":{"text":"Thlawh lomi loram ihsin farah hrangah rawl tampi a suah ding; Asinain dingthluk lairelnak a um lo ruangah a suakmi rawl hman an sung lam ding."},"24":{"text":"Na fapa na hrem lo ahcun amah na duhdaw lo a si; Na duhdawt a si ahcun nun na sim ding."},"25":{"text":"Miding pawl in eikhop rawl an nei; Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cu kumkhua in an ril a rawng."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nunau fim pawl in an inn an sak; Asinain a aa pawl in anmah kut lala in an balsiat."},"2":{"text":"Miding pawl in Bawipa an ṭihzah; Asinain mi hrokhrawl pawl cun ziangah an siar lo."},"3":{"text":"Mi aa hngal in tamtuk an ṭong ih, Mifim pa ih ṭongkam in amah kha a humhim."},"4":{"text":"Hnaṭuantu ding cawcang pawl an um lo ahcun, na cuam cu a lawng ding; Asinain cawcang pawl ih thazaang in rawl tampi a suah ding."},"5":{"text":"Rintlak mi thutheitu in thudik a sim ṭheu; Asinain rintlak lomi cun thuphan lawnglawng a sim."},"6":{"text":"Mi puarthau pawl cu mifim an cang thei dah lo; Asinain mifim pawl cun ol ngaiten thu an zir."},"7":{"text":"Mi aa pawl kiangkap ah um hlah; Nangmah lo zirh ding zianghman an nei lo."},"8":{"text":"Ziangruangah mifim cu a fim? Ziang ka tuah ding ti a theih ruangah a fim. Ziangruangah mi aa cu a aat? Ka thei a si tiah a ruah awk ruangah a aa."},"9":{"text":"Mi aa pawl cu an sual khalah sual sir awk ti an thei lo. Asinain miding cun ngaihthiam mi si ding kha an duh."},"10":{"text":"Na lungawinak cu nangmah ih ta a si; Na riahsiatnak khal nangmah ih ta a si; Zohman in an lo ṭawmpi thei lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pa ih inn a siat ṭheh hnu hmanah, Mi ṭha pa ih deu cu a fek ringring hrih ding."},"12":{"text":"Mihrek in lamzin dik tiih an ruahmi A netnak ah thihnak ih mi hruaitu lamzin a um."},"13":{"text":"Hnih-nak aw in riahsiatnak aw a thup thei; Sikhalsehla lungawinak a cem tikah, Riahsiatnak cu a taang ringring ding."},"14":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo in an ṭhat lo man an ngah ding ih, Mi ṭha in an ṭhat man an ngah ding."},"15":{"text":"Ruahnak mal pawl in ziang hmuahhmuah an zum; Mifim pawl cun an fehnak kha ṭhatein an zohta ṭheu."},"16":{"text":"Mifim pawl cu ralring tein an um ih ṭhat lonak kha an hrial; Asinain mi aa cun ralrinnak nei loin zamrang tukin an tuah ṭheu."},"17":{"text":"Mi thintawi pawl cu at-hlawh zetin thil an tuah; Asinain mifim deuh pawl cu tangdorte in an um."},"18":{"text":"Ruahnak mal pawl cu aat man an ngah ding; Asinain mifim cun an fim man ah fimthiamnak an co ding."},"19":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu mi ṭha pawl hmaiah an kun ih, Mithmai ṭha ngah dingin zaangfah an dil."},"20":{"text":"Mifarah pawl cu an innhnen hman in an hrial; Asinain milian pawl cu rualpi tampi an nei."},"21":{"text":"Mi lungawi si na duh ahcun, mi farah va zaangfah aw; Midang hmuhsuam cu sualnak a si."},"22":{"text":"Ṭhatnak hrang lawng khua na khan ahcun, Mi in an lo zum ding ih an lo upat ding. Asinain ṭhat lonak hrang khuakhan cu palhnak a si."},"23":{"text":"Hnaṭuan khung ṭuan awla na cawm aw thei ding; To men ih ṭong rero cu farahnak a si."},"24":{"text":"Mifim pawl cu lennak laksawng pek an si ding; Asinain mi aa pawl cu an aatnak in theih thei an si."},"25":{"text":"Thudik simtu thutheitu cun nunnak a humhim ding; Asinain thuphan a pertu cu mi zuartu a si."},"26":{"text":"Pathian ṭihzahnak in mi pakhat le a innsang hnenah, mah le mah rinsan awknak le humhimnak a pek."},"27":{"text":"Thihnak in luat na duh maw? Bawipa ṭihzah cu nunnak cerhti a si."},"28":{"text":"Siangpahrang ih hu le thawm cu, a ukmi tam le mal parah a um; A ukmi an um lo ahcun amah lawng cu zianghman a si lo."},"29":{"text":"Thinsau mi cu mifim a si; Asinain na thin a tawi ahcun na aatnak kha na langter."},"30":{"text":"Thindaihnak in pumsa a damter; Asinain iksiiknak cu ruh hrangah khensar natnak vek a si."},"31":{"text":"Mi farah pawl na hrem ahcun, mi farah pawl sersiamtu Pathian na nautat a si; Asinain farah pawl zaangfahtu cu Pathian ṭihzahtu a si."},"32":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu anmah ih tuahmi ṭhatlonak in siatnak a thlenpi; Asinain mi ṭha pawl cu anmah ih felnak in a humhim."},"33":{"text":"Fimnak cu mifim pawl ih lung sungah a um ih, Mi aa pawl ih lung sungah cun umnak hmun a nei lo."},"34":{"text":"Dingnak in miphun a cawisaang; Sualnak cun miphun mual a photer."},"35":{"text":"Siangpahrang in a felmi a hnaṭuantu pawl a lawm; Asinain a fel lomi hnaṭuantu pawl cu a hrem."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Awkaa neem ih thulehnak in thinhengnak a daiter; Asinain ṭong hrang in thinhengnak a suahter sin."},"2":{"text":"Mifim pawl ih lei in fimnak a karhter, Mi aa pawl ih kaa in aatnak a suahter."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in hmunkipih a cangmi thil hmuahhmuah a hmu ṭheh; ṭhatnak kan tuah ah siseh, siatnak kan tuah ah siseh, in zoh ringring a si."},"4":{"text":"Zaangfahnak ṭongkam in thinlung a nungter sal; Asinain zaangfahnak um lo ṭongkam cun thinlung a kuaiter."},"5":{"text":"Pa ih nunsimnak a eltu cu mi aa an si; Nunsimnak a saangtu cu mifim an si."},"6":{"text":"Miding in an sumsaw an khawl; Asinain mi ṭha lo cun harnak a thlen tikah an rak hmang ral zo."},"7":{"text":"Mifim pawl ruangah fimnak a karhzai; Mi aa pawl ruangih karhzai a si lo."},"8":{"text":"Mi ṭha pawl thla an cam tikah Bawipa a lung a awi; Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl ih an kenmi raithawinak cu a fih."},"9":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih thil tuahzia cu Bawipa in a hua; Asinain dingnak a tuahtu pawl cu a duhdawt."},"10":{"text":"Thil sual na tuah ahcun nazet ih hremnak na tuar ding; Nunsimnak na duh lo ahcun na thi ding."},"11":{"text":"Mithi khua Sheol le hngilhnak ram sungih a ummi pawl khal khi Bawipa in a hmu ṭheh; Ziangtin so minung in an ruahnak kha Pathian hmai ihsin an thuh thiam ding?"},"12":{"text":"Mi hngal pawl cun nunsim an duh lo; A fim deuh pawl hnen ihsin ruahnak khal an dil dah lo."},"13":{"text":"Minung cu an lungawi tikah an mithmai a ṭha; Asinain an riahsiat tikah an thin a nau."},"14":{"text":"Mifim pawl cun zir ding an duh; Asinain mi aa pawl cu an aatnak ah khan an lung a kim ko."},"15":{"text":"Mifarah pawl cu lungrethei ringring in an um; Milungawi pawl cu an nun a nuam ringring."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihphah ih malte neih hi, lian ih thinphang rero hnakin a ṭha sawn."},"17":{"text":"Duhdawtmi pawl thawn hanghnah hangrah ei cu, Huatawknak hmun ih sa thaw bik ei hnakin a thaw deuh."},"18":{"text":"Thintawinak in tawhawknak a suahter; Asinain thinsaunak in remnak a thlenter."},"19":{"text":"Mizaangzel na si ahcun hmunkipah harnak na tong ding; Miding na si ahcun harsatnak na nei lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Fapa fim in a pa ih lung a awiter; Mi aa lawngin a nu kha a hmuhsuam."},"21":{"text":"Mi aa pawl cu anmah ih aatnak ah an thin a nuam; Asinain mifim cun dingnak kha a tuah ding."},"22":{"text":"Ruahnak tam deuh na lak tik poh ah na hlawhtling ding; Cu lo ahcun na hlawhsam ringring ko ding."},"23":{"text":"A caan thawn a remmi ṭongkam ṭong ngah cu, ziangtlukin so a ṭhat."},"24":{"text":"Mifim cu thihnak lam ah vung feh loin, nunnak lamzin ah a hung feh."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa in mihngal pawl ih inn cu a siatbal ding; Asinain nuhmei nu ih thilri kha a kilveng ding a si."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa in ruahnak ṭha lo pawl cu a hua; Asinain rem awknak ṭongkam ah a lung a awi."},"27":{"text":"Dik lozet ih hlawknak ngah na tum ahcun, Na innsang na buaiter ding. Nawhthuh lak hlah awla na san a sau ding."},"28":{"text":"Mi ṭha pawl cun thu leh hlanah an ruat hmaisa ṭheu; Mi ṭha lo pawl cun zamrang in an let ih buainak an suahter."},"29":{"text":"Mi ṭha pawl thla an cam tikah Bawipa in a ngai; Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl ih thlacamnak cu a hnong."},"30":{"text":"Mithmai ṭha in mi lung a awiter, Cule thuthang ṭha cun ruh sung tiangin damnak a pek."},"31":{"text":"Nunsimnak ṭhatein na ngai ahcun mifim na si."},"32":{"text":"Zir ding na el ahcun nangmah le nangmah na hmuhsuam aw a si. Nunsimnak na saan ahcun na fim deuh ding."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihzah hi fim zirnak a si. Upatnak na co theinak dingah tangdor hmaisa aw."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minung in khua cu kan khaang ko ding; Asinain a cemnak ih thuneitu cu Pathian a si."},"2":{"text":"Na tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu a ṭha ṭheh in na ruat ko ding; Asinain Bawipa cun thinlung lam a zoh sawn."},"3":{"text":"Na tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa ih hnenah hlaan aw; Na khawkhannak ah na hlawhtling ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in thil hmuahhmuah hi cemnetnak nei in a tuah; Cuvekin mi ṭha lo ih cemnetnak cu siatralnak a si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in mi hngalhngawng pawl cu a hua; Cuvek pawl cu hremnak in a luatter lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Pathian hnenah felzet le zumtlak zetin um awla na sualnak a lo ngaithiam ding; Bawipa ih thu ngai awla ṭhat lonak na hrial thei ding."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih lung na awiter tikah na ral pawl hman na rualpi ah na tuah thei ding."},"8":{"text":"Fel lonak thawn paisa tampi neih hnakin, Felte in hlawh ih paisa malte neih hi a ṭha deuh."},"9":{"text":"Khawkhannak cu na nei ko ding; Asinain na tuahmi pawlah lam a lo hruaitu cu Pathian a si."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang cun Pathian ih hu le ham thawn thu a rel; A hmurka in a suakmi pawl cu a dik ringring."},"11":{"text":"Cuai le tahnak pawl cu Pathian in dikteih tuah a duh; Zuar mi hmuahhmuah khal felteih tuah a duh."},"12":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak tuah hi siangpahrang pawl in an duh lo; Ziangahtile uknak fektertu cu dingnak a si."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang in thudik theih a duh ih, Thudik ṭongtu kha mithmaiṭha a pe ding."},"14":{"text":"Mifim cun siangpahrang lungawiter ding a zuam; Siangpahrang a thin a hen ahcun pakhatkhat an thi men thei."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang ih mithmai a ṭhat tikah nunnak a um; A zaangfahnak cu ṭhalruah kengtu khawdur bangtuk a si."},"16":{"text":"Fimnak hi sui hnakin a ṭha deuh; Theihthiamnak hi ngun hnakin hril deuh ding a si."},"17":{"text":"Mi ṭha pawl cun ṭhat lonak a hrialtu lamzin an thlun; Curuangah khuitawk lam na pan ti kha zoh ṭha aw; Na nunnak a lo run thei ding."},"18":{"text":"Hngalnak in siatralnak a thlenter; Porh awknak in ṭumsuknak ah mi a hruai."},"19":{"text":"Mifarah thawn tangdorte ih um cu, Mi puarthau pawl thawn hransaw ṭhen awk hnakin a ṭha deuh."},"20":{"text":"An lo zirhmi kha ṭhatein ngai awla na hlawhtling ding; Bawipa kha rinsan awla na lung a awi ding."},"21":{"text":"Thinlung fimmi cu thil a thlei dang theitu an si; Awkaa thlum in mi a hiip thei."},"22":{"text":"Mifim hrangah fimnak cu nunnak cerhti a si; Asinain mi aa fim zirh tum cu caan a cem lak meen."},"23":{"text":"Mifim pawl cun an ṭong hlanah khua an ruat; Curuangah an simmi cu hmual a nei."},"24":{"text":"Zaangfahnak ṭongkam cu khuaitizu vek a si; Kaa sungah a thlum ih harhdamnak hrangah a ṭha."},"25":{"text":"Lamzin dik a si tiih na ruahmi kha, Thihnak ah a lo thlenpitu lamzin a si thei meen."},"26":{"text":"Hnaṭuantu cu rawl a hiarnak in tam deuh hna a ṭuanter; Ziangahtile a ril rawnnak kha riamter a duh."},"27":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cun midang harsatnak pek ding lam an hawl; An ṭongkam hman in mi a kaang."},"28":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl in mi relsiatnak an karhter; Harnak an suahter ih rualpi ṭha hman an ṭhen-awter."},"29":{"text":"Mi helhlong pawl in rualpi pawl an bum ih, siatralnak lamah mi an hruai."},"30":{"text":"Mit a lo sin duapdotu le kam a lo sehtu cu va ralring aw; Ziangahtile ṭhat lonak ruattu an si."},"31":{"text":"Nunsaunak cu miding pawl ih covo a si; Sam par cu sunlawinak lukhuh a si."},"32":{"text":"Thinsau cu thacahnak hnakin a ṭha deuh; Mah le mah uk theinak cu khawpi tampi uk theinak hnakin a ṭha deuh."},"33":{"text":"Pathian ih tumtahnak thei dingah camcawhfung an zuuk; Asinain a thulehnak cu amah Pathian ih lairelmi a si."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rem-awklonak inn ih puai zawh hnakin, Thinlung hnadaite ih buhṭhing tlangkhat ei a ṭha sawn."},"2":{"text":"A fim zetmi sal cu a bawipa ih fapa santlai lomi tlunah, Thuneihnak a ngah ding ih ro ṭhen khat a co ve ding."},"3":{"text":"Sui le ngun cu meisa in hniksak an si; Minung thinlung cu Bawipa in a hniksak."},"4":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cun ruahnak ṭha lo an thlun ih, thuphanpertu pawl in thuphan thu kha an ngai."},"5":{"text":"Mifarah na zawmtai a si ahcun a sersiamtu Pathian na zawmtai a si; Mi in vansiatnak an ton tikah na di a riam ahcun hrem na si ding."},"6":{"text":"Tar pawl ih bawi lukhuh cu an tu le fa pawl an si; Nauhak pawl ih sunlawinak cu an nu le pa an si."},"7":{"text":"Upat tlakmi pawl in thuphan an sim lo; Mi aa pawl cun a remcaan laiah simrel ding an thei lo."},"8":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat pawl in nawhthuh cu mitkher vekin hna a ṭuan thei ding tiin an ruat; Ziang hmuahhmuah a tuah thei tiah an zum."},"9":{"text":"Mi in nangmah a lo duhdawt ding na duh a si ahcun, An sual tikah va ngaithiam aw; Sualpalhnak ciin ringringnak in rualpi a ṭhen thei."},"10":{"text":"Mi aa voi zakhat thawi hnakin, Mifim voi khat kawk a luut thuuk sawn."},"11":{"text":"Harnak a suakter ringringtu mi ṭha lo pawl hnenah, Thihnak kha zualkotu bangin thlah a si ding."},"12":{"text":"A fa lonsak mi vompi ton hi, Mi aa buai rero lai ton hnakin a ṭha deuh."},"13":{"text":"Ṭhatnak kha ṭhat lonak ih a lehrultu cu, ṭhat lonak khan a inn ihsin a suahsan lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Tawhawknak hramthok cu tidai khamtu kuai hramthok vek a si; Sualawknak a um hlanah baang aw."},"15":{"text":"Sualnak nei lo mawhthluk le mi ṭha lo thiam coter hi, An pahnih in Bawipa ih huat zawng a si."},"16":{"text":"Mi aa fim zirhnak hrangih tangka tampi cem hi ziangso a ṭhahnem? Ziangahtile a fim cuang lo ding; Fim theinak thinlung a nei lo."},"17":{"text":"Rualpi ṭha in duhdawtnak an langter ringring; Harsatnak caanih kan bawm-awk lo ah unau si man ziangso a um?"},"18":{"text":"Khawruahnak nei lo mi aa lawng in mi dang ih leiba hrangah, ṭuanvo lakin thu a kam aw."},"19":{"text":"Sualnak duh cu harsatnak tuah duh thawn a bang; Na uar awk rero ahcun harsatnak na sawm thawn a bang."},"20":{"text":"Thinlung ṭha lo minung cu a lamzin a tluang lo; Mibum hmang lei cu siatralnak sungah a tla."},"21":{"text":"Fapa aa cun riahsiatnak a suahter; Fapa aa a neitu cu lungawinak a nei lo."},"22":{"text":"Lungawinak hi sii ṭhazet a si. Thinharnak in ruh a roter."},"23":{"text":"Thuṭhentu misual pawl cun, Nawhthuh an lak thup ih dingthluk lairelnak a um thei lo."},"24":{"text":"Mifim pawl cun thil ṭha tuah ding an thei; Asinain mi aa pawl cu an thinlung a vaangza."},"25":{"text":"Fapa aa in pa ih hnenah thinharnak a thlenter ih, A nu ih hnenah lungretheihnak a thlenter."},"26":{"text":"Sualnak nei lomi hrem cu a dik lo; Mi ṭha pawl vuak cu a sia sinsin."},"27":{"text":"Mifim pawl in tampi an ṭong lem lo; Daite in a ummi cu thildik hmu theitu an si."},"28":{"text":"Mi aa hman daitein a um ahcun, mifim ah ruah a si; A kaa a ciip ahcun, mifim bangtuk a si."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Midang thawn a pawlkom aw thei hrimhrim lomi cu, Mah ih duhnak lawng ruattu an si. Midang ruahnak cu a pom thei dah lo."},"2":{"text":"Mi aa cun thu a theih le theih lo kha thupi ah a ruat lo; Ziangtluk ka fim ti langter ding lawng a duh."},"3":{"text":"Sualnak le ningzah mualphonak cu an feh tlang ringring; Upatnak na hlohter ahcun a ai ah hmuhsuamnak na ngah ding."},"4":{"text":"Minung ṭongkam hi fimnak hram a si thei; Tipithuanthum vekin a thuk thei ih, A luang ringring mi tiva vekin a thar ringring thei."},"5":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl mithmaiṭha pek cu a dik lomi a si; Miding thiamlo coter khal a dik lomi a si."},"6":{"text":"Mi aa hmur in tawhawknak a suak; Cun a kaa in vuakvelhnak a sawm."},"7":{"text":"Mi aa a ṭong tikah amah le amah a siatsuah aw rero; A ṭongmi in amah le amah a awk aw."},"8":{"text":"Mi relsiatnak thu cu a thaw nasa; A thlum zet ih kan dolh hluahhlo."},"9":{"text":"Mi zaangzel cu mi siatsuahtu tluk ih sia a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa cu a hngetmi beunak inn donhleisang a si; Miding pawl cu cutawkah an feh ih an him."},"11":{"text":"Milian pawl in an sumsaw kha himnak ah an ruat; A saang ih a fek zetmi khawpi kulhnak hauhruang ah an ruat."},"12":{"text":"Zokhal tangdornak a neih hlan lo cu upatnak pek a si dah lo; Mi hngal pawl cu siatnak lamzin ah an um."},"13":{"text":"Thu na leh hlanah ṭhatein ngai hmaisata aw; Cutin na tuah lole mi aa na si ih hlei ah thu na leh mi kha na hmuhsuam a si."},"14":{"text":"Minung thinlung in natnak a tuar thei; Sikhalsehla zoso thinlung kuai cu a tuar thei?"},"15":{"text":"Mifim pawl cu zir duhnak thinlung an nei ringring."},"16":{"text":"Mi thupi mi ton na duh maw? Thil ṭhen ding keng awla olte in na tong thei ding."},"17":{"text":"Thuṭhennak zungah thu a sim hmaisa biktu cu mi dik bik a bang; Sikhalsehla cutiih a bangnak cu amah a eltupa in thu a sut ih a hlathlai ciamco tik tiang lawng a daih."},"18":{"text":"Thutheizet veve pahnih thuṭhennak zungah thu an el awk ahcun, Camcawhfung lawngin an thu a ṭhen thei."},"19":{"text":"Na unau bawm awla anih in a fekmi khawpi hauhruang vekin a lo hum ding; Asinain na tawh a si ahcun na hrangah a sangka a khar ding."},"20":{"text":"Na ṭong ih a suahtermi rah in na pum a lo puarter ding; Na hmur ihsin a suakmi in na lung a lo kimter ding."},"21":{"text":"Na ṭongkam in na nunnak a himter thei vekin siatnak khalah a siatter thei; Curuangah na ṭongkam ruangih a ra thlengmi thil pawl cu na tuar thei a ṭul."},"22":{"text":"Nupi ton cu thil ṭha ton a si; Cumi in Bawipa ih ṭhatnak na parah a langter."},"23":{"text":"Mifarah a ṭong tikah a dil tein a dil ṭheu; Sikhalsehla milian pa cun awkaa hrang in mi a let."},"24":{"text":"Rualpi hrekkhat cu caan tawite sung lawng an hmun; Sikhalsehla rualpi ṭhenkhat cu unau hnakin mi an tlaihsan sawn."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A dingmi mifarah si cu a hrokhrawlmi mi aa hnakin a ṭha deuh."},"2":{"text":"Theihnak um lo ih a duh lawng duh cu a ṭha lo; Thinsaunak um lo cun harnak ton a olte."},"3":{"text":"Minung in mah ih aatnak ruangah siatralnak an tong ṭheu; Cutikah Bawipa an mawhthluk."},"4":{"text":"Lennak in rualpi thar tampi a suahter; Sikhalsehla mifarah cu a rualpi cia hman in an tlansan ṭheu."},"5":{"text":"Thuṭhennak zungah thuphan na sim asile, Cawhkuan na tong ding, na luatnak a um lo."},"6":{"text":"Mitampi in mi thupi pawl hnenin mithmaiṭha ngah an zuam; Mi tirhsiang hrang ahcun zokhal rualpi ṭha an si ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Mifarah cu a suahpi unau hman in an hnong ṭheu; Theihthiam mi rualpi menmen pawl cun ziangtlukin so an tlansan sinsin ding! Ziangtluk ih a kawh hai rero khalle an kir nawn lo."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah le nangmah duhdaw awla, Fimnak kha na zir thei tawkin zir aw; Na zirmi kha ciing ringring awla, Na thil tuahmi ah na hlawhtling ding."},"9":{"text":"A dik lomi thutheitu cu hremnak in a luat lo ding; Thuphan a simtu cu a siatral ding."},"10":{"text":"Mi aa cu nunnuam zetin nung dingah a tlak lo; Sal ih bawi uk ding cu a tlak lo sinsin."},"11":{"text":"Na fim asile na thinlung na uk thei ding, Mi ih sualnak ngaithiam cu thil sunglawi a si."},"12":{"text":"Siangpahrang thinhengnak cu kiosa huuk bangtuk a si; Sikhalsehla a zaangfahnak cu hrampi parih tladai bangtuk a si."},"13":{"text":"Fapa aa in siatralnak ah a pa a thlenpi; A phunzai ringringmi nupi cu catbaang loin a surmi ruah bangtuk a si."},"14":{"text":"Inn le sumsaw cu nu le pa hnenih ngahmi rothil an si; Sikhalsehla nupi fim cu Bawipa ih hnen ihsin ngahmi a si."},"15":{"text":"Zaangzel in na it ringring men asile, na ril a rawng ding."},"16":{"text":"Pathian thukham thlun awla na nunkhua a sau ding; Ziangsiar loin na um asile na thi ding."},"17":{"text":"Mi farah parih zaangfahnak neih cu Bawipa ih hnen ih thil pek bangtuk a si; Bawipa amah in a lo pe sal leh ding."},"18":{"text":"Na faale kha an no laiah nun sim aw; Na sim lo asile anmah le anmah siatsuah aw dingin na bawm a si."},"19":{"text":"Nasa zetih thinhengtu cu hremnak a tong ding; Harnak sungin voi khat run hman awla na run sal a ṭul thotho ding."},"20":{"text":"Ruahnak pekmi kha na ngai ih zirnak na neih asile, Nikhat khat ahcun mifim na si ding."},"21":{"text":"Minung cun a thinlung in khaw- khannak tampi a nei ko ding; Sikhalsehla Bawipa ih khawkhannak lawng tuah a si ding."},"22":{"text":"Duhham hi ningzahnak a si; Mifarah si hi thuphanpertu si hnakin a ṭha deuh."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihzah awla na nunkhua a sau ding; Siatralnak tong loin na him ding ih na hna a ngam ding."},"24":{"text":"Mihrek cu an zaang a zel tukih, An kaa sungih rawl baar ding hman an zuam lo."},"25":{"text":"Mi puarthau hrem awla, ruahnak mal in fimnak a ngah ding; Mifim na si ahcun nunsimnak ihsin fim na zir ding."},"26":{"text":"A pa a thawi ih a nu kha inn ihsin a dawitu fapa cu, Ningzahnak le mualphonak a suah tertu a si."},"27":{"text":"Ka fapa, zirnak na bansan ahcun na theih ciami kha na hngilh sal ding."},"28":{"text":"Midang siatnak lawng a ruattu thutheihpitu hnenah cun dingnak a um lo; Mi ṭha lo pawl in sualnak tuah an duh."},"29":{"text":"Mi hngal pawl cu thawi an tong ding. Mi aa pawl cu vuak an hlawh ding a si."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zu in cu mi hmuhsuam tonnak a si; ṭongkam a tamter ih tawhawknak a suahter. Zurit cu aat a si."},"2":{"text":"A thin a hengmi siangpahrang cu a hruum durdomi kiosa na ṭih vekin ṭih aw; Amah a thin a hengtertu cu mah le mah that-aw bangtuk a si."},"3":{"text":"Zovek mi aa khal in tawhawknak cu a suahter thei; Tawhawknak hrial thei cu upat tlak a si."},"4":{"text":"Lo rih tikcu caan ih lothlawh a zuam lotu mi zaangzel cu, rawl lak tikcu ah rawl khawm ding a nei lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Minung in a thinlung sungih a neih mi ruahnak cu tikhur thuk sungih tidai bangtuk a si; Sikhalsehla mifim pa in a khaisuak thei ding."},"6":{"text":"Zokhal in mah ih felnak fingfing an sim cio; Sikhalsehla zoso mifel taktak a tong thei?"},"7":{"text":"Pa cu miding le miṭha a si ahcun, A faale pawl mi vanṭha an si."},"8":{"text":"Thuṭhennak tokham ih a tomi siangpahrang cun, Thil ṭha lo hmuahhmuah kha a mit in a thleidang thluh thei."},"9":{"text":"Zoso, “Ka thinlung ka thianter zo, Ka sualnak in ka thiang zo,” a ti thei?"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in cuai le tahnak dik lo pawl a hua."},"11":{"text":"Nauhak khal in a sinak a nuncan daan a thiang le thiang lo, A dik le dik lo kha a tuahnak in a langter ṭheu."},"12":{"text":"Hmuhnak mit le theihnak hna cu, Bawipa ih tuahmi an si."},"13":{"text":"Na tikcu caan ihnak in na cemter asile na farah ding; Hna ṭuan ringring awla rawl tampi na nei ding."},"14":{"text":"Thil leitu in, “A man a tamtuk!” tiah a phunzai ṭheu; Sikhalsehla a lei ih a feh hnuah cun, “Olte in ka lei,” tiah a porh aw ṭheu."},"15":{"text":"Sui tampi a um, lungvar khal tampi a um; Sikhalsehla fimnak ṭongkam cu a man a khung sawnmi a si."},"16":{"text":"Theih dah lomi pa hrangah aamahkhan saktu cu, A thilri aamahkhannak hrangah laksak a si ding."},"17":{"text":"Hrokhrawl in ngahmi rawl cu a thaw; Sikhalsehla rei lo ah a kaa sungah vunnel bangtuk a si ding."},"18":{"text":"Ruahnak ṭha a neimi thawn thu va ron aw; Na thiltuahmi ah na hlawhtling ding. Ṭhatein timtuahta loin ral do hlah."},"19":{"text":"A thupte in mi rel a hmangtu in thuthup kha a phuang ṭheu; Curuangah mi rel a hmangtu kha va kom hlah."},"20":{"text":"Na nu le na pa na camsiat asile, Khawthim lakih mei-inn mit bangin na nunnak a cem ding."},"21":{"text":"Olte ih na ngahmi sumsaw cu na hrangah ṭhathnemnak a mal ve ding."},"22":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak kha ṭhat lonak in lehrul hlah; Bawipa rinsan awla a lo run ding."},"23":{"text":"A dik lomi cuai le tahnak a hmangtu pawl cu Bawipa in a hua."},"24":{"text":"Kan lamzin ah kan ke kar in hruaitu cu Bawipa a si; Minung in ziangtinso an fehnak ding lamzin an theih thei ding?"},"25":{"text":"Pathian hnen thawhlawm pek ding thu na kam hlanah ṭhatein ruat hmaisata aw; Culole neh hnuah na siir aw pang ding."},"26":{"text":"A fimmi siangpahrang cun misual kha a hawl ih zaangfah loin a hrem ṭheu."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa in ruahnak le siaṭha thleidan theinak thinlung in pek; Kan thinlung hnen ihsin khuiah so kan relh thei ding?"},"28":{"text":"Siangpahrang in felnak le ṭhatnak le dingnak thawn, A ram a uk sung hmuah cu a uknak a hnget ding."},"29":{"text":"Mino pawl ih sunlawinak cu an thazaang a si; Putar pawl ih mawinak cu an sampar hi a si."},"30":{"text":"Thawinak hma kan ton ruangah kan ṭhat lonak a thiang; Vuaknak kan ton ruangah thinlung thianfainak kan ngah."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang ih thinlung cu Bawipa ih kut sungah a um; Tiva luannak a thleng awk bangin Amah ih duhnak poh ah a mer."},"2":{"text":"Zokhal in mah ih nundaan cio hi a dik in kan ruat; Sikhalsehla Bawipa cun kan thinlung a zoh."},"3":{"text":"Dingnak le a dikmi tuah cu raithawinak hnakin Bawipa in a duh sawn."},"4":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu porhawknak le puarthaunak in a uk; Himi cu sualnak a si."},"5":{"text":"Ṭhatein khuakhangta in na ṭuan asile na hlawh a tling ding; Sikhalsehla zamrang in na ṭuan asile khopkham in na nei thei dah lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Hrokhrawlnak in ngahmi sumsaw cu a zuangmi tikhu le thihnak thang an si."},"7":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu anmah ih tuahmi ṭhatlonak in a siatralter ding; Ziangahtile a dingmi thil tuah an duh lo."},"8":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih lamzin cu a kawi, Sikhalsehla mithiang mi in thil dik an tuah."},"9":{"text":"A phunzai ringringmi nupi thawn innpi sungih umtlang hnakin, inn luanglu kelkawmte ih mahte um a ṭha sawn."},"10":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl cu thil ṭha lo tuah an duh ringring; Zo ih par khalah zaangfahnak thinlung an nei lo."},"11":{"text":"Mi puarthau hrem a si tikah mi aa in fimnak a ngah; Sikhalsehla mifim cu an zirh tikah a fimnak a karh."},"12":{"text":"A dingmi Pathian cun mi ṭha lo pawl ih inn ah ziang a cang ti kha a thei ṭheh ih, Mi ṭha lo kha siatnak ah a thlenter ding."},"13":{"text":"Mifarah pawl ih aunak aw a ngai duh lotu cu, Amah ih au tikah zokhal in an theihpi ve lo ding."},"14":{"text":"A thupte ih pekmi laksawng in thinhengnak a daihter; Puan thuaiih pekmi nawhthuh in thinlingnak a nemter."},"15":{"text":"Thu pakhatkhat dingtein rel a si tikah miding pawl hrangah lungawinak a si; Sikhalsehla mi ṭha lo pawl hrang ahcun riahsiatnak a si."},"16":{"text":"Fimnak lamzin ihsin a pialmi pawl cu thihnak in a bawh."},"17":{"text":"Nomnak a duhtu cu a farah ding; Zu le sa a duhtu cu a lian dah lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl in mi ṭha pawl par ih an tlunter tummi harnak cu, Anmah ih par lala ah a tlung ṭheu."},"19":{"text":"A phunzaimi le mi tawh a hmangmi nunau thawn umtlang hnak cun, Nelrawn ih va um ziar khi a ṭha sawn."},"20":{"text":"Mifim umnak ah lennak le nomnak a um; Asinain mi aa cun paisa an ngah vete in an ei-ek ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Dingnak le zaangfahnak nei awla na nun a sau ding; Midang khal in an lo upat ding ih ṭhatein an lo tuamhlawm ding."},"22":{"text":"A fimmi ralbawi cun micak pawl ih kilmi khawpi a la thei ih, an rinsanmi hauhruang khal a siat thei."},"23":{"text":"A lei le a kaa a kil theitu cu harnak in a luat ding."},"24":{"text":"Mi puarthau, mi porh-aw le hngal zetih a nungmi pa cu, A hmin ah, “Mi hmuhsuamtu,” an ti."},"25":{"text":"Hnaṭuan zianghman a zuam lomi mi zaangzel cu, Amah le amah a that aw rero a si."},"26":{"text":"Sunvu a ruahmi cu ziang ka ngah pei ti lawng a si. Asinain miding pawl cun ui loin siangzet in an pek."},"27":{"text":"Mi ṭha loih raithawinak cu Bawipa in a fih; Thinlungput ṭha lo thawn a tuahmi cu a fih sinsin."},"28":{"text":"Thuphanper a dik lomi theihpitu cu a siatral ding; Sikhalsehla thudik a simtu ih thu cu cohlan a si ding."},"29":{"text":"Miding cu amah le amah a rinsan aw ṭheu; Sikhalsehla mi ṭha lo cun a titer aw ṭheu."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa na dodal a si ahcun milai ih fimnak, thiamnak le theihfiangnak pawl in a lo bawm thei lo ding."},"31":{"text":"Raldonak ni hrangah rang tla cu timtuahcia an si; Sikhalsehla nehnak cu Bawipa hnenin a rami a si."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lennak hnakin hminṭhatnak hril ding a si sawn; Zaangfahnak cu sui le ngun hnakin a ṭha sawn."},"2":{"text":"Mifarah le milian an bangawknak zawnte a um; Cumi cu Bawipa ih sersiammi veve an sinak hi a si."},"3":{"text":"Mifim cu harnak a rat kha a hmuh tikah a hrial; Sikhalsehla mi aa cun a pahcih hluahhlo ih neh hnuah a sir aw."},"4":{"text":"Tangdor in Bawipa ṭihzah awla, Lennak, upatnak le nunsaunak na ngah ding."},"5":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih lamzin cu hling le thang in a khat; Mah ih nunnak a duhtu cun hlatpi in a hrial ding."},"6":{"text":"Nauhak kha nundaan dik zirh aw, A tar tiangin cuih lamzin ihsin a pial lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Mifarah cu milian ih sal a si, Cawitu cu coihtu ih sal a si."},"8":{"text":"Dinglonak thlaici na tuh asile harsatnak na at ding; Midang pawl na hrem theinak khal a reh ding."},"9":{"text":"Tirhsiang awla na rawl kha farah pawl hlawm aw; Thlawsuah na ngah ding."},"10":{"text":"Mi puarthau dawihlo uhla buainak a reh ding; Tawhawknak le nautatawknak khal a hlo ding."},"11":{"text":"Thinlung thiang a keng ih awkaa thlum a nei mi cun, Siangpahrang a rualpi ah a tuah thei ding."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in thuphan a simtu pawl a dawihlo ih, Thudik a simtu pawl kha himte in a kilveng."},"13":{"text":"Mi zaangzel cu inn ah a um men, Innleng ka suak asile kiosa in i keuthat ding, a ti."},"14":{"text":"Hlawhhlangnu ih hmurka cu a thukmi khur a si; Bawipa ih thinhengnak a tuahtu pawl cu cuih khur sungah an tla ding."},"15":{"text":"Nauhak thinlung sungah huatsuahnak a um ringring; Nunsimnak fung cun ṭha deuh in a zirh thei ding."},"16":{"text":"Mah ih lennak duh ruangih mi farah a hremtu le, Milian a tlontu cu a farah ding."},"17":{"text":"Na hna i tun aw, mifim pawl ih thusimmi ka lo zirh ding; Cun ka fimthiamnak na thinlung sungah ciing aw.","title":"Mifim Pawlih Thufim Sawmthum"},"18":{"text":"Na thinlung sungah na ret asile na lung a awi ding; Na hmurka ah ralring cia in an um ding."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa kha rinsan aw, tiah ka lo duhsak; Curuangah himi thu pawl tuih ni ah ka lo zirhnak cu a si."},"20":{"text":"Nangmah ih hrangah thufim sawmthum ka lo ngansak; Hi thufim pawl cu fimnak le ruahnak ṭha thawn a khatmi an si."},"21":{"text":"Cule hi thufim pawl in thudik a lo theihter ding ih, Nangmah tirh a lo fialtu kha diktein thu na sim thei ding."},"22":{"text":"Mifarah kha a farah ruangah a thil va long hlah, Thuṭhennak zung sung khal ah va hrem hlah."},"23":{"text":"Ziangahtile Bawipa in an thu a ṭanpi ding ih, Anmah a siatsuahtu pawl ih nunnak kha a siatter ding."},"24":{"text":"Thinheng a hmangmi le thintawimi va kom hlah,"},"25":{"text":"Ziangruangah tile, an nundaan na cawng ngah pang asile, na ṭhin thei nawn lo ding."},"26":{"text":"Midang leiba hrangah ṭuanvo laak in thu va kam hlah."},"27":{"text":"Na sam thei lo asile na ihkhun hman an lo laksak ding."},"28":{"text":"Nan pupa pawl ih an rak tuahcia mi ramri kha ṭhawn hlah."},"29":{"text":"A hnaṭuannak ih a thiamzetmi na hmu maw? Amah cu mizaraan hnenah si loin siangpahrang hnenah a ṭuan ding."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uktu bawi thawn rawl na ei tikah, Na hmaiah zoso a um ti kha ṭhatein zoh aw."},"2":{"text":"Rawlphammi na si ahcun sup aw deuh aw."},"3":{"text":"A lo pekmi rawl thawthaw kha hahio hlah; Ziangahtile an lo bumnak rawl a si thei."},"4":{"text":"Na nunnak siatsuah aw tiangtiang in lennak va hawl hlah; A colh hna thiam in fim aw."},"5":{"text":"Ziangruangah tile na paisa cu mit ṭhep karah a hlo theimi a si; Thla bun hruak in mupi bangin a zuanghlo ding."},"6":{"text":"Tirhfaakmi ih rawl va ei hlah, Rawl thaw a lo domi khal va hahio hlah."},"7":{"text":"Ziangruangah tile a thinlung put bangtuk in a nunzia cu a si: “In aw, ei aw,” a lo ti ding; Sikhalsehla cumi cu a thinlungtak in a lo timi a si lo."},"8":{"text":"Na eimi hmuahhmuah kha na luak sal ṭheh ding ih, Na faknak awkam hmuahhmuah khal thulolak a si ṭheh ding."},"9":{"text":"Mi aa theih ah thu sim hlah, Ziangahtile fimnak thu na relmi kha a nautat ding."},"10":{"text":"Hlanlai ih tuahciami ramri kha ṭhawn hlah; Nu le pa nei lo pawl ih lo khal va long hlah."},"11":{"text":"Ziangahtile Bawipa cu a cakmi anmah ṭantu a si ih, Thukhingkhainak hmunah an lamah a ṭang ding ih an thu a simsak ding."},"12":{"text":"A lo zirhtu pawl thu kha ṭhatein ngai awla, Fimnak kha na zir thei zat in zir aw."},"13":{"text":"Nauhak nunsim loin um hlah, Fung in na thawi ruangah a thi lo ding."},"14":{"text":"A nunnak kha thihnak ihsin na run ngah sawn ding."},"15":{"text":"Ka fapa, na fim asile ka lung a awizet ding."},"16":{"text":"Fimnak thu na sim ka theih tikah ka lung a nuam ngaingai ding."},"17":{"text":"Misual pawl kha va daw hlah, Na nun sung Bawipa ṭihzah in um sawn aw."},"18":{"text":"Cutin na um asile na hmailam a tleu ding ih, na ruahsannak a hlo lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Ka fapa, ngai aw, fim awla, Lamzin dik kha thlun ringring aw."},"20":{"text":"Zu le sa a phaam mi pawl va kom hlah."},"21":{"text":"Ziangahtile zu phaam le sa phaam pawl cu an farah ding; Na tikcu le caan kha ei le ih lawngin na cemter a si ahcun, A rei hlanah puansia na sin ding."},"22":{"text":"A lo hringtu na pa ih thu ngai aw; Amah um hlah sehla na seem lo ding. Na nu kha a tar tikah nautat hlah."},"23":{"text":"Thutak kha lei awla zuar nawn hlah; Fimnak, thuzirhnak le theihnak tla kha lei awla zuar nawn hlah."},"24":{"text":"Miding mi ih pa cu a lung a awi nasa ding; Fapa fim hringtu cu a fapa parah a lung a awi ding."},"25":{"text":"Na nu le na pa lungawiter aw, Nangmah a lo hringtu na nu cu lungawi in um seh."},"26":{"text":"Ka fapa, na thinlung taktein i ngai aw; Ka nundaan hi zohṭhim aw."},"27":{"text":"Hlawhhlangnu cu khur thukpi a si; Nunau uire cu thihnak thang a si."},"28":{"text":"Fifir bangin mi an bawh ih, Mi tampi an siatsuah ih mi zuangzam ah an canter."},"29":{"text":"Zoso thinpit le vansaang in a um ṭheu? Zoso a riah a sia ṭheu? Zoso mi thawn a to aw ṭheu? Zoso a phunzai ṭheu? Zoso a thu um loin hma a tuar ṭheu? Zoso mit sen remrem in a um ṭheu?"},"30":{"text":"Zu a in ringringmi pawl an si."},"31":{"text":"Khuathai sungah senzet le tleuzet in a um ih, In tikah dang sungah naalzet in a lut ding a bangmi zu kha zoh hlah."},"32":{"text":"A netnak ahcun rul bangin mi a cuk ih, Tursia nei rulha bangin mi a cuk ṭheu."},"33":{"text":"Na mit in thil phundang na hmu ding ih, ṭhatein khua na ruat thei lo ding ih fiangtein na ṭong thei lo ding."},"34":{"text":"Cutik ahcun tipithuanthum laifang ih a itmi pa bangtuk le, Lawng puanzarnak ṭhuam zim ih a itmi pa bangtuk na si ding."},"35":{"text":"In thawi naón a na lo, In vua naón ka thei lo, Ziangtikah ka tho ding ih, A dang in ding ka hawl hrih ding, tiah na ti ding."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl kha va daw hlah; Anmah thawn pawl aw hlah uh."},"2":{"text":"Annih pawl cu mi siatsuahnak ding thu lawnglawng an ruat ih, Mi siatsuahnak ding thu lawnglawng an sim."},"3":{"text":"Inn cu fimnak in sak a si ih, Theihnak in hngehter a si."},"4":{"text":"Theihnak in inn khaan hmuahhmuah cu, a sunglawimi le a mawimi thilri in a thuam."},"5":{"text":"Cah hnakin fim a ṭha sawn, Cah hnakin theihnak a thupi sawn."},"6":{"text":"Ral na do hlanah ralring zetin timtuahnak nei aw; Ruahnak ṭha petu tam na neih tik poh ah ral na nehnak ding a tam a si."},"7":{"text":"Fimnak cu mi aa hrang ahcun a saang tukih a thei thei lo; Thil thupi rel tikah zianghman sim ding a thei lo."},"8":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo tuah ding lawnglawng khua a khangtu cu, A hmin ah “Harnak Tuahtu,” an ti."},"9":{"text":"Mi aa ih tumtahmi pohpoh cu sualnak a si; Mi hmuhsuam a hmangtu cu zokhal in an hua."},"10":{"text":"Harnak caan ah na bei a dongmai a si ahcun, Misantlai lo taktak na si."},"11":{"text":"Thah dingih an hruaimi na hmuh ahcun zamrang in va run aw."},"12":{"text":"Himi cu ka hnaṭuan a si lo tiin um men hlah; Ziangahtile Pathian in a thu cu a thei ih na thinlung a zoh a si. A lo thlingthla ringring ih, na tuahmi vekin a lo sam leh ding."},"13":{"text":"Ka fapa, khuaitizu kha ei aw, a thaw a si; A thlar sungin a tlami khuaitizu cu a thlum bangin,"},"14":{"text":"Fimnak cu na nunnak hrangah a ṭhami a si; Fimnak na neih asile na hmailam a tleu ding ih, na ruahsannak a hlo lo ding."},"15":{"text":"Mi ṭha pa a bawh ih a inn siatbal ding a tumtu, Mi helhhlong pa vekin va nung hlah."},"16":{"text":"Ziangruangah tile miding cu voi sarih tiang tlu hmansehla, a tho sal ding; Sikhalsehla mi ṭha lo cu vansiatnak in a siatsuah ding."},"17":{"text":"Na ral kha vansiatnak a ton tikah na lung awi hlah; A rilhbah tikah na di riam hlah."},"18":{"text":"Na lung a awi asile Bawipa in a lo hmu ding ih a lung a awi lo ding; Cutikah hrem loin a thlah sal pang ding."},"19":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ruangah thin nuam loin um hlah; Mi ṭha lo pawl cu va daw hlah."},"20":{"text":"Ziangahtile mi ṭha lo in ruahsan ding a nei lo; Mi ṭha lo ih mei-inn cu a mit ding."},"21":{"text":"Ka fapa, Bawipa le siangpahrang kha upat in ṭihzah aw; Anmah a dodaltu pawl va kom hlah."},"22":{"text":"Ziangahtile an hnenah harsatnak hmakhatte ah a ra thleng thei; Bawipa le siangpahrang hnen in ziangvek siatsuahnak a ra ding ti zo in a thei?","title":"A Dang Thufim Pawl"},"23":{"text":"Himi pawl khal hi mifim pawl ih simmi thu an si: Thuṭhen tikih mi ṭanbul neih cu a ṭha lo."},"24":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo kha miding a si, a titu thuṭhentu bawi cu, mi in an camsiat ding ih miphun tinkim in an hua ding."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla misual a hremtu cu a ṭhangso ding ih, mi upatnak a co ding."},"26":{"text":"Felte ih thuleh cu rualpi taktak sinak langtertu a si."},"27":{"text":"Lo le ram ṭhatein na neih hnuah le, Pumcawmnak ding na hram a hnget hnu lawngah inn sak aw."},"28":{"text":"Thuhla fiangtein thei loin mi sual va puh hlah; Midang in an ruahsualnak ding thu tla va sim hlah."},"29":{"text":"Ka parih a tuah vekin a parah ka tuah ve ding; A tuahmi vekin ka lehrul ding, tiah ti hlah."},"30":{"text":"Mi aa zaangzel pa ih lo le sabit hmuan sungin ka feh."},"31":{"text":"Zohhnik, hlingbur in a khat ih leilung cu hrampi in a khuh ṭheh; Cun a kulhnak lungto phardawl khal a cim ṭheh."},"32":{"text":"Ṭhatein ka zoh ih khua ka ruah tikah, hiti in fimzirhnak ka ngah:"},"33":{"text":"Malte in ka zauta hrih pei, Malte in ka it ta hrih pei, Malte in ka cawlta hrih pei, na ti sung ah,"},"34":{"text":"Farahnak cu rukru bangtuk in le, tlaksamnak cu hriamnam thawn mi a siimtu rukru bangin a ra thleng ding."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tanglamih thu pawl khal hi Solomon ih thufim an si ih, Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah ih milai pawl in an ngan sinmi a si.","title":"Solomon Ih Thufim Dang Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ih sunlawinak cu thil a thuh hi a si; Sikhalsehla siangpahrang pawl ih sunlawinak cu thil an phuan hi a si."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang in ziang a ruat ti cu kan thei thei lo; A saangzetmi van le a thukzetmi tipithuanthum bangtuk in, kan theih ban lomi a si."},"4":{"text":"Ngun khi a eek thianter awla, sosu thiam in thil mawizetah a ser ding."},"5":{"text":"Siangpahrang hnenih ruahnak ṭha lo a petu kha dawi hlo uhla, A uknak cu dingthluk lairelnak thawn a hnget ding."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang hmaiah upat va cuh hlah, Mi upa pawl ih umnak hmun khal ah va ding hlah."},"7":{"text":"Ziangahtile hitawk ah hung to aw ti cu, Nangmah hnakin a upa sawnmi tonak kian aw ti hnakin a ṭha sawn."},"8":{"text":"Thil na hmuh mi kha zamrang tukin thuṭhennak zungah va sim hlah; Ziangahtile tetti dangin na palhnak a langter sal asile ziangso na tuah ding?"},"9":{"text":"Na innhnen thawn nan ruahnak a bang aw thei lo asile nanmahte in remnak tuah uh; Cule nan thuthup kha va phuang hlah."},"10":{"text":"Na phuang pang asile mi in thu na thuh thei lo kha an thei dingih, na ningzahnak a cem dah nawn lo ding."},"11":{"text":"A caan a si laite ih ṭongmi ṭongkam cu, Ngun kheng sungih sui thingrah bangtuk a si."},"12":{"text":"Mifimzet nunsimtu ih simmi thu cu a ngai duhtu hrangah, Sui zunghruk le sui hlawnthil bangtuk a si."},"13":{"text":"Palai fel cu a thlahtu hrangah thinlung daitertu a si; Rawl lak caan ni ling laifangih rialti bangtuk a si."},"14":{"text":"Thil ka lo pe ding tiah thu mi a kam ih a pe dah lotu cu, Ruah tel lo khawdur le tidai keng lo thli bangtuk a si."},"15":{"text":"Thinsaunak thawn uktu bawi hman kha lem a theih; Awkaa nem in thinlung hak hman a nemter thei."},"16":{"text":"Na ṭulzat hnak in tam deuh khuaitizu ei hlah; Tamtuk na ei asile na luak ding."},"17":{"text":"Na innhnen kha leng tamtuk hlah, Na len tamtuk asile a lo ning ding ih a lo hua ding."},"18":{"text":"A dik lo in mi sualpuhnak cu, Mi a that theimi talhtum, ralnam le conkiang vek a si."},"19":{"text":"Harnak caan ah rinsan tlak lomi rinsan cu, Ha hnin thawn rawl khai le ke-awl thawn feh bangtuk a si."},"20":{"text":"Riahsia thinhar mi hnenih hla va sak cu, Khawsik ni ih puanhlum phoih le, Hma parih cite phulh bangtuk a si."},"21":{"text":"Na ral a ril a rawng asile ei ding rawl pe aw; A ti a haal asile in ding tidai pe aw."},"22":{"text":"Cutiih na tuah asile a luthlung ah meiling na ret a si ding. Bawipa in ṭhatman a lo pe ding."},"23":{"text":"Saklam thli in ruah a ratpi bangtuk in, Mi relsiatnak in thinhennak a suahpi."},"24":{"text":"A phunzai ringring mi nupi thawn innpi sungih umtlang hnakin, Inn luanglu kelkawmte ih um a ṭha sawn."},"25":{"text":"Ram hlatpi ihsin thuthang ṭha theih cu, Dangcaar tihal laifangih tidai daite in bangtuk a si."},"26":{"text":"Miding in mi ṭha lo pa nehnak a coter a si ahcun, Thihsii rawi mi tikhur, a si lole cerhti baal vek a si."},"27":{"text":"Khuaitizu tamtuk ei cu a ṭha lo; Cuvekin mi hnen ihsin thangṭhatnak tamtuk ngah tum cu a ṭha lo."},"28":{"text":"Mah ih thinhengnak a sup thei lotu cu, Khawkulhnak hauhruang a cim ih a siatmi khua bangtuk a si. Olte in ral an lut ding."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thangṭhat upatnak cu mi aa hrang ah a kaih lo; Khawṭhal caanih vur tla bangtuk le rawl lak caanih ruah sur bangtuk a si."},"2":{"text":"Tican nei lomi camsiatnak cu, Sunṭam le vanva zuang bangin umhmun an nei lo."},"3":{"text":"Funghreu cu rang vuaknak ah, Rang kakharh cu laak kakharhnak ah, Fungfek cu mi aa vuaknak ah a si."},"4":{"text":"Mi aa kha mi aa biak in bia hlah, A lo biak daan vekin na biak ve asile amah thawn nan bang aw ding."},"5":{"text":"Mi aa kha amah thawn kaih aw in bia aw; Cutiin na ti lo asile ka fim tiah a ruat sual aw pang ding."},"6":{"text":"Mi aa kha palai ih a thlahtu cu, Amah le amah ke tan aw vek a si; harnak a tong ding."},"7":{"text":"Thufim cu mi aa pawl ih kaa ahcun, A thlai-aw menmen mi ke-awl pa ih ke bangtuk a si; Zianghman ṭhathnemnak a nei lo."},"8":{"text":"Mi aa upatnak pek cu saili ah saihlum ṭawn cih bangtuk a si. ṭhathnemnak a nei lo."},"9":{"text":"Mi aa ih thufim ṭongṭhimnak hman cu, Zuri pa in a kut a suntu hling a coih tum vek a si."},"10":{"text":"Hnaṭuan petu bawi in a tawivak mi zuri le mi aa a tonmi poh hnaṭuan a pek ahcun, Li le thal thawn mi a tuahmawh rero mi a bang."},"11":{"text":"A aatnak langter sal rerotu mi aa cu, Mah ih luak ei saaltu uico bangtuk a si."},"12":{"text":"Mah le mah ka fim tiih a ruat awtu hnakin, Mi aa bik hrangah ruahsannak a um sawn."},"13":{"text":"Mi zaangzel ziangah inn lengah a suak duh lo? Ziang so a ṭih? Kiosa maw a ṭih?"},"14":{"text":"Mi zaangzel cu sangka khar a kopza ih a mer awk rero bangin, A ihkhun parah a let aw rero men."},"15":{"text":"Mihrek khat cu an zaangzel tuk ih, An kaa sungih rawl san hman an zuam lo."},"16":{"text":"Mi zaangzel cu fimkhur zet in thu a let theimi mifim pasarih hnakin, amah ih ruahnak ahcun a fim sawn."},"17":{"text":"Mah thawn a pehpar aw lomi tawhawknak ih a teltu cu, Amahte a fehtu uico ih hnakawr kaitu bangtuk a si."},"18":{"text":"Mi a bum ih, “Ka lo capoh men,” a titu cu, Mei-alh tom le conkiang hriamnam thawn mi a tuahmawhtu mi molh bangtuk a si.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Zanthing a um lo a si le meisa a mit; A thupte in mi relsiat hmangtu a um lo le tawhawknak a dai."},"21":{"text":"Meihol in meiling a vaamter ih Thing in meisa a alhter bangtuk in, Mi tawh a hmangtu pawl in tawhawknak an suahpi ṭheu."},"22":{"text":"Mi a relsiatu ih ṭongkam cu rawlthaw bangtuk a si; Pum sung tiangin a lut vivo."},"23":{"text":"Awkaa thlum a nei naón thinlung ṭha lomi cu, Mawizet ih hnihmi leibeel bangtuk a si."},"24":{"text":"Mi huatnak a neitu cun awkaa ṭha in mi a bia ṭheu; Sikhalsehla a thinlung cu mi bumnak in a khat."},"25":{"text":"Mi zaangfah zet bangin a ṭongtu khi va zum hlah; Ziangruangah tile a thinlung cu fihnungza thil in a khat."},"26":{"text":"A thinlung sungih a ummi huatnak cu bumnak in a khuh khalle, A ṭhat lonak cu mizapi in an hmu thotho ding."},"27":{"text":"Midang tlaknak dingah khur a laitu cu cuih khurah amah a tla ding; Midang nennak dingah lung a hriltu cu cuih lungin amah a nen ding."},"28":{"text":"Thuphan sim a hmangmi lei in bumnak a tuartu kha a hua; A hrokhrawl mi kaa in siatsuahnak lawng a suahpi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thaizing thu-ah tluang khawng hlah, Cuih ni in ziang a suahpi ding ti na thei lo."},"2":{"text":"Ziangtik khalah nangmah le nangmah lawm aw hlah; Midang a si lole mikhual in lo lawm sawn hai seh."},"3":{"text":"Lungto le vunnel ih khingrih daan hi, Aat ruangih tonmi harsatnak thawn ṭhim ahcun, Zianghman ti tham a si lo."},"4":{"text":"Thinheng cu a siakha zet ih mi a siatsuah thei; Asinain iksiiknak thawn ṭhim ahcun, zianghman ti tham a si lo."},"5":{"text":"Ziangah i poisa lo tiih a lo ruah ding hnak cun, Mi pakhat hmaiton ih a sualmawh- nak va remsak khi a ṭha sawn."},"6":{"text":"Rualpi ṭha cu na thin a lo natter hmanah duhsaknak ṭha a nei; Sikhalsehla na ral in na liangih a lo kuah asile ralring aw."},"7":{"text":"Na pum a puar tik ahcun khuaitizu hman na duh lo ding naón, Na rilrawn laifang ahcun a khazetmi rawl hman khi thlum na ti ding."},"8":{"text":"Mah ih innsang ihsin vakvaitu cu, Bu a hluum lomi vate bangtuk a si."},"9":{"text":"Rimhmui le sathau rimthaw cun na thin a lo nuamter naón, Thinharnak cun na hnangamnak a balsiat thluh ṭheu."},"10":{"text":"Na rualpi ṭha siseh, na nu le na pa ih rualpi ṭha siseh, va hngilh hlah; Harsatnak na ton tikah na unau va sim hlah; Khawhlatpi ih a um na unau hnakin na kiang naite ih a ummi, Na innhnen in a lo bawm thei sawn a si."},"11":{"text":"Ka fapa, fimvar tein um awla ka lung a awi ding; I soiseltu pawl kha ṭongkam ka let thei hai ding."},"12":{"text":"Mi fimvar cun harsatnak a rami an hmu ih an kian thei; Ziang a ruat cuca lo pawl cun harsatnak an pan ih neh hnuah an siir aw sal ṭheu."},"13":{"text":"Theih dah lomi pa ih leiba hrangah aamahkhan tuah ngamtu cu, A neihmi thil kha aamahkhannak ah lak sak thluh ding a si."},"14":{"text":"Zingpit ah a it laimi na rualpi ṭha ring zetih na biak ahcun, Na camriam thawn a bangrep a si."},"15":{"text":"Cat loin a phunzai mi nupi cu, Nikhawceen ih ruahti for rero thawn an bang aw."},"16":{"text":"Cu nu cu ziangtinso daitein na umter thei ding? Thlihrang teh na kham thei dah maw? Culole na kutzaphak in siti teh na huum thei dah maw?"},"17":{"text":"Thir le thir an tat-awk bangin, Milai khal pakhat le pakhat hnen in fimnak an zir a si."},"18":{"text":"Theikung khi ṭhatein na tuamhlawm ahcun theirah ei ding na nei ding; Mah ih bawipa a zohṭhatu hnen-um cu upat an co ding."},"19":{"text":"Tidai sungih na hmel na hmuh bangin, Na sinak khal na thinlung sungah na hmu ve."},"20":{"text":"Milai ih duhhiarnak hi mithi khua vek a si; A khat zo ti a um dah lo."},"21":{"text":"Sui le ngun khi meisa in an hniksak thei; Milai ih ziaza khal porhnak in hniksak a theih ve."},"22":{"text":"Mi aa pa khi thizikte in thawi khal awla, A aatnak cu na thawi tlan thei cuang lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Na tuuruun kha ṭhatein tuamhlawm awla, Na cawrual pawl kha ralring theitawp in zoh aw."},"24":{"text":"Ziangahtile lennak hi kumkhua in a hmun lo; Siangpahrang lukhuh hman kumkhua an hmun ve lo."},"25":{"text":"Tlanghrap ah rawlko na lak thluh ih, Hrampi na thlawh lai ah rawlko neta pawl an kho lai rero."},"26":{"text":"Na tuu pawl ih hmul in hnipuan na tak thei ih, Na me hrekkhat na zuar man in loram na lei thei."},"27":{"text":"A taanglai mi na me pawl in na innsang le, Na hnen-um nunau pawl ih in dingah mehnawi an lo pe ding."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo cu zohman ih dawi loin anmahte an tlan; Sikhalsehla midingfel cu kiosa vekin an ral a ṭha."},"2":{"text":"Ram pakhat a sual tikah uktu pakhat hnu pakhat an thleng aw vivo; Sikhalsehla ram pakhatkhat in mifim le thuruatthiam hruaitu a neih ahcun cuih ram cu a cak ih reipi a hmun."},"3":{"text":"Mi farah pawl a hrem ih harsatnak a petu ram uktu cu, Lo rawl a siatsuahtu ruah takzet thawn an bang aw."},"4":{"text":"Daan ziangsiar loih na um ahcun mi ṭha lo lam ṭang na si; Asinain daan na thlun ahcun mi ṭha lo pawl dodaltu na si."},"5":{"text":"Mi sualral pawl cun thudik hi ziangvek a si ti an thei lo; Asinain Bawipa a biatu pawl cun fiangtein an thei."},"6":{"text":"Thinlung tluangtlam loih milian si hnakin, Tluangtlam zetih mifarah si a ṭha sawn."},"7":{"text":"Daan a thlunmi tlangvalpa cu mi fimvar a si; Mi-hrong a va komtu cu a pa ih mithmai baaltertu a si."},"8":{"text":"Midang hnen ihsin tangka ṭhang le a miat in milian na si ahcun, Na lennak cu mifarah pawl a zaang- fahtu hnen a thleng leh ding."},"9":{"text":"Daan na thlun lo asile na thlacamnak cu Pathian thinhengtertu sawn a si."},"10":{"text":"Mi tluangtlam pakhat khi nungsual dingih na bum a si ahcun, Nangmah le nangmah cuih sualnak ah cun na awk aw ding. Zianghman sualnak a nei lomi cu laksawng ṭha an co ding."},"11":{"text":"Milian pawl in anmah le anmah khi mifimzet ah an ruat aw ṭheu; Asinain mi ih thinlung a theitu mifarah pakhat khi a fim sawn."},"12":{"text":"Mi ṭha pakhat uktu bawi a hung si tikah mi tampi an lung a awi; Asinain mi ṭha lo uktu ih an can tikah misenpi cu an relh thluh."},"13":{"text":"Na sualnak thuh na tum ahcun na hlawhtling dah lo ding; Na sualnak cu phuang in hlonhlo aw, Pathian in a lo zaangfah ding."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa cu kumkhua in ṭihzah awla na thin a nuam ding; Na lung a ruh ahcun na nunnak a siatral ding."},"15":{"text":"Mi uk ṭha lo pawl ih hnuai ah farah pawl cu ṭantu an nei lo; Cuih mi uktu cu kiosa huuk rero le vom heer vak rero vekin ṭih a nung."},"16":{"text":"Thinlung ruahnak nei cuca lomi uktu cu uktu ṭha lozet a si; Ding lonak a huatu cun caan reipi ram a uk ding."},"17":{"text":"Laithattu cu amah ih thlankhur zamrang zetih a lai rerotu a si. Kham ding a si lo."},"18":{"text":"Tlaitluang awla na him ding, Na lungput a tluan lo ahcun rinlopi ah khur sungah na tla ding."},"19":{"text":"Lothlo milaw zet cun ei ding tampi a nei; Tikcu caan a lak ih a cemraltertu cu kumkhua in a farah ding."},"20":{"text":"Rintlak mifel cun a nuam le a famkim mi nunnak a nei; Asinain zamrangih len a duh ahcun hremnak a tuar ding."},"21":{"text":"Mi thleidan neih cu a ṭha lo; Sikhalsehla thuṭhentu hrekkhat cun nawhthuh fate meen duh ah thu an rel sual ṭheu."},"22":{"text":"Mi duhham pawl in zamrangih len an duh tuk ruangah, Farahnak an hnenah a thleng zik ti khi an thei nawn lo."},"23":{"text":"Mi pakhat ih mawhnak va rem sak awla, Neh hnuah cun na porh rero hnakin a lung a awi sawn ding."},"24":{"text":"A nu le pa ih thilri ruk in ‘Sual a si lo’ tiih a ruattu cu rukru thawn an dang aw lo."},"25":{"text":"Duhhamnak cun harsatnak a suahter; Bawipa rinsan awla na hlawk sawn ding."},"26":{"text":"Mah ruahnak lawngih ṭan cu aat-hna a si; Na hnakih a fimdeuhmi pawl ih zirhnak khi thlun awla na him ding."},"27":{"text":"Mi farah pawl khi thil va ṭhen awla na hlawhsam dah lo ding; Mi farah pawl na dungtun ahcun mitampi in an lo cam ding."},"28":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl bawi an can tikah mipi cu an relh thluh; Sikhalsehla mi ṭha lo pawl an nau tik ahcun miding pawl in ram an uk sal ding."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na nuncan an lo remtinte na lung a hak asile, Ni khatkhat ah thosal thei nawn loin na siatralta ding."},"2":{"text":"Uktu mi ṭha an si ahcun ram sung mi an nun a nuam; Asinain uktu mi ṭha lo an si ahcun an ram mi pawl an zonzai."},"3":{"text":"Fimnak duhtu fapa cun a pa ih lung a awiter. Hlawhhlangnu hnenih paisa hmang raltu cu mi aa a si."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang in dingnak thawn ram a uk asile an ram a hngetkhoh; Asinain sumsaw lawng a ruat asile a ukmi ram a siatral ding."},"5":{"text":"Na innhnen pawl a hleifuan ih na porh asile, Na hrangah thang na kam thawn a bang."},"6":{"text":"Midik mitluangtlam pawl an lungawi thawsuak ih an um laiah, Mi ṭha lo pawl cu an sualnak thang ah an awk aw."},"7":{"text":"Mi ṭha in mi farah pawl ih sinak an theih sak; Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cun cuvek an theih sak thei lo."},"8":{"text":"Midang zawn a ruat lotu cun khawpi buainak an thlenter; Mifim pawl cun thubuai an daiter."},"9":{"text":"Mifim in mi-aa taza a cuai tikah, Mi-aa pa cun a hnihsan ih napi in a camriam."},"10":{"text":"Mi thisen suah a poisa lo mi cun, Miding mi ṭha pohpoh khi a hua; Asinain mi tluangtlam cun miding ih nunnak a hum sak."},"11":{"text":"Mi-aa pawl cun an thinhennak khi hmakhatte-ah an langter; Asinain ruahnak a neimi pawl cu an thin a sau ih an sup aw."},"12":{"text":"Ram uktu in a dik lomi thuthang a zum asile, A hnaṭuan upa pawl hmuahhmuah cu thuphanper an si ding."},"13":{"text":"Mi farah siseh, mi farah hremtu siseh, Thil bangrep ih an neihmi a um; Bawipa in khawhmuhnak mit a pek veve."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa in mi farah pawl ih covo a hum sak ahcun, Reipi ram sungmi a uk ding."},"15":{"text":"Nauhak hrangah cun nuncan rem le daan ṭha thlunter hi thil ṭha a si; Nauhak pakhat amah ih thuthu ih a nun ahcun a nu ningzaktertu a si ding."},"16":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl an lal tikah sualnak a karh zai; Asinain miding pawl in cuih mi ṭha lo pawl an nau vivo kha an hmu ding."},"17":{"text":"Na fapa kha daan ṭha thlunnak ah nunsim awla, Amah ih ruangah na hmai a hngal ringring ding; Anih cun ziangtik khalah na ningzahnak a suahter lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Pathian ih hmuhsaknak a um lo ahcun, Mipi cu an vaivuan ṭheh. Pathian ih daan a thluntu cu mi lungawi an si."},"19":{"text":"Hnen-um pakhatkhat, hmurka ih va biak men cun a nuncan na rem thei lo ding; Na sim duhmi cu a thei ding naón na thu cu zianghman a siar lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Ruat hmaisa loih a ṭongtu hnakin, Ruat ciamciamih a ṭongtu mi-aa hrangah ruahsannak a tam sawn."},"21":{"text":"Na hnen-um ih duhmi hmuahhmuah khi a seenlai ihsin na rak pek ringring a si ahcun, Nikhat khat na neihmi hmuahhmuah a lo lak sak thluh leh ding."},"22":{"text":"Thinbahlak pawl cun tawhawknak le buainak tampi an suahter."},"23":{"text":"Puarthau hngalhngawnnak hin siatralnak ah a lo thlenter ding; Asinain tangdorte ih na um ahcun mi ih upat na co ding."},"24":{"text":"Fifir ih rualpi cu a hrangah ral ṭihnung bik a si; Thuṭhennak zungah thudik a sim asile hremnak a tuar ding; Thudik a sim lo asile Pathian in a camsiat ding."},"25":{"text":"Midang ih an lo ruahdan poisa tukih um khi ṭihnungza a si; Asinain Bawipa na rinsan ahcun phan ding a um lo."},"26":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in anmah uktu bawi ih mithmai ṭha co cu an duh thluh; Asinain Bawipa ih hnen lawnglawng in a dingmi thuṭhennak cu na co ding."},"27":{"text":"Mi ṭha in mi ṭha lo an hua; Mi ṭha lo in mi ṭha an hua ve."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi pawl hi Jakeh fapa Agur ih ṭongmi an si: “Maw Pathian, ka thinlung a bang, Ka thazaang khal a bang thluh zo; Zianghman ka tuah thei nawn lo.","title":"Agur Ih ṭongmi"},"2":{"text":"Kei cu ramsa vek ka si thlang, minung ka bang nawn lo. Milai thinlung khal ka nei nawn lo."},"3":{"text":"Fimthiamnak khal ka zir dah lo, Pathian thu khal zianghman ka thei lo."},"4":{"text":"Zoso vancung thuhla hi a thei thluhtu? Zoso a kut in thli a kai theitu? Asilole zoso puansia in tidai a fun theitu? Asilole zoso lei le van ih ramri a ṭhen theitu? Cupa cu zoso a si, na thei maw?
