A fapa teh zo a si?"},"5":{"text":"“Pathian ih ṭongkam pohpoh cu a dik a si; Amah cu humhimnak a hawltu hrangah ralphaw a si."},"6":{"text":"Pathian ih ṭongkam cu beet hlah, A lo kawk ding ih na thuphanpernak kha a langter ding.”"},"7":{"text":"“Maw Pathian, na hnenah thil pahnih ka lo dil; Ka thih hlanah i coter hram aw:","title":"Thufim Dang Pawl"},"8":{"text":"Thuphanpertu si lo dingin i kil aw; Farah tuk le lian tuk khal in i tuah hlah awla, Ka khop tawkfang lawng rawl i pe hram aw."},"9":{"text":"Thil tampi ka neih ahcun ‘ Bawipa ka ṭul lo,’ ka ti pang ding; Ka farah tuk ahcun ruk ka ru pang ding ih, Ka Pathian hmin ka thangsiatter pang ding.”"},"10":{"text":"Ziangtik hmanah hnen-um khi a bawipa ih hmaiah va soisel hlah; Na soisel asile hnen-um in a lo camriam ding ih mual na pho sawn ding."},"11":{"text":"Pale pawl a camsiat ih, Nule pawl lungtong lotu an um."},"12":{"text":"Borhhlawh zet cingin mah le mah Ka thianghlimzet tiih a ruat awtu an um."},"13":{"text":"Mi ṭhazet ka si tiih a ruat awmi an um; Anmah le an mah cu mi ṭha bikah an ruat aw!"},"14":{"text":"Mi farah le nunhar pawl nekrawk le dekcok ih a nungmi an um; Cutiin an pum an cawm aw."},"15":{"text":"Cangvat in fanu pahnih a nei ih an hminah, “I pe aw, I pe aw,” ti an si. Khop ti a nei dah lomi thil pathum an um; “A tawk zo” a ti dah lotu thil pali an um a si:"},"16":{"text":"Cu pawl cu mithi khua Sheol, fa nei lo nucing, Ruahti a haal zetmi ramcaar le mih thei lomi meihlio tla an si."},"17":{"text":"Zokhal a pa kha hnihsuak ih a saitu le, A nu a tar tikih a hmuhsuamtu cu, Langta in a sa a ei dingih tlangak in a mit a phorh sak ding."},"18":{"text":"Ka hrangah mangbangza thu thuk pathum an um; Ka theih thei lomi thil pali an um a si:"},"19":{"text":"Cupawl cu vanih a zam reromi muvanlai ih zin, Lungpi parih a vakmi rul ih zin, Tifinriat tlunih tangphawlawng fehnak zin le Mipa in nunau a duhnak zin, tla an si."},"20":{"text":"Nupi zuangzam ih cangvaih daan cu hivek in a si: A uire ih ti a bual awk thluh hnuah cun, “Zianghman sualnak ka tuah ual lo,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Leilung ih a tuar thei lomi thil phunthum an um; A zawi thei lomi thil pali an um a si:"},"22":{"text":"Cumi pawl cu Siangpahrang ah a hung cangmi sal, Rawl duhduh ei ding a neimi mi aa,"},"23":{"text":"Mi mitkemzet a sinan pasal a nei thei thothotu nunau le A bawinu ih to-nak a longtu hnen-um nu, tla an si."},"24":{"text":"Leilung tlunah a fatezet naón a fimzetmi ramsa pali an um:"},"25":{"text":"Cu pawl cu an tha a cak lo naón ṭhal caanah rawl a seekkhawl ciatu sihte;"},"26":{"text":"A cak lo naón lungkhaam lakah kua a tuahtu meingan;"},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang an nei lo naón, A rual a rual ih a ṭhawn dutdomi kharbok;"},"28":{"text":"Na kut khalah na huum thei ih, Siangpahrang innsung khal ah na hmuh theimi dekder, tla an si."},"29":{"text":"An vah laifangih zohthanung thil pathum an um; Ropizet ih feh a hmangmi thil pali an um a si:"},"30":{"text":"Cupawl cu ramsa lakih a cakbik le Zianghman ṭih a nei lomi kiosa,"},"31":{"text":"Mecang, arcang puar le, A kuthnuai pawl hmaiih a feh hngualhngotu siangpahrang, tla an si."},"32":{"text":"Aatthlakza in na puarthau ih, Thil ṭha lo tuah na tum ahcun, Cawl awla ruat ṭhata aw."},"33":{"text":"Cawhnawi na cawh ciamco le thawphat na ngah, Mi pakhat ih hnar na vuak le thi a suak, Na thin na soter le thubuai harsatnak na tong."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi pawl hi Siangpahrang Lemuel hnenah a nu ih cahmi thufim pawl an si.","title":"Siangpahrang Hnenah Ruahnak Pekmi"},"2":{"text":"“Nang cu ka duhdawt zetmi ka fapa, ka thlacam ruangih ngahmi fapa, ka rilrah na si. Ziangthu so ka lo sim ding?"},"3":{"text":"Tisa hiarnak le nunau lamah na thazaang le na sumsaw hmang hlah; Siangpahrang tampi a siatsuahtu cu cupawl an si."},"4":{"text":"I ngai hnik, Lemuel. Siangpahrang in zu in ding a si lo; Zu hiarnak neih ding khal a si lo."},"5":{"text":"Ziangahtile zu an in tikah daan kha an hngilh ih, Mi nunhar pawl covo khal an thei nawn lo."},"6":{"text":"Zu cu mithi zik pawl le thinnuam lo beidong pawl hrangah a si."},"7":{"text":"Cu pawl cun in hai sehla an lung nomlonak le, An farahnak tla hngilh hai seh."},"8":{"text":"“Mahte a sim thei lomi pawl hrangah simsak aw; Bawmtu nei lo pawl ih covo kha hum sak aw."},"9":{"text":"An hrangah simsak awla, thuṭhentu dik va si aw; Mi farah le mi nunhar pawl ih covo kha hum sak aw.”"},"10":{"text":"Nupi ṭhaṭhum khi ziangtluk in ngah a har! Ruby lungvar mankhung hnakin man a nei deuh!","title":"Nupi ṭhaṭhum"},"11":{"text":"A pasal in a rinsanzet ih ziangtik khalah a pasal cu a zonzai lo ding."},"12":{"text":"A nunsung hmuahhmuah a pasal parah thil ṭha a tuah ringring ih siatnak a tuah dah lo."},"13":{"text":"Umlak ti nei loin tuuhmul le patzai puan a tak ṭheu."},"14":{"text":"Sumsaw let pawl ih tangphawlawng bangin, Ram kelet ihsin a innsang hrangah rawl a rak phur ṭheu."},"15":{"text":"A innsang hrang rawl zaal dingah le a hnen-um pawl an hnaṭuan ding tawlrel sak dingah, Zingthlapit in a tho ṭheu."},"16":{"text":"Leiram a hawl ih a lei, A hlawhmi sumsaw in sabit hmuan a tuah."},"17":{"text":"Hnaṭuan taima zet a si ih, A thazaang a cak ih a law fawn."},"18":{"text":"A thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah ih man neihzia a thei ih, Zan siimpi tiang innsang hna a ṭuan."},"19":{"text":"Amahte pat a hmuih ih amah ih hnipuan khal a tak."},"20":{"text":"Mi farah le mi nunhar hnenah a tirh a siangzet."},"21":{"text":"An sungte in kawr hlum an nei thluh ih, Thlatang khawsik caan a thlen khal ah an thla a phang hrimhrim lo."},"22":{"text":"Tangphah khuh a tah ih sendup mawizetih tahmi hnipuan a hruh."},"23":{"text":"A pasal cu khawsungah mizapi ih theihmi hotu a si."},"24":{"text":"Hnipuan le taikhap pawl a tuah ih sumsaw let pawl a zorh."},"25":{"text":"A thazaang a cak, an upat zet ih hmailam hrangah thinphannak a nei lo."},"26":{"text":"Fimkhur zet le awkaa nemtein a ṭong ṭheu."},"27":{"text":"Umlak ti nei loin a innsang ih poihai a tawlrel ringring."},"28":{"text":"A faale pawl in an thangṭhat ih, A pasal khal in a lawmzet."},"29":{"text":"A pasal in, “Nunau tampi cu nupi ṭha an si cio naón, Nang hi a ṭha hleice na si,” a ti."},"30":{"text":"Iang neih cu mi a buum thei ih mawinak khal a ziam thei; Asinain Bawipa a ṭihzahtu minu cu lom le porh tlak a si."},"31":{"text":"A tuahmi thil hmuahhmuah ruangah amah cu thang ṭhat uh; Mi hmuahhmuah ih upat tlak minu a si."}}}}},"21":{"info":{"name":"Thusimtu","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Thusimtu (ecclesiates)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem siangpahrang, David fapa Thusimtu ih sim mi pawl:","title":"Nunnak Hi Thulolak A Si"},"2":{"text":"Thusimtu in hiti in a ti, Zianghman an si lo, zianghman an si lo; Thil hmuahhmuah hi zianghman an si lo;"},"3":{"text":"Milai in leilung tlun a nun sungih a hnaṭuan mi le a zonzaih mi hmuahhmuahnak in ziang ṭhathnemnak so a ngah?"},"4":{"text":"Sankhat a liam ih sandang a ra suak, Asinain leilung cu a hmun ringring ko."},"5":{"text":"Ni khal a suak ih a tla sal, Cule a suahnak lamah a kir ih a suak sal lala."},"6":{"text":"Thli cu thlanglam ah a hrangih saklam khalah a hrang; A heel aw vivo ih a thoknak a thleng kir sal."},"7":{"text":"Tiva hmuahhmuah tifinriat ah an luang, Sikhalsehla tifinriat cu a khat cuang lo; Tiva cu an hna lamah an kir salih, An luan keel in an luang sal."},"8":{"text":"Thil hmuahhmuah hi thinlung rethei tertu an si; Minung kaa in sim cawk ding a si lo. Mit in thil a hmuh mi hi khawh ti a nei lo, Hna khalin a theih mi hi nin ti a nei lo."},"9":{"text":"Thil a um zo mi kha a um sal ding; Thil tuah cia mi kha tuah sal an si ding; Vanrang hnuai ah hin thil thar zianghman a um lo."},"10":{"text":"Zotal in, “Zohhnik uh, himi hi thilthar a si!” an ti thei mi a um dah maw? A um lo, Kan seem hlanpi ih a rak um cia mi hlir an si."},"11":{"text":"Hlanlai san kha zohman in an thei nawn lo; A ra thleng ding mi san khal cu An nehhnu ih san pawl in an thei nawn lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Kei Thusimtu hi Jerusalem ah Israel siangpahrang ka rak si.","title":"Thusimtu Ih Hmuhton Mi"},"13":{"text":"Cule vanhnuai ih thil umdaan hmuahhmuah pawl hi fimnak hmangin theihfel le hmuhsuak dingah ka thinlung in ka ngaihtuah. Pathian in milai parah harsatnak a pekmi hi ka zoh tikah riahsiatnak ngaingai a si."},"14":{"text":"Leilung tlunih thil tuah mi hmuahhmuah hi ka hmu zo. Zohhnik uh, zianghman an si lo; thli dawi rero sehla cu bangtuk men an si."},"15":{"text":"A kawi cia mi cu dingter a theih lo, A um lo mi cu siar a theih lo."},"16":{"text":"Keimah le keimah cu: “Ka hlanih Jerusalem a rak uktu hmuahhmuah hnakin fimnak tam sawn ka nei. Ka thinlung in fimnak le theihnak cu nasazet ka nei a si,” ka ti aw."},"17":{"text":"Cuticun ka thinlung cu fimnak thei dingah le aatnak le fimlonak khal thei dingah ka hmang. Cukhal cu zianghman an si lo; thli dawi rero vek thotho a si."},"18":{"text":"Fimnak a tam tikah buainak a tam, Theihnak a tam tikah riahsiatnak a tam."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka thinlung tein, “Atu cun nomnak ka tep ve hnik pei; thil dang ruat loin nomnak lawnglawng ka ti ve hnik pei,” tiah ka ti. Asinain cu khal cu zianghman a rak si lo."},"2":{"text":"Hnihnak hi aat a si! Nomnak khal hi ziangso a ṭhahnem?"},"3":{"text":"Milai in leilung tlun kum malte an nun sungah hin thilṭha an tuah ding mi ka hmuhsuak theinak dingah, fimnak lamzin thlun in ka tha tho tertu ah zu ka in ih, cuticun thuṭha cu ka thinlung in ka hawl."},"4":{"text":"Thil thupi zetzet ka tuah: Ka hrangah inn ka sak ih, sabit hmuan ka tuah;"},"5":{"text":"pangpar hmuan le thingkung ciinnak hmuan nuam ka tuah ih rah a phunphun a rah mi thingkung tam zet ka phun."},"6":{"text":"Thingkung ṭhang lai pawl ti toihnak ah tiah tili tla ka tuah;"},"7":{"text":"Ṭuangsuak sal ka nei ih cuih tlunah salnu le salpa tampi ka lei beet. Ka neih mi caw le tuu pawl cu ka hlanih Jerusalem ih a rak um mi zo ih neih mi hnak khalin a tam deuh."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang pawl le ramṭhen pawl hnen ihsin sui le ngun ka khawm ciamco. Hlasa tu ah nunau siseh mipa siseh ka ret; mipa in nuam an ti ṭheu mi nusun khal tampi ka nei."},"9":{"text":"Jerusalem ah ka hlanih siangpahrang a rak ṭuantu hmuahhmuah hnakin ka lian deuh ih ka nasa deuh. Cule ka fimnak khal amah keel a si."},"10":{"text":"Ka mit in thilṭha a hmuh mi hmuahhmuah ka ngah ṭheh. Ka thinlung in nomnak a duh mi hmuahhmuah ka co ṭheh. Ka hnaṭuannak ihsin thinlung nomnak ka ngah ih cumi cu ka ṭuan man ka ngah mi laksawng a si."},"11":{"text":"Hi thil hmuahhmuah hi ka ruatih ka tuah mi le ka ṭuan mi hmuahhmuah ka ngaihtuah tikah, zohhnik uh, zianghman an si lo; thli dawi rero vek lawnglawng an si ti fiangtein ka thei. Vanrang hnuai milai hrangah hin thil ṭhahnem zianghman a um lo a si."},"12":{"text":"Cule fimnak le aatnak le fimlonak pawl hi ka khingkhai ih ka hun tahṭhim. Siangpahrang ih a tuah cia mi dah ti lo a hnu ih a ra mi cun zianghman tuah thei mi dang a neih cuang lo."},"13":{"text":"Cuti ih ka khingkhai hnuah tleunak in thimnak cu a laan vekin fimnak in aatnak cu a laan a si, ti ka thei."},"14":{"text":"Mifim cun a lu ah mit a nei, a sinan mi aa cu khawthim lakah a feh. Cule an pahnih tlunah mi hmuahhmuah hnenih a tlung mi khawlairel cu a tlung thotho ding ti ka hmu."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah keimah te in, “Mi aa ton mi hi ka tong ve ding sikhawh, ka fim hi ziangso a ṭhathnemnak a um cuang?” tiah ka ti. Hi khal hi zianghmanlo thotho a si."},"16":{"text":"Mi aa an theih nawn lo vek thotho in mifim khal an thei nawn ve hai lo ding. Hmailam ahcun kan zate in hngilh ṭheh kan si ding. A si, mi aa vekin mifim khal a thi ve thotho."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah nunnak hi ka hua, ziangahtile vanhnuai ih thil hmuahhmuah cu riahsiatnak thleng tertu men an si. Thil hmuahhmuah hi thulolak an rak si. Thli ka rak dawi rero men a si."},"18":{"text":"Vanhnuai ih ka tuah mi le ka hnaṭuan mi hmuahhmuah hi ka hua; ka nehhnu ih ka airawltu hnenah ka taanta thluh ding ti ka thei cia a si!"},"19":{"text":"Cupa cu mifim a si ding le mi aa a si ding hman zoso a thei! Ziang a va si hmanah ka fimnak le ka hnaṭuannak ihsin a suak mi rah hmuahhmuah cu amai uk mi an si ding fawn! Cukhal cu thulolak men a si."},"20":{"text":"Leilung tlunih ka hnaṭuan mi le ka thil ti mi hmuahhmuah ka ngaihtuah vivo tikah beidong in ka um. Nasazet ih hna ka ṭuan rero kha ka siir aw."},"21":{"text":"Ziangahtile zianghman a ṭuanlotu hnenah fimnak le theihnak le thiamnak thawn hna a ṭuantu in a neih mi hmuahhmuah a taanta ṭheh ding a sihi! Hi khal hi zianghmanlo a si ih thil ṭha lozet a si."},"22":{"text":"Rethei le zonzai in a nunsung hmuahhmuah ni hnuai ah hna a ṭuan ih ziangso a ngah?"},"23":{"text":"A nunsung hmuahhmuah cu tuarnak le helhkamnak hlir an si. Zan khalah a thinlung a nuam cuang lo. Hi khal hi thulolak a si ko."},"24":{"text":"Minung hrangah cun ei le in le a hnaṭuan ihsin nomnak a ngah mi kha a ṭhabik a si. Cumi khal cu Pathian kutsung ihsin a ra mi an si ti ka hmu zo."},"25":{"text":"Ziangahtile amah tel locun zoso a ei a in thei dingih a nuam aw thei ding?"},"26":{"text":"A si, amah a lungawi tertu hnen ahcun fimnak le thiamnak le lungawinak a pek. Asinain misual hnenah cun, Pathian lungawi tertu hnen ih pek sal thluh leh dingin, phurh ding le khawm ding ṭuanvo a pek a si. Cukhal cu thulolak a si; thli dawi rero bangtuk a si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziang hmuahhmuah in caan an nei ih Leilung tlun thil tinkim hrangah tikcu remcaang a um.","title":"Ziang Tinkim In Caan An Nei"},"2":{"text":"Suah caan a um ih thih caan a um, Phun caan a um ih phawi caan a um;"},"3":{"text":"Thah caan a um ih damter caan a um, Bal caan a um ih sak caan a um;"},"4":{"text":"Ṭah caan a um ih hnih caan a um, Riahsiat caan a um ih laam caan a um;"},"5":{"text":"Lungto hlon caan a um ih khawmsaal caan a um; Pom awk caan a um ih pom awk hrial caan a um;"},"6":{"text":"Hawl caan a um ih hlohter caan a um, Khawm caan a um ih hlon caan a um;"},"7":{"text":"Thlek caan a um ih ṭhit caan a um, Daite ih um caan a um ih ṭong caan a um;"},"8":{"text":"Duhdawt caan a um ih huat caan a um, Ral awk caan a um ih rem awk caan a um."},"9":{"text":"Hnaṭuantu in harsazet ih a hnaṭuannak in ziangso ngah mi a neih?"},"10":{"text":"Pathian in minung hnenah buaipi dingin hnaṭuan a pek ti ka thei."},"11":{"text":"Pathian in ziangthil khal sisehla a remcaang mi tikcu a pek ti ka hmu fawn. Sikhalsehla a liam zo mi caan a um tile a ra ding mi caan a um ti cu minung in a thei naón, Pathian in ziangso a tuah, a hram ihsin a netnak tiang ziangso a tumtah ti cu a thei thei lo."},"12":{"text":"Milai hrangih ṭhabik cu an nun sungih lungawi le nunnuam ih an um thei hi a si."},"13":{"text":"A in a ei ih a hnaṭuannak ah lungkimnak a neih hi Pathian ih laksawng a si."},"14":{"text":"Pathian thil tuah mi hmuahhmuah cu a hmun ding, ti ka thei; beet thei ding a um lo, lak sal ding khal zianghman a um lo. Milai in a thil tuah mi an hmuh tikah Bawipa an ṭihzahnak dingah a si."},"15":{"text":"Atu ih a um mi hi a rak um cia mi an si; hmailam ih a um laiding mi khal a um cia mi thotho an si. Pathian in a liam zo mi kha a kirter sal ṭheu a si."},"16":{"text":"Leilung tlunah hin dingnak a umnak ding hmunah ṭhatlonak a um ringring, ti ka hmu. Miding an umnak ding hmunah miṭha lo an um ringring.","title":"Leitlun Ih Ding Lonak"},"17":{"text":"Ka thinlungte in, “Pathian in miding le miṭha lo parah thu a ṭhen ding; thil hmuahhmuah hrangah le hnaṭuan mi hmuahhmuah hrangah tikcu a ret a si,” tiah ka ti."},"18":{"text":"Ka thinlungte in, “Minung hi ramsa tlunah zianghman a hlei ih kan cuannak le kan saannak a um cuanglo ti langter dingah Pathian in in hniksak a si,” ka ti."},"19":{"text":"Ziangahtile ramsa le milai parih khawlairelnak cu a bangrep a si. Ramsa cu a thi ih milai khal a thi ve. Thihnak ahcun an hmunkhat a si. Milai in ramsa cu a hleih cuangnak zianghman a um lo; a hlo thei mi thaw an nei veve."},"20":{"text":"An pahnih in hmun khatah an feh. An pahnih in leivut ihsin lak mi an si ih leivut ah an kir sal ding."},"21":{"text":"Minung ih thlarau cu tlunlam ah a kai ih ramsa ih thlarau cu lei thuai ah a lut ti zoso fiangtein a sim thei?"},"22":{"text":"Curuangah minung hrangah cun a hnaṭuan mi parih lungawinak neih hi thil ṭhabik a si, ti ka hmu. Cucu a ṭuanvo a si. A hnuah ziang a cang ding ti zoso a sim thei ding?"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cui hnuah leilung tlunih hremnak a tuartu pawl thuhla ka ruat. Hremnak tuartu pawl ih mitthli ka hmu; zohman hnemtu an nei si lo! Mi hremtu pawl cu an kut sungah thil ti theinak an nei ih, an hrem mi pawl cu zohman bawmtu an nei lo."},"2":{"text":"A thi cia mi pawl an thih zo ruangah a nunglai mi pawl hnakin mi vanṭha an si, tiah ka ruat."},"3":{"text":"Annih hnakin mi vanṭha sawn cu leilung tlunih thil ṭha lo tuah mi hmuahhmuah a hmu hrih lotu le a suak hrih lotu pawl an si."},"4":{"text":"Cule minung in harsazet ih hna a ṭuan ih thil a ti suak thei mi hmuahhmuah khal hi ziang ruangah a si tile: a minung pi hleih duh ah le laan a duh ruangah a si, ti ka hmu. Hi khal hi thulolak a si ih thli dawi rero vek a si."},"5":{"text":"“Mi aa cu hnaṭuan loin a kut a bom ih a netnak ahcun rawl loin a thi,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Kei cun, “Harsazet hnaṭuan ih thulolak si thotho ding suumpi khat neih hnak cun thinlung nuamte ih zate khat lawng neih a ṭha sawn,” ka ti."},"7":{"text":"Nun sungih zianghman lo a si mi pakhat ka hmu lala."},"8":{"text":"Mi pakhat cu fapa a nei lo, unau khal a nei lo; amah lawngin a um ih milian si duh ah cat baang loin hna a ṭuan; a sinan a lennak ah a lung a kim dah lo. “Zo hrangah so hiti lawmmam in hna ka ṭuan ih nunnomnak tikcu hman neilo ih ka um?” ti khal a ruat dah lo. Hi khal hi thulolak a si ih a nuamlo zet mi nunnak a si."},"9":{"text":"Mi pahnih cu pakhat hnakin an ṭha deuh, ziangahtile an hnaṭuan man tam deuh an ngah."},"10":{"text":"Pakhatkhat an tluk pang asile a dang pakhat in a tho. Sikhalsehla mi pakhat lawng cu a tluk pang asile zaangfakza a si, tho tu zohman a nei lo."},"11":{"text":"Cui tlunah mi pahnih an it tlang tikah cun an khua a hlum. Sikhalsehla mi pakhat lawng cu ziangtinso a khua a hlum thei ding?"},"12":{"text":"Mi pakhat lawng cu neh a ol-te; a sinan pahnih cu an ṭang thei zet ding; hridai zangthum hrual cu olte in a cat dah lo."},"13":{"text":"A tar ih a aa mi siangpahrang, midang ih ruahnak ṭha pek mi khal a saang duh nawn lomi hnak cun tleirawl farah mifim a ṭha sawn."},"14":{"text":"Thawnginn ihsin a suak mi khal siangpahrang a si thei, a ram sungah farah zonzai in a rak suak mi sihmansehla!"},"15":{"text":"Hi leitlun ih a um mi minung hmuahhmuah ih thu ka hun ruatih siangpahrang airawltu mino pakhat cu hmunkhat khatah a um ti ka thei."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang ih uk mi cu minung siar cawk lo an si ko ding. Sikhalsehla a thih tikah cun a rak tuah mi thil ruangah a parah zohman lungawi an um cuanglo ding. Hi khal hi zianghmanlo a si ih thli dawi rero vek thotho a si."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian biakinn ih na feh tikah ralring zetin feh aw. Zianghman ruatlo ih sualnak a tuah tu mi aa pawl ih thawinak pek mi hnakin a thu thlun duhnak thinlung thawn feh a ṭha sawn.","title":"Ruat Fel Cia Lo In Thukamnak Tuah Hlah"},"2":{"text":"Ruat hmaisa loin ṭong hlah; Pathian hmaiah cun man mawh zetih ṭong ding khal ruat hlah. Pathian cu vancungah a um; nang cu leilung parah na um; curuangah na ṭong mi malter aw."},"3":{"text":"Thinlung a har tikah mang a tam, Mi aa pawl cu an ṭong a tam."},"4":{"text":"Pathian hnenih thukamnak na tuah tikah na thukam vekih tuahsuak dingah na khulfung hlah. Ziangahtile Pathian in mi aa cu zianghman ah a hai lo. Na thukam vekin pe aw."},"5":{"text":"Na thukam vekih na pek lo hnak cun thukamnak zianghman tuah lo a ṭha sawn."},"6":{"text":"Na ṭongkam in sualnak ah lo hruai hlah seh! A lo hruai asile Pathian palai hmaiah, “Ka ti sual a si!” ti hlah. Culo le na ṭong mi ruangah Pathian a thin a heng dingih na thil tuah mi hmuahhmuah a lakah an cang ṭheh ding."},"7":{"text":"Mang a tam le thulolak a tam. Pathian cu ṭihzah aw!"},"8":{"text":"Ramṭhen pakhatkhat sungah mifarah an namsuk ih an co ding le an ngah ding khal ngah loih an um na hmuh a si ahcun mangbang in va um hlah; ziangahtile bawi pakhat cu a tlunah bawi dang pakhat a um lai ih an zate ih tlunih bawi upabik in a zoh ringring a si.","title":"Nunnak Cu Zianghmanlo Men A Si"},"9":{"text":"Leiram ih a suak mi cu mi hmuahhmuah hrang a si. Siangpahrang hman in leiram sung suak a ring a si."},"10":{"text":"Tangka duhtu cu saduhthah in tangka a nei dah lo ding; tangka lawnglawng a ruattu cun ziangzat a miat khalle a mal tuk a ti ringring ding. Cukhal cu zianghmanlo a si!"},"11":{"text":"Neih mi a tam tikah a eitu an tam ve; thilri neitu pawl hrangah an thilri an mit in an zoh fang dah tilo cun ziangso ṭhathnemnak a um?"},"12":{"text":"Hnaṭuantu cu mal a ei khalah, tam a ei khalah, a ihthat a thaw ringring; a sinan milian pa cu tamtuk a neih ruangah a itthat thei lo."},"13":{"text":"Leilung tlunah thil poimawhzet pakhat ka hmuh mi cu: milai in amah siatsuah tu ding lennak a khawl ciamco mi hi a si."},"14":{"text":"Cule a khawl mi cu rinlopi in a hloral ih a fapa hnenah a roh ding zianghman a taang nawn lo!"},"15":{"text":"Tak lawngte in a nui pum sungih sin a suah vekin tak lawngte in a kir sal ding; a hnaṭuan man hmuahhmuah ken thei ding mi zianghman a nei lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Hi khal hi thil ṭha lo ngaingai a si, a ratlam vek cekci in a kir sal hi; hna kanṭuan, thli kan dawi ih a kaih kan tum; cuti lawngih hna a ṭuan hi ziangso a hrangah miatnak a um?"},"17":{"text":"A san sung hmuahhmuah ah khawthim sungah rawl a ei ih riahsiatnak, helhkamnak, natnak le thinhengnak thawn a um fawn!"},"18":{"text":"Curuangah ka hmuhsuak mi cu hihi a si: Milai in a ṭhabik a tuah thei mi cu Pathian in caan tawite a pek sungah hin ei le in ih a ṭuan mi sungin a ngah mi kha nompi hi a si ko. Cucu a covo a si."},"19":{"text":"Pathian in minung cu a nompi dingah lennak le thilri a pek ahcun, a hnaṭuan man cu nompi in lungawipi ding a si. Cucu Pathian ih laksawng a si."},"20":{"text":"Cuvek minung cun mi santawi a si kha a ruat lemlo ding, ziangahtile Pathian in a thinlung cu lungawinak in a khah ter."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leilung tlunih thil ṭha lo pakhat ka hmuh mi cu minung hrangah a ritzet mi a si:","title":"Hnangamnak A ṭhabik"},"2":{"text":"Mi pakhat hnenah Pathian in lennak, thilri le mi ih upatnak tla a pek ih a thinlung in a duh mi hmuahhmuah neih lomi zianghman a nei lo; sikhalsehla a thilri pawl nunnuam zetih hman theinak cu Pathian in a pek lo; midang sawn in nuamzet in an hmang. Hihi thil mawilo le thil ṭha lozet a si."},"3":{"text":"Mi pakhat in faate zakhat khal nei sehla, kum reipi nungin mi sanṭhazet khal sisehla, a neih mi thilri pawl nunnuam in a hmang theilo-ih thinlung hnangamnak zianghman a ngah lo a si ahcun anih hnakin a thi cia in a suak mi naute a ṭha sawn."},"4":{"text":"Cui naute cu suahsan nei lo, thim lakih a liam mi a si ih ziangtik hmanah a hmin a lang dah lo;"},"5":{"text":"ni khal a hmu dah loih zianghman theih mi a neilo naón, thin nuamlo pa hnak cun daiteón colhnak a ngah a si."},"6":{"text":"Mi pakhat cu kum thawngkhat nungin sanhnih nolh hmansehla thinlung hnangamnak a neih lo ahcun ziangso a ṭhathnem? Zozo khal an fehnak ding cu a hmunkhat ṭheh a si lo maw?"},"7":{"text":"Milai in a pumpi hrang lawngah hna a ṭuan, a sinan a tawk thlang ti a um dah lo."},"8":{"text":"Ziangtin so mifim cun mi aa hnakin sawtnak a neih deuh cuang? Mi farah pa cu nun ding zia thei hmansehla ziangso a ṭhahnem?"},"9":{"text":"Curuangah thinlung vakvai ih um ter rero hnakin na mithmai ih a um mi thilri parih lungkimnak neih hi a ṭha sawn. Cukhal cu thulolak a si ih thli kaih tum vek a si."},"10":{"text":"Thil a um cia mi cu hminsak cia ṭheh an si ih ziangvek thil an si ti cu theih cia a si. Minung cun amah hnakih a cak deuh mi cu a dodal thei lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Ziangahtile tam deuh ṭong tikah sullam a neilo deuhdeuh. Cuti a si ahcun ziangtinso milai hrangah sawtnak a um cuang ding?"},"12":{"text":"Milai nunnak hrangah thilṭha cu, leilung tlun caan tawite a nun sungah le phenthlam bangin a liam cing mi a nunnak sungah hin zoso a thei thei ding? Zo in so a thih hnuah leitlun ah ziang a cang ding ti a thei ding?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hminṭhat cu zihmui ṭhabik hnakin a ṭha sawn. Thih ni cu suah ni hnakin a ṭha sawn.","title":"Fimnak Ih Thupitnak"},"2":{"text":"Puai tuahnak hmunih feh hnakin mithi inn feh a ṭha sawn. Ziangahtile minung cu kan zate in thihnak in in hngak a si ti cu theih ringring ding a si."},"3":{"text":"Hnih hnakin riahsiat a ṭha sawn. Mithmai ah lungawinak a um theilo naón thinlung a ṭhat ter."},"4":{"text":"Mifim pawl ih thinlung cu mithi inn ah a caam; a sinan mi aa pawl ih thinlung cu nomnak hmunah a um."},"5":{"text":"Mi aa ih na thangṭhatnak hla a sak mi ngai hnakin mifim ih kawknak ngai a ṭha sawn."},"6":{"text":"Miaa hnih cu meisa sungih hling an paih ih a puak mi thawm vek a si. Tican ziang hman a nei lo."},"7":{"text":"Mifim in midang a bum tikah mi aa ah a can aw a si. Nawhthuh na lak asile na ziaza na siatsuah a si."},"8":{"text":"Thil thokpek hnakin a net lam a ṭha sawn. Hngalzet ih um hnak cun lungsau a ṭha sawn."},"9":{"text":"Olte in na thinheng hlah; olte-ih thinheng cu mi aa pawl ih daan a si."},"10":{"text":"“Ziangtin so tuihsan hnakin hlan san a ṭhat sawn?” tiah va sut hlah. Cuvek cu mifim pawl thusuh daan a si lo."},"11":{"text":"Thilri neih hnakin fimnak neih a ṭha sawn. Ni a hmutu hmuahhmuah hrangah a ṭha mi ro a si."},"12":{"text":"Fimnak cu sumsaw vekin humhimnak a si; fimnak cun fimnak neitu hnenah nunnak a pek a si."},"13":{"text":"Pathian ih hnaṭuannak hi ruat hnik uh: A kawihter cia mi hi zoso a dingter thei ding?"},"14":{"text":"Ṭhat ni ah na lungawi aw; siat ni ah khua ruat aw. Pathian in lungawinak a um ter ih harnak khal a um ter. Curuangah hmailam ah ziang a um ding ti cu zohman in an thei lo."},"15":{"text":"Ka nunnak santlailo sungah hin thil phunkim ka hmu ih mawh neilo cu mawh a neilo naón a thi lohli ih miṭha lo cu a ṭhatlonak thawn kum reipi a nung mi ka hmu."},"16":{"text":"Miṭha tuk si aw hlah, mifim tuk khal si aw hlah, ziangah so nangmah le nangmah na siatsuah awk ding."},"17":{"text":"Miṭha lo tuk va si hlah; mi aa tuk khal va si hlah. Na tikcu kim hlanah ziangah so na thih ding?"},"18":{"text":"Thil pakhat fekten kai ih a dang thil khal thlah cuanglo a ṭha. Pathian a ṭihzah tu cun a phunhnih ah an hlawh a tling ding."},"19":{"text":"Khua hotu upa pahra in khua hnenih cahnak an pek mi hnakin fimnak in mifim pa hnenah cahnak tam sawn a pek."},"20":{"text":"Leilung tlunah ṭhatnak lawnglawng a tuah ih siatnak a tuah dah lotu zohman an um lo."},"21":{"text":"Cui tlunah mi ṭongmi hmuahhmuah cu va poisa tuk hlah; culo ahcun na hnen-um pawl khalin an lo relsiatnak na thei pang ding."},"22":{"text":"Nangmah khalin midang vei tampi na relsiat ti na thei aw ko."},"23":{"text":"Hi hmuahhmuah hi fimnak in ka hniksak. Ka fim hmang tin ka ruat, a sinan ka rak fim ta lo."},"24":{"text":"Nunnak timi hi zoso a thei thei ding? A hlazet le a thuk zet, a thuk taktak mi a si ih zohman ih hawlsuak theih ding a si lo."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah ka thinlung cu fimnak hawl ding le zir ding le hmu suak dingin ka vun ruat ciammam ih ka ton ngaingai mi cu ṭhatlonak le fimlonak le aatnak le buainak lawng an si."},"26":{"text":"Nunau ka ton mi cu ka hrangah thihnak hnakin a khaa sawn, a thinlung cu thang a si ih a kut pawl cu thir cikcin an si; Pathian ih zaangfah mi cu cunu hnenin a luat ding, a sinan misual cu cunu in a kaitaar ding."},"27":{"text":"Thusimtu in, “Ka hmuh mi cu himi hi a si: thil pakhat hnu pakhat ka thinlung in ka ngaihtuah vivo; a thusuak ka hawl vivo;"},"28":{"text":"reipi ka hawl naón ka hlawhtling lo a si. Cule minung thawngkhat sungah upat tlak cu mipa pakhat ka hmu; a sinan nunau cu pakhat hman ka hmu lo."},"29":{"text":"Ngaihnik, ka hmuh mi cu himi hi a si: Pathian in minung hi miding ah a tuah naón anmah duhnak le tumtahnak ah an pial ṭheh a si,” a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu pawl thei thei dingah zoso mifim a um? Thil pawl ih tican hi zoso a thei thei? Fimnak in minung ih mithmai cu a vaangter ih an mithmai a sia mi khal a hloh ter."},"2":{"text":"Pathian hmaiah thu na kam zo ruangah siangpahrang ih thupekmi cu tuah aw.","title":"Siangpahrang Thu Ngai Uh"},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang cun a duhduh in thil a tuah thei, curuangah a hmaika ihsin zamrang in feh aw, cubangtuk ṭihnung hmunah cun um duh hlah."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang thu cu a saangbik a si ruangah amah cu zo in so, “Ziang so na tuah rero?” tiah a sut ngam ding."},"5":{"text":"Amaió thu a thluntu cu harsatnak in a luat ding. Mifim cun ziangtik caan ah so hna ka ṭuan dingih ziang vekin so ka ṭuan ding, ti a theithiam."},"6":{"text":"Ziangahtile thil hmuahhmuah in tikcu le caan remcaang an nei fingfing. Kan theih mi hi a mal tuk lawm mam."},"7":{"text":"Hmailam ah ziang a cang ding ti zohman in an thei lo. A sim theitu midang khal an um lo."},"8":{"text":"Zohman thihnak ihsin a hum aw thei an um loih thih ni ṭhawn theitu khal an um lo. Cui ral ihsin zohman an luat thei lo. Thuphan simnak in an luat thei lo."},"9":{"text":"Vanhnuai ih thil tuah mi hmuahhmuah ka thinlung hmangin ka ruah hnuah ka hmuh mi cu himi hi a si! Mi hrekkhat in midang tlunah thu an nei ih mi hrekkhat cu a rak tuartu an si.","title":"Miṭha Le Miṭha Lo"},"10":{"text":"Miṭha lo pawl thlaan ih an phum ka hmu. Asinain thlaan ihsin kan kir lamah cun ṭhatlonak an tuahnak khuasung rori ah khan mi in an thangṭhat ciamco. Hi khal hi zianghman lo, thulolak a si."},"11":{"text":"Miṭha lo pawl parih daantatnak kha zamrangih cawh an si lo ruangah sualnak cu ralṭhazet in an tuah."},"12":{"text":"Misual in thil ṭha lo cu vei zakhat a tuah hnu hmanah a nung thotho lai. Sikhalsehla Pathian ṭihzahtu pawl hrangah cun amah an ṭihzah ruangah a netnak ahcun thil a ṭha ṭheh ko ding, tiah ka thei."},"13":{"text":"Asinain miṭha lo pawl hrangah cun cuvekin a ṭha lo ding; an nun khal a sau lo ding; an nunnak cu phenthla vek lawng a si, Pathian an ṭihzah lo ruangah."},"14":{"text":"Leilung tlunah thulolak thil pakhat a um! Miding in midinglo ih tuar ding kha a tuar ih midinglo in miding ih ngah ding kha a ngah mi hi a si. Hi khal hi zianghman sullam neilo mi a si."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah nomnak hi thil ṭha a si ka ti, ziangahtile leilung tlun minung hrangah ei le in le lungawi hnakih a ṭha deuh mi zianghman a um lo. Vanrang thuai, Pathian pekmi tikcu tawite a neih sungah hin cumi cu a hnaṭuan harsa lakah a lung nuam tertu laksawng a si."},"16":{"text":"Fimnak nei dingah le leilung tlunih thil an tuah mi hmuahhmuah hi a tican thei dingah ka thinlung ka hmangih it loin a sun a zan in ka ruat."},"17":{"text":"Ziang hmuahhmuah hi Pathian ih thu in an cangṭheh a si; milai in leilung tlunih thil a cangmi pawl hi zianghman a thei theilo ding; ziangtlukin a zuam ih a taimak khalle a theisuak cuanglo ding. Mifim in ka thei a si, a ti hmanah a thei cuanglo ding."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thil hmuahhmuah hi napi-in ka ruatih miding le mifim le an thil tuah mi hmuahhmuah cu Pathian ih kut sungah a um a si. Duhdawtnak le huatnak an neih mi khal a kut sungah a um. Ka hmailam ah ziang a um ti zohman in an thei lo."},"2":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah tlunah khawlairel bangrep in a thleng. Miding siseh, misual siseh, miṭha siseh miṭha lo siseh, mithiang siseh mithianglo siseh, thawinak a petu siseh thawinak a pe lotu siseh, an ton mi a bangrep ṭheh a si. Miṭha cu misual hnakin a miat cuanglo. Thukam tu cu thukam lotu hnakin a miat cuanglo."},"3":{"text":"Cumi cu khuaza vanrang hnuai ih thil ṭha lobik a si. Mi hmuahhmuah hrangah khawlairel bangrep a thleng. Minung thinlung cu an nun sungah aatnak le ṭhatlonak in a khat. Cui hnuah mithi pawl hnenah an feh a si."},"4":{"text":"Asinain minung hnenih siarcih mi pawl hrangah cun ruahsannak a um lai, ziangahtile a thi mi kiosa hnak cun a nung mi uico a ṭha sawn."},"5":{"text":"A nungmi pawl cun thi leh ding, ti tal an thei; a sinan a thi cia pawl cun zianghman an thei nawn lo. An hrangah laksawng a um nawn lo; pum hngilh ih hngilh an si."},"6":{"text":"An mi duhdawtnak, an mi huatnak le an tumtahnak pawl cu an thihpi ṭheh zo a si. Leilung tlunih hnaṭuannak sungah tel theinak zianghman an nei nawn lo."},"7":{"text":"Va feh awla na rawl cu thin nuamzet in ei aw, na sabitti cu lungawizet in in aw! Pathian in na tuah mi cu a lo lungkimpi zo a si."},"8":{"text":"Na hnipuan kha vaar ter ringring awla na lu khal hriak thih ringring aw."},"9":{"text":"Vanhnuai ih tikcu tawite Pathian in nunnak a lo pek mi sungah hin na duh mi na nupi thawn nuamzet in um uh, ziangahtile leilung tlun na nun sungah hin cumi cu na hnaṭuan man laksawng a si."},"10":{"text":"Na ton mi hnaṭuan hmuahhmuah cu na thazaang neih mi hmuahhmuah in tuah aw; ziangahtile na thlennak ding Sheol ahcun hnaṭuannak siseh, ruahnak siseh, theihnak siseh, fimnak siseh zianghman a um nawn lo."},"11":{"text":"Ni hnuai ahhin thildang pakhat ka hmu lala: tlan zuamnak ah micak bik in a neh cuanglo, raldonak ah ralṭhabik in a neh cuanglo. Mifim lawngin rawl a ngah cuanglo, mi fimthiam lawng milian an si cuanglo, thilthiam hnen lawngah hlawhtlinnak a um cuanglo; a tikcu a kim tikah cun vansiatnak in an zate in a man a si."},"12":{"text":"Milai in a tikcu caan a thei dah lo. Nga cu sur in an kaih vek le vate cu thang in an awk vekin milai khal cu rinlopi ah siatsuahnak an parah a thleng a si."},"13":{"text":"Ni hnuai ah fimnak tahṭhim tlak pakhat ka hmu ih cucu a thupizet tiah ka ruat.","title":"Fimnak Le Aatnak Parih Ruahnak"},"14":{"text":"Khua pakhat a um ih khuasung mi cu an malte; siangpahrang a cakzet mi in a do ih a kulh ṭheh tlunah cuih khua a lak theinak ding napi in a zuam."},"15":{"text":"Cui khawsung ah mifarah a sinan mifimzet pakhat a um; cupa lawngin a fimnak thawn cuih khua cu a humsuak thei ding naón zohman in cupa cu an ciing lo."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah, “Fimnak cu cahnak hnakin a ṭha sawn,” ka ti. Asinain mifarah pa ih fimnak cu zianghman ah an siarlo ih a ṭongkam cu zohman in an ngai duh lo."},"17":{"text":"Mi aa pawl an tonkhawmnak hmun ah an hotu pa a au reronak aw ngai hnak in mifim ṭongkam neem ngai a ṭha sawn."},"18":{"text":"Fimnak cu ral hriamnam hnakin a ṭha sawn ih misual pakhat in thilṭha tampi a siatsuah thei."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thothe thi in rimhmui rim a siat ter; Malte aatnak in fimnak tumbik a phiat thei."},"2":{"text":"Mifim ruahnak cu vorhlam ah a feh, Mi aa ruahnak cu kehlam ah a peeng."},"3":{"text":"Lamzin a feh lai hmanah ruahnak a nei lo, Mikip hnenah a aatnak a phuang vivo."},"4":{"text":"Bawi pakhat na parih a thin a heng tikah, Na hnaṭuan in suak hlah. Tangdornak in palhnak tampi a damter."},"5":{"text":"Ni hnuai ah thil ṭha lo ka hmuh mi a um, Uktu amai palhnak ruangah a si;"},"6":{"text":"Mi aa pawl in upa hnaṭuan an ṭuan ih, Milian pawl cu hmun nauta an co."},"7":{"text":"Sal pawl cu rang parah an to ih, Bawi pawl sal bangin an ke ih an feh ka hmu."},"8":{"text":"Khur a laitu cu a sungah amah a tla ding, Phar a bal tu cu rul in a cuk ding."},"9":{"text":"Lungto a laitu cu hliamnak a tong ding. Thing hau tu hrangah ṭihnungza a um."},"10":{"text":"Hreitlung a bil zetih a taat ta lo a si ahcun, Thazaang tampi a hman a ṭul; Fimnak nei sehla a hlawh a tling deuh ding."},"11":{"text":"Dawi aat hlanah rul in mi a cuk ahcun, Rul dawithiamtu um cu ziangso a ṭhahnem?"},"12":{"text":"Mifim cu a ṭongkam in zaangfah a hlawh, Mi aa cu amai hmurka in a siatsuah."},"13":{"text":"Thuphan pipi a kaa sungin a suak ih A ṭong netnak cu aatnak pittawp a si."},"14":{"text":"Mi aa cu a ṭong a tam; A sim dingmi thu khal zohman in an thei lo. Amaió hnu ah ziang a cang ding ti sim theih a si lo."},"15":{"text":"Mi aa cun thi hrulh in hna a ṭuan, Khawpi fehnak lamzin hman a thei lo."},"16":{"text":"Ram uktu siangpahrang mi note a si ih, An hotu pawl zan vaar puai an tuah; Cui ram cu hmailam ruahsan ding a neilo."},"17":{"text":"Asinain ram siangpahrang miphun u a si ih, Mi pacang thu relthiam a si ih tlunah, Ram sung hotu pawl caan hmantein tirawl an ei ih, Supnak nei in zu khal an rit lonak ram cu, Mi vannei ram an si."},"18":{"text":"Daithlan ruangah innbo a cim, Zaangzel ruangah inn a zun."},"19":{"text":"Rawl cu mi hnih tertu a si, sabit cu mi lungawiter tu a si, Asinain tangka lo cun ziang hman ti thei a si lo."},"20":{"text":"A thupte hman in siangpahrang va cam hlah. Na ihnak khaan hmanah milian va rel sia hlah, Ziangahtile thli lak vate in na aw cu a zampi dingih Thla nei in na ṭong cu an va sim ding."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na tangka sumtuahnak ah hmang aw, Nikhat khat a miat na ngah ding.","title":"Mifim Ih Tuah Mi"},"2":{"text":"Na neih mi ṭhen sarih a si lole ṭhen riatah ṭhen aw, Leilung tlunah ziang thil ṭha lo a thleng ding ti na thei lo."},"3":{"text":"Khawdur in ruah a phurh ahcun leilung parah a burh ding, Thingkung cu thlanglam ah siseh saklam ah siseh a tluk tikah, A tluknak hmun poh ah a taang a si."},"4":{"text":"Thli lawng a zohtu cun thlaici a tuh dah lo, Khawdur lawng a thlirtu cun rawl a la dah lo."},"5":{"text":"Nunau in a pum sungih a vun mi naute, Ziangtin nunnak hram a thok ti na theih theilo vekin; Ziangtinkim ti theitu Pathian ih Hnaṭuannak cu na thei thei lo."},"6":{"text":"Zinglam ah thlaici tuh aw, zanlam tiang cawl hlah; Khui mi a kho ṭha ding ti na thei lo; An pahnih in an ṭha ding maw ti khal na thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Khawvaang hi a ṭha, Nitleu hmuh khal hi a nuam."},"8":{"text":"Mi pakhat kum reipi a nung asile A tlaitluan in mi lungawi siseh. Asinain a thi dingih a hrangih khawthim cu, A sau zet ding tiah ciing aw. Hmailam hrang beisei ding a um lo."},"9":{"text":"Maw mino, na no laiah hin lungawi in um aw; Na no lai caan hi hmang ṭha aw. Na thinlung duhnak le, Na mit ih a lo hruainak ah thlun aw. Asinain hi thil hmuahhmuah ruangah hin Pathian in na thu a lo ṭhen ding, ti kha thei aw.","title":"Mino Hrang Nunsimnak"},"10":{"text":"Na thinlung ih thinharnak hlon aw; Na taksa ih harnak khal hlon aw; Ziangahtile reipi na no nawn lo ding."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na nolai ah a lo Seemsuahtu thei aw, Harsatnak in a lo man hlan le, Kum le tikcu a ra her ih, “Thin nomnak zianghman ka nei nawn lo,” na ti hlanah hin."},"2":{"text":"Ni le thlapi le arsi an thim hlan le, Khawdur in ruah hlir a rak ken hlanah hin."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah himnak a lo pe ṭheu tu na baan kha an ṭhia pei ih a cak mi na ke tla an ṭawnṭai ding. Na rawl khainak dingah na ha a maltuk dingih na mit a malh ding ruangah fiangtein khua na hmu thei nawn lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Na hna a set dingih lamzin ih thawmvang khal na thei lo ding. Fangrial thawm le awn-mawi an tum mi khal na thei thei ceu ding; a sinan vate ai hman in na ihthatnak ihsin an lo ṭhangter thei ding a si."},"5":{"text":"Hmunso kha na ṭih dingih suah va vak kha na hrangah ṭihnung a si ding. Na ṭuak a par dingih na feh tikah na ṭhawn thei ceu dingih hiarnak na rak neih mi hmuahhmuah an hlo ding. Kannih cu kumkhua kan umnak ding inn ah kan feh dingih khuasung lamzin ah ṭahnak aw thawm a um ding."},"6":{"text":"Ngun cikcin kha a cat dingih sui mei-inn a tlu dingih a kuai ding. Tikhur ih hri kha a cat dingih ti thannak beel a kuai ṭheh ding."},"7":{"text":"Kan ruangpi cu leivut ah a kir sal dingih kan thlarau cu in petu Pathian hnenah a kir sal ding."},"8":{"text":"Thulolak, thulolak, ziang hmuahhmuah thulolak an si, tiah Thusimtu in a ti."},"9":{"text":"Thusimtu cun a fimnak thawn a theih mi cu mipi hnenah a zirh vivo. Ṭongṭhimnak a phunphun a theih mi kha a zingzoi ih a fiangter vivo."},"10":{"text":"Thu kha mi ngai nuam zawng in a sim ih, a ngan mi thu cu thudik a si."},"11":{"text":"Mifim pawl ih ṭongkam cu tuukhal pa in tuu khalhnak ih a hman mi fungzum vek a si. Thufim khawlkhawm mi cu hngetzet ih khen mi tlawngkhen vekin a hmun ringring. Kan zate ih tuukhal a si mi Pathian in in pek mi an si."},"12":{"text":"Ka fapa, ralring ṭul mi a um lai: Cabu ngan rero hi cem ni a neilo, ca zoh ringring khal hi taksa in a tuar lo."},"13":{"text":"Hi thu hmuahhmuah ih tlunah sim ding pakhat lawng a um. Pathian ṭihzah awla a daan thlun aw. Pathian in milai a tuah sannak cu himi hrangah a si."},"14":{"text":"Pathian cun ziang hmuahhmuah kan tuah mi parah thu a ṭhen ding; a ṭha siseh, a sia siseh, a thupte ih kan tuah mi par tiangin thu a ṭhen ding a si."}}}}},"22":{"info":{"name":"Solomon Hla","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Solomon hla (the songs of solomon)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hla lakih hla ṭha bik, Solomon ih mi hlamawi pawl."},"2":{"text":"Na hmur in i hnam aw, I ngainak cu sabitti hnakin a thlum sawn.","title":"Hla Fingkhatnak Nunau"},"3":{"text":"Nang cu a hmui in na hmui, Zihmui bangin na hmin a thang. Nunau zokhal nang ngai loin um thei hlah hai."},"4":{"text":"I hruai awla kan tlanhlo ding; Ka bawipa si awla na umnak khaan ah i fehpi aw. Hmunkhatah nuam tlang uhsi; Diriam in kan duh awknak thuk sungah kan ciah aw ding. Nunau hmuahhmuah in an lo ngai hi an mawh lo."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem leengrual tla, Dum hman ningna mi mawi ka si; Kedar deuthlam bang ka dum naón, Solomon inn puanzar iang in ka mawi."},"6":{"text":"Ka dum ruangah i iai hlah uh, Ni ih i eet ruangah hin; Ka ṭa le pawl ka parah an thinheng in, Sabit dum ah hna in ṭuanter; Zutmetawknak caan hman nei loin."},"7":{"text":"I sim hnik law, nang ka ngai aw; Khuiah simaw na tuurual na khalh? Khuiah simaw an colh ding sun ni ling ah? Ziangah so tuukhal dang pawl ih tuurual lakah, Ka lo hawl rero ding?"},"8":{"text":"Nunau lakih duh thla leeng bik, Nang in a hmun na thei lo maw? Feh awla tuurual pawl thlun aw; Tuukhal pawl ih thlamte kiangah Na me hrangah tlimno hawl aw.","title":"Mipa"},"9":{"text":"Ka ngai bikmi nang cun, Rang nu pakhat in Faro rangleng hnuktu rangcang tampi lung a thawhter bangin, Valrual thinlung na thawhter hai."},"10":{"text":"Mawi tuk aw khua na sawm ai sam na biang tlunah, Man sung lung bang na hngawng tlunah tlai sialso te in."},"11":{"text":"Hmanseh na hrang ṭaang orh sui ṭhi tuah uhsi, Ngun khuut hlawn thil thawn."},"12":{"text":"Tintling tlunah, zau maw ka bawi, Ka zihmui rimthaw in a zeel.","title":"Nunau"},"13":{"text":"Ka lungduh cu mura rimthaw bang hmui, Ka siang ṭaang cung par a zau ah."},"14":{"text":"Ka lungduh valpa cu ram pangpar iang, An sim Engedi sabit hmuan parmawi khi bang."},"15":{"text":"Mawi sersi ee, ka duh bik cu, Duhnunnak na mit ah ni bang tle.","title":"Mipa"},"16":{"text":"Ka lungduh cem, valno lakah na piang hlei ce! Nuam cuang hlei in lung i ngamter, Zaunak tintling, hramhring hmang in.","title":"Nunau"},"17":{"text":"Kan inn kaan ah sidar thing, A siling ah farthing si ngai."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei cu Sharon ramlak in pangpar le Tlangrawn ṭe lili par vek ka si men."},"2":{"text":"Hlingbur lak ih lili par bang, Lung ka duh nu a leenghawi lakah si ve ngai.","title":"Mipa"},"3":{"text":"Lung ka duh valpa cu a val hawi lakah, Tuthing lak um epal kung bang a cuang; A phenthlam hnuai ah to ningna, A rah ka hrangah a thlum hlei ce.","title":"Nunau"},"4":{"text":"A puai khaanpi sung i hruai lut, Duhnak puanzar ka tlun a zaar."},"5":{"text":"Sabit caar in ka tha tlungter, Epal rah in ka zaang damter; Zuun ngaih vangah, ka uai hninghniang."},"6":{"text":"Kehlam kut in i ṭaangkham ih, A vorhlam kut in kei i pom."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem leengrual le tla, Kan duhawknak kharhmar lo dingin, Zuanzaang tlancak zukneng zaatum, hminsaal in kei thu in kam uh."},"8":{"text":"Ka duh valpa ih aanka thei ing, Ra tlan vervo thlua tlang cungin, Tlangsang kaan in ka hnenah zuang.","title":"Hla Finghnihnak Nunau"},"9":{"text":"Ka tum val zaatum no bang, No thianthite zukneng a iang; Cunah dir maw pharson kiangah, Tukvirh ongin i rak cuan maw, Ral vanphar tal in tin a bih."},"10":{"text":"Aanka i hlan lung ka duh cun, Duh hniang, ra aw, Lung ka duh cem rata hram aw.","title":"Mipa"},"11":{"text":"Thlatang khawdai a cem zo ih, Vanrial ruahpi a kang ve zo."},"12":{"text":"Hramlak ah pangpar an par zo. Hlasak caan cu tu hi a si; Thuro hlasak ram sung a thang."},"13":{"text":"Theipi rah tla cu an hmin thlang, Zilthli lakah hmui verver in, Sabit par rimhmui a zeel aw. Duh hniang, ra aw, Lung ka duh cem rata hram aw."},"14":{"text":"Lungpi kua sungih a relhmi Kaiva thuro bangtuk na si. Iang nei na mithmai zoh ka duh Na aw thlumte tla theih ka duh."},"15":{"text":"Cinghnia pawl kha kaita hai uh, A cuih cinghnia fano tla kha; Sabit hmuan parmawite an siatsuah ta hlanah."},"16":{"text":"I duhtu ih ta cu ka si, Anih khal ka ta a si ve. A tuurual cu lili par lakah a kil,","title":"Nunau"},"17":{"text":"Zinglam thlizil nem a hrang ih Zinglam khawfing a cah tiangin, Ra kir thlang aw, ka duh bikmi, Bether tlang ih zukneng le zaathar tla bangin."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zansiar ka tintling ah zau ing, Ka duh nang hi zanmang lawng ah maw ka lo man; Hawl len hmanning ka tong thiam lo.","title":"Nunau"},"2":{"text":"Khawpi kot-thler zalam tawi in, Zinpi, zinṭeek khalah ka zoh; Lung ka duh val lawng cu ka hawl, Hmanseh ka tong thei ve si lo!"},"3":{"text":"Khawsuah hau-hnar kiltuón in hmu, “Ka duh valpa nan hmu maw?” tiin ka sut."},"4":{"text":"Anmah ka lan vete in ka tong; Thlah thiam nawn loin kutin ka kai; Ka suahsemnak ka nuih innsung thlenpi hlan cu."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem leengrual le tla, Kan duhawknak kharhmar lo dingin, Zuanzaang tlan cak zukneng, zaathar hminsaal in, kei thu in kam uh."},"6":{"text":"Nelrawn ihsin meikhu zing bang, Sumsaw hawltu pawl ih zuarmi, Zihmui le mura rimthaw thawn, A rami hi ziangso a si?","title":"Hla Fingthumnak Nunau"},"7":{"text":"Solomon a ra luailo lai, A bawi tokheng parah an phur; Israel ralkap sungih ṭha bik, Ralkap sawmruk tla in an kil."},"8":{"text":"An zatein ralnam hmang thiam, Raldo ṭhangtu thiam pawl si hai. Ralnam cio kha an hmanter ih, Zan ih ral ruk do thei dingah."},"9":{"text":"Thing ṭha bikih tuahmi a bawi tokheng parah, Solomon siangpahrang bawi an phur."},"10":{"text":"Bawi tokheng ke ngun in an khuut, Sui pianzia puan in an tuam, Coihcinmawi suipuan mawi cun; A todan nem sendup puanih tuammi, Duhnungza in Jerusalem nuih tahmi a si."},"11":{"text":"Ra suak cio uh Zion nunau, Siangpahrang Solomon ra zoh uh; A sui lukhuh a lu tlunah a khum, A nupi ṭhit a lungawi le thinnom ni ih A nu ih khumter mi cu a si."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mawi sersi ee, ka duh bik cu, Na lu tuamnak puanmawi phen ih Duhnak khat mi na mit sersi, Gilead tlang in merual tlan bang Na samthlai rem zam sialso hai.","title":"Mipa"},"2":{"text":"Meh le kholhfai mi tuuhmul bang Na ha tianrem vaarte in an fai; A beuh um lo rem thliahthli hai."},"3":{"text":"Patsen hlaar bang na hmur a mawi, Na ṭong mawite khawh a theih lo; Na lukhuhnak puan naal phen in, Na biang note a lang cemci."},"4":{"text":"Na hngawng, David lungdawl sang bang, Ngil ih a hluum zetmi a bang; Ralphaw thawngkhat baannak bangtuk, Hlawnthil ṭhirual erhnak a si."},"5":{"text":"Na siangṭaang ih pawhte tla cu, Lili pangpar mawi bik lakih, Zukneng faphir pawhfawp an bang."},"6":{"text":"Mura zihmui tlang cung parah, Cuih rimhmui tlang ah ka um ding; Zinglam thlizil a hran tik le, Khawfing a cah tiang ka um ding."},"7":{"text":"Ka duh bikmi na mawizia hi! Soi ding um loin na mawi hleice!"},"8":{"text":"Lebanon tlang in i thlun aw, ka ham cia mi; Lebanon ihsin rung hram aw; Kiosa le tlavang pawl an umnak Amana Tlang, Senir tlang le Hermon tlang ihsin rung ṭum aw."},"9":{"text":"Zohkhop thei lo ka thainu ding, Na ṭaang cung ṭhi erh mi tla in, Ka lung thinril hmuah in a lak."},"10":{"text":"I duhnak in ka lung ngamter, Ka lunghnemtu le ka ham cia; I hnamnak cu sabit hnakin a thlum sawn; Na zihmui cu ziangdang hnakin a rim a hmui sawn."},"11":{"text":"Ka duh bikmi, Na hmur khuaitizu bang in a thlum; Na ṭong ka hrang hnawi le khuaitizu bang an si. Na thilthuam cu Lebanon rimhmui bang a hmui."},"12":{"text":"Ka thinhnemtu, ka ham ciami, A thup lakih hmuan vek a si; Kulh mi hmuan le maih bul cerhti;"},"13":{"text":"A cu tawkah hanghnah ziangkim mawite in an cerh; Hmangthaw rahnak taleti hmuan bangin an ciing; Hmangṭha bik in a rah a suak."},"14":{"text":"Henna le nard, saffron le, Kalamus le sinamon pawl, Rimhmui phunphun an kim a si. Mura le aloi tla an um, Rimhmui bik phun tiangin an kim."},"15":{"text":"Cerhti put le tiva luang in Cuih hmuan cu an hningter ringring; Lebanon tlang ihsin rung luang, Tiva pawl in ciarter ringring."},"16":{"text":"Maw saklam thli, nang ṭhang thlang aw; Maw thlanglam thli, ka hmuan hran aw; A sungah rimhmui khatter aw; Lung ka duh val a hmuan pan seh, A hmang thlum bikmi rah ei seh.","title":"Nunau"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hmuanduum sungah ka ra zo, Ka lung duh le ka ham cia mi! Ka mura le rimhmui ka khawm; Ka khuaitizu thlar thawn ka ei, Ka sabitti le cawhnawi ka in. Ei uh, in uh, duhdawtmi tla, Duh-awknak nan rit hlan tiangin.","title":"Nunau Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Ka vung zau ah me rem thiam lo, Zan ka mangah ka duhdawt mi in ruuninn king ngai. Ra lut ning law, ka duh bikmi, Ka thuro le ka thinhnemtu, Ka lu daitla in a ciarter, Ka sam cu mero cumci in a hnawng ṭheh zo.","title":"Mipa"},"3":{"text":"Ka hnipuan pawl ka hlit ṭheh zo, Ziangah ka hruk sal duh nawn ding? Ka ke tla ka kholhfai ṭheh zo, Ziangah ka baalter sal duh ding?","title":"Nunau"},"4":{"text":"Lung ka duh cun sangka run tham, A rat thei ing, um rem thiam hlang."},"5":{"text":"A luh ding lai caang in cuan ing, Ka kut zaṭial mura zihmui culhta ing khaw, Ka kut zung mura zihmui ti ka riimter, Ruuninn on lainak ah sangka cu rak pawk ing."},"6":{"text":"Ka lungduh hrang innkhar ka ong, Hmanseh valpa a liamhlo zo; Ziangbang a aw theih nuam ing maw? Khua ka cuanah a um nawn lo. Ko hman ningna a thei si lo."},"7":{"text":"Khawpi kilvengtu in kei in hmu, An duh tawk in in vuak in hliam, Ralhruang kiltu pawl in ka lukhuh an thlek."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem leengnu rual tla, Lung ka duh val nan ton ahcun, Zuun rim ngai in par bang uai ee, ti in biathli hei than hram uh."},"9":{"text":"Lengdang lakah mawi cuang hlei nu, Lung na tum val, midang lakah cuangce hmen maw? Ziang bang sunglawi mi piang a si? Thutiam kan lo peknak dingah.","title":"Nunau pawl"},"10":{"text":"Mawi in cak ee, ka valpa cu, Thawnghra lakah a piang hleice.","title":"Nunau"},"11":{"text":"A hmai daarti lon bang a ngil, A sam kir deuh nawnten a um. Tlang ak vek in a dum zenzi."},"12":{"text":"Tiva kiangih thuro bangin a mit a mawi, Tivakap ding hnawiti kholhfai thuro bangin."},"13":{"text":"A biang cu pangpar le rimhmui in a khat mi, Hmuanduum bang duhnungte a si. A hmur lili pangpar a bang, Mura zihmui ti in a ciar."},"14":{"text":"A kut an mawi soi ding um lo, Lung mankhung bik zunghruk a hruk; Lungsen mankhung ben mi saiho, bangin a taksa ngil zenzi."},"15":{"text":"Sui kheng sungih lungvar mankhung, Ret mi bangin a cawn a vaar. Ka valpa cu patling hleice, Sidar thingsaang dinnak Lebanon tlang khi hei hluan."},"16":{"text":"A hmur thlum cu hnam ding a nuam, A thu tinkim ka ruat tikah ka zaang i zuun. Ka ngai mi cu cuvek a si, Jerusalem khua nunau pawl."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nunau lakih mimawi hleice, Na ngai mi cu khui ah a feh? Kan lo hawlpi theinak dingah, A fehnak lam in sim hnik.","title":"Nunau pawl"},"2":{"text":"Lung ka duh val a hmuan ah kal, Balsam zihmui thing tla a ciinnak ah. Lili pangpar tla khawm phah in, A hmuan sungah tuurual a kil.","title":"Nunau"},"3":{"text":"Lung ka duh bik, ka ta a si, Kei khal a ta ka si, Lili pangpar lakah a tuurual tla a khal."},"4":{"text":"Lungtak ka duh, Jerusalem khua bang na mawi, An sim Tirzah khawpi bangin duh na nung ce; Hi khua pawl bang na mawinak in, Lungmolh thawthawt lo tiang i tuah.","title":"Hla Fingnganak Mipa"},"5":{"text":"Na mit a dang zoh thlang hram aw, Caang thiam lo in i kaih taang tak. Gilead tlang in merual tlan bang, Na sam thlairem zam sialso hai."},"6":{"text":"Meh le kholhfai mi tuuhmul bangin, Na ha tianrem vaarte in an fai; A beuh um lon rem thliahthli hai."},"7":{"text":"Na lu khuhnak puan naal phen in, Na biang note a lang cemci."},"8":{"text":"A duh ahcun siangpahrang in, Nupi sawmruk, nusuun sawmriat va nei ko seh. Lengdawh note siar cawk lo in neita ko seh."},"9":{"text":"Hmanseh kei cun pakhat lawngte duh in ngai ing, Cu nute cu thuro bang duhnung a si. A nuih fa neih hman ih neihsun, A duh hleimi fanu a si. A zohtu hmuah nunau tla in an fak cio thluh; Siangpahrang nupi, nungai, nusun, hman in amah faknak hla an sak cio a si."},"10":{"text":"Zing khawtleu bang mit-men mawite zo a si ta? A mawi sersi, a pan veuvi; Ni le thla iang in a tle mawi."},"11":{"text":"Ṭhuangkung lakah ka ra thleng zo, Phaivun rawn ih zanthing note, Sabit parih hnah no cerh le, Taleti par ra zoh dingah."},"12":{"text":"Raldo dingih rangleng mawngtu, Daite ih a um thei lo bangin, Ngai awknak in i thirter thluh."},"13":{"text":"Lam aw, lam aw, Shulam leengdawh; Na lam lai cu kan lo zoh ding. I zohtu pawl tlar le tlar lakih ka lam hi, Ziangruangah maw a zoh nan duh?","title":"Nunau"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A cungsin ce leengnu na si, Vai tuah kedam hruk nang na mawi; Na cawn mawi ee, vaimi thiam thil zung suakte bang.","title":"Mipa"},"2":{"text":"Rimhmui catlo a umnak sabit kheng, Cuih khengte bang na lai mawi ee; Lili pangpar mawite ih kulh mi, Sangvut teel hluum bang in na pum mawi ee."},"3":{"text":"Na siangṭaang ih pawhte tla cu, Zukneng faphirte vek an si."},"4":{"text":"Saiho innsang a bang na hngawng, Heshbon khawpi kotka kiangih, Tili bangtuk na mit a si; Damaskas khawpi ral an vennak, Lebanon ram ralven innsang, Bang mi duhnung hnar mawi na nei."},"5":{"text":"Karmel tlang bang na lu sangah a khai deudi, Na sam phiar mi pat femte naal bangin a tle; A mawinak in siangpahrang lungthin a kai thei."},"6":{"text":"Na cuan a mawi, na hmel a ṭha, Zalung hneem thiamtu na duhnak."},"7":{"text":"Zoh mawi tuumkung bang iang na nei, Na siangṭaang ah tumrah bor bang pawhte a um."},"8":{"text":"Tuumkung parah kai in a rah cu lo hnik lang, Ka hrangah cun na pawhte cu, sabit rah bawrte vek a si. Na thawthawt epal rimthaw bang."},"9":{"text":"Na kaa rim cu sabitti thlum bik khi a bang, sabitti luang detdo seh, lung ka duh hnen ah, A hmur a ha tiangin lon seh."},"10":{"text":"Kei cu in ngaitu ih ta ka si, A hiar mi cu kei ka si.","title":"Nunau"},"11":{"text":"Duhte ra aw, ramdai thiangah va leeng tlang in, Lai lungrawn khua ah caam uhsi."},"12":{"text":"Zingthlapit in tho in sabit kung zoh uhsi; Cerh thlang in par thlang hai maw ti khi va zoh in, Taleti par thlang hai maw tin, A cuih hmuan ah lungsung duh bia thu lo ruah lang."},"13":{"text":"Leeng-ai rah par rimhmui na hnim thei ding, Kan sangka kiangah thing rah tinkim an um ding; Lung ka duh aw, nomnak hlun le nomnak thar tla, Na hrang siseh ti in ka ret."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sunghno ka nuih hnawiti cawm mi rak si ve in, Ka suahseempi ka ṭa sita la maw ka ti; An sial zatlanglam ih ka lo ton caang zongah, Hnam ning ka ti an phai relsiat hman phang lo leen."},"2":{"text":"Lawipi ning law sunghno ka nuih ruuninn hnuai ah, Lungsak te leen dawtnak i sim thiam ding ka ti; Sabitti le taleti sawrmi rimthaw cu, Siah ta hnik ning na hrang haalriam na in dingah."},"3":{"text":"Na keh lam in i ṭaangkham ih, Na vorhlam kut in kei i pom."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem leengrual le tla, Kan duh awknak kharhmar lo ding thu in kam uh."},"5":{"text":"Husihmen maw thlaler ramṭhing lakin a ra, Lung a duh valpa thawn zaṭial tlai aw phah leen. Na suahsemnak lungrawn khawte, Epal thinghnuai ah lo ṭhang ing.","title":"Nunau"},"6":{"text":"Keimah siarlo leeng dang ngai hlah, Keimah siar lo na ṭaang cungah pom duh aw hlah; Zuunrim ngaih cu thih ṭian bang leen a fak ruangmang, Lungfah hi ee thih ṭian bang leen zaang mi zuun ngai; Meisa alh bang a hliau in hliau, Meisa kaang bang a alh in alh."},"7":{"text":"Mit thei hlah ee dairial ti in, Ruun tilian in fen thei hlah ngai; Zokhal a lennak in duhnak lei tumtu cu, Nautatnak lawng a co sawn ding."},"8":{"text":"Tleirawl leengno farnu kan nei, A pawhte cu a bomh pekte; Valno in a leen tikah khin, A hrangah ziang kan tuah sak ding?","title":"A ṭa le pawl"},"9":{"text":"Seempi farnu kulh hauhruang phar va si sehla, Kan siamsak lai ngun lung dawl saang, Ruuninn kotṭial va si sehla, Sidar thing in kan kulh ih tur."},"10":{"text":"Khawkulh hauhruang phar cu ka si, Ka pawhte lungdawl saang an si. Amah thawn um ka nomzia le ka hnangam hi, Duhhniang a man, a thei a si.","title":"Nunau"},"11":{"text":"Baal Hamon an timi hmun ah, Ka Solomon in sabit hmuan a nei; Lo nga pek in a lo an thlo, Mi pakhat in a nga sum thawngkhat an pe.","title":"Mipa"},"12":{"text":"Maw Solomon, ngun thawngkhat cu na ta a si, Lo thlo pawl ih covo cu zahnih a si. Keimah bul in sabit hmuan ka nei."},"13":{"text":"Ka dawt sunghno na aanka cu, Ka hmuan sungin i rak hlaan aw, ka lungduh; Hawidawt ṭhianrual mi tlan na aw an ngai duh hai."},"14":{"text":"Ram sazuk bang ka hnen ra law, Maw ka dawt aw; Tlangthing kuai par hmui lak a ceel zukneng no bang.","title":"Nunau"}}}}},"23":{"info":{"name":"Isaiah","shortname":"Isai","abbr":[],"desc":"Isaiah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amoz fapa Isaiah in, Judah siangpahrang Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz le Hezekiah pawl san ah, Judah le Jerusalem hrangih Pathian ṭongkam a theih mi cu hiti in a si."},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw lei le van, ka ṭongmi hi thei uh. Ka cawm mi ka faate pawl in in dodal a si.","title":"Pathian In A Minung Pawl Nun A Sim"},"3":{"text":"Caw in a neitu an thei; laak khalin an bawipa ih rawl peknak kuang an thei. Asinain ka minung Israel cun cutluk hman an thei lo. Zianghman an thei bembem lo a si,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Maw Israel, nannih misual, mimawh, thilṭha lo lawnglawng a tuah ih nawhthuh a ei mi minung pawl, nan cemthla a si. Nan sualnak in a lo dirhthlak a si. Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian thianghlim cu nan dungtun a si."},"5":{"text":"Ziangruangah ral nan tho ringring? Nasa sinsin ih hrem nan duh maw si? Maw Israel, na lu cu hma in a khatih na thin le na lung cu natnak a tuar."},"6":{"text":"Na kezim ihsin na luthlung tiang a dam mi khui hmanah a um lo. A pem mi le a dup mi le a bauh mi hlir in a khat a si. Na hma pawl cu kholhfai mi a si lo, tuam mi khal a si lo. Sii hnih mi khal a si lo."},"7":{"text":"Nan ram cu siatsuah ṭheh a si ih a ṭhing reprep; nan khua pawl cu meisa in a kaangṭheh zo. Nan mithmuh rori ah miphundang pawl in nan ram cu an lakih an siatsuah ṭheh a si."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem khua lawnglawng a taang ih anih khal cu ral ih kulh ṭheh mi khawpi a si; sabit hmuan ih hmuan kiltu deu le fanghma hmuan ih sak mi thlam vekin bawmtu le ṭantu neilo khawpi a si."},"9":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in mi hrekkhat pawl zuah hlah sehla, Sodom le Gomorrah khua vekin a hloral ta mi khawpi a si zo ding."},"10":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, na minung le na uktu pawl cu Sodom le Gomorrah minung le uktu bangtuk an si. Na hnenih Bawipa ṭongkam hi ngai ṭha hnik. Kan Pathian ih a lo zirh mi hi ruat ṭha hnik."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “In pek ringring mi thawinak pawl hi ka duhzet ah maw nan ruat? Thawinak ih nan ur mi tuu pawl le nan ṭilva thau zetzet pawl hi ka khop zo. Nan caw, nan tuu le nan me thisen pawl hi ka ningtuk zo!"},"12":{"text":"In biak tikah hipawl rak keng dingah zoso a lo fial? Ka Biakinn sung ra hnaihnok tu dingah zoso a lo sawm?"},"13":{"text":"Nan thil pek mi pawl hi zianghman ah a ṭhahnem lo. Rimhmui nan pek mi pawl hi ka fih a si. Nan Thla Thar Puai pawl, nan Sabbath pawl le nan pumkhawmnak pawl hi ka tuar thei nawn lo. Nan sualnak in a siatsuah ṭheh zo a si."},"14":{"text":"Nan Thla Thar Puai le nan ulh mi nan puai pawl hi ka hua. Ka hrangah thilrit an si ih ka tuar thei nawn lo a si!"},"15":{"text":"Baan pharh in thla nan cam hman ah ka lo zoh lo ding. Ziangtluk tam ih nan cam khalle ka lo ngaisak lo ding; ziangahtile nan kut cu thisen in a khat a si."},"16":{"text":"Thiangfai in kholh aw uh; ka mithmuh ih nan tuah rero mi thilsual pawl hi tuah nawn hlah uh. A si, thilṭha lo tuah cu baang thlang uh;"},"17":{"text":"Thilṭha tuah zir uh. A dikmi hawl uhla, hremnak a tuartu pawl bawm uh. Nu le pa neilo ngakṭah pawl bawm uhla nuhmei pawl ṭan uh!"},"18":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ra uhla kan ruat tlang hnik pei. Nan sualnak cu sen-eu bangin sen hmansehla, vur bangin ka lo thiangfai ter ding; sendup bangin dup hmansehla tuuhmul bangin ka lo vaar ter ding."},"19":{"text":"Ka thu nan ngai a si ahcun hi ram ih a suah mi thilṭha nan ei ding."},"20":{"text":"Asinain ka thu nan eel ih in dodal a si ahcun nan thi rori ding. Bawipa keimah in ka ṭong zo a si,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Rintlakzet a si mi khawpi cu hlawhhlang ah a cang. Khuahlan ahcun miding pawl umnak khawpi a si; atu ahcun mithat pawl lawnglawng an um.","title":"Khawpi Sual"},"22":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, khuahlan ahcun ngun bangtuk na rak si; atu ahcun man neilo na si. Khuahlan ahcun sabit zu thawzet bangtuk na rak si; atu ahcun tidai lawng na si."},"23":{"text":"Na hotu pawl cu ralthotu le rukru pawl ih rualpi hlir an si. Thu an rel tikah nu le pa neilo farah pawl an ṭan dah lo ih nuhmei pawl ih thu cu an ngaisak dah lo."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah, cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, a maksak mi ih a sim mi hi ngaiṭha aw; Bawipa in, “Ka ral ih a cang zo mi na parah hin phu ka la ding; cuticun hnaihnawhnak in pe nawn lo ding."},"25":{"text":"Na parah ka thinhengnak a thleng sal ding. Thir an ser vekin somei ah ka lo ser dingih na balhnak hmuahhmuah cu ka hlon thluh ding."},"26":{"text":"Khuahlan ih hotu le remruattu pawl vekin hotu le remruattu a thar in ka lo pe ding. Cuticun Jerusalem cu a dingmi le rinsantlak khawpi ti ih kawh a si ding,” a ti."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ding mi a si ruangah Jerusalem cu a hum dingih sual a sirtu hmuahhmuah a run ding a si."},"28":{"text":"Asinain a sualtu le amah a dotu hmuahhmuah cu dip ṭheh in a rial dingih amah a hnongtu pawl cu a that ding a si."},"29":{"text":"Thingkung nan biak ruangah le hmuan thianghlim sungih milem nan biakmi ruangah ningzak in nan um ding."},"30":{"text":"A thi mi sasua kung vekin nan vuai dingih zohman ih tidai toih lo hmuan vek nan si ding."},"31":{"text":"Hramro cu meici fate in a kang thei vekin micak le mi nasa pawl khal anmah ih thilsual tuahnak in a siatsuah dingih cuih siatsuahnak cu zohman in an mit thei nawn lo ding."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in Amoz fapa Isaiah hnenah Judah le Jerusalem thu thawn peh aw in hi ti hin a sim.","title":"Kumkhua Hnangamnak (Mik 4.1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Hmailam caanah Biakinn a dinnak tlang cu tlangdang hnakin a saangbik a si ding. Miphun tampi cuih tlang ahcun cat loin an ra dingih"},"3":{"text":"an minung pawl in, “ Bawipaió tlang ah hung feh uhsi; Israel Pathian in Biakinn ahcun. Thlun dingih in duh mi cu in zirh dingih A hrilzo mi a lamzin ihsin kan feh ding. Bawipaió thuzirhmi cu Jerusalem ihsin a ra; Zion ihsin a mi pawl hnenah a sim a si."},"4":{"text":"Ram tumzetzet karlakih thutam mi cu a daiter ding. Cuticun an ralnam cu leilehnak tuhmui ah an ser dingih an feipi cu thingrah kung thenfainak namte ah an tuah ding. Ramkhat le ramkhat an do aw nawn lo dingih, raldo khal an tum nawn lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Maw Jakob ih tefa sin pawl, Bawipaió in pek mi tleunak sungah tlangleng uhsi."},"6":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na minung Jakob ih tefa sin pawl cu na dungtun a si. Curuangah an ram cu nisuahnak lam le Filistin ramih mitkher le dawithiam pawl an khat. Mi phundang ih thlun mi daan an thlun.","title":"Puarthaunak Cu Siatsuah A Si Ding"},"7":{"text":"An ram cu sui le ngun in a khatih an sumsaw cu cem ti a nei lo. An ram cu rang in a khatih an rangleng pawl cu siarcawk lo an si."},"8":{"text":"An ram cu milem in a khatih anmah ih kut ih an tuahcop mi an biak."},"9":{"text":"An zate in hmuhsuam le nautat mi an si dingih ningzak le hmaisia in an um ding. Maw Bawipa , zohman ngaidam hlah aw."},"10":{"text":"Bawipaió thinhengnak ihsin luat dingah le a sunlawinak le a cahnak huham hrial duh ah leilung ah khur lai tahrat in an lut dingih tlangpar lungpuk sungah an relh ding."},"11":{"text":"Milai ih hngalnak cu a cem dingih milai ih puarthaunak cu siatsuah ṭheh a si ni a thleng ding. Cule Bawipa lawnglawng cawi mawi a si ding."},"12":{"text":"Cui ni ahcun Cungnungbik Bawipa in mi lianngan hmuahhmuah a niam ter ding; mihngal le mi puarthau hmuahhmuah a namthla ṭheh ding a si."},"13":{"text":"Lebanon ih sidar thing sang zetzet pawl le Bashan ramih sasua kung hmuahhmuah cu a siatsuah ṭheh ding."},"14":{"text":"Tlang sang siseh, tlang niam siseh;"},"15":{"text":"ral vennak inn sang zetzet siseh khua kulhnak ralhruang sang zetzet siseh rualraan in a thlakcim ṭheh ding."},"16":{"text":"A tumbik le a mawibik tipithuanthum ih feh thei Tarshish khua ih lawng pawl hman a pil ter ṭheh ding."},"17":{"text":"Milai ih hngalnak le puarthaunak hmuahhmuah a cemter ṭheh ding. Cui ni ahcun Bawipa lawnglawng a saangbik ih cawimawi mi a si dingih,"},"18":{"text":"milem hmuahhmuah khal an hloral ṭheh ding."},"19":{"text":"Leilungpi hnin dingih Bawipa a rat tikah cun a thinhengnak ihsin luat dingah le a sunlawinak le a cahnak huham hrial duh ah leilung lai tahrat in an lut dingih tlangpar ih lungpuk sungah an relh ciamco ding."},"20":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen ngaingai tikah cun sui le ngun in an tuah mi milem pawl cu an tlansan dingih duum le palap hnenah an hlon ṭheh ding."},"21":{"text":"Leilungpi hnin dingih Bawipa a ra thlen tikah cun a thinhengnak tlansan dingah le a sunlawinak le a cahnak huham hrialin tlangpar ih lei kua le lungpuk ah an relh ciamco ding."},"22":{"text":"Curuangah milai cu rinsan hlah uh. Rinsantlak an sinak ziangso a um?"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Atu ihsin Bawipa , Cungnungbik Bawipa in, minung ih rinsan bik mi milai siseh thilri siseh Jerusalem le Judah ihsin a lak ṭheh ding. An rinsan bik mi an rawl le an tidai,","title":"Jerusalem Khawsungih Buainak"},"2":{"text":"an micak le an ralkap pawl, an thuṭhentu le an profet pawl, an thusim thiam le an kutzoh thiam pawl,"},"3":{"text":"an ram uktu bawi le ralkap bawi pawl, an ram hruaitu pawl le mitkher thiam pawl a lak ṭheh ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in an ram cu nauhak tualleng pawl a uk ter ding."},"5":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in anmah ih miatnak hrangah cun mihmaisong an neilo ding. Mino pawl in an upa pawl an upat lo dingih mi nauta pawl in an tlunih bawi pawl an hmaisong lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Caan a rathleng dingih innsang pakhat sungah an unau pakhat cu, “Nang cu hruk ding hnipuan tal na neih ruangah hi bangtuk kan harsat caan ah hin in hotubik si hram aw,” an ti ding."},"7":{"text":"Asinain anih in, “Sihlah e, nan hotu ka si lo ding. Ka lo bawm thei lo ding. Ka inn sungah rawl a um lo, hnipuan khal a um lo. Nan hotu ah in tuah hlah uh,” a ti ding."},"8":{"text":"A si, Jerusalem cu a cem a si! Judah khal a sawn ruairo a si! Ziang hmuahhmuah an sim mi le an tuah mi cu Bawipaió duhlo zawng hlir an si. Langhngan in Pathian rori an hmuhsuam."},"9":{"text":"Mi thleidan an neihnak cu an hrangah siatsuahtu a si ding. Sodom khua mi bangtuk in ningzah neiloin an sual. An cem a si; ci an tuh mi an khawm sal a si."},"10":{"text":"Asinain miding pawl cu milungawi an si dingih an lamzin hmuahhmuah a tluang ding. An hlawhman cu lungawizet in an ngah ding."},"11":{"text":"Asinain miṭha lo pawl cu an cem a si; midang parih an tuah mi cu an parah a thleng sal ding."},"12":{"text":"Ka minung pawl cu tangka cawihtu pawl in an hremih tangka kilsaktu pawl in an bum a si. Maw ka minung pawl, nan hotu pawl in an lo hruaisual ih khuilam zawh ding ti nan thei lo."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa cu a minung pawl thurel dingah tim a tuah. A tim a tuah ṭheh ih,","title":"In A Minung Pawl Parah Thu A ṭhen"},"14":{"text":"an uktu pawl le an hotu pawl cu thurelnak hmunah a suahpi. An hnenah, “Mi sabit hmuan nan long ṭheh ih nan inn cu mi farah hnen ihsin nan lak mi thilri in a khat."},"15":{"text":"Ka minung palcih theinak le mi farah pawl ih covo lon theinak thu zianghman nan nei lo. Keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka sim zo a si,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Jerusalem nunau pawl an hngalzia hi zohhnik uh. An puarthau tukah vantau eu-eu in an feh. Ningzah neiloin mipa par lawnglawngah an mit an meng. Duh awzet le zum awzet in an feh ih an ke ih an khih mi khiingte cu an awnter sulso.","title":"Jerusalem Nunau Hnenih Ralrin Peknak"},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka hrem hai ding-an sam ka meet dingih lukolh in ka thlah ṭheh hai ding,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Jerusalem nunau hnenih sin an uar bikmi hlawnthil pawl Bawipa ih a lonnak tikcu a ra thleng ding. An lu le an ke ih an thlaih mi khiingte, an hngawng le"},"19":{"text":"an kut ih an khih mi faute pawl a lak ṭheh ding. An hmai khuhnak puanpaate,"},"20":{"text":"an lukhum pawl, an baan le an taai ih an khih mi ai-camnak an thlaih aw mi baan thlaih le taikhap pawl,"},"21":{"text":"an kutzung ih an hruk mi zunghruk le an hnar ih an thlaih mi hnarthlaih pawl,"},"22":{"text":"an hnipuan ṭhaṭha, an puan le an korfual le paisa bawm pawl,"},"23":{"text":"a paa zet mi an hnipuan pawl, an pavua pawl, an hngawngngerh pawl le an lukhuhnak puan paate sau zetzet pawl cu a long ṭheh ding a si."},"24":{"text":"Zihmui an hmang nawn lo ding, an rim a siazet sawn ding; taikhap ṭhaṭha ai ah hridai siava an khap ding; sam mawizetzet ai ah an lu a kolh ṭheh ding; hnipuan mawizetzet ai ah puansia an hruk ding; an mawinak cu an ningzahnak ah a cang ding."},"25":{"text":"Khawsung mipa pawl, micak bik pawl hman ral kutah an thi ding."},"26":{"text":"Khawpi kotka pawl an ṭap an rak ding. An khawpi cu hnipuan neilo leilung ih a to nunau bangtuk a si ding."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cui caan a kim tikah nunau pasarih in mipa pakhat an kai dingih, “Kanmah teón kan cawm aw ko ding; hnipuan tla in holh a ṭul lo ding; pasal nei theilo ih um ningzahnak ihsin kan luatnak ding ah kan pasal a si kan lo ti hram pei,” tiah an ti ding."},"2":{"text":"Tikcu caan a rathleng dingih ramsung thingkung le rawlkung pawl cu Bawipa in a tum ter dingih a mawiter ding. Israel mi sungin a taangmi pawl in an ramih a suak mi rawl an hmuh tikah an thin a nuam dingih an mithmai a ṭha saal ding.","title":"Jerusalem A ṭha Saal Ding"},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem ih a taangmi, a nung dingah Pathian ih hrilmi pawl cu mithianghlim tiah kawh an si ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in a cahnak huham thawn thu a ṭhen dingih ram a thianter ding. Cun Jerusalem sualnak le thisen thletnak cu a kholhfai ding."},"5":{"text":"Cule Zion Tlang par le cutawkih a ra khawm mi pawl ih tlunah Bawipa in sun ah khawdur a umter dingih zanah meikhu le meisa tleu a umter ding. Pathian ih sunlawinak huham in khawpi pumpi cu a khuh dingih a hum ding a si."},"6":{"text":"Bawipaió sunlawinak in khawpi cu sun nisatnak ihsin a hneem dingih ruah a sur ih thlipi a hran hmanah beunak le himnak hmun a si ding."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaihnik uh, hla ka lo sak sak ding, Ka rualpa le a sabit hmuan hla cu: Ka rualpa in sabit hmuan a nei, Leilung ṭhazet tlangpar ram ṭhazet ah,","title":"Sabit Hmuan Hla"},"2":{"text":"Leilung a ceek ih lungto pawl a hrilfai ṭheh, Sabit kuang ṭhabik pawl a phun. Hmuan kilnak ah thlaam a sak ih, Sabit rialnak ah khur a lai. Cule sabit rah hmin ding a hngak, Asinain a sabit rah cu a zate in a thur thluh."},"3":{"text":"Ka rualpa in, “Jerusalem le Judah ih a um mi pawl, ka sabit hmuan le keimah thu hi in ruat sak hnik uh."},"4":{"text":"Ka sabit hmuan hrangah ka tuah lo mi ziangso a um. Asinain ziangah so ka ruah vekih sabit rah thaw suak loin sabit rah thur a suah?"},"5":{"text":"Ka sabit hmuan parah hi bangtuk in ka tuah ding. A hauhruang ka bauhṭheh dingih a kulhnak ka bal ṭheh ding; ramsa in an duh le ei in palsiat ṭheh hai seh."},"6":{"text":"Hrampi kho in khat ṭheh seh. Sabit kuang cu ka thianfai nawn lo dingih a thlawh khal ka thlo nawn lo ding. Hling le so khat ṭheh seh. Khawdur khal ruah surter hlah aw tiah ka kham ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Israel cu Cungnungbik Bawipaió ih sabit hmuan a si; Judah mi cu a ciin mi sabit kuang ṭhazet an si. Ṭhatnak an tuah ding tiah a zum; Asinain mi an that ih thisen an luangter. A dikmi an tuah ding tiah a zum; Asinain an ṭhatlonak a tuartu pawl an ṭap an ai."},"8":{"text":"Nan cem a si! Inn le lo nan neih cia mi tlunah inn dang le lo dang na beet vivo. A rei hlanah zohrang hmanah hmun le ram a um nawn lo dingih ram sungah nanmah lawng nan um ding.","title":"An Tuahmi Thilṭha lo"},"9":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Hi inn tumpipi le inn mawizetzet hi a lawng ṭheh dingih a siat ṭheh ding."},"10":{"text":"Rawl han nga hmuan ih ciin mi sabit in sabitti cuai hnih lawng a suah ding. Thlaici han hra tuh mi in rawl han khat lawng a suah ding,” a ti mi ka thei zo."},"11":{"text":"Nan cem a si! Zingpit nan thawh vete in zu nan in ih zu nan rit ruangah zanlam tlaipi tiang nan meng."},"12":{"text":"Nan puai caanah ṭingṭang le khuang le phirivau nan tum ih le sabit zu thawn nan ciah aw. Asinain Bawipaió in ziang a tuah ti nan thei thei lo."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah sal kaih mi ah nan cang ding. Nan hotu pawl rawl loin an thi dingih mi zaaraan pawl cu tihal in an thi ding."},"14":{"text":"Mithi khua in a pum a puar zo, a khop zo ti a nei lo; a kaa kau zetin a aang ringring. Jerusalem ih bawi le upa pawl khal a au a khuangih a hnok ceelceel mi mizaraan pawl thawn hmun khatah a dolh hai a si."},"15":{"text":"Zozo khal an ning a zak dingih mi puarthau pawl hmuahhmuah ṭhum ṭheh an si ding."},"16":{"text":"Asinain Cungnungbik Bawipa in a cahnak huham a langter dingih a hman mi a tuah ding, a thianhlimnak cu a minung pawl thu a ṭhennak parah a langter ding a si."},"17":{"text":"A siat ṭheh mi khawpi sungah cun tuu pawl in hrampi an ei dingih me pawl in tlimno an ngah ding."},"18":{"text":"Nan cem a si! Nan sualnak ihsin nan luat suak thei nawn lo a si hi!"},"19":{"text":"“ Bawipa in ka tuah ding a ti mi cu zamrangin tuah sehla kan zohhnik pei cu. Israel ih Pathian thianghlim in a saduhthah cu tuah suak hnik seh; a ruah mi le a tumtah mi pawl cu hmu hnik uhsi!” nan ti."},"20":{"text":"Nan cem a si! Thilṭha lo cu thilṭha nan ti ih thilṭha cu thilṭha lo nan ti. Thimnak cu tleunak ah nan cangter ih tleunak cu thimnak ah nan cangter. A khaa mi cu a thlum ah nan tuah ih a thlum cu a khaa ah nan tuah a si."},"21":{"text":"Nan cem a si! Kan fim, kan fim ngaingai tiah nan ruat aw!"},"22":{"text":"Nan cem a si! Zu palang lamah micak pawl! Zu a phun phun rawi lamah cun ralṭha le ṭih neilo pawl nan si!"},"23":{"text":"Asinain nawhthuh an lo pek ahcun mi mawh khal nan thlah hluahhlo ih mawh neilo sawn cu a thu nan theihsak lo."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah fangcang kungro le hrampi caar cu meisa in a huul ih a kaang ṭheh vekin nan hram pawl an muat dingih nan par mawi pawl an vuai dingih thli in a semhlo ṭheh ding; ziangahtile Israel ih Pathian thianghlim, Cungnungbik Bawipa ih in zirh mi nan hnong a si."},"25":{"text":"A minung pawl parah Bawipa cu a thin a hengih hrem dingah a kut a khai zo. Tlang pawl an hnin ṭheh dingih a thi mi pawl ih ruak cu hnawmhne bangin lamzin ah an ril teptep ding. Cui hnu hmanah Bawipaió thinhengnak cu a reh hrih lo dingih hrem dingah a kut a khai hrih ko ding."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa in lamhlapi ih a um mi miphun khat ko dingah theihthiamnak a langter. Vanhram deng ihsin ra dingah hurhuuk in a ko. An ra ngaingai ih zamrangzet in an ra thleng."},"27":{"text":"An lakah a baang mi pakhat hman an um lo; pakhat hman a bah mi an um lo. An it lo, an sing fawn lo. An taikhap pakhat te hman a dor loih an kedam hri pakhat te hman a cat lo."},"28":{"text":"An conkiang pawl cu an hriam ngaingai; an li cu sai mai dingih nawp cia an si. An rang tin pawl cu ṭeeklung vekin an hak ih an rangleng ke pawl cu phusiing bangin an herh aw."},"29":{"text":"An ralkap pawl cu kiosa in sa an deh ih zohman lon thei lo dingah an tlanpi ih an ai an kio bangin an thawm a ring a si."},"30":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah tifinriat awn vekin Israel tlunah an awn an au ding. Hi ram hi zohhnik uh. Thimnak le oloksongnak lawng a um. Tleunak cu thimnak in a dolh a si."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Uzziah a thih kum ah Bawipa ka hmu. A siangpahrang tokham parah sunglawi le huham neizet in a to ih a sunlawinak puan cu Biakinn sung a khat ṭheh.","title":"Pathian In Isaiah A Ko"},"2":{"text":"A kimvel ah meisa alh bangtuk serafim vancungmi an um ih thla paruk ciar an nei. Thla pahnih in an hmai an khuh aw; a dang pahnih in an ruangpi an khuh aw ih a dang pahnih in an zuang."},"3":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat an ko aw ih: “Thianghlim, thianghlim, thianghlim! Cungnungbik Bawi cu a thianghlim! A sunlawinak cu leilung ah a khat a si,” an ti."},"4":{"text":"An aw thawm cu a thang tukih Biakinn hram tiangin a hnin ṭheh. Cule Biakinn cu meikhu in a khat ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah kei in, “Ka cem a si! Ka ruahsan ding zianghman a um nawn lo. Ka hmur ihsin a suak mi ṭongkam hmuahhmuah cu a sualmi ṭongkam a si ṭheh; misual lakah ka um ih hmurka thianglo lakah ka leeng. Atu ah ka mit rori in siangpahrang, cungnungbik Bawipa ka hmu fawn,” tiah ka ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun serafim pakhat cu biakṭheng ih meiling kha caiceh in a cep ih cumi kengin ka hnenah a rung zuang."},"7":{"text":"Cui meiling cun ka hmur a run dai ih, “Zohhnik, na hmur a dai zo; atu ihsin na mawhnak a hlo ṭheh ih na sualnak cu ngaidam a si zo,” tiah i ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, “Zoso ka thlah ding? Zosi kan palai a si ding?” a ti ka thei. Cutikah kei in, “Keimah ka feh ding! I thlah aw!” ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Cule anih in, “Va feh awla hi minung pawl hnenah: ‘Ziangtluk ih nan ngai hmanah nan thei lo ding. Ziangtluk ih nan zoh hmanah nan hmu lo ding,’ ti aw."},"10":{"text":"Hi minung pawl ih thinlung hi mol ter awla an hna khal seet ter in an mit tla caw ter aw; cuticun hmu hlah hai seh, thei hlah hai seh, theithiam hlah hai seh. An hmuh ih, an thei ih an theihthiam a si ahcun ka lamah an hoikir dingih an dam pang ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah kei in, “ Bawipa , cuticun ziangtik tiangso a si ding?” ka ti. Anih in, “Khawpi pawl siatsuah ṭheh an si ih an ṭhing reprep tiang; zozo khalin an inn an tlansan ṭheh tiang; hi ram hi an ṭiosan ih a ṭhin reprep tiang a si ding."},"12":{"text":"Hi minung pawl hi lamhlapi ah ka kuat hai dingih an ram cu ramṭhing ah a cang ding."},"13":{"text":"Minung pahra sungah pakhat hi ram sungih a taan hmanah anih khal cu siatsuah cih a si thotho ding; amah cu an hau cia mi sasua kung sumhmui bangtuk a si ding,” a ti. (Sumhmui cu Pathian ih minung pawl hramthawhnak thar tican a si.)"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uzziah fapa Jotham ih fapa siangpahrang Ahaz in Judah ram a uk laiah raldonak a suak. Siria siangpahrang Rezin le Israel siangpahrang Pekah, Remaliah fapa, in Jerusalem an do; a sinan an lak thei lo.","title":"Ahaz Hnenih Thucahmi"},"2":{"text":"Siria ralkap pawl Israel ram an thleng zo ti kha Judah siangpahrang in a theih tikah amah le a minung pawl cu an thin a phang tukih thli in thingkung a sem vekin an hnin an ṭhia ciamco."},"3":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Isaiah hnenah, “Na fapa Shear Jashub hruai awla siangpahrang Ahaz tong dingah feh uh. Siangpahrang cu tlunta ticawm ihsin tidai a rung luannak tihriat netnak ih hnipuan taktu pawl hnaṭuannak lamzin ah nan tong ding."},"4":{"text":"Nan ton tikah amah cu ralring te in, hnangamzet in, thinphang lo le ṭih lo te ih um dingah sim uh. Siangpahrang Rezin le a ralkap pawl le siangpahrang Pekah thinhengnak cu ṭih ding a um nawn lo; a mit zik rero mi thingthu pahnih ih meikhu tluk hman a si nawn lo."},"5":{"text":"Siria le Israel mi le an siangpahrang thawn an lo phiar a si."},"6":{"text":"Judah do an tum; Judah mi pawl cu an hnenih ṭang dingin an hro dingih Tabeel fapa cu siangpahrang canter an tum a si."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Keimah Bawipa in cuti ih cang lo dingin ka than zo."},"8":{"text":"Ziangahtile Siria cu Damaskas khua hnakin a cak sawn cuanglo ih Damaskas cu siangpahrang Rezin hnak khalin a cak sawn cuang fawn lo. Israel ram thu kan sim asile atu ihsin hmailam kum sawm ruk le kum nga sungah Israel cu a kuai ṭheh dingih ram ramkhat ti tlak hman a um lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Israel ram cu Samaria khua hnakin a cak sawn cuanglo ih Samaria khal cu siangpahrang Pekah hnakin a cak sawn cuang fawn lo.
