Nan zumnak a cak lo asile rei nan awh lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa cun Ahaz hnenah a sim sal ih,","title":"Immanuel Khihhmuhnak"},"11":{"text":"“ Bawipa na Pathian hnenih sin khihhmuhnak dil aw. A thukbik mithi khua ihsin siseh, a saangbik vancung khalin siseh dil aw,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Ahaz in, “Khihhmuhnak ka lo dil ding. Bawipa cu ka hniksak lo ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Isaiah in, “Maw siangpahrang David tefa sin pawl, ngaihnik uh. Minung thin nan cemter zo ih a poizet a si; atu ah Pathian thin nan cemter duh lala maw si?"},"14":{"text":"Atu ah Bawipa amah rori in khihmuhhnak a lo pe ding. Nunau no pakhat in fa a vun ih fapa a hring dingih a hminah Immanuel tiah an sak ding."},"15":{"text":"A hung upat ih a ṭha le a sia thleidan a thiam tikah a rawl ei mi cu cawhnawi le khuaitizu a si ding."},"16":{"text":"Cui caan a thlen hlanah nan ṭihzet mi siangpahrang pahnih ih ram cu a ṭhing reprep ding."},"17":{"text":"“Israel le Judah nan ṭhen awk hnuah ziangtik hman ih nan ton dah lo mi harsatnak cu Bawipa in nangmah le na sungkhat le na miphun parah a thlenter ding - Assiria siangpahrang a thlenter ding a si."},"18":{"text":"“Cui caan a thlen tikah Bawipa in Izipt mi pawl cu Nail tiva hna a hlatnak bik khalin thothe vekin ra zuang dingah le Assiria mi pawl cu an ram in khuai vekih ra zuang dingah kuai in a ko ding."},"19":{"text":"An ra dingih horkuam kip, lungpuk kip, hling le so lak le ṭilva tlannak ram kip ah an khat ding."},"20":{"text":"Cui caan a thlen tikah Bawipa in Assiria siangpahrang cu nan lu meettu dingah Zufrates tiva raal ihsin a ko dingih nan khahmul, nan lupar sam le nan taksa par hmul hmuahhmuah a meet ṭheh ding."},"21":{"text":"“Cui caan a thlen tikah lothlo pa pakhat in cawla pakhat le me pahnih a neih hmanah,"},"22":{"text":"an hnawi a tamzet dingih a hai mi a daih ṭheh ding. A si, ram sungih a taangmi hmuahhmuah in ei dingah cawhnawi le khuaitizu an nei ding."},"23":{"text":"“Cui caan a thlen tikah sabit hmuan ṭhazet, sabit kuang thawngkhat a um mi, hmuan pakhat ih tangka thawngkhat man cu hling le so in a khat ding."},"24":{"text":"Li le thal thawn minung ramtawihnak hmunah a cang ding. A si, ram pumpuluk cu hling le so in a khat ṭheh ding."},"25":{"text":"Rawl an rak ciinnak tlangpar pawl cu hlingkung a kho ṭheh dingih zohman an feh lo ding. Caw le tuu tlannak ramah a cang ding."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Cangannak ah lungpheng tumpi pakhat la awla misenpi theih thei dingin: ‘Zamrang-lon-zamrang-laak,’ tiah ngan aw.","title":"Isaiah In Fapa A Nei"},"2":{"text":"Rintlak minung pahnih-puithiam Uriah le Jeberekhiah fapa Zekhariah cu theihpitu ah sawm hai aw,” tiah i ti."},"3":{"text":"Cui hnuah ka nupi thawn kan ittlang ih fa a vun ih fapa a nei. Cutikah Bawipa in, “A hmin ah ‘Zamrang-lon-zamrang-laak,’ tiah ti aw."},"4":{"text":"Naute in, ‘Nunu, Papa,’ tihman a thiam hlanah Damaskas ih lennak thilri le sumsaw hmuahhmuah le Samaria ih ral lon thilri hmuahhmuah cu Assiria siangpahrang in a lak ṭheh ding a si,” tiah i ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule Bawipaió cu ka hnenah a ṭong saal ih,","title":"Assiria Siangpahrang A Ra Ding"},"6":{"text":"“Hi minung pawl in daiteih a luangmi Shiloah Tiva tidai an hnong ih siangpahrang Rezin le siangpahrang Pekah hmaiah khur rero ih an um ruangah,"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa Keimah rori in Assiria siangpahrang le a ralkap pawl cu Judah do dingah ka hruai ding. Zufrates tiva a len ih a kap hmuahhmuah a liam thluh bangin an ra ding."},"8":{"text":"Judah ram sungah tilik bangin an rung dingih liang an tiang dingih ziang hmuahhmuah an khuh ṭheh ding,” a ti. Pathian kan hnenah a um. A thla a pharh ih kan ram cu a hum a si."},"9":{"text":"Maw ramkip le phunkip tla, thinphang in hmun khatah tongkhawm aw uh. Ngai uh, lamhlapi ih a um mi pawl tla raldo dingah nan timtuah uh; a sinan ṭih uh. A si, nan timtuah ṭheh uh; a sinan phang uh!"},"10":{"text":"Tumtahnak cu nei ko uh. Zianghman hlawhtlinnak nan nei cuanglo ding. Nan duhzat in ṭong uh; a lak hlir an si ding, ziangahtile Pathian kan hnenah a um a si."},"11":{"text":"Misenpi pawl ih thlun mi lamzin thlun lo dingah Bawipa in a huham nasazet thawn ralrinnak i peek.","title":"In Profet Cu Ralrinnak A Pek"},"12":{"text":"“An tumtah mi ah tel ve hlah awla an ṭih mi kha ṭih ve hlah aw."},"13":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa Keimah lawng a thianghlim mi ka si kha ciing ṭha aw. Keimah lawnglawng na ṭih ding mi cu ka si."},"14":{"text":"Ka thianhlimnak mangbangza a si ruangah keimah cu an bahnak lungto bangtuk ka si. Keimah cu Judah ram le Israel ramih misenpi le Jerusalem khawsungmi pawl a awk tu ding thang bangtuk ka si."},"15":{"text":"Mi tampi an bah ding. An tlu dingih an kiak an kuai ṭheh ding. Thang in a awk ding,” tiah i ti."},"16":{"text":"Nannih ka dung i thluntu pawl, Bawipa in ka hnenih a sim mi thu pawl a kilkhawitu le a nung tertu ding nan si.","title":"Mithi Thuron Lo Dingih Thupeknak"},"17":{"text":"Bawipa cu a minung pawl ih hmuh lo dingin a thup aw; a sinan kei cun amah ka rinsan ih ka ruahsannak cu amah hnenah ka ret a si."},"18":{"text":"Hitawk ah hin Bawipa in i pek mi faate pawl thawn kan um. Cungnungbik Bawipaió tokham cu Zion Tlang ah a um ih kanmah tla hi Israel mi pawl hnenah khihhmuhnak ah in thlah a si."},"19":{"text":"Mi tampi in pol le kut ṭial zohthiam pawl, a phun a tlok rero tu pawl, leeng ding le thuron dingah an lo fial ding. “A nungmi pawl can ai-ah a thi mi pawl thusuh ding le mithi thlarau pawl thuron ding cu a ṭha ko sokhaw,” an lo ti ding."},"20":{"text":"Cuti an ti tikah nannih in, “ Bawipa ih a lo zirh mi hi ngai sawn uh. Pol thu cu ngai hlah uh. An lo sim mi cu nan hrangah ṭhathnemnak zianghman a nei lo ding,” nan ti pei."},"21":{"text":"An rilrawng le an thinheng in an siangpahrang le an Pathian tiangin an cam ding. Van an zoh ding,","title":"Harsatnak Tikcu"},"22":{"text":"leilung khal an zoh ding; a sinan harnak le thimnak siar lo a dang zianghman an hmu lo ding. Cui ṭihnungza thimnak sungah cun an lut cuahco a si. Hi harsatnak caan sungih sin an luatnak ding lamzin a um lo ding."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zebulun miphun le Naftali miphun pawl ram cu ningzak in a rak um zo; a sinan hmailamah hi ram cu ram sunglawi ah a cang ding. Mediterranean ihsin nisuahnak lamah Jordan khatlam ral tiang, cule ramdang mi umnak Galilee tiang ram sunglawi ah a cang ṭheh ding.","title":"A Ra Dingmi Siangpahrang"},"2":{"text":"Khawthim lakih a feh mi pawl in a nasazet mi tleunak an hmu zo; Thladem ramih a um mi pawl parah tleunak a thleng zo."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , lungawinak tumpi na pek hai; An thin na nuamter zo a si. Na hnaṭuan mi parah an lung a awi ngaingai; Mi in rawl an lak caan ih an lung a awi bangtuk le, raal lon mi thilri an zem awk caan bangin."},"4":{"text":"An thilrit phurhnak hnamhri cu na saat cat zo; An liang parih kawn khal na khiak ṭheh zo. Maw Bawipa , na minung pawl a hrem tu le a hmuhsuam tu cu na neh zo. Hlanlaipi ih Midian ralkap na neh zo vekin."},"5":{"text":"Na minung dotu pawl ih kedam le thisen hnih mi an hnipuan pawl hmuahhmuah cu meisa in ur ṭheh an si ding."},"6":{"text":"Kan hnenah naute a suak zo; Kan hrangah fapa peek a si zo; Amah cu in uktu a si ding. Amah cu “Mangbangza Remruattu,” “A cakmi Pathian,” “Kumkhua ih Pa,” “Daihnak Siangpahrang,” tiah kawh a si ding."},"7":{"text":"A siangpahrang uknak le huham cu a ṭhangso vivo ding; A uknak sungah kumkhua in daihnak a um ding. Siangpahrang David ai ah a uk ding; Dingnak le thuhman thawn a uk dingih atu le kumkhua in a uk ding a si. Cungnungbik Bawipa in hi hmuahhmuah a tuah ding."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel uknak le Jakob tefa sin parah thuṭhennak a peek zo.","title":"In Israel A Hrem Ding"},"9":{"text":"Hi thu cu Israel mi hmuahhmuah le Samaria khawpi ih a um hmuahhmuah in an thei ding. Atu ahcun hngalzet le puarthau zetin an um."},"10":{"text":"Annih in, “Tlakrawh inn pawl an cim ṭheh zo; a sinan lungto inn kan sak saal ko ding. Theipi kungih tuah mi kaan an tan ṭheh; a sinan sidar thing ṭhabik in kan sak saal pam ding,” an ti."},"11":{"text":"Cui ruangah Bawipa in an raal pawl cu raltho dingah le anmah do dingah a forh."},"12":{"text":"Nisuahnak lamah Siria le nitlaknak lamah Filistin mi pawl cun Israel dolh ṭheh dingah an kaa an ang! Cu hmanah Bawipaió thinhengnak cu a reh hrih lo; a kut cu mihrem dingah khai cia in a um lai a si."},"13":{"text":"Israel mi pawl an sual an siir aw hrih lo; Cungnungbik Bawipa in daan a tat naan amah an pan duh cuang lo."},"14":{"text":"Ni ni khat sungah Bawipa in Israel hotu pawl le misenpi pawl cu a hrem ding; an lu le an mei a saat tan ding."},"15":{"text":"Mi upa le upat tlak pawl cu lu an si; thuphan lawnglawng mizirhtu profet pawl cu a mei an si."},"16":{"text":"Himi pawl hruaitu pawl in an hruaisual ih an buai ṭheh zo."},"17":{"text":"Cui ruangah Bawipa in an mino pawl cu pakhat hman a luat ter lo ding; an nuhmei le nu pa neilo pawl hnen khalah zaangfahnak a neilo ding; ziangahtile hi minung pawl hi Pathian theilo le miṭha lo hlir an si ih, an sim mi thu cu thu ṭha lo hlir a si. Cui hnu hmanah Bawipaió thinhengnak cu a dai hrih lo; hrem dingah a kut cu khai cia in a um lai a si."},"18":{"text":"Himi pawl ih ṭhatlonak cu hling le so a kaang ṭheh tu meisa bangin a alh rero lai a si. Hrampi le tusung thing tiangin a kaangih a khu cu dum zetin vanah a kai."},"19":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa a thin a heng ruangah a thinhengnak cu an ram sungah meisa bangin a kaangih minung pawl cu tih mi thing vekah an cang. Zokhal mah hrang hlir ah an nung; unau dontu pakhat hman an um lo."},"20":{"text":"Rawl an hmuh mi pohpoh cu an zon hnawh ih an ei; a sinan an rilrawn a reh cuang lo. An sungsuak an faate tiangin an ei!"},"21":{"text":"Manasseh mi le Efraim mi an do aw; an pahnih an ṭangkhawm ih Judah an do. Cui hnu khalah Bawipaió thinhengnak cu a dai hrih lo; hrem dingah a kut cu khai cia in a um lai a si."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nan cem riai a si! Ka minung pawl hrem duh ah a dinglo mi daan nan tuah!"},"2":{"text":"Mifarah le mi zonzai pawl in an covo an co loih an thu nan theihsak lo. Cuticun nuhmei le nu pa neilo farah pawl ih thilri pawl nan long a si."},"3":{"text":"Pathian in a lo hrem tikah ziangso nan tuah ding? Nan parah lam hlatpi ihsin harsatnak a rathlen tikah ziangtinso nan um ding? Bomnak hawl in zohnen ah so nan tlan ding? Nan thilri le nan lennak pawl hi khui ah so nan thuh ding?"},"4":{"text":"Raldonak ah nan thi ding; a si lole an lo kai dingih an lo hruaihlo ding a si. Cui hnu hmanah Bawipaió thinhengnak cu a dai hrih lo; hrem dingah a kut cu khai cia in a um lai a si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka thin i heng tertu pawl thawinak ih ka hman mi talhtum cu Assiria a si.","title":"Pathian In Assiria Siangpahrang A Hmang"},"6":{"text":"Ka thin ai a thok tertu, Pathian ṭihzah lotu pawl do dingah Assiria ka thlah a si. An thilri long dingah le an minung pawl lamzin hnawmhne bangih palcih dingah ka thlah a si,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Asinain Assiria siangpahrang in mi thisen luannak ding tumtahnak a rak nei ve. Ram tampi siatsuah ding a tum."},"8":{"text":"Tluang a khawngih, “Ka ralkap hotu ralbawi pawl cu siangpahrang an si ṭheh!"},"9":{"text":"Kalno le Karkhemish khua pawl ka neh. Hamath le Arpad khua pawl tla ka neh fawn. Samaria le Damaskas khawpi pawl tla ka lak zo."},"10":{"text":"Milem a biatu ram pawl daantattu dingah ka kut ka hawi zo; an milem pawl cu Jerusalem le Samaria ih milem hnakin an tam sawn a si."},"11":{"text":"Samaria le a milem pawl ka siatsuah thluh zo bangtuk in Jerusalem khua le cutawkih an biak mi milem pawl cu ka siatsuah ṭheh ding a si,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa in, “Zion Tlang le Jerusalem parih ka tuah mi pawl ka ṭheh tikah Assiria siangpahrang khal cu a tluangkhawn le a puarthau ruangah daan ka tat ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang in, “Keimaió tuah ṭheh mi a si! Ka cak, ka fim ih theihthiamnak ka nei a si. Ramkhat le ramkhat karlak ramri pawl cu ka siat ṭheh ih an rawl khawl mi pawl cu ka lak ṭheh. Cawcang bangin, cutawkih a um mi pawl cu ka palbeek ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Leilung tlunih ram pawl cu vate bu vek an si ih an lennak le an sumsaw pawl cu vate ti kan laak vekin olte in ka laak a si. Keimah dawi dingah, thla khawng ngamtu zohman an um lo. Ka aang ngamtu khal an um lo,” tiah tluang a khawng ciamco."},"15":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa cun, “Hreitlung in a hmangtu hnakin ka tum sawn, a ti thei pei maw? Hluah in thing attu hnakin ka thupi sawn, a ti pei maw? Talhtum in minung a keng lo; minung in talhtum a keng a si,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in atu rawlkhop ih a nungmi pawl hi hrem dingah natnak a thlengter ding. An taksa ruangpi sungah natnak cu meisa kang bangin a kaang ding."},"17":{"text":"Pathian amah, Israel ih tleunak cu meisa ah a cang ding. Israel ih Pathian thianghlim cu mei-alh ah a cang dingih ni ni khat sungah ziang hmuahhmuah, hling le so tiangin, a kaang ṭheh ding."},"18":{"text":"Tupi ruul zetzet le loram ṭhaṭha pawl cu natsia in milai a siatsuah bangin a siatsuah thluh ding a si."},"19":{"text":"Thingkung a taangmi tla a malzet dingih nauhak tualleng hmanin a siar thei ding."},"20":{"text":"Israel mi pawl sungin a taangmi mi malte in anmah a siatsuahtu ram rinsan nawn loin Israel ih Pathian thianghlim Bawipa sawn an rinsan tikcu caan a thleng ding.","title":"Mi Malte An Kir Ding"},"21":{"text":"Israel mi sungin mi malte cu a cak mi an Pathian hnenah an kir saal ding."},"22":{"text":"Atu ahhin Israel mi cu Tifinriat kapih vunnel zat in an tam naan a kirsal mi cu mi malte an si ding. Mi tam sawn hrangah cun hlohralnak cu retsak cia a si ih an ton ding hrimhrim a si."},"23":{"text":"A si, hi ram pumpi sungah Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim cia vekin, siatsuahnak a thlengter ding a si."},"24":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in Zion ih a um mi a minung pawl hnenah, “Izipt mi in nan parih an rak tuah zo vekin Assiria mi khalin an lo hrem ih nan tuarzet naan ṭih hlah uh.","title":"In Assiria A Hrem Ding"},"25":{"text":"Reilote ah nan parih hremnak ka thlenter mi cu ka reh ter dingih anmah sawn ka siatsuah thlang ding."},"26":{"text":"Oreb Lungpi ih Midian mi pawl ka rak vuak bangtuk in Cungnungbik Bawipa Keimah in ka fungin ka vuak hai ding. Izipt mi ka tuarter zo bangin Assiria mi pawl ka tuarter ve ding."},"27":{"text":"Cui caan a thlen tikah cun a cak mi Assiria kut sungih sin ka lo suah dingih an kawn cu nan hngawng ah thilrit a si nawnlo ding,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Ral pawl in Ai khua an lak. Migron an lan zo. An rawl cu Mikmash ah an ret.","title":"Ral In An Nam"},"29":{"text":"Cui tlangkawn an run tan ih Geba ah an riak. Ramah khua mi pawl cu an thin a phangzet. Siangpahrang Saul ih khua Gibeah khua mi pawl cu an tlanhlo ṭheh."},"30":{"text":"Gallim mi pawl au hnik uh! Laishah mi pawl ngai hnik uh! Anathoth mi pawl in sawn hnik uh!"},"31":{"text":"Madmenah le Gebim khua mi pawl cu thih ṭih ah an tlan ciamco."},"32":{"text":"Tuihsun ah ral cu Nob khua ah an um ih Zion Tlang le Jerusalem khawpi lamah an kut tum an hawi ciamco."},"33":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in thinghnge thlak mi bangin a thlak hai ding. Anmah lakih a puarthau bik le a saangbik khal cu saattan mi le namthlak mi a si ding."},"34":{"text":"Tupi laifangih thing pawl tla hreitlung ih an hau vekin le Lebanon ih thing ṭhabik tla an thluk vekin Bawipa in anmah tla cu a thluk ding a si."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David le a tefa sin pawl ih siangpahrang an ṭuannak cu hau mi thingkung bangtuk a si. Asinain thingbul in hnge dang a cerh saal ṭheu bangtuk in David tefa sin sung ihsin siangpahrang a thar a suak ding.","title":"Ral Daihnak Ram"},"2":{"text":"Bawipaió thlarau in fimnak a pe ding; A mi pawl uk thiamnak le theihthiamnak a pe ding. Bawipaió duhnak cu a theithiam dingih a ṭih ding;"},"3":{"text":"Bawipaió hnaṭuan kha a lungawinak a si ding. Mit zohnak le mi simnak men in thu a ṭhen lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Mi farah pawl thu cu ṭhatein a ṭhensak dingih, Bawmtu neilo pawl an covo a hum sak ding. A thupeknak vekin minung cu hrem an si dingih, Mi ṭha lo pawl cu thah an si ding."},"5":{"text":"Dingnak le felnak thawn a minung pawl a uk ding."},"6":{"text":"Cinghnia le tuu an um tlaang dingih, Tlavang le me te an bok tlaang ding. Caw faate le kiosa faate rawl an ei tlaang dingih Nauhak in an kilkhawi hai ding."},"7":{"text":"Caw le savom rawl an ei tlaang dingih An faate pawl cu an bok tlaang ding. Caw bangin kiosa in fangkuang ro a ei ding."},"8":{"text":"Naute khal tuahmawhnak a tong lo ding, Rul tur nei kiangih a lek rero hmanah."},"9":{"text":"Pathian tlang thianghlim Zion ahcun, Tuahmawhnak le ṭhatlonak zianghman a um lo ding. Ziangahtile tifinriat ih tidai a khah vekin Leilung cu Bawipa theihnak in a khat ding."},"10":{"text":"Cui ni ah David tefa sin sung ihsin siangpahrang a thar a suak dingih miphun tampi hrangah khihhmuhnak a si ding. A khawpi sungah an tongkhawm aw dingih upatnak an pe ding.","title":"Sal Taang Mi An Kir"},"11":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah cun Bawipa in a huham a langter saal dingih, Assiria ram, Izipt ram, Pathros ram, Sudan ram, Elam ram, Babilonia le Hamath ram le tipikap ram le tidai ih kulh mi ram pawl ihsin a taang hrih mi a mi pawl cu a khawm saal ding."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in a thantaar a khaisaang dingih Israel le Judah mi, ṭhekdarh a si mi pawl cu leilung killi ihsin ka khawmsaal ding, ti langternak ah miphun tampi hnenah a hmuh ding."},"13":{"text":"Israel ram in Judah cu a halhsik nawn lo dingih Judah cu Israel ral a si nawn lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Hmun khat ah an ṭang tlaang dingih nitlaknak lamah Filistin le nisuahnak lamih a um mi pawl an do ding. Edom mi le Moab mi pawl an neh dingih Ammon mi pawl in an thu an ngai ding."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in Suez tidai kel cu a kangter dingih Zufratis tiva kangter dingah thli sa a hrangter dingih tivate pasarih lawng a zuah ding; cuticun zokhal in an tan thei ding."},"16":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin an pupa pawl suahnak hrangih lamzinpi a rak um vek khan Assiria ram ihsin cutawkih a nungdam sun a minung Israel mi pawl hrangah misenpi suahnak lamzin a um ding."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah senpi in: “Maw Bawipa , nangmah ka lo thangṭhat; Ka parah na thin a rak heng naan Atu ahcun i hneem ih na thin a heng nawn lo.","title":"Lungawinak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Pathian cu i Runtu a si; Amah ka rinsan dingih ka phang lo ding. Bawipa in huham le thazaang i pek; Amah cu i Runtu a si."},"3":{"text":"Tihal mi hrangah ti thiangte cu An lungawinak a si bangin, Pathian ih minung hrangah a runnak cu An lungawinak a si,” tiah hla an sa ding."},"4":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah misenpi in: “ Bawipaió hnenah lungawinak thu sim uh; A lo bawmtu dingah amah ko uh. Miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah a tuah mi sim uh; A natsat zia than uh!"},"5":{"text":"Bawipaió hnenah hla sa uh! Mangbangza thil tampi a tuah zo a si. Cui thuthang cu leilung pumpi in thei seh."},"6":{"text":"Zion ih a um mi hmuahhmuah in Hla sa hai sehla au hai seh. Israel ih Pathian thianghlim cu amak a si; A minung pawl hnenah a um,” tiah hla an sa ding."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon ih thu ah Pathian ṭong a ra mi Amoz fapa Isaiah in a theih mi cu hiti in a si.","title":"Pathian In Babilon A Hrem Ding"},"2":{"text":"Tlangpar phul ahcun raldonak thantaar thlai uh! A puarthau mi khawpi kotka pawl do dingah nan ralkap pawl hnenah napi in au uhla do thlang uh tinak ah nan kut hawi uh."},"3":{"text":"Bawipaió hmaihngalnak a co tu le in a porh aw zet mi a ralkap pawl cu do awknak thianghlim ih ral do dingah le a thinheng tertu pawl hrem dingah a ko zo a si."},"4":{"text":"Tlangpar ihsin a thang mi thawmvang cu ngaihnik uh! Misenpi awn-au thawng, ram tampi le miphun tampi an tonkhawmnak thawmvang cu! Ralkap tampi ih Bawipa in a ralkap pawl cu raldo dingah a tiarter a si."},"5":{"text":"A ralkap pawl cu lamhlapi vanhramdeng ihsin an ra. A thinheng in hi ram pumpi cu Bawipa in a siatsuah ding."},"6":{"text":"Ṭap ai uh! Bawipaió ni cu a nai zo; Cungnungbik in siatsuahnak a thlenter ding ni a ra thleng zik thlang."},"7":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah ih kut cu thacem in a zawng thluahthlo dingih an thinlung tla a der ṭheh ding."},"8":{"text":"Ṭihphannak le tuksumnak in an khat dingih naute neih zikih nunau nat bangin thinharnak le natnak in a ciah hai ding. Ṭihnak in pakhat le pakhat an zoh aw dingih ningzahnak in an hmai cu a sen ṭheh ding."},"9":{"text":"Bawipaió ni cu a rathleng zik thlang, Bawipaió thinheng ni le aithok ni cu! Leilung pumpi hi ramṭhing ah a cang dingih misual hmuahhmuah cu an hloral ṭheh ding."},"10":{"text":"Van arsi le arsi burpi khal an tleu lo ding; ni a suah tikah a thim dingih thlapi khal a vang lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Leilung pumpi parah thih hlohnak poimawh ka thlengter dingih mi ṭha lo pawl cu an sualnak ruangah ka hrem ding. Mi hngal pawl cu ka vuakdai hai dingih mi puarthau le zaangfah neilo pawl cu ka hrem ding."},"12":{"text":"A nungdam sun cu sui hnakin an mal sawn ding"},"13":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa Keimah in ka thinhengnak ka langter ni ahcun van khi ka hnin ṭheh dingih leilung tla a umnak ihsin phong ko in a khur ding."},"14":{"text":"Babilon ih a um mi ramdangmi pawl cu an khua le an ram ciarah an tlan dingih khaaltu neilo tuu bangtuk in le ramtawi pawl hmai ihsin sakhi a tlan vekin an tlanhlo ṭheh ding."},"15":{"text":"Zokhal sisehla kaih ngah mi poh cu ralnam in sunthat le sahthat a si ding."},"16":{"text":"An mithmuh rori ah an naute pawl cu sop ṭheh in an vuak that ding; an innsung thilri an lak dingih an nupi pawl kaihrem in an sualpi ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, “Babilon do dingah Median mi pawl ka forh. Anmah tla cu sui a duh lomi le ngun a poisa lomi an si."},"18":{"text":"An li le an thal thawn mino an that ding. Naute parah siseh, tleirawl parah siseh zaangfahnak zianghman an neilo ding."},"19":{"text":"Babilon ram cu ram mawibik a si; an ram minung pawl in an porh bik mi ram a si. Sikhalsehla Bawipa Keimah in Sodom le Gomorrah ka siatsuah vekin ka siatsuah thluh ding."},"20":{"text":"Babilon ah zohman an um duh nawn lo ding. Hmunkhat ihsin hmun dangih a ceer ringringtu Arab mi tla in an puanthlam an sak duh lo dingih tuukhal pawl khal in an tuu an khal duh lo ding."},"21":{"text":"Nelrawn ramsa umnak hmun ah a cang dingih sumbuh bu saknak hmunah a cang ding. Cutawkah saam-ar an um dingih zaathar pawl an pet an zuang ding."},"22":{"text":"Ralvennak inn le siangpahrang inn pawl ah cinghnia le kawlkei an bo ceelceel ding. Babilon ih tikcu caan a cem zikte thlang; rei a awh nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung Israel mi pawl parah zaangfah thinpemnak a nei saal dingih amai minung ah a hril saal ding. Anmaió ramah a umter saal dingih an hnenah ramdangmi tla an um ding.","title":"Saltaannak Ihsin An Kirsal"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih a pek mi an ram ih an kir tikah miphun tampi in Israel mi cu an bawm ding. Cule miphun tampi in Israel an rian ding. Israel mi sal ih a rak kaitu pawl cu Israel in sal ah an kai dingih, anmah a rak hremtu pawl cu Israel in a uk ṭheh ding."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi pawl cu an zonzaihnak, an tuarnak le an hnaṭuankhung ihsin a cawl ter dingih awllen caan a tuahsak hai ding.","title":"Babilon Siangpahrang Mithi Khua-ah"},"4":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah Babilon siangpahrang cu an hnihsan dingih, “Mi zaangfah neilo siangpahrang a tla zo! Zohman a hrem thei nawnlo ding!"},"5":{"text":"An neh mi le an lak mi ram minung pawl cat loih a hmuhsuam tu le thinheng in a hremtu siangpahrang siava pawl cu an thilti theinak le an huham thawn a cemter ṭheh a si.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Atu cun leilung pumpuluk ah daihnak le hnangamnak a um dingih zozo khal lungawi sopar te in hla an sa ding."},"8":{"text":"Hi siangpahrang a tlak zo ruangah Lebanon ramih farthing le sidar thing pawl cu an ai a puang ding, ziangahtile anmah hautu siangpahrang a um nawn lo."},"9":{"text":"“Babilon siangpahrang hmuak dingah mithi khua cu a ralring. Leilung tlun an nunlai ih upa a rak si mi pawl ih thlarau cu an timlaam aw ih, siangpahrang pawl ih thlarau cu an tokham ihsin an tho."},"10":{"text":"An zate in an au ih, ‘Atu cun kanmah vekin na ṭawnṭai ve thlang! Kanmah vek thotho na sihi!"},"11":{"text":"Ṭingṭang awn-mawi thawn an lo hmuak ṭheu mi cu atu ahcun mithi khua Sheol na thleng ve a sihi! Tholung cu na ihkhun ah an cangih na puan sin mi khal tholung thotho an sihi!’ tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Maw Babilon siangpahrang, deirel arsi, nang cu van ihsin na tla zo! Tuihlan ahcun ram tampi na neh, atu ahcun leilungah vuakthlak na si!"},"13":{"text":"Van ah kai na tum ih a saangbik arsi tlunah na tokham ret na tum. Khuavang pawl an tokhawmnak saklam tlang parah siangpahrang bangtuk ih to ding na rak ruat."},"14":{"text":"Khawdur tlunah ka kai dingih Cungnungbik bangtuk ka si ding, na ti."},"15":{"text":"Asinain a thuknak bik hmun mithi khua ah dirhthlak na si zo."},"16":{"text":"Mithi pawl in ṭhep lo le aang loin an lo zoh dingih, “Leilung tlun a hnin ṭheh tu le ram tampi a khur tertu cu hi pa hi maw a si?"},"17":{"text":"Khua tampi a siatsuahtu le leilungtlun ramṭhing ih a cangtertu cu amah hi maw a si? A salkaihmi a thlah dah lotu le an inn ih tlunter a sianglotu cu amah hi maw a si?” tiah an ti ding."},"18":{"text":"Leilung tlun siangpahrang hmuahhmuah cu a ṭhazet le a mawizet mi thlaan ah phum an si;"},"19":{"text":"a sinan nang cu thlaan na nei loih na ruak cu a thu dingah hlonlak mi a si. Ral ih an thah mi ralkap pawl ruak thawn hmun khatah lungkua sungih hlon mi na si ih palcih rero mi na si!"},"20":{"text":"Na ram na siatsuah ih na minung pawl na thah ruangah siangpahrang dang bangtuk in sunglawi ih phum na tong lo a si. Miṭha lo sung, na sungkhat pawl zohman an nung lo ding."},"21":{"text":"That ṭheh hai uh! Hi siangpahrang ih fapa pawl cu an pu le an pa pawl ih sualnak ruangah an thi ding. Anmaió sung zohman in leilungtlun ah mi uktu an canglo dingih khua dintu khal an um lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Babilon ka do dingih ka siatsuah ṭheh ding. Ka zuah mi zianghman a um lo ding-nauhak khal ka zuah lo ding; zohman an luat lo ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo.","title":"Pathian In Babilon A Siatsuah Ding"},"23":{"text":"Babilon cu cirhduup ah ka cangter dingih cutawkah sumbuh an um ding. Babilon cu siatsuahnak hmunphiah in ka phiat dingih ziang hmuahhmuah a phiat hlo ṭheh ding. Cungnungbik Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo."},"24":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in siat a serh ih, “Ka khuakhan mi cu a kim ding. Ka tum mi hmuahhmuah cu tuah ṭheh a si ding.","title":"Pathian In Assiria A Siatsuah Ding"},"25":{"text":"Ka ta a si mi Israel ram sungih Assiria mi pawl cu ka siatsuah dingih ka tlang parah ka palbeek hai ding. Ka minung pawl ih phurh mi Assiria kawn cu ka hlih sak dingih an thilrit cu ka ṭhum sak ding."},"26":{"text":"Cumi cu leilung pumpi hrangah ka tumtah mi a si ih miphun pawl hrem dingah ka kut ka hawi zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Himi tuahsuak dingah cungnungbik Bawipa cun a tum rori a si. A kut cu daantat dingah a hawi zo ih zohman in an kham thei nawn lo ding."},"28":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahaz a thih kum ah hi thu cu Pathian hnen ihsin a ra:","title":"Pathian In Filistin Mi A Siatsuah Ding"},"29":{"text":"Maw Filistin mi pawl, an lo vuaknak fung cu a kiak zo; a sinan nan lungawi duh hlah uh! Rul pakhat a thih tikah a ai-ah a hraangdeuh mi rul dang pakhat a suak a si. Rul in ti a tit ih a zuang thei mi rulhreng a keuh."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa cu a minung pawl lakih mi zonzai le mi farah pawl kilkhawitu a si dingih himte in a umter ding. Sikhalsehla nannih Filistin mi parah cun nasazet in paam a tlungter dingih pakhat hman nan luat lo ding."},"31":{"text":"Maw Filistin khua pawl, bomnak dil in au uhla aihram uh! Nan zate in thinphang in um uh! Saklam ihsin ralkap ratnak leikhu cu khawdur bangin a ra, cuih ralkap lakah ṭihhrut pakhat hman an um lo."},"32":{"text":"Filistin ram ihsin a ra mi palai pawl cu ziangtin so kan son ding? Bawipa in Zion cu a tihnget zo ih harsatnak a tuar ringringtu a minung pawl cu cutawkah humhimnak an ngah ding, tiah kan sawn ding."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihi Moab ih thuhla a si: Ar le Kir khawpi cu zan zankhat sungah siatsuah an si ih, Moab ram cu a ṭhing reprep.","title":"Pathian In Moab A Siatsuah Ding"},"2":{"text":"Dibon khua mi pawl cu biakṭheng ih ṭap dingah tlang parah an kai. Moab mi pawl cu Nebo le Medeba khua pawl an hmuh tikah riahsia le ninghang in an ṭap an ai. An riahsia in an sam le an khahmul an meet ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Khawsung lamzin ih a feh pawl in buri hnipuan an hruk; an khuasuah le an inn parin an ṭap ih an raak an kio."},"4":{"text":"Heshbon le Elealeh khua mi pawl cu an ṭap an au ih an aw cu Jahaz tiang a thang. Ralkap ralṭhabik hman an khur; an ralṭhatnak cu a hlo ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Moab hrangah ka thin a na a si! A minung pawl cu Zoar khua le Eglath Shelishiyah khua tiang an tlan ṭheh. Mi hrekkhat cu Luhith lamzin an zawh ih an feh phah ah an ṭap vivo; a hrek cu Horonaim lamah an tlan ih lungngai in an ṭap phah vivo."},"6":{"text":"Nimrim Tiva cu a kang ṭheh, a kiangkap ih hrampi cu an vuai ṭheh; a hringmi zianghman a um nawn lo."},"7":{"text":"An neih mi hmuahhmuah thiar in Partiam Phairawn an tan ih khatlam ralah tlan an tum."},"8":{"text":"Moab ramri kipah ṭahnak thawm a thang. Eglaim le Beerelim khua khalah an ṭahnak thawm a thang."},"9":{"text":"Dibon khua ah tiva cu thisen in a khat; a sinan cuhnak ih besia deuh an hrangah Pathian in a thlengter hrih ding. A si, Moab ram sungih a taangsun mi pahnih khat tla cu thah ṭheh an si ding."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nelrawn ih a um mi Sela khua ih Moab mi pawl in Jerusalem khua ih mi uk bawi hnenah tuu faate laksawng ah an kuat.","title":"Moab Hrangah Ruahsannak A Um Lo"},"2":{"text":"Cule a bu ihsin dawi mi vate bangin, tumtah mi nei cuca loin Arnon Tivakap ahcun an suk an so ih an hngak."},"3":{"text":"Judah mi hnenah, “Ziang so kan tuah ding, in sim hnik uh! Sun nilingah thing daihnem ih kan colh bangin nan thladem hnuai ah in colhter hram uh! Kannih cu raltlan mi kan si ih zohman ih in hmuh theilonak hmunah in thup hram uh!"},"4":{"text":"Nan ram sungah in umter hram uhla a siatsuah in duhtu pawl ih kut ihsin in humhim hram uh,” tiah an dil. (Hremnak le siatsuahnak cu a reh dingih ram pumpi siatsuahtu pawl cu an cem ding."},"5":{"text":"Cule David tefa sin pakhatkhat cu siangpahrang ah a cang dingih a minung pawl cu duhdawtnak le rintlak sinak thawn a uk hai ding. A hman mi tuah dingah a zamrang dingih thudik lawnglawng a ṭan ding a si.)"},"6":{"text":"Judah mi pawl in, “Moab mi pawl an puarthau zia cu kan theih ṭheh mi a si! An hngal zia le mi an hmuhsuam cu zapi theih a si; a sinan an tluangkhawnnak cu zianghman a si lo,” an ti."},"7":{"text":"Moab mi pawl cu an tuar mi harnak ruangah an ṭap ding. Cule Kir Heres khua sungih rawl thawthaw an ei ṭheu mi an vun ruahsaal tik khalah an ṭap ding. An zate in an bei a dong ding."},"8":{"text":"Heshbon khua kiangih lo pawl le Sibmah sabit hmuan ihsin ram uktu bawi pawl ri tertu sabit a suak. Hitawkih sabit kuang cu an ṭhazet ih Jazer khua tiang a zaam; nisuahnak lamah nelrawn tiang, nitlaknak lam ahcun Tili Thi khatlam ral tiang a zaam a si."},"9":{"text":"Atu ahcun Jazer khua hrangih ka ṭah vekin Sibmah sabit kuang cu ka ṭah, ziangahtile an lungawi tertu dingah rawl lak ding an neilo."},"10":{"text":"Loram cu a ṭhazet nan zohman an lung a awi lo. Sabit hmuan sungah zohman awn-au an um lo, hla khal an sak lo. Zohman in sabit an ciil lo; lungawi ih awn-aunak cu a reh ih a ṭhing reprep."},"11":{"text":"Moab le Kir Heres hrangah riahsia in ka hruum ruangro."},"12":{"text":"Moab mi pawl tlangpar biakṭheng le an biakinn ah thlacam dingih an feh rero cu an tha an baangter lak men; zianghman a ṭhahnem lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Hi thu cu a hlanah Pathian in Moab hnenih a rak sim mi a si."},"14":{"text":"Cule atu ah Bawipa in, “Atu ihsin kum thum cekci ah Moab ram sungih sumsaw le lennak hmuahhmuah cu a cem ṭheh ding. Minung an tamzet nan mi malte lawng an nung dingih an ṭawnṭai zet ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Damaskas cu khawpi a si nawn lo ding; a siat ṭheh mi hnawmpen a si ding.","title":"Pathian In Damaskas Le Israel A Hrem Ding"},"2":{"text":"Siria ramih khua pawl cu kumkhua in tlansan mi khua an si ding. Tuu le caw tlannak leenkolh a si dingih cuih ṭilva pawl cu zohman in an dawi lo ding."},"3":{"text":"Israel khal ṭannak neilo a si dingih Damaskas cu a zalennak a hlo ding. Siria mi a nungsun pawl cu Israel mi vekin ningzak le mualpho in an um ding. Keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka sim zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, “Israel ih natsatnak a cem ni a thleng cing ding; a lennak cu farahnak in a thlengsak ding."},"5":{"text":"Israel cu rawl lak ṭheh zomi lo bangtuk a si ding. Rawl an lak cia mi Refaim Phairawn ih lo vekin a kolh ṭheh ding."},"6":{"text":"Mi malte lawng an nung ding. Israel cu, a rah an lawh ṭheh ih a ziik ah pum hnih thum, a hnge ah pum li nga a taangmi Olif kung bangtuk a si ding. Keimah, Israel ih Bawipa Pathian in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah mi pawl in anmah seemsuahtu, Israel ih Pathian thianghlim hnenah bomnak duh ah an hoi ding."},"8":{"text":"Anmaió kutih an tuahcop mi biakṭheng pawl cu an rinsan nawn lo ding; an kutzung in a suak mi Asherah pathiannu biaknak a zarhmi thingphun pawl le mei-ur thawinak hrangih biakṭheng pawl khal an rinsan nawn lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah cun ṭhate ih an kulh mi khua pawl cu an tlansan ṭheh dingih, Israel mi ṭih ruangah a tlantu Hiv mi le Amor mi khawpi pawl bangin, an khua pawl cu an tan ṭheh ding a si."},"10":{"text":"Maw Israel, lungpi bangin a lo runtu le a lo humtu Pathian cu na hngilh zo. Ram dang Pathian be dingin hmuan thianghlim tuah na tum a si."},"11":{"text":"Asinain na phun zing rori ah an ṭhang ih an mum an par hmanah rawl lak ding cu na nei cuanglo ding. Harsatnak le a dam theilo mi natnak lawng a um ding."},"12":{"text":"Ram cak zetzet pawl cu an buai ciam co. An buainak thawmvang cu tifinriat huuk thawm le a nasazet mi tisuar thawm bangtuk a si.","title":"Ral Pawl An Sung"},"13":{"text":"Ral pawl cu tisuar bangin mi an nor ciamco; a sinan Pathian in a kawk hai ih dungah an siip; tlang parih thli sem mi leivut bangtuk le phusiing ih lak mi fangkuang ro vekin an hloral ta a si."},"14":{"text":"Zanlam ahcun tuksumza; a sinan zinglam ahcun an hlo ṭheh! Kan ram a siimtu hmuahhmuah in cubangtuk an si ciar ding."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sudan ram tiva khatlam ralih a um mi ramah thlakhawn thawmvang a thang.","title":"Pathian In Sudan A Hrem Ding"},"2":{"text":"Cui ramih thlah mi ram palai pawl cu Nail tivapi par in phaipheng ih tuah mi lawng in an ra. Maw palai cak pawl, zamrangin kirsal uh! Thuhla cu nan ramah kirpi saal uh; Nail tiva puutnak, a cakmi le huham a nei mi nan ramah, leilung pumpi ih an ṭih mi-misaang le vunngil mi nan miphun hnenah cun kirsal uh."},"3":{"text":"Leilung tlunih a um mi hmuahhmuah in ngai uh! Tlangzim parih an thlai dingmi khihhmuhnak thantaar zoh uh! Tawtawrawt an tum awn ngai uh!"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Sun laiah vaang kelkel ih ni a tlan bangtuk le rawl lak caan khawhlum zanah daite ih dai a tlak bangtuk in ka umnak vancung ihsin ka run zoh ding."},"5":{"text":"Sabit par an tla ṭheh ih a rah an hmin phah vivo laifang sabit rah lak a cuut deuh hlanah Sudan mi pawl cu nam hriamzet in sabit hnge olzet ih a sahcat thei vekin olzet in ral in a siatsuah ding."},"6":{"text":"An ralkap ruak pawl cu phum loin an taan dingih vate le ramsa hrangah an si ding. Khawṭhal caanah vate in an ei dingih thlatang ah ramsa in an ei ding a si,” tiah i ti."},"7":{"text":"Tikcu caan a rathleng dingih Nail tiva puutnak ram, a cakmi le huham a nei mi ram, leilung pumpi ih an ṭih mi misaang le vunngil mi pawl in Cungnungbik Bawipa hnenah thawinak an peknak caan a thleng ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa biaknak hmun Zion Tlang ahcun an ra ding a si."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Izipt hrangih a thleng mi thu: Bawipa cu zamrang zetin mero parah a to ih Izipt ah a ra a si. A hmaiah Izipt ih milem pawl cu an khur ih Izipt mi pawl ih ralṭhatnak cu a hlo.","title":"Pathian In Izipt A Hrem Ding"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Izipt ram sungah mah le mah do awknak ral ka tho ter ding; unau le unau an do aw dingih innhnen le innhnen tla an ral aw ding. A hua aw mi khua pakhat le pakhat an do aw dingih a ral aw mi siangpahrang pawl cu mi uk theinak huham duh ah an do aw ding."},"3":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl ih tumtah mi cu ka siatbal ṭheh dingih an thinlung ka siat ter ding. An milem hnenah bomnak an dil ding; pol an leeng dingih mithi thlarau pawl thu an ron ding."},"4":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl cu miheer le mi puarthau kut sungah ka pek dingih mi zaangfah neilo siangpahrang in a uk hai ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa Keimah in ka sim zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Nail tivapi ah tidai a malzet dingih nuamte in a kang ṭheh ding."},"6":{"text":"A tiva ṭeek pawl cu an nam zet dingih an caar ṭheh ve ding. Phaipheng le phok pawl cu an vuai ṭheh ding;"},"7":{"text":"Nail tivakap ih ciin mi rawl kung hmuahhmuah an caar ṭheh dingih thli in a semhlo thluh ding."},"8":{"text":"Nail tivapi ih ngakaih in pum a cawmtu hmuahhmuah an hruum an ai ding; an sio le an sur pawl cu a lak an si ṭheh ding."},"9":{"text":"Puanthaan tuahtu pawl an thin a nau ding;"},"10":{"text":"thiamtaktu le zungthiam pawl cu an thin a pit dingih an van a sang ding."},"11":{"text":"Zoan khua ih hotu pawl cu mi-aa hlir an si! Izipt mifim bik pawl in at-thlak thu an forh. Hlanlai siangpahrang le mifim pawl ai-awhtu kan si tiah ziangtinso siangpahrang an sim ngam?"},"12":{"text":"Maw Izipt siangpahrang, khui ah so na mifim pawl an si ṭheh? Cungnungbik Bawipa in Izipt hrangih tumtahnak a neih mi hi an lo sim thei hmang ding nan!"},"13":{"text":"Zoan le Memfis hotu pawl cu mi-aa an si! An miphun hruaitu ding an si nan an hruaisual zo a si!"},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in thinlung buainak a pek hai ih an thusimmi khal a buai ṭheh. Curuangah Izipt in thilsual lawnglawng a tuah ih zuri pa cu amai luak par lala ih a sawn vekin Izipt cu a sawn rero a si."},"15":{"text":"Izipt ram sungah milian siseh, mi farah siseh mitum siseh, mi nauta siseh a bawm theitu zohman an um lo."},"16":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl cu nunau bangih a ṭihhrut caan a rathleng ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa in anmah hrem dingih a kut a thlir kha an hmuh tikah an tuksum in an ṭhia thlohthlo ding.","title":"Izipt In A Biak Ding"},"17":{"text":"An hrangah Bawipa in a ruah cia mi an theihsaal tinte in Izipt mi in Judah mi pawl cu an ṭih ringring ding."},"18":{"text":"Cui caan a thlen tikah Izipt khua panga ah Hebru ṭong an hmang ding. Cutawkih a um mi pawl in siatserh ih thu an kam tikah Cungnungbik Bawipa hmin in an kam ding. Khua pakhat cu, “Ni khawpi,” tiah an ti ding."},"19":{"text":"Cui caan a thlen tikah Izipt ramah Bawipaió hmin in biakṭheng pakhat an dawl dingih Izipt ramri ah a hmin in lungphun an phun ding."},"20":{"text":"Cupawl cu Izipt ramah Cungnungbik Bawipa a um ti khihhmuhnak an si ding. Cutawkih a um mi pawl in hremnak an tuar ih bomnak dilin Bawipa an kawh tikah anmah runtu dingah Bawipa in mi pakhat a thlah ding."},"21":{"text":"Izipt mi hnenah Bawipa cu a lang leh ding. Cutikah Bawipa cu an ṭihzah ding, an biak dingih a hnenah thawinak le laksawng an keng ding. A hnenah thu fekten an kam dingih an thukam mi vekin an tuah ding."},"22":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl cu Bawipa in a hrem ding, a sinan a damter saal hai ding. Amah lam an hoi dingih an thlacamnak a theihsak dingih a damter hai ding."},"23":{"text":"Cui caan a thlen tikah Izipt le Assiria karlakah lamzinpi a um ding. Hi ram hnih ih minung pawl cu olte in an tlawng aw thei dingih hmun khatah Pathian an be tlaang ding."},"24":{"text":"Cui caan a thlen tikah Israel cu Izipt le Assiria thawn an ṭangtlang dingih an ram thum cu leilung pumpi hrangah thlawsuahnak an si ding."},"25":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in thlawsuahnak a pe hai dingih, “Izipt ka minung, Assiria ka kut tuah mi, le Israel ka hril mi, nan parah thlawsuahnak um hram seh,” a ti ding."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Assiria ram siangpahrang Sargon thupeknak vekin Assiria ralkap hotu ralbawi le a ralkap pawl in Filistin pawl ih khua Ashdod an do.","title":"Lawngte-ih Tlangmi Profet"},"2":{"text":"A hlankhan kum thum in Bawipa in Amoz fapa Isaiah cu a hruk mi a buri hnipuan le a kedam pawl phuak dingah a fial zo. A fial vekin a tuah ih lawngfangkheh le kedam loin a um."},"3":{"text":"Ashdod an lak tikah Bawipa in, “Ka siahhlawh Isaiah cu lawngte in le kedam loin kum thum sung a um zo. Himi cu Izipt le Sudan parih a thleng dingmi thil khihhmuhnak a si."},"4":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang in hi ram ramhnih ihsin a kaih mi sal pawl cu lawngfangkheh in a hruaihlo hai ding. Mino siseh, upa siseh, ke lawng le lawngfangkheh in an feh ding; an zahmawh tla a lang ṭheh dingih Izipt hrangah cun ningzahnak ngaingai a si ding."},"5":{"text":"Sudan ram a rinsantu le Izipt ram a porh rero tu pawl cu an bei a dong dingih an thin a pit ding."},"6":{"text":"Cui caan a thlen tikah Filistin ram tipikap ih a um mi pawl cun, ‘Assiria siangpahrang kut ihsin in humtu ding ti ih kan rinsan mi pawl ziang an cang, zohhnik uh! Ziangtin so kan luat thei ding?’ an ti ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon ram hrangih a thleng mi thu: Nelrawn ihsin phusiing bangin thihhlohnak poimawh cu ṭihnungza ram in a ra thleng ding.","title":"Babilon Ram A Siatnak Ding"},"2":{"text":"Ṭihnungza thil a cangmi in langnak ka hmu-zuarthlainak le siatsuahnak hlir a si. Maw Elam ralkapbu, do uh! Media ralkap pawl, khua pawl cu kulh ṭheh uh! Babilon in a thlen ter mi harsatnak le tuarnak pawl cu Pathian in a cemter thlang ding."},"3":{"text":"Langnak sungih ka hmuh mi cun ka sungah ṭihnak le natnak a suah ter-nunau nauneih nat bangtuk a si."},"4":{"text":"Ka thin a tur dukdo ih ṭihnak le thlaphannak in i zeel. Zanlam a thlen ding cu ka hngakhlap zet; a sinan a ra thlen ngaingai tikah ṭihphannak in ka khat thotho."},"5":{"text":"Langnak ka hmuh mi ahcun rawl ei puai an tiimlaam ciamco khi ka hmu. An sawm mi pawl tonak ah puan sahsah an phah. An ei an in. Cule rinlopi ah thupek a thang, “Ralbawi pawl, tho uhla nan ralphaw la uh!” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Feh awla ralvengtu ret aw; a hmuh mi lo sim seh."},"7":{"text":"Rang to tahrat in mi pahnih pahnih in a ra mi le laak le kalauk to in a ra mi a hmuh asile ṭhateih zoh dingah sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule ralvengtu cun, “ Bawipa , a sun a zan in ralveng in ka ding a si,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Rinlopi ah an ra thleng! Rang to tahrat in pahnih pahnih in an ra. Ralvengtu in thu a than, “Babilon a tlu zo! An biakmi milem pawl cu an kuai ṭheh ih leilung ah an ril teptep!” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Maw Israel ka minung pawl, sangvut vekih ciil zo mi nan si, a sinan atu ah Israel ih Pathian, Cungnungbik Bawipa hnen ihsin ka theih mi thuthang ṭha cu nan hnenah ka than zo."},"11":{"text":"Edom ram hrangah a ra thleng mi thu: Edom ihsin mi pakhat in i ko ih, “Maw ralvengtu, zan khawthim hi ziangtik ah so a cem ding? Tuan ah khua a vang ding maw? I sim hnik!” a ti.","title":"Edom Parih Thu Thleng"},"12":{"text":"Cutikah kei in, “Zinglam a ra thleng cing ding; a sinan zan khawthim a ra saal ding. Thusuh na duh hrih ahcun ra saal awla i ra suut aw,” tiah ka ti."},"13":{"text":"Arabia ram hrangih a ra thleng mi thu: Nannih Dedan mi, phulcaar Arabia ramih ṭilva thawn a riak tu pawl,","title":"Arabia Parih Thu Thleng"},"14":{"text":"tihal in nan hnenih a ratu pawl cu tidai rak pek uh. Tema ramih a um mi pawl, raltlan mi pawl hnenah rawl pe uh."},"15":{"text":"Mitampi cu ralnam ih thah ṭih ah an tlan; conkiang ih sai ṭih ah an tlan ih ral an ṭih ruangah an tlan a si."},"16":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, “Kumkhat cekci sungah Kedar miphun pawl ih cahnak le sunlawinak cu a cem ding."},"17":{"text":"Kedar ramsung mi lakah conkiang hmangtu pawl cu mi ralṭhabik pawl an si; a sinan mi malte lawng an taang ding. Keimah Israel ih Pathian, Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah i ti."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Langnak Phairawn hrangih a thleng mi thu: Ziang so an tuah? Ziangah so khawpisung mi pawl an inn par diphun ah puai an tuah ciamco?","title":"Jerusalem Hrangih Thu Thleng"},"2":{"text":"An khua pumpi in lungawi in an au an kio ih an thawmvang cu a nasa ngaingai. Tuihṭum raldonak ih a thi mi nan minung pawl cu ral an do ruangih a thi mi an si lo."},"3":{"text":"Nan hotu pawl an tlan ṭheh ih thal pakhat hman an sai hlanah kaih mi an si."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah i fehsan thluh uh; keimah lawng ka minung a thi mi pawl hrangah ninghang in ka ṭap rero ding. A leem khal i tum hlah uh!"},"5":{"text":"Langnak Phairawn ah atu hi ṭih ih buai caan, ral sung caan le mangbang ih um caan a si ih, cumicu Cungnungbik Pathian Bawipa in kan parih a thlenter mi a si. Kan khawpi kulhnak ralhruang cu an balcim ṭheh zo ih bomnak dil ih aunak aw cu tlang kipah a khawk vivo."},"6":{"text":"Elam ram ihsin ralkap pawl cu rang parin an ra ih li le thal an keng. Kir ram ih ralkap pawl cun ralphaw thawn an tim an tuah ṭheh zo."},"7":{"text":"Ram ṭhazet Judah phairawn ahcun rangleng an khat ih rang ralkap pawl cu Jerusalem kotka hmaiah an ding ṭheh zo."},"8":{"text":"Judah ralhruang le an ṭannak pawl a cim ṭheh. Cui caan a thlen tikah hriamnam nan retnak inn ihsin hriamnam nan suah ciamco."},"9":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi kulhnak pharah rem a ṭulmi pawl nan hmu. Jerusalem khua sungih inn nan siar ciamco ih khawpi kulhnak phar remnak hrangih lungto duh ah inn hrekkhat cu nan bal. Khawpi sungih tidai khawlnak dingah,","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"khawpi kulhnak phar sunglam ah tikhawlnak tumpi nan dawl ih ticawm hlun ihsin tidai nan run luangter. Sikhalsehla hi thil hmuahhmuah a rak tumtu le a cangtertu Pathian sawn cu zianghman ah nan siar lo."},"12":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in ṭap le ai dingah le nan sam meet ṭheh ding le buri hnipuan hruk dingah a lo ko hai a si."},"13":{"text":"Asinain nan hni nan kheek ih puai nan tuah sawn. Ei dingah caw le tuu nan that ih sabit nan in ciamco. “Kan ei kan in pei cu! Thaisun ah kan thi ding a si,” nan ti."},"14":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa Amah rori in ka hnenah, “Hi an ṭhatlonak hi an nunsung hmuahhmuah ngaidam an si lo pei. Keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in siangpahrang innsungsang hotu Shebna hnen ah i feh ter ih,","title":"Shebna Hnenah Ralrinnak Peknak"},"16":{"text":"“Zo ka si tiah so na ruat aw? Tlangpar lungto lakah na hrangah thlaan lai dingin zo in so thu a lo pek?"},"17":{"text":"Mi upa pakhat cu na si ve nan Bawipa in a lo thur dingih a lo hlonhlo mai ding."},"18":{"text":"Bawhlung vekin hluum ko in a lo khirh dingih ram kaupi ah a lo hlon ding. Cutawkah na hngalpi zet mi rangleng kiangah na thi ding. Na bawipa ih innsungsang ningzak tertu na si."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa in na hnaṭuannak ihsin a lo hlon dingih na hnaṭuan saang ihsin a lo ṭhum ding,” ti ih sim dingah i fial."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in Shebna hnenah, “Cui caan a thlen tikah Hilkiah fapa ka siahhlawh Eliakim ka ko ding."},"21":{"text":"Na zung hnaṭuannak korfualpi le na taikhap le na thuneihnak hmuahhmuah ka lak dingih a hnenah ka pe ding. Amah cu Jerusalem le Judah mi pawl hrangah an pa bangtuk a si ding."},"22":{"text":"Amah cu David tefa sin siangpahrang ih thuai ah thuneihnak kimten ka pe ding. Hna a ṭuan theinak dingah a kut ah tawhfung pawl ka pe dingih amah ih a on mi cu zohman in an khar lo ding; amah ih a khar mi cu zohman in an ong lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Amah cu a hngetzet mi thil bannak fungkhen bangin ka hngetter dingih a innsungsang zate hrangah mithmaiṭha ngahnak a hrampi a si ding."},"24":{"text":"“Asinain a sungkhat pawl le a cawm mi pawl cu a hrangah thilrit zet an si ding. Thil bannak fungkhen ah beel le kheng pawl an thlai vekin a parah an thlai aw ding."},"25":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah hngetzet ih khen mi fungkhen cu a der dingih a tlong ding. Cuticun a parih a thlai awmi khal cu an cem ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti. Bawipa in a sim zo a si!"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tair khua hrangih a thlengmi thu: Tipithuanthum parih khualtlawng mi pawl, riahsia in ṭap ai-uh! Nan suah nan luhnak khawpi Tair cu a siat ṭheh zo; inn pawl le lawng colhnak tla a siat ṭheh zo. Saipras ihsin nan lawng pawl an kir tikah cuih thu cu nan thei.","title":"Pathian In Foenisia Khua Pawl A Hrem Ding"},"2":{"text":"Maw Sidon khua ih sumtuahtu pawl, ai-hram uh! Nan minung pawl cu,"},"3":{"text":"Izipt ramih a suak mi rawl lei le zuar tahratin ram tinkim thawn sumtuah dingah tifinriat parah nan thlah hai."},"4":{"text":"Maw Sidon khawpi, ningzakza na si. Tifinriat le tipithuanthum thuuk pawl in an lo khaak ih, “Faate ka nei dah lo. Fapa le fanu khal ka cawm dah lo,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Tair a siat ṭheh a si, ti an theih tikah cun Izipt mi pawl hman an mang a bang dingih an riah a sia ding."},"6":{"text":"Maw Foenisia mi pawl, riahsia in ṭap-ai uh! Spain ramih tlanhlo tum uh!"},"7":{"text":"Khuahlan lai ih an rak din mi, nomnak in a khat mi Tair khawpi rak timi cu hihi a si pei maw? Tifinriat khatlam ralah ramdang lak ding le luah dingah tifinriat raal ih mi a thlahtu khawpi cu hihi a si pei maw?"},"8":{"text":"Leilung tlun ih upat bik mi sumtuahtu tum zetzet umnak, mi-uk bawi umnak Tair khawpi parah zoso hibangtuk in thu a tawlrel?"},"9":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa ih tawlrelmi a si! An hngalnak le an tluangkhawnnak cemter dingah le an upat mi pawl mualpho ter dingah Pathian in a tuah mi a si."},"10":{"text":"Maw Spain ram a va luahtu pawl, va feh uhla lo va thlo uh! A lo humtu ding zohman an um nawn lo."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in a kut cu tifinriat parah a khai ih ram tampi a hlon ṭheh zo. Foenisia ramih pursum leilawnnak hmun tumpipi pawl tla siat ṭheh dingin thu a pek."},"12":{"text":"Maw Sidon khawpi, na lungawinak a cem zo. Na minung pawl cu hremnak an tuarih Saipras ih an tlan khalle an him cuanglo ding. ("},"13":{"text":"Tair khawpi hramlak ramsa tlannak ih a cangtertu cu Assiria mi an si lo, Babilon mi an si. Raldonak innsang cu Babilon mi pawl in an sak ih Tair khawpi kulhnak ralhruang an bal ih khawpi cu an siatsuah ṭheh a si.)"},"14":{"text":"Maw tipithuanthum parih lawng thluntu pawl, riahsia in ṭap-ai uh! Nan rinsanzet mi khawpi cu a siat ṭheh zo a si."},"15":{"text":"Tair khawpi cu siangpahrang sankhat sung caan, kum sawm sarih sung an hngilh tikcu caan a rathleng ding. Cui kum a cem tikah Tair khawpi cu hla sungih hlawhhlangnu vek a si ding."},"16":{"text":"Na ṭingṭang la awla khua sungah tawivak aw; Nang, hngilh zo mi hlawhhlang nu! An lo theih salnak dingah, Na ṭingṭang tum awla na hla sak saal aw."},"17":{"text":"Cui kum sawm sarih a cem tikah Bawipa in Tair cu a hnaṭuan hlun a ṭuanter saal dingih leilungtlun ramkipah hlawhhlang nu a cang saal ding."},"18":{"text":"Pursum leilawn ihsin a ngah mi paisa cu Bawipa hnenah pek a si ding. A paisa cu a khawl ciamco lo ding, a sinan Bawipa a biatu pawl in a paisa cu rawl leinak le an hai mi an hnipuan leinak ah an hmang ding."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in leilung a siatsuah ṭheh dingih a ṭhing reprep ding. Leilung cu a linglet ter dingih minung pawl a ṭhekdarh ṭheh ding.","title":"In Leilung Pumpi A Hrem Ding"},"2":{"text":"Zozo khal sisehla an ton mi a bangraan ṭheh ding-puithiam pawl le senpi pawl, sal pawl le bawi pawl, a leitu le a zuartu pawl, paisa coihtu le cawitu pawl, milian le mifarah pawl an ton mi a bangrep ṭheh ding."},"3":{"text":"Leilung pumpi cu a khingkuai ṭheh dingih a siatbal ṭheh ding. Bawipa in a sim zo ih a sim vekin a cang ding."},"4":{"text":"Leilung cu a caar ih a vuai ṭheh; leilung pumpi cu a derdai; lei le van a siatral ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Mi in Pathian daan an buar ih kumkhua hrangih a tuah mi thukamnak cu an siatbal; cuticun leilung an borhhlawhter a si."},"6":{"text":"Cuhrangah leilung cu siat dingah Pathian in a cam. Leilung mi in an sualman an tuar a si. A nungmi an mal deuhdeuh."},"7":{"text":"Sabit kuang pawl an vuai ih sabit a har deuhdeuh. Lungawi sopar teih a rak um ṭheu mi pawl cu riahsiatnak in an khat."},"8":{"text":"Nuamzet ih hla an sak ṭheunak ṭingṭang le khuang pawl cu an dai zo."},"9":{"text":"Zu an in hmanah nuamzetin hla an sa thei nawn lo; zu ih thawtnak khal an thei nawn lo."},"10":{"text":"Khawpi sung ah ziang hmuahhmuah a buai ṭheh; minung pawl cu luat duh ah inn sungah an kharhkhum aw ṭheh."},"11":{"text":"Mi pawl cu lamzin ah an dingih zu duh ah an au. Nomnak zianghman a um nawn lo; nomnak cu ramsung ihsin kumkhua daih in dawihlo a si zo."},"12":{"text":"Khawpi cu a siat ṭheh ih a kotka pawl cu a bal ṭheh."},"13":{"text":"Leilung tlun ramkipah cuticun a si ṭheh ding. Rawl lak caan a cem ih olif kung ihsin olif rah an vuakthlak ṭheh ih pakhat hman taanglo ih an lak ṭheh caan a bang ding."},"14":{"text":"A taangsun pawl cu lungawi in hla an sak ding. Nitlak lamih a um mi pawl in Pathian a nasatzia an phuang dingih,"},"15":{"text":"nisuahnak lamih a um mi pawl in an thangṭhat ding. Tifinriat kap tluan ih a um mi pawl in Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cu an cawimawi ding."},"16":{"text":"Leilung tlunih a hlabik ram hman in Israel miphun, miphun dik, an thangṭhatnak hla cu kan thei ding. Asinain kei ih hrangah cun beisei ding a um lo. Ka cem deuhdeuh ih ka taksa ruangpi in a daih nawn lo. Mi zuarthlaitu pawl in in zuarthlai thotho ih in zuarthlainak cu ani ani in a besia deuhdeuh."},"17":{"text":"Maw leitlun minung pawl, tuksumnak a um, khur thuukpi a um ih nan hrangah thang kam cia in a um."},"18":{"text":"Tuksumnak ihsin tlanhlo a tumtu cu khur sungah an tla ding; khur ihsin a tlantu cu thang in a awk ding. Van ihsin ruah nasazet in a sur dingih leilung hramṭonak a hnin ṭheh ding."},"19":{"text":"Leilungpi cu a khing ding, a kuai dingih a phel aw ding."},"20":{"text":"Leilungpi cu zuri bangin a sawn dingih thlisia lakih deute bangin a tlu ding. Leilungpi hi a sualnak in a delh tuk zo; a tlu dingih a thosal nawn lo ding."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in tlunlam ih a um mi huham neitu pawl le leilung parih mi-uktu pawl a hremnak tikcu caan a ra thleng ding."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in khur sungih thawngtla bangin siangpahrang pawl a khawm ding. Anmah hremnak tikcu caan a thlen hlan cu thawnginn sungah a khum hai ding."},"23":{"text":"Thlapi a thim ding; ni a tlaang lo ding; ziangahtile Cungnungbik Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si ding. Jerusalem khua Zion Tlang ihsin a uk dingih misenpi hotu pawl in a sunlawinak huham an hmu ding."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah cu ka Pathian na si; Ka lo upat dingih na hmin ka thangṭhat ding. Mangbangza thil pawl na tuah zo; Kum reipi ihsin na tum mi pawl cu Felte in na tuah ṭheh a si.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Khawpi pawl cu na siatbal ṭheh ih, An kulhnak ralhruang pawl na siat ṭheh. Kan ral pawl ih sak mi siangpahrang inn pawl cu, Ziangtik hmanih sak saal nawn lo dingin a siat ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Ram cakzetzet sungih minung pawl in, Nangmah cu an lo thangṭhat ding; Zaangfah neilo ramih khawpi pawl khalin Nangmah cu an lo ṭihzet ding."},"4":{"text":"Mifarah le bawmtu neilo pawl in an lo pan ih Harsatnak caan khalah an him a si. Thlisia a hraan tikah beunak na pek hai ih, Nisat tikih colhnakah daihnem na pek. Thlatang ih thlisia bangin, Zaangfah neilo mi in an do hai;"},"5":{"text":"ramcaar lakih nisen sa bangin; Sikhalsehla Bawipa nangmah in Kan ral pawl cu na daih terih; Zaangfah neilo mi ih au-thawm cu na reh ter, Khawdur in nisa a daihter bangin."},"6":{"text":"Hitawk Zion Tlang parah hin Cungnungbik Bawipa in leilungtlun ramkip le miphunkip hrangah rawl ei puai a tuah ding. Cui rawl ei puai ahcun rawl thawbik le sabit thawbik an pe ding.","title":"Pathian In Rawl Ei Puai A Timlaam"},"7":{"text":"Hi tlangpar ah hin ramtin le miphun tinih riahsiatnak cu mero bangin a kiangter ding."},"8":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in thihnak cu kumkhua in a hloral ter ding. Mi hmuahhmuah ih mitthli a hnul dingih leilungtlun khuazakip ah a minung pawl ih an tuar mi mualpho ningzahnak cu a lak hlosak ding. Bawipa Amah in a sim zo a si."},"9":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah zozo khalin, “Amah cu kan Pathian a si! Amah cu kan rinsan zo ih in runsuak zo a si! Amah cu Bawipa a si! A hnenah kan rinsannak cu kan retih lungawi aipuang in kan um; ziangahtile in hum zo a si,” an ti ding."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in Zion Tlang cu a hum ding; a sinan fangkuangro dawm ih an palbeek bangin Moab mi pawl cu palbeek an si ding.","title":"Pathian In Moab Mi A Hrem Ding"},"11":{"text":"Tileuh tum bangin an kut cu an hawi ding, a sinan Pathian in anmah cu a namthla dingih an kut cu pawk ding neilo in a pil ding."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in Moab mi pawl ih sak mi ralhruang, saangzetzet ih an dawl mi phar pawl cu a balcim dingih leivut ah an cang ṭheh ding."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Misenpi in hi hla cu Judah ramsungih an sak caan a thleng ding: Kan khawpi cu a cak! Pathian Amah in a ralhruang pawl a kil!","title":"Pathian In A Minung Hnenah Nehnak A Pek"},"2":{"text":"Khawpi kotka pawl cu ong uhla, Rintlakzet miphun cu luh ter uh; A dikmi lawng a tuahtu miphun cu!"},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , daihnak famkim cu nangmah in na pe, An tumtah mi ah a hnget mi le Nangmah a lo ringtu hnenah cun!"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu kumkhua in rinsan uh! Amah in in hum ringring ding."},"5":{"text":"Mi puarthau pawl cu a namthlak ih, An umnak khawpi cak hman cu a siatter; An ralhruang phar pawl cu a cimter ih, Leivut ah a cangter ṭheh a si."},"6":{"text":"Atu ahcun rak hrem mi pawl in Cui leivut tlunin an feh ih an ke in an pal."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , miṭha pawl lamzin cu na tluangter; An thlun mi lamzin cu zinphei a si."},"8":{"text":"Na duhnak kan thlun ih kan ruahsannak cu na hnenah a um; Kan duh mi hmuahhmuah cu nangmah na si!"},"9":{"text":"Zan khuavaar in nangmah cu ka lo ngai, Ka thinlung zate in kan lo hlam. Leilung le a minung pawl thu na ṭhen tikah, Thudik cu an thei ṭheh ding."},"10":{"text":"Miṭha lo mi par ah zaangfahnak na nei naan, A dikmi cu an tuah dah cuanglo. Miding pawl ih ramsung hmanah hin Thilsual an tuah thotho. Na natsatnak cu zianghman ah an siar lo."},"11":{"text":"Na hrem hai ding ti na ral pawl in an thei lo; Maw Bawipa , ningzakin tuah hai awla tuar hai seh; Na rak ruah cia mi hremnak cu tuar hai seh. Na minung pawl ziangtlukin na duhdawt ti kha hmuh hai aw."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah in neinung lennak in pe ding; Kan tuah thei kan timi hmuahhmuah hi Nangmaió tuahmi an si ṭheh."},"13":{"text":"Maw Bawipa kan Pathian, mi dangdang in in uk zo; Asinain kan Bawipa cu nangmah lawng na si."},"14":{"text":"An thi zo ih an nung nawn lo ding; An thla pawl cu an thosal nawn lo ding. Na hrem ih na hloral ter ṭheh zo a si. Zohman in an ciing nawn hai lo."},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , kan miphun hi na ṭhangso ter; Kan ram cu a kilkip in na kau ter. Cu ruangah na hmin in upatnak a co."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na minung pawl daan na tat ih An thinpit ah na hnenah thla an cam."},"17":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah in in ṭap ter; Nausuak natih nunau a ṭah bangin."},"18":{"text":"Kan na, kan tuar ih kan ṭap; Asinain zianghman kan hring lo. Kan ram hrangah nehnak zianghman kan suahpi lo; Kan ti suak mi zianghman a um lo."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kan minung a thi cia mi pawl an nung ding; An ruangpi cu a nung saal ding a si. Thlan sungih a it mi pawl cu An ṭhang dingih lungawi in hla an sa ding! A tleu detdo mi daitla ih leilung a hringter bangin A thicia mi pawl cu Bawipa in a nungter saal ding."},"20":{"text":"Maw ka minung pawl, nan inn sungah lut uhla nan sangka khar uh! Pathian thinhengnak a reh hlanlo sung cu relh ta hrih uh.","title":"Hremnak Le Ngaidamnak"},"21":{"text":"Leilung mi pawl an sualnak ruangih daantat dingah Bawipa cu vancung a umnak hmun ihsin a rung ṭum ding. A thupte ih mi an phil mi pawl tla phuan thluh a si dingih a thi mi pawl cu leilung in a thup nawn lo ding."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cui ni ah tipithuanthum sungih a um mi rul tumpi that dingah le a ngerh aw mi le ṭihnungza Leviathan rul cu hrem dingah Bawipa in a cak mi le a hmual a ṭha mi a ralnam a hmang ding."},"2":{"text":"Cui ni ah Bawipa in a nuamzet mi a sabit hmuan thu ahcun,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka sabit hmuan cu keimah in ka kil ih ti ka toih ringring. Zohman ih an siatsuah lonak dingah a sun a zan in ka kil."},"4":{"text":"Atu ahcun ka sabit hmuan parah ka thin a heng nawn lo. Hling le so an um ahcun keimah in ka do dingih ka ur fai ṭheh ding."},"5":{"text":"Asinain ka minung ih ral pawl in keimai humhimnak an duh a si ahcun keimah thawn remnak tuah hai seh. A si, keimah thawn remnak tuahta hai seh,” a ti ding."},"6":{"text":"Cui ni ah Israel mi, Jakob ih tefa sin pawl cu thingkung bangin hram an thla saal ding; an mum dingih an par ding. Cuticun leilung tlunah an rah a khat ding."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu an ral pawl tluk cun Bawipa in a hremsiat lo; a thi mi khal an ral pawl zat in an tam lo."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl cu sal taannak ih kuatnak in a hrem hai. Nisuahnak lam ihsin a hrangmi thlisia a semhlo ter a si."},"9":{"text":"Khawvel pawl biakṭheng ih dawl mi lungto pawl miphiu vut vekih rialdip a si hlanlo le Asherah pathian nu can ai-ih thing phun mi le rimhmui urnak biakṭheng pawl a um sungah cun Israel sualnak cu ngaidam a si lo ding."},"10":{"text":"Ralhruang ih kulh mi khawpi pawl cu an siatbal ṭheh zo! Hramlak ramṭhing bangin an lawngih an ṭhing reprep. Ṭilva tlannak ramah a cangih ṭilva pawl an um ih rawl an piat."},"11":{"text":"Thinghnge pawl tla an ro ih an kiak ṭheh; nunau pawl in tih thing ah an hlam. Ziangahtile minung pawl in zianghman an theihthiam lo ruangah anmah seemsuahtu Pathian in an parah lainatnak le zaangfahnak zianghman a nei nawn lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Cui ni ah Bawipa in, Zufrates tiva ihsin Izipt ramri tiang a minung pawl pakhat hnu pakhat a khawm dingih fang le fanghi ṭhen bangtuk in a ṭhen ding."},"13":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen tikah Assiria le Izipt ramih saltaangmi Israel mi pawl ko dingah tawtawrawt an tum ding. An ra dingih Jerusalem khua, a tlang thiang parah Bawipa an biak ding a si."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel uknak cu a cem a si! A sunlawinak cu an hotu zuri pawl lu parah, pangpar ih tuah mi siangpahrang lukhum a vuai vekin, a vuai a si. A hngalzet mi an lu cu ṭhazet in rimhmui an hnih naan thizik ih zu an rit ruangah an ril men.","title":"Saklam Uknak Hrangih Ralrin Peknak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in anmah do dingah a cakzet mi le huham a neizet mi pakhat a hril zo. Cupa cu rial tlak in a rung tla ding, thli le ruah bangin a ra ding, thil siatsuahtu tilik bangin a ra dingih ram cu a neh ding."},"3":{"text":"An hotu zuri pawl ih hngalnak cu ke ih palcih mi an si ding."},"4":{"text":"An hotu mi hngal pawl ih hminthannak cu theipi rah hmaisabik a hmin vete in an lawh ih an ei ih a cem vekin a cem ding a si."},"5":{"text":"Tikcu a ra thleng dingih cuih ni ah Bawipa cu a minung a nungdam sun pawl hrangah pangpar ih tuah mi siangpahrang lukhum vek a si ding."},"6":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in an thuṭhentu pawl hnenah dingnak thinlung a pe dingih an khawpi kotka pawl a ra dotu an ral pawl a dawihlo tu hnenah ralṭhatnak a pe ding."},"7":{"text":"Profet le puithiam pawl hman zu an ri ih an sawn ciamco. Sabit zu le zureu tamzet an in ih hmunkipah an lu zing in an sawn an ril ih an buai nasa. Profet pawl cu zu an ri tukih Pathian in langnak a hmuhter mi hman a tican an thei lo; puithiam pawl khal zu an ri tuk ve ih an hnenih a thlengmi thurel ding hman an rel thei lo.","title":"Isaiah Le Profet Zuri Pawl"},"8":{"text":"An tonak cabuai hman an luak in a khat ṭheh ih a thiannak hmun malte hman a um lo."},"9":{"text":"Ka parah an phunzai ih, “Hi pa hi zo ka zirh tiah so a ruat aw? A thusim mi cu hnawi thlei pekte nauhak hrang lawngah a ṭha ko lo maw?"},"10":{"text":"In zirh tikah a cafang a cafang in, a catlaang a catlaang in le a thu pakhat hnu pakhat in in hei zirh fawn!” in ti."},"11":{"text":"Ka thusim mi nan ngai duh lo asile Pathian in ramdang ṭong theih lo mi hmang in a lo zirhter hai ding."},"12":{"text":"Amah in colhdamnak le nunnomnak a lo pe naón a thu cu nan ngai duh lo."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah a si Bawipa in a cafang a cafang in, a catlaang a catlaang in le thu pakhat hnu pakhat in a lo zirh tumnak cu! Cule kal khat nan kal tin in nan bah ding. Hriamhma nan pu ding, thang in a lo awk hai dingih ralkaih mi nan si ding."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem ihsin hi minung pawl a uktu nannih mi puarthau pawl, Bawipaió thusim mi hi ngaihnik uh!","title":"Zion Hrangah Innkiil Lungpi"},"15":{"text":"Nanmah cun “Thihnak thawn thukamnak kannei zo ih mithi khua Sheol thawn lungkimnak cachuk kan tuah zo,” nan hei ti ih tluang nan khawng ciamco. Thilṭha lo poimawh a thlen tikah kan luat ding tiah nan zum ih thuphan pernak le mibumnak nan rinsan ruangah kan him ding, tiah nan ruat."},"16":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa cun, “Zion ah a hngetmi le a khoh mi innhram ka thok ih, cuih innhram ahcun innkil ih dawl cih mi lungpi ka ret. Cui innkil lungpi parah cun, ‘A hngetmi zumnak cu a thin a sau fawn a si,’ ti in ka ngan."},"17":{"text":"Innhram a ding maw dinglo ti tahnak ah felnak ka hmang ding. Sikhalsehla nan rinsanzet mi thuphan pawl cu thlisia le rial in a siatsuah ṭheh dingih nan himnak pawl cu tilik in a siatsuah ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Thihnak thawn thukamnak nan tuah mi cu bal ṭheh a si dingih mithi khua Sheol thawn lungkimnak cachuk nan tuah mi cu phiat ṭheh a si ding. Thil ṭha lo poimawh a thlen tikah tilik bangin a lo khuh ṭheh hai ding."},"19":{"text":"Cui thil poimawh cu hi ṭumkhat lawng a si ding, nan ti vete in a dang a ra thleng lala ding. Zingkhat hnu zingkhat a thleng ding. A sun a zan in nan tuar ding. Pathian thu a thar in a ra thleng dingih tuksumza a si sinsin ding."},"20":{"text":"Phungthluk ih, ‘Ihnak ihkhun le a tawituk, sin ding puan le a fate tuk,’ an timi mipa nan hluan ding."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in thiltuah a tum mi cu thil phundangzet vek a bang khalle a tuahsuak ding; Perazim Tlang le Gibeon Phairawn ih a rak do ciamco zo vekin a ṭul ahcun atu khalah a do ko ding. A thok zomi a hnaṭuan cu a kimter ding; cuih a hnaṭuan mi cu theih thei lo mi thil mangbangza an si."},"22":{"text":"Na hnenih ralrinnak thu ka sim mi hi caponak ah ruatin hnihsan meen hlah. Na hnihsan meen asile na luatnak dingah a har sinsin ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa in hi ram pumpi siatsuah dingih a ruahcia mi cu ka thei zo a si."},"23":{"text":"Ka lo sim mi hi ngai uhla nan hnenih ka phuan mi hi ṭhatein ruat uh!","title":"Pathian Fimnak"},"24":{"text":"Zovek lothlo pa khalin a leileh mi sungih rawl ciinnak ah tiah kumkhua catbaang loin a lei a let dah keel lo."},"25":{"text":"A leileh cu ṭhateih a simsial ṭheh hnu ahcun zira le remhmui ci a vorh. Sangvut le barli sangvut a tuh ih a kiangkapah rawl dangdang a cing."},"26":{"text":"Lo hnaṭuan daan a thiam, ziangahtile Pathian in a zirh a si."},"27":{"text":"Zira ci le remhmui ci laak duh ah talhtum tumzet in a vuak lo; talhtum ai ah a tawk dingmi fung fate deuh a hmang a si."},"28":{"text":"Sangvut a laak tikah a siat thluh tiangin catbaang loin a rial dah lo. Sangvut fang siat lo dingih ralringte in cawleng in a ciil ih a tawkfangte in a ciil thiam a si."},"29":{"text":"Hi bangtuk fimnak le thiamnak cu Cungnungbik Bawipa ih pekmi a si. Pathian khawkhannak cu fimnak ih khuakhan mi a si ih hlawhtlinnak a um ringring."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, Pathian biakṭheng, na cem a si! David khawpi cu a cem riai a si! Kum khat hnih cu awh hrih ko seh, puai tuahnak le nomnak pawl thawn!","title":"Jerusalem Ton Mi Thil Poimawh"},"2":{"text":"Cule “Pathian biakṭheng,” timi khawpi parah cun Pathian in thilṭha lo poimawh a thlengter ding. Cutikah ṭahnak le au-nak a um dingih Jerusalem khawpi pumpi thisen in a khuh mi thawinak biakṭheng ah a cang ding."},"3":{"text":"Pathian in hi khawpi cu a ral dingih a do dingih a kulh ṭheh ding."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem cu leilung thuai ihsin hung ṭongsuak a tumtu mithla vek, leivut lakih sin a hung phun supso tu aw vek a si ding."},"5":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, nangmah a lo dotu ramdang mi pawl cu leivut bangin semhlo ṭheh an si dingih ṭihnungza an ralkap pawl cu fangkungro bangin an zamhlo ṭheh ding. Hmakhatte-ah rinlopi-in,"},"6":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa cun a nasazet mi thli le ruah, khuari le ṭeek tla le linghnin in a lo run ding. Thlisia le a alh hluarhlo mi meisa a run thlak ding."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah Jerusalem khawpi, Pathian biakṭheng timi khua a dotu ih ralkap hmuahhmuah, an hriamnam le an thilri pawl le an ken mi hmuahhmuah cu mang vekin le zan kan ih ih kan mitthlam ih a cuangduak mi vekin an hloral ṭheh ding."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem do dingah a puum aw mi ram hmuahhmuah cu, rilrawng zet pa a mangah rawl thawzetzet a ei ih a maai rero naón a ṭhangsaal tikah cun rilrawng thotho a sivek le tihal zet pa a mangah tidai riamzet in a in rero naón a ṭhangsaal tikah cun tihal le dangcaar thotho ih a um vekin an si ding."},"9":{"text":"Feh uhla mi aa si hrih ko uh! Nan mit cu caw hrih ko seh! Zu zianghman in loin ri uh! Zureu forkhat hman in loin sawn rero uh!","title":"Zohman in A Thu An Ngai Lo"},"10":{"text":"Thizik ih it that dingah Bawipa in nan ih a lo hmuh ter hai a si. Profet pawl hi misenpi ih mit an si ding naón Pathian in an mit a hup a si."},"11":{"text":"Profet ih an hmuh mi langnak hmuahhmuah a tican nan theih theilonak dingah thuh in a um dingih an erh pit mi cazual vek a si ding. Casiar thiam hnenah nan fehpi ih in siarsak hnik aw nan ti hmanah ka siar thei lo, an erh pit a si si, a ti ding."},"12":{"text":"Casiar thiamlo hnenah nan pekih in siarsak aw nan ti khalle ca siar ka thiam ual lo, a lo ti ding."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Himi pawl cun in bia naón an ṭong cu tican neilo a si ih an thinlung cu khuimaw lamah a vakvai. Annih hrangah cun biaknak timi cu milai ih tuahcop mi daanterek le thilti ṭheu daan pawl khi a si ih, zoh loih an siar mi pawl khi a si."},"14":{"text":"An ruah lopi in an parah harsatnak pakhat hnu pakhat ka thlengter ding. Mifim timi pawl cu mi-aa ah an cang dingih an fimnak cu zianghman ah a ṭhahnem lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"An tumtahmi Bawipa hnenih sin a thuptu pawl cu rei an awh lo ding. An tum mi cu thupte in an tuah ih, “Zohman in in hmu lo, zohmanin an thei lo,” an ti.","title":"Hmailam Beiseinak"},"16":{"text":"Thil hmuahhmuah an linglet ter ṭheh. Beel tuahtu maw, beel tuahnak tlak so a thupi sawn? Minung ih tuah mi thil in a tuahtu hnenah, ‘Ziangah so i tuah?’ a ti thei ding maw? Asilole, “Na tuah mi hi zianghman na thei lo,” tiah a sim thei ding maw?"},"17":{"text":"Ṭongṭhimnak ih a um vekin a rei hlanah tupi ngawzet cu loram ah a cang dingih loram cu tupi ah a cangsal ding."},"18":{"text":"Cuih ni a thlen tikah hnaset pawl in cauk thangzet ih an siarmi kha an thei dingih caan reipi khawthim sungih a um zo mi mitcaw pawl in an mit an meng dingih khua an hmu thei ding."},"19":{"text":"Mifarah le mi lungnem pawl in Israel Pathian thianghlim ih pekmi lungawinak cu an co saal ding."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah midang a hmuhsuam a hremtu le Pathian zianghman ih a siarlo tu pawl cu an cem ding. Misual hmuahhmuah cu siatsuah ṭheh an si ding."},"21":{"text":"Pathian in midang a thangsiat tu, miṭha lo pawl hrem a khamtu le mifel pawl an felnak vekih thuhman coter duh lo ah thuphan a pertu pawl cu a siatsuah ṭheh hai ding."},"22":{"text":"Curuangah Israel ih Pathian, harsatnak sung ihsin Abraham a suahtu Bawipa in, “Maw ka minung pawl, mualpho in nan um nawn lo ding; ningzak in nan hmai a raam nawn lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Ka lo pek dingmi tefa pawl nan hmu dingih cuticun keimah cu Israel ih Pathian thianghlim ka si kha in theithiam ding. Upatnak in pe dingih khawruahhar ṭihzahnak thawn ka hmaiah nan ding ding."},"24":{"text":"Mi aa pawl in thil theihthiamnak an nei dingih a phunzaitu le a tlokciar ringring tu pawl khal lungawizet in zirh an theih ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Judah ram uktu pawl cu an cem a si. Ziangahtile keimah dodaltu ah an cang. Keimaió khawkhannak a si lo mi an thlun ih ka lungkimnak tel loin lungkimnak cachuk an tuah; cuticun sualnak pakhat hnu pakhat an thuah vivo.","title":"Izipt Thawn Lungkimnak Tuah Lo Ding"},"2":{"text":"Keimah ron hmaisa loin bomnak duh ah Izipt ramah an feh. Izipt in in hum seh ti an duh ih Izipt siangpahrang an rinsan a si."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an siangpahrang in a bawm thei hai lo ding; Izipt ih humhimnak cu hloralnak ah a net ding."},"4":{"text":"An ram palai pawl cu Izipt ram khawpi Zoan le Hanes an thlengzo naón,"},"5":{"text":"bomnak an ṭulzet laifangih a bawm theilotu ram, rintlak a si lo mi ram an rak rinsan pang cu Judah mi pawl an siir zet saal ding,” tiah a ti zo!"},"6":{"text":"Thlanglam nelrawn ramih ramsa pawl thu ah Pathian in hiti in a sim; “Ram palai pawl cu ṭihnunnak ram, kiosa le rulhraang pawl le a zam thei mi dragon rul pawl umnak ah khual an tlawng. Mi zianghman bomnak a pe theilotu ram hnenih laksawng pek dingah thilri mankhung zetzet cu an laak le an kalauk parah an suang ciamco."},"7":{"text":"Izipt in bomnak cu thulolak a si. Curuangah Izipt cu, ‘ṭihtlak lo Rulpi,’ tiah hmin ka pek zo,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Ziangtluk miṭha lo an si kha kumkhua ih hminsinnak dingah an thuhla cu cauk sungih ngan dingin Pathian in i fial.","title":"Pathian Thungailo Mi Pawl"},"9":{"text":"Pathian dodaltu an si ringring, thuphan pertu an si ringring ih Pathian zirhnak kha an thlun duh hrimhrim lo."},"10":{"text":"Profet pawl hman cu, “Daite in um uh, ṭong hlah uh! Hihi a hman ee, khakha a hmanlo ee, tiah in sim duh hlah uh! Kan theih duh mi a nuam mi lawnglawng in sim uh. Kanmah umteón um ve mai uhsi!"},"11":{"text":"In kian uh, kan lamzin in kham hlah uh! Nan ‘Israel ih Pathian thianghlim,’ thu cu a theih kan duh nawn lo,” an ti."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Israel ih Pathian Thianghlim cun, “Ka lo sim mi cu zianghman ah nan siarlo ih mibumnak le thisen luannak sawn nan rinsan a si."},"13":{"text":"Mimawh hrimhrim nan si. Phar dawl a tlun ihsin a hnuailam tiang a khingkuai mi bangtuk nan si ih rinlopi ah nan tlu leh ding."},"14":{"text":"Tlak beel a kuai ih meivam laknak ah le tikuang ihsin tidai vun suahnak hman umlo ih a kuai thluh bangin nan kuai thluh leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa Israel ih Pathian Thianghlim in misenpi hnenah, “Rakir saal uhla daitein keimah i rinsan uh. Dai ziarzi ih um cu nan cahnak a si ih nan him ding,” tiah a ti. Asinain cutiih um cu nan duh lo."},"16":{"text":"“Rang tlan cakzet pawl kan to dingih kan raal pawl ih hmuh lonak ah kan tlan ding,” nan ti. A si, nan hman; nan tlanhlo ngai ko ding. Kan rang pawl cu an cakzet a si, nan ti; a sinan a lo dawitu pawl cu nannih hnakin an cak sawn ding;"},"17":{"text":"Nan ral pakhat nan hmuh tikah nannih cu thawngkhat nan tlan ding; nan ral panga nan hmuh ahcun nan zate in nan tlan ṭheh ding. Nan ralkapbu sungin pakhat hman nan taanglo ding; a taangmi cu tlangzim parih amah lawng lungleng ih a dingmi nan thantaar ṭhuam pakhat lawng a si ding!"},"18":{"text":"Cubangtuk a sinan Bawipa cu nan parah zaangfahnak a nei lai hrih. Amah cun thil hman lawnglawng a tuah ruangah nanmah zaangfah dingah a lo hngak lai hrih. Lungawinak taktak cu Bawipa rinsannak ihsin a ra a si."},"19":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem ih a um mi pawl, nan ṭap nawn lo ding. Bawipa cu lainatnak neitu a si ih bomnak dilin a hnenih nan au tikah a lo theihsak hai ding.","title":"A Minung Pawl A Thluasuah Ding"},"20":{"text":"Bawipa cun harnak le tuarnak sungah a lo thlenter hai ding, a sinan nan tuarnak hmunah cun a um ve dingih a lo zirhtu a si ding; cuticun amah nan hawl rero a ṭul lo ding."},"21":{"text":"Zin nan hlo ih vorhlam le kehlam ih zinpeng nan zawh tikah nan dunglam ihsin a aw cu, “Hitawkin feh uh; hinah lamzin a um,” tiah a ti nan thei ding."},"22":{"text":"Sui le ngun in huut mi nan milem pawl cu hnawmhne bangin nan hlonhlo dingih, “A hmuh ka lo duh nawn lo!” nan ti ding."},"23":{"text":"Rawl ci nan tuh tikah Bawipa in ruah a sur ter dingih rawl a ṭhan ter ding, rawl nan paṭha dingih nan ṭilva pawl tlannak khalah hramno a tamzet ding."},"24":{"text":"Nan lo leilettu cawcang le laak pawl in a ṭhabik le a thawbik ṭilva rawl an ei ding."},"25":{"text":"Cui ni a thlen ih nan ral pawl ih ralhruang nan lakih an minung pawl nan thah tikah tlangsaang le tlangniam hmunkip in tidai an luang ding."},"26":{"text":"Thlapi cu ni tlukin a tleu dingih ni cu a tleu keel ih let sarih in a tleu ding; ni sarih tleunak khi ni khat ah kom hai sehla a bang ding. A tlunih thil cang ding pawl cu Bawipa in a minung hnenih a thlenter mi hma pawl a tuamsak hai ih a damter tikcu caanah a kim ṭheh ding a si."},"27":{"text":"Pathian ih huham le sunlawinak cu a hlatpi in hmuh thei a si. Meisa le meikhu in a thinhengnak an langter. Thu a sim ih a ṭong cu meisa bangin a alh.","title":"Pathian In Assiria A Hrem Ding"},"28":{"text":"Ziang hmuahhmuah a fenhlo ṭheh tu tilian bangin a hmaiah thli a hran ter. Cui thli cun ram tampi a siatsuah ih a ṭha lomi an tumtahnak tla a cemral ter ṭheh."},"29":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih Pathian ih minung pawl cu nizarh ni puai tuah zanih lungawi in hla nan sak bangin lungawi le hlasa in nan um ding a si. Israel a ṭantu Bawipaió Biakinn an feh laiah phirivau tum phah in lungawizet ih a fehtu pawl bangtuk in nan lung a awi ding."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa in a nasazet mi a aw cu mi hmuahhmuah a theihter dingih a thinhengnak hmual khal a ton ter hai ding. Meisa hliozet a um dingih khawdur a puak ciamco ding; rial a tla dingih ruah cu a thlet in a thle aw ding."},"31":{"text":"Assiria mi pawl cu Bawipaió aw an theih tikah le a hremnak hmual an ton tikah an tuk a suum ding."},"32":{"text":"Pathian in Assiria mi pawl a hrem beet vivo tikah amai minung pawl cun khuang le ṭingṭang aw thawng an thlun ding. Pathian amah rori in Assiria mi pawl cu a do ding."},"33":{"text":"Meisa rumzet sungih Assiria siangpahrang ur-nak ah tiah khuahlan lai ihsin hmun pakhat cu timlaam cia in a um zo. Cui hmun cu a thuuk ih a kauzet; zanthing tla saangzet in an peng zo! Kaat meisa bangtuk a si mi Bawipaió thaw in a ur ding a si."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bomnak duh ah Izipt ih a fehtu pawl cu an cem a si! Izipt ralkap pawl an rinsan; an rang, an rangleng, le an ralkap cakzet pawl an rinsan a si. Asinain Bawipa Pathian, Israel ih Pathian Thianghlim cu an rinsan lo; a hnenih sin bomnak khal an dil lo.","title":"Pathian In Jerusalem A Hum Ding"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cun a tuah mi a thei, thilṭha lo poimawh a thlenter a si. Miṭha lo pawl le a rak ṭantu pawl kha ka hrem ding a ti bangin a hrem taktak."},"3":{"text":"Izipt mi pawl cu pathian an si lo, milai lawng an si! An rang pawl cu thlarau an si lo, titsa nei an si! Bawipa in a kut pharh in thil a tuah tikah cun a cakzet mi ram cu a ril dingih cumi a cakzet mi ram in a bom mi ram cak lo khal a sawn cih ding a si. An ram hnih in a siat ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Ramsa a dehtu kiosa cu tuukhal pawl in ziangtlukih an au an kio hnawh hmanah an dawihlo thei lo bangin, kei Cungnungbik Bawipa cu Zion Tlang humhim ka tumnak ihsin zohmanin in kham theilo ding."},"5":{"text":"A fanote hum dingah vate cu a bu tlunih a heel awk rero bangin kei Cungnungbik Bawipa khalin Jerusalem cu ka hum dingih ka ṭan ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in, “Maw Israel mi pawl, ka hmaiah nan sual zo ih in ralsan zo! Sikhalsehla ka hnenah rakir uh!"},"7":{"text":"Nan zate in sui le ngun ihsin a borhhlawh mi milem nan tuah mi pawl nan hlonhlo ṭhehnak tikcu caan a rathleng ding."},"8":{"text":"Raldonak ah Assiria cu a siat ṭheh ding, a sinan milai kut in a si lo ding. Assiria mi pawl cu raldonak ihsin an tlan dingih an mino pawl cu sal ah an kai hai ding."},"9":{"text":"An siangpahrang cu thinphang in a tlanhlo dingih an ralbawi pawl cu an ṭihtuknak ah an thantaar hman an tlanhlohsan ding,” tiah a ti.
