Jerusalem ah an biakmi Bawipa , Zion Tlang ah a meisa in thawinak a kangtertu Bawipa in a sim zo a si."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nikhat khatah cun a felzet mi siangpahrang a um dingih dingnak thawn hnaṭuantu ram pumpi hotu pawl tla an um ding.","title":"A Fel Mi Siangpahrang"},"2":{"text":"Cupawl cu thli le ruah ihsin beunak lungpi bangtuk an si fingfing ding. Anmah cu nelrawn ih a luangmi tiva bangtuk le ramcaar lakih lung tumpi hneemdai bangtuk an si."},"3":{"text":"Misenpi ṭulnak le hai mi ah an mit an meng dingih an hna an thong ding."},"4":{"text":"Ziang hmuahhmuah cu manhlap in an tuah lo ding; a sinan theihthiamnak thawn an tuah dingih an thinlung ngaingai an ṭong ding."},"5":{"text":"Zohman in mi aa cu upattlak tiah an ruat lo dingih mi depde pawl cu mifel an ti lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Mi hmukhmak cun aat-thlakza in a ṭong ih thilṭha lo tuah ding a ruat. A tuah mi le a ṭongmi cu Pathian hmuhsuamnak lawng an si; mi rilrawng pawl a cawm dah loih tihal mi pawl in ding tidai a pe dah fawn lo."},"7":{"text":"Miṭha lo a si ih thilṭha lo a tuah; a mibumnak in mifarah siatsuah ding lawng a ngaihtuah ih mizonzai pawl in an covo co lo dingah a kham ciamco."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mifel cun felzet le rintlakzet in thil a tuah ih a hman mi cu a ṭan a si."},"9":{"text":"Nuam zet le daithlang zetih a um mi nannih nunau pawl, ka thusim mi hi ngaihnik uh!","title":"Thuṭhennak Le Ngaithiamnak"},"10":{"text":"Atu ahcun lungkimzet le hnangamzet in nan um; a sinan hmaikum atu tikcu ahcun nan bei a dong ding, ziangahtile sabit laak ding zianghman nan neilo ding."},"11":{"text":"Nuamzet le daithlangzet in, donharnak zianghman umlo in nan um zo; a sinan atu cun ṭihphang in khur thlohthlo uh! Nan hnipuan hlit uhla nan taai ah puansia ṭem uh!"},"12":{"text":"Riahsia in nan ṭaang cuum uh! Ziangahtile lo ṭhazetzet le sabit hmuan pawl cu siatsuah ṭheh an si zo ih,"},"13":{"text":"hling le so le hrambur lawng ka minung pawl ih lo sungah an kho a si. Innsungsang nuamzet ih an rak umnak inn pawl hrang le nuamzet ih an umnak khawpi hrangah ṭap in ai ciamco uh."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn hman an tlansan dingih ram sungih khawpibik cu a ṭhing reprep ding. Inn pawl le an ralvennak ralhruang pawl cu kumkhua in a siatral ding. Cutawkah hramlak laak an vak dingih tuu pawl an tlang ding."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in a thlarau kan hnenah a run ṭhum saal ding. Ramṭhing cu ramṭha ah a cang saal dingih lo cun rawl tampi a suak ding."},"16":{"text":"Ramsung khuazakip ah dingnak le diknak lawnglawng tuah a si ding."},"17":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in a dik mi an tuah ding ruangah kumkhua in himnak le daihnak a um ding."},"18":{"text":"Pathian minung ih inn pawl cu daihnak le hnangamnak in a khat dingih thinharnak zianghman a umlo ding. ("},"19":{"text":"Tupi sungah rial a tla dingih khawpi cu balsiat ṭheh a si ding.)"},"20":{"text":"Ziangtluk lungawinak so mi hmuahhmuah hrangah a si ding, lorawl hrangah tidai a tam ih laak le caw hrangah phannak umlo in tlannak hrampi a tam tikah cun!"}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kan raal pawl an cem a si! Thil an ru, mi an zuarthlai; anmah cu zohman in an ramh loih an zuarthlai hai lo! Sikhalsehla ruk an ruknak le mi an zuarthlainak tikcu cu a cem cing ding; ruknak le zuarthlainak a tuartu bik ah an cang thlang ding a si.","title":"Bomnak Hrangih Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , in zaangfah hram aw. Na hnen lawngah ruahsannak kan nei. Nikhat hnu ni khat in humhim awla harsatnak sungin in run hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Kan hnenah ṭangin na do tikah cun miphun dang pawl cu raldonak hmun ihsin an tlanhlo a si."},"4":{"text":"An thilri pawl cu an lon ih ralthil lon mi ah an canter."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa a nasat zia cu! Ziang hmuahhmuah tlunah uktu a si. Jerusalem cu dingnak le felnak in a khahter dingih,"},"6":{"text":"ram pumpi cu hnangamzet le hngetzet in a umter ding. A minung pawl cu a hum ringring ih fimnak le thiamnak tla a pek. An ro ṭhabik cu Bawipa an ṭihzahnak hi a si."},"7":{"text":"Ralṭha pawl in bomnak an dil ding. Daihnak um seh tiah khua a khang rero tu ram palai pawl cu nasazetin an ṭap ding."},"8":{"text":"Ramsung ih lamzin tumpipi cu ṭihnunnak a tam ruangah zohman khual an tlawng ngam lo. Lungkim thukamnak pawl an phiat ṭheh ih thukamnak an tuah mi pawl an balsiat ṭheh zo. Zohman upat mi an nei nawn lo."},"9":{"text":"An ram cu zohman ih thlawh loin a lawngih a ṭhing reprep. Lebanon ramih tupi pawl cu an vuai ṭheh ih Sharon phairawn ramṭhazet cu nelrawn vekah a cang; Bashan ramah le Karmel Tlang ah thingkung pawl cu an hnah a ṭil ṭheh a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in miphun pawl hnenah, “Atu cun ka thok thlang ding. Ka cahzia le ka huham neihzia ka langter dingih nan hmu ding.","title":"In Ralrinnak A Pek"},"11":{"text":"Nan ngaihtuah mi pawl cu zianghman ṭhathnemnak an neiloih nan tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu alak hlir an si. Nanmah le nanmah nan siatsuah aw a si!"},"12":{"text":"Ṭhung tuahnak ih an ur mi lungto vekin a vut ah nan cangṭheh dingih hling an ur ih vutcam ih a can vekin nan ciam ṭheh ding a si."},"13":{"text":"A hlat ih um mi siseh, a nai ih um mi siseh, zozo khalin ka thil tuah mi hi thei hai sehla huham ka neihzia hi thei thlang hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Zion ih a ummi misual pawl cu thinphang in an khur thlohthlo. “Pathian thuṭhennak cu kumkhua alh mi meisa vek a si. Kannih lakah hin cuvek meisa sung ihsin a luat theitu kan um ding maw?” tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"A hman mi lawng nan sim ih nan tuah a si ahcun nan luat thei ding. Nan thuneihnak cu mifarah bumnak ah hmang hlah uh; nawhthuh tla ei hlah uh! Laithah tumtu pawl hnenah tel hlah uh; thilṭha lo an tuahnak khalah telve hlah uh!"},"16":{"text":"Cuti ih nan um asile nan hlawhtling dingih a hngetzetmi ralhruang bangin nan him ding. Ei ding rawl le in ding tidai nan ngah ding."},"17":{"text":"Ram kaupi a uktu siangpahrang ih sunlawinak cu na mit in na hmu saal ding.","title":"Hmailam Hrang Ruahsannak"},"18":{"text":"Ramdangmi siahkhawltu le thlingthlatu nan rak ṭihzet mi pawl kha cu a ruah hman nan ruat saal nawn lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Mihngalzet ramdangmi, an ṭong hman a tican nan theih lomi pawl kha nan hmu saal nawn lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Zion hi zohhnik uh, biaknak lamih puai kan tuahnak khawpi hi! Jerusalem hi zohhnik uh! Ziangtluk umnak ṭha le himnak khua so a si! Puanthlam-a ṭhuam an phawi dah lomi le a hri a cat dah lomi bangtuk a si ding."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in a sunlawinak huham in hmuh ding. Tiva kauzet le tivate kiangkapah kan um ding, a sinan kan ral lawng pawl cu cunah an feh lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Lawng parih long feh ternak thilri hmuahhmuah cu ziang hmanah an ṭhahnem lo; lawng puan hman an pharh thei lo. Kan ral ralkap pawl ih thilri hmuahhmuah cu lon ṭheh a si ding. Cui thilri cu a tamzet dingih ke-awl pawl khalin covo an ngah thei ding. Bawipa amah cu kan siangpahrang a si ding. Amah in in uk dingih in hum ding a si.","merge":"23"},"24":{"text":"Kan ramsungih a um mi hmuahhmuah in, “Ka dam lo e,” tiah an ti dah nawn lo dingih an sualnak phunkim cu ngaidam a si ding."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw miphun hmuahhmuah tla, ra uh! Ra tongkhawm aw uhla ra ngaihnik uh! Leilung pumpi le a tlunih a um mi hmuahhmuah in ra uhla ra ngai uh!","title":"Pathian In A Ral Pawl A Hrem Ding"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu miphun pawl hmuahhmuah parah le an ralkap pawl parah a thin a heng a si. Siatsuahnak ih thlenter dingin a ruat."},"3":{"text":"An ruak cu phum an si lo ding; a leengah an thu an ṭawt ding; tlang pawl cu thisen in a sen ṭheh ding."},"4":{"text":"Ni, thlapi le arsi pawl an tla dingih leivut ah an cangṭheh ding. Van cu pherzual bangin a zual aw dingih a hlota dingih arsi pawl cu sabit hri le theipi kung an hnah a ṭilh bangin an ṭil ding."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in vanah a ralnam a taat hriam ih atu ahcun Edom ram le ramsung minung siatsuah ṭheh dingih a ruahcat cia mi pawl parah cuih ralnam cu a rung thleng ding."},"6":{"text":"Thawinak ih pekmi tuu le me pawl an thah mi thisen le a thau vekin thisen le thau in a ralnam cu a tuam ṭheh ding. Bawipa in hi thawinak cu Bozrah khawpi ah a pek ding. Cuticun Edom ramah nasazet in a that hai ding."},"7":{"text":"Cui ram mi pawl cu hramlak cawcang le cawcangte pawl bangtuk in an ril dingih leilung cu thisen in a sen dingih thau in a khuh ding."},"8":{"text":"Hi tikcu cu Bawipa in Zion a run caan a si dingih Zion ral pawl parih phu a lak caan a si ding."},"9":{"text":"Edom ram tiva ih tidai pawl cu lawng hnihmi ṭaar-si ah a cang ṭheh dingih leilung cu kaat leilung ah a cang ṭheh ding."},"10":{"text":"A sun a zan in a kang dingih meikhu cu cat loin a suak ding. San khat hnu san khatah an ram cu hnawmpen ramṭhingah a cang dingih zohman an ramsungin khual an tlawng nawn lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Sumbuh le tlang-ak umnak ramah a cang ding. Bawipa in, lei le van a seemsuah hlan vekin an ram cu a lawngmi le a ṭhing reprep mi ah a cangter saal ding."},"12":{"text":"Ram uktu siangpahrang a umlo dingih an hotu pawl hmuahhmuah cu an hloral ṭheh ding."},"13":{"text":"Hling le so an siangpahrang inn kipah le ralhruang in kulh mi khua kipah a kho dingih cinghnia le sumbuh umnak ah an cang ding."},"14":{"text":"Cutawkah hramlak ramsa an vak dingih khawsia pakhat le pakhat an sawn aw ding. Zan ih a vak mi khawsia rul tumpi tla colhnak hawl in cutawkah a ra thleng ding."},"15":{"text":"Sumbuh pawl in bu an tuah dingih ti an ti ding; faate an keuh dingih an cawm ding. Langta tla cutawkah pakhat hnu pakhat an khawm aw ding."},"16":{"text":"Bawipaió ca-uk sungah a nungmi ramsa thuhla hawl uhla siar hnik uh! Cui ramsa pawl cu hi ram sungih a umlo mi an umlo ding; rualpi neilo khal an umlo ding. Cubangtuk ih si dingah Bawipaió thupek cia mi a si; amah rori in hmunkhat ah a khawm ṭheh hai ding."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa amah in ram cu a ṭhensak dingih an covo fingfing a pe hai ding a si. Sankhat hnu sankhat cunah an um dingih kumkhua in anmah ih ta a si ding."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nelrawn ramṭhing cu a lung a awi ding; Hramlak ah pangpar an par ding.","title":"Thianhlimnak Lamzin"},"2":{"text":"Nelrawn cu hla a sa dingih lungawi in a au ding; Lebanon Tlang bangin a mawi dingih, Karmel le Sharon ih lo bangin ramṭha a si ding. Zokhal in Pathian sunlawinak cu an hmu ding, A nasatzia le a huham neihzia an hmu ding."},"3":{"text":"Kut caklo pawl cakter uhla, A ṭawnṭai ih a thir mi khuk pawl hngetter uh."},"4":{"text":"Thinnau mi le beidong mi hnenah, “Cak uhla zianghman ṭih hlah uh; Pathian nanmah run dingah a ra lai, Na ral pawl parih phu lak dingah a ra a si,” tiah sim uh!"},"5":{"text":"Mitcaw pawl in khua an hmu thei dingih, hnaset pawl an hna a vaang ding."},"6":{"text":"Ke-awl mi in an khir an laam dingih, A ṭong theilo mi khal lungawi in an au ding. Nelrawn sungin tidai a luang dingih,"},"7":{"text":"A alh mi vunnel cu tili ah a cang ding. Leilung a caar mi cu ticawm in a khat saal ding. Cinghnia an rak um ṭheunak hmunah, Phok le phaipheng tla an kho ding."},"8":{"text":"Cutawkah cun misenpi hrang lam tumpi a um dingih “Thianhlimnak Lamzin,” ti a si ding. Misual pawl cu cuih lamzin ah an feh theilo ding. Cutawkih a fehtu pawl cu mi-aa pawl ih hruaisualnak an tong lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Cutawkah cun kiosa a um lo ding; Sahraang dang tla in an pal lo ding. Bawipa ih a runsuak mi pawl cu, Hi lamzin thlun in an inn ah an tlung ding."},"10":{"text":"Lungawi sopar tein Jerusalem an thleng ding, Nunnuam zetin hla an sa dingih an au ding. Ninghan riahsiatnak in an luat thlang dingih, Kumkhua in an nun a nuam tata ding."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah in Judah ram a uknak kum hleili kumah Assiria ram siangpahrang Sennakherib in ralhruang in kulh mi Judah ram khua pawl a do ih tampi a lak.","title":"Assiria Mi In Jerusalem Siim An Tum (2 Sian. 18.13-27 ; 2 San. 32.1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Cuihhnu ah a kutthuai ih bawi upabik cu ralkap tampi thawn Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah cu remnak tuahter dingah Lakhish ihsin Jerusalem ah a thlah. Cui a thlah mi bawi cu puan taktu pawl hnaṭuannak lamzin, tlunta tili ihsin tidai an laknak tihriat kiangah a um."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Judah mi upa pathum in an va tong: Siangpahrang inn hnaṭuantu pawl hotu Hilkiah ih fapa Eliakim, zung cazipi Shebna le cazin kaitu Asaf fapa Joah an si."},"4":{"text":"Assiria ralbawipa cun, “Ziangah so siangpahrang Hezekiah hi amah le amah zum awzet in a um? tihi kan siangpahrang in a thei duh."},"5":{"text":"Ṭong meenmeen hin ralkap lam cahnak le thiamnak hi a ai-awh thei ding tiah nan ruat maw si? Keimah do dingah hin zo in in bawm ding tiah so nan ruat?"},"6":{"text":"Ka thei ko, Izipt in in bawm ding tiah nan zum. Sikhalsehla Izipt rinsan cu ziang a bang nan thei maw? Kianghrol ah phaipheng kuang hman vek a si-a kiak ih na kut a lo aat. Izipt siangpahrang an rinsan tikah cun cubangtuk a si ringring ko."},"7":{"text":"“Asilole Bawipa nan Pathian nan rinsan a si maw? Hezekiah in biakṭheng pakhat lawngah Pathian nan biak ding tiah Judah le Jerusalem mi pawl thu a pekih a dang biakinn le biakṭheng pawl hmuahhmuah a bal ṭheh mi kha nan Pathian biakinn le biakṭheng pawl sokhaw an si!"},"8":{"text":"Asile kan siangpahrang hmin in thu ka lo tiam pei! Rang thawnghnih ka lo pe ding, a totu dingah minung cuzat na hmu thei ding maw?"},"9":{"text":"Kan Assiria ralkap bawi lakih ralbawi nautabik hman nan tluk lo sokhaw! Cui tlunah Izipt in rangleng le rangpar ralkap pawl in kuat ding nan hei ti lai sapbai!"},"10":{"text":"Nan ram ka do ih ka siatsuah hi Bawipaió bomnak a tello ah mawsi nan ruat? Bawipa amah rori in nan ram do dingah le siatsuah dingah i fial a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Eliakim, Shebna le Joah in cuih ralbawipa hnenah, “Kan hnenah cun Aramaik ṭong in ṭong aw! Kan thei ko sokhaw. Hebru ṭong cun ṭong hlah; phar parih a um mi hmuahhmuah in in ngai a si,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Assiria ralbawipa cun, “Hi ka thusim mi hmuahhmuah hi nanmah le nan siangpahrang hnen lawngih sim dingah kan siangpahrang in i thlah ah maw nan ruat? Si hlah e; phar parih a totu pawl hnen khalah hi thu hi sim ding ka si; ziangahtile nanmah tla ih nan tuah ding vek thotho in annih khalin an eek an ei dingah an zun an in ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule ralbawipa cu a dingih Hebru ṭong in, a aw neih patawp in a au ih, “Assiria siangpahrang in nan hnenih a ṭongmi hi ngaihnik uh."},"14":{"text":"Hezekiah in lo bum rero hlah seh, tiah ralrinnak a lo pek a si. Hezekiah cun a lo run theilo ding."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa rinsan dingih a lo forhnak cu lung hlah uh; Bawipa in in run dingih kan khawpi cu Assiria ralkap pawl a laak ter lo ding, tiah zum duh hlah uh!"},"16":{"text":"Hezekiah thu cu zum hlah uh. Assiria siangpahrang in atu ah nan khawpi sung ihsin rasuak in remnak tuah dingah thu a lo pek a si. Nan sabit hri ih sabit cu ei ter nan si ko ding; nan theipi kung ihsin theipi cu nan ei ko dingih nan tikhur in tidai cu nan in ko ding."},"17":{"text":"Cule kan siangpahrang in nan ram vek rori a si mi ramah a lo umter dingih cutawkah sabitti nan in theinak dingah sabit hri a um ve ko ih sang tuah dingah fang a um ko."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa in in run ko ding, tiah ruat dingah Hezekiah in nan thinlung cu lo mol rero hlah seh. Assiria siangpahrang in ram tampi a do tikah an ram ih khuavang pawl in an ram an run suak, ti nan thei dah maw?"},"19":{"text":"Khui ah so Hamath le Arpad khuavang pawl an si ṭheh? Khui ah so Sefarvaim khuavang pawl an um? Zo talin Samaria ram an run maw?"},"20":{"text":"Ram hizat ih khuavang pawl lakah khuavang pakhat talin an ram cu Assiria siangpahrang kut sungin an run maw? An run lo a si ruangah nannih teh nan Bawipa in Jerusalem a run ding tiah ziangtinso nan zum thiam?” tiah a ti ciamco."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah misenpi cu an dai khepkhep; Siangpahrang Hezekiah ih a rak tiamcia bangin an dai ih zianghman an sawn lo."},"22":{"text":"Cule Eliakim, Shebna le Joah cu riahsia in an hnipuan an thlekih Assiria ralbawipa ih ṭong mi hmuahhmuah cu an siangpahrang hnenah an va sim."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah in a hnenih an ra sim mi thu cu a theih tikah riahsia in a hnipuan a thlekih buri hnipuan a hruk ih Bawipaió Biakinn ah a feh.","title":"Siangpahrang In Isaiah Thu A Ron (2 Sian. 19.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Cule Amoz fapa Isaiah hnenah siangpahrang inn kiltu hotu Eliakim, zung cazipi Shebna le puithiam upa pawl a thlah. Annih khalin buri hnipuan an hruk ve."},"3":{"text":"Isaiah hnenih va sim dingah hiti in thu a cah, “Tuihsun cu kan hrangah tuar ni a si. Hremnak kan tuarih ningzahnak kan tong. Nunau pakhat in naute a neizik naón a nu a tha a maltuk lawmmam ruangah a hring theilo mi bangtuk kan si."},"4":{"text":"Assiria ram siangpahrang in a nungmi Pathian hmuhsuam dingah a kutthuai bawi pakhat a run thlah. Bawipa na Pathian in hiti ih an hmuhsuamnak cu thei hram sehla a ṭongtu cu hrem hram seh. Curuangah kan minung a taangsun pawl hrangah thla in rak cam sak hram aw,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Isaiah in siangpahrang Hezekiah ih thucahmi a theih tikah"},"6":{"text":"hiti in thu a khirh, “Assiria mi pawl ih Pathian hmuhsuamnak ṭong an ṭong ruangah na thinlung siat ding a si lo, tiah Bawipa in a ti."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa in Assiria siangpahrang cu thu vakvai a theihter dingih cumi ruangah a ramah a kir ding; cule amai ram minung pawl ih kut in a thi ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Assiria ralbawipa cu a kirih, an siangpahrang cu Lakhish in a feh ih a kiangih um mi Libnah khua a do ti a theih tikah siangpahrang tong dingah cunah a feh.","title":"Assiria Pawl In Siim An Tum Lala (2 Sian. 19.8-19)"},"9":{"text":"Culai ah Ethiopia ram siangpahrang Tirhakah ho in Izipt ralkap pawl cu Assiria ralkap do dingin an ra, tiah thu a thang. Cumi cu Assiria siangpahrang in a theih tikah Judah ram siangpahrang Hezekiah hnenah ca a kuat ih a hnenah,"},"10":{"text":"“Na rinsan mi na Pathian cun ka kut sungih thlenglo dingin thu a lo sim; a sinan cumicun lo bum hlah seh!"},"11":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang in ram pakhatkhat parah ka siatsuah ding, ti ih a ruahcat hnu ahcun ziangtin a tuah ṭheu ti cu na theihcia a si ko. Ka luat thei ding, tiah na ruat mawsi?"},"12":{"text":"Ka pu le ka pa pawl in Gozan, Haran le Rezef khua pawl an rak siat ṭheh ih Betheden mi Telassar ih a um mi pawl an that ṭheh. An khuavang zohman in an run theilo a si."},"13":{"text":"Khui ah so Hamath, Arpad, Sefarvaim, Hena le Ivvah khua pawl uktu siangpahrang pawl an si ṭheh?” tiah a ngan."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah in cuih cakuat cu a rak thlah mi pawl kut in a lakih a siar. Cule Biakinn ah a feh ih Bawipaió hmaiah ca cu a retih,"},"15":{"text":"thla a cam ih,"},"16":{"text":"“Maw Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian, na siangpahrang tokham parih a totu, nangmah lawng hi Pathian na si ih leilung tlun ram hmuahhmuah uktu na si. Nangmah in lei le van hi na seemsuah."},"17":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , atu ah in run thei awla in run zoh hram aw! Sennakherib in a nungmi Pathian na parih hmuhsuamnak a ṭongmi hmuahhmuah hi run thei ṭheh aw."},"18":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Assiria siangpahrang pawl cun ram tampi an siatsuah ṭheh zo ih an ṭhingter ṭheh ti cu kan thei zo."},"19":{"text":"An khuavang pawl Pathian a si lomi khuavang, thing le lungto in tuahcop mi milem pawl khal an ur ṭheh ti kan thei zo."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah maw Bawipa , kan Pathian, Assiria mi kut sungin in run hram aw; cuticun leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah in nangmah lawng Pathian na si kha an thei ding,” tiah thla a cam."},"21":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Hezekiah thlacamnak Bawipa ih a lehnak kha Isaiah in a theih tikah Isaiah in Hezekiah hnenah thuthan dingin palai a thlah. Bawipa in,","title":"Siangpahrang Hnenih Isaiah Thucahmi (2 Sian. 19.20-37)"},"22":{"text":"“Maw Sennakherib, Jerusalem khawpi in a lo hnihsan ih capo hnihsuahsainak meenah a lo tuah a si."},"23":{"text":"Na hmuhsuam mi le na cam rero mi hi zo a si tiah so na ruat? Israel ih Pathian Thianghlim Keimah sokhaw ka si!"},"24":{"text":"Na siahhlawh pawl ka hnenah na thlah ih, ‘Ka rangleng pawl thawn tlang saangbik ka neh ih Lebanon Tlangzim khal ka laak a si,’ tiah tluang na khawng. ‘A saangbik sidar thing lakih a saangbik khal ka hau thei; a ṭhabik farthing khal ka hau thei ih tupi sungih a hlatnak bik khal ka thleng thei,’ tiah na porh aw."},"25":{"text":"‘Miphundang pawl ramsungah tikhur ka lai ih tidai ka in thei; ka ralkap pawl in Nail Tivapi cu caar ṭheh ko in an pal,’ tiah na porh aw ciamco."},"26":{"text":"“Hi pawl hi hlanlaipi ihsin ka rak ngaihtuah cia mi a si ti na thei lo maw? Ka rak tumcia mi cu atu ah ka tuahsuak a si. Keimah in cahnak huham ka lo pek ruangah ralhruang ih kulh mi khua pawl cu hnawmpen ah na canter ṭheh a si."},"27":{"text":"Cutawkih a rak umtu pawl cu zianghman thilti theinak an neilo. Thinphang le mangbangin an um meen. Nisuahnak lam ihsin thlisia a hrang mi in a seem mi lo sung hrampi le diphun ih a kho mi hrampi bangtuk an si."},"28":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na thu cu a zate in ka thei. Na tuah mi le na fehnak khal ka thei ṭheh. Ka parih na thinhengzia khal ka thei a si."},"29":{"text":"Na thinhengnak thuhla ka thei zo ih na tluangkhawnnak tla ka theih ṭheh zo ruangah atu cun na hnar ah sio ka thlaih ding; na kaa ka lo kharh dingih na ratnak lamzin ihsin ka lo kirter ding,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cule Isaiah in siangpahrang Hezekiah hnenah, “A cang dingmi thil pawl khihhmuhtu cu hiti in a si ding. Tuihkum le hmaikum cu amahte ih a kho mi fang nan ei ding; asinan a kumleh ahcun fang nan ciing thei dingih rawl nan nei ding; sabit hri nan phun dingih sabit rah nan ei ding."},"31":{"text":"Judah miphun sungin a taangsun cu nan ṭhangso zet ding; leilung thuukpi sung tiang hram a thla ih rah a rah mi thingkung bangtuk nan si ding."},"32":{"text":"Jerusalem le Zion Tlang ah a taangsun mi malte an um ding, ziangahtile Cungnungbik Bawipa in cuti ih cang dingin a tumtah hrimhrim mi a si,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang thu ahcun Bawipa in hiti in a sim zo: “Hi khawpi sungah a lut lo ding; hi khawpi sungah conkiang pakhat hman a sai lo ding. Hi khawpi kiangkapah ralphaw kengtu ralkap pakhat hman an ra lo ding; cule hi khawpi donak ah a ralhruang lenglam in leisaang a kimvel in a dawl lo ding."},"34":{"text":"Hi khawpi sung cu a pal hrimhrim lo ding; a ratnak lamzin ihsin a kir saal ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo!"},"35":{"text":"Hi khawpi cu ka ṭan dingih ka hum ding; ka hmin thannak ah le ka siahhlawh David hnenih thukamnak ka tuah zo ruangah hi khawpi cu ka run ding a si,” a ti."},"36":{"text":"Bawipaió vancungmi pakhat cu Assiria ralkap pawl riah hmunah a feh ih an ralkap thawng zakhat le thawng sawmriat le thawngnga a that. A thaizing khua a vang tikah ralkap cuzat cu an ril teptep; an thi ṭheh riai!"},"37":{"text":"Cutikah Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib cu dungah a siip ih Nineveh khua ah a kir."},"38":{"text":"Nikhat ah Sennakherib cu a khuavang Nisrok biakinn sungih a khuavang a biak laiah, a fapa pahnih Adrammelek le Sharezer in an ralnam in an sunthat ih cuihnu ah Ararat ramah an tlan. A fapa dang pakhat Esarhaddon in a ai ah siangpahrang a ṭuan."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Culai ah siangpahrang Hezekiah cu a na ih a thi zikte. Amoz fapa profet Isaiah in a va veh ih, “ Bawipa in a seherhmi hmuahhmuah tuah ṭheh in sim ṭheh seh, a nunglo ding a lo ti. Curuangah thi dingin tiimlaam aw,” tiah a va ti.","title":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah Natnak Le Damnak"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Hezekiah cu phar lamah a herih thla a cam."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka damsung hmuahhmuah ah nangmah rinsan in le rintlakzet in ka lo rian zo ih tuah ding i duhsak mi lawnglawng tuahsuak ka tum ringring cu ciing hram aw,” tiah a ti. Cule nasazet in a ṭap ciamco."},"4":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in Isaiah hnenah,"},"5":{"text":"“Hezekiah hnenah va feh awla ‘ Bawipa keimah, na pu David ih Pathian in na thlacamnak cu ka thei ih na mitthli ka hmu zo. Tuihnu kum hleinga ka lo nunter hrih ding."},"6":{"text":"Nangmah le hi khawpi cu Assiria siangpahrang kut sung ihsin ka lo luatter dingih hi khawpi cu ka hum ringring ding, a ti,’ tiah va sim aw,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Isaiah in, “ Bawipa in a thukamnak a kimter ding tinak ah hminsinnak a lo pe ding."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahaz ih a tuah mi ni tahnak kha sun hnuah Bawipa in a thlaam cu dunglamah kal hra a kir ter ding,” tiah a ti. A ti vekin a thlaam cu dunglamah kal hra a kir saal a si."},"9":{"text":"A natnak ihsin Hezekiah a dam sal tikah lungawi thangṭhatnak hla a ngan:"},"10":{"text":"Ka san ṭhat laitak ah Mithi khua ka thleng ding a si hi, ka ti. Tarkuun ih nunglo dingah ka ruat aw."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa ka tongsaal nawn lo ding, Midang a nungmi zokhal, tiah ka ruat. Minung umnak hi ram ahcun!"},"12":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu sahcat a si ih a cem ta; An bal mi thlaam bangin. Thiamtlang ihsin an tan mi puan bangin. Pathian in ka nunnak a cemter a sihi, ka ti."},"13":{"text":"Zan vaarte nat tuar in ka ṭap ka ai; Kiosa in ka ruh khiak ṭheh sehla cubangin. Pathian in ka nunnak a cemter a sihi, ka ti."},"14":{"text":"Ka aw cu a diim zetih theih thei a si nawn lo; Thuro bangin ka awn maimai. Vancung lam ka thlirnak ah ka mit an kham ṭheh; Maw Bawipa , hibang harnak sungin i run aw."},"15":{"text":"Ka sim thei mi ziangso a um? Bawipaió tuah mi an si ṭheh si! Ka thin a na tukih ka it thei lo."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na hrangah ka nung ding, Na hrang lawngah nun ka duh. I damter awla i nungter hram aw."},"17":{"text":"Ka thin natnak cu daihnakah a cang ding; Ka nunnak cu ṭihphannak sungin na run. Ka sualnak hmuahhmuah i ngaidam ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Mithi khua ihsin zohmanin an lo thangṭhat theilo ding; Mithi pawl in rintlak na sinak cu an ring theilo a si."},"19":{"text":"A lo thangṭhat tu cu minung pawl an si; Atu ih ka lo thangṭhat bangtuk in. Rintlak na sizia cu pa le pawl in an faate pawl an sim a si."},"20":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah in i damter zo; ṭingṭang kan tum dingih Nangmah thangṭhatnak hla kan sa ding. Kan nundam sung hmuahhmuah ah Nangmah cawimawinak cu Na Biakinn sungah kan sa ringring ding."},"21":{"text":"Isaiah in siangpahrang cu, “Theipi rah rialdip awla na khuaihli hma ah ben aw; cule na dam ding,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Hezekiah in, “Biakinn ah ka feh thei saal ding, ti langnak ah ziang khihhmuhnak so a um?” tiah a sut."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cui caanah Babilon siangpahrang a si mi, Baladan fapa Merodak Baladan in siangpahrang Hezekiah a na ti kha a thei; curuangah ca pakhat le laksawng pakhat a kuat.","title":"Babilon Ihsin Palai An Ra (2 Sian. 20.12-19)"},"2":{"text":"Hezekiah cun Baladan ih palai pawl cu ṭhatein a rak zoh ih a lennak hmuahhmuah a hmuh ṭheh hai. A neih mi a sui le a ngun pawl, rimhmui le zihmui pawl, a ralkap le ralkap thilthuam hmuahhmuah tla a hmuh a si. A thilri retnak inn sungah siseh, a uknak sung hmuahhmuah ah siseh, a neih mi a hmuh lomi pakhat hman a um lo."},"3":{"text":"Cule profet Isaiah cu siangpahrang Hezekiah hnenah a feh ih, “Himi pawl hi khui in so an rat? Na hnenah ziangso an sim?” tiah a sut. Hezekiah cun, “Ram hla zet, Babilon ram in an ra,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Isaiah in, “Siangpahrang inn sungah ziangso an hmuh?” ti ih a sut tikah Hezekiah in, “Ziang hmuahhmuah an hmu ṭheh. Thilri retnak inn sungah ka hmuhter lomi thil zianghman a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Isaiah in, “Cungnungbik Bawipa in,"},"6":{"text":"‘Na inn sungih a um mi hmuahhmuah, tuihsun tiangin na pu le na pa pawl ih an rak khawl mi thilri le hlawnthil pawl cu Babilon ramih an phurh ṭhehnak tikcu a rathleng ding. Zianghman a taanglo ding."},"7":{"text":"Nangmaió tefasin pawl rori hman Babilon ah an hruai dingih Babilon siangpahrang inn ih hnaṭuantu dingah an til an per ding a si,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"8":{"text":"Cumi cu siangpahrang Hezekiah in a theih tikah a nundam sungah cun daihnak le humhimnak a um ding, ti can ai a si tiah a zum ruangah Hezekiah cun, “ Bawipa hnen ihsin a ra mi thu i sim mi cu thuṭha a si,” tiah a sawn."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kan Pathian in, “Ka minung pawl hneem uh, Ka minung pawl hneem hai uh;","title":"Ruahsannak ṭongkam"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem khua mi pawl tha pe uh. A reizet an tuar zo ih An sualnak cu ngaidam a si zo, tiah sim uh. An sualnak hmuahhmuah ih ruangah Nasazet in daan ka tat hai a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Aw a thangih, “ Bawipa hrangah Hramlak ramṭhing ah lamzin tuah uh. Kan Pathian hrangah nelrawn ah lamzin sial uh!"},"4":{"text":"Horkuam hmuahhmuah silhkhah thluh uhla, Tlangsang hmuahhmuah bal ṭheh uh. Tlang pawl cu hmunrawn ah an cang dingih, Leilung bingbo hmuahhmuah rualtein rem thluh an si ding."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipaió huham cu a lang dingih, Mi hmuahhmuah in an hmu ding. Bawipa amah rori in a kam zo a si,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Aw in, “Au aw!” i ti. Kei in, “Ziang so ka au ding?” tiah ka sut. “Minung cu hrampi bangtuk an si; Hramlak pangpar hnakin reideuh an nung cuanglo."},"7":{"text":"Hrampi cu an vuai ih pangpar cu an ziam, Bawipa in an parih thli a hranter tikah cun! Minung cu hrampi hnakin an cak deuh cuanglo."},"8":{"text":"A si, hrampi cu an vuai ih pangpar cu an ziam; Asinain kan Pathian thu cu a hmun ringring a si,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, tlang parah hung kai awla, Thuthang ṭha cu hung sim aw. Maw Zion, ring zetin au awla, Thuthang ṭha cu phuang aw. Simsuak aw, zianghman ṭih hlah. Judah ram khawpi pawl hnenah ‘Nan Pathian a ralai a si,’ tiah sim aw!"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa cu a cahnak huham thawn Mi uk dingah a ra lai. A runsuak mi pawl tla a rak hruai a si."},"11":{"text":"A tuu pawl cu tuukhal bangin a kilkhawi ding; Tuu faate pawl cu hmun khatah khawm tahrat in, A kut in a cawi dingih, An nu hnenah nuamte in a fehpi ding."},"12":{"text":"Tipithuanthum khi a suumpi in a tah theitu an um maw? Van khi a khaap in a tah theitu teh an um maw? Zoso leilung tlunih leivut hi a bawm sungah a thun ṭheh thei? Zoso tlangsaang le tlangmual hi cuai in a khai thei?","title":"Tahṭhim Thei Asilomi Israel Ih Pathian"},"13":{"text":"Hitión tuah aw tiah Bawipa a sim theitu zoso a um? A zirh theitu le ruahnak pe theitu teh an um maw?"},"14":{"text":"Pathian in zoso thu a ron dah? Zohnen ah so fimnak le theihthiamnak a hawl dah? Thiltuah daan teh zotal in an sim dah maw?"},"15":{"text":"Bawipaió hrangah miphun pawl cu zianghman an si lo; Tidai forkhat tluk fang an si. Lamhlatpi ih tikulh pawl tla cu, Leidip fangkhat tlukin an zaang a si."},"16":{"text":"Lebanon tupi sungih ramsa hmuahhmuah cu, Kan Pathian hnenih thawinak pek dingah a tamtuk lo. Tupi sungih thingkung hmuahhmuah khal cu Mei-ur thawinak zanthing hrangah a maltuk a si."},"17":{"text":"Leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah cu A hrangah zianghman an si lo."},"18":{"text":"Pathian cu ziangthawn so kan ṭhim thei ding? Ziang a bang ticu ziangtinso kan rel thei ding?"},"19":{"text":"Kutzungthiam pawl ih tuah mi milem, Sui sertu pawl ih sui in an khuut mi, Ngunkheng sungih an toh mi bangtuk a si lo."},"20":{"text":"Sui le ngun a neilo tu cun A siat ol lomi zanthing an hril. Kutzungthiam pakhat a hawl ih A tlu lo dingmi milem a tuah ter."},"21":{"text":"Nan hmu lo maw? Nan thei dah lo maw? Reipi ihsin sim cia nan si lo maw? Leilung ziangtin a thok ticu nan thei zo lo maw?"},"22":{"text":"Leitlun le van leengah A siangpahrang tokham parih a totu in a tuah a si. A thuai ih milai pawl cu a mithmuh ah sihte tia fang an si. Van khi puan bangin a pharh ih Minung umnak ah puanthlam bangin a zaar a si."},"23":{"text":"Amah in uktu cakzetzet cu a thlak ih Thulolak ah a tuah ṭheh."},"24":{"text":"Anmah tla cu thingkung note Hram neilo a suak pekte bangtuk an si. Culai ah Bawipa in thli a hran ter, An caar ṭheh ih fangkungro bangin a semhlo ṭheh a si."},"25":{"text":"Pathian thianghlim cu zo thawn so kan tahṭhim thei ding? Amah a bangtu zotal an um maw?"},"26":{"text":"Van khi hun zohhnik uh! Nan hmuh mi arsi hmuahhmuah khi zoso a tuah? Ralkapbu an ho vekin hi arsi pawl a ho tu cun ziangzat an si, ti a thei ih an hmin in a ko fingfing a si. A huham cu a nasa ngaingai ih Pakhat te hman an hlo dah lo."},"27":{"text":"Maw Israel, ziangah so nan phunzai ih Bawipa in kan harnak in theihsak lo, Kan hrangah thil a tawlrel ṭha lo, tiah nan ti?"},"28":{"text":"Nan hmu lo maw? Nan thei dah lo maw? Bawipa cu kumkhua ih a hmun mi Pathian a si. Leilung hmuahhmuah tuahtu a si. Anih cu thabaang le thacem in a um dah lo; A ruahnak cu theih ban ding rual a si lo."},"29":{"text":"A baang mi le thacem mi pawl cu an tha a cakter saal."},"30":{"text":"Mino pawl hman an baang dingih Tlangval khal an tha cem in an sawn ding."},"31":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa a rinsan tu cu An tha a tlung saal ding. Muvanlai vekin thlapharh in an zam ding. An tlan khalle an tha a baang lo ding; An feh rero khalle thacem in an sawn dah lo ding."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in, “A hlatpi ih um mi ram pawl, Dai zirziar in um uhla ka sim mi hi ngaihnik uh! Thurelnak hmunah nan thu cu rak keng uh. Nan thuhla relnak tikcu nan ngah ding. Ra uhla zoso a hman ti kan ruat tlang hnik pei.","title":"Pathian In Israel Mi Thu A Kam"},"2":{"text":"“Mi hmuahhmuah nehtu cu zoso nisuahnak lamin a rak hruai? A fehnak kipah zo in so nehnak a pek? Miphun tampi le siangpahrang tampi tlunah zo in so nehtu a siter? A neh mi pawl cu leivui sihaisehla cubangin a ralnam in a sah thlak! Fangkungro cu thli ih a semhlo bangin a conkiang in a ṭhekdarh ṭheh!"},"3":{"text":"An dungin a dawi, himdam zetin a feh vivo! Leilung hman a dai manlo titlak in a zamrang."},"4":{"text":"Hiti ih a ngaihtuahtu cu zoso a si? Leilung tlun thuanthu ih cang dingin a tumtu cu zoso a si? Bawipa keimah cu a hramthok ah ka rak um zo; Bawipa Pathian keimah cu a netnak khalah ka um ding."},"5":{"text":"“Lamhlatpi ram pawl in ka thiltuah mi cu an hmu zo; An ṭih ngaingai ih an thinphang in an ṭhia. Curuangah hmun khatah an tongkhawm aw."},"6":{"text":"Kutzungthiam pawl tla an bawm aw ih Pakhat le pakhat tha an pe aw."},"7":{"text":"Lettama in sui sertu hnenah ‘Sui tuah na thiam zet,’ a ti. Milem ngilzet ih a deengtu in Tlawngkhen in a kaikomtu cu a lom. Mi pakhat in ‘Na erh mi cu aṭha a si,’ a ti ih Hngetzetin milem cu an retnak hmunah tlawngkhen in an kheng."},"8":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla nang Israel ka siahhlawh, Nang cu ka lo hrilzo mi na si. Ka rual Abraham ih tefa sin nan si."},"9":{"text":"Leilung netnak in ka lo hruai; Vanhram deng ihsin ka lo ko ih, ‘Nang cu ka siahhlawh na si,’ ka lo ti. Ka lo hnong lo, ka lo hril sawn a si."},"10":{"text":"Zianghman ṭih hlah, na hnenah ka um a si. Keimah cu na Pathian ka si, zianghman in lo phangter hlah seh. Ka lo bawm dingih ka lo cakter ding; Ka lo hum dingih ka lo run ding."},"11":{"text":"“Na parih thinhengtu pawl cu Mual an pho dingih ningzah an tuar ding. Nangmah a lo dotu cu an thi ding."},"12":{"text":"Cat lo ih a lo dotu pawl cu Leilung ihsin an hloral ta ding."},"13":{"text":"Keimah cu Bawipa na Pathian ka si; Na tha ka lo cakter ih, ‘Zianghman ṭih hlah; ka lo bawm ding,’ tiah ka lo ti,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Israel, miphun fate le mi ṭawnṭai na si. Asinain zianghman ṭih hlah, ka lo bawm ding. Israel ih Pathian Thianghlim keimah cu a lo runtu ka si."},"15":{"text":"Nangmah cu fang vuaknak fung, a thar, a hriam mi ha a nei mi bangtuk ah ka lo tuah ding. Tlangsang pawl na ciil dingih an siat ding; Tlangmual pawl tla leivut ah an cangṭheh ding."},"16":{"text":"Van ah na khirh hai dingih Thli in a semhlo ding; Thlisia in khuazakip ah a ṭhekdarh ding. Asinain keimah hi na Pathian ka si ruangah nang cu na lung a awi ding. Israel ih Pathian Thianghlim hi i thangṭhat ding."},"17":{"text":"“Ka minung pawl mangbang vansaangin an um ih Tihal in an dang a caar tikah, Bawipa keimah in an thlacamnak cu ka thei ding; Israel ih Pathian keimah cun ka dungtun dah lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Tlangcar lakih sin tiva an puut dingih Phairawn in cerhti fim an luang ding. Nelrawn cu ticawm in ka khahter dingih Ramcaar cu cerhti luannak ah ka canter ding."},"19":{"text":"Nelrawn ah sidar zanthing ka kho ter ding, Lawithing, lenhmui le olif thing tla ka kho ter ding. Leenkolh ah tupi ka umter dingih cuih tupi ahcun farthing, hualthing le tufar thing an kho ding."},"20":{"text":"Cumi cu mi in an hmuh tikah Bawipa keimah ih tuah mi a si kha an thei ding. Israel ih Pathian thianghlim in hi hmuahhmuah cu a cangter a si tikha an theithiam thlang ding,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang, Bawipa Pathian in; “Miphun hmuahhmuah ih khuavang pawl, Nan thuhla cu rel hnik hmeen uh! Nan thiam tawkin sim hnik uh!","title":"In Khuavang Pawl A Zuam"},"22":{"text":"Hinah ra uhla thil a cang dingmi simcia hnik uh; Thil a cangzo mi pawl ih tican in simfiang hnik uh. Cule hmailam ih thil a cangmi a um tikah a tican kan theih theinak dingah, ziangti zawng in so a kim ding, ti in simfiang hnik uh."},"23":{"text":"Hmailam ih a ra dingmi thuhla in sim uh; Cuticun khuavang ngaingai nan si kan thei ding. Thilṭha pahnih khat tal tuah hnik uh, Asilole thihnak thupoimawh thlenter hnik uh. ṭihnak le tuksumnak in in khahter hnik uh."},"24":{"text":"Nanmah siseh, nan thiltuah mi siseh, thuphan hlir nan si! Nanmah a lo biatu pawl le fihnungza an si fawn."},"25":{"text":"“Nisuahnak lamih a um mi pakhat ka hril zo; Saklam ihsin do dingah ka hruai ding. Mi uktu pawl cu ciarbek vekin a pal, Beel tuahtu ih tlak a pal bangin a palbeek a si."},"26":{"text":"Hi thil a cang ding, tiah in simcia theitu zotal nan um maw? Nan hman ngai a sihi, kan ti dingah zotal nan um maw? Cubangtuk a ṭongtu zohman nan um lo; ṭong kamkhat hman nan ṭong lo, Nan ṭong a theitu pakhat te hman an um lo."},"27":{"text":"Keimah Bawipa cu Zion hnenih hi thuthang a phuang tu hmaisabik ka si. Jerusalem hnenah palai ka thlah ih, ‘Na minung an ra ding! an rakir ding a si,’ tiah sim dingin ka fial a si."},"28":{"text":"Nan khuavang pawl ka zoh tikah Pakhat hman in zianghman an ṭong lo. Ka thusuh mi a let theitu zohman an um lo."},"29":{"text":"Hi khuavang pawl hi thulolak hlir an si; An tuah thei mi zianghman a um lo. An milem pawl hi mi ṭawnṭai le huham neilo hlir an si."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka siahhlawh cu hinah a um; Amah cu ka cak ter mi le ka hrilmi a si, A parah ka lung a awi. Ka thlarau in ka khah ter zo ih Miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah thuding a thleng ter ding.","title":"Siahhlawh"},"2":{"text":"A au lo dingih a aw tla a saang lo ding; Lamzin khalah ringzet zetin thu a sim lo ding."},"3":{"text":"A sawn i a kiak zik mi phaikung a khiak lo ding, A mit zik mi mei inn khal a hmit lo ding. Mi hmuahhmuah hnenah kumkhua in thuding a thleng ter ding."},"4":{"text":"A bei a dong lo dingih a thin tla a nau lo ding; Leilung tlunah thuding a leeng ter ding. Lamhlapi ram pawl in a thuzirh mi cu an hngakhlap ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Pathian in van tla khi a seemsuah ih a pharh; Leilung le nunnak a nei mi thil hmuahhmuah a tuah. Minung hnenah nunnak le thaw a peek. Bawipa Pathian in a siahhlawh hnenah,"},"6":{"text":"“ Bawipa keimah in ka lo ko ih huham ka lo peek, Leilung tlunah thuding a leennak dingah. Nangmah sungin mi hmuahhmuah thawn thukamnak ka tuah ding. Nangmah sungin miphun tampi hnenah tleunak ka thlenter ding."},"7":{"text":"Mitcaw pawl ih mit cu na vaangter dingih, A thim mi thawnginn sungih a to mi pawl cu na luat ter ding."},"8":{"text":"“Keimah lawng hi Bawipa na Pathian ka si. Ka huham cu khuavang dang ka hlawm lo ding, Ka sunlawinak khal milem pawl ka ṭhen lo ding."},"9":{"text":"A ra thleng ding ti ih ka rak simcia mi cu An thleng ngaingai zo. Atu ahcun thil thar ka lo sim ding, An thlen hlan ihsin ka lo sim cia ding,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah hla thar sa uh; Leilung pumpi in amai thangṭhatnak hla sa uh. Tifinriat parih a fehtu pawl in amah cu thangṭhat uh; Tifinriat sungih a um mi pawl khalin thangṭhat uh. Lamhlapi ramah a um mi khalin thangṭhat cio uh.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"11":{"text":"Nelrawn le nelrawn khua pawl in Pathian cu cawimawi hai seh. Kedar mi pawl khalin cawimawi hai seh! Sela khua ih a um mi in tlangsaang parih sin lungawi in au ciamco hai seh!"},"12":{"text":"Lamhlapi ih a um mi pawl in Bawipa hnenah thangṭhatnak le sunlawinak pe hai seh!"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa cu micak bik bangin a feh; Raldo dingah a timtuah ih a hngakhlap zet a si. Raldo dingah a au ih neh dingah a au ciamco. A ral pawl hnenah a huham a hmuh."},"14":{"text":"Pathian in, “Tikcu reipi daiteón ka um zo; Ka minung pawl ka sawn lo. Atu cun ka thok thlang ding; Nau nei ding nunau bangin ka hruum ka ai.","title":"In A Minung A Bawm Ding"},"15":{"text":"Tlangmual le tlangsaang pawl ka siatsuah ding; Hrampi le thingkung pawl ka caar ter ṭheh ding. Tiva horkuam pawl cu nelrawn ah ka tuah dingih, Ticawm pawl ka kaang ter ṭheh ding."},"16":{"text":"“Ka minung mitcaw pawl ka hruai ding; An feh dah lonak lamzin ihsin. An khuathimnak cu tleunak ah ka thleng ding; An hmai ih zin bingbo cu ka ngilter ṭheh ding. Hi pawl cu ka tuah tengteng ding."},"17":{"text":"Milem a rinsantu pawl le Cui milem pawl ka pathian a ti tu cu an ning a zak dingih mual an pho ding a si,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Nannih hnaset pawl, ṭhatein ngaihnik uh! Nannih mitcaw pawl, naihten zohhnik uh!","title":"Israel Ih Thu Theih Lo Zia"},"19":{"text":"Ka siahhlawh hnakih mit a caw sawn an um pei maw? Palai ka thlah mi hnakih hnaset sawn an um pei maw?"},"20":{"text":"Maw Israel, na hmuh mi le na ton mi hi a tamzet zo; Asinain na hrangah zianghman santlai an si lo. Theihnak ah hna na nei; Asinain na theih fel ngaingai mi ziangso a um?” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa cu mi run ding a hiarzet tu Pathian a si; Curuangah a daan le a thuzirh mi kha a sunloih ih, A minung pawl khalin upat hai seh ti a duh."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a minung pawl cu mi in an ram; Leilung kua sungah an khum ih, Thawnginn hlatpi ah an thup hai a si. Thilri ram mi le lon mi an si; Anmah humtu dingah zohman an um lo."},"23":{"text":"Hi thuhla hi a theitu zotal nan um maw? Tuihnu cun ṭhatein nan ngai thlang lo ding maw?"},"24":{"text":"Israel hi mi ramtu pawl kutih a petu hi zoso a si? Bawipa amah a si; Kan dodal ih a parah sualnak kan tuah mi Bawipa a si. A duhnak vekin kan nung thei lo; A thupekmi vekin kan thlun thei fawn lo."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah a thinhengnak in tuarter ih, Raldo harsatnak in tongter a si. A thinhengnak cun meisa bangin Israel ram pumpi a kang; Sikhalsehla ziang a cang rero ti kan thei dah lo; Hi hmuahhmuah ihsin zianghman kan zir ngah mi a um cuang lo."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Israel, nangmah a lo tuahtu Bawipa in, “Zianghman ṭih hlah-ka lo hum ding; Na hmin in ka lo ko zo-ka ta na si.","title":"Pathian In A Minung Pawl A Run"},"2":{"text":"A thukmi tidai sungih na feh khalle na hnenah ka um ding. Na ton mi harsatnak pawl hin a lo neh lo ding. Meisa sungih na feh khalle na kaanglo ding. Hremnak harsa khal in a lo na ter lo ding."},"3":{"text":"Ziangahtile keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si. A lo runtu, Israel ih Pathian thianghlim ka si. Nangmah luatter duh ah Izipt ka hnong sawn pei; Ethiopia le Seba khal ka dungtun sawn pei."},"4":{"text":"Na nunnak run duh ah miphun tampi ka hnong sawn pei; Ziangahtile nang cu ka hrangah na sunglawi. Ka lo duhdawt ih upatnak ka lo pek a si."},"5":{"text":"Zianghman ṭih hlah aw-na hnenah ka um a si. “Lamhlapi nisuahnak le nitlaknak ihsin, Na minung pawl ka rak hruai ding."},"6":{"text":"Anmah thlah dingin saklam cu ka sim dingih, Anmah hreng nawnlo dingin thlanglam cu ka fial ding. Ram hlapipi ihsin ka minung pawl cu rakir hai seh; Leitlun khuazakip in ra tlung hai seh."},"7":{"text":"Keimaió minung an si ih, Sunloihnak i petu dingih ka seemsuah mi an si,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Pathian in, “Ka minung pawl cu thuṭhennak zungah ko uh; Mit an nei naón mitcaw an si. Hna an nei naón hnaset an si.","title":"Israel Cu Thutheih Pitu An Si"},"9":{"text":"Miphun dang pawl cu thuṭhennak hmunah ko hai uh; An khuavang lakah hmailam thusim theitu an um maw? Atu ih thil cangmi pawl hi zoso a rak simsung dah? Hi khuavang pawl hin kan sim mi cu a hman ih Kan thu cu thudik a si, ti langternak ah thutheih pitu rak suahpi hai seh!"},"10":{"text":"“Maw Israel mi pawl, nanmah hi ka thu theitu nan si; Keimah i riantu phun ih ka lo hrilmi nan si. Cuticun keimah cu in thei dingih in zum ding; Keimah lawng Pathian ka si kha in theithiam ding. Keimah siarlo Pathian dang a um lo; A um dah loih a um dah lo ding."},"11":{"text":"“Keimah pakhat lawng hi Bawipa ka si. A lo run theitu ding cu keimah lawng ka si."},"12":{"text":"A cang dingmi ka rak simcia zo; Cule nangmah bawm dingah ka ra a si. Cubangtuk ih a tuahtu ramdang khuavang an um lo; Nanmah hi ka thu theitu nan si."},"13":{"text":"Keimah cu Pathian ka si ih ka si kumkhua ding. Ka huham sung ihsin zohman an luat lo ding. Ka tuah mi cu zohmanin an thleng theilo ding,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian thianghlim, a lo runtu Bawipa in, “Nanmah luatter dingah Babilon ah ralkap ka thlah ding; An khawpi kotka pawl ka siatbal ṭheh ding, An minung awn-aunak cu ṭahnak ah a cang ding.","title":"Babilon Ihsin Luatnak"},"15":{"text":"Keimah hi Bawipa nan Pathian thianghlim cu ka si. Maw Israel, a lo seemsuahtu ka si ih, Keimah hi na siangpahrang ka si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Khuahlan laiah Bawipa in, Tifinriat sungin lamzin a rak tuah. Tiherh lakah lamzin a umter a si."},"17":{"text":"A cakzet le a makzet mi ralkapbu cu a hloral ter ṭheh; Rangleeng le rangpar ralkapbu pawl cu! An ril ih an tho nawn lo; Meifar kan mih vekin an mit ta a si."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa in, “Dunglam thil lawnglawng ngaihtuah hlah uh; Hlanlai thuhla lawng ruat hlah uh;"},"19":{"text":"Thilthar ka tuah dingmi ṭhatein thlir uh. Atu khalah an um rero thlang-nan hmu thei ding. Hramlak ramṭhingah lamzin ka tuah ding, Cutawkah tidai nan hrangah ka luan ter ding."},"20":{"text":"Hramlak ramsa hman in in ṭihzah ding; Cinghnia le saam-ar in in thangṭhat ding, Ka hrilmi ka minung pawl hrangah Nelrawn ih tiva kan luan ter tikah cun!"},"21":{"text":"Keimah hrangih ka tuah mi miphun an si; Keimaió thangṭhatnak hla in an sa ding!” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Israel, nan biakmi cu kei ka si ual lo; Kei cu in ning a sisi!","title":"Israel Sualnak"},"23":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinak ih tuu cu ka hnenah nan keng lo; Nan saserh thawinak in nan cawimawi mi cu Kei ka si lo. Thil pek ding lo ngen in nan thil ka rit ter lo. Rimhmui lo dil in ka lo rethei ter lo."},"24":{"text":"Ka hrangah rimhmui nan lei lo; Nan ṭilva ih thau in in tlai ter fawn lo. Nan sualnak in ka thil in rih terih, Thilṭha lo nan tuah mi in ka thin in baangter a si."},"25":{"text":"Cubangtuk a sinan, nan sualnak a malh ṭheh tu Pathian cu Keimah thotho ka si! Keimah ka si ruangah hibangtuk in ka tuah a si. Nan mawhnak cu ka ciing ringring lo ding."},"26":{"text":"Thuṭhennak zungah feh hnik uhsi; Mi mawhthluknak nan neih mi rak keng hnik uh. Nan felnak langter dingah nan thu cu sim hnik uh!"},"27":{"text":"Nan pu le nan pa pawl an rak sual; Nan hotu pawl tla ka parah an sual zo."},"28":{"text":"Nan ram uktu pawl in ka hmun thianghlim an borhhlawh ter; Curuangah Israel parah siatsuahnak ka thlenter; Ka minung pawl midang hmuhsuam dingih a tuahtu cu Keimah ka si,” tiah a ti."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Israel, ka siahhlawh, Ka hrilmi, Jakob tefa pawl, ngaihnik uh.","title":"Lawng Hi Pathian A Si"},"2":{"text":"Keimah hi a lo seemsuahtu Bawipa ka si. Na nunnak a seem vete in ka rak lo bawm zo. Zianghman ṭih hlah; i riantu ka siahhlawh na si. Ka hrilmi, ka duhdawt mi na si."},"3":{"text":"“Tidai a haal mi ramah tidai ka pe ding; Nelrawn ah tiva ka luanter ding. Nan faate pawl parah ka thlarau ka burh dingih Nan tefa sin par khalah ka malsawmnak ka burh ding."},"4":{"text":"Ṭhazet ih tidai a ngah mi hrampi bangin an ṭhang dingih, Tivakap ih partiam kung bangin an hniing ding."},"5":{"text":"“Pakhat hnu pakhat mi in ‘Kei khal Bawipaió mi ka si,’ an ti ding. Israel mi pawl an ra fin vivo ding. An baan parah Bawipaió hmin an ngan fingfing dingih, Pathian ih minung ah an siar aw ding,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Israel a uktu le a humtu Bawipa , Cungnungbik Bawipa cun, “keimah cu hmaisabik le netabik ka si; Keimah siarlo Pathian dang a um lo."},"7":{"text":"Ka tuah mi a tuah theitu zotal an um maw? Caan a rak thoktir ihsin a netnak tiang, Thil a cang ding hmuahhmuah a simcia theitu an um maw?"},"8":{"text":"Ka minung pawl, zianghman ṭih hlah uh! Khua hlanlai ihsin tuihsan tiang a cang ding hmuahhmuah a hlankhan in ka rak simcia zo; Cui thu cu nan thei ih keimai thutheih pitu nan si. Pathian dang zotal an um maw? A cak mi Pathian, ka theih dah lomi teh an um maw?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Milem a tuahtu minung pawl cu zianghman an si lo; cule an uar zetmi le an sunloih zetmi an khuavang pawl khal cu santlailo hlir an si. Hi khuavang a biatu le a upat tu cu mi aa le mitcaw pawl an si ih ningzahnak an tong ding.","title":"Milem Biaknak Ziang Siar Lonak"},"10":{"text":"Biak dingah thir in khuavang tuah cu zianghman a ṭhahnem lo."},"11":{"text":"Cui khuavang a biatu hmuahhmuah cu an ning a zak leh ding. Milem a tuahtu pawl cu minung lawng an si. Zianghman an si lo. Ra hai sehla an thuṭhennak hmunah ra ding hnik hai seh. An ṭih dingih ningzahnak an tuar ding a si."},"12":{"text":"Sodengpa in thir tankhat a lakih meivam sungah a vaam ter. A cak mi a baan in sobul a lakih pianhmang nei tiangin a deen. Cuti ih a ṭuannak ah a ril a rawng, a ti a haal ih a baang ngaingai."},"13":{"text":"Cule lettama pakhat in zanthing a tah. Miphiu in zuk pungsan a suai; zipaw a ṭhut ih a hriamhrei in a ṭuan. Biakinn sungih ret dingah minung pianhmang in a tuah; minung pianhmang mawizet ah a tuah a si."},"14":{"text":"Cumi tuah dingah sidar thing maw, sasua kung maw, farthing maw tupi ihsin a hau ih a hmang. Asilole sidar thing a phun ih ruahpi ih ṭhanter dingin a hngak."},"15":{"text":"Minung in thingkung a hrek cu tihthing ah a hmangih a hrek cu milem tuahnak ah a hmang. Thing a hrek cun meisa a tuah ih a khuahlumnak ah a ai ih sang tla a rawh. A dang a hrek cun milem a tuah ih a biak:"},"16":{"text":"Zanthing hrekkhat cu meisa ah a muah; sa tla a em ih a ei ih a tlaizet hngin. Meisa ai tahratin, “A hlum a va nuam so! Ka meisa ṭhat daan cu!” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Zanthing hrekkhat cun milem a tuah. A hmaiah a kun ih a biak. A hnenah, “Nangmah hi ka pathian na si. I run hram aw,” tiah thla a cam."},"18":{"text":"Cubangtuk minung pawl cu an aa tukih ziang a si kan tuah ti hman an thei lo. Thutak le thuhman lamah cun an mit an siing ih an thinlung a pit a si."},"19":{"text":"Milem siamtu in, “Zanthing a hrek cu meisa ah ka ur ṭheh. Meivam parah sang ka rawh ih sa ka em ih ka ei. A dang zanthing cu milem ah ka tuah. Cui zanthing tan tankhat hmaiah cun atu hi ka kuun rero a sihi!” ti ruahnak le ngaihtuahnak malte hman a neilo a si."},"20":{"text":"Vutcam ei vekih tican neilo a si. A thinlung aa in zin peengah a hruaihlo ih bom thei ding a si nawn lo. A kutih a pom mi milem cu pathian a si ual lo, ti hman a thei thei nawn lo."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Israel, hi thil pawl hi ciingṭha aw; I riantu na si hi hngilh hlah. I riantu si dingah ka lo seemsuah ih, Ziangtik hmanah ka lo hngilh lo ding.","title":"Cu Seemsuahtu Le Runtu A Si"},"22":{"text":"Na sualnak cu mero a kian bangin ka kianter zo. Ka hnenah rasal aw; A lo runtu cu keimah ka si,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Maw van tla, lungawi in au uh! Leilung thuuk mi pawl, au cio uh! Tlang le tupi sung zanthing hmuahhmuah khal lungawi aipuang in au cio uh! Bawipa in a nasatnak langter tahratin A minung Israel a run zo a si."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Keimah cu Bawipa ka si; a lo seemsuahtu le Runtu ka si. Keimah hi Bawipa cu ka si; thil hmuahhmuah seemsuahtu ka si. Van tla khi keimah lawngin ka pharh; Leilung ka tuah tikah zohmanin in bawm lo."},"25":{"text":"Kutṭial zohthiam pawl cu mi-aa ah ka tuah ih, Arsi zohthiam pawl ih ṭong cu thuphan ah ka cangter. Mifim pawl ih ṭong cu ka el pit ih, An fimnak cu aatnak a sizia ka langter ṭheh a si."},"26":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka siahhlawh in a cang dingmi thil a simcia ih, Ka tumtah mi phuang dingah palai ka thlah tikah cun, Cui a sim mi le ka tumtah mi cu ka kimter rori a si. Jerusalem hnenah, ‘Minung an um saal ding a si,’ tiah ka ti. Judah khawpi hnenah, ‘A thar in saksal nan si ding,’ ka ti. Hi khawpi pawl cu hnawmpen sung ihsin an ding saal ding."},"27":{"text":"Thu ka pekih Tipithuanthum ka caarter."},"28":{"text":"Cule Sairas hnenah, ‘Nangmah cu ka ai-ah uktu na si ding. Tuahter ka lo duh mi na tuah ding: Jerusalem cu saksaal dingah thu na pe dingih Biakinn ih innhram thoksaal dingah thu na pe ding,’ ka ti,” tiah a sim."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sairas cu Bawipaió hrilmi siangpahrang a si! Bawipa in ram tampi nehtu dingah ṭuanvo a pek. Siangpahrang tampi an huham long dingah a thlah. Bawipa in a hrangah khawpi kotka pawl a on sak ding. Bawipa in Sairas hnenah,","title":"In Sairas Hnaṭuan A Pek"},"2":{"text":"“Keimah rori in na fehnak lamzin ka sial ding; Tlangsang le tlangmual pawl ka rawnter ding. Daar ih tuah mi kotka pawl ka khiak dingih Thir kotkalh pawl cu ka tan ṭheh ding."},"3":{"text":"A thimnak le a thupnak hmunih sumsaw pawl ka lo pe ding; Cuticun keimah hi Bawipa ka si cu na thei dingih, Israel ih Pathian in a lo hril a si, tihi na thei ding."},"4":{"text":"Ka siahhlawh Israel bawmtu dingah ṭuanvo ka lo pe; Ka hrilmi minung pawl bawmtu dingah. Keimah cu i theilo naón, Upatnak tumpi ka lo pek a si."},"5":{"text":"“Keimah hi Bawipa ka si, Pathian dang zohman an um lo. Nang cun i theilo naón, Na hai mi thazaang cahnak ka lo pe ding."},"6":{"text":"Khatlam vanhramdeng ihsin khatlam vanhramdeng tiang, Mi hmuahhmuah in keimah hi Bawipa ka sinak le Pathian dang khuihman ih a um lo zia, An theih ṭhehnak dingah hibangtuk in ka tuah a si."},"7":{"text":"Tleunak le thimnak tuahtu ka si. Thlawsuahnak le thihhloh poimawhnak suahtertu khal ka si. Hi hmuahhmuah a tuahtu cu Bawipa keimah ka si."},"8":{"text":"Nehnak cu van ihsin ruah bangin ka sur ter ding. Leilung in cucu a rak pom dingih, Dingnak le luatnak thawn a mum dingih a par ding. Bawipa keimah in cubangtuk in ka cangter ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Beel dang vek thotho a si mi tlakbeel pakhat in Beel tuahtu kha thu a el ngam pei maw? Tlak in beel tuahtu kha, “Ziang so na tuah rero hi?” a ti dah maw? Beel in beel tuahtu ih zung mawilonak cu a soi dah maw?","title":"Seemsuahtu Le Leilung Thuanthu Uktu"},"10":{"text":"Zotal in a nu le a pa hnenah, “Ziangah so hiti vekin in tuah?” a ti ngam dah maw?"},"11":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian thianghlim, Hmailam thil um ding daan a sersiamtu Bawipa cun, “Ka faate pawl thuhla ahcun i soisel theinak thu na neilo; Ka kut tuahnak khalah thu i pe theilo ding."},"12":{"text":"Leilung pumpi a tuahtu cu keimah ka si ih A parih um dingah minung cu ka seem ter. Ka cahnak in van tla khi ka pharh ih, Ni le thlapi le arsi pawl khi ka uk a si."},"13":{"text":"Sairas a forhsuak tu cu keimah ka si; A ṭha lomi rem dingih ka tumtahnak ṭuansuaktu dingah! A fehnak lamzin cu ka dingter ding. Ka khawpi Jerusalem cu a dinter saal dingih Sal taangmi ka minung pawl a luatter ding. Hi bangtuk tuah dingah zohman in a hlawhman an pe lo, Nawhthuh khal an pe lo a si,” tiah a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel hnenah, “Izipt le Ethiopia lennak cu na ta an si ding; Seba mi khaansaang pawl cu na sal an si dingih Thir cikcin thawn an lo thlun ding. Na hmaiah an lu an kuun dingih, ‘Pathian in a lo umpi-Amah lawng hi Pathian a si."},"15":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian, a minung pawl a runtu cu, A thup aw mi Pathian a si,’ tiah an phuang ding,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Milem a tuahtu hmuahhmuah cu an ning a zak ding; An zate in mual an pho ding."},"17":{"text":"Asinain Israel cu Bawipa in a hum zo; A mi nehnak cu kumkhua daih a si; A minung pawl cu mual an pho dah lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa in van tla khi a tuah! Amah cu Pathian a si. Amah in leilung hi a seemter ih leilungah a tuah! Reizet daih ding le hngetzet in a tuah. Ramṭhing le nelrawn hlir ah a tuah lo; Asinain milai umnak tlak ramah a tuah a si. Amah in, “Keimah cu Bawipa ka si; Pathian dang khuihman ah a um lo."},"19":{"text":"A thupte in ka sim lo, Ka tumtah mi khal hmuh theilonak ah ka thup lo. ‘Ramṭhing le nelrawn ah i hawl uh,’ tiah Israel mi pawl ka ti dah lo. Keimah hi Bawipa cu ka si ih thutak ka sim. Thudik ka phuang a si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ra hnik uh, leilung miphun pawl, Ram uknak a cem ṭheh hnu ih a taangmi pawl, Hmunkhatah ra hnik uh. Nan thuṭhennak hmunah rasuak ciar hnik uh. Zanthing ih tuah mi milem pawl a vahpi rero tu, Anmah a run theilotu khuavang hnenih thlacam tu pawl, Himi pawl cun zianghman theihnak an neilo!","title":"Leilung Le Babilon Ih Milem Pawl"},"21":{"text":"Nan thuṭhennak hmunah nan thu cu ra rel hnik uh! Thuneitu pawl cu pakhat le pakhat ron aw hai seh! Hlanlaipi ihsin hi thil pawl hi a cang ding a si, tiah a rak simcia tu cu zoso a si? A minung pawl a runtu Pathian, Bawipa keimah ka si lo maw? Pathian dang zohman an um lo!"},"22":{"text":"“Leilung tlun minung hmuahhmuah tla, Keimah lam hoikir uhla runak nan ngah ding. Keimah lawng Pathian ka um."},"23":{"text":"Ka sim mi hi thudik a si ih, a thleng aw dah lo ding. Ka hmin sal in thu ka kam a si: Mi hmuahhmuah an ra dingih ka hmaiah khuk an bil ding. Ka hmaiah thu an kam aw ding."},"24":{"text":"“Ka hnen lawngah nehnak le cahnak cu a um, tikha an phuang cio ding. Asinain i huatu cu ningzahnak an tuar ding."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa keimah in Jakob tefa sin pawl cu ka run dingih thangṭhatnak in pe ding."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Babilon ih khuavang pawl cu an cem a si! Khuahlanah Bel le Nebo an rak biak mi an si; Atu ahcun laak parah an suang ih, ṭilva baang tertu thilrit ah an cang zo."},"2":{"text":"Cubangtuk in an khuavang pawl cu an cem a si. Milem pawl cu anmah le anmah an run aw thei lo. An kaih ih an phurh hlo a si."},"3":{"text":"“Maw Jakob tefa sin pawl, i ngaihnik uh; Ka minung sung ihsin a taangsun pawl. Nan seem vete in ka kilkhawi mi nan si ih, Nan suahthlak vete in ka cangcawi mi nan si."},"4":{"text":"Nan Pathian ka si ih ka lo kil ringring ding, Na ṭuakpar le na tarkuun tiang ka lo cangcawi ding a si. Ka lo tuah ih ka lo kilveng ringring ding; Bomnak ka lo pe dingih ka lo hum ding."},"5":{"text":"“Zothawn so in ṭhim ding? Keimah bangtu an um maw?"},"6":{"text":"Mi in an paisa bawm an ongih an sui an buur; An ngun cu cuai in an thlai. Sui sertu an saangih milem an tuahter; Cui hmaiah an kuun ih an biak!"},"7":{"text":"An liangah an hun khai ih an phur; Hmun pakhat ah an retih cutawkah a ding ringring. A umnak ihsin hmundangah a ceer thei lo. A hnenih thla an cam tikah a sawn thei lo, Harsatnak sung khalin a hum theilo a si."},"8":{"text":"“Maw misual pawl, hihi ruat ṭha uh! Ka thil tuahcia mi hi ngaihtuah ṭha hnik uh!"},"9":{"text":"Thil a cangcia mi pawl kha vun mang saal hnik uh! Keimah lawng Pathian ka si kha thei uh; Keimah bangtuk zohman an um lo."},"10":{"text":"A hramthok ihsin ziang a cang ding ti cu ka rak sim cia zo; Khuahlanlai ihsin a cang dingmi cu ka relcia zo a si. Ka tumtah mi cu a pelh dah lo ding, ka ti. Tuah ka tum mi hmuahhmuah cu ka tuah ding a si."},"11":{"text":"Nisuahnak lam ihsin mi pakhat ka ko lai; Khaute bangin a rung zam dingih Ka khawkhan cia mi pawl cu a tisuak ṭheh ding. Ka sim zo vekin tuahsuak a si ding."},"12":{"text":"“I ngaihnik uh, nannih mi lungruh pawl, Nehnak cu a hlatzet hrih lai, ti ih a ruat tu pawl."},"13":{"text":"Nehnak ni cu ka rak kengih a thlengzik thlang; A hlat nawn lo a si. Ka mi nehnak cu zohman in an tlaiter thei lo ding; Jerusalem cu ka hum dingih, Cutawkih Israel mi hnenah hminthannak ka pe ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Babilon, Na siangpahrang tokham ihsin rung ṭum awla, Leilung par leivut lakah hin rung to aw. Na sanlai ahcun fala vek na si; zohmanih neh lo khawpi! Asinain atu ahcun falano le fala taksa neem na si nawnlo. Sal na si thlang!","title":"Babilon Parih Thuṭhennak"},"2":{"text":"Fang rialnak lungtumpi cu her aw! Fang rial aw! Na hmai khuhnak puan paate cu hlit thlang aw; Na hnipuan ṭhaṭha cu phuak thlang aw. Tiva tan dingin na hni hlit aw."},"3":{"text":"Namthlak mi le ningzak in, Taklawng um mi salnu bangin, Mi in an lo hmu thlang ding. Na parah phu ka lak dingih Zohman in in kham theilo ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian thianghlim in in luatter zo; Amaió hmin cu Cungnungbik Bawipa a si!"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Babilon hnenah, “Daite in khuathim sungah to meen aw! Mi in ‘Ram kipih Lalnu,’ an lo ti nawn lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Ka minung parah ka ai a thok; Ka minung lo vekin ka tuah a si. Na cahnak le na huham sungah ka thlak hai ih An parah zaangfahnak zianghman na nei lo; Nutar le patar pawl hman na tisiat a si."},"7":{"text":"Lalnu ka si ringring ding, tiah na rak ruat ih Thildang cungcang cu na ngaihtuah dah lo. Ziangtin so a neet leh ding, tikhal na ruat lo."},"8":{"text":"“ṭhatein ngaihnik, nang nomnak lawng a duhtu; Nang ka hnget ka him ti ih a ruattu, ruatṭha hnik. Pathian tluk tuum ah na rel aw ih, Zohman ih bang lo mi ah na ruat aw a si. Ka nuhmei dah lo ding; Ka faate pawl tla in in taan dah lo ding, na ti."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mitṭhep ah, ni ni khat sungah, Hi thil pahnih cu na parah an thleng ding. Ziangtluk ih na zingawk le rai na thawi rero hmanah Na faate pawl in an lo taan thotho ding; Nuhmei ah na cang fawn ding."},"10":{"text":"“Na siatvaatnak sungah cun zum awzet in na um; ‘Zohman in in hmu lo paam!’ na ti. Na fimnak le na theihnak in a peengah a lo hruai; Nangmah le nangmah cu, ‘Pathian ka si, Keimah bangtuk zohman milai an um lo!’ na ti."},"11":{"text":"Thihhlohnak poimawh cu na parah a thleng ding; Na mitkher le na kutṭial zohthiam pawl in an kham thei lo ding. Rinlopi ah siatsuahnak na parah a thleng ding; Na mang hmanih na man dah lomi siatnak cu!"},"12":{"text":"Na mitkher le na dawi thiamnak pawl cu thlah hlah aw; Na nolai ihsin na hman mi thil an si. An lo bawm thei khal a si thei meen! Na ral pawl in an ṭih tla a si thei meen!"},"13":{"text":"Ziangtluk ih ruahnak an lo pek rero khalle Thilti theinak zianghman na nei nawn lo. Na thuron mi pawl cu rasuak in lo run hai seh: Arsi thu a zirtu le van tla ih lamzin a theitu pawl, Thlakhat hnu thlakhat thu a lo sim ih Na parih thil a cang dingmi a lo simtu pawl cu!"},"14":{"text":"“Annih cu fanghi bangtuk meen an si; Meisa ih ur ṭheh ding an si. Anmah le anmah hman an run aw thei lo ding. Meisa alh cu an hrangah a sa tuk ding; A hlum meen, ai ding tawkfang meisa a si lo ding."},"15":{"text":"Na san sung hmuahhmuah ah thu na ron mi, Arsi zohthiam pawl ih thu cun Hitión an lo tuah ding: An lo tlansan ṭheh dingih anmah ih duhnak zin ciar an zawh ding. A lo runtu dingah pakhat hman an taanglo ding,” a ti."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Israel mi pawl, hihi ngaihnik uh! Judah tefa sin pawl, ṭhatein ngai uh! Bawipaió hmin salin thu na kam ih, Israel ih Pathian ka biak, na ti. Asinain na ṭongmi cu na hmurka lawngin a si; Na thinlung ah zianghman a um lo.","title":"Pathian Cu Hmailam Caan Ih A Si"},"2":{"text":"Cui tlunah hngalzet in, “Kei cu khua thianghlim sungih um mi ka si; Israel ih Pathian ka rinsan a si; Amaió hmin cu Cungnungbik Bawipa a si,” na ti."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel hnenah, “Khuahlanlai ihsin thil a cang dingmi ka rak simcia zo; Cule hmakhatte-ah ka kim ter."},"4":{"text":"Na thinlung cu thir le daar bangih ruh zetin A um ding tihi ka rak thei cia zo!"},"5":{"text":"‘Ka khuavang pawl ih cangter mi le, Ka milem pawl ih sim cia mi a si,’ na ti theilonak dingah, thil a cang hlan ihsin ka rak sim cia zo; Hlanlaipi ihsin ka rak sim cia zo a si."},"6":{"text":"“Ka rak sim cia mi hmuahhmuah an kim ṭheh zo; Ka rak sim mi an hman a si, ti ih na pom a ṭul a si. Atu ah a ra thleng dingmi thilthar ka lo sim ding; A hlanih ka phuan dah lomi thil pawl cu."},"7":{"text":"Atu lawngah ka cangter ding, Hi bangtuk cu dunglamah a cang dah lomi thil an si. A rak cang dah zo a si ahcun ka theih cia mi a si na ti ding."},"8":{"text":"Na suahthlak ihsin mi dodaltu na si ih, Rinsan ding na si lo, ti cu ka thei ṭheh a si. Curuangah a si hi thu hi na theih dah lonak le ṭong kamkhat hman na hna ih a thlen dah lonak cu!"},"9":{"text":"“Mi in ka hmin an thangṭhatnak dingah Ka thinhengnak cu ka suup a si; Ka thin ka neemter saal ih ka lo siatsuah lo ding."},"10":{"text":"Ngun cu somei sungih an thianfai ter bangin, Tuarnak meisa sungah ka lo hniksak a si. Asinain man neilo na si cu fiangtein ka thei."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah thil ka tuah mi hi ka hmin hrang lawngah ka tuah; Ka hmin cu thangsia in ka umter thei lo; Sunlawinak khal keimai ta lawng a si ih Zohman in an co lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel hnenah, “Maw Israel, ka kawh mi pawl, i ngaihnik uh; Keimah cu Pathian ka si; Hmaisa bik ka si, netabik khal ka si. Keimah lawng hi Pathian ka si.","title":"Ih Hrilmi Sairas"},"13":{"text":"Leilung ih hramṭohnak cu ka kutih tuah mi a si; Van tla khi ka kutih pharh mi an si. Lei le van ka ko tikah, Hmakhatte ah ka hmaiah an ra ding a si."},"14":{"text":"“Nan zate in pumkhawm uhla ngaihnik uh! Ka hrilmi pa in Babilon a do ding, tiah Khui khuavang hmanin a phuang cia theilo a si. Ka tuahter duh mi cu a tuah ding a si."},"15":{"text":"A hnenah a ṭongtu le a kotu cu keimah ka si; Ka hruai suakih hlawhtlinnak ka pek."},"16":{"text":"I ra naih uhla ka sim mi hi thei hnik uh! A hramthok ihsin nan hnenah zianghman thup loin ka sim; Ka sim mi thu cu a kim ringring a si,” a ti. (Atu ah Cungnungbik Bawipa in huham i pekih i thlah.)"},"17":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian thianghlim, a lo runtu Bawipa in, “Keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si; Nan ṭhatnak dingah a lo zirhtu le Nan fehnak ding lamzin ah a lo hruaitu ka si.","title":"In A Minung Pawl Hrangih Tumtahnak"},"18":{"text":"Ka thupekmi rak ngai uh cila maw! Nan parah hin thlawsuah malsawmnak cu Ziangtik hman ih a kaang dah lomi tiva bangin a luang ding nan! Nan hnenah nehnak cu, Tifinriat kapih tilet a thlen cingcing bangin a thleng ding nan!"},"19":{"text":"Nan tefa sin pawl cu tipikap ih vunnel zat an si dingih leilung tlunah hin a hloral mi nan si lo ding nan!” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Babilon ihsin suak uh! Nan luat a si feh uh! Cui thu cu lungawi in tlang-au uh! Khuazakip ah than uhla: “ Bawipa in a siahhlawh Israel a run zo a si!” tiah au ciamco uh."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl cu a caar le a sazet mi nelrawn lakihsin a hruai tikah, tihalnak zianghman an tuar lo. An hrangah lungpi sungin tidai a puut ter. Lungpi cu a kuaiter ih tidai a luang zurzo."},"22":{"text":"“Misual hrangah cun himnak a um lo,” tiah Bawipa in a ti."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lamhlatpi ih a um mi ram pawl, i ngaihnik uh! Khawtluang ih a um mi pawl tla! Ka suah hlan ihsin Bawipa in i hrilzo ih Amah riantu si dingah ṭuanvo i pek a si.","title":"Miphun Tampi Hnenah Tleunak"},"2":{"text":"Ka ṭong cu ralnam vekin a hriamter; A kut in i hum. A hriamzet mi le hman dingih retcia mi conkiang bangtuk ah i tuah a si."},"3":{"text":"Amah in ka hnenah, “Maw Israel, nang cu keimah riantu na si; Nangmah ruangah mi in in thangṭhat ding,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Kei in, “Ka ṭuan rero naón a lak hlir ah an cang. Ka thazaang a cem ṭheh; ka ṭuansuak mi zianghman a um lo,” ka ti. Asinain Bawipa cu a ṭha lomi ṭhattertu le a diklomi dik ko ih a tuah theitu a si tiah ka ring; Ka ṭuan mi ruangah amah in laksawng i pe ding."},"5":{"text":"Ka suah hlan ihsin, Bawipa in ṭuanvo i zem zo; A minung pawl hruaikir saal dingah le a ṭhekdarh aw mi Israel mi pawl kirter saal dingah amah riantu ah i tuah a si. Bawipa in hminṭhatnak i pek a si. Amah cu ka cahnak hrampi a si."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Keimah riantu, na ṭuanvo thupi sinsin a um: A taangsun Israel mi pawl hnenah A hlan vekin hminthannak na thlenter saal ding lawng si loin, Leilung pumpi runnak an ngah theinak dingah nangmah cu miphun tampi hnenih tleunak ah ka lo tuah ding a si,” i ti."},"7":{"text":"Mi ih an hmuhsuam zet mi, Miphun tampi ih huat mi, Uktu bawi pawl ih hnen-um ṭuantu hnen ah, A thianghlim mi Pathian, Israel Runtu cun, “Mi luat na si kha siangpahrang tla in an lo hmu dingih an lo upatnak langter dingah an ding ding; Siangpahrang fapa le bawi pawl tla in an lo hmu dingih upatnak in na hmaiah an kuun ding,” tiah a ti. Bawipa Israel ih Pathian thianghlim in a riantu a hrilzo ih a thukam pawl a kimter ringring ruangah a tlun ih bangtuk in a cang ngaingai ding a si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl hnenah, “Nanmah runnak ni a thlen tikah ka lo bawm ding; Bomnak nan dilmi cu ka thei ding. Ka lo kilveng dingih ka lo hum ding; Nanmah sungin mi hmuahhmuah hnenah thukamnak ka tuah ding. Nan taantak mi ramsungah cun ka lo umter saal ding.","title":"Jerusalem Rem Saalnak"},"9":{"text":"Thawngtla mi hnenah cun, ‘Suak thlang uh,’ ka ti dingih, Thimnak sungih a um mi hnenah ‘Tleunak sungah ra thlang uh,’ ka ti ding. Cuticun tlang parih hrampi a piat rero tu tuu bangtuk an si ding."},"10":{"text":"An ril a rawng lo dingih an ti tla a haal lo ding; Nisa le nelrawn niling in a siatsuah hai lo ding. Ziangahtile anmah a duhtu in a kilkhawi dingih, Cerhti umnak ah a hruai hai ding a si."},"11":{"text":"“Tlang parah lamzinpi ka tuah dingih, Ka minung pawl fehnak lamzin ka sial ding."},"12":{"text":"Ka minung pawl cu ramhlapi ihsin an ra ding; Saklam le nitlaknak lam, Thlanglam Asuan khua khalin an ra ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Maw van tla, hla sa uh! Maw leilung, lungawi in au uh! Tlang pawl tla lungawi in hlasa hai seh! Bawipa in a minung pawl cu a hneem dingih, a tuarzettu a minung pawl parah zaangfahnak a nei ding a si."},"14":{"text":"Asinain Jerusalem mi pawl cun, “ Bawipa in in dungtun zo, in hngilh zo a si,” an ti."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in, “Nunau in a sungsuak fa a hngilh thei ding maw? A hrin mi a fa cu duhloin a um thei ding maw? A nu in a fa cu hngilh hmansehla, Kei cun ka lo hngilh dah lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, ka lo hngilh thei dah lo ding; Ka kut zaphak parah na hmin cu ka ngan zo."},"17":{"text":"“Nangmah a lo dinsal tu ding pawl cu an rathleng cing dingih, a lo siatsuahtu pawl cu an tlan ding."},"18":{"text":"Na kiangkap ih thil a cangmi pawl hi zohhnik! Na minung pawl an ra-an rakir saal rero lai a si. A nungmi Bawipa keimah in ka lo kam: Mo in a hlawnthil pawl cu hmaihngal zetih a hruh vekin, hi na minung pawl cu na hrangah hmaihngal tlak hlawnthil bangtuk an si ding."},"19":{"text":"“Na ram cu hnawmpen ah a cangih a ṭhing reprep! Asinain a ra umtu pawl hrangah a fate tuk ding. Cule hnawmpen ih a lo cantertu pawl cu a hlatzet ah ret an si ding."},"20":{"text":"Sal taannak ramih a suak mi na minung pawl cun ‘Hi ram hi a fate tuk, ram kau deuh kan duh a si,’ tiah ni khat khatah an lo ti lai ding."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah na thinlungte-in, ‘Zoso hi faate pawl hi i hrinsak? Ka faale pawl an thi ih nucing ka si zo; Thawng tlakmi le dawihlo mi ka si, Zo in so hi faale pawl hi a kilkhawi? Keimah lawngih taantak mi ka si, khui in so hi faale pawl hi an rat?’ tiah na ti ding,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian in a minung pawl hnenah, “Ka kut ka hawi pei ih Miphun pawl hnenah khihhmuhnak ka langter ding; Cuticun nan faate pawl cu inn ah an ratpi ding."},"23":{"text":"Siangpahrang pawl cu nan hrangah pa bangtuk an si dingih, siangpahrang bawinu pawl cu a lo tuamhlawmtu nan nu bangtuk an si ding. Nan hmaiah an lu an kuun dingih an lo ṭihzah ding; Nan hmaiah upatnak an lo pe ding. Cutikah keimah cu Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding; Keimah bomnak a hngaktu pawl cu an bei a dong lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Ralkap ih lakcia mi thil cu nan long kir thei ding maw? Zaangfah neilotu ih kaih cia mi thawngtla pawl cu nan runsuak thei nawn ding maw?"},"25":{"text":"Bawipa in, “A si, a cang theilo nan timi hi a cang ding a si; Ralkap cakzet kut sungih ral kaihmi pawl cu runsuak a si dingih, zaangfah neilotu ih lak cia mi thilri khal lon kir a si ding. A lo dotu hmuahhmuah cu ka do dingih, nan faate pawl cu ka runsuak ding a si."},"26":{"text":"A lo hremtu pawl cu anmah le anmah ka thah awkter hai dingih, Mithah duhnak le thinhengnak in an ri ding. Cutikah nanmah a lo humtu le a lo luat tertu cu Bawipa keimah ka si kha miphun hmuahhmuah in an thei ding. Israel ih Pathian cakzet ka si kha an thei ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Mipa pakhat in a nupi a maak vekin Ka minung pawl hi ka maak ah maw nan ruat? Cuti asile nupi maaknak lethmat khui ah so a si? Mi pakhat in a faate pawl salih a zuar vekin Ral kaihnak ah ka lo zuar hai ah maw nan ruat? Asilo, nanmah ih sualnak ruangah ralkaih mi nan si; Thilsual nan tuah ruangah dawihlo mi nan si."},"2":{"text":"“Ziangah so ka minung pawl run dingih ka feh tikah Zo talih biak hman ka ton lo? Ziangah so ka kawh hai tikah zohmanin in sawn lo? Anmah hum dingah ka ṭawnṭai tuk lawmmam maw si? Ka thupeknak thawngin tifinriat cu a kang ṭheh, Tiva pawl cu nelrawn ah an cangṭheh, Tidai umlo ruangah tiva sung nga cu an thi ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Van tla ka thim ter thei, Mithi ngai bangin a mithmai a uih ṭheh a si,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in simthiamnak lei i pek, Thabaang mi pawl thacak tertu dingah. Zingtinte ka beng i var ter, I zirh dingmi thei theitu dingah.","title":"Riantu Ih Thungainak"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in theihthiamnak thinlung i pek, Amah cu ka dodal loih, Ka dungtun fawn lo a si."},"6":{"text":"I vua tu pawl hrangah ka zaang cu ka tun; I hmuhsuamtu pawl cu ka kham lo; Ka khahmul an bot ih ka hmai ih cil in phui khalle ka dawn lo a si."},"7":{"text":"In hmuhsuamnak cu ka hrangah a na lo, Ziangahtile Bawipa Pathian in i bawm a si. In tisiatnak tuar thei dingah pacan ka cuh. Mualpho in ka um lo ding ti ka thei,"},"8":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pathian cu ka kiangah a um ih, Thiam i coter ko ding. Sual i puh ngamtu zoso a um? Thuṭhennak hmunah kan feh hnik pei! Sual cu i puh hnik hmeen seh!"},"9":{"text":"Bawipa amah cu i ṭantu a si; Zoso mimawh na si, i ti ngam ding? Sual i puhtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu an hloral ṭheh ding; A mawr ih a rop mi hnipuan bangin an cem ding a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa a ṭihzah ih, A siahhlawh ṭongkam a ngaitu pawl, Nan fehnak lamzin cu thimnak in khat hmansehla, Bawipa cu rinsan uhla, nan Pathian cu hngauhsan uh."},"11":{"text":"Midang siatsuah dingih miphiartu pawl, Nan miphiarnak in nanmah a lo siatsuah ding! Bawipa amah in cutin a cangter dingih oloksongnak nan tuar ding."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Runnak a duhtu pawl, i ngai hnik uh. Ka bomnak duh ih a ra mi pawl. Nan suahnak lungpi kha ruat hnik uh, An lo laih suaknak lung kha!","title":"Jerusalem Hnemnak Thu"},"2":{"text":"Nan pu Abraham le a lo hringtu Sarah kha ruat hnik uh. Ka kawh laiah Abraham cu faate a neilo. Asinain mal ka sawm ih faate ka pe. A tefa sin pawl cu mi tamzet ah ka tuah."},"3":{"text":"“Jerusalem parah lainatnak ka nei ding. Siatsuah ṭheh a si mi a khua ramih a umtu pawl parah. A ram cu nelrawn ah a cang naón hmuanduum ah ka cangter saal ding, Eden ih ka ret mi hmuanduum bangtuk in. Lungawinak le thinlung nomnak a um ding, Ka hnenih lungawinak le thangṭhatnak in a khat ding."},"4":{"text":"“maw ka minung pawl, i ngai uh; Ka ṭong mi hi ngaihnik uh. Miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah ka thuzirhnak ka thlenter ding. Ka daan pawl cu an hrangah tleunak a si ding."},"5":{"text":"Zamrang zet in ka ra dingih ka run hai ding, Ka mi nehnak cu a nai zo. Miphun hmuahhmuah cu keimah rori in ka uk ding; Ram hlapi pawl in ka rat ding cu an hngakhlap. Ka runnak cu beisei in an hngak a si."},"6":{"text":"Van tla khi hun thlir hnik uh! Leilung hi cuan hnik uh! Van khi meikhu bangin an hlo ding; Leilung hi hnipuan hlun bangin a ṭet ding; Cule mi hmuahhmuah cu thothe bangin an thi ṭheh ding. Asinain ka mi runnak cu kumkhua daih a si ding; Ka mi nehnak cu sanmureng in a hmun ding."},"7":{"text":"“Dingnak a theitu nannih pawl, i ngai uh; Ka zirhnak thinlung sungih a rettu pawl! Midang in an lo hro ih an lo hmuhsuam khalle zianghman ṭih hlah uh!"},"8":{"text":"Cubangtuk minung pawl cu hnipuan rop bangin an cem ding. Asinain ka mi runnak cu kumkhua daih a si ding, Ka mi nehnak cu sanmureng in a hmun ding,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , tho awla in bawm aw! Na cahnak suah awla in run aw! Khuahlan lai ih na rak suah vekin suah saal aw. Tipithuanthum rulhreng Rahab a thattu le a saat ṭheh tu cu nangmah na si."},"10":{"text":"Tifinriat a kaang tertu le na run mi pawl an fehsuahnak dingah tidai lakih lamzin a tuahtu cu nangmah na si."},"11":{"text":"Na runsuak mi pawl cu Jerusalem ah, lungawi aipuang in, hlasak phah le au phah in an thleng ding a si. Kumkhua in an lung a awi dingih riahsiatnak le ninghannak ihsin kumkhua in an luat ding a si."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in, “A lo cak tertu cu keimah ka si. Ziangah so hrampi bangih a san a tawi ih a thi thei mi milai cu nan ṭih rero?"},"13":{"text":"Nanmah a lo tuahtu Bawipa , Van tla khi a pharhtu le leilung ih hramṭohnak a rettu Pathian cu nan hngilh zo maw si? Ziangah so a lo hremtu pawl ih thinhengnak le nanmah siatsuah ding a tumtu pawl cu khur thlohthlo in nan ṭih rero? An thinhengnak in ziangtik hmanah a lo dai thei dah lo ding!"},"14":{"text":"Atu ih thawngtla mi pawl cu a rei hlanah an luat ding, An nun a sau dingih an duhzat in ei ding rawl an ngah ding."},"15":{"text":"“Keimah hi Bawipa nan Pathian ka si. Tifinriat cu keimah in ka ṭhang ih a tilet pawl cu ka huuk ter ciamco. Ka hmin cu Cungnungbik Bawipa ka si."},"16":{"text":"Van tla khi ka pharh ih Leilung ih hramṭohnak tla Keimah in ka phun a si. Jerusalem hnenah, ‘Nangmah cu ka minung na si! Ka thuzirhmi ka lo pek zo ih Ka kutin ka lo hum a si,’ ka ti,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, ṭhang thlang aw! ṭhang awla tho thlang aw! Bawipa in a thinheng in a lo in ter mi hremnak khuat cu na in zo. A ne tiang na in ih a lo sawn ter zo.","title":"Jerusalem Tuarnak A Reh Zo"},"18":{"text":"A lo hruaitu zohman an um lo. Na minung lakah a kut lo san tahrat in a lo tho tu zohman an um lo a si."},"19":{"text":"Vanduainak phun hnih na tong; Raldonak ruangah na ram cu a siat ṭheh ih, Na minung pawl cu rawl loin an caar ṭheh. A lo zaangfahtu zohman an um lo a si."},"20":{"text":"Lamzin kel kipah na minung pawl cu ṭaamsawl in an ril teptep. Thangkam pai thangih awh mi zukneng bangtuk an si. Pathian ih thinhengnak hmual an tong a si."},"21":{"text":"Harsatnak a tuartu Jerusalem mi pawl, Zuri bangtuk ih a sawn rero tu pawl,"},"22":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian cun a lo ṭan ih nan hnenah, “Ka thinheng in ka lo pekmi khuat cu nan kut sung ihsin ka laak saal rero lai a si. A lo sawn tertu zu cu nan in a ṭul nawn lo pei."},"23":{"text":"Nanmah a lo hremtu pawl, Lamzin in a lo ril tertu, hnawmhne pal ih a lo pal tu pawl hnenah cuih khuat cu ka pe ding a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, a nasa ih a cak mi khua si saal aw! Maw Pathian ih khawpi thianghlim, A mawi mi in thuam aw saal aw! Pathian theilo mi pawl cu na kotka sungah an lut saal nawn lo ding.","title":"Pathian In Jerusalem A Run Ding"},"2":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, luat thlang aw! Leivut lakih sin tho awla na tokham ah to aw. Maw sal ih a taang Zion mi! An lo ṭeemnak cikcin pawl cu phoih thlang aw."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl hnenah, “Nanmah leinak ah paisa zianghman an pe lo, Asinain sal ah nan cang. Nanmah tlennak ah zianghman peek a si lo ding, A lakin nan luat ding a si."},"4":{"text":"A hlanah Izipt ramah nan um ih mikhual ah nan cang. Nehhnu ah ziangthuhla hman umlo in Assiria in a lo hrem hai."},"5":{"text":"Atu Babilon ah cuvek thotho a cang saal: Ziangthu umlo in salkaihmi ah nan cang. A lo uktu pawl cu puarthau in tluang an khawngih Keimah hmuhsuamtu ringring an si."},"6":{"text":"Asinain tikcu a ra thleng dingih Keimah cu Pathian ngaingai ka sihi nan thei dingih nan hnenih a ṭongtu hi keimah ka si kha nan lung a pem ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Tlangpar ihsin a ra ih, Luatnak le daihnak thuthang ṭha a phuangtu ih ke cu ziangtlukin so a mawi? Zion hnenah nehnak thu a than ih “Nan Pathian cu Siangpahrang a si!” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Khawpi a kilvengtu pawl cu an au, Lungawi in hmun khatah an au ciamco!
