Netabik ah Babilon siangpahrang in a in ding.","merge":"20"},"27":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Miseenpi hnenah sim aw; Keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in, an rit ih an luak lai hlan lo, an sawn ih tho thei loih an um lai hlan lo, an in ding in thu ka pek a si. Ziangahtile an hnenah raldonak ka thlengter ding."},"28":{"text":"Cuih khuat cu na kut ihsin la duh loin an um ih an in duh lo a si le Cungnungbik Bawipa in, nan in tengteng a ṭul a ti tiah sim aw."},"29":{"text":"Siatsuahnak cu keimah ih khawpi ihsin ka thok ding. Hremnak tong lo ih luat dingah an ruat-aw maw si? An luat lo ding, hrem an si ṭheh ding. Leilung mi hmuahhmuah hnenah raldonak ka thlengter ding. Keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka sim zo."},"30":{"text":"“Jeremiah, hi ka simmi hmuahhmuah hi nangmah in na phuang ṭheh ding. Himi pawl cu hiti in na sim ding, ‘ Bawipa cu van ihsin a hruum ding, Vansang bik ihsin khawri bangin a hruum durdo ding. A minung pawl parah nasa zetin a hruum ding; Sabit sawrtu pa bangin a au ding. Leilung tlun mi hmuahhmuah in an thei ding."},"31":{"text":"A thawm cu vanhramdeng tiang a khawk ding. Bawipa cun miphun hmuahhmuah parah an mawhnak thurel ding a nei. Zozo khal an thu a rel ding. Misual pawl cu a that hai ding. Bawipa in a sim zo,’ ti aw,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in “Ram khat hnu ram khat ah siatralnak a thleng ding; vanhramdeng ah thlipi a tho ding,” a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Bawipa ih a thah mi pawl ih ruak cu khat lam vanhramdeng ihsin khatlam vanhramdeng tiang an darh-aw thluh ding. Zohman in an ṭah lo ding; ruak tuamtu nei lo le phumtu nei lo an si ding. Leilung parah eekdawm bangin an ril teptep ding."},"34":{"text":"Maw nannih hotu pawl, ka minung a khaaltu pawl, ṭap uhla napi in ai uh. Mithi ngai in ṭap uhla leivut lakah lawng rero uh. Nan thihnak tikcu a ra thleng zo ih tuu bangin thah nan si ding. Bungbeel bangin nan tlakuai ding."},"35":{"text":"Nan luat theinak lamzin a um lo ding."},"36":{"text":"Ṭap uhla vansaanglam in au uh, ziangahtile Bawipa cun a thinheng in nan miphun a siatsuah zo ih a daizet le a himzetmi nan ram cu hnawmpen ah a cangter zo.","merge":"37"},"38":{"text":"Kiosa in a kua a tlansan vekin Bawipa in a minung pawl a tlansan zo a si. Tuksumza raldonak le Bawipa ih thinhengnak in hi ram cu thlaler ramṭhingah a tuah zo a si."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah fapa Jehoiakim Judah siangpahrang a can hnu reilote ah,","title":"Jeremiah Thah An Tum"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭong cu ka hnenah a ra thleng ih, “Biakinn sungah ding awla, Judah ram khawpi pawl ihsin cutawkah Pathian biak dingih a rami hnenah phuang dingih ka lo timi hmuahhmuah cu phuang aw. Hrelh mi um loin sim ṭheh aw."},"3":{"text":"Na simmi an ngai ih an nuncan ṭha lomi an ṭhin tla a si thei men. An ṭhin ngaingai a si ahcun an thilsual tuahmi ruangah an parih siatsuahnak thlenter ding ka tummi cu tum loin ka um sal ding,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule misenpi hnenih sim dingah Bawipa ih ṭong cu ka hnenah a ra ih, “Keimah Bawipa in ka lo sim zo: Ka thu in ngai a si ahcun ka lo zirhmi pawl thlun uh;"},"5":{"text":"nan hnenih ka thlah ringring ṭheumi profet pawl ih ṭong kha ngai uh. An thu hi nan ngai dah lo a si."},"6":{"text":"An thu nan ngai duh lo thotho a si le Shiloh parih ka tuah vekin hi Biakinnpi parah ka tuah ding ih leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah in hi khawpi hmun cu siatserhnak ah an hmang ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Biakinnpi sungih cuti ka simmi cu puithiam pawl, profet pawl le a ra mi hmuahhmuah in an thei."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in sim dingih thu i pekmi hmuahhmuah ka sim ṭheh vete in annih in in kai ih a thah in tum, “Hi vekih na sim ruangah thah tlak na si."},"9":{"text":"Hi Biakinnpi hi Shiloh vekah a cang ding, hi khawpi hi siatsuah ṭheh a si ding, a sungah zohman an um lo ding, tiah ziangah so na ti?” tiah in ti."},"10":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Judah hotu pawl in an theih tikah siangpahrang inn ihsin Biakinn ah an ra tlan ih Kotka Thar ah an ra to."},"11":{"text":"Puithiam le profet pawl in hotu pawl le misenpi hnenah cun, “Hi pa cu thah tlak a si. Ziangahtile kan khawpi a simsiat a si. Nan hna in nan theihmi a si ko,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule kei in, “Hi Biakinnpi le hi khawpi ka relsiatnak hmuahhmuah cu, Bawipa in sim dingah i fial ih ka simmi a si."},"13":{"text":"Nan nundaan nan thleng ding le nan thil tuahzia nan ṭhin ding cu a ṭul hrimhrim a si. Bawipa nan Pathian thu nan ngai pei. Cutiih nan tuah asile nan parih siatsuahnak thlenter a tummi cu a ṭulsal ding."},"14":{"text":"Kei sawh cu nan kut sungah ka um a si. A dik a ṭha nan ti vekin ka parah tuah ko uh."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla thil pakhat cu thei cia uh. In that ngaingai a si ahcun nanmah le hi khawpi sung mipawl cu mawh nei lo nan thah ruangah mi mawh nan si ding. Ziangahtile hi ralrinnak lo petu dingah i thlah tu cu Bawipa a si,” tiah ka ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah hotu pawl le mipi pawl in puithiam le profet pawl hnenah cun, “Hi pa hi thah ding a si lo; Pathian kan Bawipa hmin in kan hnenah a ṭong a si,” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cuih hnuah upa hrekkhat pawl an ding ih mipi hnenah cun,"},"18":{"text":"“Moresheth khua mi profet Mikah in Hezekiah, Judah siangpahrang a si laiah mipi hnenah Cungnungbik Bawipa ih ṭong mi hiti in a sim: ‘Zion cu lo vekin thlawh a si ding. Jerusalem cu khawrop ah a cang ding ih Biakinn dinnak tlang cu tupi ah a cang ding,’ a ti."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang Hezekiah le Judah mipawl in cutiih a sim ruangah Mikah cu an that lo. Hezekiah in Bawipa cu a upat ih zaangfah a dil sawn a si lo maw? Cule Bawipa in a thin a suup ih thlenter a tummi siatralnak cu a ṭulsal a si. Kannih cu atu-ah ṭihnungza siatralnak kan parah kan thlenter zik a si hi!” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule mi pakhat a hminah Uriah an timi, Kiriath Jearim khua Shemaiah ih fapa cu Bawipa hmin in hi miphun le hi khawpi Jeremiah bangin a relsiattu a um ve."},"21":{"text":"Uriah ṭong cu siangpahrang Jehoiakim le a ralkap pawl le bawi upa pawl in an theih tikah siangpahrang in thah a tum. Asinain Uriah in a theih tikah a ṭih ih Izipt ram ah a tlan."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla siangpahrang Jehoiakim in Akbor fapa Elnathan le midang pawl Uriah vung kai dingah Izipt ram ah a thlah."},"23":{"text":"An kai ih siangpahrang Jehoiakim hnenah an hruai. Siangpahrang cun a that ih a ruak cu misenpi phumnak thlaanmual ah a hlon."},"24":{"text":"Asinain kei cu Shafan fapa Ahikam ih ṭanpi mi ka si ruangah thah dingah misenpi kut sungah i pe lo."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah ih fapa Zedekiah cu Judah siangpahrang a can vete in Bawipa ih ṭong ka hnenah a thleng ih,","title":"Jeremiah In Caw-kawn A Orh"},"2":{"text":"saphaw le thinghrolh in caw-kawn tuah tahratin ka hngawng ih bat dingah i fial."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in Jerusalem ah siangpahrang Zedekiah tong dingin a rami palai pawl Edom ram, Moab ram, Ammon ram, ṭai-ar le Sidon ram ihsin rampalai a rami pawl hnen ihsin an ram siangpahrang hnen ciarih thucah dingah i sim."},"4":{"text":"An siangpahrang ciar va sim dingah Cungnungbik Bawipa Israel ih Pathian in hiti in thu i pek a si:"},"5":{"text":"“A makzetmi ka huham le ka cahnak in leilung pumpi le minung le leilung ih a nungmi ramsa hmuahhmuah hi ka seemsuah a si; cu pawl cu ka pek duhmi hnenah ka pek."},"6":{"text":"Ka siahhlawh Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar kut tangih miphun hmuahhmuah a retu cu keimah ka si; hramlak ramsa hman amah riantu ah ka pek a si."},"7":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah in amah cu an rian ding ih a fapa le a fasuan pawl tiangin, a miphun a ṭumsuk caan a kim hlan tiang, an rian ringring ding. Cuih hnuah a miphun in miphun dang pawl le a cakmi siangpahrang pawl an rian leh ve ding a si."},"8":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla ram ramkhat khat siseh, uknak pakhatkhat siseh, a uknak thuai ih um an duh lo a si ahcun cuih miphun cu raldonak le paamnak le natnak in ka hrem ding ih a netnak ah a siat thluhtertu dingah Nebuchadnezzar cu thu ka pek ding."},"9":{"text":"Nan profet pawl siseh, zovek khal siseh, hmailam thil a cang dingmi ka sim thei a titu cu zum hlah uh. Mang in siseh, mithi thlarau ko tahratin siseh, kut ṭial zohnak in siseh, ka thei a titu cu va zum hlah uh. An zatein Babilon siangpahrang kut sungih pe-aw lo ding in an lo sim a si."},"10":{"text":"An lo bum a si; nan ram ihsin lam hlapi ih hruaisuak nan sinak dingah a ṭangtu cu anmah an si ding. Ka lo dawihlo ding ih siatsuah ṭheh nan si ding."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla miphun pakhatkhat in Babilon siangpahrang kut sung ah a pe-aw ih a rian a si ahcun amah ih ram sungah ka umter ding; amah ih ram ah a um ding ih amah ih ram cu a thlo ding a si. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in Judah siangpahrang Zedekiah hnen khal ah ka sim: “Babilon siangpahrang kut thuaiah um aw. Amah le a minung pawl rian awla na nung ding."},"13":{"text":"Ziangah so nangmah le na minung pawl cu raldonak le rawl loin le natnak in nan thih ding? Babilon siangpahrang kut thuai ih a um lo mi pawl raldonak le paamnak le natnak in an thi ding, tiah Bawipa in a sim zo."},"14":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang kut thuai um lo dingih a lo simtu profet pawl ih thu cu zum hlah aw."},"15":{"text":"Hi profet pawl cu, ka thlahmi an si lo ih ka hmin in mi bumtu lawng an si, tiah amah Bawipa rori in a ti zo. Curuangah a lo dawihlo ding ih nangmah siseh, hi thuphan pertu profet pawl siseh, thahnak nan tuar ding a si,” ka ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule puithiam pawl le misenpi hnenah Bawipa ih ṭong cu hiti in ka sim: “Babilon ihsin Biakinn thilri bungbeel pawl a ra thleng cing ding a lo titu profet pawl cu zum hlah uh. An lo bum a si."},"17":{"text":"An thu ngai hlah uh. Babilon siangpahrang kut thuaiah um uhla nan nung ding. Hi khawpi cu ziangah so khawrop ah nan canter duh rero?"},"18":{"text":"Profet ngaingai an si ih Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih thu an hnen ih a um taktak asile Biakinn sungih a um laimi thilri le siangpahrang inn ih a ummi sumsaw pawl cu Babilon ih thiarhlo lo dingah ka hnenah i dil hai seh,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Babilon ah Judah siangpahrang, Jehoiakim ih fapa Jehoiakhin le Judah ram upa le Jerusalem khawsung upa pawl a hruaihlo tikah Biakinn ṭhuam pawl, daar tikuang le a tonak leng pawl, le Biakinn thilri hrekkhat pawl cu a taanta a si.","merge":"20"},"21":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian keimah in Biakinn sung le Jerusalem siangpahrang inn ih a taang hrihmi thilri thu ka sim mi hi ngai uh:"},"22":{"text":"Babilon ah an thiar ṭheh ding ih keimah in tawk ka ti hlan lo cuih Babilon khua-ah cun a um ding. Cuih hnuah keimah in ka kirpi ding ih hi hmun ah ka ret sal ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih kum, Zedekiah ih siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum linak, thla nga thla ah Gibeon khua mi Azzur ih fapa profet Hananiah in Biakinnpi sungah thu i sim. Puithiam pawl le misenpi theihhngan ah,","title":"Jeremiah Le Profet Hananiah"},"2":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel Pathian ih ṭong cu hiti in i sim: “Babilon siangpahrang ih cahnak huham cu ka khiak ṭheh zo."},"3":{"text":"Kum hnih sungah siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Babilon ih a thiarhlo ṭhehmi Biakinn thilri bungbeel pawl cu ka kirpi ṭheh ding."},"4":{"text":"Babilon ah salih kaihmi Judah siangpahrang, Jehoiakim ih fapa Jehoiakhin cu Judah mipawl thawn hmunkhat ah ka hruai kir ding. Asi, Babilon siangpahrang ih cahnak cu ka khiak ṭheh ding a si. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah puithiam pawl le Biakinn sungih a dingmi misenpi theihhngan ahcun Hananiah hnenah,"},"6":{"text":"“A si ngai; Bawipa in cuticun tuah hram seh! Sal ih kaihmi mi hmuahhmuah pawl le an thiarhlo mi Biakinn thilri pawl cu na sim vekin va kim ngaingai sehla hi ram ah kirpi ṭheh si hai sehla ka va duh so!"},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na hnenah le misenpi hnenih ka ṭongmi hi ngaihnik."},"8":{"text":"Hmaisa profet pawl, nang le kei hlan ih thu a rak simtu profet pawl cun miphun tampi parah le a makzetmi siangpahrang uknak parah raldonak, paamnak le natnak a thleng ding a si, tiah an rak sim."},"9":{"text":"Asinain daihnak le remnak a um ding, tiih a simtu profet cu a thusimmi a kim ngaingai lawngah Bawipa ih thlahmi profet a si, tiah an ti ding,” tiah ka ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule Hananiah in ka hngawng ih bah-mi cawkawn cu a lak ih a khiak ṭheh hnuah,"},"11":{"text":"mipi theihhngan ahcun, “Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in miphun tampi hngawng parih a bah-mi cu hi bangtuk in ka khiak ding a si, tiah Bawipa in a ti. Kum hnih sungah a tuahsuak ding a si,” a ti. Cule ka fehsanta!"},"12":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Bawipa in ka hnen ah,"},"13":{"text":"Hananiah hnenah feh ih hiti ih va sim dingah i fial: “ Bawipa in thing ih tuahmi cawkawn cu na khiak thei ngai men ding; a sinan cu-aiah thirkawn ka tuah ding."},"14":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian cun hi miphun pawl parah thirkawn ka thlaih ding ih Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar an rian ding. Keimah Bawipa in hramlak ramsa tiang in Nebuchadnezzar riantu ah ka tuah ding, a ti,” tiah ka sim."},"15":{"text":"Cuticun Hananiah ka sim ih hiti in ka beet fawn, “Ngaihnik, Hananiah! Nang cu Bawipa ih thlahmi na si lo. Himi pawl in thuphan zum dingah na forh rero hai a si!"},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in nangmah hi tisiat dingin Bawipa amah rori in a sim zo. Bawipa dodal dingah misenpi hnenih na ṭong ruangah tuih kum a cem hlanah na thi ding,” tiah ka ti."},"17":{"text":"Hananiah cu cuih kum thla sarih thla ah a thi ngaingai."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem ihsin Babilon ah Nebuchadnezzar in sal ih a hruaimi lakih hotu pawl, puithiam pawl, profet pawl le midang dang pawl hnenah Jeremiah ih ca nganmi a si.","title":"Babilon Um Judah Mi Hnenih Jeremiah Cakuat"},"2":{"text":"Hi ca cu siangpahrang Jehoiakhin le a nu, siangpahrang inn ih bawi le upa pawl, Judah ram hotu le Jerusalem khawsung upa pawl, zungthiam le sodeng pawl saltaannak hmun ah hruaihlo an si hnu ih a nganmi a si."},"3":{"text":"Hi ca cu Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar hnenah Judah siangpahrang Zedekiah ih a thlahmi Shafan fapa Elasah le Hilkiah fapa Gemariah kut in a kuatmi a si. A ca sungah cun:"},"4":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in Jerusalem ihsin Babilon ah Nebuchadnezzar a hruaitermi misenpi pawl hnenah hiti in a sim:"},"5":{"text":"‘Hmun luah uhla inn tla ṭhatein sak uhla um uh. Hmuan tuah uhla nan cinmi ei uh."},"6":{"text":"Nupi ṭhi uhla faate tla nei uh. Nan faate pawl tla nupi ṭhi hai sehla faate nei ve hai seh. Ṭumsuk loin nan ṭhangso sawn pei."},"7":{"text":"Thawngtla in ka lo fehternak khawpi ih ṭhatnak hrangah hnaṭuan uh. Ka hnenah an hrangah thlacam sak uh. Ziangahtile an ṭhangso ih mi neinung an si ahcun nannih khal mi neinung nan si ve ding."},"8":{"text":"Keimah Bawipa Israel ih Pathian in ralrinnak ka lo pek a si. Nan lakih a ummi profet pawl in siseh, hmailam thu ka thei a titu midang dang khal in siseh, lo bum hlah hai seh. Mang an man mi tla zianghman ah va siar hlah uh."},"9":{"text":"Annih cu ka hmin ih thuphan pertu an si. Ka thlahmi an si lo. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,’ a ti."},"10":{"text":"“ Bawipa in, ‘Babilon ram ih nan umnak kum sawmsarih a kim tikah nan parah seherhnak ka nei ding ih nan khua le nan ram ah kirter sal dingih ka lo tiammi vekin ka kimter ding."},"11":{"text":"Nan hrangih tumtahnak ka neihmi cu keimah lawngin ka thei. Tumtahnak ka neihmi cu siatralnak si loin mi neinung nan sinak dingah a si; cuih tumtahnak cu nan ruahsannak le nan hmailam hrang a si."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah keimah in ko ding. Ka hnenah ra in thla nan cam tikah ka lo theihsak ding."},"13":{"text":"In hawl ding ih in hmu ding. Nan thinlung takte ih in hawl tikah cun!"},"14":{"text":"Asi, in hmu ding ih nan khua le nan ram ah ka lo kirter ding, tiah ka lo sim a si. Khuakip le ramkip ih ka lo ṭhekdarhnak ihsin ka lo finkhawm hai ding ih sal nan taan hlanih nan rak umnak ram ahcun ka lo hruaikir ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"“ Bawipa in Babilon ah profet pawl in pek, tiah nan ti."},"16":{"text":"David in a rak ukmi ram a uktu siangpahrang le hi khawpi sungih a ummi, nanmah vekin sal ih hruaihlo a si lomi nan sungkhat pawl ih thu ah Bawipa ih ṭongkam hi ngai hnik uh:"},"17":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in ‘Raldonak le paamnak le natnak an parah ka thlenter ding ih ei ṭha loih a ṭawtmi theipi bangin ka tuah ding."},"18":{"text":"Raldonak, paamnak le natnak thawn ka thlun ding ih cumicu leilung tlun miphun tampi in an hmuh tikah an tuk a sumzet ding. Ka ṭhekdarhnak ram kipih mipawl in an parih a thlengmi thil an hmuh tikah mangbang le ṭihphang in an um ding. Mi in hnihsuahsainak ah an hmang ding ih an hmin cu mi siatcamnak ah an hmang ding."},"19":{"text":"An hnenah cat loin keimah riantu profet pawl hnen ihsin ka thu cu ka thlenter ringring naón an ngai duh lo ruangah hi bangtuk ih an tuarnak a si."},"20":{"text":"Babilon ih ka lo kuatmi nan zatein keimah Bawipa ih ka sim mi hi ngaihnik uh,’ a ti."},"21":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in, nan hnenah amah hmin ih thuphan a rel rerotu Kolaiah ih fapa Ahab le Maaseiah ih fapa Zedekiah thu ah simmi a nei zo. Annih cu Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar kut ah ka pe ding ih nan mithmuh rori ah a that ding, a ti."},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem ihsin Babilon ih hruaimi sal kaihmi pawl in mi pakhatkhat an cam duh tikah, ‘Babilon siangpahrang in an nungcung in a kiomi Zedekiah le Ahab vekin Bawipa in lo tuahseh,’ an ti ding."},"23":{"text":"Cubangtuk in an tuar ding, ziangahtile thilsual an tuah. Mi nupi le mi pasal parah an sual ih Bawipa ih hmin in thuphan an per ruangah a si. Cumi cu Bawipa ih duh lomi an si. An tuahmi hmuahhmuah a thei ṭheh ih amah cu an sualnak ah thu theitu a si. Bawipa in a sim zo,” tiah a ngan."},"24":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in Nehelam mi Shemaiah hnen ih thu sim dingah i fial. Shemaiah in Jerusalem mi le Maaseiah ih fapa puithiam Zefaniah le puithiam dangdang hnenah amah ih hmin in ca a kuat. A cakuat sungah cun Shemaiah in Zefaniah hnenah,","title":"Shemaiah Cakuat","merge":"25"},"26":{"text":"“ Bawipa in Jehoiada ai ah puithiam ah a lo tuah zo ih atu-ah Biakinn sungih bawi tum bikah na cang zo. Curuangah mi aa asinain profet a ṭuanter awmi hmuahhmuah thir cikcin in an hngawng khit ṭheh aw; cumi cu na ṭuanvo a si."},"27":{"text":"Ziangah so mipi hnenah profet ṭong ih a ṭong rerotu Anathoth khuami Jeremiah kha cuvekin na tuah lo?"},"28":{"text":"Reipi awhter nawn ding a si lo. Ziangahtile Babilon ih minung pawl cu cutawkah reipi sal ah nan taang ding. Inn nan sak pei, nan um pei. Hmuan nan tuah pei ih nan cinmi rawl nan ei pei, a titu cu amah a si,” tiah ca a kuat."},"29":{"text":"Cuih ca cu Zefaniah in ka hnenah a siar."},"30":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in ka hnenah,"},"31":{"text":"Shemaiah thu thawn peh aw in Babilon ih sal taangmi hmuahhmuah hnenah hiti ih thucah dingin i sim, “Keimah Bawipa in Shemaiah le a tesinfa hmuahhmuah cu ka hrem ding. Amah cu ka thlah mi a si lo naón nan hnenah profet ngai vekin a ṭong ih a lo bum a si. Nanmah lakah tesinfa pakhat hman a nei lo ding. Ka minung pawl hrangih thil ṭha ka tuah ding mi cu a hmu man nawn lo ding. Ziangahtile keimah dodal dingah ka minung pawl a forh a si. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti.","merge":"32"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in ka hnenah,","title":"A Minung Hnenih Ih Thukamnak"},"2":{"text":"“Ka lo simmi hmuahhmuah hi cabu sungah ngan ṭheh aw."},"3":{"text":"Ziangahtile ka minung Israel le Judah mipawl ka kirter salnak tikcu a ra thleng ding. An pupa pawl hnenih ka rak pekmi ram ah ka kirter sal ding ih anmah ih ta a si sal ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel le Judah mi hnenah,"},"5":{"text":"“ṭihphannak aw thawm ka thei, daihnak a si lo; Thinphang ih aunak aw thawm a si."},"6":{"text":"Cawlta uhla ruathnik uh! Mipa in faate a hring thei pei maw? Ziangah so nunau nau neizik bangin, mipa pawl in an pum an dom awk rero? Ziangah so an hmai tla a raam thluh?"},"7":{"text":"Ṭihnung le tuksumza ni a ra thleng ding. Cuvek ni cu a um dah keel lo; Ka minung hrangah awloksongnak ni a si. Asinain an tuar thei suak ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Cuih ni a thlen tikah an hngawng ih caw-kawn cu ka khiak ṭheh ding ih an thir cikcin cu ka hlon ṭheh ding. Ramdangmi salah an cang nawn lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Keimah Bawipa an Pathian hi in rian ding ih siangpahrang ih ka tuah dingmi David tesinfa kha an rian sawn ding."},"10":{"text":"“Ka minung pawl, ṭih hlah uh; Israel mi pawl phang hlah uh. Ram hlapi ihsin ka lo run ding, sal nan taannak ram ihsin. Nan ram ah nan kirsal ding ih, thlangamte in nan um sal ding. Himzetin nan um ding ih nan thla a ṭeem lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Nan hnenah ka ra ding ih ka lo hum ding. Ka lo ṭhekdarhnak ram cu ka siatsuah ding. Asinain nannih cu ka lo tisiat lo ding. Lo hrem loin ka um lo ding; Asinain ka lo hrem tikah dingthluk lairelnak thawn ka tuah ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl hnenah, “Nan hma hi a dam thei lo ding; Nan hriamhma hi a besia ngaingai a si."},"13":{"text":"A lo tuamhlawmtu zohman an um lo, Nan hma hnih dingah sii a um fawn lo. Nan damnak dingah beiseinak a um lo."},"14":{"text":"A lo ngaitu pawl in an lo hngilh ṭheh zo. An lo poisa nawn lo. Ral vekin ka lo tuah; Hremnak nan tuarmi hi a nazet. Ziangahtile nan sualnak a tam ih, nan ṭhatlonak hi a nasa ngaingai a si."},"15":{"text":"Nan hriamhma ruangah phunzai nawn hlah uh; Nan damnak ding a um lo. Hiti vekin ka lo hrem, ziangahtile nan sualnak a tam ih, nan ṭhatlonak hi a nasat tuk ruangah a si."},"16":{"text":"Sikhalsehla tu cun a rak lo dolhtu pawl kha, dolh ṭheh an si ve thung ding. Nan ral pawl kha ral kaihmi ah an cang ding. A rak lo hmuhsuamtu pawl kha, hmuhsuam an si ve ding. A rak lo ramtu pawl kha ram an si ve thlang ding."},"17":{"text":"Ka lo harhdamter sal ding, Nan hma pawl cu ka damter ding; Nan ral pawl in, ‘Zion cu hnonmi le khaak mi a si; Zohman in ziangah an siar lo,’ an ti hmanah, Keimah Bawipa in ka ṭong zo,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka minung pawl cu, An ramah ka kirter ding ih, An innsang kipah zaangfahnak ka nei ding. Jerusalem cu saksaal a si ding ih, A siangpahrang inn cu dinter sal a si ding."},"19":{"text":"Cutawkih a ummi pawl cun, thangṭhatnak hla an sa ding; lungawi in an au ding. Thlawsuah ka pek ding ih an zai ciamco ding. Ka malsawmnak ruangah upatnak an ngah ding."},"20":{"text":"Khuahlan ih an rak neihmi nauhak bangin an nei sal ding. An khua le ram cu hngetzet in ka dinter sal ding. Anmah a hmuhsuamtu cu ka hrem ding."},"21":{"text":"Anmah uktu cu anmah ih miphun sungin a suak ding. An siangpahrang fapa cu anmah ih miphun a si ding. Cupa cun ka kawh tikah i naih ding. Zoso kawh locun a ra ngam ding? Annih cu ka minung an si ding ih, Kei hi an Pathian ka si ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa ih thinhengnak cu thlipi vek a si. A huuk reromi thlipi vek a si ih misual pawl ih lu tlun ah a huuk ding. Tuah a tummi a tuah thluh hlan lo a reh lo ding. Hi thu cu a ra dingmi tikcu ah a minung pawl in fiangtein an thei ding.","merge":"24"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in hiti in a sim, “Israel miphun hmuahhmuah ih Pathian ka si can a ra thleng ding ih annih cu ka minung an si ding.","title":"Israel Mi Kirsalnak Ding"},"2":{"text":"Nelrawn ah thihnak ihsin a luatmi pawl hnenah zaangfahnak ka langter. Israel mipawl in colhnak an duh tikah,"},"3":{"text":"lam hlapi ihsin an hnenah ka lang. Maw Israel mipawl, ka duhdawt ciami nan si ih nan parah duhdawtnak cu cat loin ka nei ding."},"4":{"text":"A thar in ka lo dinter ding. Nan khuangte nan lak ding ih lungawi in nan lam sal ding."},"5":{"text":"Samaria tlang ah sabit hmuan nan tuah sal ding ih hmuan sungih a suakmi cu a phuntu nanmah in nan ei ding."},"6":{"text":"Asi, ralvengtu pawl in Efraim tlangpar ihsin ‘Zion ah feh uhsi; Bawipa kan Pathian hnenah cun,’ tiih an au-nak tikcu a ra thleng ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel hrangah lungawinak thawn au uh; Miphun lakih miphun tumbik hrangah cun! ‘ Bawipa in a minung a run zo. A taangsun mipawl a hum zo a si,’ tiah thangṭhatnak hla sa uh."},"8":{"text":"Saklam ihsin ka run hruai hai ding. Vanhram deng ihsin ka finkhawm ding. Mitcaw le ke-awl pawl thawn an ra ding. Nunau favun le fahring zik pawl thawn. An ra kirsal tikah cun miphun tumpi an si ding."},"9":{"text":"Ka minung pawl cu ṭap phah in an kir ding. Ka hruaikir ding, thlacam phah in; Tidai luannak hmunah ka khor hai ding; An bah lonak ding lamzin tluang ihsin. Israel hrangah cun pa ka si; Efraim cu ka fapa upa bik a si,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw miphun pawl, i ngai uhla, ka thu cu tipikap hlatzet ah phuang uh. Ka minung pawl ka ṭhekdarh hai, a sinan ka finkhawm sal ding. Ka khor hai ding, tuukhal in a tuu a khor vekin."},"11":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu ka luatter zo; A cak zetmi miphun kut sungin ka run zo."},"12":{"text":"An ra ding ih Zion tlang ah, lungawi in hla an sa ding. Ka ṭhatnak ruangah an ai a puang ding; Rawl le sabit le olif hriak ruangah, Tuu le caw pawl ka laksawng ruangah cun! Khop zetih tidai toihmi hmuan an bang ding. An ṭulmi hmuahhmuah an nei ṭheh ding."},"13":{"text":"Fala pawl an lung a awi ding ih an laam ding; Mipa pawl khal, mino mitar ti loin, an lung a nuam ding. Ka hneem hai ding ih an mithi ngainak cu lungawinak ah ka thleng ding. An riahsiatnak cu an aipuannak ah ka tuah ding."},"14":{"text":"Puithiam pawl ih pum cu, rawl ṭha bik in ka puarter ding. Ka minung pawl ih duhmi cu ka kimter ṭheh ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ramah khawsung in aw a thang; ṭahnak le aihramnak aw a si; Rachel in a faate pawl a ṭah, An thih ṭheh ruangah a ṭap ih Leem khal a theih nawn lo.","title":"Israel Parih Zaangfahnak","ref":"Mat 2.18"},"16":{"text":"Ṭap nawn loin suup awla, na mitthli cu hnul thlang aw. Na faate pawl hrangih na tuahmi pawl hi ṭuanman laksawng ngah loin na um lo ding. Ral ram ihsin an ra kir ding a si."},"17":{"text":"Na hmailam hrangah ruahsannak a um; Na faate pawl an ra kir ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo."},"18":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl riahsia in an ṭong ka thei: ‘ Bawipa , hrem hrih lomi ṭilva kan bang; Asinain nang in na thu thlun daan in zirh. In kirter sal hram aw; Na hnenah kan kir sal ko ding; Kan Bawipa le kan Pathian!"},"19":{"text":"“Na hnen ihsin hmun dangah kan pial, a sinan kir sal kan duh. In hrem hnu ahcun riahsia in kan lu kan kun; Ningzak le mualpho in kan um; Kan no laiih kan rak sual ruangah a si,’ an ti."},"20":{"text":"“Maw Israel, nang cu ka fapa duh na si; Ka duh bikmi fa na si. Na hmin ka sim tinin duhdawtnak thawn ka lo ruat. Ka thinlung hi nangmah lo cun a um thei lo; Zaangfahnak na hnenah ka nei ringring ding."},"21":{"text":"Lamzin parah hminsinnak le khihhmuhnak tuah awla, Na fehnak lamzin hlun kha hun hawl kir sal aw. Maw Israel mipawl, ra kir sal uh, Nan fehsanmi khua pawl ah ra tlung sal uh."},"22":{"text":"Maw rintlak lo minung pawl, Ziangtik tiangso ṭhukṭhun in nan um hrih ding? Thil thar le thil phundang ka seemsuah zo; Thil thar le thil phundang a si zia cu, Nunau in mipa a humhim ding, ti tlukin a dang a si,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in, “An saltaannak ihsin an ram ih ka hruai kir tikah Judah ram le a khua pawl ahcun, ‘ Bawipa in Jerusalem tlang thiang cu thluasuahnak pe hram seh, Amah a umnak hmun thianghlim hi,’ tiah an ti sal ding.","title":"Pathian Minung Pawl ṭhansonak"},"24":{"text":"Judah ram le a khua pawl ah mi an um ding; lothlo pawl tla an um ding ih tuukhal pawl khal an tuurual thawn an um ding."},"25":{"text":"Tha bang mipawl an tha ka tlunter ding ih rawl loih a ṭamsawl mipawl rawl ka khopter ding."},"26":{"text":"Cuticun mi pawl in, ‘Ka itthat ih tha-tlung zetin ka ṭhang,’ an ti ding."},"27":{"text":"“Keimah Bawipa in ka sim a si: can a ra thleng ding ih Israel ram le Judah ram cu minung le ṭilva in ka khahter sal ding."},"28":{"text":"Ka mithmuh ah keimah in ka phawisuak, ka balṭheh, ka hlonhlo, ka siatsuah ih vansiat malmaknak ka thlenter vekin atu khalah ka mithmuh ah ka phun sal ding ih ka din sal hai ding a si."},"29":{"text":"Cuih tikcu a thlen tikah cun mi pawl in, ‘An nu le an pa in sabit thur an ei, Asinain an faate pawl ih ha a ṭim,’ an ti nawn lo ding."},"30":{"text":"Zokhal sisehla sabit thur a eitu cu amah ih ha a ṭim ding. Zokhal sisehla amah ih sual ruangah thihnak a tong ding,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel mi le Judah mipawl thawn thukamnak thar ka tuahnak tikcu a ra thleng ding."},"32":{"text":"An pu le an pa pawl Izipt ram ihsin an kut in ka hruaisuak lai ih anmah thawn thukamnak ka tuahmi thukam hlun bangtuk cu a si lo ding. An pasal bangtuk ka si naón annih in cuih thukamnak cu an thlun lo."},"33":{"text":"Israel mi thawn ka tuah dingmi thukamnak cu hi bangtuk in a si ding: Ka daan cu an sungmuril ah ka ret ding ih an thinlung parah ka ngan ding. Kei hi an Pathian ka si ding ih annih cu ka minung an si ding."},"34":{"text":"Zohman pakhat le pakhat - an innhnen siseh, an unau siseh - Bawipa thei dingih an zirh awk le an sim awk a ṭul nawn lo ding. Ziangahtile a tum a seen in, an zate in an thei ṭheh ding a si. An sualnak ka ngaidam ding ih an mawhnak ka ciing nawn lo ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Bawipa in sun vangtertu ah ni a tuah, Zan engtertu ah thlapi le arsi a tuah. Tifinriat a thoter ih a huuk ciamco, A hmin cu Cungnungbik Bawipa a si."},"36":{"text":"Lei le van, ni le thla a um sung ahcun, Israel miphun khal a um ve ding, tiah Bawipa in thu a kam zo."},"37":{"text":"Nikhat khat ah tlunlam van khi, A sum tah theih va sisehla, Leilung ih hram khi zawt theih va sisehla, Culawngah Israel miphun hi a hnong ding, An thil tuah sualmi pawl ruangah. Bawipa in a sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Jerusalem cu a pumpi in ka khawpi ah dinsal a sinak tikcu a ra thleng ding. Hananel Inndonsang ihsin kulhnak nitlak lam Kotka Kel tiang remsal ṭheh a si ding."},"39":{"text":"Khawpi ramri cu cutawk ihsin nitlaknak lamah Gareb tlang tiang, cule a kimvel in Goab tiang a si ding."},"40":{"text":"Mithi phumnak le hnawm an hlonnak phairawn a pumpi in le Kidron Tiva kuam tlun ih ram hmuahhmuah, nisuahnak lam ah Rang Kotka tiang, a zatein ka hrangah hmun thianghlim a si ding. Khawpi cu ziangtik hmanah bal le siatsuah a si nawn lo ding,” a ti."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, Zedekiah ih Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan kum hranak ah ka hnenah thu a sim. Cuih kum cu Nebuchadnezzar Babilon siangpahrang a sinak kum hleiriatnak kum a si ve.","title":"Jeremiah In Lo Ram a Lei"},"2":{"text":"Cuih kum ah Babilon siangpahrang ralkap pawl in Jerusalem an do ih kei cu siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl khaan pakhat sungah in kharh khum."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang Zedekiah in cutawkah thawng ah i thlak ih i thlaknak thu cu ‘ Bawipa ih ṭongmi na phuan ruangah,’ i ti. Bawipa cun hiti in a sim, “Babilon siangpahrang hi khawpi hi ka lakter ding ih,"},"4":{"text":"siangpahrang Zedekiah khal a luat lo ding. Babilon siangpahrang kut sungah pek a si ding. Hmaiton in an hmu aw ding ih pumpak in an bia aw ding."},"5":{"text":"Zedekiah cu Babilon ah hruaihlo a si ding ih a thu ka rel hlan lo cutawkah a um ding. Babilon mipawl a do khalle a hlawhtling lo ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in thu i sim ih,"},"7":{"text":"ka paseu Shallum ih fapa Hanamel cu ka hnenah a ra ding ih Benjamin ram sung Anathoth khua ih a lo cu keimah lei dingah i ra tong ding; ziangahtile a sungte lakah a nai bik ka si ih keimah ih hrangah a lei theitu ding ka si."},"8":{"text":"Cule Bawipa ih i sim ṭheh vete in Hanamel cu ka umnak khaan sungah a ra ih lo lei dingah i ra fial. Curuangah Bawipa in ka hnenih a ṭongmi hi a dik a si, ti ka thei."},"9":{"text":"Hanamel hnen ihsin lo cu ka lei ih tangka cu a cuai kan thlai. A man cu ngun tangka in hleisarih man a si."},"10":{"text":"Lungkimnak cakhen kan tuah ih ka hmin ka ngan. Thu theihpitu kan ko ih tangka cu cuai in kan thlai."},"11":{"text":"Lo leinak cakhen cu pahnih in kan tuah. Pakhat cu tacik khenmi a si ih a dang pakhat cu tacik khen lomi a si. Keimah ih hrangah a pahnih in ka lak ih,"},"12":{"text":"Maiseiah ih fa sin Neriah fapa Baruk hnenah ka pek. Hanamel mithmuh ah le lo leinak hmin ngantu le thutheitu pawl le cuih khaan sungih a tomi pawl mithmuh ah Baruk hnenah cun ka pek."},"13":{"text":"An zate hmaiah Baruk hnenah cun,"},"14":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in hi lo leinak cakhen hi kum reipi tiang hlolote ih a umnak dingah tacik khenmi siseh, khen lomi khal siseh, kum reipi siat lo dingin tlak beel sungah ṭhateih ret dingah thu a lo pek a si."},"15":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in inn le lo le sabit hmuan pawl tla hi ram sungah lei sal a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Lo leinak cakhen cu Baruk hnenih ka pek hnuah thla ka cam:","title":"Jeremiah Thlacamnak"},"17":{"text":"“A lian bik Bawipa , lei le van hi na cahnak le na huham in na tuah. Na hrangah a har tukmi zianghman a um lo."},"18":{"text":"Minung siar cawk lo parah a hmunmi na duhdawtnak na langter zo, a sinan an nu le an pa sualnak ruangah mi na hrem fawn. Nang cu a maksakmi le a nasa zetmi Pathian na si; nang cu Cungnungbik Bawipa na si."},"19":{"text":"Nang cu thil ruat thiamtu, mangbang za thil tuahtu na si. Minung tuah mi hmuahhmuah na hmu ṭheh ih an hnaṭuan vekin laksawng na pek."},"20":{"text":"Kum reipi laiah Izipt ram ah thil khawruahhar le thil mangbangza na tuah ih tuihsun tiangin Israel mi lakah siseh, mi phundang dang lakah siseh, na tuah ringring lai. Curuangah khuazakip ah na hmin a thang."},"21":{"text":"Thil khawruah har le thil mangbangza na tuahmi in kan ral pawl a ṭihter ih na huham le na cahnak hmang in Israel mipawl cu Izipt ram ihsin na suah a si."},"22":{"text":"Hi ram cawhnawi le khuaitizu a luannak ram hi an pupa pawl hnenih na kam cia vekin an hnenah na pek."},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hi ram sung an thlen ih an luah tikah na thukham an thlun lo; na thuzirhmi vekin an nung fawn lo. An tuah dingih na thupekmi hmuahhmuah zianghman an tuah lo. Curuangah hi bangtuk siatsuahnak cu an parah na thlenter."},"24":{"text":"“Babilon mipawl in an khawpi la dingah a lenglam ihsin leilung an khahsilh ih an do ciamco. Raldonak le paamnak le natnak in hi khawpi cu an kut sungah a thlenter ding. Na ṭong mi hmuahhmuah a kim thluh a si ti cu na hmu ṭheh ko."},"25":{"text":"Asinain, Maw Cungnungbik Bawipa , Babilon mipawl in hi khawpi an lak zik thlang naón thu theihpitu pawl hmuhhngan ah lo lei dingah thu i pek fawn,” tiah ka ti."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in ka hnenah,"},"27":{"text":"“Keimah cu Bawipa ka si, mi hmuahhmuah ih Pathian ka si. Ka hrangah zianghman a harmi a um lo."},"28":{"text":"Hi khawpi cu Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar le a ralkap pawl kut ah ka pe ding; an lak ding ih,"},"29":{"text":"meisa in an ur ding. Himi pawl in an inn parah Baal khawzing hnenah rimhmui an ur ih khuavang dangdang hnenah sabitti an pek ih an toih ruangah ka thin in hengter. Hi mi pawl cu an inn pawl thawn ciam ko in an ur ṭheh ding."},"30":{"text":"An thuanthu hramthok pek ihsin Israel mi le Judah mi pawl in ka thin in tok ih an thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah in ka thin in hengter zo a si."},"31":{"text":"Hi khawpi sung mi pawl in hi khawpi an din thok ni ihsin ka thin in hengter. Siatsuah dingah ka ruat cat zo."},"32":{"text":"Ziangahtile Judah mi le Jerusalem mipawl in an siangpahrang le an hotu pawl, an puithiam le an profet pawl thawn thil sualral an tuah a si."},"33":{"text":"An dung in tun ih ka zirh rero hai naón zianghman an ngai lo, a zir khal an zir duh lo."},"34":{"text":"Fihnungza a si mi an milem pawl hman cu keimah biaknak hrangih sakmi Biakinn sungah an ret ih an balter zo a si."},"35":{"text":"An fanu le an fapa pawl Molek khawzing hnenih raithawinak ih pe dingah Baal khawzing hnenah Hinnom phairawn ah biakṭheng an dawl. Cuvek ih tuah dingah thu ka pek lo; cuvekin an tuah ding ih Judah mipawl an sualter ding ti cu a ruah hman ka ruah dah lomi a si,” tiah i ti."},"36":{"text":"Bawipa Israel ih Pathian in ka hnenah, “Jeremiah, raldonak le paamnak le natnak in hi khawpi cu Babilon siangpahrang kut ah a thlengter ding, tiah hi mipawl in an ti. Atuih ka ṭong ding mi hi ngai hrihhnik!","title":"Ruahsannak Thukam"},"37":{"text":"Ka thinhengnak le ka ai-thawhnak ruangih ram tampi ih ka ṭhekdarhnak ihsin anmah cu ka finkhawm hai ding; hi ram ahhin ka kirter sal ding ih hnangamte in an um ding."},"38":{"text":"Annih cu ka minung an si ding ih kei hi an Pathian ka si ding."},"39":{"text":"An nunnak ah tumtahmi thil pakhat lawng ka pe ding: anmah ṭhatnak le an tesinfa pawl ṭhatnak hrangah kumkhua in keimah cu upatnak in pe ding."},"40":{"text":"Anmah thawn kumkhua hrang in thukamnak ka tuah ding. An hrangih thil ṭha tuah cu ka bang dah lo ding; an thinlung zate thawn keimah in ṭihzah dingah ka tuah ding ih cuticun ka hnen ihsin an pial nawn lo ding."},"41":{"text":"An hrangih thil ṭha tuah cu nuam ka ti ding ih hi ram ahhin kumkhua in ka hmunter hai ding."},"42":{"text":"“An parah thil poimawh ka thlenter zo bangin an hnenih thil ṭha ka kam ciami pawl cu ka thlenter vivo ding."},"43":{"text":"Mi pawl in hi ram cu nelrawn bangtuk, minung le ramsa um lonak ram ah a cang ding ih Babilon mipawl ih kut ah pek a si ding tiah an sim. Sikhalsehla hi ram ah lo le leiram pawl lei sal ciamco an si ding."},"44":{"text":"Mi pawl in lo an lei ding, an lei awknak cakhen cu hmin an ngan ding, tacik an khen ding ih thu theihpitu khal an um ding. Hi bangtuk cu Benjamin ram sungah le Jerusalem kiangkap khawte pawl ah, Judah ram khawsung ah le tlangpar ram khua pawl ah, tlanghram ram ah le Judah ram thlanglam ram sung khalah an tuah ding. Mi pawl cu an ram sungah ka umter sal ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl khaan sungih thawng ka tlak lai ahcun Bawipa ih thu cu a voihnihnak ka hnenah a thleng sal.","title":"Ruahsannak Thukamnak Dang"},"2":{"text":"Leilung a siamtu, a tuahtu le a umnak hmun ih a dintu Bawipa in ka hnenah a sim. A hmin ah Bawipa a si mi cun,"},"3":{"text":"“I ko awla ka lo let ding. Na theih lomi thil khawruahhar le mangbangza ka lo sim ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa keimah, Israel ih Pathian in Jerusalem inn pawl le Judah ram siangpahrang inn cu ral in an kulh ih an do ciamco ruangah a cim ṭheh ding tiah ka sim."},"5":{"text":"Mihrek cun Babilon mi pawl cu an do ve ding; a sinan annih in ka thinhengnak le ka ai-thawhnak in ka siatsuah tummi pawl ih ruak thawn inn pawl cu an khahter ding. Himi pawl in thilsual an tuah ruangah hi khawpi cu ka dungtun zo a si."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hi khawpi le a minung pawl cu ka damter sal ding ih ka harh ververter ding. An hnenah hnangamnak le daihnak tlamtling in ka thlenter ding."},"7":{"text":"Judah le Israel cu ka ṭhansoter ding ih a hlan vekin ka dinter sal ding."},"8":{"text":"An sualnak le ka parih an mawhnak pawl cu ka kholhfai ding ih an sualnak le ral an thawhnak cu ka ngaithiam ding."},"9":{"text":"Jerusalem cu ka hrangah lungawinak, hmaihngalnak le uannak hrampi a si ding. Jerusalem mipawl hrangah thil ṭha ka tuahmi le hi khawpi hrangih ṭhansonak ka thlentermi cu leilungtlun miphun pawl in an theih tikah an ṭih ding ih an khur rero ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Mi in hi hmun cu nelrawn ram vek a si, milai siseh ramsa siseh an um lo tiah an ti. Asi, an dik a si. Judah khua pawl le Jerusalem khawsung lamzin pawl cu an ṭhing reprep ngai a si. Minung le ramsa zianghman an um lo. Sikhalsehla hi hmun pawl ahhin,"},"11":{"text":"lungawi aipuannak thawng le mocan puai ih awn-au thawmvang nan thei sal ding. Mi pawl in ka Biakinn ah lungawi thawinak pe dingah hlasak phah ih an rat nan thei ding. Annih in, ‘Cungnungbik Bawipa hnenah lungawinak pe uh, Ziangahtile amah cu a ṭha; a duhdawtnak cu kumkhua in a hmun,’ an ti ding. Hi ram cu a hlan vekin ka ṭhansoter ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Hi ram nelrawn a bangmi le minung le ramsa an um lonak ram hi ṭilva tlannak ram a cang sal ding ih cunah tuukhal pawl in an tuu an khal ding."},"13":{"text":"Tlangpar ram ih khua pawl, tlanghram ram le Judah ram thlanglam ah, Benjamin ram sung le Jerusalem kiangkap khawfate te ah le Judah ram khua pawl ah tuukhal pawl in an tuu an siar ciamco sal ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel le Judah mi hnenih ka thukammi ka kimternak tikcu a ra thleng ding."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah an siangpahrang ah David ih tesinfa mifel pakhat ka hril ding. Cuih siangpahrang in hi ram sungah hin thil dik le thil ding a tuah ding."},"16":{"text":"Judah mi le Jerusalem mipawl cu runsuak an si ding ih hnangam zetin an um ding. Hi khawpi cu, ‘ Bawipa kan Rundamnak,’ ti a si ding."},"17":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang cu David tesinfa a si ringring ding ih,"},"18":{"text":"Keimah riantu le mei-ur thawinak petu le sangphut le thawinak dangdang petu dingah Levi phun sungin puithiam an ṭuan ringring ding, tiah keimah Bawipa in thu ka kam a si,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,"},"20":{"text":"“Sun le zan cu anmah tikcute ih um ringring dingah anmah thawn thukamnak ka tuah zo. Cuih thukamnak cu bal theih a si nawnlo ding."},"21":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in a tesinfa pawl in siangpahrang ṭuan ringring ding in ka sal pa David thawn thukamnak ka tuah ih keimah riantu si ringring ding in Levi phun puithiam pawl thawn thukamnak ka tuah zo; hi thukamnak pawl cu bal theih a si nawn lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Ka sal pa David ih tesinfa pawl le Levi phun puithiam pawl cu ka karhzaiter ciamco ding ih, van ih arsi le tifinriat kap vunnel siar cawk lo an si bangin siar cawk lo an sive ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,"},"24":{"text":"“Hi mipawl in ka hril ciami innsang pahnih Israel le Judah hi a hnong zo a si, tiah an rel rero hi na thei zo maw? Cule ka minung Israel le Judah mipawl cu an nautat ih miphun hmanah an siar nawn lo."},"25":{"text":"Asinain keimah Bawipa in sun le zan thawn thukamnak ka tuah ih lei le van an umzia uktu dingah daan khal ka tuah a si."},"26":{"text":"Hi thil pawl a tuahtu ka si vekin Jakob ih tesinfa pawl le i riantu David thawn ka tuahmi thukamnak cu ka hmunter ding. Abraham, Isaak le Jakob ih tesinfa pawl uktu ah David ih tesinfa pakhatkhat ka hril ding. Ka minung pawl parah zaangfahnak ka nei ding ih mi neinungzet ka siter sal hai ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar le a ralkap pawl le a kut thuai ih a ummi miphun hmuahhmuah pawl ih ralkap pawl in Jerusalem le a kiangkap khua pawl an do rero laiah Bawipa ih thu cu ka hnenah a rung thleng.","title":"Zedekiah Hnenih Thucahmi"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in Judah siangpahrang Zedekiah hnenah feh tahratin hiti in va sim dingah i fial, “Keimah Bawipa in hi khua cu Babilon siangpahrang kutah ka pe ding ih a nih in ciam ko in a ur ding."},"3":{"text":"Na luat lo ding; kaih na si ding ih Babilon siangpahrang kut ah pek na si ding. Hmaiton in amah cu na hmu ding ih nan bia aw ding; cule Babilon ah na feh ding."},"4":{"text":"Zedekiah, na hnenih ka ṭongmi hi ngaihnik! Raldonak ahcun na thi lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Daite in na thi ding; na hlan ih siangpahrang a cangmi na pu le na pa pawl an thih ih an phum tikah rimhmui an ur bangin na hrang khalah rimhmui an ur ve ding. An lo ṭah ding ih, ‘Kan siangpahrang a thi ee,’ an ti ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Babilon siangpahrang ralkap pawl in,"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem khua an do rero laiah siangpahrang Zedekiah cu ka sim. Babilon ralkap pawl cun Lakhish le Azekah khua khal an do ciamco; hi khua pahnih cu a taangsun ralhruang kulhmi Judah khawpi an si."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang Zedekiah le Jerusalem mipawl in zohman in kanmah ih miphun Israel mi lala cu sal ah kan zua nawn lo pei;","title":"Sal Pawl An Bum"},"9":{"text":"Hebru sal pawl cu nunau siseh, mipa siseh luatter ṭheh an si pei, tiah lungkimnak an tuah."},"10":{"text":"Mipi pawl le an hotu pawl an zatein an lung a kim ih an sal pawl thlah thluh ih sal ih kaih sal nawn lo dingin an lung a kim ṭheh a si. An lungkimnak vekin an thlah ṭheh."},"11":{"text":"Asinain an lung an thleng sal ih an kaih sal ih sal ah an tuah sal ṭheh lala."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa ,"},"13":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian ṭong cu mipi hnenih sim dingah ka hnenah a thleng: “Izipt ram saltaannak ihsin nan pupa pawl ka runsuak ih ka luatter tikah anmah thawn thukamnak ka tuah."},"14":{"text":"Hebru sal kum ruk a lo riantu an um tikah a kum sarihnak ahcun nan luatter ding, tiah ka sim. Asinain nan pupa pawl cun ka thu in thlun lo, ka simmi khal an ngai lo."},"15":{"text":"Naite ah nan thinlung nan thleng ih ka lung i awitertu thil nan tuah. Nan zatein nan phunpi Israel sal pawl cu thlah ṭheh dingah nan lung a kim ih, keimah in biaknak Biakinn sungah ka mithmuh ah thukamnak nan tuah."},"16":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nan lung nan thleng lala ih ka thangsiatnak thil nan tuah lala. Nan zatein an duh vekih nan thlah ciami sal pawl cu nan kaih sal ih sal ah nan tuah lala."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah keimah Bawipa in ka thu nan thlun lo a si, tiah ka lo ti. Nan phunpi Israel mipawl cu nan luatter lo. A ṭha, nannih tla luatnak ka lo pe ding: Raldonak le paamnak le natnak in duhduh ih thih theinak ka lo pe ding. Nan parih ka tuahmi in leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah tuksum ko in a tuah ding."},"18":{"text":"Judah ram le Jerusalem khawsung bawi pawl, siangpahrang inn ih bawi pawl, puithiam pawl le hotu hmuahhmuah in cawcang pakhat an that ih a laifang in an seu ih cuih caw ruang ṭhen hnih karlak ih feh tahratin keimah thawn thukamnak an tuah. Sikhalsehla cuih thukamnak cu an bal ih thlun ding an timi khal an thlun lo. Curuangah cawcang parih an tuah vekin himi pawl parah ka tuah ve ding.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Anmah thah a hiar zettu an ral pawl hnenah ka pe ding ih an ruak pawl cu vate le ramsa in an ei ding."},"21":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Zedekiah le a kut thuai bawi pawl tla anmah thah a duhtu pawl hnenah ka pe ding. Nanmah do lo in a cawltu Babilon ralkap pawl ih kut ah ka pe ding."},"22":{"text":"Cuih ralkap hnenah thu ka pe ding ih hi khawpi ah an ra kir sal ding. An do ding, an neh ding ih an ur ciam ding. Judah khua pawl cu zohman um lonak nelrawn vekah ka tuah ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah ih fapa Jehoiakim cu Judah siangpahrang a si laiah Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Jeremiah Le Rekhab Mipawl"},"2":{"text":"“Rekhab miphun pawl ih innsang hmuahhmuah ah va feh awla thu va sim aw. Biakinn sungih a khaan pakhatkhat sungah rak hruai awla sabitti pe hai aw,” tiah i ti."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Rekhab hrin pawl, Habazziniah ih fapa Jeremiah dang ih fapa Jaazaniah le a unau pawl le a fapa pawl cu,"},"4":{"text":"Biakinn ah ka hruai. Igdaliah ih fapa profet Hanan ih dungthlun tu pawl ih khaan ah ka umter hai. Hi khaan cu Biakinn ih thuneitu bawi a si mi Shallum ih fapa Maaseiah khaan tlunah a si ih bawi dangdang pawl ih khaan kiangah a si."},"5":{"text":"Cule khuat le pakan kuum khat in sabitti Rekhab mipawl hmai ahcun ka ret ih, “Sabitti in uh,” ka ti."},"6":{"text":"Asinain annih in, “Sabitti kan in lo. Kan pu Rekhab ih fapa Jonadab in kanmah siseh kan tesinfa pawl siseh sabitti nan in hrimhrim lo pei in ti."},"7":{"text":"Inn sak khal in kham; lo thlawh le sabit hmuan tuah khal in siang lo; a lei khal nan lei lo pei, a ti. Hi ramsung mikhual vekih kan umnak ram ahhin kan um suah theinak dingah puanthlam sungih um ringring dingah thu in pek a si."},"8":{"text":"Jonadab ih in simmi le a thupekmi hmuahhmuah cu kan thlun ṭheh. Kanmah in sabitti kan in dah lo; kan nupi pawl, kan fanu le kan fapa pawl khal in an in dah lo a si."},"9":{"text":"Kan umnak kan inn hrangah tiah inn kan sa dah lo; Puanthlam sungah kan um; sabit hmuan le lo le rawl tla kan nei lo. Kan pu Jonadab thupekmi hmuahhmuah in kimten kan thlun ṭheh a si.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in hi ram a do tikah Babilon ralkap le Siria ralkap pawl ṭih ah kan tlan ih Jerusalem ah feh uhsi kan ti ih curuangah atu Jerusalem ah kan um a si,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in Judah le Jerusalem mi hnenah feh dingah le hiti ih va sim dingah i fial, “Keimah Bawipa in, ziangah so ka thusimmi nan ngai duh lo ih ka thupekmi nan thlun duh lo? tiah ka lo sut.","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Rekhab miphun cu an pu Jonadab ih thupekmi kha a tesinfa pawl in an thlun ih tuihsun tiangin zohman in sabitti an in lo. Asinain nannih cu ka lo sim rero naón ka thu nan thlun duh lo."},"15":{"text":"Ka sal profet pawl pakhat hnu pakhat nan hnenah ka thlah rero ih a dikmi tuah ih thilsual tuahnak nuncan tlansan dingah an lo sim rero. Nan pupa pawl le nanmah hnenih ka lo pekmi hi ram ahhin nan um thei ringringnak dingah Pathian dang pawl rian lo ding le bia lo dingah an lo sim, ralrinnak an lo pek. Asinain ka thusimmi cu nan ngai lo ih ziang hman ah nan siar lo."},"16":{"text":"Jonadab ih tesinfa pawl cun an pu ih thupekmi an thlun naón nannih pawl cun ka thu nan thlun lo a si."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah nannih Judah mi le Jerusalem mipawl nan parah keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in ka lo tiam ciami siatsuahnak hmuahhmuah ka thlenter ding a si. Hi bangtuk in nan parah ka thlenter ding, ziangahtile nan hnenih ka ṭong tikah nan ngai duh lo ih ka lo ko hai tikah in awi duh fawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule Rekhab hrin pawl hnenah, “Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in ‘Nan pu Jonadab ih thupekmi cu nan thlun ṭheh zo; a thuzirhmi tla nan ngai ih a lo simmi daan hmuahhmuah nan tuah ṭheh a si."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in thu ka lo kam. Rekhab fapa Jonadab in keimah riantu dingah tesinfa fapa cat loin a nei ringring ding,’ a ti,” tiah ka sim."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah ih fapa Jehoiakim Judah siangpahrang a cannak kum linak ah Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Baruk In Biakinn Sungah Cazual A Siar"},"2":{"text":"“Cazual la awla Israel le Judah le miphun hmuahhmuah pawl thuhla ka simmi hi a zatein ngan thluh aw. Josiah siangpahrang a ṭuan laiah na hnenih hmaisabik ka ṭongmi ihsin tuihsun tiang ka lo simmi hmuahhmuah ngan thluh aw."},"3":{"text":"Judah mipawl parih siatsuahnak thlenter ka tummi hi an theih ih an nuncan ṭhin thei pang hai sehla! Cuticun an sualnak le an ṭhat lonak pawl ka ngaidam ding naón!” tiah i ti."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Neriah ih fapa Baruk ka ko ih Bawipa in ka hnenih a ṭongmi hmuahhmuah cu ngan dingah ka auh. Baruk in cazual sungah a khum ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Cule kei in Baruk hnenah cun, “Kei cu Biakinn sungih feh theinak thu ka ngah nawn lo."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah nangmah feh dingah ka lo duh: hmailam rawl an ulh sal tik caan ah feh aw. Hi cazual ihsin ringzet in siar awla cuti cun Bawipa in ka hnen ih a ṭong ih ka lo auh-mi hmuahhmuah hi mipi in an thei ṭheh ding. Mi hmuahhmuah le an khua ciar in a rami Judah mipawl tla ih an theih ṭheh theinak hmun ihsin siar aw."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah thla an cam ih an nuncan ṭha lomi an tlansannak tla ah a cang thei men ding. Ziangahtile hi minung pawl parah Bawipa in ṭihnungza a thinhengnak le a ai-thawhnak thlenter a tum a si,” tiah ka ti."},"8":{"text":"Neriah ih fapa Baruk cun ka sim vek cekci in Biakinn sungah Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu a va siar."},"9":{"text":"Jehoiakim Judah siangpahrang a sinak kum nganak thla kua thla ah Bawipa ih mithmai ṭha co duh ah mipawl cu rawl an ul sal! Jerusalem khawsungah a ummi le Judah ramsung khawpi ihsin a rami hmuahhmuah in rawl an ul."},"10":{"text":"Cule mi hmuahhmuah in thu an ngai laifangah ka simmi cu cazual sung vekin a zatein Baruk in a siar ṭheh. Cutiin Biakinn sungah a siar ih cuih khaan ih sungṭuan Shafan ih fapa Gemariah ih khaan in a siar. A khaan cu tlunta khaan Biakinn ih Kotka Thar timi kiangah a si."},"11":{"text":"Baruk in Bawipa ih ṭong cazual ihsin a siarmi cu Shafan fasuan Gemariah ih fapa Mikaiah in a thei.","title":"Bawi Pawl Hnenah Baruk In A Siar"},"12":{"text":"Cule Mikaiah cu siangpahrang inn, sungṭuan ih khaan ah bawi pawl an tongkhawm laifangah a feh. Sungṭuan Elishama, Shemaiah ih fapa Delaiah, Akbor ih fapa Elnathan, Shafan ih fapa Gemariah, Hananiah ih fapa Zedekiah le bawi dangdang tla an rak um."},"13":{"text":"Baruk in mipi hnenih a siarmi thu kha Mikaiah in a theih vekin an hnenah a sim."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah bawi pawl in Jehudi an thlah. Jehudi cu Nethaniah ih fapa a si; Nethaniah cu Shelemiah ih fapa a si; Shelemiah cu Kushi ih fapa a si. An thlah ih mipi hnenih a siarmi cazual rak keng dingah Baruk va sim dingin an fial. Baruk in cazual cu a rak keng."},"15":{"text":"Bawi pawl cun, “To awla cazual cu siar aw,” an ti. An ti vekin Baruk cun a siar."},"16":{"text":"A siar ṭheh tikah pakhat le pakhat thinphang in an zoh aw ih, “Siangpahrang kan sim a ṭul ding,” tiah Baruk cu an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule Baruk cu, “In sim hnik! Ziangtin so hi hmuahhmuah hi na ngan thei? Jeremiah in a lo auh maw si?” tiah an sut."},"18":{"text":"Baruk in, “Jeremiah in ṭong fangkhat hman hrelh loin i auh ih hi cazual parah cati thawn ka ngan a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Nang le Jeremiah cu nan relh a ṭul ding. Nan relhnak cu zohman sim hlah uh,” an ti."},"20":{"text":"Bawi pawl in cazual cu sungṭuan Elishama khaan ah an retta ih siangpahrang khaan ah an feh ih siangpahrang hnenah cuih thu cu a zatein an va sim ṭheh.","title":"Siangpahrang In Cazual A Ur"},"21":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in cazual la dingah Jehudi a thlah. Jehudi cun Elishama khaan ihsin a va lak ih siangpahrang le a kiangih a dingtu pawl hnenah cun cazual cu a siar."},"22":{"text":"Thla kua thla, thlatang lai a si ih siangpahrang bawipa cu a thlatang inn ah meisabeel ih an muahmi meisa ai in a to."},"23":{"text":"Jehudi cun a hun siar ih cahmai hmai thum hmai li a hun siar tikah siangpahrang cun namte in a at thlek ih meisa sungah, meisabeel sungah cun a paih. Cazual zate ih a cem hlan lo meisa sungah a paih vivo."},"24":{"text":"Asinain siangpahrang siseh, a kut thuai bawi pawl siseh, cazual sung thuhla cu an thei ṭheh naón ṭihnak an thiam lo, riahsiatnak khal an thei lo."},"25":{"text":"Elnathan, Delaiah le Gemariah in cazual ur lo dingah siangpahrang cu an leem rero naón zianghman ah a siar lo."},"26":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in keimah le ka cazi Baruk kai dingah thu a pek. A fialmi cu siangpahrang fapa Jerahmeel, Azriel ih fapa Seraiah le Abdeel ih fapa Shelemiah an si. Asinain Bawipa in in thup."},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jehoiakim in Baruk ka auh-mi cazual cu a ur ṭheh hnuah Bawipa in,","title":"Jeremiah In Ca Dang A Ngan"},"28":{"text":"cazual dang lak ih hmaisa cazual sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah ngan sal dingah i fial."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa in siangpahrang hnenah hiti ih va sim dingin i fial: “Cazual na ur zo; cule Jeremiah cu hi ram ah Babilon siangpahrang a ra ding ih hi ram le hi ramsung minung pawl le ṭilva pawl a siatsuah ṭheh ding tiah zianghrangah na ngan? tiah na sut zo."},"30":{"text":"Curuangah keimah Bawipa in atu-ah nang siangpahrang Jehoiakim ka lo sim: David ukmi ram hi na tesinfa zohman in an uk dah lo ding. Na ruak cu khawleng ah hlon a si ding ih sun ah nisa in a em ding ih zan ah dai in a tlak ding."},"31":{"text":"Nan zate ih nan tuahmi sualnak ruangah hin nangmah le na tesinfa pawl le na kut thuai bawi pawl ka lo hrem ding. Nangmah in siseh, Jerusalem mi le Judah mi pawl in siseh, ralrinnak ka lo pekmi zianghman ih nan siar lo ruangah ka thlenter ding, ti ih ka sim ciami siatralnak cu nan zate parah ka thlengter ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cule cazual dang pakhat ka lak ih ka cazi Baruk hnenah ka pek ih ka auh-mi hmuahhmuah a ngan ṭheh. A hmaisa cazual sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah le a bang-awmi thu dang ka auh-mi pawl cu a ngan ṭheh a si."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Jehoiakim ih fapa Jehoiakhin ai ah Josiah ih fapa Zedekiah cu Judah siangpahrang ah a tuah.","title":"Zedekiah In Jeremiah Hnenah Dilnak"},"2":{"text":"Asinain Zedekiah in siseh, a kut thuai bawi pawl le misenpi pawl in siseh, Bawipa in ka hnenih a simmi thu cu an ngai duh lo."},"3":{"text":"Kan miphun ai-awh in Bawipa kan Pathian hnenih thlacam dingah siangpahrang Zedekiah in Shelemiah ih fapa Jehukal le Maaseiah ih fapa puithiam Zefaniah cu ka hnenah a rak thlah."},"4":{"text":"Culai ahcun thawng ah in thlak hrih lo ih luat zetin misenpi lakah ka tlang thei lai."},"5":{"text":"Babilon ralkap pawl in Jerusalem an kulh ṭheh zo; sikhalsehla annih in Izipt siangpahrang Faro ralkap pawl cu Izipt ramri an rak lan zo ti an theih tikah Jerusalem ihsin an siip thluh sal."},"6":{"text":"Cule Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in,"},"7":{"text":"Zedekiah sim dingah hiti in i sim, “Izipt ralkap pawl cu nangmah bawm dingah an ra lai rero. Asinain an ram ah an kir sal ding."},"8":{"text":"Babilon ralkap pawl cu an ra sal ding ih Jerusalem khawpi hi an do ding, an lak ding ih ciam ko in an ur ding."},"9":{"text":"Babilon mipawl an ra nawn lo ding tiin ruat tahratin nangmah le nangmah bum aw rero hlah; Keimah Bawipa in ralrinnak ka lo pek: an ra tengteng ding."},"10":{"text":"Babilon ralkap an zatein na neh ṭheh ih hmapu pawl lawnglawng an taang ih an buuk sungih hlum ṭhehmi an si hmanah cupawl cu an tho sal ding ih hi khawpi cu meisa thawn ciam ko in an ur thotho ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Izipt ralkap pawl an ra ti an theih tikah Babilon ralkap pawl cu Jerusalem ihsin an siip.","title":"Jeremiah Thawng Ah An Thlak"},"12":{"text":"Curuangah kei khal sungkhat thilri co ding ka neih ve ruangah Benjamin ram ih feh dingah Jerusalem ihsin ka pok."},"13":{"text":"Asinain Benjamin Kotka ka thlen tikah cutawkih kotka kiltu ralkap pawl hotu ralbawi, a hmin Irijah an timi, Shelemiah ih fapa, Hananiah ih fasuan cun i rak kham ih, “Babilon mi hnenah na tlan tum a si lo maw?” tiah i sut."},"14":{"text":"“Sihlah, tlan ka tum lo,” tiah ka sawn. Asinain Irijah cun ka simmi cu a ngai lo. I kai ih bawi pawl hnenah i hruai."},"15":{"text":"In hmuh tikah an thin a heng ih in vuak ih sungṭuan Jonathan inn ah, thawnginn ih an tuahmi inn sungah cun in ret ih tawh an hren."},"16":{"text":"Leilung thuai khaan sungah in ret ih cutawkah reipi ka um."},"17":{"text":"Cuih hnuah siangpahrang Zedekiah in i ko ih a inn sungah cun a thupte in, “ Bawipa hnen ihsin ziang thu a ra maw?” tiah i sut. “A ra a si. Babilon siangpahrang kut ah pek na si ding,” tiah ka ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule thusuh ding ka neih ruangah a hnenah cun, “Ziang sualnak so nangmah le na kut thuai bawi pawl parah siseh, misenpi parah siseh, ka neih ih thawng ah i thlak?"},"19":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang in nangmah le hi ram cu a lo do lo ding, tiah a lo simtu na profet pawl teh khui-ah so an si ṭheh?"},"20":{"text":"Atu-ah siangpahrang Bawipa , na hnen ah ka lo dilmi i tuahsak dingah zaangfah ka lo dil, i theih sak hram aw. Jonathan inn, thawnginn sungah cun i kuat sal hram hlah aw. I kuat sal a si ahcun cunah ka thi tengteng ding,” tiah ka ti."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang Zedekiah in siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl umnak khaan sungah i khum. Cutawkah ka um ih khawpi sungih sang a cem hlan lo, sangtuahtu lamzin timi ihsin, nitinte sang zawl khat ka ngah ringring."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mattan ih fapa Shefatiah, Pashhur ih fapa Gedaliah, Shelemiah ih fapa Jehukal le Malkhiah ih fapa Pashhur pawl in misenpi hnenih,","title":"Tikhur Sungah Jeremiah An Thlak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭong ka simmi, “Hi khawpi sungih a taangmi cu ral kut in, a si lole rawl lo in, a si lole natnak in nan thi ding. Asinain Babilon mi hnenah a feh ih a pe awtu pawl cu thah an si lo ding; an nunnak tal cu zuah a si ding,” tiah ka timi cu an thei."},"3":{"text":"Culawng si loin Bawipa in a simmi, “Hi khawpi cu Babilon ralkap pawl kut ah ka pe ding ih an la ding,” a timi khal mipi hnenah ka sim."},"4":{"text":"Cuih bawi pawl cu siangpahrang hnenah an feh ih, “Hi pa hi thah ding a si. Hitiih a ṭong ruangah khawsung ralkap pawl an tha a nau ih khawsungmi hmuahhmuah hrang khalah thanaunak ah a cang ṭheh. Misenpi bom tum loin an hrangih harsatnak sawn a duh a si,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Zedekiah in, “Cuti a si ahcun nan duh vekin tuah uh, ka lo kham thei lo a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah in hruai ih siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl inn lakih a ummi siangpahrang ih fapa Malkhiah ih tikhur sungah hridai in in vun thlak. Tikhur sungah tidai a rak um lo; ciarbek lawng a um ih cuih ciarbek sungah cun ka vung pil cuahco."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla siangpahrang inn ih hna a ṭuantu Sudan mi tilper pa Ebedmelek in tikhur sungih in thlak cu a thei. Culai ah siangpahrang cu Benjamin Kotka timi ah thu a rel laifang a si."},"8":{"text":"Cutawkah Ebedmelek cu a va feh ih siangpahrang hnenah,"},"9":{"text":"“Maw siangpahrang Bawipa, na kut thuai bawi pawl ih an tuah mi hi thil sual a si. Jeremiah cu tikhur sungah an thlak ih cunah rawl lo in a thi tengteng ding; ziangahtile hi khawpi sungah rawl a um nawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang in Ebedmelek hnenah, “Nangmah le midang pathum va feh uhla Jeremiah cu tikhur sung ihsin a thih hlanah va dirhsuak uh,” tiah thu a pek."},"11":{"text":"Ebedmelek cu midang pathum thawn siangpahrang thilri retnak ah khaan ah an feh ih puansia le hnipuan hlun an lak ih hridai thawn in run thlak."},"12":{"text":"Hridai in ka baan i natter lo dingah ka baan thuai ka zak ah puansia dam dingin i sim. I sim vek cun ka tuah."},"13":{"text":"Cule tikhur sung ihsi cun in dirhsuak. Cuihhnu cun inn kiltu pawl ih inn ah in ret."},"14":{"text":"Voikhat ah siangpahrang Zedekiah in Biakinn ih vung luhnak kotka pathumnak ihsin i ko ih ka hnenah, “Thu pakhat ka lo sut ding ih thudik i sim ding ka duh a si,” tiah a ti.","title":"Zedekiah In Jeremiah Thu A Ron"},"15":{"text":"Kei in, “Thudik ka lo sim a si ahcun i that ding; ruahnak ka lo pek ahcun zianghman ah na siar cuang lo ding,” tiah ka ti."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang Zedekiah in a thupte in siatcam in thu i kam ih, “A nungmi Pathian hmin saal in ka lo kam, nunnak in petu Pathian hmin in ka lo kam a si: Ka lo that hrimhrim lo ding; nangmah thah a lo duhtu pawl kut sung khal ah ka lo pe lo ding,” tiah i ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian ṭong cu Zedekiah hnenah hiti in ka sim: “Babilon siangpahrang kut thuai bawi pawl hnenih na pek awk a si ahcun na nunnak cu an lo zuah ding ih hi khawpi hi ciam ko in an ur lo ding. Nangmah le na innsang pawl cu nan him ding."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na pek aw lo a si ahcun hi khawpi hi Babilon kut ah pek a si ding ih ciam ko an ur ding ih nang khal na luat lo ding,” tiah ka ti."},"19":{"text":"Asinain siangpahrang in, “Babilon mipawl hnenih a tlantu kan ramsung minung pawl ka ṭih a si. An kut sungih ka thlen a si ahcun ih hrem rori ding,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah kei in, “An kut sungah pek na si lo ding. Bawipa ih ṭongkam sawn hi ṭhatein ngai aw tiah ka lo dil. Na ngai asile ziang hmuahhmuah a ṭha ding, na nunnak khal an lo zuah ding."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an hnenih pek awk na duh lo a si ahcun ziang a cang ding ti kha Bawipa in langnak i hmuhter zo."},"22":{"text":"Cuih langnak ahcun Judah siangpahrang inn ih a taangmi nunau hmuahhmuah hi Babilon siangpahrang kut thuai ih bawi pawl hnenah hruai ṭheh an si ding kha ka hmu. An feh phah ih an ṭong mi hi ngai hnik: ‘Siangpahrang cu a rualpi ṭha pawl in an hruai sual zo. A tlunah thu an nei tuk. Atu-ah a ke cu ciarbek sungah a pil zo. A rualpi pawl in an tlansan ṭheh,’ an ti,” tiah ka sim."},"23":{"text":"Cuih tlun ah, “Na nupi pawl le na faate pawl hmuahhmuah hi Babilon mipawl hnenah hruai ṭheh an si ding ih nangmah khal an kut sung ihsin na luat lo ding. Babilon siangpahrang in thawng ah a lo thlak ding ih hi khawpi hi ciam ko in an ur ding,” tiah ka ti."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Zedekiah in, “Hitiih thu kan ruah awknak hi zohman theihter hlah aw. Cuticun na nunnak khal ṭih ding a um lo ding."},"25":{"text":"Nangmah thawn thu kan ruah awknak hi bawi pawl ih an theih a si ahcun na hnenah an ra ding ih thu kan rel mi hi an lo sut ding. Na sim ṭheh a si ahcun kan lo that lo ding, tiah an lo tiam ding."},"26":{"text":"Thawng sungah i kuat sal in i thihter siang hram hlah aw, tiah ka va dil,’ ti men aw,” tiah i ti."},"27":{"text":"Bawi pawl cu an ra ih thu in ra sut ngaingai. Asinain siangpahrang ih i tiam vek cekci in ka sim. Annih in zianghman tuah theimi dang an nei cuang lo. Ziangahtile siangpahrang thawn thu kan ruah awknak kha a theitu zohman an um lo."},"28":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl innah cun in ret ih Jerusalem an lak ni tiang cunah in ret a si"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah in Judah siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum kua kum, thla hra thla ah Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar cu a ralkap zate thawn a ra ih Jerusalem a do.","title":"Jerusalem An Lak"},"2":{"text":"Zedekiah in siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum hleikhat kum, thla li thla, ni kua ni ah khawkulhnak phar dawl cu an bal thei a si."},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi an lak tikah Babilon siangpahrang kut thuai ih bawi upa hmuahhmuah an ra ih Kotka Lai an timi ah an to. Cupawl cu Nergal Sarezer, Samgar Nebo, Sarsekhim le a dang Nergal Sarezar an si."},"4":{"text":"Cumi cu siangpahrang Zedekiah le a ralkap pawl in an hmuh tikah khawpi sung ihsin zan ah tlanhlo an tum. Siangpahrang hmuan sung lamzin ihsin an suak ih khawpi kulhnak phar thuah hnih a pehtu kotka zin in an feh ih Jordan phairawn lamzin in an tlan."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Babilon ralkap pawl in an dawi ih Zedekiah cu Jerikho khua kiang hmunrawn ah an kai. Cule siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar hnenah an fehpi. Nebuchadnezzar cu Hamath peng sung Riblah khua ah a rak um ih cutawkah cun Zedekiah ih thu cu a rel."},"6":{"text":"Riblah khua ahcun Zedekiah ih fapa pawl cu an pa ih hmuhhngan ah Nebuchadnezzar in a thah; Judah ramsung bawi upa pawl khal a that ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Zedekiah ih mit a phorh ih Babilon ih fehpi dingah thir cikcin in a khih."},"8":{"text":"Cutiih an tuah laiah Babilon ralkap dang pawl in siangpahrang inn le misenpi inn pawl an ur ih Jerusalem khawkulhnak phar dawl tla an bal ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Netabik ah an ralkap pawl hotu ralbawi Nebuzaradan in Jerusalem khawpi sungih a taang hrih mi pawl le amah hnenih a ra tlantu pawl kha salih taang dingah Babilon ah a hruai a si."},"10":{"text":"Judah ram ah mifarah bik pawl, thilri le loram zianghman a nei lo pawl a ṭan ih sabit hmuan le lo pawl a pekta."},"11":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in ralkap hotu ralbawi Nebuzaradan hnenah thu a pek ih,","title":"Jeremiah An Suah"},"12":{"text":"“Jeremiah hawl ah feh awla ṭhatein va kilkhawi aw. Zianghman harsatnak pe hlah aw. A duhmi hmuahhmuah tuahsak sawn aw,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah Nebuzaradan le bawi dang Nebushazban le Nergal Sarezer le a dang bawi upa dangdang pawl an ra ṭheh ih,"},"14":{"text":"siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl umnak inn ih in retnak ihsin in ra suah. Keimah humhim dingih ṭuanvo an pekmi Ahikam fapa le Shafan ih fasuan a si mi Gedaliah ih kut thuai ah in ret. Cuticun ka miphun pawl lak ahcun ka um."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang inn kiltu pawl umnak inn ih in ret laiah Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in,","title":"Ebedmelek Hrangah Ruahsannak"},"16":{"text":"“Sudan mi Ebedmelek hnen ah sim aw: ‘Ka tuah ding ka ti bangtuk in hi khawpi hnenah hin ṭhansonak si loin siatsuahnak ka thlengter ding. Cumi tikcu a thlen tikah a hmutu na si ve ding."},"17":{"text":"Asinain keimah Bawipa in nang cu ka lo hum ding ih na ṭih mi pawl hnenah pek na si lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Ka lo humhim ding ih zohman in an lo that lo ding. Keimah i rinsan zo ruangah na nunnak cu a him ding ih na luat ding a si. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,’ va ti aw,” tiah a ti."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon ralkap pawl hotu ralbawi Nebuzaradan in Ramah khua ah i luatter hnuah Bawipa ih ṭong cu ka hnenah a thleng. Judah mi le Jerusalem mipawl cu salkaihmi an si ih Babilon ram lam ih an hruai laiah kei khal kaihmi ka si ve ruangah thir cikcin thawn Ramah khua ka thlen venak a si.","title":"Gedaliah Hnenah Jeremiah A Um"},"2":{"text":"Ralbawipa cun hmundangte ah i hruai ih, “ Bawipa na Pathian in hi ram parah siatsuahnak ka thlenter ding, tiah a rak timi cu,"},"3":{"text":"atu-ah a sim cia vekin a thleng ngaingai a si. Na minung pawl an sual ih Bawipa ih thu an ngai duh lo ruangah hi bangtuk in a cang a si."},"4":{"text":"Tuihsun ihsin na kutngel ihsin thir cikcin hi ka phuak ding ih ka lo thlah ding. Keimah thawn Babilon ih na feh duh a si ahcun na feh thei; ṭhatein ka lo kilkhawi ding. Na feh duh lo a si ahcun na thu a si. Hi ram pumpi sungah na duhduh na hril pei ih nangmah in a rem a ṭha na tinak poh ah na feh pei,” tiah i ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule zianghman ṭong loih ka um tikah Nebuzaradan cun, “Judah ram uktu ah Babilon siangpahrang in a tuahmi Shafan ih fasuan, Ahikam ih fapa Gedaliah hnenah vung kir aw. Amah thawn misenpi lakah vung um aw; a si lole na feh duhnaknak ah feh aw la um aw,” i ti. Cule laksawng i ṭhen ih lamcaw i ken hnuah i thlah."},"6":{"text":"Cutin Ahikam ih fapa Gedaliah hnenah ka feh ih Mizpah ah a hnenah ka um. Cuticun ram sungih a taangmi misenpi lakah ka um."},"7":{"text":"Judah ralbawi hrekkhat le ralkap hrekkhat pawl cun remnak an tuah lo. Judah ram sungih taantami, ralkaihmi sungih a tel lomi mifarah bik pawl zohtu le hotu ah Babilon siangpahrang in Gedaliah a ret a si ti an theih tikah,","title":"Judah Ram Uktu Gedaliah (2 Sian. 25.22-24)"},"8":{"text":"Nathaniah ih fapa Ishmael, Kareah ih fapa Johanan, Tanhumeth ih fapa Seraiah, Netofah ihsin Efai fapa pawl le Maakah ihsin Jezaniah pawl cu Gedaliah hnenah Mizpah ah an feh."},"9":{"text":"Gedaliah in an hnenah, “Babilon ralbawi pawl hnenih remnak tuah cu nan hrangah zianghman phan ding a um lo, tiah feltein ka lo sim. Hi ram sungah um in Babilon siangpahrang rian uhla nan hrangah ziang hmuahhmuah a tluang ko ding."},"10":{"text":"Keimah khal Mizpah ahhin ka um ding ih Babilon mi an rat tikah nan palai ka si ding. Sabit le thingrah le olif hriak pawl khawm uhla ṭhatein re uh; cule nan lakmi khua pawl sungah daitein um uh,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule Babilon siangpahrang in Israel mi hrekkhat pawl cu Judah ram sungah a umter ih anmah hotu ah Gedaliah a tuah, tikha Moab ram, Ammon ram, Edom ram le ram dangdangih a tlanmi Israel mi pawl in an thei."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah an tlannak ram ciar ihsin an tho ih Judah ram ah an kir. Gedaliah hnenah Mizpah ahcun an ra ih cutawkah sabit le thingrah tampi an khawm ciamco."},"13":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Johanan le remnak a tuah duh lotu ralkap hotu pawl Gedaliah hnenah Mizpah ah an ra ih,","title":"Gedaliah An That (2 Sian. 25.25-26)"},"14":{"text":"A hnenah, “Ammon siangpahrang Baalis in nangmah that dingah Ishmael a thlah, ti na thei lo maw?” tiah an ti. Asinain Gedaliah cun a zum lo."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Johanan in Gedaliah cu a thupte in, “Ishmael cu keimah in ka that pei ih a thattu zo a si ti zohman in an thei lo ding. Nangmah thah dingah ziangah so kan zohsawh men ding? A lo that ngaingai tla si bangsehla nangmah a ra lo pantu Judah mipawl hi hmunkip ah ṭhekdarh an si lala ding ih Judah ramih a taangmi mipi hrangah cun thil poimawh ngaingai a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Gedaliah cun, “Zianghman ti hlah; Ishmael ih thuhla na simmi hi thudik a si lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih kum thla sarih thla ah siangpahrang sungkhat a si mi, siangpahrang kut thuai ih bawi upa bik lakah pakhat a si mi, Elishama ih tesinfa Nethaniah ih fapa Ishmael cu minung pahra thawn Judah ram uktu Gedaliah tong dingah Mizpah ah a feh. An zatein hmunkhat ih rawl an hil tlang laiah,"},"2":{"text":"Ishmael le a minung pahra cun an ralnam an suah ih Gedaliah cu an that."},"3":{"text":"Gedaliah hnenih a ummi Israel mipawl le Babilon ralkap hrekkhat cutawkih a rak ummi pawl tla Ishmael in a thah ṭheh a si."},"4":{"text":"A thaisun ah, Gedaliah an thah kha zohman ih an theih hlanah,"},"5":{"text":"Shekhem, Shiloh le Samaria ihsin minung sawmriat an ra thleng. An khabe hmul meet in le an hnipuan thlek in anmah le anmah an sun an at-aw ih Biakinn ah sangphut le rimhmui pe dingah a rami an si."},"6":{"text":"Ishmael cun ṭap phah in Mizpah ihsin a va hmuak hai. An hnen a thlen tikah, “Gedaliah tong dingah cun rung uh,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Khawpi an rung luh tikah Ishmael le a minung pawl cun an rak that hai ih an ruak cu tikhur sungah an hlon ṭheh a si."},"8":{"text":"Asinain anmah lakah minung pahra in Ishmael hnenah cun, “In that hram hlah aw; sangvut le fangtlor le olif hriak le khuaitizu pawl hramlak ah thuhmi kan nei,” tiah an leem. Curuangah that loin a zuah hai."},"9":{"text":"Ishmael in a thahmi pawl ih ruak an hlonnak tikhur cu a tumpi a si ih Israel siangpahrang Baasha in siangpahrang Asa a rak do laiah siangpahrang Asa in a rak laihmi tikhur a si. Ishmael in cuih tikhur cu miruak in a khatter ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Cule Babilon ralkap pawl hotu ralbawi Nebuzaradan in Gedaliah kilkhawi dingih a retmi siangpahrang fanu pawl le Mizpah khua ih mipi pawl cu thawng ah a thlak ṭheh. Cupawl cu Ishmael in salah a kaih ih Ammon ram lam ah a tlanpi ṭheh."},"11":{"text":"Ishmael ih thilsual a tuahmi cu Johanan le amah thawn a ummi ralkap hotu ralbawi pawl in an theih tikah,"},"12":{"text":"ralkap thawn an dawi ih Gibeon ih tili tumpi kiangah an man."},"13":{"text":"Ishmael ih sal kaihmi pawl in Johanan le amah thawn a rami ralbawi pawl cu an hmuh tikah an lung a awi ngaingai."},"14":{"text":"An let kir ih an hnenah cun an ra tlan."},"15":{"text":"Asinain Ishmael le a minung pariat cu Johanan ih kaih ngah lo in an tlan suak ih Ammon ram ah an thleng."},"16":{"text":"Cule Ishmael in Gedaliah a thah hnuah Mizpah ihsin sal ih a kaihmi ralkap pawl siseh, nunau le nauhak pawl siseh, tilper mipawl tiangin Johanan le ralbawi pawl cun ṭhatein an zoh."},"17":{"text":"Asinain Babilon siangpahrang in Judah ram uktu ah a tuahmi Gedaliah kha Ishmael in a thah ruangah Babilon mi ṭihnak an thinlung sungah a khat. Curuangah Babilon mi ṭih ah Izipt ram ah an tlan. Lamzin ah Bethlehem khua kiangah Khimham ah an cawl.","merge":"18"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun ralkap hotu pawl hmuahhmuah le Kareah ih fapa Johanan le Hoshaiah ih fapa Azariah le mipi pawl a tum a seen in ka hnenah an ra ih,","title":"Mipi In Jeremiah Thlacam An Fial"},"2":{"text":"annih in, “Kan lo dilmi hi in tuahsak hram aw. Bawipa kan Pathian hnenah kan hrangah thlacam hram aw. A nungmi kan zate hrangah hin thla in cam sak aw. Tuih hlanah cun minung kan tamzet, a sinan atu-ah cun in hmuh vekin mi malte lawng kan taang a si."},"3":{"text":"Kan fehnak ding lamzin le kan tuah dingmi thil kan hmuh theinak dingah Bawipa kan Pathian hnenah thla in cam sak hram aw,” tiah in ra dil."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah kei in, “A ṭha; nan dil vekin Bawipa kan Pathian hnenah cun thla ka cam ding. A simmi hmuahhmuah cu ka lo sim ṭheh ding; zianghman ka suup lo ding,” ka ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule annih in, “ Bawipa kan Pathian in kan hrangih thu a lo pekmi kan thlun duh lo a si ahcun Bawipa cu in dodaltu sisehla kan parah thu theitu dikzet le felzet si hram seh!"},"6":{"text":"A hnenah thlacam sak dingih kan lo dil ruangah kan duh ah siseh, duh lo ah siseh, Bawipa kan Pathian ih thu cu kan ngai ding. A thu kan ngai asile kan lamzin a tluang ding a si,” tiah in ti."},"7":{"text":"Ni hra hnuah Bawipa ih ṭong cu ka hnenah a rung thleng.","title":"In Jeremiah Ih Thlacamnak A Let"},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Johanan le a hnen ih a ummi ralkap hotu pawl le misenpi pawl cu ka ko."},"9":{"text":"An hnenah, “A hnenah dil dingih in thlahmi Bawipa Israel ih Pathian in nan hnenah,"},"10":{"text":"‘Hi ram sungih um nan duh ahcun ka lo siatsuah lo ding, ka lo tungding sawn ding; ka lo phawi lo ding, ka lo phunhnget sawn ding a si. Nan parih ka thlentermi siatralnak hin ka thin in natter zo a si."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah Babilon siangpahrang cu ṭih nawn hlah uh. Nan hnenah ka um ih a cahnak huham sungin ka lo run ding."},"12":{"text":"Zaangfah thinpemnak neitu ka si ruangah nan parah zaangfahnak ka neihter ding ih nan khua le nan ram ah a lo kirter ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,’ a ti."},"13":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla nannih Judah ram ih a taangmi pawl in Bawipa nan Pathian thu cu nan el lo pei ih hi ram sungih um khal nan nuar lo pei. Nannih in ‘Asilo, Izipt ram ah kan feh ding ih kan vung um sawn ding. Izipt ram ahcun ral kan do nawn lo ding, raldo ding kawhnak aw tla kan thei lo ding ih kan ril tla a rawng lo ding,’ nan ti lo pei. Nan ti a si ahcun Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in, ‘Izipt ram ah feh in a um nan tumtah hrimhrim a si ahcun,","merge":"14"},"16":{"text":"nan ṭih zetmi ral in a lo man ding. Nan phan zetmi rilrawnnak cun a lo thlun ding ih Izipt ram ah nan thi ding."},"17":{"text":"Izipt ram ah feh in um a tum hrimhrimtu pawl cu ral kut in maw, paamnak in maw, a si lole natnak in maw an thi ṭheh tengteng ding. Zohman an nung lo ding. An parih ka thlenter dingmi siatralnak in zohman an luat lo ding,’ a ti."},"18":{"text":"“ Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in, ‘Ka thinhengnak le ka ai-thawhnak cu Jerusalem khuami parih burh a si vekin Izipt ram ih nan feh a si ahcun nan parah burh a si ve ding. Midang pawl mithmuh ah tuksumza nan si ding. Mi ih puahcokmi ah nan cang ding ih nan hmin cu midang siatcamnak ah an hmang ding. Cule hi ram hi nan hmu sal nawn lo ding,’ a ti,” tiah ka sim."},"19":{"text":"Cuih hnuah hiti in ka sim beet sal, “ Bawipa in Judah ram ih a taangmi nannih pawl cu Izipt ram ih feh lo dingin a lo sim zo. Atu ah ralrinnak ka lo pek."},"20":{"text":"Nan feh a si ahcun nan ti sualzet ding a si. Bawipa kan Pathian hnenah nan hrangih thlacam sak dingin in dil ih a thupek mi hmuahhmuah tuah dingah thu nan kam aw."},"21":{"text":"Atute ah ka lo sim ṭheh. Asinain Bawipa kan Pathian in i simtermi hmuahhmuah nan el thluh fawn."},"22":{"text":"Curuangah ciing ṭha uh: Um nan duhnak ram ah feh tahrat in ral in maw, rawl loin maw, a si lole natnak in maw nan thi ding a si,” ka ti."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa an Pathian in an hnenah sim dingih i fialmi hmuahhmuah cu misenpi hnenah ka sim ṭheh.","title":"Izipt Ah Jeremiah An Thlenpi"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Hoshaiah ih fapa Azariah le Kareah ih fapa Johanan le mi puarthau pawl in, “Na thuphan a si. Bawipa kan Pathian in Izipt ram feh lo dingah le um lo dingih sim dingah a lo thlah lo a si."},"3":{"text":"Babilon mi pawl in kan tlunah thu an neih ih in thah theinak dingah, a si lole Babilon ih in fehpi theinak dingah Neriah ih fapa Baruk in thusia a lo forh a si,” tiah in ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuticun Judah ram sungih um dingah Bawipa ih thupekmi cu Johanan in siseh, ralbawi pawl in siseh, misenpi pawl khal in siseh, zohman in an thlun duh lo."},"5":{"text":"Cule Johanan le ralbawi pawl in Judah ramih a taangmi pawl hmuahhmuah le ṭhekdarh ṭheh an sinak ram ihsin a ra kirtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu Izipt ram ah an fehpi."},"6":{"text":"Mipa, nunau, nauhak le siangpahrang fanu pawl tla an fehpi ṭheh. Gedaliah ih kilkhawi dingah Babilon ralkap hotu ralbawi Nebuzaradan ih a retmi hmuahhmuah pawl le, Baruk le keimah tiangin in hruai ṭheh a si."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupekmi cu ngai loin Izipt ram Tahpanhes khua tiang an vung feh a si."},"8":{"text":"Cutawkah Bawipa in ka hnenah,"},"9":{"text":"“Lungto tum pipi la awla hi khawpi sung acozah inn luhnak hmai ih lamzin phah mi phahlei thuai ah phum aw; cuti na tuah cu Israel mi hrekkhat in lo hmu hai seh."},"10":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian keimah in i riantu Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar cu hi hmunah ka runter ding ih cuih na phummi lung tumpipi parah cun a siangpahrang tokham a hung ding ih an tlunah a siangpahrang puanthlam a zaar ding, ti thu sim aw."},"11":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar a ra ding ih Izipt cu a neh ding.
