Natnak in thi dingih ruahciami pawl cu natnak in an thi ngaingai ding; sal kaih dingih ruahciami pawl cu sal kaihmi an si ngaingai ding; ral kut in thi dingih ruahciami pawl cu ral kut in an thi ngaingai ding."},"12":{"text":"Izipt ram khawzing pawl ih biakinn pawl cu meisa in ka ur ding. Babilon siangpahrang in an khawzing pawl cu meisa in a ur ding, a si lole a phurhlo ding. Tuukhal in a hnipuan par ih hrik a lak ṭheh ih a faiter vekin Babilon siangpahrang in Izipt ram cu a faiter ding ih nehtu a si hnuah Izipt ram ihsin a feh sal ding."},"13":{"text":"Izipt ram Heliopolis ih a zarhmi lungto phunmi pawl cu a balcim ṭheh ding ih an khawzing biakinn pawl cu a ur ṭheh ding a si,” tiah ka ti."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Izipt ramsung Migdol khua, Tahpanhes khua, Memfis khua le Izipt ram thlanglam ih a um Israel mi hmuahhmuah thu ah Bawipa in ka hnenah, hiti in a sim.","title":"Izipt Ram Ih Israel Mi Hnenah Pathian Ih Thucah"},"2":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian cun, “Jerusalem khawpi parah le Judah ram khua hmuahhmuah parah siatsuahnak ka thlentermi cu nan mit rori in nan hmu zo. Atu khalah hnawmpen bangtuk an si hrih ih milai zohman an um lo."},"3":{"text":"Ziangah cutin a cang tile thilsual an tuah ih ka thin in hengter ruangah a si. Nanmah in siseh, nan pupa pawl in siseh, nan biak dah lomi khawzing nan rian ih khawzing dangdang hnenah raithawinak nan pek a si."},"4":{"text":"Nan hnenah cat loin keimah riantu profet pawl ka thlah ih hi bangtuk thil ka huat zawng hi tuah lo dingah an lo sim."},"5":{"text":"Asinain an thu cu nan ngai lo ih zianghman ah nan siar lo. Thilsual nan tuahmi khawzing dangdang hnenih raithawinak pek cu nan bang cuang lo."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah ka thinhengnak le ka ai-thawhnak cu Judah ram ih khua pawl parah le Jerusalem khawpi sung lamzin parah ka run burh ih meisa in ka ur. Khuarop ah an cang ih ṭihnungza hmun ah an cang. Tuihsun tiang cutin an um lai."},"7":{"text":"“Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian keimah in, ziangah so hibangtuk thilsual hi nan parah nan thlenter duh rero, tiah ka lo sut. Siatsuahnak hi mipa, nunau, nauhak le naute pawl par tiang minung pakhat hman taang nawn lo tiangin nan thlengter duh maw si?"},"8":{"text":"Nan rung umnak hi Izipt ram sungah hin khuazing dangdang hnenah raithawinak pe tahratin le milem pawl be tahratin ziangah so ka thin in hengter? Leilung tlun mi hmuahhmuah ih puahcok dingah le nan hmin hi mi camsiatnak ih hman dingah nanmah le nanmah siatsuah awk ṭheh nan tum maw si?"},"9":{"text":"Judah ram ih khua pawl sungah le Jerusalem khawsung lamzin par in nan pupa pawl le Judah siangpahrang le an nupi pawl le nanmah le nan nupi pawl ih thil ṭha lo nan rak tuahmi pawl kha nan hngilh ṭheh zo maw si?"},"10":{"text":"Cubangtuk a si naón tuihsun tiangah thinlung neemnak nan nei hrih lo; Keimah upatnak le ṭihzahnak zianghman nan nei lo ih nanmah le nan pupa pawl hnenih ka pekmi daan vekin nan nung duh fawn lo."},"11":{"text":"“Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah, Israel ih Pathian in ka lo ral ding ih Judah ram cu ka siatter ṭheh ding."},"12":{"text":"A taangsun Judah mi pawl, Izipt ram ah vung feh ih vung um a tum ṭengṭengtu pawl cu an zatein an cemral ṭheh ding. An zatein a tum a seen in Izipt ram ah ral kut in maw, rawl loin maw, an thi ṭheh ding a si. Mi hmuh ah tuksumza an si ding; hmuhsuam mi ah an cang ding ih an hmin cu mi camsiatnak le mi sulhnak ah an hmang ding."},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem ka hrem zo vekin Izipt ram ih a ummi pawl cu raldonak le paamnak le natnak in ka hrem ding."},"14":{"text":"A taangsun Judah mipawl, Izipt ram a thleng mipawl cu minung pakhat hman a nungmi le a luatmi an um lo ding. Kirsal in um leh an duhzetnak Judah ram ah zohman an kir thei lo ding. Ral tlanmi pahnih khat siar le zohman an kir lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cule mipa pawl, an nupi pawl ih khawzing dangdang hnenah thawinak an pek ti a theitu pawl le cutawkih a dingtu nunau hmuahhmuah le Izipt ram thlanglam ih a ummi Israel mipawl tiang mi tamzet an zatein ka hnenah an ra ih,"},"16":{"text":"“ Bawipaió hmin in in simmi thu hmuahhmuah cu kan ngai duh lo a si."},"17":{"text":"Kan tuah ding kan timi hmuahhmuah cu kan tuah ko ding. Kan khawzing nu Vancung Khumpinu hnenah raithawinak kan pe ding ih kanmah le kan pupa pawl in siseh, kan siangpahrang pawl le in hotu pawl in siseh, Judah ram khua pawl le Jerusalem khua lamzin parih an rak tuah zo vekin raithawinak ih pekmi sabitti cu a parah kan burh ko ding. Cuti kan rak tuah lai ahcun rawl kan paṭha ih mineinung kan si ih zianghman harsatnak kan tong lo."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Vancung Khumpinu hnenah thawinak kan pek nawn lo hnu le a hnenih pekmi sabitti kan burh nawn lo hnu ahcun ziang hmuahhmuah kan tlasam ih kan minung pawl cu ral kut in le rawl loin an thi ciamco a si,” tiah in ti."},"19":{"text":"Cuih tlunah nunau pawl in, “Vancung Khumpinu hmuihmel cuangin sang kan rawh ih a hnen ih thawinak kan pekmi sabitti pawl kan burh tikah kan pasal pawl cu kan tuahmi parah an lung a hmui ngaingai a si,” tiah in ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutiih i sawntu mipa le nunau pawl hnenah cun kei in,"},"21":{"text":"“Nanmah le nan pupa pawl in siseh, nan siangpahrang pawl le nan hotu pawl in siseh, mipi pawl khal in siseh, Judah ram khawsung ah le Jerusalem khua lamzin parih thil nan tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu Bawipa in a thei lo ih a theih hmanah a hngilh zo tiah maw si nan ruat?"},"22":{"text":"Tuihsun tiangah nan ram cu hnawmpen in a um ih milai zohman an um lo a si. Tuksumza ah an cang ih nan thilsual tuah mi le thil ṭha lo nan tuahmi pawl cu Bawipa in a zawi thei nawn lo ruangah nan ram cu a ṭhing ih mi in siatcamnak ah an hmang a si."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupekmi nan thlun lo ih khawzing dangdang hnenih raithawinak nan pek ruangah hi bangtuk siatralnak nan parah a thleng a si,” tiah ka ti."},"24":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel Pathian ih ṭongmi cu Izipt ram ih a ummi Judah mi pawl hnenah ka sim. A hleice in nunau pawl hnenah ka sim a si: “Nanmah le nan nupi pawl in Vancung Khumpinu hnenah siatcam in thukamnak nan tuah. A hnenah thawinak pe dingin le sabit thawinak pekmi a par ih burh dingih thukamnak nan tuah ih nan thukammi vekin nan tuah ngaingai. A ṭha; nan thukamnak cu thlun uh. Siatcam ih nan thukammi vekin tuah ṭheh ko uh.","merge":"25"},"26":{"text":"Sikhalsehla keimah Bawipa in Izipt ramih a ummi Israel mipawl nan hnenah, a makzetmi ka hmin in siatcam in thu ka kammi hi ngaihnik uh: Ka hmin saal tahratin, ‘A nungmi Cungnungbik Bawipa hmin in thu ka kam aw,’ tiah zohman in nan ti nawn lo pei."},"27":{"text":"Ka mithmuh ah neinung in nan um nawn lo ding; siatsuah mi nan si sawn ding. Mi pakhat hman taang lo tiangin ral kut in maw, paamnak in maw, nan thi ṭheh ding a si."},"28":{"text":"Asinain mi malte lawng thi loin nan luat ding ih Izipt ram ihsin Judah ram ah nan kir ding. Cutik lawngah zo ih ṭong so a dik sawn, keimah ih ṭong maw, nanmah ih ṭong so, tikha a taangsunmi malte cun an thei leh ding."},"29":{"text":"Hi hmunah hin ka lo hrem ding ih nan parah siatralnak ka thlenter ding ti ih ka thukamnak a kim ding a si, ti langternak ah keimah Bawipa in khihhmuhnak ka lo pe ding."},"30":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Zedekiah cu amah thah a duhtu a ral Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar kut sungih ka pek vekin Izipt siangpahrang Hofra cu a ral le amah thah a duhtu pawl ih kut ah ka pe ding a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah ih fapa Jehoiakim in Judah siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum li kum ah Baruk in ka auh-mi ca cu a ngan. Cule a hnenah,","title":"Baruk Hnenih Pathian Thukamnak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa , Israel Pathian ih ṭongmi cu ka sim, “Baruk,"},"3":{"text":"nang cun ‘Ka bei a dong zo. Bawipa in ka harsatnak hmuahhmuah tlunah riahsiatnak a beet sinsin a si. Ka ai-hramnak ruangah ka bang ih ka vuai ṭheh zo. Colh damnak ka ngah lo,’ na ti."},"4":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla keimah Bawipa cun ka sak ciami ka bal ṭheh ih ka phun ciami ka phawi ṭheh sal. Leilung pumpi hi cuti cun ka tuah ding a si."},"5":{"text":"Na hrangah a hleice ih nunnomnak na hawl duh maw si? Hawl duh hlah! Miphun kip parah siatralnak ka thlenter ding. Asinain nang cu na fehnak kip ah thi loin na luat ding. Bawipa Keimah in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in miphun pawl ih thuhla ka hnenah a sim.","title":"Karkhemish Ah Izipt A Sung"},"2":{"text":"Izipt thu in a thok. Jehoiakim in Judah siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum li kumah Eufrates Tivapi kiang Karkhemish khua ah Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Izipt siangpahrang Neko cu a neh ih Izipt ram thu ah Bawipa in hiti in a ti."},"3":{"text":"“Izipt ralbawi pawl cu an au, ‘Nan ralphaw tiar cia in um uhla, raldonak hmun ah feh uh!"},"4":{"text":"Nan rang pawl timtuah uhla a parah to uh! Artlang in ding uhla nan thir lukhuh khum uh! Nan feipi tat hriam uhla, nan thir angki pawl hruk uh,’ an ti."},"5":{"text":"“Asinain ka hmuhmi hi ziangso a si? Thinphang in dung ih an kir ka hmu. An ralkap pawl dunglamah an rak nor ka hmu! An ṭih tukah an tlan thei tawp in an tlan. Dunglam an hoikir nawn lo."},"6":{"text":"Asinain tlan cak pawl khal an tlan suak lo. Ralkap pawl cu an luat cuang lo. Saklam ah Eufrates tiva kiang ah cun an sawn ih an ril."},"7":{"text":"Nail tiva vekih a ṭhang ciamco hi zoso a si? Tikap tlun tiangih a liammi tiva bangin!"},"8":{"text":"Izipt a si, Nail vekih a ṭhang ciamcotu cu! A kap tlun tiangih a liammi tiva bangin. Izipt cun ‘Ka ṭhang dingih leilung pumpi ka khuh ṭheh ding; Khawpi hmuahhmuah ka siatter ṭheh ding. A sungih ummi minung pawl thawn!"},"9":{"text":"Rang pawl feh dingah thu pe uh, Rangleeng pawl tla tlan vutvo dingah! Ralkap pawl kuat uh, Sudan le Libia ram ralkap pawl, ralphaw keng phah in feh hai seh! Lidia ih conkiang sai thiam pawl tla,’ an ti.”"},"10":{"text":"Tuihsun hi a maksak mi, Cungnungbik Bawipa ih ni a si. Tuihsun ah phu a la ding. Tuihsun ah a ral pawl a hrem ding a si. A ralnam cun a ei ding ih a puar zet ding; An thisen a in ding ih a khop zet ding. Tuihsun ah Cungnungbik in thawinak a pek a si; Saklam ram Eufrates tiva kap ahcun!"},"11":{"text":"Maw Izipt mipawl, Gilead ah feh uhla damnak sii va hawl uh! Nan sii pawl cu santlai lo an si; Zianghman in a lo damter thei lo."},"12":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah in na ningzah nak an thei zo. Na ṭahnak cu leilung pumpi ah a thang. Ralkap pakhat cu a dang ralkap par ah a sawn. An pahnih in leilung ah an tlu."},"13":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar cu Izipt do dingih a ra thlen tikah Bawipa ih ṭong cu ka hnenah a thleng:","title":"Nebuchadnezzar A Ra Thleng"},"14":{"text":"“Izipt khua pawl hnenah than aw, Migdol, Memfis le Tahfanhes hnen ahcun; ‘Tho uhla ṭang ṭha uh; Nan neihmi pawl cu raldonak ah, siatsuah ṭheh an si ding!"},"15":{"text":"Ziangah so nan khawzing maktak Apis cu a tluk? Bawipa in a vuak thlak ruangah,’ ti aw."},"16":{"text":"Nan ralkap pawl cu an sawn ih an tlu. Pakhat le pakhat an biak aw ih, ‘Zamrang uh, kan suahnak ram le kan minung hnenah kir uhsi; Kan ral pawl ih ralnam ihsin kan tlan pei,’ an ti."},"17":{"text":"“Izipt siangpahrang hnenah hmin thar pe uh; ‘Tikcu ṭha A Luantertu Pontam Pa!’ ti uh."},"18":{"text":"Cungnungbik keimah Bawipa hi siangpahrang ka si. Keimah hi a nungmi Pathian ka si. Tlang dang hnakin Tabor Tlang a saan bangin, Tifinriat tlun ih Karmel Tlang a din bangin, Nangmah a lo dotu ih cahnak cu a si ding."},"19":{"text":"Maw Izipt mipawl, salkaih hruaihlomi si dingah tiar aw uh. Memfis khua cu nelrawn ah a cang ding. Zohman um duh lonak ramṭhing ah!"},"20":{"text":"Izipt cu caw thau zet a bang. Asinain saklam ihsin tur nei thothe in a do ih a hen."},"21":{"text":"Hlawh pekmi ralkap pawl hman cu, caw faate bangin ziang ṭhahnem lo an si. Ṭang tahratin raldotu zohman an um lo. An zatein an let ih an tlan hlo; An vanduai ni a ra thleng zo. An siatralnak caan cu!"},"22":{"text":"Izipt cu thawm neizet in a tlan hlo, Rul vekih thlik phah in, Ral pawl an ra thlen tikah cun! Hreitlung thawn an ra do, Thingkung an hau theh ih;"},"23":{"text":"Tupi thing an ṭhiam ṭheh vekin, An minung cu siar cawk lo an si, An ral pawl cu sihte hnakin an tam sawn."},"24":{"text":"Izipt mipawl cu ningzak in an um, Saklam mi pawl in an neh. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo.”"},"25":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa Israel ih Pathian in, “Thebes khua ih an khawzing Amon cu Izipt le a khawzing pawl le a siangpahrang pawl thawn ka hrem ding. Izipt siangpahrang le amah a rinsantu pawl hmuahhmuah cu ka lak ding ih,"},"26":{"text":"Anmah thah a duhtu Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar le a ralkap kutah ka pe ding. Asinain neta lam ahcun Izipt ram sungah khuahlan ih mi an rak um vekin an um sal ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"27":{"text":"“Ka minung pawl, ṭih hlah uh; Israel mipawl, nan thinphang hlah uh. Thawng nan tlaknak ram hlapi ihsin kan lo run ding. Nan kirsal dingih hnangamte in nan um ding. Him zetin nan um ding ih, zohman in an lo ṭihter lo ding.","title":"In A Minung A Run Ding"},"28":{"text":"Nan hnenah ka ra ding ih ka lo hum ding; Ka lo ṭhekdarhnak ram le miphun pawl cu ka siatsuah ding. Asinain nannih cu ka lo siatsuah lo ding. Hrem lo cun ka lo thlah men lo ding; Asinain ka lo hrem tikah, dikzet in ka lo tuah ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo.”"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Izipt siangpahrang in Gaza a do hlan ah Bawipa in Filistin ram thuhla i sim;","title":"In Filistin Thuhla A Sim"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Zohhnik! Saklam ah tidai a ṭhang ciamco; Tilian bangin tiva kap ah a liam ding. Leilung le a par ummi hmuahhmuah a khuh thluh ding; Khawpi le a sung ummi milai pawl tla a khuh ding; Cupawl in bomnak duh ah an au ding. Leitlun mi hmuahhmuah nasa zetin an ṭap ding an ai ding."},"3":{"text":"Rangcang pawl ih ke vuak thawm an thei ding; Rangleeng tlan thawm le lengke ril thawm tla. Pale pawl in an faale pawl bawm dingah an kir hnawh lo ding. An kut cu an siir ah tha nei loin an thlai-aw ding."},"4":{"text":"Filistin ram siatsuahnak tikcu a ra thleng zo, ṭai-ar le Sidon ihsin bomnak an ngahsunmi sahtannak tikcu cu! Keimah Bawipa in Filistin pawl ka siatter ding, Krete tikulh ihsin a rami pawl cu!"},"5":{"text":"Gaza mi hnenah riahsiatnak tumpi a ra thleng; Ashkelon mi pawl cu an dai ziarzi. Ziangtik tiangso Filistin ram hrekkhat pawl cu mithi ngai in an um ding?"},"6":{"text":"‘ Bawipa ih ralnam, Ziangtik tiangso mi na saat vivo hrih ding? Na kawm sungah kir sal awla, cutawkah daiteón um thlang aw,’ tiah na au!"},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ziangtinso daiteón a um thei ding? Tuah ding ṭuanvo ka pek hnu ahcun? Ashkelon do dingah le tipikap ih a ummi pawl saat dingah thu ka pek zo a si,” a ti."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in Moab ram thu ah hiti in a sim: “Nebo khuami pawl cu zaangfakza an si! An khawpi a siatral zo! Kiriathaim khua cu lak a si zo; An ralhruang bal ṭheh a si zo; An mipawl cu mualpho in an um.","title":"Moab Ram Siatralnak Ding"},"2":{"text":"Moab ram sunlawinak a cem zo; Ral pawl in Heshbon khua an lak; Moab miphun siatsuah ṭheh dingin an ngaihtuah. Madmen khua cu a ṭhing reprep ding, Ralkap pawl in an ciil ṭheh ding."},"3":{"text":"Horonaim mipawl cu, ‘Siatsuahnak, Thisen luannak,’ tiah an au!"},"4":{"text":"“Moab cu a siat ṭheh zo; Nauhak ṭah thawm cu ngaihnik uh!"},"5":{"text":"An ai thawmvang cu ngaihnik uh, Lamzin thlun in saklam ah Luhith tiang a thang. Ninghan riahsiatnak ai-thawm cu ngaihnik uh, Thlanglam ah Horonaim tiang a thang."},"6":{"text":"‘Zamrang in, luat dingah tlan uh, Nelrawn ih laak lauzet bangin tlan uh,’ an ti."},"7":{"text":"“Maw Moab, na cahnak le na lennak na rinsan; Asinain atu-ah nehmi na si thlang ding. Na khawzing Khemosh cu sal taannak hmun ah a feh ve ding. A bawi pawl le a puithiam pawl thawn."},"8":{"text":"Khua pakhat hman siatral loin a luat lo ding. Phairawn le hmunrawn tiangin an siat ṭheh ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo."},"9":{"text":"Moab hrangah lungphun phun uh, Tuan ah siat ṭheh a si thlang ding. A khawpi pawl cu khawrop ah an cang ṭheh ding. Zohman an um sal nawn lo ding.”"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnaṭuan ah a muangcaangtu cu siatserh siseh! Mi a saat lotu le a that lotu cu siatserh siseh!"},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Moab cu himzet le daizetin a um ringring. Ral kaihmi a si dah lo. Moab cu beel pakhat in a dang pakhat ah tleng reromi sabitti vek a si lo. Zohman ih puah lomi a hran vekih retmi sabitti bangtuk a si. A rim a siat dah lo ih a thaw ringringmi sabitti vek a si.","title":"Moab Khua Pawl Siatsuahnak"},"12":{"text":"“Asinain a tu-ah mi ka thlah ding ih Moab cu an thlet hlomi sabitti bangin an thlet hlo tikcu a ra thleng ding. A sabitti an thlet hlo ding ih a beel cu cip seksek in an khuai ṭheh ding."},"13":{"text":"Cule Israel mipawl in an rinsan zetmi an khawzing Bethel cu a kim lo le zahpi tlak ih an theih vekin Moab mipawl khal in an khawzing Khemosh cu a kim lo le zahpi tlak in an thei ding."},"14":{"text":"“Maw Moab mipawl, ziangah so mi ralṭha le raldo thiam kan si tiah nan puar thau rero?"},"15":{"text":"Moab le a khua pawl cu siatsuah ṭheh an si ding; An tlangval ṭha bik pawl tla thah ṭheh an si. Keimah hi siangpahrang ka si, Cungnungbik Bawipa ka si. Keimah in ka sim zo."},"16":{"text":"Moab ram ih vanduai ni a nai zo, A siatral ni a thleng cing ding."},"17":{"text":"“Hi miphun hrangah ṭap uh, A kiangkap ih a umtu pawl, A hmin thannak a theitu pawl khal ṭap uh. ‘A nasa zetmi a mi uknak a cem zo, A sunlawinak le a cahnak a um nawnta lo,’ ti uh."},"18":{"text":"Nannih Dibon khuami pawl, Nan sunlawinak hmun ihsin ṭum uhla leivut lakah to uh. Moab siatsuahtu a ra zo. A ruhkulh pawl hnawmpen ah a canter ṭheh zo."},"19":{"text":"Nannih Aroer khua a ummi pawl, Lamzin kiangah ding tahrat in hngak uh; An khua a tlansantu pawl hi sut uh; Ziangvek thil so a thleng ti sut uh."},"20":{"text":"‘Moab cu a tlu zo,’ tiah an lo sim ding; ‘A hrangah ṭap uh, mualpho in a um zo; Moab cu a siat ṭheh zo, Arnon Tivapi tluan ah than uh,’ an lo ti ding."},"21":{"text":"“Tlangpar ih a ummi khua pawl parah thuṭhen ni a thleng zo. Cuih khua pawl cu Holon, Jahzah, Mefaath,"},"22":{"text":"Dibon, Nebo, Beth Diblathaim,"},"23":{"text":"Kiriathaim, Bethgamul, Bethmeon,"},"24":{"text":"Kerioth, le Bozrah khua an si. A hlat siseh, a nai siseh, Moab ram ih khua hmuahhmuah parah cun thuṭhennak a thleng zo a si."},"25":{"text":"Moab ih ki cu sahtan ṭheh a si zo; a cakmi a baan tla an khiak ṭheh zo. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Moab kha ri-ter uh, ziangahtile keimah dodaltu a si. Moab cu amah ih luak lakah a lawngtaal ding ih mi in an hnihsan ding.","title":"Moab Cu Ningzak In A Um Ding"},"27":{"text":"Maw Moab, hnihsuahsainak men ih Israel na rak hman kha na ciinglai maw? Fifir an kaih ih an tisiat bangin Israel na tisiat a si kha!"},"28":{"text":"“Moab ram ih a ummi pawl, nan khua pawl tlansan uh! Feh uhla khukhaam lakah va um uh. Khukhaam kiangkap ih bu a saktu thuro bangin um uh."},"29":{"text":"Moab cu a hngalzet. A minung pawl an hngalzia, an puarthau le an zum awkzia le ziangvek in an ruat-aw ti ka thei ṭheh."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa keimah rori in an hngalnak cu ka thei a si. A puarthaunak cu zianghman a si lo; an thil tuahmi tla rei a daih lo ding."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah Moab ram sung mi hmuahhmuah le Kir Heres mi hrangah ka mitthli a tla ding."},"32":{"text":"Jazer mipawl hrang hnakih na deuh in Sibmah mipawl hrangah ka ṭap ding. Maw Sibmah khua, Rili Thi le Jazer tiang a ruang a thleng mi sabit hri vek na rak si. Asinain atu ahcun ṭhal caan ih na rah le na rah ding hmuahhmuah khal siat ṭheh an si zo."},"33":{"text":"Lungawinak le thinnomnak cu Moab ram ṭha sung ihsin laksak ṭheh a si. Sabit rialnak hmun ihsin sabitti luang nawn loin ka phit ṭheh. Sabit tuahtu le lungawi in a autu zohman an um nawn lo."},"34":{"text":"Heshbon le Elealeh khuami pawl an ṭap ih, an ṭah aw cu Jahaz tiang a thang. Zoar khuami tla in an thei ih, Horanaim le Eglath Shelishiyah khua pawl tiang a thang a si. Nimrim Tiva hman a kang thluh zo."},"35":{"text":"Moab mipawl cu an khuavang biaknak hmun ah mei-ur thawinak pe thei lo le an khawzing pawl hnenah hlannak pe thei loin ka kham ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo."},"36":{"text":"“Curuangah cawnglai tum phah ih mithi phumnak hla satu bangin Moab le Kir Heres mi hrangah ka thinlung mitthli a tla, ziangahtile an neihmi hmuahhmuah a cem thluh zo."},"37":{"text":"An zatein an sam le an khahmul an met. An zatein an baan an sat ih buri hnipuan an hruk ṭheh."},"38":{"text":"Moab ram sungih inn par hmuahhmuah ah le khawkip ih khawhnar pawn ah mithi ngainak lawng a khat, ziangahtile Moab cu zohman ih duh lomi beel kuai siava bangin ka khuai ṭheh zo a si."},"39":{"text":"Moab cu a siatdarh ṭheh zo! ṭap in ai uh! Moab mualpho in a um zo. Hnawmpen ah a cang zo. A kiangkap miphun pawl in hnihsuahsainak ah an hmang a si. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Bawipa in hiti in a sim cia: Moab cu miphun phunkhat in khaupi bangin a thla phar tahrat in a nam ding ih,","title":"Moab Hrangah Luatnak A Um Lo"},"41":{"text":"Khua pawl siseh, ruhkulh pawl siseh, a lak ṭheh ding. Cuih ni ahcun Moab ralkap pawl cu nau neizik nunau bangin thinphang in an um ding."},"42":{"text":"Ka parah hngalzet ih a um ruangah Moab cu siatsuah ṭheh a si ding ih miphun phunkhat a si nawn lo ding."},"43":{"text":"Moab cu tuksumnak, khur thukpipi le mi awktu thang pawl in an bawh. Cucu Bawipa ih ṭong a si."},"44":{"text":"Tuksumnak ihsin tlanhlo a tumtu cu khur sungah an tla ding. Khur thuk sung ihsin suak tahratin a tlantu pawl cu thang in a awk ding. Ziangahtile Bawipa in Moab siatsuah dingah ni a khiah cia zo."},"45":{"text":"Bawmtu nei lo raltlan pawl cu siangpahrang Sihon in a rak ukmi Heshbon khawsung ah himnak an hawl. Asinain meisa in cuih khua cu a kang ṭheh. Raldo hiarzet Moab mi pawl ih ram le tlang saangpipi pawl an kang ṭheh zo a si."},"46":{"text":"Moab mi pawl cu zaangfakza an si! Khemosh khawzing a biatu pawl cu siatralnak an tong ih an fanu le an fapa pawl cu ralkaih thawng thlakmi ah an cang zo."},"47":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hmailam tikcu caan ahcun Bawipa in Moab cu neinungzet ah a tuah sal ding. Himi cu Bawipa ih ṭongmi a si ih Moab parah a kim ding a si."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ammon ram ih thu ah Bawipa in hiti in a sim, “Israel mipawl khuiah so an si? An ram a humtu zohman an um lo maw? Ziangah so Gad ram cu Molek khawzing a biatu pawl an lakter ih an luahter?","title":"Ammon Parih Thuṭhennak"},"2":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Rabbah khawpi ih a ummi pawl in raldonak thawmvang an theihnak tikcu ka thlengter ding ih an khawpi a siatral ding ih an khawte pawl tla ciam ko in ur ṭheh an si ding. Cutikah an rak lon ciami ram cu Israel mi pawl in an longkir ding."},"3":{"text":"Maw Heshbon mipawl, ṭap in ai uh! Ai khua cu a cem zo a si! Maw Rabbah nunau pawl, ṭap in ai rero uh! Buri hnipuan hruk uhla mithi ngai in um uh! Tawivak in suk le so ah tlan uh! Nan khawzing Molek cu a puithiam pawl le a bawi pawl thawn ralkaih mi sal ah an cang ding."},"4":{"text":"Nannih rintlak lo pawl, ziangah so tluang nan khawn ciamco? Nan cahnak a cem zo a si. Ziangah so nan cahnak ring tahratin zohman in in tawng ngam lo ding, tiah nan ti?"},"5":{"text":"Nan kimvel in tuksumza ka suahter ding. Nan zatein nan tlanhlo ṭheh ding. Zokhal luat duh ah nan tlan ding ih nan ralkap pawl a kokhawmtu zohman nan um lo ding."},"6":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla netalam ahcun Ammon ram cu neinungzet ah ka canter sal ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in Edom thu ah hiti in a sim: Edom mi pawl hi thudik an ruat thei nawm lo maw si? An thuronmi pawl in ziangtuah ding an sim thei lo maw si? An fimnak hmuahhmuah a cem ṭheh zo maw si?","title":"Edom Ram Parih Thuṭhennak"},"8":{"text":"Maw Dedan mipawl, her uhla tlan uh! Relh uh! Esau tesinfa pawl ka siatsuah ding, ziangahtile anmah ka hremnak tikcu a ra thleng zo."},"9":{"text":"Mi in sabit rah an lawh tikah a hri parah malte tal an hlah; rukru pawl in zanih mi an ram tikah an duhmi thil lawng an lak."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Esau tesinfa pawl cu an tak lawng in ka ret; an relhnak hmun khal ihsin ka phorhsuak ih an relh thei nawn lo. Edom mi hmuahhmuah an hloral ṭheh zo a si. Mi pakhat hman an taang nawn lo."},"11":{"text":"Nupa nei lo ngakṭah pawl ka hnenah tanta uh, ka kilkhawi ding. Nan nuhmei pawl khal in in ring thei ding a si."},"12":{"text":"“Hremnak a tuar lo ding pawl hman ih hremnak khuat hai an in a si ahcun hrem lo ih luat dingah nan ruat aw maw si? Sihlah! Cuih khuat hai cu nan in tengteng pei!"},"13":{"text":"Keimah rori in Bozrah khawpi cu mi hmuh ah tuksumza le ramṭhing ah a cang ding. Khawte hmuahhmuah cu kumkhua in an siatral ta ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Kei in, “Maw Edom, Bawipa hnen ihsin thu ka ngah. Miphun pawl in an ralkap timtuah in nangmah do dingih tiar dingah palai an thlah zo."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in a lo ṭawnṭaiter ding ih zohman in an lo upat lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Na hngalnak hi a lo bumtu a si. In ṭih hmang na ti vek hin zohman in an lo ṭih lo. Lungto khukhaam saangpi le tlang saangpi zim ah na um; muvanlai tlukih hmunsang ih na um hmanah Bawipa in a lo dirthla ding. Bawipa in a sim zo a si,” ka ti."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Edom parih a thleng dingmi siatsuahnak cu a nasa tuk ding ih a kiangih a fehtu hmuahhmuah an mangbang in an ṭih ding."},"18":{"text":"Sodom le Gomorrah parah le a kiangkap khua pawl parih a thleng mi thil ṭihnung cu Edom par khalah a thleng ding. Cuih hmunah minung zohman an um sal nawn lo ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo."},"19":{"text":"Jordan Tiva kap tupi sungih sin suak tahratin ṭilva tlannak lenkolh ih a hung suakmi kiosa bangin keimah ka ra thleng ding ih rinlopi in Edom mipawl cu an ram ihsin ka tlanhloter ding. Cule hotu ka hrilmi in ram cu a uk ding. Keimah thawn ṭhim ding zoso a um? Keimah i zuam ngamtu zoso a um? I dodal ngamtu uktu zoso a um?"},"20":{"text":"Curuangah Edom mipawl siatsuahnak ding ka tummi le Teman khua sung mipawl ziangtluk in tisiat ka tum tikha ngaihnik uh! An faate pawl hman caihhlo an si ding ih mi hmuahhmuah an tuk a sum ding."},"21":{"text":"Edom a tluuk tikah cun a thawm a nasa tuk ding ih leilung pumpi hman a hnin ṭheh ding. Ṭihphannak awn-au thawm cu Agaba Tikel tiang a thang ding."},"22":{"text":"Khaupi in ar a nam bangin Bozrah cu ral in an nam ding. Cuih ni ah Edom ralkap pawl cu nau neizik nunau bangin thinphang in an um ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa in Damaskas thu ah hiti in a sim: “Thusia an theih ruangah Hamath le Arpad khawsung mipawl cu donhar le thinphang in an um. Thinharnak in tipi bangin a khuh ih colhdamnak an ngah thei lo.","title":"Damaskas Parih Thuṭhennak"},"24":{"text":"Damaskas mi pawl cu an ṭawnṭai ih thinphang in an tlanhlo. Nau neizik nunau bangin mangbang vansaang le harsa in an um."},"25":{"text":"Khua nuamzet le khua hminthangzet cu ṭiosan ṭhehmi khua ah a cang."},"26":{"text":"Cuih ni ah an tlangval pawl cu khawsung lamzin ah thah an si ding ih a ralkap pawl cu an siatral ṭheh ding."},"27":{"text":"Damaskas kulhnak ralhruang pawl cu meisa in ka ur ding ih siangpahrang Benhadad inn pawl cu ciamko in ka ur ṭheh ding. Keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar ih nehmi Kedar hrin le Hazor ih ukmi peng pawl thu ah Bawipa in hiti in a sim: “Kedar mi pawl khi do uhla nisuahnak lam hrin cu siatsuah uh!","title":"Kedar Hrin Le Hazor Khua Parih Thuṭhennak"},"29":{"text":"An puanthlam le an tuu rual pawl, an puanthlam puanzar pawl le an puanthlam sungih a ummi thilri hmuahhmuah long ṭheh uh. An kalauk pawl hruai uhla mipi hnenah, ‘Nan kiangkap khuazakip ah ṭihphannak a um,’ ti uh."},"30":{"text":"“Hazor mi pawl, keimah Bawipa in ralrinnak ka lo pe: Tlan uhla relh uh. Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in a lo phiar ih hiti in a ṭong:"},"31":{"text":"‘Ra uh, kan him a si tiah a ruattu pawl kan do ding. An khawpi cu kotka a nei lo; tawhkalh hrennak khal a nei lo ih zohman in an kilveng lo a si,’ a ti."},"32":{"text":"“An kalauk le an caw pawl la uh! An sam tawite ih a mettu pawl cu hmunkip ah ka ṭhekdarh ding ih hmunkip ihsin an hnenah siatralnak ka thlenter ding."},"33":{"text":"Hazor cu kumkhua in hmunṭhing ah ka tuah ding ih cinghnia lawng umnak hmunah a cang ding. Cuih hmun ah minung zohman an um sal nawn lo ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"34":{"text":"Zedekiah cu Judah siangpahrang a can ṭheh vete in Elam ram thu ah Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka hnenah a sim:","title":"Elam Ram Parih Thuṭhennak"},"35":{"text":"“Elam ram a caktertu conkiang saithiam pawl kha ka that ṭheh ding."},"36":{"text":"Hmunkip ihsin Elam parah thlipi ka hranter ding ih hmunkip ah a minung pawl cu ka ṭhekdarh ṭheh ding. A minung raltlan pawl an thlen lonak ram pakhat hman a um lo ding."},"37":{"text":"Anmah thah a tumtu an ral pawl kha an ṭih ding ih Elam mi thinlung ah ṭihnak ka umter ding. Ka thinheng in Elam mipawl cu ka siatsuah ding ih an ci ka mitter lai hlanlo anmah dotu ah ralkap ka thlah ding."},"38":{"text":"An siangpahrang pawl le an hotu pawl ka hloralter ding ih an rak tonak hmunah ka siangpahrang tokham ka ret ding."},"39":{"text":"Asinain netalam ahcun Elam mipawl cu mineinung ka siter sal ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Babilon khawpi le a minung pawl thu-ah hi bangtuk in i sim:","title":"Babilon An Lak Ding"},"2":{"text":"“Mi phunkip hnenah hi thuthang cu sim awla than vivo aw. Thantar tuah awla tlang-aupi aw; Daite in umpi hlah. Babilon a tlu zo a si; A khawzing Marduk cu a kuai ṭheh zo! Babilon ih milem pawl cu ningzak in an um zo, Fihnungza an milem pawl cu rialdip ṭheh an si zo."},"3":{"text":"“Saklam ihsin miphun phunkhat Babilon do dingah a rung zo ih Babilon cu ramṭhingah a cangter ding. Milai le ṭilva pawl an tlan hlo ṭheh ding ih minung zohman an um lo ding,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Cuih tikcu a ra thlen tikah Israel le Judah mi pawl an ra ding ih Kei an Pathian hi ṭapphah in in ra hawl ding.","title":"Israel Kirnak Ding"},"5":{"text":"Zion fehnak lamzin an sut ding ih cuih lamzin in an ra ding. Kumkhua hrangin thukamnak keimah thawn an tuah ding ih ziangtik hmanah an siatbal nawn lo ding."},"6":{"text":"“Ka minung pawl hi tuukhaltu pawl in tlangsaang hramlakih an hlohtermi tuu bangtuk an si. A hlomi tuu vekin tlang pakhat hnu pakhat ah an vak ih an inn hman an thei nawn lo."},"7":{"text":"A hmutu hmuahhmuah in an do ih an that. An ral pawl in, ‘An tlannak tlimno a si mi le an pupa pawl ih an ruahsanmi an Bawipa hnenih an sual ruangah hi bangtuk thil kan tuah mi hi kan sual lo a si,’ an ti."},"8":{"text":"“Maw Israel mipawl, Babilon ihsin tlan uh. Hiram hi tlansan uh! A tlan hmaisabiktu si uh!"},"9":{"text":"Saklam ih a ummi miphun pawl ka tokhrok ding ih Babilon ka doter ding. Hiram do dingah an tiar-aw ding ih an neh ngaingai ding. Sakah thiam pawl an si ih conkiang in hmui an bat tikah a ṭhelh dah lo pawl an si."},"10":{"text":"Babilon cu an siim ding ih a siimtu pawl cun an duhmi hmuahhmuah an long ṭheh ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Babilon mipawl, ka miphun nan siim. Cutikah nan lung a awi ih nan ai a puang. Fangrialtu cawcang vekin le a feh phah in a ai mi rangcang bangin nan feh.","title":"Babilon Ih Tluknak Ding"},"12":{"text":"Asinain nanmah ih khua, khawpi nasazet cu, ningzak le mualpho in a um ding. Babilon hi miphun hmuahhmuah lakah a ṭawnṭai bik miphun ah a cang ding. Ramcaar le tidai um lonak nelrawn ah a cang ding."},"13":{"text":"Ka thinhengnak ruangah Babilon ah minung zohman an um lo ding. Khawrop ah a cang ding ih a kiangih a fehtu hmuahhmuah cu mangbang le khawruahhar in an um ding."},"14":{"text":"“Conkiang saithiamtu pawl, Babilon do dingah tiar-aw uhla kulh ṭheh uh. Nan conkiang thawn Babilon cu sai uh. Ziangahtile Bawipa keimah parah an sual a si."},"15":{"text":"Babilon khawpi kimvel in raldo au in au uh. Babilon a sung zo! Khawkulhnak phardawl cu an bal ih an cim ṭheh zo. Babilon mi parah phu ka la a si. An parah nan phu la uhla midang an tuah vekin anmah parah tuah ve uh."},"16":{"text":"Hiram sungah thlaici tuh si hlah seh; rawl lak ti khal um hlah seh. Ramdangmi a rak ummi pawl in Babilon a dotu ralkap pawl an ṭih ding ih an khua le an ram ah an kir sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel mipawl cu kiosa ih dawimi le ṭhekdarhmi tuu vek an si. Hmaisa ah Assiria siangpahrang in a nam ih neta ah Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in an ruh a ṭam a si.","title":"Israel Kirnak Ding"},"18":{"text":"Cuih ruangah keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in Assiria siangpahrang ka hrem zo vekin siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar le a ram cu ka hrem ding."},"19":{"text":"Israel mipawl cu an ram ah ka tlungter ding. Karmel Tlang le Bahan ram ih a khomi rawl pawl an ei ding ih Efraim ram le Gilead ram ihsin a suakmi rawl cu an duhzat in an ei ding."},"20":{"text":"Cuih tikcu a thlen tikah cun Israel ram ah sualnak a um lo ding ih Judah ram ah thil ṭha lo a um lo ding. Ziangahtile an nunnak ka zuahmi pawl cu an sualnak ka ngaithiam ṭheh ding a si. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Merathaim mi le Pekod mipawl do uh. That uhla siatsuah ṭheh uh. Ka thupekmi vekin tuah ṭheh uh. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo.","title":"Babilon Parih Pathian Thuṭhennak"},"22":{"text":"Hiram ah raldonak thawm a thang ih siatsuahnak nasazet a um."},"23":{"text":"Sobul a si mi Babilon in leilung pumpi hi sop ṭheh ko in a deng. Asinain atu ahcun cuih sobul cu a kiak ṭheh zo! Hiram parih a thlengmi thil an hmuh tikah mi hmuahhmuah an mang a bang."},"24":{"text":"Maw Babilon, keimah i rak do. Asinain na theih loin thang ka rak kam ih cuih thang cun a lo awk a si."},"25":{"text":"Ka hriamnam retnak inn ka ong ih ka thinheng in ka hriamnam cu ka suah hai. Ziangahtile a maksak bikmi Cungnungbik keimah Bawipa in Babilon ah thil tuah ding ka nei a si."},"26":{"text":"Hmunkip ihsin do uhla a rawl retnak inn pawl cu bauh ṭheh uh. Nan lonmi pawl cu rawl bangin vuun liailiai in khawl uh. An ram cu siat ṭheh uh. Zianghman zuah hlah uh."},"27":{"text":"Ralkap hmuahhmuah that uh. That ṭheh hai uh. Babilon mipawl an cem a si. Hremnak an tuar tikcu a ra thleng zo,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Babilon ihsin raltlan a luatmi pawl Jerusalem ah an ra thleng ih, Bawipa ih Biakinn parah ih thil an rak tuah sualmi ruangah Babilon mipawl parah Bawipa kan Pathian in ziangvek in phu a lak, ti kha an ra sim."},"29":{"text":"“Babilon do dingah conkiang saithiam pawl sim uh. Li le thal a hmang thiamtu hmuahhmuah feh ṭheh uh. Babilon khawpi cu kulh theh uhla zohman luat hlah hai seh. Thil a rak tuahmi vekin leh ruul uh. Midang parih a tuah vekin a parah tuah ruul ve uh; ziangahtile Israel mipawl ih A thianghlim Keimah parah hngalzet in hna a ṭuan a si."},"30":{"text":"Curuangah a tlangval pawl khawpi lamzin ah thah an si ding ih a ralkap pawl hmuahhmuah cuih ni ah siatsuah ṭheh an si ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo."},"31":{"text":"“Babilon, hngalnak in na khat a si; curuangah Ziangkimtithei Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka lo ral a si! Ka lo hremnak tikcu a ra thleng zo."},"32":{"text":"A puarthaumi na ram hi a sawn ding ih a tlu ding; zohman in an lo thawhsak lo ding. Na khua pawl cu meisa in ka ur ding ih a kiangkap thil hmuahhmuah cu an siatral ṭheh ding,” a ti."},"33":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in, “Israel mi le Judah mipawl cu namnuaimi an si. An kaih hai ih pakhat hman thlah loin an kil ṭhepṭhep."},"34":{"text":"Sikhalsehla anmah a runsuaktu ding cu a cakzet; a hmin cu Ziangkimtithei Bawipa a si. Amah rori in an thu cu a dinpi ding ih leilung parah daihnak a thlenter ding. Asinain Babilon mi hnen ahcun buainak a thlenter ding,” a ti."},"35":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Babilon ah ralnam a thleng; Thihnak cu a minung pawl, a mi uktu le a mifim pawl parah a thleng a si!"},"36":{"text":"Ralnam cu thuphanpertu, a profet pawl parah a thleng. Ziangtluk mi aa so an si. Thihnak cu a ralkap pawl parah a thleng; Ziangtluk in so an tuk a suum."},"37":{"text":"A rang le a rangleng pawl siat suah uh. A saancopmi a ralkap pawl parah thihnak a thleng; An ṭawnṭaihzia cu! A sumsaw le a hlawnthil siatsuah ṭheh uh; Long uhla ram ṭheh uh!"},"38":{"text":"A leilung le tiva pawl khal caar thluh hai seh. Babilon cu ṭihnungza milem an umnak ram a si; A minung pawl an lung a molhter ṭheh zo."},"39":{"text":"“Curuangah Babilon cu khawsia le ramhuai le a thianglo vate pawl ih umnak ram ah a cang ding. Milai an um nawn lo ding. Ziangtik san hmanah an um dah lo ding."},"40":{"text":"Sodom le Gomorrah ka siatsuah ih a kiangkap khua pawl ka siatter ṭheh vekin Babilon par khalah a thleng ding. Cuih hmunah milai zohman an um nawn lo ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo."},"41":{"text":"“Saklam ih a ummi ram ihsin milai an ra; a hlatzet le ram cakzet ihsin. Raldo dingah siangpahrang tampi an tim aw."},"42":{"text":"An li le thal le an ralnam pawl an pai; Mi zaangfah nei lo le mi thinsia pawl an si. Tifinriat thlipi thawm bangtuk an si, An rang an to tikah cun! Raldo dingah an tiar aw, Babilon do dingah cun!"},"43":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang cu a kut a zawng ṭheh; Cuih thu a theih tikah cun! Donharnak le thinharnak in a khat, Nau neizik nunau na bangin."},"44":{"text":"“Jordan Tiva kap tupi sung ihsin suak tahratin ṭilva tlannak lenkolh ih a hung suakmi kiosa bangin Bawipa keimah ka ra ding ih rinlopi in Babilon mipawl cu an khawpi ihsin ka tlanhloter ṭheh hai ding. Cule hotu dingih ka hrilmi in an ram cu a uk ding. Keimah thawn ṭhim ding zoso a um? Keimah i zuam ngamtu zoso a um? I dodal ngamtu uktu zoso a um?"},"45":{"text":"Curuangah Babilon khawpi siatsuah ding ka tummi le an minung pawl ziangtlukin tisiat ka tum daan hi ngai hnik uh! An faate pawl hman dir hlo an si ding ih mi hmuahhmuah an tuk a suum ding."},"46":{"text":"Babilon a tluuk tikah cun a thawm a nasa tuk ding ih leilung pumpi a hnin ṭheh ding. An thinphannak awn-au cu miphun dang pawl in an thei ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Babilon le a minung pawl parah siatsuahtu thlipi ka ratter.","title":"Babilon Parih A Dang Thuṭhennak"},"2":{"text":"Thlipi in fanghi a semhlo bangin Babilon siatsuahtu dingah ramdangmi ka thlah ding. Cuih siatsuahnak ni a thlen tikah cun hmunkip in an do ding ih an ram cu kolh ṭheh in an tuah hnuah an taanta ding."},"3":{"text":"An ralkap pawl conkiang sainak tikcu pe hlah uh. An thir angki hruknak tikcu khal pe hlah uh. Tlangval a si ti ah zohman zuah hlah uh. An ralkap zatein that ṭheh uh."},"4":{"text":"Hriamhma an pu ding ih an khua pawl ih lamzin ah an thi ding."},"5":{"text":"Israel ih A thianghlim Keimah parah an sual zo naón Bawipa , Ziangkimtithei Pathian keimah in Israel le Judah mi pawl cu ka dungtun hrih lo a si."},"6":{"text":"Babilon ihsin tlanhlo uh. Luat dingah tlan uh. Babilon sualnak ruangah thahnak tuar duh hlah uh. A parah phu ka la ih a tuar ding zat in ka hrem a si."},"7":{"text":"Babilon cu ka kut sungih sui khuat hai, leilung pumpi a ritertu bangtuk a si. Mi phunkip in a zu an in ih an thinlung a molh ṭheh zo."},"8":{"text":"Babilon cu rinlopi in a tlu ih a siatral ṭheh zo. Ṭah ciamco uh. A hma hnih dingah sii hawl uh. A dam sal tla a si thei men."},"9":{"text":"Cutawkih a ummi ramdangmi pawl in, ‘Babilon kan bawm tum naón a tlai tuk zo. Fehsan uhsila kan ram le kan khua ah tlung uhsi. Pathian in a cahnak hmuahhmuah thawn Babilon cu a hrem ih a siat ṭheh zo a si,’ an ti,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka minung pawl in ‘ Bawipa in kan diknak a langter zo. Feh uhsila Bawipa kan Pathian ih thil tuahmi cu Jerusalem mi hnenah sim uhsi,’ tiah an au,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in Babilon siatsuah a tum ruangah Media siangpahrang pawl a tokhrok hai. A Biakinn an siatter ruangah cuvekin phu a la tum a si. Ralkap pawl hotu ralbawi cun, “Nan conkiang tathriam uh. Nan ralphaw keng uhla tiar cia uh!"},"12":{"text":"Babilon khawkulhnak phardawl do dingah theihternak pe uh. Ral kiltu thlah beet uh. Kilvengtu ret uh. Ral bawhtu ding thlah uh!” a ti. Bawipa in Babilon mi parih ka tuah ding a timi cu a tuah zo."},"13":{"text":"Khi ram ah tiva tampi le sumsaw tampi a um; asinain tikcu a nei nawn lo; a nunnak hri cu sahtan a si zo."},"14":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in Babilon do dingah minung tam ngaingai, sihte zat ka run thlah ding ih ralnehnak thawn an au ding, tiah amah ih nunnak saal in thu a kam zo."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in leilung hi a huham in a tuah; A fimnak in lei hi a seemsuah ih, van khal a pharh a si.","title":"Pathian Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"16":{"text":"Amah ih thupeknak in van tlun ih tidai a huuk; Vanhram deng ihsin khawdur a rak keng. Ruah lakah nimthla a kauter ih, a thil retnak inn ihsin thli a run kuat."},"17":{"text":"Cumi an hmuh tikah minung cu, zianghman an thei lo ih mi-aa vek an si. Milem a tuahtu pawl cu, beidong le ninghang in an um. Ziangahtile an tuahmi an khuavang pawl cu nunnak nei lo, a lem lawng an si."},"18":{"text":"Zianghman ih ṭhahnem lo an si ih, hmuhsuam tlak an si; An siatral ṭheh ding; Bawipa a rat ih a hrem tikah cun!"},"19":{"text":"Jakob ih Pathian cu cubangtuk a si lo; Amah cu ziang hmuahhmuah tuahtu a si. Israel mipawl cu Amah ih tabul si dingah a hril a si; Amah ih hmin cu Ziangkimtithei Bawipa a si."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Babilon, nang cu ka sobul na si; Ka raldonak hriamnam na si. Miphun le uknak tampi sutkuainak ah ka lo hmang.","title":"Ih Sobul"},"21":{"text":"Rang le a totu pawl sutbalnak ah, Rangleeng le a mawngtu pawl sutkuainak ah,"},"22":{"text":"Nunau le mipa thahnak ah, Mino le upa thahnak ah, Fala le tlangval thahnak ah,"},"23":{"text":"Tuukhal le an tuu pawl thahnak ah, Lothlo le an leilehnak caw pawl thahnak ah, Uktu le bawi pawl thahnak ah,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Jerusalem parih thilsual an tuah ruangah Babilon le a minung pawl hnenih phu ka lak kha nan hmu ding.","title":"Babilon Hremnak"},"25":{"text":"Maw Babilon, nang cu leilung pumpi a siatsuahtu tlangsaangpi vek na si; sikhalsehla Bawipa keimah hi na ral ka si. Ka lo kaihrem ding ih leilung ah ka lo hlon ding ih vutcam ah ka lo canter hnuah ka lo tlansan ding."},"26":{"text":"Khawrop ah na cang ding ih na lungto pakhatte hman inn saknak ah hman sal a si nawn lo ding. Kumkhua in nelrawn ah na cangta ding a si. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo."},"27":{"text":"“Raldo dingah theihter hminsinnak pe uh! Miphun pawl ih theih dingah tawtawrawt tum uh. Babilon do dingah miphun pawl timtuah uh. Raldo dingah Ararat ram, Minni ram le Ashkenaz ram pawl sim uh. Raldo hotu dingah ralbawi pakhat hril uh. Kharbok rual tamzet bangin raldonak rang pawl khal rak keng uh."},"28":{"text":"Babilon do dingah miphun pawl timtuah uh. Media siangpahrang pawl, an hotu le an bawi pawl, an ralkap le an ukmi ram hmuahhmuah ko ṭheh uh."},"29":{"text":"Leilung pumpi cu a khur ih a hnin ciamco. Ziangahtile Babilon ram cu nelrawn ah canter ih zohman um lonak ramṭhing ih canter dingah Bawipa in a tumtahmi a tuahsuak zo a si."},"30":{"text":"Babilon ralkap pawl cu raldo nawn loin an ṭannak ruhkulh sungah an cawl. An thin a nau zo ih nunau vek an si zo. Khawpi kotka pawl cu bal ṭheh an si ih inn pawl cu meisa in a kang ciamco."},"31":{"text":"Babilon khawpi cu hmunkip in an bal vivo zo a si, tiah Babilon siangpahrang sim dingah thuthantu pakhat hnu pakhat an tlan."},"32":{"text":"Ral pawl in tiva tannak hmun cu an lak zo ih ruhkulh pawl cu meisa in an ur a si. Babilon ralkap pawl cu uk thei an si nawn lo ih sukso ah an vakvai."},"33":{"text":"Reilote ah ral pawl in an saat thluk ding ih fangcilnak hmun ih fang an pal bangin leilung ah palcih an si ding. Keimah Ziangkimtithei Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in, Jerusalem cu a saattan ih a ei. Tidai retnak beel bangin a thlet ṭheh. Sahrang bangin a dolh ṭheh a si. A duhmi lawng a lak ih, a dang cu a hlonhlo."},"35":{"text":"Zion mi pawl in, “Kan thisen an luanter ruangah, Babilon mipawl in tuar hai seh,” ti hai seh. Jerusalem mipawl in, “Harnak kan tuar ruangah hin, Babilon mi pawl cawh siseh,” ti hai seh."},"36":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in Jerusalem mi hnenah, “Nan thu hi ka dinpi ding ih nan parih thilsual an tuahmi ruangah nan ral pawl ka cawh ding. Babilon ram ih tidai dawhhna pawl ka caarter ding ih an tiva pawl ka kangter ding.","title":"In Israel A Bawm Ding"},"37":{"text":"Khi ram cu hnawmpen ah ka cangter ding ih hramlak ramsa umnak lawngah a cang ding. Zoh ngam lo dingah a cang ding ih a hmutu hmuahhmuah an tuk a suum ding."},"38":{"text":"Babilon mipawl cu kiosa bangin an huuk ding ih kiosa no bangin an ai ding."},"39":{"text":"Mi hamṭam pawl an si maw? Rawl ei puai ka tuahsak ding ih zu an ri ding ih lungnuam in an um ding. An it that ding ih an ṭhang nawn lo ding."},"40":{"text":"Tuufaate, me le tuucang an that vekih thah dingah ka hruaihlo ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Bawipa in Babilon thu ah hiti in a sim: “Leilung pumpi ih porhmi khawpi cu ral in an lak zo. Mi phunkip hmaiah Babilon cu tuksumza ah a cang zo.","title":"Babilon Ih Tuarmi"},"42":{"text":"Tipi in Babilon a khuh ih tilet cu a parah a huuk ciamco."},"43":{"text":"A dang khua pawl cu zoh duh-awk lo ah an cang ih zohman um duh lonak, pal duak ding hmanah duh lo dingmi, nelrawn caar ah an cang."},"44":{"text":"Babilon ih khuavang Beel cu ka hrem ding ih a rak rukmi thilri pawl ka khirhter ding. Miphun pawl in an bia nawn lo ding. Babilon kulhnak phardawl pawl an tlu zo."},"45":{"text":"Israel mipawl, tlan thluh uh. Nun nan duh a si ahcun ṭihnungza ka thinhengnak hi tlansan uh."},"46":{"text":"Nan theihmi thawmvang ruangah ṭih hlah uh. Nan thin khal nau hlah seh. Kumtinte thu dangdang, ram sungah thah awknak le siangpahrang pakhat le pakhat an do-aw ti thu a thang."},"47":{"text":"Curuangah Babilon ka tisiatnak tikcu a ra thleng ding. Ram pumpi cu ningzak le mualpho in ret a si ding ih a minung pawl cu thah an si ding."},"48":{"text":"Saklam ihsin siatsuah dingih a rami minung pawl kut sungih Babilon a tluk tikah cun lei le van ih um ziang hmuahhmuah cu lungawi in an au ciamco ding."},"49":{"text":"Leilung pumpuluk ah mi tampi Babilon in a thihter; atu-ah Babilon cu Israel mi tampi a thihter ruangah a tlu ve thlang ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"50":{"text":"Bawipa in Babilon ih a minung pawl hnenah, “Thihnak ihsin nan luat zo! Atu feh uh! Zianghman hngak hlah uh! Nan khua le nan ram cu a hlazet naón Bawipa keimah hi in thei uhla, Jerusalem khal ciing uh!","title":"Babilon Ih Ummi Israel Pawl Hnenah Pathian Thucahmi"},"51":{"text":"Nannih in ‘Ningzak le mualpho in kan um zo. Ramdangmi pawl in Biakinn sung hmun thianghlim pawl cu an lak ṭheh zo ih zianghman ti theimi kan nei lo,’ nan ti."},"52":{"text":"Curuangah ka lo sim: Tikcu a ra thleng ding ih Babilon milem pawl ka siatsuah ṭheh ding. Hmapu pawl cu ram sungah an ai an kio ding."},"53":{"text":"Babilon cu van ah kai thei tahrat in a khohzetmi ral ṭannak ruhkulh ralhruang va sak thei hmansehla cumi siatsuahtu dingah mi ka thlah thotho ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"54":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Babilon ihsin ṭahnak aw le, ramsung siatsuahnak ruangih riahsiat ṭah thawm cu ngai uh.","title":"Babilon Siatsuahnak Ding"},"55":{"text":"Babilon cu ka siatsuah ih, A thawmvang neihmi cu ka vuakdai a si. Ralkap pawl in a huuk reromi tilet bangin an nam ih, Ring zetzet ih au phah in an do."},"56":{"text":"Babilon siatsuah dingah an ra; A ralkap pawl an kai; An conkiang pawl an khiak ṭheh; Miṭha lo a hremtu cu Pathian Keimah ka si; Babilon parah phu ka la ding."},"57":{"text":"A ram uktu pawl, a mifim pawl, a hotu pawl le a ralkap pawl zu ka riter ding. An it that dingih an ṭhang sal nawn lo ding. Keimah siangpahrang in ka sim zo. Ziangkimtithei Bawipa ka si."},"58":{"text":"A nasa zetmi Babilon ih phar pawl cu, leilung ah a cim ṭheh ding. A saangzetmi kotka pawl cu, meisa in a kang ṭheh ding. Miphun pawl ih hnaṭuanmi cu zianghman a si lo; An zonzaihnak hmuahhmuah cu, meisa hrang lawngah a si. Ziangkimtithei Bawipa Keimah in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"59":{"text":"Siangpahrang Zedekiah a bawmtu pakhat cu Seraiah a si. Seraiah cu Neriah fapa, Mahseiah fasuan a si. Zedekiah cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan kum linak ah Babilon ah a feh ih a hnenah Seraiah khal a feh ve. Cutikah Seraiah hnenah cun thu ka cah.","title":"Jeremiah Thucahmi Cu Babilon Ah An Kuat"},"60":{"text":"Babilon parah siseh, Babilon hrangih thu dangdang siseh, cabu sungah ka ngan. Siatsuahnak a thleng dingmi hmuahhmuah ka ngan ṭheh."},"61":{"text":"Seraiah hnenah cun, “Babilon na thlen tikah hi cazual sungih ka nganmi hmuahhmuah hi mipi hnenah va siar tengteng aw."},"62":{"text":"Cule Bawipa hnenah, ‘Maw Bawipa , hi hmun hi ka siatsuah ding ih kumkhua in ramṭhing ah a cang ding ih a nungmi thil, minung siseh, ramsa siseh, an um lo ding, tiah na sim zo,’ tiah thlacam aw."},"63":{"text":"Cule Seraiah, hi cabu hi mipi hnenih na siar ṭheh hnuah nangmah rori in lungto thawn ṭemcih awla Eufrates Tivapi sungah hlon aw."},"64":{"text":"Na hlon tikah, ‘Hi vekin Babilon parah a kim ding. Ti sungah a pil ding ih a suak sal nawn lo ding. Ziangahtile Bawipa in siatsuahnak cu Babilon parah a thlenter ding a si,’ tiah ti aw,” ka ti. Jeremiah ih ṭong cu hi hmuah hi a si."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah cu Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan tikah kum kul hluankhat a si ih Jerusalem ihsin kum hleikhat a uk. A nu ih hmin cu Hamutal a si ih Libnah khua ih ummi Jeremiah ih fanu a si.","title":"Jerusalem Tluknak (2 Sian. 24.18—25.7)"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jehoiakim vek thotho in siangpahrang Zedekiah khal Bawipa ih parah a sual."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu Jerusalem mi le Judah mipawl parah a thin a heng ngaingai ih a mit hmuhlonak hmunah a dawihlo hai a si. Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar do duh ah Zedekiah cu ral a tho."},"4":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar cu a ralkap thawn a feh ih Zedekiah siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum kua kum, thla hra thla, ni hra ni ah Jerusalem a do. Khawpi lengah riahbuk an sak ih khawpi phardawl leng ihsin a kimvel in leilung an dawl ih,"},"5":{"text":"Zedekiah siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum hleikhat kum tiang an kulh."},"6":{"text":"Cuih kum hleikhat kum, thla li thla, ni kua ni ah paam a nasat tuk ruangah khawsung mipawl zianghman ei ding an nei nawn lo."},"7":{"text":"Cule khawkulh phardawl cu an balcim ih Babilon ralkap pawl in Jerusalem khawpi cu an kulh ṭhepṭhep naón Judah ralkap pawl cu zan khawthim ah an rak tlanhlo ṭheh. Siangpahrang hmuan lakin an feh ih phar pahnih a pehtu kotka zin in an feh ih Jordan phairawn lam ah an tlan."},"8":{"text":"Asinain Babilon ralkap pawl in siangpahrang Zedekiah cu an dawi ih Jerikho khua kiang hmunrawn ah an kai ngah; a ralkap pawl in an tlansan ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Cule Zedekiah cu siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar hnenah an fehpi. Culai ah Nebuchadnezzar cu Hamath ram Riblah khua ah a um ih cutawkah Zedekiah ih thu cu a relsak."},"10":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in Riblah ahcun Zedekiah ih fapa pakhat cu a pa ih mithmuh rori ah a that; Judah ram bawi dangdang khal a that."},"11":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Zedekiah ih mit a phorh ih thir cikcin in a khih ih Babilon ah a kuat. Babilon ah Zedekiah cu a thih ni tiangin thawng sungah a um."},"12":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar ih Babilon siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum hleikua kum, thla nga thla, ni hra ni ah, siangpahrang hnenih ruahnak petu le a ralkap hotu ralbawi Nebuzaradan cu Jerusalem khua sungah a lut ih,","title":"Jerusalem Biakinn An Siatsuah (2 Sian. 25.8-17)"},"13":{"text":"Biakinn le siangpahrang inn le Jerusalem khawsung ih bawi upa pawl ih inn hmuahhmuah meisa in a ur ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"A ralkap pawl in khawpi kulhnak phardawl pawl an rak bal ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Cule Nebuzaradan in Jerusalem ih a taangmi minung pawl, zungthiam pawl le Babilon ralkap pawl hnenih a relhtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu Babilon ah a fehpi ṭheh."},"16":{"text":"Cule Judah ram ahcun mi farah bik pawl le thilri zianghman a nei lo pawl kha a taan ih lo hnaṭuantu dingah le sabit hmuan thlotu dingah a ret a si."},"17":{"text":"Babilon mi pawl in Biakinn sungih a ummi dar ih tuahmi ṭhuam pawl le leng pawl an denkuai ṭheh ih dar tikuang tumpi khal an siat ṭheh. A dang dar ih tuahmi thilri hmuahhmuah cu Babilon ah an phur ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Cule sawhleek pawl le biakṭheng thianfai tikih hmanmi vutcam khawlnak kheng pawl, meisa vanmi mei-inn ih thuam pawl, thawinak pek tikih sathi donnak maihum pawl, rimhmui ur tikih hmanmi khengkuum pawl le Biakinn sungih hmanmi dar thilthuam hmuahhmuah an lak ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Ngun le sui ih tuahmi thilri hmuahhmuah khal an lak ṭheh; pakan kuum pawl, meivam laknak kheng pawl, raithawi tikih sathi khawlnak maihum pawl, vutcam retnak kheng pawl, mei-inn ṭhuam pawl, rimhmui urnak kheng pawl le sabitti thawinak pek tikih sabitti thletnak maihum pawl khal an lak ṭheh a si."},"20":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon in dar ih a tuahmi thilri pawl: ṭhuam pahnih, leng pawl, tikuang tumpi le tikuang dotu cawcang hleihnih pawl cu cuai ih thlai theih lo ding in an rit."},"21":{"text":"Ṭhuam pahnih cu an bang aw; pakhat cu pi kul hluansarih a sang ih pi hleiriat a tum; a sung a kua ih a thir cu pi thum a sah. Ṭhuam ziik ah dar ih tuahmi lubo a um ih pi sarih le a hrek a sang; a kimvel ah taleti rah cuang in mawiternak sermi a um ih a zatein dar ih tuah ṭhehmi an si.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Cutiih mawiternak sermi taleti rah cu ṭhuam lu pakhat ah zakhat a um ih cuih sungah sawmkua le paruk cu leilung ihsin hmuh thei an si."},"24":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Babilon ralkap hotu ralbawi Nebuzaradan in Puithiam Sang Seraiah le puithiam sang sangtu puithiam Zefaniah le Biakinn ih bawi tumpipi pathum kha thawng thlak dingah a hruaihlo.","title":"Judah Mi Babilon Ah An Hruai (2 Sian. 25.18-21 , 27-30)"},"25":{"text":"Khawpi sungih ralkap pawl hotu ralbawi pakhat, khawpi sungih a taang hrihmi siangpahrang ruahnak petu sungin minung pasarih, ralkap zung ih cazin kaitu le ralbawi sangtu pakhat le mi upa deuhdeuh minung sawmruk tla a fehpi a si."},"26":{"text":"Nebuzaradan in Hamath ram, Riblah khua ih a rak ummi,"},"27":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang hnenah a hruai. Cutawkah Babilon siangpahrang in a thawiter ih a thahter hai. Cuticun Judah mi pawl cu an ram ihsin saltaannak ram ah hruaihlo an si."},"28":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in sal dingih a hruaihlo mi minung cazin cu a thuailam vekin a si: Siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum sarih kum ah minung thawng thum le kul hluan thum;"},"29":{"text":"A kum hleiriat kum ah Jerusalem ihsin minung zariat le sawmthum le pahnih;"},"30":{"text":"Kum kul hluanthum kum ah minung za sarih le sawmli le panga; an zate in minung thawngli le zaruk Nebuchadnezzar in a hruaihlo a si."},"31":{"text":"Evilmerodak cu Babilon siangpahrang a can kum ah Judah siangpahrang Jehoiakhin parih zaangfahnak a neih ruangah thawng inn ihsin a suah. Cutiih a suah cu Jehoiakhin thawng thlak dingih an hruaihlo hnu kum sawm thum le kum sarih kum, thla hlei hnih thla, ni kul hluannga ni ah a si."},"32":{"text":"Evilmerodak in Jehoiakhin cu ṭhatein a zoh ih Babilon ih thawng a tla vemi siangpahrang dangdang hnenih upatnak a pekmi hnakin tam sawn in upatnak a pek a si."},"33":{"text":"Cuti cun Jehoiakhin cu a zoh ṭha ih a thawng tlaknak hnipuan a thleng awkter ih a nunsung hmuahhmuah siangpahrang cabuai ah rawl a eiter."},"34":{"text":"A nun sung nitinte a ṭulmi leinak ih hman dingah Babilon siangpahrang in Jehoiakhin cu tangka a pek ringring."}}}}},"25":{"info":{"name":"Ṭahhla","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Ṭahhla (lamentations)"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem cu lungleng in a um, Mi phuntling an rak umnak khawpi cu! Leilung pumpi i an rak upatmi khawpi cu nuhmei vekah a cang zo! Lalnu vek a rak si mi khawlian cu, Salkaihmi ah a cang zo!","title":"Jerusalem Ih Riahsiatnak"},"2":{"text":"Zan khawvarte a ṭap thluahthlo maw; Mitthli a biang parah luang vivo maw! A rualpi zohman an um ta lo, A hneemtu ah pakhatte hman an um lo. A rak ṭantu pawl in an zuarthlai, Mi hmuah in atu ahcun an dodal."},"3":{"text":"Judah mipawl sal ah an cang, Hnaṭuan khung an ṭuan, Bawmtu nei loin; An hruaihlo hai an run inn ihsin; Miphun dang ram ah an um, Kan ta ti ding ram nei loin! Ral pawl in an kulh ṭheh hai, Luatnak lamzin nei loin."},"4":{"text":"Zion lamzin riahsia in a um, Zohman in an zawh nawn lo, Colh ni Pathian bia dingah. Hla saktu fala pawl harsatnak an tuar, Puithiam pawl an hruum an ai. Zion cu thinlung naa in a tuar, Khawpi kotka pawl an ṭhing."},"5":{"text":"A ral pawl an hlawh a tling, An kut sungah an huum. Bawipa amah in a tuarter, A sualnak a tamtuk ruangah. A faate pawl kaih ṭheh an si, Lam hlapi ah hruaihlo an si."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem ih sunlawinak cu, A cem zomi thil a si. An ṭawnṭai zet a hotu pawl cu, Rawl loih derdaimi zukneng vek an si; Thazaang zianghman an nei lo, Sakah thiam hmai ihsin an tlan tikah cun!"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem cu khawrop ah a cang, lungleng za in; A rak sunlawi zia a vun ciing sal ṭheu. A ral pawl ih kut sungah a thleng, Zohman bawmtu nei loin. A nehtu pawl cun an hnihsan, An hmuhsuam ciamco, a siatral tikah cun."},"8":{"text":"Hmaizah tlak a sinak cu a cem zo, A taklawng in a um ih an hmuhsuam. A ningna in a ṭap a ai, A ningzak in a hmai a hup. A mahte a borhhlawh awter, Jerusalem in ṭihnungza sualnak a tuah zo ruangah!"},"9":{"text":"A thianfai lonak cu a hni ah a lang; A hmailam thu cu a ruat dah lem lo. A siatnak cu ṭihnung za a si; Zohman in an hneem thei lo. A ral pawl in an neh zo; Zaangfah dil in Bawipa a ko."},"10":{"text":"A ral pawl in a thil an long ṭheh, A sumsaw hmuahhmuah tla cu! A mit rori in a hmu hai, Biakinn sung an luh lai cu. Zentail mipawl lut lo dingah, Bawipa ih a khammi hmun ahcun."},"11":{"text":"A minung pawl an hrum an ai; Ei ding pakhatkhat an hmuh tikah cun. An hlawnthil cu rawl ah an thleng, An pumpi nunnak dingah cun. “ Bawipa , i run zoh aw,” tiah an khawpi cu a au; “Ka harsat zia i run hmu aw!” a ti."},"12":{"text":"“I zohhnik uh,” tiah a au, A kiangih a fehtu hmuahhmuah hnenah cun. “Zohman in natnak an tuar dah lo, Kei ka tuarmi natnak tluk cun; Bawipa ih i pekmi natnak a si, Ka parih a thinheng tikah cun."},"13":{"text":"“Tlunlam ihsin meisa a run thlak, Ka ruh sungih a alh-mi meisa cu. Keimah awk dingah thang a kam ih, Leilung ah i tlukter. Cuticun i tlansanta ih, Cat loin natnak i tuarter."},"14":{"text":"“Ka sualnak hmuahhmuah cazin sungah a khum; A zatein hmunkhat ah a ṭem ih Ka hngawng ah i thlaih; A rit tukih i delh ciamco, Thazaang ka nei nawn lo. Bawipa in ka ral kut sungah i thlenter; Ka hrangah an cak tuk ih ka caang thei lo."},"15":{"text":"“ Bawipa ih hnihsanmi ah an cang, Ka ralkap cak bik pawl cu; A ralkap bur khat a kuat, Ka tlangval pawl that dingah. Sabit bangin ka minung pawl a rial hai, Judah fala note cu!"},"16":{"text":"“Curuangah a si kei ka ṭap, Ka mitthli rialti bangin a luang. Hnemtu zohman ka nei lo, Tha thotertu zohman an um lo. Ka ral in in neh ngah zo; Ka minung pawl zianghman an nei nawn lo."},"17":{"text":"“Bomnak duh ah ka ban ka pharh, Asinain zohman in in bawm lo. Bawipa in ral pawl a ko, Khawzakip in in fuuk. An lakah zianghman ka si lo, Fihnungza thil men ka si."},"18":{"text":"“Asinain Bawipa cu a dik, A thu eltu ka rak si zo ruangah. Maw miphun pawl, i ngaihnik uh; Ka tuarzia hi zohhnik uh. Ka leeng le val pawl an hlo zo, Salkaihnak hmun ram hlapi ah."},"19":{"text":"“I rak ṭantu pawl ka ko, Asinain in bawm duh lo. Puithiam le hotu pawl an thi, Khawpi sung lamzin tluan ah. An pumpi nun duh ih, Rawl an hawlnak ah."},"20":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , ka vansaanzia hi i zohhnik; Ka nunnak a tuarzia hi. Ka thin a na ih ka lung a kuai, Ka lo dodal sualnak ruangah. Lamzin parah thah awknak a um, Inn sung khalah thihnak a thleng."},"21":{"text":"“Ka aihramnak i ngai sak aw, I hneemtu zohman an um si lo. Ka ral pawl an di a riam, Ka parih siatralnak na thlenter ruangah. Na tiamcia ni cu thlenter zaang aw, Ka tuar vekin ka ral pawl tuar ve hai seh."},"22":{"text":"“An tuahmi hmuahhmuah na hmaiah lang ṭheh seh; An ṭhatlonak hmuahhmuah tla hi! Annih cu hrem hai aw, Ka sualnak ruangih i hrem zo vekin. Vansanglam in ka aihram, Ka thin a pit a si,” a ti."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Zion cu thimnak in a khuh; Bawipa a thin a heng ruangah. Israel ih sunlawinak cu, Van ihsin lei ah a run thlak; A Biakinn pi hman a dungtun, A thinheng ni ahcun.","title":"In Jerusalem A Hrem"},"2":{"text":"Judah ram khawte hmuahhmuah a siatsuah ṭheh, Zawnruahnak zianghman um loin. An ralhruang pawl a balsak ṭheh, An ram hum in an ṭannak ruhkulh pawl cu. Ningzah mualphonak a thlenter, An uknak le uktu pawl parah cun."},"3":{"text":"Israel cahnak a sattan ṭheh, A thin-ai a thawh tikah cun. A pharh cia a baan a zuuk sal, Ral pawl ih in ra do tikah cun. Meisa alh bangin kan parah a hlio ciamco, Ziang hmuahhmuah a siatsuah ṭheh."},"4":{"text":"A conkiang in kanmah in bat, Ral pawl ih in bah vekin. Amah in a that ṭheh hai, Kan hmai in hngaltertu hmuahhmuah cu. Hi Jerusalem khawpi sungah hin, A thinhengnak mei alh bangin kan tuar."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel a tisiat ṭheh zo, An do ral lian bangin. Hnawmpen ah a cangter ṭheh zo, An ruhkulh le an siangpahrang inn pawl cu. Cem neilo riahsiatnak a thlenter zo, Judah misenpi parah cun."},"6":{"text":"Sop seksek in a deengkuai theh, Amah kan biaknak Biakinn pi cu. Kan ulhmi ni pawl a cemter, Sabbath ni le ni thianghlim pawl cu. Siangpahrang le puithiam pawl khal in an tuar, Tuar harzetmi a thinhennak cu."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa in a biakṭheng a hnong zo, A Biakinn thianghlim hman a tlansan. Ral pawl a balsiatter ṭheh, Biakinn phar pawl cu. An ral nehnak an aupi ciamco, Lungawi in Pathian kan rak biaknak hmun ahcun."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in siatter dingah a tum hrimhrim, Zion kulhnak phar pawl cu. A hlan in a rak tah cia ṭheh zo, Siat ṭheh dingah a ui hrimhrim lo. Hmunkhatah hnawmpen ah an cang ṭheh zo; Donhleisang inn pawl le a phar pawl cu."},"9":{"text":"A kotka pawl hnawmpen sungah an pil ṭheh; A kothrolh pawl tla an kiak ṭheh. Salkaihmi thawng thlaknak ah an thleng ṭheh, Siangpahrang le bawi upa pawl cu. Daan cu zohman in an zirh nawn lo; Bawipa hnen in langnak an ngah nawn lo, profet pawl cun."},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem patar pawl cu, Leilung ah dai zirziar in an to. An lu ah vutcam an phulh aw, An ruangpi ah buri puan an khuh aw. Jerusalem fala pawl cu, Lei dai in an lu an kun."},"11":{"text":"Ka ṭahnak ah ka mit a kham ṭheh, Ka donhar ah ka thin a pit ṭheh; Ka riahsia in ka tha a celh ṭheh, Ka minung pawl vanduainak an ton ruangah. Nauhak le naute pawl khawpi lamzin ih an sawn an rilh ruangah."},"12":{"text":"Tihal le rilrawng in, An nu le pawl an ṭah. Lamzin parah cun an ril, Ral hmapu bangin. Nuamtete in an nunnak a cem, An nule pawl ih ṭaang parah cun."},"13":{"text":"Maw duhnungza Jerusalem, Ziang so ka ṭong nawn ding? Ziangtizawng in so ka lo hneem thei ding? Nang vekih a tuartu hi an um keel lo. Na hma hi tipithuanthum tluk in a thuk; Zoso a lo damter thei ding?"},"14":{"text":"Na profet pawl in lo sim ding an nei lo, thuphanper dah ti lo cu! An thusimmi in an lo bum, Na sualnak an phuang dah fawn si lo! Thudik lo an lo sim ruangah, Sirawknak ṭul lo ah na ruat-aw."},"15":{"text":"Na kiangih a fehtu pawl in, Hmuhsuam nautatnak thawn an lo zoh. An lu an thing ih an lo hnihsan, Jerusalem siatralnak cu. “Hihi maw khawpi mawi bik an timi cu? Leilung pumpi ih hmaihngalpimi cu hihi maw a si?” an ti."},"16":{"text":"Na ral pawl in an lo nautat, Huatnak mit thawn an lo zoh. An hmur ciip in an lo hnihsan, “Kan siatsuah ṭheh zo, Kan hngakhlapmi ni cu hihi a si,” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in a tisuak ngaingai zo, Ka tuah ding a rak ti ringring vekin. Zaangfahnak nei loin in tisiat ṭheh zo, Ralrinnak in rak pek cia vekin. Nehnak a pek hai, kan ral pawl hnenah; Lungawinak a pek hai, kan siatral ṭheh ruangah."},"18":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, Bawipa hnenah, Nangmah kulhnak phardawl rori hi au hai seh. Na mitthli cu sun zan in, Tiva bangin luang hai seh. Na hrangah colh ni um hlah seh, Na mitthli khal hul ni nei hlah seh."},"19":{"text":"Zanvarte tho cingcing awla, Bawipa cu ko cingcing aw. Bawipa ih hmaiah na thinlung natnak cu tidai bangin luangter aw. Na faate pawl hrangah baan pharh in zaangfahnak dil aw; Lamzin kel kipih a thi zikmi na faate pawl, Rawl loih a thi ṭheh zikmi na faate pawl hrangah cun."},"20":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , zohhnik, Na hrem reromi pawl hi zohhnik. Nunau pawl in an faate sa an ei, An duhdawtmi an faate pawl cu! Puithiam le profet pawl an that, Biakinn pi sung rori ahcun."},"21":{"text":"Mino mitar ti loin an thi, Khawpi lamzin ahcun. Fala le tlangval khal an thi, Ral pawl ih ralnam cun. Zaangfahnak nei loin na that hai, Na thinheng ni ahcun."},"22":{"text":"Ka ral pawl cu khuazakip in na sawm, puai zawh ding bangin. Zohman a luat theitu an um lo, Na thinheng ni ahcun. Ka faate pawl an that ṭheh, Ka duhdawtmi le ka cawmmi pawl cu."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ih hremnak a harzia, A thinhengnak fungfek, A theitu ka si.","title":"Hremnak, Sirawknak Le Ruahsannak"},"2":{"text":"Tleunak um lo khawthim sungah, Pil deuhdeuh in i tuul."},"3":{"text":"Zaangfahnak zianghman um loin, Sunvu cat loin i vuak a si."},"4":{"text":"Ka vun a thlek ih ka tit a lang, Ka ruh pawl khal a khiak ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"A pit zetmi thawnginn ah i khum, Vansan thinharnak thawng sungah."},"6":{"text":"Ka duh lo cing in i umter, Thihnak khawthim rimsia lakah."},"7":{"text":"Thir cikcin in i khit, Luat dingah ruahsannak nei lo thawngtla ka si."},"8":{"text":"Pathian hnen bomnak dilin ka au, Asinain ka aunak a ngai duh lo."},"9":{"text":"Sawn phah rero in ka feh, Ka hernak kipah lungphar in i kham."},"10":{"text":"Savom bangin i bawh, Kiosa vekin i zon."},"11":{"text":"Lamzin ihsin i dawihlo, I bauhthlek ṭheh ih i tlansan."},"12":{"text":"A li a nawp ih, A conkiang hmui bahmi ah i tuah."},"13":{"text":"A conkiang in i sai ih, Ka lung sungah thukpi a lut."},"14":{"text":"Miphun pawl in sunvu in hnihsan, An hrangah cun hnihsuahsainak zokzeetnak hla meen ka si."},"15":{"text":"Ka duh lo cingin tikha i inter ih, A khami tuarnak cu rawl bangin i eiter."},"16":{"text":"Ka hmai cu leilung ah i rawt ih, Lungto ah ka ha a khiak ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Hnangam daihnak in in tlansan, Lungawinak cu ziangvek a si tihman ka ciing nawn lo."},"18":{"text":"Reipi ka nung nawn lo ding, Bawipa hnenih ka ruahsannak a cem zo."},"19":{"text":"Inn le lo nei loih ka tuar rero hi ka ruah tikah ka hrangah a khami thih sii a si."},"20":{"text":"Cumi catbaang loin ka ruat ih Ka thin a nau cuahco."},"21":{"text":"Asinain ruahsannak a ra tlungsal, Hi thil pakhat ka theih tikah cun:"},"22":{"text":"A hmunmi Bawipa ih duhdawtnak cu Ziangtik hmanah a cat dah lo; A zaangfahnak cu net ni a nei lo."},"23":{"text":"Zinglam khawvang bangin a thar ringring; Rintlak a sinak cu a nasa a si."},"24":{"text":"Ka covo cu Bawipa lawng a si; Curuangah ka ruahsannak a hnenah ka re ding."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ṭha a si, Amah a ringtu pawl hrangah cun."},"26":{"text":"Thinsau zetin hngah cu kan hrangah a ṭha bik, Amah ih in runnak hngah cu."},"27":{"text":"Cuih thinsaunak zir cu No lai caan ah a ṭha bik."},"28":{"text":"Harsatnak kan tuar tikah, Thinsau le daizirziar in to ding kan si."},"29":{"text":"Tangdornak thawn lukuun ding kan si; Ziangahtile ruahsannak a um hrih thei meen."},"30":{"text":"Hmuhsuammi le vuakmi kan si hmanah, tuar cuahco ṭheh ding kan si ko."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa cu mi zaangfahtu a si, Kumkhua cun in hnong lo ding."},"32":{"text":"Riahsiatnak in pe hmansehla, A lainatnak cu a lang ding; In duhdawtnak cu rintlak a si."},"33":{"text":"Lungawinak zianghman a nei lo, Kan ninghannak le kan tuarnak ah hin."},"34":{"text":"Bawipa in a thei ṭheh, Thawnginn ah leilung ih palcih kan si tikah cun."},"35":{"text":"Amah in a thei ṭheh, Amah ih pekmi covo kan ngah lo tikah cun."},"36":{"text":"Amah in a thei ṭheh, Thuṭhennak hmun ih thudik an dinpi lo tikah cun."},"37":{"text":"Bawipa ih tumtahnak tel loin, Zianghman tuahsuak a si dah lo."},"38":{"text":"Cungnungbik thupekmi vekin, a ṭha le a sia an cang fingfing."},"39":{"text":"Ziangah so minung an phunzai rero, An sual ruangih hremmi an si tikah cun."},"40":{"text":"Kan nuncan hi zohhliah sal uhsila Bawipa hnenah kirsal uhsi."},"41":{"text":"Vancung Pathian hnenah kan kut lawng si loin kan thinlung khal hlan uhsi. Cule hiti in thlacam uhsi:"},"42":{"text":"“Na hmai ah kan sual ih kan lo dodal zo; Cule, Maw Bawipa , nang in in ngaithiam lo."},"43":{"text":"Na thinhengnak in na thuam aw; Zaangfahnak zianghman nei loin in dawi ih in that."},"44":{"text":"“Na ai-thawhnak khawdur cu Kan thlacamnak in a pah tlang thei lo."},"45":{"text":"Nangmah in fihnung hnawmhne ah in tuah, Leilung pumpi miphun hmaiah."},"46":{"text":"“Kan ral pawl hmuahhmuah in hmuhsuam nautatnak ṭongkam thawn in roh."},"47":{"text":"Siatsuahnak le hlohralnak kan tong zo; Thinphannak le ṭihnunnak sungah kan um."},"48":{"text":"Ka minung pawl siatralnak an ton ruangah ka mitthli cu tiva bangin a luang."},"49":{"text":"“Ka mitthli cu cerhti bangin Cat loin a puut ringring."},"50":{"text":"Bawipa in vancung ihsin, I run zoh ih i hmuh hlan lo a cat dah lo."},"51":{"text":"Ka riah a sia ih ka thin a na, Khawpi sung nunau pawl parih Thil a thlengmi ruangah cun."},"52":{"text":"“Vate bangin thang in in awk, Thuhla um lo ih i huatu ka ral pawl cun."},"53":{"text":"Ka nungcingin khur sungah in thlak, Lungto in an khuh a kaa ahcun."},"54":{"text":"Tidai in i khum cuahco, Ka thi cing ding a sihi, ka ti."},"55":{"text":"“Khur sung tawdeng ihsin, Maw Bawipa , nangmah ka lo ko."},"56":{"text":"Ka aunak ngai dingih ka lo dil tikah i theihsak a si."},"57":{"text":"Ka aunak aw cu i let ih, ‘ṭih hlah aw,’ i ti."},"58":{"text":"“Keimah ṭan dingah na ra ih, Maw Bawipa , ka nunnak cu na run ngah zo."},"59":{"text":"Ka thu cu felzetin i ṭhensak aw; Ka parih an dik lo zia cu na thei ko."},"60":{"text":"Ka ral pawl in in mitkem zia le In phiar zia cu na thei ṭheh ko."},"61":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , in hmuhsuamnak le In phiarnak hmuahhmuah na thei ṭheh."},"62":{"text":"Sun ni-hlawh ka thu lawng an rel ih Keimah zuarthlainak lawng an ngaih tuah."},"63":{"text":"An to ah siseh an din ah siseh in puahcok ih Hnihsuahsainak ah in hmang."},"64":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa , hiti an tuah ruangah hin cawh awla hrem hai aw."},"65":{"text":"Siatserh hai awla thinlung harnak in khat hai seh."},"66":{"text":"Na thinheng in hawlsuak hai awla, Leilung par ihsin hloralter ṭheh aw.”"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tle zohzo mi kan sui pawl cu An dal ṭheh zo. Biakinn ih lungto pawl cu lamzin ah ṭhekdarh ṭheh an si zo.","title":"Jerusalem A Siat Hnu Ah"},"2":{"text":"Kan hrangah Zion tlangval pawl cu Sui tlukin an rak sunglawi. Sikhalsehla atu ahcun tlakbeel tluk men ah ruah an si."},"3":{"text":"Cinghnia pinu hman in a faate cu ṭhatein zoh a thiam. Asinain ka minung pawl cu nelrawn kalauk vate vek an si; Zaangfahnak zianghman an thiam lo."},"4":{"text":"Ka minung in an fano an thihter, Rawl lo le ti loin. Nauhak in rawl an dil naón, Zohman in an pe lo."},"5":{"text":"Lamzin ah rawl loin an thi, Rawl thawbik a rak eitu pawl cu. Hnawmhne hlonnak ah rawl an hawl, Nunnuam zetih rak cawmmi pawl cun."},"6":{"text":"Ka minung pawl in cawhkuan hremnak an tuar. An tuarnak cu a luar sawn; Milai kut tel loin rin loih a siatmi Sodom khuami pawl hnakin."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem lal pawl cu borhhlawh loin vur vekin an thiang; Cawhnawi bangin an raang. An harhdam ih an cakzet; Mepian lungvar bangin an mawi ih an naal zenzen."},"8":{"text":"Atu ahcun lamzin ah an thi, Rapṭing hnakin an dum sawn; Zohman in an thei thiam nawn lo. An vun cu an ruh ah a erh aw ṭheh, Thingro vekin an caar."},"9":{"text":"Ral kut in a thimi kha an van nei sawn; Neta ih a thimi pawl hnak cun. Ei ding zianghman nei loin, Rawl loih nuamte ih thih cu a har sawn."},"10":{"text":"Tuksumza ngaingai a si, Ka minung hnenih a thlengmi vanduainak cu; Lainatu nule pawl in rawl ai ah an suan hai, An sungsuak an faate pawl cu."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in a ai thawhnak cu, Meivam bangin a run burh. Zion ah meisa a alhter ih, A hramṭohnak tiang ciam ṭheh ko in a kang."},"12":{"text":"Zohman in an zum thei lo, Ramdang uktu bawi khal in an zum thei lo; Jerusalem khawpi sung luh thei ding cu; Jerusalem kotka sungih ral pawl luh thei ding cu."},"13":{"text":"Asinain an lut thei, A profet le a puithiam pawl an sual ruangah. A profet le a puithiam pawl in thil poimawh an tuah, Mawh nei lomi ih thisen an luanter ruangah."},"14":{"text":"An hotu pawl cu an vakvai, Lamzin tluan ah mitcaw bangin. Thisen an hnih awknak a luar tuk, Zohman ih tham ṭha lo an si."},"15":{"text":"Misenpi pawl in, “Tlan uh, Mi borhhlawh nan si, In dai hlah uh,” an ti. Curuangah ram kip ah an vakvai, Khui hmanah tlun inn an tong lo; “Hinah nan um thei lo” an ti."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in an hrangah helhkamnak zianghman a nei lo; A ṭhekdarh sawn hai a si. Kan puithiam le kan upa pawl cu Zianghman ah a siar lo."},"17":{"text":"Bomnak a ra hmang ding ti zoh na ah kan mit a kham ṭheh; Bomnak cu a ra dah si lo. Bomnak in pe hmang ding tiah kan hngak rero naón, Khui ram hman in bomnak in pe thei lo."},"18":{"text":"Kan ral pawl in in thlingthla, Kan dung in in thlun ringring; Lamzin hmanah kan vak ngam lo. Tikcu le caan kan nei nawn lo, Kan cem netnak ni a thleng zo a si."},"19":{"text":"Van ih khaupi hnakin, Zamrang sawn in kan ral in in dawi. Tlangpar ah in dawi ih, Nelrawn ah rinlopi in in man."},"20":{"text":"Kan nunnak hrampi an kai ngah, Bawipa ih hriakculhmi kan rinsan bikmi cu. In dotu pawl kut ihsin in hum ding; A thla thuai ah kan um ding, kan timi cu."},"21":{"text":"Hni rero uh, Edom le Uz mipawl, Nan lung awi ko uh, tikcu nan neih sungah cun. Nan siatralnak tikcu a ra thleng ve ko ding; Taklawng le ningzak in nan sawn nan ril rero ve ko ding."},"22":{"text":"Zion in a sualman cu a kuan ṭheh zo; Bawipa in saltaannak ah in re nawn lo ding. Sikhalsehla Edom, nang cu Bawipa in a lo hrem ding; Na mawhnak hmuahhmuah a langter ṭheh ding."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , kan parih a thleng mi hi in theihsak hram aw. In run zoh awla kan ningzahnak hi in run hmuhsak hram aw.","title":"Zaangfah Dil Ih Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Kan ram le kan ro neihmi pawl cu Kan theih dah lomi pawl ih kut sung an thleng. Kan inn pawl cu ramdangmi pawl ih ta ah an cang."},"3":{"text":"Kan pale pawl ral kut in an thi, Ngakṭah farah ah kan cang. Kan nule pawl nuhmei ah an cang."},"4":{"text":"Kan inmi tidai kan lei a ṭul; Kan tihmi zanthing khal a man kan pek a ṭul."},"5":{"text":"Kan hngawng ah hngawngkol in thlaih; Ramsa bangin cat lo ih dawimi kan si. Kan bang nasa zet naón colh ni kan nei lo."},"6":{"text":"Rawl khopkham ih ngah duh ah, Izipt ram le Assiria ram ah rawl dil ah kan feh."},"7":{"text":"Kan pupa pawl cu an sual ih an um nawn lo; Asinain an sual man cu kannih in kan tuar."},"8":{"text":"Sal hnakin a ṭha cuang lomi pawl, Kan tlun ah lal an cang. An kut sung ihsin in suah theitu Zohman an um fawn lo."},"9":{"text":"Mi thah hmang pawl hramlak ah an vak rero; Thih ṭih cingin nun duh ah rawl kan hawl."},"10":{"text":"Kan rilrawnnak in kan taksa a satter thluh; Kan vun cu lungthu bangin a ling."},"11":{"text":"Kan nupi pawl an kaihrem, Zion tlang rori ahcun. Judah khawte kipah kan fanu pawl Sualpinak an tuar."},"12":{"text":"In hotu pawl an hruai ih, An hngawng in an awk that. Kan patar pawl khal zianghman hmaizahnak an pe lo."},"13":{"text":"Kan tlangval pawl sal bangin Fang an rialter; Kan nauhak tualleng pawl cu an sawn rero, An phurhmi zanthing a rit tuk ruangah."},"14":{"text":"Kan patar pawl in an tlansan zo, An to ṭheunak khawpi kotka cu. Tlangval khal in an tlansan zo, An tum ṭheumi ṭingṭang pawl cu."},"15":{"text":"Kan nunnak sung ihsin Lungawinak a suakhlo zo. Kan nomnak le kan laamnak cu, Riahsiatnak in a airawl zo."},"16":{"text":"Kan suilukhuh kan lu ihsin a tla zo. Kan sual zo ih kan lamzin a pit a si."},"17":{"text":"Hi ruangah kan thin a na, Kan thin muril tiangin a na. Hi bangtuk ruangah hin Kan mit a mal thlang a si."},"18":{"text":"Ziangahtile Zion tlang cu a ṭhing, ṭio sanmi hmun a si; Hramlak ih cinghnia pawl an vak, Siatbalmi khawrop ahcun."},"19":{"text":"Asinain, maw Bawipa , nang cu Kumkhua in uktu bawi na si. Na bawi tokham cu san ih-khuk in a hmun ringring ding a si."},"20":{"text":"Ziangah so atu tiang, In dungtun ringring hrih? Ziangtik talah in thei sal nawn pei maw?"},"21":{"text":"Na hnenah in kirter hram aw, Maw Bawipa , in kirter hram aw. Khuahlan kan rak sunlawinak pawl cu In pe kir sal hram aw."},"22":{"text":"Culole kannih hi kumkhua in maw in hnong ding? Kan parih na thinhengnak hi Cem ni a nei lo ding maw si?"}}}}},"26":{"info":{"name":"Ezekiel","shortname":"Eze.","abbr":[],"desc":"Ezekiel"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sawmthum kum, thlali thla, ni nga ni ah, keimah puithiam Ezekiel, Buzi ih fapa cu Babilon ram Khebar Tivapi kiangah sal ih kaihmi Judah mipawl thawn kan um. Van a ong aw ih Pathian langnak ka hmu.","title":"Pathian A Hmuh Hmaisa Biknak (1.1—7.27) Pathian Tokham"},"2":{"text":"Cuih kum cu siangpahrang Jehoiakhin sal ih an kaihnak kum nganak kum a si."},"3":{"text":"Cuih Babilon ram Khebar Tivapi kiangah cun ka hnenah Bawipa ih ṭongmi ka thei ih a huham cahzia khal ka thei."},"4":{"text":"Ka hun zoh ih saklam ihsin thlipi huuk a run kha ka hmu. Khawdur sahzet sungin nimthla a kau zohzo ih a kiangkap cu a vaang zukzo. Nimthla a kaunak zawn ahcun dar bangin a tleumi ka hmu."},"5":{"text":"Thlipi laifangah a nungmi ramsa bangtuk milai hmuihmel kengmi pali ka hmu;"},"6":{"text":"asinain hmai pali le thla pali an nei fingfing."},"7":{"text":"An ke pawl cu an ding zerzer ih an tin pawl cu cawcang tin bangtuk an si; tleuzet ih hnawtmi dar vek an si."},"8":{"text":"Hmai pali le thla pali an nei fingfing ih tlunah an thla pakhat hnuai ah milai kut pakhat an nei fingfing; cutin pakhat in kut pali ciar an nei."},"9":{"text":"Cuih ramsa nung pakhat in an thla pahnih ciar an pharh ih kil li nei, tung le vang can-aw in an um ih an thlazim cu an dai aw ṭheh. An ṭhawn tikah an taksa her aw lotein a burpi in an ṭhawn."},"10":{"text":"Ramsa nung pakhat in hmai phun dangdang pali fingfing a nei. Hmailamah milai hmai a nei; vorhlam ah kiosa hmai a nei; kehlam ahcun cawcang hmai a nei ih dunglamah muvanlai hmai a nei."},"11":{"text":"Ramsa nung pakhat in an thla pahnih fingfing an pharh ih cuticun ramsa dangih thlazim kha an dai fingfing. An thla pahnih cu pharh loin an taksa parah an khup fingfing."},"12":{"text":"Ramsa nung pakhat in kap li fingfing an hoi ih cuticun an taksa her ṭul loin an duhnakah a burpi in an feh thei a si."},"13":{"text":"Cuih ramsa nung pawl lakah cun meisa vaampi vekih a tleu zohzo mi a um ih amah cu catbaang loin a ṭhawn aw rero. Cuih meisa vaampi sung ihsin nimthlakau vekih a tleu zohzo mi a suak."},"14":{"text":"Cuih ramsa pawl cu nimthlakau tlukih cak in dung le hmaiah an pet rero."},"15":{"text":"Cuih ramsa pali cu ka zoh rero laiah ramsa pakhat kiangah lengke pakhat fingfing, lengke pali leilung dai in ka hmu."},"16":{"text":"Cuih lengke pali cu an bangrep; lungmankhung bangin an tleu fingfing; cuih lengke sungah lengke dang pakhat dingzet in a tan zawng in a vunglutmi a um fingfing;"},"17":{"text":"cuticun lengke cu an duhnakah an her-aw thei."},"18":{"text":"Leengke pawl ih tlangkap cu an saangzet ih an makzet; mit hlir in an khat."},"19":{"text":"Ramsa nung pawl an ṭhawn tikah lengke pawl khal an ṭhawn ve; leilung ihsin tlunlam ih an kaiso tik khalah lengke pawl khal an so ve a si."},"20":{"text":"Ramsa nung pawl cu an duhnak kipah an feh; cuvek cekci in lengke pawl khal an feh ve; ziangahtile ramsa pawl in an uk a si."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah ramsa nung pawl an feh ah siseh, an din ah siseh, a si lole thli lakih an kai ah siseh, lengke pawl khal cun an tuah ṭheh ve a si."},"22":{"text":"Cule ramsa pawl ih lu tlunah cun mangbangza in a vaarmi tlunkhuh-kuum a um."},"23":{"text":"Cumi hnuai ahcun ramsa nung pawl cu an ding.
