Riahsia in na ṭang cuum aw."},"13":{"text":"Ka minung pawl ka hniksak, An sual an sir duh lo a si ahcun, Hi thil pawl hi an parah a thleng ding."},"14":{"text":"“Milaipa, profet na si vekin atu-ah phuangsuak aw. Na za beng awla ralnam cun a sat rero ding. Mi thattu nam a si, ṭihtertu nam a si ih mi sattu nam a si."},"15":{"text":"Ka minung pawl an ralṭhatnak a cemter ih a sawnter hai. Nimthlakau vekin a tleu zukzo mi ralnam thawn, mi that dingah tiar cia in an khawpi cu ka fuuk."},"16":{"text":"Maw ralnam, vorhlam le kehlam ah sat vivo aw. Na hernak kipah sat vivo aw."},"17":{"text":"Kei khal ka za ka beng ding ih cuticun ka thinhengnak a reh ding. Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Babilon Siangpahrang Ih Ralnam"},"19":{"text":"“Milaipa, a ralnam thawn Babilon siangpahrang a run theinak lamzin pahnih in hminsin aw. Cuih lamzin pahnih cu ram pakhat ihsin a thok ding. Lamzin ṭeekah hminsinnak ṭhuam phun aw."},"20":{"text":"Pakhat in Ammon khawpi Rabbah fehnak lamzin a hmuh ding ih a dang pakhat in ralhruang ih kulhmi Judah khawpi Jerusalem lamzin a hmuh ding."},"21":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang cu lamzin ṭeekah a ding. Khui zin ka thlun ding ti theihnak ah ai a zing: thal pawl thing tahrat in a zoh; a milem pawl thu a ron ih raithawinak sathin hnit a zoh."},"22":{"text":"‘Jerusalem,’ ti ih nganmi a thal cu vorhlam kut in a kai. Cuih thal cun ruhkulh pawl sut thluknak ding, raldo tikah hawhawt ciamco ding, kotka pawl sut balnak ding, ralhruang hnakin sangsawn ih leilung dawl ding le donhleisang don ding pawl a sim ṭheh."},"23":{"text":"Lungkimnak cakhen an tuah zo ruangah hibangtuk in thil a cang ding ticu Jerusalem mi pawl cun an zum lo. Sikhalsehla hibangtuk in a cang ngaingai ding cu an sualzia theihternak ah le ral ih kaihmi an si ding, ti ih ralrin pek cianak a si."},"24":{"text":"Himi cu keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa ih ka ṭongmi a si. Nan sualnak pawl an lang ṭheh zo. Nan mawhzia cu zapi theih a si zo. Hnonmi nan si thlang ih nan ral pawl ih kut ah ka lo pe ding a si."},"25":{"text":"“Nang mi ṭha lo, mi borhhlawh Israel hotu, hremnak neta bik na tuar ding ni a ra thleng cuahco zo."},"26":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo. Na siangpahrang lukhuh le na lupawng cu hlon aw. A hlan vekin zianghman a um nawn lo ding. Farah nauta pawl kha thuneihnak dinhmun ah cawisaang aw. Mi uktu pawl hnuai ah ṭhum ṭheh aw."},"27":{"text":"Siatralnak! Siatralnak! Asi, khawpi cu ka siatsuah ṭheh ding. Asinain hi khawpi hrem dingah ka hrilmi uktu a ra thlen hlan cu hi thil cang ding pawl hi a kim hrih lo ding; a kim tikah a kut ah ka pe ding."},"28":{"text":"“Milaipa, profet na si vekin phuang awla Israel a hmuhsuamtu Ammon mi pawl hnenah ka ṭongmi hi than aw. An hnenah: ‘Ralnam cu mithat dingah zuuk cia in a um; Mi that dingih hnawt tleumi a si; Nimthlakau vekih tle zukzo dingah.","title":"Ralnam Le Ammon Mi Pawl"},"29":{"text":"Langnak nan hmuhmi cu thuphan an si ih hmailam thu nan simsungmi cu thulolak an si. Mi ṭha lo le mi siava ngaingai nan si ih nan tuarnak ni, neta bikih hremnak nan tuarnak ni cu a ra thleng cuahco zo. Ralnam in nan hngawng a lo sat ding."},"30":{"text":"“‘Nan ralnam cu a kawm sungah thun sal uh. Nan seemnak hmun le nan suahnak ramah nan thu ka ṭhen ding."},"31":{"text":"Meiling bangin ka thinhengnak cu nan parih ka burh tikah ka thinhengnak nan tuar ding a si. Cule mi siatsuah lamih a thiambik pawl, zaangfah nei lomi pawl ih kut ah ka lo pe ding."},"32":{"text":"Meisa in siatsuah ṭheh nan si ding. Nan thisen cu nan ram sungah a luang ding ih zohman in an lo thei nawn lo ding,’ ti aw,” tiah a ti. Bawipa in a sim zo."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Jerusalem Sualnak"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, mithat pawl an khahnak khawpi hi a thu ṭhen dingah na tim na tuah maw? Fihnungza thil tampi a tuahmi hi fiangtein a hnenah simta aw."},"3":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ka ṭongmi hi sim aw: na minung tampi na that ih milem bia tahratin na borhhlawhter awk ruangah na tikcu a rathleng cing ding."},"4":{"text":"Mi na that ih na tuahcopmi na milem pawl thawn na borhhlawhter awk ruangah na tikcu a rathleng ding, na caan a cem cing ding a si. Curuangah a si miphun pawl ih hnihsuahsainak ah ka lo canter ih ram tampi ih hmuhsuam dingah ka lo tuah."},"5":{"text":"Cin le daan zianghman na neih lo ruangah ram hla tilo, ram nai tilo in an lo nautat ciamco."},"6":{"text":"Israel hotu pawl in anmah ih thazaang an ring ih mi an that."},"7":{"text":"Khawpi sung mi zohman nu le pa upattu an um lo. Ramdang mikhual pawl nan bum ih nuhmei le ngakṭah pawl par ihsin hlawknak nan hawl."},"8":{"text":"Hmun thianghlim pawl zianghman ah nan siar lo ih Sabbath khal nan buar."},"9":{"text":"Mihrek in midang pawl thah duh ah thuphan an per. Mihrek in raithawinak sa an ei. Mihrek in an taksa hiarnak lawnglawng an diriamter."},"10":{"text":"Mihrek cu an pa ih nupi thawn an it tlang. Mihrek in nunau pawl thi an neih lai hmanah hranhram in an sualpi."},"11":{"text":"Mihrek cu an uire; Midang in an mo nu siseh an pa ih fanu siseh an thlem."},"12":{"text":"Nanmah lakih mihrek in tangka duh ah mi nan phil. Mihrek in an unau Israel mi hnenah tangka cawih tahratin tangka ṭhang an lak ih a miat hawl in an lian. Kei cu in thei nawn lo,” a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo."},"13":{"text":"“Ruk nan ru ih mi nan thah ruangah ka kuttum in ka lo cuum ding."},"14":{"text":"Cutiih ka lo tuah ngaingai ni ahcun, cahnak le ralṭhatnak kan nei ding tiah mawsi nan ruat? Keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo ih ka thu cu ka kimter ding."},"15":{"text":"Nan minung pawl cu miphun dang hnenah le ram dangdang ah ka ṭhekdarh ding ih thil sualral nan tuahmi cu ka cemter ding."},"16":{"text":"Cuticun miphun dang pawl in an lo thangsiat ding, asinain nannih in Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Pathian Ih Thianternak Somei"},"18":{"text":"“Milaipa, Israel mi pawl hi ka hrangah hman tlak an si lo. Thir-eek vek an si: sodengtu in somei sungih a taantami ngun, dar, rangva, thir le suan pawl ih eek bangtuk an si."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in thir eek vekih santlai lo an si ti kha atu-ah ka sim a si: Jerusalem ah ka ko ṭheh ding ih,"},"20":{"text":"ngun, dar, thir, suan le rangva pawl somei sungih an finkhawm vekin ka finkhawm ding. Cupawl cu somei sungih an titter vekin ka tuah ding. Ka thinhengnak le ka aithawhnak in ka titter ṭheh hai ding."},"21":{"text":"Asi, Jerusalem ah ka finkhawm ding ih an hnuai ihsin meisa ka muah ding ih ka thinhengnak in ka titter hai ding a si."},"22":{"text":"Somei sungih ngun an titter vekin Jerusalem ah ka titter hai ding ih cuticun Bawipa ih thinhengnak kan tuar ti an thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah hiti in a sim sal.","title":"Israel Hotu Pawlih Sualnak"},"24":{"text":"“Milaipa, Israel mi pawl hi sim aw: an ram hi a thianghlim lo; curuangah ka thinheng in ka hrem ding."},"25":{"text":"An hotu pawl cu anmah ih deh ciami ramsa tlunih a huuk reromi kiosa bangtuk an si. Mi an that, an zatein an ngah theizat in tangka le thilri an lak; mi an thah ruangah nunau tampi nuhmei ah an cangter."},"26":{"text":"Puithiam pawl in ka daan an bal ih thil thianghlim kha an upat lo. Thil thianghlim le thil borhhlawh an thleidang thiam lo. A thiangmi le a baalmi an dan awknak kha mi an zirh lo. Sabbath khal zianghman ah an siar lo. Curuangah Israel mi pawl hin keimah in upat lo a si."},"27":{"text":"Acozah bawi pawl cu an deh ciami ramsa a bauhthlek rerotu cinghnia hraang vek an si. Milian si duh ah mi an that."},"28":{"text":"Mi in phar pawl cu siirang an hnih vekin an sualnak cu profet pawl in an thuhsak a si. Profet pawl in langnak dik lo an hmu ih simsungnak thuphan an sim. Cungnungbik Bawipa ih thu ka sim an ti; asinain Bawipa keimah in an hnenah thu ka sim dah lo."},"29":{"text":"Milian pawl in mi an bum ih mi an ram. Farah zonzai an tisiat ih ramdangmi parah hlawknak an hawl."},"30":{"text":"Phardawl a dawl theitu minung ka hmu lo; phar pawl bal ṭheh a sinak zawn ih a ding theitu le ka thinheng in ram pumpi siatsuah ding ka tum tikah rampi a ṭan theitu ding minung ka hawl rero naón pakhat hman ka tong lo."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah ka thinhengnak cu an parah ka burh ding ih an thil tuahmi ruangah ka thinlingnak meisa in ka siatsuah ding,” tiah a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Misual Nunau Unau Hnih"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, hlanlai ah nunau unau hnihte an rak um."},"3":{"text":"An nolai ihsin Izipt ramah an um ih an falat vete in an nuncan a ṭha lo; an pawhte duhduh ih thammi an si ih fala him si nawn loin hlawhhlang ah an cang."},"4":{"text":"Upa sawn cu Oholah ti a si, a naunu cu Oholibah ti a si. An pahnih in ka nupi an si ih fanu le fapa pawl in hrin. Oholah cu Samaria a si ih, Oholibah cu Jerusalem a si."},"5":{"text":"Oholah cu ka ta a si ko naón hlawhhlang hna a ṭuan thotho ih Assiria ramih a mi duhmi pawl a ngai ciamco."},"6":{"text":"A mi duhmi pawl cu sendup pianzia hnipuan a hruktu ralkap pawl, miphun ṭha hrin le hnaṭuan tumzetzet a ṭuantu pawl an si ih an zatein rangpar ralkap bawi, mi piangzet pawl an si."},"7":{"text":"Assiria ralbawi pawl hrangah hlawhhlang hna a ṭuan ih Assiria milem pawl biaknak le a taksa hiarnak thawn a borhhlawhter aw a si."},"8":{"text":"Fala si nawn loin hlawhhlang ih a cannak Izipt ramih a um vek ṭhiamṭhiam in hlawhhlang cu a ṭuan thotho. A tleirawl lai ihsin mipa pawl a hnenah an it ṭheu ih hlawhhlang tlukah an rak tuah zo a si."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah a duh kuahko mi le amah a hiartu Assiria mi pawl hnenah cun ka pekta a si."},"10":{"text":"Annih in a hnipuan an hlit ih taklawng in an ret; a fanu le a fapa pawl an kai; cule amah khal ralnam in an that; cutiin thuṭhennak a tong. Khawzakip ah nunau pawl in a thuhla cu an rel hiamhiam."},"11":{"text":"“Cumi cu a naunu Oholibah in a hmu naón a poisa cuang lo. A unu Oholah hnakin a hur sawn le a luar sawnmi hlawhhlang ah a cang."},"12":{"text":"Anih khal taksa hiarnak in a khat ih Assiria miphun ṭha hrin pawl, hnipuan tleu a hruktu ralkap bawi pawl, rangralkap bawi mipiang zetzet pawl cu a duh a si."},"13":{"text":"Nuncan sia in a borhhlawh awter. Upa sawn vek thotho in a nauta deuh khal a sia thotho a si."},"14":{"text":"“A nuncan siava sungah cun thuk deuhdeuh ah a pil sinsin. Babilon ram bawi pawl ih zuk cu phar parah an suai, siisen an hnih, taikhap an khap ih lupawng an pawngter; cupawl cu a ngai ciamco.","merge":"15"},"16":{"text":"Cupawl a hmuh vete in a ngaizet ih Babilon ahcun palai a hei thlah."},"17":{"text":"Babilon mi pawl an ra ih an ra ihpi; an hurnak an riamter ih an borhhlawhter. Cutiih a borhhlawh awkter hnuah cun a ninghang in a ningsin hai a si."},"18":{"text":"Asinain mikip theih dingin a tuah aw ih hlawhhlang a si kha mi hmuahhmuah ih hmuh dingah a phozaar aw. A unu ka ningsin vekin anih khal ka ningsin a si."},"19":{"text":"Izipt ramih tleirawl a si lai ihsin hlawhhlang hna a rak ṭuan vek thotho in a tu khalah a ṭuan ih a luar vivo."},"20":{"text":"Laakcang le rangcang bangin zahmawh le ti a neitu mipa hur pawl kha a hiar hai a si,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Oholibah, Izipt ramah tleirawlte na rak si laiah na nuncan a ṭha lo ih mipa pawl in na pawhte an lo tham ih fala him na sinak hlo tiangih na sualnak kha na pehzom duh vivo a si!"},"22":{"text":"“Cuti a si ruangah Oholibah, Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka lo sim duhmi cu hiti in a si: Na duhmi pawl cu na khop neknek zo, sikhalsehla na parah an thin ka hengter ding ih nangmah kulh dingah ka run hruai hai ding.","title":"Nauta Nu Parih Pathian Thuṭhennak"},"23":{"text":"Babilon mi, Khaldean mi, Pekod mi, Shoa mi, Koa mi le Assiria mi pawl ka run hruai ding. Cuih mipiang zetzet, miphun ṭha hrin pawl le bawi upa pawl, acozah bawi pawl le rangralkap ralbawi pawl cu ka finkhawm ding."},"24":{"text":"Saklam ihsin an run do ding, ralkap tampi le rangleng le rawl phurhnak leng pawl thawn an rung ding. Ralphaw le thir lukhuh thawn an thuam aw ding ih an lo kulh ṭheh ding. An kut sungah ka lo pe ding ih anmah ih daan in na thu an ṭhen ding."},"25":{"text":"Na parih ka thin a heng ruangah an thinheng in ka lo siatsuahter ding. Na hnar an tan ding, na hna an hlep ding ih na faate pawl an that ding. Asi, na fanu le na fapa pawl an lo long ding ih an nungcung in meisa in an ur ding."},"26":{"text":"Na hnipuan an thlek ding ih na hlawnthil pawl an la ding."},"27":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin na rak thok zomi nuncan siava le taksa hiarnak na tuah ringringmi cu ka cemter ding. Milem pawl cu na zoh nawn lo ding ih Izipt ram khal na ruat nawn lo ding,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Nanmah a lo huatu le a lo mitkemtu pawl ih kut sungah ka lo pe ding."},"29":{"text":"Cutiih an lo huat ruangah hna na ṭuan man hmuahhmuah an lak ṭheh ding ih na hnipuan hlit in lawngfangkheh in hlawhhlang vekin an lo thlah ding. Na taksa hiarnak le hlawhhlang na sinak in,"},"30":{"text":"na parah hibangtuk thil hi a thlengter a si. Miphun tampi hrangah hlawhhlang na ṭuan ih an milem pawl thawn na borhhlawhter aw zo."},"31":{"text":"Na unu ih thu na cawn ruangah hremnak khuathai na in dingah ka lo pe ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Na unu ih khuathai in na in ding, A khuat cu a tum ih a thuuk zet fawn. Mi hmuahhmuah in an lo hmuhsuam ding ih an lo nautat ding. Na in dingmi khuat cu a liam thluahthlo."},"33":{"text":"Cuih khuat cun vansaanglam in a lo tuah ding; Na ri ciamco ding. Ṭihnak le siatsuahnak khuat a si, Na unu Samaria ih khuat a si."},"34":{"text":"Na in dingih a cemfai ṭheh ding, Na khuat kuai phelte pawl in, Na pawhte an lo aat ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Keimah i hngilh ih i dungtun ruangah le na taksa hiarnak le hlawhhlang na sinak ruangah na tuar ding a si,” a ti."},"36":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Milaipa, Oholah le Oholibah parih thuṭhen dingah na tiar zo maw? Fihnungza thil pawl an tuah ruangah mawhthluk aw.","title":"Unau Pahnih Parah Pathian Thuṭhennak"},"37":{"text":"Ṭaangṭawm sualnak an tuah ih mi an that: milem pawl thawn an sual ih fapa in hrinsakmi pawl an that. Ka fapa pawl cu milem hnenih thawinakah an pek."},"38":{"text":"An tuahmi cu culawng a si lo. Ka ṭunghmuntermi ka Biakinn an borhhlawhter tikcu ah Sabbath khal an buar."},"39":{"text":"Milem pawl thawinak ih ka faate pawl an thah ni rori ah ka Biakinn ah an ra ih an borhhlawhter."},"40":{"text":"“Ram hlapi ih a ummi mipa pawl an sawm leuhleuh ih mipa pawl cu an ra ngaingai. Unau pahnihte cu ti an kholh aw, an mithmul an dumter ih sui le ngun thil mankhung an hruk."},"41":{"text":"Tokham mawizet parah an to ih an hmaiah cabuai pakhat an ret ih a parah cun thil ṭhaṭha ka pekmi, rimhmui le olif hriak pawl an ret."},"42":{"text":"Zianghman a poisa lotu miburpi ih awn-au thawm a thang; nelrawn ihsin rak hruaimi miburpi an si. Nunau unau hnih ih ngeel ah faute an hrukter ih an lu ah a mawizetmi lukhuh an khumter."},"43":{"text":"Ka thinlung tein nupa sualnak tuah tahratin a baang hnephnep mi nunau cu an hman reromi an hlawhhlang nu a si thotho, ka ti."},"44":{"text":"Hi hlawhhlang nunau pahnih hnenah atu le atu an feh. Nuncan siava nunau Oholah le Oholibah hnenah cun an kir leuhleuh."},"45":{"text":"Miding pawl in hi nunau pawl cu ṭaangṭawm sualnak an tuahmi le mi an thah ruangah an hnong hai ding, ziangahtile nupa sualnak an tuah ringring ih an kut khal thisen a hnih aw a si,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in hiti in a ti: “Anmah thinphangtertu le an thil longtu ah miburpi rak hruai uh."},"47":{"text":"Miburpi cun lungto in deng hai sehla ralnam thawn do hai seh; an faate pawl that hai sehla an inn pawl ur hai seh."},"48":{"text":"Hi ram sungah nuncan siava ih nun cu ka kham ding; cumicu nunau hmuahhmuah in hi nunau pahnih vekih nupa sualnak an tuah lonak dingah ralrin peknak a si ding."},"49":{"text":"Cule nannih unau hnih tla: nan nuncan fihnungza a si ruangah le milem nan biaknak sual ruangah ka lo hrem ding. Cuticun keimah hi Cungnungbik Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding,” a ti."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum kua kum, thla hra thla, ni hra ni ah Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"A Tlapmi Beel"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, tuihsun nithla hi ṭhatein ca sungah khum aw; ziangahtile tuihsun hi Babilon siangpahrang in Jerusalem kulh a thok ni a si."},"3":{"text":"Keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka minung raltho pawl hrangih tahṭhimnak ka neihmi hi sim hai aw: Meisa parah beel toh aw, Beel cu tidai khat te in than aw."},"4":{"text":"A sungah sa thawbik pawl can cia in re aw; Sa liang le sa cawn pawl, A hleice ih hrilmi sa ruh tan cia pawl tla."},"5":{"text":"Sa thawbik tuusa pawl sihaiseh. Beel hnuai ah zanthing pawl hun thlak aw. Tidai soseh. Satit le saruh pawl suang aw,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in hiti in a ti: “Mithat pawl umnak khawpi cu a cem fai zo! Thianfaiter dah lomi a tlapmi beel vek a si. Sa semkhat hnu semkhat an thur vivo ih semkhat hman a taang nawn lo."},"7":{"text":"Khua sungah mi an that, asinain leivut ih a khuh theinak leilung parah thisen cu an luangter lo. A ngilmi lungto parah an luanter."},"8":{"text":"Cutawkah cun thisen cu ka taan, zohman ih thuh thei lo dingah le thinhengnak thawn phuba lak theinak dingah,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in hiti in a ti: “Mi thattu pawl umnak khawpi cu a cem riai a si. Keimah rori in zanthing ka khawm ding;"},"10":{"text":"tam sinsin in zanthing cu beet uh. Meisa muah uhla sa cu suang uh. A tidai kang thluh in suang uh. A ruh khal kaang thluh seh."},"11":{"text":"Cule dar beel lawng cu meiling parah re uhla sen ko in vaam hiamhiam seh. Cuticun meivam sungah tlap ih a ei ciami cu a cem cuang lo ding naón,"},"12":{"text":"a tlapmi a kaang ṭheh hnuah cun beel thiangah a cangsal ding."},"13":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem, na nuncan ṭhatlonak in a lo borhhlawhter a si. Thianfaiter ka lo tum naón na borhhlawh thotho. Ka thinhengnak nasa zetih na tuar hlanlo na thiangfai nawn lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Cungnungbik keimah Bawipa in ka sim zo. Hna ka ṭuan ngaingai tikcu a thleng zo. Na sualnak pawl hi ka um san men lo ding; na parah zaangfahnak ka nei lo ding. Ka thin ka ṭhum lo ding. Na tuahmi ruangah hremnak na tuar ding,” tiah Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Profet Ih Nupi A Thi"},"16":{"text":"“Milaipa, na duh bikmi cu rinlopi ah na hnen ihsin ka la ding. Asinain phunzai hlah, a ṭah khal ṭap hlah, na mitthli khal tla hlah seh."},"17":{"text":"Na ik-ik khal zohman in thei hlah hai seh. Na mithi ngai langternak ah na lu khuh lo le na ke lawngin a lengah suak hlah. Na hmai khuh hlah, mithi ngai pawl ih eimi rawl khal ei hlah,” i ti."},"18":{"text":"Cuih sun zinglam ah mipi pawl thawn thu kan ruah aw rero. Cuih zanlam ah ka nupi in i thih san. A thaisun cu Bawipa ih i sim vek cun ka um."},"19":{"text":"Mipi pawl in, “Ziangah so hi bangtuk in na um?” tiah in sut."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah an hnenah, “ Bawipa in ka hnenah,"},"21":{"text":"nanmah Israel mi hnenah hi thu sim dingah i fial: Israel mi pawl, nan Biakinn khohkhahnak ruangah nan hngal a si. A zoh nan duh mi le nan pan duh bikmi Biakinn cu Bawipa in a borhhlawhter ding. Cule Jerusalem ih a taangta mi nan innsang ciarih mino deuh pawl cu ral kut in an thi ding."},"22":{"text":"Cuih hnuah keimah ih ka tuah vek cekci in nan tuah ve ding. Nan hmai nan khuh lo ding ih mithi ngai pawl ih eimi rawl nan ei lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Mithi nan ngai lo ding, ṭah khal nan ṭap lo ding. Lukhuh lo le ke lawngin lengah nan suak lo ding. Nan sualnak ruangah nan taksa a cem duahdo ding ih nan aihram ton aw ding."},"24":{"text":"Nan hrangah keimah hi hminsinnak ka si ding; ka tuahmi hmuahhmuah hi nan tuah ṭheh ve ding. Bawipa in hi thil pawl a kimter tikah Bawipa Pathian a si kha nan thei ding, i ti a si,” tiah ka sim hai."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Milaipa, an hnen ihsin a hngetzetmi Biakinn, an uar zetmi, sunglawi zetin an zoh duhmi le an pan duhmi Biakinn cu ka la hlo ding. An fanu le an fapa pawl khal ka lakhlo sak ding."},"26":{"text":"Cubangtuk ih ka tuah ni ahcun, cuih siatsuahnak ihsin a luattu pakhatkhat in cuih thu cu an ra lo sim ding."},"27":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun na ṭong theilonak hi a reh ding; na ṭong thei sal ding ih a luattu hnenah na ṭong thei ding. Cuticun mipi hrangah hminsinnak na si ding ih Bawipa ka si hi an thei ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Ammon Parih Profet ṭong"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, Ammon ram hi mawhthluk awla a ṭhatlonak hi phuangsuak aw."},"3":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah i ka ṭongmi hi ngai dingah sim aw: Ka Biakinn borhhlawh in a um hi na lung a awi; Israel ram siatsuah ṭheh in a um ih Judah mi pawl sal ih an taan hi na di a riam a si."},"4":{"text":"Cutiih na lung a awi ruangah nisuahnak lam nelrawn ih a um miphun pawl ka lo nehter ding. Na ram sungah ralkap riahnak an sak ding ih na ram an luah ding. Na ei dingmi le na in dingmi thingrah le cawhnawi pawl cu an ei an in ding."},"5":{"text":"Rabbah khawpi cu kalauk tlannak ramah ka tuah ding ih Ammon ram pumpi cu tuu pawl tlannak hmunah ka cangter ding; cuticun keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding."},"6":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa in hiti in a ti: na za na beng ih lungawi in na khir ciamco; Israel ram parah iksiiknak na nei."},"7":{"text":"Cutiih na um ruangah miphun dang kut ah ka lo pe ding ih annih in an lo ram ding, na thilri an lo long ding. Ka lo siatsuahnak cu a besia zet ding ih miphun pakhat na si thei nawn lo ding; ka ram ti ding khal na nei nawn lo ding. Cutikah keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha na thei ding,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Moab, in Judah khal hi midang vek thotho a si ko ual, a ti ruangah,","title":"Moab Parih Profet ṭong"},"9":{"text":"Moab ramri kiltu khua pawl, khua mawi bik Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon le Kiriathaim pawl tla telin, ral pawl ka doter hai ding."},"10":{"text":"Nisuahnak lam nelrawn ih ummi miphun pawl in, Ammon mi thawn Moab ram cu an neh ding. Keimah in ka nehter ding ih Ammon mipawl ti a um nawn lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Moab cu ka hrem ding ih keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha an thei ding,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Edom mi pawl in Judah mi parah zaangfahnak nei loin phuba an lak ruangah Edom mi pawl cu kumkhua in mawhphurtu ah an cang.","title":"Edom Parih Profet ṭong"},"13":{"text":"Atu-ah ka than a si: Edom cu ka hrem ding ih minung le ṭilva hmuahhmuah ka that ṭheh ding. Teman khua ihsin Dedan khua tiang an ram cu ramṭhing ah ka tuah ding ih an minung pawl cu ralnam in an thi ding."},"14":{"text":"Ka minung Israel mi pawl in ka ai ah Edom mi parah phuba an la ding ih ka thinhengnak le ka aithawhnak cu Edom mi pawl an tuarter ding. Keimah ih phuba lakmi cu ziangvek a si ti cu Edom in a thei ding,” a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo."},"15":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Filistin mi pawl in kumkhua an ral a si mi pawl parah zaangfahnak zianghman nei loin phuba an lak ih an mitkem in an siatsuah ṭheh a si.","title":"Filistin Parih Profet ṭong"},"16":{"text":"Curuangah atu-ah thu ka than: Filistin cu ka do ding ih ka that ṭheh hai ding. Filistin Rawn ih a nung hrihmi pawl khal ka siatsuah ding."},"17":{"text":"Nasa zetin ka hrem ding ih an parih phuba ka lakmi cu a na ngaingai ding. Ka thinhengnak an tuar rero ding. Cuticun keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding,” a ti."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum hleikhat kum, thla khat thla, ni khat ni ah Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Ṭai-ar Parih Profet ṭong"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, ṭai-ar khawpi sung mipi pawl in an aupi reromi cu hihi a si: ‘Jerusalem a siat ṭheh zo! Sumtuahnak thazaang a nei nawn lo! In zuamtu kan ral a si thei nawn lo ding,’ an ti."},"3":{"text":"“Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ṭongmi cu hiti in a si: ṭai-ar khawpi, Keimah hi na ral ka si. Miphun tampi nangmah do dingah ka rak hruai ding ih tipithuanthum tilet tho bangin na parah an ra thleng ding."},"4":{"text":"Na khawpi kulhnak phardawl cu an siatsuah ding ih na ralvennak donhleisang inn pawl cu an siatbal ṭheh ding. Cule keimah in leivut pawl cu ka phiatfai ding ih lungto lawng ka taan ding."},"5":{"text":"Cuih lungto pawl cu tipi sungih lungto a dingmi an si ding ih cuih parah ngakaitu pawl in an sur an pho ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo. Miphun tampi in ṭai-ar cu an ram ding."},"6":{"text":"An ramsung khua pawl ih a ummi pawl tla ralnam in an that ding. Cuticun ṭai-ar in keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha a thei ding,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Siangpahrang hmuahhmuah lakih siangpahrang maksak bik Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar cu ṭai-ar do dingin ka run hruai ding. Ralkap tampi, rang, rangleng le rangralkap pawl thawn saklam in a rung ding."},"8":{"text":"Ramsung khua ih a ummi pawl cu raldonak ah an thi ding. Ral pawl cun kahsam an lai ding, leilungsang an dawl ding, an ralphaw cu phar bangin a pit ding ih a sahzet ding."},"9":{"text":"Phar sutnak thingtum in na khawpi phar pawl cu an su ciamco ding, nan ralvennak donhleisang pawl cu hreitlung in an hau ding ih an bal ciamco ding."},"10":{"text":"An rang pawl ih thawhtermi leivut in a lo khuh ding. A siatciami khawpi kotka in an feh tikah an rang pawl in an rawl phurhnak leng le rangleng pawl an hnuhnak thawmvang cun nan phar pawl an hnin durdoter ding."},"11":{"text":"Rangralkap pawl in nan lamzin parah mi an nor vutvo ding ih mipi pawl an ralnam in an that vivo ding. A tumzetmi nan ṭhuam pawl cu leilung ah an tlu ṭheh ding."},"12":{"text":"Nan lennak le nan sum tuahnak thilri pawl cu an duhduh in an lak ding. Nan phar pawl cu an bal ṭheh ding ih nan nomcennak inn pawl cu an bauh ṭheh ding. Lungto le zanthing pawl, inn le phar balmi pawl cu tipithuanthum sungah an hlon ṭheh ding."},"13":{"text":"Nan hlasak ka cemter ding ih nan ṭingṭang aw pawl cu ka daiter ding."},"14":{"text":"Lungto lawng ka taan ding ih a parah ngakaitu pawl in an sur an pho ding. Nan khawpi cu dinsal a si nawn lo ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian in ṭai-ar khawpi hnenah hiti in a ṭong: “Neh mi na si ih na tluk tikah tipikap ih a ummi pawl in ral ih thahmi pawl an airaknak aw kha an thei ding ih an tuk a sum ding."},"16":{"text":"Tipithuanthum ih khualtlawn miphun pawl ih siangpahrang hmuahhmuah cu an tokham ihsin an ṭum ding. An puanfual le an puanṭelh pawl an hlit ding ih lei parah khur thlohthlo in an to ding. Na tuarzia an hmuh tikah an tuk a sum tuk ding ih khur loin an um thei lo ding."},"17":{"text":"Cule na hrangah hi mithi phumnak hla hi an sak ding: Khawpi hminthangzet cu a siat zo, A lawng pawl cu tipipar ihsin an hlo zo. Hi khawpi sung mipawl in tipithuanthum an rak uk; Tipi kapih um ram pawl cu an ṭihter hai."},"18":{"text":"Tikulh tampi an khur ciamco, Hi khawpi a tlak ni ahcun. An mipi pawl an mang a bang ngaingai, Cuvek siatsuahnak an hmuh tikah cun.”"},"19":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “A siat ṭheh ih zohman an um duh lonak khawpi pawl vekin ramṭhing ah ka lo tuah ding. Tipithuanthum tidai in ka lo khuh ding."},"20":{"text":"Khuahlan laiih a rak nungmi pawl thawn hmun khatih um dingah mithi khua Khurthuk ah ka lo kuat ding. Cuih leilungthuai ram, kumkhua in siatsuahmi ramah cun mithi pawl thawn ka lo umter ding. Curuangah zo ih umnak hman na si nawn lo ding ih a nungmi ram sungah hmun na luah nawn lo ding."},"21":{"text":"Rapthlakza hminsin mi na si ding ih cuticun na cemta ding. Mi in an lo hawl ding, asinain an lo hmu dah lo ding a si,” a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Ṭai-ar Khawpi Phumnak ṭahhla"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, tipikap ah a um ih miphun dangdang tipikap ih a um ve mi thawn pursum leilawn a tuahtu,"},"3":{"text":"Ṭai-ar khawpi hrangah mithi phumnak hla sak aw. Hihi Cungnungbik Bawipa ih simmi a si tiin sim aw: Maw ṭai-ar, ‘Mawinak lamah cun ka kim a si,’ na ti."},"4":{"text":"Na inn cu tifinriat a si; A lo dinsuahtu pawl in lawng mawizet vekah an lo tuah."},"5":{"text":"Na thing ah Hermon Tlang ih farthing an hmang; A lo dinsuahtu pawl cun. Lebanon ihsin sidar thing an lak, Na puan thlainak dingah."},"6":{"text":"Bashan ram in ṭhil thing an lak, Na lawng hlaunak dingah. Saipras ih farthing in na zial pawl cu an tuah, Saiho in an khuh ih an mawiter."},"7":{"text":"Na puanzar cu pat femte in an tah, Izipt ramih ṭelhmi coihcinmawi puan a si. Lam hlapi in theih a theih; Na parih thlahliap puanzar cu, Puan ṭha bik pawl an si. Saipras tikulh ih puan sendup an si."},"8":{"text":"A lo hlautu pawl cu Sidon le Arvad khuami an si. Na mithiam pawl cu lawng kiltu an si."},"9":{"text":"Hi lawng tuahtu pawl cu Byblos ih a zirfeltu an si. Na sumdawr tuahnak ahcun, Tipi parih lawng kiltu hmuahhmuah in sum an tuah a si."},"10":{"text":"Persia, Lidia le Libia ramih ralkap pawl in na ralkap an ṭuan. An ralphaw le an lukhuh pawl cu na ralkap inn ah an thlai. Na hrangih hminthannak a ngahtu pawl cu anmah an si."},"11":{"text":"Arvad ralkap pawl in na ralhruang pawl an kil ih Gamad ralkap pawl in na ralvennak donhleisang pawl an veng. An ralphaw pawl cu na phar parah an thlai. A lo mawitertu cu anmah an si."},"12":{"text":"“Spain ramah sum na tuah ih na thilri tampi ngun, thir, rangva, le suan thawn na thleng."},"13":{"text":"Grik ram, Tabul le Meshek ram khalah sum na tuah ih na thilri dar ih tuahmi thilri le sal pawl thawn na thleng."},"14":{"text":"Na thilri dangdang thawn hnaṭuantu rang pawl, raldonak rang pawl le laak pawl cu Beth Togarmah ihsin na thleng."},"15":{"text":"Rhodes mi pawl thawn khal pursum leilawnnak na tuah. Tipi kapih a ummi ram pawl in na thilri cu saiho le thingdum mankhung in an lo thleng."},"16":{"text":"Na zuarmi thilri pawl le na ṭuansuahmi thilri pawl cu Siria mi in an lo lei. Lung hring mankhung, puansen, coihcinmawi puan, pat femte ih tahmi hnipuan, tipi sung ihsin lakmi kep le ruby lungmankhung pawl cu na thilri ai ah an lo pek."},"17":{"text":"Judah le Israel in na thilri ai ah sangvut, khuaitizu, olif hriak le rimhmui pawl an lo pek."},"18":{"text":"Damaskas mi pawl in na zuarmi thilri le na ṭuansuahmi pawl an lo lei ih cuih ai ah Helbon ihsin sabitti le Sahar ihsin tuuhmul an lo pek. Na thilri thawn an tuahciami thir le rimhmui nan thleng aw.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Dedan mi pawl in na thilri pawl ai ah rangkung dammi puan an lo zorh."},"21":{"text":"Arab mi pawl le Kedar ram uktu pawl in na zuarmi thilri ai ah tuu le tuufaate le me an lo pek."},"22":{"text":"Sheba le Raamah sumtuahtu pawl in na thilri ai ah sui le ngun hlawnthil, sui le rimhmui ṭha bik pawl an lo pek."},"23":{"text":"Haran, Kanneh le Eden khua pawl, Sheba ih sumtuahtu pawl le Asshur le Kilmad pawl in na hnenah sum an tuah."},"24":{"text":"Na hnenah hnipuan ṭha le hnipuan mawi, hnipuan sendup, coihcinmawi puan, a tleumi puanpher, ṭha zetih an hrual mi hripi le hrite pawl an zuar a si."},"25":{"text":"Na thil zuarmi pawl cu thil phurtu lawng tum bik pawl in a bur a bur in an phur a si. “Rit zetih thil phurtu, Tifinriat ih lawng bangtuk na si."},"26":{"text":"A lo hlautu pawl in tifinriat par an lo thlenpi tikah, Nisuahnak lam thlipi in a lo soihsiat; Leilung thawn a hlatnak hmunah."},"27":{"text":"Na lennak le na thil zuarmi hmuahhmuah, Lawng kiltu na minung pawl, Na lawng parih zungthiam pawl le sumtuahtu pawl, Lawng parih ralkap hmuahhmuah, An zatein tifinriat ah an pil, Na lawng thli ih a soihsiat tik ahcun."},"28":{"text":"A pil cuahcomi lawng kiltu pawl ih Au thawm cu tipikap ah a ra thang!"},"29":{"text":"“Lawng an zatein an tlansan ṭheh, Long kiltu hmuahhmuah tikap an thleng ṭheh."},"30":{"text":"Nangmah ngai in nasa zetin an ṭap, An lu cu leivut an phulh aw ih Vutcam lakah an lawng ciamco."},"31":{"text":"Nangmah ruat in an sam an met ṭheh, Buri hnipuan an hruk ṭheh. An thin na in mitthli tla in an ṭap."},"32":{"text":"Na hrangah mithi phumnak hla an seh: ‘ṭai-ar cu zo in so a ṭhim thei ding e, Tipi sungih a pil zomi Ṭaiar cu?"},"33":{"text":"Na thilri pawl tipi ral a thlen tikah cun, Mi hmuahhmuah ih haimi na kimter e. Na thilri man ṭhazetzet pawl cun, Siangpahrang pawl na lianter ṭheh hai e."},"34":{"text":"Atu cu tipi sungah na pilpi zo, Tipithuanthum taw ah na pilta e. Na thilri le a lo riantu hmuah hmuah cu, Nangmah thawn tipi sungah nan hlota e,’ an ti."},"35":{"text":"Tifinriat kapih a ummi miphun pawl in na parih a thlengmi an hmuh tikah an mang a bang. An siangpahrang pawl hman an tuk a sum ih an mithmai ah ṭihnak a lang."},"36":{"text":"Nang cu na liam zo, kumkhua in na liamta zo; leilung pumpi ih sumtuahtu pawl cu an tuk a sum, nangmah vek kan cang pang ding, ti an phang,” a ti."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Ṭai-ar Siangpahrang Parih Profet ṭong"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, ṭai-ar uktu bawi hnenah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ka ṭongmi hi sim aw: Na zum aw tuk ih khawzing ka si na ti. Khawzing ka si ih siangpahrang tokham parah ka to ih tifinriat in i kulh ṭheh, khawzing ka si ko, na ti. Nangmah le nangmah cu khawzing tlukah na ruat ngaingai aw ding naón khawzing cu na si lo, milai lawng na si."},"3":{"text":"Daniel hnakin ka fim sawn, ka hnen ihsin thuh theimi thuthup a um lo, tiah na ruat."},"4":{"text":"Na fimnak le na thil thiamnak in sui le ngun thawn a lo lianter ngai."},"5":{"text":"Sumtuah cu na thiamzet ih a miat tampi na ngah. Na len ruangah na puarthau ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"“Atu-ah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ka ṭongmi cu hiti in a si: khawzing tlukin ka fim tiih na ruah awk ruangah,"},"7":{"text":"nangmah do dingah, zianghman mizawn ruat lo ral pawl, ka rak hruai ding. Na fimnak le na thil thiamnak thawngin thil mawizet tampi na khawl zomi pawl cu an siatsuah ṭheh ding."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah an lo that ding ih a ciarmi thlaan ah an lo phum ding."},"9":{"text":"Nangmah that dingih an rat tikah khawzing sokhaw ka si na ti thotho ding maw? Nangmah a lo thattu pawl thawn nan ton awk tikah cun khawzing si loin milai lawng na si ko ding."},"10":{"text":"Pathian thei lo ramdangmi kutah uico bangin na thi ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in thu ka pek zo,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka hnenah a ṭong sal.","title":"Ṭai-ar Siangpahrang A Tla"},"12":{"text":"“Milaipa, ṭai-ar siangpahrang ih a tuar dingmi hi ruat in riahsia in um aw. A hnenah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ka ṭongmi hi sim aw: Mi famkim na rak si ih zohṭhim tlak na rak si. Ziangtluk mifim le mipiang so na rak si?"},"13":{"text":"Pathian hmuan - Eden ah na rak um ih lungmankhung a phunphun na rak hruk: ruby le daimon lungmankhung, a aihre lungmankhung, a sen karnelian le jasper lungmankhung, safaira, emerald le garnet lungmankhung pawl na hruk. Sui hlawnthil tampi na nei. Cupawl cu seemsuah na si ni ih na hrangih tuahmi pawl an si."},"14":{"text":"A sunglawi vancungmi cherub cu nangmah kiltu dingah ka ret. Ka tlang thianghlim ah na um ih a tle zohzomi lungmankhung lakah na feh."},"15":{"text":"Seemsuah na si ni in thil ṭha lo tuah na thok ni tiang na nuncan cu soisel ding zianghman a um lo."},"16":{"text":"Thil na lei na zuar ih na buai ih cin le daan nei loin sualnak ah na thleng a si. Curuangah ka tlang thianghlim in ka lo dawi ih a lo kiltu vancungmi in a tleumi lungmankhung pawl lakin a lo dawihlo a si."},"17":{"text":"Mipiang na si ruangah na hngal ih na hminthannak in mi aa ah a lo canter. Curuangah leilung ah ka lo hlon ih siangpahrang dangdang ih ralrinnak dingah ka lo tlansan."},"18":{"text":"Thil na lei i na zuarnak ah a baalmi tampi na tuah ruangah na biakinn hmun pawl tla na borhhlawhter ṭheh. Curuangah khawpi cu meisa in ka ur ih leilung ah a ciam zo. A lo zohtu hmuahhmuah in vutcam ih na can kha an lo hmu."},"19":{"text":"Na van a duai, na cem tariai; a lo theitu miphun hmuahhmuah cu an tuk a sum; nangmah vekah kan cang pang ding, ti an phang,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Sidon Parih Profet ṭong"},"21":{"text":"“Milaipa, Sidon khawpi ṭhatlonak hi rel aw:"},"22":{"text":"An hnenah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ka ṭongmi hi sim aw: Maw Sidon, keimah hi na ral ka si. Na parih thil ka tuahmi ruangah mi in in thangṭhat ding. Na sungih a ummi pawl ka hrem tikah ziangtluk a thianghlim mi ka si ti kha ka langternak a si ih cutiin Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding."},"23":{"text":"Natsia ka run thlengter ding ih na lamzin ah thisen a luang ding. A kiil ih kip in an lo do ding ih na minung pawl an that ding. Cule Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ramhnen pawl, Israel a hmuhsuamtu le a tisiatu pawl cu pakhat hman Israel hrangah hling le so vek an si thei nawn lo ding. Cule keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding,” a ti.","title":"Israel In Malsawm A Dong Ding"},"25":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Israel mi pawl cu ka ṭhekdarhnak ram pawl ihsin ka kirter sal ding ih cuticun miphun hmuahhmuah in a thianghlim mi ka si kha in thei ding. Israel mi pawl cu anmah ih ram, ka siahhlawh Jakob hnenih ka rak pekmi ramah an um ding."},"26":{"text":"Cutawkah daihnak thawn an um ding. Inn an sak ding ih sabit hmuan an tuah ding. Anmah a hmuhsuamtu le a tisiatu an kiangkap ram pawl cu ka hrem ding ih Israel cu thlangamte in a um ding. Cule keimah hi Bawipa an Pathian ka si kha in thei ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum hra kum, thla hra thla, ni hleihnih ni ah, Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Izipt Parih Profet ṭong"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, Izipt siangpahrang ṭhatlonak hi phuang aw. Amah le Izipt ram pumpi hremnak an tuar ding, tiah sim aw."},"3":{"text":"Izipt siangpahrang hnenah, “Cungnungbik Bawipa ih ṭong cu hiti in a si: Nang tiva sungih a bokmi ṭihnungza tisartam, Kei hi na ral ka si. Nail tivapi cu ka ta a si, keimah in ka tuah na ti."},"4":{"text":"Na khabe ah sio ka thluah ding ih na tivapi ih nga pawl cu na kep parah ka kopter ding. Cuih nga pawl thawn tivapi sung ihsin ka lo dirsuak ding."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah siseh, nga pawl siseh nelrawn ah ka lo hlon ding. Na ruangpi cu nelrawn ahcun a taang ding ih zohman in an lo phum lo ding. Na sa cu ramsa le vate rawl ah ka pe ding."},"6":{"text":"Cutiin Izipt mi hmuahhmuah in Bawipa ka si kha an thei ding,” a ti. Bawipa in, “Israel mi pawl in bawmtu dingah nanmah Izipt mi an lo ring, asinain funghreu ṭawnṭai tluk fang na si."},"7":{"text":"An lo vawk tikah na kiak ih an zak nan suntlang; cule an el na merhter."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka lo sim: Nangmah do dingah mi ka run thlah ding; na minung le na ṭilva pawl an that ding."},"9":{"text":"Izipt cu ramṭhing ah a cang ding. Cuticun keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding. “Nail tivapi cu ka ta a si, ka tuahmi a si, na ti ruangah,"},"10":{"text":"Keimah hi na ral le na Nail ih ral ka si. Izipt ram pumpi hi, saklam ah Migdol khua ihsin thlanglam ah Aswan khua tiang, Sudan ramri thlengin ramṭhing ah ka canter ding."},"11":{"text":"Milai siseh, ramsa siseh a sungin zohman an feh lo ding. Kum sawmli sung a sungah zianghman a um lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Leilung pumpuluk ah Izipt ram cu ramṭhing bikah ka tuah ding. Kum sawmli sung Izipt ram khua pawl cu khawrop ah ka tuah ding; khuadang a siatmi hnakin a besia sawn ding. Izipt mi pawl cu raltlan mi ah an cang ding. Ramkip ah an tlan ding ih miphun dangdang lakah an um ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Kum sawmli hnuah Izipt mi pawl cu ka ṭhekdarhnak ram pawl ihsin ka hruaikir sal ding ih,"},"14":{"text":"Izipt thlanglam ram, an suahkehnak khua le ramah ka umter ding. Cutawkah ram ṭawnṭaizet an si ding;"},"15":{"text":"ram hmuahhmuah lakah ram ṭawnṭai bik an si ding ih miphun dang uktu an si dah nawn lo ding. Zianghman ih siartlak lo ah ka tuah ding; anmah ih duh zawng ih hruai theimi pakhat hman an um lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Bawmtu dingah Israel mi in an rinsan nawn lo ding. Izipt ih tuarmi an hmuh tikah annih kan rinsan cu kan rak mawh ngai a si, tiah Israel mi in an thei ding. Cule Israel mi in keimah hi Cungnungbik Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum kul hluan sarih kum, thla khat thla, ni khat ni ah Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Nebuchadnezzar In Izipt A Neh Ding"},"18":{"text":"“Milaipa, Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in ṭai-ar a do a si. Nebuchadnezzar in a ralkap pawl kha thilrit a phurhter ih an thil phurhmi a rih tuk ruangah an lu a kolh ṭheh, an liang khal a kok ṭheh; sikhalsehla an zonzaih tlukin siangpahrang siseh ralkap pawl siseh an ngahmi a um lo."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa in hiti in ka sim: Izipt ram cu siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar hnenah ka pe ding. An ram cu a ram ding ih an thilri a long ding; a ralkap pawl ih thlahlawh dingah Izipt ram lennak cu a phur ṭheh ding."},"20":{"text":"A hnaṭuan man ah Izipt ram ka pe ding, ziangahtile a ralkap pawl in ka hrangah hna an ṭuan a si. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"21":{"text":"“Cubangtuk thil a thlen tikah Israel cu miphun cakzet ah ka tuah ding ih nang Ezekiel cu mi hmuahhmuah ih an lo theih theinak hmun ihsin ka lo ṭongter ding; cuticun Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cun ka hnenah hiti in a sim sal.","title":"In Izipt A Hrem Ding"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, profet ṭong in phuangsuak awla Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ka ṭongmi hi than aw. Hitiin napi in au aw: ṭihnungza ni a thleng ding,"},"3":{"text":"Cuih ni cu a nai zo, Bawipa in a ṭuannak ding ni cu, Miphun pawl hrangah khawdur le harsatnak ni a si."},"4":{"text":"Izipt ramah raldonak a um ding, Sudan ramah vansaannak a um ding. Izipt ramah mi tampi thah an si ding, Ram cu an siatsuah ṭheh ding ih Ramṭhing ah an cangter ding."},"5":{"text":"“Cuih raldonak ahcun Ethiopia ram, Libia ram, Lidia ram, Arabia ram, Kub ram le ka minung lak hman in ralkap an sanmi pawl tampi an thi ding,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Saklam ah Migdol ihsin thlanglam ah Aswan tiang Izipt ram a humtu hmuahhmuah cu raldonak ah an thi ṭheh ding. A zum-aw zetmi Izipt ralkap pawl cu siatsuah ṭheh an si ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"7":{"text":"An ram cu leilung pumpuluk ah ramṭhing bikah a cang ding ih an khua pawl cu hnawmpen ah an cang thluh relrel ding."},"8":{"text":"Izipt ram cu meisa in ka ur ih a humtu pawl thah ṭheh an si tikah, Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding."},"9":{"text":"“Cuih ni a ra thlen ih Izipt cu siatsuah ṭheh a si tikah thlangamte ih a ummi Ethiopia mi pawl hnenah long in thu phurtu ka thlah ding ih Ethiopia mi pawl an tuk a sum ding. Cuih ni cu a ra thleng cing ding,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Izipt lennak cemtertu dingah Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar ka hmang ding."},"11":{"text":"Amah le a ralkap pawl cu ram tisiat ṭhehtu dingah an ra ding. Izipt ram cu ralnam thawn an do ding ih ram sungah miruak a khat ding."},"12":{"text":"Nail tivapi ka caarter ding ih Izipt ram cu mi ṭha lo pawl kuthnuai ah ka re ding. Ramdangmi pawl in a ram pumpuluk in an tisiat ṭheh ding. Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Memfis ih a ummi milem pawl le khuavang pawl cu ka siat ṭheh ding. Izipt ram uktu ding zohman an um lo ding ih mi hmuahhmuah an thin ka phangter ṭheh ding."},"14":{"text":"Izipt thlanglam ih Pathros khua cu khawṭhing ah ka tuah ding ih saklam ih a ummi Zoan khua cu meisa in ka ur ding. Thebes khua cu ka hrem ding."},"15":{"text":"Izipt ram sungih ruhkulh nasa bik a neitu Pelusium khua cu ka aithawhnak ka tuarter ding. Thebes khua ih lennak cu ka siatsuah ding."},"16":{"text":"Izipt cu meisa in ka ur ding ih Pelusium cu harsatnak a tuar ding. Thebes khua ih khawkulh phardawl pawl cu bal ṭheh a si ding ih khawsung cu tidai in a khat ding."},"17":{"text":"Heliopolis khua le Bubastis khua ih tlangval pawl ral kutin an thi ding ih midang pawl cu salkaihmi ah an cang ding."},"18":{"text":"Izipt cahnak ka khiak ih an uar zetmi an thazaang ka cemter tikah cun Tahpanhes parah khawthim a thleng ding. Khawdur in Izipt cu a khuh ding ih Izipt ramih khawsungmi pawl hmuahhmuah cu ralkaihmi ah an cang ding."},"19":{"text":"Cutiih Izipt ka hrem tikah cun Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum hleikhat kum, thla khat thla, ni sarih ni ah Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Izipt Siangpahrang Ih Cahnak A Cem"},"21":{"text":"“Milaipa, Izipt siangpahrang ih baan ka khiak zo. Damter dingah le ralnam kai sal thei ding tlak ih cak sal dingah zohman in an buah sak lo ih an tuam sak fawn lo."},"22":{"text":"Atu-ah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in hiti in ka sim: Izipt siangpahrang ih ral cu keimah ka si. A baan pakhat a ṭha hrih mi siseh, a kiak zo mi siseh, ka khiak ding ih a kut ihsin a ralnam a tla ding."},"23":{"text":"Leilung tlun khuazakip ah Izipt mi pawl cu ka ṭhekdarh ṭheh ding."},"24":{"text":"Cule Babilon siangpahrang ih baan ka cakter ding ih ka ralnam a kut sungah ka pek ding. Asinain Izipt siangpahrang ih baan cu ka khiak ding ih hrum rero in a ral hmaiah cun hmapu in a ril ding."},"25":{"text":"Asi, anih cu ka ṭawnṭaihter ding ih Babilon siangpahrang cu ka cakter ding. A hnenah ka ralnam ka pek ih Izipt ram lamih a hawi tikah cun mi hmuahhmuah in Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding."},"26":{"text":"Leilung tlun khuazakip ah Izipt mi pawl cu ka ṭhekdarh ṭheh ding. Cuticun Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum hleikhat kum, thla thum thla, ni khat ni ah Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Izipt Le Sidar Thing Tahṭhimnak"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, Izipt siangpahrang le a minung pawl hnenah hiti in sim aw: Huham na va nei lawmmam so! Ziangthawn so ka lo ṭhim ding?"},"3":{"text":"Lebanon ramih sidar thing bangtuk na si; A mawizet le a niimzet mi hnge thawn, Mero tawt tiangin a saangzet mi thing na si."},"4":{"text":"Cuih thing ṭhantertu dingah tidai a um; A cawmtu dingah leilung hnuai ah tiva an um; Cuih thing dinnak hmun cu an ciarter ringring; Tupi sungih thing dang hnenah tivate an thlenter."},"5":{"text":"Tidai ṭhate ih a ngah ruangah, Cuih thing cu thing dang hnakin a sang sawn; A hnge pawl an tam ih an sau."},"6":{"text":"Vate phunkim in a hnge parah bu an sak; A thlahnem ah ramsa pawl in faate an nei; A hneemdai ah leilung miphunkip an cawl."},"7":{"text":"Cuih thingkung cu ziangtluk in a mawi! A saangzet ih a hnge an sau zet fawn; A hram pawl cu thukzet ih a luang mi tidai an thleng."},"8":{"text":"Pathian hmuan ih sidar thing hman in a tluk lo; Ziangvek farthing hman cuvek hnge nei an um lo; Ziangvek tupifar hman in cuvek ṭeek ṭha an nei lo; Pathian hmuan sung hmanah cutluk thing mawi an um lo."},"9":{"text":"Mawizet ih ka tuahmi a si, a zaammi hnge thawn; Pathian ih Eden hmuan thing pawl ih dawt kuahkomi a si."},"10":{"text":"Atu-ah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in mero tawt ko ih a ṭhangmi thingkung parah ziangvek thil a thleng ding ti ka lo sim ding. Cuih thingkung cu a sang deuhdeuh ih a hngal deuhdeuh."},"11":{"text":"Cutiih a hngal ruangah amah cu ka hnong zo; ramdang bawi ih kut sungah ka thlengter zo. Cuih bawi cun a ṭhatlonak vekin a parah hna a ṭuan ding."},"12":{"text":"Zaangfahnak zianghman nei lo ramdangmi in an hau ding ih an tlansan ding. A kiakmi a ṭeek le a hnge pawl cu ramsung tlangpar le phairawn kipah an tla ding. A hneemdai hnuai ih a ummi miphun hmuahhmuah in an tlansan ding."},"13":{"text":"A tlumi thing parah cun vate pawl an ra fu ding ih a hnge tlun ah ramsa pawl an vak ding."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah atu thok ihsin thingkung dang cu ziangvek ṭha in tidai an ngah khalle cuih thingkung vek cun an sang thei nawn lo ding ih mero a tawttu thing an um nawn lo ding. An zatein milai vekin thi ṭheh ding an si ih mithi khua ih a rak fehcia pawl a vun thlun vetu an si ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in hiti in a sim: “Cuih thingkung mithi khua ih a feh ni ah, riahsiatnak langternak ah, leilung hnuai tidai cu amah khuhtu ah ka tuah ding. Tivapi pawl ka kaitaar ding ih tivate pawl cu ka luangter lo ding. Cuih thingkung a thih ruangah Lebanon Tlang sang parah thimkhawzing ka tlunter ding ih tupi sung ih thingkung hmuahhmuah ka vuaiter ṭheh ding."},"16":{"text":"Mithi khua ih ka vun kuat tikah, a tluk thawmvang in miphun pawl a hninter ṭheh ding. Cuih thingkung a tluk ruangah Eden hmuan ih thingkung hmuahhmuah, a hleice ih hrilmi thing pawl le tidai ṭhazet ih a ngahtu Lebanon thingkung pawl cu mithi khua ih a rak fehciatu thing pawl an si ruangah an lung a awizet ding."},"17":{"text":"Cuih thingkung thawn hmunkhat ah a tlu ciami thingkung pawl fin dingah mithi khua Sheol ah an vung feh ding. A hneemdai ih a ummi hmuahhmuah cu miphun dangdang lakah ṭhekdarh ṭheh an si ding,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Hi thingkung cu Izipt siangpahrang le a minung pawl an si. Eden hmuan ih thingkung pawl hman amah vekih a saangmi le mi mit la thei an um lo. Sikhalsehla atu ahcun Eden hmuan ih thingkung dang vek ṭhiamṭhiam in mithi khua ah a feh pei ih raldonak ih a thimi le Pathian thei lo mi pawl a vun fin ding a si. Keimah in ka sim zo,” tiah Cungnungbik Bawipa in a ti."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum hleihnih kum, thla hleihnih thla, ni khat ni ah Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Izipt Siangpahrang Cu Tisartam Vek A Si"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, Izipt siangpahrang hnenah ralrinnak fiangtein pe aw. Ka thu cu a hnenah hiti in sim aw: Miphun pawl lakah kiosa vekin hna na ṭuan, asinain tiva sungih a vak reromi tisartam vek sokhaw na si. Na ke in tidai na nawiter ih tiva pawl na balter ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Miphun pawl an tonkhawm awk tikah ka sur in ka lo awk ding ih annih in tikap ah an lo dir ding."},"4":{"text":"Leilung parah ka lo hlon ding ih na sa eitu dingah leilungtlun vate le ramsa hmuahhmuah ka ko ding."},"5":{"text":"A ṭoih hluahhlomi na ruak cu tlang le nelrawn pawl khuhnakah ka hmang ding."},"6":{"text":"Na thisen in tlangsaang pawl a hnih ṭheh hlanlo le tivate pawl a khahter ṭheh hlanlo ka thle rero ding."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah ka lo siatsuah tikah cun van khi lang loin ka khuh ding ih arsi pawl ka thimter ṭheh ding. Ni cu khawdur phenah a relh ding ih thlapi khal a vang lo ding."},"8":{"text":"Van ih a ummi tleunak hmuahhmuah ka hmit ṭheh ding ih na ram cu thimnak in a khuh ṭheh ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"9":{"text":"“Ka lo siatsuahnak thuthang cu na theih dah lomi ram pawl sungih ka phuan tikah miphun tampi an thin a nuamlo ding."},"10":{"text":"Na parih thil ka tuahmi hin miphun tampi mangbang zetin a tuah ding. Ka ralnam ka vai tikah cun siangpahrang tampi thinphang in an khur thlohthlo ding. Nangmah na tluk ni ahcun an zatein anmah ih nunnak ruat ah thinphang in an ṭhia rero ding,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in Izipt siangpahrang hnenah, “Babilon siangpahrang ih ralnam na tong ding."},"12":{"text":"Zaangfah nei lo miphun pawl ih ralkap pawl in an ralnam an suah ding ih na minung pawl an sattan ding. Na minung pawl le na uanawknak thilri dang hmuahhmuah cu an siatsuah ṭheh ding."},"13":{"text":"Tiva kua kipah na ṭilva pawl ka that ding ih tidai nawitertu ah minung siseh, ṭilva siseh tiva kua ah an feh nawn lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Na tidai ih hnawm pawl cu a taw ah ka ṭhutter ding ih na tiva pawl cu thiangfai zetin ka luangter ding ih hriak bangin a fim ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"15":{"text":"Izipt cu ramṭhing ah ka tuah ih cutawk minung hmuahhmuah ka siatsuah ṭheh tikah cun keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding."},"16":{"text":"Hi ralrinnak pekmi hi mithi phumnak hla ah a cang ding. Izipt le a minung pawl parih riahsiatnak langternak dingah miphun tampi nunau pawl in an sak ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum hleihnih kum, thla khat thla, ni hleinga ni ah Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Mithi Khua"},"18":{"text":"“Milaipa, Izipt mi pawl hrangah mithi ngai in um aw. Mithi khua ah miphun cak zetzet pawl thawn vun kuat aw."},"19":{"text":"An hnenah cun: Midang hnakin ka mawi cuang tiah na ruat aw maw? Mithi khua ah na vung feh ding ih, Pathian thei lo pawl thawn daiziar in na um ding."},"20":{"text":"“Izipt mi pawl cu ral kutih a thimi pawl thawn an tlu ding. Anmah that ṭhehtu dingah ralnam tiarcia in a um."},"21":{"text":"Ralṭha bik pawl le Izipt ṭan ih raldotu pawl in mithi khua in Izipt mi pawl an rak hmuak ih, ‘Ral kutih a thimi Pathian theilotu pawl cu hinah an rung ih an umta a si,’ tiah an au."},"22":{"text":"“Cunah Assiria a um ve; a ralkap pawl ih thlaan cu a kiangkap hmunkip ah an um. An zatein ral kutih thi an si."},"23":{"text":"An thlaan pawl cu mithi khua thuknak bikah an um. A ralkap pawl cu raldonak ah an thi ih an thlaan in a thlaan an kulh. Cupawl cu an dam laiah a nungmi pawl ram a ṭhihṭhaih rerotu an rak si."},"24":{"text":"“Elam khal cunah a um; a ralkap pawl ih thlaan cu a kiangkap ah an um ṭheh. An zatein ral kutih a thimi an si ih mithi khua ahcun serhtan loin an vung feh. An dam laiah cun tuksumnak khuazakip ah a rak umtertu an si naón atu ahcun mualpho le daiziar in an um zo."},"25":{"text":"Elam cu ralkut in a thimi pawl lakah a it; a ralkap pawl ih thlaan cu a kiangkap ah an um. An zatein serhtan lo, ral kut thi lawnglawng an si. An nun laiah cun khuazakip ah tuksumnak a khahtertu an si; asinain atu ahcun ral pawl ih thah mi lakah an tel ih mualpho le daiziar in an thi."},"26":{"text":"“Meshek le Tubal khal cunah an um; an ralkap pawl ih thlaan cu an kiangkap ah an um. An zatein serhtan lo, ral thahmi lawnglawng an si. A nungmi pawl a ṭhihṭhaihtu bik an rak si."},"27":{"text":"Khuahlan ih ralṭha hminthang pawl cu an thih tikah hriamnam kim thawn an phum. An ralnam cu an lu hnuai ah an ret ih an ralphaw cu an ruangpi parah an ret. Asinain annih cu cuvekin upatnak thawn phum an tong lo. Hi ralṭha pawl cu a nungmi pawl ṭhihṭhaih thei dingin huham an rak nei."},"28":{"text":"“Cuvekin Izipt mi pawl cu serhtan lo, ral thahmi pawl lakah palcih mi ah an cang ding."},"29":{"text":"“Edom khal cutawkah a siangpahrang pawl le a hotu pawl thawn an um. Anmah cu ralkap cak zetzet an rak si, asinain atu ahcun mithi khua ah serhtan lo, ralthahmi pawl thawn an um a si."},"30":{"text":"“Saklam ih siangpahrang pawl tla cunah an um; Sidon mi pawl khal an um ve. An huham in khuazakip ah ṭihphang in mi an rak tuah, asinain atu ahcun ral thahmi le serhtan lo pawl thawn mualpho in an cawl zo. Mithi khua ih a vung fehtu pawl thawn mualphonak cu an ṭawm aw a si."},"31":{"text":"“Hitiih ral ih thahmi pawl hmuahhmuah an hmuh tikah Izipt le a ralkap pawl hrangah cun an hnem awknak a si ding,” tiah Cungnungbik Bawipa in a ti."},"32":{"text":"“Izipt siangpahrang cu a nungmi pawl ṭhihṭhaihtu si dingah ka ngaihtuah; asinain amah le a ralkap pawl cu thah an si ding ih ral kutin a thimi serhtan lo pawl thawn phum an si ding,” tiah a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"In Kilvengtu Ah Ezekiel A Tuah (Eze. 3.16-21)"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, ram pakhat ih raldonak ka thlenter tikah ziang a cang ṭheu ti cu na minung pawl sim aw. Cuih ram minung pawl in anmah lakah mi pakhat kilvengtu ah an hril a si."},"3":{"text":"Ral an rat a hmuh tikah mi hmuahhmuah ralrin peknak ah tawtawrawt a tum."},"4":{"text":"Mi pakhat in cuih tum thawmvang a thei naón zianghman ah a siar lo ih ral pawl ra in amah an that a si ahcun a thisen cu amah ih lu parah a um, amah mawhthluk ding a si."},"5":{"text":"Ralrinnak pekmi a thei naón zianghman ih a siar lo ruangah a thih cu amah ih mawh a si. Ralrinnak an pekmi rak ngaita sehla a luat thei ding naón!"},"6":{"text":"Sihmansehla ralvengtu in ral pawl an rat kha a hmu naón tawtawrawt a tum lo a si ahcun ral an ra ding ih cuih misual pawl cu an that ding. An thisen man cu ralvengtu ih hnenah ka hlam ding."},"7":{"text":"“Maw milaipa, nangmah hi Israel miphun hrangah ralvengtu ah ka lo tuah ding. Ralrinnak ka lo pekmi cu an hnenah na pe sin pei."},"8":{"text":"Misual pakhat a thi ding tiah ka than ih a nunnak hum thei dingah a nuncan thleng dingin ralrinnak na pek lo ahcun misual si in a thi ding. A thisen man cu na parah ka hlam ding."},"9":{"text":"Ralrinnak na pek naón sualtuah a bansan cuang lo a si ahcun misual in a thi ding; asinain na nunnak cu a him ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Milaipa, Israel mi pawl in ‘Kan sualnak le thil ṭha lo kan tuahmi in kan thil in ritter a si. Kan taksa a ṭum zutzo. Ziangtin so kan nun thei ding?’ tiah an ti rero vekin an hnenah ti sal aw.","title":"Pumpak ṭuanvo"},"11":{"text":"Ṭhatein sim aw; Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah, a nungmi Pathian ka si vekin ka sim: misual pakhat a thih hmuh cu ka lungawi zawng a si lo. Sualnak bansan ih a nun hmuh ka duh sawn. Maw Israel, thil ṭha lo na tuahmi cu bang thlang aw. Ziangah so thih cu na duh?"},"12":{"text":"“Milaipa, Israel mipawl sim aw: mi ṭha pakhat a sual ahcun a rak ṭhatnak khan a run lo ding. Mi ṭha lo pa in ṭhatlonak a bansan a si ahcun hrem a si lo ding; a sinan mi ṭha pakhat in sualnak tuah a thok a si ahcun a nunnak cu zuah a si lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Mi ṭha pakhat hnenah nunnak thu ka tiam; asinain thil ṭha a rak tuah ciami kha a tawk ti ih a ruah tlunah sualnak a tuah a si ahcun thil ṭha a rak tuahmi kha ka ciing nawn lo ding. A sualnak ruangah a thi ding."},"14":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pakhat cu na thi ding tiah ralrinnak ka pek; asinain sual tuah a bansan ih a dingmi le a ṭhami a tuah ahcun,"},"15":{"text":"thuṭhimnak ah tangka cawitu ih thukamnak thil a lakmi kha a khirh sal ih tlunah a rak rukmi thil khal a pek kir a si ahcun, sualnak a bansan ih nunnak petu daan a thlun ruangah a thi lo ding, a nung ding a si."},"16":{"text":"Sualnak a tuahmi pawl kha ka ngaidam ding; a ding le a ṭhami a tuah ruangah a nung ding a si."},"17":{"text":"“Cule na minung pawl in ka thil tuah daan hi a dik lo a si, an ti. Asilo, anmah ih thil tuah daan sawn a dik lo a si."},"18":{"text":"Miding pakhat in thil ṭha tuah nawn loin thil ṭha lo tuah a thok ahcun cumi ruangah a thi ding a si."},"19":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pakhat in sualnak tuah a baansan ih a dingmi le a ṭhami a tuah tikah cun a nunnak a hum ngah a si."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Israel, ka tuahmi hi nang in a dik lo na ti. Zokhal nan tuahmi vekin thu ka lo ṭhen ding,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum hleihnih kum, thla hra thla, ni nga ni ah Jerusalem ihsin a luat mipa pakhat ka hnenah a ra ih Jerusalem khawpi a siat zo a si, tiah i ra sim.","title":"Jerusalem Siatnak Thuthang"},"22":{"text":"Cupa a ra thlen hlan ni khatnak zanlam ah Bawipa ih umpinak nasa zetin ka hnenah a thleng. Cupa cu a thaizing a ra thlen tikah Bawipa in ṭong theinak huham i pek sal. Curuangah ka ṭong thei sal."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Mipi Pawlih Sualnak"},"24":{"text":"“Milaipa, Israel ramih a siat ṭheh zomi khawsungih a ummi mipi pawl in, ‘Abraham cu pakhat lawng asinain ram pumpi a hnenah pek a si. Kannih cu mi tamzet kan si ih atu-ah hi ram cu kanmah ih ta a si ve zo,’ an ti."},"25":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ka ṭongmi hi sim aw: A sungih thi a um laimi sa nan ei a si. Milem nan bia. Mi nan that! Hi ram hi kanmah ih ta a si, tiah ziangtinso nan ruah thei?"},"26":{"text":"Nan ralnam hi nan rinsan. Nan thil tuahmi pawl hi fihnungza an si. Zokhal in ṭaangṭawm sualnak nan tuah. Hi ram hi kan ta a si tiah ziangin so a lo ruahter?"},"27":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah hi a nungmi Pathian ka si vekin ralrinnak ka pek, sim aw: a siatṭhehmi khawsungih a ummi pawl cu thah an si ding. Hramlak ih a ummi minung pawl cu sahrang in a ei ding. Tlangpar le lungpuk sungih a relhmi pawl cu natnak in an thi ding."},"28":{"text":"Hi ram cu ramṭhing ah keimah in ka tuah ding ih an uar zetmi an cah-nak cu a cem ding a si. Israel ramih tlangsaang pawl cu a ruul tuk ding ih a sungin zohman in an pah thei lo ding."},"29":{"text":"Mipi pawl an sual ruangah ka hrem ih an ram cu ramṭhing ih ka tuah tikah cun keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Milaipa, na minung pawl cu khawkulhnak phardawl kiangah siseh, an inn sangka kiangah siseh, an ton awk tikah nangmah ih thu lawng an rel. Pakhat le pakhat, ‘Atu-ah Bawipa ih ṭongkam ziang bangtuk si a ra thleng, kan va ngai pei,’ tiah an ti aw.","title":"Profet ṭong An Thei"},"31":{"text":"Curuangah ka minung pawl cu, milai ih an tuah ṭheu vekin, na thusimmi ngai dingah an khawm aw ciamco, asinain tuah dingih na fialmi an tuah lo. Duhdawtnak ṭong cu an hmur in a suak, asinain an duhham lai thotho."},"32":{"text":"An hrangah nang cu, na zai ṭha thawn, an thabaang colhdamnak ih ngaihla saktu hnakin na uak cuang lo; ṭingṭang tumtu men ah na cang. Na ṭongmi cu an thei ṭheh naón pakhat hman an thlun hrimhrim lo."},"33":{"text":"Asinain na ṭongmi hmuahhmuah a kim tikah cun, an kim thluh ding sikhawh, cutik lawngah anmah lakih profet na um kha an thei ding,” a ti."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Israel Tuukhal Pawl"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, Israel uktu pawl an ṭhat lo zia hi sim aw. Profet ṭong in simsuak awla Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in an hnenih ka ṭongmi hi sim aw: Nannih Israel tuukhal pawl, nan cem a si! Nanmah le nanmah cu nan kilkhawi aw zet naón nan tuu pawl cu nan kilkhawi dah lo."},"3":{"text":"Tuuhnawi nan in, tuuhmul hnipuan nan hruk, tuu ṭha bik pawl nan that ih nan ei. Sikhalsehla tuu cu nan kilkhawi dah lo."},"4":{"text":"Tuu ṭawnṭai pawl ṭhatein nan zoh lo, a na mi pawl nan tuamhlawm lo, tuahmawhnak a tongmi pawl an hma nan tuam sak lo, a hlo ih a tawivakmi pawl hawl in nan hruaikir lo, a si lole a hlomi pawl nan hawl duh hrimhrim lo. Nan tisiat sawn a si."},"5":{"text":"Cuih tuu pawl cu khaaltu an neih lo ruangah ramkip ah ṭhekdarh ṭheh an si ih sahrang pawl in an deh ih an ei."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah ka tuu pawl cu thlua le tlang lakah an vakvai. Leilung tlun khuazakip ah ṭhekdarh ṭheh an si ih zohman in an hawl lo, hruai tumtu khal an um lo."},"7":{"text":"“Tuukhal pawl, Bawipa keimah in nan hnenih ka lo simmi hi ngaihnik uh."},"8":{"text":"A nungmi Pathian ka si ih fiangtein ka lo sim. Ka simmi nan ngai le a ṭha sawn. Tuukhal an um lo ruangah ka tuu pawl cu sahrang in an nam, an deh ih an ei a si. Ka tuukhal pawl in tuu cu a hawl an tum lo. Tuu pawl si loin anmah sawn an kilkhawi aw."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah tuukhal pawl, ka simmi hi ngaihnik uh."},"10":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka run phuang: Keimah hi nan ral ka si. Ka tuu pawl cu nan hnen ihsin ka la ding ih anmah khaaltu nan si sal nawn lo ding, nanmah le nanmah khal ka lo kilkhawi awter nawn lo ding. Nan hnen ihsin ka tuu pawl cu ka la ding ih nan ei nawn lo ding a si."},"11":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka lo sim: Keimah rori in ka tuu pawl cu ka hawl ding ih ka kilkhawi ding.","title":"Tuukhal ṭha"},"12":{"text":"Tuukhal in a vakvaimi tuu pawl cu a zohṭha ih a hruaikhawm bangin ka tuah ve ding. Khawthim le siatralnak ni ih ṭhekdarh ṭheh an rak sinak hmunkip ihsin ka hruaikhawm ṭheh ding."},"13":{"text":"Ramdang dang ihsin ka suahter hai ding ih hmun khatah finkhawm in anmah ih ramah ka hruai ding. Israel tlang sang pawl le tiva kapah ka hruai ding ih hramhring umnak hmun nuam ah ka cawm hai ding."},"14":{"text":"Israel ramsung tlangpar phuul lakah siseh, tiva kuam ah siseh, phairawn hramhring lakah siseh, hnangam zetin an tlang ding ih hrampi an piat huahho ding."},"15":{"text":"Ka tuu pawl khaaltu cu keimah ka si ding ih colhnak hmun khal ka hawl sak ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"16":{"text":"“A hlomi tuu pawl ka hawl ding, a vakvaimi pawl ka hruaikir ding, hma a neimi pawl an hma ka tuamsak ding ih a nami pawl ka damter ding; asinain a thaumi le a cakmi pawl cu ka tisiat ṭheh ding, ziangahtile kei cu a dingmi tuahtu tuukhal ka si."},"17":{"text":"“Cun ka tuurual pawl, Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka lo sim: pumpak ciar in nan thu ka ṭhen ding ih a ṭhami le a siami cu ka lo thiadang ding; tuu le me ka ṭhen ding."},"18":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat cu hrampi ṭha bik nan ei hi nan lung a kim hrih lo; nan ei lomi tla nan palbeek ṭheh a si! Tidai fimzet nan in ih nan in lomi tidai cu nan nawiter!"},"19":{"text":"Ka tuurual dang pawl cun nan palbeek mi hrampi le nan nawitermi tidai an in a ṭul a si."},"20":{"text":"“Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka lo sim: nanmah tuu cak le tuu ṭawnṭai karlakih thuṭhentu ka si ding."},"21":{"text":"Tuu cak lo le tuu dam lo pawl kha a kapah nan engpet ih lengah pawt ko in nan khik."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka tuu pawl cu ka run ding ih nan tisiat nawn lo ding. Ka tuu pawl pakhat hnu pakhat in an thu ka ṭhen ding ih a ṭha le a sia ka dang ding."},"23":{"text":"Anmah khaaltu dingah i riantu David bangtuk siangpahrang ka pe ding ih a kilkhawi hai ding."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa keimah hi an Pathian ka si ding ih anmah uktu siangpahrang cu i riantu David vek a si ding. Keimah in ka sim zo."},"25":{"text":"An himnak dingah anmah thawn thukamnak ka tuah ding. Ram sungih ṭihnungza sahrang pawl hmuahhmuah ka hloter ṭheh ding ih cuticun ka tuu pawl cu hramlakah thlangamte in an um ding ih tupi sungah an bok huahho ding."},"26":{"text":"“Thlua ka suah hai ding ih ka tlang thianghlim kiangkap ah an um ding. Cutawkah an ṭul tikah thlawsuah ruah ka surter ding."},"27":{"text":"Thingkung pawl in rah an rah ding, an loram in thlairawl a suah ding; cuticun zokhal anmah ih ram ciarah hnangamte in an um ding. Ka minung pawl an ṭeemnak thir cikcin cu ka botcat ṭheh ding ih salih a tuahtu pawl kutsung ihsin ka luatter tikah Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding."},"28":{"text":"Pathian thei lo miphun pawl in an ram nawm lo ding ih sahrang pawl khal in an deh an ei nawn lo ding. Hnangamzet in an um ding ih zohman in an ṭhihṭhaih lo ding."},"29":{"text":"Ram ṭha ka pe ding ih an ram sungih paamnak cu ka rehter ding. Miphun dang pawl in an hnihsan nawn lo ding."},"30":{"text":"Israel cu ka hum ih ka minung an si kha mi hmuahhmuah in an thei ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"31":{"text":"“Nannih ka tuu pawl, ka cawmmi ka tuurual pawl cu ka minung nan si ih Keimah hi nan Pathian ka si,” tiah Cungnungbik Bawipa in a ti."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Pathian Ih Edom A Hremnak"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, Edom ram ṭhat lonak hi sim aw."},"3":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ka ṭongmi hi sim aw: “Edom tlangsaang pawl, keimah hi nan ral ka si! Ramṭhing ah ka lo tuah ding."},"4":{"text":"Na khua pawl cu khawrop ah ka canter ding; Na ram cu ramṭhing ah ka tuah ding. Cule Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding."},"5":{"text":"Israel ih ral na si ringring ih an sual ruangah neta bik hremnak an tuar tik le siatralnak an ton tikah a minung pawl cu thah dingah na ngaihtuah a si."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah kei cu a nungmi Pathian Cungnungbik Bawipa ka si vekin ka lo sim: na lamzin cu thihnak lamzin a si ih na luat thei lo ding. Na mawhnak cu mithah a si ih mithahnak in a lo thlun ding."},"7":{"text":"Edom tlangpar ram cu ramṭhing ah ka tuah ding ih cuih ramsung a fehtu hmuahhmuah cu ka that ding."},"8":{"text":"Tlangpar cu ruak thawn ka khahter ding; ral kutin a thimi pawl ih ruak in tlang le phairawn pawl cu ka khahter ding."},"9":{"text":"Kumkhua in ramṭhing ah ka lo tuah ding ih na khua pawl sungah minung zohman an um sal nawn lo ding. Cuticun Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding."},"10":{"text":"“ Bawipa keimah hi Judah le Israel ih Pathian ka si naón cuih ram pahnih cu an ram hmuahhmuah thawn keimah ih ta an si, na ti."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah keimah hi Cungnungbik Bawipa , a nungmi Pathian ka si bangtuk in ka lo sim: ka minung pawl parah thinhengnak, iksiiknak le huatnak na neih ruangah ka lo thungrul ve ding. An parih thil na tuahmi ruangah ka lo hrem kha an thei ding."},"12":{"text":"Cuticun Israel tlangsaang pawl hi an ṭhing ih ka duhduh in ka ei ding, tiah hmuhsuamnak thawn na ṭongmi cu keimah Bawipa in ka thei a si, ti hi na thei ding."},"13":{"text":"Ka parah puarthauzet le uang-awzet ih na ṭong rero ṭheu cu ka thei ṭheh a si,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Ramṭhing ah ka lo tuah ding ih cutiih na siat ṭheh cu leilung pumpi in an lo hmuh tikah an lung a awi ding."},"15":{"text":"Ka ta a si mi Israel in siatsuahnak a ton tikih na di a riam vekin na parah ka tuah ve ding. Seir tlangsaang pawl, a si, Edom ram pumpi in ramṭhing ah a cang ding. Cuticun mi hmuahhmuah in keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding,” a ti."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Milaipa, Israel tlangsaang pawl hnenah thu sim awla Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in an hnenih ka sim mi thu hi ngai dingah sim aw.","title":"Israel Parih Pathian Thlawsuahnak"},"2":{"text":"Israel ih ral pawl cun, ‘Khi khuahlan tlang pawl cu kan ta an si zo,’ tiah tluang an khawng."},"3":{"text":"“Profet ṭong in phuangsuak awla Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ka simmi hi than aw. Kiangkap ram pawl in Israel tlangpar ram pawl an lak ih an siim tikah mi hmuahhmuah in Israel cu an hnihsan."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in kiangkap ram pawl in an siim ih an hnihsan rero mi nannih tlangsaang le tlangniam pawl, tivate le phairawn pawl, hmunrop ih cantermi hmun pawl, ṭiosanmi khua pawl hnenih ka simmi hi ngai uh:"},"5":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka thinsahru in kiangkap ram pawl, hleice in Edom ram parah ka sim zo a si. Hni surso le nautatnak thawn ka ram cu an lak ih hmun nuam pawl an luah ṭheh a si."},"6":{"text":"“Curuangah Israel ram hnenah profet ṭong in phuang aw. Miphun dang pawl in an hmuhsuam ih mual an photer ruangah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in thiiknak le thinhengnak thawn ka simmi hi Israel tlangsaang le tlangniam pawl, tivate le phairawn pawl hnenah sim aw."},"7":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in siatcam in ka kam a si: kiangkap ram pawl cu ningzak le mualpho in an um ding."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nan tlangsaang parah zanthing kung pawl ih hnah cu an cerh sal ding ih ka minung Israel nanmah pawl hrangah an rah ding. Nan inn ah nan tlung cing ding."},"9":{"text":"Nan lamah ka ṭang ding ih nan ram cu thlawhmi le thlaici tuhmi ramah ka canter tengteng ding."},"10":{"text":"Nan minung khal ka lo pungzaiter ding. Khawpi sungah nan um ding ih siatsuah ciami pawl cu nan dinsal vivo ding."},"11":{"text":"Milai siseh, ṭilva siseh ka karhzaiter ding. A hlan hnakin minung nan tam deuh ding ih faate tla tampi nan nei ding. A hlanih nan rak um ṭheu vekin cutawkah nan um ding ih tuihhlan hnakin mi ṭhangso ah ka lo tuah ding. Cuticun Bawipa ka si hi nan thei ding."},"12":{"text":"Ka minung Israel pawl cu ka lo hruaikir ding ih ram sungah ka lo umter sal ding. Nanmah ih ram a si ding ih nan tefa pawl khal rilrawng in an um lo ding."},"13":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim: Mi in hi ram cu a minung a eitu le amah ih ramsung fa lala a rutu ram a si, tiah an ti ngai."},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu thok ihsin misa eitu le mahih faate pawl a rutu a si nawn lo ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"15":{"text":"Anmah hnihsuahsainak ah a hmangtu le a rak hnihsan rerotu miphun pawl ih thu cu hi ram in a ngai nawn lo ding. Hi ram in a miphun ih faate pawl khal a ru nawn lo ding. Bawipa Pathian keimah in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Israel Ih Nun Thar"},"17":{"text":"“Milaipa, Israel mi pawl an ram sungih an rak um laiah an nuncan le an tuahmi in an ram a balter. Nunau cu thlatin thi a neih laiah cun mi thiang lo ih ruah an si vekin an nuncan hi ka hmaiah a thiang lo a si."},"18":{"text":"An ram sungah mi thisen an luanter ih milem pawl bia tahrat in an ram an balhter ruangah ka thinhengnak cu nasa zetin an parah ka burh."},"19":{"text":"An nuncan le an tuahmi ruangah ka hnong hai ih ram dangdang ah ka ṭhekdarh ṭheh."},"20":{"text":"An fehnak ram kipah mi in ‘An Pathian ih pekmi ram an tlansan a si,’ an ti ruangah ka hmin thianghlim cu an thangsiat."},"21":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in an fehnak ram kipah in thangsiat ruangah ka hmin thianghlim ka pamhmaih a si."},"22":{"text":"“Atu-ah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in an hnenih ka sim duhmi thu hi Israel mi hnenah sim aw: Thil ka tuah dingmi cu Israel nanmah ih zawn ka ruah ruangah a si lo, nan fehnak ram kipah ka hmin thianghlim nan thangsiat ih cuih ka hmin thianghlim cu pamhmai ka ti ruangah a si sawn."},"23":{"text":"Miphun pawl lakah ka hmin cu nan thangsiat. Cuih mi pawl lakah a nasami ka hmin ih thianhlim zia ka langter tikah Bawipa ka si hi an thei ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo. Miphun pawl hnenih ka hmin thianhlimnak langtertu dingah nanmah ka lo hmang ding."},"24":{"text":"Miphun kip le ramkip ihsin ka lo la ding ih nanmah ih ramah ka lo kirpi ding."},"25":{"text":"Tidai thiangfai ka lo theh ding ih milem biaknak hmuahhmuah le a lo borhhlawhtertu hmuahhmuah khal ka thiangfaiter ding."},"26":{"text":"Thinlung thar le nunnak thar ka lo pe ding. Lungto bangih a hak mi nan thinlung cu ka la ding ih thinlung neemte ka lo pe ding."},"27":{"text":"Nan sungah ka thlarau ka khum ding ih ka daan pawl le ka thupekmi pawl nan thlun thei ding."},"28":{"text":"Cuticun nan pupa pawl hnenih ka pekmi ram sungah nan um ding. Nannih cu ka minung nan si ding ih kei hi nan Pathian ka si ding."},"29":{"text":"A lo baaltertu hmuahhmuah ihsin ka lo hum ding. Nan rawl ka karhzaiter ding ih cuticun paam nan tong nawn lo ding."},"30":{"text":"Nan thingrah le nan lorawl ka karhter ding ih cuticun paam tong loin miphun pawl lakah nan ning a zak nawn lo ding."},"31":{"text":"Nan nuncan ṭha lo le thilsual nan tuahmi pawl nan thei sal ding ih nan sualnak le nan mawhnak ruangah nanmah le nanmah nan fih aw ding."},"32":{"text":"Israel mi pawl, ziang hmuahhmuah ka tuahmi hi nanmah zawnruah ah a si lo, tihi nan theih dingah ka duh a si. Nan thil tuahmi ruangah ningzak le mualpho in um uh. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Nan sualnak hmuahhmuah ihsin ka lo thianfaiter tikah nan khawsungah nan um sal ding ih a siatmi pawl cu nan sak sal ding."},"34":{"text":"Nan lo kiangkap ih a fehtu hmuahhmuah in nan lo pawl hrampi a khah ih hrambulak vek a si kha an hmu ṭheh; asinain nan lo pawl cu ka lo thloter sal ding."},"35":{"text":"Ramṭhing ih a cang ciami ram cu Eden Hmuan vekih a can sal kha mi hmuahhmuah in an hmu ding; balsiat ciami, ram ciami le khawrop ih a cang ciami khua pawl cu luahsal in ralhruang ih kulh ṭheh sal an si kha an hmu ding."},"36":{"text":"A luatsun ramhnen pawl in hi khua pawl a dinsaaltu le ramṭhing pawl sungih rawl a ciingsaaltu cu Bawipa keimah ka si kha an thei ding. Cuvekin ka tuah ding tiah thutiamtu cu Bawipa keimah ka si ih ka tuah suak ding,” a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Israel mi pawl cu bomnak i diltu miphun ah ka tuah sal ding ih tuurual bangin ka pungzaiter ding."},"38":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi cu puai tikcu ih thawinak tuu pawl in a khah vekin atu-ih khawrop ah a cangmi khua pawl hi minung in ka khatter ding. Cuticun Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding,” a ti."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ih ban thacak cu ka hnenah a um; a thlarau in i lak ih ruh hlir in a khatmi phairawn ah i ret.","title":"Ruh Ro In A Khat Mi Phairawn"},"2":{"text":"Cuih phairawn hmun kipah i hruai ih ruh tam ngaingai ka hmu, cuih ruh pawl cu an ro ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Anih in, “Milaipa, hi ruh pawl hi an nung thei sal pei maw?” tiah i sut. Kei in, “Cungnungbik Bawipa , nangmah lawngin na thei,” tiah ka sawn."},"4":{"text":"Anih in, “Ruh pawl hnenah profet ṭong in phuangsuak aw. Bawipa ih ṭongkam ngai dingah hi ruh ro pawl hi sim aw."},"5":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in an hnenih ka ṭongmi cu hiti in a si, an hnenah sim aw: Nan sungah thaw ka khum ding ih ka lo nungter ding."},"6":{"text":"Thahri ka lo pe ding, titsa in ka lo tuam ding ih vun in ka lo khuh ding. Nan sungah thaw ka khum ding ih nan nungsal ding. Cuticun Bawipa ka si hi in thei ding,” tiah i ti."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah i sim vekin profet ṭong in ka phuang. Cutiih ka phuan laiah rinlopi in khawng-aw ruihromi thawmvang ka thei ih ruh pawl cu pakhat le pakhat an peh aw rupro."},"8":{"text":"Ka zoh cuahco laiah cun ruh pawl cu thahri an hun nei ih titsa in a tuam ih vun in a khuh hai. Asinain an ruangpi sungah cun thaw a um lo."},"9":{"text":"Pathian in ka hnenah, “Milaipa, thli hnenah sim aw. Cungnungbik Bawipa in: ‘Maw thli, khuazakip ihsin ra awla hi miruak pawl sung ahhin thaw thawtkhum awla nungter hai aw, tiah thu a lo pek,’ tiah ti aw,” i ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule i sim vek cun ka ti. Cuih titsa ruang pawl sungah cun thaw a lut ih an nung ih an ding. Ralkap burpi zat in an tam."},"11":{"text":"Cule Pathian in, “Milaipa, Israel mi pawl cu hi ruh bangtuk an si. Kan ro ṭheh zo ih hmailam ruahsannak zianghman kan nei lo an ti."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah profet ṭong in phuang awla Bawipa Pathian keimah ih simmi hi than aw: Keimah in an thlaan pawl cu ka ong ding. Ka suahter ding ih Israel ramah ka kirter hai ding."},"13":{"text":"Ka minung pawl an phumnak thlaan pawl ka on ih ka suahter hai tikah cun keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding."},"14":{"text":"An sungah ka thaw ka khum ding, ka nungter hai ding ih anmah ih ramah ka umter ding. Cuticun keimah hi Bawipa ka si kha in thei ding. Hi bangtuk in ka tuah ding tiah thu ka tiam zo ih ka tuah suak rori ding. Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Judah Le Israel Uknak An Kom Aw"},"16":{"text":"“Milaipa, fung pakhat la awla a parah ‘Judah ukmi ram,’ tiah ngan aw. Fung dang pakhat la awla a parah ‘Israel ukmi ram,’ tiah ngan aw."},"17":{"text":"Cule na kut sungih fung pahnih zim cu pehton awla cuticun fung pakhat a bang ding."},"18":{"text":"Cule na minung pawl in a tican an lo suh tikah,"},"19":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in Israel ai ah fung ka la ding ih Judah ai ih fung thawn ka re tlang ding a ti, tiah sim aw. Fung pahnih cu pakhat ah ka tuah ding ih ka kut sungah ka huum ding."},"20":{"text":"“Fung pahnih cu na kut sungah huum awla mi pawl in hmu hai seh."},"21":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa ih ka simmi cu than aw: Ka minung pawl cu an vahvaihnak miphun tampi sungin ka hruai kir ding, ka finkhawm ding ih an ramah ka kirter ding."},"22":{"text":"An ramsung Israel tlangpar ah miphun pakhat ah ka kom ding. Anmah uktu ah siangpahrang pakhat an nei ding ih miphun pahnih an si nawn lo ding; uknak pahnih khalah an ṭhen aw nawn lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Fihnungza milem pawl thawn an borhhlawh awter nawn lo ding; sualnak thawn khal in an baal awter nawn lo ding. An sualih keimah in zuarthlainak lamzin hmuahhmuah in ka luatter ding. Ka thiangfaiter ding; ka minung an si ding ih an Pathian ka si ding."},"24":{"text":"I riantu David bangtuk a si mi siangpahrang cu an siangpahrang a si ding. Uktu bawi pakhat hnuai ah an kom aw ṭheh ding ih ka daan pawl cu feltein an thlun ding."},"25":{"text":"I riantu Jakob hnenih ka pekmi ram, an pupa pawl an rak umnak ramah an um ding. Cutawkah kumkhua in an um ding ih an faate pawl le an tesinfa pawl tla kumkhua in an um ding. I riantu David bangtuk a si mi siangpahrang in kumkhua in a uk ding."},"26":{"text":"Kumkhua in humhim an si theinak dingah anmah thawn thukamnak ka tuah ding. Ka hngetkhohter ding ih ka karhzaiter hai ding; an ram sungah ka Biakinn a din ringringnak dingah ka ngaihtuah ding."},"27":{"text":"An hnenah keimah ka um ding; an Pathian ka si ding ih ka minung an si ding."},"28":{"text":"Anmah lakah kumkhua um dingin ka Biakinn ka ret tikah cun ka minung si dingih Israel mi pawl ka hril kha miphun pawl in an thei ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah,","title":"Gog Cu Pathian Hriamhrei A Si"},"2":{"text":"“Milaipa, Magog ram ih miphun pawl Meshek le Tubal uktu bawi Gog hnenah a ṭhatlonak thu sim aw: A hnenah,"},"3":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ih ṭongmi hi sim aw: Keimah hi a ral ka si."},"4":{"text":"A dunghmai ka her ding, a khabe ah sio ka thlaih ding ih a ralkap pawl thawn ka dirsuak ding.
