A ralkap cu an rang le an rangralkap pawl thawn an tam ngaingai ih ralphaw le ralnam an keng fingfing."},"5":{"text":"Persia mi, Sudan mi le Libia mi pawl a hnenah an ṭang ih ralphaw le lukhuh an nei fekfek."},"6":{"text":"Gomer ram le Beth Togarmah ramih raldo theimi hmuahhmuah khal a hnenah an ṭang ih miphun dang tampi tla a hnenah an tel."},"7":{"text":"Tiar cia ih um dingah sim awla a ralkap pawl tla a thupekmi vekih tiar-aw dingin sim aw."},"8":{"text":"Kum reipi hnuah, miphun tampi hnen ihsin hi minung pawl hmun khatih finkhawm an sinak le ral ṭih ding um lo in himte ih an umnak ram hi do dingah thu ka pe ding. Israel tlangpar ram, kum reipi ramṭhing a rak si naón atu ahcun mi hmuahhmuah hnangamzet ih an umnak ram cu a do ding."},"9":{"text":"Amah le a ralkap pawl le amah hnenih a ṭangtu miphun pawl in thlipi bangin an do ding ih cuih ram cu khawdur le mero bangin an khuh ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in Gog hnenah cun, “Cuih tikcu a thlen tikah thu ṭha lo na ruat ding ih na ngaihtuah ciamco ding."},"11":{"text":"Ralhruang le ruhkulh zianghman nei loin khawsungah daite le hnangamte in a ummi, zohman bawmtu nei lo pawl kha do na tum ding."},"12":{"text":"Khawrop a rak si dahmi khawpi pawl sungih a ummi minung pawl cu na ram ding ih an thil na long ṭheh ding. Miphun tampi hnen ihsin finkhawmmi an si ih atu ahcun ṭilva tampi le thilri tampi an nei ih leilung pumpi lamzin ton awknak ah an um a si."},"13":{"text":"Sheba le Dedan mi pawl le Spain ramih sumtuahtu pawl in, ‘Mi thil ram ding le lon dingah maw na ralkap pawl khawm tahratin mi na do? Sui le ngun, ṭilva le thilri pawl la tahratin cuih lonmi hransaw thawn tlanhloh na tum maw si?’ tiah an sut ding,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in Gog hnenih a ṭongmi sim dingah i thlah. “Ka minung Israel mi pawl thlangamte ih an um laiah,"},"15":{"text":"miphun tampi lakin na khawmmi a cakzet le a tamzet na ralkap pawl thawn na umnak saklam ram ihsin na rungsuak ding. An zatein rang par in an rung ding."},"16":{"text":"Khatlam ihsin khatlam deng tiang ka minung Israel pawl cu thlipi bangin na do ding. Tikcu a kim tikah, miphun dang pawl hnenah zo ka si ti langternak ah le nan lakih ka hnaṭuannak thawngin ka thianhlimnak a lang theinak ah ka ram do dingih ka lo thlahsannak cu a si."},"17":{"text":"Khuahlan laiih i riantu Israel profet pawl hnen in thu ka rak than ih hmailam tikcu ah Israel do dingah mi pakhatkhat ka thlah ding, ka rak timi kha nangmah hi na si,” a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo."},"18":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Gog in Israel a do ni ahcun ka thin a hengzet ding.","title":"Pathian In Gog A Hrem"},"19":{"text":"Ka thinhengnak meisa bangih a ling laiah thu ka than: cuih ni ahcun Israel ramah ling nasazetin a hnin ding."},"20":{"text":"Nga le vate hmuahhmuah, ramsa hmuahhmuah a tum a seen a bok a vakmi tiang in le leilung tlun mi hmuahhmuah in keimah ṭih ah an khur thlohthlo ding. Tlang saangpipi an min ding, khaam saangpipi an cim ding ih khawkulh phardawl hmuahhmuah an cim ṭheh ding."},"21":{"text":"Siatralnak a phunphun in Gog cu ka ṭhihṭhaih ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo. A ralkap pawl cu anmah le anmah parah an ralnam an hawi ding."},"22":{"text":"Natnak le thisen suahnak in Gog cu ka hrem ding. Ruah le rial cu meisa le katmei thawn amah le a ralkap pawl le a hnenih a ṭangtu miphun hmuahhmuah pawl parah ka burh ciamco ding."},"23":{"text":"Cuticun miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah mi maksak ka sizia le mi thianghlim ka sizia cu ka langter ding. Cule Bawipa ka si kha an thei ding,” a ti."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Milaipa, Meshek le Tabul miphun pawl uktu bawi bik Gog hnenah sim awla a ral ka si hi phuang aw.","title":"Gog A Sung"},"2":{"text":"Hmun dangpi ah ka fehter ding ih Israel ram tlangpar a thlen hlan lo saklam ah ka hruai vivo ding."},"3":{"text":"Cule a kehlam kutih li le a vorhlam kutih thal pawl cu ka ti thla thluh ding."},"4":{"text":"Gog le a ralkap le amah a ṭantu pawl cu Israel tlangpar ahcun an thi thluh ding ih an ruak pawl cu vate le ramsa rawl ah ka canter ding."},"5":{"text":"Lenkolh lakah an ril ding ih an thi ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"6":{"text":"Zohman ih hnaihnok dah lomi, tipikap tluan ih a ummi pawl le Magog ramah meisa ka kangter ding ih cuticun Bawipa ka si kha mi hmuahhmuah in an thei ding."},"7":{"text":"Ka hmin thianghlim cu Israel mi pawl ka theihter ding ih zohman in ka hmin an thangsiat nawn lo ding. Cuticun miphun hmuahhmuah in keimah hi Bawipa , Israel ih Pathian Thianghlim ka si kha in thei ding,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “A thuhla ka sim ciami ni cu a ra thleng ding; a thleng tengteng ding a si."},"9":{"text":"Israel ram khawpi sungih a ummi pawl cu an suak ding ih ral pawl ih taanmi hriamnam pawl cu zanthing hrangah an khawm ding. Ralphaw pawl, li le thal pawl, feipi le talhtum pawl cu mei ah an tik ding ih zanthing tik lotein kum sarih a daih ding."},"10":{"text":"Hram lakah tihthing an hawl lo ding, tupi sung thing khal an hau lo ding, ziangahtile zanthing ai ah ral pawl ih taanmi hriamnam an tik ding. Anmah a rak rutu le a rak ramtu pawl kha an ru ding ih an ram ding,” tiah a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Cuih tikcu a kim tikah Gog cu Israel ram, Tipi Thi ih nisuahnak lam Mikhual Phairawn ah phumnak hmun ka pek ding. Gog le a ralkap pawl cu cutawkah phum an si ding ih cuih phairawn cu ‘Gog Ralkap Pawl Phairawn,’ ti a si ding.","title":"Gog An Phum"},"12":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in miruak pawl cu thla sarih sung an phum ding ih cuticun ramsung cu an thiangfaiter sal ding."},"13":{"text":"Ramsung mi hmuahhmuah in miruak phum cu an bawm ding ih cuticun ka sunlawinak a lang ni ah upatnak cotu an si ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"14":{"text":"Thla sarih hnuah ramsung thianfaiternak dingah milai hril an si ding ih ramsung hmuahhmuah ah an vak ding ih phum hrih lomi miruak hmuahhmuah an phum ding."},"15":{"text":"Cutiih an tawihvah tikah ruh an hmuh a si ahcun hminsinnak an tuah ding; cuticun thlaan laitu pawl in an hmu ding ih Gog Ralkap Pawlih Phairawn ah an phum ding."},"16":{"text":"(Cuih kiangah khua pakhat a um ding ih ‘Ralkap Tampi’ tiah hngilh lonak ah hminsak a si ding.) Cuticun ramsung cu thianfaiter a si sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Milaipa, an hrangih ka timtuahmi thawinak sa ra ei dingah khuazakip ihsin vate le ramsa pawl ko aw. Israel tlang parah rawl ei puai tumpi a um ding ih cutawkah sa an ei ding ih thisen an in ding."},"18":{"text":"Tuucang, a si lole tuufaate, a si lole mecang, a si lole a thaumi cawcang bangtuk ih thah a si mi ralkap pawl ruak an ei ding ih leilung uktu bawi pawl ih thisen an in ding."},"19":{"text":"Himi pawl cu raithawinak bangtuk ih ka thah tikah vate le ramsa pawl in an ei thei zat in a thau an ei ding ih an rit tiangin thisen an in ding."},"20":{"text":"Rang le rangralkap pawl siseh, ralkap le raldotu pawl siseh, an kaih thei zat an kai ding ih ka cabuai parah an ei ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Miphun pawl hnenah ka sunlawinak ka langter ding ih a dikmi ka thuṭhennak cu ka huham thawn ziang bangtuk in ka tuahsuak ti cu ka hmuh hai ding.","title":"Israel Dinsalnak"},"22":{"text":"Cuihhnu cun Israel mi pawl in keimah hi Bawipa an Pathian ka si kha in thei ding."},"23":{"text":"Ka parih sualnak an tuah ruangah Israel mi pawl cu saltaannak hmun an thleng ti kha miphun pawl in an thei ding. Ka dungtun hai ih an ral pawl in an neh ih raldonak hmunah ral kut in ka thihter."},"24":{"text":"An thianlonak le an ṭhatlonak ruangih an tuar dingzat cu an parah ka thlenter ih ka dungtun hai a si,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Sikhalsehla atu cun Jakob tesinfa Israel mi parah zaangfahnak ka nei ding ih mi ṭhangso le mi neinung ka siter sal ding. Ka hmin thianghlim cu ka kilkhawi ding."},"26":{"text":"An ram sungah zianghman thinphannak um loin an um ih zohman in hnaihnawhnak an pek lo tikah cun keimah in zuarthlai ruangih ningzak mualpho ih an umnak cu an hngilh thei sal leh ding."},"27":{"text":"Mi thianghlim ka si hi miphun tampi hnenih langternak ah an ral pawl umnak ramih ṭhekdarh an sinak ihsin ka kirpi ding."},"28":{"text":"Cuticun ka minung pawl hin an Bawipa le an Pathian ka si hi in thei ding. Cubangtuk cun in thei ding, ziangahtile saltaannak hmunih anmah a kuattu le atu-ah pakhat hman taang loin an ram sungih finkhawmtu le hruaikirtu cu keimah ka si."},"29":{"text":"Israel mi parah ka thlarau ka burh ding ih ziangtik hmanah ka hmai ka thup nawn lo ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal kan taannak kum kul hluannga kum, Jerusalem an laknak kum hleili kum, kumthar nihra ni ah, Bawipa ih kut cu huham nasa zet thawn ka hnenah a um ih, amah in hmun dangah i hruai.","title":"Sak Leh Ding Biakinn A Hmuhnak (40.1—48.35) Ezekiel Cu Jerusalem Ah An Hruai"},"2":{"text":"Langnak ka hmuhmi ahcun Pathian in Israel ramah i fehpi ih tlang saangpi pakhat parah i ret. Ka hmaiah khawpi bangtuk inn a burpi ih a ummi ka hmu."},"3":{"text":"I naihter deuh ih dar vekih a tleumi pa pakhat ka hmu. Tahnak patzai hri le tahfung a keng ih kotka ih a din kha ka hmu."},"4":{"text":"Ka hnenah, “Milaipa, ṭhatein zoh aw! Ralringte in ngai awla ka lo hmuhmi hmuahhmuah ṭhatein ciing aw; ziangahtile hi ruangah a si hitawk ih ka lo hruai. Na hmuhmi hmuahhmuah hi Israel mi hnenah na sim pei,” i ti."},"5":{"text":"Ka hmuhmi cu Biakinn a si ih a kimvel in phardawl ih kulhmi a si. Dar vekih a tleumi pa cun a tahnak fung dong ruk a saumi cu a lak ih Biakinn kulhnak phardawl cu a tah. Dong ruk a sang ih dong ruk a sah.","title":"Nisuahnak Lam Kotka"},"6":{"text":"Cule nisuahnak lamih a ummi kotka lamah a feh. Dawlmi kailawn ah a hung kai ih tluntabik a thlen tikah sangka cu a tah; dong ruk a sah a si."},"7":{"text":"Cuih pawnah cun fehnak lamzin a um ih vorhlam le kehlam ah inn kilnak khaan khaan thum fingfing an um. Cuih khaan pawl cu a tung le a vang an canrep ih dong ruk fingfing an sau ih an kau. Khaan khat le khaan khat karlakih phar cu dong nga a sah. Cuih khaan sangtu ahcun lamzin pakhat dong ruk sau a um ih Biakinn lam hoitu khaan tumpi ah a va thleng."},"8":{"text":"Cuih khaan tumpi cu a tah ih dong riat a kau. Hi khaan cu Biakinn naih bik sangka ah a cang ih Biakinn naih bik phar cu dong hnih a sah.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"(Hi inn kiltu pawl ih khaan cu an tia aw thluh ih an karlakih phar tla a sah daan an bangrep.)"},"11":{"text":"Cuih hnuah lamzin ih sangka cu a tah ih dong hleithum a kau. Kotka pakhat le pakhat karlak khal a tah ih dong hra a kau."},"12":{"text":"Inn kiltu pawl khaan ih hmaizawn fingfing ahcun phar niamtete an um ih dong khat saang le dong khat sah an si. (A khaan pawl cu dong ruk kau le dong ruk sau an si fingfing.)"},"13":{"text":"Cule a khaan ih dunglam phar netnak ihsin lamzin khatlam ih a ummi khaan dunglam phar netnak tiang a tah ih dong kul hluannga a hla a si."},"14":{"text":"A netnak ih a ummi khaan ihsin phar ih kulhmi tual ah va thlen theih a si. Cuih khaan cu a tah ih dong kul a kau."},"15":{"text":"Lamzin cu kotka lenglam phar ihsin a netabik khaan ih phar lenglam tiang dong sawmnga a sau."},"16":{"text":"Cuih khaan pawl ahcun a lenglam phar ah tukvirh fatete a um fingfing ih khaan pakhat le pakhat karlak phar khalah tukvirh fatete a um fingfing. Lamzin kapih phar parah cun tuumkung khuaimi zuk pawl an um."},"17":{"text":"Cupa cun lamzin in tual tiang i hruai. Tual kulhnak phardawl ih lenglam ahcun a khaan khaan sawmthum an sak ih cuih khaan pawl ih hmaizawn ahcun lungto phahmi tual a um ih,","title":"A Lenglam Tual"},"18":{"text":"a laifang tualrawn cu a kulh ṭheh. Cuih lungto phahmi tual cu a laifang tualrawn hnakin a niam sawn."},"19":{"text":"A laifang fehnak ah a saangdeuh in fehnak lam an tuah ih cupa cun lamzin pahnih karlak cu a tah tikah dong zakhat a si."},"20":{"text":"Saklam ihsin a lenglam tual ih fehnak lamzin kha a tah sal.","title":"Saklam Kotka"},"21":{"text":"Cuih lamzin vorhlam le kehlam ih khaan pathum fingfing a ummi le an karlak phar pawl le khaan tumpi pakhat a ummi cu nisuahnak lam kotka lamih a ummi khaan pawl thawn an tia aw thluh. Lamzin cu dong sawmnga a sau ih dong kul hluannga a kau."},"22":{"text":"Khaan tumpi le tukvirh pawl le an zuksuaimi tuumkung pawl cu nisuahnak lam kotka ih a ummi pawl bangtuk an si. Kotka tiang kainak karbak pasarih a um ih khaan tumpi cu tualrawn sangtu bikah a um ih tualrawn lam a hoi."},"23":{"text":"A lenglam tual tan in a laifang tualrawn lamah hi saklam kotka ihsin nisuahnak lam vekin lamzin pakhat a feh. Cupa cun cuih lamzin pahnih karlak cu a tah tikah dong zakhat a hla a si."},"24":{"text":"Cuih hnuah cupa cun thlanglam ah i fehpi ih lamzin pakhat kan hmu. A tah ih lamzin dang vek thotho a si."},"25":{"text":"Hi lamzin kiangih khaan pawl khal cun khaan dang vek thotho in tukvirh an nei fingfing. Hi lamzin cu dong sawmnga a sau ih dong kul hluannga a kau."},"26":{"text":"Cuih lamzin thlen hlanah karbak pasarih a um ih a netnak ah khaan tumpi a um ve ih tualrawn a hoih ve. Lamzin kap phar sunglam ahcun, hmundang vek thotho in tuumkung zuksuaimi an um."},"27":{"text":"A laifang tualrawn fehnak a um ve thotho ih mipa cun a tah tikah lamzin pahnih karlak cu dong zakhat a si."},"28":{"text":"Cupa cun thlanglam lamzin ihsin a laifang tualrawn tiang i fehpi. Cuih lamzin cu a tah ih phar lenglam ih a ummi lamzin tia thotho a si.","title":"A Laifang Tualrawn: Thlanglam Kotka"},"29":{"text":"Inn kilnak khaan pawl, khaan tumpi le a sunglam phar pawl cu lamzin dang kiangih a ummi khaan tia thotho an si. Hi khaan pawl ah tukvirh tla an um ve. A saulam cu dong sawmnga a si ih a kauhlam cu dong kul hluannga a si.","merge":"30"},"31":{"text":"Khaan tumpi cu tualrawn dang a hoi ih lamzin kap phar parah tuumkung zuk pawl an suai. Hi kotka kainak ah karbak pariat a um."},"32":{"text":"Cupa cun nisuahnak lam lamzin ihsin a laifang tualrawn tiang i fehpi. Lamzin cu a tah ih lamzin dang tia a si.","title":"A Laifang Tualrawn: Nisuahnak Lam Kotka"},"33":{"text":"Inn kilnak khaan pawl, khaan tumpi le a sunglam phar pawl cu lamzin dang kiangih a ummi tia thotho an si. Tukvirh cu phar tinah a um ih khaan tumpi tla ah a um ve. A saulam cu dong sawmnga a si ih a kauhlam cu dong kul hluannga a si."},"34":{"text":"Khaan tumpi cu a lenglam tual a hoi. Lamzin kap phar parah tuumkung zuk pawl an suai. Hi kotka kainak ah karbak pariat a um."},"35":{"text":"Cupa cun saklam lamzin ah i fehpi. Lamzin cu a tah ih lamzin dang tia thotho a si.","title":"A Laifang Tualrawn: Saklam Kotka"},"36":{"text":"Hmun dangih a um vek thotho in inn kilnak khaan pawl, khaan tumpi le phar tinah tukvirh an um thluh ve. A saulam cu dong sawmnga a si ih a kauhlam cu dong kul hluannga a si."},"37":{"text":"Khaan tumpi cu a lenglam tual a hoi. Lamzin kap phar parah tuumkung zuk pawl an suai. Hi kotka kainak ah karbak pariat a um."},"38":{"text":"A lenglam tual ah saklam i hung fehnak a sunglam lamzin thawn pehcih mi inn fate pakhat a um. Cuih inn fate cu tualrawn lam a hoitu khaan tumpi lamah a ong aw ih cutawkah cun mei-ur thawinak hrangih pek dingmi sa pawl cu an kholh.","title":"Saklam Kotka Kiangih Inn Pawl"},"39":{"text":"Hi khaan tumpi sungah cabuai pali a um ih kap khatah pahnih veve an um. Hi cabuai pawl parah hin mei-ur thawinak hrangah siseh, sualthlah thawinak hrangah siseh, kuansal thawinak hrangah siseh pek mi ṭilva pawl an thahnak a si."},"40":{"text":"A khaan lengah, a khaan sungih cabuai bangtuk, cabuai pali a um ve ih saklam kotka sung luhnak kap hnih ahcun pahnih veve an ret."},"41":{"text":"A zatein cabuai pariat, thawinak hrangih ṭilva thahnak ah an um; a khaan sungah cabuai pali, tual ah cabuai pali an um."},"42":{"text":"Inn fate sungih cabuai pawl cu lungto in sermi an si. Cuih cabuai pawl cu dong khat an sang ih dong khat le khap khat an kau ih, an kauhlam le an saulam a tia aw. Thawinak hrangih pekmi ṭilva pawl talhnak le thahnak hriamhrei hmuahhmuah cu hi lungto cabuai parah an ret ringring."},"43":{"text":"Cuih cabuai tlang ahcun a tlangkop zabok tia a kimvel in a um. Thawinak ih pekmi sa hmuahhmuah cu cuih cabuai parah cun an ret."},"44":{"text":"Cule mi pa cun a laifang tualrawn ah i hruai. Cuih tualrawn lam hoi in sakmi innkhaan pahnih an um ih pakhat cu thlanglam kotka kiangah a si ih saklam a hoi."},"45":{"text":"Mipa cun thlanglam a hoitu khaan cu Biakinn ih hna a ṭuantu puithiam pawl umnak khaan a si ih,"},"46":{"text":"saklam a hoitu khaan cu biakṭheng ih hna a ṭuantu puithiam pawl umnak khaan a si, tiah i sim. Puithiam pawl cu an zatein Zadok cithlah mi an si. Levi phun sungin anmah lawng hi Bawipa ih umnak hmun ih Bawipaió hnaṭuan dingah a lut theitu an si."},"47":{"text":"Cupa in a laifang tualrawn cu a tah ih dong zakhat kau le dong zakhat sau a si. Biakinn cu nitlaknak lamah a um ih a hmaizawn ah biakṭheng pakhat a um.","title":"A Laifang Tualrawn Le Biakinn"},"48":{"text":"Cule Biakinn sungih vung luhnak khaan sungah i hruai. Luhnak sangka cu a tah ih dong nga a sah ih dong hleili a kaumi a si; a kapih phar pawl cu dong thum a sahmi an si."},"49":{"text":"Cuih khaan vung luhnak ah karbak an um ih dong kul sau le dong hleihnih kau an si. Vung luhnak ih vorhlam le kehlam ah ṭhuam tumpi pakhat veve an um."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule mipa cun a laifang khaan, Hmun Thianghlim ah i luhpi. Cuih khaan sung vung luhnak cu a tah ih dong ruk thuk le dong hra kau a si ih a kaphnih ih phar cu dong nga sah fingfing an si. A laifang khaan cu a tah ih dong sawmli sau le dong kul kau a si."},"2":{"text":"Luhnak sangka cu dong kul a kau; a kap hnih ih phar cu dong hra veve a sah. Hmun Thianghlim cu a tah ih dong sawmriat sau le dong sawmli kau a si."},"3":{"text":"Cule a sungta bik khaan ah a vung lut. A vung luhnak cu a tah ih dong hnih thuk le dong ruk kau a si; a kaphnih ih phar pawl cu dong sarih sah an si."},"4":{"text":"Sungta bik khaan cu a tah tikah dong kul kau le dong kul sau a si. Cule anih in, “Himi hi Hmun Thianghlim Bik a si,” tiah i ti."},"5":{"text":"Cupa cun Biakinn phar a sunglam ihsin a sahnak a tah ih dong ruk sah a si. Biakinn phar thawn dai aw in sakmi khaan tampi, Biakinn kimvel ahcun a um ih khaan pakhat cu dong li kau an si fingfing.","title":"Biakinn Phar Thawn Sakcihmi Khaan"},"6":{"text":"Hi khaan pawl cu dot thum in tuahmi an si ih dot khatnak ah khaan sawmthum fingfing a um. Biakinn phar a lenglam cu a tluntabik khaan ah a paa bikih a thuailam khaan ahcun a sah deuh vivo. Cuticun zial donnak khansuk pawl cu phar parah hrencih ṭul loin phar parah an taang thei."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Biakinn phar cu a lenglam ihsin zoh tikah cun a taw ihsin a lu tiang a sah daan a bangrep mi phar a bang. Biakinn phar lenglam, a khaan fatete ih lenglam ihsin kailawn kel pahnih an tuah ih dot thuaita bik ihsin tlunta bik dot tiang kai a theih."},"8":{"text":"Hi khaan fatete ih lenglam phar pawl cu dong nga sah an si ih khaan fatete sung luhnak ah Biakinn saklam kap ihsin sangka pakhat a um; Biakinn thlanglam kap ihsin a dang sangka pakhat a um. Biakinn kimvel ah dong nga kau cangdawl a um vivo ti kha ka hmu. Cuih cangdawl cu leilung ihsin dong ruk a sang ih Biakinn phar kiang khaan fatete ih zial thawn a rual aw a si. Cuih cangdawl le puithiam pawl ih hmanmi inn pawl karlakah, Biakinn sir tluan ahcun, dong kul kau hmunlawng um.","merge":"9"},"12":{"text":"Cuih hmunlawng a netnak, Biakinn ihsin nitlaknak lamah inn pakhat a um ih dong sawmkua sau le dong sawmsarih kau a si. A phar cu a kimvel in dong nga a sah a si."},"13":{"text":"Cupa cun Biakinn ih lenglam a tah ih dong zakhat a sau. Cule Biakinn dunglam ihsin hmunlawng mi tan in nitlaknak lamih ummi inn a netnak tiang dong zakhat thotho a ti.","title":"Biakinn An Tah"},"14":{"text":"Biakinn hmailam ah vorhlam le kehlam ih ummi hmunlawng siarcih in dong zakhat thotho a si."},"15":{"text":"Inn a saulam cu nitlaknak lamah a tah ih a kaphnih ih fehnak lamzin thawn dong zakhat ṭhiamṭhiam a si. Biakinn sung vung luhnak, Hmun Thianghlim le Hmun Thianghlim Bik pawl cu,"},"16":{"text":"a zial ihsin a sangkate tiang thing in khuhmi a si. Hi sangkate pawl cu khuh theimi an si."},"17":{"text":"Biakinn sunglam phar cu sangka tlun tiangin tuumkung le cherubim timi thla nei ramsa zuk in,"},"18":{"text":"a khat ṭheh a si. Tuumkung le cherubim zuk pawl cu, cuih khaan kimvel phar parah cun, karlak thlak in zuk an suai. Cherubim cu hmai pahnih fingfing an nei."},"19":{"text":"Hmai pakhat cu minung hmai a si ih kap khat lamih tuumkung lam a hoi, hmai dang pakhat cu kiosa hmai a si ih khatlam tuumkung a hoi ve. Phar parah cun a tluanpi in,"},"20":{"text":"zial ihsin sangka tlun tiang cuvek cun a si thluh."},"21":{"text":"Hmun Thianghlim ih sangka ṭhuam pawl cu a kauh le a sah an tia aw ṭheh a si. Hmun Thianghlim Bik sung vung luhnak sangka hmaiah thing ih tuahmi biakṭheng bangtuk a si mi,"},"22":{"text":"thil pakhat a um. Cumi cu dong thum a sang ih dong hnih a kua. A kil ih ṭhuam pawl, a hram dammi le a kap pawl khal thing ih tuahmi a si thluh. Mipa cun ka hnenah, “Himi hi Bawipa ih umnak hmunih a dingmi cabuai a si,” tiah i ti."},"23":{"text":"Hmun Thianghlim sung vung luhnak a netnak ah sangka pakhat a um ih Hmun Thianghlim Bik vung luh netnak ah sangka dang pakhat a um fawn.","title":"Sangka Pawl"},"24":{"text":"Hi sangka pawl cu kharton ih tuahmi an si ih a laifang in a ong awmi sangka an si."},"25":{"text":"Biakinn phar par vekin Hmun Thianghlim sangka par ahcun tuumkung le cherubim zuk an um. Biakinn sung vung luhnak sangka ahcun a lenglam in thing in tuahmi sangka khuh an thlai."},"26":{"text":"Hi khaan sirlam kaphnih ah sangkate an um ih a phar cu tuumkung zuk in an mawiter."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cupa cun a lenglam tualrawn ah i fehpi ih Biakinn ihsin saklam ih a ummi inn ah i hruai. Cuih inn cu Biakinn ih nitlaknak lam dengih a ummi inn ihsin a hla lo.","title":"Biakinn Kiangih Inn Pahnih"},"2":{"text":"Cuih inn cu dong zakhat a sau ih dong sawmnga a kau."},"3":{"text":"Cuih inn khatlam cu Biakinn sau zawng ih a ummi, dong kul a kaumi hmunlawng lam a hoi; a dang khatlam cu a lenglam tual ih lungto phah mi lamzin a hoi. Dot thum in sakmi inn a si ih a tlunta dot cu a hnuaita dot hnakin dunglam ah a pil deuh vivo."},"4":{"text":"Cuih inn saklam tluan ahcun fehnak lamzin a um ih dong hra kau le dong zakhat sau a si. Saklam kap in luhnak ong pawl an um."},"5":{"text":"Hi inn ih tlunta khaan pawl cu a hnuai ih khaan pawl hnakin an fiak deuh, ziangahtile tlunta dot pawl cu dunglam ah an pil deuh vivo ruangah a si."},"6":{"text":"Inn dot thum ih khaan pawl cu cangdawl parih sakmi an si ih tualrawn ih sakmi inn dangdang vek si loin ṭhuam pakhat hman in a do lo."},"7":{"text":"Hnuaita dot ih lenglam phar cu dong sawmnga sung a khaan dannak um loin a peh aw thluh; dong sawmnga cu inn a saulam ih hrek a si. A dang dong sawmnga ahcun khaan tampi a um. Tlunta bik dot ahcun inn tluan ih khaan lawnglawng a um.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Hi khaan pahnih hnuai, nisuahnak lam inn netnak, phar an dawl thoknak zawn ihsin a lenglam tualrawn ih vung ṭumnak ah lamzin a um. Biakinn thlanglam kapah Biakinn ih nitlaknak lam dengih inn thawn a hlat lomi hmunah saklam kapih inn vek cekci in inn pakhat a um.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Inn khaan pawl ih hmaiah cun saklam kapih a um vekin lamzin pakhat a um. Cuih lamzin pawl cu an tia aw thluh, an pianhmang khal an bang-aw ih vung luhnak sangka pawl khal an bangrep aw."},"12":{"text":"Cuih inn thlanglam kap khaan pawl hnuai, phar an dawl thoknak nisuahnak lam dengah sangka pakhat a um."},"13":{"text":"Mipa cun ka hnenah, “Hi inn pahnih cu an thianghlim a si. Hi inn sungah hin Bawipa ih umnak hmunih a lut theitu puithiam pawl in Bawipa hnenih pekmi thawinak thianghlim bik an ei a si. Inn khaan pawl cu a thianghlimmi an si ruangah thawinak thianghlim bik - sangphut thawinak, sualthlah thawinak, a si lole kuansal thawinak pawl cu puithiam pawl in cutawkah an ret ding."},"14":{"text":"Biakinn sungah puithiam pawl an luh hnuah a lenglam tualrawn ih an feh duh a si ahcun Bawipa ih hna an ṭuan tikih an hrukmi hnipuan pawl an hlit pei ih hi innkhaan ah an ret pei. Mipi pumkhawmnak hmunih feh an duh a si ahcun hnipuan dang an hruk hmaisa pei."},"15":{"text":"Cupa cun Biakinn sung a tah ṭheh hnuah nisuahnak lam kotka in i suahpi ih Biakinn lenglam ih hmun pawl a tah.","title":"Biakinn Hmun Tahnak"},"16":{"text":"A tahfung cu a lak ih nisuahnak lam a tah ih dong za nga a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cuih hnuah saklam kap a tah; thlanglam le nitlaknak lam khal a tah ih an zatein dong za nga an ti fingfing.","merge":"18"},"20":{"text":"Cutiin phardawl ih a kulhmi hmun cu dong za nga kau, za nga sau hmun a si. Cuih phardawl cu a thianghlimmi le a thianghlim lomi ramri ṭhentu ah a cang."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cupa cun nisuahnak lam a hoitu kotka ah i hruai ih,","title":"Cu Biakinn Ah A Ra"},"2":{"text":"cutawkah nisuahnak lam ihsin a rami nasa zetih a tleumi Bawipa ih sunlawinak cu ka hmu. Pathian ih aw cu tifinriat tidai huuk thawm bangtuk a si ih leilung cu a nasa zetmi tleunak in a tlet ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Hi langnak cu Jerusalem siatsuah ding ih Pathian a rat lai ih ka hmuhmi le Khebar Tivapi kiangih ka rak hmuhmi langnak bangtuk thotho a si. Cutikah leilung ah ka hlon aw ih ka bok."},"4":{"text":"Nasa zetih a tleumi tleunak cu nisuahnak lam kotka sungin a lan ih Biakinn sungah a lut."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa ih thlarau in i cawi ih a laifang tualrawn ah i fehpi; cutawk ihsin Biakinn cu Bawipa ih sunlawinak in a khat ti kha ka hmu."},"6":{"text":"Cutawkah ka kiangah mi pakhat a rung ding ih Biakinn sung ihsin Bawipa ka hnenih a ṭong kha ka thei:"},"7":{"text":"“Milaipa, hitawk ah ka siangpahrang tokham a um. hittawk ah Israel mi lakah hin ka um ding ih kumkhua in ka uk hai ding. Israel mi pawl in siseh, an siangpahrang pawl in siseh khawzing dangdang bia tahrat in, a si lole an siangpahrang ih ruak pawl cu hi hmunah re tahrat in ka hmin thianghlim cu an thangsiatter nawn lo ding."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang pawl in an inn sung luhnak sangka le an sangka ṭhuam pawl cu ka Biakinn sung luhnak sangka le sangka ṭhuam kiangah an tuah ih cuticun kan karlak ah phar pakhat lawng a um a si. Fihnungza thil tampi tuah tahrat in ka hmin thianghlim an thangsiatter ruangah ka thinheng in ka siatsuah hai a si."},"9":{"text":"Atu cun khuavang biak cu an bansan ding ih an siangpahrang ih ruak pawl cu an hlon a ṭul ding. Cutiih an tuah a si ahcun an hnenah kumkhua in ka um ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Bawipa in, “Milaipa, Israel mi pawl hnenah hi Biakinn thuhla hi sim awla a sak daan tla thei hai seh. An thil tuahsualmi ruangah an ningzakter aw."},"11":{"text":"Cule an thil tuahsualmi ruangah ningzahnak caang an thiam a si ahcun an hnenah Biakinn sak daan ding pawl cu simfiang aw: ruang an zingmi, a sung luhnak le a leng suahnak pawl, ziangvek pianhmang a si ding tile ziangvek in thilri hmuahhmuah an ret ding tile a daan le a daan terek pawl hmuahhmuah cu simfiang aw. An hrangah ngan ṭheh awla cuticun ziangvek in thil a um ti an thei ding ih daan hmuahhmuah cu an tuahsuak thei ding."},"12":{"text":"Biakinn hrangih daan cu hihi a si: Biakinn umnak tlangpar le a kimvel hmuahhmuah cu hmun thianghlim a si,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Biakinn tahnak thotho in tah tikah biakṭheng cu a hnuailam bangtuk in a si. A hramah a kimvel in khur a um ih dong khat thuk le dong khat kau a si. Biakṭheng tlangah a tlangkop a um ih khap khat a sang.","title":"Biakṭheng"},"14":{"text":"Biakṭheng a niamnak bik zawn cu a hram a sannak bik ihsin dong hnih a sang. Cule biakṭheng kimvel in dong khat zau in an tuah ih a saannak zawn cu dong li a sang. Cuih hnuah a kimvel in dong khat zau in an tuah lala ih a laifang cu a sang bik."},"15":{"text":"Hi a saannak bik zawn, thawinak pekmi pawl an urnak zawn cu dong li sang a si. Hi tlunah a kil li ah ki pali an um."},"16":{"text":"Biakṭheng lu, a saannak bik cu dong hleihnih sau le dong hleihnih kau a si ih tungvang can aw a si."},"17":{"text":"A laifang zawn khal a tung le a vang an can aw ih dong hleili veve an si. A tlangah tlangkop a um ih khap khat a sang. (A tawhram ih khur a ummi cu dong khat a kau.) Biakṭheng hung fehnak kailawn cu nisuahnak lamah a um."},"18":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Milaipa, ka lo sim mi hi ṭhatein ngai aw. Hi biakṭheng hi dawl ṭheh a si tikah thawinak ih pekmi sa a parah ur tahrat in le sathi a parah theh tahrat in hlannak na tuah pei.","title":"Biakṭheng Hlannak"},"19":{"text":"Levi phun puithiam Zadok tesinfa pawl lawnglawng keimah riantu ah ka umnak hmunah an lut thei ding. Himi cu Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah thupekmi a si. Sualthlah thawinak hrangah cawcangte na pek ding."},"20":{"text":"Cawcang thisen malte na lak pei ih biakṭheng lu ih ki pali ah na hnih pei; biakṭheng laifang zawnih kil pawl tla na hnih pei ih a tlang kimvel khalah na hnih thluh pei. Cuticun biakṭheng cu na thiangter pei ih na hlan pei."},"21":{"text":"Sualthlah thawinak hrangih pekmi cawcang cu na lak pei ih biakinn lengah hmun pakhat ah na ur pei."},"22":{"text":"A thaisun ah raitluan mecang pakhat na lak pei ih sualthlah thawinak ah na pek pei. Biakṭheng thianternak dingah cawcang thisen thawn na tuah vekin mecang thisen thawn khal in tuah aw."},"23":{"text":"Cumi na tuah ṭheh tikah raitluan mi cawcangte le tuucangte la awla,"},"24":{"text":"ka hnenah rak keng aw. Puithiam pawl in an parah ci an phulh ding ih ka hnenah mei-ur thawinakah an pe ding."},"25":{"text":"Nitinte ni sarih sung, mecang pakhat, cawcang pakhat le tuucang pakhat sualthlah thawinak ah nan pek pei. An zatein raitluan an si ṭheh pei."},"26":{"text":"Nisarih sung puithiam pawl in biakṭheng cu an thiangter pei ih hman dingah an timlaam pei."},"27":{"text":"Zarh khat hnuah cun biakṭheng parah puithiam pawl in thawinak pek an thok pei; misenpi pawl ih mei-ur thawinak le remnak thawinak pawl cu an pek pei. Cuticun nan zate parah ka lung a awi ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka lo sim zo,” tiah a ti."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cupa cun Biakinn ihsin nisuahnak lam kapih a ummi a lenglam kotka ah i hruai. Cuih kotka cu kharmi a si.","title":"Nisuahnak Lam Kotka Hman Daan"},"2":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Hi kotka cu khar a si ringring ding, ziangtik hmanah on a si dah lo ding. Zovek milai hman in an hmang lo ding, ziangahtile Israel ih Pathian, Bawipa keimah a sungin ka feh zo. Khar a si ringring ding."},"3":{"text":"Mi-uk bawi lawnglawng ka umnak hmunih rawl thianghlim ei dingah a feh thei ding. Cuih kotka cun a lut pei ih a sunglam ih khaan tumpi ihsin a suak sal pei,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule cupa cun Biakinn hmailam ih a ummi saklam kotka ah i fehpi. Khua ka vun zoh ih Bawipa ih Biakinn cu a nasa zetmi Bawipa ih sunlawi tleunak in a khat kha ka hmu. Leilung ah bokkhup in ka hlon aw;","title":"Biakinn Sung Luh Theinak Daan"},"5":{"text":"cule Bawipa cu ka hnenah, “Milaipa, na hmuhmi le na theihmi hmuahhmuah hi ṭhatein hminsin aw. Biakinn hrangah daan le daanterek pawl ka lo sim thluh ding. Zopawl so Biakinn sungah luh a thiang ih zoso a thiang lo, ti kha feltein hminsin aw."},"6":{"text":"“Raltho phun Israel mipawl cu sim aw; fihnungza thil an tuah ringringmi hi Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka zawi thei nawn lo ding a si."},"7":{"text":"Ka hnenih thawinak sa a thi le a thau pawl pek a si laiah, serhtan lo ramdangmi, ka thu a ngai duh lomi pawl cu Israel mipawl in Biakinn sungah an luhter ruangah ka Biakinn an borhhlawh ter zo a si. Cule ka minung pawl in thil fihnungza tuah tahrat in ka thukam an balsiat zo a si."},"8":{"text":"Ka biakinn sungih biaknak hrang thil thianghlim tuahmi pawl cu anmah ih ṭuanvo ah an la duh lo, ramdangmi ih ṭuanvo sawn ah an tuah a si."},"9":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim: serhtan lo ramdangmi le ka thu a ngai duh lomi pawl cu Israel mi lakih a ummi ramdangmi an si hmanah ka Biakinn sungah an lut thei lo pei,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Levi mi pawl cu Israel misenpi pawl thawn keimah in tlansan ih milem a biatu an si ruangah ka hrem hai ding.","title":"Levi Mipawl Cu Puithiam An Si Thei Lo"},"11":{"text":"Biakinn kotka kil tahrat in le Biakinn sung hnaṭuan ṭuannak in keimah in rian thei ding. Mipi in mei-ur thawinak hrang le thawinak dang hrangih an pekmi ṭilva pawl an that ding ih mipi riantu si dingah ṭuanvo an nei ding."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla milem biaknak tuah tahratin Israel mipawl an hruaisual ruangah Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in siatcam in ka sim: ka hrem tengteng hai ding."},"13":{"text":"Ka puithiam hna an ṭuan lo pei; ka hrangih thilri thianghlim kiangkap khalah an feh lo pei ih Hmun Thianghlim Bik sung khalah an lut lo pei. Thil borhhlawh an tuah ruangah hi bangtuk in hremnak an tuar a si."},"14":{"text":"Biakinn sungih hnaṭuan tenau pawl ṭuan dingah ṭuanvo ka pek a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Zadok hrin Levi mi puithiam pawl cu, Israel misenpi pawl in in dungtun lai hmanah, rintlak zetin Biakinn sungah ka hna an ṭuan a si. Curuangah atu khalah annih pawl cu ka umnak ah a rami le keimah i riantu an si ding ih thawinak pekmi sathau le sathi pawl ka hnenih a petu an si ding.","title":"Puithiam Pawl"},"16":{"text":"Anmah lawnglawng ka Biakinn sungah an lut thei ding, ka biakṭheng ah hna an ṭuan thei ding ih Biakinn sung biaknak hrangih thiltuahmi pawl cu an tuah thei ding."},"17":{"text":"Biakinn laifang tualrawn ah kotka ihsin an lut tikah pat femte ih tahmi hnipuan an hruk ding. Biakinn tualrawn ah siseh, Biakinn sungah siseh ṭuanvo nei in hna an ṭuan tikah tuuhmul in tahmi hnipuan zianghman an hruk lo pei."},"18":{"text":"Cuticun thaw sa lo le thlan suak loin an um ding; pat ih tahmi lupawng le pat ih tahmi bawngbi an hruk pei, a sinan taikhap cu an khap lo pei."},"19":{"text":"Misenpi umnak a lenglam tual ih an va suah hlanah Biakinn sung hnaṭuannak ih an hrukmi hnipuan cu an hlitta pei ih khaan thianghlim sungah an retta pei. A zarhmi an hnipuan pawl cu misenpi tuahmawhtu ih an can lonak dingah hnipuan dang an hruk pei."},"20":{"text":"“Puithiam pawl cu an lu an meet lo pei, an sam khal saupi in an zuah lo pei. A mawitawk in an sam cu an zuah pei."},"21":{"text":"Puithiam pawl in a sunglam tualrawn ih an luh hlanah sabitti an in hrimhrim lo pei."},"22":{"text":"Midang ih maakmi nunau cu puithiam pawl in an ṭhi lo pei. Puithiam cun Israel mi fala him a si lole puithiam dangih thihsanmi nuhmei lawng an ṭhi pei."},"23":{"text":"“Puithiam pawl cu a thianghlim le thianghlim lo thu ah siseh, a thiangfai le thiangfai lo thu ah siseh, ka minung pawl a zirhtu an si pei."},"24":{"text":"Thu el awknak le thuneitu an um tikah ka daan bangtuk in puithiam pawl in thu an relcat pei. Ka thupekmi le ka daan bangtuk in biaknak puai pawl cu an ul pei ih Sabbath ni pawl khal thianghlimte in an ul pei."},"25":{"text":"“Puithiam in miruak tham tahratin mithianglo ah a cangter aw lo pei; a nu le a pa ih ruak, amah ih faate ruak, a unau a si lole pasal nei lo a farnu ruak dah ti lo ahcun miruak a tham hrimhrim lo pei."},"26":{"text":"Mithiang a si sal hnuah ni sarih sung a hngak hrih pei ih,"},"27":{"text":"cuih hnuah a thianfai theinak dingin Biakinn sunglam tualrawn ah feh in thawinak a pek pei. Cuticun Biakinn sungah hna a ṭuan thei sal ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo."},"28":{"text":"“Puithiam pawl in puithiam an sinak cu Israel mi pawl hnenih ka pekmi lakah an covo a si ding ih san khat hnu san khat an roh aw vivo ding. Israel ram sungah zianghman covo dang an nei lo pei. Keimah hi an ṭulmi an covo ka si."},"29":{"text":"Sangphut thawinak, sualthlah thawinak le kuansal thawinak ih pekmi pawl cu puithiam pawl ih rawl a si ding ih, ka hrangih Israel ram sungih a hleice in an retmi hmuahhmuah khal anmah in an ngah thluh ding."},"30":{"text":"Puithiam pawl in thlaithar ih pekmi a ṭha bik le ka hnenih an pekmi thil hmuahhmuah an co ding. Mipi pawl in sang an rawh tin in an rawh hmaisa bik sang cu puithiam hnenah an pek pei ih cuticun an innsang ah ka thlawsuah a thleng ding a si."},"31":{"text":"Puithiam pawl in vate le ramsa pawl anmahte a thimi siseh, ramsa dang ih dehmi sa siseh an ei lo pei,” tiah a ti."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi ram cu Israel miphun pawl hrangih zem a si tikah ṭhenkhat cu Bawipa ih hrangah pek a si pei. Peng riat sau le peng ruk kau a si pei. A ram pumpi in ram thianghlim a si pei.","title":"Ih Co Mi Ram"},"2":{"text":"Cuih ram sungah tungvang can aw mi hmun, Biakinn hrangah zuah a si pei ih dong za-nga a saumi le a kaumi a si pei; a kimvel in dong sawmnga kau hmunlawng in a kulh pei."},"3":{"text":"Hi hmunih a hrek, peng hra sau le peng riat kaumi hmun ih hrek, cu a dangte in ret a si pei; Biakinn umnak, hmun thianghlimbik a si pei."},"4":{"text":"Hi ram sungih hmun thianghlim, Biakinn sungih Bawipa ih hna a ṭuantu puithiam pawl hrangih retmi a si pei. Puithiam pawl ih inn le Biakinn saknak hmun a si pei."},"5":{"text":"Cuih tlunih hmun hrek a taang hrihmi cu Levi mi pawl, Biakinn sungih hna a ṭuanmi hrangah ret sak a si pei. Cutawk cu Levi mi pawl umnak khua a si pei."},"6":{"text":"Cuih hmun thianghlim sangtu ram, peng riat sau le peng hnih kau ih tahmi ram cu Israel mi zokhal an umnak ding khawpi hrangah ret a si pei."},"7":{"text":"Mi-uk bawi hrang khalah ram retsak a si pei. Hmun thianghlim ih nitlaknak lam ramri ihsin nitlaknak lamah Mediterranean Tifinriat tiang a thleng ding. Nisuahnak lamah cun hmun thianghlim ih nisuahnak lam ramri ihsin rampi a netnak tiang a si ding; cuticun a saulam cu Israel miphun phunkhat hrangih ṭhenmi ram can in a sau ding.","title":"Mi-uk Bawi Comi Ram"},"8":{"text":"Cuih hmun le cuih ram cu Israel ram sungah mi-uk bawi ih a comi ram a si ve ding ih cuticun misenpi pawl cu hnaihnok nawn loin ram ṭhen dangdang pawl cu Israel miphun pawl ih comi ram a si, tiah a upat ve ding."},"9":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa , in, “Maw Israel mi-uk bawi pawl, nan sualnak hi a reituk zo! Mi nan hmuhsuamnak le mi nan ramnak pawl hi baang thlang uh! A dikmi le a felmi lawng tuah thlang uh. Ka minung pawl cu an ram ihsin nan dawihlo nawn lo ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka lo sim a si.","title":"Mi-uk Bawi Hrangih Daan"},"10":{"text":"“Zokhal in a dikmi tahnak le thlainak an hmang pei:"},"11":{"text":"“Thil a romi tahnak ephah pakhat cu a tii-mi tahnak bath pakhat thawn an bang aw. Homer cu mi zapi hman bikmi tahnak a si. A hman daan cu a tanglam vekin a si: Homer pakhat cu ephah pahra le bath pahra thawn an bang aw."},"12":{"text":"“Nan thil thlainak cu a thuailam vekin a si pei: Gerah kul cu shekel pakhat thawn a bang aw. Shekel sawmruk cu mina pakhat thawn a bang aw."},"13":{"text":"“Thawinak nan pek tikah a tanglam vekin nan pek pei: Sangvut cu nan lo in a suakmi ṭhen sawmruk ih ṭhenkhat, Barli sangvut cu nan lo in a suak mi ṭhen sawmruk ih ṭhenkhat, Olif hriak cu nan thingkung in a suakmi sungin ṭhen zakhat ih ṭhen khat a si ding. Bath in tah tikah: bath pahra cu homer pakhat thawn an bang aw; homer pakhat cu kor pakhat thawn an bang aw a si. Tuu a si ahcun Israel ram sungih tuu zahnih sungah tuu pakhat a si ding. “Sangphut thawinak, mei-ur thawinak le pawlkom thawinak hrangih ṭilva pawl cu nan rak keng pei ih cuticun nan sualnak ngaithiam an si ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in thu ka lo pek a si.","merge":"14"},"16":{"text":"“Israel ramsung misenpi pawl in hi thawinak pawl cu Israel ram mi-uk bawi hnenah an keng pei."},"17":{"text":"Mi-uk bawi ih ṭuanvo cu Israel miphun pumpi hrangah Thla Thar Puai, Nizarh puai le puai dangdang tuah tikah mei-ur thawinak, sangphut thawinak le sabit thawinak pawl hrangih ṭilva pawl hawlsak ding kha a si. Israel mi pawl ih sual thianfaiternak dingah sualthlah thawinak, sangphut thawinak, mei-ur thawinak le pawlkom thawinak pawl tuahsak ding kha a ṭuanvo a si,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Thla khat thla, ni khat ni ah raitluan cawcang pakhat nan that pei ih Biakinn nan thiangter pei.","title":"Puai Pawl (Suah 12.1-20 ; Pui 23.33-43)"},"19":{"text":"Puithiam in hi sualthlah thawinak cawcang ih thisen malte cu a lak pei ih Biakinn sangka ṭhuam pawl, biakṭheng kil li parah le a sunglam tualrawn luhnak kotka ṭhuam pawlah a hnih pei."},"20":{"text":"Cuih thla ni sarih ni ah cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in tipang sual hrangah siseh, a si lole theih lo sual hrangah siseh, nan tuah pei. Cuticun Biakinn cu nan thianghlimter pei."},"21":{"text":"“Thla khat thla, ni hleili ni ah Lantak Puai tuah nan thok pei. Ni sarih sung mi hmuahhmuah in thilnu tel lo sang nan ei pei."},"22":{"text":"Puai tuah ni khatnak ni ah mi-uk bawi in amah ih sualnak le misenpi sualnak ruangah cawcang a that pei ih a pek pei."},"23":{"text":"Puai tuah ni ni sarih sung nitinte in raitluan cawcang pakhat le tuucang pakhat Bawipa hnenah a pek pei ih a pumte in mei-ur thawinak ah a ur ṭheh pei. Nitinte in mecang pakhat khal sualthlah thawinak hrangah a pek pei."},"24":{"text":"An thahmi cawcang pakhat le tuucang pakhat thawn vainim reelkhat le olif hriak pawng thum ciar pek a si pei."},"25":{"text":"“Puanthlam Puai cu thla sarih thla ni hleinga ni ah thok a si pei ih ni sarih sung cu nitinte in mi-uk bawi in cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in sualthlah thawinak, mei-ur thawinak le vainim le olif hriak a pek pei,” tiah a ti."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “A sunglam tualrawn vung luhnak nisuahnak lam kotka cu hnaṭuan ni ni ruk sung khar a si pei ih Sabbath ni le Thla Thar Puai ni ah on a si pei.","title":"Mi-uk Bawi Le Puai Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Mi-uk bawi cu a lenglam tualrawn in khaan tumpi sungah a lut pei ih kotka a thlen tikah kotka ṭhuam kiangah a ding pei. Culai ah puithiam pawl in mei-ur thawinak le remnak thawinak an pek pei. Cutawk kotka ahcun Pathian a biak pei ih cuih hnuah a suak sal pei. Kotka cu zanlam lawngah khar a si pei."},"3":{"text":"Sabbath tin le Thla Thar Puai tinah kotka hmai ahcun misenpi pawl cu an lu an kuun pei ih Bawipa an biak pei."},"4":{"text":"Sabbath ni ah mi-uk bawi in mei-ur thawinak hrangah raitluan tuufaate paruk le tuucang pakhat Bawipa hnenah a keng pei."},"5":{"text":"Tuucang pakhat thawn hmun khatah vainim reelkhat a pek pei ih tuufaate pakhat thawn a pek duhmi poh a pek pei. Cubangtuk sangphut thawinak hrangah olif hriak pawng thum a pek pei."},"6":{"text":"Thla Thar Puai ah cawcangte pakhat, tuufaate paruk le tuucang pakhat, an zatein raitluanmi a pek pei."},"7":{"text":"Cawcang pakhat le tuucang pakhat hrangah thlairawl thawinak pekmi cu rawl haan hrek ciar a si pei ih tuufaate pakhat hrangah cun mi-uk bawi ih a pek duhmi a pek pei. Cubangtuk in thlairawl thawinak ih rawl haan hrek pek a si tik poh ah olif hriak pawng thum pek a si ve pei."},"8":{"text":"Mi-uk bawi khaan tumpi sung a luh laiih kotka zin a zawh vek in, a suah tik khalah cuih kotka zin thotho a zawh pei."},"9":{"text":"“Miseenpi pawl in puai tikcu ih Bawipa an biak tikah saklam kotka ihsin a luttu pawl cu Pathian an biak hnuah thlanglam kotka in an suak pei; cule thlanglam kotka in a luttu pawl cu saklam kotka in an suak pei. Zohman an luhnak kotka in an suak sal lo pei, khatlam kotka in an suak sal pei."},"10":{"text":"Misenpi an luh tikah mi-uk bawi cu a lut ve ding ih an suah tikah a suak ve ding."},"11":{"text":"Rawl ei puai le biaknak puai tikcu ah cawcang pakhat a si lole tuucang pakhat hrangah thlairawl thawinak pekmi cu rawl haan hrek a si pei ih tuufaate pakhat hrangah cun Pathian biatu in a pek duhmi pohpoh a si pei. Cubangtuk thlairawl thawinak pek tikah cun olif hriak pawng thum pekcih a si pei."},"12":{"text":"“Mi-uk bawi in Bawipa hnenah mah lungtho ih peknak a tuah duh tikah, mei-ur thawinak a si khalle, remnak thawinak a si khalle a sunglam tualrawn vung luhnak nisuahnak lam kotka cu amah hrangah on a si pei. Sabbath ni ih thawinak a pek bangtuk in thawinak cu a pek pei ih a suah sal hnuah cun kotka cu khar a si pei,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Zingtinte in kum khat kim raitluan tuufaate cu Bawipa hnenih thawinak pekmi ah meisa in a pumte in ur a si pei. Hi thawinak cu nitinte in pek a si pei.","title":"Nitinte Pekmi Thawinak"},"14":{"text":"Cuih tlunah zingtinte in sangvut pawng li le hrek a rawi dingmi olif hriak pawng khat thawn pek a si pei. Bawipa hnenih pekmi hi thawinak hrangah daan pawl cu kum tluan ih thlunmi daan an si pei."},"15":{"text":"Tuufaate, thlairawl thawinak le olif hriak pawl cu zingtinte in Bawipa hnenah pek ringring an si pei,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in hi bangtuk in thu a pek: “Mi-uk bawi in a fapa pakhatkhat hnenah a co dingmi ram laksawng ih a pek a si ahcun cuih ram cu a fapa innsang ih ramah a cang ding.","title":"Mi-uk Bawi Le Ram"},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mi-uk bawi in a ram pakhatkhat a hnaṭuantu hnenih a pek a si ahcun Jubilee Kum a kim tikah amah ih ramah a cang sal ding. Ram cu amah ih ta a si ih amah le a fapa pawl lawngin kumkhua hrangin an nei thei ding."},"18":{"text":"Mi-uk bawi in misenpi thilri ziangvek hman a long lo pei. A ram pakhatkhat a fapa pawl a pek tikah amah ih ram sungta lawnglawng a pek pei; cuticun ka minung pawl namsuk tahrat in an ram a long thei lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cupa cun a sunglam tualrawn thlanglam kap kotka kiangih a ummi, saklam a hoimi khaan pawl luhnak ah i fehpi. Hi khaan pawl cu puithiam pawl hrangih khaan thianghlim timi an si. Cuih khaan pawl ih nitlaknak lam hmun pakhat cu i khihhmuh ih,","title":"Biakinn Coka Pawl"},"20":{"text":"“Hi hmunah hin puithiam pawl in sualthlah thawinak le kuansal thawinak hrangih pekmi sa pawl an suang pei ih thlairawl thawinak pekmi pawl tla an rawh pei; cuticun thil thianghlim cu misenpi tuahmawhtu ih a can lonak dingah a lenglam tual ah suahpi a si lo pei,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cule cupa cun a lenglam tualrawn ah i fehpi ih a kil kil li ah dong sawmli a saumi le dong sawmthum a kaumi tualrawn fate a um vivo kha i hmuh.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Cuih tual pawl cun an kimvel in lungto ih dawlmi phar an nei fingfing ih tappi cu phar thawn dai-aw in an tuah."},"24":{"text":"Cupa cun, “Hi coka pawl cu biakinn hnaṭuantu pawl in misenpi ih thawinak an pekmi sa an suannak hmun a si pei,” tiah a ti."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cupa cun Biakinn luhnak sangka ah i kirpi sal. Cuih sangka hnuai zawn cun tidai a hung puut ih Biakinn a hoinak nisuah lamah a luang. Biakinn thlanglam kap hnuai in a luang ih biakṭheng thlanglamkap lan tiang a luang.","title":"Biakinn Ihsin Tiva A Luang"},"2":{"text":"Cupa cun saklam kotka lam zawh in Biakinn ihsin i hruai ih nisuah lam a hoitu kotka lamah i kelpi. Cuih kotka ih thlanglam kapah tivate pakhat a hung suak ih a luang."},"3":{"text":"Cupa in a thil tahnak fung thawn nisuahnak lam tiva a vung luannak lamah cun dong thawngkhat a vun tah ih cutawk ihsin tiva cu tan dingah i fial. Tidai cu ka kemit tiang lawng a si."},"4":{"text":"Cule dong thawngkhat a tah salih tidai cu ka khuk a tiang. Dong thawngkhat a vun tah sal lala ih tidai cu ka taai a hung tiang."},"5":{"text":"A dang dong thawngkhat a vun tah sal tikah tidai cu a thuk tuk thlang ih ka tan thei nawn lo. A leuh ih leuh lo cun tan thei ding a si nawn lo."},"6":{"text":"Anih in, “Milaipa, hi na hmuhtonmi pawl hi ṭhatein ciing aw,” i ti. Cule cupa cun tivakap ah i kirpi sal ih,"},"7":{"text":"cutawk ka thlen tikah khatlam khatlam ah thingkung tampi an um fingfing kha ka hmu."},"8":{"text":"Cupa cun ka hnenah, “Hi tiva cu ram sungin nisuahnak lamah a luang ih Jordan tiva kuam ihsin Tipi Thi ah a thleng. Tipi Thi sungih a vung luan tikah cun ci a almi tidai hmuahhmuah cu tidai thar in a airawl ṭheh ding."},"9":{"text":"Tiva a luannak hmun kipah tisung um ramsa le nga a phunphun an um ding. Cuih tiva cun Tipi Thi ih tidai hmuahhmuah cu a tharter ṭheh ding ih a thiangfaiter ṭheh ding. A luannak kipah nunnak a suakter ding."},"10":{"text":"En-gedi Cerhti ihsin En-eglaim Cerhti tiang tipikap ah ngakaitu an um vivo ding ih cutawkah an sur pawl an pho ding. Mediterranean Tifinriat ih nga phunkim a um vekin cutawk khalah nga phunkim a um ve ding."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla tipikap ih cirhduup le tili ih tidai pawl cu an thiangfai lo ding. Citi suahnak cutawkah an um ringring ko ding."},"12":{"text":"Tiva kap hnih ah thingkung a phunphun an kho ding ih ei ṭhami rah an rah ding. An hnah a vuai dah lo ding ih an rah khal a reh dah lo ding. Biakinn ihsin a luangmi tidai in a cawm ruangah thlatinte in rah thar an rah ringring ding. Cuih thingrah pawl cu rawl ah an ring ding ih thinghnah pawl khal mi tampi ih damnak ah a cang ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in Israel hnenah, “Nan hrin hrin hleihnih ih nan zem awk dingmi nan ramri cu hibangtuk in a si pei. Josef hrin in ramṭhen ṭhenhnih an co ding.","title":"Ramri Fianternak"},"14":{"text":"Nan pu le nan pa pawl hnenah hi ram cu an ta si dingin ka pek ding tiah siatcam in thu ka rak kam zo, atu-ah a tia awtein zem aw uh."},"15":{"text":"“Saklam ramri cu Mediterranean Tifinriat ihsin nisuahnak lamah a feh pei ih Hethlon khua in Hamath Tlangkawn in Zedad khua tiang,"},"16":{"text":"Zedad khua ihsin (Damaskas ukmi ram le Hamath ih ukmi ram karlak ih a ummi) Berothah khua le Sibraim khua in, (Hauran ram ukmi ramri kiangih a ummi) Tikon khua tiang a si pei."},"17":{"text":"Cutiin saklam ramri cu Mediterranean Tifinriat ihsin nisuah lamah Enon khua tiang a si pei. Saklam ih ramri cu Damaskas le Hamath ram pawl an si."},"18":{"text":"“Nisuahnak lam ramri cu Damaskas le Hauran ramri ihsin a thok ih thlanglam ah a feh ih Jordan Tiva cu ramri ah a cang; Jordan Tiva in nitlaknak lam cu Israel ram a si ih nisuahnak lam cu Gilead ram a si; cuticun Tipi Thi kapih a ummi Tamar tiang a vung feh."},"19":{"text":"“Thlanglam ramri cu Tamar ihsin a thok ih nitlaknak lamah Kadesh tipuut tiang a feh; cule saklam nitlaknak lamah a feh vivo ih Izipt ramri ihsin Mediterranean Tifinriat a thleng."},"20":{"text":"“Nitlaknak lam ramri cu Mediterranean Tifinriat a si ih saklam ah Hamath tlangkawn in nitlaknak lam kap hmun tiang a si."},"21":{"text":"“Hi ram cu nan hrin pawl ṭhen aw uh."},"22":{"text":"Kumkhua in nanmah ih ta a si ding. Nanmah lakah a ummi ramdangmi pawl, hitawk ramah faate a neimi pawl cu ram nan zem awk tikah covo an nei ve pei. Israel minung thotho ah rel an si pei ih Israel miphun pawl thawn ram nan zem awk tikah camcawhfung an zuuk ve ding a si."},"23":{"text":"Nan lakih a ummi ramdangmi pawl khal in Israel mi bangin ram zemmi covo a ngah ve ding. Keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa in ka sim zo,” tiah a ti."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saklam ramri cu Mediterranean Tifinriat ihsin nisuahnak lamah a feh pei ih Hethlon khua in Hamath Tlangkawn ah, cutawk in Enon khua ihsin Damaskas ram le Hamath ramih ramri tiang a si pei. Nisuahnak lam ramri ihsin nitlaknak lam ramri Mediterranean Tifinriat tiang ram ṭhenmi cu Israel hrin khat in ṭhenkhat fingfing an co ding ih a tanglam hrin pawl in ramṭhen cu saklam in thlanglam ah a sangsang in an co ding a si: Dan hrin Asher hrin Naftali hrin Manasseh hrin Efraim hrin Reuben hrin Judah hrin","title":"Ram An Zem Aw","merge":"2"},"8":{"text":"Cun Judah hrin pawl ram a hun sangtu ramṭhen cu a hleice ih hman dingah a dangte ih ret a si ding. Cuih ramṭhen cu saklam in thlanglam ah peng hra a si ding ih, a kauhlam cu an hrin pawl ih an ṭhenmi nisuahnak lam ihsin nitlaknak lam ram tia a si ding. Hi ramṭhen sungah hin Biakinnpi a um ding.","title":"A Hleice Ih Retmi Ramṭhen"},"9":{"text":"Hi ramṭhen a laifangah ramṭhen a hleice in peng hra sau le peng riat kau cu Bawipa ih hrangah pekmi ram a si ding."},"10":{"text":"Hi ramṭhen thianghlim sungah puithiam pawl ih comi ram a um ding. Cuih an ram cu nisuahnak lam ihsin nitlaknak lamah peng hra kau a si ding ih saklam in thlanglam ah peng li sau a si ding. Hi ramṭhen laifangah Bawipa ih Biakinn a um ding."},"11":{"text":"Hi ram thianghlim cu Zadok ih tesinfa puithiam pawl hrangah a si ding. Annih pawl cu rinsantlak zetin ka hna an ṭuan; Israel mi pawl in thilsual an tuah tikah Levi hrin pawl cu an tel ve naón Zadok hrin puithiam pawl cu an tel ve lo."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Levi mi pawl ih ram sangtu ah ram an nei ding ih a thianghlim bik ram a si ding."},"13":{"text":"Levi hrin pawl khal in a hleice in ram an nei ding ih puithiam pawl ih ram ihsin thlanglam ah a si ding. Nisuahnak lam ihsin nitlaknak lamah peng hra a kau ding ih saklam ihsin thlanglam ah peng li a sau ding."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih pekmi ram cu ramṭhen dang pawl lakah a ṭhabik ram a si ih zuar theih, thleng theih le ṭhin theih khal a si lo. Ram thianghlim a si ih Bawipa ih ta a si."},"15":{"text":"Cuih ramṭhen sungin a taang hrihmi ram, peng hra a kaumi le peng hnih a saumi cu ram thianghlim a si lo; asinain misenpi hrangah a ṭulnak vekih hman dingmi ram a si. Cuih ramṭhen sungah an duh ahcun an um thei ih a hman khal an hmang thei. Cuih ramṭhen laifangah khawpi a um ding,"},"16":{"text":"a tung le a vang a can-aw ding ih kap khatah dong thawngli le zanga a si ding."},"17":{"text":"Hi khawpi kapah a kimvel in dong zahnih le sawmnga kau hmunlawng a um ding."},"18":{"text":"Khawpi an din ngah hnu ih a taang hrihmi ram, hmun thianghlim timi ih thlang, nisuahnak lamah peng li sau le peng hnih kau, nitlaknak lamah peng li sau le peng hnih kau ram cu khawpi sungih um mi misenpi pawl ih lo thlawh ding ram a si ding."},"19":{"text":"Khawsungih a ummi hmuahhmuah in zo hrin an si hmanah hi ram cu an thlo thei ding."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah ramṭhen laifangah a hleice ih retmi ram cu a tung le a vang can-aw a si ding ih kap khatah peng hra fingfing a si ding; hi sungah khawpi dinnak hmun tla a telcih ding a si."},"21":{"text":"Hi ramṭhen, Biakinn le puithiam pawl ram le Levi mi pawl ram le khawpi dinnak hmun pawl umnak ram lengah nisuahnak lam le nitlaknak lamih a ummi ram pawl cu mi-uk bawi ih ta a si. A ram cu nisuahnak lamah nisuahnak lam ramri tiang, nitlaknak lamah Mediterranean tifinriat tiang a si ih saklam ah Judah comi ram thawn an ramri aw ding ih thlanglam ahcun Benjamin comi ram thawn an ramri aw ding a si.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Hi a hleice ih retmi ramih thlanglam ram cu a taang hrihmi Israel hrin dang pawl ih co dingmi a si; nisuahnak lam ramri ihsin nitlaknak lamah Mediterranean Tifinriat tiang ram cu saklam in thlanglam ah a tanglam ih hrin pawl hin a sangsang in an co ding. Benjamin hrin Simeon hrin Issakhar hrin Zebulun hrin Gad hrin","title":"Hrin Dang Hrangih Ramṭhen","merge":"24"},"28":{"text":"Gad hrin ih comi ramṭhen thlanglam ah thlanglam ramri cu thlanglam nitlaknak lamah a feh ih Tamar in Kadesh ram ih ramcaar tipuut tiang, cule saklam nitlaknak lamah a feh ih Izipt ramri in Mediterranean Tifinriat tiang a si."},"29":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Hi bangtuk in ram cu Israel hrin pawl ih co dingah nan ṭhen pei ih nan zem-aw ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi sung luhnak ah kotka hleihnih a um. Khawpi cu a kapli in phardawl in a kulh ih kapkhat cu dong thawngli le zanga fingfing a sau.","title":"Jerusalem Kotka Pawl"},"31":{"text":"Kap khatah kotka pathum fingfing an um ih kotka pakhat in Israel hrin khatih hmin an keng ciar. Saklam kotka pathum cu Reuben, Judah le Levi hmin suangin an sak."},"32":{"text":"Nisuahnak lam kotka pawl cu Josef, Benjamin le Dan hmin suangin an sak."},"33":{"text":"Thlanglam kotka pawl cu Simeon, Issakhar le Zebulun hmin suangin an sak."},"34":{"text":"Cule nitlaknak lam kotka pawl cu Gad, Asher le Naftali hmin suang ih sakmi an si."},"35":{"text":"Khawpi kimvel phardawl pali cu a zatein dong thawng hleiriat a sau. Cuih caan ihsin hi khawpi hmin cu ‘Khinah Bawipa A Um,’ ti a si ding."}}}}},"27":{"info":{"name":"Daniel","shortname":"Dan","abbr":[],"desc":"Daniel"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoiakim ih Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan kum thumnak ah Babilon siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem khawpi cu a do ih a kulh ṭheh.","title":"Daniel Le A Rualpi Pawlih Thu (1.1—6.28) Nebuchadnezzar Inn Ih Um Tlangval Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in siangpahrang Jehoiakim cu a kaihter ih Biakinn thilri le hlawnthil hrekkhat pawl a lakter. A kaihmi pawl cu Babilon ah a fehpi ih Biakinn thilri a lakmi pawl cu a khawzing pawl ih biakinn thilri retnak khaan ah a ret."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in a kuthnuai ih bawi tum bik pakhat Ashpenaz kha ralkaihmi le thawngthlakmi Israel mi pawl sungin siangpahrang hrin le bawi phun, mino deuh pawl hril dingah thu a pek."},"4":{"text":"Mi piangzet, mifim, ziangkim ah zirnak a nei ciami, fimvarmi le kutke himmi an si pei ih siangpahrang inn ah hnaṭuan theitu an si pei, tiah a ti. Babilon ṭong an siar thiam le an ngan thiamnak dingah Ashpenaz cu anmah zirhtu a si pei."},"5":{"text":"Nitinte an ei an inmi cu siangpahrang inn ih ei le inmi rawl le zu a si ve pei. Cutiih kum thum zirnak an neih hnuah siangpahrang hmaiah an suak pei, tiah thu a pek."},"6":{"text":"Cutiih hrilmi lakah cun Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael le Azariah an tel ve. An pali in Judah hrin ihsin an si."},"7":{"text":"An bawi upabik cun annih cu hmin thar a sak hai ih an hminthar cu Belteshazzar, Shadrak, Meshak le Abednego ti an si."},"8":{"text":"Daniel cun siangpahrang inn ih rawl ei tahrat in le zu in tahrat in raithiang lomi si lo ding ah a thinlung a ṭhencat aw; curuangah Ashpenaz cu amah bawm dingin zaangfah a dil."},"9":{"text":"Ashpenaz khal cu Pathian in Daniel parah zaangfahnak thinlung a neihter;"},"10":{"text":"sikhalsehla Aspenaz in siangpahrang a ṭih ruangah Daniel hnenah cun, “Nan ei ding le nan in dingmi hi siangpahrang amah rori ih relcat ciami a si. Curuangah tlangval dang vekin nan cakvak lo a si pang ahcun keimah lehlam in that men ding,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Daniel cu amah le a rualpi pathum zohtu dingah Ashpenaz in mikiltu ah a retmi pa hnenah a feh ih,"},"12":{"text":"“Ni hra sung in hniksak aw. Ei dingah hanghnah hangrah le in dingah tidai in pe hnik aw."},"13":{"text":"Cule tlangval dang siangpahrang inn ih ti le rawl a ei a intu pawl thawn in ṭhim hnik awla cuih par ihsin thu cu ṭhencat sal leh aw,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Anmah kiltupa cu nihra sung hniksak dingah a lung a kim."},"15":{"text":"Nihra cu a hung kim ih an zoh tikah siangpahrang inn ih ti le rawl a eitu pawl hnakin harhdam sawn le cak sawn in an lang."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah cuih ni thokin anmah kiltupa cun siangpahrang ih pekmi rawl si loin hanghnah hangrah cu a eiter lanta."},"17":{"text":"Pathian in hi tlangval pali cu fimnak, calai lam thiamnak le theihthiamnak a pek. Cuih tlunah Pathian in Daniel cu mang lehtheinak le langnak pawl simfiang theinak a pek."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang in tikcu a khiahmi kum thum a kim tikah Ashpenaz in tlangval pawl cu Nebuchadnezzar hnenah a fehpi."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang thawn thu an ruah aw ih midang hmuahhmuah hnakin Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael le Azariah pawl in a lung an tong bik. Curuangah siangpahrang inn ih hnaṭuantu ah an cang."},"20":{"text":"Siangpahrang in ziangvek thu a suh ih, ziangvek thuharsa a suahter hmanah hi tlangval pali cun a ram ukmi sungih kutṭial zohthiam le mitkher thiam pawl hnakin a lethra in an thei thei deuh."},"21":{"text":"Persia siangpahrang Sairas in Babilon a neh tiang Daniel cu siangpahrang hnaṭuantu ah a um lanta."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar cu siangpahrang a ṭuan kum hnihnak ah mang pakhat a man. Cuih a mang cun a thin a harter tukih a it thei lo.","title":"Nebuchadnezzar Ih Mang"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah a kutṭial zohthiam pawl, a mitkher thiam pawl, dawithiam pawl le arsi zohthiam pawl kha a mang lettu dingah a ko hai. A hnenah an ra ih a hmaiih an ra din tikah,"},"3":{"text":"an hnenah cun, “Mang ka manmi in ka thin i harter tuk. A tican theih ka duh,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang hnenah Aram ṭong in, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, na nunkhua sau hram seh. Na mang cu in sim awla a tican kan lo sim pei cu,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Siangpahrang in an hnenah, “Ka mang le a tican in sim dingah ka tummi le ka ruahcat zomi a si. In sim thei lo asile nan kut le nan ke ka lo bohthlek thluh ding ih nan inn pawl khal hnawmpen ah ka cangter thluh ding."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka mang le a tican in sim thei a si ahcun laksawng le hminṭhatnak ka lo pe ding. Curuangah atu-ah ka mang le a tican cu i sim uh,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang hnenah cun, “Siangpahrang Bawipa in na mang in sim a si ahcun a tican cu kan lo sim ding,” an ti sal."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in aw-hrangzet in, “Ka ruah vek ngaingai nan sihi! A tikcu reideuh seh ti hi nan tummi a si, ziangahtile ka mang in sim thei lo ahcun,"},"9":{"text":"nan zatein hremnak bangrep ka lo pe ding, tiih ka ruahcat zomi nan theih ruangah a si. Tikcu a reideuh asile thu cu a thleng-aw deuh ding tiih ruahsannak nan neih ruangah nan lakah theihthiam awknak nan nei ih thuphan lawnglawng in sim rero a si ko. Ka mang cu ziang a si ti in sim uh. Cule ka mangih tican khal in sim thei, ti ka thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang ih thuronmi pawl in, “Hi leilung tlunah hin siangpahrang bawipa nangmah ih theih na duhmi hi a lo sim theitu zohman an um lo ding. Na thusuhmi vek hi ziangvek siangpahrang tum bik le cak bik hman in an kutṭial zohthiam, an mitkher thiam le an dawithiam pawl hnenah an sut dah keel lo."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa na thusuhmi hi a hartuk lawmmam ih khawzing pawl dah tilo milai cun na hrangah a let theitu zohman an um lo ding. Khawzing pawl le milai lakah an um fawn lo,” tiah an sawn."},"12":{"text":"Cuvete in siangpahrang bawipa cu a thin a heng, a ai a thok ih Babilon ramsungih siangpahrang ruahnak petu pawl hmuahhmuah that ṭheh dingah thu a pek."},"13":{"text":"Cuticun siangpahrang ruahnak petu pawl hmuahhmuah Daniel le a rualpi pawl tiangin thah dingah thu pek ṭheh a si."},"14":{"text":"Cule Daniel cu mi-thattu dingih ṭuanvo pekmi, siangpahrang kiltu ralkap pawl hotu ralbawi Ariok hnenah a feh. Ralring zetin a ṭong ih,","title":"Pathian In Daniel Hnenah Mang Le A Tican A Sim"},"15":{"text":"Ariok cu, “Ziangah so siangpahrang bawipa in hibangtuk thupek hrangzet cu a suah?” tiah a sut. Cutikah Ariok in Daniel cu thil umdaan hmuahhmuah a sim thluh."},"16":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Daniel cu siangpahrang hnenah a feh ih a mang ih tican a sim theinak dingah tikcu reideuh a dil."},"17":{"text":"Daniel cu a tlung ih a rualpi Hananiah, Mishael le Azariah pawl cu cuih thuhla pawl a sim ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Babilon ramsung siangpahrang ruahnak petu pawl thawn thahcih an si lonak dingah le cuih mangbangza thil an hnenih a fiangter theinak dingin, Pathian hnenih zaangfahnak dil dingah a sim."},"19":{"text":"Cule cuih zan rori ah Daniel cun langnak a hmu ih cuih mangbangza thil cu a hnenah fianter a si. Cule Daniel in vancung Pathian cu a thangṭhat."},"20":{"text":"“Pathian cu a fim ih huham a nei, Kumkhua in amah cu thangṭhat uh!"},"21":{"text":"Amah in tikcu le caan hi a tuah; Siangpahrang pawl a din hai ih Amah in a ṭhumsal hai a si. Fimnak le theihthiamnak a petu cu Amah a si."},"22":{"text":"Thuthuk le thuthup khal Amah in a langter ṭheh. Khawthim lakih thuhmi khal Amah in a thei thluh. Amah cu tleunak in a kulh."},"23":{"text":"Maw ka pu le ka pa ih Pathian, Nangmah cu ka lo thangṭhat ih ka lo upat a si. Nangmah in fimnak le cahnak i pek. Ka thlacamnak i ngai ih Siangpahrang hnenih sim ding tla i sim zo,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Daniel cu siangpahrang ruahnak petu pawl that ding ih ṭuanvo pekmi Ariok hnenah a feh ih, “That hlah aw, siangpahrang hnenah i fehpi awla a mangih tican cu ka sim ding,” tiah a ti.","title":"Daniel In Siangpahrang A Sim"},"25":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Ariok in Daniel cu siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar hnenah a fehpi ih, “Siangpahrang bawipa, Judah saltangmi lakah na mang let theitu ding pakhat ka tong zo,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Siangpahrang in (Belteshazzar ti tla ih an kawhmi) Daniel hnenah cun, “Ziang mang ka man timi le a tican i sim thei pei maw?” tiah a sut."},"27":{"text":"Daniel in, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, na mang le a tican a lo sim theitu zohman an um lo; mifim pawl siseh, mitkher thiam siseh, kutṭial zohthiam le arsi zohthiam siseh, zohman an um lo."},"28":{"text":"Sikhalsehla vancung ah, mangbangza thil a simfiang theitu Pathian a um. Amah in siangpahrang bawipa, na hnenah hmailam ih a cang dingmi thu a lo sim cia a si. Na ihthah lai ih na hmuhmi na mang cu ka lo sim ding."},"29":{"text":"“Siangpahrang bawipa, na ihthah laiah hmailam thu na man. Cule mangbangza a langfiangtertu Pathian in hmailam ih a rathleng dingmi thil kha a lo hmuh a si."},"30":{"text":"Hi thil cu ka hnenah a simfiangmi a si; keimah hi midang hnakih ka fimbik ruangah a si lo, asinain siangpahrang bawipa nangmah in na mangih tican cu na theih theinak dingah le na hnenih a ra thlengmi ruahnak pawl hi na theihnak dingah hiti in simfiang a sinak cu a si."},"31":{"text":"“Maw siangpahrang bawipa, na mangah a tum le a maksak zetmi, a vaar zetmi le a tleu zetmi, asinain zoh tikah ṭihnungza a si mi milem na hmai ih a din kha na hmu."},"32":{"text":"A lu cu sui hlirih tuahmi, a ṭaang le a kut cu ngun in tuahmi, a taai le a cawn cu dar ih tuahmi;"},"33":{"text":"a ke pawl cu thir ih tuahmi an si ih a ke zaphak cu thir a hrek, tlak a hrek ih tuahmi an si."},"34":{"text":"Cuih milem cu na zoh rero laifang ah zohmanih tham loin lungpi pakhat cu amahte in a ril ih thir le tlak ih tuahmi a ke cu a rilh ngah ih a parh ṭheh."},"35":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah thir le tlak, dar le ngun le sui pawl cu an kuaizaam ih ṭhal ih fangrialnak hmunih leivut bangtuk ah an cang ṭheh. Cuih leivut pawl cu thli in a neh malte hman um lo tiangin a semhlo ṭheh. Asinain cuih lungto cu a ṭhang vivo ih tlang tumpi ah a cang; cule leilung pumpi a khuh ṭheh a si."},"36":{"text":"“Na mang cu cumi a si. Maw siangpahrang bawipa, na mangih tican cu atu-ah ka lo sim ding."},"37":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa, nang hi siangpahrang hmuahhmuah lakah a tumbik le a maksakbik na si. Vancung Pathian in siangpahrang lakih lal bik ah a lo tuah ih huham le cahnak le hminthannak tla a lo pek."},"38":{"text":"Milai umnak leitlun hmuahhmuah uktu ah a lo tuah ih ramsa le vate tlun khalah uktu ah a lo tuah. Nangmah hi a lu ih sui kha na si."},"39":{"text":"Na hnuah ram uknak a um hrih ding naón nangmah ih ram uknak tluk cun a nasa lo ding. Cuih hnuah ram uknak pathumnak a um ding ih leilung pumpi a uk ding. Cumi cu dar ram uknak a si ding."},"40":{"text":"Cuih hnuah ram uknak palinak a um ding ih thir tlukih a cakmi a si ding. Cutiih a cah ruangah ziang hmuahhmuah a deengkuai ding ih a khiak ṭheh ding. Thir cun ziang hmuahhmuah a denkuai vekin cuih hlanih uknak hmuahhmuah cu a deengkuai ding ih a rialdip ṭheh ding."},"41":{"text":"Cule na mangih na hmuh vekin a ke le a kezung pawl cu a hrek thir, a hrek tlak an si. Atican cu cuih uknak cu a ṭhen awmi uknak a si ding tinak a si. Thir vekih cahnak a nei ve ding, ziangahtile thir le tlak an rawi-awk ruangah a si."},"42":{"text":"A kezung pawl cu a hrek thir, a hrek tlak an si ih a tican cu cuih uknak cu a hrek a cak ding ih a hrek cu a ṭawnṭai ding tinak a si."},"43":{"text":"Na hmuh vekin thir cu tlak thawn an rawi aw a si. A sullam cu cuih ram uknak ih uktu bawi pawl in hrinkhat le hrinkhat kom awknak ah hrin dangdang ṭhit ton awknak tuah an tum ding tinak a si. Sikhalsehla an tuahsuak thei lo ding, ziangahtile thir le tlak cu an rawi-aw thei lo."},"44":{"text":"Cuih ram uk bawi pawl ih ram an uk tikah vancung ih Pathian in a cem dah lomi uknak a run umter ding. Zohman in cuih uknak cu an neh lo ding; asinain uknak dang hmuahhmuah cu a siatsuah ṭheh ding ih kumkhua in a hmunta ding."},"45":{"text":"Na mangah zohman ih tham loin tlang ih lungpi cu amahte in a ril ih thir, dar, tlak, ngun le sui ih tuahmi milem a sut kha na hmu. A maksak mi Pathian in hmailam ih a ra dingmi thil kha siangpahrang bawipa nangmah a lo sim a si. Na mang manmi cekci ka lo sim zo; cule a tican khal dikzet in ka lo simfiang zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar cu leilung ah a bok ih Daniel hnenah thawinak le thil hlanmi pawl pek dingin thu a pek.","title":"Siangpahrang In Daniel Laksawng A Pek"},"47":{"text":"Siangpahrang cun, “Na Pathian hi Pathian dang hmuahhmuah lakah a maksak bik a si; siangpahrang tlunah Bawi a si ih mangbangza thil simfiangtu Pathian a si. Himi cu ka thei, ziangahtile mangbangza thil nangmah in na simfiang zo,” a ti."},"48":{"text":"Cule Daniel cu hnaṭuan tumzet a pek ih laksawng mankhung zetzet a pek hnuah Babilon peng hotu bikah a tuah; siangpahrang thuronmi pawl lakah hotubik ah a tuah fawn."},"49":{"text":"Daniel ih dilsaknak thawngin Shadrak, Meshak le Abednego khal cu Babilon peng thuhla tawlreltu ah siangpahrang in a tuah. Daniel cu siangpahrang inn ih hnaṭuantu ah a um lanta."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in, a tung pi sawmkua a vaang pi kua a si mi milem tumpi kha sui in a tuah ih Babilon peng Dura hmunrawn ah a ret.","title":"Nebuchadnezzar In Milem Biak A Fial"},"2":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in a kuthnuai ih bawi upa hmuahhmuah - ramṭhen uktu bawi pawl, ram uk bawi pawl, ram uktu bawi bawmtu pawl, mangki bawi pawl, tangka kaitu pawl, thuṭhentu pawl le bawi dangdang pawl hmun khatah rasuak dingin thu a pe. Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in sui milem a tuahmi apnak ih rasuak thluh ding an si."},"3":{"text":"Bawi hmuahhmuah cu sui milem apnak hmunah an ra suak ih sui milem hmai ih an din tikah,"},"4":{"text":"thuthantu pakhat in aw ringzet in, “Phunkip le hnamkip le ṭongkip hmangtu minung pawl, ngaihnik uh!"},"5":{"text":"Tawtawrawt an tum nan thei ding ih cuvete in hmun khatah phirivau, lemlawi, baza, ṭingṭang le a awn theimi hmuahhmuah an tum tla nan thei ding. Cutiih awnmawi an tum vete in nan lu nan kun pei ih siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar ih a tuahmi sui milem hi nan bia pei."},"6":{"text":"A lu a kun lotu le a bia lotu cu hmakhatte ah meisa alh sungah thlak an si ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah tummi aw an theih vete in phunkip, hnamkip le ṭongkip a hmangtu pawl cu an lu an kun ih siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar ih sui milem cu an bia ciamco."},"8":{"text":"Cuih caan ah Babilon mi pawl in Judah mi pawl thangsiat dingah tikcu rem cang a si.","title":"Daniel Ih Rualpi An Mawhthluk"},"9":{"text":"Annih in siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar hnenah, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, na nunkhua sau hram seh."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa nangmah in thu na pek ih awnmawi an tum vete in zokhal an lu an kun ding ih sui milem an bia ding."},"11":{"text":"Lu a kun lotu le sui milem a bia lotu cu meisa alh sungah thlak an si ding, tiah na ti."},"12":{"text":"Babilon peng uktu le hotu dingih ṭuanvo na pekmi Judah mi Shadrak, Meshak le Abednego tla cu siangpahrang bawipa na thupekmi an el. Na Pathian an bia lo, milem na tuahmi hmai khalah an kun lo a si,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang bawipa cu a thin a heng ngaingai ih cuih pathumte cu a hmai ih rak hruai dingah thu a pe."},"14":{"text":"An rat tikah,” Shadrak, Meshak le Abednego, ka khawzing an bia duh lo ih ka sui milem tuahmi hmai khalah an kun duh lo, tiah an lo timi hi thungai a si maw?"},"15":{"text":"Atu-ah tawtawrawt, phirivau, lemlawi, ṭingṭang le a awn theimi hmuahhmuah an tum ding ih cumi nan theih vete in nan lu nan kun pei ih milem hi nan bia ding. Nan biak duh lo a si ahcun hmakhatte ah meisa alh sungah hlon nan si ding. A lo hum theitu ding Pathian a um tiah nan zum maw si?” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Shadrak, Meshak le Abednego cun, “Maw siangpahrang bawipa, hi thu ahcun kanmah le kanmah ṭan-awk ṭul in kan ruat lo."},"17":{"text":"Meisa alh sungin in hum theitu Pathian a um a si ahcun kan biakmi le kan rianmi kan Pathian lawnglawng a si ih amah cun na cahnak huham sung khal in in hum ko ding."},"18":{"text":"In hum lo a va si hmanah, siangpahrang bawipa, na khawzing pawl cu kan bia lo ding ih na sui milem tuahmi hmai khalah kan kun lo ding, ti cu in theihsak cia aw,” tiah an ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutiih an ṭongmi cu Nebuchadnezzar in a theih tikah a thin a suup thei nawn lo, Shadrak, Meshak, le Abednego parih a thinheng tukah a mithmai a sen ṭheh. A minung pawl cu thu a pek ih meipi an muah ṭheumi hnakih letsarih sa dingin a muahter.","title":"Daniel Ih Rualpi Pathum Thah Ding"},"20":{"text":"Cule a ralkap sungah micak bikbik a hril ih cuih Judah mi pathum kutke ṭem dingah le meisa sungih paih dingah thu a pek."},"21":{"text":"Cute pathum cu an angki, an bawngbi le an lukhuh, an hruhlaimi thilthuam famkim thawn an ṭeem ih meipi sungah cun an paih."},"22":{"text":"Siangpahrang in meipi cu sa cuang dingah thu khohzet ih a pek vekin meipi an muahmi cu a sa ngaingai ih mi pathum meipi sungih a paihtu ralkap cakzet pawl hman cu meisa in a kaang that."},"23":{"text":"Cule Shadrak, Meshak le Abednego pawl cu an kutke ṭemmi thawn meipi sungah cun an vung tla."},"24":{"text":"Cule rinlopi-ah Nebuchadnezzar cu a mangbang in a ding lohli! A kuthnuai ih bawi pawl cu, “Mi pathum kha an kutke ṭem tahratin meipi sungah kan paih a si lo maw?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “A si bawipa, na tivek cun a si,” an ti."},"25":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa cun, “Ziangtin so meisa sungah mi pali an feh rero ka hmuh hi!” tiah a sut. “An kutke khal ṭemmi an si lo ih a na an tuarnak zianghman a lang fawn lo; cule a palinak tla cu khawzing pawl ih fapa a bang!” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar cu meipi tihnak lamih a ummi kotka lamah a feh ih, “Shadrak! Meshak! Abednego! Ziangkimtithei Pathian ih siahhlawh pawl, ra suak uh!” tiah a ko ciamco. Cule hmakhatte ah an rasuak.","title":"An Suak ih An Hnaṭuan A Kai"},"27":{"text":"Cule ram uk bawi pawl, ramṭhen uktu pawl, ramṭhen uktu bawmtu pawl le siangpahrang kuthnuai ih bawi hmuahhmuah an ra ih meipi ih a tuahmawh lomi mi pathum cu an ra zoh ciamco. An sam phangkhat hman a kang lo, an hnipuan khal a kang lo ih meisa rim hman an nam lo. Cumi cu an hmu ṭheh."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in, “Shadrak, Meshak le Abednego ih Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh! Amah a riantu le a rinsantu pawl runsuak dingah a vancungmi a run thlah a si. An biakmi an Pathian siar lo khawzing dang biak le a hmai ih kun hnak cun ka thupekmi an el ih an nunnak tiangin an pe ngam sawn a si."},"29":{"text":"“Curuangah atu in thu ka lo pe a si: Zovek phun le zovek hnam an si hmanah, ziangbangtuk ṭong a hmangtu an si hmanah Shadrak, Meshak le Abednego ih Pathian upat lonak thawn a ṭongtu an um a si ahcun anmah cu an kut le an ke bauhthlek ṭheh an si pei ih an inn cu hnawmpen ih canter ṭheh an si pei. Hi bangtuk ih mi run theitu khawzing dang khui hmanah a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Siangpahrang in Shadrak, Meshak le Abednego cu Babilon peng sungah an hnaṭuan a kaiter a si."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in phunkip, hnamkip le ṭongkip hnenah a tanglam thu hi a cah: “Nan parah daihnak um ko seh!","title":"Nebuchadnezzar Mang Pahnihnak"},"2":{"text":"Cungnungbik Pathian in ka hnenih a langtermi mangbangza le khawruahhar thil pawl hi rak ruat ciar hnik uh."},"3":{"text":"“Pathian ih in hmuhmi mangbangza pawl hi ziangtlukinso a maksak! Khawruahhar a tuahmi hi ziangtlukinso huham a neih! Pathian cu kumkhua in siangpahrang a si ding, sanikhuk in a uk ding."},"4":{"text":"“Ka inn ah nunnuamzet le neinungzet in ka rak um ṭheu."},"5":{"text":"Asinain voikhat cu ka ih laiah ṭihnungza mang ka man ih tuksumza thil ka hmu."},"6":{"text":"Cuih ka mangih tican i simfiangtu dingah Babilon peng sungih siangpahrang thuronmi pawl kokhawm dingah thu ka pek."},"7":{"text":"Kutṭial zohthiam pawl, pol pawl, mitkher thiam pawl le arsi zohthiam pawl an ra ih ka mang cu ka sim naón a sullam zohman in in simfiang thei lo."},"8":{"text":"Cule Daniel a ra. (Daniel cu ka khawzing hmin suangin Belteshazzar ti tla in kawh a si.) A sungah khawzing thianghlim pawl ih thlarau a um ih a hnenah ka mang cu ka sim. A hnenah:"},"9":{"text":"Belteshazzar, kutṭial zohthiam pawl hotu, na sungah khawzing thianghlim pawl ih thlarau a um ih thil mangbangza le thil thuuk na thei thei, ti ka thei. Ka mang cu hihi a si; a tican i sim aw!"},"10":{"text":"“Ka ih laiah langnak ka hmu ih leilung pumpi laifangah thingkung tumpi pakhat ka hmu."},"11":{"text":"Cuih thingkung cu a ṭhang deuhdeuh a sang deuhdeuh ih a ziik in van a dai ih leitlun mi hmuahhmuah in an hmu thei a si."},"12":{"text":"A hnah pawl cu an mawi ngaingai, a rah a tam ngaingai ih leilung pumpi ei khopin a tam. Ramsa pawl a hneem ah an bok, vate pawl in a hnge ah bu an sak ih a nungmi tinkim in a rah cu an ei."},"13":{"text":"“Cuih langnak ih thu ka ngaihtuah rero laiah van ihsin felzet le ralring zetih khua a tangmi vancungmi pakhat a rung ṭum."},"14":{"text":"Aw ringzet in thu a run phuang ih, ‘Zanthing hi hau uhla a hnge pawl tan ṭheh uh. A hnah pawl hleuh thluh uhla a rah pawl ṭhekdarh ṭheh uh. A hnen ihsin ramsa pawl le a hnge ihsin vate pawl dawihlo ṭheh uh."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a sumhmui le a hram cu thir le dar cikcin thawn khit uhla leilung ah taan uh. Cutawkah hrampi lakah cun taanta uh. “‘Atu ihsin himi pa ih parah dai tla-aw sehla ramsa le thingkung le hrampi lakah umseh."},"16":{"text":"Kum sarih sung milai thinlung keng lo in ramsa thinlung sawn a keng ding."},"17":{"text":"Himi cu a fel ih a ralringzet vancungmi ih thurelcat mi a si. Cuti a si ruangah leilungtlun khuazakip mi in thei hai seh: Cungnungbik Pathian in minung ih ram uknak tlunah thu a nei ih cuih ram uknak cu a duhmi hnenah a pek, leitlun mi nauta bik hnen khalah a pek thei a si, a ti."},"18":{"text":"“Himi hi ka mang cu a si. Atu-ah Belteshazzar, ka mangih tican i sim aw. Ka thuronmi pawl pakhat hman in a tican in sim thei lo; a sinan nang cun na sim thei ding, ziangahtile khawzing thianghlim pawl ih thlarau na sungah a um a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Belteshazzar ti khalih kawhmi Daniel cu a thin a phang ih zianghman a ṭong thei lo. Cutikah siangpahrang in a hnenah, “Belteshazzar, ka mang le a tican in lo phangter hlah seh,” tiah a ti. Belteshazzar cun, “Siangpahrang bawipa, na mang le a tican hi na hrangah si loin na ral pawl ih hrangah sisehla ka va duh so!"},"20":{"text":"Thingkung a sangzet ih a ziik in van a daimi cu leilungtlun mi hmuahhmuah in an hmu thei."},"21":{"text":"A hnah pawl cu an mawizet ih a rah cu leilung pumpuluk ih eikhop dingin a tam. A hnuai ah ramsa pawl an bok ih a hnge ah vate pawl in bu an sak."},"22":{"text":"“Maw siangpahrang bawipa, a sangzetmi le a hngetzetmi thingkung cu nangmah hi na si. Na nasazet ih van na dai; na cahnak huham cu leilung pumpuluk ah a thleng.","title":"Daniel In Mang A Simfiang"},"23":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa, nangmah in na zoh laiah van ihsin vancungmi a rung ṭum ih, ‘Thingkung hi hau uhla cekkuai ṭheh uh; a sinan a sumhmui cu leilung ah taanta uh. Thir le dar cikcin in khit uhla hramlakih hrampi lakah cun taanta uh. Hi pa parah dai tla-aw sehla cutawkah ramsa thawn kum sarih sung um hai seh,’ a ti."},"24":{"text":"“Maw siangpahrang bawipa, na mangih tican cu hiti in a si ih Cungnungbik Pathian in na parih a rathleng dingmi cu a phuang zo."},"25":{"text":"Minung umnak khua le ram ihsin dawihlo na si ding ih ramsa lakah na um ding. Kum sarih sung cawcang bangin hrampi na ei ding; hramlakah na it ding ih dai in a lo tlak ding. Cule minung ram uknak tlunah Cungnungbik Pathian in thu a nei timi le cuih ram uknak cu a duhmi hnenah a pek timi hi na thei ngah ding."},"26":{"text":"Sumhmui cu leilung ih taanta dingah vancungmi in thu a pek. A tican cu Pathian in leilung pumpi a uk a si, ti na theih ngah tikah siangpahrang na cangsal ding, tinak a si."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang bawipa, thu ka lo simmi hi ngai aw. Sualnak tuah nawn hlah, a dikmi tuah awla mifarah pawl zaangfah aw. Cuticun na ṭhangso vivo ding,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"A tivek cun siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar parah a kim ṭheh."},"29":{"text":"Thla hleihnih hnuah, Babilon khua a siangpahrang inn parih a toihvah rero laiah,"},"30":{"text":"“Zohhnik uh, Babilon a maksakzia hi!
