Ka khawpi ah ka tuah ih ka huham le ka cahnak, ka sunlawinak le ka maksaknak langter dingah ka din a si,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"A ṭongmi hman a ṭong thluh man hlanah van ihsin aw in, “Siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar, ka simmi hi ngai aw! Na siangpahrang huham cu na hnenih sin lakhlo a si zo."},"32":{"text":"Minung umnak khua le ram ihsin dawihlo na si ding; hramlak ramsa lakah na um ding ih kum sarih sung cawcang bangin hrampi na ei ding. Cule Cungnungbik Pathian in minung ram uknak tlunah thu a nei ih cuih ram uknak cu amah ih duhmi hnenah a pe thei, tihi na thei ngah ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"A tivek cun a kim ngaingai. Nebuchadnezzar cu minung umnak khua le ram ihsin dawihlo a si ih cawcang vekin hrampi a ei ngaingai. A taksa parah dai a tla; a sam cu muvanlai thlahmul tlukin a sau ih a tin cu vate tin vekin a hriam."},"34":{"text":"“Kum sarih a kim tikah van khi ka hun zoh ih ka thinlung a kim sal. Cungnungbik Pathian cu ka thangṭhat ih kumkhua ih a nungmi hnenah cun upatnak le sunlawinak ka pek a si,” tiah siangpahrang cun a ti. “Kumkhua in a uk ding, A uknak cu kumkhua in a hmun ding.","title":"Nebuchadnezzar In Pathian A Thangṭhat"},"35":{"text":"Leitlun minung pawl cu zianghmanlo ah a zoh hai. Van ih vancungmi le leitlun ih minung pawl cu, Amah in a uk thluh a si. Zohman in a duhnak an el thei lo; A thiltuahmi khal thu an sut thei lo."},"36":{"text":"“Ka thinlung a kim sal tikah cun ka hminthannak, ka maksaknak, ka sunlawinak le ka ram uknak pawl cu ka hnenah pek ṭheh an si sal. Ka kuthnuai ih bawi a rak si mi le ka minung phun-u pawl khal in in rak cohlangsal ih ka siangpahrang thuneihnak tla cu a hlan hnakih nasa sawn in ka hnenah pek a si sal."},"37":{"text":"“Atu-ah cun keimah Nebuchadnezzar in vancung siangpahrang ka cawimawi, ka upat ih ka sunloih fawn a si. A tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu a ding le a dikmi an si ih puarthau zetih thil a tuahtu cu a ṭhum a si,” tiah siangpahrang in a ti."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zan khatah siangpahrang Belshazzar in rawl ei-puai tumpi a tuah ih a kuthnuai um bawi le upa pawl thawngkhat a sawm ih hmun khatah zu an in tlang.","title":"Belshazzar Puaituahnak"},"2":{"text":"Cutiih zu an in laiah Belshazzar cun Jerusalem Biakinn ihsin a pa Nebuchadnezzar in sui khuathai le ngun khuathai le kheng pawl a rak lakmi kha rak keng dingin thu a pek. Amah le a bawi upa pawl, a nupi pawl le a nusun pawl in zu an innak ding hrangah a cahmi a si."},"3":{"text":"A cah vek cun hmakhatte-ah sui khuathai le kheng pawl cu an rak keng ih zu in-nak ah an hmang."},"4":{"text":"Cuticun sui le ngun, dar le thir, zanthing le lungto tla ih tuahmi khawzing pawl cu an thangṭhat ciamco."},"5":{"text":"Rinlopi ah milai kut pakhat a lang ih mei-inn vannak ṭhuam zawn phar parah cun ca a ngan. Ca a ngan rerotu kut cu siangpahrang in a hmu."},"6":{"text":"Cuvete in a mithmai a raam thluh; a ṭih ngaingai ih a khuk a ṭhia ciamco."},"7":{"text":"Cule mitkher thiam pawl, dawithiam pawl le arsi zohthiam pawl ko dingah mi a auh ciamco. An kawhmi pawl cu an rathleng ih an hnenah siangpahrang in, “Hi canganmi a siar theitu le a sullam i sim theitu cu siangpahrang puansen in thom a si pei, a hngawng ah hminṭhatnak sui ṭhirual a orh ding ih ka uknak sungah thuneihnak lamah pathumnak a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang ruahnak petu pawl cu hmaiah an ra suak ih canganmi cu an zoh naón zohman in an siar thei lo; a tican tla siangpahrang a sim theitu zohman an um lo."},"9":{"text":"Siangpahrang Belshazzar cu a van a sang ih a hmai a raam sinsin; A bawi upa pawl khal in ziang tuah ding an thei hrimhrim lo."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang le a bawi upa pawl mangbang ih an umnak thawmvang cu siangpahrang nu in a theih tikah rawl einak khaan sungah a ra lut ih, ‘Siangpahrang bawipa, na nunkhua sau hram seh! Hi bangtuk in thinhar le hmairaam cun um hram hlah aw."},"11":{"text":"Na ramsungah hin khawzing thianghlim pawl ih thlarau a neitu mi pakhat a um. Na pa siangpahrang a rak si laiah cupa cun ruahnak dik le theihnak a neihzia kha a langter zo ih a fimnak tla cu khawzing fimnak bangtuk a si. Curuangah na pa siangpahrang Nebuchadnezzar in kutṭial zohthiam pawl, mitkher thiam pawl, tinzoh thiam pawl le arsi zohthiam pawl ih hotu ah a tuah a si."},"12":{"text":"Thilti theinak a hleice in a nei; a fimzet ih mangih tican sim le mangbangza theih theinak le thuthuuk sim theinak lamah cun a thiam ngaingai. Curuangah cupa, siangpahrang in Belteshazzar ti ih hmin a sak mi, Daniel cu ko awla amah in a sullam a lo sim thluh ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Zamrangte in Daniel cu siangpahrang hmaiah cun an rak hruai ih siangpahrang in a hnenah, “Daniel na si maw? Judah mi salih kaihmi, ka pa siangpahrang in Judah ram ihsin a rak hruaimi Daniel na si maw?","title":"Daniel In Canganmi Ih Tican A Sim"},"14":{"text":"Khawzing thianghlim pawl ih thlarau na sungah a um ih thiamnak, theihnak le fimnak na nei tiah ka lo thei."},"15":{"text":"Ruahnak i petu pawl le mitkher thiam pawl hi canganmi siartu dingah le a tican i simtu dingah an rak hruai naón a tican an thei thei hrimhrim lo."},"16":{"text":"A thup-awmi ih a tican a sim thei ih thil thuuk tla a sim thei tiah ka lo thei zo. Hi canganmi hi na siar thei ih a tican i sim thei ngaingai a si ahcun siangpahrang puansen in thom na si ding, hminṭhatnak suiṭhi na hngawng ah orh na si ding ih hi ramsung thuneihnak lamah pathumnak na si ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Daniel in, “Na laksawng cu na hrangah re ko aw, a si lole midang pe aw. Siangpahrang bawipa na hrangah hi canganmi cu ka siar ding ih a tican ka lo sim ding."},"18":{"text":"“Cungnungbik Pathian in na pa Nebuchadnezzar cu siangpahrang tumzet ah a tuah ih huham a neihter ih mi nasa a siter."},"19":{"text":"A nasa tuk ih phunkip, hnamkip le ṭongkip a ṭongmi in an ṭih ih an khur ciamco. Mi pakhatkhat thah a duh ahcun a that mai, nunter a duh ahcun a nunter mai. A duhduh in mi cu hminṭhatnak a pek ih mualpho khal in a tuah a si."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cutiih puarthau in, thinlungruh in le zaangfah thinpemnak zianghman nei lo ih a um ruangah cun a siangpahrang tokham cu lon a si ih upatnak dinhmun cu a sung a si."},"21":{"text":"Minung umnak khua le ram in dawihlo a si ih a thinlung cu ramsa thinlung vekah a cang. Hramlak laak lakah a um ih cawcang vekin hrampi a ei ih, humtu le phentu zianghman nei loin leenkolh ah a it ih dai in a tlak. Neta bikah Cungnungbik Pathian in minung ram uknak tlunah thu a nei ih cuih ram uknak cu a duhmi hnenah a pek thei a si, ti kha a run thei ngah."},"22":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla cuih thu pawl cu nang a fapa hin na thei ṭheh naón na thinlung a neem cuang lo."},"23":{"text":"Vancung Bawipa dodal in hna na ṭuan ih Biakinn ihsin lakmi khuathai le kheng pawl hinah na keng ṭheh. Nangmah le na tlangsuak pawl, na nupi pawl le na nusun pawl in cuih khuathai thawn zu nan in ih sui le ngun, dar le thir, zanthing le lungto thawn tuahmi khawzing pawl nan thangṭhat ciamco. Khua a hmu thei lomi khuavang, zianghman thu a thei thei lo le zianghman theihnak a nei lomi khawzing cu nan cawimawi ciamco. Nan nunnak le nan thihnak tlunih laireltu, na tuahmi hmuahhmuah tlunih thuneitu Pathian sawn cu upatnak zianghman nan pe lo."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah hi thu pawl ngantu dingah kut a rak kuatnak cu a si."},"25":{"text":"“A nganmi cu, ‘Mene, mene, tekel u-pharsin,’ ti a si."},"26":{"text":"Atican cu a tanglam bangtuk in a si: ‘Mene,’ ti cu ‘siar’ tinak a si ih na ram uknak hi Pathian in a ni a siar zo ih a cemter cing ding, tinak a si."},"27":{"text":"‘Tekel,’ ti cu ‘cuai thlai’ tinak a si ih thlai na si tikah cuai na kim lo tinak a si."},"28":{"text":"‘u-pharsin,’ ti cu ‘ṭhen’ tinak a si ih na ram uknak hi ṭhenṭhek thluh a si ih Media mi le Persia mi hnenah pek a si, tinak a si,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Belshazzar in Daniel kha siangpahrang puansen hruh dingah le a hngawng ih suiṭhi orh dingah a hnaṭuantu pawl thu a pek. Cutiin a uknak ih thuneitu bik pathumnak ah a tuah."},"30":{"text":"Cuih zan rori ah Babilon siangpahrang Belshazzar cu an that ih,"},"31":{"text":"kum sawmruk le kum hnih a timi Media mi Darias in Babilon ram cu a lak a si."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darias in a ram pumpi uktu dingah ramṭhen uktu bawi za le kul a ret.","title":"Kiosa Khumnak Sungah Daniel"},"2":{"text":"Cuih bawi pawl zohtu le hotu ah bawi upa pathum a ret ih culak ah Daniel cu pakhat a si; ramṭhen uktu bawi za le kul cu an kutthuai ah an um. Annih in siangpahrang hrangih thil thupi le a ṭulmi pawl an ngaihtuah a si."},"3":{"text":"Reilote ah Daniel cu hotu a dang pahnih hnakin le ramṭhen uktu bawi dang pawl hnakin a hnaṭuan a ṭhat deuhnak kha a lang. Cutiin midang hnakih a lang deuh ruangah siangpahrang in a ram pumpi uktu dingah Daniel cu a ruat."},"4":{"text":"Cule hotu dang pahnih le ramṭhen uktu bawi pawl cun Daniel in sualnak le palhnak a nei maw ti an hawl ciamco; a sinan a sualnak an hmu lo, ziangahtile Daniel cu mifel rintlakzet a si ih thilsual le zumtlak lo thil zianghman a tuah lo."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah anmah le anmah cu, “A biaknak thu ah dah tilo Daniel sual kan puh theinak ding zianghman kan hmu zik lo,” tiah an ti aw."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah siangpahrang tong dingah an feh ih a hnenah, “Darias siangpahrang bawipa, na nunkhua sau hram seh!"},"7":{"text":"Na ram pumpi uktu bawi pawl, hotu pawl, ramṭhen uktu bawi pawl, ramṭhen uktu bawi bawmtu pawl le bawi dangdang kan zatein thinlung khatión thil pakhat kan lo dil. Thu pe awla na thupekmi vekih an thlun ṭhehnak dingah ngaihtuah aw. Ni sawmthum sungah zohman in siangpahrang bawipa nangmah hnen siarlo ziangvek khawzing le zovek milai hnen hmanah thlacammi le ngenmi nei hlah hai seh. Hi thupekmi a thlun lotu cu kiosa khumnak sungah hlon hai seh."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa nangmah in hi thu hi suah awla na hmin khen aw. Cule mi hmuahhmuah ih thlun ṭheh dingin ngaihtuah aw; zohmanih thleng thei lomi Media mi le Persia mi pawl ih daan suahmi ah cang seh,” tiah an ti."},"9":{"text":"An tivek in Darias cun thu a pek ih a thupekmi parah a hmin a khen."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang in a hmin a khen zo, tikha Daniel in a theih tikah a inn ah a tlung. A inn tlunta khaan ahcun Jerusalem lam hoi in sangkate an um. Cutawkah a tuah ringring ṭheu vekin a ong awmi sangkate pakhat kiangah cun a khuk a bil ih ni khat ah voithum Pathian hnenah thla a cam."},"11":{"text":"Daniel in Pathian hnen ah thla a cam ringring thotho ti kha a huatu pawl in an hmuh tikah,"},"12":{"text":"Daniel sualpuh dingah an zatein siangpahrang hnenah an feh. Annih in, “Maw Siangpahrang bawipa, atu ihsin ni sawmthum sung siangpahrang bawipa nangmah hnen siarlo zohman in ziangvek khawzing le ziangvek milai hnen hmanah thlacammi le ngenmi nei hlah hai seh, tiah thu na pek zo,” tiah an ti. Siangpahrang bawipa in, “Asi, zohman ih el thei lomi thupek a si. Zohman ih thleng thei lomi Media le Persia mi pawl ih daan suahmi a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah annih in siangpahrang hnenah, “Judah ram ihsin salkaihmi pakhat Daniel in siangpahrang bawipa nangmah a lo upat lo ih na thusuahmi khal a thlun lo. Nitinte ni khatah voithum thla a cam a si,” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cuih thu cu siangpahrang in a theih tikah a thin a nuam lo zet ih Daniel runsuak theinak dingah lamzin a phunphun a hawl. Sun nihlawh a hawl naón a hum theinak lamzin a hmu lo."},"15":{"text":"Daniel a phiartu pawl cu siangpahrang hnenah an ra ih, “Siangpahrang bawipa, Media le Persia daan a si vekin siangpahrang ih a pek ciami thu cu thleng theih a si nawn lo, ti cu nangmah in na thei ko,” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang in Daniel kai dingah thu a pek ih an kaih hnuah kiosa tampi khumnak sungah an thlak. Daniel hnenah cun siangpahrang in, “Rintlak zetih na renmi na Pathian in lo run hram seh,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Zohman ih an run thei lonak dingah lungto tumpi pakhat thawn kiosa khumnak cu an khar ih siangpahrang hmin khennak tacik le a bawi upa pawl ih tacik in an khen."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa cu a inn ah a tlungkir ih cuih zan cu zanvar it lo, rawl khal ei lo le nomnak zianghman tuah loin a um."},"19":{"text":"Zingthlapit ah a tho ih kiosa khur ahcun zamrangte in a va feh."},"20":{"text":"A va thlen tikah thinlung harzet in, “Maw Daniel, a nungmi Pathian riantu! Rintlak zetih na renmi na Pathian cun kiosa kaa sung ihsin a lo hum thei maw?” tiah a auh."},"21":{"text":"Cule Daniel cun, “Maw Siangpahrang bawipa, na nunkhua sau hram seh!"},"22":{"text":"Pathian in kiosa pawl ih kaa huptu dingah a vancungmi a run thlah ih pakhat hman in in siatsuah lo. Sualnak zianghman ka nei lo ih siangpahrang bawipa na parah mawhnak zianghman ka neih lo ruangah a si,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang cu a lung a awi tuk ih Daniel cu kiosa khur sung ihsin suah dingah thu a pek. An suah ih tuahmawhnak zianghman a ton lo kha an hmu; Pathian a rinsan ruangah a him a si."},"24":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang in Daniel sual a puhtu pawl cu an nupi le an faate pawl thawn kai tahrat in kiosa khumnak sungih thla dingah thu a pek. A thupekmi vekin an kai ih kiosa khumnak sungih an thlak tikah leilung hman an thlen hlanah kiosa cun an rak zon ih an ruh pawl tiangin an ṭamkiak ṭheh a si."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang Darias cun mi phunkip, hnamkip le ṭongkip a ṭongtu leitlun mi hmuahhmuah hnenah ca a ngan: “Nan parah daihnak um hram seh!"},"26":{"text":"Ka ramsung mi hmuahhmuah in Daniel ih Pathian cu upat ding le ṭih dingah thu ka pek zo. “Amah cu a nungmi Pathian, Kumkhua in a hmunmi Pathian a si. A uknak cu siatsuah a si dah lo ding ih a huham cu cem ni a nei dah lo ding."},"27":{"text":"“Mi runtu le mi humtu a si. Lei le van khuazakip ah, Mangbangza le khawruahharza a tuah. Kiosa kaa sung ihsin Daniel a hum a si,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Daniel cu Darias uk sung le Persia mi siangpahrang Sairas uk sungah neinung zetin a nung a si."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Belshazzar in Babilon siangpahrang a ṭuan, kum khatnak ah keimah Daniel mang ka man ih zanah hmuhnak ka nei. Ka mang cu ka ngan ih cuih zanih ka hmuhmi cu,","title":"Daniel In Langnak A Simfiang (7.1—12.13) Daniel In Sahrang Pali A Hmuhnak"},"2":{"text":"hi vekin a si: Khawzakip in thli a hrang ih tipithuanthum tidai tla a sem ciamco."},"3":{"text":"Tipithuanthum sung cun sahrang tum zetzet pali an hung suak ih pakhat le pakhat an dang ciar."},"4":{"text":"Sahrang pakhatnak cu kiosa a bang, asinain muvanlai vekin thla a nei. Cutiih ka zoh laiah a thla cu a tlekcat. Cule sahrang cu an cawisaang ih milai bangin an dinter. Cuih hnuah milai thinlung an neihter a si."},"5":{"text":"A pahnihnak sahrang cu savom a bang ih a dunglam ke in a ding. A ha in hnakruh pathum a keu ih a hnenah cun, “Na ei thei zat in ei rero ko aw,” tiah aw pakhat in a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutiih ka zoh laiah sahrang dang pakhat a hung suak. Tlavang a bang naón a zaang parah thla pali a nei; a thla cu vate thla vek a si. Lu khal pali a nei. A hmuihmel zoh tikah thuneizet ding a bang."},"7":{"text":"Cumi ka zoh rero laiah a palinak sahrang a hung suak. Huham neizet, ṭihnungza le tuksumza ramsa a si. Thir ha a nei ih an tum zetzet; cuih a thir ha thawn a dehmi pawl cu a ṭam ṭheh ih a palcih hai fawn a si. Sahrang dang vek si loin hi sahrang cun ki pahra a nei a si."},"8":{"text":"Cutiih a ki pawl ka zoh rero laiah a ki lakah cun ki fate a hung suak ka hmu. Cuih ki fate cun a hmaisa ki pathum cu a thlong hai. Cuih ki fate cun milai mit a nei ih kaa khal a nei ih puarthau zetin a ṭong ciamco."},"9":{"text":"Cutiih ka zoh rero laiah cun siangpahrang tokham pawl an hun ret. Kumkhua ih a nungmi cu tokham pakhat parah a to. A hnipuan cu vur vekin a rang ih a sam cu tuuhmul vekin a thiangfai. A tokham cu meisa leng parah a um ih a hlio ciamco;","title":"Kumkhua In A Nungmi A Hmu"},"10":{"text":"meiling cu tidai luang bangin cutawk cun a suak ciamco. Amah riantu dingah minung a thawng a za in an um ih a hmaiah minung a thawngih thawngin an ding. Thuṭhennak cu an thok ih cabu pawl an kau."},"11":{"text":"Cutiih ka zoh laiah ki fate in tluang a khawn rero le puarthau zetih a ṭong rero lai hrih ka thei. Cule ka hmuhhngan ah sahrang palinak an that ih a ruak cu meisa sungah an hlon ih cuticun a cemta."},"12":{"text":"A dang sahrang pawl cu an huham neih mi hmuahhmuah laksak ṭheh an si, asinain an nunnak cu caan tawite sung zuah an si."},"13":{"text":"Zan ih langnak ka hmuhmi ahcun minung a bangmi pakhat ka hmu. Mero par in a ra ih kumkhua ih a nungmi hnenah cun a feh ih a hnenah a thleng."},"14":{"text":"Cule phunkip, hnamkip le ṭongkip ih ṭongtu pawl in amah an rian theinak dingah a hnenah cun thuneihnak, hminthannak, upatnak le siangpahrang huham hmuahhmuah pek a si. A thuneihnak cu kumkhua in a hmun ding ih a uknak a cem dah lo ding."},"15":{"text":"Langnak ka hmuhmi cun ka thin i phangter ih ka thinlung i buaiter.","title":"A Hmuhmi Fianternak"},"16":{"text":"Cutawkih a dingmi pakhat hnenah ka hung feh ih a tican i simfiang dingah ka hung sut. A sullam cu hiti in i sim."},"17":{"text":"Hi sahrang tum zetzet pali cu leilung tlunih a suak dingmi uknak pali an si."},"18":{"text":"Cule Cungnungbik Pathian ih minung pawl in siangpahrang huham an ngah ding ih kumkhua in kumkhua tiang an cota ding,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cule sahrang palinak, sahrang dang thawn a bang-aw lomi, ṭihnungza sahrang, a dar ke-tin le a thir ha thawn a dehmi hmuahhmuah a bohthlek ih a palcih rerotu ih thu theih ka duh."},"20":{"text":"A lu parih ki pahra a neihnak, neta ih ki pakhat a hung suahnak le a hung suah ruangih ki pathum an thlongnak thu tla cu theih ka duh. Mit a nei, kaa khal a nei ih puarthau zetin a ṭong ciamco. A dang hnakin ṭihnungza bik a si."},"21":{"text":"Cutiih ka zoh laiah cuih ki cun Pathian ih minung pawl a do ih a neh."},"22":{"text":"Cule kumkhua ih a nungmi a ra ih Cungnungbik Pathian ih minung pawl ṭan in thuṭhennak a tuah. Pathian minung pawl in siangpahrang thuneihnak an co caan a ra thleng zo."},"23":{"text":"Cuticun ka hnenah in simfiang a si: “Sahrang palinak cu leilung tlunih a hung suak dingmi uknak palinak a si ding ih uknak dang thawn a bang-aw lo ding. Leilung pumpi hi a neh ṭheh, a siatsuah ṭheh ding ih a palcih ciamco ding."},"24":{"text":"Ki pahra cu cuih uknak a uktu ding siangpahrang pahra an si. Cule siangpahrang dang pakhat a suak ding; amah cu siangpahrang dang thawn an bang-aw lo ding ih siangpahrang pathum pawl kha a hlon ding."},"25":{"text":"Cungnungbik Pathian a relsia ding ih Pathian minung pawl a hrem ding. An biaknak daan pawl le puai pawl thleng a tum ding; Pathian minung pawl cu kum thum le a hrek sung a kuthnuai ah a ret ding."},"26":{"text":"Cuih hnuah vancung thuṭhennak a rung um ding ih a huham le a thuneihnak hmuahhmuah cu laksak ṭheh a si ding; siatsuahnak a tong ding ih a hloralta ding."},"27":{"text":"Leitlun uknak hmuahhmuah ih huham le maksaknak pawl cu Cungnungbik Pathian ih minung pawl hnenah pek a si ding. An comi siangpahrang huham cu a cem nawn lo ding ih leilungtlun mi uktu hmuahhmuah in an rian ding ih an upat ding,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Himi hi thunetnak a si. Ka ṭih tukih ka raam ṭheh; cuih thu cu ka thinlung sungah ka ret ringring."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Belshazzar in siangpahrang a ṭuan kum thumnak ah voihnihnak langnak ka hmu.","title":"Daniel In Tuu Le Me A Hmu"},"2":{"text":"Cuih langnak ka hmuhmi ahcun Elam peng lungdawl ih kulhmi Susa khawpi sungah um in ka thei aw. Ulai Tivapi kapah ka ding ih,"},"3":{"text":"cuih tivakap ahcun tuucang pakhat, ki saupi pahnih a neimi ka hmu; a ki pakhat cu a dang ki hnakin a sau ih a no deuh fawn."},"4":{"text":"Cuih tuucang in nitlak lam, saklam le thlanglam a khik rero kha ka zoh. Ramsa dang in an kham thei lo; a mi nehnak cun an luat thei fawn lo. A duhduh in ziang hmuahhmuah a tuah hluahhlo ih a hngalzet."},"5":{"text":"Cumi ih tican mangbangin ka ngaihtuah rero laiah nitlak lam ihsin mecang pakhat a ra tlan ciamco ka hmu; a tlan a cak tuk ih a ke in leilung a dai man lo. A mit le a mit karlakah a langzetmi ki pakhat a nei."},"6":{"text":"Tiva kapah a ding ka hmuhmi tuucang lamah cun a feh ih tuucang cu a tha neih patawp in a zon."},"7":{"text":"Tuucang a zon le a sual lai cu ka zoh. A thin a heng tuk ih tuucang cu nasa zetin a a ki pahnih kiak ko in a khik. Tuucang cun khik ve theinak thazaang zianghman a nei lo. Leilung ah a ril ih mecang cun a palcih a si; a run theitu zohman an um lo."},"8":{"text":"Cuih mecang cu a puarthau deuhdeuh ih a cah bik laitak ah a ki cu a kiak. Cuih ki pakhat ai ahcun a langzetmi ki pali an hung suak; a ki pali cun saklam, thlanglam, nisuah lam le nitlak lam an hoi fingfing."},"9":{"text":"Ki pali lakih pakhat sung ihsin ki fate pakhat a hung suak ih a huham cahnak cun thlang lam, nisuah lam le Ram Tiam lam a pan."},"10":{"text":"Van ralkap, arsi pawl do ding tlak in a cak ih a do ih a hrekkhat cu leilungih a hlon hnuah a palcih."},"11":{"text":"Van ralkap pawl hotu bawi hman a dodal; nitinte a hnenih an pekmi thawinak cu a kham ih Biakinn a tiborhhlawh a si."},"12":{"text":"Cutawkah nitin thawinak pek ai-ah minung pawl in sualnak an tuah; biaknak dik cu leilungah hlonthlak a si. A tuahmi hmuahhmuah ah cuih ki cu a hlawhtling a si."},"13":{"text":"Cule vancungmi pakhat in a dang vancungmi hnenah, “Hi langnak sungih a langmi thil hi ziangtik tiangso a rei ding? Hi bangtuk tuksumza sualnak hin ziangtik tiangso nitin thawinak pekmi cu a ai-awh ding? Ziangtik tiangso van ralkap pawl le Biakinn cu palcih an si hrih ding?” ti ih a sut kha ka thei."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah cuih vancungmi cun, “Hi thil hi zanlam le zinglam thawnghnih le zathum sung a rei ding ih cuih sungah zinglam le zanlam thawinak pekmi zianghman a um lo ding. Cuih hnuah Biakinn cu a hlan vekin a um thei sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cuih langnak ih tican ka ruah rero laiah rinlopi in mi pakhat ka hmaiah a ra ding.","title":"Langnak Cu Gabriel In A Fianter"},"16":{"text":"Ulai Tivapi tlun ihsin aw pakhat in a rak auh ih, “Gabriel, a hmuhmi ih tican cu a hnenah simfiang aw,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Gabriel cu a ra ih ka kiangah a ra ding; ka ṭih tukih leilung ah ka bok. Ka hnenah cun, “Milaipa, hi thu hi theithiam aw. Na hmuhmi hi leilung cemnak thuthawn pehawknak a nei a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutiih a ṭong rero laiah ka tlu ih zianghman ka thei lo. Sikhalsehla anih cun i tho ih i dinter ih,"},"19":{"text":"“Pathian thinhengnak in ziangbangtuk thil a suahter ding tihi ka lo hmuh a si. Na hmuhmi langnak hi caan neta bik thawn pehtlaihnak a nei a si."},"20":{"text":"“Ki pahnih a neimi tuucang na hmuhmi kha Media le Persia uknak can-ai a si."},"21":{"text":"Mecang kha Grik uknak can-ai a si ih, a mit karlakih a langzetmi ki kha an siangpahrang hmaisa bik can-ai a si."},"22":{"text":"Ki pakhat a kiah hnu ih ki pali a hung suakmi kha an ram a ṭhen awk ṭheh hnu ih a hung suak dingmi uknak pali can-ai an si; hi uknak pali hi hmaisa uknak tluk cun an cak lo ding."},"23":{"text":"“Cuih uknak pawl an cem zik cuahco thlang ih an siatvaat tuk ruangih hremnak an tuar tikcu a hung kim cuahco tikah mi lungruh, mi sualral le mi bumhmang siangpahrang pakhat a hung suak ding."},"24":{"text":"A cak vivo ding, asinain a cahnak cu amah ih thilti theinak ruangah a si lo ding. Siatsuahnak nasa zetin a suahter ding ih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah ah a hlawhtling ding. Mi cak zetzet le Pathian ih minung pawl parah siatnak tampi a thlenter ding."},"25":{"text":"Mi depde a si ruangah bumnak in thil a ti thei vivo ding. A zum aw ngaingai ding ih rinloparal ah mi tampi a tisiat ding. Siangpahrang lakih siangpahrang maksak bik hman a dodal ding; sikhalsehla amah cu milai cahnak tel lotein siatsuahnak a tong ding."},"26":{"text":"Na hnenih simfiang zo a si mi zinglam le zanlam raithawinak pekmi thu ih langnak na hmuhmi cu a ra kim ngaingai ding. Sikhalsehla thuthup ah ret aw, ziangahtile a kimnak dingah tikcu a rei hrih ding a si,” tiah i ti."},"27":{"text":"Ka thin a har ih ni tam nawn sung ka dam lo. Cuih hnuah ka tho ih siangpahrang ih fialmi hna cu ka ṭuan thei sal. Asinain ka hmuhmi cun ka mang i bangter ih ka theih thei mi a si lo."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahasueras ih fapa, Media mi Darias in Babilon ram cu a uk.","title":"Daniel In A Minung Pawl Hrangah Thla A Cam"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang a ṭuan kum khatnak ah cabu thianghlim pawl ka siar ih Bawipa in profet Jeremiah hnenih a rak sim cia bangtuk in Jerusalem cu kum sawmsarih sung siatsuah in a um ding timi thu cu ka ngaihtuah rero."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian hnenah thinlung taktein thla ka cam; rawl ul in, buri hnipuan hruk in vutcam lakah ka to ih ka dil rero."},"4":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa ka Pathian hnenah thla ka cam ih ka minung pawl ih sualnak tla ka phuang. A hnenah, “ Bawipa Pathian, nang cu na maksakzet ih ka lo upat ngaingai. Na thukammi parah cun rintlakzet na si ih a lo duhtu le na thukham a thluntu parah cun a hmunmi duhdawtnak na nei."},"5":{"text":"“Kannih cu kan sual zo, mi sualral kan si ih mawhnak a tuahtu kan si. Kan tuah dingih na thupekmi cu kan hnong ih nangmah in thildik in hmuhmi ihsin kan pial zo."},"6":{"text":"Na hmin in kan siangpahrang pawl, in uktu pawl, kan pupa pawl le kan miphun pumpi hnenah na profet pawl in thu an sim naón a lo riantu pawl ih thu cu kan ngai duh lo."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nang cun a dikmi na tuah ringring naón kannih cun kan parah ningzahnak thil lawnglawng kan thlenter. Judea ram le Jerusalem khua, ramhla le ramnai hmunkip ih na ṭhekdarh mi Israel mi hmuahhmuah kan zatein kan mualpho ṭheh zo."},"8":{"text":"Kan siangpahrang pawl, in uktu pawl le kan pupa pawl cu ningzak le fihnungza in an rak nung ih, maw Bawipa , na parah kan sual zo."},"9":{"text":"Na parah raltho phun kan si nacingin in ngaithiam ih in zaangfah a si."},"10":{"text":"Maw Bawipa kan Pathian, a lo riantu profet pawl hnen ihsin in pekmi na daan pawl bangtuk ih nung dingah in sim rero naón kan lo ngai duh cuanglo."},"11":{"text":"Israel mi hmuahhmuah in na daan pawl cu kan bal ih na thu kan ngai lo. Cutiin na parih kan sual ruangah na siahhlawh Moses ih Daan sungih a ummi siatcamnak pawl cu kan parah na thlenter a si."},"12":{"text":"Kanmah le in uktu pawl parah ka thlenter ding na timi cu na thlenter ngaingai. Leitlun khua dangdang hnakin Jerusalem cu nasa deuh in na hrem;"},"13":{"text":"Moses Daan sungih a ummi hremnak hmuahhmuah cu kan parah na thlenter ṭheh. Cuti si nacingin, maw Bawipa kan Pathian, kan sualsir in le thudik thlun tahratin na lungawiter kan tum hrih lo."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian nang cun a dikmi na tuah ringring ruangah le na thu kan ngai duh lo ruangah kanmah hrem ding na tum ih na tumtah vekin in hrem taktak."},"15":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa kan Pathian, na cahnak le na huham na langter ih na minung pawl Izipt ram ihsin na suahter; na huham cu an ciing lai ringring. Kan sual zo, kan mawh tuk zo."},"16":{"text":"A liam ciami tikcu sungah nangmah cu in ṭantu na si ringring; curuangah Jerusalem parah na thinheng nawn hram hlah aw. Jerusalem cu na khawpi a si, na tlang thianghlim a si. Kanmah kan sual ruangah le kan pupa pawl in thilsual an rak tuah ruangah a kiangkap ramih mi hmuahhmuah in Jerusalem le na minung pawl cu an nautat a si."},"17":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka thlacamnak le ka lo ngennak hi i theihsak hram aw. A siat ṭheh zomi na Biakinn cu a hlan vekin tungding sal aw; cuticun Pathian ngaingai na si ti an lo thei ding."},"18":{"text":"Maw Pathian, in run ngai hram aw. In run zoh awla harnak kan tonzia le na hmin a kengtu khawpi in harsatnak a tonzia hi run hmu hram aw. Thildik kan tuah ruangah si loin nang cu mi zaangfahtu na si ruangah na hnenah thla kan cam."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa , in run thei aw. Bawipa in ngaidam aw. Bawipa in run ngai awla in tuahsak hram aw! Mi hmuahhmuah in Pathian na sizia hi an theihnak dingah rei nawn hlah! Hi khawpi le hi minung pawl hi na ta an si ko,” ka ti."},"20":{"text":"Ka sualnak le Israel mi pawl sualnak phuangin thla ka cam ringring ih amah ih Biakinn thianghlim cu a hlan vekih a tundin salnak dingah Bawipa ka Pathian cat loin ka dil a si.","title":"Gabriel In a Simfiang"},"21":{"text":"Cutiih thla ka cam laiah ka rak hmuh ciami Gabriel cu ka umnak hmunah cun a rung zam. Zanlam thawinak pek caan a si."},"22":{"text":"Gabriel cun ka hnenah, “Daniel, hi thu na theih theinak dingin nangmah bawm dingah ka ra."},"23":{"text":"Pathian hnenih na dil tikah amah in a lo let ko. A lo duhdaw ih cuih thu sim dingah ka ra zo. Langnak na hmuhmi ih tican ka simfiang mi hi ṭhatein ngai aw."},"24":{"text":"“Sualnak le ṭhat lonak ihsin na minung pawl le na khawpi an luatnak dingah Pathian in kum sawmsarih ih let sarih a khiah zo. Sualnak cu ngaidam a si ding, dingnak cu kumkhua hrangin hngehter a si ding; cuticun sim ciami le na hmuhmi pawl cu an ra thleng ngaingai ding ih Biakinn thianghlim cu a thar in thianhlimter a si sal ding."},"25":{"text":"Himi hi ciing ṭha awla ruatfel aw: Jerusalem dinsal dingih thupek tikcu caan ihsin Pathian ih hrilmi hotu a rat hlanlo kum sarih let sarih a liam ding. Jerusalem cu lamzin tumpipi le ruhkulh hngetzetzet thawn dinsal a si ding ih kum sawmruk le kum hnih ih let sarih sung a ding ding; a sinan hih caan hi harsatnak le buainak caan a si ding."},"26":{"text":"Cuih caan a cem tikah Pathian ih hrilmi hotu cu dik lozetin an that ding. A cakzetmi ram uktu ih ralkap pawl in khawpi le Biakinn cu an siatsuah ṭheh ding. Tilik bangin a netnak a ra thleng ding; Pathian ih a timtuah ciami ral le siatsuahnak an ra thleng ding a si."},"27":{"text":"Cuih ram uktu bawi cun kum sarih hrangin mi tampi thawn lungkimnak cakhen a tuah ding ih cuih tikcu ih hrek a cem tikah peknak le thawinak pawl cu a cemter ding. Thil Fihnung Tuksumza cu Biakinn sung hmunsangbik ah ret a si ding ih cutawkih a rettupa in Pathian ih tumtahsakmi netnak a ton hlanlo cutawk hmunsang bik ahcun a um ringring ding."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sairas in Persia siangpahrang a ṭuan kum thumnak ah Belteshazzar ti khalih kawhmi Daniel ih hnenah thu pakhat langter a si. Cuih thu cu thudik a si, asinain theih a har ngaingai. A hnenah langnak in simfiang a si.","title":"Tigris Tivapi Ah Daniel Ih Hmuhmi"},"2":{"text":"Culai ah zarh thum sung lungngai in ka rak um."},"3":{"text":"Zarh thum a kim hlan cu rawlthaw zianghman ka ei lo, sa khal ka ei lo; sabitti ka in lo ih ka sam khal ka hriat lo."},"4":{"text":"Cuih kum thla khatnak thla, ni kul hluanli ni ah tiva tumzet ṭigris Tivapi kapah ka ding."},"5":{"text":"Khua ka hun cuan ih minung bangtuk pakhat, puan hmangfeem hnipuan a hruk ih sui ṭha bik taikhap a khaptu ka hmu."},"6":{"text":"A taksa ruangpi cu lungvar bangin a tleu. A mithmai cu nimthlakau vekin a vaang ih a mit tla cu meisa hlio vekin a hlio. A baan le a ke pawl cu hnawtfaimi dar vekin a tleu zukzo ih a aw cu miburpi au thawm bangtuk a si."},"7":{"text":"Cuih langnak a hmutu cu keimah lawng ka si. Ka kiangih a ummi pawl cun zianghman an hmu lo, asinain an ṭih ngaingai ih an tlan, cule an relh."},"8":{"text":"Keimah lawng ka taang ih cuih mangbangza langnak cu ka zoh rero. Ka tha a cem ṭheh, ka mithmai tla a dangzet ih zohman in in thei thiam zik lo."},"9":{"text":"A aw ka theih tikah leilungah ka tlu ih zianghman thei loin ka bokkhup."},"10":{"text":"Cule kut pakhat in i kai ih ka kut le ka khuk in i vak ter. Ka khur rero lai."},"11":{"text":"Vancungmi cun, “Daniel, Pathian ih duhdawtmi na si. Ding awla ka lo sim dingmi hi ṭhatein ngai aw. Na hnenih thlah mi ka si,” tiah i ti. Cutiih a sim vete in ka hung ding. Asinain ka khur rero thotho."},"12":{"text":"Cule anih in, “Daniel, ṭih hlah. Theihthiamnak nei dingah tangdor dingih na ruahcat ni ihsin na thlacam Pathian in a thei. Na thlacamnak lo let dingah ka ra zo."},"13":{"text":"Persia ram kilvengtu bawi vancungmi in ni kul hluankhat sung i kham. Cule vancungmi lakih a tum bik pakhat Mikhael in i ra bawm, ziangahtile Persia ramah cun keimah lawng taantami ka si."},"14":{"text":"Hmailam ah na minung pawl parah ziang a thleng ding ti lo theihter dingah ka ra zo a si. Hi langnak cu hmailam thu a si,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutiih a ṭong tikah cun leilung lawng ka zoh, zianghman ṭong thei loin ka um."},"16":{"text":"Cule minung vek a si mi vancungmi cun a kut a run dawh ih ka hmur i tham. A hnenah cun, “Bawipa, hi langnak hin ka tha i cemter ṭheh ih khur loin ka um thei lo."},"17":{"text":"A bawipa hmaiih a dingtu sal vek ka si. Na hnenah ziangtinso ka ṭong thei ding? Thazaang zianghman ka nei lo, thaw thawt ding khal ka nei lo,” tiah ka ti."},"18":{"text":"I run tham sal ih cak deuh in ka thei aw."},"19":{"text":"Anih cun ka hnenah, “Pathian in a lo duhdaw a si. Curuangah zianghman phang hlah, zianghman in lo ṭihter hlah seh,” a ti. Cutiih i ti tikah cun ka cak deuhdeuh in ka thei aw ih a hnenah, “Bawipa, i sim dingmi cu i sim aw. I cakter deuh zo,” tiah ka ti."},"20":{"text":"Anih in, “Ziangruangah na hnenah ka ra, ti hi na thei maw? Thutak Cabu sungih an nganmi na hnenih phuang dingah ka ra. Atu-ah Persia ram kilvengtu bawi vancungmi do dingah ka kirsal ding. Cuih hnuah Grik ram kilvengtu bawi vancungmi a lang ding. Israel ram kilvengtu bawi vancungmi Mikhael siarlo i bawmtu zohman an um lo.","merge":"21"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amah Michael cu i bawmtu le i ṭantu dingah ṭuanvo neitu a si."},"2":{"text":"Cule atuih ka lo sim dingmi hi thudik a si,” a ti. Vancungmi cun, “Persia ram cu siangpahrang pathum in an uk hrih ding. A palinak siangpahrang cu a dang pawl hnakin a lian deuh ding. A cah bik le a lian bik laitak ahcun Grik ram a zuam ngam ding."},"3":{"text":"“Cule a ralṭha zetmi siangpahrang pakhat a hung suak ding. A uk mi ram cu a kau ngaingai ding ih a duhmi poh a tuah hluahhlo ding."},"4":{"text":"Asinain a cah bik laitak ah a ram ukmi cu a ṭhen-aw thluh ding ih ram pali ah a cang ding. Amah ih tesinfa a si lomi in a ai-ah siangpahrang an ṭuan ding, sikhalsehla amah tluk cun zohman in huham an nei lo ding."},"5":{"text":"“Izipt ram siangpahrang cu a cakzet ding. A ralbawi tumbik pakhat cu amah hnakin a caksawn ding ih a ram ukmi tla a kausawn ding.","title":"Izipt Le Siria Ram Pawl"},"6":{"text":"Kum tampi hnuah Izipt siangpahrang in Siria siangpahrang thawn ṭantlangnak cakhen an tuah ding ih a fanu tla a nupi dingah a pe ding. Sikhalsehla cuih cakhen cun rei a awh lo ding. Izipt siangpahrang ih fanu, a pasal, a fa le amah a thluntu, siahhlawh pawl thah ṭheh an si ding."},"7":{"text":"Reilote ah Izipt siangpahrang fanu ih sungkhat siangpahrang a cang ding. Siria siangpahrang ralkap pawl a do ding; an ral ṭannak ruhkulh sung tiangin a nor ding ih a neh ding."},"8":{"text":"An khawzing lem pawl le an khuavang pawl hnenih pekmi sui le ngun ih tuahmi thilri pawl cu Siria ihsin Izipt ah a phurkir ding. Kum rei nawn daihnak a um hnuah,"},"9":{"text":"Siria siangpahrang in Izipt ram a do ding; asinain a siip sal a ṭul ding."},"10":{"text":"“Siria siangpahrang fapa pawl in raldo dingah an tim an tuah ding ih ralkap tam ngaingai an khawm ding. Siangpahrang fapa lakih pakhat in ral pawl ih ṭanhmun an khuarnak cu tilian bangin a do ding."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah a thinhengin Izipt siangpahrang in Siria siangpahrang cu a do ding ih a ralkap tam ngaingai a kai ding."},"12":{"text":"Cutiih ral a neh ruangah le Siria ralkap tampi a thah ruangah cun a hngalzet ding; asinain ral cu a neh ringring lo ding."},"13":{"text":"“Siria siangpahrang khal a kirsal ding ih a hlan hnakih ralkap tamdeuh in a khawm ding. A tikcu a remcan tikah hriamnam ṭhazet kengtu a ralkap siarcawk lo thawn Izipt do dingah a pan ding."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Izipt mi tampi cu an siangpahrang duh lo ah ral an tho ding. Cule Daniel, na miphun sungin mithah ṭih lo mi hrekkhat cu, langnak an hmuh ruangah ral an tho ve ding; sikhalsehla an sung ding."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Siria siangpahrang cun ralhruang ih kulhmi khawpi cu a kulh ding ih a la ding. Izipt ralkap pawl cun an do thei nawn lo ding; an ralkap lakih a cakbik pawl hman raldo dingah thazaang an nei nawn lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Ral nehtu Siria cun dotu zohman nei loin a duhduh a tuah vivo ding. Ram Tiam ah a ding ding ih cuih ram cu a kut sungah a hum ding."},"17":{"text":"“Cule Siria siangpahrang cun raldo dingah a ngaihtuah ding; a ralkap hmuahhmuah hman a tum ding. A ral ram siatsuah ṭheh dingah a ral thawn ṭantlangnak cakhen a tuah ding ih a fanu tla a nupi dingah a pe ding. Asinain a tumtahmi cu a tisuak lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Cuih hnuah tifinriat kap ram pawl a do ding ih ram tampi a neh ding. Sikhalsehla ramdang pakhat uktu bawi in amah cu a neh ding ih a puarthaunak cu a cemter ding; a puarthaunak cu amah Siria siangpahrang par lala ah a thlenter ding."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu amah ih ram ralṭannak ralhruang ah kir tahratin a ṭang ding naón a sung thotho ding; cuticun anih khal a cem ding."},"20":{"text":"“Amah ih hnuah siangpahrang dang pakhat a suak ding. Cuih siangpahrang cun a ramsung paisa ṭhanter duh ah a kuthnuai bawi pakhat a fial ding ih a ram minung pawl hnen ihsin ngunkhuai tampi in a la ding. Reilote ah cuih siangpahrang cu an that ding, sikhalsehla mizapi hmuh ah a si lo ding ih raldonak hmun khalah a si lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Vancungmi in a simfiang vivo ih, “Cuih siangpahrang a hun sangtu Siria siangpahrang cu mi ṭha lo, mi siakha zet a si ding; siangpahrang can theinak lamzin khal a nei lo ding naón rinlopi ah mibumnak in siangpahrang thuneihnak cu a long ding a si.","title":"Mi ṭha lo Siria Siangpahrang"},"22":{"text":"Amah a dodaltu cu, Pathian ih Puithiam Sang a si khalle, hlonhlo le hnonhlo a si ding."},"23":{"text":"Cakhen tuah tahrat in ram tampi a bum ding; ram fate uktu asinain ni khat hnu ni khat a cak deuhdeuh ding."},"24":{"text":"Rinlopi ah a lianzetmi peng a do ding ih a pupa pawl ih tuah dah lomi thil a tuah ciamco ding. Raldonak ih a lakmi le a lonmi hransaw thilri pawl cu amah a thluntu pawl a zem ciamco ding. Ralhruang tampi do dingah a tum lawk ding naón a rei hlanah a tikcu a cem ding a si."},"25":{"text":"Ralṭha zetin Izipt ram do dingah ralkap tampi a la ding; Izipt siangpahrang khal amah do dingah ralkap tamzet le cakzet thawn a tiar-aw ve ding. Asinain Izipt siangpahrang cu phiarnak a tong ding ih a hlawhtling lo ding."},"26":{"text":"A thuron bikmi pawl in an siatsuah ding; a ralkap tampi thah an si ding ih an ṭekdarh ṭheh ding."},"27":{"text":"Cule siangpahrang pahnih cu cabuai pakhat ah rawl an hil tlang ding; sikhalsehla an thinlung cu a ṭha lo veve ding ih pakhat le pakhat an bum aw ton rero ding. An tumtahmi cu an tisuak lo ding, ziangahtile a tikcu a kim hrih lo."},"28":{"text":"Siria siangpahrang cu a lonmi thilri hmuahhmuah thawn a tlungkir ding; Pathian minung pawl ih biaknak siatsuah ṭheh tum in a tlungkir ding. A duhduh a tuah vivo ding ih amah ih ramah a kir ding a si."},"29":{"text":"“Nehhnu ah Izipt ram a do sal ding; sikhalsehla a hlan vekin thil a cang thei lo ding."},"30":{"text":"Rom miphun pawl amah do dingah lawng thawn an ra ding ih a thin a phang ding. “Cule a thinheng in a kir ding ih Pathian minung pawl ih biaknak siatsuah a tum ciamco ding. Mah ih biaknak a tlansantu pawl ih ruahnak pekmi kha a thlun ding."},"31":{"text":"A ralkap hrekkhat pawl cun Biakinn an borhhlawhter ding. Nitin thawinak pekmi cu an cemter ding ih thil Fihnung Tuksumza an ret ding."},"32":{"text":"Cuih siangpahrang cun hrawhhrawlnak thawn hna a ṭuan ding ruangah an biaknak a dungtuntu pawl cun an bawm ding; sikhalsehla Pathian a thluntu pawl cun an do ding."},"33":{"text":"Mipi lakih hotu fim pawl in an fimnak kha mi tampi hnenah an hlawm ve ding. Asinain a rei hlanah cupawl ṭhenkhat cu raldonak ah an thi ding ih ṭhenkhat meisa tla in an ur that ding. Cule mi ṭhenkhat cu an thilri lonsak an si ding ih thawng ih thlak an si ding."},"34":{"text":"Cutiih thahnak an tuar rero laiah Pathian minung pawl cu bomnak malte an ngah ding; anmah ṭantu mitampi cu mahih zawnruahnak ruangih ṭantu an si ding."},"35":{"text":"Cuih hotu fim hrekkhat pawl cu thahnak an tuar ding naón cutiih tuarnak ruangah misenpi pawl cu an thiangfai deuh ding. Cuticun caan netnak, Pathian ih a khiahmi caan, a thlen hlan cu a si vivo hrih ko ding."},"36":{"text":"“Siria siangpahrang cun a duhduh a tuah ding. Ziangvek khawzing hnakin ka tum sawn, tiah tluang a khawng ding ih Cungnungbik Pathian hnak hmanin ka maksak sawn, tiah a porh-aw ding. Pathian hremnak a ton hlan cu cutiin a ti thei vivo ko ding. Asinain Pathian cun a tumtah vek cekci in a tuah suak ding."},"37":{"text":"Siangpahrang cun a pupa pawl ih an rak renmi khawzing, le nunau pawl ih an duhzetmi khawzing khal zianghman ah a siar lo ding. Ziangbangtuk khawzing hman a poisa lo ding, ziangahtile khawzing hnakin ka tum sawn, tiah a ruat-aw ding a si."},"38":{"text":"Cuhnakin ralhruang a humhimtu khawzing a upat sawn ding. A pupa pawl ih an biak dah lomi khawzing hnen sawnah sui le ngun, lungmankhung le laksawng sunglawi dangdang a pe ding."},"39":{"text":"A ralhruang pawl ihsin ṭangtu dingah ramdang khawzing biatu pawl a hmang ding. Amah kha in uktu bawi na si, ti ih a saangtu pawl cu upatnak, hminṭhatnak, hnaṭuan tumpipi le laksawngah leiram a pe ding."},"40":{"text":"“Siria siangpahrang ih netnak tikcu a kim cuahco thlang tikah Izipt siangpahrang in amah kha a do ding; cule Izipt siangpahrang cu a cahnak zate, a rang le a rangleng pawl le lawng tampi thawn a do ve ding. Tilian bangin ram tampi a do ding."},"41":{"text":"Ram Tiam hman a do ding ih a thawng a thawngin a that ding; sikhalsehla Edom ram, Moab ram le Ammon ram a taang hrihmi pawl cu an luat ding."},"42":{"text":"Hi ram pawl a do tikah cun Izipt ram hman a luat lo ding."},"43":{"text":"Izipt ramih an thuhmi hlawnthil, sui, ngun le a dang thil mankhung pawl a la ṭheh ding. Libia ram le Ethiopia ram tla a neh ding."},"44":{"text":"Cule nisuah lam le sak lam ihsin a thlengmi thuthang in a thin a phangter ding; thinṭeu zetin a do sinsin ding ih khua-le-ram tampi a siatsuah ding ih mi tam ngaingai a that ding."},"45":{"text":"A siangpahrang puanthlam pawl hman cu tifinriat le Biakinn dinnak tlang karlakah a sak ding. Sihmansehla cutawkah zohman bawmtu nei loin a thi ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Puan hmangfeem ih tuahmi hnipuan a hruktu vancungmi in, “Cuih caan ah na minung pawl a kilvengtu vancungmi maksak Mikhael a lang ding. Hi miphun pawl hnenah an thawhkeh ihsin an ton dah lomi harsatnak nasazet a thleng ding. Cuih tikcu a kim tikah Pathian cabu sungih hmin nganmi na miphun pawl cu runsuak an si ding.","title":"Tikcu Netnak"},"2":{"text":"A thi zomi minung tampi an nungsal ding; mi ṭhenkhat cu kumkhua nunnak an co ding ih ṭhenkhat cu kumkhua ningzahnak an tuar ding."},"3":{"text":"Hotu fim pawl cu van ih tleunak hmuahhmuah thawn an tleu ding. A dikmi tuah dingah mitampi a zirhtu pawl cu arsi bangin kumkhua in an tleu ding,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule ka hnenah, “Daniel, atu-ah cabu cu khup awla leilung a cem hlanlo cu zohman ih on lo dingin a parah tacik khen aw. Minung tampi in thil a cangmi pawl ih tican theih an tum rero ding naón an zuamnak cu alak a si ṭheh ding,” tiah i ti."},"5":{"text":"Cuih hnuah tivakap ah mi pahnih an din ka hmu; kap khatah pakhat fingfing an ding."},"6":{"text":"Cuih mi pakhat in tiva tlunlam ih a dingtu vancungmi hnenah, “Hi vek khawruahhar thil pawl a cem hlanah tikcu ziangtlukso a um hrih ding?” tiah a sut."},"7":{"text":"Vancungmi cun a kut pahnih van lamah thlir in Kumkhua Pathian hmin saal in thukamnak a tuah ih, “Kum thum le a hrek a um ding. Pathian minung pawl hremnak a cem tikah hi thil hmuahhmuah cu a kim ṭheh ding a si,” a timi ka thei."},"8":{"text":"Cutiih a timi cu ka thei naón a tican ka thei thei lo. Curuangah, “Bawipa, ziangvekin so a cemnetnak a si ding?” tiah ka sut sal."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah anih in, “Daniel, atu-ah feh aw, ziangahtile hi thu pawl cu tikcu netnak a thlen hlanlo zohman ih theih lo dingin thuh ih tacik khenmi a si ding."},"10":{"text":"Mi tampi cu thianternak an ngah ding. Mi ṭhalo pawl cun an thei thei lo ding ih an ṭha lo vivo ko ding; asinain mifim pawl cun an thei thei ding."},"11":{"text":"“Nitin raithawinak an baansan, cumicu Fihnung Tuksumza an tuah thok ihsin, ni thawngkhat le zahnih le sawmkua a liam ding."},"12":{"text":"Ni thawngkhat zathum sawmthum le ni nga a cem hlanlo rintlak zetih a nungtu pawl cu milungawi an si!"},"13":{"text":"“Cule nang Daniel, a net tiang rintlak zetin um aw. Leitlun na nunnak cu a cem ding, asinain tikcu netnak ahcun laksawng co dingin na thosal ding,” tiah i ti."}}}}},"28":{"info":{"name":"Hosea","shortname":"Hos","abbr":[],"desc":"Hosea"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz le Hezekiah pawl siangpahrang an ṭuan san le Israel siangpahrang, Joash fapa Jeroboam in siangpahrang a ṭuan laiah Bawipa ih thu cu Beeri fapa Hosea hnenah a ra."},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel miphun hnenih a ṭong tikah hmaisa bik ah Hosea hnenah, “Feh awla nupi va ṭhi aw; na nupi cu hlawhhlang a si ding ih na faale pawl khal an nu vek an si ding. Ka miphun in in tlansan zo ih hlawhhlang phun ah an cang zo,” tiah a ti.","title":"Hosea Ih Nupi Le Faate Pawl"},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Hosea cun Gomer a ṭhit. Gomer cu Diblaim fanu a si. Fa a vun ih fapa a hring."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Hosea hnenah, “A hminah ‘Jezreel,’ sak aw; ziangahtile Israel siangpahrang ih pu Jehu in Jezreel khua ih mi a rak thah ruangah a rei hlanah Israel siangpahrang ka hrem ding a si. Jehu tesinfa pawl ih uknak san cu ka cemter ding."},"5":{"text":"Cule Jezreel phairawn ah Israel ralkap pawl ih cahnak cu ka siatsuah ṭheh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Gomer in fa pahnihnak a hun nei ih fanu a si. Cule Bawipa in Hosea hnenah, “A hmin ah ‘Lo-ruhamah,’ sak aw; ziangahtile Israel mi pawl cu ka lainat nawn lo ding ih ka ngaidam nawn lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Asinain Judah mi pawl cu ka lainat ding. Bawipa an Pathian keimah in ka run ding; asinain cutiih ka run tikah raldonak ralnam, li le thal, rang le rangralkap thawn ka run lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Gomer in a fanu cu pawhte fawp a baanter hnuah fa a vun sal ih fapa a hring."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in Hosea hnenah, “A hmin ah ‘Lo-ammi,’ sak aw; ziangahtile nannih Israel mi cu ka minung nan si lo ih kei khal nan Pathian ka si lo,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Israel miphun cu tifinriat ih vunnel zat an si leh ding; tah cawk lo le siar cawk lo an si ding. Atu-ah Pathian in, “Israel cu ka minung a si lo,” a ti. Asinain “Nannih cu a nungmi Pathian ih faate nan si,” a ti ni a ra thleng leh ding.","title":"Israel Cu Dinter Sal A Si Ding"},"11":{"text":"Judah mi le Israel mi cu an kom-aw sal ding. Anmah hrangah hruaitu pakhat an hril ding ih a hlanlai vekin an ram sungah an karhzai ding ih an ṭhangso ding. Asi, Jezreel san cu san maksak a si ding."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Curuangah nan unau Israel mi pawl cu “Pathian minung,” tiah le “Bawipa Ih Duhmi,” tiah ko uh."},"2":{"text":"Ka faale pawl, nan nu hi sim hnik uh; amah cu ka nupi a si lo maw? Keimah cu a pasal ka si lo maw? A uiretnak le hlawhhlang a sinak baang dingah sim uh.","title":"Hlawhhlang Gomer, Hlawhhlang Israel"},"3":{"text":"A baang lo asile a nuih pum sung ihsin a suah lai ih lawngfangkheh ih a um vekin a hnipuan ka hlit ding. Leilung ro le lei caar bangin ka tuah ding ih tihal in a thi ding."},"4":{"text":"A faate pawl hnen khalah zaangfahnak ka nei lo ding; annih cu ningzah thiam lo hlawhhlang nu ih faate an si! Anih cun, “I duhtu hnenah ka feh ding; ti le rawl, tuuhmul le puan, olif hriak le sabitti in pe paam,” a ti.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Curuangah a lamzin khamnakah hruang ka tuah ding ih hling le so in amah cu a kimvel in ka kulh ding."},"7":{"text":"Amah a ngaitu pawl kha an dung in a dawi ding naón a man lo ding. A hawl rero ding naón a hmu lo ding. Cule anih in, “Hmaisa ka pasal hnenah ka kir sal ding. Atu hnakin tuih hlanah ka rak nuam sawn,” tiah a ti ding."},"8":{"text":"A hnenah rawl, sabit, olif hriak le Baal biaknak ih a hmanmi sui le ngun pawl a petu cu keimah ka si hi a thei dah lo."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah ka pek ciami rawl le sabit pawl cu rawl lak caan ah ka lak kir ding; a hnipuan hrang ka timi tuuhmul le patpuan pawl tla ka lak sak kir ding."},"10":{"text":"A hnipuan ka hlit ṭheh ding ih a mi ngaimi hmaiah a lawngfangkheh in ka umter ding; ka kut sungin zohman in an run thei lo ding."},"11":{"text":"A nomnak puai pawl: kumtin puai le thlatin puai pawl, Sabbath puai le biaknak lam puai pawl cu ka cemter ṭheh ding."},"12":{"text":"“I ngaitu pawl ih in phalh mi,” a timi a sabit hmuan le a theipi kung pawl ka siatsuah ṭheh ding. A sabit hmuan le a thingrah hmuan pawl cu ramṭhing ah ka tuah ṭheh ding ih hramlak ramsa in an siatsuah ṭheh ding."},"13":{"text":"Keimah hngilh tahrat in Baal hnenah rimhmui a ur ih a mi ngaimi pawl hrangah a ṭhirual le a hnakhai khaih tahrat ih a thlun reronak caan ai-ah amah ka hrem ding. Hitiin Bawipa in a sim zo a si."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah amah cu nelrawn ah ka hruai kir sal ding ih duhdawtnak ṭongkam thawn ka leem ding.","title":"In A Minung Pawl A Duhdawtnak"},"15":{"text":"A sabit hmuan pawl cu ka pe kir ding ih Harsatnak Nelrawn cu ruahsannak sangka ah ka tuahsak ding. A no lai Izipt ihsin a suah lai vek khan ka lam a hoi sal ding."},"16":{"text":"Cuticun “Ka Pasal,” tiah i ko sal ding ih, “Ka Baal,” tiah i ko nawn lo ding."},"17":{"text":"Baal hmin cu ka saalter nawn lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah cun ka minung pawl an tuahmawh lonak dingah leilung par ramsa le van ih zam vate le leilung ih a bokvak pawl thawn thukamnak ka tuah ding. Raldonak hriamnam pawl: ralnam pawl le li le thal hmuahhmuah ka hlonhlo ṭheh ding ih ka minung pawl cu hnangamte le himte in khua an sa ding."},"19":{"text":"Maw, Israel, ka nupi ah ka lo tuah ding; Mifel le rintlak ka si ding, A hmunmi duhdawt zaangfahnak Na parah ka langter ding ih, Kumkhua in ka ta na si ding."},"20":{"text":"Ka thukam ka hngetter ding ih, ka ta na si ding; Kei hi Bawipa ka si kha na thei ding."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah ka minung Jezreel ih thlacamnak ka theihsak ding ih, Leilung ah ruah ka surter ding. Cule leilung in rawl le sabit le olif pawl a suahter sal ding.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Ram sungah ka minung pawl cu ka um hngetter ding. An ṭhangso ding ih mi neinung zet an si ding. “Lo-ruhamah,” tiih rak kawhmi pawl cu “Ka zaangfah ding,” ih, “Lo-ammi,” tiih rak timi pawl cu “Ka minung nan si,” ka ti ding. Cule annih in “Kan Pathian na si” tiah in ti ding."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in hiti in i sim sal: “Va feh awla midang a ngaitu hlawhhlang nu cu va duh aw. Israel mi pawl in pathian dangdang an bia ih milem pawl hnenah sabit caar an pe rero naón annih cu ka duhdawt thotho vekin nang khal in cu nu cu na duh thotho ve pei,” i ti.","title":"Hosea Le Hlawhhlang Nu"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah cu nu leinak ah ngun tangka hleinga le barli fang han sarih ka pek."},"3":{"text":"Amah cu, “Caan reipi hlawhhlang na ṭuan nawn lo pei; midang khal na ngai nawn lo pei. Ka hnenah na um ding naón ka hnenah na it hrih lo pei,” tiah ka sim."},"4":{"text":"Cumi bangtuk in Israel mi pawl khal siangpahrang nei lo le hotu nei loin, thawinak pe thei loin le lungto ṭhuamthiang nei loin, zuk le tinzohnak milem pawl nei loin reipi an um ding."},"5":{"text":"Asinain Israel mi pawl in Bawipa an Pathian lam ah an hoikir ih an siangpahrang David ih tesinfa hnen an pan sal caan a um leh ding. Cule Bawipa cu an ṭihzah ding ih a laksawng ṭha an ngah ding."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in hi ram sungih a ummi pawl parah mawhthluknak a nei a si. Maw Israel, a simmi hi ngai hnik: “Hiram sungah hin duhdawtnak a um lo ih rintlak sinak khal a um lo. Minung pawl in an Pathian ah in ruat lo.","title":"In Israel A Mawhthluk"},"2":{"text":"Mi an camsiat, thuphan an per, mi an that, ruk an ru, nupi le pasal pawl in midang an ngai san. Thisen luannak a karh vivo ih mi thahnak pakhat hnu pakhat a um."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah hi ram cu a caar ding ih ram sungih nunnak a neimi hmuahhmuah an cau ṭheh ding. Ramsa le vate hmuahhmuah le nga hman an thi ṭheh ding,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Zohman in misenpi pawl mawhthluk hlah hai seh; a kawk khal kawk hlah hai seh. Ka mawhthluk mi cu nanmah puithiam pawl nan si.","title":"In Puithiam Pawl A Mawhthluk"},"5":{"text":"A sun a zan in sualnak poimawh nan tuah; nannih hnakin profet pawl an ṭha cuang fawn lo. Nan nu Israel hi ka siatsuah ding."},"6":{"text":"Ka minung pawl in keimah in theih duh lo ruangah an cem thla ding. Nannih puithiam pawl khal in in thei duh lo ih ka thuzirhmi pawl nan hlon. Curuangah nannih cu ka lo hnong ih nan fapa pawl khal ka puithiam an si thei nawn lo ding."},"7":{"text":"“Puithiam nan tam deuhdeuh ih ka parah nan sual deuhdeuh. Upat tlak nan sinak cu nan mualphonak ah ka tuah ding."},"8":{"text":"Ka minung pawl ih sualnak thawngin milian ah nan cang; curuangah tam sinsin in sualter nan duh."},"9":{"text":"Misenpi vek thotho in cawhkuannak nan tuar ve ding. Thil ṭha lo nan tuah ruangah ka lo hrem ding ih ka lo cawh ding."},"10":{"text":"Raithawinak pekmi sungin nan covo cu nan ei ding naón nan ril a rawng thotho ding. Hlawhhlang nan ṭuan ih punzainak khawzing nan bia rero ding naón faate nan nei cuang lo ding, ziangahtile khawzing dang thlun duh ah ka hnen ihsin nan pial a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Zu thar in siseh zu hlun in siseh ka minung pawl ih thinlung a hloter ṭheh.","title":"In Khuavang Biaknak A Duh Lo"},"12":{"text":"Thingtan hnenah tin an leeng, funghreu in an duhmi a rak sim. Curuangah kei cu in tlansan. Hlawhhlang ih a cangmi nunau vekin annih cu khawzing dang hnenah an pe aw."},"13":{"text":"Tlangzim hmunthiang ah thawinak an tuah ih tlangpar thingpi sang sasua kiing daihnem ṭha hnuai ah rimhmui an ur. “Curuangah nan fanu pawl cu hlawhhlang ah an cang ih nan fapa ih nupi pawl cu mipa dang thawn an sual."},"14":{"text":"Asinain hi ruangah ka hrem hai lo ding; ziangahtile nanmah hman biakinn hlawhhlang pawl hnenah nan feh ih anmah thawn hmunkhat ah thawinak nan pek. Thufim ih a um vekin, ‘Ruahnak nei lo miphun cu an siat ding.’"},"15":{"text":"“Nannih Israel mi pawl cu ka hrangah hlawhhlang ah nan cang zo naón Judah mi cu cuvekin si hram hlah hai seh. Gilgal a si lole Bethaven ah i bia hlah hai seh. Cutawk hmunah a nungmi Bawipa ih hmin in thukamnak tla tuah hlah hai seh."},"16":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu laak lungruh bangin an lung a ruh a si. Ziangtin so tuufaate bangin tlimno lakah ka cawm thei ding?"},"17":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu milem in a ham ṭheh a si. An duhnakah feh hai seh."},"18":{"text":"Zu tampi an in hnuah hlawhhlang an ṭuannak ah nuam an ti zet ih hmin ṭhatnak hnakin thangsiatnak an duh sawn."},"19":{"text":"Phusiing ih semhlomi vekin ṭhekdarh ṭheh an si ding ih an khuavang biaknak cu an zahpi ding."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Nannih puithiam pawl hihi ngai uh. Nannih Israel mi pawl, ṭhatein ngai uh. Siangpahrang sungkhat pawl, ngaihnik uh! Dingnak thawn thuṭhentu ding nan si naón nan parah thuṭhennak a thleng ding. Mizpah ah thang ah nan cang zo; Tabor tlang ah mi awktu sur ah nan cang ih,"},"2":{"text":"Akhesia khua ah mi tlaknak khur thukpi ah nan cang zo. Curuangah nan zatein ka lo hrem hai ding."},"3":{"text":"Israel thuhla cu ka thei ṭheh; ka hnen ihsin a thup-aw thei zik lo. Rintlak lo a si zo ih a minung pawl cu keimah bia dingah an tlak lo,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Misenpi in thil ṭha lo an tuah ruangah Pathian hnenah an kirnak ding a kham. An thinlung ah hlawhhlang ṭuan duhnak a khat ih Bawipa an thei nawn lo.","title":"Hosea In Milem Biak Ralrinnak A Pek"},"5":{"text":"Israel mi pawl ih puarthaunak kha anmah mawhphurhtu bik a si. An sualnak in a bahter ih an tlu; Judah mi khal an hnenah an tlu ve."},"6":{"text":"An tuu le an caw pawl thawinak ah Bawipa hnenah an pek, asinain an hrangah a ṭhahnem lo. Bawipa an hmu thei lo, an hnen ihsin a tlan zo."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah rintlak lo ah an cang zo; an faate pawl Bawipa ta an si nawn lo. Curuangah an ram cu siatsuah a si cing ding."},"8":{"text":"Gibeah ah raldonak tawtawrawt tum uh! Ramah ah tiarawknak tawtawrawt tum uh! Bethel ah raldo auhnak au ciamco uh! Benjamin mi pawl, raldonak ah feh uh!","title":"Judah Le Israel An Do Aw"},"9":{"text":"Hremnak ni a thleng zik thlang; Israel cu siatsuah a si ding. Israel mi pawl, hi thil hi a cang tengteng ding sokhaw."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Judah in Israel a do ih a ram a lon ruangah ka thin a heng. Curuangah an parah hremnak cu tilian bangin ka burh ciamco ding."},"11":{"text":"Israel cu namsuknak a tuar; zianghman pek ding a nei lotu hnenah bomnak dil in a pan ringring ruangah amah ih ram rori a si mi a sung zo."},"12":{"text":"Israel parah siatsuahnak ka thlenter ding ih Judah mi parah siatralnak ka tlunter ding."},"13":{"text":"Israel in a nat a luar zia a hmuh tikah le Judah in a hma a besiat zia a theih tikah, Israel cu a cakzetmi Assiria siangpahrang hnenah bomnak dil dingah a feh; asinain an natnak siseh, an hma siseh a damter thei lo."},"14":{"text":"Israel le Judah cu kiosa in ṭilva a nam vekin ka nam ding. Keimah rori in ka thlekbauh ṭheh ding ih ka tlansan ding. Ka hnuk vivo hai tikah zohman in an run thei lo ding."},"15":{"text":"“An sualnak ruangah tawkfang an tuarta ih keimah in ra hawl sal hlanlo cu ka minung pawl hi ka dungtun hrih ding. An tuarnak ruangah keimah kha a hawl in tum dah pangah,” tiah a ti."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Misenpi in, “ Bawipa ih hnenah kirsal uhsi. In bauhthlek ṭheh zo naón amah thotho in in damter ding. In tuahmawh zo naón amah thotho in kan hma in tuam sak ding.","title":"Hnenah Kirsal An Tum"},"2":{"text":"Ni hnih hnuah in thoter sal ding ih ni thumnak ah in nungter sal ding; cule a hmaiah a nung in kan um ding."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu theih tum uhsi. Amah cu kan hnenah zinglam khawvang bangin a ra ding, a pelh lo ding. Amah cu kan hnenah leilung a toihtu ṭoruah bangin pelh loin a ra thleng ding,” an ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Israel le Judah, nannih hi ziangtinso ka lo tuah ding? In duhdawtnak cu zinglam suumzing bangin zamrang in a hlo; daitla bangin a hul lohli."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah ka profet pawl nan hnenah thuṭhennak le siatsuahnak ṭong thawn ka thlah a si. Nan hnen ihsin ka duhmi cu nanmah ih theih lo ding zianghman a um lo; tleunak bangin a fai a si."},"6":{"text":"Nan hnen ihsin a ṭunghmun mi duhdawtnak a si ka duh, ramsa ih raithawinak a si lo. Keimah in theih ding a si ka duh, mei-ur thawinak a si lo."},"7":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla hi minung pawl, hi tiamkammi ram an thlen vete in annih thawn thukamnak ka tuahmi cu Adam hmun ah an bal ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Gilead cu mi ṭha lo le mi thattu pawl ih khua a si."},"9":{"text":"Puithiam pawl cu damiah bangin mi an bawh. Shekhem hmun thianghlim fehnak lamzin hmanah mi an that. Cuih thil ṭha lo pawl cu tumhrim in an tuah!"},"10":{"text":"Israel ram sungah thil poimawhzet pakhat ka hmu: ka minung pawl in milem biaknak in an baal-awter ṭheh zo."},"11":{"text":"“Nannih Judah mi pawl, nan thil tuahmi ruangih hremnak nan tuar ding tikcu ka khiah zo."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka minung Israel damter ka tum ih ṭhangsoter sal ka duh naón an ṭhatlonak le thil sual an tuahmi lawng ka hmu. Samaria ah pakhat le pakhat an bum aw; inn an bauh ih thil an ruk; lamzin ah mi thil an long."},"2":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo an tuahmi hi ka ciing ringring ding ti an ruat baan hrimhrim lo; an sualnak in a kulh ṭheh kha hmu loin ka um thei fawn lo,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Miseenpi in an siangpahrang le an bawi pawl an bum an phiar ih an lung an tluanter.","title":"Siangpahrang Inn Ah Phiarnak"},"4":{"text":"An zatein ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuahtu an si ih rintlak lo hlir an si. Sang tuahtu in sang a nawng ih meisa lingzet parah sang a rawh ih a lingzet vekin an mi huatnak cu a ling ringring a si."},"5":{"text":"Siangpahrang in puai a tuah ni ah siangpahrang le a kut thuai bawi pawl cu zu an ri ih mi aa vek an si."},"6":{"text":"An mi phiarnak cu meisa vekin a ling. An thinhengnak cu zanvar a sa ih zinglam ahcun meisa alh bangin a hliau."},"7":{"text":"“An thin a sa tukih anmah uktu pawl an thah. An siangpahrang cu pakhat hnu pakhat an that naón bomnak dil in zohman ka hnenah thla an cam lo,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel mi cu a hrek lawng a hminmi sang bangtuk an si. An kiangkap ih miphun dang pawl an rinsan ih,","title":"Israel Le Miphun Dang Pawl"},"9":{"text":"ramdangmi an rinsan ruangah an thazaang a nau ti kha an thei lo. Reipi an nung nawn lo ding; cu khal an thei cuang lo."},"10":{"text":"An puarthaunak kha an sualnak langtertu a si. Hi bangtuk thil a cang ṭheh hnu khalah hin Bawipa an Pathian keimah ih hnenah an kir duh lo."},"11":{"text":"Israel cu ruahnak nei lo laileng aa bangin a vak; hmaisa ah bomnak dil in Izipt ah a feh; neta ah Assiria hnenah a tlan."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla anmah kaihnak ah sur ka siah ding ih an feh phah ah vate bangin ka awk ding. Thilsual an tuah ruangah ka hrem ding."},"13":{"text":"“Mi vanduai an si! In taan zo ih in dodal zo. Annih cu siatsuah an si ding. A hum ka duh hai naón keimah riangri ka thang in siat."},"14":{"text":"Thinlung ngai in thla an cam lo; thlacam ai ah leilung ah an hlon aw ih Pathian thei lo pawl bangin an aukiau. Rawl le sabit hrangih thla an cam tikah Pathian thei lo pawl bangin an sun aw ciamco. Ziangtluk raltho phun so an si!"},"15":{"text":"Anmah cawmtu le a caktertu cu keimah ka si naón keimah zuarthlaitu riangri ah an cang."},"16":{"text":"Cahnak zianghman a nei lomi khawzing hnenah in pialsan cingcing. Annih cu a kawimi li vekin rintlak lo an si. An hotu pawl cu puarthau zetih an ṭong ruangah sarthih in an thi ding ih Izipt mi pawl in an hnihsan ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Tawtawrawt tum uh! Ka ram sungah ral pawl cu muvanlai vekin an rung zam. Ka minung pawl in anmah thawn ka thukammi an bal ṭheh ih ka thuzirhmi cu an duh lo a si.","title":"In Israel A Mawhthluk"},"2":{"text":"Kan Pathian a si, kannih cu amah ih minung kan si ih amah cu kan thei a si, an ti naón,"},"3":{"text":"thil ṭha an dungtun ṭheh a si. Curuangah an ral pawl in an dawi ding."},"4":{"text":"“Ka minung pawl in siangpahrang an hril, asinain anmah ih thu in an hril. Hotu khal an hril, asinain keimah ih lungkimnak a tel lo. An sui le an ngun an suah ih milem ah an tuah; anmah siatsuah awknak hrangah!"},"5":{"text":"Samaria khawpi sung mi pawl in sui cawcang an biak khi ka hua! An parah ka thin a heng ngaingai a si. Milem hi ziangtik tiangso an biak ding? Ziangtikah so an bang ding?"},"6":{"text":"An milem cu Israel mi kutzungthiam pa ih tuahmi a si; Pathian ngaingai hman a si lo! Samaria ih an biakmi sui cawcang cu denkuai ṭheh ding a si."},"7":{"text":"Thli an vorh ih thlipi an khawm ding! A vui um lomi rawl kung cun rawl a suah thei dah lo ding. Rawl a suah thei hmanah ramdangmi in an ei ding."},"8":{"text":"Israel cu dolh-mi miphun a si zo; miphun dang pakhat vekah a cang zo ih beel kuai vekin hman tlak lo a si thlang."},"9":{"text":"Hramlak laak bangin a lung a ruh ih amah ih duhmi lamzin lawng a thlun. Assiria bomnak dil duh ah a va tlan. Miphun dangih humnak duh ah a ngaimi hnenah paisa a pek."},"10":{"text":"Miphun dang hnenah a zuar-aw naón atu-ah ka finkhawm sal ding. Reilote-ah Assiria siangpahrang in a hrem ding ih harsatnak nasa zetin an tuar ding."},"11":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl in an sual thianfainak dingah biakṭheng tam deuhdeuh an tuah; asinain cuih biakṭheng pawl cu an sualnak hmun ah a cang."},"12":{"text":"Misenpi hrangah a siar ih siar cawk lo thuzirhnak ka ngan, asinain thu lamdangpi a si-aw, tiin an thlun duh lo."},"13":{"text":"Thawinak pek cu an paih zet; thawinak sa ei tla an duh zet. Sikhalsehla keimah an Bawipa cu an parah ka lung a awi lo. An sualnak ka ciing ding ih cuih sualnak ruangah ka hrem hai ding. Cule Izipt ram ah an kir sal ding."},"14":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl in inn ṭhaṭha tampi an sak, asinain anmah siamtu cu an hngilh. Judah mi pawl in phardawl ih kulhmi khawpi tampi an din. Sikhalsehla an khua le an inn ṭhaṭha pawl kaang ṭheh dingah meisa ka thlah ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Israel mi pawl, khawvel mi bang ih nan puai tuahnak cu baang thlang uh. Nan Pathian hnen ihsin nan pial zo ih a hmai ah rintlak lo ah nan cang zo. Hi ram pumpi sungah hlawhhlang bangin Baal khawzing hnenah nan zuar aw zo ih, a man in pekmi tiih nan ruahmi rawl in nan lung a lo awiter a si.","title":"Hosea In Israel Hremnak Thu A Than"},"2":{"text":"Asinain reilote ah rawl le olif hriak le sabit tla khopkham in nan ngah lo ding. Sabitti thar khal nan ngah nawn lo ding."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu Bawipa ih ram sungah an um nawn lo ding. Izipt ram ah an kir sal a ṭul ding ih Assiria ram ih a thiang lomi rawl an ei ding."},"4":{"text":"Ramdang ahcun Bawipa ih hnenah sabit thawinak an pe thei lo ding ih thawinak dang khal a hnenah an pe thei lo ding. An rawl cun rawl eitu hmuahhmuah a ti borhhlawh ding ih ruakhngah rawl-ei thawn a bang aw ding. An rawl cu an rilrawnnak rehtertu lawng a si ding ih Bawipa ih biakinn ih pekmi ah saan a si lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Cule Bawipa hrangih puai tuah tikcu caan a thlen tikah ziangso an tuah ding?"},"6":{"text":"Hlohralnak a thlen ih misenpi pawl an ṭiodarh tikah Izipt mi pawl in Memfis khawpi ih phum dingah an khawm hai ding. An sui le an ngun a rak umnak, le an inn le an lo a rak dinnak hmun ah hrampi le hlingkung pawl an kho ṭheh ding."},"7":{"text":"Hremnak an tuar caan a thleng zo, an parih phulak caan a thleng zo. Cutiin a cang tikah Israel mi pawl in an thei ding. “Hi profet hi a aa a si; hi thlarau lam hmutu hi a molh a si,” nan ti. Nan sualnak a tamtuk ruangah kei cu nasa zetin in hua."},"8":{"text":"A minung Israel mi hnenih ralrinnak thu sim dingah Pathian in kei hi profet in i thlah a si. Asinain ka fehnak kip ah vate bangin thang ih awk in tum. Pathian inn sung hman ah misenpi hi profet ih ral ah an cang."},"9":{"text":"An thil tuahmi cu a ṭha lo tuk ih Gibeah khua ih an rak tuahmi vek a si ko. Pathian in an sualnak cu a ciing ringring ding ih a hrem hai ding."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Hmaisa bikih Israel ka rak hmuh tikah nelrawn ih sabit rah hmuh vek a si. Nan pu le nan pa ka rak hmuh tir ah theipi rah tikcu ih a rah hmin hmaisa bik hmuh vek a si. Sikhalsehla Baal-Peor tlang an thlen tikah cun Baal khawzing biak an thok. Cule a rei hlanah an duh zetmi khawzing pawl vekin ningsinza ah an cang.","title":"Israel Sualnak Le An Sual Man"},"11":{"text":"Israel ih ropitnak cu vate bangin a zuang hlo ding; faate an hring nawn lo ding, an nunau pawl favun an um nawn lo ding ih an sungin nau a seem nawn lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Faate an neih hmanah ka laksak ding ih an nung lo ding. Hi minung pawl ka tlansan tikah cun thil poimawh zetzet an parah a thleng ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Israel cu ka hmuh tir ah mawizet ih a khomi tuumkung bangtuk a si; asinain atu-ah an faate pawl cu ramsa bangin dawimi le thahmi an si kha ka hmu."},"14":{"text":"Maw Bawipa hi minung pawl parah ziang tuah ding so ka lo dil ding? An nunau pawl cu cingter ṭheh awla an hnawi cu caarter ṭheh aw."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in, “An thil sual tuahmi hmuahhmuah hi Gilgal ah a thok. Cutawk ihsin anmah huat ka thok a si. Thil sual an tuah ruangah ka ram sung ihsin ka dawisuak hai ding. Ziangtik khalah ka duh sal nawn lo ding; an hotu pawl in an zatein in dodal a si.","title":"In Israel A Hrem"},"16":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu a hram a caarmi le a rah thei lomi thingkung vek an si. Faate an nei lo ding. An neih hmanah an duh zetmi an fahniang pawl cu keimah in ka that ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"A hna ka ṭuanmi ka Pathian in a minung cu a hnong ding. Ziangahtile a thu an ngai duh lo. Miphun dang lakah mi vakvai phun ah an cang ding.","title":"Israel Parih Profet ṭongkam"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel cu a rah tamzet sabit hri vek a si. An paṭhat deuhdeuh tikah biakṭheng tam deuhdeuh an dawl. An ram in rawl tam deuh a suah tikah an biakmi ṭhuamthiang pawl cu mawi deuhdeuh in an tuah."},"2":{"text":"An thinlung cu bumnak in a khat ih anmah ih sualnak ruangah an tuar ding. Pathian amah rori in an biakṭheng pawl cu a bal ding ih an ṭhuamthiang pawl cu a khiak ṭheh ding."},"3":{"text":"Reilote ah hi minung pawl in, “ Bawipa kan ṭihzah lo ruangah siangpahrang kan nei lo. Asinain siangpahrang cun ziangso in tisak thei cuang ding?"},"4":{"text":"An ṭong lawnglawng a si ko; thulolak kamawknak le tiamawknak lawnglawng a si. Dingnak cu dinglonak ah a cang ih leileh sungih tur nei hrampi bangin a kho ciamco,” tiah an ti ding."},"5":{"text":"Samaria khawpi sungih a ummi pawl cu an thin a phang ding ih Bethel ih an sui cawcang a hloh ruangah an riah a sia ngaingai ding. Anmah le an puithiam pawl cun a cuih cawlem cu an ṭah ding. A mawinak sui hmuahhmuah an lak ṭheh tikah an ṭap an raak ding."},"6":{"text":"Cuih cawlem cu Assiria siangpahrang bawipa hnenah siah ai-ah an pek ding. Cawlem biak ding thu a thlun ruangah Israel cu ningzak le mualpho in a um ding."},"7":{"text":"Samaria le a siangpahrang cu tidai parih a phuanmi thingtan feemte bangin a fen hlo ding."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi ih biakmi Aven tlangzim ih milem pawl cu siatsuah ṭheh an si ding. An biakṭheng parah hrampi le hlingkung an kho ding. Mipi pawl in tlangsaang hnenah, “In thup aw,” an ti ding ih tlangte hnenah cun, “In khuh aw,” tiah an ko ding."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel mi pawl in Gibeah ih an sualnak thok in atu tiangah ka parih sual hi an cawl dah lo. Curuangah ral in Gibeah ah a man ding.","title":"In Israel Thu A ṭhen"},"10":{"text":"Hi misual phun hi ka do ding ih ka hrem ding. Miphun tampi in an bor ding ih an sualnak tampi ruangah hremnak an tuar ding."},"11":{"text":"“Israel cu hlanlai ahcun cawcangte hremṭhatmi fang ciil duhzetmi bangtuk a rak si. Asinain hnaṭuan khung ṭuan thei dingin a mawizetmi a hngawng ah hngawngkol ka thluah. Judah in ṭhee a hnuk ih Israel in ṭhun a hnuk, cutiin lei an let."},"12":{"text":"‘Nan hrangah lei thar let uh; dingnak phun uhla ka hnenih nan ṭan man thlawsuahnak vui cu at uh. Nan Bawipa ka hnenih nan kir caan a cu zo; ka ra ding ih nan parah thlawsuahnak ka lo burh ding’ ka ti."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nan tuhmi cu ṭhatlonak a si ih ṭhatlonak vui nan at a si. Nan thuphanpernak rah nan ei zo a si. “Nan rangleng pawl le nan ralkap tamzet nan rinsan ruangah,"},"14":{"text":"nan minung hnenah raldonak a thleng ding ih nan ralṭannak hmuahhmuah siatsuah ṭheh an si ding. Cuih ni cu siangpahrang Shalman in ral a do ih Betharbel khua a siatsuah ih nunau le nauhak pawl a thah ṭheh ni vek a si ding."},"15":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo nan tuahmi a tamtuk ruangah cuvek thotho in nannih Bethel minung par khalah a cang ding. Raldonak a thok vete in Israel siangpahrang cu a thi ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel cu a nauhak lai ihsin ka duhdawt; Ka fapa a si vekin Izipt ram ihsin ka ko suak.","title":"Pathian In Ralthotu A Minung A Duhdawt"},"2":{"text":"Asinain ka fapa ti ih ka ko deuhdeuh tikah ka hnen ihsin a hlat sinsin ah a pial. Ka minung cun Baal hnenah raithawinak an pek; Milem hnen ah rimhmui an ur."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Israel feh a zirhtu cu keimah ka si. Ka ṭaang ih a cawitu cu keimah ka si. Asinain anmah damtertu ka si kha an thei lo."},"4":{"text":"Duhdawtnak le lainatnak hri thawn ka hruai; Ka cawi ih ka biang ah ka neek cih, Kuun tahratin rawl ka fah a si."},"5":{"text":"Asinain ka hnenah an kir duh lo; Curuangah Izipt ram ah an kir sal ding ih, Assiria in a uk hai ding."},"6":{"text":"Ral in an khua an lak ṭheh ding ih khua kotka pawl an siatbal ṭheh ding. Anmah duhnak lawng an tuah ruangah, Ka minung pawl siatsuah ṭheh an si ding."},"7":{"text":"Ka hnen ihsin pial an tum ring ring ruangah, An parah hngawngkol bun an si-ih, Cungnungbik hnenah an au rero ding naón sawngtu zohman an nei lo ding."},"8":{"text":"Maw Efraim, ziangtinso ka lo thlah thei ding? Maw Israel, ziangtinso ka lo dungtun thei ding? Admah bang cun ziangtinso ka lo siatsuah thei ding? Zeboiim vek cun ziangtinso ka lo tuahsiat thei ding? Cubangtuk ka lo tuah ding cu ka ruat thei lo; A lo duhtu ka thinlung hi a hlum ih a neem a si."},"9":{"text":"Ka thinheng in ka lo cawh lo ding, Israel cu ka siatsuah sal lo ding; Ziangahtile kei cu minung ka si lo, Pathian ka si; Nan hnenih a ummi Thianghlim bik cu ka si; Thinheng in ka ra lo ding."},"10":{"text":"An ral pawl lamah kiosa bangin ka huuk ding ih, Ka minung pawl in in thlun ding. Nitlaknak lam in ṭhia phahphah in in pan ding."},"11":{"text":"Izipt ihsin vate bangin zamrang zetin an ra ding; Assiria ihsin thuro bangin an rung ding. An inn ciar ah ka tlunpi ding, Keimah Bawipa in ka ti."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in hiti in a ti, “Israel mi in an thuphan pernak le an mibumnak in in kulh theh. Rintlak le a thianghlimmi Pathian ka si naón Judah mi pawl cun in dodal lai thotho.","title":"Israel Le Judah A Mawhthluk"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingpit ihsin zanlam tiang Israel mi pawl ih an tuahmi cu thil ṭhahnem lo le siatsuahnak lawnglawng an si. An lakah mi zuarthlainak le thisen suahnak a karh ciamco. Assiria thawn ral remnak an tuah ih Izipt thawn pursum leilawnnak an tuah,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in Judah mi pawl mawhthluk ding a nei; Israel pawl khal an nunzia a ṭhat lo ruangah a hrem ding. An tuahmi parah phu a lak ding."},"3":{"text":"An pu Jakob cu a u Esau thawn an nuih pum sungih an um laiah an sual-aw; a hung upat tikah Pathian thawn an buan-aw fawn."},"4":{"text":"Vancungmi thawn an buan-aw ih a neh. Jakob cu a ṭap ih thlawsuah a dil. Pathian cu Bethel ah Jakob hnenah a ra ih thu a sim."},"5":{"text":"Amah cu Cungnungbik Bawipa Pathian a si; Bawipa ti cu a hmin a si."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Jakob ih tesinfa pawl, nan Pathian cu rinsan uhla atu-ah amah ih hnenah kir uh. Rintlak le dingtein nung uhla, nan Pathian hnaṭuan ding cu thinfualte in hngak uh."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel mi pawl cu Kanaan mi pawl vek thotho in an hrokhrawl. An thil leitu pawl kha a dik lo cuai khainak in bum an duh.","title":"Thuṭhennak ṭongkam"},"8":{"text":"‘Kan lian ngah zo, kan nei ngah zo a si. Zohman in thil dik lo in lennak nan ngah tiah in mawhthluk thei lo ding,’ an ti."},"9":{"text":"Sihmansehla kei hi Izipt ram ihsin a lo hruaisuaktu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si. Nelrawn ih nan hnen ka rat laiah puanthlam sungih nan rak um vek khan ka lo umter sal ding."},"10":{"text":"“Profet pawl hnenah thu ka sim ih langnak tampi ka umter. Profet pawl hmang in ka minung pawl hnenah ralrinnak ka pek."},"11":{"text":"Gilead ah milem an biak ih a biatu hmuahhmuah cu an thi ding. Gilgal ah cawcang in rai an thawi; curuangah biakṭheng pawl cu hramlak ih lungtopen ah an cang ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Kan pu Jakob cu Aram ram ah a tlan; cutawkah nupi hlawhnak ah tuu a khal."},"13":{"text":"Israel mi pawl Izipt saltaannak ihsin suah dingah le kilkhawi dingah Bawipa in profet pakhat a thlah."},"14":{"text":"Israel mi pawl in Pathian cu nasa zetin a thin an hengter; an sualnak ruangah thi tlak an si. Pathian parih thangsiatnak an thlenter ruangah amah in a hrem ding a si."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hlanlai ahcun Efraim hrin an ṭong tikah hrin dang pawl in an rak ṭih ṭheu. Israel hrin dang pawl in Efraim hrin cu an rak zohso. Asinain Baal khawzing biaknak in an sual ih curuangah annih cu an thi.","title":"Israel Parah Netabik ṭhuthennak"},"2":{"text":"An sual sinsin ih biak dingah thir in milem an tuah. Minung thinlung in suai copmi ngun milem pawl minung kut in an tuah. Cule, “Cuih milem hnenah raithawinak pek uh,” tiah an ti. Ziangtin so minung in cawcang hmel cuangih tuahmi cawlem cu an hnam thei!"},"3":{"text":"Curuangah hi minung pawl cu zinglam suumzing bangin an hlo ding, daitla bangin an hloral ding a si. Fang cilnak puum ihsin thli ih a seemmi fanghi bangtuk an si ding; meikhu suahnak ihsin a suakmi meikhu vek an si ding."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Izipt ihsin a lo hruaisuaktu cu keimah, Bawipa nan Pathian hi ka si. Keimah siar lo Pathian dang nan nei lo. Keimah lawng hi nanmah runtu ka si."},"5":{"text":"Thlaler ramṭhing le ramcaar ah ṭhatein ka lo kilkhawi."},"6":{"text":"Asinain ram ṭha sungih nan luh tikah nan pum a puar ih nan hna a ngam; cule nan puarthau ih kei cu in hngilh."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah kiosa bangin ka lo nam ding. Tlavang bangin nan fehnak lamzin ihsin ka lo bawh ding."},"8":{"text":"A fano lonmi savompi bangin ka lo zon ding ih ka lo bauhthlek ṭheh ding. Kiosa bangin nan hmun rori ah ka lo maai ṭheh ding ih sahrang bangin cipseksek in ka lo thlek ṭheh ding."},"9":{"text":"“Maw Israel mi pawl, Keimah in ka lo siatsuah ding! Zoso a lo hum thei ding?"},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang le hruaitu nan ngen. Asinain atu khuiah so an si? Ziangtin so ram pumpi an hum thei ding?"},"11":{"text":"Ka thinheng in siangpahrang ka lo pek zo ih ka thinheng ah ka lak sal zo."},"12":{"text":"“Israel ih sualnak le mawhnak cu cazual parah ṭhatein nganmi a si ih ṭhatein retkhummi a si."},"13":{"text":"Israel cu nun theinak tikcu ṭha a nei, asinain a aat ruangah cuih tikcu ṭha cu a laak hna a thiam lo; amah cu a rung suak zikmi naute a nuih pum sungih suah duh lo ih a kir salmi bangtuk a si."},"14":{"text":"Himi pawl cu mithi khua Sheol ihsin ka run suak lo ding; thihnak kut sung khal in ka sansuak lo ding. Maw Thihnak, na pulhnat cu run keng hnik aw! Maw Sheol, na mi siatsuah theinak thawn ra aw! Himi pawl parah zaangfahnak zianghman ka nei thei nawn lo."},"15":{"text":"Israel cu phaikung bangin no hngualhngi hmansehla nelrawn ihsin nisuahnak lam thli sa ka hrangter ding ih an tipuut le an tikhur pawl a caar ṭheh ding. A thil mankhung hmuahhmuah a siat ṭheh ding."},"16":{"text":"Pathian a dodal ruangah Samaria cu hrem a si ding ih a ṭio ding. A minung pawl cu ral kut in an thi ding. An faate pawl cu leilung ah denthat an si ding ih an nunau fa vun lai pawl cu an pum zaithlek an si ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Israel mi pawl, Bawipa nan Pathian hnenah ra kir uh. Nan sualnak ruangah nan bah zo ih nan tlu zo.","title":"Hosea In Israel A Leem"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah kir uhla hiti in thlacam uh: “Kan sualnak hmuahhmuah in ngaidam hram aw; kan thlacamnak in sang awla kan lo kam cia vekin kan lo thangṭhat ding."},"3":{"text":"Assiria cun in run thei dah lo ding; kan rangleng pawl cun in hum thei fawn lo ding. Kan kut ih tuahmi kan milem pawl hnenah, ‘Nang cu kan khawzing na si,’ tiah kan ti nawn lo ding. Maw Bawipa bawmtu dang nei lo pawl hnenah zaangfahnak pek ṭheutu na si,” ti uh. Bawipa in hiti in a ti:"},"4":{"text":"“Ka minung pawl ih hlawhhlannak le vahvaihnak cu ka damter ding; Ka thinlung ngaingai in ka duhdawt hai ding. Ka thinhengnak cu an hnen ihsin a pialsan zo.","title":"In Nunnak Thar A Tiam"},"5":{"text":"Israel mi hrangah cun ramcaar ih ruahti bangtuk ka si ding; Lili pangpar bangin an par ding, Lebanon thingkung bangin hnget zetin an kho ding."},"6":{"text":"A hnge a thar in a cerh ding ih, Olif thing vekin a mawi ding. Lebanon in sidar thing bangin An rim a thaw ding."},"7":{"text":"Keimah ih thladem thuaiah an um sal ding. Hmuan ah thlaikho an ciing ding ih, Sabit hmuan ih sabit bangin an rah ding. Lebanon sabitti bangin an hmin a thang ding."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu milem thawn Pehtlaihnak an nei nawn lo ding; An thlacamnak cu ka thei ding ih Ka kilkhawi ringring hai ding. A hnah a hring ringring mi thingkungpi bangin, Ka thladem thuaiah ka ret ding. Keimah cu an thlawsuahnak hrampi ka si,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Mifim hmuahhmuah in hitawk ih nganmi hi thei hai sehla theihthiamnak nei in an thinlung in ciing ṭha hai seh. Bawipa ih lamzin cu a dik ih miding pawl cun cumi lamzin an thlun. Asinain cuih lamzin an zawh lo ruangah misual pawl cu an bah ih an tlu."}}}}},"29":{"info":{"name":"Joel","shortname":"Joe","abbr":[],"desc":"Joel"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pethuel ih fapa Joel hnenah Bawipa ih simmi thu cu:","title":"Kharbok in Ramsung A Siatsuah"},"2":{"text":"Patar pawl, ngaihnik uh; Judah ram sungih ummi pawl theihnik uh; Hi bangtuk hi nanmah nun sungah a cang dah maw? Nan pale sanah teh a cang dah keel maw?"},"3":{"text":"Hi thu cu nan faale hnenah sim uh, Cun annih in an faate hnenah simsin ve hai seh.
