Sankhat hnu sankhat ah simsin aw vivo hai seh."},"4":{"text":"Thing ngeet kharbok ih hlah mi kha, A burbur ih ummi kharbok in an ei. A burbur ih ummi kharbok ih hlah mi kha, A pet vivo mi kharbok in an ei. A pet vivo mi kharbok ih hlah mi kha, Siatsuahtu kharbok in an ei ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Nannih zuri pawl, tho uhla ṭap uh, Sabitti intu pawl, sabit thawthaw hrangah ṭap uh; Ziangahtile an siat ṭheh zo a si."},"6":{"text":"Kharbok bur in kan ram an siim; An cak ngaingai ih siar cawk lo an si. An ha cu kiosa ha vek a si ih, An tin tla cu kiosapi ih tin vek a si."},"7":{"text":"Ka sabit hri an siatsuah ṭheh, Ka theipi kung cu an ngeetkiak ṭheh ih hnah nei lo ah an tuah; A rah an ei ṭheh, a hawng an hawk ṭheh; A hnge pawl cu raang ko in an hiikfai ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Nannih minung pawl, A pasal dingmi tlangval pa ih thihsanmi fala nu a ṭah bangin, Buri hnipuan hruk ih a ṭah bangtuk in ṭap uh."},"9":{"text":"Thawinak ih pek dingah sabit le sangphut cu Bawipa ih inn ah a um nawn lo. Bawipa riantu nannih puithiam pawl ṭap uh!"},"10":{"text":"Loram cu a siat ṭheh, leilung cu riahsia in a ṭap. Thlairawl an siat ṭheh, Sabit an ro ṭheh ih Olif in hriak a suah nawn lo."},"11":{"text":"Lothlo pawl, nan riahsia uh, Sabit tuamhlawmtu pawl, riahsia in ṭap uh. Sangvut le barli sangvut an um lo, Rawl lak ding zianghman a um lo."},"12":{"text":"Sabit hri an vuai ih Theipi kung an caar. Taleti kung, ung kung, epal kung le thingkung dangdang tla an ro ṭheh. Minung hrangah lungawinak le Thinnomnak a cem a si."},"13":{"text":"Maw puithiam pawl, biakṭheng ih hnaṭuantu pawl, Buri hnipuan hruk in ṭap uh. Biakinn ah feh uhla zanvar ṭap uh. Nan Pathian pek dingah rawl le Sabitti a cem ṭheh zo."},"14":{"text":"Rawl ulh ni than uh, Khawmnak thianghlim tuah ni ti uh! Upa pawl ko khawm hai uhla Ramsung minung pawl sawm ṭheh uh. Bawipa inn sungah ra tlaang uhla Bawipa Pathian hnenah cun ṭap uh."},"15":{"text":"Cuih ni cu hreh a va um so! Cuih Bawipa ni cu a nai thlang; Cungnungbik hnen ihsin a nasa zet mi siatsuahnak thawn a ra."},"16":{"text":"Kan mithmuh rori ah rawl an hlo ṭheh; Kan Pathian inn ihsin lungawinak le thinnomnak a cem ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Leilung a caar ih thlaici an thi ṭheh. Rawl retnak an siatral ṭheh, Thlairawl ret ding a um nawn lo."},"18":{"text":"Ṭilva pawl an ai an hruum, Cawcang pawl an van a saang. Ziangahtile ei ding hrampi a um lo; Tuu run pawl khal in an tuar a si."},"19":{"text":"Maw Bawipa nangmah ka lo ko; Ziangahtile meisa in phuul ih hrampi a kang fai ih, Mei alh in hramlak ih thing tiangin a kang fai a si."},"20":{"text":"Asi, hramlak ih ramsa hman in nangmah an lo hai nasa; Ziangahtile tiva tete an caar ih, Hrampi hmuahhmuah meisa in a kang ṭheh a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion ah tawtawrawt phaw uhla, Pathian tlang thianghlim ah ralrinnak dar tum uh. Hi ramih a ummi hmuahhmuah khur hai seh; Ziangahtile Bawipa ih ni a nai zo.","title":"Ni Ralrinnak Petu Kharbok Tla"},"2":{"text":"Thimnak le khawdurnak ni, Mero le suum ih a khah ni a si. Tlang parah thimnak bangin kharbok an ra; Mi cakzet le mi nasazet ralkap bangin. Hi bangtuk cu khuahlan san ihsin a um dah keel lo; Hmailam san, san-i-khuk khalah a um dah lo dingmi a si."},"3":{"text":"Hmaituang meisa in ziang hmuahhmuah a kang; Dungṭang meisa hlio a alh ringring. An hmailam ih ram cu Eden hmuan bangtuk a si; An dunglam cu ramṭhing ah a cang, An fehnak lamzin ah zianghman a nung thei lo."},"4":{"text":"To rang bangin a rualrual in an ra; Raldonak rang bangin hmaiah an tlan."},"5":{"text":"Rangleeng ke awn bangin an awn durdo, Tlang par ahcun an pet zohzo. An thawmvang cu fangkuang meisa kaang awn bangtuk a si. Raldo ding ralkap bangin siar cawk lo an si."},"6":{"text":"An hmaiah mi hmuahhmuah an thin a phang; An mithmai a raam ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Ralṭha bik bangin hmaiah an nor, Ralkap bangin phar ah an kai. Anmah ih zawn cio in an feh, An fehnak ding lamzin in zohman an peeng lo."},"8":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat an pah-aw lo. Hmailam ah cawl bang loin dingtein an feh ih, Zohman in an kham thei lo."},"9":{"text":"Khawpi an thleng, phar ah an van; Inn parah an kai ih Fifir bangin tukvirh in an lut."},"10":{"text":"An hmaiah leilungpi hi a khur, Van khal khi a hnin; Ni le thlapi an thim, Arsi pawl an tleu nawn lo."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa ih thupeknak aw cu a ralkap hmaiah khawri bangin a ri durdo; A ralkap cu an nasa ngaingai; A tirhfialmi cu siarcawk lo an si. Bawipa ih ni cu a nasa ih tuksumza a si; Zoso a tuar thei ding?"},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Atu rori ah Nan thinlung zatein rawl ul in, Mitthli tla le riahsia in, Ka hnenah ra kir uh.","title":"In Sualsir Ding A Fial"},"13":{"text":"Nan hnipuan thlek loin nan thinlung khuai sawn uh; Cule ka hnenah ra kir uh,” tiah a ti. Bawipa nan Pathian hnen ahcun ra kir uh; Ziangahtile amah cu zaangfahnak le lainatnak neitu a si; A thin a fual ih a ṭunghmunmi duhdawtnak in a khat; Hrem a tummi khal a suup sal ṭheu a si."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian in a thinlung leet sal in, Lo rawl tampi a lo thlawsuah tla a si thei sokhaw. Cutin sangphut le sabit thawinak, a hnenah nan pe ding a si."},"15":{"text":"Zion Tlangah tawtawrawt tum uh, Rawl ul ding thu than uhla misenpi pumkhawmnak tuah uh."},"16":{"text":"Mipi kokhawm uhla khawmpi sunglawi tuah uh. Upa pawl ko uhla, nauhak pawl kha kokhawm uh. Asi, an ṭaang ih an cawimi naute khal kokhawm uh. Nupi ṭhitu tlangval a inn ihsin ra suak seh; Cun mothar khal a innkhaan sung ihsin ra suak seh."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnaṭuantu puithiam pawl cu Biakinn luhnak sangka le biakṭheng karlak ah ding tahrat in: “Maw Bawipa , na minung pawl hi zuah hram aw; Ram dangmi pawl in hmuhsuam le nautat in, ‘Khui-ah so nan Pathian cu a um?’ in ti hlah hai seh” tiah thlacam in ṭap hai seh."},"18":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in a ram zawn a ruahnak a langter; A minung pawl a lainat a si.","title":"Pathian In Israel Ram A ṭhatter Sal"},"19":{"text":"An ṭahnak aw a thei ih an hnenah, “Ngai uh, rawl le sabit le olif siti ka lo pe hai ding ih, Nan ei nan in ding ih nan tlai zet ding. Miphun tampi hmai ah mualpho in Ka lo umter nawn lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Saklam ralkap nan ṭihmi pawl cu Nan hnen ihsin hlatpi ah ka re ding; Ramcaar le ramṭhing ah ka dawi hlo hai ding; An hmaituang pawl cu nisuahnak tipi thi sungah, Dungṭang ih fehtu pawl cu nitlak lam tifinriat sungah, Ka dawihlo ding. An ruak thu le nam cu khua hlapi a thleng ding; Puarthau in thil a tuah ruangah!"},"21":{"text":"“Maw leilung, zianghman ṭih hlah, na thla khal ṭem hlah; Lungawi soparte in um aw. Bawipa in mangbangza thil a tuah zo a si."},"22":{"text":"Hramlak ih ṭilva pawl, nan thin phang hlah uh; Nan tlannak hrampi cu a hring ringring ding; Thing an rah ding ih theipi le Sabit khal an rah ngaingai ding."},"23":{"text":"“Maw Zion mi pawl, thinnuam in um uh; Bawipa nan Pathian hnenah nan lung awi uh. Amah in nan ṭul zat in ṭhal ruah a surter; Thlatang ruah le ṭoruah thawn, A hlan bangin a surter a si."},"24":{"text":"Nan rawl ciilnak hmun cu rawl in a khat ding ih, Nan ralca beel pawl cu sabit le olif hriak in a liam ding."},"25":{"text":"Nan hnen ih ka run thlah mi Thing ngeet kharbok, a bur a bur ih ummi kharbok, A pet vivo mi kharbok pawl ih a eimi pawl cu ka lo ruul sal hai ding."},"26":{"text":"“Nan duhzat in nan ei ding ih nan tlai zet ding; Cutin Bawipa nan Pathian hmin cu nan thangṭhat ding. Nan hrangah mangbangza a tuah zo. Ka minung pawl cu mualpho in an um nawn lo ding."},"27":{"text":"Israel mi lakih ka um kha nan thei ding; Bawipa Keimah lawng hi nan Pathian ka si. Pathian dang a um lo; Ka minung pawl cu mualpho in an um nawn lo ding."},"28":{"text":"“Leh hnuah cun mi hmuahhmuah parah ka thlarau ka burh ding; Nan fapa le nan fanu pawl in, profet bangin ka thu an phuang ding. Nan patar pawl in mang an man ding; Nan mino pawl in langnak an hmu ding.","title":"Ih Ni"},"29":{"text":"Cutik ni ahcun salnu le salpa pawl par tiangin ka thlarau ka burh ding."},"30":{"text":"“Van ah siseh lei ah siseh, Thilmak zetzet ka langter ding. Thisen le meisa le meikhu tom an lang ding."},"31":{"text":"Ni a thim ding ih, Thlapi cu thi bangin a sen ding, A nasazet le hreh a um zetmi Bawipa ih ni a thlen hlan deuh caan ahcun."},"32":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa ih hmin a kotu hmuahhmuah cu runnak an ngah ding. Ziangahtile Bawipa ih a sim zo vekin Zion Tlang ah a luatmi an um ding; Jerusalem ah a taangsun an um ding; Bawipa ih kawhmi pawl cu!” tiah a ti."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah le Jerusalem mivannei ih ka tuah ni le tikcu ahcun,","title":"Miphun Hmuahhmuah Thu A ṭhen Ding"},"2":{"text":"miphun hmuahhmuah cu hmunkhat ah ka ko khawm ding ih, Bawipa ih Thuṭhennak Horkuam ah ka vun hruai hai ding. Ka miphun a si mi Israel ai-awh in an thu ka ṭhen ding. Ziangahtile ka minung pawl an ram sung ciar ah an ṭhekdarh hai ih ka ram cu an ṭhen aw ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Ka minung pawl cu camcawhfung zuuk in an zem aw. Cuih tlunah mipa nauhak le nunau nauhak salah an zuar ih an ngahmi paisa in hlawhhlang an leeng ih zu in dingah zu an lei."},"4":{"text":"Ka hrangah ziangso nan si nannih Ṭaiar le Sidon le Filistin ram pawl? Ka parah phuba lak nan tum maw si? Ka parah ziangtal phuba lak theimi nan nei maw? Nan neih a si ahcun cakzet le zamrang zetin nan thil tuahmi cu nan lu parah ka kirter ding."},"5":{"text":"Ziangahtile ka sui le ka ngun le ka hlawnthil sunglawi pawl cu nan biakinn ah nan thiar ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Judah le Jerusalem mi pawl cu an ram ihsin lamhlapi ah nan fehpi ih Grik mi pawl hnenah nan zuar."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nan zuarnak hmun ahcun ka forh hai ding ih cuih hmun cu an tlansan ding. Nan thil tuahmi cu nan lu parah ka kirter ding."},"8":{"text":"Nan fanu le nan fapa pawl Judah mi hnenah ka zuar ding ih annih in lamhlapi ih a ummi Seba mi hnenah an zorh ding. Bawipa in a sim zo."},"9":{"text":"“Hi thu hi miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah than uh; Raldo dingah timtuah uhla nan ralkap tho hai seh. Raldo ding hmuahhmuah cu hmunkhat ah tong aw in feh hai seh."},"10":{"text":"Nan lei lehnak tuhmui pawl cu ralnam ah ser uh; Nan thingfa cehnak cehrep cu feipi ah tuah uh. Mi derdai bik khal in do ve hai seh."},"11":{"text":"Zamrang in ra suak uh, Kiangkap miphun hmuahhmuah, Cutawkah tongkhawm aw uh,” a ti. Maw Bawipa , na ralkap pawl, raldo dingah run kuat aw."},"12":{"text":"“Miphun hmuahhmuah in raldo dingah pok hai seh; Bawipa ih Thuṭhennak Horkuam ah feh hai seh. Ziangahtile miphun hmuahhmuah thuṭhen dingah, Cutawkah ka to ding."},"13":{"text":"“Rawl ah a cu, namkawi suah uh; Ra uh, sabit ra sawr uh. Sabit sawrnak khur a khat, ralca beel an liam. An sualnak a nasa ngaingai a si."},"14":{"text":"Mi thawng tampi an um, Thuṭhennak Horkuam sungah. Thuṭhennak Horkuam ah Bawipa ih ni a nai zo."},"15":{"text":"Ni le thlapi cu an thim. Arsi an tleu nawn lo."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa cu Zion ihsin a hruum ding; Jerusalem ihsin a aw a suah ding. Cutikah lei le van an hnin ṭheh ding; Asinain a minung hrangah Bawipa cu an beunak a si; Israel hrangah amah cu an himnak ṭanhmun a si.","title":"Pathian In A Milai A Thlawsuah Ding"},"17":{"text":"“Cutiin keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si kha nan thei ding; Ka tlang thianghlim Zion ih a ummi ka si! Jerusalem cu khua thianghlim a si ding; Ram dangmi zohman in, Jerusalem khua sung an pal thei lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun tlangsaang ihsin Sabitti a puut ding; Tlang fatete ihsin cawhnawi a luang ding. Judah ram tiva hmuahhmuah ah tidai an luang ding; Bawipa ih inn ihsin cirhti a puut ding ih, Sittim phairawn in tidai a ngah ding."},"19":{"text":"“Asinain Izipt cu nelrawn ro ah a cang ding ih, Edom ram cu thlaler ramṭhing ah a cang ding. Ziangahtile Judah ramah thil poimawh an tuah ih, Mawh neilo thisen an suahter ruangah a si."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Judah ramah kumkhua in minung an tlangleng ding; Jerusalem ah cat loin minung an um ding."},"21":{"text":"An thisen man cu keimah in phuba ka la ding; Bawipa keimah cu Zion ah ka um ding,” a ti."}}}}},"30":{"info":{"name":"Amos","shortname":"Amos","abbr":[],"desc":"Amos"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu cu Tekoa khuami tuukhal Amos ih simmi a si. Linghnin hlan kum hnih, Judah siangpahrang ah Uzziah a si ih Israel siangpahrang ah Joash ih fapa Jeroboam a si laiah Pathian in Israel thuhla Amos hnenih a langtermi a si."},"2":{"text":"Amos in, “ Bawipa cu Zion ihsin a hrum durdo; A aw cu Jerusalem ihsin khawri bangin a thang. Tuu an tlannak hrampi a ro ṭheh, Karmel Tlang parih hrampi an caar zo,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Damaskas khuami pawl atu le tu an sual ruangah ka hrem ding. Gilead mi pawl zaangfahnak nei loin thir ha bunmi fangrialnak thingtum thawn an rialsiat hai."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Syria siangpahrang Hazael inn parah meisa ka thlak ding ih siangpahrang Benhadad ih ral ṭannak pawl a kaang ṭheh ding."},"5":{"text":"Damaskas kotka pawl ka khiak ṭheh ding ih Betheden uktu le Aven phairawn ih um pawl ka dawihlo hai ding. Syria rammi pawl Kir ramah salih hruai ṭheh an si ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Gaza mi pawl cu atu le tu an sual ruangah ka hrem tengteng ding. An miphun pumpi in Edom ram ah sal ah an zuar ṭheh.","title":"Filistin"},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Gaza ih khawkulhnak phardawl parah meisa ka run thlak ding ih an inn ṭha pawl hmuah thawn a kaang theh ding."},"8":{"text":"Ashkelon khua uktu pawl cu ka hlon ding. Ekron khua cu ka hrem ding ih a taanglai mi Filistin pawl cu an thi ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa in, “ṭai-ar khua mi pawl cu atu le tu an sual ruangah ka hrem tengteng ding. An miphun pumpi in Edom ram ah salah an hruai ṭheh. Pawlkomnak thukam an tuahmi cu an thlun lo.","title":"Ṭai-ar"},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Ṭaiar khua ih khaw kulhnak phardawl pawl parah meisa ka run thlak ding ih an inn ṭha pawl hmuah thawn a kaang ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Edom mi pawl cu atu le tu an sual ruangah ka hrem tengteng ding. An unau Israel mi pawl zaangfahnak nei loin nam thawn an dawi. An thinhengnak cu tawp ti a nei lo ih a reh thei dah lo.","title":"Edom"},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Teman khua parah meisa ka run thlak ding ih Bozrah inn ṭha pawl a kaang ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ammon mi pawl cu atu le tu an sual ruangah ka hrem tengteng ding. Mi ram an nor ih ral an do tikah Gilead ah favun nunau pawl an raithlek ṭheh.","title":"Ammon"},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Rabbah khua ih khawkulhnak phardawl parah meisa ka run thlak ding ih an inn ṭha pawl a kaang theh ding. Cule raldo awk ni ahcun aunak a tam ding ih an do awknak cu thlisia bangin a hrang ding."},"15":{"text":"An siangpahrang le a kut hnuai bawi pawl salah an kai ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Moab mi pawl cu atu le tu an sual ruangah ka hrem tengteng ding. Edom siangpahrang ih ruh cu an ur ciam ṭheh.","title":"Moab"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah Moab ram parah meisa ka run thlak ding ih Kerioth ih inn ṭha pawl a kaang ṭheh ding. Moab mi pawl cu raldo-awk laifang, ralkap pawl an au ciamco lai le tawtawrawt aw a than rero laifangah an rak thi rero ding."},"3":{"text":"Moab ram uktu le an ram sungih hotu pawl hmuahhmuah khal ka that ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Judah mi pawl cu atu le tu an sual ruangah ka hrem tengteng ding. Ka thuzirhmi an nautat ih ka thukham pawl an thlun lo. An pupa pawl ih rak biakmi pathian deu pawl in an hruai sual a si.","title":"Judah"},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Judah parah meisa ka run thlak ding ih Jerusalem inn ṭha pawl an kaang theh ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel mi pawl cu atu le tu an sual ruangah ka hrem tengteng ding. Mi fel a si khalle leiba a sam thei lotu pawl le kedam tuak khat man a pe thei lotu pawl kha sal ah an zuar.","title":"Israel Thuṭhennak A Tuar"},"7":{"text":"Bawmtu nei lo le mi ṭawnṭai pawl leivut lakah an palcih ih mi farah pawl lamzin ihsin an tul hlo. Pa le fa in nunau pakhat an sualpi ih cuti cun ka hmin thianghlim an borhhlawhter."},"8":{"text":"Biaknak hmunkip ah mi farah hnen ihsin leiba ai-ih an lakmi puan an phah ih an it. Tangka baaktu pawl hnen ihsin paisa an kuantermi in zu an lei ih an Pathian biakinn sungah an in."},"9":{"text":"“Asinain ka miphun pawl, nanmah ih hrangah sokhaw sidar thing bangin a saangmi le sasua thing bangin a hakmi Amor mi pawl ka siatsuah ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin ka lo hruaisuak ih thlaler ramṭhing ah kum sawmli sung ka lo khor. Cule Amor mi pawl ih ram cu nan ta dingah ka lo pek."},"11":{"text":"Nan fapa ṭhenkhat pawl profet ah ka hril ih nan mino ṭhenkhat pawl Nazir mi ah ka hril. Asilo nan ti thei ding maw, Israel mi pawl? Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo a si."},"12":{"text":"Asinain cuih Nazir mi pawl cu zu nan inter ih profet pawl ka thu aupi lo dingin nan kham."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah atu-ah leilung ah ka lo namcih ding ih rawl ritzet a phurtu cawleng awn bangin nan hrum nan ai ding."},"14":{"text":"Tlan cakzet pawl hman an luat thei lo ding; mi cakzet pawl an thazaang a ṭum ding ih ralkap pawl hman an nunnak an hum-aw thei lo ding."},"15":{"text":"Li le thal a hmangtu pawl hman an ṭang thei lo ding; tlan cak bik hman an luat lo ding ih rangralkap pawl tla an luat ce lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun ralṭha bik ralkap hman in an hriamnam an hlonta ding ih an tlan hlo ding,” a ti. Bawipa in a sim zo."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Israel mi pawl, Izipt ram ihsin nan miphun pumpi in Bawipa in a lo hruaisuak zo ih nanmah ih thuhla ah a simmi hi ngaihnik uh:"},"2":{"text":"“Leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah lakah nanmah lawng hi ka theih mi le ka kilkhawi mi nan si. Cucing in nan sual; curuangah ka lo hrem ding,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Lungkim tlang loin mi pahnih hmunkhat ah khual an tlawng tlang thei maw?","title":"Profet Ih ṭuanvo"},"4":{"text":"Kiosa cu dehmi sa nei loin tupi sungah a huuk maw? Kiosa no cu dehmi sa nei loin a kua sungah a hngirhngir maw?"},"5":{"text":"Vate cu thang tarh um loin awh a theih maw? Thang cu a pelhtertu um loin a pelh thei maw?"},"6":{"text":"Raldonak tawtawrawt khua sungih an tum tikah khawsungmi thinphang loin an um maw? Bawipa ih thlenter loin khawsungah harsatnak a thleng dah maw?"},"7":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in a riantu profet pawl hnenah a tumtahmi phuangta loin hna a ṭuan dah lo."},"8":{"text":"Kiosa a hrum tikah zoso ṭih loin a um thei? Cungnungbik Bawipa a ṭong tikah tlang-aupi loin zoso a um thei ding?"},"9":{"text":"Izipt le Ashdod siangpahrang inn sungih um pawl hnenah, “Samaria kimvel ih tlang ah tongkhawm aw uhla cutawkih thil sualral an tuahmi le a sungih hnahnawhnak nasa zet tla hi zohhnik uh,” tiin than uh.","title":"Samaria Vanduainak Ding"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Himi pawl in an siangpahrang inn sung cu sualralnak le thisen luannak thawn an lakmi thilri in an khahter. Ziangtiih mifel si ding, ti khal an thei nawn lo."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah an ram ral in an kulh ding. An ṭankhuarnak hmun pawl an siatsuah ding ih an siangpahrang inn cu an ram ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Tuukhal in kiosa ih dehmi tuu a hawl tikah a ke pahnih le a hna lawng a runsuak vekin Samaria khua ih um Israel mi pawl khal an todan kil le an ihkhun ke thawn lawng an luat thei ding."},"13":{"text":"Ṭhatein ngai uhla Jakob ih tesinfa pawl cu ralrinnak thu sim uh,” tiah Cungnungbik Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in a ti."},"14":{"text":"“An sualnak ruangih Israel ka hrem ni ah Bethel ih biakṭheng pawl khal ka siatsuah ṭheh ding. Biakṭheng ih ki pawl khal ka khiak ding ih leilung ah an tla ṭheh ding."},"15":{"text":"Ṭhal inn siseh, thlatang inn siseh ka balsiat ṭheh ding. Saiho ih ceimawimi inn pawl le inn tumpi dang pawl khal ka siatsuah ṭheh ding,” a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu hi ngaihnik uh, nannih Samaria nunau pawl, cawmthaumi Bashan cawpi pawl, mi nauta pawl a rialbek ih mi farah a namnehtu le “In ding i pe aw,” tiih mahih pasal a auh hluahhlotu pawl,"},"2":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in a thianhlimnak thawn, “Sio thawn an lo dirh caan a ra thleng leh ding; nan zatein nga sio ih awkmi nga vek nan si ṭheh ding."},"3":{"text":"A nai bik phar-ong ah an lo hnuk ding ih cutawkin khawleng ah Harmon lamah an lo hlon ding,” tiah siatcam in thu a kam."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Israel mi pawl, Bethel ih hmunthiang ah va feh uhla nan duh ahcun va sual uh! Gilgal tla ah va feh uhla nan sual thei tawkin va sual uh. Nan raithawinak ṭilva pawl cu zingkhat hnu zingkhat hei keng uhla nan thawhlawm khal ni thumnak tinte hei keng ringring uh.","title":"Israel In A Thei Thei Lo"},"5":{"text":"Nan sang kha lungawinak in Pathian hnenah hei pe uhla thawhlawm a hlei ih nan thawhmi khal tluangkhawnpi ciamco uh. Cupawl a si lo sawm a tuah nan hiar mi cu!"},"6":{"text":"“Nan khua hmuahhmuah ah paam a tlun tertu cu keimah ka si. Cu hmanah ka hnenah nan ra kir lo."},"7":{"text":"Nan lo rawl in ruahti a ṭul bik laiah ruah sur loin ka umter. Khua pakhat ah ruah ka surter ih a dang khua pakhat ahcun ka surter lo. Lo pakhat in ruah a ngah naón a dang pakhat cu vanruah loin a caar."},"8":{"text":"Minung tampi cu khua dangih tidai in dingah hawl rero in an feh. Asinain in khop an hmu lo. Cu cingin ka hnenah nan ra kir cuang lo."},"9":{"text":"“Nan lo rawl a ngautertu dingah thlisa ka hranter. Kharbok in nan hmuan le nan sabit hmuan, nan theipi kung le olif kung pawl khal a ei ṭheh. Sikhalsehla ka hnenah nan ra kir duh cuang lo."},"10":{"text":"Izipt ramih ka rak thlenter bangin nan parah pulhnat ka thlenter. Raldonak ah nan mino pawl ka thihter ih nan rang cak zetzet ka lak hlo. Nan hnarkua cu nan riahnak hmun ih miruak thu rim in ka khahter ṭheh. Cu khalah ka hnenah nan ra kir duh cuang lo."},"11":{"text":"“Sodom le Gomorrah ka siatsuah bangin nanmah lakih mi ṭhenkhat pawl ka siatsuah. Atuih a nungmi nannih pawl hi meisa sung ihsin thursuakmi a alh laimi funghreu bangtuk nan si. Sikhalsehla ka hnenah nan ra duh cuang lo."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah sokhaw maw Israel mi pawl, ka lo hrem ding ka ti cu! Cutiih ka tuah ding ruangah nan Pathian tong dingah timtuah cia in um uh,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Pathian cu tlangsaang pipi tuahtu a si; Thli tuahtu khal a si. A ruahmi cu minung a theihter; Sun cu zan ah a canter; Leilung hmunsang a pal ṭheh. A hmin cu Cungnungbik Bawipa Pathian a si."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Israel mi pawl, mithi phumnak hla ka lo saksanmi hi ngaihnik uh:","title":"Sir Aw Dingih Kawhnak"},"2":{"text":"Fala him Israel cu a cem zo, A tho sal nawn lo ding. Leilung ah a ril zo, Amah thotu an um lo."},"3":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Israel ramsung khua pakhat in ralkap thawngkhat a thlah; asinain zakhat lawng an ra tlung. Khua dang pakhat in zakhat a thlah ih pahra lawng an ra kir,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi hnenah, “Ka hnenah ra kir uhla nan nung ding."},"5":{"text":"Khawzing biak dingah Beersheba ah feh hlah uh; Bethel ah i hawl duh hlah uh; Bethel cu zianghman a si lo ding. Gilgal khalah va feh hlah uh; a minung pawl sal ah hruai an si ṭheh ding,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah feh uhla nan nung ding. Nan feh lo asile nan parah meisa hlio bangin Bawipa a thleng ding. Bethel mi pawl cu meisa in a kaang ding; zohman in an hmit thei lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Dingthluk lairelnak kha merh tahrat in felnak kha leiah a deengtu nannih pawl cu nan cem ding."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in arsi tla a tuah, Siruk rawlṭawm le zaangkhua pawl; Thimnak cu sun nitleu ah a tuah, Sun cu zan ah a canter. Tifinriat tidai pawl a ko ih Leilung parah a toih. A hmin cu Bawipa a si."},"9":{"text":"Micak pawl le an ṭanhmun ralhruang pawl cu a siatsuah ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Nannih pawl cun thuṭhennak zungih dinglonak a phuangtu le thudik a reltu pawl nan hua."},"11":{"text":"Mi rethei zonzai pawl nan namsuk ih an rawl nan long. Curuangah nan sakmi lungto inn ṭhaṭha sungah hin nan um lo ding ih sabit hmuan mawi sungih nan ciinmi sabitti nan in lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Nan sualnak tuksumza a sizia le thil sual nan tuahmi a tam zia hi ka thei ṭheh. Miṭha nan hrem, nawhthuh nan la ih farah zonzai pawl parah dingthluk lairelnak thawn thu nan rel lo."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah cuih tikcu caan ahcun thuruat thiam mifim pawl cu daitein an rak um. Ziangahtile cuih caan cu caan sia a si."},"14":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo bansan in thil ṭha tuah uh; cuti asile nan nung ding. Ziangkimtithei Bawipa Pathian cu kan hnenah a um nan ti vekin a um ngaingai ding."},"15":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo hua uh, thilṭha duh uh; thuṭhennak zungah dingthluk lairelnak kha lal seh. Cuti asile Josef hrin a taangsun parah Bawipa in zaangfahnak a nei hrih ding."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa Ziangkimtithei in, “Khawsung lamzin ah ṭahnak le ai-hramnak a um ding. Lothlo pawl an ko ding ih ṭah man pekmi pawl thawn mithi an ṭah tlang ding."},"17":{"text":"Sabit hmuan kip ah ai-hramnak a um ding. Ka lo hrem ding ruangah cupawl cu a kim ṭheh ding,” a ti. Bawipa in a sim zo."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa ni a hngakhlaptu pawl nan hrangah ṭihnungza a si. Cuih ni in ziangso a lo ṭhathnempi ding? Nan hrangah thimnak ni a si ding, tleunak ni a si lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Kiosa ṭih ah a zaam ih savom tongtu bangtuk a si ding. Asilole inn ah ra tlung in phar zuut na khaw rul cuk tongtu bangtuk a si ding."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa ni in tleunak si loin thimnak a thlenter. Tleunak malte hman um lo a thim bepbepmi ni a si."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Biaknak puai nan tuahmi pawl hi ka hua ih ka mit an kem."},"22":{"text":"Mei-ur thawinak le sangphut thawinak in rak pekmi pawl hi ka saang lo ding; thawinak hrangah tiah thau zetih nan cawmmi ṭilva pawl khal ka saang lo ding."},"23":{"text":"A ringzetmi nan hla pawl hi bang thlang uh; nan ṭingṭang awn pawl hi ka ngai paih nawn lo."},"24":{"text":"Dingthluk lairelnak cu tivapi bangin luang sehla felnak cu a kaang dah lomi ti bangin luang sawnseh."},"25":{"text":"“Maw Israel mi pawl, hramlak ih kum sawmli sung ka lo hruai laiah khan thawinak le peknak zianghman ka lo ngen lo."},"26":{"text":"Atu cu nan khawzing le siangpahrang a si mi Sakkuth zuk le nan arsi khawzing Kaiwan ih lem pawl nan biak ruangah,"},"27":{"text":"Damaskas pawnlam ram ah salih ka lo hruai tikah cuih milem pawl cu nan ken ṭheh a ṭul ding,” tiah Bawipa in a ti. A hmin cu Ziangkimtithei Pathian a si."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion ah nuam zetih a ummi le Samaria ah hnangam zetih a ummi, miphun pipa Israel hruaitu mi nasa pawl, Israel misenpi ih bomnak duh ah an pan reromi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so!","title":"Israel Siatsuahnak"},"2":{"text":"Va feh uhla Kalneh khua khi va zohhnik uh. A tum zetmi Hamath khua le Filistin ram ih Gath khua tla vung zohhnik uh! Hi ram pawl hnakin nannih nan ṭha deuh maw si? Nan ram hi an ram hnakin a kau deuh maw si?"},"3":{"text":"Siatnak ni thlen ding hi nan theih duh lo khalle nan thil tuahmi in cuih ni cu a naiter sinsin."},"4":{"text":"Ihkhun ṭha zetzet parah a ittu le zauṭheng nuam zetzet ah a zau huahhotu, caw note sa le tuu note sa tlaizet ih a eitu nannih pawl nan hmakhua a va pit so!"},"5":{"text":"David bangin hla phuah le ṭingṭang tum cu nan duhzet."},"6":{"text":"Sabit cu hai tumpipi in nan dawk rero ih rimhmui ṭha bik nan hnih aw rero; a sinan Israel a siatral tikah malte hman nan riah a sia lo."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah sal ih feh hmaisa biktu nanmah nan si ding. Nan rawl ei puai le nan nomnak puai pawl a cem ding."},"8":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa Ziangkimtithei Pathian in hi ralrinnak thu cu a pe zo: “Israel ih hngalnak hi ka hua; an inn tum zetzet khal hi ka mitkem zawng a si. An khawpi bik le a sungih ummi thil hmuahhmuah cu ral kut sungah ka pe ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Innsang pakhat sungah minung pahra an taang a si khalle an pahra in an thi ding."},"10":{"text":"Mithi ih sungkhat mithivui ṭuanvo neitu in miruak cu inn sung ihsin a la suak ding. Cuih a sungkhat cun innsung ih a taanglai mi pakhatkhat hnenah, “Zotal nan um lai maw?” tiah a vun auh ding. Cutikah aw pakhat in, “Um hlah,” a ti ding. Cule a sungkhat pa cun, “Daite in um aw! Bawipa ih hmin saal hrimhrim lo dingin na ralring pei,” tiah a ti ding."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in thu a pek tikah inn tum siseh inn fate siseh siatbal ṭheh an si ding."},"12":{"text":"Lungtlep lakah rang an tlan maw? Milai in tifinriat tidai parah cawcang thawn lei an let maw? Asinain nannih in dingnak cu thihsii ah nan canter zo ih a ṭhami cu a ṭha lo ah nan canter."},"13":{"text":"“Lodebar khua kan lak thei,” tiah nan porh-aw ciamco. “Karnaim lak dingah cun kan cakzet a si,” nan ti."},"14":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa Pathian amah rori in, “Maw Israel mi pawl, nan ram luahtu dingah ramdang ralkap pawl ka thlah ding. Cuih ralkap cun saklam ah Hamath Tlangkawn ihsin thlanglam ah Arabah phairawn tiang an lo namsuk ding,” a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa hnen in langnak pakhat ka hmu. Cuih langnak ahcun siangpahrang ih rawlkung an aat ṭheh ih hrampi a cerh pekte ah Bawipa in kharbok burpi a seemter kha ka hmu.","title":"Kharbok Langnak"},"2":{"text":"Cuih langnak ka hmuhmi sungah cun kharbok pawl cun ram pumpi sungih thilhring hmuahhmuah an ei ṭheh kha ka hmu. Cutikah kei in, “Maw Cungnungbik Bawipa , na minung pawl hi ngaithiam hram aw. Ziangtin so an nun thei ding? An malzet ih an ṭawnṭai tuk fawn,” tiah ka ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in a thinlung a thleng ih, “Na hmuh vek cun a si sal lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa hnen in langnak a dang pakhat ka hmu. Bawipa in a minung pawl meisa in hrem a tum kha ka hmu. Cuih meisa cun lei thuai tipithuanthum kha a kaang ṭheh ih leilung khal hun kaang lala ding khi a si.","title":"Meisa Langnak"},"5":{"text":"Cutikah kei in, “ Bawipa Pathian, baang aw. Ziangtin so na minung pawl an nun thei ding? An malzet ih an ṭawnṭai tuk fawn,” tiah ka ti."},"6":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in a thinlung a thleng ih, “Na hmuhmi vek cun a si sal lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa hnen in langnak a dang pakhat ka hmu. Hmuithlurhri hmang ih sakmi inn phar kiangah Bawipa a din kha ka hmu. Cule hmuithlurhri cu a kut sungah a um.","title":"Hmuithlurhri Langnak"},"8":{"text":"“Amos ziangso na hmuh?” tiah i sut. “Hmuithlurhri,” tiah ka sawn. Cule anih in, “Ka minung Israel mi pawl hi a ding lomi phar vek an si ih an ding lozia langternak ah hi hmuithlurhri hi ka lo hmuh a si. Anmah hrem dingih ka ruah ciami cu ka thleng nawn lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Isaak tesinfa pawl ih Pathian biaknak hmun pawl cu an ṭhing reprep ding. Israel ih hmun thianghlim pawl cu siatsuah ṭheh an si ding. Siangpahrang Jeroboam cithlah pawl ih ram-uknak cu ka cemter ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Bethel ih puithiam Amaziah in Israel siangpahrang Jeroboam hnenah thu a than ih, “Amos in Israel misenpi lakah a lo phiar a si. A ṭongmi hin ram pumpi a siatsuah ding.","title":"Amos Le Amaziah"},"11":{"text":"A simmi cu hiti in a si: ‘Jeroboam cu raldonak ah a thi ding; Israel mi pawl an ram ihsin sal ah hruaihlo an si ding,’ tiah a sim ciamco,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Amaziah in Amos hnenah cun, “Nang profet, ṭong nawn hlah; Judah ram ah va kir awla cutawkah thu va sim aw. Anmah in na hlawhman lo pe hai seh."},"13":{"text":"Hitawk Bethel ahcun profet ṭong in ṭong nawn hlah. Hitawk cu kan ram pumpi biakinn a si ih siangpahrang ih Pathian biaknak hmun a si,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Amos in, “Profet ka si lo; profet ih fapa khal ka si lo; ṭilva khaaltu le theipi kung pawl kilkhawitu ka rak si."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa in ka tuu ka khalhnak ihsin i lak ih a minung Israel hnenih profet hna ṭuan dingah thu i pek a si."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭongmi hi ngaihnik! Nang cun Israel miphun engtai in siseh, Isaak miphun engtai in siseh ṭong nawn lo dingah i kham."},"17":{"text":"Cutiih na ti ruangah, nang Amaziah, Bawipa in na hnenah, ‘Na nupi cu khawsungah hlawhhlang ah a cang ding ih na faate pawl ralnam in an thi ding. Nan ram cu ṭhenṭhek ṭheh a si ding ih midang hnenah pek a si ding. Nangmah khal Pathian thei lotu ram, ramdang ah na thi ding. Israel mi pawl hi an ram ihsin sal ah an hruaihlo tengteng ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa hnen in langnak a dang pakhat ka hmu. Cuih langnak ahcun a hmin zetmi thingrah bawm khat ka hmu.","title":"Thingrah Bawm Khat Langnak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Amos, ziangso na hmuh?” tiah i sut. “Thingrah hminzet bawm khat,” tiah ka sawn. Cutikah Bawipa in, “Ka minung Israel mi pawl an cem ni a thleng zo. Anmah hrem ka tumnak thinlung ka thleng nawn lo ding."},"3":{"text":"Cuih ni ah biakinn sungih hla saknak pawl cu ṭahnak aw ah a cang ding. Hmunkip ah miruak an um ding. A dai khepkhep ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Ngaihnik uh, nannih mi tlasam a palcihtu le ramsung mi rethei zonzai siatsuah a tumtu pawl!","title":"Israel Vanduainak"},"5":{"text":"Nan thinlungte cun, “Zarh ni a sau tuk, kan hngak thei lo; kan rawl zuar kan duh thlang. Ziangtikah so Sabbath ni a cem ding ih thil kan zuar thei sal ding? Kan thil man cu a hlei in kan ngen ding ih thil tahnak le khing thlainak pawl cu kan thil leitu pawl bumnak ah a dik lo in kan tuah ding."},"6":{"text":"A sia bik sangvut hman cu man tamzet ah kan zuar ding. Leiba nei ih kedam tuak khat man hman a pe thei lotu mi farah kan hawl ding ih sal zuat dingah kan lei ding,” tiah nan ti."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa Israel ih Pathian in siatcam thukam in, “Sualnak an tuahmi cu ka hngilh dah lo ding."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah leilungpi hi a hnin ding ih hi ramsung minung hmuahhmuah zonzaihnak an tuar ding. Hi ram pumpi hi a hnin ṭheh ding ih Nail Tivapi bangin a ṭum tawk le a kai tawk a um ding."},"9":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun sun laifang ah ni ka tlakter ding ih sun nitleu laiah khua ka thimter ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka ti a si."},"10":{"text":"Nan puai pawl cu mithi vuinak ah ka canter ding ih nan lungawinak hla cu riahsiat ṭahnak ah ka canter ding. Nan sam ka meetter ṭheh ding ih buri hnipuan ka lo hrukter ṭheh ding. Fapa neihsun a thih ih a nu le a pa an ṭah bangin ka lo ṭapter ding. Cuih ni cu a netnak tiangin a kha zetmi ni a si ding."},"11":{"text":"Hi ram sungih paam ka tlunter ding ni a ra thleng cing ding. Mipi pawl cu an ril a rawng ding naón rawl duh rilrawn a si lo ding; an ti a haal ding naón tidai duh tihal a si lo ding. Bawipa ih ṭongkam theih duh rilrawng le tihal an si ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka sim zo a si."},"12":{"text":"Mi pawl cu saklam in thlanglam ah, nisuahnak in nitlaknak ah an vakvai ding. Khawzakip ah Pathian ih ṭongkam an hawl ding naón an hmu lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun fala le tlangval harhdam zet pawl hman tihal in an bah an ril ding."},"14":{"text":"Samaria ih milem Ashimah hmin in siat a serhtu pawl, ‘Dan ih khawzing hmin in,’ a titu le ‘Beersheba ih khawzing hmin in,’ a titu pawl cu an bah ding ih an tho sal nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu biakṭheng kiangih a din kha ka hmu. Thu a pek ih, “Biakinn ṭhuam lubo pawl kha vua awla innleng tiangin hnin ṭheh seh. Khuai ṭheh awla misenpi ih lu parah tla thluh seh. Midang hmuahhmuah cu ral kut in ka thihter ṭheh ding. Zohman an luat lo ding; pakhat hman an tlansuak lo ding.","title":"Bawipa Ih Thuṭhennak"},"2":{"text":"Mithi khua Sheol ih relh tum in leilung vun lai khal hai sehla ka phorhsuak thotho ding. Vancung ih an kai hmanah ka dirthlak thotho ding."},"3":{"text":"Karmel Tlang luzim ih an relh hmanah ka hawl ding ih ka kai thotho ding. Ka hnen ihsin an tlan ih tipi thuanthum tawdeng ih an vung relh khalle ti sungih rulpi thu ka pe ding ih ka cukter ding."},"4":{"text":"An ral pawl in an kai ih ramdang ih an hruaihlo hmanah thah ṭheh dingin an ral pawl thu ka pe ding. Hi minung pawl cu ka mit ṭhep loin ka zoh hai ding; anmah bom ding cu ka tum lo, siatsuah ṭheh ding lawnglawng ka tum a si,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa Pathian in leilung a run tham; Cutikah leilung cu a hnin ciamco. Leilung tlun mi hmuahhmuah an riah a sia. Leilung pumpi cu Nail Tiva bangin A ṭum tawk, a kai tawk a um."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in vancung ah a umnak a tuah; Van cu leilung ih tlunah a kuumpi in a ret. Tifinriat ih tidai pawl cu a ko ih Leilung parah a toih; A hmin cu Bawipa a si."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Israel mipawl, nanmah tlukin Ethiopia mipawl khal ka ruat zet a si. Izipt ram ihsin ka lo hruaisuak bangin Filistin pawl cu Krete ram ihsin ka hruaisuak ih Siria mipawl cu Kir ram ihsin ka hruaisuak a si."},"8":{"text":"Keimah Cungnungbik Bawipa in hi miphun sualral, Israel siangpahrang ram cu ka zoh thup ringring ih leilung par ihsin ka phiat fai ding. Asinain Jakob tesinfa pawl cu an zate cun ka siatsuah lo ding."},"9":{"text":"“Thu ka pe ding ih Israel pawl cu khohriik in rawl an hriik vekin ka hriik ding. Mi ṭhahnem lo pawl hlon duh ah miphun tampi lakah ka hriik vivo ding."},"10":{"text":"Ka minung lakin, ‘Harsatnak cu Pathian in kan hnenah a thlenter lo ding,’ a titu misual pawl cu ral kut in an thi ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Inn cim bangtuk ih a cim zomi David ram uknak ka dinter salnak ding ni cu a thleng zik thlang. A phar pawl ka rem sal ding ih ka tungding sal ding. Ka sak sal ding ih khuahlan ih a rak si vekin ka siter sal ding.","title":"Israel Damter Salnak"},"12":{"text":"Curuangah Israel pawl in a taang hrihmi Edom ram cu an neh thluh ding ih ka ta a rak si dahmi miphun hmuahhmuah khal an neh sal thluh ding a si,” a ti. Himi a cantertu ding Bawipa in a ti."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Tikcu a ra thleng ding ih lorawl cu lak cawk lo in a ṭhang ding; Sabit cu sabitti ih tuah cawk loin a zaai ding. Tlangsaangpi ihsin sabit thlum an for thluahthlo ding ih, Tlangpar ihsin tidai bangin a luang ding."},"14":{"text":"Ka minung pawl an ram ah ka kirter sal ding; A siat ciami an khua pawl an sak sal ding ih Cutawkah khua an sa ding. Sabit hmuan an tuah ding ih Sabitti an in ding. Hmuan an tuah ding ih an cinmi an ei ding."},"15":{"text":"An hnenih ka pekmi ram sungah Ka minung pawl ka phun ding ih Phawi sal an si nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti. Bawipa nan Pathian in a sim zo a si."}}}}},"31":{"info":{"name":"Obadiah","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Obadiah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Edom ram thuhla ah Bawipa Pathian in Obadiah hnenih a simmi langnak cu, Bawipa in miphun pawl lakah a tlang-autu a thlah ih a tlang aumi kan theih mi cu: “Nan tim tuah uh, Kan zatein tho in Edom kha do uhsi,” ti a si.","title":"in Edom A Hrem Ding"},"2":{"text":"Edom hnenah Bawipa in, “Zohhnik, miphun lakah phunnau bikah ka lo tuah ding; Hmuhsuam nautatmi na si ding."},"3":{"text":"Na hngalnak in a lo bum ngah zo. Lungpuk sungah na um ih, Hmun sangzet ih na um ruangah na thinlung cun, ‘Zoso i dir thla theitu ding?’ tiah na ti."},"4":{"text":"Muvanlai bangin vansaangzet ah zuang in na bu cu arsi lakah sak hman awla, Ka lo dir thla thotho ding,” tiah Bawipa in a ti."},"5":{"text":"“Zan ah rukru ra hai sehla, An lo rammi cu a tam ding naón, An lakmi cu an duhmi lawng a si ding. Sabit rutu pawl ra hai sehla, Hlah mi nei loin maw an um ding?"},"6":{"text":"Asinain Esau thilri an ram zia hi ruathnik uh; A thupte ih a retmi sumsaw hman an phorhsuak ṭheh hi!"},"7":{"text":"A hlanih a lo ṭanpitu pawl in an lo bum, Na ram sung in an lo dawihlo. Nangmah thawn remte ih a rak ummi pawl in an lo neh zo. Nangmah rawl a hil pitu na rualpi pawl in thang an lo kam; ‘Fimnak a neihmi khuiah so a si?’ an lo ti."},"8":{"text":"“Cuih ni ahcun Edom mifim pawl ka siatsuah ding ih, Esau Tlang ah fimnak ka zuah lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Teman ralkap pawl an thin a phang ding ih Edom ralkap hmuahhmuah thah an si ding."},"10":{"text":"“Na unau Jakob tesinfa hnenih thil sual na tuah ruangah, Ningzak in na um ringring ding ih Kumkhua in na hloralta ding.","title":"Ziangah Edom Hremnak A Tong"},"11":{"text":"Ral pawl in an kotka tla an siat bal ṭheh ni ah khan, Zianghman poisa loin na rak ding meen. Jerusalem ih hlawnthil a la hlo ih Camcawhfung zuuk in a zem aw ṭhehtu ramdangmi tlukin mi siava na si."},"12":{"text":"Na unau ih vanduai ni ah porh aw rero hlah; Judah siatsuahnak a ton ni ah na lungawi hlah. Awloksong ih an um ni ah hni suamso hlah."},"13":{"text":"Ka minung pawl harsatnak an tuar ni ah an kotka sungah va lut hlah. Siatnak an ton ni ah diriam in va um hlah. An tluk ni ah an thilri khal va long hlah."},"14":{"text":"Tlansuah a tumtu pawl that dingah lamzin ṭeek in bawh hlah. Vansanglam ih an um ni ah An miluat hrekkhat an ral kut sungah va pe hlah."},"15":{"text":"“Reilote ah Keimah Bawipa in, Miphun hmuahhmuah parah thu ka ṭhen ni a ra thleng ding. Maw Edom, midang parih na tuah vekin na parah tuah a si ve ding. Na thil tidaan cu na lu parah a ra kir ding.","title":"Pathian In Thu A ṭhen Ding"},"16":{"text":"Ka minung pawl in ka tlang thianghlim parah a khami hremnak khuathai an in zo. Sikhalsehla a kiangkap ih ummi Miphun hmuahhmuah cun, Cuhnakih a khasawnmi khuathai an in ding. An zate in an in ding ih an hloral ṭheh ding."},"17":{"text":"“Asinain Zion Tlang ah mi hrekkhat an luat ding. Cuih tlang cu a thianghlim ding. Jakob ih minung pawl in, An covo anmah ih ram kha an co sal ding.","title":"Israel Ih Nehnak"},"18":{"text":"Jakob innsang cu meisa ah a cang ding ih, Josef innsang cu meihlio ah a cang ding; Esau innsang cu fanghi a si ding ih, An alh ding ih an kaang ṭheh ding. Esau innsang cu a luatmi pakhat hman an um lo ding. Bawipa in a sim zo a si."},"19":{"text":"“Cule Negeb ih a ummi pawl in Esau Tlang an luah ding, Shephelah phairawn ih a ummi pawl in Filistin ram an luah ding. Israel mi in Efraim le Samaria ram an luah ding a si. Benjamin hrin in Gilead ram an co ding."},"20":{"text":"Israel Saklam um saltaang pawl an kir ding ih, Saklam ah Zarefath tiang Foenisia ram an luah ding. Jerusalem saltaang pawl Sardis ih a ummi pawl in Judah thlanglam ih um Negeb khawpi pawl an luah ding."},"21":{"text":"Nehtu Jerusalem mi pawl in cu Zion Tlang ah an kai ding ih, Esau Tlang uktu an si ding. Cule Bawipa cu Siangpahrang a si ding."}}}}},"32":{"info":{"name":"Jonah","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Jonah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nikhat ni ah Amittai ih fapa Jonah hnenah Bawipa in hiti hin a sim.","title":"Jonah In Pathian Thu A Ngai Lo"},"2":{"text":"“Tho awla a nasa zetmi khawlipi Nineveh ah va feh awla a sual zia va phuang aw. A ṭhat lozia hi ka hmu ṭheh a si,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jonah cu Pathian hnen ihsin tlan dingah Tarshish khua ah feh a tum. Joppa khua ah a vung feh ih cutawkah Tarshish feh ding lawng pakhat a hmu. Lawng man a pek ih Bawipa ih hmuh ban lonak Tarshish khua ih feh dingah lawng parah cun a kai."},"4":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa in thlipi nasa zetin a hranter ih tifinriat parah cun tilet maksak a tho ih an lawng cu a kuai ṭheh zik."},"5":{"text":"Lawng hnaṭuantu pawl an thin a phang ngaingai ih an khawzing hnen ciar ah heh-le-heh tiah thla an cam ciamco. Cule an lawng zaang seh tiah lawng thilri tampi tidai sungah an hlon. Culai ah Jonah cu hnuaita khaan ah a rak itthat."},"6":{"text":"Lawng bawipa cu a ra ih, “Ziangvek minung so na si, na rak ih thah meen? Tho awla na khawzing hnenah thlacam hmeen! Na khawzing in hlohter siang loin in run ruat khal a si thei meen so khaw!” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule neta bikah lawng hnaṭuantu pawl cun, “Ra hnik uh, hi tlukih kan van a siat hi zo ih ruangah so a si, camcawhfung kan zuuk hnik pei,” tiah an ti. Camcawhfung cu an zuuk ngaingai ih Jonah parah a tla riai!"},"8":{"text":"Cutikah a hnenah, “Hi tlukih kan van a siat hi zo ih ruangah so a si, in simhnik? Zianghna so na ṭuan? Khui ram in so na rat? Ziang miphun so na si?” tiah an suut ciamco."},"9":{"text":"Jonah cun an hnenah, “Hebru mi ka si ih tifinriat le leilungpi a tuahtu vancung Pathian Bawipa a biatu ka si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun Jonah in Pathian hnen ihsin a tlan thu a sim hai tikah lawng hnaṭuantu pawl cu an ṭih sinsin ih, “Ziangah so hibangtuk thil cu na tuah?” tiah an kawk ciamco."},"11":{"text":"Cule annih in, “Thlisia dai dingah ziangtinso kan lo ti ding?” tiah an suut. Ziangahtile thlisia cu a zual deuhdeuh!"},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Jonah cun, “Tidai sungah i hlon uhla thlisia hi a dai ding. Hitiih thlisia nasa zetih a hran hi keimah ih ruangah a si ti ka thei,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Lawng hnaṭuantu pawl cun leilung lam pan dingah an hlau rero naón tilet cu a nasa deuhdeuh ruangah an ti thei hrimhrim lo."},"14":{"text":"A netnak ah Bawipa hnenah an au ih, “Maw Bawipa , hi minung pakhat ruangah hin kan zatein in cemter siang hram hlah aw. Mawh nei lo thisen kan parah tla lo dingin in zaangfah hram aw. Maw Bawipa , nang cun na duh bangin ziang hmuahhmuah hi na cangter a si,” tiah thla an cam."},"15":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jonah cu an cawi ih tifinriat sungah cun an hlon; cule tilet cu a dai."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah lawng hnaṭuantu pawl in Bawipa cu an ṭih ngaingai ih thawinak an pek hnuah amah rian dingin thu an kam aw."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in Jonah dolhtu dingah ngapi a fial ih Jonah cu ngapi pum sungah ni thum le zanthum a um."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jonah cun ngapi pum sung ihsin Bawipa a Pathian hnenah thla a cam:","title":"Jonah Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"“Ka vansaannak sungin Bawipa cu ka ko ih amah in i thei. Mithi khua ihsin bomnak ka dil, Ka aunak cu i thei zo."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah in tipi thuuk sungah i hlon, Tipi laifang tawne ahcun! Tilik in in khuh; Na tilet le na thlisia pawl cu Ka par ihsin an liam vivo."},"4":{"text":"Na mithmuh ihsin dawimi ka si ih Na Biakinn thianghlim cu ka hmu nawn lo ding, tiah ka ruat."},"5":{"text":"Ka kiangih tidai pawl cun ka thaw in phit; In khuh ṭheh, tipithuanthum cun! Tisung hrampi in ka lu in tuam."},"6":{"text":"Tlang saangpi hram ahcun ka pil vivo; Kotkhar in kumkhua ih hrennak ram ahcun! Asinain maw Bawipa ka Pathian, Khur sung ihsin ka nunnak cu na suah."},"7":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu ka sungih a cem cuahco tikah, Bawipa cu ka hun mang sal. Ka thlacamnak na hnenah a thleng, Na Biakinn thianghlim sungah cun."},"8":{"text":"Santlai lo milem a biatu pawl cun Pathian zaangfahnak an tlansan."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kei cun na hnenah lungawinak hla thawn thawinak ka lo pe ding. Ka thukammi cu ka kimter ding, Rundamnak cu Bawipa ih hnen ihsin a ra,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in ngapi a fial ih Jonah cu leilung parah a luak sal a si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭong cu Jonah hnenah a ra thleng sal ih,"},"2":{"text":"“Tho awla a nasa zetmi khawlipi Nineveh ah feh aw; ka lo sim ciami vekin ka thu va phuang aw,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Jonah in Bawipa ih thu a thlun ih Nineveh khua ah a feh. Nineveh cu khua tum ngaingai a si ih khawsung cu ni thum sung feh a si."},"4":{"text":"Nikhat sung a feh ih Nineveh khua ahcun thu a sim: “Ni sawmli hnuah Nineveh khawpi hi a cem ding,” tiah a tlang-au ciamco."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Nineveh khua mi pawl in Pathian an zum. Nauta bik in upa bik tiang buri hnipuan an hruk ih rawl an ul."},"6":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Nineveh siangpahrang in a theih tikah a siangpahrang tokham ihsin a tho ih a lal hnipuan a hlit hnuah buri hnipuan a hruk ih vutcam lakah a to."},"7":{"text":"Cule Nineveh khawsung ah thu a than ih, “Nineveh siangpahrang le a tlangsuak pawl ih thuthan mi cu: Minung siseh, ṭilva siseh, caw siseh, tuu siseh zianghman nan ei lo pei; rawl nan ei lo pei ih tidai khal nan in lo pei."},"8":{"text":"Minung siseh ramsa siseh, nan zatein buri hnipuan nan hruk pei ih nan aw neih patawp in Pathian nan ko pei. Zozo khal a thil sual tuahmi le a siatnak tlansan seh."},"9":{"text":"Kan hlohral ṭheh lonak dingah Pathian in a thin a sup sal ih a thinhengnak a daiter khal a si thei,” tihi a si."},"10":{"text":"Cutiih an tuahmi le an nundaan ṭha lo pawl an tlansan kha Pathian in a hmuh tikah a thin a sup sal ih an parah thlenter dingih a tummi siatsuahnak cu a thlengter sal lo."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cutikah Jonah cu a lung a awi lo ngaingai; a thin tla a hengzet ih,","title":"Jonah Ih Thinhennak Le Pathian Ih Zaangfahnak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah hiti in thla a cam, “Maw Bawipa , himi a si kan ram ih ka rak um lai ihsin ka phanmi cu! Hi ruangah a si a hlankhan in Tarshish khua ih tlan ka rak tumnak cu! Nang cu zaangfah thiam le lainat thiam Pathian, thinsaumi le a hmunmi duhdawtnak neitu Pathian, mi siatsuah a tum hmanah a sir-aw sal ṭheutu Pathian na si ti ka thei."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , ka nunnak hi la hram aw; nun hnakin thih ka duh sawn,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Hitiih na thin a heng hi a dik na ti maw si?” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Jonah cu khawsung ihsin a suak ih nisuahnak lamah a feh hnuah cunah a to. Cule a hrangah sawlhnah in deuthlam a sak ih Nineveh khua parah ziang a ra thleng ding ti zoh tum in deuthlam hnuai ah a to."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian in uum a khoter ih Jonah phentu dingah le a harnak nuamter deuh dingah a tlun ah a zaamter. Cutikah uum ruangah Jonah cu a lung a awi ngaingai."},"7":{"text":"Asinain a thaizing zingpit ah Pathian in uumhri cu sunhrul a eiter ih a vuai ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Ni a hung suah tikah Pathian in nisuahnak lam thlisa a hranter. Cule ni in Jonah lu a em ruangah Jonah cu a lung a mit ih a sawn cuahco. Jonah cun thih a dil ih, “Nun hnakin thih ka duh sawn,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian in Jonah hnenah, “Uum ruangah hiti ih na thin a heng hi a dik na ti maw si?” tiah a sut. Jonah cun, “Thih ngam in ka thin a heng hi ka dik ko a si!” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Zan khat sungah a kho ih zan khat sungih a vuai ṭheh salmi, na phun lomi le na tuh lomi, uum hri hrangah zaangfahnak na nei."},"11":{"text":"Cuti a si ahcun hi a nasa zetmi Nineveh khua, kehlam kut le vorhlam kut hman a thleidang thiam hrih lotu minung thawng zakhat le thawngkul umnak le ṭilva tla siar cawk lo umnak khua hi zaangfah lo in maw ka um ding?” tiah a ti."}}}}},"33":{"info":{"name":"Mikah","shortname":"Mik","abbr":[],"desc":"Mikah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jotham, Ahaz le Hezekiah in Judah siangpahrang an rak ṭuan laiah Moresheth khua mi Mikah hnenah Bawipa ih ṭongkam a ra thleng. Samaria le Jerusalem thuhla ah Bawipa in Mikah hnenah a run langtermi a si."},"2":{"text":"Rak ngai uh, nannih miphun pawl, Leilung parih mi hmuahhmuah in rak thei uh. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a lo mawhthluk a si; Ngai uh, vancung a biakinn ihsin thu a sim.","title":"Samaria Le Jerusalem Hrangih ṭahhla"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu a hmun thianghlim ihsin a ra lai; Tlangzim par ihsin a rung ṭum ding."},"4":{"text":"A ke thuaiah tlang pawl cu meisa sungih khuailul bangin an tlorh ding; Phairawn pawl khal an puak kuai ding ih tlangpar in tidai a luan bangin horkuam sungah an luang ding."},"5":{"text":"Hi thil pawl cu a kim ding, ziangahtile Israel mi pawl an sualih Pathian an dodal ruangah a si. Israel ih sualnak hi zo mawhthluk ding so a si? An khawpi bik Samaria rori mawhthluk ding a si. Judah ram sungih milem biaknak a um hi zo mawhthluk ding so a si? Amah Jerusalem a si ko."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in, “Samaria cu phuul lakih khawrop le sabit hri cinnakah ka canter ding. Khua dawlnak lungto pawl cu horkuam sungah ka hril ṭheh ding ih khua hramṭohnak lung phum pawl cu ka langter ṭheh ding."},"7":{"text":"An sunloih zetmi milem pawl ka vuakkuai ṭheh ding ih an biakinn hlawhhlang pawl an pekmi thil hmuahhmuah meisa in ka ur ṭheh ding. An milem pawl cu hnawmpen ah an cang ṭheh ding. Samaria in hi thil pawl cu hlawhhlan man ah a ngah ih atu-ah cu pawl cu a ral pawl in hlawhhlang man ah hmun dangah an pek ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule Mikah in, “Hiti a si ruangah kei cu riahsia in ka ṭap ding. Ka riahsiatnak langternak ah ka ke lawngin le ka lawngfangkheh in ka vak rero ding. Cinghnia bangin riahsia in ka bo ding ih kalauk vate bangin lungleng in ka ai ding."},"9":{"text":"Samaria ih hma cu damter a theih nawn lo; Judah khal cuvek thotho in a tuar ding. Siatsuahnak cu ka minung pawl an umnak Jerusalem kotka a thleng zo,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Ral ih in nehzia hi Gath ih um kan ral pawl sim hlah uh; kan ṭah rero hi hmu hlah hai seh. Maw Beth Leafrah khua mi pawl, nan riahsiatnak cu leivut lakah ril tahrat in langter uh.","title":"Ral In Jerusalem An Pan"},"11":{"text":"Maw Shafir khua mi tla, taklawng le ningzak in sal ah feh uh. Zaanan khua ih a ummi pawl cu an khua in an suak ngam lo. Bethezel khua mi pawl an riahsiatnak nan theih tikah cutawkah beunak a um lo ti thei uh."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in harsatnak cu Jerusalem khua kiangte tiang a thlenter zo ruangah Maroth khua mi pawl cu bomnak ngah ding an hngakhlap zet."},"13":{"text":"Nannih Lakhish ih a ummi pawl, rang pawl cu rangleng ah ṭemcih uh. Nannih in Israel sualnak nan cawng ih cuti cun Jerusalem nan sualter."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah, maw Judah mi pawl, Moresheth Gath khua cu ṭhen awknak laksawng nan pek a ṭul ding. Akzib khua cu Israel siangpahrang pawl hrangah cun bumnak lawng a si."},"15":{"text":"Maw Mereshah mi pawl, nan ral in nan khua an la ding ih Bawipa in nan ral kut sungah a lo thlenter ding. Israel hruaitu pawl cu an tlan ding ih Adullam lungpuk ah an relh ding."},"16":{"text":"Maw Judah mi pawl, nan fahniang pawl nan ngai ruangah riahsia in nan sam meet uh. Nan faale pawl cu sal ah an kai ding ih ramdang ih an fehpi ding ruangah nan lu cu langta lu bangin meet kolh thluh uh."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ihkhun parah zau tahratin thil ṭha lo tuah ding khua a khang rerotu pawl cu nan hmakhua a va pit so! Khua a hung vang ih tikcu ṭha an ngah vete in thil ṭha lo an ruahmi cu an tuah.","title":"Farah Namsuktu Pawlih Hmakhua"},"2":{"text":"Lo an duh tikah mi ih lo an long. Inn an duh tikah mi ih inn an luah mai. Zo ih innsang le thilri hman a him lo."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Bawipa in hiti in a ti, “Nan parah thil ṭha lo ka thlenter ding ih zohman nan luat thei lo ding.Awloksong le vansaang in nan um ding ih hngalhngawng zet cun nan tlang nawn lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Cuih tikcu a thlen tikah siatnak nan tonmi cu mi tampi in thuṭhimnak ah an hmang ding ih hi nan thinnatnak hla hi an sak ding: ‘Siatsuah ṭheh kan si zo, Bawipa in kan ram a lak zo; Sal ih in kaitu pawl hnenah a pek,’ an ti ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule hi ram cu Bawipa ih minung hnenih pek sal a si tikah nannih hrangah cun co ding zianghman a um lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Misenpi in ka hnenah, “Thu in sim duh hlah. Cuih thu pawl cu a rel in rel nawn hlah. Pathian cun mual in photer zik lo."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi pawl hi camsiatnak hnuai ah an um tiah maw si na ruah? Pathian cu a thin a sau thei nawn lo tiah na ruat maw si? Cuvek thil cu a tuah ngaingai pei maw? Thil ṭha a tuahtu pawl hnen ahcun ṭong thlum in a ṭong ṭheu a si lo maw?” an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in, “Ka minung pawl cu nan ral vek in nan do. Raldonak ihsin an rung tlung ih kan inn ah himte in kan um tiah an ruat; asinain nannih in an taksa parih angki fual hman kha ru dingah nan rak bawh."},"9":{"text":"Ka miphun ih nupinu pawl cu an duhmi an inn nuamzet ihsin nan dawi suak ih an faale pawl hnen ihsin ka thlawsuah kha nan laksak."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah tho uhla feh uh; hitawk ah humhimnak malte hman a um nawn lo. Nan sualnak in hi hmun cu a siatter ṭheh zo."},"11":{"text":"“Hi minung pawl ih duhmi profet cu sukso ah tawivak tahratin thuphan le mi bumnak lawng rel ih, ‘Nan hrangah cun sabitti le zu an luang ringring ko ding,’ a ti hluahhlotu khi a si."},"12":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla a taang hrihmi Israel pawl nannih cu hmunkhat ah ka lo finkhawm ding. Tuu innih a tlungmi tuu vekin hmunkhat ah ka lo tlunter ding. Ṭilva tlannak ramih tuu an khah vekin nan ram cu minung in an khat sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in lamzin a sial ding ih an saltaannak hmun ihsin a hruaisuak ding. Khawpi kotka pawl cu an bauh ding ih an suak ding. An siangpahrang Bawipa amah rori in a suahpi hai ding."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel uktu pawl tla ngaihnik uh! Dingthluk lairelnak a duhtu ding nan si naón,","title":"Mikah In Israel Hotu Pawl a Mawhthluk"},"2":{"text":"Ṭhatnak a huatu le siatnak a duhtu riangri nan si. Ka minung pawl cu nungcung in an vun nan hawk ih an ruh ihsin an tit nan filh."},"3":{"text":"Ka minung pawl ih sa nan ei ṭheh. An vun nan hawk ih an ruh nan khiah hnuah beel ih suan dingah nan saattan ṭheh."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa hnenih nan au ciamco tikcu a ra thleng leh ding. Asinain a lo sawn lo ding. Thil siava nan tuah ruangah nanmah lam zoh loin hmun dang a lo hoisan hai ding."},"5":{"text":"Tangka petu hnenah daihnak a um ding tiah thu a kam ih tangka pe lotu hnenah cun ral a tlung ding tiih mi a hrotu profet pawl in ka minung pawl cu an bum ṭheh a si. Hi vek profet pawl hnenah Bawipa in,"},"6":{"text":"“Maw profet pawl, nan tikcu a cem zik thlang. Ni in a lo liamsan cing ding. Zan in a lo khuh hai ding. Langnak nan hmu nawn lo ding ih hmailam thu phuan theinak zianghman nan nei nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Hmailam thu a simtu pawl cu an simmi a kim lo ruangah mualpho in an um ding. Pathian in an thu a let lo ruangah an zatein ningzak in an um ding."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kei cu Israel mi an sualnak ziang a si ti sim dingah Bawipa in thlarau le huham thawn i khahter ih dingte ih thuṭhen theinak le ralṭhatnak i pek."},"9":{"text":"Maw Israel uktu pawl, dingthluk lairelnak a hua ih thil ṭha kha thil ṭha loih a cantertu nannih pawl i ngaihnik uh!"},"10":{"text":"Pathian ih khawpi Jerusalem cu mithahnak le dinglonak parah nan sak rero a si."},"11":{"text":"Khawpi uktu bawi pawl in nawhthuh duh ah thu an ṭhen; puithiam pawl in sum ngah duh ah Daan cabu an hrilhfiah ih profet pawl in tangka duh ah hmailam thu an phuang; cule an zatein, “Kan hnenah Bawipa a um,” an ti ṭheh. “Kan parah thil poimawh zianghman a thleng lo ding. Bawipa cu kan hnenah a um a si,” an ti."},"12":{"text":"Hi bangtuk nan si ruangah Zion cu lo bangin lei ah leh ṭheh a si ding. Jerusalem khua cu khawrop ah a cang ding ih Biakinn umnak tlang cu tupi ah a cang ding a si."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hmailam tikcu ahcun Bawipa ih Biakinn dinnak tlang cu, Tlang hmuahhmuah lakah a saangbik a si ding. Miphun tampi in ti luang bangin an pan dutdo ding.","title":"In Daihnak Thawn A Uk (Isai 2.1-4)"},"2":{"text":"Cuih minung pawl cun,” Bawipa ih tlang ah hung feh uhsi, Israel Pathian ih Biakinn ahcun; Tuahter in duhmi cu kan zir ding ih A hrangih a hrilciami lamzin ahcun kan feh ding,” an ti ding. Bawipa ih thuzirhnak cu Jerusalem ihsin a ra ih Zion ihsin a minung hnenah thu a sim."},"3":{"text":"Amah cu miphun tampi lakah thuṭhentu a si ding ih, A hlat le a nai miphun cak zetzet karlakah lai a rel ding. An ralnam cu leilehnak tuhmui ah an ser ding ih, An feipi cu thingfa cehnak cehrep ah an tuah ding. Miphun pakhat le pakhat an do aw nawn lo ding ih, Raldo daan khal an zir nawn lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Zozo khal hnangam zetin an um ding ih, An sabit hmuan le an theipi kung lakah cun Zohman in an thin an phanter nawn lo ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a ti."},"5":{"text":"Miphun kip in anmah ih khawzing ciar biak in a thu an thlun ciar; sikhalsehla kannih cun Bawipa kan Pathian kan biak ding ih kumkhua in a thu kan thlun ding."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka hremmi pawl cu hmunkhat ah ka finkhawmnak caan le ralkaihnak hmun ih a tuar zettu pawl ka kawhkhawmnak tikcu a ra ding.","title":"Ralkaihnak In Israel Mi An Kir Ding"},"7":{"text":"Ke-awl mi an si naón a taangsun ka miphun ah ka tuah ding. Dawihlomi an si naón a thar in ka thawhpi sal hai ding ih miphun tumzet ah an cang ding. Zion Tlang ah cuih caan ihsin a kumkhua in ka uk hai ding,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Nang Jerusalem, Pathian in tuukhal bangtuk in a minung pawl a kilvennak hmun, nang cu na ram uknak sungih khawpi bikah na cang sal ding."},"9":{"text":"Ziangah so ringzet in na ṭah ciamco? Ziangah so nau neizik nunau bangin na tuar ciamco? Siangpahrang na neih nawn lo ruangah maw? Thuron dingmi na neih nawn lo ruangah a si maw?"},"10":{"text":"Maw Zion fanu pawl, nau neizik bangin ṭhia thlohthlo in ai rero uh; ziangahtile hi khawpi ihsin nan suak ding ih hramlak ah nan um ding. Babilon ah nan feh ding a si. Sikhalsehla cutawk ihsin run suak nan si ding ih Bawipa in nan ral pawl ih kut sungin a lo hum ding."},"11":{"text":"Miphun tampi nanmah do dingah an ṭangkhawm. Annih in, “Jerusalem cu siatṭheh ding a si! Hnawmpen ah cang ṭheh sehla kan zoh ding!” an ti."},"12":{"text":"Asinain hi miphun pawl in Bawipa ih thinlung sungah ziang a um ti an thei lo. Fang cu ciil ding ih an khawm ṭheu bangin Bawipa in annih pawl cu hrem dingih a finkhawm ṭheh hi an thei lo."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Jerusalem mi pawl, feh uhla nan ral pawl hrem hai uh. Thir ki le dar ketin a neimi cawcang bangin ka lo cakter ding. Miphun tampi nan rialdip ding ih thisen suah tahrat ih an ngahmi lennak pawl cu leilung pumpi in Bawipa keimah ih hnenah nanmah in in pe ding,” a ti."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem mi pawl, nan ralkap hmunkhat ah finkhawm uh! In kulh ṭheh zo! Israel hotu cu a biang ah thirfung in an thawi ding."},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Bethlehem Efratah, nang cu Judah peng ah khawfate bik pakhat na si naón na sungin Israel uktu ka suahter ding. A suahseemnak cu khuahlan lai, a liam zomi san ihsin a rak thok zo a si,” a ti.","title":"Pathian Thukam Mi Uktu"},"3":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa in a minung pawl cu fa neitu ding nu in fapa a neih hlan sung hmuah an ral pawl kut sungah a taanta ding. Cuih hnuah a unau ralkaihnak hmun ih a ummi pawl thawn an kom aw sal ding."},"4":{"text":"Amah a rat tikah cun Bawipa ih thazaang le Bawipa Pathian ih huham thawn a minung pawl a uk hai ding. Leilung pumpuluk ah mi hmuahhmuah in a maksak zia cu an hmuh ding ruangah amah ih minung pawl cu him zetin an um ding."},"5":{"text":"Daihnak a thlenpi ding a si. Assiria mi pawl in kan ram in do ih kan ṭanhmun an rung thlen tikah anmah do dingah kan hotu cak bik pawl kan thlah ding."},"6":{"text":"An hriamnam thawn Assiria ram, Nimrod ih ram cu an va neh ding. Assiria pawl in kan ram an do tikah in humtu cu anmah an si ding."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi a taangsun pawl cu miphun tampi hrangah Bawipa ih run thlakmi daitla bangtuk an si ding; hrampi note hrangih ruahhmai bangtuk an si ding. Cupawl cun minung si loin Pathian an rinsan ding.","title":"Tlensuahnak Le Hremnak"},"8":{"text":"Israel mi ṭhenkhat miphun tampi lakah an taang ding ih tupi sung le ṭilva tlannak phuul lakih rawl hawl in a vak rero mi kiosa bangtuk an si ding. Kiosa cu tuurual lakah lut in a zon ih a bauhthlek ṭheh hai. Runsuah ngaihnak a um nawn lo."},"9":{"text":"Cuvekin Israel cun a ral tampi a neh ding ih a siatsuah ṭheh hai ding."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Cuih ni ah nan rang pawl ka la ding ih nan rangleng pawl ka siatter ṭheh ding."},"11":{"text":"Nan khawpi pawl ka siat ṭheh ding ih nan ṭannak phardawl pawl cu ka bal ṭheh ding."},"12":{"text":"Nan dawithiam pawl ka hlon ṭheh ding ih nan pol pawl cu pakhat hman ka zuah lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Nan milem pawl le nan biak rero mi nan lungphun zarh pawl ka balsiat ṭheh ding. Nanmah kut ih tuahmi thil ziangtik hman ah nan bia nawn lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Nan ram sungih Asherah lem pawl le nan khua pawl cu ka siatsuah ṭheh ding."},"15":{"text":"Ka thu a thlun lotu miphun hmuahhmuah cu thinheng in an parah phuba ka la ding a si."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi parih mawhthluknak a neih mi hi ngaihnik uh! Maw Bawipa , tho awla na neihmi thu cu simhnik aw; tlang saangpipi le tlang niamtete in na thu cu thei hai seh.","title":"In Israel A Mawhthluk"},"2":{"text":"Nannih tlang saangpi pawl, nannih kumkhua hmun mi leilung hram ṭoh-nak pawl, Bawipa ih thu cu ngai uh! Bawipa in a minung parah thu a nei. Israel parih a neihmi thu a sim ding."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka minung pawl, nan parah ziang tuahmi so ka neih? Ziangtin so nan hrangah thilrit ih ka can cu? I let hnik uh!"},"4":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin ka lo runsuak ih saltaannak sungin ka lo tlensuak. Nanmah hruaitu dingah Moses le Aaron le Miriam ka thlah."},"5":{"text":"Ka minung pawl, Moab siangpahrang Balak in nan parih thil tuah a tummi le Beor ih fapa Balaam in thu a lehnak pawl kha ciing ringring uh. Akasia ih riah hmun ihsin Gilgal fehnak lamzin ih thil a cangmi pawl kha thei ringring uh. Cuih thil pawl ciing ringring uhla nanmah hum duh ih thil ka rak tuahmi pawl cu nan thei sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Vancung Pathian Bawipa bia dingih ka feh tikah a hnenah ziangso ka ken ding? A hnenih mei-ur thawinak pe dingah kum khat kim caw no ṭha ka hei keng ding maw?","title":"Ih Duhmi"},"7":{"text":"Tuu a thawng le a za in pe ningla Bawipa cu a lung a awi pei maw? Cat loih a luangmi olif hriak in a lung a awiter pei maw? Ka sualnak ruangah a hnenah ka sung suak ka fatir ka pe ding maw?"},"8":{"text":"Asilo, Bawipa amah in a ṭhami le tuahter in duhmi cu in sim zo. Siter in duh mi cu: A dingmi tuah le zaangfahnak tlaihsan le tangdorte in Pathian thawn fehtlang khi a si."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihzah cu fim a si. Bawipa in khawpi cu a ko ih, “Khawsungih a ummi pawl, ngai uh."},"10":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo pawl ih inn ahcun ṭhat lonak thawn an ngahmi sumsaw tampi a um. A dik lomi tahnak an hmang, ka huatmi thil a si."},"11":{"text":"A dik lomi tahnak le a dik lomi cuaithlainak a hmangtu pawl cu ziangtinso ka ngaithiam thei ding?"},"12":{"text":"Khawsungih milian pawl cun mifarah pawl nan neekrawk ih nan zatein thuphan pertu hlir nan si."},"13":{"text":"Nan sualnak ruangah nanmah siatsuahnak atu ihsin ka thok zo."},"14":{"text":"Rawl cu nan ei ding naón nan puar lo ding; nan ril a rawng ringring ding. Thilri humsuak dingih nan tlanpi hmanah nan hlawhtling lo ding. Nan tlanpi suakmi a um pang hmanah ral kut in ka siatter ṭhiamṭhiam ding."},"15":{"text":"Rawlci nan tuh ding naón a rah cu nan la ngah lo ding. Olif rah ihsin siti nan rial ding naón hman ding cu nan nei dah lo ding. Sabitti nan tuah ding naón nan in dah lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang Omri le a fapa siangpahrang Ahab ih thil ṭha lo tuahmi nan thlun zo a si. An taantami an thu cu nan thlun ṭhiamṭhiam ruangah siatnak ah ka lo thlenpi hai ding ih mi hmuahhmuah in an lo hmuhsuam ding. Khawzakip ih mi in nautatnak thawn an lo siatsuah ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A va poi so! Rilrawng zetin thingkung parah thingrah hawl ih zianghman a ngah lotu le sabit hri parah sabit rah hawl ih a tong lotu ka bang. Theipi rah thawthaw le sabit rah hmuahhmuah cu an rak lo ṭheh zo.","title":"Israel Ih Nuncan ṭhat Lozia"},"2":{"text":"Hi ram sungah hin mifel pakhat hman an um lo; Pathian rinsantu pakhat hman an um lo. Mi thahnak tikcu lawng an bawh. Pakhat le pakhat zuarthlai aw dingin an bawh aw fingfing a si."},"3":{"text":"Thil ṭha lo tuahnak lam ahcun rintlak hlir an si. Hotu bawi le thuṭhentu pawl in nawhthuh an dil. Thil tithei pacang pawl in an duh mi an sim ih cuticun thil ṭha lo cu an rel tlang."},"4":{"text":"An lakih miṭha bik hman hling vek a si ih mifel bik an timi cu so bangtuk a si. Profet hmangin Pathian in ralrinnak a sim zo bangin a minung pawl a hremnak tikcu a ra thleng ding. Atu-ah an buai celcel zo."},"5":{"text":"Na inn hnen khal rinsan hlah; na rualpi khal zum hlah. Na nupi hnenih na ṭongmi hman ralring aw."},"6":{"text":"Cuvek tikcu ahcun fapa pawl in an pale pawl cu mi aa ah an ruat ding ih, fanu pawl in an nule pawl cu an dodal ding. Mo pawl cu an ni thawn an to aw ding ih zozo khal an ral cu anmah ih innsungsaangmi an si ding."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kei cun Bawipa ka thlir ding. Thlangamtein i runtu Pathian cu ka hngak ding ih amah in i hum ding. Ka Pathian cun ka aw a ngai ding."},"8":{"text":"Kan ral pawl in kan parah direm ding zianghman an nei lo. Kan bah zo, asinain kan thosal ding. Thimnak sungah kan um, asinain Bawipa in tleunak in pe ding.","title":"In Runnak A Ratpi"},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih parah kan sual zo ih tikcu tawkfang sung cu a thinhengnak kan tuar ding. Sikhalsehla a netnak ahcun amah in in ṭan ding ih kan tlunih thil dik lo an tuahmi cu dingnak thawn thu a ṭhen leh ding. Khawtleu ah amah in in suahpi ding ih in runnak kha kan hmu ding."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah kan ral pawl, “ Bawipa nan Pathian cu khuiah so a si?” ti ih in nautat rerotu pawl in an hmu ding ih ningzak in an um ding. Kan ral pawl an sung ding ih lamzin ah ciarbek bangih palcih an si kha kan hmu ding."},"11":{"text":"Maw Jerusalem mi pawl, nan khawpi sak salnak tikcu a ra thleng zik thlang. Cuih tikcu caanah nan ram cu kauhter sinsin a si ding."},"12":{"text":"Nan minung pawl khuazakip in nan hnenah an ra kir ding: Nisuahnak lam Assiria ihsin, thlanglam Izipt ram ihsin le lam hlatzet tifinriat le tlang saangpipi ihsin an ra kir ding."},"13":{"text":"Asinain cuih leiram pawl cu a parih umtu pawl ih sualnak le ṭhat lonak ruangah ramṭhingah a cang ding."},"14":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na hrilmi na minung pawl hi tuu bangin na kianghrol thawn khal hai aw. An kiangkap ram pawl cu ram ṭha zetzet an si naón annih ih umnak cu ramṭhing a si ih cutawkah anmah lawng an um. Ram ṭhatnak Bashan le Gilead ah feh hai sehla hlanlaipi ih an rak um bangin khopkham in um sal hai seh.","title":"In Israel A Zaangfah"},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , Izipt ram ihsin in suahpi lai caan ih na rak tuah bangin kan hrangah mangbangza tuah hram aw."},"16":{"text":"Miphun dang pawl in cumi cu an hmuh tikah ziangtluk ih micak an si hmanah an ning a zak ding. Beidong in an hmur an hup ding ih an hna an phit ding."},"17":{"text":"Leivut lakah rul bangin an vak ding; leilung ih a vakmi cucik kharbok bangin! An ral ṭannak ralhruang ihsin khur thlohthlo in an ra suak ding. Ṭihnak thawn Bawipa kan Pathian hnenah an kir ding."},"18":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , nangmah vek Pathian zoso a um! A taangsun na minung pawl cu an sualnak na ngaidam a si. Kumkhua in na thin a heng lo; a hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu an parah na langter ringring."},"19":{"text":"Atu khalah kan parah zaangfah lainatnak na nei sal ko ding. Kan sualnak cu na ke tangah na pal ding ih tifinriat ih tawne ah na hlonhlo ding."},"20":{"text":"Khuahlan laiah kan pupa Abraham le Jakob hnen ih thu na rak kam cia bangin an tesinfa, na minung Israel mi hnenah cun rinsan tlak na sizia le a hmunmi na duhdawtnak cu na langter ding a si."}}}}},"34":{"info":{"name":"Nahum","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Nahum"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Himi hi Elkosh khuami Nahum in Nineveh khua thuhla ah langnak a hmuh mi a si:"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu thiiknei le phuhlam hmang Pathian a si; Bawipa cu phuhlam hmang le thinheng thei a si. Amah a dodaltu parah phu a hlam ih, A ral pawl parah thinheng in a lehrul.","title":"Nineveh Khua Parah Thinhennak"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu olte in a thin a heng lo; Asinain a huham cu a nasa ngaingai. Misual pawl hrem loin a luatter hrimhrim lo ding. Bawipa ih fehnak kipah phusiing le thlipi a tho ih, Mero cu a ke fehnak ihsin a thomi leikhu a si."},"4":{"text":"Tifinriat thu a pek ih a kanter, Tiva hmuahhmuah khal an caar an ro ṭheh. Bashan ram le Karmel tlang tla an ro ṭheh ih, Lebanon tlang ih pangpar khal an vuai ṭheh a si."},"5":{"text":"Tlang saangpipi a hmaiah an hnin ih, Tlang niamtete an cim ṭheh. A hmaika ahcun leilung le a parih ummi pawl cu, An khur ih an ṭhia."},"6":{"text":"A thinhengnak hmaiah zoso a ding thei ding? A thin ai-thoknak cu zoso a tuar thei ding? A thinhengnak cu tisa bangin a burh, A hmaika ahcun lungto hman leivutah an cang ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ṭha, Harsatnak caanah beunak ṭha bik a si. A hnenih humhimnak a hawltu cu a zaangfah ih, Himdamnak an ngah a si."},"8":{"text":"Tilian in thil a siatsuah bangin, A ral pawl cu a siatsuah ih, A dodaltu pawl cu thihnak khawthim sungah a thlak hai."},"9":{"text":"Ziangah so Bawipa cu a phiar nan tum rero? A lo siatsuah ṭheh hai ding a si. Zohman in voihnih tiang an do ngam dah lo."},"10":{"text":"Hling le so an ngerh awk ṭheh bangin an ngerh aw; Zu phaam pawl bangin an ri ih, Hramro bangin an kaang ṭheh ding."},"11":{"text":"Maw Nineveh, na sungin misual pakhat Bawipa dodaltu le midang thusual forhtu a suak zo."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi hnenah, “Assiria mi an tamzet ding ih an cakzet ding naón, Siatsuah an si dingih an cem ding. Ka minung pawl, ka lo hrem zo ih Ka lo hrem sal nawn lo ding."},"13":{"text":"A lo delhtu kawn cu ka khiak ding, A lo ṭemṭawntu thir cikcin cu ka phihcat ding,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Assiria hrangah Bawipa ih thupekmi cu: “Na hmin sawngtu dingah tefa na nei nawn lo ding; Na khawzing biakinn ihsin na milem le an zuk pawl cu ka khuai ṭheh ding. Na thlaan cu atu ihsin ka timtuah cia ding ih, Nung tlak na si nawn lo,” ti hi a si."},"15":{"text":"Tlangpar ah thuthangṭha a phurtu le daihnak a rak thlentu ih ke khi zohhnik uh! Maw Judah, na tuah dingmi puai cu tuah aw, Na thukammi cu kimter aw. Mi ṭha lo pawl cun an lo neh nawn lo ding, Annih cu siatsuah ṭheh an si zo."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Nineveh, a lo siatsuahtu dingin a lo do; Raldonak ruhkulh in rak bawh uh; Lamzin zoh ṭha uh, nan hnipuan fektein hruk uh. Nan cahnak le nan thazaang suah thluh uh.","title":"Nineveh A Siat"},"2":{"text":"Siatsuahtu pawl in an thilri an ram ih an siatsuah ṭheh zo naón Bawipa in Judah le Israel sunlawinak cu a pe sal ding."},"3":{"text":"An ral miralṭha pawl ih ralphaw cu a sen; An ralkap pawl cu senlaar in an thuam aw; An rangleng pawl raldo dingah artlang ih an tiar awk tikah cun, Meisa tleu vekin an tleu. An rang pawl cu an dungke hnih in an ding."},"4":{"text":"An rangleng pawl cu khawsung lamzin kaupi ah an pet ciamco; Misenpi tonnak hmunah suk le so ah an khir; Meisa hlio vek an si, Nimthlakau vekin an tle zukzo."},"5":{"text":"A hleice ih hrilmi ral bawi pawl an ko, An nawt awknak ah an bah phahphah. Khawpi kulhnak phardawl lamah an tlan, Ral pawl in phardawl ihsin an run den tikah, A khamnak zamrang in an tuah."},"6":{"text":"Tiva lam kapih kotka pawl cu bal ṭheh an si; Siangpahrang inn cu ṭihphannak in a khat."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawinu an kai, A sal pawl cun thuro uuk bangin an ṭah; An riahsia in an awm an cuum."},"8":{"text":"Tivapi an kham ih an dawlnak a pah bangin, Nineveh khawlipi sung in milai an suak ciamco. “Tlan hlah uh, tlan hlah uh,” tiah an au, Asinain zohman an kir duh cuang lo."},"9":{"text":"Ngun pawl ram ṭheh uh, Sui pawl la ṭheh uh; Hi khawlipi cu hlawnthil in a khat ih cem ni a nei lo ding."},"10":{"text":"Nineveh cu siatsuah ṭheh a si zo, Tlansan mi le ramṭhing ah a cang zo. Mi thinlung a nau ih, An khuk a ṭhia, an tha a cem, An hmai a raam ṭheh."},"11":{"text":"Khuiah so khawpi cu a um? Kiosa kua vek a si mi khawpi, Kiosa thuangte cawmnak hmun, Kiosacang le a pinu an fehnak hmun, Kiosa note tla an himnak khawpi cu?"},"12":{"text":"Kiosacang in sa a deh, A keu ih a bauhthlek ṭheh, A pinu le a fanote pawl hrangah, A kua cu bauhthlekmi sa in a khat."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Keimah hi nan ral ka si. Nan rangleng pawl ka ur ṭheh ding. Ral kutah nan ralkap pawl an thi ding. Midang hnen ihsin nan lakmi cu nan hnen ihsin ka lak sal ṭheh ding. Na palai pawl ih ngenmi cu zohman in an thei nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi khawpi cu a cem a si, Mi bumnak le mi thahnak in a khat mi khawpi, Mi thilri lonnak le ramnak in a khatmi khawpi."},"2":{"text":"Ngaihnik uh, an rang vuak thawm, An rangleng ke ring thawm, An rang ke vuak thawm, An rangleng tlan thawm durdo cu!"},"3":{"text":"Rang ralkap pawl in an nam hai, An ralnam an lek zukzo, an feipi a tle zurhzo. Miruak cu a thuah in an thuah aw, Siar cawk lo miruak cu! Ruak parah milai an bah rero!"},"4":{"text":"Hlawhhlangnu Nineveh cu hremnak a tuar; Duh thlala a si ih iang a nei; Asinain a iang neihnak cun tur a nei. Miphun tampi a thlem ih, Sal ah a tuah hai a si."},"5":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Maw Nineveh, keimah hi na ral ka si; Na hni ka lo hlit ṭheh ding ih na hmai ka lo khuh ding; Miphun pawl in na taklawngte ih na um kha an lo hmu ding; Ram uknak pawl in na mualphonak an lo hmu ding a si."},"6":{"text":"Nautatnak thawn ka lo zoh ding, Mi ih fihmi ah ka lo tuah ding; Mi in mangbang in an lo zoh ding."},"7":{"text":"A lo hmutu pawl cu an com dukdi ding ih, ‘Nineveh a siat ṭheh zo e, Zotal ih zaangfah a tong maw? Hnemtu ding zotal an um maw?’ an ti ding,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Nineveh, Izipt khawpi Thebes hnakin na ṭhadeuh cuang maw? Thebes khal cun phar bangin mi humtu tiva a nei - Nail tiva pi cu a hrangah a ṭanhmun khuarnak a si."},"9":{"text":"Amah in Ethiopia le Izipt ram a uk; a cahnak cu cem ti a nei lo; Put le Libia khal amah ṭantu an si."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Thebes mi pawl khal sal kaihmi an si ih an hruai hlo. Lamzin kel kipah an faale pawl cu an vuak that. An mi upa le bawi deuhdeuh pawl cu thir cikcin khit tahratin an hruai ih anmah kaitu lakah camcawhfung zukin an zem ih an ṭhekdarh ṭheh hai."},"11":{"text":"Nineveh, nang khal na ri ve ding ih zianghman thei loin na tlu ding ih na ral pawl kut sung ihsin luat na tum ve ding."},"12":{"text":"Na ralhruang pawl cu a rah a hmin zetmi theipi kung vek an si: Theipi kung cu hnin awla a rah cu a eitu ka sungah an rung tla ding."},"13":{"text":"Na ralkap pawl cu nunau vek an si; na ral pawl hmaiah na ram cu zohman ṭantu nei loin a um. Na kotka kharnak kothrolh pawl cu meisa in a kaang ṭheh zo."},"14":{"text":"Ral in an lo kulh ding ruangah tidai rak khai cia aw; na ralhruang le na ruhkulh pawl hngetkhoh deuh in rak tuah aw. Tlakrawh hrangah tlak rak pal cia awla, tlakrawh ahnak kuang tla rak tuah cia aw."},"15":{"text":"Asinain ziangvek in na rak tuah cia ṭheh khalle meisa in a lo ur that thotho ding; a si lole ral kut in na thi thotho ding. Kharbok ih piat ṭhehmi thlaikho bangin na cemfai thotho ding. Kharbok bangin karhzai dingah zuam aw."},"16":{"text":"Sumtuah pawl tla cu van ih arsi hnakin tam sawn na rak nei naón atu ahcun an um nawn lo. An thla pharh tahrat in a zuang hlomi kharbok vekin an hlo zo a si."},"17":{"text":"Na bawi upa pawl cu khawsik ni ah phar parih a bokmi kharbok bangtuk an si. Asinain ni a hung suah tikah cun an zam hlo ih khuitawk ah an feh ti zohman in an thei nawn lo."},"18":{"text":"Maw Assiria siangpahrang, na ram uktu pawl an thi, na hrin upa pawl cu kumkhua in an it that zo! Na minung pawl tlangpar ah ṭhekdarh an si ṭheh ih zohman inn ih a rak hruai kirtu ding an um lo."},"19":{"text":"Na tuahmawh hma cu dam theinak a um lo; thihpi tlak hma sia a si. Siatsuahnak na ton thu a theitu hmuahhmuah in an lungawi in an zaa an beeng. Zaangfahnak nei loih mi na tisiat ringringnak ihsin a luattu zotal an um maw?"}}}}},"35":{"info":{"name":"Habakkuk","shortname":"Hab","abbr":[],"desc":"Habakkuk"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Profet Habakkuk hnenah Bawipa ih thu a ra thlengmi cu hiti in a si."},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , bomnak dil in ka aunak hi ziangtikah so i theihsak ding? Tisiatnak sungin in runsuak hlanah hin voi ziangzatso ka lo kawh ding?","title":"Habakkuk A Phunzai"},"3":{"text":"Ziangah so hi bangtuk harsatnak cu i tonter? Ziangtin so hitluk thil ṭha lo an tuahmi hi na zoh thei cuahco lai? Siatsuahnak le tisualnak hlir ka kiangkap ah an khat ih thawi awknak le tawh awknak lawnglawng khuazakip ah a um."},"4":{"text":"Daan timi hi hmual a nei lo ih ṭhathnemnak khal a nei lo. Thildik timi cu tuahsuak a si dah lo. Mi ṭha lo pawl in mi ṭha pawl ih lu parah an kai; cuticun thufel timi cu anmah ih duhduh in an her thei a si."},"5":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in a minung pawl ih hnenah, “Nan kiangkap ih miphun pawl hi zoh ṭha uh; nan hmuh tikah cun nan mang a bangzet ding. Thil pakhat ka tuah ding ih nan theih tikah nan zum lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Mi puar le mi tokhrok pawl Babilon mi pawl kha thuneitu ah ka tuah ding. Anmah cu ram dang neh dingin leilung pumpi ah an feh."},"7":{"text":"Khawzakip ah thinphannak le tuksumnak hlir an khahter. An hngal tukah anmah ih thu lawng daan ah an neih a si."},"8":{"text":"“An rang pawl cu tlavang hnakin an zamrang sawn; rilrawng cinghnia cang hnakin ṭih an nung sawn. An rangralkap pawl cu an rang to in ram hlapi ihsin an ra. An rang cu leilung an huat phahphah. Khaupi in an sadehmi an zon bangin ral cu an zon a si."},"9":{"text":"“An ralkap pawl in ram an nor vivo; a kham theitu zohman an um lo. An thlen ding thawmvang an theih cun zozo khal ṭihnak in an khat. Ral an kaihmi cu vunnel zat in an tam."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang pawl an nautat ih bawi upa pawl an hnihsan.
