Ziangvek ralhruang hman in a kham thei lo. A leng ihsin lei an dawl ih an lak thei thotho."},"11":{"text":"Cule thli bangin an hrang ih an hlota. An cahnak kha khawzing tlukah an ruat!” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , a hramthok ihsin nang cu Pathian na si. Nang cu ka Pathian na si, a thianghlimmi le kumkhua in a hmunmi na si. Maw Bawipa , ka Pathian le ka Lungpi, nangmah in Babilon mi pawl cu na hril zo ih kanmah hrem theitu tiangin na cakter.","title":"Habakkuk A Phunzai Sal"},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ziangtinso hitluk mi ṭha lo le mi huaisen pawl hi na zawi thei? Thil ṭha lo zoh-nakah na mit cu an thianghlim tuk ih sualnak a tuahtu pawl cu na hmu thei ṭheu lo a si. Ziangah so anmah hnakih miding pawl an siatsuah rero naón daiziar ih na um san men?"},"14":{"text":"Ziangtin so minung cu uktu le hotu nei lo nga vek le cucik kharbok vek tlukah na tuah?"},"15":{"text":"Babilon mi pawl in midang cu nga vekin sio in an sio. Sur in an awk, an dirhsuak ih an kaihmi ruangah lungawi in an au ciamco."},"16":{"text":"An sur in thil ṭha bik an ngah thei ruangah an sur hnenah raithawinak an pek ih an biak a si."},"17":{"text":"Kumkhua in maw an ralnam hmang tahratin miphun pawl cu zaangfahnak nei loin an siatsuah rero ko ding?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ralvennak donhleisang ah ka hung kai ding ih Bawipa in ka ṭong dingmi ziangvek i sim ding tile ka phunzainak kha ziangtin i sawn ding, ti ka hngak ding.","title":"In Habakkuk A Run Sawn"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cun hiti in i run sim, “Na hnen ih ka langter mi cu voikhat zohnak in siar thei dingah lungpher parah fiangtein ngan aw."},"3":{"text":"Ngan fel aw, ziangahtile a kimnak tikcu a si hrih lo. Asinain cuih tikcu cu zamrang in a ra thleng ding ih ka lo hmuhmi cu a kim ngaingai ding. A kimnak tikcu a tlai vek a bang ding naón thinsau in hngak aw; a kim tengteng ding ih a tikcu cu a tlai nawn lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Cuih thu cu: ‘Mi ṭha lo pawl cu an luat lo ding; sikhalsehla mi ding pawl cu Pathian rintlak an si ruangah an nung ding,’ tihi a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Lennak cu mibum a hmang. Mi duhham pawl cu an puarthau ih daiteón an um thei lo: thihnak vekin khawh ti an nei dah lo. Mithi khua Sheol bangtuk an si: a tawk zo an ti dah lo. Curuangah a si miphun pakhat hnu pakhat anmah ih hrang lawnglawng ah an neh ciamco.","title":"Miding Lo Pawl An Cem"},"6":{"text":"Neh mi pawl in nehtu pawl cu an roh hai ding ih an nautatnak an langter ding. “Nan ta a si lomi nan lak; asinain nan cem ve ding. Lei a lo baktu pawl leiba pe dingah hneekcih tahrat in nan lian deuh deuh; ziangtik tiangso cutin nan tlanleen vivo hrih ding?” an ti hai ding."},"7":{"text":"Asinain nan theih man hlanah, nannih mi nehtu cu leiba neitu ah nan cang ve ding ih midang in paisa ṭhang pe dingah an lo hnekcih ve ding. Ral pawl an ra ding ih nan ṭih ruangah khur thlohthlo in an lo tuah ding. An lo ram ciamco ding!"},"8":{"text":"Miphun tampi cu nangmah in na ram. Asinain a nungsun pawl in, mi tampi na thah zo ruangah le leilung pumpi khawpi pawl le an minung pawl na tisiat ṭheh ruangah an lo ram ve ding."},"9":{"text":"Na cem a si! Midang siatsuah tahrat in na innsang cu na lianter; na umnak inn cu siatsuahnak le ṭihphannak ihsin himseh tiah na ngaihtuah ciamco."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na ngaihtuahnak cu a lak an si, na innsang ningzahnak a thlentu sawn an si. Miphun tampi na siatsuahnak in nangmah parah siatsuahnak na thlenter zo a si."},"11":{"text":"Phar ih dawlmi lungto hman cu nangmah dodal in a au ding ih innbo in aw-khawk in a run sawn ding."},"12":{"text":"Na cem a si! Khawpi cu mi siatsuahnak thawn na din ih mi thahnak thawn na sak a si."},"13":{"text":"Na nehmi miphun pawl in an tha cem ko in thil ṭhahnem lo hna an ṭuan ih an sak ciami pawl cu meisa in a kang ṭheh. Cumi cu Cungnungbik Bawipa ih thil tuahmi a si."},"14":{"text":"Asinain tifinriat cu tidai in a khah vekin leilung cu Bawipa ih sunlawinak theihnak in a khat ding."},"15":{"text":"Na cem a si! Na thinheng ah na innhnen pawl ningzak in na tuah ih an mual na photer; zu ri bangin na tlukter."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah nang khal upatnak cotu si loin ningzahnak in na khat ding. Nangmah rori zu na in ding ih na sawn in na ril ding a si. Bawipa in nangmah hremnak khuathai a lo inter ding ih upat hminṭhatnak na neihmi cu mualphonak ah a cang ding."},"17":{"text":"Lebanon tupi ih thing na hau ṭheh; atu ahcun nangmah hau na si ding. A ramsa pawl na that hai; atu ahcun ramsa pawl ṭihnak thawn na khat ding. Leilung pumpi minung le an khawpi pawl na siatsuah ruangah le milai tampi na thah ruangah hi bangtuk in na parah a thleng ding a si."},"18":{"text":"Milem in ziangso ṭhathnemnak a neih? Milai ih tuahcopmi thil pakhat men a si ih thuphan dah ti lo a lo sim theimi zianghman a um lo. Milem tuahtu in a tuahmi cu a rinsan tikah ziangso a hrangah a ṭhahnem? ṭong hman a ṭong thei lomi khawzing cu!"},"19":{"text":"Na cem riai a si! Thingtan hnenah cun, “Ṭhang aw,” na ti. Lungtlep khat hnenah, “Tho aw,” na ti. Milem in na hnenah langter theimi ziangtal a nei maw? Sui le ngun in khuutmi a si ding naón a sungah nunnak a um lo."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa cu a Biakinn thianghlim sungah a um. A hmaiah leilungtlun mi hmuahhmuah cu daitein umseh."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Profet Habakkuk thlacamnak cu hiti in a si:","title":"Habakkuk Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa , na thil tuahmi ka thei zo, Mangbangza ngaingai an si. Na thil tuahmi pawl cu a thar in Kan san ahhin tuah sal hram aw. Na thin a heng lai hmanah Kan parah zaangfahnak nei hram aw."},"3":{"text":"Pathian cu Edom ihsin a ra sal. Pathian thianghlim cu Paran tlang ihsin a ra. A sunlawinak in van a khuh, A thangṭhatnak cu leilung ah a khat."},"4":{"text":"A rat tikah cun nimthlakau vekin a tleu, A kut ihsin tleunak a suak zukzo; Cutawkah a cahnak cu thuh in a um."},"5":{"text":"Natnak a hmai ah a thlah ih, Thihnak cu a dungih thlun dingin thu a pe."},"6":{"text":"Amah a cawlh tikah leilung a hnin durdo; A mit zoh meen ah miphun kip an ṭhia thlohthlo. Kumkhua hmun tlangsaangpi pawl cu an kuai ṭheh, Sanmureng in a rak ummi tlang cu an pil ṭheh. Khuahlan lai ihsin a rak zawh ṭheumi tlang pawl cu!"},"7":{"text":"Kushan mi pawl thlaṭem in an um ka hmu; Midian mi pawl khal an khur."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa , tiva in na thin an lo tok a si maw? Tifinriat in na ai an lo thawhter a si maw? Nang cu khawdur parah na to, Thlipi cu na rangleng a si; Na minung pawl hnen ih nehnak na pek tikah cun."},"9":{"text":"Na li cu na nawp, Na conkiang sai dingah na bih. Na nimthlakau in leilung cu a phelkuai a si."},"10":{"text":"Tlangsangpi pawl in an lo hmuh tikah an ṭhia thlohthlo. Van ihsin tidai an run thlet. Leilung hnuai tidai an awn ciamco, Tilet cu saangzet in an tho."},"11":{"text":"Na conkiang eeng zohzo ih a suah tikah le, Na feipi tleu zurzo ih a zam tikah cun, Ni le thlapi cu an umnak hmun ah an ding."},"12":{"text":"Na thinheng in leilung cu na pal, Na thin ai-thok in miphun pawl na rial a si."},"13":{"text":"Asinain na minung pawl hum dingah na suak, Hriak na culhmi hum dingah cun. Miṭhalo pawl ih hotu cu na sah thlak ih, A dungthlun pawl cu na siatsuah ṭheh a si."},"14":{"text":"Na conkiang in a ralkap hotu bawi a ngah, Kanmah ṭhekdarh dingah thlipi bangih a rat tikah cun! Thupteih mi farah a hremtu vekin, Kanmah hnihsan phah ih a rat tikah cun!"},"15":{"text":"Na rang pawl thawn tifinriat na pal tikah cun, A nasa zetmi tipi cu a phuul ciamco."},"16":{"text":"Cumi pawl ka theih tikah ka khur, Ka hmur cu ṭihnak in a ṭhia. Ka ruangpi a caang thei nawn lo, Ka ke an sawn, in din lo. Kanmah in dotu pawl Pathian in a hrem tikcu caan, Thinsau in ka hngak ding, a ra thleng dingmi caan cu!"},"17":{"text":"Theipi in rah an neih lo ih Sabit hri ih sabit a rah lo hmanah, Olif kung ih olif rah an siat ṭheh ih, Lo in rawl a suah lo hmanah, Tuu pawl an thih fai ṭheh ih, Caw inn tla an lawng ṭheh hmanah,"},"18":{"text":"Ka lungawi in ka thin a nuam thotho ding; Ziangahtile Bawipa Pathian cu i runtu a si."},"19":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in thazaang i pe; Zukneng bangin ka ke a fekter, Tlangsang parah himte in i ret."}}}}},"36":{"info":{"name":"Zefaniah","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Zefaniah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amon ih fapa Josiah in Judah siangpahrang a ṭuan laiah Bawipa ih thu cu Zefaniah hnenah a ra thleng. Zefaniah cu siangpahrang Hezekiah tesinfa a si ih a pupa pawl cu Amariah, Gedaliah le Kushi an si."},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Leilung tlun ziang hmuahhmuah hi ka siatsuah ṭheh ding,","title":"Ih Thuṭhennak Ni"},"3":{"text":"minung siseh, ramsa siseh, vate le nga tiangin ka tisiat ṭheh ding. Mi ṭha lo pawl ka dirhthlak hai ding. Minung cu ka cimit ding ih pakhat hman an luat lo ding. Bawipa keimah in ka ṭong zo."},"4":{"text":"“Judah mi le Jerusalem mi pawl ka hrem ding. Baal khuavang an biaknak a taangsun mi khal ka siatralter ding ih Baal khuavang a riantu khawvel puithiam pawl cu zohman in an thei nawn lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Inn parah kai tahrat in ni le thlapi le arsi a biatu pawl cu ka siatsuah ṭheh ding. Keimah i biatu le ka hmin rinsan in siatsertu a sinan Milkom khuavang hmin in siat a sertu lala cu ka siatsuah ding a si."},"6":{"text":"Keimah i tlansan ih i thlun nawn lotu le ka hnenah ra loin keimah thu i ra ron lotu pawl cu ka tisiat ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ih thuṭhennak ni cu a nai a si. Curuangah a hmaiah daiteón um uh. Bawipa in a miphun pawl cu thawinak ih pek dingah a tum ih Judah ram siatsuah dingah ral pawl a sawm a si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Thawinak pek ni ahcun siangpahrang fapa pawl le bawi pawl le miphun dangih nunphung daan a thluntu pawl cu ka hrem hai ding."},"9":{"text":"Lawki mi vekin khuavang a biatu le an bawipa ih inn sungih thilri khatte ih a umnak dingah mi a thattu le ruk a rutu pawl cu ka hrem hai ding."},"10":{"text":"“Cuih ni ahcun Jerusalem ih Nga Kotka ah ṭah thawng nan thei ding. Tuah tharmi khawpi veng ah aihramnak nan thei ding ih tlangpar ah ri durdo ih a tlumi thawng nan thei ding."},"11":{"text":"Cumi nan theih tikah nannih khal ṭap uhla ai rero uh; nannih khawpi thuailam ih a umtu pawl cu; ziangahtile sumtuahtu pawl cu an thi ṭheh ding a si."},"12":{"text":"“Cuih caan ah mei-inn keng tahrat in Jerusalem cu ka hawl ding. Mah le mah zum-awzet le hnangamzet ih a umtu pawl, ‘ Bawipa cun zianghman a tuah dah lo; a ṭha khal a tuah lo, a sia khal a tuah lo,’ a titu pawl cu ka hrem hai ding."},"13":{"text":"An lennak cu lon ṭheh a si ding ih an inn pawl cu siat ṭheh a si ding. An sak rero mi an inn pawl cu an hngak dah lo ding ih an phun rero mi sabit hri ih sabitti cu an in dah lo ding,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa ih ni cu a nai zo: a naizet zo ih reilote ah a ra cing ding. Cuih ni cu siatnak ni a si ding, ziangahtile ralkap ral ṭha bik hman beidong in an ṭap ding."},"15":{"text":"Cuih ni cu thin ai-thok ni a si ding, harsatnak le vansaanglam ih um ni, siatsuah ni le hloral ni, thimnak ni le thinpih ni, ni dum le khawdur ni a si ding."},"16":{"text":"Raldonak thawmvang le tawtawrawt thawngin a khatmi ni, ralkap pawl in ralhruang in kulhmi khawpi le ralvennak innsang pawl an do ding ih an do phah ih an au-nak in a khatmi ni a si ding."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Minung parih siatralnak ka thlenter mi cu a nasa tuk ding ih mi hmuahhmuah mitcaw bangin an vak ding. Ka parih an sual tuk zo ruangah an thisen tidai bangin thlet a si ding ih an ruak cu leilung ah an thu an ṭawtralta ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cuih ni, Bawipa in a thinhengnak a langter ni ahcun an sui le an ngun in zohman a run thei hai lo ding. A thinhengnak meisa in leilung pumpi hi a kang ding a si. Leilung tlun ih a ummi hmuahhmuah hi rinlopi in an nunnak a cemter ding a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw ningzah nei lo pawl, pangpar bangin nan vuai ih nan thih hlanah hin,","title":"Hnenah Siir Awknak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih thinhengnak cu mei alh vekih nan par a thlen hlan le a thin ai-thoknak a langter ni a thlen hlanah hin khuaruat thiam mi si thlang hnik uh."},"3":{"text":"Ram sungih nannih mi lungnem le thukham a thluntu pawl, Bawipa hnenah kir thlang uh. Thildik tuah uhla Bawipa hmaiah lungnem mi si uh. Bawipa in a thinhengnak a langter ni ah hremnak ihsin nan luat tla a si thei men."},"4":{"text":"Gaza khawpi sungah zohman an taang lo ding. Ashkelon mi an ṭio ding. Ashdod mi pawl cu ni hrek ah dawihlo ṭheh an si ding ih Ekron mi pawl cu an khawpi ihsin dawi ṭheh an si ding.","title":"Kiangkap Miphun Pawl Cemnak"},"5":{"text":"Nannih Filistin mi, tipikap ih a ummi pawl, nan cem a si! Bawipa in nan parah thurelnak a tuah zo. A lo tisiat ding ih pakhat hman nan luat lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Tifinriat kapih nan ram hi tuukhal riahbuk le tuuhruang pawl umnak hramlak ah a cang ding."},"7":{"text":"Nan ram hi Judah mi a taangsun pawl in an luah ding. Cutawkah an tuu an khal ding ih Ashkelon ih inn pawl ah an it ding. Bawipa an Pathian an hnenah a um ding ih mi neinung a siter sal ding."},"8":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Moab mi le Ammon mi pawl in ka minung pawl an hmuhsuamnak le an nautatnak ka thei zo; an ram kan long ṭheh ding, tiih tluang an khawnnak tla ka thei zo."},"9":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian nung ka si vekin, Moab le Ammon cu Sodom le Gomorrah vekin siatsuah ṭheh an si ding tiah thu ka kam a si. Cikhur pawl umnak hmunah an cang ding. Kumkhua in a siat tata ding ih hrampi lawng a kho ding. A taangsun ka minung pawl in an siatsuah ding ih an ram cu an luah ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cubangtuk in Moab mi le Ammon mi pawl cu an hngalhngawng, an puarthau ih Cungnungbik Bawipa ih minung pawl an hmuhsuam ruangah hrem an si ding."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa cu an hrangah ṭihnungza a si ding. Leilung tlunih khawzing pawl cu zianghman lo ah a tuah ṭheh ding. Miphun hmuahhmuah in amah cu an hmun le an ram ciar ah an biak ding."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in Ethiopia mi pawl tla a thihter ding."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in Assiria siatsuahnak ah a huham a hmang ding. Nineveh khawpi cu tidai um lonak nelrawn ah a cangter ding ih tlansan mi khawrop ah a cang ding."},"14":{"text":"Caw le tuu le ṭilva phunkip an bawhnak hmunah a cang ding. Hnawmpen lakah cun sumbuh an um ding ih sangkate ihsin an ai ding. Tlang-ak tla sangkapi ihsin an ai ding. Inn parih sidar thing hmuahhmuah cu lak ṭheh an si ding."},"15":{"text":"Ka cakzet tiah a puarthau mi le ka him tiah a ruat-awtu parah cubangtuk thil cu a thleng ding. Leilung tlunah kan khawpi hi a tum bik tiah khawsung mi pawl cun an ruat. An khawpi cu ramsa riahnak hmunṭhing ah a cang ding. A hmutu pawl cu an mangbang tukah an com dukdi ding ih an kuttum an hoi ding a si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem cu a cem a si! Khi khawpi borhhlawh le raltho duh khawpi, mahih minung a hrem rerotu khawpi cu!","title":"Jerusalem Sualnak Le Tlennak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭong a ngai duh lo ih a nunsimnak tla a oih lo. A rinsannak cu Bawipa hnenah a re lo; Bawipa ih bomnak khal a dil lo."},"3":{"text":"A bawi pawl cu a huuk reromi kiosa vek an si; a thureltu bawi pawl cu cinghnia rilrawng vek an si; an hrong tukah thaizing tiang an deh mi malte hman a re thei lo pawl an si."},"4":{"text":"A profet pawl cu duhdah ih nung pawl an si. A puithiam pawl cun a zarh timi kha an buar ih Pathian daan kha anmah duhzawng in an her vivo."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla khawpi sungah Bawipa cu a um. A dikmi lawng a tuah; a ṭha lomi a tuah dah lo. Zingtin pelh loin a minung pawl hnenah dingnak a thlenter. Asinain mi ṭha lo pawl cun thil ṭha lo an tuah thotho ih an ning khal a zak lo."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Miphun tampi ka siatralter ṭheh zo. An khawpi pawl ka siatsuah ṭheh ih an phar le an ralvennak innsang pawl cu hnawmpen ah ka canter ṭheh zo. Khawpi pawl an ṭiosan, khawpi lamzin pawl an ṭhing reprep; zohman an taang nawn lo."},"7":{"text":"Hi bangtuk hnuah cun ka minung pawl in in upat, in ṭihzah ding ih ka nunzirhnak tla an pom ding ih ka thuzirhmi pawl an hngilh nawn lo ding tiah ka ruat. Sikhalsehla a hlan keel in an nuncan cu a sia thotho."},"8":{"text":"“Hngak hrih uh! Miphun pawl sual ka puh ni tiang hngak hrih uh. Miphun tampi le uknak tampi ka thinhengnak a nasatzia an theihnak dingah hmunkhat ih finkhawm hai dingah ka ruat cat zo. Ka thin aithoknak in leilung pumpi hi meisa bangin a kang ṭheh ding."},"9":{"text":"“Cule miphun kip an hmurka ka thleng ding ih hmurka thiang thawn ka hnen lawngah thla an cam ding. An zatein ka thu an ngai ding."},"10":{"text":"Ram hlatpi Ethiopia ram tiva ral hman in ṭhekdarh a si mi ka minung pawl in ka hnenah thil pek ding an rak keng ding."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah nannih ka minung pawl, keimah in rak dodal ruangah ningzak in nan um nawn lo ding. Mi hngalhngawng le mi puarthau hmuahhmuah cu ka hloralter ṭheh hai ding ih nannih pawl in ka tlang thianghlim parah cun in dodal nawn lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Cutawkah mi lungnem le mi tangdor pawl, Bawipa ih hmin a rinsantu pawl ka taan ding."},"13":{"text":"Israel mi a taangsun pawl in zohnen hmanah thilsual an tuah nawn lo ding; thuphan an per nawn lo ding; an hmur le an lei in mibum khal an tum nawn lo ding. Daihnak le himnak thawn khua an sa ding ih zohman an ṭih nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Maw Israel mi pawl, Lungawi in au uhla hla sa uh. Maw Jerusalem fanu, Na thinlung zate thawn lungawi in um aw.","title":"Lungawinak Hla"},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in a lo hremnak cu a bang zo; Na ral pawl a hlonhlo ṭheh zo. Bawipa , Israel ih siangpahrang cu nan hnenah a um; ṭihphan ding zianghman a um nawn lo."},"16":{"text":"Tikcu a ra thleng ding ih Jerusalem hnenah: “Maw Zion khawpi, zianghman phang hlah; Na kut tla na ṭih ruangah zawng ṭheh hlah seh."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa na Pathian cu na hnenah a um, A cahnak huham in nehnak a lo pek. Bawipa cu na parah a lung a hmui ding, A duhdawtnak ruangah nunnak thar a lo pe ding. Hla a sa ding ih na parah a lung a awi ding."},"18":{"text":"Puai tuah caan ih lungawi mi bangin,” an ti ding. Bawipa in, “Na harsatnak caan cu ka cemter zo; Na ningzahnak cu ka hlonhlo zo."},"19":{"text":"Tikcu a ra thleng ding ih, A lo hremtu pawl ka hrem ding. Ke-awl mi pawl ka run hai ding ih Ralkaih thawngtla mi pawl ka hruai kir ding. An mualphonak cu upat an conak ah ka tuah ding. Leitlun mi hmuahhmuah in an lawm hai ding."},"20":{"text":"Tikcu a ra thleng ding ih, ṭhekdarh mi na minung pawl ka hruaikir hai ding. Leilung pumpi ih hminthang ah ka lo tuah ding ih, Mi neinungzet ah ka lo tuah sal ding; Cumi cu na mit in na hmu ding” tiah a ti. Bawipa in a ṭong zo a si."}}}}},"37":{"info":{"name":"Haggai","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Haggai"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darias in Persia siangpahrang a ṭuan kum hnihnak, thla ruk thla, ni khat ni ah Bawipa ih ṭong cu profet Haggai hnenah a rung thleng. A rung thlengmi thu cu Judah ram uktu bawi, Shealtiel ih fapa Zerubbabel hrangah le puithiam sang Jehozadak ih fapa Joshua hrangah a si.","title":"Biakinn Sak Dingah Ih Thupeknak"},"2":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in Haggai hnenah, “Atu hi Biakinn sak salnak dingah cun tikcu remcaang a si lo tiah mipi in an ti ciamco,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah profet Haggai hmangin misenpi hnenah Bawipa ih thu cu hiti in a si:"},"4":{"text":"“Maw ka minung pawl, ka Biakinn hnawmpen vekih a um laiah ziangah so nannih hmuah inn ṭhaṭha ah nan um?"},"5":{"text":"Nan parih thil a thlengmi hi nan hmu thiam lo maw si?"},"6":{"text":"Rawl ci tampi nan tuh, asinain rawl malte lawng nan la. Rawl ei ding nan nei, asinain pum puar tlak nan nei lo. Sabit in ding nan nei, asinain rit tlak hman nan nei lo. Hnipuan hruh ding nan nei, asinain a lo hlumtertu hnipuan ṭha nan nei lo. Hnaṭuantu khal in pumcawmnak tlak nan hlawh lo."},"7":{"text":"Ziangruangah hi bangtuk hin nan parah a cang ti nan thei lo maw si?"},"8":{"text":"Tlangpar ah va kai uh, thing va lak uhla Biakinn sak sal uh. Cutikah ka lung a awi dingih cutawkah ka sunlawinak ka langter ding."},"9":{"text":"Rawl kan paṭha zet ding tin nan ruat, asinain nan lakmi ngaingai cu a malte a si. Nan rawl cu inn ih nan run tlun tikah keimah in ka semhlo ṭheh. Ziangah so ka semhlo nan thei maw? Nan zatein nanmah inn ciar nan sak ih manhlap zetih nan um laiah kei ih inn cu balsiat ṭhehmi hnawmpen vekih nan umter ruangah a si."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah sokhaw ruah tla a sur lo ih zianghman a khoh thei lo cu!"},"11":{"text":"Ruah sur loin leilung ka carter ṭheh: tlangpar le lo sung le sabit hmuan pawl le olif hmuan pawl, leilung parih a khomi rawl kung parah le minung le ṭilva tlunah le milai in ciin an tummi thil hmuahhmuah parah ruah ka surter lo ih ka caarter a si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah Zerubbabel le Joshua le Babilon saltaannak ihsin a ra kirtu pawl hmuahhmuah in Bawipa an Pathian fialmi cu an tuah. An thin a phang ih Bawipa ih palai a si mi profet Haggai ih thu cu an ngai.","title":"Misenpi In Ih Thu An Thlun"},"13":{"text":"Haggai cun Bawipaió thu cu misenpi hnenah a sim: “Nan hnenah ka um ding, tiah thu ka lo kam a si,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa in mi hmuahhmuah cu Biakinn ṭuan dingah an lung a thoter: Judah ram uktu bawi Zerubbabel, Puithiam Saang Joshua, le saltannak ihsin a ra kirtu pawl an tel ṭheh. Cungnungbik Bawipa , an Pathian ih biakinn cu sak sal an thok."},"15":{"text":"Darias in Persia siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum hnih kum, thla ruk thla, ni kul hluan li ni ah an thok a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih kum thla sarih thla, ni kul hluankhat ni ah Bawipa ṭong cu Haggai hnenah a rung thleng sal.","title":"Biakinn Thar Mawinak"},"2":{"text":"Haggai cu Judah ram uktu bawi Zerubbabel, Puithiam Saang Joshua le mipi hnenah thu sim dingin a fial."},"3":{"text":"“Hmaisa Biakinn kha ziangtluk in so a mawi, a ciingtu nanmah lakah pakhat tal nan um maw? Atu-ah ziangtin nan hmu? Atu hi cu zianghman a si ual lo, nan ti ding."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla zohman nan lung uih in nan tha nau hlah seh. Hna ṭuan uh, nan hnenah ka um a si."},"5":{"text":"Izipt ihsin nan rak suah laiah nan hnenah ka um ringring ding, tiah thu ka rak lo kam hai. Atu khalah nan hnenah ka um; curuangah nan thin phang hlah uh."},"6":{"text":"“Rei lote ah van le lei, leilung pi le tifinriat pawl hi ka hnin ciamco ding."},"7":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah ka hlonhlo ṭheh ding ih an sumsaw le an hlawn thil pawl cu hitawk ah an rak keng ding; cutin hi Biakinn cu lennak in a khat ding."},"8":{"text":"Leilung tlun sui le ngun hmuahhmuah cu ka ta an si."},"9":{"text":"Biakinn thar cu a hlun hnakin a nasasawn ding ih cutawkah ka minung pawl ṭhansonak le hnangamnak ka pe ding,” a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a sim zo a si."},"10":{"text":"Darias in siangpahrang a ṭuan kum hnihnak, thla kua thla, ni kul hluanli ni ah Cungnungbik Bawipa in profet Haggai hnenah a sim sal."},"11":{"text":"“Puithiam pawl hiti in thu sut hnik aw:"},"12":{"text":"Thuṭhimnak ah mi pakhatkhat in thawinak ih pekmi sa thianghlim sungin a hrekkhat lakin a puan in zawi in feh pi sehla. Cuih a puan cun sangreu maw, rawl suan cia maw, sabitti maw, olif hriak maw, a si lole rawl phunkhatkhat maw dai pang sehla cuih a daimi cu a thianghlimmi tirawl ah a cang pei maw?” a ti. Cutin a sut hai tikah puithiam pawl cun, “A cang lo ding,” an ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule Haggai in, “Thuṭhimnak ah mi pakhatkhat in miruak a tham ruangah mi borhhlawh ah a cang, ti sehla. A tlunlam ih kan relmi tirawl pawl hi tham sehla, tirawl borhhlawh ah an cang ve pei maw?” tiah a sut. Puithiam pawl in, “A cang ding,” an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Haggai cun, “ Bawipa in, mi borhhlawh pakhat in a thammi tirawl cu tirawl borhhlawh ih a can vekin hi ram minung pawl le an cinmi tirawl par khalah a si ve ding; curuangah biakṭheng parih an pekmi thil hmuahhmuah cu thil borhhlawh an si ṭheh, a ti,” tiah a sim."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Nan parih a thlengmi hi nan thei thiam lo maw? Biakinn nan sak sal hlan ahcun,","title":"Ih Thlawsuah Tiamnak"},"16":{"text":"nan lo rawl han kul ngah dingah nan zum naón han hra lawng nan ngah ṭheu. Ralca beel ihsin sabitti pung sawmnga ngah dingin nan ruat naón pung kul lawng nan ngah ṭheu."},"17":{"text":"Nan cinmi hmuahhmuah siatsuahtu dingah a nasa zetmi thli le rial ka thlah, a sinan nan sir aw duh cuang lo."},"18":{"text":"Tuihsun hi thla kua thla, ni kul hluanli ni a si ih Biakinn hrampi hnaṭuan an ṭheh ni a si. Atu thok ihsin thil a ra thleng dingmi ṭhatein zohhnik uh."},"19":{"text":"Fang a um nawn lo ih sabit rah le theipi rah le olif rah pawl an um hrih lo naón, atu thok ihsin thlawsuah ka lo pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cuih ni kul hluanli ni, thla kua thla ahcun Bawipa ih ṭong Haggai hnenah a voihnihnak a ra thleng.","title":"Zerubbabel Hnenih Ih Thukamnak"},"21":{"text":"Judah ram uktu bawi Zerubbabel hnenah hiti in ṭong ding a fial: “Reilote ah lei le van hi ka hnin ciamco ding ih,"},"22":{"text":"an ram uknak pawl ka hlonhlo sak ṭheh ding ih an cahnak pawl ka cemter ṭheh ding. Rangleng le a mawngtu pawl ka linglet ṭheh hai ding: rang pawl cu an thi ding ih a totu pawl pakhat le pakhat an that aw ding."},"23":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun nang ka hnaṭuantu Zerubbabel, ka hmin in ram uktu ah ka lo tuah ding. Hriak ka lo culhmi na si,” tiah a ti. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a ti."}}}}},"38":{"info":{"name":"Zekhariah","shortname":"Zek","abbr":[],"desc":"Zekhariah"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darias in Persia siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum hnihnak kum, thlariat thla ah, Iddo ih fasuan, Berekhiah ih fapa profet Zekhariah hnenah Bawipa ih thu cu hiti in a ra.","title":"Bawipa In A Minung Pawl A Ko"},"2":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in Zekhariah cu Israel mi hnenah hiti in sim dingin a fial. “Keimah, nan Bawipa cu nan pu le pa pawl parah ka thin a heng ngaingai;"},"3":{"text":"asinain atu-ah nan hnenah hiti in ka lo sim. Ka hnenah ra kir uhla nan hnenah ka kir ve ding."},"4":{"text":"Nan pu le nan pa bangtuk si hlah uh. Khuahlan laiah profet pawl in ka thu an sim hai ih sualnak tuah lo ding le thil ṭha lo tuah lo dingin an sim. Asinain ka thu an ngai duh lo, a thlun khal an thlun lo a si."},"5":{"text":"Cuih profet pawl le nan pupa pawl cu an nung nawn lo."},"6":{"text":"Ka sal profet pawl hmangin nan pupa pawl ka thu le ka thukham ka pek, a sinan zianghman ah an siar lo; curuangah harsatnak tampi an tong a si. Cule hremtlak an si ruangih hrem dingih a rak tumtu cu Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah ka si kha an run thei ih an sir-aw sal a si,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Darias in siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum hnihnak kum, thla hleikhat thla (Shebat thla), ni kul hluanli ni ah zan ah Bawipa in langnak in thu i sim.","title":"Profet In Langnak In Rang A Hmu."},"8":{"text":"Rang sen par a tomi Bawipa ih vancungmi pakhat, phairawn ih lenhmui kung lakah a cawl ih a dungah rang dang pawl an um: rang sen, rang ṭial le rang raang pawl tla an si."},"9":{"text":"“ Bawipa , hi rang pawl ih tican cu ziangso a si?” tiah ka sut. Vancungmi in, “Atican ka lo sim ding."},"10":{"text":"Leilung pumpi thleng thluh ding le zoh dingah Bawipa in a thlah a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Rang pawl cun, vancung mi hnenah, “Leilung tlun khuazakip ah kan thleng ṭheh zo ih leilung pumpi cu daitein le hnangamte in a um a si, ti kan hmu zo,” tiah an sim."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah vancungmi cun, “Cungnungbik Bawipa , Jerusalem le Judah khawpi dang pawl parah kum sawmsarih sung na thin a heng zo. An parih zaangfah thinpemnak na neih sal hlan, ziangtik tiangso hiti in an um hrih ding,” tiah an sut."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in vancungmi cu thinhnemnak ṭongkam in a sawn ih,"},"14":{"text":"cuih Cungnungbik Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu tlang-aupi ding ah vancungmi in i fial. “Ka khawpi thianghlim Jerusalem hrangah duhdawtnak le seherhnak tamzet ka nei."},"15":{"text":"Asinain thlangamnak le daihnak a ngahtu miphun pawl parah ka thin ka sup rero naón cuih miphun pawl in ka minung pawl tuarnak cu an luarter deuhdeuh."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah Jerusalem khawpi parih ka zaangfahnak langter dingah ka ra kir a si. Ka Biakinn cu saksaal a si ding ih Jerusalem khawpi cu dinsal a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Vancungmi in ka hnenah, “Cungnungbik Bawipa in ‘Ka khua pawl cu an ṭhangsozet sal ding ih Jerusalem khawpi cu ka bawm ding ih ka ta tiah ka ti sal ding,’ a ti. Cumi cu tlang-aupi hrih aw,” tiah i ti."},"18":{"text":"Langnak pakhat a um sal ih cawcang ki pali ka hmu.","title":"Profet In Ki Pawl A Hmuhnak"},"19":{"text":"Ka hnenih a ṭong rerotu vancungmi hnenah cun, “Hi ki pawl ih tican cu ziangso a si?” tiah ka sut. Anih in, “Judah mi, Israel mi le Jerusalem mi pawl khuazakip ih a ṭhekdarhtu miphun pawl can-ai an si,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in sobul thawn hnaṭuantu pali i hmuh."},"21":{"text":"“Himi pawl hi ziang tuah dingah so an rat?” tiah ka sut. Anih in, “Himi pawl cu Judah ram a ṭiotertu le a minung pawl a ṭhekdarh ṭhehtu miphun pawl ṭhihṭhaih ding le hlonhlo ṭheh dingah an ra a si,” tiah i sawn."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Langnak dang pakhat ah mi pakhat tahnak hri a kut ah kengin ka hmu.","title":"Tah-nak Hri Ka Hmu"},"2":{"text":"“Khui-ah so na feh ding?” tiah ka sut. Anih in, “Jerusalem khawpi hi ziangcan a sau ih ziangtluk a kau ti theih duh ah ka tah ding,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule ka hnenih a ṭong rerotu vancungmi cu hmaiah a ra suak ih a dang vancungmi pakhat in a rak hmuak khi ka hmu."},"4":{"text":"A hmaisa vancungmi in a neta hnen ahcun, “Va tlan awla, tahnak hri a kengtu tlangvalpa khi Jerusalem khawpi sungah minung le caw an tam ngaingai leh ding ih an tumtuk ah phar in kulh cawk a si lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in thu a kam zo ih Bawipa amah cu khawpi kimvel ah khawpi humtu meisa phar a si ding ih cu tawk ah a sunlawinak thawn a um ding a si, va ti aw,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl hnenah, “Keimah in leilung khuazakip ah ka lo ṭhekdarh ṭheh. Asinain atu cu Babilon ram in ra suak uhla, Jerusalem ah ra kir sal uh, nannih saltaang pawl!","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Nanmah a lo hremtu in a lo dai tikah keimah ih mitmu a dai a si,” a ti. Curuangah Cungnungbik Bawipa in keimah cu a minung pawl a ramtu miphun pawl hnen ah hi thu sim dingin i thlah."},"9":{"text":"“ Bawipa keimah rori in ka lo do ding ih nan sal a rak si dah mi pawl in an lo ram ve thlang ding,” tiah Bawipa in a ti. Cumi a kim tikah Cungnungbik Bawipa ih thlahmi ka si kha zokhal in an thei ding."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Maw Jerusalem mi pawl, lungawi in hlasa uh. Nan hnenih um dingah ka ra lai a si,” a ti.","title":"Saltaang Pawl An Ko Sal"},"11":{"text":"Cutikah cun miphun tampi Bawipa ih hnenah an ra ding ih amah ih minung ah an cang ding. Nan lakah a um ding ih nan hnen ih i thlahmi ka si kha nan thei ding."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah hi a ram thianghlim sungah hin Judah cu a hleice in amah ih ta an si ding ih Jerusalem cu khua dang hmuahhmuah hnak in a duh bikmi khawpi a si ding."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa ih umnak hmunah cun zokhal daitein um uh; ziangahtile a umnak hmun thianghlim ihsin a ra lai a si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Langnak dang pakhat ah Bawipa in Puithiam sang Joshua, Bawipa ih vancungmi hmai ih a din kha i hmuh. Joshua kiangah cun Joshua sualpuh dingah tiar cia in Satan a din kha ka hmu.","title":"Profet In Puithiam Sang A Hmu"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi in Satan hnen ahcun, “Satan, Bawipa in lo kawk seh! Jerusalem a duhtu Bawipa in nangmah cu lo hlon seh. Hi pa cu meisa sung ihsin zuukmi thingthu bangtuk a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Joshua cu hnipuan siava hruk in cutawk ah a ding."},"4":{"text":"Cuih vancungmi in amah kiltu vancungmi dang pawl hnen ah, “Hi pa ih a hrukmi hnipuan siava pawl cu phuak ṭheh uh,” a ti. Cule Joshua hnenah cun, “Na sualnak cu ka lak hlo ṭheh zo ih hruk ding hnipuan thar ka lo pek ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Amah kiltu pawl cu Joshua lu parah lupawng thar pawngter dingin thu a pek. A thu pekmi vekin an tuah, cule cutawk ih vancungmi a din laiah cun hnipuan thar an hrukter."},"6":{"text":"Cule vancungmi in Joshua hnen ah,"},"7":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa ih ṭongmi cu hiti in a sim; “Ka daan nan thlun ih nan hnenih ṭuanvo ka lo pekmi pawl nan tuah suak a si ahcun ka Biakinn le a kimvel pawl kilkhawitu nan si ringring ding ih ka mit hmuh ih a ummi vancungmi pawl ih thlacamnak ka theihsak vekin nan thlacamnak khal ka lo theihsak ding."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah nang Puithiam sang Joshua, ṭhatein ngai aw; nannih Joshua rualpi puithiam pawl, hmailam tikcu ṭha khihhmuhtu nannih pawl, ṭhatein ngai uh: Thingṭeek an timi keimah riantu cu nan hnenah ka langter ding!"},"9":{"text":"Joshua hmaiah hmai pasarih a neimi lungto pakhat ka ret ding. A parah ca ka ngan ding ih ni khat sungah hi ram ih sualnak cu ka lak hlo ṭheh ding."},"10":{"text":"Cuih ni a thlen tikah cun nan sabit hmuan le nan theipi hmuan sung ih umtlang huahho ding in nan inn-hnen pawl nan sawm fingfing ding a si,” tiah a ti. Guam."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hnen ih a ṭong rerotu vancungmi cu a ra sal ih a itthat mi ṭhang vekin i ra ṭhang.","title":"Profet In Mei-inn Tohnak A Hmu"},"2":{"text":"“Ziang so na hmuh?” tiah i sut. Kei in, “Sui in tuahmi mei-inn tohnak ka hmu. A tlun ah meiti retnak kheng a um. Mei-inn tohnak par ahcun mei-inn pasarih an um ih mei-inn pakhat in meica thulnak ong pasarih an nei fingfing."},"3":{"text":"Mei-inn tohnak kiangah olif thingkung pahnih, a sir veve ah an um ka hmu,” tiah ka ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule vancungmi cu, “Hi thil pawl ih sullam ziangso an si, bawipa?” tiah ka sut."},"5":{"text":"Amah in, “Sullam na thei lo maw?” i ti. Kei in, “Bawipa, ka thei lo,” tiah ka ti."},"6":{"text":"Vancungmi cun Cungnungbik Bawipa ih hnen ihsin a rami thu cu Zerubbabel sim dingin i fial. Bawipa in, “Hriamnam cahnak le na thazaang cahnak in si loin ka thlarau in na hlawhtling ding.","title":"Zerubbabel Hnenah Pathian Thukamnak"},"7":{"text":"Na hmaiah khamtu tlang tia a um hmanah an hlo ṭheh ding. Biakinn cu na din sal ding ih biakinn saknak a neta bik lungto na dawl tikah misenpi pawl cu, ‘A mawizet, a mawizet,’ tiah an au ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa ih thu cu ka hnenah a ra thleng sal ih,"},"9":{"text":"“Biakinn hram cu Zerubbabel in a dawl thok zo ih a saksuak ding. Cumi a kim ngaingai tikah ka minung pawl in an hnenah nangmah a lo thlahtu keimah ka si kha an thei ding."},"10":{"text":"An biakinn sak hnaṭuannak a sawt lo ti an theih tikah an thin a nauzet. Sikhalsehla Zerubbabel in Biakinn cu taimak zetin a sak rero ko ti kha an hmuh tikah an lung a awi ding,” tiah a ti. Vancungmi cun, “Mei-inn pasarih cu leilungtlun khuazakip a hmu ṭhehtu Bawipa ih mit pasarih tican a si,” tiah i ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule kei in, “Mei-inn tohnak sir ih a ummi olif thingkung pahnih ih tican ziangso a si?"},"12":{"text":"Olif hriak a rung luannak sui in tuahmi dawng pahnih kiangih olif thinghnge pahnih ih tican ziangso a si?” tiah ka sut lala."},"13":{"text":"Anih cun, “Atican na thei lo maw?” i ti. Kei in, “Bawipa, ka thei lo a si,” tiah ka ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutikah anih in, “Himi pawl cu leilung pumpuluk ih Bawi a si mi Pathian in a hrilmi le hriak a culhmi minung pahnih an si,” tiah i ti."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hun zoh sal ih thli lakah cazual a zam kha ka hmu.","title":"A Zammi Cazual Hmuhnak"},"2":{"text":"Vancungmi in, “Ziang so na hmuh?” tiah i sut. Kei in, “Thli lakah cazual a zammi ka hmu. Cuih cazual cu dong kul a sau ih dong hra a kau,” tiah ka ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah ka hnenah, “Hi cazual parah hin hi ram ih a thleng dingmi siatserhnak an ngan a si. Hmaikhat ah hi ram ihsin rukru hmuahhmuah hlonhlo an si ding tiah an ngan; khatlam ahcun siatcam in thuphan a permi hmuahhmuah tla hlonhlo an si ding tiah an ngan."},"4":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, cuih siatserhnak cu keimah in ka suahter ding ih rukru innsung le siatcam in thuphan a pertu innsung kipah a thleng ding, tiah a ti. Cuih siatserhnak cu an innsungah a caam ding ih cuih inn ih thing siseh lungto siseh a siatsuah ṭheh ding,” tiah i ti."},"5":{"text":"Vancungmi cu a ra lang sal ih, “Zohhnik, thildang pakhat a ra thleng ding!” tiah a ti.","title":"Bawm Sungah Nunau A Hmuhnak"},"6":{"text":"“Ziang so a si?” tiah ka sut. Anih in, “Bawm pakhat a si ih cuih bawm cu leilung pumpuluk ih sualnak can ai a si,” tiah i ti."},"7":{"text":"Cuih bawm cu sin a nei ih suan in tuahmi a si. Ka hmuhhngan ah a sin cu an ong ih a sungah cun nunau pakhat a rak to."},"8":{"text":"Vancungmi in, “Hi nunau cu ṭhatlonak ai-awhtu a si,” tiah a ti. Cule cu nu cu bawm sungah cun an nam cih ih a siin a vun sin."},"9":{"text":"Ka hun zoh ih nunau pahnih vaca thla vek ih a cakzet thla pawl thawn ka lam ih an ra zam kha ka hmu. Bawm cu an cawi ih an zampi hlo."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah vancungmi cu, “Khuiah so an fehpi ding?” tiah ka sut."},"11":{"text":"Anih in, “Babilon ah an fehpi ding ih cutawkah a hrangah biakinn an sak sak ding. Cuih biakinn an sak ṭheh tikah bawm cu biak dingah cutawkah an ret ding,” tiah i sim. Guam."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Langnak a dang pakhat ka hmu ih tlang pahnih karlak ihsin rangleng pali an ra suah kha ka hmu. Cuih tlang pahnih cu dar tlang an si.","title":"Rang Leng Pali Hmuhnak"},"2":{"text":"Pakhatnak rangleng cu rang sen in an hnuk, pahnihnak cu rang dum in an hnuk,"},"3":{"text":"pathumnak cu rang raang in an hnuk ih palinak cu rang ṭial in an hnuk."},"4":{"text":"Cule vancungmi cu, “Bawipa, hi rangleng pawl ih tican ziangso a si?” tiah ka sut."},"5":{"text":"Anih in, “Hi pawl cu thli pali an si. Leilung pumpuluk ih Bawipa hnen ihsin atu pekte a rami an si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Rang dum pawl ih hnuhmi rangleng cu saklam ah a feh, rang raang pawl ih hnuhmi cu nitlaknak lam ah a feh, rang ṭial pawl ih hnuhmi cu thlanglam ram ah a feh."},"7":{"text":"Rang pawl an ra suah tikah leilung pumpi va zoh ding kha an hngakhlap zet. Vancungmi cun, “Feh uhla, leilung cu va zoh uh!” a ti; a ti vek cun an va zoh."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah vancung mi cun “Saklam ram lam ih a fehtu rang pawl in Bawipa ih thinhengnak an daiter zo a si,” tiah in run auh."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih ṭongkam cu ka hnenah hiti in a ra thleng ih,","title":"Joshua Suilukhuh Khumter Ding"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa cun, “Saltaannak ihsin a ra kirmi Heldai, Tobijah le Jedaiah pawl ih laksawng cu la awla Zefaniah ih fapa Josiah inn ah zamrang in feh aw."},"11":{"text":"Anmah pawl ih laksawng pekmi sui le ngun in sui lukhuh tuah awla Jehozadak ih fapa Puithiam Sang Joshua khumter aw."},"12":{"text":"A hnenah, Cungnungbik Bawipa in, ‘Thingṭeek ti ih kawhmi cu atu a umnak ah a ṭhangso ding ih Bawipa ih Biakinn amah in a sak sal ding."},"13":{"text":"Biakinn a sak saaltu cu amah a si ding ih siangpahrang tlukin hminthannak a ngah ding ih a minung pawl amah in a uk ding. Puithiam pakhat a bawi tokham kiangah a ding ding ih, daihnak le remnak thawn hmunkhat ah hna an ṭuan tlang ding, a ti,’ tiah ti aw."},"14":{"text":"Cuih suilukhuh cu Bawipa ih Biakinn sungah a um ding ih Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah le Josiah pawl theih ringringnak a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Lamhlapi ih a ummi pawl khal an ra ding ih Bawipa ih Biakinn cu an ra sak bawm ding. Cutiih an sak tikah Cungnungbik Bawipa , in nan hnenah keimah i thlah hi nan thei ding. Bawipa , nan Pathian thupekmi nan thlunkim a si ahcun a tlunlam thil hmuahhmuah hi a kim ṭheh ding a si."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darias in siangpahrang a ṭuannak kum linak kum, thlakua thla (Kislev thla), ni li ni ah Bawipa ih thu cu ka hnenah a ra thleng.","title":"Thinlung Taklo Rawl Ulhnak"},"2":{"text":"Bethel khua mi pawl in Sharezer le Regemmelek cu an milai pawl thawn Cungnungbik Bawipa ih Biakinn ah Bawipa ih thlawsuahnak dil dingah le,"},"3":{"text":"puithiam pawl le profet pawl thusuh dingah an thlah. An thusuh mi cu, “Biakinnpi siatsuah ṭheh a si ruangah kum tampi sung kan rak tuah zo vekin thla nga thla ah rawl ul in riahsia le lungngai in kan um hrih pei maw?” ti a si."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa thu cu ka hnenah a ra thleng ih,"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Hi ram minung le puithiam pawl hi sim aw: kumpi kum sawm sarih sung, thla nga thla le thla sarih thla ah rawl an ul ih riahsia le lungngai in an um hi keimah in upat ruangah a si lo."},"6":{"text":"Ti le rawl an in an ei tik khal ah anmah ih diriamnak lawnglawng ah a si,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem cu ṭhangso le neinungzet in a rak um ih minung tampi an rak um lai caanah le hi khawpi kiangkap khua tla ah mi tampi an rak um lawng si loin thlanglam ramah le nitlaknak lam tlanghram tla ih mi tampi an rak um lai caanah hi bangtuk in Bawipa in khuahlan profet pawl hmangin a rak sim zomi a si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in hi thu cu Zekhariah hnenah a sim:","title":"Ih Thu An Thlun Lo Ruangah An ṭekdarh"},"9":{"text":"“Khuahlan ah hi thukham pawl cu ka minung hnenah ka rak pek: Dingte in thu nan rel pei ih pakhat le pakhat parah zaangfahnak le lainatnak nan nei pei."},"10":{"text":"Nuhmei pawl le farah pawl, nan lakih a ummi ramdangmi pawl le a hlawhsammi pawl nan namsuk lo pei. Cule pakhat le pakhat siatsuah awk nan tum lo pei, ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka minung pawl cu mi thinlungruh pawl an si; ka thupekmi thlun duh loin an dunglam in hoisan; an hna an phit ih zianghman an ngai duh lo;"},"12":{"text":"an thinlung cu lungto vekin a hak a si. Kum reipi laiih ka thlarau thawn ka rak thlahmi profet pawl sungin thu ka zirhmi pawl an ngai duh lo ruangah an parah ka thin a heng ngaingai."},"13":{"text":"Thu ka sim tikih an ngai duh lo ruangah annih khal thla an cam tikah ka ngai duh ve lo."},"14":{"text":"Thlisia bangin ka semhlo hai ih an theih dah lonak ram dangdang ah ka ṭhekdarh ṭheh. Hi tluk ram ṭha cu a sungah zohman um loin ramṭhing ah a cang a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa ih thu cu Zekhariah hnenah hiti in a ra thleng:","title":"Jerusalem Din Sal Dingah Thukamnak"},"2":{"text":"“Jerusalem mi pawl ka duhdawtnak cu a thuk ih Jerusalem khawpi bawm ding cu ka caakzet; ka thiik ruangah a ral pawl parah ka thin a heng a si."},"3":{"text":"Ka ra kir sal ding ih ka khawpi thianghlim Jerusalem ah ka ra um ding. Rintlak khawpi tiin theih a si ding ih Cungnungbik Bawipa ih tlang cu tlang thianghlim tiin kawh a si ding."},"4":{"text":"Kianghrol hrol in a fehtu nutar le patar pawl khal khawpi sung mi zapi ton awknak hmunah an to huahho sal ding."},"5":{"text":"Khawpi lamzin tluanah nauhak tualleng pawl cu nunau siseh mipa siseh lungawi aipuang in an lek ciamco sal ding."},"6":{"text":"“Cutiih ka timi cu hi miphun sung ihsin a taangmi pawl hrangah cun thil cang thei lo a bang ding, sihmansehla ka hrangah cun thil cang thei lo a si lo."},"7":{"text":"Ka minung pawl an hruaihlonak ram pawl ah ka hum ding ih"},"8":{"text":"nisuahnak lam le nitlaknak lam ihsin ka hruai kir sal ding ih Jerusalem ah an um sal ding. Annih cu ka minung an si ding ih keimah cu an Pathian ka si ding; rintlakzet le dingzet in ka uk ding."},"9":{"text":"Ralṭhatnak nei uh! Biakinn dinsal dingah a hram an rak thok lai ih profet pawl in an rak simmi ṭongkam cu atu-ah nan thei sal a si."},"10":{"text":"Cuih hlanah cun zohman in minung siseh, ṭilva siseh hnaṭuan dingah an lak thei lo, an sang thei lo; ral an nei ih humhimnak an um hrimhrim lo. Mi pakhat le pakhat ral aw dingin keimah in ka tokhrok."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu-ah cun hi ramsung ih a taangsun mi pawl ka zohnak cu a phundang a si."},"12":{"text":"Hnangam in an thlaici an tuh thei thlang ding. An sabit hri in rah an rah ding, leilung in rawl a suah ding ih ruah tampi in a sur ding a si. Ka miphun sung ihsin a taangsun mi pawl parah hi bangtuk thlawsuahnak ka pek ding."},"13":{"text":"Judah mi le Israel mi pawl! Tuih hlanah cun ramdangmi pawl pakhat le pakhat an cam awk tikah ‘Judah le Israel pawl parih a thlengmi siatralnak hi na parah thleng ve seh,’ an ti aw. Sikhalsehla keimah in ka lo runsuak ding ih cu tikah ramdangmi pawl cun ‘Judah le Israel mi pawl ih comi thlawsuahnak co ve hram aw,’ tiah pakhat le pakhat an ti aw ding. Curuangah nan ral ṭha uhla zianghman ṭih hlah uh,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Nan pu le nan pa pawl in ka thin in hengter tikah anmah siatralnak cu ka tum ih zianghman thinlung thlengnak um loin ka tum vek cun ka tuah suak a si."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu-ah cun Jerusalem le Judah mi pawl thlawsuah dingah ka tum a si. Curuangah phannak zianghman nei hlah uh!"},"16":{"text":"Hitiin tuah sawn uh: Pakhat le pakhat nan biak awk tikah thudik sim uh. Thuṭhennak hmunah thudik suakter uh; daihnak le remnak suaktertu thudik cu!"},"17":{"text":"Midang siatnak ding thu ngaihtuah hlah uh. A dik lomi tetti in siatcam hlah uh. Thuphan pernak, dinglonak le thazaang thawn midang siatnak tuah cu ka hua a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa ih thu cu Zekhariah hnenah hiti in a ra thleng:"},"19":{"text":"“Thla linak, thla nganak, thla sarihnak le thla hranak ih tuah ṭheumi rawl ulhnak cu Judah mi pawl hrangah lungawi aipuannak puai ah a cang thlang ding. Thudik le daihnak cu nan duh pei,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Khua tampi ihsin mi tampi Jerusalem ih an ratnak tikcu a ra thleng zik thlang."},"21":{"text":"Khawpi pakhat ihsin a rami pawl in khawpi dang ihsin a rami pawl hnenah, ‘Cungnungbik Bawipa kan biak ding ih a thlawsuahnak kan dil ding. Kan hnenah ra tel ve uh,’ an ti ding."},"22":{"text":"Minung tamzet le miphun cakzetzet pawl Jerusalem ah an ra ding ih Cungnungbik Bawipa an ra biak ding, a thlawsuahnak dil in thla an cam ding."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Judah mi pakhat hnenah ramdangmi pahra an ra ding ih, ‘Na nun khawsaknak ah um ve le tel ve kan duh, ziangahtile Pathian cu na hnenah a um, ti kan thei zo,’ an ti ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Himi cu Bawipa ih ṭongkam a si: Hadrak ram le Damaskas khawpi hrem dingah amah in a ruat cat zo. Israel miphun pawl lawng si loin Siria ram khawpi khal Bawipa ih ta a si.","title":"Kiangkap Miphun Parih Thuṭhennak"},"2":{"text":"Hadrak ramri ih a ummi Hamath khua tla amah ih ta a si ih cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in ṭai-ar khua le Sidon khua pawl tla an thilthiamnak thawn Bawipa ih ta an si ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Ṭai-ar khua cun amah ih hrangah ralhruang nasa zetin a tuah ciamco ih tlunah sui le ngun tamzet a khawl ih a tamtuk ah hnawmhne bangtuk ah a cang."},"4":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa cun ṭai-ar khua ih a neihmi hmuahhmuah cu a laksak ṭheh ding. A lennak hmuahhmuah cu tifinriat sungah a hlonsak ding ih a cuih khua cu meisa in ur ziam a si ding."},"5":{"text":"Cumi cu Ashkelon khua in a hmu ding ih a phang ding. Gaza khal in a hmu ding ih a tuarzet ding. Cuvek thotho in Ekron khua khal in a hmu ding ih ruahsannak a neihmi hmuahhmuah a hloral ṭheh ding. Gaza siangpahrang khal a hloral ding ih Ashkelon cu a ṭhing reprep ding."},"6":{"text":"Ashdod khua ah miphun za-rawi an um ding. Bawipa in “Hi a puarthau zetmi Filistin mi pawl cu nau ko in ka ṭhum ding."},"7":{"text":"Thisen thawn sa cu an ei nawn lo ding; khammi rawl khal an ei nawn lo ding. A taangsun pawl cu ka miphun ah an tel ve ding ih Judah phun sungah phunkhat vek an si ding. Jebus mi pawl bangtuk in Ekron khal ka miphun ah a cang ding."},"8":{"text":"Ka ram cu ka kilveng dingih a sungin zo ralkap pawl hman an feh thei lo ding. Zaangfah neilo ram uktu zohman in ka miphun an hrem nawn lo ding. Ka minung pawl ih tuarzia ka hmu ṭheh zo,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Nan lungawi uh, Zion mi pawl, nan lungawi uh! Lungawi in au ciamco uh, Jerusalem mi pawl! Zoh uh, nan siangpahrang a ra lai! Nehtu a si ih nehnak thawn a ra; Asinain lungnemmi a si ih laak parin a ra; Laak note, laakpi ih faate to in a ra a si.","title":"A Ra dingmi Siangpahrang"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Israel ram ihsin raldonak rangleng ka hlon ding; Jerusalem ihsin raldonak rang pawl ka lak sak ding ih, Raldonak likhuk pawl cu ka siatsuah ṭheh ding. Nan siangpahrang in mi phunkip pawl thawn daihnak le remnak a tuah ding. Khatlam tifinriat in khatlam tifinriat tiang a uk ding. Eufrates tivapi ihsin vanrang deng tiang a uk ding,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Raithawinak thisen thawn hngettermi nan hnen ih ka thukamnak vekin, Nan minung pawl cu ka luatter ding; Saltaannak tidai um lo khur sung ihsin ka luatter ding a si.","title":"Pathian Ih Minung Pawl Kirsalnak"},"12":{"text":"Kir sal uh, ruahsannak neitu saltaang pawl! Himnak hmun nan ram ah tlung uh; Atu-ah ka lo sim: harnak nan tuarmi ruangah a let hnih in thlawsuahnak ka lo pe ding."},"13":{"text":"Judah cu ralkap ih li vekin ka hmang ding, Israel cu conkiang vekin ka hmang ding, Zion mi pawl cu ralnam vekin ka hmang ding, Grik mi pawl do dingah,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa cu a minung pawl tlunah a lang ding, A thal pawl nimthlakau vekin a sai ding. Cungnungbik Bawipa in a tawtawrawt a tum ding; Thlanglam thlipi sungin a feh ding."},"15":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in a minung pawl a hum ding. An ral pawl an siatsuah ṭheh ding, Lungherh deengtu pawl an palcih ding; Raldonak ah zuri bangin an au ciamco ding ih, An ral pawl ih thisen an suahter ding. Cuih thisen cu biakṭheng ih a ummi kheng sung ihsin an thletmi thawinak thisen vekin a luang ding."},"16":{"text":"Cuih ni a kim tikah tuukhal in a tuurual ṭihphannak sungin a hum vekin, Bawipa in a minung pawl a hum ding; Suilukhuh parih lungvar vekin, A ram sungah cun an tleu ding."},"17":{"text":"Ziangtluk ram ṭha le ram mawi so a si ding! Vainim in tlangval a cakter dingih, Sabit in fala tla a cakter hai ding."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa ih hnenah thlatir ah ṭoruah dil uh. Khawdur a tuahtu le ruah a surtertu cu amah a si. Mi hmuahhmuah ih loram a hringtertu khal Bawipa a si.","title":"In Luatnak Thu A Kam"},"2":{"text":"Minung in milem le pol hnenah thu an ron, a sinan an simmi cu thulolak le thuphan lawng a si. Mi hrekkhat in mang an let, asinain a peengah an lo hruai; thinhnemnak ṭong an ṭongmi cu ṭhathnemnak zianghman a nei lo. Curuangah mipi pawl cu a hlomi tuu vekin an vakvai. Hotu an neih lo ruangah harsatnak an tong a si."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa in hiti in a ti. “Ka minung pawl a uktu parah ka thin a heng. Curuangah ka hrem hai ding. Judah mi pawl cu keimah ih ta an si ih Cungnungbik Bawipa keimah in ka kilkhawi ding. Anmah cu ka uarzetmi le a cakzetmi ka raldonak rang an si ding."},"4":{"text":"Anmah sung ihsin mi uktu pawl, mi hruaitu pawl le ralbawi pawl an suak ding ih ka minung pawl an uk ding."},"5":{"text":"Lamzin ciarbek lakih an ral a palcil rerotu ralkap pawl vekin Judah mi pawl cu nehtu an si ding. Bawipa an hnenih a um ruangah ral an do ding ih an ral sungih rangralkap pawl hman an neh ding."},"6":{"text":"“Judah mi pawl cu mi cakzet ah ka tuah ding; Israel mi pawl ka runsuak ding. An parah lainatnak ka nei ding, An zate in an khua le an ram ah ka hruai kir ding. Ka hnon dah lomi vekah ruah an si ding. Keimah hi Bawipa an Pathian ka si, An thlacamnak ka theihsak ding."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi pawl cu raldo thiam vekin an cak ding ih, Sabitti in bangtuk in an lung a nuam ding. An tesinfa pawl in hi nehnak cu an cing ding ih, Bawipa ih thiltuahmi ruangah an lung a awi ding."},"8":{"text":"“Ka minung pawl ka ko ding ih Hmunkhat ah ka finkhawm ding. Ka run hai dingih a hlan vekin mi tamzet ah an cang sal ding."},"9":{"text":"Miphun dang lakah ka ṭhekdarh zo hai naón, Ram hlazet khal in keimah in thei ding. Anmah le an faate pawl an nung suak ding ih, An khua le an ram ah an kir tlang ding."},"10":{"text":"Izip ram le Assiria ram ihsin ka hruai kir ding ih, Anmah ih ram sungah hmun ka khuar sak ding. Gilead le Lebanon ram khal ah ka umter ding; Ram pumpuluk ah minung an khat ding."},"11":{"text":"Harsatnak tifinriat an tan tikah, Bawipa keimah in tilet cu ka vuak ding ih, Nail tiva thuk cu a kang ṭheh ding, A puarthaumi Assiria ningzak in a um ding ih, A maksakmi Izip huham a nei nawn lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Ka minung pawl Bawipa ah ka cakter ding; Ka hmin in lamzin an feh ding,” a ti. Bawipa in a sim zo."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Lebanon, na sangka pawl ong aw, Na sidar thingkung pawl meisa in kaang ṭhehseh.","title":"Uktu ṭha Lo Pawl An Siat"},"2":{"text":"Tu farthing pawl, ṭap ai rero uh, Sidar kung pawl an tlu ṭheh zo; Thing sunglawi pawl siatsuah an si ṭheh zo. Bashan ram ih ṭhil thing pawl ṭap in ai rero ko uh. A ruul zetmi tupi cu hau ṭheh a si zo!"},"3":{"text":"Uktu pawl riahsia in an ṭap an rak; An sunlawinak a cem zo. Kiosa pawl an huuk rero, ngaihnik uh! Jordan tivakap ih an inn a si mi tupi cu siatsuah ṭheh a si zo."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ka Pathian in ka hnenah, “Thah ding a si mi tuu pawl a khaaltu ih nuncan kha cawng hnik.","title":"Tuukhal Pahnih"},"5":{"text":"A neitu pawl in tuu an that, asinain annih cu zohman in an mawhthluk hai lo. Tuusa zuar tahrat in, ‘ Bawipa cu thangṭhat si ko seh! Kan lian zo a si,’ an ti. Tuukhal pawl hman in an tuu pawl parah zaangfahnak an nei lo,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Leilung tlun ah zohman ka zaangfah nawn lo ding. Keimah rori in mi hmuahhmuah cu an uktu pawl ih kutsung ah ka thunlut thluh ding. Cuih uktu pawl in leilung cu an tisiat ṭheh ding, asinain an thilti theinak huham sungin zohman ka run lo ding,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Tuu a leitu pawl le a zuartu pawl in an hnaṭuantu dingah kei cu in lak ih thah ding a si mi tuu pawl khaaltu ah ka cang. Funghreu pahnih ka lak: pakhat cu, “Zaangfahnak,” ka ti ih a dang pakhat cu “Komawknak,” ka ti. Cuti cun tuurual cu ka kilkhawi."},"8":{"text":"Keimah i huatu tuukhal pathum parah cun ka thin a sau thei nawn lo, ka zawi thei nawn lo ih thla khat sungah an pathum in ka dawi hlo a si."},"9":{"text":"Cule tuurual hnenah cun, “A lo khaaltu ka si nawn lo ding. A thi ding cu thi ko hai seh, siatsuah ding cu siatsuah si ko seh. A taangmi cu pakhat le pakhat an sa ei-aw thluh ko hai seh,” ka ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun, “Zaangfahnak,” timi funghreu cu ka lak ih, Bawipa in miphun hmuahhmuah thawn a tuahmi thukamnak bal ṭheh dingah ka khiak."},"11":{"text":"Cutiin cuih ni ah thukamnak rak tuahcia mi cu bal ṭheh a si. Tuu a leitu le a zuartu pawl cun in zohhliah ringring; ka thil tuah mi hi Bawipa ih simmi a si, ti kha an thei."},"12":{"text":"An hnenah “Nan lung a kim ahcun ka nihlawh i pe uh. A kim lo ahcun a poi lo, nanmah in nei ko uh,” tiah ka ti. Curuangah ka nihlawh ah ngun tangka sawmthum in pek."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Hi tangka cu Biakinn tangka ah re aw,” i ti. Curuangah ngun tangka sawmthum, ka man ih an ruahmi tangka sunglawizet cu, ka lak ih Biakinn tangka retnak ah ka ret."},"14":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a pahnihnak funghreu “Komawknak,” timi cu ka khiak lala; cutiin Judah le Israel kom awknak cu ka phiat a si."},"15":{"text":"Cule Bawipa in ka hnenah, “Tuih ṭum cu zianghman ih santlai lo tuukhal pa ih nuncan cawng aw."},"16":{"text":"Ka tuurual kiltu dingah tuukhal pakhat ka ret; a sinan hlohralnak tongzikmi tuu pawl a hum duh lo; a hlomi tuu khal a hawl lo; hma a neimi tuu khal a tuamhlawm lo ih a harhdammi a taangsun tuu pawl tla rawl a pek lo. A thau bikmi tuusa a ei ih an ketin pawl tiangin a hawk ṭheh sawn a si."},"17":{"text":"Cuih tuukhal pa cu a lamzin a pit ih a cem a si! A tuu pawl a tlansan zo. A cahnak hmuahhmuah ral in an siatsuah ṭheh ding. A baan a ro a car ding ih a vorhlam mit a caw ding,” a ti."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel thuhla cu Bawipa ih hnen ihsin hiti in a ra thleng. Van tla khi a pharhtu Bawipa , leilung a seemsuah ih minung nunnak thlarau a petu Bawipa cun hiti in a sim:","title":"Jerusalem A Luat Ding"},"2":{"text":"“Jerusalem cu khuat pakhat sungih sabitti vekah ka tuah ding; a kiangkap in miphun pawl cun an in ding ih zuri bangin an sawn ding. Cule Jerusalem an kulh tikah Judah ram khua dangdang tla an kulh thluh ve ding."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cuih tikcu a thlen tikah Jerusalem cu a rit zetmi lungto ah ka tuah ding ih cawi a tumtu miphun cu tuahmawhnak a tong ding. Leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah cu Jerusalem do dingah an ṭangkhawm ding."},"4":{"text":"Cuih tikcu ah an rang pawl cu an thin ka phangter ding ih rang parih a totu hmuahhmuah an thinlung ka aa-ter ṭheh ding. Judah mi pawl cu ka kilkhawi ding, a sinan an ral pawl ih rang mit cu ka cawtter ṭheh ding."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah Judah hrin pawl cun, “ Bawipa Cungnungbik Pathian in Jerusalem ih a ummi a minung pawl hnenah thazaang a pek a si,” tiah pakhat le pakhat an sim aw ding."},"6":{"text":"“Cutikah Judah hrin pawl cu hramlak meisa tom bangtuk, a si lole vainim lo ih vainimkau kaang parih beel bangtuk ah ka tuah ding an kiangkap ih miphun hmuahhmuah an siatsuah thluh ding. Jerusalem khua mi pawl cu khawpi sungah an him ko ding."},"7":{"text":"“David tesinfa pawl le Jerusalem mi pawl ih ngah dingmi hminthannak kha Judah mi pawl ih ngah dingmi hnakin a thupit sawn lonak dingah hmaisabik ah Judah ralkap pawl hnenah Bawipa keimah in nehnak ka pek ding."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah Jerusalem ih a ummi pawl cu Bawipa in a hum ding ih anmah lakih mi ṭawnṭai bik hman David tlukin a cak ding. David tesinfa pawl cun Bawipa ih vancungmi vekin lam an hruai ding; amah Pathian vek rero an si ding."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah cun Jerusalem a dotu miphun hmuahhmuah cu ka siatsuah ṭheh ding."},"10":{"text":"“David tesinfa pawl le Jerusalem khua ih midang pawl cu zaangfah lainatnak thinlung le thlacam duhnak thinlung thawn ka khahter ding. Mi pakhat an sun ciami kha an zoh ding ih an fa neihsun a thih ih an ṭah vekin an ṭah ding. An fapatir a thih ih ninghang le lungngai ih an um vekin an um ding."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah cun Jerusalem khawsungih ṭahnak cu Megiddo phairawn ah Hadad-rimmon hrangih ṭahnak vekin a nasa ding a si."},"12":{"text":"Hi ram innsang tinah mahte ciar lungngai in an um ding. David tefa sin innsang pawl, Nathan tesinfa innsang pawl, Levi tesinfa innsang pawl, Shimei tesinfa innsang pawl le innsang dang pawl tla cuticun an um ding. An innsang ciarah lungngai in an um ding ih mipa le nunau cu hmun dangdang ah lungngai in an um ding,” a ti. Guam.","merge":"13"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Cu tikcu a thlen tikah David tesinfa pawl le Jerusalem mi pawl an sualnak le an milem biaknak ihsin thianfaiter dingah cerhti pakhat a put ding."},"2":{"text":"Cutikah cun hi ram milem pawl ih hmin cu ka phiathlo ṭheh ding ih zohman in an cing nawn lo ding. Profet ka si a titu hmuahhmuah cu ka hlonhlo ṭheh ding ih milem biak duhnak thinlung khal ka lak hlo ṭheh ding."},"3":{"text":"Cule mi pakhatkhat in profet ṭong ih ṭong a tum thotho a si ahcun, a nu le a pa in, ‘ Bawipa ih hmin in thuphan na per ruangah na thi ding,’ tiah an ti ding. Cutin profet ṭong ih a ṭong tikah cun amah ih nu le pa in an sunthat ding a si."},"4":{"text":"Cubangtuk tikcu a thlen tikah cun zovek profet hman langnak pakhatkhat a hmuh ruangah a uar aw lo ding, profet nun tla a cawng lo ding ih misenpi bumnak dingah profet pawl ih hruk ṭheumi, a hraam zetmi korfualpi tla a hruk lo ding."},"5":{"text":"Cuhnak in anih cun ‘Kei cu profet ka si lo. Lothlo ka si; ka nunsung hmuahhmuah lothlo ka si ringring ko,’ a ti sawn ding."},"6":{"text":"Cule mi pakhatkhat in ‘Na ṭaang ih tuahmawhnak hma pawl kha ziangruangah so a si?’ tiih a sut tikah ‘Ka rualpi inn ih ka ton pang mi an si,’ tiah a ti ding,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cungnungbik Bawipa in, “Maw, ralnam, tho awla ka hrangih hnaṭuantu tuukhal khi sat aw! That awla tuu pawl cu khuazakip ah ṭeekdarh ṭheh hai seh. Mi tenau pawl cu keimah in ka siatsuah ko hai ding;","title":"Pathian Ih Tuukhal Pawl Thah Ding"},"8":{"text":"cule hi ram sung milai pawl ṭhen thum ih ṭhen hnih cu an thi ding. Ṭhen thum ih ṭhen khat lawng an luat ding."},"9":{"text":"Cule a taangmi ṭhen thum ih ṭhen khat cu ka hniksak ding ih ngun cu meisa in a thianfaiter bangin ka thianfaiter ding. Sui cu hniksak a si vekin ka hniksak ding. Cule ka hnenah thla an cam ding ih ka theihsak ding. Ka minung an si kha ka sim ding ih keimah khal an Pathian ka si hi an phuang ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa in thu a ṭhennak ding ni cu a nai zo. Cule Jerusalem khua an ram ding ih an lonmi thilri pawl cu na mithmuh ah an zem ding.","title":"Jerusalem Le Miphun Dang Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in miphun hmuahhmuah Jerusalem do dingah a ko khawm ding. Khawpi cu an lak ding, inn thilri pawl an long ding ih nunau pawl an kaihrem ding. Minung a hrek cu sal ah an kai ding, a sinan a dang pawl cu khawpi ihsin khui hmanah an hruaihlo lo ding."},"3":{"text":"Cule Bawipa cu a vung feh ding ih cuih miphun pawl cu, khuahlan laiih a rak do vekin, a do ding."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Jerusalem ihsin nisuahnak lam Olif Tlang parah Bawipa cu a ding ding. Cule Olif Tlang cu nisuahnak lam ihsin nitlaknak lam ih a fehmi phairawn kaupi in ṭhen hnih ah a ṭhen ding. Tlang ih hrek cu saklam ah a ṭhawn ding ih a dang hrek cu thlanglam ah a ṭhawn ding."},"5":{"text":"Olif Tlang ṭhen hnih ih a ṭhentu cuih phairawn ihsin nan tlansuak ding. Judah siangpahrang Uzziah san laiah ling a rak hnin ih nan pu le nan pa pawl an rak tlansuak vekin nan tlan ve ding. Bawipa ka Pathian cu a ra ding ih a mithiang hmuahhmuah a rak hruai ding."},"6":{"text":"Cuih caan a thlen tikah khawsik le vurtlak ti a um lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Khawthim tikhal a um nawn lo ding. Zan hmanah sun khawvang lawng a um ding. Ziangtikah cuvek in a si ding, ti cu Bawipa lawng in a thei."},"8":{"text":"Cuih ni a thlen tikah cun Jerusalem ihsin nunnak tidai a luang ding; tidai hrek cu Tipi Thi ah a luang dingih a hrek cu Mediterranean tifinriat ah a luang ding. Ṭhal tilo, fur tilo kum letsuak in a luang ringring ding."},"9":{"text":"Cule Bawipa cu leilung pumpuluk ih siangpahrang a si ding. Mi hmuahhmuah in Pathian tiah an biak ding ih amah ih hmin keel in an thei ding."},"10":{"text":"Hi leiram cu a zatein saklam ah Geba ihsin thlanglam ah Rimmon tiang hmun rawn ah tuah ṭheh a si ding. Jerusalem cu a kiangkap ram hnakin a sang cuang ding. Hi khawpi cu Benjamin kotka ihsin hlanlai ih kotka an rak umnak Akil Kotka timi tiang a kau ding; cule Hananel innsang ihsin siangpahrang sabit rialnak hmun tiang a si ding."},"11":{"text":"Cutawkah mipi pawl cu humhimnak le thlangamnak thawn an um ding ih siatsuahnak zianghman an phang lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa in Jerusalem a dotu miphun pawl parah tuksumza natnak a thlengter ding. An nung cungin an taksa a ṭawt ding; an mit le an lei pawl tla an ṭawt ṭheh ding."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in an thin phangter in an lung a buaiter ding ih mi hmuahhmuah in an kiangih a ummi milai pohpoh kai tahrat in pakhat le pakhat an thawi aw ciamco ding."},"14":{"text":"Judah mi pawl in Jerusalem an ṭan ding ih ral an do ding. Miphun tampi ih thilri le lennak cu an long ding: sui, ngun le hnipuan ticawk loin an lak ding."},"15":{"text":"An ral pawl riahhmun ih a ummi ṭilva hmuahhmuah: rang pawl, laak pawl, kalauk pawl le laak faate pawl par khalah tuksumza natnak a thleng ve ding."},"16":{"text":"Cule Jerusalem a dotu miphun pawl sungin a taangsun pawl cu Ziangkimtithei Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si tiih biak dingah le Puanthlam Puai tuah dingah kumtinte Jerusalem khua ah an feh ding."},"17":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si tiah biak ding a eltu le a feh duh lotu leilung tlunih miphun pakhatkhat an um ahcun an ramah ruah a sur lo ding."},"18":{"text":"Izip mi pawl in Puanthlam Puai an tuah duh lo ih an feh duh lo a si ahcun Jerusalem feh a eltu le Pathian a bia duh lotu pawl parih tuksumza natnak Bawipa ih a thlentermi cu an parah a thleng ve ding."},"19":{"text":"Izip mi siseh, miphun dang siseh, Puanthlam Puai an tuah duh lo a si ahcun cubangtuk hremnak cu an parah a thleng ding."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah cun rangleng hnuktu rang pawl parih thlaih mi darkhingte par hmanah “ Bawipa ih ta, a thianghlimmi a si,” tiah ngan ṭheh a si ding. Biakinn sungih rawl suannak beel pawl cu biakṭheng hmai ih kheng pawl vekin bungbeel thiang an si ding."},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem le Judah ram pumpi sungih a ummi beel pohpoh cu Ziangkimtithei Bawipa biaknak hrangah a dangte in ret an si ding. Cuih beel cu thawinak a petu pawl in an pekmi thawinak sa suannak ah an hmang ding. Cuih ni a thlen tikah Ziangkimtithei Bawipa ih Biakinn sungah thil zuartu le thil leitu pakhat hman an um nawn lo ding a si."}}}}},"39":{"info":{"name":"Malakhi","shortname":"Mal","abbr":[],"desc":"Malakhi"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi pawl sim dingah Bawipa in a thuailam thu cu Malakhi hnenah a thlenter."},"2":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl hnenah, “Nannih cu ka lo duhdawt ringring a si,” a ti. Asinain annih in, “In duhdawtnak cu ziangvek in so na langter?” tiah an ti. Cutikah Bawipa in, “Esau le Jakob cu unau an si, asinain Jakob le a tesinfa pawl ka duhdawt ih,","title":"In Israel A Duhdawt"},"3":{"text":"Esau le a tesinfa pawl cu ka hua. Esau ih tlangpar ram ka siatsuah ṭheh ih a leilung cu hramlak cinghnia hrangah ka taan a si,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Esau tesinfa Edom mi pawl in, “Kan khawpi pawl cu siatsuah ṭheh an si zo naón kan din sal pei,” an ti ahcun Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in, “An duh ahcun din sal ko hai seh; ka bal ṭheh sal thotho ding. Mi in ‘Ram sualral,’ ti in le ‘ Bawipa ih thinhengnak kumkhua in a tongtu miphun,’ tiah an ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cumi cu anmah Israel mi an mit rori in an hmu ding ih, “ Bawipa cu Israel ram sung lawngah si loin a leng khalah a nasa a si,” an ti ding."},"6":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in puithiam pawl hnenah, “Fapa in a pa cu a upat, siahhlawh in a bawipa cu a upat. Keimah hi nan pa ka si, ziangah so in upat lo? Keimah hi nan bawipa ka si, ziangah so in ṭihzah lo? In hmuhsuam ih nannih in, ‘Ziangtin so kan lo hmuhsuam?’ tiah in sut hrih lai.","title":"In Puithiam Pawl a Kawk"},"7":{"text":"Ka biakṭheng parah rawl thiang lo nan retnak in in hmuhsuam a si. Cule nannih in ‘Ziangvek in so kan lo upat lo?’ tiah in sut. Ka lo sim: ka biakṭheng nan nautat ih zianghman ih nan siar lonak in in upat lonak a lang a si."},"8":{"text":"A mit a cawmi, a si lole a nami, a si lole a ke a awlmi ṭilva pawl thawinak ah ka hnenih nan pek tikah a ṭha ṭheh ko, zianghman a poi lo, tiah nan ruat maw si? Cuvek ṭilva kha ramuktu hnenah pek hnik uh! Nan parah a lung a awi ding maw? Nan parah mithmai ṭha a nei ding tiah nan zum maw?” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Puithiam pawl, kan parah ṭhatnak tuah aw, tiah Pathian cu dil hnik uh. Nan thlacamnak a ngai hrimhrim lo ding ih cumi cu nanmah ih mawh ruangah a si ding."},"10":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in, “Biakinn sungah lut tahrat in ka biakṭheng parah zianghman ṭhahnem lo meisa nan van lonak dingah nanmah lakah pakhatkhat in biakinn sangka cu khar uhla ka duh a si. Nan parah lungawinak ka nei lo; ka hnenih nan rak kenmi thawinak pawl cu ka saang lo ding."},"11":{"text":"Leilung tlun um miphun hmuahhmuah, nisuahnak ihsin nitlaknak tiang, keimah cu in upat. Khawzakip ah ka hmin upatnak ah rimhmui an ur ih cotlakmi thawinak pawl in pek. An zatein in upat a si!"},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih pawl cun in upat lo; kan biakṭheng cu a borhhlawh mi biakṭheng nan ti ih nan nautatmi rawl a parah ret tahrat in ka hmin in thangsiat a si."},"13":{"text":"‘Hi vek cu kan ning tuk zo,’ nan ti ih nan hnar in phiit. Ka hnenih pek dingah rukmi ṭilva nan rak keng, a si lole a ke-awlmi le a naa mi nan rak keng. Cu pawl cu ka lo saang ding tiah nan ruat maw si?"},"14":{"text":"Pek dingah in kam ciami ṭilva ṭhazet kha a tuurual lakah a um ko naón ka hnenah santlai lo ṭilva thawinak ih i petu cu a parah siatserhnak umseh! Ziangahtile keimah cu a maksakmi siangpahrang ka si ih miphun hmuahhmuah in in ṭihzah a si,” tiah Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in a ti."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in puithiam pawl hnenah, “Hi thupekmi cu nanmah hrangah a si."},"2":{"text":"Nan thiltuahmi in ka hmin upat uh. Ka thusimmi nan ngai lo a si ahcun nan parah siatcamnak ka thlengter ding. Nan pumcawmnak hrangih nan ngahmi thil parah siatcamnak ka thlengter ding. Thungai ti ahcun cuih thil parah siatcamnak ka thlengter zo, ziangahtile ka thupekmi zianghman ah nan siar lo."},"3":{"text":"Nan faate pawl ka hrem ding; nan hmaiah thawinak nan pekmi ṭilva ih eek ka maan ding ih eek tlang ah hruaihlo nan si ding."},"4":{"text":"Cuti cun Levi tesinfa puithiam pawl thawn thukamnak ka tuahmi cu balsiat ṭheh a si lonak dingah hi thu a petu cu keimah ka si kha nan thei ding,” tiah Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in a ti."},"5":{"text":"“Keimah in upatnak dingah ka thukamnak sungah nunnak le harhdamnak pe dingah ka tiam ih ka tiam vekin ka pek. Culai ahcun in rak upat ih in rak ṭihzah."},"6":{"text":"A ṭha lo an rak zirh lo, a dikmi lawng an rak zirh. Keimah thawn tla kan rem-aw zet; anmah in a dikmi an tuah lawng si loin midang in thil ṭha lo an tuahmi an tuah nawn lonak dingah mi tampi an zirh ih an bawm a si."},"7":{"text":"Pathian thu dik teih an theihnak dingah mi zirh ding cu puithiam pawl ih ṭuanvo a si. Ka duhmi le ka tummi an theihnak dingah mipi pawl in an pan ding, ziangahtile puithiam pawl cu Ziangkimtithei Bawipa ih palai an si."},"8":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla atu-ahcun nanmah puithiam pawl riangri lamzin dik ihsin nan pial zo. Nan thuzirhnak ruangah mi tampi in thil sual an tuah. Nanmah thawn ka tuahmi thukamnak cu nanmah in nan bal zo."},"9":{"text":"Cutiih ka thu nan ngai lo ruangah, thu ka tuah ding ih Israel mi pawl in an lo hmuhsuam thung ding ih an lo mualphoh ding; ka minung pawl thu nan zirh tikah thleidan nei in nan zirh a si,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Kan zatein pa pakhat ih fa kan si lo maw? Pathian pakhat in kan zatein in tuah a si lo maw? Cuti asile ziangah so pakhat le pakhat karlakah thukamnak kan tuahmi cu kan bal cingcing ih Pathian in kan pupa pawl thawn thukamnak a tuahmi cu kan nautat?","title":"Misenpi Rintlak Lo An Si"},"11":{"text":"Judah mi pawl in Pathian hnenih thukamnak an tuahmi an bal ih hi ram le Jerusalem khua sungah tuksumza thilsual an tuah. Bawipa in a duhzetmi Biakinn cu an borhhlawhter zo. Ramdang khawzing a biatu nunau pawl an nupi ah an ṭhit."},"12":{"text":"Hi bangtuk a tuahtu pawl cu Bawipa in Israel miphun sungin hlon hram sehla, kan miphun in Ziangkimtithei Bawipa hnenih thawinak an peknak ah ziangtik hmanah tel ve nawn hram hlah hai seh."},"13":{"text":"Thil dang pakhat nan tuah hrihmi cu, hihi a si. Bawipa hnenih nan pekmi thawinak a lo saan nawn lo ruangah nan ninghang in nan ṭap nan ai ih a biakṭheng cu nan mitthli in nan ciah a si."},"14":{"text":"Ziangah so in saan lo? tiah nan sut. Ziangah a lo sang lo tile nan no laiih nan ṭhitmi nan nupi thawn thukamnak nan tuahmi nan balmi kha a thei a si. Nan nupi cu nan rualpi ṭha bik a si: rintlak pasal ka si ding tiah Pathian hmaiah thukamnak nan tuah, asinain cuih nan thukammi rori cu nan bal."},"15":{"text":"Nan nupi thawn taksa khat le thinlung khat ah Pathian in a lo tuah a si lo maw? Hitiih a tuah tikah a tumtahmi ziangso a si? A tumtahmi cu faate nan neih ih Pathian minung ngaingai ih an cannak dingah a si. Curuangah zokhal siseh, a nupi hnenih thukamnak a tuah vekin kimter seh; zohman in a thukammi cu bal hlah seh."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa Israel ih Pathian in, “Nupi maak cu ka hua. Cubangtuk thilsual nanmah lakah pakhatkhat in na nupi parih nan tuah tikah ka hua a si. Rintlak pasal si dingah na nupi hnenih thukamnak na tuahmi kha bal lo dingah ralring aw,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Nan ṭongtam in Bawipa cu a ning zo. Asinain nannih cun, “Ziangtin so Bawipa cu kan nin?” tiah nan sut. Nannih in, “Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in thil ṭha lo a tuahtu pawl cu mi ṭha an si tiah a ruah; thungai ih ticun a duhzet hai a si,” nan ti. Asilole “A dingzet ih ruahmi Pathian cu khui ah so a um?” tiah nan sut. Cuvek ih nan ṭong in Bawipa cu a ning tuk zo a si.","title":"Thuṭhennak Ni A Nai"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in “Ka hrangih lamzin sialtu dingah ka palai ka thlah ding. Cule nan hawl reromi Bawipa cu a Biakinn ah rinlopi in a ra ding. Nan hngakhlap zetmi ka palai cu a ra ding ih ka thukamnak cu a ra phuang ding,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a ra thlen ni cu zoso a tuar thei ding? A lang ngaingai tikah cun zoso a luat thei ding? Thil sawpnak satpia vek le thir hman a thiangfaitertu meisa vek a si ding."},"3":{"text":"Ngun a tii-ter ih a thiangtertu vekin ṭhuthen dingah amah cu a ra ding. Thir sertu in sui le ngun a thianfaiter vekin Bawipa ih palai cun puithiam pawl a thiangfaiter ding ih cuti cun a dikmi thawinak kha Bawipa ih hnenah an rak keng ding."},"4":{"text":"Cule hlanlai ih a rak si vekin Judah mi le Jerusalem mi pawl ih pekmi thawinak cu Bawipa lungawitertu a si sal ding."},"5":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in, “Nan thu ṭhen dingah nan hnenah ka ra ding ih dawithiam pawl, ṭaangṭawm sualnak a tuahtu pawl, tetti dik lo pawl, hnaṭuantu pawl ih nihlawh a ei saktu pawl, nuhmei le ngakṭah farah le ramdangmi pawl parih miatnak a hawltu pawl le i upat lotu pawl hmuahhmuah parah mawhnak pe in thu ka ṭhen ding a si,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Keimah hi Bawipa cu ka si ih a thleng-aw dah lomi ka si. Curuangah nannih Jakob tesinfa pawl cu nan cimit hrih lo a si.","title":"Ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat Peknak"},"7":{"text":"Nanmah hlanih nan pupa pawl vek thotho in nannih khal ka daan pekmi pawl ihsin nan pial ih zianghman nan thlun lo a si. Keimah lam hoikir uhla nan lam ka hoikir ve ding. Asinain nannih cun, ‘Na hnenih ra kir sal dingah ziangso kan tuah ding?’ tiah nan sut."},"8":{"text":"Kei khal in ka lo sut ve hnik pei: Mi pakhat in Pathian ta fir hi a dik nan ti maw? A dik lo ti cu zapi theih a si, asinain nannih cun nan fir thotho. ‘Ziangtin so kan lo fir?’ tiah nan sut hrih. Ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat le thawhlawm nan pek lo tikah nan fir a si."},"9":{"text":"Nan zate parah siatcamnak a thleng, ziangahtile nan miphunpi in ka ta in fir ruangah a si."},"10":{"text":"Biakinn ah nan ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat cu kimtein rak keng uhla rawl tampi a um ding. I hniksak hnik uh, vancung sangka pawl ka ong ding ih nan hrangah thil ṭha a phunphun ka run burh ding."},"11":{"text":"Nan lo rawl pawl cucik kharbok in an siatsuah lo ding ih nan sabit hri parah sabit rah a bawr in a rah ding."},"12":{"text":"Cuti cun miphun hmuahhmuah in malsawm dong, mi lungawi tiah an lo ti ding, ziangahtile nan ram cu ram ṭha le ram nuam a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Ka thuhla cu mawi lo zetzet in nan rel. A sinan ‘Na thu kan relmi ziangso a um?’ tiah nan ti.","title":"Pathian Ih Zaangfah Thukamnak"},"14":{"text":"Nan simsuak rorimi cu ‘Pathian kan rian rero hi a lak a si. A simmi vek ih tuah hi ziangso a ṭhathnem? Kan tuah sualmi kan sir aw ih kan riahsiatnak Ziangkimtithei Bawipa hnenah langter tum rero hi ziangso sawtnak a um?"},"15":{"text":"Kan hmuh cio vekin mi puarthau lehlam thluasuahnak an ngah ko a si! Mi ṭha lo pawl mi neinung zetzet ah an cang ih tlunah thilsual tuah tahrat in Pathian thinsaunak an hniksak ih cawhkuannak zianghman tong loin an luat ko a sisi!’ nan ti,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule Bawipa a ṭihzahtu pawl cu pakhat le pakhat an bia aw ih an ṭongmi cu Bawipa in a ngai ih a thei. A mit hmuh ah Bawipa a ṭihzahtu le a hmin a upattu pawl ih thuhla cu cabu sungah an khum a si."},"17":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in, “Anmah cu ka minung an si ding. Thil ka tuah suak ni ahcun ka ta rori ah an cang ding. A pa a riantu fapa cu a pa in a zaangfah ṭheu vekin anmah cu ka zaangfah ding."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah a dingmi le a ding lomi parah ziangvek thil a thleng aw tile keimah i riantu le i rianlotu pawl ziangvek an cang ti cu ka minung pawl in an hmu sal ding a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Bawipa in, “Somei bangin a lingmi meisa ling a ra thleng ding. Mi puarthau le mi ṭha lo pawl fangkung ro vekih ur an sinak ni a ra thleng cing ding. Cuih ni ah annih pawl cu meisa in ur ṭheh an si ding ih an hram le an hnge zianghman a taang lo ding.","title":"Ih Ni A Ra Thleng Ding"},"2":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka thu a ngaitu nannih pawl hrangah cun ka mi runnak huham nan parah ni bangin a tlang ding ih ni tleunak in harhdamnak a pek vek in nan parah damnak a thlengter ding. Caw faate caw inn ihsin an suahmi vekin luatzet le lungawizet in nan um ding."},"3":{"text":"Ka cangvaih ni ahcun mi ṭha lo pawl cu nan neh dingih nan ke tangih leivut vek an si ding."},"4":{"text":"“Israel mi hmuahhmuah ih thlun dingah Sinai tlang ah ka siahhlawh Moses hnen ih ka pekmi daan pawl le thukham pawl le Moses ih thuzirhmi pawl cu ciing ringring uh."},"5":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla ni lian le ṭihnungza a si mi Bawipa ih ni a ra thlen hlanah nan hnenah profet Elijah ka run thlah ding."},"6":{"text":"Amah in pa le faale pawl hmunkhat ah a finkhawm sal ding; culo ahcun keimah ra in nan ram hi ka siatsuah pang ding,” tiah a ti."}}}}},"40":{"info":{"name":"Matthai","shortname":"Mat","abbr":[],"desc":"Matthai nganmi thuthang ṭha"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih suahkehnak cu hi bangtuk in a si. Amah cu Abraham ih cithlah David ih tesinfa a si.","title":"Jesuh Khrih Suahkehnak"},"2":{"text":"Abraham ih fapa cu Isaak a si. Isaak ih fapa cu Jakob a si. Jakob ih fapa cu Judah le a unau pawl an si."},"3":{"text":"Judah ih fapa cu Perez le Zerah an si (an nu cu Tamar a si), Perez ih fapa cu Hezron a si, Hezron ih fapa cu Ram a si,"},"4":{"text":"Ram ih fapa cu Amminadab a si, Amminadab ih fapa cu Nahshon a si, Nahshon ih fapa cu Salmon a si,"},"5":{"text":"Salmon ih fapa cu Boaz a si (a nu cu Rahab a si), Boaz ih fapa cu Obed a si (a nu cu Ruth a si), Obed ih fapa cu Jesse a si. Jesse ih fapa cu siangpahrang David a si."},"6":{"text":"David san ihsin Israel mi pawl Babilon ram sal an taan tiang an pupa pawl cu a tanglam vekin an si. David ih fapa cu Solomon a si (a nu cu Uriah nupi a rak si.)"},"7":{"text":"Solomon ih fapa cu Rehoboam a si, Rehoboam ih fapa cu Abijah a si, Abijah ih fapa cu Asa a si."},"8":{"text":"Asa ih fapa cu Jehoshafat a si, Jehoshafat ih fapa cu Joram a si. Joram ih fapa cu Uzziah a si."},"9":{"text":"Uzziah ih fapa cu Jotham a si, Jotham ih fapa cu Ahaz a si, Ahaz ih fapa cu Hezekiah a si,"},"10":{"text":"Hezekiah ih fapa cu Manasseh a si, Manasseh ih fapa cu Amon a si, Amon ih fapa cu Josiah a si."},"11":{"text":"Josiah ih fapa cu Jehoiakhin le a unau pawl an si."},"12":{"text":"Babilon saltaannak ihsin Bawi Jesuh suah tiang a tanglam vek an si. Jehoiakhin ih fapa cu Shealtiel a si, Shealtiel ih fapa cu Zerub-babel a si,"},"13":{"text":"Zerub-babel ih fapa cu Abiud a si, Abiud ih fapa cu Eliakim a si, Eliakim ih fapa cu Azor a si,"},"14":{"text":"Azor ih fapa cu Zadok a si, Zadok ih fa pa cu Akhim a si, Akhim ih fapa cu Eliud a si,"},"15":{"text":"Eliud ih fapa cu Eleazar a si, Eleazar ih fapa cu Matthan a si, Matthan ih fapa cu Jakob a si,"},"16":{"text":"Jakob ih fapa cu Josef a si, Josef cu Mari ih pasal a si, Mari in Messiah timi Jesuh a hring."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Abraham ihsin David tiang san hleili, David ihsin Babilon i sal an taan tiang san hleili, sal an taan ihsin Messiah a suah tiang san hleili a si."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih suahnak cu hiti in a si. A nu Mari cu Josef thawn an ham aw ih an ṭhit-awk hlanah Thlarau Thianghlim ih fa ka nei ding ti a thei.","title":"Jesuh Khrih Suahnak (Luk 3.23-38)"},"19":{"text":"A hamtu Josef cu mi ṭha a si ruangah Mari kha mi hmaiah ningzak ih umter a duh lo ih an hamawknak cu a thupte ih phelh saal a tum."},"20":{"text":"Cumi thu a ruah rero laiah a mang ah Bawipa ih vancungmi pakhat a hnenah a lang ih, “David tefa sin Josef, Mari hi na nupi ih ṭhit dingah ṭih hlah. Ziangahtile fa a vunnak hi Thlarau Thianghlim thawngin a si."},"21":{"text":"Amah in fapa a hring ding ih a hmin ah Jesuh tiah na sak pei, ziangahtile a minung pawl kha an sualnak ihsin a run suak ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa in profet hnen in,"},"23":{"text":"“Fala him pakhat in fa a vun ding ih fapa a hring ding, a hmin ah Immanuel tiah an ko ding,” tiih a rak sim ciami a kimnak dingah hi bangtuk in thil a hungcang a si. (Immanuel ti mi cu, “Pathian kan hnenah a um,” tinak a si.)"},"24":{"text":"Josef cu a hung ṭhang ih, Bawipa ih vancungmi ih a fial vekin Mari cu a ṭhit."},"25":{"text":"Asinain fapa a hrin hlantiang a ihpi lo. Fapa a hring ih a hmin ah Jesuh tiah a sak."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu Herod in Judea ram ah siangpahrang a ṭuan laiah, Judea ram Bethlehem khua ah a suak. A rei hlanah nisuahnak lam ihsin arsi zohthiam pawl Jerusalem khawpi ah an ra ih,","title":"Nisuahnak Lam Mifim Pawl An Ra"},"2":{"text":"“Judah mi pawl ih Siangpahrang dingah a suakmi naute khuiah so a um?
