Nisuahnak lamah a arsi kan hmu ih amah biak dingah kan ra a si,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cuih thu cu siangpahrang Herod in a theih tikah a thin a har ngaingai. Jerusalem khua ih a ummi midang hmuahhmuah khal an thin a har ve."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Herod in puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl a kokhawm ih, “Messiah cu khuiah so a suah ding?” tiah a sut."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah annih in, “Judea ram Bethlehem khua ah a suak ding,” tiah an let. Profet ih ngantami cu:"},"6":{"text":"“Judah ram sungih a ummi Bethlehem, Judah ram khawpi pawl lakah hin a fate bik cu na si hrimhrim lo. Ziangahtile na sung ihsin hruaitu pakhat a suak ding ih, Ka minung Israel mi pawl a hruai ding,” ti a si."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Herod in nisuahnak lamih mifim pawl cu a thupte in a ko ih, ziangtik teu-ah arsi a suak, ti kha feltein a sut."},"8":{"text":"Cule Bethlehem khua ah a thlah ih, “Va feh uhla naute cu ṭhatein va hawl uh; nan hmuh asile kei khal i sim uhla amah biak dingah ka feh ve ding,” tiah thu a cah hai."},"9":{"text":"Herod ih sim vek cun an feh ih nisuahnak lamih an hmuhmi arsi cu an hmu sal. Cuih arsi an hmuh sal tikah an lung a awi ngaingai. An hmaiah a feh vivo ih naute umnak tlunah cun a cawl.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Inn sungah an vung lut ih naute cu a nu Mari thawn an vung hmuh tikah khukbil in an biak. An laksawng kenmi sui, frankincense rimhmui le mura zihmui an suah ih an pek."},"12":{"text":"Cule mifim pawl cu Pathian in an mang ah Herod hnenih kir sal nawn lo dingin a sim ruangah lamzin dangin an ram ah an tlung."},"13":{"text":"Nisuah lam mifim pawl an feh hnuah Bawipa ih vancungmi pakhat cu Josef ih mangah a lang ih, “Hi naute hi Herod in thah dingah a hawl ding. Curuangah tho awla naute le a nu thawn Izipt ramah tlan uh. Kir sal ding i ka lo sim hlan lo cutawkah nan um pei,” tiah a ti.","title":"Izipt Ram ah An Tlan"},"14":{"text":"A ti bangtuk in Josef cu a tho ih naute le a nu thawn a zanzan in Izipt ram ah an tlan."},"15":{"text":"Herod ih thih tiang cutawkah an um. Hi bangtuk ih a sinak cu Bawipa in profet kaa in, “Ka Fapa cu Izipt ram ihsin ka ko suak,” tiah a rak timi kha kimternak dingah a si."},"16":{"text":"Nisuah lam mifim pawl in in bum ngah ti kha Herod in a theih tikah a thin a heng ngaingai. Cule mifim pawl ih simmi arsi suah caan thawn a vun tuat ih Bethlehem le a kiangkap khua ih a ummi mipa nauhak kum hnih le a hnuailam hmuahhmuah that ṭheh dingin thu a pek.","title":"Herod In Nauhak Pawl A That"},"17":{"text":"Cuticun profet Jeremiah ih a rak sim ciami kha a kim. A rak sim ciami cu:"},"18":{"text":"“Ramah khawsung in aw a thang, ṭahnak le aihramnak aw a si. Rachel in a faate pawl a ṭah; An thih ṭheh ruangah a ṭap ih, Leem khal a theih nawn lo,” ti a si.","ref":"Jer. 31.15"},"19":{"text":"Herod a thih hnuah Izipt ramah cun Bawipa ih vancungmi pakhat Josef ih mangah a lang ih,","title":"Izipt Ram Ihsin An Kir"},"20":{"text":"“Tho awla naute le a nu kha Israel ram ah kirpi aw, ziangahtile naute thah a tumtu pawl an thi zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"A ti bangtuk in Josef cu a tho ih naute le a nu cu a hruai ih Israel ram ah kir dingin an feh."},"22":{"text":"Asinain Arkhelaus in a pa Herod ih can-ai ah Judea siangpahrang a ṭuan ti Josef in a theih tikah cutawkah cun a feh ngam lo. A mangih thu an sim bet vekin Galilee peng ah a feh ih,"},"23":{"text":"Nazareth timi khua ah a um. Cuticun profet pawl ih an rak sim ciami, “Amah cu Nazareth mi ti a si ding,” timi cu a kim a si.","ref":"Mar 1.24; Luk 2.39; Joh 1.45"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih tikcu hrawngah baptisma petu Johan cu Judea peng ramṭhing ah a ra thleng ih thu a sim.","title":"Baptisma Petu Johan Thusimnak"},"2":{"text":"“Vancung Uknak a nai zo a si. Nan sual sir aw uh,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Profet Isaiah in, “Mi pakhat cu hramlakah a au ih, ‘Bawipa ih hrangah lamzin sial uh, A fehnak ding lamzin kha dingter uh,’ a ti,” tiih a rak timi kha a rak simsan duhmi cu Johan hi a si.","ref":"Isai 40.3"},"4":{"text":"Johan ih hnipuan cu kalauk hmulih tahmi a si, a taikhap cu savun ih tuahmi a si ih a rawl cu kharbok le hramlak khuaitizu a si."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem in siseh, Judea ram khuazakip in le Jordan tiva kiangkap hmuahhmuah in siseh, a hnenah mi an ra."},"6":{"text":"An sualnak an phuang ih Jordan tiva ah baptisma a rak pek hai."},"7":{"text":"Johan in Farasi pawl le Sadusi pawl a hnenah baptisma la dingih an rat kha a hmuh tikah, “Maw rul hrin hrokhrawl pawl, a ra thleng dingmi Pathian ih hremnak sung ihsin nan luat thei ding, tiah zoso a lo sim?"},"8":{"text":"Nan sual nan sir awknak kha nan rah in langter uh."},"9":{"text":"“‘Abraham cu ci in thlahtu kan pu a si,’ ti tahrat in hremnak ihsin kan luat ding, tiah va ruat hlah uh. Thungai in ka lo sim: Pathian cun hi lungto pawl hman hi Abraham tesinfa ah a tuah thei a si."},"10":{"text":"Thingkung tawhram ah hreitlung ret cia in a um zo. Rah ṭha a rah lomi thingkung hmuahhmuah cu hau tahratin meisa sungah paih an si ding."},"11":{"text":"Nan sualnak nan sir-aw ti theihnak ah kei cun tidai thawn baptisma ka lo pek, asinain keimah hnu ih a ra dingmi pa cun Thlarau Thianghlim le meisa thawn baptisma a lo pe ding. Amah cu kei hnakin a tum deuh ngaingai; kei cu a kedam kengtu hmanah ka tlak lo."},"12":{"text":"A kut sungah fang seepnak ṭangṭa a keng. Fang ngai cu a cuam sungah a khum ding ih a hivai pawl cu a mit dah lomi meisa sungah a paih ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cuih caanah Jesuh cu Galilee ihsin Jordan Tiva ah Johan ih baptisma la dingin a ra.","title":"Jesuh In Baptisma A Lak (Mar 1.1-8 ; Luk 3.1-8 ; Joh 1.19-28)"},"14":{"text":"Asinain Johan in a hnenah, “Keimah sawn hi na hnen ihsin baptisma la ding ka si, ziangtinso nangmah riangri ka hnenih na rat?” tiah a sut."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh in, “Atu cu hiti in tuah si ko seh. Ziangahtile Pathian in tuah dingih in fialmi cu hiti hin kimter thluh ding a si,” tiah a ti. A ti vek cun Johan khal a lung a kim."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh cu baptisma a tuah ngah vete in tidai sung ihsin a hung suak. Cutikah van khi a ong-aw ih Pathian ih Thlarau cu thuro bangin a rung ṭum ih a parih a fut kha a hmu."},"17":{"text":"Cule van ihsin aw pakhat in, “Hi pa hi ka duh zetmi ka Fapa a si, a parah ka lung a kimzet,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu Satan ih hniksak dingah Thlarau in ramṭhing ah a fehpi.","title":"Jesuh Hniksaknak"},"2":{"text":"Ni sawmli le zan sawmli rawl loih a um hnuah Jesuh cu a ril a rawng ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Satan a hnenah a ra ih, “Pathian Fapa ngaingai na si ahcun hi lungto pawl hi saang ah cang dingin thu pe aw,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh cun, “Ca Thianghlim in ‘Milai nunnak cu rawl lawngin a si lo. Pathian hmurka in a suakmi ṭongkam in a si sawn,’ a ti,” tiah a let.","ref":"Daan 8.3"},"5":{"text":"Cule Satan in Jesuh cu Jerusalem Khawpi Thianghlim ih Biakinn zim ah a fehpi ih,"},"6":{"text":"a hnenah, “Pathian Fapa na si ahcun hitawk ihsin dawp aw, ziangahtile Ca Thianghlim ah, ‘Pathian in na kiangih a ummi vancungmi pawl thu a pe ding, An kut in an lo dom ding ih na ke cu lungto thawn a khawng aw lo ding,’ tin a um,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Saam 91.11-12"},"7":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh cun, “Ca Thianghlim in ‘Bawipa na Pathian cu na hniksak lo pei,’ a ti a si,” tiah a let.","ref":"Daan 6.16"},"8":{"text":"Cule Satan in Jesuh kha tlang saangpi parah a fehpi ih leilung tlun ram hmuahhmuah kha an maksaknak thawn a hmuh ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Satan cun, “Na khuk bilh tahratin i biak ahcun hi hmuahhmuah hi ka lo pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Satan, tlan aw, ziangahtile Ca Thianghlim in ‘Bawipa na Pathian na biak pei ih amah lawng na rian pei,’ a ti a si,” tiah a let.","ref":"Daan 6.13"},"11":{"text":"Cule Satan cun a tlansan; cuih hnuah vancungmi pawl in an rung tuamhlawm."},"12":{"text":"Johan kha thawng ah an thlak ti a theih tikah Jesuh cu Galilee ah a feh.","title":"Jesuh Galilee Ah Hnaṭuan A Thok (Mar 1.12-13 ; Luk 4.1-13)"},"13":{"text":"Nazareth ah um loin Kapernaum khua ih um dingin a feh. Kapernaum khua cu Zebulun le Naftali phun pawl ram sung Galilee Tili kapih a ummi khua a si."},"14":{"text":"Hitiih a umnak cu profet Isaiah ih a rak sim ciami kimternak dingah a si. Isaiah cun:"},"15":{"text":"“Zentail mi pawl ih umnak Galilee ram sung, Jordan tiva ral khatih um, Tipi lamah, Zebulun le Naftali ram,"},"16":{"text":"Khawthim sungih a ummi pawl in, Tleunak maksak an hmu ding. Thihnak ram thim sungih a ummi pawl parah tleunak a suak ding,” tiah a rak ti.","ref":"Isai 9.1-2"},"17":{"text":"Cuih tikcu ihsin Jesuh in, “Nan sual sir uh, ziangahtile vancung Uknak a nai zo,” tiah thusim hram a thok."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh cu Galilee Tili kapih a feh rero laiah ngakaitu unau pahnih, tili sungah sur vorh in nga an kaih rero kha a hmu. Cuih unau pahnih cu Simon (Piter tiih kawhmi) le a nau Andru an si.","title":"Jesuh In Ngakaitu Pali A Ko (Mar 1.14-15 ; Luk 4.14-15)"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh cun, “Ka hnenah ra uhla mikaitu ah ka lo tuah ding,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Hmakhatteah an sur pawl cu an tanta ih amah cu an thlun."},"21":{"text":"A feh vivo ih Zebedi fapa pahnih Jeim le Johan teih unau a hmu. Anmah cu an pa Zebedi thawn an lawng sungah an um ih an sur pawl an tholh rero. Jesuh cun a vun ko ih,"},"22":{"text":"hmakhatte ah an lawng le an pa tanta in Jesuh cu an thlun."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh cu Galilee peng khuazakip ah a feh ih sinakok kipah thu a zirh vivo. Vancung Uknak Thuthang ṭha a sim vivo ih natnak a phunphun a tuartu pawl kha a damter vivo.","title":"Jesuh In A Zirh, Mi A Damter (Mar 1.16-20 ; Luk 5.1-11)"},"24":{"text":"A thuhla cu Siria ram hmuahhmuah tiangin a thang thluh; curuangah cun natnak le harsatnak a phunphun a tuartu, khawsia-ih polhmi pawl, merainat nei pawl le a zengmi pawl kha a hnenah an ratpi ih an zate in a damter ṭheh."},"25":{"text":"Galilee le Dekhapolis peng, Jerusalem le Judea peng le Jordan tiva ral ihsin mi tampi an ra ih amah cu an thlun."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in mipi a hmuh tikah tlangpar ah a hung kai; cutawkah cun a to ih a dungthluntu pawl a hnenah an ra.","title":"Tlangpar Thuzirhnak"},"2":{"text":"Cule a kam a kau ih hiti in thu a zirh:"},"3":{"text":"“Thlarau lamah ka farah ti a thei awtu pawl cu mi thluasuak an si; Ziangahtile vancung Uknak cu anmah ih ta a si."},"4":{"text":"Ninghang lungsia pawl cu mi thluasuak an si; Ziangahtile Pathian in a hneem hai ding."},"5":{"text":"Lungnemmi pawl cu mi thluasuak an si; Ziangahtile Pathian ih kam ciami an co ding."},"6":{"text":"Pathian ih duhnak tuah dingih a hiarhaaltu pawl cu mi thluasuak an si; Ziangahtile Pathian in an lung di a riamter ding."},"7":{"text":"Mi zaangfah thiamtu pawl cu mi thluasuak an si; Ziangahtile Pathian in anmah a zaangfah ve ding."},"8":{"text":"Thinlung a thiangmi pawl cu mi thluasuak an si; Ziangahtile Pathian an hmu ding."},"9":{"text":"Remnak a tuahtu pawl cu mi thluasuak an si; Ziangahtile Pathian ih fahniang tiah kawh an si ding."},"10":{"text":"Pathian duhnak tuah ruangih hremnak a tuartu pawl cu mi thluasuak an si; Ziangahtile vancung Uknak cu anmah ih ta a si."},"11":{"text":"“Keimah ih dungthluntu nan si ruangah mi in an lo hmuhsuam, an lo hrem ih thuphan a phunphun an lo puh tikah mi thluasuak nan si."},"12":{"text":"Nan lungawi in nan aipuang uh, ziangahtile nan hrangah tuarman tampi vancung ah ret a si. Nan hlanih profet pawl khal cu bangtuk in hrem an tuar zo."},"13":{"text":"“Nannih cu mi phunkip hrangah cite nan si. Sihmansehla cite cu a alnak a ziam asile alter sal a theih nawn lo. Ṭhathnemnak zianghman a neih nawn lo ruangah hlon ding le pal men ding lawng a si.","title":"Cite Le Tleunak"},"14":{"text":"“Nannih cu leilung pumpi hrangah tleunak nan si. Tlangpar ih tohmi khua cu thuh a theih lo."},"15":{"text":"Zohman in mei-inn an van tikah khengkuum an khuh dah lo. Mei-inn vannak tung parah an vang. Cutiin inn sungih a ummi zate hrangah tleunak a si."},"16":{"text":"Cubangtuk in nan tleunak cu mi hmaiah tleuter ding nan si. Cuticun thil ṭha nan tuahmi cu mi in an hmu ding ih vanih a ummi nan Pa kha an thangṭhat ding."},"17":{"text":"“Moses Daan pawl le profet pawl ih thuzirhmi siatsuah dingah a ra, tiah i ruat hlah uh. Cupawl siatsuah dingah ka ra lo, an zirhmi pawl kimter dingah ka ra sawn a si.","title":"Daan Thu Zirhnak (Mar 9.50 ; Luk 14.34-35)"},"18":{"text":"Hihi cing ṭha uh: lei le van a um sung cu Daan sungih daan terek bik pakhat hman a hlo lo ding, ziang hmuahhmuah a kim ṭheh hlan cu pakhatte hman a hlo lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah zokhal sisehla thukham sungih a thupi lo bik pakhatte hman kha a thlun lo ih mi dang khal thlun lo dingin a zirh ve a si ahcun amah cu vancung Uknak ah mi tenau a si ding. Cule zokhal sisehla Daan kha a thlun ih mi dang khal thlun ve dingih a zirh a si ahcun amah cu vancung Uknak ah mi thupi a si ding."},"20":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Pathian duhmi tuahnak ah Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl hnakih nan fel sawn lo ahcun vancung Uknak ah nan lut thei lo ding."},"21":{"text":"“Hlanlaiah cun ‘Mi va that hlah, mi a thattu cu thuṭhennak a tuar ding a si,’ an rak timi nan thei zo.","title":"Thinhennak Thu"},"22":{"text":"Asinain kei cun: a unau parah a thin a hengtu cu thuṭhennak a tuar ding; zokhal sisehla a unau kha ‘Zianghman ih ṭhahnem lo,’ a titu cu thuṭhentu hmaiah suahpi a si pei ih a unau kha, ‘Mi aa,’ a titu cu hell meisa sungah a tla ding tiah phan a um a si, tiah ka ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah biakṭheng ah laksawng Pathian hnenih pek na tum laiah na unau pakhatkhat na parah thinhengnak a nei ti na thei a si ahcun,"},"24":{"text":"biakṭheng hmaiah na laksawng cu taanlawk awla zamrang zetin na unau hnenah feh tahratin remnak va tuah aw; cule ra sal awla na laksawng cu Pathian hnen ah pe aw."},"25":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat in a lo khiing ih zungih a lo thlenpi a si ahcun, zung nan thlen hlan a tikcu um laiah amah thawn remnak va tuah aw. Zung a lo thlenpi hnuah cun thuṭhentu kut ah a lo pe ding ih thuṭhentu in palik hnenah a lo pe lala ding ih thawng ah thlak na si ding."},"26":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: an lo cawhmi tangka na kuan ṭheh hlan lo thawng sungah na um ding."},"27":{"text":"“Ṭaangṭawm sualnak nan tuah lo pei, an ti ṭheumi nan thei.","title":"Ṭaangṭawm Sualnak Thu"},"28":{"text":"Asinain kei cun: nunau kha hahio mit in a zohtu cu a thinlung in cu nu thawn ṭaangṭawm sualnak a tuah zo, tiah ka lo ti."},"29":{"text":"Curuangah na vorhlam mit in a lo sualter asile phorh awla hlon aw. Na ruangpi hell sungih hlon tuar hnak cun na taksa ṭhen pakhatkhat na sun cu na hrangah a ṭha sawn."},"30":{"text":"Na vorhlam kut in a lo sualter le sattan awla hlon aw. Na ruangpi hell sungih hlon tuar hnak cun na kutke pakhatkhat tan a si cu na hrangah a ṭha sawn."},"31":{"text":"“Zokhal in a nupi a maak asile maaknak ca ken seh, timi nan thei.","title":"Nupi Maaknak Thu"},"32":{"text":"Asinain kei cun: mi pakhat in a nupi kha, mipa dang thawn sualnak ruangah siar lo, a maak asile, a nupi cu pasal a neih tikah ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuahtu a siter. Curuangah cupa cu mi sual a si. Cutiih a maak minu a ṭhitu pa khal ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuahtu a si ve."},"33":{"text":"“Khuahlan laiah cun ‘Nan thukam pelhter hlah uh, Bawipa hnenih thu nan kammi cu tuah suak uh,’ an ti ṭheumi nan thei.","title":"Thukamnak Thu (Mat 19.9 ; Mar 10.11-12 ; Luk 16.18)"},"34":{"text":"Asinain kei cun hiti in ka lo sim: thukamnak nan tuah tikah ziangtik hmanah siatcam in tuah hlah uh. Vancung hmin saal in thu kam hlah uh, ziangahtile Pathian tonak a si."},"35":{"text":"Leilung hmin saal khal in thu kam hlah uh, ziangahtile Pathian ke retnak a si. Jerusalem hmin saal khal in kam hlah uh, ziangahtile Siangpahrang maksak umnak khawpi a si."},"36":{"text":"Nan lu saal khal in thu kam hlah uh, ziangahtile nan lu parih sam phangkhat hman kha nan dumter thei lo ih nan rangter thei fawn lo."},"37":{"text":"‘A si,’ ‘asilo,’ ti lawng hi sim uh; cuih hlei cu mi ṭha lo Khawsia hnen ihsin a suakmi an si."},"38":{"text":"“Mit ai ah mit, ha ai ah ha, tiih an simmi cu nan thei.","title":"Phulei Samnak Thu"},"39":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kei cun hiti in ka lo sim. A lo tisiattu parah phulei va sam hlah uh; mi pakhatkhat in na vorhlam biang ah a lo beeng asile na kehlam biang khal tun lawlaw aw."},"40":{"text":"Cule mi pakhatkhat in na angki duh ah thuṭhennak zung tiang a lo thlenpi asile na kawt angki khal pe lawlaw aw."},"41":{"text":"Cun a lo uktu ralkap pakhatkhat in a thilri peng khat phur dingin a lo fial a si ahcun peng hnih tiang va phurhsak aw."},"42":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat in thil pakhatkhat a lo dil a si ahcun va pe aw; na thil cawi a duhtu hnenah va coih aw."},"43":{"text":"“Nan rualpi nan duhdawt pei ih nan ral pawl nan hua pei,” timi cu nan thei zo.","title":"Ral Pawl Duhdawtnak (Luk 6.29-30)"},"44":{"text":"Asinain kei cun hiti in ka lo sim: nan ral pawl duhdaw uhla a lo hremtu pawl hrangah thla cam uh;"},"45":{"text":"cuticun vancungih a ummi nan Pa ih fa nan si ding. Ziangahtile Pathian in mi ṭha le mi ṭha lo tlunah bangrep in ni a tlangter ih thil ṭha a tuahtu le thil sia a tuahtu tlunah bangraan in ruah a surter."},"46":{"text":"A lo duhtu lawng nan duh a si ahcun ziangah so Pathian in laksawng a lo pek ding? Siahkhongtu hman in cu bangtuk cun an tuah ve a si!"},"47":{"text":"Nan rualpi ṭha pawl lawng nan biak ṭhat a si ahcun mi dang nan hleihnak ziangso a um cuang? Pathian bia lomi hman in cuvek cu an tuah a sisi!"},"48":{"text":"Vancung ih a um nan Pa a famkim vekin nannih khal nan famkim ve pei."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Biaknak lamih thil ṭha nan tuahmi hi mi in in hmu hai seh tiin mizapi hmaiih tuah lo dingin ralring uh. Cutiih mipi hmaiih nan tuah ahcun vancungih a ummi nan Pa hnen ihsin ṭhatman ziang hman nan ngah lo ding.","title":"Siannak Thu"},"2":{"text":"“Curuangah mi tlasam hnenah thil pakhatkhat nan ṭhen tikah mititeraw pawl in sinakok le zalamzin ih an tuah vekin tawtawrawt tum in uang aw hlah uh. Annih cun mipi pawl ih lom dingah an tuah. Fiangtein ka lo sim: an ngah dingmi cu an ngah ṭheh zo."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih cun mi tlasam nan bawm tikah nan vorhlam kut ih tuahmi kha nan kehlam kut khal in theih lo dingin va tuah uh."},"4":{"text":"Cuticun a thupte ih nan tuahmi a hmutu nan Pa in ṭhatman a lo pek ding."},"5":{"text":"“Thla nan cam tikah mititeraw pawl vekin cam hlah uh. Annih cun mi hmuahhmuah in in hmu hai seh tiin sinakok le zalampi ah ding tahratin thlacam an duh ngaingai. Fiangtein ka lo sim: an ngah dingmi an ṭhatman cu an ngah ṭheh zo.","title":"Thlacamnak Thu (Luk 11.2-4)"},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih cu thla nan cam tikah nan innkhaan sungah lut uhla sangka nan khar hnuah mithmuh lomi nan Pa hnenah thla cam uh. Cule a thupte ih nan tuahmi a hmutu nan Pa in nan ṭhatman a lo pe ding."},"7":{"text":"“Thla nan cam tikah Pathian thei lomi pawl ih sullam nei tuk lomi ṭong tampi an ṭong vekin va tuah hlah uh. Annih cun reipi thla an cam tikah Pathian in a thei cuang ding tiah an ruat."},"8":{"text":"Anmah vek va si hlah uh. Nan ṭulmi cu nan dil hlan ihsin nan Pa in a thei cia zo."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah hi bangtuk in thla nan cam pei: ‘Vancung ih a ummi kan Pa, na hmin thianghlim cu upat si ko seh;"},"10":{"text":"Na Uknak thleng hram seh; Vancung i na duhnak tuah a si bangin leitlun khalah tuah si ve seh."},"11":{"text":"Nitin kan ṭulmi rawl in pe aw."},"12":{"text":"Mi in kan parah sualnak an tuah ih kan ngaidam bangtuk in, Kanmah ih sualnak khal in ngaidam ve aw."},"13":{"text":"A harmi hniksaknak tuarter loin, siatnak ihsin in hum hram aw.’"},"14":{"text":"“Nan parah sualnak a tuahtu pawl nan ngaidam a si ahcun vancungih a ummi nan Pa in a lo ngaidam ve ding."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla midang sualnak nan ngaidam lo a si ahcun nan sualnak cu nan Pa in a lo ngaidam ve lo ding."},"16":{"text":"“Rawl nan ulh tikah mititeraw pawl vekin riahsia mithmai in um hlah uh. Mihrek in rawl an ulh kha mi hmuahhmuah in in thei hai seh tiah an mithmai in an langter. Fiangtein ka lo sim: an ngah dingmi an ṭhatman an ngah ṭheh zo a si.","title":"Rawl Ulhnak Thu"},"17":{"text":"Nannih cu rawl nan ulh tikah nan hmai phiah in nan sam tla ṭhatein hriat uh."},"18":{"text":"Cuticun zohman in rawl nan ulh kha an lo thei lo ding ih mithmuh lo nan Pa lawng in a lo thei ding. A thupte ih nan tuahmi a hmutu nan Pa in ṭhatman a lo pek ding."},"19":{"text":"“Tlap le nget ih a siatsuah theinak le rukru pawl in an bauh ih an ruk theinak hi leitlun ah nan sumsaw khawl hlah uh.","title":"Vancung Ah Khawl Uh (Luk 12.33-34)"},"20":{"text":"Tlap le nget ih a siatsuah thei lonak le rukru pawl in an bauh ih an ruk thei lonak vancung ah nan sumsaw cu khawl sawn uh."},"21":{"text":"Ziangahtile nan sumsaw umnak ah nan thinlung khal a um ve ding."},"22":{"text":"“Mit cu taksa ruangpi hrangah mei-inn a si. Nan mit a fim le nan taksa ruangpi cu a tleu ṭheh ding.","title":"Taksa Ruangpi Ih Tleunak (Luk 11.34-36)"},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nan mit a ṭhat lo ahcun nan ruangpi cu thimnak sungah a um ding. Cuti a si ruangah nan sungih tleunak cu thimnak a si ahcun ziangtluk ṭihnungza so thimnak cu a si ding!"},"24":{"text":"“Zokhal in bawi pahnih a rian thei lo. Pakhat a duh ding ih pakhat a hua ding. Pakhat hnenah rintlak zetin a um ding ih pakhat cu a hmuhsuam ding. Pathian le tangka nan rian tlang thei lo ding.","title":"Pathian Le Tangka Thu (Luk 16.13 ; 12.22-31)"},"25":{"text":"“Cuti a si ruangah ka lo sim: nan nunnak hrangih nan ṭulmi ti le rawl le nan ruangpi hrangih hnipuan pawl thu ruat le donhar in um hlah uh. Thungai ih ti ahcun, nunnak hi rawl hnakin a thupi sawn lo maw? Hnipuan hnak khal in taksa ruangpi hi a thupi sawn lo maw?"},"26":{"text":"Van ih a zuangmi vate khi zohhnik uh; annih in thlaici an tuh lo, rawl khal an khawm lo ih cuam sung khalah an khawl lo. Asinain vancungih a ummi nan Pa in a cawm thluh a si. Vate hnakin tampi nan sunglawi sawn a si lo maw?"},"27":{"text":"Nan donhar ruangah nan nunnak caan tawite tal nan sauter thei maw?"},"28":{"text":"“Cun ziangah so hnipuan thu ah nan don a har? Hramlakih pangpar khi zohhnik uh; hna an ṭuan lo, pathnuk in thiam an tak fawn lo."},"29":{"text":"Asinain atu-ah ka lo sim: siangpahrang Solomon hman, kha tlukin a lian naón, a lennak le a hnipuan in hi pangpar ih mawinak a tluk lo a si."},"30":{"text":"Tuihsun ah a nung ih thaisun ah meisa sungih paih ding hrampi hman a ceimawitu Pathian cun cuih pawl hnakin nannih cu a lo thuam sawn lo ding maw? Nan zumnak a va mal lawmmam so!"},"31":{"text":"“Curuangah ‘Ei in ding le sinfen ding tla khui-in so ka ngah ding,’ tiin donhar in um hlah uh."},"32":{"text":"Hi pawl cu Pathian thei lo khawvel pawl ih an helhkam ringring mi an si. Vancung ih a ummi nan Pa in hi thil pawl nan ṭulzia cu a thei a si."},"33":{"text":"Cuhnakin Pathian Uknak le a felnak hawl hmaisa sawn uhla thil dang hmuahhmuah cu a lo pebeet ding a si."},"34":{"text":"Curuangah thaisun hrangah donhar in um hlah uh; thaisun in donharnak amah tawkin a nei ve ding. Ni ni khat ih a phurhmi harsatnak tlunah a dang beetcih ding a si lo."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi va soi hlah; cuticun Pathian in a lo soi ve lo ding.","title":"Mi Soisel Hlah (Luk 6.37-38 , 41-42)"},"2":{"text":"Ziangahtile mi na soi vekin nangmah khal Pathian in a lo soi ve ding ih midang parih na hmanmi tahfung in Pathian in a lo tah ve ding."},"3":{"text":"Na mit sungih thingtum hman poisa loin na unau mit sungih mithnawm fate kha ziangah so na poisat?"},"4":{"text":"Na mit sungah thingtum a um nacingin ziangtinso na unau cu ‘Na mithnawm ka lo coihsak ding,’ tiih na ti thei?"},"5":{"text":"Mititer aw pa! Na mit sungih thingtum kha suah hmaisata awla cuticun na unau mit sungih mithnawm cu fiangtein na hmu thei ding ih na coihsak thei ding."},"6":{"text":"“A thianghlimmi thil kha uico va pe hlah uh; her tahratin nanmah riangri sawp seksek in a lo keu ding. Nan keplung mankhung pawl cu vok hmaiah thlak hlah uh; a ke in a pal lak men ding a si."},"7":{"text":"“Dil uh, nan ngah ding; hawl uh, nan hmu ding; king uh, nan hrangah sangka on a si ding.","title":"Dil Uh, Hawl Uh, King Uh (Luk 11.9-13)"},"8":{"text":"Ziangahtile a diltu hmuahhmuah cun an ngah ding, a hawltu hmuahhmuah cun an hmu ding ih a kingtu hmuahhmuah hrangah sangka cu on sak an si ding."},"9":{"text":"Nan faate pawl in saang an lo dil asile, nannih pale pawl in lungto nan pe ding maw?"},"10":{"text":"Nga lo dil hai sehla rul nan pe ding maw?"},"11":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo zet nan si naón nan faate pawl hrangah cun a ṭhami thil pek nan thiam a si ahcun vancungih a ummi nan Pa in a diltu hnenah cun ziangtinso thil ṭha pek loin a um ding."},"12":{"text":"“Mi in kan parah tuah hai seh ti nan duh vekin mi dang parah tuah ve uh. Himi hi Moses Daan le profet pawl thuzirhnak ih sim duhmi taktak cu a si."},"13":{"text":"“A fiakmi kotka sungin feh uh, ziangahtile hell fehnak kotka cu a kau ih a lamzin khal a ol; curuangah a zawhtu khal an tam a si.","title":"Kotka Fiak (Luk 13.24)"},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nunnak sungih luhnak kotka cu a fiak ih a fehnak lamzin khal a har; curuangah a thleng suaktu cu mi malte an si."},"15":{"text":"“Profet deu pawl khi ralring uh; an lenglam cun tuu bangin nan lakah an tlang; asinain an sunglam cu cinghnia hrang vek an si.","title":"Thingkung Le A Rah (Luk 6.43-44)"},"16":{"text":"Mi ziangvek an si ti cu an tuahmi in nan thei ding. Hling kung ihsin sabit a rah dah lo; lenhling khal in theipi a rah dah keel lo."},"17":{"text":"A harhdammi thingkung ṭha cun rah ṭha a rah ih thingkung ṭha lo cun rah sia a rah."},"18":{"text":"A harhdammi thingkung cun rah sia a rah thei lo ih thingkung ṭha lo cun rah ṭha a rah thei ve lo."},"19":{"text":"Cule rah ṭha a rah lomi thingkung cu an hau ih meisa sungah an paih ṭheu."},"20":{"text":"Cuvekin profet deu pawl cu an tuahmi in nan theithiam ding."},"21":{"text":"“‘Bawipa, Bawipa,’ tiih i kotu hmuahhmuah in vancung Uknak an thleng thluh lo ding; vancungih a ummi ka Pa ih duhnak a tuahtu lawnglawng an thleng ding a si.","title":"Ka Lo Thei Dah Lo (Luk 13.25-27)"},"22":{"text":"Thuṭhen Ni a thlen tikah mi tampi in ‘Bawipa, Bawipa, na hmin in thu kan sim, na hmin in khawsia tampi kan dawi suak ih mangbangza tampi kan tuah,’ tiah ka hnenah an ti ding."},"23":{"text":"Asinain kei cun, ‘Ka lo thei dah lo! Ka hnen ihsin tlan uh, nannih mi ṭha lo pawl!’ tiah ka ti hai ding."},"24":{"text":"“Curuangah hi ka ṭongmi a thei ih a thluntu cu lungpi parih inn saktu mifim pa bangtuk a si.","title":"Inn Saktu Pahnih (Luk 6.47-49)"},"25":{"text":"Ruah napi in a sur, ti a lian ih thlipi in a nuai ciamco naón lungpi parih sakmi inn a si ruangah a sawn lo."},"26":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla hi ka ṭongmi a thei naón a thlun lotu cu vunnel parih inn saktu mi-aa bangtuk a si."},"27":{"text":"Ruah napi in a sur, ti a lian ih thlipi in a nuai tikah a sawn mai; a tlu ih a siatbal thluh a si,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh in hi thu hmuahhmuah a sim ṭheh tikah misenpi pawl cu a thuzirhmi kha an mang a bang ngaingai.","title":"Jesuh Thuneihnak"},"29":{"text":"Anih cun Daanthiam pawl vek si loin thunei zetin thu a zirh a si."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu tlangpar ihsin a rung ṭum ih mitampi in an thlun.","title":"Jesuh In Miphar Pakhat A Damter (Mar 1.40-45 ; Luk 5.12-16)"},"2":{"text":"Cule miphaar pakhat a hnenah a ra ih a hmaiah a khukbil in a kun ih, “Bawipa, na duh ahcun i damter thei a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh cun a hei dawh ih a tham hnuah, “Ka lo damter ding, atu ihsin thiang thlang aw,” tiah a ti. Hmakhatteah cupa cu a dam."},"4":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Ngai aw, hi thu hi zohman sim hlah; asinain puithiam hnenah va feh vurvo awla amah in rak lo zohseh. Cun na dam zo a si ti ih mizapi theih dingah Moses thupekmi vekin thawinak va pe aw,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh cu Kapernaum khua a thlen tikah Rom ralbawipa pakhat in a ra tong ih bomnak a ra dil.","title":"Rom Ralbawi Ih Hnen-um A Damter (Luk 7.1-10)"},"6":{"text":"“Bawipa, ka hnen-umpa cu besia zetin a na ih caang thei loin inn ah a it ringring a si,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"“Ka ra pei ih ka damter pei,” tiah Jesuh in a ti."},"8":{"text":"Ralbawipa in, “Bawipa, cuticun si hlah seh; nang ka inn tiangih ratter dingah kei ka tlak lo. Damnak thu pe awla ka hnen-umpa cu a dam ko ding."},"9":{"text":"Keimah khal ka tlunlam bawi pawl ih ukmi ka si ih ka kut hnuai khalah ralkap an um. Ka kut hnuai ralkap pakhatkhat cu, ‘Feh aw,’ ka tile a feh; ‘Ra aw,’ ka tile a ra. Ka hnen-um khal, ‘Himi tuah aw,’ ka tile a tuah a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cumi cu Jesuh in a theih tikah a mang a bang ngaingai ih amah a thluntu mizapi pawl hnenah, “Thungai in ka lo sim: Israel mi lak hmanah hi pa ih zumnak bangtuk ka hmu hrih lo."},"11":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: nisuahnak le nitlaknak ihsin mi tampi an ra ding ih vancung Uknak rawl einak puai ah Abraham le Isaak le Jakob thawn an to tlang ding."},"12":{"text":"Asinain vancung Uknak co ding a si mi pawl sawn kha ṭahnak le hacang rialnak hmun khawthim sungah hlon an si ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in ralbawipa hnenah, “Inn ah va tlung awla na zumnak vekin tuah sak na si ding,” tiah a ti. Ralbawipa ih hnen-um cu cuih caan cekci ah a rak dam."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh cu Piter inn ah a feh ih cutawkah Piter ih pizon cu khurhnat in a na ih ihkhun ah a rak it kha a hmu.","title":"Jesuh In Mi Tampi A Damter (Mar 1.29-34 ; Luk 4.38-41)"},"15":{"text":"Jesuh cun a kut a vun tham ih a khurhnat cu a dam. Cule a tho ih Jesuh kha a tuamhlawm thei."},"16":{"text":"Zanlam a si tikah khawsia ih polhmi pawl kha Jesuh hnenah an ratpi. A ṭong kam khat in khuavang pawl cu a dawi ih mina mi pawl cu a damter ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Hitiih a tuahnak cu profet Isaiah in, “Amah rori in kan natnak cu a lak ih kan dam lonak pawl cu a phurhlo a si,” tiah a rak simmi kimternak dingah a si.","ref":"Isai 53.4"},"18":{"text":"Jesuh in a kiangkapih misenpi a hmuh tikah a dungthluntu pawl kha tili khatlam ralih feh dingah thu a pek.","title":"Jesuh Thluntu Ding Pawl (Luk 9.57-62)"},"19":{"text":"Daanthiam saya pakhat a hnenah a ra ih, “Sayapa, na fehnak hmun kipah ka lo thlun ding,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Cinghnia in kua an nei ih vate in bu an nei; asinain Milai Fapa cun riahnak hmun hman a nei lo,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"A dungthluntu dang pakhat in Jesuh hnen ah, “Bawipa, ka va kirta hrih ding ih ka pa ka va phumta pei,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh in, “I thlun sawn aw, mithi pawl in mithi cu phum ko hai seh,” tiah a sawn."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh cu a dungthluntu pawl in an thlun ih lawng sungah an lut.","title":"Jesuh In Thlipi A Daiter (Mar 4.35-41 ; Luk 8.22-25)"},"24":{"text":"Rinlopi-ah thlipi a huk ih lawng cu a pil zik. Asinain Jesuh cu a itthat."},"25":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl in an va ṭhang ih, “Bawipa, in run aw! Kan thizik thlang a si,” tiah an ti."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh cun, “Ziangah so cuticun nan ṭih? Nan zumnak a va mal so!” tiah a ti. Cule a tho ih thli le tilet cu dai dingin thu a pek; hmakhatte ah tili cu daitein a um sal."},"27":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah an mang a bang ih, “Hi pa hi ziang bangtuk minung so a si? Thlipi le tilet hman in a thu an ngai!” tiah an ti."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh cu tili khatlam ral Gadara an timi ramah a thleng ih cutawkih thlaan lungkua sung ihsin a ra suakmi pahnih in an rak tong. Himi pahnih cu khawsia polhmi an si ih ṭihnung ngaingai an si ruangah cuih lamzin cu zohman in an zawh ngam lo.","title":"Khuavang Polhmi Pahnih A Damter (Mar 5.1-20 ; Luk 8.26-39)"},"29":{"text":"Hmakhatteah an au ih, “Maw Pathian Fapa, nang le kannih ziangso kan seng aw? A tikcu a kim hlanah kanmah hrem dingah maw na rat?” tiah an ti."},"30":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin hla nawn ah rawl a ei reromi vok rual an um."},"31":{"text":"Khawsia pawl in Jesuh cu an dil ih, “In dawisuak ding a si ahcun khitawk ih vok pawl sungah khin in lutter aw,” an ti."},"32":{"text":"Jesuh cun, “Va lut uh,” tiah a ti. Khawsia pawl cu cuih mi pahnih sungin an suak ih vok pawl sungah an va lut. Vok rual cu cutawk khaamhraap ihsin an dawp ciamco ih tili sungah an tlathat ṭheh."},"33":{"text":"Vok kiltu pawl cu khawsungah an vung tlan ih cuih thuhla pawl le khawsia polhmi pahnih parih thil a cangmi pawl cu kimtein an sim ṭheh."},"34":{"text":"Curuangah khawsungmi hmuahhmuah cu Jesuh tong dingah an feh; Jesuh an hmuh tikah an ram ihsin hmun dangih feh dingah zaangfah an dil."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng sungah a lut ih tili khatlam ralih a khua Kapernaum ah a kir sal.","title":"Jesuh In Mizengpa A Damter (Mar 2.1-12 ; Luk 5.17-26)"},"2":{"text":"Cule mizeng pakhat cu a ihkhun thawn Jesuh hnenah an rak zawn. Zumnak an neihzia kha Jesuh in a hmuh tikah, mizengpa hnenah cun, “Ka fapa, zianghman phang hlah. Na sualnak cu ngaidam a si zo,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule Daanthiam saya ṭhenkhat pawl in, “Hi pa hi Pathian thangsiat in a ṭong a si,” tiah an ti aw."},"4":{"text":"Cutiih an ruah cu Jesuh in a thei ih, “Ziangah so hi bangtuk thil ṭha lo hi nan ruat?"},"5":{"text":"‘Na sualnak cu ngaidam a si zo,’ ti maw ‘Tho awla feh aw,’ ti so a ol sawn?"},"6":{"text":"Milai Fapa in leilung parah mi sual ngaidam theinak thu a nei, tihi nan hmaiah ka langter ding,” tiah a ti ih mizengpa hnenah cun, “Tho aw, na ihphah la awla inn ah va tin aw,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Mizengpa cu a tho ih a inn ah a tin."},"8":{"text":"Cumi cu mipi in an hmuh tikah an thin a phang ih cubangtuk thuneihnak cu milai hnenah a pek ruangah Pathian an thangṭhat."},"9":{"text":"Cuih hmun ihsin Jesuh cu a suak ih a feh rero laiah siahkhongtu pakhat Matthai an timi pa a zung sungih a to kha a hmu ih, “I thlun aw,” tiah a ti. Matthai cu a tho ih Jesuh a thlun.","title":"Jesuh In Matthai A Ko (Mar 2.13-17 ; Luk 5.27-32)"},"10":{"text":"Jesuh cu Matthai inn ih zanriah a ei laiah siahkhongtu dang tampi le misual an si ti ih hnonmi pawl in Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu rawl an eipi."},"11":{"text":"Farasi ṭhenkhat pawl in cumi cu an hmuh tikah a dungthluntu pawl kha, “Nan sayapa hi ziangah so hibangtuk minung pawl thawn rawl an ei tlang?” tiah an sut."},"12":{"text":"Cumi cu Jesuh in a theih tikah an hnenah, “A harhdammi in sibawi an hai lo, mina lawngin an ṭul a si."},"13":{"text":"Va feh uhla, ‘ṭilva in thawinak pek ka ṭul lo, mi zaangfahnak thinlung a si ka duh,’ tiah Ca Thianghlim ih a timi hi a tican va ruathnik uh. Miding pawl ko dingah ka ra lo, misual pawl ko dingah ka ra a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 12.7; Hos 6.6"},"14":{"text":"Cule baptisma petu Johan ih dungthluntu pawl Jesuh hnenah an ra ih, “Kannih le Farasi pawl cu rawl kan ul ṭheu naón ziangah so na dungthluntu pawl hmuah rawl an ulh dah lo?” tiah an sut.","title":"Rawl Ulhnak Thu (Mar 2.18-22 ; Luk 5.33-39)"},"15":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Mo lomnak puai ih sawmmi pawl cu ziangah so mopa a um sungah cun riahsia in an um ding? Riahsia in an um lo ding! Sikhalsehla an hnen ihsin mopa lakhlo a si tikcu a thleng leh ding ih cutikah rawl cu an ul leh ding."},"16":{"text":"“Zohman in angki hlun tlek parah puan thar an belh dah keel lo, ziangahtile belhmi thil thar kha a com ding ih angki a tlekmi kha a kau sinsin ding."},"17":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in zohman in savun thawl hlun sungah sabitti thar an thun dah lo; an thun asile savun thawl cu a kuai ding ih sabitti kha a zun hlo ṭheh ding ih savun thawl cu a siatralta ding a si. Cu hnakin savun thawl thar sungih sabitti thar thun a si ahcun siatnak ziang hman um loin an pahnih in an him ding,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cuih thu Jesuh in a sim rero laifangah Judah mi lakih bawi pakhat Jesuh hnenah a ra ih khukbil in, “Tubaite ah ka fanu a thi. Asinain nangmah na rat ih a parih na kut na suan ahcun a nung sal ding,” tiah a ra ti.","title":"Jesuh Puan A Thamtu Nunau Nu (Mar 5.21-43 ; Luk 8.40-56)"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh cu a tho ih cu pa cu a thlun ih a dungthluntu pawl khal cun an thlun ve."},"20":{"text":"Culai ah nunau nu pakhat kum hleihnih sung besia zetih thidok natnak a tuartu Jesuh dunglam ihsin a ra ih Jesuh ih puanzim kha a tham."},"21":{"text":"“A puan zimte tal ka tham thei a si ahcun ka dam ko ding,” tiah a thinlungte in a ruat."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh cu a her ih cu nu cu a hmu. “Ka fanu, na thinphang hlah! Na zumnak in a lo damter zo,” tiah a ti. Cuvete in cu nu cu a dam."},"23":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu Judah hotupa ih inn sungah a lut. Mithi topinak khuangdar tumtu pawl le minung hnok ceelceel ih an um a hmuh tikah,"},"24":{"text":"“Nan zatein suak ṭheh uh! Hi nauhak nu cu a thi lo, a itthat a si,” tiah a ti. Cutikah an hnihsan ṭheh."},"25":{"text":"Asinain mi an suah thluh vete in Jesuh cu nauhak nu ih umnak khaan sungah a lut ih a kut a vun kaih vete in nauhak nu cu a hung tho."},"26":{"text":"Cuih thu cu a kiangkap ram sung hmuahhmuah ah a thang thluh."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh cu cuih hmun ihsin a suak ih a feh rero laiah mitcaw pahnih in an dawi ih, “Maw David Fapa, in zaangfah hram aw,” tiah an au.","title":"Mitcaw Pahnih Khua A Hmuhter"},"28":{"text":"Jesuh cu inn sungah a lut ih mitcaw pahnih cu a hnenah an ra ih Jesuh cun, “Ka lo damter thei ding tiin nan zum maw?” tiah a sut. “Asi, Bawipa, kan zum,” tiah an ti."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in an mit a tham ih, “Nan zumnak vekin cang seh,” a ti ih,"},"30":{"text":"khua an hmu thei sal. Jesuh cun an hnenah, “Hi thu hi zohman nan sim lo pei,” tiah fek zetin a tiam."},"31":{"text":"Asinain an feh ih Jesuh ih thuhla cu cuih kiangkap khuazakipah an than."},"32":{"text":"Mipi an inn ih an tin rero laiah midang pawl in khawsia in a polh ruangah a ṭong thei lomi mipa pakhat Jesuh hnenah cun an rak hruai.","title":"A ṭong Thei Lomi A ṭongter"},"33":{"text":"Jesuh in khawsia a dawi suak sak vete in cupa cu a ṭong thei sal ih mi hmuahhmuah an mang a bang ṭheh. “Israel mi lakah hi bangtuk cu kan hmu dah hrih lo,” tiah an ti cio."},"34":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Farasi pawl cun, “Khawsia dawihlo theinak huham cu khawsia bawi in a hnenah a pek a si,” tiah an ti."},"35":{"text":"Cuticun Jesuh cu khual a tlawng ih khawpi siseh, khawte siseh, a pal phah vivo. Sinakok ah thu a zirh, vancung Uknak Thuthang ṭha a sim ih natnak le damlonak phunphun a neitu pawl a damter vivo.","title":"Jesuh In Mipi A Zaangfah"},"36":{"text":"Misenpi pawl a hmuh tikah khaaltu nei lo tuu bangtuk in rethei le awloksong ih an um ruangah an parah zaangfahnak tampi a nei."},"37":{"text":"Curuangah a dungthluntu pawl hnen ah, “Rawl khawm ding tampi a um naón a khawmtu ding minung an malte a si."},"38":{"text":"Curuangah rawl lak ding neitu bawi hnen ah rawl khawmtu ding milai tampi thlah dingah thlacam uh,” tiah a ti. te"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu hleihnih kha hmun khatah a ko ih thlarau ṭha lo dawihlo theinak le natnak le dam lonak a phunphun damter theinak huham a pek.","title":"Tirhthlahmi Hleihnih (Mar 3.13-19 ; Luk 6.12-16)"},"2":{"text":"Tirhthlahmi hleihnih ih hmin pawl cu, hmaisabik ah Simon (Piter timi) le a nau Andru; Zebedi ih fapa Jeim le a nau Johan;"},"3":{"text":"Filip le Bartholomeo; Thomas le siahkhongtu Matthai; Alfias ih fapa Jeim le Tadias;"},"4":{"text":"Phunṭan Simon le Jesuh a zuartu Judas Iskariot tla an si."},"5":{"text":"Hi hleihnih pawl cu Jesuh in a thlah ih ṭhatein thu a cah hai. “Zentail ram ah va feh hlah uhla Samaria khawsung ah va lut hlah uh.","title":"Tirhthlahmi Hleihnih Thucahmi (Mar 6.7-13 ; Luk 9.1-6)"},"6":{"text":"Cuhnakin a hlomi tuu run Israel mi pawl hnenah nan feh pei."},"7":{"text":"Feh uh la, ‘Vancung Uknak a nai zo,’ tiah va sim uh."},"8":{"text":"Mina damter uh, mithi thoter sal uh, phaarnat a neimi pawl damter uhla khuavang pawl dawihlo uh. Man loin nan ngahmi kha man loin va pe uh."},"9":{"text":"Nan kordip ah sui tangka siseh, ngun tangka le dar tangka siseh, pai hlah uh."},"10":{"text":"Nan khualtlawnnak lamzin hrangah rawl dilnak ah cawdip siseh, angki hlei siseh, kedam le kianghrol siseh, keng hlah uh. Hnaṭuantu pa cu a sammi hmuahhmuah pek thluh a si ding."},"11":{"text":"“Khawpi siseh, khawte siseh nan thlen tikah lungawite ih tlun-inn a lo ontu inn ah lut uhla nan feh sal hlan tiang cuih inn ah va cam uh."},"12":{"text":"Inn sungih nan luh tikah ‘Nan hnenah daihnak um hram seh,’ tiah va ti uh."},"13":{"text":"Cuih inn sung mi pawl in tlun-inn an lo on asile daihnak hrang mal nan sawm sakmi cu cuih inn ah umseh. Asinain tlun-inn an lo on lo asile daihnak malsawmnak cu la kir sal uh."},"14":{"text":"Cule zokhal in tlun-inn an lo on lo ih nan thu khal an ngai duh lo asile cuih hmun cu tlansan uhla nan ke ih leivut cu thingthlata uh."},"15":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: thuṭhennak Ni ah Pathian in cuih khua mi pawl hnakin Sodom le Gomorrah khua mi parah zaangfahnak tam deuh a nei ding a si,” tiah a sim."},"16":{"text":"“Ngai uh! Cinghnia hraang rual lakih tuu thlah bangtuk in ka lo thlah a si. Curuangah rul vekin fimkhur uhla thuro vekin nan nun nem uh.","title":"A Thleng Dingmi Hremnak (Mar 13.9-13 ; Luk 21.12-17)"},"17":{"text":"Ralring uh, ziangahtile nanmah a lo kaitu dingah mi an suak ding; zungah an lo thlenpi ding ih sinakok ah an lo vuak ding."},"18":{"text":"Keimah ih ruangah uktu le siangpahrang pawl hmaiah an lo thlenpi ding ih anmah le Zentail mi pawl hnenah ka thu thantertu nan si ding."},"19":{"text":"Thuṭhennak hmunih thlenpi nan si tikah ziangso ka sim ding ti le ziangtinso ka sim ding, tiin nan donhar hlah uh. A tikcu a kim tikah nan sim dingmi cu theihter nan si leh ding."},"20":{"text":"Ziangahtile a ṭongtu ding cu nanmah si loin nan sung ihsin a ṭongtu nan Pa ih Thlarau ṭongkam a si ding."},"21":{"text":"“Mi in anmah ih unau lala kha that dingah midang kut ah an thlengter ding. Pale pawl khal in an faate tlunah cu bangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in an tuah ding. Faale pawl khal in an pale pawl an ral ding ih midang kut ah an thlen ding."},"22":{"text":"Keimah ruangah mikip in an lo hua ding. Sikhalsehla a netnak ni tiang a ṭang theitu cu runsuak an si ding."},"23":{"text":"Khua pakhat ah an lo hrem asile khua dangah va tlan uh. Fiangtein ka lo sim: Milai Fapa a ra thlen hlanah Israel ram sung khua hmuahhmuahih nan hnaṭuanmi cu nan ṭheh man lo ding."},"24":{"text":"“A saya hnakin a tum sawnmi tlawngta zohman an um lo. A bawipa hnakin a tum sawnmi sal zohman an um lo."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah tlawngta pakhat cu a saya tluk a si ahcun lungkim ding a si ko; sal khal a bawipa tluk a si ahcun lungkim ding a si ko. Innsang ih lu bik kha khawsia bawi Beelzebul tiih kawh a si ahcun innsang sung um midang pawl cu cuhnakih hmin sia deuh in kawh an si ding."},"26":{"text":"“Curuangah milai ṭih hlah uh. Atuih thuh-mi hi on ṭheh a si ding ih thuthup hmuahhmuah khal phuan ṭheh a si leh ding.","title":"Zoso ṭih Ding A si (Luk 12.2-7)"},"27":{"text":"Khawthim lakih ka lo simmi hi sun khawvang ah sim sal uhla a thup ih nan theihmi hi innpar ihsin phuang uh."},"28":{"text":"Taksapum a that thei naón thlarau a that thei lotu pawl cu va ṭih hlah uh. Takpum le thlarau a pahnih in hell sungih a that theitu Pathian kha va ṭih sawn uh."},"29":{"text":"Paisasen pakhat in sunṭam pahnih nan lei thei a si lo maw? Asinain cuih sunṭam pakhat hman cu nan Pa ih thu loin leilung ah a tla lo."},"30":{"text":"Nannih sinsin cu nan samphang hman a siar ṭheh a si."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah nan thin phang hlah uh. Sunṭam tampi hnakin nan man a khung sawn a si."},"32":{"text":"“Mi pakhat in mipi hmaiah ka minung a sinak kha a ṭanpi ngam a si ahcun vancung ka Pa hmaiah amah kha ka ṭanpi ve ding.","title":"Mi Hmaiih Khrih ṭannak (Luk 12.8-9)"},"33":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mipi hmaiih i hnongtu cu vancung ka Pa hmaiah ka hnong ve ding."},"34":{"text":"“Leilung tlunah remnak thlentertu ah a ra tiah i ruat hlah uh. Remnak tuahtu ah ka ra lo, ralnam kengin ka ra sawn a si.","title":"Remnak Asilo Ralnam Sawn (Luk 12.51-53 ; 14.26-27)"},"35":{"text":"Pa le fapa, nu le fanu, ni le vah pawl ral awter dingah ka ra a si."},"36":{"text":"Mi pakhat ih ral ṭihnung bik cu amah ih innsang mi an si ding."},"37":{"text":"“Zokhal sisehla, keimah hnakin a nu le a pa a duh sawntu cu i thluntu dingah a tlak lo. Keimah hnakin a fanu siseh, a fapa siseh, a duh sawntu cu i thluntu dingah a tlak lo."},"38":{"text":"Zokhal sisehla amah ih thinglamtah phur tahratin ka dungih i thlun lotu cu ka minung si dingah a tlak lo."},"39":{"text":"Amah ih nunnak hum a tumtu cu a nunnak a sung ding, asinain keimah ruangih a nunnak a liamtu cu a nunnak a hum ngah ding."},"40":{"text":"“Nanmah tlun-inn a lo ontu cu keimah tlun-inn ontu a si ve; keimah tlun-inn i ontu cun keimah thlahtu khal a on ve a si.","title":"Ṭhatman A Ngah Ding (Mar 9.41)"},"41":{"text":"Pathian thusimtu tlun-inn a ontu cu Pathian thuphurtu tlun-inn a on ruangah a thusimmi ṭhatman a ṭawm ve ding. Miṭha pakhat kha mi ṭha a si ruangih tlun-inn a ontu cu cuih miṭhapa ih ṭhatman a ṭawm ve ding."},"42":{"text":"Fiangte in ka lo sim: ka dungthluntu pawl lakih nauta bik kha ka dungthluntu a si ruangih tidai khuat khat a petu cu ṭhatman a ngah tengteng ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu hleihnih pawl hnenah thu a sim ṭheh tikah cutawk hmun ihsin a suak ih a kiangkap khawsungah thuzirh ding le thuphuang dingah a feh.","title":"Baptisma Petu Johan Ih Thlahmi Pawl (Luk 7.18-35)"},"2":{"text":"Thawng sung ihsin baptisma petu Johan in Khrih hnaṭuanmi thuhla kha a theih tikah amah thluntu ṭhenkhat pawl a thlah ih,"},"3":{"text":"“A ra ding, an timi cu nangmah hi na si maw, a si lole midang kan hngak hrih ding maw?” tiah Jesuh cu an sut."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Va feh uhla nan hmuhmi le nan theihmi hi Johan hnenah cun va sim uh:"},"5":{"text":"mitcaw in khua an hmu, ke-awl pawl an feh thei, miphaar pawl tla an thiang, hnaset pawl an hna a ong, mithi thawhter sal an si ih mifarah hnenah Thuthang ṭha phuan a si.","ref":"Isai 35.5-6; 61.1"},"6":{"text":"Keimah ih thuhla ah hin thinlung ṭhukṭhunnak a nei lotu cu mi thluasuak an si,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Johan ih dungthluntu pawl an feh sal hnuah Jesuh in misenpi hnenah Johan ih thu cu a sim. “Johan hnenah nelrawnih nan va feh tikah ziang hmu dingin so nan ruah awk? Thli in a sem ruangih a kur reromi phaikung maw?"},"8":{"text":"Ziang zoh dingah so nan feh? Hnipuan mawi zetzet a hrukmi pa zoh dingah maw? Cubangtuk hnipuan a hruktu cu siangpahrang innih ummi an si."},"9":{"text":"I sim hnik uh, ziang hmu dingin so nan feh? Profet zoh dingah maw? Asi, profet nan hmu. Asinain nan hmuhmi hi profet hnakin a tum sawn a si."},"10":{"text":"Ziangahtile Johan thuhla hi Ca Thianghlim in, ‘Pathian in na hrangih lamzin sialtu dingah na hmaiah ka palai ka thlah ding a si, a ti,’ tiah a ngan.","ref":"Mal 3.1"},"11":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim. Nunau ih hrinmi lakah baptisma petu Johan tlukih a tummi zohman an um dah lo. Sikhalsehla vancung Uknak ih mitenau bik hman khi Johan hnakin a tum sawn lai a si."},"12":{"text":"Johan ih thusim caan thokin atu tiang vancung Uknak cu dodalnak nasa zet a tong ih mi hel-hlong pawl in hramhram in laak an tum."},"13":{"text":"Khuahlan ihsin Johan san tiang profet pawl le Moses Daan pawl in hi vancung Uknak thu hi an sim."},"14":{"text":"An thu simmi nan zum duh a si ahcun Johan hi a ra ding tiih rak sim ciami Elijah kha amah hi a si."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah theihnak hna a neitu in thei uh."},"16":{"text":"“Tuih san minung pawl hi ziang thawn so ka tahṭhim ding? Anmah cu thil zuarnak hmunih a tomi nauhak pawl an bang. Nauhak bur khat in a dang nauhak bur khat hnenah,"},"17":{"text":"‘Mopuai khuangdar kan lo tumsak naón nan laam duh lo! Mithi phumnak hla kan sak khalle nan ṭap duh cuang lo,’ an ti."},"18":{"text":"Johan a rat tikah rawl a ul ih sabitti khal in loin a um tikah mi hmuahhmuah in ‘A sungah khawsia a lut a si,’ an ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Milai Fapa a ra ih a ei le a in an hmuh tikah mi hmuahhmuah in, ‘Hi pa hi zohhnik uh! Mi hrong dang le rawlpham zu-in pa hi; siahkhongtu pawl le misual pawl ih rualpi a si,’ an ti. Asinain Pathian ih fimnak cu a dik a si ti kha a hnaṭuannak in a langter,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh ih mangbangza tam bik a tuahnak khuami pawl in an sualnak an sir awk cuang lo ruangah a kawk hai.","title":"A Zumlotu Khua Pawl (Luk 10.13-15)"},"21":{"text":"“Maw Khorazin khua, na van a va duai ve! Maw Bethsaida khua, na van a va duai ve! Nan sungih mangbangza ka tuahmi pawl hi Tai-ar khua le Sidon khua ah rak tuah sisehla cuih khawsungmi pawl cun an sualsirnak langternak ah khumdip hnipuan hrukin vutcam an phulh awknak a reipi zo ding."},"22":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Thuṭhennak Ni ah Pathian in nannih hnakin Tai-ar le Sidon khuami pawl parah zaangfahnak tam sawn a nei ding."},"23":{"text":"Cun nang Kapernaum khua! Van tiangih hlirso awk na duh maw? Hell sungah hlon na si ding! Na sungih tuahmi mangbangza pawl hi Sodom khua ah tuah rak sisehla siat loin tuihsun tiang hi a hmun hrih ding!"},"24":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Thuṭhen Ni ah nang hnakin Sodom khua parah Pathian in zaangfahnak tam sawn a nei ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Culai ahcun Jesuh in, “Maw Ka pa, lei le vanih Bawi! Mifim le mithiam hnen ihsin na rak thuh ringringmi kha atu-ah zianghman a thiam lomi hnenih na langter ruangah ka lo lawm a si.","title":"Ka Hnenah Ra Cawl Uh (Luk 10.21-22)"},"26":{"text":"Asi, Ka pa, hi bangtuk ih si ding hi na duhmi a rak si."},"27":{"text":"“Ka Pa in ka kut sungah ziang hmuahhmuah i pek ṭheh zo. Pa siar lo zohman in Fapa an thei lo; cule Fapa le Fapa in thei ve hai seh tiih a hrilmi pawl siar lo, zohman in Pa an thei lo."},"28":{"text":"“Thilrit a phurmi le zonzaih a tuartu pawl, ka hnenah ra uh, colhdamnak ka lo pe ding."},"29":{"text":"Ka kawn hi phurhnik uh. Kei cu nunnem le tangdornak thinlung neimi ka si. Ka hnen ihsin zir uhla colhdamnak nan ngah ding."},"30":{"text":"Ziangahtile keiih kawn phurh cu a nuam ih ka thil khal a zaang a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnu reilote-ah Sabbath ni ah Jesuh cu sangvut lo lakin a feh. A dungthluntu pawl an ril a rawn ruangah sangvut an zuut ih a fang kha an ei.","title":"Sabbath Thu Suhnak (Mar 2.23-28 ; Luk 6.1-5)"},"2":{"text":"Cumi kha Farasi pawl in an hmuh tikah Jesuh hnenah, “Zohhnik, na dungthluntu pawl in Sabbath ni ah hiti ih an tuah hi Daan an buar a si,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in, “David le a rualpi pawl an ril a rawn laiah David in ziang a rak tuah ti kha nan siar dah lo maw?"},"4":{"text":"David cu Pathian inn sungah a lut ih Pathian hnenih pekmi saang a rualpi pawl thawn an ei a si kha! Cutiih an ei cu Daan ih duh lomi a si, ziangahtile cuih saang cu puithiam pawl lawngih ei theimi saang a si."},"5":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Sabbath tinte Biakinn sungah puithiam pawl in Sabbath daan an buar ringring ti kha Moses Daan sungah nan siar dah lo maw? Asinain mi sual ah ruah an si ual lo."},"6":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: hitawk ah hin Biakinn hnakih tum sawn a um a si."},"7":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim in, ‘ṭilva thawn raithawinak pek si loin mi zaangfahnak sawn ka duh a si,’ tiah a timi hi a tican ngaingai thei ngah uhla a sual lomi pawl kha nan sual a si, tiin nan ti lo ding."},"8":{"text":"Ziangahtile Milai Fapa hi Sabbath tlunih Bawi a si,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin Jesuh cu a feh ih sinakok sungah a lut.","title":"Kutzeng Pa (Mar 3.16 ; Luk 6.6-11)"},"10":{"text":"Cutawkah kutzeng pa pakhat a rak um. Jesuh sualpuh a duhtu pawl tla an rak um ve ih, “Sabbath ni ih mi damter hi kan Daan ih duhmi a si maw?” tiah Jesuh kha an sut."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Thuṭhimnak ah nanmah lakih mi pakhat in a tuu Sabbath ni ah khur thukpi sungah tla sehla suah loin maw a um ding?"},"12":{"text":"Minung cu tuu hnakin a let tampi in a sunglawi sawn a si. Curuangah Sabbath ni ah a ṭhami tuah cu kan Daan ih duhmi a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun kutzeng pa hnenah cun, “Na kut hawi aw,” tiah a ti. A kut cu a hawi ih a khatlam kut vekin a dam sal."},"14":{"text":"Cule Farasi pawl cu an feh ih Jesuh that dingah thu an ruat khawm."},"15":{"text":"Phiar an tum kha Jesuh in a theih tikah cutawk ihsin a suak. Cule miburpi in an thlun vivo. Mina hmuahhmuah a damter ih,","title":"Pathian Ih Hrilmi Riantu"},"16":{"text":"amah ih thuhla kha midang zo hnen hmanih sim lo dingin thu a pek."},"17":{"text":"Hitiih a tinak cu profet Isaiah kaa in Pathian in:"},"18":{"text":"“Ka hrilmi i riantu cu hinah a um; Ka duhdawtmi a si ih a parah ka lung a awi. A parah ka Thlarau ka re ding ih, Ka thuṭhennak cu miphun hmuah hmuah hnenah a than ding."},"19":{"text":"Mi thu eltu a si lo ding ih a au ciamco fawn lo ding. Lamzin ah ring zetin thu a sim lo ding."},"20":{"text":"A derdaimi hnenah a thinlung a nem ding ih, Bawmtu nei lo hnenah zaangfahnak a nei ding. Dingnak kha nehtu a siter lai hlan lo taimak a suah ding."},"21":{"text":"Cule a parah mi hmuahhmuah in ruahsannak an nei ding,” tiih a timi kimternak dingah a si.","ref":"Isai 42.1-4"},"22":{"text":"Cun Jesuh hnenah khawsia ih polh ruangah a mit a cawmi le a ṭong thei lomi pa pakhat an ratpi. Jesuh cun a damter ih a ṭong thei sal ih khua khal a hmu thei sal.","title":"Jesuh Le Beelzebul (Mar 3.20-30 ; Luk 11.14-23)"},"23":{"text":"Cutikah misenpi an mang a bang ih, “Hi pa hi David fapa a si ngai pei maw?” tiah an ti."},"24":{"text":"Cumi cu Farasi pawl in an theih tikah, “Khawsia a dawi theinak cu khawsia bawi Beelzebul in huham a pek ruangah a si,” an ti."},"25":{"text":"An thinlung ih ruahmi kha Jesuh in a thei ih an hnenah, “Khui ram khal sisehla ṭhen aw ih mah le mah a do awmi cu reipi an awh lo ding. Cun khua siseh, innsang siseh, ṭhen aw ih mah le mah a do awmi cu an ṭeekdarh thluh ding a si."},"26":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in Satan in Satan lala a dawisuak a si ahcun mah le mah do aw a si ruangah ziangtinso a ram cu a hmun thei ding?"},"27":{"text":"Nannih in, ‘Khawsia a dawi theinak cu Beelzebul in huham a pek ruangah a si,’ tiah in ti. Cuti a si ahcun a lo thluntu pawl hnenah khawsia dawi theinak huham kha zo in so a pek? Nanmah a lo thluntu pawl ih tuahmi lala hin nan palh a si ti kha a langter."},"28":{"text":"Pathian ih pekmi Thlarau thawn khawsia ka dawi thei a si ruangah Pathian Uknak cu nan hnenah a thleng zo tinak a si."},"29":{"text":"“Mi cakzet pa cu amah ṭem hmaisa lo cun zohman in a inn bauh tahrat in a thilri an laksak thei lo ding. Amah an ṭem ngah hnu lawngah a thilri an ram thei ding a si."},"30":{"text":"“Ka hnenih a ṭang lotu cu i dodaltu an si. I finkhawmpi lotu cu a ṭhekdarhtu an si."},"31":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: milai in ziangvek sualnak an tuah ih ziangvek ṭong siava an ṭong khalle ngaithiam theih an si. Asinain Thlarau Thianghlim a thangsiattu cu ngaithiam an si lo ding."},"32":{"text":"Milai Fapa a relsiatu cu ngaithiam theih an si ding. Asinain Thlarau Thianghlim a relsiatu cu atuih sanah siseh, hmailam sanah siseh, ngaithiam an si lo ding."},"33":{"text":"“Thingrah ṭha nei dingah thingkung ṭha neih a ṭul. Thingkung sia na neih ahcun a rah an sia ding. Thingkung cu a rah in theih a theih.","title":"Thingkung Le A Rah (Luk 6.43-45)"},"34":{"text":"Rul hrin pawl! Mi siava nan si ih ziangtinso ṭong ṭha cu nan ṭong thei ding? Kaa cun thinlung sungih a ummi a ṭong a si."},"35":{"text":"Mi ṭha cun thil ṭha a khawlmi sungin thil ṭha a suahter ih mi ṭha lo cun thil ṭha lo a khawlmi sungin thil ṭha lo a suahter a si."},"36":{"text":"“Thungai in ka lo sim: zokhal sisehla ralring loih a ṭongmi kha Thuṭhennak Ni ah ziang ruangah cutiin a ṭong ti a simfiang a ṭul leh ding."},"37":{"text":"Nangmah ih ṭong lala hi na mawh le mawh lo thuṭhennak ah hman a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cule Daanthiam ṭhenkhat le Farasi ṭhenkhat pawl in, “Sayapa, hmuhsaknak pakhatkhat kan mit hmuh ahhin tuah cila kan duh,” tiah an ti.","title":"Hmuhsaknak Tuah An Fial (Mar 8.11-12 ; Luk 11.29-32)"},"39":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Tuih san milai hi mi ṭha lo le Pathian ṭihzah lo pawl nan va si so! Hmuhsaknak tuah maw in fial? Ka tuah lo ding. Profet Jonah ih hmuhsaknak siar lo hmuhsaknak dang nan hmu lo ding."},"40":{"text":"Jonah cu ngapi pum sungah ni thum le zan thum a um vekin Milai Fapa khal leilung sungah ni thum le zan thum a um ve ding."},"41":{"text":"Thuṭhennak Ni ah Nineveh khuami pawl an ding pei ih an lo mawhthluk ding, ziangahtile Jonah thusimmi an theih tikah an sual an sir aw a si. Thungai in ka lo sim: Jonah hnakih tum sawn hinah a um."},"42":{"text":"Thuṭhennak Ni ah Sheba Siangpahrang bawinu a ding pei ih a lo mawhthluk ding, ziangahtile Siangpahrang Solomon fimnak theih duh ah lam hlapi ihsin a hung. Fiangtein ka lo sim: Solomon hnakih tum sawn hinah a um."},"43":{"text":"“Thlarau thiang lo cu mi pakhat sung ihsin a suah tikah ramṭhing ah colhnak hmun hawl in a vak vivo. Asinain colhnak hmun a hmuh lo tikah,","title":"Thlarau Thiang Lo A Kir Sal (Luk 11.24-26)"},"44":{"text":"‘Ka tlansan mi ka inn ah ka kir sal pei,’ tiah a ruat. Cutiin a kir sal ngaingai ih a inn cu a lawngin faite ih phiahmi a rak si kha a hmu."},"45":{"text":"Cule a suak sal ih amah hnakih a siava sawnmi thlarau pasarih a sawm ih cuih inn ahcun an ra um; cutiin a hlan hnakin cupa cu a luar sinsin. Cu bangtuk in tuihsan mi ṭha lo pawl parah hin a thleng ding,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh cu misenpi hnenih a ṭong rero laiah a nu le a nau pawl an ra. Amah ton duh ah a lengah an ding.","title":"Jesuh Ih Nu Le A Nau Pawl (Mar 3.31-35 ; Luk 8.19-21)"},"47":{"text":"Cutawkih a um vemi mi pakhat in, “Na nu le na nau pawl a lengah an ding, nangmah an lo biak duh a si,” tiah a sim."},"48":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh cun, “Zoso ka nu cu a si? Zoso ka naule pawl cu an si?” a ti hnuah,"},"49":{"text":"a Dungthluntu pawl kha a khih ih, “Zohhnik uh! Hinah ka nu le ka naule pawl cu an um."},"50":{"text":"Zokhal sisehla vancungih a ummi ka Pa ih duhnak a tuahtu hmuahhmuah cu ka unau, ka farnu le ka nu an si,” tiah a ti."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih sun thotho ah Jesuh cu inn ihsin a suak ih tili kapah a va feh ih a to hnuah thu a zirh.","title":"Thlaici Vorhtu Tahṭhimnak (Mar 4.1-9 ; Luk 8.4-8)"},"2":{"text":"A kiangkapih a ra khawmmi misenpi pawl an tam tuk ruangah lawng sungah a lut ih a to. Misenpi pawl cu tili kapah cun an ding."},"3":{"text":"Thuṭhimnak hmangin thu tampi a zirh: “Voikhat ah mi pakhat cu thlaici vorh dingah a feh."},"4":{"text":"Thlaici cu lo sungih a vorh tikah ṭhenkhat cu lamzin parah an tla ih cu pawl cu vate in an ei ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"A ṭhenkhat cu leilung malnak lungsedaap lakah an tla ih leilung a sah lo ruangah thlaici cu hmakhatte ah an ṭo."},"6":{"text":"Asinain ni a sat tikah a ṭo pekte pawl cu an thi sal; an hram in leilung thukpi ih hram a thlak thei lo ruangah an car lohli."},"7":{"text":"Thlaici a ṭhenkhat cu hlingbur lakah an tla ih an kho naón hlingbur cun a zaap ruangah an ṭhang thei lo."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla thlaici ṭhenkhat cu leilung ṭhatnak ah an tla ih ṭhenkhat cu a let zakhat, ṭhenkhat cu a let sawmruk, ṭhenkhat cu a let sawmthum in rawl a suak,” tiah a sim."},"9":{"text":"Jesuh cun, “Theihnak hna a neitu in thei uh,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun dungthluntu pawl a hnenah an ra ih, “Mipi hnenih thu na sim tikah ziangah so tahṭhimnak na hman ṭheu?” tiah an sut.","title":"Tahṭhimnak Ih Tumtahmi (Mar 4.10-12 ; Luk 8.9-10)"},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Vancung Uknak thuthuuk theih theinak cu nan hnenah pek a si zo. Asinain mipi hnenah cun pek a si lo."},"12":{"text":"Ziangahtile a neimi hnenah a hleifuan ih a neih tiangin pek beet a si ding ih a nei lomi hnen ihsin a neihsunte hman kha lak sak a si hrih ding."},"13":{"text":"Ziang ruangah an hnenih ka ṭong tikah thuṭhimnak ka hmang tile annih cun an zoh naón an hmu thei lo, an ngai naón an thei thei lo."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah profet Isaiah ih simmi kha an parah a kim a si. Profet Isaiah cun: ‘Hi minung pawl in an ngai rero ding naón an thei thei lo ding. An zoh rero ding naón an hmu thei lo ding."},"15":{"text":"Ziangahtile an thinlung a pit tuk, an thutheihnak hna a pit ih an mit khal an meng lo a si. Cu bangtuk in rak si hlah hai sehla an mit in an hmu ding, an hna in an thei ding ih, an thinlung khal in an thei thiam ding. Cuticun ka lamah an her ding ih ka damter hai ding a si, tiah Pathian in a ti’, tiah a sim.","ref":"Isai 6.9-10"},"16":{"text":"“Asinain nannih cu ziangtluk mi vannei so nan si! Nan mit in a hmu ih nan hna khal in a thei."},"17":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: nan hmuhmi le nan theihmi hi profet tampi le Pathian minung tampi in hmuh le theih an rak duhzet ve naón an rak hmu thei lo ih an rak thei thei fawn lo."},"18":{"text":"“Curuangah hi thlaici vorh tahṭhimnak ih tican hi ngai uhla thei uh.","title":"Jesuh In A Simfiang (Mar 4.13-20 ; Luk 8.11-15)"},"19":{"text":"Lamzin tluan ih a tlami thlaici pawl cu vancung Uknak thu a thei naón a tican a thei thei lotu pawl an si. An thinlung sungih tuhmi kha Miṭha lo pa in a laksak sal a si."},"20":{"text":"Lungsedaap lakih a tlami thlaici cu vancung Uknak thu an theih vete in lungawi zetin a pomtu an si."},"21":{"text":"Lungawi zetin an pom naón an sungah thukpi a pil lo ih rei an daih lo. An pommi thu ruangah harsatnak le hremnak a ra thlen tikah an let sal lohli."},"22":{"text":"Hlingbur lakih a tlami thlaici pawl cu vancung Uknak thu a thei naón hi leilung tlun nunnak thuhla ah donhar ih a ummi pawl an si. Sum le saw an duhnak in cuih thu cu a tuam ih rah an nei thei lo."},"23":{"text":"Leilung ṭha ih a tlami thlaici pawl cu vancung Uknak thu a hna in a thei ih a tican tla a thei thiamtu pawl an si. Annih cun rah an nei ih a ṭhen cu a let zakhat, a ṭhen cu a let sawmruk, a ṭhen cu a let sawmthum tiang an rah a si,” tiah a sim."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in tahṭhimnak dang pakhat a sim lala ih, “Vancung Uknak cu hi bangtuk hi a si. Mi pakhat in a lo sungah thlaici ṭha a vorh.","title":"Hrampi Tahṭhimnak"},"25":{"text":"Zan khatah mi hmuahhmuah an ihthat sungah a ralpa a ra ih rawl ci lak ahcun hrampi ci a vorhta ih a tlanhlo."},"26":{"text":"Thlai kho cu an hung ṭhang ih an vuih tikah hrampi khal cu an lang ve."},"27":{"text":"Cule a hnen-um pawl a hnenah an ra ih, ‘Bawipa, na lo sungih na vorhmi cu thlaici ṭha an si lo maw? Khuiinso hrampi hi an rat?’ tiah an sut."},"28":{"text":"Anih in, ‘Himi a tuahtu cu kan ralpa a si,’ tiah a sawn. Annih cun, ‘Hrampi cu kan va bawt pei maw?’ tiah an sut sal."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah anih in, ‘Bawt hlah uh, ziangahtile hrampi nan bawt zawng ah rawl kung tla nan bawtcih pang ding."},"30":{"text":"Rawl laak a cut hlan lo rawl kung le hrampi cu ṭhang tlang ko hai seh. Cule rawl latu pawl kha hmaisabik ah hrampi bawt uhla nan tom hnuah ur uh; cuih hnuah rawl cu khawm uhla ka cuam sungah thun uh,’ ka ti hai ding,” tiah a sim."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh in tahṭhimnak dang pakhat a sim sal. “Vancung Uknak cu hi bangtuk a si. Mi pakhat in anṭam ci a lak ih a lo sungah a vorh.","title":"Anṭam Ci Tahṭhimnak (Mar 4.30-32 ; Luk 13.18-19)"},"32":{"text":"Thlaici hmuahhmuah lakah a fate bikmi thlaici a si. Asinain a kho ih a ṭhan tikah cun rawl kung lakah a tum bikmi a si. Thingkung bangtuk a si ih vate pawl tla an ra ih a hnge lakah bu an sak,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Jesuh in tahṭhimnak pakhat an hnenah a sim sal. “Vancung Uknak cu nunau pakhat in thilnu malte a lak ih sangphut reel khat sungih a rawimi bangtuk a si. Cuih thilnu malte cun saang bawm khat cu a zatein a thoter ṭheh a si,” tiah a ti.","title":"Thilnu Tahṭhimnak (Luk 13.20-21)"},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in hi bangtuk thu pawl hi misenpi hnenih a sim tikah tahṭhimnak a hmang ṭheu. Tahṭhimnak hmang loin an hnenah ziang hman a sim dah lo.","title":"Tahṭhimnak A Hman Daan (Mar 4.33-34)"},"35":{"text":"Hi vekih a simnak cu profet ih simmi kha a kim theinak dingah a si. Profet ih sim mi cu: “An hnenih ka ṭong tikah tahṭhimnak ka hmang ding; Leilung hramthok ihsin theih dah lomi thil kha an hnenah ka phuang ding,” ti a si.","ref":"Saam 78.2"},"36":{"text":"Jesuh cun misenpi kha a fehsan ih inn sungah a lut. Cutikah a dungthluntu pawl a hnenah an ra ih, “Lo sungih hrampi tahṭhimnak kha a tican in sim aw,” tiah an ti.","title":"Jesuh In Hrampi Thu A Fianter"},"37":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Thlaici ṭha a vorhtu cu Milai Fapa a si."},"38":{"text":"Lo cu hi leilungpi hi a si; thlaici ṭha cu vancung Uknak a cotu minung pawl an si ih hrampi cu Mi ṭha lo pa ih milai pawl an si."},"39":{"text":"Hrampi ci a vorhtu kan ral cu Satan a si. Rawlkhawm caan cu san cemnak caan a si ih rawlkhawmtu pawl cu vancungmi an si."},"40":{"text":"Hrampi cu an khawm ih meisa in an ur ṭheh; cu bangtuk in san cemnak caanah cun a si ve ding."},"41":{"text":"Milai Fapa in a Uknak sung ihsin mi a sualtertu le thil ṭha lo a tuahtu pawl a lengih suahhlo dingah a vancungmi pawl a thlah ding."},"42":{"text":"Cumi pawl cu meisa sungah an paih ding ih cutawkah ṭap-ai in an hacang an rial ding."},"43":{"text":"Cun Pathian ih minung pawl cu an Pa Pathian ih Uknak sungah ni bangin an tleu ding. Theihnak hna a neitu in thei uh,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"“Vancung Uknak cu lo sungih thuhmi hlawnthil bangtuk a si. Cuih hlawnthil cu mi pakhatkhat in a hmuh tikah ṭhatein a khuhta ih lungawi aipuang in innih a neihmi hmuahhmuah kha a zuar ih cuih lo cu a lei,” tiah Jesuh in a sim.","title":"Thuh-mi Hlawnthil Tahṭhimnak"},"45":{"text":"“Vancung Uknak cu hi bangtuk a si. Sum tuahtu pakhat in keplung mankhung a hawl.","title":"Lung Mankhung Tahṭhimnak"},"46":{"text":"A man a khung taktakmi keplung a hmuh tikah a neihmi dang hmuahhmuah kha a zuar ih cuih lung cu a lei,” tiah a sim."},"47":{"text":"“Vancung Uknak cu tili sungih vorhmi sur bangtuk a si. Nga kaitu hrekkhat in an sur cu tili sungah an vorh ih nga phunkim an awk.","title":"Sur In Tahṭhimnak"},"48":{"text":"An sur a khah tikah ti kapah an hnuk ih an tohmun in nga cu an hril; nga ṭha pawl cu an bawm sungah an san ih nga ṭha lo cu an hlon."},"49":{"text":"Cu bangtuk in san cemnak caanah cun a si ding; vancungmi pawl an feh ding ih mi ṭha pawl lak ihsin mi ṭha lo pawl cu an khawm ding ih,"},"50":{"text":"meisa sungah an hlon ding. Cutawkah an ṭap an raak ding ih an hacang an rial ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"51":{"text":"Misenpi pawl cu Jesuh in, “Hi thu hmuahhmuah hi nan thei thei maw?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Kan thei,” tiah an sawn.","title":"Thudik Thar le Hlun"},"52":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Cu a si ahcun vancung Uknak thu a zir zomi Daan zirhtu pohpoh cu a thilri retnak inn sung ihsin thil hlun le thil thar a hun suahtu, inn neitu pa bangtuk a si,” tiah a sim."},"53":{"text":"Jesuh in hi tahṭhimnak pawl a sim ṭheh tikah cutawk ihsin a suak ih,","title":"Nazareth Ah Jesuh An Hnong (Mar 6.1-6 ; Luk 4.16-30)"},"54":{"text":"a khua ah a tlung. An sinakok ah thu a zirh hai ih a thu a theitu pawl cu an mang a bang ngaingai. “Hi bangtuk fimnak hi khuitawk in so a lak?” tiah an sut aw. “Hi bangtuk mangbangza hi ziangtinso a tuah thei?"},"55":{"text":"Lettama fapa a si lo maw? Mari kha a nu a si lo maw? Jeim, Josef, Simon le Judas kha a naule an si lo maw?"},"56":{"text":"A far le tla hitawk ah an um ṭheh a si lo maw? Khui-inso hi bangtuk hi a lak?” tiah an ti."},"57":{"text":"Cuti cun Jesuh cu an hnong. Jesuh in an hnenah, “Profet cu amah ih suahnak khua le innsang siar lo hmun dangah cun upatnak a tong a si,” tiah a ti."},"58":{"text":"Zumnak an neih lo ruangah cutawkah cun mangbangza tampi a tuah lo."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih tikcu ah Galilee ram uktu Herod in Jesuh thuhla a thei.","title":"Baptisma Petu Johan Thihnak (Mar 6.14-29 ; Luk 9.7-9)"},"2":{"text":"Herod in, “Hi pa hi baptisma petu Johan a nung salmi a si ko. Cu ruangah a si hiti ih mangbangza a tuah thei,” tiah a kut hnuai bawi pawl kha a sim."},"3":{"text":"Cuih hlanah Herod in Johan kaih ding thu a pek; cule an kai ih thirhri in an khih hnuah thawng ah an thlak. Ziangah cutiin a tuah tile a naupa Filip ih nupi Herodias ruangah a si."},"4":{"text":"Tihnimtu Johan in Herod cu, “Herodias na ṭhit hi a dik lo,” tiah a rak ti ṭheu ruangah,"},"5":{"text":"Herod in Johan cu thah a duh, asinain Judah mi pawl a ṭih, ziangahtile Johan cu profet a si tiah an ruahmi a si."},"6":{"text":"Cule Herod suah ni ah Herodias fanu cu mizapi hmaiah a laam ciamco. Herod cu a lung a kim ngaingai ih a hnenah,"},"7":{"text":"“I dil mi pohpoh ka lo pe ding tiin ka lo kam a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"A nu ih ruahnak a pek vekin Herod hnenah, “Hitawk hmun rori ahhin baptistma petu Johan ih lu cu darkheng in i pe aw,” tiah a fanu cun a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Siangpahrang bawipa cu a riah a sia ngaingai. Sikhalsehla a sawmmi pawl hmai rori ih thukamnak a tuah zo ruangah a dil vekih tuah dingah thu a pek."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Johan cu thawng sung rori ahcun a lu a tanter."},"11":{"text":"Johan ih lu cu darkheng in an run keng ih Herodias fanu cu an pek; anih in a nu Herodias hnenah a fehpi."},"12":{"text":"Cun Johan dungthluntu pawl cu an ra ih a ruak an lak ih an phum; cuih hnuah Jesuh cu an va sim."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh cu Johan thuhla a theih tikah a suak ih lawng a to ih a ṭhinnak hmun ah amah lawng a feh. Cuih thu cu mipi in an theih tikah an khua cio in an pok ih lei par in an feh ih amah cu an thlun.","title":"Jesuh In Mi Thawngnga Rawl A Dar (Mar 6.30-44 ; Luk 9.10-17 ; Joh 6.1-14)"},"14":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng ihsin a suak ih misenpi kha a hmuh tikah a thinlung cu zaangfahnak in a khat ih cutawkah mina tampi tla a damter."},"15":{"text":"Cuih ni zanlam ah a dungthluntu pawl cu a hnenah an ra ih, “Khua a siim thlang, hitawk hi hmun ṭhing a si fawn. Mipi hi kiangkap khua ah fehter awla anmah ih hrangah rawl va lei hai seh,” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh in, “An feh a ṭul lo ding; nanmah in an ei ding rawl ziangtal pe uh,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Annih in, “Hitawkih kan neihmi zate cu sanghlom nga le nga pum hnih lawng an si,” an ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Ka hnenah rak keng uh,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Misenpi pawl cu hrampi parih to dingah thu a pekta ih saang hlom nga le nga pum hnih cu a lak hnuah van lam hoi in Pathian hnenah lungawi thu a sim. saang cu a phel ih a dungthlun pawl hnenah a pek; a dungthlun pawl in misenpi hnenah an zem sin."},"20":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in an ei ih an khopzet. Cuih hnuah an hlahmi kha dungthluntu pawl in an sar ih bawm hleihnih a khat."},"21":{"text":"Rawl a eitu pawl cu nunau le nauhak pawl siar cih loin pacang hlir thawng nga tluk an si."},"22":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in misenpi pawl cu a tlunter. A dungthluntu pawl cu lawng sungah a luhter ih tili khatlam kapah a fehter hai.","title":"Tidai Parah Jesuh A Feh (Mar 6.45-52 ; Joh 6.15-21)"},"23":{"text":"Misenpi a tlunter hnuah amah lawng thlacam dingah tlang parah a hung kai. Khua a siim thlang naón cutawkah Jesuh cu amah lawng a um."},"24":{"text":"Long cu tili parah hlat nawn a thleng zo ih thli a hmaiton in a hraan ruangah tilet in lawng cu suk le so ah a den ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Zinglam nazi pathum le paruk karah Jesuh cu tidai parah a feh ih a dungthluntu pawl hnen pan in a ra."},"26":{"text":"A dungthluntu pawl in tidai parih a feh rero an hmuh tikah an ṭih ngaingai. “Muthla a si lo maw?” tiah an ti ih thinphang in an raak ciamco."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh in hmakhatte ah, “ṭih hlah uh! Keimah ka si! Zianghman phan ding a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cule Piter in, “Bawipa, nangmah na si ngaingai ahcun na hnenah tidai parin i fehter ve aw,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ra aw he,” tiah a ti. Curuangah Piter cu lawng sung ihsin a suak ih tidai par in Jesuh hnenah cun a feh."},"30":{"text":"Asinain thli na pi ih a hran kha a hmuh tikah a ṭih ih ti sungah cun a pil deuhdeuh. Cutikah, “Bawipa, i run aw!” tiah a au."},"31":{"text":"Hmakhatteah Jesuh in a hei dawh ih a hei kaih ngah hnuah, “Na zumnak a va mal so! Ziangah so na zum lo lawmmam?” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"An pahnih cun lawng sungah an lut ih thli cu a dai."},"33":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu pawl in lawng sungah Jesuh cu an biak ih, “Nang cu Pathian Fapa ngaingai na si,” tiah an ti."},"34":{"text":"Tili cu an tan ih Gennesaret peng an va thleng.","title":"Gennesaret Ah Mi A Damter (Mar 6.53-56)"},"35":{"text":"Cutawk minung pawl khal in Jesuh cu an rak thei thiam. Curuangah kiangkapih a ummi mina hmuahhmuah an ko ih Jesuh hnenah an ratpi."},"36":{"text":"A dam lomi pawl in a puanzim tetal tham thei dingin an dil ih a puanzim a thamtu hmuahhmuah cu an dam thluh."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Farasi hrekkhat le Daanthiam ṭhenkhat pawl cu, Jerusalem ihsin Jesuh hnenah an ra ih,","title":"Pupa Pawlih Thuzirhmi (Mar 7.1-13)"},"2":{"text":"“Ziangah so na dungthluntu pawl in kan pupa pawl ih in zirhtami daan an buar? Rawl an ei hlanah a daan vekin an kut an kholh lo,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Cuti asile ziangah so nannih teh nanmah ih thuzirhmi lawng nan thlun ih Pathian thukham sawn nan buar?"},"4":{"text":"Pathian in, ‘Nan nu le nan pa upat uh,’ a ti. ‘A nu siseh, a pa siseh a camsiattu cu thah a si pei,’ tiin a ti.","ref":"Suah 20.12; Daan 5.16; Suah 21.17; Pui 20.9"},"5":{"text":"Asinain nannih ih nan zirhmi cu: mi pakhatkhat in a nu maw, a pa maw bomnak dingah thil a neihmi kha, ‘Himi cu Pathian ta a si,’ a ti ahcun,"},"6":{"text":"a nu siseh, a pa siseh a bawm a ṭul nawn lo, tiah nan ti. Cu bangtuk in nanmah ih thuzirhmi nan thlun ih Pathian thukham sawn ziang hmanah nan siar lo."},"7":{"text":"Nannih titer-aw pawl! Profet Isaiah in nanmah ih thuhla a rak simmi hi a va dik lawmmam so! Isaiah in,"},"8":{"text":"‘Himi pawl hin an kaa lawng in in upat ih an thinlung ngaingai cun in hlat zet a si."},"9":{"text":"Milai ih tuahcopmi daan kha, Pathian pekmi daan vekin an zirh ruangah, Keimah in biak rero khal hi ṭhathnemnak zianghman a nei lo, tiah Pathian in a ti,’ tiah a sim,” a ti.","ref":"Isai 29.13"},"10":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in mi tampi a hnenah a ko ih, an hnenah, “Ngai uhla theihnik uh!","title":"Minung A Baaltertu Thil (Mar 7.14-23)"},"11":{"text":"Minung a baaltertu hi a kaa ihsin a lutmi thil an si lo, a kaa ihsin a hung suakmi in mi a baalter sawn a si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule a dungthluntu pawl a hnenah an ra ih, “Na ṭongmi in Farasi pawl an thin a natter, ti hi na thei maw?” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Vancung i a ummi ka Pa in a phun lomi kung cu bawt ding a si ko."},"14":{"text":"Anmah ruangah nan hnaihnok hlah seh! Annih tla cu hotu mitcaw pawl an si; mitcaw in mitcaw a hruai ahcun an pahnih in khursungah an tla ding,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Piter in, “Cuih na ṭongmi cu fiangtein in sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Midang pawl hnakin nan fim deuh cuang lo maw si?"},"17":{"text":"Nan thei thei lo maw? Mi kaa sungin a lutmi thil cu a pumpi ah a thleng ih cuticun a lengah a lansuak."},"18":{"text":"Asinain a kaa in a suakmi cu a thinlung sung ihsin a hung suakmi a si ruangah cumi in minung a baalter a si."},"19":{"text":"Ziangahtile mi a thattertu, ṭaangṭawm sualnak a tuahtertu, nupa sualnak a tuahtertu, ruk a rutertu, thuphan a pertertu, le mi a thangsiattertu ruahnak siava hmuahhmuah cu a thinlung sung ihsin a suakmi an si."},"20":{"text":"Hi pawl in milai cu a baalter a si. Sikhalsehla rawl ei hlanih kut kholh lo cun mi a baalter lo,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh cu cutawk ihsin a suak ih Tai-ar le Sidon khua kiangkap ah a feh.","title":"Nunau Nu Ih Zumnak (Mar 7.24-30)"},"22":{"text":"Cuih ramih a ummi Kanaan nunau pakhat in Jesuh hnenah a ra ih, “Maw David fapa, i zaangfah aw. Ka fanu cu khawsia in a polh ih vansaanglam in a um,” tiah a ra ṭahhnawh."},"23":{"text":"Asinain a hnenah Jesuh in kam khat hman a sawn lo. A dungthluntu pawl an ra ih, “Hi nu hi dawihlo aw! In thlun ringring ih in auh ciamco,” tiah Jesuh cu an dil."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Israel mi tuu hlo pawl hrang lawngah thlah mi ka si,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah cuih nunau nu cu Jesuh ke hramah a ra bok ih, “Bawipa, i zaangfah hramhram ko aw!” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nauhak rawl lak tahratin uico pek cu a dik lo a si,” tiah a sawn."},"27":{"text":"Nunau nu in, “Asi, bawipa, na timi cu a dikmi a si. Sikhalsehla bawi pawl ih cabuai ihsin a tlami rawl ṭilfuan cu uico tla in an ei ṭheu ko a sisi!” tiah a let."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Minu, na zumnak cu a nasa a si. Na duhmi cu tuahsak na si pei,” tiah a ti. Culaifang ah a fanu cu a rak dam."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh cu cutawk ihsin a suak ih Galilee Tili kapin a feh. Tlang parah a hung kai ih cunah a to.","title":"Jesuh In Mi Tampi A Damter"},"30":{"text":"Mi tam ngaingai in amah cu an pan. Ke-awl, mitcaw, mizeng, ṭong thiam lo le a na mi tampi Jesuh ke hramah an rak hruai. Jesuh in an zatein a damter."},"31":{"text":"Ṭong thiam lomi an ṭong thei, mizeng an dam, ke-awl pawl ṭhatein an feh thei ih mitcaw tla in khua an hmuh sal kha mipi in an hmuh tikah an khawruah a har ngaingai ih Israel Pathian an thangṭhat."},"32":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthlun pawl kha a hnenah a ko ih, “Hi miburpi hi ka hnenah ni thum sung an um zo ih rawl ei ding zianghman an neih lo ruangah ka zaang an fak ngaingai. Rawl do ta loih tlunter cu ka duh lo, lamzin ah an ṭaamsawl ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh In Mi Thawngli Rawl A Daar (Mar 8.1-10)"},"33":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cun, “Milai hizat daar dingah hi ramṭhing ahhin khuitawk rawl so kan va lak ding?” an ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in, “saang hlom ziangzatso nan neih?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “saang hlom sarih le nga fatete malte lawng a um,” tiah an ti."},"35":{"text":"Jesuh in misenpi cu leilung ah a toter."},"36":{"text":"Cun saang hlom sarih le nga malte cu a lak ih Pathian hnenah lungawi thu a sim hnuah a phel ih a dungthlun pawl a pek. Dungthluntu pawl in mipi hnenah an zem sin."},"37":{"text":"An zatein an ei ih an khopzet. Cule an hlahmi kha dungthluntu pawl in an sar ih bawm sarih a khat."},"38":{"text":"A eitu pawl cu nunau le nauhak siarcih loin pacang hlir thawngli an si."},"39":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh in mipi cu a tlunter ih amah cu lawng sungah a lut ih Magadan peng ah a feh."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sadusi le Farasi ṭhenkhat cu Jesuh hnenah an ra ih, a sual hawl duh ah, “Pathian ih umpi mi na si ahcun hmuhsaknak tuah hnik aw,” tiah an ti.","title":"Mangbangza Tuah An Fial (Mar 8.11-13 ; Luk 12.54-56)"},"2":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh cun, “Ni a tlak tikah ‘Van a sen le nikhua a ṭha ding,’ tiah nan ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun zing thlapit ah ‘Van kam a sen ih a dup asile khua a dur ruangah ruah a sur ding,’ nan ti. Van zoh tahratin ni khua ṭhat le siat ding nan sim thei, asinain tuih caan khihhmuhtu pawl hi nan theithiam fawn lo!"},"4":{"text":"Tuih san minung hi mi ṭha lo le Pathian poisa lo pawl nan va si so! Mangbangza tuah dingah in fial, asinain ka tuah lo ding. Nan hrangah Jonah thu siar lo mangbangza dang a um lo ding,” tiah a ti. Cutiin a suak ih a feh."},"5":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cu tili an tan ih khatlam ral an thleng; annih in saang ken an hngilh.","title":"Farasi Le Sadusi Pawlih Thilnu (Mar 8.14-21)"},"6":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Daithlang hlah uh! Farasi le Sadusi pawl ih thilnu khi ralring uh,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"“Sang kan ken lo ruangah hi bangtuk in a sim a si pei,” tiah pakhat le pakhat an ti aw."},"8":{"text":"Cutiih an rel ruri cu Jesuh in a theih tikah, “saang nan neih lo thu cu ziangah so nan rel duh rero? Nan zumnak a va mal so!"},"9":{"text":"Nan thei thei hrih lo maw? Mi thawng nga hrangah saang hlom nga ka phel kha nan thei nawn lo maw? An hlah mi bawm ziangzat nan sar ti nan cing nawn lo maw?"},"10":{"text":"Mi thawngli hrangih saang hlom sarih kha nan cing lai maw? An hlah mi bawm ziangzatso nan sar kha?"},"11":{"text":"Nan hnenih ka simmi hi saang thu a si lo tihi ziangah so nan theih thei lo? Farasi le Sadusi pawl ih thilnu hi ralring uh,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutikah a dungthlun pawl in, “Ralring uh,” tiah a timi kha saangih rawimi thilnu si loin Farasi le Sadusi pawl ih zirhnak thilnu a si sawn, ti kha an thei thiam sal."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh cu Sisaria Filipi peng ah a feh ih cu tawkah a dungthlun pawl kha, “Mi in Milai Fapa hi zo a si in ti so?” tiah a sut.","title":"Piter In Jesuh Thu A Phuannak (Mar 8.27-30 ; Luk 9.18-21)"},"14":{"text":"Annih in, “Mi ṭhenkhat in baptisma petu Johan a si an lo ti, mi ṭhenkhat in Elijah a si an lo ti. A ṭhenkhat cun Jeremiah, a si lole profet pakhatkhat a si ding an lo ti,” tiah an let."},"15":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nannih in teh!
