Kei hi zo a si in ti so?” tiah a sut."},"16":{"text":"Simon Piter in, “Nang cu a nungmi Pathian ih Fapa Messiah na si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Johan fapa Simon, mi vannei na si! Ziangahtile hi thu cu minung hnen ihsin na ngahmi a si lo, vancung i a um ka Pa in na hnenih a phuanmi a si."},"18":{"text":"Ka lo sim Piter, nang cu lungto na si; hi lungpi parah hin ka kawhhran ka din ding ih thihnak hman in a neh thei dah lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Vancung Uknak tawhfung ka lo pe ding ih leilung tlunih na khammi cu vancungah kham a si ve ding ih leilung tlunih na onmi cu vancung khalah on a si ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in a dungthlun pawl kha Messiah a si ti zohman sim lo dingin thu a pek."},"21":{"text":"Cuih caan thokin Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Jerusalem ah ka feh ding ih hotu pawl, puithiam upa pawl le Daan zirhtu pawl ih kut ah harnak ka tong ding. In that ding, asinain ni thum hnuah thawhter sal ka si ding,” tiah fiangtein a sim.","title":"Jesuh In A Thihnak Ding Thu A Sim (Mar 8.31—9.1 ; Luk 9.22-27)"},"22":{"text":"Piter in Jesuh cu a dang deuhah a hruai ih a mawhthluk. “Bawipa, Pathian in duh hram hlah seh. Hi bangtuk cu na parah thleng hram hlahseh,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh cu a her ih Piter hnenah, “Nang Satan, ka hnen ihsin tlan aw! Ka fehnak lamzin khamtu na si, ziangahtile hi bangtuk na ruahnak hi Pathian hnen ihsin a rami a si lo, milai hnenin a rami a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Zokhal keimah thlun a duhtu cu amah ih duhnak kha taan in a thinglamtah phur in i thlun seh."},"25":{"text":"Ziangahtile zokhal mah nunnak hum a duhtu cu a nunnak a sung ding; asinain keimah ruangah a nunnak a liamtu cun a nunnak a hum ngah ding."},"26":{"text":"Mi pakhat in leilung pumpuluk co khalsehla a nunnak a hloh ahcun ziang ṭhathnemnak so a um? Zianghman a ṭhahnem lo! A nunnak kha zianghman in a lei thei sal nawn lo ding."},"27":{"text":"Milai Fapa hi a Pa ih sunlawinak le vancungmi pawl thawn a ra cing ding ih mi hmuahhmuah kha an hnaṭuanmi vekin ṭuanman a pek ding."},"28":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Milai Fapa hi Siangpahrang vekin a rat nan hmuh hlan lo nanmah lakah a thi lo dingmi nan um,” tiah a ti."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni ruk hnuah Jesuh in Piter le Jeim le a nau Johan kha tlang saangpi parah a kaipi ih anmah lawng an um.","title":"Jesuh Ih Hmuihmel Thlengnak (Mar 9.2-13 ; Luk 9.28-36)"},"2":{"text":"Cule an mithmuh rori ah Jesuh cu a hmuihmel a thleng aw; a hmai cu ni bangin a tleu ih a hnipuan cu mi tlet thei khopin a raang."},"3":{"text":"Cuih hnuah dungthluntu pathum cun Moses le Elijah kha Jesuh thawn thu ruah aw rero in an hmu."},"4":{"text":"Cule Piter in, “Bawipa, hitawk ih kan um hi a ṭha tuk; na duhmi a si ahcun riahbuk pathum in ka sak ding; pakhat cu na hrangah, pakhat cu Moses hrangah, pakhat cu Elijah hrangah,” tiah Jesuh hnenah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutiih a ṭong rero laiah a tleu zetmi mero in a run zeel hai ih mero sungin aw pakhat in, “Hi pa cu ka duhdawt zetmi ka Fapa a si; a parah ka lung a kimzet, a thu ngai uh,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cuih aw cu dungthluntu pawl in an theih tikah an ṭih tuk ih leilung ah an bok."},"7":{"text":"Jesuh cu a ra ih a tham hai. “Tho uh, ṭih hlah uh,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutikah an hun zoh ih Jesuh lawng a si kha an hmu."},"9":{"text":"Tlangpar ihsin an rung ṭum tikah Jesuh in, “Hi nan hmuhmi hi Milai Fapa thihnak ihsin thawhter a si hlan cu zohman nan sim lo pei,” tiah feltein a cah."},"10":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu pawl in Jesuh cu, “Ziangah so Daanthiam pawl in Elijah a ra hmaisa ding tiah an ti?” tiah an sut."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Elijah cu a ra hmaisa taktak ding ih ziang hmuahhmuah amah in a rak timtuah cia ding a si."},"12":{"text":"Asinain ka lo sim: Elijah cu a ra thleng zo ih mi in zo a si ti an theih lo ruangah an duhtawk in an tuahsiat a si. Cuvek thotho in Milai Fapa khal hi an tuahsiat ve ding,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutikah dungthluntu pawl in a simmi hi baptisma petu Johan ih thuhla a si, ti kha an thei thiam."},"14":{"text":"Misenpi hnenih an kir sal tikah mi pakhat cu Jesuh hnenah a ra ih a hmaiah khukbil tahratin,","title":"Jesuh In Khawsia Polhmi A Damter (Mar 9.14-29 ; Luk 9.37-43a)"},"15":{"text":"“Bawipa, ka fapa hi zaangfah hram aw. Merai a nei ih a nat a thawh tikah cun awloksong ngaingai a si; meisa sung le tidai sung tla ah a paih aw ṭheu."},"16":{"text":"Na dungthluntu pawl hnenah ka ratpi naón an damter thei lo,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Maw zumnak mal le misual mipalh pawl! Ziangtik tiangso ka lo umpi hrih ding? Ziangtik tiangso ka lo zawi hrih hai ding? Nauhak pa cu ka hnenah ratpi uh,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh in khawsia cu suak dingin a kawk ih nauhakpa ih sung ihsin khawsia cu a suak; cu ihsin nauhak pa cu a dam."},"19":{"text":"Cun dungthluntu pawl cu zohmanih theih loin Jesuh hnenah an ra ih, “Ziangah so kannih hmuah in kan dawi suak thei lo?” tiah an sut."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nan zumnak a mal ruangah a si. Fiangtein ka lo sim: anṭam ci tia zumnak nan neih ahcun hi tlang hi ‘Hitawk ihsin khi tawkah ṭhawn aw,’ nan ti ahcun a ṭhawn ding. Ziang hmuahhmuah nan tuah thei ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cu an zatein Galilee ih an tonkhawm awk tikah Jesuh in an hnen ah, “Milai Fapa hi milai kutah pek a si cing ding ih an that ding.","title":"Jesuh In A Thihnak Thu A Simsal (Mar 9.30-32 ; Luk 9.43b-45)"},"23":{"text":"Asinain ni thum ni ah thawhter sal a si ding,” tiah a sim. Dungthluntu pawl cu an riah a sia ngaingai."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu Kapernaum khua an thlen tikah biakinn ngunkhuai khongtu pawl Piter hnenah an ra ih, “Nan Sayapa hin biakinn ngunkhuai a pe maw?” tiah an sut.","title":"Biakinn Ngunkhuai Peknak"},"25":{"text":"Piter in, “Asi, a pe,” tiah a ti. Piter cu inn sungih a luh tikah Jesuh a ṭong hmaisa ih, “Simon, ziangtin na ruat? Hi leitlun siangpahrang hnenah zo in so ramdang ihsin thil luhpi man, a si lole ngunkhuai an pek? Ramsung mi in maw, ramdang mi in so?” tiah a sut."},"26":{"text":"Piter in, “Ramdang mi in,” tiah a let. Jesuh in, “A ṭha, cuti a si ahcun ramsung mi cun pek a ṭul lo tinak a si cu!"},"27":{"text":"Asinain hi mi pawl thinhengter kan duh lo. Curuangah tili ah va feh awla sio va thlak aw. Na awh hmaisa bikmi nga kaa sungah nang le kei hrangah biakinn ngunkhuai pek ding tawkin tangka na hmu ding. Cumi cu la awla va pe aw,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih caanah dungthluntu pawl cu Jesuh hnenah an ra ih, “Vancung Uknak ah zoso a tum bik?” tiah an sut.","title":"Zoso A Tum Bik (Mar 9.33-37 ; Luk 9.46-48)"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in nauhakte pakhat a ko ih an hmaiah a dinter hnuah,"},"3":{"text":"“Fiangtein ka lo sim: nan thinlung nan thleng ih hi nauhakte bangtuk nan si lo ahcun vancung Uknak sungah nan lut dah lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Mi tangah a dor ih hi nauhak bangtuk a si mi cu vancung Uknak sungah a tum bikmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Cun ka hmin in hi bangtuk nauhakte a cohlangtu cu keimah a cohlangtu a si."},"6":{"text":"“Zokhal in hi nauhakte pakhatkhat keimah i zumnak ihsin a pialtertu cu a hngawng ah fangcang rialnak lungtum thlaih tahratin tifinriat sungah thlak sisehla amah ih hrangah a ṭha sawn.","title":"Sual Forhnak (Mar 9.42-48 ; Luk 17.1-2)"},"7":{"text":"Leilung tlunah hin zumnak pialtertu thil tampi an um hi a poi ngaingai. Cubangtuk cu a um ringring ko ding; cutiih mi a pialtertu pawl cu an hrangah a poimawh bik miangmo a si."},"8":{"text":"“Nan kut in siseh, nan ke in siseh, nan zumnak a lo pialter a si ahcun tan uhla hlon uh. Kut pahnih le ke pahnih thawn kumkhua meisa sungih nan tlak hnak cun kut lo le ke loin nunnak sungih nan luh a ṭha sawn."},"9":{"text":"Cule nan mit in nan zumnak a hlohter a si ahcun phorh uhla hlon uh. Mit pahnih thawn hell meisa sungih tlak hnak cun mit pakhat lawng thawn nunnak sungih luh a ṭha sawn."},"10":{"text":"“Hi bangtuk nauhakte nan zawmtai lonak dingah ralring uh. Fiangtein ka lo sim: anmah kilvengtu vancungmi pawl cu vancungih ka Pa ih hmaiah an um ringring a si.","title":"A Hlomi Tuu Tahṭhimnak (Luk 15.3-7)"},"11":{"text":"Milai Fapa cu a hlomi hawl dingah a ra."},"12":{"text":"“Tuu zakhat a nei mipa in a tuu pakhat a hloh le ziang a tuah ding tiah nan ruat? Tlang parih hrampi a piat reromi a tuu sawmkua le pakua cu a taanta ding ih a hlomi tuu pakhat hawl dingah a feh ding."},"13":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: a hmuh tikah a hlo lomi sawmkua le pakua hnakin a hlomi tuu pakhat parah a lung a awi sawn a si."},"14":{"text":"Cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in vancungih a ummi nan Pa in hi nauhaktete lakih pakhat hman hlo dingah a siang lo a si."},"15":{"text":"“Nan unau pakhat nan parih a sual ahcun va feh uhla a sualnak va sim uh. Asinain zohmanih theih loin nanmah lawng tong aw uh. Nan thu a lo ngai a si ahcun nan unau nan ngah sal a si.","title":"A Sualmi Unau"},"16":{"text":"Asinain nan thu a ngai lo a si ahcun theihpitu pakhat maw pahnih maw fehpi uh. Ca Thianghlim in, “Sual puh awknak hmuahhmuah cu theihpitu pahnih maw, cuhnak tam maw um hai seh,” a ti vekin na fehpi mi cu thutheitu an si ding.","ref":"Daan 19.15"},"17":{"text":"Cule nan thu a ngai lo a si ahcun a thuhla pawl kimtein kawhhran hnenah nan sim pei. A netnak ah kawhhran ih thu khal a ngai lo a si ahcun amah cu khawvelmi a si lo ah siahkhongtu tlukah va ruat uh."},"18":{"text":"“Cun nan zatein ka lo sim: leilung tlunih nan khammi cu vancung khalah kham a si ve ding; cule leilung tlunih nan thlahmi cu vancung khalah thlah a si ve ding.","title":"Khammi Le Kham Lomi"},"19":{"text":"“A dang ka lo sim hrih ding: leitlun ah thlacam in nan dil mi thu ah mi pahnih nan lungkim tlang in thla nan cam a si ahcun vancungih a ummi ka Pa in a lo tuahsak ding."},"20":{"text":"Ziangahtile ka hmin in mi pahnih siseh, pathum siseh, nan pumkhawm tikah nan hnenah ka um ve a si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun Jesuh hnenah Piter cu a ra ih, “Bawipa, ka unau pakhatkhat ka parih a sual ahcun voi ziangzat tiangso ka ngaidam ding? Voi sarih tiang maw?” tiah a sut.","title":"Mi Ngaidam Lo Hnen-um"},"22":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Si hlah ee, voi sarih tiang lawng a si lo; voi sawmsarih ih let sarih tiang na ngaidam pei;"},"23":{"text":"ziangahtile vancung Uknak cu hi bangtuk in a si. Voi khatah Siangpahrang pakhat a um ih a hnen-um pawl ih hnaṭuan daan kha zingzoi a tum."},"24":{"text":"A zingzoi pekte ah tangka thawng tampi a baaktu a hnen-um pakhat a hnenah an run hruai."},"25":{"text":"Cuih hnen-um pa cun leiba samnak tangka ziang hman a nei lo. Cu ruangah siangpahrang in cupa cu a leiba kuannak dingah a nupi le a faate pawl le a neihmi hmuahhmuah thawn salih zuar ṭheh dingin thu a pek."},"26":{"text":"Siangpahrang hmaika ah hnen-um pa cu a bok ih, ‘I zaangfah awla i hngak hrih hram aw. Ka lo kuan ṭheh ko ding,’ tiah a dil ciamco."},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang cun a zaangfah ih a leiba cu a olh ih a thlah."},"28":{"text":"“Cule cupa cu a feh ih amah leiba malte a rak baaktu a hawipi hnen-um pa pakhat a tong. Cupa cu a kai ih a hngawng in a deek ih, ‘I baakmi i pe aw,’ tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cuih hnen-um pa cu a bok ih, ‘I zaangfah awla i hngak hrih hram aw. Ka lo kuan ko ding,’ tiah a dil ciamco."},"30":{"text":"Asinain a ngaidam duh lo. A leiba a kuan ṭheh hlan lo thawngah a thlak."},"31":{"text":"Cumi cu hnen-um dang pawl in an hmuh tikah an thin a nuam lo ngaingai ih siangpahrang hnenah an feh ih cuih thuhla cu an va sim ṭheh."},"32":{"text":"Cutikah siangpahrang in cuih hnen-um pa cu a ko ih, ‘Nang sal ṭha lo. I dil ciamco ruangah i baakmi hmuahhmuah ka lo olh a si."},"33":{"text":"Na parih zaangfahnak ka neih vekin na hawipi parah zaangfahnak nei ve ding mawi na si,’ tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu a thin a heng ngaingai ih cupa cu a leiba zate ih a sam ṭheh hlan lo thawngah a thlak,” a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Zokhal nan unau kha nan thinlung ngaingai in nan ngaidam lo a si ahcun vancungih a ummi ka Pa in cuih hnen-um pa bangtuk in a lo tuah ve ding a si,” tiah a sim."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih thu pawl cu Jesuh in a sim ṭheh tikah Galilee ihsin a suak ih Judea ram, Jordan tiva khatlam ralah a feh.","title":"Nu-pa ṭhennak Thu (Mar 10.1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Mi tampi in an thlun ih cutawkah mina tampi a damter."},"3":{"text":"Farasi mi hrekkhat a hnenah an ra ih a sual hawl duh ah, “Ziangvek thu khalah mipa in a nupi maak dingah kan Daan in a thlah maw?” tiah an sut."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh in, “A hramthokah Seemsuahtu in nu le pa a tuah, ti kha Ca Thianghlim sungah nan siar dah lo maw?"},"5":{"text":"Cutawkah Pathian in ‘Cu a si ruangah mipa in a nu le a pa a taanta pei ih a nupi thawn an kom aw ding; cuti cun annih pahnih cu pakhat ah an cang pei,’ a ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah annih cu pahnih an si nawn lo, pakhat an si. Pathian ih a kommi cu zohman in ṭhen hlah hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Farasi pawl in, “Cuti asile ziangah so Moses in ‘Mipa in a nupi kha maaknak ca pe-aw sehla fehter seh,’ tiah daan in pek?” tiah an sut."},"8":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Thuzirh nan har tuk ruangah Moses in nupi maak theinak thu a lo pekmi a si. Asinain a hlanah cun cuvek a rak si lo."},"9":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: mi pakhat in a nupi kha mipa dang thawn zum tlak loin a um ti siar lo, a maak ih nupi dang a ṭhit asile cupa cu ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuahtu a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl in, “Nupi le pasal karlakah hi bangtuk si ding a si ahcun ṭhi aw loin um lawlaw hai sehla a ṭha sawn,” tiah Jesuh cu an ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Cuih nan timi cu mi hmuahhmuah hrangah a si lo; Pathian ih vo zemmi pawl hrang lawngah a si."},"12":{"text":"Mipa in nupi an ṭhit lonak san cu a thu a phunphun a um; mi hrek cu cutiih um dingah an suahpimi a si; mi hrek cu nupi ṭhi lo dingah tilpermi an si ih mi hrek cu vancung Uknak ih ruangah nupi ṭhi loin an um. Cubangtuk ih a thlun theitu pawl cun hi thuzirhnak hi thlun ko hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat in an faate pawl kha Jesuh in an lu parah kut suangin thla camsak dingah an rak hruai; asinain dungthluntu pawl in an rak kawk.","title":"Nauhak Pawl Thlawsuah A Pek (Mar 10.13-16 ; Luk 18.15-17)"},"14":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nauhak pawl cu ka hnenah ra ko hai seh, dawn hlah uh; ziangahtile vancung Uknak cu hi bangtuk pawl hrangah a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"An lu parah a kut a suan hnuah cutawk ihsin a feh."},"16":{"text":"Voikhat ah mi pakhat Jesuh hnenah a ra ih, “Sayapa, kumkhua nunnak co dingah ziang thil ṭha so ka tuah ding?” tiah a sut.","title":"Milian Tlangvalpa (Mar 10.17-31 ; Luk 18.18-30)"},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Thil ṭha thu ah ziangah so i sut? Miṭha Pakhat lawng a um. Nunnak co na duh ahcun thukham pawl thlun aw,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Tlangvalpa cun, “Ziangbangtuk thukham so?” tiah a sut. Jesuh in, “Mi that hlah; ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuah hlah; ruk ru hlah, a dik loin mi sual puh hlah;"},"19":{"text":"na nu le na pa upat aw; na inn hnen kha nangmah na duhdawt awk vekin duhdaw aw,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Tlangvalpa in, “Hi thukham pawl cu ka thlun thluh zo. Ziang so ka tuah hrih ding?” tiah a sut."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in a hnenah, “Mi famkim si na duh ahcun va feh awla na neihmi hmuahhmuah zuar tahratin na ngahmi tangka cu mi farah pawl va ṭhen aw; cuticun vancung ah hlawnthil na nei ding. Cuih hnuah i thlun aw,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cumi cu tlangvalpa in a theih tikah riah sia in a kir, ziangahtile milian zet a si."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: milian hrangah vancung Uknak sungih luh cu a har ngaingai a si."},"24":{"text":"Ka lo sim sal: Kalauk pakhat ṭhim hnakua sungih luh hnakin milian pakhat Pathian Uknak sungih luh a har sawn,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cumi cu dungthluntu pawl in an theih tikah an mang a bang ngaingai ih, “Cuti asile zoso runnak a ngah thei ding,” tiah an sut."},"26":{"text":"Jesuh cun hmaitontein a zoh hai ih an hnenah, “Himi hi minung hrangah cun a si thei lomi a si, sikhalsehla Pathian hrangah cun ziang hmuahhmuah a cang thei,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule Piter in, “Ziangtinkim taan in nangmah kan lo thlun zo. Ziang so kan ngah ding?” tiah a sut."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: San Thar a thlen ih Milai Fapa cu a tokham sunglawi parih a to tikah cun nannih ka dungthluntu hleihnih hi Israel miphun hleihnih uktu si ve dingah tokham parah nan to ve ding."},"29":{"text":"Cule zokhal keimah ih hrangah nu le pa siseh, faate siseh, unau siseh, farnu siseh, inn siseh, lo siseh, a taantatu cu a let zakhat in a ngah sal ding ih kumkhua nunnak pek a si ding."},"30":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atuih hmaisa bik a si mi pawl hi neta bik an si leh ding; atuih neta bik a si mi pawl hi hmaisa bik an si ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Vancung Uknak cu hi bangtuk hi a si. Mi pakhat cu a sabit hmuan sungih hnaṭuantu hawl dingah zingthlapit in a feh.","title":"Sabit Hmuan Hnaṭuantu Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Nikhat hlawhman ngun tangka fangkhat pe dingin a lung a kim ih a hmuan ah hnaṭuantu pawl cu a thlah."},"3":{"text":"Zinglam nazi pakua ah dawr hmunah a va feh ih mi-umlak ṭhenkhat a va hmu."},"4":{"text":"Cupawl hnenah, ‘Nannih tla sabit hmuanah va feh uhla hna va ṭuan ve uh; nan nihlawh a tawkzawn in ka lo pe ding,’ tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cuticun an feh. Cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in nazi hleihnih ah le zanlam nazi pathum ah a dang a thlah lala."},"6":{"text":"Zanlam nazi panga zikte ah dawr hmun ah a feh sal ih minung ṭhenkhat an rak ding hrih kha a hmu. ‘Ziangah so zianghman tuah lo in sun nihlawh nan ding ih nan tikcu nan cemter?’ tiah a sut."},"7":{"text":"Annih in, ‘Zohman in hnaṭuan in pek lo ruangah a si,’ tiah an sawn. Anih in, ‘Cuti a si ahcun sabit hmuan ah feh uhla va ṭuan ve uh,’ tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"“Zanlam a hung si tikah hmuan neitu pa in hmuan uktu pa cu ‘Hmuan hnaṭuantu pawl cu ko hai awla an nihlawh pe aw, a neta bikih a ṭuantu pawl in thok awla a hmaisa bikih a ṭuantu pawl tiang,’ tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Zanlam nazi panga-ih hnaṭuan a thoktu pawl cu an hlawhman ah ngun tangka fangkhat ciar pek an si."},"10":{"text":"Cuhrangah hmaisa bikih hnaṭuan fialmi pawl hlawhman la dingih an rat ve tikah tam deuh kan ngah ding tiah an zum; asinain annih khal ngun tangka fangkhat ciar pek an si ve."},"11":{"text":"Tangka cu an lak ih hmuan neitu bawi parah cun an phunzai."},"12":{"text":"‘Himi pawl neta bikih hna a ṭuantu pawl hi nazi pakhat sung lawng an ṭuan; kannih cu nisasen lakah sunvu kan ṭuan, asinain kanmah zat thotho ni hlawhman na pek,’ tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"“Cutikah hmuan neitupa in pakhat pa hnenah, ‘Ka rual, ngaihnik! Ka lo bum lo a si. Ni khat hlawhman cu ngun tangka fangkhat si dingin na lung a rak kim a si lo maw?"},"14":{"text":"Nan hlawhman cu la uhla inn ah tlung uh. Neta bikih hnaṭuan ka fialmi pa khal hi nan ngahzat a ngah ve ding cu ka duhmi a si."},"15":{"text":"Ka tangka cu ka duh vekih hman theinak thu ka nei a si lo maw? An parih tirh ka sian ruangah nan nahsiik maw si?’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"16":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Curuangah neta bik pawl cu hmaisabik ah an cang ding ih hmaisa bik pawl cu neta bikah an cang ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerusalem lamih a feh laiah khan dungthluntu hleihnih kha a dangte ah a hruai ih an mahte lawng, an feh phah ah, thu a ruah hai.","title":"A Thihnak Ding Thu (Mar 10.32-34 ; Luk 18.31-34)"},"18":{"text":"“Ngaihnik uh! Jerusalem ah kan hung feh ding ih cutawkah Milai Fapa hi puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl kut ah an thlen ding ih that dingin an rel ding."},"19":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Zentail mi pawl kut ah an thlen ding. Cun Zentail mi pawl in an hmuhsuam ding, an vuak ding ih thinglamtah ah an kheng ding. Sikhalsehla ni thumnak ah thawhter sal a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cule Zebedi nupi cu Jesuh hnenah a fapa pahnih thawn an ra; Jesuh hmaiah cun a kun ih zaangfah a dil.","title":"Nu Ih Zaangfah Dilnak (Mar 10.35-45)"},"21":{"text":"“Ziang so na duh?” tiah Jesuh in a sut. Anih in, “Siangpahrang na si tikah ka fapa pahnih hi na vorhlam le na kehlamih an to theinak dingah thu i kam aw,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nan dilmi hi ziang kan dil ti nan thei lo. Ka in ding mi tuarnak khuathai hi nan in thei ding maw?” tiah a sut. A fapa pahnih cun, “Kan in thei ding,” an ti."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh cun, “Ka in dingmi khuathai cu nan in thei ve ngai men ding. Asinain ka vorhlam le ka kehlam ah zo a to ding ti a hriltu cu kei ka si lo. Hi tonak tla cu ka Pa in a timtuah sak ciami pawl hrangah a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cuih thu cu dungthluntu dang pahra in an theih tikah cute unau hnih parah an thin a heng ngaingai."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah an zatein Jesuh in a ko khawm ih, “Nan theih vekin leilung tlunih uktu pawl cun an ukmi pawl kha an lal-hnawh hai ih hotu pawl khal in thu an nei ngaingai."},"26":{"text":"Asinain nannih lakah cun cu bangtuk cu si hlah seh. Nanmah lakah pakhatkhat in mi dang hnakih thupit a duh ahcun midang pawl ih hnen-um a ṭuan a ṭul;"},"27":{"text":"nanmah lakah pakhatkhat in hmaisa bik si a duh asile nan sal a si hmaisa a ṭul."},"28":{"text":"Milai Fapa cu rianmi si loin mi riantu si dingah le mi tampi tlen dingah a nunnak pe dingin a ra a si,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl kha Jerikho ihsin an suah laiah mi tampi in an thlun.","title":"Jesuh In Mitcaw Pahnih A Damter (Mar 10.46-52 ; Luk 18.35-43)"},"30":{"text":"Lamzin kiangih a rak tomi mitcaw pahnih in Jesuh an kiangte ihsin a feh ti kha an theih tikah, “Maw David fapa, in zaangfah hram aw,” tiah an au."},"31":{"text":"Mi senpi pawl in daiteih um dingin an kawk. Asinain an dai cuang lo. “David fapa, in zaangfah hramhram aw,” tiah ring sinsin in an au."},"32":{"text":"Jesuh cu a ding ih an pahnih in a ko. “Ziang tuah sak so nan duh?” tiah a sut."},"33":{"text":"Annih in, “Bawipa, khua in hmuter hram aw,” tiah an ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in a zaangfah hai ih an mit cu a tham. Hmakhatteah khua an hmu thei sal ih amah cu an thlunta."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu Jerusalem an naih vivo thlang. Olif tlang ih Bethphage khua an thleng. A dungthluntu pahnih hmaiah a hei thlah ih,","title":"Jesuh Cu Jerusalem Ah A Lut (Mar 11.1-11 ; Luk 19.28-40 ; Joh 12.12-19)"},"2":{"text":"hiti in thu a cah. “Nan hmaiih khua ah va feh uhla laakpi an hrenmi a faate thawn nan hmu lohli ding. A hri phoih uhla ka hnenah rak hruai uh."},"3":{"text":"‘Mi in ziangah so nan hruai,’ an lo tile, ‘Bawipa in a ṭul a si,’ va ti uh. Cuticun hmakhatte ah an lo thlah ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Himi cu profet ih a rak sim ciami kimternak dingah a si. Profet cun:"},"5":{"text":"“Zion khawpi khi sim uh, Na siangpahrang cu na hnenah a ra lai; Amah cu mi lungnem a si ih laak parah a to. Laak note parah a to a si, ti uh,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Zek 9.9"},"6":{"text":"Curuangah dungthluntu cu an feh ih Jesuh simmi vekin an tuah."},"7":{"text":"Laak le a faate cu an rak hruai ih an zaang ah an puan an dam ih Jesuh cu a to."},"8":{"text":"Mi tampi in Jesuh fehnak ding lamzin ahcun an puan an rak phah ih mi dang pawl in hnahsawl an lak ih lamzin ahcun an phah ve."},"9":{"text":"Jesuh hmaiih a fehmi pawl siseh, a dunglam ihsin a thluntu pawl siseh, an zate in: “Hosanna! Pathian cu van a saangbik ah thangṭhat uh!” tiah an au ciamco."},"10":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerusalem khawsungih a luh tikah a khua pumpuluk in an au celcel ih, “Hi pa hi zoso a si?” tiah khua mi pawl in an sut."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah misenpi pawl cun, “Hi pa cu Galilee ram Nazareth khuami profet Jesuh a si,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Jesuh cu Biakinn sungah a lut ih cutawkih thil a zuartu le a leitu pawl kha a dawi ṭheh. Tangka thlengtu pawl ih cabuai pawl le laileng zuartu pawl ih tokham pawl cu a linglet ṭheh.","title":"Biakinn Ah Jesuh A Feh. (Mar 11.15-19 ; Luk 19.45-48 ; Joh 2.13-22)"},"13":{"text":"Cule an hnenah, “Ca Thianghlim sungah Pathian in, ‘Ka Inn cu thlacamnak inn ti a si ding,’ tiah a ti. Asinain nannih cun fifir relhnak kua ah nan tuah,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Mitcaw le kebai pawl Biakinn sungah cun a hnenah an ra ih a damter."},"15":{"text":"Thil maksak a tuahmi le Biakinn sungih nauhak pawl in, “David Fapa cu thangṭhat uh,” tiih an aumi cu puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl in an hmuh tikah an thin a heng ngaingai."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh kha, “An au reromi hi na thei maw?” tiah an sut. Jesuh in, “Thei tuk e! Ca Thianghlim sungah, ‘Nauhak le naute pawl sungin thangṭhatnak famkim na suakter,’ tiih nganmi kha nan siar dah lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh cun a tlansan hai ih Jerusalem khawpi sung ihsin a suah hnuah Bethani khua ah a feh ih cunah a riak."},"18":{"text":"A thaizing zingpitah Jesuh cu Jerusalem khawpi lamah a feh sal ih lamzin ah a ril a rawngzet.","title":"Jesuh In Theikung A Cam (Mar 11.12-14 , 20-24)"},"19":{"text":"Lamzin kiangah theipi kung pakhat a hmu ih a hei pan; asinain a hnah siar lo ziang hman a hmu lo. Hmakhatteah theipi kung cu a ro ṭheh."},"20":{"text":"Cumi cu a dungthluntu pawl in an hmuh tikah an mang a bang ngaingai. “Ziangtin so cutluk zamrangin a ro ṭheh?” tiah an sut."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: rinhmainak nei lo tein nan zum taktak ahcun hi theipi kung parih ka tuahmi hi nannih khal in nan tuah thei ve ding. Himi lawng si loin hi tlang hman hi ‘ṭhawn awla tifinriat sungah dawp aw,’ nan ti le nan ti vekin a cang ding."},"22":{"text":"Nan zum ngaingai ahcun thlacamnak thawn nan dilmi hmuahhmuah cu nan ngah ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh cu Biakinn sungah a ra sal ih thu a zirh rero laiah puithiam upa pawl le hotu pawl a hnenah an ra ih, “Ziangah so hi bangtuk thil hi na tuah? Pathian thu in kan ti asile, ‘Ziangah so Johan cu nan zum lo,’ in ti ding."},"26":{"text":"Asinain minung thu in kan ti lala khalle Johan cu mi hmuahhmuah in profet a si tiah an zum fawn ih misenpi pawl in kanmah lehlam ziangmaw tiin in ti pang ding, ti phan a um fawn!” an ti."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah, “Kan thei lo,” tiah Jesuh cu an let. Cule Jesuh in, “Cuti a si ahcun kei khal in ziangthu in hi bangtuk thil hi ka tuah, ti ka lo sim ve lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ziangtin nan ruat? A fapa upa hnenah a feh ih, ‘Ka fa, tuihsun ah sabit hmuan ah va feh awla hna va ṭuan aw,’ tiah a fial.","title":"Fapa Pahnih Tahṭhimnak"},"29":{"text":"A fapa cun, ‘Ka duh lo,’ tiah a el; asinain nehhnu ah a sir-aw sal ih sabit hmuanah cun a feh."},"30":{"text":"Cule a fapa nauta pa hnenah a feh sal ih sabit hmuan feh a fial ve. Cupa cun, ‘E law, ka pa,’ tiah a ti; asinain a feh lo."},"31":{"text":"Hi fapa pahnih lakah hin zo in so an pa ih duhnak a tuah?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “A fapa upa,” tiah an let. Cutikah Jesuh in, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: siahkhongtu le hlawhhlang pawl hi nan hlanah Pathian Uknak sungah an lut ding."},"32":{"text":"Ziangahtile baptistma petu Johan cu a dikmi lamzin hmuh dingah nan hnenah a ra naón nan zum lo; sikhalsehla ngunkhuai khongtu le hlawhhlang pawl cun an zum. Cumi nan hmuh hnu hmanah nan thinlung nan thleng cuang lo, zum khal nan zum cuang lo,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hi tahṭhimnak thu hi ngai hrih uh. Voikhat ah ram neitu pakhat a um ih sabit hmuan a tuah. Cuih a hmuan cu hawi in a kulh, sabit sawrnak ah khur a laih ih a kilnakah parthlam a sak. Cuih hnuah sabit hmuan ṭuantu pawl hnenah a saan ih amah cu khual tlawn ah a feh.","title":"Sabit Hmuan ṭuantu Tahṭhimnak (Mar 12.1-12 ; Luk 20.9-19)"},"34":{"text":"Sabit rah lawh caan a cut tikah a covo hlam dingah a hmuan a saangtu pawl hnenah cun a sal pawl a thlah."},"35":{"text":"Sabit hmuan a saangtu pawl in a sal pawl cu an kaih ih pakhat an vuak, pakhat an that ih a dang pakhat cu lungto in an deng."},"36":{"text":"Lo neitu pa cun a sal pawl tam deuh in a thlah lala; asinain hmuan saangtu pawl cun a hlan vek thotho in an rak tuahsiat."},"37":{"text":"A netnak ah a fapa a thlah, “Ka fapa hi cu an hmaisong rori ding,” tiah a ruat."},"38":{"text":"Asinain hmuan saangtu pawl cun a fapa an hmuh tikah, “Hi pa hi hmuan neitu ih fapa a si. Ra uh, kan that pei ih a thilri kan co pei,” tiah an ti aw."},"39":{"text":"A fapa cu an kai ih hmuan lengah an dirsuak ih an that."},"40":{"text":"“Hmuan neitu pa a rat tikah cuih hmuan saangtu pawl cu ziangtin a tuah ding tiah nan ruat?” tiah a sut."},"41":{"text":"Annih in, “Cubangtuk mi ṭha lo pawl cu a that ding ih a covo hman teih a pe theitu ding midang hnenah a hmuan cu a san ding,” tiah an sawn."},"42":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Ca Thianghlim ih a timi hi nan siar dah lo maw? Ca Thianghlim in: ‘Inn saktu pawl in santlai lo tiih an hnonmi lungto cu A thupi bikmi lungto ah a cang riangri; Himi cu Bawipa ih tuahmi a si, kan mithmuh ah a mawi zetmi a si,’ a ti.","ref":"Saam 118.22-23"},"43":{"text":"“Fiangtein ka lo sim: Pathian Uknak hi nan hnen ihsin lak a si ding ih rah ṭhateih a suahtertu ding pawl hnenah pek a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"“Zokhal hi lungto parih a tlami cu a kuai ṭheh ding ih hi lungto ih a rialmi poh cu leivut bangin an dip ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Jesuh simmi tahṭhimnak pawl cu puithiam upa le Farasi mi pawl in an theih tikah anmah ih thuhla a sim ti kha an thei."},"46":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh cu kaih an tum. Asinain mipi in Jesuh cu profet a si tiah an ruah ruangah mipi pawl an ṭih ih an kai ngam lo."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in mipi pawl cu tahṭhimnak thawn a zirh.","title":"Mopuai Tahṭhimnak (Luk 14.15-24)"},"2":{"text":"“Vancung Uknak cu hi bangtuk a si. Ka cawcang pawl le ṭilva thau zetzet pawl kan that zo ih ziang hmuahhmuah kan timtuah ṭheh zo. Rawl ei tlang dingah ra thlang uh, tiah va ti uh,’ a ti."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla sawm ciami pawl cun zianghman ah an siar lo ih an hnaṭuan keel an ṭuan; pakhat cu a lo ah a feh, a dang pakhat cu a dawr tuahnak ah a feh;"},"6":{"text":"mi hrekkhat pawl in a hnen-um pawl cu an kai ih an thawi hnuah an that hai."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu a thin a heng ngaingai. Asinain anih cun zianghman a sim thei lo."},"13":{"text":"Cule Siangpahrang in a hnen-um pawl kha, ‘A kutke ṭem uhla khawleng thimnak ah hlon uh. Rom Siangpahrang hnenah ngunkhuai pek hi kan Daan in a duh maw duh lo,” tiah an sut."},"18":{"text":"Tumtahnak ṭha lo an neihmi kha Jesuh in a theih ruangah an hnenah, “Mi depde pawl! Upa bik cu nupi a ṭhi ih fa nei loin a thihsan; a nupi cu a naupa in a run co."},"26":{"text":"Pahnihnak pa khal cu a thi lala ih a pathumnak pa in a nupi a run co lala. Cuticun an unau zate ih nupi a si hnuah an thi ṭheh."},"27":{"text":"Neta bikah cu nu khal cu a thi ve."},"28":{"text":"An pasarih in an nupit ciar ruangah thawhsalnak ni ah zo ih nupi bik so a si ding?” tiah an sut."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nan va palh thei lawmmam so! Pathian in,"},"32":{"text":"‘Kei cu Abraham ih Pathian, Isaak ih Pathian, Jakob ih Pathian ka si,’ a ti. A nungmi ih Pathian a si, a thimi ih Pathian a si lo,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cumi cu misenpi in an theih tikah a thuzirh daan kha an mang a bang ngaingai."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in Saddusi mi pawl cu ṭong ding thei nawn loin a tuah ti kha Farasi mi pawl in an theih tikah an tong khawm aw ih,","title":"Thukham Tumbik (Mar 12.28-34 ; Luk 10.25-28)"},"35":{"text":"anmah lakih mi pakhat, Daanthiam pa in Jesuh kha a sual hawl duh ah thu a sut."},"36":{"text":"“Sayapa, Daan sungah hin khui thukham so a tum bik?” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Jesuh in, “‘Bawipa na Pathian cu na thinlung zate, na nunnak zate le na ruahnak zate in na duhdawt pei,’"},"38":{"text":"timi hi a tum bik le a pakhatnak thukham a si."},"39":{"text":"Pahnihnak ih a thupi bikmi thukham cu pakhatnak vek thotho a si: ‘Na innhnen kha nangmah na duhdawt awk vekin na duhdawt ve pei,’ ti hi a si."},"40":{"text":"Moses Daan hmuahhmuah le profet pawl ih zirhmi hmuahhmuah cu hi thukham pahnih in a huap ṭheh a si,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Farasi pawl hmun khatih an pumkhawm awk tikah Jesuh in,","title":"Messiah Thu (Mar 12.35-37 ; Luk 20.41-44)"},"42":{"text":"“Messiah hi ziangtinso nan ruat? David in:"},"44":{"text":"“Bawipa in ka Bawipa hnenah, Na ral pawl na ke hnuai ih ka ret hlan lo, Ka vorhlam kapah to aw,’ a ti."},"45":{"text":"David in Bawipa a ti ahcun ziangtinso Messiah cu David tesinfa a si thei ding?” tiah a sut."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh ih thusuhmi cu zohman in an let thei lo ih cuih ni thokin zohman in thu an sut ngam nawn lo."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu misenpi le a dungthluntu pawl hnenah thu a sim.","title":"Jesuh In Ralrinnak A Pek (Mar 12.38-39 ; Luk 11.43 , 46 ; 20.45-46)"},"2":{"text":"“Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl hi Moses pekmi Daan a sim fiangtu dingmi an si."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah an lo simmi hmuahhmuah cu nan tuah le nan thlun dingmi an si, sikhalsehla an thil tuahmi cu cawng hlah uh; ziangahtile an simmi vekin anmah in an tuah lo a si."},"4":{"text":"Mi ih zaang parah thilrit zetzet an suang, asinain anmah cun cuih thilrit phurh bawm dingah an kutzim hman in an dai duh lo."},"5":{"text":"Mi ih hmuh ding lawnglawngah ziang hmuahhmuah an tuah. An lu le an baan ih an khih awkmi parih Ca Thianghlim an nganmi lu khih le baan khih pawl tla khi zohhnik uh! Ziangtluk in so a tum! An puanfeem tla khi zohhnik uh! Ziangtluk in so a sau."},"6":{"text":"Puai tuahnak hmun le sinakok ah a ṭhat biknak hmun le upatnak hmun ah to an duh."},"7":{"text":"Dawr tluan mipi hmun ah mi ih upat pek an duh ih, ‘Sayapa, Sayapa,’ tiih kawh an duh."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih cu, ‘Sayapa,’ ti kha va duh hlah uh! Ziangahtile nannih tla cu unau fingfing nan si ih Sayapa ti dingmi cu pakhat lawng nan nei a si."},"9":{"text":"Cule leilung tlunah hin zohman, ‘Ka Pa,’ tiah nan ko lo pei, ziangahtile vancung i a ummi nan Pa lawnglawng Pa nan nei a si."},"10":{"text":"Cuih tlunah zohman, ‘Hotu,’ ti kawh ding kha va cuh hlah uh, ziangahtile hotu pakhat lawng nan nei ih amah cu Messiah hi a si."},"11":{"text":"Nanmah lakih a tum bik mi cu nan hnen-um a si ding."},"12":{"text":"Zokhal amah le amah a tum awtertu cu ṭhum a si ding ih mi hnuai ih a dormi cu cawisan a si ding."},"13":{"text":"“Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Nannih mi depde pawl! Vancung Uknak sangka cu mi lut thei lo dingin nan khar ih nanmah le nan lut duh fawn lo; midang luh a duhmi hrangah nan ong duh fawn lo.","title":"Jesuh In An Depdetnak A Soisel (Mar 12.40 ; Luk 11.39-42 , 44 , 52 ; 20.47)"},"14":{"text":"(“Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Nannih mi depde pawl! Nuhmei pawl kha nuhmei an si ruangah nan hmuhsuam ih an inn tiangin nan lawng; cule mizapi hmuh ahcun rei zetzet thlacam nan uar. Hiti nan si ruangah hremnak nasazet nan tong ding.)"},"15":{"text":"“Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Nannih mi depde pawl! Mi pakhat thinlung thlengter dingah tifinriat ah lawng in nan feh ih ram tampi ah nan vak. Mi pakhat nan ngah tikah hell tla dingah nanmah hnakih let hnih tuar dingin nan tuah."},"16":{"text":"“Nannih hruaitu mitcaw pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! ‘Mi pakhat in Biakinn hmin saal in siat a cam ahcun a siatcammi in a kaihreng lo, asinain Biakinn sungih a ummi sui hmin saal in siat a cam ahcun a siatcammi in a kaihreng a si,’ tiah mi nan zirh."},"17":{"text":"Mitcaw le mi aa pawl! Khuiso a thupi deuh? Sui maw, a si lole sui kha thianghlim ko ih a tuahtu Biakinn so?"},"18":{"text":"Cuih tlunah, ‘Mi pakhat in biakṭheng hmin saal in siat a cam ahcun a siatcammi in a kaihreng lo; asinain biakṭheng parih a ummi thilhlanmi saal in siat a cam ahcun a siatcammi in a kaihreng a si,’ tiah nan sim."},"19":{"text":"Khua nan va hmu thei lo lawmmam so! Khuiso a thupi sawn? Thilhlanmi maw, thilhlanmi a thianghlimtertu biakṭheng so?"},"20":{"text":"Curuangah mi pakhat in biakṭheng saal in siat a cam tikah biakṭheng le biakṭheng parih a ummi thilhlanmi hmuahhmuah thawn siat a cam a si."},"21":{"text":"Biakinn saal in siat a cam tikah biakinn le a sungih ummi Pathian hmin in siat a cam a si."},"22":{"text":"Cule vancung saal in siat a cam a si ahcun Pathian tokham le a parih a totu hmin in siat a cam a si."},"23":{"text":"“Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Nannih mi depde pawl! Hmeh ih rawimi puṭinan, remhmui le aithing pawl kha Pathian hnenah ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat nan pek; asinain Daan sungih a thupi zetmi dingnak, zaangfahnak le rintlaknak pawl cu nan thlun lo ih zianghman ah nan siar fawn lo. Ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat cu nan pek ding hrimhrim a si. Asinain Daan sungih a ummi a dang pawl khal nan daithlan lo pei."},"24":{"text":"Hotu mitcaw pawl! Nan inmi sungih thothe cu nan hap, asinain kalauk riangri nan dolh fawn!"},"25":{"text":"“Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Nannih mi depde pawl! Nan khuat le nan pakan pawl a lenglam lawng fai lengleng in nan kholh ih a sung cu midang thil nan lonmi le hamṭamnak in nan ngahmi thil in a khat."},"26":{"text":"Farasi mitcaw pawl! Nan khuat a sunglam pawl kha kholh hmaisa uhla cuticun a lenglam khal a fai ve ding a si."},"27":{"text":"“Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Nannih mi depde pawl! Nannih cu si raang hnihfaimi thlaan vek nan si; a lengah a mawi naón a sungah cun ruh le a thu a ṭoih mi ruak in a khat."},"28":{"text":"Cubangtuk in nan lenglam ih zoh ahcun mi hmuahhmuah hrangih mi ṭhazet vek nan bang, asinain nan sunglam ahcun depdetnak le sualnak a phunphun in nan khat a si."},"29":{"text":"“Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Nannih mi depde pawl! Profet pawl phumnak ah thlaan ṭhaṭha nan tuah ih mi ṭha pawl ih lungphun cu nan mawiter.","title":"Anmah Hremnak Ding A Sim Cia (Luk 11.47-51)"},"30":{"text":"Nannih in, ‘Hi kan pupa pawl ih san ahhin rak nung ve nungna thil an tuahmi pawl hi kan tuah lo ding ih profet pawl khal an thi hrimhrim lo ding,’ tiah nan ti."},"31":{"text":"Cuti nan ti tikah hin profet pawl a rak thattu pawl ih tesinfa kan si, tiah nan ti awknak nan langter a si."},"32":{"text":"Curuangah nan pupa pawl ih an rak thok ciami thil cu nannih pawl hin kimtein tuah ṭheh lawlaw uh!"},"33":{"text":"Nannih rul pawl, tur nei rulih faale pawl! Hell sung tla dingih hnonmi nan sinak ihsin ziangtinso nan luat thei ding?"},"34":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: nan hnenah profet le mifim le zirhtu saya pawl ka thlah ding; ṭhenkhat cu nan that ding, ṭhenkhat cu thinglamtah parah nan that ding ih ṭhenkhat cu sinakok ah nan thawi hai ding ih khua khat ihsin khua dangah nan dawi vivo ding."},"35":{"text":"Cubangtuk in mawh nei lomi thihnak nan tuarter ruangah hremnak nan parah a tla ding. Mawh nei lo Abel ihsin thokin Biakinn le biakṭheng karlakih nan thahmi Berakhiah ih fapa Zekhariah tiang, an thisen a suah man cu nan parah a tla ṭheh ding a si."},"36":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: himi pawl nan thah ruangih hremnak cu tuihsan minung pawl parah a thleng ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Na hnenah Pathian in a thlahmi profet pawl na that ih a palai pawl kha lungto in na deng. Arpi in ar faate pawl a thla hnuai ih a uap vekin na minung pawl cu ka kut in ka hum tum rero naón na duh lo!","title":"Jesuh In Jerusalem A Duhdawt (Luk 13.34-35)"},"38":{"text":"Curuangah na Biakinn cu a lawng ding ih a ṭhing ding."},"39":{"text":"Ka lo sim cia: ‘Bawipa ih hmin in a rami cu Pathian in thlawsuahnak pe hram seh,’ tiih na ti thei hlan lo atu ihsin thok in i hmu nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu a tho ih Biakinn ihsin a feh laiah a dungthluntu pawl a hnenah an ra ih Biakinn an rak sak daan a makzia kha an relpi.","title":"Biakinn Siatnak Ding Thu (Mar 13.1-2 ; Luk 21.5-6)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Asi, hipawl hi zohhnik uh. Fiangtein ka lo sim: hi lungto pakhat hman hi a umnak keel ah a um nawn lo ding; a zate in balthlak ṭheh an si ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh cu Olif tlang parih a to laiah a dungthluntu pawl a thupte in a hnenah an ra ih, “Hi thil hi ziangtikah so a can ding? Cun na rat salnak caan le san cemnak langtertu ziang thil so a um ding, in simhnik?” tiah an sut.","title":"Harsatnak Le Hremnak Thu (Mar 13.3-13 ; Luk 21.7-19)"},"4":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ralring uh, zohman in lo bum hlah hai seh."},"5":{"text":"Mi tampi ka hmin in an ra ding ih, ‘Keimah hi Messiah cu ka si,’ tiah an ti ding ih mi tampi an bum ding."},"6":{"text":"Lam naite ah siseh, lam hlapi ah siseh, raldonak thawmvang nan thei ding, asinain va phang hlah uh. Cubangtuk thil cu a um ding, asinain a netnak a thleng tinak a si hrih lo."},"7":{"text":"Ram khat le ram khat, peng khat le peng khat an do aw ding. Leilung tlun hmun kipah paam le linghnin a um ding."},"8":{"text":"Cubangtuk thil pawl cu nauhrin nat thok bangtuk a si."},"9":{"text":"“Cun an lo kai ding ih hrem ding le thah dingah mi kut ah an lo thlen ding. Keimah ruangah miphun kip in an lo hua ding."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah mi tampi in an zumnak an bansan ding. Pakhat le pakhat an zuar aw ding ih an hua aw ding."},"11":{"text":"Cule profet deu tampi an suak ding ih mi tampi an bum ding."},"12":{"text":"Sualnak a karh ding ih mi tampiih duhdawtnak cu a ṭumsuk ding."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a netnak tiang a dinghnget theitu cu rundam a si ding."},"14":{"text":"Cun miphun hmuahhmuah ih theih ṭheh dingah hi vancung Uknak Thuthang ṭha hi leilung tlun khuazakip ah phuan a si ding. Cuih hnuah a netnak cu a si ding."},"15":{"text":"“Profet Daniel in a rak sim ciami, ‘Tuksumza Thil-borhhlawh,’ cu nan hmu ding. Cuih Thil-borhhlawh cu hmun thianghlim ah a ding ding. (Hi ca a siartu: a sim duhmi hi theithiam aw.)","title":"Tuksumza Thil-borhhlawh (Mar 13.14-23 ; Luk 21.20-24)"},"16":{"text":"Cule Judea ramih a ummi pawl cu tlangpar ah tlan hai seh."},"17":{"text":"A inn parih a ummi cu innsung thilri lak dingah ṭum hlah seh."},"18":{"text":"Lo ih a ummi pa cu a puan lak dingah kir hlah seh."},"19":{"text":"Cuih caan le cuih ni ah nunau favun le naukai neimi nunau pawl hrangah ziangtlukin so a har ding."},"20":{"text":"Thlatang caan le Sabbath ni ngelcel ih thinphang in nan tlan ciamco lonak dingah Pathian hnenah thlacam uh!"},"21":{"text":"Ziangahtile leilung hramthok ihsin tuih ni tiang a thlengmi ṭihnungza harsatnak hnakin a ṭihnung sawnmi a thleng ding ih cuvek ṭihnungzet harsatnak cu tuih hnu khalah a thleng nawn lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Cuih tikcu caan cu Pathian in tawiter loin rak um sehla zohman an luat lo ding. Asinain Pathian in a hrilmi pawl hrangah a caan cu a tawiter ding."},"23":{"text":"“Cule mi pakhatkhat in, ‘Zoh uh, hinah Messiah a um,’ a si lole ‘Khinah a um,’ tiah an lo ti le va zum hlah uh."},"24":{"text":"Ziangahtile Messiah deu le profet deu pawl an suak ding ih khawruahhar le hmuhsaknak mak ngaingai an tuah ding ih a cang thei tawkin Pathian ih hrilciami pawl hman an bum ding."},"25":{"text":"Ciing ringring uh! A hlankhan in ka lo simcia a si."},"26":{"text":"“Mi in, ‘Zoh uh, ramṭhing ah a um,’ tiah an lo ti a si ahcun va feh hlah uh. ‘Hi tawkah hin a thup aw,’ an ti khalle va zum hlah uh."},"27":{"text":"Ziangahtile nisuahnak ihsin ni tlaknak tiang hmakhat ih a tleu zukzomi nimthlakau vekin Milai Fapa cu a ra ding a si."},"28":{"text":"“Miruak umnak kipah langta an khawm aw ding."},"29":{"text":"“Cuih harsat caan a cem hnuah cun ni a thim ding, thlapi a vang nawn lo ding, van ihsin arsi pawl an tla ding ih vanih a ummi cah-nak huham pawl cu an fehnak lamzin ihsin an pial ding.","title":"Milai Fapa Ratnak Ding (Mar 13.24-27 ; Luk 21.25-28)"},"30":{"text":"Cutikah Milai Fapa rat ding theihthiamnak van ah a lang ding; Milai Fapa cu vancung mero parin cah-nak huham le sunlawinak tumpi thawn a rat kha an hmu ding ih leilung tlun miphun zakip an ṭap ding."},"31":{"text":"A ringzetmi tawtawrawt an tum ding ih leilung kil li ah a vancungmi pawl a thlah ding; vanhram khatlam deng ihsin khatlam deng tiangih ummi hrilciami pawl a finkhawm ding."},"32":{"text":"“Theipi kung thuhla in fim lo zirhseh. Theipi cu a hnge pawl an hung hring ih a hnah no tete tla an hung cerh tikah ṭhal tikcu a nai a si ti nan thei.","title":"Theipi Kung Ihsin Zirnak (Mar 13.28-31 ; Luk 21.29-33)"},"33":{"text":"Cuvekin hi thil hmuahhmuah nan hmuh tikah a tikcu a naizet thlang ih a thleng cing ding ti nan thei pei."},"34":{"text":"Ciing ṭha uh: atu sanih a nunglai mi hmuahhmuah an thih ṭheh hlanah hi thil hmuahhmuah hi an kim ṭheh ding."},"35":{"text":"Lei le van cu an cemral ding naón ka ṭongkam cu a cem dah lo ding."},"36":{"text":"“Cuih ni le caan cu vanih a um mi vancungmi in siseh, Fapa in siseh, zohman in an thei lo; Pa lawng in a thei.","title":"Zohman In A Tikcu An Thei Lo (Mar 13.32-37 ; Luk 17.26-30 , 34-36)"},"37":{"text":"Noah san laiih thil a cangmi vekin Milai Fapa ratnak caanah cun a cang ve ding."},"38":{"text":"Tilik a tlun hlanah cun minung pawl cun an ei an in ih nupi an ṭhi, pasal an nei; Noah lawng sung a lut ni tiang nuam zetin an um."},"39":{"text":"Cutiin tilik in a fen hlo ṭheh hlan tiang ziang a cang ding ti zohman in an thei lo. Cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in Milai Fapa a rat tik khalah a si ding."},"40":{"text":"Cuih caan a thlen tikah lo ah mi pahnih hna an ṭuan ding ih pakhat cu lakhlo a si ding ih pakhat cu taanta a si ding."},"41":{"text":"Nunau pahnih sum an deng ding; pakhat cu lakhlo a si ding ih pakhat cu taanta a si ding."},"42":{"text":"“Curuangah ralring in um uh; ziangahtile ziang tikah nan Bawipa a ra ding ti nan thei lo."},"43":{"text":"Inn neitu pa in fifir a ratnak ding tikcu a theih ahcun it loin a kil ding ih fifir pa cun a inn bauh in a lut thei lo ding, ti cu nan theihmi a si."},"44":{"text":"Curuangah ralring tein um uh, ziangahtile Milai Fapa cu nan rin lo laifangah a ra ding a si."},"45":{"text":"“Cuti asile zo bik so rintlak le a fimmi hnen-um cu a si ding? Rintlak le a fimmi hnen-um cu a bawipa in hnen-um dang pawl hotu ah ṭuanvo a pek ih a tikcu hmantein hnen-um dang pawl rawl a pe theitu pa kha a si ding.","title":"Hnen-um Fel Le Fel Lo (Luk 12.41-48)"},"46":{"text":"Ṭhateih a hna a ṭuan rero laifangah a bawipa a ra kir a si ahcun ziangtluk in so cuih hnen-um pa cu a lung a awi ding?"},"47":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: cuih hnen-um pa cu a bawipa in a thilri hmuahhmuah kilkhawitu ah a ret ding."},"48":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hnen-um fel lomi a si ahcun, ka bawipa cu a ra tlung hrih lo ding, a rei lai paam ding tiah a ti ding ih"},"49":{"text":"hnen-um dang pawl kha a hmuhsuam, a thawi pei ih zuri pawl thawn ei le in in an um ding."},"50":{"text":"Cule a bawipa cu a rin lo ni le a theih lo caanah ruah lopi in a ra kir ding."},"51":{"text":"A bawipa in cupa cu a dawi ding ih mititeraw pawl umnak hmunah a kuat ding; cutawkah ṭap-ai in a hacang a rial ding a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Cuih caanah cun vancung Uknak cu mopa hmuak dingah an mei-inn thawn a fehtu fala pahra bangtuk a si ding.","title":"Fala Pahra Tahṭhimnak"},"2":{"text":"Cuih fala pahra sungah panga cu an aa ih a dang panga cu an fim."},"3":{"text":"Fala aa pawl cun mei-inn an keng naón zinan an keng lo."},"4":{"text":"A fimmi pawl cun an mei-inn khattein zinan an keng."},"5":{"text":"Mopa cu a thlen a tlai ruangah fala pawl cu an sing ih an itthat."},"6":{"text":"“Zanṭim a si tikah, ‘Mopa a ra! Tho uhla va hmuak uh,’ tiah au thawm a thang."},"7":{"text":"Fala pahra cu an ṭhang ih an mei-inn cu an timtuah."},"8":{"text":"Cule fala aa pawl cun fala fim pawl hnenah, ‘Kan mei-inn an mit cuahco thlang, nan zinan in ṭhen ve uh,’ tiah an dil."},"9":{"text":"Fala fim pawl cun, ‘A cang lo ding, nannih ceem in zinan kan keng lo. Dawr ah va feh uhla va lei uh,’ tiah an ti."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah fala aa pawl cu zinan lei dingah dawr ah an va feh; an feh sungah mopa cu a rak thleng. Ralringte in a rak um ciami fala panga pawl cu mopa thawn nupiṭhit rawldarnak puai sungah an lut ih sangka an khar."},"11":{"text":"“Cuih hnuah fala dang pawl cu an ra thleng ih ‘Bawipa, bawipa, sangka in rak on hram aw,’ tiah an au."},"12":{"text":"‘Thungai in ka lo sim: nannih ka lo thei hai lo,’ tiah mopa in a ti,” tiah a sim."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Cutiin a ni le a caan nan theih lo ruangah ralringte in hngak uh,” tiah a netnak ah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Cuih caanah vancung Uknak cu hi bangtuk in a si ding. Voikhat ah mipa pakhat a um ih khual tlawn a tum. A feh hlanah a hnen-um pawl a ko ih a thilri pawl a kilkhawiter.","title":"Hnen-um Pathum Tahṭhimnak (Luk 19.11-27)"},"15":{"text":"An thil titheinak zat ciarin an hnenah a pek: pakhat pa hnenah sui tangka thawng nga a pek, a dang pakhat hnenah thawng hnih a pek ih a dang pakhat pa hnenah thawng khat a pek. Cuih hnuah khual a tlawng."},"16":{"text":"Sui tangka thawng nga a ngahtu hnen-um pa cu hmakhatte ah a feh ih sum a tuah ih a miat thawng nga a ngah."},"17":{"text":"Cubangtuk in thawng hnih a ngahtu pa khal in a miat thawng hnih a ngah ve."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla tangka thawng khat a ngahtu pa cu a feh ih khur a laih hnuah a bawipa ih tangka cu a phum."},"19":{"text":"“Caan reipi hnuah an bawipa cu a ra kir ih an tangka hman daan thuhla fianter dingah an rel khawm."},"20":{"text":"Sui tangka thawng nga a ngahtu pa cu a ra ih a miat thawng nga a ra pek. ‘Bawipa sui tangka thawng nga i pek. Zohhnik! Hinah a miat thawng nga ka ngahmi khal ka lo pe,’ tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"A bawipa in ‘Hnen-um ṭha, rintlak zet hnen-um na si! Malte parah rinsantlak na si ruangah tampi kilkhawitu-ah ka lo tuah ding. Ra awla na bawipa lungawinak sungah hin ra tel ve aw,’ tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cule thawng hnih pekmi pa a ra lut ih ‘Bawipa i pekmi kha sui tangka thawng hnih a si. Zohhnik! Hinah a miat ka ngahmi a dang thawng hnih khal a um,’ tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"A bawipa in ‘A ṭha, hnen-um ṭha le rinsantlak hnen-um na si. Malte parah rinsantlak na si ruangah tampi kilkhawitu-ah ka lo tuah ding. Ra awla na bawipa lungawinak sungah hin ra tel ve aw,’ tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cule thawng khat a ngahtu pa a ra lut ih ‘Bawipa, nang cu mi tifekfek na si ti ka thei; na tuh lonak ah a rah na la ih na vorh lonak khalah rawl na khawm."},"25":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah ka lo ṭih ih na tangka cu leilung sungah ka phum. Zohhnik! Hinah a um ko,’ tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cutikah a bawipa in ‘Nang hnen-um ṭha lo, mi zee pa! Thlaici ka tuh lonak ah ka aat ih ka vorh lonak ah ka khawm cu na thei taktak maw si?"},"27":{"text":"Cuti a si ahcun ziangah so ka tangka cu ka ra kir tikih tangka ṭhang thawn ka ngah theinak dingah tangka retnak ah na rak ret lo?"},"28":{"text":"Hiti a si ruangah hi pa hnenih tangka cu la uhla thawng hra a neitu pa hnenah pek uh."},"29":{"text":"Ziangahtile a neitu pawl cu pek belh an si ding ih a hleifuan in an nei ding. Asinain zianghman a nei lo pa hnen in a neihsunte hman kha lak sak a si ding."},"30":{"text":"Hi ṭhathnemnak nei lo hnen-um pa hi a leng khawthimnak ah hlon uhla cutawkah ṭap-ai in a hacang rial seh,’ tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Milai Fapa cu Siangpahrang vekin a sunlawinak le vancungmi hmuahhmuah thawn a rat tikah siangpahrang tokham parah a to ding.","title":"Thuṭhennak Neta Bik"},"32":{"text":"Miphun hmuahhmuah a hmaiah khawm ṭheh an si ding. Cule tuukhal in tuu le me a ṭhen bangin mi hmuahhmuah cu a ṭhen ding."},"33":{"text":"Mi ṭha pawl cu a vorhlam ah a ret ding ih mi ṭha lo pawl cu a kehlam ah a ret ding."},"34":{"text":"Cule Siangpahrang cun a vorhlamih a ummi pawl hnenah ‘Ra uh, ka Pa ih a thlawsuahmi pawl! Ra uhla leilung seemtir ihsin nan hrangih rem ciami vancung Uknak hi ra co uh."},"35":{"text":"Ziangahtile ka ril a rawn tikah ei ding rawl in pek; ka ti a haal tikah in ding tidai in pek; mikhual ka si laiah nan inn ah in tlunter;"},"36":{"text":"hnipuan nei lo ka si tikah hnipuan in pek; ka nat laiah in tuamhlawm; thawng ka tlak laiah in veh,’ tiah a ti ding."},"37":{"text":"Cule miding pawl cun, ‘Bawipa ziangtikah so na rilrawn kan lo hmuh ih rawl kan lo pek; na ti a haal kan lo hmuh ih tidai kan lo pek?"},"38":{"text":"Ziangtikah so mikhual na si kan lo hmuh ih kan innih kan lo tlunter; hnipuan na neih loih hnipuan kan lo pek?"},"39":{"text":"Ziangtikah so na nat le thawng na tlak kan lo hmuh ih kan lo veh?’ tiah an ti ding."},"40":{"text":"Siangpahrang in, ‘Thungai in ka lo sim: hi ka unau pawl lakah nauta bik parih nan tuahmi cu ka parah nan tuah a si,’ a ti ding."},"41":{"text":"“Cule a kehlam ih a ummi pawl hnenah cun ‘Nannih Pathian ih camsiatmi pawl, ka hnen in tlanhlo uh. Satan le a dungthlun pawl hrangih ngaihtuahmi a mit dah lomi meisa sungah vung feh uh."},"42":{"text":"Ziangahtile ka ril a rawng naón rawl in pe lo; ka ti a hal naón in ding tidai in pe lo;"},"43":{"text":"mikhual ka si laiah nan inn ah in tlungter lo; hnipuan nei lo ka si laiah hnipuan in pe lo; ka naa ih thawng ka tlak laiah in tuamhlawm lo,’ tiah a ti ding."},"44":{"text":"Cule annih in ‘Bawipa, ziangtikah so na ril a rawn, na ti a haal, mikhual na si, hnipuan nei lo in na um, na nat i thawng na tlak kan lo hmuh ih kan lo bom duh lo?’ tiah an ti ding."},"45":{"text":"Siangpahrang in, ‘Thungai in ka lo sim: mi nauta bik pakhat nan bom duh lo kha, keimah in bawm duh lo a si,’ a ti ding."},"46":{"text":"Cuih hnuah cupawl cu kumkhua hrem hmun ah an feh ding ih mi ding pawl cu kumkhua nunnak ah an feh ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu pawl Jesuh in a zirh ṭheh tikah a dungthluntu pawl hnenah,","title":"Jesuh An Phiarnak (Mar 14.1-2 ; Luk 22.1-2 ; Joh 11.45-53)"},"2":{"text":"“Nan theih vekin tuih hnu ni hnih ah Lantak Puai a si ding ih Milai Fapa cu thinglamtah parih khencih dingah pek a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule puithiam upa pawl le upa dang pawl cu Puithiam Saang Kaiafas inn ah an tong aw ih,"},"4":{"text":"Jesuh kha kai ih that dingah a thupte in an tawlrel."},"5":{"text":"“Puai sungah cun kan that lo pei, mipi an buai pang ding,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh cu Bethani khua, phaarnat a rak tuartu Simon inn ah a um ih,","title":"Bethani Ah Jesuh Zihmui An Toih (Mar 14.3-9 ; Joh 12.1-8)"},"7":{"text":"rawl a ei laiah nunau pakhat a hnenah a ra ih alabaster thawl khattein mankhung zet zihmui a kenmi kha Jesuh lu ah a toih."},"8":{"text":"Cumi cu dungthluntu pawl in an hmuh tikah an thin a heng ih, “A va pamhmai ve!"},"9":{"text":"Hi zihmui cu tangka tampi ah zuar in a man kha mifarah pek ding sawn a si naón,” an ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutiih an ti kha Jesuh in a theih tikah an hnenah, “Ziangah so hi nunau nu cu nan hnaihnok rero? Ka hrangih a tuahmi hi thil ṭha le thil mawi zet a si."},"11":{"text":"Mifarah cu nan hnenah an um ringring ding, asinain kei cu nan hnenah ka um ringring lo ding."},"12":{"text":"Ka parih zihmui a toihmi hi ka ruak phum dingih a timtuahnak a si."},"13":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: Thuthang ṭha an simnak leilung tlun khuazakip ah hi nu ih a tuahmi hi amah hngilh lonak dingah sim a si ringring ding,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu lakih pakhat a si mi Judas Iskariot an timi cu puithiam upa pawl hnenah a feh ih,","title":"Judas In Jesuh Phiar A Duh (Mar 14.10-11 ; Luk 22.3-6)"},"15":{"text":"“Nan hnenah Jesuh ka lo pek asile ziangso in pek ding?” tiah a sut. Annih in tangka sawmthum an siar ih Judas cu an pek."},"16":{"text":"Cuih ni thokin Jesuh zuar theinak dingah Judas cun tikcu ṭha lawng a hngak."},"17":{"text":"Thilnu rawi lo sangreu Puai ni hmaisa bik ni ah dungthluntu pawl cu Jesuh hnenah an ra ih, “Khuitawkah so Lantak Puai rawl ei tlaangnak cu kan lo tuah sak ding?” tiah an sut.","title":"Lantak Puai Rawl Einak (Mar 14.12-21 ; Luk 22.7-13 , 21-23 ; Joh 13.21-30)"},"18":{"text":"Anih in, “Khawpi sung mi pakhat pa ih inn ah va feh uhla ‘Sayapa in ka tikcu a kim zo; ka dungthluntu pawl thawn na inn ah Lantak Puai kan tuah ding, a ti,’ va ti uh,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Jesuh sim vek cun dungthluntu pawl cun Lantak Puai zanriah cu an tiimlaam."},"20":{"text":"Zanlam ah Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu rawl ei dingah an to khawm."},"21":{"text":"Zanriah an ei rero laiah Jesuh in, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: nanmah lakah pakhat in i zuar ding,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cu an riah a sia ngaingai ih pakhat hnu pakhat in, “Bawipa, keimah ka si maw?” tiah an ti fingfing."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Keimah thawn khengkhat sungih saang a hnimtu in i zuar ding a si."},"24":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim ih a simcia vekin Milai Fapa cu a thi ding, asinain Milai Fapa a zuartu pa cu a hmakhua a va pit so! Cupa cu a nu ih pum sungin suak loin rak um sawnta sehla amah ih hrangah a ṭha sawn ding naón!” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Mi zuartu Judas in, “Sayapa, na ti sanmi cu kei ka si maw?” tiah a sut. Cutikah Jesuh in, “Nangmah in na sim zo,” tiah a let."},"26":{"text":"Rawl an ei laiah Jesuh in saang cu a lak ih thla a cam hnuah a phel ih a dungthluntu pawl hnenah a pek. “Lak uhla ei uh; himi hi ka taksa a si,” tiah a ti.","title":"Bawipa Zanriah (Mar 14.22-26 ; Luk 22.14-20 ; 1 Kor 11.23-25)"},"27":{"text":"Cuih hnuah khuathai a lak ih Pathian hnenah lungawi thu a sim hnuah an hnenah a pek. “Nan zatein in uh;"},"28":{"text":"himi hi ka thisen a si. Pathian thukam hngettertu le mitampi sual ngaithiamnak hrangih ka thletmi thisen a si."},"29":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: ka Pa ih Uknak sungah nanmah thawn sabit thar ka in sal hlan lo hi sabit cu ka in nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cule hla an sak ih Olif Tlangah an feh."},"31":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in an hnenah, “Tuih zan rori ah nan zatein nan tlanhlo ding ih keimah lawng in tan ding; ziangahtile Ca Thianghlim in ‘Pathian in tuukhal kha a that ding ih tuurual cu ṭhekdarh ṭheh an si ding,’ a ti a si.","title":"Piter Ih Elnak Thu A Simcia (Mar 14.27-31 ; Luk 22.31-34 ; Joh 13.36-38)"},"32":{"text":"Asinain thihnak ihsin thawhter sal ka si tikah Galilee ah nan hmaiah ka feh ding,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Piter in Jesuh hnenah, “Midang tlan ṭheh hman hai sehla kei cu ka tlan lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in Piter hnenah, “Thungai in ka lo sim: tuih zan ar a khuan hlanah ‘Amah cu ka thei lo a si,’ tiah voi thum tiang i phatsan ding,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Piter in, “Na hnenih thi ve ding ka si hmanah ka lo phatsan dah lo ding,” a ti. Dungthluntu dang pawl khal in cuti cun an ti ciar."},"36":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu a dungthluntu pawl thawn Gethsemane an timi hmuan ah an feh ih an hnenah, “Khitawk ih thla ka va cam sungah hinah rak to uh,” tiah a ti.","title":"Gethsemane Hmuan ah Thla A Cam (Mar 14.32-42 ; Luk 22.39-46)"},"37":{"text":"Piter le Zebedi fapa pahnih kha a fehpi. A riah a sia ih a thinlung a nuam lo ngaingai."},"38":{"text":"Cule an hnenah, “Ka thinlung hi riahsiatnak in a khat tuk ih a kuai ṭheh ding a bang. Hinah um uhla itthat loin i hngak uh,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Hlat deuh ah a va feh ih leilung ah a bok ih, “Ka Pa, a cang thei a si ahcun hi tuarnak khuathai hin i luatter hram aw! Asinain ka duh vekin si hlah seh, na duh vekin si ko seh,” tiah thla a cam."},"40":{"text":"Cun dungthluntu pathum hnenah a ra kir tikah an pathum in an itthat kha a hmu ih Piter hnenah, “Ziangtin so it loin nazi pakhat sung hman in hngak thei lo?"},"41":{"text":"Sualforhnak sungih tla lo dingin itthat loin thlacam uh. Thinlung cun a duh naón taksa cu a thazaang a der a si!” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Jesuh cu a feh sal ih thla a cam lala. “Ka Pa, hi khuathai hin luat a theih lo ih ka in tengteng a ṭul a si ahcun na duh vekin si ko seh,” a ti."},"43":{"text":"Dungthluntu pathum hnenah a ra kir sal ih an rak itthat thotho; an mit an meng thei hrimhrim lo."},"44":{"text":"Jesuh cun a taanta hai ih a cam keel in voithumnak thla a cam."},"45":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu pathum hnenah cun a ra kir ih, “Nan itthat ih nan cawl lai hrih maw si? Zoh uh, i zuartupa cu hinah a thleng zo,” tiah a ti."},"47":{"text":"Jesuh a ṭong rero laiah dungthluntu hleihnih lakih a tel ve mi Judas cu a ra thleng. Amah thawn hmun khatah puithiam upa pawl le Judah mi upa dang pawl ih thlahmi miburpi kha ralnam le talhtum pawl keng in an ra.","title":"Jesuh An Kaihnak (Mar 14.43-50 ; Luk 22.47-53 ; Joh 18.3-12)"},"48":{"text":"Mi phiartu cun misenpi kha theihthiamnak a rak simcia ih, “Ka hnam dingmi pa cu nan kaih duhmi pa a si ih nan kai pei!” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Judas in Jesuh cu a pan vurvo ih, “Sayapa, na parah daihnak um ko seh,” a ti phah in a hnam."},"50":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ka rual, na tummi cu tuah zaang sawn aw,” tiah a ti. Cule miburpi an ra thleng ih Jesuh cu an kaih hnuah fektein an ṭem."},"51":{"text":"Jesuh thawn a ummi lakah pakhat pa in a ralnam a zuuk ih Puithiam Saang ih salpa kha a hna a sah thlak."},"52":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Na nam cu a kawm sungah khum sal aw. Ralnam a hmangtu cu ralnam in an thi ve ding."},"53":{"text":"Ka Pa hnenah bomnak ka dil a si ahcun hmakhatte ah vancungmi ralkap bur hleihnih hnakih tam a run thlah thei ti hi na thei lo maw?"},"54":{"text":"Asinain cu bangtuk in sisehla Ca Thianghlim in a cang ding tiih a sim ciami cu ziangtinso a kim thei ding?” tiah a ti."},"55":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in miburpi hnenah cun, “Kei hi rukru maw ka si, ralnam le talhtum thawn keimah kai dingih nan rat ciamco? Nitinte Biakinn ah ka to ih thu ka lo zirh ṭheu laiah zohman in in kai fawn lo."},"56":{"text":"Sikhalsehla profet pawl in Ca Thianghlim sungih an nganmi a kim theinak dingah hi bangtuk in a cang a si,” tiah a ti. Cuihsin dungthluntu pawl cun an taan ih an tlansan ṭheh."},"57":{"text":"A kaitu pawl in Jesuh cu Puithiam Saang Kaiafas inn ah an fehpi ih cutawkah cun Daanthiam pawl le Judah upa pawl an tong aw khawm.","title":"Thureltu Khonsil Hmaiah An Suahpi (Mar 14.53-65 ; Luk 22.54-55 , 63-71 ; Joh 18.13-14 , 19-24)"},"58":{"text":"Piter in a hlat nawn ihsin Puithiam Saang ih tual tiang a thlun. Tual ah a vung lut ih ziang bangtuk in thil a cang ding ti zoh duh ah ralvengtu pawl hnenah a to."},"59":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl le Khonsil upa pawl in Jesuh cu an thah theinak dingah an zatein a sual an hawl."},"60":{"text":"Thuphan per tahratin a mawhnak hawltu tampi an ra suak naón a sualnak an hmu thei cuang lo. A netnak ah mi pahnih an ra suak ih,"},"61":{"text":"“Hi pa hin ‘Pathian Biakinn hi ka bal ding ih ni thum ah ka sak thei sal ding,’ a ti,” tiah an ra ti."},"62":{"text":"Cutikah Puithiam Saang a ding ih Jesuh cu, “Hitiin sual an lo puh hi a leh ngaihnak na thei lo maw?” tiah a sut."},"63":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh cu daitein a um. Cule Puithiam Saang cu a hung ṭong sal ih, “A nungmi Pathian hmin saal in siatcam in ka lo ti: Pathian fapa Messiah na si maw si lo so, sim hnik,” tiah a ti."},"64":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nangmah in na sim zo! Asinain thungai in ka lo sim: tuih thokin Milai Fapa hi Ziangkimtithei ih vorhlam ah to in nan hmu pei ih vancung mero par ihsin a rat khal na hmu ding,” tiah a ti."},"65":{"text":"Cuvete in Puithiam Saang cun a hnipuan a thlek ih, “Cumi cu Pathian thangsiat a si! Annih in, “A mawh rori, thah ding a si,” an ti."},"67":{"text":"Cule a hmaiah cil an phui ih an thawi ih an beng. Cule a bengtu pawl in,"},"68":{"text":"“Maw Messiah, profet bangin in sim hnik he! Zoso a lo bengtu!” tiah an ti."},"69":{"text":"Piter cu innleng tual ih a to laiah Puithiam Saang ih hnen-um nunau pakhat a ra ih, “Nangmah khal hi Galilee mi Jesuh thawn a pawl-awmi na si,” tiah a ti.","title":"Piter In Voithum Tiang Jesuh A Hnong (Mar 14.66-72 ; Luk 22.56-62 ; Joh 18.15-18 , 25-27)"},"70":{"text":"Asinain Piter in mizapi hmaiah cun a el ih, “Na ṭongmi hi ziang thu a si ti ka thei lo,” tiah a let."},"71":{"text":"Cule Piter cu kotka lamah a va feh. Hnen-um nunau dang in a hmu ih, “Hi pa hi Nazareth mi Jesuh thawn a ummi a si,” tiah cu tawkih a rak ummi mipi pawl hnenah a ti."},"72":{"text":"Piter cun a el sal ih, “Siatcam in ka sim: hi pa hi ka theihmi a si lo,” a ti."},"73":{"text":"Caan malte hnuah cutawkih a dingmi pawl in Piter cu, “Phat duh hlah, nang khal an hnenih telmi na si ko. Na aw cawi in a lang a si,” tiah an ti."},"74":{"text":"Cule Piter in, “Siatcam in thudik ka sim a si. Thudik lo ka sim a si le Pathian in i hrem seh! Hi pa hi ka thei hrimhrim lo,” tiah a ti. Cuṭheh vete in ar a khuang ih,"},"75":{"text":"Piter in Jesuh ih a rak sim ciami, “Ar a khuan hlanah ka thei lo a si, tiah voithum tiang i phatsan ding,” a timi kha a vun mang sal. Piter cu khawlengah a suak ih thinlung na zetin a ṭap."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingthlapit ah puithiam upa pawl hmuahhmuah le Judah upa pawl in Jesuh cu that dingah an tawlrel.","title":"Jesuh Cu Pilat Hnenah An Fehpi (Mar 15.1 ; Luk 23.1-2 ; Joh 18.28-32)"},"2":{"text":"Thir cikcin in an khih hnuah an hruai ih Rom Acozah bawi Mangki Pilat kut ah an pek."},"3":{"text":"Mi phiartu Judas in Jesuh cu thu an ṭhen ih mawh an pek ti kha a theih tikah a sir-aw ih tangka sawmthum kha puithiam upa le Judah upa hnenah a va khirh sal.","title":"Judas Thihnak (Dung 1.18-19)"},"4":{"text":"“Mawhnak nei lo pa thihnak thleng tiangin ka phiar ruangah ka sual tuk a si,” tiah a va ti. A va feh ih amah le amah a hngawng in a awk that aw."},"6":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl in cuih tangka cu an sar ih, “Hi tangka hi thisen tangka a si ruangah biakinn tangka retnak sungih ret ding cu kan Daan in a duh lo,” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"A thuhla an rel ih zate lungkimnak in cuih tangka cu Beel Tuahtu ih lo leinak ah an hmang ih cuih lo cu ramdangmi pawl phumnak thlaanmual ah an hmang."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah cuih lo cu tuih ni tiangin, “Thisen Lo,” tiah kawh a si lai."},"9":{"text":"Cuticun profet Jeremiah ih a rak simmi cu a kim. Profet Jeremiah in, “Israel mi pawl in cupa leinak ah an lungkim in an khiahmi tangka sawmthum cu an lak ih,"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa in thu i pekmi vekin beel tuahtu lo leinak ah an hmang,” tiah a rak ti.","ref":"Zek 11.12-13"},"11":{"text":"Jesuh cu Rom Acozah Mangki bawi hmaiah cun a ding ih Mangki bawipa cun, “Judah mi pawl ih Siangpahrang na si maw?” tiah a sut. Jesuh in, “Nangmah in na ti si!” tiah a sawn.","title":"Pilat In Jesuh Thu A Sut (Mar 15.2-5 ; Luk 23.3-5 ; Joh 18.33-38)"},"12":{"text":"Asinain puithiam upa le Judah mi upa dang pawl ih sual an puhmi pawl cu zianghman a let lo."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah Pilat in, “Sual an lo puhmi hmuahhmuah hi na thei lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh cun kam khat hman a sawn duh lo; curuangah Mangki bawipa cu a khawruah a har ngaingai."},"15":{"text":"Lantak puai tinte in Mangki bawipa cun, misenpi in suakseh tiah an ngenmi thawngtla pakhat kha a suahter daan a si.","title":"Jesuh Thi Dingin An Rel (Mar 15.6-15 ; Luk 23.13-25 ; Joh 18.39—19.16)"},"16":{"text":"Culai ah mi kipih theihmi thawngtla pakhat a um ih a hmin cu Jesuh Barabbas a si."},"17":{"text":"Misenpi an tonkhawm awk tikah Mangki bawi Pilat cun, “Zoso lo thlah sak ningla nan duh? Jesuh Barabbas maw Messiah timi Jesuh so?” tiah a sut."},"18":{"text":"Judah upa pawl in an nahsiik ruang meenah Jesuh cu a kut ah an thlenter a si, ti kha Pilat in fiangtein a thei."},"19":{"text":"Pilat cu thuṭhennak innpi sungih a to laiah a nupi in, “Mawhnak zianghman a nei lo pa kha a parah zianghman rak tuah hlah. Misenpi in, “Barabbas,” tiah an ti."},"22":{"text":"“Cuti asile Messiah timi Jesuh hi ziangtin ka tuah pei?” tiah Pilat in a sut. “Thinglamtah parah that aw!” tiah an zatein an ti."},"23":{"text":"Asinain Pilat in, “Ziang sualnak so a tuah?” tiah a sut hai. Cutikah, “Thinglamtah ah khenbet aw!” tiah an au thei patawp in an au ciamco."},"24":{"text":"Pilat in cutiih suh rero kha a ṭhathnemnak a um lo ih misenpi in hnaihnawhnak riangri an suakter pang ding ti a hmuh ruangah tidai lak tahratin mizapi hmaiah a kut a kholh ih, “Hi mawh nei lo pa thihnak ah hin kei ka tel lo! Nanmah ih tuahmi a si,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah misenpi cun, “Hi pa thihnak ih thisen cu kanmah le kan tesinfa pawl parah thleng ko seh,” tiah an ti."},"26":{"text":"Cuticun Pilat in an hrangah Barabbas cu a thlah sak; cule Jesuh cu a thawiter hnuah thinglamtah parih that dingin an kut ah a pek."},"27":{"text":"Cule Pilat ih ralkap pawl in Jesuh cu Mangki bawipa ih inn ah an fehpi ih misenpi pawl cu a kiangah an ra khawm.","title":"Ralkap Pawl In Jesuh An Hmuhsuam (Mar 15.16-20 ; Joh 19.2-3)"},"28":{"text":"A hnipuan an hlit ih puansen an sinter."},"29":{"text":"Cule hlingih tuahmi lukhuh a lu ah an khumter; cun a vorhlam kut ah fung an kenter. Cule thinglamtah parih thah dingah an hruai."},"32":{"text":"Cutiih an feh laiah Sairin khua mi Simon kha an tong ih ralkap pawl in Jesuh thinglamtah kha hramhram in Simon an putter.","title":"Thinglamtah Parah Jesuh An Khen (Mar 15.21-32 ; Luk 23.26-43 ; Joh 19.17-27)"},"33":{"text":"Golgotha an timi hmun an thleng. Golgotha ti cu, “Luruh Hmun,” tican a si."},"34":{"text":"Cutawkah Jesuh cu hnitkha vekih a khami thawn rawimi sabitti an pek; a tep ih a in duh lo."},"35":{"text":"Jesuh cu thinglamtah ah an khen ih a hnipuan cu camcawhfung zuukin an zem aw."},"36":{"text":"Cuih hnuah an to ih amah cu an kil."},"37":{"text":"“Hi pa cu Judah Siangpahrang Jesuh a si,” tiah sual an puhnak kha an ngan ih a lu tlunah an tar."},"38":{"text":"Cun mi ṭha lo damiah pahnih Jesuh thawn thinglamtah parah an khen ve; pakhat a vorhlam ah, a dang pakhat a kehlam ah an thlai."},"39":{"text":"A kiangkapih a suksotu pawl tla in an diriam in an lu an sut hnawh ih,"},"40":{"text":"“Biakinnpi bal tahratin ni thum sungah ka sak sal ding na ti a si lo maw! Pathian Fapa na si ahcun nangmah le nangmah run awla thinglamtah par ihsin rung ṭum aw he!” tiah an dekcok."},"41":{"text":"Cubangtuk in puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl le Judah upa pawl in an hmuhsuam ih,"},"42":{"text":"midang cu a hum thei, asinain amah le amah cu a hum aw thei lo! Israel Siangpahrang a si lo maw si? Atu rori ah hin thinglamtah par ihsin a rung ṭum a si ahcun kan zum ding a si!"},"43":{"text":"Pathian a rinsan ih Pathian Fapa ka si a ti si! Pathian in a hum duh maw kan zoh hnik pei cu!” tiah nautat ṭong in an ti."},"44":{"text":"Amah thawn an khenbetmi damiah pawl tla in cu bangtuk cun an nautat ve."},"45":{"text":"Sun laitak fangah ramsung pumpuluk ah thimkhawzing a tlung ih nazi pathum sung a thim.","title":"Jesuh Thihnak (Mar 15.33-41 ; Luk 23.44-49 ; Joh 19.28-30)"},"46":{"text":"Zanlam nazi pathum ah Jesuh cu napi in a au ih, “Eli, Eli, lema sabakthani?” a ti; a tican cu, “Ka Pathian, Ka Pathian, zianghrangah i tlansan?” ti a si."},"47":{"text":"Cutawkih a dingmi hrekkhat pawl in an thei ih, “Elijah a ko a si,” tiah an ti."},"48":{"text":"An lakah pakhat pa cu a va tlan vurvo ih tidai a hawp thei zetmi puan a va lak ih sabit sungih a hnim hnuah funghreu parah a ṭemcih ih Jesuh cu a inter zik."},"49":{"text":"Asinain midang in, “Um hrih, amah run dingah Elijah a rat le rat lo kan zohhnik pei,” tiah an ti."},"50":{"text":"Jesuh cu napi in a au sal ih a hnuk a cat."},"51":{"text":"Cule Biakinn puanzar cu a tlunlam ihsin a hnuailam tiang ṭhen hnih ah a tlek. Leilung a hnin ṭheh, lungpi an kuai ṭheh,"},"52":{"text":"thlaan pawl an ong aw ih a rak thi ciami Pathian mithiang pawl an tho sal."},"53":{"text":"An thlaan ihsin an suak ih Jesuh cu thlaan in a thawhsal hnuah Khua Thianghlim sungah an lut ih mi tampi hmaiah an lang."},"54":{"text":"Ral bawipa pakhat le amah thawn Jesuh a kiltu ralkap pawl in linghnin le thil dang a cangmi hmuahhmuah kha an hmuh tikah an tuk a sum ih, “Hi pa hi Pathian Fapa taktak a si,” tiah an ti."},"55":{"text":"Galilee ram ihsin Jesuh a rak thluntu le a rak bawm ṭheutu nunau tampi an um ih a hlat nawn in an rak cuan."},"56":{"text":"Cuih nunau lakah cun Mari Magdalene, Jeim le Josef ih nu Mari le Zebedi nupi tla an tel."},"57":{"text":"Zanlam a hung si tikah Arimathea khua ihsin milianpa pakhat a ra thleng. A hmin cu Josef a si ih Jesuh dungthluntu pakhat a si ve.","title":"Jesuh Phumnak (Mar 15.42-47 ; Luk 23.50-56 ; Joh 19.38-42)"},"58":{"text":"Pilat a va tong ih Jesuh ruak kha a dil. Jesuh ruak cu Josef hnenih pek dingah Pilat in thu a pek."},"59":{"text":"Cuticun Josef in Jesuh ruak cu a lak ih puan thar nemtein a tuam ih,"},"60":{"text":"amah ih thlaan dingih lungkhermi thlaan thar sungah a phum. Cuih hnuah lungphengpi in thlaan kaa cu a kharta ih a fehsan."},"61":{"text":"Mari Magdalene le a dang Mari cu cutawk ahcun thlaanlam hoi in an to."},"62":{"text":"A thaisun Sabbath ni ah puithiam upa le Farasi pawl in Pilat an tong ih,","title":"Thlan Kiltu Pawl"},"63":{"text":"“Bawipa, hi thuphanpertu pa hin a nun laiah ‘Nithum hnuah ka tho sal ding,’ tiah a rak ti."},"64":{"text":"Curuangah a thlaan kha ṭhatein ni thumnak ni tiang kilter aw; culole a dungthluntu pawl in a ruak kha an fir pei ih misenpi pawl kha thihnak ihsin a tho sal zo a si, tiah an bum ding. Hi neta bumnak hi a hmaisa bumnak hnakin a poimawh sawn ding a si,” tiah an ti."},"65":{"text":"Pilat cun, “A kiltu Rom ralkap pawl ret uhla thlaan kha a him thei tawkin tuah uh,” tiah a ti."},"66":{"text":"Curuangah an feh ih thlaan cu a him thei tawkin an tuah; thlan khar lungpheng kha tacik an khen ih a lengin ṭha zetin an kilter."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sabbath ni a liam ih a thaizing zingthlapit ah Mari Magdalene le a dang Mari cu thlaan zoh dingah an feh.","title":"Jesuh Thawhsalnak (Mar 16.1-10 ; Luk 24.1-12 ; Joh 20.1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Hmakhatteah nasa zet in ling a hnin. Bawipa ih vancungmi pakhat cu vancung ihsin a rung ṭum ih thlaan sangka khar lungphengpi cu a ṭhawn ih a parah a to."},"3":{"text":"A hmuihmel cu nimthla bangtuk a si ih a hnipuan cu vur bangin a vaar."},"4":{"text":"Thlan kiltu pawl cu an ṭih tukah an khur ih mithi bangtuk an si."},"5":{"text":"Vancungmi cun nunau pawl hnenah, “ṭih hlah uh; thinglamtah parih an thahmi Jesuh nan hawl ti ka thei."},"6":{"text":"Hinah a um lo, a rak simcia bangtuk in thihnak ihsin thawhter sal a si zo. An phumnak hmun hi ra zohhnik uh."},"7":{"text":"Zamrang in va feh uhla a dungthluntu pawl kha ‘Thihnak ihsin thawhter a si zo; nan hmaiah Galilee ah a feh ding ih cutawkah nan hmu ding!’ tiah va sim uh. Ka lo simmi hi hngilh hlah uh,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah zamrang zetin thlaan ihsin an tlung; an ṭih phah, an lung a awi phah, cuticun dungthluntu pawl sim dingah an tlan."},"9":{"text":"Rinlopi-ah Jesuh in a tong hai ih, “Nan hnenah daihnak um hram seh,” tiah a ti. An va pan ih a ke an va pom ih an biak."},"10":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnen ah, “Nan thinphang hlah uh. Ka unau pawl kha Galilee ih feh dingin va sim uh. Cutawkah in tong ding!” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutiih nunau pawl an feh laiah, thlaan kiltu ralkap hrekkhat pawl cu khawpi sungah an feh ih puithiam upa pawl hnenah thlaan ih thil a cangmi hmuahhmuah kha an sim.","title":"Thlan Kiltu Pawlih Thuthannak"},"12":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl le Judah mi upa pawl an tong aw ih thu an ruatkhawm. Ralkap pawl kha nawhthuh paisa tampi an pek ih,"},"13":{"text":"“Kan ihthat sungah zanah a dungthluntu pawl an ra ih a ruak kha an fir a si, nan ti pei."},"14":{"text":"Cumi cu Mangki bawipa in a theih khalle nan phan ding zianghman a um lo, mawhnak an nei lo tiah kan lo simsak ding,” tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"Thlan kiltu ralkap pawl in paisa cu an lak ih an simmi vekin an tuah. Cuih thu cu Judah mi pawl cun tuihsun tiangin an rel ṭheumi a si."},"16":{"text":"Dungthluntu hleikhat pawl cu Jesuh ih a fial bangtuk in Galilee tlang parah an feh.","title":"A Dungthluntu Hnenah Jesuh A Lang (Mar 16.14-18 ; Luk 24.36-49 ; Joh 20.19-23 ; Dung 1.6-8)"},"17":{"text":"Amah cu an hmu ih an biak, asinain a hrek cun an zum lo."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh cun a pan hai ih an hnenah, “Lei le vanih thuneihnak hmuahhmuah cu ka hnenah pek a si zo."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah feh uhla miphun hmuahhmuah ka dungthluntu va siter uh; Pa le Fapa le Thiang Thlarau hmin in baptisma va pe uh."},"20":{"text":"Cule ka thupekmi hmuahhmuah thlun dingin va zirh uh. Hngilh hlah uh, san a cem lai hlanlo nan hnenah ka um ringring ding,” tiah a ti."}}}}},"41":{"info":{"name":"Marka","shortname":"Mar","abbr":[],"desc":"Marka nganmi thuthang ṭha"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian Fapa Jesuh Khrih ih Thuthang ṭha cu hiti in a si.","title":"Baptisma Petu Johan Thusimnak (Mat 3.1-12 ; Luk 3.1-18 ; Joh 1.19-28)"},"2":{"text":"A thokah profet Isaiah in: “Pathian in ‘Na hmaiah ka palai ka thlah ding; Na hrangih lamzin sialtu dingah,’"},"3":{"text":"Mi pakhat cu ramṭhingah a au ih, ‘Bawipa ih hrangah lamzin sial uh, A fehnak ding lamzin kha dingter uh,’ a ti,” tiah a ngan.","ref":"Isai 40.3"},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Johan cu ramṭhing ihsin a ra ih baptisma a pek hai ih thu tla a sim phah vivo. Mipi pawl kha, “Nan sualnak sir uhla baptisma lak uh. Cuticun Pathian in nan sualnak a lo ngaithiam ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Judea peng le Jerusalem khawpi ihsin mi tampi Johan ih thusimmi ngai dingah an ra. An sualnak an phuang ih Jordan tiva ah baptisma a pek hai."},"6":{"text":"Johan cu kalauk hmulih tahmi hnipuan a hruk ih a taai ah savun taikhap a khap.
