Asinain anih cun Thlarau Thianghlim in baptisma a lo pek hai ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cuih hnu rei loteah Galilee peng Nazareth khua ihsin Jesuh cu a ra ih Jordan tiva ah Johan in baptisma a rak pek.","title":"Jesuh Baptisma Le Hniksaknak (Mat 3.13—4.11 ; Luk 3.21-22 ; 4.1-13)"},"10":{"text":"Jesuh cu ti sung ihsin a hung suah vete in van a ong aw ih Thlarau cu thuro bangin a parih a rung fut kha a hmu."},"11":{"text":"Van ihsin aw pakhat a rung thang ih, “Nangmah cu ka duhdawtmi ka Fapa na si. Na parah ka lung a kim ngaingai,” tiah a run ti."},"12":{"text":"Hmakhatteah Jesuh cu ramṭhing ah Thlarau in a fehter ih"},"13":{"text":"cutawkah ni sawmli a um ih Satan in a hniksak. Ramsa pawl thawn an um. Asinain vancungmi pawl in an rung tuamhlawm."},"14":{"text":"Johan kha thawngih an thlak hnuah Jesuh cu Galilee ah a feh ih Pathian ih Thuthang ṭha a sim.","title":"Jesuh In Nga Kaitu Pali A Ko (Mat 4.12-22 ; Luk 4.14-15 ; 5.1-11)"},"15":{"text":"“Tikcu a kim zo ih Pathian Uknak a nai zo. Nan sualnak pawl sir uhla Thuthang ṭha cu zum uh,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh cu Galilee Tili kapih a feh laiah ngakaitu pahnih Simon le a nau Andru kha sur in nga an kaih rero laifang a hmu."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “I thlun uhla milai kaitu ah ka lo tuah ding,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Hmakhatteah an sur an taan ih amah cu an thlun."},"19":{"text":"Hla deuh a va feh ih Zebedi ih fapa Jeim le Johan te unau hnih a hmu. Anmah cu an lawng sungah an um ih an sur an tholh rero."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in a hmuh vete in an pahnih in a ko. Cuticun an pa Zebedi le an hlawhfa pawl cu lawng sungah cun an taan ih Jesuh cu an thlun."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu Kapernaum khua ah an ra ih a thaisun Sabbath ni ah Jesuh cu pumkhawmnak inn Sinakok ah a feh ih thu a zirh.","title":"Khawsia Polhmi (Luk 4.31-37)"},"22":{"text":"A thuzirh daan a theitu pawl cu an mang a bang ngaingai, ziangahtile Daanthiam pawl vek a si lo, anih cun thunei zetin a zirh a si."},"23":{"text":"Cuih caanah khawsia in a polhmi mipa pakhat cu Sinakok ahcun a ra ih,"},"24":{"text":"“Nazareth mi Jesuh, ziangso kannih in hai? Kanmah siatsuah dingah maw na rat? Zo na si ti ka lo thei: Pathian ih thlahmi Mi Thianghlim na si,” tiah a au ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh in khawsia cu, “Daite in um aw! Kha pa sung in suak aw!” tiah thu a pek."},"26":{"text":"Khawsia in cupa cu nasa zetin a thin ih ring zetin a auter hnuah a suak."},"27":{"text":"Mipi cu an mang a bang ngaingai ih pakhat le pakhat, “Ziangvek thu so a si? Zirhnak thar phun khat maw a si? Hi pa hi khawsia parah thu a nei ih ‘Suak uh!’ a tile an suak fawn,” tiah an ti aw."},"28":{"text":"Cuticun Jesuh thuhla cu Galilee peng khuazakip ah zamrang zetin a thang."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthlun pawl cu Jeim le Johan tel in, sinakok ihsin an feh ih Simon le Andru inn lam pan in an feh.","title":"Jesuh In Mi Tampi A Damter (Mat 8.14-17 ; Luk 4.38-41)"},"30":{"text":"Simon ih pizon kha khurhnat in a na ih a tho thei lo; Jesuh a thlen vete in a nat thuhla cu an sim."},"31":{"text":"Mina hnenah cun a feh ih a kut a kai ih a thawhter. A khurhnat cu a reh lohli ih anmah a tuamhlawm thei."},"32":{"text":"Ni a tlak ih zanlam a si tikah mipi in mina hmuahhmuah le khawsia ih polhmi pawl kha Jesuh hnenah an rat pi."},"33":{"text":"Cuih khua ih mi hmuahhmuah cu cuih inn hmai ahcun an ra tong khawm aw ṭheh."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in an natnak phunphun kha a damter ih an sungih khawsia pawl tla a dawisuak ṭheh. Khawsia pawl cu kam khatte hman a ṭongter lo; ziangahtile zo a si ti kha an thei."},"35":{"text":"A thaizing, zingthlapit ni suah hlanah, Jesuh cu a tho ih inn ihsin a suak. Hnarpawn ah a suak ih mi um lonak ah thla a cam.","title":"Galilee Ah Jesuh Thu A Sim (Luk 4.42-44)"},"36":{"text":"Asinain Simon le a rualpi pawl cu amah hawl ah an feh ih,"},"37":{"text":"an va hmuh tikah a hnenah, “Mi hmuahhmuah in an lo hawl,” tiah an sim."},"38":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh in, “Hi kiangkap khua pawl khalah kan feh vivo ding, an hnenah thu ka sim ve ding, ziangahtile cucu ka rat hnawhsanmi a si,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Curuangah Galilee peng pumpuluk tlawng in sinakok ah thu a sim vivo ih khawsia pawl a dawi suak vivo a si."},"40":{"text":"Phaarnat in a na mipa pakhat cu Jesuh hnenah a ra ih a khuk bilh in, “Na duh a si ahcun i thiangter thei ko,” tiah bomnak a dil.","title":"Jesuh In Mi Pakhat A Damter (Mat 8.1-4 ; Luk 5.12-16)"},"41":{"text":"Jesuh cun a zaangfah ngaingai ih a kut in a hei dawh hnuah a tham ih, “Ka lo thiangter duh zet a si, thiang thlang aw,” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Hmakhatteah a phaarnat cu a dam ih a thiang."},"43":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in cupa cu a fehter ih, fektein thu a tiam,"},"44":{"text":"“Ngai aw! Hi thu hi zohman na sim lo pei. Puithiam hnenah va feh vurvo awla rak lo zohseh; cule mi hmuahhmuah in a dam a si ti an lo theihnak dingah Moses thupekmi vekih thawinak va pe aw,” tiah fektein thu a tiam."},"45":{"text":"Asinain cupa cu a feh ih a damnak thu cu hmunkip ah a than vivo. Cuih thu a rel tamtuk ruangah Jesuh cu khawsungah mi hmuhhngan in a feh thei nawn lo. Hnarpawn fianhrial sawnah amah lawng a um ih cutawkah hmunkip ihsin mi in an ra pan."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni malte a rei hnuah Jesuh cu Kapernaum khua a ra thleng sal ih inn ah a um ti thu kha a thang ciamco.","title":"Jesuh In Mizengpa A Damter (Mat 9.1-8 ; Luk 5.17-26)"},"2":{"text":"Mi tamtuk an rat ruangah inn sung cu a lawngnak pakhat hman a um lo; sangka kiang a leng tiangin an khat ṭheh. An hnenah Jesuh in thu a sim;"},"3":{"text":"cuti ih a sim laifangah mi pali in mizengpa pakhat Jesuh hnenah an rak zawn."},"4":{"text":"Milai an tam tuk ruangah Jesuh hnenah cun an thlenpi thei lo. Curuangah Jesuh umnak zawn diphun kha an bauh ih mizengpa cu a ihphah parah it in an vun thlak."},"5":{"text":"Zumnak an neih zia kha Jesuh in a hmuh tikah mizengpa hnenah cun, “Ka fapa, na sualnak cu ngaithiam a si zo,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutawkih a to vemi Daanthiam hrekkhat pawl in,"},"7":{"text":"“Ziangtin so hi vekin a ṭong ngam? Pathian thangsiat a sisi. Pathian siar lo zoso mi sualnak a thlah thei?” tiah an thinlung tein an ti."},"8":{"text":"An thinlung cu Jesuh in hmakhatte ah a thei ih an hnenah, “Ziangah so hi bangtuk in nan ruat?"},"9":{"text":"Hi mizengpa hnenah hin ‘Na sualnak cu ngaithiam a si zo,’ ti maw, ‘Tho awla na ihphah lak awla va feh aw,’ tiso a ol sawn?"},"10":{"text":"Milai Fapa in leilung parah mi ih sual ngaithiam theinak a nei a si, ti hi nan hnenah ka langter duh a si,” tiah a ti. Curuangah mizengpa hnenah,"},"11":{"text":"“Tho aw; na ihphah la awla na inn ah va tin aw, ka lo ti,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"An zatein an zoh ih cu laifangah mizengpa cu a tho; a ihphah a lak ih zamrang zetin a feh. An zatein an mang a bang tuk lawmmam ih “Hi bangtuk cu kan hmu dah lo,” an ti ih Pathian an thangṭhat."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh cu Galilee Tili kapah a va feh sal. Mi tampi a hnenah an ra ih thu a zirh.","title":"Jesuh In Levi A Ko (Mat 9.9-13 ; Luk 5.27-32)"},"14":{"text":"A feh phahah siahkhongtu, Alfias ih fapa Levi a zungkhaan sungih a to kha a hmu. Jesuh in, “I thlun aw,” a ti. Levi cu a tho ih a thlun."},"15":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh cu Levi inn ah rawl a ei. Siahkhong le misual tiih hnonmi tampi in Jesuh cu an thlun ih cu pawl ṭhenkhat cu Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl thawn rawl an ei tlang."},"16":{"text":"Farasi mi Daanthiam hrekkhat pawl in Jesuh cu hi bangtuk hnonmi misual le siahkhong pawl thawn rawl a ei kha an hmuh tikah a dungthluntu pawl kha, “Ziangah so hi bangtuk mi pawl thawn rawl a ei?” tiah an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Jesuh in a thei ih, “Mi harhdam pawl in sibawi an hai lo; a na mi lawng in an hai a si. Miding pawl ko dingah ka ra lo, misual pawl ko dingah ka ra a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Voikhat ah baptisma petu Johan thluntu pawl le Farasi mi pawl rawl an ul. Mi ṭhenkhat pawl Jesuh hnenah an ra ih, “Ziangah so baptisma petu Johan dungthluntu pawl le Farasi thluntu pawl cu rawl an ul naón nang a lo thluntu pawl cu rawl an ulh lo?” tiah an sut.","title":"Rawl-ulhnak Thu (Mat 9.14-17 ; Luk 5.33-39)"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Mopuai ih sawmmi pawl khi rawl an ul tiin nan ruat maw? An ul lo! Mopa an hnenih a um sungah cun rawl cu an ul lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an hnen ihsin mopa lak hlo a si ni a thleng ding ih cutikah rawl cu an ul ve leh ding."},"21":{"text":"“Angki hlun belhnak ah zohman in puan tharte an hmang dah lo; ziangahtile belhnak puan thar cu a com ding ih hnipuan hlun sawn kha a tlekter ding ih a ong ciami kha a kau sinsin ding."},"22":{"text":"Cun sabitti thar kha savun thawl hlun sungah an than dah lo, ziangahtile sabitti thar in savun thawl hlun cu a kuaiter ding ih sabit le a thawl cu an cemral ding. Curuangah sabitti thar cu savun thawl thar sungah than sawn ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh cu Sabbath ni ah sangvut lo sungin a feh. Amah thawn hmun khatah a dungthluntu pawl tla an feh ve ih sangvut vui kha an zuut phah.","title":"Sabbath Ni Ulh Thu (Mat 12.1-8 ; Luk 6.1-5)"},"24":{"text":"Farasi pawl in Jesuh cu, “Zohhnik, na dungthlun pawl Sabbath ni ah hi bangtuk thil an tuah hi kan Daan ih duh lomi a si,” tiah an ti."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh in, “David in ei ding zianghman a neih lo tikah ziang a tuah ti cu nan siar dah lo maw si? Amah le a rualpi pawl an ril a rawng zet ih,"},"26":{"text":"Pathian inn sungah lut tahratin Pathian hnenih hlanmi sang kha a ei. Culai ih Puithiam sang cu Abiathar a si. Kan Daan sung vek a si ahcun cuih sang cu puithiam lawngih eithiang a si. Asinain David in a ei ih cuih tlunah a rualpi pawl tla a pek,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Sabbath cu minung hrangih tuahmi a si; minung hi Sabbath hrangih tuahmi a si lo."},"28":{"text":"Curuangah Milai Fapa cu Sabbath tlun khalah Bawi a si,” tiah a sim."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu sinakok ah a va feh sal ih cutawkah kut zengpa pakhat a rak um.","title":"Kut Zengpa (Mat 12.9-14 ; Luk 6.6-11)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh kha sualpuh a duhtu pawl tla an rak um ih curuangah Sabbath ni ah a damter ding maw damter lo ding tiah ṭhatein an zoh."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in cupa cu, “Hmailam ah hin ra suak hnik,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule mipi cu, “Kan Daan in Sabbath ni ah ziang tuah ding so in on? Mi bawm ding maw harsatnak pek ding so? Mi nunnak runsuah ding maw siatsuah ding so?” tiah a sut. Asinain annih cu kam khat hman an ṭong lo."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh cun a thinheng in a zoh vivo hai ih an thinlung a ruh zia kha a hmuh tikah a riah a sia zet fawn. Cule mi pa cu, “Na baan hawi aw,” a ti. A baan cu a hawi ih a dam ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Farasi mi pawl cu sinakok ihsin an suak ih Herod ih milai pawl thawn Jesuh thah theinak dingah thu an ruatkhawm."},"7":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu Galilee Tili ah an va feh; miburpi in Jesuh cu an thlun. Anmah tla cu Galilee peng, Judea peng,","title":"Tili Kap Ah Miburpi In An Pan"},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem khua, Idumea peng, Jordan tiva ihsin nisuahnak lam ram, Tai-ar le Sidon kiangkap ram pawl tiang in a rami an si. Jesuh ih thil tuahmi pawl an theih ruangih a rami an si."},"9":{"text":"Milai an tamtuk lawmmam ih in ciil ciamco pang ding ti a phan ruangah dungthluntu pawl kha lawng pakhat timtuah cia in a retter."},"10":{"text":"Mi tampi a damter ih mina hmuahhmuah in an tham ngah theinak dingah an nor ciamco."},"11":{"text":"Cun khawsia polhmi pawl in an hmuh tikah a hmaiah an bok ih, “Nangmah cu Pathian Fapa na si,” tiah an au ciamco."},"12":{"text":"Jesuh in cuih khawsia polhmi pawl cu amah kha zo a si ti an rel lonak dingah thu a pek."},"13":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu tlangpar ah a hung kai ih a hnenah a mi duhmi pawl a ko. A hnenah cun an ra ih,","title":"Jesuh In Dungthlun Hleihnih A Hril (Mat 10.1-4 ; Luk 6.12-16)"},"14":{"text":"minung hleihnih a hril ih ‘Tirhthlah pawl,’ tiah a ko. “Ka hnenih um dingah ka lo hril. Cule thusim dingah ka lo thlah ding ih,"},"15":{"text":"khawsia dawihlo theinak thu tla nan nei ding,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Hleihnih a hrilmi pawl cu hihi an si. Simon (Piter tiih hmin a pekmi),"},"17":{"text":"Zebedi ih fapa Jeim le a nau pa Johan (Jesuh in Boanerges tiah hmin a pek hai, a tican cu ‘Khawri Fa,’ tinak a si),"},"18":{"text":"Andru, Filip, Bartholomeo, Matthai, Thomas, Alfias ih fapa Jeim, Thaddaeus, Phunṭan Simon, le"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh a zuartu Judas Iskariot tla an si."},"20":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu inn ah a tlung. A hmaisa vek thotho in mi tam ngaingai an ra ih Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu rawl ei caan hman an nei lo.","title":"Jesuh Le Beelzebul (Mat 12.22-32 ; Luk 11.14-23 ; 12.10)"},"21":{"text":"Cuih thu cu a sungte pawl in an theih tikah, “Jesuh cu a aa zo,” tiah mi in an ti fawn ruangah amah kilkhawi dingin an feh."},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem ihsin a rami Daanthiam hrekkhat pawl in Jesuh cu “Beelzebul in a kai zo a si. Khawsia uktu bawi ih huham in khawsia pawl a dawi thei a si,” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh cun a ko hai ih an hnenah tahṭhimnak thawn thu a sim. “Ziangtin so Satan in Satan lala cu a dawi thei ding?"},"24":{"text":"Ram pakhatkhat cu ṭhen tampi ah a ṭhen aw ih anmah le anmah an do awk ahcun cuih ram cu an ṭekdarh ding."},"25":{"text":"Innsang pakhat sungah pakhat le pakhat an to aw ih an thawi awk a si ahcun cuih innsang cu an ṭeekdarh ding."},"26":{"text":"Cubangtuk in Satan in Satan lala a dawisuak a si ahcun an ṭhenṭhek awk ruangah an ram cu rei a awh lo ding ih a cemral ding a si."},"27":{"text":"“Micak pa cu amah an ṭem hmaisa lo ahcun zohman in a inn bauh tahratin a thilri an lak sak thei lo ding."},"28":{"text":"“Thungaite in ka lo sim: minung hi ziangvek in an sual ih ṭong siava tiang an ṭong hmanah ngaihthiam an si ding."},"29":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Thlarau Thianghlim a thangsiattu cu ngaidam a si lo ding, ziangahtile kumkhua daih sualnak a tuah a si,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh kha “Khawsia a sungah a lut,” tiah an ti ruangah Jesuh in hiti ih a ṭongnak hi a si."},"31":{"text":"Cule Jesuh ih nu le a naule pawl an ra. Inn lengah an ding ih inn sungah mi an vun tirh.","title":"Jesuh Nu Le A Naule Pawl (Mat 12.46-50 ; Luk 8.19-21)"},"32":{"text":"A kiangah mi tampi an rak to ih annih in, “Zohhnik, na nu le na naupa pawl le na farnu pawl leeng ah an um, nangmah an lo poi,” tiah an ti."},"33":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Zoso ka nu cu a si? Ka naule tla cu zoso an si?” a ti."},"34":{"text":"A kiangkapih a totu mipi pawl khi zoh phah in, “Hinah ka nu le ka naule tla cu an um ko a si."},"35":{"text":"Zokhal sisehla Pathian duhnak a tuahtu hmuahhmuah cu ka unau, ka farnu le ka nu an si,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in Galilee Tilikap ah thu a zirh sal. A kiangih a ra khawmmi minung pawl cu an tam tuk lawmmam ruangah lawng sungah a lut ih a to. Long cu tipar hlatnawn ah a um ih misenpi pawl cu tili kap tidai ri tiangin an ding.","title":"Thlaici Vorhtu Tahṭhimnak (Mat 13.1-9 ; Luk 8.4-8)"},"2":{"text":"Tahṭhimnak hmangin thu tampi a zirh."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh cun, “Ngaihnik uh: Voikhat ah mipa pakhat a um ih thlaici vorh dingin lo ah a feh."},"4":{"text":"Lo sungih thlaici a vorh tikah a hrekkhat cu lamzin tluanah an tla ih vate in an ra sar thluh."},"5":{"text":"A hrekkhat cu leilung malnak lungsedaap lakah an tla. Leilung a sah lo ruangah thlaici cu hmakhatte ah an kho."},"6":{"text":"Asinain ni a hung sa ih thlaikho a ṭo pekte pawl cu a hun sat. An hram a thuk lo ruangah thlaikho cu an caar cing ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"A hrekkhat cu hlingbur lakah an tla; hlingkung pawl cu an ṭhang ih thlaikho cu an zaap ih vuirah nei thei loin an um."},"8":{"text":"Asinain thlaici hrekkhat cu leilung ṭhatnak ah an tla, ṭhatein an kho ih an ṭhang ih vui an nei. A hrek cu a let sawmthum, a hrek cu a let sawmruk, a hrek cu a let zakhat tiangin thlai thar an suak,” tiah a sim."},"9":{"text":"A netnak ah, “Theihnak hna a neitu cun thei uh,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Jesuh cu amah lawng a um tikah a thusimmi a rak theitu hrekkhat pawl le dungthluntu hleihnih pawl a hnenah an ra ih a tahṭhimnak pawl simfiang dingah an ra dil.","title":"Hi Tahṭhimnak Ih Tumtahmi (Mat 13.10-17 ; Luk 8.9-10)"},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Pathian Uknak thuthup cu nan hnenah pek a si zo. Sikhalsehla lenglamih a ummi pawl cu tahṭhimnak lawng in sim an si;"},"12":{"text":"curuangah, ‘An zoh rero ding naón an hmu lo ding; An ngai rero ding naón an thei thei lo ding. Ziangahtile an hmuh thei ih an theih thei ahcun, Pathian hnenah an kir ding ih Ngaithiam an si ding,’,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isai 6.9-10"},"13":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Hi thlaici vorh tahṭhimnak hi nan thei thei lo maw? Cu a si ahcun ziangtinso tahṭhimnak dang teh nan theih thiam ding?","title":"Hi Tahṭhimnak A Simfiang (Mat 13.18-23 ; Luk 8.11-15)"},"14":{"text":"Thlaici vorhtu in Pathian thu a vorh."},"15":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat cu lamzin tluan ih a tlami thlaici bangtuk an si. Pathian thu cu an thei, asinain an theih vete in Satan a ra ih an sungih tuh mi thu cu a laksak."},"16":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat cu lungsedaap lakih a tlami thlaici bangtuk an si. Pathian thu an theih vete in lungawi zetin an pom."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an sungah thukpi a pil lo ih rei a daih lo. Cu ruangah Pathian thu ruangih harsatnak le hremnak a thlen tikah hmakhatte ah an leet sal."},"18":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat cu hlingbur lakih a tla mi thlaici bangtuk an si. Pathian thu cu an thei ngah,"},"19":{"text":"asinain hi leilung tlun nunnak thu ih donharnak, len duhnak le a dang duhnak le helhkamnak dangdang in a ṭem ih a khuh ruangah rah an rah thei lo."},"20":{"text":"Mi dang cu leilung ṭhatnak ih a tlami thlaici bangtuk an si. Pathian thu cu an thei, an pom hnget ih rah an rah. Let sawmthum, let sawmruk le let zakhat tiangin an rah a si,” tiah a sim."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Zotal in mei-inn cu kho hnuai ah siseh, ihkhun hnuai ah siseh nan re dah maw? Mei-inn vannak tung parah nan ret ṭheu a si lo maw?","title":"Kho Hnuai Ih Mei-inn (Luk 8.16-18)"},"22":{"text":"A kelkawmih thuhmi pawl kha mipi hmuh ah langter a si ding ih a thupte ih tuahmi pawl kha phuan ṭheh a si ding."},"23":{"text":"Theihnak hna a neitu cun thei uh,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Nan theihmi kha ṭhatein ruat uh. Midang tahnak ih nan hmanmi kha Pathian in nanmah tahnak ah a hmang ve ding, cu hnakih nasa sawn hman in a hmang ding a si."},"25":{"text":"A neimi cu pek beet a si ding ih a nei lomi cu a neihsunmi hman kha lak sak a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Pathian Uknak cu hi bangtuk a si. Mi pakhat in a lo ah thlaici a vorh.","title":"A ṭhangmi Thlaici Tahṭhimnak"},"27":{"text":"Zan ah a it, zingah a tho ih sunah hna a ṭuan, cuih sungah thlaici cu an rak kho ih an ṭhang. Asinain ziangtin cuvekin a cang, ti a thei lo."},"28":{"text":"Leilung in thlaici kho cu a ṭhangter ih rah a rahter, hmaisabik ah hnah no an suak, cuih hnuah an vui ih neta bikah a fang an um."},"29":{"text":"A fang a cut tikah hnaṭuantu pa in fang ah caan a cut ruangah fangahnak favah in a fang cu a at,” tiah a sim."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Pathian Uknak cu ziang bangtuk a si tiin so kan ti ding? Simfiangnak ah ziang tahṭhimnak so kan lak ding?","title":"Anṭam Ci Tahṭhimnak (Mat 13.31-32 , 34 ; Luk 13.18-19)"},"31":{"text":"Anṭam ci bangtuk a si. Mi pakhat in leilung tlunih thlaici fate bik anṭam ci cu a lak ih leilung ah a vorh."},"32":{"text":"Tikcu malte hnuah a kho ih rawl kung dang hnakin a tum bikah a cang. Hnge le ṭeek tumpipi tla a nei thei ih vate tla cu a hnah hneem ah bu tla an sak,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Hi bangtuk tahṭhimnak dangdang tla hmangin an hnenah an theih theinak ding tawpin thu a sim."},"34":{"text":"Tahṭhimnak hmang loin an hnenah thu a sim dah lo. Asinain a dungthlun pawl thawn anmah lawngih an um tikah ziang hmuahhmuah fiangtein a sim."},"35":{"text":"Cuih sun zanlam ah Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl cu, “Tili ih khatlam ralah va feh uh si,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh In Thlipi Hrang A Daihter (Mat 8.23-27 ; Luk 8.22-25)"},"36":{"text":"Curuangah misenpi pawl cu an taan ih dungthluntu pawl cu lawng sungah an lut. Cuih lawng sungah Jesuh cu a rak to zo ih lawng cun an fehpi. Cunah lawng dang pawl tla an um."},"37":{"text":"Rinlopi ah thlipi nasa zetin a hrang ih tilet tho cu lawng sungah a lut vivo ih lawng sungah cun tidai a khat zik thlang."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng ih mei lamah a um ih tokham parah a rak itthat. Dungthluntu pawl cun an ṭhang ih, “Sayapa, kan hlohral thluh ding hi na poisa lo maw si?” tiah an ti."},"39":{"text":"Jesuh cu a hung tho ih thlipi cu, “Hrang nawn hlah!” tiah thu a pek ih tilet cu, “Dai aw!” tiah a ti. Cutikah thli cu hrang nawn loin a um ih tilet khal a dai khepkhep."},"40":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Ziangah so cuti lawmmam ih nan ṭih? Zumnak nan nei hrih lo maw si?” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Cumi cu a mak tuk an ti ih an mang bangin pakhat le pakhat, “Hi pa hi zo bik so a si pei? Thlipi le tilet hmanin a thu an ngai hi!” tiah an ti aw rero."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu Galilee Tili khatlam ral Gerasene peng ah an va thleng.","title":"Jesuh In Khawsia Ih Polh Mipa A Damter (Mat 8.28-34 ; Luk 8.26-39)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng sung ihsin a suah vete in cutawkah thlaan lungkua sungih a ummi pa a ra suak ih Jesuh a ra tong. Cupa cu khawsia ih polhmi a si ih,"},"3":{"text":"thlaan lakih a ummi a si. Zohman ih hreen thei lomi pa a si."},"4":{"text":"Voi tampi thir cikcin rori in a kutke an ṭem ṭheu naón an ṭem tinte in thirhri cu a ticat ih a ke ṭemnak thirhri tla cu a botcat ṭheh, zohman a kaihrem theitu an um lo."},"5":{"text":"A sun a zan ih thlaan lak le tlang lakah a vak ih a au phahphah ih amah le amah lungto in a sun, a at aw phah ṭheu."},"6":{"text":"Hla nawn ihsin Jesuh cu a hei hmu; a va tlan ih a hmai ah a khuk a bilh ih,"},"7":{"text":"a aw neih patawp in, “Maw Jesuh, Cungnungbik Pathian ih Fapa! Nang le kei ziangso kan seng aw? Pathian hmin in ka lo dil, i hrem hramhram hlah aw!” tiah a au ciamco."},"8":{"text":"Hi bangtuk ih a aunak cu Jesuh in, “Thlarau siava, hi pa sung ihsin suak aw,” a rak ti ruangah a si."},"9":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Na hmin zoso a si?” tiah a sut. Cupa cun, “Ka hmin cu ‘Burpi,’ a si, ziangahtile kan tam ngaingai a si,” tiah a let."},"10":{"text":"Cupa cun thlarau siava pawl cu cuih ram ihsih dawihlo lo dingah Jesuh cu a dil ciamco."},"11":{"text":"Cutawk kiangkap tlangmual ah vok rual tampi an tlang."},"12":{"text":"Thlarau siava pawl cun Jesuh cu, “Vok hnenah in thlah awla an sungah in lutter hram aw,” tiah an dil."},"13":{"text":"A dil vek ih a fehter hai ih thlarau siava pawl cu cupa sung ihsin an suak ih vok sungah cun an lut. Cule vok rual cu thawnghnih hrawng an si ih khaamhraap ihsin an vung dawp ciammam ih tili sungah an tla that ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Vok khaaltu pawl cu an tlan ih cuih thuhla cu khawsung ah le lo lakah an sim ciamco. Mipi pawl cu thil cangmi zoh dingah an va feh."},"15":{"text":"Jesuh hnenih an thlen tikah khawsia ‘Burpi,’ ih a rak polh mipa khal an va hmu. Cutawkah cun a to ih hnipuan hruk in le lungfim in an va hmu. Curuangah an thin a phang ngaingai."},"16":{"text":"Cuih thil a hmutu pawl in khawsia polhmi pa le vok rual parah ziang vek thil a cang ti kha mipi pawl an sim."},"17":{"text":"Cule an ram tlansan dingah Jesuh cu an dil ciamco."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng sungih a luh zawng ah khawsia ih rak polh dahmi pa cun, “Na hnenah ka feh ve pei,” tiah a dil."},"19":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh in a duh lo. “Na inn ah va tlung sawn awla na sungte pawl hnenah Bawipa ih a lo tuah sakmi le a lo zaangfahnak thuhla pawl cu va sim aw,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cuticun cupa cu Dekhapolis ram sung hmuahhmuah ah a feh ih Jesuh ih a tuah sakmi thuhla cu a sim. Cuih thu a theitu hmuahhmuah cu an mang a bang ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh cu Tili khatlam ral ah a va feh sal. Cutawk Tilikap ahcun mi tampi Jesuh kiangkap ah an khawm aw.","title":"Jairas Fanu Le Jesuh Puanfeem A Thamtu Nunau (Mat 9.18-26 ; Luk 8.40-56)"},"22":{"text":"Sinakok uktu pakhat a si mi Jairas cu a ra ih Jesuh a hmuh tikah a ke hramah a bok ih zaangfahnak a dil."},"23":{"text":"“Ka fanute besia zetin a na. Ra hram awla a parah na kut ra suang aw, cule a dam ding ih a nung ding a si,” tiah a dil."},"24":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu Jairas hnenah feh dingin a pok. Mitampi in Jesuh an thlun ruangah a kilkip in an run eng cupco."},"25":{"text":"Mitampi lakah cun thidok nat in kum hleihnih a na zomi nunau pakhat a um."},"26":{"text":"Sibawi tampi in an tuah zo naón a dam cuang lo. A neihmi tangka hmuahhmuah a hmang zo naón a ṭha lam si loin a besia deuhdeuh."},"27":{"text":"Cunu cun Jesuh thu a rak thei ih miburpi lakin Jesuh dunglam in a ra."},"28":{"text":"“A puan ka tham thei ahcun ka dam ko ding,” tiah a ruat."},"29":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh puan cu a tham. Cutiih a tham vete in a thisuak cu a reh ih ka natnak ihsin ka dam zo ti kha a thei."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh in a sung ihsin a huham a suah kha a thei lohli ih miburpi lamah her in, “Zoso ka puan a tham?” tiah a sut."},"31":{"text":"A dungthlun pawl in, “Miburpi in an lo nor cupco hi na hmu ko. Ziangtin so ‘Zoso ka puan a tham?’ na ti,” tiah an ti."},"32":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh cun ka puan a thamtu cu zo bik so a si, tiah a zoh rero."},"33":{"text":"Cutiih thil a cangmi cu nunau nu in a theih tikah ṭih le ṭhia phah in a ra ih Jesuh kehram ah a khuk a bilh ih thudik kha a sim."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in a hnenah, “Ka fanu, na zumnak in a lo damter zo. Dai tein va feh aw, na natnak cu damta seh,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Jesuh cutiih a ṭong rero laiah cun Jairas inn ihsin thlahmi zualko an ra thleng ih Jairas cu, “Na fanu a thi zo. Ziangah so Sayapa cu na hnaihnok duh nawn rero,” tiah an ti."},"36":{"text":"Jesuh in cuih thu an simmi cu ziang hmanah a siar lo ih Jairas hnenah cun, “Zianghman phang hlah, a zum lawng zum aw,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in Piter le Jeim le a nau Johan siar lo zohman amah a thlunter siang nawn lo."},"38":{"text":"Jairas inn cu an va thleng ih ṭapraak le hnok ceelceel ih an um kha Jesuh in a hmu."},"39":{"text":"An hnenah a vung lut ih, “Ziangah so hnok ceelceel ih nan um? Ziangah so nan ṭah nan raak! Hi nauhak nu hi a thih ual lo; a itthat a si,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Annih in Jesuh cu an hnihsan meen. Curuangah an zatein khawlengah a suahter ṭheh. Nauhak nu ih nu le pa le a dungthlun pathum cu a ko ih nauhak nu an retnak khaan sungah cun an vung lut."},"41":{"text":"Nauhak nu cu a kut in a vun kai ih, “Talitha koumi,” tiah a ti. Cumi cu, “Nute tho aw ka lo ti,” tican a si."},"42":{"text":"Hmakhatteah nauhak nu cu a tho ih a feh thei. (Amah cu kum hleihnih mi a si.) Cumi an hmuh tikah an mang a bangtuk lawmmam."},"43":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh in zohman sim lo dingin thu a pek ih, “Ei ding ziangmaw tal pek uh,” tiah a ti."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu cutawk ihsin a feh ih a khua ah a dungthlun pawl thawn an kir.","title":"Nazareth Mi In A Thu An Pom Lo (Mat 13.53-58 ; Luk 4.16-30)"},"2":{"text":"Sabbath ni ah an sinakok sungah thu a zirh. Cunah mi tampi an um ih a thuzirhmi an theih tikah an mang a bang ngaingai. “Hi hmuahhmuah hi khuiinso a lak? Hi bangtuk fimnak hi khuiinso a ngah? Ziangtin so mangbangza hi a tuah thei?"},"3":{"text":"Mari fapa lettama, Jeim le Josef le Judas le Simon teih u kha a si lo sawm? A farnu pawl tla hinah an um lai a si lo maw?” an ti. Cuticun Jesuh cu zianghman ah an rel lo."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh in ah hnenah, “Profet cu amah ih suahnak khua le ram, a sungkhat le a innsang siar lo hmun dangah cuh upatnak a tong a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cutawkah cun mina malte parah a kut a suang ih a damter; cumi siar lo mangbangza zianghman a tuah lo."},"6":{"text":"Zumnak an neih lo ruangah Jesuh cu a mang a bang ngaingai. Cule Jesuh cu kiangkap khua ah a feh ih thu a zirh vivo."},"7":{"text":"Dungthluntu hleihnih kha a ko ih pahnih pahnih in a thlah. Ramhuai neh theinak thu a pek ih,","title":"Jesuh In Dungthluntu Hleihnih A Thlah (Mat 10.5-15 ; Luk 9.1-6)"},"8":{"text":"“Khual nan tlawnnak ah kianghrol siar lo a dang zianghman nan keng lo pei: rawl siseh, cawdip siseh, nan kordip ah tangka siseh nan keng lo pei."},"9":{"text":"Kedam cu dam uh, asinain angki a hlei in keng hlah uh."},"10":{"text":"Tlun-inn a lo ontu ih inn ah khua dangih nan feh sal hlan lo caam uh."},"11":{"text":"Nan thlennak khua pakhat in, tlun-inn an lo on duh lo ih nan thu khal an ngai duh lo a si ahcun, tlansan uhla nan ke ih leivut kha thinta uh. Cumi cu an hrangah ralrin peknak a si ding,” tiah thu a pek."},"12":{"text":"Cuticun an feh ih mi hmuahhmuah an sualnak sir aw dingah thu an sim."},"13":{"text":"Ramhuai tampi an dawi ih mina tampi tla olif hriak an culh ih an damter."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh thuhla cu khuazakipih a than ruangah Siangpahrang Herod tla in cuih thu cu a thei ve. Mi hrekkhat cun, “Baptisma petu Johan kha a nung sal a si! Curuangah hi bangtuk in mangbangza tuah theinak huham a nei,” tiah an ti.","title":"Baptisma Petu Johan Thihnak (Mat 14.1-12 ; Luk 9.7-9)"},"15":{"text":"Mi dang cun, “Elijah a si,” an ti. Mi dang cun, “Khuahlan laiih profet pawl vek profet pakhat a si ko,” an ti."},"16":{"text":"Cumi cu Herod in a theih ve tikah, “Baptisma petu Johan a si! A lu ka rak tanter zomi a si naón a nung sal a si hi!” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Johan cu kaih ih thirhri in khit tahratin thawng thlak dingah Herod amah rori in thu a rak pek dahmi a si. Ziangah cutin a tuah tile, Herod in a nau Filip ih nupi Herodias a ṭhit hrangah,"},"18":{"text":"Johan in, “Na naupa ih nupi na ṭhit cu a dik lo a si,” tiah Herod kha a ti ringring ruangah a si."},"19":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah Herodias in Johan cu a mitkem in a ngiar ringring ih thah tiangin a duh; a sinan Herod a um ruangah zianghman a ti ngam lo."},"20":{"text":"Herod in Johan cu a ṭih ngaingai, ziangahtile Johan cu mi ṭha le mi thianghlim a si ti a thei. Curuangah a hum ṭheu. Johan ih thusimmi a ngaitinte a thin a nuam dah lo, asinain a thusimmi ngai cu a duh thotho."},"21":{"text":"Neta bikah Herodias cu caan ṭha a ngah. Herod suahcam a hung kim ih a suahcam lomnak ah Herod cun Acozah bawi upa pawl, a ralkap uktu ralbawi pawl le Galilee rammi upa pawl hrangah rawl darnak puai a tuah."},"22":{"text":"Herodias fanu cu a rung lut ih a laam tikah Herod le a sawmmi upa pawl cu an lung a awi ngaingai. Curuangah Siangpahrang bawipa in falanu hnenah cun, “Ziang so na duh? Na duh mi hmuahhmuah ka lo pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"“Na dilmi pohpoh ka lo pe ding; ka ram ukmi a hrek tiang hman ka lo pe ding,” tiah siatcam in thu a kam."},"24":{"text":"Cule falanu cu a feh ih a nu hnenah, “Ziang so ka dil ding?” tiah a va sut. A nu in, “Baptisma petu Johan ih lu dil aw,” tiah a rak ti."},"25":{"text":"Falanu cu zamrang tein a kir ih Siangpahrang bawipa cu, “Atu ah hitawk rori ah hin baptisma petu Johan ih lu cu darkheng in i pe cila ka duh!” tiah a dil."},"26":{"text":"Cumi a theih tikah Siangpahrang cu a riah a sia ngaingai, asinain a sawmmi bawi le upa pawl hmaiih siatcam in thu a kam awk zo ruangah falanu ih a dilmi cu a el thei nawn lo."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah hmakhatte ah ralkap pakhat a thlah ih Johan ih lu rak keng dingin thu a pek. Ralkap pa cu a suak ih thawnginn ahcun a feh ih Johan ih lu cu a va tan."},"28":{"text":"Cuih hnuah darkheng in a rak keng ih falanu cu a pek, falanu cun a nu hnenah a pek sin."},"29":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Johan ih dungthluntu pawl in an theih tikah a ruak an ra lak ih an phum."},"30":{"text":"A thlahmi pawl cu an ra tlung ih Jesuh cu an tong ih an tuahmi hmuahhmuah le an zirhmi hmuahhmuah an sim.","title":"Jesuh In Mi Thawng Nga Rawl A Dar (Mat 14.13-21 ; Luk 9.10-17 ; Joh 6.1-14)"},"31":{"text":"A hnenih a rami le a kirmi, mi sukso pawl cu an tamtuk ruangah Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu rawl einak caan hman an nei lo. Cu hrangah an hnenah, “Kan feh pei ih kanmah lawng hlimphirte ih kan um theinak hmunah va um uh si; cule malte tal nan cawl thiam ding,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cuticun anmah lawng hlimphirte ih um theinak hmun feh dingah lawng in an pok."},"33":{"text":"Asinain an feh kha mi tampi in an hmu ih zo an si ti kha hmakhatte ah an thei. Curuangah khua hmuahhmuah ihsin an pok ih an ke in an rak tlan ih Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu an colhnak ding hmunah an rak thlen khelh vivo."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng sung ihsin a suah tikah miburpi cu a hmu ih a thinlung cu anmah zaangfahnak in a khat, ziangahtile khaaltu nei lo tuurual bangtuk an si. Curuangah thu tampi a zirh hai."},"35":{"text":"Zanlam khua a hung siim tikah a dungthluntu pawl cu a hnenah an ra ih, “Khua a siim zo; hitawk hi hmunṭhing a si fawn."},"36":{"text":"Miburpi pawl hi thlah awla ziang lo ei ṭha an lei theinak dingah kiangkap khua pawl le lo tla ah va feh hai seh,” tiah an ti."},"37":{"text":"Jesuh cun, “Nanmah in an ei ding cu pek uh,” tiah a ti. Cutikah annih in, “Tangka zahnih man rawl va lei tahratin himi pawl hi rawl daar uh, ti in duh maw si?” tiah an sut."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh in, “sang ziangzat so nan neih? Va zohhnik uh,” tiah a ti. An va zoh ih, “sang hlom nga le nga pum hnih a um,” tiah an ti."},"39":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl hnenah mipi pawl kha hram hring parah a bur a bur in toter dingah thu a pek."},"40":{"text":"Cutiin misenpi cu zakhat tlar le sawmnga tlar in an to khawm."},"41":{"text":"Cun Jesuh in sang hlom nga le nga pum hnih cu a lak ih vanlam hawi in Pathian hnenah lungawinak thu a sim. Sang cu a phel ih mipi pawl zem dingah a dungthluntu pawl hnenah a pek. Nga pum hnih khal cu an zate hnenah a zem."},"42":{"text":"An zatein an ei ih an khopzet."},"43":{"text":"Sang le nga an hlahmi cu dungthluntu pawl in an sar ih bawm hleihnih an ngah."},"44":{"text":"Rawl a eitu cu mipa lawnglawng siar in thawng nga an si."},"45":{"text":"Cuih hnuah zamrangte in Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl cu lawng sungah a luhter ih tili khatlam ral Bethsaida ah a hmaiah rak feh sung dingin a thlah. Cule misenpi pawl cu a tlunter.","title":"Tidai Parah Jesuh A Feh (Mat 14.22-33 ; Joh 6.15-21)"},"46":{"text":"Cibai a buk hai hnuah tlang parah thlacam dingah a feh."},"47":{"text":"Khua a thim tikah lawng cu tili laifang a thleng ih Jesuh cu amah lawng tlang parah a um lai."},"48":{"text":"Thli kha anmah lamih a hran ruangah a dungthluntu pawl in lawng an hlau tikah harnak tampi an tong ti kha a hei hmu. Curuangah zinglam khawvang deuh hlanah an hnenah cun ti parin a va feh. An kiang a thlen tikah lansan a tum,"},"49":{"text":"asinain ti parih a feh kha an hmu. Mithla ah an ruat ih an thin phangin an raak ciamco."},"50":{"text":"An hmuh tikah an zatein an ṭih ngaingai. Hmakhatteah Jesuh in, “Nan thinphang hlah uh! Keimah ka si,” tiah a ti."},"51":{"text":"Cule lawng sungah an hnenah a vung lut ih thli cu a dai. Dungthluntu pawl cu an mang a bangzet,"},"52":{"text":"ziangahtile mi thawng nga rawl a daarnak kha a sullam an thei thei lo, an thinlung in a ruat ban lo."},"53":{"text":"Tili an tan hnuah Gennesaret ah an va thleng ih cuih hmunah an lawng cu an hreng.","title":"Gennesaret Ah Jesuh In Mina A Damter (Mat 14.34-36)"},"54":{"text":"Long sung ihsin an suah vete in mipi in Jesuh cu an theithiam lohli."},"55":{"text":"Curuangah cutawk ramah cun zamrangin an feh ih a umnak an theihnak hmun poh ah mina pawl cu laang in an rak zawn."},"56":{"text":"Cun Jesuh a fehnak pohpoh ah khawte ah siseh, khawpi ah siseh, lo lak khalah siseh, an mina pawl cu dawrhmun khalah an rak thlenpi hai ih, “Na puanfeem tal lo tham hai seh,” tiah an dil; cule a puanfeem a tham ngahtu cu an dam."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem ihsin a rami Farasi ṭhenkhat le Daanthiam ṭhenkhat pawl cu Jesuh hnenah an va leng.","title":"Pupa Pawlih Thuzirhmi (Mat 15.1-9)"},"2":{"text":"A dungthluntu hrekkhat pawl cu kut kholh loih rawl an ei kha an hmu; rawl ei hlanah nan kut nan kholh ding, timi vekin an kut an kholh lo, tinak a si."},"3":{"text":"Ziangahtile Farasi mi siseh, Judah mi dangdang pawl siseh, an zatein an pupa pawl ih thuzirhnak kha an thlun; a daan vekin an kut an kholhta lo ahcun rawl an ei lo;"},"4":{"text":"cule dawrih an leimi thil khal a daan vekih an kholhta lo ahcun an ei duh lo. Cun an pupa pawl ih thuzirhmi khuathai kholh daan, beel kholh daan, darkheng kholh daan le ihkhun kholh daan ti pawl tla an thlun."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Farasi mi pawl le Daanthiam pawl in Jesuh cu, “Ziangah so na dungthluntu pawl in kan pupa pawl ih in zirhta mi daan vekin nung loin kut kholh lo pi thawn rawl an ei?” tiah an sut."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Profet Isaiah in nanmah ih thuhla a rak sim tikah a va dik lawmmam so! Nannih mititeraw pawl, nan thu cu hiti in a ngan: Pathian in ‘Hi minung pawl hin an ṭongkam lawngin in upat; An thinlung cu ka hnen ihsin a hlat ngaingai a si."},"7":{"text":"Keimah in biak hi a lak a si, Ziangahtile milai ih tuahcopmi daan kha Pathian ih pekmi daan vekin an zirh a si,’ a ti.","ref":"Isai 29.13"},"8":{"text":"Pathian thupekmi cu nan taan ih milai ih zirhmi sawn cu nan thlun a si!” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in a peh ih, “Nanmah ih thuzirhmi fekter ih Pathian pekmi daan hnon zia cu nan va thiam so!"},"10":{"text":"Ziangahtile Moses thupekmi sungah ‘Nan nu le nan pa upat uh,’ tile ‘A nu siseh, a pa siseh, a camtu cu thah a si ding,’ tiah a um."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih cun ‘Mi pakhat in a nu le a pa kha: nanmah bomnak hrangah ka timi ka thilri hi Korban a si, a ti ahcun, (Korban ti cu Pathian ta a si tican a si)"},"12":{"text":"cupa cu a nu le a pa bomnak ihsin a luat,’ tiah nan ti."},"13":{"text":"Cutiih mi nan zirhmi in Pathian ṭongkam cu a phiat ṭheh a si. Cule cu bangtuk ih nan tuahmi dangdang tla tampi a um,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in misenpi kha a ko sal ih an hnenah, “Nan zatein ka thusimmi hi ngai uhla thei uh!","title":"Minung Baaltertu Thil (Mat 15.10-20)"},"15":{"text":"Minung hi lenglam ihsin sung lamah a lutmi thil in a baalter lo. A sunglam ihsin a ra suakmi in a baalter sawn a si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in misenpi pawl cu a fehsan ih inn sungih a luh tikah a dungthluntu pawl cu cuih a ṭongmi sullam sut dingah an ra."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Midang pawl hnakin nan fim cuang lo a sihi! Nan thei lo ngaingai maw? Lenglam ihsin minung sungah a lutmi in mi a baalter thei lo,"},"19":{"text":"ziangahtile cuih thil cu a thinlung sungah feh loin a pumpi sungah a feh ih cuticun zunpawng ah a suak sal a si,” tiah a ti. (Hitiin Jesuh ih a sim tikah ziang bangtuk rawl hman hi ei thiang an si ṭheh ko, tiah a ti duhnak a si.)"},"20":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Mi a baaltertu ngaingai cu a sunglam ihsin a suakmi an si."},"21":{"text":"Ziangahtile ṭhatlonak a tuahtertu ruahnak ṭha lo pawl cu minung sunglam ihsin a suakmi an si: nupa sualnak, rukruk, mithah,"},"22":{"text":"Ṭaangṭawm sualnak, duhham, thil siava dangdang tuah, mibum, a mawi lo zetmi thilsual tuah, iksiik, misimsiat, puarthau le aat-thlakza thil tuahnak,"},"23":{"text":"hi thil siava pawl hi minung thinlung sung ihsin a suakmi an si ih hi pawl hin mi an baalter a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu a feh ih Tai-ar khua kiang a hung thleng. Inn pakhat sungah a lut ih cutawkah a um ti zohman theihter a duh lo; asinain a thup aw thei cuang lo.","title":"Nunau Nu Ih Zumnak (Mat 15.21-28)"},"25":{"text":"Cu ngaingai in, a fanu ramhuai ih a kaihmi nunau pakhat in Jesuh a um ti kha a thei ih hmakhatte ah Jesuh kehram ah a bok."},"26":{"text":"Cuih nunau nu cu Zentail nu a si ih Siria ram Fonisia pengih a suakmi a si. Ramhuai kha a fanu sung ihsin dawisuak dingah a dil."},"27":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh cun, “Rawl cu faale pawl kan pek hmaisa pei. Faale pawl ih rawl uico pek cu a dik lo a si,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cu nu cun, “A si ko, Bawipa! Sikhalsehla faale pawl ih hlahtakmi rawl ṭilfuan cu cabuai hnuai ih uico pawl in an ei ve ṭheu ko a sisi!” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Cutiih i leh thei ruangah inn ah va tlung awla na fanu sung ihsin ramhuai cu a suak zo ti na va hmu ding,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Inn ah a tlung ih a fanu cu ihkhun parih a rak ih kha a va hmu. Ramhuai cu a sung ihsin a rak suak zo ngaingai."},"31":{"text":"Cule Tai-ar peng ihsin Jesuh cu a pok ih Sidon ram pal phah in Dekhapolis ram laifang a hruut ih Galilee Tili a thleng.","title":"Hnaset, ṭongthiam Lo A Damter"},"32":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat in a hnenah hnaset ṭong thiam lo pa pakhat an rak keng ih a parah Jesuh in a kut suang dingin an dil."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh in cupa cu mipi hnen ihsin hmun dangdeuh ah a hruai ih a kut zungin a hna pahnih cu a tawhsak; cil a phui ih a lei a thamsak."},"34":{"text":"Cule vanlam hoi in Jesuh cu a hruum ih cupa hnen ahcun, “Effatha,” tiah a ti. Atican cu “Ong aw thlang aw,” tinak a si."},"35":{"text":"Hmakhatteah cupa cu a hna a vaang, a lei a naal ih har lotein a ṭong thei."},"36":{"text":"Cuih thu cu zo hnen hmanah sim lo dingin Jesuh in mipi pawl cu a dawn. Asinain tam deuh a dawn hai tikah tam deuhdeuh in an sim."},"37":{"text":"Cule cuih thu a theitu hmuahhmuah in an mang a bang ngaingai ih, “A tuahmi hmuah in an va ṭha lawmmam so! Hnaset mi an hna a vaang ih ṭong thiam lo tla an ṭong thei,” tiah an fak ciamco."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnu rei lote-ah mi tampi an pumkhawm aw lala. Mipi cu rawl ei ding an neih lo tikah Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl kha a ko ih,","title":"Jesuh In Mi Thawngli Rawl A Dar (Mat 15.32-39)"},"2":{"text":"“Hi mi pawl hi ni thum sung ka hnenah an um zo ih atu-ah ei ding zianghman an nei nawn lo; ka zaang an fakzet a si."},"3":{"text":"Rawl ziang hman ei loih ka tlunter a si ahcun mi hrekkhat cu lam hlapi feh ding an si ruangah lamzin ah an ṭamsawl ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"A dungthluntu pawl cun, “Hi bangtuk ramṭhing ah hin zo in so milai hi zat hrangah rawl cu a hawl thei ding?” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh in, “sang hlom ziangzatso nan neih?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Hlom sarih,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh in misenpi cu lei parah to dingin thu a pek. Cule sang hlom sarih cu a lak ih Pathian hnenah lungawithu a sim hnuah a phel ih mipi zem dingah a dungthluntu pawl a pek; a dungthluntu pawl cun an zem."},"7":{"text":"Nga fatete khal malte lai an nei. Jesuh in Pathian hnenah lungawithu a sim hnuah nga khal zem dingin a dungthluntu pawl a fial."},"8":{"text":"An zatein an ei ih an khopzet, minung cu thawngli tluk an si."},"9":{"text":"Cule an hlahmi kha dungthluntu pawl in an sar ih bawm sarih a ti. Jesuh in mipi pawl cu a tlunter ih,"},"10":{"text":"hmakhatte ah lawng sungah a dungthluntu pawl thawn an lut ih Dalmanutha pengah an feh."},"11":{"text":"Farasi mi hrekkhat pawl Jesuh hnenah an ra ih thu an el aw. Jesuh ih sual hawl an duh ruangah, “Pathian hrilmi na si le si lo langternak ah mangbangza tuahhnik,” tiah an ti.","title":"Mangbangza Tuah An Fial (Mat 12.38-42 ; 16.1-4)"},"12":{"text":"Jesuh cu lungkim lo zetin a hruum ih, “Ziangah so tuihsan minung pawl in mangbangza tuah in fial? Thungai in ka lo sim: cubangtuk mangbangza cu tuihsan minung hnenah pek a si lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"A fehsan ih lawng sungih a luh hnuah tili khatlam ralah a feh."},"14":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl in sang ken an hngilh ih lawng sungah sang hlom khat lawng a um.","title":"Farasi Le Herod Ih Thilnu (Mat 16.5-12)"},"15":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Farasi mi le Herod ih thilnu kha ralring uh,” tiah a sim."},"16":{"text":"Annih in, “sang kan neih lo ruangah a si, hiti ih in ti,” tiah pakhat le pakhat an ti aw."},"17":{"text":"Cumi cu Jesuh in a thei ih an hnenah, “sang nan neih lo thu cu ziangah so nan rel rero? Nan thei thei hrih lo maw? Cutluk in maw nan ruah ban lo?"},"18":{"text":"Mit nan neih si, nan hmu thei lo maw? Hna nan neih si, nan thei thei lo maw? Mi thawng nga hrangih,"},"19":{"text":"Sang hlom nga ka phel kha nan cing nawn lo maw? An hlahmi sang bawm ziangzat so nan sar kha?” a ti. Annih in, “Bawm hleihnih,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Cun minung thawngli hrangah sang hlawm sarih ka phel tikah an hlahmi bawm ziangzat so nan sar kha?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Bawm sarih,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Cuih hnu khalah nan thei thei hrih lo maw?” tiah a ti hai."},"22":{"text":"Bethsaida khua an thleng ih cutawkah mitcawpa pakhat Jesuh hnenah an rak hruai ih Jesuh ih tham dingin an dil.","title":"Bethsaida Ah Mitcawpa A Damter"},"23":{"text":"Jesuh in mitcawpa cu a kut in a hruai ih hnarpawn ah a fehpi. A mit ah a cil a vun phui hnuah a parah a kut a suang ih, “Ziangtal na hmu thei maw?” tiah a sut."},"24":{"text":"Mitcawpa cu vantau in khua a hun zoh ih, “A si, mi ka hmu thei; asinain thingkung feh rero vek an bang,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh in cupa ih mit ahcun a kut a suang lala. Mitcawpa cun napiin khua a hun zoh ih a mit cu a vaan ngah ruangah ziang hmuahhmuah fiangtein a hmu thei."},"26":{"text":"Jesuh in innah a tlunter ih, “Khawsungah va lut nawn hlah,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu Sisaria Filipi kiang khawte pawl tlawng dingah an feh. Lamzin ah dungthluntu pawl cu, “Mi in zo in ti so, in simhnik uh?” tiah a sut.","title":"Piter Ih Phuansuahnak (Mat 16.13-20 ; Luk 9.18-21)"},"28":{"text":"Annih in, “Mi hrekkhat in baptisma petu Johan a si, an lo ti. Mi hrek in Elijah a si an lo ti. Midang in profet pakhatkhat a si, an lo ti,” tiah an ti."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nannih in teh, zo in ti so?” tiah a sut. Piter in, “Nang cu Messiah na si,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Cuih thu cu zohman va sim hlah uh,” tiah a tiam."},"31":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl a zirh ih, “Milai Fapa cu tuarnak nasazet a tong ding ih upa pawl, puithiam upa pawl le Daan thiam pawl in an hnong ding; an that ding, asinain ni thum hnuah a tho sal ding,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh In A Thih Ding Thu A Sim (Mat 16.21-28 ; Luk 9.22-27)"},"32":{"text":"Cuih thu cu an hnenah fiang zetin a sim. Curuangah Piter in Jesuh cu a dang deuh ah a pialpi ih a mawhthluk."},"33":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh cu a her ih a dungthluntu pawl zoh phah in Piter cu, “Satan, ka hnen ihsin tlan aw! Na ruahdan hi Pathian hnen ihsin rami a si lo, milai hnen ihsin rami a si,” tiah a kawk."},"34":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in mipi le a dungthluntu pawl cu a hnenah a ko ih, “Zokhal keimah i thlun duhtu cun amah ih duhnak taanta sehla a thinglamtah pu in i thlunseh."},"35":{"text":"Ziangahtile zokhal amah ih nunnak hum a duhtu cu a nunnak a sung ding; asinain keimah ih hrang le Thuthang ṭha ruangah a nunnak a liamtu cu a nunnak a hum ngah ding a si."},"36":{"text":"Mi pakhat in leilung pumpuluk co hmansehla amah ih nunnak a sun ahcun ziangso a ṭhahnem? Zianghman a ṭhahnem lo!"},"37":{"text":"A nunnak kha zianghman in a lei thei sal nawn lo ding!"},"38":{"text":"Tuihsan, Pathian zianghman ih siar lo san, hi san ṭha lo ah hin mi pakhatkhat in keimah siseh, ka thuzirhmi siseh, a zahpi ahcun Milai Fapa in a Pa ih sunlawinak le vancung mithiang pawl thawn a rat tikah a zahpi ve ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: hi tawkih a ummi mi ṭhenkhat pawl hi Pathian Uknak huham thawn a ra thlen an rak hmuh hlan lo an thi lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"Ni ruk hnuah Jesuh in Piter le Jeim le Johan cu a fehpi ih tlang parah anmah lawng a kaipi. An mit hmuhah Jesuh cu a hmuihhmel a thleng aw;","title":"Jesuh Hmuihmel Thlengnak (Mat 17.1-13 ; Luk 9.28-36)"},"3":{"text":"a hnipuan cu a tleu in a tleu ih milai in ziangtluk hmanin sawp hai sehla cutluk cun a vaar thei dah lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu pathum cun Elijah le Moses thawn Jesuh cu bia aw rero in an hmu."},"5":{"text":"Piter in Jesuh hnenah, “Sayapa, hitawk kan um cu a va ṭha so! Deubuk pathum in kan sak pei; na hrangah pakhat, Moses hrangah pakhat, cule Elijah hrangah pakhat,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Ziangahtile Piter le a rualpi pawl cu an thin a phang tuk ih ziang ṭong ding dang an theih lo ruangah a si."},"7":{"text":"Cuih hnuah mero a ra zaam ih an tlun ihsin a run khuh ṭheh, cule mero sung ihsin, “Himi cu ka duhdawtmi ka Fapa a si, amah ih thu nan ngai pei,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"A dungthluntu pathum cun an kiangkap an zoh rero naón zohman an hmu lo; Jesuh lawng an kiangih a um kha an hmu."},"9":{"text":"Tlangpar ihsin an rung ṭum laiah Jesuh in, “Milai Fapa hi thihnak ihsin ka thawhsal hlan cu nan hmuhmi hi zohman nan sim lo pei,” tiah thu a pek."},"10":{"text":"Cuih a thupekmi cu an thlun; asinain, “Thihnak ihsin thawhsal,” timi cu ziang a si pei? tiah pakhat le pakhat an sut aw rero."},"11":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu, “Ziangah so Daanthiam pawl in Elijah a ra hmaisa ding, an ti?” tiah an sut."},"12":{"text":"Jesuh cun, “Ziang hmuahhmuah timtuah ṭheh dingah Elijah cu a ra taktak ding. Asinain ziangah so Ca Thianghlim in ‘Milai Fapa cu nasa zetin a tuar ding ih a hnon tla an hnong ding,’ tiah a ti?"},"13":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: Elijah cu a ra zo ih, Ca Thianghlim ih a sim vekin minung in an duhduh in an tuah zo,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Dungthluntu dang pawl hnen an vung thlen tikah an kiangkap in mitampi in an kulhvel ih Daanthiam hrekkhat pawl le dungthluntu cu thu an el awk rero kha an hmu.","title":"Ramhuai Polhmi Nauhak A Damter (Mat 17.14-20 ; Luk 9.37-43a)"},"15":{"text":"Misenpi in Jesuh kha an hmuh tikah an mang a bang ngaingai ih va hmuak dingah an tlan ciamco."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl cu, “Anmah thawn ziangthu so nan el awk rero?” tiah a sut."},"17":{"text":"Misenpi lakih mi pakhat in, “Sayapa, ka fapa na hnenah ka rak hruai sokhaw; ziangahtile ramhuai in a polh ih ṭong khal a ṭong thei lo."},"18":{"text":"Ramhuai in a polh tikah cun, leilung ah a hlon aw ih a cil buanra a suak ih a hacang rial tahratin a pumpuluk a ṭhong ṭheh ṭheu. Cuih ramhuai dawisuak dingah na dungthluntu pawl ka sim naón zianghman an ti thei lo,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Maw zumnak nei lo minung pawl! Nan hnenah ziangtik tiangso ka um hrih ding? Ziangtik tiangso ka lo zawi hrih hai ding? Nauhakpa cu ka hnenah rak keng uh,” tiah a ti ih"},"20":{"text":"Jesuh hnenah cun an ratpi. Ramhuai in Jesuh a hmuh vete in nauhakpa cu a dirhcaih ih leilung ah a tlu, a let aw tualto ih a ka ihsin buanra a suak ciamco."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hitiih a sinak hi a rei zo maw?” tiah a pa cu a sut. A pa in, “A seentet lai ihsin a si zo."},"22":{"text":"Voi tampi ramhuai hin that dingin meisa lak le tidai sungah a paih ṭheu. Na tuah theimi a si ahcun in zaangfah awla in bawm hram aw,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Na tuah theimi a si ahcun, na ti. A si! Zumnak neitu hrangah cun ziang hmuahhmuah a cang thei a si,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cupa cun hmakhatte ah, “Ka zum a si; ka zum kim lonak i bawm aw,” tiah a au ciamco."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh cun misenpi in a kiangah an ra fuk vivo ti a hmuh tikah ramhuai kha thu a pek ih, “Hnaset le ṭong thiam lo thlarau siava, hi nauhak pa sung ihsin suak awla lut sal nawn hlah, tiah thu ka lo pek,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Ramhuai cu a hruum ih nauhak pa kha dircai phah in a thlukta ih a sung ihsin a suak. Nauhak pa cu mithi a bang ih mi tampi in, “A thi zo,” tiah an ti."},"27":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh in nauhak pa cu a kut in a vun dirh ih a hung ding."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh cu inn sungah a lut ih dungthluntu pawl in a thupte in, “Ziangah so kannih hmuah in kan dawi thei lo?” tiah an sut."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Thlacamnak dah ti lo, thildang zianghman in hi bangtuk cu a dawi thei lo ding,” tiah a sim."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu cutawk ihsin an pok ih Galilee peng tan phah in an feh. Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl thu a zirh vivo ruangah midang zohman in a umnak thei dingah a duh lo.","title":"A Thihnak Ding Thu A Sim Sal (Mat 17.22-23 ; Luk 9.43-45)"},"31":{"text":"Ziangtin a zirh tile: “Milai Fapa hi mi kut ah an thlen ding ih an that ding. Asinain ni thum hnuah a tho sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cuti ih a zirhmi cu an thei thei lo. A suh le an sut ngam fawn lo."},"33":{"text":"Kapernaum khua an thleng ih inn sungih an luh hnuah Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl cu, “Lamzin ah ziangthu so nan el awk rero kha?” tiah a sut.","title":"Zoso A Tum Bik (Mat 18.1-5 ; Luk 9.46-48)"},"34":{"text":"A thu suhmi cu zohman in an let lo, ziangahtile lamzinih an el awkmi cu anmah lakah zoso a tum bik ti a si."},"35":{"text":"Jesuh cu a to ih dungthluntu hleihnih a ko ih an hnenah, “A tum bik si a duhtu cu mi nauta bik a si hmaisa ding ih mi hmuahhmuah riantu a si pei,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cule nauhak pakhat a ko ih an hmaiah a dinter. Nauhak pate cu Jesuh in a kuah ih an hmaiah a dinter hnuah,"},"37":{"text":"“Zokhal sisehla ka hmin in hi bangtuk nauhak a cohlangtu cu keimah i cohlang a si; cule keimah i cohlangtu cu keimah i thlahtu khal a cohlang a si,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Johan in, “Sayapa, na hmin in khawsia a dawisuaktu mi pakhat kan hmu ih kan lak ih tel vemi a si lo ruangah kan khamta,” tiah a ti.","title":"In Dodal Lotu Cu Kanlam ṭang A si (Luk 9.49-50)"},"39":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Kham hlah uh! Ziangahtile ka hmin in mangbangza a tuahtu cun i simsia lo ding."},"40":{"text":"Ziangahtile in dodal lotu cu kanmah lam ṭang a si."},"41":{"text":"Thungaite in ka lo sim: Ka minung nan si ruangih tidai khuat khat a lo petu cu ṭhatman a ngah tengteng ding,” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Zokhal sisehla hi bangtuk nauhakte pawl pakhatkhat keimah i rinsannak ihsin a pialtertu cu a hngawng ah fangcang rialnak lungtum thlaih tahratin tifinriat sungih thlak a hrangah a ṭha sawn a si.","title":"Sualforhnak Thu (Mat 18.6-9 ; Luk 17.1-2)"},"43":{"text":"Curuangah na kut in na zumnak a lo pialter a si ahcun na kut cu tan aw! Na ke pahnih thawn hell sungih tlak hnak cun ke pakhat lawng thawn nunnak sungih na luh a ṭha sawn."},"47":{"text":"Cule na mit in na zumnak a lo pialter a si ahcun na mit cu phorh suak aw. Mit pahnih thawn hell sungih tlak hnak cun mit pakhat lawng thawn Pathian Uknak sungih na luh a ṭha sawn."},"48":{"text":"Cutawkah ‘anmah a eitu tholung pawl cu an thi dah lo ih anmah kangtu meisa khal a mit dah lo a si.’"},"49":{"text":"“Thawinak sa cu ci in thianfaiter a si vekin mi hmuahhmuah cu meisa in thianfaiter thluh an si ve ding."},"50":{"text":"“Ci cu a ṭha. Sikhalsehla a alnak a ziam asile ziangtinso na alter sal thei nawn ding? “Ci bangtuk in a ṭha mi pawlkomnak nei uhla pakhat le pakhat rualremte in um uh,” tiah a ti."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu cutawk hmun in a suak ih Judea peng ah a feh ih Jordan Tiva a tan. Tiva ral khat ahcun miburpi in an pan thotho ih a zirh keel vekin thu a zirh.","title":"Nupa ṭhen Awknak Thu (Mat 19.1-12 ; Luk 16.18)"},"2":{"text":"Farasi mi hrekkhat a sual hawl duh ah an ra; annih in, “In sim hnik! Mipa in a nupi maak dingah kan Daan in a thlah maw?” tiah an sut."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ziangbangtuk daan so Moses in a lo pek?” tiah a sut."},"4":{"text":"Annih in, “Moses cun nupi maaknak ca nan ngan pei ih nan maak thei ding in ti,” tiah an let."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Nan thinlung a ruh tuk ih zirh theih nan si lo ruangah Moses in hi bangtuk daan cu a lo pek a si."},"6":{"text":"Asinain a hramthok, lei le van seemsuah a si laiah cun Ca Thianghlim ih a sim vekin ‘Pathian in mipa le nunau a tuah."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah mipa in a nu le a pa a taanta ding ih a nupi thawn an kom aw ding ih pumkhat ah an cang ding,’ tiah a ti a si."},"8":{"text":"Cu a si ruangah annih cu pahnih an si nawn lo, pakhat an si zo."},"9":{"text":"Pathian ih a kommi cu zohman in ṭhen hlah hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Inn sungih an luh sal tikah a dungthluntu pawl in cuih thu cu an sut."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh cun an hnenah, “Mi pakhat in a nupi a maak ih nunau dang a ṭhit asile a nupi par ihsih nunau dang thawn ṭaangṭawm sualnak a tuah a si."},"12":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in nunau in a pasal a taan ih mipa dang a neih ahcun ṭaangṭawm sualnak a tuah a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat in an faate pawl kha Jesuh in thlawsuah pe dingah an rak hruai. Asinain cu pawl cu a dungthluntu pawl in an rak kawk.","title":"Nauhak Pawl Thlawsuah A Pek (Mat 19.13-15 ; Luk 18.15-17)"},"14":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Jesuh ih a theih tikah a thin a heng ih a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Nauhak pawl cu ka hnenah ra hai seh, dawn hlah uh. Ziangahtile Pathian Uknak cu hi bangtuk nauhak pawl hrangah a si."},"15":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: zokhal sisehla nauhak bangtuk in Pathian Uknak an cohlang lo ahcun cuih Pathian Uknak sungah an lut thei dah lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule nauhak pawl cu a pom ih an parah a kut a suang fingfing ih thlawsuah a pek."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh cu khual tlawng dingih a pawh zawng ah mi pakhat a hnenah a ra tlan ih a khuk bilh tahrat in, “Zirhtu ṭha, kumkhua nunnak ka co theinak dingah ziangso ka tuah ding?” tiah a sut.","title":"Milianpa Ih Thu (Mat 19.16-30 ; Luk 18.18-30)"},"18":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ziangah so zirhtu ṭha i ti? Pathian siar lo zohman mi ṭha an um lo."},"19":{"text":"Thukham pawl cu na thei a sisi. ‘Mi that hlah; ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuah hlah; rukru hlah; a dik loin midang sual puh hlah; mi va bum hlah; na nu le na pa upat aw,’ ti an si kha,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cupa cun, “Sayapa, hi thukham pawl cu ka nauhak lai ihsin ka thlun ṭheh ciami an si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in cupa cu duhdawtnak thawn a zoh hliah ih, “Thil pakhat na sam lai. Va feh awla na neihmi hmuahhmuah zuar in tangka na ngah mi kha mifarah va pe awla vancung ah hlawnthil tampi na nei ding. Cuih hnuah i ra thlun aw,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cuih thu a theih tikah mithmai sia le riahsia in a feh; ziangahtile amah cu milian ngaingai a si."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl cu a zoh vivo hai ih, “Milian pawl hrangah Pathian Uknak sungih luh cu ziangtlukin so a har ding!” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cumi an theih tikah dungthluntu pawl cu an mang a bang ngaingai; asinain Jesuh cun a sim beet ih, “Ka faale tla, Pathian Uknak sung luh ding hi ziangtlukin so a har!"},"25":{"text":"“Pathian Uknak sungih milian pa a luh ding hnak cun ṭhimte hnakua sungih kalauk a luh a ol sawn ding,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cuih thu an theih tikah dungthluntu pawl cu an mang a bang sinsin ih, “Cuti a si ahcun zoso runnak a ngah thei ding?” tiah pakhat le pakhat an ti aw."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl cu hmaiton tein a zoh ih, “Himi hi milai hrangah cun a cang thei lo; Pathian hrang lawngah a cang thei. Inn siseh, lo siseh, unau siseh, farnu siseh, nu siseh, faate siseh, a let zakhat in a ngah ding; cuih tlunah hremnak khal a ngah ve ding. Cule a ra dingmi sanah kumkhua nunnak a ngah ding a si."},"31":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atuih hmaisa bik a si mi tampi cu neta bik an si ding, cule atuih neta bik a si mi tampi cu hmaisa bik an si leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu Jerusalem lam ah an feh laiah Jesuh cu an hmaiah a rak feh; a dungthluntu pawl cu an thin a nuam lo. Dungthluntu hleihnih pawl cu hmun dang deuh ah a hruai ih a parih a ra thleng dingmi thil pawl cu a sim sal.","title":"Jesuh In A Thihnak Ding A Sim Lala (Mat 20.17-19 ; Luk 18.31-34)"},"33":{"text":"Anih in, “Ngaihnik uh! Asinain ni thum hnuah a tho sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cule Zebedi ih fapa Jeim le Johan cu Jesuh hnenah an ra ih “Sayapa, thil pakhat in tuahsak hram dingah kan duh,” tiah an ti.","title":"Jeim Le Johan Ih Dilnak (Mat 20.20-28)"},"36":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ziang so nan duhmi cu a si?” tiah a sut."},"37":{"text":"Annih in, “A sunglawimi na Uknak sungih na bawi tokham parih na to tikah na kiangah in toter ve hram aw; pakhat na vorhlam ah, pakhat na kehlam ah,” tiah an ti."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh cun an hnenah, “Ziang kan dil tihi nan thei lo. Ka in dingmi tuarnak khuathai hi nan in thei ding maw? Baptisma ka lak vek rori in nan lak thei ve ding maw?” tiah a sut."},"39":{"text":"Annih in, “Kan ti thei ding,” tiah an let. Jesuh in an hnenah, “Ka in dingmi khuathai hi nan in thei ngai ko ding ih baptisma ka lak vekin nan lak thei ve ko ding."},"40":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka vorhlam le ka kehlam ih totu ding hril theinak cu keiih thu a si lo. Pathian in hi hmun cu a timtuah sak ciami pawl hnenah a pe ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Cuih thu cu dungthluntu dang pahra pawl in an theih tikah Jeim le Johan parah an thin a heng ngaingai."},"42":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh in an zatein a kokhawm ih, “Leitlun ram uktu pawl cu an ukmi pawl kha an lal-hnawh ih an hotu pawl tla cu thu an nei nasa ti cu nan thei."},"43":{"text":"Asinain nannih lakah cun hi bangtuk cun a si lo pei. Nanmah lakah pakhat in a tum bik si a duh ahcun nan zate riantu a si pei."},"44":{"text":"Nanmah lakah pakhatnak si a duhtu cun nan zate sal a si pei."},"45":{"text":"Ziangahtile Milai Fapa hman hi rianmi si loin miriantu si dingah le mi tampi tlen dingah a nunnak pe dingin a ra a si,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl le miburpi cu Jerikho khua an thleng. Mitcaw pa cu an ko ih, “Na lung awi aw, tho aw, a lo ko so khaw,” tiah an ti."},"50":{"text":"A puan sin laimi hlon duak in amah cu Jesuh hnenah a pet vurvo."},"51":{"text":"“Ziang lo tuah sak ding so na duh?” tiah Jesuh in a sut. Hmakhatteah khua a hmu thei ih cuih sin Jesuh cu a thlun."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem khua an naih rero thlang ih Bethfath le Bethani khua kiang Olif tlang an thleng.
