A hri phoih uhla rak hruai uh."},"3":{"text":"Mi pakhat in, ‘Ziangah so nan phoih?’ a lo ti le, ‘Bawipa in a hai, a lo khirh sal cing ding,’ va ti uh,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuticun an feh ih khawsung lamzinpi ah, inn pakhat sangka ah laak note pakhat hreenmi kha an hmu. A hri an phoih zawng ah,"},"5":{"text":"cutawkih a dingmi mi hrekkhat in, “Ziangah so laak note cu nan phoih rero,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Annih in Jesuh ih a sim cia vek cun an sim ih hmakhatte ah an fehter."},"7":{"text":"Jesuh hnenah laak cu an rak hruai ih a parah an puan an dam hnuah Jesuh cu a to."},"8":{"text":"Mi tampi in a fehnak ding lamzin ah an puan an phah; mi hrek in sawl an khiak ih an phah ve."},"9":{"text":"A hmaiih a fehmi in siseh, dunglamih a thluntu pawl in siseh: “Hosanna! Bawipa hmin in a rami cu Pathian in thlawsuah hram seh!"},"10":{"text":"Kan pu David Siangpahrang uknak a ra dingmi cu Pathian in thlawsuah ko seh! Hosanna! A saangbik vanah khin Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh,” tiah an au ciamco."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerusalem ah a lut ih Biakinn sungah a feh ih ziang hmuahhmuah kimtein a zoh thluh. Asinain tikcu a tlai zo ruangah a dungthluntu hleihnih thawn Bethani khua ah an va feh."},"12":{"text":"A thaisun Bethani khua ihsin an rat sal laiah Jesuh cu a ril a rawng.","title":"Jesuh In Thei Kung A Cam (Mat 21.18-19)"},"13":{"text":"Lamhlat nawnah a hnah niim ciaiciai in theikung pakhat a hmu ih a rah hawl dingah a pan. Sikhalsehla theikung kiang a thlen tikah a hnah lawng a hmu; ziangahtile theipi rah tikcu a si lo."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Zohman in na rah lo ei nawn hlah hai seh,” tiah theikung cu a ti. A dungthluntu pawl in cuih ṭong cu an thei."},"15":{"text":"Jerusalem an thlen tikah Jesuh cu Biakinn ah a feh ih thil a leitu le a zuartu pawl kha a dawihlo ṭheh. Paisa thlengtu pawl ih cabuai le laileng zuartu pawl ih tohkham pawl khal a lingleh sak thluh.","title":"Jesuh Biakinn Ah A Feh (Mat 21.12-17 ; Luk 19.45-48 ; Joh 2.13-22)"},"16":{"text":"Cule Biakinn tualih thil phurih vak sukso pawl khal a kham ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Mipi pawl cu hiti in a sim: “Ca Thianghlim sungah Pathian in ‘Ka inn cu miphun hmuahhmuah hrangih thlacamnak inn ti a si ding,’ a timi a um. Sikhalsehla nannih in rukru relhnak lungpuk ah nan tuah a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isai 56.7; Jer. 7.11"},"18":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl in cuih thu an theih tikah Jesuh thah theinak lamzin an hawl. Annih in Jesuh cu an ṭih ngaingai, ziangahtile Jesuh thuzirhmi in misenpi pawl ih thinlung a ton tuk ruangah a si."},"19":{"text":"Zanlam a si tikah Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu khawpi sung ihsin ah suak."},"20":{"text":"A thaizing zingpit lamzinih an feh laiah theikung cu an hei hmu. A zim ihsin a hram tiang a ro ṭheh.","title":"Theikung A Thi (Mat 21.20-22)"},"21":{"text":"Piter in a vun mang sal ih Jesuh hnenah, “Zohhnik, Sayapa! Na cammi theikung kha a thi zo!” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Pathian rinsan uh!"},"23":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: zokhal sisehla a thinlung sungah rinhmainak nei loin a sim vekin a cang tengteng ding tiah a zumfek ahcun, ‘Hi tlang hi thawn awla tifinriat sungah va tla aw,’ a ti khalle tuah sak a si ding."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah hiti in ka lo sim: thla nan cam ih thil pakhatkhat nan dil tikah ka ngah zo tiin zum uhla nan dil mi hmuahhmuah cu nan ngah ko ding."},"25":{"text":"Cun thlacam dingih nan din tikah mi pakhatkhat parih duh lonak nan neihmi kha va ngaithiam uh; cutikah vancungih a ummi nan Pa in nan sualnak kha a lo ngaithiam ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu Jerusalem khua sungah an ra thleng sal. Jesuh cu Biakinn sungih a feh laiah puithiam upa, Daanthiam pawl le upa dang pawl an ra ih,","title":"Jesuh Thuneihnak An Sut (Mat 21.23-27 ; Luk 20.1-8)"},"28":{"text":"Jesuh cu, “Ziangvek thuneih theinak in so hi bangtuk thil hi na tuah? Zo in so hi thuneihnak hi a lo pek?” tiah an sut."},"29":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Thu pakhat ka lo sut dingih in let thei a si ahcun ziangvek thuneihnak in so hi bangtuk thil hi ka tuah, ti ka lo sim hai ding."},"30":{"text":"I simhnik uh: Johan ih baptisma a pek theinak thu hi zo ih hnen in so a ngah? Pathian hnen in maw, milai hnen in so?” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Anmah le anmah an el aw ih, “Ziangtin so kan ti ding? ‘Pathian hnen ihsin,’ kan ti ahcun ‘Cuti asile ziangah so Johan cu nan zum lo?’ tiah in ti ding."},"32":{"text":"Asinain, ‘Milai hnen ihsin,’ kan ti ahcun misenpi ṭih a um fawn, ziangahtile misenpi in Johan cu profet a si ti kha an thei thluh fawn,” an ti."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh hnenah, “Kan thei lo,” tiah an let. Jesuh in an hnenah, “Kei khal in ziangvek thuneihnak in so hi bangtuk thil hi ka tuah, ti ka lo sim ve lo ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh in an hnenah tahṭhimnak thawn thu a sim. “Hlanlaiah mi pakhat a um ih sabit hmuan a tuah; hawi a kulh, sabit sawrnak ah khur a lai ih rit kilnakah parthlam a sak. Cule thlawhhlawh a duhmi pawl hnenah a pekta ih amah cu khual a tlawng.","title":"Sabit Hmuan Hnaṭuantu Pawl Tahṭhimnak (Mat 21.33-46 ; Luk 20.9-19)"},"2":{"text":"Sabit rah lawh a cut tikah a covo la dingin a sal pakhat a thlah."},"3":{"text":"Hmuan thlotu pawl cun a salpa cu an kai ih an vuak ih kut lawngin an kirter."},"4":{"text":"Cun sal dang pakhat a thlah sal. Hmuan thlotu pawl in a lu ah an vuak ih mualpho le ningzak in an tuah."},"5":{"text":"Hmuan neitu pa cun sal dang a thlah lala, a sinan an rak that; sal dang tampi tla cuvek cun an tuah. Ṭhenkhat an vuak ih ṭhenkhat cu an that."},"6":{"text":"Thlah dingih a taangmi cu a duhdawt zetmi fapa lawng a si thlang. Neta bikah hmuan thlotu pawl hnenah a fapa cu a thlah ih, “Ka fapa cu an upat ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Asinain cuih hmuan thlotu pawl cun, “Hi pa hi hmuan neitu ih fapa a si. Ra uh kan that pei ih a thil hmuahhmuah kan ta a si ding,” tiah pakhat le pakhat an ti aw."},"8":{"text":"Cuti cun a fapa cu an kaih ih an thah hnuah a ruak cu hmuan lengah an hlon."},"9":{"text":"“Cuih hnuah hmuan neitu in ziangso a tuah ding?” tiah Jesuh in a sut hai. “Hmuan neitupa a ra ding ih a hlawhfa pawl cu a that ṭheh ding ih a hmuan cu hlawhfa dang kut ah a pe ding."},"10":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim sungah: ‘Inn saktu pawl in santlai lo tiih an hnonmi lungto cu, A thupi bikmi lungto ah a cang riangri."},"11":{"text":"Cumi cu Bawipa ih tuahmi a si; Ziang tlukih zoh mawi so a si,’ tiih ngan ciami kha nan siar dah lo maw?” tiah a ti.","ref":"Saam 118.22-23"},"12":{"text":"Judah mi upa pawl cun cuih tahṭhimnak cu anmah a ṭongsanmi a si, ti an theih ruangah Jesuh kha a kaih an tum. Asinain misenpi pawl an ṭih ruangah an suak ih Jesuh cu an fehsan sal."},"13":{"text":"Farasi mi hrekkhat le Herod minung pawl hrekkhat cu Jesuh kha thusuhnak in awk ngah dingah an thlah.","title":"Ngunkhuai Peknak Thu (Mat 22.15-22 ; Luk 20.20-26)"},"14":{"text":"Jesuh hnenah an ra thleng ih, “Sayapa, nang cu mi in ziangtin in ti pei ti khal ruat loin thudik na sim ti kan thei. Mi mithmai na zoh lo ih upa nauta thleidannak thinlung na nei lo. Pathian duhnak thudik lawng mi hnenah na sim. Curuangah fiangtein in sim hnik. Rom siangpahrang hnenah ngunkhuai pek hi kan Daan in a thlah maw thlah lo? Kan pe ding maw pe lo ding?” tiah an sut."},"15":{"text":"Asinain an depdetnak kha Jesuh in a hmu ih, “Ziangah so thangih awh in tum? Ngun tangka rak keng hnik uh, ka zoh pei,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"An rak keng ih Jesuh in, “Hihi zo ih hmuihmel le hmin so a si?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Rom siangpahrang ih hmuihmel le hmin,” tiah an ti."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh in, “Cuti a si ahcun siangpahrang ta a si mi cu siangpahrang pek uhla Pathian ta a si mi cu Pathian hnenah pek uh,” tiah a ti. Cumi an theih tikah an mang a bang ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Cule Sadusi ṭhenkhat, thih hnuah cun zohman an thosal lo ding, tiah a zumtu pawl Jesuh hnenah an ra ih,","title":"Thawhsalnak Thu (Mat 22.23-33 ; Luk 20.27-40)"},"19":{"text":"“Sayapa, Moses in daan in ngan sakmi ah ‘Mipa pakhat a thih ih faate nei loin nupi a taan ahcun faate nei ih a can salnak dingah a thihsan mi a nupi cu a naupa in a ṭhi pei,’ tiah a um."},"20":{"text":"Voikhat ah unau pasarih an um; upa bik pa cu nupi a ṭhi ih faate nei loin a thi."},"21":{"text":"A pahnihnak pa in cu nu cu a ṭhi ih faate nei loin a thi ve. Cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in a pathumnak in cu nu cu a ṭhi naón a thihsan lala."},"22":{"text":"An zatein fa nei loin an thi ṭheh. An pasarih in cu nu cu an ṭhi ih faate nei loin an thi ṭheh a si. Neta bikah nunau nu khal a thi ve."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah thawhsal caan mithi an thawhsal ni ah cu nu cu zo ih nupi bik so a si ding? An pasarih in an ṭhi fingfing fawn,” tiah an sut."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nan va palh lawmmam so? Ziangah kan palh ti nan thei maw? Ca Thianghlim siseh, Pathian cahnak huham siseh, nan theih lo ruangah a si."},"25":{"text":"Ziangahtile mithi pawl an thawhsal tikah vancungih vanmi bangtuk an si ding ruangah ṭhit awk ti a um nawn lo ding."},"26":{"text":"Mithi thawhsalnak thu-ah cun Moses Cabu sungih hrambur a kangmi thu kha nan siar dah lo maw? Cutawkah Pathian in Moses hnenah, ‘Keimah cu Abraham ih Pathian, Isaak ih Pathian, le Jakob ih Pathian ka si,’ a ti."},"27":{"text":"Pathian cu a nungmi pawl ih Pathian a si, a thi mi pawl ih Pathian a si lo. Curuangah nan palh nasa a si,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cutawkah an thu relmi a thei vetu Daanthiam pakhat a rak um. Jesuh in Sadusi pawl ih thusuhnak kha a let thiam zet ti a theih tikah Jesuh hnenah a ra ih, “Khuimi thukham so a thupi bik?” tiah a ra sut.","title":"A Thupi Bikmi Thukham (Mat 22.34-40 ; Luk 10.25-28)"},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in, “A thupi bikmi thukham cu ‘Maw Israel mi pawl ngai uh! Bawipa kan Pathian lawng hi Bawipa a si."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian cu nan thinlung zate, nan nunnak zate, nan ruahnak zate le nan thazaang zate thawn nan duhdaw pei,’ tihi a si."},"31":{"text":"Cun a pahnihnak ih a thupimi thukham cu, ‘Na innhnen kha nangmah na duh awk vekin na duhdaw pei,’ tihi a si. Hi thukham pahnih hnakih a thupi sawnmi thukham a um nawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Daanthiam pa cun Jesuh hnenah, “Sayapa, na timi cu a ṭha ngaingai. Na sim bangtuk in Bawipa lawng hi Pathian a si ih pathian dang an um nawn lo, ti cu a dik ngaingaimi a si."},"33":{"text":"Cu ruangah milai in Pathian cu a thinlung zate, a ruahnak zate le a cahnak zate thawn a duhdaw pei ih amah ih pum a duhdawt vekin a innhnen cu a duhdaw ve pei. Hi thukham pahnih thlun cu mei-ur thawinak le thawinak dangdang pawl pek hnakin a thupi sawn a si,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in a thu lehmi cu a felzet a si ti kha a hmu ih a hnenah, “Nangmah cu Pathian Uknak thawn nan hlat aw lo,” tiah a ti. Cuih hnuah cun Jesuh cu zohman in thu an sut ngam nawn lo."},"35":{"text":"Biakinn sungih thu a zirh laiah Jesuh in hiti in thu pakhat a sut, “Ziangtin so Daanthiam pawl in Messiah cu David tesinfa a si ding, tiah an ti thei?","title":"Messiah Thu (Mat 22.41-46 ; Luk 20.41-44)"},"36":{"text":"Amah David lala cu Thlarau Thianghlim in a simter ih, ‘Bawipa in ka Bawipa hnenah, Na ral pawl na ke hnuai ih ka ret ngah hlan lo, Ka vorhlam kapah to aw,’ tiah a ti.","ref":"Saam 110.1"},"37":{"text":"“Amah David hman in Messiah cu ‘Bawipa,’ tiih a ko asile ziangtinso David ih tesinfa cu a si thei ding,” tiah a ti. Mi tampi in Jesuh thuzirhmi cu lungawi aipuang zetin an ngai."},"38":{"text":"Cutiih thu a zirh tikah Jesuh in, “Daanthiam pawl hi ṭhatein ralring uh. Annih cun an puanfualpi thawn tawihvah an duh ih mipi tamnak dawr tluan ah mi in upatnak thawn cibai in buk hai seh ti an duh."},"39":{"text":"Sinakok ah tonak ṭha bik an ham cia ih puai tuahnak hmun ah hmun ṭha bik an hril."},"40":{"text":"Nuhmei pawl kha a miat hawlnak ah an hmang ih an inn tiangin an lawng. Cule mi in in hmu hai seh tiah rei zetzet in thla an cam. Hrem an ton dingmi cu midang tonmi hnakin a nasa sawn ding,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh cu Biakinn tangka retnak kiangah a to ih mi in thawhlawm tangka an pek lai rero kha a zoh. Milian tampi in tangka tampi an san.","title":"Nuhmei Thawhlawm (Luk 21.1-4)"},"42":{"text":"Cule a farah zetmi nuhmei pakhat a ra ih daar tangka pia hnih a san ve."},"43":{"text":"A dungthluntu pawl kha hmunkhat ah a ko ih an hnenah, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: hi farah nuhmei nu in thawhlawm sannak kuang sungah midang hmuahhmuah hnakin tam bik a san a si."},"44":{"text":"Ziangahtile midang pawl cun an neihmi sungin a hleifuan an pek; asinain hi nuhmei nu cun a farah zet naón a neihmi hmuahhmuah a san; a pumcawmnak ih a hman dingmi hmuahhmuah a pek ṭheh a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu Biakinn ihsin a feh zawng ah a dungthluntu pakhat in, “Sayapa, zohhnik! Hi inn le lungpipi pawl cu an va mak so!” tiah a ti.","title":"Jerusalem Biakinn Siatnak Thu (Mat 24.1-2 ; Luk 21.5-6)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hi a nasa zetmi inn pawl hi na hmu a si lo maw? Hi lungpipi pawl hi pakhat hman an umnak keel ah an um nawn lo tikcu a thleng ding, an zatein an cim ṭheh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh cu Olif Tlang, Biakinn ihsin ralden ih a ummi Tlangah cun a to; cutawkah Piter, Jeim, Johan le Andru a thuptein an ra ih,","title":"Harsatnak Le Hremnak (Mat 24.3-14 ; Luk 21.7-19)"},"4":{"text":"“Hi bangtuk caan cu ziangtikah so a si ding? In sim hnik! Cuih caan a ra thleng cing ding ti theihthiamnak ah ziang hminsinnak so a um ding?” tiah an sut."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Ralring uh! Zohman in lo bum hlah hai seh."},"6":{"text":"Mi tampi keimah ih hmih in an ra ding ih ‘Amah ka si,’ tiah an ti ding ih mi tampi an bum ding."},"7":{"text":"Lam naite ih raldonak thawm le lam hlapi ih raldonak thawmvang pawl nan theih tikah thinphang in um hlah uh. Cubangtuk thil cu a thleng ding, asinain caan netnak a si hrih lo."},"8":{"text":"Ram khat le ram khat, uknak pakhat le pakhat, an do aw ding. Khawzakip ah ling a hnin ding ih paam a tlung ding. Cubangtuk cu nauhrin zikih pumnat thok vek a si."},"9":{"text":"“Nanmah hrimhrim nan ralring pei. An lo kai ding ih khonsil zung tampi ah an lo suahpi hai ding; Sinakok tla ah an lo thawi ding; keimah ruangah hotu le siangpahrang hmaiah an lo dingter ding. Cuih caan cu ka Thuthang ṭha nan simnak ding caan a si."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla caan a net hlanah Thuthang ṭha cu miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah sim a si ding."},"11":{"text":"Cule an lo kai ih zungih an lo suahpi tikah ziangso kan sim ding tiah a hlankhan in va phang hlah uh. Tikcu a ra thlen tikah nan sim dingmi cu theihter nan si ding. Ziangahtile nan simmi ṭong cu nanmah ih ṭong a si lo ding; Thlarau Thianghlim ih simmi ṭong a si ding."},"12":{"text":"Unau le unau kha thihnak tiangin an phiar aw ding; cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in pale in an faale parah an tuah ding. Faale in an nu le an pa pawl an dodal ding ih thihnak tiang an thlenter ding."},"13":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in keimah ruangah an lo hua ding. Sikhalsehla a netnak tiang a tuarsuak theitu cu rundam an si ding."},"14":{"text":"“Tuksumza Thil-borhhlawh cu a din lonak ding hmunih a din kha nan hmu ding.” (Hi ca a siartu: a sim duhmi hi theithiam aw.) “Cule Judea pengih a ummi pawl an zatein tlang parah tlan hai seh.","title":"Tuksumza Thil-borhhlawh (Mat 24.15-28 ; Luk 21.20-24)"},"15":{"text":"A inn tlun diphun ih a ummi in a ken dingmi thil lak dingah inn sungah vung lut hlah seh."},"16":{"text":"Lo ih a ummi in a puan lak dingah a inn ah tlung hlah seh."},"17":{"text":"Favun le nau-awkkai neimi hrangah cun a har ngaingai ding."},"18":{"text":"Cuih harsatnak pawl cu thlatang lai ngelcel ih a thlen lonak dingah Pathian hnenah thlacam uh."},"19":{"text":"Ziangahtile hi thil a thleng dingmi hi Pathian ih leilung a seemsuah thokin atu tiangah a um dah keel lomi harsatnak a si ding. Hmailam ziangtik khalah a um dah nawn fawn lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa in cuih ni cu a malter zo; malter loin um sehla zovek milai hman an taang lo ding. Asinain a hril ciami pawl hrangah cuih ni khua cu a tawiter zo a si."},"21":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat in ‘Zohhnik uh, hinah Messiah a um,’ ‘Zohhnik uh, khinah Messiah a um,’ tiah an lo ti khalle va zum hlah uh."},"22":{"text":"Ziangahtile Messiah deu le profet deu tampi an ra ding. Pathian hril ciami pawl hman an bum thei tawk bum dingah hmuhsaknak mak le khawruahhar tampi tla an tuah ding."},"23":{"text":"Ralring uh! A hlankhan in ziang hmuahhmuah ka lo sim cia zo a si."},"24":{"text":"“Cuih harsatnak caan hnuah cun ni a thim ding ih thlapi tla a vang lo ding.","title":"Milai Fapa Ratnak Thu (Mat 24.29-31 ; Luk 21.25-28)"},"25":{"text":"Van ihsin arsi pawl an tla ding ih van tlolak ih a ummi pawl ih cahnak le huham pawl cu an lamzin keel ihsin an pial ding."},"26":{"text":"Cule Milai Fapa cu a lang ding ih cahnak le sunlawinak thawn mero lakin a rung ding."},"27":{"text":"Leilung khatlam deng ihsin khatlam deng tiangih a ummi Pathian ih hril ciami pawl khawm dingah leilung kil li ah vancungmi pawl a thlah ding."},"28":{"text":"“Theikung ihsin ralrinnak zir uh. A hnge pawl an hring ih a ziik tla a mum ih hnah note an cerh tikah ṭhal tikcu a nai thlang ti nan thei.","title":"Theikung Thu Ihsin Ralrinnak (Mat 24.32-35 ; Luk 21.29-33)"},"29":{"text":"Cuvekin hi bangtuk thil a thlen vivo tikah tikcu a nai zo, a ra thleng zik thlang, ti kha nan thei ding."},"30":{"text":"Hitawkih a ummi pawl an thih ṭheh hlanah hi thil hmuahhmuah a thleng ṭheh ding, ti hi hngilh hlah uh."},"31":{"text":"Van le leilung hi a cemral ding naón ka ṭongkam hi cu an cemral dah lo ding."},"32":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla ziangtikah cuih ni le caan a ra thleng ding, ti cu zohman in an thei lo; vanih vancungmi in an thei lo, Fapa khal in a thei lo, Pa lawng in a thei.","title":"Zohman In A Tikcu An Thei Lo (Mat 24.36-44)"},"33":{"text":"Ziangtikah a tikcu a thleng ding ti nan theih lo ruangah ralringte le fimkhur tein um uh!"},"34":{"text":"Ziang thawn a bangrep tile mi pakhat khual tlawng dingin a pok ih a hnen-um pawl kha an ṭuanvo felte le kimtein a pekta ih sangka kiltu pa tla it lo siing loih sangka kil dingah a tiamtatu inn neitupa bangtuk a si."},"35":{"text":"Inn neitu bawi cu ziang tikah a ra thleng ding, ti nan theih lo ruangah ralring zetin um uh. Zanlam ah a si thei, zanṭim ah a si thei, khawvang hlan khalah a si thei ih nisuak zawng khalah a si thei."},"36":{"text":"Rinlopi ih a ra thlen a si ahcun na ihthat lai lo tong pang hlah seh."},"37":{"text":"Nan hnenih ka simmi hi mi hmuahhmuah hnen khalah ka sim a si: Ralring in um uh,” tiah Jesuh in a ti."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lantak puai le Thilnu telh lo sang puai a kimnak dingah ni hnih lawng a duh. Puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl in Jesuh kha a thupte in kai ih thah theinak lamzin an hawl.","title":"Jesuh Zuarnak An Tawlrel (Mat 26.1-5 ; Luk 22.1-2 ; Joh 11.45-53)"},"2":{"text":"Asinain, “Puai tikcu lai ahcun kan tuah lo pei, misenpi pawl in hnaihnawhnak an suahter pang ding,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh cu Bethani khua, phaarnat a rak tuartu Simon inn ah a um ih rawl a ei laiah nunau nu in alabaster thawl pakhat in a mankhung zetmi rimhmui a khatin a rak keng. Cuih thawl cu a khuai ih rimhmui cu Jesuh lu ah a toih.","title":"Bethani Khua Ah Hriak An Toih (Mat 26.6-13 ; Joh 12.1-8)"},"4":{"text":"Cutawkih a ummi mi ṭhenkhat pawl cu an thin a heng ih, “A va pamhmai ve!"},"5":{"text":"Rimhmui cu ngun tangka zathum hnakih tam ah zuar in cuih tangka cun mifarah bawm sehla a ṭha sawn lo maw?” tiah pakhat le pakhat an ti aw ih cu nu cu an mawhthluk ciamco."},"6":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Zianghman ti hlah uh! Ziangah so nan buaipi rero? Hi nu hin thil ṭha le thil mawi a tuah a si."},"7":{"text":"Mifarah cu kumkhua nan hnenah an um ding ih nan duh ahcun ziangtik khalah nan bawm thei. Asinain kei cu nan hnenah ka um ringring lo ding."},"8":{"text":"A tuah thei tawk a tuah zo. Ka taksa pum parah rimhmui a toihmi hi keimah vuinak dingah a hlankhan in a timtuah ciami a si."},"9":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: leilung pumpuluk Thuthang ṭha an simnak kipah hi a tuahmi hi amah theihnak ah an sim ringring ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu hleihnih lakih pakhat Judas Iskariot cu Jesuh zuar dingah puithiam upa pawl hnenah a feh.","title":"Judas In A Phiar (Mat 26.14-16 ; Luk 22.3-6)"},"11":{"text":"An hnenih a ṭongmi pawl an theih tikah an lung a awi ngaingai ih tangka pe dingin thu an rak kam. Cule Judas cun Jesuh a zuar ngah ih an kut sung a thlenter theinak dingah caan ṭha a bawh."},"12":{"text":"Thilnu rawi lo Sang Puai ni khatnak ni, Lantak Puai rawldonak hrangih tuu faate pawl an thah ni ah dungthluntu pawl in, “Khuiah so Lantak Puai zanriah kan lo timtuah sak ding na duh?” tiah Jesuh kha an sut.","title":"Dungthluntu Pawl Thawn Zanriah An Ei (Mat 26.17-25 ; Luk 22.7-14 , 21-23 ; Joh 13.21-30)"},"13":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in mi pahnih a thlah ih hiti in thu a cah, “Khawsung ah va feh uhla tithawl in tidai a phurtu pa thawn nan tong aw ding. Amah cu thlun uhla,"},"14":{"text":"a luhnak innih inn neitupa hnenah ‘Sayapa in amah le a dungthluntu pawl Lantak Puai zanriah an hil tlaangnak ding inn khaan khuiso a si? tiah va sut uh, in ti,’ va ti uh."},"15":{"text":"Cule anih in tlunta khaan tumpi a lo hmuh ding. Ziang hmuahhmuah ṭhate le kimteih timtuah ciami khaan a si ding ih cunah cun zanriah ei tlaangnak ding cu va tuah uh,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cu an pok ih khawsung an thlen tikah Jesuh ih sim ciami bangtuk in ziang hmuahhmuah an hmu. Cunah Lantak Puai zanriah cu an tuah."},"17":{"text":"Zanlam a si tikah Jesuh cu a dungthluntu hleihnih thawn an ra thleng."},"18":{"text":"Cabuai ih rawl an ei laiah Jesuh cun, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: Nanmah lakah pakhat, keimah thawn rawl a ei tlangtu pa in i zuar ding,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cu an thin a nuam lo ngaingai ih pakhat hnu pakhat in, “Na tisanmi hi kei ka si lo, ti aw?” tiah an ti fingfing."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nanmah hleihnih lakah a telmi, keimah thawn kheng khat sungih sang a hnimtu pa a si ding."},"21":{"text":"Milai Fapa cu thihnak a tuar ding, tiah Ca Thianghlim ih a ti vekin a thi ko ding. Asinain hi Milai Fapa a zuartu hrangah cun a hmakhua a pit a si! Suak lo lawlaw in rak um sehla amah ih hrangah cun a ṭha sawn ding naón!” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Zanriah an ei laiah Jesuh in sang a lak ih thla a cam hnuah sang cu a phel ih a dungthluntu pawl hnenah a pek. “Hi hi ka taksa a si; Lak uhla ei uh,” tiah a ti.","title":"Bawipa Zanriah (Mat 26.26-30 ; Luk 22.14-20 ; 1 Kor 11.23-25)"},"23":{"text":"Cuih hnuah hai a lak ih Pathian hnenah lungawinak thla a cam hnuah an hnenah a pek ih an zatein an in."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Himi hi mi tampi hrangih ka thletmi ka thisen a si; Pathian thukamnak a nemhngettu ka thisen a si."},"25":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Pathian Uknak sungih sabit thar ka in hlanlo hi sabit cu ka in sal nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cule hla an sak hnuah an suak ih Olif Tlangah an feh."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Nan zatein in taan ding ih nan tlanhlo ṭheh ding; ziangahtile Ca Thianghlim sungah ‘Pathian in tuukhal cu a that ding ih tuu pawl cu ṭhekdarh an si ṭheh ding,’ tiah ngan cia in a um.","title":"Piter Ih Phatsannak Ding A Sim Cia (Mat 26.31-35 ; Luk 22.31-34 ; Joh 13.36-38)","ref":"Zek 13.7"},"28":{"text":"Sikhalsehla thihnak ihsin thawhtersal ka si hnuah cun nan hmaiah Galilee ah ka feh ding,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Piter in, “Midang in lo tlansan ṭheh hman hai sehla kei cun ka lo tlansan hrimhrim lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh in Piter cu, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: tuihzan ar voi hnih a khuan hlanah voi thum tiang ‘Ka thei lo a si,’ tiah i phatsan ding,” a ti."},"31":{"text":"Piter cun nasa sinsin in, “Na hnenih thi ding ka si ve hmanah cu vek cun ka ṭong hrimhrim lo ding,” tiah a ti. Dungthluntu dang khal in cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in an ti ve."},"32":{"text":"Gethsemane timi hmun an thleng ih Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Ka thlacam sung hinah rak um uh,” tiah a ti.","title":"Gethsemane Ah Thla A Cam (Mat 26.36-46 ; Luk 22.39-46)"},"33":{"text":"Piter, Jeim le Johan kha a hruai. Thinhar le awloksong in a um ih,"},"34":{"text":"an hnenah cun, “Ka thinlung hi riahsiatnak in a khat tuk ih a kuai ṭheh ding a bang. Hinah rak um uhla it loin i rak hngak uh,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Hmaiah malte a va feh ih leilung ah a bok ih thla a cam. A can thei ahcun cuih harsatnak cu tong lo dingin a dil."},"36":{"text":"“Abba, Ka pa! Na hrangah cun ziang hmuahhmuah a cang thei ṭheh. Hi tuarnak khuathai hi ka hnen ihsin la hram aw. Asinain ka duh vekin si hlah seh, na duh vekin si sawnseh,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cun a ra kir ih dungthluntu pathum an ihthat kha a hmu. Piter hnenah, “Simon, na rak itthat maw si? Nazi pakhat sung hman itthat loin i hngak thei hrimhrim lo maw si?” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cule an hnenah, “Itthat loin hngak uhla sualforhnak sungih tla lo dingin thlacam uh. Thinlung cun a duh naón taksa cu a thazaang a mal a si,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Jesuh cu a feh sal ih a hmaisa vekin thla a cam lala."},"40":{"text":"Cun a ra kir ih dungthluntu pawl an itthat ṭheh kha a hmu; an mit an meng thei hrimhrim lo. Ziangtiih rak son ding ti khal an thei lo."},"41":{"text":"A voithumnak a ra kir sal tikah an hnenah cun, “Nan itthat hrih maw si? Nan cawl thei hrih lai maw si? Tawk seh! A tikcu a thleng zo! Zoh uh! Milai Fapa cu misual pawl kut sungah pek a si ding hi!"},"42":{"text":"Tho uhla feh uhsi! Zoh uh, i zuartu pa a ra thleng!” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Jesuh cu a ṭong rero laiah dungthluntu hleihnih lakih a tel vemi Judas cu a ra thleng. Judas thawn hmun khatah, puithiam upa pawl, Daanthiam pawl le Judah mi upa pawl ih thlahmi miburpi cu ralnam le talhtum pawl kengin an ra.","title":"Jesuh An Kai (Mat 26.47-56 ; Luk 22.47-53 ; Joh 18.3-12)"},"44":{"text":"Mizuartu pa cun mipi pawl cu hminsinnak a rak pek cia zo ih, “Ka hnam mipa cu kaih nan duhmi pa a si ding. Amah cu kai uhla ṭhatein kil uhla fehpi uh,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Judas cun a ra thlen vete in Jesuh cu a pan ih, “Sayapa!” tiah a ti ih a hnam."},"46":{"text":"Cutiin Jesuh cu an kai ih fektein an khit."},"47":{"text":"Culai ah an kiangih a dingmi pakhat in a ralnam a zuk ih Puithiam sang hnen-um pa ih hna a sah thlak."},"48":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cun, “Keimah hi rukru maw ka si, ralnam le talhtum thawn nan rat ciamco?"},"49":{"text":"Nitinte Biakinn ah thu ka lo zirh ṭheu laiah zohman in in kai fawn lo. Asi, Ca Thianghlim sung thu cu a kim a ṭul a si,” tiah a ti hai."},"50":{"text":"Cule a dungthluntu hmuahhmuah in an tlansan ṭheh."},"51":{"text":"Mino pakhat, puan paate lawng a sinmi pa in Jesuh cu a thlun. Amah khal cu a kaih an tum ve;"},"52":{"text":"asinain a puan taan in a tak lawngin a tlanhlo."},"53":{"text":"Jesuh cu Puithiam sang inn ah an hruai ih cutawkah puithiam upa pawl, upa dang pawl le Daanthiam pawl an tong aw khawm.","title":"Thurelnak Hmun An Thlenpi (Mat 26.57-68 ; Luk 22.54-55 , 63-71 ; Joh 18.13-14 , 19-24)"},"54":{"text":"A hlat nawn ihsin Piter in a thlun ih Puithiam Saang ih tual ah a lut. Tual ah ralvengtu pawl hnenah a to ih meisa a ai."},"55":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl le thuṭhentu Khonsil upa pawl in Jesuh cu thah duh ah a sual an hawl rero naón an hmu thei lo."},"56":{"text":"Mi tampi in thuphan per in Jesuh cu sual an puh, asinain an thu a rual aw thei lo."},"57":{"text":"Cun mi ṭhenkhat, a dik lo thutheitu si in an ding ih,"},"58":{"text":"“Hi pa hin ‘Milai sakmi hi Biakinn hi ka bal ṭheh ding ih ni thum sungah milai ih tuah lomi Biakinn ka sak ding,’ a ti, kan thei,” tiah Jesuh cu thuphan an puh."},"59":{"text":"Sikhalsehla annih khal cu an thu a rual aw thei cuang lo."},"60":{"text":"An zate hmaiah Puithiam Saang cu a ding ih Jesuh cu thu a sut. “Sual an lo puh hi na let thei lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"61":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh cu daitein a um ih ṭong kam khat hman a let lo. Cule Puithiam Saang cun, “Sunloih mi Pathian ih Fapa Messiah cu na si maw?” tiah a sut sal."},"62":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ka si! Milai Fapa hi Ziangkimtithei ih vorhlam kapah to in vancung mero thawn a rat khal nan hmu leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"63":{"text":"Cutikah Puithiam Saang cun a puan a thlek ih, “Thutheitu dang kan ṭul nawn lo."},"64":{"text":"Pathian a nautat zia cu nan thei thluh zo! Ziangtin nan ruat?” tiah a ti. An zatein Jesuh cu misual a si ih thah tlak a si, tiah an lung a kim ṭheh."},"65":{"text":"Mi hrek in Jesuh cu cil an phui; a mit an huh ih an thawi. “A lo thawitu hi zoso a si, simhnik!” tiah an ti. Cule ralkap pawl in an fehpi ih an beng phahphah."},"66":{"text":"Piter cu Puithiam Saang ih tualih a um laiah Puithiam Saang ih hnen-um nu pakhat a ra.","title":"Piter In Jesuh A Phatsan (Mat 26.69-75 ; Luk 22.56-62 ; Joh 18.15-18 , 25-27)"},"67":{"text":"Piter cu meisa a ai kha a hmuh tikah hmaitontein a zoh ih, “Nangmah khal hi Nazareth mi Jesuh thawn a rak um tlangmi na si,” tiah a ti."},"68":{"text":"Asinain Piter cun a phatsan ih, “Ka thei lo. Na ṭongmi hi ziangthu a si ti ka thei lo,” tiah a ti. Cule kotka zin lamah a ṭhawn. Cuvete in ar a khuang."},"69":{"text":"Hnen-um nu cun a va hmu lala ih a kiangkap mi pawl hnenah, “Hi pa khal hi an lakah a tel sokhaw!” tiah a sim lala."},"70":{"text":"Asinain Piter cun a phat thotho. Reilote ah a kiangkap ih a dingmi pawl in Piter cu, “Nangmah khal an lakih tel na si hrimhrim ko, ziangahtile Galilee mi na sisi!” tiah an ti."},"71":{"text":"Cun Piter in, siatcam in thu a kam ih, “Nan timi pa hi zo a si ti ka thei hrimhrim lo,” tiah thlalet cam in a ti."},"72":{"text":"Cuvete in a voihnihnak ar a khuang ih Piter cun Jesuh in, “Ar voi hnih a khuan hlanah voi thum tiang ‘Ka thei lo a si,’ tiah i phatsan ding,” a rak timi kha a vun mang sal ih napi in a ṭap."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingpitte ah Puithiam upa pawl cu upa dang pawl le Daanthiam pawl le thuṭhentu Khonsil upa pawl thawn zamrangin an tong ih thu an ruat khawm. Jesuh cu thir cikcin thawn khit in an hruai ih Pilat kut ah an pek.","title":"Pilat Hnenah Jesuh An Hruai (Mat 27.1-2 , 11-14 ; Luk 23.1-5 ; Joh 18.28-38)"},"2":{"text":"Pilat in, “Judah siangpahrang na si maw?” tiah a rak sut. Jesuh in, “Nangmah in na ti si!” tiah a let."},"3":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl in Jesuh cu sual a phunphun an puh."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Pilat in, “An thu hi na let lo ding maw? Sual an lo puhnak hmuahhmuah hi ngaihnik,” tiah a ti lala."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh cu a ṭong duh thotho lo ih Pilat cu a mang a bang ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"Lantak Puai poh ah kum tinte Pilat in thawngtla mi lakin mipi ih dilmi kha a thlah ṭheu.","title":"Jesuh That Dingin An Relcat (Mat 27.15-26 ; Luk 23.13-25 ; Joh 18.39—19.16)"},"7":{"text":"Culai ah Barabbas an timi, ralthawh laiah mi a rak thattu pa cu ral a thotu dang pawl thawn thawng ah an thlak."},"8":{"text":"Misenpi pawl cu an ra suak ih kumtin an tuah ṭheu vekin thawngtla suah ding cu Pilat hnenah an sut."},"9":{"text":"Pilat in, “Judah Siangpahrang hi lo thlah sak ningla nan duh maw?” tiah a sut."},"10":{"text":"Pilat in a hnenah Jesuh an peknak cu Puithiam upa pawl in Jesuh an nahsiik ruangah a si ti cu a thei keukeu."},"11":{"text":"Asinain Pilat in Barabbas sawn thlahter dingah puithiam upa pawl in misenpi cu an rak forhcia."},"12":{"text":"Pilat in a sut lala ih, “Cuti asile Judah siangpahrang nan timi pa hi ziangti in tuah so nan duh?” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Annih in, “Thinglamtah parah that aw!” tiah an au."},"14":{"text":"“Ziang sualnak so a tuah?” tiah Pilat cun a sut lala. Annih in, “Thinglamtah parah that ko aw!” tiah na sinsin in an au."},"15":{"text":"Pilat in misenpi lungkimnak tuah a duh ruangah an hrangah Barabbas a thlah. Cule Jesuh cu a thawiter ih thinglamtah parih that dingin an kut ah a pek."},"16":{"text":"Ralkap pawl in Jesuh cu Mangki bawipa ih tual ah an luhpi ih mipi dang pawl tla an ko.","title":"Ralkap Pawl In Jesuh An Hmuhsuam (Mat 27.27-31 ; Luk 19.2-3)"},"17":{"text":"Jesuh cu puan sen an sinter; hling in lukhuh an tuah ih a lu ah an khumter."},"18":{"text":"Cule salaam an pek ih, “Judah Siangpahrang, a nunkhua sau hram seh!” tiah an au."},"19":{"text":"A lu ah fungfek in an thawi, cil an phui, an ṭhilhṭhuam ih a hmai ah atu le atu an lu an kuun."},"20":{"text":"Cutiih an hmuhsuam ṭheh hnuah puansen an sintermi kha an hlit ih amah ih hnipuan an hrukter sal. Cule amah thawn thinglamtah parih khenbet mi pahnih tla in an hmuhsuam ve."},"33":{"text":"Sun laifangah cuih ram pumpuluk ah nazi pathum sung thimkhawzing a tlung.","title":"Jesuh A Thi (Mat 27.45-56 ; Luk 23.44-49 ; Joh 19.28-30)"},"34":{"text":"Zanlam nazi pathum ah Jesuh cu, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabakthani!” tiah napi in a au. A tican cu, “Ka Pathian, ka Pathian, ziangah so i tlansan?” tinak a si."},"35":{"text":"Cutawkih a ummi ṭhenkhat in an thei ih, “Ngaihnik uh, Elijah a ko a si hi!” tiah an ti."},"36":{"text":"Mi pakhat a va tlan vurvo ih puansia kha sabitti thur sungah a va ciah ih fung parah a ṭemcih hnuah Jesuh ih kaa ah a hun hnih; “Hngak hrihhnik uh! Thinglamtah par ihsin ṭhum dingah Elijah a rung maw rung lo kan zoh pei,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Jesuh cu napi in a au ih a hnuk a cat."},"38":{"text":"Cuvete in Biakinn puanzar cu a tlunlam ihsin a hnuailam tiang ṭhen hnih ah a tlek."},"39":{"text":"Thinglamtah hmai zawnih a dingtu ralbawipa in Jesuh a thih kha a hmuh tikah, “Hi pa hi Pathian Fapa ngaingai a si!” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Cutawkih nunau hrekkhat pawl cun lamhlat nawn in an cuan. Anmah tla cu Mari Magdalene, Jeim nauta sawn le Josef ih nu Mari, le Salome an si."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh kha Galilee ram a um laiah a rak thluntu pawl le a rak bawmtu pawl an si. Ralbawipa a ko ih, “Jesuh a thihnak a rei zo maw?” tiah a sut."},"45":{"text":"Jesuh a thi thla zo ti kha ralbawipa hnen ihsin a theih tikah Pilat in Jesuh ih ruang cu Josef a lakter."},"46":{"text":"Josef in puan nemte a lei ih Jesuh ruak cu thinglamtah par ihsin a ṭhum ih puan in a tuam hnuah lungkhermi thlaan ah a phum. Cule lungphengpi in thlaan ka cu a kharta."},"47":{"text":"Mari Magdalene le Josef nu Mari tla in a kiangin an zoh ve ih Jesuh ruak a retnak cu an hmu."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sabbath ni a cem hnuah Mari Magdalene, Jeim nu Mari le Salome in Jesuh ruak va culh dingah zihmui an lei.","title":"Jesuh A Thosal (Mat 28.1-8 ; Luk 24.1-12 ; Joh 20.1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Nipi zing, nisuak zawng ah thlaan ah an va feh."},"3":{"text":"Lamzin an feh phah ah, “Thlankhar lungphengpi teh zo in so in ṭhawn sak ding?” tiah pakhat le pakhat an sut aw."},"4":{"text":"Cuih lung cu lungpheng hlaipi a si. Cule an hun zoh tikah lungphengpi cu a rak ṭhawn aw zo kha an hmu."},"5":{"text":"Thlan sungah an vung lut ih tlangval pakhat puan rang sin in vorhlam kapih a to kha an hmu ih an phang ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"Anih in, “Nan thin phang hlah uh! An retnak hmun hi ra zoh hman uh."},"7":{"text":"Va feh uhla a dungthluntu pawl le Piter kha ‘Nan hmaiah Galilee ah a feh ding. Cutawkah a lo sim cia vekin nan hmu ding,’ tiah va sim uh,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cutiin an suak ih thlaan ihsi cun thinphang le tuksum in an tlan. An ṭih tuk ruangah zo hnen hmanah ziang hman an sim lo."},"9":{"text":"Nipi ni ah thihnak ihsin Jesuh a thawh hnuah a hmaisa bik ah Mari Magdalene hnenah a lang; Mari Magdalene cu a sung ihsin khuavang pasarih a dawisuahmi nunau kha a si. Nunau pawl cu Piter le a rualpi pawl hnenah an feh ih an theihmi thuhla cu a tawinak in an sim.","title":"MARKA THUTHANGṬHA NETNAK TAWI"},"10":{"text":"Mari Magdalene cu a feh ih a rualpi pawl a va sim. Cupawl cu Jesuh a thih ruangah mithi ngai in an ṭap rero. Cuih hnuah Jesuh amah rori in kumkhua rundamnak thu, thu nung le thu thianghlim cu nisuahnak ihsin nitlaknak tiang a dungthluntu pawl hmangin a than a si.]"},"11":{"text":"“Jesuh a nungsal zo, ka hmu a si!” tiah a sim tikah an zum lo."},"12":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh cu dungthluntu pahnih khawte lamih an feh laiah phun dangin an hnenah a lang.","title":"Dungthluntu Pahnih Hnenah Jesuh A Lang (Luk 24.13-35)"},"13":{"text":"An kir ih midang pawl tla an sim, asinain annih khal in an zum lo."},"14":{"text":"Neta bikah Jesuh cu dungthluntu hleikhat rawl an ei laiah an hnenah a lang. Zumnak an neih lo ruangah le amah a nungin a hmutu pawl an zum lo ih thinlung ruh an neih ruangah a kawk hai.","title":"Dungthluntu Hleikhat Hnenah Jesuh A Lang (Mat 28.16-20 ; Luk 24.36-49 ; Joh 20.19-23 ; Dung 1.6-8)"},"15":{"text":"Cule an hnenah, “Leilung khuazakip ah va feh uhla mi hmuahhmuah hnenah Thuthang ṭha va sim uh."},"16":{"text":"Zokhal sisehla a zum ih baptisma a co ahcun rundam a si ding. Asinain a zum lotu cu hnon a si ding."},"17":{"text":"A zumtu pawl cu mangbangza tuah theinak huham pek an si ding; ka hmin in ramhuai an dawi thei ding; ṭong thar in an ṭong ding;"},"18":{"text":"rul an kaih ah siseh, thihsii an in hmanah siseh, an zianghman a poi lo ding; mina parah an kut an suang ding ih mina cu an dam ding,” tiah a ti. ["},"19":{"text":"Bawipa Jesuh cu an hnenih thu a sim ṭheh hnuah vancungah laakso in a um ih Pathian vorhlam kapah a to.","title":"Vancung ah Jesuh A Kai (Luk 24.50-53 ; Dung 1.9-11)"},"20":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu pawl cu an feh ih khuazakip ah thu an sim; Bawipa cu an hnenah hna a ṭuan ih mangbangza an tuahmi in an thusim mi a dik a si, ti kha a langter.] ["}}}}},"42":{"info":{"name":"Luka","shortname":"Luk","abbr":[],"desc":"Luka nganmi thuthang ṭha"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa Theofilas, Mi tampi in kan lakih a cangmi thu pawl hi a ṭha thei tawpin an ngan."},"2":{"text":"An ngan tikah cuih thil a cangmi a hramthok ihsin mit in a hmutu pawl le cuih thu a simtu ih simmi vekin nganmi a si."},"3":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah kei khal in hi thuhla pawl hi a hramthok ihsin feltein ka zingzoi ṭheh zo ruangah a sangsangte in na hrangah ka ngan le a ṭha ding tiah ka ruat."},"4":{"text":"An lo sim le an lo zirh ciami thu hi tlamtlingzet le dikzet ih na theihnak dingah hi ca hi ka ngan a si."},"5":{"text":"Herod cu Judea Ram ih siangpahrang a si laiah, Abijah puithiam phun sungih a tel vemi puithiam Zekhariah a rak um. A nupi cu Elizabeth a si ih anih khal puithiam phun a si ve.","title":"Baptisma Petu Johan Suahnak"},"6":{"text":"An pahnih in Pathian mithmuh ah nuncan ṭha in an nung ih Bawipa ih daan le thupekmi pawl kha kimtein an thlun thluh."},"7":{"text":"Elizabeth cu a cin ruangah faate an nei lo; an nupa in an tarzet thlang."},"8":{"text":"Voikhat ah Zekhariah cu nitin a hnaṭuan caan a kim ih Biakinn sungah puithiam hna a ṭuan."},"9":{"text":"Puithiam pawl ih an thlun ṭheumi daan bangtuk in biakṭheng parih rimhmui ur dingah camcawhfung zuukin Zekhariah cu an hril. Curuangah Bawipa ih Biakinn sungah cun a vung lut."},"10":{"text":"Culai ahcun rimhmui ur caan a si ih senpi pawl cu Biakinn lengah thla an cam ciamco."},"11":{"text":"Vancungmi pakhat cu a hnenah a rung lang ih rimhmui urnak biakṭheng vorhlam kapah a ding."},"12":{"text":"Zekhariah in a hmuh tikah a thin a phang ih a ṭih."},"13":{"text":"Asinain vancungmi in, “Zekhariah, ṭih hlah! Pathian in na thlacamnak cu a thei zo ih na nupi Elizabeth in fapa a lo hrin ding. A hmin ah Johan na sak pei."},"14":{"text":"Cuih na fapa a suah tikah na lung a awi ngaingai ding ih midang tampi tla an lung a awizet ding."},"15":{"text":"Amah cu Bawipa ih mithmuh ah mi maksak ngaingai a si ding. Sabitti siseh, zu siseh a in lo ding. A suahthlak vete in Thlarau Thianghlim thawn a khat ding ih,"},"16":{"text":"Israel mi tampi tla Bawipa an Pathian hnenah a kirter sal ding."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa ih hmaiah a rak feh sungtu palai a si ding ih profet Elijah vekin a cakmi le hmual nei zetmi a si ding. Pale pawl ih thinlung tla an faale lamah a mer awter sal ding ih thu-ngai lomi pawl khal miding pawl ih thuruahdan lamzin ah a hruai kir sal ding. Bawipa ih hrangah Bawipa ih minung pawl a timtuah sak ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Zekhariah in vancungmi hnenah, “Na sim vek in a cang ngaingai ding ti ziangtinso ka theih ding? Kei hi patar ka si zo ih ka nupi khal a tarzet zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutikah vancungmi in, “Kei hi Gabriel ka si. Pathian hmaiih a ding ringringtu ka si ih Amah in hi thuṭha na hnenih rung sim dingah i thlah."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka thu simmi na zum lo khalle a tikcu a kim tikah cun ka thu simmi cu a kim ko ding. Hitiih na zum lo ruangah ṭong thei loin na um ding. Na hnenih ka thukammi a kimnak ni a thlen hlan lo kam khatte hman na ṭong thei nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cuih caan sung hmuahhmuah misenpi pawl in Zekhariah cu an hngak ringring ih ziangah Biakinn sungah cutik tiang lawmmam a rei a si pei tiah an khawruah a har."},"22":{"text":"Biakinn sung ihsin a ra suah tikih a ṭong thei lo kha an hmuh tikah Biakinn sungah langnak hmuhmi a nei a si, ti an thei. Kam khatte hman a ṭong thei lo ruangah a kut in a hmuh."},"23":{"text":"Biakinn sungih a hnaṭuan tikcu a cem tikah Zekhariah cu inn ah a tlung."},"24":{"text":"Tawkfang a rei tikah a nupi Elizabeth cu fa a vun ih thla nga sung cu lengah a suak lo."},"25":{"text":"Elizabeth in, “Neta bikah Bawipa in i bawm ih misenpi hmaiah ka ningzahnak cu i laksak zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Elizabeth ih favun a thlaruknak ah Pathian in vancungmi Gabriel cu Galilee ram Nazareth an timi khua ah a thlah.","title":"Jesuh Suahnak Ding Thuthan"},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang David ih tesinfa a si mi Josef thawn ṭhi aw dingih thukamnak a neimi fala hnenah thu pakhat sim dingin a thlah. Cuih fala hmin cu Mari a si."},"28":{"text":"Vancungmi cu a hnenah a ra ih, “Na parah daihnak um ko seh! Bawipa na hnenah a um ih thlawsuahnak tampi a lo pek a si,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cuih vancungmi ih thusimmi a theih tikah Mari cu a don a har ngaingai ih a ṭongmi ih tican cu ziang a si pei tiah khawruahhar in a um."},"30":{"text":"Cule vancungmi in, “Mari, ṭih hlah! Pathian mithmai ṭha na co a si."},"31":{"text":"Fa na vun ding ih fapa na hring ding. A hmin ah Jesuh na sak ding."},"32":{"text":"Mi maksak a si ding ih Cungnungbik Pathian ih Fapa tiah kawh a si ding. Amah cu Bawipa Pathian in a pu David bangtuk in siangpahrang ah a tuah ding ih,"},"33":{"text":"Jakob tesinfa pawl ih tlunah a kumkhua in siangpahrang a si ding. A uknak cu a cem dah lo ding,” tiah a sim."},"34":{"text":"Mari in vancungmi hnenah, “Kei cu fala him ka si. Cubangtuk cu ziangtinso a si thei ding?” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Vancungmi in, “Thlarau Thianghlim cu na hnenah a ra thleng ding ih Cungnungbik ih cahnak huham cu na parah a um ding. Curuangah na hrin dingmi fa cu fapa thianghlim a si ding ih Pathian Fapa tiah kawh a si ding."},"36":{"text":"Na sungkhat Elizabeth kha na thei a si lo maw? Fa a nei thei nawn lo tiah simrelmi a si naón a tarzet hnuah fa a vun ih atu-ah thlaruk a si zo."},"37":{"text":"Ziangtin a si tile Pathian ih tuah thei lomi zianghman a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Mari in, “Kei cu Bawipa ih salnu ka si. Na sim vek cun ka parah si ko seh,” tiah a ti. Cule vancungmi cun a fehsan."},"39":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Mari cu a tim a tuah ih Judea peng tlangpar khua ah zamrangte in a hung feh.","title":"Mari In Elizabeth A Leeng"},"40":{"text":"Cutawk a thlen tikah Zekhariah inn ah a lut ih Elizabeth cu cibai a buk."},"41":{"text":"Mari ih ṭongkam cu Elizabeth in a theih vete in a pum sungih naute cu a caang. Elizabeth cu Thlarau Thianghlim in a khat ih,"},"42":{"text":"ringzet in, “Nang cu nunau hmuahhmuah lakah a thlawsuak bikmi nunau na si. Na hrin dingmi fa khal hi thlawsuahmi fa a si!"},"43":{"text":"Ziangah so ka Bawipa ih nu in kei vek tla hi i hung leen duh?"},"44":{"text":"Ziangahtile na ṭong ka theih vete in ka pum sungih naute hi lungawi aipuang in a khir a si."},"45":{"text":"Bawipa in na hnenih a simmi thu hi na parah a kim taktak ding ti na ruat ih na lungawi daan ding hi a va mak ve!” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Mari in, “Ka thinlung in Bawipa cu a thangṭhat;"},"47":{"text":"Pathian i Runtu parah ka nunnak cu a lung a kimzet;"},"48":{"text":"Ziangahtile mi nauta a salnu hi hngilh loin i thei ringring a si. Atu thokin mi hmuahhmuah in mi thluasuak in ti ding,"},"49":{"text":"Ziangkimtithei Pathian in ka hrangih thil maksak a tuah zo ruangah hin. Amah ih hmin cu a thianghlim,"},"50":{"text":"Sankhat hnu sankhat amah a a ṭihzahtu pawl cu a zaangfah a si."},"51":{"text":"A baan thacak a hawi ih mi puarthau pawl cu an tumtahnak thawn a ṭhekdarh ṭheh."},"52":{"text":"Siangpahrang cakzet pawl kha, an lal tokham ihsin a ṭhum ih, mi nauta pawl a khaisaang a si."},"53":{"text":"Rilrawngmi pawl cu thil ṭha in a cawm ih, milian pawl cu kut lawngin a kirter."},"54":{"text":"Kan pupa pawl hnenih a thukamnak cu a kimter ih, a siahhlawh Israel bawm dingah a ra zo a si."},"55":{"text":"Abraham le a tesinfa pawl parah a kumkhua in zaangfah dingah a ciing ringring!” tiah a ti."},"56":{"text":"Mari cu Elizabeth hnenah thla thum hrawng a um hnuah a inn ah a tlung."},"57":{"text":"Elizabeth cu a hrin nithla a kim ih fapa a nei.","title":"Baptisma Petu Johan Suahnak"},"58":{"text":"Elizabeth parih a makmi Bawipa ih zaangfahnak cu a sungkhat le innhnen pawl hmuahhmuah in an thei ih an zatein an lungawipi."},"59":{"text":"Naute cu a suah hnu ni sarih ah a serhtan dingah an ra ih a pa hmin suangin Zekhariah tiah a hmin sak an tum."},"60":{"text":"Asinain a nu in, “A si lo, a hmin cu Johan a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"61":{"text":"Annih in, “Nan sungte lakah cuvek hmin a neitu zohman an um si lo!” tiah an ti."},"62":{"text":"Cule a pa cu kutzung hmuh in an biak ih a fapa hmin sak a duhmi kha an sut."},"63":{"text":"Zekhariah in ca ngannak cahnah a dil ih, “A hmin cu Johan a si,” tiah a ngan. An zatein an lau ih an mang a bang ngaingai."},"64":{"text":"Cu ṭheh vete in Zekhariah ih hmur le lei cu an nung sal ih ṭong thei sal in Pathian a thangṭhat."},"65":{"text":"An innhnen pawl cu an thin a phang zet; cuih thu cu Judea tlangpar ram hmuahhmuah ah a thang ṭheh."},"66":{"text":"Cuih thu a theitu hmuahhmuah in an thinlung ciar in an rak ngaihtuah fingfing ih, “Hi naute cu ziangbangtuk minung ah hung cang pei maw!” tiah an ti cio. Ziangahtile Bawipa ih huham cu naute parah a um ti kha a fiangin an thei."},"67":{"text":"Johan ih pa Zekhariah cu Thlarau Thianghlim in a khat ih hiti in Pathian thu a sim:","title":"Zekhariah Thusimmi"},"68":{"text":"“Israel ih Pathian Bawipa cu thangṭhat uhsi; A minung pawl bawm dingah le, luatter dingah a ra zo."},"69":{"text":"Kan hrangah a mak zetmi Runtu a suakter zo; Amah cu Bawipa ih siahhlawh David ih tesinfa a si."},"70":{"text":"Khuahlan a profet thianghlim pawl sung ihsin thu in kam cia zo;"},"71":{"text":"In huatu pawl kut sungin le kan ral pawl kut sung ihsin humhim dingah."},"72":{"text":"Kan pupa pawl hnenah ‘Zaangfah thinpemnak ka nei ding ih, ka thukamnak thianghlim cu ka hngilh lo ding,’ tiah a ti."},"73":{"text":"Kan pu Abraham hnenah, ‘Nan ral pawl kut ihsin ka lo run ding; ṭihnak zianghman um loin ka hna nan ṭuan ding;","merge":"74"},"75":{"text":"Nan nunsung hmuahhmuah ka hmaiah mi ding le Mi thianghlim nan si ding,’ tiah siatcam in thukamnak a rak tuah."},"76":{"text":"“Ka fa, nang cu a saang bik Pathian ih profet tiah kawh na si ding. Nang cu Bawipa ih lamzin rak sial saktu dingah a hmaiah na rak feh ding;"},"77":{"text":"A minung pawl cu an sual ngaidamnak in rundamnak an ngah ding a si, tiih simtu dingah."},"78":{"text":"Kan Pathian cu mi zaangfahtu le mi nunnem a si ruangah, Rundamnak zing khawtleu cu kan parah a tlaangter ding;"},"79":{"text":"Thimnak le thihnak phenthlam hnuai ih a ummi pawl hrangah Vancung ihsin a tlaang ding ih, remnak lamzinah in fehter ding,” tiah a ti."},"80":{"text":"Naute cu taksa in siseh thlarau in siseh a ṭhang ih a cak vivo. Israel mi hnenah zapi hmuh ih a lang hlansung cuih ramṭhing ahcun a um."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih caanah Siangpahrang Augustas a um ih a ukmi Rom ramsung hmuahhmuah ah mipum siar ih hmin lak thluh dingin thu a pek.","title":"Jesuh Suahnak (Mat 1.18-25)"},"2":{"text":"Hi mipum siarnak hmaisa bik caanah hin Kuirinias cu Siria ram uktu a si."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah zozo khal mipum siar ih hminkhum dingah anmah ih suahnak khua ciarah an feh."},"4":{"text":"Josef cu Galilee ram Nazareth khua ihsin Siangpahrang David suahnak Judea ram Bethlehem khua ah a feh. Josef cu David tesinfa a si ruangah cutawk khua ih a fehnak cu a si."},"5":{"text":"Mipum siar hminkhum dingah cun ṭhit dingih a ham ciami Mari thawn an feh. Mari cu nau a pai ih,"},"6":{"text":"Bethlehem khua an um laiah nau hrin tikcu a kim."},"7":{"text":"A fatir ah fapa a hring ih puan in an tuam hnuah rannung rawl einak kuang sungah an hlum; ziangahtile riahbuk ah riahnak khaan an co lo."},"8":{"text":"Cutawk ram sungah cun tuukhal ṭhenkhat pawl cu zanah an tuu pawl kil in an um.","title":"Tuukhal Pawl Le Vancungmi Pawl"},"9":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi pakhat cu an hnenah a lang ih Bawipa ih sunlawinak cu an parah a rung tleu. An ṭih ngaingai;"},"10":{"text":"asinain vancungmi cun, “ṭih hlah uh! Nan hrangah thuthang ṭha ka run keng; cuih thuthang ṭha cu mi hmuahhmuah hrangah lungawinak ngaingai a si."},"11":{"text":"Tuih zan rori ah David khawsungah nanmah Runtu Bawi Khrih a suak zo."},"12":{"text":"Cumi hminsinnak ah hiti in a si ding: naute cu puan in an tuam ding ih rannung rawl einak kuang sungah an hlum nan hmu ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Hmakhatteah cuih vancungmi thawn hmun khatah vancung ihsin vancungmi burpi an rung lang ih Pathian thangṭhatnak hla an sak."},"14":{"text":"“A saang bik vanah khin Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh; A duhdawtmi minung pawl umnak leilungah hin remnak leeng ko seh,” tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"Vancungmi cu vanih an kirsal tikah tuukhal pawl in, “Bethlehem khua ah va feh in Bawipa ih in simmi cu va zohhnik uhsi,” tiah pakhat le pakhat an ti aw."},"16":{"text":"Cuticun manhlap zetin an feh ih Mari le Josef le rannung rawl einak kuang sungih a itmi naute cu an va hmu."},"17":{"text":"Tuukhal pawl in naute an hmuh tikah vancungmi in cuih naute thuhla an simmi cu an hnenah an sim."},"18":{"text":"Tuukhal pawl ih simmi thu a theitu hmuahhmuah cu an mang a bang ngaingai."},"19":{"text":"Mari in hi thu hmuahhmuah cu ṭhazet in a ciing ringring ih thuk zetin a ruat."},"20":{"text":"Cule tuukhal pawl cu an kir ih an hmuhmi le an theihmi pawl ruangah Pathian thangṭhatnak hla sak phah in an tlung. Vancungmi ih a rak sim cia vekin a kim ṭheh a si."},"21":{"text":"Zarh khat hnuah naute cu a serhtan caan a kim tikah Jesuh tiah a hmin an sak. Cuih hmin cu a nuih a vun hlan ihsin vancungmi in a rak sim ciami hmin a si.","title":"Jesuh Hmin An Sak"},"22":{"text":"Moses daan sungih a um bangtuk in thianter awknak hrangih tuah ṭulmi pawl kha Josef le Mari in an tuah ding tikcu a thleng. Curuangah naute cu Bawipa hnenih hlan dingin Jerusalem ah an fehpi.","title":"Biakinn Ah Jesuh An Fehpi."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa ih daan cabu sungah, “Fatir mipa pohpoh cu Bawipa ih hnenah nan hlan pei,” tiah ngan ciami a um."},"24":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Bawipa ih pekmi daan sungih a um vekin thuro khuah khat a si lole laileng note pahnih thawn thawinak pe dingah an fehpi."},"25":{"text":"Cule Simeon an ti mipa pakhat cu Jerusalem khua ah a rak um. Amah cu mi ṭha le Pathian a ṭihzahtu a si ih Israel mi hneemnak an ngahnak ding kha a hngak ringringtu a si. Thlarau Thianghlim a hnenah a um ih,"},"26":{"text":"“Bawipa ih tiammi Messiah na hmuh ngah hlanah cun na thi lo ding,” tiah fiangtein a phuan."},"27":{"text":"Thlarau hruainak in Simeon cu Biakinn sungah a feh tikah daan vekin a hrangih tuah dingah Jesuh cu a nu le a pa in Biakinn sungah an ratpi."},"28":{"text":"Simeon in naute cu a ṭaangah a cawi ih Pathian a thangṭhat,"},"29":{"text":"“Bawipa, tuihsun ah hin na thukammi cu na kimter ih, Na salpa cu daitein a nunnak ni na liamter thei thlang a si."},"30":{"text":"Na rundamnak cu ka mit rori in ka hmu zo;"},"31":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah mit hmuh ih na timtuahmi rundamnak cu!"},"32":{"text":"Cuih rundamnak cu Zentail mi hnenah na lamzin langtertu tleunak a si ih, Na minung Israel mi pawl hnenah sunlawinak thlengtertu a si,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Simeon ih ṭongmi cu naute nu le pa in an theih tikah an mang a bang ngaingai."},"34":{"text":"Cutikah Simeon cun thlawsuah a pek hai ih a nu Mari hnenah, “Hi naute cu Israel mi lakah mi tampi tluknak dingah le mi tampi tungdingtu dingah Pathian ih hrilmi a si. Amah hi mitampi in an engtaimi le Pathian hnenin a rami hmuhsaknak mak a si ding ih,"},"35":{"text":"cutiih an relsiat ruangah anmah thinlung sungih thuthup pawl an neihmi langtertu ah a cang ding. Cule nangmah khal a hriammi ralnam ih sun vekin riahsiat ninghannak in na thinlung a lo sun ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Anna an timi nunau profet pakhat a um ih amah cu nuhmei a si ih Asher hrin Fanuel ih fanu a si. Kum sarih sung lawng pasal a nei ih,"},"37":{"text":"amah cu kum sawmriat le kum li a si. Nitin Biakinn ah a um ih a sun a zan in Pathian a biak ih rawl-ul in thla a cam ringringtu a si."},"38":{"text":"Culaifang ah a ra thleng ve ih Pathian a thangṭhat ngaingai. Cule Pathian in Jerusalem a luatter ding a si ti ih a hngaktu pawl hmuahhmuah hnenah naute thu cu a sim ciamco."},"39":{"text":"Josef le Mari in Bawipa ih daanih a fialmi vekin tuah ṭulmi pawl an tuah ṭheh hnu ah Galilee ram Nazareth khua an inn ah an tlung.","title":"Nazareth Ah Jesuh An Kirpi"},"40":{"text":"Naute cu a ṭhang vivo ih a cak ngaingai. Amah cu fimnak in a khat ih Pathian thlawsuahnak a parah a um."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh ih nu le pa cu kumtinte Lantak Puai ah Jerusalem ah an feh ṭheu.","title":"Nauhak Jesuh Cu Biakinn Sungah A Um"},"42":{"text":"Jesuh kum hleihnih a kim tikah an daan vekin puai ahcun an feh."},"43":{"text":"An puai a cem tikah inn ah an tlung, asinain nauhak pa Jesuh cu Jerusalem ah a taangta. A nu le a pa in cumi cu an thei lo;"},"44":{"text":"mizapi lakah a tlung ve hmang tiah an ruat. Sun nihlawh an feh hnuah an sungkhat le rualpi pawl lakah an hawl vivo."},"45":{"text":"Asinain an hmu thotho lo; curuangah amah hawl in Jerusalem ah an kir sal."},"46":{"text":"A ni thumnak ah Biakinn sungah an hmu. Judah mi zirhtu saya pawl an tokhawm ih an thu ngai phah in thu khal a sut phah rero."},"47":{"text":"Thu a theih daan le fim zetih a thu leh daan an hmuh tikah a theitu pawl cu an mang a bangzet."},"48":{"text":"A nu le a pa in cutawkih Jesuh an hmuh tikah an lau an khawruah a har ngaingai ih a nu in, “Ka fapa, ziangah so hi bangtuk hin in tuah? Na pa thawn awloksong in kan lo hawl rero!” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ziangah so in hawl duh rero? Ka Pa ih inn ah um ding ka si, ti nan thei lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"50":{"text":"Asinain cutiih a thu lehnak cu a tican an thei lo."},"51":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh cu a nu le a pa thawn Nazareth ah an kir ih an thu ngai in a um. A nu in hi thuhla hmuahhmuah cu a thinlung ah feltein a ciing ringring."},"52":{"text":"Jesuh cu taksa in siseh, fimnak in siseh a ṭhang vivo ih Pathian hmai le minung hmaiah mithmai ṭha a ngah."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rom siangpahrang Tiberias ih ram a uknak kum hleinga kumah Pontius Pilat cu Judea ram uktu Mangki bawi a si ih Herod cu Galilee ram uktu a si. Cule Herod ih u Filip cu Iturea le Trakhonitis ram uktu a si; Lisanias cu Abilene ram uktu a si ih,","title":"Baptisma Petu Johan Ih Thusimnak (Mat 3.1-12 ; Mar 1.1-8 ; Joh 1.19-28)"},"2":{"text":"Annas le Kaiafas cu Puithiam Saang an si. Cuih tikcu caan hrawngah ramṭhing ih um Zekhariah ih fapa Johan hnenah Pathian ṭongkam a thleng."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Johan cu Jordan Tiva kiangkap ram hmuahhmuah a tlawng vivo ih, “Nan sual sir uhla baptisma lak uh; cule Pathian in nan sualnak a lo ngaidam ding,” tiah thu a sim vivo."},"4":{"text":"Profet Isaiah ih ṭong cu cabu sungah ngan in a um. Cuih cabu sungah: “Mi pakhat cu ramṭhing ah a au ih, ‘Bawipa ih lamzin kha rem uh, a fehnak lamzin cu ngilter uh."},"5":{"text":"Horkuam hmuahhmuah silhkhat uhla, tlang le mual hmuahhmuah in rawnter uh; Lam kel hmuahhmuah dingter uhla, a bingbo mi hmuahhmuah in rualter uh."},"6":{"text":"Miphun zakip in Pathian ih runnak an hmu ding,’ tiah a ti,”","ref":"Isai 40.3-5 tiin a um."},"7":{"text":"Mitampi cu Johan ih baptisma lak dingah a hnenah an ra. Johan cun, “Nannih rul pawl! A ra thleng cing dingmi Pathian ih hremnak ihsin nan luat thei ding tiah zoso a lo sim?"},"8":{"text":"Nan sualnak nan sir awk ahcun nan thil tuahmi in langter uh. Abraham kha kan pu a si pam tiah ti rero hlah uh. Fiangtein ka lo sim: Pathian in hi lungto hman hi Abraham ih tesinfa ah a cangter thei a si."},"9":{"text":"Thingkung pawl a hram ihsin haunak dingah hreitlung retcia a si zo. Rahṭha a rah lomi thingkung cu an hau ding ih meisa sungah an paih ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah mipi in, “Cuti asile ziangtinso kan um ding?” tiah an sut."},"11":{"text":"Anih in, “Angki zun hnih a neitu in zun khat cu a nei lotu hnenah ṭhen seh; rawl a neitu in a nei lotu kha hlawm seh,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Siahkhongtu ṭhenkhat pawl Johan ih baptisma lak dingah an ra ih, “Sayapa, kannih pawl ziangso kan tuah ding?” tiah an sut."},"13":{"text":"Anih in, “Nan khon ding zat hnakih tam deuh in va la hlah uh,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Ralkap ṭhenkhat pawl khal in, “Kannih teh? Ziangtin so kan tuah ding?” tiah an ra sut ve. An hnenah cun, “Zo ih hnen hmanin hranhram in paisa va lak hlah uh; thuphan in zohman sual va puh hlah uh. Nan thlahlawh zatah nan lungkim uh,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in ruahsannak an nei ciamco ih Johan cu Messiah a si pei maw, tiah an mangbangin an ruat fingfing."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah Johan in, “Kei cun tidai in baptisma ka lo pek. Asinain mi pakhat kei hnakih tum sawn a ra ding. Kei cu a kedam hri phoih saktu ding hman ka tlak lo. Anih cun Thlarau Thianghlim le meisa in baptisma a lo pek ding."},"17":{"text":"Fang seepnak ṭangṭa a keng ih fang pawl a seep ding. Fangngai cu a cuam sungah ṭhatein a ret thluh ding, asinain a hii pawl cu a mit dah lomi meisa sungah a ur ding,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Johan cun Thuthang ṭha cu mipi hnenah a phunphun in a sim ih an ziaza thleng dingah a forh vivo."},"19":{"text":"Asinain Mangki bawi Herod cu a naupa ih nupi Herodias a ṭhit ih thil ṭha lo dangdang tla a tuah ruangah Johan in a kawk ṭheu."},"20":{"text":"Cutikah Herod in Johan cu thawngah a thlak ih cuticun thil ṭha lo sinsin a tuah."},"21":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah baptisma an lak ṭheh hnuah Jesuh khal a lak ve. 1.12-13)"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkah ni sawmli sung Satan in a hniksak. Cuih sung hmuahhmuah zianghman a ei lo ruangah a netnak ahcun a ril a rawng ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Satan in Jesuh cu, “Pathian Fapa na si ahcun hi lungto hi sang ah cangter aw,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ca Thianghlim in ‘Milai nunnak hi rawl lawngin a si lo,’ a ti,” tiah a sawn.","ref":"Daan 8.3"},"5":{"text":"Cule Satan in a hun fehpi ih mitṭhepkar ah leilung tlun ram hmuahhmuah a hmuh."},"6":{"text":"“Hi leilung parih thuneihnak le lennak hmuahhmuah hi nangmah ka lo pe ding. Ka ta an si ṭheh ih ka duhmi hnenah ka pe thei."},"7":{"text":"Ka hmaiah kuun in i biak ahcun a zatein na ta an si ṭheh ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ca Thianghlim in ‘Bawipa na Pathian na biak pei ih Amah lawng na rian pei,’ a ti,” tiah a sawn.","ref":"Daan 6.13"},"9":{"text":"Cule Satan in Jesuh cu Jerusalem ah a fehpi ih Jerusalem Biakinn zim ah a ret ih, “Pathian Fapa na si ahcun hitawk ihsin dawp aw."},"10":{"text":"Ziangahtile Ca Thianghlim in, ‘Nangmah a lo kilkhawitu dingah Pathian in a vancungmi pawl a fial ding,’ a ti a si."},"11":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Ca Thianghlim sungah, ‘An kut in an lo cawi ding ih na ke lungto ah na khawng aw lo ding,’ ti khal in a um a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Saam 91.12"},"12":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh cun, “Ca Thianghlim in ‘Bawipa na Pathian cu va hniksak hlah,’ a ti,” tiah a let.","ref":"Daan 6.16"},"13":{"text":"Satan in Jesuh cu a phunphun in sual a forh ṭheh hnuah caan malte sung a feh santa."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh cu Galilee ah a kir ih Thlarau Thianghlim huham cu a hnenah a um. Cuih ram hmuahhmuah ah a hmin a thang ṭheh.","title":"Jesuh In Galilee Ah Hnaṭuan a Thok (Mat 4.12-17 ; Mar 1.14-15)"},"15":{"text":"Sinakok ah thu a zirh ih mi hmuahhmuah in an thangṭhat."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh cu a rak tuallennak hmun Nazareth khua ah a feh ih amah ih daan vekin Sabbath ni ah sinakok ah a feh. Ca Thianghlim siar dingah a ding ih,","title":"Nazareth Mi In A Thu An Pom Lo (Mat 13.53-58 ; Mar 6.1-6)"},"17":{"text":"profet Isaiah cazual kha an pek. Cuih cazual cu a pharh ih:"},"18":{"text":"“Bawipa ih Thlarau cu ka parah a um, Ziangahtile mifarah hnenih Thuthang ṭha sim dingah hriakculh in i hril zo. Sal taangmi pawl hnenih luatnak thu sim dingah le Mitcaw in khua an hmuh thei salnak dingah i thlah. Hremmi pawl luatter dingah le,"},"19":{"text":"Bawipa in a minung pawl a runnak ding tikcu a ra thleng zo, ti than dingah i thlah a si,” tiih ngannak hmun kha a siar."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in a siarmi cazual cu a zual sal ih a kiltu ih kutah a pek ih a to. A ra pumkhawmmi hmuahhmuah in Jesuh cu mitṭhep loin an zoh."},"21":{"text":"Cule anih in, “Ka siarmi nan rak theih vekin hi Ca Thianghlim sungih nganmi cu tuihsun ah a kim a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Hmualnei zet ih a ṭongmi kha an theih tikah an thinlung ah a lutzet ih mak an ti ngaingai. “Hi pa hi Josef fapa a si lo maw si?” an ti."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “ṭongṭhimnak ih ‘Sibawipa, nangmah le nangmah damter aw he!’ timi kha in ṭongsan ding ti fiangtein ka thei. Cuih tlunah ‘Kapernaum khua ih na tuahmi thil pawl tla na khua ah hin tuah ve aw,’ tiah in ti ding."},"24":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Profet cu amah ih khua ah sunloih a si dah lo."},"25":{"text":"“Ka simmi hi ngai uh: Elijah sanah kum thum le a hrek sung ruah a sur lo ih ram pumpuluk ah paampi a tlun laiah khan Israel ram sungah nuhmei an tamzet a si."},"26":{"text":"Asinain cuih nuhmei pawl hnenah Elijah cu thlah a si lo; Sidon ram Zarefath khua ih nuhmei nu hnen lawngah thlah a si."},"27":{"text":"Cule profet Elisha san laiah khan Israel ram sungih a ummi mitampi cu phaarnat in an na; asinain midang zohman damnak an ngah lo; Siria mi Naaman lawng a dam a si,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cumi cu sinakok ih a ra pumkhawmmi pawl in an theih tikah an thin a heng ngaingai."},"29":{"text":"An zatein an pok ih Jesuh cu an khua ihsin an dirhsuak hnuah an khua ih tlangzim tiang an hruai ih khaam ihsin tuul thlak an tum."},"30":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh cu miruul lak ihsin a feh hlo."},"31":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu Galilee peng Kapernaum khua ah a feh ih Sabbath ni ah thu a zirh.","title":"Ramhuai Ih Polhmi (Mat 1.21-25)"},"32":{"text":"A thuzirh zia an hmuh tikah hmualnei zetih a zirh ruangah an mang a bang ngaingai."},"33":{"text":"Cuih sinakok ah ramhuai ih polh mi, ramhuai thlarau neitu, pakhat a um. Cupa cu ring zetin a au ih,"},"34":{"text":"“Nazareth Jesuh, ziangti ih tuah so in duh? Kanmah siatsuah dingah maw na rat? Zo na si ti ka lo thei: Pathian tirhfung thianghlim na si,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Daite in um! Hi pa sung ihsin suak aw,” tiah thu a pek. Ramhuai cun mizapi hmaiah mipa cu a thluk ih a parah zianghman siatsuahnak tuah lo tein a suak."},"36":{"text":"Cutikah mipi pawl cu an mang a bang tuk lawmmam ih pakhat le pakhat, “Hi pa ih ṭongka cu a va mak so! Thu neizet le huham nei zetin ramhuai pawl tla thu a pek ih a suahter,” tiah an ti aw."},"37":{"text":"Cule Jesuh thuhla cu cuih ramsung khuazakipah a thang ṭheh."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh cu sinakok ihsin a suak ih Simon inn ah a feh. Simon ih pizon cu khawsiknat in a rak na ih cuih thu cu Jesuh an sim.","title":"Mi Tampi A Damter (Mat 8.14-17 ; Mar 1.29-34)"},"39":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu a ihkhun kiangah a ding ih a khawsiknat cu dam dingin thu a pek. Hmakhatte-ah a dam; a tho ih anmah pawl cu a tuamhlawm."},"40":{"text":"Ni a tlak hnuah natnak phunphun a tuartu pawl cu an rualpi pawl in Jesuh hnenah an rak hruai. A nami pawl ih lu parah a kut a suan ih an natnak ihsin a damter thluh."},"41":{"text":"Mitampi sung ihsin khawsia pawl cun, “Nang cu Pathian Fapa na si!” tiah au phah in an suak. Sikhalsehla Jesuh in khawsia pawl cu ṭong lo dingin thu a pek, ziangahtile Messiah a si kha an thei."},"42":{"text":"Khua a hung vang ih Jesuh cu khawsung ihsin a pok ih ramṭhing ah a va feh. Mi in an hawl ciamco ih an hmuh tikah, “In fehsan hram hlah aw,” tiah an leem.","title":"Jesuh In Sinakok Ah Thu A Sim (Mar 1.35-39)"},"43":{"text":"Asinain an hnenah, “Pathian Uknak Thuthang ṭha cu khua dangdang khal ah ka sim a ṭul hrimhrim a si, ziangahtile cumi tuah dingah Pathian ih thlahmi ka si,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"Cutiin Judea ram sungih sinakok ahcun thu a sim vivo."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Voikhat ah Jesuh cu Gennesaret Tili kapah a ding ih culaiah Pathian thu a simmi ngai duh ah misenpi cun amah naih an cuh aw ciamco.","title":"Kawh Hmaisa Bik Dungthlun Pawl (Mat 4.18-22 ; Mar 1.16-20)"},"2":{"text":"Culai ah Jesuh in titlang ih lawng pahnih an hrenmi kha a hmu. Ngakaitu pawl cu lawng sung ihsin an suak ih an sur pawl an kholh rero."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng pakhat deuh sungah a lut; cuih lawng cu Simon ih ta a si; cule lawng cu titlang ihsin a hlatnak deuh ah ṭhawn dingin a fial. Cuih lawng sungah Jesuh cu a to ih misenpi pawl cu a zirh hai."},"4":{"text":"Thusim a ṭheh tikah Simon hnenah, “Ti thuknak lamah na lawng hi ṭhawn awla na rualpi pawl thawn nan sur cu vun vorhhnik uh,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Simon in, “Bawipa, taima zetin zanvarte kan vorh naón zianghman kan awk lo. Sikhalsehla vorh uh, in ti a si ahcun kan vorh a si pei cu,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Sur cu an vun vorh ih nga tam ngaingai an awk ih an sur tiangin a tlek ṭhehzik."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah lawng dangih an rualpi pawl kha, “In ra bawm uh,” tiah an kut an hei zaap. An ra ih an lawng pahnih cu nga khattein an ret ih an lawng cu a pil zikte."},"8":{"text":"Cumi cu Simon in a hmuh tikah Jesuh ih khuk kiangah a khuk a bilh ih Jesuh hnenah cun, “Bawipa, i fehsan hram aw; ziangahtile kei hi misual ka si!” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Amah le a rualpi pawl cu nga tam ngaingai an awh ruangah an mang a bang ngaingai."},"10":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in amah thawn nga a kaitu Zebedi ih fapa Jeim le Johan khal an mang a bang ve. Jesuh in Simon cu, “Na thin phang hlah; atu thokin minung kaitu na si ding,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"An lawng pawl cu ti kapah an dinter ih an thil hmuahhmuah fehsan in Jesuh cu an thlun."},"12":{"text":"Voikhat ah Jesuh cu phaarnat a tuartu pa pakhat ih umnak khua ah a thleng. Cupa cun Jesuh a hmuh tikah a hmaiah a bok ih, “Bawipa, na duh ahcun i thiangter thei a si,” tiah a dil.","title":"Jesuh In Mipa Pakhat A Damter (Mat 8.1-4 ; Mar 1.40-45)"},"13":{"text":"Jesuh in a kut in a tham hnuah, “Ka lo thiangter duh, thiang thlang aw,” tiah a ti. Hmakhatteah a natnak cu a dam."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Zohman va sim hlah, asinain va feh vurvo awla puithiam in lo zohseh; cule na dam ti kha mi hmuahhmuah ih an lo hmuhnak dingah Moses daan vekin thawinak va pe aw,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh thuhla cu hmun kipah a thang sinsin, mi in an pan sinsin ih a thu simmi an ngai; cule an natnak khal a damter."},"16":{"text":"Cuih hnuah misenpi hnen ihsin feh tahratin hlimphirnak hmunah amah lawng thla a cam ṭheu."},"17":{"text":"Nikhat ah Jesuh cu thu a zirh rero laiah Jerusalem khua le Judea ram le Galilee ramih khawkip ihsin a rami Farasi le Daanthiam ṭhenkhat pawl khal an ra to ve. Mina damter theinak Bawipa ih huham cu Jesuh parah a um.","title":"Jesuh In Mizengpa A Damter (Mat 9.1-8 ; Mar 2.1-12)"},"18":{"text":"Culai ah mizengpa pakhat cu a ihphah thawn laangin an rak zawn ih Jesuh hmaiih vun ret dingah inn sungah luhpi an tum."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mi an tamtuk ruangah an fehpi theinak ding lamzin a um lo. Curuangah inn parah an kaipi ih diphun bauh hnuah misenpi lak Jesuh hmai rori-ah cun a ihphah thawn an vun thlak."},"20":{"text":"Zumnak an neihzia kha Jesuh in a hmuh tikah mizengpa hnenah cun, “Ka rual, na sualnak cu ngaithiam a si zo,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Daanthiam pawl le Farasi pawl cun, “Pathian thangsiatnak hi bangtuk a ṭong theitu milai cu ziangvek milai so a si? Pathian pakhat lawng sual ngaithiam theitu a si,” tiah pakhat le pakhat an ti aw."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh in an ruahmi cu a thei ih an hnenah, “Hi bangtuk in ziangah so nan ruah?"},"23":{"text":"‘Na sualnak hi ngaithiam a si zo,’ ti maw, a si lole ‘Tho awla feh aw,’ tiso a ol sawn?"},"24":{"text":"Mi Fapa hi leilung tlunah hin sualnak a ngaithiam thei a si, ti nan hnenah ka langter ding,” tiah a ti. Cule mizengpa cu, “Ka lo sim: Tho aw! Na ihphah la awla na inn ah tlung aw,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Hmakhatteah mizengpa cu mipi hmaiah cun a tho ih a ihphah cu a lak ih Pathian thangṭhat phah in a inn ah a tlung."},"26":{"text":"Mipi cu an mang a bang ngaingai! ṭih phah in Pathian cu an thangṭhat ih, “Ziangbangtuk khawruahharza thil so tuihsun ih kan hmuh mi hi!” tiah an rel ciamco."},"27":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh cu a feh ih siahkhongtu Levi an timi pa a zung sungih a to kha a hmu. Jesuh in a hnenah, “I thlun aw,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh In Levi A Ko (Mat 9.9-13 ; Mar 2.13-17)"},"28":{"text":"Levi cu a tho ih ziang hmuahhmuah taanta in Jesuh cu a thlun."},"29":{"text":"Cule Levi in a inn ah rawl einak puai tumpi Jesuh hrangah a tuah ih a sawmmi pawl lakah cun siahkhongtu pawl le midang tampi an tel."},"30":{"text":"Farasi mi ṭhenkhat le Daanthiam ṭhenkhat anmah ih bu sungtel pawl cu Jesuh dungthluntu pawl hnenah an phunzai. “Ziangah so siahkhongtu le misual tla thawn rawl nan ei ih ti nan in tlang?” tiah an sut."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh in, “A harhdammi pawl in sibawi an ṭul lo, a nami pawl lawngin an ṭul."},"32":{"text":"Miding pawl ko dingah ka ra lo; misual pawl an sual sir awter dingah ka ra a si,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat in Jesuh hnenah, “Johan dungthluntu pawl cu rawl an ul ṭheu ih thla khal an cam ṭheu; cule Farasi pawl ih dungthluntu pawl tla in cuvekin an tuah ve ṭheu. Asinain na dungthluntu pawl cu an duhduh in an in an ei,” tiah an ti.","title":"Rawl Ulh Thu (Mat 9.14-17 ; Mar 2.18-22)"},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Mopuai a ra zawhtu pawl cu mopa an hnenih a um sungah rawl loin an um ding maw?” tiah a sut. “An um lo ding!"},"35":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mopa an hnen ihsin laak a si caan a ra thleng ding ih cutikah rawl cu an ul leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh in an hnenah hiti in thuṭhimnak a sim, “Zohman in hnipuan hlun belhnak dingah hnipuan thar an thlek dah keel lo. An thlek a si ahcun hnipuan thar cu a tlek laklawh ding ih hnipuan hlunih an belh tikah a kaih aw fawn lo ding."},"37":{"text":"Cule zohman in sabitti thar cu savun thawl hlun sungah an thun lo ding, ziangahtile sabitti thar in thawl hlun cu a pahkuai ding ih sabitti cu a bung lak ding ih thawl khal cu a siat ṭheh ding."},"38":{"text":"Cu hnak cun sabitti thar kha savun thawl thar sungah thun sawn ding a si."},"39":{"text":"Cun sabitti hlun an in hnuah zohman in sabitti thar an in duh lo. ‘A hlunmi a ṭha sawn,’ an ti,” tiah a sim."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu Sabbath ni ah lo lakin a feh. A dungthlun pawl in sangvut vui an zuut phah ih an zaphak sungih an nuai hnuah a fang cu an ei.","title":"Sabbath Ni Thu Thusuhnak (Mat 12.1-8 ; Mar 2.23-28)"},"2":{"text":"Farasi mi ṭhenkhat pawl in, “Kan Daan in Sabbath ni ah tuah lo ding, timi cu ziangah so nan tuah?” tiah an sut."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “David le a ralkap pawl an ril a rawn tikah David in ziang a tuah ti kha nan siar dah lo maw?"},"4":{"text":"Pathian inn sungah lut tahratin Pathian hnenih pekmi sang a lak ih a ei; cule a ralkap pawl tla a pek a si. Puithiam pawl siar lo cuih saang ei cu kan Daan in a duh lo a si kha!” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in a netnak ah, “Milai Fapa cu Sabbath ih Bawi a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Voikhat ah Sabbath ni ah Jesuh cu sinakok ah a feh ih thu a zirh. Cunah cun a kut vorhlam a zengmi pa pakhat a um.","title":"Kutzeng Pa Ih Thu (Mat 12.9-14 ; Mar 3.1-6)"},"7":{"text":"Farasi mi ṭhenkhat pawl le Daanthiam ṭhenkhat pawl in Jesuh ih sual hawl an duh ruangah Sabbath ni ahhin a damter pei maw, tiah cat loin an zoh."},"8":{"text":"An ruahnak cu Jesuh in a theih ruangah mipa cu, “Tho awla hmailam ahhin ra suak aw,” tiah a ti. Kutzeng pa cu a tho ih hmaiah cun a ra ding."},"9":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in an hnenah, “Thu ka lo sut hai ding: Kan Daan in Sabbath ni ih tuah dingah ziangso in on? Mi bom ding maw, mi tuahmawh ding so? Mi nunnak humhim ding maw, siatsuah ding so?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule cu pawl cu a zohhliah vivo hnuah kutzeng pa hnenah cun, “Na kut hawi aw,” a ti. A kut cu a hawi ngaingai ih a dam ngah."},"11":{"text":"Farasi le Daanthiam pawl cu an thin a heng tuk ih Jesuh an siatsuah theinak dingah thu an ron aw ciamco."},"12":{"text":"Culai ah Jesuh cu thlacam dingin tlang parah a kai ih Pathian hnenah zanvar thla a cam.","title":"Tirhthlah Hleihnih A Hril (Mat 10.1-4 ; Mar 3.13-19)"},"13":{"text":"Khua a hung vaan tikah a dungthlun pawl a ko khawm ih anmah sungin mi hleihnih a hril; cupawl cu ‘Tirhthlah pawl’ tiah a ko."},"14":{"text":"An hmin cu Simon (Piter tiah a kawhmi) le a nau Andru, Jeim le Johan, Filip le Bartholomeo,"},"15":{"text":"Matthai le Thomas, Alfias ih fapa Jeim le Simon (Phunṭantu tiih kawhmi),"},"16":{"text":"Jeim ih fapa Judas le Jesuh phiar lehtu Judas Iskariot tla an si."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh cu a dungthlun pawl thawn tlangpar ihsin an rung suk ih a thluntu tampi pawl thawn hmun rawn ah an ding. Mitampi cutawkah cun an ra; Judea ram pumpuluk ihsin siseh, Jerusalem khua in siseh, tipikap ih a ummi Taiar le Sidon khawpi tla in an ra.","title":"Jesuh In Thu A Zirh, Mi A Damter (Mat 4.23-25)"},"18":{"text":"Jesuh thusimmi ngai duh ah le an natnak tla dam duh ah an ra. Thlarau thiang lo pawl ih zonzaihtermi pawl tla a damter."},"19":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in amah kha tham an duh; ziangahtile a sung ihsin huham a suak ih a damter ṭheh hai ruangah a si."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl a zoh hai ih, “Mi farah pawl cu mi thlawsuak nan si, Pathian Uknak cu nanmah ih ta a si!","title":"Rawn-ih Jesuh Thuzirhnak"},"21":{"text":"“Atu laiih rilrawng pawl cu mi thlawsuak nan si, nan khopkham leh ding a si! “Atu laiih mitthli a tlami pawl cu mi thlawsuak nan si, nan lungawiin nan hni leh ding."},"22":{"text":"“Mi in an lo hua, an lo hnong ih Milai Fapa ruangah an lo hmuhsuam, an lo relsiat asile mi thlawsuak nan si!"},"23":{"text":"Cubangtuk a si tikah nan thin nuam in um uhla lungawiin laam uh; ziangahtile nan hrangah tuarman tampi vancungah retcia in a um zo. Cubangtuk cu an pupa pawl khal in profet pawl parah an rak tuah zomi a si."},"24":{"text":"“Atuih milian pawl cu zaangfakza nan si; nunnuam nan comi a cem zo!"},"25":{"text":"“Atuih a khopkham pawl cu zaangfakza nan si; rilrawngin nan vakvai leh ding. “Atuih a hni rero pawl cu zaangfakza nan si; nan ṭap nan ai leh ding."},"26":{"text":"“Mikip ih porh le fakmi cu zaangfakza nan si; Ziangahtile an pupa pawl khal in cuvekin profet deu pawl kha an rak porh dah a si."},"27":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla ka thu a theitu nannih pawl: Nan ral duhdaw uh; a lo huatu pawl parah ṭhatnak tuah uh;","title":"Nan Ral Pawl Duhdaw Uh (Mat 5.38-48 ; 7.12a)"},"28":{"text":"a lo camtu pawl khi thlawsuah pe uhla a lo hremtu pawl hrangah thla cam uh."},"29":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat in na biang a lo beng asile khatlam khal tun hrih aw; mi pakhatkhat in na kawt angki lenghruk a lak ahcun na angki sunghruk khal pe cih aw."},"30":{"text":"Na thilri pakhatkhat a lo diltu an um ahcun va pe aw; cule mi pakhatkhat in na thil an lak le va dil sal nawn hlah."},"31":{"text":"Na hrangah tuah hai sehla ti na duhmi kha midang hrangah va tuah aw."},"32":{"text":"“Nangmah a lo duhdawtu lawng na duhdawt a si ahcun ziangah so thlawsuah malsawm ngah ding cu na zum? Misual pawl khal in anmah a duhdawtu cu an duhdawt ve a sisi!"},"33":{"text":"Nangmah parah ṭhatnak a tuahtu hrang lawngah ṭhatnak na tuah ve ahcun ziangah so thlawsuah malsawm ngah ding cu na zum? Misual pawl hman in cuvek cu an tuah ve a sisi!"},"34":{"text":"Ka ngah sal ding tiih na zummi hnen lawngih na coih ahcun ziangah so thlawsuah malsawmnak ngah ding cu na beisei? Misual pawl hman in an ngah sal ding ahcun misual dang pawl hnenah an coih ve a sisi!"},"35":{"text":"Cutiin a si lo! Nan ral pawl duhdaw uhla an parah ṭhatnak tuah uh. Coih uhla ngah sal ding ruat duh hlah uh. Cuticun ṭhatman tampi nan ngah ding ih Cungnungbik Pathian ih fa nan si ding. Ziangahtile amah cu miṭha lo le lungawi hna hman a thiam lomi par khalah a ṭha a si."},"36":{"text":"Nan Pa cu mi zaangfah thiam a si vekin nannih khal mi zaangfah thiam va si ve uh,” tiah Jesuh in a ti."},"37":{"text":"Mi va soisel hlah, Pathian in a lo soisel ve lo ding. Midang va hnong hlah, Pathian in a lo hnong ve lo ding. Midang ngaidam awla Pathian in a lo ngaidam ve ding.","title":"Midang Va Soisel Hlah (Mat 7.1-5)"},"38":{"text":"Midang hnenah thil ṭhen aw, Pathian in a lo ṭhen ve ding. Tamzet in, liam thluahthlo in, na kut sungah pek na si ding ih na zawi thei nawn lo tiangin burh na si ding. Midang parih na hmanmi tahnak khi Pathian in na parah a hmang ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in hi tahṭhimnak hi a sim: “Mitcaw pakhat in a dang mitcaw a hruai thei lo ding. A hruai asile an pahnih in korhrum sungah an tla ding."},"40":{"text":"Tlawngta cu a saya hnakin a thiam sawn dah lo; asinain tlawngta cu a zirnak a ṭheh tikah cun a saya bangtuk a si ding."},"41":{"text":"“Nan mit sungih thingtum a ummi sawn hman ruat loin ziangah so na unau mit sungih mit-hnawm fate lehlam na zoh?"},"42":{"text":"Na unau hnenah ‘Unau, zaangfahte in na mit sungih mithnawm kha ka lo coih sak pei,’ tiah ziangtinso na ti thei? Nangmah mit sungih thingtum hman na hmuh thei si lo! Mi titer aw pawl! Hmaisabik ah nan mit sungih thingtum kha suahta uhla cuih hnuah nan unau mit sungih mithnawm kha coih dingah ṭhatein nan hmu ding,” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Thingkung ṭha in rahsia a rah dah lo; thingkung ṭha lo in rah ṭha khal a rah thei ve lo.","title":"Thingkung Le A Rah (Mat 7.16-20 ; 12.33-35)"},"44":{"text":"Thingkung hmuahhmuah khi an rah in theih thei an si: hlingkung par ihsin thei rah nan lo dah lo; cuvekin theihmu kung ihsin sabit rah nan lo fawn lo."},"45":{"text":"Mi ṭha in a thinlung sungih a ummi thil ṭha kha a suahter; mi ṭha lo in a thinlung sungih a ummi thil ṭha lo pawl kha a suahter ve. Ziangahtile minung cu a thinlung sungih a ummi kha a kaa in a suak a si,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ziangah so ‘Bawipa, Bawipa,’ tiah in ti ih ka lo sim mi cu nan tuah fawn lo?","title":"Inn Saktu Pahnih (Mat 7.24-27)"},"47":{"text":"Ka hnenah ra in ka thusimmi a ngai ih a thluntu pawl cu mi ziangvek an si, ti ka lo hmuhhnik ding."},"48":{"text":"Cupa cu lungpi parah khur thukpi lai in ṭhuam a bun ih inn a saktu pa bangtuk a si. Tiva a hung lian ih cuih inn cu a sawh ciamco naón a hnin thei lo; ziangahtile fekteih sakmi inn a si."},"49":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka thusimmi a thei naón a thlun lotu pa cu ṭhuam ṭhateih phun loin leilung meen ih inn a saktu pa vek a si. Tilian in a cuih inn cu a run pah tikah hmakhatte ah inn cu a tlu ih ziangtluk ṭihnungza so a si!” tiah a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu hi thu hmuahhmuah a sim ṭheh tikah Kapernaum khua ah a feh.","title":"Ralbawi Ih Hnen-um A Damter (Mat 8.5-13)"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkah Rom ralbawi pakhat a um ih hnen-um pakhat a nei; cuih a hnen-um cu a duh ngaingai; asinain a na ih a thi zik thlang."},"3":{"text":"Cuih ralbawipa cun Jesuh thuhla a theih tikah a hnen-um ra damter dingin va dil dingah Judah mi upa pawl a thlah."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh hnenah an va thleng ih thungai thlak in an va dil. “Hi pa cu na bom ding a tlak ngaingai a si."},"5":{"text":"Kan miphun a duhdawtu a si ih amah rori in kan hrangah sinakok a sak a si,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh in anmah cu a hei thlun. A cuih inn an naih vivo tikah ralbawipa cun a rualpi pawl a rak thlah ih, “Bawipa, har rero in ra duh hlah.
