Ka inn hi nangih luhnak ah a tlak lo a si."},"7":{"text":"Cun na hnenah keimah ka ra ding ka ti khalle ka tlak thotho lo tiah ka ruat aw. Curuangah thu pe mai awla ka hnen-um cu a dam ko ding."},"8":{"text":"Keimah khal bawi upa kut hnuai ih um ka si ih keimah ih kuthnuai khalah ralkap pawl an um. Ralkap pakhatkhat hi ‘Feh aw,’ ka ti ahcun a feh; a dang pakhat hi ‘Ra aw,’ ka ti ahcun a ra. Cun ka hnen-um cu ‘Hihi tuah aw,’ ka ti ahcun a tuah a si,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cumi cu Jesuh in a theih tikah cupa ih zumnak cu a mang a bang ngaingai. A thluntu misenpi pawl lam ahcun a her ih, “Thungai in ka lo sim: Israel mi lak hmanah hi bangtuk zumnak cu ka tong dah lo!” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"A thlahmi pawl cu ralbawipa ih inn ah an kir ih a hnen-um pa a rak dam zo kha an hmu."},"11":{"text":"Cuihhnu reilote-ah Jesuh cu Nain an timi khua ah a feh ih a dungthlun pawl le mitampi in an thlun.","title":"Nuhmei Fapa A Thawhter Sal"},"12":{"text":"An khuahnar a thlen tikah mithi phum dingah miruunpi an ra suak. A thimi cu nuhmei nu ih fapa neihsun a si ih khawsungmi tampi in a nu cu an thlun."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa in cu nu cu a hmuh tikah a zaangfah ngaingai ih, “ṭap nawn hlah,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu a va feh ih ruakkuang cu a tham; cule a zawntu pawl cu an ding. Jesuh in, “Tlangval pa, tho aw ka lo ti!” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Mithi pa cu a tho ih a ṭong thei; cule Jesuh in a nu ih hnenah a hruai."},"16":{"text":"An zatein an thin a phang ih Pathian an thangṭhat. “Kan lakah a maksakmi profet a suak; a minung pawl run dingah Pathian a ra thleng zo,” tiah an ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh ih thuhla cu cuih ram hmuahhmuah le a kiangkap ah a thang ṭheh."},"18":{"text":"Cuih thu hmuahhmuah cu Johan dungthluntu pawl in Johan hnenah an sim. Cule Johan in a dungthlun pahnih a ko ih,","title":"Johan Ih Thlahmi Palai Pawl (Mat 11.2-19)"},"19":{"text":"“Johan in a ra ding tiah a timi cu na si maw, a si lole a dang kan hngak hrih ding maw?” tiin Bawipa va sut dingah a thlah."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh hnen an thlen tikah annih in, “Baptisma petu Johan in ‘a ra ding a timi cu nangmah hi na si maw, a si lole midang kan hngak hrih ding so?’ tiah sut dingah in thlah a si,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Culai fangah cun Jesuh in mi tampi an dam lonak le an natnak a phunphun a damter ih khawsia ih polhmi tla a damter ih mitcaw tampi tla khua a hmuhter sal."},"22":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh in Johan dungthlun pawl cu, “Va kir uhla nan hmuhmi le nan theihmi hi Johan cu va sim uh: mitcaw in khua an hmu thei, ke-awl pawl ṭhatein an feh thei, phaarnatih a nami pawl tla an thiang sal; hnaset mi in thawmvang an thei thei, mithi pawl an thosal ih mi farah pawl hnenah Thuthang ṭha cu sim a si zo."},"23":{"text":"Keimah ih thuhla ah thinlung rinhmainak a nei lotu cu mi thlawsuak an si,” tiah a sawn."},"24":{"text":"Johan ih thlahmi palai pawl an kir hnuah Jesuh in Johan ih thuhla cu mipi hnenah hiti in a sim: “Ramṭhing ih nan feh tikah ziang hmu dinginso nan feh? Thli in a sem ruangah a kuur reromi hrampi maw?"},"25":{"text":"Ziang hmuh duh ah so nan feh? Hnipuan mankhung a hrukmi zoh duh ah maw? Cubangtuk hnipuan mankhung a hrukih nuamzetin a umtu pawl cu siangpahrang inn lawngah an um a si."},"26":{"text":"I sim hnik uh: Ziang zoh duh ah so nan feh? Profet zoh duh ah maw? Asi, profet zoh duh ah nan feh ngai; asinain nan hmuhmi hi profet hnakih nasa sawn a si."},"27":{"text":"Ziangahtile Johan thuhla hi Ca Thianghlim sungah, ‘Pathian in na hrangih lamzin sialtu dingah na hlanah ka palai ka thlah ding a ti,’ tin a um."},"28":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: minung ih hrinmi hmuahhmuah lakah Johan hnakih a tum sawn le a nasa sawnmi zohman an um lo. Sikhalsehla Pathian Uknak sungih mi nautabik cu Johan hnakin a tum sawn a si,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cutiih a simmi cu mipi in an thei. Anmah le siahkhongtu pawl tla cu Pathian ih dingnak a pomtu an si ih Johan ih baptisma latu an si."},"30":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Farasi pawl le Daanthiam pawl cun an hrangih Pathian tumtahmi kha an pom lo ih Johan ih baptisma a la duh lotu an si."},"31":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Tuihsan milai pawl hi ziangthawn so ka ṭhim ding? Ziang bangtuk so an si?"},"32":{"text":"Dawr tuahnak hmunih a tomi nauhak pawl bangtuk an si. Nauhak bur khat in a dang bur khat hnenah: ‘Mopuai hla kan lo saksak naón nan laam duh lo; Mithi hla kan lo saksak naón nan ṭap duh fawn lo,’ a ti awmi nauhak pawl bangtuk an si."},"33":{"text":"Baptisma petu Johan a ra ih rawl ul le sabitti in loin a um tikah ‘Ramhuai in a polh,’ nan ti."},"34":{"text":"Milai Fapa a ra thleng ih a ei a in tikah nannih in ‘Hi pa hi zohhnik uh! Rawl phaam le sabitti phaam pa hi; siahkhongtu le misual pawl ih rualpi a si!’ in ti."},"35":{"text":"Asinain Pathian fimnak a dik zia cu a pomtu pawl in an langter a si,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Farasi mi pakhat in Jesuh cu zanriah eitlang dingah a sawm. Jesuh cu a va feh ih rawl ei dingah cun a to.","title":"Simon Inn ah Jesuh A Thleng"},"37":{"text":"Cuih khua ah nunsual ih a nungmi nunau pakhat a rak um. Cunu in Jesuh cu Farasi pa innah rawl a ei ding ti a theih tikah alabaster timi lungih tuahmi thawl pakhat in zihmui a rak keng ih,"},"38":{"text":"Jesuh dunglam, a ke hramah ding tahratin a ṭap ih a mitthli in Jesuh ih ke cu a tlak ruangah a ciar. Cule Jesuh ih ke cu a sam in a hnawt hul ih a hnam hnuah zihmui a toih."},"39":{"text":"Cumi cu Farasi pa in a hmuh tikah a thinlungte in, “Hi pa hi profet taktak a si ahcun a tham rerotu nunau nu hi zo a si ti a thei ding ih ziangvek nuncan sual in a nung ti khal a thei ding,” tiah a ruat."},"40":{"text":"Jesuh in Simon hnen ahcun, “Simon, thu ka lo sim duhmi a um,” tiah a ti. Simon in, “Sayapa, i sim aw he!” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Tangka coihtu pa hnen ihsin tangka a cawitu mi pahnih an um. Pakhat pa in ngun tangka zanga a cawi ih a dang pakhat in sawmnga a cawi."},"42":{"text":"An pahnih in an sam thei lo veve. Curuangah an pahnih in a olh. Cute pahnih lakah zo deuh in so tangka coihtu cu an duhdawt deuh ding?” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Simon in, “Tangka tam deuh a olh mipa in a duhdawt deuh ding tiah ka ruat,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Jesuh in, “A dik a si,” a ti."},"44":{"text":"Cule nunau nu lam ih a her hnuah Simon hnenah cun, “Hi nunau nu hi na hmu maw? Na inn sungah ka runglut; nang in ka ke kholhnakah tidai i pe lo, asinain hi nu in ka ke cu a mitthli in a kholh ih a sam in a hnawt hul a si."},"45":{"text":"Nang cun hnamnak in i rak hmuak lo, asinain hi nu cun ka ra thlen vete in cat loin ka ke a hnam a si."},"46":{"text":"Nang cun ka lu ih culh dingah olif hriak i pe lo, asinain anih cun ka ke hi zihmui in a toih a si."},"47":{"text":"Ka lo sim: a mi duhdawtnak tumpi a langtermi hin a sualnak tampi cu ngaithiam a si zo ti kha a langter a si. Sikhalsehla a sualnak malte lawng ngaithiam a si mi cun duhdawtnak malte lawng a langter ve a si,” tiah a ti."},"48":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in nunau nu hnenah, “Na sualnak pawl cu ngaithiam a si zo,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Rawl einak cabuai ih a totu midang pawl cun an thinlungte in, “Sualnak hman a thlah sak theitu, hi pa hi zo vek mi so a si?” tiah an ti aw."},"50":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh in nunau nu cu, “Na zumnak in a lo run suak zo; hnangamte in va tlung aw,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tawkfang a rei hnuah Jesuh cu Pathian Uknak Thuthang ṭha sim in khawpi le khawte a tlawng vivo. Dungthluntu hleihnih tla an tel.","title":"Jesuh Thluntu Nunau Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Cule natnak a phunphun le khawsia ih polhmi pawl a damtermi nunau tla an tel ve: a sung ihsin ramhuai pasarih a dawi suakmi Mari (Magdalene ti tla in kawhmi),"},"3":{"text":"Herod zung ah bawi a si mi Khuza nupi Joanna, Susanna le an neihmi thilri thawn Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl a bawmtu nunau pawl tla an si."},"4":{"text":"Khua khat hnu khua khat in Jesuh hnenah mi an ra; mi tam ngaipi a hnenih an ratkhawm tikah hiti in tahṭhimnak a sim.","title":"Thlaici Vorhtu Tahṭhimnak (Mat 13.1-9 ; Mar 4.1-9)"},"5":{"text":"“Voikhat ah mi pakhat cu thlaici vorh dingah a feh. Lo sungih thlaici a vorh tikah a ṭhenkhat cu lamzin tluanah an tla ih cu pawl cu mi in an pal, vate in an sar ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Ṭhenkhat cu lungsedaap lakah an tla ih thlaici cu an kho naón leilung a hnawng lo ruangah an caar ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Thlaici hrekkhat pawl cu hlingbur lakah an tla ih hlingkung thawn an ṭhang tlang ih hlingkung in a zaap ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Cule ṭhenkhat cu leilung ṭhatnak ah an tla ih an kho ih an vui; fang zakhat fingfing an nei. Theihnak hna a neitu cun thei uh,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cuih tahṭhimnak ih tican ziang a si, tiah a dungthluntu pawl in Jesuh an sut.","title":"Cuih Tahṭhimnak Ih Tican (Mat 13.10-23 ; Mar 4.10-12)"},"10":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Pathian Uknak ih thuthup theih theinak cu nan hnenah pek a si zo; asinain midang hnenah cun tahṭhimnak thawn lawngin sim a si ding. Curuangah an zoh rero ding naón an hmu thei lo ding, an ngai rero ding naón an thei thiam lo ding."},"11":{"text":"“Hi tahṭhimnak ih tican cu hiti in a si: thlaici cu Pathian ih ṭongkam a si.","title":"Thlaici Vorh Tahṭhimnak Ih Tican (Mat 13.18-23 ; Mar 4.13-20)"},"12":{"text":"Lamzin tluan ih a tlami thlaici cu Pathian ṭongkam an thei naón Satan a ra ih an zum lonak ding le runmi an si lonak dingah an thinlung sung ihsin Pathian ih thu cu a lak hlosak mi pawl an si."},"13":{"text":"Lungsedaap lakih a tlami thlaici cu Pathian ṭongkam cu an thei ih lungawi zetin an pom. Asinain an thinlung sung thukpi ah a pil lo. Tikcu tawite sung an zum ih hniksaknak caan a thlen tikah a tlu salmi pawl an si."},"14":{"text":"Hlingbur lakih a tlami thlaici cu Pathian ṭongkam cu an thei; sikhalsehla leilung tlun donharnak, len duhnak le taksa nomnak in a khuh ih ziangtik hmanah a rah cu a hmin dah lomi pawl an si."},"15":{"text":"Leiram ṭha ih a tlami thlaici cu Pathian ṭongkam an thei ih thinlung ṭha le zawnlungte ih a cem tiang rah nei ko a pom hngettu pawl an si,” tiah a sim."},"16":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Zohman in mei-inn vang tahratin kho an khuh dah lo, ihkhun hnuai khal ah an ret keel lo. Inn sungih mi an luh tikah tleunak an hmuh fiang theinak dingah mei-inn vannak tung parah an ret a si.","title":"Kho Khuhmi Mei-inn (Mar 4.21-25)"},"17":{"text":"“A thupte ih thuhmi hmuahhmuah cu langter thluh sal a si dingih khuhmi thil hmuahhmuah cu khawtleu ah suahter sal ṭheh an si ding."},"18":{"text":"“Curuangah thu nan ngaidan ah hin ralring uh; ziangahtile thil tawkfang a neitu cu peksin a si ding ih zianghman a nei lotu cu malte ka nei tiih a ruahmi hman kha laksak a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Jesuh ih nu le a nau pawl kha a hnenah an ra, asinain mi an tamtuk ruangah an tong thei lo.","title":"Jesuh Ih Nu Le Unau Pawl (Mat 12.46-50 ; Mar 3.31-35)"},"20":{"text":"Mi pakhat in Jesuh hnenah, “Na nu le na naule pawl lenglam ah an ding ih an lo tong duh,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in mipi hnenah, “Ka nu le ka naule pawl cu Pathian thu a thei ih a thluntu pawl an si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Voikhat ah Jesuh cu a dungthluntu pawl thawn lawng sungah an lut ih an hnenah, “Tili khatlam ral ah feh uhsi,” tiah a ti. A ti vek cun an feh.","title":"Jesuh In Thlisia A Daiter (Mat 8.23-27 ; Mar 4.35-41)"},"23":{"text":"Long in an feh rero laiah cun Jesuh cu a it that! Rinlopi-ah thlisia a rung hrang ciamco; an lawng sungah tidai a lut ih a khah zik thlang tikah cun an phang ngaingai."},"24":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl in Jesuh cu an va ṭhang ih, “Bawipa, Bawipa! Kan thi thluh zik thlang sokhaw,” tiah an ti. Jesuh cu a hung tho ih thlisia le tilet cu thu a pek. Thlisia cu a reh ih zianghman thawthaang um loin a dai khepkhep."},"25":{"text":"Cule a dungthluntu pawl cu, “Nan zumnak khui-ah so?” tiah a ti. Sikhalsehla annih cu an mang a bang ih an ṭihzet; cule pakhat le pakhat, “Hi pa hi zoso a si? Thlisia le tilet tla thu a pek ih a thu an ngai hi!” tiah an ti aw."},"26":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu lawng in Galilee tili ralkhat Gerasene timi peng ah an thleng.","title":"Khawsia Polhmi Jesuh In A Damter (Mat 8.28-34 ; Mar 5.1-20)"},"27":{"text":"Jesuh cu tikap ih a suah zawng ah khawsia pawl ih polhmi pakhat in a rak tong. Cupa cu caan reipi inn ah um loin le hnipuan hruk loin a tawivak vivo ih mithi phumnak lungkua sungah a um sawn ṭheu."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh a hmuh tikah napi in a raak ih Jesuh ke hramah a hlon aw ih ringzet in, “Jesuh, Cungnungbik Pathian Fapa! Nang le kei ziangso kan seng aw? I hrem hram aw hlah, tiah ka lo dil!” tiah a au."},"29":{"text":"Ziangah cuvekin a au tile Jesuh in khawsia kha cupa sung ihsin suak dingin thu a pek ruangah a si. Voi tampi cu khawsia cun a tuah tikah thawnginn ah a kut le a ke thir cikcin in an ṭem khalle thir cikcin cu a phihcat thluh ih khawsia cun ramṭhing ah a hlohter ṭheu a si."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Na hmin zoso?” tiah a sut. Anih in, “Ka hmin cu burpi ka si,” tiah a sawn. Ziangahtile khawsia burpi a sungih an um ruangah a si."},"31":{"text":"Khawsia pawl in Jesuh cu, “Khur thukpi sungah in thlak hram hlah aw,” tiah an dil."},"32":{"text":"Cutawk kiangkap tlang parah vok rual tampi an tlang rero. Khawsia pawl in Jesuh cu, “Vok sungah in lutter hram aw,” tiah an dil ih an dil vek cun vok sungah a thlah hai."},"33":{"text":"Cupa ih sungin an suak ih vok rual sungah cun an lut. A cuih vok rual cu khaamsaangpi ihsin an vung dawp ih tili sungah an pil that thluh."},"34":{"text":"Cuih vok rual a khaaltu pawl in ziang a cang ti kha an hmu thluh in zamrangin an tlan ih cuih thu cu khawsung le lo lakah an than ciamco."},"35":{"text":"Ziang a cang ti zoh dingah mi tampi an va feh. Jesuh hnen an thlen tikah a sung ihsin khawsia a suak mipa cu Jesuh kehram ah a to ih hnipuan hrukin le thinlung fimin a um kha an va hmu ih an ṭih ngaingai."},"36":{"text":"Ziang bangtuk in a dam ti a hmutu pawl in a thuhla cu an sim."},"37":{"text":"Cuih ram sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah in an ṭih ngaingai ih an zatein Jesuh cu hmun dangih feh dingin an dil. Curuangah Jesuh cu lawng sungah a lut ih a feh."},"38":{"text":"A sungih khawsia tampi a dawi mipa cun, “Na hnenah i fehter ve aw,” tiah a dil ciamco. Sikhalsehla Jesuh in,"},"39":{"text":"“Inn ah va tlung awla Pathian in na hrangih a tuahmi thu hi va sim aw,” tiah a ti ih a tlunter. Cupa cu khawsungah a tlung ih Jesuh in a hrangih a tuahmi cu mi hnenah a sim ciamco."},"40":{"text":"Jesuh cu tili ral khatlam a thlen tikah mi tampi in an rak hmuak, ziangahtile caan reipi amah kha an rak hngak zo.","title":"Jairas Fanu Le Jesuh Puan A Thamtu (Mat 9.18-26 ; Mar 5.21-43)"},"41":{"text":"Cule Jairas an timi pa a ra thleng. Jairas cu sinakok uktu a si. Jesuh ke hramah a bok ih a innih ra dingin a dil,"},"42":{"text":"ziangahtile a fanu neihsun, kum hleihnih a si mi cu, a na ih a thi zik thlang. Jesuh cu a va feh ih cutiih a feh laiah cun miburpi in a kilkip in an fuuk ih an thlun luihlo."},"43":{"text":"Cumi lakah nunau pakhat, kum hleihnih sung thidok natnak a tuartu a tel ve. A neihmi hmuahhmuah cem ṭheh in sibawi pawl hnenah a tuamhlawm aw naón zohman in an damter thei lo."},"44":{"text":"Mipi lakah cun Jesuh dunglam ihsin a hung ih Jesuh ih puanzimte kha a tham; cule a thidok cu hmakhatte ah a reh."},"45":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Zoso i thamtu?” tiah a sut. “Zohman in kan lo tham lo,” an ti. Cule Piter in, “Bawipa, na kimvel ah mipi in an lo kulh ih an lo naih cupco a sisi!” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh in, “Mi pakhatkhat in i tham a si, ziangahtile ka sung ihsin huham a suah kha ka thei,” tiah a ti."},"47":{"text":"Nunau nu in keimah ka si ti i thei zo, tiah ṭhia rero in a ra ih Jesuh ke hramah a ra bok. Cutawkah mizapi hmuh ahcun ziang ruangah Jesuh cu a tham ih ziang vekin hmakhatte-ah a dam ti thu tla a sim ṭheh."},"48":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ka fanu, na zumnak in a lo damter zo; hnangamte in va tlung aw,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Cutiih Jesuh a ṭong rero laiah Jairas inn ihsin mi an rak thlahmi a ra thleng ih Jairas kha, “Na fanu a thi zo; Sayapa cu hnaihnok nawn hlah,” tiah a ra ti."},"50":{"text":"Jesuh in cumi cu a thei ih Jairas hnenah, “Na thin phang hlah! Zum ringring aw; cule na fanu cu a dam ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"51":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jairas ih inn a thlen tikah Piter, Johan, Jeim le nauhak nu-ih nu le pa siar lo zohman inn sungah a luhter lo."},"52":{"text":"Cutawk mithi hmunih a ummi hmuahhmuah cu riahsia in an ṭap rero. Jesuh in, “ṭap hlah uh; hi nauhak nu hi a thi lo, a itthat a si,” tiah a ti."},"53":{"text":"Nauhak nu a thi ti cu zokhal in an theih ruangah Jesuh cu an hnihsan."},"54":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh in a kut in a vun kaih ih, “Ka fanu, tho aw,” tiah a ti."},"55":{"text":"A hung nung sal ih hmakhatte ah a hung tho. “Rawl ei ding pe uh,” tiah Jesuh in a ti."},"56":{"text":"A nu le a pa pawl cun mak an ti ngaingai. Jesuh in cuih thu cu zohman sim lo dingin a tiam."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu hleihnih pawl cu hmun khatah a ko ih khawsia dawi theinak le natnak a phunphun damter theinak huham a pek hai.","title":"Dungthluntu Hleihnih A Thlah (Mat 10.5-15 ; Mar 6.7-13)"},"2":{"text":"Cule Pathian Uknak thu sim ding le mina damter dingah a thlah hai."},"3":{"text":"An hnenah, “Khual nan tlawn tikah zianghman keng hlah uh: kianghrol siseh, zaal siseh, rawl siseh, paisa siseh, angki hlei khal keng hlah uh."},"4":{"text":"Nan tlun-inn ah hmun dang nan feh sal hlan lo va caam uh."},"5":{"text":"An lo khirnak khua cu tlansan uhla anmah ralrin peknak ah nan ke ih leidip kha thingta uh,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cu an feh ih khawte an tlawng vivo; Thuthangṭha an sim ih khuazakip ah mina an damter vivo."},"7":{"text":"Galilee ram uktu bawi Herod in cu bangtuk ih thil a cangmi cu a theih tikah a awlok a song ngaingai, ziangahtile baptistma petu Johan a nung sal a si tiah mi ṭhenkhat in an ti.","title":"Herod Awloksongnak (Mat 14.1-12 ; Mar 6.14-29)"},"8":{"text":"Midang in, “Elijah a lang a si hi,” an ti ih midang ṭhenkhat cun khuahlan laiih profet pakhatkhat a nung sal a si, an ti."},"9":{"text":"Herod in, “Johan ih lu ka tanter zo; asinain a thuhla ka theih reromi hi pa hi zo a si pei?” tiah a ti. Cule Jesuh cu hmu suak rori dingin a tum."},"10":{"text":"A thlahmi a dungthluntu pawl cu an ra tlung ih an tuahmi hmuahhmuah cu Jesuh an sim. Cule a hruai hai ih Bethsaida an timi khua ah anmah vial lawng an feh.","title":"Jesuh In Mi Thawngnga Rawl A Do (Mat 14.13-21 ; Mar 6.30-44 ; Joh 6.1-14)"},"11":{"text":"Cuih thu cu mipi in an theih tikah an thlun. Jesuh cun cibai a buk hai ih an hnenah Pathian Uknak thu a sim ih damnak a ṭulmi pawl tla a damter."},"12":{"text":"Ni a tlak zik tikah a thlahmi hleihnih cu a hnenah an ra ih, “Hitawk hi ramṭhing a si; curuangah misenpi pawl hi fehter aw, khua le lo lakah va feh hai sehla rawl le riahnak inn tla va hawl hai seh,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh in, “Nanmah in an ei ding rawl cu pe uh,” tiah a ti. Annih in, “Kan neihmi hmuahhmuah cu a zatein saang hlom nga le nga pum hnih lawng a si. Minung hi zat hrang rawl kan lei cawk ding maw?” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cutawkah pacang lawnglawng thawng nga tluk an um. Jesuh in, “Mipi hi sawmnga bur ciar in toter uh,” tiah dungthluntu pawl cu a sim."},"15":{"text":"Cutiin dungthluntu pawl in an tuah hnuah,"},"16":{"text":"Jesuh cun saang hlom nga le nga pum hnih cu a lak ih van a hun zoh ih Pathian hnenah lungawinak thawn thla a cam hnuah a phel ih mipi zem dingin dungthluntu pawl hnenah a pek."},"17":{"text":"An zatein an ei ih an khop hnuah an hlahmi kha dungthluntu pawl in an rutkhawm ih bawm hleihnih a ti."},"18":{"text":"Nikhat ah Jesuh cu amah lawng thla a cam laiah dungthluntu pawl an ra ih, “Mipi in zo in ti so?” tiah a rak sut hai.","title":"Piter In Jesuh Si-nak A Phuang. (Mat 16.13-19 ; Mar 8.27-29)"},"19":{"text":"Annih in, “Mihrek in baptisma petu Johan a si, an lo ti. Ṭhenkhat in Elijah a si, an lo ti. Cule midang in khuahlan laiih profet pakhatkhat a nungsal a si, an lo ti,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nannih in teh! Zo a si tiah so in ruat?” tiah a sut. Piter in, “Nangmah cu Pathian ih Messiah na si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cuih thu cu zohman sim lo dingin Jesuh in a tiam hai.","title":"A Tuarnak Le A Thihnak Ding A Sim (Mat 16.20-28 ; Mar 8.30—9.1)"},"22":{"text":"Cule an hnenah, “Milai Fapa hi a tuar nasa ding ih upa pawl, puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam saya pawl in an hnong ding. Amah cu an that ding; asinain ni thumnak ah thawhter sal a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cule an zate hnenah, “Zokhal sisehla i thlun duh ahcun mah zawnruahnak kha tlansan sehla nitinte a thinglamtah phur in i thlun seh."},"24":{"text":"Ziangahtile zokhal siseh amah ih nunnak a hum duhtu cu a nunnak a sung ding; sikhalsehla keimah ih hrangah a nunnak a sungtu cu a nunnak a hum ngah ding."},"25":{"text":"Mi pakhat in leilung pumpi hi co ṭheh hmansehla amah ih nunnak a sun, a si lole a hloral a si ahcun ziangso hlawhmi a neih? Hlawhmi zianghman a nei lo."},"26":{"text":"Mi pakhat in keimah le ka thu zirhmi a zahpi ahcun Milai Fapa khal in a sunlawinak le a Pa le vancung mithiang pawl ih sunlawinak thawn a ra thlen tikah a zahpi ve ding."},"27":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: hitawk ih a ummi lakah hin, Pathian Uknak a rung thlen an hmuh hlan lo, a thi lo dingmi nan um a si,” tiah a sim."},"28":{"text":"Hi thu pawl a sim hnu zarh khatah Jesuh in Piter le Johan le Jeim a ko ih thlacam dingah tlangpar ah an kai.","title":"Jesuh Hmuihmel Thlengnak (Mat 17.1-8 ; Mar 9.2-8)"},"29":{"text":"Thla a cam rero laiah Jesuh cu a hmelpian a thleng aw ih a hnipuan cu a vaar tukah a tleu in a tleu."},"30":{"text":"Hmakhatteah mi pahnih an rung lang ih an bia aw. Cuih mi pahnih cu Moses le Elijah an si."},"31":{"text":"Vancung sunlawinak thawn an rung lang ih Jerusalem khua ih a thihnak in Pathian tumtahmi a kimternak ding thu kha Jesuh thawn an ruah aw."},"32":{"text":"Piter le a rualpi pawl cu ih-hmuh thaw zetin an rak itthat; asinain an hung ṭhang ih Jesuh ih sunlawinak le Jesuh thawn a ding tlangmi mi pahnih kha an hmu."},"33":{"text":"Cuih mi pahnih ih Jesuh an fehsan zawng ah Piter in, “Bawipa, hitawk ih kan um hi a ṭha ngaingai a si! Buuk pathum in kan sak pei; nangmah hrangah pakhat, Moses hrangah pakhat, Elijah hrangah pakhat,” tiah a ti. Amah cun ziang ka ṭong ti hman a thei ngah ngaingai lo."},"34":{"text":"Cutiih a ṭong rero laiah mero a hung zaam ih a thlaam in a run phen; cutiih mero in a run tuam ruangah dungthlun pawl cun an ṭih ngaingai."},"35":{"text":"Cule mero sung ihsin aw pakhat in, “Hi pa hi ka hrilmi ka Fapa a si, a thu ngai uh,” tiah a run ti."},"36":{"text":"Cuih aw a reh tikah Jesuh amah lawng an hmu. Dungthlun pawl cu daitein an um; an hmuhmi thuhla cu cuih caanah cun zo ih hnen hmanah an sim lo."},"37":{"text":"A thaisun ah Jesuh le a dungthlun pathum cu tlang ihsin an rung suk ih mipi tamzet in Jesuh kha an rak hmuak.","title":"Khawsia Polhmi Nauhakpa A Damter (Mat 17.14-18 ; Mar 9.14-27)"},"38":{"text":"Cule mipi lak ihsin mi pakhat a au ih, “Sayapa, ka fapa neihsun hi i ra zoh sak hram aw,” tiah a dil."},"39":{"text":"“Khawsia in a polh ih rin lopi in a au a kio ih a tlu ṭheu; a kaa in cilbuanra a suak ih harzet koin a tuah, a thlah duh hrimhrim lo!"},"40":{"text":"Khawsia dawisuak dingah na dungthluntu pawl ka dil rero naón an ti thei lo,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nannih pawl hi ziangtluk zumnak nei lo le mi sualral phun so nan si! Ziangtik tiangso nan hnenah ka um ding? Ziangtik tiangso ka lo tuar hrih hai ding?” tiah a ti. Cule mi pa hnenah cun, “Na fapa cu hinah rak hruai aw,” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Cutiin Jesuh hnenih nauhakpa a rat laiah khawsia in leilung ah nauhakpa cu a thluk ih zianghman thei loin a dirhcaih ciamco. Jesuh in khawsia cu a kawk ih nauhakpa cu a damter; cule nauhakpa cu a pa ih hnenah a pek."},"43":{"text":"Pathian cahnak huham an hmuh tikah mipi cu an mang a bang ngaingai. Jesuh ih thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah an hmuh tikah mipi cun mak an ti zet; cutiih an um laiah a dungthluntu pawl hnenah,"},"44":{"text":"“Thu ka lo sim ding ih cumi cu ziangtik hmanah hngilh hlah uh. Milai Fapa hi an phiar ding ih thuneitu kut ah pek a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a dungthluntu pawl in a simmi tican an thei lo. An theih thei lonak dingin thuhmi thu a si ruangah an thei thei lo ih an sut ngam fawn lo."},"46":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cun anmah lakah zoso a tum bik, timi thu-ah an el aw.","title":"Zoso A tumbik? (Mat 18.1-5 ; Mar 9.33-37)"},"47":{"text":"An ruahmi kha Jesuh in a theih ruangah nauhakte pakhat a hruai ih a kiangah a dinter."},"48":{"text":"Cule an hnenah, “Ka hmin in hi nauhakte a cohlangtu cu keimah i cohlang a si; keimah i cohlangtu cu i thlahtu a cohlang a si. Ziangahtile nanmah lakih mi nautabik cu a tum bik a si,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Johan in, “Bawipa, mi pakhat cu na hmin in ramhuai pawl a dawi rero kan hmu ih kan dawn; ziangahtile kan bu sungtel a si lo,” tiah a ti.","title":"Dodal Lo Tucu Bawmtu A Si (Mar 9.38-40)"},"50":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Dawn hlah uh; ziangahtile zokhal sisehla a lo dodal lotu cu a lo bawmtu an si,” tiah Johan le dungthluntu dang hnenah a ti."},"51":{"text":"Jesuh vancungih laak a sinak ding caan a nai cuahco thlang tikah Jerusalem ih feh hrimhrim dingin a ruatcat ih a pok.","title":"Samaria Khua In Jesuh An Duh Lo"},"52":{"text":"A hmaiah palai a thlah sung ih cupawl cu ziang hmuahhmuah rak timtuah sungtu dingah Samaria khua pakhat ah an lut."},"53":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cuih khawsungmi pawl in an duh lo, ziangahtile Jerusalem khua ah a lan ding ti an theih fiang ruangah a si."},"54":{"text":"Cumi cu a dungthlun Jeim le Johan in an hmuh tikah Jesuh hnenah, “Bawipa, hi pawl siatral ṭheh dingah vancung ihsin meisa tlakter sehla na duh lo maw?” an ti."},"55":{"text":"Jesuh cu an lamah a her ih a kawk hai."},"56":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu khawte dangah an feh."},"57":{"text":"Cutiih a feh vivo laiah mi pakhat in Jesuh cu, “Na fehnak kipah ka lo thlun ding,” a ti.","title":"Jesuh Thlun Duhtu Pawl (Mat 8.19-22)"},"58":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Cinghnia pawl in kua an nei ih vate tla in bu an nei; sikhalsehla Milai Fapa cun riahnak le lu hngauhsannak hmun khal a nei lo,” tiah a ti."},"59":{"text":"Mi pakhat hnenah Jesuh in, “I thlun aw,” a ti. Asinain cupa cun, “Bawipa, ka pa ka va phumta hmaisa pei,” tiah a ti."},"60":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Mithi cu mithi pawl in phum ko hai seh. Nang cu feh awla Pathian Uknak thu phuang sawn aw,” a ti."},"61":{"text":"A dang pakhat in, “Bawipa, ka lo thlun ding; asinain hmaisabik ah ka sungte pawl ka va biakta pei,” a ti."},"62":{"text":"Jesuh in a hnenah, “Zokhal dunglet hoi phah ih lei a lettu cu Pathian Uknak hrangah santlai lo a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Bawipa in midang sawmsarih le pahnih a hril ih amah a fehnak ding khawkip le hmunkip ah khan pahnih pahnih in a rak thlah sung.","title":"Sawmsarih Le Pahnih a Thlah"},"2":{"text":"An hnenah cun, “Rawl khawm ding a tamzet naón a khawmtu ding an malte a si. Curuangah rawl khawmtu ding tam sinsin a thlahnak dingah lo neitu hnenah thla cam uh."},"3":{"text":"Va feh uh! Cinghnia rual lakih tuu faate thlahmi bangin ka lo thlah hai a si."},"4":{"text":"Cutiih nan feh tikah paisa bawm siseh, zaal siseh, kedam siseh keng hlah uh; lamzin ih nan tonmi pawl biak dingah cawlta hlah uh."},"5":{"text":"Inn pakhatkhat sungih nan va luh tikah a hmaisabik ah, ‘Hi inn sungah daihnak um hram seh,’ tiah va ti uh."},"6":{"text":"Daihnak a duhtu a si ahcun daihnak na parah um hram seh, tiah cibai nan buknak cu a parah a umta ding; cuti a si lo ahcun nan hnenah daihnak cu kir salseh."},"7":{"text":"Cuih innah cun um uhla an lo pekmi poh kha in uhla ei uh; ziangahtile hnaṭuantu in a hlawhman cu a ngah a ṭul a si. Inn pakhat ihsin inn dangah ṭhawn duldo hlah uh."},"8":{"text":"Khua pakhat nan thlen ih tlun-inn an lo on a si ahcun an lo pekmi pohpoh cu ei uh;"},"9":{"text":"cuih khawsungih mina pawl tla damter uhla cuih khuami pawl cu, ‘Pathian Uknak a nai zo,’ tiah sim uh."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla khua pakhat nan thlen ih an lo tlunter lo asile khawsung lamzin ah feh uhla,"},"11":{"text":"‘Kan ke ih a kopmi nan khua ih leivut khal nanmah engtainak ah kan thingfai ṭheh a si. Asinain Pathian Uknak cu nan kiangah a ra thleng zo, ti ciing ringring uh,’ nan ti pei."},"12":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: Thuṭhennak Ni ah cuih khuami hnakin Sodom khuami hnenah Pathian in zaangfahnak a nei sawn ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"“Maw Khorazin khua, na hmakhua a va pit so! Maw Bethsaida khua, na hmakhua a va pit so! Na sungih mangbangza ka tuahmi pawl hi Tai-ar khua le Sidon khua ah tuah rak sisehla, cuih khawsungmi pawl cun an sualsir langternak dingah buri hnipuan hrukin vutcam an phulh awknak a reipi zo ding!","title":"A Zumlotu Khua Pawl (Mat 11.20-24)"},"14":{"text":"Thuṭhennak Ni ah Pathian in nang hnakin Tai-ar le Sidon khuami pawl parah zaangfahnak tam sawn a nei ding."},"15":{"text":"Cun nang Kapernaum khua! Van tiangih hlirsan awk na duh maw si? Hell sungah hlon na si ding!” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Nan thu a ngaitu pawl cu ka thu a ngaitu an si. A lo hnongtu cu keimah i hnongtu an si. Cule keimah i hnongtu cun keimah i thlahtu khal an hnong a si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Sawmsarih le pahnih thlahmi pawl cu lungawi zetin an ra kir sal ih, “Bawipa, na hmin in ramhuai pawl kan dawi tikah kan thu an ngai a si,” tiah an ti.","title":"Sawmsarih Le Pahnih An Kir"},"18":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Nimthlakau bangin vancung ihsin Satan a tlak kha ka hmu."},"19":{"text":"Ngai uh! Huham neihnak ka lo pek hai: rul le varngen-meipir pawl parah nan feh thei ding; nan ral neh theinak huham khal ka lo pek ih zianghman in a lo tuahmawh thei lo ding."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla thlarau ṭha lo in nan thu an ngai ruangah nan lungawi hlah uh; nan hmin vancungih ngan cia a si ruangah nan lungawi sawn uh,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh cu Thlarau Thianghlim in lungawinak thawn a khatter ih, “Maw ka Pa, lei le vanih Bawipa, mifim le mithiam pawl hnenih sim dah lomi thil cu fimthiamnak a nei lomi hnenah na langter ruangah na parah ka lung a awi. A si ka Pa, hiti ih a cangmi hi na duhzawng ih a cangmi a si.","title":"Jesuh A Lung A Awi (Mat 11.25-27 ; 13.16-17)"},"22":{"text":"“Ka Pa in ziang hmuahhmuah ka hnenah i pe zo. Fapa hi zo a si ti Pa siar lo zohman in an thei lo; cule Pa hi zo a si ti khal Fapa le, Pa ih thu Fapa in an hnenih a phuan ciami pawl siar lo zohman in an thei lo,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu a dungthluntu pawl lamah a her ih anmah lawngih theih dingin, “Nan hmuhmi thil pawl nan hmuh hi ziangtluk vannei so nan si!"},"24":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: profet tampi le siangpahrang tampi in nan hmuhmi hi hmuh ve an duh naón an hmu thei lo; theih ve an duh naón an thei ngah lo a si,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Daanthiam saya pakhat a ra ih a sualnak hawl dingin Jesuh hnenah, “Sayapa, kumkhua nunnak ka ngah theinak dingah ziangso ka tuah ding?” tiah a sut.","title":"Samaria Miṭha Tahṭhimnak"},"26":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ca Thianghlim in ziangtinso a ti? A timi cu na pomdan ziangtinso a si?” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cupa cun, “Bawipa na Pathian cu na thinlung hmuahhmuah, na nunnak hmuahhmuah, na cahnak hmuahhmuah le na ruahnak hmuahhmuah thawn na duhdaw pei ih na innhnen cu nangmah na duh awk vekin na duh hai ve pei, a ti,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Na simmi cu a dik a si; cu bangtuk in va tuah awla na nung ding,” tiah a sawn."},"29":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Daanthiam pa cun amah le amah thiam coter awk a duh ruangah Jesuh kha, “Zoso ka innhnen cu a si?” tiah a sut."},"30":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Voikhat ah mi pakhat cu Jerusalem ihsin Jerikho ah a vung feh. Cutiih a feh laiah suamhmang pawl in an kai ih a hnipuan an hliit hnuah thizikte in an thawi ih an tlansan."},"31":{"text":"Culai ah puithiam pakhat cu cuih lamzin ah a vung feh ngelcel; asinain cupa a hmuh tikah khatlam kam in a hrial ih a fehsan."},"32":{"text":"Cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in Levi mi pakhat khal a va feh ve ih mina pa cu a hei zohhliahta ih khatlam kapin a hrial ih a fehsan ve."},"33":{"text":"Asinain Samaria mi pakhat cu cutawk lamzin ah khual a tlawng ve ih cuih mina pa hnen a thleng ih a hmuh tikah a zaangfah ngaingai."},"34":{"text":"A hei fuuk ih a hma cu siti le sabitti a hnih ih ṭhatein a tuam sak. Cule a hruaimi rannung parah toter in khualbuk ah a fehpi ih cunah ṭhatein a tuamhlawm."},"35":{"text":"A thaisun ah ngun tangka fanghnih a suah ih riahbuk kiltupa cu a pek ih, ‘Hi pa hi ṭhatein run tuamhlawm awla hi lam ih ka ra kir sal tikah hi pa na zohnak hrangih na cemmi hmuahhmuah cu ka lo ruul sal thluh ding,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"36":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh in, “Suamhmang ih an kaih mipa ih innhnen cu himi pathum lakah hin zo hi so a si, tiah na ruat?” tiah a sut."},"37":{"text":"Daan zirhtu saya in, “Amah a zaangfahtu pa hi a si,” tiah a let. Jesuh in, “Feh awla cubangtuk in va tuah ve aw,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu khual an tlawng vivo ih khua pakhat an thleng. Martha timi nu in Jesuh cu a inn ah a tlunter.","title":"Martha Le Mari Hnenah Jesuh A Leeng"},"39":{"text":"Martha ih naunu cu Mari a si. Mari cu Jesuh ih kehram ah a to ih a thusimmi kha a ngai."},"40":{"text":"Martha cu hnaṭuan tampi nei in a buai ih a thin a ṭeu ruangah Jesuh hnenah, “Bawipa, ka naunu in hnaṭuan hmuahhmuah i tun ṭheh hi na poisa lo maw si? Sim aw, i ra bawm seh!” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Martha, Martha! Nang cu thil tampi parah helhkam le awloksong in na um;"},"42":{"text":"a ṭul ngaingaimi cu pakhat lawng a si. Cumi cu Mari in a hril ngah ih zohman in an lawng nawn lo pei,” tiah a ti."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khatah Jesuh cu hmun pakhat ah thla a cam. A ṭheh tikah a dungthlun lakih pakhat in, “Bawipa, Johan in a dungthlun pawl thlacam a zirh vekin thlacam in zirh ve aw,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh In Thlacam Daan A Zirh (Mat 6.9-13 ; 7.7-11)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Thla nan cam tikah hiti in nan ti pei: ‘Kan Pa, Na hmin thianghlim cu upat si ko seh, Na Uknak thleng hram seh."},"3":{"text":"Nitin kan ṭulmi rawl in pe aw."},"4":{"text":"Kan parih sualnak a tuahtu pawl kan ngaithiam bangin, kan sualnak in ngaithiam ve aw. A harmi hniksaknak ah in thlengter hlah aw,’ tiah nan ti pei,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in a dungthlun pawl hnenah, “Thuṭhimnak ah nanmah lakih pakhat in na rualpi inn ah zanṭim ah feh tahratin ‘Ka rual, sang hlom thum in i coih hram aw."},"6":{"text":"Ka rualpi pakhat khualtlawnnak ihsin ka inn a ra thleng ih rawl pek ding zianghman ka nei lo,’ tiah na va ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule thuṭhimnak ah a innsung ihsin na rualpi cun ‘I hnaihnok hlah. sangka ka khar zo ih ka faale thawn kan it zo; thil pe dingin ka tho paih nawn lo,’ tiah ti bang sehla,"},"8":{"text":"ziangtinso na tuah ding? Thungai in ka lo sim: a rualpi na si ruangah hung tho in na dilmi saang cu lo pe lohli lo hmansehla ningzak loin na dil rero hrat ahcun a tho pei ih na ṭulmi cu a lo pe ko ding."},"9":{"text":"“Curuangah hiti in ka lo sim: dil uh, nan ngah ding; hawl uh nan hmu ding; king uh, nan hrangah sangka on a si ding."},"10":{"text":"Ziangahtile a diltu hmuahhmuah in an ngah ding, a hawltu cun an tong ding ih a kingtu hrangah sangka cu onsak a si ding."},"11":{"text":"Nannih pale pawl lakah na fapa in ngasa lo dilsehla rul a petu nan um pei maw?"},"12":{"text":"Asilole arti a dil tikah varngen-meipir a petu nan um pei maw?"},"13":{"text":"Mi ṭha lo nan si ko naón nan faale hnenah cun thil ṭha pek nan thiam a si ahcun vancung nan Pa in ziangtlukin so a diltu hnenah Thlarau Thianghlim cu a pek sinsin ding!” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh in a ṭong thei lo mipa hnenin ramhuai pakhat a dawi suak; cutiih a dawi suak hnuah a polh mipa cu a ṭong thei. Cule misenpi cu an mang a bang ngaingai.","title":"Jesuh Le Beelzebul (Mat 12.22-30 ; Mar 3.20-27)"},"15":{"text":"Asinain mi ṭhenkhat cun, “Hitiih ramhuai pawl a dawi theinak cu ramhuai uktu bawi Beelzebul in huham a pek ruangah a si,” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Midang pawl in Jesuh sualnak hawl an duh ve; curuangah, “Pathian ih lungkim mi na si le si lo theihnak ah hmuhsaknak tuah aw,” tiah an fial."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh in an ruahnak kha a thei ih an hnenah, “Ram pakhatkhat ṭhen tampi ah a ṭhen aw ih ṭhenkhat le ṭhenkhat a do awmi ram cu rei a awh lo ding; a rem aw lomi innsang cu an ṭhenṭhek aw ṭheh a si."},"18":{"text":"Cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in Satan uknak sung khalah bu tampi ah um in bu khat le bu khat an do awk le ziangtinso cuih Satan uknak cu rei a awh thei ding? ‘Beelzebul in huham a lo pek ruangah ramhuai na dawi thei,’ tiah in ti."},"19":{"text":"Cuti vekin Beelzebul ruangah ramhuai ka dawi thei ngai ti bang sehla, nanmah a lo thluntu pawl in teh ziangtinso ramhuai an dawi thei? A lo thluntu pawl lala hi nanmah parih thuṭhentu an si ding."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kei cun Pathian cahnak thawn ramhuai ka dawi thei a si sawn; cutiin a si ruangah Pathian Uknak cu nan hnenah a ra thleng zo, ti a lang a si."},"21":{"text":"“Mi cakzet pakhat in a hriamnam neihmi hmuahhmuah thawn a inn a kilven ahcun a thilri pawl cu an him."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a cak deuh sawn pa in cupa cu a do ih a neh ahcun a rinsan zetmi a hriamnam pawl cu a lawng ṭheh ih a lonmi thilri pawl cu mi a zemdarh ṭheh a si."},"23":{"text":"“Keimah i ṭan lotu hmuahhmuah cu i dodaltu an si; a khawm i bawm lotu hmuahhmuah cu a ti darhdaitu sawn an si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"“Thlarau pakhat cu mi pakhat sung ihsin a suah tikah colhnak hmun hawl in ramcaar le ramṭhing ah a vak vivo. Colhnak hmun a ton lo tikah ‘Ka tlansan zomi ka inn ah ka kir sal ding,’ tiah amah tein a ruat.","title":"Thlarau Siava A Ra Kir Sal (Mat 12.43-45)"},"25":{"text":"Cuticun a kir sal ngaingai tikah a inn cu faizet le umnak dingah duhnungza zetin a va hmu."},"26":{"text":"Cuih hnuah a feh ih amah hnakih a siava deuhmi ramhuai pasarih a va sawm ih cutawkah an ra um. Cule a netnak ahcun cupa cu a hlan hnakin a besia sinsin a si,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh in hi thu a sim ṭheh tikah misenpi lakih nunau nu pakhat in Jesuh cu, “A lo hringtu le a lo tuamhlawmtu nunau cu mi thlawsuak a va si so!” tiah a ti.","title":"Thlawsuahnak Taktak"},"28":{"text":"Jesuh cun, “Pathian thu a thei ih a thlun taktaktu pawl cu mi thlawsuak an si sawn,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Mitampi in Jesuh cu an pan ih an fuuk cupco laiah Jesuh in, “Tuih san minung hi an va ṭha loso! Hmuhsaknak tuahsak ding an dil, sikhalsehla Jonah hmuhsaknak siar lo hmuhsaknak dang zianghman tuahsak an si lo ding.","title":"Hmuhsaknak Tuah Ding An Ngen (Mat 12.38-42)"},"30":{"text":"Profet Jonah cu Nineveh minung pawl hrangah hmuhsaknak a rak si bangtuk in Milai Fapa hi tuih san minung pawl hrangah hmuhsaknak a si ve ding."},"31":{"text":"Thuṭhen Ni ah Siangpahrangnu Sheba cu a tho ding ih tuih san minung pawl hi sual a puh ding, ziangahtile Siangpahrang Solomon fimnak thuzirhmi ngai dingah lamhlapi ihsin a ra thleng; asinain thungai in ka lo sim: Solomon hnakih tum sawn hinah a um."},"32":{"text":"Thuṭhen Ni ah Nineveh khawsung mi pawl an tho ding ih sual an lo puh ding, ziangahtile Jonah in an hnenih thu a sim laiah an sualnak an sir aw a si; thungai in ka lo sim: Jonah hnakih tum sawn hinah a um a si."},"33":{"text":"“Zohman in mei-inn vang tahratin an thup dah lo, a si lole kho an khuh dah keel lo; mei-inn vannak tung parah an ret ih cuticun a ra luttu pawl in khua ṭhatein an hmu a si.","title":"Taksa Pum Tleunak (Mat 5.15 ; 6.22-23)"},"34":{"text":"Nan mit tla cu nan pum hrangah mei-inn bangtuk a si. Nan mit a fim ahcun nan pumpuluk in a tleu ding, asinain nan mit a ṭhat lo ahcun nan pumpuluk in a thim ṭheh ding."},"35":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah nan sungih tleunak hi thimnak a si sal lonak dingah ralring uh."},"36":{"text":"Nan taksa pumpuluk cu malte hman thimnak sungah um loin a tleu ṭheh a si ahcun mei-inn in nan taksa a tlet vekin a tleuzet ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Thu a sim ṭheh tikah Jesuh cu Farasi mi pakhat in rawl ei a sawm; cuhrangah Jesuh cu a feh ih rawl ei dingah a to.","title":"Farasi Le Daanthiam Pawl A Mawhthluk (Mat 23.1-36 ; Mar 12.38-40)"},"38":{"text":"Jesuh cu rawl a ei hlanih a kut a kholh lo kha Farasi pa cun a hmuh tikah a lau ngaingai."},"39":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in a hnenah, “Nannih Farasi pawl cun nan khuat le pakan pawl a lenglam lawng nan kholhfai ṭheu, asinain nan sunglam cu duhhamnak le ṭhat lonak in nan khahter a si."},"40":{"text":"Mi aa pawl! A lenglam a tuahtu Pathian in a sunglam tla a tuah a si lo maw?"},"41":{"text":"Curuangah nan khuat le nan pakan pawl sungih a ummi kha mi farah pawl pe uhla ziang hmuahhmuah nan hrangah a thiang ding a si."},"42":{"text":"Farasi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Hanghnah hangrah sungin puṭinan le remhmui le aithing le a dangdang tla cu ṭhenhra ṭhenkhat nan pek ko naón dingnak le Pathian duhdawt ding cu nan daithlan. A dang khal daithlang cuang loin hi pawl cu nan tuah dingmi an si."},"43":{"text":"Farasi pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Sinakok ah tokham ret sak ciami parih to cu nan duh tuk lawmmam ih sumdawrnak tluan ih upatnak an lo pek tla cu nan sunsak bik."},"44":{"text":"Nan hmakhua a va pit so! Nannih cu hminsinnak a nei lomi thlaan, mi in an theih thiam lo ruangah an pal ṭheu mi thlaan bangtuk nan si,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Cutikah Daanthiam saya pakhat in, “Sayapa, hiti ih na ṭong tikah kannih khal in hmuhsuam ve a si!” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Daanthiam saya pawl, nannih hrang tla-ah nan hmakhua a pit a si! An phurh thei lo ding thilrit khi mi ih zaang parah nan suang ih nanmah cun phurh bawm dingah nan kut zimte hman nan suah zuam lo."},"47":{"text":"Nan hmakhua a pit a si! Nan pupa pawl ih an rak thahmi profet pawl hrangah thlaan ṭhaṭha nan tuah."},"48":{"text":"Cuticun nan pupa pawl ih thil tuahmi cu nan lungkimpi a si ti nan langter; annih in profet pawl an that ih nannih in an thlaan nan tuah."},"49":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian ih Fimnak in ‘An hnenah profet le tirhthlah pawl ka thlah ding; ṭhenkhat an that ding ih a ṭhen an hrem ding,’ a ti."},"50":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah tuih san mi pawl hi leilung hramthok ihsin profet pawl an thah ruangah hrem an si ding."},"51":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Abel thah a tuarnak ihsin thokin biakṭheng le Hmun Thianghlim karlakih an thahmi Zekhariah tiang, thisen a suah ruangah tuih san mi pawl in hrem an tuar ding a si."},"52":{"text":"Nannih Daanthiam saya pawl, nan hmakhua a va pit so! Fimnak inn luhnak sangka tawhfung cu nan keng; cule nanmah nan lut duh lo ih tlunah luh a duhmi pawl nan kham fawn a si,” tiah Jesuh in a ti."},"53":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin Jesuh cu a feh tikah Daanthiam saya pawl le Farasi pawl in nasa zetin an engtai ih thil tampi thu ah thu tampi an sut;"},"54":{"text":"pakhatkhat ṭong sualmi a neih ahcun amah ih ṭong lala ih awk aw dingin thu tampi an suhnak cu a si."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Miburpi a thawngthawng in an tong aw ih an pal awk cupco laiah Jesuh cun a dungthlun pawl hnenah a hmaisa ah hiti in a sim: “Farasi pawl ih thilnu hi ralring uh; an titer awknak thilnu hi!","title":"Titer-aw Pawl Hi Ralring Uh (Mat 10.26-27)"},"2":{"text":"Ziangkhalsiseh khuhmi pohpoh cu on thluh an si ding ih thuthup hmuahhmuah cu phuan ṭheh an si ding."},"3":{"text":"Cuticun khawthim lakih nan simmi thuthup pohpoh kha sun khawvang lakah theihter thluh an si ding ih inn kharhkhumin thupte ih nan simmi cu inn tlun luanglu ihsin aupi a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ka rualle uh, ka lo sim hai: taksa pum lawng a that thei ih cuhnakih besia dang a tuah thei lotu cu va ṭih hlah uh.","title":"Zoso ṭih Ding A Um (Mat 10.28-31)"},"5":{"text":"Zoso ṭih ding sawn, ti ka lo sim hai ding: a thah lawng si loin hell sungih thlak theinak khal thu a neitu Pathian lawng ṭih uh. Fiangtein ka lo sim: Amah hi nan ṭih dingmi cu a si!"},"6":{"text":"Sunṭam panga kha pia hnih ah an zuar a si lo maw? Asinain pakhat hman Pathian in a hngilh lo a si."},"7":{"text":"Nan lu parih samphang hman a siar ṭheh. Curuangah nan thin phang hlah uh; sunṭam tamzet hnakin nan sunglawi sawn a si."},"8":{"text":"“Hitiin ka lo sim: zokhal sisehla keimah ih ta a sinak kha mi hmaiah a phuang ngamtu cu Milai Fapa in Pathian ih vancungmi pawl hmaiah cubangtuk in a phuang ve ding.","title":"Jesuh Khrih Phuannak Le Hnonnak (Mat 10.32-33 ; 12.32 ; 10.19-20)"},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mi hmaiah i hnongtu cu Milai Fapa in Pathian ih vancungmi pawl hmaiah a hnong ve ding."},"10":{"text":"“Zokhal siseh Milai Fapa a simsiatu cu ngaihthiam an si pei; sikhalsehla Thlarau Thianghlim a simsiatu cu ngaihthiam a si lo pei."},"11":{"text":"“Sinakok ah siseh, ram uktu a si lole hotu bawi hmaiah siseh khiing dingih an lo hruai tikah ziangtinso ka ṭan ding ih ziangso ka ṭong ding tiah va helhkam hlah uh."},"12":{"text":"Ziangahtile a cuih caan ah nan ṭong dingmi cu Thlarau Thianghlim in a lo sim ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Misenpi lakih mi pakhat in, “Sayapa, ka pa ih in roh tami rothil in zem ve dingah ka u in sim sak aw,” tiah Jesuh kha a ti.","title":"Milian Aa Pa Ih Tahṭhimnak"},"14":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Ka rual, nan karlakih thuṭhentu si dingah le nan rothil zemsaktu dingah zo in so thu i pek?” tiah a let."},"15":{"text":"Cule mi zapi hnenah cun, “Duhhamnak a phunphun kha ralring uhla fimkhur zetin um uh; ziangahtile mi pakhat ih nunnak taktak cu, ziangtluk milian a si hmanah, a thilri neihmi ahhin a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh in hi tahṭhimnak hi a sim: “Voikhat ah milian pakhat a um ih a ram sung ihsin rawl tampi a suak."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah a thinlung tein ‘Ka lo sungsuak rawl retnak ka nei nawn lo. Ziang ka tuah ah so a ṭhat ding?"},"18":{"text":"Hitiin ka tuah pei: Ka rawl-inn pawl ka bal pei ih tum deuh in ka sak pei. Cunah ka rawl le ka thilri hmuahhmuah ka ret pei."},"19":{"text":"Cule keimah le keimah cu: Mi vannei pa! Kum tampi sung na ṭul dingmi thilri na nei zo. Na duhduh in nung huahho aw; ei aw, in awla nuam zetin nung aw, ka ti aw ding,’ tiah a ruat."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in a hnenah, ‘Mi-aa pa! Tuih zan rori-ah na nunnak hi a cem ding; cule na hrangih na khawlcia mi na thil hmuahhmuah hi zo in so a co ding?’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"21":{"text":"Cun Jesuh in, “Anmah ih hrangah thilri an khawl ih an lianzet naón Pathian mithmuh ah a lian lomi cu himi pa bangtuk an si,” tiah a netnak ah a sim."},"22":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh in dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Cu a si ruangah nan ei dingmi rawl hrangah siseh, nan sinfen ding hnipuan hrangah siseh, donhar in um hlah uh, tiah ka lo sim.","title":"Pathian Rinsan Uh (Mat 6.25-34)"},"23":{"text":"Ziangahtile nunnak cu rawl hnakin a thupi sawn ih taksapum cu hnipuan hnakin a thupi sawn a si."},"24":{"text":"Tlangak khi zohhnik uh; annih in thlaici an tuh lo ih rawl khal an khawm fawn lo. Rawl-inn le cuam khal an nei lo. Asinain Pathian in a cawm hai. Nannih tla cu vate hnakin a let tampi in nan sunglawi sawn a si."},"25":{"text":"Nanmah lakah zotal in ei-in le sinfen thu a helhkamnak in a nunnak malte a sauter theitu nan um maw?"},"26":{"text":"Cutluk thil fate hman nan tuah thei lo a si ahcun ziangah so thil dangdang thu cu nan helhkam duh rero?"},"27":{"text":"Hramlak pangpar tla khi ziangvekin an ṭhang ti zohhnik uh: hna an ṭuan lo, sinfen an zaal fawn lo. Sikhalsehla thungai in ka lo sim: Siangpahrang Solomon ih lennak le sunlawinak hmuahhmuah hman in hi pangpar pakhat ih mawinak hi a tluk lo."},"28":{"text":"Tuihsun ah a um naón thaisun ahcun a um nawn lomi, meisa sungih paih-mi hramlak hrampi hman khi a thuamtu cu Pathian a si. Nannih tla cu a lo thuam sinsin lo ding maw si? Nan zumnak a mal tuk lawmmam!"},"29":{"text":"“Ei ding le in ding thu lawng ruat le helhkam ringringin um hlah uh."},"30":{"text":"Ziangahtile leilung tlunih khawvel mi pawl in cubangtuk thil cu an ruah ringringmi a si. Nan Pa in hi bangtuk thil nan ṭul ti cu a thei."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah nan Pa ih Uknak kha helhkam in hawl sawn uhla thil dang pawl cu a lo pe leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Tuurun tete tla, nan thinphang hlah uh; ziangahtile nan hnenah Uknak pek cu nan Pa ih lungawi zawng a si.","title":"Vancung Ih Lennak (Mat 6.19-21)"},"33":{"text":"Nan neihmi thilri pawl zuar ṭheh uhla nan ngahmi tangka cu mifarah pawl ṭhen uh. A siat thei lomi tangka bawm nan hrangah ngaihtuah uhla vancung ah nan sumsaw pawl khawl uh. Cutawkah cun fifir in an dai thei lo ding ih a tlap thei fawn lo ruangah ziangtik khalah a hloral dah lo ding."},"34":{"text":"Ziangahtile nan sumsaw umnak ah nan thinlung khal a um ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Ziangbangtuk thil a ra thlen khalle ralring ciain um uhla nan mei-inn vangin timlaam ciain um uh.","title":"Ralrinnak A Nei Mi Hnen-um"},"36":{"text":"Mopuai ihsin a ra kir dingmi an bawipa a hngaktu hnen-um pawl bangin ralring zetin um uh. An bawipa cu a rat ih sangka a king tikah hmakhatte ah sangka cu an ong ding."},"37":{"text":"An bawipa a ra kir tikah itthat loteih ralrinnak a neimi hnen-um pawl cu ziangtluk lungawiza so an si. Thungai in ka lo sim: a tim a tuah hnuah a toter ding ih amah rori in a tuamhlawm hai ding."},"38":{"text":"Zanṭim ih a ra kirah siseh, cuhnak tlai ih a kir khalah siseh, ralrinnak nei ih a ra hmuhmi pawl cu an hrangah ziangtluk lungawiza so a si!"},"39":{"text":"Cule hihi ciing uh: inn neitu pa in fifir ratnak ding tikcu kha a theih cia ahcun a inn kha a bauhter hrimhrim lo ding."},"40":{"text":"Cuvekin nannih khal ralringte in um uh, ziangahtile a ra ding tiih nan zum lo laiah Milai Fapa cu a ra thleng ding a si,” a ti."},"41":{"text":"Piter in, “Bawipa, hi tahṭhimnak hi kanmah ih hrangah na timi a si maw, asilole misenpi hrangah so?” tiah a sut.","title":"Rintlak Le Rintlak Lo Hnen-um (Mat 24.45-51)"},"42":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Zoso rinsan tlak le a fimmi hnen-um cu a si? Rinsan tlak le a fimmi hnen-um cu a bawipa in a innpi kilkhawitu dingah le a dang hnen-um pawl kha a tikcu caan te ih an covo rawl pe dingah a ret dingmi hnen-um kha a si."},"43":{"text":"A bawipa innih a ra kir tikah hna a rak ṭuan rerotu hnen-um cu ziangtluk lungawiza so a si!"},"44":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: cuih hnen-um cu a bawipa in a thilri hmuahhmuah kilkhawitu-ah a ret ding."},"45":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cuih hnen-um in, ‘Ka bawipa cu a rei hrih ding,’ a tiih hnen-um dang nunau siseh mipa siseh a thawi vivo ih a ei a in ih a riit a bah ahcun,"},"46":{"text":"cuih hnen-um in a ra ding ti a zum lo caan le a theih lo ni ah a bawipa cu a ra thleng ding. A bawipa in a satcip seksek ding ih thulung lo le rintlak lo pawl lakah a re ding."},"47":{"text":"A bawipa in tuahter a duhmi hnaṭuan a thei naón tiimlaam a tuah lotu hnen-um cu nasa zetih vuak a tong ding."},"48":{"text":"Asinain a bawipa in tuahter a duhmi a thei lo naón thil pakhatkhat a tuahtu hnen-um cu vuak tlak a si khalle dimte deuh ih vuak a tong ding. Tampi a ngahtu hnen ihsin tampi dil sal a si ding. Tam ngaingai pek a si mi hnen ihsin tam ngaingai dil sal a si ve ko ding,” a ti."},"49":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Leilung tlunah hin meisa kangter dingah ka ra thleng; atu-ah hin alh thlang sehla ka va duh so!","title":"Jesuh Cu ṭhenṭhektu A Si (Mat 10.34-36)"},"50":{"text":"Baptisma lak ding ka nei ih cumi tuah ṭheh a si hlan cu ka thinlung a baangzet."},"51":{"text":"Leilung tlun ahhin remnak a run keng tiah maw si in ruat? A si lo, remnak si loin ṭhenṭheknak sawn ka run keng a si."},"52":{"text":"Atu thok ihsin innsungsaang pakhat ih mi panga a ummi pawl cu an ṭhen aw ding; pathum in a dang pahnih kha an engtai ding ih pahnih in pathum kha an engtai ve ding."},"53":{"text":"Pale in an fapa pawl an engtai ding ih fapa pawl in an pale pawl an engtai ve ding. Nule in an fanu pawl an engtai ding ih an fanu pawl in an nule pawl an engtai ve ding. Nile pawl in an vahle pawl an engtai ding ih an vahle pawl in an nile pawl khal an engtai ve ding,” a ti."},"54":{"text":"Jesuh in misenpi hnenah, “Nitlaknak lam ihsin khawdur a suah tikah hmakhatte ah ‘Ruah a sur ding,’ nan tiih a sur ngaingai.","title":"Caan Theihthiamnak (Mat 16.2-3)"},"55":{"text":"Cule thlanglam ihsin thli a hran nan theih tikah ‘Thaw a sa ding,’ nan tiih a sa ngaingai."},"56":{"text":"Nannih titer awk thiam pawl! Van le leilung nan zoh ih ni khua ṭhat ding le siat ding nan sim thei! Cuti asilekhaw ziangah so tuih sanih thu-umzia nan theih thiam lo?” tiah a ti."},"57":{"text":"Ziangah so thil dik tuah dingah nan thinlung nan ṭhen cat thei lo?","title":"Nan Ral Thawn Rem Aw Uh (Mat 5.25-26)"},"58":{"text":"Mi pakhat in a lo khiing ih zung a lo thlenpi tum a si ahcun zung a lo thlenpi ngah hlanah amah thawn remnak tuah dingah va zuam aw. Cuti na tuah lo ahcun thuṭhentu hmai tiang a lo dir ding ih thuṭhentu in palik kut ah a lo pe ding ih cuticun thawng ah thlak na si ding."},"59":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: na kuan dingmi a neta bik pia khat tiang na kuan ṭheh hlan lo cutawk ihsin na suak hrimhrim lo ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Culai ahcun mi ṭhenkhat in Jesuh hnenah, Galilee mi pawl in Pathian hnenih thawinak an pek laifangah Pilat ih a thahmi pawl thu kha an sim.","title":"Nan Nun Daan ṭhin Uh"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Cuih Galilee mi pawl cutiih thah an si ruangah midang Galilee mi hnakin an sual sawn, tiah nan ruat maw si?"},"3":{"text":"An sual deuh cuang lo! Fiangtein ka lo sim: Nan sual nan sir ih nan nun daan nan ṭhin lo ahcun anmah vekin nan thi ṭheh ve ko ding."},"4":{"text":"Siloam hmunih donhleisang a tluuk tikah minung hleiriat a nenthatmi pawl thu kha teh ziangtinso nan ruat? Cutiih an thih ruangah Jerusalem ih a ummi midang pawl hnakin an sual cuang a si ti a langter tiah nan ruat maw si?"},"5":{"text":"A si hrimhrim lo! Fiangtein ka lo sim: Nan sual nan sir ih nan nun daan nan thleng lo ahcun anmah vekin nan thi ṭheh ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah hiti in tahṭhimnak a sim: “Hlanlaiah mi pakhat in a hmuan sungah theipi kung pakhat a cing. A rah le rah lo a va zoh ṭheu ih a rah a hmu dah lo.","title":"A Rah Lomi Theipi Kung Tahṭhimnak"},"7":{"text":"Curuangah hmuan kiltu hnenah, ‘Zohhnik, hi theipi hi! Kum thum tiang rori a rah maw rah lo, tiah ka ra veh ṭheu naón a rah zianghman ka hmu lo. Hau mai aw! Ziangah so leiram ṭha a ei rero ding?’ a ti."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hmuan kiltu in ‘Bawipa, kum khatte cu zuah hrih ko aw! A kimvel in leilung ka lai ding ih dawm ka burh hrih ding."},"9":{"text":"Cule a hnakum ah rah a rah asile lungawiza a si ding; a rah thotho lo asile hauter leh siseh,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"10":{"text":"Voikhat ah Sabbath ni ah Jesuh in sinakok ah thu a zirh.","title":"Sabbath Ni Ah Nunau A Damter"},"11":{"text":"Cutawkah khawsia ih polhmi nunau pakhat a um. Cuih khawsia cun kum hleiriat sung a ngorter; a el tla a kuun ṭheh ih dingtein a um thei hrimhrim lo."},"12":{"text":"Cunu cu Jesuh in a hmuh tikah a hei auh ih, “Nunau nu, na natnak ihsin na luat zo!” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"A parah a kut a suang ih hmakhatte ah dingtein a um thei ih Pathian kha a thangṭhat."},"14":{"text":"Sinakok kiltu upa pakhat cu Sabbath ni ah Jesuh in mi a damter ruangah a thin a heng ih mipi hnenah a ṭong ih, “Hnaṭuannak dingah ni ni ruk a um; cuih ni ruk sungah cun ra uhla damter aw uh; Sabbath ni ahcun si hlahseh,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, “Titer aw pawl! Zokhal si uhla Sabbath ni ah nan caw le nan laak pawl an hri nan phoih ih tidai innak ah nan fehpi ciar a si."},"16":{"text":"Atu hitawk ah hin Abraham tesinfa Satan in kum hleiriat sung ṭemhrennak a tuartu a um; anih hi a ṭemhrennak ihsin Sabbath ni ah luatter a si lo ding maw?” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"A thulehnak cun a ral pawl cu an ningzak koin a tuah; cule mipi pawl cu khawruahhar thil tampi a tuah ruangah an lung a awi ngaingai."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Pathian Uknak cu ziang bangtuk so a si? Ziang thawn so ka ṭhim ding?","title":"Anṭam Ci Tahṭhimnak (Mat 13.31-32 ; Mar 4.30-32)"},"19":{"text":"Mi pakhat in anṭam ci a lak ih a lo sungih a vorhmi bangtuk a si. A vorhmi cu a kho, a ṭhang ih thingkung ah a cang ih a ṭeek parah vate tla in bu an tuah a si,” tiah a sim."},"20":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Pathian Uknak cu ziang thawn so ka tahṭhim ding?","title":"Thilnu Tahṭhimnak (Mat 13.33)"},"21":{"text":"Nunau pakhat in thilnu malte a lak ih sangphut bawm khat sungah a phulh ih sangphut cu a zatein a thoter ṭhehtu thilnu bangtuk cu a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerusalem lam pan ih a feh laiah khua pakhat hnu pakhat pal phahin thu a zirh vivo.","title":"A Fiakmi Sangka (Mat 7.13-14 , 21-23)"},"23":{"text":"Mi pakhat in, “Bawipa, runnak a ngahtu hi mi malte lawng maw an si ding?” tiah a sut. Jesuh cun hiti in a let."},"24":{"text":"“A fiakmi sangka ihsin luh zuam uh; ziangahtile mi tampi in cuih sung luh cu an zuam rero ding naón an ti thei lo ding."},"25":{"text":"Inn neitu bawi a pok ding ih sangka cu a khar ding; cule a lengah dingin sangka cu nan king ding ih ‘Bawipa, sangka in rak on hram aw,’ nan ti khalle ‘Khuitawk ihsin nan rat ka thei lo,’ a lo ti ding."},"26":{"text":"Cule nannih in, ‘Nangmah thawn rawl kan ei tlang ih tidai khal kan in tlang a si kha! Kan khawsungah tla thu in zirh rero kha!’ tiah nan ti ding."},"27":{"text":"Sikhalsehla anih cun ‘Khuitawk ihsin a rami nan si ka thei lo. Nannih miṭha lo pawl, ka hnen ihsin tlan ṭheh uh,’ tiah a lo ti ding."},"28":{"text":"Nannih pawl cu a lengah hlonhlo nan si ding ih Abraham, Isaak le Jakob le profet hmuahhmuah tla cu Pathian Uknak sungih an um kha nan hmu lai ding; cutikah nannih cu nan ṭap nan raak ding ih nan hacang nan rial ciamco ding a si."},"29":{"text":"Nisuahlam le nitlaklam in siseh, saklam le thlanglam khal in siseh, mi an ra ding ih Pathian Uknak rawl ei puai ah an tokhawm ding."},"30":{"text":"Cutikah cun atu-ih a neta bik hi hmaisa bik an si ding ih hmaisa bik hi neta bik an si leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cuih caanah Farasi mi ṭhenkhat pawl Jesuh hnenah an ra ih, “Herod in thah a lo duh ruangah hitawk in suak awla hmun dangah feh aw,” tiah an ti.","title":"Jesuh In Jerusalem A Duhdawt (Mat 23.37-39)"},"32":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Va feh uhla cuih cinghnia pa cu ‘Tuihsun le thaisun cu khawsia pawl ka dawisuak pei ih mina pawl ka damter lai ding. Cule a ni thumnak ah ka hnaṭuan cu ka ṭheh ding a ti,’ tiah va sim uh."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah tuihsun, thaisun le tipsun cu ka feh vivo hrih ko ding. Jerusalem khawsung siar lo hmun dangah profet thah ding cu a cang lo a si."},"34":{"text":"“Maw Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Profet pawl na that ih na hnenah Pathian in palai a tirhthlahmi pawl tla lungto in na deng. Arpi in a thla hnuai ah a faate pawl a huh vekin na minung pawl cu voi tampi ka kut in hum ka duh naón in sen dah lo!"},"35":{"text":"Curuangah nan Biakinn cu hmun ṭhing ah a cang ding. Fiangtein ka lo sim: ‘Bawipa ih hminin a rami cu Pathian in thlawsuah hram seh,’ tiah nan sim thei caan a thlen hlan cu ka hmel in hmu nawn lo ding a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Voikhat cu Sabbath ni ah Jesuh cu Farasi hotu lakih pakhat ih inn ah rawl zawh dingin a feh; cule misenpi cun ṭhatein an rak thlir ringring.","title":"Jesuh In Mina Pa A Damter"},"2":{"text":"Mi pakhat a kut le a ke a thling thluhmi mina cu Jesuh hnenah a ra ih,"},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in Daanthiam pawl le Farasi mi pawl kha, “Kan Daan in Sabbath ni ah mina damter ding a on maw on lo so?” tiah a sut."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla annih cun zianghman an ṭong lo. Jesuh in mina pa cu a hruai ih a damter ih a thlah."},"5":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in an hnenah, “Nanmah lakah mi pakhat cu a fapa maw a caw si maw Sabbath ni ah tikhur sungah tla pang sehla Sabbath ni a si ruangah suah loin maw nan um ding?” tiah a sut."},"6":{"text":"Hi thu-ah zianghman an sawn thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Rawl zawhnak hmunah mi ṭhenkhat pawl in tonak ṭha bik an hril ṭheu kha Jesuh in a hmuh ruangah hi tahṭhimnak hi an zate hnenah a sim:","title":"Khualṭhatnak Le Lungnemnak"},"8":{"text":"“Mopuai ah an lo kawh asile tonak ṭha bik cuh hlah uh. Nangmah hnakih mi upa sawn an sawm khal a si thei;"},"9":{"text":"nan pahnih a lo sawmtu innteek pa in na hnenah ra tahratin, ‘Na tonak hi kian aw,’ tiah a lo tiih hmun niam bikih na vung to sal tikah cun na ning a zakzet ding."},"10":{"text":"Cuhnak cun an lo sawm tikah hmun niam bikah va to awla a lo sawmtu innteek pa a ra ding ih, ‘Ka rual, tonak ṭha deuhah hin hung to aw,’ tiah a lo ti ding. Cutikah sawmmi misenpi hmaiah mithmaiṭha na ngah ding."},"11":{"text":"Ziangahtile amah le amah a uang awtu cu mi nauta ah tuah a si ding ih, lungnem tangdor ih a umtu cu hmaizahnak ngahtu upa-ah a cang ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in innteek pa hnenah cun, “Thaithawh siseh zanriah siseh, eitlang dingih mi na sawm tikah na rualpi pawl, na unau pawl, a si lole na sungkhat pawl le na innhnen milian pawl kha va sawm hlah; ziangahtile annih pawl cun nangmah kha an lo sawm thei leh ve ding ih na thil tuahmi kha an lo samsaal thei ding."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla rawl na daar tikah farah zonzai pawl, a zengmi pawl, ke-awl pawl le mitcaw pawl kha va sawm hai aw;"},"14":{"text":"annih pawl cun an lo samsaal thei lo ding hrangah malsawm dongtu na si ding. Miṭha pawl thihnak ihsin an thawhsal ni ah Pathian in a lo samsaal leh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cuih thu cu rawl ei-nak cabuai ih an sawm vemi pakhat in a theih tikah Jesuh hnenah cun, “Pathian Uknak sung rawldarnak puai ih a telmi pawl cu an lung a va awi ding so!” tiah a ti.","title":"Rawl Daarnak Puai Thawn Tahṭhimnak (Mat 22.1-10)"},"16":{"text":"Jesuh in cupa hnenah cun, “Voikhat ah mi pakhat a um ih rawl daarnak puai tumpi a tuah ih mi tampi a sawm."},"17":{"text":"Rawl ei caan a cut tikah a sawm ciami pawl hnenah a hnen-um a thlah. ‘Ra thlang uh, ziang hmuahhmuah timtuah a si zo,’ tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla pakhat hnu pakhat ‘Ka man lo,’ tiin puhmawh ding an hawl fingfing. Pakhat pa in ‘Lo pakhat ka lei ih ka va zohta a ṭul a si. I rak ngaithiam aw,’ tiah hnen-um pa cu a ti."},"19":{"text":"A dang pakhat pa in ‘Cawcang khuah nga ka lei ih atu-ah an ṭha maw ṭha lo ka hniksak ding. I rak ngaithiam hram aw,’ a ti ve."},"20":{"text":"A dang pakhat pa in ‘Tubaite ah nupi ka ṭhi ngelcel ih ka ra thei lo ding,’ a ti lala."},"21":{"text":"Hnen-um pa cu a kir ih cuih thu pawl cu a bawipa ih hnenah a sim ṭheh. A bawipa cu a ai a thok ih a hnen-um pa hnenah cun, ‘Zamrang zetin khawsung lamzinpi le innlak zinte ah va feh awla mi farah, mi zonzai, kutzeng kezeng, mitcaw le ke-awl pawl rak hruai aw,’ tiah a fial."},"22":{"text":"Rei lote-ah hnen-um pa cun ‘Bawipa, na thu pekmi vekin ka tuah ṭheh zo; asinain umnak tampi a lawng lai,’ tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah a bawipa cun, ‘Khua pakhat le pakhat karlak lamzinpi le lamzinte hmuahhmuah ah va feh awla ka inn a khah ṭheh hlan lo mi rak hruai hai aw."},"24":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Ka rak sawm ciami pawl sungin zohman in ka zanriah daarmi an tep lo pei,’ a ti,” tiah a sim."},"25":{"text":"Voikhat ah mi tamzet in Jesuh cu an thlun vivo laiah an lamah Jesuh cu a her ih,","title":"Dungthluntu Si Man Harnak (Mat 10.37-38)"},"26":{"text":"“Zokhal siseh ka hnenah a ra ih a nu le pa, a nupi le faate pawl, a unau le a farnu pawl le amah le amah khal keimah hnakih a duh deuh a si ahcun ka dungthluntu a si thei lo ding."},"27":{"text":"Zokhal sisehla amah ih thinglamtah phur tahratin ka dungih i thlun lotu cu ka dungthluntu a si thei lo ding."},"28":{"text":"“Nanmah lakah pakhatkhat in inn saangpi sak a tum a si ahcun hmaisabik ah tote ciamciam in a inn sak ṭhehnak dingah tangka kimtein a neih le neih lo kha a tuak ṭhehta a si lo maw?"},"29":{"text":"Cutiin a tuak ṭheh hmaisa lo a si ahcun a hnaṭuan dingmi cu a thok ngah hnu-ah sak ṭheh loin a taang ding ih a rak hmutu hmuahhmuah in an hnihsan ding."},"30":{"text":"‘A hei thok ve naón a ṭheh thei si lo!’ an ti ding."},"31":{"text":"“Ralkap thawnghra a neimi siangpahrang pakhat in siangpahrang dang pakhat ralkap thawngkul thawn amah do dingih a rami kha, a do tum a si ahcun hmaisabik ah to ciamciamin cuih siangpahrang dang do theinak ding thazaang a neih le neih lo a ruat hmaisa a ṭul a si."},"32":{"text":"Do theinak thazaang a neih lo a si ahcun cuih siangpahrang dang hnenah, lam hlapi ih a um laiah, remnak tuah dingah a palai pawl a thlah ding a si."},"33":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in nannih tla nan neihmi hmuahhmuah nan tanta lo ahcun keimah ih dungthluntu nan si thei lo pei,” tiah Jesuh in a sim."},"34":{"text":"“Cite cu a ṭhazet, asinain a alnak a ziam asile alter sal ngaihnak a um nawn lo.","title":"Man Nei Lo Cite (Mat 5.13 ; Mar 9.50)"},"35":{"text":"Leilung hrangah san a tlai lo ih dawm hrang hmanah a ṭhahnem nawn lo. A lakih hlonhlo ding men a si thlang. Hi thu hi theihnak hna a neitu in thei uh,” tiah Jesuh in a ti."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Voikhat ah siahkhongtu pawl le misual tiih hnonmi pawl tampi cu Jesuh thusimmi ngai dingah a hnenah an ra.","title":"A Hlomi Tuu (Mat 18.12-14)"},"2":{"text":"Cutikah Farasi mi pawl le daanthiam pawl cu an phunzai ih, “Hi pa hin hnonmi misual tla a rak kom ih an hnenah rawl tla a ei a si!” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh in a tanglam tahṭhimnak hi a sim."},"4":{"text":"“Thuṭhimnak ah nanmah lakah mi pakhat in tuu zakhat nei in tuu pakhat hlo bang sehla ziangsi a tuah ding? Tuu sawmkua le pakua kha hramlak ah a tanta ding ih a hlomi a ngah sal hlan lo a hawl ciamco ding."},"5":{"text":"A hmuh tikah a lung a awi tuk ih liangpulut tahratin,"},"6":{"text":"inn ah a tlunpi. Cule a rualpi le a innhnen pawl ko khawm in ‘A hlomi ka tuu ka hmu sal ih ka lung a awi ngaingai. Curuangah lungawi in lawm uhsi,’ tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cubangtuk in sual sirnak a ṭul lomi miṭha sawmkua le pakua hnakin a sual a sirmi misual pakhat hrangah vancungah lungawinak a tamsawn ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"“Cu a si lole, nunau pakhat in tangka fang hra nei sehla fang khat a thlau ahcun ziangso a tuah ding? Mei-inn vang tahratin a inn kha a phiat ih a hmuh sal hlanlo a kel le a kawm tiangin a hawl ṭheh.","title":"A Hlomi Tangka"},"9":{"text":"A hmuh sal tikah a rualpi pawl le innhnen pawl a ko khawm ih ‘Ka thlaumi tangka ka ngah sal zo; curuangah lungawi in lawm uhsi,’ tiah a ti ding."},"10":{"text":"Cubangtuk in sual sirnak a neimi misual pakhat hrangah Pathian ih vancungmi pawl an lung a awizet a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in hiti in a sim. “Voikhat ah mi pakhat a um ih fapa pahnih a nei.","title":"A Hlomi Fapa"},"12":{"text":"A nauta sawn cun a pa hnenah, ‘Ka pa, ka co dingmi rothil atu-ah i pe aw,’ tiah a dil. Curuangah an pa cun a ro thil hmuahhmuah cu a ṭhen ih a fapa pahnih cu a zem."},"13":{"text":"Ni rei loteah fapa nauta sawn cun a comi thilri cu a zuar ṭheh ih a ngahmi tangka thawn inn ihsin a suak. Ram hlapi ah a feh ih tenrennak zianghman um loin a tangka cu a duhduh in a thehvorh ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"A neihmi hmuahhmuah cu a hmang ral ṭheh. Cule cuih ram sungah paampi a tlung ih neihmi zianghman a nei nawn lo."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah cuih ramih mi pakhat hnenah a hna ṭuansak dingah a feh ih cupa cun vok kilkhawi dingin a lo ah a fehter."},"16":{"text":"Vok ih an eimi be-hawng kha puar zetin ei sehla a duh zet naón zohman in ei ding zianghman an pe fawn lo."},"17":{"text":"A neta bikah a thinlung a hung fim ih, ‘Ka pa ih hlawhfa pawl cun ei cawk loin rawl ei ding an nei; asinain kei cu hinah ei ding zianghman nei loin ka thi cuahco thlang!"},"18":{"text":"Ka tho pei ih ka pa hnenah ka feh ding. Ka pa, Pathian parah le na parah ka sual zo."},"19":{"text":"Na fapa si dingah ka tlak nawn lo; na hnaṭuantu na sal pakhat ah i tuah hram aw, tiah ka va ti pei,’ tiah a ruat."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah a pa ih hnen kir dingin a pok. “Lam hlatpi ih a rat rero lai kha inn ihsin a pa in a hei hmu. A zaangfah ngaingai ih va tlan tahratin a fapa cu a kuah ih a hnam."},"21":{"text":"A fapa cun, ‘Ka pa, Pathian parah le na parah ka sual zo. Na fa tiih kawh ding ka tlak nawn lo,’ tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a pa cun a hnen-um pawl a ko ih, ‘Zamrang in ra uh! Hnipuan ṭha bik rak keng uhla hrukter uh. A kutah zunghruk hrukter uhla a ke ah kedam dam uh."},"23":{"text":"Cule caw faate a thau bik kha va that uhla lungawinak puai tuah uhsi!"},"24":{"text":"Ziangahtile hi ka fapa cu a thizo naón a nung sal; a hlozo naón hmuhsal a si,’ tiah a ti. Cuticun lungawi puai cu an tuah."},"25":{"text":"“Cu laifangah fapa upa sawn cu lo ah a rak feh. Lo ihsin a ra tlung ih inn kiang a ra thlen tikah hlasak thawm le laam thawm a thei."},"26":{"text":"Cuhrangah hnen-um pakhat a ko ih ‘Ziang so an tuah ciamco?’ tiah a sut."},"27":{"text":"Cuih hnen-um cun, ‘Na naupa a ra kir sal zo, himdamte ih a ra kir sal ruangah na pa in a thaumi caw faate a thah,’ tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"“A fapa upa sawn cu a thin a heng tuk ih innsung hmanah a lut duh lo. Curuangah a pa a ra suak ih innsungih rung lut dingin a leem."},"29":{"text":"Asinain a fapa cun, ‘Vun ruat hnik! Kum hizat liangluang sal bangin na hna ka ṭuan ih na thu voikhat hman ka lo el dah lo. Ziang so kei i pek? Ka rualpi pawl thawn nomnak puai tuahnak ah me pakhat hman i pe dah lo!"},"30":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hi na fapa cu hlawhhlang pawl thawn nomnak ah na thilri hmuahhmuah a thehvorh ṭheh ih na hnenih a ra kir sal tikah a thaumi caw faate na thah sak!’ tiah a pa cu a ti."},"31":{"text":"A pa cun, ‘Ka fapa, nang cu ka hnenah na um ringring ih ka neihmi thil hmuahhmuah hi nangmah ih ta an si."},"32":{"text":"Asinain na naupa cu a thi ih atu-ah a nung sal; a hlozo naón atu cu ka hmu sal; cuhrangah lungawi aipuang in puai tuah tlak hrimhrim a si,’ a ti,” tiah Jesuh in a sim."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Voikhat ah milianzet pakhat a um ih a thilri kilkhawitu dingah siahhlawh pakhat a nei. Cuih a siahhlawh pa cun na tangka a thehvorh a si, tiah a bawipa cu an sim.","title":"Thil Kilkhawitu Mi Hrokhrawl"},"2":{"text":"Cuhrangah a hnenah a ko ih ‘Na thu ka theihmi hi ziangtinso a si? Ka thilri na kilnak cazin kimtein i pe aw; ziangahtile ka thilri kilkhawitu na si thei nawn lo ding,’ tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah a siahhlawh pa cun ‘Ka bawipa in ka hnaṭuan ihsin i dawi tum a si hi! Ziang so ka tuah pei? Leilung lai ding le ka ti thei lo; mi thil dil ih um ding le ka ning a zak fawn."},"4":{"text":"Asinain thil pakhat tuah ding ka thei! Ka hnaṭuan a cem tikah an innih i umter siangtu rualpi ṭha ka neih a ṭul ding,’ tiah a thinlung in a ruat."},"5":{"text":"Cuhrangah a bawipa hnenih leiba a neitu hmuahhmuah a ko khawm. Pakhatnak pa cu ‘Ziangzat so ka bawipa na baak?’ tiah a sut."},"6":{"text":"Anih in ‘Olif hriak pung zakhat,’ tiah a let. Thilri kilkhawitu pa cun ‘Hihi na cazin a si ding: to awla pung sawmnga, tiah ngan aw,’ tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule a dang pakhat pa cu, ‘Nangteh ziangzatso na baak?’ tiah a sut. Anih in, ‘sangvut dip thawngkhat,’ tiah a let. Thilri kilkhawitu pa cun, ‘Hihi na cazin a si ding: dip zariat, tiah ngan aw,’ tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Hi mihrokhrawl thilri kilkhawitu pa hi cubangtuk in fimvar zetih thil ti a thiam ruangah a bawipa in a porhzet, ziangahtile hi leilungtlun mi pawl hi anmah ih thu tawlrelnak ahcun tleunak sungih a ummi pawl hnakin an fimvar sawn a si,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Cuti a si ruangah hiti in ka lo sim: leilung tlunih sumsaw hmangin rualpi tuah uh, ziangahtile leilung thilri a cem tikah kumkhua a hmunmi inn ah luhter nan si ding."},"10":{"text":"Thil fate ih rintlak a si mi cu thil tumpi khalah rintlak a si ding; thil fate thu-ah zumtlak lo a si mi cu thil tumpi thu khalah zumtlak lo a si ding."},"11":{"text":"Leilung thilri nan tawlrelnak hmanah rintlak lo nan si ahcun ziangtinso lennak taktak cu nan hnenah pek nan si thei ding?"},"12":{"text":"Cule midang thilri par hmanah rinsantlak nan si lo ahcun nanmah ih co dingmi ngaingai cu zo in so a lo pek duh ding?"},"13":{"text":"Mi pakhat cu bawi pahnih ih sal a si thei lo. Pakhat a hua ding ih pakhat kha a duh ding; pakhat hnenah rinsantlak in a nung ding ih pakhat tu cu a nautat ding. Pathian le sumsaw cu nan rian tlang thei lo,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cuih thu pawl cu Farasi mi pawl in an theih tikah tangka duh tuk pawl an si ruangah Jesuh kha an hnihsan.","title":"Jesuh Ih ṭongmi Pawl (Mat 11.12-13 ; 5.31-32 ; Mar 10.11-12)"},"15":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Miseenpi hmaiah cun miding bikah nan lang awter; asinain Pathian cun nan thinlung a thei ṭheh. Ziangahtile minung in man nei zetih nan ruahmi cu Pathian mithmuh ahcun zianghman a si lo."},"16":{"text":"“Moses ih Daan le profet ih canganmi pawl cu baptisma petu Johan san tiang hrang lawngah a si. Cuihhnu cun Pathian Uknak Thuthang ṭha cu phuan a si ih zozo khal hranhram ih luh an tum."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Daan sungih cafang fate bik hloh hnakin van le leilung hloh ṭheh a ol sawn."},"18":{"text":"“Zokhal a nupi a ma ih nunau dang a ṭhitu cu ṭaangṭawm sualnak a tuah; cule maakmi nu a ṭhitu cu ṭaangṭawm sualnak a tuah ve a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"“Voikhat ah milianzet pakhat a um ih hnipuan mankhung bik in a thuam aw ih nitin rawl thawthaw ei in nuam zetin a nung.","title":"Milian Pa Le Lazaras Thu"},"20":{"text":"Lazaras an timi mi farahzet pakhat a um ve ih a pumpuluk in hma a khat ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Milian pa ih cabuai ihsin a tlami rawl ṭilfuan sar dingah milian pa ih sangka ah an hruai ṭheu. Uico an ra ih a hma cu an ra liak ṭheu."},"22":{"text":"Mifarah pa cu a thi ih vancungih rawl ei-nak puai ah Abraham kiangih to dingah vancungmi pawl in an fehpi. Milian pa cu a thi ve ih an phum;"},"23":{"text":"cule Hell sungah a tla ih harzet in a tuar. Cuphah in tlunlam a hun zoh ih lamhlatzet ah Abraham le a kiangih Lazaras kha a hun hmu."},"24":{"text":"Cule a au ih, ‘Ka pa Abraham, i zaangfah hram aw. Lazaras kha fial awla a kutzung kha tidaiah hnim sehla ka lei daiter dingah ti i run forhseh; ziangahtile hi meisa sungah ka tuar a har tuk a si!’ tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Abraham in, ‘Ka fapa, vun ruat hnik! Na nun sungah khan thil ṭha hmuahhmuah na ngah ṭheh zo ih Lazaras cun thil ṭha lo lawnglawng a co. Asinain atu-ah cun anih cu hitawk ah hin nunnuam in a um ih nang cu harnak na tuar a si!"},"26":{"text":"Cuih tlunah kan karlakah Kawhrum tluan thukpi a um ih curuangah hitawk ihsin na hnenah rat a duhmi zohman an ra thei lo ih na umnak ihsin kan umnak khalah hin rat duhtu an um khalle an ra thei lo a si,’ a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cutikah milian pa cun ‘Cuti a si ahcun, maw ka pa Abraham, ka pa ih inn ah Lazaras kha hei thlah hram aw."},"28":{"text":"Cutawkah unau panga ka nei. Lazaras kha va feh sehla annih tal cu hitawk tuarnak hmunah hin an ra thlen lonak dingah ralrinnak va pe seh, tiah zaangfah ka dil a si,’ a ti."},"29":{"text":"Abraham cun, ‘Na unau pawl ralrinnak petu dingah Moses le profet pawl an um a si. An simmi kha rak ngai hai seh,’ a ti."},"30":{"text":"Milian pa cun, ‘Ka pa Abraham, cuti lawng cun a tawk lo. Mi pakhat thihnak ihsin a tho ih an hnen a thlen ahcun an nunsualnak cu an ṭhin ding,’ tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Abraham cun, ‘Moses le profet pawl ih thu an ngai duh lo a si ahcun mi pakhat thihnak ihsin tho hmansehla an lung duh cuang lo ding,’ a ti,” tiah Jesuh in a sim."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Sualnak sungih mi a tlatertu thil cu a ra thleng ringring ko ding; asinain cuih thil a thlentertu ih hrangah cun tuksumza a si.","title":"Sualnak (Mat 18.6-7 , 21-22 ; Mar 9.42)"},"2":{"text":"Hi nauhak pakhatkhat a sualter hnak cun a hngawng ah fang rialnak lungtumpi kha thlaih tahratin tifinriat sungah hlon sehla amah hrangah a ṭhasawn."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah thil nan tuahmi ah ralring uh. Na unau a sual ahcun nunsim aw; a sir awk ahcun ngaithiam aw."},"4":{"text":"Na parah ni khat sungah voi sarih tiang sual hmansehla na hnenah ra tahratin ‘Ka sual ka sir aw a si,’ a ti ahcun ngaithiam aw,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl in, “Kan zumnak hi ṭhangter sin aw,” tiah an Bawipa cu an ti.","title":"Zumnak"},"6":{"text":"An Bawipa cun, “Nannih in anṭam ci tia zumnak nan neih ahcun hi thingtheihmu kung hi ‘Na hram in phong aw awla tifinriat sungah va phun aw aw,’ nan ti thei ding ih nan ti vekin a cang ngaingai ding."},"7":{"text":"“Thuṭhimnak ah nanmah lakah pakhatkhat in hnen-um pakhat a nei tibang sehla, cuih hnen-um cu lei a let, a si lole tuu a khal ti sehla, innih a ra tlun tikah ‘Zamrang awla na rawl ei aw,’ nan ti ding maw?","title":"Hnen-um Ih ṭuanvo"},"8":{"text":"Nan ti lo ding! Cuhnakin amah cu ‘Ka hrangah zanriah i suan sak aw; cule na rawl suannak thuam hruk awla rawl ka ei sung i kil aw; cuih hnu lawngah nang cu rawl na ei leh ding,’ nan ti ding."},"9":{"text":"Hnen-um pa cu thu nan pekmi a tuah ṭheh ruangah lungawinak ṭongkam a parah nan ṭong dah maw si?"},"10":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in nanmah par khal ah a si ve: tuah uh, tiih an lo timi nan tuah ṭheh tikah ‘Kannih cu lom tlak lo hnen-um men kan si. Kan ṭuanvo a ṭuantu lawng kan si,’ tiah ti uh,” tiah a sim."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerusalem lam a pan zawng ah Samaria le Galilee ramri a pal phah vivo.","title":"Jesuh In Mi Pahra A Damter"},"12":{"text":"Khua pakhat a va thleng ih cuih khawsungih phaarnat in a nami pahra in an rak tong. Lamhlat nawnah an ding ih,"},"13":{"text":"“Maw Jesuh, Bawipa, in zaangfah hram aw,” tiah an au."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh in a hmu ih an hnenah, “Va feh uhla puithiam pawl in lo zoh hai seh,” tiah a ti. An feh laifangah cun an dam ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Anmah lakih pakhat pa in a dam ṭheh zo ti kha a hmuh awk tikah a kirsal ih aw ring zetin Pathian a thangṭhat."},"16":{"text":"Hmakhatteah Jesuh kehram leilungah cun a bok ih Jesuh hnenah lungawi thu a sim. Cupa cu Samaria mi pa a si."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Damnak a ngahtu cu mi pahra an si. Pakua teh khui-ah so an si?"},"18":{"text":"Ziangah so hi ramdang mi pakhat lawng Pathian hnenih lungawinak pe dingah a rat?” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Tho awla feh aw. Na zumnak in a lo damter zo,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Farasi mi ṭhenkhat in, “Ziang tikah so Pathian Uknak a ra thlen ding?” tiah Jesuh cu an sut. Jesuh in, “Pathian Uknak cu mithmuh in a ra lo.","title":"Pathian Uknak A Ratnak Thu (Mat 24.23-28 , 37-41)"},"21":{"text":"Zohman in ‘Zohhnik uh! Hinah a um hi! Khinah a um khi!’ tiah an ti lo ding. Ziangahtile Pathian Uknak cu nan sungah a um a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cule a dungthluntu pawl hnenah, “Milai Fapa ih caan ni khat tal hmu ve thei sehla tiah saduh nan thah tikcu a ra thleng ding, asinain nan hmu lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Nan hnenah ‘Zoh uh! Khinah a um! Zoh uh! Hinah a um!’ tiah a lo titu an um ding. Sihmansehla zoh dingah va feh hlah uh."},"24":{"text":"Nimthlakau in van khatlam kap ihsin khatlam tiang a hrawh ih a tlet ṭheh vekin Milai Fapa cu amah ih ni ahcun a si ve ding."},"25":{"text":"Asinain hmaisabik ah amah in tuarnak nasazet a tong ding ih tuihsan minung pawl in an hnong ding."},"26":{"text":"Noah sanlai ih a rak can zo bangin Milai Fapa san khalah a cang ve ding."},"27":{"text":"Noah a lawng sungah a lut ih tilik a tlung ih mi hmuahhmuah an thih ṭheh hlan tiangin mizapi cu an nuam, an ei an in ih an ṭhi aw rero lai."},"28":{"text":"Lot sanih a rak si zo bangtuk in a si ve ding. Zozo khal zu an in, sa an ei; thil an lei, thil an zuar; thlai an ciing ih inn an sak."},"29":{"text":"Lot in Sodom a tlansan ni ah van ihsin meisa le kaat ruahpi bangin a rung sur ih mi hmuahhmuah an thi ṭheh."},"30":{"text":"Milai Fapa a rung lang ni ahcun cuvek in a si ve ding."},"31":{"text":"Cuih ni ahcun a inn diphun ih a umtu cun a innsungih a ummi thilri la dingah ṭum hlah seh.
