Cuvek thothoin lo ih a rak umtu cu inn ah tlung hlah seh."},"32":{"text":"Lot ih nupi kha nan ciing lai maw?"},"33":{"text":"Zokhal amah ih nunnak hum a tumtu cu a nunnak a sung ding; a nunnak a liamtu cun a nunnak a hum ngah ding."},"34":{"text":"Thungai in ka lo sim: cuih zaan ah ihkhun pakhat ah mi pahnih an ittlang ding; pakhat cu a lak ding ih pakhat cu a taanta ding."},"35":{"text":"Nunau pahnih sum an deng tlang ding; pakhat cu lak hlo a si ding ih pakhat cu taanta a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"(“Mi pahnih lo ah hna an ṭuan tlang ding: pakhat cu lak hlo a si ding ih pakhat cu taanta a si ding,” tiah a ti.)"},"37":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cun, “Bawipa, khui tawkah so?” tiah an sut. Jesuh in, “Ruak a umnak hmun ahcun langta an khawm aw ding,” tiah a sim."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthlun pawl kha thinnau loih thla an cam ringring a ṭulzia zirh duh ah tahṭhimnak pakhat a sim.","title":"Nuhmei Nu Le Thuṭhentu Tahṭhimnak"},"2":{"text":"An hnenah cun, “Khua pakhat ah Pathian a ṭih loih milai khal a hmaizah lotu thuṭhentu pakhat a um."},"3":{"text":"Cuih khua thotho ah nuhmei nu pakhat a um ih nuhmei nu cun, ‘I raltu thawn thu kan neihmi ahhin i bawm hram aw,’ tiah atu le atu a ra dil ringring."},"4":{"text":"Thuṭhentu in cuih thu cu caan reipi relsak duh loin a um; asinain a netabik ahcun ‘Pathian ka ṭih lo ih mi khal ka hmaizah lo naón,"},"5":{"text":"hi nuhmei nu in i hnaihnok ringring ruangah a thu cu ka relsak pei. Ka relsak lo a si ahcun catbang loin a ra ringring ding ih a netnak ahcun keimah lehlam thinlung baangin i tuah ding,’ tiah a ruat,” tiah a sim."},"6":{"text":"Cule an Bawipa cun an hnenah, “Hi a dik lomi thuṭhentu ih ṭongkam cu nan thei!"},"7":{"text":"Cuti a si ahcun Pathian in amah ih bomnak dilin sun zan a au rerotu a minung pawl cu an thu ṭhensak loin a um pei maw? Anmah bawm dingah a khul a fung pei maw?"},"8":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: zamrang zetin a relsak ding ih thuding a coter ding a si. Sikhalsehla Milai Fapa hi leilungih a rat tikah zumnak neitu a hmu pei maw?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Jesuh in hi tahṭhimnak cu, miṭha ngaingai ih a ruat awmi le midang hmuahhmuah a hmuhsuamtu pawl hnenah a simmi a si.","title":"Farasi Le Siahkhongtu Tahṭhimnak"},"10":{"text":"“Voikhat ah mi pahnih cu thlacam dingah Biakinn ah an feh. Pakhat cu Farasi a si ih pakhat cu siahkhongtu a si."},"11":{"text":"Farasi pa cu hlat nawnah amah lawng a ding ih hiti in thla a cam. ‘Maw Pathian, kei cu midang vekin ka duhham lo, thuphan ka per lo ih ṭaangṭawm sualnak tla ka tuah lo ruangah ka lo thangṭhat. Khi tawkih a ummi siahkhongtu vek ka si lo ruangah ka lo lawm."},"12":{"text":"Zarhkhat ah voihnih rawl ka ul, ka ngahmi hmuahhmuah sungin ṭhenhra ih ṭhenkhat ka lo pek,’ a ti."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla siahkhongtu pa cu a hlat nawn ah a ding ih vanlam hman hoih ngam loin a ṭaang a cuum aw ih ‘Maw Pathian, i zaangfah hram aw; kei cu misual ka si,’ tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Farasi mi pa si loin siahkhongtu pa sawn kha inn ih a tlun tikah Pathian hmaiah thuding cotu a si. Ziangahtile zokhal amah le amah a khaisang awtu cu namthlak a si ding ih tangdortu cu khaisan a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat in an faate pawl ih parah Jesuh in a kut suangseh ti duh ah Jesuh hnenah an faate pawl cu an rak hruai. Cutiih an tuah cu a dungthluntu pawl in an hmuh tikah an kawk.","title":"Jesuh In Nauhak A Thlawsuah (Mat 19.13-15 ; Mar 10.13-16)"},"16":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh in nauhak pawl cu a ko ih, “Nauhak cu ka hnenah ra hai seh, dawn hlah uh; ziangahtile Pathian Uknak cu hi bangtuk mi pawl ih ta a si."},"17":{"text":"Hihi ciing ṭha uh! Zokhal Pathian Uknak kha nauhak pawl ih an cohlan bangtuk in a cohlang lotu cu cuih Uknak sungah an lut thei dah lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Judah mi hotu pakhat in Jesuh cu, “Zirhtu ṭha, kumkhua nunnak co dingah ziangso ka tuah ding?” tiah a sut.","title":"Milian Pa Ih Thu (Mat 19.16-30 ; Mar 10.17-31)"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ziangah so miṭha, tiah i ti? Pathian pakhat siarlo miṭha dang zohman an um lo."},"20":{"text":"Thukham pawl na thei ko a si lo maw: ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuah hlah; lai that hlah; ruk ru hlah; thuphan per hlah; na nu le na pa kha upat aw,’ ti tla an si kha!” tiah a let."},"21":{"text":"Cupa in, “Ka seentet lai ihsin hi thukam pawl hicu ka thlun thluh zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cumi cu Jesuh in a theih tikah a hnenah cun, “Na tuah ṭulmi pakhat a um lai. Na neihmi hmuahhmuah zuar ṭheh awla na ngahmi tangka kha mifarah pawl va pe aw; cule vancung ah sumsaw na nei ding. Cuih hnuah ra awla i thlun aw,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Asinain cuih thu cu cupa in a theih tikah a riah a sia ngaingai, ziangahtile amah cu milianzet a si."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh in a riahsiat kha a hmuh tikah hiti in a sim: “Milian hrangah cun Pathian Uknak sungih luh cu ziangtluk in so a har!"},"25":{"text":"Milian pakhat Pathian Uknak sungih luh hnakin kalauk pakhat ṭhim hnakua sungih luh khi a ol sawn a si,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cumi cu mipi in an theih tikah, “Cuti asile zoso runmi a si thei ding?” tiah an sut."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Minung hrangih a cang thei lo timi hi Pathian hrangah cun a cang thei a si,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cutikah Piter in, “Zohhnik! Kan innsang taanta in nangmah kan lo thlun hi!” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Asi, na simmi a dik a si; fiangtein ka lo sim: zokhal a inn siseh, a nupi siseh, a unau siseh, a nu le a pa siseh, a faate pawl siseh, Pathian Uknak hrangah a tlansan a si ahcun,"},"30":{"text":"tuih san ahhin a let tampiin ngahmi a nei ding ih a ra dingmi san ah kumkhua nunnak a ngah ding,” tiah a sim."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh in a dungthlun hleihnih pawl kha hmun dangte ah a fehpi ih an hnenah, “Ngaihnik uh! Jerusalem ah kan feh ding ih Milai Fapa ih thu profet pawl ih an rak simmi hmuahhmuah kha a kim ding.","title":"A Thihnak Ding Voithumnak A Sim (Mat 20.17-19 ; Mar 10.32-34)"},"32":{"text":"Zentail mi pawl ih kut ah thlenpi a si ding ih annih in hnihsuahsainak ah an hmang ding, an dekcok ding ih an cil an phui ding."},"33":{"text":"An vuak ding ih an that ding, asinain ni thumnak ah a tho sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cupawl cu a dungthluntu pawl cun an thei thei lo; a ṭong ih sullam kha thuhsak a si ruangah Jesuh ih ṭongmi kha a tican an thei lo."},"35":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerikho khua lamah a feh ih a thlen zik zawng ah mitcaw pakhat cu lamzin kiangah kutdawh in a rak to.","title":"Mitcaw Kutdawh A Damter (Mat 20.29-34 ; Mar 10.46-52)"},"36":{"text":"A kiangin mi tampi an lan kha a theih tikah, “Ziang so a si?” tiah a rak sut."},"37":{"text":"Annih in, “Nazareth mi Jesuh a ra a si,” tiah an ti."},"38":{"text":"Cupa cun, “Maw David Fapa Jesuh, i zaangfah hram aw,” tiah a au ciamco."},"39":{"text":"Hmaiih a ummi misenpi pawl in an kawk ih daiteih um dingah an sim. Sikhalsehla anih cun, “David Fapa, i zaangfah hrawm aw,” tiah a au sinsin."},"40":{"text":"Cuhrangah Jesuh cu a ding ih, “Mitcaw pa kha hinah rak hruai uh,” tiah thu a pek. A hnenih a ra thlen tikah Jesuh in,"},"41":{"text":"“Ziang tisak dingso na duh?” tiah a sut. “Bawipa, khua hmu thei sal ningla ka duh,” a ti."},"42":{"text":"Jesuh in a hnenah, “Cuti asile khua hmu aw! Na zumnak in a lo damter zo,” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Hmakhatteah khua a hmu thei ih Jesuh kha a thlun ih Pathian a thangṭhat vivo. Cumi cu misenpi in an hmuh tikah an zatein Pathian kha an thangṭhat."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerikho khua a thleng ih khawsung in a feh vivo.","title":"Jesuh Le Zakia"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkah siahkhongtu upa pakhat, a lianzetmi, Zakia timi a um."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh kha zo a si ti hmuh a duhzet naón amah cu mi niamte a si ih tlunah mi an tamzet ruangah a hmu thei hrimhrim lo."},"4":{"text":"Curuangah mipi hmaiah a tlan ih cutawk lamih a feh vivotu Jesuh hmuh duh ah theipi kung parah a kai."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh cutawk hmun a thlen tikah a tlunlam a hun zoh ih, “Zakia, zamrangin rung ṭum aw, tuihsun na inn ah ka tlung ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Zakia cu zamrangin a ṭum ih Jesuh kha a inn ah lungawi zetin a tlunter."},"7":{"text":"Cumi a hmutu hmuahhmuah cu an phunzai hmurhmo ih, “Hi pa hi misual pa ih inn ah a tlung ual!” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Zakia cu a ding ih Bawipa ih hnenah cun, “Bawipa, i ngaihnik! Ka neihmi ih hrek cu mifarah ka pe ding; cule ka bummi an um ahcun a let li in ka sam sal ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Jesuh in a hnenah, “Tuih sun hi pa ih inn ah rundamnak a ra thleng zo, ziangahtile hi pakhal hi Abraham ih tesinfa a si ve."},"10":{"text":"Milai Fapa cu a hlomi hawl ding le rundam dingah a ra,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cutiih a simmi a rak ngaitu mipi hnenah Jesuh in tahṭhimnak pakhat a sim. Amah cu Jerusalem a thleng zik thlang ih mipi cun Pathian Uknak a ra thleng zik thlang tiah an ruat.","title":"Sui Tangka Tahṭhimnak (Mat 25.14-30)"},"12":{"text":"Curuangah hiti in a sim: “Voikhat ah bawi pakhat a um ih amah cu ram hlapi ah feh tahratin siangpahrang ih canter a si hnuah innih ra tlun sal a tum."},"13":{"text":"Cutiih a feh hlanah a hnen-um pahra kha a ko ih sui tangka fang khat fingfing a pek hnuah, ‘Himi thawn sum rak tuah hnik uh; ka ra kir tikah ziangzat nan ngah, kan zohhnik pei,’ tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"A ram sungmi pawl in cuih an bawipa cu an hua ih curuangah ‘Hi pa hi cu kan siangpahrang dingah kan duh lo,’ tiah a simtu dingah palai an thlah."},"15":{"text":"“Cupa cu siangpahrang a can hnuah a ra tlung sal. A thlen vete in sum ziangzat an ngah ti theih duh ah a hnen-um pahra cu a hnenah a ko."},"16":{"text":"Pakhat pa cu a ra ih, ‘Bawipa, sui tangka fang khat i pekmi in sui tangka fang hra a miat ka ngah,’ tiah a ra ti."},"17":{"text":"A bawipa in, ‘A ṭha, nang hi hnen-um ṭha na si. Thil fate parih rintlak na si ruangah khawpi pahra uktu-ah ka lo re ding,’ tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Pahnihnak pa a ra ih, ‘Bawipa, sui tangka fang khat i pekmi in fang nga a miat ka ngah,’ tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cupa cu ‘Khawpi panga uktu-ah ka lo ret ding,’ tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"“A dang hnen-um pakhat a ra ih, ‘Bawipa, hinah na sui tangka cu a um. Pavua in ka tuam ih ka ret."},"21":{"text":"Nang cu mi tifekfek na si ruangah ka lo ṭih. Na ta a si lomi tla na lak ṭheu ih thlaici na vorh lomi khal na khawm ṭheu,’ tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah a bawipa in, ‘Hnen-um ṭha lo! Nangmah hnonnak dingah hin nangmah ih ṭong lala ka hmang ding! Mi tifekfek ka si cu na thei ih ka ta a si lomi tla ka lak ih ka vorh lomi khal ka khawm cu na thei."},"23":{"text":"Cuti asile ziangah so ka tangka cu tangka retnak zung ah na rak ret lo? Rak ret cila ka ra kir sal tikah tangka ṭhang thawn ka ngah ding a sisi!’ tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cule cutawkih a dingmi pawl hnenah, ‘A sui tangka cu la uhla sui tangka fang hra a neitu hnen-um hnenah pe uh,’ tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Asinain annih in, ‘Bawipa, anih cun fang hra a nei zo si!’ an ti."},"26":{"text":"An bawipa cun, ‘Fiangtein ka lo sim: thil a neitu hnenah a dang khal belh a si ding; asinain thil a nei lotu hnen ihsin a neihsun malte hman kha laksak hrih a si ding."},"27":{"text":"Cun an siangpahrang dingih i duh lotu ka ral pawl cu hinah ratpi uh la ka mithmuh ah hin that uh,’ a ti,” tiah Jesuh in a sim."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh in hi thu a sim hnuah an hmaiah Jerusalem ah a feh.","title":"Jerusalem Ah Sunglawi Zetin A Lut (Mat 21.1-11 ; Mar 11.1-11 ; Joh 12.12-19)"},"29":{"text":"Cule Olif tlang ih Bethphage le Bethani khua kiang a thlen tikah a hmai ah a dungthluntu pahnih kha a thlah ih,"},"30":{"text":"hiti in thu a cah. “Nan hmaiih a ummi khawsungah khin va lut uhla zohman ih an to dah hrih lomi laak note pakhat hri in an khihmi kha nan hmu ding. A hri phoih uhla hinah rak hruai uh."},"31":{"text":"Zokhal in ziangah so nan phoih, tiah an lo sut asile Bawipa in a hai tiah va sim uh,” a ti."},"32":{"text":"An va feh ih Jesuh in a sim vek cekci-in ziang hmuahhmuah cu an hmu."},"33":{"text":"Laak note cu an phoih rero laiah a neitu pawl in, “Ziangah so nan phoih?” tiah an ti."},"34":{"text":"Annih in, “Bawipa in a hai,” tiah an let."},"35":{"text":"Cule laak cu Jesuh hnenah an hei hruai. Cun laak parah cun an puan an dam ih Jesuh cu an toter."},"36":{"text":"Laak par cun a feh ih a fehnak lamzin ahcun mipi in an puan an phah vivo."},"37":{"text":"Jerusalem khua kiang lamzin Olif Tlang ihsin a vung suhnak zawn an thlen tikah a thluntu miburpi pawl cun Pathian an thangṭhat ih, thil mak zetzet tampi an hmuh ruangah cun an aw neih patawp in an au ciamco."},"38":{"text":"“Bawipaói hmin in a rami siangpahrang parah Pathian thlawsuahnak um ko seh! Van ah daihnak um sehla Pathian hnenah sunlawinak cu um ko seh!” tiah an ti."},"39":{"text":"Cule miburpi lakih a ummi Farasi ṭhenkhat pawl in Jesuh cu, “Sayapa, na dungthlun pawl hi daiteón um hai seh, sim aw!” tiah an ti."},"40":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: Annih pawl daiteih an um asile hi lungto pawl hi an hung au ciamco ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Jerusalem khawpi cu a hei naih vivo ih a hmuh ngah tikah Jesuh cu a ṭap:","title":"Jerusalem Ruangah Jesuh A ṭap"},"42":{"text":"“Tuihsun ah hin daihnak hrangah ziangso a ṭul, tihi thei thei cila maw! Asinain cucu na hmuh thei lo dingin thuh a si!"},"43":{"text":"Nan ral pawl in an lo kulh ṭheh ding ih an lo kham ṭhehnak le khuazakip in an lo fuuknak caan a ra thleng ding."},"44":{"text":"Nangmah siseh, na phar dawlmi sungih a ummi na minung pawl siseh, an that ṭheh ding. Nangmah rundam dingih Pathian a rat tikcu na theih lo ruangah lungto pakhat hman suang aw-in a taangmi an um lo ding a si!” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu Biakinn sungah a feh ih thil zuartu pawl kha a dawi ṭheh.","title":"Biakinn Ah Jesuh A Feh (Mat 21.12-17 ; Mar 11.15-19 ; Joh 2.13-22)"},"46":{"text":"“Ca Thianghlim sungah Pathian in ka Biakinn cu thlacamnak inn tiah kawh a si ding a ti. Asinain nannih cun fifir pawl relhnak kua ah nan canter!” tiah a kawk hai."},"47":{"text":"Nitinte in Jesuh cun Biakinn sungah thu a zirh. Puithiam upa pawl, Daanthiam pawl le hotu pawl in Jesuh cu thah an duh."},"48":{"text":"Asinain an thah theinak ding lamzin an hawl thei lo, ziangahtile mi hmuahhmuah in a thu simmi cu ṭongfang pakhat hman hrelh loin ngai an duh."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nikhat ah Jesuh cu Biakinn sungah thu a zirh ih Thuthangṭha a sim rero laiah puithiam upa pawl, Daanthiam pawl le khawsung upa pawl a hnenah an ra ih,","title":"Jesuh Ih Thuneihnak An Sut (Mat 21.23-27 ; Mar 11.27-33)"},"2":{"text":"“In simhnik! Zo ih thu in so hi bangtuk thil hi na tuah? Zo in so thu a lo pek?” tiah an sut."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Thu ka lo sut ve hnik pei. I simhnik uh."},"4":{"text":"Johan in baptisma pek theinak thu a neihmi hi Pathian hnen ihsin a ra maw, minung hnen ihsin so?” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Annih pakhat le pakhat, “Ziangtin so kan sim ding? ‘Pathian hnen ihsin a ngah,’ kan ti asile anih in, ‘Cuti asile ziangah so Johan cu nan zum lo?’ in ti ding."},"6":{"text":"Asinain ‘Minung hnen ihsin a ngah,’ kan ti fawn asile hi misenpi pawl hin lungto in in deng ding, ziangahtile Johan cu profet a si tiah an zum ṭhehmi a si fawn,” tiah anmah le anmah an el aw."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah annih in, “Zo hnen ihsin a ngah ti kan thei lo,” tiah an let."},"8":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in, “Kei khal in zo hnen ihsin hi thil tuah theinak thu hi ka ngah, ti ka lo sim lo ding,” tiah a let ve."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jesuh in hi tahṭhimnak hi misenpi hnenah a sim: “Voikhat ah mi pakhat in sabit hmuan a nei ih midang hnenah man pek in a hmuan cu a san hnuah caan reipi sung khual a tlawng.","title":"Sabit Hmuan Hnaṭuantu Tahṭhimnak (Mat 21.33-46 ; Mar 12.1-12)"},"10":{"text":"Sabit rah lawh caan a cut tikah hmuan saangtu pawl hnenah cun a covo va la dingin a sal pakhat a thlah. Sikhalsehla hmuan saangtu pawl in a salpa cu an rak vuak hnuah a kut lawngin an kirter."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah a sal pakhat a thlah sal; cupa khal cu hmuan saangtu pawl cun an vuak ih ningzak koin an rak tuah hnuah kut lawngin an kirter lala."},"12":{"text":"Cule a sal dang pakhat a thlah sal. Hmuan a saangtu pawl cun an rak tuahmawh ih hmuan lengah an hlon."},"13":{"text":"Cun sabit hmuan neitu pa cun, ‘Ziangtin so ka ti ding? Ka duhdawtmi ka fapa hi ka thlah pei; amah cu an rak upat ko ding,’ tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Asinain hmuan saangtu pawl in a fapa cu an rak hmuh tikah pakhat le pakhat, ‘Hi pa hi hmuan neituih fapa ngaingai a si. Kan that pei ih a co ding hmuahhmuah cu kan ta ah a cang ding!’ tiah an ti aw."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah hmuan leengah an hlon ih an that. “Cuti a si ruangah hmuan saangtu pawl parah hmuan neitu in ziangso a tuah ding?"},"16":{"text":"Amah cu a ra ding ih cupawl cu a thah hnuah hmuan saangtu dang hnenah a hmuan cu a saan ding a si,” tiah a ti. Cumi cu misenpi in an theih tikah, “Cuticun a ti hrimhrim lo ding,” tiah an ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in a zohhliah hai ih an hnenah, “Asile, Ca Thianghlim sungah ‘Inn saktu pawl in santlai lo ti ih an hnonmi lungto cu a thupi bikmi lungto ah a cang riangri,’ tiih nganmi kha a tican ziangso a si?"},"18":{"text":"Zokhal cuih lungto parih a tlami cu an kuai seksek ding ih cuih lungto in a tlakmi cu a zaam ṭheh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Daanthiam pawl le puithiam upa pawl in cutawk rori ahcun kaih an tum, ziangahtile a tlunih tahṭhimnak hi anmah ṭongsan in a simmi a si, ti kha an thei; asinain mipi kha an ṭih fawn.","title":"Ngunkhuai Peknak Thu (Mat 22.15-22 ; Mar 12.13-17)"},"20":{"text":"Curuangah an kaih theinak dingah tikcu remcaang an hawl. Mi ṭhenkhat cu Jesuh thlingthlatu dingah nawhthuh an pek ih, “Mi ṭhazet vekin um uh. Jesuh hi Rom Acozah ih thu neitu Mangki bawi hnenih kan thlenpi theinak dingah thu nan sut pei ih amah ih ṭong lala kha thang ah hmangin a awh nan zuam pei,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Thlingthlatu pawl in Jesuh cu, “Sayapa, na simmi le na zirhmi hi a dik a si tiah kan thei. Mi na thleidang lo ih minung hrangih Pathian duhnak thudik kha felteón na zirh ti tla kan thei."},"22":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah thu pakhat in simhnik: Rom Siangpahrang hnenah ngunkhuai pek hi kan Daan in a on maw, on lo so?” tiah an sut."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh in an depdetnak kha a thei ṭheh ih an hnenah,"},"24":{"text":"“Ngun tangka fang khat i hmuhhnik uh. A parah zo ih zuk le hmin so a cuang?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Rom Siangpahrang zuk le hmin,” tiah an sawn."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh in, “Cuti a si ahcun Rom Siangpahrang ta cu siangpahrang pe uh; Pathian ta cu Pathian pe uh,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cuti cun misenpi hmaiah a kaih an tum naón ziangti hmanin an kai ngah thei lo; thu an suhmi a lehnak an theih tikah an lau ih daiziar in an um."},"27":{"text":"Cun Sadusi mi ṭhenkhat, minung hi thihnak ihsin thawhsal a um nawn lo, a titu pawl Jesuh hnenah an ra ih,","title":"Thihnak Ihsin Thawhsalnak Thu (Mat 22.23-33 ; Mar 12.18-27)"},"28":{"text":"“Sayapa, Moses in hiti in daan a nganta: ‘Mi pakhat cu faate nei loin a nupi a thihsan ahcun a unau pakhatkhat in a cuih nupi cu a ṭhi pei ih faate an neihmi kha an u mithi pa ih faate-ah ruah a si pei,’ tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Voikhat ah unau pasarih an um. Upabik cu nupi a nei naón faate nei loin a thi."},"30":{"text":"Pahnihnak pa in cunu cu a ṭhit ih faate nei loin a thi ve."},"31":{"text":"A pathumnak pa khal in a ṭhit ih fa nei loin a thi ve thotho. An unau pasarih in cu nu cu an ṭhinaón faate nei loin an thi ṭheh."},"32":{"text":"A neta bikah cuih nunau nu khal cu a thi ve."},"33":{"text":"Cutiin a si ih a thi ciami pawl an thawhsal tikah cunu cu zo ih nupi so a si ding? An pasarih in an ṭhi ciar fawn si!” tiah an sut."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Tuihsan minung pawl cu nunau le mipa an ṭhi aw."},"35":{"text":"Sikhalsehla thihnak ihsin thawhter sal dingah siseh, a ra lai dingmi san ih nung dingah siseh, a tlakmi pawl cu cuih caan ahcun an ṭhi aw nawn lo ding."},"36":{"text":"Vancungmi bangtuk an si ding ih an thi thei lo ding. Thihnak ihsin an thawhsal zo ruangah annih tla cu Pathian ih faate an si."},"37":{"text":"Cule Moses in, a thimi pawl cu thawhter sal an si ti cu fiangteón a langter a si. Hrambur a kaangmi thuhla sungah khan Bawipa cu ‘Abraham ih Pathian, Isaak ih Pathian, le Jakob ih Pathian,’ tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Pathian cu a thimi ih Pathian a si lo, a nungmi ih Pathian a si; ziangahtile mi hmuahhmuah cu a hnenah cun a nungmi hlir an si,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Daanthiam ṭhenkhat pawl in, “Sayapa, na thu lehmi a ṭha zet!” tiah an hun ti."},"40":{"text":"Cutiin Jesuh cu thu an sut ngam nawn lo."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ziangtin so Messiah cu David tesinfa a si, ti theih a si ding?","title":"Messiah Thu Suhnak (Mat 22.41-46 ; Mar 12.35-37)"},"42":{"text":"Ziangahtile David amah rori in Saam Hlabu sungah, ‘Bawipa in ka Bawipa hnenah, Na ral pawl hmuahhmuah cu na ke hnuaiah,"},"43":{"text":"Ke pal dingih ka ret thluh hlan lo ka vorhlam ah to aw,’ tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"David in ‘Bawipa,’ tiah a ti ahcun ziangtinso Messiah cu David tesinfa cu a si thei ding?” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in a thusimmi an ngai laiah khan Jesuh in a dungthlun pawl hnenah,","title":"Daanthiam Pawl Ralrin Peknak (Mat 23.1-36 ; Mar 12.38-40)"},"46":{"text":"“Daanthiam pawl hi ralring uh! Annih tla cu an angki fualpi thawn vah sukso an uar ih dawrtluan ah khin upatnak thawn mi ih cibaibuk an duh; sinakok le puai tuahnak hmun ah khin tonak ṭhabik an hril ringring."},"47":{"text":"Nuhmei pawl an hmuhsuam ih an inn tiangin an lawng, asinain mi hmai ahcun sau zetzet in thla an cam fawn! Hremnak an tuar dingmi cu a luar cuang ding a si!” tiah a ti."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh in a kiangkap kha a zoh ih, milian pawl in Biakinn tangka kuang sungah an thawhlawm an thlak rero kha a hmu;","title":"Nuhmei Nu-ih Thawhlawm (Mar 12.41-44)"},"2":{"text":"cule nuhmei farah zet pakhat in paisa pia hnihte a thlakmi tla kha a hmu."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Fiangtein ka lo sim: hi nuhmei nu hin midang hmuahhmuah hnakin tam sawn a pek a si."},"4":{"text":"Ziangahtile midang pawl cun an neihmi sungih a hleifuan kha an pek; sikhalsehla hi nuhmei nu cu farahte asinain a nunnak dingih a neihmi kha a zatein a pek a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"A dungthlun ṭhenkhat cun Jerusalem Biakinn thu, lungto ṭha zetzet ih an dawlmi mawizia le Pathian hnenih laksawng an pekmi thu pawl an rel ciamco. Jesuh in,","title":"Biakinn Siatnak Ding Thu A Sim (Mat 24.1-2 ; Mar 13.1-2)"},"6":{"text":"“Himi hi nan hmu ṭheh; asinain hi lungto pawl hi pakhat hman an umnak keel ah um nawn loin hlon thlak ṭheh an si caan a thleng ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Annih in Jesuh cu, “Sayapa, cuih caan cu ziangtikah so a si ding? Cun a tikcu a ra thleng zo, ti theihthiamnak ah ziangbangtuk hminsinnak so a um ding?” tiah an sut.","title":"Harnak Le Hremnak (Mat 24.3-14 ; Mar 13.3-13)"},"8":{"text":"Jesuh cun, “Mi in an lo bum thei lonak dingah ralring uh; mi tampi ka hmin in an ra ding ih ‘Keimah hi Amah cu ka si,’ tiin le ‘A tikcu a kim zo,’ tiah an sim ding. Sikhalsehla va thlun hlah uh."},"9":{"text":"Ral le do awknak thawmvang nan theih tikah ṭih hlah uh; cu bangtuk pawl cu a ra thleng hmaisa ding, asinain a netnak a thok zo tinak a si lo."},"10":{"text":"“Ram khat le ram khat an do aw ding; Acozah pakhat in a dang Acozah kha a siim ding."},"11":{"text":"Leilung tlun ah ṭihnungza linghnin mangṭam, le pulhnatsia a phunphun khuazakipah a tlung ding. Thil lamdang zetzet le hmuhsaknak mak zetzet van ihsin an lang ding."},"12":{"text":"“Cubangtuk thil a thlen hlanah nannih tla cu kaihnak le hremnak nan tuar ding; sinakok i nan thu rel dingin le thawngthlak dingin midang pawl ih kut ah pek nan si ding. Keimah ih ruangah siangpahrang le uktu bawi pawl ih hmaiah suahpi nan si ding."},"13":{"text":"Cucu nan hrangah Thuthang ṭha simnak caan ṭha a si ding."},"14":{"text":"Ziangtin so kan hum awknak dingah kan ṭan ding tiah a hlankhan ihsin nan donhar lo dingin nan thinlung rak timtuah cia uh."},"15":{"text":"Ziangahtile ṭongkam thiamnak le fimnak nasa zetin ka lo pe ding ih nan ral pawl zohman in nan ṭongmi kha an el thei lo ding ih nan palh a si, a ti theitu khal an um lo ding."},"16":{"text":"Nan nu le nan pa, nan u le nan nau, nan sungkhat le nan rualpi pawl in an lo phiar ding ih mi ṭhenkhat cu thah tla nan tong ding."},"17":{"text":"Keimah ih ruangah mi hmuahhmuah in an lo hua ding."},"18":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nan lu parih samphang pakhat hman a tlong lo ding."},"19":{"text":"Hnget zetin ding ko uh; cuticun nan run aw ngah ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ralkap pawl in Jerusalem an kulh ṭheh nan hmuh tikah a siat cing ding ti kha nan thei ding.","title":"Jerusalem Siatnak Ding Thu A Sim (Mat 24.15-21 ; Mar 13.14-19)"},"21":{"text":"Cutikah Judea ih a ummi pawl cu tlang parah nan tlan pei; khawpi sungih a ummi pawl cu khawpi nan taanta pei ih khawpi leeng hramlak ih a ummi pawl khal khawpi sungah nan lut lo pei."},"22":{"text":"Ziangahtile himi cu ‘Hremnak Ni,’ a si ding ruangah Ca Thianghlim ih a rak sim ciami hmuahhmuah kha a kimnak tikcu a si ding."},"23":{"text":"Cuih caan cu nunau favun pawl le naukai nei nunau pawl hrangah cun an hmakhua a pit a si! Hi leilung parah ṭihnungza harsatnak a ra thleng ding ih Pathian hremnak cu hi minung pawl parah a tlung ding."},"24":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat cu ralnam in an thi ding ih mi ṭhen cu leitlun ramkipah salah hruai an si ding. Jerusalem cu Pathian thei lotu Zentail pawl in an tikcu a cem hlanlo an ke hnuai ah an pal ding,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ni le thlapi le arsi pawl parah khin thil lamdang zetzet a um ding. Leitlun pumpi ah vansaannak a um ding, ziangahtile tifinriat a awnmi le tilet a thomi kha an ṭih ding ih an thinlung a hnok ṭheh ding.","title":"Milai Fapa A Ratnak Ding Thu (Mat 24.29-31 ; Mar 13.24-27)"},"26":{"text":"Leitlun pumpi parah a ra thleng dingmi thil an ruah tikah mi tampi cu an thinpit in an tlu ding, ziangahtile vanih cahnak huham pawl cu a pingpeng ah an feh ṭheh ding."},"27":{"text":"Cutikah Milai Fapa cu mero lakin sunlawinak le a nasa zetmi huham thawn a lang ding."},"28":{"text":"Hi bangtuk thil a ra thlen vivo tikah ding uhla tlunlam zoh uh, ziangahtile nan luatnak a nai zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in hi tahṭhimnak hi a sim: “Theipi kung siseh, thingkung dang thu khal siseh, ruathnik uh.","title":"Thei Kung Ihsin Zirnak (Mat 24.32-35 ; Mar 13.28-31)"},"30":{"text":"Hnah note a cerh tikah khuaṭhal caan a nai zo ti nan thei."},"31":{"text":"Cu bangtuk in hi thil pawl a tlun ih a kim vivo tikah Pathian Uknak cu a thleng zik thlang a si, ti thei uh."},"32":{"text":"Atuih a nungmi pawl an thih ṭheh hlanah hi thil hmuahhmuah cu a thleng kim ṭheh ding ti kha ciing ṭha uh."},"33":{"text":"Van le lei cu a hloral leh ding naón ka thu cu a hloral dah lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ralring in um uh! Puai tuah ih zu in le sa ei in siseh, nun khuasaknak helhkam in siseh, va um hlah uh; nan um asile rin lopi ah cuih Ni cu a ra thleng ding ih,","title":"Ralrin A ṭul"},"35":{"text":"thang bangin a lo awk ding. Ziangahtile cuih Ni cu leilung tlun mi hmuahhmuah parah a ra thleng ding."},"36":{"text":"Ralring zetin um uhla, a ra thleng dingmi thil hmuahhmuah hi himte ih nan pahsuak theinak dingah thazaang nei dingin le Milai Fapa hmaiih nan din theinak ding ah cat loin thla cam uh,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cuih caan hrawngah Jesuh cu Biakinn ah thu a zirh ih zanlam a si tikah a suak ih Olif tlang ah a va riak ṭheu."},"38":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah in a thu zirhmi ngai duh ah zingpitte in Biakinn ah an feh ṭheu."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lantak Puai an timi, thilnu tel lo sang puai cu a thleng zik thlang.","title":"Jesuh Phiar An Tum (Mat 26.1-5 ; Mar 14.1-2 ; Joh 11.45-53)"},"2":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl cu misenpi kha an ṭih ruangah Jesuh kha a thupte ih an thah theinak ding lamzin an hawl rero."},"3":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu hleihnih sungih a telmi Iskariot an timi Judas sungah Satan a lut.","title":"Judas In Jesuh Zuar A Tum (Mat 26.14-16 ; Mar 14.10-11)"},"4":{"text":"Curuangah Judas cu a va feh duak ih Jesuh an hnenih a zuar thei ding thu puithiam upa pawl le Biakinn kiltu bawi pawl hnenah a va sim."},"5":{"text":"Annih khal cu an lung a awizet ih tangka pe dingin an lung a kim."},"6":{"text":"Judas khal a lung a kim ve ih misenpi theihter lo tein an kut sungah Jesuh a pek theinak ding tikcu remcaang a hngak."},"7":{"text":"Thilnu tel lo saang Puai tuah ni a thleng ih Lantak Puai hrangih tuu note pawl thahnak tikcu a kim.","title":"Jesuh Cu Lantak Puai Hman A Tum (Mat 26.17-25 ; Mar 14.12-21 ; Joh 13.21-30)"},"8":{"text":"Jesuh in Piter le Johan a thlah ih, “Va feh uhla Lantak Puai rawl kan ei tlaangnak ding va tawlrel uh,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Annih in, “Khui-ah so va tuah dingin in duhsak?” tiah an sut."},"10":{"text":"Anih in, “Khawpi sungih nan va luh tikah tibeel in tidai a khaitu pa nan tong ding. Cupa cu a luhnak inn tiang va thlun uh;"},"11":{"text":"cule cuih inn neitu hnenah cun ‘Keimah le ka dungthlun pawl Lantak zanriah kan einak ding khaan khui-ah so a um tiah kan Sayapa in a lo ti,’ tiah va ti uh."},"12":{"text":"Tlunta khaan ah tokham le cabuai pawl kimteih an retmi khaan tumpi a lo hmuh ding ih cutawkah cun ziang hmuahhmuah va tawlrel uh,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"An feh ih Jesuh ih a sim vek cekci in ziang hmuahhmuah cu an hmu ih cutawkah cun Lantak zanriah cu an timtuah."},"14":{"text":"A tikcu a kim tikah Jesuh cu cabuai ah a dungthluntu pawl hnenah a to.","title":"Bawipa Zanriah An Ei (Mat 26.26-30 ; Mar 14.22-26 ; 1 Kor 11.23-25)"},"15":{"text":"An hnenah cun, “Hi Lantak zanriah hi harsatnak ka tuar hlanah nanmah thawn eitlang dingah ka duhzetmi a si."},"16":{"text":"Ziangahtile fiangtein ka lo sim: Pathian Uknak sungah hi Lantak zanriah ih tican taktak kimter a si hlanlo ka ei nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in khuathai a lak ih Pathian hnenah lungawi thu a sim hnuah, “Himi hi lak uhla hlawm aw uh."},"18":{"text":"Fiangtein ka lo sim: Pathian Uknak a ra thlen lai hlanlo hi sabitti hi ka in nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun saang hlom khat a lak ih Pathian hnenih lungawi thu a sim hnuah a phel ih a dungthluntu pawl hnenah cun a pek. “Himi hi nan hrangih ka pekmi ka taksa a si. Keimah in theih ringringnak dingah run tuah uh,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in zanriah an ei ṭheh tikah khuathai cu an hnen ah a pek ih, “Hi hai cu nan hrangah ka thletmi ka thisen thawn nemhngetmi Pathian thukam thar a si."},"21":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla zohhnik uh! I zuartupa cu atu-ah hi cabuai ahhin keimah thawn kan umtlang."},"22":{"text":"Pathian lairel cia bangtuk in Milai Fapa cu a thi ding, sikhalsehla Milai Fapa a zuartu pa hrangah cun a hmakhua a pit a si!” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cutikah cubangtuk thil cu zo bikin so a tuah pei, tiah anmah le anmah an sut aw."},"24":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl lakah zoso a tum bik ih ruah ding a si, tiin thu-el awknak a um.","title":"Zoso A Tum Bik"},"25":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Leitlun siangpahrang pawl in misenpi pawl kha lal zetin huham thawn an uk ih cuih uktu bawi pawl cun ‘Miseenpi ih Rualpi,’ tiah an ti aw."},"26":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih cu cubangtuk nan si lo ding; nanmah lakih upa bik cu nauta bik bangtuk in a um ding ih hotu bik cu hnen-um bangin a um ding."},"27":{"text":"Zoso a tum deuh: To in rawl a eitu maw, rawl petu so? A totu kha a tum sawn a si lo maw? Sikhalsehla kei cu nan lakah a lo riantu vekin ka um a si."},"28":{"text":"“Harnak ka tuar sung hmuahhmuah ah i umpitu cu nanmah nan si."},"29":{"text":"Ka Pa in uk theinak thu i pek vekin kei khal in uk theinak thu ka lo pe ve ding."},"30":{"text":"Ka Uknak sungih ka cabuai ah nan ei nan in ding ih Israel phun hleihnih uktu dingah bawi tokham parah nan to ding,” a ti."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Simon, Simon, ngaihnik! Lothlo pa in fang cu a fangngai le a hii a thiatdan ṭheu vekin Satan in nanmah lakah thiatdang dingah le nan zatein hniksak dingah thu a ngah zo.","title":"Piter Ih Phatsan Ding Thu A Sim (Mat 26.31-35 ; Mar 14.27-31 ; Joh 13.36-38)"},"32":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Simon, na zumnak a tlaksam lonak dingah na hrangah thla ka cam. Cule ka hnen lam na hoikir sal tikah na unau pawl kha thazaang na pe pei,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Piter in, “Bawipa, nangmah thawn thawng tlatlaang dingah le thitlaang dingah ka tiar a si,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Piter, fiangtein ka lo sim: Tuihzan ah ka thei hrimhrim lo tiah voithum tiang i phatsan hlanlo ar a khuang lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in a dungthluntu pawl kha, “Tangka bawm le zaal le kedam keng loin ka lo thlah laiah khan ziangtal tlaksammi nan nei maw?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Tlaksammi zianghman kan nei lo,” tiah an ti.","title":"Tangka Bawm, Zaal Le Ralnam"},"36":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Sikhalsehla tuih ṭum cu tangka bawm a nei mi in tangka bawm keng uh, zaal a nei mi in zaal keng uh. Ralnam a nei lo mi in a korfual zuar in ralnam pakhat leiseh."},"37":{"text":"Ziangahtile fiangtein ka lo sim: Ca Thianghlim in ‘Amah cu misual lakah a tuar ve a si,’ tiah keimah ih thu an nganmi kha a kim ding; ziangahtile keimah ih thu nganmi hmuahhmuah kha a kim vivo zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl in, “Bawipa, zohhnik! Hinah ralnam pahnih a um!” tiah an ti. Anih in, “Cu vial a tawk!” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Jesuh cu khawpi lengah a suak ih a feh ṭheunak Olif tlang ah a hung feh; dungthluntu pawl khal an feh ve.","title":"Olif Tlangah Jesuh Thla A Cam (Mat 26.36-46 ; Mar 14.32-42)"},"40":{"text":"Cuih tlang a thlen tikah an hnenah, “Sualforhnak sungih nan luh lonak dingah thla cam uh,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Cule lungden ban tluk a hlatnak ah a va feh ih a khuk bilh in thla a cam."},"42":{"text":"“Ka Pa, na lungkimmi a si ahcun hi tuarnak hai hi i lak sak hram aw. Sikhalsehla keimah ih duhnak si loin nangmah ih duhnak vekin si ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Van ihsin vancungmi a rung lang ih thazaang a rung pek."},"44":{"text":"A thinlung a baangzet ih taimak sinsin in thla a cam; a suakmi a thlan cu thifor bangin leilung ah a tla."},"45":{"text":"A thlacamnak ihsin a tho ih a dungthluntu pawl hnenih a va kir tikah an rak itthat ṭheh kha a hmu; an thinhar in an baangzet ruangah a si."},"46":{"text":"An hnenah, “Ziangah so nan ihthat? Sualforhnak sungih tla lo dingin tho uhla thla cam uh,” tiah a ti."},"47":{"text":"Jesuh a ṭong rero laiah dungthluntu hleihnih lakih pakhat a si mi Judas ih a hruaimi miburpi pawl an ra thleng. Jesuh hnam dingah Judas cun a hun fuuk.","title":"Jesuh An Kaihnak (Mat 26.47-56 ; Mar 14.43-50 ; Joh 18.3-11)"},"48":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh in, “Judas, Milai Fapa hi hnamnak in maw na zuar?” tiah a rak ti."},"49":{"text":"Jesuh hnenih a ummi dungthlun pawl in ziang a cang ti kha an hmuh tikah Jesuh cu, “Bawipa, kan ralnam hi kan hmang ding maw?” tiah an sut."},"50":{"text":"Cule anmah lakih pakhat in Puithiam Saang ih salpa a vun saat ih a vorhlam hna a saat thlak."},"51":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh cun, “Tawk seh!” a ti ih an tuahmawh mipa ih hna cu a tham ih a damter."},"52":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in amah kai dingih a ra thlengmi puithiam upa pawl le biakinn kiltu bawi pawl le khua upa pawl hnenah cun, “Kei hi suamhmang maw ka si, ralnam le talhtum thawn nan rat?"},"53":{"text":"Nitinte in nan hnenah Biakinn sungah ka um naón zohman in in kai lo! Sikhalsehla atu hi khawthim huham a cah lai caan a si ih nannih nan hnaṭuan caan a si,” tiah a ti."},"54":{"text":"Jesuh cu an kai ih Puithiam Sang ih innah an fehpi; cule Piter in a hlat nawn in a thlun.","title":"Piter In Jesuh A Phatsan (Mat 26.57-58 , 69-75 ; Mar 14.53-54 , 66-72 ; Joh 18.12-18 , 25-27)"},"55":{"text":"Tual laifangah meipual an sep ih mei a aitu pawl hnenah cun Piter khal a to ve."},"56":{"text":"Hnen-um nu pakhat in Piter meisa kiangih a to kha a hmuh tikah hmaiton-in a zohhliah ih, “Hi pa hi Jesuh hnenih a tel vemi a si,” tiah a ti."},"57":{"text":"Asinain Piter in, “Nunau nu, cupa cu zo a si ti hman ka thei lo,” tiah a ti."},"58":{"text":"Malte a rei hnuah mi pakhat in a hmu ve ih, “Nang tla na tel ve ko,” tiah a ti. Asinain Piter in, “Mi pa, kei ka tel lo,” a ti."},"59":{"text":"Cule nazi pakhat tluk a rei hnuah midang pakhat in, “Hi pa hi Jesuh hnenah a tel ve, ti cu zum lo ding ṭha a si lo; ziangahtile amah khal hi Galilee mi a si ve ko,” tiah fiang zetin a ti."},"60":{"text":"Asinain Piter cun, “Maw mipa, ziang nan ṭong ti hman ka thei lo,” tiah a ti thotho. Cutiih a ṭong rero laiah cun ar a khuang."},"61":{"text":"Bawipa cu a her ih Piter kha a zohhliah; cule Piter cun Bawipa in, “Tuihzan ar a khuan hlanah voithum tiang ka thei lo tiah i phatsan ding,” a timi kha a vun mang sal."},"62":{"text":"Piter cu a suak ih ninghang zetin a ṭap."},"63":{"text":"Jesuh a kiltu pawl in amah cu an dekcok ih an thawi.","title":"Jesuh An Dekcok Ih An Thawi (Mat 26.67-68 ; Mar 14.65)"},"64":{"text":"A hmai puan in an tuam ih, “Zoso a lo thawi? Simhnik!” tiah an ti."},"65":{"text":"Cule nautatnak ṭongkam tampi khal an ṭong."},"66":{"text":"Khua a hung vang ih upa pawl, puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl an tongkhawm aw ih Jesuh cu khonsil hmaiah an suahpi.","title":"Khonsil Hmaiah Jesuh An Thlenpi (Mat 26.59-66 ; Mar 14.55-64 ; Joh 18.19-24)"},"67":{"text":"Annih in, “Messiah na si maw? In simhnik!” tiah an sut. Jesuh in, “Ka lo sim hmanah in zum lo ding."},"68":{"text":"Cule thu ka lo sut khalle in let fawn lo ding."},"69":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu thokin Milai Fapa cu Cungnungbik Pathian ih vorhlam kapah toter a si ding,” tiah a ti."},"70":{"text":"An zatein, “Cuti asile Pathian Fapa maw na si?” tiah an ti. Anih in, “Ka si kha nanmah in nan sim!” tiah a let."},"71":{"text":"Cule annih pawl in, “Theihpitu dang kan ṭul nawn lo. Amah ih awkam rori kan thei zo,” tiah an ti."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"An zatein an pok ih Jesuh cu Pilat hmaiah an hruai.","title":"Jesuh Cu Pilat Hmaiah An Suahpi (Mat 27.1-2 , 11-14 ; Mar 15.1-5 ; Joh 18.28-38)"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkah cun sual an puh ih, “Hi pa hin kan misenpi a hruai sual ih kan kai a si; Rom Siangpahrang hnenah ngunkhuai nan pe lo ding, tiah a sim ih, ‘Messiah ka si, Siangpahrang ka si,’ a ti,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Pilat in, “Judah siangpahrang na si maw?” tiah a sut. Jesuh in, “Nangmah in na sim zo!” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule Pilat in puithiam upa le misenpi hnenah cun, “Himi pa hi a sualnak ka hmu lo,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Asinain an ṭangṭha sinsin ih, “A thu zirhnak ruangah Judea peng pumpi-ah hnaihnawhnak a khat. Galilee in a thawh ih atu hitawk a thleng zo,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Pilat in cumi cu a theih tikah, “Hi pa hi Galilee mi a si maw?” tiah a sut.","title":"Herod Hmaiah Jesuh An Hruai"},"7":{"text":"Pilat in Jesuh cu Herod ih ukmi ram sungmi a si ti kha a theih tikah Herod hnenah Jesuh cu a kuat. Culai fangah Herod cu Jerusalem khawsungah a rak um ngelcel."},"8":{"text":"Herod in Jesuh kha a hmuh tikah a lung a awi ngaingai, ziangahtile a thu kha a thei ringring ṭheu ih hmuh a duhnak a rei zet zo. Jesuh ih a tuahmi hmuhsaknak kha hmu ve sehla a saduhthah a si."},"9":{"text":"Curuangah Herod in Jesuh kha thu tampi a sut, asinain Jesuh cun kam khat hman a let lo."},"10":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl cu hmailamah an ra suak ih Jesuh cu nasazet in sual an puh."},"11":{"text":"Herod le a ralkap pawl in Jesuh cu hnihsuahsainak ah an hmang ih an dekcok. Cule puan mawizet an sinter ih Pilat hnenah an kuat sal."},"12":{"text":"A cuih ni rori-ah cun Herod le Pilat cu rualpi ṭha ah an cang; cuih hlanah cun a hua aw zetmi an si."},"13":{"text":"Pilat in puithiam upa pawl, hotu pawl le mipi pawl cu a kokhawm ih,","title":"Jesuh That Dingin Thu An Relcat (Mat 27.15-26 ; Mar 15.6-15 ; Joh 18.39—19.16)"},"14":{"text":"an hnenah cun, “Hi pa hi ka hnenah nan rak hruai ih misenpi a hruai sual a si, tiah nan ti. Asinain hitawk nan mithmuh ah ka zingzoi naón sual nan puh mi hmuahhmuah ahhin a sualnak zianghman ka hmu lo."},"15":{"text":"Herod khal in a sualnak a hmuh lo ruangah ka hnenih a rak kuat salnak a si. Thihnak tlak ih a tuahmi thil pakhat hman a um lo."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah ka vuak pei ih ka thlah pei,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"(Lantak Puai tuah tinte in an hrangah Pilat in thawngtla pakhat a thlah ṭheu.)"},"18":{"text":"Pilat ih ṭong an theih tikah misenpi cu an au ciammam ih, “Amah that aw! Barabbas in thlahsak sawn aw!” tiah an ti."},"19":{"text":"(Barabbas cu khawpi sungah buainak a suahpitu le mithat a si ruangah thawngih an thlakmi a si.)"},"20":{"text":"Pilat in Jesuh cu luatter a duh ruangah misenpi hnenah thu a sim sal."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla annih cun, “Thinglamtah ah that aw! Thinglamtah ah that aw!” tiah an au thotho."},"22":{"text":"Pilat cun voithumnak tiang a sim sal ih, “Ziang sualnak so a tuah? Thihnak tlak ih a tuahmi sualnak ka hmu hrimhrim lo. Ka vuak ding ih ka thlah ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an aw neih patawp in an au ih Jesuh cu thah ding hrimhrim a si, tiih an au sinsin ruangah a netnak ahcun an au-nak in a neh."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah an dil vekin Pilat in Jesuh cu thah dingin a relcat."},"25":{"text":"Misenpi in suak seh tiih an duh mipa, thubuai ruang le mi thah ruangih thawngih an thlak mipa cu Pilat cun a suah; cule misenpi saduhthah vekin Jesuh cu an duhduh ih tuah dingah an kut ah a pek."},"26":{"text":"Ralkap pawl in Jesuh cu an hruai ih an feh laiah cun Sairin khua mi Simon, khawte lam ihsin khawpiih a rami pa an tong. Cupa cu an kai, thinglamtah an putter ih Jesuh dungin an thlunter.","title":"Jesuh Thinglamtah Ah An Khen (Mat 27.32-44 ; Mar 15.21-32 ; Joh 19.17-27)"},"27":{"text":"Mi tampi in Jesuh an hruaimi cu an thlun ih cu lakah an ṭaang cuum in a raak kio rerotu nunau ṭhenkhat an um."},"28":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cun dunglet a hoih ih an hnenah, “Maw Jerusalem nunau pawl, ka hrangah cun ṭap hlah uh; nanmah ih hrang le nan faate pawl hrangah ṭap sawn uh."},"29":{"text":"Ziangahtile ‘Naute a nei dah lomi, fa a vun dah lomi le voikhat hman naute pawhte a fawh dah lomi nunau pawl hi an van a va ṭha so!’ tiih an ti caan a thleng ding."},"30":{"text":"Cuih caan cu mi in tlang sangpi hnenah ‘In run nen aw,’ tiin le mual hnenah ‘In run khuh aw,’ tiih an ti caan a si ding."},"31":{"text":"Ziangahtile thing a hrin lai hmanah hi bangtuk thil an tuah a si ahcun thing a ro tik sinsin ahcun ziang a bang pei maw?” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Jesuh thawn hmun khatih thah dingah misual pahnih khal an hruai ve."},"33":{"text":"“Luruh,” an timi hmun an thlen tikah cutawk hmunah cun Jesuh cu thinglamtah parah an thlai ih misual pahnih khal cu a vorhlam ah pakhat, a kehlam ah pakhat an thlai ve."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ka pa, an sualnak run ngaithiam aw. Ziang kan tuah ti an thei lo,” tiah a ti. Cule amah a thattu pawl cun camcawhfung zuukin a hnipuan cu an zem aw."},"35":{"text":"Misenpi pawl in an cuan ih an zoh ringring laiah Judah mi hotu pawl cun nautatnak thawn, “Midang hmuah a run ngah ṭheu; Pathian ih hrilmi Messiah a si ngaingai ahcun amah le amah khal run aw seh,” tiah an ṭongsan."},"36":{"text":"Ralkap pawl khal in an hnihsan ve ih amah va fuuk tahratin a man olmi sabitti thur an pek ih,"},"37":{"text":"“Judah siangpahrang na si ahcun nangmah le nangmah run aw aw he!” tiah an ti."},"38":{"text":"A lu tlun ah, “Hi pa hi Judah Siangpahrang a si,” tiah nganmi ca an taar."},"39":{"text":"Thinglamtah parih an khenmi misual pa pakhat cun nautatnak ṭong thawn, “Nangmah hi Messiah na si lo maw? Nangmah le nangmah run aw awla kannih tla hi in run ve aw he!” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Asinain misual pakhat pa cun, “Pathian na ṭih lo maw si? Kan parih thuṭhennak an tuahmi hi a bangrep ṭheh."},"41":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kannih pahnih parih an tuahmi thuṭhennak hi cu a dikmi a si, ziangahtile kan thil tuah ruangih kan tuar tlakmi kan tuar a si. Asinain hi pa hi cu sualnak zianghman a tuah lo,” tiin a mawhthluk."},"42":{"text":"Cule Jesuh hnenah, “Maw Jesuh, Siangpahrang ih na rat tikah i hngilh hram hlah aw,” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Jesuh in cu pa ih hnenah cun, “Thu ka lo kam a si: tuihsun ah keimah thawn Paradis ah na um ding,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"Sun nazi hleihnih hrawngin cuih ram pumpuluk ah zanlam nazi pathum tiang thimkhawzing a tlung.","title":"Jesuh Thihnak (Mat 27.45-56 ; Mar 15.33-41 ; Joh 19.28-30)"},"45":{"text":"Cule Biakinn ih zaarmi puanzar cu a tlek ih ṭhen hnih ah a ṭhen aw."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh cu napi in a au ih, “Ka pa, ka thlarau na kut sungah ka lo pe,” tiah a ti. Cutiih a sim ṭheh hnuah a thaw a cem."},"47":{"text":"Cumi cu ralbawi pa in a hmuh tikah Pathian kha a thangṭhat ih, “Hi pa hi cu sualnak nei lo miṭha a si!” tiah a ti."},"48":{"text":"Cuih thil hmuahhmuah zoh dingah a rami mipi pawl in cuih thil a cangmi pawl an hmuh ngah tikah ninghang in an ṭaang an cuum ih riahsia in innah an tlung."},"49":{"text":"Pumpak in Jesuh a theitu hmuahhmuah le Galilee ihsin a rak thluntu nunau pawl tla cun a hlat nawnah an ding ih an cuan."},"50":{"text":"Judea ram Arimathea timi khua ah Josef an timi mi pakhat a um. Amah cu miṭha le upat hmaizah tlakmi a si ih Pathian Uknak a ra cing ding, tiah a hngaktu a si. Amah cu khonsil sungtel pakhat a si ve naón khonsil thurelnak le thiltuahmi cu a lung a kim lo.","title":"Jesuh Phumnak (Mat 27.57-61 ; Mar 15.42-47 ; Joh 19.38-42)","merge":"51"},"52":{"text":"Cupa cu Pilat hnenah a feh ih Jesuh ih ruak cu a va dil."},"53":{"text":"Cule Jesuh ruak cu thinglamtah par ihsin a ṭhum ih puan neemte in a tuam hnuah zohman ih hman hrih lo, lung an khermi thlaan thar sungah a phum."},"54":{"text":"Cumi cu tlawngkai ni nga ni a si ih Sabbath ni a thok zik thlang."},"55":{"text":"Galilee ihsin Jesuh a rak thluntu nunau pawl cu Josef an thlun ih thlaanah cun an feh ve. A thlaan le a sungih Jesuh ruak an vui daan khal cu an hmu ṭheh."},"56":{"text":"Cule an inn ah an kir ih Jesuh ruak culh dingah rimhmui le zihmui pawl an ngaihtuah. Sabbath ni-ah cun an Daan ih a fial vekin an cawl."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nipi ni zing thlapit ah nunau pawl cu an timtuah ciami rimhmui pawl kengin thlaan ah an feh.","title":"Jesuh Thawhsalnak (Mat 28.1-10 ; Mar 16.1-8 ; Joh 20.1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Thlankhar lung phengpi a rak ṭhawn aw zo kha an hmu;"},"3":{"text":"cu hrangah an vung lut, asinain Bawipa Jesuh ih ruak cu an hmu lo."},"4":{"text":"An mang a bang ih an ding; culai fangah hmakhatte ah hnipuan tleuzet hrukin mi pahnih an kiangah an rung ding."},"5":{"text":"An ṭih ngaingai ih leilungah an bok; cutikah mi pahnih cun, “Ziangah so a thimi lakah a nungmi cu nan hawl?"},"6":{"text":"Hinah a um nawn lo; a tho sal zo. Galilee-ih a um laiah nan hnenih a simmi kha nan ciing lo maw?"},"7":{"text":"‘Milai Fapa hi misual pawl kut sungah pek a si ding; thinglamtah parah an khen ding ih ni thum hnuah a tho sal ding,’ a ti kha!” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule nunau pawl cun a ṭong kha an vun mang sal ih,"},"9":{"text":"thlaan ihsin an kir hnuah dungthluntu hleikhat le midang pawl hnenah an sim."},"10":{"text":"Nunau pawl cu Mari Magdalene, Joanna le Jeim ih nu Mari tla an si. Anmah le nunau dang an hnenih a telmi pawl in a dungthluntu pawl kha an sim."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a dungthluntu pawl cun nunau pawl ih simmi cu thulolak ah an ruat ih an zum lo."},"12":{"text":"Asinain Piter cu a pok ih thlaanah cun a va tlan. Kuun tahratin a vun bih ih ruak tuamnak puan neemte lawng a hmu; a dang zianghman a hmu lo. Cule cutiih a cangmi cu a mangbang zetin inn ah a tlung sal."},"13":{"text":"Cuih ni thotho ah Jesuh a rak thluntu mi pahnih cu Jerusalem ihsin peng sarih hrawng a hlami Emmaus timi khua ah an feh.","title":"Emmaus Khua Ah A Feh (Mar 16.12-13)"},"14":{"text":"Cule tubaite ih thil a cangmi pawl cu an ruah aw vivo."},"15":{"text":"Cutiin an ṭong ih an relkhawm rero laiah cun Jesuh amah rori in a hun fuuk hai ih an feh tlang."},"16":{"text":"Amah cu an hmu naón an thei thiam lo."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Nan feh phahah ziang thu so nan rel rero?” tiah a sut. Cule an riahsia mithmai thawn an ding."},"18":{"text":"Pakhat pa, Kleopas an timi pa in, “Jerusalem khua a ra tlawngtu mi hmuahhmuah lakah nangmah lawng hi maw tuih ni hnih thum sungah Jerusalem khawsungih thil a cangmi pawl a thei lotu hi na si?” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Anih in, “Ziang thil maw?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Nazareth Jesuh parih thil a cangmi pawl!” tiah an let. “Himi pa cu Pathian hmai le misenpi hmaiah zozo khal in profet a si ih a ṭongmi ah siseh, a tuahmi ah siseh, huham a nei ngaingai tiih an ruah ṭhehmi a si."},"20":{"text":"Kan puithiam upa pawl le in hotu pawl in a thihnak rel dingah mi kut ah an pek ih cuticun thinglamtah parah an that."},"21":{"text":"Cule amah cu Israel mi tlentu a si ding, tiah ruahsannak kan rak neih zetmi a si. Cuih tlunah cubangtuk thil a can hnu tuih ni hi a ni thumnak ni a si."},"22":{"text":"Kan lakih nunau ṭhenkhat in kan mang in bangter fawn; tuihzing zingthlapit ah thlaan ah an va feh;"},"23":{"text":"asinain a ruak an va hmu lo. An ra kir ih ‘Vancungmi kan hmu ih Anih cu a nungsal zo, tiah in sim,’ tiah an ti."},"24":{"text":"Kan lakih mi ṭhenkhat thlaanah an va feh ve ih nunau pawl sim vek cekci in an va hmu ve; asinain amah cu an hmu thotho lo,” tiah an ti."},"25":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cun an hnenah, “Nannih hi nan va aa so! Profet pawl ih an rak sim ciami nan va zum har lawmmam so!"},"26":{"text":"Messiah hrangah hi thil pawl hmuahhmuah hi a tuarta ṭheh hnuah a sunlawinak sungih luh ding cu a ṭul lo maw si?” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in Ca Thianghlim sung Moses cauk pawl ihsin thokin profet pawl ih nganmi tiang, amah ih thu an ngannak hmuahhmuah kha an hnenah a simfiang."},"28":{"text":"An feh tumnak khua an thlen zik zawng ah Jesuh cu a feh hrih ding vekin a um awter."},"29":{"text":"Asinain annih in, “Kan hnenah riak ve ko aw! Khua a tlai zo ih a thim thlang fawn,” tiah an kai. Curuangah an hnen riak dingin a thlun."},"30":{"text":"An hnenah cun a to ih rawl an hil tlang. Sang a lak ih thla a cam hnuah a phel ih a zem hai."},"31":{"text":"Cutikah an mit a hung vaang ih Amah a si kha an thei thiam; asinain an mithmuh ah a hlo sal."},"32":{"text":"Anmah le anmah cu, “Lamzin kan feh tlang laiih kan hnenih a ṭong le Ca Thianghlim a simfiang rero laiah khan kan sungah meisa kang vekin a um tho lo maw kha?” tiah an ti aw."},"33":{"text":"Hmakhatteah Jerusalem ah an kir sal ih dungthlun hleikhat le a dang pawl an rak tonkhawm lai kha an va hmu ih,"},"34":{"text":"“Bawipa cu a tho sal taktak a si! Simon hnenah a lang!” tiih an rak sim awk rero kha an thei."},"35":{"text":"Annih pahnih khal in lamzin ih thil a cangmi thu le sang a phel zawng ih Bawipa a si ti an theihthiamnak thu pawl kha an sim ve."},"36":{"text":"An pahnih in lamzin ih thil a cangmi pawl thu kha dungthluntu hnenih an rel rero laiah hmakhatte ah an lakah Bawipa cu a rung ding ih, “Nan hnenah daihnak um seh,” tiah a ti.","title":"Dungthlun Pawl Hnenah Jesuh A Lang (Mat 28.16-20 ; Mar 16.14-18 ; Joh 20.19-23 ; Dung 1.6-8)"},"37":{"text":"Mithla kan hmu tiah an ruat ih an ṭih ngaingai."},"38":{"text":"Asinain anih in, “Ziangah so nan thin a phan? Ziangah so nan thinlung sungah rinhmainak a um ciamco?"},"39":{"text":"Ka kut le ka ke tla hi zohhnik uh! Keimah sokhaw ka si! I tham uhla nan thei ding; ziangahtile mithla cun ruh le titsa a nei lo, kei cu ka nei ti in hmu a si!” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Cutiin a sim ih a kut le a ke tla cu a hmuh hai."},"41":{"text":"An zum thei thotho lo; an lung a awi tukih an mang tla a bang tuk fawn. Curuangah anmah cu, “Hinah ei ṭha ziangtal nan nei maw?” tiah a sut."},"42":{"text":"Annih in nga pum khat suan cia an pek ih,"},"43":{"text":"a lak ih an hmuh hnganah cun a ei."},"44":{"text":"Cule an hnenah cun, “Nan hnen ka um laiah ka sim reromi cu hi thil pawl hi sokhaw an si: Moses Daan cabu sung, profet pawl ih nganmi cabu sung le Saam cabu sungih keimah ih thu an rak nganmi pawl cu a kim ṭheh a ṭul a si,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Cun an thinlung mit a vangter ih Ca Thianghlim ih simmi kha an thei thei."},"46":{"text":"An hnenah, “An nganmi cu hihi a si: Messiah cu a tuar pei ih a thih hnu ni thumnak ah a tho sal ding."},"47":{"text":"Cule Jerusalem ihsin thokin miphun hmuahhmuah hnenah amah hmin ih sualsirnak le sualngaidamnak thuthang cu phuan a si ding."},"48":{"text":"Nannih cu hi thil cangmi pawl ih thutheitu nan si."},"49":{"text":"Cule ka Pa ih a lo tiam ciami kha keimah rori in nan parah ka run thlah ding. Asinain tlunlam ihsin huham nan hnenih a rung thlen hlanlo khawpi sungin nan hngak pei,” tiah a ti."},"50":{"text":"Cun khawpi ihsin a hruai suak hai ih Bethani khua tiang an feh. Cutawkah a ban a pharh ih thlawsuah a pek hai.","title":"Jesuh Vancung ah A Kai (Mat 16.19-20 ; Dung 1.9-11)"},"51":{"text":"Cutiih thlawsuahnak a pek laiah an hnen ihsin a suak ih vancungah a kai."},"52":{"text":"Amah cu an biak ih lungawi zetin Jerusalem ah an kir."},"53":{"text":"An tikcu hmuahhmuah cu Biakinn sungah Pathian thangṭhatnak ah an hmang."}}}}},"43":{"info":{"name":"Johan","shortname":"Joh","abbr":[],"desc":"Johan nganmi thuthang òha"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A hramthokah Thu a rak um. Cuih Thu cu Pathian thawn a um ih Pathian a si.","title":"Nunnak Thu"},"2":{"text":"A hramthok ihsin cuih Thu cu Pathian thawn a um zo."},"3":{"text":"Amah sung ihsin Pathian in ziang hmuahhmuah a seemsuah; seemsuah mi thil hmuahhmuah sungah hin amah tel loih tuahmi pakhatte hman a um lo."},"4":{"text":"Cuih Thu cu nunnak ih hram a si ih cuih nunnak cun minung hnenah tleunak a run thlen."},"5":{"text":"Tleunak cu khawthim sungah a tleu ih thimnak in a hmit thei dah lo."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in a palai Johan a thlah ih,"},"7":{"text":"Johan cu mi hnenah cuih tleunak thu sim dingin a ra. A simmi hmuahhmuah in an theih ih an zumnak dingah a ra a si."},"8":{"text":"Anih cu tleunak a si lo; tleunak thu sim dingah a rami a si sawn."},"9":{"text":"Cuih tleunak cu tleunak taktak a si. Cuih tleunak cu leitlun ah a ra ih mi hmuahhmuah tlettu a si."},"10":{"text":"Cuih Thu cu leitlun ah hin a um ih amah sung ihsin Pathian in leilung hi a tuah naón leilung in amah cu a thei lo."},"11":{"text":"A ram sungah a ra naón a minung pawl in an rak saang lo."},"12":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat cun an saang ih an zum; curuangah Pathian ih faate cantheinak thu a pek."},"13":{"text":"Pathian ih faate an cannak cu leilung daan, minung ih thi le sa in hrinmi in a si lo; Pathian amah rori kha an Pa a si."},"14":{"text":"Cuih Thu cu minung ah a cang ih kan lakah a um; zaangfahnak le thutak in a khat. A sunlawinak kan hmu ih a Pa in a fapa neihsun hnenih a pekmi sunlawinak a si."},"15":{"text":"Johan in cupa ih thu cu hiti in a sim: “‘Amah cu ka hnuah a ra; asinain kei hnakin a tum sawn, ziangahtile amah cu ka suah hlanah a rak um zo,’ tiih ka lo simmi kha amah ih thu hi a si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"A famkim zetmi a zaangfahnak thawn kannih cu in thlawsuah zo ih a thlawsuah cu pakhat hnu pakhat in pek a si."},"17":{"text":"Pathian ih Daan cu Moses hnen ihsin in pek; asinain zaangfahnak le thutak cu Jesuh Khrih sung ihsin a ra."},"18":{"text":"Zohman in Pathian cu an hmu dah lo. A Pa ih Fapa neihsun, a ṭaang sungih a pommi, Pathian a si mi in a langter zo a si."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem ih Judah hotu pawl in puithiam ṭhenkhat pawl le Levi mi pawl kha Johan hnenah cun an thlah ih, “Nang hi zoso na si?” tiah an va sut.","title":"Baptisma Petu Johan Simmi Thu (Mat 3.1-12 ; Mar 1.1-18 ; Luk 3.1-18)"},"20":{"text":"Johan cun an thusuhmi cu pheh lotein a let ih, “Kei hi Messiah ka si lo,” tiah fiangtein zapi theih ah a sim."},"21":{"text":"Annih in, “Asile zoso na si? Elijah na si maw?” tiah an sut. Johan in, “Ka si lo,” a ti. Annih in, “Profet na si maw?” an ti lala. “Ka si lo,” a ti thotho."},"22":{"text":"Annih in, “Cuti asile zoso na si, in simhnik. Na thu lehmi cu in thlahtu hnenah kan va sim sal a ṭul. Zo ka si, tiin so na ti awk?” tiah an sut."},"23":{"text":"Johan in Profet Isaiah ih simmi kha a vun lak ih, “Kei cu ‘Bawipa ih fehnak lamzin kha dingter uh,’ tiih ramṭhingih a au-mi aw kha ka si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isai 40.3"},"24":{"text":"Farasi pawl ih an thlahmi palai pawl cun,"},"25":{"text":"Johan cu thu an sut sal ih, “Messiah na si lo ih Elijah le Profet khal na si lo ahcun ziangah so baptisma na pek?” tiah an ti."},"26":{"text":"Johan in, “Kei cun tidai in baptisma ka pek, asinain nan lakah nan theih hrih lomi mi pakhat a um."},"27":{"text":"Amah cu ka dungah a ra lai; sikhalsehla kei cu a kedam hri phoihtu hmanah ka tlak lo,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Hitiih an suh awknak hmun cu Johan in baptisma a peknak Jordan tiva ihsin nisuah lamih a ummi Bethani khua ah a si."},"29":{"text":"A thaisun ah Johan in Jesuh a hnenih a rat lai kha a hmu ih, “Leilung sualnak a phurtu Pathian Tuufa khi zohhnik uh!","title":"Pathian Tuufa"},"30":{"text":"‘Ka dungin mi pakhat a ra, asinain kei hnakin a tum sawn, ziangahtile ka suah hlanah anih cu a rak um zo,’ tiih a thuhla ka sim rero zo mipa cu amah hi a si."},"31":{"text":"Amah hi zo a si ding ti ka rak thei lo. Asinain amah hi Israel mi pawl ih an theihnak dingah tidai in baptisma ka pek rero sannak a si,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Johan in, “Thlarau cu vancung ihsin thuro bangin a rung ih a parah a rung fut kha ka hmu."},"33":{"text":"Amah teu a si tihi ka rak thei thotho cuang lo, sikhalsehla tidai in baptisma pe dingih i thlahtu Pathian in ‘Thlarau a rung ding ih mi pakhat parih a fut kha na hmu ding; cupa cu Thlarau Thianghlim in baptisma petu ding a si,’ tiah i sim."},"34":{"text":"Cupa cu ka hmu ngah zo. Fiangtein ka lo sim: Amah cu Pathian Fapa a si,” tiah a hmuhmi le a theihmi kha a sim."},"35":{"text":"A thaisun ah Johan le a dungthluntu pahnih cu cutawk ah an ding sal ih,","title":"Jesuh Dungthluntu Hmaisa Bik Pawl"},"36":{"text":"Jesuh a rat kha an hmuh tikah, “Pathian Tuufa khi zohhnik uh,” tiah Johan in a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cutiih a timi cu a dungthluntu pahnih cun an thei ih Jesuh hnenah cun an feh ve."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh cu a dunglet a her ih an rak thlun kha a hmuh tikah, “Ziang so nan hawl?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Rabbi, khui-ah so na um?” tiah an let. Rabbi ticu zirhtu Sayapa tinak a si."},"39":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ra uhla ra zohhnik uh,” tiah a ti. Cuih tikcu cu zanlam nazi pali hrawng a si. An feh ih a umnak cu an va hmu ih cuih ni cu a hnenah an caam ta."},"40":{"text":"Cuih mi pahnih lakah pakhat cu Simon Piter ih naupa Andru a si."},"41":{"text":"Hmakhatteah a u-pa Simon kha a va hawl ih a hmuh tikah, “Messiah cu kan hmu zo,” tiah a ti. Messiah timi cu Khrih tinak a si."},"42":{"text":"Cule Simon cu Jesuh hnenah a fehpi. Jesuh in amah cu a zoh ih, “Na hmin cu Johan fapa Simon a si; sikhalsehla Sefas tiah kawh na si thlang ding,” a ti. Sefas ticu Piter ti thawn a bang aw ih a tican cu ‘lungto,’ tinak a si."},"43":{"text":"A thaisun ah Jesuh cu Galilee feh a tum. Filip kha a hmu ih a hnenah, “I thlun aw,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh In Filip Le Nathanael A Ko"},"44":{"text":"Filip cu Andru le Piter umnak Bethsaida khua mi a si."},"45":{"text":"Filip in Nathanael a tong ih a hnenah, “Moses in Daan cabu sungah a thuhla a nganmi le profet pawl khal in a thuhla an ngan mipa kha kan tong zo. Amah cu Josef fapa Jesuh, Nazareth khuami a si,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Nathanael in, “Nazareth khua in thil ṭha a suak thei pei maw?” tiah a ti. Filip in, “Ra zohhnik awla!” tiah a ti."},"47":{"text":"Jesuh in Nathanael a rat kha a hmuh tikah, “Israel mi taktak hi zohhnik uh! A thinlung ah zianghman hrawhhrawlnak a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"48":{"text":"Nathanael in, “Ziangtin so i theih?” tiah a sut. Jesuh in, “Filip ih a lo kawh hlan theipi kung hnuai ih na to lai ah khan ka lo hmu zo,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Nathanael in, “Sayapa, nang cu Pathian Fapa na si! Israel Siangpahrang na si!” tiah a ti."},"50":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Theipi kung hnuai ih na to lai ka lo hmu, ka ti ruangah i zum a si maw? Hi hnakih thil maksak tampi na hmu lai ding!” tiah a ti."},"51":{"text":"Cule an hnenah, “Thungai in ka lo sim: vancung khi a ong aw ding ih Milai Fapa parah hin Pathian ih vancungmi an ṭum le an kai kha nan hmu ding,” tiah a ti."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni hnih hnuah Galilee peng Kana khua ah nupi ṭhit puai a um. Jesuh ih nu khal cunah a um ih,","title":"Kana Khua Ih Nupi ṭhit Puai"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl kha an sawm ve."},"3":{"text":"An sabitti a cem tikah a nu in Jesuh hnenah, “Sabitti an nei nawn lo,” tiah a ra sim."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Jesuh in, “Ka nu, i sim duh hlah; ka tikcu a kim hrih lo,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"A nu cun hnen-um pawl hnenah, “A lo simmi poh tuah uh,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cutawkah Judah daanih a um vekin an kut kholhnak hrangah tidai ralca beel tumpi beel ruk an ret. Beel khat in galan kul ihsin sawmthum tiang a dawl thei."},"7":{"text":"Jesuh in hnen-um pawl hnenah cun, “Hi beel pawl hi tidai khat tein than uh,” a ti. Liam thluahthlo in an than ih,"},"8":{"text":"an hnenah cun, “Beel sung tidai cu vun suak uhla puaituahnak a tawlreltu pa hnenah hei pek uh,” tiah a ti. Tidai cu an hei pek."},"9":{"text":"Cuih tidai cu sabitti ah a cang ih cumi cu a tep. Khuitawkin cuih sabitti cu a ra ti a thei lo; tidai a suaktu hnen-um pawl cun an thei ko. Curuangah nupi ṭhitu pa cu a ko ih,"},"10":{"text":"a hnenah cun, “Zozo khal in sabitti thaw bik kha a hmaisabik ah an pe ṭheu ih mi tampi an khawh deuh hnuah sabitti menmen kha an pe ṭheu; asinain nang cun sabitti thaw bik kha a netnak tiang na pe thei,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in hi mangbangza hmaisa bik hi Galilee peng Kana khua ah a tuah. Cuticun a sunlawinak a langter ih a dungthluntu pawl in an zum."},"12":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh le a nu, a naule pawl le a dungthluntu pawl cu Kapernaum khua ah an feh ih cutawkah ni malte sung an cam."},"13":{"text":"Lantak Puai tikcu a kim zik thlang ih Jesuh cu Jerusalem ah a feh.","title":"Biakinn Ah Jesuh A Feh (Mat 21.12-13 ; Mar 11.15-17 ; Luk 19.45-46)"},"14":{"text":"Biakinn a thlen tikah cutawkih caw le tuu le laileng pawl a zuartu le tangka a thlengtu pawl an cabuai ih an to kha a hmu."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah hri kha vuaknak fung ai-ah a merh ih, tuu siseh caw siseh an zuarmi pawl cu a vuak ih Biakinn sung ihsin a dawi ṭheh; tangka thlengtu pawl ih cabuai pawl khal a linglet ṭheh ih an tangkanawi pawl a thehdarh ṭheh."},"16":{"text":"Laileng a zuartu pawl cu, “Hitawk ihsin nan laileng pawl kha tlanpi ṭheh uh! Ka Pa ih inn cu nan dawr tuahnak ah hmang nawn hlah uh!” tiah thu a pek."},"17":{"text":"Cutikah a dungthluntu pawl in, “Maw Pathian, na inn ka tlaihsannak cu ka lung sungah meisa bangin a alh,” tiah Ca Thianghlim ih a rak timi kha an vun mang sal.","ref":"Saam 69.9"},"18":{"text":"Judah mi hotu pawl cu an ra sal ih, “Hi bangtuk thil tuah theinak thu ka nei, ti na langternak ah ziang hmuhsaknak so in hmuh ding?” tiah an sut."},"19":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hi Biakinn hi bal uhla ni thum sungah ka sak sal thei ding,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Annih in, “Ni thum sungah na sak sal thei ngai pei maw? Hi Biakinn saknak ah hin kum sawm li le kum ruk a rei a si,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Jesuh ih a sim duhmi Biakinn cu amah ih taksa ruangpi kha a si."},"22":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh thihnak ihsin a thawhsal tikah a dungthluntu pawl in amah ih taksa ruangpi thu a sim ti kha an thei sal ih Ca Thianghlim simmi le Jesuh simmi kha an zum."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh cu Lantak Puai sung Jerusalem khawsungih a um laiah mi tampi in mangbangza a tuahmi an hmuh ruangah amah kha an zum.","title":"Jesuh In Minung Sizia A Thei ṭheh"},"24":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh cun a thinlung zatein a zum hai lo, ziangahtile minung cu ziangvek an si ti kha a thei ṭheh."},"25":{"text":"An thuhla cu midang ih sim a ṭul lo, ziangahtile an thinlung ziangvek a si ti cu amah in a thei ṭheh a si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah mi hotu pa pakhat, a hminah Nikodemas an timi a rak um; amah cu Farasi mi a si.","title":"Jesuh Le Nikodemas"},"2":{"text":"Zan khat cu Jesuh hnenah a va feh ih Jesuh cu, “Rabbi, nang cu Pathian ih run thlahmi saya na si, ti kan lo thei. Mangbangza na tuahmi pawl hi Pathian tel lo cun zohman in an tuah thei lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Thungaite in ka lo sim: zokhal hrin sal a si lo ahcun Pathian Uknak a hmu thei lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Nikodemas in, “Ziangtin so patling cia cu hrin sal a si thei ding? A nuih pum sungah lut tahratin voihnih hrin sal cu a si thei hrimhrim lo ding,” tiah a sawn."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Thungaite in ka lo sim: zokhal tidai le Thlarau in hrin sal a si lo ahcun Pathian Uknak sungah a lut thei lo ding."},"6":{"text":"Minung cu taksa lam cun a nu le a pa sung ihsin hrinmi a si; sikhalsehla thlarau lamah cun Thlarau ih hrinmi a si."},"7":{"text":"Hrin salmi na si a ṭul ka ti tikah na mangbang hlah."},"8":{"text":"Thli cu a duhnak poh ah a hrang; a thawm na thei, asinain khuitawk ihsin a ra ih khuilamah a feh ding ti na thei lo. Thlarau ih hrinmi khal cu cubangtuk in an si,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Nikodemas cun, “Ziangtin so cumi cu a si thei ding?” tiah a sut."},"10":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nang cu Israel mi lakah zirhtu saya pakhat na si ih himi hman na thei thei lo maw?"},"11":{"text":"Thungaite in ka lo sim: kannih cu kan theihmi kan sim ih kan hmuhmi kha kan than; asinain zokhal in kan thu simmi nan pom duh lo."},"12":{"text":"Hi leitlun thuhla ka lo sim ih i zum lo; cuti asile ziangtinso vancung thuhla ka lo sim tikah na zum thei ding?"},"13":{"text":"Vancung ihsin a rung ṭummi Milai Fapa siarlo zohman vancungah a kaitu an um lo,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"“Moses in nelrawn ah fung parih dar rul a thlai bangtuk in Milai Fapa khal thlai a si ve ding;"},"15":{"text":"cuti cun amah a zumtu hmuahhmuah cu kumkhua nunnak an ngah ding."},"16":{"text":"Pathian in leilung hi a duhdawt zet ruangah a Fapa neihsun a pek ih amah a zumtu hmuahhmuah cu thi loin kumkhua nunnak an co ding."},"17":{"text":"Ziangahtile leilung tlunah Pathian in a Fapa a run thlah tikah leilung thuṭhentu dingah a thlah lo, leilung runtu dingah a thlah a si."},"18":{"text":"Zokhal Fapa a zumtu cu thuṭhennak a tong lo ding; sikhalsehla a zum lotu cu Pathian ih Fapa neihsun a zum lo ruangah thuṭhennak a tong zo."},"19":{"text":"Thuṭhennak timi cu hiti in a si: leilung tlunah hin tleunak a ra thleng, asinain mi in tleunak hnakin thimnak an duh sawn; ziangahtile an tuahnak a ṭhat lo ruangah a si."},"20":{"text":"Zokhal thil ṭha lo a tuahtu cun tleunak a hua ih tleunak sung khal ah a ra lo ding, ziangahtile a thil ṭha lo tuahmi kha a lang pang ding ti a phang."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a dikmi a tuahtu cu tleunak sungah a ra ih a tuahmi cu Pathian duhmi thlunin a tuah a si ti kha cuih tleunak cun a langter,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh cu a dungthluntu pawl thawn Judea peng ah an feh ih an hnenah malte sung a um ih baptisma tla a pek.","title":"Jesuh Le Johan"},"23":{"text":"Johan khal Aenon timi, Salim ihsin a hlat lonak hmun ah, baptisma a pek ve, ziangahtile cutawkah cun tidai tampi a um. Mi tampi a hnenah an ra ih baptisma a pek hai."},"24":{"text":"Himi cu Johan thawng an thlak hlanih a cangmi thil a si."},"25":{"text":"Johan dungthluntu ṭhenkhat pawl le Judah mipa pakhat cu thianfaiter awknak thu ah thu an el aw."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah Johan hnenah an feh ih, “Sayapa, Jordan tiva ihsin nisuah lamih nangmah thawn a rak um dah pa kha na ciing lai a si lo maw? A thu na rel ṭheu mi kha! Atu-ah baptisma a pek rero ve ih mi tampi a hnenah an feh a si,” tiah an ti."},"27":{"text":"Johan in, “Pathian pekmi ti lo cun zohman in zianghman comi an nei thei lo ding."},"28":{"text":"Keimah rori in, ‘Kei cu Messiah ka si lo; a hlanih a rak thleng sungmi ka si,’ tiah ka simmi theitu cu nanmah nan si."},"29":{"text":"Ṭhitmi mothar cu a ṭhitu tlangval pa ih ta a si; asinain nupi ṭhitu tlangval pa ih rualpi, a ding ih aw thawm a ngaitu pa cu, tlangval pa ih aw a theih tikah cun a lung a awi ngaingai. Cuih lungawinak cu ka ta a si ih ka lungawinak cu a famkim a si."},"30":{"text":"Amah cu a ṭhangso ding ih kei cu ka ṭumsuk ding,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Tlunlam ihsin a rungmi cu mi hmuahhmuah hnakin a tum sawn. Leilung ih a ummi cu leilung ta a si ih leilung tlun thuhla a sim; asinain vancung ihsin a rami cu ziang hmuahhmuah tlunah a um.","title":"Vancung Ihsin A Rungṭummi Pa"},"32":{"text":"Amah cun a hmuhmi le a theihmi thuhla pawl a sim naón zohman in a thu cu an pom lo."},"33":{"text":"Sikhalsehla zokhal a thu simmi a pomtu cu cutiih a pomnak in Pathian cu a dik a si, ti kha a hngetter."},"34":{"text":"Pathian ih a thlahmi cun Pathian ih thu a phuang, ziangahtile Pathian in a Thlarau famkim in a hnenah a pek."},"35":{"text":"A pa in a Fapa cu a duhdawt ih ziang hmuahhmuah a kut sungah a pek."},"36":{"text":"Fapa a zumtu cun kumkhua nunnak a nei; Fapa-ih thu a eltu cun nunnak a nei lo ding ih Pathian ih thinhengnak a tuar ding."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu Johan hnakin dungthluntu tam deuh a nei ih baptisma tla tam deuh a pek, tiah Farasi mi pawl in an thei.","title":"Jesuh Le Samaria Nunau"},"2":{"text":"A ngaingai ahcun Jesuh amah cun zohman baptisma a pek lo; a dungthluntu lawng in an pek."},"3":{"text":"Cutiih an rel ruri mi cu Jesuh in a theih tikah Judah ram ihsin a suak ih Galilee ah a kir sal."},"4":{"text":"A kir phahah Samaria ram a pal phah."},"5":{"text":"Samaria ramih a feh laiah Saikhar an timi khua pakhat a thleng. Cuih Saikhar khua cu Jakob in a fapa Josef hnenih a pekmi loram ihsin a hlat lo."},"6":{"text":"Cutawkah cun Jakob tikhur a um. Jesuh cu a khual tlawnnak ah a bang zet ih cuih tikhur kiangah cun a to. A tikcu cu sun hrawng a si."},"7":{"text":"Samaria nunau nu pakhat cu tidai khai dingah a ra ih Jesuh in a hnenah, “Tidai in ding i pe aw,” tiah a dil."},"8":{"text":"A dungthluntu pawl cu rawl lei dingah khawsung ah an feh."},"9":{"text":"Cuih nunau nu cun, “Nang cu Judah mi na si ih kei cu Samaria mi ka si; ziangtinso tidai in ding i dil?” tiah a ti. Judah mi pawl cun Samaria mi pawl ih hmanmi khokheng pawl an hmang duh lo."},"10":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Pathian ih a lo pekmi laksawng hi ziang a si, ti le tidai a lo diltu hi zo a si, ti thei cila amah sawn na dil ding ih anih in nunnak tidai a lo pe ding naón!” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cuih nunau nu in, “Bawipa, balṭin na nei lo ih tikhur hi a thuk zet fawn. Khuitawk in so cuih nunnak tidai cu na lak ding?"},"12":{"text":"Kan pu Jakob in hi tikhur hi in pek; amah le a fapa pawl siseh, a tuu rual le a caw rual pawl siseh, hi tikhur ihsin tidai an ngah. Jakob hnakin ka tum sawn tiah na ruat aw maw si?” tiah a sut."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Zokhal siseh hi tidai a intu cu a ti a haal sal ding."},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka pek dingmi tidai a intu cu a ti a haal nawn lo ding. Ka pek dingmi tidai cu amah sungah cirhti ah a cang ding ih cumi cun nunnak tidai le kumkhua nunnak a pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Nunau nu in, “Bawipa, cuih tidai cu i pe aw! Cuticun ka ti a haal nawn lo ding ih hitawk ah tidai khai ding khalah ka rat a ṭul nawn lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Na pasal va ko awla ra sal aw,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Anih in, “Pasal ka nei lo,” tiah a let. Jesuh in, “Pasal ka nei lo na ti cu thudik na sim a si."},"18":{"text":"Pasal panga na nei zo ih atu na umpi mi pa hi na pasal ngaingai a si lo. Thudik i sim a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Nunau nu in, “Bawipa, profet na si ti ka lo thei."},"20":{"text":"Kannih Samaria mi kan pupa pawl cun hi tlang parah hin Pathian an rak biak; sikhalsehla nannih Judah mi cun Pathian cu Jerusalem ah biak ding a si, nan ti,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh cun a hnenah, “Nunau nu, ka lo simmi hi zum aw: Mi in Pathian cu hi tlang ah siseh, Jerusalem khal ah siseh, an biak lo can a ra thleng ding."},"22":{"text":"Nannih Samaria mi cun nan biakmi nan thei ngaingai lo; asinain kannih Judah mi cun kan biakmi kan thei, ziangahtile rundamnak cu Judah mi hnen ihsin a ra."},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian Thlarau hruainak thawngin Pathian a bia taktaktu in Pa cu thlarau le thutak thawn an biak caan a ra thleng ding; a si, cuih caan cu atu-ah a ra thleng zo. Cutiih biak cu Pathian in a duhmi a si."},"24":{"text":"Pathian cu Thlarau a si ih a biatu pawl in thlarau le thutak in an bia ding,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Nunau nu in a hnenah, “Messiah cu a ra ding ih a rat tikah cun ziang hmuahhmuah amah in in sim leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Na hnenih a ṭong rerotu hi amah cu ka si,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Culai fangah Jesuh dungthluntu pawl cu an ra kir ih nunau nu thawn an biak awk rero kha an hmuh tikah an mang a bang ngaingai. Sikhalsehla zohman in cu nu cu, “Ziang so na duh?” tiah an sut lo. Jesuh khal cu, “Ziangah so hi nu cu na biak?” tiah an sut ve lo."},"28":{"text":"Cule nunau nu cu a tithawl a tanta ih khawsungih a vung feh hnuah mi senpi hnenah,"},"29":{"text":"“Hlanih thil ka tuah ciami hmuahhmuah i sim theitu pa hi ra zohhnik uh! Amah hi Messiah cu a si pei maw?” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cuticun khawsung in an suak ih Jesuh hnenah cun an feh."},"31":{"text":"Culai ah dungthluntu pawl in Jesuh cu, “Sayapa, rawl ei aw,” tiah an fial."},"32":{"text":"Anih in, “Nan theih lomi rawl ei ding ka nei,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cule a dungthluntu pawl cun, “Pakhatkhat in rawl an rak pek a si pei maw?” tiah pakhat le pakhat an sut aw."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Kei ka rawl cu i thlahtu-ih duhnak tuah le hnaṭuan i fialmi ṭuan ṭheh hi a si."},"35":{"text":"Ṭongṭhimnak ah ‘Thla li hnuah rawl khawm caan,’ tiah nan ti. Sikhalsehla thungai in ka lo sim: lo sung khi hei zohhnik uh! Lorawl an thar zo ih rawl lak caan a cu zo a si."},"36":{"text":"Rawl a latu pa cu a hlawhman kha pek a si ih rawl cu kumkhua a nunnak hrangah a khawm. Cuticun thlaici a tuhtu le rawl a latu cu hmun khatah an lung a awi tlang ding."},"37":{"text":"Ziangahtile ṭongṭhimnak ih ‘Mi pakhat in a tuh; a dang pakhat in a at,’ timi cu a dikzet a si."},"38":{"text":"Nan rak ṭuan dah lonak lo sungah fang at dingin ka lo thlah hai. Cutawkah midang ih an rak ṭuan cianak ihsin midang hnaṭuan ruangah a miat nan ngah a si,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Nunau nu in, “Ka rak tuah ciami hmuahhmuah i sim sal ṭheh,” tiah a ti hrangah cuih khawsungih a ummi Samaria mi tampi in Jesuh cu an zum."},"40":{"text":"A hnenah Samaria mi pawl an ra ih, “Kan hnenah cam hrih aw,” tiah an ra sawm ih ni hnih a cam."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh thusimmi an thei ih mi tam sinsin in an zum."},"42":{"text":"Cule nunau nu hnenah cun, “Atu cu nangmah ih thusimmi ruangah si loin kanmah rori in a thu simmi kan thei ih kan zum; amah hi leilung Runtu a si taktak ti khal kan thei,” tiah an ti."},"43":{"text":"Cutawkah ni hnih a cam hnuah Jesuh cu a suak ih Galilee ah a feh.","title":"Jesuh In Bawi Pakhat Ih Fapa A Damter"},"44":{"text":"Ziangahtile amah rori in, “Profet cu amah ih ramah cun upatnak a ngah lo,” tiah a rak ti."},"45":{"text":"Galilee-ih a thlen tikah cutawkih mipi pawl in an rak hmuak, ziangahtile Jerusalem khua Lantak Puai ah a feh ih cuih puai sungih a thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah an rak hmuh zo ruangah a si."},"46":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu tidai kha sabitti ih a rak canternak Galilee peng Kana khua ah a feh sal. Cutawkah acozah bawi pakhat a rak um ih a fapa pakhat Kapernaum khua ah a na."},"47":{"text":"Jesuh cu Judea ihsin Galilee a ra thleng ti a theih tikah a hnenah cun a va feh ih, Kapernaum khua ah va feh in a thizikmi a fapa damter dingah zaangfah a dil."},"48":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hmuhsaknak le khawruahhar thil tla nan hmuh dah ti lo ahcun zohman in nannih pawl cun nan zum lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Cuih acozah bawipa cun, “Bawipa, ka fapa a thih hlanah ra hram aw,” tiah a dil."},"50":{"text":"Jesuh in a hnenah cun, “Va tlung aw, na fapa cu a nung ding,” tiah a ti. Cupa in Jesuh ih ṭong cu a zum ih a tlung."},"51":{"text":"A tlunnak lamzin ihsin a hnen-um pawl in an rak hmuak ih, “Na fapa cu a nung ding,” tiah an ti."},"52":{"text":"Anih in, “Ziangtik caanah so ka fapa cu a dam deuh?” tiah a sut tikah annih in, “Mizan sun zanlam nazi pakhat ah a khurhnat a reh,” tiah an ti."},"53":{"text":"Cuih caan cu Jesuh in ‘Na fapa a nung ding,’ tiih a rak ti caante kha a si, tiah a pa cun a hun thei sal. Cuticun amah le a innsang zatein an zum."},"54":{"text":"Himi hi Jesuh cu Judea ihsin Galilee-ih a rat hnuah a voihnihnak mangbangza a tuahmi a si."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh cu Jerusalem ah Judah biaknak puai pakhat a um ih a feh.","title":"Tili Kap Ih Mina Damternak"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ahcun Tuu Kotka an timi kiangah tili pakhat a um ih a kapah deu suanmi panga a um. Cuih tili cu Hebru ṭong in Bethzatha tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cuih deusuan sungah cun mina tampi an it teptep. Ṭhenkhat cu mitcaw, ṭhenkhat cu ke-awl le ṭhenkhat cu a zengmi tla an si."},"4":{"text":"(A caancaan ah Bawipa ih vancungmi a rung ṭum ih tidai kha a cangter ṭheu. Cutiih tidai a cang vete in tili sungih a dawp hmaisa bik kha an natnak ihsin an dam ṭheu. Curuangah mina pawl cun tidai caang ding kha an hngak.)"},"5":{"text":"Cutawkah mipa pakhat kum sawm thum le kum riat sung a nami a um."},"6":{"text":"Cutawkih a ih ringring kha Jesuh in a hmu ih kum reipi a na zo ti tla a thei. Curuangah Jesuh in, “Dam na duh maw?” tiah a sut."},"7":{"text":"Cupa in, “Bawipa, tidai a caang tikah tili sungih i hnimtu ding zohman an um lo. Tili sungah ka vung ṭum ding ka ti laifangah midang in in rak khelh ringring ṭheu,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Tho awla na ihphah la in feh aw,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Hmakhatteah cupa cu a dam; a ihphah cu a lak ih a feh. Cuih ni cu Sabbath ni a si."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah Judah mi hotu pawl in damnak a ngahtu pa cu, “Tuih sun hi Sabbath ni a si ih na ihphah na fehpi hi kan Daan in a duh lo a si,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Anih in, “Keimah i damtertu pa in na ihphah la awla feh aw, i ti si!” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Annih in, “Cutiih a lo titu cu zo so a si?” tiah an sut."},"13":{"text":"Asinain damnak a ngahtu pa cun Jesuh cu zo a si ti a thei lo, ziangahtile cutawkah miburpi an um ih an lakin Jesuh cu a rak feh zo."},"14":{"text":"Neh hnuah cupa cu Jesuh in Biakinn sungah a tong ih, “Zohhnik! Atu cu na dam zo; curuangah va sual nawn hlah. Culole na parah thil ṭha lo sinsin a thleng ding,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cule cupa cu a feh ih Judah mi hotu pawl hnenah, “I damtertu cu Jesuh a si,” tiah a va sim."},"16":{"text":"Sabbath ni ih mi a damter ruangah cun Jesuh cu an ralsan ih harsatnak an pek."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Ka pa cu hna a ṭuan ringring ih kei khal hna ka ṭuan ve a ṭul a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutiih a ti ruangah Judah mi hotu pawl cu an thin-ai a thok ih amah kha thah an tum sinsin; Sabbath a buar lawng si loin Pathian cu ka Pa a si, a ti ruangah Pathian tlukah a tuah aw tiah an ruat."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh in an hnenah, “Thungai in ka lo sim: Fapa cun amah tein zianghman a tuah thei lo. A Pa ih tuahmi a hmuhmi lawng kha a tuah a si. Pa in a tuahmi kha Fapa khal in a tuah ve.","title":"Fapa Ih Thuneihnak"},"20":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pa in a Fapa kha a duhdawt ih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah kha a hmuh ṭheh. Himi hnakin tuah ding a nasa sawn mi kha a hmuh hrih ding ih nan mang a bang ding."},"21":{"text":"Pa in mithi a thawhter ih nunnak a pek vekin Fapa khal in a duhmi poh hnenah nunnak a pe ve a si."},"22":{"text":"Pa in zo ih par hmanah thuṭhennak a tuah lo. Fapa hnenah thuṭhen theinak a pe zo."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah Pa a upattu hmuahhmuah in Fapa khal an upat ve pei. Zokhal Fapa a upat lotu cun a thlahtu a Pa khal a upat ve lo a si."},"24":{"text":"Thungaite in ka lo sim: zokhal ka simmi a thei ih i thlahtu a zum ahcun kumkhua nunnak a nei.
