Nangmah in i thlah hi leilung in an zum theinak dingah annih cu pakhat ah cang hram hai seh."},"22":{"text":"Nangmah le keimah cu pakhat kan si vekin annih khal pakhat ih an can theinak dingah nangmah ih i pekmi sunlawinak kha anmah khal ka pek ve a si."},"23":{"text":"Annih pawl cu pakhat taktak an si ih cuticun leilung in nangmah ih thlahmi ka si ti a theihnak dingah le keimah i duhdawt vekin annih khal na duhdawt ti an theihnak dingah kei cu anmah ih sungah ka um ih nang cu ka sungah na um a si."},"24":{"text":"“Ka Pa, nangmah ih i pekmi ka sunlawinak hi annih in an hmuh theinak dingah nangmah in annih cu ka kut sungah i pe zo. Anmah cu keimah ka umnak poh-ah um ve hai seh ti ka duh; ziangahtile leilung seemsuah hlan ihsin i duhdawt zo."},"25":{"text":"A dingmi ka Pa, nang cu leilung hin a lo thei lo, sikhalsehla kei cun ka lo thei ih annih in nangmah ih i thlah hi an thei."},"26":{"text":"An hnenah na hmin cu ka phuang zo ih, ka parih duhdawtnak na neihmi hi an sungih a um venak dingah le keimah khal an sungih ka um venak dingah na hmin cu ka phuang vivo hrih ko ding,” tiah thla a cam."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hitiin Jesuh in thla a cam ṭheh hnuah dungthluntu pawl thawn an pok ih Kidron an timi tivate ral ah an feh. Cutawkah hmuan pakhat a um ih Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl cu cuih hmuan sungah an lut.","title":"Jesuh An Kaihnak (Mat 26.47-56 ; Mar 14.43-50 ; Luk 22.47-53)"},"2":{"text":"Cuih hmuan cu Jesuh le a dungthluntu pawl an ton awk ṭheunak a si ruangah a zuartu Judas in khuitawkah a um ti a thei."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah cuih hmuan ahcun Judas cu Rom ralkap bur khat, puithiam upa le Farasi pawl ih thlahmi Biakinn kiltu palik pawl thawn, hriamnam an keng ih mei-inn le meifar thawn an feh."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh in a parah ziangbangtuk thil a ra thleng ding ti kha a theih ṭheh ruangah hmaiah a va suak ih, “Zoso nan hawl?” tiah a rak sut."},"5":{"text":"Annih in, “Nazareth mi Jesuh,” an ti. Jesuh in, “Keimah hi amah cu ka si,” a ti. A zuartu Judas cu an kiangah cun a ding."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Keimah hi amah cu ka si,” a timi an theih tikah dunglamah ah siip ih leilungah an tlu."},"7":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Zoso nan hawl?” tiah a sut lala. Annih in, “Nazareth mi Jesuh,” tiah an ti thotho."},"8":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Keimah hi amah cu ka si, tiah ka lo sim zo. Keimah in hawl a si ahcun midang hi cu fehter uh,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Hitiih a tinak cu, “Ka Pa, ka kut sungih i pekmi cu pakhat hman ka hlohtermi an um lo,” a timi kha kimternak dingah a si."},"10":{"text":"Simon Piter in ralnam a kenmi cu a vun zuk ih Puithiam Saang salpa ih vorhlam hna a sat thlak. Cuih salpa ih hmin cu Malkhas a si."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in Piter hnenah, “Na ralnam cu a kawm ah thun sal aw! Ka Pa ih i pekmi tuarnak hai hi ka in lo dingah maw si na ruat?” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Rom ralkap cun an hotu ralbawi le Judah mi palik pawl thawn Jesuh cu an kai; an ṭem hnuah,","title":"Annas Hmaiah Jesuh An Fehpi"},"13":{"text":"hmaisabik ah Annas hnenah an fehpi. Annas cu cuih kumih Puithiam Saang a ṭuantu Kaiafas nupi ih pa a si."},"14":{"text":"Kaiafas cu mizapi ai-ah mi pakhat thih a ṭha sawn tiih Judah hotu pawl hnenih ruahnak petu kha a si."},"15":{"text":"Simon Piter le a dang dungthluntu pakhat in Jesuh kha an thlun. Cuih dungthluntu cu Puithiam Saang thawn a thei aw zetmi an si ih Jesuh cu a thlun ih Puithiam Saang ih tual ah a vung feh.","title":"Piter In Jesuh A Phatsan (Mat 26.69-70 ; Mar 14.66-68 ; Luk 22.55-59)"},"16":{"text":"Asinain Piter cu kotka lengah a rak um. Cule cuih dungthluntu cu a kir ih kotka kiltu nu cu a va biak hnuah Piter a run luhpi."},"17":{"text":"Kotka kiltu nu in, “Khi pa a thluntu lakah na tel ve a si lo maw?” tiah Piter kha a ti. Piter in, “Ka si lo,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Khua a sih ruangah hnen-um pawl le kiltu palik pawl in meihol in meipual an sep ih dinhmunin meisa an ai. Piter khal cu a va feh ve ih an hnenah dingin meisa a ai ve."},"19":{"text":"Puithiam Saang in Jesuh cu a dungthluntu pawl ih thu le a thuzirhmi thu pawl a sut ciamco.","title":"Puithiam Saang In Jesuh Thu A Sut (Mat 26.59-66 ; Mar 14.55-64 ; Luk 22.66-71)"},"20":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Langhnganin mizapi hnenah thu ka sim ringring. Mi tampi an ra khawmnak sinakok ah le Biakinnpi ah thu ka zirh ringring. A thup in ziang thu hman ka sim dah lo."},"21":{"text":"Cuti asinain ziangah so thu i sut? Ka thusimmi i theitu pawl kha sut sawn aw. Ka simmi an thei ṭheh ko,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutiih a ti tikah cutawkih a ummi palik pakhat in Jesuh kha a beng ih, “Puithiam Saang hnenah ziangtinso cutiin na ṭong ngam?” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ka ṭongsual mi a um ahcun cuih ka ṭong sualmi cu hitawk ih a ummi hmuahhmuah hnenah hin simhnik! Asinain ka ṭongmi hi a dikmi a si ahcun ziangah so i beng?” tiah a sawn."},"24":{"text":"Cutiin Annas in a ṭemnak phoih sak cuang loin Jesuh cu Puithiam Saang Kaiafas hnenah a kuat."},"25":{"text":"Piter cu cutawkah meisa ai-in a ding lai. Culai ah midang pawl in, “Nang khal hi a dungthluntu lakah pakhat na si ve a si lo maw?” tiah an ti. Piter in, “Ka si lo,” a ti.","title":"Piter In Jesuh A Phatsan Lala (Mat 26.71-75 ; Mar 14.69-72 ; Luk 22.58-62)"},"26":{"text":"Puithiam Saang hnen-um lakih pakhat, Piter in a hna a sahtan mi pa ih sungkhat pa in, “Hi Jesuh thawn hmuan sungah ka lo hmu a si lo maw?” tiah a sut."},"27":{"text":"Asinain Piter cun, “Kei ka si lo,” a ti thotho. Cutikah ar a khuang."},"28":{"text":"Zingpit ah Jesuh cu Kaiafas inn ihsin Mangki bawi innah an hruai. Judah mi hotu pawl cu an daan vekin thianghlimte ih Lantak Puai rawl ei an duh ruangah Mangki bawi inn sungah cun an lut lo.","title":"Pilat Hmaiah Jesuh An Hruai (Mat 27.1-2 , 11-14 ; Mar 15.1-5 ; Luk 23.1-5)"},"29":{"text":"Curuangah Pilat cu a va suak ih an hnenah, “Hi pa hi ziang sualnak so a neih?” tiah a sut."},"30":{"text":"Annih in, “Sualnak nei lo sisehla na hnenah hin kan rak hruai lo ding,” tiah an sawn."},"31":{"text":"Pilat in an hnenah, “Cuti asile nanmah in hruai uhla nanmah ih daan vekin a thu cu va rel uh,” tiah a ti. Annih in, “Kannih cun mithah theinak thu kan nei lo,” tiah an ti."},"32":{"text":"Jesuh in ziangbangtuk thihnak so ka tuar ding ti ih a rak sim ciami ṭongkam kimnak dingah hi vekih a cannak cu a si."},"33":{"text":"Pilat cu a inn sungah a lut sal ih Jesuh cu a ko. “Judah Siangpahrang na si maw?” tiah a sut."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Hi thu i suhmi hi nangmah ih palung a si maw, midang in ka thu an lo sim ruangah so a si?” tiah a sut."},"35":{"text":"Pilat in, “Judah mi ah maw si i ruat? Ka hnen a lo thlentu hi na miphun le puithiam upa pawl sokhaw an si! Na tuahmi thil cu ziangso a si?” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Kei ka uknak ram cu hi leilung tlunah a si lo; hi leilung tlunah sisehla Judah mi hotu pawl kut sungih thleng lo dingin ka dungthluntu pawl in an do ding. Ka uknak ram cu hi leilungah a si lo,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cutikah Pilat in, “Siangpahrang cu na si ngai maw?” tiah a sut. Jesuh in, “Nang cun Siangpahrang na si i ti. Leilung ih ka suahsanmi le ka ratsanmi cu thu pakhat lawng a si: cumi cu thutak sim ding hi a si. Thutak sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah cun ka thu simmi an ngai a si,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cutikah Pilat in, “Thutak cu ziang so a si?” tiah a sut. Cun Pilat cu misenpi hnenah a va suak sal ih an hnenah cun, “A parah mawhnak thu ka hmu lo."},"39":{"text":"Curuangah daan nan neihmi vekin Lantak Puai ah thawngtla pakhatkhat ka lo thlah sak ṭheu. Judah siangpahrang hi lo thlah sak ningla nan duh maw?” tiah a sut."},"40":{"text":"Annih in, “Anih thlah kan duh lo! Barabbas thlah kan duh!” tiah an au ciamco. Barabbas cu suamhmang a rak si.","title":"Jesuh That Dingin A Relcat (Mat 27.15-31 ; Mar 15.6-20 ; Luk 23.13-25)"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Pilat in Jesuh cu a hruai ih ralkap pawl a vuakter."},"2":{"text":"Ralkap pawl in hling a neimi thinghnge in lukhuh an phiar ih an khumter. Cule puan sen an sinter."},"3":{"text":"A hnenah an feh ih, “Judah Siangpahrang hi a nunkhua sau hram seh,” tiah an ti ih an beng."},"4":{"text":"Pilat cu a va suak sal ih mipi hnenah, “Ngaihnik uh! A parah thah tlak sualnak ka hmu lo, ti langternak ah nan hnenah ka rak hruai ding,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cuti cun hling lukhuh khumin le puan sen sinin Jesuh cu a ra suak. Pilat in an hnenah, “Zoh uh! Mi pa cu hi pa hi a si!” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl le Biakinn kiltu palik pawl in an hmuh tikah, “Thinglamtah ah that aw! Thinglamtah ah that aw,” tiah an auh. Pilat in an hnenah, “Nanmahte in hruai uhla thinglamtah ah va that uh! Kei cun a parah sualnak ka hmu lo,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule Judah mi pawl cun, “Daan kan nei ih cuih daan vek cun a thih a ṭul a si, ziangahtile Pathian Fapa ka si a ti,” tiah an let."},"8":{"text":"Cumi cu Pilat in a theih tikah a thin a phang deuhdeuh."},"9":{"text":"A inn sungah a vung lut sal ih Jesuh cu, “Khuiinso na rat?” tiah a sut. Asinain Jesuh cun a sawn lo."},"10":{"text":"Pilat in, “I sawn lo ding maw si? Nangmah thlah theinak le thah theinak thu ka neih hi na thei maw?” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ka tlunih thu na neih theinak hi Pathian ih a lo pek ruangah a si. Curuangah nang hnakin na kutih i thlengtertu pa hi a sual sawn a si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cumi cu Pilat in a theih tikah Jesuh thlah theinak lamzin kha a hawl. Asinain mipi cun, “Hi pa na thlah asile Rom Siangpahrang ih rualpi na si lo. Zokhal Siangpahrang ka si a ti awtu cu Rom Siangpahrang ih ral an si,” tiah an au ciamco."},"13":{"text":"Cuih ṭong cu Pilat in a theih tikah Jesuh cu lengah a hei suahpi ih, “Lungphah Tual,” timi hmunih thuṭhentu tonak ah a to. Cuih hmun cu Hebru ṭong in “Gabbatha,” an ti."},"14":{"text":"Lantak Puai ding ni khat a duh ni a si ih sunlai hrawng a si. Pilat in mipi pawl cu, “Nan Siangpahrang hi zohhnik uh!” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Annih in, “That aw! That aw! Thinglamtah parah that aw!” tiah an au ciamco. Pilat in, “Nan Siangpahrang hi maw thinglamtah parah ka thah ding?” tiah a sut. Puithiam upa pawl in, “Sizar siarlo Siangpahrang dang kan nei lo,” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule Pilat in Jesuh cu thah dingah an kut sungah a pek. Cutiin Jesuh cu an fehpi."},"17":{"text":"A thinglamtah pu in a suak ih “Luruh Hmun,” an timi hmunah a thleng. Cuih hmun cu Hebru ṭong in “Golgotha,” an ti.","title":"Thinglamtah Ah Jesuh An Khen (Mat 27.32-44 ; Mar 15.21-32 ; Luk 23.26-43)"},"18":{"text":"Cutawkah Jesuh cu thinglamtah ah an khen. A dang mipa pahnih tla an khen ve ih an karlak ah Jesuh cu an thlai."},"19":{"text":"Pilat in ca a ngan ih thinglamtah parah a taarter. Cuih ca a nganmi cu, “Nazareth mi Jesuh, Judah Siangpahrang,” ti a si."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh an thlainak hmun cu khawpi ihsin a hlat lo ruangah cuih ca cu mi tampi in an siar. Hebru ṭong, Latin ṭong le Grik ṭong in nganmi a si."},"21":{"text":"Puithiam upa pawl in Pilat cu, “‘Judah Siangpahrang,’ ti si loin ‘Judah Siangpahrang ka si, a ti,’ tiah ngan aw,” an ti."},"22":{"text":"Pilat in, “Ka ngan zomi cu ka ngan vekin um seh,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Ralkap pawl in Jesuh cu thinglamtah parih an khen ṭheh hnuah a hnipuan cu an lak ih pakhat ciar co dingah ṭhen li ah an ṭhen. Cule zungṭhit nei lo ih tahmi a korfual khal cu an lak."},"24":{"text":"Ralkap pawl cun, “Hi korfual cu kan thlek lo pei. Zo in a co ding ti theihnak ah camcawhfung kan zuk sawn pei,” tiah an ti. Hitiih thil a cannak cu Ca Thianghlim sungih, “Ka hnipuan cu an ṭhen aw ih, Ka kor hrangah camcawhfung an zuk,” timi a kimnak dingah a si. Cubangtuk cekci cun ralkap pawl in an tuah.","ref":"Saam 22.18"},"25":{"text":"Jesuh ih thinglamtah kiangah cun a nu le a nu ih naunu le Klopas nupi Mari le Mari Magdalene pawl an ding."},"26":{"text":"Jesuh in a nu le a duhdawtmi dungthluntu pa cutawkih an din kha a hmu ih a nu hnenah cun, “Amah kha na fapa a si,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule a dungthluntu pa hnenah cun, “Anih kha na nu a si,” tiah a vun ti. Cuihsin thokin dungthluntu pa in Jesuh ih nu cu a innah a umter."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh in ziang hmuahhmuah a kim ṭheh zo ti kha a thei; Ca Thianghlim sungih a ummi kimnak dingah, “Ka ti a haal,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh A Thi (Mat 27.45-56 ; Mar 15.33-41 ; Luk 23.44-49)","ref":"Saam 69.21; 22.15"},"29":{"text":"Cutawkah sabitti thur beel khat a um ih cuih sabitti thur sungah puansia an hnim ih hissop fung zimah ṭemcih tahratin Jesuh cu a kaa-ah an hun hnih."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh in cuih sabitti thur cu a tep ih, “A kim ṭheh zo,” a ti. Cule a lu a kuun ih a thaw a cem."},"31":{"text":"Cule Judah mi hotu pawl cu Pilat hnenah an feh ih thinglamtah parih an thahmi pawl ih ke khiak dingah le an ruak pawl la dingah an va dil. An dil ni cu Tlawngkai Ninga a si, ziang ruangah an dil tile an thahmi ruak pawl cu Sabbath ni-ah thinglamtah parih an thlai awk hrih ding kha an duh lo; cuih Sabbath cu a thianghlim cemi ni a si fawn.","title":"Jesuh Ih Hnak An Sun"},"32":{"text":"Curuangah ralkap pawl an va feh ih Jesuh thawn hmunkhatih an thahmi pakhat pa ih ke an khiak ih cuih hnuah a pahnihnak pa ih ke khal an khiak."},"33":{"text":"Asinain Jesuh hnen an thlen tikah a thi ngah zo ti kha an hmu ih anih cu a ke an khiak lo."},"34":{"text":"Ralkap pakhat in Jesuh ih hnak kha a feipi in a hun sun ih hmakhatte ah thi le tidai a suak."},"35":{"text":"Cuih thil a hmutu pa amah rori in a ṭongmi a si ih nan zum theinak dingah a si. A simmi hi a dikmi a si ih amah khal in thudik ka sim a si ti hi a thei."},"36":{"text":"Hitiih thil a cannak cu Ca Thianghlim sungah, “A ruh pakhatte hman an khiak lo ding,” tiih a ummi kha a kimnak dingah a si.","ref":"Suah 12.46; Mipum 9.12; Saam 34.20"},"37":{"text":"Cule Ca Thianghlim hmun dangah, “An sunmi kha an zoh ding,” ti tla in a um.","ref":"Zek 12.10; Thup 1.7"},"38":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Arimathea khuami Josef in Jesuh ruak lak dingah Pilat hnenah a va dil. Josef cu Jesuh dungthluntu pakhat asinain Judah hotu pawl kha a ṭih ruangah a thupte in a rak thlun vivo. Pilat in Jesuh ruak kha na la thei, a ti ruangah Josef cun a va lak.","title":"Jesuh An Phum (Mat 27.57-61 ; Mar 15.42-47 ; Luk 23.50-56)"},"39":{"text":"Jesuh tong dingah zanih a rak feh dahtu Nikodemas khal Josef hnenah a feh ve ih zihmui pawng zakhat tluk, mura zihmui le cing thling rawimi kha a keng."},"40":{"text":"An pahnih in Jesuh ruak kha an lak ih Judah pawl ih mithi phum daan vekin zihmui thawn puanrang nemtein an tuam."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh an thahnak hmunah cun hmuan pakhat a um ih cuih hmuan sungah cun zohman an phum dah hrih lonak thlaan thar pakhat a um."},"42":{"text":"Sabbath ni a si zik thlang ih cuih thlaan cu a naite fawn ruangah Jesuh ih ruak cu cutawkah an phum."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nipi Ni zingpit khua a van hlanah, Mari Magdalene cu thlaan ah a va feh ih thlaankhar lungpheng ṭhawn cia-in a um kha a hmu.","title":"A Lawngmi Thlaan (Mat 28.1-8 ; Mar 16.1-8 ; Luk 24.1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Simon Piter le Jesuh ih a duhdawtmi dungthluntu hnenah a va tlan ih, “Thlaan ihsin Bawipa an thiar hlo zo; khuitawkih an ret ti kan thei lo!” tiah a sim."},"3":{"text":"Cun Piter le a dang dungthluntu cu an pok ih thlaan ah an va feh."},"4":{"text":"An pahnih in an tlan ih a dang dungthluntu cu Piter hnakin tlan a cak deuh ruangah hmaisa deuh ah thlaan ah a thleng."},"5":{"text":"Thlaan sung cu a vun bih ih ruak tuamnak puan nemte cu a hmu, asinain a vung lut lo."},"6":{"text":"A dungin Simon Piter cu a ra thleng ih thlaan sung ahcun a vung lut mai. Ruak tuamnak puan nemte le,"},"7":{"text":"Jesuh ih lu ṭemnak puan kha a hmu. Asinain a lu ṭemnak puan cu ruak tuamnak puan nemte umnak ah a um lo; amah dangte in zual aw in a um."},"8":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu dang, thlaan a thlengtu hmaisa deuhtu pa khal cu thlaan sungah cun a lut ve ih a hmu ih a zum."},"9":{"text":"Thihnak ihsin a thosal ding tiih Ca Thianghlim ih a timi kha a tican an thei thiam hrih lo."},"10":{"text":"Cule dungthluntu cu an inn ah an tlung."},"11":{"text":"Mari cu thlaan lengah a ding ih a ṭap rero. Cutiih ṭah phah in a kuun ih thlaan sung cu a vun bih ih,","title":"Mari Magdalene Hnenah Jesuh A Lang (Mat 28.9-10 ; Mar 16.9-11)"},"12":{"text":"vancungmi pahnih puanrang thawn thuam aw in Jesuh ruak an rak retnak ah khan a lu lamah pakhat, a ke lamah pakhat an to kha a hmu."},"13":{"text":"Vancungmi cun, “Ziangah so na ṭah rero?” tiah Mari cu an sut. Anih in, “Ka Bawipa zo in si maw an lak ih khuitawkah an ret ti ka thei lo,” tiah a sawn."},"14":{"text":"Cule Mari cu a her ih cutawkih Jesuh a din kha a hmu; asinain Jesuh a si kha a thei lo."},"15":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nunau nu, ziangah so na ṭah rero? Zoso na hawl?” tiah a sut. Cutiih a biatu cu hmuan kiltu a si tiin a ruat ih Mari cun, “Bawipa, nangmah in na lak a si ahcun na retnak kha i sim awla ka feh ding ih ka va la ding,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Mari!” tiah a vun ko. Mari cun Jesuh lam a hoi ih Hebru ṭong in “Rabboni!” tiah a ti. Rabboni ti cu Sayapa tican a si."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in Mari cu, “I kai hlah! Ziangahtile Pa hnenah ka thleng hrih lo. Asinain ka unau pawl hnenah va sim awla ‘An Pa a si vemi ka Pa, an Pathian a si vemi ka Pathian hnenah ka feh ding a ti,’ tiah va sim aw,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cuti cun Mari Magdalene cu a feh ih Bawipa a hmuhnak thu le a hnenih a ṭongmi pawl hmuahhmuah cu dungthluntu pawl hnenah a sim."},"19":{"text":"Cuih Nipi ni zanlam ah dungthluntu pawl cu hmunkhatah an tong aw. Judah mi hotu pawl an ṭih ruangah sangka hmuahhmuah an khar ṭheh. Cule Jesuh cu a ra lang ih anmah lakah a ding ih, “Nan hnenah daihnak um ko seh,” tiah a ti.","title":"Dungthluntu Hnenah Jesuh A Lang (Mat 28.16-20 ; Mar 16.14-18 ; Luk 24.36-49)"},"20":{"text":"Cumi a ṭong ṭheh in an hnenah a kut le a hnak a hmuh. Dungthluntu pawl cu an Bawipa an hmuh tikah an lung a awi ngaingai."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah cun, “Nan hnenah daihnak um ko seh! Ka Pa in i thlah vekin nannih khal ka lo thlah ve a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cutiih a ṭong hnuah an parah a thaw a thawt ih, “Thlarau Thianghlim rak co uh!"},"23":{"text":"Mi an sualnak nan ngaidam ahcun ngaidam an si ding; nan ngaidam lo a si ahcun ngaidam lo an si ding,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Dungthluntu hleihnih lakah pakhat a si mi (Faphir an timi) Thomas cu Jesuh a lang laiah an hnenah a um lo.","title":"Jesuh le Thomas"},"25":{"text":"Curuangah dungthluntu dang pawl in, “Bawipa kan hmu sokhaw!” tiah an sim. Thomas in an hnenah, “A kut thir in an khennak hma si ka hmuh ih ka kut in cuih hma si le a hnak kha ka tham ngah hlanah cun ka zum lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Zarhkhat hnuah dungthluntu pawl cu innkhaan sungah an um ih Thomas khal a um ve. sangka an khar ṭheh naón Jesuh cu a ra lang ih an lakah a ding in, “Nan hnenah daihnak um ko seh!” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cule Thomas hnenah cun, “Hinah na kutzung rak re hnik awla ka kut hi zohhnik aw; na kut rak dawh awla ka hnak hi tham aw. Zum loin um nawn hlah; zum thlang aw!” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Thomas in, “Ka Bawipa le ka Pathian!” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh in, “I hmuh ruangah na zum a si maw? Keimah i hmu lo naón a zumtu cu mi thlawsuak an si,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"A dungthluntu pawl ih mit hmuhah Jesuh in hmuhsaknak tampi a tuahmi, hi cabu sungih ngan lomi tampi a um.","title":"Hi Cabu Ngantu Ih Tumtahmi"},"31":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hi hmuah hi ka ngan ih ka ngannak sullam cu nannih in Jesuh cu Messiah, Pathian Fapa a si ti nan zum ih amah nan zumnak thawngin le amah ih hminin nunnak nan neihnak dingah a si."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Jesuh cu a dungthluntu pawl hnenah Tiberias Tili ah a lang sal. A lang daan cu hiti in a si.","title":"Galilee Ah A Dungthluntu Hnenah Jesuh A Lang"},"2":{"text":"Simon Piter, Faphir timi Thomas, Galilee peng Kana khuami Nathanael, Zebedi fapa pawl le Jesuh dungthluntu pahnih tla hmunkhat ah an tong khawm aw."},"3":{"text":"Simon Piter in, “Kei cu sur ka vorh ding,” tiah a ti. Midang khal cun, “Kan ra tel ve ding,” an ti fingfing. Cutiin lawng pakhat in an feh; asinain cuih zan cu zianghman an kai lo."},"4":{"text":"Ni a hung suah zawng ah Jesuh cu tikapte-ah a ding, asinain Jesuh a si ti kha dungthluntu pawl cun an thei lo."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Naule uh, ziangtal nan kai lo maw?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Zianghman kan kai lo,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Nan lawng ih vorhlam kamah khan nan sur hei vorh uhla malte tal cu nan kai ding,” a ti. Cuti cun an sur cu an hei vorh ngaingai ih tamzet an awk ngah ruangah an sur hman cu an dir sal thei nawn lo."},"7":{"text":"Jesuh ih a duhdawtmi dungthluntu cun Piter hnenah, “Bawipa sokhaw a si!” tiah a ti. Piter in Bawipa a si ti kha a theih tikah (a hnipuan a rak phoih cia ruangah) a kor lenghruk kha a hruk lohli ih ti sungah a dawp."},"8":{"text":"Dungthluntu dang pawl in nga a khatmi an sur cu an dir vivo ih tikap an thleng. Leilung ihsin a hla lem lo, pi zathum tluk lawng a rak si."},"9":{"text":"Tikap ih an hung kai tikah meiling parah nga le saang em ciami kha an hmu."},"10":{"text":"Cule Jesuh in an hnenah, “Nan kaihmi nga cu rak keng uh,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Simon Piter cu lawng sungah a hung kai ih nga tumpipi a khatmi sur cu tikap ah a dirh. Nga cu pum za le sawmnga le pum thum a si; cutluk tam a si naón sur cu a tlek lo."},"12":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “Ra uhla thawhhlam ra ei uh!” a ti. Dungthluntu lakah zohman in, “Zoso na si?” tiah an sut ngam lo; ziangahtile Bawipa a si ti an thei."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh cu a va feh ih saang kha a lak ih a pek; nga khal a pek hai."},"14":{"text":"Himi cu Jesuh thihnak ihsin a thawh hnuah dungthluntu hnenih a lang voithumnak a si."},"15":{"text":"An ei ṭheh hnuah Jesuh in Simon Piter cu, “Johan fapa Simon, hi midang pawl ih in duhdawt hnakin nang in i duhdaw sawn maw?” tiah a sut. Simon in, “A si Bawipa, ka lo duhdawt cu na thei,” tiah a ti. Jesuh in a hnenah, “Ka tuunote pawl kilkhawi aw,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh Le Piter"},"16":{"text":"A voihnihnak ah Jesuh in, “Johan fapa Simon, i duhdaw maw,” tiah a sut sal. Simon in, “A si Bawipa, ka lo duhdawt cu na thei,” tiah a let. Jesuh in, “Ka tuu pawl kilkhawi aw,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Johan fapa Simon, i duhdaw maw?” tiah voithumnak a sut lala. Cutiin voithum tiang Jesuh in, “I duhdaw maw?” tiih a sut ruangah Piter cu a riah a sia ih Jesuh hnenah cun, “Bawipa, nang cun ziang hmuahhmuah na thei ṭheh. Ka lo duhdawt ti khal na thei ṭheh ko a sisi!” tiah a ti. Cule Jesuh in, “Ka tuu pawl kilkhawi aw."},"18":{"text":"Thungaite in ka lo sim: na no laiah cun na tim na tuah ih na duhnak hmun poh ah na feh; asinain na tar tikah cun na ban na pharh ding ih midang in an lo ṭem ding ih na duh lonak hmunah an lo fehpi ding,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Hitión a ṭong tikah Piter hi ziangbangtuk thihnak a tuar ding ih ziang bangtuk in Pathian hnenah sunlawinak a pe ding, ti kha Jesuh in a langternak a si. Cule Jesuh in, “I thlun aw,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Piter cu a her ih a dunglamah Jesuh ih a duhdawtmi dungthluntu kha a hmu. Hi dungthluntu pa cu rawl an ei laiah Jesuh a hei naih ih, “Bawipa, a lo zuartu ding cu zoso a si?” tiih a suttu kha a si.","title":"Jesuh Le Dungthluntu Dang"},"21":{"text":"Piter in cupa kha a hmuh tikah, “Bawipa, hi pa hi teh ziangti in so a si ding?” tiah Jesuh cu a sut."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ka rat tiang nung dingih ka duhmi a si ahcun na hrangah ziangso a poinak a um? I thlun sawn aw!” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah hi dungthluntu cu a thi lo ding tiah Jesuh ih dungthluntu pawl lakah thu a thang. Sikhalsehla Jesuh in a thi lo ding, a timi a si lo: “Ka rat tiang nung dingih ka duhmi a si ahcun na hrangah ziangso a poinak a um?” a timi a si."},"24":{"text":"Hi dungthluntu cu hi thu pawl a simtu le a ngantu khal a si; cule a simmi cu a dik a si ti kan thei."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh ih a tuahmi thil dang tampi a um hrih. Pakhat hnu pakhat ngan vivo sehla nganmi cabu pawl cu leilung pumpi hmanah hin a tlem cawk lo ding tiah ka ruat.","title":"Thu Netnak"}}}}},"44":{"info":{"name":"Tirhthlah","shortname":"Dung","abbr":[],"desc":"Tirhthlah pawlih hna òuannak"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa Theofilas, Ka cabu hmaisa sungah khan Jesuh in hnaṭuan hram a thawh ihsin vancungih lakso a si ni tiang,"},"2":{"text":"a thil tuahmi hmuahhmuah le a thuzirhmi hmuahhmuah kha ka ngan. Vancung ih lakso a si hlanah Amah ih a hrilmi a tirhthlah pawl cu Thlarau Thianghlim cahnak huham thawn ṭhatein thu a zirhta hai."},"3":{"text":"A thih hnuah ni sawmli sung an hnenah voi tampi a lang ih a nungsal a si ti kha zohmanih el thei lo dingin phun tampi in a langter. Amah an hmu ih anih in Pathian Uknak thu kha an hnenah a sim."},"4":{"text":"Cule hmun khatih an tonkhawm awk laiah, an hnenah hiti in thu a pek: “Jerusalem ihsin khuihmanah feh hlah uh. Ka Pa in laksawng a lo pe ding tiah ka lo sim ciami kha hngak sawn uh."},"5":{"text":"Johan cun tidai in baptisma a pe; asinain ni malte sungah Thlarau Thianghlim thawn baptisma pek nan si ding,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Tirhthlah pawl cu Jesuh thawn an ton awk tikah annih in, “Bawipa, atuih caanah hin Israel mi hnenah Uknak cu na pe sal ding maw?” tiah an sut.","title":"Jesuh Cu Vancung ah Laak A Si"},"7":{"text":"Jesuh in an hnenah, “A cuih tikcu le nithla cu ka Pa ih thuneihnak ih khiah-mi a si ih nannih theih ṭulmi a si lo."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nan hnenih Thlarau Thianghlim a rung thlen tikah cahnak huham thawn nan khat ding ih Jerusalem le Judea ram le Samaria ram hmuahhmuah le leilung tlun a deng tiang keimah ih theihpitu nan si ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutiih a sim ṭheh tikah Jesuh cu an mithmuh rori-ah vanah laakso a si ih mero in a phen ih an hmu thei nawn lo."},"10":{"text":"Cutiih a hung kainak van cu an zoh cuahco laiah puanvaar sinin mi pahnih hmakhatte-ah an kiangah an rung ding ih,"},"11":{"text":"“Galilee mi pawl, ziangah so van zoh in nan din cuahco? Nan hnen ihsin vanih a kaimi Jesuh hi vanih a kai lai nan hmuh vek cekci in a rakir sal leh ding,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Jesuh ih tirhthlah pawl cu Olif Tlang ihsin Jerusalem ah an kir. Olif Tlang cu Jerusalem ihsin peng hrek tluk a hlat.","title":"Judas Ai-awhtu Hrilnak"},"13":{"text":"Khawpi sungah an vung feh ih an umnak tlunta khaan ah an hung lut. Piter le Johan, Jeim le Andru, Filip le Thomas, Bartholomeo le Matthai, Alfias ih fapa Jeim, phun ṭantu Simon, le Jeim ih fapa Judas tla an si."},"14":{"text":"Hmun khatih thlacam tlang dingah an tongkhawm ṭheu ih nunau pawl le Jesuh ih nu Mari le Jesuh ih naule pawl tla an tel."},"15":{"text":"Ni malte a rei hnuah zumtu pawl an tongkhawm aw ih minung za le kul hrawng an si. Piter cu a ding ih,"},"16":{"text":"“Ka u le ka nau pawl, Thlarau Thianghlim in David ih hmurka hmangin a sim ciami Jesuh a kaitu pawl hruaitu Judas ih thu cu Ca Thianghlim sungih an ngan vekin a kim a ṭul a si."},"17":{"text":"Judas cu kan hnaṭuanpi sungih tel ve dingah hrilmi a si ruangah kan pawl sungah sungtel a rak si ve,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"(Judas in thilsual a tuahmi manih a ngahmi tangka in lo pakhat a lei ih cuih lo sungah a bah ih a thi; a pum a kuai ih a sungril hmuah a pawt ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Jerusalem ih a ummi hmuahhmuah in an thei ih anmah ih ṭong in cuih lo cu Akeldama an ti; a tican cu, “Thisen Lo,” tinak a si.)"},"20":{"text":"Piter in, “Ziangah tile Saam cabu sungah, ‘A inn cu lawng sehla A sungah zohman um hlah hai seh,’ tiah ngan ciami a um. Cule hmun dangah, ‘Midang in a hnaṭuan cu la hai seh,’ tiin a um fawn.","ref":"Saam 69.25; Saam 109.8"},"21":{"text":"“Cuti a si ih Bawipa Jesuh thawhsalnak thutheitu-ah pakhatkhat cun in telpi a ṭul a si. Amah cu Bawi Jesuh kan hnenih khual a tlawn vivo sung hmuahhmuah kanmah lakah a tel ih, Johan in baptisma thu a simnak ihsin thokin Jesuh kan hnenin vanih laakso a si ni tiang, kanmah lakah a tel vemi a si ding,” tiah a ti.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Curuangah mi pahnih ih hmin an pek. Anmah cu Barsabbas ti ih kawhmi Josef, (Justus ti tla in an kawhmi) le Matthias an si."},"24":{"text":"Cule thla an cam ih, “Bawipa, nang cun mi thinlung sung na thei ṭheh; himi pahnih lakah zo deuh na hril ti run langter aw;"},"25":{"text":"a co dingmi hmunah in fehsantu Judas ih ai-awhtu ah na tirhthlah pawl lakih ṭuanvo la dingah na hrilmi cu run fiangter aw,” tiah an ti."},"26":{"text":"Cule an pahnih sungah zoso tirhthlah a si ding ti theihnak ah camcawhfung an zuuk ih Matthias in a ngah. Matthias cu tirhthlah hleikhat pawl hnenah an betcih."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pentikos ni a thlen tikah zumtu hmuahhmuah cu hmun khatah an um.","title":"Thlarau Thianghlim A Rung Thleng"},"2":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah van ihsin thlipi hrang bangin thawmvang a rung ih an tonak khaan cu a khat ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Cule lei bangtuk a si mi meisa hliau an rungsuak zohzo ih cuih khaan sung ummi hmuahhmuah cuih meisa hliau cun a run dai fingfing."},"4":{"text":"An zatein Thlarau Thianghlim in an khat ih Thlarau in ṭong theinak a pek vekin ṭong dangdang in an ṭong ciamco."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem khua sungah leilung tlun khuazakip ihsin a rami Judah mi an um laifang a si ih biaknak lam khalah a zuam ngaingaimi pawl an si."},"6":{"text":"Cuih ṭong dangdang ih an ṭongnak thawmvang an theih tikah miburpi an ra khawm aw. Zumtu pawl ih ṭongmi cu a rami pawl in anmah ih ṭong ciarin an theih tikah an mang a bangzet."},"7":{"text":"Mangbang le khawruahhar in, “Hitiih a ṭong reromi pawl hi Galilee mi an si ko lo maw?"},"8":{"text":"Ziangtin so kanmah ih ṭong cio ih ṭong in kan theih thei?"},"9":{"text":"Kannih cu Parthia ram, Media ram, Elam ram, Mesopotamia ram, Judea ram, Kappadosia ram, Pontas ram, Asia ram,"},"10":{"text":"Frizia ram, Pamfilia ram, Izipt ram le Libia ramsung Sairin khua kiang tla in a rami kan si. Mihrek cu Rom khua in a rami kan si ih,"},"11":{"text":"Judah mi le Zentail mi Judah biaknak ih a lutmi pawl kan si. Mihrek cu Krete tikulh le Arabia ram in kan ra. Asinain Pathian in a huham thawn thil mak zetzet a tuahmi thu anmah ih ṭong ih an simmi kha kanmah ih ṭong ciarin kan thei a si,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Mangbang le awloksong in, “Himi hi a tican ziang a si pei?” tiah pakhat le pakhat an sut aw rero."},"13":{"text":"Asinain midang cun zumtu pawl cu an hnihsan ih, “Hi pawl hi zu an ri a si hi!” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule Piter cu a dang tirhthlah hleikhat hnenah a ding ih aw ring zetin misenpi hnenah thu a sim: “Ka phunpi Judah mi le Jerusalem ih a ummi pawl, nan zatein in ngai uhla, hi thil ih a tican ka lo sim hai ding.","title":"Piter Ih Thusimnak"},"15":{"text":"Nan ruah bangtuk a si lo; hipawl hi zu an ri lo; zinglam nazi pakua lawng a si lai."},"16":{"text":"Ziang so a si ti ahcun profet Joel ih a rak sim ciami a kimnak sawn a si. Profet Joel ih sim ciami cu:"},"17":{"text":"‘Pathian in, ni netnak lamah cun hiti in ka tuah ding; Mi hmuahhmuah parah ka Thlarau ka burh ding; Nan fapa pawl le nan fanu pawl in ka thu an phuang ding; Nan tlangval pawl in langnak an hmu ding; Nan patar pawl in mang an man ding;"},"18":{"text":"Asi, ka salnu le ka salpa pawl tlun khalah cuih ni ahcun Ka Thlarau ka burh ding ih, ka thu an sim ding."},"19":{"text":"Tlunlam vanah hmuhsaknak mak ka tuah ding ih, Hnuailam leilung par khalah khawruahhar ka tuah ding. Thisen le meisa le meikhu sahzet a um ding."},"20":{"text":"Ni a thim ding ih, thlapi khi thisen bangin a sen ding; Bawipa ih Ni - ni maksak le ni sunglawi a thlenhlan deuh ah,"},"21":{"text":"Bawipa hnenah bomnak dil in a autu cu rundam an si ding,’ a ti.","ref":"Joe 2.28-32"},"22":{"text":"“Ka phunpi Israel mi pawl, hi thu ka simmi hi ngaihnik uh! Nazareth mi Jesuh cu minung asinain Pathian ih thuneihnak a nei a si, ti cu amah hnenin Pathian in a huham thawn thil khawruahhar le hmuhsaknak mak zetzet a tuahmi pawl ihsin a langter zo. Himi cu nanmah rori ih nan theihmi a si, ziangahtile nan lakih a cangmi thil an si."},"23":{"text":"Pathian amah ih khawkhannak vekin nan kut sungah Jesuh pek ding kha a rak ruahcat ciami a si. Misual pawl ih forhfialnakin Jesuh cu thinglamtah ah nan khenbet ih nan that."},"24":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in thihnak ihsin a thoter sal ih thihnak huham sung ihsin a luatter zo, ziangahtile amah cu thihnak ih kaitar theihmi a si lo."},"25":{"text":"David in amah ih thuhla cu hiti in a sim: ‘Bawipa cu ka mithmai ah ka hmu ringring; Ka kiangah a um ih ka phang lo ding."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah ka lung a awi ih, ka ṭongkam cu nomnak in a khat. Curuangah kei hi a thi theimi milai ka si naón, ruahsannak sungah hnangam zetin ka cawl ding."},"27":{"text":"Ziangahtile mithi khua-ah cun i taanta lo ding ih, rintlak na salpa hi thlankhur sungah ziamralta dingah cun i siang lo ding."},"28":{"text":"Nunnak thlen theitu lamzin cu i hmuh zo ih i umpi ruangah lungawinak in ka khat ding,’ a ti.","ref":"Saam 16.8-11"},"29":{"text":"“Ka u le ka nau pawl, mi hminthang kan pu Siangpahrang David ih thu cu nan hnenah fiangtein ka sim duh. David cu a thi ih an phum; a thlaan tla tuihsun tiang kan lakah a um."},"30":{"text":"Amah cu profet a si ih Pathian ih a kam ciami thu a thei; David bangtuk in David ih tesinfa pakhatkhat kha siangpahrang si dingah Pathian in thu a kam."},"31":{"text":"Pathian in hmailam caanah ziang a tuah ding ti cu David in a hmu cia; curuangah Messiah a thawhsalnak ding thu cu hiti in a sim: ‘Mithi khua ah amah cu a taanta lo ding ih, a taksa ruangpi cu thlaan sungah a ziamta lo ding,’ tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Pathian in hi Jesuh rori hi thihnak ihsin a thoter sal ih cumi theihpitu cu kanmah hi kan si."},"33":{"text":"Pathian a Pa ih vorhlam kapah sunglawi zetin thlenter a si zo ih a kam cia bangtuk in Thlarau Thianghlim cu a Pa hnen ihsin a ngah zo. Atuih nan hmuhmi le nan theihmi cu kan parih a burhmi amah ih laksawng a si."},"34":{"text":"Ziangahtile vancungih a thlengtu cu David a si lo; David amah in: ‘Bawipa in ka Bawipa hnenah, na ral pawl na ke hnuai ah,"},"35":{"text":"Na kepal-ih ka canter hlantiang Ka vorhlam kapah hin to aw, a ti,’ tiah a ti.","ref":"Saam 110.1"},"36":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl, thinglamtah parih nan thahmi Jesuh hi Pathian in Bawipa le Messiah ah a tuah zo a si, tihi fiangtein nan theih ṭheh dingah a ṭul hrimhrim a si,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cuih thu an theih tikah an thinlung a khoih zetih Piter le a dang tirhthlah pawl cu, “U le nau pawl, ziangso kan tuah ding?” tiah an sut."},"38":{"text":"Piter in an hnenah, “Nan zatein nan sual sir fingfing uhla Jesuh Khrih hmin in baptisma lak uh; cuticun nan sualnak ngaidam nan si ding ih Pathian laksawng Thlarau Thianghlim nan ngah ding."},"39":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pathian thukamnak cu nanmah le nan faate pawl hnenah le Pathian thawn a hlat awmi an si naón Bawipa kan Pathian in a kawhmi pawl hmuahhmuah hnenah a si,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Piter in thu tampi a zirh ih a forh hai. “Hi miṭha lo parih a thleng dingmi hremnak ihsin luat dingah zuam aw uh,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Piter ih simmi cu mi tampi in an zum ih baptisma an lak; cuih ni ni khatah an pawl cu mi thawngthum tlukin an karh."},"42":{"text":"An zatein tirhthlah pawl hnen ihsin an zir ih, tirawl eitlangnak le thlacam tlangnak thawn pawlkomnak an nei ringring."},"43":{"text":"Tirhthlah pawl in khawruahharza le hmuhsaknak mak zetzet thil tampi an tuah ruangah mi hmuahhmuah ih thinlung sungah ṭihnak le hmaizahnak in a khat.","title":"Zumtu Pawl Nundan"},"44":{"text":"Zumtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu an pawlkom aw ih thurual zetin an thil neihmi tla an ṭawm aw."},"45":{"text":"An thilri neihmi le an hlawnthil pawl tla an zuar ih an ngahmi tangka cu an ṭulnak vekin an zem aw."},"46":{"text":"Ni khat hnu ni khat Biakinn sungah an tongkhawm aw; an inn ah rawl an ṭawm aw ih tangdornak le lungawi thanuam in an ei tlang."},"47":{"text":"Pathian an thangṭhat ih mi hmuahhmuah hnenin mithmai ṭha an ngah. Cule nitinte in Bawipa in an pawlah rundamnak ngahtu a bet vivo."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nikhat ah Piter le Johan cu thlacam tikcu zanlam nazi pathum ah Biakinn ah an feh.","title":"Kezengmi A Dam"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkih Kotka Mawi an timi ah suahkeh kezeng pa pakhat a rak um. Nitinte Biakinn ih a fehtu pawl hnen ihsin tangka dil dingah cuih kotka-ah cun an hei ret ṭheu."},"3":{"text":"Piter le Johan an luh kha a hmuh tikah thil pakhatkhat pe dingah a dil hai."},"4":{"text":"Ṭhatein an zoh fel ih Piter in, “In hun zohhnik!” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Ziangtal ka ngah pei maw, tiah beisei zetin a zoh hai."},"6":{"text":"Cule Piter cun, “Tangka lo pek ding zianghman ka nei lo; asinain ka neihmi ka lo pe: Nazareth mi Jesuh Khrih hmin in tho awla feh aw,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule a vorhlam kut in a kaih ih a vun dirh. Hmakhatteah cupa ih ke le kebeu pawl cu an cak sal."},"8":{"text":"A hung tho lohli ih amahte in a ding ih a feh thei. Cule Piter le Johan hnenah Biakinn sungah a lut ve. A feh, a khir a zuang ih Pathian a thangṭhat."},"9":{"text":"Cutiih a feh thei le Pathian a thangṭhat cu mipi in an hmu ih,"},"10":{"text":"Kotka Mawi ah tangka dil in a um ringringtu a si kha an theih tikah a parih thil a thlengmi ruangah an khawruah a har ih an mang a bang ngaingai."},"11":{"text":"Cupa cu Solomon Hulhliap timi ahcun Piter le Johan hnenah a um kha an hmuh tikah mipi cu an khawruahhar in an hnenah an va tlan.","title":"Biakinn Sungih Piter Thusimmi"},"12":{"text":"Cumi cu Piter in a hmuh tikah an hnenah, “Ka phunpi Israel mi pawl, ziangah so hi thu ah nan khawruah a har ih kanmah lehlam mitṭhep loin in zoh? Hi pa a feh thei hi kanmah ih cahnak le Pathian duhzawng in a nung theitu kan si ruangih a cangmi ah maw si nan ruat?"},"13":{"text":"Abraham le Isaak le Jakob ih Pathian, kan pu le kan pa pawl ih Pathian in amah ih sunlawinak cu a Siahhlawh Jesuh hnenah a pek zo. Asinain nannih in amah cu thuneitu pawl ih kut sungah nan pek. Pilat in thlah dingih thu a rel ciami hman amah ih mithmuh rori-ah nan hnong zo a si."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh hi mi thianghlim le mi ṭhazet asinain nannih in nan hnong; cuih tlunah Pilat kha zaangfah nan dil ih laithattu kha thlah sawn dingah nan fial."},"15":{"text":"Nannih cun nunnak ih mi a hruaitu kha nan that; asinain Pathian in thihnak ihsin a thoter sal ih kanmah hi cumi a theihpitu kan si."},"16":{"text":"Hi Jesuh hminih huham ruangah hi kezeng pa hin damnak a ngah thei. Nan hmuhmi le nan theihmi hi a hmin zumnak thawngin tuahmi a si. Nan zate ih nan hmuh ṭheh vekin Jesuh zumnak in hi pa hi a damter a si."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah ka u le ka nau tla, nanmah le nan hotu pawl in Jesuh parih nan rak tuahmi hi nan theih lo ruangih tuahmi a si ti ka thei."},"18":{"text":"Pathian in khuahlan laipi ah a hrilmi Messiah cu harsatnak a tuar ding tiah profet pawl hnenin a rak phuang zo; cumi kha atu-ah hiti in a kim a si."},"19":{"text":"Sir aw uhla Pathian hnenah kir sal uh. Cuti asile nan sualnak a lo ngaithiam ding. Cutiin nan ti asile,"},"20":{"text":"Bawipa hnen ihsin tharthawhnak tikcu a rathleng ding ih nan hrangih a hrilcia mi Messiah timi Jesuh cu nan hnenah a lo pe ding."},"21":{"text":"Pathian in khuahlan laipi ih a profet thianghlim pawl hnen ihsin a phuan cia vekin, ziang hmuahhmuah siam thar tikcu a kim hlanlo Jesuh cu vancungah a um ding."},"22":{"text":"Ziangahtile Moses in, ‘Bawipa nan Pathian in keimah i thlah vekin nan miphun a si mi profet pakhat nan hnenah a thlah ding. Amah ih a lo simmi hmuahhmuah cu nan thlun ṭheh a ṭul.","ref":"Daan 18.15, 18"},"23":{"text":"Cuih profet a thlun duh lotu cu Pathian miphun sung ihsin dawihlo a si ding ih siatsuahnak a tong ding,’ a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cule thuthan ding a neitu profet hmuahhmuah, profet Samuel le amah hnu ih a rami profet pawl khal in, an zatein tuih hrawngih a cangmi hi an rak than cia zo."},"25":{"text":"Profet pawl hnen ihsin Pathian ih thukamnak cu nanmah ih hrangah a si ih Pathian in nan pu le nan pa pawl hnenih a tuahmi thukamnak a ṭawm vetu nan si. Pathian in Abraham hnenah, ‘Na tesinfa sung ihsin leilung tlunih mi hmuahhmuah cu thluasuahnak ka pe ding,’ tiah a ti.","ref":"Seem 22.18"},"26":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah Pathian in zovek khal nan ṭhat lonak ihsin nan kir ih a lo thlawsuah theinak dingah a hrilmi a Siahhlawh cu a hmaisabik ah nan hnenah a thlah a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Piter le Johan in mipi hnenih thu an sim rero laiah puithiam ṭhenkhat le biakinn kilvengtu hotu bawi le Sadusi hrekkhat an ra thleng.","title":"Khonsil Hmaiah Piter Le Johan"},"2":{"text":"Mithi pawl an nung sal ding ti fiangternak ah Jesuh cu thihnak ihsin a tho sal tiah tirhthlah pahnih ih an phuan ruangah annih pawl cu an thin-ai a thok ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah cuih tirhthlah pahnih cu an kai ih khua a sim zo ruangah thawngah a thaisun tiang an thlak."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an thusimmi a theitu tampi cun an zum; a zumtu pawl cu an karh sinsin ih thawngnga tluk an ti."},"5":{"text":"A thaisun ah Judah mi hotu pawl, upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl cu Jerusalem ah an tongkhawm aw."},"6":{"text":"Cutawkah Puithiam Saang Annas an tong; cule Kaiafas le Johan le Alexander le Puithiam Saang ih sungkhat dang pawl tla thawn an tongkhawm aw."},"7":{"text":"Tirhthlah pahnih cu an hmaiah an dinter ih, “Hi thil cangmi hi ziangtinso nan tuah? Ziang huham so nan neih ih zo ih hmin so nan hman?” tiah an sut."},"8":{"text":"Piter cu Thlarau Thianghlim in a khat ih an hnenah, “Mipi hotu pawl le upa pawl,"},"9":{"text":"tuihsun ahhin hi kezeng pa a damnak thu le a parih thil ṭha tuah a si thu hi in sut a si ahcun,"},"10":{"text":"nan theih dingmi le Israel mi hmuahhmuah in an theih ṭheh dingmi cu hihi a si: nan hmaiih a dingmi pa a damfelnak hi Nazareth mi, thinglamtah parih nan thahmi, thihnak ihsin Pathian in a thawhter salmi Jesuh ih hmin thawngin a si, tihi a si."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh thu ahhin Ca Thianghlim in: ‘Inn saktu pawl in nan hnonmi lungto cu a thupi bik lungto ah a cang zo,’ tiah a ti.","ref":"Saam 118.22"},"12":{"text":"Rundamnak cu amah ih sung lawngah a um; ziangahtile Pathian ih rundammi kan sinak dingah leikhawvel pumpuluk ah hin minung hnenih pekmi hmin dang zohman an um lo,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Khonsil upa pawl in Piter le Johan cu fimnak le thiamnak a nei lomi mi menmen an si naón ziangtlukin an ral a ṭha ti kha an hmuh tikah an mang a bang ngaingai. Cule annih cu Jesuh ih rualpi an si ti kha an mang sal."},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an damtermi pa cu Piter le Johan kiangih a din ringring ruangah an ṭong theimi zianghman a um fawn lo."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah an thurelnak khaan ihsin lengah an suahter hai ih anmah lawng in khaan sungah cun thu an rel."},"16":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat cu, “Ziangtin so kan tuah ko sawh ding? Zohman ih an tuah thei lomi hmuhsaknak thilmak an tuah ti cu Jerusalem khawsung ih a ummi hmuahhmuah in an thei ṭheh zo ih zohman ih el theimi a si nawn lo."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hi thu hi mipi hnenih a zai lonak dingah Jesuh hmin in zohnen hmanah thu sim nawn hlah uh, kan ti pei,” tiah an ti."},"18":{"text":"Cule an ko kir hai ih, Jesuh hmin in zohman zirh lo ding le zohnen hmanah thu sim hrimhrim lo dingin an dawn."},"19":{"text":"Asinain Piter le Johan in, “Nanmah ih thu thlun maw Pathian ih thu thlun so Pathian hmaiah a dik sawn, nanmahte in ṭhen hnik uh."},"20":{"text":"Ziangahtile kanmah rori in kan hmuhmi le kan theihmi cu sim loin kan um thei lo,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah Khonsil upa pawl cun nasa sinsin in ralrinnak an pek hnuah an thlah. Mi hmuahhmuah in an lakih thil a cangmi an hmu ih Pathian an thangṭhat ruangah tirhthlah pawl hrem cu a cang thei lo ti kha an hmu."},"22":{"text":"Hmuhsaknak ah damnak a ngahtu pa hi kum sawmli tlun a si."},"23":{"text":"Piter le Johan cu an luat vete in an rualpi pawl hnenah an kir ih puithiam le upa pawl ih an simmi thu pawl cu an ruah hai.","title":"Ralṭhatnak Ding Thla An Cam"},"24":{"text":"Cumi cu zumtu pawl in an theih tikah hmunkhatte ah Pathian hnenah thla an cam ih, “Maw Cungnungbik Bawipa, van le lei le tipithuanthum le a sungih ummi hmuahhmuah a Tuahtu Bawipa,"},"25":{"text":"Na Thlarau Thianghlim hmangin na siahhlawh kan pu David hnenin thu na sim ih: ‘Ziangah so Zentail mi pawl hi an ai a thawh? Ziangah so milai hin a ṭhahnem lomi mi phiarnak an tuah?"},"26":{"text":"Bawipa le Messiah dodal dingah, leilung siangpahrang pawl an tim an tuah ih, Uktu bawi pawl thawn hmun khatah an tongkhawm aw,’ tiin na rak ti.","ref":"Saam 2.1-2"},"27":{"text":"Ziangahtile Herod le Pontius Pilat in Messiah ih na hrilmi na Siahhlawh Thianghlim Jesuh dodal dingah hi khawpi sungah hin Zentail mi pawl le Israel mi pawl thawn an tongkhawm aw ngaingai."},"28":{"text":"Na huham le na tumtahnak in a hung cang leh ding tiih na rak khiah ciami kimter ṭheh dingah an tong aw khawm a si."},"29":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, atuih in hro reromi tla hi nangmah in run thei hram awla kannih na sal pawl tla hin na thu cu ralṭha zetih kan sim theinak dingah in bawm hram aw."},"30":{"text":"Mi damnak dingah na baan run pharh awla na Siahhlawh Thianghlim Jesuh hmin in hmuhsaknak le khawruahhar thil pawl tuah theinak in run pe hram aw,” tiah an ti."},"31":{"text":"Thla an cam ṭheh vete in cutawkih an tonkhawmnak inn cu a hnin thluh. Thlarau Thianghlim in an khat ih Pathian thu cu ralṭha zetin an sim."},"32":{"text":"Zumtu pawl cu thinlung le ruahnak rual aw zetin an umtlang. Zohman in a neihmi thilri kha, ‘Ka bulta a si,’ a ti lo; an neihmi hmuahhmuah kha pakhat le pakhat an ṭawm aw.","title":"Zumtu Pawl Thil An ṭawm Aw"},"33":{"text":"Bawi Jesuh thawhsalnak thu cu tirhthlah pawl in a nasa zetmi huham thawn an sim ih Pathian in an zate parah thlawsuah tampi a run burh."},"34":{"text":"An lakah zohman a tlasam mi an um lo. Lo a neitu le inn a neitu pawl in an lo le an inn pawl cu an zuar ih an ngahmi tangka cu,"},"35":{"text":"tirhthlah pawl kutah an rak pek. Cule cuih tangka cu a ṭulnak vekin an zem vivo."},"36":{"text":"Cubangtuk in Saipras tikulh ih a suakmi Levi mi Josef in,"},"37":{"text":"a lo kha a zuar ih a ngahmi tangka cu tirhthlah pawl ih kut sungah a pek. Josef cu tirhthlah pawl in Barnabas tiah an ti. (Barnabas ti cu “Thazaang Petu,” tinak a si.)"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asinain Ananias an timi pa le a nupi Sapfira cun an neihmi thilri kha an zuar ih,","title":"Ananias Le Safira Thu"},"2":{"text":"a nupi ih lungkimnak thawn tangka ṭhenkhat cu anmah ih hrangah an ret ih a taangmi cu tirhthlah pawl kut sungah an pek."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Piter in, “Ananias, ziangah so Satan in a lo neh ih na thil zuarnak ih na ngahmi tangka a hrek cu suup tahrat in Thlarau Thianghlim na bum?"},"4":{"text":"Na thilri cu na zuar hlanah nangmah ih ta a si; na zuar hnu khalah na ngahmi tangka cu na ta thotho a si. Sikhalsehla ziangah so hi bangtuk tuah ding hi na thinlung hrimhrim in na ruah? Milai na bum a si lo, Pathian na bum a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cumi cu Ananias in a theih vete in a tlu ih a thi; cule cuih thu a theitu hmuahhmuah cu an tuk a sum ṭheh."},"6":{"text":"Tlangval pawl an rung ih a ruak cu an tuam ṭheh hnuah lengah an zawn ih an phum."},"7":{"text":"Nazi pathum hnuah ziang a cang ti thei loin a nupi a ra ve."},"8":{"text":"Piter in, “Hi tangka hi nan thil nan zuarmi ihsin nan ngahmi tangka zate a si maw? I sim hnik!” tiah a sut. Sapfira in, “Asi, kan ngahmi zate a si,” tiah a sawn."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah Piter in, “Ziang hrangah so na pasal thawn nan pahnih in Bawipa ih Thlarau hniksak dingah nan lung a kimtlang? Na pasal a phumtu tlangval pawl cu sangka kiangah an um lai; nangmah khal an lo zawn suak ve ding,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah anih khal Piter kehram ah a tlu ih a thi ve. Tlangval pawl cu an rung lut ih a thi zo ti kha an hmuh tikah a lengah an zawn ih a pasal thlaan kiangah an va phum ve."},"11":{"text":"Kawhhran pumpi le cuih thu a theitu hmuahhmuah cu tuksum in an um."},"12":{"text":"Mipi lakah cun tirhthlah pawl in hmuhsaknak le khawruahhar thil tampi an tuah. Zumtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu Solomon Hulhliap timi ah an tong khawm aw.","title":"Khawruahhar Tampi An Tuah"},"13":{"text":"Anmah cu midang in an porh zet naón a lenglam mi cu an lakah an tel ngam lo."},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nunau siseh mipa siseh Bawipa a zumtu pawl cu an pawl ah tam sinsin in an lut."},"15":{"text":"Tirhthlah pawl ih thil an tuahmi an hmuh ruangah mina tampi cu khawsung lamzin ah an zawn ih Piter a feh zawng ah mi ṭhenkhat tal a thlaam in hliap seh tiah ihkhun le pher parah an hlum vivo hai."},"16":{"text":"Cule mi tampi cu Jerusalem kiangkap khua ihsin an ra ih mina siseh, khawsia polh mi pawl siseh, an rak zawn ih an zatein an dam thluh."},"17":{"text":"Puithiam Saang le a rualpi pawl hmuahhmuah le cutawk hrawngih a ummi Sadusi pawl cun tirhthlah pawl kha an halhsik tuk ruangah thil pakhatkhat tuah an tum.","title":"Tirhthlah Pawl Hremnak An Tuar"},"18":{"text":"Tirhthlah pawl kha an kai ih mipi thawng ah an thlak."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cuih zanah cun Bawipa ih vancungmi in thawnginn sangka pawl cu a ong ih tirhthlah pawl cu a suah hnuah an hnenah,"},"20":{"text":"“Va feh uhla Biakinn sungah dingin misenpi hnenah hi nuntharnak thuhla hi kimten va sim uh,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"A sim vekin tirhthlah pawl cun an tuah ih zing thlapit ah Biakinn sungah an lut ih thuzirh an thok. Puithiam Saang le a rualpi pawl in Khonsil thurelnak thupi zet nei dingah Judah mi upa hmuahhmuah kimtein an ko khawm. Tirhthlah pawl thawnginn ihsin an hmaiih rak hruai dingah mi an hei thlah."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla thawnginn bawi pawl an va thlen tikah thawnginn sungah tirhthlah pawl an hmu nawn lo; curuangah an kir ih Khonsil pawl an sim:"},"23":{"text":"“Thawnginn kan va thlen tikah tawh ṭhatein a hren aw ih a kiltu pawl khal in sangka ṭhatein an kil ko; asinain sangka kan ong tikah a sungah zohman an um lo,” tiah an ti."},"24":{"text":"Cumi cu puithiam upa le Biakinn kiltu bawi in an theih tikah tirhthlah pawl ziang an cang, tiah khawruahhar in an um."},"25":{"text":"Cule mi pakhat a rung lut ih, “Ngaihnik uh! Thawng ih nan thlakmi pawl kha Biakinn ah an um ih mi an zirh rero a si,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah Biakinn kiltu ralbawi le a kuthnuai milai pawl cu an va feh ih tirhthlah pawl cu an va hruai kir. Hranhram in an hruai lo, ziangahtile misenpi in lungto in in deng pang ding ti an phang."},"27":{"text":"Tirhthlah pawl cu an run luhpi ih Khonsil hmaiah cun an dinter. Cule Puithiam Saang in thu a sut."},"28":{"text":"“Hi pa hmin in thu nan zirh nawn lo pei, tiah fek zetin thu kan lo pe zo ti nan thei lo maw? Asinain nan tuah thotho. Nan thuzirhmi cu Jerusalem nan khahter zo ih a thihnak thu khalah kanmah hi mawhphurtu ah in tuah a si,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Piter le a dang dungthlun pawl in, “Milai thu hnakin Pathian thu kan ngai sawn ding."},"30":{"text":"Nanmah in Jesuh cu thinglamtah parah nan khen that; asinain kan pupa pawl ih Pathian in thihnak ihsin a thoter sal zo."},"31":{"text":"Pathian in a thoter sal ih Israel mi pawl sualsirnak tikcu an neih ih an sualnak tla ngaidam a sinak dingah Amah cu Pathian in Hruaitu le Rundamtu ah a vorhlamah a toter zo."},"32":{"text":"Hi thil hmuahhmuah a theihpitu cu kanmah hi kan si; kanmah lawng kan si lo, Pathian in amah ih thu a ngaitu pawl hnenah laksawngih a rak pekmi Thlarau Thianghlim tla hi thu theihpitu a si ve,” tiah an ti."},"33":{"text":"Cutiih an timi cu Khonsil sungtel pawl in an theih tikah an thin a heng tuk lawmmam ih tirhthlah pawl cu thah ṭheh an duh."},"34":{"text":"Sikhalsehla anmah lakah mi hmuahhmuah ih upatmi Daanthiam pa Farasi mi Gamaliel cu Khonsil hmaiah a hung ding ih tirhthlah pawl cu a lengih malte sung suahter dingah thu a pek."},"35":{"text":"Cule Khonsil upa hnenah cun, “Israel mi pawl, himi pawl parih thil nan tuahmi ah hin ralring uh."},"36":{"text":"Kan dung laiah Theudas an timi pa a hungsuak ih keimah hi mi menmen ka si lo, a ti ih mi zali in an thlun. Asinain amah cu an that ih a thluntu pawl cu an ṭekdarh ṭheh; cule a hnaṭuannak cu a cem ve."},"37":{"text":"Cuih hnuah mipum siar laiah Galilee mi Judas a hungsuak lala ih mi tampi in an thlun hluarhlo; asinain thah a si ve ih a dungthluntu pawl cu an ṭekdarh ṭheh lala."},"38":{"text":"Atuih thu khalah hin fiangtein ka lo sim, himi pawl tlunah hin zianghman tuah hlah uh. Umsan men uh! An tumtahmi le an tuahmi hi milai ih thokmi a si ahcun a hloral ko ding."},"39":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian ih tuahmi a si ahcun nan neh thei cuang lo ding. Pathian dodaltu riangri ah nan cang thei,” tiah a ti. Curuangah Khonsil upa pawl cun Gamaliel ih ruahnak pekmi cu an thlun."},"40":{"text":"Tirhthlah pawl cu an ko ih fungfek in an vuak ih Jesuh hmin in thu sim nawn lo dingah thu an pek hnuah an thlah."},"41":{"text":"Tirhthlah pawl cu Khonsil upa pawl hnen ihsin an suah tikah Jesuh hrangah ningzah mualpho tuar dingin ruah an si ruangah an lung a awizet."},"42":{"text":"Cule nitinte in Messiah Jesuh ih Thuthang ṭha cu Biakinn ah siseh mi inn ah siseh catbang loin an zirh ih an sim vivo."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Caan malte a rei deuh tikah dungthluntu pawl an tam vivo ih Judah mi pawl le Grik ṭong in a ṭongtu Judah mi pawl karlak ah thubuai a um. Grik ṭong a hmangtu Judah mi pawl in nitin a ṭulmi leinak ih tangka zem tikah an nuhmei pawl in an co ding zat an co lo a si, tiah thu a um.","title":"Bawmtu Upa Pasarih"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah tirhthlah hleihnih pawl in zumtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu hmun khatah an kokhawm ih, “Tangka thuhla tawlrelnak ah Pathian thusim kan daithlang a si ahcun a dik lo ding."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah u le nau pawl, nanmah lakah Thlarau Thianghlim le fimnak in a khatmi mi pasarih hril uhla anmah pawl cu hi thuhla tawlreltu ah kan ret ding."},"4":{"text":"Kannih cu kan tikcu zatein thlacamnak le thusimnak ah kan hmang ding,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Tirhthlah hleihnih pawl ih ruahnak an suahpi mi parah an zatein an lung a awi ih cuticun zumnak le Thlarau Thianghlim in a khatmi Stefen, Filip, Prokhoras, Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas, le Antiok khua ihsin Judah biaknak ih a luttu Zentail mi Nikolaus tla an hril."},"6":{"text":"An pasarih in tirhthlah pawl hnenah an fehpi ih tirhthlah pawl in an lu parah an kut an suang ih thla an cam sak."},"7":{"text":"Cule Pathian thu cu a zai vivo. Dungthluntu pawl tla Jerusalem khua sungah an karh vivo ih puithiam tampi in an zumnak cu an pom ve."},"8":{"text":"Pathian in a thlawsuah zetmi le cahnak huham thawn a khatmi Stefen in misenpi lakah khawruahharza le hmuhsaknak mak tampi a tuah.","title":"Stefen An Kai"},"9":{"text":"Asinain Salsuak pawl sungin Stefen thawn thu-el awknak a suak ih acuih Stefen thu eltu lakah cun Sairin khua le Alexandria khua ihsin a rami Judah pawl tla an tel. Cun Silisia le Asia ram ih Judah pawl khal an tel ve."},"10":{"text":"Asinain Stefen cu Thlarau in fimnak a pek ih a ṭong tikah cun zohman in an el thei lo."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah mi ṭhenkhat kha, “Moses le Pathian thangsiat in a ṭong kan thei a si,” tiah ti dingah nawhthuh an pek."},"12":{"text":"Cuti cun misenpi, upa pawl le Daanthiam pawl kha thinheng koin an forh. Stefen cu an kai ih Khonsil upa hmaiah an suahpi."},"13":{"text":"Cule thuphan puhtu ding pawl cu an rak hruai ih annih in, “Hi pa in kan Biakinn Thianghlim le Moses Daan tla hi nautat hmuhsuam in a ṭong ringring."},"14":{"text":"Hi Nazareth mi Jesuh in hi Biakinn hi a bal ṭheh ding ih Moses san ihsin kanmah ih san tiang a ummi kan pupa daan khal a thleng ṭheh ding a si, tiah a ṭong lai kan thei,” an ti."},"15":{"text":"Khonsil pumkhawmnak sungih a telmi hmuahhmuah in Stefen cu an hei zoh ih a mithmai cu vancungmi ih mithmai bangtuk in an hmu."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Puithiam Saang in Stefen cu, “Hitiih an timi hi a si ngaingai maw?” tiah a sut.","title":"Stefen Ih Thusimmi"},"2":{"text":"Stefen in, “U le nau, nu le pa pawl, i ngaihnik uh! Kan pu Abraham cu Haran um dingih a feh hlanah Mesopotamia ah Pathian sunlawinak a hnenah a rung lang ih,"},"3":{"text":"‘Na sungkhat le na ram taanta awla ka lo hmuh dingmi ramah feh aw,’ tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuti cun Khaldea ram ihsin a suak ih Haran khua ah a um. A pa thih hnuah atu nan umnak ramah hin Pathian in a certer."},"5":{"text":"Culai ah hi ram hi Pathian in Abraham hnenah a bulta si dingah a fiakte hman a pe lo; asinain a hnenah pe dingin thu a kam ih hi ram hi nangmah le na tesinfa pawl ih ta a si ding, tiah a ti. Pathian in hiti ih thukamnak a tuah laiah Abraham cu faate a nei lo."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in a hnenah, ‘Na tesinfa pawl cu ramdang ah an um ding; cuih ramah sal an cang ding ih kum zali sung zonzaih an tuar ding."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an renmi miphun parah cun thuṭhennak ka nei ding ih cuih hnu lawngah cuih ram ihsin an suak ding ih hi hmunah hin keimah in bia ding,’ tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule Pathian in Abraham hnenah serhtannak daan kha a thukam hminsinnakah a pek. Curuangah Abraham in a fapa Isaak a suah hnu zarh khatah a serh a tansak. Isaak in a fapa Jakob ih serh a tansak ih Jakob in a fapa hleihnih an serh a tansak. A fapa hleihnih cu kan phun cithlahtu kan pupa hminthang pawl an si."},"9":{"text":"“Jakob ih fapa pawl in an naupa Josef cu an nahsuah ih Izipt ramah salah an zuar. Sikhalsehla Pathian a hnenah a um ih,"},"10":{"text":"a harsatnak sung ihsin himte in a hruai suak. Izipt siangpahrang hmaiih a din tikah Pathian in Josef cu ziaza mawi le fimnak a pek ih Izipt siangpahrang in a ram pumpi le a innsang tlunah uktu bawi a ṭuanter."},"11":{"text":"Izipt ram le Kanaan ram sungih mangṭam a tlun tikah mipi hrangah harsatnak tampi a thleng. Kan pupa pawl khal in rawl an ngah thei lo."},"12":{"text":"Jakob in Izipt ah rawl a um ti a theih tikah a fapa pawl, kan pu le kan pa pawl cu a thlah; himi cu Izipt an thlennak hmaisa bik a si."},"13":{"text":"A voihnihnak ih Izipt an thlen tikah a u le hnenah Josef cu a phuang aw ih Izipt siangpahrang in Josef ih sungkhat pawl cu a thei ngah."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah Josef in a pa Jakob le a sungkhat pawl hnenah Izipt ramih rung vai dingin thu a cah. An zatein minung sawmsarih le panga an si."},"15":{"text":"Cule Jakob cu Izipt ah a vung feh; cutawkah amah le a fapa pawl cu an thi."},"16":{"text":"An ruak cu Shekhem ah an fehpi ih Abraham in Hamor miphun hnen ihsin tangka in a rak leimi thlaan ah an phum."},"17":{"text":"“Pathian in Abraham hnenih thu a kammi a kimnak tikcu a nai vivo tikah Izipt ramih a ummi kan phunpi pawl cu an tam sinsin."},"18":{"text":"Neta bikah Josef ih thuhla a thei dah lotu siangpahrang pakhat in Izipt ram cu a uk."},"19":{"text":"Kan pu le kan pa pawl cu a bum ih a hrem; an faate pawl tla thi hai seh tiah an innsung ihsin inn lengah a hlonter."},"20":{"text":"Culai caanah naute mawi zet Moses timi cu a suak. Moses cu inn ah thla thum sung ṭhatein an cawm."},"21":{"text":"Pawnleng ih hlon a si ve tikah siangpahrang ih fanu in a lak ih a fapa ah a tuah ih cutiin a kilkhawi."},"22":{"text":"Izipt mi ih fimnak hmuahhmuah an zirh thluh ih a ṭongkam le a tuahnak in mi nasazet a si ti a langter."},"23":{"text":"“Moses cu kum sawmli a ti tikah a phunpi Israel mi pawl ziang bangtuk in an nung, ti hmuh duh ah a leng."},"24":{"text":"Culai ah a phunpi Israel mi pakhat cu Izipt pa in a rak hrem kha a hmu tikah a va bawm ih phuba la in Izipt pa cu a that."},"25":{"text":"(Pathian in anmah luattertu dingah i hmang ding ih ka phunpi khal in an theithiam ding, tiah a ruat naón an rak theithiam lo.)"},"26":{"text":"A thaisun ah Israel mi pahnih an sual awk lai kha a hmu ih va rem a tum. ‘Unau pawl, i ngai uh! Nannih cu mi phunkhat Israel mi veve nan si! Ziangah so hiti in nan sual awk rero?’ tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a phunpi a hmuhsuamtu pa in Moses cu a tulpet ih, ‘Zo in so kan tlunah uktu le thuṭhentu ah a lo tuah?"},"28":{"text":"Mizan ih Izipt pa na thah vek khan thah ve i duh maw si?’ tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cumi cu Moses in a theih tikah Izipt ram ihsin a tlan ih Midian ramah a va um. Cutawkah fapa pahnih a nei."},"30":{"text":"“Kum sawmli a liam hnuah Sinai Tlang kiang ramṭhing ah hrambur alh sung ihsin Moses hnenah vancungmi pakhat a lang."},"31":{"text":"Cuih mei alh cu Moses in a hmuh tikah a mang a bang ih zohhliah dingah hrambur alh-mi kiangah cun a va feh. Asinain Bawipa ih aw a thei ih,"},"32":{"text":"‘Keimah hi nan pupa pawl ih Pathian, Abraham ih Pathian, Isaak le Jakob ih Pathian ka si,’ tiah a ti. Moses cu thinphang in a khur ih a zoh hman a zoh ngam lo."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa cun, ‘Na kedam phuak aw, ziangahtile na dinnak hmun hi hmun thianghlim a si!"},"34":{"text":"Izipt ramih ka minung pawl an tuarmi le an zonzaihnak ka hmu. An aihramnak ka thei ih anmah luatter dingah ka rung. Ra aw, Izipt ah ka lo thlah ding,’ tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"“Moses cu Israel mi pawl ih hnon dahmi pa a si. ‘Zo in so kan tlunah uktu le thuṭhentu-ah an lo tuah?’ tiah an rak ti. Hrambur alh sung ihsin a hnenih a langmi vancungmi ih bomnak thawngin Pathian in Israel mi uktu dingah le luattertu dingah a thlahmi a si."},"36":{"text":"Izipt ram ihsin Israel mi pawl cu a hruaisuak ih Izipt ram le Tipi Sen le ramṭhing lakah kum sawmli sung thil khawruahhar le hmuhsaknak mak tampi a tuah."},"37":{"text":"Moses cu Israel mi hnenah, ‘Pathian in nan hnenah keimah i thlah bangtuk in profet a thlah ding ih cupa cu nanmah ih miphun sung ihsin a si ding,’ tiah a rak titu pa a si."},"38":{"text":"Amah cu Israel mi pawl ramṭhingih an um laiah an lakih a tel ringringtu pa a si; kan pu le kan pa pawl lakah a rak um ih Sinai Tlangah vancungmi ṭongkam a rak sangtu le misenpi hnenih a rak umtu a si; cule Pathian thunung kan hnenih a thlen theinak dingah a rak cohlangtu a si fawn."},"39":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla kan pu le kan pa pawl in amah cu an thlun duh lo. An hnong ih Izipt ram ah vung kirsal an duh sawn."},"40":{"text":"Curuangah Aaron hnenah, ‘In hruaitu dingah khawzing tampi in in tuahsak aw. Izipt ram ihsin in hruaisuaktu Moses parah ziang a cang ti kan thei nawn ual lo,’ tiah an ti."},"41":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah cawcang hmuihmel cuangin caw lem an tuah ih rai an thawi ih an kutih an tuahcopmi hrangah upatnak puai an tuah ciamco."},"42":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian in a dungtun ih profet pawl cabu sungih ngan a si vekin vanih arsi pawl a biakter hai. Cuih cabu sungah cun: ‘Israel mi pawl, kum sawmli sung ramṭhing ah ṭilva nan that ih Raithawinak nan pekmi kha ka hnenah nan tuahmi a si lo."},"43":{"text":"Nan phurhmi thlam cu Molek khawzing puanthlam a si. Nan kenmi milem cu nan khawzing Refan ih arsi lem a si. Annih tla cu biak dingih nan tuahmi khawzing lem an si. Curuangah nannih cu Babilon lan ah ka lo dawihlo ding,’ tiah a um.","ref":"Amos 5.25-27"},"44":{"text":"“Kan pu le kan pa pawl in Thukamnak Puanthlam cu nelrawn ramṭhing ah an nei ringring. Cuih Puanthlam cu Pathian in Moses hnenih a langtermi pianhmang vekih sakmi a si."},"45":{"text":"Neh hnuah kan pu le kan pa pawl in cuih puanthlam cu an pu pa hnen ihsin an lak ih Joshua thawn an feh tikah an fehpi vivo; hmai an nor ih Pathian in a rak um ciami miphun pawl kha a dawisak ih cuih ram pawl cu an lak vivo. Puanthlam cu cutawkah David san tiang a um."},"46":{"text":"David cu Pathian hmaiah mithmai ṭha a ngah ih Jakob ih Pathian umnak hrangah inn pakhat sak thei dingah Pathian hnenah a dil."},"47":{"text":"Sikhalsehla inn a saktu ngaingai cu Solomon a si."},"48":{"text":"“Asinain Cungnungbik Pathian cu minung kutih tuahmi inn sungah a um lo; Profet pawl in hiti in an sim:"},"49":{"text":"‘Vancung hi ka tokham a si ih Leilung hi ka kepal a si, tiah Bawipa in a ti. Ka hrangah ziangbangtuk inn so sak nan tum? Ka um duhnak hmun cu khuitawk so a si?"},"50":{"text":"Hi thil hmuahhmuah a tuahtu hi Keimah ka si lo maw?’ a ti.","ref":"Isai 66.1-2"},"51":{"text":"“Nan lung a va ruh lawmmam so! Nan thinlung cu Pathian thei lo thinlung a va si lai so! Pathian thu ngai dingah nan hna a va set lawmmam ve! Nannih hi nan pupa pawl vek thotho nan si: Thlarau Thianghlim nan dodal ringring!"},"52":{"text":"Nan pupa pawl ih an hrem lomi profet pakhat tal an um maw? Pathian ih Siahhlawh fel a ra ding tiah khuahlan lai ihsin a rak phuangtu Pathian ih palai pawl an rak that. Atu-ah cuih a felmi a Siahhlawh cu nanmah in nan zuar ih nan that!"},"53":{"text":"Vancungmi in an run kenmi Pathian ih daan a saangtu cu nanmah nan si; asinain cuih daan a thlun lotu cu nanmah thotho nan si,” tiah a ti."},"54":{"text":"Khonsil upa pawl in Stefen thusimmi an theih tikah an thin a heng tuk ih an hacang an rial hnawh.","title":"Lungto In Stefen An Den That"},"55":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Stefen cu Thlarau Thianghlim in a khat ih vancung a hun zoh tikah Pathian sunlawinak le Pathian vorhlamih a dingmi Jesuh kha a hun hmu."},"56":{"text":"Cutikah, “Zohhnik uh! Van a ong aw ih Pathian vorhlamah Milai Fapa a ding ka hmu!” tiah a ti."},"57":{"text":"Cutikah Khonsil upa pawl cu an hna an kut in an phit ih an aw neih patawp in an au ih Stefen cu an zon!"},"58":{"text":"Khawpi sung ihsin an dirhsuak ih lungto in an deng. A dengtu pawl in an puan pawl cu Saul an timi tlangvalpa hnenah an retta."},"59":{"text":"Lungto in an den rero laiah Stefen cun Bawipa a ko ih, “Bawipa Jesuh, ka thlarau run la hram aw!” tiah a au."},"60":{"text":"A khuk a bilh ih, “Bawipa, an sualnak hi ciing ringring hram hlah aw!” tiah napi in a au. Cutiih a au ṭheh vete in a hnuk a cat."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih ni ihsin thokin Jerusalem ih kawhhran cu hremnak nasa zet an tuar. Tirhthlah pawl siarlo a dang zumtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu Judea ram le Samaria ram sungah an ṭhendarh aw ṭheh.","title":"Saul In Kawhhran A Hrem"},"2":{"text":"Stefen cu Pathian a ṭihzahtu ṭhenkhat in an vui ih nasa zetin an ṭah."},"3":{"text":"Asinain Saul cun kawhhran pawl siatsuah a tum; inn khat hnu inn khat a feh ih nunau mipa tilo zumtu hmuahhmuah an inn ihsin a dirsuak ih thawng ah a thlak hai."},"4":{"text":"A ṭekdarhmi zumtu pawl cu khuazakipah an thleng ih an thlennak hmunkipah Thuthang ṭha an sim.","title":"Samaria Ah Thuthangṭha A Thleng"},"5":{"text":"Filip cu Samaria khawpi ah a feh ih cuih khuami hnenah Messiah ih thuhla a sim."},"6":{"text":"Mi tampi in a thusimmi cu ṭhatein an ngai ih hmuhsaknak a tuahmi tla an hmu."},"7":{"text":"Miburpi sung ihsin khawsia pawl ringpi ih au phah in an suak ih mizeng le ke-awl pawl tla an dam."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah cuih khawpi sungah lungawinak tampi a um."},"9":{"text":"Cutawk khua ah Simon an timi pa a rak um. Caan rei nawn a mitkher thiamnak in Samaria mi pawl cu an thinlung let ko in a tuah. Keimah ka si bik tiin a ruat aw ve."},"10":{"text":"Khawpi sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah a tum a seen in a thu an ngai. Annih in, “Amah hi, ‘A Maksak mi Huham,’ timi Pathian ih cahnak a si hi!” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Caan reipi a mitkher thiamnak in an lung let ṭheh ko in a tuah ruangah a thu an thlun duhnak a si."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Filip ih thusimmi Pathian Uknak Thuthang ṭha le Jesuh Khrih ih thuhla an theih tikah an zum ih nunau siseh mipa siseh baptisma an lak."},"13":{"text":"Simon khal cun a zum ve; baptisma a lak hnuah Filip cu a thlun ih khawruahhar le hmuhsaknak thil tampi Filip ih tuahmi kha a hmuh tikah anih khal a mang a bang ngaingai."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem ih a ummi tirhthlah pawl in Samaria mi khal in Pathian thu an pom ve thlang ti an theih tikah an hnenah Piter le Johan an thlah."},"15":{"text":"An hnen an thlen tikah zumtu pawl in Thlarau Thianghlim an ngahnak dingah an hrangah thla an cam."},"16":{"text":"Ziangahtile Thlarau Thianghlim kha zo ih hnen hmanah a rung thleng hrih lo; Bawi Jesuh hminih baptisma latu lawng an si lai."},"17":{"text":"Cule Piter le Johan in an parah kut suangin thla an cam ih Thlarau Thianghlim an ngah."},"18":{"text":"Tirhthlah pawl in an kut an suan tikah zumtu pawl in Thlarau Thianghlim an ngah kha Simon in a hmu. Curuangah Piter le Johan hnenah,"},"19":{"text":"“Kei khal in an tlunih ka kut ka suanmi hmuahhmuah Thlarau Thianghlim an ngah theinak dingah hi cahnak huham i pe ve uh,” tiah ti phah in tangka a pek hai."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Piter in, “Pathian ih pekmi laksawng hi tangka thawn lei thei dingih na ruah ruangah nangmah cu na tangka thawn va hloral uh!"},"21":{"text":"Pathian mithmuh-ah na thinlung a dik lo ruangah kan hnaṭuanmi sungah na tel lo, covo khal na nei lo."},"22":{"text":"Hi bangtuk thil ṭha lo na ruah sualnak ihsin siir aw awla a lo ngaithiamnak dingah Bawipa ih hnenah thlacam aw."},"23":{"text":"Ziangahtile nahsuahnak in a khatmi le sualnak thawng sungih a tlami na si, tihi ka hmu a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cutikah Simon in Piter le Johan hnenah, “Zaangfahnak in hi nan ṭongmi pawl hi ka parih a thlen lonak dingah Pathian hnenah thla i cam sak hram uh,” tiah a dil."},"25":{"text":"Pathian thu an phuang ih an hmuhmi le an tonmi an sim hnuah Piter le Johan cu Jerusalem ah an kir sal. An kir phahah Samaria peng khawte tampi sungah Thuthang ṭha cu an sim vivo."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa ih vancungmi in Filip hnenah, “Na timtuah awla thlanglam ah Jerusalem ihsin Gaza fehnak lamzin ah vung feh aw,” tiah a ti. (Atu-ah cun hi lamzin cu an hmang nawn lo.)","title":"Filip Le Ethiopia Bawi Ih Thu"},"27":{"text":"A ti vekin a tim a tuah ih Filip cu a feh. Culai ah Ethiopia mi pakhat an khua lamih a tlungmi a tong. Cupa cu tilpermi a si ih Ethiopia siangpahrang nu ih neihmi sumsaw hmuahhmuah a kilkhawitu bawi a si. Amah cu Jerusalem ah Pathian bia dingin a feh."},"28":{"text":"A ra tlunlam ah a rangleng parah to in profet Isaiah cabu a siar."},"29":{"text":"Thlarau Thianghlim in Filip hnenah, “Feh awla khi rangleng khi va naih aw,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Filip cun a hei dawi ih profet Isaiah cabu a siar ti a thei. Filip in, “Na siarmi hi a tican na thei maw?” tiah a sut."},"31":{"text":"Cupa cun, “Zotal ih in simfiang lo ahcun ziangtinso ka theih thei ding?” tiah a sawn. Cule Filip cu a rangleng parah to ve dingin a sawm."},"32":{"text":"A siarmi Ca Thianghlim cu a tanglam vek hin a si: “Amah cu thah dingmi tuu bangin an hruai ih, Tuu faate a hmul an met laiah ai loih a um bangin, ṭong loin daitein a um."},"33":{"text":"Hmuhsuam nautatnak a tuar, ṭantu zohman a nei lo; Leitlun ihsin a nunnak an laksak ruangah, A ci thlahmi pawl sim ding zohman an um lo,” tiin a um.","ref":"Isai 53.7-8"},"34":{"text":"Cupa in Filip cu, “I sim hnik! Profet Isaiah ih a ṭongmi hi zo ih thu so a si? Amah ih thu maw, midang ih thu so?” tiah a sut."},"35":{"text":"Cutikah Filip in cuih Baibal caang ihsin thokin Bawi Jesuh Thuthang ṭha cu a sim ṭheh."},"36":{"text":"Cutiin an vung feh vivo ih tidai a umnak hmun an thleng. Cupa cun, “Hinah tidai a um. Baptisma co dingah ziangso i dawntu a um?” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"(Filip in, “Na thinlung zatein na zum ahcun baptisma co ding na si,” a ti. Cupa cun, “Ka zum; Jesuh Khrih cu Pathian Fapa a si tiah ka zum,” a ti.)"},"38":{"text":"Cuih Ethiopia pa cun a rangleng cu a dinter ih Filip thawn tidai sungah an vung ṭum ih Filip in baptisma a pek."},"39":{"text":"Tidai sung ihsin an hung suah tikah Bawipa ih Thlarau in Filip cu a lak hlo. Cuih bawi in Filip cu a hmu nawn lo; asinain lungawi zetin a inn lamah a tlung."},"40":{"text":"Filip cu Ashdod a va thleng; Sisaria ah a feh ih lamzin tluan khua kipah Thuthang ṭha cu a sim vivo."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih caan hrawngah Saul cun Bawipa ih dungthlun pawl kha that dingah a hringhro rero. Puithiam Saang hnenah a va feh ih,","title":"Paul Ih Lungthlengnak (Dung 22.6-16 ; 26.12-18)"},"2":{"text":"Damaskas khua ih sinakok inn uktu pawl in amah kha an rak theihnak dingah ca ken ding a va dil. A tumtahmi cu cutawkah Bawipa ih Lamzin a thluntu an um asile nunau mipa tilo kai tahratin Jerusalem ih hruai ding kha a si."},"3":{"text":"Saul cu Damaskas khua a thlen zikah hmakhatte ah van ihsin tleunak in a kimvelin a run tlet."},"4":{"text":"Saul cu a tlu ih, “Saul, Saul, ziangah so i hrem?” tiah aw pakhat a thei."},"5":{"text":"Saul in, “Bawipa, zoso na si?” tiah a sut. Cuih aw cun, “Na hrem reromi Jesuh ka si."},"6":{"text":"Tho awla khawpi sungah va feh aw; na tuah ṭulmi kha an lo sim ding,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Saul thawn khual a tlawngmi pawl cu an cawl ṭheh ih kam khat hman an ṭong lo; aw cu an thei naón zohman an hmu lo."},"8":{"text":"Saul cu leilung ihsin a hung tho ih a mit a hun meng, asinain zianghman a hmu thei lo. Curuangah a kut in an hruai ih Damaskas khua sungah cun an fehpi."},"9":{"text":"Ni thum sung khua a hmu thei lo; cuih ni thum sungah zianghman a ei lo, tidai khal a in lo."},"10":{"text":"Damaskas khawsungah Ananias timi dungthluntu pakhat a um. Langnak hmuhmi a nei ih cumi sungin Bawipa in, “Ananias!” tiah a ko. Anih in, “Bawipa, hinah ka um,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa in, “Na tim tuah awla Lamzin Ding timi ah va feh aw. Judas inn ah Tarsas khuami Saul timi pa a um maw, tiin va sut aw. Amah cu thla a cam lai rero;"},"12":{"text":"anih khal in langnak a hmu ih cumi langnak sungah cun a mit khua a hmuh thei salnak dingah Ananias an timi pa a rung lut ih a lu parah kut a ra suan kha a hmu,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Ananias in, “Bawipa, mi tampi in himi pa ih thuhla hi in sim zo ih Jerusalem ih na minung pawl parih thil ṭha lo a tuahmi pawl khal in sim."},"14":{"text":"Cule atu-ah puithiam upa pawl ih thuneihnak thawn nangmah a lo biatu pawl hmuahhmuah kai dingah Damaskas ah a ra thleng a si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa in a hnenah, “Va feh aw! Ziangahtile amah cu Zentail mi hnen le siangpahrang pawl hnen le Israel mi pawl hnenah ka hmin thangter dingin le ka hnaṭuan dingin ka hril zo."},"16":{"text":"Cule keimah in ka hrangih a tuar dingmi pawl cu ka hmuh ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Ananias cu a feh ih Saul umnak innah cun a va lut. Saul ih lu parah a kut suang tahrat in, “Unau pa Saul, hitawk lam na rat laiih lamzinah na hnenih a langmi Jesuh Bawipa amah rori in na hnenah i thlah. Khua na hmuh sal theinak dingah le Thlarau Thianghlim thawn na khahnak dingah na hnenah i thlah a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Saul ih mit ihsin ngakep bangtuk a si mi a tla ih khua a hmu thei sal. A tho ih baptisma an pek."},"19":{"text":"Cule rawl a ei ih thazaang a nei sal. Saul cu Damaskas khua ih dungthluntu pawl hnenah ni malte sung a um."},"20":{"text":"An pumkhawmnak sinakok inn pawlah a va feh ih Jesuh cu Pathian Fapa a si, ti thu kha a sim."},"21":{"text":"A theitu hmuahhmuah cu an mang a bang ngaingai ih, “Jerusalem ah Jesuh a zumtu pohpoh a siatsuahtu cu amah hi a si lo maw? Cuvek thothoin hitawk khalah hin cubangtuk mi cu kai tahratin puithiam upa pawl hnenih thlenpi dingah a ra thleng a si lo maw?” tiah an sut aw ruri.","title":"Damaskas Khua Ah Saul In Thu A Sim"},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Saul thusimmi cu hmual a nei deuhdeuh; Jesuh cu Messiah rori a si tiah a simmi kha mi thinlung sungah fiangtukin a luh ruangah Damaskas khua ih a ummi Judah mi pawl in a thu cu an let thei lo."},"23":{"text":"Ni tam nawn a rei tikah Judah mi pawl an tongkhawm aw ih Saul that dingah khua an khang."},"24":{"text":"Asinain cutiih an khawkhanmi cu a simtu an rak um ih Saul in a thei. Amah thah duh ah a sun a zan in khawpiih kotka pawl cu an kil."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Saul a thluntu pawl in zan khatah Saul cu bawm sungah an ret ih khawpi kulhnak hauhruang ong in a lengah an vun ṭhum."},"26":{"text":"Saul cu Jerusalem ah a feh ih dungthlun pawl lakah tel ve a tum. Asinain annih pawl cun dungthlun a si ve thlang ti kha an zum lo ih an zatein amah kha an ṭih riangri.","title":"Jerusalem Ah Saul A Thleng"},"27":{"text":"Cule Barnabas in a ṭanpi ih tirhthlah pawl hnenah a fehpi. Barnabas in an hnenah cun Damaskas lamzin ih Bawipa a tonnak le Bawipa in a hnenih a ṭongmi pawl kha fiangtein a sim. Cule Saul in Jesuh ih hmin kha Damaskas khua ah ralṭha zetin thuthang.tha a phuannak thu tla a sim."},"28":{"text":"Curuangah Saul cu an hnenah a um ih Jerusalem khawsung hmunzakip ah a feh ih ralṭha zetin Jesuh hmin in thu a sim."},"29":{"text":"Grik ṭong a hmangtu Judah mi pawl hnen tla-ah thu a sim ih thu tla an el aw, asinain annih cun a thah an tum."},"30":{"text":"Cumi cu zumtu pawl in an theih tikah Saul cu Sisaria ah an hruai ih Tarsas ah an thlah."},"31":{"text":"Cuti cun Judea ram, Galilee ram le Samaria ram sung kawhhran pawl cu hnangamte in an um. kawhhran cu Thlarau Thianghlim bomnak in a cak deuhdeuh ih mi khal an karh vivo. Pathian ṭihzah in an um."},"32":{"text":"Piter cu khuazakipah a tlawng ih voikhat cu Lidda khua ih ummi Pathian awi pawl tlawng dingah a feh.","title":"Lidda Le Joppa Ah Piter A Tlawng"},"33":{"text":"Cutawkah Aenias an timi pa a tong. Aenias cu mizeng a si ih kum riat sung ihkhun ihsin a tho thei dah lomi a si."},"34":{"text":"Piter in, “Aenias, Jesuh Khrih in a lo damter a si. Tho awla na ihphah zual aw,” tiah a ti. Hmakhatte-ah Aenias cu a tho."},"35":{"text":"Lidda le Sharon-ih a ummi hmuahhmuah in Aenias cu an hmuh ruangah Bawipa lamah an hoikir."},"36":{"text":"Joppa khua ahcun Tabitha an timi nu a um ih Jesuh zumtu a si. (A Grik hmin cu Dorkas a si ih a tican cu “Zukneng,” tinak a si.) A tikcu hmuah cu thil ṭha tuahnak ah le mifarah bomnak ah a hmang."},"37":{"text":"Cuih caanah cu nu cu besia zetin a na ih a thi. A ruak cu an kholh ih tlunta khaan ah an ret."},"38":{"text":"Joppa khua cu Lidda khua in a naite a si. Cule Joppa ih a ummi zumtu pawl in Lidda ah Piter a um ti kha an theih tikah mi pahnih an thlah ih, “Zamrang in kan hnenah ra hram aw,” tiah an cah."},"39":{"text":"Curuangah Piter cu a tim a tuah ih anmah a thlun. A va thlen tikah Piter cu tlunta khaanah cun an hruai. Cutawkah cun nuhmei pawl in an pan ciamco ih an ṭap ih Dorkas damlai-ih angki le kawtkor a tahmi pawl kha an hmuh."},"40":{"text":"Piter in khaan sung ihsin mi pawl cu a suahter ṭheh ih, a khukbil in thla a cam; cule Dorkas ruak lam a hoi ih, “Tabitha, tho aw!” tiah a ti. Dorkas cun a mit a hun meng ih Piter a hmuh tikah a hung to."},"41":{"text":"Piter in a hei dawh ih a dinter. Cule nuhmei pawl le zumtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu a kawh ih a nungzo tiin an hnenah a hmuh."},"42":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Joppa khawsung hmuahhmuah ah a thang ih mi tampi in Bawipa an zum."},"43":{"text":"Piter cu Joppa khua ah savun tuahtu Simon inn ah ni tampi sung a caam."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sisaria khua ah Kornelias an timi pa a um. Amah cu, “Italy Ralkap Burpi,” timi Rom ralkap bu uktu ralbawi bothum a si.","title":"Piter Le Kornelias"},"2":{"text":"Amah cu Pathian a ṭihzah zettu a si; a innsungsang in Pathian a bia ringringtu an si. Judah mi mifarah pawl tampi a bawm ih cat loin Pathian hnenah thla a cam ringringtu a si."},"3":{"text":"Voikhat cu zanlam nazi pathum tlukah langnak a hmu; cuih a hmuhmi ahcun Pathian ih vancungmi pakhat a hnenah a ra ih, “Kornelias!” tiah a ko."},"4":{"text":"Cuih vancungmi cu ṭih phah in a zoh ih, “Ziang so a si, Bawipa?” tiah a sut. Vancungmi cun, “Pathian cu na thlacammi le mifarah na bomnak parah hin a lung a awi ih na dilnak a thei a si."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah Joppa khua ah Simon Piter an timi pa ko dingin mi thlah aw."},"6":{"text":"Simon Piter cu Tipi kapih a ummi savun in thil tuahtu Simon ih innah a caam,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule vancungmi cu a feh; cuih hnuah Kornelias in a innih a ummi hnen-um pahnih le ralkap pakhat a ko. Ralkap pa cu biaknak lamah a taimazet le a felzetmi a si ih amah a kilvengtu lakah pakhat a si."},"8":{"text":"Thil a cangmi pawl hmuahhmuah kha a sim ṭheh hnuah Joppa khua ah a thlah hai."},"9":{"text":"A thaisun ahcun an feh vivo ih Joppa khua an thlen zik zawng sunlaifang hrawngah Piter cu thlacam dingin inn parah a hung kai."},"10":{"text":"Piter cu a ril a rawng ih rawl ei a duh; rawl an tuah rero laiah langnak a hmu."},"11":{"text":"Van khi a ong aw ih puan hlaipi bangtuk a si mi thil pakhat a kil pali in leilung ah an run ṭhummi a hmu."},"12":{"text":"A sungah ke li nei ramsa a phunphun, bokvak ramsa le vate a phunphun an um."},"13":{"text":"Aw pakhat in a hnenah, “Piter, tho aw; that awla ei aw!” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Asinain Piter in, “Bawipa, a si lo!
