A thiang lomi le a borhhlawhmi ka ei dah hrimhrim lo,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Aw cun a run sim sal ih, “Pathian in a thiang a timi cu a thiang lo-ah ruat hlah,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cumi cu voithum tiang a rung lang ih cuih hnuah cuih thil cu vanah lak kir a si."},"17":{"text":"Cuih langnak ih a tican cu Piter in a ruah rero laifangah Kornelias ih thlahmi pawl cu Simon ih inn an thleng ih kotka lengah an ding."},"18":{"text":"“hittawk ah Simon Piter timi mikhual a um maw?” tiah an vun auh."},"19":{"text":"Piter cun a hmuhmi ih tican a ruah rero laifangah Thlarau in, “Ngaihnik, mi pathum in an lo hawl!"},"20":{"text":"Na timtuah awla vung feh aw; cule an hnenih feh ding cu ṭhukṭhun in um hlah; keimah ih thlahmi an si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah Piter cu a vung ṭum ih a ra hawltu hnenah cun, “Nan hawlmi cu keimah ka si. Ziang so nan ṭul?” tiah a sut."},"22":{"text":"Annih in, “Ralbawi Kornelias in in thlah. Amah cu miṭhazet a si. Pathian a bia ih Judah mi pawl in an upat zetmi a si. Sim ding na neihmi kha thei seh tiah a inn ah nangmah lo sawm dingin Pathian ih vancungmi in a fial,” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Piter in cuih zan cu a hnenih riak hrih dingin a sawm hai ih an riak. A thaisun ah Piter cu a tim a tuah ih anmah thawn a feh; Joppa khua ih Khrih zumtu hrekkhat pawl tla an tel ve."},"24":{"text":"A tipsun ah Sisaria ah a thleng ih Kornelias cun a sungkhat pawl le a sawmmi a rualpi pawl thawn an rak hngak ringring."},"25":{"text":"Piter cu inn ih a vung luh zawng ah Kornelias in a rak hmuak ih a hmaiah a kuun ih a kehram ah a bok."},"26":{"text":"Asinain Piter in a dinter ih, “Ding aw! Kei khal minung sokhaw ka si ve,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Inn sungih an luh phahah Piter in Kornelias cu a biak phah vivo; inn sungah cun mi tampi an tong-aw khawm."},"28":{"text":"Piter in an hnenah, “Kan biaknak daan vek a si ahcun Judah mi in Zentail mi leen ding le pawl ding cu khammi a si, ti cu nan thei ṭheh. Sikhalsehla zohman mi thiang lo le mi borhhlawh-ah ruah ding a si lo ti kha Pathian in i hmuh zo."},"29":{"text":"Curuangah mi nan thlah ih in ra kawh tikah kam khat hman el loin ka ra. Ziangah in ko ti atu-ah hin i sim hnik uh,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Kornelias in, “Kan dunglam ni thum laiah, tuih tikcu hrawng zanlam nazi pathum ah ka innah thla ka cam. Hmakhatte-ah hnipuan tleu zet hrukin mi pakhat ka hmaiah a ding ih,"},"31":{"text":"‘Kornelias, Pathian in na thlacamnak a thei ih mifarah na bomnak khal a hminsin ṭheh."},"32":{"text":"Joppa ah Simon Piter an timi pa ko dingin mi thlah aw. Joppa ahcun Tipi kapih a um mi savun in thil tuahtupa Simon ih inn ah a riak,’ tiah i ti."},"33":{"text":"Curuangah hmakhatte-ah ka lo ko; cule nangmah khal in i zaangfah ih na ra. Atu-ah hitawk ah hin Pathian hmaika-ah kan zatein kan um ih Bawipa in sim dingih a lo fialmi kha ngai dingah kan lo hngak a si,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Piter cun a thok ih, “Pathian cun zozo khal bangraan tein mi a zoh a si, ti thudik kha ka thei.","title":"Piter Ih Thusimmi"},"35":{"text":"Ziangbangtuk miphun a si khalle Pathian a ṭihzah ih a hmaiah thildik a tuah a si ahcun Pathian ih pom tlak a si."},"36":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah ih Bawipa a si mi Jesuh Khrih hnenin daihnak Thuthang ṭha cu Pathian in Israel mi hnenah a pek, ti cu nan thei."},"37":{"text":"Johan in baptisma thuthang a sim hnu Galilee ihsin thokin Israel ramsung hmunzakip ah thil maksak a cangmi khal cu nan thei ṭheh."},"38":{"text":"Nazareth mi Jesuh parah ziang bangtuk in Pathian in Thlarau Thianghlim le huham a burh ti tla nan thei ṭheh. A hnenah Pathian a um ruangah hmunzakip ah feh tahrat in thil ṭha a tuah vivo ih Satan ih tuahsiatmi pawl hmuahhmuah a damter thluh."},"39":{"text":"Israel ram sungah le Jerusalem ih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah a hmutu le a theitu kanmah hi kan si. Cule amah cu thinglamtah parah an khen ih an that."},"40":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ni thumnak ni ah Pathian in thihnak ihsin a thoter sal ih kan hnenah a langter."},"41":{"text":"Mi hmuahhmuah hnenah si loin a thu theitu dingih in hrilmi pawl hnenah a langter. Thihnak ihsin a thawhsal hnuah amah thawn kan ei kan in tlang a si."},"42":{"text":"Cule mi hnenah Thuthang ṭha sim dingah le amah cu Pathian in a nungmi le a thimi parah thuṭhentu ih a tuah kha simtu dingah in fial a si."},"43":{"text":"Profet hmuahhmuah in amah ih thu cu an sim ih amah a zumtu hmuahhmuah in a hmin thawngin an sualnak ngaidam a si ding, tiah an ti,” tiah a sim."},"44":{"text":"Cutiih Piter a ṭong rero laiah a thusimmi a ngaitu hmuahhmuah parah Thlarau Thianghlim a rung thleng.","title":"Zentail Mi In Thlarau An Ngah"},"45":{"text":"Joppa ihsin Piter thawn a rami Jesuh zumtu Judah mi pawl cu Zentail mi hnen khalah Pathian in a laksawng Thlarau Thianghlim a burh ti kha an hmuh tikah an mang a bang ngaingai."},"46":{"text":"Ziangahtile cute pawl cu ṭong phun dang in an ṭong ih Pathian ih maksak zia an thangṭhat kha an theih ruangah a si. Piter in,"},"47":{"text":"“Kanmah ih kan ngah zo vekin himi pawl khal in Thlarau Thianghlim an ngah ve a si. Curuangah tidai ih baptisma la ding kha zo in so a dawn thei ding?” tiah a ti."},"48":{"text":"Curuangah Jesuh Khrih hmin in baptisma lak dingah thu a pek. Cule an hnenih caam hrih dingin Piter cu an sawm."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tirhthlah pawl le Judea ram sungih a ummi zumtu hmuahhmuah in Pathian ih thu cu Zentail mi pawl khal in an pom ngah zo, ti an thei.","title":"Piter Cu Jerusalem Kawhhran Ah"},"2":{"text":"Piter cu Jerusalem ih a thlen tikah Zentail mi pawl serhtanter a duhtu pawl in an soisel ih,"},"3":{"text":"“Serhtan lo Zentail pawl innah na riak ih an hnenah rawl tiangin na ei,” an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah Piter in thil a cangmi umtudan hmuahhmuah kha a hramthok ihsin a sim hai."},"5":{"text":"“Joppa khua ih thla ka cam laiah langnak hmuhmi ka nei. Van ihsin kil li nei puan hlaipi bangtuk a si mi thil pakhat ka kiangte-ah an run ṭhum."},"6":{"text":"A sung ṭhatein ka vun bih ih ramsa le innzuat ṭilva le a bokvak thiammi thilnung le hramlakih vate pawl ka hmu."},"7":{"text":"Cule aw ka thei ih cuih aw cun, ‘Piter, tho aw, that awla ei aw,’ tiah i ti."},"8":{"text":"Asinain kei in, ‘Bawipa, a si lo! Biaknak lamin a thiang lo timi le a borhhlawhmi rawl ka kaa sungah an lut dah kel lo,’ tiah ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutikah van ihsin aw ka thei sal ih, ‘Pathian in a thiang, a ti ciami kha nang in a thiang lo tiah ruat hlah,’ tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cuti cun voithum tiang rori a cang ih neta bikah a zatein vanah an lak kir sal."},"11":{"text":"Cuti a si laiah Sisaria ihsin an rak thlahmi mi pathum kha ka riahnak inn ah an ra thleng."},"12":{"text":"Cule zianghman nuarnak um lotein feh dingah Thlarau in i fial. Hi Joppa khua mi kan unau paruk, Jesuh zumtu pawl khal hin Sisaria ahcun in thlun ve ih kan zatein Kornelias ih inn ah kan va feh."},"13":{"text":"Kornelias in vancungmi a rung ih a innih a dinnak thu kha in sim. Cuih vancungmi cun Kornelias hnenah, ‘Joppa ah mi thlah awla a hmin ngai Simon Piter an timi pa koter aw."},"14":{"text":"Amah in thu a sim ding ih cuih a thusimmi thawngin nangmah le na innsang rundamnak nan ngah ding,’ tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cule thusim ka hun thawh ih a hramthok ih kan parih Thlarau Thianghlim a rung thlen vekin an parah Thlarau Thianghlim cu a thleng ve."},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Bawipa in, ‘Johan cun tidai thawn baptisma a lo pek; asinain nannih cu Thlarau Thianghlim thawn baptisma pek nan si ding,’ tiah a rak timi ka vun mang sal."},"17":{"text":"Pathian in Bawipa Jesuh Khrih kan zum ih kan hnenah Thlarau Thianghlim cu laksawngih in rak pek bangtuk in hi Zentail mi hnen khalah cuih laksawng cu a pek ve a si, ti cu a fiang zetmi a si. Ziangtin so kei taak ko hin Pathian cu ka kham thei ding!” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cumi an theih tikah an soiselnak cu an baang ih Pathian thangṭhat in, “Pathian in Zentail mi hnen khalah sualsir awknak le nunnak caan a pek ve a si cu!” tiah an ti."},"19":{"text":"Stefen an thah hnu hremnak a um ruangah Jesuh zumtu pawl ṭhenkhat cu khuazakip ah an ṭekdarh ṭheh. Mi tampi cu Fonisia, Saipras le Antiok tiang an thleng ih Judah mi hnen lawngah Thuthang ṭha cu an sim.","title":"Antiok Khua Ih Kawhhran"},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla zumtu ṭhenkhat cu Saipras le Sairin khua ihsin Antiok khua ah an feh ih Bawi Jesuh Khrih ih Thuthang ṭha cu Zentail mi hnen khalah an sim."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa ih huham an hnenah a um ih mi tampi in an zum ih Bawipa ih lam an pan."},"22":{"text":"Cuih thuhla cu Jerusalem khua a thleng ih Jerusalem ih kawhhran in Antiok khua ah Barnabas an hun thlah."},"23":{"text":"Barnabas cu Antiok khua a thlen tikah Pathian in mipi hnenih thlawsuah a pekzia a hmuh tikah a lung a awi ngaingai ih an thinlung zatein Bawipa an zum ih rinsantlak zumtu an si theinak dingah thazaang a pek hai."},"24":{"text":"Barnabas cu miṭhazet a si ih Thlarau Thianghlim le zumfeknak thawn a khatmi a si. Cule mi tampi Bawipa ih hnenah a hruai."},"25":{"text":"Cule Barnabas cu Saul hawl dingah Tarsas ah a feh."},"26":{"text":"Saul a hmuh tikah Antiok ah a fehpi ih kum khat sung an pahnih in kawhhran minung pawl kha an pumkhawmpi ih mi tampi an zirh. Hi Antiok khua ah hin a si dungthlun pawl cu “Khristian” tiin an kawh hmaisa bik."},"27":{"text":"Cuih caan hrawngah profet ṭhenkhat pawl cu Jerusalem ihsin Antiok ah an feh."},"28":{"text":"An lakih profet pakhat Agabas an timi pa a ding ih Thlarau huham thawn, “Leilung pumpuluk ah mangṭam a tlung ding a si,” tiah a sim. (Cuih mangṭam cu Klaudius in Rom siangpahrang a ṭuan laiah a thleng.)"},"29":{"text":"Dungthluntu pawl cun an tithei tawk ciar in Judea ramih a ummi zumtu unau pawl bomnak pe dingah an tawlrel."},"30":{"text":"An tawlrel vekin an ngahmi tangka kha Barnabas le Saul kut in kawhhran upa hnenah an kuat."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi caan hrawngah Siangpahrang Herod in kawhhran sungih Khristian ṭhenkhat pawl hrem a thok.","title":"Hremnak A Tam Sinsin"},"2":{"text":"Johan unau Jeim kha ralnam hmang-in a thahter ih,"},"3":{"text":"cumi cun Judah mi pawl an lung a awiter ti a hmuh tikah Piter khal a kaihter. (Himi cu Thilnu tello Sang Puai tuah laifangah a si.)"},"4":{"text":"Piter cu an kai ih thawngah an thlak; thawnginn kiltu ralkap bur li an um ih bur khatah ralkap pali fingfing an um; cu pawl ih kil dingin an kut sungah an pek. Lantak puai ṭheh tikah zapi hmaiah a thu cu rel dingin Herod ih tumtahmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Cuti cun Piter cu thawng sungah an ret, asinain a hrangah kawhhran pawl in Pathian hnenah napi in thla an camsak."},"6":{"text":"Herod in a thaisun mipi hmaiah Piter ih thu ka rel ding a ti ni zanah Piter cu thawnginn kiltu ralkap pahnih karlakah a it. Thir cikcin pahnih in an khih ih thawnginn kotka khal an kil ṭheh.","title":"Thawng Sungin Piter A Suak"},"7":{"text":"Rinlopi-ah Bawipa ih vancungmi a rung ding ih an ihnak khaan cu tleunak in a run tleuter. Vancungmi in Piter cu a liang in a hnin ih, “Zamrang in tho aw!” tiah a ṭhang. Hmakhatte-ah Piter ih kut ihsin thir cikcin cu an poihtla."},"8":{"text":"Cule vancungmi in, “Na taikhap khap awla na kedam dam aw,” tiah a ti. A tivek cun Piter in a tuah ih vancungmi in, “Na puan sin awla i thlun aw,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Piter cun a thlun ih thawnginn lengah an suak; vancungmi in cuti ih a tuah cu thungai a si dingah a ruat lo; langnak ka hmu a si ding, tiah a ruat aw."},"10":{"text":"Ralkap ih an kilnak kotka pakhatnak cu an lan, cule a pahnihnak tla an lan thotho. A netnak ah khawpi sung thawn a peh-awmi thir kotka an thleng. Cuih kotka cu an hrangah amahte in a ong aw ih an pahnih in an suak. Lamzin an vun zawh ih rinlopi ah vancungmi cun a hlohsan ih Piter lawng a taang."},"11":{"text":"Cutikah a parih a cangmi thil pawl cu fiangtein a hun thei ngah ih, “Atu cu a cangmi ngaingai a si ka thei zo! Herod thuneihnak sungin le Judah mi pawl in ka parih cang dingin saduh an thahmi hmuahhmuah sung ihsin runsuak dingah Bawipa in a vancungmi a run thlah a si hi!” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Thil a cangmi a theih ngah hnuah Johan Marka ih nu Mari ih inn ah a feh; cutawkah mi tampi an khawm aw ih thla an cam rero."},"13":{"text":"Piter cun a leng ihsin sangka a vun king ih Roda timi hnen-um nu cu sangka ong dingin a ra."},"14":{"text":"Piter ih aw a si ti a theih tikah a lung a awi tuk ih sangka hman ong loin, “Inn lengah Piter a ding a si!” tiah a au."},"15":{"text":"Annih in, “Na aa maw si?” tiah an ti. Sikhalsehla, a si ngaingai sokhaw, a ti ringring ruangah, “A vancungmi a si pei cu!” an ti thotho."},"16":{"text":"Piter in sangka cu cat loin a king rero. A net-ah sangka cu an ong ih Piter a si kha an hmuh tikah an mang a bang ngaingai."},"17":{"text":"Piter cun daiteih um dingin a zaa a zaap ih, Bawipa in thawng sung ihsin a suahnak thuhla kha an hnenah a sim. “Hi thu hi Jeim le a dang zumtu pawl sim uh,” tiah a ti ih a suak ih hmun dangah a feh."},"18":{"text":"Zinglam khua a van tikah thawnginn kiltu ralkap pawl cu, Piter ziang a cang a si pei, tiah an buai nasa."},"19":{"text":"Piter hawl dingah Herod in thu a pek; asinain an hmu lo. Curuangah thawnginn kiltu pawl cu an thu a zingzoiter ih that dingin thu a pek. Cuih hnuah Judea ram ihsin Herod cu a suak ih Sisaria khua ah caan tawkfang a hmang."},"20":{"text":"Herod cu Tai-ar le Sidon mi pawl parah a thin a heng ngaingai; curuangah cuih khuami pawl cu Herod tong dingah a bur in an feh. A hmaisabik ah siangpahrang innih hotu bik Blastas kha an hnenih ṭang dingin an sawm. Cule Herod hnenah cun an va feh ih daihnak le remnak tuah dingin an va dil. Ziangah cutiin an dil tile an rammi pawl ih rawl an ngahmi cu Herod siangpahrang ukmi ram sung ihsin a rat ruangah a si.","title":"Herod A Thi"},"21":{"text":"An ni tinh ni ah Herod cu a siangpahrang thilthuam in a thuam aw ih a tokham ah a to ih mipi hnenah thu a sim."},"22":{"text":"Cutikah mipi in, “Hitiih a ṭongtu hi milai a si ual lo, pathian a sisi!” tiah an au."},"23":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah Bawipa ih vancungmi in Herod cu natsiava in a natter, ziangahtile Pathian kha upatnak a pek lo ruangah a si. Herod cu a rulkhuk in a sunglam an ei thluh ih a thi."},"24":{"text":"Pathian ih thu cu a zai ih a ṭhang vivo."},"25":{"text":"Barnabas le Saul cu an hnaṭuan dingmi an ṭuan ṭheh ruangah Jerusalem ihsin Johan Marka an hruai ih an kir."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Antiok khua kawhhran sungah profet le saya ṭhenkhat an um. Anmah tla cu Barnabas, Simeon (Midum ti tla in an ti), (Sairin khua mi) Lusias, (Mangki Herod thawn a ṭhang tlangtu) Minian le Saul an si.","title":"Barnabas Le Saul An Thlah"},"2":{"text":"Anmah pawl cu Pathian bia in rawl an ulh laiah Thlarau Thianghlim in, “Barnabas le Saul hi ka thiahmi hnaṭuan lawng ṭuan dingah thiadang uh,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Rawl ul in thla an cam hnuah an lu parah an kut an suang ih Barnabas le Saul cu an hei thlah."},"4":{"text":"Thlarau Thianghlim in a thlah hai bangtuk in Barnabas le Saul cu Seleusia ah an feh ih cutawk ihsin tangphawlawng in Saipras tikulh ah an lan.","title":"Saipras An Thleng"},"5":{"text":"Salamis khua an thlen tikah Judah mi pawl ih sinakok ah Pathian thu an sim. An hnaṭuan bawmtu dingah Johan Marka an hruai."},"6":{"text":"Saipras tikulh sung an tlawng vivo ih Pafos khua tiang an thleng. Cutawk ah mitkher thiam Bar-Jesuh an timi an tong. Amah cu Judah mi, profet a ti awmi a si."},"7":{"text":"Amah cu Saipras tikulh uktu Mangki Serzias Paulas ih rualpi a si. Serzias Paulas cu mifim zet a si. Pathian thu theih a duh ruangah Barnabas le Saul cu a hnenah a ko."},"8":{"text":"Asinain mitkher thiam Elimas in a ngaih lo; (Elimas ti cu a Grik hmin a si.) Serzias Paulas kha an simmi zum lo dingin a forh ciamco."},"9":{"text":"Cule Saul, Paul ti tla in an kawhmi, cu Thlarau Thianghlim in a khat ih Paul in mitkher thiam pa cu hmaiton tein a zoh ih,"},"10":{"text":"“Nang Satan fapa! Thilṭha hmuahhmuah a dodaltu cu nangmah na si. Mi bumnak ṭha lo a phunphun in na khat ih Bawipa ih thudik hi thuphan ih canter ding lawnglawng na zuam a si."},"11":{"text":"Atu rori-ah hin Bawipa ih kut cu na parah a rung thleng ding, na mit a caw ding ih tawkfang sung cu sun khawvang na hmu lo ding,” tiah a ti. Hmakhatte-ah Elimas ih mit cu mero dum in a khuh ih amah hruaitu ding hawl ah mitcaw cingin a vak rero."},"12":{"text":"Cutiih a cangmi cu Mangki bawipa in a hmuh tikah zumtu-ah a cang; ziangahtile Bawipa ih thuhla an zirhmi ah a mang a bang ngaingai."},"13":{"text":"Paul le a rualpi pawl cu tangphawlawng in Pafos ihsin an feh ih Pamfilia ram Perga khua an thleng. Cutawk ihsin Johan Marka in a kirsan ih Jerusalem ah a tlung.","title":"Pisidia Ram Antiok Khua An Thleng"},"14":{"text":"Perga ihsin an feh sal ih Pisidia ram Antiok khua an thleng. Cutawkah Sabbath ni ah sinakok ah an feh ih an to."},"15":{"text":"A khawmmi pawl in Moses Daan cabu le profet pawl ih nganmi cabu an siar hnuah sinakok hotu pawl in, “Unau pawl, kan mipi hrangah thapeknak ṭongkam sim ding nan neih asile in sim uh,” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Paul cu a ding ih a kut hawi phah in thusim a thok: “Ka phunpi Israel mi le hitawk ih Pathian a ra biami Zentail mi hmuahhmuah tla, i ngai uh!"},"17":{"text":"Israel ih Pathian in kan pu le kan pa pawl a hril ih Izipt ramih an um laiah miphun tumpi ah a tuah. Cuih Pathian cun Izipt ram ihsin a maksak mi a huham thawn a suah hai ih,"},"18":{"text":"nelrawn ramṭhing lakah kum sawmli sung a zoh, a kilkhawi hai a si."},"19":{"text":"Kanaan ramih a rak ummi miphun phun sarih kha a siatsuah ṭheh ih amah ih miphun Israel mi cu ram luahtu ah a tuah."},"20":{"text":"Hitiih thil a cangmi hi kum zali le sawmnga sung a rei. Cuih hnuah profet Samuel san a thlen hlan sung Thuṭhentu pawl a ret."},"21":{"text":"Cule Israel mi pawl in siangpahrang an dil ih Pathian in kum sawmli sung an siangpahrang si dingah Benjamin hrin sungin Kish ih fapa Saul a pek hai."},"22":{"text":"Cun Saul a dawihlo hnuah Pathian in David kha an siangpahrang ah a tuah. David thu cu Pathian in hiti in a ti: ‘Jesse ih fapa David cu ka mi duhzawng a si. Ka tuahter duhmi hmuahhmuah kha a tuah ding a si,’ tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cule David ih tesinfa Jesuh cu a rak kam cia vekin Pathian in Israel mi pawl Rundamtu dingah a tuah."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh ih hnaṭuan a thok hlan deuh ah, Johan in Israel mi hmuahhmuah hnenah an sual sir aw ding le baptisma la dingah thu a sim."},"25":{"text":"Cule Johan in a hnaṭuan a ṭuan ṭheh zik zawng ah mipi hnenah, ‘Zo a si tiin so in ti?’ tiah a sut. ‘Nan hngak reromi cu kei ka si lo! Asinain ngai uh! Amah cu keimah hnuah a ra ding ih kei cu a kedam hri phoihtu ding hmanah ka tlak lo,’ tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Ka phunpi Israel mi, Abraham ih tesinfa pawl le hitawk ih Pathian a ra biatu Zentail mi pawl, hi rundamnak Thuthang hi kan zate hrangih pekmi a si."},"27":{"text":"Ziangahtile Jerusalem ih a rak ummi mipi pawl le an hotu pawl in Jesuh cu Rundamtu a si tiah an rak thei lo. Profet pawl ih rak nganmi thu Sabbath tinte in an siarmi khal a tican an thei lo. Asinain Jesuh an thahnak in profet pawl ih ṭongkam kha an kimter a si."},"28":{"text":"Cule annih in Jesuh an thah theinak dingah thuhla an hawl rero naón, an hawl thei lo ruangah Pilat hnenah thahnak thu pe ding in an dil."},"29":{"text":"Cun Ca Thianghlim in a thuhla a rak sim ciami hmuahhmuah kha an tuah ṭheh hnuah thinglamtah par ihsin an ṭhum ih thlaan ah an phum."},"30":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in thihnak ihsin a thoter sal ih,"},"31":{"text":"amah thawn Galilee ihsin Jerusalem tiang khual a tlawngtu pawl hnenah ni tampi sung a lang. Atu-ah Amah ih ai-ah cupawl cu Israel mi hnenah thutheitu an si."},"32":{"text":"Cuih Thuthang ṭha cu atu-ah nan hnenah kan rak keng. Pathian in kan pupa pawl hnenih thu a rak kammi cu atu an tesinfa kannih hnenah hin Jesuh thihnak ihsin a thoter salnak thawngin a kimter zo a si. Cumi cu Saam pahnihnak sungah: ‘Nangmah cu ka Fapa na si, tuihsun ah na Pa ka si zo,’ tiin a um.","merge":"33","ref":"Saam 2.7"},"34":{"text":"Cule Jesuh cu thlaan sungah a thu-ralta lo ding ih a thosal ding ti thu-ah Pathian in hiti in a sim cia. ‘David hnenih kam ciami a thianghlimmi thluasuahnak cu nanmah hnenah ka lo pe ding,’ tiah a ti.","ref":"Isai 55.3"},"35":{"text":"Cule hmun dang khalah, ‘A thianghlimmi na siahhlawh cu thlaan sungah na ziamralter siang lo ding,’ tiah a ti.","ref":"Saam 16.10"},"36":{"text":"Ziangahtile David cu amah ih san sungah Pathian duhmi hna a ṭuan ve naón, a thih tikah a pu le a pa hnenah an phum ih a taksa cu thlaan sungah a ziamta a si."},"37":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in thlaan ihsin a thawhter mipa-ih parah cun cubangtuk in a si lo."},"38":{"text":"Ka phunpi Israel pawl, nan zatein fiang zetih nan theih a ṭul mi cu: Jesuh hmin in sual ngaidamnak thuthang nan hnenah phuan a si; nan sualnak sung ihsin Moses ih Daan in a lo luatter thei lo, asinain Jesuh a zumtu hmuahhmuah cu an sualnak sung ihsin an luat a si, tihi nan theih a ṭul.","merge":"39"},"40":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah ralring uh, a tanglamih profet pawl ih an rak simmi hi nan parah a kim pang ding. Profet pawl in:"},"41":{"text":"‘Zohhnik uh! Nannih mi hnihsan hmang pawl: Mangbang thinphang uhla thi ta uh! Ziangahtile tuihsun ih ka tuahmi hi, mi in nan hnenih an simfiang hmanah nan zum duh lo dingmi thil an si,’ tiin an sim,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Hab 1.5"},"42":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas cu sinakok ihsin an suak ih mipi pawl cun hmai Sabbath ni ih ra sal dingin le cuih Thuthang ra sim sal dingin an sawm."},"43":{"text":"Mipi pumkhawmnak ihsin an ṭiak hnuah Paul le Barnabas cu Judah mi tampi le Judah biaknak ih a lutmi Zentail mi tampi in an thlun. Tirhthlah pawl in an hnenah thu an sim ih Pathian zaangfahnak sungih nung ringring dingin thazaang an pek hai."},"44":{"text":"A hmaizarh Sabbath ni ah mi tampi, khawsung mi hmuahhmuah titlak in Pathian thu theih duh ah an ra suak."},"45":{"text":"Cumi cu Judah mi pawl in an hmuh tikah an nahsuak ih Paul ih thusimmi cu an el ih an hmuhsuam."},"46":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul le Barnabas cun ralṭha sinsin in thu an sim. “Pathian thu nan hnenih sim hmaisa ding cu a ṭulmi a si. Sikhalsehla nannih in nan duh lo, nan el ih kumkhua nunnak ngah ding tlak ih nan ruat awk lo ruangah kan lo tlansan ding ih Zentail mi hnenah kan feh ding."},"47":{"text":"Ziangahtile Bawipa ih thukham in pekmi cu hiti in a si: ‘Leilung pumpuluk hi rundam a sinak dingah, nannih cu Zentail mi hrangah tleunak ah ka lo tuah zo a si,’ a ti,” tiah an ti."},"48":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Zentail mi pawl in an theih tikah an lung a awi ngaingai ih Bawipa ih Thuthang ṭha cu an sunloih zet. Cule kumkhua nunnak hrangih hrilmi pawl cu zumtu-ah an cang."},"49":{"text":"Bawipa ih thu cu cuih ramsung hmunkipah a thang."},"50":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Judah mi pawl in khawsungih upa pawl le Pathian awitu upat tlak Zentail nunau pawl kha an tokhrok ih cu pawl cun Paul le Barnabas cu an hrem ih an peng sung ihsin an dawihlo."},"51":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas cun an parih lungkim lonak langternak ah an ke ih leidip kha an thingta ih Ikoniam ah an feh."},"52":{"text":"Antiok khua ih dungthlun pawl cu lungawinak le Thlarau Thianghlim in an khat."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cubangtuk thotho in Ikoniam khua khalah Paul le Barnabas cu sinakok ah an va feh ih nasa zetin thu an sim. Judah mi le Zentail mi tampi zumtu-ah an cang.","title":"Ikoniam Khua An Thleng"},"2":{"text":"Asinain a zum duh lotu Judah mi pawl in Zentail mi pawl kha an tokhrok ih zumtu pawl kha an dodalter."},"3":{"text":"Tirhthlah pahnih cu cutawkah reipi an um ih ralṭha zetin Bawipa ih thu an sim rero. Bawipa ih zaangfahnak thu an simmi a dik a si, ti langternak ah Bawipa in hmuhsaknak mak le khawruahhar thil tuah theinak huham a pek hai."},"4":{"text":"Khawsung mi pawl cu an ṭhen aw ṭheh. Mihrek in Judah mi an ṭan ih mihrek in tirhthlah pawl an ṭan."},"5":{"text":"Cule Zentail mi ṭhenkhat le Judah mi ṭhenkhat in an hotu pawl thawn tirhthlah pawl tuahsiat ding le lungto in deng dingah thu an relcat."},"6":{"text":"Cumi cu tirhthlah pawl in an theih tikah Likaonia ram sungih Listra khua, Derbe khua le a kiangkap ram pawl ah an tlan."},"7":{"text":"Cutawkah Thuthang ṭha cu an sim."},"8":{"text":"Listra khua ah mizeng pakhat, suahkeh ke-awl ih voikhat hman a feh thei dah lo pa a um.","title":"Listra Le Derbe Khua Ah"},"9":{"text":"Paul thusimnak ahcun a to ih a thusim cu a ngai. Paul in a thusimmi kha cupa in a zum ih damnak a ngah thei ti a hmuh tikah hmaitontein a zoh ih,"},"10":{"text":"ringzet in, “Tho awla dingtein hung ding aw!” tiah a ti. Cupa cu a hung khir ih a feh thei!"},"11":{"text":"Cutiih Paul ih a tuahmi cu mipi in an hmuh tikah anmah Likaonia ṭong in, “Khawzing pawl minung bangtuk ah an cang ih kan hnenah an rung a si hi!” tiah an au ciamco."},"12":{"text":"Barnabas kha an khawzing Zeus hmin an pek ih Paul cu a ṭong biktu a si ruangah an khawzing Hermes hmin an pek."},"13":{"text":"An khuahnar ah an khawzing Zeus ih biakinn a um; cutawkih puithiam in cawcang pawl le pangpar pawl kotka ah a run keng, ziangahtile amah le mipi pawl in tirhthlah pawl hnenah raithawinak pek an duh ruangah a si."},"14":{"text":"Cutiih tuah an tummi cu Barnabas le Paul in an theih tikah an hnipuan an thlek ih mipi lakah au phah in an tlan vivo."},"15":{"text":"“Hitiin ziangah so nan tuah tum? Kannih hi nanmah bangtuk milai kan si ve! A ṭhahnem lomi thil nan tuahnak ihsin lei le van le tipithuanthum le a sungih ummi hmuahhmuah a tuahtu Pathian nung hnenih nan kirnak dingah Thuthang ṭha sim dingin kan ra a si."},"16":{"text":"Hlanlaiah cun Pathian in zozo khal an duhmi lamzin thlun dingin a on."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla thilṭha a tuahmi in amah a um ti kha a langter ringring a si: van ihsin ruah a surter ih a tikcu caan ah thlaici kho a umter; tirawl a lo pek ih nan thinlung hnangam in a tuah a si,” tiah an ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutiin an sim hnu hmanah raithawinak tuah lo dingah tirhthlah pawl in misenpi cu har zetin an kham thei ceu."},"19":{"text":"Judah mi ṭhenkhat Pisidia ram Antiok khua in le Ikoniam khua ihsin an ra ih miburpi kha anmah lam ṭang dingin an sawm ngah hnuah Paul cu lungto in an deng; a thi zo tiah an ruat ih hnarpawn ah an hnuk ih an taan."},"20":{"text":"Sikhalsehla dungthluntu pawl a kiangah ding in an tonkhawm awk tikah a tho ih khawsungah a feh sal. A thaisun ah Barnabas thawn Derbe khua ah an feh."},"21":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas in Thuthang ṭha cu Derbe khua ah an sim ih dungthluntu tampi an ngah. Cuih hnuah Listra khua, Ikoniam khua le Pisidia peng Antiok khua ah an kir.","title":"Siria Ram Antiok Khua Ah An Kir"},"22":{"text":"Zumtu pawl kha tha an pek phah vivo ih zumnak sungah rintlak zetin um dingin an forh vivo. “Pathian Uknak sung lut ding kan si ahcun harsatnak tampi kan ton ding hrimhrim a si,” tiah an zirh vivo."},"23":{"text":"Kawhhran umnak poh ah kawhhran upa an ret vivo ih thlacam le rawl-ul in an rinsanmi an Bawipa hnenah hlannak an tuahta vivo."},"24":{"text":"Pisidia ram an lan ṭheh hnuah Pamfilia ram an thleng."},"25":{"text":"Thuthang ṭha Perga khua ah an sim ih cuih hnuah Attalia khua ah an vung feh."},"26":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin lawng in Antiok khua ah an kir. Antiok khua cu atu-ih an ṭhehmi an hnaṭuan ṭuan dingah Pathian hnenih an rak pek awknak khua kha a si."},"27":{"text":"Antiok khua an thlen tikah kawhhran senpi pawl an kokhawm ih Pathian in anmah a hmanzia le Zentail mi pawl Pathian thu zum dingih lamzin a on sakzia pawl an sim."},"28":{"text":"Cutawkah zumtu pawl thawn reipi an um tlang."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat Judea ram ihsin Antiok khua ah an ra ih, “Moses Daan ih in fial bangtuk in serh nan tan lo ahcun rundamnak nan ngah thei lo ding,” tiah zumtu unau pawl an zirh ciamco.","title":"Jerusalem Ih Thurel Khawmnak"},"2":{"text":"Cuih thu cu Paul le Barnabas in nasa zetin an el; cule a netnak ah hi thu-ah hin tirhthlah pawl le kawhhran upa pawl thawn Jerusalem ih vung tong aw dingin Paul le Barnabas le Antiok khua ih upa dang pawl an fial."},"3":{"text":"An feh zawng ah kawhhran pawl in an thlah. Cule Fawnisia le Samaria ram an pal phah ih cutawkah Zentail mi pawl ziang bangtuk in Pathian lamah an lung an thleng zo ti kha an theihter phah vivo. Cuih thu an theih tikah zumtu pawl cu an lung a awi ngaingai."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem an thlen tikah kawhhran le tirhthlah pawl le kawhhran upa pawl in an rak hmuak ih a rak hmuaktu pawl hnenah cun Pathian ih hnaṭuannak kha kimtein an sim."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Farasi pawl sungih a telmi zumtu hrekkhat pawl cun, “Zentail mi pawl cu serh an tan hrimhrim a ṭul ih Moses Daan thlun dingin kan sim a ṭul a si,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah tirhthlah pawl le kawhhran upa pawl cu cuih thu ruat dingah an tong aw khawm."},"7":{"text":"Caan reipi an el awk hnuah Piter a ding ih, “Ka u le ka nau tla, nan theih zo vekin kei hi nanmah lak ihsin Zentail mi pawl in Thuthang ṭha an theih ih an zum thei venak dingah Thuthang ṭha an hnenih sim dingah Pathian in i hrilnak a rei zo."},"8":{"text":"Cule mi hmuahhmuah ih ruahnak a thei ṭhehtu Pathian in Zentail mi pawl khal a pom a si; cuih a pomnak cu kan hnenih Thlarau Thianghlim in pek vekin an hnen khalah Thlarau Thianghlim a peknak in a langter zo."},"9":{"text":"Pathian in anmah le kanmah karlakah thleidannak zianghman a nei lo; an zum ruangah an sualnak khal a ngaidam a si."},"10":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah ziangah so kan pu le kan pa pawl in siseh, kanmah khal in siseh kan phurh thei lomi thilrit cu zumtu pawl ih zaang parah suang tahratin Pathian cu hniksak nan duh?"},"11":{"text":"Asilo! Kannih hi anmah vek thotho in zumnak kan nei ih Bawipa Jesuh ih zaangfah thinpemnak thawngin rundamnak kan ngah a si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas khal in Pathian in anmah hmangin Zentail mi lakah hmuhsaknak mak le khawruahhar a phunphun a tuahmi hmuahhmuah kha an sim tikah an zatein dai khepkhep in an ngai."},"13":{"text":"An sim ṭheh tikah Jeim a ding ih, “Ka u le ka nau tla, i ngaihnik uh!"},"14":{"text":"Simon in atute ih a ṭong zomi cu nan thei. Zentail mi pawl khal Pathian in an zawn a ruat ih anmah lak ihsin minung hrekkhat cu Amah ih ta si dingah a hril a si, tiah a simfiang zo."},"15":{"text":"Profet pawl khal in hivek thothoin an rak sim zo. Ca Thianghlim in:"},"16":{"text":"‘Bawipa in, himi hnuah, Ka ra kir sal ding ih A tlu zomi David ih uknak cu ka tung sal ding. A siatbal mi cu ka sak ding ih ka cakter sal ding."},"17":{"text":"Cuti cun leilung tlun miphun hmuahhmuah ka hnenah an ra ding; Ka hril ciami Zentail mi hmuahhmuah khal an ra ding."},"18":{"text":"Khuahlan lai ihsin hi thu a theitertu Bawipa in a ti,’ tiah a ti.","ref":"Amos 9.11-12"},"19":{"text":"Curuangah kei ka ruahnak ahcun: Pathian a pantu Zentail mi pawl hi hnaihnawhnak pe hlah uhsi."},"20":{"text":"Cuhnakin an hnenah milem biaknak rawl thiang lo ei lo dingin le nupa sualnak tuah lo dingin le hngawngrek-ih thahmi sa le sathi pohpoh ei lo dingin ca kuat sawn uhsi."},"21":{"text":"Ziangahtile Sabbath tinte in sinakok ah Moses Daan cu kum reipi sung siar a si zo ih Pathian thu khal khawkip ah sim a si zo,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cule tirhthlah pawl, kawhhran upa pawl le kawhhran zate in anmah sung ihsin mi ṭhenkhat hril tahratin Paul le Barnabas thawn Antiok khua ih thlah dingah an rel. Anmah lakah zumtu pawl in an upat zetmi pahnih, Barsabbas ti khal in an kawhmi Judas le Silas an hril ih,","title":"Zumtu Zentail Pawl Hnenih Cakuat"},"23":{"text":"a tanglamih ca kuat hi an kut ah an pek: “Nan unau a si mi kannih tirhthlah pawl le kawhhran upa pawl in Antiok le Siria le Silisia ih a ummi Zentail unau pawl nan zate hnenah cibai kan lo buk."},"24":{"text":"Hitawkih kan pawl sung ihsin nan hnen a ra thlengmi ṭhenkhat in an ṭongkam in harsatnak an lo pek ih an lo buaiter ti kan thei. Hitiih an ra ṭong tikah kannih ih kan fialmi an si lo."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah kan tong-aw khawm ih kanmah sung ihsin hrilmi palai nan hnenah kan hun thlah."},"26":{"text":"Kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih hnaṭuannak hrangah nunnak tiangin a pe ngamtu kan duhdawtmi Paul le Barnabas thawn an hung ding."},"27":{"text":"Cuti cun Judas le Silas nan hnenah kan hun thlah ih anmah in hi ca sungih kan nganmi hi an lo sim ding."},"28":{"text":"Thlarau Thianghlim le kannih lungkim tlangnak kan nei ih hi a tanglam ih a ṭulmi daan pawl siarlo a dang thilrit nan parih ret ding kan duh lo:"},"29":{"text":"Milem biaknak rawl nan ei lo pei; sathi nan ei lo pei; hngawngrek-ih thahmi sa nan ei lo pei; cule nupa sualnak nan tuah lo pei. Himi pawl tuah loin nan hrial thei a si ahcun a ṭha thluh ding. Damte in um hram uh,” tiah an ngan."},"30":{"text":"An thlahmi an palai pawl cu an feh ih Antiok an thleng. Cutawkih zumtu pawl hmuahhmuah cu an ko khawm ih an kenmi cakuat cu an pek."},"31":{"text":"Cumi an siar tikah mipi thapeknak ca a si ruangah an lung a awi ngaingai."},"32":{"text":"Judas le Silas anmah khal cu profet an si ih mipi hnenah ralṭhatnak le thacahnak thu reipi an sim."},"33":{"text":"Cutawkih tawkfang an um hnuah zumtu pawl in hnangamte in an thlah ih anmah a hun thlahtu kawhhran hnenah an kir sal."},"34":{"text":"(Sikhalsehla Silas cu cunah a taangta.)"},"35":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas cu tawkfang sung Antiok ah an um ih midang tampi thawn Pathian thu an zirh ih an sim."},"36":{"text":"Malte a rei deuh hnuah Paul in, “Bawipa ih thu kan rak simnak ah khan feh sal uhsila khawkip ih unau pawl kan va tlawng sal pei ih an umtlandan kan va zoh sal pei,” tiah Barnabas cu a ti.","title":"Paul Le Barnabas An ṭhen Aw"},"37":{"text":"Barnabas in Johan Marka kha an hnenah fehter a duh."},"38":{"text":"Asinain Paul in Johan Marka hruai ding cu a ṭha tiin a ruat lo, ziangahtile Johan Marka cun an khualtlawnnak a net tiang thlun loin Pamfilia ihsin a kirsan hai ruangah a si."},"39":{"text":"Cuih thu-ah cun Paul le Barnabas cu napi-in an el aw ih an ṭhen aw. Barnabas in Marka cu a hruai ih Saipras ah lawng in an feh."},"40":{"text":"Paul in Silas a hruai ih zumtu pawl in Bawipa ih zaangfahnak thawn va feh hram uhlaw tiah an thlahta."},"41":{"text":"Paul le Silas cu Siria ram le Silisia ram sung an pal phah ih kawhhran pawl kha tha an pek phah vivo."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul cu Derbe khua le Listra khua a va thleng; cutawkah dungthlun a si mi Timote a um. A nu cu Judah mi a si ih Khristian a si ve, a pa cu Grik mi a si.","title":"Paul Le Silas Hnenah Timote A Feh"},"2":{"text":"Listra khua le Ikoniam khua ih a ummi zumtu pawl in Timote cu an porhzet."},"3":{"text":"Paul in Timote cu hruai a duh ruangah a serh a tanter. Ziangahtile cutawk khawsungih a ummi Judah mi pawl in Timote ih pa cu Grik mi a si ti kha an theih ṭheh ruangah a si."},"4":{"text":"Khua pakhat hnu pakhat an thleng vivo ih Jerusalem khua ih tirhthlah pawl le kawhhran upa pawl in an relcatmi daan pawl kha zumtu pawl hnenah an sim vivo ih thlun ding khalah an forh."},"5":{"text":"Curuangah kawhhran pawl cu zumnak lamah an cak deuhdeuh ih ni khat hnu ni khat minung an tam sinsin."},"6":{"text":"Asia ram sungih Thuthang ṭha sim dingah Thlarau Thianghlim in a on lo ruangah Frizia le Kalatia ram sungah khual an tlawng.","title":"Paul In Langnak A Hmu"},"7":{"text":"Misia ramri an thleng ih Bithinia ramsung luh an tum, asinain Jesuh ih Thlarau in a on lo."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah Misia ram cu an lan ih Troas khua ah an feh."},"9":{"text":"Cuih zanah Paul in langnak a hmu ih cuih a hmuhmi ahcun Masidonia mi pakhat ding tahratin, “Masidonia ah ra awla in ra bawm aw,” tiah zaangfah a dil."},"10":{"text":"Paul ih langnak a hmuh ṭheh vete in Masidonia ih feh dingah kan tim kan tuah, ziangahtile cutawk mi pawl hnenih Thuthang ṭha sim dingah Pathian in in ko a si tiah kan zum."},"11":{"text":"Troas ihsin lawng in kan feh ih Samothrace ah dingtein kan feh; cule a thaisun ah Neapolis kan thleng.","title":"Filipi Ah Lydia Lungthlengnak"},"12":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin leilung in Filipi khua kan thleng. Filipi khua cu Masidonia ram sungih peng pakhatnak ih khawpi a si. Rom ih ukmi khua a si fawn. Cutawkah ni tampi kan caam."},"13":{"text":"Sabbath ni ah khawpi ihsin tivakap ah kan feh; cutawkah Judah mi pawl hmun khatih thlacamnak hmun a um ding tiah kan ruat. Kan to ih cutawkih a rami nunau pawl thawn, thu kan ruah aw."},"14":{"text":"An lakih pakhat, kan thu a ngaitu cu Thiatira khuami Lydia a si ih amah cu puan sendup zuartu a si. Amah cu Pathian a biatu a si ih Paul thusimmi kha ṭhateih ngai dingah Bawipa in Lydia ih thinlung sangka a on."},"15":{"text":"Amah le a innsungsang pawl baptisma an lak ṭheh hnuah, Lydia in, “Bawipa a zum taktak tiih in ruat asile ka inn ah ra caam ve hram uh!” tiah in sawm. Cutiin in sawm suak ih kan va feh."},"16":{"text":"Ni khatah thlacamnak hmunih kan feh laiah, khawsia polhmi hmailam thu a simsung theitu sal nunau pakhat in in rak hmuak. Hmailam thu a simsungnak in a bawi pawl hrangah tangka tampi a ngah.","title":"Filipi Thawng Sungah"},"17":{"text":"Paul le kanmah cu in thlun vivo ih, “Himi pawl hi Cungnungbik Pathian ih sal an si! Rundamnak thu nan hnenah an phuang a si!” tiah a au vivo."},"18":{"text":"Cuti cun ni tampi sung a tuah ih a netnak ah Paul cu a thin-ai a thok ih a dunglet hoi tahratin a khawsia hnenah cun, “Hi nu sung ihsin suak dingah Jesuh ih hmin in thu ka lo pek!” tiah a ti. Hmakhatteah a khawsia cu a suak."},"19":{"text":"Amah a neitu pawl in tangka an ngah theinak lamzin a um nawn lo ti kha an theih tikah Paul le Silas cu an kaih ih thuneitu bawi pawl hnenah miburpi tonkhawmnak hmunah an dirh."},"20":{"text":"Rom Acozah bawi thuṭhentu pawl hmaiah an hruai ih, “Himi pawl hi Judah mi phun an si ih kan khawsungah buainak an suahter."},"21":{"text":"Kan daan thawn a kaih-aw lomi daan an zirh; kannih cu Rom Acozah minung kan si ih hi an zirhmi daan hi kan pom thei lo, a thlun khal kan thlun lo,” tiah an ti."},"22":{"text":"Cule misenpi pawl khal Paul le Silas a huatu ah an tel ve. Cuih hnuah Acozah bawi thuṭhentu pawl in Paul le Silas ih hnipuan cu an dirhthleksak ih vuak dingah thu an pek."},"23":{"text":"Besiazet ih an vuak hnuah thawng sungah an khum ih thawnginn uktu pa cu ṭhateih tawh hren dingin thu an pek."},"24":{"text":"Cuih thupekmi a ngah vekin thawnginn uktu pa in Paul le Silas cu thawnginn sungta khaan sungah a vun khum ih a rit zetmi thingtum pahnih in hreng a sut."},"25":{"text":"Zanṭim hrawngah Paul le Silas cu thla an cam ih Pathian thangṭhatnak hla an sak; cule thawngtla dang pawl in an rak ngai."},"26":{"text":"Rinlopi-ah nasa zetin ling a hnin ih thawnginn cu a tawhram tiangin a hnin ṭheh. Hmakhatte-ah sangka pawl an ong aw ṭheh ih thawngtla pawl hmuahhmuah ih kut khihnak thir cikcin cu an phoih aw ṭheh."},"27":{"text":"Thawnginn uktu cu a ṭhang ih thawnginn sangka pawl a ong ṭheh ti a hmuh tikah thawngtla pawl an tlan thluh zo tiin a ruat ih, a ralnam zuuk tahratin amah le amah thah awk a tum."},"28":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul cu a aw neih patawp in a au ih, “Nangmah le nangmah tuahmawh aw hlah! Kan zatein kan um thluh ko,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Thawnginn kiltu pa cun meisa rak keng uh, a ti ih thawnginn sungah zamrangin a lut ih khur phah rero in Paul le Silas kehram ah a bok."},"30":{"text":"Cule lengah a hruai hai ih, “Ka bawipale pawl, rundamnak ngah dingah ziangso ka tuah ding?” tiah a sut."},"31":{"text":"Annih in, “Bawi Jesuh zum awla nangmah le nan sungte in rundamnak nan ngah ding,” tiah an ti."},"32":{"text":"Cule Pathian thu cu amah le a innsang zate hnenah an sim."},"33":{"text":"Cuih zan rori-ah cun thawnginn uktu pa in a fehpi hai ih an hmaa pawl cu a buah sak; cule cuvete in amah le a innsang zatein baptisma an lak."},"34":{"text":"Cun Paul le Silas cu a inn ah a hruai ih rawl ei ding a pek. Amah le a innsang zatein Pathian an zum ngah ruangah lungawinak in an khat."},"35":{"text":"A thaizing ah Rom Acozah bawi thuṭhentu pawl in palik bawi pawl an hei thlah ih, “Kha pawl kha thlah hai uh,” tiah thu an pek."},"36":{"text":"Curuangah thawnginn uktu pa in Paul cu, “Thuṭhentu bawi pawl in nangmah le Silas thlah dingin thu an rak pe. Curuangah suak uhla, daitein feh uh,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul in palik bawi pawl hnenah cun, “Sualnak zianghman kan nei lo naón mizapi hmai rori-ah in thawi; Rom Acozah minung kan si ve! Cuih tlunah thawngah in thlak. Cule atu-ah a thupte in fehter in tum maw si? Feh naisai hlah! Rom Acozah bawi pawl anmah rori hinah ra hai sehla in ra suah hai seh!” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cutiih a timi cu palik bawi pawl in Rom Acozah bawi thuṭhentu pawl hnenah an va sim; cule Paul le Silas cu Rom mi an si ti an theih tikah an thin a phang!"},"39":{"text":"Curuangah Paul le Silas hnenah cun an va feh ih ngaithiamnak an va dil; cule thawnginn ihsin an suah ih khawsung ihsin hmun dangah feh uh, tiin an dil."},"40":{"text":"Paul le Silas cu thawnginn ihsin an suak ih Lydia ih inn ah an feh. Cutawkah zumtu unau pawl an tong ih thazaang peknak thu an sim hnuah cuih khua ihsin an suak."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul le Silas cu Amfipolis le Appollonia an tlawng ih Thesalonika khua an thleng. Cutawkah Judah mi pawl ih sinakok a um.","title":"Thesalonika Khua An Thleng"},"2":{"text":"Amah ih tuah keel vekin Paul cu Sinakok ah a feh. Cutawkah Sabbath ni ni thum sung rori mipi thawn thu an el aw ih,"},"3":{"text":"Messiah cu thihnak a tuar ding ih a thosal ding a si ti kha Ca Thianghlim sung ihsin a langter ih a simfiang vivo. “Nan hnenih ka phuanmi Jesuh hi Messiah cu a si,” tiah Paul in a ti."},"4":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat cu an thinlung a fiang ngah ih Paul le Silas kha an kom. Cuvekin nunau hotu pawl le Pathian a biatu Grik mi tampi a burpi in Paul le Silas hnenah an kom ve."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Judah mi pawl in an nahsiik ih lamzin ih a vak lakmi mi hlothlau ṭhenkhat pawl kha an khawm ih miburpi ah an cang. Khawsungah an au an kio ih nasa zetin buainak an suahpi. Jason an timi pa ih inn an va kulh ih cutawkah Paul le Silas kha kai ih mipi hmai ah hnuk an tum."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cutawk inn ah Paul le Silas cu an hmu lo ih Jason le zumtu ṭhenkhat pawl sawn kha khawsung upa hmaiah an hruai ih, “Hmunzakipah buainak a suahtertu pawl, atu-ah kan khawsung an ra thleng ih,"},"7":{"text":"Jason in a inn sungah a umter hai. An ṭongmi cu ‘Jesuh timi siangpahrang dang pakhat a um,’ an tiih cuti cun Rom siangpahrang ih daan an buar a si,” tiah an au ciamco."},"8":{"text":"Cutiih an aunak ruangah miburpi le khawsung upa pawl cu an buaiter ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Thuneitu pawl in Jason le a rualpi pawl cu anmah thlah dingih a ṭul zat tangka an lak ih cuih hnuah an thlah sal."},"10":{"text":"Khua a thim vete in zumtu pawl in Paul le Silas cu Berea khua ah an thlah. Berea khua an thlen tikah sinakok ah an feh.","title":"Berea Khua An Thleng"},"11":{"text":"Cutawkih mipi pawl cu Thesalonika mi pawl hnakin an thinlung a tluangtlam deuh. An thusimmi pawl cu an thinlung taktein an ngai ih, nitinte in Paul ih simmi cu a si ngaingai maw, si ngaingai lo tiah Ca Thianghlim an siar ih an zohṭhim."},"12":{"text":"Mi tampi in an zum; upat tlak Grik nunau pawl le Grik mipa pawl khal in an zum ve."},"13":{"text":"Asinain Thesalonika ih ummi Judah mi pawl in Berea khua khalah Paul in Pathian thu a sim ti an theih tikah Berea khua ahcun an ra ih mipi kha an tokhrok ih an buaiter ciamco."},"14":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah zumtu pawl in Paul cu tifinriat lamah an tlanter; asinain Silas le Timote cu Berea ah an taangta."},"15":{"text":"Paul a thlahtu zumtu pawl in Paul cu Athens khua tiang an thlun; cule a thluntu pawl cu an kir ih Silas le Timote in a zamrang thei tawkih amah hei dawi dingah Paul in thu a cah hai."},"16":{"text":"Paul in Silas le Timote kha Athens khua ihsin a hngak laiah cuih khawpi cu milem zuk in a khat ti kha a hmu ih a thin a nau ngaingai.","title":"Athens Khua-ah"},"17":{"text":"Curuangah Judah mi pawl le Pathian a biatu Grik mi pawl thawn an pumkhawmnak inn sinakok ah thu an el aw ṭheu; mizapi ton awknak hmun khalah a rami pawl thawn an el aw ringring."},"18":{"text":"Epikurian thuzirhtu saya ṭhenkhat le Stoik thuzirhtu saya hrekkhat pawl thawn khal thu an el aw. Mi hrekkhat in, “Zianghman thei sii lo, hi pa hin mi hmaiah lang duh zetin ziangso rel a tum rero?” tiah an ti. Mihrek in, “Ramdang pathian pawl ih thuhla a sim a bang,” an ti. Ziangah cutin an ti tile Paul in Jesuh le a thawhsalnak thu a sim ruangah a si."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Paul cu Areopagas an timi an khua ih khonsil hnenah an suahpi ih, “Thuthar na zirhmi hi ziangso a si, ti kan thei duh."},"20":{"text":"A hrekkhat na simmi kan theihmi cu a lamdang zet ih a tican ziang a si ti kan thei duh,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"(Ziangah cutin an ti tile Athens khua mi hmuahhmuah le hi khua ih a ummi ramdang mi tla cu thu thar le thil thar kha an tikcu zate hmangin theih rero le sim rero a duh bikmi pawl an si.)"},"22":{"text":"Paul cu an khua khonsil Areopagas timi upa hmaiah cun a ding ih an hnenah, “Nannih Athens mi pawl hi biaknak lam pohpoh ahcun nan taimazet ti ka hmu."},"23":{"text":"Ziangahtile nan khawpi sungih ka toihvah tikah Pathian nan biaknak hmun pawl tla ka zoh ih biakṭheng pakhat parah ‘Kan Theih Lomi Pathian Hnenah,’ tiih nan nganmi ka hmu. Cutiin nan thei lo na-cingih nan biakmi Pathian cu atu nan hnenih ka phuanmi hi a si."},"24":{"text":"Leilung le a sungih a ummi hmuahhmuah a tuahtu Pathian cu lei le vanih Bawi a si ih milai kutih sakmi biakinn sungah a um lo."},"25":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Pathian cu mi hmuahhmuah hnenah nunnak le thaw le thildang hmuahhmuah a petu Pathian a si ruangah milai in a hrangih kan tuahmi kha a ṭulmi zianghman a um lo."},"26":{"text":"Minung pakhat sung ihsin leilung miphun hmuahhmuah a tuah ih leilung pumpuluk ah a umter ṭheh. A hlankhan in ziangtik caanah an um ding ih khuitawk hmun tiang an um thei ding, ti kha a relcia ṭheh."},"27":{"text":"Ziangah hiti in a tawlrel cia tile Pathian an hawl ih an hmuh suak theinak dingah a si. Sikhalsehla a ngaingai ti-ah cun Pathian cu zo thawn hman a hlat lo."},"28":{"text":"Mi pakhat ih a rak sim cia vekin, ‘Amah ih sungah kan nung, kan tlangleng ih khua kan sa!’ tiah nan hla phuahtu ṭhenkhat pawl ih an tivek in, ‘Kannih khal hi a faate kan si ve.’"},"29":{"text":"Cutiih Pathian ih faate kan si ruangah thilthiam pawl le zuk suaithiam pawl in sui milem le ngun milem le lungto milem an tuahmi hi Pathian ah kan ruah ding a si hrimhrim lo."},"30":{"text":"Minung in Pathian thei lo bembem ih an rak um caan kha cu Amah Pathian in hmu lo vekin a um san meen; sikhalsehla atu-ah cun an nuncan ṭha lomi ihsin sualsir dingah mi hmuahhmuah kha a fial a si."},"31":{"text":"Ziangahtile a hril ciami mi pakhat in leilung pumpuluk hi dingnak thawn thuṭhen cat dingah ni a tin zo. Cuih thu cu thudik a si, ti kha mi hmuahhmuah hnenah langternak ah cupa cu thihnak ihsin a thoter sal zo,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Mithi thawhsalnak thu Paul ih a simmi an theih tikah mi hrek in an hnihsan; asinain midang in, “In sim sal hrih cila kan duh,” tiah an ti."},"33":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Paul cu an khawmnak ihsin a feh."},"34":{"text":"Mi hrekkhat in an thlun ih an zum. A zumtu lakah cun Khonsil upa Dionisias tla a tel. Damaris an timi nunau pakhat le midang ṭhenkhat khal an tel."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Paul cu Athens ihsin a feh ih Korin khua a thleng.","title":"Korin Khua-ah"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkah Pontus ramih a suakmi Judah mi Aquila a tong. Aquila cu a nupi Prisilla thawn Italy ihsin a ra tlanmi an si. Ziangahtile Rom siangpahrang Klaudius in Judah mi hmuahhmuah cu Rom khua ihsin a dawi ruangah an tlan. Paul cun a va tong hai ih,"},"3":{"text":"an hnenah a caam ih anmah thawn hna a ṭuan. Aquila le Prisilla cu puanthlam tuah in pumcawmmi an si ih anmah vekin Paul khal puanthlam tuah in a pum a cawm aw ve."},"4":{"text":"Sabbath nitinte in sinakok ah Judah mi le Grik mi pawl an thinlung fiangter dingah thu an ruah aw, an el aw ṭheu."},"5":{"text":"Masidonia ihsin Silas le Timote an ra thlen tikah Paul cu a tikcu neihmi hmuahhmuah in Pathian thusimnak ah a hmang ih Jesuh cu Messiah taktak a si tiah Judah mi hnenah a sim ciamco."},"6":{"text":"Annih in Paul cu an engtai ih ṭong siava tla in an leh tikah Paul in a lungkimlonak langternak ah a hnipuan ih leivut kha a thinta ih, “Nan hloral a si ahcun nanmah ih mawh a si ding! Kei i mawhthluk hlah uh! Atu ihsin Zentail mi hnenah ka feh ding!” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah a feh ih Zentail mi Titias Jastas an timi pa inn ah a um; Titias Jastas cu Pathian a biatu a si ih a inn cu sinakok kiangte ah a um."},"8":{"text":"Sinakok uktu upa bik Krispas khal a sungkhat pawl thawn Bawipa an zum; cule Korin khuami tampi tla in Pathian thu cu an thei ih an zum ruangah baptisma an lak."},"9":{"text":"Zankhat ah Paul in langnak a hmu ih cuih sung ihsin Bawipa in, “Paul, ṭih hlah! Sim rero ko aw, na bei dong hlah!"},"10":{"text":"Na hnenah ka um a si. Zohman in harnak an lo pe thei lo ding, ziangahtile hi khawsungih mi tampi cu ka minung an si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Curuangah Paul cu kum khat le a hrek sung a um ih mipi hnenah Pathian thu a zirh ringring."},"12":{"text":"Gallio in Akhaia ram uktu Rom Mangki a ṭuan laiah Judah mi pawl an tongkhawm aw ih Paul cu an kai ih zungah an suahpi."},"13":{"text":"“Hi pa hin mi tampi hnenah kan daan thawn a kaih aw lomi Pathian biak daan a zirh a si,” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Paul a hung ṭong zik zawng ah Gallio in Judah mi hnenah, “Thil ṭha lo le thil sual pakhatkhat tuah ruangah a si ahcun Judah mi pawl nan parah thinlung sau zetin ka um ding."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu cu nan biaknak ih ṭong fang le hmin le nan daan ruangih thu el aw nan si ruangah nanmah tein va relcat uh! Cubangtuk thu-ah cun thuṭhentu ka si thei lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule a zung ihsin Judah mi pawl cu a dawi ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Sinakok inn uktu Sosthenes kha an zatein an kai ih zung hmai rori ah an vuak. Asinain Gallio cun zianghman ah a siarsak lo."},"18":{"text":"Paul cu Korin khua ih zumtu pawl thawn ni tampi sung an um hnuah Prisilla le Aquila thawn lawng in Siria ah an feh. Kenkhria ihsin lawng in an feh hlanah thu tiamkamnak a rak tuah zo bangtuk in Paul cu a lu a meet.","title":"Antiok Ah A Kir Sal"},"19":{"text":"Efesa khua an thleng ih cutawk ah Prisilla le Aquila cu a taan. Sinakok ah a lut ih Judah mi pawl thawn thu an ruah aw."},"20":{"text":"Rei deuh um dingin an sawm naón a lung a kim lo."},"21":{"text":"A feh zawng ah thu a cahta ih, “Pathian lungkimnak a si ahcun nan hnenah ka ra sal leh ding,” tiah a ti. Cule Efesa ihsin lawng in a feh."},"22":{"text":"Sisaria a thlen tikah Jerusalem khua ah a lan ih cutawkih kawhhran kha a tongta ih Antiok ah a hung feh sal."},"23":{"text":"Cutawkah tawkfang sung a um hnuah a pok sal ih Kalatia le Frizia ram a tlawng ih zumtu hmuahhmuah an thazaang a cakter."},"24":{"text":"Culai ah Alexandria khua ih suak, Apollos timi Judah pa cu Efesa khua ah a ra thleng. Amah cu ṭong a thiam zet ih Ca Thianghlim tla a thei ngaingaimi a si.","title":"Efesa Le Korin Ah Apollos"},"25":{"text":"Bawipa ih Lamzin thuhla ah zirh zomi a si ih, thinlung thozet le felzetin Jesuh ih thuhla cu a sim ih a zirh. Asinain a theihmi cu Johan ih baptisma thu lawnglawng a si."},"26":{"text":"Ralṭha zetin sinakok ah thu a sim. A thusimmi cu Prisilla le Aquila in an theih tikah an inn ah an sawm ih Pathian Lamzin thuhla kha felfai deuh in an sim."},"27":{"text":"Cule Apollos cu Akhaia peng ih feh a tum ruangah Efesa khua ih zumtu pawl in an bawm ih Akhaia khua ih dungthluntu pawl hnenah Apollos an rak mikhual theinak dingah ca an ngansak. Akhaia khua a thlen tikah Pathian zaangfahnak thawngin zumtu a rak si mi pawl hrangah bawmtu ṭhazet ah a cang."},"28":{"text":"Ziangahtile mi thu el a thiamzet ih Jesuh cu Messiah taktak a si, tiah Ca Thianghlim sung ihsin la tahrat in a fiangter ih cuticun zapi hmaiih thu el awknak ah Judah mi pawl kha a neh thei ringring."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Apollos cu Korin khua ih a um laiah Paul cu cuih ram sungah khual a tlawng ih Efesa ah a thleng. Cutawkah dungthluntu ṭhenkhat pawl a tong ih,","title":"Efesa Khua Ah Paul A Thleng Sal"},"2":{"text":"Paul in, “Zumtu nan si zo ih Thlarau Thianghlim nan ngah maw?” tiah a sut. Annih in, “Thlarau Thianghlim a um ti hman kan theih ual lo,” tiah an sawn."},"3":{"text":"“Cuti asile ziangvek baptisma so nan lak?” tiah Paul in a sut. Annih in, “Johan ih baptisma,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah Paul in, “Johan ih baptisma cu sual a sir awmi pawl hrangah a si ih amah Johan in ka dungih a ra ding pa kha Israel mi pawl in an zum dingmi a si. Cumi cu Jesuh a si,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cumi an theih tikah Bawi Jesuh hmin in baptisma an lak."},"6":{"text":"Paul in an parah a kut a suang ih an parah Thlarau Thianghlim a rung thleng; ṭong phun dangdang in an ṭong ih Pathian thu cu profet bangin an phuang."},"7":{"text":"Anmah cu pacang hlir hleihnih tluk an si."},"8":{"text":"Paul cu sinakok ah a feh ih thla thum sung ralṭha zetin mipi hnenah thu a sim. Anmah thawn thu an el aw ih Pathian Uknak thu kha an thinlung ah lut ngah dingin a zuam."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mi ṭhenkhat cu an thinlung a ruhzet ih an zum duh lo; curuangah miburpi hmaiah Bawipa ih Lamzin thuhla kha an relsiat ciamco. Curuangah Paul in a tlansan ih zumtu pawl kha a fehpi ih Tirannas timi thusimnak innpi ah nitinte in thu a zirh."},"10":{"text":"Cuti cun kum hnih sung a ṭuan ih Asia ram sungih a ummi Judah mi siseh, Zentail mi siseh, an zatein Bawipa ih thu cu an thei."},"11":{"text":"Pathian in Paul kha a hmang ih lamdang zet, mangbangza pawl a tuah.","title":"Skeva Ih Fapa Pawl"},"12":{"text":"A pavua le a taaingerh puan pawl hman kha mina pawl hnenah an ken tikah an natnak a dam ih an sung ihsin khuasia pawl an suak."},"13":{"text":"Hmunkipah vak tahratih khuasia a dawitu Judah mi ṭhenkhat tla in Bawi Jesuh hmin in Paul vekih tuah ve an tum. Annih in khuasia pawl hnenah, “Paul ih a simmi Jesuh ih hmin in ka lo dawi,” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Judah mi Puithiam Saang a hmin Skeva an timi pa ih fapa unau pasarih in cubangtuk cun an tuah ciamco."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla khawsia in an hnenah cun, “Jesuh ka thei; Paul thuhla khal ka thei. Sikhalsehla nannih hi zoso nan si?” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Khuasia polhmi pa cun unau pasarih pawl cu a zon ih a sual hai ih a neh thluh. Hmapu le hnipuan tlek ṭheh-in a inn ihsin an tlan."},"17":{"text":"Cuih thuhla cu Efesa khua ih a ummi Judah mi le Zentail mi hmuahhmuah in an theih tikah an ṭih ngaingai ih Jesuh hmin cu upatnak an pek sinsin."},"18":{"text":"Zumtu sung ihsin mi tampi an ra ih zapi hmaiah thil an rak tuah ṭheumi pawl kha an phuang ciamco."},"19":{"text":"Mitkherh thiam tampi tla in an mitkher cabu pawl cu hmun khatah an khawm ih zapi mithmuh ah an ur. Cutiih an urmi mitkher cabu pawl cu a man an kom tikah ngun tangka thawng sawmnga a si."},"20":{"text":"Cuti cun Bawipa ih thu cu nasa zetin a zai ih a cak sinsin."},"21":{"text":"Cubangtuk in thil a um hnuah Paul in Masidonia ram le Akhaia ram hrawng tlawn ih Jerusalem ih lanta ding kha a thinlung in a ruat. “Cutawk ka thlen hnuah Rom khal ka hmuh a ṭul,” tiah a ti.","title":"Efesa Khua Ih Buainak"},"22":{"text":"Curuangah amah a bawmtu lakih pahnih Timote le Erastas kha Masidonia ah a thlah ih amah cu Asia ram sungah tikcu tam deuh a hmang."},"23":{"text":"Cuih tikcu hrawngah Efesa khua ah Bawipa ih Lamzin thuhla ah thubuai tumpi pakhat a um."},"24":{"text":"Ngun in sosertu Demetrias an timi pa in khawzingnu Artemis ih biakinn zuk kha ngun in a ser ih a hnaṭuantu pawl hrangah tangka tampi a ngah."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah a hnaṭuantu pawl le anmah vekih hnaṭuantu dangdang pawl kha a kokhawm ih an hnenah, “U le nau pawl, hi kan hnaṭuanmi ruangah hin neinungin kan um ti cu nan theih ṭhehmi a si."},"26":{"text":"Asinain atu-ah Paul an timi pa in ziang bangtuk in hna a ṭuan ti cu nanmah rori-in nan hmuhmi le nan theihmi a si. ‘Milai ih tuahcopmi pathian cu pathian an si lo,’ tiah a ti ih Efesa khawsung le Asia ram zate ti ding tlak in mi tampi thinlung ah a simmi cu a lut ngah a si."},"27":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah hi kan hnaṭuanmi hi a hmin a sia thlang ding tihi phan a umzet. Cuih tlunah Asia ram le leilung tlun pumpuluk ah mikip miza in an biakmi a ropi zetmi khawzingnu Artemis ih biakinn hi mi in zianghman ah an siar nawn lo ding ih a ropitnak hi a cemralta ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cumi cu mipi in an theih tikah an thin a hengzet ih, “Efesa khua ih Artemis cu a ropi a si,” tiah an au ciamco."},"29":{"text":"Cutiih an au cu khawsungah a khat ṭheh. Mipi cun, Masidonia mi pahnih Paul thawn khual a tlawng tlangmi Kaias le Aristarkas kha an kai ih puai zohnak bualrawn ah an suahpi."},"30":{"text":"Mipi hmaiah cun Paul amah rori suah a duh naón zumtu pawl in an kham."},"31":{"text":"Cuih peng sungih thuneitu a rualpi pawl hrekkhat in cuih bualrawn ih va feh hrimhrim lo dingin thu an cah fawn."},"32":{"text":"Cutiin bualrawn ahcun an buai rero; mihrek in pakhat thu an au, midang in thudang thu an rak au ve; mi tam sawn cun cutawkah ziangah kan ra suak ti hman an thei lo."},"33":{"text":"Judah mi pawl in Alexander kha hmaiih an suahter ruangah mi tampi cun hi thubuai a suahtertu hi amah a si hmang tiah an ruat. Cule Alexander cun dai uh, tiah a kut in mipi cu a hun hmuh hai ih amah ih dinhmun ṭan in thusim a tum."},"34":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Judah mi a si kha mipi in an theih tikah an au keel in an au hluarhlo sal ih, “Efesa khua ih Artemis cu a ropi a si,” tiah nazi pahnih sung an au."},"35":{"text":"A netnak ah cuih khua ih thuneitu lakih sungṭuantu pa in mipi cu a daihter deuh ih an hnenah cun, “Efesa khuami pawl, Efesa khua cu a ropimi Artemis ih biakinn le vancung ihsin a rung tlami milem umnak hmun a si ti cu mi hmuahhmuahih theih ṭhehmi a si."},"36":{"text":"A el theitu zoso a um? Zohman in an el thei lo ding. Curuangah daitein um uhla ruatta ciamciam loin zianghman tuah hlah uh."},"37":{"text":"Himi pawl hin biakinn sung thilri an ruk lo, kan khuavangnu khal an relsiat lo naón hinah nan rak suahpi."},"38":{"text":"Demetrias le a hnaṭuantu pawl in zo ih tlun khalah sual mawhthluk ding an neih a si ahcun tazacuai theinak zung kan nei ko; thuṭhen ni le thuṭhentu upa tla kan nei ko. Cunah thukhiin theih a si."},"39":{"text":"Cuhnakih thupi deuh nan duh asile kan daan vekin khawsungmi zate ih pumkhawmnak ah relcat ding a si."},"40":{"text":"Ziangahtile tuihsun ih thil a cangmi ruangah hin buainak nan suahpi tiin mawhthluk kan tong pang ding ti phan a um. Hi tluk lawmmam ih buainak thu-ah hin puhmawh ding a um lo; cule ziangah nan buai tiah in ti hai sehla ṭan kan la thei lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Cutiih a ti hnuah a ra khawmmi pawl cu a ṭiakter hai."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih thubuai cu a dai ih Paul in a zumtu pawl cu hmun khatah a kokhawm ih thapeknak ṭongkam in a forh hnuah cibai a bukta hai ih Masidonia ramah a feh.","title":"Masidonia Le Akhaia Ram Ah"},"2":{"text":"Cuih ram cu a tlawng vivo ih thapeknak thu a sim vivo. Cule Akhaia a thleng ih,"},"3":{"text":"cutawkah thla thum a caam. Siria ah feh a tum naón, a tim a tuah rero laiah Judah mi pawl ih an zuar tum thu a theih ruangah Masidonia lam in feh sal a tum."},"4":{"text":"Berea khuami Pirhas ih fapa Sopater le Thesalonika khuami Aristarkas le Sekundas, Derbe khuami Kaias, Asia ram in Taikhikas le Trofimas, le Timote tla in Paul cu an fehpi."},"5":{"text":"An rak feh sungih Troas ihsin in rak hngak."},"6":{"text":"Thilnu tello Sang Puai a cem hnuah Filipi ihsin lawng in kan feh ih ni nga hnuah Troas ah kan man hai. Troas ahcun zarh khat kan caam."},"7":{"text":"Zarhte ni zanlam ah pawlkomnak zanriah hil tlang dingin kan tongkhawm aw. A ra khawmmi hnenah Paul in thu a sim ih a thaizing feh ding a si ruangah zanṭim tiang thu a sim.","title":"Paul In Troas Khua Neta Bik A Tlawnnak"},"8":{"text":"Tlunta khaan ah kan khawm aw ih mei-inn tampi an vang."},"9":{"text":"Tlangval pakhat Zutikhas an timi cu saangkate ah a to ih Paul in reipi thu a sim tikah cun a ih a rak hmu deuhdeuh ih a netnak ahcun a ihthat ngah ruangah cuih inn dot thumnak ihsin leilung ah a tla. An vung sar tikah a rak thi zo."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul a vung ṭum ih cuih tlangvalpa cu a bawhhnawh ih a pom. Paul in, “Nan thinphang hlah uh, a nunglai a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cule Paul cu tlunta khaanah cun a hung kai sal ih sang kha a phel ih an ei. Paul cu reipi, zinglam nisuak tiang thu a sim hnuah a feh."},"12":{"text":"Cuih tlangvalpa cu a nungin a inn ah an fehpi ih an hna a ngam zet."},"13":{"text":"Lawng parah kan va feh ih cuih lawng in Assos ah kan feh; Assos ahcun Paul sawm phah ding kan si. Cutiih sawm phah ding cu in sim ciami a si, ziangahtile lei lamzin in anih cu a rak feh.","title":"Troas Ihsin Miletas Ah"},"14":{"text":"Assos ah Paul cu kan tong ih kan lawng parah kan toter ih Mitilene ah kan feh."},"15":{"text":"Mitilene ihsin kan suak ih a thaisun ah Khios zawn kan thleng. A tipsun ah Samos kan thleng ih a thiamsun ah Miletas kan thleng."},"16":{"text":"Paul cun Asia ramih caam rei ding cu a duh lo ruangah Efesa lansan mai a tum. A cang thei a si ahcun Pentikos ni kheel in Jerusalem ih thlen lohli a duh."},"17":{"text":"Paul in Miletas ihsin mi a thlah ih Efesa khua kawhhran upa pawl in amah rak tong dingin thu a cah.","title":"Paul Ih Neta Bik Thucahmi"},"18":{"text":"An rat tikah Paul cun, “Asia ram ka ra thlen ih a ni khatnak ni ihsin ka tikcu hmuahhmuah cu nan hnenah ziangvekin ka hmang ti cu nan thei ṭheh ko."},"19":{"text":"Tangdornak le mitthli thawn Bawipa ka rian ih Judah mi pawl ih in phiarnak khal har fualfo-in ka tuar."},"20":{"text":"Zapi hmaiah siseh, nan innsung khalah siseh, thusimnak caan ka neih tikah nan hrangih bawmtu a si ding hmuahhmuah in zianghman suup loin ka sim ti khal nan thei."},"21":{"text":"Judah mi hnenah siseh, Zentail mi hnenah siseh, an sualnak tlansan in Pathian hnenah an kir ih kan Bawi Jesuh an zum a ṭul hrimhrim tiah ka sim tlunah feltein ralrinnak khal ka pek hai a si."},"22":{"text":"Cule atu-ah Thlarau Thianghlim ih hruainak thlunin Jerusalem ah feh ka tum; cutawkah ziang ka cang ding ti zianghman ka thei lo."},"23":{"text":"Khawkip ah thawngtlak le harsatnak lawnglawng in in hngak a si ti lawng kha Thlarau Thianghlim ih ralrin peknak thawngin ka thei."},"24":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka hrangah ka nunnak hi zianghman ah ka siar lo; Bawipa Jesuh in ṭuan dingih i pekmi Pathian ih zaangfahnak Thuthang ṭha phuan ding ṭuanvo hi famkim zetih ṭuan thluh thei ding lawng hi ka saduhthah a si."},"25":{"text":"Nan zate hnenah a suk a so ah ka vak ih, Pathian ih Uknak thu ka lo sim. Asinain atu cu zohman in in hmu sal nawn lo ding, tihi ka thei."},"26":{"text":"Curuangah tuihsun ah hin fiangtein nan hnenah ka phuang: nanmah lakah pakhatkhat nan hloral asile kei in mawhthluk hlah uh."},"27":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pathian ih tumtahmi kha suupmi zianghman nei loin a zatein nan hnenah ka phuang ṭheh a si."},"28":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah nanmah le nanmah kilkhawi awk thiam uhla Thlarau Thianghlim in tuurual kilkhawitu dingih a lo ret vekin nan tuurual kha ṭhatein kilkhawi uh. Pathian in a Fapa thisen thawn Amaió ta ih a tuah zomi a kawhhran khaaltu va si uh!"},"29":{"text":"Kei ka feh hnuah ṭihnungza cinghnia hraang an ra ding ih tuuruun pawl hi an zoh meen lo ding, ti ka thei."},"30":{"text":"Nanmah ih sung ihsi hin mihrek cun anmah lamih hruai duh ah thuphanper tahratin zumtu pawl hi an hruaisualnak tikcu caan a ra thleng ding."},"31":{"text":"Curuangah ralring uhla sun tilo zan tilo in mitthli thawn kum thum sung nan zatein ka lo zirhmi kha hngilh hlah uh."},"32":{"text":"Atu cu Pathian kilkhawinak le a zaangfahnak thu sungah ka lo ap zo. Amah in a lo ṭhansoter ding ih a minung pawl hrangih a ret ciami thlawsuahnak kha a lo pek ding."},"33":{"text":"Zo ih tangka, sui le hnipuan khal ka daw dah lo."},"34":{"text":"Ka kut rori hin hna ka ṭuan ih keimah le ka rualpi pawl ih kan ṭulmi thil tla kha ka suahpi ve ti cu nan thei ṭhehmi a si ko."},"35":{"text":"Ziang hmuahhmuah ah napi in ṭuan tahratin santlai lomi pawl kan bawm ding a si ti kha ka lo hmuh zo; Bawipa Jesuh khal in, ‘Ngah lam hnakin pek lamah lungawinak a tam sawn,’ a timi ṭongkam kha ciing ringring uh,” tiah thu a cah."},"36":{"text":"Paul in cutiin a sim ṭheh tikah a khuk a bil ih an zatein thla an cam tlang."},"37":{"text":"Paul cu an pom an hnam ih damte in vung feh aw, ti phahin an zatein an ṭap ciamco."},"38":{"text":"Zohman in in hmu sal nawn lo ding, a ti ruangah an riah a siat cuangnak a si. Cule lawng umnak tiang an hei thlah."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kannih khal in cibai kan buk ih kan feh. Long in khui hmanah taang phah loin kan feh ih Kos kan thleng; a thaisun ah Rhodes tikulh kan thleng ih cutawk ihsin Patara ah kan lanta.","title":"Jerusalem Ah Paul A Feh"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkah Fonisia ih a feh dingmi lawng kan tong ih cuih lawng ah kan ceer ih kan feh."},"3":{"text":"Saipras tikulh a lang theinak hmun kan thleng ih cutawk ihsin thlanglam ah kan her ih Siria lamah kan lan. Tai-ar khua ah kan ṭum ih cutawkah lawng thil phurhmi pawl an suahta."},"4":{"text":"Cutawkah dungthluntu ṭhenkhat an um ih an hnenah zarh khat kan um. Thlarau ih simnak thawngin Paul cu Jerusalem ih feh lo dingin an dawn."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla anmah thawn kan umtlang tikcu a cem tikah kan suak ih kan feh. Annih khal in an zatein an nupi le an faate pawl thawn tipikap tiang in thlah. Cutawkah kan zatein khukbil in thla kan cam tlang."},"6":{"text":"Cule pakhat le pakhat cibai kan buk aw ih kannih lawng parah kan kai ih annih inn ah an tlung."},"7":{"text":"Tai-ar khua ihsin lawng in kan feh vivo ih Ptolemais kan thleng. Cutawkah zumtu unau pawl kan tong phah ih an hnenah ni khat kan caam."},"8":{"text":"A thaisun kan pok lala ih Sisaria kan thleng. Cutawkah Jerusalem ih upa pasarih hrilmi lakih pakhat a si mi Pathian thusimtu Filip ih inn ah kan riak."},"9":{"text":"Pasal nei hrih lo fanu fala pali a nei ih Pathian thu a phuangtu profet an si."},"10":{"text":"Ni tam nawn kan um hnuah Judea ram ihsin profet pakhat Agabas an timi a ra thleng."},"11":{"text":"Kan hnenah a ra ih Paul ih taikhap a lak hnuah a kut le a ke kha cuih taikhap cun a ṭeem aw ih, “Thlarau Thianghlim in hiti in a ti: hi taikhap a neitu pa hi Jerusalem khua ah Judah mi pawl in hi bangtuk in an ṭeem ding ih Zentail mi pawl ih kut sungah an pe ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cumi kan theih tikah kanmah in siseh, midang khal in siseh, Paul cu Jerusalem ih feh lo dingin kan dawn ciamco."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla anih cun, “Ziangah so hiti ih nan um! Hiti nan ṭah ruangah ka lung in hnoter sinsin a si! Bawipa Jesuh hrangah cun Jerusalem khua sungah ṭeem le ṭawn lawng hman si loin thih ding tiang hman ka tiar a si,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Ziangti hmanih kan don thei lo ruangah, “Bawipa ih duhnak vekin si ko seh,” tiah kan ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutawkah tikcu tawkfang sung kan um hnuah kan tim kan tuah ih Jerusalem ah kan feh."},"16":{"text":"Sisaria ih a ummi dungthlun ṭhenkhat pawl cun in thlun ve ih kan riahnak ding Mnason ih inn ah in fehpi. Mnason cu Saipras mi a si ih a hlan ihsin dungthluntu a rak si ringring."},"17":{"text":"Jerusalem kan vung thlen tikah zumtu unau pawl cun lungawi zetin in rak hmuak.","title":"Paul In Jeim A Leng"},"18":{"text":"A thaisun ah Jeim tong dingin Paul thawn kan feh ih kawhhran upa pawl tla an kim ṭheh."},"19":{"text":"Paul in cibai a buk hai hnuah an parih a lungawinak thu a sim ih a hnaṭuannak hmangin Pathian in Zentail mi lakih a tuahmi hmuahhmuah kha famkim zetin a sim."},"20":{"text":"Cumi an theih tikah an zatein Pathian kha an thangṭhat. Cule annih in, “Kan u pa Paul, Judah mi pawl sungin mi thawng ziangzatso zumtu an cang zo ih Daan an thlunnak ah ziangtlukin taimak an suah ti cu na hmuh ṭhehmi a si."},"21":{"text":"Zentail ram sungih a ummi Judah mi hmuahhmuah hnenah Moses Daan dungtun dingin le an faate pawl serhtan nawn lo dingin le Judah daan pawl thlun nawn lo dingin Paul in a zirh a si, tiah hitawk ummi pawl hin thu an thei."},"22":{"text":"Atu-ah hitawk ih nan thlen zo hi an thei ding a si ih ziangtinso kan tuah ding?"},"23":{"text":"Hitiin tuah cila a ṭha ding tiah kan ruat. hittawk ah hin thukamnak a tuah zotu mi pali an um."},"24":{"text":"Anmah thawn va feh awla thianfainak ih tuah ṭheumi daan vekin va tuahpi ve awla an cemmi tangka tla va pek sak hai aw; cule an lu an meet thei ding. Cuti cun nangmah rori in Moses Daan kha na thlun ih na thuhla an rak theih ciami pawl hi thudik zianghman a um lo, ti kha an thei ṭheh ding."},"25":{"text":"Zentail mi pawl zumtu ih a cangmi pawl thuhla ahcun kanmah in ca kan kuat zo. Kan cakuatmi sungah cun milem hnenih pekmi tirawl ei lo ding, sathi ei lo ding, hngawngrek-ih thahmi sa ei lo ding, le nupa sualnak tuah lo ding, tiah kan relcatmi kha kan kuat zo a si,” tiah an ti."},"26":{"text":"Cuhrangah Paul in a thaisun ah cuih mi pali cu a fehpi ih anmah thawn an daan vekin thianfainak cu an tuah. Cuih hnuah Biakinn sungah an lut ih thianfainak caan hi ziangtik ni ah a cem ding tile ziangtikah thawinak an pek fingfing a ṭulnak ding thu tla kha a sim."},"27":{"text":"Ni sarih ni a kim zik tikah Asia ram ihsin a rami Judah mi ṭhenkhat pawl in Biakinn sungah Paul kha an hmu. Mipi pawl kha an tokhrok ih Paul cu an kai.","title":"Biakinn Sungah Paul An Kai"},"28":{"text":"“Israel mi pawl, in bawm uh! Hi pa hi hmunzakipah feh tahratin Israel mi pawl siseh, Moses Daan siseh, hi Biakinn siseh, relsia in thu a zirh vivotu a si. Atu-ah hi Biakinn sungah hin Zentail mi pawl hman a ratpi ih hi hmun thianghlim hmuah a borhhlawhter thluh zo!” tiah an au."},"29":{"text":"(Hitiih an aunak cu Efesa khuami Trofimas kha Paul thawn Jerusalem khawsungah an hmuh ruangah Biakinn sungah a luhpi a si, tiin an ruah ruangah a si.)"},"30":{"text":"Khawpi sung cu a zatein buainak in a khat ih misenpi cu an tlan ih Paul cu kai tahratin Biakinn sung ihsin an dirh suak. Cule hmakhatte-ah Biakinn sangka pawl cu an khar."},"31":{"text":"Misenpi in Paul cu thah an tum rero laiah Jerusalem khawpi an khawpum in ral an tho a si tiah Rom ralkap hotu ralbawipa hnenah thu an than."},"32":{"text":"Hmakhatte-ah cuih ralbawipa cu ralbawi dang le ralkap pawl thawn an va tlan. Mipi in ralkap pawl thawn cuih ralbawipa an hmuh tikah Paul an vuak kha an baang."},"33":{"text":"Ralbawipa cu Paul hnenah a va feh ih a kaih hnuah thir cikcin pahnih in khit dingah thu a pek. Cule mipi cu, “Hi pa hi zoso a si? Ziang sualnak so a tuah?” tiah a sut."},"34":{"text":"Mipi sungih mi ṭhenkhat cu phunkhat in an au, mi hrekkhat cu phundang in an au ve. Thu a buaituk lawmmam ih, ralbawipa in ziang a cang ti a theih fiang lo ruangah a ralkap pawl kha Paul cu ṭankulh sungih luhpi dingin thu a pek."},"35":{"text":"An fehpi tikah kailawn tiang lawng an thlenpi thei; cuih hnu cun misenpi pawl an neh thei lo ruangah Paul cu ralkap pawl in a zawn in an zawn."},"36":{"text":"An dungin an rak nor vivo ih, “That uh,” tiah an au phah vivo."},"37":{"text":"Ralkap pawl in Paul cu ṭankulh sungih an luhpi zik zawng ah Paul in ralbawipa cu, “Thu pakhatte ka lo sim thei pei maw?” tiah a sut. Ralbawipa in, “Grik ṭong na thiam maw si?","title":"Paul In Amah Ih ṭannak Thu A Sim"},"38":{"text":"Cuti a si ahcun kan dung rei nawnah ral a tho ih hriamnam thawn mi thawngli ramṭhingih a tlanpitu Izipt pa kha cu na si lo ti aw?” tiah a sut."},"39":{"text":"Paul in, “Keimah cu Judah mi ka si. Silisia ram Tarsas khua ih a suakmi, khawpi hminthangih um ka si. Misenpi hnenah thusimnak tikcu i pe hram aw,” tiah a dil."},"40":{"text":"Ralbawipa cun thusimnak tikcu a pek ih, curuangah Paul cu kailawn parah ding tahrat in mipi pawl cu dai dingin a zaa a zaap. Mipi pawl an daih tikah Paul in Hebru ṭong in an hnenah thu a sim."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul cun, “U le nau, nu le pa pawl, nan hmaiah hin ka ṭannak thu ka sim ve tikah hin i ngaihnik uh!” a ti."},"2":{"text":"Hebru ṭong ih a ṭong ruangah mipi cu an dai ṭhepṭhep. Cule Paul cun a hun peh sal ih:"},"3":{"text":"“Keimah cu Silisia peng Tarsas khua suak Judah mi ka si. Asinain Jerusalem khua ah a ṭhanglian mi ka si ih Gamaliel ih zirhmi ka si. Kan pupa pawl ih daan felzet le fekzet ih zirhmi ka rak si. Tuihsun hitawk ih a rami nanmah vekin Pathian hnenah pum petu ka rak si ve."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ih Lamzin thluntu pawl hi thi ko in ka rak hrem hai. Nunau tilo, mipa tilo in ka kai ih thawngah ka thlak."},"5":{"text":"Puithiam Saang le Khonsil upa pawl cu thudik ka simmi hi a theitu an si. Cuih upa pawl hnen ihsin Damaskas khua ih Judah unau pawl hnen pek ding ca ka keng ih Bawipa ih Lamzin thluntu pawl hi kai tahratih thir cikcin thawn khit in Jerusalem khua ih rak hruai dingin le hrem dingin Damaskas khua ah ka rak feh a si."},"6":{"text":"“Cutiin ka feh ih Damaskas ka thlen zikah, sunlai hrawngah van ihsin a tleuzetmi tleunak in ka kimvel kha hmakhatte ah i run tlet.","title":"Paul Ih Lungthlengnak (Dung 9.1-19 ; 26.12-18)"},"7":{"text":"Leilung ah ka tlu ih aw pakhat in, ‘Saul, Saul, ziangah so i hrem?’ tiah i ti kha ka thei."},"8":{"text":"‘Bawipa, zoso na si?’ tiah ka hun sut. Anih in, ‘Na hremmi Nazareth mi Jesuh ka si,’ tiah i ti."},"9":{"text":"Ka hawipi pawl in tleunak cu an hmu naón i biatu-ih aw cu an thei lo."},"10":{"text":"‘Ziang so ka tuah ding, Bawipa?’ tiah ka sut. Bawipa in, ‘Tho awla Damaskas khawsungah va feh awla na tuah dingah Bawipa in a tumtah ciami hmuahhmuah kha an lo sim ding,’ tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"A tleu tuk ruangah ka mit a caw ih ka rualpi pawl in ka kutin Damaskas khawsungah in hruai."},"12":{"text":"Cuih khawpi ah Ananias cu daan thluntu saakhua-mi le cutawk ih um Judah mi hmuahhmuah ih upatmi a si."},"13":{"text":"Ananias cu ka hnenah a ra ih ka kiangah ding tahratin, ‘Unau pa Saul, khua hmu sal aw,’ tiah a ti. Cuvete in khua ka hmu sal ih amah cu ka hun zoh."},"14":{"text":"Amah in, ‘Kan pu le kan pa pawl ih Pathian in amah ih duhnak a theitu dingah le Miding pa hmutu dingah le amah ih aw rori a theitu dingah a lo hril zo a si."},"15":{"text":"Ziangahtile na hmuhmi le na theihmi hi mi hmuahhmuah hnenih simtu dingah Amah ih thutheitu na si ding."},"16":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah reipi hngak nawn hlah! Tho awla amah ih hmin ko phah in baptisma lak awla na sualnak thiangfaiter aw,” tiah i ti."},"17":{"text":"“Cuih hnuah Jerusalem ah ka kirsal ih Biakinn sungih thla ka cam laiah langnak ka hmu.","title":"Zentail Mi Hnenih Thusim Ding"},"18":{"text":"Cuih langnak ahcun Bawipa ka hmu ih ka hnenah, ‘Tho awla zamrangte in Jerusalem ihsin suak aw, ziangahtile hi khuami pawl in ka thuhla na phuanmi hi an pom lo ding,’ tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Kei in, ‘Bawipa, sinakok ah ka feh ih nangmah a lo zumtu pawl kha kai in ka vuak rero ṭheu kha an theih ṭhehmi a si."},"20":{"text":"Cule na thutheitu Stefen an thah tikah keimah rori ka um ih an thah kha ka lungkimpi tlunah a thattu pawl ih puan pawl a rak kensaktu ka si,’ tiah ka ti."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa cun, ‘Feh ko aw; lam hlapi Zentail mi pawl hnenah ka lo thlah ding,’ i ti,” tiah Paul in a sim."},"22":{"text":"Cumi a sim tiang cu mipi pawl in ṭhatein an ngai. Asinain cuih hnu cun an aw neih patawp in, “Kha pa kha hloral seh! That uh! Nung ding a tlak lo!” tiah an au ciamco."},"23":{"text":"An zatein an au, an kio, an hnipuan an zaap ih leivut kha vanah an khirh ciamco."},"24":{"text":"Rom ralbawipa in a ralkap pawl kha Paul hi ṭankulh sungah fehpi uhla ziang ruangah mipi pawl in hitlukin an hua ih an au hnawh ti theihnak dingah fung in vuak uh, tiah thu a pek."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla fung in vuak dingih an ṭem ṭheh tikah Paul in cutawkih a dingmi bawi pakhat hnenah, “A sual thu ṭhen hrih lo Rom mi pakhat hi vuak daan a si pei maw?” tiah a sut."},"26":{"text":"Cuih thu a theih tikah cuih bawi cu ralbawipa hnenah a feh ih, “Ziang so na tuah? Khi pa khi Rom ih minung sokhaw a si!” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Curuangah Paul hnenah a va feh ih, “Rom mi na si maw? I sim hnik?” tiah ralbawipa cun a sut. “Ka si,” tiah Paul in a ti."},"28":{"text":"Ralbawipa in, “Kei khal tangka tampi ka pek hnuah ka si ve,” tiah a ti. Paul cun, “Kei cu ka suahkeh ihsin Rom mi ka si,” tiah a sawn."},"29":{"text":"Cuvete in Paul thusuh a tumtu pawl cu dungah an siip ṭheh. Ralbawipa khal cu Paul kha Rom mi a si ti a theih tlunah Rom mi thir cikcin thawn a khih kha a theih sal tikah a thin a phangzet."},"30":{"text":"Ralbawipa cun Judah mi pawl in Paul parih sual an puhmi hi ziang bik so a si, ti theihfiang a duh ruangah a thaisun ah Paul ih thir cikcin cu a phoihter ih Puithiam upa pawl le Khonsil upa an zatein tongkhawm aw dingah thu a pek. Cule Paul cu a hruai ih an hmaiah a dinter.","title":"Khonsil Hmaiah Paul An Thlenpi"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul in Khonsil upa pawl cu hmaiton tein a zoh hai ih, “Ka phunpi Israel mi pawl, tuihsun tiang Pathian hmaiih ka nunzia ahhin phuhrun awknak malte hman ka nei lo,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"Puithiam Saang Ananias in Paul kiangih a dingmi pawl hnenah Paul kha a kaa ah hei beng dingin thu a pek."},"3":{"text":"Cutikah Paul in, “Nang siirang hnihmi phar, Pathian in nangmah a lo beng ding a si. Daan vekih ka thu rel dingah kha tawkah na to; asinain ‘Hei beeng uh,’ tiih thu na peknak in cuih Daan cu na buar a si!” tiah a sawn."},"4":{"text":"Paul kiangih a ummi pawl in, “Pathian ih Puithiam Saang na hmuhsuam a si!” tiah Paul cu an ti."},"5":{"text":"Paul cun, “Israel mi u le nau pawl, Puithiam Saang a si ti ka thei lo! Ca Thianghlim sungah, ‘Na miphun a uktu na relsiat lo pei,’ tiin a um a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Paul in a rami pawl lakah a hrek cu Sadusi an si ih a hrek cu Farasi an si, ti kha a hmuh tikah Khonsil upa hmaiah cun a au ih, “Ka phunpi Israel mi pawl, kei hi Farasi ka si, Farasi pawl ih fapa ka si. A thimi pawl an nung sal ding, tiih ruahsannak ka neih ruangah atu hitawk ah hin tazacuainak ka tong,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cutiih a sim ṭheh vete in Farasi le Sadusi pawl cu an to aw ih cutawkih a ummi pawl lakah ṭhenṭhek awknak a suak."},"8":{"text":"(Ziangahtile Sadusi pawl cun minung hi an thih hnuah cun an thosal nawn lo ding; vancungmi khal an um lo, thlarau khal an um lo, tiah an ti. Asinain Farasi pawl cun a pathum tein a um tiah an zum.)"},"9":{"text":"An au cu a ring deuhdeuh ih Farasi a si mi Daanthiam hrekkhat pawl an ding ih nasa zetin an au ve: “Hi pa sualnak hi malte hman kan hmu lo. Thlarau a si lole vancungmi in a hnenah a sim ngaingai a si thei meen sokhaw!” tiah an ti."},"10":{"text":"Nasa tukih an tawh awk ruangah Paul kha an bauhthlek thluh ding tiah ralbawipa a thin a phang. Curuangah mipi lak ihsin Paul kha vung hruai ih ṭankulh ih fehpi dingin a ralkap pawl thu a pek."},"11":{"text":"Cuih zanah cun Bawipa cu Paul kiangah a ding ih, “Paul, zianghman ṭih hlah! Hitawk Jerusalem khua ah ka thu theihpitu na si zo, hivek thotho in Rom khua khalah na si hrih ding,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"A thaizing ah Judah mi ṭhenkhat pawl an tongkhawm aw ih khua an khang. Paul an thah thei hlanah cun rawl ei lo ding le tidai khal in lo dingin thu an kam aw.","title":"Paul Thah An Tum"},"13":{"text":"Hitiin hmun khatih khua a khangtu hi minung sawmli leng lo an si."},"14":{"text":"Cutiin Puithiam upa le upa dang pawl hnenah an feh ih, “Paul kan thah thei hlanah cun zianghman ei lo le in lo dingin thu kan kam aw zo."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah nanmah le Khonsil pawl in Rom ralbawipa hnenah thu hei cah uhla, Paul thuhla kim deuh in theih kan duh, tiin ti awter uhla, Paul kha hitawk ah run hruaiter uh.
