Cule kannih in kan rak bawh pei ih hitawk a thlen man hlanah kan rak that pei,” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul farnu-ih fapa in cutiih an phiarthupmi cu a theih ruangah ṭankulh-ah cun a feh ih Paul kha a va sim."},"17":{"text":"Cule Paul in ralbawi pakhat kha a ko ih a hnenah, “Hi tlangvalpa hi ralbawipa hnenah hei hruai aw; thuruah ding pakhat a nei,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cuih ralbawi cun a hruai ih an hotu ralbawipa hnenah a fehpi ih, “Thawngtla pa Paul in i ko ih hi tlangvalpa hi na hnenih ratpi dingah i fial, ziangahtile thu pakhat lo sim ding a nei,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"An hotu ralbawipa cun tlangvalpa cu a kut in a hruai ih anmah pahnih lawng an feh ih, “Ziang so i ruah duh?” tiah a sut."},"20":{"text":"Tlangvalpa cun, “Judah mi hotu upa pawl in Paul thuhla-ah Khonsil pawl in famkim deuh in thu theih an duh tiah an ti-awter ding ih thaisun ah Paul kha Khonsil upa hnenah run hruai dingin lo dil dingah lungkimnak an nei zo."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla an thu cu ngai hlah aw; ziangahtile minung sawmli leng lo in Paul kha an rak bawh ding. Paul an thah hlanah cun zianghman ei lo le in lo dingin thu an kam aw. Atu-ah an ralring aw thluh zo ih nangmah ih thurelcat dingmi lawng an hngak lai,” tiah a sim."},"22":{"text":"Ralbawipa cun, “Ka hnenih na simmi hi zo ih hnen hmanah va phuang hlah,” tiah a ti ih tlangvalpa cu a tlunter."},"23":{"text":"Cule ralkap hotu ralbawipa cun a kuthnuai ralbawi pahnih a ko ih, “Sisaria ih feh dingah ralkap zahnih timtuah uh. Cule rang ralkap sawmsarih le feipi ralkap zahnih khal timtuah uhla tuihzan nazi pakua ih suak thei dingin ralring hai seh.","title":"Mangki Felix Hnenah An Kuat"},"24":{"text":"Paul ih to dingah rang tla ngaihtuah uhla Mangki bawi Felix hnenah himte in thlenter uh,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cule ralbawipa in a tanglam vekin ca a kuat."},"26":{"text":"“Klaudius Lisias in Mangki Bawipa Felix hnenah cibai bukin ca ka lo kuat."},"27":{"text":"Na hnenih ka hun kuat mipa hi Judah mi pawl in an kai ih a thah an tum. Rom mi a si ti ka thei ih ka ralkap pawl thawn kan va run suak."},"28":{"text":"A sual an puhmi hi ziang a si bik ti theih duh ah Khonsil upa hnenah ka fehpi."},"29":{"text":"Ka theih ngah tikah a tuahmi cu thah tlak sualnak a si lo ih thawng thlak tlak sualnak khal a si lo; sual an puhmi cu anmah ih daan thuhla men khi a si."},"30":{"text":"Cule amah thah duh ah khua an khang ti ka theih ruangah hmakhatte ah na hnenah ka hun kuat. Sual a puhtu pawl khal cu na hnenah ra in na hmai rori ih tazacuai dingin ka sim hai a si,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Ralbawipa ih thupekmi vekin ralkap pawl cun an tuah. Paul cu an hruai ih cuih zanah Antipatris tiang an fehpi."},"32":{"text":"A thaizing ah lei ralkap pawl cu an kir ih rang ralkap pawl in an thlun."},"33":{"text":"Sisaria khua an thlenpi ih Mangki Bawipa kutah cakuat cu an pek hnuah a kut sungah Paul cu an ap."},"34":{"text":"Mangki Bawipa in cakuat cu a siar ih, “Khuitawk pengin so na rat?” tiah Paul kha a sut. Silisia pengin a si, ti a theih tikah a hnenah,"},"35":{"text":"“Thu a lo khingtu pawl an thlen tikah na thu cu ka rel leh ding,” tiah a ti. Cule Paul cu Siangpahrang Herod ih a rak sakmi innpi Mangki Bawipa ih zung sungah ralkap ih kil dingin thu a pek."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni nga hnuah Puithiam Saang Ananias cu upa ṭhenkhat le sih-ni Tertullas thawn Sisaria ah an feh. Mangki Bawipa Felix hmaiah an suak ih Paul taza an cuainak cu an sim.","title":"Paul Cu Judah Mi In Taza An Cuai"},"2":{"text":"Cule Paul cu an ko ih sih-ni Tertullas cun Paul sual an puhnak thu cu hiti in a sim: “Mangki Bawipa, fimnak thawn nangmah in in hruai ruangah caan reipi daihnak kan ngah ih kan ram ṭhatnak hrangah rem ṭulmi pawl tampi rem a si zo."},"3":{"text":"Himi kan hmuh tikah na tuahmi pawl hi khuazakipah mi in an pom ih na parah kan lung a awi ngaingai."},"4":{"text":"Na tikcu tamtuk ka lo laksak pang ding ti ka phan ruangah kan sim duhmi kha a tawi thei sungin kan hun sim pei ih zaangfahte in in ngaisak hram aw."},"5":{"text":"Himi pa hi mi buaiter theizet le ṭihnungza a si tiin kan hmu. Leilung tlun hmun kipih Judah mi pawl a buaiter ringring ih Nazareth bu an timi pawl sungah hruaitu amah hi a si."},"6":{"text":"Kan Biakinn borhhlawhter a tum ih culai ah kan kai. (Cule kan daan vekin a thu rel kan tum;"},"7":{"text":"asinain ralbawipa Lisias a ra ih hranhram in in ra long."},"8":{"text":"Cuih hnuah Lisias in Paul tazacuai a duhtu pawl cu na hnenah hin feh hai seh, tiah thu a pek.) Nangmah in hi pa hi thu na sut ahcun amah ih hnen ihsin sual kan puhmi pawl hi nangmah rori in na thei ko ding,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cutiih a simmi cu Judah mi pawl in an bawm ih a simmi hi a zatein a dik ṭheh a si an ti."},"10":{"text":"Mangki Bawipa in Paul cu thu sim dingah a kut in a zaap ih Paul in Mangki Bawipa hnen ah: “Nangmah cu hi ram sungah hin kum reipi thureltu a ṭuantu na si ti ka thei ih atu-ah na hmaiah ka ṭanhmun sim dingin caan ka neih ruangah ka lung a awizet.","title":"A ṭannak Thu Felix Hmaiah A Sim"},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Pathian bia dingin ka hung fehnak hi ni hleihnih hnakin a tam hrih lo, ti cu na thei ko ding."},"12":{"text":"Biakinn sungah zo thawn hman thu kan el aw lo, ti cu Judah mi in an thei ṭheh. Sinakok ah siseh, khawpi sung hmun dangdang khalah siseh, misenpi ka tokhroknak an hmu hrimhrim lo ding."},"13":{"text":"Cule atu-ah na hmaiih sual in puhmi pawl hi a dik taktak a si tiah an lo hmuh thei fawn lo ding."},"14":{"text":"Ka tuah taktak tiin na hmaiah ka ti duhmi cu hihi a si: Kan pupa pawl ih Pathian ka biaknak ah hin Lamzin kan timi ka thlun; annih in cuih Lamzin cu a dik lo an ti. Sikhalsehla Moses Daan sungih nganmi hmuahhmuah le profet pawl ih nganmi cabu sung ummi hmuahhmuah khal ka zummi an si ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Anmah vek thothoin keimah khal Pathian hnenah ruahsannak ka nei ve. Cuih ruahsannak cu, mi hmuahhmuah in, miṭha khal misia khal, thihnak ihsin an tho sal ding, timi a si."},"16":{"text":"Cuti cun Pathian hmai le minung hmaiah phuhrun awknak nei lo dingin ka zuam thei tawk ka zuam ringring."},"17":{"text":"“Kum reipi sung Jerusalem khua ka thlen nawn lo ruangah ka miphun pawl bomnak ah tangka pe ding le thawinak pe dingin Jerusalem ah ka hung feh."},"18":{"text":"A daan vekin thianfainak ka tuah ṭheh hnuah a tlunih ka simmi pawl ka tuah rero laiah Biakinn sungah in hmu. Culai ah ka hnenah miburpi an um lo; buainak khal a um lo."},"19":{"text":"Asinain cutawkah cun Asia ram ihsin a rami Judah mi hrekkhat an um. Cupawl cu ka parah lungkimlonak an neih a si ahcun na hmai rori-ah hin anmah ra in mawhthluknak cu ra sim ve ding an si."},"20":{"text":"Asilole hitawk ih a um pawl hin Khonsil upa pawl hmaiih ka din laiah ka sual tiih an hmuhmi lo sim hai seh."},"21":{"text":"An hmaiih ka din laiah thil pakhat lawng ka aupi mi a um: ‘Mithi pawl cu nunnak ah an tho sal ding,’ tiin ka zum ruangah tuihsun ah hin thu in khiing a si,” tiah a sim."},"22":{"text":"Cule Felix cu cuih Lamzin thuhla ṭha zetih a theitu a si ruangah an thu rel cu a cawlter ih, “Ralbawipa Lisias a ra thlen tikah nan thu cu ka rel leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Paul a kiltu ralbawi cu, “Paul hi ṭhatein kilveng uhla, malte in luatter deuh uhla a ṭul a haimi pawl cu a rualpi pawl in pe hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Ni malte a rei hnuah Felix cu a nupi Drusilla thawn an ra. Drusilla cu Judah mi a si. Paul kha a ko ih Paul in Jesuh Khrih zumnak thuhla kha a sim ih cumi cu an ngai."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul in ṭhatnak thu, mah le mah suup awknak thu le a ra thleng dingmi Thuṭhennak Ni thu pawl a sim tikah Felix cu a thin a phang ih, “Tu cu va kir hrih aw. Tikcu ka neih tikah ka lo ko sal leh ding,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Felix cun Paul in tangka i pe sehla tiah ruahsannak a nei. Curuangah Paul cu a ko leuhleuh ih thu a ruahpi ṭheu."},"27":{"text":"Kum hnih a rei hnuah Mangki Felix cu Porsius Festas in a hnaṭuan a thleng. Judah mi pawl hnen ihsin mithmai ṭha ngah a duh ruangah Felix in Paul cu suah loin thawng sungah a taanta."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Festas cu cuih ram a thlennak ni thum hnuah Sisaria ihsin Jerusalem ah a feh.","title":"Rom Siangpahrang Hnenah Azu A Khan"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkah Puithiam upa pawl le Judah mi hotu pawl in Paul parih sual an puhnak thuhla pawl cu an rak sim."},"3":{"text":"Paul cu lamzin ih thah an duh ruangah Jerusalem ah run hruai dingin Festas cu an dil."},"4":{"text":"Festas in, “Paul cu Sisaria khua ih thawngtlami a si ih keimah khal Sisaria ah ka kir cing ding."},"5":{"text":"Nan hotu pawl cu keimah thawn Sisaria ah ra hai sehla himi pa in sualnak a neih a si ahcun ra sim hai seh,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Festas cu an hnenah ni riat a si lole ni hra hrawng a caam hnuah Sisaria ah a tlung. Inn a thlen ih thaisun ah Festas cu a thurelnak zung sungah a to ih Paul cu rak hruai dingin thu a pek."},"7":{"text":"Paul cu a ra thleng ih Jerusalem ihsin a rami Judah mi pawl cu a kiangkap ah an ding vialvial ih nasa zetin sual an puh; asinain sual an puhmi cu a dik taktakmi a si tiah an langter thei lo."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul cu a ṭang ve ih, “Judah mi daan thu-ah siseh, Biakinn thu-ah siseh, Rom siangpahrang ih thu-ah siseh, sualnak zianghman ka tuah lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Asinain Judah mi hnen ihsin mithmai ṭha ngah a duh ruangah Festas in Paul cu, “Jerusalem ah feh in cutawkah ka hmaiah taza lo cuai hai sehla na lung a kim pei maw?” tiah a sut."},"10":{"text":"Paul in, “Rom Siangpahrang ih thurelnak hmaiah atu hi ka ding ih hitawk ah taza in cuai hai seh. Nangmah ih na theih vekin Judah mi hnenah thilsual zianghman ka tuah lo."},"11":{"text":"Daan ka buar ih thihnak tlak thilsual ka tuahmi a um ahcun luat ningla tiah ka dil lo. Sikhalsehla sual in puhmi ah hin thudik zianghman a um lo a si ahcun zohman in Judah mi pawl kut sungah in thlenpi thei lo ding. Rom Siangpahrang hnenah azu ka khan a si!” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cule Festas in amah ruahnak petu pawl thawn an tonkhawm awk hnuah Paul cu, “Rom siangpahrang hnenih azu na khan vekin a hnenah na feh ding,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cuih hnu caan tawkfang a rei hnuah Siangpahrang Agrippa le Bernis cu Festas cibai buk ih biata dingin Sisaria ah an ra tlawng.","title":"Agrippa Le Bernis Hnenah Thu A Sim"},"14":{"text":"Ni rei nawn an caam hnuah Festas in Paul ih thuhla cu siangpahrang Agrippa hnenah cun a sim. “Felix in thawngih a thlakta mipa pakhat Sisaria ah hin a um."},"15":{"text":"Jerusalem ih khual ka vung tlawn laiah Judah mi puithiam upa pawl le upa dang pawl in taza an cuai ih amah cu thah dingah in dil."},"16":{"text":"Asinain ka sim mi cu: Kannih Rom mi pawl cun mi pakhatkhat taza an cuai tikah tazacuaitu thawn hmaiton tein amah a ṭannak thu simnak caan a neih ve hlanah cun tazacuai mipa kha an kut sungih pek cu kan daan a si lo, tiah ka ti."},"17":{"text":"Hitawkih an rat tikah ni khat hman hngak loin a thaisun rori-ah thurelnak zungah ka to ih cupa cu rak hruai uh tiah thu ka pek."},"18":{"text":"Amah a duh lotu pawl cu an ding ih thu an sim, asinain sual an puh hmang ding tiih ka ruah tlukin an puh lo."},"19":{"text":"An biaknak thu le Jesuh an timi pa a thi ih Paul in, ‘A nungsal,’ tiih a simmi ruangah thu el awknak an rak nei a si."},"20":{"text":"Hi thuhla-ah hin ziangtinso thufiang ka theih thei ding, tiah ka thinlung ka ṭhen aw thei lo; curuangah Paul cu Jerusalem ah feh in sual an lo puhmi thu hi cutawkah rel sehla na lung a kim pei maw?” tiah ka sut."},"21":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul cun azu a khan ih amah khal kil hrih ding le Rom Siangpahrang ih a thu rel leh ding in a dil. Curuangah amah kha Rom siangpahrang hnenih ka kuat thei hlan cu ralkap pawl ih kil dingah thu ka pek a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Agrippa in Festas cu, “Cupa ih thusimmi cu keimah rori in theih ve ka duh,” tiah a ti. Festas in, “Thaisun ah na thei ding,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"A thaisun ah Agrippa le Bernis cu sunglawi zet le ropi zetin, tonkhawmnak khaan sungah cun an vung lut ih ralbawi upa bik pawl le khawsung tlangsuak upa pawl in an thlun. Cule Festas ih thupeknak vekin Paul cu an vun hruai."},"24":{"text":"Festas in, “Siangpahrang Agrippa le hitawk ih a rami pawl: Hi nan hmuh mipa hi Judah mi hmuahhmuah in, hitawk ah siseh Jerusalem ah siseh, an duh lonak thu ka hnenih an thlentermi a si. Nung tlak a si lo ti tiangin an au."},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla thah tlak sualnak a tuahmi ka hmu thei lo. Cule amah in Rom siangpahrang hnenih azu a khan ruangah cutawkih kuat dingin thu ka relcat zo."},"26":{"text":"Asinain Rom siangpahrang hnenih a thuhla ngan ding felfai-in ka thei tuk lo. Curuangah atu-ah nan hmaiah hin ka rak hruaiter. Siangpahrang Agrippa, nangmah ih hmai rori-ah ka hun suahpi. A thuhla ka zingzoi hnuah ngan ding ziangtal ka nei pei maw, ti duh ah a si."},"27":{"text":"Ziangahtile keimah ih hrang hrimhrim ah thawngtla pakhat thu an khiinnak thuhla zianghman fiangtein ngan loih kuat cu a mawi lo a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Agrippa in Paul hnenah, “Na thuhla cu na sim thei,” tiah a ti. Paul in a kut a hun thlir ih a ṭannak thu cu hiti in a sim:","title":"Paul In Agrippa Hmaiah Thu A Sim"},"2":{"text":"“Siangpahrang Agrippa, tuihsun nangmah ih hmaiah Judah mi pawl ih sual in puhmi thu pawl let ve theinak caan ka ngah ruangah mi vanṭha ngaingai ka si tiah ka ruat aw."},"3":{"text":"Judah mi daan hmuahhmuah le thu an el awknak pawl a thei ṭhehtu na si ruangah mi vanṭha ih ka ruah awk cuangnak cu a si. Thinsautein i ngai hram aw, tiah zaangfah ka lo dil."},"4":{"text":"“Judah mi pawl hmuahhmuah in ka nuncan daan cu ka nauhak lai ihsin in thei ṭheh. Ka nuncan khuasaknak thuhla pawl, a hmaisa-ah keimah ih miphun hnenah, a neta-ah Jerusalem ah, a zatein an theih ṭhehmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Ka thuhla cu sim an duh a si ahcun an sim pei, an theih ringring mi a si. A hramthok ihsin kei cu kan biaknak lamah cun a fektukmi Farasi pawl ih sungtel ka si."},"6":{"text":"Tuihsun hitawk ah ka thu rel dingin ka dinnak khal hi Pathian in kan pu le kan pa pawl hnenih thukamnak a tuahmi kha ruahsannak ka neih ruangah a si."},"7":{"text":"Cutiih ruahsannak ka neihmi cu kan miphun phun hleihnih pawl in Pathian kha a sun a zan in an rak biak laiih ruahsannak an rak neih mi thotho a si. Cuih ruahsannak ruangah cun Siangpahrang Bawipa, Judah mi pawl in taza in cuainak hi a si!"},"8":{"text":"Hitawkih a rami pawl, Pathian in mithi a thawhter tihi ziangah so a cang thei lomi thilah nan ruat?"},"9":{"text":"“Nazareth mi Jesuh ih thuhla cu ka do thei tawkin ka do ding, tiah keimah rori in ka rak ruah dahmi a si."},"10":{"text":"Cumi cu Jerusalem khua ih ka rak tuah rero dahmi a si. Puithiam upa pawl hnen ihsin thuneihnak ka ngah ih Pathian minung pawl tampi thawngah ka thlak. Thah dingih thurel an si tikah ka lungkimnak langternak ah ka kut ka rak tung ve ṭheu."},"11":{"text":"Voi tampi sinakok sung rori-ah ka hremter hai ih an zumnak bansan hai seh tiah ka zuam thei tawkin ka rak zuam. An parah ka thin a heng tuk ih anmah hrem dingin ramdang khua pawl tiang ka thleng dah a si."},"12":{"text":"“Cutiin anmah hrem duh rori-ah cun Puithiam upa pawl hnen ihsin thuneihnak ca ka lak ih Damaskas khua ah ka feh.","title":"A Lungthlengnak Thu A Sim (Dung 9.1-19 ; 22.6-16)"},"13":{"text":"Maw siangpahrang Bawipa, sun laifangih Damaskas lamzinih ka feh rero laiah ni hnakin a tleu deuhmi tleunak van ihsin a rung thleng ih keimah le ka fehpi mi pawl ih kimvel kha a run tlet."},"14":{"text":"Kan zatein leilungah kan tlu ih Hebru ṭong in aw pakhat ka thei ih, ‘Saul, Saul, ziangah so i hrem rero? Cawcang in a neitu pa ih fung a saih tikah amah a natter awk sawn vekin nangmah na nater aw sawn a si,’ tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"‘Bawipa, zoso na si?’ tiah ka sut. Cule Bawipa in, ‘Na hremmi Jesuh ka si."},"16":{"text":"Tho awla na ke in ding aw. Keimah i rian dingin ka lo hril duh ruangah na hnenah ka lang a si. Tuihsun ih kei i tonnak thu le hmailamih ka lo hmuh dingmi thu pawl hi midang hnenah na sim pei ih ka thutheitu na si pei."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah cu Israel mi le Zentail mi hnenah ka lo thlah ding ih an kutsung ihsin ka lo runsuak ding."},"18":{"text":"An mit na mengter ding ih thimnak sung ihsin tleunak ah, Satan cahnak sung ihsin Pathian hnenah na kirter hai ding. Cuti cun keimah in zumnak thawngin an sualnak tla cu ngaidam an si ding ih Pathian ih thianhlimtermi pawl lakah an tel ve ding,’ tiah i ti."},"19":{"text":"“Cuti a si ruangah, Siangpahrang Agrippa, van ihsin langnak ka hmuhmi ih thu cu ka el thei lo.","title":"Paul In A Hnaṭuannak A Sim"},"20":{"text":"Hmaisabik ah Damaskas khua ah, cule Jerusalem khua ah, cuih hnuah Judea ramsung hmuahhmuah le Zentail mi hnen khalah ka feh ih, ‘Nan sual siir aw uhla Pathian hnenah kir uh; cule nan sualsirnak langtertu hnaṭuan kha ṭuan uh,’ tiah thu ka sim vivo."},"21":{"text":"Cutiih ka ti ruangah Judah mi pawl in Biakinn sungah in kai ih a thah tiangin in tum a si."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla tuihsun tiangah hin Pathian in i bawm ih atu-ah, nanmah a tum a seen ti loin nan zate hmaiah ka hmuhmi thu cu ka sim a si. Ka simmi thu hi Moses in siseh, profet pawl in siseh a cang ding tiih an rak sim ciami an si."},"23":{"text":"Cutiih an simmi cu ziang a si tile: tleunak rundamnak thu cu Judah mi le Zentail mi pawl hnenih than dingah Messiah in tuarnak a tong ding ih, cuih hnuah thihnak ihsin a nungsaaltu hmaisa bik a si ding, ti a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Paul in a ṭannak thuhla cutiin a sim tikah Festas in, “Paul, na aa zo a si! Na zir tamtuknak in a lo aatter zo a si hi!” tiah a hei auh."},"25":{"text":"Cutikah Paul in, “Bawipa Festas, ka aa lo sokhaw! Lungfim tein thutak ka lo sim a si!"},"26":{"text":"Maw Siangpahrang Agrippa, na hnenah cun suupmi nei lo ralṭha zetin ka ṭong; ziangahtile nang cu hi thu pawl hmuahhmuah hi a thei ṭhehtu na si. Pakhat hman hrelh loin na hminsin ṭheh ko ding tiah ka zum, ziangahtile hiti ih ka simmi pawl hi zo ih theih lomi, a kelkawm-ih thuhmi pawl an si lo."},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang Agrippa, profet pawl na zum maw? Na zum a si, ti ka thei!” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Agrippa in Paul cu, “Hi tikcu tawite sungah Khristian canter i tum maw si?” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Paul in, “A caan tawite ah siseh, caan saupi ah siseh, nangmah le tuihsun hitawk ih ka thu a ngaitu hmuahhmuah hi nan zatein, hi ka kutih thir cikcin siarlo, keimah vek si ṭheh uhla tihi Pathian hnenih ka thlacamnak a si,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cule Siangpahrang Bawipa, Mangki Bawipa, Bernis le midang pawl tla an tho ih,"},"31":{"text":"an feh hnuah pakhat le pakhat, “Hi pa hi thah tlak le thawng thlak tlak sualnak a tuahmi a um ual lo,” tiah an ti aw."},"32":{"text":"Cun Agrippa in Festas hnenah, “Rom siangpahrang hnenah azu khan hlah sehla, hi pa hi thlah theih mai a si ko ding naón!” tiah a ti."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Italy ah lawng ih feh dingin thu relcat a si tikah Paul le thawngtla dang pawl cu Rom ralkap “Siangpahrang Ralkap Burpi,” timi a hotu ralbawi Julius kutah an pek.","title":"Rom Ah Paul A Feh"},"2":{"text":"Asia ram tangphawlawng colhnak hmun pawl a pal phah vivo ding mi Adramittium khua ihsin a rami tangphawlawng to in kan feh. Masidonia ram Thesalonika khuami Aristarkas khal kan hnenah a tel ve."},"3":{"text":"A thaisun ah Sidon kan thleng. Julius cu Paul parah zaangfahnak thinlung a nei ih Paul cu a ṭulmi thilri pawl a ngah theinak dingah a rualpi pawl va leen le va ton theinak tikcu tla a pek."},"4":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin kan feh ih thli kanmah lam lawnglawngih a hran ruangah Saipras tikulh thli-upnak lam in kan feh."},"5":{"text":"Tifinriat kha Silisia le Pamfilia zawn ihsin kan tan ih Lisia ram Mira khua kan thleng."},"6":{"text":"Cutawkah ralbawipa cun Alexandria ihsin Italy ih a feh dingmi tangphawlawng a hmu ih cuih tangphawlawng ahcun in fehter."},"7":{"text":"Nuamtete in kan feh ih ni tampi kan rei hnuah a netnak ah harzet in Snidas khua zawn kan thleng. Cutawklam zawh in feh ding thli in in kham ruangah Krete tikulh leilung phen thli-upnak lam ihsin kan feh ih Salmon ram-forhlei kiang ihsin kan lan."},"8":{"text":"Tifinriat kap naih in kan feh vivo ih harzet in Himnak Longcolh Hmun an timi kan thleng. Cumi cu La sia khua ihsin a hlat lo."},"9":{"text":"Cutawkah cun reipi kan cawl ih Sualtlennak Ni a luan zo ih tangphawlawng in khualtlawn cu ṭihnung a si thlang. Curuangah Paul in hiti in an hnenah ruahnak a pek:"},"10":{"text":"“U le nau pawl, hi tawk ihsin kan lamzin cu ṭihnungza a si ding. Nan phurhmi thilri le tangphawlawng hi siatralnak a tong ding ih kan nunnak khal a cemral ding a si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul ih simmi hnakin tangphawlawng neitupa ih simmi sawn kha ralbawipa ih thinlung sungah a lut."},"12":{"text":"Cuih an tangphawlawng colhnak cu thlatang tikcu ahcun umnak a ṭhat lo ruangah mi tam sawn cun a cang thei a si ahcun Finiks thleng feh lawlaw ih cutawkih thlatang sung um kha an duh. Finiks cu Krete tikulh ih tangphawlawng colhnak a si ih thlanglam nitlaknak lam le saklam nitlaknak lam hoi in a um."},"13":{"text":"Thlanglam ihsin simthli neemte a hung hrang ih an tumtah vekih feh thei dingin an ruat. Curuangah tangphawlawng hrennak thirkawn kha ti sungin an hnuk ih Krete tikap naih vivo in kan feh.","title":"Thlipi A Hrang"},"14":{"text":"Asinain rei lote-ah, “Nisuah Saklam Zothlipi,” cak zetin Krete lam ihsin a rung hrang."},"15":{"text":"Kan tangphawlawng cu a run deen ih cuih thli cu kan pah thei nawn lo ruangah beidong in kan um ih kan tangphawlawng cu thli in a duhnak poh ah a fehpi vivo."},"16":{"text":"Kauda tikulh ih thlanglam kan thlen tikah cun thli in phen deuh ruangah a zia a um deuh. Cutawkah cun harsa zetin tangphawlawng ih a kenmi vokkuanglawng cu rem deuhin kan ret."},"17":{"text":"Tangphawlawng parah vokkuanglawng cu an vun hnuk ih hri in tangphawlawng ahcun fektein an ṭemcih. Libia ram tikap kiangih ti sungih vunnel tlangtluan pah ding an phan ruangah tangphawlawng cu a puanzar an ṭhum ih thli in a duhduhnak ah a so ih."},"18":{"text":"Thlipi a hrang thotho ih a thaisun ahcun tangphawlawng ih phurhmi thilri hrekkhat cu ti sungah an hlon."},"19":{"text":"A tipsun ah tangphawlawng ih thilthuam hrekkhat an hlon."},"20":{"text":"Ni tampi sung, ni le arsi pawl kan hmu thei lo; thli cu nasa zetin a hrang ringring. A netnak ahcun kan nung ding ti ruahsannak malte hman kan nei nawn lo."},"21":{"text":"Tangphawlawng parih mi pawl cu rawl loin ni tampi an um hnuah an hmaiah Paul a ding ih, “Unau pawl, ka thusimmi in ngai uhcila Krete tikulh ihsin feh loin um nungla hi bangtuk cemnak le ralnak hi kan tong lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu-ah nan thinphang hlah uh, tiah ka lo sim. Tangphawlawng hi cu kan sung ding naón kanmah cu kan hloral lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Ziangahtile mizanah i neitu le ka biakmi Pathian ih vancungmi ka hnenah a rung ih,"},"24":{"text":"‘Paul, ṭih hlah aw! Rom siangpahrang ih hmaiah na din a ṭul a si! Pathian na parih a ṭhat ruangah nangmah thawn a fehmi pawl hi pakhat hman thi lotein an nunnak a zuah ṭheh ding,’ tiah i ti."},"25":{"text":"Curuangah unau pawl, phang hlah uh! Ziangahtile Pathian ka rinsan ih i sim cia vek cekci in a si ko ding."},"26":{"text":"Asinain tikulh pakhatkhatah thli in in soih ding,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Zan hleilinak a si zo, Mediterranean Tifinriat ahcun thlipi in in hrual ciamco. Zanṭim hrawngah tangphawlawng kiltu pawl in leilung kan naih thlang hmang tiah an zum deuh."},"28":{"text":"Curuangah hri in thirtum an khih ih an vun thlak ih tidai cu pi zakhat le pi kul a thuuk. Malte hnuah an thlak sal ih pi sawmkua a si."},"29":{"text":"Tangphawlawng in lungpi a sawh pang ding ti an phan ruangah a dunglam ihsin a hrennak thirkawn pali an thlak ih thlacam phahin khuavan ding an hngak."},"30":{"text":"Cule lawng hnaṭuan pawl cu tlan an tum; vokkuanglawng kha ti sungah an vun ṭhum ih a hmailam ihsin a hrennak thirkawn ṭhenkhat thla ding vekin an um awter."},"31":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ralbawipa le ralkap pawl hnenah cun Paul in, “Tangphawlawng kiltu pawl tangphawlawng parih an um lo asile nan nun ding ruahsannak zianghman a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Curuangah vokkuanglawng a kaitu hri pawl cu ralkap pawl in an satcat ih vokkuanglawng cu an fen hloter."},"33":{"text":"Khua a van deuh hlanah Paul in rawl ei dingin a fial hai: “Ni hleili sung lungphangin nan um zo ih hi sung hmuahhmuah ah zianghman nan ei lo."},"34":{"text":"Zaangfah ka lo dil: rawl malte tal ei thlang uh. Nan nunnak dingah a ṭul a si. Nan lu parih samphang pakhat hman a hloral lo ding,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cutiih a ti hnuah Paul in saang malte a lak ih an zate hmaiah Pathian hnenah thlacam in saang cu a phel ih a ei."},"36":{"text":"Midang khal an thinlung a hung cak deuh ih rawl malte an ei fingfing."},"37":{"text":"Tangphawlawng parih a ummi cu kan zatein zahnih le sawmsarih le paruk kan si."},"38":{"text":"Tawkfang an ei ṭheh hnuah sangvut hmuahhmuah kha tifinriat sungah an hlon ṭheh ih cuti cun tangphawlawng kha zaang deuh in an tuah."},"39":{"text":"Khua a vang tikah tangphawlawng kiltu pawl in tikap an hmuh tikah khui ram a si ti an thei thei lo. Asinain tikel ih tikap pakhat an hmu ih a cang thei asile cutawkih an tangphawlawng colhter kha an tum.","title":"Tangphawlawng A Siat"},"40":{"text":"Curuangah an tangphawlawng hrennak hri cu an satcat ih a thirkawn cu tifinriat sungah an pilter; cule tangphawlawng hlaunak hri in an ṭemmi an phoih. Cun tangphawlawng hmailam bikah a puanzar kha an zaar ih thli in hmailam ah a sem ih tikap lamah cun kan feh."},"41":{"text":"Asinain tangphawlawng cun vunnel pawng a sawh ih a taang. A hmailam cu vunnel sungah a dawt aw ih a phuak aw thei nawn lo; a dunglam cu tisuar in a hrual ciamco ih a phel kuai thluh."},"42":{"text":"Ralkap pawl cun thawngtla pawl kha ti an leuh ding ih titlang an thlen tikah an tlanhlo thluh ding ti an phan ruangah thah ṭheh hai an tum."},"43":{"text":"Asinain ralbawipa in Paul kha a hum duh ruangah a kham hai. Cule ti a leuh thei pawl cu tangphawlawng ihsin dawp dingah le tikap ah leuh dingin thu a pek."},"44":{"text":"A taangmi pawl in thingpheng maw, tangphawlawng a kuaimi thingphel maw, an pom ih an thlun. Cuti cun kan zatein tikap ah himte in kan thleng."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Himteih tikap kan thlen tikah cuih tikulh cu Malta tikulh a si ti kan thei.","title":"Malta Tikulh Kan Thleng"},"2":{"text":"Cutawkih a rak ummi minung pawl cu kan parah an ṭhazet. Ruah a sur ih a daih tuk ruangah kan hrangah meipi in tih sak ih ṭhazet in in zoh."},"3":{"text":"Paul in thinghreu a va khawm ih meipi-ah cun a thlak. Mei a sat ruangah thing sung ihsin rul a hung suak ih Paul ih kut kha a cuk ih a thlai aw niarniar."},"4":{"text":"Paul ih kut parih rul a thlai awk niarniar an hmuh tikah cutawk tikulh ih minung pawl cun, “Hi pa hi laithat a si ding, tifinriat sung ihsin a luat naón laireltu a khawzing in a nunter lo ding a si hi!” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Paul in rul cu meisa sungah a thinthlak ih amah cu a zianghman a poi lo."},"6":{"text":"Ziangtikah so a hung thlin uun-o ding, a si lole ziangtikah so a sawn ruangro ding, ti kha cutawkih mi pawl cun an hngak. Asinain reizet an hngak ih ziangti hmanih a um lo kha an hmuh tikah an thinlung an thleng sal ih, “Amah hi pathian a si ding!” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cutawk ihsin a nai nawn ah loram a kau nawn a um ih a neitu cu cuih tikulh ih lalpa Publias a si. Publias cun ṭhazet in in zoh ih ni thum sung a mikhual ah kan cang."},"8":{"text":"Publias ih pa cu khurhnat le thisen sungdok in a na ih ihkhun ah a it ringring. A ihnak khaan sungah Paul a lut ih a parah a kut suangin thla a cam ih a dam."},"9":{"text":"Cuih thu an theih tikah cuih tikulh ih midam lo hmuahhmuah an ra ih an dam ṭheh ve."},"10":{"text":"Laksawng tampi in pek ih tangphawlawng in kan feh tikah lamzin hrangih kan ṭul dingmi pawl tla tangphawlawng parah in ret sak."},"11":{"text":"Thla thum hnuah Alexandria ihsin a rami, “Faphir Khawzing,” an timi tangphawlawng kha kan to. Cuih tangphawlawng cu thlatang sung cuih tikulh ih a rak ummi a si.","title":"Malta Ihsin Rom Khua Ah"},"12":{"text":"Sirakus khawpi kan thleng ih cutawkah ni thum kan caam."},"13":{"text":"Cutawkin kan suak sal ih Rezium an timi khua kan thleng. A thaisun ah thlanglam ihsin thli a hung hrang ih ni hnih hnuah Puteoli khua kan thleng."},"14":{"text":"Cutawkah zumtu unau pawl an rak um ih an hnenah zarh khat caam dingin in dil. Cule cutawk ihsin Rom khua kan thleng."},"15":{"text":"Rom ih a ummi zumtu unau pawl in kan thawmvang an theih tikah Appius Dawr an timi khua le Riahbuk Pathum an timi khua tiang in ra hmuak. Paul cu anmah a hmuh tikah Pathian a lawm ih a lungtho in thazaang a ngah ngaingai."},"16":{"text":"Rom khua kan thlen tikah Paul cu amahte in an umter ih ralkap pakhat an kilter.","title":"Rom Khua-ah"},"17":{"text":"Ni thum hnuah Paul in cutawk hrawngih a ummi Judah upa pawl kha tongkhawm dingah a sawm. An rat tikah Paul in an hnenah, “Ka phunpi Israel mi pawl, kan Israel miphun le kan pupa pawl hnen ihsin kan ngahmi kan nun daan parah zianghman siatsuahnak ka tuah lo naón Jerusalem ah thawng in thlak ih tlunah Rom pawl ih kutah in pe."},"18":{"text":"Thu in sut hnuah thih tlak sualnak zianghman ka tuah lo ti kha an hmu ih Rom pawl cun a thlah in duh."},"19":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cumicu Judah mi pawl in an el tikah ka phunpi parah zianghman mawhthluk ding ka nei lo naón Rom siangpahrang hnenih azu khaan lo a theih nawn lo."},"20":{"text":"Curuangah nanmah ton le nan hnenih thusim ka duhnak a si. A ngaingai ti ahcun hiti ih thir cikcin ih khih ka sinak cu Israel mi in an ruahsan ringringmi pa ih ruangah a si,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Annih in Paul hnenah, “Na thuhla ah hin Judea ram ihsin cakuat zianghman kan ngahmi a um lo. Na thuhla a sia a ṭha simtu dingah khilam ihsin a ra thlengtu kan milai zohman an um fawn lo."},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na ruahnak cu a theih kan duhzet, ziangahtile nan pawl thu hi hmunzakipah mi in an relsia a si ti kan thei,” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Curuangah Paul thawn ni an tin aw ih Paul umnak ahcun an ni tin ni ah mi tampi an ra suak. Zing ihsin zan tiang, Pathian Uknak thu cu a simfiang ciamco ih, Moses Daan cabu sung ihsin le profet pawl ih canganmi sung ihsin la tahratin Jesuh ih thu kha an thinlung sungah lut dingin a sim."},"24":{"text":"A simmi in mihrek cu an thinlung a fiangter, asinain mihrek cun an zum lo."},"25":{"text":"Paul in thu pakhat a sim ih cuih thu ruangah an lung a rual thei lo ih an ṭiakdarh aw ṭheh. A simmi cu, “Thlarau Thianghlim in, Profet Isaiah hmangin, nan pu le nan pa pawl hnenih a simmi thu cu a dikzet a si."},"26":{"text":"A rak simmi cu: ‘Hi minung pawl hnenah va feh awla va sim aw; Nan ngai rero ding naón nan thei lo ding; Nan zoh rero ding naón nan hmu lo ding."},"27":{"text":"Ziangahtile an thinlung a pit, an hna a set ih an mit a caw. Cutin a si lole an mit in an hmu ding; An hna in an thei ding ih, an thinlung in an theithiam ding. Ka lam an hoikir ding ih ka damter hai ding a si, tiah Pathian in a ti,’,” tihi a si.","ref":"Isai 6.9-10"},"28":{"text":"Cule Paul in a netnak ah, “Pathian ih rundamnak Thuthang cu Zentail mi hnenah thlenter a si zo, tihi nan theih a ṭul a si. Annih in cuih Thuthang cu an ngai ding!” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"(Paul in cutiin a sim ṭheh hnuah Judah mi pawl cu an ṭiak ih anmah le anmah nasa zetin cuih thu-ah an el aw ciamco.)"},"30":{"text":"Paul cu amahte a saanmi innah kum hnih sung a um. Amah ton duhih a rami hmuahhmuah kha ṭhatein a rak tong."},"31":{"text":"Ralṭhazet le zalen zetin Pathian Uknak thu kha a sim ih Bawi Jesuh Khrih ih thu khal a zirh."}}}}},"45":{"info":{"name":"Rom","shortname":"Rom","abbr":[],"desc":"Rom khuami hnenih paul cakuat"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh ih siahhlawh le a tirhthlahmi, Pathian in a Thuthang ṭha phuangtu dingah a hril ih a kawhmi keimah Paul in ca ka lo kuat."},"2":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim sungih ngan vekin cuih Thuthang ṭha cu Pathian in a profet pawl hnenih a tiam ciami a si."},"3":{"text":"Cuih Thuthang ṭha cu Amah ih Fapa, kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih thuhla a si: minung a sinak lamah cun amah cu David tesinfa sung ihsin suakmi a si."},"4":{"text":"Pathian a sinak le a thianhlimnak lamah cun, thihnak ihsin thawhter a si ruangah Pathian Fapa a sinak cu a nasa zetmi huham thawn langter a si zo."},"5":{"text":"Khrih hrangah le Amah thawngin mi hmuahhmuah in an zum ih an thlun theinak dingah Pathian in a tirhthlahmi sinak cu covo ah i pek."},"6":{"text":"Cu mi hmuahhmuah sungah cun nannih Rom khua ih a ummi khal Jesuh Khrih ta si dingah Pathian ih kawhmi ah nan tel ve a si."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah Rom khua ih a um, Pathian ih a duhdawtmi le a minung si dingih a kawhmi nan zate hnenah hi cakuat hi ka ngan. Kan Pathian le Bawipa Jesuh Khrih ih zaangfahnak le daihnak nan hnenah um hram seh."},"8":{"text":"Leitlun pumpi ah nan zumnak thu a than ruangah nan zapi hrangah Jesuh Khrih thawngin ka lungawinak thu Pathian hnenah ka sim hmaisa a si.","title":"Lungawinak Thlacam"},"9":{"text":"Amah Fapa ih Thuthang ṭha cu ka thinlung hmuahhmuah in ka sim ih a hna ka ṭuanmi Pathian in cuih ka simmi thu cu a dik a si ti i theihpi. Ka thlacam tinte in ka lo hngilh dah lo ti cu Amah Pathian in a thei."},"10":{"text":"Pathian remruat asile voikhat khat tal cu ra lo tlawng thei dingin Amah hnenah ka dil ringring."},"11":{"text":"Ziangahtile nanmah caktertu dingah Pathian thlarau lam laksawng lo ṭawm dingah ka duhzet a si."},"12":{"text":"Cuti ka ti tikah ka zumnak in nanmah ih zumnak thazaang a cakter ih nan zumnak khal in ka thazaang a cakter ve ding ka tinak a si."},"13":{"text":"U le nau tla, himi hi ciing ringring uh: voi tampi nanmah tlawng dingah ka tum zo; asinain ra tlawng suak thei lo dingin i khawkhartu ziangsimaw a um ringring. A dang Zentail mi lakah lungthlengmi ka neihter thei bangin nanmah lak khalah lungthlengmi um thei ding cu ka duhzet a si."},"14":{"text":"Ziangahtile mi hmuahhmuah hnenah ṭuanvo leiba ka nei: mifim le mi-aa hnenah siseh, cathiam le zianghman thiam lomi hnenah siseh, leiba ka nei."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Rom khua ih a ummi nannih hnen khalah Thuthang ṭha phuan cu ka hiar ngaingai a si."},"16":{"text":"Thuthang ṭha hi ka zahpi hrimhrim lo: ziangahtile a zumtu hmuahhmuah rundamnak an ngahnak dingah Pathian ih huham a si. A hmaisa ah Judah mi hrangah a si ih Zentail mi hrang khalah a si ve.","title":"Thuthang ṭha Ih Hmual"},"17":{"text":"Ziangtiin a si tile, Pathian in Amah le minung karlakah remnak ziang bangtuk in a tuah, ti kha a langter: cumi cu a hramthok ihsin a netnak tiang zumnak thawngin a si. Ca Thianghlim khalin, “Zumnak thawngih thiamcotermi cu an nung ding,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Pathian ih thinhengnak cu minung sualmawhnak le ṭhat lonak hmuahhmuah parah vancung ihsin a rung lang; cuih minung ṭhat lonak cu thudik theih thei lonak dingih dawntu an si.","title":"Minung Sualnak"},"19":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian ih hremnak an tong; ziangahtile Pathian Amah in a fianter zo bangin minung ih Pathian theih theinak cu fiang zetin a lang a si."},"20":{"text":"Pathian in hi leilung a sersiam thok ihsin hmuh theih lomi a nunzia siseh, kumkhua ih a neihmi huham le Pathian a sizia siseh, fiangtein hmuh theimi an si. Pathian ih thil tuahmi pawl parah hmuh theih an si. Curuangah zokhal in puhmawh ding an nei lo."},"21":{"text":"Pathian cu an thei ko; sikhalsehla upat hmaizah tlak asinain upat hmaizahnak an pe lo; a parah lungawi thu khal an sim lo. An ruahnak sawn kha thulolak ah a cang ṭheh ih an thinlung kawlawngpi cu thimnak in a khat."},"22":{"text":"Kan fim an ti aw naón an aa a si."},"23":{"text":"Kumkhawnung Pathian bia sawn loin a thi theimi minung le vate le ramsa le a bokih a vakmi ramsa pawl vekih tuahmi zuk sawn kha an biak."},"24":{"text":"Curuangah cubangtuk minung pawl cu an thinlung ih an hiarmi thil ningsinza hurnak pawl tuah dingah Pathian in kham duh loin a thlahthlam. Cule pakhat le pakhat parah ningzakza thil an tuah aw."},"25":{"text":"Pathian ih thudik thuhla cu thuphan in an thleng; Siamtu Pathian bia loin le rian loin siammi thilri sawn an rian ih an biak. Siamtu sawn kha kumkhua in thangṭhat ding a si. Amen."},"26":{"text":"Hi thil an tuah ruangah Pathian in minung cu ningzakza a si mi an taksa hiarnak thlun lawlaw dingin a hnonta hai. Nunau hmanin nunau an sinak thil a daan vekih hmang loin cin le daan nei loin nu le nu an sualpi aw."},"27":{"text":"Cuvek thotho in mipa khal in nunau thawn pawl awk daan an tlansan ih an taksa hiarnak ruangah mipa le mipa an sualpi aw. Mipa in pakhat le pakhat cubangtuk ningzakza thilsual an tuah ruangah an thilsual tuah ruangih an hlawhman cu an parah a thleng."},"28":{"text":"Hi minung pawl in Pathian theihnak ngaingai cu an thinlung sungah caamter an duh lo ruangah thinlung borhhlawhnak thlun lawlaw dingin Pathian in a hnonta hai. Curuangah tuah lo ding thil pawl kha an tuah."},"29":{"text":"Annih cu siatnak le ṭhat lonak a phunphun, hamṭamnak le sualralnak a phunphun in an khat; nahsiiknak, mithahnak, sualawknak, mi bumnak le depdet hrokhrawlnak tla in an khat. An kaa a tam ih,"},"30":{"text":"pakhat le pakhat an relsia aw. Pathian mitkem zawng in an nung, an hngal, an puarthau, anmah le anmah an porh aw, ṭhat lonak tuah dingah lamzin a phunphun an hawl, an nu le an pa thu an ngai lo;"},"31":{"text":"a ṭha le a sia thleidan thiamnak thinlung an nei lo, an thukam mi an thlun dah lo ih midang hrang zaangfahnak le zawnruahnak zianghman an nei lo."},"32":{"text":"Hi bangtuk ih a nungmi pawl cu thi tlak hrimhrim an si, tiih Pathian daan pekmi a um ti tla an thei ko. Cuih tlunah hibangtuk thil ṭha lo anmah in an tuah lawng si loin midang in an tuah tik khalah an lungkimpi a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Curuangah ka rual, zokhal na sile mi dang na soisel tikah misual na si ve hi pheh theinak na nei lo. Ziangahtile midang thu a ṭhentu cu thilsual tuahtu vek thotho in misual an si ruangah mi thu na ṭhennak in nangmah lala misual na cang awter a si.","title":"Pathian Thuṭhennak"},"2":{"text":"Hi bangtuk thil ṭha lo a tuahtu pawl parah Pathian in an thu a ṭhen tikah thil dik a tuah, ti kan thei."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah ka rual, midang in thil ṭha lo an tuah ih an thu na relnak in nangmah cu anmah lala vek na si. Pathian ih thurelnak ka luat ding tiah na ruat aw maw si?"},"4":{"text":"Culole Pathian zaangfahnak le mi a zawi theizia le a thinsaunak pawl a nasa ngaingaimi hi zianghman ah na siar lo a si maw? Pathian zaangfahnak cu na sual sir dingih a lo hruaitu ah a si, ti cu fiangte in na thei."},"5":{"text":"Asinain nang cu na thinlung a hak ih a khoh remrem; curuangah Pathian in a thinhengnak le a dikmi thuṭhennak Ni ah na ton dingmi hremnak cu tam sinsin dingin nangmah tein na khawl a si."},"6":{"text":"Ziangtin tile Pathian in zozo khal an tuahmi vekin tuahman a pe ding.","ref":"Saam 62.12; Thufim 24.12"},"7":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat in thil ṭha an tuah ringring ih sunlawinak, hminṭhatnak le kumkhua nunnak an hawl. Cupawl cu Pathian in kumkhua nunnak a pe ding."},"8":{"text":"Mi ṭhenkhat cu mahih zawn lawng an ruat ih a ṭha lomi thlun duh ah a ṭhami kha an hnong. Cupawl parah Pathian in a thinhengnak cu meiling bangin a burh ding."},"9":{"text":"A ṭha lomi a tuahtu hmuahhmuah in harsatnak le aihramnak an tuar ding; a hmaisa a tuartu ah Judah mi an si ding ih a neta ah Zentail mi an si ve ding."},"10":{"text":"Asinain thil ṭha a tuahtu hmuahhmuah hnenah Pathian in sunlawinak, hminṭhatnak le daihnak a pe ding; a hmaisa a cotu cu Judah mi an si ding ih a neta ah Zentail mi an si ding."},"11":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pathian cun zozo khal bangrep in mi thu a ṭhen a si. Zohman a thleidang lo.","ref":"Daan 10.17"},"12":{"text":"Zentail mi pawl cu Moses Daan an nei lo; an sual tikah Daan nei loin an hloralta ding. Judah mi pawl cun Moses Daan an nei; an sual tikah Daan vekin thuṭhennak an tuar ding."},"13":{"text":"Pathian hmaiih miding timi pawl cu Daan sungih a ummi pawl an hna ih theih lawngin a si lo; Daan ih a fialmi tuahnak in a si sawn."},"14":{"text":"Zentail mi cu Daan an nei lo; asinain an suahkeh theihfimnak in Daan ih thupekmi vekin an tuah tikah Daan cu nei lo hman hai sehla suahkeh theihfimnak an neihmi cu an hrangah an daan a si ve."},"15":{"text":"An tuahmi ziaza in Daan ih fialmi thukham cu an thinlung sungah ngan in a um, ti a langter. Cumi cu a dik a si ti kha sia le ṭha an thleidan thiamnak in a langter; ziangahtile voikhat khatah an thinlung lala in a mawhthluk hai ih voikhat khatah thiam a coter hai a si."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah ka phuanmi Thuthang ṭha vekin hi bangtuk thinlung umdaan hi Pathian in milai ruahnak thup thu a ṭhen ni ih a umdaan ding a si."},"17":{"text":"Cuti asile nannih pawlteh? Judah mi kan si nan ti aw maw? Moses Daan cu nan rinsan hleenhleen ih Pathian thu ahcun nan uar awzet.","title":"Judah Mi Le Daan"},"18":{"text":"Pathian in tuah hai seh a lo timi cu nan thei thluh ih a ṭhami hril ding khal Daan sung ihsin nan zir zo."},"19":{"text":"Mitcawmi lam hruaitu kan si ih thimnak sungih a ummi hrangah tleunak kan si, tiah nan zumzet."},"20":{"text":"A aa mi pawl zirhtu kan si ih zianghman thei bembem lo pawl hrangah zirhtu kan ṭuan nan ti. Daan sungah theih kimnak le thudik famkim zetin kan nei tiah nan zumzet."},"21":{"text":"Zirhtu saya pawl, midang cu nan zirh ih ziangah so nanmah nan zirh awk lo? “Rukru hlah,” tiah nan zirh; nanmah teh nan ru maw?"},"22":{"text":"“ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuah hlah,” nan ti; nanmah teh nan sual maw? Milem cu a fih in nan fih; asinain milem biakinn thilri teh nan ru maw?"},"23":{"text":"Pathian ih Daan kan nei tiah nan uar awzet, asile cuih daan buar tahratin Pathian hnenah ningzahnak nan thlenter maw?"},"24":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim sungah, “Nanmah Judah mi ruangah hin Zentail mi in Pathian an thangsiat,” tiah a um.","ref":"Isai 52.5"},"25":{"text":"Daan nan thlun a si ahcun nan serhtannak hi man a nei; sikhalsehla Daan nan buar a si ahcun serhtan dah lo thawn nan bangrep thotho a si."},"26":{"text":"Serhtan lo Zentail mi in Daan sung ummi thukham a thlun ahcun an serhtan lonak kha serhtannak ah Pathian in a ruahsak lo ding maw?"},"27":{"text":"Curuangah nannih Judah mi pawl, serhtanmi nan si ih Daan khal cu ca ngan fekfekin nan nei naón cuih Daan nan buar ruangah taksa in serh an tan lo naón Daan a thluntu Zentail mi pawl ih thurel mawhthluknak nan tong ding a si."},"28":{"text":"Thungai in kan ti asile, zoso Judah mi taktak, serhtan ngaingaimi cu an si? A lenglam lawngin Judah mi si ih serhtannak kha taksa parih tuahmi thil lawng a si ahcun Judah mi taktak a si lo."},"29":{"text":"A sunglam sawn in Judah mi, thinlung serhtantu pawl kha Judah mi ngaingai an si. Cumi cu nganmi Daan ih tuahmi a si lo, Pathian Thlarau ih tuahmi a si. Cubangtuk minung cu milai hnen ihsin si loin Pathian hnen ihsin thangṭhatnak ngahtu a si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuti asile Judah mi pawl hi Zentail mi tlunah an cuan hleinak a um maw? Serh an tan hi ziangtal man a nei maw?"},"2":{"text":"A phunphun in an cuan hleinak a um. Hmaisabik ah Pathian in a thu cu Judah mi pawl a kilter."},"3":{"text":"Asinain Judah mi ṭhenkhat rintlak lo an si ah teh, ziang a cang ding? Pathian khal an parah rintlak lo a si ve ding maw?"},"4":{"text":"Si hrimhrim hlah! Minung zokhal thuphan pertu an si ṭheh khalle Pathian cu a dikmi le rintlak a si ko ding. Ca Thianghlim in, “Na ṭong tikah, Na ṭongmi cu a dik a si ti langter a si ding ih, Na thu an ṭhen tikah, thu na neh ding,” a ti.","ref":"Saam 51.4"},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kan thil tuah dik lomi hin Pathian ih thil dik a tuahzia fiangtein a langter a si ahcun, ziangso kan sim nawn ding? Pathian in in hrem tikah a palh a si, kan ti ding maw? (Minung daan in ka sim.)"},"6":{"text":"Ti naisai hlah! Pathian cu a dik a si; a dik lo ahcun ziangtinso leilungpi thu a ṭhen thei ding?"},"7":{"text":"Asinain ka dik lonak hin Pathian sunlawinak sawn ah hna a ṭuan ih a diknak kha a langfiangter sawn a si awk ah ziangtin a si ding? Ziangah so kei sawn cu misual tiah mawhthluk ka co thotho?"},"8":{"text":"Ziangah so, “A ṭhami lang dingin a ṭha lomi tuah uhsi,” tiah kan ti lo? A si ngai; mi hrekkhat in cu tivek cekci hi na sim a si tiah thu in puh ih in hmuhsuam. Cubangtuk mi pawl cu mawhphurh tlak an si vekin mawh an phur ding."},"9":{"text":"Cuti asile, Judah mi kan si hi Zentail mi hnakin ṭhathnemnak a um cuang lo maw? Um hrimhrim hlah! Fiangtein ka langter zo vekin Judah mi siseh Zentail mi siseh, kan zatein sualnak huham hnuai ah kan um ṭheh a si.","title":"Miding Zohman An Um Lo"},"10":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim in: “A dingmi zohman an um lo,"},"11":{"text":"A fimmi pakhat hman an um lo, Pathian biatu khal an um lo."},"12":{"text":"An zatein Pathian hnen ihsin an pial thluh ih, zinpeng an zawh ṭheh zo. Zohman thildik a tuahtu an um lo, pakhatte hman an um lo."},"13":{"text":"An ṭongkam cu thihpi tlakmi bumnak hlir a si; An lei ihsin ṭihnungza thuphan pernak a suak; An hmur ihsin thihsii, rul tur bangtuk a suak."},"14":{"text":"An ṭong cu mi camsiatnak hlir in a khat."},"15":{"text":"Mi tuahmawh ding le mi phil dingah cun an zamrang zet;"},"16":{"text":"An fehnak kipah siatsuahnak le cemralnak in a thlun hai."},"17":{"text":"Daihnak lamzin cu an thei dah lo;"},"18":{"text":"Pathian ṭihzahnak khal an zir dah lo,” a tivek kha a si."},"19":{"text":"Atu-ah cun Daan sungih thupekmi hmuahhmuah cu Daan hnuai ih a ummi pawl hrangah a si, ti kan thei. Cumi cu zohman in an phet thei lonak dingah le leikhawvel pumpuluk hi Pathian thuṭhennak hnuai ih thlenpi dingah a si, tinak a si."},"20":{"text":"Ziangahtile zohman in Daan thlun tahratin Pathian hmaiah thiamconak a ngah thei lo ding. Daan ih hnaṭuanmi cu minung an sual theihternak lawng a si."},"21":{"text":"Atu cu Pathian in Amah le minung karlakah rualremnak lamzin a langter zo. Cuih remnak lamzin thu-ah Moses Daan le profet pawl kha theihpitu an si naón Daan thawn zianghman a seng aw lo.","title":"Pathian In Remnak A Tuah"},"22":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih an zumnak thawngin Pathian in minung thawn remnak a tuah. Khrih a zumtu hmuahhmuah hrangah cuti cun Pathian in a tuah a si; curuangah dan awknak zianghman a um lo;"},"23":{"text":"kan zatein misual kan si ṭheh ih Pathian sunloihnak kan co baan lo."},"24":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu-ah cun in luattertu Khrih Jesuh ih tlennak zaar ah Pathian in a zaangfahnak laksawng cu in pek ih Amah thawn rualremnak in tuahsak zo."},"25":{"text":"Pathian in Jesuh Khrih ih thisen thawngin misual ngaidamnak kha a tumtahmi a si ih, cuih ngaidamnak cu amah an zumnak thawngin an ngah ding. Pathian in hi bangtuk thil a tuah cu amah ih dingnak langternak dingah a si. Hlanah cun Pathian cu a thin a sau ih minung ih sualnak kha poisa lem loin a rak umsan."},"26":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu-ah cun Amah ih dingnak kha langfiangter dingah minung ih sualnak cu a umsan meen nawn lo; cutiin a dingnak a langter ih Jesuh a zumtu hmuahhmuah cu Amah thawn rualremnak a coter hai."},"27":{"text":"Cuti asile ziangtal kan porh awk ding a um maw? Um hrimhrim hlah! Ziangih ruangah so? Daan kan thlun ruangah maw? Si hlah! Kan zum ruangah a si."},"28":{"text":"Ziangahtile Daan ih thupekmi thlun ruangah si loin zumnak thawng lawngin minung cu Pathian thawn rualremnak a um a si, tihi kan thu netnak a si."},"29":{"text":"Culole Pathian cu Judah mi pawl ih Pathian lawng a si maw? Zentail mi pawl ih Pathian tla a si ve lo maw? A si, Zentail mi pawl ih Pathian khal a si."},"30":{"text":"Pathian cu pakhat a si ih Judah mi pawl cu an zumnak thawngin Pathian thawn remawknak a um ding ih Zentail mi pawl khal an zumnak ruangah Amah thawn a rem awter hai ding."},"31":{"text":"Cuti asile hi zumnak ruangah Daan cu kan hlonta, tinak a si maw? Si hrimhrim hlah! Daan kan hngetter a si sawn."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kan phun cithlahtu Abraham thu teh ziangti in so kan ruah ding? A hmuhton mi ziang bangtuk so a si?","title":"Abraham In Tahṭhimnak"},"2":{"text":"Thil a tuahmi thawngin Pathian thawn rualremnak a co ti sehla porh awk ding tawkfang cu a nei ding! Sikhalsehla Pathian hmaiah cun porh awk ding zianghman a nei lo."},"3":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim in, “Abraham in Pathian a ring ih cuih a rinnak ruangah Pathian in miding ah a ret a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Seem 15.6; Gal 3.6"},"4":{"text":"Mi pakhat hna a ṭuan tikah a hnaṭuan man cu an pek; cumi cu laksawngah ruah ding a si lo. Amah ih a hlawhmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ṭuannak si loin zumnak a neitu, mawh-nei mi kha mawh-nei lo ah a tuahtu Pathian a rinsantu ih zumnak cu Pathian in amah thawn rualremternak hrangah a co sakmi a si."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in mi pakhat ṭuannak malte hman tel lotein miding bangin a cohlan sakmi pa ih lungawinak David in a rel tikah himi hi a si a sim duh mi cu:"},"7":{"text":"“An ṭhatlonak ngaithiam a si mi le an sualnak thlahsak a si mi pawl cu milungawi an si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa in an mawhnak a siarsak lomi le an sualnak cazin ih a khumsak lomi pawl cu milungawi an si,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"David ih a relmi lungawinak hi serhtanmi pawl lawngih ngah theimi a si maw? Si hrimhrim hlah! Hi lungawinak cu serhtan lomi pawl ih comi khal a si ve. Ziangahtile kan sim zomi Ca Thianghlim in, “Abraham in Pathian cu a ring ih cuih a rinnak ruangah Pathian in miding ah a cohlang a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cumi cu ziangtikah so a si? Abraham in serh a tan hlanah maw, serh a tan hnuah so? Serh a tan hnuah a si lo, a tan hlanah a si."},"11":{"text":"Miding ih cohlan a si hnuah Abraham in serhtannak cu a tuah. Pathian in serh a tan hlan hmanah a rinnak ruangah miding ah a siar ih cumi hminsinnakah serhtannak cu a tuah. Cuti a si ruangah serhtan lomi pawl an zumnak ruangih Pathian in mi dingah a cohlan mi pawl hrangah cun Abraham cu thlarau lamih an pa bik a si."},"12":{"text":"Cule serhtanmi pawl ih pa khal a si thotho; ziangahtile serhtanmi pawl cu serh an tan lawng si loin, kan pa Abraham serh a tan awk hlanih a nun bangin rinnak thawn a nungmi pawl an si."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in Abraham le a tefa pawl cu, hi leilung hi na ta a si ding, tiah thu a kam tikah Abraham in Daan a thlun ruangah a timi a si lo, sikhalsehla Abraham in a ring ih Pathian in miding ih a cohlan ruangah a si.","title":"Pathian Thukam Le Zumnak"},"14":{"text":"Pathian ih thukamnak a co theitu pawl cu Daan a thluntu pawl hnen lawngah pek sibang sehla minung ih zumnak cu thulolak meen a si ding ih Pathian ih thukam cu man nei lo ah a cang ṭheh ding."},"15":{"text":"Daan cun Pathian thinhengnak a thlenter; asinain Daan um lonak ahcun daan buar sualnak khal a um ve lo."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah thukamnak cu zumnak parih a dingmi a si ih Abraham tesinfa hmuahhmuah hnenah Pathian velneihnak laksawng a si tiah aamahkhan in thukamnak a si. Daan a thluntu pawl hrang lawngah si loin Abraham bangin a zumtu pawl hrang khalah a si. Ziangahtile Abraham cu thlarau lam in kan zate ih pa a si."},"17":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim khal in, “Nangmah cu miphun tampiih pa ah ka lo tuah zo,” tiah a ti. Curuangah cuih thukamnak cu Abraham ih a zummi Pathian hmaiah a hngetmi thukamnak a si. Cuih Abraham ih zummi Pathian cu mithi a nuntertu le a thu in a um lomi kha a umter theitu Pathian a si.","ref":"Seem 17.5"},"18":{"text":"Abraham cun a zum ih beisei ding zianghman a um nawn lo hnu hmanah a beisei thotho hrih ruangah, “Miphun tampiih pa,” ah a cang. Ca Thianghlim in, “Na tesinfa pawl cu arsi zat an si ding,” a timi kha a kim."},"19":{"text":"Culai ah Abraham cu kum zakhat zikte a si; asinain a thi tuan dingmi a taksa pum zoh tikah siseh, Sarah nau a neih thei lo thu a ruah tik khalah siseh, a zumnak cu a ṭum cuang lo."},"20":{"text":"Pathian ih thukammi khal zum loin a um cuang lo; a zumnak in cahnak a pek sawn ih Pathian kha a thangṭhat."},"21":{"text":"Pathian cun thu a kam ciami cu a tuahsuak ding ti kha a ring nasa."},"22":{"text":"Curuangah rinnak thawngin Abraham cu, “Pathian in miding ah a cohlang,” a si."},"23":{"text":"Cule, “miding ah a cohlang,” timi ṭongfang hi amah ih hrang lawngih nganmi a si lo."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh kan Bawipa thihnak ihsin a thosaltertu Pathian kan zumnak thawngin miding ih cohlanmi kannih hrang khalah nganmi a si ve."},"25":{"text":"Kan sualnak ruangah thihnak ah thlenter a si ih Pathian thawn kan rualrem awknak dingah le thiam coter ka sinak dingah nunnak ah thawhter sal a si."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Atu cu zumnak in thiam cotermi kan si zo ih kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih ruangah Pathian thawn kan rem aw zo.","title":"Pathian Thawn Rualremnak"},"2":{"text":"Zumnak ruangih kan comi Pathian ih zaangfahnak sungah Amah in in thlenpi ih cuih zaangfahnak sungah cun atu hi kan um. Curuangah Pathian ih sunlawinak kan ṭawm aw ding tiah ruahsannak kan nei ih kan thin a nuam."},"3":{"text":"Cule harnak kan tuar tik khalah hin kan lung a awi thotho; ziangahtile harsatnak in tuartheinak a suahter,"},"4":{"text":"tuartheinak in Pathian lungkimnak a suahter, cule amah ih lungkimnak in ruahsannak a suahter, ti kha kan thei."},"5":{"text":"Cule hi ruahsannak in kan bei dong loin in tuah, ziangahtile Thlarau Thianghlim sung ihsin Pathian in a duhdawtnak cu kan thinlung sungah a burh zo. Cuih Thlarau Thianghlim cu Pathian ih in pekmi laksawng a si."},"6":{"text":"Zianghman ti theimi kan neih lo laifangah Pathian ih khiah mi tikcu caanah Khrih cu misual pawl hrangah a thi."},"7":{"text":"Miding hrang hmanah mi pakhatkhat thih ding cu a olmi thil a si lo. Miṭha hrangah cun thih a ngamtu pakhatkhat an rak um khal a si thei."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian in ziangtlukinso in duhdawt ti cu a langter: misual kan si hrih na cingin kan hrangah Khrih cu a thi!"},"9":{"text":"A thisen thawng in kannih cu Pathian thawn kan rem awk zo ruangah ziangtlukinso Pathian thinhengnak ihsin Amah in in runsuak sinsin ding!"},"10":{"text":"Hlanlaiah cun Pathian ih ral kan rak si, sikhalsehla atu cu a Fapa thihnak ruangah a rualpi ah in tuah zo. Pathian ih rualpi kan si zo ruangah Khrih ih nunnak in ziangtlukin so in runsuak sinsin ding."},"11":{"text":"Hi lawng hi a si hrih lo; Pathian rualpi ah in cantertu kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih ruangah Pathian ih thil tuahmi ahhin kan lung a awi ngaingai a si."},"12":{"text":"Sualnak cu mi pakhat ruangah leilungah a ra ih cuih a sualnak cun thihnak a thlenpi. Curuangah thihnak cu mi hmuahhmuah hnenah a thleng, ziangtin tile zozo khal an sual ṭheh.","title":"Adam Le Khrih"},"13":{"text":"Daan pekmi a um hlan ihsin sualnak cu leilung tlunah hin a rak um zo; sikhalsehla Daan a um lonak hmunah cun sual cu sual ah siar a si lo."},"14":{"text":"Adam san thok ihsin Moses ih san tiang mi hmuahhmuah cu thihnak in a uk ṭheh; Adam in Pathian thupekmi a thlun loih a sual bangtuk ih an sual ve lo hmanah thihnak cun a uk thotho hai. Adam cu nehhnu ih a ra dingmi pa ih hmuithlam a si."},"15":{"text":"Asinain cute pahnih cu an bang aw lo, ziangahtile Pathian ih laksawng cu Adam ih sualnak vek a si lo. Mi pakhat sualnak ruangah mi tampi thihnak an tong, ti cu thudik a si. Sikhalsehla Pathian ih zaangfahnak cu cu hnakin a tum deuh; Jesuh Khrih amah pakhat ih in zaangfahnak Pathian ih laksawng cu mi tampi hnenah a tum sinsin a si."},"16":{"text":"Cule Pathian ih laksawng le mi pakhat ih sualnak cu an dang aw zet. Cuih voikhat sualnak hnu ih a ra thlengmi thuṭhennak cu “Nan mawh,” tihi a si. Sikhalsehla sualnak tam zet hnuah kan hlawh lo cingih a ra thlengmi laksawng cu, “Nan mawh lo,” tiih thuṭhennak a si."},"17":{"text":"Mi pakhat Adam ih sual ruangah thihnak in mi a uk ṭheh; sikhalsehla mi pakhat Jesuh Khrih ih a tuahmi thawngin Pathian zaangfahnak tlamtling a ngahtu le Amah thawn rem awknak laksawng a cotu hmuahhmuah hnenah cun ziangtluk tam sinsin in so dingnak in a uk hai ding."},"18":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah sualnak pakhat tuahmi in mi hmuahhmuah cu sual a phurh bangtuk in dingnak pakhat tuahmi in mi hmuahhmuah cu a luatter ih nunnak a pek."},"19":{"text":"Cule mi pakhat ih thu-ngaih lonak ruangah mi hmuahhmuah misual ih canter an si bangtuk in mi pakhat ih thungainak thawngin mi hmuahhmuah cu Pathian thawn an rem aw ding."},"20":{"text":"Daan a ra thlen tikah sualnak karhtertu ah a cang. Sikhalsehla sual a karhnak hmunah cun Pathian ih zaangfahnak khal a karh sinsin ve."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah sualnak in thihnak thawn minung in uk vekin Pathian ih zaangfahnak in dingnak thawn minung cu in uk ve; cuticun kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih zaar in kumkhua nunnak sungah in hruai a si."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asile ziangtinso kan ti ding? Pathian ih zaangfahnak karh sinsin seh tiah sual kan tuah vivo hrih ding maw?","title":"Sual Ah Thi, Khrih Ah Nung"},"2":{"text":"Tuah naisai hlah! Sualnak ah kan thi zo ih ziangtinso a sungah kan um thei nawn ding?"},"3":{"text":"Khrih Jesuh thawn kan pehzom awknak in a sungih hnimmi kan si tikah a thihnak sung khalah hnimmi kan si tihi nan hngilh maw si?"},"4":{"text":"Baptisma kan lak tikah amah thawn phummi kan si ih a thihnak ah khal kan ṭawm ve; cuvek thotho in Pa ih sunlawinak huham in Khrih kha thihnak ihsin a thawhter bangtuk in kannih khal a thar in kan nung ding."},"5":{"text":"A thihnak ah khan amah thawn a thi tlang mi kan si ruangah thihnak ihsin thawhter a sinakah khan kannih khal kan tel ve ding."},"6":{"text":"Kan nun hlun cu Khrih thawn thinglamtah parah khencih a si zo ti kan thei; cumi cu sual in a khatmi kan nunnak hlunih pum cu a siatral ṭheh ding tinak a si. Cutiin sualnak ih sal kan si nawn lo."},"7":{"text":"Ziangahtile mi pakhat cu a thih tikah sualnak in a parah thu a nei nawn lo."},"8":{"text":"Khrih thawn kan thih tlang ruangah a nun khal amah thawn kan nung tlang ding tiah kan zum."},"9":{"text":"Khrih cu thihnak ihsin thawhter a si zo ih a thi sal nawn lo ding, ti kan thei; thihnak cun a parah thu a nei nawn lo."},"10":{"text":"Cule sual thu-ah cun kumkhua daih in a thi ih atu a nun hi cu Pathian ah a nung a si."},"11":{"text":"Cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in nannih khal sual thu-ah cun mithi kan si tiin siseh, nunnak thu-ah cun Khrih Jesuh zaar in Pathian thawn pawlkom in kan nung tiin siseh, ruat aw uh."},"12":{"text":"Taksa hiarnak kha nan thlun lonak dingah a thi theimi nan taksa pum cu sualnak in uk nawn hlah seh."},"13":{"text":"Nan taksaṭhen ziangkhal thil ṭha lo sual tuahnak ah nan hmang lo pei. Cuhnakin thihnak ihsin nunnak ih thawhtermi bangin nan ziangzongza Pathian hnenah pe aw sawn uhla nan nunnak zate thawn thil ṭha tuahnak ah hmang sawn uh."},"14":{"text":"Sualnak cu a lo uktu bawi si nawn hlah seh; ziangahtile daan hnuai ah nan nung nawn lo, Pathian zaangfahnak hnuai ah nan nung zo a si."},"15":{"text":"Cuti asile ziangtinso a si ding? Daan hnuai ih um loin Pathian zaangfahnak hnuai ih kan um ruangah sual kan tuah hrih ding maw? Tuah hrimhrim hlah!","title":"Dingnak Ih Sal Nan Si"},"16":{"text":"Nannih in mi pakhatkhat hnenah a sal si dingin le a thu ngai dingin nan pe aw a si ahcun, cuih a thu nan ngaimi cu nan bawi a si ih nannih cu a sal nan si ko; cucu fiang zetin nan thei zo a si. Sualnakih thu nan thlun asile sualnak ih a suahpimi cu thihnak a si ruangah thihnak nan tuar ding; asinain Pathian ih thu nan thlun ahcun Pathian thu thlunih a suahpimi cu remnak a si ruangah Pathian thawn rualremnak nan co ding."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian hnenah thangṭhatnak um ko seh! Ziangahtile nannih tla cu sualnak ih sal nan rak si dah naón atu-ah cun zirhnak nan ngahmi sungih thudik kha nan thinlung zatein nan thlun zo."},"18":{"text":"Sualnak ihsin luattermi nan si ih dingnak salah nan cang zo a si."},"19":{"text":"(Nan thei thei deuh ding tiah nitin hmanmi ṭong ka hman hi!) A hlanah cun a ṭha lomi tuahnak ah nan taksaṭhen cu a baalmi le a ṭha lomi ih salah nan pe aw. Cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in atu-ah cun a thianghlimmi tuahnak ah nan taksaṭhen cu a zatein dingnak ih sal si dingin pe aw uh."},"20":{"text":"Sualnak ih sal nan rak si laiah cun dingnak ih ukmi nan si lo."},"21":{"text":"Cutiih sualnak sal nan si ruangah ziangtal hlawknak nan ngah maw? Nan ngahmi cu kha vek thil sual nan tuah ruangah atu ningzakih nan um hi a si. Cubangtuk thil ih hlawhman cu thihnak a si!"},"22":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu-ah cun sualnak ihsin luattermi nan si zo ih Pathian ih salah nan cang zo. Nan hlawkmi cu Pathian hnenih hlanmi nunnak thiang a si ih cumi in a suahpimi cu kumkhua nunnak a si."},"23":{"text":"Ziangahtile sualnak ih hlawhman cu thihnak a si; sikhalsehla Pathian ih laksawng cu kan Bawipa Khrih Jesuh thawn kan pehzom awknak thawngin kumkhua nunnak a si."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"U le nau pawl, nannih tla cu nan zatein daan thu a theitu nan si ruangah atu nan hnenih ka sim dingmi hi nan theih ciami a si ko. Minung cu an nunsung lawnglawng daan in a uk, ti nan thei ko a si lo maw?","title":"ṭhit Awknak Ihsin Tahṭhimnak"},"2":{"text":"Tahṭhimnak ah, pasal nei nunau pakhat cu a pasal a nunsung lawnglawng daan in a uk; a pasal a thih asile ṭhit-umnak daan ihsin a luat a si."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah a pasal a nung cingin mipa dang thawn an umtlang a si ahcun ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuahtu a si; sikhalsehla a pasal in a thihsan a si ahcun midang a pasal khalle ṭaangṭawm sualnak tuahtu a si nawn lo."},"4":{"text":"Ka u le ka nau tla, nanmah ih thuhla khalah hin cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in a si. Daan thu ka rel a si ahcun, nannih cu Khrih ruangpum ih taksa ṭhen nan si zo ruangah a thimi nan si. Asinain atu-ah cun Pathian hrangih rah ṭha nan rah theinak dingah thihnak ihsin thawhter sal a si mi pa ih ta nan si."},"5":{"text":"Ziangtin tile, kan milai si daan vekih kan rak nun laiah cun kan taksa ih sualhiarnak cu Daan in kan taksa sungah a cangvaiter ih a rah kan ngahmi cu thihnak a si."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu-ah cun Daan ihsin kan luat zo; ziangtin tile salih in rak tuahtu Daan hrangah cun mithi kan si zo. Ca in nganmi Daan hlun hnuai ah si loin Thlarau lamzin tharah Pathian kan rian a si."},"7":{"text":"Cuti asile ziangtinso kan ti ding? Daan hrimhrim hi sual a si, kan ti ding maw? Ti naisai hlah! Sualnak hi sual a si ti in theitertu cu Daan hi a si. Daan in, “Midang thil daw hlah,” i rak ti hlah sehla midang ih thil dawt cu ziang a si ti ka rak thei lo ding.","title":"Daan Le Sualnak"},"8":{"text":"Asinain sualnak in cuih thukham cu hmang tahratin ka pumsa sungah duhhiarnak a phunphun a thoter. Daan a um lonak ahcun sualnak cu a thi a si."},"9":{"text":"Keimah khal hi daan tel loin a nungmi ka rak si; asinain thukham a ra thlen tikah sualnak cu a nung ih kei cu ka thi."},"10":{"text":"Nunnak petu dingah timi thukham cu ka hrangah cun thihnak a si."},"11":{"text":"Sualnak in tikcu ṭha a ngah ih thukham cu a hriamhrei ah hmang tahratin i bum ih i that a si."},"12":{"text":"Cutiin Daan amah ngaingai cu a thianghlim ih thukham khal a thianghlim, a dikmi a si ih a ṭhazet."},"13":{"text":"Cuti asile a ṭhami cu kei ka thihnak riangri ah a cang, a si maw? Si hrimhrim hlah! Thihnak tuahtu ngaingai cu sualnak a si. Sualnak in sualnak a sizia taktak kha fiangteih langter dingah ṭhatnak kha hmang tahratin thihnak cu ka parah a thlenter. Curuangah thukham in sualnak cu tuksumza sualnak a sizia hi a langter a si."},"14":{"text":"Daan cu thlarau lamih thil a si ti kan thei; asinain kei cu tisa mi ka si ih sualnak ih sal si dingah zuarmi ka si.","title":"Minung Sunglam Buainak"},"15":{"text":"Thil ka tuahmi hi a tican ka thei ṭheu lo, ziangahtile tuah ka duhmi kha ka tuah lo ih ka duh lomi sawn kha ka tuah."},"16":{"text":"Tuah ka duh lomi ka tuah ruangah Daan cu a dik tiin ka lungkimpi ti a lang."},"17":{"text":"Curuangah hiti ih a tuah rerotu ngaingai hi keimah ka si lo; ka sungih a ummi sualnak a si sawn."},"18":{"text":"Minung ka sinak taktak sungah ṭhatnak zianghman a um lo ti cu ka thei. Ziangahtile a ṭhami tuah duhnak thinlung cu ka sungah um hmansehla a ṭhami ka tuah thei hrimhrim lo."},"19":{"text":"Ka tuah duhmi thil ṭha kha tuah loin ka tuah duh lomi thil sia riangri sawn kha ka tuah a si."},"20":{"text":"Tuah ka duh lomi ka tuah a si ahcun a sullam cu a tuahtu kha keimah ka si lo ih ka sungih a nungmi sualnak a si sawn, tinak a si."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah ka sungih thil a can daanzia cu ka thei - a ṭhami tuah ka duh tikah ka hrilsuakmi cu a ṭha lomi hlir a si."},"22":{"text":"Ka sung muril in Pathian ih daanah cun ka lung a awi."},"23":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka taksa sungah hna a rak ṭuan vetu daan dang a um; cuih daan cu ka thinlung sungin a ṭha a timi kha a rak dotu daan a si. Cumi cun ka taksa sungih hna a ṭuanmi sualnak ih daan hnuai ah sal bangin i taanter."},"24":{"text":"Mi lungrethei ka va si so! Thihnak lamzin a pantu hih taksa pum ihsi hin zoso i runsuak ding?"},"25":{"text":"Pathian hnenah thangṭhatnak um ko seh: Pathian Amah in kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih thawng in i runsuak a si. Ka si daan ngaingai cu hiti in a si - Keimahte cun ka thinlung lawngin Pathian daan cu ka thlun; asinain minung ka sinak taktak cun sualnak daan ka thlun a si."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Atu cu Khrih Jesuh thawn a pehzom awmi hrangah cun sual thuṭhennak in an luat zo.","title":"Thlarau Sungih Nun"},"2":{"text":"Ziangahtile Khrih Jesuh thawn pehzomnak thawngin nunnak in petu Thlarau ih daan in sualnak le thihnak daan sung ihsin in luatter zo."},"3":{"text":"Minung sinak hi a ṭonṭaih tuk ruangah Daan ih a tuah thei lomi kha Pathian in a tuah suak. Amah ih Fapa run thlah tahratin minung sinak sungih a ummi sualnak kha a hnonsak; cuih a Fapa cu sualnak siatralterta dingin minung sinak thawn a ra."},"4":{"text":"Hi bangtuk in Pathian in hna a ṭuannak cu minung sidaan thawn nung loin Thlarau duhnakih a nungmi kannih sungah hin Daan ih in fialmi a dik le a dingmi pawl cu kimternak ding hrangah a si."},"5":{"text":"Minung sinak in a fialmi vekih a nungmi pawl thinlung cu minung sinak ih duhmi in a uk. Thlarau fialmi vekih a nungmi pawl thinlung cu Thlarau ih duhmi in a uk ve."},"6":{"text":"Minung sinakih a ukmi pawl ih ton dingmi cu thihnak a si; Thlarau ukmi pawl ih co dingmi cu nunnak le daihnak a si."},"7":{"text":"Curuangah mi pakhat minung sinakih a ukmi cu Pathian ih ral a si, ziangahtile Pathian ih daan a thlun lo; a thlun duh lo lawng si loin a thlun thei lo."},"8":{"text":"Minung sinakih daan a thluntu pawl cun Pathian lung an awiter thei lo."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla nannih cu nan minung sinakih duhmi vekin nan nung lo; Pathian ih Thlarau cu nan sungih a um taktak a si ahcun Thlarau ih fialmi vekin nan nung sawn a si. Zokhal Khrih ih Thlarau a nei lotu cu Khrih ta a si lo."},"10":{"text":"Khrih nan sungih a nun ahcun Thlarau cu nan hrangah nunnak a si; ziangahtile sualnak ruangah nan ruangpi cu a thi ding naón nannih cu Pathian thawn remtermi nan si zo."},"11":{"text":"Thihnak ihsin Jesuh a thawhtertu Pathian ih Thlarau nan sungih a nun ahcun thihnak ihsin Khrih a thawhtertu Pathian in nan sungah a Thlarau a umternak thawngin a thi theimi nan taksa ruangpi cu nunnak a pe ve ding a si."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah ka u le ka nau tla, minung kan sinak daanih duhzawng in nung ding kan si lo."},"13":{"text":"Minung nan sinak daan duhzawng ih nan nun asile nan thi ding; sikhalsehla sualnak nan tuah ṭheumi pawl kha Thlarau bomnak in nan thah asile nan nung ding."},"14":{"text":"Pathian Thlarau ih hruaimi pawl cu Pathian ih fa an si."},"15":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pathian in a lo pekmi Thlarau cu salah a lo tuahtu ding Thlarau a si lo ih ṭihphang in a lo tuahtu khal a si fawn lo. Cuih Thlarau cun Pathian ih fa ah a lo canter ih Pathian hnenah, “Abba, Ka Pa,” tiih kan au theinak thazaang in petu khal cu Thlarau a si."},"16":{"text":"Hitiih kan au ahhin Pathian ih Thlarau in kan thlarau a pehzom ih Pathian ih fa kan sinak kha a fiangter."},"17":{"text":"Fa kan si ruangah Pathian in a minung hrangih a retciami thlawsuah a cotu ding kan si; cule Pathian in Khrih hrangih a retciami khal Khrih thawn kan co tlang ding. Ziangahtile Khrih tuarnak a tuar vetu kan si ahcun a sunlawinak khal kan ṭawm ve ding a si."},"18":{"text":"Atuih caanih harsatnak kan tuar mi hi kan hnenih a lang lai dingmi sunlawinak thawn cun tahṭhim tlak ah ka ruat hrimhrim lo.","title":"Hmailam Sunlawinak"},"19":{"text":"Pathian in a faale pawl a langternak ding caan kha sersiammi hmuahhmuah in an hngakhlap ngaingai."},"20":{"text":"Ziangahtile sersiammi thil hmuahhmuah hi tumtahmi um loih hloral meen dingah lairel cia a si. Cumi cu anmah ih duh thu si loin Pathian ih duhnak in a si. Asinain ruahsannak a um lai."},"21":{"text":"Nikhat khat ah sersiammi hmuahhmuah hi a ziamral dingmi saltaannak ihsin luatter ṭheh an si ding ih Pathian faale pawl ih comi a sunglawi luatnak cu an ṭawm ve leh ding."},"22":{"text":"Atuih caan tiang sersiammi hmuahhmuah cun nauhrin natih hrum-ai bangin an hrum an ai a si ti kan thei."},"23":{"text":"Sersiammi lawng si loin Pathian laksawng hmaisa bik Thlarau a co ih a teptu kanmah khal hi kan taksa ruangpi luatnak ding le Pathian fa cannak ding hngakin kan pumsa sunglam in kan hrum kan ai ve a si."},"24":{"text":"Ziangahtile ruahsannak in rundammi kan si. Kan ruahsanmi kha kan hmu thei a si ahcun ruahsannak a si ngaingai lo. Zoso a mit in a hmuh theimi cu a ruahsan dah?"},"25":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kan hmuh lomi kan ruahsan a si ahcun thinsau tein kan hngak a si."},"26":{"text":"Cuti vek ṭhiamṭhiam in kannih cu a ṭawnṭaimi kan si ruangah kanmah bawm dingah Thlarau a ra. Ziangtin so thla kan cam ding ti hman kan theih lo laiah, hmurka hmanin simsuak thei lomi hrum-ainak thawn Thlarau in kan hrangah Pathian hnenah in dil sak."},"27":{"text":"Cule kan thinlung a hmutu Pathian in Thlarau ih ruahmi cu ziang a si ti a thei; ziangtin tile Pathian duhzawng in a mithiang pawl hrangah Thlarau in Pathian hnenah in dil sak a si."},"28":{"text":"Ziangtinkim ahhin Pathian cun amah a duhdawtu le amah ih tumtahmi vekih a kawhmi hrangah cun an ṭhatnak ah hna a ṭuan a si, ti kan thei."},"29":{"text":"Pathian in a hril ciami pawl cu a Fapa hmuihmel keng dingah a thleidang cia hai; cuti cun unau tampi lakah a Fapa cu upa bik a sinak dingah a si."},"30":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian in a thleidan ciami pawl cu kawh khal a ko. Cule a kawhmi pawl cu thiam a coter ih a sunlawinak khal a hlawm hai a si."},"31":{"text":"Hi hmuahhmuah kan theih hnuah ziangso kan sim hrih ding? Pathian kan lamih a ṭan ahcun zoso in dodal thei ding?","title":"Khrih Sungin Pathian Duhdawtnak"},"32":{"text":"In dodaltu cu Pathian a si lo, a Fapa neihsun hman zuah loin kan zate hrangah in pe zo! Amah ih Fapa rori hman in pek a si ahcun thil dangdang khal a lakin in pe lo ding maw?"},"33":{"text":"Pathian ih hrilmi a minung pawl cu zo in so sual a puh thei ding? Pathian amah in thiam a coter sawn hai a sisi!"},"34":{"text":"Zo in so mawh a phurh hai ding? Khrih Jesuh in mawh a phurh lo ding; anih cu an hrangah a thi ih thawhter sal a si hnuah Pathian vorhlam kapah a um ih kan hrangah Pathian hnenah a dil."},"35":{"text":"Cuti a si ahcun zo in so Khrih ih duhdawtnak cun in ṭhen thei ding? Harsatnak siseh, tuarnak siseh, hremnak siseh, rilrawnnak siseh, hnipuan neilo farahnak in siseh, ṭihphannak le thihnak khal siseh, cupawl in in ṭhen thei ding maw? ṭhen thei hlah!"},"36":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim sungah, “Nangmah ih ruangah sun nihlawh thahnak kan tong; Thah dingih ruahmi tuu bangtuk kan si,” tiah a um.","ref":"Saam 44.22"},"37":{"text":"Hi bangtuk a si ko naón kannih in duhdawtu ih thawngin hi thil hmuahhmuah tlunah kannih cu nehtu hnakin kan uak deuh a si."},"38":{"text":"Ziangahtile amah ih in duhdawtnak ihsi cun zianghman in in ṭhensuak thei lo ding, tihi fiangtein ka zum a si; thihnak in siseh, nunnak in siseh, vancungih a ummi vanmi le uktu le huham neitu pawl in siseh, atu san in siseh, hmailam san in siseh, thuneitu"},"39":{"text":"leitlun ummi in siseh, leihnuai ummi in siseh, sersiammi thil hmuahhmuah in siseh, in ṭhen thei lo ding. Kan Bawipa Khrih Jesuh sungin kan ta a si mi Pathian ih duhdawtnak ihsi cun in ṭhen theitu ding zianghman a um lo."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka simmi hi thudik a si. Khrih ta ka si ih thuphan ka per lo. A sia le a ṭha thleidan thiamnak, Thlarau Thianghlim ih ukmi ka thinlung hin thuphan ka per lonak cu fiangtein i sim.","title":"Pathian Le A Hrilmi Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Ka riahsiatnak cu a nasa ngaingai; ka phunpi ka thi le ka sa a si mi pawl hrangah,"},"3":{"text":"ka thinnatnak cu cem ti a nei dah lo. Anmah ih ruangah keimah sawn hi Khrih ihsin ṭhensuakmi le Pathian camriamnak hnuai ih a ummi si sawn ningla ka va duh so!"},"4":{"text":"Annih tla cu Israel mi an si; Pathian in a faale ah a canter ih a sunlawinak cu an hnenah a langter; anmah thawn thukamnak tla a tuah ih an hnenah Daan a pek; anmah in a dikmi biaknak an nei ih Pathian ih thutiamnak a cotu an si."},"5":{"text":"Anmah cu kan pupa Hebru mi hminthang zetzet ihsin a rung suakmi an si; cule minung sinak lamih kan ruat asile Khrih khal an phunpi a si. Ziang hmuahhmuah uk ṭhehtu Pathian cu kumkhua-in thangṭhat si ko seh, Amen."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi an zatein Pathian ih minung an si ṭheh lo; asinain Pathian ih thukamnak cu a kim suak lo ka ti duhnak a si lo."},"7":{"text":"Abraham tesinfa khal an zatein Pathian ih fa an si ṭheh lem lo. Pathian in Abraham hnenah, “Tefa ka lo kammi pawl cu Isaak sungsuak an si ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Himi ih a tican cu: minung daan vekih hrinmi tefa pawl hi Pathian fa an si tinak a si lo; Pathian ih thukamnak thawngin hrin a si mi faale pawl lawng kha tefa taktak ih siar dingmi an si, tinak a si."},"9":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pathian ih thukamnak cu hiti in a um: “A cam a kim tikah ka ra sal ding ih Sarah in fapa a nei ding,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Hi lawng hi a si hrih lo. Ziangtin tile Rebekka ih fapa pahnih in pa an nei ih amah cu kanmah in hringtu kan pu Isaak a si."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hrilmi fapa pakhat in Pathian ih tumtahmi a kimter theinak dingah Pathian in Rebekah hnen ahcun, “A u in a nau a rian ding,” tiah a ti. Pathian in hi thu hi an suah hlanah a rak sim zo a si; a ṭha siseh, a sia siseh, zianghman an tuah hlanih a simmi a si. Curuangah Pathian in mi a hril tikah an thil tuahnak thawngin si lo in Amah in a kawh ruangah a si sawn.","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim khal in, “Jakob cu ka duhdaw, asinain Esau cu ka hua,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cuti a si ahcun Pathian hi a ding lo a si, kan ti pei maw? Ti hrimhrim hlah!"},"15":{"text":"Ziangahtile Moses hnenah, “Zaangfah ka duhmi parah ka zaangfah ding; zawnruahnak neih ka duhmi parah an zawn ka ruat ding,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Curuangah ziangtinkim ahhin minung ih duhnak le tuahnak ruangah si loin Pathian ih zaangfahnak a um ruangah a si ṭheh a si."},"17":{"text":"Izipt ram Faro siangpahrang thu khalah Ca Thianghlim in, “Nangmah cu siangpahrang ah ka lo tuah ih leilung hmuahhmuah ah ka cahnak huham na langter ih ka hmin na thanternak dingah ka lo hril a si,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian in a duhmi poh kha a zaangfah ih a duhmi poh kha an lung a ruhter a si."},"19":{"text":"Asinain nanmah lakih pakhatkhat in ka hnenah, “Hiti a si ngaingai ahcun, ziangtinso Pathian in mi a mawhthluk thei ding? Pathian ih duhmi le tummi cu zoso a el thei ding?” tiah in sut ding.","title":"Pathian Thinhennak Le Zaangfahnak"},"20":{"text":"Asinain, ka rual, cutiin Pathian a sawn ngamtu cu zoso na si? Beel in a tuahtu hnenah, “Ziangah so hiti in i tuah?” tiah a sawn dah maw?"},"21":{"text":"Thungai in kan ti asile beel tuahtu cun tlak leilung kha a duhduh ih tuah theinak thu a nei: a duh asile tlak hlom khat ihsin beel pahnih a tuah thei; pakhat cu tikcu sunglawi caan ih hman dingah, a dang pakhat cu nitin hman men dingah, a tuah a si."},"22":{"text":"Cuvek ṭhiamṭhiam in Pathian ih thil tuahdan khal ah a si. A thinhengnak langter ding le zokhal in a huham an hmuhnak ding kha a duh. Sikhalsehla a thinhengnak a tuartu ding le siatsuahnak a tongtu ding pawl ih parah cun a thin a sauzet ih mi a zawi theizet fawn."},"23":{"text":"Cule a famkimmi a sunlawinak khal cu langter a duh ih a cotu dingih tin ciami kan si ruangah a zaangfahnak dongtu kannih parah a sunlawinak cu a run burh."},"24":{"text":"Ziang ruangah tile kannih cu amah ih kawhmi a minung kan si; Judah mi sung ihsin kawhmi lawng si lo in Zentail mi sung khalin kawhmi kan si."},"25":{"text":"Hosea cabu sungah Pathian in, “Ka minung a si lomi pawl kha ‘Ka minung,’ tiah ka ko ding. Ka duh lomi miphun khal ‘Ka duhdawtmi,’ tiah ka ko ding.","ref":"Hos 2.23"},"26":{"text":"‘Nannih hi ka minung nan si lo tiah a rak tinak hmunah khan, ‘A nungmi Pathian ih faale pawl’ tiah annih cu kawh an si ding,” a ti.","ref":"Hos 1.10"},"27":{"text":"Cule profet Isaiah in Israel ih thu ah, “Israel mi pawl cu tifinriat kapih vunnel zat in tam hman hai sehla mi malte lawnglawng rundam an si ding;"},"28":{"text":"ziangahtile rei lote-ah hi leikhawvel thu hi Pathian in a ṭhen ding,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isai 10.22-23"},"29":{"text":"A hlan deuh ah Isaiah thotho in, “Cungnungbik Bawipa in tefa ṭhenkhat pawl zuah loin um sehla Sodom bangtuk ah kan cang zo ding ih Gomorrah vek kan si zo ding,” tiah a rak ti bangtuk kha a si.","ref":"Isai 1.9"},"30":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah, hiti in kan sim: Pathian thawn rualremnak tuah a tum dah lomi Zentail mi pawl cu an zumnak thawngin Pathian thawn an rem aw zo.","title":"Israel Hrangah Paul Thlacamnak"},"31":{"text":"Asinain Pathian ih minung pawl, Pathian thawn rualrem duh ah daan a hawl rerotu pawl cun cuih remnak cu an tong lo."},"32":{"text":"Ziangruangah so cutin a si? Zumnak rinsan loin an tuahmi an rinsan sawn ruangah a si. Cuti cun, “Bahnak lungto,” parah an bah a si."},"33":{"text":"Cuih Lungto thu ah Ca Thianghlim in: “Zohhnik, Zion ah lung pakhat ka ret; Cumi ruangah mi tampi an bah an sawn ding; Cuih lungpi cun mi a tluter hai ding. Sikhalsehla cumi a zumtu cu, an mualpho lo ding,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isai 28.16"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka u le ka nau tla, ka phunpi pawl hi rundamnak ngah hram hai sehla ti cu ka thinlung neihmi zatein ka duhmi a si. An hrangah ziangtlukin so thla ka cam ṭheu!"},"2":{"text":"Pathian hrangah cun an ṭang ngaingai, ti cu theihpitu ka si; sikhalsehla an ṭanzia hi a dik lo."},"3":{"text":"Pathian in amah le minung karlakah ziang bangtuk in rualremnak lamzin a tuah ti kha an thei lo; anmahte in an lamzin an sialcop. curuangah Pathian in minung thawn rualremnak a tuahmi lamzin sungah an lut duh lo."},"4":{"text":"Khrih in Daan cu a cemter zo ruangah zo khal zumnak a neitu pohpoh cu Pathian thawn rualremnak a ngah a si."},"5":{"text":"Moses in Pathian thawn rem awknak cu Daan thlunnak thawngin a si, tiah a ngan ih, “Zokhal Daan ih thupekmi a thluntu cu a nung ding,” a ti.","title":"Mi Hmuahhmuah Hrangah Rundamnak","ref":"Pui 18.5"},"6":{"text":"Asinain Ca Thianghlim in zumnak thawngin Pathian le minung karlakah remnak a um, ti thu-ah cun hiti in a ti: “Zoso vancungah a kai ding? tiah mah le mah sut awk ding a si lo.” (Cucu Khrih kha van in run ṭumpi ding, tican a si.)"},"7":{"text":"“Lei hnuai ah zoso a vung ṭum ding? tiin khal sut aw hlah.” (Cucu Khrih kha thihnak ihsin hun suahpi ding, tican a si.)"},"8":{"text":"A simmi taktak cu, “Pathian ih phuanmi thu cu na kiangah a um, na hmur ah a um ih na thinlung sung khalah a um,” ti a si. Cumi cu kan phuanmi zumnak ih thu cu a si.","ref":"Daan 30.12-14"},"9":{"text":"Jesuh cu Bawipa a si tiah na hmurka in na phuang ih Pathian in thihnak ihsin a thawhter sal, tiah na thinlung in na zum ahcun rundam na si ding."},"10":{"text":"Ziangahtile kan zumnak thawngin Pathian thawn rualremnak kan co; kan phuannak thawngin rundamnak kan ngah."},"11":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim in, “Amah a zumtu poh cu an mualpho lo ding,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isai 28.16"},"12":{"text":"Hitión ‘A zumtu poh cu,’ a ti tikah zozo khal an tel ṭheh, ziangahtile Judah mi le Zentail mi karlakah thleidannak a um nawn lo. Pathian cu mi hmuahhmuah ih Bawi a si ih Amah ih hmin a kotu hmuah hnenah siang zetin thlawsuah a pek a si."},"13":{"text":"Ca Thianghlim in, “Zokhal Bawipa ih hmin a kotu hmuah in rundamnak an ngah ding,” a timi a kim a si.","ref":"Joe 2.32"},"14":{"text":"An zum lomi cu ziangtinso a hmin an hlam thei ding? A thuhla an theih lo ahcun ziangtinso an zum thei ding? A thu phuan a si lo ahcun ziangtinso an theih ding?"},"15":{"text":"Palai thlahmi an um lo ahcun ziangtinso thu an phuan thei ding?
