Sikhalsehla anmah Thuṭhentu cu a tiar awknak a reipi zo ih anmah a Siatsuahtu ding cu it loin a um a si."},"4":{"text":"Vancungmi a sualmi pawl cu Pathian in zuah loin hell sungah a hlonthlak ih cutawk khawthim sungah cun ṭemṭawnin an um ih Thuṭhennak Ni hngak fualfo in an um."},"5":{"text":"Khuahlan sanih leilung khal Pathian in a rak zuah cuang lo. Pathian ṭihzahnak a nei lo leitlun miphun parah tilik a tlunter ih a runsuakmi cu dingnak thu a simtu Noah le midang pasarih lawng an si.","ref":"Seem 6.1—7.24"},"6":{"text":"Pathian in Sodom le Gomorrah khawpi cu a hnong ih meisa in a siatsuah; cumi cu Pathian ṭihzahnak a nei lotu pawl hrangah cinken dingih a tuahmi a si.","ref":"Seem 19.24"},"7":{"text":"Asinain cin le daan nei lo, miṭha lo pawl in vansaanglam ih an tuahmi miṭha pa Lot cu Pathian in a runsuak.","ref":"Seem 19.1-16"},"8":{"text":"Cuih miṭha pa cu miṭha lo pawl lakah um in khua a sa ih nitinte an ṭhat lo zia a hmu ih a theih tikah a thin a na zet."},"9":{"text":"Cutiin Bawipa cun amah a ṭihzahtu pawl harsat an tuarnak in runsuak a thiam ih miṭha lo pawl Thuṭhennak Ni tiang hremnak tuarter dingin a ret thiam."},"10":{"text":"Cutiin hremnak tuarih a retmi pawl cu Pathian thuneihnak nautat tahratin anmah ih tisa hiarnak le hurnak fihnungza a thluntu bik pawl an si. Hitiin mi a zirhsualtu pawl hi an puar ih an hngalzet; tlunlam vanih a ummi misunglawi pawl hman ziangah an siar lo; an hmuhsuam riangri a si."},"11":{"text":"Anmah hnakin a cak sawn le a tumsawn vancungmi hmanin Bawipa ih mithmuh ah cu pawl cu an hmuhsuam lo."},"12":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hi zirhsualtu pawl cu ziang hman ruahnak an nei lo, an thinlung ih a suak lokmi poh an tuah; kaih-ih thah dingmi ramsa bangtuk an si. An theih thei lomi poh cu nautatnak thawn an relsia. Curuangah ramsa bangin thahnak an tong ve ding."},"13":{"text":"Midang harsatnak an pek ruangah harsatnak an tuar ve ding. Annih hrangah nun nuam timi cu khawvan lai khalah an tisa hiarmi poh tuah ih diriamter khi a si. Mi bum cu nuam an ti ih nan hnenih rawl an ei tikah ningzahnak le mualphonak a suahtertu an si."},"14":{"text":"Nunau ṭha lo zoh dah ti lo an zoh duhmi ziang hman a um lo; sual tuah an hiarnak cu a riam thei dah lo. Zumnakih a derdai deuhmi pawl kha sualnak thang in an awk. Hamṭam lamah cun neh ding rual an si lo. Pathian ih camsiatnak hnuai ah an um a si."},"15":{"text":"Lamzin ding an pialsan ih zin an hlo zo. Beor fapa profet Balaam ih a rak thlunmi lamzin an thlun. Balaam cu thil ṭha lo tuah man ih a co dingmi paisa a duhtu a si ih,"},"16":{"text":"a sualnak ruangah mawhthluk a tong. A laak in Balaam cu milai ṭong in a biak ih aatthlakza thil ṭha lo a tuahmi cu a baanter.","ref":"Mipum 22.4-35"},"17":{"text":"Hi minung pawl cu a caarmi cirh le thlisia in a semmi khawdur bangtuk an si. Pathian in an hrangah a thuk bik khawthimnak hmun timtuah ciain a ret zo."},"18":{"text":"Puarthaunak le ṭong ṭha lo an ṭong; sualpalhnak sung ihsin a ra luat pekmi pawl sualnak thang-ih awk sal dingah an taksa hiarnak kha an hmang."},"19":{"text":"Mi an tiamkammi cu luatnak a si, sikhalsehla anmah rori cu mi siatsuahtu ziaza ṭha lo ih sal an si; ziangahtile minung cu thil ziang khal in a neh ahcun cuih a nehtu thil ih sal a si."},"20":{"text":"Kan Bawipa le Runtu Jesuh Khrih pumpak in an theihnak ruangah hi leilung borhhlawh sualnak sung ihsin an luat ih cutiih an luat ngah hnuah cuih borhhlawh sualnak in a thlem sal ih a kaihtaar ngah ahcun a hmasa hnakin a neta deuh cu a besia sawn a si."},"21":{"text":"Dingnak lamzin an theih hnuah le thukham thianghlim an hnenih pek a si hnu ih an pialsan hnak cun ziang hman thei lo lawlaw in rak um hai sehla an hrangah a ṭha sawn."},"22":{"text":"Hi bangtuk in an parih thil a cangmi in, “Uico cun a luak a ei sal,” tile, “Vok cu kholh hnu hmanah ciarbek sungah a bual aw kiir sal,” tiih ṭongṭhimnak hi a dik a si ti a langter.","ref":"Thufim 26.11"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi pawl, himi hi a voihnihnak nan hnenih ka nganmi cakuat a si. Ka cakuatmi a voihnih tein ka tummi cu nan thinlung sungah ruahnak thiang um thok seh tihi a si ih cumi cu ka lo theihter sal duhmi a si.","title":"Bawipa A Ra Sal Ding"},"2":{"text":"Hlanlaipi ah mithiang profet pawl in an rak sim ciami le kan Bawipa in Runtu in thukham a lo pekmi, nan hnenih tirhthlah pawl ih an phuanmi pawl kha ciing ringring uh, ti ka duhmi a si."},"3":{"text":"A hmaisabik ah nan theih dingmi cu: ni neta bik caanah mi ṭhenkhat an tisa hiarnak ih a ukmi pawl an ra suak ding, tihi a si. Cupawl cun hnihsuah ah an lo sai ding ih,"},"4":{"text":"“Khrih in ka ra sal ding, tiin a lo tiam a si lo maw? Atu hi khuiah so a um? Kan pupa pawl cu an thihnak a rei zo, sikhalsehla leilung a seem pek ihsin atu tiang ziang hmuahhmuah anmah keel thotho an si,” tiah an lo ti ding."},"5":{"text":"Hlanlaipi ah Pathian in a thu in lei le van hi a tuah a si ti an thei naón a thei lo vekin an um ding. Leilung cu tidai sung ihsin le tidai thawn tuahmi a si."},"6":{"text":"Cule tidai thotho, tilik tidai in leilung hlun cu a siatsuah a si."},"7":{"text":"Asinain atuih a ummi van le leilung hi meisa-ih siatsuah dingah Pathian ih thupeknak thotho in zuah hrihmi an si. Pathian a hmuhsuamtu pawl thuṭhen an si ni le siatralnak an ton ni hrangah zuahmi an si."},"8":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi pawl, thu pakhat hi hngilh hlah uh: Bawipa ih zoh daanah cun ni khat le kum thawngkhat an dang aw lo; amah ih hmaiah cun an bang aw a si."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa cu a thukammi kimter dingah a khul a fung a si tiah mihrek in ruat hman hai sehla, a khul a fung a si lo. Nan parah thinsaunak a neih ruangah a si sawn; ziangahtile pakhatte hman siatralnak tong lotein mi hmuahhmuah an sualnak ihsin an kir sal theinak ding a duh ruangah a si."},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Bawipa ih Ni cu rinlopi ah fifir bangin a ra ding. Cuih Ni ah van pawl cu huuk celcel in an hloral ding ih vanih a ummi hmuahhmuah tla an kaang ding ih an siatral ṭheh ding. Cule leilung cu a parih a ummi thil hmuahhmuah thawn a hloral ding a si."},"11":{"text":"Hi bangtuk in ziang hmuahhmuah a siat ṭheh ding ruangah nan nun laiah hin ziang bangtuk i nung ding so nan si? Nan nunnak cu a thianghlimmi sisehla Pathian hnenih hlanmi siseh."},"12":{"text":"Van pawl an kaang ṭheh ih siatsuah ṭheh an si ni le vanih a ummi hmuahhmuah meisaling in a tiitter ṭheh ding ni Pathian ih Ni cu ra thleng zaang hram seh tiih nan hngah ṭiaṭia lai ah hin cubangtuk cun um uh."},"13":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kannih cu Pathian ih in tiamkammi van thar pawl le lei thar, dingnak a tlanleennak hmun cu kan hngak a si."},"14":{"text":"Curuangah ka duhdawtmi tla, cuih Ni nan hngah rero laiah hin Pathian hmaiah mawh nei lo le a thiangmi si dingah zuam uhla amah thawn a rem-awmi si uh."},"15":{"text":"Kan duhdawtmi kan unau Paul in Pathian ih a pekmi fimnak thawn nan hnenih a nganmi ca kuat sungih a um vekin Bawipa in kan parih a thinsaunak cu kanmah rundamsuak in duh ruangah a si, tiin ruat uh."},"16":{"text":"Hi thuhla a telhnak a cakuat nganmi hmuahhmuah sungah cu bangtuk in a ngan ṭheu a si. A cakuatmi sungih a nganmi thuhla hrekkhat cu a theih a harmi an si ruangah mi aa le mi hnget hngai lo pawl cun, Ca Thianghlim caang dangdangih sullam an hrilhfiah sual vek thothoin, a ping a peng hlirin an sim a si. Cuticun anmah ih par lala ah siatralnak an thlenter."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka duhdawtmi tla, nannih hrangah cun himi cu nan theih ciami a si. Curuangah ralring zetin um uh! Cin le daan nei lomi pawl in an lo hruai sual lonak dingah le him zetin nan umnak hmun ihsin nan tlak lonak dingah ralringte in um uh."},"18":{"text":"Kan Bawipa le in Runtu Jesuh Khrih zaangfahnak le amah theihnak sungah ṭhang vivo uh. Amah hnenah sunlawinak cu atu le kumkhua in um camcin seh. Amen."}}}}},"62":{"info":{"name":"1 Johan","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"1 johan cakuat pakhatnak"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A hramthok ihsin a rak um ciami nunnak ih Thu nan hnenah ca in kan ngan. Cumi cu kan hna ih kan theihmi le kan mit in kan hmuhmi a si. Kan mit rori in kan rak hmuh ih kan kut rori in kan rak thammi a si.","title":"Nunnak Thu"},"2":{"text":"Cuih nunnak cu hmuh theihmi ih a rung can tikah kannih in kan hmu a si. Curuangah cuih Thu cu nan hnenah kan rel ih Pa thawn a ummi kumkhua nunnak, kan hnenih theihter a si mi Thu kha nan hnenah kan sim a si."},"3":{"text":"Pa le a fapa Jesuh Khrih thawn pawlkomnak kan neihmi sungih nan tel venak dingah kan hmuhmi le kan theihmi cu nan hnenah kan phuang a si."},"4":{"text":"Kan lungawinak kim seh tiah hi ca hi nan hnenah kan ngan a si."},"5":{"text":"A Fapa hnen ihsin kan theihmi thu le nan hnenih kan phuanmi cu himi hi a si: Pathian cu tleunak a si ih a sungah thimnak zianghman a um lo.","title":"Pathian Cu Tleunak A Si"},"6":{"text":"Curuangah amah thawn pawlkomnak kan nei kan ti naón thimnak sungih kan um a si ahcun kan ṭong in siseh, kan ṭuannak in siseh, thuphan kan per a si."},"7":{"text":"Sikhalsehla amah cu tleunak sungih a um vekin kannih khal tleunak sungih kan um ahcun pakhat le pakhat pawlkom awknak kan nei ih a Fapa Jesuh ih thisen in kan sualnak hmuahhmuah a tlengfai a si."},"8":{"text":"Sualnak kan nei lo kan ti ahcun kanmah le kanmah kan bum aw ih kan sungah thutak a um lo."},"9":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian hnenah kan sualnak kan phuan ahcun zumtlak le a dingmi a si ruangah kan sualnak in ngaidam ding ih kan mawhnak hmuahhmuah a thiangfaiter ding."},"10":{"text":"Asinain sualnak kan tuah lo kan ti ahcun Pathian cu thuphanper ah kan canter ih a thu kan sungah a um lo a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka faale tla, sual nan tuah lonak dingah hi ca hi nan hnenah ka ngan a si. Sikhalsehla pakhatkhat in sualnak nan tuah a si ahcun a dingmi Jesuh Khrih, kan ai-awh in Pa Pathian hnenih thu in simsak theitu kan nei.","title":"Khrih Cu Bawmtu A Si"},"2":{"text":"Cule Khrih amah ruangah kan sualnak cu in ngaithiam ih kanmah ih sualnak lawng si loin mi hmuahhmuah ih sualnak khal ngaithiam an si."},"3":{"text":"Pathian thupek kan thlun ahcun amah a theitu kan si ti a fiang a si."},"4":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat in Pathian ka thei tiah a ti naón a thupek a thlun lo ahcun thuphanper a si ih a sungah thutak a um lo."},"5":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Pathian thu a thluntu cu a sungah Pathian a duhdawtnak famkimin a um tinak a si. Pathian thawn pehzomnak kan nei ti kan theih fiangnak ding cu hiti in a si:"},"6":{"text":"Zokhal Pathian thawn pehzomnak ka nei a titu cun Jesuh Khrih bangin a nung ding."},"7":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi tla, nan hnenih ka nganmi thukham hi a thar a si lo; a hramthokin nan rak neihmi thukham hlun kha a si. Cuih thukham hlun cu nan theih ciami thu a si.","title":"Thukham Thar"},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla atu nan hnenih ka nganmi thukham hi thukham thar a si, ziangahtile hi thukham thar a dik zia cu Khrih sung le nanmah sungah hmuh theih a si. Ziangtin tile khawthim cu a reh vivo ih khawtleu taktak a lang zo."},"9":{"text":"Zokhal tleunak sungah ka um a ti naón a unau a huatu cu khawthim sungah a um hrih lai tinak a si."},"10":{"text":"Zokhal a unau a duhdawtu cu tleunak sungah a um ih curuangah midang sualternak ding a sungah zianghman a um lo."},"11":{"text":"Sikhalsehla a unau a huatu cu khawthim sungah a um a si; khawthim sungah cun a tawivak ih thimnak in a mit a cawtter ruangah khuitawk lam ka pan ti hman a thei lo."},"12":{"text":"Ka faale tla, Khrih thawngin nan sualnak cu ngaithiam a si ruangah hi cakuat hi nan hnenah ka ngan."},"13":{"text":"Pale tla, a hramthok ihsin a rak um zomi Amah nan theih ruangah hi cakuat hi nan hnenah ka ngan. Tlangval pawl, Satan nan neh thei ruangah hi cakuat hi nan hnenah ka ngan a si."},"14":{"text":"Ka faale pawl, Pa Pathian nan theih ruangah hi cakuat hi nan hnenah ka ngan. Pale pawl, a hramthok ihsin a rak um zomi Amah nan theih ruangah hi cakuat hi nan hnenah ka ngan. Tlangval pawl, micak nan si ruangah hi cakuat hi nan hnenah ka ngan; Pathian thu nan sungah a um ih Satan khal nan neh zo a si."},"15":{"text":"Hi leilung le a sungih thilri hi tlaihsan hlah uh; hi leilung hi nan tlaihsan asile Pathian duhdawtnak nan nei lo a si."},"16":{"text":"Leilung ta a si mi thil hmuahhmuah: sualnak tisa in a hiar mi, milai in an hmuhmi le an duhmi thil, minung in hmaihngal porh awknak ih an ruahmi thil hmuahhmuah hi pakhatte hman Pa hnen ihsin a rami an si lo. A zatein leilung ihsin a rami an si ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Leilung le a sungih a ummi thilri, milai ih an tlaihsanmi pawl hi an hloral vivo zo; asinain Pathian duhnak a tuahtu cu kumkhua in a nung ding."},"18":{"text":"Ka faale pawl, ni netnak a nai zo. Khrih ih Ral a ra ding ti nan thei; atu-ah Khrih ih ral tampi an lang zo ih curuangah neta bik caan a nai zo ti kan thei.","title":"Khrih Ih Ral"},"19":{"text":"Himi pawl hi kanmah ih mi ngaingai an si lo ruangah in tlansan a si. Kanmah sungih a telmi taktak si hai sehla in pawl ringring ko ding. Hitiih in suahsannak hin kan pawl sungih minung ngaingai an rak si lo, ti a langter a si."},"20":{"text":"Asinain nannih cu Khrih in Thlarau Thianghlim a lo burh zo ruangah nan zatein thutak theitu nan si."},"21":{"text":"Nan hnenih cakuat ka ngan hi thutak nan theih lo ruangah a si lo; thutak nan thei ih thuphan cu thutak ihsin a ra dah lo ti khal nan theih ruangah a si sawn."},"22":{"text":"Cuti asile zoso thuphanpertu cu a si? Jesuh cu Messiah a si lo, a titu poh cu thuphanpertu a si. Cupa cu Khrih ih Ral a si ih Pa le Fapa a hnongtu a si."},"23":{"text":"Ziangtin tile, Fapa a hnongtu cun Pa khal a hnong a si. Zokhal Fapa a pomtu cu Pa khal a pom ve."},"24":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah a hramthok ihsin nan theihmi thuthang cu nan thinlung sungah ṭhatein re uh. Cutiin ṭhateih nan ret asile Pa le Fapa thawn a pehzom aw ringringmi nan si ding."},"25":{"text":"Cuih kumkhua nunnak cu Khrih amah rori ih in tiamkammi a si."},"26":{"text":"Nanmah bum a lo tum rerotu pawl ih thu-ah hi cakuat hi nan hnenah ka ngan."},"27":{"text":"Nannih cu Khrih in a Thlarau nan parih a burh zo ruangah cuih a Thlarau nan sungih a um sungah cun midang ih zirh rero nan ṭul lo. Ziangahtile a Thlarau in ziang hmuahhmuah a lo zirh ih a lo zirhmi cu thuphan a si fawn lo, thudik a si sawn. Curuangah Thlarau ih zirhmi cu thlun uhla Khrih thawn pehzom aw ringring in um uh."},"28":{"text":"A si, ka faale pawl, amah thawn nan pehzom awknak ahcun hmun ringring ko uh; cuticun amah a rat tikah ralṭhatnak in kan khat ding ih a ra thlen Ni ah ningzakih a hmai-ihsin kan relh rero a ṭul lo ding."},"29":{"text":"Khrih cu a ding a si ti nan thei ko; curuangah zokhal a dingmi a tuahtu cu Pathian faate a si ti thei uh."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian kan Pa-ih in duhdawt zia hi ruathnik uh! In duhdawtnak a maksak ruangah Pathian faale tiih kawh kan si hi; cutiih in ti vekin kan si taktak. Curuangah a si hi khawvelih in theih lonak cu! Pathian khal a thei lo.","title":"Pathian Faale Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi pawl, atu cu Pathian faate kan si zo; asinain ziang bangtuk kan si lai ding ti cu a fiang hrih lo. Sikhalsehla Khrih a rat tikah cun amah bangtuk kan si ding ti kan thei; ziangahtile amah a si vek cekci in kan hmu ding."},"3":{"text":"Zokhal Khrih sungah hi bangtuk ruahsannak a neitu cu Khrih a thianhlim bangtuk in amah le amah a thianghlimter aw ve."},"4":{"text":"Zokhal a sualtu cu Pathian ih daan a buar a si, ziangahtile sual timi cu daanbuar khi a si."},"5":{"text":"Khrih cu minung sualnak thianfai sak dingah a ra ti cu nan thei ih a sungah ziang hman sualnak a um lo."},"6":{"text":"Curuangah Khrih sungih a ummi poh cun sualnak a tuah vivo lo. Sualnak a tuah ringringtu cu Khrih a hmu dah lo le a thei dah lomi an si."},"7":{"text":"Ka faale pawl, zohman in lo bum hlah hai seh. Khrih cu miding a si bangin zokhal dingnak a tuahtu poh cu miding a si ve."},"8":{"text":"Zokhal sual a tuah ringringtu cu Satan ih ta a si, ziangahtile Satan cu a hramthok ihsin sual a tuahtu a si. Pathian Fapa a langnak cu Satan hnaṭuannak siatsuah ṭheh ding rori ahhin a si."},"9":{"text":"Pathian fa zokhal in sual a tuah rero nawn lo, ziangahtile Pathian nunzia kha thlaici bangin a sungah a um. Cule Pathian cu a Pa a si ruangah sual in a nung nawn lo."},"10":{"text":"Pathian faate le Satan faate an dan awknak bik cu hihi a si: a dikmi a tuah lotu le a unau a duhdaw lotu cu Pathian faate an si lo."},"11":{"text":"A hramthok ihsin nan rak theih ringringmi thuthang cu pakhat le pakhat duhdaw aw uh, ti a si.","title":"Pakhat Le Pakhat Duhdaw Aw Uh"},"12":{"text":"Kain bangtuk si hlah uh; amah cu Satan fa ah a cang ih a nau Abel a that a si. Ziangah so Kain in Abel cu a thah? Ziangahtile a thil tuahmi a dik lo ih a naupa ih tuahmi cu a dik ruangah a si."},"13":{"text":"Curuangah u le nau tla, khawvelmi in an lo huat asile nan mang bang hlah uh."},"14":{"text":"Kannih cu thihnak kan suahsan zo ih nunnak sungah kan lut zo, ti kan thei; cuti kan theihnak cu kan unau kan duhdawt ruangah a si. Duhdawtnak a nei lomi cu thihnak sungah a taang lai hrih a si."},"15":{"text":"A unau a huatu cu mithat a si ih mi thattu sungah cun kumkhua nunnak a um lo ti nan thei."},"16":{"text":"Duhdawtnak taktak ziang bangtuk a si ti kan theihnak cu hiti in a si: Khrih in kan hrangah a nunnak a pek. Cuvek thothoin kannih khal in kan nunnak cu kan unau pawl hrangah pe ve ding kan si."},"17":{"text":"Milian pakhat in a tlasam zetmi a unau a hmu naón a thinlung in ziang hmanah siar loin a umsan meen a si ahcun Pathian ka duhdawt tiah ziangtinso a ti thei ding?"},"18":{"text":"Ka faale tla, kan duhdawt awknak cu ṭongkam le awka men si ding a si lo; duhdawtnak taktak cu ṭuannak ah a lang dingmi a si."},"19":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah thutak sungah kan um ti kan theihnak ding cu hiti in a si; cule Pathian hmaiah phuhrung aw loteih kan umnak ding cu hiti in a si.","title":"Pathian Hmaiah Ralṭhatnak"},"20":{"text":"Kan siaṭha thleidan thiamnak thinlung in in mawhthluk hman sehla Pathian cu kan thinlung hnakin a tum deuh ngaingai ih ziang hmuahhmuah theitu khal a si, ti kan thei."},"21":{"text":"Curuangah ka duhdawtmi tla, kan siaṭha thleidan thiamnak thinlung in in mawhthluk lo asile Pathian hmaiah ralṭhatnak kan nei a si ih,"},"22":{"text":"a hnen ihsin kan dilmi pohpoh kan ngah, ziangahtile a thupekmi kan thlun ih a lungawimi kan tuah ruangah a si."},"23":{"text":"A thupekmi cu Khrih ih thupekmi bangtuk in, a Fapa Jesuh Khrih kan zum ih pakhat le pakhat kan duhdawt awknak ding kha a si."},"24":{"text":"Pathian thupekmi a thluntu pohpoh cu Pathian sungah a um ih Pathian khal a sungah a um ve. Cule Pathian ih in pekmi Thlarau ruangah Pathian cu kan sungah a um, ti kan thei."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi tla, Thlarau ka nei a titu poh va zum hlah uh. An neihmi thlarau cu Pathian hnen ihsin a rami a si maw si lo tiah hniksak hmaisa uh. Ziangahtile profet dik lo pawl khuazakipah an thleng zo.","title":"Thlarau Dik Le Dik Lo"},"2":{"text":"Pathian Thlarau a si le si lo hiti in nan thei thiam ding: zokhal Jesuh Khrih cu minung in a ra tiah a phuangtu cu Pathian hnen ihsin a rami Thlarau neitu a si."},"3":{"text":"Sikhalsehla zokhal cutiin a phuang duh lotu cu Pathian hnen ihsin a rami Thlarau neitu a si lo. A neihmi thlarau cu Khrih ih Ral hnen ihsin a rami a si. Khrih ih Ral cu a ra ding tiah nan thei zo ih atu hi leitlunah a ra thleng zo."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka faale tla, nannih cu Pathian faate nan si; profet dik lo pawl tla nan neh zo, ziangahtile nan sungih a ummi Thlarau cu khawvel mi pawl sungih thlarau hnakin a cak sawn."},"5":{"text":"Profet dik lo pawl cun khawvel thuhla an sim ih khawvelmi in an thu cu an ngai, ziangahtile khawvelih ta an si."},"6":{"text":"Sikhalsehla kannih cu Pathian ta kan si. Pathian a theitu poh in kan thu an ngai; Pathian ta a si lomi cun kan thu an ngai lo. Cuticun thlarau dik le dik lo kan thleidan thiamnak cu a si."},"7":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi tla, pakhat le pakhat duhdaw aw uh si, ziangahtile duhdawtnak cu Pathian hnen ihsin a rami a si. Mi a duhdawtu cu Pathian fa a si ih Pathian theitu a si.","title":"Pathian Cu Duhdawtnak A Si"},"8":{"text":"Mi a duhdaw lotu cu Pathian a thei lo, ziangahtile Pathian cu duhdawtnak a si."},"9":{"text":"Pathian ih in duhdawtnak cu a Fapa neihsun hi leilungah hin run thlah in a langter ih amah thawngin nunnak kan conak dingah a si."},"10":{"text":"Duhdawtnak timi cu hiti in a si: Kanmah in Pathian kan rak duhdaw ti a si lo, amah sawn in in duhdaw ih a Fapa a run thlah; cumicu kan sualthlah raithawinak dingah a si."},"11":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi tla, hi bangtuk in Pathian in in duhdawt a si ahcun kannih khal pakhat le pakhat duhdaw aw ve ding kan si."},"12":{"text":"Zohman in Pathian cu an mit in an hmu dah lo, sikhalsehla pakhat le pakhat kan duhdaw aw a si ahcun Pathian cu kan sungah a nung ih a duhdawtnak cu kan sungah a famkim a si."},"13":{"text":"A Thlarau kan hnenih in pek zo ruangah Pathian cu kan sungah a um ih kannih khal a sungah kan um, ti fiangtein kan thei."},"14":{"text":"Pa in a Fapa cu leitlun Runtu si dingah a run thlah, ti a hmutu le a simtu kanmah hi kan si."},"15":{"text":"Zokhal Jesuh cu Pathian Fapa a si ti a phuangtu cu Pathian sungah a um ih Pathian khal a sungah a um ve."},"16":{"text":"Cule kanmah rori in Pathian ih in duhdawtnak cu kan thei ih kan zum a si. Pathian cu duhdawtnak a si, cule duhdawtnak thawn a nungmi hmuahhmuah cu Pathian sungah a nungmi an si ih Pathian khal an sungah a nung ve."},"17":{"text":"Thuṭhennak Ni ah ralṭhatnak kan neihnak dingah duhdawtnak cu kan sungah a famkimter zo. Cule leilung tlunih kan nunnak cu Khrih nunnak bangtuk a si ruangah cuih ralṭhatnak cu kan nei rori ding a si."},"18":{"text":"Duhdawtnak sungah cun ṭihphannak a um lo; a famkimmi duhdawtnak in ṭihphannak cu a hlohter ṭheh. Curuangah ṭihphannak a neimi sungah cun duhdawtnak cu famkimin a um hrih lo, ziangahtile ṭihphannak cu hremnak thawn a pehtlai awmi a si."},"19":{"text":"Pathian kan duhdawt cu amah ih in duhdawt hmaisa ruangah a si."},"20":{"text":"Zokhal Pathian ka duhdaw ticing in a unau a huatu cu thuphanper a si. Ziangahtile a mit in a hmuhmi a unau hman a duhdawt lo a si ahcun a hmuh lomi Pathian cu a duhdaw thei hrimhrim lo ding."},"21":{"text":"Khrih ih in pekmi thukham cu hiti in a si: zokhal Pathian a duhdawtu cun a unau khal a duhdaw ve ding."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zokhal Jesuh cu Messiah a si ti a zumtu cu Pathian fa a si. Cule zokhal sisehla an pa a duhdawtu cun a faale khal a duhdawt a si.","title":"Leilung Nehtu Kan Si"},"2":{"text":"Pathian faale pawl kan duhdawt a si ti kan theihnak cu amah Pathian kan duhdawt ih a thupekmi kan thlunnak hin a si."},"3":{"text":"Ziangahtile Pathian kan duhdawt ti cu a thupekmi kan thlun tinak a si. A thupekmi cu kan hrangah thlun har a si lo,"},"4":{"text":"ziangahtile Pathian fa a si mi poh in khawvel kha an neh thei. Cule kan zumnak thawngin kannih cu khawvel nehtu kan si."},"5":{"text":"Khawvel a nehtu cu zo so an si? Jesuh cu Pathian Fapa a si ti a zumtu pohpoh cu khawvel nehtu an si."},"6":{"text":"Ti le thisen thawn a rami cu Jesuh Khrih a si. Tidai thawn lawng in a ra lo, tidai le thisen ceem in a ra. Hitiin a ratnak cu a dikmi a si tiah Thlarau rori in a theihpi, ziangahtile Thlarau cu thutak a si.","title":"Jesuh Khrih Thu Theitu"},"7":{"text":"Theihpitu pathum an um:"},"8":{"text":"Thlarau le tidai le thisen an si ih an pathum in an theihpimi thu a bang aw a si."},"9":{"text":"Minungih thu theihpimi kan zum; cule Pathian ih theihpimi cu a thupi sinsin ih a Fapa thu a theihpimi cu amah rori in a langter zo."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah zokhal Pathian Fapa a zumtu cun amah ih thinlung sungah theihnak a nei a si; sikhalsehla Pathian a zum lotu cun, Pa in a Fapa thu a simmi a zum lo ruangah, Pathian kha thuphanper ah a canter."},"11":{"text":"Cutiih a theihtermi cu hiti in a si: Pathian in kumkhua nunnak in pe ih cuih nunnak cu a Fapa sungah a um."},"12":{"text":"Zokhal Fapa a neitu cu nunnak a nei; Pathian Fapa a nei lotu cu nunnak a nei lo."},"13":{"text":"Pathian Fapa a zumtu in kumkhua nunnak kan nei ti nan theihnak dingah hi cakuat hi nan hnenah ka ngan.","title":"Kumkhua Nunnak"},"14":{"text":"Kannih cu Pathian hmaiah ralṭhatnak kan nei, ziangahtile amah ih duhnak thawn mil-aw in kan dil ahcun kan dilnak kha in theih sak ṭheh a si, tihi fiangtein kan thei."},"15":{"text":"Amah kan dil tinten in theih sak; cule in theih sak ti kan theih ruangah kan dilmi hmuahhmuah in pe a si, ti khal kan thei."},"16":{"text":"Na unau pakhatkhat in thihpitlak a si lomi sualnak a tuah na hmuh ahcun Pathian hnenah thla cam sak awla Pathian in luatnak a pe ding. Himi cu thihpitlak a si lomi sualnak a tuahtu pawl hrangah a si. Sikhalsehla thihpitlak sualnak a um ih cumi a tuahtu pawl hrangah cun Pathian hnenah thla cam sak uh ka ti lo."},"17":{"text":"Thil tuah sualmi hmuahhmuah hi sualnak a si, sikhalsehla sualnak hmuahhmuah hi thihpitlak sualnak an si lo."},"18":{"text":"Pathian faate a si mi cu sualnak tuah vivo in a nung nawn lo ti kan thei, ziangahtile Pathian Fapa in a hum ih Satan in a siatsuah thei lo."},"19":{"text":"Leilung pumpi hi Satan kut hnuai ah a um; asinain kannih cu Pathian ta kan si ti kan thei."},"20":{"text":"Pathian Fapa cu a ra zo ih theihthiamnak in pek ruangah Pathian taktak kan thei, ti a fiang. A Fapa Jesuh Khrih thawn pehzomnak kan neih ruangah a dikmi Pathian thawn pehzomnak kan nei thei. Amah cu a dikmi Pathian a si ih kumkhua nunnak khal a si."},"21":{"text":"Ka faale tla, milem pawl cu va hrial uh."}}}}},"63":{"info":{"name":"2 Johan","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"2 johan cakuat pahnihnak"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kawhhran upa keimah in ka duhdawtmi le upatmi Nu le a faale pawl nan hnenah hi ca ka lo kuat a si. Keimah lawng si loin thutak a theitu hmuahhmuah in an lo duhdawt a si."},"2":{"text":"Ziangtiin tile thutak cu kan sungah a um ih kumkhua in kan hnenah a um ding."},"3":{"text":"Pathian kan Pa le a fapa Jesuh Khrih, Pa ih Fapa, in zaangfahnak, ngilneihnak le daihnak cu in pe hram sehla thutak le duhdawtnak khal kan ta si ringring hram seh."},"4":{"text":"Kan Pa Pathian ih thu in pek bangtuk in na faale hrekkhat cu thutak sungah an um ti ka hmuh tikah ka lung a awizet.","title":"Thutak Le Duhdawtnak"},"5":{"text":"Curuangah ka duhdawtmi le upatmi Nu, pakhat le pakhat duhdaw aw uhsi tiah ka lo dil. Hitiih ka nganmi hi thukham thar a si lo; a hramthok ihsin kan rak theihmi thukham a si."},"6":{"text":"Hi duhdawtnak ka timi cu Pathian thukham kan thlun a ṭul tinak a si. Cuih thukham cu, a hramthok ihsin nan rak theih zo bangtuk in, duhdawtnak thawn nan nung pei, ti a si."},"7":{"text":"Mibumtu tamzet leilung tlunah an thleng zo, Jesuh Khrih cu minung in a ra lo a si, a titu pawl an si! Cu bangtuk minung pawl cu mibumtu an si ih Khrih ih Ral an si."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah nan ṭuan sanmi nan hlohter lonak dingah le nan ṭuanman kha kimteih nan ngah theinak dingah ralringzet in um uh."},"9":{"text":"Zokhal Khrih thuzirhnak sungah um loin a hleifuan in a nungtu cu Pathian a nei lo. Sikhalsehla Khrih thuzirhnak sungih a umtu cu Pathian a nei ih a Fapa khal a nei a si."},"10":{"text":"Curuangah mi pakhatkhat nan hnenah a ra thleng ih hi thu zirhnak a keng lo a si ahcun nan inn ah thlenter hlah uh. “Na parah daihnak um seh,” ti hman ti duh hlah uh."},"11":{"text":"Ziangahtile ṭhat lonak a tuahtu kha, “Daihnak na parah um seh,” a titu cu ṭhat lonak a tuahmi sungah a tel ve a si."},"12":{"text":"Thu lo sim ding tamzet ka nei, sikhalsehla ca le cati cun ka lo sim lo pei. Kan lungawinak a famkim theinak dingah nan hnenah ra tlawng in pumpak in lo biak ka tum a si.","title":"Ṭong Netnak"},"13":{"text":"Nan duhdawtmi nan unau Nu ih faale in cibai an lo buk a si."}}}}},"64":{"info":{"name":"3 Johan","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"3 johan cakuat pathumnak"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kawhhran upa keimah in ka duhdawt zetmi Gaius na hnenah hi ca hi ka lo kuat."},"2":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi ka rual, thlarau lamah damte in na um ti ka theih vekin ziang hmuahhmuahah harhdam le siarem ih na umnak dingah na hrangah thla ka cam;"},"3":{"text":"Nang cu thutak sungah a um ringringmi na si bangtuk in thutak ah taimakin na um hrih ti thu Khristian unau pawl in in ra sim ih ka lung a awi ngaingai."},"4":{"text":"Ka faale pawl thutak sungah an nungcang ti ka theih hnakih ka lung i awitertu thu dang a um nawn lo."},"5":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi ka rual, na Khristian unau hrang hna na ṭuan tikah, na theih dah lomi an si hmanah rin um zetin na ṭuan a si.","title":"Gaius A Lawm"},"6":{"text":"Duhdawtnak na neih zia cu hi tawk kawhhran hnenah an ra rel zo. Hmailam an feh hrihnak ding lamzin khalah Pathian lungtong zawng in rak bawm hrih aw."},"7":{"text":"Ziangahtile Khrih hnaṭuannak an lamzin an rak thok tikah zum lotu pawl hnen ihsin bomnak ziang hman la loin Khrih hnaṭuan an rak thok a si."},"8":{"text":"Curuangah thutak sungih an hnaṭuannak sungah kannih khal kan tel venak dingah kannih Khristian pawl in napi in kan bawm pei."},"9":{"text":"Kawhhran hnenah ca tawite ka ngan; asinain an hotu si a duhtu Diotrefes cun ka simmi cu ziang hmanah a siar lo ding.","title":"Diotrefes Le Demetrias"},"10":{"text":"Curuangah ka ra thlen tikah a tuahmi hmuahhmuah ka phuang thluh ding; kan thuhla siazet ih a relmi le thuphan a permi pawl ka langter ṭheh ding. Culawng a si hrih lo. Khristian unau pawl an ra tlawn tikah thlen-inn a on duh lo ih thlen-inn on a duhtu pawl hman kha a kham ih cupawl cu kawhhran sung ihsin phuar dingah a zuam ciamco a si."},"11":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi ka rual, a ṭha lomi kha cawng hlah aw; a ṭhami cawng sawn aw. A ṭhami a tuahtu cu Pathian ta a si, a ṭha lomi a tuahtu cun Pathian a hmu lo."},"12":{"text":"Zozo khal in Demetrias an lawm; thutak hrimhrim khal in a lawm a si. Kanmah khal in cumi cu kan theihpi vemi a si ih kan simmi cu a dikmi a si ti na thei."},"13":{"text":"Thu lo sim ding tamzet ka nei, asinain cafung le cati thawn cun ngan ka duh lo.","title":"Cibaibuk Netnak"},"14":{"text":"Lo tlawn cing ka tum ih cunah hmaitonin ka lo sim leh ding."},"15":{"text":"Daihnak na parah um hram seh. Na rualpi pawl in cibai an lo buk. Kan rualpi pawl kha pumpak ciar in cibai in rak buksak aw."}}}}},"65":{"info":{"name":"Juda Cakuat","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":"Juda cakuat"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih ih siahhlawh le Jeim ih nau keimah Juda in Pathian kawhmi, Pathian kan Pa ih duhdawtmi le Jesuh Khrih humhimnak sungih a ummi pawl nan hnenah hi ca ka lo kuat."},"2":{"text":"Pathian zaangfahnak le daihnak le duhdawtnak cu famkim zetin nan ta si hram seh."},"3":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi unau tla, kan zatein kan pomtlaangmi rundamnak thu hi nan hnenah ca in ka thiam tawkin ka ngan; Pathian in a mithiang hnenah kumkhua daihin a pekmi zumnak thu ahhin taimak suah in ṭang uhla zuam uh tiah a hleice in ka lo forh duh a si.","title":"Zirh Sualtu Pawl"},"4":{"text":"Ziangahtile kan lakah Pathian ziangih a siar lotu pawl kan theih loin an lut ih an ziaza ṭha lomi thuh awknak ah Pathian zaangfahnak thuthang kha a pingpeng in an sim ih kan hrangah Bawi le Lal a si mi Jesuh Khrih kha an hnong. Hi bangtuk minung pawl cu siatralnak an tong ding tiah Ca Thianghlim in hlanlai ihsin a rak sim cia zo."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa in Israel mi pawl Izipt ram ihsin a suah ih neh hnuah a zum lotu pawl cu siatralnak ah a thlenter ti hi nan theih ṭheh ciami a si ko naón nan theih sal dingah ka duhmi a si.","ref":"Suah 12.51; Mipum 14.29-30"},"6":{"text":"An thuneih theinak sungah um duh loin an umnak hmun a tlansantu vancungmi pawl kha ciing ringring uh. Annih cu leilung thuai khawthim sungah kumkhua in thir cikcin in khih an si ih a maksakmi Ni ah Pathian in an thu a ṭhen leh hai ding."},"7":{"text":"Cuih vancungmi vek thothoin Sodom le Gomorrah khua le a kiangkap khua pawl in nupa sualnak an tuah ih an tisa hiarnak an riamter ti kha hngilh hlah uh: annih pawl ih kumkhua meisa ih hremnak an tuarmi kha mi hmuahhmuah hrangah ralrin peknak a si ti a fiang a si.","ref":"Seem 19.1-24"},"8":{"text":"Cubangtuk ṭhiamṭhiam in tuihsan minung pawl khal an si: hmuhnak kan nei an ti ih an taksa an borhhlawhter; Pathian thuneihnak kha an nautat ih vanih a ummi mi sunglawi pawl an zawmtai."},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi lakih a upa bik Mikhael hman in cubangtuk in a tuah lo. Moses ih ruak zo in a co ding tiah Satan thawn thu an el awk tikah nautatnak ṭongkam thawn Satan cu a camriam ngam lo; “Bawipa in a lo kawk!” tiah a ti meen a si.","ref":"Dan 10.13, 21; Thup 12.7; Daan 34.6; Zek 3.2"},"10":{"text":"Sikhalsehla hi minung pawl cun an theih thei lomi thu poh kha nautatnak thawn an relsiat. Cule ramsa bangtuk in an taksa duhnak in an theih theimi thil pawl cu anmah lala siatsuahtu ah an cang."},"11":{"text":"An hmakhua a va pit so! An thlunmi cu Kain ih a rak thlunmi lamzin a si. Paisa duh ruangah Balaam ih a rak tuahmi sualnak ah an taksa pum an pe aw. Korah vekin ral an tho ih Korah bangtuk in siatralnak ah an thleng ve a si.","ref":"Seem 4.3-8; Mipum 22.1-35; 16.1-35"},"12":{"text":"Pawlkomnak rawl nan eitlaang tikah ningzahnak malte hman nei loin an ei an in ruangah a lo hmelsia tertu an si. Anmah ih zawn lawng an ruat. Thli in a zuanpi rero naón ruahti a zawi lomi khawdur bangtuk an si. Fur hmanah rah a nei lomi thingkung bangtuk an si; a hramih phawi suak ih a thi ngahmi thingkung bangtuk an si."},"13":{"text":"Ṭihnungza tisumsuar bangtuk an si; ningzakza an ziaza ṭha lo cu tiphuul bangin an phuan burhbo; arsi zuang bangtuk an si ih a thuk bik khawthimnak hmunah kumkhua an umnak dingah Pathian in umnak a ngaihtuah sak zo."},"14":{"text":"Adam ihsin sanruknak a si mi Enok in himi pawl thuhla hi a rak sim cia zo. “Pathian cu a vancungmi, mithiang thawng tampi thawn,","ref":"Seem 5.18, 21-24"},"15":{"text":"mi hmuahhmuah thuṭhen dingah le Pathian ṭihzahnak zianghman nei loin thil a tuahtu hmuahhmuah le Pathian upatnak zianghman nei lo misual pawl in tuksumza ṭongsiava thawn Amah a relsiattu pawl an thu ṭhen dingah a ra ding a si,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Himi pawl cu an phunzai ringring ih catloin midang an relsia, a ṭha lomi an tisa duhnak an thlun; anmah le anmah an khaisaang aw ih an thuthu in ziang hmuahhmuah a feh theinak dingah midang an porh ciamco."},"17":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ka duhdawtmi tla, kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih ih tirhthlah pawl in an rak lo zirhnak kha ciing ringring uh.","title":"Ralrinnak Le Zirhawknak"},"18":{"text":"Nan hnenih an simmi cu, Ni netnak a thlen tikah nanmah a lo hnihsantu le Pathian ṭihzahnak nei loin anmah ih tisa duhnak a thluntu an suak ding,” tihi a si.","ref":"2 Pit 3.3"},"19":{"text":"Himi pawl cu ṭhenṭheknak a suahtertu le tisa duhnak ih a ukmi le Thlarau a nei lotu an si."},"20":{"text":"Asinain nannih ka duhdawtmi pawl cu a thianghlimmi nan zumnak parah ṭhangso vivo uh. Thlarau Thianghlim cahnak thawn thla cam uhla,"},"21":{"text":"kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih in a zaangfahnak thawn kumkhua nunnak a lo pek ding ni nan hngah laiah hin Pathian ih duhdawtnak sungah hmun ringring uh."},"22":{"text":"Rinhmainak a neimi parah zaangfahnak nei uh;"},"23":{"text":"midang pawl kha meisa sung ihsin suah uhla rundam suak uh; cule a dang pawl parah zaangfahnak le ṭihnak langter uh, sikhalsehla an tisa hiar sualnak in a hnawihnihmi an hnipuan pawl cu hua uh."},"24":{"text":"Tlu suak loin a lo kilkhawi ih sualmawhnak nei loin lungawinak thawn a sunglawimi a umnak ah a lo thlenter theitu,","title":"Thluasuah Peknak"},"25":{"text":"amah lawng kan Pathian le Runtu a si mi hnen ahcun, kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih thawngin a cem ciami caan ah siseh, atu le hmailam caanah siseh, sunlawinak, thawmliannak, cahnak le thuneihnak cu kumkhua in kumkhua tiang um camcin hram seh. Amen."}}}}},"66":{"info":{"name":"Thuphuan","shortname":"Thup","abbr":[],"desc":"Thuphuan johan hnenih langtermi thuphuan"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu hi Jesuh Khrih ih a phuanmi a si. A ra thleng cing dingmi thil kha a siahhlawh pawl hnenih langter dingah Pathian in a hnenih a hmuhtermi a si. Cumi cu Khrih in a vancungmi pakhat thlah tahratin a siahhlawh Johan hnenih a theihtermi a si.","title":"Johan Hnenih Thuphuan"},"2":{"text":"Cule Johan in a hmuhmi hmuahhmuah cu a sim ṭheh. Pathian hnen ihsin a rami thuthang le Jesuh Khrih ih a langtermi thutak cu Johan in hi bangtuk in a sim."},"3":{"text":"Hi cabu a siartu le profet thusimmi a theitu le hi cabu sungih a ummi a thluntu pawl cu mi lungawi an si. Ziangahtile hi thu pawl a kimnak tikcu a nai zo."},"4":{"text":"Asia peng sungih a ummi kawhhran pasarih hnenah keimah Johan in thu ka lo cah: Atuih canah a ummi le a rak um zomi le hmailam khalah a um lai dingmi Pathian le a bawi tokham hmaiih a ummi thlarau pasarih le,","title":"Kawhhran Pasarih Cibai Buknak"},"5":{"text":"rintlak a si mi thutheitu, hrin hmaisa bik a si mi Fapa, thihnak ihsin thawhtersal a si mi leilung siangpahrang pawl uktu Jesuh Khrih in zaangfahnak le daihnak lo pe hram seh. Kannih in duhdawt ih a thihnak thisen thawngin kan sualnak ihsin in luatter zo."},"6":{"text":"Puithiam bangin a siangpahrang uknak sungah Pathian le a Pa riantu si dingah kannih cu in tuah zo. Curuangah sunlawinak le huham cu Jesuh Khrih hnenah kumkhua in um ko seh. Amen."},"7":{"text":"Zoh uh! Khrih cu mero thawn a ra ding ih mi hmuahhmuah in an hmu ding; amah a suntu pawl khal in an hmu ding. Leilung tlun minung hmuahhmuah an ṭap-ai ding. Cutiin a si hrimhrim ding. Amen."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian in, “Keimah cu Alfa le Omega ka si,” a ti; Amah cu atuih a ummi le a rak um zomi le hmailam khalah a um lai dingmi Ziangkimtithei a si."},"9":{"text":"Keimah cu nan unau Johan, Jesuh a thluntu ka si ih Khrih uknak sungih a telmi pawl parih a rathlengmi harsatnak nan tuarmi khal a tuar vemi ka si. Pathian thu le Jesuh ih phuanmi thutak ka sim ruangah Patmos tikulh ah in ret.","title":"Johan In Khrih A Hmu"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa Ni ah Thlarau in i zeel ih ka dunglam ihsin tawtawrawt vekin a ring zetmi aw thawm ka thei."},"11":{"text":"“Na hmuhmi hi ca sungah ngan awla Efesa, Smarna, Pergamum, Thiatira, Sardis, Filadelfia le Laodisia khua pasarih ih a ummi kawhhran pasarih hnenah kuat aw,” tiah i ti."},"12":{"text":"Cutiih i titu cu zoso a si tiah ka her ih ka zoh tikah sui meisa vannak tung pasarih ka hmu."},"13":{"text":"Cuih meisa vannak tung pasarih lakah milai a bang zetmi pakhat a ding ih a kebeu tiang angki fual hrukin sui ṭaangkap a ṭaangah a kap ka hmu."},"14":{"text":"A sam cu tuuhmul le vur bangtuk in a rang. A mit cu meiling bangin a vaam."},"15":{"text":"A ke cu somei sungih an thianter hnuah an hnawtfaimi dar vekin a tle. A aw cu tipilian tlasuar thawm bangtuk a si."},"16":{"text":"A vorhlam kut in arsi pasarih a keng ih a ka sung ihsin kaphnih hriam ralnam pakhat a suak. A mithmai cu sun laitakih ni bangin a tleu."},"17":{"text":"Cutiin ka hmuh tikah mithi bangin a kehram ah ka ril. A vorhlam kut in i run tham ih, “Ṭih hlah aw! Keimah cu a hmaisa bik le a neta bik ka si."},"18":{"text":"A nungmi khal ka si. Ka rak thi naón atu-ah kumkhua hrangin ka nung sal zo. Thihnak le mithi khua tlunah thuneitu ka si."},"19":{"text":"Curuangah na hmuhmi thil pawl, atuih a ummi le hmailamih a um lai dingmi thil pawl hi ngan aw."},"20":{"text":"Ka vorhlam kutih na hmuhmi arsi pasarih le sui mei vannak tung pasarih ih tican thuthup cu hi bangtuk in a si. Arsi pasarih cu kawhhran pasarih ih vancungmi an si ih mei vannak tung pasarih cu kawhhran pasarih an si,” tiah a ti."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Efesa kawhhran ih vancungmi hnenah hiti in ngan aw: A vorhlam kutah arsi pasarih kengin sui mei vannak tung pasarih lakih a tawivak rerotu ih thucahmi cu hi bangtuk in a si:","title":"Efesa Kawhhran Hnenih Thucahmi"},"2":{"text":"Na hnaṭuanmi ka thei; taima zetih hna na ṭuan zia le thinsau zetih na um zia khal ka thei. Cun miṭha lo pawl na zawi-eet thei lo zia le dungthluntu si lo cingih dungthluntu ka si a titu pawl na hniksak ih thuphanper an si zia na hmuhsuahnak thu pawl ka thei ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Na thin a sau ih keimah ih ruangah na tuar; asinain na bei a dong lo."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla mawhthluk ding pakhat ka lo nei: a hramthokih duhdawtnak na neihmi kha na nei nawn lo."},"5":{"text":"Na tlaknak a san zia hi ruathnik. Na sual sir awla a hmaisaih na tuahmi kha tuah sal aw. Na sualnak na tlansan lo a si ahcun ka ra ding ih na mei vannak tung hmun dangah ka ṭhawn ding."},"6":{"text":"Asinain porhtlak na sinak pakhat a um. Nikolas a thluntu pawl ih hnaṭuannak cu keimah ih ka huat tlukin na hua ve a si."},"7":{"text":"“Theihnak hna nan neih asile Thlarau in kawhhran hnenih a simmi hi ngai uh. “Nehtu a si mi hnenah Pathian Hmuan sungih a khomi nunnak thingrah ei theinak thu ka pe ding,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"“Smarna kawhhran ih vancungmi hnenah hiti in ngan aw: a hmaisa bik le a neta bik a si mi, a thi ih a nung salmi ih thucahmi cu hi bangtuk in a si.","title":"Smarna Kawhhran Hnenih Thucahmi"},"9":{"text":"Harsatnak na tuarmi pawl ka thei. Mifarah na si khal ka thei: sikhalsehla na lian a si. Judah mi kan si an ti naón a si ngaingai lomi pawl ih an lo relsiatnak ka thei. Annih cu Satan ta an si."},"10":{"text":"Harsatnak na tuar dingmi kha zianghman ṭih hlah. Ngaihnik! Satan in a lo hniksak ding ih ṭhenkhat cu thawngah thlak nan si ding. Cule nan harsatnak cu nihra a rei ding. Thihnak tuar ding a si hmanah ka hrangah rinsan tlak in um uhla nan neh man ah nunnak suilukhuh ka lo pe ding."},"11":{"text":"“Theihnak hna nan neih asile Thlarau in kawhhran hnenih a simmi hi ngai uh. “Nehtu pawl cu voihnih thihnak in a siatsuah lo ding,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"“Pergamum kawhhran ih vancungmi hnenah hiti in ngan aw: ralnam kaphnih hriam a neituih thucahmi cu hi bangtuk in a si.","title":"Pergamum Kawhhran Hnenih Thucahmi"},"13":{"text":"Na umnak hmun cu ka thei: Satan in a bawi tokham a retnak hmunah a si. Ka hrangah rintlak in na nung ih Satan umnak hmunah rintlak ka thu theitu Antipas an thah lai hmanah ka parih rinsannak na neihmi cu na ṭhin cuang lo."},"14":{"text":"Sikhalsehla na parah lungkim lonak malte ka nei: nanmah lakah Balaam thuzirhnak a thluntu mi ṭhenkhat an um. Milem hnenih pekmi rawl einak le nupa sualtuahnak in sualnak sungih Israel mi pawl luhpi dingah Balaam in Balak kha a rak fial."},"15":{"text":"Cuvek thothoin Nikolas a thluntu pawl ih thuzirhnak a pomtu khal nan lakah an um."},"16":{"text":"Cuti a si ruangah hi bangtuk sualnak ihsin kir sal uh. Nan kir sal lo asile nan hnenah zamrangin ka ra ding ih cumi pawl cu ka kaa sung ihsin a suakmi ralnam thawn ka do ding a si."},"17":{"text":"“Theihnak hna nan neih asile Thlarau in kawhhran hnenih a sim mi hi ngai uh. “Nehtu pawl cu thuh-mi Manna sang ṭhenkhat ka pe ding. Cuih tlunah lung raang pakhat fingfing in ka pe ding ih cuih lung raang parah cun a cotu lawngih theihmi an hmin thar ngan in a um fingfing ding,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"“Thiatira kawhhran ih vancungmi hnenah hiti in ngan aw: a mit meisa bangin a alh-mi le a ke cu hnawtfaimi daar vekin a tleumi Pathian Fapa ih thucahmi cu hi bangtuk in a si.","title":"Thiatira Kawhhran Hnenih Thucahmi"},"19":{"text":"Na hnaṭuanmi ka thei. Duhdawtnak na neih zia, rinsantlak na si zia, hna na ṭuan zia le thinsaunak na neih zia ka thei ṭheh. A hmaisa hnakin atu-ah tam sawn in hna na ṭuan ti khal ka thei."},"20":{"text":"Asinain ka lo mawhthluknak pakhat a um: Pathian ih thlahmi profet ka si a ti awtu nunau Jezebel na zawi-eet theinak hi a si. Jezebel in ka minung pawl a hruaisual ruangah nupa sualnak an tuah ih milem hnenih pekmi rawl tla an ei."},"21":{"text":"Thinlung sir awknak tikcu ka pek, asinain a nunsualnak lamzin ihsin a kir duh lo."},"22":{"text":"Curuangah natnak thawn ihkhun ah ka thlenter ding ih nupa sualnak a tuahpitu pawl thawn tuksumza harsatnak an tuar ding. Amah thawn an tuahmi sualnak ihsin an sir awk lo ahcun hi tuarnak pawl hi atu rori-ah an parah ka thlenter ding."},"23":{"text":"Amah a thluntu pawl khal ka that ding ih cuticun kawhhran hmuahhmuah in minung ruahnak le tumtahmi a thei ṭhehtu ka si zia hi an thei ding. Cule zozo khal nan tuahmi vekin a man nan ngah ding."},"24":{"text":"“Sikhalsehla Thiatira khua ih a ummi midang pawl cun hi zirhnak ṭha lo hi nan thlun lo ih midang in, ‘A thukmi Satan thuthup,’ an timi cu nan thei lo. Nan hnenih ka sim duhmi cu: nan parah thilrit bet ka tum lo;"},"25":{"text":"nan pom ciami hi ka rat hlan tiang thlah hlah uh, tihi a si."},"26":{"text":"Nehtu pawl le tuah hai seh tiih ka duhmi a net tiang a tuahtu pawl cu ka Pa hnen ihsin ka ngahmi thuneihnak kha an hnenah ka pe ve ding. Miphun dangdang tlunih uknak thu an hnenah ka pe ding; thirfung thawn uk theinak le tlak beel khuai bangih miphun dang pawl khuaiparh theinak thu an hnenah ka pe ding. Cun deirel arsi khal ka pe ding.","merge":"27"},"29":{"text":"“Theihnak hna nan neih asile Thlarau in kawhhran pawl hnenih a sim mi hi ngai uh,” tiah a ti."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Sardis kawhhran ih vancungmi hnenah hiti in ngan aw: “Pathian ih thlarau pasarih le arsi pasarih a neituih thucahmi cu hi bangtuk in a si. Na hnaṭuanmi ka thei; a nungmi kawhhran tiah na hmin a thangzet naón na thi a si.","title":"Sardis Kawhhran Hnenih Thucahmi"},"2":{"text":"Curuangah ṭhangharh awla na neih hrihmi kha a thih ngah hlanah thazaang a thar in la sal aw. Ziangahtile hna na ṭuan ciami hi Pathian hmaiah an famkim hrih lo tiin ka hmu."},"3":{"text":"Curuangah an lo zirhmi le na theih ciami pawl kha hngilh hlah aw; a thlun tum awla na sualnak ihsin kir sal aw. Na ṭhangharh lo a si ahcun rukru bangin na hnenah ka ra ding ih ka rat tikcu hman na thei lo ding."},"4":{"text":"Sikhalsehla Sardis khua ih a ummi lakah mi malte cun nan hnipuan thiangfai zetin nan re a si. Puan rang hrukin keimah thawn nan feh ding, ziangahtile cutiih feh tlak nan si."},"5":{"text":"Nehtu pawl cu cubangtuk in puan rang an hruk ding ih nunnak cabu sung ihsin an hmin ka phiat lo ding. Ka Pa le a vancungmi pawl hmaiah ‘Ka ta an si,’ tiah langhngan in ka sim ding."},"6":{"text":"“Theihnak hna nan neih asile Thlarau in kawhhran pawl hnenih a simmi hi ngai uh,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"“Filadelfia kawhhran ih vancungmi hnenah hiti in ngan aw: “A thianghlimmi le a dikmi-ih thucahmi cu hi bangtuk in a si. Amah cu David tawh a neitu a si ih sangka a onmi cu zohman in an khar thei lo ding; cule a kharmi cu zohman in an ong thei lo ding.","title":"Filadelfia Kawhhran Hnenih Thucahmi"},"8":{"text":"Na hnaṭuanmi ka thei; na thazaang a mal ti khal ka thei. Asinain ka thuzirhmi na thlun ih ka hmaiah rinsan tlak in na um. Na hmaiah sangka ka ong ih zohman in an khar thei lo ding."},"9":{"text":"Ngaihnik! Judah mi kan si, an ti naón a si taktak lomi thuphanper pawl, Satan minung pawl cu na hnenah ka ratter dingih na hmaiah an kun ding. Ka lo duhdawt hi an zatein an thei ding."},"10":{"text":"Ka thupekmi bangtuk in thinsau in harsatnak na tuar thei ruangah leilungtlun mi hmuahhmuah hniksak dingah a ra thleng dingmi harsatnak sung ihsin ka lo humhim ding."},"11":{"text":"Ka ra cing ding. Nehtu na si ruangih na ngah dingmi laksawng cu zohmanih an lo lon theilonak dingah na neih ciami cu kil ṭha aw."},"12":{"text":"Nehtu cu ka Pathian ih biakinn sungih ṭhuam ah ka tuah ding ih cuih biakinn cu a tlansan nawn lo ding. Ka Pathian ih hmin cu a parah ka ngan ding; Jerusalem khua thar, ka Pathian ih khawpi hmin khal a parah ka ngan ding. Cuih khawpi cu vancung ihsin ka Pathian hnenin a rung ṭum dingmi a si. Cule ka hmin thar khal a parah ka ngan ding."},"13":{"text":"“Theihnak hna nan neih asile Thlarau in kawhhran pawl hnenih a simmi hi ngai uh,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"“Laodisia kawhhran ih vancungmi hnenah hiti in ngan aw: A hminah Amen a si mi, rinsantlak le theitudik a si ih Pathian ih siammi hmuahhmuah ih hramthawhnak a si mi-ih thucah cu hi bangtuk in a si.","title":"Laodisia Kawhhran Hnenih Thucahmi"},"15":{"text":"Na hnaṭuanmi ka thei. A daih khal na dai lo, a sat khal na sa fawn lo, ti ka thei. Na daih asile dai lawlaw aw, na sat asile sa lawlaw aw, ti ka duh."},"16":{"text":"A daih le dai si lo, a sat le sa si lo; a hlum fangfang na si ruangah ka ka sung ihsin ka lo khak suak ding."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah cun, ‘Ka lian ih mi neinung ka si; zianghman tlaksammi ka nei lo,’ na ti aw. Sikhalsehla mizonzai le zangfakza na si zia na thei aw lo. Na farah, lawngfangkheh in na um ih na mit a caw."},"18":{"text":"Thu ka lo sim duhmi cu, sui ngaingai ka hnen ihsin lei awla cuticun na lian ding. Na thuam awknak ah hnipuan rang lei awla, ningzakza lawngfangkheh ih na um kha hup aw. Na mit hrangah mitna sii khal lei awla cuticun khua na hmu ding."},"19":{"text":"Ka duhdawtmi pawl cu ka kawk ih ka hrem a si. Curuangah taimak suah in um awla na sualnak sir aw."},"20":{"text":"Ngaihnik! sangka kiangah ka ding ih ka king. Zokhal ka aw a thei ih sangka i ontu cu a innah ka lut dingih a hnenah rawl ka ei ding; cule anih khal keimah thawn a ei ve ding."},"21":{"text":"Nehtu ka si zo ih atu-ah ka Pa ih bawi tokham parah ka Pa kiangih ka to vekin nehtu a si mi pawl cu ka bawi tokham parah ka kiangah to theinak thu ka pe ding."},"22":{"text":"“Theihnak hna nan neih asile Thlarau in kawhhran pawl hnenih a simmi hi ngai uh,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah ka hun zoh ih langnak dang ka hmu sal ih vancungah sangka a ong awmi pakhat ka hmu. Cule a hmaisa-ih ka theihmi tawtawrawt bangtuk ih a ringmi aw kha ka thei ih, “Hi tawkah hung awla himi ṭheh in a ra thleng dingmi ka lo hmuh ding,” tiah cuih aw cun i ti.","title":"Vancung Ih Pathian Biaknak"},"2":{"text":"Cule Thlarau in hmakhatte-ah i zeel. Vancung ahcun bawi tokham pakhat a um ih cuih tokham parah mi pakhat a to."},"3":{"text":"A mithmai cu a hringmi jasper lungmankhung le a senmi karnelian lungmankhung bangtuk in a tleu; a bawi tokham kiangkap cu a hringmi emerald lungmankhung bangtuk vangro in a kulh."},"4":{"text":"A bawi tokham kimvelah a dang bawi tokham kul hluanli an um ih cuih tokham parah puan vaar a sinmi le suilukhuh a khumtu upa kul hluanli an to."},"5":{"text":"Cuih bawi tokham ihsin nimthla a kau zukzo ih khawri thawm a thang durdo. Cule bawi tokham hmaiah cun meisa vanmi pasarih a um ih, cuih meisa vanmi pasarih cu Pathian ih thlarau pasarih an si."},"6":{"text":"Bawi tokham hmaiah cun tikhal bangin a tlemi thlalang tifinriat bangtuk khal a um. Cuih bawi tokham kimvelah thilnung pali an um ih dunglam hmailam in mit in an khat ṭheh."},"7":{"text":"Thilnung pakhatnak cu kiosa a bang; a pahnihnak cu cawcang a bang; a pathumnak cu minung mithmai a bang ih a palinak cu a zammi mupi a bang."},"8":{"text":"Thilnung pali cu thla paruk ciar an nei ih cuih thla cu a sunglam a lenglam in mit in an khat ṭheh. Sun le zan cat loin hla an sak ih, Thianghlim, thianghlim, thianghlim, Ziangkimtithei Bawipa Pathian; A rak um zomi le atu-ah a ummi le hmailam khalah a umlai dingmi a si, tiah an sak."},"9":{"text":"Thilnung pali in bawi tokham parah a to ih kumkhua in kumkhua tiang a nungmi hnenah sunlawinak le upatnak le lungawinak hla an sak."},"10":{"text":"Cubangtuk ih hla an sak tikah bawi tokham parih a totu hmaiah cun an kun ih kumkhua in kumkhua tiang a nungmi cu an biak. An sui lukhuh cu bawi tokham hmaiah cun an ṭhum ih:"},"11":{"text":"“Kan Bawipa le kan Pathian, Nang cu sunlawinak le upatnak le huham co tlak na si. Ziangahtile nang cun ziang hmuahhmuah na tuah ih na thu in siam mi le nunter mi an si,” tiah an ti."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawi tokham parih a tomi in cazual pakhat a vorhlam kut in a ken kha ka hmu. Cuih cazual cu a sunglam le lenglam in nganmi a si ih tacik pasarih ih khenmi a si.","title":"Cazual Le Tuufa"},"2":{"text":"Cule vancungmi pakhat a cak zetmi ka hmu ih aw ring zetin, “Hi tacik khenmi siatbal tahratin cazual ong dingah a tlakmi zoso a um?” tiah a au."},"3":{"text":"Asinain cuih cazual ong tahratin a sung a zoh theitu vancungah siseh, leitlunah siseh, leihnuai khalah siseh, zohman an um lo."},"4":{"text":"Cutiin cazual a ongtu ding tlak le a sung a zohtu ding tlak zohman an um lo ka hmuh tikah napiin ka ṭap."},"5":{"text":"Cutikah upa pakhat in, “Ṭap hlah. Zohhnik! Judah phun sung ihsin a rami Kiosa tiih kawhmi, David ih tefa misunglawi tiih kawhmi cu nehtu a si zo ih tacik pasarih cu a siatter dingih cazual cu a ong ding,” tiah i ti."},"6":{"text":"Cule Tuufa pakhat, bawi tokham laifangah a ding ih thilnung pali le upa pawl in an kulh kha ka hmu. Cuih Tuufa cu thah ciami a bang. Ki pasarih le mit pasarih a nei ih cuih mit pasarih cu leilung tlun khuazakip ah a thlahmi Pathian ih thlarau pasarih an si."},"7":{"text":"Tuufa cu a va feh ih bawi tokham parih a tomi-ih vorhlam kut ihsin cazual cu a lak."},"8":{"text":"Cutiih a lak ṭheh vete in Tuufa hmaiah cun thilnung pali le upa kul hluanli cu an bok. Ṭingṭang pakhat ciar le rimhmui in a khat mi sui kheng pakhat fingfing an keng ih cuih rimhmui cu Pathian minung pawl ih thlacamnak a si."},"9":{"text":"Hla thar an sak ih: “Nangmah cu cazual latu dingah le tacik phoihtu dingah na tlak a si. Ziangahtile thahnak na tuar zo ih, na thihnak thawngin phunkip hnamkip le ṭongtin hrintin ihsin Mi tampi Pathian hrangah na lei zo a si."},"10":{"text":"Kan Pathian riantu dingah puithiam phun le siangpahrang uknak ah annih cu na tuah zo ih annih in lei tlun an uk ding,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Ka zoh sal tikah a thawng sawm a thawng za, a siar ih siar cawk lo vancungmi pawl ih aw thawng ka thei. Bawi tokham le thilnung pali le upa pawl ih kimvelah an ding ih,"},"12":{"text":"ring zetin hla an sak ih: “Thah a tuartu Tuufa cu huham le lennak, fimnak le cahnak, Hminthannak le sunlawinak le thangṭhatnak co tlak a si,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Cule vancungah siseh, leitlun le leihnuai khalah siseh, ti sungih a ummi khal in siseh, lei le van ih nunnak thaw a neimi hmuahhmuah in: “Bawi tokham ih a totu le Tuufa hnenah thangṭhatnak le upatnak, Sunlawinak le cahnak cu a kumkhua in um ko seh,” tiah hla an sak."},"14":{"text":"Cule thilnung pali in, “Amen,” an ti tikah Upa pawl cun an bok ih an biak."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule Tuufa in tacik pasarih lakah pakhat a phoih kha ka hmu ih thilnung pali lakih pakhat in, a aw khuari thawm bangin, “Ra,” tiah a ti ka thei.","title":"Tacik Paruk A Phoih"},"2":{"text":"Ka zoh ih rang raang pakhat ka hmu. A parih a totu cun li pakhat a keng ih bawi lukhuh khal an pek. Mi nehtu in neh dingih a feh bangin a feh."},"3":{"text":"Cule Tuufa in tacik pahnihnak a phoih ih thilnung pahnihnak in, “Ra,” a ti kha ka thei."},"4":{"text":"Rang dang pakhat a ra suak ih rang sen a si. A parih a totu hnenah leilung tlunah pakhat le pakhat thah awknak ral thok dingin thu an pek. Ralnam tumpi khal an pek."},"5":{"text":"Cule Tuufa in tacik pathumnak a phoih ih thilnung pathumnak in, “Ra,” a ti kha ka thei. Ka zoh ih rang dum pakhat ka hmu. A parih a totu in cuai thlainak zaazu pakhat a kut in a keng."},"6":{"text":"Thilnung pali lak ihsin aw bangtuk thawng ka thei ih, “Nikhat hlawhman ah sangvut pawng khat, ni khat hlawh manah barli pawng thum. Asinain olif thingkung le sabit hmuan cu siatsuah hlah,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cule Tuufa in tacik palinak a phoih ih thilnung palinak in, “Ra,” a ti kha ka thei."},"8":{"text":"Ka zoh ih rang a tisa a raammi pakhat ka hmu. A parih a totu cu a hminah Thihnak a si ih Hell in a dunglam naihte ihsin a thlun. Anmah tla cu leilung mi ih ṭhenli ṭhenkhat kha raldonak, paamnak, natnak le sahrang ih tuahmawhnak in thah dingah thu pekmi an si."},"9":{"text":"Cule Tuufa in tacik panganak a phoih. Pathian thu an sim ruangah le rintlak zetin an phuan ngam ruangih thah a tongtu pawl ih thlarau cu biakṭheng hnuai ah ka hmu."},"10":{"text":"Ring zetin an au ih, “A thianghlimmi le a dikmi Cungnungbik Bawipa, leilung tlun minung kan thisen a luantertu pawl hi ziangtik tiangso phuba la lo le hrem loin na zuah ding?” an ti."},"11":{"text":"Annih pawl cu puan rang pakhat ciar pek an si ih, “Nanmah bangin thah a tuar dingmi nan unau le nan siahhlawhpi pawl an kim hlan lo caan malte sung cawl hrih uh,” tiah an sim."},"12":{"text":"Cule Tuufa in tacik paruknak a phoih khi ka hmu. Nasa zetin ling a hnin ih ni cu puansia dum vekin a dum ih thlapi cu thisen bangin a sen ṭheh."},"13":{"text":"Cule arsi tla cu thlipi in theikuh a sem thlak vekin leilung ah an tla."},"14":{"text":"Van cu cazual vekin a zual aw hlo ih tlang le tikulh hmuahhmuah cu an umnak hmun ihsin an ṭhawn ṭheh."},"15":{"text":"Cule leilung tlun siangpahrang pawl le ram uktu pawl le ralbawi pawl, milian le thuneitu pawl le midang hmuahhmuah, sal le miluat thawn, lungkua sung le tlangpar lungpuk hnuai ah an relh."},"16":{"text":"Tlang le lungpi pawl hnenah, “In nen uhla bawi tokham ih a totu mithmai le Tuufa thinhengnak ihsin in thup hram uh."},"17":{"text":"An thinhengnak a thlen ni, tuksumza ni a thleng zo ih zoso a tuar thei ding?” tiah an au."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah leilung kil li ah a dingmi vancungmi pali ka hmu. Cuih vancungmi pali in leilung parah le tifinriat ah le thingkung ah thlipi hrang lo dingin an kham.","title":"Israel Mi Thawng Za Le Thawng Sawmli Le Thawng Li"},"2":{"text":"Nisuah lam ihsin a nungmi Pathian ih hminsinnak tacik a kengtu dang vancungmi pakhat a hung suah khi ka hmu. Pathian in leilung le tifinriat siatsuah theinak thu a pekmi vancungmi pali kha aw ring zetin a hei ko."},"3":{"text":"Vancungmi cun, “Kan Pathian ih siahhlawh pawl an cal ih hminsinnak tacik khen an si ṭheh hlan ahcun leilung le tifinriat le thingkung pawl siatsuah hrih hlah uh,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule Pathian hminsinnak tacik in an cal ih khen ciami pawl cu thawng za le thawng sawmli le thawng li an si, tiah in sim. Cumi cu Israel miphun hleihnih sungin an si."},"5":{"text":"Judah hrin in thawng hleihnih, Reuben hrin in thawng hleihnih, Gad hrin in thawng hleihnih,"},"6":{"text":"Asher hrin in thawng hleihnih, Naftali hrin in thawng hleihnih, Manasseh hrin in thawng hleihnih,"},"7":{"text":"Simeon hrin in thawng hleihnih, Levi hrin in thawng hleihnih, Issakhar hrin in thawng hleihnih,"},"8":{"text":"Zebulun hrin in thawng hleihnih, Josef hrin in thawng hleihnih, Benjamin hrin in thawng hleihnih an si."},"9":{"text":"Cuih hnuah ka hun zoh ih mipi tamzet ka hmu; zohmanih siarcawk lo miruunpi an si. Annih cu phun kip, hnam kip, le hrin kip ṭong kip ihsin a rami an si ih bawi tokham le Tuufa hmaiah an ding; puan rang an hruk ih an kut in ṭhulhfau hnah an keng fingfing.","title":"Siarcawklo Miruunpi"},"10":{"text":"“Rundamnak cu bawi tokham parih a totu kan Pathian le Tuufa hnen ihsin a ra,” tiah ring zetin an au."},"11":{"text":"Vancungmi hmuahhmuah cu bawi tokham le upa pawl le thilnung pali kimvelah an ding. Bawi tokham hmaiah an bok ih Pathian an biak;"},"12":{"text":"“Amen! Thangṭhatnak, sunlawinak, fimnak, lungawinak, upatnak, huham le cahnak cu kumkhua in kan Pathian ta si ko seh, Amen!” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Upa kul hluanli lakih pakhat in, “Hi puan rang a sintu pawl hi zoso an si? Khuitawk in so an ra?” tiah i sut."},"14":{"text":"“Bawipa, ka thei lo. Nang na thei sawn ding,” tiah ka ti. Cule anih in, “Himi pawl cu hremnak nasazet sung ihsin himdam in a ra suakmi an si. An puan cu Tuufa thisen sungah an sawp ih an vaar ter zo."},"15":{"text":"Curuangah Pathian ih bawi tokham hmaiah an ding ih biakinn sungah a hnaṭuan cu a sun a zan in an ṭuan. Bawi tokham parih a totu in a umpi ding ih cuih a umpinak cu an himnak a si ding."},"16":{"text":"An ril a rawng nawn lo ding ih an ti khal a haal nawn lo ding; ni in a ling hai lo ding ih vansaanglam thawsat khal an tuar lo ding."},"17":{"text":"Ziangahtile bawi tokham laifangih a ummi Tuufa cu anmah khaaltu a si ding ih nunnak petu cerhti umnak ah a hruai hai ding. Cule an mitthli hmuahhmuah cu Pathian in a hnul sak ṭheh ding a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuufa in tacik pasarihnak a phoih tikah vancungah nazi hrek sung hrawng thawthaang zianghman um loin a dai ṭhepṭhep.","title":"Hminsinnak Tacik Pasarihnak"},"2":{"text":"Cule Pathian hmaiih a dingtu vancungmi pasarih kha ka hmu ih an hnenah tawtawrawt pasarih an pek."},"3":{"text":"A dang vancungmi pakhat, rimhmui urnak kheng a kengtu, a ra ih biakṭheng kiangah a ding. Pathian minung pawl ih thlacamnak thawn pek cih dingah le bawi tokham hmaiih a dingmi sui biakṭheng parih pe dingah cuih vancungmi hnenah cun rimhmui tampi an pek."},"4":{"text":"Pathian hmaiih a dingtu vancungmi ih kut ihsin rimhmui urnak meikhu cu Pathian minung pawl ih thlacamnak thawn an kai tlaang."},"5":{"text":"Cule vancungmi in rimhmui urnak kheng cu a lak ih biakṭheng ih meisa vaam thawn a khahter hnuah leilungah a hlon. Cuvete in khua a ri, ṭeek a tla, nimthla a kau ih ling a hnin."},"6":{"text":"Cule vancungmi pasarih cu an tawtawrawt pasarih tum dingah an tiar aw cia.","title":"Tawtawrawt Pali An Tum"},"7":{"text":"Vancungmi pakhatnak in a tawtawrawt cu a tum ih thisen thawn a rawi awmi rial le meisa cu leilung ah ruah bangin a sur ciamco. Leilung ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat a kang ṭheh, thingkung ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat a kang ṭheh ih hrampi hring cu a zatein an kang ṭheh."},"8":{"text":"Vancungmi pahnihnak in a tawtawrawt a tum ih a alh hluahhlomi meitlang tumpi vek thil pakhat khi tifinriat sungah an vun hlon. Cutikah tifinriat ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat cu thisen ah a cang ṭheh."},"9":{"text":"Tifinriat sung thilnung ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat an thi ih tangphawlawng ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat an siat ṭheh."},"10":{"text":"Vancungmi pathumnak in a tawtawrawt a tum. Meifar bangin a alh hluahhlomi arsi tumpi pakhat cu van ihsin tiva le cerhti pawl ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat parah a tla."},"11":{"text":"Cuih arsi hmin cu, “A Kha,” ti a si. Tidai ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat cu tikha ah a cang ih cutiih a khaat ruangah cuih ti a intu mi tampi an thi."},"12":{"text":"Cule vancungmi palinak in a tawtawrawt a tum ih ni ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat, thlapi ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat le arsi pawl ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat cu an siat ṭheh. Curuangah an tleunak ṭhenthum ih ṭhenkhat cu a hlo. Sun ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat ah siseh, zan ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat ah siseh, tleunak a um lo."},"13":{"text":"Cule ka hun zoh ih vansangpi-ah khin mupi pakhat a zam ih, “Ṭihnungza! Ṭihnungza! Vancungmi pathum in an tawtawrawt an tum tikah cun leilung parih a ummi hmuahhmuah hrangah ṭihnungza a va si so!” tiah ring zetin a ti ka thei."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule vancungmi panganak in a tawtawrawt a tum ih van ihsin leilungah arsi pakhat a tlak ka hmu. Cule cuih arsi cu tawpneilo khurih tawhfung a hnenah an pek."},"2":{"text":"Cuih arsi in tawpneilo khur cu a on tikah sosernak somei tumpi ihsin meikhu a suah vekin meikhu a hung suak luailo. Cuih meikhu in ni tleunak le thli lak khal a thimter ṭheh."},"3":{"text":"Kharbok tampi cu cuih meikhu lak ihsin leilung parah an rung tla ih varngen meipir neihmi huham vek kha an hnenah pek an si."},"4":{"text":"Cuih kharbok pawl cu hrampi, thingkung le a dang hramkung khal siseh, siatsuah lo dingin an sim. An siatsuah theimi cu an cal ah Pathian hminsinnak tacik a nei lomi lawng an si."},"5":{"text":"Hi minung pawl thah theinak thu an nei lo; thla nga sung hrem theinak thu lawng an nei. Mi an hrem tikih a nat zia cu varngen meipir in mi a hen ih a nat bangtuk khi a si."},"6":{"text":"Cuih thla nga sungah cun minung in thihnak an hawl rero ding naón an tong lo ding; thih an duh ding naón thihnak in a tlansan ding."},"7":{"text":"Cuih kharbok pawl cu raldo dingih a ralringmi rang bangtuk an si. An lu parah sui lukhuh a bangmi an khum; an hmai cu minung hmai an bang."},"8":{"text":"An lu-ih sam cu nunau sam bangtuk a si; an ha tla cu kiosa ha bangtuk a si."},"9":{"text":"An ṭaang cu raldonak ih tuahmi thir ṭaangphaw bangtuk a si mi in an khuh ṭheh ih an thla an khawn thawm cu raldonak hmunih a tlan ciamcomi rangleng tampi awn thawm a bang."},"10":{"text":"Mei an nei ih varngen meipir bangin mi an hen thei; thla nga sung mi an hrem theinak khal cu an mei ih huham neihmi ruangah a si."},"11":{"text":"Anmah uktu siangpahrang an nei ih cuih an siangpahrang cu tawpneilo khur uktu vancungmi a si. A hmin cu Hebru ṭong in Abaddon a si; Grik ṭong cun Apollion a si."},"12":{"text":"Ṭihnungza pakhatnak cu a cem; hi hnuah ṭihnungza pahnih an ra hrih ding."},"13":{"text":"Cule vancungmi paruknak in a tawtawrawt a tum. Pathian hmaiih a ummi sui biakṭheng ih kil li ihsin aw thawng ka thei.","title":"Tawtawrawt Paruknak"},"14":{"text":"Cuih aw in vancungmi paruknak hnenah, “Eufrates Tivapi kapih ṭemcih in a ummi vancungmi pali cu thlah thlang hai aw,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Vancungmi pali cu thlah an si ih annih cu hi nazi, hi ni, hi thla le hi kum cekci-ah minung hmuahhmuah ih ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat that ṭhehtu dingih timtuahmi an rak si."},"16":{"text":"Rang ralkap pawl cu an zatein million zahnih an si."},"17":{"text":"Cule hmuhmi ka neihnak ahcun rang le rang totu pawl ka hmu. An raldonak ṭaangphaw cu meiling bangin a sen, safaira timi lungmankhung bangin mepian a si ih kaat bangin a aihre. An rang pawl lu cu kiosa lu bangtuk an si ih an kaa sung ihsin meisa, meikhu le kaat mei-alh bangtuk an suak zukzo."},"18":{"text":"Cuih rang ka sung ihsin a suak zukzo mi minung siatsuahtu phunthum: meisa, meikhu le kaat mei-alh in minung ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat an that ṭheh a si."},"19":{"text":"Rang pawl huham neihnak cu an kaa le an mei ah a si. An mei cu rul vek a si ih lu an nei; cuih an lu cu minung tuahmawhnak ah an hmang."},"20":{"text":"Hi minung siatsuahtu phunthum ih an thah ngah lomi minung pawl cun anmah ih tuahcopmi thil kha an tlansan cuang lo. Khawsia an biaknak, sui le ngun le daar le lungto le thing ih tuahmi, a hmu thei lo, a ṭong thei lo, a feh thei lo, an kutih tuahcopmi milem pawl an biaknak an baang cuang lo."},"21":{"text":"Culawng si loin mi an thahnak, dawi an hmannak, nupa sual an tuahnak le ruk an ruknak pawl cun an sir cuang fawn lo."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule a cak zetmi vancungmi pakhat vancung ihsin a rung ṭum ka hmu. Amah cu mero in a thuam aw ih a lu kimvelah vangro a lang. A hmai cu ni bangtuk a si ih a ke cu meisa ṭhuam bangtuk a si.","title":"Vancungmi Le Cazual Fate"},"2":{"text":"A kut in pharh ciami cazual a keng. A vorhlam ke in tifinriat a pal ih a kehlam ke in leilung a pal;"},"3":{"text":"cule a au ih a aw rindan cu kiosa tampi aw bangtuk a si. Cutiih a au ṭheh vete in khuari pasarih in tlir durdo in an hun let."},"4":{"text":"Cutiin an ṭong ṭheh vete in ca in ngan ka tum. Asinain van ihsin aw ka thei ih, “Khawri pasarih ih simmi kha thuthup ah re aw; ngan hrih hlah,” tiah i run ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule ka hmuh ciami vancungmi, tifinriat le leilungih a dingtu in van lamah a vorhlam kut a khai ih,"},"6":{"text":"kumkhua-in kumkhua tiang a nungmi Pathian, van le leilung, tipi thuanthum le a sungih ummi hmuahhmuah a tuahtu Pathian ih hmin in siatcam in thukamnak a tuah. Cutikah vancungmi in, “A rei nawn lo ding."},"7":{"text":"Vancungmi pasarihnak in a tawtawrawt a tum tikah a siahhlawh a si mi profet pawl hnenih a rak than ciami a thupte ih a tumtahmi cu Pathian in a kimter ding,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule vancung ihsin aw ka theihmi in, “Va feh awla tifinriat le leilungih a dingtu kut sungih a ummi pharh ciami cazual khi va la aw,” tiah i run ti sal."},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi hnenah cun ka va feh ih cazual fate cu ka va dil. Anih in, “La awla ei aw; na pum sungah a kha ding naón na kaa sungah cun khuaitizu bangin a thlum ding,” tiah i ti."},"10":{"text":"I ti vekin cazual cu ka lak ih ka ei tikah ka kaa sungah khuaitizu vekin a thlum; asinain ka dolh tikah ka pum sungah cun a kha ngaingai."},"11":{"text":"Cule in sim sal ih, “Pathian in miphun tampi, hrin tampi, ṭong tampi le siangpahrang tampiih thu thawn peh aw in a simmi kha na phuan sal a ṭul ding,” tiah i ti."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tahfung a bangmi funghreu pakhat i pek ih, “Va feh awla Pathian biakinn le biakṭheng va tah aw; cule biakinn sungih Pathian a biatu pawl siar aw.","title":"Theihpitu Pahnih"},"2":{"text":"Asinain biakinn tual cu va tah hlah, ziangahtile Pathian thei lomi pawl hnenah pek a si zo ih cu pawl cun thla sawmli le thla hnih sung Khawpi Thiang cu an cilbal thluh ding."},"3":{"text":"I theihpitu pahnih, buri hnipuan thawn thuam aw in, ka thlah ding; annih in Pathian thu cu profet bangin ni thawngkhat ni zahnih le sawmruk sung an sim ding,” tiah i ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuih theihpitu pahnih cu leilung Bawipa ih hmaiah a dingmi Olif thingkung pahnih le mei-inn pahnih an si."},"5":{"text":"Anmah a siatsuah tumtu an ral pohpoh cu an kaa sung ihsin a suakmi meisa in an siatsuah ding; cuti cun annih tuahmawh a tumtu cu thah an si ding."},"6":{"text":"Van pihter theinak thu an nei ih Pathian thu an phuan sung cu van ihsin ruah a sur lo ding. Tidai tlun khalah thu an nei ih cerhti pawl kha thisen ah an canter thei. Leilung hi an duh tik caan pohah natnak a phunphun in hrem theinak thu an nei."},"7":{"text":"An thusim an ṭheh tikah tawpneilo khur sung ihsin a suakmi sahrang in a do ding. A neh dingih a that ding."},"8":{"text":"Cule an ruak cu an Bawipa thinglamtah parih an thahnak khawpi lamzin ah an taanta ding. Cuih khawpiih hmin deu cu Sodom a si lole Izipt a si."},"9":{"text":"Miphun kip, hrin kip, ram kip le ṭong kipih mi hmuahhmuah in an ruak cu ni thum le a hrek sung an zoh ding ih a phum ding khal an kham ding."},"10":{"text":"Hi profet pahnih an thih ruangah leilung tlun minung cu an lung a awi ding. An lungawinak puai an tuah ding ih pakhat le pakhat laksawng an ṭhen aw ding, ziangahtile hi profet pahnih ruangah leilung mi harsatnak tamzet an rak tuar."},"11":{"text":"Asinain ni thum le a hrek hnuah Pathian hnen ihsin nunnak petu thaw a ra ih an sungah a lut ih annih cu an hung ding; cumi a hmutu hmuahhmuah cu an tuk a sum ṭheh."},"12":{"text":"Cule cuih profet pahnih cun van ihsin, “Hinah hung uh,” tiah a run titu aw ringzet an thei. An ral pawl ih mithmuh rori-ah annih cu mero thawn vancungah an kai."},"13":{"text":"Cuih caan cekci-ah nasazet in ling a hnin ih khawpi ṭhenhra ih ṭhenkhat a siat ṭheh; minung thawng sarih an thi. Midang pawl cu ṭih le phangin an um ih vancung Pathian ih maksak zia an hmu ih an thangṭhat."},"14":{"text":"Ṭihnungza pahnihnak cu a cem, asinain pathumnak rei lote-ah a ra ding."},"15":{"text":"Cule a pasarihnak vancungmi in a tawtawrawt a tum ih vancungah a ring zetmi aw in, “Leilung tlun uk theinak huham cu kan Bawipa le a Messiah kut sungah a um zo ih kumkhua-in kumkhua tiang amah in a uk ding,” tiah an ti.","title":"Tawtawrawt Pasarihnak"},"16":{"text":"Cutikah Pathian hmaiah an bawi tokham ih a totu upa kul hluanli pawl cu an bok ih Pathian an biak,"},"17":{"text":"Annih in, “Ziangkimtithei Bawipa Pathian, atu-ah a ummi le hlan ihsin a rak um zomi! A nasami na huham na langter ih uknak hram na thok zo ruangah kan lo thangṭhat."},"18":{"text":"Na thinheng a langnak tikcu a thleng ih mithi pawl thuṭhen caan a kim ruangah, Pathian awi lo pawl an thin a ling in a ling. Na siahhlawh profet pawl le a lo upattu na minung pawl a tum a seen in ṭuanman an ngah caan a thleng a si. Leilung a siatsuahtu siatsuahnak an ton caan a thleng zo,” tiah an ti."},"19":{"text":"Vancung ih a ummi Pathian biakinn an ong ih cutawkah Thukam Kuang a um. Cule nimthla a kau zukzo, khua a ri durdo, ling a hnin ih rial napi in a tla."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule vanah khawruahharza thil pakhat a lang. Nunau pakhat a lang ih a thuam cu ni a si; thlapi a ke thuaiah a ret ih arsi hleihnih ih tuahmi siangpahrang lukhuh a khum.","title":"Nunau Le Rulhreng"},"2":{"text":"Fa a vun ih nau hrin caan a kim. Nauhrin natih a nat ruangah a ai rero."},"3":{"text":"Cule vanah a dang khawruahhar hmuhsaknak mak pakhat a lang. Rulhreng sen tumzet, lu pasarih le ki pahra a neimi a lang. A lu pawl cun siangpahrang lukhuh pakhat fingfing an khum."},"4":{"text":"A mei in vanih arsi ṭhenthum ṭhenkhat leilungah a vuak thlak. Nau nei ding nunau hmaiah a ding ih nau a suah vete in deh dingin a bawh."},"5":{"text":"Cule cuih nunau nu in miphun hmuahhmuah thirfung thawn a uktu dingah fapa a hring. Asinain naute cu an lak ih Pathian le a bawi tokham hnenah an tlanpi."},"6":{"text":"Nunau cu Pathian in hmun a remsak ciami hramlakah a tlan. Cutawkah ni thawngkhat zahnih le sawmruk sung an cawm ding."},"7":{"text":"Cule vanah raldo awknak a um. Mikhael le a vancungmi pawl in rulhreng cu an do; rulhreng le a vancungmi khal in an do ve."},"8":{"text":"Asinain rulhreng cu a sun ruangah a vancungmi pawl thawn vancungah an um thei nawn lo."},"9":{"text":"Rulhreng tumpi, khuahlan rulpi, Khawsia a si lole Satan tiih kawh mi, leilung pumpuluk mibumtu cu van ihsin an hlon. A vancungmi pawl thawn leilungah an vun thlak."},"10":{"text":"Cule vancungah aw ringzet ka thei ih, “Pathian ih rundamnak a thleng zo! Pathian in siangpahrang a sinak a huham a langter zo! Messiah ih huham a langter zo! Ziangahtile Pathian hmaiah dingin, a sunzan in kan unau sual a puhtu cu vancung ihsin hlon a si zo."},"11":{"text":"Kan unau pawl in Tuufa thisen le thutak an phuanmi thawngin nehnak an ngah zo. An nunnak an pe siang ih thih khal an ngam a si."},"12":{"text":"Curuangah vancung le vanih a ummi hmuahhmuah nan lungawi uh! Asinain leilung le tifinriat hrangah cun an hmakhua a va pit so! Ziangahtile Satan nan hnen a rung thleng zo ih, Caan reipi a nei nawn lo ti a theih ruangah a thin a heng ngaingai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Rulhreng in leilungah in thlak ti a theih vete in fapa a hringtu nunau cu dawi a thok."},"14":{"text":"Asinain nunau nu cu a hrangah rem ciami hramlakih zuannak dingah a tum zetmi mupiih thla pahnih an pek. Cutawkah rulhrengih siatsuah thei lo dingin kum thum le a hrek sung an kilkhawi ding."},"15":{"text":"Cule nunau nu cu tilian in fenseh tiah rulhreng in a kaa sung ihsin tidai a suahter ciamco."},"16":{"text":"Asinain nunau nu bawm dingah leilung cu a kaa a ang ih rulhreng kaa sungin a suakmi tidai cu a rak dolh ṭheh."},"17":{"text":"Rulhreng cu nunau nu parah a thin a heng tuk ih nunau tefa pawl Pathian thukham a thluntu le Jesuh ih phuanmi thutak a rinsantu hmuahhmuah do dingah a pok lala."},"18":{"text":"Cutiin tifinriat kapah rulhreng cu a ding."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule tifinriat sung ihsin sahrang a hung suak ka hmu. Ki pahra le lu pasarih a nei; a ki parah cun siangpahrang lukhuh pakhat fingfing an khum ih a lu parah Pathian hmuhsuamnak hmin pakhat fingfing an um.","title":"Sahrang Pahnih"},"2":{"text":"Cuih sahrang cu tlavang a bang; a ke cu savom ke bangtuk a si ih a kaa cu kiosa kaa bangtuk a si. Rulhreng in a neihmi a huham, a siangpahrang tokham le a thuneihnak maksak cu a pek."},"3":{"text":"Sahrang ih lu pakhat cu thihpi tlak besia zetih hriammi a bang, asinain a cuih a hriamhma cu a dam. Leilung pumpuluk an mang a bang ih sahrang cu an thlun."},"4":{"text":"Rulhreng in a thuneihnak sahrang hnenih a pek ruangah mi hmuahhmuah in rulhreng cu an biak. Cule sahrang khal an biak thotho ih, “Sahrang a bangtu zoso a um? Zo in so a do thei ding?” an ti."},"5":{"text":"Sahrang cu Pathian hmuhsuamnak le hminsiatnak thu kha puarthau zetin rel thei dingah an on ih thla sawmli le thla hnih sung thuneih theinak khal on a si."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian le a hmin, a umnak hmun le vancungih a ummi hmuahhmuah kha sahrang cun a camriam ciamco."},"7":{"text":"Cuih tlunah Pathian ih minung pawl do dingah le neh dingah caan an on ih hrin kip, ram kip, ṭong kip, le phun kip tlunah thuneihnak an pek."},"8":{"text":"Cuticun leilungtlun mi hmuahhmuah in sahrang cu an bia ding; asinain leilung seem hlan ihsin nunnak cabu sungih hmin khum ciami pawl cun an bia lo ding; cuih nunnak cabu cu thah a si mi Tuufa-ih ta a si."},"9":{"text":"“Theihnak hna nan neih asile ngai uh!"},"10":{"text":"Sal ih kaih ding ti ciami cu kaih an si ding ih ralnam ih thah ding ti ciami cu thah an si ko ding. Hi bangtuk caanah Pathian minung pawl in thinsau zetih tuar theinak le rintlak sinak an langter a ṭul ngaingai."},"11":{"text":"Cule sahrang dang pakhat leilung sung ihsin a hung suah ka hmu. Cuih sahrang in tuufa ki bangtuk ki pahnih a nei ih rulhreng bangin a ṭong."},"12":{"text":"Sahrang pakhatnak ih a neihmi a nasa zetmi thuneihnak kha a mithmuh rori-ah a hmang. Thihpi tlak hriamhma a pu naón a hma a dam zomi a pakhatnak sahrang cu leilung le leilung tlunih a ummi hmuahhmuah in an bia dingah a hneek ciamco hai."},"13":{"text":"Hi sahrang pahnihnak in a mak ngaingaimi khawruahharza an tuah. Mi hmuahhmuah ih mithmuh ah van ihsin leilungah meisa a tlakter."},"14":{"text":"Cule pakhatnak sahrang mithmuh rori ih khawruahharza tuah theinak thu an pek ruangah leilung tlunih a ummi minung hmuahhmuah a bum thei a si. Ralnam hriamhma a pu naón a nung thothomi sahrang upatnak ah amah ih zuklem tuah dingah thu a pek."},"15":{"text":"Sahrang pakhatnak lem sungah nunnak thaw thawlut dingah sahrang pahnihnak cu thu an pek ih cuticun a lem cu a ṭong thei ih tlunah amah a bia lotu pawl kha a that ṭheh."},"16":{"text":"Cuih sahrang in mi hmuahhmuah, mitum siseh mite siseh, milian siseh mifarah siseh, sal siseh, miluat siseh, an vorhlam kutah a si lole an cal ah hranhram in hminsinnak a tuah."},"17":{"text":"Cuih hminsinnak an neih lo ahcun zianghman an zuar thei lo ih an lei thei fawn lo; cuih hminsinnak cu sahrang hmin a si lole sahrang hmin ai-ih hmanmi nambat a si."},"18":{"text":"Hi zawn ah hin fimnak hman a ṭulzet. Fimnak a neitu in sahrang nambat ih tican cu an tuat thei, ziangahtile cuih nambat cu mi pakhat hmin ai-ih hmanmi a si ih, a nambat cu zaruk sawmruk le paruk a si."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule ka hun zoh ih Zion Tlangah Tuufa a din ka hmu; amah thawn hmun khatah mi thawngza le thawng sawmli le thawngli an um ih cu pawl cu amah ih hmin le a Pa ih hmin an cal ih nganmi an si.","title":"Tuufa Le A Minung Pawl"},"2":{"text":"Cule vancung ihsin aw pakhat ka thei ih cuih aw cu tilian tlasuar awn le khawri ringzet awn vek a si. Ṭingṭang tum thiammi pawl ih an ṭingṭang tum aw bangtuk khal a si."},"3":{"text":"Minung thawngza le thawng sawmli le thawngli pawl cu siangpahrang tokham le thilnung pali le upa pawl hmaiah an ding. Hla thar an sak ih cuih hla cu anmah lawngih zir theimi a si. Mi hmuahhmuah sung ihsin anmah lawng tlen ciami an si."},"4":{"text":"Anmah cu mi thianghlim an si, nunau thawn a pawl aw dah lomi an si ih a himmi an si. Tuufa fehnak kipah an thlun. Mi hmuahhmuah lak ihsin tlenmi an si ih, thlairah hmaisa bik bangtuk in, Pathian le Tuufa hnenah hlan hmaisa bikmi an si."},"5":{"text":"Thuphan an per dah lo; mawhnak zianghman an nei lo."},"6":{"text":"Cule vanah a zam reromi vancungmi pakhat ka hmu. Amah cu leilung tlun miphun kip, hrin kip, ṭong kip le ram kip hnenah kumkhua ih a hmunmi Thuthang ṭha thantu a si.","title":"Vancungmi Pathum"},"7":{"text":"Aw ring zetin, “Pathian upat uhla a maksaknak thangṭhat uh! Ziangahtile miphun kip an thu rel caan a thleng zo. Van le leilung, tifinriat le cerhtiput hmuahhmuah a tuahtu kha bia uh!” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Vancungmi pahnihnak in pakhatnak cu a thlun ih, “A nasa zetmi Babilon cu a siat zo, a siat ngah zo a si. A tisa hiarnak sabitzu kha mi hmuahhmuah a pek ih, a ritter ṭheh a si,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi pathumnak in a hmaiih a zammi vancungmi pahnih kha a thlun ih aw ring zetin, “Zokhal sahrang le milem a bia ih a hminsinnak a cal ah a si lo le a baan ah a neitu cu,"},"10":{"text":"Pathian thinhengnak khuathai sungih thletmi a thinhengnak sabitzu hran cu a in ding. Cuih zu a intu cu vancung mithiang pawl le Tuufa hmaiah meisa le kaat mei-alh sungih hremnak an tuar ding."},"11":{"text":"Anmah hremnak meisa khu cu cat loin tlunah a kai ringring. Sahrang le a lem a biatu le a hmin hminsinnak a neitu hrangah cun sunah siseh zanah siseh hnangamte ih colhdamnak caan an nei nawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Hi bangtuk caanah Pathian minung pawl, Pathian thukham a thluntu le Jesuh hrangah rintlak zetih a nungtu pawl in thinsau in tuar theinak an neihmi an langter a ṭul ngaingai."},"13":{"text":"Cule vancung ihsin aw pakhat ka thei ih, “Himi hi ngan aw. Bawipa zum cingte ih a thitu pawl cu mi lungawi an si,” tiah a ti. Cutikah Thlarau in, “A si ngaingai!
