Annih cu an hnaṭuan khunghar ihsin an cawl thlang ding a si; ziangahtile an ṭuanmi in a thlun hai ding,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cule ka hun zoh ih a raangmi mero ka hmu; cuih mero parah cun a lu ah sui-ih tuahmi siangpahrang lukhuh a khum ih a kutah a hriam zetmi favah a kengtu Milai Fapa bangtuk ka hmu.","title":"Leilung Tlun Rawlkhawm Caan"},"15":{"text":"Biakinn sung ihsin vancungmi pakhat a ra suak ih mero parih a totu hnenah cun aw ring zetin, “Na favah cu fang ah-nak ah hmang aw, ziangahtile a caan a kim zo; leilung tlun rawlkhawm a cu zo,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule mero parih a totu in leilung tlunah a favah cu a vun hawi ih leilung tlun fang cu a khawm."},"17":{"text":"Cule a dang vancungmi pakhat vancung biakinn ihsin a ra suak ka hmu; anih khal a hriam zetmi favah a nei ve."},"18":{"text":"Cule a dang vancungmi pakhat, meisa tlun thuneitu, biakṭheng ihsin a ra suak. Favah hriam zet a neitu vancungmi hnenah napi in a au ih, “Na favah hmang awla leilung tlun sabit hmuanih sabit pawl hlep thlang aw; ziangahtile sabit an hmin zo a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cutiin vancungmi in a favah cu leilungah a vun hawi ih sabit hri ihsin sabit rah a hlep ih Pathian thinhengnak sabit rialnak sungah a vun thlak."},"20":{"text":"Sabit rah cu khawpi lengih a ummi sabit rialnak ah an rial ih sabit rialnak sung ihsin thisen a luang; cuih thisen cu peng zahnih tiang a luang ih rang kakharh tiang a thuk."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule vanah a dang khawruahharza le a maksakmi hmuhnak ka nei lala. Vancungmi pasarih in natsia pasarih an keng; hi natsia cu a neta bik hremnak an si, ziangahtile Pathian thinhengnak a lang netnak a si.","title":"Vancungmi Le Natsia Neta Bik"},"2":{"text":"Cule ka zoh ih meisa thawn a rawi awmi thlalang, tifinriat bangtuk a si mi ka hmu. Cuih tlunah sahrang le a lem siseh, a nambat ai-awhtu siseh, a nehtu pawl khal siseh ka hmu. Cuih nehtu pawl cu thlalang tifinriat kapah an ding ih Pathian pekmi ṭingṭang an keng."},"3":{"text":"Pathian riantu a si mi Moses ih hla le Tuufa ih hla cu hiti in an sak: “Bawipa, Ziangkimtithei Pathian, Na thiltuahmi hi ziangtluk mangbangza so an si. Miphun hmuahhmuahih Siangpahrang, Na lamzin cu ziangtluk a dingmi le a dikmi so an si."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah a lo ṭihzah lotu zoso a um ding? Na maksak zia a phuang lotu zoso a um ding? Nangmah lawng na thianghlim a si. Miphun hmuahhmuah na hnenah an ra ding ih an lo bia ding. Ziangahtile a dikmi na thil tuahmi cu mi hmuahhmuah in an hmu zo.”"},"5":{"text":"Cuih hnuah vancungah a ong awmi biakinn ka hmu ih a sungah Puanthlam Thianghlim khal ka hmu."},"6":{"text":"Natsia pasarih a kengtu vancungmi pasarih cuih biakinn sung ihsin an ra suak; annih tla cu a tleu zetmi puanrang thawn an thuam aw ih sui ṭaangkhap thawn an ṭaang an khap aw."},"7":{"text":"Cule thilnung pali lakah pakhat in kumkhua in kumkhua tiang a nungmi Pathian ih thinhengnak in a khatmi sui kheng pasarih cu vancungmi pasarih hnenah a pek."},"8":{"text":"Biakinn cu Pathian huham le sunlawinak meikhu in a khat ih vancungmi pasarih in an kenmi natsia pasarih a reh hlanah cun zohman biakinn sungah an lut thei lo."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule biakinn ihsin aw ring ka thei ih vancungmi pasarih hnenah, “Feh uhla Pathian thinhengnak kheng pasarih kha leilungah vun thle uh!” tiah a ti.","title":"Pathian Thinhennak Kheng"},"2":{"text":"Pakhatnak vancungmi a feh ih a kheng cu leilungah a thlet. Sahrang hminsinnak a neitu le sahrang lem a biatu pawl taksa parah ṭihnungza le a na zetmi hma sia a suak."},"3":{"text":"Cule vancungmi pahnihnak in a kheng cu tifinriat parah a vun thlet. Tidai cu miruak ihsin a suakmi thisen bangtuk ah a cang ih tifinriat sungih a nungmi hmuahhmuah an thi ṭheh."},"4":{"text":"Cule vancungmi pathumnak in a kheng cu tiva le cerhtiput parah a thlet ih tidai cu thisen ah an cang ṭheh."},"5":{"text":"Tidai tlunih thuneitu vancungmi in, “Hi na thuṭhennak pawl hi a dikmi an si, Maw a Thianghlimmi, atuih a ummi le hlan khalah a rak um zomi Pathian!"},"6":{"text":"Mithiang pawl le profet pawl thisen an suahter ruangah an in dingah thisen na pekmi hi in tlak hrimhrim an si,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Biakṭheng ihsin aw pakhat ka thei ih, “Bawipa, Ziangkimtithei Pathian! Na thu relcatmi hi a dikmi le a dingmi an si!” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cule vancungmi palinak in a kheng cu ni parah a thle ih minung kang dingah thu a pek."},"9":{"text":"Ni in a kang hai ruangah minung pawl in hi hremnak tlunih thuneitu Pathian ih hmin kha an camriam ciamco. Asinain an sualnak ihsin an sir lo ih Pathian khal thangṭhatnak an pe cuang lo."},"10":{"text":"Cule vancungmi panganak in a kheng cu sahrang ih bawi tokham parah a thlet. Sahrang ih uknak khuazakip ah thimkhawzing a tlung ih minung pawl cu an tuarmi a nat tuk ruangah an lei an keu ciamco."},"11":{"text":"An nat le an hma ruangah vancung Pathian cu an cam an riam. Asinain an thilsual tuahmi cu an sir aw cuang lo."},"12":{"text":"Cule vancungmi paruknak in a kheng cu Eufrates tivapi parah a thlet. Tiva cu a kang ṭheh; cumicu nisuahlam ihsin a ra dingmi siangpahrang pawl hrang lamzin ongtu a si."},"13":{"text":"Cule butlak bangtuk a si mi thlarau borhhlawh pathum ka hmu. Rulhreng kaa sung le sahrang kaa sung le profet deu kaa sung ihsin a suakmi an si."},"14":{"text":"Cupawl cu hmuhsaknak mak a tuahtu khawsia thlarau an si. Cuih thlarau pathum cu an feh ih leilung tlun siangpahrang hmuahhmuah hmun khatah an hruai khawm. Cutiih an hruai khawmnak cu Ziangkimtithei Pathian ih Ni sunglawi ni ah raldo dingah a si."},"15":{"text":"“Zohhnik! Fifir bangin ka ra ding. Misenpi hmaiah taklawng le ningzakih an um lonak dingah itthat lotein a meng ih a hnipuan a fingkhawitu cu mi lungawi an si,” tiah Bawipa in a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cule thlarau pathum in siangpahrang pawl cu Hebru ṭong in Armageddon an timi hmunah an hruai khawm."},"17":{"text":"Cule vancungmi pasarihnak in a kheng cu thli lakah a thlet ih Siangpahrang tokham umnak biakinn sung ihsin aw pakhat a ra thang ih, “A cem zo,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cutikah nimthla a kau zukzo, khua a ri durdo, ṭeek a tla ciamco ih tuksumza ling a hnin. Minung um hramthok ihsin cubangtuk linghnin a um dah lo. Linghnin hmuahhmuah lakah a besia bikmi a si."},"19":{"text":"Khawpi tumzet cu ṭhenthum ah a kuai ih ram dangih khawpi hmuahhmuah khal a siatsuah ṭheh. Pathian in a nasami Babilon cu a hngilh loih a khuathaiih a thinhengnak sabitti a inter."},"20":{"text":"Tikulh hmuahhmuah an hlo ih tlang hmuahhmuah an cemral ṭheh."},"21":{"text":"Rial tum zetzet, pakhat ah pawng zakhat tiang a ritmi rial van ihsin minung parah an tla. Cutiin hremnak an tuar ruangah mi in Pathian an cam an riam, ziangahtile an tuarmi natsia cu tuksumza a si."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule kheng pasarih a kengtu vancungmi pasarih lakih pakhat ka hnenah a ra ih, “Ra awla tiva tampi kiangih toh-mi khawpi, hminthang hlawhhlangnu khi ziangvekin hremnak a tong ding, ti ka lo hmuh ding.","title":"Hlawhhlang Hminthang Nu"},"2":{"text":"Leilung tlun siangpahrang pawl amah thawn nupa sualnak an tuah ih leilungtlun mi pawl khal in amah ih tisa diriam sualnak sabitti an in ruangah an ri ṭheh a si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Thlarau in i zeel ih vancungmi in hramlakah i feh pi. Cutawkah sahrang sen parah nunau pakhat a to ka hmu; cuih sahrang taksa pumpuluk ah Pathian hmuhsuamnak hmin tampi an ngan ih cuih sahrang cu lu pasarih le ki pahra a nei."},"4":{"text":"Cuih nunau cu mepian sen le puansen dup in a thuam aw ih hlawnthil sui le tikep lung le lungmankhung dangdang in a taksa cu a khat ṭheh. A kut in sui khuathai pakhat a keng ih cuih khuathai cu a tisa diriam sualnak thil zoh mawi lo le fihnungza thil in a khat."},"5":{"text":"A cal ah hmin pakhat an ngan ih tican thup a nei. “A maksak zetmi Babilon, hlawhhlang hmuahhmuah le misual borhhlawh hmuahhmuah ih nu,” ti a si."},"6":{"text":"Cule cuih nunau cu Pathian mithiang pawl ih thisen le Jesuh an rinsan ruangih thah a tuartu pawl ih thisen a in ruangah a ri, ti ka hmu. Cuih nunau ka hmuh tikah ka mang a bang ngaingai."},"7":{"text":"Cutikah vancungmi pakhat in, “Ziangah so na mang a bang? Nunau ih tican thup le nunau nu a tonak sahrang lu pasarih le ki pahra a nei mi sahrang ih tican thup cu ka lo sim ding."},"8":{"text":"Hi na hmuhmi sahrang hi a rak nung dah naón atu cu a nung nawn lo; tawpneilo khur sung ihsin a hung suak ding ih siatralnak ah a feh lan ding. Leilung siam hlan ihsin nunnak cabu sungih hmin ngan lomi pawl in cuih sahrang an zoh tikah an mang a bang ngaingai ding. A rak nung dah naón atu cu a nung nawn lo; asinain a hung suak sal ding."},"9":{"text":"“Fimnak le theihnak neih a ṭul. Lu pasarih cu nunau a tonak tlang pasarih an si. Siangpahrang pasarih khal an si."},"10":{"text":"Cuih siangpahrang pasarih lakah panga cu an tlu zo; pakhat in a uk lai; a dang pakhat cu a ra hrih lo. A rat tikah tikcu tawite sung lawng a uk ding."},"11":{"text":"A rak nung dah naón atu-ah a nung nawn lomi sahrang cu siangpahrang pariatnak a si; siangpahrang pasarih lakih a telmi a si ih siatralnak ih a thleng dingmi a si."},"12":{"text":"“Ki pahra na hmuhmi cu ram a uk thok hrih lotu siangpahrang pahra an si; asinain annih cu sahrang thawn nazi pakhat sung uk dingah thuneihnak pek an si ding."},"13":{"text":"An pahra in an huham le an thuneihnak cu sahrang hnenih pe ding cu an tumtah ciarmi a si."},"14":{"text":"Annih cu Tuufa an do ding; sikhalsehla Tuufa le amah ih a kawhmi, a hrilmi le amah a rinsantu pawl in an neh ding, ziangahtile Tuufa cu bawi hmuahhmuah lakih Bawi bik, siangpahrang hmuahhmuah lakih Siangpahrang sin a si,” tiin i sim."},"15":{"text":"Cule vancungmi in, “Hlawhhlang nu ih tonak tidai na hmuhmi cu miphun kip, hrin kip, ram kip le ṭong kip an si."},"16":{"text":"Na hmuhmi ki pahra le sahrang in hlawhhlang nu cu an hua ding; a neihmi thil hmuahhmuah an long ding ih a taklawngin an taan ding; a sa an ei ding ih meisa in an ur ding."},"17":{"text":"Pathian tumtahmi an tuahsuaknak dingah Pathian in an thinlung sungah tuah duhnak thinlung a ret. Curuangah thinlung rualtein hna an ṭuan tlang ih Pathian thu a kim hlan sung an ram uknak huham cu sahrang hnenah an pek."},"18":{"text":"“Na hmuhmi nunau cu leilung tlun siangpahrang pawl a uktu khawpi tumpi a si,” tiah i ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi hnuah vancungmi pakhat vancung ihsin a rung ṭum ka hmu. Amah cu thuneihnak huham tumzet a nei ih a tleunak in leilung pumpuluk a vangter ṭheh.","title":"Babilon Siatnak"},"2":{"text":"Ring zetin a au ih, “Nunau nu a tlu zo! Babilon maksak cu a siat zo! Khawsia le thlarau borhhlawh in an luah ih a sungah fihnungza le mitkemza vate a phunphun in an khat."},"3":{"text":"Ziangahtile miphun hmuahhmuah in a taksa hiar sualnak zu an in ih an ri ṭheh. Siangpahrang pawl thawn tisa sualnak an tuah ih sumtuahtu pawl khal supnak nei lo a taksa hiar nomnak thawngin milian ah an cang,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cule aw dang pakhat vancung ihsin ka thei ih, “Ra suak uh, ka minung pawl, Kha nu hnen ihsin ra suak uh. A sualnak sungah tel hlah uh, Hrem a tuarnak sung khalah tel hlah uh."},"5":{"text":"Ziangahtile a sualnak cu van a tiang ih, A ṭhatlonak cu Pathian in a ciing ringring a si."},"6":{"text":"Nanmah a lo tuah vek cekci-in a parah tuah ve uh. A tuahmi let hnih in phulei sam uh. Nan in dingih a rawimi hnakih let hnih cak in a in dingah a khuathai sungah rawi sak uh."},"7":{"text":"Sunlawinak le nunnomnak amah le amah a rak pek awk zat in, natnak le riahsiatnak pe ve uh. Ziangahtile a thinlungte in, ‘Hinah ka to, siangpahrang bawinu ka si, nuhmei ka si lo, riahsiatnak ka tong dah lo ding,’ a ti."},"8":{"text":"Hi vek a si ruangah ni khat sungah rinlopi in pulhnat in a tlun ding. Natnak, riahsiatnak le paampi a tong ding. Meisa ih ur a tong ding. Ziangahtile a thuṭhentu Bawipa Pathian cu Ziangkimtithei a si,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"A tisa sualnak le a taksa hiar nomnak sungih a teltu leilung siangpahrang pawl in Babilon khawpi meisa ih a kangnak meikhu an hmuh tikah an ṭap an ai ding."},"10":{"text":"Cutiih a tuarnak an hmuh tikah tuar ve pang ding an ṭih ruangah hlavaang ah an ding ih, “Ziangtluk ṭihnungza so a si! Ziang tluk tuksumza so a si! Khua maksak le a cakmi Babilon khawlipi! Nazi pakhat sungah hremsiatnak na ton hi!” tiah an ti ding."},"11":{"text":"Leilung tlun sumtuah pawl khal cu nu hremsiatnak a ton cu an ninghanpi ih an ṭap, ziangahtile zohman in an thilri an lei nawn lo."},"12":{"text":"Zohman in an sui, an ngun, an lungmankhung, an tikep lungmankhung le patzai in tahmi puanrang, mepian sendup puan, pu puan, puan sen le a ngah har zetmi thing ihsin tuah mi a phunphun, vuiho le thing mankhung ihsin tuahmi a phunphun, daar, thir, lungrang le,"},"13":{"text":"thinghawng hmui, masala, rimhmui, mura rimhmui, frankinsens rimhmui le sabitti le hriak, vainim le sangvut, caw le tuu, rang le rangleng, sal le minung khal zohman in an lei nawn lo."},"14":{"text":"Sumtuah pawl in cu nuih hnenah, “Nei ningla tiih saduh na thahmi thil ṭha hmuahhmuah an hloral ṭheh zo; na lennak le na sunlawinak kha an cem thluh zo ih ziangtik hmanah na ngah sal nawn lo ding,” an ti."},"15":{"text":"Cutawk khawpi sungah sumtuah tahratih a lianmi pawl in a tuarnak sungih tel ve pang ding an ṭih ruangah hlatzet ah an ding ding. An riahsia in an ṭap ding ih,"},"16":{"text":"“ṭihnungza a si! Tuksumza a si! Babilon khawlipi cu! Patzai in tahmi puanrang, sendup puan le puan sen in a rak thuam aw ṭheu ih sui hlawnthil le lungmankhung le tikep lungmankhung in a cei-aw ṭheu a si."},"17":{"text":"Asinain nazi pakhat sungah a hlawnthil hmuahhmuah cu a cemral ṭheh a si,” an ti ding. Tangphawlawng mawngtu bawi pawl le lawng a totu mi hmuahhmuah, lawng hnaṭuan pawl le tidai parih pumcawmnak a hawltu hmuahhmuah hlapi ah an ding ih,"},"18":{"text":"khawpi a kangnak meikhu an hmuh tikah, “Hi khawlipi bangtuk khawpi ziangtik hmanah a um dah lo,” tiah an au."},"19":{"text":"An lu ah leivut phulh aw in an ṭap an raak ih, “ṭihnungza le tuksumza a va si so, hi khawpi hrangah cun! Tangphawlawng a nei ih ti parah sum a tuahtu hmuahhmuah cu hi nunau ih lennak thawngin milian ih an cannak khawpi a si. Asinain nazi pakhat sungah a neihmi hmuahhmuah a cemfai ṭheh a si!” an ti."},"20":{"text":"Maw van, Babilon a siatral ruangah na lungawi aw! Maw Pathian mithiang pawl, tirhthlah pawl le profet pawl, lungawi aipuang in um uh! Ziangahtile nan parih a thiltuahmi ruangah Pathian hnen ihsin cawhkuan a tong zo."},"21":{"text":"Cule a cak zetmi vancungmi pakhat in lungto pakhat, fang rialnak lungtlep tumpi tia khi a khai ih tifinriat sungah a vun hlon ih, “Hi bangtuk in Babilon khawlipi cu vuakthlakmi bangin hlon a si ding ih zohman in an hmu sal nawn lo ding."},"22":{"text":"Babilon khawlipi ṭingṭang tum thawng le minung awzai, phirivau tum thiam pawl in phirivau an tum thawng le tawtawrawt tum thiam pawl ih an tawtawrawt tum thawng cu na sungah a thang nawn lo ding. Ziangbangtuk hnaṭuan a si khalle hnaṭuantu na sungah an um nawn lo ding. Fang rial awn thawng na thei nawn lo ding."},"23":{"text":"Ziangtik hmanah na sungah mei-inn a vang nawn lo ding. Nupi ṭhi tlangval aw siseh mothar aw siseh na sungah a leng nawn lo ding. Na sungih sumtuahtu pawl cu leilung tlunah huham nei bik an si, sikhalsehla na dawithiamnak in leilungtlun mi hmuahhmuah cu na bum ṭheh a si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Profet le Pathian mithiang pawl ih thisen a sungih a luan ruangah Babilon cu hrem a tong zo. A si, leilung tlunih thah a tuartu pawl ih thisen cu hi khawsungah a luang a si."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah vancungah mi tampi-ih aw bangtuk ka thei ih, “Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh! Rundamnak le sunlawinak le huham cu kan Pathian ih ta an si!"},"2":{"text":"A thuṭhennak cu a dik le a dingmi an si. Hlawhhlang nu, a taksa hiar sualnak thawn leilung a balhtertu cu hrem a si zo. Pathian riantu pawl a thah ruangah amah cu Pathian in a hremsuak zo a si,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cule ringzet in, “Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh! Khawlipi a kang ruangih meikhu cu kumkhua in vanah a kai a si,” tiah an au lala."},"4":{"text":"Cutikah upa kul hluanli le thilnung pali cu an bok ih bawi tokham parih a totu Pathian cu an biak. Annih in, “Amen! Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule bawi tokham ihsin aw pakhat a ra thang ih, “Kan Pathian cu thangṭhat uh; a riantu pawl le a minung pawl, a tum a te ti loin amah a ṭihzahtu hmuahhmuah in thangṭhat uh,” tiah a ti.","title":"Tuufa Nupi ṭhit Puai"},"6":{"text":"Cuih hnuah miburpi ih aw bangtuk, a hrual in a hrual awmi tisuar aw bangtuk, khua a ri durdomi aw bangtuk ka thei. Cuih aw in, “Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh! Ziangahtile Bawipa, Ziangkimtithei kan Pathian cu Siangpahrang a si!"},"7":{"text":"Lungawi aipuang in um uhsi! A maksaknak cu thangṭhat uhsi! Ziangahtile Tuufa nupi ṭhit caan a thleng zo ih monu khal ṭhit awknak puai hrangah timtuah ciain a um zo."},"8":{"text":"A hruk dingah patzai in tahmi puanrang a tleu zetmi cu pek a si zo,” tiah an ti ka thei. Cuih patzai ih tahmi puanrang cu Pathian minung pawl ih thilṭha tuahmi a si."},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi in, “Himi hi ngan aw: Tuufa nupi ṭhit puai ih sawmmi pawl cu mi lungawi an si. Hi thu hi Pathian thudik a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cutikah amah biak dingah a kehramah ka bok, asinain anih in, “Khatiin bok hlah! Kei khal nangmah bangtuk siahhlawh ka si ve; Jesuh in a phuanmi thutak a pomhngettu nan unau lakah pakhat ka si ve. Pathian lawng biak ding a si,” tiah a ti. Jesuh ih a phuanmi thutak hi a si profet pawl thinlung a thotertu cu!"},"11":{"text":"Cule vancung khi a ong aw ka hmu ih rang raang pakhat a lang. A parih a totu cu Rintlak le Midik tiah kawhmi a si. Thu a ṭhen tikah le ral a do tikah dingnak thawn a ṭhen ih a do a si.","title":"Rang Raang Parih A Totu"},"12":{"text":"A mit tla cu meisa bangtuk in a alh ih a lu parah bawi lukhuh tampi a khum. A parah a hmin ngan ciain a um, asinain amah siar lo zohman in cuih hmin cu an thei lo."},"13":{"text":"A hnipuan hrukmi cu thisen sungih hnimmi a si. A hmin cu, “Pathian Thu,” ti a si."},"14":{"text":"Vancung ralkap pawl in patzai ih tahmi puanrang thiang hruk in le rang raang parah to tahratin amah cu an thlun."},"15":{"text":"A kaa sung ihsin a hriam zetmi ralnam pakhat a ra suak ih cumi thawn miphun tampi a neh ding. Thirfung thawn a uk ding ih Ziangkimtithei Pathian thinhengnak cu sabit rialnak sungih sabit an pal bangin a pal ding."},"16":{"text":"A puan parah le a kawng ah hmin an ngan ih, “Siangpahrang hmuahhmuah lakih Siangpahrang sin, bawi hmuahhmuah lakih Bawi bik,” ti a si."},"17":{"text":"Cule vancungmi pakhat ni parih a din kha ka hmu. Van ih a zammi vate hnenah aw ring zetin a au ih, “Pathian ih puai tumpi a tuah dingmi kha ra zawh khawm uh."},"18":{"text":"Ra uhla siangpahrang pawl, ralkap hotu bawi pawl, ralkap pawl, rang le rang totu pawl, mi hmuahhmuah, sal siseh miluat siseh, mitum siseh mite siseh, cu pawl ih sa ra ei uh,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cule sahrang le leilung tlun siangpahrang pawl le an ralkap pawl cu rang parih a totu le a ralkap pawl do dingah hmun khatah an khawm aw."},"20":{"text":"Sahrang cu an kai ih a mithmuh ah hmuhsaknak mak tampi a tuahtu profet deu khal an kaih cih. Cuih khawruahhar a tuahnak in sahrang hminsinnak a kengtu le sahrang lem a biatu pawl cu a bum. Sahrang le profet deu cu hmun khatah kaatmei thawn a alh ringringmi meilipi sungah an nungcung in an hlon."},"21":{"text":"An ralkap pawl cu rang parih a totu pa ih kaa sung ihsin a suakmi ralnam in an that. Cule an sa cu vate hmuahhmuah in an ei thei zat in an ei."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule vancung ihsin vancungmi pakhat a rung ṭum ih a kut in tawpneilo khur onnak tawhfung le a rit zetmi thir cikcin a ken kha ka hmu.","title":"Kum Thawng Khat"},"2":{"text":"Cuih vancungmi in khua hlanlai ihsin rulpi a si mi rulhreng cu a kaih ih thir cikcin in a khit ih tawpneilo khur ahcun kum thawngkhat sung a thlak. Cuih rulhreng cu Khawsia a si lole Satan timi cu a si."},"3":{"text":"Kum thawngkhat a kim hlanah cun zohman bum nawn hlah seh tiah cuih khur sungah cun tawh a hren ih hminsinnak tacik a khen cih. Cuih hnuah caan malte sung thlah sal a si ding."},"4":{"text":"Cule bawi tokham pawl le a parih a totu, thuṭhen theinak an hnenih pek a si mi pawl ka hmu. Jesuh ih a phuanmi thutak le Pathian thu an phuan ruangih thah a tuartu pawl ih thlarau pawl ka hmu. Annih pawl cun sahrang an bia lo, a lem khal an bia lo; sahrang ih hminsinnak cu an cal ah siseh an baan ah siseh an nei lo. An nung sal ih siangpahrang tokham parah to in Khrih thawn kum thawngkhat sung an uk."},"5":{"text":"A dang mithi pawl cu kum thawngkhat a cem hlanah cun an thosal hrih lo. Himi hi mithi thawhsalnak hmaisa bik a si."},"6":{"text":"Hi bangtuk in mithi thawhsalnak a hmaisa bikih a teltu cu mi lungawi le mi thluasuak an si. Voihnih thihnak in an tlunah thu a nei nawn lo. Pathian le Khrih hrangah puithiam an ṭuan ding ih amah thawn kum thawngkhat sung an uk ding."},"7":{"text":"Kum thawngkhat hnuah Satan cu a thawng tlaknak ihsin suah a si ding ih,","title":"Satan A Sung"},"8":{"text":"leilung tlun khuazakipah ṭeekdarhmi miphun pawl bum dingah a feh ding; cuih miphun pawl cu Gog le Magog ti an si. Raldo dingah Satan in hmunkhatah a finkhawm ding; anmah cu tifinriat kapih vunnel zat an si ding."},"9":{"text":"Leilung tlun khuazakipah an feh ih Pathian minung pawl umnak hmun le a duh zetmi khawpi kha an kulh ṭheh. Asinain van ihsin meisa a rung tla ih a kang that ṭheh hai."},"10":{"text":"Cule anmah bumtu Satan cu sahrang le profet deu an hlonnak, kaat meilipi sungah an hlon. Cutawkah a sun a zanin hrem ringring an si ding."},"11":{"text":"Cule a maksak zetmi bawi tokham raang le a parih a totu ka hmu. Bawi tokham parih a totu mithmuh ihsin van le leilung cu an tlan ih hmuh theih an si nawn lo.","title":"Netabik Thuṭhennak"},"12":{"text":"A thi ciami pawl cu a tum a sen in bawi tokham hmaiah an ding ka hmu. Cabu pawl an kau; cuih hnuah nunnak cabu timi cabu dang pakhat an kau lala. Mithi pawl cu cuih cabu sungih an rak khum ciami an hnaṭuan vekin an thu ṭhen a si."},"13":{"text":"Cule tifinriat in a sungih ummi mithi pawl a hun suah. Thihnak le mithi khua khal in an hren cihmi mithi pawl an hun suah ve. An zatein an hnaṭuan ciami vekin thuṭhen an si ṭheh."},"14":{"text":"Cule thihnak le mithi khua cu tilipi vek a si mi meilipi sungah thlak an si. Hi meilipi cu voihnih thihnak kha a si."},"15":{"text":"Zokhal nunnak cabu sungih hmin ngan lomi cu meilipi sungah hlon an si."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuih hnuah van thar le lei thar ka hmu. A hmaisa ih a rak ummi van le leilung kha cu an hlota ih tifinriat khal a um nawn lo.","title":"Van Thar Le Lei Thar"},"2":{"text":"Cule Khawpi Thianghlim Jerusalem thar cu, a pasal dingmi tong dingah cei-aw in a timtuah awmi monu vekin Pathian hnen vancung ihsin a rung ṭum kha ka hmu."},"3":{"text":"Bawi tokham ihsin aw ringzet ka thei ih, “Pathian umnak inn cu minung hnenah a si zo. Amah cu an hnenah a um ding ih annih tla cu amah ih minung an si ding. Pathian Amah rori an hnenah a um ding ih an Pathian a si ding."},"4":{"text":"An mitthli hmuahhmuah a hnul sak ding. Thih a um nawn lo ding; ninghang riahsiat, aihram ṭahnak le natnak a um nawn lo ding. Ziangahtile thil hlun pawl cu an hlo ṭheh zo,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cule bawi tokham parih a totu in, “Zohhnik uh, thil hmuahhmuah a thar in ka tuah a si,” tiah a ti. Ka hnenah, “Himi thu hi ngan aw, ziangahtile a dikmi le zumtlak thu a si,” tiah i ti."},"6":{"text":"Cule, “Ziangkim ṭheh thluh a si zo. Keimah cu Alfa le Omega ka si, a thawhnak le a cemnetnak ka si. Zokhal ti a haaltu cu nunnak cerhti in dingah man loin ka pe ding."},"7":{"text":"Nehtu hmuahhmuah in himi hi an co ding. An Pathian ka si ding ih annih cu ka faale an si ding."},"8":{"text":"Sikhalsehla ṭihhrutmi, zumnak bansantu, fihnungza tuahtu, mi a that hrimtu, nupa sualnak a tuahtu, dawithiam pawl, milem a biatu le thuphanpertu pawl ih umnak ding hmun cu kaat meilipi sungah a si ding ih cumi cu voihnih thihnak a si,” tiah i ti."},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi pasarih lakih a neta bik, natsia pasarih in a khatmi kheng pasarih a kengtu in ka hnenah, “Ra aw, Tuufa ih nupi ding Mo cu ka lo hmuh ding,” tiah i ti.","title":"Jerusalem Thar"},"10":{"text":"Thlarau in i zeel ih vancungmi in a saang zetmi tlang parah i fehpi. Cule Jerusalem, Khawpi Thianghlim cu Pathian hnen vancung in a rung ṭum kha i hmuh."},"11":{"text":"Pathian sunlawinak thawn a tleumi Khawpi a si; Jasper timi lunghring mankhung bangin a tleu ih thlalang bangin a fai."},"12":{"text":"A kimvel in a saang zetmi phar in an kulh ih kotka hleihnih a nei; cuih kotka cu vancungmi hleihnih in an kil. Cuih kotka ahcun Israel miphun hleihnih ih hmin an ngan."},"13":{"text":"Siir khatah kotka pathum fingfing an um: nisuahnak lamah pathum, thlanglam ah pathum, saklam ah pathum le nitlaknak lamah pathum an um."},"14":{"text":"Khawpi kulhnak phar cu inn-hramṭohnak lungto hleihnih parih phunmi a si; cuih lungto parah cun Tuufa ih tirhthlah hleihnih pawl ih hmin an ngan."},"15":{"text":"Ka hnenah i simtu vancungmi in khawpi le a phar le a kotka pawl tahnak ah sui tahfung a keng."},"16":{"text":"Khawpi cu a kauhlam le a saulam le a saanlam a bangaw ṭheh. Vancungmi in a tahfung thawn cuih khawpi cu a tah: a saulam peng thawngkhat le zanga, a kauhlam peng thawngkhat le zanga a si ih a saanlam khal peng thawngkhat le zanga thotho a si."},"17":{"text":"Vancungmi in milai ih tahfung thawn phar khal a tah ih pi zahnih le hleiruk a saang."},"18":{"text":"Phar cu Jasper timi lunghring mankhung in an tuah ih khawpi cu thlalang bangin a fai mi sui hlir in tuahmi a si."},"19":{"text":"Khawpi hramṭohnak lungto cu lungmankhung a phunphun in mawitermi a si. A pakhatnak cu jasper timi lunghring mankhung a si, a pahnihnak cu safaira timi mepian lungmankhung a si, a pathumnak cu agate timi hring-eu lungmankhung a si, a palinak cu emerald timi hringdup lungmankhung a si;"},"20":{"text":"a panganak cu onix timi lungsen mankhung a si, a paruknak cu karnelian timi a sendupmi lungmankhung a si, a pasarihnak cu aihre le sui pianzia rawimi quartz lungmankhung a si, a pariatnak cu beriil timi mepian le a hring rawimi lungmankhung a si, a pakuanak cu topaz timi aihre lungmankhung a si, a pahranak cu khalsidoni timi a pawlmi lungmankhung a si, hleikhatnak cu turquoise timi a sen le aihre rawimi lungmankhung a si ih hleihnihnak cu amethyst timi a eengmi lungmankhung a si."},"21":{"text":"Kotka hleihnih cu tikep lungmankhung hleihnih in tuahmi an si; kotka ih kipin tikep lungmankhung pakhat fingfingih tuahmi an si. Khawpi lamzin cu sui hlir in tuahmi a si ih thlalang bangin a fai."},"22":{"text":"Cuih khawpi ah biakinn a um lo, ziangahtile a biakinn cu Ziangkimtithei Bawipa Pathian le Tuufa a si."},"23":{"text":"Ni le thlapi ih tleunak khal a ṭul lo, ziangahtile Pathian sunlawinak cu cuih khawpi ah a tleu ih an mei-inn cu Tuufa a si."},"24":{"text":"Leilung tlun mi hmuahhmuah in cuih khawpi tleunak thawngin fehnak an hmu ding ih leilung tlun siangpahrang pawl in cuih khawpi sungah an lennak sumsaw an keng ding."},"25":{"text":"Cuih khawpi kotka pawl cu sun nihlawh in on an si ding; ziangtik hmanah an khar lo ding, ziangahtile cutawkah zan a um nawn lo."},"26":{"text":"Leilung miphun hmuahhmuah in an phun lennak le sunlawinak cu cuih khawpi ah an rak keng ciar ding."},"27":{"text":"Sikhalsehla cuih khawpi sungah a thiang lomi zianghman a lut lo ding; ningsinza thil a tuahtu le thuphanpertu khal an lut lo ding. Tuufa nunnak cabu sungih hmin nganmi lawng an lut ding."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cule cuih vancungmi cun thlalang bangin a tleumi nunnak tiva i hmuh. Cuih tiva cu Pathian le Tuufa ih bawi tokham ihsin a puut ih,"},"2":{"text":"khawpi lamzin laifang in a luang. Cuih tiva kap hnih ah nunnak thingkung a um ih thla khat voikhat in kum khatah voihleihnih an rah. Cule thinghnah cu mi phunkip hrangah damnak a si."},"3":{"text":"Pathian ih camsiat a tongtu zianghman cuih khawpi sungah a um thei lo ding. Pathian le Tuufa ih bawi tokham cu cuih khawpi ah a um ding ih a siahhlawh pawl in amah cu an biak ding."},"4":{"text":"Hmaiton in an hmu aw ding ih a hmin cu an cal ah ngan a si ding."},"5":{"text":"Cuih hmunah zan a um nawn lo ding; mei-inn siseh nitleu siseh an ṭul lo ding, ziangahtile Bawipa Pathian cu an tleunak a si ding ih siangpahrang bangin kumkhua in an uk lanta ding."},"6":{"text":"Cule vancungmi in ka hnenah, “Hi thu pawl hi a dikmi le zumtlak an si. Profet pawl hnenah a Thlarau a thlahtu Bawipa Pathian in a thleng cing dingmi thil kha Amah ih siahhlawh pawl theihter dingah a vancungmi a thlah a si,” tiah i ti.","title":"Jesuh Ratsalnak"},"7":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ngai uh, ka ra cing ding. Hi cabu sungih nganmi profet ṭongkam a thluntu cu mi lungawi an si,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Keimah Johan in hipawl hi ka hmu ih ka thei. Cutiin ka hmu ih ka theih hnuah hi bangtuk thil i hmuhtu vancungmi ih kehramah ka bok ih a biak ka tum."},"9":{"text":"Asinain anih in, “I bia hlah! Kei khal nangmah le na unau profet pawl le hi cabu sungih nganmi thu a thluntu pawl bangtuk in Pathian ih siahhlawh ka si ve! Pathian bia sawn aw!” tiah i ti."},"10":{"text":"Cule ka hnenah, “Hi cabu sungih nganmi profet ṭongkam hi thup hlah, ziangahtile hi thu pawl hi a kim cing ding."},"11":{"text":"Zokhal thil ṭha lo a tuahtu cu tuah hrih ko seh; fihnungza a si mi cu fihnungza in nung hrih ko seh; thil ṭha a tuahtu cu tuah hrih ko seh; cule a thianghlimmi cu thianghlim in um hrih ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Jesuh in, “Ngai uh! Ka ra cing ding! An hnaṭuan vekih pe ciar dingah ṭuanman ka rak keng ding."},"13":{"text":"Keimah cu Alfa le Omega, a hmaisa bik le a neta bik, a thawhnak le a cemnetnak ka si,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"An hnipuan fai zetin an sawp ih nunnak thingkungih rah ei theinak thu le khawpi sungah kotka ihsin luh theinak thu a neitu cu mi lungawi an si."},"15":{"text":"Sikhalsehla uico bangtuk in a nungmi, dawithiam pawl, nupa sualnak a tuahtu, mi a thattu pawl, milem a biatu pawl le an ṭong in siseh, an tuahnak in siseh, thuphanper pawl cu khawpi lengah an um ding."},"16":{"text":"“Keimah Jesuh in hi thu hi kawhhran pawl hnenih than dingah ka vancungmi nan hnenah ka run thlah. Keimah hi David ih hram le tesinfa ka si; keimah hi deirel arsi tleu ka si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Thlarau le Mo cun, “Ra aw,” an ti. Hi thu a theitu hmuahhmuah in, “Ra aw,” tiah ti ciar hai seh. Tihal mi hmuahhmuah in ra uh; nunnak tidai a duhtu hmuahhmuah in man loin ra in uh."},"18":{"text":"Keimah Johan in, hi cabu sungih nganmi profet ṭongkam a theitu hmuahhmuah hnenah, ralrinnak ka lo pek; hi profet ṭongkam tlunah zokhal thudang a bettu cu Pathian in a parah hi cabu sungih nganmi natsia hremnak kha a bet ve ding.","title":"Thunetnak"},"19":{"text":"Cule zokhal hi cabu sungih profet ṭongkam nganmi hi a phiat hlotu cu hi cabu sungih ngan ciami a co dingmi nunnak thingrah le Khawpi Thianghlim sungih luh theinak a co dingmi kha Pathian in a phiat hlosak ve ding."},"20":{"text":"Hi thu hmuahhmuah a phuangtu in, “A si! Ka ra cing ding,” tiah a ti. Amen! Bawipa Jesuh, ra thlang aw!"},"21":{"text":"Bawipa Jesuh ih zaangfahnak cu nan zate hnenah um hram seh."}}}}}}}
